articles.title: Integral zeros of Krawtchouk polynomials and quantum entanglements
articles.title_zh: Krawtchouk多项式的整数零点与量子纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08518v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In Heo and Kiem (2019), the authors raised a problem relating integral zeros of binary Krawtchouk polynomials, parametrized by quadruples (m,n,k,ell) with młe n and kłe ell, to the existence of pairs of subspaces satisfying the range criterion in quantum information theory, and settled the symmetric case k=ell. In this paper, we solve the problem for the following three asymmetric families: (m,n,k,ell)=(3,t²⁻¹,t(t-1)/2,t(t+1)/2), tge2; (m,n,k,ell)=(4,3t²⁺²t-1,(3t²⁻t)/2,(3t²⁺⁵t+2)/2), tge2; (m,n,k,ell)=(4,3s²⁺⁴s,(3s²⁺s)/2,(3s²⁺⁷s+4)/2), sge1. The remaining cases are sporadic zeros, with only finitely many for each mge5.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文解决了Heo和Kiem (2019)提出的一个问题，该问题将二元Krawtchouk多项式的整数零点与量子信息理论中满足范围判据的子空间对的存在性联系起来。作者解决了三种不对称情况下的问题，并指出其余情况为零星零点。这项工作对理解Krawtchouk多项式在量子信息理论中的应用具有重要意义。
authors: Jaeseong Heo, Young-Hoon Kiem, Chul-hee Lee

articles.title: Universality in Quantum Many-Body Spin Ratchets
articles.title_zh: 量子多体自旋棘轮中的普适性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08590v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider a class of quantum circuits, known as quantum many-body spin ratchets, which act on alternating spin chains with two distinct spin types on even and odd sites. This setup breaks parity symmetry and exhibits chiral transport. It has been shown that the drift velocity in the case of integrable, SU(2)-symmetric quantum spin ratchets is universal, and conjectured that the same holds in the non-integrable case. Here, we prove that this universal drift is exact at all times, requiring only translation invariance and U(1) symmetry. Furthermore, we prove that it is sufficient for the circuit to be translation-invariant on average by deriving the same result in the random case. Finally, we demonstrate that breaking translation invariance immediately results in deviations from this universal prediction.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一类量子多体自旋棘轮，其在交替自旋链上作用，并展现出手性输运。作者证明了在仅需平移不变性和U(1)对称性的条件下，漂移速度的普适性在所有时间都是精确的。研究还表明，即使电路平均平移不变，该普适性也成立，但打破平移不变性会导致与普适预测的偏差。
authors: Andrea Azzali, Marko Ljubotina

articles.title: Exploring topological signatures of quantum Fisher information scaling in graph states
articles.title_zh: 探索图态中量子费舍尔信息标度的拓扑特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08593v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graph states are a versatile resource for quantum metrology, and their quantum Fisher information (QFI) has a closed-form expression in terms of the underlying graph: it counts pairs of vertices with identical neighborhoods. It remains unclear, however, which global structural properties of a graph determine whether its QFI exceeds the standard quantum limit (SQL). Here we ask whether topological invariants, namely the Betti numbers of the graph's clique complex, capture this behavior, and we address the question numerically with two complementary approaches. First, we randomly add or delete edges in balanced complete multipartite graphs, which combine a QFI beyond the SQL with a single nonvanishing higher Betti number. Edge addition eventually destroys both the metrological advantage and the nontrivial topology. Under edge deletion, by contrast, higher Betti numbers persist well after the QFI has dropped to the SQL. Second, we start from Erdős--Rényi random graphs, whose QFI does not typically exceed the SQL, and maximize a chosen Betti number with a Monte Carlo search. The search drives the graphs toward near-extremal multipartite structures whose QFI lies well beyond the SQL. Our results show that topological optimization offers a route to metrologically useful graph states, but also that Betti numbers alone do not determine the QFI.
articles.abstract_zh: 图态是量子计量学的重要资源，其量子费舍尔信息（QFI）与图的拓扑结构密切相关。本文探讨了图的拓扑不变量，特别是其团复形的贝蒂数，是否能表征QFI超越标准量子极限（SQL）的行为。研究通过数值模拟发现，边缘的增删会影响计量优势和拓扑结构，为理解图态的计量性能提供了新视角。
authors: Majid Hassani, Patrick Emonts, Jordi Tura

articles.title: What are local complementations, really?
articles.title_zh: 局部补全究竟是什么？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08620v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A local complementation at a vertex v of a graph G replaces the induced neighborhood of v with its complement. Local complementations are, at face value, peculiar operations. Yet they famously show up when describing the local Clifford equivalence among graph states, and, because of this, have become a fundamental notion in the study of graph states. Following Bouchet, we show here how local complementations on graphs are more naturally thought of in terms of switchings of (matroid) bases of stabilizer states. Bases and switchings reveal structural properties of stabilizer states that are harder to glean from the graph-theoretic description alone, such as vertex-minors and statistics of local Pauli measurements. Bases also simplify prior proofs about graphs up to local complementations, of which we give several examples. Bases are foundational in the study of (multi)matroids; as such this paper serves as a gentle introduction to the applications of multimatroids to quantum information theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 局部补全作为图操作，在描述图态的局部Clifford等价性中扮演着核心角色。本文借鉴Bouchet的观点，将图上的局部补全更自然地解释为稳定器态（拟阵）基的切换。这种基于基和切换的视角揭示了稳定器态的结构特性，并简化了关于图在局部补全下的证明。该工作也为多拟阵在量子信息理论中的应用提供了入门介绍。
authors: Kenneth Goodenough

articles.title: Neutral-atom quantum features as complementary structural encodings for graph learning
articles.title_zh: 中性原子量子特征作为图学习的互补结构编码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08821v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Structural descriptors provide graph neural networks (GNNs) with positional and topological inductive biases. However, widely used classical encodings based on random walks or Laplacian spectra emphasize specific structural statistics of a graph, leaving room for alternative descriptors. Neutral-atom quantum processing units (QPUs) can realize graph-dependent Rydberg Hamiltonians, allowing graph topology to be probed through dynamical correlation measurements. In this work, we use these measurements as quantum graph features (QGFs), providing a complementary, hardware-derived family of structural encoding that is not accurately described by classical features derived from Laplacian and adjacency matrices, even when supplemented with an extended set of random-walk, geometric descriptors and classical physical models. By appropriately selecting the quench parameters of the Hamiltonian, we access two characteristic correlation regimes with distinct structural signatures: antiferromagnetic-like and ferromagnetic-like. On an intrinsic information benchmark of 15 topological and spectral probing tasks, quantum and hybrid quantum-classical features match or surpass classical descriptors on local topological properties. When supplied to message-passing, attention, and graph-transformer backbones, hybrid quantum-classical features yield improvements that are within cross-fold noise on most cells but sign-consistent across architectures. When comparing noiseless, shot-sampled emulation-derived quantum features with a neutral-atom QPU implementation, the downstream hybrid results with compressed hardware features match their emulated counterparts within 0.01 F₁ on all backbones. On a synthetic family of ladder graphs, QGFs distinguish two specific classes, outperforming the strongest classical structural descriptors by a margin exceeding cross-fold variability.
articles.abstract_zh: 图神经网络（GNNs）依赖结构描述符来获取位置和拓扑归纳偏置。本文提出利用中性原子量子处理单元（QPUs）的动态关联测量作为量子图特征（QGFs），为图学习提供了一种互补的、硬件衍生的结构编码。这些QGFs无法被传统经典特征准确描述，并在多项拓扑和谱探测任务中展现出优异性能。
authors: Mathieu Garrigues, Igor O. Sokolov, Matthias Hecker, Lorenzo Moro, Shaheen Acheche

articles.title: Quantum-Enhanced Classical Communications for DPMZM-based NG-PON2 Systems
articles.title_zh: 基于DPMZM的NG-PON2系统中量子增强的经典通信
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09081v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents a framework for integrating quantum detection techniques into a Dual-Parallel Mach-Zehnder Modulator (DPMZM)-based Next Generation Passive Optical Network 2 (NG-PON2) communication system. We present a system model for the DPMZM-based NG-PON2 quantum communication system and characterize its signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), demonstrating its superiority over conventional MZM-based systems. We analyze the performance of various quantum modulation techniques, including binary phase-shift keying, quadrature phase-shift keying, and M-ary quadrature amplitude modulation. A comprehensive analytical framework is developed to evaluate the SNR, BER, and mutual information for both classical and quantum detection schemes within the DPMZM-based NG-PON2 quantum communication system. Our simulation results show that quantum detection significantly outperforms classical detection, and the DPMZM architecture further enhances the performance over the baseline MZM architecture by improving the effective modulation efficiency and receiver sensitivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个将量子检测技术集成到基于双平行马赫-曾德尔调制器（DPMZM）的下一代无源光网络2（NG-PON2）通信系统中的框架。研究建立了系统模型并分析了信噪比（SNR），证明了其优于传统MZM系统。仿真结果表明，量子检测显著优于经典检测，且DPMZM架构通过提高调制效率和接收灵敏度进一步增强了性能。
authors: Parvin Kumar, Sourav Banerjee, Neel Kanth Kundu, Umesh Sharma

articles.title: Parametric CZ Gates in a Tunable Tripod Architecture with Fixed-Frequency Superconducting Qubits
articles.title_zh: 可调三脚架架构中固定频率超导量子比特的参数化CZ门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09105v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Efficient implementation of the operations required for quantum error correction in superconducting quantum computers requires high gate fidelity, adequate qubit connectivity, and selective control of interactions. Sharing a single coupler among multiple qubits can improve connectivity, but also requires accounting for its effects on qubits outside the target pair. In this work, we numerically investigate the feasibility of implementing parametric-resonance CZ gates in a tunable tripod structure consisting of three fixed-frequency transmon qubits connected to a single tunable coupler. We modulate the external flux applied to the coupler and optimize the pulse parameters for each qubit pair to construct CZ₀₁, CZ₀₂, and CZ₁₂ gates. We calculate the time evolution of a Hamiltonian that includes three energy levels for each circuit element and evaluate gate fidelity and leakage after virtual Z correction. The fidelities obtained for the target-pair computational blocks, whose input and output basis states have both the coupler and spectator qubit in their ground states, are 0.9943, 0.9834, and 0.9907, respectively. We also find that population preservation at the end of the gate depends on the initial state of the spectator qubit. These results demonstrate the possibility of constructing CZ operations for each qubit pair through flux modulation of a shared coupler while maintaining fixed data-qubit frequencies. They also highlight the need to evaluate performance and optimize control over the full computational space, including the spectator qubit.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文数值研究了在由三个固定频率transmon量子比特连接到一个可调耦合器组成的可调三脚架结构中实现参数共振CZ门的可行性。通过调制耦合器的外部磁通并优化脉冲参数，作者构建了CZ₀₁、CZ₀₂和CZ₁₂门。计算得到的门保真度分别为0.9943、0.9834和0.9907，表明该架构在量子纠错操作中具有潜力。
authors: Chanpyo Kim, Hansol Kim, Jeongsoo Kang, Younghun Kwon

articles.title: Exploring Variational Regularization of Krylov Subspaces
articles.title_zh: 探索Krylov子空间的变分正则化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09229v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Krylov subspace methods efficiently approximate extremal eigenstates and eigenvalues of many-body Hamiltonians, but non-orthogonal bases can suffer from ill-conditioning. This challenge is amplified in quantum computing, where direct state access and thus straightforward orthogonalization are unavailable. We investigate a variational Krylov-like framework that iteratively optimizes a parametrized sequence of states to mimic Lanczos-like couplings while penalizing linear dependencies. Analyzed against exact Krylov and Lanczos on a finite Anderson impurity model, ansatz expressivity strongly influences the performance: Hamiltonian-inspired ansätze preserve Krylov-like convergence while improving the conditioning, whereas shallow ansätze remain stable but miss low-energy directions.
articles.abstract_zh: Krylov子空间方法在近似多体哈密顿量的本征态和本征值方面表现高效，但在量子计算中，非正交基可能导致病态问题。本文研究了一种变分Krylov类框架，通过迭代优化参数化态序列来模拟Lanczos耦合并惩罚线性依赖。研究发现，哈密顿量启发的ansatz在保持Krylov类收敛性的同时改善了条件数，而浅层ansatz虽然稳定但可能错过低能方向。
authors: Alexandre Perrin, Jérémie Messud, Sébastien Burdin, Matthieu Saubanère

articles.title: Optimal performance of driven-dissipative many-body quantum batteries beyond complete nonreciprocity
articles.title_zh: 超越完全非互易性的驱动耗散多体量子电池的最佳性能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09434v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Proposals for nonreciprocal quantum batteries identify the point of complete nonreciprocity, where coherent and reservoir-mediated couplings balance, as the operating point for enhanced charging. We show that, for batteries built from interacting qubits, this point is, in general, suboptimal. The optimal design is set by a more intricate interplay between the coherent coupling and the local and collective dissipation rates, of which complete nonreciprocity is only a special case. We consider a many-body battery charged by a driven many-body charger, with each qubit coupled to a local bath and the complete setup immersed in a shared engineered reservoir. For a weakly driven two-qubit setup, we prove the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction to be the optimal coupling, and show that the battery capacity is maximized at a coupling strength fixed by the local and collective dissipation rates, which coincides with complete nonreciprocity only for a specific balance between them. The shared reservoir enhances the capacity for couplings weaker or stronger than both local dissipation rates, and can increase the extractable work even where it reduces the capacity. At strong drive, with the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction between the charger and the battery, the capacity is bounded by 1/2. For qubits arranged in a star network with a single central battery qubit, these results remain qualitatively unchanged, while the maximum capacity of a battery charged by N_A weakly driven charger qubits saturates with N_A in the presence of the shared reservoir, approaching its limit as N_A⁻¹. In contrast, the maximum capacity of N_B qubit batteries charged by a single-qubit charger decays as N_B⁻².
articles.abstract_zh: 非互易量子电池的现有研究通常将完全非互易点视为增强充电的最佳工作点。本文指出，对于由相互作用量子比特构建的电池，该点通常并非最优。最佳设计由相干耦合、局部和集体耗散率之间更复杂的相互作用决定。研究发现，Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用是弱驱动双量子比特设置中的最佳耦合，且电池容量在由耗散率决定的特定耦合强度下最大化。
authors: Vimal Sreekanth, Chandrima B. Pushpan, Amit Kumar Pal

articles.title: Sharp error tolerance of the monogamy-of-entanglement game
articles.title_zh: 纠缠一夫一妻制博弈的精确误差容忍度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09504v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The BB84 monogamy-of-entanglement (MoE) game has numerous applications in quantum cryptography, including quantum key distribution, position verification, and unclonable encryption. In this short note, we improve the error threshold for parallel repetition with identical answer strings from the approximately 3.7% certified by the original bound to the sharp threshold (1-1/sqrt2)/2approx14.64%. When the players need not give identical answers, we also obtain exponential decay whenever the sum of their error tolerances is below this threshold. These bounds strengthen existing security reductions to the BB84 MoE game, improving security bounds and certified noise tolerances for cryptographic protocols.
articles.abstract_zh: BB84纠缠一夫一妻制（MoE）博弈在量子密码学中具有广泛应用。本文将该博弈在相同答案串并行重复情况下的误差阈值从约3.7%提高到精确的约14.64%。当玩家无需给出相同答案时，只要其误差容忍度之和低于此阈值，也会出现指数衰减。这些更强的界限提升了现有安全归约的性能，从而改进了密码协议的安全界限和认证噪声容忍度。
authors: Llorenç Escolà-Farràs, Florian Speelman

articles.title: Direct-decision quantum sensing for classifying transient NMR signals
articles.title_zh: 用于瞬态核磁共振信号分类的直接决策量子传感
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09512v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Task-oriented quantum sensing aims to extract decision-relevant information directly, without first reconstructing the full signal. We study this approach for mixture-threshold classification of transient NMR-like signals generated from molecular spin Hamiltonians, motivated by small-volume molecular sensing. Using analytical models and numerical simulations, we compare classical coil readout followed by matched-filter classification with quantum computational sensing (QCS), in which trainable controls interleaved with signal-driven sensor-qubit evolution map the transient directly to a decision score. We consider both the sensor-ensemble limit and strict single-sensor single-shot readout. Increasing QCS control depth can improve robustness and class-dependent output contrast. Ensemble accuracy can rise rapidly for some waveform pairs, whereas single-shot correctness improves more gradually because one projective outcome must distinguish the classes. Repeated acquisitions improve both routes by averaging independent fluctuations, while disorder-aware training mitigates quasistatic inhomogeneity in the modeled sensor ensemble. QCS can outperform inductive readout under the modeled conditions, for example when coil transfer is weak or receiver noise limits coil performance. However, the simulated QCS protocols at lower effective sensor coupling require long sensing intervals, whereas short-time protocols require a much stronger effective drive at the sensor. Practical advantage therefore depends on jointly attainable source-signal strength, signal-to-sensor transfer, qubit coherence, and readout resources.
articles.abstract_zh: 任务导向的量子传感旨在直接提取决策相关信息，而非重建完整信号。本文研究了这种方法在瞬态核磁共振（NMR）类信号混合阈值分类中的应用。研究比较了经典线圈读出与量子计算传感（QCS），发现增加QCS控制深度可以提高鲁棒性和输出对比度。重复采集和考虑无序的训练可以进一步提升QCS的性能，使其在小体积分子传感中具有潜力。
authors: Juha Leppäkangas, Michael Marthaler

articles.title: Twisted Compactification, Quotient Quantum Codes and Logical Gates
articles.title_zh: 扭曲紧致化、商量子码和逻辑门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09538v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many quantum codes, including balanced-product, bivariate-bicycle and genon codes and the five-qubit code, are quotient codes: a larger code folded onto itself by identifying each check with its image under a deck transformation composed with a symmetry. We show that this is the lattice form of twisted compactification, in which a theory on X× F carries a symmetry background along F, and we use the correspondence in both directions. For monomial quotients of Pauli stabilizer codes, a transfer theorem gives the logical qudits, logical operators and distance bounds from those of the parent, with a Tate cohomology group counting the logical operators that are new. For higher-form and cup-product symmetries the twist is an entangling diagonal circuit; when a finite cover trivializes the background, the code is a dressed quotient, so abelian Pauli codes give non-abelian topological order such as D(D₄₎. The dressings have Clifford level at most one less than the degree of the twist, and for cubic twists the code dimension is a count of solutions of quadratic equations in cup products, which certifies that the code is not a Pauli stabilizer code when it is not a power of two; on tori and slabs the distance is linear in the size. Twists also create logical gates: three toric codes on S³ have no logical qubits, but on RP³ the same circuit is a logical CCZ. A quarter-turn twist of the 3D fermionic toric code gives codes of linear distance, from [[768,2,9]] up, whose p+ip pump is an explicit finite-time quasi-local evolution that preserves the code space exactly; using the spin-topological response formula of Barkeshli, Hsin and Kobayashi, we identify its logical action as T up to Clifford factors. Finally, twisting abelian gauge theories reach only the quantum doubles D(G) with [G,G] central.
articles.abstract_zh: 许多量子码，包括平衡积码、双变量双环码和五量子比特码，都是商码，通过对称变换将一个更大的码折叠到自身。本文证明这是一种扭曲紧致化的格点形式，其中理论在对称背景下进行。对于泡利稳定器码的单项式商，一个转移定理给出了逻辑量子比特、逻辑算子和距离界限。
authors: Po-Shen Hsin

articles.title: BQP-Complete Susceptibilities Observable at Ballistic Times in Local Quantum Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 局域量子动力学中弹道时间可观测的BQP完备敏感性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09563v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Local response measurements track how perturbations spread in quantum simulators and nonequilibrium many-body systems. Locality bounds constrain the propagation speed, but do not determine whether the response can distinguish computational outcomes at fixed measurement precision as the distance increases. Here we construct time-independent dynamics with bounded nearest-neighbor interactions in which a fixed single-site detector responds to a remote bond phase after a time proportional to their separation. The susceptibility has a positive lower bound independent of distance. With product-state preparations, estimating this susceptibility to constant additive accuracy is complete for bounded-error quantum polynomial time (BQP), with a decision gap independent of distance. Two source-phase settings give the susceptibility with a distance-independent shot count at fixed accuracy and confidence. Inverse-polynomially weak local couplings between the computational register and the chain carrying the excitation preserve the gap. The leading correction vanishes when exchanging the two internal states of the excitation reverses the interaction. Varying the source and observation time makes all bond phases locally identifiable near the zero-phase reference setting. We also prove a conditional quantum advantage for distribution-free response prediction.
articles.abstract_zh: 局域响应测量追踪扰动在量子模拟器和非平衡多体系统中的传播。本文构建了具有有界最近邻相互作用的瞬态动力学，其中固定单点探测器在与远程键相分离的时间后作出响应。研究发现，以恒定加性精度估计这种敏感性对于有界误差量子多项式时间（BQP）是完备的，且决策间隙与距离无关。
authors: Yuting Lyu

articles.title: Magic Can Superactivate Quantum Capacity
articles.title_zh: “魔力”可以超激活量子容量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09594v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Environmental magic can enable two channels with zero quantum capacity to transmit quantum information jointly. We establish this superactivation within a family of discrete quantum convolution channels with fixed Clifford interactions. For the couplings considered, stabilizer-mixture environments induce entanglement-breaking channels. We construct a mixed magic environment whose induced channel has positive private capacity and a Choi state with positive partial transpose, hence zero quantum capacity. A half-erasure auxiliary activates this channel through the Smith--Yard mechanism. Finite-block encoding and decoding over a self-complementary convolution auxiliary then realize a higher-dimensional erasure channel that still permits activation. We also bound the activated capacity by the modified relative entropy of magic of the main environment. Replacing either environment of the convolution pair by any stabilizer mixture makes the joint quantum capacity vanish, identifying environmental magic as a necessary resource on both sides for this realization.
articles.abstract_zh: 环境中的“魔力”可以使两个量子容量为零的信道共同传输量子信息。本文在一系列具有固定Clifford相互作用的离散量子卷积信道中建立了这种超激活现象。研究构建了一个混合“魔力”环境，其诱导信道具有正的私有容量和零量子容量，并通过辅助信道实现了激活。结果表明，环境“魔力”是实现这种超激活的必要资源。
authors: Chunhe Xiong, Sunho Kim, Shunlong Luo, Lin Zhang, Shao-Ming Fei, Junde Wu

articles.title: Quantum subsets discrimination and key sifting with success probability one
articles.title_zh: 成功概率为一的量子子集判别与密钥筛选
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09604v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Non-distinguishability of non-orthogonal quantum states is the essential feature of quantum mechanics. In particular, one cannot deterministically orthogonalize the set of quantum states, while probabilistic orthogonalization is possible, including unambiguous state discrimination and discrimination between the subsets. Here, we propose a method for error-free subsets discrimination with significantly increased success probability, which may reach one even for non-orthogonal and linearly dependent input states. This method may be applied in quantum cryptography: An alternative basis reconciliation procedure is described, which may provide unit sifting probability even for a large number of bases and for non-orthogonal states within each basis.
articles.abstract_zh: 非正交量子态的不可区分性是量子力学的基本特征。本文提出了一种无误差子集判别方法，即使对于非正交和线性相关的输入态，其成功概率也能显著提高并达到一。该方法可应用于量子密码学，提供了一种替代的基底协调程序，即使在大量基底和每个基底内的非正交态情况下，也能提供单位筛选概率。
authors: D. A. Kronberg

articles.title: Slices for normal forms in quantum information and a Riccati-type equation
articles.title_zh: 量子信息中范式的切片与Riccati型方程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09645v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: It is known that the normal space to an orbit of a compact group linear action meets each orbit. We show that this yields known normal forms for quantum states. We compute the gradient flow converging to the normal form and find it gives a Riccati type matrix-valued ODE.
articles.abstract_zh: 已知紧群线性作用轨道上的法空间与每个轨道相交。本文展示了这可以导出量子态的已知范式。研究计算了收敛到范式的梯度流，并发现它产生了一个Riccati型矩阵值常微分方程。
authors: Ranee Brylinski, Jean-Luc Brylinski

articles.title: Shaping Frequency-Bin Biphoton Correlations via Programmable Optical Frequency Combs
articles.title_zh: 通过可编程光频率梳塑造频率箱双光子关联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09713v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Programmable shaping of photon-pair spectral correlations is important for frequency-bin quantum information processing. However, achieving this control remains challenging in nonlinear optical systems without reliable forward models. Here, we demonstrate model-free, hardware-in-the-loop shaping of the measured joint spectral intensity of a cascaded photon-pair source driven by a programmable optical frequency comb. A blockwise simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation controller optimizes up to 22 pump, signal, and idler parameters. Each iteration requires only two accepted hardware evaluations, independent of the parameter count. The controller converges to diverse target patterns on 3×3, 4×4, and 5×5 frequency-bin grids. The optimized distributions achieve Pearson correlations between 0.66 and 0.98 and classical overlap fidelities between 0.32 and 0.62. Cross-target similarity analysis confirms that the optimized patterns remain target-specific. Source characterization yields a maximum coincidence-to-accidental ratio of approximately 585. Accuracy is limited by pump-phase transfer, parasitic nonlinear background, waveshaper constraints, amplitude-only filtering, and measurement noise. Joint spectral intensity contains no spectral-phase information. Therefore, the results demonstrate control of measured frequency-bin populations and correlations, not complete reconstruction of the two-photon state. Phase-sensitive characterization is required to verify inter-bin coherence and quantify the entanglement dimensionality of the output state. Our results establish direct measurement feedback as a practical approach to reconfigurable frequency-bin correlation engineering when an accurate end-to-end model is unavailable.
articles.abstract_zh: 光子对光谱关联的可编程整形对于频率箱量子信息处理至关重要。本文展示了一种无模型、硬件在环的测量联合光谱强度整形方法，该方法由可编程光频率梳驱动。控制器优化了多达22个参数，并在3×3、4×4和5×5频率箱网格上收敛到不同的目标模式。
authors: Usman Khan, Daniel Lopez, Venkat Aneesh Padmasola, Nirmal Dangi, Santosh Kumar, Yuping Huang

articles.title: Arrival-time problem in the quantum information era - observation of a Zeno crossover in monitored arrival-time distributions
articles.title_zh: 量子信息时代中的到达时间问题——监测到达时间分布中的芝诺交叉现象观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09814v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When does a quantum particle arrive at a detector? The temporal distributions of itinerant quantum particles have been debated since the birth of quantum mechanics. Here we study the arrival-time problem in periodically monitored spin chains and quantum circuits. The arrival dynamics exhibits two regimes, the quantum Zeno and the low-monitoring regime, separated by an optimal monitoring period set by the single-particle bandwidth. In support of the theory, on superconducting quantum hardware, we measure arrival-time distributions for single and multiple interacting particles in one- and two-dimensional circuits. The measured distributions resolve both regimes and agree closely with quantum-trajectory theory. The crossover persists in interacting many-particle systems: the optimal monitoring point is preserved while many-body interference reshapes the distributions. Zeno suppression likewise persists in two-dimensional geometry. Together, these results show that the two regimes are a generic feature of monitored propagation rather than a single-particle effect. To our knowledge, our work constitutes the first experimental measurement of arrival-time distributions in a monitored quantum transport setting, addressing one of the longest-standing problems in quantum mechanics.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子粒子何时到达探测器是一个长期争论的问题。本文在周期性监测的自旋链和量子电路中研究了到达时间问题，发现到达动力学表现出量子芝诺效应和低监测两种机制。在超导量子硬件上的实验测量证实了这两种机制的存在，并与量子轨迹理论高度吻合。
authors: Yousef Mafi, K. G. S. H. Gunawardana, Kim Pöyhönen, Teemu Ojanen

articles.title: Entanglement in Collective Neutrino Oscillations on a Quantum Computer
articles.title_zh: 量子计算机上集体中微子振荡中的纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08595v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Simulations on a quantum computer have been propounded as a next-generation tool for studying neutrino flavour oscillations in dense environments like supernovae or neutron star mergers. However, quantum advantage hinges on the presence of quantum entanglement in the neutrino ensemble, and it has been argued that such entanglement becomes negligible in the limit of large neutrino number density. Here, we address this question by explicitly simulating the multiparticle dynamics of entangled neutrino ensembles with a varying number of particles, N, on both classical and quantum hardware, and comparing our results to those obtained with conventional ``mean-field'' methods based on Boltzmann-type kinetic equations. For simple toy systems, we demonstrate both analytically and numerically that, indeed, the predictions of full multiparticle simulations agree with those of mean-field methods in the large-N limit. Along the way, we develop novel algorithms for the efficient simulation of entangled neutrino gases on both classical and quantum hardware. We then discuss physical situations in which an entangled neutrino system emphcannot be described through mean-field dynamics alone and quantum entanglement therefore becomes phenomenologically relevant. We comment on the conditions under which these scenarios may be realized in supernova cores or neutron star mergers.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子计算机被认为是研究致密环境中中微子味振荡的下一代工具。本文通过在经典和量子硬件上显式模拟不同粒子数N的纠缠中微子系综的多粒子动力学，解决了量子纠缠在中微子系综中是否可忽略的问题。研究表明，在N趋于无穷大的极限下，完整多粒子模拟的预测与平均场方法一致。
authors: Katarina Bleau, Nikolina Ilic, Joachim Kopp, Ushak Rahaman, Xin Yue Yu

articles.title: Features of Non-Local Quantum Correlations in Nuclei
articles.title_zh: 原子核中非局域量子关联的特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08776v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Classical simulation of quantum many-body systems is challenged by the combined effects of entanglement and non-stabilizerness (magic). Non-local magic, MNL_α, quantifies the component of non-stabilizerness that cannot be removed by local unitary transformations and provides a measure of quantum complexity beyond entanglement alone. It is bounded from below by the antiflatness of the entanglement spectrum, F_A. We calculate stabilizer Rényi entropies, non-local magic, entanglement-spectrum antiflatness, and entanglement entropy in shell-model ground states of more than 260 even-even, odd-even, and odd-odd nuclei, using a bipartition into proton and neutron sectors. We find that the previously established bound 4F_AłeqMNLₗᵢₙ holds for every nucleus studied and approaches saturation in the limit of separable states. Odd-odd nuclei exhibit markedly different patterns of entanglement and magic compared with even-even and odd-even systems, revealing distinctive signatures of proton-neutron quantum correlations and providing new insight into the complexity generated by nuclear interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 经典模拟量子多体系统面临纠缠和非稳定性（魔力）的挑战。本文计算了260多个偶偶、奇偶和奇奇核的壳模型基态中的稳定器Rényi熵、非局域魔力、纠缠谱反平坦度和纠缠熵。研究发现，奇奇核表现出与偶偶和奇偶系统显著不同的纠缠和魔力模式，揭示了质子-中子量子关联的独特特征。
authors: James W. T. Keeble, Caroline E. P. Robin, Federico Rocco, Martin J. Savage

articles.title: Motion-Induced Polaron Resonance beyond the Orthogonality Catastrophe
articles.title_zh: 超越正交灾变的运动诱导极化子共振
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09390v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate the spectroscopic response of a repulsively interacting, infinitely heavy impurity moving at constant velocity v through a one-dimensional ideal Fermi gas. Using an exact functional-determinant approach, we calculate the Ramsey response and spectral function, fully accounting for many-body particle-hole excitations. We uncover a strongly nonmonotonic dependence on impurity velocity: decoherence is enhanced around the Fermi velocity, whereas sufficiently rapid motion restores a narrow, long-lived polaron resonance. A long-time wave-packet analysis yields analytical expressions for the polaron energy and decay rate over the full velocity range and quantitatively captures the numerical results. At high velocity, the polaron energy approaches the mean-field value, the decay rate vanishes as 1/v, and the spectral weight approaches unity. Thus, rapid prescribed motion provides a dynamical route to suppressing the orthogonality catastrophe and restoring polaron coherence even for an infinitely heavy impurity, where recoil is entirely absent.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在恒定速度v下穿过一维理想费米气体的排斥相互作用、无限重杂质的光谱响应。研究发现，退相干在费米速度附近增强，而足够快的运动则能恢复狭窄、长寿命的极化子共振。这表明快速预设运动提供了一种抑制正交灾变并恢复极化子相干性的动态途径。
authors: Jia Wang, Xia-Ji Liu, Hui Hu

articles.title: Learning State Preparation Circuits for Quantum Phases of Matter
articles.title_zh: 学习物质量子相的态制备电路
articles.abstract: arXiv:2410.23544v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Many-body ground state preparation is an important subroutine used in the simulation of physical systems. In this paper, we introduce a flexible and efficient framework for obtaining a state preparation circuit for a large class of many-body ground states. We introduce polynomial-time classical algorithms that take reduced density matrices over O(1)-sized balls as inputs, and output a circuit that prepares the global state. We introduce algorithms applicable to (i) short-range entangled states (e.g., states prepared by shallow quantum circuits in any number of dimensions, and more generally, invertible states) and (ii) long-range entangled ground states (e.g., the toric code on a disk). Both algorithms can provably find a circuit whose depth is asymptotically optimal. Our approach uses a variant of the quantum Markov chain condition that remains robust against constant-depth circuits. The robustness of this condition makes our method applicable to a large class of states, whilst ensuring a classically tractable optimization landscape.
articles.abstract_zh: 多体基态制备是物理系统模拟中的重要子程序。本文提出了一种灵活高效的框架，用于获取一大类多体基态的态制备电路。该方法引入了多项式时间经典算法，能够为短程纠缠态和长程纠缠基态找到渐近最优深度的电路。
authors: Hyun-Soo Kim, Isaac H. Kim, Daniel Ranard

articles.title: Concentration of ergotropy in quantum many-body systems
articles.title_zh: 量子多体系统中能量提取功的集中现象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2412.19801v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ergotropyn̆icodex2014the maximal amount of unitarily extractable workn̆icodex2014quantifies the "charge level" of a quantum battery. We prove that, in large many-body batteries, it exhibits a concentration of measure phenomenon. Namely, the ergotropy almost coincides with its average for almost all states sampled from the Hilbertn̆icodex2013Schmidt measure. Importantly, the average ergotropy is macroscopic, scaling with the number of particles in the system. This occurs despite the von Neumann entropy also concentrating around a macroscopic average, a surprising coexistence since high entropy is commonly associated with effective thermality and thus passivity. We establish these results by proving that ergotropy, as a function of the state, is Lipschitz continuous with respect to the Bures distance and by applying Lévy's measure concentration lemma. Furthermore, we numerically extend our findings to the Bures measure, which represents the situation with the least amount of prior information about the state. Our continuity and concentration bounds open a new perspective on the noise-robustness of quantum many-body batteries and lay the groundwork for further rigorous studies of their charge stability and work extraction with limited prior knowledge.
articles.abstract_zh: 能量提取功衡量量子电池的“充电水平”。本研究证明，在大型多体电池中，能量提取功表现出测度集中现象，即对于几乎所有希尔伯特-施密特测度采样的态，其值几乎与其平均值一致。值得注意的是，平均能量提取功是宏观的，并随系统粒子数线性增长，这与冯诺依曼熵的宏观集中现象共存，揭示了高熵态并非总是被动。这些结果为量子多体电池的抗噪声能力提供了新视角。
authors: Karen Hovhannisyan, Rick P. A. Simon, Janet Anders

articles.title: Orbit dimensions in linear and Gaussian quantum optics
articles.title_zh: 线性与高斯量子光学中的轨道维度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.07995v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the dimension of the manifold of quantum states (called orbit) that a given bosonic state can reach under linear or quadratic Hamiltonian evolutions. That is, we investigate how many directions in the Hilbert space a state can explore in these sub-universal regimes. After showcasing a simple way to compute orbit dimensions, we find that these topological quantities reveal fundamental insights into the structure of attainable state spaces (e.g., boson bunching does not increase the number of accessible directions) with multifaceted consequences. First, we illustrate how they can alone yield no-go results for some transformations. We then propose ways to probe orbit dimensions using homodyne/heterodyne measurements on pure states, or photon counters on two copies of general states. We also relate orbit dimensions to the number of directions accessible to bosonic variational circuits. Next, we study links between orbit dimensions and the resource theory of non-Gaussianity (resp. P-nonclassicality), and prove that free states coincide with a unique minimal-dimension orbit in the pure multimode case, under Gaussian (resp. displaced-linear) unitaries. We then extend this result to a mixed-state setting, provided that an alternative convex-roof-based definition of orbit dimensions is taken; however, we show that those fail to be fixed-mode monotones under the respective free operations. Our entire framework is proven to hold in both discrete and continuous-variable settings, and can be used with Fock as well as phase-space representations such as the Wigner or stellar representations. Overall, this work offers a new perspective on the structure of reachable quantum states of light, which can help practitioners understand limitations and sources of expressivity and non-Gaussianity (or P-nonclassicality) in bosonic quantum information protocols such as quantum machine learning.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了给定玻色子态在线性或二次哈密顿量演化下可达到的量子态流形（轨道）的维度。这些拓扑量揭示了可达态空间结构的基本洞察，例如玻色子聚束不会增加可访问方向的数量。研究展示了如何计算轨道维度，并说明其可用于推导某些变换的“不可行”结果。此外，文章提出了利用零差/外差测量或光子计数器探测轨道维度的方法，并将其与玻色子变分电路可访问的方向数联系起来。
authors: Eliott Z. Mamon

articles.title: Imprints of information scrambling on eigenstates of a quantum chaotic system
articles.title_zh: 量子混沌系统本征态上的信息扰乱印记
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.02853v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: How are the spatial and temporal patterns of information scrambling in locally interacting quantum many-body systems imprinted on the eigenstates of the system's time-evolution operator? We address this question by identifying statistical correlations among sets of minimally four eigenstates that provide a unified framework for various measures of information scrambling. These include operator mutual information and operator entanglement entropy of the time-evolution operator, as well as more conventional diagnostics such as two-point dynamical correlations and out-of-time-ordered correlators. We demonstrate this framework by deriving exact results for eigenstate correlations in a minimal model of quantum chaos -- Floquet dual-unitary circuits. These results reveal not only the butterfly effect and the information lightcone, but also finer structures of scrambling within the lightcone. Our work thus shows how the eigenstates of a chaotic system can encode the full spatiotemporal anatomy of quantum chaos, going beyond the descriptions offered by random matrix theory and the eigenstate thermalisation hypothesis.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了局域相互作用量子多体系统中信息扰乱的时空模式如何印刻在系统时间演化算符的本征态上。通过识别至少四个本征态之间的统计关联，研究提出了一个统一框架来描述各种信息扰乱度量。该框架在Floquet双幺正电路这一量子混沌的最小模型中得到了精确验证，揭示了蝴蝶效应、信息光锥以及光锥内更精细的扰乱结构。这项工作表明混沌系统的本征态能够编码量子混沌的完整时空结构，超越了随机矩阵理论和本征态热化假说的描述。
authors: Bikram Pain, Ratul Thakur, Sthitadhi Roy

articles.title: Quantum algorithms to detect ODMR-active defects for quantum sensing applications
articles.title_zh: 用于量子传感应用的ODMR活性缺陷检测量子算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.13281v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Spin defects in two-dimensional materials are a promising platform for quantum sensing. Simulating the defect's optical response and optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) contrast is key to identifying suitable candidates. However, existing simulation methods are typically unable to supply the required accuracy. Here, we propose two quantum algorithms to detect an imbalance in the triplet-to-singlet intersystem crossing (ISC) rates between excited states with the same and different spin projections -- a necessary condition for nonzero ODMR response. The lowest-cost approach evaluates whether the evolution of an S=0 state under the spin-orbit coupling induces ISC to S=1, and also whether there is an imbalance in its intensity depending on the final state spin projection. The second approach works by comparing the emission spectrum of a spin defect with and without the spin-orbit coupling operator, inferring ISC intensity for different spin transition channels from spectrum intensity changes. Additionally, we present an improved scheme to evaluate the defect's optical response, building upon previous work. We study these quantum algorithms in the context of the negatively charged boron vacancy in hexagonal boron nitride. We generate an embedded active space of 18 spatial orbitals using quantum defect embedding theory (QDET) and show that the ISC rate imbalance can be detected with as few as 105 logical qubits and 4.41 × 10⁸ Toffoli gates. By avoiding direct and costly rate calculations, our methods enable faster screening of candidate defects for ODMR activity, advancing the prospect of using quantum simulations to aid the development of high-performing sensing devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维材料中的自旋缺陷是量子传感的有前景平台，但现有模拟方法难以准确预测其光学响应和ODMR对比度。本文提出了两种量子算法，用于检测激发态间三重态到单重态系间窜越（ISC）速率的不平衡，这是非零ODMR响应的必要条件。第一种算法评估S=0态在自旋轨道耦合下是否诱导ISC到S=1，并检测其强度是否依赖于最终态自旋投影。第二种算法通过比较有无自旋轨道耦合算符的发射光谱来推断不同自旋跃迁通道的ISC强度。
authors: Pablo A. M. Casares, Yanbing Zhou, Utkarsh Azad, Stepan Fomichev, Jack S. Baker, Chen Ling, Debasish Banerjee, Alain Delgado, Juan Miguel Arrazola

articles.title: Quantum Simulation of Non-Hermitian Special Functions and Dynamics via Contour-based Matrix Decomposition
articles.title_zh: 基于轮廓矩阵分解的非厄米特殊函数与动力学量子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.10267v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Simulating non-Hermitian dynamics on quantum computers is often hindered by the decay of success probability and the instability of non-diagonalizable matrices. Here, we present contour-based matrix decomposition (CBMD), a rigorous and versatile quantum functional calculus framework for simulating non-Hermitian matrix functions. By generalizing the matrix Cauchy residue theorem, CBMD decomposes holomorphic non-Hermitian operators into an analytic infinite contour-residue identity, followed by finite truncation with controlled error to yield linear combinations of Hermitian components. For first-order dynamics, CBMD achieves optimal query complexity across all parameters, strictly matching the optimal performance bounds within the linear combination of Hamiltonian simulation (LCHS) paradigm. Beyond first-order systems, the framework naturally generalizes to complex operator functions, including second-order wave dynamics and non-Hermitian special functions such as Bessel and Airy evolutions. Furthermore, CBMD systematically suppresses the asymptotic growth of non-Hermitian components, yielding a significant reduction in the required number of amplitude amplifications compared to the naive scheme of combining monomials via linear combination of unitaries (LCU) after Taylor expansion. Notably, CBMD avoids explicit dependence on matrix diagonalizability, effectively mitigating the long-standing challenges associated with ill-conditioned eigenvectors and Jordan blocks. Our work establishes a systematic matrix calculus that bridges high-performance classical numerics and fault-tolerant quantum algorithms. It should be noted that CBMD inherits standard LCU overheads, and requires the target function to have a bounded growth order on the real axis.
articles.abstract_zh: 在量子计算机上模拟非厄米动力学常受成功概率衰减和非对角化矩阵不稳定性的阻碍。本文提出了基于轮廓矩阵分解（CBMD）的量子泛函演算框架，用于模拟非厄米矩阵函数。CBMD将全纯非厄米算符分解为厄米分量的线性组合，并通过有限截断实现受控误差。对于一阶动力学，CBMD在所有参数上均达到最优查询复杂度，并可推广到二阶波动力学和非厄米特殊函数，显著降低了所需资源。
authors: Chao Wang, Huan-Yu Liu, Cheng Xue, Xi-Ning Zhuang, Menghan Dou, Zhao-Yun Chen, Guo-Ping Guo

articles.title: Enhancing Long-distance Continuous-variable Quantum-key-distribution with an Error-correcting Relay
articles.title_zh: 利用纠错中继增强长距离连续变量量子密钥分发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.11224v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Noiseless linear amplifiers (NLAs) serve as an effective means to enable long-distance continuous-variable (CV) quantum key distribution (QKD), even under realistic conditions with non-unit reconciliation efficiency. Separately, unitary averaging has been suggested to mitigate some stochastic noise, including phase noise in continuous-variable states. In this work, we combine these two protocols to simultaneously compensate for thermal-loss effects and suppress phase noise, thereby enabling long-distance CV QKD that surpasses the repeaterless bound, the fundamental rate-distance limit, for repeaterless quantum communication systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 无噪声线性放大器（NLAs）是实现长距离连续变量（CV）量子密钥分发（QKD）的有效手段。本研究将NLAs与幺正平均相结合，以同时补偿热损耗效应并抑制相位噪声。这种组合协议使得长距离CV QKD能够超越无中继量子通信系统的基本速率-距离极限，为实现更远距离的量子安全通信提供了新途径。
authors: S. Nibedita Swain, Ryan J. Marshman, Josephine Dias, Matthew S. Winnel, Alexander S. Solntsev, Timothy C. Ralph

articles.title: Multi-Objective Optimization with Quantum-Annealing-Inspired Algorithms
articles.title_zh: 基于量子退火启发算法的多目标优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.26477v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Combinatorial optimization is widely regarded as a primary application for near-term quantum processors, although a definitive demonstration of a practical quantum advantage remains elusive. Recent studies have reported that both gate-based quantum circuits and quantum annealers can outperform state-of-the-art classical heuristics on multi-objective optimization (MO-MaxCut) problems. However, these studies did not fully account for the substantial pre- and postprocessing overheads intrinsic to quantum solvers, leading to incomplete comparisons between quantum and classical approaches. In this work, we re-examine the same benchmark suite using GPU-based quantum-annealing-inspired algorithms (QAIAs), which generate probabilistic samples analogously to quantum processors and thus serve as formidable classical contenders. Our results show that QAIAs can sample candidate solutions approximately two orders of magnitude faster than the previously studied quantum processors, based on the reported sampling and device-access times. On the instances for which a complete pipeline can be compared, the measured end-to-end QAIA runtime, including model construction, sampling and Pareto filtering, is about an order of magnitude shorter than that of the exact objective-space baselines DCM and DPA-a, and the QAIA pipeline outperforms the tested evolutionary multi-objective heuristics under an equal wall-clock budget.
articles.abstract_zh: 组合优化是近期量子处理器的主要应用之一，但实际量子优势的明确证明仍未实现。本文使用基于GPU的量子退火启发算法（QAIAs）重新评估了多目标优化（MO-MaxCut）问题。研究发现，QAIAs在采样候选解方面比先前研究的量子处理器快约两个数量级。在可进行完整流程比较的实例上，QAIAs的端到端运行时间也显著优于量子方法，表明QAIAs是强大的经典竞争者。
authors: Xian-Zhe Tao, Pavel Mosharev, Zhaofeng Su, Man-Hong Yung

articles.title: Imperceptible measurement deviations can fake high-dimensional entanglement
articles.title_zh: 微不可察的测量偏差可伪造高维纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20396v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum entanglement is a central resource for emerging quantum technologies, but its experimental certification usually assumes that prescribed quantum measurements can be realized exactly. This assumption becomes increasingly restrictive in high-dimensional systems, where accurate measurement control is more challenging. Here, we show that arbitrarily small, adversarially tailored measurement deviations can lead to the false certification of high-dimensional entanglement in systems that are, in fact, separable, with the effect becoming increasingly severe as the dimension grows. We experimentally demonstrate this across a broad range of dimensions using classical photonic states encoded in the spatial degree of freedom. We report false certification of several tens of entangled dimensions in systems spanning up to 61 dimensions while exploiting measurement deviations as low as 0.23%. Our results reveal how imperceptible invasive attacks can critically compromise high-dimensional entanglement certification, motivating the development of new certification methods robust to bounded discrepancies between theory and experiment.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子纠缠是新兴量子技术的核心资源，但其实验认证通常假设测量可精确实现。本研究表明，任意微小、经过对抗性定制的测量偏差，可能导致对实际上可分离的高维系统进行错误的纠缠认证，且维度越高，这种效应越严重。实验利用经典光子态在空间自由度中编码，在高达61维的系统中，以低至0.23%的测量偏差，成功伪造了数十个纠缠维度。这揭示了微不可察的攻击如何严重损害高维纠缠认证，促使开发对理论与实验间有限差异具有鲁棒性的新认证方法。
authors: Jaime Moreno, Elna Svegborn, Simon Morelli, Markus Hiekkamäaki, Lea Kopf, Robert Fickler, Armin Tavakoli

articles.title: Depth-reduced quantum simulation of Lindbladian dynamics via adaptive variational quantum trajectory compression
articles.title_zh: 基于自适应变分量子轨迹压缩的Lindblad动力学深度约减量子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09051v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum simulation of open quantum systems in the noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) era is hindered by the non-unitary nature of dissipative dynamics and the limited quantum resources available on near-term quantum processors, namely restricted qubit counts and noise-limited circuit depths. In this work, we propose an efficient quantum algorithm for simulating Lindbladian dynamics on NISQ devices. For open quantum systems with Pauli dissipations, we first derive a compact and stable mixed-unitary adjoint channel that approximates the target dissipative dynamics and enables ancilla-free implementation through trajectory sampling. To further reduce the circuit depth required for implementing the sampled trajectories, we introduce an adaptive variational quantum trajectory compression framework. In this framework, a depth-adaptive parameterized quantum circuit is trained to approximate repeated Hamiltonian simulation operators, which are then used to replace repeated unitary segments appearing in the sampled trajectories. Importantly, the training procedure can also be performed without auxiliary qubits. Numerical simulations of the dissipative quantum XY model and the interacting disordered XXZ chain demonstrate the accuracy and reduced execution gate counts of the proposed algorithm. Our results provide a practical route toward ancilla-free and depth-reduced simulation of open quantum systems on near-term quantum hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 在NISQ时代，开放量子系统的量子模拟面临耗散动力学的非幺正性和有限量子资源的挑战。本文提出了一种高效的量子算法，用于在NISQ设备上模拟Lindblad动力学。对于具有泡利耗散的开放系统，研究推导了一个紧凑稳定的混合幺正伴随通道，通过轨迹采样实现无辅助比特的耗散动力学近似。为进一步减少电路深度，引入了自适应变分量子轨迹压缩框架，通过训练深度自适应参数化量子电路来近似重复的哈密顿量模拟算符，从而替代采样轨迹中重复的幺正段。
authors: Huan-Yu Liu, Cheng Xue, Yun-Jie Wang, Xi-Ning Zhuang, Chao Wang, Yu-Chun Wu, Zhao-Yun Chen, Guo-Ping Guo

articles.title: A Kernel-Based Density of States Estimator for Quantum Computing
articles.title_zh: 一种基于核函数的量子计算态密度估计器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24972v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce a quantum kernel method for estimating the density of states (DoS) of quantum many-body systems. The method exploits the Rodeo algorithm as a physical implementation, requiring no modification of its standard single-ancilla circuit. Averaging the Rodeo response over Haar-random input states reconstructs the DoS convolved with a spectral kernel whose analytical form is determined entirely by the probability distribution of the sampled evolution times. This establishes a direct quantum analogue of the classical Kernel Polynomial Method (KPM): Haar-random states perform stochastic trace estimation, while the temporal sampling distribution plays the role of the reconstruction kernel. We derive the estimator, quantify its statistical and systematic uncertainties, and establish an explicit correspondence between quantum reconstruction kernels and classical signal-processing window functions, enabling concepts such as spectral leakage, side-lobe attenuation, and main-lobe width to guide kernel design. The method is validated numerically on the one-dimensional transverse-field spin--sfrac12 and spin--1 Ising models, where the reconstructed density of states and the resulting thermodynamic observables agree with exact diagonalization within the estimated statistical uncertainties.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种用于估计量子多体系统态密度（DoS）的量子核方法。该方法利用Rodeo算法作为物理实现，无需修改其标准单辅助比特电路。通过对哈尔随机输入态的Rodeo响应进行平均，可以重建与谱核卷积后的DoS，其中谱核的解析形式完全由采样演化时间的概率分布决定。这建立了经典核多项式方法（KPM）的直接量子模拟，并量化了估计器的统计和系统不确定性。该方法在二维横场自旋-1/2和自旋-1伊辛模型上进行了数值验证。
authors: Julio Cesar Siqueira Rocha

articles.title: Schrödinger Generator for High-Dimensional Integration and Sampling on Quantum Many-Body States
articles.title_zh: 用于量子多体态高维积分与采样的薛定谔生成器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.00529v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Integration and sampling in high dimensions are among central challenges in modern science and technology, underlying applications ranging from quantum many-body physics to Bayesian inference and artificial intelligence. Although conventional Monte Carlo methods are formally scalable, their efficiency deteriorates rapidly in the presence of strong correlations or sharp features in high-dimensional configuration space. Here we introduce a new framework, termed the Schr"odinger Generator, for integration and sampling based on the explicit optimization of coordinate transformations. The method decomposes the total Jacobian into two complementary components, including an adaptive map that minimizes estimator variance by learning the marginal structure in each dimension, and a normalizing-flow-based transformation that captures non-factorizable correlations in the target distribution. A final resampling step guarantees unbiased sampling even when the learned transformation is imperfect. We demonstrate stable and scalable performance for nuclear quantum many-body states in dimensions exceeding 600. Short-range correlations among nucleons in finite nucleus are faithfully reproduced. The framework offers a physically transparent approach to high-dimensional stochastic integration and sampling, opening new possibilities for simulations of complex quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 高维积分和采样是现代科学技术中的核心挑战。本文引入了一个名为“薛定谔生成器”的新框架，用于基于坐标变换的显式优化进行积分和采样。该方法将总雅可比矩阵分解为两个互补部分：一个自适应映射，通过学习每个维度的边际结构来最小化估计器方差；以及一个基于归一化流的变换，用于捕获目标分布中不可分解的关联。最终的重采样步骤确保了即使学习到的变换不完善也能进行无偏采样。该方法在维度超过600的核量子多体态上展示了稳定且可扩展的性能。
authors: Lin-Jing Jiang, Fu Ma, Pei Li, Kai-Jia Sun, Guo-Liang Ma, Yu-Gang Ma

articles.title: Exact quantum geometry from sublattice symmetry: Closed-form solution of the quarter-flux Harper-Hofstadter model
articles.title_zh: 子格对称性下的精确量子几何：四分之一磁通Harper-Hofstadter模型的闭合解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26099v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum geometry has emerged as a guiding principle across atomic and condensed-matter physics, shaping the topological responses of Bloch bands and the stability of the correlated phases they host. Sublattice symmetry, though common among bipartite lattice models, has not yet been exploited to obtain closed-form quantum geometry in multiband systems. For this purpose, we derive a general expression for the QGT of sublattice-symmetric systems in terms of contributions from the individual sublattice sectors, and show that this symmetry renders the Bloch Hamiltonian of a paradigmatic four-band model, the quarter-flux Harper-Hofstadter model, anti-block-diagonal, analytically yielding the spectrum, eigenstates, and full quantum geometric tensor (QGT), including the Berry curvature and quantum metric, for all four bands. The model, describing charged particles on a two-dimensional square lattice subjected to a uniform magnetic field, has recently been realized experimentally with ultracold atoms, photons, and superconducting circuits. Finally, we evaluate fractional-Chern-insulator stability criteria analytically and quantify the lowest band of the quarter-flux Harper-Hofstadter model to be a nearly ideal Chern band. Our approach opens a route for studying also the quantum geometry of other sublattice-symmetric multiband systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子几何是原子和凝聚态物理中的重要指导原则。本文利用子格对称性，推导了子格对称系统量子几何张量（QGT）的通用表达式。研究表明，这种对称性使得四分之一磁通Harper-Hofstadter模型的布洛赫哈密顿量呈反块对角形式，从而解析地得到了所有四个能带的能谱、本征态和完整的QGT，包括贝里曲率和量子度规。该模型描述了二维方格中带电粒子在均匀磁场下的行为，并已在实验中实现。
authors: Isaac Tesfaye, André Eckardt

articles.title: Revealing the Quantum Signature of Gravity via Gravitational Waves
articles.title_zh: 通过引力波揭示引力的量子特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.09931v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Can propagating gravitational waves serve as operational probes of the quantum nature of gravity? We address this question by developing a unified theoretical framework that combines spacetime geometry, quantum information, and gravitational-wave physics. Starting from the geodesic deviation equation in linearized General Relativity, we derive the effective detector Hamiltonian directly from spacetime geometry and construct the complete quantum dynamics for detector subsystems interacting with both classical and quantized propagating gravitational-wave fields. This unified formulation enables a direct comparison between classical and quantum descriptions of gravitational radiation within the same physical framework. We demonstrate that classical gravitational-wave backgrounds can induce mixedness in the detector state but cannot generate genuine quantum correlations between the detector subsystems. In contrast, quantized gravitational waves coherently mediate gravity-induced entanglement, quantum coherence, quantum memory, and nonclassical correlations, providing clear operational signatures of the quantum nature of propagating gravitational radiation. We further discuss how mesoscopic quantum mechanical oscillators offer a promising route towards experimentally probing these effects. Our results establish a geometric and quantum-information-based framework for exploring quantum gravity through propagating gravitational waves.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个统一的理论框架，结合时空几何、量子信息和引力波物理学，探讨传播的引力波是否能作为探测引力量子性质的探针。研究发现，经典引力波背景可导致探测器态的混合性，但无法产生真正的量子关联。相比之下，量子化引力波能相干地介导引力诱导的纠缠、量子相干性、量子记忆和非经典关联，从而提供了引力量子性质的明确操作性特征。
authors: Partha Nandi

articles.title: Experimental realization of twofold topological phase transition induced by long-range hoppings in one-dimensional chains
articles.title_zh: 一维链中长程跳跃诱导的双重拓扑相变的实验实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08605v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-range hoppings offer a powerful mechanism to engineer exotic topological phases beyond conventional tight-binding models. Here, we experimentally demonstrate a twofold topological phase transition driven by third-nearest-neighbor couplings in a one-dimensional phononic chain that emulates cis-polyacetylene. Tunable hopping parameters in highly structured aluminum plates allow us to observe the emergence of Dirac points, a valley pseudospin structure, and topological edge states. The experimental results are supported by non-equilibrium Green's function transport calculations. Our findings confirm the predicted long-range phase diagram and establish phononic metamaterials as a versatile platform for exploring topological phenomena beyond the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger paradigm.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文实验证明了在一维声子链中，由第三近邻耦合驱动的双重拓扑相变。通过高度结构化的铝板中可调谐的跳跃参数，研究人员观察到了狄拉克点、谷赝自旋结构和拓扑边缘态的出现。这些实验结果得到了非平衡格林函数输运计算的支持，证实了预测的长程相图，并确立了声子超材料作为探索超越Su-Schrieffer-Heeger范式拓扑现象的多功能平台。
authors: J. A. Franco-Medrano, B. Manjarrez-Montañez, E. Flores-Olmedo, G. Báez, A. M. Martínez-Argüello, Y. Betancur-Ocampo, R. A. Méndez-Sánchez

articles.title: Growth and fabrication of advanced PbTe-Pb quantum devices
articles.title_zh: 先进PbTe-Pb量子器件的生长与制备
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08823v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report recent progress in the growth and fabrication of advanced PbTe-Pb Majorana devices for three-terminal correlation experiments. A critical prerequisite for these devices is a continuous Pb film spanning from the PbTe nanowire to the substrate. In previous studies, PbTe nanowires were spatially separated from the substrate mask, making them unable to fulfill this requirement. To address this issue, we have developed a new growth and fabrication approach. Key fabrication steps are introduced between the PbTe growth and Pb deposition. The top facet of the PbTe nanowire is covered with a Te capping layer before breaking the ultra-high vacuum, enabling ex situ processing for subsequent steps. The mask is then removed, followed by the fabrication of shadow walls. After reloading the chip into the growth chamber, the Te protection layer is removed through thermal decomposition, and the Pb film is subsequently deposited. Notably, a pristine PbTe-Pb interface with an in-situ-equivalent quality can be achieved despite the ex-situ processing. Our technique facilitates the develop of advanced PbTe-Pb quantum devices with complex designs, paving the way toward the realization of topological qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报告了用于三端关联实验的先进PbTe-Pb马约拉纳器件在生长和制备方面的最新进展。为解决现有技术中PbTe纳米线与衬底掩膜分离的问题，研究人员开发了一种新的生长和制备方法。该方法通过引入关键制备步骤和Te保护层，实现了高质量的PbTe-Pb界面，即使经过非原位处理也能保持原位等效的纯净度。这项技术有望促进具有复杂设计的先进PbTe-Pb量子器件的开发。
authors: Zehao Yu, Wenyu Song, Lining Yang, Zeyu Yan, Yuhao Wang, Weizhao Wang, Xinchen He, Ruidong Li, Jiaye Xu, Shuai Yang, Zonglin Li, Shan Zhang, Xiao Feng, Tiantian Wang, Yunyi Zang, Lin Li, Runan Shang, Qi-Kun Xue, Ke He, Hao Zhang

articles.title: Mixed-dimensional topological charge compensation beyond Weyl-node pairing
articles.title_zh: 超越外尔节点配对的混合维度拓扑电荷补偿
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08951v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Nielsen-Ninomiya no-go theorem requires the total topological charge (C) in a periodic Brillouin zone to vanish, conventionally leading to opposite-chirality pairs of Weyl points (WPs). A charged nodal surface (NS) provides an alternative mechanism for compensating a same-chirality Weyl pair, yet the general symmetry constraints governing this configuration and its electronic realization remain unexplored. Here, by an exhaustive analysis of all 1651 magnetic space groups (MSGs), with and without spin-orbit coupling, we identify only 13 type-II MSGs that permit the realization of a minimal unpaired mixed-dimensional configuration comprising a single |C|=2 NS and two same-chirality |C|=1 WPs. Guided by this symmetry framework, we identify the chiral boron allotrope THC-B₃₀ as the first electronic realization of this unconventional topology. First-principles calculations reveal only two WPs with C=-1 and one NS with C=+2, satisfying global topological charge neutrality and exhibiting unconventional Fermi arcs connecting the WP and NS projections. Moreover, strain-induced topological phase transitions redistribute topological charge among distinct band-degeneracy manifolds. Our findings establish a symmetry-guided route to realizing same-chirality Weyl pairs through mixed-dimensional charge compensation beyond conventional Weyl-node pairing.
articles.abstract_zh: 尼尔森-二宫定理要求周期性布里渊区中的总拓扑电荷为零，通常导致外尔点（WPs）的反手性配对。本文通过对所有1651个磁空间群的详尽分析，识别出13种允许实现由单个|C|=2节点表面（NS）和两个同手性|C|=1外尔点组成的最小非配对混合维度配置的II型磁空间群。研究人员将手性硼同素异形体THC-B₃₀确定为这种非传统拓扑结构的首个电子实现，其第一性原理计算揭示了满足全局拓扑电荷中性的非传统费米弧。
authors: Xiao-Jing Gao, Ke-Xin Pang, Yun-Yun Bai, Yanfeng Ge, Yan Gao

articles.title: Strong phonon-coupled trion emission in Janus homobilayer
articles.title_zh: 詹姆斯同质双层中强声子耦合的三激子发射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09083v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Janus transition metal dichalcogenides with broken mirror symmetry provide a novel platform for exploring many-body effects mediated by spin-valley-phonon interactions. Strong electron-phonon coupling demands a precise match between a strong effective dipole moment and nanometer-scale charge confinement. Here, we report thermally robust and enhanced trion emission in a symmetric bilayer WSeS with an S/S stacking configuration. The inward-pointing antiparallel built-in electric fields induce a strong electron confinement effect at the interface, driving dominant trion emission at cryogenic temperatures. Furthermore, a massive electron-phonon coupling strength (3.9) resonant with the optical phonon A₁² energy (51 meV) contributes to the thermal stability of this trion emission at elevated temperatures. By tailoring the interfacial architecture in Janus WSeS homobilayers, this study overcomes the thermal decoherence limits inherent to traditional semiconductor systems, offering novel insights into room-temperature many-body interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了在具有S/S堆叠配置的对称双层WSeS中，观察到热稳定性强且增强的三激子发射。内向反平行内建电场在界面处诱导了强电子限制效应，驱动了低温下的主导三激子发射。此外，与光学声子A₁²能量共振的巨大电子-声子耦合强度（3.9）有助于提高三激子发射在高温下的热稳定性。这项研究通过定制詹姆斯WSeS同质双层中的界面结构，克服了传统半导体系统的热退相干限制，为室温多体相互作用提供了新见解。
authors: Tianyishan Sun, Dingkun Bi, Haonan Wang, Hiroto Ogura, Yanlin Gao, Mina Maruyama, Susumu Okada, Shiro Entani, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Kazunari Matsuda, Toshiaki Kato

articles.title: Non-trivial topological spin-polarized surface states induced nonreciprocal transport in the hourglass semimetal
articles.title_zh: 沙漏半金属中非平凡拓扑自旋极化表面态诱导的非互易输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09258v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum materials such as topological semimetals have gained consummate interest due to their exotic band crossings and protected surface states. In particular, Ta₃GeTe₆ has emerged as a prototypical hourglass Dirac semimetal, as confirmed by both experimental and theoretical analysis. The ARPES confirms the topological hourglass-type band dispersions and Rashba-type band, while Hall measurements reveal a high hole carrier concentration and nonreciprocal transport behavior. These findings are further supported by a phenomenological toy model, which predicts a nonreciprocal resistance, consistent with the observed direction-dependent magnetoresistance. Furthermore, the Raman spectroscopy uncovers two-fold and four-fold phonon symmetries drag of highly anisotropic phonons, which establishes symmetry-dependent resistance. DFT calculations reveal Dirac-like and hourglass Dirac band crossings near the Fermi level for the bulk, with Rashba-type spin splitting induced by the surface inversion-symmetry breaking, leading to spin-polarized surface states. The combined experimental and theoretical results demonstrate that Ta₃GeTe₆ hosts a non-trivial electronic topology, with the inversion-symmetry breaking at the surface as the driver of this nonreciprocal transport behavior.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过实验和理论分析证实了Ta₃GeTe₆是一种典型的沙漏狄拉克半金属。ARPES和霍尔测量揭示了其拓扑沙漏型能带色散、Rashba型能带以及非互易输运行为。拉曼光谱和DFT计算进一步揭示了高度各向异性声子的对称性依赖电阻以及由表面反演对称性破缺引起的自旋极化表面态。综合结果表明，Ta₃GeTe₆具有非平凡的拓扑自旋极化表面态，并展现出非互易输运特性。
authors: Zahir Muhammad, Ghulam Hussain, Zia ur Rehaman, Rajibul Islam, Igor Antoniazzi, Muhammad Ismail Khan, Carmine Autieri, Maciej R. Molas, Xiaoguang Li, Xiaoyang Lina Azizur Rahmana, Weisheng Zhaoa

articles.title: Momentum-space engineering in van der Waals heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 范德华异质结构中的动量空间工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09285v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Twenty years of graphene research have established Dirac fermions as a versatile platform for exploring quantum topological phenomena. Yet control over graphene's low-energy spectrum mostly follows the route of miniband engineering using real-space superlattices. Here we introduce a complementary approach based on momentum-space 'Umklapp' band engineering. This is realised by matching reciprocal space positions of band edges of two adjacent highly incommensurate 2D crystals to coincide upon a boost from their Bragg vectors, creating resonant interlayer hybridisation that qualitatively reconstructs their spectra. To demonstrate this approach experimentally, we use monolayer graphene on MoS₂, twisted such that MoS₂ Q-valley states are brought by Umklapp into energy-momentum resonance with graphene's Dirac cones. The ensuing hybridization results in the formation of a clear additional Dirac-like spectral feature, identified by a distinct Landau-level fan and Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations characteristic to Berry phase π electrons. These new topological spectral features create a spin-valley locked Ising system which is robust against small twist-angle variations that can be further tuned by an external displacement field. More broadly, Umklapp band engineering offers a practical strategy for tailoring the electronic structure in van der Waals heterostructures, expanding the design space of quantum materials beyond moiré superlattices and weak proximity effects.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于动量空间“Umklapp”能带工程的新方法，以控制石墨烯的低能谱。通过匹配两个相邻高度不相称二维晶体能带边缘的倒空间位置，使其在布拉格矢量提升下重合，从而产生共振层间杂化并重构光谱。实验中，研究人员在MoS₂上使用单层石墨烯，通过扭曲使MoS₂的Q谷态与石墨烯的狄拉克锥发生能量-动量共振，形成了新的拓扑谱特征，创建了一个自旋谷锁定的伊辛系统。
authors: Xiao Li, Astrid Weston, James G. McHugh, Michael D. Thompson, Matthew Watson, Yunze Gao, Nicholas Clark, Laxman Nagi Reddy, Samuel Magorrian, Wendong Wang, Zhiyuan Wang, Sofia Konyzheva, Francisco Selles, Amy Carl, Katarzyna J. Salamon, Alex Summerfield, Nicholas Hine, Andre K. Geim, Neil R. Wilson, Jonathan R. Prance, Andrey V. Kretinin, Vladimir I. Falko, Roman Gorbachev

articles.title: Exciton design via topological spin textures
articles.title_zh: 通过拓扑自旋织构设计激子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09800v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Excitons carry energy and information through a semiconductor without carrying charge. This makes them attractive for optoelectronics, but also hard to guide. Magnetic skyrmions, on the other hand, are moved by small electrical currents. Here we develop a theory of excitons interacting with a skyrmion in which the electron and the hole are treated as distinct constituents, each with its own spin--orbit coupling. We find that the topology of the skyrmion is transferred to the exciton only when the exchange coupling exceeds the relevant spin--orbit splitting. The exciton then experiences a full flux quantum, with opposite signs in the two valleys. The quantum metric of the spin texture creates a ring-shaped barrier that traps excitons, whereas the topological charge fixes the angular momentum of the trapped states and hence their optical selection rules. Because the trap moves with the skyrmion, excitons can be transported by current pulses, and small skyrmions accommodate a single exciton, which opens the door for potential hybrid applications in future information technology intertwining topological magnetic bits with optical excitations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种激子与斯格明子相互作用的理论，发现斯格明子的拓扑性质仅在交换耦合超过自旋-轨道分裂时才能转移到激子。激子会经历一个完整的磁通量子，并在两个谷中具有相反的符号。自旋织构的量子度量形成一个环形势垒来捕获激子，而拓扑电荷则决定了被捕获态的角动量及其光学选择规则。由于陷阱随斯格明子移动，激子可以通过电流脉冲传输，这为未来信息技术中结合拓扑磁位与光学激子的混合应用开辟了可能性。
authors: Karim Rezouali, Selcuk Sözeri, Samir Lounis

articles.title: Reversible Interchain Associations Dominate Plateau Elasticity in Conjugated Polymers
articles.title_zh: 可逆链间关联主导共轭聚合物的平台弹性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09810v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The modulus plateau is widely regarded as a hallmark of topological entanglement in homopolymer melts and has been used to identify entanglement in semiflexible conjugated polymers. Using regiorandom poly(3-alkylthiophenes) as a model system, we show that their plateau elasticity relaxes through an Arrhenius process decoupled from segmental and terminal dynamics, reorganizes persistently under mechanical perturbation, and varies systematically with side-chain length. These behaviors are hard to reconcile with a purely topological-entanglement picture and instead support a transient network dominated by reversible interchain associations, consistent with π-π interactions between conjugated backbone segments. The results thus demonstrate that plateau elasticity alone does not uniquely identify topological entanglement in conjugated polymers. More broadly, they identify the strength and lifetime of interchain association as molecular design parameters linking backbone packing to stress relaxation, viscoelastic properties, and processability in conjugated polymers, complementing their established role in electronic structure and charge transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了无规聚（3-烷基噻吩）的平台弹性，发现其通过与链段和末端动力学解耦的阿伦尼乌斯过程弛豫，并在机械扰动下持续重组，且随侧链长度系统性变化。这些行为与纯拓扑缠结模型不符，反而支持由可逆链间关联主导的瞬态网络，这与共轭主链段之间的π-π相互作用一致。研究结果表明，平台弹性本身不能唯一地识别共轭聚合物中的拓扑缠结，并揭示了链间关联的强度和寿命是连接主链堆积与应力弛豫、粘弹性和加工性能的关键分子设计参数。
authors: Juncheng Zheng, Xiaobing Zuo, Xiaodan Gu, Shiwang Cheng

articles.title: Energy- and momentum-resolved Cooper-pair emission from a cuprate superconductor
articles.title_zh: 铜氧化物超导体中库珀对的能量和动量分辨发射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09857v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconductivity arises from Cooper pairing, but conventional photoemission probes electrons individually rather than as pairs. Here we report the observation of Cooper-pair emission from an optimally doped cuprate superconductor using two-electron angle-resolved photoemission (2e-ARPES). Below the superconducting transition, we observe a distinct two-electron emission peak at zero pair binding energy and zero pair momentum that disappears in the normal state, revealing the characteristic fingerprint of a Cooper pair. Unexpectedly, the joint energy distribution broadens markedly along the relative-energy axis as temperature decreases, while the total energy width remains nearly unchanged. This anomalous behavior cannot be explained by instrumental resolution, static disorder or thermal broadening, and instead points to scattering processes involving collective excitations of the superconductor. Our results establish 2e-ARPES as a probe of both Cooper-pair emission and the many-body dynamics of the superconducting state.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用双电子角分辨光电子能谱（2e-ARPES）首次观测到最佳掺杂铜氧化物超导体中的库珀对发射。在超导转变温度以下，研究人员观察到一个独特的双电子发射峰，其在正常态下消失，揭示了库珀对的特征指纹。令人意外的是，随着温度降低，联合能量分布沿相对能量轴显著展宽，而总能量宽度几乎不变。这种异常行为表明存在涉及超导体集体激发的散射过程，确立了2e-ARPES作为探测库珀对发射和超导态多体动力学的新方法。
authors: Henry Amir, Jack Zwettler, Ka Ho Wong, Genda Gu, Rafael M. Fernandes, Jorge Noronha, Dirk K. Morr, Fahad Mahmood

articles.title: Unraveling square and kagome lattice frustrated magnetism by scalable tensor networks
articles.title_zh: 可扩展张量网络揭示方形和kagome晶格受挫磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09881v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We extend the scalability of variational infinite two-dimensional tensor network methods with application to investigate frustrated magnetism of the square-lattice J₁₋J₂ model and kagome-lattice Heisenberg model. In the sign-problem-free limit of the square-lattice model, we achieve high ground-state energy precision comparable to quantum Monte Carlo methods. With no obstruction beyond this limit, our method obtains direct estimates of order parameters. For the square-lattice J₁₋J₂ model, we determine isotropic plaquette order in the valence-bond solid region. For the model near J₂/J₁₌₀.5, and the kagome lattice Heisenberg model, our data indicate linear-dispersion gapless states. To probe the candidate spin-liquid nature of the highly frustrated cases, we go beyond inferring the absence of symmetry-breaking orders and analyze susceptibilities that characterize gapless spin liquids. By estimating scaling dimensions, our data indicate a stable gapless spin liquid on the kagome lattice, and competing scenarios for the intermediate regime of the square-lattice model. Our developments include parallelization and randomized low-rank methods and largely expand the frontier of high-precision variational numerics for quantum phases of matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文扩展了变分无限二维张量网络方法的可扩展性，并将其应用于研究方形晶格J₁-J₂模型和kagome晶格海森堡模型的受挫磁性。该方法在方形晶格模型的无符号问题极限下，实现了与量子蒙特卡洛方法相当的基态能量精度，并直接估计了序参量。研究结果表明，kagome晶格上存在稳定的无能隙自旋液体，而方形晶格模型的中间区域则存在竞争情景。
authors: Xing-Yu Zhang, Jutho Haegeman, Yuchi He

articles.title: Violent relaxation redux
articles.title_zh: 剧烈弛豫再探
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09531v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Collisionless self-gravitating systems, such as merging galaxies, have long seemed an exception to the statistical-mechanical principle that chaotic many-body systems relax to maximum-entropy states: Lynden-Bell's statistical mechanics of their "violent relaxation," constrained by exact conservation of phase-space volume -- equivalently, of infinitely many collisionless "Casimir" invariants -- has appeared not to be a good description. We propose that violent relaxation does give rise to Lynden-Bell's maximum-entropy equilibria, but that both are underpinned by gravitational turbulence, in which large-scale gravitational fluctuations drive chaotic phase-space mixing of the particles' distribution function. We derive the universal small-scale (sub-Jeans) spectra of this turbulence and show that it leads to phase-space-volume conservation being broken on a timescale only logarithmically longer, in the particle number N, than the dynamical (violent-relaxation) time. This timescale separation lets the system relax "adiabatically" through a sequence of Lynden-Bell equilibria, each corresponding to instantaneous values of the Casimirs. At long times, it approaches an equilibrium close to its "ground state": a distribution whose Casimirs have adjusted so that the system's energy is now its minimum possible energy. Thus, the system's universal tendency is toward a minimum-energy, maximum-entropy state. We corroborate this picture with 1D N-body simulations and hypothesize that it can explain the universal equilibria of galaxies and dark-matter halos.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出，剧烈弛豫确实会产生Lynden-Bell的最大熵平衡态，但两者都以引力湍流为基础。在这种湍流中，大尺度引力波动驱动粒子分布函数的混沌相空间混合。研究推导了这种湍流的普适小尺度谱，并表明它导致相空间体积守恒在比动力学时间仅对数长的时间尺度上被打破。这种时间尺度分离使得系统能够“绝热地”通过一系列Lynden-Bell平衡态进行弛豫。
authors: Michael L. Nastac, Yonadav Barry Ginat, Robert J. Ewart, Michael Barnes, Alexander A. Schekochihin

articles.title: Propagating the Hierarchical Equations of Motion using the Multi-Layer Multi-Configurational Time-Dependent Hartree method
articles.title_zh: 使用多层多组态含时Hartree方法传播层次运动方程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09637v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The hierarchical equations of motion (HEOM) are a powerful, numerically exact approach for simulating the time evolution of open quantum systems. Recently, several tensor-train- and tensor-network-based approaches have been suggested and realized to extend the range of applicability of the HEOM approach to larger and more realistic systems. In this paper, we build upon the existing twin-space formulation of the HEOM and present a novel approach to propagate the fermionic HEOM efficiently using the multi-configurational time-dependent Hartree method (MCTDH). We benchmark the resulting HEOM+MCTDH method with electron transport calculations for a Holstein-type nanojunction model.
