Furthermore, we demonstrate the capabilities of the HEOM+MCTDH method by applying it to a more complex vibronic coupling nanojunction model with strong molecule-electrode coupling for which fully quantum simulations have not been feasible previously.
articles.abstract_zh: 层次运动方程（HEOM）是模拟开放量子系统时间演化的强大数值精确方法。本文基于HEOM的现有双空间公式，提出了一种利用多组态含时Hartree（MCTDH）方法高效传播费米子HEOM的新方法。研究人员通过对Holstein型纳米结模型的电子输运计算对HEOM+MCTDH方法进行了基准测试，并将其应用于更复杂的振动耦合纳米结模型，展示了其在以前无法进行全量子模拟的系统上的能力。
authors: Robin L. Grether, Samuel L. Rudge, Martin Mäck, Riley J. Preston, Uwe Manthe, Michael Thoss

articles.title: Dual topology and edge-reconstruction in α-Sn
articles.title_zh: α-Sn中的双重拓扑和边缘重构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.23289v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We formulate the tight-binding model for cubic α-Sn based on the DFT calculations. In the model, we incorporate a variable bond angle, which allows us to simulate the effect of the in-plane strain. In the bulk, we demonstrate the presence of the Z₂ topological invariant and a non-zero mirror Chern number, making α-Sn one of the rare cases where dual topology can be observed. We calculate the topological phase diagram of multi-layer α-Sn as a function of strain and number of layers. We find that a non-trivial quantum spin Hall state appears only for compressive strain above five layers of thickness. Quite surprisingly, both in the trivial and non-trivial phases, we find a plethora of edge-states with energies inside the bulk gap of the system. Some of these states are localized at the side surfaces of the slab and some of them prefer top/bottom surfaces. We find that they can be adiabatically connected to topological states in the chiral limit, where the model supports multiple one-dimensional winding numbers that take different values in different directions in the Brillouin zone. Finally, around high-symmetry points their presence can also be explained by the mirror Chern number and Wilson-loop invariants
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于DFT计算建立了立方α-Sn的紧束缚模型，并引入可变键角以模拟面内应变效应。研究发现，块体α-Sn存在Z₂拓扑不变量和非零镜像陈数，展现出罕见的双重拓扑特性。通过计算多层α-Sn的拓扑相图，发现非平凡量子自旋霍尔态仅在压缩应变且厚度超过五层时出现。此外，在平凡和非平凡相中均存在大量位于体能隙内的边缘态，这些边缘态可与手性极限下的拓扑态绝热连接。
authors: Jan Skolimowski, Nguyen Minh Nguyen, Alicja Kawala, Giuseppe Cuono, Carmine Autieri, Wojciech Brzezicki

articles.title: Multiscale Quasiparticle Electronic Structure and Excitonic Properties of CdSe Nanoclusters
articles.title_zh: CdSe纳米团簇的多尺度准粒子电子结构和激子特性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23130v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum confinement in stoichiometric CdₙSeₙ nanoclusters dramatically attenuates electronic screening, driving a delicate, size-dependent competition between quasiparticle self-energy corrections (ΔQP) and exciton binding energies (E_b). Here, we present a GW/BSE study across a representative size series (n = 3, 6, 13, 33) and leverage it to validate a scalable atomistic tight-binding (TB) framework derived from first principles. Our results demonstrate that 1-2 eV spectral blueshifts previously reported in the literature arise from single-particle GW convergence artifacts rather than deficiencies in the electron--hole kernels. We show that the near-perfect cancellation between ΔQP and E_b breaks down as cluster volume increases, driven by the rapid onset of dielectric screening attenuating E_b faster than ΔQP and leading to a pronounced divergence from mean-field predictions. Spatial inverse participation ratio analysis of the electronic structure reveals that optical suppression of fundamental pre-peaks stems from a severe spatial mismatch between localized valence orbitals and delocalized conduction states. Finally, we demonstrate that the confinement-induced scaling of the quasiparticle gap and the optical onset is accurately reproduced by a scissor-corrected, DFT-parameterized TB model. As such, this work provides a quantitative multiscale roadmap for embedding effective many-body effects kernels into computationally efficient models, enabling reliable optical predictions for realistic semiconducting nanostructures containing up to thousands of atoms.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了化学计量CdₙSeₙ纳米团簇中的量子限制效应，该效应显著减弱了电子屏蔽，导致准粒子自能修正（ΔQP）和激子结合能（E_b）之间存在尺寸依赖的竞争。研究通过GW/BSE方法对一系列纳米团簇进行了研究，并验证了一个可扩展的原子紧束缚框架。结果表明，先前报道的1-2 eV光谱蓝移源于单粒子GW收敛伪影，而非电子-空穴核的缺陷。随着团簇体积的增加，ΔQP和E_b之间的近乎完美抵消被打破，导致与平均场预测的显著偏离。
authors: Surender Kumar, Martin Thümmler, Alexander Croy, Stefanie Gräfe, Caterina Cocchi

articles.title: Framing Anomaly in Lattice Chern-Simons-Maxwell Theory
articles.title_zh: 格点陈-西蒙斯-麦克斯韦理论中的框架反常
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.04318v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Framing anomaly is a key property of (2+1)d chiral topological orders, for it reveals that the chirality is an intrinsic bulk property of the system, rather than a property of the boundary between two systems. Understanding framing anomaly in lattice models is particularly interesting, as concrete, solvable lattice models of chiral topological orders are rare. In a previous work, we defined and solved the U(1) Chern-Simons-Maxwell theory on spacetime lattice, showing its chiral edge mode and the associated gravitational anomaly on boundary. In this work, we show its framing anomaly in the absence of boundary, by computing the expectation of a lattice version of the modular T operator in the ground subspace on a spatial torus, from which we extract that łangle T ångle has a universal phase of -2π/12 as expected: -2π/8 from the Gauss-Milgram sum of the topological spins of the ground states, and 2π/24 from the framing anomaly; we can also extract the 2π/24 framing anomaly phase alone from the full spectrum of T in the ground subspace by computing łangle T^m ångle. This pins down the last and most crucial property required for a valid lattice definition of U(1) Chern-Simons theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 框架反常是(2+1)维手性拓扑序的关键特性，揭示了手性是系统的内在体性质。本文在先前工作的基础上，研究了格点U(1)陈-西蒙斯-麦克斯韦理论在无边界情况下的框架反常。通过计算空间环面基态子空间中模T算符格点版本的期望值，研究人员提取出预期的-2π/12普适相位，其中2π/24来自框架反常。这项工作确定了手性拓扑序所需的最后一个也是最关键的性质。
authors: Ze-An Xu, Jing-Yuan Chen

articles.title: Thermodynamic speed limits in isolated quantum systems
articles.title_zh: 孤立量子系统中的热力学速度极限
articles.abstract: Author(s): Rikuya Kobashi We derive thermodynamic speed limits for isolated quantum systems undergoing finite-time unitary driving. The key ingredient is a set of generalized second-law inequalities: For the Gibbs entropy and for several thermodynamically motivated observational entropies, the entropy production is bounded f… [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 043140] Published Mon Nov 09, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文推导了经历有限时间酉驱动的孤立量子系统的热力学速度极限。研究的关键在于一系列广义第二定律不等式。对于吉布斯熵和几种热力学驱动的观测熵，熵产生被限制在一个范围内。
authors: Rikuya Kobashi

articles.title: Interplay of noise and reservoir-induced decoherence in persistent currents
articles.title_zh: 噪声与储层诱导退相干在持久电流中的相互作用
articles.abstract: Author(s): Samudra Sur and Thierry Giamarchi Persistent current is a hallmark of quantum phase coherence. We study the fate of the persistent current in a nonequilibrium setting, where a tight-binding ring is subjected to stochastic disorder as well as a fermionic reservoir attached to each site. We evaluate the current using the Keldysh techn… [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 043141] Published Mon Nov 09, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 持久电流是量子相位相干性的标志。本研究在一个非平衡环境中，探讨了持久电流的演变，其中紧束缚环受到随机无序和连接到每个位点的费米子储层的影响。作者使用Keldysh技术评估了电流。
authors: Samudra Sur and Thierry Giamarchi

articles.title: Rapid Multi-Mode Trapped-Ion Laser Cooling in a Phase-Stable Standing Wave
articles.title_zh: 相位稳定驻波中的快速多模阱离子激光冷却
articles.abstract: Author(s): Zhenzhong Xing, Hamim Mahmud Rivy, Vighnesh Natarajan, Aditya Milind Kolhatkar, Gillenhaal Beck, and Karan K. Mehta Integrated optical delivery of standing waves is shown to enable fast, multi-mode laser cooling of trapped ions to the quantum ground state, offering simultaneous advantages in cooling rate, bandwidth, and final phonon number. [PRX Quantum 7, 043027] Published Mon Nov 09, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了驻波的集成光学传输能够实现被捕获离子的快速多模激光冷却至量子基态。这种方法在冷却速率、带宽和最终声子数方面同时提供了优势。
authors: Zhenzhong Xing, Hamim Mahmud Rivy, Vighnesh Natarajan, Aditya Milind Kolhatkar, Gillenhaal Beck, and Karan K. Mehta

articles.title: Symmetry-Resolved Criticality in Dissipative Quantum Phase Transitions
articles.title_zh: 耗散量子相变中的对称性分辨临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09450v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Symmetry breaking in mixed quantum states exhibits a rich strong-to-weak hierarchy, yet the use of symmetry as an operational probe of dissipative criticality remains largely unexplored. In this work, we develop a symmetry-based framework that connects semiclassical phase space, trajectory-level dynamics, and ensemble responses, and demonstrate it in the two-dimensional dissipative XYZ model. We show that symmetry breaking manifests semiclassically as a bifurcation of the Husimi-Q distribution and dynamically as a sharp change in a trajectory-level symmetry residual. At the ensemble level, the weak-symmetry sensitivity to a perturbed symmetry operator exhibits pronounced finite-size scaling, yielding an estimate of the dissipative critical point. Finally, we propose a trajectory-based quantum-circuit algorithm in which mid-circuit measurements condition quantum jumps and allow the proposed indicators to be extracted from circuit observables. Our work provides a symmetry-centered route to diagnosing dissipative phase transitions and critical scaling in open quantum many-body systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文开发了一个基于对称性的框架，将半经典相空间、轨迹级动力学和系综响应联系起来，并在二维耗散XYZ模型中进行了演示。研究表明，对称性破缺在半经典上表现为Husimi-Q分布的分叉，在动力学上表现为轨迹级对称性残差的急剧变化。该工作为诊断开放量子多体系统中的耗散相变和临界标度提供了一条以对称性为中心的新途径。
authors: Xingli Li, Yan Li, Jinghui Pi, Wenlin Li, Shuai Geng, Lin Shang, Jiasen Jin, Yangqian Yan

articles.title: Density kernel and temporal quantum information probes in double-scaled SYK
articles.title_zh: 双标度SYK模型中的密度核与时间量子信息探针
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08592v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Entanglement is conventionally defined through a Hilbert space bipartition on a fixed time slice. Recent work has generalized this notion to multiple times through a non-Hermitian density kernel constructed from temporal correlation functions, encoding causal response, temporal non-classicality and quantum dynamics. We construct this kernel in the double-scaled Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev (DSSYK) model using its exact chord Hilbert space formulation and study the resulting temporal information diagnostics. The direct sum structure of chord space naturally introduces a coarse-graining under which coherence between different chord sectors is removed. We show that the corresponding kernel measures quantify how information is dynamically transferred across subregions in the chord Hilbert space. We find that decreasing łambda enhances the propagation of temporal correlation across chord sectors, as well as the loss of memory within a fixed sector. This accelerated temporal dynamics in the small łambda limit coincides with the emergence of a semiclassical gravity description. Depending on the chord space partition, the probes exhibit either saturation, a growth followed by a decay, or temporary memory loss. The characteristic propagation time is nicely captured by a wavefront picture in Krylov space, with position-dependent hopping parameters that are determined by the DSSYK Lanczos coefficients. Finally, given the quantum sine-dilaton gravity description of DSSYK and its connections to de Sitter holography, our results provide a controlled setting for probing temporal quantum correlations across quantum and semiclassical gravitational regimes, and motivate a geometric interpretation of the density kernel.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在双标度Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev (DSSYK) 模型中构建了一个非厄米密度核，并研究了由此产生的时间信息诊断。该密度核通过时间关联函数构建，编码了因果响应、时间非经典性和量子动力学。研究发现，减小参数λ会增强时间关联在弦空间扇区间的传播，并加速固定扇区内的记忆丧失，这与小λ极限下半经典引力描述的出现相吻合。
authors: Johanna Erdmenger, Maximilian Gaschler, Jonathan Karl, Arnab Kundu, Georg Setzer

articles.title: Thermodynamics of Speed and Efficiency with Quantum Feedback
articles.title_zh: 带有量子反馈的速度与效率热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08564v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rapid thermodynamic operations generally entail irreversible dissipation, giving rise to trade-offs between operating speed and thermodynamic cost. Yet, how quantum feedback fundamentally reshapes these trade-offs remains elusive. Here, we derive a finite-time current--dissipation relation for continuously monitored open quantum dynamics with jump feedback. From this fundamental relation, we establish a quantum speed limit and a power-efficiency trade-off for stationary information engines, identifying how feedback affects state transformations and the performance of engines through both informational entropy and direct dynamical contributions. Our results provide a quantitative foundation for fast, low-dissipation quantum thermodynamics in the presence of feedback control, exemplified by attaining the generalized Landauer bound in finite-time information erasure and approaching unit information efficiency at finite power in the large-system limit of a collective engine.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文推导了具有跳跃反馈的连续监测开放量子动力学的有限时间电流-耗散关系。基于此基本关系，研究建立了稳态信息引擎的量子速度极限和功率-效率权衡。结果为在反馈控制下实现快速、低耗散量子热力学提供了定量基础，并展示了在有限时间信息擦除中达到广义朗道尔界限，以及在集体引擎的大系统极限下以有限功率接近单位信息效率。
authors: Yue Liu, Ryotaro Honma, Ruicheng Bao, Tan Van Vu

articles.title: Magic Is in the Eye of the Measure
articles.title_zh: 量子“魔性”取决于度量方式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08586v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magic, or nonstabilizerness, is the quantum resource behind universal quantum computation. Its applications in high-energy and nuclear physics rely almost exclusively on the stabilizer Rényi entropy (SRE), although magic has no unique measure. For two qubits, we compare the SRE with three measures defined through optimizations over stabilizer states: the min- and max-relative entropies of magic and the logarithmic free robustness. We determine the maximal-magic states of all four measures, with exact proofs, and find that they depend on the measure. In the determination of the weak mixing angle from minimal magic in Møller scattering, the min-relative entropy gives an energy-dependent value that differs from that of the SRE, whereas the max-relative entropy and the logarithmic free robustness give sin²θ_W=1/4 at all energies. We trace this difference to the non-analytic structure of the optimization-based measures. Physical conclusions drawn from extremizing magic can thus depend on the measure.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子“魔性”（非稳定性）是普适量子计算背后的量子资源，但其度量方式并非唯一。本文比较了稳定器Rényi熵与三种基于稳定器态优化的度量，并确定了所有四种度量的最大“魔性”态，发现它们依赖于所选的度量。研究表明，从最小“魔性”推导出的物理结论可能因度量方式的不同而异。
authors: Zhi-Heng Shen, Zhewei Yin, Hao-Lin Zhang

articles.title: Harnessing dimensional leakage for continuous-variable randomness certification
articles.title_zh: 利用维度泄漏实现连续变量随机性认证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08607v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Semi-device-independent quantum protocols often rely on strict Hilbert-space dimension assumptions that are difficult to satisfy in realistic implementations, particularly with infinite-dimensional optical fields. The almost-qudit framework addresses this issue by quantifying the leakage of quantum states beyond a target subspace. Although such leakage can severely compromise randomness certification for fixed preparation and measurement inputs, we show that averaging over the full input ensemble can mitigate this vulnerability and extend the range of tolerable leakage. This enhanced robustness enables nonzero randomness certification using low-squeezing single-mode Gaussian states and homodyne detection, thus offering an experimentally accessible continuous-variable implementation.
articles.abstract_zh: 半设备无关量子协议常依赖严格的希尔伯特空间维度假设，这在实际实现中难以满足。本文展示了通过对完整输入系综进行平均，可以减轻维度泄漏对随机性认证的负面影响，并扩展可容忍泄漏的范围。这种增强的鲁棒性使得使用低压缩单模高斯态和零差检测实现非零随机性认证成为可能，从而提供了一种可实验实现的连续变量方案。
authors: Moisés Alves, Tailan S. Sarubi, Vitor L. Sena, Alexandre B. Tacla, Rafael Chaves

articles.title: Quantum-enabled measurement of gravitational forces at the milligram scale
articles.title_zh: 量子赋能的毫克级引力测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08619v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Gravity is by far the weakest among all known interactions. While it dominates the large-scale structure of the universe, gravitational interactions between small masses in the microscopic range remain underexplored because they are too weak to be experimentally accessible. The interface between gravity, described by general relativity, and quantum mechanics, which describes the microscopic world, is of particular interest. From a theory standpoint, these two major descriptions of nature have not been combined in a satisfactory manner. Technology is gradually becoming mature enough such that probing gravity at the microscopic scale, where quantum mechanics and gravity potentially meet, is becoming accessible. Explorations towards genuine quantum gravity have to be carried out under conditions where the gravitating masses possess non-classical properties, which necessitates ultimate protection against disturbances, such as ultralow temperatures and a small range of motion. Here, we present an experiment at millikelvin temperatures, where the gravity due to a micron-range coherent displacement of an 87 mg source mass imprints on the motion of an oscillating membrane loaded with a 1.3 mg test mass. Vibrations of the membrane are measured in the microwave optomechanical scheme, which is a key setup for investigating non-classical motional states of mechanical oscillators. When considering the combination of total source and test masses, our setup presents two orders of magnitude progress in sensing gravity at the small scale, as well as a 35 dB improvement of gravitational sensitivity at kHz frequencies or above. Our setup offers a plausible approach for studying gravitational interactions between masses prepared in non-classical motional states.
articles.abstract_zh: 引力是已知相互作用中最弱的，但其在微观尺度上的相互作用仍未被充分探索。本文介绍了一项在毫开尔文温度下进行的实验，其中87毫克源质量的微米级相干位移产生的引力，对运动产生了影响。该工作旨在探索引力与量子力学在微观尺度上的交界面，为真正的量子引力研究提供实验基础。
authors: Matthew Herbst, Ewa Rej, Joe Depellette, Richa Cutting, Jinhoon Jeong, Mika A. Sillanpää

articles.title: How Many Shots Does a Quantum Reservoir Need? Measurement Cost and Its Scaling in Buffered Quantum Reservoir Computing
articles.title_zh: 量子储层需要多少次测量？缓冲量子储层计算中的测量成本及其标度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08632v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum reservoir computing (QRC) inherits from classical reservoir computing the property that only a linear readout is trained, but unlike a classical reservoir its state is never directly observable: every feature is an expectation value estimated from a finite number of measurement shots. The shot budget is therefore a first-class hyperparameter with no classical analogue. Its effect on QRC has recently begun to be studied; what remains unsettled is how a required budget should be defined, and whether competing definitions agree. This paper argues that they do not, and that the disagreement is systematic rather than incidental. This paper distinguishes a emphprecision budget N_ǎrepsilon, the shots needed to estimate the reservoir features to a fixed relative accuracy, from a emphconvergence budget Nₛₜₐᵣ, the shots needed for the trained readout to approach its own noise-free ceiling. Proposition~e̊fprop:confound shows that Nₛₜₐᵣ depends on the noise-free error floor by construction, so that a configuration with a worse floor appears cheaper, and that configurations should therefore be compared at a fixed measurement budget rather than by the budget each needs to reach its own ceiling.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子储层计算（QRC）中，储层状态无法直接观测，每个特征都是通过有限次测量估计的期望值。本文探讨了QRC中所需的测量次数预算的定义及其影响，区分了用于估计储层特征的“精度预算”和训练读数达到其无噪声上限所需的“收敛预算”。研究指出，这两种预算定义并不一致，且这种差异是系统性的。
authors: Raman Khurana

articles.title: Sign-hedged Beam QAOA:Scaling Quantum Optimization Algorithms
articles.title_zh: 符号对冲束搜索QAOA：扩展量子优化算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08646v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) encodes a combinatorial objective as an Ising Hamiltonian and alternates cost and mixer operations for p rounds. Recursive QAOA (RQAOA) scales further by using the resulting correlations, whether variables tend to agree or disagree, to eliminate variables one at a time. But each inferred sign is accepted irrevocably, so a single early mistake propagates through every later reduction and can discard the global optimum. As elimination proceeds, residuals shrink while effective edge density typically rises, so later decisions face denser Ising problems, a regime that fully connected Sherrington Kirkpatrick (SK) instances stress test directly. This paper proposes sign-hedged beam RQAOA, which retains the variable or pair selected by standard RQAOA, explores both possible sign assignments, keeps the best B residual problems according to a classical score, and completes each survivor with ordinary RQAOA. On frustrated SK instances, where standard recursion collapses to AR 0.474, beam recovers near-optimal AR 0.998 at the same p. We evaluate the workflow on 50+ instances from HamLib and QOBLIB, spanning 4 and 5 regular and Erdos Renyi MaxCut graphs, Sherrington Kirkpatrick (SK) spin glasses, and cardinality-constrained portfolio optimization, with up to 60 qubits and hardware runs on ibm kingston and ibm marrakesh. Matched simulator and device cells show consistent beam rankings: simulation and hardware agree that beam recovers near-optimal approximation ratio (AR) where standard recursion fails. These gains come from additional residual-circuit evaluations, classical pruning, and exact solution of a small core, rather than from increasing p, beam is a decision-side optimization atop fixed-p QAOA/RQAOA, not a claim that quantum circuits alone scale with qubit count.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子近似优化算法（QAOA）通过交替成本和混合操作来解决组合优化问题。递归QAOA（RQAOA）通过利用变量间的相关性来逐步消除变量，但早期错误可能导致全局最优解的丢失。本文提出了一种符号对冲束搜索RQAOA方法，该方法保留标准RQAOA选择的变量或对，探索两种可能的符号分配，并根据经典分数保留最佳的B个残差问题。在受挫的Sherrington Kirkpatrick实例上，该方法显著提高了近似比。
authors: Anupama Ray, Arush Sharma

articles.title: Random encoders and expurgation improve 1,873 entries of the Grassl qubit code tables
articles.title_zh: 随机编码器和删减改进了Grassl量子比特码表中的1,873个条目
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08744v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: I report 192 explicit binary stabilizer codes [[n,k,d]] with 53łe nłe 254 and 5łe dłe 13 whose minimum distance exceeds the lower bound listed in Grassl's code tables at the same (n,k): 161 codes by one and 31 by two. Through the standard propagation rules they raise 1,873 entries of the table. For 190 of the codes, a random Clifford encoder is followed by expurgation: every logical operator of weight below the target distance is enumerated, and a few logical operators are promoted to stabilizers so that each low-weight one anticommutes with at least one of them. The other two are obtained by puncturing a code from the table and repairing it in the same way. All 192 distances are exact: the lower bound is certified by exhaustive meet-in-the-middle enumeration of up to 4×10¹³ Pauli operators, and the upper bound by an explicit logical operator of weight d. A first-moment count explains the results. Expurgated random codes have about eight more logical qubits than a typical random code of the same length and distance, so they beat the table wherever its best known codes are no better than random. The largest gains, up to nine logical qubits, are at dge9 and ngtrsim170, where the table often gives a lower bound without an explicit code. The same count predicts improvements at 619 further pairs (n,d). The search was run by AI agents. The codes, their certificates and an independent checker are public.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报告了192个明确的二元稳定器码[[n,k,d]]，其最小距离超过了Grassl码表中相同(n,k)下的下限。通过标准传播规则，这些码提高了表中1,873个条目。研究表明，经过删减的随机码比相同长度和距离的典型随机码多出大约八个逻辑量子比特，从而在现有最佳已知码不优于随机码的情况下超越了表格。
authors: Marin Girard

articles.title: Kinetic Cluster Embedding for Qubit Decoherence in Dissipative Spin Baths
articles.title_zh: 耗散自旋浴中量子比特退相干的动力学簇嵌入方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08830v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interpreting the decoherence of a spin qubit requires knowing how the surrounding bath spins behave: whether they fluctuate independently, exchange polarization incoherently, or evolve as coherent groups. These processes can yield the same Hahn-echo coherence time yet produce different coherence signals under pulse control of the qubit. Existing theoretical approaches either capture bath correlations at a cost that grows combinatorially with spin-bath cluster size or neglect polarization transport altogether. We introduce kinetic cluster embedding (KCE), which uses a single dimensionless parameter, comparing the flip-flop coupling of a spin pair with its detuning and linewidth, to decide how each pair must be treated. Pairs that can complete an appreciable exchange oscillation are propagated with the full dissipative quantum dynamics. All other spins are treated as random-telegraph fluctuators coupled through a kinetic network of polarization-transfer rates. We show that for nitrogen-vacancy centers coupled to surface electron spins, KCE propagates about 7 four-spin clusters, compared to more than 10⁵ propagated by fourth-order master-equation cluster-correlation (ME-CCE4); nevertheless it reproduces ME-CCE4 coherence times to within 15% for dipolar couplings of order 10² times the bath relaxation rate. For a three-dimensional P1 bath, the agreement is within 16%. Coherent multispin clusters emerge as the leading correction to independent fluctuators, and they leave a distinct signature in the CPMG response. Importantly, we find that whether a rate description suffices is set not by coupling strength alone but by whether a pair can exchange polarization coherently before detuning and damping suppress it.
articles.abstract_zh: 解释自旋量子比特的退相干需要理解周围浴自旋的行为。现有理论方法在处理浴关联时存在计算成本高或忽略极化传输的问题。本文引入了动力学簇嵌入（KCE）方法，通过一个无量纲参数来决定如何处理自旋对。该方法能够有效模拟氮空位中心与表面电子自旋耦合的系统，显著降低了计算复杂性。
authors: Xiaofei Yu, Jonah Nagura, Stella Wang, Evan J. Villafranca, Peter C. Maurer, Giulia Galli

articles.title: From spectroscopy to quantum dynamics: assessing reduced models of a NaCs molecular gate
articles.title_zh: 从光谱学到量子动力学：评估NaCs分子门约化模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08844v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate how spectroscopic calibration and basis selection affect predictions for a dipolar-exchange gate between two optically trapped ²³Na¹³³Cs molecules. We construct a 128-state molecular Hamiltonian restricted to the N=0,1 rotational manifold, fit two effective optical parameters to three bright microwave transitions, and compare the resulting spectrum with four additional lines. In the coherent pair model, changing the optical polarization angle by +0.1ⁱ̧rc reduces the calculated gate fidelity from 94.64% to 1.09% at fixed carrier frequencies. Retuning the carriers and restoring the target Rabi frequencies recovers 89.31%. The remaining sensitivity reflects changes in the multilevel pair dynamics that are not removed by target-frequency and target-Rabi recalibration. Enlarging the molecular basis produces nonmonotonic changes in fidelity, although the 11-state and 25-state calculations give closely agreeing logical maps after phase alignment. Two controls with isolated transfer probabilities near 98.45% yield complete-gate fidelities differing by more than 11 percentage points. We relate these comparisons to a sufficient bound on the error of a projected propagator. The numerical tests quantify agreement among selected bases for a specified coherent Hamiltonian.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了光谱校准和基选择如何影响偶极交换门在光学捕获的²³Na¹³³Cs分子间的预测。研究构建了一个128态分子哈密顿量，并发现光学偏振角微小变化会导致门保真度显著下降。扩大分子基组会产生非单调的保真度变化，但经过相位对齐后，11态和25态计算的逻辑映射结果非常接近。
authors: Marko Gacesa

articles.title: Quantum Fluctuations in Noether's Theorem
articles.title_zh: 诺特定理中的量子涨落
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08906v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When deriving the expression for the Noether's current one obtains a term that is an integral over the Euler-Lagrange equation. This term vanishes along the classical path and so does not contribute to the current. However, quantum particles do not necessarily follow the classical path; this concept is the basis of Feynman's path integral quantization formalism. Thus, for a quantum system, the Euler-Lagrange term does not vanish and, hence, corresponds to a quantum fluctuation of the Noether's current owing to the system deviating from the classical path. Here, we compute this quantum fluctuation from Noether's theorem and the path integral formalism. We find that, for a time invariant system, the expression for the quantum fluctuations is give by minus the functional expression for the Hamiltonian, Δ E = -H(y), evaluated at the distance from the classical path, y. As an example we evaluate quantum energy fluctuations of a single Harmonic oscillator. In the short time limit we recover the energy-time uncertainty relation and in the long time limit we recover the zero point energy of the quantum harmonic oscillator.
articles.abstract_zh: 在推导诺特流时，存在一个沿经典路径消失的欧拉-拉格朗日方程积分项。然而，量子粒子不遵循经典路径，导致该项不为零，从而产生诺特流的量子涨落。本文利用诺特定理和路径积分形式计算了这种量子涨落，发现对于时间不变系统，其表达式为哈密顿量的负泛函。研究以谐振子为例，在短时极限下恢复了能量-时间不确定关系，在长时极限下恢复了零点能。
authors: J. A. Crosse

articles.title: Shared Lookups and Lazy Residues: Fewer Toffoli Gates for Factoring RSA-2048
articles.title_zh: 共享查找与惰性余数：减少RSA-2048分解所需的Toffoli门数量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08907v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Gidney's 2025 construction for factoring RSA-2048 with few logical qubits spends most of its Toffoli gates on discrete-log table lookups and residue uncomputation. We reduce both costs. Shared lookups return entries for several primes of a residue number system at once because they have the same address. Retained intermediate residues remove recomputation during cleanup and enable lazy arithmetic with a single final modular reduction. We prove output preservation and estimate resources with an open benchmark built on the reference simulator. Against the best reference setting within the same logical-qubit budget, using the published model for the reference and benchmark counts for our circuits, we obtain 15% fewer Toffolis at 1,461 qubits (5.08 × 10⁹ per factoring) and 46% fewer at 1,806 qubits (2.55 × 10⁹). A matched ablation finds 28.8% fewer Toffolis from three-prime sharing at fixed window and checkpoint settings. Architecture-specific timing determines how much becomes a runtime saving.
articles.abstract_zh: Gidney在2025年提出的RSA-2048分解方案中，大部分Toffoli门消耗在离散对数表查找和余数反计算上。本文通过引入共享查找和保留中间余数来降低这些成本。共享查找允许一次性返回多个素数的条目，而保留中间余数则消除了清理过程中的重复计算。实验结果表明，在相同逻辑量子比特预算下，该方法可将Toffoli门数量减少15%至46%。
authors: Monit Sharma, Hoong Chuin Lau

articles.title: Optimal Separations Between Randomized and Quantum Query Complexity under Permutation Symmetry
articles.title_zh: 置换对称下随机与量子查询复杂度的最优分离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08919v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A function f:Ḑsubseteq A^N→0,1 is emphpermutation-invariant if every permutation of its input positions preserves both its domain and its value. We study how this symmetry limits quantum speedups. For 1/6łeqǎrepsilon<1/2, we prove that every such function over an arbitrary finite alphabet A satisfies R_ǎrepsilon(f)=O(Q_ǎrepsilon(f)²⁾, where R_ǎrepsilon and Q_ǎrepsilon denote randomized and quantum query complexities with error at most ǎrepsilon. This improves the previous cubic bound (ITCS 2019). We further establish bounds for graph and hypergraph properties, for which vertex relabeling preserves both the promise and the answer. For the same range of ǎrepsilon, we obtain R_ǎrepsilon(f)=O(Q_ǎrepsilon(f)⁴⁾ for graph properties in the adjacency-matrix model and R_ǎrepsilon(f)=Oₖ₍Q_ǎrepsilon(f)²k) for k-uniform hypergraph properties with fixed k≥2, where the implicit constant depends only on k. These improve the previous bounds R₁/₃(f)=O(Q₁/₃(f)⁶⁾ and R₁/₃(f)=Oₖ₍Q₁/₃(f)³k), respectively (SICOMP 2024) These bounds are tight for permutation-invariant functions and nearly tight for graph and hypergraph properties. Unstructured search gives a matching quadratic separation with R₁/₃(f)=Θ!łeft(Q₁/₃(f)²ⁱ̊ght). For every fixed k≥ 2, we construct explicit families of invariant promise problems on k-uniform hypergraphs satisfying R₁/₃(f)≥ Q₁/₃(f)²k⁻o⁽¹⁾.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了置换不变函数中量子加速的限制。对于任意有限字母表上的置换不变函数，证明了随机查询复杂度R与量子查询复杂度Q之间存在R(f)=O(Q(f)²)的关系，改进了此前的立方界限。此外，对于图和超图性质，研究也建立了更优的界限。这些界限对于置换不变函数是紧密的，对于图和超图性质是接近紧密的。
authors: Yunqi Huang, Lvzhou Li, Zekun Ye, Shenggen Zheng

articles.title: Optimal asymptotic pure-state conversion under thermal operations
articles.title_zh: 热操作下纯态渐近转换的最优性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08974v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum thermodynamics seeks to characterize possible state transformations under thermodynamic constraints in microscopic quantum systems. In the fully quantum regime, however, quantum coherence imposes various restrictions on state conversions, and a complete characterization of state convertibility has remained open. Here we resolve this problem for asymptotic conversions between pure states. Specifically, we show that asymptotic convertibility is fully determined by the free-energy and energy-variance ratios. Our result reveals how genuinely quantum effects quantitatively constrain state conversions in quantum thermodynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子热力学旨在描述微观量子系统在热力学约束下的态转换。在完全量子体系中，量子相干性对态转换施加了多种限制，其完整表征仍未解决。本文解决了纯态之间渐近转换的问题，表明渐近可转换性完全由自由能和能量方差比决定。该结果揭示了真正的量子效应如何在量子热力学中定量限制态转换。
authors: Tatsuya Yamanouchi, Naoto Shiraishi

articles.title: Perfect Wave Transfer in Nonconformal Tomonaga-Luttinger Liquids
articles.title_zh: 非共形Tomonaga-Luttinger液体中的完美波传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09018v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Perfect wave transfer (PWT) reproduces spatial reflection at a common finite time under a fixed Hamiltonian. We classify this process for open compact bosons and inhomogeneous Tomonaga--Luttinger liquids, distinguishing transfer of oscillator and neutral observables from transfer on the charged field algebra. In the single-charge model, the first two notions coincide. Global transfer additionally requires rephasing of the compact zero mode. For regular reflection-symmetric channels, exact oscillator transfer forces an odd multiple of the optical crossing time and a strictly ordered, parity-compatible spectrum differing from the conformal ladder at only finitely many levels. This spectral condition is also sufficient when the Robin boundary data induced by the physical profile are included. Requiring Neumann conditions after the Liouville transformation instead forces conformality. We construct an explicit, regular one-defect family for every r>1/2. Its transfer parameters are precisely the reduced fractions r=p/q with odd numerator and denominator, with shortest transfer time pL/v₀. At the delay 3L/v₀, the r=3/5 profile has numerical contrast Kₘₐₓ/Kₘᵢₙsimeq 12.913, compared with 81 for r=3. Two independent conservative discretizations show second-order convergence on fixed mode bands. Occupation- and charge-constrained error estimates quantify robustness, while an exact homogeneous-chain calculation explains the J²/³ resolved-band scale also observed in the engineered channels. These results provide a spectral design method and finite-device benchmarks for quadratic quantum channels. An interacting microscopic realization remains open.
articles.abstract_zh: 完美波传输（PWT）在固定哈密顿量下，于共同有限时间内再现空间反射。本文对开放紧致玻色子和非均匀Tomonaga-Luttinger液体中的PWT过程进行了分类，区分了振子和中性可观测量的传输与带电场代数上的传输。研究发现，对于正则反射对称通道，精确的振子传输要求光学交叉时间的奇数倍和严格有序的、与宇称兼容的谱。
authors: Davide Batic, Denys Dutykh

articles.title: Interaction-enabled charging and thermal crossover of the spin-work deficit in a Hubbard double quantum dot
articles.title_zh: Hubbard双量子点中自旋功亏的相互作用诱导充电和热交叉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09119v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study how conservation of total spin affects the extractable work of an interacting Hubbard double quantum dot charged in the presence of unresolved quasistatic detuning fluctuations. The full fermionic Fock space is used to model preparation through electronic reservoirs, whereas the additional work deficit associated with spin conservation arises entirely from the singlet and triplet states at half filling. At zero detuning, modulation of the symmetric tunnel barrier couples two singlets of even parity. The corresponding transition matrix element vanishes when U = V . An exact formula for the additional work deficit follows from passive spectral rearrangement under two extraction constraints: conservation of particle number alone and conservation of both particle number and total spin. At low temperature, an expansion in the detuning response gives a leading estimate of the noise amplitude at which this deficit first appears. Increasing the preparation temperature changes the triplet population and produces a crossover at s2 = q, where the additional spin constraint becomes nonbinding for the averaged state, even though both ergotropies may continue to decrease. We obtain a semi-analytic expression for this crossover by separating the thermal Gibbs weights from the singlet dynamics under a fixed charging pulse. Averaging over symmetric detuning disorder also restores parity in the density matrix and allows singlet eigenvalues of different parity to exchange order, changing the branch that determines the thermal boundary. The work values are optimal over specified classes of unitary operations and do not establish the yield of a finite discharge protocol.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了总自旋守恒如何影响相互作用的Hubbard双量子点在未解决的准静态失谐波动存在下的可提取功。研究发现，与自旋守恒相关的额外功亏完全源于半填充时的单重态和三重态。在低温下，通过失谐响应的展开可以估算出该亏缺首次出现的噪声幅度。提高制备温度会改变三重态布居，并在特定条件下产生一个交叉点，使额外的自旋约束对平均态变得非约束。
authors: Khalil Loukhssami, Cheng Shang, Morad El Baz, Khadija El Hawary

articles.title: A Tutorial on Practical QKD Post-Processing Algorithms Using a GUI-Based Simulation Framework
articles.title_zh: 基于GUI仿真框架的实用QKD后处理算法教程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09182v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent experimental demonstrations of Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) have attracted significant attention for their ability to establish information-theoretically secure encryption keys for next-generation communication systems. As practical deployment accelerates, the realization of compact, scalable, and high-throughput discrete-variable (DV) QKD systems has become increasingly important. While advances in photonic integration are enabling low-size, low-weight, and low-power QKD hardware, the security and performance of these systems rely heavily on efficient post-processing techniques to generate identical, secure keys. This tutorial presents a comprehensive algorithm-level review of practical post-processing techniques for DV-QKD, with particular emphasis on information reconciliation methods based on Cascade, Winnow, low-density parity-check (LDPC), and polar codes. We also analyze the theoretical asymptotic and finite-size secret key rates (SKRs) of DV-QKD and benchmark these bounds against the practical SKRs achieved using actual post-processing algorithms. Furthermore, we present a server-client model to implement the entire QKD post-processing pipeline. The performance is evaluated in terms of QBER and SKR across various system parameters, considering the complete post-processing pipeline, including sifting, information reconciliation, privacy amplification, and authentication. This tutorial also presents a graphical user interface (GUI) for the QKD post-processing methods, enabling researchers, industry practitioners, and academic users to visualize and analyze the impact of different post-processing techniques and system parameters, such as QBER, on the SKR performance of DV-QKD systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子密钥分发（QKD）在建立信息论安全加密密钥方面备受关注。本文提供了一份关于离散变量QKD（DV-QKD）实用后处理技术的全面算法级综述，重点介绍了基于Cascade、Winnow、LDPC和极性码的信息协调方法。研究分析了DV-QKD的理论渐近和有限尺寸秘密密钥率，并将其与实际后处理算法实现的密钥率进行了基准测试。此外，还提出了一个服务器-客户端模型来实施整个QKD过程。
authors: Ushnik Nath, Neha Sharma, Ramniwas Meena, Neel Kanth Kundu

articles.title: Reachability Constraints and Monotones for Quantum-State Texture
articles.title_zh: 量子态纹理的可达性约束与单调量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09230v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: How a quantum resource can be quantified depends on which operations are free. Yet two proposed quantifiers of quantum state texture can increase under free operations: the Wigner-Yanase-Dyson skew information relative to the unique textureless state and the squared Hilbert-Schmidt distance from that state. We show reachability from every state orthogonal to the textureless state, whether pure or mixed: each can be freely transformed into any other state. Therefore, every texture monotone must assign the same maximal value to all such states, a requirement that neither candidate satisfies. We then construct valid texture monotones by adding the population outside the textureless state to the skew information and by maximizing the squared Hilbert-Schmidt distance over free operations. We prove faithfulness, convexity, and invariance under textureless ancillas, characterize additivity properties and strong monotonicity, satisfied only in the Wigner-Yanase case, and derive tight bounds for both monotones at fixed overlap with the textureless state and characterize all saturating states. Together, these results show how allowed state transformations impose operational constraints on the quantification of quantum state texture.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子资源量化取决于自由操作的定义。本文指出，现有两种量子态纹理的量化方法在自由操作下可能增加。研究证明，所有正交于无纹理态的纯态或混合态之间均可自由转换，这意味着所有纹理单调量必须赋予这些态相同的最大值。为此，本文通过将无纹理态之外的布居数添加到斜信息中，并最大化希尔伯特-施密特距离的平方，构建了有效的纹理单调量。
authors: Jose Alfredo de Leon, Pablo Vielman, Miguel Gonzalez

articles.title: Evaluation of Quantum Machine Learning Models for Network Anomaly Detection
articles.title_zh: 量子机器学习模型在网络异常检测中的评估
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09253v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The proliferation of Internet-connected devices has intensified the risk of large-scale network intrusions, necessitating more advanced detection methodologies for the post quantum era. This work presents, to the best of our knowledge, a com- prehensive investigation of quantum machine learning (QML) for anomaly detection on the BoT-IoT dataset, a widely adopted benchmark for IoT security. Leveraging feature-engineered rep- resentations, we implement and evaluate four representative quantum classifiers: Quantum Support Vector Classification (QSVC), Quantum Neural Networks (QNN), and Variational Quantum Classifiers (VQC).
articles.abstract_zh: 随着物联网设备普及，大规模网络入侵风险加剧，亟需后量子时代更先进的检测方法。本文对量子机器学习（QML）在BoT-IoT数据集上的异常检测进行了全面研究。研究利用特征工程表示，实现并评估了四种代表性量子分类器，包括量子支持向量分类、量子神经网络和变分量子分类器。
authors: Swathi Chandrasekhar, Shiva Raj Pokhrel

articles.title: Correlation-Enhanced Quantum Reservoir Processing for Two-Qutrit Steering: From Generalization to Discovery
articles.title_zh: 用于双三能级系统导引的关联增强量子储备池处理：从泛化到发现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09268v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum reservoir processing (QRP) has been applied to entanglement quantification, yet its potential for generalizable steering detection and the discovery of high-dimensional quantum correlations remains largely unexplored. Here, we introduce correlation-enhanced QRP (CEQRP), extending QRP to two-qutrit systems with two-body spin-correlation readouts. Some CEQRP-based classifiers substantially improve cross-family generalization, with logistic regression trained on full-information CEQRP features achieving approximately 96% accuracy on unseen Werner states and over 97% accuracy on unseen isotropic states at both (m=4) and (m=5). Independently, we establish two interconnected steering criteria for mixed two-qutrit states: a necessary-and-sufficient all-versus-nothing criterion for states admitting three linearly independent pure conditional states, and an asymptotic sufficient criterion, with the two criteria linked through invertible local filtering. These criteria provide rigorously certified steerable samples for training-set augmentation. Combining CEQRP-based classification with these theory-certified samples enables the discovery of new Alice-to-Bob steerable partially entangled states, including states at (p=0.45) whose steerability is independently confirmed by semidefinite programming (SDP) using seven projective measurement settings. The trained classifiers further guide finite-setting searches for steering boundaries. Our results establish a pathway from generalizable classification to the discovery of high-dimensional quantum steering.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子储备池处理（QRP）在纠缠量化中有所应用，但在可泛化导引检测和高维量子关联发现方面的潜力尚未充分探索。本文引入了关联增强QRP（CEQRP），将其扩展到具有双体自旋关联读数的双三能级系统。基于CEQRP的分类器显著提高了跨家族泛化能力。研究还建立了混合双三能级态的两个相互关联的导引判据，为训练集增强提供了严格认证的导引样本。
authors: Pu Wang, Zhongyan Li, Huixian Meng, Yutao Xin. Ziqi Zhi, Zhihua Guo, Huaixin Cao

articles.title: A Geometric Journey Through the Aharonov--Bohm Effect: Tonomura's Toroid, Pseudoscalar Phase, and Quantum Holonomy in Clifford Algebra
articles.title_zh: 阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆效应的几何之旅：Tonomura环形磁体、赝标量相位与Clifford代数中的量子完整性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09311v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The magnetic Aharonov--Bohm (AB) effect is often introduced through the idealised infinite solenoid and a complex scalar phase. We give a geometric-algebra formulation based on the compact toroidal magnets shielded by a superconductor employed in the electron-holography experiments of Tonomura and collaborators. Working in the real Euclidean Clifford algebra  Cl(3,0), we distinguish the unit volume pseudoscalar I (grade 3), coordinate angles (scalars, grade 0), tangent vectors (grade 1), and directed surface bivectors (grade 2). The magnetic field is represented by the dual bivector B= I mathbf B, while the electromagnetic U(1) phase is represented by the central unit multivector eIα generated by the pseudoscalar I, rather than by a spatial rotor with a bivector generator. We establish the linked toroidal geometry, formulate magnetic flux and Stokes' theorem intrinsically in geometric algebra, and derive the holonomy element U_Γ=exp(IqΦ_B/hbar) from U(1) gauge covariance, with every sign fixed explicitly. We then express superconducting fluxoid quantization in the same notation and obtain the binary electron holonomy U_Γ = (-1)^N in the ideal limit where the linked magnetic flux equals N h/(2e). Finally, a short conditional-state description of the quantum source and field shows how a backreaction can introduce an additional phase and reduce interference visibility. The conditional-state overlap is represented by a central scalar--pseudoscalar element; preservation of the fluxoid sector alone does not guarantee unit coherence.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于Tonomura及其合作者在电子全息实验中使用的超导屏蔽紧凑环形磁体，提出了磁性阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆（AB）效应的几何代数表述。作者在实欧几里得Clifford代数Cl(3,0)中工作，区分了赝标量、坐标角、切向量和有向表面双矢量，并用中心单位多矢量表示电磁U(1)相位。研究建立了环形几何结构，在几何代数中内在地阐述了磁通量和斯托克斯定理，并从U(1)规范协变性推导了完整性元素，最终以相同符号表达了超导磁通量子化。
authors: Andrew Powell

articles.title: Critical properties of EPR steering
articles.title_zh: EPR导引的临界特性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09321v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Every PVM-critical entangled two-qubit state becomes steerable with two copies. We prove this for the full critical boundary and for two different critical inputs. The joint measurements can have arbitrarily little entanglement, while all conditional states on Bob's two systems remain separable. Criticality is exactly the point where this measurement-entanglement threshold vanishes. The number of measurements has a separate critical behavior: every fixed setting bound leaves an unsteerable neighborhood of the critical input. Moreover, for any such bound, there are critical states that remain unsteerable under every tensor power, although unrestricted measurements activate them with two copies. These results identify different roles for measurement entanglement, measurement number, and collective access in revealing steering. We also construct fixed-dimensional states whose steering activates on two copies while Bell locality persists through any prescribed finite copy range. In increasing dimension, the two-copy steering violation is unbounded, giving an affirmative solution to the amplification question of Hsieh, Liang, and Lee.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究证明了每个PVM临界纠缠双量子比特态在两份副本下都变得可导引，并探讨了测量纠缠、测量数量和集体访问在揭示导引中的不同作用。结果表明，联合测量可以具有任意小的纠缠，而Bob系统上的所有条件态保持可分离。研究还构建了固定维度的态，其导引在两份副本上被激活，而贝尔局域性在任何有限副本范围内持续存在，为Hsieh、Liang和Lee的放大问题提供了肯定答案。
authors: Yu-Xuan Zhang, Jing-Ling Chen

articles.title: Tomography of approximately Gaussian mixed states
articles.title_zh: 近似高斯混合态的层析成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09322v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Moment-based tomography efficiently reconstructs Gaussian states, but stochastic phase noise generally produces mixed, non-Gaussian outputs. For approximately Gaussian outputs, we formulate reconstruction as a problem in quantum learning theory under model misspecification. Our trace-distance guarantee separates the intrinsic Gaussian approximation error from statistical errors in estimating the first moments and covariance matrix. Using recent Gaussian trace-distance bounds, we obtain linear dependence of the statistical contribution on moment errors when the covariance inverses remain bounded, improving on the square-root dependence on covariance error in earlier guarantees. A Fock-space truncation procedure provides certified, convergent lower and upper bounds on the intrinsic error. Under an explicit sub-Gaussian condition on the heterodyne outcomes, the sufficient sample count scales inversely with the square of the allowed statistical error remaining after accounting for the approximation error. We verify the statistical condition for stochastic phase rotations and heralded unitary-averaged states with bounded input squeezing. We apply the framework to probabilistic unitary averaging for phase noise reduction, quantifying reconstruction error and accounting for heralding overhead in the total number of estimation attempts.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将近似高斯混合态的重建问题，在模型误设定下，表述为量子学习理论中的一个问题。研究提出的迹距离保证将固有的高斯近似误差与估计一阶矩和协方差矩阵的统计误差分离开来。通过Fock空间截断程序，可以获得固有误差的认证、收敛的上下界。在明确的亚高斯条件下，所需的样本数量与允许的统计误差的平方成反比。
authors: S. Nibedita Swain, Timothy C. Ralph, Jens Eisert, Nathan Walk

articles.title: Quantum-induced latent symmetries
articles.title_zh: 量子诱导的潜在对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09406v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the interplay of latent symmetries and multiparticle quantum states upon the introduction of additional particles. We show how physical symmetries in multimode quantum systems give rise to symmetries in the multiparticle state space of indistinguishable fermions and bosons. Latent symmetries, hidden symmetries that are exclusively visible in the eigenspectral domain, offer new ways to engineer the functionality of multimode quantum systems. In this vein, we present multiboson state generation as an application of latent symmetries to the multiparticle domain. Finally, we demonstrate that even in systems that are entirely devoid of symmetry, latent symmetries can be induced in the multiparticle state space, as a result of quantum indistinguishability.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了在引入额外粒子时，潜在对称性与多粒子量子态之间的相互作用。作者展示了多模量子系统中的物理对称性如何导致不可区分费米子和玻色子的多粒子态空间中的对称性。潜在对称性，即仅在特征谱域中可见的隐藏对称性，为设计多模量子系统的功能提供了新途径。研究还证明，即使在完全没有对称性的系统中，量子不可区分性也能在多粒子态空间中诱导潜在对称性。
authors: Jonas Himmel, Malte Röntgen, Tilman Gühlstorf, Matthias Heinrich, Max Ehrhardt, Alexander Szameit, Tom A. W. Wolterink

articles.title: Dynamics and pseudospectra around quantum exceptional points
articles.title_zh: 量子奇异点附近的动力学与赝谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09464v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exceptional points (EPs) are a hallmark of non-Hermitian physics, giving rise to extreme sensitivity and enhanced dynamic response. Such unique spectral singularities have been extensively studied in classical photonics, both at theoretical and experimental levels, where the relevant observables are evident. That is not necessarily the case in the quantum regime, where this kind of behavior around EPs, to a large extent, remains elusive. In fact, the interplay between dissipation and quantum fluctuations makes the complete Lindbladian evolution quite different from effective non-Hermitian Hamiltonian descriptions. In this context, we investigate the signatures of the Liouvillian EPs on spectral and dynamic response by considering properly normalized long-time averages and imbalances. Even though our approach is generic, we focus on two paradigmatic models-a lossy Bose-Hubbard lattice and a dissipative two-spin system, where we investigate the role of quantum jumps and interactions in the Liouvillian spectrum, in terms of complex and structured pseudospectra. Our results demonstrate how non-Hermitian phenomena emerge in realistic quantum lattices, providing a bridge between classical EP physics and experimentally accessible open quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了耗散和量子涨落对量子奇异点（EPs）附近行为的影响，这在量子领域中仍是难以捉摸的。作者通过考虑适当归一化的长时间平均值和不平衡性，探讨了Liouvillian EPs对谱和动态响应的特征。研究聚焦于有损Bose-Hubbard晶格和耗散双自旋系统这两个典型模型，并以复杂且结构化的赝谱形式，探究了量子跳跃和相互作用在Liouvillian谱中的作用。结果揭示了非厄米现象如何在实际量子系统中出现。
authors: Georgios E. Pavlou, Ioannis Kiorpelidis, Georgios K. Simopoulos, Manas Kulkarni, Konstantinos G. Makris

articles.title: Resonance-engineered single-photon routing in an asymmetric Jaynes-Cummings cavity-waveguide system
articles.title_zh: 非对称Jaynes-Cummings腔波导系统中经共振工程的单光子路由
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09519v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate single-photon scattering and routing in an asymmetric cavity-waveguide quantum electrodynamics system consisting of a Jaynes-Cummings cavity-emitter subsystem coupled to two one-dimensional waveguides. Using a real-space scattering approach, we derive an exact three-channel scattering matrix and analytical expressions for the channel-resolved scattering amplitudes. The scattering response is governed by the interplay of asymmetric cavity-waveguide coupling, atom-cavity detuning, coherent preparation of a single-photon superposition across multiple input channels, and intrinsic dissipation. Coupling asymmetry controls the relative weights of the cavity-mediated scattering pathways, whereas atom-cavity detuning modifies their spectral response. Coherent multichannel input states provide an additional phase-sensitive control of the output probabilities through interference. In particular, we identify an analytical condition, J₂₌₂J₁ and α₁₌₋α₂, under which the probability in the second output channel becomes independent of photon energy; for an equal-weight normalized input, this probability is 1/2. We further show how cavity and atomic dissipation reduce the probability remaining in the guided channels. These results provide a framework for resonance-engineered single-photon routing in asymmetric Jaynes-Cummings cavity-waveguide systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了由Jaynes-Cummings腔-发射器子系统与两个一维波导耦合组成的非对称腔波导量子电动力学系统中的单光子散射和路由。研究利用实空间散射方法，推导了精确的三通道散射矩阵和通道分辨散射幅度的解析表达式。散射响应受非对称腔波导耦合、原子-腔失谐、多输入通道单光子叠加的相干制备以及固有耗散的相互作用控制。研究还识别出一个解析条件，在此条件下第二个输出通道的概率与光子能量无关。
authors: Adam Sulieman Ibrahim Abdalla

articles.title: Open Quantum Time Crystals without External Thermodynamic Resources: Go and No-Go Theorems
articles.title_zh: 无外部热力学资源的开放量子时间晶体：可行性与不可行性定理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09540v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Time crystals are phases of matter that spontaneously break time-translation symmetry. They have been ruled out in the ground and Gibbs states of isolated systems with only short-range interactions, yet they have been proposed and observed experimentally in nonequilibrium settings such as Floquet and open systems. However, existing proposals for time crystals in open quantum systems require an external supply of thermodynamic resources, such as work or energetic coherence. Whether coupling to an environment, without any such resource supply, can induce a time crystal absent in the isolated system remains open. Here, we answer this question systematically. We first construct an explicit model and prove that coupling to an environment can activate a time crystal absent in the isolated system, even without such resource supply. We consider Lindblad master equations with (i) time-independent Hamiltonian and jump operators, (ii) time-translation covariance, and (iii) detailed balance---conditions that hold in standard derivations unless thermodynamic resources are supplied externally. Our model satisfies these conditions, and the activation occurs in a stationary state of both the isolated and open systems. We give several implementations of this dynamics with a zero-temperature Gibbs environment, a time-independent, energy-conserving interaction, and only short-range Hamiltonians, one of which exactly reproduces the time-crystalline periodicity. We then prove a no-go theorem: under (i)--(iii), activation can arise only from an environment-induced Hamiltonian term, not from dissipation. Our results show that time crystals can be activated in open systems without external resource supply and identify the physical requirements on the system and environment for this activation through our general no-go theorem.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统地探讨了在没有外部热力学资源供应的情况下，环境耦合是否能诱导孤立系统中不存在的时间晶体。研究构建了一个明确的模型并证明，即使没有外部资源，环境耦合也能激活孤立系统中不存在的时间晶体。该模型满足了林德布拉德主方程的时间无关哈密顿量和跳跃算符、时间平移协变性以及详细平衡条件。
authors: Yuri Ogami, Hiroyasu Tajima

articles.title: Relativistic analogue of the Kramers-Henneberger transformation and pair creation
articles.title_zh: Kramers-Henneberger变换的相对论模拟与对产生
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09549v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In analogy to the Kramers-Henneberger transformation in non-relativistic quantum mechanics, we propose and investigate a spinor transformation for the Dirac equation which allows us to transform space-time dependent vector potentials A(t,x)boldsymboleₓ away. In the mass-less case, we exactly arrive at the free Dirac equation, while for massive Dirac fields, the transformation results in a non-trivial mass matrix containing space-time dependent phases. Special emphasis is placed on the phenomenon of fermion pair creation in the external field A(t,x)boldsymboleₓ where the spinor transformation allows us to conceptually disentangle the different contributions to pair creation. It can also be used to reformulate the WKB approach and the Riccati equation (which can be advantageous in certain cases) and to obtain additional insight into the mechanism of dynamically assisted pair creation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了并研究了狄拉克方程的旋量变换，该变换允许消除时空相关的矢量势，类似于非相对论量子力学中的Kramers-Henneberger变换。在无质量情况下，变换精确地得到自由狄拉克方程；对于有质量狄拉克场，则产生包含时空相关相位的非平凡质量矩阵。研究特别强调了外场中费米子对产生现象，旋量变换有助于概念性地解耦对产生的不同贡献，并可用于重新表述WKB方法和Riccati方程。
authors: Johannes Marschall, Christian Kohlfürst, Naser Ahmadiniaz, Ralf Schützhold

articles.title: Efficient One-Shot Simulation of Network Instruments and Multi-party Purity Distillation
articles.title_zh: 网络仪器的有效一次性模拟与多方纯度蒸馏
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09641v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We undertake an information theoretic study of instrument compression problems (ICPs) in multiple network configurations, wherein the goal is to design and analyze protocols that simulate specific quantum classical (QC) correlation amidst distributed parties - some holding components of the quantum state and the rest holding classical registers - with minimum communication. We present a unified framework of protocols based on likelihood instruments whose analysis yields new inner bounds in the one-shot and asymptotic regimes for the different network configurations we study. Our framework comprises of a common template for designing the instrument simulation protocol and analyzing its information theoretic performance. We also address a related problem of multi-party purity distillation wherein three distributed parties have to distil pure states efficiently via local operations and minimal communication. In regards to the tools, in addition to one-shot purity concentration protocol of i̧te202203arXiv_ChaPadSen and one-shot quantum simultaneous decoder of Sen i̧te202102SAD_Sen, we leverage Sen's fully smooth multi-partite covering i̧te202504arXiv_Sen for all of our covering bounds.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对多种网络配置下的仪器压缩问题（ICPs）进行了信息论研究，旨在设计和分析以最小通信量模拟分布式各方之间特定量子经典（QC）关联的协议。研究提出了一个基于似然仪器的统一协议框架，其分析为不同网络配置的一次性（one-shot）和渐近（asymptotic）方案提供了新的内界。该框架还解决了多方纯度蒸馏的相关问题，其中三个分布式方需要通过局部操作和最小通信量有效地蒸馏纯态。
authors: Igor Bernard, Arun Padakandla

articles.title: A Phase-Balanced Differential Rydberg-Atom Quantum Receiver for Weak GNSS Signal Detection
articles.title_zh: 用于弱GNSS信号检测的相位平衡差分里德堡原子量子接收器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09653v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper proposes a phase-balanced differential Rydberg atomic quantum receiver (DRAQR) for weak-signal recovery, using local-oscillator phase control to reinforce differential signal responses and a shared squeezed-reservoir model to correlate inter-cell quantum projection noise (QPN) and photon shot noise (PSN). An analytical model incorporating QPN, PSN, intrinsic thermal noise (ITN), and inter-cell correlations quantifies signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) gain, outage-constrained minimum detectable power, and bit-error rate (BER) for square M-QAM. For the evaluated settings, SNR gain reaches approximately 10~dB as PSN correlation approaches unity, with BER decreasing as correlation increases. Under Rician fading, at a 0-dB threshold SNR and maximum outage probability of 0.1, the minimum detectable power decreases from -146.95~dBm at K=1.155 to -159.98~dBm at K=2.4. Analytical results are validated against Monte-Carlo simulations over 150,000 data runs per point for receiver-performance plots.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种相位平衡差分里德堡原子量子接收器（DRAQR），用于弱信号恢复。该接收器利用本振相位控制增强差分信号响应，并采用共享压缩储层模型关联单元间量子投影噪声（QPN）和光子散粒噪声（PSN）。分析模型量化了信噪比增益、中断受限最小可检测功率和误码率。在评估设置下，当PSN相关性接近统一时，信噪比增益达到约10 dB，且误码率随相关性增加而降低。
authors: A. K. Mandal, F. Zhang, J. H. Mikkelsen, M. Shen

articles.title: Quantum Integration Software Suite For HPC-Quantum Computing Workflows
articles.title_zh: 用于HPC-量子计算工作流的量子集成软件套件
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09659v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we focus on addressing challenges related to modelling the integration of conventional high-performance computing (HPC) and quantum computing (QC). We introduce the Quantum Assembly Compiler (QASC) for OpenQASM3.0 files. The compiler produces an executable that leverages the high-performance simulator QuEST to simulate quantum programs. Additionally, we introduce a performance modelling tool, QACC-perf, which can estimate the cost of integrating QC in classical HPC workflows, as well as the execution time of the quantum circuits. Finally, we demonstrate the utility of these tools in the context of multiscale quantum chemistry workflows using the ChemShell computational chemistry environment.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文旨在解决传统高性能计算（HPC）与量子计算（QC）集成建模相关的挑战。研究引入了用于OpenQASM3.0文件的量子汇编编译器（QASC），该编译器生成可利用高性能模拟器QuEST模拟量子程序的可执行文件。此外，还提出了一个性能建模工具QACC-perf，用于估计QC集成到经典HPC工作流中的成本以及量子电路的执行时间。这些工具的实用性在ChemShell计算化学环境中的多尺度量子化学工作流中得到了验证。
authors: Mateusz Meller, Joseph C. R. Thacker, Thomas W. Keal, Vendel Szeremi

articles.title: An Adaptive Quantum Search Framework under Unknown Solution-density: Minimizing Expected Queries to the First Solution
articles.title_zh: 未知解密度下自适应量子搜索框架：最小化首次解的预期查询次数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09688v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Grover's algorithm provides a mathematically optimal quadratic speedup for unstructured search, yet its standard formulation relies on a critical prerequisite: prior knowledge of the target solution count to determine the number of algorithm iterations. Although numerous strategies have been developed to identify or bypass this parameter, comparing them directly is nontrivial. This study investigates and computationally optimizes 3 prominent frameworks: Boyer-Brassard-Hoyer-Tapp, Fixed-Point search, and Density Estimation Methods. Density-specific benchmarks select the best tested method and configuration to minimize expected first-solution queries under 2 initialization-cost conventions. To translate these theoretical benchmarks into practical utility, a hybrid quantum-classical adaptive framework integrating Hill-climbing-assisted Grover Adaptive Search with state-space density estimation modeled via the Wang-Landau algorithm is proposed as a potential use-case. This implementation operates directly on the optimized query methods established earlier. Analytical models support the approach; ideal simulations show 18.8%-63.4% lower mean accumulated query costs than the tested randomized and fixed-point baselines.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在解决Grover算法标准形式中对目标解数量先验知识的依赖问题。作者调查并计算优化了Boyer-Brassard-Hoyer-Tapp、不动点搜索和密度估计方法这三个主要框架，以最小化首次解的预期查询次数。为了将这些理论基准转化为实际应用，研究提出了一个混合量子-经典自适应框架，该框架将爬山辅助的Grover自适应搜索与通过Wang-Landau算法建模的状态空间密度估计相结合。分析模型支持该方法，理想模拟显示平均查询次数降低了18.8%-63.4%。
authors: Wiwat Asawalertsak, Rajchawit Sarochawikasit

articles.title: Witnessing Polarization Entanglement of Annihilation Photons via Compton Scattering
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09738v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Experimentally certifying polarization entanglement in annihilation photons is challenging because polarizers are unavailable in the high-energy regime and one needs to rely on Compton polarimetry. Previously proposed schemes designed for this task are either experimentally unfeasible or require a specific source state model. We address these issues by reformulating Compton scattering as a continuous-outcome quantum instrument, thereby enabling the prediction of the scattering angles and the post-scattering polarization state. Our framework allows connecting Compton polarimetry with entanglement witnesses by deriving experimentally accessible lower bounds on Bell state fidelities for arbitrary initial two-photon polarization states. We discuss how this witness can be extracted from coarse-grained coincidence measurements with detectors of almost any angular resolution. The presented scheme does not require knowledge of angle-independent empirical factors like detector efficiencies and source activity. Thus, our results provide a feasible route towards experimental entanglement certification in para-positronium decay with current technology.
authors: Tobias C. Sutter, Beatrix C. Hiesmayr

articles.title: Universal photonic synthetic temporal-mode converter for heterogeneous quantum interconnects
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09752v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a synthetic temporal-mode converter (STC) that combines programmable waveform matching with denser time multiplexing for heterogeneous quantum interconnects. Programmable couplers and optical delays reshape known single-photon temporal waveforms through coherent interference between time bins. Conversion to a common single-bin mode concentrates amplitudes from N bins in łceilłog₂Nc̊eil mixing stages, simultaneously improving temporal indistinguishability and freeing channel time. Simulations yield mode overlaps above 99.9% for exponential and Gaussian inputs. For N=256 and 0.5,dB loss per stage, STC gives a 45.6-fold higher photon-pair coincidence rate than temporal gating at equal mode overlap for two exponential inputs. Relative to long pulses, the shortened temporal matched mode can support an approximately 41-fold higher photon-pair coincidence rate when the available time-multiplexing capacity is fully utilized.
authors: Joohyung Song, James I. Kwon, Edo Waks, Saikat Guha, Chaohan Cui

articles.title: Scalable Unitary State-Encoding for Generic Large Data
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09760v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Efficient encoding of data into quantum states remains a fundamental bottleneck in many quantum computing protocols, which would otherwise offer advantages over their classical counterparts. Here, we introduce deterministic and scalable amplitude-encoding methods with low two-qubit gate costs and tunable trade-offs between circuit depth and encoding fidelity. Our approaches require no amplitude amplification or mid-circuit measurement and are capable of encoding arbitrary complex data or queryable functions by using tensor-networks to go beyond what can be held in classical memory. Our principle contributions are two complementary algorithms for simplifying fully controlled multiplexer circuits to one- and two-qubit gates. In the first, we formally map the elimination of redundant gate controls to a Boolean logic minimization problem, while in the second we utilize a single ancilla qubit to map the multi-controlled rotation gates to a sequence of one- and two-qubit operations via the Walsh-Hadamard spectrum of the gate angles. We benchmark these methods across a broad range of function classes, characterizing their total depth in an all-to-all connectivity graph against system size and target fidelity. Hybridizing our methods gives up to orders of magnitude improvement in circuit depth at equivalent state fidelity compared to the default state-preparation method in the Qiskit package. We furthermore demonstrate our method on IQM hardware with a square lattice connectivity, finding excellent fidelity, even with minimal noise mitigation. By significantly reducing gate depth for encoding, this work enables the experimental execution of applications on current and near-term hardware which would otherwise be reduced to noise before the first calculation step, shortening the time horizon to robust quantum utility.
authors: Vittorio Pagni, Peter K. Schuhmacher, Michael Felderer, Michael Epping, Kevin Lively

articles.title: Differentiable Digital Twins for Optimization, Calibration, and Characterization of Neutral-Atom- and Ion-based Quantum Computers
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09779v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum technologies based on individually controlled atoms are among the most promising platforms for scalable quantum computing, owing to their favorable coherence properties and controllability. Nonetheless, achieving reliable and high-fidelity gate operations remains challenging due to the sensitivity of these systems to noise and hardware imperfections. In this work, we introduce a comprehensive software toolset designed to model atomic quantum systems with high precision and simulate qubit gate dynamics. By integrating quantum optimal control and benchmarking techniques with automatic differentiation for efficient and accurate gradient-based optimization, the toolset enables significant improvements in gate performance. We demonstrate its capabilities through detailed case studies involving both neutral atoms and trapped ions, highlighting its effectiveness in enhancing quantum gate fidelities, and providing valuable insights for experimental implementation.
authors: Marco Rossignolo, Lorena C. Bianchet, Anurag Saha Roy, Shai Machnes

articles.title: Beyond the n/2 Threshold: Quantum Query Complexity for Computing Hamming Weight and Symmetric Functions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09809v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The oracle-interrogation algorithm [van Dam, FOCS '98] computes every n-bit Boolean function with bounded error using n/2+O(sqrt n) quantum queries. In contrast, parity can be computed exactly using łceil n/2c̊eil queries, but whether an additive overhead beyond n/2 is necessary for a single Boolean output has remained open. In this work, we construct an explicit family of symmetric Boolean functions requiring n/2+Ømega(n¹/³) quantum queries at a fixed positive constant error. We also give an algorithm that recovers the exact Hamming weight using n/2+O(n¹/³) quantum queries with bounded error, and therefore computes every symmetric Boolean function within the same query bound. Together, these results determine the optimal additive order for Hamming weight recovery and for the worst case over symmetric Boolean functions at sufficiently small constant error.
authors: Yuan Deng, Zihan Hao, Honghao Lin, Qipeng Liu, Vahab Mirrokni, Jianan Shao, David P. Woodruff

articles.title: Deterministic Quantum Search for NP Problems Through Verifier-Based Oracle Construction
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09830v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Problems in the class NP are important in computational science, where a given candidate solution can be verified in polynomial time, while finding a solution may require evaluating the entire search space in the worst case. Classical exhaustive approaches generally solve such problems by evaluating the verifier function over all possible inputs, resulting in a worst-case query complexity of O(N), where N = dⁿ represents the size of the search space, d is the number of possible values for each variable, and n is the number of variables. Quantum search algorithms can solve unstructured search problems more efficiently by reducing the query complexity to O(sqrt (N)), providing a quadratic speedup over classical exhaustive search. However, conventional quantum search formulations typically assume access to an oracle that identifies valid solutions, while standard implementations generally yield probabilistic success. In this work, we propose a generalised quantum oracle construction method for NP problems, together with a deterministic quantum search framework that identifies satisfying assignments using their corresponding classical verifier functions. The proposed framework retains the quadratic query speedup of quantum search over classical exhaustive search. We further establish that constructed oracle can be implemented using a number of gates polynomial in the size (L) of the binary encoding of verification function, consistent with the polynomial-time evaluation of the corresponding classical verifier, while the total qubit requirement remains O(poly(L)). The construction is demonstrated on multiple N-SAT instances, with circuit-level simulations confirming deterministic identification of satisfying assignments. These results establish the applicability of deterministic quantum search to NP problems while retaining the quadratic query advantage over classical exhaustive search.
authors: Soumyajyoti Chatterjee, Harishankar Mishra, Asvija Balasubramanyam, S D Sudarsan, Gudapati Naresh Raghava

articles.title: Gibbsian Entropy for General Wigner Distributions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09839v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a definition of non-equilibrium Gibbsian entropy applicable to general quantum systems, computable from Wigner functions, for both Gaussian and non-Gaussian states. We show that while the Wigner function is a quasi-probability distribution, fundamental results linking observables in repeated observations to the function, such as the law of large numbers, the central limit theorem and, crucially, the relation between the entropy and the cumulant generating function continue to apply. This ideas are the core of the large deviation theory, which allow to formulate a positive-definite definition of entropy based on our ignorance of the underlying state structure after repeated measurements of cumulants. This new definition is a parallel to the Gibbs entropy formulation, but it can also be used in out-of-equilibrium regimes. Some important properties of this entropy are discussed. In addition we derive some information theory quantities such as relative entropy, conditional entropy, mutual information and Rényi entropy. We then compare the results with Wehrl entropy for the 1D harmonic oscillator, for pure and mixed states. We conclude the the work discussing potential applications of this new formalism, ranging from quantum correlations beyond entanglement to thermalization in closed quantum systems.
authors: Gabriel Rabelo-Soares, Yevgeniy Kovchegov, Giorgio Torrieri

articles.title: Novikov-Magnus Master Equation for Driven Quantum Systems under Classical Correlated Noise
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09876v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a modular framework for deriving time-local quantum master equations for driven systems subject to temporally correlated classical noise. The construction combines the Donsker-Furutsu-Novikov relation with the Magnus expansion: Functional response closes the noise average, while nested commutators retain the noncommuting chronological action of noise-induced perturbations along the controlled quantum trajectory. For zero-mean Gaussian noise, we derive the resulting Novikov-Magnus quantum master equation through fourth order in the noise strength. The same response hierarchy suggests a natural extension beyond Gaussian noise, with connected higher-order noise correlations weighting higher functional derivatives of the stochastic map. For a driven qubit under Ornstein-Uhlenbeck and band-limited 1/f noise, the second- and fourth-order maps remain CPTP throughout the perturbative regime and accurately reproduce stochastic simulations. Their diamond-norm errors are comparable to those of the cumulant-based pseudo-Lindblad master equation, with a modest fourth-order improvement for Ornstein-Uhlenbeck noise.
authors: Nada Khogeer, Jerison Parra, Caroline Desgranges, Hugo Ribeiro

articles.title: pfoqcompiler: Efficient Compilation of Quantum Control in Recursive First-Order Quantum Programs
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08503v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recursive quantum control allows for simple and concise descriptions of algorithms. However, a naive circuit compilation sequentializes the different branches of the quantum if-statement and results in an exponential increase in circuit depth. Existing techniques can parallelize these branches, but do so at the cost of an exponential number of ancillary qubits. We present pfoqcompiler, a compiler targeting Qiskit for the first-order quantum programming language FOQ that exploits program structure to merge compatible recursive procedure calls across quantum branches. We introduce weaker syntactically-checkable conditions for well-foundedness, recursive halving, and uniformity, while preserving previously demonstrated complexity characterizations. For weakly well-founded bounded-width programs, the compiler produces polynomial-size circuits; weakly recursively halving programs additionally yield polylogarithmic depth, while weak uniformity removes the asymptotic overhead of branch sequentialization.
authors: Mário Silva (LMF, QuaCS), Alexandre Guernut (MOCQUA), Marco Lewis (LMF, QuaCS)

articles.title: A Complete Calculus for Hamiltonian Quantum Programming
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08675v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Given the forces acting on a quantum particle, a Hamiltonian models its continuous evolution. Quantum computers evolve Hamiltonians to simulate physical systems, to solve optimisation problems, and to estimate eigenvalues, and even the popular circuit abstraction is compiled to Hamiltonians on the hardware. We introduce Hamilton, a process calculus whose parallel operator is the sum of interactions acting simultaneously. Its operational semantics is the Lie-Trotter product formula, which recovers a sum as the limit of ever finer sequential interleavings; compiling a program means halving it to a chosen precision and unrolling the interleaving into a circuit. The semantics is fully abstract, the expressible Hamiltonians are exactly those whose Pauli coefficients have the form m/2^k, the precision that successive halving reaches, and the equational theory is complete and decidable. A full implementation compiles Hamilton programs to circuits and decides their equivalence, and Agda proofs sanity-check the core metatheory.
authors: Jacques Carette, Chris Heunen, Robin Kaarsgaard, Neil J. Ross, Amr Sabry

articles.title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Annealing for Protein Side-Chain Optimization: A Feasibility Study
