articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08696v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Hybrid quantum-classical annealing solvers are moving from research laboratories toward industrial use, but their advantage over classical optimization appears to be confined to a narrow class of problems. A recent systematic benchmark of the D-Wave hybrid solver against industry-leading classical solvers, across several classes of optimization problems, found it to be most competitive on binary quadratic programs, while noting that few industrial problems take this form. Therefore, identifying real-world industrial problems that can be modeled with this structure is a key challenge. We propose protein side-chain optimization, a core step of computational protein design, as one of these problems: it is natively a binary quadratic program, and its application context requires pools of low-energy solutions, which annealers naturally return. In this feasibility study, we test whether the competitiveness of the hybrid solver against industry-leading classical solvers extends to this problem. On 40 instances derived from 20 experimentally determined protein structures with up to about 200 amino acids and 2000 binary variables, we compare the results achieved with a hybrid solver, run for 5 seconds, against those of the commercial solver Gurobi, run for 10 seconds, 1000 seconds, and 4 hours. The hybrid solver reaches the certified optimum whenever one is available, matches Gurobi's performance on smaller instances, and outperforms it on larger instances, finding lower-energy solutions. These results show that the competitiveness of the hybrid solver on binary quadratic programs, so far observed only on a synthetic benchmark, extends to a real-world problem. This motivates comparisons with classical heuristics specific to protein side-chain optimization.
authors: Valeria B. C. Visani, Simone Reale, Alfonso Gautieri, Elisabetta Di Nitto

articles.title: Spiral momentum spectra and spin asymmetry in vacuum pair production driven by phase-modulated elliptically polarized electric fields
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08899v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study vacuum electron--positron pair production in phase-modulated elliptically polarized electric fields using the quantum kinetic equations. We analyze how the modulation amplitude, frequency, ellipticity, and modulation form affect the spin-resolved momentum spectra and the spin asymmetry. Cosine-type modulation can deform ring-shaped momentum distributions into spiral patterns. This deformation depends nonmonotonically on the modulation amplitude and frequency and is most pronounced for circular polarization. In the transverse momentum plane, the spin-resolved yields favor the spin channel along the direction of field handedness. Reversing the field handedness would reverse the favored channel while leaving the total yield unchanged. Sine-type modulation preserves ring-shaped and mirror-symmetric spectra approximately, however, it leads to a stronger dependence of the spin asymmetry on the modulation amplitude than cosine-type modulation does. These results show that phase modulation and ellipticity can control the momentum spectra patterns in vacuum pair production. Moreover, phase modulation can also affect the degree of spin asymmetry.
authors: Li-Yi Yang, Hong-Hao Fan, Jing-He Huang, Shuo Yang, Bai-Song Xie

articles.title: Scanning Probe Control, Quantum Dynamics, and Dispersive Readout of Suspended Carbon Nanotube Resonators
articles.title_zh: 悬浮碳纳米管谐振器的扫描探针控制、量子动力学与色散读出
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09581v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Suspended carbon nanotubes (CNTs) offer promising opportunities for quantum nanomechanics owing to their small effective mass, strong electrostatic tunability, and mechanical nonlinearity. We develop a unified theoretical framework for coherent control and readout of a suspended CNT driven by an atomic force microscope (AFM) tip and capacitively coupled to a Cooper-pair box (CPB). We first derive the linear and nonlinear Duffing response of the CNT and quantify the effects of AFM force gradients, tip-position fluctuations, and voltage noise on mechanical stability, dephasing, and heating. These results establish operating conditions for coherent actuation with limited backaction. We then quantize the Duffing oscillator, derive its Kerr anharmonicity, and identify the requirements for selective control of individual vibrational transitions. Estimates of thermal occupation and active cooling illustrate the constraints for CNT modes spanning frequencies from 54 MHz to 5.37 GHz. Finally, we derive the CNT--CPB interaction and its dispersive limit, showing how phonon number and parity can be mapped onto the CPB through Ramsey interferometry and detected using quantum-capacitance readout. The resulting framework identifies the conditions under which localized AFM actuation, nonlinear quantum dynamics, and superconducting state-resolved detection can operate within a single CNT device.
articles.abstract_zh: 悬浮碳纳米管因其小有效质量、强静电可调性和机械非线性，在量子纳米力学领域具有广阔前景。本文提出了一个统一的理论框架，用于通过原子力显微镜（AFM）尖端驱动并与库珀对盒（CPB）电容耦合的悬浮碳纳米管的相干控制和读出。研究量化了AFM力梯度、尖端位置波动和电压噪声对机械稳定性、退相干和加热的影响，并建立了相干驱动的操作条件。此外，工作还对Duffing振子进行了量子化，并探讨了CNT-CPB相互作用及其色散极限，展示了如何通过拉姆齐干涉将声子数和宇称映射到CPB。
authors: Cristian Staii

articles.title: A proof of the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture
articles.title_zh: Aaronson-Ambainis猜想的一个证明
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09773v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Aaronson and Ambainis conjectured that every bounded polynomial of low degree on the discrete cube has an influential variable. They showed that the conjecture implies that the acceptance probability of every quantum algorithm making T queries can be approximated on most inputs by a classical algorithm making poly(T) queries. We prove their conjecture: every function fo̧lon-1,1ⁿ→[-1,1] of degree at most dge1 has a variable of influence at least c,øperatornameVar(f)⁵/²/d⁶, where c>0 is an absolute constant. In the original formulation, for polynomials of degree at most d with values in [0,1] on 0,1ⁿ and variance at least ǎrepsilon, this gives a variable of influence at least (ǎrepsilon/d)⁷. The proof is elementary, with steps inspired by works of others. Thus, as Aaronson and Ambainis anticipated, superpolynomial quantum speedups in the query model require structure, such as a promise on the inputs.
articles.abstract_zh: Aaronson和Ambainis曾猜想，离散立方体上每个低次有界多项式都存在一个有影响力的变量。他们指出，该猜想意味着任何进行T次查询的量子算法的接受概率，在大多数输入上都可以通过进行多项式(T)次查询的经典算法来近似。本文证明了这一猜想，表明在查询模型中，超多项式量子加速需要输入具有特定结构。该证明是初等的，并受到了其他研究工作的启发。
authors: David Turturean

articles.title: Classical control of quantum-state relaxation in confined molecular hydrogen
articles.title_zh: 限制分子氢中量子态弛豫的经典控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09850v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum-state conversion between the ortho and para nuclear-spin states of H₂ is forbidden in the isolated molecule but these states can become connected through interactions with a surrounding environment. How that same environment governs the dynamics of the newly connected states remains poorly understood. Here, we investigate this problem using H₂ confined in crystalline molecular solids, where the host environment selectively enables conversion between a pair of otherwise disconnected ortho-H₂ and para-H₂ states. Rotationally resolved infrared spectroscopy directly determines the state-specific conversion dynamics in crystalline CO₂ and N₂O at 10 K, revealing that increasing H₂ concentration suppresses nuclear-spin conversion by nearly an order of magnitude, reaching complete suppression by 20% H₂ loading. Molecular dynamics and Monte Carlo simulations identify two complementary origins of this concentration dependence: changes in the thermally populated phonon modes available to mediate relaxation, and strain-driven H₂ clustering that progressively removes molecules from the host crystal field responsible for enabling conversion. The resulting picture connects a classical collective response of the host to microscopic quantum-state dynamics: H₂ loading generates strain that reorganizes the local molecular environment, thereby modifying both the phonon bath and the molecular coupling to that bath. These results establish a multiscale mechanism by which condensed-phase environments can govern the connectivity and dynamics of an effective two-level system.
articles.abstract_zh: 孤立H₂分子中正氢和仲氢核自旋态之间的量子态转换是被禁止的，但通过与周围环境的相互作用可以实现连接。本文研究了H₂在晶体分子固体中的量子态弛豫问题，发现宿主环境能够选择性地实现正氢和仲氢态之间的转换。通过旋转分辨红外光谱，研究揭示了在10 K下，增加H₂浓度会显著抑制核自旋转换。分子动力学和蒙特卡洛模拟进一步确定了这种浓度依赖性的两个互补来源：热激发声子模式的变化以及应变驱动的H₂团簇形成。
authors: Nathan McLane, Richard C. Remsing, Leah G. Dodson

articles.title: A Quantum Mechanical Description of Active Matter
articles.title_zh: 活性物质的量子力学描述
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09861v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The natural environments habitable to life are inseparable from dissipative and entropic forces, which mandate active matter to operate on constant fluxes of energy and momentum to survive and propagate through spacetime. In contrast to fundamental particles which are characterized by energy and momentum, we postulate that energy expenditure rate and momentum generation rate are the fundamental dynamical quantities driving this evolution of swimming active matter and accordingly construct the corresponding Lagrangian and Hamiltonian of motion of the active matter. Furthermore, living systems broadly employ periodic, non-repeating motion for both locomotion and various biological functions, with meaningful information stored in the periods of these functions. Consequently, analyzing these dynamics in the Fourier space lands us at the familiar tools of the operator based, quantum mechanics. This is accomplished by introducing a complex field to describe the evolving probability distribution of a single unit, as well as the population density of mutually non-interacting active particles under the constraint of scarce resources. The resulting single-unit wavefunction evolves analogously to the Dirac equation with minimal coupling, wherein gauge symmetry reflects the generality of the governing equations across arbitrary resource landscapes. Additionally, we present a Schrödinger-like equation where the effective potential term represents the environmentally mandated, non-motile base metabolic rate. Finally, we formalize the bidirectional coupling between active swimmers and the surrounding fluid via a multipole expansion of the active force with an emphasis on force monopoles and dipoles, where each pole corresponds to a distinct mode of active motility.
articles.abstract_zh: 生命可居住的自然环境与耗散和熵力密不可分，这要求活性物质通过持续的能量和动量通量来生存和传播。本文提出能量消耗率和动量产生率是驱动游泳活性物质演化的基本动力学量，并据此构建了活性物质运动的拉格朗日量和哈密顿量。通过引入一个复数场来描述单个单元的演化概率分布以及稀缺资源下互不作用活性粒子的种群密度，将这些动力学在傅里叶空间中进行分析，从而将其与基于算符的量子力学工具联系起来。
authors: Ghansham Chandel, Siddhartha Das

articles.title: Trajectory-Dependent Decoherence and Leakage During Shuttling of Multi-Spin Qubits
articles.title_zh: 多自旋量子比特穿梭过程中的轨迹依赖性退相干与泄漏
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09873v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Logical qubits encoded in collective states of multiple spins are promising building blocks for large-scale semiconductor quantum processors. As novel fault-tolerant architectures increasingly rely on qubit shuttling, understanding decoherence of the shuttled multi-spin qubits becomes crucial. We analyze fidelity and leakage of the logical qubits dephased by the spatio-temporally correlated 1/f noise, considering two-, three-, and four-spin encodings. We study different shuttling protocols and establish that for all encodings generally, parallel shuttling provides the best protection against decoherence at short distances, whereas sequential shuttling outperforms others for long-range transport (although the exact boundaries depend on the specific device parameters). We explain this common behavior in terms of the dephasing factors of pairs of the shuttled spins; we provide explicit expressions for fidelities and leakage, thus enabling experimentalists to predict performance of the multi-spin qubits from only several independently measured pairwise dephasing factors. Our results establish a connection between shuttling trajectories, noise correlations, and qubit decoherence, and provide guidance for achieving noise-resilient shuttling in scalable semiconductor quantum processors.
articles.abstract_zh: 编码在多自旋集体态中的逻辑量子比特是构建大规模半导体量子处理器的有前景的基石。本文分析了在空间-时间相关1/f噪声下，穿梭多自旋逻辑量子比特的保真度和泄漏。研究了不同的穿梭协议，发现对于所有编码，并行穿梭在短距离内提供最佳的退相干保护，而顺序穿梭在长距离传输中表现更优。这些结果建立了穿梭轨迹、退相干和泄漏之间的联系，并为实验人员预测多自旋量子比特的性能提供了依据。
authors: Yu-Ning Zhang, Aleksandr S. Mokeev, Maximilian Rimbach-Russ, David P. DiVincenzo, Viatcheslav V. Dobrovitski

articles.title: Limit cycles in periodically driven open quantum systems
articles.title_zh: 周期性驱动开放量子系统中的极限环
articles.abstract: arXiv:1908.03900v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the long-time behavior of quantum N-level systems that are coupled to a Markovian environment and subject to periodic driving. As our main result, we obtain a general algebraic condition ensuring that all solutions of a periodic quantum master equation with Lindblad form approach a unique limit cycle. Quite intuitively, this criterion requires that the dissipative terms of the master equation connect all subspaces of the system Hilbert space during an arbitrarily small fraction of the cycle time. Our results provide a natural extension of Spohn's algebraic condition for the approach to equilibrium to systems with external driving.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了与马尔可夫环境耦合并受周期性驱动的量子N能级系统的长时间行为。主要结果是，我们得到了一个通用的代数条件，确保具有Lindblad形式的周期性量子主方程的所有解都趋近于一个唯一的极限环。该判据要求主方程的耗散项在任意小的周期时间内连接系统希尔伯特空间的所有子空间。这些结果将Spohn的平衡趋近代数条件自然地扩展到具有外部驱动的系统。
authors: Paul Menczel, Kay Brandner

articles.title: Deterministic interconversion of the Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger state and Knill-Laflamme-Milburn state via Lie-transform-based pulse design in Rydberg atoms
articles.title_zh: 基于李变换脉冲设计的里德堡原子中GHZ态与KLM态的确定性相互转换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2405.15456v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Conversion between different types of entangled states is an interesting problem in quantum mechanics. But research on the conversion between Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) state and Knill-Laflamme-Milburn (KLM) state in atomic system has not been reported. In this paper, we propose a scheme to realize the interconversion (one-step) between GHZ state and KLM state with Rydberg atoms. By utilizing Rydberg-mediated interactions, we simplify the system. By combining Lie-transform-based pulse design, the evolution path is built up to realize interconversion of GHZ state and KLM state. The numerical simulation result shows that the present scheme is robust against decoherence and operational imperfection.
articles.abstract_zh: 不同类型纠缠态之间的转换是量子力学中一个有趣的问题。本文提出了一种利用里德堡原子实现GHZ态和KLM态之间确定性一步相互转换的方案。通过利用里德堡介导的相互作用，简化了系统，并结合基于李变换的脉冲设计构建了演化路径。数值模拟结果表明，该方案对退相干和操作缺陷具有鲁棒性。
authors: J. P. Wang, Y. Q. Ji, L. P. Yang, C. Q. Wang, L. Dong, X. M. Xiu

articles.title: Statistics of Strongly Coupled Defects in Superconducting Qubits
articles.title_zh: 超导量子比特中强耦合缺陷的统计学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.00193v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Decoherence in superconducting qubits is dominated by defects that reside at amorphous interfaces. Interaction with discrete defects results in dropouts that complicate qubit operation and lead to nongaussian tails in the distribution of qubit energy relaxation time T₁ that degrade system performance. Spectral diffusion of defects over time leads to fluctuations in T₁, posing a challenge for calibration. In this work, we measure the energy relaxation of flux-tunable transmons over a range of operating frequencies. We vary qubit geometry to change the interface participation ratio by more than an order of magnitude. Our results are consistent with loss dominated by discrete interfacial defects. Moreover, we are able to localize the dominant defects to within 500 nm of the qubit junctions, where residues from liftoff are present. These results motivate new approaches to qubit junction fabrication that avoid the residues intrinsic to the liftoff process.
articles.abstract_zh: 超导量子比特的退相干主要由非晶界面处的缺陷引起，这些缺陷导致量子比特能量弛豫时间T₁分布出现非高斯尾部，从而降低系统性能。本文测量了磁通可调谐transmon量子比特在不同工作频率下的能量弛豫，并通过改变量子比特几何结构将界面参与比改变了一个数量级以上。结果表明损耗主要由离散界面缺陷引起，并且能够将主要缺陷定位在量子比特结附近500纳米范围内，这些区域存在剥离工艺残留物。这些发现为避免剥离工艺固有残留物的新型量子比特结制造方法提供了依据。
authors: S. Weeden, D. C. Harrison, S. Patel, M. Snyder, E. J. Blackwell, G. Spahn, S. Abdullah, Y. Takeda, B. L. T. Plourde, J. M. Martinis, R. McDermott

articles.title: Semi-device-independent channel identification with communication matrices
articles.title_zh: 基于通信矩阵的半设备无关信道识别
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.14273v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We look into the task of differentiating between any two quantum channels and reconstructing them from the obtained measurement statistics with possibly limited information about the experimental set-up. We employ the communication matrix formalism where the measurement statistics of a prepare-and-measure scenario is represented as a stochastic communication matrix. In order to differentiate between any two quantum channels, the informational completeness of the set-up is both necessary and sufficient. On the other hand, if we want to uniquely characterize any quantum channel, in addition we also need to have a complete description of the set-up. We show that in many important cases we can deduce this information directly from the communication matrix of the set-up before applying the channel. Given that we trust the dimension of the system, we show that we can deduce the information completeness of the set-up directly from the rank of the communication matrix. Furthermore, we show that another quantity of the communication matrix, called the information storability, can be used to self-test the set-up (up to unitary or antiunitary freedom) for an important class of states and measurements. This provides us a semi-device-independent way to identify quantum channels from the prepare-and-measure statistics. Lastly, we consider scenarios where we might have some additional information about the channels or additional resources at our disposal which could help us relax some of the assumptions of the proposed scenario.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在实验设置信息可能有限的情况下，区分任意两个量子信道并从测量统计数据中重建它们的任务。研究采用了通信矩阵形式，其中制备-测量场景的测量统计数据表示为随机通信矩阵。为了区分任意两个量子信道，设置的信息完备性是必要且充分的。如果信任系统的维度，可以直接从通信矩阵的秩推断设置的信息完备性。此外，通信矩阵的另一个量，即信息可存储性，可用于自测试设置。
authors: Samgeeth Puliyil, Leevi Leppäjärvi, Mário Ziman

articles.title: Fully quantum algorithmic framework for partial differential equation-constrained optimization
articles.title_zh: 偏微分方程约束优化的全量子算法框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.14420v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Partial differential equation (PDE)-constrained optimization, where an optimization problem is subject to PDE constraints, arises in various applications such as design, control, and inference. Solving such problems is computationally demanding because it requires repeatedly solving a PDE and using its solution within an optimization process. In this paper, we first propose a fully quantum algorithmic framework for solving PDE-constrained optimization problems. The proposed method combines a quantum PDE solver that prepares the solution vector as a quantum state, and a quantum optimizer that assumes oracle access to a quantized objective function. The central idea is the explicit construction of the oracle in a form of block-encoding for the objective function, which coherently uses the output of a quantum PDE solver. This enables us to avoid classical access to the full solution that requires quantum state tomography canceling out the potential quantum speedups. We also derive the overall computational complexity of the proposed method with respect to parameters for optimization and PDE simulation, where quantum speedup is inherited from the underlying quantum PDE solver. We numerically demonstrate the validity of the proposed method by applications, including a parameter calibration problem in the Black-Scholes equation and a material parameter design problem in the wave equation. This work presents the concept of composing quantum subroutines so that the weakness of one (i.e., prohibitive readout overhead) is neutralized by the strength of another (i.e., coherent oracle access), toward a bottleneck-free quantum algorithm.
articles.abstract_zh: 偏微分方程（PDE）约束优化问题在设计、控制和推理等多种应用中广泛存在，但其计算成本高昂。本文首次提出了一个解决PDE约束优化问题的全量子算法框架。该方法结合了将解向量制备为量子态的量子PDE求解器，以及假设对量子化目标函数具有预言机访问权限的量子优化器。核心思想是显式构建目标函数的块编码形式的预言机，其连贯地利用量子PDE求解器的输出，从而避免了对完整解的经典访问。
authors: Yuki Sato, Jumpei Kato, Hiroshi Yano, Kosuke Ito, Naoki Yamamoto

articles.title: Operational impact of quantum resources in chemical dynamics
articles.title_zh: 量子资源在化学动力学中的操作性影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.06833v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum coherence and other non-classical features are widely discussed in chemical dynamics, yet it remains difficult to quantify when such resources are operationally relevant for a given process and observable. While quantum resource theories provide a comprehensive framework for comparing free and resourceful settings, existing approaches typically rely on resource monotones or on performance bounds under free operations, and do not directly quantify the maximal influence a chosen resource can exert on a fixed chemical dynamics. Here, we introduce task specific, process level quantifiers that upper bound the largest change a quantum resource can induce in a target figure of merit. Central is a resource impact functional C_M(Łambda), defined by comparing a state with its paired resource-free counterpart under the same quantum channel Łambda, which admits an operational interpretation in binary hypothesis testing. We derive variation and time bounds that constrain how rapidly a resource can modify a target signal, providing resource-aware analogues of quantum speed limits. Moreover, we show that open system dynamics can be decomposed into free and resourceful components such that only the resourceful component contributes to C_M(Łambda), thereby isolating the parts of a generator responsible for resource-induced changes in the observable. We illustrate the framework exemplary for energy transfer in a donor-acceptor dimer in two analytically solvable regimes. Our results provide a general toolbox for diagnosing and benchmarking quantum resource effects in molecular processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子相干性及其他非经典特性在化学动力学中被广泛讨论，但量化这些资源何时对特定过程和可观测物具有操作相关性仍然困难。本文引入了任务特定、过程层面的量化器，用于上限一个量子资源能在目标品质因数中引起的最大变化。核心是一个资源影响泛函C_M(Łambda)，它通过比较一个态及其在相同量子信道Łambda下的无资源对应物来定义，并在二元假设检验中具有操作性解释。研究还推导了限制资源修改目标信号速度的变异和时间界限，提供了量子速度极限的资源感知类比。
authors: Julia Liebert, Gregory D. Scholes

articles.title: Operational bounds and diagnostics for coherence in energy transfer
articles.title_zh: 能量转移中相干性的操作界限与诊断
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.09748v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Excitation energy transfer in light-harvesting aggregates is highly efficient, yet whether quantum coherence plays an operational role in transport remains debated. A central challenge is that coherence is usually inferred from spectroscopic signatures, whereas transport performance is assessed through specific observables and depends on both the open system dynamics and the initial state preparation. Here we develop a resource theoretic approach that quantifies the maximum change that initial site-basis coherence can induce in a chosen readout under fixed reduced dynamics. The central quantity is the resource impact functional, which yields state independent, readout specific bounds on coherence-induced changes in signals and transport figures of merit. We apply the framework to two models. For a donor-acceptor dimer, we analyse coherence sensitivity across coupling and bath-timescale regimes and bound trapping efficiency and average transfer time in terms of the impact functional. For a multi-site chain with terminal trapping, we derive rigorous criteria that distinguish population placement from sensitivity to initial state site-basis coherence. These include upper bounds on the largest advantage over incoherent preparations, necessary delocalization requirements for achieving a prescribed improvement, and a simple pairwise sufficient condition that can be checked from local information. For quasi-local reduced dynamics, we further obtain a Lieb-Robinson-type bound that constrains when coherence prepared in a distant region can influence a localized readout at finite times. Together, these results provide operational diagnostics and rigorous bounds for benchmarking coherence effects and for identifying regimes in which they are necessarily negligible or potentially relevant in excitonic transport models.
articles.abstract_zh: 光捕获聚集体中的激发能量转移效率极高，但量子相干性在传输中是否发挥操作作用仍存在争议。本文开发了一种资源理论方法，量化了在固定约化动力学下，初始位点基相干性能在选定读数中引起的最大变化。核心量是资源影响泛函，它提供了与状态无关、与读数相关的相干性诱导信号和传输品质因数变化的界限。该框架应用于供体-受体二聚体和具有末端捕获的多位点链模型，导出了区分布居位置与初始态位点敏感性的严格判据。
authors: Julia Liebert, Gregory D. Scholes

articles.title: Quantitative Universal Approximation for Noisy Quantum Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 含噪声量子神经网络的定量通用近似
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.02064v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We prove a quantitative universal approximation theorem for noisy quantum neural networks (QNNs), with explicit non-asymptotic error bounds in terms of the number of accuracy blocks, the qubit count, the number of two-qubit gates, and hardware noise parameters. Motivated by quantitative finance, where target functions are expectations of payoffs, we first extend existing noiseless bounds to expectation functions and derive explicit constants for exponential Levy models, covering the Black-Scholes price of (truncated) European Put options. We then formulate the noisy circuit via quantum channels, obtain a fidelity-based bound for general noise models, and specialise to depolarising noise with readout error, calibrated to real hardware. Finally, we provide a detailed numerical analysis for option pricing in the Black-Scholes model, testing our results on actual noisy quantum hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了含噪声量子神经网络（QNNs）的定量通用近似定理，并给出了显式非渐近误差界。研究将现有无噪声界扩展到期望函数，并推导出指数Levy模型的显式常数，涵盖了期权定价。通过量子信道公式化噪声电路，获得了基于保真度的通用噪声模型界限，并专门针对去极化噪声和读出误差进行了校准。最后，作者对期权定价进行了详细的数值分析，并在实际含噪声量子硬件上验证了结果。
authors: Lukas Gonon, Antoine Jacquier, Marcel Mordarski

articles.title: Low-rank geometry of two-qubit gates
articles.title_zh: 双量子比特门的低秩几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.15102v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a framework based on the determinantal geometry of two-qubit gates. Combining the Weyl chamber representation with operator Schmidt theory, we interpret gate synthesis as a distance problem to determinantal varieties. This gives an operational geometry to the Weyl chamber, quantifying nonlocal complexity. We show that the square root of iSWAP gate is the closest perfect entangler to the variety of local operations, and that no perfect entangler can be approximated by a local gate with average gate fidelity above 78.3%. The three different determinantal costs form a synthesis-adapted coordinate system that encodes nonlocal complexity and generally reconstruct the Weyl coordinates in the reduced sector.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个基于双量子比特门行列式几何的框架，将门合成解释为到行列式簇的距离问题，从而为Weyl腔提供了操作几何，量化了非局域复杂性。研究表明，iSWAP门的平方根是距离局域操作簇最近的完美纠缠器。此外，没有完美纠缠器可以通过平均门保真度高于78.3%的局域门近似。三种不同的行列式成本构成了一个适应合成的坐标系，编码了非局域复杂性，并通常在约化扇区中重建Weyl坐标。
authors: Llorenç Balada Gaggioli

articles.title: Classical Stochasticity Using Quantum Computers
articles.title_zh: 利用量子计算机实现经典随机性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.09384v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We demonstrate that quantum algorithms can be used to model classical stochastic simulations as the measurement process is inherently random. To illustrate, we solve the classical Lorenz system with stochastic behavior using a Python random number generator. We compare the classical stochastic Lorenz system with the measured output of the quantum algorithm.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了量子算法可以用于模拟经典随机过程，因为测量过程本身具有随机性。为了说明这一点，研究使用Python随机数生成器解决了具有随机行为的经典Lorenz系统。最后，将经典随机Lorenz系统与量子算法的测量输出进行了比较，展示了量子计算在模拟经典随机性方面的潜力。
authors: Diego Campos, Narasimha Reddy Gosala, Arundhati Dasgupta

articles.title: On the generic structures of the protocols for quantum auction and quantum summation and their relation
articles.title_zh: 量子拍卖和量子求和协议的通用结构及其关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27693v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Secure multi-party computation (SMC) addresses the problem of jointly computing global functions of private inputs while revealing minimal information about individual data. Two prominent examples of SMC tasks are sealed-bid auction and secure multi-party summation. Existing schemes for quantum auction and quantum summation have largely been developed independently, motivated by distinct applications and employing different computational primitives. In this work, mutual reductions between the two tasks are established for single-item sealed-bid auctions with first-price payment. In one direction, an auction used as a black box computes a secure sum: each party bids a private random key drawn from its input, so the clearing price depends on the inputs only through their sum S. The reduction is perfectly private against colluding semi-honest parties and uses O(S²łog(1/δ)) auction rounds, which is optimal, or O(Słog(1/δ)) under coherent access. It can be instantiated with an existing auctioneer-free quantum auction after a one-line change to its disjunction subroutine, which as published leaks occupancy counts. In the other direction, summation with randomized inputs yields threshold disjunctions, and a single search over composite keys locates the highest bid and a winner, revealing nothing else. Because each query consumes the bidders' encodings, a bidder can adapt its effective bid undetected, while a fixed query set restores sealed bidding. Combinatorial auctions and general payment rules lie outside this framework. On a superconducting processor, one instance of each direction is executed, recovering the winner for four-bidder instances with ties and the sum of private inputs from repeated auctions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了安全多方计算（SMC）中单物品首次价格密封投标拍卖和安全多方求和这两种任务之间的相互归约关系。研究表明，一个用作黑盒的拍卖可以计算一个安全和，其中清算价格仅通过所有输入的总和S依赖于输入。这种归约对串通的半诚实参与方是完全私密的，并且使用O(S²log(1/δ))次拍卖轮次，这是最优的，或者在相干访问下为O(Slog(1/δ))。
authors: Kabir Sandhu, Sandeep Mishra, Anirban Pathak

articles.title: Matrix Samplers and Quantum-Proof Extractors: Their Correspondence and Almost-Optimal Constructions
articles.title_zh: 矩阵采样器与量子安全提取器：对应关系及近最优构造
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37122v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We establish an equivalence between matrix samplers and quantum-proof randomness extractors. The classical sampler-extractor equivalence is established by a seminal work of Zuckerman (Random Structures & Algorithms, 1997). Using this equivalence, we construct explicit strong matrix samplers with optimal randomness overhead and near-optimal sample complexity via constructing quantum-proof extractors. Specifically for matrix dimension D, accuracy ǎrepsilon and failure probability δłeqǎrepsilon, our matrix sampler uses  m+O_α(łog(D/δ)) random bits and  O_α!łeft(ǎrepsilon⁻²⁻αłog¹⁺α(D/δ)i̊ght) samples,  for any constant α>0. Compared with the matrix sampler of Xun and Zuckerman (CCC 2025), our construction has improvements in two aspects. Under optimal random seed length, we can replace the øperatornamepoly D dependence in the number of samples by O(łog¹⁺α D). Under the same scale of sample size, we can remove their łogłog D factor in the length of the random seed. Our underlying strong quantum-proof extractor has output length n-O_α(a+łog(1/η)) and seed length at most (1+α)łog a+(2+α)łog(1/η)+O_α(1) for n-bit sources with conditional min-entropy n-a and error η. We also obtain strong quantum-proof extractors for every constant entropy rate, for any error as small as 2⁻Ømega⁽ⁿ⁾, having optimal seed length O(łog(n/η)) and output length Ømega(n), improving previous constructions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了矩阵采样器与量子安全随机性提取器之间的等价性。利用这一等价性，研究通过构造量子安全提取器，构建了具有最优随机性开销和近最优样本复杂度的显式强矩阵采样器。与现有工作相比，本构造在最优随机种子长度下，将样本数量中的多项式D依赖替换为O(log¹⁺α D)，并在相同样本规模下消除了随机种子长度中的loglog D因子。该工作为量子安全随机性提取和矩阵采样提供了重要进展。
authors: Kuan Cheng, Ruiyang Wu

articles.title: Disentangling Multiple Scaling Dimensions via Operator Covariance in Critical Quantum Spin Systems
articles.title_zh: 通过临界量子自旋系统中的算子协方差解耦多个标度维度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08663v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a general proof of different power-law decays versus distance of the eigenvalues of two-point covariance matrices in critical lattice quantum models, allowing extraction of multiple scaling dimensions. We demonstrate the practical utility of this method in the context of a spin-1/2 chain with critical ground state described by the SU(2)₁ Wess--Zumino--Witten field theory. Using quantum Monte Carlo simulations to compute covariance matrices in different symmetry sectors, we resolve the expected relevant and marginal primary operators as well as some descendants. The covariance method can be integrated into many existing numerical schemes and promises to significantly enhance computational studies of quantum criticality.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个通用证明，说明了临界晶格量子模型中两点协方差矩阵特征值随距离呈现不同的幂律衰减，从而可以提取多个标度维度。研究在SU(2)₁ Wess--Zumino--Witten场理论描述的自旋-1/2链的临界基态背景下，展示了该方法的实用性。通过量子蒙特卡洛模拟，成功分辨出预期的相关和边缘原初算子以及一些子代算子。该协方差方法有望显著增强量子临界性的计算研究。
authors: Zhi Lin, Anders W. Sandvik

articles.title: Disentangling Spin and Orbital Contributions in the Search for Altermagnetic Terahertz Conversion in RuO2
articles.title_zh: 在RuO2中寻找交变磁太赫兹转换时解耦自旋和轨道贡献
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09098v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rutile RuO2 has emerged as a prominent candidate altermagnet, yet the microscopic origin of its reported charge-angular-momentum conversion remains unsettled. Recent theoretical and experimental advances have highlighted a potentially dominant role of orbital transport, raising a fundamental ambiguity between spin- and orbital-mediated conversion in RuO2. Here, we report the first experimental disentanglement of the spin- and orbital-to-charge conversion channels in RuO2 heterostructures using terahertz emission spectroscopy. We identify Fe as a predominantly spin-current injector, whereas Ni and permalloy predominantly inject orbital currents, revealing a substantial orbital contribution to ultrafast terahertz emission. Under controlled spin-current injection, we find no evidence for inverse altermagnetic spin-splitting effect. Instead, the observed anisotropy is consistent with an anisotropic inverse spin Hall response that is strongly conditioned by the near-interface environment. Under orbital-current injection, the anisotropy is markedly weaker, indicating that orbital-to-charge conversion is largely isotropic in RuO2. Our results establish orbital transport and interface-conditioned spin Hall conversion as key to terahertz emission from RuO2, underscoring the need to disentangle spin, orbital, and interfacial contributions before assigning anisotropy to altermagnetism.
articles.abstract_zh: 金红石型RuO2已成为一种重要的交变磁体候选材料，但其电荷-角动量转换的微观起源仍未确定。本文首次通过太赫兹发射光谱实验解耦了RuO2异质结构中的自旋-电荷和轨道-电荷转换通道。研究发现Fe主要注入自旋电流，而Ni和坡莫合金主要注入轨道电流，揭示了轨道对超快太赫兹发射的显著贡献。在受控自旋电流注入下，未发现交变磁自旋分裂效应的逆效应证据，观察到的各向异性与受近界面环境强烈影响的各向异性逆自旋霍尔响应一致。
authors: Jiahao Liu, Yuxiao Mo, Tongyang Guan, Wenhui Fang, Yongwei Cui, Wentao Qin, Zhe Yuan, Lishu Zhang, Zhensheng Tao, Yizheng Wu

articles.title: Lefschetz-Thimble Method to the Sign Problem in the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev Model
articles.title_zh: Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev模型中符号问题的Lefschetz-Thimble方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09168v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The sign problem in path integrals severely limits the application of quantum Monte Carlo methods to strongly correlated systems, whereas the Lefschetz-thimble method offers a rigorous framework to mitigate this issue. In this paper, we establish a numerical framework based on the Lefschetz thimbles for the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model. By introducing continuous auxiliary fields via the Hubbard-Stratonovich transformation, the partition function is formulated as a high-dimensional complex integral. We employ the complex Langevin equation to explore the saddle-point distribution of the effective action in the complex plane. Monte Carlo integration is then performed to compute the partition function and Green functions. Our numerical results exhibit excellent agreement with high-temperature expansions, infrared-limit solutions, and determinantal quantum Monte Carlo (DQMC) simulations, confirming the validity of our framework. Furthermore, we demonstrate that our complex Langevin search successfully captures the relevant dominant saddle points governing the SYK model in the large-N limit. Our work deepens the understanding of the sign problem in the SYK model and provides a viable non-perturbative avenue for addressing sign problems in more complex strongly correlated systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 路径积分中的符号问题严重限制了量子蒙特卡洛方法在强关联系统中的应用，而Lefschetz-thimble方法提供了一个严格的框架来缓解这一问题。本文建立了基于Lefschetz thimbles的Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 模型的数值框架。研究采用复朗之万方程探索复平面中有效作用量的鞍点分布，并进行蒙特卡洛积分计算配分函数和格林函数。数值结果与高温展开、红外极限解和行列式量子蒙特卡洛模拟表现出极好的一致性，证实了该框架的有效性。
authors: Yin-Hao Fang, Yang Qi

articles.title: Thermodynamic Phase Diagrams in łambda-(BETS)₂GaBrₓCl₄₋ₓ under Physical and Chemical Pressure
articles.title_zh: 物理和化学压力下λ-(BETS)₂GaBrₓCl₄₋ₓ的热力学相图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09320v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The evolution of electron correlation in the superconducting state of the mixed-crystal series łambda-(BETS)₂GaBrₓCl₄₋ₓ was investigated by magnetic and transport measurements. Br concentrations evaluated by electron-probe microanalysis agree well with single-crystal X-ray diffraction refinement. Demagnetization-corrected susceptibility and magnetization of crystals with xc₍ᵣf₎ = 0.22, 0.24, 0.42, and 0.63 all show a diamagnetic superconducting transition. The lower critical field Hc₁, determined from the deviation from the Meissner response, shows a dome-like maximum at xc₍ᵣf₎ = 0.24. The upper critical field Hc₂, obtained from the first high-field magnetoresistance measurements in this system, decreases with increasing Br concentration up to xc₍ᵣf₎ = 0.42, establishing the high-field superconducting boundary on the chemical-pressure side. Combining these results with reported transport data under chemical and physical pressure, we propose a pressure-temperature phase diagram for łambda-(BETS)₂GaCl₄. Its double-dome-like structure has a local minimum near x = 0, where a quantum-critical point was proposed at P approx 0.13 GPa, separating a low-pressure regime of superconductivity coexisting with magnetism and an unconventional metallic state from a higher-pressure regime with conventional metallic behavior. A low-temperature resistivity upturn, previously reported only under physical pressure, is also found under chemical pressure, suggesting that spin-density-wave fluctuations may extend continuously across both pressure axes. The phase diagram overlaps with that of łambda-(STF)₂GaCl₄ under physical pressure, indicating that chemical substitution, external pressure, and molecular substitution can be unified in a single bandwidth-controlled phase diagram for łambda-type molecular superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过磁性和输运测量研究了混合晶体系列λ-(BETS)₂GaBrₓCl₄₋ₓ超导态中电子关联的演化。研究发现，经过退磁校正的晶体均显示出抗磁超导转变，下临界场Hc₁在特定Br浓度处呈现穹顶状最大值。上限临界场Hc₂随Br浓度增加而减小，从而确定了化学压力侧的高场超导边界。结合这些结果与已报道的输运数据，本文提出了λ-(BETS)₂GaCl₄的压力-温度相图，其双穹顶状结构在x=0附近有一个局部最小值。
authors: Aulia Anisa Firdaus, Arifa Diana Agustin, Fathan Muyassar Santana, Taiyo Oka, Shuhei Fukuoka, Atsushi Kawamoto, Dita Puspita Sari, Yasuyuki Ishii

articles.title: Superconducting Fluctuation Driven Quantum Transport in Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊δ Thin Films
articles.title_zh: Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊δ薄膜中超导涨落驱动的量子输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09510v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconducting fluctuations (SF), arising from Cooper-pair-driven interactions and electron-electron interactions within the transition regime, can dominate the magnetoconductance (MC) of superconducting thin films near their transition temperature. In some systems, this fluctuation-dominated regime is preceded by a narrow window in which quantum interference effects are manifested as weak antilocalization (WAL) or weak localization (WL). Here, we report magnetotransport measurements on thin films of the high-temperature superconductor Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊δ (BSCCO) that establish SF as the dominant mechanism governing MC across the transition regime. In the narrow temperature window well above T_c where SF does not exist, a cusp in MC can be attributed to WAL-like signature well described by the Hikami--Larkin--Nagaoka (HLN) framework. Closer to the transition (TBKT), we observe signatures consistent with Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless (BKT) correlations, underscoring that the dominant physics is set by collective, pairing-driven behavior rather than single-particle quantum interference. Measurements on non-superconducting control samples show no WAL-like features, indicating that the WAL over narrow temperature window, emerges only in conjunction with superconducting fluctuations. Hall measurements further reveal a concomitant sign reversal of the dominant carrier response, pointing to a substantial reorganization of transverse transport coincident with the onset of superconductivity. Together, these observations establish that magnetotransport in BSCCO thin film.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了高温超导体Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊δ（BSCCO）薄膜的磁输运测量结果，证实超导涨落（SF）是主导磁导（MC）跨越转变区域的主要机制。在SF不存在的远高于T_c的狭窄温度窗口中，MC中的尖峰可归因于弱反局域化（WAL）样特征。接近转变温度时，观察到与Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless（BKT）关联一致的特征，强调了主导物理是集体配对驱动行为而非单粒子量子干涉。
authors: Sohini Guin, Naresh Shyaga, Jagadish Rajendran, Aryaman Das, Subhransu Kumar Negi, Saisab Bhowmik, Pankaj Bhardwaj, Chandni Usha, Dhavala Suri

articles.title: Quantum Interference Control of Coupled Atomic Spins
articles.title_zh: 耦合原子自旋的量子干涉控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09578v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a protocol for the non-resonant electric control of quantum states in atomic-scale spin systems using Landau-Zener-Stückelberg-Majorana (LZSM) interferometry. We focus on a Ti-Ti-Fe trimer on a thin MgO layer, a platform that has recently emerged as a promising candidate for qubit realization using electron spin resonance combined with scanning tunneling microscopy (ESR-STM). We first analyze a Ti dimer in the absence of the Fe atom and show, through a detailed spectroscopic study, that avoided level crossings can be engineered by combining the in-plane component of the external magnetic field, the tip magnetic field, and the applied bias voltage, which allows the system to be tuned electrically through these crossings. Based on this, we develop LZSM protocols for coherent state control in the dimer using non-resonant LZSM-STM. We then consider the full trimer, where the Fe atom generates a local magnetic field at the remote Ti atom, enabling non-local spin control. We show that this remote and non-resonant manipulation reduces unwanted effects associated with tunneling electrons and enables quantum operations on short timescales. Our results show that quantum interference can be used as a resource for electrically driven, non-resonant, and non-local spin control in atomic-scale systems. This approach enables fast quantum operations while mitigating decoherence, offering a promising route toward scalable atom-based qubit architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种利用Landau-Zener-Stückelberg-Majorana (LZSM) 干涉测量法对原子尺度自旋系统进行非共振电学控制量子态的协议。研究重点关注MgO薄层上的Ti-Ti-Fe三聚体，该平台是实现量子比特的有前景的候选者。通过详细的光谱研究，作者展示了如何通过结合外部磁场、尖端磁场和偏置电压来设计避免的能级交叉，并开发了使用非共振LZSM-STM对二聚体进行相干态控制的协议。该方法通过远程和非共振操控减少了隧道电子带来的不良影响，并实现了短时间内的量子操作。
authors: Sergio Santiago Gomez, Gustavo Mauricio Meneses Ancalle, Daniel Domínguez, María José Sánchez, Alejandro Ferrón

articles.title: Quantum-walk measurements with sequential imaging of the same atomic sample
articles.title_zh: 同一原子样本的序贯成像量子行走测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09618v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate sequential single-atom-resolved imaging of the same ultracold atomic sample and apply this technique to quantum-walk measurements in an optical lattice. In quantum gas microscope experiments, fluorescence imaging provides microscopic information on atomic distributions but induces motional heating through photon scattering, making it difficult to reuse the same sample for subsequent quantum dynamics. To overcome this limitation, we apply Raman sideband cooling with parameters optimized for post-imaging cooling, enabling sequential single-atom-resolved measurements of the same sample. By optimizing the cooling parameters with machine learning, we achieve high fidelity over multiple imaging cycles. To demonstrate the capability of this technique, we measure one-dimensional quantum walks of single atoms in an optical lattice. By determining the initial atomic positions from fluorescence images, we extract quantum-walk transition probabilities without requiring deterministic preparation of the initial atomic positions. The observed dynamics agree with numerical simulations of quantum walks of single atoms. Our method provides a route toward reducing experimental overhead in quantum gas microscope studies requiring repeated acquisition of spatially resolved correlation data.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了对同一超冷原子样本进行序贯单原子分辨成像，并将该技术应用于光晶格中的量子行走测量。通过优化拉曼边带冷却参数，研究实现了在多个成像周期中的高保真度序贯单原子分辨测量。该方法克服了荧光成像引起的运动加热问题，使得同一样本可用于后续量子动力学研究。通过从荧光图像确定初始原子位置，无需确定性制备即可提取量子行走跃迁概率，观察到的动力学与数值模拟结果一致。
authors: Ryuta Yamamoto, Takeshi Fukuhara

articles.title: Theory of Optical and Magneto-Optical Properties of [111]-Oriented Site-Controlled Quantum Dots
articles.title_zh: [111]取向位点控制量子点光学和磁光性质的理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.09704v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Site-controlled [111]-oriented quantum dots (QDs) are promising sources of non-classical light, yet their optical spectra exhibit apparently conflicting symmetry signatures. At zero magnetic field, excitonic spectra are commonly interpreted as C₂ᵥ-like, whereas measurements in Faraday geometry display selection rules characteristic of C₃ᵥ-like symmetry. Here, we show that both regimes can be described consistently without invoking any change in the underlying structural symmetry. Combining 8-band kḑotp theory, a self-consistent Hartree-informed configuration interaction scheme, and group theoretical analysis, we introduce a controlled symmetry reducing perturbation that lowers the QD symmetry to Cₛ. At zero field, the optical response remains predominantly C₂ᵥ-like because the additional low-symmetry transitions carry only weak oscillator strengths. In Faraday geometry, the same reduced-symmetry structure produces four dominant, nearly circularly polarised trion transitions, reproducing the experimentally observed C₃ᵥ-like response. By contrast, an exact C₂ᵥ description inferred from the zero-field spectrum permits only two such trion transitions and therefore fails at finite field. Our results thus provide a unified description of the zero and finite magnetic field optical response without any restoration or enhancement of the underlying structural symmetry. More generally, we demonstrate that a higher-symmetry-like optical spectrum does not uniquely identify the exact symmetry of a QD, therefore also providing useful guidance for other QD and nanostructure systems that lie beyond the ones studied here.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种理论，能够一致地描述[111]取向位点控制量子点（QDs）在零磁场下表现出的C₂ᵥ对称性特征和在法拉第几何中表现出的C₃ᵥ对称性特征。通过引入受控的对称性降低微扰，将QD对称性降至Cₛ，该模型在零场下主要呈现C₂ᵥ响应，而在法拉第几何中则产生四个主导的、近似圆偏振的三激子跃迁，重现了实验观察到的C₃ᵥ响应。该理论结合了8带k·p理论、自洽Hartree-informed组态相互作用方案和群论分析。
authors: N. D. O'Connor, G. Juska, E. Pelucchi, S. Schulz

articles.title: Spin-density wave of ferrimagnetic building blocks masking the ferromagnetic quantum-critical point in NbFe2
articles.title_zh: NbFe2中亚铁磁结构单元的自旋密度波掩盖铁磁量子临界点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.00101v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In the metallic magnet NbFe2, the low temperature threshold of ferromagnetism can be investigated by varying the Fe concentration within a narrow homogeneity range. NbFe2 is one of a number of compounds where modulated order is found to mask the ferromagnetic quantum critical point. However, here we report the rare case where the masking modulated magnetic order has been fully refined. Spherical neutron polarimetry and high-intensity single-crystal neutron diffraction reveal the first case of a longitudinal spin-density wave masking the ferromagnetic quantum critical point. The spin-density wave is characterised by a large-wavelength incommensurate modulation of its low average moment. It is formed from ferrimagnetic building blocks with antiparallel ferromagnetic sheets. The existence of ferromagnetic sheets and cancellation of the magnetisation only over mesoscopic length scales show local similarity between the spin-density wave and the ferromagnetic parent phase and indicate the spin-density wave's unconventional nature as emerging from underlying ferromagnetic quantum criticality.
articles.abstract_zh: 在金属磁体NbFe2中，发现自旋密度波（SDW）掩盖了铁磁量子临界点。本研究首次通过球形中子极化和高强度单晶中子衍射，完整解析了这种纵向SDW。该SDW由反平行铁磁片组成的亚铁磁结构单元形成，具有大波长非公度调制和低平均磁矩，表明其非常规性质源于潜在的铁磁量子临界性。
authors: T. Poulis, G. Mani, J. Sturt, W. J. Duncan, H. Thoma, V. Hutanu, B. Ouladdiaf, I. Kibalin, M. H. Lemee, P. Manuel, A. Neubauer, C. Pfleiderer, F. M. Grosche, P. G. Niklowitz

articles.title: Electron Coherence and Dephasing by Quasi-Static Coulomb Fluctuations in Classical Ionic Media
articles.title_zh: 经典离子介质中准静态库仑涨落引起的电子相干性与退相干
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.18187v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We develop a microscopic theory of quantum-particle propagation through quasi-static electrostatic fluctuations of a classical one-component plasma. The RPA potential is Gaussian but has an unscreened 1/r correlation tail, which makes the disorder-averaged retarded Green function infrared sensitive. Its eikonal attenuation scale is ellₘ̊ w=k²/G for g=G/k³łl1, with the formal strong-saddle asymptote ellₘ̊ ₛ=(4sqrt[3]2/3)G⁻¹/³ for ggg1. For a slab of thickness d, the retarded--advanced mutual-coherence kernel is infrared finite: the coherence decays algebraically for łambda_Dłlh̊ołl d and saturates at larger transverse separation. Thus equilibrium ionic-density fluctuations constitute a distinct quasi-static dephasing channel with a nonexponential coherence law. A finite coherence radius exists only when the saturation threshold is crossed. Relativistic paraxial reduction gives aₘ̊ ᵣₑₗ=1/(hbar v) and the finite high-energy limit 1/(hbar c). The ionic contribution is very small at conventional TEM energies for a 100,nm water-like layer. Within the quasi-static model it grows for thicker samples and lower-energy electrons, while sub-keV transmission through liquid water is strongly limited by inelastic scattering.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究发展了一种微观理论，描述量子粒子在经典单组分等离子体准静态静电涨落中的传播。结果表明，RPA势具有未屏蔽的1/r关联尾部，使得无序平均的延迟格林函数对红外敏感。相干性在特定条件下呈代数衰减，并在较大横向分离处饱和，揭示了非指数相干定律和独特的退相干通道。该理论还讨论了相对论准轴近似和离子贡献。
authors: Yury A. Budkov

articles.title: Physical regimes of quartic quantum advantage in elastic media simulation
articles.title_zh: 弹性介质模拟中四次方量子优势的物理机制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06975v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum algorithms for elastic media simulation have been conjectured to offer up to a quartic quantum advantage over classical methods; however, the devil is always in the details. Here, we determine key physical conditions under which this quartic separation could be achieved in the relevant parameters. For continuum elastic dynamics at fixed volume with spatial convergence order m, we find that the end-to-end speedup is of order (m+4)/(m+1) in the simulation time, and 4/(m+1) in the accuracy, with exponential memory advantage. For elastic lattice systems, we define microscopically resolved bulk observables (MRBOs) as those that can be efficiently extracted from a quantum state, but cannot be resolved by a known continuum model with fewer degrees of freedom than the lattice. We then argue that the estimation of MRBOs is a candidate problem for quartic quantum advantage in problem size. We propose MRBOs for pseudorandom heterogeneous materials as an explicit end-to-end application where this occurs, while admitting efficient `quantum cheese' encodings of the material properties. We thus demonstrate how the interplay between regularity, physical scale, observable sensitivity and quantum encodability constrains the relation between classical and quantum complexity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了弹性介质模拟中量子算法相对于经典方法可能实现的四次方量子优势。研究确定了在相关参数下实现这种优势的关键物理条件，并发现对于连续弹性动力学，模拟时间加速比为(m+4)/(m+1)，精度加速比为4/(m+1)，并具有指数级内存优势。此外，作者提出了微观分辨体观测值（MRBOs）的概念，并认为其估计是实现问题规模上四次方量子优势的候选问题。
authors: David Jennings, Kamil Korzekwa, Matteo Lostaglio, Tamás Vaszary

articles.title: All Bell inequalities with a quantum advantage in the minimal scenario are self-testing
articles.title_zh: 最小贝尔情景中所有具有量子优势的贝尔不等式都是自检验的
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06997v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the minimal Bell scenario, all extremal quantum correlations are known, but the Tsirelson inequalities that delimit the quantum set remain poorly understood. We study which correlations can maximize a given Tsirelson inequality, and conversely, which inequalities are maximized by a given correlation. We show that every Tsirelson inequality with quantum advantage is maximized by a single, extremal correlation, and thus self-tests the corresponding realization. This characterizes all self-tests based on linear Bell inequalities in this scenario. We also show that at most a two-dimensional family of inequalities can be maximized by a nonlocal extremal correlation. We identify these as polygons for a family of correlations realized by qubit states of arbitrary entanglement. This allows us to deduce that the quantum set is not self-dual.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了最小贝尔情景中具有量子优势的Tsirelson不等式。研究表明，每个具有量子优势的Tsirelson不等式都由单一的、极值量子关联最大化，从而自检验了相应的实现。这表征了该情景中所有基于线性贝尔不等式的自检验。此外，作者还发现最多一个二维不等式族可以被非局域极值关联最大化，并由此推断量子集不是自对偶的。
authors: Mu-En Liu, Andrea Zingarofalo, Victor Barizien, Jean-Daniel Bancal

articles.title: Threshold-Free Symmetry-Enriched Topological Quantum Memory
articles.title_zh: 无阈值对称性增强拓扑量子存储器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07017v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that non-Abelian symmetry enrichment can protect a toric code memory against incoherent electric noise at any bond error probability pin[0,1]. For a toric code on the honeycomb lattice coupled to Sp(N) rotors, with electric anyons carrying the fundamental representation, we construct an efficient minimum-weight decoder whose logical error probability decays exponentially with system size for Nge40, a conservative sufficient bound. The same decoder also rules out strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking in the fundamental channel of Sp(N) under the corresponding local decoherence in two dimensions. The construction extends to other symmetries, including SU(N).
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了非阿贝尔对称性增强如何保护环面码存储器免受非相干电噪声的影响，即使在任意键错误概率下。对于与Sp(N)转子耦合的蜂窝晶格上的环面码，作者构建了一个高效的最小权重解码器，其逻辑错误概率随系统尺寸呈指数衰减。该解码器还排除了二维Sp(N)基本通道中强到弱的自发对称性破缺。
authors: Abhijat Sarma, Ruochen Ma, Cenke Xu

articles.title: Single-shot ground-state preparation via strongly coupled baths
articles.title_zh: 通过强耦合浴实现单次基态制备
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07021v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Preparing ground and thermal states of quantum many-body systems is a central task in quantum simulation. Dissipative protocols have emerged as a promising solution for both near-term and fault-tolerant hardware, but most constructions rely on weak system-bath coupling, leading to slow cooling. Here, we construct cooling protocols at strong system-bath coupling, and demonstrate accurate state preparation within even a single cooling cycle. Our protocols combine dynamically ramped ancilla energy levels with time-dependent couplings to optimize the trade-off between cooling error and physical time. For a general class of free-fermion systems, we reduce the dynamics exactly to a two-level scattering problem: ground-state cooling becomes a control problem of maximizing resonant excitation transfer while suppressing non-adiabatic heating. We then construct a family of ``Möbius-Ingham'' protocols, which reach optimal error scaling for gapless spectra and almost-exponential suppression of the leading heating error for gapped spectra, as a function of the cycle period. In our free-fermion benchmarks, Möbius-Ingham cooling lies on the Pareto frontier between steady-state error and cooling time among the controls tested. We further demonstrate its effectiveness in interacting Ising and t-V chains and the two-dimensional Fermi-Hubbard model. Finally, we extend our construction to Gibbs state preparation, showing how free-fermion thermal states can be prepared in a single cycle.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种在强系统-浴耦合下制备量子多体系统基态和热态的冷却协议。该协议结合了动态调整的辅助能级和时间依赖的耦合，以优化冷却误差和物理时间之间的权衡。对于自由费米子系统，作者构建了一系列“Möbius-Ingham”协议，这些协议在无能隙谱中实现了最优误差标度，并在有能隙谱中几乎指数级抑制了主要的加热误差。
authors: Liang-Hong Mo, Jerome Lloyd, Yuxuan Zhang, Dmitry A. Abanin, Biao Lian

articles.title: Upper and lower bounds for few-copy Gaussian tomography, and the absence of a fermionic warm regime
articles.title_zh: 少量拷贝高斯层析成像的上下界，以及费米子暖区间的缺失
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07271v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chen, Mele, Mele and Preskill proved a crossover for bosonic Gaussian tomography: cold states need Θ(m³/ϵ²⁾ copies under single-copy or few-copy measurements, warm ones Θ(m²/ϵ²⁾. The author proved Ømega(m³/ϵ²⁾ for adaptive single-copy tomography of mixed fermionic Gaussian states. This note shows the crossover has no fermionic counterpart and extends the fermionic bound to blocks of k copies. There is no warm regime: on the quadratic Gibbs balls β|h|_Fłeβ₀ of unknown Hamiltonian h, the single-copy rate is Θ(m³/ϵ²⁾ for every fixed β₀>0, at accuracies that resolve the ball, with a lower-bound constant independent of β₀. At the maximally mixed state a replicated-parameter Fisher budget gives N>m³/(8,553,600,k,ϵ²⁾ for blocks of at most k copies and all ϵłe1/3600; an exact formula for the maximal block Fisher information, via spinor tensor powers of mathfrakso(2m), shows that the budget mt² behind it is asymptotically attained for every fixed block size; whether 1/k is the true rate is open. Near the vacuum, block protocols need Ømega(m³/(ϵ²minsqrt k,m)) copies, with no logarithm, via an exterior-power embedding of qudit tomography; parity superselection changes no rate, and number superselection costs nothing on number-conserving inputs. The embedding also carries upper bounds: a particle-number measurement followed by the k-copy qudit protocol of Nayak and Zhou attains the lower bound for every k on number-conserving fermionic Gaussian states with bounded fugacity trace and on passive bosonic Gaussian states with bounded photon number, and a heterodyne stage that undoes displacement and squeezing extends this to all cold bosonic Gaussian states. This closes their k-entangled gap on the cold class; intermediate temperatures remain open.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了少量拷贝高斯层析成像的上下界，并指出玻色子高斯层析成像中存在的“冷”与“暖”态交叉现象在费米子系统中并不存在。作者证明了对于混合费米子高斯态，单拷贝层析成像的速率为Θ(m³/ϵ²)，并且将费米子下界扩展到k个拷贝的块。研究表明，在二次吉布斯球上，单拷贝速率对于所有固定的β₀>0都是Θ(m³/ϵ²)。
authors: Ron Rubin

articles.title: Quantum simulation of classical RCL circuits via complexification and Schrödingerization
articles.title_zh: 通过复数化和薛定谔化实现经典RCL电路的量子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07300v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The decomplexification procedure establishes a mathematical equivalence between finite dimensional quantum dynamics and classical dynamics by mapping the complex quantum domain onto the real classical one. Its inverse process, complexification --- which lifts a classical dynamics to an equivalent quantum formulation --- is of great interest, particularly because it enables the quantum simulation of equations that are of classical relevance. In this way, one can prepare the solution of classical differential equations to be implemented using quantum computation tools. In the present work, we recall the decomplexification procedure and also discuss several distinct strategies for performing the complexification of classical equations, so as to obtain the corresponding quantum-equivalent dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了通过复数化和薛定谔化将经典动力学转化为等效量子形式的方法，从而实现经典RCL电路的量子模拟。作者回顾了去复数化过程，并讨论了几种不同的策略来对经典方程进行复数化，以获得相应的量子等效动力学。这种方法对于利用量子计算工具解决经典微分方程具有重要意义。
authors: Huner Fanchiotti, Carlos A. García Canal, Miguel A. Mayosky, Alejandro L. Veiga, Armando Pérez, Rafael Gómez-Lurbe, Vicente Vento

articles.title: Frustration-freeness is decidable but unprovable
articles.title_zh: 无挫折性是可判定的但不可证明的
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07337v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The frustration-free property is valuable in quantum many-body systems, which states that its ground states simultaneously minimize all local interaction terms, even when these terms act on overlapping degrees of freedom. Prominent examples include the AKLT model and Kitaev's toric code model, which serve as paradigmatic models of symmetry-protected topological phases and topological order, respectively. A fundamental question is whether a given Hamiltonian is frustration-free for all system sizes. Here we establish two seemingly contradictory results concerning this decision problem. First, we prove that frustration-freeness is decidable for any fixed local Hilbert space dimension. Specifically, there exists a finite, Hamiltonian-independent system-size cutoff such that frustration-freeness at this cutoff size guarantees frustration-freeness at all system sizes. Second, on the other hand, we also show that there exists a frustration-free Hamiltonian whose frustration-freeness cannot be proved within the standard axioms of mathematics (ZFC). We reconcile these seemingly contradictory results by showing that the cutoff, although finite for each local Hilbert space dimension, is uncomputable as a function of that dimension. Our findings reveal an unexpected fundamental distinction between decidability and provability arising in quantum many-body physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了量子多体系统中无挫折性这一重要性质的判定问题。作者证明了对于任何固定的局部希尔伯特空间维度，无挫折性是可判定的，即存在一个有限的、与哈密顿量无关的系统尺寸截止值。然而，研究也表明存在一个无挫折哈密顿量，其无挫折性无法在标准数学公理（ZFC）内被证明。
authors: Naoto Shiraishi

articles.title: Higher-order topological quantum battery
articles.title_zh: 高阶拓扑量子电池
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07401v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A quantum battery is a next-generation energy-storage device that exploits genuinely quantum properties such as superposition and coherence. We propose a second-order topological quantum battery coupled to a photonic crystal described by the breathing-Kagome model, where optical loss is present on all lattice sites while nonlinear gains are introduced selectively at the output sites. Under these realistic non-Hermitian conditions, the system exhibits a clear topological phase transition manifested in both the ergotropy and the charging power. Remarkably, perfect work extraction is realized in the topological phase, where the maximum value of the ergotropy is quantized and acts as a good topological-phase indicator. The triangular geometry coherently distributes energy into two quantum batteries, where mirror-symmetry-protected phase synchronization gives rise to collective energy storage.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于呼吸-Kagome模型的二阶拓扑量子电池，该电池与光子晶体耦合。在非厄米条件下，系统展现出清晰的拓扑相变，体现在能量提取功和充电功率上。研究发现，在拓扑相中实现了完美的功提取，且能量提取功的最大值被量子化，可作为拓扑相的良好指标。
authors: Motohiko Ezawa

articles.title: Structured Quantum Hardness from Unstructured Assumptions
articles.title_zh: 从非结构化假设中获得结构化量子困难性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07413v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Whether useful structured hardness can arise from unstructured assumptions is a fundamental question in complexity and cryptography. The longstanding Bennett-Gill question asks whether mathsfNPa̧pmathsfcoNP remains hard relative to a random oracle; [GIKKLS, STOC 2023] recently gave a conditional affirmative answer in the classical setting. We establish the quantum analogue: if mathsfUPnotsubseteqmathsfBQP, then mathsfNPOa̧pmathsfcoNPOnotsubseteqmathsfBQPO with probability 1 over a random oracle O. Beyond extending the classical result, this separation has a distinctly quantum significance: Shor's algorithms defeat canonical number-theoretic hardness candidates, while lattice assumptions and other leading post-quantum cryptographic assumptions do not directly supply hard languages with two-sided classical certification on every input. Our conditional oracle separation provides evidence that such structured quantum hardness can nevertheless arise from unstructured sources. Complementing this result, we rule out fully black-box quantum reductions of worst-case quantum hardness in mathsfNPa̧pmathsfcoNP to post-quantum injective one-way functions and indistinguishability obfuscation. This barrier excludes a broad class of black-box approaches to deriving structured quantum hardness from generic cryptographic primitives, providing partial evidence that the non-black-box techniques in our first result are essential.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了结构化困难性是否能从非结构化假设中产生这一复杂性理论和密码学中的基本问题。作者建立了Bennett-Gill问题的量子模拟，证明了如果UP不包含在BQP中，那么NPOcoNPO在随机预言机O下不包含在BQPO中。这一结果表明，即使Shor算法击败了经典的数论困难性，结构化量子困难性仍可能从非结构化来源中产生。
authors: Xiao Liang, Takashi Yamakawa, Chak Fai Yung

articles.title: Optimal quantum metrology with restricted controls
articles.title_zh: 受限控制下的最优量子计量学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07583v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum control can enhance sensing precision, but practical protocols are constrained by probe preparation and the available control resources. Optimizing the sensing protocol within these constraints helps establish what precision is experimentally attainable. We study quantum metrology from a fixed initial probe state under restricted Hamiltonian controls with bounded amplitudes. Building on Pontryagin's maximum principle, we formulate quantum Fisher information maximization at a prescribed interrogation time for multiple control channels subject to a weighted amplitude constraint. The formulation also accommodates stochastic Hamiltonian evolution and time-local master equations. A geometric description of sensitivity accumulation reveals the mechanisms underlying the optimized protocols. Two spin-1/2 examples demonstrate the resulting enhancement: time-dependent control outperforms optimized constant control in transverse-field sensing, while optimized waveforms improve upon CPMG pulses for AC-field sensing under strong colored noise. These findings highlight the importance of optimizing sensing protocols within available control resources to improve experimentally attainable precision.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在受限哈密顿量控制下，从固定初始探针态出发的最优量子计量学。作者基于庞特里亚金最大值原理，提出了在给定探测时间内最大化量子费舍尔信息的公式，并考虑了多个受加权振幅约束的控制通道。通过两个自旋-1/2的例子，研究展示了优化协议带来的增强，强调了在可用控制资源内优化传感协议的重要性。
authors: Li Sun, Haoze Wang, Chong Chen

articles.title: Observing mixed-state Uhlmann winding numbers in integrated photonic quantum walks
articles.title_zh: 在集成光子量子行走中观测混合态Uhlmann缠绕数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07600v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Integer winding numbers provide a well-established classification of topological phases protected by chiral symmetry at zero temperature, but extending this classification to thermal mixed states remains challenging. The Uhlmann phase, a mixed-state extension of the Berry phase, provides a geometric framework for characterizing finite-temperature topology. However, this geometric phase is restricted to two quantized values and therefore cannot resolve the multiple thermal regimes associated with high winding numbers. Here, we experimentally observe integer mixed-state winding numbers in a photonic quantum-walk chip. We prepare and reconstruct thermal states associated with high-winding chiral Hamiltonians and their spectrum-preserving dimensional extensions. The reconstructed Uhlmann overlaps form closed trajectories in the complex plane, and their integer windings around the zero-overlap point are directly observed. As temperature increases, the Uhlmann winding number undergoes multiple discrete changes, accompanied by switches of the Uhlmann phase and the successive disappearance of momentum-resolved topological kinks. These results highlight an integer-valued topological characterization alongside the mixed-state geometric phase.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在光子量子行走芯片中实验观测了整数混合态Uhlmann缠绕数。研究制备并重构了与高缠绕手性哈密顿量相关的热态，并直接观测到重构的Uhlmann重叠在复平面中形成的闭合轨迹及其围绕零重叠点的整数缠绕。结果表明，随着温度升高，Uhlmann缠绕数会发生多次离散变化，伴随着Uhlmann相位的切换和动量分辨拓扑扭结的相继消失。
authors: Baichu Yu, Qin-Qin Wang, Huilong Huang, Bin-Tong Yin, Xiao-Ye Xu, Feng Gao, Xin Wang, Keren Li, Sen Yang, Yuan-Yuan Zhao

articles.title: Separability and lower bounds of concurrence via symmetric measurement correlations
articles.title_zh: 基于对称测量关联的可分性与纠缠度下界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07727v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The detection and quantification of quantum entanglement is a central issue in quantum information science, particularly for unknown quantum states. Based on symmetric measurement correlation matrices, we present a family of separability criteria that can be experimentally applied without state tomography, and recover some related existing criteria as special cases. Using the constructed correlation matrices, we further derive a class of lower bounds of concurrence. Through illustrative examples, we demonstrate that our criteria outperform some existing separability criteria in entanglement detection, and that the obtained lower bounds on concurrence are tighter than known counterparts.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一系列基于对称测量关联矩阵的可分性判据，这些判据无需态层析即可实验应用，并包含了现有的一些相关判据作为特例。利用构建的关联矩阵，作者进一步推导了一类纠缠度下界。通过示例，研究表明这些判据在纠缠检测方面优于现有方法，并且获得的纠缠度下界也更为紧致。
authors: Yuhang Xie, Yanjun Chu, Shao-Ming Fei

articles.title: Efficient preparation of spin-squeezed states with Grover's algorithm
articles.title_zh: 基于Grover算法高效制备自旋压缩态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07766v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a scheme for preparing spin-squeezed states in an ensemble of N spin-1/2 particles based on Grover's algorithm. With only a few oracles, the scheme can exactly prepare superpositions of a few neighboring Dicke states with the Wineland squeezing parameter scaling as N⁻¹. The scheme requires only global rotations and Dicke-selective phase shifts, thus avoiding the need to engineer a dedicated many-body Hamiltonian for the squeezing dynamics. We further discuss the feasibility of realizing the scheme in cavity QED systems, with the phase-matched Grover iterations realized by single-photon reflection from a dispersively coupled cavity. Full-sequence scattering calculations accounting for finite photon bandwidth and loss show that appreciable spin squeezing can be achieved with high fidelity for suitable system parameters.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于Grover算法，在N个自旋-1/2粒子系综中制备自旋压缩态的方案。该方案仅需少量预言机，即可精确制备少数相邻Dicke态的叠加态，其Wineland压缩参数与N⁻¹成比例。研究还讨论了在腔QED系统中实现该方案的可行性，并表明在适当系统参数下可高保真度地实现显著的自旋压缩。
authors: Zhi-Yuan Zeng, Wen-Long Ma

articles.title: Detecting Nonbilocal Correlations via Parameterized Elegant Joint Measurement
articles.title_zh: 通过参数化优雅联合测量检测非双局域关联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07769v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum networks constitute a defining resource for quantum information processing; however, their nonclassical behavior is jointly governed by the choice of measurement basis and the independence of the distributed sources. We study a bilocal entanglement-swapping network in which the central node performs a three-parameter elegant joint measurement (EJM). For two independent Bell-state sources, we construct two binary edge observables and then derive a quantum prediction involving three parameters, which surpasses the classical constraints. In particular, the parameter θ controls both the degree of entanglement of the EJM basis states and the maximum value of the quantum prediction. These results provide an analytic and directly reproducible route for tuning nonbilocal correlations in an experimentally relevant two-source network.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子网络是量子信息处理的关键资源，其非经典行为受测量基选择和分布式源独立性的共同影响。本文研究了一个双局域纠缠交换网络，其中央节点执行三参数优雅联合测量（EJM）。这些结果为在实验相关的双源网络中调节非双局域关联提供了一条分析且可直接复现的途径。
authors: Ye Tian, Ying-Qiu He, Zan-Jia Li, Yu-Yan Zhang, Dong Ding

articles.title: Continuous variable payload transmitter for the SPOQC mission
articles.title_zh: SPOQC任务的连续变量载荷发射器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07861v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The continuous variable (CV) quantum key distribution (QKD) scheme enables two parties to share a secret key separated by a certain distance. Here we propose, design, build, test and show results of a CV payload transmitter, intended to demonstrate downlink based QKD from a CubeSat in low earth orbit. This is part of the SPOQC mission by Quantum Communications Hub, UK which was successfully launched on March 2026.
articles.abstract_zh: 连续变量（CV）量子密钥分发（QKD）方案使两方能够在一定距离内共享秘密密钥。本文提出、设计、构建、测试并展示了一个CV载荷发射器的结果，旨在演示从低地球轨道CubeSat进行的下行链路QKD。该发射器是英国量子通信中心SPOQC任务的一部分，该任务已于2026年3月成功发射。
authors: Vinod N. Rao, Killian Murphy, Timothy Ayers, Fadi Ahwal, Timothy P. Spiller, Rupesh Kumar

articles.title: Monopoles, Scattering and Generalized Symmetries on a Quantum Computer
articles.title_zh: 量子计算机上的磁单极子、散射与广义对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07960v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum computers have advanced to the stage that interesting many-body quantum phenomena can be observed. A striking example is the magnetic monopole paradox, a problem that was only solved recently using the language of generalized symmetries. Here we demonstrate a quantum spin chain analogue of magnetic monopole scattering on Quantinuum System Model H2. We implement a novel protocol for preparing a localized quasiparticle wavepacket on top of the ground state. By combining this protocol with time evolution across a duality defect, we efficiently convert local particles into non-local string-like excitations. We demonstrate this particle-to-string conversion in the transverse-field Ising model and a symmetry-protected topological (SPT) phase of the cluster model. Our results establish duality defects and generalized symmetries as practical resources for preparing and probing non-local excitations on quantum hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子计算机已能观测到有趣的量子多体现象，其中磁单极子悖论是一个显著例子。本文在Quantinuum System Model H2上演示了磁单极子散射的量子自旋链模拟。研究实现了一种新颖的协议，用于在基态之上制备局域准粒子波包。这些结果表明，对偶缺陷和广义对称性是量子硬件上制备和探测非局域激发的实用资源。
authors: Oliver O'Brien, Atsushi Ueda, Etienne Granet, Henrik Dreyer, Frank Verstraete

articles.title: Quantum Relative Entropy and Information Flux Resolve Wavefunction Collapse in Spacelike-Separated QED Waveguides
articles.title_zh: 量子相对熵和信息通量解决类空间隔QED波导中的波函数坍缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08000v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Resolving how first-order quantum coherence and definite measurement outcomes emerge from entangled vacuum fluctuations across spacelike-separated regions is unified here by the principle that quantum relative entropy governs the energy-information flux across causal boundaries [P.~Dorau and A.~Much, Phys.~Rev.~Lett.~136, 091602 (2026)]. We establish the exact quantum-optical realization of this principle using dual, spacelike-separated entangled nonlinear biphoton sources implemented in quantum electrodynamics waveguides pumped by an optical frequency comb and seeded by a continuous-wave laser in a coherent state |αångle. We demonstrate that single-photon-added coherent states (SPACS) generated via coherent seeding possess a quantum relative entropy that precisely quantifies the entanglement deficit between signal and idler fields. Tracing over the unmeasured idler continuum yields an exact spatial Lindblad master equation along the propagation axis, proving that spatial dephasing is driven by an information divergence flux determined by the SPACS overlap fidelity F = |α|²/(1+|α|²⁾. Uniting this relative-entropy flow with quotient measurement theory (detailed in Section~S3 of the Supplemental Material), we rigorously resolve nonlocal wavefunction collapse into local coset projections---explaining macroscopic state reduction without superluminal signaling. This exact open-system framework simultaneously saturates the wave-particle-entanglement triality [T.~H.~Yoon and M.~Cho, Sci.~Adv.~7, eabi9268 (2021)] and anchors hardware-native time--frequency Gottesman--Kitaev--Preskill stabilizers to the comb symplectic structure.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过量子相对熵控制因果边界上的能量-信息通量原理，统一解释了类空间隔区域中纠缠真空涨落如何产生一级量子相干性和确定测量结果。研究利用在量子电动力学波导中实现的双重、类空间隔纠缠非线性双光子源，建立了该原理的精确量子光学实现。结果表明，通过相干播种产生的单光子添加相干态具有精确量化信号和闲置场之间纠缠亏缺的量子相对熵。
authors: Tai Hyun Yoon

articles.title: Non-Unitary Quantum Butterfly Effect: Theory and Experiment
articles.title_zh: 非酉量子蝴蝶效应：理论与实验
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08152v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a generalization of the out of time order correlator (OTOC) for non-unitary systems. For a Haar-random brickwork qudit-circuit, peppered with local, projective measurement, we calculate the infinite-temperature, ensemble-average OTOC. Utilizing transfer matrix machinery, we find that the OTOC asymptotically decays exponentially and that the decay depends on the rate of measurement. In the thermodynamic limit, with sparse measurement, the OTOC approximately exhibits a Gaussian shape. Phenomenologically, this corresponds to the development of a causal scrambling front where unlike the unitary case, the signal decays in the bulk of the causal cone. We develop a Monte Carlo framework to compute the OTOC. We then estimate the OTOC directly via quantum simulation and on Quantinuum's trapped-ion quantum computer. We resolve the unitary and non-unitary OTOC phenomenology despite the presence of hardware noise. Our analytic results characterize how local nonunitary channels affect OTOC decay, providing a quantitative benchmark for the cumulative effects of a broad class of hardware noise on many-body dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了非酉系统时间序外关联器（OTOC）的推广。研究计算了无限温度下的系综平均OTOC，发现OTOC渐近地呈指数衰减，且衰减速率取决于测量速率。分析结果表征了局部非酉信道如何影响OTOC衰减，为硬件噪声对多体动力学的累积效应提供了定量基准。
authors: Paul Argyle, Djamil Lakhdar-Hamina, Sarah H. Miller, Victor Galitski

articles.title: Quantum Advantage with Sign-Free Proofs: An Oracle Separation between mathsfStoqMA and mathsfMA
articles.title_zh: 无符号证明的量子优势：mathsfStoqMA与mathsfMA之间的谕示分离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08180v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Several landmark oracle results (FOCS 2000, FOCS 2025, STOC 2026) establish strict separations along the chain mathsfMA subseteq mathsfQCMA subseteq mathsfQMA, showing that quantum verification and quantum witnesses can each provide additional power over classical proof systems. These separations, however, use substantial coherent quantum computation, often through the quantum Fourier transform. We prove that a minimal quantum resource already suffices to outperform every classical verifier. Namely, we show the separation mathsfMA subsetneq mathsfStoqMA relative to a classical oracle. The class mathsfStoqMA, introduced by Bravyi, Bessen, and Terhal (arXiv 2006), restricts the verifier to classical reversible computation, followed by a single Hadamard-basis measurement. Its power is closely tied to the complexity of stoquastic Hamiltonians, a sign-problem-free and seemingly more tractable class of quantum Hamiltonians. Our separating problem is to determine whether a sparse high-girth graph, given via an adjacency-list oracle, has a large or small Perron--Frobenius eigenvalue. This amounts to a ground-energy estimation task for a related stoquastic Hamiltonian.
