Our construction builds on a line of work on graph exploration problems with exponential quantum speedups, from welded trees (STOC 2003) to recent constructions (STOC 2021, arXiv 2026).
articles.abstract_zh: 现有谕示结果表明量子验证和量子证据比经典证明系统具有额外能力，但这些分离通常依赖于大量的相干量子计算。本文证明了即使是最小的量子资源也足以超越所有经典验证器，即在经典谕示下展示了mathsfMA与mathsfStoqMA之间的分离。研究提出的分离问题是确定一个稀疏高围长图的Perron--Frobenius特征值大小，这相当于一个相关的基态能量估计任务。
authors: Yassine Hamoudi, Yvan Le Borgne, Shrinidhi Teganahally Sridhara

articles.title: Certifying quantum code and circuit distances at scale
articles.title_zh: 大规模量子编码和电路距离的认证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08247v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Code and circuit distances characterize how strongly quantum error correction suppresses logical errors and guide code comparisons, schedule choices and resource estimates. Yet many published distances are only upper bounds from heuristic searches. Here, we express both distances as tropical partition functions and evaluate them with rank-based dynamic programming and weight-bounded search. Circuit reductions and relaxations shrink the problems, and proved lower bounds with explicit logical errors of matching weight certify exact values. On two benchmarks, our method certifies more instances than all other tested exact solvers combined. We certify distances for codes with up to 31,200 qubits, such as Google's modular hyperbolic codes, and for memory circuits with up to 8×10⁵ fault mechanisms, such as those of high-rate Cornucopia codes. Our audit of 26 recent papers identifies overestimated distances and non-tight upper bounds in 10 papers, with a maximum discrepancy of at least eight. Certified distances also guide circuit design and show which defective chips remain usable. In particular, we certify circuit distance 16 for IBM's two-gross memory circuits with the standard schedule, not the assumed 18, whereas redesigned schedules reach 18 at one noisy cycle, at the cost of one more timestep per cycle. At 99.98% junction yield, keeping gross-code memory blocks with dead checks that are certified at distance 10 or more raises the estimated usable share from 53% for perfect blocks alone to 94% with an improved schedule.
articles.abstract_zh: 编码和电路距离表征了量子纠错抑制逻辑错误的强度，并指导编码比较、调度选择和资源估算。本文将这两种距离表示为热带配分函数，并使用基于秩的动态规划和权重有界搜索进行评估。该方法认证了多达31,200个量子比特的编码和多达8×10⁵个故障机制的存储电路的距离。对26篇近期论文的审计发现，有10篇论文存在距离高估和非紧密上界的问题。
authors: Bin Cheng, Naixu Guo, Feng Pan

articles.title: Entropic measures of quantum information
articles.title_zh: 量子信息的熵度量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08254v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Entropy has played a pivotal role in physics ever since its inception by Clausius in the early industrial age. Shannon ushered the concept into the information age by using it to describe fundamental limits of information processing, founding the field of information theory. Today, a fruitful interaction between information theory and physics is pushing our understanding of entropy forward. It has revealed, in particular, that no single notion of entropy suffices to capture all relevant properties of physical systems, making it necessary to consider a variety of entropic measures of quantum information, each with distinct features and uses. This review surveys these recent advances in a structured way, covering a comprehensive array of information measures, including Rényi and smooth entropies, together with their interrelations. Starting with a systematic characterization of entropies that motivates their definitions from natural physical principles, we discuss their applications ranging from quantum communication and cryptography to resource theories, thermodynamics, and many-body physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 熵在物理学和信息论中都扮演着核心角色，但单一的熵概念不足以捕捉物理系统的所有相关特性。本综述系统地概述了量子信息中各种熵度量的最新进展，包括Rényi熵和光滑熵及其相互关系。文章从熵的系统表征出发，讨论了它们在量子通信、密码学、资源理论、热力学和多体物理等领域的应用。
authors: Roberto Rubboli, Bartosz Regula, Mario Berta, Ludovico Lami, Marco Tomamichel

articles.title: Dualities in one-dimensional quantum lattice models: Lie groups, Schur-Weyl duality and symmetry breaking
articles.title_zh: 一维量子格点模型中的对偶性：李群、Schur-Weyl对偶性与对称性破缺
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08293v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a systematic framework for gauging continuous symmetries, and show that the Schur-Weyl duality arises naturally as a realization of this construction with open boundary conditions. Restricting to compact Lie group symmetries, we construct dual models for one-dimensional quantum lattice models exhibiting those symmetries. We demonstrate that matrix product operators enable the explicit construction of intertwiners between the dual theories and their (non-invertible) symmetries. With closed boundary conditions, we can relate the full spectrum of these dual theories by considering all possible twisted boundary conditions.We illustrate how the Peter-Weyl transform appears when the duality acts on the boundary Hilbert space of a G-symmetric model. The presented framework generalizes previous work on dualities for unitary fusion category symmetric models. It exemplifies how dualities for both finite and continuous symmetries rely on the relation between a bond algebra and a representation of the symmetry in the lattice as double centralizers. We argue that dual non-invertible spontaneous symmetry breaking is the mechanism that underlies symmetric tensor network algorithms. We illustrate these results for U(1)- and SU(2)-symmetric quantum lattice models.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个规范连续对称性的系统框架，并展示了Schur-Weyl对偶性在开放边界条件下作为该构造的自然实现。研究限制于紧李群对称性，为展现这些对称性的一维量子格点模型构建了对偶模型。该框架推广了先前关于酉融合范畴对称模型对偶性的工作，并论证了对偶非可逆自发对称性破缺是统一有限和连续对称性对偶性的机制。
authors: Dante Bosgoed, Frank Verstraete, Laurens Lootens

articles.title: Beyond Quantum Messages: Toward Quantum-Native Network Functioning
articles.title_zh: 超越量子消息：迈向量子原生网络功能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08298v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Quantum Internet is commonly envisioned as a network that transports quantum states and distributes entanglement as the key resource underpinning distributed quantum applications. This view is necessary but incomplete if quantum phenomena are confined to what the network carries or manages, while network functionalities remain grounded predominantly in classical abstractions. This Perspective advances a broader thesis: quantum phenomena can also participate directly in the realization of network functionalities. We first establish the architectural baseline by introducing entanglement as a stateful network resource whose operational condition is non-locally distributed across remote nodes, evolves through manipulation or consumption, and degrades over time through decoherence. Its evolving state must therefore remain visible to the functionalities acting on it. We then move beyond resource visibility and use two mechanisms as proof points of a broader quantum-native functional design space: entanglement generation during propagation through coherent spatial-path superposition, and operational connectivity induced by shared entanglement that can depart from the physical graph. These examples show that paths, neighbors, or participating nodes may become operationally relevant in ways determined by quantum coherence and shared entanglement, rather than by physical connectivity alone. We identify Quantum Addressing as a transversal abstraction capable of representing such relations while complementing, rather than replacing, classical addressing and signaling. The resulting perspective broadens the Quantum Internet from transporting quantum information and distributing entanglement to exploiting quantum phenomena in network functioning, opening a coupled frontier spanning routing, forwarding, control, and functionality placement.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子互联网通常被视为传输量子态和分发纠缠的网络，但如果量子现象仅限于网络承载或管理的内容，这种观点则不完整。本文提出一个更广泛的论点：量子现象也可以直接参与网络功能的实现。文章以相干空间路径叠加传播过程中的纠缠生成以及共享纠缠诱导的操作连接性作为更广泛的量子原生功能设计空间的证明点。
authors: Angela Sara Cacciapuoti, Jessica Illiano, Caterina De Risi, Marcello Caleffi

articles.title: Room-Temperature Quantum Emission from Boron Nitride Nanotubes
articles.title_zh: 氮化硼纳米管的室温量子发射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08460v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum information systems such as quantum key distribution and quantum communications require bright, high-purity, stable sources of single photons to act as carriers of quantum information. As such, methods for obtaining single photon emitters (SPEs) in solid-state devices capable of articulating with quantum photonic circuits are a necessary obstacle that must be overcome. Hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) flakes have been extensively studied as a host material for SPEs, though working in two dimensions is accompanied by engineering complexity. However, dimensionality can be reduced through the implementation of boron nitride nanotubes (BNNTs). Here we investigate the potential of BNNTs as room-temperature SPEs using confocal photoluminescence microscopy and Hanbury Brown-Twiss interferometry. Quantum emitters were found in BNNTs spanning the entirety of the visible spectrum, including spectral regions where SPEs within hBN have not been reported. Furthermore, each tube was found to possess multiple SPEs at varying emission wavelengths along the length, exhibiting lifetimes as fast as 0.5 ns, which is about two-fold faster than the fastest hBN SPEs. Additionally, we demonstrate that surface passivation/coating mitigates blinking events, therefore increasing the emitter stability. Thus, BNNTs can function as a single structure supporting a variety of multiwavelength SPE sources, while maintaining a compact radius of ~25 nm, making them ideally suited for deterministic placement and integration within nanophotonic devices such as waveguides and interferometric filters.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子信息系统需要明亮、高纯度、稳定的单光子源，而二维材料在单光子发射器（SPEs）方面存在工程复杂性。本文研究了氮化硼纳米管（BNNTs）作为室温SPEs的潜力，利用共聚焦光致发光显微镜和Hanbury Brown-Twiss干涉仪进行表征。研究在BNNTs中发现了覆盖整个可见光谱的量子发射器，其寿命快至0.5纳秒，比hBN中的SPEs快约两倍。
authors: Ke-Sean J. M. Peter, Ryan A. Kowalski, David A. Curie, Dakota Braaten, Matthew W. Day, Denis R. Candido, Deyu Li, Richard F. Haglund, Joshua D. Caldwell, Richarda Niemann

articles.title: Provable circuit-level thresholds for non-abelian topological phases
articles.title_zh: 非阿贝尔拓扑相的可证明电路级阈值
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08488v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We provide an explicit scheme to realize a quantum memory in any 2D non-chiral topological order. For this, we construct syndrome extraction circuits based on the Turaev-Viro path integral as well as a classical algorithm for decoding on the fly. We prove that our scheme has a threshold under a local stochastic circuit-level noise model and discuss how to generalize it to implement topological logical gates.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出了一种在任意二维非手性拓扑序中实现量子存储器的明确方案。作者构建了基于Turaev-Viro路径积分的综合征提取电路，并开发了实时解码的经典算法。研究证明，该方案在局部随机电路级噪声模型下具有阈值，并讨论了其推广到实现拓扑逻辑门的可能性。
authors: Yuanjie Ren, Margarita Davydova, Shankar Balasubramanian, Andreas Bauer

articles.title: Multipartite Entanglement, TQFT Partition Functions and PL Bordism
articles.title_zh: 多体纠缠、拓扑量子场论配分函数与PL配边
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07000v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In a previous work we conjectured that the multi-invariants of the ground state of a gapped (d-1)+1-dimensional system, labeled by bipartite (d+1)-edge-colored graphs encoding closed oriented d-manifolds M, compute the partition functions Z(M) of the low energy topological quantum field theory (TQFT), up to non-universal factors determined by the local structure of the triangulation. In this paper we determine which combinations of partition functions can be isolated from the non-universal factors. The answer is governed by oriented bordism. If M is null-bordant, Z(M) is obtained from an explicit, state-independent finite family of multi-invariants, up to a power of Z(S^d) which is fixed to be Z(S^d)ḩⁱ⁽M⁾/² for even d and can be removed for odd d. Conversely, the obstruction is measured by a quotient of the group of "residues" of colored graphs which receives a surjective map from the oriented bordism group, with kernel precisely the torsion subgroup as far as smooth manifolds are concerned. In d=4 the obstruction is the signature: Z(M)/Z(S⁴⁾ḩⁱ⁽M⁾/² can be extracted if and only if σ(M)=0. This is due to the fact that the first Pontryagin class p₁ has a local expression and thus eⁱθσ⁽M⁾=efracⁱ³θⁱⁿt_M p₁ cannot be separated from the non-universal factors. Torsion invariants, in contrast, are not obstructed: for the ground state of the 4+1-dimensional invertible phase with partition function (-1)ⁱⁿt w₂w₃ we compute the multi-invariants exactly, and two graphs with identical local data, encoding the Dold manifold and CP²× S¹, give opposite signs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了多体纠缠、拓扑量子场论（TQFT）配分函数与PL配边之间的关系。作者确定了哪些配分函数组合可以从非普适因子中分离出来，并发现其结果受有向配边理论的支配。对于零边界流形，TQFT配分函数Z(M)可以通过一组有限的多重不变量获得，并讨论了偶数和奇数维度下的特殊情况。研究特别指出，在d=4时，只有当流形M的签名σ(M)=0时，Z(M)/Z(S⁴)ʰⁱ⁽M⁾/²才能被提取。
authors: Michele Del Zotto, Abhijit Gadde, Pavel Putrov

articles.title: On Entanglement Dynamics in Holographic Theories
articles.title_zh: 关于全息理论中的纠缠动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07010v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Entanglement entropy (EE) is central to modern theoretical physics, yet its calculation in interacting theories with nontrivial time dependence remains challenging. In this thesis, we investigate the real-time dynamics of EE in strongly coupled quantum field theories (QFTs) using the Anti-de Sitter/Conformal Field Theory (AdS/CFT) correspondence. We first examine EE evolution in an exactly solvable two-dimensional conformal field theory (CFT) with an inhomogeneous sine-square deformation (SSD). We argue that the unconventional time evolution driven by the SSD Hamiltonian can be viewed as a change in spacetime foliation, producing new horizons in the dual three-dimensional bulk. Holographic EE calculations agree with CFT results in all comparable cases. We then study entanglement dynamics in generic chaotic quantum many-body systems. In the limit of late time and large regions, these dynamics are believed to admit an effective entanglement membrane description. In 2d CFTs, a degenerate membrane tension reproduces several entropy dynamics results, unlike the non-degenerate tension in higher dimensions. Using holography, we show that capturing reflected entropy in 2d CFT requires an additional degree of freedom in the membrane description. We further show that a conventional non-degenerate tension emerges when the CFT undergoes a relevant deformation, holographically dual to a planar Banados-Teitelboim-Zanelli (BTZ) black hole with scalar hair and an interior Kasner universe. We then develop a membrane effective theory for reflected entropy dynamics in higher dimensions. Finally, we apply the membrane theories for reflected entropy to study the time evolution of multipartite entanglement signals. We found that scrambling dynamics generate multipartite entanglement with rich structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本论文利用AdS/CFT对应关系，研究了强耦合量子场论中纠缠熵（EE）的实时动力学。首先，作者考察了具有非均匀正弦平方形变（SSD）的二维共形场论中的EE演化，并发现全息EE计算与CFT结果一致。随后，研究探讨了混沌量子多体系统中的纠缠动力学，指出在晚期和大区域极限下，这些动力学可由有效的纠缠膜描述。通过全息方法，论文揭示了二维CFT中简并膜张力与高维非简并张力在熵动力学结果上的差异。
authors: Hanzhi Jiang

articles.title: Agnostic and efficient detection of Z₂ symmetry-protected topological phases in projected entangled-pair states
articles.title_zh: 基于投影纠缠对态的Z₂对称保护拓扑相的普适高效检测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07030v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Symmetry-protected topological (SPT) phases are the simplest example of quantum phases that cannot be detected by local order parameters. Their classification is by now well-established from multiple perspectives, a prominent one being via tensor network states. The practical question, however, is not mere classification, but detection: given the ground state of an interacting Hamiltonian and a symmetry group G along with its representation, is there an efficient way to tell if the state is in a SPT phase with respect to G? While there exist such practical tests in one spatial dimension (1D), methods in 2D have so far been restricted to finite-size systems or require an explicit form of virtual symmetries of the tensor networks representing the ground state. Here, we develop an agnostic and efficient method to detect interacting Z₂ 2D SPT phases, using an infinite projected entangled-pair (PEPS) representation of the ground state. The method is agnostic to the symmetry representation in the virtual space of the PEPS tensor and applicable independent of the bond dimension of the tensors. Moreover, it is efficient as it does not require finite-size scalings: it works directly in the thermodynamic limit. We numerically demonstrate the procedure by mapping out phase boundaries away from fixed-point wavefunctions. We extract the SPT label cocycle data explicitly from the PEPS tensor.
articles.abstract_zh: 对称保护拓扑（SPT）相无法通过局部序参量检测，其分类已通过张量网络态等方法建立。本文旨在解决二维SPT相的实际检测问题，提出了一种普适且高效的方法来检测相互作用的Z₂二维SPT相。该方法利用基态的无限投影纠缠对态（PEPS）表示，并且对PEPS张量虚拟空间中的对称表示和键维不敏感。这项工作为在二维系统中识别SPT相提供了一个实用的工具。
authors: Alexandre Chaduteau, Hao Chen, Juraj Hasik, Titus Neupert

articles.title: Observable-Based Learning of Effective Entanglement Hamiltonians
articles.title_zh: 基于可观测量学习有效纠缠哈密顿量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07353v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Determining the entanglement Hamiltonian (EH) of an interacting quantum many-body system remains a fundamental challenge beyond special analytically tractable cases. Here we develop an observable-matching framework for learning effective EHs, which we demonstrate using response estimates from quantum Monte Carlo. As applications of this framework, we first calibrate the overall prefactor of the lattice Bisognano--Wichmann (LBW) construction using equal-time correlations and then learn spatially resolved couplings beyond its prescribed profile, without assuming a specific functional form for their spatial dependence. Trained solely on local correlations, the learned EHs reproduce benchmarked von Neumann and second Rényi entropies in 1D and second Rényi entropies in 2D. For a strong-bond cut associated with special surface criticality at the (2+1)D O(3) Wilson--Fisher critical point, free-form learning outperforms the calibrated LBW ansatz in predicting the second Rényi entropy and reveals spatially nonuniform coupling renormalizations. Importantly, the learned EH also provides access to the von Neumann entropy in this setting, revealing a negative subleading correction and extending previous Rényi entropy findings to the von Neumann case. Directly evaluating the von Neumann entropy in such (2+1)D interacting quantum many-body systems remains challenging for conventional numerical methods. These results establish observable-based learning as a route to constructing effective entanglement Hamiltonians beyond prescribed spatial profiles in higher-dimensional interacting systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 确定相互作用量子多体系统的纠缠哈密顿量（EH）是一个基本挑战。本文开发了一种基于可观测量匹配的框架来学习有效EH，并利用量子蒙特卡洛的响应估计进行了验证。该框架首先使用等时关联校准了晶格Bisognano-Wichmann（LBW）构造的整体前因子，然后学习了超出其预设剖面的空间分辨耦合。仅通过局部关联训练的EH在1D和2D中成功再现了冯诺依曼和二阶雷尼熵。研究还发现，在(2+1)D O(3) Wilson-Fisher临界点处，自由形式学习在预测二阶雷尼熵方面优于LBW方法，并揭示了空间非均匀耦合重整化。
authors: Siyi Yang, Yuzhi Liu, Yi-Ming Ding, Zheng Yan

articles.title: Probing Non-Abelian Topology through Quench Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 通过淬火动力学探测非阿贝尔拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07456v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quench dynamics offer valuable insights to topological matter, wherein the emergent topological phenomena serve as a dynamic probe to the topology of static Hamiltonians. While such a practice has been widely applied to detect the Abelian band topology or the Euler-class topology of band nodes, little is known regarding the quench dynamics of non-Abelian topological insulators in multiband systems, where the intertwining geometry of all eigenstates necessitates the description of noncommutative topological charges. Here we propose a quench protocol for non-Abelian topological insulators, so that the underlying topology can be systematically probed using dynamic signatures. Specifically, we develop a band-projection scheme to extract the gap-resolved topology from dynamic skyrmions in the emergent quasimomentum--time manifolds of the quench processes. These skyrmions are characterized by a series of gap-resolved dynamic Chern numbers, which enable us to reconstruct the full non-Abelian topology of the post-quench Hamiltonian, including the global non-Abelian topological charge and edge-state patterns under the open-boundary condition. Our proposal offers dynamical access to non-Abelian topology in multiband systems, and can be readily implemented using photons or cold atoms.
articles.abstract_zh: 淬火动力学为拓扑物质提供了宝贵的见解，但对于多带系统中非阿贝尔拓扑绝缘体的淬火动力学知之甚少。本文提出了一种针对非阿贝尔拓扑绝缘体的淬火协议，旨在利用动态特征系统地探测其潜在拓扑。作者开发了一种能带投影方案，从淬火过程中准动量-时间流形中出现的动态斯格明子中提取间隙分辨的拓扑。这些斯格明子由一系列间隙分辨的动态陈数表征，从而能够重建淬火后哈密顿量的完整非阿贝尔拓扑。
authors: Zhenming Zhang, Tianyu Li, Wei Yi

articles.title: Primitive Quantum Gates for an SU(3) Discrete Subgroup: Σ(216×3)
articles.title_zh: SU(3)离散子群Σ(216×3)的基本量子门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08161v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We construct a primitive gate set for the digital quantum simulation of the 648-element discrete subgroup of SU(3), dsb. The five algorithmic primitives are the inversion, group multiplication, trace, group Fourier transform, and kinetic-phase gates, for which we provide qubit and qutrit--qubit decompositions. For a fiducial shear-viscosity calculation on a 10³ spatial lattice with 50 time steps and a total synthesis-error budget of 10⁻⁸, the estimated fault-tolerant costs are 2.3--6.8×10¹⁰ T gates in the qubit architecture and 1.3--5.9×10¹² R gates in the qutrit--qubit architecture.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为SU(3)的648元离散子群Σ(216×3)的数字量子模拟构建了一套基本门集。这套门集包含反演、群乘法、迹、群傅里叶变换和动能相位门五种算法原语，并提供了它们的量子比特和量子三态-量子比特分解。对于一个在10³空间晶格上进行50个时间步长的剪切粘度计算，且总合成误差预算为10⁻⁸的基准案例，估算的容错成本在量子比特架构中为2.3-6.8×10¹⁰个T门，在量子三态-量子比特架构中为1.3-5.9×10¹²个R门。
authors: Erik J. Gustafson, Henry Lamm, Edison Murairi, Sebastian Osorio Perez

articles.title: Coherent phase slips in coupled rings: from weak to strong interactions
articles.title_zh: 耦合环中的相干相滑移：从弱相互作用到强相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08168v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the coherent transfer of circulation between two weakly coupled lattice rings of ultracold bosons, in which a persistent current initially prepared in one ring oscillates back and forth between the rings without net transfer of particles. Combining Bose--Hubbard simulations with their Gross--Pitaevskii and quantum phase model limits, we show that similar current oscillations arise from two distinct microscopic mechanisms. At weak interactions, particles in each occupied momentum mode tunnel independently between the rings, leading to a transfer time inversely proportional to the inter-ring tunnelling, extensive particle-number fluctuations and entanglement distributed over many Schmidt components; this mode-exchange dynamics is suppressed by self-trapping as the interactions increase. At stronger interactions and large filling, in the phase-dominated regime, circulation is instead transferred through a second-order collective process between many-body persistent-current states, with a transfer time scaling as the inverse square of the inter-ring tunnelling in the weak-link limit. Number fluctuations then remain of order one instead of growing with the particle number, and within each number sector the system evolves into coherent superpositions of two many-body configurations, distinguished by which ring carries the circulation. The entanglement accessible under number-conserving operations therefore reaches up to approximately one bit. We propose a quench protocol to prepare the initial state and estimate transfer times within reach of current ring-lattice experiments, identifying coupled rings as a platform to study coherent quantum phase slips and to manipulate persistent-current states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了超冷玻色子两个弱耦合晶格环之间环流的相干转移，其中一个环中初始制备的持久电流在两环之间来回振荡，而没有净粒子转移。结合玻色-哈伯德模拟及其格罗斯-皮塔耶夫斯基和量子相模型极限，研究揭示了相似的电流振荡源于两种不同的微观机制。在弱相互作用下，粒子通过独立的模式交换动力学进行隧穿；而在强相互作用和高填充度下，环流通过多体持久电流态之间的二阶集体过程进行转移。
authors: Axel Perez-Obiol, Malcolm G. Boshier, Luigi Amico, Juan Polo

articles.title: Atomic Static Electric Quadrupole Polarizability from Relativistic Many-Body Theory With Application To Thulium łeft(6s², 4f¹³i̊ght), ²F₇/₂ and ²F₅/₂
articles.title_zh: 基于相对论多体理论的原子静态电四极极化率及其在镱原子中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08348v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In the present work a method for calculating atomic static electric rank-n tensor quadrupole polarizabilities α_Q⁽ⁿ⁾(J) for arbitrary atomic electronic structure is presented. It is based on a linear-symmetry representation of atomic states using large-scale relativistic configuration interaction wavefunctions, and the quadrupole polarizabilities are obtained by a sum-over-states approach. The major result from applying this method to atomic thulium is α_Q⁽⁰⁾(frac72) = 2496⁺⁰₋₂₃₁ au for the electronic ground term ²F₇/₂ static electric scalar quadrupole polarizability which is roughly a factor of four smaller than same property in the electronic ground state of the cesium atom. This finding adds to the favorable properties of thulium atoms in atomic-clock research.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种计算任意原子电子结构静态电n阶张量四极极化率α_Q⁽ⁿ⁾(J)的方法。该方法基于原子态的线性对称表示，并利用大规模相对论组态相互作用波函数，通过态求和法获得四极极化率。将此方法应用于镱原子，主要结果是其电子基态²F₇/₂的静态电标量四极极化率α_Q⁽⁰⁾(7/2)为2496⁺⁰₋₂₃₁ au，约为铯原子基态相同性质的四分之一。这一发现进一步凸显了镱原子在原子钟研究中的优势。
authors: Timo Fleig

articles.title: Dynamical effects induced by synthetic SU(1,1) gauge fields
articles.title_zh: 合成SU(1,1)规范场引起的动力学效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08447v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Compact gauge fields are powerful tools for controlling quantum dynamics and topological phases of matter. Non-compact gauge fields are particularly relevant for open systems, where particles or energy are exchanged with the environment. Here, we investigate the wavepacket and entanglement dynamics induced by an SU(1,1) gauge field. The wavepacket undergoes non-Abelian non-compact Bloch oscillations, in which the spectrum of an auxiliary one-dimensional quantum problem determines the transition between stable oscillations and unstable amplification. In the unstable adiabatic regime, the wavepacket probes an SU(1,1) topological defect, and its amplification is determined solely by a hyperbolic solid angle in Minkowski space. Threading an SU(1,1) gauge field through a bosonic tight-binding model yields the bosonic Kitaev model, whose volume or super-volume entanglement scaling is governed by the stability of the gauge field. We further propose an experimental realization of an SU(1,1) gauge field in a spinor condensate. Our results can be generalized to other non-compact groups and higher dimensions, providing a geometric framework for entanglement control, selective amplification, and engineering energy transfer.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了由SU(1,1)规范场引起的波包和纠缠动力学。波包经历了非阿贝尔非紧致布洛赫振荡，其稳定性和放大行为由辅助量子问题的谱和闵可夫斯基空间中的双曲立体角决定。将SU(1,1)规范场引入玻色子紧束缚模型，产生了玻色子Kitaev模型，其纠缠标度受规范场稳定性的控制。研究还提出了在旋量凝聚体中实现SU(1,1)规范场的实验方案，为非紧致群和高维系统提供了几何框架。
authors: Chenwei Lv

articles.title: Principles of Quantum Communication Theory: A Modern Approach
articles.title_zh: 量子通信理论原理：一种现代方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2011.04672v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This is a preliminary version of a book in progress on the theory of quantum communication. We adopt an information-theoretic perspective throughout and give a comprehensive account of fundamental results in quantum communication theory from the past decade (and earlier), with an emphasis on the modern one-shot-to-asymptotic approach that underlies much of today's state-of-the-art research in this field. In Part I, we cover mathematical preliminaries and provide a detailed study of quantum mechanics from an information-theoretic perspective. We also provide an extensive and thorough review of quantum entropies, and we devote an entire chapter to the study of entanglement measures. Equipped with these essential tools, in Part II we study classical communication (with and without entanglement assistance), entanglement distillation, quantum communication, secret key distillation, and private communication. In Part III, we cover the latest developments in feedback-assisted communication tasks, such as quantum and classical feedback-assisted communication, LOCC-assisted quantum communication, and secret key agreement.
articles.abstract_zh: 本书是关于量子通信理论的初步版本，采用信息论视角，全面阐述了过去十年（及更早）量子通信理论的基础成果，并强调了现代的“一次性到渐近”方法。第一部分涵盖数学预备知识、信息论视角的量子力学以及量子熵和纠缠度量。第二部分研究经典通信、纠缠蒸馏、量子通信、秘密密钥蒸馏和私密通信。第三部分则探讨了反馈辅助通信任务的最新进展。
authors: Sumeet Khatri, Ludovico Lami, Mark M. Wilde

articles.title: Enhanced quantum sensing mediated by a cavity in open systems
articles.title_zh: 开放系统中腔介导的增强型量子传感
articles.abstract: arXiv:2312.04766v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We simulate the dynamics of systems with multiple qubits coupled to a cavity in order to assess their potential for quantum metrology of a parameter in the open systems limit. The qubits and the cavity are both allowed to have losses and the system is studied under various coupling strength regimes. The focus is primarily on the coupling between the qubits using the quantum Fisher information as the measured parameter. Some results on estimating the qubit-cavity detuning parameter are also presented. We investigate the scaling of the uncertainty in the estimate of the qubit-cavity coupling with the number of qubits and for different initial states of the qubits that act as the quantum probe. As initial probe states, we consider Dicke states with varying excitation numbers, the GHZ state, and separable X-polarized states. It is shown that in the strong coupling regime, i.e., when the coupling between the qubits and the cavity is greater than the decay parameters of both the qubits and the cavity, Dicke states with a large excitation number can achieve the Heisenberg limit, with the precision scaling improving as the excitation number increases. A particularly intriguing finding of our study is that in the weak coupling regime, as well as in situations where either the qubit or cavity decay parameters exceed the coupling, the separable X-polarized state is the best in terms of scaling and exhibits strongly superlinear, and in some regimes near-quadratic, finite-size QFI scaling over the system sizes considered.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文模拟了多量子比特与腔耦合系统的动力学，以评估其在开放系统极限下进行量子计量学的潜力。研究考虑了量子比特和腔的损耗，并在不同耦合强度下进行分析，主要关注使用量子费舍尔信息作为测量参数的量子比特间耦合。结果表明，在强耦合区域，即量子比特与腔的耦合大于两者的衰减参数时，具有大量激发数的迪克态可以达到海森堡极限，且精度随激发数增加而提高。
authors: Quinn Langfitt, Zain H. Saleem, Michael Perlin, Tian Zhong, Anil Shaji, Stephen K. Gray

articles.title: Hybrid Oscillator-Qubit Quantum Processors: Simulating Fermions, Bosons, and Gauge Fields
articles.title_zh: 混合振子-量子比特量子处理器：模拟费米子、玻色子和规范场
articles.abstract: arXiv:2409.03747v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Key to solving many societally-relevant problems in materials science, quantum chemistry and nuclear physics is understanding their fundamental microscopic quantum behaviour. All of these problems can be phrased as fermionic (e.g. electrons) and bosonic particles (e.g. lattice vibrations, photons) interacting with each other. However, solving these systems of strongly-interacting fermions and bosons is out of reach for classical computers and also non-error-corrected qubit-only quantum computers. In this paper, we introduce a hybrid qubit and bosonic-oscillator quantum-simulation framework, which is so efficient that it could simulate some of these strongly-correlated problems even without error correction. Specifically, we leverage the available universal bosonic gate set with O(1) operations per gate as a function of the bosonic cutoff. This enables our framework to provide exact decompositions of higher-order fermion-boson interactions, including notoriously challenging terms such as (2+1)D gauge theories. We show how to compile dynamics, ancilla-free partial error detection, non-local observable measurement, and ground state energy estimation using both qubit-boson variational quantum eigensolvers and quantum signal processing. We introduce a "post-qubit quantum advantage" experiment which is both out of reach of near-term qubit-only quantum computers and classical computers. We develop a new qubit-based algorithm for simulating a beamsplitter which scales as almost-linear with boson number cutoff Nmax, asymptotically outperforming previously-known qubit methods. Our framework can be used in superconducting, as well as trapped-ion and neutral-atom hardware. This work establishes digital hybrid qubit-boson quantum simulation as a promising and advantageous method for solving the many challenging strongly correlated fermion-boson models of relevance to science and technology.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种混合量子比特和玻色子振子量子模拟框架，其效率足以在没有纠错的情况下模拟强关联问题。该框架利用通用的玻色子门集，实现了高阶费米子-玻色子相互作用的精确分解，包括具有挑战性的(2+1)D规范理论。该方法还涵盖了动力学编译、无辅助部分错误检测、非局域可观测量测量以及基态计算。
authors: Eleanor Crane, Kevin C. Smith, Teague Tomesh, Alec Eickbusch, John M. Martyn, Stefan Kühn, Lena Funcke, Michael Austin DeMarco, Isaac L. Chuang, Nathan Wiebe, Alexander Schuckert, Steven M. Girvin

articles.title: Trotterization, Operator Scrambling, and Entanglement
articles.title_zh: Trotter化、算符混淆与纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.23345v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Operator scrambling describes how initially local operators spread under many-body dynamics and is closely connected to quantum chaos. In this work, we reveal a connection between operator scrambling and the reliability of quantum simulations. We show that the Trotter error in an observable expectation value is bounded by a scrambling correlator between the evolved observable and the multiplicative Trotter error operator. This bound retains the dependence on both the input state and the observable. We then derive entanglement-based bounds showing that sufficient entanglement brings both the observable and error-operator factors in the bound to their normalized Frobenius scales. This indicates that, for observables that are normalized sums of local Pauli terms, the leading system-size dependence of the upper bound may be reduced from O(N) to O(1) relative to the spectral-norm estimate in systems undergoing entanglement growth and quantum thermalization. Even when the evolving state is weakly entangled, the effective states generated by the observable or error operator can have larger subsystem entanglement, thereby improving the error bound. Our results clarify the fundamental connection between Trotterization, scrambling, and entanglement, and provide refined guarantees for quantum simulation of many-body dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文揭示了算符混淆与量子模拟可靠性之间的联系，表明可观测量的Trotter误差受演化可观测量与乘性Trotter误差算符之间混淆关联器的限制。研究进一步推导了基于纠缠的界限，指出在经历纠缠增长和量子热化的系统中，对于某些可观测量，上限的主要系统尺寸依赖性可能从O(N)降低到O(1)。
authors: Tianfeng Feng, Yue Cao, Qi Zhao

articles.title: Quantum Kicked Top: A Paradigmatic Model
articles.title_zh: 量子受击陀螺：一个范式模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.12345v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The quantum kicked top (QKT) is one of the most widely studied models in quantum chaos, providing a minimal yet powerful framework for exploring the relationship between classical nonlinear dynamics and quantum behavior. Unlike many chaotic systems with infinite-dimensional Hilbert spaces, the QKT possesses a finite-dimensional Hilbert space, making it analytically and numerically controllable while still showing a rich dynamical phenomena. In this chapter, we present a comprehensive introduction to the QKT as a paradigmatic model of quantum chaos. Starting from the classical kicked top, we derive the discrete nonlinear map governing the dynamics on the unit sphere and analyze its phase space structure through fixed points, stability analysis, bifurcations and Lyapunov exponents. We then discuss the role of symmetries, including rotational and time-reversal symmetry, and how their breaking modifies the dynamics. The quantum description is developed using Floquet theory, where the periodically driven spin system is represented by a unitary Floquet operator acting on a (2j+1)-dimensional Hilbert space. Within this framework, signatures of quantum chaos such as spectral statistics, entanglement generation and recurrences are discussed. The model also admits an interpretation as a system of interacting qubits, enabling explicit few-qubit realizations and direct connections with quantum information measures through reduced density matrices and entanglement entropy. By linking classical phase space structures with quantum dynamical indicators, the QKT provides a clear setting to investigate the emergence of chaotic behavior in the semiclassical limit. The chapter, therefore, highlights the quantum kicked top as a bridge between nonlinear classical dynamics, quantum chaos and modern quantum information science.
articles.abstract_zh: 本章全面介绍了量子受击陀螺（QKT）作为量子混沌的范式模型。文章首先从经典受击陀螺出发，分析其相空间结构和对称性。随后，利用Floquet理论发展了量子描述，展示了其在有限维希尔伯特空间中可控且丰富的动力学现象，使其成为研究经典非线性动力学与量子行为关系的强大框架。
authors: Avadhut V. Purohit, Udaysinh T. Bhosale

articles.title: High-performance cellular automaton decoders for quantum repetition and toric code
articles.title_zh: 用于量子重复码和环面码的高性能元胞自动机解码器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.21866v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Execution of quantum algorithms on large-scale quantum computers will require extremely low logical error rates and scalable decoding architectures. Local decoders are promising candidates for this task because they avoid the communication and data-processing bottlenecks inherent in global decoding strategies. Here, we present SCALA (Signaling CA with Local Attraction), a non-hierarchical cellular automaton decoder for quantum repetition and toric codes, and compare it with the hierarchical CA decoder proposed by Harrington. SCALA combines constant local memory and simple nearest-neighbor signaling with a system-size-dependent global reset schedule. We find a code-capacity threshold estimate of p_csimeq7.40(5)% and sub-threshold scaling approaching p_Lpropto pd/⁴ for the toric code. For the finite system sizes accessible numerically, and despite numerical evidence for the absence of a finite critical threshold, SCALA also provides strong logical-error suppression under phenomenological noise while retaining its low local computational overhead. SCALA furthermore remains robust when its internal signals are themselves noisy. Together with its simple local dynamics, this makes SCALA particularly interesting for low-overhead real-time decoding and motivates its exploration as a quantum cellular automaton for measurement-free quantum error correction.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种名为SCALA（具有局部吸引力的信号元胞自动机）的非分层元胞自动机解码器，用于量子重复码和环面码。SCALA在环面码上实现了约7.40(5)%的码容量阈值估计，并在现象学噪声下表现出强大的逻辑错误抑制能力。该解码器具有较低的局部计算开销，并且对内部信号噪声具有鲁棒性。
authors: Don Winter, Thiago L. M. Guedes, Markus Müller

articles.title: General method for obtaining the energy minimum of spin Hamiltonians for separable states
articles.title_zh: 获取可分离态自旋哈密顿量能量最小值的一般方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.03022v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce a highly general method to determine the energy minimum of spin Hamiltonians over separable states when the single-particle reduced density matrices are fixed. We present efficient numerical methods that reduce the problem to calculations in a two-particle system. For a broad class of very general spin models, we present analytic formulas for the minimum. For ferromagnetic Ising and Ising-like models of spin-j particles, the minimum over separable states on two-colorable lattices, and over symmetric separable states on fully connected graphs, is given by a compact analytic formula involving the quantum Fisher information. For antiferromagnetic Ising-like and XY-like models of spin j-particles living on a complete graph, the energy minimum for symmetric separable states is given with the expectation value of single-particle operators. For the ferromagnetic Heisenberg chain of spin-1/2 particles, the minimum is expressed via the Uhlmann-Jozsa fidelity. These relations enable the extraction of the quantum Fisher information and quantum fidelity of the corresponding single-particle reduced states from correlation measurements on ground-state ensembles of suitably engineered spin models. For a number of other models, we obtain not necessarily tight lower bounds. We also present bounds for various levels of multiparticle entanglement.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种确定在固定单粒子约化密度矩阵下，可分离态自旋哈密顿量能量最小值的高度通用方法。该方法通过高效的数值计算将问题简化为双粒子系统。对于广泛的自旋模型，文章给出了能量最小值的解析公式，并揭示了其与量子Fisher信息和Uhlmann-Jozsa保真度之间的联系。
authors: Géza Tóth, József Pitrik

articles.title: A hardware-efficient variational ansatz with an exact diagonal metric for real- and imaginary-time evolution and Haar sampling
articles.title_zh: 一种具有精确对角度量的硬件高效变分Ansatz，用于实虚时间演化和Haar采样
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07942v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Variational quantum algorithms depend on the geometry of their parametrised circuits: metric-aware optimisation and time evolution require the Fubini--Study metric, which has hitherto demanded costly auxiliary measurements and ill-conditioned inversions. This work introduces a hardware-efficient n-qubit ansatz, which parametrises states by a binary tree and whose Hilbert-space pullback metric is diagonal in closed form. Quantum natural gradient on the tree parameters, variational imaginary- and real-time evolution, and exact unitary-invariant (Haar) sampling on a symmetry sector run with no auxiliary metric circuits or matrix inversion. When the target state is supported on a subspace of k computational-basis states, the redundant tree parameters carry a gauge freedom a pruning compiler converts into circuits whose two-qubit count provably grows linearly in k; a variant reaches near-optimal O(nk/łog n) scaling with the closed-form metric intact. On electronic-structure calculations for small molecules and half-filled Hubbard quench dynamics, the method reaches reference-level accuracy with one to three orders of magnitude fewer two-qubit gates than leading alternatives. Interchangeable constructions (a Schur-transform dressing or internal reparameterisations) make the ansatz exactly spin-adapted, with fixed total spin at every parameter and no penalty terms. The bare ansatz is an exactly controllable, well-conditioned and barren-plateau-free primitive for preparing and sampling sector states: on its own, it is classically simulable in k (a boundary proved for a general class of sector-sparse ansätze); composed with a classically hard dressing, it yields molecular ground states, sector-Haar benchmarking, thermal correlators, and exact effective Hamiltonians trained from energy measurements alone, with the composed circuit carrying the potential for quantum advantage.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种硬件高效的n量子比特变分Ansatz，通过二叉树参数化量子态，并获得了闭合形式的对角希尔伯特空间回拉度量。这使得量子自然梯度、变分虚时间演化、实时间演化以及精确的酉不变（Haar）采样无需昂贵的辅助测量或矩阵求逆。该方法在电子结构计算和Hubbard淬火动力学中，以显著减少的双量子比特门数量达到了参考级精度。
authors: Dario Picozzi

articles.title: Negative quasiprobability trajectories for Bell-diagonal states under local decoherence
articles.title_zh: 局域退相干下贝尔对角态的负拟概率轨迹
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.16358v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The fluctuation theorem (FT) relates microscopic trajectory distributions to macroscopic averages. Using quasiprobability trajectories, this framework has recently been extended to quantum information dynamics. Despite sharing the form of conventional thermodynamic FTs, information FTs involve quasiprobabilities whose negativity and statistical properties remain poorly understood. In this work, we analytically determine the properties of negative distributions for two-qubit Bell-diagonal states evolving under local dephasing, depolarizing, and amplitude-damping channels, under the fixed local computational basis. We show that the occurrence of negative quasiprobabilities is not determined by the entanglement or Bell nonlocality of the initial state. For these channels, a diagonal-interference decomposition identifies a nonnegative reference contribution and yields channel-dependent interference bounds. More importantly, we prove that quasiprobability distributions containing negative weights can violate Horváth's necessary and sufficient criterion for the Jensen-Steffensen inequality to hold for every continuous convex function, even though the specific exponential Jensen-like relation enforced by the FT and the quantum data-processing inequality remains valid. This trajectory-level contrast with classical stochastic descriptions reveals a distinctive feature of quantum information dynamics that is invisible when only the corresponding average-level information inequalities are considered.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文分析确定了在局域退相干、去极化和振幅阻尼信道下，双量子比特贝尔对角态负拟概率分布的性质。研究表明，负拟概率的出现并非由纠缠或贝尔非局域性决定。更重要的是，文章证明了包含负权重的拟概率分布可以违反Horváth关于Jensen-Steffensen不等式的必要充分准则，从而加深了对信息涨落定理的理解。
authors: Qing Yu, Kun Zhang, Yang-Yang Chen, Xiao-Hui Wang

articles.title: Lee-Yang theorem for fermions
articles.title_zh: 费米子的Lee-Yang定理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.23942v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Lee-Yang theorems are a powerful tool for studying many-body systems, with applications ranging from analyzing phase transitions to proving the efficiency of certain classical and quantum algorithms. In this work, we prove a Lee-Yang zero-freeness theorem for the partition function of a broad class of interacting fermion models, implying the existence of a provably efficient quantum algorithm for estimating their ground-state energies. This class includes several well-known models such as the attractive Hubbard model, repulsive Hubbard model on bipartite graphs, and the interacting Hofstadter model. Our results also rigorously establish the nonexistence of phase transitions in these models in the presence of a nonzero local external field.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了广泛的相互作用费米子模型配分函数的Lee-Yang无零点定理。这一结果意味着存在一种可证明高效的量子算法，用于估计这些模型的基态能量。此外，研究还严格确立了在存在非零局域外场的情况下，这些模型中不存在相变。
authors: Chaithanya Rayudu, Takahiro Misawa, Andrew Zhao, Jun Takahashi

articles.title: Leakage suppression for high-fidelity exchange gates and quantum simulation in superconducting circuits
articles.title_zh: 超导电路中高保真度交换门和量子模拟的泄漏抑制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.37296v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Parametric frequency modulation makes superconducting interactions programmable for quantum gates and quantum simulation. Leakage into higher transmon levels and coupler modes degrades gate fidelity and takes simulated dynamics outside the intended state space. Simple pulse shaping reduces off-resonant excitation, while strong coupling and short pulses demand simultaneous control of multiple leakage pathways. Controlling these pathways across individual exchange operations and simultaneous couplings is essential for fast gates and faithful programmable dynamics. We introduce parametric derivative removal by adiabatic gate (PDRAG), combining derivative shaping and finite-pulse calibration for qubit and coupler modulation. At an interqubit coupling of g/2π=100 MHz, simulations demonstrate 13-ns exchange operations, approaching the timescale of fast single-qubit gates. Combined with calibrated phase accumulation, these pulses realize a two-parameter fSim gate family with infidelity below 1.8×10⁻⁷. For quantum simulation, PDRAG suppresses leakage and improves fidelity in continuous and digital Floquet simulations of Su--Schrieffer--Heeger chains. Floquet analysis identifies finite-pulse return interference as the calibration mechanism; realistic-circuit transfer preserves suppression. PDRAG establishes a unified framework spanning quantum gates and quantum simulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种通过绝热门进行参数导数去除（PDRAG）的方法，用于超导电路中的泄漏抑制。PDRAG结合了导数整形和有限脉冲校准，以实现量子比特和耦合器的调制。模拟结果显示，该方法实现了13纳秒的交换操作，失真度低于1.8×10⁻⁷，并显著提高了连续和数字Floquet模拟的保真度。
authors: Yiwen Li, Xinsheng Tan, Yang Yu

articles.title: Optimal expansion in unitary groups I: Golden adelic groups and cutoff
articles.title_zh: 酉群中的最优扩张 I：黄金adelic群和截止现象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.09047v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this paper and its companion [DEP2] we construct and study special generating sets for p-arithmetic unitary Lie groups, extending the seminal works of Lubotzky, Phillips and Sarnak to higher dimensions. The real embeddings of our sets form optimal topological generators for compact unitary Lie groups, and their p-adic embeddings give rise to Cayley graphs and complexes over finite unitary groups, which exhibit the cutoff phenomenon. In the current paper we prove two main results: First, we construct p-arithmetic lattices in PU₄ and PU₈ which act transitively on their corresponding Bruhat-Tits buildings. These groups are used to construct Golden Gate sets on two and three qubits, which have optimal circuit length and efficient compiling algorithms. Second, we study the cutoff phenomenon for quotients of the Bruhat-Tits building of a general semisimple p-adic group. We show that cutoff occurs for quotients which satisfy either the Ramanujan property or the weaker Sarnak-Xue Density Hypothesis (SXDH). For this purpose we bound the operator norms of a large class of Hecke operators in terms of the rate of decay of unitary representations. In the companion paper [DEP2], we prove such a SXDH result for unitary groups.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建并研究了p-算术酉李群的特殊生成集，将其作为紧致酉李群的最优拓扑生成元，并产生了表现出截止现象的有限酉群上的Cayley图和复形。研究构建了PU₄和PU₈中的p-算术格，用于量子比特上的黄金门集，并探讨了Bruhat-Tits建筑商的商的截止现象。
authors: Rahul Dalal, Shai Evra, Ori Parzanchevski

articles.title: Ising anyons in the SU(2)₂ Chern--Simons theory
articles.title_zh: SU(2)₂ Chern-Simons理论中的Ising任意子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.15268v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Ising anyons and SU(2)₂ Chern--Simons theory share the fusion rules and F-symbols, and their R-symbols agree up to braiding orientation and an overall phase. The quantum-group description, U_q(mathfraksl₂₎ at q = eⁱπ/⁴, is nevertheless not semisimple: tensor powers of the fundamental representation contain an additional spin-3/2 representation and reducible indecomposable representations, all of zero quantum dimension. We construct explicit highest-weight bases for up to four strands, compute the Racah and braiding matrices, and show that for four strands changes of fusion basis and braiding mix the physical sector with an indecomposable summand. We prove that this mixing affects neither the braid-closure invariant nor the plat-closure amplitude for any number of strands, so that each braiding matrix can be replaced by its physical block. The full representation theory thus reproduces the Ising-anyon data for all observables relevant to topological quantum computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了Ising任意子与SU(2)₂ Chern-Simons理论，指出它们共享融合规则和F-符号。尽管其量子群描述U_q(sl₂)在q = eⁱπ/⁴处非半单，但研究构建了显式最高权重基并计算了Racah和编织矩阵。文章证明，物理扇区与不可分解扇区之间的混合不影响编织闭合不变量或平板闭合振幅，从而为拓扑量子计算的可观测量再现了Ising任意子数据。
authors: Artem Belov, Andrey Morozov

articles.title: Topological metal-insulator transitions in one-dimensional non-Hermitian quasicrystals: beyond PT-symmetry
articles.title_zh: 一维非厄米准晶中的拓扑金属-绝缘体相变：超越PT对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.25072v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: One-dimensional non-Hermitian quasicrystals with parity and time-reversal (PT) symmetry can simultaneously exhibit localization-delocalization transition, topological phase transition, and PT-symmetry-breaking transition. This motivates us to investigate how the absence of PT symmetry impacts topological metal-insulator transitions in non-Hermitian quasicrystals. We propose a non-Hermitian quasiperiodic model that generally does not preserve PT-symmetry but, in most parameter regions, hosts a generic triple-transition scenario encompassing localization, topological, and degeneracy-breaking transitions. These transitions can be understood within the dual momentum-space representation featuring asymmetric couplings. Specifically, the localization boundary is obtained from the dual momentum-space representation by comparing the Lyapunov exponent, or inverse localization length, of the reciprocal Aubry-André model with the nonreciprocal hopping-asymmetry ratio of the dual lattice. The accompanying topological transition is characterized by a point-gap winding number defined with respect to a reference energy inside the complex spectral gap, whereas the degeneracy-breaking transition is understood from the loss of the reciprocal nłeftrightarrow -n spectral symmetry. The system also exhibits a localization-delocalization transition analogous to that in the Hermitian case, which occurs without accompanying topological or degeneracy-breaking transitions. Our work extends the topological metal-insulator transitions previously studied in PT-symmetric systems to a more general class of non-Hermitian setting, and further reveals that non-Hermitian systems can host distinct types of localization behavior.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一维非厄米准晶中超越PT对称性的拓扑金属-绝缘体相变。研究提出了一个非厄米准周期模型，该模型在大多数参数区域展现出局域化、拓扑和简并破缺的三重相变情景。这些相变可以通过具有不对称耦合的双动量空间表示来理解，其中局域化边界和拓扑相变由Lyapunov指数和点隙缠绕数表征。
authors: Guangjie Zhang, Bing Shao, Longwen Zhou, Jiangbin Gong, Weiwei Zhu

articles.title: Entanglement in Presence of Topological Interfaces and Dualities
articles.title_zh: 拓扑界面和对偶性存在下的纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.22451v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Entanglement through interfaces has attracted considerable attention in 2d conformal field theory (CFT). However, it is known that field-theoretic predictions based on the existing framework are in general incompatible with numerical results [1-4]. A new framework for entanglement through topological defects was recently proposed in [5]. It provides a general description of entanglement through topological defects and successfully reproduces the numerical results for the Ising model in all tested cases and regimes. The key insight is that the relevant quantum correlations are encoded in twisted states, allowing for the construction of the full reduced density matrix (RDM). In this work we pursue two objectives. First, we provide new examples by studying defects in the free boson CFT. Second, we extend the framework to topological interfaces connecting two, possibly distinct, CFTs. Of particular interest are interfaces relating dual theories. We show that the reduced density matrix for a duality interface is the projection of the vacuum reduced density matrix onto a single symmetry sector, closely paralleling the framework of symmetry resolution. Unlike symmetry resolution, however, the projection is imposed by the physical interface itself, demonstrating that duality interfaces reflect quantum correlations back into the entangling interval. We establish this mechanism for diagonal and non-diagonal rational CFTs as well as the free boson CFT. Relative entropy allows us to quantify the distinguishability of the duality interface RDM from the vacuum RDM.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维共形场论（CFT）中通过界面的纠缠研究面临理论预测与数值结果不兼容的问题。本工作旨在扩展一个新框架，该框架通过扭曲态编码量子关联并成功重现了伊辛模型的数值结果。研究首先通过自由玻色子CFT中的缺陷提供新示例，其次将其推广到连接两个不同CFT的拓扑界面，特别是涉及对偶理论的界面。结果表明，对偶性界面的约化密度矩阵是真空约化密度矩阵在单一对称性扇区上的投影。
authors: Christian Northe, Riccardo Poletti, Paolo Rossi

articles.title: Universal Negative Correlation between Nonreciprocity and Superconducting Transition Width in FeTe-Based Heterostructures
articles.title_zh: FeTe基异质结构中非互易性与超导转变宽度之间的普适负相关
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07116v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonreciprocal charge transport in noncentrosymmetric superconductors probes broken symmetries and superconducting fluctuations and underpins the superconducting diode effect. Despite extensive studies, the factors governing its magnitude remain unclear. In this work, we use molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) to synthesize a broad family of FeTe-based superconducting heterostructures with top layers spanning topologically trivial versus nontrivial, layered versus nonlayered, and magnetic versus nonmagnetic materials. Through systematic first- and second-harmonic transport measurements, we find that the magnetochiral anisotropy coefficient γ is insensitive to the top-layer crystal structure, lattice constant, thickness, topology, and magnetism, but exhibits a negative correlation with the superconducting transition width Δ T. Control measurements on superconducting stoichiometric FeTe films reveal much weaker nonreciprocity, confirming the essential role of interfacial inversion-symmetry breaking. Combined with a disorder-based theoretical model, our results establish a universal relationship: for comparable inversion-symmetry breaking, reduced interfacial disorder sharpens the superconducting transition and strongly enhances nonreciprocal transport in the Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) transition regime. These findings identify Δ T as a unifying parameter governing nonreciprocity across FeTe-based heterostructures, reconcile previously disparate observations, and establish a general framework for engineering enhanced nonreciprocal superconducting responses and exploring superconducting diode effects in nonlinear quantum devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 非中心对称超导体中的非互易电荷输运是超导二极管效应的基础，但其影响因素尚不明确。本研究通过分子束外延制备了多种FeTe基超导异质结构，并系统测量了其输运特性。结果表明，磁手性各向异性系数γ与顶层材料的多种结构和物理性质无关，但与超导转变宽度ΔT呈负相关。结合基于无序的理论模型，本工作揭示了在相似反演对称性破缺条件下，非互易性与超导转变宽度之间存在普适的负相关关系。
authors: Annie G. Wang, Saswata Mandal, Zi-Jie Yan, Bomin Zhang, Xiaoda Liu, Hongtao Rong, Deyi Zhuo, Pu Xiao, Lok-Kan Lai, Zhiyuan Xi, Ke Wang, Chao-Xing Liu, Cui-Zu Chang

articles.title: Barlow Packings All Have Maximum Packing Fraction: Why it is so Hard to Find Barlow Structures Other than fcc or hcp?
articles.title_zh: 巴洛堆积都具有最大堆积密度：为什么除了fcc或hcp之外很难找到其他巴洛结构？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07197v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We apply lattice theory to periodic Barlow packings (X₁X₂dots XN)ᵢₙfₜy where XᵢinA,B,C and Xᵢ≠ Xᵢ₊₁, formed by stacking two-dimensional hexagonal close-packed layers, interacting via generalized (n,m)-Lennard-Jones potentials. The cohesive energies of all packings lie between those of hexagonal close-packed (hcp, (AB)) and face-centered cubic (fcc, (ABC)) structure and vary almost linearly with the fcc stacking fraction. The equilibrium lattice constant, bulk modulus, Einstein frequency, and vibrational entropy show similarly near-linear trends. For the standard (12,6) potential, fcc has the highest vibrational entropy and hcp the lowest, with other Barlow packings falling between them, consistent with previous sticky-hard-sphere Monte Carlo simulations and supported by phonon dispersion calculations. These trends imply an approximately linear dependence of free energy on fcc stacking fraction, with hcp and fcc as endpoints. This provides a simple thermodynamic explanation for why intermediate Barlow stackings are rare in nature: near-linearity offers little driving force to favor them. Exceptions may arise when hcp and fcc are nearly degenerate in energy or when many-body interactions, absent from the present model, favor another stacking. Density-functional calculations including dispersion forces for argon Barlow packings with periods N=2,3,4, and 12 corroborate the predicted near-linear cohesive energy dependence.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究利用晶格理论分析了周期性巴洛堆积，发现其内聚能介于密排六方（hcp）和面心立方（fcc）结构之间，并与fcc堆积分数呈近似线性关系。平衡晶格常数、体模量、爱因斯坦频率和振动熵也呈现类似的线性趋势。这些趋势表明自由能与fcc堆积分数近似线性相关，hcp和fcc是其端点。这为中间巴洛堆积在自然界中罕见提供了一个简单的热力学解释。
authors: Andres Robles-Navarro, Shaun Cooper, Alex Travesset, Peter Schwerdtfeger

articles.title: Interfacial polarity control of anomalous Hall effect in LaCoO3-SrIrO3 heterostructures
articles.title_zh: LaCoO3-SrIrO3异质结构中界面极性对反常霍尔效应的调控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07501v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interfacial polarity in oxide heterostructures can drive robust charge redistribution across the interface, yet its role in tailoring topological transport phenomena like the anomalous Hall effect (AHE) remains largely unexplored. Here, we control the sign of polarity-induced charge in SrIrO3-LaCoO3 interfaces by independently engineering the layer stacking sequence and the atomic termination. In-situ angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy directly confirms the sign reversal of the induced charge in SrIrO3 through the contrasting electronic band shifts between different interfacial configurations. Magneto-transport measurements across a systematic matrix of four distinct heterostructures reveal that the AHE can be cleanly toggled on and off: it emerges exclusively under electron-doped conditions, while remaining suppressed for hole-doped SrIrO3. Our results establish that this response originates from an intrinsic, Berry-curvature-driven mechanism governed by polarity-controlled band filling of SrIrO3. These findings shift interfacial polarity from a passive structural consequence to an active design variable for engineering topological quantum states in oxide heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 氧化物异质结构中的界面极性可导致界面处显著的电荷再分布，但其在调控反常霍尔效应（AHE）等拓扑输运现象中的作用尚不明确。本研究通过独立设计层堆叠顺序和原子终止，控制了SrIrO3-LaCoO3界面中极性诱导电荷的符号。磁输运测量表明，AHE仅在电子掺杂条件下出现，而在空穴掺杂SrIrO3中被抑制。这些结果表明，AHE响应源于由极性控制的SrIrO3能带填充所驱动的本征贝里曲率机制，将界面极性从被动结构效应转变为工程拓扑现象的主动设计变量。
authors: Yeonjae Lee, Chanyoung Shin, Youngdo Kim, Jinyoung Kim, Jaeung Lee, Miyoung Kim, Sangjae Lee, Changyoung Kim

articles.title: Ultrafast Moiré Exciton Dynamics Revealed by Two-Dimensional Coherent Spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 二维相干光谱揭示超快莫尔激子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07539v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Moiré superlattices of van der Waals heterostructures confine excitons into discrete energy levels in finite-sized samples, yet their internal relaxation pathways remain obscured by inhomogeneous broadening. Here, using two-dimensional coherent spectroscopy (2DCS), we directly resolve seven discrete energy levels of the moiré-confined intralayer WS₂ A exciton in an hBN-encapsulated WS₂/WSe₂ heterostructure, corresponding to a confinement depth of 57.02 meV. By tracking the population of these levels over picosecond delays, we uncover a two-stage thermalization process: an effective exciton temperature drops from 171.8 to 99.3 K within 1.2 ps through rapid intra-manifold population redistribution, followed by a slower recovery toward quasi-equilibrium mediated by exciton--environment interactions. Kullback--Leibler divergence analysis confirms the progressive transition from a non-equilibrium to a Boltzmann-distributed population. Our results establish state-resolved access to moiré exciton dynamics and provide a foundation for exploring nonequilibrium many-body phenomena in moiré quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 范德华异质结构中的莫尔超晶格将激子限制在离散能级中，但其内部弛豫路径因非均匀展宽而难以观测。本研究利用二维相干光谱（2DCS）直接分辨了hBN封装的WS₂/WSe₂异质结构中莫尔限制的层内WS₂ A激子的七个离散能级。通过追踪这些能级在皮秒延迟下的布居，揭示了一个两阶段热弛豫过程。这些结果为研究莫尔激子动力学和非平衡多体现象提供了基础。
authors: Deran Zhang, Zhexue Chen, Dongxue Chen, Tengfei Yan, Jianhua Jiang, Hui Dong

articles.title: Multi-Channel Non-Abelian Edge Pumping via Multi-Degeneracy Encircling
articles.title_zh: 通过多重简并环绕实现多通道非阿贝尔边缘泵浦
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07594v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Non-Abelian operations enable sequence-dependent control of light, yet experimental realizations in wave systems have remained confined to local bulk or same-boundary modes and have often required fragile gap-closing degeneracies. Conventional Thouless pumps, meanwhile, support only two-channel edge transfer across a single gap. Here we demonstrate multi-channel non-Abelian edge pumping on a silicon photonic chip by adiabatically encircling multiple band degeneracies in a multi-gap lattice. In a minimal three-band band-triangle, two opposite-charge Weyl points and one zero-charge degeneracy are linked by global band connectivity, yielding both opposite-boundary and same-boundary edge channels. Sequencing these channels produces non-Abelian braiding of three topologically protected edge modes that reside on distinct physical boundaries. The process remains fully gapped and is protected by topological winding rather than by maintained spectral degeneracies. The same band-triangle principle extends systematically to an arbitrary number of channels, establishing a scalable route to collective, sequence-controlled routing of topological states in integrated photonic circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 非阿贝尔操作可实现光的序列依赖控制，但波系统中的实验实现通常局限于局部体态或同边界模式。本研究在硅光子芯片上通过绝热环绕多带隙晶格中的多个能带简并，实现了多通道非阿贝尔边缘泵浦。在一个最小的三能带“能带三角形”中，产生了异边界和同边界边缘通道。这些通道的序列化产生了三个拓扑保护边缘模式的非阿贝尔编织，该过程保持完全带隙并受拓扑缠绕保护。
authors: Qingyang Mo, Jiacheng Sun, Zhongfu Li, Jiajun Li, Wange Song, Tao Li, Shuang Zhang

articles.title: Signature of chiral anomaly in a graphene-based heterostructure
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯基异质结构中手性反常的特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07841v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chiral anomaly is a fundamental manifestation of topological matter caused by chirality imbalance. It can be of great practical value by providing a mechanism for dissipationless transport. The phenomenon is highly sensitive to the system dimensionality, disappearing in the 2D limit. Different schemes have been proposed to observe the chiral anomaly in graphene-based systems but experimental evidence has been lacking. Here, we synthesized two types of the Gr/Sr/SiC nanostructure - with 2D and 3D, bulk-like, layers of Sr - the difference being the amount of Sr intercalated under graphene. In contrast to the 2D material, 3D Gr/Sr/SiC exhibits a signature of the chiral anomaly - quadratic negative magnetoresistance in parallel magnetic and electric fields. Also, the functional form of the temperature dependence of the magnetoresistance agrees with the chiral anomaly. In addition, the 3D heterostructure exhibits suppressed conductivity and quantum oscillations in graphene. These effects may be associated with the graphene layer incorporated into a complex 3D heterostructure. Hopefully, the discovered signature of chiral anomaly in the built-in graphene would spur research on the phenomenon in topological nanomaterials.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性反常是拓扑物质的基本表现，可提供无耗散输运机制，但在二维极限下消失。本研究合成了两种Gr/Sr/SiC纳米结构，分别具有二维和三维的Sr层。结果显示，与二维材料不同，三维Gr/Sr/SiC在平行磁场和电场中表现出二次负磁阻，这是手性反常的特征，且磁阻的温度依赖性也与手性反常一致。这些发现有望为构建基于手性反常的器件提供基础。
authors: Ivan S. Sokolov, Dmitry V. Averyanov, Oleg E. Parfenov, Sergey P. Lebedev, Alexander A. Lebedev, Olesya O. Kapitanova, Alexey N. Mihalyuk, Oleg A. Kondratev, Andrey M. Tokmachev, Vyacheslav G. Storchak

articles.title: Half-integer quantum anomalous Hall effect in MnBi₂Te₄ via non-magnetic extension
articles.title_zh: 通过非磁性扩展在MnBi₂Te₄中实现半整数量子反常霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07844v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Within an ab-initio approach, we study the electronic structure and Hall response of the antiferromagnetic topological insulator film of MnBi₂Te₄ in contact with non-magnetic GeBi₂Te₄ (Bi₂Te₃₎ overlayer. The proposed junction design eliminates the exchange splitting one of the Dirac cones of the MnBi₂Te₄ (0001) thus manifesting a half-integer quantum anomalous Hall phase. The described recipe allows to enlarge temperature of the effect observation, enriches the diversity of topological properties of the MnBi₂Te₄ compound and is appropriate for other layered antiferromagnetic topological insulators. Applying the proposed heterostructure design, the half-quantized Hall phase can be established with employing other overlayer and magnetic topological insulator films.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究采用第一性原理方法，探讨了反铁磁拓扑绝缘体MnBi₂Te₄薄膜与非磁性GeBi₂Te₄（或Bi₂Te₃）覆盖层接触时的电子结构和霍尔响应。所提出的结设计消除了MnBi₂Te₄ (0001) 中一个狄拉克锥的交换劈裂，从而展现出半整数量子反常霍尔相。该方法有望提高效应观测温度，丰富MnBi₂Te₄化合物的拓扑性质多样性，并适用于其他层状反铁磁拓扑绝缘体。
authors: Igor P. Rusinov, Tatiana V. Menshchikova, Evgueni V. Chulkov

articles.title: Non-Perturbative Resolution of Luttinger's Theorem Violations in Strongly Correlated Systems
articles.title_zh: 强关联系统中卢廷格定理违背的非微扰解决
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07933v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many-body physics faces an apparent paradox concerning violations of Luttinger's theorem in strongly correlated systems. The theorem relates the electron number to the Luttinger count -- the monodromy of the logarithm of the imaginary-frequency Green's function G(iϵ) -- and, at finite magnetic field, connects the Hall conductivity to the magnetic-field derivative of the Luttinger count via the Streda formula. Here, we provide a non-perturbative solution to this paradox. We demonstrate that the reported violations of Luttinger's theorem do not require a breakdown of the skeleton diagram representation of physical quantities, thereby resolving a long-standing point of contention in many-body theory. Furthermore, we show that the Luttinger integral, which accounts for the mismatch between the particle number and the Luttinger count, is itself a genuine topological invariant directly tied to the Luttinger-Ward functional Φ[G] rather than to the Green's function alone. We demonstrate that this invariant, like the monodromy of łn G(iϵ) itself, stems exclusively from the zero-frequency discontinuity of the Matsubara trajectory.
articles.abstract_zh: 强关联系统中卢廷格定理的违背是一个长期存在的悖论，该定理将电子数与卢廷格计数相关联。本研究提出了一个非微扰解决方案，表明卢廷格定理的违背不需物理量骨架图表示的失效。此外，研究发现卢廷格积分本身是一个真正的拓扑不变量，直接与卢廷格-沃德泛函Φ[G]相关，而非仅与格林函数相关。该不变量与ln G(iϵ)的单值性一样，仅源于松原轨迹的零频率不连续性。
authors: Nazzareno Africani, Herbert Eßl, Alessandro Toschi, Michele Fabrizio

articles.title: Zero-Point Renormalization Reshapes the Shift Current: The Role of Electron-Phonon Coupling
articles.title_zh: 零点重整化重塑位移电流：电子-声子耦合的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08019v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Shift current (SC) drives the bulk photovoltaic effect, holding promise for near-instantaneous, low-dissipation photodetection and energy conversion. The current understanding of SC relies primarily on a single-particle picture, in which the SC is determined purely by band dispersion. While many-body effects from directly excited quasiparticles, such as excitons, magnons and phonons, have been explored, the renormalization of electronic states by quantum virtual-phonon coupling --- inherent in essentially all solids and particularly decisive for transport --- remains unaddressed. Here, using first-principles calculations, we identify this missing channel --- band-renormalized shift current (BRSC) --- in monolayer MoS2. We find that the zero-point renormalization alone, without any polarization-carrying photoexcited phonons and with barely any alteration of the band dispersion, dramatically reshapes the SC spectrum: emergent low-energy peaks arise from phonon-assisted optical transitions between momentum-distinct states, with a pronounced redshift of higher-energy features. A mere 1.0% strain sharply tunes the BRSC, whereas raising the temperature enhances it. Our findings overturn the band-structure-only paradigm, establishing electron-phonon coupling as an indispensable ingredient for nonlinear photocurrent and opening a strain-thermal route for engineering next-generation optoelectronic responses.
articles.abstract_zh: 位移电流（SC）驱动体光伏效应，但其现有理解主要基于单粒子图像。本研究通过第一性原理计算，在单层MoS₂中识别出被忽视的“能带重整化位移电流”（BRSC）通道。结果表明，仅零点重整化就能显著重塑SC谱：低能峰源于声子辅助的动量不同态之间的光学跃迁，高能特征则出现明显的红移。此外，仅1.0%的应变就能显著调控BRSC。
authors: Yang Li, Zuzhang Lin, Zhikuan Wang, Chengzhi Wu, Zeyu Jiang, Bing Huang

articles.title: Direct transition from a fractional Chern insulator to a topological superconductor
articles.title_zh: 从分数量子霍尔绝缘体到拓扑超导体的直接转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08475v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We find numerical evidence for a direct continuous transition from a Laughlin fractional Chern insulator (FCI) to a c₋₌₃/2 topological superconductor (TSC), driven by increasing bandwidth at filling ν=1/3 in a repulsively interacting Chern band. At the critical point, the electron correlation length diverges at momentum away from the reference Fermi surface. We develop a generalized theory of superconducting-vortex proliferation for this transition. Magnetic translation organizes the vortices into six valleys, so translation-preserving proliferation requires additional gauge fields. The resulting theory reproduces the momentum structure of the critical spectrum and captures the divergent electron correlation. Upon doping away from commensurate filling, the theory gives rise to a superconducting dome. These results are consistent with an anyonic origin of the topological superconductivity in the absence of a weak-coupling Fermi-surface instability.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究提供了数值证据，表明在排斥相互作用的陈带中，通过增加带宽，可以实现从劳林分数量子霍尔绝缘体（FCI）到c₋₌₃/2拓扑超导体（TSC）的直接连续转变。在临界点，电子关联长度在远离参考费米面的动量处发散。我们为此转变发展了一种广义的超导涡旋增殖理论，该理论再现了临界谱的动量结构并捕捉了发散的电子关联。这些结果与在没有弱耦合费米面不稳定性情况下拓扑超导体的任意子起源一致。
authors: Taige Wang

articles.title: Chern-Simons Interfaces and Minimal Models from Quantum Groups
articles.title_zh: 量子群中的陈-西蒙斯界面和极小模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07012v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Coupling two-dimensional fundamental Dirac fermions to SU(N)ₖ Chern-Simons theory produces non-chiral interfaces that in the infrared flow to a compact boson and a W_N minimal model. We propose a description of these interfaces as continuum limits of q-deformed fermion chains. The q-deformation is achieved by coupling a chain of one-dimensional fundamental complex fermions to SU(N)ₖ Chern-Simons theory, keeping the underlying topological gauge field continuous. The operator algebra is controlled by quantum groups, which provide an algebraic perspective on the usual categorical formulation of anyon chains. As an application, we derive a Lieb-Schultz-Mattis constraint involving baryon-number and lattice translation, obstructing a unique symmetric gapped ground state. At unit filling, we gap out the compact boson sector with a Mott term and obtain standard anyon chain Hamiltonians previously studied in the literature. This provides an anomaly argument for the existence of N copies of minimal model sectors permuted by lattice translation in the infrared.
articles.abstract_zh: 将二维基本狄拉克费米子耦合到SU(N)ₖ陈-西蒙斯理论会产生非手性界面，在红外区域流向紧致玻色子和W_N极小模型。本研究提出将这些界面描述为q-形变费米子链的连续极限，其中q-形变是通过将一维基本复费米子链耦合到SU(N)ₖ陈-西蒙斯理论实现的。算符代数由量子群控制，为任意子链的范畴化表述提供了代数视角。研究还推导了一个涉及重子数和晶格平移的Lieb-Schultz-Mattis约束，阻碍了唯一的对称带隙基态。
authors: Suriyah Rajalingam Kannagi, Sergio Sanjurjo

articles.title: The generic Mott transition in the sine-Gordon model through an embedded worm algorithm
articles.title_zh: 正弦-戈登模型中通过嵌入式蠕虫算法实现的通用莫特转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.20901v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The generic Mott transition in one-dimensional quantum systems can be described by the sine-Gordon model with a tilt via bosonization. Because the configuration space of the sine-Gordon model separates into distinct topological sectors, standard local Monte Carlo schemes are limited to very small system sizes. To overcome this limitation, we introduce the smooth worm (SmoWo) Monte Carlo algorithm which enlarges the configuration space to allow smooth transitions between topological sectors. The method combines worm updates with event-chain Monte Carlo moves. We explicitly prove its validity and quantify its performance. Thanks to the substantial acceleration achieved by the SmoWo algorithm, we are able to simulate large system sizes, providing a precise picture of the different phases and critical behaviour of the sine-Gordon model.
articles.abstract_zh: 一维量子系统中的通用莫特转变可通过倾斜正弦-戈登模型描述。针对标准蒙特卡洛方法在拓扑扇区限制下的局限性，本文引入了平滑蠕虫（SmoWo）蒙特卡洛算法，该算法通过扩展构型空间实现了拓扑扇区间的平滑过渡。SmoWo算法显著加速了模拟过程，使得研究人员能够模拟大系统尺寸，从而精确描绘了正弦-戈登模型的不同相和临界行为。
authors: Oscar Bouverot-Dupuis, Laura Foini, Alberto Rosso

articles.title: Overview of the Theory of Extremely Correlated Fermi Liquids
articles.title_zh: 极端关联费米液体理论综述
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13541v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Extremely Correlated Fermi Liquids (ECFL) theory is reviewed as a framework for understanding the t-J model in metallic systems close to the Mott insulating limit. This overview presents the underlying ideas and the resulting equations in a form accessible to nonexperts. We compare theoretical results with all available resistivity data for single-layer High-Tc systems, and with some spectral data. The highlighted results include a density dependent quasilinear T-dependence in resistivity, an unusually small quasiparticle weight, and distinct low-temperature emergent scales that dominate transport, thermodynamics and spectral properties of single-layer High T_c systems. Suggestions are made for further experiments to probe the physics of these challenging quantum many-body systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文综述了极端关联费米液体（ECFL）理论，该理论为理解接近莫特绝缘体极限的金属系统中的t-J模型提供了框架。综述以非专业人士易懂的形式介绍了其基本思想和方程，并将理论结果与单层高温超导系统的电阻率和部分光谱数据进行了比较。研究强调了电阻率的密度依赖准线性温度行为、异常小的准粒子权重以及在低温下主导输运、热力学和光谱特性的独特标度。
authors: B Sriram Shastry

articles.title: Updated Tkatchenko Scheffler method and assessment of dispersion methods for alkali-containing systems
articles.title_zh: 改进的Tkatchenko-Scheffler方法及碱金属体系色散方法评估
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.01501v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Tkatchenko-Scheffler (TS) pairwise method to calculate dispersion interactions is a widely used approach to incorporate missing long-range van der Waals contributions in semilocal and hybrid density functional calculations. Despite subsequent many-body extensions, this formulation remains widely used. In 2018, Fedorov et al. reported updated van der Waals radii to the seminal work published in 2009. The present work examines the accuracy of the TS method with updated van der Waals radii (TS₂₀₁₈₎, coupled with the semilocal Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof density functional, for structural predictions of semiconducting and insulating materials. Special attention is paid to materials containing alkali elements, for which the TS₂₀₀₉ method exhibits a large overbinding, associated with potentially large errors in predicted atomic structures. We also consider a narrower reformulation (TSₐₗₖₐₗᵢ₎ where only the the alkali atoms are corrected, so the method remains otherwise compatible with TS₂₀₀₉. We compare these methods with a broader set of dispersion corrections--the DFT-D3 method, the exchange-hole dipole moment method, and the beyond-pairwise, nonlocal many-body dispersion method--for ionic and alkali-containing systems more generally. We examine equilibrium geometry predictions for 45 inorganic solid compounds as well as three Cs-containing halide perovskites, CsPbX₃ (X = Cl, Br, I). Our results show that the updated van der Waals radii in the TS₂₀₁₈ and TSₐₗₖₐₗᵢ methods resolve the overbinding that is present with TS₂₀₀₉ in alkali-containing systems, bringing predictions into closer agreement with other dispersion methods. For the halide perovskites, method-dependent differences in predicted cell volumes and shapes persist, and no approach performs with perfect accuracy on all metrics for all three materials.
articles.abstract_zh: Tkatchenko-Scheffler (TS) 对方法广泛用于密度泛函计算中引入范德华相互作用。本文评估了结合更新范德华半径（TS₂₀₁₈）的TS方法在半导体和绝缘材料结构预测中的准确性，尤其关注TS₂₀₀₉方法对碱金属体系存在过大结合误差的问题。研究还提出了一种仅修正碱金属原子的TSₐₗₖₐₗᵢ方法，并将其与DFT-D3等其他色散校正方法进行了比较。
authors: Aaron M. Schankler, Ruyi Song, Sampreeti Bhattacharya, Ela Lucas, Lee Hampton III, Alexandre Tkatchenko, Yosuke Kanai, Volker Blum

articles.title: Quantum Communication and Phase Sensing over a Dephasing Channel with Thermal Noise
articles.title_zh: 热噪声退相干信道上的量子通信与相位传感
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07855v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dephasing is a prominent source of decoherence in quantum communication, degrading phase coherence and transmission reliability. Therefore, knowledge of the physical channel parameters for reliable transmission is imperative, motivating the integration of quantum communication and sensing at the physical layer. Consequently, we study the transmission of coherent states over a von Mises dephasing channel affected by thermal noise.
