We consider a heterodyne receiver, for which, we first derive the symbol-error probability (SEP) and an accurate closed-form approximation, through which an irreducible asymptotic error floor due to the dephasing channel is identified. We note that the derived SEP is affected by the mismatch between the receiver's mean phase estimation and the true mean phase, thereby formalizing the interplay between sensing accuracy and communication reliability. In addition, we derive the Fisher information (FI) for the mean phase acquisition of the channel and provide closed-form lower and upper FI bounds. Moreover, the quantum FI (QFI) of the channel is studied, and lower and upper bounds on the QFI are given, which become asymptotically tight as the photon number increases. Despite the initial complexity of the FI and the QFI, the bounds given are relatively simple and effective. In addition, by comparing the FI with the QFI, we show that heterodyne detection approaches the quantum sensing limit as the number of photons increase, while an unavoidable sensing floor exists due to dephasing. Then, using the SEP and the FI analysis, we discuss the conditions under which communication and phase estimation requirements are jointly feasible. Finally, numerical results validate the derived SEP, estimation bounds, and the sensing-communication feasibility tradeoff.
articles.abstract_zh: 退相干是量子通信中主要的退相干源，会降低相位相干性和传输可靠性。本文研究了在受热噪声影响的von Mises退相干信道上传输相干态。针对外差接收机，推导了符号错误概率（SEP）及其精确的封闭形式近似，并识别出由退相干信道引起的不可约渐近误差底。研究还推导了信道平均相位获取的费雪信息（FI）和量子费雪信息（QFI）的上下界，形式化了传感精度与通信可靠性之间的相互作用。
authors: Nikos A. Mitsiou, Ioannis Krikidis

articles.title: Non-Markovian delay-assisted sensing with waveguide-coupled quantum emitters
articles.title_zh: 非马尔可夫延迟辅助的波导耦合量子发射器传感
articles.abstract: Author(s): Prajit Dhara, Isack Padilla, Saikat Guha, Annyun Das, and Kanu Sinha We show that in a minimal setup of two waveguide-coupled quantum emitters, separated by long distances and subject to an external field, time-delayed feedback can be a resource for sensing field gradients. While the field gradient induces a detuning between the emitters, the large interatomic separa… [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 043138] Published Fri Nov 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了由两个波导耦合量子发射器组成的最小系统，发现时间延迟反馈可作为感知场梯度的资源。即使发射器之间存在大距离，场梯度引起的失谐也能通过这种机制被有效探测。该研究揭示了非马尔可夫效应在量子传感中的潜在应用。
authors: Prajit Dhara, Isack Padilla, Saikat Guha, Annyun Das, and Kanu Sinha

articles.title: All you need is Trotter
articles.title_zh: 你所需要的一切就是Trotter
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2261 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-11-06-2261 The work here enables a cost scaling of tildeOłeft( fracT ¹⁺o⁽¹⁾ m̊ log² (1/ϵ)ǎrepsiloni̊ght) and maximum depth tildeOłeft( fracT¹⁺o⁽¹⁾ m̊ log (1/ϵ)ǎrepsiloni̊ght) for estimating observables after some Hamiltonian evolution eⁱ H T using no extra block-encoding qubits, where ϵ is the algorithmic error of the target Hamiltonian evolution and ǎrepsilon is the statistical error from the observable estimation. Throughout, tildeO suppresses factors that are doubly logarithmic in 1/ϵ (i.e. m̊ polyloglog(1/ϵ)), which are subdominant to the displayed m̊ polylog(1/ϵ) factors. This is achieved through product formulas, stable interpolation (Chebyshev), and to calculate the needed fractional queries, cardinal sine interpolation is used. This is an improvement over similar work using interpolation methods which have a superlinear scaling of the form 5^p T¹⁺¹/p, where p is the order of the product formula used and an improvement on required qubits over Quantum Signal Processing methods while maintaining scaling with m̊ polylog1/ϵ. This is accomplished through an optimized and variable (with T) order p. The slightly better łog²⁽¹/ϵ) compared to łog³⁽¹/ϵ) comes from the use of cardinal sine interpolation compared to other methods using Chebyshev interpolation and product formulas. The work presented here also provides an alternative to Quantum Signal Processing techniques to calculate observables or amplitudes after a fractional query evolution with a cost O(Tłog1/ϵ) through this cardinal sine interpolation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种估算哈密顿量演化后可观测量的量子算法，实现了优化的成本和深度缩放，且无需额外的块编码量子比特。该方法通过乘积公式、稳定插值和基数正弦插值实现，显著改进了现有插值方法和量子信号处理方法。其关键在于优化且可变的乘积公式阶数，从而在保持良好缩放的同时减少了所需量子比特。
authors: Gumaro Rendón

articles.title: Bounding the entanglement of a state from its spectrum
articles.title_zh: 从量子态谱中界定其纠缠
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2260 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-11-06-2260 We introduce a framework to upper bound the entanglement content of a bipartite quantum state from its spectrum alone. Using linear maps and their inverses, we derive rigorous constraints on the maximal entanglement that can be activated under global unitary transformations. We use as entanglement quantifiers the negativity and the Schmidt number; however, our framework is general and applies to any other entanglement measure. Our approach yields compact analytical sufficient criteria for bounding the entanglement of full-rank states in arbitrary dimensions and reveals new spectral constraints on Schmidt number witnesses.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种仅凭双分量量子态的谱来设定其纠缠含量上限的框架。通过线性映射及其逆，研究者推导了全局酉变换下可激活的最大纠缠的严格约束。该方法为任意维度全秩态的纠缠界定提供了紧凑的解析判据，并揭示了施密特数见证者的新谱约束。
authors: Jofre Abellanet-Vidal, Guillem Müller-Rigat, Albert Rico, and Anna Sanpera

articles.title: Optimising physical parameters of a quantum network based on a loss-jitter trade-off
articles.title_zh: 基于损耗-抖动权衡优化量子网络的物理参数
articles.abstract: As quantum communication systems and networks are becoming a commercial reality, clarity on their future infrastructure is increasingly important. Based on the inevitable presence of some amount of loss, chromatic dispersion, and timing jitter, we present simulations to show that certain wavelengths and bandwidths have clear advantages.
articles.abstract_zh: 随着量子通信系统和网络日益商业化，其未来基础设施的清晰性变得至关重要。本文基于不可避免的损耗、色散和时间抖动，通过仿真展示了特定波长和带宽在量子网络中具有明显优势。该研究为量子网络物理参数的优化提供了指导。
authors: Marcus J Clark and Siddarth K Joshi

articles.title: FNO-Based Inverse Co-Design of Semiconducting Quantum-Dot Devices
articles.title_zh: 基于FNO的半导体量子点器件逆向协同设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06994v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Gate-defined semiconductor quantum dots are promising building blocks for scalable spin-based quantum processors, however their operational properties depend on several fabrication and control parameters, such as lithographic gate layout and applied voltages. Existing device architectures have been refined through repeated fabrication and experimental testing, producing layouts that support reliable device operation. However, this process does not exhaustively explore the design space, limiting the ability to obtain qubits with targeted properties. We address these challenges by presenting a differentiable inverse co-design framework for electrostatically defined quantum dots that jointly optimises gate voltages and the gate electrode layout. A semiclassical Thomas--Fermi electrostatic simulator provides reference data for a Fourier neural operator (FNO) surrogate, which predicts the two-dimensional charge-density field. The desired spatial distribution of the confined charge defines the target quantum-dot geometry for inverse design. The FNO reproduces charge densities with a relative L² test error of just 0.6% and enables millisecond-scale differentiable evaluations. Relative to the CPU-based physics simulator, the FNO achieves a 17,000-fold speed-up on GPU for a single design, with further performance gains enabled by batched inference. When embedded in a gradient-based design loop with fabrication constraints, the FNO can produce both vertically and horizontally elongated double-dot confinement geometries from the same initial conditions. The ability to engineer these distinct confinement configurations demonstrates control over quantum-dot shape and position, providing a route towards designing devices with distinct qubit-relevant operating properties prior to fabrication.
articles.abstract_zh: 栅极定义的半导体量子点是自旋量子处理器有前景的构建模块，但其操作特性受多种制造和控制参数影响。本文提出了一种可微分的静电定义量子点逆向协同设计框架，可联合优化栅极电压和栅电极布局。该框架利用傅里叶神经算子（FNO）代理模型预测二维电荷密度场，实现了对电荷密度的精确再现，并显著加速了设计过程。
authors: Marek Rychetsky, Valentin Duruisseaux, Freya Shah, David L. Craig, Ming Ni, Georgios Katsaros, Taylor L. Patti, Anima Anandkumar, Natalia Ares

articles.title: Nonlocal magic of fermions is bounded by entanglement fluctuations and is logarithmic for free fermions
articles.title_zh: 费米子非局域魔性受纠缠涨落限制，对自由费米子呈对数关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07003v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Free-fermion states are classically simulable, yet, written as qubits, they typically carry extensive magic, the quantum resource that stabilizer circuits lack. Part of this magic is nonlocal: local unitaries acting separately on two parts of the system cannot remove it. If these local unitaries are restricted to Gaussian ones, the nonlocal magic grows linearly with the number m of partially entangled fermion pairs. We show that this growth is an artifact of the Gaussian restriction: local Gaussian unitaries minimize the nonlocal stabilizer Rényi entropy for up to three pairs, but not from four pairs on. General local non-Gaussian unitaries that respect fermion parity take m free-fermion pairs to fermionic Bell pairs with a fidelity that decays at most as 1/sqrt m compared to exponential decay with Gaussian unitaries, so the nonlocal magic drops from linear to logarithmic in m. The reason is statistical --- Bell pairs have equal Schmidt weights, that is, a fully degenerate entanglement spectrum, and a state can stay far from them only if its Schmidt weights are spread over many orders of magnitude. This spread is measured by the capacity of entanglement C_E, the variance of the entanglement Hamiltonian, and the nonlocal magic of any fermionic state grows at most logarithmically with C_E. Free-fermion pairs add to C_E independently, so C_E grows only linearly in m, and this leads to the stabilizer fidelity decreasing at most as 1/sqrt m. Almost all the magic of free fermions, including Hartree--Fock and BCS mean-field states, is therefore local.
articles.abstract_zh: 自由费米子态虽然可经典模拟，但作为量子比特时通常带有广泛的“魔性”。本文研究了这种非局域魔性，发现其增长是高斯限制的产物。通过使用更通用的非高斯局域酉算符，费米子的非局域魔性从线性增长降至对数增长。这一发现揭示了纠缠涨落对量子资源边界的关键作用。
authors: Raghav G. Jha, Dengyao Luo, Alexander F. Kemper, Bojko N. Bakalov

articles.title: Quantum Noise Engineering in Advanced LIGO
articles.title_zh: 先进LIGO中的量子噪声工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07074v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Advanced LIGO is a gravitational-wave detector with extreme sensitivity, operating close to the quantum limits of optical measurement. The quantum noise in this system arises from vacuum fluctuations entering the interferometer readout port: phase-like fluctuations produce measurement imprecision, while amplitude-like fluctuations drive radiation-pressure back-action. In this review, we present an intuitive description in terms of complex fields and quadratures, and follow squeezed vacuum from its generation, through its interaction with the filter cavity and propagation through the interferometer, to the readout. We discuss how frequency-independent and frequency-dependent squeezing engineer quantum noise, and how correlations between optical quadratures map onto correlations between measurement imprecision and back-action. We conclude that LIGO is both a gravitational-wave observatory and a kilometre-scale platform for quantum measurement science.
articles.abstract_zh: 先进LIGO是灵敏度极高的引力波探测器，其运行接近光学测量的量子极限。本文综述了该系统中的量子噪声来源，并以复场和正交分量直观描述了压缩真空的产生、与滤波腔的相互作用以及在干涉仪中的传播。研究讨论了频率无关和频率相关的压缩如何进行量子噪声工程，以及光学正交分量之间的关联如何映射到测量不精确性和辐射压反作用之间的关联。
authors: Begüm Kabagöz

articles.title: Field-aligned measurement removes the anisotropy barrier of sample-based quantum subspace solvers for magnetized-plasma heat conduction
articles.title_zh: 场对齐测量消除了磁化等离子体热传导中基于样本的量子子空间求解器的各向异性障碍
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07102v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sample-based quantum subspace methods construct a small subspace from measured basis states and solve the target problem classically within it. We study these methods for heat conduction in magnetized plasmas, where the anisotropy ḩiₚₐᵣₐₗₗₑₗ/ḩiₚₑᵣₚ reaches 10⁸ to 10¹⁰. We prove two results for the energy-norm Galerkin solution. First, if the measurement basis is aligned with the flux surfaces and the subspace contains the poloidal-mode-zero block, the error is bounded by |r₀|L^₊(ḩiₚₐᵣₐₗₗₑₗ₋ḩiₚₑᵣₚ₎⁻¹/², where the numerator does not depend on ḩiₚₐᵣₐₗₗₑₗ. The bound is sharp, so the accuracy improves as the anisotropy grows. Second, in the computational basis, a subspace that misses a single node of a flux surface suppresses the flux-function component there as ḩiₚₐᵣₐₗₗₑₗ⁻¹/², which gives an error floor when the limiting solution is nonzero on that surface. We verify both results on a shaped cross-section and on a KSTAR-like Miller equilibrium with ten qubits. At ḩiₚₐᵣₐₗₗₑₗ/ḩiₚₑᵣₚ₌₁₀⁹, the computational basis gives an error of order unity for every shot budget, whereas a quantum Fourier transform on the poloidal register gives 1.3×10⁻⁵. The same barrier limits sample-based quantum diagonalization. The aligned measurement needs no time evolution, so the circuit is only state preparation and a five-qubit quantum Fourier transform. On a ten-qubit superconducting processor, the aligned basis gives a median error of 7.0×10⁻⁶ with 768 shots, whereas the computational basis gives errors above 0.94 up to 1.2×10⁴ shots. A trapped-ion processor shows the same behavior.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了基于样本的量子子空间方法在磁化等离子体热传导问题中的应用，该问题具有高达10¹⁰的各向异性。研究证明，若测量基与磁通面校准且子空间包含极向模式零块，则误差界限随各向异性增大而提高。相反，在计算基中，若子空间缺失磁通面上的单个节点，则会产生误差下限。这些结果在十量子比特系统上得到了验证，表明场对齐测量能显著提高精度。
authors: Doyeol (David), Ahn (Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, University of Seoul, Dongdaemun-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea, Singularity Quantum Inc., Newport Beach, California, USA)

articles.title: Dithered Belief Propagation for Real-Time Quantum Memory Decoding
articles.title_zh: 用于实时量子存储器解码的抖动置信传播算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07144v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce dithered belief-propagation decoding for circuit-level quantum memory to mitigate the oscillations and trapping behavior that limit standard belief-propagation (BP) decoders for qLDPC codes. Our approach combines a quantum-adapted sign-flip mechanism with chained randomized prior perturbation. Evaluated under circuit-level noise on the distance-11 rotated surface code and the distance-12 bivariate-bicycle code, the proposed dithered decoder significantly outperforms BP and BP+OSD+CS-10. The proposed decoder achieves accuracy comparable to or better than state-of-the-art Relay-BP, especially at higher physical error rates, while trading a moderate increase in additions for about 98% fewer multiplications on average and eliminating node-level RNGs. These results suggest that dithering is a promising approach toward real-time decoding of quantum memories.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了一种用于电路级量子存储器的抖动置信传播解码算法，旨在缓解标准置信传播（BP）解码器在qLDPC码中存在的振荡和陷阱行为。该方法结合了量子适应的符号翻转机制和链式随机先验扰动。实验结果表明，该抖动解码器在较高物理错误率下，性能优于现有BP及其变体，且在计算效率上具有显著优势，为实时量子存储器解码提供了有前景的解决方案。
authors: Zhengyu Cai, Mohamad Ali Jarkas, Bokun Zhao, Warren J. Gross

articles.title: Improving Gravitationally Induced Entanglement in Interferometric Configurations
articles.title_zh: 改进干涉配置中引力诱导的纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07153v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Proposals to detect gravitationally induced entanglement between massive particles offer a promising pathway toward probing the quantum nature of gravity. We perform a systematic geometric optimization and comparative analysis of Stern--Gerlach (SG) and Mach--Zehnder (MZ) matter-wave interferometers for this purpose, deriving exact analytical expressions for the gravitational phase of each configuration. Our first key result is that geometric optimization is indispensable. For commonly assumed experimental parameters, neglecting the optimization of geometric ratios can suppress the accumulated phase, and hence the detectability of entanglement, by up to several orders of magnitude. Second, we provide a complete comparative analysis of two SG orientations (linear and parallel) and three MZ orientations (translation-symmetric, mirror-symmetric, and parallel-arms). The parallel-arms SG and MZ configurations tend to yield the largest phase accumulations and are nearly equivalent in performance, whereas the translation-symmetric MZ setup exhibits destructive-interference nulls that act as blind operating points where detection becomes ineffective. These observations highlight the importance of geometry-aware design. A Monte Carlo error analysis of realistic fabrication tolerances indicates that the parallel-arms configurations are generally more robust, maintaining low relative phase uncertainty over broad parameter intervals. Furthermore, an evaluation of Bell violations assesses the feasibility and signal-to-noise ratio of each configuration. Our results identify geometric optimization, particularly through parallel-arms designs, as an important consideration for near-term experiments targeting gravitationally induced entanglement.
articles.abstract_zh: 探测大质量粒子间引力诱导纠缠的提议为探索引力的量子本质提供了途径。本文对斯特恩-盖拉赫（SG）和马赫-曾德尔（MZ）物质波干涉仪进行了系统的几何优化和比较分析，并推导了每种配置的引力相位的精确解析表达式。研究发现几何优化对于纠缠的可探测性至关重要，且平行臂SG和MZ配置通常能产生最大的相位累积。
authors: Alireza Maleki

articles.title: Scalable Transpilation for Overcoming Restricted Connectivity in Distributed Superconducting Quantum Architectures
articles.title_zh: 用于克服分布式超导量子架构中受限连接的可扩展转译
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07175v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Distributed Quantum Computing (DQC) offers a promising pathway to scale superconducting quantum hardware, but restricted inter- and intra-module connectivity creates a major transpilation bottleneck. Current DQC transpilation methods often assume idealized hardware connectivity, ignore subsequent intra-module routing, or suffer from substantial computational overheads that limit their applicability at scale. To address this, we introduce a scalable transpilation method tailored for the restricted connectivity of distributed superconducting quantum architectures. Specifically, our quantum interaction graph (QIG) approach couples a graph-partitioning mapping step with a fast SABRE-inspired routing heuristic. On a 48-qubit (3 QPUs × 16 qubits) architecture with all-to-all inter-core connectivity, our method reduces average aggregated costs by up to 24.72% (unstructured) and 24.01% (structured), while delivering >250× speed-ups for structured workloads compared to the state-of-the-art DMapS algorithm. On the 399-qubit (3×133) IBM Flamingo, where DMapS times out on dense circuits, our approach maintains practical runtimes. Against a DQC-adapted SABRE baseline, it reduces structured circuit routing costs by up to 51.94% (all-to-all inter-core topology) and 51.96% (restricted line topology). Ultimately, this work delivers a practical transpilation method for DQC at scale.
articles.abstract_zh: 分布式量子计算（DQC）为扩展超导量子硬件提供了前景，但受限的模块间和模块内连接性构成了主要的转译瓶颈。本文提出了一种可扩展的转译方法，专为分布式超导量子架构的受限连接性设计。该方法结合了图划分映射步骤和受SABRE启发的快速路由启发式算法，在多量子比特架构上显著降低了成本并提高了速度，解决了现有方法在扩展性上的局限。
authors: Afonso Azenha, Ilia Polian, Sebastian Brandhofer

articles.title: Thermally-driven quantum reservoir computing
articles.title_zh: 热驱动量子储层计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07187v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Heat generation limits computation, classical and quantum, from single logic gates to entire data centers. However, an in principle limiting physical factor can sometimes be turned into a resource. In reservoir computing, energy dissipation is what gives a reservoir its fading memory. Here, we introduce a paradigm where the data injection itself is encoded on the time-dependent temperature of a thermal bath. We derive an exact expression for the nonlinear response of any fixed readout, and prove a rigorous memory-nonlinearity trade-off which turns out to be a structural necessity, rather than a tunable dynamical regime, since the same coupling that injects data also enforces equilibration. We illustrate both results with a driven qubit, using a single free parameter, and with a pair of coupled qubits, where the breaking of a discrete symmetry opens a fifteen-dimensional space to a single observable, yet that observable alone recovers just over half of it. This refutes the misconception that large Hilbert spaces guarantee computational power. Our results relocate the memory-nonlinearity trade-off from the reservoir's dynamics to its measurement channel, pointing to observable choice and bath engineering (instead of Hamiltonian control) as the physical levers for a thermally-native quantum reservoir computer.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了一种热驱动量子储层计算范式，其中数据注入编码在热浴的时间依赖温度上。研究推导了任意固定读出的非线性响应的精确表达式，并证明了一个严格的记忆-非线性权衡，这是一种结构性必然。该工作通过驱动量子比特和耦合量子比特对的例子进行了说明，并指出大希尔伯特空间不一定保证计算能力，将记忆-非线性权衡从储层动力学转移到其测量机制。
authors: Thiago Werlang, Daniel Valente

articles.title: Unifying First-Order Coherence, Concurrence, and Bell Correlations in Three-Flavor Neutrino Oscillations
articles.title_zh: 统一三味中微子振荡中的一阶相干性、纠缠度和贝尔关联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07285v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neutrino oscillations provide a natural setting for investigating the quantum character of flavor conversion and the distribution of quantum resources over macroscopic distances. Here, we study exact relations among purity-based first-order coherence, pairwise concurrence, and the maximal Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt (CHSH) value in coherent three-flavor neutrino oscillations. By expressing the evolving neutrino as a three-qubit single-excitation state, we derive the generally mixed two-qubit reductions and show that the squared first-order coherence of each flavor mode and its two associated squared concurrences sum to unity. Furthermore, a closed two-branch relation is obtained, showing that the maximal CHSH value of any reduced pair is determined by its average first-order coherence and concurrence. The branch structure follows from the correlation-tensor spectrum and yields exact conditions for CHSH violation. For the vacuum parameters and propagation ranges considered, electron preparation gives weak CHSH violations in electroncontaining pairs, while muon preparation produces a dominant utau pair with substantially stronger concurrence and Bell correlations. The comparison also identifies the thirdflavor contribution responsible for the different locations of concurrence and CHSH maxima. These results clarify the distribution of quantum correlations during flavor evolution and provide a basis for extensions to coherent matter propagation and wave-packet-induced mixed states.
articles.abstract_zh: 中微子振荡为研究味转换的量子特性和量子资源在宏观距离上的分布提供了理想环境。本研究探讨了相干三味中微子振荡中，基于纯度的一阶相干性、两体纠缠度以及最大CHSH值之间的精确关系。通过将演化的中微子表示为三量子比特单激发态，我们推导了普遍混合的两量子比特约化态。研究发现，每个味模的平方一阶相干性及其两个相关的平方纠缠度之和为一，并得到了一个封闭的两分支关系，揭示了任何约化对的最大CHSH值由其平均一阶相干性和纠缠度决定。
authors: Bingbing Li, Tao Wu, Jiadong Shi

articles.title: Fidelity Determines the Minimum Error of Quantum Recovery
articles.title_zh: 保真度决定量子恢复的最小误差
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07344v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Even a recovery that maximizes worst-input entanglement fidelity can retain avoidable errors in subsequent measurements. Entanglement fidelity is the probability of passing a test of whether the state and its entanglement were preserved; infidelity is the probability of failing it. Operational error is the largest possible change in any measurement probability, quantified by the normalized diamond distance. For every finite-dimensional noise channel and fixed encoding, we prove that operational error and worst-input entanglement infidelity have the same minimum over all recovery operations. The proof constructs one final unitary (a reversible quantum operation) that makes any recovery's operational error no greater than its original worst-input entanglement infidelity. With a retained noise record, we determine the optimal error and characterize all optimal decoders subject to a Kraus-rank limit for each outcome. For a fixed decoded channel, a semidefinite program finds the optimal final unitary in the low-error regime. We characterize all optimal final corrections and show that, at a fixed error floor 0<ϵ<1, the operational optimizers' sensitivity to residual unitary errors of size s is at worst of order s⁴/³, while the canonical polar correction has quadratic sensitivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 即使是最大化最差输入纠缠保真度的恢复操作，也可能在后续测量中保留可避免的误差。本研究证明，对于每个有限维噪声信道和固定编码，操作误差和最差输入纠缠失真度在所有恢复操作中具有相同的最小值。该证明通过构建一个最终的酉操作，使得任何恢复的操作误差不大于其原始的最差输入纠缠失真度。研究还确定了最优误差，并描述了在每个结果的Kraus秩限制下所有最优解码器。
authors: Dario Picozzi

articles.title: Operational Characterizations and Resource Structure of the Interactive Weight of Quantum Instruments
articles.title_zh: 量子仪器交互权重的操作性表征与资源结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07371v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantifying the interactivity of quantum instruments is fundamental to understanding their resource structure and operational capabilities. Here, we introduce the interactive weight of quantum instruments as a resource quantifier that measures the minimum fraction of an instrument that cannot be explained by non-interactive components. Through quantum-information tasks including quantum-state recovery, positive linear loss games, and environment-assisted input-blind extraction, we establish quantitative bounds on the interactive weight of quantum instruments and exact operational characterizations of its complementary quantity, the maximal non-interactive content. In particular, we extend environment-assisted input-blind extraction to the setting of restricted environmental access and develop a corresponding framework. Within the allowed-operations framework introduced by Hsieh et al., we establish fundamental resource-theoretic properties of the interactive weight of quantum instruments, including faithfulness, convexity, and monotonicity under deterministic allowed operations. Furthermore, we prove that the maximal non-interactive content satisfies exact multiplicativity under independent parallel composition, yielding necessary constraints on multicopy resource conversion and establishing the finite-copy maximal-weight distillation no-go result under deterministic allowed operations. These results establish a unified theoretical framework for the interactive weight of quantum instruments from the perspectives of resource quantification, operational interpretation, and resource conversion, providing systematic theoretical tools for the quantitative comparison and conversion of interactive quantum instruments.
articles.abstract_zh: 量化量子仪器的交互性对于理解其资源结构和操作能力至关重要。本研究引入了量子仪器的交互权重作为一种资源量化器，衡量仪器中无法用非交互组件解释的最小部分。通过量子态恢复、正线性损耗博弈和环境辅助输入盲提取等量子信息任务，我们建立了交互权重的定量界限及其互补量——最大非交互内容的精确操作性表征。在允许操作框架内，我们确立了交互权重的基本资源理论性质，包括忠实性、凸性和在确定性允许操作下的单调性。
authors: Yongxi He, Xin Hong, Yu Luo, Xiangzhen Zhou, Shenggang Ying

articles.title: Certifying the Rydberg-exposure limit of a globally driven controlled-Z gate
articles.title_zh: 全局驱动受控-Z门的里德堡暴露极限认证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07388v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rydberg excitation enables entangling gates in neutral-atom quantum processors but also exposes them to spontaneous decay. Whether this exposure can be made arbitrarily small through pulse shaping and longer gate times has remained unresolved. We show that an exact controlled-Z gate driven by a single global laser has an irreducible Rydberg-exposure cost in the perfect-blockade regime. The product of the maximum Rabi frequency Ømegaₘₐₓ and the average time T_R spent in the Rydberg state is bounded below by 2.9312, independent of pulse shape and duration. We derive this bound using a sum-of-squares certificate, strengthened by constraints imposed by the shared drive. Using interval arithmetic, we also certify the existence of an exact gate pulse with Ømegaₘₐₓ T_R<2.9359. The unrounded bounds differ by less than 0.16%. The bound identifies a fundamental cost of shared-drive entangling dynamics and establishes a benchmark against which future gate-control strategies can be assessed.
articles.abstract_zh: 里德堡激发在中性原子量子处理器中实现了纠缠门，但也使其面临自发衰变。本研究表明，在完美阻塞机制下，由单个全局激光驱动的精确受控-Z门具有不可约的里德堡暴露成本。最大拉比频率Ωmax与在里德堡态中停留的平均时间TR的乘积下限为2.9312，与脉冲形状和持续时间无关。该界限是使用平方和认证导出的，并由共享驱动施加的约束得到加强。该研究确定了共享驱动纠缠动力学的基本成本，并为未来的门控制策略评估建立了基准。
authors: Yusheng Zhao, Han Wang, Mingrui Jing, Zhongyi Ni, Xin Wang, Jie Wang, Jinguo Liu

articles.title: Weak Values in Postselected Quantum Trajectories
articles.title_zh: 后选择量子轨迹中的弱值
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07404v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Weak value (WV) describes the amplified response of a meter when the measured system undergoes postselection. While conventional WV theory mainly rests on a single system-meter interaction setting, it remains unexplored whether WV can act as an effective pointer for sequential quantum measurements under postselection. Here we introduce the concept of WVs to the setting of sequential quantum measurements and quantum trajectories. We find that WV naturally emerges in postselected quantum trajectories of sequential weak measurements, by establishing a connection between the WV of the measured observable and the postselected statistics of quantum trajectories. Using sequential weak measurements on a qubit or an oscillator implemented by Ramsey interferometry with an ancilla qubit, we show that postselection shifts the collective record polarization away from the unconditioned ones, with an effective bias described by the WV. Our predictions are feasible to test in various platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 弱值描述了当被测量系统经历后选择时，测量仪器的放大响应。本研究将弱值概念引入到序列量子测量和量子轨迹的背景中。我们发现，通过建立测量可观测量弱值与后选择量子轨迹统计之间的联系，弱值自然地出现在序列弱测量的后选择量子轨迹中。使用拉姆齐干涉仪对量子比特或振荡器进行的序列弱测量表明，后选择会使集体记录极化偏离未条件极化，其有效偏差由弱值描述。这些预测在各种平台上都可行。
authors: Janarbek Yuanbek, Yuan-De Jin, Wen-Long Ma

articles.title: Information flow control in hybrid quantum networks
articles.title_zh: 混合量子网络中的信息流控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07440v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum resources can change the dynamical features and operational behaviors of conventional networks. Long-distance entanglement supports information transfer between nodes lacking a direct connection. This entanglement link not only modifies the stationary effective connectivity of the network but can also be used to suppress undesirable classical dynamics. By examining information flow control mechanism, we demonstrate that classical collective behavior can be well-balanced by altering the initially distributed entanglement. We show the entanglement thresholds for two distinct control approaches: linear response control and Lyapunov functional controllability.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子资源可以改变传统网络的动态特性和操作行为。长距离纠缠支持缺乏直接连接节点之间的信息传输。这种纠缠链路不仅修改了网络的稳态有效连接性，还可以用于抑制不希望的经典动力学。通过检查信息流控制机制，我们证明了通过改变初始分布的纠缠，可以很好地平衡经典集体行为。我们展示了两种不同控制方法：线性响应控制和李雅普诺夫函数可控性的纠缠阈值。
authors: Michael Siomau

articles.title: Elimination of quantum causal confusion in the presence of dual states
articles.title_zh: 在双重态存在下消除量子因果混淆
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07449v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: There is a rich class of bipartite quantum correlations between qubits which are consistent both with measurements performed in parallel and measurements performed in sequence. This phenomenon has recently been termed emphquantum causal confusion, which is made mathematically precise by the notion of a dual state---a bipartite density operator whose associated correlations are causally ambiguous. A natural question is then whether or not the spatial and temporal scenarios associated with a dual state are fundamentally indistinguishable from a causal perspective. Here we show that as long as the reduced density operator of a dual state is oblique---meaning that all coefficients in its Pauli expansion are non-zero---then the underlying joint probabilities giving rise to such causally ambiguous correlations will differ in the spatial and temporal scenarios. Specifically, the temporal joint probabilities will inherently violate the no-signalling condition, thus eliminating quantum causal confusion. Moreover, as oblique states form an open dense subset of the Bloch ball, the elimination of quantum causal confusion is the norm rather than an exception.
articles.abstract_zh: 存在一类丰富的量子比特之间的双体量子关联，它们与并行和顺序执行的测量都一致，这种现象被称为量子因果混淆。本研究表明，只要双重态的约化密度算符是斜的（即其泡利展开中的所有系数均非零），那么导致这种因果模糊关联的潜在联合概率在空间和时间场景中将有所不同。具体而言，时间联合概率将固有地违反无信号条件，从而消除量子因果混淆。鉴于斜态构成了布洛赫球的一个开放稠密子集，量子因果混淆的消除是常态而非例外。
authors: James Fullwood, Weixiang Ye

articles.title: Bell Test and Quantum State-Space Geometry
articles.title_zh: 贝尔检验与量子态空间几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07450v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We explore a minimal phenomenological model of coupling between the geometry of the classical spacetime and the quantum state space. Assuming a simple structure of the combined manifold, bilinear interaction between the corresponding geometric scalars and the simplest case of the two-qubit entanglement dynamics, we derive an illustrative upper bound on the geometric coupling constant from the requirement of the Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt (CHSH) inequality violation over a finite time interval.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探索了一个经典时空几何与量子态空间耦合的最小唯象模型。假设组合流形具有简单的结构，以及相应的几何标量之间的双线性相互作用和最简单的两量子比特纠缠动力学情况，我们从有限时间间隔内Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt (CHSH) 不等式违反的要求中，推导出了几何耦合常数的说明性上限。这项工作为理解量子与时空几何的相互作用提供了新的视角。
authors: Michael Siomau

articles.title: Observation of Inter-Transition Interference
articles.title_zh: 跃迁间干涉的观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07768v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many well-known quantum interference phenomena are associated with coherent superpositions of quantum states. Recent theoretical work showed that dissipative coupling between transition coherences can give rise to a distinct form of quantum interference in open quantum systems, termed inter-transition interference (ITI). Here we experimentally observe ITI through coherent microwave reflection spectroscopy of a superconducting artificial atom realized by a Kerr parametric oscillator. Using strong parametric driving, we access a regime in which two transitions become nearly degenerate and simultaneously contribute to the reflected response. The observed spectral lineshapes are not adequately captured by a model of independent transitions. By contrast, theoretical calculations that incorporate dissipative coupling between the corresponding transition coherences reproduce the essential features of the measured spectra. These results provide experimental evidence for ITI and demonstrate that dissipative coupling between transition coherences can qualitatively modify spectroscopic responses. More broadly, our work identifies transition coherences as a new arena for quantum interference in open quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 许多著名的量子干涉现象与量子态的相干叠加有关。最近的理论工作表明，开放量子系统中跃迁相干性之间的耗散耦合可以产生一种独特的量子干涉形式，称为跃迁间干涉（ITI）。本研究通过超导人工原子（由克尔参量振荡器实现）的相干微波反射光谱实验观测到了ITI。我们发现，观测到的光谱线形无法通过独立跃迁模型充分捕捉，而包含跃迁相干性之间耗散耦合的理论计算则能重现测量光谱的基本特征。这些结果为ITI提供了实验证据，并表明跃迁相干性之间的耗散耦合可以定性地改变光谱响应。
authors: Toyofumi Ishikawa, Shumpei Masuda, Akiyoshi Tomonaga, Kosuke Mizuno, Kunihiro Inomata

articles.title: Development of time-resolved fluorescence spectroscopy using heralded emission spectroscopy for organic light-emitting materials
articles.title_zh: 利用预示发射光谱法开发有机发光材料的时间分辨荧光光谱技术
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07770v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Organic light-emitting materials are widely used in optoelectronics and bioimaging, but sometimes conventional fluorescence spectroscopy techniques can be limited by scattering, background fluorescence, photon pile-up and photobleaching. We report a quantum-spectroscopic approach using frequency-entangled, nondegenerate photon pairs generated via spontaneous parametric down-conversion with heralded detection, to perform photoluminescence lifetime measurements at low excitation intensities. We demonstrate this approach across three organic light-emitting material classes: the fluorescent dye Rhodamine 6G, an organic semiconducting conjugated polymer poly[2-methoxy-5-(2-ethylhexyloxy)-1,4-phenylenevinylene] (MEH-PPV), and a fluorescent protein mOrange. The intrinsic timing correlation between signal and idler photons enables coincidence gating that suppresses uncorrelated background counts. Across all materials and integration times of 500, 1000 and 3600 seconds, heralded detection yields signal-to-noise ratios 1.6-3.0 times higher than classical pulsed-laser excitation attenuated to match heralded photon counts in the fitting range. For MEH-PPV, this roughly halves the noise amplitude. Our measured lifetimes closely match long-integration classical pulsed-laser reference values.
articles.abstract_zh: 有机发光材料广泛应用于光电子学和生物成像，但传统荧光光谱技术有时会受到散射、背景荧光、光子堆积和光漂白等限制。本研究报告了一种量子光谱方法，利用自发参量下转换产生的频率纠缠非简并光子对，结合预示探测，在低激发强度下进行光致发光寿命测量。该方法在三种有机发光材料上进行了验证，结果显示，在所有材料和积分时间下，预示探测的信噪比比匹配预示光子计数的经典脉冲激光激发高1.6-3.0倍。这项工作为有机发光材料的表征提供了一种高信噪比的量子光谱方法。
authors: Nicola J. Fairbairn, Koya Onoda, Ozora Iso, Masahiro Yabuno, Hirotaka Terai, Shigehito Miki, Yuji Kagotani, Motoyasu Adachi, Gordon J. Hedley, Ryosuke Shimizu

articles.title: Discrete quadrature spectrum of composite bosons: Weyl relation, intensity correlations, and binned homodyne detection
articles.title_zh: 复合玻色子的离散正交谱：外尔关系、强度关联和分箱零差探测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07776v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A composite boson made of two fermions can look elementary under one measurement and composite under another. In an exactly solvable paired-mode model we compare three probes: classical drives, periodically binned quadrature statistics, and intensity correlations g⁽²⁾. The Weyl defect has an exact product formula and a controlled dilute expansion in the Schmidt moments. The binned observables are instead piecewise constant in the Schmidt weights and sensitive to single eigenvalues crossing bin edges; on the flat-spectrum ladder they converge slowly and nonmonotonically over the computed range. A spectral filter and a polar correction recover an exact Pauli algebra; a heralded joint projection then extracts a logical singlet from the vacua of two independent copies of the composite, with probability set by the accepted weight and the mixedness of the filtered reduced qubit. Finite-mode examples with Schmidt number about three succeed at the percent level despite order-one Weyl defects; near-unit g⁽²⁾ does not control the binned algebra. For flat spectra the construction converges strongly to its oscillator counterpart, whose vacuum overlap is strictly positive at every scale; for infinite spectra with summable Schmidt amplitudes it converges at all but countably many filter cutoffs, positivity at the cutoffs studied remaining open.
articles.abstract_zh: 由两个费米子组成的复合玻色子在不同测量下可能表现出基本或复合特性。本研究在一个精确可解的配对模式模型中比较了三种探测方法：经典驱动、周期性分箱正交统计和强度关联g⁽²⁾。研究发现，外尔缺陷具有精确的乘积公式和受控的稀疏施密特矩展开。分箱可观测量在施密特权重上是分段常数，并且对跨越箱边缘的单个本征值敏感。对于平坦谱阶梯，它们在计算范围内收敛缓慢且非单调。该研究还通过谱滤波器和极性校正恢复了精确的泡利代数，并通过预示联合投影从两个独立复合体的真空中提取逻辑单重态。
authors: Itzhak Roditi

articles.title: Constrained Quantum Imaginary Time in Krylov Space
articles.title_zh: Krylov空间中的受限量子虚时间演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07800v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce constrained quantum imaginary time evolution (CQITE), extending quantum imaginary time evolution (QITE) to constrained-search dynamics for ground-state preparation with prescribed expectation-value constraints. A central challenge in practical QITE is constructing a compact unitary representation of the imaginary-time evolution while maintaining accuracy and controlling the approximation error. We resolve this challenge by deriving an exact characterization of the imaginary-time evolution from the Krylov space generated by repeated applications of the Hamiltonian to the initial state. This characterization induces a hierarchy of operator directions expressed through nested anti-commutators. Truncating the hierarchy produces a systematic static operator pool, with polynomial size in the system size at any fixed truncation order. The resulting construction provides a principled route to compact unitary approximations of imaginary-time dynamics. Numerical tests on spin models show close agreement with exact constrained imaginary-time evolution and small constraint deviations, while a fermionic example yields energies close to the analytic constrained-search reference.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究引入了受限量子虚时间演化（CQITE），将量子虚时间演化（QITE）扩展到具有预设期望值约束的基态制备受限搜索动力学。我们通过从哈密顿量对初始态重复应用生成的Krylov空间中导出虚时间演化的精确表征，解决了构建紧凑酉表示的关键挑战。这种表征通过嵌套反交换子诱导了算符方向的层次结构。截断该层次结构可产生一个系统的静态算符池，其大小在任何固定截断阶数下都与系统大小呈多项式关系。数值测试表明，该方法在自旋模型上与精确受限虚时间演化高度一致，且约束偏差很小，在费米子示例中也获得了接近基态的能量。
authors: Daniele Cuomo, Luis Cort Barrada, Michał Studziński, Robert van Leeuwen

articles.title: Multirobust Control Pulses Designed by Iterative Quantum Kolmogorov-Arnold-Moser Algorithm
articles.title_zh: 迭代量子Kolmogorov-Arnold-Moser算法设计的多鲁棒控制脉冲
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07802v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a multi-robust quantum control strategy designed to suppress multilevel leakage outside the computational qubit space while simultaneously ensuring robustness against unknown inhomogeneities in control parameters. It is based on a reformulation of the Derivative Removal by Adiabatic Gate (DRAG) technique which allows for the full incorporation of control pulses originally designed for two-level models by using the iterative quantum Kolmogorov-Arnold-Moser (KAM) algorithm. We apply it for optimal robust control designed by inverse optimization (RIO), referred to as RDK pulses. We analyze the performance of RDK pulses on various durations, iterations, and robustness types. We show that the two-level robustness is restored after only a few iterations with an asymptotic exponential approximation (i.e. as a superasymptotic series), even for relatively short pulse durations and that the resulting pulses are near optimal in terms of energy compared to the optimal RIO pulses defined in the qubit subspace. Such pulses are well suited for superconducting transmons as well as other forms of qubits embedded in a multi-level structure. By effectively reproducing a two-level dynamics within a multi-level system, this approach is versatile thanks to its compatibility with two-level control strategies under conditions (smoothness, duration) that are analyzed.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种多鲁棒量子控制策略，旨在抑制计算量子比特空间外的多能级泄漏，同时确保对控制参数未知不均匀性的鲁棒性。该策略基于绝热门导数消除（DRAG）技术的重新表述，并利用迭代量子Kolmogorov-Arnold-Moser (KAM) 算法整合控制脉冲。研究表明，即使在相对较短的脉冲持续时间内，经过少量迭代后，两能级鲁棒性也能恢复，且所得脉冲在能量方面接近最优。这些脉冲特别适用于超导transmon及其他嵌入多能级结构的量子比特。
authors: Meri Harutyunyan, Stéphane Guérin

articles.title: Autler-townes energy-level engineering for high-quality all-microwave qubit gate
articles.title_zh: 用于高质量全微波量子比特门的Autler-Townes能级工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07967v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-fidelity entangling gates are essential for realizing large-scale fault-tolerant superconducting quantum computing, yet existing approaches are limited: frequency-tuning techniques induce decoherence, while all-microwave-driven schemes suffer the trade-off between gate speed and leakage rate. Here, we introduce an energy-level engineering technique that employs the Autler-Townes effect to manipulate the nonlinearity of qubits without perturbing the computational subspace or degrading coherence time. This approach enables an experimentally validated, fast (97 ns) and high-fidelity (99.40(9)%) CZ gate, where error analysis reveals that gate errors arise mainly from static decoherence. The scheme facilitates fast, high-quality all-microwave gate operations with a simple topology and can be applied across various quantum platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 高保真纠缠门是实现大规模容错超导量子计算的关键。本文提出了一种利用Autler-Townes效应的能级工程技术，能够在不扰动计算子空间或降低相干时间的情况下，操纵量子比特的非线性。该方法实验验证了一个快速（97 ns）且高保真度（99.40(9)%）的CZ门，误差分析表明门误差主要来源于静态退相干。该方案以简单的拓扑结构实现了快速、高质量的全微波门操作，并可应用于多种量子平台。
authors: Wan-Peng Gao, Xiao-Liang He, Zheng-Qi Niu, Si-Qi Li, Da-Qiang Bao, Kuang Liu, Jian-Qiang You, Jaw-Shen Tsai, Zhen Wang, Zhi-Rong Lin

articles.title: From maximum work to maximum power in an optimally controlled quantum Ising Otto engine
articles.title_zh: 最优控制量子伊辛奥托引擎中从最大功到最大功率的转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08025v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In finite-time quantum Otto engines, maximizing power requires balancing the duration of the unitary strokes against the losses from nonadiabatic excitations. We address this trade-off in an Otto engine with a free-fermion working medium, using quantum optimal control. Having determined the single-particle energy scales that maximize ideal work at fixed reservoir temperatures, we realize them as the two endpoint Hamiltonians of a transverse-field Ising chain, connected by a path that crosses the quantum critical point. Optimal control of the unitary strokes yields near-ideal work on a time scale growing linearly with system size, instead of quadratically as for linear driving. We derive a time-rescaling relation that maps protocols with different energy scales onto a single reference problem and, for complete thermalization strokes of fixed duration, use it to build an analytical model of the cycle power. The model predicts two competing maximum-power regimes: a slow branch that approaches the ideal work, and a fast, size-independent branch that trades work for a shorter cycle and dominates above a crossover size, in quantitative agreement with numerical optimal-control results. It also identifies power-optimal energy scales that differ from the work-optimal ones and further increase the power. Our results provide a predictive approach to jointly optimizing the operating conditions and finite-time dynamics of quantum heat engines.
articles.abstract_zh: 在有限时间量子奥托引擎中，最大化功率需要在酉冲程持续时间与非绝热激发损失之间取得平衡。本文利用量子最优控制，研究了以自由费米子为工作介质的奥托引擎中的这种权衡。通过最优控制，酉冲程在与系统尺寸线性增长的时间尺度上产生接近理想的功。研究导出了一个时间重标关系，并构建了一个循环功率的分析模型，该模型预测了两种竞争的最大功率机制：一个接近理想功的慢速分支，以及一个以牺牲功换取更短循环的快速、与尺寸无关的分支。
authors: Vincenzo Roberto Arezzo, Davide Rossini, Giuseppe E. Santoro, Giulia Piccitto

articles.title: Approaching quantum limits in sub-Rayleigh resolution using phase modulation optimization
articles.title_zh: 利用相位调制优化实现亚瑞利分辨率的量子极限逼近
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08034v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatial-mode demultiplexing (SPADE) has made significant progress in incoherent optical imaging and has been implemented through various experimental approaches. Holography-based SPADE is widely used in proof-of-principle experiments because of its low cost, stable optical arrangement, and ease of implementation. However, its low photon utilization severely limits its practical applications. Alternating Fourier transforms and phase modulations can implement unitary optical transformations. Building on this idea, we use backpropagation to optimize the phase profiles of spatial light modulators (SLMs) and thereby design quantum measurements that are efficient in both information and energy. We study centroid--separation estimation for two incoherent point sources, using Fisher information or the estimation errors of an auxiliary neural network estimator as optimization objectives. As the number of SLMs increases, the optimized measurements approach the quantum limits characterized by the quantum Cramér-Rao bound and the information-regret tradeoff relation. With a few SLMs, our method can outperform direct imaging, showing its potential for superresolution imaging.
articles.abstract_zh: 空间模式解复用（SPADE）在非相干光学成像中取得了显著进展，但基于全息的SPADE因光子利用率低而限制了其实际应用。本文提出了一种利用反向传播优化空间光调制器（SLMs）相位剖面的方法，以设计信息和能量效率高的量子测量。研究以Fisher信息或辅助神经网络估计器的估计误差为优化目标，对两个非相干点源的质心分离估计进行了研究。结果表明，随着SLM数量的增加，优化后的测量方法能够逼近量子极限，并且在少量SLM的情况下，该方法优于直接成像，展现了其潜力。
authors: Chao-Ning Hu, Jun Xin, Xiao-Ming Lu

articles.title: Effective Thermodynamics of a Volume-Dependent Qubit
articles.title_zh: 体积依赖型量子比特的有效热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08040v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop an effective thermodynamics for a qubit whose energy gap depends inversely on a volume-like control parameter, Δ(V)=Δ₀/V, where V is a spectral-control coordinate rather than a literal mechanical volume. Starting from the canonical Gibbs state, we derive a complete thermodynamic structure from the Helmholtz potential and its Legendre and stability properties, including the fundamental relation S(U,V), a generalized pressure conjugate to V, the equation of state U=PV, the first law, and the associated Maxwell relations. Reversible adiabats preserve the Gibbs populations and satisfy TV=const. and PV²⁼const., corresponding to an effective exponent γ=2. The resulting effective Carnot cycle attains the Carnot efficiency, ηCₐᵣₙₒₜ=1-T_C/T_H, whereas the Otto cycle yields ηOₜₜₒ=1-Vₘᵢₙ/Vₘₐₓ and remains strictly sub-Carnot at finite work output. We identify the source of Otto irreversibility exactly: entropy is produced entirely during the isochoric thermalizations, and the cycle entropy production quantifies the informational mismatch between the adiabatically transported states and the reservoir-selected Gibbs states through the sum of the corresponding quantum relative entropies. Finally, we show that unitary-generated nonpassivity can act as a nonequilibrium battery, producing an apparent efficiency above Carnot when its preparation cost is omitted. At the same time, complete work accounting restores the thermodynamic bound.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为能量间隙反向依赖于类体积控制参数Δ(V)=Δ₀/V的量子比特，发展了一种有效的热力学理论。从正则吉布斯态出发，推导了完整的热力学结构，包括基本关系S(U,V)、广义压力、状态方程U=PV、第一定律和麦克斯韦关系。研究发现，可逆绝热过程保持吉布斯布居数，并满足TV=常数和PV²=常数，对应于有效指数γ=2。由此产生的有效卡诺循环达到了卡诺效率，而奥托循环的效率低于卡诺效率。研究精确识别了奥托循环不可逆性的来源，即熵完全产生于等容热化过程。
authors: André T. Cesário, Marcela Herrera

articles.title: Coupling between molecular exchange qubits
articles.title_zh: 分子交换量子比特之间的耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08058v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin triangles are promising systems for defining and manipulating scalar degrees of freedom, such as chirality, partial spin sums, or combinations between the two. Here we extend this analysis to dimers formed by pairs of spin triangles, coupled by exchange or dipolar interactions. We show that the weak-coupling limit warrants the introduction of an effective two-qubit picture, and derive the expressions of the related Hamiltonians as a function of the underlying physical interaction between the triangles. We benchmark this two-qubit Hamiltonian against the microscopic one, and discuss the observable effects of the inter-triangle coupling on the spin-electric transitions between states with different chiralities or partial-spin sums.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋三角形是定义和操纵手性、部分自旋和等标量自由度的有前景系统。本文将此分析扩展到由自旋三角形对形成的二聚体，这些二聚体通过交换或偶极相互作用耦合。研究表明，弱耦合极限下可以引入有效的双量子比特图像，并推导了相关哈密顿量作为三角形之间物理相互作用的函数。该研究将双量子比特哈密顿量与微观哈密顿量进行基准测试，并讨论了三角形间耦合对不同手性或部分自旋和态之间自旋电跃迁的可观测效应。
authors: Filippo Troiani, Jason S. R. McCoombs, Athanassios K. Boudalis

articles.title: Exponential mixing time for the Davies dynamics of the quantum random energy model
articles.title_zh: 量子随机能量模型Davies动力学的指数混合时间
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08064v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We prove exponentially slow thermalization for the quantum random energy model (QREM) under Davies dynamics. The QREM is the n-qubit Hamiltonian H=Γ T+U, where U assigns independent Gaussian energies with variance equal to the system size to computational-basis configurations and T is the transverse field generated by single-qubit Pauli X operators. Let β_c=sqrt2łog 2 be the freezing inverse temperature of the classical random energy model. For every inverse temperature β>β_c and every transverse-field strength 0łeqΓ<Γ_c(β), where eββ_c=2o̧sh(βΓ_c(β)), we show that the mixing time of the dissipative Davies dynamics associated with single-qubit Pauli system--bath couplings grows exponentially with the system size, almost surely; the bound is unchanged if the standard zero-Bohr-frequency dephasing terms are included. The result is uniform over all Davies rates satisfying detailed balance and a polynomial upper bound and does not assume primitivity. In the spin-glass phase, the Gibbs weight is carried by a sparse family of deep classical configurations that are separated by an extensive Hamming distance. A localization theorem for the QREM [Manai, Warzel, Comm. Math. Phys. 402, 1259 (2023)] transfers this geometry to the corresponding low-energy quantum eigenstates. Consequently, the Gibbs weight of the intermediate spectral sector is exponentially small, while single-qubit bath operators have exponentially small matrix elements between the two macroscopic sides of the bottleneck. A Davies-specific flux estimate then converts these two facts into an exponential lower bound on the mixing time. This gives a rigorous open-system dynamical manifestation of the frozen, localized low-energy structure of the QREM throughout its equilibrium spin-glass phase below the quantum transition line.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了量子随机能量模型（QREM）在Davies动力学下存在指数级慢热化现象。QREM是一个n量子比特哈密顿量H=Γ T+U。研究表明，对于每个逆温度β>β_c和每个横向场强度0≤Γ<Γ_c(β)，与单量子比特泡利系统-浴耦合相关的耗散Davies动力学的混合时间几乎肯定地随系统尺寸呈指数增长。该结果对所有满足详细平衡和多项式上限的Davies速率都是一致的，并且不假设原始性。在自旋玻璃相中，吉布斯权重由稀疏的深层经典构型族承载，这些构型由广泛的汉明距离分隔。
authors: Giacomo De Palma, Emanuele Mingione

articles.title: Nonuniform Time-bins for Making Raw QRNG Outputs Uniform
articles.title_zh: 用于使原始量子随机数生成器输出均匀的非均匀时间箱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08096v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Random numbers play a vital role in scientific simulations and cryptography. Both randomness and security are critical requirements for random number generators (RNGs). However, classical RNGs often rely on mathematical assumptions that can compromise security, while quantum RNGs (QRNGs) face challenges, including non-uniform output due to the lack of specialized single-photon sources. In this work, we propose a QRNG model that generates uniformly distributed random numbers using a standard coherent photon source, without requiring heavy attenuation or post-processing. Although the raw data is theoretically free of bias, post-processing, if any, may be required to suppress any classical noise and device imperfections. The proposed method analytically equalizes the output probabilities under the assumed photon-arrival-time model, potentially reducing the need for heavy attenuation and post-processing to correct binning bias. We evaluate the method using real photon-detection timestamps and compare its statistical performance with conventional uniform time binning using the NIST, Dieharder, and ENT test suites. The results demonstrate improved statistical performance for the proposed binning scheme under the tested conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 随机数在科学模拟和密码学中至关重要，但量子随机数生成器（QRNGs）常因缺乏专用单光子源而面临输出非均匀的挑战。本文提出了一种QRNG模型，该模型使用标准相干光子源生成均匀分布的随机数，无需大量衰减或后处理。该方法在假定的光子到达时间模型下，分析性地均衡了输出概率，从而可能减少校正分箱偏差所需的衰减和后处理。通过使用真实光子检测时间戳评估，该方法在统计性能上优于传统均匀时间分箱，并在NIST、Dieharder和ENT测试套件中表现良好。
authors: Nirupam Basak, Goutam Paul

articles.title: Quantum trajectory of a spin oscillator, continuous retrodiction beyond the Heisenberg uncertainty relation
articles.title_zh: 自旋振荡器的量子轨迹：超越海森堡不确定性关系的连续回溯预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08104v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Heisenberg uncertainty relation in quantum mechanics limits the precision of predicting the outcome of measurements of any non-commuting observables. However, this restriction does not apply to retrodictive guessing of the outcomes of past measurements. Here, we experimentally demonstrate this using a spin oscillator consisting of  5.17 × 10¹⁰ rubidium atoms. Through weak continuous measurements, we monitor canonical spin observables hatxA and hatpA with [hatxA,hatpA] = ihbar. By combining information obtained before and after time t, we retrodict the outcomes of measurements of hatxA and hatpA at time t with variances that remain, concurrently over 1.4 hours, sim 1.01 dB below the bound set by the Heisenberg uncertainty relation. We also infer and demonstrate the ability to retrodict, with the same precision, the measurement outcomes for arbitrary quadratures of the spin oscillator. This brings interesting prospects for further research on quantum measurements, and for quantum-enhanced sensing that combines trajectory and entanglement strategies.
articles.abstract_zh: 海森堡不确定性关系限制了对非对易可观测量测量结果的预测精度，但此限制不适用于对过去测量结果的回溯预测。本文通过一个由5.17 × 10¹⁰个铷原子组成的自旋振荡器，实验证明了这一点。通过弱连续测量，研究人员在1.4小时内，以比海森堡不确定性关系设定的界限低约1.01 dB的方差，回溯预测了自旋可观测量hatxA和hatpA在时间t的测量结果。这项工作为量子测量和结合轨迹与纠缠策略的量子增强传感带来了新的前景。
authors: Peiying Li, Junlei Duan, Suotang Jia, Klaus Mølmer, Yanhong Xiao

articles.title: Semi-Analytical Geometric Synthesis of Robust Quantum Controls
articles.title_zh: 鲁棒量子控制的半解析几何合成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08107v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-fidelity quantum gates are a central requirement for fault-tolerant quantum computation, yet their implementation is limited by the sensitivity of qubits to environmental noise and by control non-idealities. To mitigate these effects, quantum gates can be designed as dynamically corrected gates (DCGs), where control sequences are engineered to suppress the impact of errors on the resulting operation. Many methods in the literature are able to synthesize DCGs, but they typically rely on numerical optimization, with synthesis times on the order of minutes per gate. Here, we propose an automated semi-analytical method that reduces this cost by orders of magnitude, synthesizing smooth, robust control pulses in tens of milliseconds rather than minutes, with comparable fidelity and robustness. Our approach is based on the Space Curve Quantum Control (SCQC) formalism, where quantum evolution is mapped onto a geometric space curve whose geometric properties determine the target gate and its robustness. We parameterize the curve in the Frenet-Serret frame and employ the Pontryagin Maximum Principle (PMP) to design controls that are robust against both amplitude and dephasing errors. The PMP is formulated as a boundary-value problem and solved using a shooting method. The Frenet-Serret frame is integrated using Rodrigues' formula. Starting from a reference solution, we gradually vary the target rotation angle to construct a library of solutions, whose interpolation provides initial guesses for the shooting parameters of new target gates. We evaluated the method on 2,000 single-qubit rotations, obtaining a mean local optimization time of 39.945 ms per gate after preparation of the interpolation base. Quantum propagation yielded nominal gate infidelities below 10⁻⁹ after virtual phase correction, with verified robustness against quasistatic amplitude and dephasing errors.
articles.abstract_zh: 高保真量子门是容错量子计算的核心要求，但其实现受限于量子比特对环境噪声和控制非理想性的敏感度。本文提出了一种自动化的半解析方法，用于合成平滑、鲁棒的控制脉冲，将合成时间从数分钟缩短至数十毫秒，同时保持可比的保真度和鲁棒性。该方法基于空间曲线量子控制（SCQC）形式主义，将量子演化映射到几何空间曲线，其几何特性决定了目标门及其鲁棒性。研究在Frenet-Serret框架中参数化曲线，并利用庞特里亚金最大值原理（PMP）设计鲁棒控制。
authors: Eduardo Willwock Lussi, Rafael de Santiago, Eduardo Inacio Duzzioni, Hector Bessa Silveira

articles.title: Accelerating Quantum-Classical Auxiliary-Field Quantum Monte Carlo with Shadow-Trained Neural Quantum States
articles.title_zh: 利用影子训练的神经网络量子态加速量子-经典辅助场量子蒙特卡洛
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08129v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum-classical auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo (QC-AFQMC) uses a trial state prepared on a quantum computer to improve the accuracy of the classical AFQMC algorithm. State-of-the-art QC-AFQMC represents this state with matchgate shadows, so every trial-walker overlap and local energy must be averaged over many snapshots, making this classical computation a bottleneck. Here we distill the matchgate shadow data into a symmetry-constrained, noise-aware, autoregressive transformer neural quantum state (NQS). Used as the AFQMC trial state, the NQS evaluates overlaps, force biases, and local energies without repeatedly summing over the matchgate shadows. For a nickel-catalyzed oxidative-addition reaction, the noise-awareness of our NQS design successfully recovers the ideal-upCCD AFQMC barrier and reaction energy within statistical uncertainty, while standard QC-AFQMC execution with the same shadow data yields qualitatively inaccurate results as a result of hardware noise. Since the shadow data are needed only for training, the estimated classical cost for the nickel system falls by approximately 99% relative to our previous QC-AFQMC implementation.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子-经典辅助场量子蒙特卡洛（QC-AFQMC）利用量子计算机上制备的试探态来提高经典AFQMC算法的精度。本文将匹配门影子数据提炼成一个对称约束、噪声感知、自回归变换器神经网络量子态（NQS）。作为AFQMC试探态，NQS无需重复对匹配门影子求和即可评估重叠、力偏置和局部能量。对于镍催化的氧化加成反应，NQS设计成功地在统计不确定性范围内恢复了理想的upCCD AFQMC势垒和反应能。由于影子数据仅用于训练，镍系统的估计经典成本相对于之前的QC-AFQMC降低了约99%。
authors: Justin Provazza, Oliver Knitter, Joshua Goings, Evgeny Epifanovsky, Chi Chen, Martin Roetteler, Luning Zhao

articles.title: Machine learning quantum data to accelerate quantum Monte Carlo
articles.title_zh: 机器学习量子数据以加速量子蒙特卡洛
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08151v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Simulating strongly correlated electrons in molecules and materials remains a central goal for quantum computing. A promising strategy uses quantum processors to prepare trial wavefunctions that guide classical quantum Monte Carlo (QMC). However, the enormous computational cost of repeatedly processing quantum measurements has severely limited the practical scalability of this approach. Here, we overcome this bottleneck by compressing quantum measurement data into machine-learning models that efficiently provide the wavefunction overlaps needed by QMC. This accelerates quantum-classical QMC by orders of magnitude, enabling chemically accurate simulations on up to 40 qubits, more than doubling the scale of previous hardware demonstrations with comparable accuracy. We demonstrate our approach on hydrogen chains and strongly correlated iron-sulfur clusters using measurements from Google's Willow processor. By enabling efficient reuse of quantum-state information on the classical coprocessor, our framework addresses a fundamental bottleneck in hybrid quantum algorithms that will persist even into the fault-tolerant era.
articles.abstract_zh: 模拟分子和材料中的强关联电子是量子计算的核心目标。一种有前景的策略是利用量子处理器制备试探波函数来指导经典量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）计算。然而，重复处理量子测量的巨大计算成本严重限制了该方法的实际可扩展性。本文通过将量子测量数据压缩到机器学习模型中，高效地提供QMC所需的波函数重叠，从而克服了这一瓶颈，将量子-经典QMC加速了数个数量级，实现了多达40个量子比特的化学精度模拟。
authors: Tong Jiang, Andrew Zhao, Shashwat Kumar, Jigyasa Nigam, Eliott Rosenberg, Ryan Babbush, Andrew D. Baczewski, William J. Huggins, Joonho Lee

articles.title: QDiff: Differential Testing of Quantum Software Stacks
articles.title_zh: QDiff：量子软件栈的差分测试
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08220v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Over the past few years, several quantum software stacks (QSS) have been developed in response to rapid hardware advances in quantum computing. A QSS includes a quantum programming language, an optimizing compiler that translates a quantum algorithm written in a high-level language into quantum gate instructions, a quantum simulator that emulates these instructions on a classical device, and a software controller that sends analog signals to a very expensive quantum hardware based on quantum circuits. In comparison to traditional compilers and architecture simulators, QSSes are difficult to tests due to the probabilistic nature of results, the lack of clear hardware specifications, and quantum programming complexity. This work devises a novel differential testing approach for QSSes, named QDIFF with three major innovations: (1) We generate input programs to be tested via semantics-preserving, source to source transformation to explore program variants. (2) We speed up differential testing by filtering out quantum circuits that are not worthwhile to execute on quantum hardware by analyzing static characteristics such as a circuit depth, 2 qubit gate operations, gate error rates, and T1 relaxation time. (3) We design an extensible equivalence checking mechanism via distribution comparison functions such as Kolmogorov Smirnov test and cross entropy
articles.abstract_zh: 随着量子计算硬件的快速发展，量子软件栈（QSS）也应运而生。与传统编译器和架构模拟器相比，QSS的测试因结果的概率性、硬件规范的缺乏和编程复杂性而面临挑战。本文提出了一种名为QDIFF的新型QSS差分测试方法，其主要创新包括通过语义保持的源到源转换生成测试输入程序，以及通过分析电路深度等静态特性来过滤不值得在量子硬件上执行的量子电路，从而加速差分测试。
authors: Jiyuan Wang, Qian Zhang, Guoqing Harry Xu, Miryung Kim

articles.title: Optimal finite-copy readout of three-qubit entanglement with state retention
articles.title_zh: 具有状态保留的三量子比特纠缠的最优有限副本读出
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08233v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: For unknown three-qubit pure states, we characterize the optimal trade-off among GHZ-class certification, binary probability readout of the three-tangle, and conditional state retention. The vanishing ideal of the null class specifies the optimal certification subspace, while a polynomial multiplication operator gives the spectral limit for binary readout. Four copies are necessary for a nonzero certificate. A fifth copy raises the optimal success probability from τ²/48 to 5τ²/72 and permits the original unknown state to be retained, where τ is the three-tangle. We obtain this gain as an instance of a general symmetry-based additional-copy theorem. At six copies the optimal certification probability is (39+2S)τ²/296, with S=sumXTr,h̊oX², whereas the largest exact binary probability is τ²/8. Local Schur measurements and conditional local operations with classical communication attain these bounds. Retaining the full six-copy branch record yields a weighted estimator with lower variance than binary thinning of the same data. Explicit circuits and fixed-budget comparisons connect the success probabilities to input-copy consumption, retained quantum output, and coherent gate cost.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对未知的三量子比特纯态，研究了GHZ类认证、三缠结的二元概率读出以及条件状态保留之间的最佳权衡。研究发现，需要四个副本才能获得非零认证，而第五个副本可将最优成功概率从τ²/48提高到5τ²/72，并允许保留原始未知状态。在六个副本的情况下，最优认证概率为(39+2S)τ²/296，而最大精确二元概率为τ²/8。这些界限可通过局部Schur测量和带有经典通信的条件局部操作实现。
authors: Yu-Xin Wu, Yuan-Hong Tao, Ji-Hui Mo, Peng-Fei Ma, Shu-Hui Wu

articles.title: Persistent level-resolved transmon population after dispersive readout, and the limits of its open-system description
articles.title_zh: 散射读出后持久存在的能级分辨Transmon布居及其开放系统描述的局限性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08235v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We calculate the level-resolved transmon population remaining after dispersive readout with a converged open-system model. The drive and qubit-cavity coupling use the rotating-wave approximation, while the cavity is a quantized mode in a frame displaced by its classical trajectory. At a readout occupation of 80, the model leaves a persistent distribution across the first transmon levels, with p2 = 1.02 x 10⁻³ and p3 = 4.10 x 10⁻⁵ at the end of readout. These populations survive an additional drive-off wait: over 73 ns each level decays by less than 3 percent and follows its own relaxation rate, not the near-factor-of-two drop in residual cavity photons. This identifies the population as bare-level occupation rather than coherent dressing. Channel-removal and bath-model controls attribute p2 mainly to dephasing and p3 and above mainly to relaxation, unchanged across bath models though absolute values vary by up to 15 percent. We also test the coherent drive truncation. In dissipation-free transmon-only benchmarks driven by the classical cavity trajectory, the nearest-neighbour RWA drive underestimates the full charge-operator result while the drive is on. At switch-off for occupation 80, where coherent populations are hundreds of times larger than the residual values, p2(RWA)/p2(full) = 0.905 and p3(RWA)/p3(full) = 0.759, with larger discrepancies at deeper levels. One source is a parity-allowed non-nearest-neighbour charge matrix element omitted by the drive operator. A naive beyond-RWA extension with bare-basis Lindblad dissipators fails a zero-drive ground-state test and serves only as a diagnostic. A dressed-basis (secular) construction instead leaves the dressed ground state stationary at zero drive. The result is a converged RWA prediction of readout-induced population plus direct tests of where the approximation loses quantitative reliability.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文使用收敛的开放系统模型计算了散射读出后Transmon能级分辨的持久布居。研究发现，在读出结束后，Transmon的低能级上存在持久的布居分布，并且这些布居在额外的驱动关闭等待期间仍能存活，表明它们是裸能级布居而非相干修饰。通过通道移除和浴模型控制，将p2主要归因于退相干，而p3及更高能级主要归因于弛豫。研究还测试了相干驱动截断，发现最近邻RWA驱动低估了无耗散Transmon基准中的完整电荷算符结果。
authors: Sinan Bugu

articles.title: Finite-Time Thermodynamic Routing in an Anharmonic Collective Quantum Otto Engine
articles.title_zh: 非谐集体量子奥托发动机中的有限时间热力学路由
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08242v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Gibbs state determined by a thermal reservoir does not determine how a working medium approaches it or how fluctuations accumulate over repeated cycles. We exploit this kinetic freedom in an anharmonic collective quantum Otto engine. A longitudinal interaction separates neighboring Dicke transition frequencies without changing their collective matrix elements, allowing passive spectral shaping to route finite-time transport among edges with different heat costs while preserving the contact Gibbs states. Exact edge-current identities and repeated-cycle counting statistics link this routing to mean work, hot heat, and intercycle work correlations. At fixed thermal-contact exposure, structured reservoirs can increase both mean work and long-time squared precision; equal-work controls distinguish these gains from uniform relaxation-rate changes. The useful regime is mesoscopic, bounded by spectral resolution and physical contact time. An equal-cooling example and a full-spin local-noise study test the mechanism beyond ideal engine operation, the latter retaining a one-cycle precision gain despite spin-sector mixing. In a six-transmon dressed-spectrum model, passive microwave filters at fixed integrated coupling achieve equal mean work with shorter thermal contacts, corresponding to higher contact-time-normalized output, and with long-time squared precision comparable to that of the fastest sampled flat reference. The transition pathways selected by a passive reservoir thus provide a control variable for finite-time performance and accumulated work fluctuations that is independent of thermal equilibrium.
articles.abstract_zh: 热储层确定的吉布斯态并不能完全决定工作介质如何接近它或波动如何累积。本文利用非谐集体量子奥托发动机中的这种动力学自由度，通过纵向相互作用分离相邻的迪克跃迁频率，从而实现被动光谱整形，在不同热成本的边缘之间路由有限时间传输，同时保持接触吉布斯态。研究发现，在固定的热接触暴露下，结构化储层可以同时增加平均功和长时间平方精度。该机制的有用范围是介观的，受限于光谱分辨率和物理接触时间。
authors: Gabriella G. Damas, G. D. de Moraes Neto

articles.title: Recovery gates as a resource in repetition-code process tomography: exhaustive gate-optimal designs for three, five and seven qubits
articles.title_zh: 重复码过程层析成像中作为资源的恢复门：三、五和七量子比特的穷举门最优设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08310v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Process tomography built on stabilizer codes compares the logical channel of a repetition code with a reference channel, and the decoder that produces that channel is almost always fixed to the standard minimum-weight one. We ask how many physical single-qubit Pauli gates the decoder actually needs when the measurement basis is fixed---the constraint under which the count is a resource rather than a bookkeeping artefact. Exhaustive enumeration of every recovery design for n=3, 5 and 7 qubits, with rank decided by exact modular arithmetic at two primes, gives minimal counts of 0, 1 and 5 gates, against 6, 10 and 14 for first-order decoding and 6, 50 and 308 for full minimum-weight decoding. The count depends only on how many sites are corrected and never on which, so the two halves of the design problem separate. Correcting more sites is not monotonically better: at n=7 full decoding loses three dimensions of rank, and under a calibration-residual floor the precision curve at n=3 is U-shaped. The three-gate design is 9.5 times more precise than the standard six-gate decoder at the median of 40 sampled working points, and more precise at every one of them (1.8 to 88 times); the size of that factor belongs to the working point, the ordering does not. Reaching a 10,mrad rms error then costs 1.2×10⁷ shots in 65,s on a current superconducting device at a well-conditioned point, while nge5 stays out of reach for conditioning reasons rather than gate-count reasons. Finally, the optimal designs are not covariant under chain reversal: they separate the mirror pair of arXiv:2610.19779 by 1.3×10⁻³ while leaving the Jacobian at full rank.
articles.abstract_zh: 稳定子码上的过程层析成像通常使用标准最小权重解码器。本文探讨了在测量基固定时，解码器实际所需的物理单量子比特泡利门数量。通过对n=3、5和7量子比特的每个恢复设计进行穷举枚举，发现最小门计数分别为0、1和5，远低于一阶解码和完全最小权重解码。研究表明，门计数仅取决于纠正的站点数量，并且纠正更多站点并非单调更好。例如，三门设计在40个采样工作点的中位数处比标准六门解码器精确9.5倍。
authors: Long Huang

articles.title: Testing Gravitationally-Induced-Entanglement with Massive Particles and Quantum Clocks
articles.title_zh: 利用大质量粒子和量子时钟测试引力诱导纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08313v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present an experimental proposal to test whether gravity can entangle a levitated particle with an array of quantum clocks. By harnessing the collective interaction between a micrometer-scale particle and an array of ultra-precise nuclear clocks, our scheme offers a conceivable path to observing gravitationally mediated entanglement with quantum clocks in the laboratory. Crucially, this setup will probe a genuinely relativistic effect one that requires the contribution of internal clock energy to active gravitational mass and cannot arise from the Newtonian interaction between fixed masses. Therefore, observing this entanglement would provide evidence for the quantised nature of active gravitational mass -- which has not been tested in any prior experiment -- rather than for spatial coherence of fixed masses,which is routinely tested in matterwave interferometers
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一项实验方案，旨在测试引力是否能使悬浮粒子与量子时钟阵列纠缠。该方案利用微米级粒子与超精密核时钟阵列之间的集体相互作用，为在实验室中观测引力介导的量子时钟纠缠提供了一条可行途径。这项实验将探测一个真正的相对论效应，即内部时钟能量对主动引力质量的贡献，而非固定质量之间的牛顿相互作用。因此，观测到这种纠缠将为主动引力质量的量子化性质提供证据。
authors: Germain Tobar, Markus Aspelmeyer, Magdalena Zych

articles.title: Recalibration-Aware Optimization of ZEFOZ Operating Points in ¹⁶⁷Er³⁺:Y₂SiO₅ for Quantum Memories
articles.title_zh: ¹⁶⁷Er³⁺:Y₂SiO₅中用于量子存储器的ZEFOZ工作点再校准感知优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08396v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Erbium-doped solids like ¹⁶⁷Er³⁺:Y₂SiO₅ have properties that make them suitable for quantum-network memories, however, their unquenched effective electronic spin causes rapid magnetic decoherence. Operating at Zero First-Order Zeeman (ZEFOZ) points allows us to mitigate this, where we evaluate the ZEFOZ landscape for Site-2 ¹⁶⁷Er³⁺ by incorporating a full-Hessian spin-Hamiltonian treatment with the anisotropic magnetic-field covariance derived from the native ⁸⁹Y crystal lattice directly. Operating-point screening criteria were adopted to devise a Pareto-optimal frontier of four transition pairs to balance modeled Y-only magnetic pure-dephasing lifetimes (Tφ,Y⁽²⁾) against microwave control authority. The ϵ₁₄łeftrightarrowϵ₁₅ transition exhibits the longest modeled Y-bath-induced quadratic pure-dephasing time, Tφ,Y⁽²⁾>2.2×10⁵~s, while the ϵ₁₂łeftrightarrowϵ₁₃ transition stood out, achieving a Rabi frequency coefficient of 1.248 × 10⁵~Hz/mT. An assumption-based Hamiltonian-uncertainty analysis demonstrates that while uncompensated deviations shift the ZEFOZ condition away from its nominal magnetic-field coordinate, the shifted operating points can be recovered via numerical vector-field recalibration. The Pareto-optimal coordinates were mathematically recovered for all sampled Hamiltonian perturbations, and the 84.1st-percentile field relocations ranged from 10.95 to 27.97~mT. The intended operation near 10~mK must be taken into account for the suppression of Er-induced spectral diffusion through electronic-spin polarization, while the extended Y-bath pure-dephasing timescales also remain conditional on the adopted temporal-correlation model.
articles.abstract_zh: 掺铒固体如¹⁶⁷Er³⁺:Y₂SiO₅因其特性适用于量子网络存储器，但其未猝灭的有效电子自旋会导致快速磁退相干。本文通过结合全Hessian自旋哈密顿量处理和各向异性磁场协方差，评估了Site-2 ¹⁶⁷Er³⁺的零一阶塞曼（ZEFOZ）点，以减轻磁退相干。研究制定了帕累托最优的四个跃迁对，以平衡Y-only磁纯退相干寿命和微波控制权限。其中，ϵ₁₄↔ϵ₁₅跃迁表现出最长的Y浴诱导二次纯退相干时间，而ϵ₁₂↔ϵ₁₃跃迁则实现了1.248 × 10⁵ Hz/mT的拉比频率系数。
authors: Shashank Srivastava

articles.title: Disorder-blind Mpemba acceleration of quantum state preparation
articles.title_zh: 量子态制备的无序盲Mpemba加速
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08424v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Using the strong Mpemba effect to accelerate relaxation by initial-state design requires suppressing the slowest mode, which typically needs prior knowledge of the system. However, in disordered systems, this mode is sample-dependent, so a fixed preparation generally retains a slow-mode overlap. We show that a ``blind'' preparation, designed from the clean chain without knowledge of the disorder realisation or its distribution, can start farther from stationarity yet overtake a reference in typical samples of a dephased disordered XX chain. It requires only the chain geometry and the particle number. At strong dephasing, the density dynamics maps to a resistor chain, and an exact inverse-generator identity links the residual overlap to the spatial resistance profile. We find two distinct thresholds: a finite mean resistance suffices for diffusion, but the residual overlap decays as L⁻¹/² with chain length L only when the resistance variance is finite; rare weak links slow this decay. We predict the fraction of samples in which the blind preparation wins, which is an ensemble-level measure of its reliability. Finite-size calculations support both scaling regimes with interactions at strong dephasing. We give preparation circuits and a density readout for the residual overlap.
articles.abstract_zh: 利用强Mpemba效应通过初始态设计加速弛豫通常需要系统先验知识。本文研究表明，在退相干的无序XX链中，一种“盲”制备方法（无需了解无序实现或其分布）可以在典型样本中从更远离稳态的位置开始，却能超越参考态。该方法仅需链几何结构和粒子数。在强退相干下，密度动力学映射到电阻链，残余重叠与空间电阻分布相关。研究还预测了盲制备成功的样本比例，作为其可靠性的系综级度量。
authors: M Nishanth, Shreyas Sadugol, Payman Mahmoudi, Alexander Yosifov, Aditya Iyer, Roopayan Ghosh, Jinzhao Sun

articles.title: Quantum enhanced beam displacement estimation: sensitivity limits, optimal probes, and measurement schemes
articles.title_zh: 量子增强光束位移估计：灵敏度极限、最优探针和测量方案
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08427v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the ultimate sensitivity limits for measuring small transverse beam displacements and identify optimal strategies that attain them, using the framework of mode parameter estimation. We contrast two families of states with different resource constraints, using Hermite-Gauss and Laguerre-Gauss mode pairs. First, for fixed total photon number states, the optimal state is identified and we show that it asymptotically approaches a rotated NOON state. The sensitivity bound is compared to that of an asymptotically optimal pure Gaussian state with fixed average photon number. Finally, we propose concrete measurement schemes using the method of moments and show that the twin-Fock state may provide a viable alternative to the rotated NOON state for this task. Our work provides a broader benchmark for developing practical strategies for spatial sensing at the quantum limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用模式参数估计框架，研究了测量小横向光束位移的最终灵敏度极限，并确定了实现这些极限的最优策略。研究对比了具有不同资源约束的Hermite-Gauss和Laguerre-Gauss模式对两种态族。对于固定总光子数的态，最优态被识别并渐近接近旋转NOON态。最后，本文提出了使用矩量法的具体测量方案，并表明双Fock态可能为该任务提供旋转NOON态的可行替代方案，为在量子极限下开发空间传感的实用策略提供了更广泛的基准。
authors: Balázs Novák, Pau Colomer, Joseph Zhang, Emre Köse, Manuel Gessner

articles.title: DiffSequence-Q: Diffusion Design with Quantum Assistance for Biologically Active Proteins
articles.title_zh: DiffSequence-Q：量子辅助的生物活性蛋白质扩散设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08434v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Designing protein sequences that satisfy both secondary structure requirements and solubility targets remains challenging. We present DiffSequence-Q, a hybrid multinomial diffusion model conditioned on secondary structure at each residue and a continuous solubility target.
