To introduce quantum auxiliary supervision during training, we employ a quantum neural network (QNN) or quantum Kolmogorov-Arnold network (QKAN) as an auxiliary solubility prediction head over shared Transformer representations. The auxiliary prediction loss is jointly optimized with the diffusion objective, allowing quantum auxiliary supervision to influence the learned denoising model. Once trained, protein sequences are generated entirely through classical reverse diffusion. On the CATH benchmark, DiffSequence-Q achieved the highest secondary structure recovery among the four evaluated models for complete sequence generation. Evaluation with a separately trained solubility prediction model showed that the best QNN and QKAN configurations achieved mean predicted solubility scores 14.0% and 22.7% higher than the multilayer perceptron (MLP) baseline, respectively. Experimental characterization further demonstrated biological activity across three distinct protein families. Selected defensins exhibited pronounced inhibitory activity against Aspergillus niger, while xylanases and short-chain dehydrogenases exhibited substantial enzymatic activity. Together, these results support DiffSequence-Q as a framework for integrating structural requirements and solubility targets in protein generation, with experimentally demonstrated biological activity.
articles.abstract_zh: 设计同时满足二级结构和溶解度目标的蛋白质序列仍然具有挑战性。本文提出了DiffSequence-Q，一个混合多项式扩散模型，其在每个残基的二级结构和连续溶解度目标上进行条件化。为了在训练期间引入量子辅助监督，研究采用了量子神经网络（QNN）或量子Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（QKAN）作为辅助溶解度预测头。在CATH基准测试中，DiffSequence-Q在完整序列生成方面实现了最高的二级结构恢复率。
authors: Ke-Xin Tang, Zhen-Qiang Weng, Kai Yan, Yao-Yao Lu, Yu-Ze Zhu, Hang Song, Jun-Jie He, Jie-Cheng Yang, Xiang Zhao, Lin Yang, Xian-Min Jin

articles.title: Polynomial-time classical simulation of boson and fermion sampling under thermal loss
articles.title_zh: 热损耗下玻色子和费米子采样的多项式时间经典模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08444v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sampling experiments are a leading approach to demonstrating quantum computational advantage, yet their robustness to experimental noise is not completely understood. We develop a common framework for classical simulation of boson and fermion sampling under thermal loss, including pure loss. For Fock-state boson sampling, Gaussian boson sampling with fixed uniform squeezing, and fermion sampling with magic inputs, we obtain polynomial-time sampling at inverse-polynomial total variation error, for any fixed nonzero overall loss rate, and with high probability over Haar-random interferometers. A milder flatness assumption on the ideal output distribution suffices for quasipolynomial-time simulation without Haar randomness. With constant thermal loss per layer, the same flatness assumption gives polynomial-time simulation at logarithmic depth. Our bounds for Fock-state boson sampling cover both dilute and saturated regimes and become stronger near full input filling: when only a bounded number of input modes are empty, the noisy output for Haar-random interferometers converges, as the number of modes grows, to a distribution independent of the interferometer.
articles.abstract_zh: 采样实验是展示量子计算优势的主要方法，但其对实验噪声的鲁棒性尚未完全理解。本文提出了一个在热损耗（包括纯损耗）下玻色子和费米子采样的经典模拟通用框架。对于Fock态玻色子采样、固定均匀压缩的高斯玻色子采样以及魔术输入的费米子采样，研究在任何固定的非零总损耗率下，以逆多项式总变差误差实现了多项式时间采样。该工作为理解量子计算优势在噪声环境下的边界提供了重要见解。
authors: Armando Angrisani, Hela Mhiri

articles.title: All Paths All at Once: A Quantum Monte Carlo and Neural Committor Approach to Reaction Pathway Search
articles.title_zh: 一次性探索所有路径：一种用于反应路径搜索的量子蒙特卡罗和神经提交器方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03699v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Locating competing reaction pathways is difficult when potential-energy gradients are unavailable. Here we present tReaxₑₓₚₑdition, an energy-only approach combining coupled Monte Carlo exploration, stochastic quench labelling and restrained continuation. Exploration identifies connected states, while continuation resolves candidate channels and records sampled chain maxima. Single-search benchmarks on three two-dimensional potentials recovered an intermediate and competing routes without transition-state guesses. For eight of nine gas-phase reactions on GFN2-xTB, sampled chain maxima differed from independently refined saddle energies by less than 0.76 kJ/mol. Alanine dipeptide instead revealed incomplete conformational relaxation, showing that route connectivity can persist despite structural and energetic errors. Neural committor learning and local straddling-pair sampling connect the resulting paths to transition-region sampling, although molecular shooting diagnostics indicate limited committor calibration. These results show how energy-only exploration and continuation recover candidate pathways, while distinguishing route connectivity from geometric localization, barrier resolution and finite-temperature transition statistics.
articles.abstract_zh: 当势能梯度不可用时，寻找竞争性反应路径极具挑战。本文提出了一种名为tReaxₑₓₚₑdition的纯能量方法，结合了耦合蒙特卡罗探索、随机淬火标记和受限延续。该方法无需过渡态猜测即可识别连接态和解析候选通道，并在基准测试中表现良好。研究还结合了神经提交器学习和局部跨越对采样，以连接路径到过渡区采样。
authors: Chien-Chai Chang

articles.title: Constraint Variance Identity and the Matter-Geometry Fluctuation Relation
articles.title_zh: 约束方差恒等式与物质-几何涨落关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07015v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The quantum Hamiltonian constraint vanishes for physical states. For separable Hamiltonians in minisuperspace, its vanishing variance yields a fundamental identity. Under the Born-Oppenheimer approximation, we derive the Matter-Geometry Fluctuation Relation, dynamically linking spacetime clock fluctuations to matter fluctuations. This establishes a quantitative stability condition for the clock against total quantum noise. Finally, we obtain an uncertainty relation between matter energy and relational time. The stable existence of spacetime thus demands quantum fluctuations in matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子哈密顿量约束对物理态而言为零。在微超空间中，其消失的方差产生了一个基本恒等式。本文在玻恩-奥本海默近似下推导了物质-几何涨落关系，动态地将时空时钟涨落与物质涨落联系起来。这为时钟抵抗总量子噪声建立了定量的稳定性条件，并导出了物质能量与关系时间之间的不确定性关系。
authors: Yuki Yokokura

articles.title: Coherent detector responses to quantum-controlled spherical-shell geometries
articles.title_zh: 量子控制球壳几何中相干探测器的响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07041v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A detector inside a static spherical shell samples globally matched field modes even though its local geometry is flat. We construct the response of a compactly switched Unruh-DeWitt detector on a quantum-controlled pair of transparent spherical-shell spacetimes with common Arnowitt-Deser-Misner mass. A stipulated common-incoming scattering identification places the branch excitations in one Hilbert space. Their positive Gram matrix determines joint, conditional, and dephased detector responses at a finite common readout, retaining the physical detector-clock phase in the uncompensated protocol. An additional coherent phase-gate protocol compensates free detector-clock propagation while preserving the shell interaction response. For concentric shells the centered response is exactly s wave. A common incoming direction basis extends the construction to a lab-fixed detector and displaced shell centers, preserving common-translation covariance. The equal-radius benchmark exhibits conditional changes of order 25% without dark-port amplification. Combining radius and position produces an assignment-odd response that reverses under reflection and vanishes at the relational midpoint. The relative normalized-state contrast reaches 34.15% among the computed samples; the relative clock-resolved probe-influence contrast reaches 8.09% for the declared readout, while larger values belong to its separate shared-phase envelope. These effects already occur in the dominant-energy-condition-compatible core. They are relational, model-dependent detector responses, not a background-independent witness of quantum geometry. First-order coefficients have finite pointlike limits; finite-coupling statements are made only at a fixed shared regulator.
articles.abstract_zh: 探测器在静态球壳内部采样全局匹配的场模式，尽管其局部几何是平坦的。本文构建了紧凑切换的Unruh-DeWitt探测器在量子控制的透明球壳时空对中的响应。研究确定了联合、条件和去相位的探测器响应，并提出了一种相干相位门协议来补偿自由探测器时钟传播。结果显示，等半径基准测试中条件变化约为25%，且结合半径和位置会产生奇偶响应。
authors: Shoshauna Gauvin, Robert B. Mann

articles.title: Unruh-DeWitt detectors in a delocalized massive shell
articles.title_zh: 非定域化质量壳中的Unruh-DeWitt探测器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07058v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We construct a model for the response of a detector to vacuum fluctuations inside a massive hollow shell in a superposition of positions. The delocalized source mass gives rise to a superposition of spacetime geometries and their associated vacuum fluctuations. To describe this system, we employ the formalism of quantum reference frames to transition to a frame in which the source mass occupies a definite position while the detector is in a superposition of positions. This allows the dynamics of the detector to be analyzed using standard tools of quantum field theory on a definite curved spacetime. We compute the detector response for a wide range of configurations of the shell and detector positions and investigate how information about the quantum state of the shell is encoded in the response function, identifying features of the superposition that are effectively captured by the detector. In particular, we show that, under appropriate postselection, the response function exhibits interference patterns, and identify regions of the parameter space of the model in which the shell-induced contributions to the interference terms are maximized.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个模型，用于描述探测器对处于位置叠加态的质量空心壳内部真空涨落的响应。研究利用量子参考系的形式，将系统转换到源质量处于确定位置而探测器处于叠加态的参考系中。这使得可以使用标准量子场论工具分析探测器动力学。计算结果表明，在适当的后选择下，响应函数呈现干涉图样，揭示了壳体量子态信息如何编码在响应函数中。
authors: Giovanna F. do Valle, Saadat Salman Shariff, Natália S. Möller, Nelson Yokomizo

articles.title: Nonequilibrium Spin-Glass Order in a Long-Range Quantum Ising Glass and Its Sensitivity to Noise
articles.title_zh: 长程量子伊辛玻璃中的非平衡自旋玻璃序及其对噪声的敏感性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07115v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study spin-glass order after a transverse-field quench in a long-range quantum Ising glass. The diagonal-ensemble Edwards-Anderson order coincides at the no-quench and zero-field endpoints, yet in between cold shells overshoot it and hot shells undershoot it. This stems from a competition in correlation space between the rigidity of populated eigenstates and the spread of their pair patterns. Under weak longitudinal dephasing the zero-field endpoint is exactly pinned while the characteristic finite-quench response fades, giving a self-referenced noise probe for quantum spin simulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了长程量子伊辛玻璃在横向场淬火后的自旋玻璃序。对角系综的Edwards-Anderson序在无淬火和零场端点处一致，但在两者之间，冷壳层会超调而热壳层会欠调。这种现象源于占据本征态的刚性与其对模式扩散之间的竞争。在弱纵向退相干下，零场端点被精确固定，而特征性的有限淬火响应则会减弱，这为量子自旋模拟器提供了一种自参考噪声探测方法。
authors: Giuseppe D'Auria, Alessandro Silva

articles.title: Asymptotic advantage of quantum one-way and SMP communication for total functions
articles.title_zh: 量子单向和SMP通信对全函数的渐近优势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07318v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We exhibit a total Boolean function on n input bits whose bounded-error quantum simultaneous-message (and hence one-way) communication complexity is in O(sqrt n), whereas its randomised one-way (and hence simultaneous-message) communication complexity is in Ømega(n). The same function admits a classical simultaneous-message protocol of cost O(sqrt n) when the players share O(sqrt n) EPR pairs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了一个在n个输入比特上的全布尔函数，其有界误差量子同时消息（以及单向）通信复杂度为O(sqrt n)。然而，其随机单向（以及同时消息）通信复杂度为Ω(n)。当参与者共享O(sqrt n)个EPR对时，该函数也允许一个成本为O(sqrt n)的经典同时消息协议。
authors: Dmytro Gavinsky

articles.title: Demystifying Graviton Detection
articles.title_zh: 揭秘引力子探测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07447v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Detecting single gravitons is possible through the extraction of discrete energy quanta from passing gravitational waves. For decades, this was considered hopeless, with estimates suggesting a detector the size of Jupiter. Here, I explain how these earlier estimates relied on the highly inefficient electron ionization process, while the absorption through the full mass quadrupole of a macroscopic system can bring graviton detection within experimental reach. Operating in the LIGO frequency band solves the challenges of graviton sources and noise suppression, allowing gravitons to be extracted from known passing gravitational waves and detection events to be heralded by classical gravitational-wave observations. Combined with the ability to resolve single energy quanta in macroscopic systems, such as in quantum acoustics, this opens a realistic path toward graviton detection. I also discuss the general limitations of particle detection in establishing an underlying quantum theory, illustrated by an energy-nonconserving semiclassical alternative. Nevertheless, the semiclassical alternative is not standard classical wave physics, and extracting E=hbarømega from a passing wave constitutes bona fide particle detection. This opens the way not only to the first detection of individual gravitons, but also to experimentally probing linearized quantum gravity and the graviton counting statistics of gravitational waves.
articles.abstract_zh: 探测单个引力子可以通过从经过的引力波中提取离散能量量子来实现。本文解释了早期估计的困难性源于低效的电子电离过程，而通过宏观系统的完整质量四极子吸收可以使引力子探测在实验上可行。在LIGO频段操作可以解决引力子源和噪声抑制的挑战，结合宏观系统中分辨单个能量量子的能力，为引力子探测开辟了一条现实路径。
authors: Igor Pikovski

articles.title: Information-Spectrum General Formulas for the Capacity Region of Classical-Quantum Multiple Access Channels
articles.title_zh: 经典-量子多址信道容量区域的信息谱通用公式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07462v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: For classical-quantum multiple access channels (cq-MACs) with two senders, we give several general expressions for the capacity region, valid for arbitrary sequences of channels. In the case of asymptotically vanishing error (ǎrepsilon=0), the capacity region is expressed in terms of spectral inf-mutual information rates. For every 0łeǎrepsilon<1, the ǎrepsilon-capacity region is expressed in terms of a quantity defined through a linear combination of three alternative hypotheses. In particular, the outer bound of Kubo and Nagaoka (2015) is tight. Our results include the quantum counterpart of the general formula of Han (1998) for the classical MAC. The most important ingredient is the one-shot inner bound of Sen (2021), which we apply to each member of an arbitrary channel sequence.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为具有两个发送方的经典-量子多址信道（cq-MACs）提供了容量区域的几个通用表达式，适用于任意信道序列。在渐近误差消失的情况下，容量区域用谱下互信息率表示。对于0≤ε<1，ε-容量区域通过三个替代假设的线性组合定义的量来表示，并证明了Kubo和Nagaoka（2015）的外界是紧的。
authors: Takuya Kubo, Hiroshi Nagaoka

articles.title: Quantum transport of vortex electrons in bending magnets and circular accelerators
articles.title_zh: 弯曲磁铁和圆形加速器中涡旋电子的量子输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08010v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Controlling the sizes and phase structure of single-particle wave packets in accelerators remains an experimental challenge and requires understanding how bending magnets transform these states. An important example is transporting relativistic vortex electrons through the magnets to a collision point while keeping a narrow orbital-angular-momentum (OAM) distribution. We derive an effective Hamiltonian that accounts for the packet acceleration, employ it to obtain a generalized BMT-like equation, match the electron state at both magnet boundaries, and calculate the mean OAM and its variance. A half turn can reverse the mean OAM relative to the momentum while broadening its distribution, so recovering the mean does not ensure state recovery. We identify windows in packet sizes and bend angles for a small OAM spread and show that weak bends can produce narrow distributions with the mean OAM tilted relative to the momentum, making these states candidates for spatiotemporal vortices. For a few MeV electrons, we propose to use half-turn magnets that leave the mean OAM nearly antiparallel to the momentum while keeping its distribution narrow. For a circular orbit in a uniform field, the OAM variance after the exit grows as N² over N turns, favoring linear accelerators, such as LINAC at JINR, for first experiments in MeV range.
articles.abstract_zh: 控制加速器中单粒子波包的尺寸和相位结构是一个实验挑战。本文推导了一个有效哈密顿量，用于描述相对论涡旋电子在弯曲磁铁中的输运，并得到了广义的BMT方程。研究发现半圈弯曲可以反转平均轨道角动量（OAM）并拓宽其分布，但通过选择合适的波包尺寸和弯曲角度，可以实现较小的OAM展宽。
authors: D. Karlovets, I. Pavlov, A. Murtazin, D. Grosman, X. Chen

articles.title: Quantum Fourier integration of decay rates at next-to-leading order
articles.title_zh: 次领先阶衰变率的量子傅里叶积分
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08204v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We discuss the use of quantum neural networks (QNNs) as a tool for integrating decay rates at next-to-leading order (NLO) in perturbation theory. Data-encoding quantum circuits admit a truncated Fourier-series representation, enabling a trained QNN to approximate a target integrand and provide the coefficients subsequently integrated with Quantum Fourier Iterative Amplitude Estimation (QFIAE). The causal-unitary formulation of the Loop-Tree Duality (LTD) combines virtual and real contributions into locally finite integrands suitable for this representation. We consider H→ qbar q(g), γ^*→ qbar q(g) and Φ→φφ(φ), comparing quantum-simulator and quantum-hardware results with analytic NLO predictions. The study illustrates the potential of Fourier-based QNN integration for high-energy physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了使用量子神经网络（QNNs）作为在微扰理论中对次领先阶（NLO）衰变率进行积分的工具。数据编码量子电路允许截断傅里叶级数表示，使得训练后的QNN能够近似目标被积函数，并提供随后通过量子傅里叶迭代幅度估计（QFIAE）积分的系数。研究考虑了H→ qbar q(g)等过程，并将量子模拟器和量子硬件结果与解析NLO预测进行比较，展示了基于傅里叶的QNN积分在高能物理中的潜力。
authors: David F. Rentería-Estrada

articles.title: Fully Passive Quantum Conference Key Agreement
articles.title_zh: 全被动量子会议密钥协商
articles.abstract: arXiv:2407.15761v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum Conference Key Agreement (CKA) provides a secure method for multi-party communication. A recently developed interference-based prepare-and-measure quantum CKA possesses the advantages of measurement-device-independence, namely, being immune to side-channels from the detector side. Besides, it achieves good key rate performance, especially for high-loss channels, due to the use of single photon interference. Meanwhile, several fully passive QKD schemes have been proposed, which eliminate all side channels from the source modulation side. We extend the fully passive idea to an interference-based CKA, which has a high level of implementation security for many-user communication.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子会议密钥协商（CKA）为多方通信提供了一种安全方法。最近开发的基于干涉的制备-测量量子CKA具有测量设备独立性，能抵抗探测器侧的旁信道攻击，并在高损耗信道中表现出良好的密钥速率。本文将全被动思想扩展到基于干涉的CKA，为多用户通信提供了高水平的实现安全性。
authors: Jinjie Li, Wenyuan Wang, H. F. Chau

articles.title: Optimizing the statistical power of negative-partial-transpose-based entanglement tests
articles.title_zh: 优化基于负偏置转置的纠缠测试的统计功效
articles.abstract: arXiv:2502.19624v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A key requirement of any separable quantum state is that its density matrix has a non-negative partial transpose. For continuous bipartite quantum states, violation of this condition may be tested via the hierarchy of negative-partial-transpose (NPT) based entanglement criteria introduced by Shchukin and Vogel [Phys. Rev. Lett. 95, 230502 (2005)]. However, even for a known state, a procedure to determine the optimal NPT-based criterion within the hierarchy has, thus far, remained outstanding. Here, we introduce a theoretical framework and numerical toolbox NPyT to compare criteria performance via the statistical power of hypothesis testing for a known input state to enable the optimal entanglement criterion to be determined. Our framework takes into account environmental noise and finite number of measurements, and optimally allocates measurement resources. To demonstrate the utility of our approach, we apply our statistical framework to prominent examples of Gaussian and non-Gaussian states, including the two-mode squeezed vacuum state, the quanta-subtracted two-mode squeezed vacuum state, and the two-mode Schrödinger-cat state. We discuss the optimal criteria identified for these states and compare them to other commonly employed criteria. For example, we identify an entanglement test for the two-mode squeezed vacuum state that has high statistical power and outperforms Simon's criterion. This work illustrates that the non-Gaussianity of the entanglement test distribution increases with test matrix size, and highlights that smaller test matrices generally provide better performance. Beyond bipartite inseparability, our framework can be extended to a wide variety of other matrix-based tests of nonclassicality and multi-mode entanglement.
articles.abstract_zh: 任何可分离量子态的关键要求是其密度矩阵具有非负偏置转置。对于连续双分量量子态，可以通过Shchukin和Vogel引入的基于负偏置转置（NPT）的纠缠判据层次来测试该条件的违反。本文引入了一个理论框架和数值工具NPyT，通过假设检验的统计功效来比较判据性能，以确定最优纠缠判据。该框架考虑了环境噪声和有限测量次数，并优化分配测量资源，适用于高斯和非高斯态。
authors: Lydia A. Kanari-Naish, Amaya Calvo-Sánchez, Jack Clarke, Arjun Gupta, Sofia Qvarfort, Michael R. Vanner

articles.title: Fast simulations of X-ray absorption spectroscopy for battery materials on a quantum computer
articles.title_zh: 量子计算机上电池材料X射线吸收光谱的快速模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.15784v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) is a leading technique for understanding structural changes in advanced battery materials such as lithium-excess cathodes. However, extracting critical information like oxidation states from the experimental spectra requires expensive and time-consuming simulations. Building upon a recent proposal to simulate XAS using quantum computers, this work proposes a highly-optimized implementation of the time-domain algorithm for X-ray absorption. Among a host of improvements to Hamiltonian representation, circuit implementation, and measurement strategies, three optimizations are key to the efficiency of the algorithm. The first is the use of product formulas with the compressed double factorized form of the Hamiltonian. The second is recognizing that for spectroscopy applications, it is sufficient to control the error in the eigenvalues of the (approximate) Hamiltonian being implemented by the product formula, rather than the generic error on the full time evolution operator. Using perturbation theory to estimate this eigenvalue error, we find that significantly fewer Trotter steps are needed than expected from the time evolution error bound. The third is the choice of an optimized distribution of samples that takes advantage of the exponentially decaying Lorentzian kernel. Through constant factor resource estimates, we show that a challenging model Li₄Mn₂O cluster system with 18 spatial orbitals and 22 electrons in the active space can be simulated with 100 logical qubits and less than 4 × 10⁸ Toffoli gates per circuit. Finally, the algorithm is implemented on a simulator, and the reconstructed spectrum is verified against a classical computational reference. The low cost of our algorithm makes it attractive to use on fault-tolerant quantum devices to accelerate the development and commercialization of high-capacity battery cathodes.
articles.abstract_zh: X射线吸收光谱（XAS）是理解先进电池材料结构变化的关键技术，但其模拟耗时且昂贵。本研究提出了一种高度优化的时域XAS量子模拟算法，旨在提高效率。该算法通过哈密顿量表示、电路实现和测量策略等多方面改进，特别是利用压缩双因子化形式的乘积公式，并专注于控制哈密顿量特征值的误差，显著减少了所需的Trotter步数。
authors: Stepan Fomichev, Pablo A. M. Casares, Jay Soni, Utkarsh Azad, Alexander Kunitsa, Arne-Christian Voigt, Jonathan E. Mueller, Juan Miguel Arrazola

articles.title: Observation of hysteresis in an isolated quantum system of disordered Heisenberg spins
articles.title_zh: 在无序海森堡自旋孤立量子系统中观察到滞后现象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.18197v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We find energy-dependent hysteresis in an isolated Heisenberg quantum spin system, similar to thermomagnetic hysteresis in canonical spin glasses in contact with a thermal reservoir. Analogous to zero-field cooling and field cooling in conventional magnetic materials, an annealing protocol is devised to control the energy in an isolated system. Depending on the strength of disorder, the susceptibilities at zero field bifurcate at a specific energy, which signals the presence of different magnetic regimes. This behavior is apparent both in a numerical simulation by exact diagonalization of the Heisenberg Hamiltonian with twelve particles, as well as in an experiment with thousands of Rydberg atoms representing dipolar interacting quantum spins. The annealing protocols open a new path to explore the energy-dependent phase structure of spin systems at low energies. Our observation of a nonthermal metastable regime might indicate the existence of a phase transition to a novel state of isolated quantum spins.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究在一个孤立的海森堡量子自旋系统中发现了能量依赖的滞后现象，类似于热磁滞后。通过设计退火协议来控制孤立系统的能量，发现在零场下磁化率在特定能量处分叉，预示着不同磁性区域的存在。这一现象通过十二粒子海森堡哈密顿量的精确对角化数值模拟和数千个里德堡原子实验均得到证实，为探索低能量自旋系统的能量依赖相结构开辟了新途径。
authors: Moritz Hornung, Eduard J. Braun, Sebastian Geier, Titus Franz, Gerhard Zürn, Matthias Weidemüller

articles.title: Quantum Data Representation via Circuit Partitioning and Reintegration
articles.title_zh: 通过电路划分与重组实现量子数据表示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.05492v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum data encoding (QDE) enables faster com-putations than classical algorithms through superposition and en-tanglement. Circuit cutting and knitting are effective techniques for ameliorating current noisy quantum processing unit (QPUs) errors via a divide-and-conquer approach that splits quantum circuits into subcircuits and recombines them using classical postprocessing. Unfortunately, the existing QDE frameworks fail to consider quantum hardware limitations, such as the topology of the chip. Designing a computation model that supports the algorithm level of quantum computation and optimizes non-all-to-all connected quantum circuit simulations remains underde-veloped. In this study, we introduce shardQ, a method that leverages the SparseCut algorithm with matrix product state (MPS) compilation and a global knitting technique to mitigate the quantum error rates. This method elucidates the optimal trade-off between the computational time and error rate for quantum encoding with a theoretical proof, evidenced by an ablation analysis using an IBM Heron-type QPUs with 15% error reduction. This study also presents the results of quantum image encoding readiness. The proposed model advances the current quantum computation towards the fault-tolerant regime as QDE is the input of grand unified quantum algorithms.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子数据编码（QDE）通过叠加和纠缠实现比经典算法更快的计算，而电路切割与重组是缓解噪声量子处理器（QPU）误差的有效方法。针对现有QDE框架未考虑量子硬件限制的问题，本研究引入了shardQ方法。shardQ结合SparseCut算法、矩阵乘积态编译和全局重组技术，有效降低了量子误差率，并在理论上证明了计算时间与误差率之间的最佳权衡，在IBM Heron型QPU上实现了15%的误差降低。
authors: Ziqing Guo, Jan Balewski, Kewen Xiao, Ziwen Pan

articles.title: Optimal Distributed Similarity Estimation of Quantum Channels
articles.title_zh: 量子信道最优分布式相似性估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.10465v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the query complexity of estimating the similarity of two unknown quantum channels available at separated devices. For channels E and F on a d-dimensional system, the target functional is the normalized Choi overlap m̊ Tr[JE JF]/d², where JE and JF are unnormalized Choi operators. We call this task emph{distributed similarity estimation of quantum channels} (DSEC). Our main result is a tight characterization: estimating this overlap to additive error ǎrepsilon with constant success probability requires and is achievable with beginalign* Θ!łeft(maxłeftfracsqrt dǎrepsilon,frac1ǎrepsilon²i̊ghti̊ght) endalign* queries to each channel. The lower bound holds even for the most general model considered here, allowing arbitrary ancillas, coherent adaptive access, quantum memory within each laboratory, and multi-round classical communication. The dimension-dependent term follows from a shared-versus-independent Haar-unitary testing problem, while the ǎrepsilon-dependence is obtained through a random-phase channel construction. Conversely, we give a non-adaptive, ancilla-free, incoherent randomized-measurement protocol for arbitrary channels that attains the same scaling. The protocol uses only shared classical randomness to coordinate local state preparations and measurement bases. For unitary channels, our protocol reduces the dimension-dependent upper bound from d/ǎrepsilon for independent coherent shadows to sqrt d/ǎrepsilon. These results identify the optimal information-theoretic cost of distributed Choi overlap estimation and clarify the role of public classical randomness in distributed quantum channel learning.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了在分离设备上估计两个未知量子信道相似性的查询复杂度，目标是归一化的Choi重叠。我们对量子信道分布式相似性估计（DSEC）任务进行了严格的刻画，证明了以加性误差ε和常数成功概率估计该重叠所需的查询复杂度为Θ(max(√d/ε, 1/ε²))。研究还提出了一个非自适应、无辅助比特、非相干的随机测量协议，以实现这一估计。
authors: Congcong Zheng, Kun Wang, Xutao Yu, Ping Xu, Zaichen Zhang

articles.title: Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Composition of Quantum Circuit Optimisation Passes
articles.title_zh: 用于量子电路优化过程自适应组合的强化学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.21629v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Many quantum software development kits provide a suite of circuit optimisation passes. These passes have been highly optimised and tested in isolation. However, the order in which they are applied is left to the user, or else defined in general-purpose default pass sequences. While general-purpose sequences miss opportunities for optimisation which are particular to individual circuits, designing pass sequences bespoke to particular circuits requires exceptional knowledge about quantum circuit design and optimisation. Here we propose and demonstrate training a reinforcement learning agent to compose optimisation-pass sequences. In particular the agent's action space consists of passes for two-qubit gate count reduction used in default PyTKET pass sequences. For the circuits in our diverse test set, the (mean, median) fraction of two-qubit gates removed by the agent is (57.7%,  56.7 %), compared to (41.8 %,  50.0 %) for the next best default pass sequence. In doing so our model demonstrates the ability to forgo reward to improve the final two-qubit gate count. Our approach clearly separates the problem of designing circuit optimisation passes from the problem of using them optimally in practice. We expect this separation of concerns to facilitate innovations in both areas.
articles.abstract_zh: 现有的量子软件开发工具包提供了多种电路优化过程，但其应用顺序通常由用户决定或采用通用默认序列，这可能错过特定电路的优化机会。本研究提出并展示了训练一个强化学习智能体来组合优化过程序列的方法。该智能体在减少双量子比特门数量方面表现出色，在测试集中平均减少了57.7%的双量子比特门，优于现有最佳默认序列的41.8%。
authors: Daniel Mills, Ifan Williams, Jacob Swain, Gabriel Matos, Enrico Rinaldi, Alexander Koziell-Pipe

articles.title: Generating entangled polaritonic condensates by pumping with entangled pairs of photons
articles.title_zh: 通过纠缠光子对泵浦产生纠缠极化激元凝聚体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.22778v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the steady state of two single-mode, uniform, spatially separated polaritonic condensates exposed to resonant pumping with entangled pairs of photons in the presence of incoherent exciton reservoirs created by nonresonant optical pumping. We demonstrate the principal possibility of driving the system to an entangled state despite its exposure to noises arising from the excitonic reservoirs and photon leakage through the microcavity mirrors. We estimate the minimum pair-induced polariton influx required to drive the system into a steady state that violates the partial-transpose criterion for entanglement. Furthermore, we trace the evolution of the system after a sudden switch-off of the entangled pumping. Our analysis provides estimates for the entanglement lifetime in a system of two exciton-polariton condensates.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了在非共振光泵浦产生的非相干激子库存在下，通过纠缠光子对共振泵浦两个单模、均匀、空间分离的极化激元凝聚体的稳态。研究证明了即使系统受到激子库噪声和微腔镜光子泄漏的影响，仍能将其驱动至纠缠态。我们估算了使系统进入违反纠缠部分转置判据的稳态所需的最小对诱导极化激元流入量，并分析了纠缠泵浦突然关闭后系统的演化，提供了激子-极化激元凝聚体系统中纠缠寿命的估计。
authors: N. A. Asriyan, A. A. Elistratov, A. V. Kavokin

articles.title: Dequantization Barriers for Guided Stoquastic Hamiltonians
articles.title_zh: 引导式随机哈密顿量的去量子化障碍
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.23183v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We construct a probability distribution, induced by the Perron--Frobenius eigenvector of an exponentially large graph, that cannot be efficiently sampled by any classical algorithm, even when given the best-possible warm-start distribution. In the quantum setting, this problem can be viewed as preparing the ground state of a stoquastic Hamiltonian given a guiding state as input, and is known to be efficiently solvable on a quantum computer. We further show that even estimating the ground-state energy of that Hamiltonian remains classically hard. Our results suggest that no efficient classical algorithm can solve a broad class of stoquastic ground-state problems. Our graph is constructed from a class of high-degree, high-girth spectral expanders (such as the LPS Ramanujan graphs) to which self-similar trees are attached. This builds on and extends prior work of Gilyén, Hastings, and Vazirani (Quantum 2021, STOC 2021), which ruled out dequantization for a specific stoquastic adiabatic path algorithm. We strengthen their result by ruling out any classical algorithm for guided ground-state preparation or energy estimation, while also providing a derandomized construction.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一种由指数级大图的Perron-Frobenius特征向量诱导的概率分布，该分布无法被任何经典算法高效采样，即使给定最佳的暖启动分布。在量子领域，这相当于在给定引导态的情况下制备随机哈密顿量的基态，且已知可在量子计算机上高效解决。研究进一步表明，即使估计该哈密顿量的基态能量在经典上仍然是困难的，这表明没有高效的经典算法可以解决一类广泛的随机基态问题。
authors: Yassine Hamoudi, Yvan Le Borgne, Shrinidhi Teganahally Sridhara

articles.title: Quantum Theory Over Dual-Complex Numbers
articles.title_zh: 对偶复数上的量子理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.17581v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We take quantum theory and replace C by C[e] where e² = 0, i.e. we extend quantum theory to the ring of dual complex numbers. The aim is to develop a common language in which to treat continuous quantum physics and discrete quantum models in a unified manner, including their symmetries. Since quantum theory is linear, introducing e is enough to model infinitesimals. A first objection to this programme is that C[e] is not a field, since division by e is undefined, while quantum mechanics typically relies on division. A second objection concerns whether unitarity still makes sense given e² = 0. Hence, the core of this work is dedicated to proving that dual-complex quantum theory remains fully consistent. In particular, norm is preserved at all times, and renormalization never requires dividing by an infinitesimal. An equivalence with conventional quantum theory is demonstrated: the dual-complex extension of a parametrized quantum operation automatically provides a linear treatment of its first-order variations. As a first example application, we provide a unified description of both the Dirac equation in the continuum and the Dirac Quantum Walk in the discrete. We establish the discrete Lorentz covariance of the latter.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究将量子理论扩展到对偶复数环C[e]（其中e²=0），旨在为连续量子物理和离散量子模型提供统一的描述语言。尽管对偶复数环不是一个域，且量子力学通常依赖除法，但本工作证明了对偶复数量子理论的完全一致性，包括范数守恒和重整化不涉及无穷小量除法。研究还展示了其与传统量子理论的等价性，并以Dirac方程为例，提供了连续和离散情况下统一的描述。
authors: Nathan Houyet (École Normale Supérieure de Paris-Saclay), Dogukan Bakircioglu (Université Paris-Saclay, Inria, CNRS, LMF), Pablo Arrighi (Université Paris-Saclay, Inria, CNRS, LMF)

articles.title: Using spatiotemporal Born rule for testing macroscopic realism
articles.title_zh: 利用时空玻恩定则检验宏观实在论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.21793v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We show that, given an evolving quantum system and the quasiprobability distribution generated by the spatiotemporal generalization of the Born rule in pseudo-density matrices (PDMs), this distribution deviates from the sequential measurement probability distribution, given by the Lüders-von Neumann distribution, if and only if the non-signaling in time is violated; therefore, macroscopic realism can be tested using the spatiotemporal Born rule. Furthermore, we study a definition of temporal entanglement according to the structure of the PDMs that is analogous to the definition of spatial entanglement in density matrices, and we employ our results to explore the relationship between the negativity of the PDM, temporal entanglement, violation of temporal Bell inequalities, and macroscopic realism. From the examples, a clear distinction between violation of macroscopic realism and of temporal Bell inequalities is made, as well as simple examples where a clear causal witness is present while non-signaling in time and macroscopic realism are respected.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究表明，对于演化的量子系统，由伪密度矩阵（PDMs）中玻恩定则的时空推广所产生的准概率分布，仅当时间非信号条件被违反时，才会偏离Lüders-von Neumann分布给出的序贯测量概率分布。因此，时空玻恩定则可用于检验宏观实在论。研究还基于PDMs结构定义了时间纠缠，并探讨了PDMs的负性、时间纠缠、时间贝尔不等式违反与宏观实在论之间的关系。
authors: Naim Elias Comar, Lucas C. Céleri, Mia Stamatova, Vlatko Vedral, Aditya Varna Iyer, Rafael Chaves

articles.title: SesQ: A Surface Electrostatic Simulator for Precise Energy Participation Ratio Simulation in Superconducting Qubits
articles.title_zh: SesQ：用于超导量子比特中精确能量参与比模拟的表面静电模拟器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.28524v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: An accurate and efficient numerical electromagnetic model for superconducting qubits is essential for characterizing and minimizing design-dependent dielectric losses. The energy participation ratio (EPR) is the commonly adopted metric used to evaluate these losses, but its calculation presents a severe multiscale computational challenge. Conventional finite element method (FEM) requires 3D volumetric meshing, leading to prohibitive computational costs and memory requirements when attempting to capture singular electric fields at nanometer-thin material interfaces. To address this bottleneck, we propose SesQ, a surface integral equation simulator tailored for the precise simulation of the EPR. By applying discretization on 2D surfaces, deriving a semi-analytical multilayer Green's function, and employing a dedicated non-conformal boundary mesh refinement scheme, SesQ accurately resolves singular edge fields without an explosive growth in the number of unknowns. Validations with analytically solvable models demonstrate that SesQ accelerates capacitance extraction by roughly two orders of magnitude compared to commercial FEM tools. While achieving comparable accuracy for capacitance extraction, SesQ delivers superior precision for EPR calculation. Simulations of practical transmon qubits further reveal that FEM approaches tend to significantly underestimate the EPR. Finally, the high efficiency of SesQ enables rapid iteration in the layout optimization, as demonstrated by minimizing the EPR of the qubit pattern, establishing the simulator as a powerful tool for the automated design of low-loss superconducting quantum circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 超导量子比特的精确高效电磁模型对于表征和最小化介电损耗至关重要，其中能量参与比（EPR）的计算面临多尺度挑战。针对传统有限元方法（FEM）计算成本高昂的问题，本研究提出了SesQ，一种专门用于精确模拟EPR的表面积分方程模拟器。SesQ通过在二维表面离散化、推导半解析多层格林函数和采用非共形边界网格细化方案，在不显著增加未知数的情况下准确解析奇异边缘场，将电容提取速度比商业FEM工具提高了约两个数量级。
authors: Ziang Wang, Shuyuan Guan, Feng Wu, Xiaohang Zhang, Qiong Li, Jianxin Chen, Xin Wan, Tian Xia, Hui-Hai Zhao

articles.title: On the Computational Power of Geometrically Local QAC circuits
articles.title_zh: 几何局部QAC电路的计算能力研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.07178v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The computational power of mathsfQAC, which are constant-depth quantum circuit families consisting of arbitrary single-qubit unitaries and n-qubit generalized Toffoli gates, has gained tremendous focus recently. In this work, we initiate the study of the computational complexity of geometrically local mathsfQAC circuits, where the qubits are arranged in a high-dimensional grid, and all the generalized Toffoli gates act on contiguous qubits along one direction. We prove that mathsf2D-QAC circuits are universal: any mathsfQAC circuit can be exactly simulated by a two-dimensional geometrically local mathsfQAC circuit. Therefore, we focus on the computational power of mathsf2D-QAC circuits with grid width w. We prove that mathsfPARITY computation has a tight width--depth tradeoff of w=nΘ⁽¹/d⁾ in the constant-depth regime if the circuit allows arbitrary ancilla. Moreover, for polynomial-size circuits, a width lower bound of nømega⁽¹/d⁾ for mathsfPARITY would imply mathsfPARITYnotinmathsfQAC⁰. We also establish Fourier tail and sensitivity bounds, together with tight width lower bounds and tight depth lower bounds in mathsf1D-QAC circuits for mathsfMAJORITY and mathsfMOD computation. Our main tool is emphlocal measurement variance, the maximum variance of normalized sums of observables on separated regions. We use a hybrid argument to show that each layer of a mathsf2D-QAC⁰ circuit increases this variance by at most a factor depending only on its width, yielding a variance bound for every mathsf2D-QAC⁰ state. The high local measurement variance of cat and Dicke states then gives the width lower bounds.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究首次探讨了几何局部QAC电路的计算复杂度，其中量子比特排列在高维网格中，广义Toffoli门作用于沿一个方向的连续量子比特。我们证明了2D-QAC电路是通用的，并且任何QAC电路都可以被二维几何局部QAC电路精确模拟。研究还揭示了PARITY计算在常数深度下具有严格的宽度-深度权衡，并建立了傅里叶尾部和敏感度界限，以及1D-QAC电路中严格的宽度和深度下界。
authors: Yangjing Dong, Fengning Ou, Penghui Yao

articles.title: Efficient Multi-Controlled Gate Implementation in Trapped-Ion Systems
articles.title_zh: 囚禁离子系统中高效的多控门实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.04654v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Multi-controlled gates are essential primitives in quantum algorithms, yet implementing them via standard gate-level decompositions remains resource-intensive. We develop efficient pulse-level implementations of multi-controlled gates in trapped-ion systems using the Cirac-Zoller scheme. We first show that the Cirac-Zoller construction admits a freedom in the sign choice of red-sideband (RSB) pulses, which leaves the logical operation invariant up to a local Pauli-Z correction. By exploiting this freedom, we construct equivalent realizations of multi-controlled gates and develop pulse cancellation for more efficient implementations of successive gates. We perform numerical simulations and show that pulse cancellation reduces the gate time and improves the state fidelity. Furthermore, we propose ancilla-free circuits for general N-controlled gates that use a single-controlled gate primitive and O(N) RSB pulses. As a key application, we apply our pulse cancellation to the linear combination of unitaries (LCU) method for block encoding. We show that the RSB-pulse cost of the select operator over L unitaries can be reduced from O(Lłog L) to O(L), which improves the efficiency and scalability of LCU-based quantum circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 多控门是量子算法中的基本操作，但其标准门级分解资源消耗大。本研究利用Cirac-Zoller方案，在囚禁离子系统中开发了高效的脉冲级多控门实现。通过利用红边带（RSB）脉冲符号选择的自由度，我们构建了等效的多控门实现并开发了脉冲抵消技术，以更高效地实现连续门。数值模拟表明，脉冲抵消能缩短门时间并提高态保真度，且我们提出了无辅助比特的通用N控门电路，显著降低了RSB脉冲成本。
authors: Minhyeok Kang, Taejin Kim, Jungsoo Hong, Joonsuk Huh

articles.title: Computational and physical complexity of synthesizing random multi-qudit quantum states and unitary operators
articles.title_zh: 随机多量子比特量子态和酉算子合成的计算与物理复杂性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.07374v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We analyze the complexity of synthesizing random states and unitary operators in a multi-qudit system in two paradigms. In one case, we consider the situation in which we manipulate the system by applying a sequence of one- and two-qudit quantum gates that constitute the elementary, and universal, gate set. The minimum number of gates required to perform the desired operation represents the computational complexity. In the other case, we consider the situation in which we manipulate the physical system using physical fields with optimized control pulses. The minimum time required to perform the desired operation represents the physical complexity. In both cases, we use analytical arguments in combination with optimal-control-theory numerical calculations to determine the complexity of random operations. We show analytically that the computational complexity of synthesizing random states or unitary operators scales exponentially with the number of qudits. While our numerical results are limited to small systems and are insufficient to reveal the asymptotic scaling laws, they suggest that the physical complexity of synthesizing random quantum states and unitary operators scales more slowly than the computational complexity. We discuss various implications of our results, especially concerning the relationship between random and pseudorandom states and unitary operators.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文分析了在多量子比特系统中合成随机量子态和酉算子的计算与物理复杂性。研究人员在两种范式下进行分析：一是基于量子门序列的计算复杂性，二是基于优化控制脉冲的物理复杂性。分析结果表明，合成随机量子态或酉算子的计算复杂性随量子比特数量呈指数级增长。数值结果虽然受限于小系统，但为物理复杂性的渐近标度律提供了初步线索。
authors: Sahel Ashhab, Bora Basyildiz

articles.title: Optimal Quantum Junta Testing
articles.title_zh: 最优量子Junta测试
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.37926v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We determine the quantum query complexity of testing k-juntas for Boolean functions, unitaries, and quantum channels. Let n denote the number of input bits or qubits and ǎrepsilon the distance parameter. For all sufficiently large k, n ge 2k, and 2⁻k/¹⁶ łe ǎrepsilon łe 1/16, we establish the following tight bounds. bullet Junta functions: The query complexity is Θ(sqrtk/ǎrepsilon), closing the gap left by Ambainis, Belovs, Regev, and de Wolf (SODA 2016) and Bun, Kothari, and Thaler (STOC 2018, ToC 2020). bullet Junta unitaries: The query complexity is Θ(sqrtk/ǎrepsilon), closing the gap left by Chen, Nadimpalli, and Yuen (SODA 2023). With forward-only access, the query complexity is Θ(k/(ǎrepsilon² łog k)). At constant ǎrepsilon, these bounds establish a separation between Θ(sqrtk) queries with forward and inverse access and Θ(k/łog k) queries with forward-only access. bullet Junta channels: The query complexity is Θ(k/(ǎrepsilon² łog k)), closing the gap left by Bao and Yao (COLT 2023, TPAMI 2025). The upper bounds for channels and forward-only unitaries are achieved by nonadaptive, ancilla-free testers using product inputs and single-qubit measurements. Our upper bounds follow from a reduction to emphunion size testing, a generalization of support size testing to distributions over subsets of a ground set. We develop optimal testers for this problem both from independent samples and from a reversible sampler. Our matching lower bounds use moment-matching constructions and a phase-masked unitary ensemble. For this ensemble, the average acceptance probability of every forward-only quantum algorithm admits an exact representation in terms of independent classical samples.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文确定了布尔函数、酉算子和量子信道k-junta测试的量子查询复杂性。研究人员在特定条件下建立了紧密界限。对于junta函数以及具有正向和逆向访问权限的junta酉算子，查询复杂性为Θ(sqrtk/ε)。对于仅具有正向访问权限的酉算子和junta信道，查询复杂性为Θ(k/(ε² log k))。这些结果填补了现有研究的空白，并揭示了不同访问模式下的复杂性差异。
authors: Jinge Bao, Minbo Gao, Penghui Yao

articles.title: Polynomial-Time Algorithms for Nuclear Tensor Norms and Multipartite Quantum Separability
articles.title_zh: 核张量范数和多体量子可分离性的多项式时间算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.03637v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study a multilinear optimization problem for tensors with bounded Frobenius norm, where each of the k local factors of dimension d is chosen from a convex set. We give a deterministic algorithm running in time dO⁽k⁾ for constant additive approximations. As applications, we obtain the first polynomial-time algorithms at constant accuracy for weak membership in the nuclear-norm unit ball of high-order tensors and for multipartite quantum separability in Frobenius norm. Our approach views tensor optimization as a cooperative multiprover game and combines this perspective with a recursive spectral compression procedure. We then show that related ideas admit a quantum implementation when the input state is given through copies, rather than an explicit classical description. In this setting, we obtain an algorithm to solve Frobenius-norm separability testing using poly(k) copies and poly(kłog d) time.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了张量的多线性优化问题，并提出了一种在d^O(k)时间内实现常数加性近似的确定性算法。该算法首次为高阶张量核范数单位球的弱成员资格问题以及Frobenius范数下的多体量子可分离性问题提供了多项式时间解。此外，研究还展示了当输入态通过副本而非经典描述给出时，可利用量子实现以多项式时间进行可分离性测试。
authors: Martino Bernasconi, Giulio Malavolta

articles.title: How Far Can a Trainable Frequency Move? Resolution, Grids and Coupling in Trainable-FrequencyQuantum Models
articles.title_zh: 可训练频率量子模型中频率的移动范围：分辨率、网格和耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.23409v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Trainable-frequency quantum models train the prefactors of their encoding gates so that the circuit's frequencies can move onto the target's. From the unit start of prior work, training rarely reaches a target more than one resolution step away. We show that the target-driven part of the prefactor gradient is a weighted sum of slopes of the overlap sin u/u, where u is the model-target frequency distance scaled by the window half-width. This gives each frequency a reach: under gradient flow, an isolated real frequency whose coefficient adapts optimally reaches its target from within half a step, for every target at least one step from zero frequency; with a fixed coefficient, a phase-dependent barrier can stop it. A ternary prefactor grid places a model frequency within half a step of every band frequency, with logarithmically many encoding gates. Single-frequency circuits trained with Adam and jointly trained amplitudes behave as predicted: inside the first side lobe, a frequency starts toward its target exactly when in phase with it in 98% of runs, and only 11 of 768 frequencies starting beyond the lobe reached their target. With several frequencies, the grid start raised successful fits on synthetic targets from 69% to 84% against the best random start. With many target frequencies, least squares on the fixed grid fits near-perfectly, but the circuit does not reach the coefficients; training the prefactors narrows this shortfall, but with 8 and 24 target frequencies, training the fixed grid ten times longer fitted better. On real series, training the frequencies improved held-out R² at equal budget by 0.010--0.045 on four of seven series, but a classical screen did not separate these from the others. A classical model with independently trainable frequencies shows the same dependence on the start; our results describe how to train such models, not an advantage of the circuit.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了可训练频率量子模型中频率的移动能力，其中编码门的预因子被训练以使电路频率与目标频率对齐。研究表明，预因子梯度中目标驱动部分是重叠函数斜率的加权和，这赋予了每个频率一个“可达范围”。在最佳适应下，孤立的实频率可以在半步之内达到其目标。一个三元预因子网格可以通过对数数量的编码门将模型频率置于每个频带频率的半步之内。单频率电路的实验结果验证了这些预测。
authors: Michael Poppel, Markus Baumann, Sebastian Wölckert, Claudia Linnhoff-Popien, Jonas Stein

articles.title: Singlet-only always-on gapless exchange (SAGE) spin qubits: Charge noise effects and two-qubit gates
articles.title_zh: 单重态常开无能隙交换（SAGE）自旋量子比特：电荷噪声效应与双量子比特门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.15419v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Singlet-only always-on gapless exchange (SAGE) spin qubits are an alternative type of exchange-only (EO) qubits that encode a single qubit in the spins of four electrons located in four tunnel-coupled quantum dots. While conventional EO qubits are susceptible to local magnetic field gradients caused by local nuclear environments and g-factor variations, the SAGE qubit subspace is inherently protected from magnetic-gradient-induced Pauli errors by virtue of the singlet-only encoding, which is invariant under magnetic field gradients, and the always-on exchange couplings, which provide energetic leakage protection. However, the always-on operation simultaneously increases the qubit's sensitivity to charge noise. Here, starting from a Hubbard model describing the underlying electronic structure of the coupled quantum dots, we characterize the performance of SAGE qubits in the presence of 1/f charge noise that induces fluctuations in both the dot chemical potentials and the interdot tunnel couplings. We calculate SAGE idle coherence times and show that realistic CPMG-like pulse sequences can be used to significantly extend SAGE single-qubit coherence times for experimentally relevant charge noise strengths. We likewise study the fidelity of SAGE two-qubit gates in the presence of charge and magnetic noise and again propose a simple refocusing strategy to mitigate the noise, while increased ramp times of the entangling pulse suppress leakage into noncomputational states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了单重态常开无能隙交换（SAGE）自旋量子比特，这是一种将单个量子比特编码在四个量子点中四个电子自旋上的新型交换型量子比特。SAGE量子比特通过单重态编码和常开交换耦合，本质上免受磁梯度引起的泡利误差影响，但对电荷噪声更为敏感。研究人员基于哈伯德模型，表征了SAGE量子比特在1/f电荷噪声下的性能，计算了空闲相干时间，并表明类CPMG脉冲序列可显著延长其相干时间。
authors: Nathan L. Foulk, Katharina Laubscher, Silas Hoffman, Sankar Das Sarma

articles.title: Stability and Relaxation of Electron-Phonon Systems at Strong Coupling
articles.title_zh: 强耦合下电子-声子系统的稳定性和弛豫
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07014v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the kinetic properties of Migdal-Eliashberg theory (MET) for electron-phonon interactions at strong coupling. Previously, the system was found to be dynamically unstable at large couplings within a Markovian quantum Boltzmann approximation. Using the quasiclassical Kadanoff-Baym equation, we show that this instability is absent when non-Markovian effects are taken into account. We also analyze the long-time relaxation dynamics at strong-couplin, and find a clear imprint of the non-Markovian nature of the dynamics: in an intermediate temperature range between the Debye frequency and the coupling strength, the relaxation rate becomes linear in temperature with Planckian slope, while the leading relaxation mode acquires a large imaginary component, producing strongly oscillatory decay. Our results imply that any instability which preempts superconductivity must arise from effects beyond MET, such as phonon softening or polaronic effects at finite electronic bandwidth. This shows that the characteristic phonon frequency is not a fundamental bound on T_c, and leaves open a route to higher T_c in multi-orbital electron-phonon systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了强耦合下电子-声子相互作用的Migdal-Eliashberg理论（MET）的动力学特性。研究表明，在准经典Kadanoff-Baym方程中考虑非马尔可夫效应时，先前在马尔可夫量子玻尔兹曼近似中发现的动态不稳定性消失。分析了强耦合下的长时间弛豫动力学，发现在中间温度范围内弛豫速率呈现普朗克斜率，且主导弛豫模式具有大的虚部，产生强烈的振荡衰减。这些结果表明，任何先于超导性的不稳定性都必须源于MET之外的效应。
authors: Noga Bashan, Erez Berg

articles.title: Electrically tunable superconducting dimensionality in stripe-ordered monolayer MoTe₂
articles.title_zh: 条纹有序单层MoTe₂中电可调超导维度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07302v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dimensionality governs the stability of collective quantum states, including whether Cooper pairs can establish the phase coherence required for superconductivity. In solids, however, electronic dimensionality is usually encoded in the crystal structure and is difficult to control reversibly. Here we show evidence that monolayer 1Tprⁱme-MoTe₂ develops a stripe charge-density wave that reorganizes its low-energy electronic states into quasi-one-dimensional channels. Raman spectroscopy and scanning tunneling microscopy identify the stripe order, whereas directional transport and tunneling spectroscopy reveal superconducting correlations confined to the stripe direction and insulating behavior perpendicular to it. Electrostatic doping weakens the transverse insulating response and drives the system into phase-coherent two-dimensional superconductivity. These results show that stripe charge order can reconfigure superconducting dimensionality and make it electrically tunable within a single crystalline layer.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提供了证据表明单层1T'-MoTe₂会形成条纹电荷密度波，将低能电子态重组为准一维通道。拉曼光谱和扫描隧道显微镜证实了条纹有序，而定向输运和隧道光谱揭示了沿条纹方向的超导关联和垂直方向的绝缘行为。静电掺杂削弱了横向绝缘响应，并使系统进入相位相干的二维超导状态。这些结果表明，条纹电荷有序可以重构并电学调控超导维度。
authors: Tianyu Qiu, Ziyi Han, Fei Yang, Keyu Wei, Liguo Dou, Yong Zhang, Dekun Yang, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Xuefeng Wang, Fucong Fei, Fengqi Song, Yanyan Shangguan, Shaochun Li, Jinsheng Wen, Hong Yao, Chaoxing Liu, Binghai Yan, Lin He, Xiaoxiang Xi

articles.title: Parity-Selective Quantum Interference in Unconventional Magnets
articles.title_zh: 非常规磁体中的宇称选择性量子干涉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07330v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonrelativistic spin splitting has emerged as a defining feature of unconventional magnetic states. Here we show that quantum interference offers a symmetry-resolved probe for the parity of such spin splitting, as even- and odd-parity magnets exhibit qualitatively different weak (anti-)localization behaviors. Even-parity magnets can host time-reversal symmetric scattering loops depicted by the spin group, giving rise to a weak localization that can be suppressed by spin-orbit coupling. In contrast, odd-parity magnets have a hidden weak antilocalization that can be released by spinorbit coupling. We further derive the corresponding magnetoconductivity formulas to facilitate experimental explorations. Our results not only advance the weak (anti-)localization theory to unconventional magnets but also suggest a practical diagnostic of unconventional spin-split magnetic states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了量子干涉可以作为非常规磁态中非相对论自旋分裂宇称的对称性分辨探针。偶宇称磁体表现出弱局域化，可通过自旋轨道耦合抑制；这源于自旋群描绘的时间反演对称散射环。相反，奇宇称磁体具有隐藏的弱反局域化，可通过自旋轨道耦合释放。研究人员进一步推导了相应的磁导率公式，以促进实验探索。
authors: Yiyuan Chen, Xiao-Bin Qiang, Hai-Zhou Lu, Congjun Wu, X. C. Xie

articles.title: Solvable macroscopic models for populations of type I excitability neurons with Gaussian noise
articles.title_zh: 具有高斯噪声的I型兴奋性神经元群体的可解宏观模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07714v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The dynamics of type I excitability neurons near the bifurcation point are governed by the model of quadratic integrate-and-fire neuron (QIF). The model of QIF subject to white Gaussian noise is abundant in statistical physics, since it not only reasonably reproduces the dynamics of some biological systems but also emerges in the problems of stochastic stability and in quantum mechanics of one-dimensional systems with quenched disorder. We derive the solution for the mean interspike interval of a QIF subject to additive Gaussian noise in terms of analytic functions, from the first passage time problem. On the basis of this solution, we construct analytical expressions for the firing rate and population-mean membrane potential in terms of the real and imaginary parts of a certain universal analytic function. With this function, we generalize theoretical results to heterogeneous populations with Lorentzian-distributed parameters. Implementation of theoretical results is demonstrated and examined for two problems: the interplay between chemical and electrical synapses, and the emergence of effective endogenous noise in sparse inhibitory networks. For the latter case, it is possible to cover the scenarios where the effective noise intensity depends on Lorentzian-distributed parameters, which is not feasible directly with the diffusion approximation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了I型兴奋性神经元在分岔点附近的动力学，该动力学由二次积分-发放（QIF）神经元模型描述。研究人员从首次通过时间问题出发，推导了具有加性高斯噪声的QIF神经元平均峰间间隔的解析函数解。在此基础上，构建了发放率和群体平均膜电位的解析表达式。该工作将理论结果推广到具有洛伦兹分布参数的异质群体，并展示了其在化学和电突触相互作用以及有效内源性噪声出现等问题中的应用。
authors: Maria V. Ageeva, Denis S. Goldobin

articles.title: Anisotropic g-tensor and strong spin-orbit interaction of holes in hexagonal germanium nanowires
articles.title_zh: 六方锗纳米线中空穴的各向异性g张量和强自旋轨道相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07846v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hexagonal germanium combines direct-gap optical activity with the low-nuclear-spin environment of a group-IV material, making it a candidate platform for spin qubits and spin-photon interfaces. Using a ten-band kḑotp model, we study the response of confined hole states in hexagonal germanium nanowires to magnetic and electric fields. We show that, by symmetry, the top valence band of the bulk crystal has a vanishing g factor in the plane perpendicular to the c axis, in analogy with the in-plane g factor of heavy holes in two-dimensional hole gases. In nanowires, confinement induces only small transverse g-tensor components, so the g tensor remains strongly anisotropic. A transverse electric field strongly reduces the nanowire band gap, providing a gate-tunable optical signature and limiting the usable field range. The same field induces a Rashba spin-orbit interaction that is markedly stronger for fields perpendicular to the c axis and depends nonlinearly on the field strength. In narrow wires at strong fields, the spin-orbit length reaches a few tens of nanometers, comparable to hole devices in cubic silicon. We identify the microscopic origin of the Rashba coupling as a second-order process mediated by a few intermediate subbands with distinct symmetry selection rules. Our results provide guidance for the design of electrically controlled hole-spin qubits in hexagonal germanium nanowires.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用十带k·p模型研究了六方锗纳米线中受限空穴态对磁场和电场的响应。研究表明，由于对称性，体材料顶价带在垂直于c轴的平面内g因子消失，导致纳米线中g张量呈现强烈的各向异性。横向电场显著减小纳米线带隙，并诱导拉什巴自旋轨道相互作用，该作用在垂直于c轴的电场下更强且非线性依赖于场强。在强场窄线中，自旋轨道长度可达数十纳米。
authors: Anirban Das, Baksa Kolok, Dániel Varjas, András Pályi

articles.title: Pressure-Induced Phase Transition and Superconducting Properties of LiPdH₂: A First-Principles Study
articles.title_zh: 压力诱导的LiPdH₂相变及超导特性：第一性原理研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07989v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a detailed first-principles investigation of the superconducting hydride LiPdH₂, focusing on the competition between its tetragonal P4/mmm and rhombohedral Rbar3m phases. Our results reveal a pressure-induced phase transition near 220 GPa, where Rbar3m overtakes P4/mmm in thermodynamic stability. The Rbar3m phase is predicted to be superconducting, with Tₘ̊ c values of up to 46 K in the harmonic approximation and 28 K at the anharmonic level. In contrast, although the P4/mmm phase is stable up to 200 GPa, it maintains a more rigid electronic character with weaker hydrogen involvement, resulting in lower superconducting performance. Ionic quantum and anharmonic effects play a decisive role in stabilizing P4/mmm and shaping its superconducting properties, whereas these effects diminish rapidly with pressure. These findings highlight the interplay between structural stability, hydrogen orbital activity, and quantum effect in optimizing the superconductivity of hydrogen-based superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对超导氢化物LiPdH₂进行了详细的第一性原理研究，重点关注其四方P4/mmm相和菱方R-3m相之间的竞争。结果揭示了在约220 GPa附近存在压力诱导的相变，R-3m相在此压力下在热力学上变得更稳定。R-3m相预计具有超导性，在谐波近似下T_c高达46 K，在非谐波水平下为28 K。P4/mmm相虽然在高达200 GPa的压力下稳定，但其电子特性更为刚性，氢参与度较低，导致超导性能较差。离子量子和非谐效应在稳定P4/mmm相和塑造其超导特性方面起着决定性作用，但这些效应随压力迅速减弱。
authors: Zahra Alizadeh, Yue-Wen Fang, M. R. Mohammadizadeh

articles.title: Thermodynamic geometry of three coupled Ising spins: exact curvature, frustration and bond anisotropy
articles.title_zh: 三个耦合伊辛自旋的热力学几何：精确曲率、挫折和键各向异性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08072v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Thermodynamic curvature is widely used as a diagnostic of interactions and phase transitions, yet its interpretation is usually tested only in the thermodynamic limit. Small spin clusters are physically relevant in their own right, since a macroscopic sample of independent molecular trimers or a few-qubit quantum simulator is governed exactly by the few-spin partition function. They also provide the only setting in which the geometry can be obtained in closed form together with its full dependence on the interaction topology. We study the Fisher-Rao (Ruppeiner) geometry of three Ising spins with arbitrary pairwise couplings in a longitudinal field. This cluster interpolates continuously between an open chain and a geometrically frustrated triangle. For the symmetric triangle we obtain the scalar curvature in closed form. It vanishes on the noninteracting line and on a line of fixed field-to-temperature ratio that does not depend on the coupling, which coincides with the inflection point of the single-spin susceptibility. The near-zero behaviour is therefore exactly linear and reflects analyticity rather than critical scaling. In the frustrated antiferromagnetic regime the curvature remains finite and negative down to zero temperature. A general low-temperature formula relates this plateau to the change in magnetization content between the degenerate ground manifold and its first excitation. Any bond anisotropy destroys the plateau below a crossover temperature that depends only logarithmically on the anisotropy, so the curvature is an extremely sensitive detector of exact ground-state degeneracy. On the ferromagnetic side the zero-temperature curvature is universal for all couplings, whereas additional zero lines in anisotropic clusters track field-induced crossings of excited levels.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在纵向场中具有任意两两耦合的三个伊辛自旋的Fisher-Rao（Ruppeiner）几何。该自旋簇在开链和几何挫折三角形之间连续插值。对于对称三角形，研究人员获得了标量曲率的封闭形式解。该曲率在非相互作用线和固定场温比线上消失，这与单自旋磁化率的拐点一致。近零行为呈线性，反映了解析性而非临界标度。
authors: Zahra Ebadi, Nayyere Einali Saghavaz, Omid Yahyayi Monem, Hosein Mohammadzadeh

articles.title: Dynamical Keldysh model for colored noise and finite relaxation rate
articles.title_zh: 动态Keldysh模型：针对有色噪声和有限弛豫率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08280v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Keldysh model describes quantum dots subjected to Gaussian noise with infinite correlation time. For multi-component noise coupled through non-commuting matrices, the spectrum exhibits a pseudogap. We solve the model for coloured noise with any correlation time, 1/ γ. Finite memory leads to the pseudogap being filled, its peaks merging and the line narrowing.
articles.abstract_zh: Keldysh模型描述了量子点在无限关联时间高斯噪声下的行为，多组分噪声会导致谱中出现赝能隙。本研究解决了具有任意关联时间（1/γ）的有色噪声模型。结果表明，有限记忆效应导致赝能隙被填充，其峰值合并，谱线变窄。
authors: F. Z. Bendjeddou, D. V. Efremov, M. N. Kiselev

articles.title: Flat-band systems: A platform to realize the moments of Quantum Metric
articles.title_zh: 平带系统：实现量子度规矩的平台
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08479v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantum metric is a fundamental geometric property of Bloch bands that governs a wide range of physical phenomena, yet experimentally accessing it remains challenging. We show that the momentum-space variation of the quantum metric can be probed through the real-space dynamics of a Gaussian wave packet prepared in an isolated flat band. Following the application of a weak constant force, we demonstrate analytically that the leading order change in the wave-packet variance is linear in time and contains a contribution proportional to the wave-packet averaged gradient of the quantum-metric trace. This geometric contribution remains finite despite the absence of band dispersion. We illustrate the effect using a gapped Lieb lattice with an exactly flat middle band and vanishing Berry curvature, allowing the quantum-metric contribution to the spreading to be isolated. The numerical results agree with the analytical prediction and confirm the quantum-metric contribution to the wave-packet spreading. The required lattice preparation, tunable hopping amplitudes, applied force, and density measurements are compatible with established ultracold-atom techniques, providing a possible platform for observing the predicted response. Our results establish wave-packet spreading as a dynamical probe of quantum geometry in flat-band systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子度规是布洛赫能带的基本几何性质，但实验获取仍具挑战。本文展示了通过在孤立平带中制备高斯波包的实空间动力学，可以探测量子度规的动量空间变化。研究发现，在弱恒定力作用下，波包方差的主导变化与量子度规迹的平均梯度成正比，且此几何贡献在无能带色散的情况下依然存在。该效应通过具有平坦中间带的Lieb晶格进行了验证，数值结果与分析预测一致。
authors: Rishi Gangadhar, Binayyak Roy, Vito Scarola, Sumanta Tewari

articles.title: 1/N corrections to łangle TJJångle and łangle TTTångle in the critical O(N) vector and Gross--Neveu--Yukawa models
articles.title_zh: 临界O(N)矢量和Gross--Neveu--Yukawa模型中<TJJ>和<TTT>的1/N修正
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07394v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We compute the subleading corrections in the 1/N expansion of the three-point functions łangle TJJångle and łangle TTTångle in the three-dimensional critical O(N) vector and Gross--Neveu--Yukawa models. We determine the coefficients of the two parity-even conformal structures and the corresponding conformal collider parameters. The calculation uses an expansion of momentum-space Feynman diagrams in a soft external momentum, together with the contact terms required by background gauge and metric sources. The sums of the structure coefficients reproduce the known current and stress-tensor two-point normalizations. We also compute these coefficients independently using the metric and mixed metric--gauge derivatives of the sphere free energy. Extrapolating the large N results to the O(2) vector model yields reasonably good agreement with recent numerical bootstrap bounds. At N=2, our γ and t₄ predictions lie within the joint bootstrap region under weaker spectral assumptions; their deviations from the more restrictive interval midpoints are only 3.28% and 4.44%, respectively. We discuss the implications for energy flux, high-frequency conductivity, and shear response near quantum criticality.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文计算了三维临界O(N)矢量和Gross--Neveu--Yukawa模型中三点函数<TJJ>和<TTT>在1/N展开中的次领先修正。研究确定了两个宇称偶数共形结构的系数及相应的共形对撞机参数。计算结果与已知的流和应力张量两点归一化值一致，并且在N=2时与数值自举界限吻合良好。
authors: Yongwei Guo, Zhijin Li

articles.title: Exact and Near-Exact Inverse Renormalization Group with Constrained Monte Carlo
articles.title_zh: 基于约束蒙特卡洛的精确和近精确逆重整化群
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07641v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We establish conditions for exactness of the inverse renormalization group via constrained Markov processes, a class of Monte Carlo simulations which sample the degrees of freedom within a block on a fine lattice under the constraint that they remain consistent with the corresponding degree of freedom on the coarse lattice according to a forward renormalization group transformation. We show analytically, for an arbitrary transformation, that constrained Markov processes correspond to an exact inversion of the renormalization group at the fixed point action, and to a near-exact inversion in the vicinity of the fixed point. We then optimize renormalization group transformations directly on inversely renormalized configurations to effectively map the action onto itself and ensure computational stability in the generation of configurations for high-dimensional systems. Starting from a set of uncorrelated configurations for the three-dimensional φ⁴ quantum field theory at lattice volume V=16³, we invert the renormalization group with constrained Monte Carlo to construct a set of uncorrelated, near-equilibrium configurations for V=128³ and extract two critical exponents of the system. The inversion exhibits no critical slowing down, with dynamic critical exponent z=0.03(2).
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过约束马尔可夫过程，建立了逆重整化群精确性的条件。研究表明，对于任意变换，约束马尔可夫过程在不动点作用量处对应于重整化群的精确反演，并在不动点附近实现近精确反演。该方法通过优化重整化群变换，成功地为高维系统生成了近平衡态构型，并在三维φ⁴量子场论中得到了验证。
authors: Dimitrios Bachtis

articles.title: A Passive Intelligent Metasurface: A Network Model
articles.title_zh: 一种无源智能超表面：网络模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07894v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Intelligent metasurfaces enable advanced wave manipulation, including negative refraction, focusing, beam splitting and beam steering, with significant potential for practical applications. However, conventional approaches often rely on active metamaterials with gain, or demand computationally intensive solutions of inverse problems to find the optimal configuration. In this work, we use the scattering framework of quantum graph theory to derive an exact, analytic expression for configuration of a passive metasurface that produces a prescribed reflected wave field. The metasurface terminates a periodic lattice of waveguides and consists of an array of channels, each a tube of length ellₘ ending in a vertex whose scattering parameter łambdaₘ sets how much of the wave is lost to the wall. For any prescribed incident and reflected field, the exact lengths and scattering parameters follow channel by channel, in closed form, from the ratio of the wave amplitudes returning to and leaving the lattice, and the metasurface is passive whenever this ratio does not exceed unity in modulus. We demonstrate the construction for both a one-dimensional and a two-dimensional metasurface. The one-dimensional metasurface terminates a two-dimensional lattice and steers, splits or perfectly absorbs Gaussian beams. The two-dimensional metasurface terminates a three-dimensional lattice and generates a prescribed image in a plane inside the lattice. In each case, we obtain the exact boundary properties that produce the effect.
articles.abstract_zh: 智能超表面在波操控方面具有巨大潜力，但传统方法常依赖有源材料或计算密集型逆问题。本文利用量子图论的散射框架，推导出了产生预设反射波场的无源超表面配置的精确解析表达式。该方法通过通道逐一确定超表面的精确长度和散射参数，且当波幅比模量不超1时，超表面为无源。
authors: Tristan Lawrie, Gregor Tanner, Luke Bennetts

articles.title: Accessing Fractional Wilson Lines from U(1) Monodromy Defects on the Fuzzy Sphere
articles.title_zh: 从模糊球上的U(1)单值缺陷获取分数Wilson线
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08102v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Wilson lines are gauge-invariant probes of charge screening and deconfinement, which can detect the response of quantum critical matter to an external charge, but their universal information at strongly-coupled critical points remains hard to access. Here we investigate a continuous family of U(1) monodromy defects of the three-dimensional O(2) Wilson--Fisher conformal field theory, which is dual to fractional Wilson lines in the critical noncompact Abelian Higgs model with one unit-charged scalar. We realize this continuous family of defects within the fuzzy-sphere framework by threading a fractional Aharonov--Bohm flux through the two poles of the sphere. We observe the emergence of charged operators carrying fractional transverse spins, as a characteristic signature of the imposed monodromy. The appearance of displacement operator at its protected dimension supports the conformal nature of this defect line. Crucially, we resolve no relevant symmetry-preserving defect scalar, and identify charge-one monopole operators as relevant symmetry-breaking deformations. Assuming the duality, these results provide non-perturbative evidence that fractional Wilson lines of the critical Abelian Higgs model are stable conformal lines.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了三维O(2) Wilson--Fisher共形场论中U(1)单值缺陷的连续族，其与临界非紧阿贝尔希格斯模型中的分数Wilson线对偶。通过在模糊球上引入分数Aharonov--Bohm磁通，实现了这些缺陷。研究观察到带有分数横向自旋的带电算符的出现，并发现位移算符的出现支持了该缺陷线的共形性质。
authors: Yin Tang, W. Zhu

articles.title: Symmetry-guided catalogue of chiral phonon materials
articles.title_zh: 手性声子材料的对称性指导目录
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.13721v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Chiral phonons---circularly polarized lattice vibrations with angular momentum---have become a key frontier in quantum materials. They offer ways to control heat and information through their coupling to electronic spin, orbital, and valley degrees of freedom. We present a symmetry-based framework that classifies phonon chirality across all crystallographic space groups. Our approach, built on symmetry representations of phonon angular momentum in reciprocal space, identifies three phononic material classes, namely, crystals with no chirality, chiral crystals with conventional s-wave helicity, and a group of achiral crystals hosting exotic higher-order helicities such as d, g, and i waves. Through high-throughput computation, we shortlist the most promising material candidates for experimental investigation. These results are compiled into the open-access Chiral Phonon Materials Database, which enables screening for materials with the desired chiral phonon properties. Our work establishes both the theoretical framework and the material platform required to exploit the properties of chiral phonons for next-generation thermal management and quantum technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性声子是量子材料领域的重要前沿，可用于通过其与电子自旋、轨道和谷自由度的耦合来控制热量和信息。本文提出了一个基于对称性的框架，对所有晶体空间群中的声子手性进行分类。该方法识别出三类声子材料，并通过高通量计算筛选出最有前景的实验候选材料，并将其汇编成开放获取的手性声子材料数据库。
authors: Yue Yang, Zhenyu Xiao, Yu Mao, Zhanghuan Li, Zhenyang Wang, Tianqi Deng, Yanhao Tang, Zhi-Da Song, Yuan Li, Huiqiu Yuan, Ming Shi, Yuanfeng Xu

articles.title: Evolution from intralayer to interlayer superconductivity in a bilayer t-J-Jbₒₜ ladder
articles.title_zh: 双层t-J-Jbₒₜ梯子中层内到层间超导的演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.07545v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Motivated by the bilayer cuprate superconductors and nickelate superconductor La₃Ni₂O₇, we investigate the evolution from intralayer to interlayer superconductivity in finite-width bilayer t-J-Jbₒₜ ladders, where t is the in-plane electron hopping, J is the in-plane spin interaction, and Jbₒₜ is the inter-plane spin interaction. By means of the density matrix renormalization group calculations, we map out the quantum phase diagram of the bilayer two-leg ladders by tuning Jbₒₜ in a large doping range δ = 1/8 - 1/2. We find that a large Jbₒₜ can always drive an interlayer superconductivity by coupling the two layers in both the Luther-Emery liquid and Luttinger liquid states. By coupling two Luther-Emery liquid states, the in-plane superconductivity evolves to inter-plane superconductivity either through an intermediate charge density wave (CDW) phase or directly, depending on doping ratio. This emergent CDW phase, which exists over a finite doping range, appears to develop from the CDW state of the two-leg ladder at δ = 1/4. By coupling two Luttinger liquids, the in-plane Luttinger liquids show a transition to the inter-plane superconducting phase at large Jbₒₜ, as reported in previous literature. Interestingly, in the intermediate Jbₒₜ regime we find that while the in-plane Luttinger-liquid features remain stable, the inter-plane superconductivity can develop an enhanced quasi-long-range order with the power exponent Kzzₘ̊ SC sim 1. At last, we show that the interlayer superconductivity is also stable by coupling the bilayer three-leg t-J ladders by a strong Jbₒₜ interaction, from both the Luther-Emery liquid and Luttinger-liquid states.
articles.abstract_zh: 受双层铜氧化物和镍酸盐超导体的启发，本文研究了有限宽度双层t-J-Jbₒₜ梯子中层内到层间超导的演化。通过密度矩阵重整化群计算，绘制了双层两腿梯子在不同掺杂范围内的量子相图。研究发现，大的层间自旋相互作用Jbₒₜ总能驱动层间超导，且层内超导向层间超导的演化可能通过中间电荷密度波（CDW）相或直接发生。
authors: Yuan Yang, Xin Lu, Yuan Wan, Wei-Qiang Chen, Shou-Shu Gong

articles.title: Gate-tunable Josephson parametric amplifiers based on semiconductor nanowires
articles.title_zh: 基于半导体纳米线的栅极可调谐约瑟夫森参量放大器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.00305v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Superconductor-semiconductor hybrid materials have been extensively used for experiments on electrically tunable quantum devices. Notably, Josephson junctions utilizing nanowire weak links have enabled a number of new gate-tunable qubits, including gatemons, Andreev level qubits and spin qubits. Conversely, superconducting parametric amplifiers based on Josephson junctions have not yet been implemented using nanowires, even though such nearly quantum limited amplifiers are key elements in experiments on quantum circuits. Here we present Josephson parametric amplifiers based on arrays of parallel InAs nanowires that feature a large critical current as required for linear amplification. The resonance frequency of the devices is gate-tunable by almost 1 GHz, with a gain exceeding 20 dB in multiple frequencies and markedly improved noise performance compared to a low-temperature commercial amplifier. This platform enables on-chip integration of gate-tunable qubits with nearly quantum limited amplifiers using the same hybrid materials and on any substrate.
articles.abstract_zh: 超导体-半导体混合材料在电可调量子器件实验中应用广泛。本文展示了基于平行InAs纳米线阵列的约瑟夫森参量放大器，其具有线性放大所需的大临界电流。该器件的谐振频率可由栅极调谐近1 GHz，在多个频率下增益超过20 dB，并显著改善了噪声性能。这一平台实现了栅极可调谐量子比特与近量子极限放大器的片上集成。
authors: Raphael Rousset-Zenou, Nicolas Aparicio, Simon Messelot, Rasmus D. Schlosser, Martin Bjergfelt, Julien Renard, Moïra Hocevar, Jesper Nygård

articles.title: Thermodynamics of the q-deformed Kittel--Shore model
