articles.title_zh: q-形变Kittel--Shore模型的热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.15216v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Kittel--Shore Hamiltonian characterizes N spins with identical long-range interactions, and the mathfraksu(2) coalgebra has been proven to be a symmetry of this model, which can be exactly solved. By using quantum groups and, in particular, mathfraksuq(2), this Hamiltonian was deformed. In this work, we study the thermodynamic properties of this deformed model for spin-1/2 particles. In particular, we discuss how this deformation affects the specific heat, magnetic susceptibility, magnetisation, and phase transitions as a function of the parameter q of the deformation and compare them with those of the undeformed model. Deformation was found to shift the thermodynamic behaviours to higher temperatures and alter the phase transitions. Additionally, we extend the framework to complex deformations on the unit circle, q = eⁱθ, for q not being a root of unity. For an N=4 tetrahedral cluster, this phase establishes a thermodynamic equivalence between a second-neighbor spin-Hamiltonian and the q-deformed quantum model. At least, we have found experimental compounds well reproduced by the Kittel--Shore model for N=4. Validating our effective algebraic model against exact diagonalisation data for the Cu₂Te₂O₅X₂ (X=Cl, Br) compound family demonstrates that θ accurately reproduces the structural anisotropy.
articles.abstract_zh: Kittel--Shore哈密顿量描述了具有相同长程相互作用的N个自旋，其具有su(2)余代数对称性。本文利用量子群对该哈密顿量进行了形变，并研究了自旋1/2粒子形变模型的热力学性质。研究发现，形变将热力学行为推向更高温度并改变了相变。此外，该工作还将框架扩展到单位圆上的复数形变，并建立了N=4四面体簇的第二近邻自旋哈密顿量与q-形变量子模型之间的热力学等价性。
authors: V. Mariscal, J. J. Relancio

articles.title: Unifying Dirac Spin Liquids on Square and Shastry-Sutherland Lattices via Fermionic Deconfined Criticality
articles.title_zh: 通过费米子去禁闭临界性统一方格和Shastry-Sutherland晶格上的狄拉克自旋液体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.19980v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a fermionic gauge theory for deconfined quantum criticality on the Shastry-Sutherland lattice and reveal its shared low-energy field-theoretic structure with the square lattice. Starting from an SU(2) π-flux parent state, we construct a continuum theory of Dirac spinons coupled to an SU(2) gauge field and adjoint Higgs fields whose condensates drive transitions to a staggered-flux U(1) spin liquid and a gapless Z₂ Dirac spin liquid. While the Shastry-Sutherland lattice permits additional symmetry-allowed fermion bilinears compared to the square lattice, the quantum field theories are identical up to additional irrelevant terms. Consequently, the Higgs potential structure and the leading low-energy theory coincide with the square-lattice case at the quantum critical point. The SO(5) critical point is expected to realize conformal deconfined criticality: we analyze it in a large-flavor expansion, calculate its critical exponents, and identify the Yukawa coupling between the fermions and Higgs fields as the relevant perturbation that destabilizes it, consistent with pseudocritical behavior observed in recent Monte Carlo studies. We show that the emergent SO(5) order parameter acquires a large anomalous dimension at the critical point, leading to strongly enhanced Néel and VBS susceptibilities-a hallmark of fermionic deconfined quantum criticality consistent with numerical studies. Our results place recent numerical evidence for a gapless Z₂ Dirac spin liquid on the Shastry-Sutherland lattice within a controlled field-theoretic framework and demonstrate that fermionic deconfined criticality on the square lattice-including critical exponents and stability-extends to frustrated lattices with reduced symmetry.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了Shastry-Sutherland晶格上去禁闭量子临界性的费米子规范理论，并揭示了其与方格晶格共享的低能场论结构。研究构建了狄拉克自旋子与SU(2)规范场和伴随希格斯场耦合的连续理论。结果表明，尽管Shastry-Sutherland晶格允许额外的对称性允许的费米子双线性，但量子场论在临界点处与方格晶格相同。
authors: Andreas Feuerpfeil, Leyna Shackleton, Atanu Maity, Ronny Thomale, Subir Sachdev, Yasir Iqbal

articles.title: Kelvin-Helmholtz and counter-superflow instabilities driven by differential effective rotation in a three-component Bose-Einstein condensate
articles.title_zh: 三组分玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中由差分有效旋转驱动的开尔文-亥姆霍兹和反超流不稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.19207v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Interfacial hydrodynamic instabilities in multicomponent superfluids provide a versatile platform to explore nonequilibrium quantum dynamics beyond classical fluid analogues. We study dynamical interfacial instabilities in a quasi-two-dimensional three-component Bose-Einstein condensate confined in a harmonic trap, where differential effective rotation between neighboring components is generated through selective phase imprinting. A component with an imprinted vorticity lⱼ acquires an azimuthal phase winding φⱼ = lⱼθ, producing a superfluid velocity v_θ(rⱼ₎ = lⱼhbar/mrⱼ at interface radius rⱼ and an effective angular velocity Ømegaⱼeff = lⱼhbar/mrⱼ². The differential effective rotation ΔØmegaⱼeff = Ømegaⱼeff - Ømegaⱼ₊₁eff between neighboring components constitutes the sole driver of interfacial shear and the Kelvin-Helmholtz instability (KHI). Three instability regimes are examined: KHI in the strongly immiscible limit, counter-superflow instability in the partially miscible regime, and a parameter window where both mechanisms coexist. A hydrodynamic pressure-balance model is derived, showing that the KHI onset condition depends only on ΔØmegaⱼeff. Time-dependent Gross-Pitaevskii simulations and a Bogoliubov-de Gennes analysis identify the dominant unstable modes, whose spatial structures are consistent with the observed density modulations. The dominant azimuthal mode is set by a competition between shear-driven destabilization and surface-tension stabilization, confirmed by numerical simulations with different imprinted vorticities. The results show that a three-component condensate with two tunable interfaces provides a controlled platform for studying multicomponent quantum hydrodynamics, with instability dynamics significantly richer than those of binary mixtures.
articles.abstract_zh: 多组分超流体中的界面流体动力学不稳定性为探索非平衡量子动力学提供了平台。本文研究了准二维三组分玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中由选择性相位印记产生的差分有效旋转驱动的动态界面不稳定性。研究考察了强不混溶极限下的开尔文-亥姆霍兹不稳定性（KHI）、部分可混溶区域的反超流不稳定性以及两种机制共存的参数窗口。
authors: Susovan Giri, Arpana Saboo, Hari Sadhan Ghosh, Vipin, Sonjoy Majumder

articles.title: Anomalous Low-temperature Magnetotransport in Kagome Metal CsCr₃Sb₅ under Pressure
articles.title_zh: 压力下笼目金属CsCr₃Sb₅中的反常低温磁输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.13553v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: As a unique kagome superconductor displaying clear signatures of strong electronic correlations, CsCr₃Sb₅ has drawn much attention. Its rich temperature-pressure phase diagram features intertwined orders including pressure-induced superconductivity and two density-wave-like phases, making it an outstanding platform to explore the complex coexistence and competition of multiple quantum orders. At around 30 K, which we designate as T₃, a possible anomaly manifesting as a hump in the resistivity has been observed, yet its nature remains largely unexplored due to limited supporting evidence from other probes. Here, we conducted systematic magnetotransport experiments under hydrostatic pressure to investigate the nature of this anomaly. Our results reveal an abundance of intriguing magnetotransport signatures below T₃, including a non-trivial temperature dependence of the Hall coefficient, multi-band characteristics, and pressure-enhanced anomalous-Hall-like effect. These signatures bear resemblance to those observed in many other correlated materials with distinct origins. These findings suggest the possibility of an additional electronic order in CsCr₃Sb₅, calling for further detailed investigations.
articles.abstract_zh: 笼目超导体CsCr₃Sb₅因其强电子关联特征而备受关注，其复杂的温压相图展现出交织的量子序。本研究通过静水压下的磁输运实验，系统地探究了CsCr₃Sb₅在约30 K处观察到的电阻异常。结果揭示了低于30 K时丰富的磁输运特征，包括霍尔系数的非平凡温度依赖性、多带特性以及压力增强的反常霍尔效应。这些发现暗示了可能存在额外的电子序。
authors: Zikai Zhou, Wenyan Wang, Deng Hu, Zheyu Wang, Ying Kit Tsui, Tsz Fung Poon, Zhiwei Wang, Swee K. Goh

articles.title: Dynamic Eikonal Attenuation and Mutual Coherence of Quantum Particles due to Equilibrium Coulomb Fluctuations
articles.title_zh: 平衡库仑涨落引起的量子粒子动态程函衰减和互相关性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.18196v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We develop a dynamic theory of eikonal attenuation and mutual coherence for a quantum particle propagating through equilibrium Coulomb fluctuations. The one-particle length ell is the attenuation length of the ensemble-averaged retarded propagator, not an Anderson localization length or a transport mean free path. For a collisionless classical one-component plasma (OCP), the potential spectrum follows from the fluctuation--dissipation theorem and the RPA dielectric function. In suitable plasma parameter windows, both fast and slow probe regimes are physically meaningful. Fast probes recover the Coulomb logarithm with the dynamical infrared length v/ømegaₘ̊ ₚ. Slow probes yield G(v)propto v and, in the controlled weak branch, ellpropto k. We derive an exact finite-thickness mutual-coherence expression and a closed slow-regime transverse scaling function. Within the controlled slow-OCP and thick-slab window, the logarithmic two-ray visibility scales as v⁻¹ at fixed transverse separation, in contrast to the v⁻² dependence for frozen finite-slab fluctuations. For a symmetric diffusive electrolyte, linearized stochastic density functional theory gives the exact on-shell result Gₘ̊ ₑₗ(v)=(m²C/hbar⁴⁾øperatornamearsinh[v/(2Dκ)], where C=kₘₐₜₕᵣₘ BTq₀²/(4πǎrepsilon_b). For ordinary liquid electrolytes, the slow diffusive limit is inaccessible within the spatial eikonal regime and is therefore a formal asymptote. The physically relevant electrolyte limit is instead that of a fast probe, vgg Dκ, where the diffusive charge relaxation generates an intrinsic infrared length v/(Dκ²⁾ absent from the quasi-static theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文发展了一种动态理论，用于描述量子粒子在平衡库仑涨落中传播时的程函衰减和互相关性。研究了无碰撞经典单组分等离子体（OCP）中探针的快慢两种机制，并推导了精确的有限厚度互相关表达式。结果表明，在受控的慢速OCP和厚板窗口内，对数双射线可见度与速度呈v⁻¹标度关系，这与冻结有限板涨落的情况不同。
authors: Yury A. Budkov

articles.title: Planckian dissipation from classical hydrodynamics
articles.title_zh: 经典流体动力学中的普朗克耗散
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.19450v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Hydrodynamics describes the long-time, long-distance dynamics of interacting quantum systems by classical equations, yet at low temperature quantum fluctuations might eventually invalidate this classical picture. Here we ask what it takes for a quantum system to sustain a consistently classical hydrodynamic description. Our starting point is the quantum fluctuation-dissipation theorem which, when read in the time domain, acts as a blurring of the fine details of correlation functions on a Planckian time-scale. We analyse how this blurring interacts with the diffusive large-deviation form of correlators assuming the existence of a hydrodynamic light cone velocity, and show that the interior of the cone splits into a classical region, where correlation and response satisfy the classical fluctuation-dissipation relation, and a quantum region, where they deviate sharply from it. We illustrate the mechanism on three phenomenological hydrodynamic equations - diffusion, telegraph and diffusive-telegraph. Preserving a finite classical region as the temperature is lowered forces the current relaxation rate to be bounded from above by the Planckian rate. This bound connects to bounds on diffusivity, equilibration time and shear viscosity. In this way, a Planckian bound on dissipation emerges not as a quantum constraint on microscopic dynamics, but as the price a system pays to remain describable by classical hydrodynamics down to low temperatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 流体动力学通常用经典方程描述相互作用量子系统的长时程行为，但在低温下量子涨落可能使其失效。本文探讨了量子系统如何维持一致的经典流体动力学描述。研究发现，在普朗克时间尺度上，量子涨落-耗散定理导致关联函数细节模糊，并将流体动力学光锥内部划分为经典区域和量子区域。维持有限经典区域要求电流弛豫速率受普朗克常数限制。
authors: Laura Foini, Jorge Kurchan, Silvia Pappalardi

articles.title: Fractional Quantum Hall States: Infinite Matrix Product Representation and its Implications
articles.title_zh: 分数量子霍尔态：无限矩阵乘积表示及其启示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.12165v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present a novel matrix product representation of the Laughlin and related fractional quantum Hall wavefunctions based on a rigorous version of the correlators of a chiral quantum field theory. This representation enables the quantitative control of the coefficients of the Laughlin wavefunction times an arbitrary monomial symmetric polynomial when expanded in a Slater determinant or permanent basis. It renders the properties, such as factorization and the renewal structure, inherent in such fractional quantum Hall wavefunctions transparent. We prove bounds on the correlators of the chiral quantum field theory and utilize this representation to demonstrate the exponential decay of connected correlations and a gap in the entanglement spectrum on a thin cylinder.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于手性量子场论关联函数的Laughlin波函数及相关分数量子霍尔波函数的新型矩阵乘积表示。该表示方法能够定量控制Laughlin波函数展开时的系数，并清晰揭示了其固有的因子化和更新结构等特性。研究证明了手性量子场论关联函数的界限，并利用此表示展示了薄圆柱体上连接关联的指数衰减和纠缠谱中的能隙。
authors: Severin Schraven, Simone Warzel

articles.title: Logically Augmented Quantum LDPC Codes: Construction and Hierarchical Decoding
articles.title_zh: 逻辑增强型量子LDPC码：构造与分层解码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.07062v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a joint framework for constructing and decoding Logically Augmented (LA) quantum low-density parity-check (QLDPC) codes. This is motivated by the need for flexible coding rates and adaptive error protection while preserving block length and code structure. On the construction side, we use an auxiliary Logical Protection Code (LPC) to impose additional stabilizer constraints on selected logical qubits of a primary code. On the decoding side, the proposed decoder uses the LPC syndrome to generate logical error hypotheses and condition belief propagation (BP) on each hypothesis. The proposed Hierarchical Logical List Decoder (HLLD) is invoked only when the initial BP decoder for primary code fails to converge. It then selects the correction with the smallest Hamming weight among the syndrome-consistent candidates produced by hypothesis-conditioned BP runs. For numerical evaluation, we focus on short repetition LPCs, which provide a flexible means of trading rate for additional error protection. Each LPC syndrome admits exactly two logical error hypotheses, irrespective of repetition length, which enables HLLD to explore both possibilities without relying on a single logical estimate. Numerical results show that varying the repetition length provides a tunable trade-off between rate and error-correction performance across a wide range of primary code constructions and their operating regimes. On the decoding side, with the overall LA code held fixed, HLLD reduces the logical error rate by up to 81%, 75%, and 69% for LA codes based on mitten, lifted-product, and bivariate bicycle codes, respectively, compared with conventional BP decoding of the same LA codes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个用于构造和解码逻辑增强型（LA）量子低密度奇偶校验（QLDPC）码的联合框架。该方法通过辅助逻辑保护码（LPC）对主码的选定逻辑量子比特施加额外的稳定器约束，以实现灵活的编码速率和自适应错误保护。所提出的分层逻辑列表解码器（HLLD）在主码的初始BP解码器失效时启动，通过LPC综合征生成逻辑错误假设并选择最小汉明权重的校正。
authors: Sheida Rabeti, Ayushi Shirke, Ivana Dimitrova, Hessam Mahdavifar

articles.title: Uniform Three-Fold Product Expansion of Algebraic-Geometry Codes over a Fixed Field
articles.title_zh: 固定域上代数几何码的均匀三重乘积展开
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.08172v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A collection of classical codes C₁,dots,Cₘ has product expansion if every low-weight word in the sum of their extensions to the product space can be written as a sum of words supported on few lines, each line being a codeword of the corresponding Cᵢ. For m=2 product expansion is equivalent to robust testability of the tensor code, while for mge 3 it is strictly stronger; it is the hypothesis on the local codes behind recent constructions of good quantum LDPC codes, good quantum locally testable codes, and quantum codes with transversal non-Clifford gates. No explicit family over a fixed field was previously known to achieve constant rate, linear distance for both the code and its dual, and 3-fold product expansion at growing length. We prove that for the one-point evaluation codes Cᵢ of length Nᵢ₌₇₂₈ḑot27,ⁱ⁻¹ and pole order łfloor Nᵢ/5f̊loor on the Garcia--Stichtenoth tower over F₇₂₉, the triple (Cᵢ,Cᵢ,Cᵢ₎ has product expansion with a constant independent of i. The dual codes Cᵢ^perp then form an explicit fixed-field family of rate tending to 109/130 and relative distance at least 8/65. The proof is geometric: we view the words of the sum code as arrays on the product of three copies of the i-th curve of the tower, where the parity checks are sections of a line bundle. An exact generation theorem describes the sum-code words supported on the grid footprint of a suitable divisor. A support-localisation argument then shows that every low-weight array lies on such a divisor, after deleting a small number of coordinates. We also give a sufficient criterion for three-fold product expansion in terms of degree and genus ratios, yielding explicit families over every non-prime finite field of order at least 512. The principal conclusions have been formally verified in Lean 4.
articles.abstract_zh: 乘积展开是构建良好量子LDPC码和量子可测试码的关键假设。本文证明了在Garcia-Stichtenoth塔上，对于特定长度和极点阶数的一点求值码Cᵢ，其三重组合(Cᵢ,Cᵢ,Cᵢ)具有与i无关的常数乘积展开。其对偶码Cᵢ^perp构成了一个显式的固定域族，其速率趋近于109/130，相对距离至少为8/65。该证明采用几何方法。
authors: Cassie Ding, Min-Hsiu Hsieh

articles.title: Product Expansion of Random Codes via Analytic Techniques
articles.title_zh: 基于解析技术的随机码乘积展开
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.02512v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Beginning with the work of Dinur, Lin, and Vidick (FOCS, 2024), tensor codes with constant product expansion have been foundational to recent advances in quantum locally testable codes (qLTCs) based on cubical complexes. Informally, product expansion says that any low-weight parity check of the tensor code can be written as the sum of few parity checks of each component code in each dimension. Recent work of Kalachev and Panteleev (FOCS, 2025) showed that tensors of random linear codes have constant product expansion. In this work we initiate the study of random linear codes with prescribed automorphism groups. For every sufficiently large prime k, we construct pairs of rate 1/2 MDS codes of length 2k, over finite fields whose size depends on k, that have constant two-sided product expansion and are invariant under the simultaneous cyclic shift of two cycles of length k. This shift is the local action in the cube complexes of Rungtanapirom, Stix, and Vdovina (Internat. J. Algebra Comput., 2019). Along the way we give a proof of the existence of two-sided product expanding codes which, unlike the earlier result of [KP25], does not rely on explicit constructions of asymptotically optimal locally testable codes. Our proof relies on several new techniques that we view as interesting in their own right. Instead of working directly over finite fields, we work over the reals and use random Rademacher matrices for the generator matrices of the component codes. From here, we show how to relate product expansion to the operator norm of sparse restrictions of carefully chosen Gram matrices, which we bound using tools from random matrix theory. More generally, we propose a method for studying properties of random linear codes by lifting to random codes over R and C, which we anticipate will be applicable more broadly to existential problems in coding theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有常数乘积展开的张量码是量子局部可测试码（qLTCs）研究的基础。本文首次研究了具有预设自同构群的随机线性码。对于足够大的素数k，我们构造了长度为2k、速率为1/2的MDS码对，它们具有常数双边乘积展开，并且在两个长度为k的循环的同步循环移位下保持不变。本研究还提供了一个存在双边乘积展开码的证明。
authors: Eshan Chattopadhyay, Noam Ringach, Nicholas Spooner

articles.title: Range-controlled entanglement in Lindbladian skin states of monitored fermions
articles.title_zh: 监测费米子Lindbladian趋肤态中的范围可控纠缠
articles.abstract: Author(s): Gianluca Passarelli, Angelo Russomanno, Davide Rossini, and Procolo Lucignano Reservoir engineering can stabilize states inaccessible to unitary dynamics. Directed particle-conserving dissipation creates Lindbladian skin states, where Pauli exclusion turns edge accumulation into a many-body density imbalance. In a monitored fermion chain with tunable hopping range, we identif… [Phys. Rev. B 114, L291303] Published Fri Nov 06, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 储层工程能够稳定酉动力学无法达到的量子态。本文研究了具有可调跳跃范围的监测费米子链中，粒子守恒耗散如何产生Lindbladian趋肤态，其中泡利不相容原理导致边缘积累形成多体密度不平衡。该工作围绕Lindbladian趋肤态中的范围可控纠缠展开，详情需查阅原文。
authors: Gianluca Passarelli, Angelo Russomanno, Davide Rossini, and Procolo Lucignano

articles.title: On-Demand Millisecond Storage of Spectrotemporal Modes at Telecom Wavelength
articles.title_zh: 电信波长下光谱时间模式的按需毫秒级存储
articles.abstract: Author(s): Anuj Sethia, Nasser Gohari Kamel, and Daniel Oblak The realization of scalable quantum networks for distribution of entanglement over long distances hinges on quantum repeaters. articles.title: Dynamically modulated light-matter interactions for ancilla-tolerant bosonic control
articles.title_zh: 容错玻色子控制中的动态调制光-物质相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05460v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strong light-matter interactions are central to state-of-the-art quantum technologies, spanning platforms as diverse as Rydberg atoms, trapped ions, and superconducting circuits. In superconducting circuits, the strong dispersive coupling between microwave photons (light) and ancillary qubits (matter) has enabled universal bosonic control and quantum error correction. However, this always-on dispersive interaction propagates errors from the ancillary qubits to the bosonic systems both while idling and when performing operations, introducing a trade-off between control strength and fidelity. We break this trade-off by introducing a parametrically activated hybridization between the bosonic modes and ancilla qubits, keeping both elements decoupled when not active. When activated, this hybridization mediates a dynamic light-matter coupling with non-trivial engineered symmetries, permitting resilience to ancilla decay and dephasing. This dynamic coupling functions as a new control primitive that offers a route to bosonic processors whose performance is set by the oscillator, rather than the ancilla.

articles.title: Toward a Quantum Information Foundation for Neutron Scattering

articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05466v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neutron scattering is a central probe of quantum materials, yet what quantum information can, in principle, be extracted from a scattering experiment remains unclear. Here we formulate neutron scattering as a quantum measurement, with the scattering amplitudes acting as Kraus operators on the material state. This provides a unified description of conventional intensity, coherent scattering, interferometric measurements, and entanglement witnesses, including those based on quantum Fisher information. We then ask how far this connection can be extended to nonlinear properties of a quantum state. For two independently prepared samples, we derive the general structure of probe-mediated measurement probabilities and show that, for spin-projection-conserving dynamics, low-order scattering cannot resolve certain many-body coherences required to determine purity. Conversely, an idealized single-spin protocol shows how probe-mediated exchange can access purity when the appropriate two-copy operation is realized. Our results establish a quantum-information description of neutron scattering and delineate the information accessible through conventional and interferometric measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 中子散射是量子材料的重要探测手段，但其可提取的量子信息尚不明确。本文将中子散射表述为一种量子测量，其中散射振幅作为对材料态的克劳斯算符。这为传统强度、相干散射、干涉测量和纠缠见证提供了一个统一描述。研究结果建立了中子散射的量子信息描述，并界定了通过传统方法可获取的信息。
authors: Michael J. Landry, Yongqiang Cheng, Daniel Pajerowski, Joshua J. Turner, Mingda Li

articles.title: Noise-Induced Topology in Chiral Quantum Walks
articles.title_zh: 手性量子行走中的噪声诱导拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05471v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Noise typically destroys quantum coherence and washes out transport phenomena that rely on interference. Chiral quantum walks are a case in point: a particle hopping on a lattice threaded by a magnetic flux can spread asymmetrically due to interference between paths, an asymmetry that noise is expected to erase. Remarkably, we find that the most ubiquitous noise -- random fluctuations of on-site energies (dephasing) -- instead renders this asymmetry topologically robust. The density profile develops a skewness that grows in time while its center stays fixed, and in a finite chain the late-time relaxation modes pile up at one edge: a skin effect lacking the drift of conventional non-Hermitian skin effects. With multiple sites per unit cell, the dephasing strength alone can cause a topological phase transition, reversing the asymmetry. On a flux ladder with noisy rung hopping, the noise causes a drift of rung coherences, a quantum ratchet with no classical counterpart. Underlying these effects, the noise-averaged dynamics is an interacting (generically non-integrable) Lindbladian that remains analytically tractable. The modes governing late-time relaxation are bound states of the noise-induced interaction and form a band with a point gap, absent both without noise and under postselection, whose winding number fixes the direction of the asymmetry. These effects are within reach of several experimental platforms, including synthetic lattices, superconducting qubits, and optical lattices.
articles.abstract_zh: 噪声通常会破坏量子相干性并消除依赖于干涉的输运现象。然而，本研究发现，最普遍的噪声——局域能量的随机波动（退相干）——反而使手性量子行走中的不对称性具有拓扑鲁棒性。密度分布会产生随时间增长的偏斜，并在有限链中导致弛豫模式堆积在边缘，表现出一种缺乏漂移的趋肤效应。此外，退相干强度本身可以引起拓扑相变，逆转不对称性。
authors: Alexandre Chaduteau, Derek K. K. Lee, Frank Schindler, Abhinav Prem

articles.title: Boosted Entanglement Swapping
articles.title_zh: 增强型纠缠交换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05497v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Entanglement swapping entangles photons that never interacted directly. When implemented with linear optics, its success probability is upper bounded by 50%, due to the limited efficiency of linear-optical Bell-state measurements. Here, we demonstrate boosted entanglement swapping using an ancilla-assisted linear-optical Bell-state measurement, which raises the theoretical success probability to 62.5% and allows all four Bell states to be identified. We measure an acceptance rate of pₐb=(69.39±0.39)% with an average fidelity of the swapped states of łangle Fbångle=(76.6±1.0)%. We implement this protocol using photons at 1550 nm, making it well suited for quantum repeaters, where it could enable more efficient entanglement distribution. Beyond quantum communication, it could also enhance fusion-based quantum computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 纠缠交换能够使从未直接相互作用的光子产生纠缠。传统的线性光学实现受限于贝尔态测量的效率，成功概率上限为50%。本文通过辅助量子比特增强的线性光学贝尔态测量，将理论成功概率提高到62.5%，并能识别所有四种贝尔态。实验测得接受率为69.39%±0.39%，交换态的平均保真度为76.6%±1.0%。该协议适用于量子中继器和融合型量子计算，可提高纠缠分发的效率。
authors: Matthias J. Bayerbach, Simone E. D'Aurelio, Stefanie Barz

articles.title: Raychaudhuri-Ehlers Kinematics on Quantum State-Space: Caustics and Extrinsic Quantum Geometry
articles.title_zh: 量子态空间上的Raychaudhuri-Ehlers运动学：焦散与外禀量子几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05499v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum mechanics is inherently geometric in that the pure states form a curved complex manifold and the Schrödinger evolution defines a Hamiltonian flow on this space. Geometry identifies constraints on flows on quantum state-space that hold independently of their microscopic realization. We uncover such universal behavior in families of geodesic paths on the quantum state-space using the Raychaudhuri-Ehlers equations. We show that the complex structure leads to tidal anisotropy in the curvature, and for Hilbert space dimension N≥3, complete point-emitted geodesic bundles necessarily develop shear and undergo direction-selective focusing at finite distance. We give these geometric results an information-theoretic interpretation in terms of fidelity susceptibility and quantum Fisher information. For ground-state manifolds constrained by physical parameters, we resolve the tidal curvature into Berry-curvature-dependent ambient tides and contributions from extrinsic bending within the full ambient state space. We further relate extrinsic bending to variations in the unitary generator of motion along intrinsic geodesics. We present exact many-body geometric results for the transverse-field XY spin chain. The product structure of the ground state leads to an exact cancellation of the ambient tide, including its Berry-curvature enhancement, by extrinsic curvature contributions. At the zero-field Ising point, we obtain exact results at finite size and show that the shear source for anisotropy-directed motion is entirely extrinsic relative to the full many-body state-space. For the metric in the thermodynamic limit, the geodesic families exhibit repeated A₂ fold catastrophes inside the ferromagnetic phase. Our framework thus separates universal state-space effects from those of physical restrictions and exposes their consequences in a paradigmatic many-body system.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子力学本质上是几何的，纯态构成弯曲的复流形，薛定谔演化定义了其上的哈密顿流。本文利用Raychaudhuri-Ehlers方程，揭示了量子态空间测地线族中的普适行为。研究表明，复结构导致曲率的潮汐各向异性，且对于希尔伯特空间维度N≥3，点发射的测地线束必然产生剪切并在有限距离处发生方向选择性聚焦。这些几何结果在信息论上可解释为保真度敏感性和量子费舍尔信息。
authors: Neellohit Karmakar, Suraj S. Hegde, Aryan Bhatia

articles.title: Quantum error correcting codes from quiver moduli: Grassmannians, cyclic monodromy, and argyle collision divisors
articles.title_zh: 基于箭袋模的量子纠错码：格拉斯曼流形、循环单值性和菱形碰撞除子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05526v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Building on aspects of a recent diagrammatic field-theory programme for quantum error correction put forward by the first-named author (arXiv:2607.08911), we construct exact finite-dimensional codes from twisted cyclic and argyle quiver moduli on the projective line. A regular fibre of the node-labelled cyclic Hitchin map records the ways to distribute simple spectral zeroes among the arrows with prescribed degrees. The Hilbert space spanned by these allocations is a Young permutation module. Root monodromy acts on its Specht factors and leaves their multiplicity spaces noiseless. Resetting the Specht factor therefore recovers the encoded state for every channel in the monodromy noise model. We prove that the largest Kostka multiplicity is the optimal dimension of a subspace code correcting the full monodromy algebra, even among codes spanning several isotypic blocks. Quantizing an argyle master space recovers the cyclic sheet space as a weight sector of a tensor power, with the identification preserving monodromy. For the balanced three-cycle with t zeroes per arrow, the multiplicity of a partition (a,b,c) of 3t is 1+min(a-b,b-c). The optimal logical dimension is thus t+1, attained uniquely by the block indexed by (2t,t). At t=1 we give explicit codewords for a qubit on six sheets. The commuting right action generates its full logical algebra, yielding errors outside the monodromy model that leave the measured footprint statistics unchanged yet require different recoveries. We also compute collision-parity ranks, give a higher-rank Grassmannian example, and derive a conditional criterion for recovery across splitting types.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于量子纠错的图示场论程序，从射影线上的扭曲循环和菱形箭袋模构建了精确的有限维量子纠错码。节点标记的循环Hitchin映射的正则纤维记录了在给定度数下将简单谱零点分布到箭头的多种方式。根单值性作用于其Specht因子，并使它们的重数空间无噪声。研究证明，最大的Kostka重数是纠正完整单值代数的子空间码的最佳维度。
authors: Steven Rayan, Evan Sundbo

articles.title: Higher-order quantum information inequalities and error-correction of non-Markovian noise
articles.title_zh: 高阶量子信息不等式与非马尔可夫噪声的纠错
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05541v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Defining entropy of a quantum channel has become a challenge with potential candidates recently reported in literature. In this Article, it is taken under consideration the entropy of a quantum channel defined as the quantum entropy of its associated Choi state. The consequences presented here of such approach is two-fold. First, the limitations on the information-processing of quantum channels are assessed, leading to the emph{higher-order quantum information inequalities}. Those are then considered as useful witnesses of non-Markovian effects beyond a given number of quantum side-channels in a quantum process. Importantly, the presentation is given with the application of the methods for the study of examples. Second, such approach provides a characterization on the condition for the recovery of quantum channel preparations under non-Markovian noise. Such result is a straightforward extension of standard error-correction conditions which gives further meaning to the higher-order information measures defined here.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子信道熵的定义是一个挑战。本文将量子信道的熵定义为其关联Choi态的量子熵，并探讨了该方法的双重结果。首先，评估了量子信道信息处理的局限性，导出了高阶量子信息不等式，可作为非马尔可夫效应的有用判据。其次，该方法为非马尔可夫噪声下量子信道制备的恢复条件提供了表征。
authors: Matheus Capela

articles.title: Multipartite entanglement swapping with homodyne and single photon detection
articles.title_zh: 基于零拍和单光子探测的多方纠缠交换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05597v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Establishing multipartite entanglement across lossy optical networks remains a central challenge for distributed quantum information processing. Here, we consider a non-Gaussian continuous-variable entanglement-swapping protocol combining a symmetric discrete Fourier transform (DFT) interferometer with photon-number-resolving detection. In the ideal limit, single-photon heralding generates a W_N-class state across remote modes, with Fourier symmetry rendering all single-click outcomes equivalent up to local phase corrections. We find that conditional pairwise entanglement can exceed that of conventional Gaussian homodyne swapping in weak-to-moderate squeezing and lossy regimes, remaining nonzero beyond the channel-loss thresholds at which Gaussian pairwise entanglement vanishes. These results demonstrate that combining non-Gaussian measurements with symmetric interferometric mixing can improve both the resilience and operational efficiency of multipartite entanglement distribution in lossy quantum networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 在有损光学网络中建立多方纠缠是分布式量子信息处理的核心挑战。本文提出了一种非高斯连续变量纠缠交换协议，结合了对称离散傅里叶变换干涉仪和光子数分辨探测。在理想情况下，单光子预示可生成远程模式间的W_N类态。研究发现，在弱到中等挤压和有损条件下，条件对纠缠可以超越传统高斯零拍交换，并在高斯对纠缠消失的信道损耗阈值之外仍保持非零。
authors: Tarek Assaf, Josephine Dias

articles.title: Tensor-network simulation of strongly coupled multi-fluxonium circuits
articles.title_zh: 强耦合多通量子电路的张量网络模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05627v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Designing a superconducting quantum processor rests on predicting the low-lying spectrum of its coupled circuit. The Hilbert-space dimension of the circuit's lumped-element model grows exponentially with the number of circuit nodes. The usual methods split the circuit into subsystems, but that split is hard to choose when the elements are strongly coupled. We present a tensor-network method that chooses no subsystems and whose memory and run time per solve are set by the number of modes and two truncations, the Fock cutoff of each normal mode and the bond dimension of a matrix product state (MPS), not by the Hilbert-space dimension. From the capacitance matrix, the inverse-inductance matrix and the junction list alone, the linear circuit is diagonalized into normal modes. Each junction cosine is then a sum of two products of single-mode operators, so the complete lumped-element Hamiltonian is a matrix product operator (MPO) of small bond dimension with one site per mode, solved by the density matrix renormalization group (DMRG). The normal modes make the method generic, and the tensor network makes it affordable. For two fluxonia joined by a tunable coupler, the method agrees with exact diagonalization of the same truncated space to within 1 MHz. Our circuit of three fluxonia joined by two couplers has 11 normal modes and a truncated space of 10⁹ states, out of reach of exact diagonalization in dense or sparse storage. At a bond dimension of 32, its lowest eight levels are converged to within 1 MHz in both truncations, and each state is stored in a small fraction of the numbers a dense vector needs. One solve at that bond dimension takes 81 min and 1.3 GB of memory on one CPU node.
articles.abstract_zh: 超导量子处理器的设计依赖于预测其耦合电路的低能谱。电路集总元件模型的希尔伯特空间维度随节点数呈指数增长。本文提出了一种张量网络方法，其内存和运行时间由模式数量和两个截断（每个简正模式的福克截断和矩阵乘积态的键维）决定，而非希尔伯特空间维度。该方法将线性电路对角化为简正模式，并将完整的集总元件哈密顿量表示为小键维的矩阵乘积算符，通过密度矩阵重整化群求解。
authors: Christian Hensel, Andrés N. Cáliz, Pau Torrente, María Hita-Pérez, Arnau Riera

articles.title: Symmetry-guided algorithms for variational quantum optimization
articles.title_zh: 变分量子优化中的对称性引导算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05865v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum numbers associated with symmetries classify quantum states and identify the sectors relevant to a given simulation. Generic hardware-efficient ansatzes do not necessarily preserve the quantum numbers and may therefore explore states outside the target sector. We develop symmetry-guided algorithms based on the quantum-accessible Hilbert--Schmidt asymmetry ((AHS)), which quantifies the deviation of a quantum state from invariance under a specified symmetry group. This quantity guides the optimization toward a highly reduced symmetry-based target sector, without enforcing the symmetry on the preparation circuit. We demonstrate the approach as a proof of principle in variational quantum eigensolver calculations targeting singlet ground states with collective SU(2) symmetry. The applications include a five-qubit (S)-wave (p+{}³He) two-cluster Hamiltonian, deduced from ab initio many-body calculations, and collective spin models with up to 12 particles, which provide a many-particle benchmark of asymmetry-guided optimization. Across these applications, (AHS)-based guidance increases the singlet probability. Overall, the proposed algorithms improve energy accuracy during optimization and ground-state fidelity compared with direct energy minimization, with substantial fidelity improvements in the larger spin systems. These results demonstrate the utility of an asymmetry objective determined by the group action, independently of the Hamiltonian energy, for improving the reliability of variational quantum optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 与对称性相关的量子数对量子态进行分类，并识别与模拟相关的扇区。本文开发了一种基于量子可访问的希尔伯特-施密特不对称性（AHS）的对称性引导算法，该算法量化了量子态偏离指定对称群不变性的程度。AHS引导优化过程趋向于高度简化的对称性目标扇区，而无需在制备电路上强制执行对称性。该方法在针对具有集体SU(2)对称性的单重态基态的变分量子本征求解器计算中得到了原理性验证。
authors: Eunjin In, Kristina D. Launey, Darin C. Mumma, James A. Sauls

articles.title: Quantum Advantage in Sensing and Imaging through Coherent Nuisance Suppression
articles.title_zh: 通过相干干扰抑制实现传感和成像中的量子优势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05868v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many sensing and imaging problems must contend with unknown nuisance parameters such as aberrations, background fields, and drift, and the cost of removing these noise sources can dominate the sample budget. In contrast to classical receivers, a quantum receiver can processes samples jointly to directly access observables in which common nuisance is suppressed. We introduce a relational Fourier sampling algorithm for optimal, source-independent imaging with a programmable quantum camera, which uses quantum pixels and a quantum computer to capture and process photon states. We demonstrate its relevance for general astronomical imaging as well as super-resolution and transient-object tracking through drifting atmospheric turbulence. A quantum camera that resolves an optical wavefront across 2^q spatial modes using q receiving qubits, with a full-rank and strongly-correlated nuisance over those modes, can yield an exponential sample-complexity reduction of exp[Ømega(2^q)]. For typical seeing conditions at leading ground-based observatories, we predict more than three orders of magnitude fewer photons to resolve point-source positions using only 15 processing qubits and a depth-9 circuit. Our work identifies coherent nuisance suppression as a novel mechanism for provable quantum advantage with direct relevance to many sensing tasks.
articles.abstract_zh: 许多传感和成像问题面临未知干扰参数的挑战，其去除成本可能很高。与经典接收器不同，量子接收器可以联合处理样本以直接访问抑制了共同干扰的观测值。本文提出了一种关系傅里叶采样算法，用于可编程量子相机实现最佳、与源无关的成像。该算法在天文成像、超分辨率和通过漂移大气湍流跟踪瞬态物体方面具有重要意义。量子相机在具有强相关干扰的2^q个空间模式上解析光波前时，可实现指数级的样本复杂度降低。
authors: Maxim Sirotin, Aleksandr Mokeev, Ishaan Kannan, Julian C. Christou, Jayadev Rajagopal, Babak Saif, Mikhail D. Lukin, Johannes Borregaard

articles.title: Norm Bounds on Sums of Positive Operators with Applications to Monogamy Games and Quantum Key Distribution
articles.title_zh: 正算子和的范数界限及其在独占博弈和量子密钥分发中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05943v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bounding the acceptance probabilities of quantum measurements is a recurring task in quantum information theory. An acceptance probability averaged over a random measurement setting can be bounded uniformly over the input state by the operator norm of an average of positive semidefinite operators. We prove a general inequality for such norms, valid for arbitrary finite families of positive semidefinite operators and averaging distributions. We give two applications of our operator-norm inequality. First, we determine the sharp robustness threshold for the parallel BB84 monogamy-of-entanglement game. For error thresholds β,γin[0,1/2], when the two players may make at most β n and γ n errors, respectively, the optimal winning probability decays exponentially if (1-2β)²⁺⁽¹⁻²γ)²>1, tends to one exponentially fast under the reverse strict inequality, and remains bounded away from zero on the boundary. Second, we establish the achievability of every asymptotic key rate 0<1- 2h₂₍γ) for one-sided device-independent BB84 quantum key distribution with tolerated bit-error rate γ and asymptotically optimal reconciliation, where h₂₍ḑot) is the binary entropy function. Alice's measurements are trusted, while Bob may perform an arbitrary joint measurement depending on the entire basis string, subject to the protocol's receipt and isolation requirements. This recovers the usual BB84 rate in this model.
articles.abstract_zh: 限制量子测量的接受概率是量子信息理论中的一项常见任务。本文证明了一个关于正半定算子和的范数普遍不等式，适用于任意有限族正半定算子和平均分布。该算子范数不等式有两个应用：首先，确定了并行BB84纠缠独占博弈的精确鲁棒性阈值。其次，建立了单边设备无关BB84量子密钥分发中，在容忍误码率γ和渐近最优协调下，所有渐近密钥率0<1-2h₂(γ)的可实现性。
authors: Salman Beigi, Marco Tomamichel

articles.title: Collectively pumped superradiant laser with coherence scaling beyond the standard quantum limit
articles.title_zh: 集体泵浦超辐射激光器：相干性超越标准量子极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05976v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: For more than half a century, the standard quantum limit (SQL) was thought to limit the laser coherence mathfrakC -- the number of photons emitted from the laser into the beam in one coherence time -- to a scaling Θ(μ²⁾, where μ is the mean number of optical-frequency excitations stored inside the laser. However, recently it has been shown [Baker et al., Nat. Phys. 17, 179 (2021)] that the Heisenberg limit -- an achievable ultimate limit set by quantum mechanics for the task of producing a beam with the standard properties of a laser beam -- is mathfrakC=Θ(μ⁴⁾, a quadratic enhancement. So far, proposals to demonstrate beyond-SQL scaling of mathfrakC have been limited to circuit QED, at microwave frequencies (i.e., a maser). Here, we introduce a class of generalized far-above-threshold (FAT) laser models, obtained by replacing the ordinary bosonic lowering operator hata by a general lowering operator hatL in the superoperators appearing in the master equation that governs the FAT laser dynamics. We then show that an optical-frequency superradiant laser in the bad-cavity limit, with feedback-controlled collective pumping, realizes one such model, in which hatL is identified with the collective superradiant lowering operator hatJ. This model can surpass the SQL scaling, with the coherence exhibiting a scaling as large as mathfrakC= Θ(μ⁸/³) in the optimal parameter regime. Here, in the bad-cavity limit, μapprox N/2, where N is the number of superradiant atoms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出了一类广义的远超阈值（FAT）激光模型，旨在实现超越标准量子极限（SQL）的激光相干性。传统上，激光相干性被认为受限于SQL的二次方标度，但海森堡极限表明存在四次方标度的可能性。作者展示了在坏腔极限下，通过反馈控制的集体泵浦，光学频率的超辐射激光器可以实现这种超越SQL的相干性标度。
authors: Ori Somech, Howard M. Wiseman

articles.title: Classical Clifford+T Sampling without Computing Marginals
articles.title_zh: 无需计算边际概率的经典Clifford+T采样
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06119v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a new exact classical sampling algorithm for Clifford+T circuits, called T-by-T sampling. For a circuit with T-count t, it reduces sampling to evaluating 2t amplitudes of circuits with successively increasing T-counts 1,2,...,t, without the need to compute costly marginal probabilities. Crucially, the number of amplitude evaluations is completely independent of the surrounding Clifford structure. This makes T-by-T sampling well suited for use together with low-rank stabiliser decompositions, which enable efficient amplitude evaluations as long as the T-count is not too high. In that sense, T-by-T sampling is an improvement over the gate-by-gate sampling technique introduced by Bravyi, Gosset, and Liu (Phys. Rev. Lett. 128, 2022), where the number of amplitudes instead scales with the number of non-monomial operations such as Hadamard gates, which can remain large even in circuits with low stabiliser rank. Concretely, T-by-T sampling offers significant speedups in regimes where T gates are embedded within large Clifford computations. This makes it well suited for applications such as simulating quantum error correction experiments, which typically have lower T complexity but involve extensive Clifford operations and measurements. In particular, we show how T-by-T sampling allows us to take samples from recent end-to-end magic state cultivation circuits with escape up to distance 19 in a couple of seconds.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种名为“T-by-T采样”的Clifford+T电路精确经典采样算法。该方法将采样问题简化为评估2t个振幅，且评估次数与周围Clifford结构无关，避免了计算昂贵的边际概率。与现有方法相比，T-by-T采样在T门嵌入大型Clifford计算的场景中显著加速，特别适用于结合低秩稳定器分解进行高效振幅评估。
authors: Mark Koch (University of Oxford)

articles.title: Resetting a Superconducting Qubit with a Compact Colder Resistive Dissipator below the Qubit Frequency
articles.title_zh: 利用低于量子比特频率的紧凑型低温电阻耗散器重置超导量子比特
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06216v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Efficient qubit reset has become a key requirement for large-scale superconducting quantum processors, as initialization fidelity increasingly lags behind gate performance and quantum error correction demands rapid, high-fidelity state re-initialization. This work proposes a compact on-chip dissipator consisting of two transmon dissipation modes and a thin-film resistor, and experimentally demonstrates an unconditional reset protocol. With no additional control lines and negligible impact on the qubit T₁, the effective temperature of the transmon qubit is reduced from 49~mK to 35~mK. Quantum process tomography is employed to benchmark the reset process, achieving a process error of 0.0028. This reset protocol is robust to pulse parameter deviations, thereby relaxing calibration requirements. The dissipator architecture provides a practical, calibration-friendly reset solution for large-scale superconducting quantum processors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出了一种紧凑型片上耗散器，用于高效重置超导量子比特，以满足大规模量子处理器对高保真初始化的需求。该方案将量子比特的有效温度从49mK降至35mK，且对量子比特T1影响可忽略不计，实现了0.0028的工艺误差。该重置协议对脉冲参数偏差具有鲁棒性，为大规模超导量子处理器提供了一种实用且易于校准的重置方案。
authors: Jiajia Tian, Meiling Li, Weijie Sun, Yanjun Ma, Zhenyu Mi, Fei Yan, Huikai Xu, Pei Liu, Guangming Xue, Haifeng Yu

articles.title: Bridging Pulse and Circuit Levels: A Geometric Framework for Deterministic Error Suppression
articles.title_zh: 连接脉冲与电路层面：一种确定性误差抑制的几何框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06291v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum errors in noisy environments remain a major obstacle to advancing quantum information technology. Standard quantum error correction requires massive ancillary qubit overhead, motivating the need for hardware-efficient mitigation strategies. In this work, we propose a framework for dynamical quantum error correction at the circuit level, requiring no logical encoding or ancillary qubits. By extending a geometric framework (originally developed for creating dynamical error-correcting gates at the control pulse level) to the discrete dynamics of digital circuits, we map the accumulation of coherent errors to trajectories in a high-dimensional error space. We demonstrate that inserting deterministically optimized twirling gate sequences actively shapes these trajectories, utilizing destructive interference to keep the accumulated error bounded with error scaling O(1). This deterministic path-shaping suppresses circuit errors fundamentally differently than the stochastic random-walk behavior of standard randomized compiling with error scaling O(sqrtN). Furthermore, we show that this circuit-level dynamical correction synergizes with pulse-level robust control, providing an analytical bridge between continuous noise dynamics and discrete quantum compilation. This research illuminates pathways to achieving highly noise-resistant quantum circuits prior to the era of fault tolerance.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种在电路层面实现动态量子纠错的几何框架，无需逻辑编码或辅助量子比特。该框架将相干误差的累积映射到高维误差空间中的轨迹，并通过插入确定性优化的旋转门序列来主动塑造这些轨迹。通过利用相消干涉，该方法将累积误差限制在O(1)的标度，与随机编译的随机游走行为（O(sqrtN)）不同。
authors: Junkai Zeng, Hao Liang, Yong-Ju Hai, Xiu-Hao Deng

articles.title: Spatial Path Superposition: A No-Cloning Perspective on MIMO-Inspired Spatial Diversity
articles.title_zh: 空间路径叠加：MIMO启发式空间分集的一种无克隆视角
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06306v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatial diversity is a key mechanism in classical Multi-Input Multi-Output (MIMO) communications, where multiple propagation alternatives provide redundant observations that improve reliability in noisy environments. A direct translation of this principle to quantum communications is forbidden by the no-cloning theorem, since an unknown quantum state cannot be copied and transmitted through independent links. In this Perspective article, we argue that spatial path superposition provides a no-cloning-compatible analogue of the spatial-diversity principle of MIMO. Rather than duplicating the transmitted quantum state, a quantum carrier is coherently delocalized over multiple communication links, so that alternative spatial evolutions are experienced in quantum superposition. In this framework, classical redundancy is replaced by spatial coherence, and the communication link itself becomes part of the quantum dynamics. Indeed, spatial coherence can enhance the fidelity of the received quantum state, providing the quantum counterpart of the classical diversity gain, and can be converted into bipartite and multipartite entanglement during propagation. This implies that, under suitable coherent path control, noisy channel evolutions can contribute constructively to entanglement generation. This Perspective identifies spatial path superposition as a quantum-native primitive for the Quantum Internet, linking no-cloning-compatible spatial diversity, fidelity enhancement, entanglement generation, and coherent path control.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从无克隆定理的角度探讨了量子通信中空间分集的问题，并提出空间路径叠加作为经典MIMO空间分集的量子兼容模拟。与经典MIMO通过复制状态实现冗余不同，量子载体在多个通信链路上相干离域，使得替代空间演化以量子叠加态形式存在。在这种框架下，空间相干性取代了经典冗余，并能提高接收量子态的保真度。
authors: Angela Sara Cacciapuoti, Claudio Pellitteri, Marcello Caleffi

articles.title: Semi-Device-Independent Certification of multi-qubit Entangled Basis Measurement
articles.title_zh: 多量子比特纠缠基测量的半设备无关认证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06337v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The entangled basis measurement plays a pivotal role in fundamental information-processing tasks, such as dense coding, quantum teleportation, and entanglement swapping. Consequently, certifying such measurements in a device-independent manner remains an important task. In this work, we present a semi-device-independent (SDI) protocol in a prepare-and-measure (PM) scenario for certifying a class of m-qubit entangled basis measurements. Specifically, we consider a tripartite PM scenario featuring two senders and one receiver, where each sender sends an arbitrary number of 2^m inputs and the receiver performs a measurement with 2^m outcomes. We adopt a classical causal model framework to demonstrate the non-classicality of quantum measurements. We introduce nonlinear witnesses in classical causal models and demonstrate that the optimal quantum value exceeds the classical bounds. Further, we demonstrate that the optimal quantum value of the witness SDI certify the entangled basis measurement and the prepared states of the two senders.
articles.abstract_zh: 纠缠基测量在量子信息处理中至关重要，对其进行设备无关认证是一个重要任务。本文提出了一种在制备-测量（PM）场景下的半设备无关（SDI）协议，用于认证一类m量子比特纠缠基测量。通过引入经典因果模型中的非线性判据，研究表明最优量子值超越了经典界限。该判据的最优量子值能够SDI认证纠缠基测量以及两个发送者制备的量子态。
authors: Rajat Pandey, Alok Kumar Pan

articles.title: Beyond the Gap: What Imaginary-Time Evolution Reveals About the Edge of the Continuum
articles.title_zh: 超越能隙：虚时间演化揭示连续谱边缘的奥秘
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06454v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The spectral gap, the energy separating the ground state from the first excitation, governs many quantum phenomena, yet it is far harder to compute than the ground state. We propose a mathematically rigorous method for extracting the gap from imaginary-time evolution in infinite-dimensional Hamiltonians, where the first excitation typically marks the edge of a continuous spectrum. We show that a gap is not automatically detected: detection depends on how the initial state and observable couple the ground state to excitations at the bottom of the continuum. When this coupling follows a power law, the gap is recovered together with a logarithmic correction whose coefficient yields the exponent of the spectral density near the edge of the continuum, which reflects the physics of the excitations. We confirm both predictions numerically for an exactly solvable model. Our results offer a new numerical approach to many-body quantum physics, in which both the gap and the threshold exponent are obtained merely at the cost of a ground-state calculation.
articles.abstract_zh: 谱能隙在量子现象中扮演关键角色，但其计算难度远超基态。本文提出了一种从无限维哈密顿量的虚时间演化中提取能隙的严格数学方法。研究表明，能隙的检测取决于初始态和可观测量如何将基态与连续谱底部的激发耦合。该方法为多体量子物理提供了一种新的数值途径，仅通过基态计算即可获得能隙和阈值指数。
authors: Ruben Karapetyan, Denys Bondar, Jakub Mareček, Aleš Wodecki

articles.title: Universally Certifying Partially Self-Correcting Quantum Memories in 3D Translation-Invariant Stabilizer Codes
articles.title_zh: 3D平移不变稳定器码中部分自纠正量子存储器的普适认证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06469v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Achieving passive protection of quantum information at finite temperature is a central problem at the intersection of quantum information and quantum many-body physics. Yet a general, computable criterion for determining self-correcting behavior directly from the form of local interactions remains elusive. Here we develop a unified algebraic-geometric framework for certifying partial self-correction in three-dimensional translation-invariant local stabilizer codes, encompassing the cubic code as a special case. From the algebraic curves defined by the codes' defining polynomials, we construct valuation matrices on the boundaries of their normalized projective closures and derive a computable rank criterion. Together with a polynomial-time decoder, this criterion guarantees super-Arrhenius memory lifetimes for code families satisfying it under the specified local Davies dynamics. We apply the framework to certify several classes of partially self-correcting quantum memories, including nearest-neighbor models with stabilizer weight as low as six and long memory lifetimes at modest system sizes. These results establish an algebraic-geometric connection between local stabilizer structure and the recoverability of quantum information at finite temperature, providing a systematic approach to certifying and designing passive quantum memories.
articles.abstract_zh: 在有限温度下实现量子信息的被动保护是量子信息和多体物理交叉领域的核心问题。本文提出了一种统一的代数几何框架，用于认证三维平移不变局部稳定器码中的部分自纠正行为。通过代码定义多项式所定义的代数曲线，构建了其归一化射影闭包边界上的赋值矩阵，并导出了一个可计算的秩判据。该判据与多项式时间解码器相结合，保证了满足条件的码族在局部Davies动力学下的超阿伦尼乌斯记忆寿命。
authors: Chong-Yuan Xu, Yong Xu

articles.title: Quantum Advantage needs Multiple Perspectives
articles.title_zh: 量子优势需要多重视角
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06497v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The origin of the quantum speedup is a topic of ongoing research. We propose a logical criterion for the possibility of a speedup within the continuous-variable and odd-prime qudit settings. There, Wigner function nonnegativity signals the possibility of efficient classical simulation in the state-injection scenario. We consider representations of quadrature/Weyl measurements in a single von Neumann algebra that reproduce the Born statistics in a particular state. If in that state, the set-theoretic universe of the algebra is ZFC-satisfiable, i.e. every ZFC-theorem holds with unit probability, all measurement contexts can be represented in a single commutative algebra of `beables'. Furthermore, the statistics admit a noncontextual hidden variable model, ensuring Wigner nonnegativity for two or more modes or qudits. For a single mode, a stronger notion of linear representation ensures commutativity, and with it, ZFC-satisfiability independently of the state, as well as Wigner nonnegativity. In consequence, in any setting that cannot be efficiently simulated, it must be impossible to merge the models associated with every context into a single ZFC-satisfiable one: quantum advantage needs multiple perspectives.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子加速的起源是一个持续研究的课题。本文提出了一个在连续变量和奇素数qudit设置中实现加速可能性的逻辑判据。研究表明，Wigner函数的非负性预示着在态注入场景中存在高效经典模拟的可能性。作者进一步指出，在无法高效模拟的任何设置中，将与每个上下文相关的模型合并到单个可交换的“可存在量”代数中是不可能的。
authors: Jochen Szangolies

articles.title: Parrondo's paradox for three discrete-time quantum walks with distinct shift operators
articles.title_zh: 具有不同移位算子的三个离散时间量子行走的帕隆多悖论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06568v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Parrondo's paradox describes a surprising phenomenon in which certain combinations of biased quantum walks result in an unexpected reversal of their bias direction. To date, research on this effect has predominantly focused on one-dimensional discrete-time quantum walks that employ fixed sequences of two or three quantum coins, paired with a single shift operator. In this work, we first introduce a wide class of unitary shift operators which allow for three movement options (left, right or stay in place) of a walker in one time step, and we then demonstrate that Parrondo's paradox can also arise with a single coin and three distinct shift operators. Furthermore, we investigate how this paradox influences the time evolution of quantum entanglement between the walker and the coin in such quantum walks.
articles.abstract_zh: 帕隆多悖论描述了一种令人惊讶的现象，即某些有偏量子行走的组合会导致其偏置方向意外逆转。本文首先引入了一类广泛的幺正移位算子，允许行进者在一步时间内有三种移动选项。研究表明，帕隆多悖论也可以通过单个量子硬币和三个不同的移位算子产生。此外，该工作还探讨了这种悖论如何影响行进者和硬币之间量子纠缠的时间演化。
authors: Zbigniew Walczak, Jarosław H. Bauer

articles.title: Discovering correlated error mechanisms: data-driven augmentation of detector error models improving decoding
articles.title_zh: 发现关联误差机制：基于数据驱动的探测器误差模型增强以改进解码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06605v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate decoder priors are essential for high-performance quantum error correction. Theoretical noise models inevitably omit physically relevant error mechanisms, most notably correlated errors, which appear consistently in experimental error budgets yet are absent from standard models. We introduce a data-driven method for augmenting detector error models (DEMs) by discovering entirely new error mechanisms directly from experimental detector-firing statistics, going beyond most existing approaches that merely refine the probabilities of already-known mechanisms. Our method generates candidates by combining pairs of existing mechanisms as building blocks, then filters and validates them using pairwise and higher-order detector correlations. Crucially, this construction provides each newly discovered mechanism with a well-defined logical effect derived from the constituent error mechanisms, enabling its direct use in decoding. Furthermore, each mechanism is accompanied by a natural decomposition into lower-order components, preserving compatibility with the original decoder. This is particularly valuable in settings that rely on correlated graph-based decoders such as correlated matching. We evaluate the method on surface-code simulations with correlated noise and correlated-matching decoding, demonstrating that, in a realistic near-term noise scenario, DEM augmentation increases the Lambda parameter by 20% across code distances 7-15 and reduces the logical error rate by 75% at code distance 15 relative to the unaugmented DEM. On experimental data from Google's superconducting device, the augmented DEM increases the Lambda parameter by 9% across code distances 5-7 and yields a reduction of 14% in logical error rate over the baseline for distance 7. To our knowledge, this is the first data-driven DEM augmentation method that produces decomposed hyperedges with assigned logical effects.
articles.abstract_zh: 准确的解码器先验对于高性能量子纠错至关重要，但现有理论噪声模型常忽略关联误差。本文提出了一种数据驱动方法，通过从实验探测器触发统计数据中直接发现全新的误差机制来增强探测器误差模型（DEMs）。新发现的机制具有明确的逻辑效应，可直接用于解码，并保持与原始解码器的兼容性。该方法通过组合现有机制生成候选，并利用成对和高阶探测器关联进行过滤和验证。
authors: Zohar Schwartzman-Nowik, Matthew P. Stafford, Boris M. Varbanov, Joan Camps

articles.title: Precision Limits and Non-Gaussian Advantage in Optical Phase Estimation under Preparation Constraints
articles.title_zh: 制备约束下光学相位估计的精度极限与非高斯优势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06645v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In optical quantum metrology, the scaling of the quantum Fisher information (QFI) with the mean photon number is a standard benchmark for relating precision to probe resources. For phase estimation, Heisenberg scaling corresponds to a quadratic growth of the QFI with the mean photon number, which Gaussian probes can approach. Interestingly, certain non-Gaussian probes can exhibit arbitrarily large QFI even at fixed mean photon number. Here, we clarify the resource requirements underlying this behavior by introducing a constraint that separates physically admissible states from inadmissible ones: an envelope on the photon-number distribution that arises naturally from the physical limitations of state-generation methods. Building on this constraint and considering pure single-mode probes, we define a resource quantity, N_RMS, fixed by the preparation constraints, and derive a finite bound on the QFI whose Heisenberg scaling is attainable. We identify a genuine metrological advantage of non-Gaussian states over Gaussian probes subject to the same constraints. Finally, we illustrate these results with an optical preparation model based on a universal gate set.
articles.abstract_zh: 在光学量子计量学中，量子费舍尔信息（QFI）与平均光子数的关系是衡量精度的标准。本文通过引入制备约束，明确了非高斯探针在固定平均光子数下展现任意大QFI的资源需求。研究定义了一个由制备约束固定的资源量N_RMS，并导出了一个可实现海森堡标度的QFI有限界。结果揭示了在相同约束下，非高斯态相对于高斯探针的真正计量学优势。
authors: Víctor Izquierdo, Javier Lalueza-Puértolas

articles.title: Experimental activation of hidden metrological steerability in quantum channels via stochastic filtering
articles.title_zh: 通过随机滤波实验激活量子信道中隐藏的计量可操纵性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06668v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum steering-assisted metrology allows a trusted party (Bob) to improve local phase estimation by exploiting classical information communicated by an untrusted party (Alice). In realistic scenarios, however, the channel is subject to noise that degrades steerability and suppresses the associated metrological advantage. Here, we demonstrate that stochastic pre- and post-filtering operations can revive the violation of the metrological steering inequality (MSI) in phase-covariant amplitude-damping channels where it is initially absent, thereby activating a hidden metrological steerability and restoring their usefulness for quantum metrology. Specifically, the critical damping parameter beyond which the MSI violation is suppressed is raised from γ_c approx 0.5 to γ_c approx 0.75 for the largest filter strength considered. We verify this in a photonic experiment, where polarization qubits carrying the encoded phase are transmitted through an amplitude-damping channel implemented with a two-path Sagnac interferometer, and the stochastic operations are realized with glass plates at the Brewster angle. By tuning the filter strength and scanning the damping parameter over its full range, we observe the revival of the MSI violation, obtained at the cost of a reduced success probability inherent to the stochastic nature of the filtering operations. Our results establish that metrological utility and steerability can be activated through stochastic operations even when these properties are absent in the original noisy channel, extending filtering-based activation from witnesses of nonclassicality to a certified and operationally quantified metrological advantage.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子操纵辅助计量学允许可信方利用非可信方传递的经典信息来改进局部相位估计。在噪声信道中，操纵性及其计量优势会退化。本文实验证明，随机预滤波和后滤波操作可以恢复相位协变振幅阻尼信道中最初缺失的计量操纵不等式（MSI）违背，从而激活隐藏的计量可操纵性。通过光子实验验证，临界阻尼参数从约0.5提高到约0.75，恢复了量子计量学的有用性。
authors: H. S. Karthik, J. Bermúdez, D. Montoya, J. Parra-Pastén, F. M. Quinteros, Akshata Shenoy H., M. Pawłowski, S. P. Walborn, G. Lima, E. S. Gómez

articles.title: Non-compact Kogut-Susskind gauge theories: 1D lattice models with exact m̊ SL(2,R) gauge invariance
articles.title_zh: 非紧致Kogut-Susskind规范理论：具有精确m̊ SL(2,R)规范不变性的1D格点模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06771v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Kogut-Susskind (KS) formulation of gauge theories constructs quantum many-body Hamiltonians with gauge invariance under a compact Lie group exactly implemented on a spatial lattice. Here, we revisit this construction for a non-compact gauge group. Although motivated in part by theories like general relativity whose first-order formulation involves the non-compact Lorentz group as a local symmetry, we focus on simpler cases in one spatial dimension akin to the Schwinger model. In a bottom-up approach, we show how exact gauge invariance under the simplest non-compact Lie group m̊ SL(2,R) can be retained exactly on a 1D lattice, and highlight the differences that arise with respect to compact gauge groups, including a continuous spectrum of the Casimir operators of the gauge fields and the emergence of infinite-dimensional representations of the matter fields. For the pure gauge theory, we discuss how a consistent restriction to the positive semigroup m̊ SL⁺(2,R) reproduces well-known results from the quantization of Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) gravity. Motivated by the constraint structure of general dilaton gravity, we introduce static charges coupled to the non-compact gauge field, which can be realised by single-fermion degrees of freedom living in an additional, synthetic dimension. With static charges our lattice model remains exactly integrable, but when extending to dynamical fermionic matter, we arrive at an interacting 1D m̊ SL(2,R) KS gauge theory. We give an interpretation of this model as a chain of charges sequentially connected by strings whose tension pulls matter left or right depending on the sign of the relative continuous m̊ SL(2,R) fluxes. This picture becomes exact when the involved m̊ SL(2,R) charges are strongly self-interacting, where we solve the reduced two-body problem analytically.
articles.abstract_zh: Kogut-Susskind (KS) 规范理论在空间格点上精确实现了紧致李群下的规范不变性。本文将此构造推广到非紧致规范群，并以一维模型为例，展示了如何在1D格点上精确保持最简单的非紧致李群m̊ SL(2,R)下的规范不变性。研究强调了与紧致规范群的区别，包括规范场Casimir算符的连续谱和物质场的无限维表示。对于纯规范理论，限制到正半群m̊ SL⁺(2,R)可重现Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) 引力量子化的已知结果。
authors: Carlos Fulgado-Claudio, Torsten V. Zache

articles.title: Using topology to reveal all mutually unbiased bases in dimension six
articles.title_zh: 利用拓扑学揭示六维空间中所有互不偏倚基
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06917v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mutually unbiased bases (MUBs) describe complementary quantum measurements: certainty in one basis gives no information about the others. In dimension six, triples of MUBs are known, but whether a fourth basis could exist remained unresolved for over three decades. OpenAI recently reported a proof that none exists. Here we use the topology of the space of complex Hadamard matrices, which describe transitions between MUBs, to characterize all sets in dimension six. We prove that every mutually unbiased triple belongs to a two-parameter family or is a single isolated triple built from the Fourier matrix. Since none of them extend to a fourth basis, this also proves that no four MUBs exist. Our proof rests on a new topological result that all order-six complex Hadamard matrices except Tao's form a connected space. Connectedness reduces the classification of triples to finitely many overlapping four-dimensional phase balls. We certify with interval arithmetic that these balls cover the space and for every pair of MUBs represented in a ball, we then determine all third bases that extend it. Dimension six is now the first non-prime-power dimension in which all sets of MUBs are classified.
articles.abstract_zh: 互不偏倚基（MUBs）描述了互补的量子测量。在六维空间中，MUBs三元组已知存在，但第四个基是否存在的问题悬而未决三十多年。本文利用复哈达玛矩阵空间的拓扑结构，表征了六维空间中的所有MUBs集合。研究证明每个互不偏倚三元组都属于一个双参数族或是一个由傅里叶矩阵构建的孤立三元组，且它们都无法扩展到第四个基，从而证明了不存在四个MUBs。
authors: Mateo Cárdenes Wuttig, Joseph Tindall

articles.title: Cryptanalysis of Isogeny-Based Quantum Money with Rational Points
articles.title_zh: 基于有理点的同源量子货币密码分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.00351v2 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum money is a representative application in cryptography that utilizes quantum technology to achieve security that is unattainable with classical systems. Since the theoretical proposal by Wiesner in 1983, the most recent instantiation is the quantum money using class group actions on elliptic curves, proposed by Montgomery and Sharif in Asiacrypt'24. In this work, we propose a concrete cryptanalysis by leveraging the efficiency of evaluating division polynomials with the coordinates of rational points, offering a speedup of O(łog⁴p) compared to the brute-force attack. While the resulting attack still runs in exponential time, our method provides the first nontrivial algorithmic insight into their structural hardness. Furthermore, due to the algebraic properties of rational points and quadratic twists, our technique naturally yields a more efficient verification procedure for the underlying quantum money. We believe this new line of analysis opens promising directions for future research in elliptic-curve-based quantum cryptography.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子货币是利用量子技术实现经典系统无法达到的安全性的密码学应用。本文针对Montgomery和Sharif在Asiacrypt'24提出的基于椭圆曲线类群作用的量子货币，提出了一种具体的密码分析方法。该方法利用有理点坐标评估除法多项式的效率，相较于暴力攻击提供了O(log⁴p)的加速。尽管攻击仍需指数时间，但它首次提供了对其结构硬度的非平凡算法洞察，并为底层量子货币提供了更高效的验证程序。
authors: Hyeonhak Kim, Donghoe Heo, Seokhie Hong, Sangjin Lee, Suhri Kim

articles.title: Quantum computing for high energy nuclear physics
articles.title_zh: 量子计算在高能核物理中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05491v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum information science (QIS) offers a new set of conceptual and computational tools ideally suited to exploring the many-body, out-of-equilibrium, and real-time properties of strongly interacting quantum systems. These themes find a natural counterpart in high energy nuclear physics, whose central goal is to describe the properties of Quantum Chromodynamics (QCD), the theory of the strong interaction, under extreme conditions. Relevant examples range from the formation and internal structure of hadrons, to the collective and thermalization dynamics of strongly interacting QCD matter, and the properties of complex many-body scattering processes. Although tremendous progress has been made over the past decades in our understanding of QCD in the nuclear physics context, through perturbative methods, lattice QCD, and effective theory descriptions, phenomena that are intrinsically connected to real-time dynamics, highly entangled many-body evolution, or finite density regimes remain only partially accessible with existing approaches. In this article, we argue that QIS can help realize a new paradigm for addressing these open questions. With the aim of making the discussion accessible to both high energy nuclear physics and QIS audiences, we provide an overview of selected open problems in high energy nuclear physics, with emphasis on aspects motivated by collider phenomenology, and discuss how they can be approached using QIS tools. This connection is illustrated through representative examples drawn from the recent literature, making the case that QIS can become a driving force for discovery in nuclear physics in the coming years.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子信息科学（QIS）为探索强相互作用量子系统的多体、非平衡和实时特性提供了新工具。这些特性与高能核物理中描述量子色动力学（QCD）在极端条件下的性质密切相关。尽管在理解QCD方面取得了巨大进展，但与实时动力学、高度纠缠多体演化或有限密度区域相关的现象仍难以完全解决。本文认为QIS有望为解决这些开放性问题提供新的范式。
authors: João Barata

articles.title: Exact Mirror-Parity Selection Rule for Electron-Phonon Coupling in Two-Dimensional Crystals
articles.title_zh: 二维晶体中电子-声子耦合的精确镜像宇称选择定则
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05710v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The electron--phonon (e-ph) interaction underlies conventional superconductivity and plays a central role in transport and other many-body phenomena in solids. Here, we derive a symmetry selection rule for e-ph scattering in two-dimensional crystals possessing a horizontal mirror plane, σₕ. For electronic states of mirror parity sₙ₍ₖ₎ and sₘ₍ₖ₊q), and a phonon mode of parity ḩi_ν(q), we show that the e-ph matrix element gₘₙ,ν(k,q) vanishes identically unless sₙ₍ₖ₎,ḩi_ν(q), sₘ₍ₖ₊q)=+1. The rule follows from the covariance of the phonon-induced deformation potential under σₕ, constitutes the Cₛ case of the general group-theoretical selection rule for matrix elements, and partitions the e-ph interaction throughout the Brillouin zone into symmetry-allowed and symmetry-forbidden scattering channels. Consequently, mirror-even phonons couple electronic states of the same mirror parity, either even--even or odd--odd, whereas mirror-odd phonons couple only states of opposite mirror parity, for both intra- and interband processes. We illustrate the selection rule through first-principles calculations for the two-dimensional superconductor Sc₂BCH₄, where mirror parity is well defined throughout the entire Brillouin zone and symmetry-forbidden matrix elements vanish up to numerical precision. We then extend the analysis to bulk MgB₂, where the rule applies exactly only on mirror-invariant planes of the three-dimensional Brillouin zone. Moving away from these planes removes the exact mirror constraint and activates scattering channels that are symmetry forbidden when the mirror eigenvalues are well defined. Our results establish horizontal mirror symmetry as an exact and practical filter of e-ph scattering processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 电子-声子（e-ph）相互作用是常规超导的基础，并在固体输运中发挥关键作用。本文推导了具有水平镜像平面σₕ的二维晶体中e-ph散射的对称性选择定则。该定则表明，除非电子态和声子模式的镜像宇称乘积为+1，否则e-ph矩阵元将完全消失。该规则将布里渊区内的e-ph相互作用划分为对称性允许和禁止的散射通道，并用二维超导体Sc₂的从头计算进行了说明。
authors: Nicolás F. Barrera, Javiera Cabezas-Escares, Francisco Munoz, Carlos Cardenas, Julia Contreras-García

articles.title: Coherence Spreading Law in Quenched Homogeneous Bose Gases
articles.title_zh: 淬火均匀玻色气体中的相干性扩散定律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05775v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate nonequilibrium coherence spreading in quenched homogeneous bosonic gases both analytically and numerically. Our ensemble-averaged Gross-Pitaevskii trajectory approach and kinetic analysis confirm the linear-in-time growth of the squared coherence length, and explicitly give the spreading-law dependence on the ratio of initial energy to healing energy. When the ratio is relatively small, the squared coherence length grows at a universal rate determined by the ratio of Planck's constant to the particle mass, insensitive to interaction strength and initial momentum distributions. However, our further calculations uncover fundamental limitations to such universality and establish its phase boundaries governed by low system energies, weak interparticle interactions and many-body integrability. Our theory fully reproduces the key experimental signatures and resolves the puzzle of the dynamical origin of the recently observed universal coherence-spreading speed limit [Nature 647, 608-612 (2025)]. Going beyond existing experimental observations, we provide some testable predictions for ultracold-atom experiments and clarify the conditions for the emergence of universal coherent dynamics in nonequilibrium bosonic many-body systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过解析和数值方法研究了淬火均匀玻色气体中的非平衡相干性扩散。研究证实了平方相干长度随时间线性增长，并明确给出了扩散定律对初始能量与愈合能量比值的依赖关系。当该比值较小时，平方相干长度以普朗克常数与粒子质量比值决定的普适速率增长，且与相互作用强度和初始动量分布无关。该理论再现了关键实验特征，并对超冷原子实验提供了可检验的预测。
authors: Yi Cao, Li-Chen Zhao, Jie Liu

articles.title: Analytic two-body density-matrix spectrum of the Fermionic Tonks-Girardeau gas
articles.title_zh: 费米子Tonks-Girardeau气体的解析两体密度矩阵谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05820v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The two-body density matrix (TBDM) of a quantum many-body system provides information about particle correlations, e.g., pairing. In this work, we derive the complete spectrum of the TBDM of the fermionic Tonks-Girardeau gas using its exact ground-state wavefunction in second quantization. We obtain analytical expressions for all eigenvalues and eigenvectors for an arbitrary number of particles and identify two different types of eigenstates: collective states, formed by superpositions of paired momentum modes, and single-determinant states. We provide a physical interpretation of this structure, explaining the origin of the different eigenstates and their degeneracies. We further derive an asymptotic expansion for the largest eigenvalue, improving on previous estimates and analytically confirming its linear scaling with the particle number, thereby indicating off-diagonal long-range order. For the high-index collective states, we obtain simpler expressions for the eigenvalues and eigenvectors, showing that the eigenvalues decay as n⁻⁴ and that the eigenvectors become independent of the number of particles. Finally, we discuss the connection between the collective states and an effective description in terms of composite bosons, whose spectral properties suggest a behavior consistent with Tan's contact for interacting bosonic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 两体密度矩阵（TBDM）提供了量子多体系统中粒子关联的信息。本文利用费米子Tonks-Girardeau气体在二次量子化下的精确基态波函数，推导了其TBDM的完整谱。研究获得了任意粒子数下所有本征值和本征矢量的解析表达式，并识别出集体态和单行列式态两种不同类型的本征态。此外，还推导了最大本征值的渐近展开式，证实其与粒子数呈线性标度，表明存在非对角长程有序。
authors: Abel Rojo-Francàs, Joan Martorell, Francesc Sabater, Bruno Juliá-Díaz

articles.title: Quantum Computing for Entanglement Asymmetry and the Quantum Mpemba Effect in Field Theory
articles.title_zh: 用于场论中纠缠不对称性和量子Mpemba效应的量子计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05987v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We construct a quantum measurement protocol for estimating the Rényi entanglement asymmetry, which quantifies symmetry breaking at the level of a subsystem and provides a probe of the quantum Mpemba effect. The protocol combines the SWAP test with a charge-resolving procedure based on randomized symmetry rotations. For a fixed additive accuracy ϵ, the required number of measurements scales as O(ϵ⁻²) without explicit dependence on the total system size, making the protocol particularly attractive for quantum many-body systems and lattice quantum field theories. As a representative application, we study the quantum Mpemba effect in the lattice Schwinger model with a θ term using classical state-vector simulations.
