We further estimate the resources required to implement the protocol on noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) devices, fault-tolerant quantum computers (FTQCs), and a representative early-FTQC architecture. Our results provide a measurement-efficient framework for investigating anomalous symmetry-restoration dynamics in quantum many-body systems and quantum field theories.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一种量子测量协议，用于估计Rényi纠缠不对称性，该量化了子系统层面的对称性破缺并可探测量子Mpemba效应。该协议结合了SWAP测试和基于随机对称旋转的电荷分辨程序，其测量次数与系统总大小无关，适用于量子多体系统和格点量子场论。研究人员还通过经典模拟和资源估算，探讨了该协议在NISQ和容错量子计算机上的实现，为研究量子多体系统和量子场论中的异常对称性恢复动力学提供了高效框架。
authors: Keisuke Fujii, Harunobu Fujimura, Masazumi Honda, Duc Truyen Le

articles.title: Statistical mechanics and hierarchy of learnability in quantum codes: From generalized symmetries to non-Abelian topological orders
articles.title_zh: 量子编码中可学习性的统计力学与层级：从广义对称性到非阿贝尔拓扑序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06154v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Local weak measurements provide noisy information about observables encoded in a quantum code. We formulate the corresponding Bayesian inference problem for a broad class of topological stabilizer codes by mapping it to classical spin models with generalized symmetries. When the wavefunction deformation and Gaussian measurement strengths coincide, the replicated model acquires an enlarged symmetry. We use this symmetry to derive exact identities among correlators averaged over measurement records that quantify the learnability of nonlocal observables associated with fractionalized excitations. Together with correlation inequalities in the associated clean ferromagnetic models, these identities establish hierarchies of learnability: if two observables remain learnable at long distances, their product must also remain learnable. We demonstrate these relations in the rank-2 toric code and the X-cube model, whose classical descriptions exhibit modulated and subsystem symmetries, respectively. We further extend the analysis to finite group quantum double models, including non-Abelian ones. We derive exact relations between learnability and correlations in the corresponding classical models, and show that the representation structure and fusion rules of anyons impose further constraints under suitable positivity conditions. These results constrain which types of nonlocal information can be learned simultaneously, providing a guide to learning phase diagrams in quantum codes under local weak measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 局部弱测量为量子编码中的可观测量提供了带噪声的信息。本文将一类拓扑稳定子码的贝叶斯推断问题映射到具有广义对称性的经典自旋模型，并利用由此产生的放大对称性推导出量化非局域可观测量可学习性的精确恒等式。这些恒等式与相关干净铁磁模型中的关联不等式共同建立了可学习性的层级关系。研究进一步将分析扩展到有限群量子双模型，包括非阿贝尔模型，揭示了可学习性之间的精确关系。
authors: Hiromi Ebisu, Masazumi Honda

articles.title: Quasi-Normal Modes and thermalization in integrable Quantum Field Theories from the Thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz
articles.title_zh: 可积量子场论中准正规模与热化：基于热力学Bethe ansatz方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06473v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We propose a Thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz (TBA) approach for describing thermalization in integrable quantum field theories. The exponential damping and oscillations when approaching thermal equilibrium can be understood as the analogs of quasi-normal mode (QNM) frequencies of black hole perturbations within the framework of holography. Holographic intuitions and some general properties of thermal Green's functions motivate the existence of such a TBA formulation, as well as lead to the imposition of a nonstandard analytical structure on the QNM TBA, while comparison with integrable form-factor expansions fixes the remaining ingredients. We conjecture the QNM TBA to be equivalent to performing an all-order resummation of secular terms in a thermal form factor expansion of retarded 2-point correlation functions. We compare the predictions with tensor network simulations of the E8 deformation of Ising CFT at nonzero temperature. We conjecture that the QNM TBA framework should also be applicable for describing out-of-equilibrium approach to Generalized Hydrodynamics (GHD).
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于热力学Bethe ansatz（TBA）的方法来描述可积量子场论中的热化过程。研究将系统趋近热平衡时的指数衰减和振荡理解为黑洞扰动准正规模频率的类比。通过全阶重求和滞后二点关联函数的长期项，该方法与可积形式因子展开式相吻合，并与E8形变Ising CFT的张量网络模拟结果进行了比较。该框架有望应用于描述非平衡态趋近广义流体动力学（GHD）的过程。
authors: Zoltan Bajnok, Romuald A. Janik

articles.title: Stability of energy gap of macroscopic quantum matter
articles.title_zh: 宏观量子物质能隙的稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06528v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In quantum many-body physics and quantum field theory, it is often assumed that gapped systems remain gapped under sufficiently weak local perturbations. However, to what extent this assumption holds is elusive, except for some special systems. In this work, we examine the stability of energy gap of macroscopic quantum matter that is only subject to two physically natural conditions, locality and translation invariance. We first show that in any spatial dimension, there are gapped local Hamiltonians with a unique ground state and an unstable gap, i.e., they become gapless under certain arbitrarily weak local perturbation in the thermodynamic limit. We then prove that for both spin and fermionic systems in one dimension, such Hamiltonians with an unstable gap must not only break translation invariance but also be fine-tuned. We further show that in any dimension greater than one, there are fine-tuned local translation invariant Hamiltonians with a unique ground state and an unstable gap. These results greatly sharpen our understanding of the fundamental problem of the stability of quantum phases of matter. We also discuss implications of our results on, for example, anyon superconductivity and higher-form symmetries.
articles.abstract_zh: 在量子多体物理和量子场论中，通常假设有能隙系统在足够弱的局部微扰下仍保持有能隙。本研究在局部性和平移不变性这两个物理条件下，考察了宏观量子物质能隙的稳定性。结果表明，在任何空间维度，都存在具有唯一基态和不稳定能隙的局部哈密顿量，它们在热力学极限下会在任意弱的局部微扰下变为无能隙。研究还证明了在一维系统中，此类哈密顿量必须打破平移不变性且经过微调，而在高于一维的任何维度，存在微调的局部平移不变哈密顿量也具有不稳定能隙。这些发现深化了对量子物质相稳定性这一基本问题的理解。
authors: Kangle Li, Liujun Zou

articles.title: Quantum power iterations via tensor networks
articles.title_zh: 基于张量网络的量子幂迭代
articles.abstract: arXiv:2404.15048v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In optimization, one of the well-known classical algorithms is power iterations, which recovers the dominant eigenvector of a diagonalizable matrix. Since numerous optimization problems can be formulated as an eigenvalue/eigenvector search, this algorithm features wide applicability. Operationally, power iterations perform repeated matrix-to-vector multiplications (textttMatVec) followed by a renormalization step to converge to the dominant eigenvalue/eigenvector. However, classical tensor network realizations can exhibit worst-case exponential growth of tensor ranks with the number of iterations. We propose a quantum realization offering a possible route around this bottleneck. Our method involves casting low-rank representations---MPO for matrices and MPS for vectors---into quantum circuits. Specifically, we recover a unitary approximation by variationally minimizing the Frobenius distance between a target MPO and an MPO ansatz wherein the tensor cores are constrained to unitaries. Such unitary MPOs can be implemented as quantum circuits with ancillary qubits. With appropriate initialization and post-selection on the ancillary space, we realize a single classical iteration. With our proposed methodology, power iterations can be realized entirely on a quantum computer via repeated, static circuit blocks. By exploiting Riemannian optimization and cross-approximation techniques, our methodology becomes instance-agnostic, allowing one to address black-box optimization of functions admitting low-rank tensor network representations within quantum computing. We emphasize that this work establishes the construction and analyzes its reliable operating conditions; it does not demonstrate an end-to-end computational advantage over classical tensor network optimization, which we discuss explicitly.
articles.abstract_zh: 幂迭代是优化领域中一种经典的算法，用于恢复可对角化矩阵的主导特征向量。然而，经典的张量网络实现可能面临张量秩随迭代次数指数增长的问题。本文提出了一种量子实现方案来解决这一瓶颈，通过将低秩表示（MPO用于矩阵，MPS用于向量）转换为量子电路。该方法通过变分最小化Frobenius距离来恢复酉近似，并可利用辅助量子比特实现酉MPO。
authors: V. Akshay, A. Berezutskii, Ar. Melnikov, A. Termanova, M. R. Perelshtein

articles.title: Entangled quantum trajectories in relativistic systems
articles.title_zh: 相对论系统中的纠缠量子轨迹
articles.abstract: arXiv:2410.05995v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum entanglement is a key resource for quantum technologies, including emerging ground-to-satellite quantum communication. In such a scenario, an important challenge to be overcome is to consider entanglement between two or more quantum particles in different inertial frames, potentially experiencing relativistic effects affecting quantum correlations. In this paper, we present a consistent framework that overcomes this challenge. To this end, we establish the notion of factorizable and entangled multi-time trajectories and derive a class of Euler--Lagrange equations under the constraint of a non-entangling behavior. Comparing this restricted evolution to the solutions of the unrestricted equations of motion allows one to investigate the trajectory-based entanglement of general systems. We solve our equations for interacting particles in a Klein--Gordon-type setting, thereby quantifying the dynamic and relativistic impact of entanglement in a self-consistent manner.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子纠缠是量子技术的关键资源，但在不同惯性系中考虑粒子间的纠缠并处理相对论效应是一个重要挑战。本文提出了一个克服这一挑战的自洽框架，建立了可因子化和纠缠的多时间轨迹概念，并推导了非纠缠行为约束下的欧拉-拉格朗日方程。通过比较受限演化与非受限运动方程的解，研究人员能够探究一般系统的基于轨迹的纠缠。该工作在类克莱因-戈登背景下求解了相互作用粒子的方程，从而以自洽方式量化了纠缠的动态和相对论影响。
authors: Yannick Noel Freitag, Julien Pinske, Jan Sperling

articles.title: Quantum Information Transmission Over Quantum Relay Channels
articles.title_zh: 通过量子中继信道传输量子信息
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.06770v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum relays are central to both quantum communication and distributed quantum computing, enabling long-distance transmission and modular architectures. Unlike classical repeaters, quantum repeaters preserve coherence without amplifying quantum information, relying on entanglement swapping and quantum error correction to overcome loss and decoherence. In this work, we investigate the transmission of quantum information via quantum relay channels. Our three-terminal relay model captures the trade-off between repeater-assisted and repeaterless communication strategies. Specifically, we propose a partial decode-forward strategy, in which quantum ``message system" consists of two components. The first component is decoded by the relay and then sent to the destination receiver, whereas the second component is decoded by the destination receiver without the relay's help. We analyze both entanglement-assisted and unassisted scenarios. As a special case, the full decode-forward strategy is recovered, with the relay decoding, re-encoding, and forwarding the entire message. Our framework allows for different entanglement topologies between the transmitter, the relay and the destination receiver, recovering known results on entanglement-assisted and unassisted communication. Furthermore, we discuss the interpretation of coding with quantum side information. These findings provide a foundation for designing secure, efficient, and reliable quantum networks and for realizing practical quantum repeaters and long-range quantum key distribution.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子中继器在量子通信和分布式量子计算中至关重要，可实现远距离传输和模块化架构。本文研究了通过量子中继信道传输量子信息的问题，提出了一个三终端中继模型，捕捉了中继辅助和无中继通信策略之间的权衡。研究人员提出了一种部分解码-转发策略，并分析了纠缠辅助和非辅助场景，该框架允许不同的纠缠拓扑结构。
authors: Yigal Ilin, Uzi Pereg

articles.title: Tree tensor network states represent low-energy states faithfully
articles.title_zh: 树张量网络态忠实地表示低能态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.20215v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Extending corresponding results for matrix product states [Verstraete and Cirac, PRB 73, 094423 (2006); Schuch et al. PRL 100, 030504 (2008)], it is shown how the approximation error of tree tensor network states (TTNS) can be bounded using Schmidt spectra or Rényi entanglement entropies of the target quantum state. Conversely, one obtains bounds on TTNS bond dimensions needed to achieve a specific approximation accuracy. The result implies that efficient TTNS approximations exist if α<1 Rényi entanglement entropies for single-branch cuts obey an area law, as in ground and low-energy states of certain gapped systems on tree graphs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文扩展了矩阵乘积态的相关结果，展示了如何利用目标量子态的施密特谱或Rényi纠缠熵来限制树张量网络态（TTNS）的近似误差。反之，可以获得实现特定近似精度所需的TTNS键维度的界限。结果表明，如果单分支切割的α<1 Rényi纠缠熵遵循面积定律，则存在高效的TTNS近似，这在树图上某些有能隙系统的基态和低能态中是成立的。
authors: Thomas Barthel

articles.title: Cost scaling of MPS and TTNS simulations for 2D and 3D systems with area-law entanglement
articles.title_zh: 具有面积定律纠缠的二维和三维系统MPS和TTNS模拟的成本标度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.08132v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Tensor network states are an indispensable tool for the simulation of strongly correlated quantum many-body systems. In recent years, tree tensor network states (TTNS) have been successfully used for two-dimensional systems and to benchmark quantum simulation approaches for condensed matter, nuclear, and particle physics. In comparison to the more traditional approach based on matrix product states (MPS), the graph distance of physical degrees of freedom can be drastically reduced in TTNS. Surprisingly, it turns out that, for large systems in D>1 spatial dimensions, MPS simulations of low-energy states are nevertheless more efficient than TTNS simulations. With a focus on D=2 and 3, the scaling of computational costs for different boundary conditions is determined under the assumption that the system obeys an entanglement (log-)area law, implying that bond dimensions scale exponentially in the interface area of the associated subsystems.
articles.abstract_zh: 张量网络态是模拟强关联量子多体系统的重要工具。尽管树张量网络态（TTNS）在降低物理自由度图距离方面优于矩阵乘积态（MPS），但对于D>1维的大系统，MPS模拟低能态的效率更高。本文主要关注D=2和3维系统，在系统遵循纠缠面积定律的假设下，确定了不同边界条件下计算成本的标度。研究结果表明，键合维度与相关子系统的界面面积呈指数关系。
authors: Thomas Barthel

articles.title: Bidirectional teleportation using scrambling dynamics: a practical protocol
articles.title_zh: 利用混洗动力学实现双向量子隐形传态：一种实用协议
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.15536v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We show that quantum information scrambling can enable a generic SWAP gate between collective degrees of freedom in systems without universal local control. Our protocol combines a Hayden-Preskill type recovery scheme, associated with the black hole information paradox, with quantum teleportation and runs them in parallel and in opposite directions, enabling bidirectional exchange of quantum states through global interactions alone. This approach cleanly distinguishes the roles of information spreading, entanglement, and chaos for enabling both coherent state transfer and recovery. We propose an experimental realization using the Dicke model, which can be realized in optical cavity and trapped-ion platforms, highlighting the utility of holography in designing practical quantum gates.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了量子信息混洗如何在没有通用局部控制的系统中实现集体自由度之间的通用SWAP门。该协议结合了Hayden-Preskill型恢复方案与量子隐形传态，并使其并行反向运行，仅通过全局相互作用实现量子态的双向交换。这种方法清晰地区分了信息传播、纠缠和混沌在实现相干态传输和恢复中的作用。作者还提出了使用Dicke模型进行实验实现的方案，突出了全息术在设计实用量子门方面的应用价值。
authors: Amit Vikram, Edwin Chaparro, Muhammad Miskeen Khan, Andrew Lucas, Chris Akers, Ana Maria Rey

articles.title: Entropic Barriers and the Kinetic Suppression of Topological Defects
articles.title_zh: 熵势垒与拓扑缺陷的动力学抑制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.16777v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Many quantum phases, from topological orders to superfluids, are destabilized at finite temperature by the proliferation and motion of topological defects such as anyons or vortices. Conventional protection mechanisms rely on energetic gaps and fail once thermal fluctuations exceed the gap scale. Here we examine a complementary mechanism of entropic protection, in which defect nucleation is suppressed by coupling to mesoscopic auxiliary reservoirs of dimension M, generating an effective free-energy barrier that increases with temperature. In the Ising chain, this produces a characteristic three-regime evolution of the correlation length as a function of temperature - linear growth, entropy-controlled plateau, and eventual breakdown - indicating a general modification of defect behavior. Focusing on two spatial dimensions, where true finite-temperature topological order is forbidden in the thermodynamic limit, we show that entropic protection can nevertheless strongly enhance stabilization at finite system size, the regime directly relevant for quantum memory and experiments. Owing to the topological character of the defects, creation and transport are independently suppressed, yielding a double parametric reduction of logical errors in the entropic toric code and enhanced coherence when the framework is extended to Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless transitions. Entropic barriers thus provide a passive and scalable route to stabilizing quantum phases in experimentally relevant regimes. We propose an experimental setup for entropic toric code using dual species Rydberg arrays with dressing.
articles.abstract_zh: 许多量子相在有限温度下会因拓扑缺陷的增殖和运动而失稳。本文研究了一种互补的熵保护机制，通过将缺陷与M维介观辅助储层耦合，产生随温度增加的有效自由能势垒来抑制缺陷成核。在伊辛链中，这导致了关联长度随温度的三区演化。研究表明，在二维空间中，尽管热力学极限下禁止真正的有限温度拓扑序，但熵保护仍能显著增强有限系统尺寸下的稳定性，这对于量子存储和实验具有直接意义。
authors: Yi-Lin Tsao, Zhu-Xi Luo

articles.title: Quantum Advantage for Sensing Properties of Classical Fields
articles.title_zh: 经典场性质感知的量子优势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.17591v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Modern precision experiments often probe unknown classical fields with bosonic sensors in quantum-noise-limited regimes where vacuum fluctuations limit conventional readout. We introduce Quantum Signal Learning (QSL), a sensing framework that extends metrology to a broader property-learning setting, and propose a quantum-enhanced protocol that simultaneously estimates many properties of a classical signal with shot noise suppressed below the vacuum level. Our scheme requires only two-mode squeezing, passive optics, and static homodyne measurements, and enables post-hoc classical estimation of many properties from the same experimental dataset. We prove that our protocol enables a quantum speedup for common classical sensing tasks, including measuring electromagnetic correlations, real-time feedback control of interferometric cavities, and Fourier-domain matched filtering. To establish these separations, we introduce an optimal-transport conditioning method, and show both worst-case exponential separations from all entanglement-free strategies and practical speedups over homodyne and heterodyne baselines. We further show that when squeezing is treated as a resource, a protocol with squeezed light can sense a structured classical background exponentially faster than any coherent classical probe.
articles.abstract_zh: 现代精密实验常在量子噪声受限的条件下，利用玻色子传感器探测未知经典场。本文引入了量子信号学习（QSL）这一传感框架，并提出了一种量子增强协议，能够同时估计经典信号的多种性质，并将散粒噪声抑制到真空水平以下。该方案仅需双模压缩、无源光学和静态零差测量，即可从同一实验数据集中进行事后经典估计。研究证明，该协议在电磁关联测量、干涉腔实时反馈控制和傅里叶域匹配滤波等常见经典传感任务中实现了量子加速，并展示了相对于无纠缠策略的指数级分离和相对于零差/外差基线的实际加速。
authors: Jordan Cotler, Daine L. Danielson, Ishaan Kannan

articles.title: Quantum Cramér-Rao bound on quantum metric as a single-observable uncertainty relation
articles.title_zh: 量子度规上的量子Cramér-Rao界限作为单可观测量不确定关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.04615v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Belavkin version of quantum Cramér-Rao bound dictates that the covariance of any set of operators is bounded by a product of the derivatives of expectation values and the inverse of quantum metric. We elaborate that because quantum metric itself is the covariance of the generators of translation in the parameter space, quantum metric in any dimension is bounded by a product of itself and Berry curvature. The generator formalism further indicates that the bound is equivalent to a single-observable uncertainty relation for systems described by multiple observables, which in the two-observable case recovers the Robertson-Schrödinger uncertainty relation. The momentum space quantum metric and spin operators of three-dimensional topological insulators under magnetic field are used to demonstrate the validity of these bounds, and their constraints on the spread of Wannier function, absorbance in 2D, and dielectric function in 3D will be elaborated.
articles.abstract_zh: Belavkin版本的量子Cramér-Rao界限指出，任何算符集合的协方差都受期望值导数与量子度规逆的乘积限制。本文阐述了量子度规本身是参数空间中平移生成子的协方差，因此任何维度的量子度规都受其自身与贝里曲率乘积的限制。生成子形式进一步表明，该界限等价于多可观测量系统的单可观测量不确定关系，在双可观测量情况下可恢复Robertson-Schrödinger不确定关系。研究使用磁场下三维拓扑绝缘体的动量空间量子度规和自旋算符来验证这些界限，并阐述它们对Wannier函数展宽、二维吸收率和三维介电函数的影响。
authors: Wei Chen

articles.title: Generalized Inverses of Quantum Channels: a categorical perspective
articles.title_zh: 量子通道的广义逆：一个范畴论视角
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.13946v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A quantum channel is defined as being completely positive (CP) and trace preserving (TP). While not every quantum channel is invertible or reversible, every quantum channel admits various kinds of generalized inverses such as the Moore-Penrose inverse and the Drazin inverse. A generalized inverse of a quantum channel may not itself be a quantum channel: it often fails to be CP. However, generalized inverses still play an important role in quantum error mitigation. Here, because it is often desirable for the generalized inverse of a quantum channel to be at least TP, the Drazin inverse, which is TP, is favoured over the Moore-Penrose inverse, which is not in general TP. In this paper, we take a categorical perspective on generalized inverses of quantum channels. This allows us to give a simple proof of the fact that the Drazin inverse of a quantum channel is always TP. It also allows us to show that for unital quantum channels, the Drazin inverse is also unital. We then generalize this result to dagger Drazin inverses, which allows us to show that for unital quantum channels, the Moore-Penrose inverse is both TP and unital as well. This opens the door to new applications of both the Drazin inverse and Moore-Penrose inverse in quantum information theory and, in particular, in quantum error mitigation.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子通道被定义为完全正（CP）且迹保持（TP）。尽管并非所有量子通道都可逆，但它们都存在多种广义逆，如Moore-Penrose逆和Drazin逆。本文从范畴论角度研究量子通道的广义逆，并简单证明了量子通道的Drazin逆总是迹保持的。研究进一步表明，对于幺正量子通道，Drazin逆也是幺正的。该结果推广到dagger Drazin逆后，也证明了幺正量子通道的Moore-Penrose逆既是迹保持的也是幺正的。
authors: Robin Cockett (University of Calgary), Jean-Simon Pacaud Lemay (Macquarie University), Priyaa Varshinee Srinivasan (Tallinn University of Technology)

articles.title: Hybrid Clifford Codes via Operator Algebra Quantum Error Correction and Projective Representation Theory
articles.title_zh: 基于算子代数量子纠错和射影表示理论的混合Clifford码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.02531v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Clifford codes are a natural generalization of quantum stabilizer codes based primarily on representation theory. This class of codes has previously been extended to the setting of quantum subsystem codes. We formulate a two-fold generalization of Clifford codes, for both the hybrid classical and quantum information and projective representation theory settings. This leads to new classes of hybrid subspace and subsystem Clifford codes. We extend the fundamental representation theoretic quantum error correction theorem to include these codes, based on the operator algebra quantum error correction framework. We also discuss several examples throughout the presentation, of both stabilizer and non-stabilizer type.
articles.abstract_zh: Clifford码是基于表示理论的量子稳定子码的自然推广。本文在混合经典和量子信息以及射影表示理论的背景下，提出了Clifford码的双重推广，从而产生了新型的混合子空间和子系统Clifford码。研究基于算子代数量子纠错框架，将基本的表示理论量子纠错定理扩展到包含这些新码。文中还讨论了稳定子型和非稳定子型的多个示例。
authors: Jonas Eidesen, David W. Kribs, Andrew Nemec

articles.title: All-optical Implementation of Generalized Quantum Teleportation
articles.title_zh: 广义量子隐形传态的全光实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.22736v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Measurement-based continuous-variable optical quantum computing inherently offers high-speed, large-scale operations, yet its practical performance remains constrained by the processing latencies and throughput bottlenecks imposed by classical electronic feedforward circuits. To overcome these limitations, we propose a loss-tolerant, all-optical feedforward (AOFF) architecture for generalized quantum teleportation, which executes programmable single-mode Gaussian operations and realizes arbitrary single-mode linear operations with two successive stages. Quantitative noise analysis under realistic device parameters demonstrates that the architecture suppresses the hardware-induced noise floor to levels potentially compatible with fault-tolerant quantum computing with Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill qubits over the range of operations required for their Clifford gates. By eliminating optoelectronic conversions, this scheme enables continuous operations with high analog bandwidth and high temporal-mode throughput that drastically reduce circuit runtime. Ultimately, this approach delivers a noise-resilient platform that reconciles operational versatility with the intrinsic speed and bandwidth of optical quantum information processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于测量的连续变量光学量子计算具有高速、大规模操作的潜力，但其性能受限于经典电子前馈电路的处理延迟和吞吐量瓶颈。为克服这些限制，本文提出了一种容损的全光前馈（AOFF）架构，用于广义量子隐形传态。该架构通过两个连续阶段执行可编程单模高斯操作并实现任意单模线性操作。在实际器件参数下的定量噪声分析表明，该架构能将硬件引起的噪声抑制到与容错量子计算兼容的水平，并显著减少电路运行时间，提供了一个噪声弹性平台。
authors: Takaya Hoshi, Akito Kawasaki, Xiruo Yan, Atsushi Sakaguchi, Takumi Suzuki, Tatsuki Sonoyama, Hironari Nagayoshi, Kosuke Fukui, Kan Takase, Warit Asavanant

articles.title: Coherent control of subradiant excitations in atomic rings
articles.title_zh: 原子环中亚辐射激发的相干控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.25638v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Subradiant excitations in ordered subwavelength atomic arrays are protected against radiative decay, making them a promising platform for storing and manipulating photonic excitations. The external geometry of the array, combined with dynamical control of the atomic dipole orientation, enables localized trapping and coherent transport of these subradiant excitations. Here, we theoretically demonstrate these capabilities in ring-shaped atomic arrays. Specifically, we show adiabatic transport of a localized excitation around a single ring, coherent transfer of a single excitation between two neighboring rings with geometry-controlled selectivity, and interaction-induced conditional phase shifts between two simultaneously trapped excitations in neighboring rings. Depending on the ring geometry, these realize either an entangling iSWAP-type exchange or a controlled-phase operation with tunable conditional phase. Together, these results demonstrate the potential of ordered atomic arrays as a platform for coherent photonic quantum information processing with dissipation-protected collective excitations.
articles.abstract_zh: 有序亚波长原子阵列中的亚辐射激发因受辐射衰减保护，成为存储和操控光子激发的理想平台。本文理论演示了在环形原子阵列中实现亚辐射激发的局域捕获和相干传输。研究展示了单环内激发的绝热传输、相邻环间激发的相干转移以及相互作用诱导的条件相移，这些可实现纠缠iSWAP型交换或可调控的受控相操作。这些结果表明有序原子阵列在耗散保护的集体激发下，在相干光子量子信息处理方面具有巨大潜力。
authors: Milena Djatchkova, Igor Lesanovsky, Beatriz Olmos

articles.title: Quantum Magnonics: Quantum States Generation and Applications
articles.title_zh: 量子磁振子学：量子态的生成与应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.27771v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Hybrid systems based on magnons in ferromagnetic materials, such as yttrium iron garnet, have achieved remarkable development in the last decade. These include the coupling of magnons to microwave and optical photons, superconducting qubits, phonons, spins, the center-of-mass motion of a ferromagnet, etc. Here, we review both the experimental and theoretical progress in this field, focusing on the generation of magnonic quantum states and their applications in a broad range of fields. Since the strong coupling is a prerequisite for achieving coherent quantum control of magnons and preparing magnonic quantum states, we start by introducing representative strong-coupling experiments in cavity magnonics, then review a series of protocols for creating various magnonic quantum states, such as Fock, cat, squeezed, and entangled states, and discuss their potential applications in macroscopic quantum studies, quantum information science, quantum sensing, magnonic quantum devices, dark matter detection, and so on. Finally, we summarize the review and give an outlook for the future study of quantum magnonics.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于铁磁材料中磁振子的混合系统在过去十年取得了显著进展。本文综述了量子磁振子学领域的实验和理论进展，重点关注磁振子量子态的生成及其广泛应用。文章首先介绍了腔磁振子学中的强耦合实验，随后回顾了生成各种磁振子量子态的协议。最后，讨论了这些量子态在宏观量子研究、量子信息科学、量子传感等领域的潜在应用，并展望了未来的研究方向。
authors: Zi-Xu Lu, Xuan Zuo, Xin-Lei Hei, Gang Liu, Zeng-Xing Liu, Qi Guo, Peng-Bo Li, Jie Li

articles.title: Variational formulae for entropy-like functionals for states in von Neumann algebras
articles.title_zh: 冯诺依曼代数中类熵泛函的变分公式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.07605v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The paper presents variational formulae for entropy-like functionals, including Segal and Rényi entropies, for normal states on semifinite von Neumann algebras. The considered functionals are of the form τ(f(h)) where τ is a normal faithful semifinite trace on this algebra, h is a positive selfadjoint operator from L¹⁽mathscrM,τ), and f is an appropriate convex or concave function. The results cover both finite and semifinite algebras, and the obtained formulae generalise known results, in particular, those concerning relative entropy. Moreover, the connection between quantum entropies and the structure of abelian subalgebras is highlighted, providing new interpretations in the context of quantum information theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了半有限冯诺依曼代数上正规态的类熵泛函（包括Segal熵和Rényi熵）的变分公式。这些泛函形式为τ(f(h))，其中τ是正规忠实半有限迹，h是L¹(mathscrM,τ)中的正自伴算子，f是适当的凸或凹函数。研究结果涵盖了有限和半有限代数，并推广了已知结果，特别是关于相对熵的公式。此外，论文强调了量子熵与阿贝尔子代数结构之间的联系，为量子信息理论提供了新的解释。
authors: Andrzej Łuczak, Hanna Podskedkowska, Rafał Wieczorek

articles.title: Second law of thermodynamics in closed quantum many-body systems
articles.title_zh: 封闭量子多体系统中的热力学第二定律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.06657v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The second law of thermodynamics for adiabatic operations -- constraints on state transitions in closed systems under external control -- is one of the fundamental principles of thermodynamics. On the other hand, it is recently established that even pure quantum states can represent thermal equilibrium. However, pure quantum states do not satisfy the second law in that they are not passive, i.e., work can be extracted from them if arbitrary unitary operations are allowed. It therefore remains unresolved how quantum mechanics can be reconciled with thermodynamics. Here, based on our key quantum-mechanical notions of thermal equilibrium and adiabatic operations, we address the emergence of the second law for adiabatic operations in the thermodynamics limit. We first introduce infinite-observable macroscopic thermal equilibrium (iMATE); a quantum state, including pure states, is in iMATE if the expectation values of all additive observables agree with their equilibrium values. We also introduce a macroscopic operation as unitary evolution generated by a time-dependent additive Hamiltonian, which is regarded as corresponding to adiabatic operations. Employing these concepts, we show that no extensive work can be extracted from any quantum state in iMATE through any macroscopic operations. Furthermore, we introduce a quantum-mechanical form of entropy density such that it agrees with thermodynamic entropy density for any quantum state in iMATE. We then prove that for any initial state in iMATE, this entropy density cannot be decreased by any macroscopic operations, followed by a time-independent relaxation process. Our theory thus proves two different forms of the second law, by adopting macroscopically reasonable classes of observables, equilibrium states, and operations. We also discuss the time scales of macroscopic operations in these results.
articles.abstract_zh: 热力学第二定律是热力学的基本原理之一，但纯量子态不满足该定律，这使得量子力学与热力学的协调成为一个未解决的问题。本文基于热力学平衡和绝热操作的量子力学概念，探讨了热力学极限下绝热操作第二定律的出现。研究引入了无限可观测宏观热力学平衡（iMATE）的概念，并定义了宏观操作为由含时加性哈密顿量生成的幺正演化。
authors: Yuuya Chiba, Yasushi Yoneta, Ryusuke Hamazaki, Akira Shimizu

articles.title: Quantum-Inspired Tensor Network Autoencoders for Anomaly Detection: A MERA-Based Approach
articles.title_zh: 基于MERA的量子启发张量网络自编码器用于异常检测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.06541v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We investigate whether a multiscale tensor-network architecture provides a useful inductive bias for reconstruction-based anomaly detection in collider jets. Jets are produced by a branching cascade, so their internal structure is naturally organised across angular and momentum scales. This motivates an autoencoder that compresses information hierarchically and can reorganise short-range correlations before coarse-graining. Guided by this picture, we formulate a Multiscale Entanglement Renormalization Ansatz (MERA)-inspired autoencoder acting on ordered jet constituents. To our knowledge, a MERA-inspired autoencoder has not previously been proposed, and this architecture has not been explored in collider anomaly detection. We compare this architecture to a dense autoencoder, the corresponding tree-tensor-network limit, and classical baselines within a background-only reconstruction framework. The paper is organised around two main questions: whether locality-aware hierarchical compression is genuinely supported by the data, and whether the disentangling layers of MERA contribute beyond a simpler tree hierarchy. To address these questions, we combine benchmark comparisons with a training-free local-compressibility diagnostic and a direct identity-disentangler ablation. In the nominal benchmark, the MERA-inspired model attains a higher mean AUC than the dense autoencoder at all three latent dimensions while using roughly one-third of its trainable parameters. The locality-preserving multiscale structure is well matched to jet data, and, at the strongest compression bottleneck, the trained disentanglers move substantially away from the identity and are accompanied by a positive mean performance shift. Overall, the study supports locality-aware hierarchical compression as a useful and parameter-efficient inductive bias for reconstruction-based jet anomaly detection in this benchmark setting.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了多尺度张量网络架构是否能为对撞机射流的异常检测提供有用的归纳偏置。受射流内部结构分层特性的启发，作者提出了一种受多尺度纠缠重整化理论（MERA）启发的自编码器，用于处理有序射流成分。该架构首次被提出并应用于对撞机异常检测，并与传统自编码器和树张量网络等方法进行了比较。研究旨在探讨局部感知分层压缩是否受数据支持，以及MERA的解纠缠层是否比简单树层次结构有额外贡献。
authors: Emre Gurkanli, Michael Spannowsky

articles.title: Leptonic CP Phase Determination from Fisher Information in T2K and NOνA
articles.title_zh: 基于T2K和NOνA实验中费雪信息的轻子CP相确定
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30404v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The precise determination of the leptonic CP phase δₘ̊ CP remains one of the central objectives of current and future long-baseline (LBL) neutrino oscillation experiments. Quantum estimation theory provides a natural framework to quantify the ultimate precision limits for estimating physical parameters encoded in quantum states. In this work, we employ the quantum Fisher information to investigate how much information about δₘ̊ CP is intrinsically encoded in neutrino states and how efficiently it is extracted in present LBL experiments such as T2K and NOνA. We first analyze the intrinsic quantum sensitivity of neutrino and antineutrino states and demonstrate how matter effects generate a neutrino mass-ordering dependent information structure. To compare the intrinsic information content of the quantum state with the information experimentally accessible through flavor measurements, we compute the event-level Fisher information from reconstructed event spectra using Poisson statistics including backgrounds and systematics. We find that both experiments extract only a small fraction of the total information available in the underlying quantum state. This extraction efficiency becomes particularly suppressed near maximally CP-violating regions, where the reconstructed event spectra exhibit reduced sensitivity to small variations in δₘ̊ CP. We also apply the same framework to the reactor mixing angle θ₁₃, providing a benchmark for comparison with the estimation of δₘ̊ CP. Our analysis provides a complementary information-theoretic perspective on precise estimation of oscillation parameters in LBL neutrino experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 轻子CP相δCP的精确测定是当前和未来长基线中微子振荡实验的核心目标之一。本文利用量子费雪信息，研究了中微子态中固有编码的δCP信息量以及T2K和NOνA等实验的提取效率。研究分析了中微子和反中微子态的固有量子敏感性，并展示了物质效应如何产生依赖于中微子质量顺序的信息结构。通过将量子态的固有信息内容与实验可获取的信息进行比较，发现这两个实验仅提取了可用总信息的一小部分。
authors: Neetu Raj Singh Chundawat, Luis A. Delgadillo, Yu-Feng Li

articles.title: Complexity of tensor network simulation for noisy quantum circuits
articles.title_zh: 噪声量子电路张量网络模拟的复杂性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00474v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We aim to rigorously address how local noise affects the classical simulability of quantum dynamics benchmarked by tensor-network methods. Using operator entanglement entropy (OEE) as a unifying criterion, we prove the following: (1) For single-qubit depolarizing noise, geometry-independent ørder1-layer and Θ(łog n)-layer thresholds for fixed absolute and relative Hilbert--Schmidt error are established, beyond which polynomial bond dimension suffices; on 1D local circuits with a product initial input, whole-trajectory MPO approximations are constructed at fixed purified distance with poly(n) bond dimension. (2) For general single-qubit noise, we identify sufficient contractivity conditions for MPO approximations with constant bond dimension, in both the average and worst cases. (3) We further extend the above results to higher dimensions, yielding poly(n) average boundary-bond dimensions for projected entangled pair operators (PEPO) across every cut. Our results establish a rigorous connection between certain noise models, circuit types, and their classical simulability.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文旨在严格探讨局部噪声如何影响量子动力学的经典可模拟性，并以张量网络方法进行基准测试。研究以算符纠缠熵（OEE）为统一标准，证明了单量子比特去极化噪声和一般单量子比特噪声下，多项式键维足以进行MPO近似。此外，结果扩展到更高维度，为投影纠缠对算符（PEPO）提供了多项式平均边界键维。这些发现建立了特定噪声模型、电路类型及其经典可模拟性之间的严格联系。
authors: Yuguo Shao, Zishuo Zhao, Song Cheng, Zhengwei Liu

articles.title: A hybrid quantum-classical neural network for learning to route
articles.title_zh: 一种用于学习路由的混合量子-经典神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.00489v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This work studies hybrid quantum-classical neural networks for learning routing heuristics. Specifically, this paper asks whether small quantum neural networks can replace parameter-heavy modules inside a competitive attention-based routing model while maintaining solution quality. For the capacitated vehicle routing problem, encoder feed-forward replacement emerges as the most promising design: it reduces the number of model parameters by 56.6% while keeping the hybrid model close to the classical neural baseline at small and medium instance sizes, although the gap grows for larger instances. This work also compares to classical routing algorithms, which remain highly competitive and often superior on the fixed Euclidean test sets. Our results therefore do not indicate quantum advantage or solver dominance, but identify encoder feed-forward replacement as a viable hybrid-module compression strategy for neural combinatorial optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了混合量子-经典神经网络在学习路由启发式算法中的应用。研究探讨了小型量子神经网络是否能替代基于注意力的路由模型中参数密集型模块，同时保持解决方案质量。对于带容量的车辆路径问题，编码器前馈替换被认为是最佳设计，它将模型参数减少了56.6%，且在中小规模实例上性能接近经典神经网络基线。尽管结果未显示量子优势，但该方法为神经组合优化提供了一种可行的混合模块压缩策略。
authors: Marcus Rolf Peter Ritt, Alexsandro Santos da Rosa Júnior, Marcos Vinicius Reballo, Cesar Augusto do Amaral, Fernando Augusto Caletti de Barros

articles.title: Resonantly interacting 2e/3 anyons: a controlled microscopic theory of anyon superconductivity
articles.title_zh: 共振相互作用的2e/3任意子：任意子超导的受控微观理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05529v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a microscopic theory of anyon superconductivity that connects electronic interactions in a lightly doped Laughlin state to the universal physics of a resonantly interacting anyon gas. Using geometric quantization of Laughlin quasiholes, we derive the effective many-body Hamiltonian of dilute charge-2e/3 anyons, including their valley structure, dispersion, and statistical and short-range interactions, together with an explicit map between anyon and electron observables. This reduces the dilute many-body problem to a few parameters fixed by data computable from few anyon numerics. In analogy with resonant Fermi and Bose gases, we organize the dilute anyon problem around a two-body binding resonance and its relevant and marginal perturbations. For a three-valley gas of charge-2e/3 anyons, we identify a resonance whose long-distance theory is governed by an Aharonov-Casher anyon Hamiltonian whose magnetic field is the statistical Chern-Simons field and whose ground state is exactly solvable. Using the ground state wavefunction, we demonstrate Cooper-pair off-diagonal long-range order directly in electron coordinates and determine the pairing symmetry and vortex-lattice structure. The leading perturbations at the fixed point are a relevant pair detuning and a marginal three-body contact in the valley-singlet channel, which determine the compressibility and sound velocity. A repulsive three-body coupling is marginally irrelevant, allowing the fixed point to control a parametrically broad dilute regime near pair resonance, while attractive three-body interactions instead generate charge-2e trimers. More broadly, our results show that binding thresholds between competing anyon composites host universal resonant regimes that are not captured by the lowest-energy anyon species alone, providing a new setting for controlled theories of anyon matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文发展了一种任意子超导的微观理论，将轻掺杂Laughlin态中的电子相互作用与共振相互作用任意子气体的普适物理联系起来。通过Laughlin准孔的几何量子化，推导了稀疏电荷2e/3任意子的有效多体哈密顿量，包括其谷结构、色散以及统计和短程相互作用。研究将稀疏多体问题简化为少数参数，并类比共振费米和玻色气体，围绕双体束缚共振组织了稀疏任意子问题。对于三谷电荷2e/3任意子气体，作者识别出一个共振，其长程理论由Aharonov-Casher任意子哈密顿量控制，并展示了电子坐标中的库珀对非对角长程有序。
authors: Qingchen Li, Pavel A. Nosov, Zhaoyu Han, Si-Yuan Chen, Taige Wang, Eslam Khalaf

articles.title: Classification and Signatures of Dissipative Quantum Hall-Superconductor Junctions
articles.title_zh: 耗散量子霍尔-超导体结的分类与特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05555v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fractional quantum Hall (FQH) edges with proximity-induced superconductivity can host parafermionic zero modes (PZMs), making them a promising platform for topological quantum computing. Recent experiments [Gül et al., Phys. Rev. X 12, 021057 (2022)] measured the edge conductance from crossed Andreev reflection (CAR) between counter-propagating FQH edges separated by a narrow superconductor. The observed conductance was small and non-quantized, with two distinct behaviors: some states show temperature-independent conductance, while others show conductance that grows as temperature decreases. We explain these results by dissipation to sub-gap modes in the superconductor and present a phase diagram for the FQH-superconductor junction. We show that for Jain states, temperature-independent non-quantized conductance occurs only in the presence of an integer mode (such as at filling ν=1±frac1m, with odd m≥3) strongly coupled to the dissipative channel. The predicted temperature trends qualitatively agree with the experiment, which shows temperature-independent conductance for ν=2/3 and integer states, but not for ν=1/3 and ν=2/5. We propose comparing ν=4/3 and 2/3 to test the predicted influence of the relative chirality of integer and fractional modes.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有邻近感应超导性的分数量子霍尔（FQH）边缘可承载准费米子零模，是拓扑量子计算的潜在平台。本文解释了最近实验中观察到的非量子化边缘电导现象，该现象源于超导体中亚能隙模式的耗散。研究提出了FQH-超导体结的相图，并指出对于Jain态，温度无关的非量子化电导仅在存在与耗散通道强耦合的整数模式时发生。这些预测的温度趋势与实验结果定性一致，为理解耗散对拓扑量子计算平台的影响提供了重要见解。
authors: Evgenii Zheltonozhskii, Barak A. Katzir, Yuval Oreg, Erez Berg, Netanel H. Lindner

articles.title: Topological localization in unentangled random braids
articles.title_zh: 无纠缠随机辫子中的拓扑局域化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05721v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In 2015, P. Serna, G. Bunin, and A. Nahum numerically investigated fluctuations in a bunch of unentangled random threads. They showed that fluctuations of an individual thread in a braid are qualitatively different from those of a thread embedded in a medium of fixed parallel lines. In particular, Serna et al. observed a logarithmic increase in the average transverse span, łeft<|x_N|i̊ght>, of a thread with polymer length, N. This behavior highlights the collective nature of topological interactions, in which each polymer fluctuates and constrains the motion of the others. Studying this problem both numerically and analytically, we propose the following interpretation: the logarithmic regime is transient, and sufficiently long polymers exhibit topological localization, where łeft<|x_N|i̊ght> approaches a finite limit at N→infty. Unlike localization induced by quenched external disorder, this phenomenon arises solely from collective topological constraints. We study braids within a locally free approximation and support the localization by analytical investigation of Brownian bridges on the asymptotic Cayley graph of a locally free group. We further conjecture that topologically induced localization emerges as a phase transition: for a small number of threads, n sim 2div 5, the span, łeft<|x_N|i̊ght>, grows algebraically, with the usual scaling łeft<|x_N|i̊ght>sim N¹/⁴ at Ngg 1; by contrast, for sufficiently large n, each thread in a long braid (Ngg 1) asymptotically localizes, approaching łeft<|x_N|i̊ght>sim const.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了无纠缠随机线束中的涨落现象，并提出了一种新的解释。研究发现，线束中单根线的涨落与固定平行线介质中的线有质的区别，且平均横向跨度随聚合物长度呈对数增长。作者认为这种对数增长是瞬态的，足够长的聚合物会表现出拓扑局域化，即平均横向跨度在长度趋于无穷时趋于有限值。这种局域化现象仅源于集体拓扑约束，而非外部无序。
authors: Daniil Fedotov, Pieter Hendrik Willem Van Der Hoek, Sergei Nechaev

articles.title: First-principles study of the formation of Group-IV--vacancy color centers in diamond
articles.title_zh: 金刚石中IV族-空位色心形成的第一性原理研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06671v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: XV (X is Si, Ge, Sn, or Pb, and V is the carbon vacancy) color centers are promising platforms for quantum computing and quantum information science due to their favorable optical and spin properties. They are commonly fabricated by ion implantation, which inevitably introduces vacancies and carbon self-interstitials (Cᵢ₎ into the lattice. However, the microscopic formation mechanism remains unclear, limiting the yield and stability of XV centers. Here, first-principles calculations are conducted to systematically investigate the roles of V and Cᵢ in XV formation. We find that XV formation is energetically favorable, with large binding energies and low diffusion barriers. Nevertheless, XV readily captures Cᵢ to form substitutional defect Xₛ, or captures an additional V to form the complex XV₂. Charge transition levels show that oppositely charged reactants never meet in these reactions, and that Coulomb repulsion blocks them only when both reactants carry charges of the same sign, which for the capture of Cᵢ requires strongly n- or p-type conditions. These competing defect reactions destabilize the split-vacancy configuration and could account for the low formation yield of XV centers, so that they appear at concentrations well below those expected from the implanted dose. Our results elucidate the microscopic origin of this intrinsic instability and suggest that Fermi-level control may suppress defect conversions and stabilize the split-vacancy configuration.
articles.abstract_zh: XV（X为Si、Ge、Sn或Pb，V为碳空位）色心因其优异的光学和自旋特性，是量子计算和量子信息科学的潜在平台。本文通过第一性原理计算，系统研究了V和Cᵢ在XV色心形成中的作用。研究发现XV形成在能量上是有利的，但XV容易捕获Cᵢ形成替代缺陷Xₛ，或捕获额外的V形成复合体XV₂。电荷跃迁能级分析表明，这些竞争性缺陷反应会使分裂空位构型不稳定，从而限制了XV色心的产率和稳定性。
authors: Xiangru Han, Adam Gali

articles.title: Longitudinal and Transverse Thermoelectric Properties in Topological Quantum Materials
articles.title_zh: 拓扑量子材料中的纵向和横向热电性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06865v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Thermoelectric materials can be topologically trivial or non-trivial, enabling reversible interconversion of heat and electricity using a solid-state technology. Incidentally, few of the first experimentally discovered 3D topological materials, namely, Bi, Sb, Sn and Pb-based chalcogenides, were long known as good thermoelectric materials. In these compounds, the heavy atoms that give rise to strong spin-orbit coupling often become essential for band inversion and non-trivial band topology. They lead to low lattice thermal conductivity, linearly dispersing Dirac-like bands induce high electrical mobility, and a band-inverted electronic structure with multiple band extrema gives rise to high Seebeck coefficients. In materials, where the applied temperature gradient induces electrical voltage (Seebeck effect) in the same direction, they are termed as longitudinal thermoelectrics. On the other hand, when the generated electrical voltage and applied thermal current remain orthogonal to each other, the materials are termed as transverse thermoelectrics. The transverse response can be driven by an additional external magnetic field (ordinary Nernst effect), intrinsic remanent magnetisation, or non-zero Berry curvature of a material, which arises from their non-trivial topology (anomalous Nernst effect). We discuss another class of quantum materials, known as goniopolar materials, that exhibit axis-dependent conduction polarity and hence transverse thermoelectric effects, which are based on mechanisms of longitudinal thermoelectric properties. In this review, we cover both types of thermoelectricity, focusing on materials that possess non-trivial topological order. We make connections between their structures, topology and transport properties and suggest tunability of thermoelectric properties going beyond conventional mechanisms such as electron-phonon interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 热电材料能够实现热能与电能的可逆转换，其中一些早期发现的三维拓扑材料，如Bi、Sb、Sn和Pb基硫族化合物，也以其优异的热电性能而闻名。这些材料中的重原子导致强自旋轨道耦合，对能带反转和非平凡拓扑结构至关重要。它们展现出低晶格热导率、高电迁移率以及高塞贝克系数。本文区分了纵向热电材料（温差与电压方向一致）和横向热电材料（温差与电压方向正交），并指出横向响应可由外部磁场驱动。
authors: Jyoti Duhan, Anil Kumar B. M., Satya N. Guin, Koushik Pal

articles.title: Mean-Field Study of Normal Metal-Quantum Dot-Superconductor System in the Presence of External Magnetic Field
articles.title_zh: 外部磁场下正金属-量子点-超导体系统的平均场研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2309.10720v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this paper, we have analyzed the spectral and transport properties of a weakly correlated single-level quantum dot hybridized with one normal conducting and another Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) superconducting lead (N-QD-S system) in the presence of an external magnetic field. We have employed Green's function equation of motion (EOM) approach within a self-consistent Hartree-Fock (HF) mean-field approximation to analyze the Hamiltonian. We studied the effect of on-dot Coulomb correlation and an external magnetic field on the sub-gap Andreev levels of a quantum dot, strongly coupled to a conventional s-wave superconductor as a function of impurity parameters. We have shown that for a finite magnetic field, the Andreev bound states (ABSs) split into a spin-up and spin-down contribution (i.e. Zeeman splitting) and cross the Fermi energy level, resulting in a quantum phase transition, which is an indication of a change in the fermion parity of the ground state. Further, within the non-linear regime, we discuss the total electrical conductance for various values of Zeeman energy and on-dot Coulomb interactions. We have compared our results with the existing experimental and theoretical results.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用格林函数运动方程方法和自洽Hartree-Fock平均场近似，分析了外部磁场下弱关联单能级量子点与正常导体和BCS超导体引线杂化的N-QD-S系统的光谱和输运性质。研究发现，在有限磁场下，安德烈夫束缚态（ABSs）会分裂并穿过费米能级，导致量子相变，这表明基态费米子宇称发生变化。此外，在非线性区域，本文讨论了不同塞曼能量和点上库仑相互作用值下的总电导。
authors: Pujita Das, Sachin Verma, Ajay

articles.title: Finite-size scaling theory of Rényi thermal entropy for second-order, first-order, and weakly first-order quantum phase transitions
articles.title_zh: 二阶、一阶和弱一阶量子相变的Rényi热熵有限尺寸标度理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.16111v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Establishing the nature of a quantum phase transition in finite-size simulations---whether continuous, first-order, or weakly first-order---is a fundamental challenge in quantum many-body computation. The weakly first-order transition is particularly elusive: its anomalously large correlation length invariably mimics a continuous critical point at accessible system sizes, and no unified finite-size scaling theory has existed to distinguish these scenarios under realistic computational constraints. In this work, we address this problem by introducing a finite-size scaling framework based on the Rényi thermal entropy (RTE) and its derivative (DRTE). We derive the finite-size scaling forms for the RTE and DRTE at continuous, first-order, and weakly first-order quantum phase transitions, and show that the DRTE isolates the universal contribution of the free energy and strengthens the characteristics of various phase transitions in finite sizes. Using quantum Monte Carlo simulations, we demonstrate accurate data collapse and extraction of critical exponents at (2+1)-dimensional O(N) critical points. Most importantly, the DRTE provides a definitive signature of weakly first-order transitions at visitable sizes---a zero-crossing and a double-peak structure---which we observe in the debated deconfined quantum criticality candidates such as the J--Q and SU(8) J₁₋₋J₂ models. Our approach offers a general, order-parameter-agnostic, and numerically efficient diagnostic tool, resolving long-standing ambiguities between continuous and weakly first-order scenarios in the finite size simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 在有限尺寸模拟中确定量子相变的性质是一个基本挑战，特别是弱一阶相变因其异常大的关联长度常模拟连续临界点。本文通过引入基于Rényi热熵（RTE）及其导数（DRTE）的有限尺寸标度框架来解决此问题。研究推导了连续、一阶和弱一阶量子相变中RTE和DRTE的有限尺寸标度形式，并表明DRTE能分离自由能的普适贡献并增强各种相变在有限尺寸下的特征。通过量子蒙特卡洛模拟，验证了该方法在提取临界指数方面的准确性，并强调DRTE在区分不同相变类型中的重要性。
authors: Zhe Wang, Yanzhang Zhu, Chunhao Guo, Bin-Bin Chen, Yi-Ming Ding, Zenan Liu, Zheng Yan

articles.title: Criticality and Quench Dynamics at the Anderson Transition of a Chern Insulator
articles.title_zh: 拓扑陈绝缘体安德森相变中的临界性与淬火动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.03426v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the critical properties and non-equilibrium dynamics of the topological Anderson phase transition in a strongly disordered Chern insulator. We show that a critical length scale emerges in the real-space profile of the local Chern marker and matches the corresponding correlation-length critical exponent found in the literature. We further determine the dynamical critical exponent from the frequency-dependent conductivity, finding values consistent with those of non-interacting models in the integer quantum Hall universality class. We then ramp the disorder strength across the phase transition and investigate the ensuing non-equilibrium dynamics. In contrast to clean topological systems, the spectral gap is closed due to localized states and consequently the generation of excitations does not exhibit Kibble-Zurek scaling. Despite this, we find that the non-equilibrium length scale extracted from the local Chern marker shows signatures of the Kibble-Zurek scaling. Our results demonstrate that the non-equilibrium dynamics of the topological Anderson transition features decoupling between the excitations and the emergent length scale as known from clean systems, and establish the local Chern marker as a probe of the emergent length scale during the quench.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了强无序陈绝缘体中拓扑安德森相变的临界性质和非平衡动力学。研究发现，局域陈示踪剂的实空间分布中出现了一个临界长度尺度，并与文献中的相关长度临界指数相符。通过频率依赖电导率确定了动力学临界指数，其值与整数量子霍尔普适类中的非相互作用模型一致。尽管激发态的产生不遵循Kibble-Zurek标度，但从局域陈示踪剂提取的非平衡长度尺度显示出Kibble-Zurek标度的特征，表明激发与涌现长度尺度之间存在解耦。
authors: Lara Ulčakar, Jernej Mravlje, Gal Lemut, Tomaž Rejec

articles.title: Quantum Tunneling-induced Hybridization and Coherent Dynamics of Jackiw-Rebbi Zero Modes in a Modified Su-Schrieffer-Heeger Chain
articles.title_zh: 修正Su-Schrieffer-Heeger链中Jackiw-Rebbi零模的量子隧穿诱导杂化与相干动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01344v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate analytically and numerically the tunneling-induced hybridization and coherent dynamics of Jackiw-Rebbi zero modes in a modified Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) model. Unlike the conventional SSH model, this modified system possess two bulk gap-closing points, namely the quadratic-type gap-closing point at momenta k₀₌₀ and the Dirac-type gap-closing points at k₀₌±π/4a. Although the quadratic point does not support a topological domain wall due to the absence of mass inversion, the low-energy Dirac theory around k₀₌±π/4a predicts an effective mass that changes sign at two spatially separated domain walls under a kink profile, generating a pair of JR bound states with each states localized at one of those domain walls. We show that the finite spatial overlap between the JR zero modes lifts the zero-energy degeneracy through quantum tunneling, producing symmetric-antisymmetric hybridized states. Using an effective two-level description, we demonstrate that hybridized JR modes undergo coherent tunneling oscillations between the two domain walls, accompanied by periodic transfer of sublattice polarization between the (A,C) and (B,D) sectors. Our results establish a unified framework connecting JR zero modes, quantum tunneling, and coherent dynamics in modified SSH systems, offering a promising platform for controllable topological quantum-state transfer in engineered lattice structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文分析和数值研究了修正Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) 模型中Jackiw-Rebbi (JR) 零模的隧穿诱导杂化和相干动力学。该修正模型具有两个体能隙闭合点，并在扭结剖面下产生一对JR束缚态。研究表明，JR零模之间的有限空间重叠通过量子隧穿消除了零能量简并，形成了对称-反对称杂化态。利用有效的两能级描述，作者证明了杂化JR模在两个畴壁之间经历相干隧穿振荡，并伴随着亚晶格极化在(A,C)和...之间的周期性转移。
authors: Surajit Mandal

Conventional approaches can overcome this mismatch by embedding nonunitary processes into enlarged unita… [Phys. Rev. A 114, 052418] Published Thu Nov 05, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 在量子计算机上模拟开放量子系统极具挑战性，因为耗散动力学是非酉的，而基于门的量子算法通常由酉操作构建。传统方法通过将非酉过程嵌入到扩大的酉操作中来克服这种不匹配。本文探讨了利用系统内禀噪声进行开放量子系统量子模拟的新方法，详情需查阅原文。

articles.abstract_zh: 量子同步在推进量子传感、通信和计算等量子技术方面具有广阔前景。该领域的一个关键挑战是识别能够促进同步动力学出现的机制。本文展示了量子同步可以通过逆对称破缺机制实现，为理解和利用量子同步提供了新的视角，详情需查阅原文。

Combining a Gaussian variational ansatz with a sum-rule analysis, we derive explicit analytical… [Phys. Rev. A 114, 053307] Published Thu Nov 05, 2026

articles.title: Post-selection games
articles.title_zh: 后选择博弈
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2259 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-11-05-2259 In this paper, we introduce post-selection games, a generalization of nonlocal games where each round can be not only won or lost by the players, but also discarded by the referee. Such games naturally formalize possibilistic proofs of nonlocality, such as Hardy's paradox. We develop algorithms for computing the local and Tsirelson bounds of post-selection games. Furthermore, we show that they have an unbounded advantage in statistical power over traditional nonlocal games, making them ideally suited for analysing Bell tests with low detection efficiency.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了后选择博弈，这是一种非局域博弈的推广，其中每一轮除了输赢之外，裁判还可以选择丢弃结果。这种博弈自然地形式化了非局域性的可能性证明，例如Hardy悖论。作者开发了计算后选择博弈的局域和Tsirelson界限的算法，并证明它们在统计能力上比传统非局域博弈具有无限优势，使其非常适合分析低探测效率的贝尔实验。
authors: Víctor Calleja Rodríguez, Ivan A. Bocanegra-Garay, and Mateus Araújo

articles.title: Entanglement routing in hexagonal lattice hypergraph quantum networks via 2-localization and hypergraph immersion
articles.title_zh: 六边形晶格超图量子网络中通过2-局域化和超图浸入实现纠缠路由
articles.abstract: In this paper, we investigate entanglement routing in hexagonal lattice hypergraph quantum networks (HLHQNs) under 2-localization and hypergraph immersion. Firstly, we model each hexagonal face as a six-partite GHZ hyperedge, and show that each hexagonal GHZ hyperedge admits deterministic 2-localization, namely, it can be converted via local operations and classical communication into a Bell state between any designated pair of vertices. This property is further generalized to arbitrary -partite GHZ states. Based on this GHZ-specific localization property, we develop two routing paradigms: localization-then-swapping (L–S) and coalescence-then-dewetting (C–D). Then, under hypergraph immersion, we formulate bipartite routing feasibility as an edge-disjoint path immersion problem on the effective localized graph, and derive illustrative scaling analyzes for both paradigms. Finally, numerical simulations on finite HLHQNs reveal distinct operational mechanisms, resource overheads and applicable scenarios. The L–S paradigm excels at point-to-point bipartite communication and concurrent routing, while the C–D paradigm is more efficient for direct multipartite GHZ-state construction over compact target sets. Our results establish a routing framework specifically for HLHQNs with GHZ-type hyperedge resources and may provide theoretical support for the design of scalable high-order entanglement quantum networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了六边形晶格超图量子网络（HLHQNs）中在2-局域化和超图浸入下的纠缠路由。研究者将每个六边形面建模为六方GHZ超边，并证明其支持确定性2-局域化，可转换为任意指定顶点对之间的贝尔态。在此基础上，提出了两种路由范式：局域化-然后-交换（L-S）和聚结-然后-去湿（C-D）。数值模拟表明，L-S范式擅长点对点双向通信和并发路由，而C-D范式在直接多方GHZ态构建方面更高效。
authors: Qi Han, Shijiao Xing, Xuexin Huang, Xiao Wu and Junlin Li

articles.title: Spectral measures and sharpness of quantum speed limits
articles.title_zh: 量子速度极限的谱测度与尖锐性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05462v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum speed limits bound the time required for a given state to evolve into a given subspace of the Hilbert space under specific energy constraints. We prove that for several standard orthogonalization time bounds, the unique spectral measure associated with the initial vector that saturates the bound is a sum of two Dirac measures. Furthermore, we constrain the families of spectral measures that come arbitrarily close to these bounds and construct examples with measures which are purely absolutely continuous and purely singular continuous with respect to the Lebesgue measure. As a complementary perspective, we discuss the geometric intuition behind quantum speed limits provided by the numerical range of the evolution operator.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子速度极限限制了给定状态在特定能量约束下演化到希尔伯特空间给定子空间所需的时间。本文证明，对于几个标准正交化时间界限，使界限饱和的初始向量的唯一谱测度是两个狄拉克测度的和。研究还限制了任意接近这些界限的谱测度族，并构建了纯绝对连续和纯奇异连续测度的例子。此外，文章还讨论了演化算子数值范围提供的量子速度极限的几何直觉。
authors: Ivica Smolić

articles.title: Fermionic Porter-Thomas statistics and their emergence in random matchgate circuits
articles.title_zh: 费米子Porter-Thomas统计及其在随机匹配门电路中的出现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05479v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: For Haar-random quantum states, measurement probabilities follow the universal Porter--Thomas distribution. This implies anticoncentration, i.e. the spreading of probability over exponentially many outcomes, a key property underlying random-circuit-sampling experiments. We derive the exact analogue of the Porter--Thomas law for random fermionic Gaussian states, both with and without particle-number conservation. We also consider Clifford Gaussian states, for which the problem maps onto a simple model of arcs and loops. For large systems the probabilities become log-normally distributed, with moments growing polynomially in system size. Free-fermion states thus anticoncentrate only up to polynomial factors. We then show how this fermionic Porter--Thomas law emerges in random one-dimensional brickwork matchgate circuits. A simple single-arc approximation accurately describes the full distribution of probabilities, revealing an early diffusive regime followed by a slow relaxation on times scaling as the square of the system size. We rigorously prove that depths growing almost quadratically with system size are required for the collision probability to converge. Finally, we show that ideal free-fermion sampling yields large linear cross-entropy scores, and propose a log-based benchmark with an exact fermionic normalization.
articles.abstract_zh: 对于Haar随机量子态，测量概率遵循普适的Porter-Thomas分布。本文推导了随机费米子高斯态（无论是否守恒粒子数）的Porter-Thomas定律的精确模拟。对于大系统，概率呈对数正态分布，其矩随系统大小呈多项式增长，表明自由费米子态的反集中性仅限于多项式因子。研究还展示了这种费米子Porter-Thomas定律如何在随机一维砖墙匹配门电路中出现，并证明了深度随系统大小几乎呈二次方增长才能实现碰撞。
authors: Guglielmo Lami

articles.title: Classical training of conditional instantaneous quantum polynomial-time Born machines
articles.title_zh: 条件瞬时量子多项式时间玻恩机器的经典训练
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05483v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Instantaneous quantum polynomial-time (IQP) Born machines are attractive quantum generative models, as certain IQP circuit families are conjectured to be hard to sample, yet they can be trained classically. Previously proposed conditional IQP Born machines make the parameters of the diagonal layer condition dependent. We introduce conditional IQP Born machines, in which the condition is encoded in the input state and a single IQP unitary is shared across conditions. Efficient sampling and amplitude-ratio evaluation for the reference state entering the diagonal layer suffice to obtain unbiased classical estimates of a conditional maximum mean discrepancy objective and its gradients. We show that input conditioning can represent conditional families that no diagonally conditioned IQP model with the same number of qubits can reproduce. For the sixteen-qubit Curie-Weiss spin model, a single conditional model captures the magnetization transition at held-out temperatures. Its mean total variation distance is six times lower than that of diagonal conditioning under the same protocol and comparable to that of classical generative models with up to seven times as many parameters. We also train conditional models classically with up to 2048 qubits, which reproduce the mean squared magnetization of the target away from the crossover. These results extend classically trained IQP Born machines to conditional generation.
articles.abstract_zh: 瞬时量子多项式时间（IQP）玻恩机器是吸引人的量子生成模型，尽管某些IQP电路族难以采样，但它们可以进行经典训练。本文引入了一种新的条件IQP玻恩机器，其中条件编码在输入状态中，并且单个IQP酉算子在不同条件之间共享。研究表明，输入条件可以表示具有相同量子比特数的对角条件IQP模型无法重现的条件族。对于十六量子比特的居里-魏斯自旋模型，该模型在捕获磁化转变方面表现出显著优势，其平均总变异距离远低于对角条件模型。
authors: Oriol Balló-Gimbernat, Emiliano Tolotti, Laia Domingo, Fernando Vilariño, Adan Garriga

articles.title: Krylov meets Fock: Complementary lenses on quantum dynamics
articles.title_zh: 克雷洛夫与福克相遇：量子动力学的互补视角
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05495v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum dynamics in Krylov space can be represented by a particle hopping on a chain whose sites are the Krylov basis vectors. The goal of this work is to extend this idea to the Fock basis, which in turn allows the description of a generic dynamics in terms of a more general, possibly higher-dimensional lattice. This construction has been dubbed the Fock state lattice (FSL), since its sites are identified with Fock states. To analyze the dynamics on the FSL we introduce various measures of the spread of a state, comparing them among themselves and with their Krylov counterparts. We apply our analysis to two models of light-matter interaction studied in quantum optics: the multi-mode Jaynes-Cummings and the Dicke models. We find that, whenever the FSL is not a chain, the corresponding dynamics provides insights complementary to the Krylov space analysis and, in some instances, greater analytical control. For example, we obtain analytical results for the FSL spread measures of the Dicke model in the thermodynamic limit and determine that their scaling in time detects the superradiant phase transition.
articles.abstract_zh: 克雷洛夫空间中的量子动力学可以表示为粒子在链上的跳跃。本文将这一思想扩展到福克基，从而允许用更一般的、可能更高维的晶格来描述通用动力学，称之为福克态晶格（FSL）。研究者引入了衡量状态扩散的各种FSL度量，并将其应用于多模Jaynes-Cummings和Dicke模型。结果表明，当FSL不是链时，其动力学分析提供了对克雷洛夫空间分析的补充洞察，并在某些情况下提供了更大的分析控制。
authors: Giuseppe Di Giulio, Dimitrios Patramanis

articles.title: From Claws to Conferences: Device-Independent Key Agreement Beyond Non-Signaling
articles.title_zh: 从“爪”到会议：超越非信号的设备无关密钥协商
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05509v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Device-independent conference key agreement (DI-CKA) allows a group of users to establish a common secret key without trusting the internal operation of their quantum devices. Existing DI-CKA protocols derive their security from multipartite Bell tests and therefore require the device components not to communicate during each round. We present, to the best of our knowledge, the first DI-CKA protocol that removes this non-signaling assumption: all interfaces and their mutual communication are treated as one untrusted device, which only has to be quantum polynomial-time while the protocol runs. Assuming that the Learning With Errors (LWE) problem is hard for quantum algorithms with quantum advice during the execution, we prove finite-size security against coherent attacks, in which the device may keep quantum memory and correlate and adapt its behavior across rounds. For two parties the protocol is a computational DI-QKD protocol with an explicit finite-size proof against coherent attacks. Technically, we lift the claw state underlying the classical-verifier test of Brakerski et al. (FOCS 2018) to multipartite entanglement, obtaining a emphGHZ-correlated claw state. %that is prepared with one coherent claw-free function evaluation and N-1 CNOT gates. We then introduce the emphcollective adaptive hardcore bit, a multiparty generalization of the adaptive hardcore bit of Brakerski et al. and show that it follows from the original property by a tight reduction. Combined with Jordan's lemma, an entropic uncertainty relation, and entropy accumulation, this certifies smooth min-entropy of the key against an external quantum adversary. Our protocol achieves empheverlasting security: LWE needs to hold only during the execution, because the final key is statistically secure and its secrecy persists even if LWE is broken after the protocol ends.
articles.abstract_zh: 设备无关会议密钥协商（DI-CKA）允许用户组在不信任其量子设备内部操作的情况下建立共享密钥。现有协议依赖多方贝尔测试，要求设备组件在每轮中不进行通信。本文提出了首个移除这一非信号假设的DI-CKA协议，将所有接口及其相互通信视为一个不受信任的设备。该协议在LWE问题对量子算法困难的假设下，证明了针对相干攻击的有限尺寸安全性。
authors: Suvradip Chakraborty

articles.title: Quantum theory of damping: A new approach to temporal evolution of density operator without the rotating wave approximation
articles.title_zh: 阻尼的量子理论：一种无需旋转波近似的密度算符时间演化新方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05537v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Lindblad master equation is the standard framework for describing dissipative dynamics of the open quantum system context. Its conventional derivation, however, relies on the rotating-wave approximation (RWA), which neglects the counter rotating terms in the system-reservoir interaction. Here, we derive a generalized Lindblad master equation beyond the RWA within the density operator formalism, retaining the full systemreservoir coupling. We consider two prototypical open quantum systems, a two-level atom and a single-mode quantized field, each interacting with thermal or squeezed reservoirs described by the Wigner-Weisskopf theory. The resulting master equations are applied to the evolution of representative physical observables and compared with the conventional RWA based formulation. We show that counter-rotating terms produce significant modifications to the dissipative dynamics and therefore cannot, in general, be neglected. For a thermal reservoir, increasing the mean thermal photon number, nth, enhances the decay of hσ^yi beyond the RWA but suppresses it within the RWA. Likewise, the evolution of hσ^zi exhibits opposite damping behavior with increasing Γt and squeezing parameter r. These findings demonstrate the importance of including counter rotating terms for an accurate description of open quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: Lindblad主方程是描述开放量子系统耗散动力学的标准框架，但其传统推导依赖于旋转波近似（RWA）。本文在密度算符形式下，推导了一个超越RWA的广义Lindblad主方程，保留了完整的系统-储层耦合。研究表明，反向旋转项对耗散动力学产生显著修改，通常不能忽略。对于热储层，增加平均热光子数会增强RWA之外的衰减，但在RWA之内则会抑制衰减。
authors: A. Marashi Nasab, E. Ghasemian, M. K. Tavassoly

articles.title: SPAM-robust learnability of quantum dynamics
articles.title_zh: 量子动力学的SPAM鲁棒可学习性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05561v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate characterization of quantum dynamics is essential for the calibration and control of quantum devices. Unknown state preparation and measurement (SPAM) errors, however, introduce gauge ambiguities that limit what can be learned. A central question is therefore which properties are learnable despite SPAM errors, and whether physical structure in the dynamics can restrict these ambiguities and expand the set of learnable properties. In this work, we address both questions within a unified framework for quantum channels and continuous-time evolution. First, for general quantum channels and Lindbladian dynamics, we use the cycle structure of a generalized pattern-transfer graph to fully characterize all learnable parameter combinations and show achievability by constructing explicit SPAM-robust learning protocols, establishing a baseline where continuous gauge freedom prevents many individual parameters from being identified. Second, we show that coherent structure drastically restricts this gauge ambiguity, reducing continuous gauge freedom to discrete or even trivial choices. This restriction manifests across both discrete- and continuous-time settings, including purely Hamiltonian evolution, noisy quantum channels close to a target unitary, and Lindbladian dynamics close to a target Hamiltonian. In particular, when the dynamics preserves or remains close to a coherent Hamiltonian form, all coherent coefficients and broad classes of dissipative error parameters become individually learnable. These results establish a systematic route to exploiting physical structure for SPAM-robust characterization, providing a foundation for the reliable calibration and control of quantum devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 准确表征量子动力学对于量子设备的校准和控制至关重要，但未知的SPAM误差引入了规范模糊性。本文在一个统一框架内研究了量子信道和连续时间演化中，哪些性质在SPAM误差下仍可学习以及物理结构如何限制这些模糊性。研究者利用广义模式转移图的循环结构，全面刻画了所有可学习的参数组合，并构建了明确的SPAM鲁棒学习协议。此外，研究还表明相干结构能显著限制这种规范模糊性，将其从连续自由度减少到离散甚至平凡的选择。
authors: Zitai Xu, Guoding Liu, Senrui Chen

articles.title: Quantum resource trade-offs of mixed sparse single and double factorization for qubitization-based phase estimation
articles.title_zh: 基于量子比特化的相位估计中混合稀疏单因子和双因子的量子资源权衡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05603v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a mixed block encoding of quantum-chemistry Hamiltonians for quantum phase estimation (QPE) on fault-tolerant quantum computers. Following a Cholesky decomposition of the electron repulsion integral tensor, we assign each Cholesky tensor to either a double-factorization (DF) branch or a sparse-single-factorization (SPSF) branch. This freedom permits a trade-off between reducing the block-encoding normalization factor łambda with DF and reducing the coefficient data loaded through quantum read-only memory (QROM) with SPSF. Resource estimates across molecular benchmarks show, however, that the mixed circuit does not generally reduce the Toffoli count relative to the less expensive pure circuit. The main obstacles are the overhead of loading substantial data through separate branch-specific QROMs and the limited benefit of mixing when the pure DF and SPSF circuits have dissimilar costs. Modest savings occur only in restricted parameter regimes, most clearly when logical-qubit requirements are included in the cost metric. These results identify the circuit-level conditions that a useful mixed block encoding must satisfy.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在容错量子计算机上进行量子相位估计（QPE）时，量子化学哈密顿量的混合块编码。通过对电子排斥积分张量进行Cholesky分解，研究者将每个Cholesky张量分配给双因子（DF）分支或稀疏单因子（SPSF）分支，以权衡块编码归一化因子和通过量子只读存储器（QROM）加载的系数数据。资源估算表明，混合电路通常不会相对于纯电路减少Toffoli门计数。研究结果指出了有用的混合块编码必须满足的电路级条件。
authors: Troy Losey, Jacob Z. Williams, Avanish Mishra, Jian-Xin Zhu, Yu Zhang

articles.title: A Study of Fluctuation Growths of Observables in Open Quantum Systems
articles.title_zh: 开放量子系统中可观测量的涨落增长研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05604v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rate at which quantum fluctuations of observables can change provides a useful characterization of the dynamical behavior of quantum systems. For closed quantum systems undergoing unitary evolution, previous work has established a general upper bound on the growth rate of the uncertainty of an observable in terms of the standard deviation of its dynamical velocity. This result is closely related to quantum acceleration limits and provides a compact constraint on fluctuation growth. In this work, we will briefly review the closed system results and extend this perspective to open quantum systems, where the state evolves nonunitarily as a consequence of interactions with an environment. The central result is an upper bound on the rate of growth of the uncertainty of an observable that remains valid for general density-matrix dynamics. We develop two complementary derivations. The first introduces a Hermitian pseudo-Hamiltonian describing the local unitary evolution of the eigenvectors of the density matrix. The second, and more general, derivation proceeds directly from the density-matrix derivative and therefore does not require knowledge of the generator of the dynamics. Both approaches lead to the same fluctuation-growth bound. An important practical advantage is that the bound can be evaluated from the observable, the state, and its time derivative without requiring reconstruction of the complete dynamical generator.
articles.abstract_zh: 可观测量的量子涨落变化率是表征量子系统动力学行为的有用指标。本文回顾了封闭量子系统的相关结果，并将其扩展到开放量子系统，其中状态因与环境相互作用而进行非酉演化。核心成果是可观测量不确定性增长率的上限，该上限适用于一般的密度矩阵动力学。研究提供了两种互补的推导方法，其中更通用的方法直接从密度矩阵导数出发，无需预先了解。
authors: Newshaw Bahreyni, Paul M. Alsing, Carlo Cafaro, Walid Redjem, Christian Corda

articles.title: Efficient training of a 128-modes 3D continuously coupled photonic chip via limited quantum resources
articles.title_zh: 通过有限量子资源高效训练128模三维连续耦合光子芯片
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05681v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Integrated photonics provides a promising route towards the development of large-scale, stable and low-loss quantum hardware. Existing implementations of universal quantum photonic chips generally rely on architectures consisting of localised interactions between the modes that can be programmed with known algorithms to implement specific operations. Recent advances have shown that interferometers based on 3D continuously coupled waveguide arrays may allow to significantly scale up the number of modes with reduced overhead. However, for this class of devices, optimal strategies to set the controllable parameters and obtain the desired transformation have not been demonstrated generally. In this work, we report the use of a machine learning algorithm driven by quantum data to program the operation of a reconfigurable three-dimensional continuously coupled photonic device comprising 128 modes. We show experimentally the capability of reaching a target unitary matrix, among those achievable by the device, through a limited number of one- and two-photon measurements. Our results demonstrate that this approach results to be effective in the presence of noise and with a limited amount of resources, also allowing to partially compensate imperfections in the experimental setup. This method can thus represent a viable route towards programming large scale integrated photonic devices, unlocking the possibility of controlling photonic systems for which an analytical decomposition is not trivial.
articles.abstract_zh: 集成光子学为开发大规模、稳定和低损耗量子硬件提供了有前景的途径。本文报告了利用量子数据驱动的机器学习算法，对一个包含128个模式的可重构三维连续耦合光子器件进行编程。实验结果表明，通过有限数量的单光子和双光子测量，该方法能够有效地使器件达到目标酉矩阵。这证明了该方法在高效训练复杂光子芯片方面的有效性。
