authors: Denis Stanev, Simone Di Micco, Francesco Hoch, Taira Giordani, Nicolò Spagnolo, Marco Gardina, Andrea Crespi, Francesco Ceccarelli, Roberto Osellame, Fabio Sciarrino

articles.title: Trinetra.Q: Statistical and Behavioral Detection of Attacks on the Quantum-Error-Correction Layer and Classical Control Stack of Quantum Computing Systems
articles.title_zh: Trinetra.Q：量子计算系统量子纠错层和经典控制堆栈攻击的统计与行为检测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05722v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Most quantum-computer security work targets physical-layer attacks on qubits, while two surfaces remain inadequately defended: the quantum-error-correction (QEC) syndrome-and-decoder pipeline, and the classical control and software stack that runs it. Tampering on these surfaces can corrupt a computation while the physical error rate appears normal, and can stay within a single-circuit integrity tolerance. We present Trinetra.Q, a detection layer of cooperating detectors, each monitoring a statistical or behavioral property of quantum-domain data against an envelope calibrated from honest operation, and raising an indication only on a statistically significant deviation. The detectors cover (A) QEC integrity over per-stabilizer firing rates, syndrome defect-count, and repeated-syndrome rate; (B) decoder confidence over the margin between minimum-weight error explanations in distinct logical classes; (C) behavioral output divergence, flagging crosstalk-class and novel attacks by their effect on a victim's output relative to a matched control; (D) control-stack tampering via known-answer canary circuits, built to be indistinguishable to a resident implant, with a cross-job consistency statistic; and (E) compilation/execution integrity. Each gates on significance, so honest operation raises no alarm. We evaluate in faithful simulation and on three production IBM Heron processors, and bound the physical attack surface with a systematic negative map: most physical-layer attacks return statistically null, the exception an implemented, measured within-job feed-forward covert-channel primitive. Every detector is also evaluated against an adaptive attacker with full knowledge of it. To our knowledge this is the first unified statistical-and-behavioral detection layer for the QEC layer and classical control stack of a quantum computing system, demonstrated on production hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 大多数量子计算机安全研究侧重于量子比特的物理层攻击，但量子纠错（QEC）综合征-解码器管道和运行它的经典控制与软件堆栈仍防御不足。本文提出了Trinetra.Q，一个由协同检测器组成的检测层，每个检测器根据正常操作校准的范围，监控量子域数据的统计或行为属性。这些检测器覆盖QEC完整性、解码器置信度、行为输出散度以及通过已知答案金丝雀电路进行的控制堆栈篡改，旨在识别对量子计算系统的潜在攻击。
authors: Garrv Sipani

articles.title: The most entangled states of four and seven qubits
articles.title_zh: 四比特和七比特的最纠缠态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05757v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pure states of four and seven qubits cannot be maximally entangled across every balanced bipartition; we determine how entangled they can be on average. For four qubits we prove the conjecture of Higuchi and Sudbery: the mean von Neumann entropy of the three 2|2 cuts is at most 1+tfrac12łog₂ 3 bits, with equality exactly on the local-unitary orbits of their state M₄ and its complex conjugate. For seven qubits the mean purity of the 35 balanced 3|4 cuts is at least 121/917 and their mean entropy is at most 2.965356029łdots bits, each with a unique optimiser up to local unitaries and qubit permutations. The two optimisers are distinct members of one icosahedral family, so minimum purity and maximum entropy select different states. The proofs bound moments of the marginal spectra by positive identities on several copies of the state, some of them spin flipped, and bound the entropy by a polynomial in those moments. The four-qubit maximum has an analytic proof; the seven-qubit proofs, and some of the four-qubit refinements below, are computer-assisted, with exact arithmetic and rigorous error bounds. We also prove the Gour--Wallach conjecture for Rényi entropies of all orders, with the maximiser changing from M₄ to cluster states at q_*approx1.588, and obtain sharp Tsallis bounds, mixed-state bounds and quantitative stability.
articles.abstract_zh: 纯粹的四比特和七比特态无法在每个平衡二分中实现最大纠缠，本文确定了它们平均纠缠的程度。对于四比特，作者证明了Higuchi和Sudbery的猜想，即三个2|2分割的平均冯诺依曼熵最大为1+tfrac12łog₂ 3比特。对于七比特，35个平衡3|4分割的平均纯度至少为121/917，平均熵最大为2.965356029比特。这些证明通过对态的多个副本（其中一些经过自旋翻转）上的正恒等式来限制边际谱的矩，并通过这些矩的多项式来限制熵。
authors: Antony Lewis

articles.title: Structural Lower Bounds for Quantum Property Estimation with Persistent Memory
articles.title_zh: 具有持久内存的量子性质估计的结构下界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05792v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In quantum property estimation, an experimenter estimates øperatornameTr(Oh̊o) for a family of observables from independent copies of an unknown state h̊o simultaneously to additive error ϵ. While quantum memory can dramatically reduce sample complexity, understanding the power of a modest register that remains coherent throughout an adaptive experiment has remained an open challenge because existing frameworks require optimizing over the infinite space of measurement trees. We overcome this barrier by developing a backward-induction framework based on operator resolvents. Rather than tracking path-dependent memory states across rounds, resolvent regularization cancels internal memory trajectories exactly, reducing the lower bound to an algebraic certificate computed directly from the target observables with sharp Ømega(1/ϵ²⁾ scaling. Our structural rule charges only the retained dimension K under arbitrary adaptive instruments and unrestricted memory lifetime. Via symmetry reductions, it yields polynomial-size linear programs that establish the optimal linear Ømega(D/(Kϵ²⁾⁾ trade-off for the D²⁻¹ Paulis, eliminating the cubic loss in prior bounds. For growing weight-w Pauli strings (w=łceilłog₂ nc̊eil) and quadratic Majorana cross-correlations, it proves lower bounds of Ømega(3^w/ϵ²⁾ and Ømega(n²/(ϵ²⁽¹⁺łn n)²⁾⁾ against an indefinitely persistent memory of dimension K=łfloorsqrt nf̊loor. These bounds match memoryless or commuting estimators within polylogarithmic factors, demonstrating that rank constraints on the persistent register fundamentally throttle observable overlap and prevent a modest coherent memory from overcoming the sample complexity barrier.
articles.abstract_zh: 在量子性质估计中，实验者需要从未知态的独立副本中同时估计一系列可观测量的迹。尽管量子内存可以显著降低样本复杂度，但理解在自适应实验中保持相干的适度寄存器的能力仍是一个开放挑战。本文通过开发基于算子预解式的逆向归纳框架克服了这一障碍，将下界简化为直接从目标可观测量计算的代数证书。该结构规则仅对保留维度K进行收费，并建立了D²⁻¹ Pauli算子的最优线性权衡。
authors: Ye Tao, Hong Shen

articles.title: Classical records and Bell correlations in a dynamically formed quantum body
articles.title_zh: 动态形成的量子体中的经典记录与贝尔关联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05826v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Competing quantum contacts can create a boundary that was absent from the specification of a subsystem. We construct approximately isolated bodies from bare field vacuum and zero-centred contact packets. A binding contribution with vanishing mean energy density nevertheless changes a bounded formation signal by order one at the same clock. On the formed material spins and their original memories, coarse collective records precede an all-outcome Bell violation. The field evolves dynamically, with the finite bath, residual boundary interaction, failed records and preparation costs retained. The result connects dynamical subsystem formation, classical collective records and microscopic nonlocality, with polynomial resources in the stated preparation and measurement class.
articles.abstract_zh: 竞争的量子接触可以创建一个子系统规范中不存在的边界。本文从裸场真空和零中心接触包构建了近似孤立的量子体。研究发现，在形成的物质自旋及其原始记忆上，粗略的集体记录先于所有结果的贝尔违背。该结果将动态子系统形成、经典集体记录和微观非局域性联系起来，并在给定的制备和测量类别中具有多项式资源。
authors: XinXin Qi, Hao Sun

articles.title: Efficiently tracking errors and outcomes in universal quantum circuits
articles.title_zh: 通用量子电路中错误和结果的高效跟踪
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05867v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a method for efficient simulation of error propagation and decoding in universal fault-tolerant quantum circuits under stochastic Pauli noise, requiring only that the circuit has a high fault distance and that all logical non-Clifford operations are implemented by physical T, CS and CCZ gates. This is achieved using modified Pauli frame-based error tracking in which the frame contains no logical information. Decoding success is identified by verifying that the Pauli frame is still logically trivial after decoding. Using the results of Ref. [1] and the observation that the distribution of non-logical measurement outcomes in the circuit is independent of the logical state, we show that we can accurately sample all detector outcomes. Our approach can also simulate circuits containing adaptive operations conditioned on logical measurements, provided these measurements have a known outcome distribution. This applies to the majority of adaptive operations such as state teleportation and preparation by measurement. Our method only detects decoding failures and so is consistent with complexity-theoretic expectations as it cannot be used to sample from the noiseless outcome distribution of the logical circuit.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种在随机泡利噪声下，高效模拟通用容错量子电路中错误传播和解码的方法。该方法通过修改后的基于泡利框架的错误跟踪实现，其中框架不包含逻辑信息。解码成功通过验证解码后泡利框架在逻辑上仍然是平凡的来识别。该方法还可以模拟包含基于逻辑测量的自适应操作的电路，并能准确采样所有探测器结果，但仅检测解码失败。
authors: Thomas R. Scruby, Julio C. Magdalena de la Fuente

articles.title: Hardware Demonstration of Neural-Surrogated Quantum-Enhanced MCMC for Large-Scale Constrained Boltzmann Sampling
articles.title_zh: 神经代理量子增强MCMC在大规模受限玻尔兹曼采样中的硬件演示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05883v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural-surrogated quantum-enhanced Markov chain Monte Carlo (QeMCMC) uses neural networks trained on samples from the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) to accelerate Boltzmann sampling. A divide-and-conquer strategy extends this approach to larger systems, but independently optimizing QAOA parameters for each subproblem is costly. In this paper, we develop a hardware-efficient implementation of neural-surrogated QeMCMC and demonstrate it using an IBM Quantum Heron r2 processor. Experiments with N=144 binary variables reveal faster autocorrelation decay for appropriate subproblem sizes while exposing challenges in neural-surrogate learning for larger blocks. We then extend the demonstration to a system with N=1064, where the autocorrelation decay rate per MCMC step is approximately 5.2 and 12.3 times those of global and local Kawasaki dynamics, respectively. These results demonstrate faster autocorrelation decay in a system exceeding one thousand variables using samples generated on quantum hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文开发了一种硬件高效的神经代理量子增强马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（QeMCMC）实现，并使用IBM Quantum Heron r2处理器进行了演示。该方法利用神经网络加速玻尔兹曼采样，并通过分治策略扩展到大规模系统。实验在N=144和N=1064的二元变量系统上进行，结果显示，与传统动力学相比，QeMCMC在量子硬件上生成的样本能显著加速自相关衰减，尤其是在超过一千个变量的系统中。
authors: Yuya Kawamata, Keisuke Fujii

articles.title: Algorithmic Wave-Particle Duality: Pathfinding in Welded Trees is Hard
articles.title_zh: 算法波粒二象性：在焊接树中寻找路径是困难的
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05912v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the welded trees problem, an algorithm navigates a randomly labeled graph formed from two binary trees joined at their leaves through a "weld" of connecting edges. A quantum walk can navigate from root to root exponentially faster than any classical algorithm. However, recording its path destroys the constructive interference responsible for the speedup, leaving open whether some quantum algorithm can efficiently find a path between the roots. We prove that, for trees of height n, the quantum query complexity of finding a path between the roots with constant probability is tildeΘ(2ⁿ/³). This establishes an algorithmic wave-particle duality, adapting the double-slit experiment to the high-complexity regime: interference between many paths lets a quantum algorithm reach the exit efficiently, but finding a single path (the algorithmic analog of the route of a particle) requires exponentially many queries. Furthermore, the bound is tight, matching the cost of a quantum algorithm that finds collisions between paths from each root to the weld. Our proof uses the compressed permutation oracle to track the information about the graph that an algorithm retains and forgets. We show that the compressed database remains close to a space of states that do not record a path between the roots by bounding the error introduced by each compressed oracle query.
articles.abstract_zh: 在焊接树问题中，量子游走可以指数级地快于经典算法从根节点导航到根节点。然而，记录路径会破坏加速所需的相长干涉。本文证明，对于高度为n的树，以恒定概率找到根之间路径的量子查询复杂度为~Θ(2ⁿ/³)。这确立了一种算法上的波粒二象性，表明量子算法通过多路径干涉可以高效到达出口，但找到单一路径则需要指数级的查询。
authors: Joseph Carolan, Andrew M. Childs, Matthew Coudron, Amin Shiraz Gilani, David Miloschewsky, Supartha Podder

articles.title: Rotated-Frame Determinant Discovery for Ground- and Excited-State Quantum Selected Configuration Interaction
articles.title_zh: 基态和激发态量子选择组态相互作用的旋转框架行列式发现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05941v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum Selected Configuration Interaction (QSCI) constructs a variational determinant space from measurements of a prepared electronic state, but finite-shot sampling can repeatedly observe high-probability determinants, limiting efficient discovery of configurations important for an accurate selected-CI description. We introduce rotate--sample--unrotate (RSU) determinant discovery, in which the same state is sampled in complementary orbital frames and the observed rotated determinants generate a finite set of candidates in the canonical basis. The Hamiltonian is then diagonalized in an orthonormal selected-CI space without enumerating the full determinant space. State-targeted orbital frames are constructed from an initial selected-CI wavefunction and its external residual. For excited states, we combine RSU with the generative quantum eigensolver (GQE) to prepare target-specific sampling states. Candidate GQE circuits are evaluated by classical selected-CI diagonalization in finite sampled spaces, so the quantum procedure requires only state preparation and determinant sampling. For N₂, exact-state controls isolate the determinant-discovery effect: at the stretched geometry, residual-natural-orbital RSU reaches chemical accuracy with 5,000 shots, compared with 20,000 shots for conventional QSCI. The improvement persists with approximate GQE-prepared states and is also observed for target excited states. These results demonstrate improved finite-shot determinant discovery in QSCI for both ground and excited states.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子选择组态相互作用（QSCI）通过测量制备的电子态来构建变分行列式空间，但有限次采样可能限制了重要组态的发现效率。本文引入了旋转-采样-反旋转（RSU）行列式发现方法，该方法在互补轨道框架中对同一状态进行采样，以生成规范基中的候选行列式。该方法将RSU与生成式量子本征求解器（GQE）结合用于激发态，仅需量子态制备和行列式采样。
authors: Yukihiro Okuno

articles.title: The Structure of Shared Classical Facts in Quantum Systems
articles.title_zh: 量子系统中共享经典事实的结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05955v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Perfectly matching local outcomes need not constitute a nondisturbing shared classical record. For finite-dimensional multipartite states, we prove that nontrivial exact records are equivalent to a spectrum sharing structure with a unique finest decomposition into locally distinguishable sectors, where entanglement may persist. For a fixed complete pointer, exact sharing is equivalent to strong quantum Darwinism together with global nondisturbance, while spectrum broadcast structure additionally requires conditional independence. Arbitrarily weak full-rank admixtures eliminate exact sharing, but two-sided distance bounds quantify robustness through disturbance and disagreement, while information bounds connect accurate local readouts to observer consensus.
articles.abstract_zh: 完美的局部结果匹配不一定构成无扰动的共享经典记录。本文证明，对于有限维多体态，非平凡的精确记录等价于具有独特最精细分解的谱共享结构，其中纠缠可能依然存在。对于固定的完整指针，精确共享等价于强量子达尔文主义和全局无扰动。研究还通过距离界限量化了鲁棒性，并通过信息界限将准确的局部读数与观察者共识联系起来。
authors: Jie Gu

articles.title: Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization via Density Matrix Renormalization Group
articles.title_zh: 基于样本的密度矩阵重整化群量子对角化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05975v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce SqDMRG, which combines sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD) with the density matrix renormalization group (DMRG). SqDMRG expands the sampled determinant space into a product of fragment spaces constructed from the samples, and solves the Hamiltonian in this product space using DMRG. We demonstrate the method on benzene pentamer and decamer clusters using classical reference samples, and on the pentamer using quantum samples obtained from the IBM Quantum Nighthawk r2 processor ibm phoenix. It achieves sub-kcal/mol accuracy with far fewer configurations than direct diagonalization.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了SqDMRG方法，它将基于样本的量子对角化（SQD）与密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）相结合。SqDMRG将采样的行列式空间扩展为由样本构建的片段空间的乘积，并利用DMRG在该乘积空间中求解哈密顿量。该方法在苯五聚体和十聚体簇上进行了演示，并使用IBM Quantum Nighthawk r2处理器获得的量子样本在五聚体上进行了验证。结果表明，该方法以远少于直接对角化的配置数量，实现了亚kcal/mol的精度。
authors: Yuto Sugimoto, Tomonori Shirakawa, Yukio Kawashima, Toshinari Itoko, Seiji Yunoki

articles.title: Quantum Key Exchange from Public Quantum Money
articles.title_zh: 基于公共量子货币的量子密钥交换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05985v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-message quantum key exchange (2QKE) cannot be realized in a statistically secure way, and therefore some computational assumptions are required. So far, the known weakest assumption for 2QKE is the existence of one-way functions (OWFs). Can we construct 2QKE from a weaker assumption than OWFs? In this paper, we give the first complete characterization of 2QKE. We show that the following four primitives are (existentially) equivalent: everlasting-secure 2QKE, standard 2QKE, efficiently-verifiable state puzzles (EV-StatePuzzs), and one-time secure digital signatures with quantum signatures and signing keys. Because EV-StatePuzzs are potentially weaker than OWFs [Kretschmer, Qian and Tal 2025], the equivalence implies that 2QKE are potentially weaker than OWFs. Moreover, our result shows the equivalence between standard 2QKE and everlasting-secure 2QKE, which means that everlasting security comes for free. Finally, one-shot signatures, quantum lightning, and public-key quantum money mini-schemes imply EV-StatePuzzs, and therefore, our result also gives a new lowerbound, namely everlasting-secure 2QKE, of these public-key unclonable primitives. We also show that one-shot signatures imply QPKE with quantum public keys. [Kitagawa, Morimae,Nishimaki and Yamakawa, 2024] constructed QPKE with quantum public keys from OWFs, and it was open whether QPKE with quantum public keys can be constructed from an assumption weaker than or incomparable to OWFs. Our result gives a potential answer to this question since one-shot signatures seem to be incomparable with OWFs. Moreover, QPKE constructed from one-shot signatures has an additional functionality, which we call certified freeze, that allows the receiver to publish a publicly verifiable classical certificate that computationally binds the receiver to an upper bound on the total number of distinct valid ciphertexts under its verification key.
articles.abstract_zh: 双消息量子密钥交换（2QKE）无法以统计安全的方式实现，因此需要计算假设。本文首次对2QKE进行了完整刻画，证明了永久安全2QKE、标准2QKE、可高效验证的状态谜题（EV-StatePuzzs）以及带量子签名和签名密钥的一次性安全数字签名这四种原语是等价的。由于EV-StatePuzzs可能弱于单向函数（OWFs），这表明2QKE的假设可能弱于OWFs。此外，研究还表明标准2QKE与永久安全2QKE等价，意味着永久安全性是免费获得的。
authors: Eli Goldin, Tomoyuki Morimae

articles.title: Shadow bootstrapping: Nearly minimal-setting pure-state tomography with shallow Clifford measurements
articles.title_zh: 影子自举：基于浅层Clifford测量的近最小设置纯态层析成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06073v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a pure-state tomography algorithm that uses a nearly minimal number of measurement settings while achieving optimal sample complexity with nonadaptive single-copy shallow Clifford measurements. For an arbitrary n-qubit pure state |ψångle in Cd, where d=2ⁿ, the algorithm uses O(d/ϵ) copies and widetildeO(1) measurement settings to output a state vector |hatψångle satisfying 1-|łangleψ|hatψångle|²łeϵ with high probability. Each measurement is implemented by a Clifford circuit of depth O(łog n). Reusing each measurement setting allows the data to be stored compactly as per-basis outcome histograms. Given these histograms, classical post-processing runs in widetildeO(d) time. Our key technique, shadow bootstrapping, uses the current estimate to reduce the variance of subsequent residual estimation, enabling progressively more accurate reconstruction with only a constant number of new measurement settings per stage.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种纯态层析成像算法，该算法使用接近最少数量的测量设置，并通过非自适应单拷贝浅层Clifford测量实现最优样本复杂度。对于任意n量子比特纯态，该算法使用O(d/ϵ)个拷贝和~O(1)个测量设置，以高概率输出满足精度要求的态矢量。其关键技术“影子自举”利用当前估计值来降低后续残差估计的方差，从而在每个阶段仅用恒定数量的新测量设置即可实现逐步更精确的重建。
authors: Gyungmin Cho, Dohun Kim

articles.title: A Post-Quantum Interactive Hashing Theorem
articles.title_zh: 一个后量子交互式哈希定理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06124v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interactive hashing, introduced by Ostrovsky, Venkatesan, and Yung [OVY93], is a building block in many cryptographic protocols, including perfectly hiding commitments from one-way permutations [NOVY92]. Its multi-output generalization is a key ingredient in constructions of statistical zero-knowledge arguments for NP and statistically hiding commitments from arbitrary one-way functions [NOV06,HR07]. In this note, we give a post-quantum security proof for this multi-output interactive hashing protocol with arbitrary relations.
articles.abstract_zh: 交互式哈希是许多密码协议中的基本组成部分，包括从单向置换构建完美隐藏承诺。其多输出泛化是构建NP的统计零知识论证和从任意单向函数构建统计隐藏承诺的关键要素。本文为具有任意关系的多输出交互式哈希协议提供了后量子安全性证明。
authors: Céline Chevalier, Laurent Holin, Quoc-Huy Vu

articles.title: Robust Geometric Gates for QCCD Architecture
articles.title_zh: QCCD架构的鲁棒几何门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06136v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The trapped-ion quantum charge-coupled device (QCCD) is a promising route toward scalable quantum computing. However, the frequency offset during shuttling operations introduce significant decoherence and control errors, severely degrading gate fidelity on transported ions. Here, using a room-temperature planar chip trap, we demonstrate a robust and universal single-qubit gate set in the QCCD architecture. Based on a recently proposed path-optimizable noncyclic geometric scheme, we show that dynamic noise is strongly suppressed even when multiple shuttling operations are interleaved with gate execution, achieving substantially higher fidelities than conventional dynamical gates. This robustness is further validated in a multi-ion system containing up to 33 qubits. With inherent robustness and adaptability to varying shuttle distances and ion numbers, our work offers a plug-and-play solution for building robust quantum primitives for the QCCD platform.
articles.abstract_zh: 囚禁离子量子电荷耦合器件（QCCD）是实现可扩展量子计算的有前景途径，但穿梭操作中的频率偏移会导致退相干和控制误差。本文利用室温平面芯片阱，在QCCD架构中演示了一组鲁棒且通用的单量子比特门。基于路径可优化的非循环几何方案，该方法即使在门执行与多次穿梭操作交错进行时也能有效抑制动态噪声，实现了比传统动态门更高的保真度。这项工作为QCCD平台构建鲁棒量子原语提供了即插即用的解决方案。
authors: Xin Zhang, Yi Tao, Hong Yang Wang, Gang Fan, Jie Zhang, Wei Wu, Ting Chen, Chun Wang Wu, Yi Xie, Ping Xing Chen

articles.title: Spatial Cost of Recovering a Fusion Qubit in a Critical Spin Chain
articles.title_zh: 临界自旋链中融合量子比特恢复的空间成本
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06215v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vanishing-error recovery of a fusion qubit from a fixed-sector ground doublet of four Kramers--Wannier defects in a critical Ising chain requires at least the shorter three-defect span of physical spins to leading order. Across arbitrary preselected spin sets and unrestricted joint decoding, this bound holds when the thermodynamic limit precedes large spacings at fixed positive ratios. An exact interval decoder attains it. Collective records of both logical axes in the complement force successful near-minimal supports to concentrate in density on a leading-order shortest interval.
articles.abstract_zh: 在临界伊辛链中，从四个Kramers-Wannier缺陷的固定扇区基态双重态中恢复融合量子比特，在领先阶需要至少三个缺陷中较短的物理自旋跨度。本文证明，在热力学极限先于固定正比率下的大间距时，该界限适用于任意预选自旋集和无限制联合解码。一个精确的区间解码器可以达到这个界限。
authors: Yi Liang

articles.title: Connection of surface code patches based on entanglement distillation without postselection
articles.title_zh: 基于无后选择纠缠蒸馏的表面码块连接
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06260v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Distributed quantum computing is a promising approach for overcoming the scalability limitations of fault-tolerant quantum computing. Entanglement distillation, a process that extracts higher-fidelity entangled states from noisy ones, plays a key role in distributed quantum computing. However, simple distillation protocols typically rely on postselection, which poses practical challenges for implementation. Here, we propose a scheme for distributed surface-code quantum computing that benefits from entanglement distillation even without postselection. Numerical simulations show that the logical error rates in the proposed scheme are lower than those in the setting without distillation. Additionally, we demonstrate that the logical error rates can be suppressed further by exploiting the asymmetry between spacelike and timelike errors in the surface code. The proposed scheme offers a practical and simple approach to distributed quantum computing with surface codes.
articles.abstract_zh: 分布式量子计算是克服容错量子计算可扩展性限制的有前景方法。纠缠蒸馏在其中扮演关键角色，但传统协议常依赖后选择。本文提出了一种无需后选择即可从纠缠蒸馏中获益的分布式表面码量子计算方案。数值模拟表明，该方案的逻辑错误率低于无蒸馏设置，并且通过利用表面码中类空间和类时间误差之间的不对称性可以进一步抑制错误率。
authors: Moeto Mishima, Toshihiko Sasaki, Yasunari Suzuki, Koji Azuma, Masato Koashi

articles.title: Improved Exact and Approximate Quantum Fourier Transforms from Multiplication
articles.title_zh: 基于乘法的改进精确和近似量子傅里叶变换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06341v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the world of quantum computing, quantum Fourier transform (QFT) has been one of the most important subroutines for quantum algorithms, as exemplified by Shor's factoring algorithms and phase estimation (which in itself has been used as a primitive in various quantum algorithms). In fact most of the well known quantum algorithms can be divided into two classes, QFT based algorithms and search based algorithms. The usual circuit for QFT (covered in almost every basic quantum algorithms course) needs O(q²⁾ gates (and O(q) qubits) to perform the exact Fourier transform over F₂^q. Cleve and Watrous (FOCS 2000) improved this gate count to O(q (łog q)² (łog łog q)) using the integer multiplication algorithm in O(n (łog n) (łog łog n)) time for two n-bit integers (best known at that time). Our first main result shows that this gate count can be improved to O(q (łog q)). In fact, if there is a multiplication circuit, to multiply two n-bit integers, with O(n (łog n)α) gates; we get a QFT circuit with O(q (łog q)α) gates (improving upon O(q (łog q)α ⁺ ¹)) gates from the construction of Cleve and Watrous). Given the recent claim by OpenAI about integer multiplication, this opens up the possibility of having a QFT circuit with o łeft( q (łog q)i̊ght) gates. On approximating the QFT over ZZ/(2^q ZZ), the result of Ahokas, Cleve and Hales (ERATO 2003) showed that an approximating circuit can be built with O łeft( q (łog łog(q/ǎrepsilon))α⁺¹ i̊ght) gates, where ϵ is the approximating parameter. Our second main result again improves this to O łeft( q (łog łog(q/ǎrepsilon))α i̊ght) gates.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子傅里叶变换（QFT）是量子算法中最重要的子程序之一。传统的QFT电路需要O(q²)个门，而Cleve和Watrous曾将其改进到O(q (log q)² (log log q))。本文的主要结果表明，QFT的门计数可以进一步改进到O(q log q)。具体而言，如果存在一个O(n (log n)α)门的n比特整数乘法电路，则可以得到一个O(q (log q)α)门的QFT电路，这显著优于现有构造。
authors: Chandrima Kayal, Rajat Mittal, Manaswi Paraashar, Nitin Saurabh

articles.title: Helium States in a CAS(2,2) Subspace Inspired by Quantum Photonics
articles.title_zh: 量子光子学启发的CAS(2,2)子空间中的氦原子态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06448v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a four-mode Fock-state photonics implementation of the variational quantum deflation (VQD) algorithm to calculate the ground-state and excited-state energies for the neutral helium atom in a CAS(2,2) Subspace. Its CAS(2,2) electronic Hilbert space is encoded into a bosonic Fock-space representation and subsequently optimized using a continuous-variable quantum circuit. The circuit architecture under study is constructed of single-mode phase shifts, beam splitters, and cross-Kerr interactions. The variational circuit is initialized in the Fock state ket1100 and its performance is benchmarked against exact diagonalization of the active-space configuration-interaction (CASCI) Hamiltonian. We also extend the method to optimize from the first to three excited states of the helium atom with the aid of the variational quantum deflation (VQD) method in a CAS(2,2). We then investigate the performance of this circuit architecture as a basis for implementing the VQD method. In the ideal noiseless simulation setting, we see that the survival probability of the ground and the excited states within the target CAS subspace is unity, because the total photon number and the photon number in the two spin sectors α and β are preserved. We demonstrate that the proposed approach enables the determination of the ground and excited-state energies within the CAS(2,2) electronic Hilbert space using a continuous-variable quantum circuit and the variational quantum deflation (VQD) algorithm, while satisfying the orthogonality conditions with negligible errors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种四模福克态光子学实现变分量子紧缩(VQD)算法的方法，用于计算CAS(2,2)子空间中中性氦原子的基态和激发态能量。该方法将电子希尔伯特空间编码为玻色福克空间表示，并通过连续变量量子电路进行优化。研究结果表明，在理想无噪声模拟环境下，基态和激发态在目标CAS子空间中的存活概率为1。
authors: Forouzan Mirmasoudi, Badie Ghavami

articles.title: A Variational Quantum Algorithm for Multi-Skill Project Scheduling
articles.title_zh: 一种用于多技能项目调度的变分量子算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06502v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Job scheduling is an NP-hard optimization problem with clear industrial relevance. In practice, distributing work across a team is not only about meeting deadlines or improving productivity; it also affects fatigue, stress, and employee well-being. Variational Quantum Algorithms (VQAs) provide a promising way to address these problems through QUBO formulations, although their scalability on near-term NISQ hardware is still limited by Hilbert-space growth and barren plateaus. In this work, we simulate a VQA for a realistic Multi-Skill Resource-Constrained Project Scheduling Problem (MS-RCPSP), including worker capacities, skill matrices, task priorities, deadlines, and calendar stability during rescheduling. To keep the problem within a near-term circuit size, we use a temporal batch decomposition that solves one day at a time, propagates the remaining workload, and combines it with a logarithmic binary encoding that keeps every batch at or below 30 qubits. Because the ground state of a QUBO Hamiltonian is a computational basis state, entanglement is not required to represent the solution, raising the question of whether it helps or hinders ansatz training. We address this question by comparing the linear and brick-wall entangling topologies of a hardware-efficient ansatz with an entanglement-free reference that has the same number of parameters and by training every configuration with COBYLA and with Adam using SPSA gradient estimation. For the instance and initialization studied, the entanglement-free reference produced feasible schedules under both optimizers. With COBYLA, it produced the feasible schedule closest to the required workload at a fraction of the simulation cost of the entangled topologies, indicating that entanglement did not improve the solutions found by the VQA.
articles.abstract_zh: 项目调度是一个具有工业相关性的NP-hard优化问题。本文模拟了一种变分量子算法（VQA），用于解决现实的多技能资源受限项目调度问题（MS-RCPSP）。为适应近期NISQ硬件的限制，研究采用了时间批处理分解和对数二进制编码，将每个批次的问题规模控制在30个量子比特以内。该工作探讨了VQA在解决复杂调度问题中的潜力。
authors: Raul Martinez, Miguel Sánchez-Beato, Matilde Osa, Jorge Parra, Mario Calonge

articles.title: Equivalence of Correlated Catalytic and Marginal Asymptotic Transformations in Quantum Resource Theories
articles.title_zh: 量子资源理论中关联催化与边际渐近变换的等价性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06573v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We prove that correlated-catalytic state conversion is possible if and only if the marginal asymptotic conversion rate is at least one. Under general operational assumptions, this equivalence holds for arbitrary states in broad classes of entanglement, coherence, and magic theories. It reduces the characterization of correlated-catalytic convertibility to the computation of marginal asymptotic rates, and yields transitivity and equality of catalytic and marginal conversion rates. Under local operations and classical communication, we fully characterize correlated-catalytic conversion from arbitrary bipartite states to entangled pure states in terms of distillable entanglement. We show that correlated catalysts cannot increase the distillable entanglement or distillable secret key of any bipartite state, and in particular cannot make bound entanglement distillable. Extending our construction to adaptive communication protocols, we further prove that correlated catalysts cannot enhance the two-way private-state generation capacity of any finite-dimensional quantum channel.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了关联催化态转换的实现当且仅当边际渐近转换率至少为1。在一般操作假设下，这一等价性适用于纠缠、相干和魔力理论中广泛类别的任意态。研究还表明，关联催化剂不能增加任何双粒子态的可蒸馏纠缠或可蒸馏密钥，也不能增强任何有限维量子信道的双向私有态生成能力。
authors: Jingsong Ao, Aby Philip, Alexander Streltsov

articles.title: Compatibility of Pauli Observables
articles.title_zh: 泡利可观测量量的兼容性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06592v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Given an arbitrary finite family of Pauli observables, how sharply can they be approximated by a single measurement? We derive an exact state-space correspondence that characterises the resulting sharpness tradeoffs, establishing a link between incompatibility and preparation uncertainty. In particular, suitable ensembles of quantum states determine the full compatibility region and generate explicit parent measurements through Pauli conjugation and classical randomisation. The compatibility region depends only on the anti-commutativity graph and determines all nonuniform tradeoffs under standard noise models, including depolarising, probabilistic and generalised noise. We show that optimal sharpness tradeoffs are determined by spectral problems for signed Pauli Hamiltonians, whose ground states supply the seeds for optimal parent measurements. The correspondence also shows that magic is necessary to attain the full compatibility region of every noncommuting Pauli family. We quantify the resulting sharpness advantage and relate it to the reduced robustness of magic. Finally, we apply the framework to several structured Pauli families, obtaining exact compatibility characterisations and explicit optimal parents.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了任意有限族泡利可观测量如何通过单一测量被精确近似的问题。研究推导了一个精确的状态空间对应关系，表征了由此产生的锐度权衡，并建立了不兼容性与制备不确定性之间的联系。结果表明，最优锐度权衡由带符号泡利哈密顿量的谱问题决定，其基态为最优父测量提供了基础。该框架还被应用于多种结构化的泡利族。
authors: Daniel McNulty, Paolo Facchi, Saverio Pascazio

articles.title: Noise-regularized training of quantum circuit Born machines under a finite shot budget
articles.title_zh: 有限测量预算下量子电路玻恩机器的噪声正则化训练
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06630v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum circuit Born machines (QCBMs) can learn distributions that are hard to sample from classically, but their value depends on generalizing from finite training data. Here, we study how hardware noise affects this generalization. We show that, for any noise process, the generalization gap of a QCBM trained with the maximum mean discrepancy is bounded by the complexity of the distributions the noisy model can reach. Scrambled local Pauli noise contracts this complexity but biases the model towards the uniform distribution, so residual noise acts as a regularizer whose optimal strength can be intermediate. We propose GENIE, a framework that realizes a chosen noise level with capped error mitigation and selects it during training from held-out data within a fixed execution budget, with provably bounded regret. In simulations on synthetic and census data, GENIE stays close to the best of four noise-control strategies, whereas every fixed noise level falls short in many settings.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子电路玻恩机器（QCBMs）能够学习经典难以采样的分布，但其泛化能力受限于有限训练数据和硬件噪声。本文研究了硬件噪声如何影响QCBM的泛化性能，并提出GENIE框架。该框架在有限执行预算内，通过有上限的误差缓解实现选定的噪声水平，并从保留数据中进行训练选择。模拟结果显示，GENIE在多种设置下表现接近最佳噪声控制策略。
authors: Hoang M. Ngo, Quan Nguyen, Jung Taek Seo, Wanli Xing, My T. Thai

articles.title: Efficient quantum ultraspherical transform and a well-conditioned quantum spectral method
articles.title_zh: 高效量子超球面变换与良条件量子谱方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06651v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Solving differential equations is a promising application of quantum computing. Spectral methods, where the solution is represented by coefficients in a basis, are particularly well suited to quantum solvers because their structured discretizations can enable efficient linear-algebra operations while providing rapid convergence. Their quantum implementation, however, requires an efficient transform between amplitudes encoding function values and amplitudes encoding expansion coefficients. This work develops two key components of a quantum spectral method. First, we construct the quantum ultraspherical transform (QUT) for orthonormal ultraspherical polynomials, a basis that supports sparse and well-conditioned discretizations of differential equations. For the basis parameters m=0 and 1, this transform reduces to the discrete cosine and sine transforms with known efficient circuits. Our contribution covers every fixed integer m≥2: for dimensions N with N+m=2ⁿ, where n is the number of qubits, the QUT achieves error at most ǎrepsilon using a gate count polynomial in n and łog(1/ǎrepsilon). The construction builds on the quantum Fourier transform, augmented by approximations whose accuracy guarantees are independent of N. Second, we develop a quantum spectral solver for regular linear ordinary differential equations based on the QUT. Under suitable boundary conditions and data-access assumptions, preconditioning keeps condition numbers bounded independently of the basis size, allowing the solution state to be prepared at polylogarithmic cost in system size and inverse error. Together, these contributions provide a framework for quantum spectral methods with the potential to solve linear differential equations efficiently.
articles.abstract_zh: 求解微分方程是量子计算的一个重要应用。本文开发了量子谱方法的两个关键组件：量子超球面变换（QUT）和良条件量子谱方法。QUT针对正交超球面多项式构建，该基底支持微分方程的稀疏和良条件离散化。对于固定的整数m≥2，当维度N满足N+m=2ⁿ时，QUT能够以多项式门计数实现高精度。
authors: Trong Duong, Norbert Hosters

articles.title: Flux Crosstalk Calibration from Zero Knowledge to High Precision in Fully Tunable Superconducting Circuits
articles.title_zh: 全可调超导电路中从零知识到高精度的磁通串扰校准
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06656v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Precise and independent flux control is essential for scalable superconducting processors built from frequency-tunable qubits and couplers, but flux crosstalk undermines it. Conventional calibration methods rely either on dedicated readout channels, which tunable couplers typically lack, or on readout schemes requiring extensive prior spectroscopy of the qubit and coupler. We demonstrate two independent methods that characterize coupler flux crosstalk without directly driving or measuring the couplers. The first method is zero-knowledge characterization, which exploits intrinsic coupler-resonator coupling to yield rapid and accurate estimates with no prior qubit or coupler spectroscopy, accelerating large scale bring-up. The second method is symmetric branch cancellation, which isolates crosstalk from other dispersive effects allowing for quantifying with high precision. Combined with an improved iterative procedure, these methods suppress residual coupler crosstalk below 5×10⁻⁵, providing a complete route from zero-knowledge initialization to high-precision crosstalk characterization in fully tunable architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 精确且独立的磁通控制对于可扩展超导处理器至关重要，但磁通串扰会对其造成影响。本文展示了两种独立的方法，无需直接驱动或测量耦合器即可表征耦合器磁通串扰。零知识表征方法利用固有的耦合器-谐振器耦合实现快速准确的估计，而对称分支抵消方法则能高精度量化串扰。这些方法结合改进的迭代程序，可将残余耦合器串扰抑制至5×10⁻⁵以下。
authors: Y. Gao, A. Galicia, J. R. Guimarães, Y. Haddad, Y. Liu, J. Cereijo, D. A. Volkov, H. Bhardwaj, M. Neis, M. Jerger, P. A. Bushev, R. Barends

articles.title: QASPA-MaxCut on Unweighted Graphs: Edge Encoding and QAOA Restarts
articles.title_zh: 无权图上的QASPA-MaxCut：边编码与QAOA重启
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06698v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Max-Cut is a common testbed for near-term quantum optimization because it has a simple Ising Hamiltonian, established classical baselines, and a parameterized quantum circuit whose performance depends on the outer classical optimizer. This paper develops QASPA-MaxCut, a shift-phase circuit for Max-Cut that encodes graph edges through controlled R_y rotations of the form CXᵢⱼR_y(θᵢⱼ)CXᵢⱼ. We derive the exact two-qubit algebra of the edge block, trace an unweighted four-vertex example, and compare one-layer QASPA-MaxCut with depth-one QAOA by exact state-vector simulation. The protocol uses seed 42, evaluates connected backbone-augmented random graphs with additional-edge probabilities pₑdgₑin0.1,0.3,0.5,0.7, and adds nineteen custom unweighted topologies. The QASPA-MaxCut score is reported after the algorithm's classical selection stage: the four leading QASPA bit strings are evaluated by the Max-Cut objective, and the best cut is retained. The QAOA score is the expected approximation ratio after local optimization, reported as a best-of-k curve over one to ten restarts. In these small exact simulations, fixed-angle QASPA-MaxCut produces reported group-mean selection ratios between 0.955 and 1.000, the topology-level readout is unchanged in the retained finite-shot checks under the rule łceil 0.03047ḑot 2ⁿ⁺¹⁰¹⁶.2c̊eil, and depth-one QAOA improves with additional classical restarts while remaining lower than the QASPA selection score in the reported mean summaries. This comparison motivates further study of the classical search budget needed to obtain competitive Max-Cut samples at shallow circuit depth.
articles.abstract_zh: Max-Cut问题是近期量子优化的常见测试平台。本文开发了QASPA-MaxCut，一种用于Max-Cut的移相电路，通过受控R_y旋转编码图的边。研究推导了边块的精确双量子比特代数，并通过精确态矢量模拟将一层QASPA-MaxCut与深度为一的QAOA进行了比较。在小规模精确模拟中，固定角度的QASPA-MaxCut表现出良好的性能。
authors: Dmytro Sapozhnyk

articles.title: Phase-Locked Quantum Battery Charging via Dissipative Mode Selection
articles.title_zh: 基于耗散模式选择的锁相量子电池充电
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06712v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate how dynamical instability and reservoir engineering can be harnessed to enhance the quality of quantum-battery charging in a bosonic two-mode system. We show that reservoir-engineered dissipative coupling selectively amplifies a single unstable quasi-dark mode, enabling phase-locked exponential charging at a reduced gain threshold, whereas coherent coupling can amplify two frequency-split unstable modes, resulting in persistent beating. This dissipative mode selection yields a near-unit ergotropy fraction and a substantially higher work-like signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), defined as ergotropy divided by the standard deviation of battery energy. Although optimizing the driving frequency enables coherent coupling to achieve faster charging and higher ergotropy power, dissipative coupling retains its advantage in the work-like SNR. An exact finite-time source-noise relation reveals that this advantage arises from a more constructive accumulation of coherent driving relative to incoherent fluctuations. Our results establish dissipative mode selection as a promising route to high-quality quantum-battery charging.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了如何利用动力学不稳定性与储层工程来提升玻色双模系统中量子电池充电的质量。研究表明，储层工程耗散耦合能选择性地放大单个不稳定的准暗模式，实现锁相指数充电，并产生接近单位的能量提取分数和显著更高的类功信噪比。尽管相干耦合能实现更快的充电，但耗散耦合在类功信噪比方面保持优势，为高质量量子电池充电提供了新途径。
authors: Borhan Ahmadi, Lei Du, André H. A. Malavazi, Shabir Barzanjeh, Adam Miranowicz, Paweł Horodecki

articles.title: Solving a non-abelian hidden subgroup problem on a trapped-ion quantum computer: the power of the measurement basis
articles.title_zh: 在离子阱量子计算机上解决非阿贝尔隐藏子群问题：测量基的威力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06716v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The hidden subgroup problem (HSP) unifies many of the best-known quantum speed-ups. For abelian groups it is solved efficiently by weak Fourier sampling, but for non-abelian groups, which include the cases relevant to graph isomorphism and lattice-based cryptography, the right measurement basis is crucial and often unknown. We experimentally study the HSP over the q-hedral groups Z_q łtimes Zₚ, which interpolate between the dihedral and affine groups and mark a boundary between instances that are efficiently solvable and those that are only information-theoretically solvable. On the IonQ Forte trapped-ion quantum computer, with p łe 7, we implement weak Fourier sampling, strong Fourier sampling in an adapted basis, strong Fourier sampling of adjacent pairs, and forgetful abelian sampling. We demonstrate that the theoretical predictions of Moore, Rockmore, Russell and Schulman survive on a noisy device: weak sampling reveals nothing about the hidden subgroup, the adapted basis succeeds for large q, adjacent pairs succeed for small q, and forgetful sampling saturates below unit success. For p=7, q=6, the hardware exceeds the success probability of an exhaustively optimised classical algorithm for up to three oracle queries.
articles.abstract_zh: 隐藏子群问题（HSP）是许多量子加速的基础。本文在IonQ Forte离子阱量子计算机上，实验研究了q-hedral群上的HSP，该群介于二面体群和仿射群之间。研究实现了弱傅里叶采样、适应基下的强傅里叶采样、相邻对的强傅里叶采样以及遗忘阿贝尔采样。结果表明，理论预测在噪声设备上依然成立，并验证了不同测量基对HSP求解效率的影响。
authors: Oliver O'Brien

articles.title: A Quantum Lower Bound for Triangle Finding
articles.title_zh: 三角形查找的量子下界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06751v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Triangle finding is a fundamental problem in graph theory that has played a central role in the development of quantum algorithmic techniques. For N-vertex graphs given by their adjacency matrices, a long line of work has improved the quantum query upper bound from O(N³/²) to O(N⁵/⁴). However, the best known lower bound has remained the elementary Ømega(N) bound obtained from unstructured search. We prove the first superlinear quantum query lower bound for triangle finding, showing that Ømega(N¹³/¹²) queries are necessary. Our result also implies the same lower bound for triangle detection and for detecting every fixed connected non-bipartite graph. The proof builds on the compressed oracle approach of Zhandry and the transfer approaches of Belovs. It compares the computation on graphs with a planted triangle to the computation on random graphs conditioned to be triangle-free, through a map on the input registers that almost commutes with every query. We average over local changes to the input while preserving its distribution, through a procedure known as conditional resampling. Our main technical contribution is a set of estimates that let us control the query error under this averaging, despite the dependence introduced by conditioning a dense graph to be triangle-free.
articles.abstract_zh: 三角形查找是图论中的一个基本问题，在量子算法技术发展中扮演了核心角色。本文首次证明了三角形查找的超线性量子查询下界，表明需要Ω(N¹³/¹²)次查询。这一结果也适用于三角形检测和检测每个固定的连通非二分图。该证明基于Zhandry的压缩预言机方法和Belovs的转移方法。
authors: Arjan Cornelissen, Amin Shiraz Gilani, Xingyu Zhou

articles.title: Near-Quantum-Limited Readout for the Princeton Axion Search using a sub-GHz Kinetic Inductance Traveling Wave Parametric Amplifier
articles.title_zh: 普林斯顿轴子搜索中基于亚GHz动能电感行波参量放大器的近量子极限读出
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06761v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Parametric amplifiers are a workhorse for near-quantum-limited measurements above 1 GHz. However, amplifier development has been more limited below 1 GHz. We present a kinetic inductance traveling-wave parametric amplifier (KI-TWPA) operating over 300-700 MHz, with gain exceeding 30 dB and pump powers of a few hundred nanowatts. The system noise performance, as measured by a variable-temperature noise source, is 2.5-3.5 quanta. This device is a versatile new tool for precision measurements of sub-GHz signals, with applications including readout of semiconductor spin qubits, superconducting detector arrays, and searches for new physics beyond the Standard Model. We characterize aspects of the amplifier performance relevant to axion searches, including gain drift, compression point, amplifier noise at various operating temperatures, readout with an input circulator, and magnetic field insensitivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 参量放大器是1 GHz以上近量子极限测量的关键工具，但在亚GHz频率范围内的发展受限。本文介绍了一种工作在300-700 MHz范围内的动能电感行波参量放大器（KI-TWPA），其增益超过30 dB，系统噪声性能为2.5-3.5量子。该设备为亚GHz信号的精密测量提供了多功能新工具，在半导体自旋量子比特读出和轴子搜索等领域具有应用潜力。
authors: Joe Wiedemann, Roman Kolevatov, Jianyang Fu, Joelle-Marie Begin, Nate Otto, Felix St-Amour, Lyman Page, Henry LeDuc, Peter Day, Saptarshi Chaudhuri

articles.title: Entanglement Entropy in Non Relativistic Collisions
articles.title_zh: 非相对论碰撞中的纠缠熵
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06774v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study numerically the build-up of entanglement entropy between two colliding, non relativistic particles, that are driven by the plain Schrödinger equation containing local, finite range potentials, and whose initial state is the product of two independent wave packets. Different situations are considered, ranging from a tunnel and mirror effect at low energy in front of a barrier, to higher energies, and also attraction rather than repulsion. While the calculated wave functions and density matrices significantly depend on the physical situations described by our models, the build-up trends and values in time of entanglement entropy look surprisingly alike one another.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文数值研究了由薛定谔方程驱动的两个非相对论粒子在碰撞过程中纠缠熵的演化。研究考虑了不同物理场景，包括低能下的隧道效应和镜面效应、高能情况以及吸引或排斥相互作用。尽管计算出的波函数和密度矩阵显著依赖于具体物理模型，但纠缠熵随时间的演化趋势和数值表现出惊人的一致性。
authors: Bertrand Giraud (IPhT Saclay), Robi Peschanski (IPhT Saclay)

articles.title: Resource-efficient formulations of the Knapsack problem for quantum computing
articles.title_zh: 量子计算中背包问题的资源高效QUBO表述
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06797v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum computing has emerged as a new tool for solving combinatorial optimization problems. Quantum optimization approaches usually operate on the subclass of Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) problems. Many optimization problems can be reformulated in this form, though there are often multiple ways to do so. The choice of formulation can considerably affect the performance of QUBO solvers in practice. In this work, we study QUBO formulations of the Knapsack problem, a canonical example of a problem with inequality constraints. In the standard formulation these constraints are converted into penalty terms, which requires additional slack variables. Here, we investigate three more resource-efficient approaches for formulating the Knapsack as a QUBO. The first two modify the standard formulation, either by deriving a smaller penalty constant or by reducing the number of slack variables. The third approach is a wholly different method, which avoids the use of slack variables entirely. All three approaches increase the probability of finding the optimal solution, both in simulations of the linear ramp Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (LR-QAOA) and on a D-Wave quantum annealer. The slackless method performs best, increasing success probabilities by several orders of magnitude even for relatively small problem sizes.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子计算为组合优化问题提供了新工具，通常通过二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）形式解决。本文研究了背包问题在量子计算中的QUBO表述，该问题包含不等式约束。针对标准表述中引入松弛变量和惩罚项的资源消耗，作者提出了三种更资源高效的QUBO表述方法，旨在提高找到最优解的概率。
authors: Pim van den Heuvel, Vrinda Mehta, Dennis Willsch, J. A. Montanez-Barrera, Kristel Michielsen

articles.title: Finite-temperature transition-window weights on a fault-tolerant quantum computer: duplex filtering on a thermal purification
articles.title_zh: 容错量子计算机上的有限温度跃迁窗口权重：热纯化上的双工滤波
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06809v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The excite-filter-readout framework of Kharazi et al. computes zero-temperature response windows on a fault-tolerant quantum computer from a pure ground state. We extend it to Gibbs states, where the two objects decouple: filters act on absolute energies, a thermal response on transition frequencies. The extension rests on a Liouville-space/TFD identity, explicit in the block-encoding/QSP setting: the thermally weighted transition-window weight is a spectral projection of H₀ (x) I - I (x) H₀^T onto the Schmidt (thermofield-double) purification, instance of Rall's framework. Around it we assemble a routed-SELECT block encoding (one Hamiltonian query per filter query), a conjugate-pair readout, and a four-route (duplex, bin, Fourier-LCU, METTS) compatibility analysis. The cost is multiplicative and conditional: a per-window query bound M_"AE" * (2*sqrt(d/Z_"lb")*d_"vt" + 4*d_W), with a tight signal-adaptive count, the optimal sqrt(alpha beta) degree, and a window-edge term. The preparation factor sqrt(d/Z) grows exponentially with system size at fixed temperature in positive-entropy-density systems (2.08 -> 25.7, N = 8 to 14 at beta = 2), relieved only as beta -> 0. Zero temperature is recovered for beta G >= ln(2(d-1)||D||²/epsilon). Identities are cross-checked between independent formula paths to 10⁽⁻¹⁶⁾⁻¹⁰⁽⁻¹²⁾ and the readout assembly is validated at matrix level under a block-encoding promise.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将Kharazi等人提出的零温度激发-滤波-读出框架扩展到吉布斯态，以在容错量子计算机上计算有限温度下的响应窗口。该扩展基于Liouville空间/热场双态（TFD）恒等式，将热加权跃迁窗口权重表示为哈密顿量在Schmidt纯化上的谱投影。研究还给出了每窗口查询的成本界限，并指出制备因子随系统尺寸呈指数增长。
authors: Yujin Tang, Yunlong Liu, Miao Xu, Qing-Xing Xie

articles.title: Linear-time erasure recovery for quantum expander codes
articles.title_zh: 量子扩展码的线性时间擦除恢复
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06818v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Erasures are used to model faults at a subset of known locations in various platforms used to construct fault-tolerant quantum computers. Beyond the utility in erasure recovery, efficient decoders for erasures are useful to both understand error decoders and as a subroutine for error decoding. Classical expander codes, which belong to the family of low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes, can be equipped with the Peeling decoder which works in linear time. Our main result is the algorithm Small-Set-Peeling, a quantum generalization of the classical Peeling decoder for erasures, that applies to quantum expander codes (Tillich, Zémor, IEEE T-IT 2013; Leverrier, Tillich, Zémor, FOCS 2015). This decoder can correct up to D-1 erasures, where D is the (design) distance of the code and, importantly, is the first decoder that is guaranteed to do so in linear time. Combining with the erasure-conversion algorithm Small-Set-Find (Krishna, Livni-Navon, Wootters, SODA 2024), our result also implies the existence of a novel graph-local linear-time decoder for Pauli errors.
articles.abstract_zh: 擦除是容错量子计算机中建模已知位置故障的常见方式。本文提出了Small-Set-Peeling算法，这是经典Peeling解码器在量子擦除恢复上的推广，适用于量子扩展码。该解码器能够纠正多达D-1个擦除，并且是首个保证在线性时间内完成此任务的解码器。结合擦除转换算法，该工作还暗示了一种新颖的图局部线性时间Pauli错误解码器的存在。
authors: Anirudh Krishna, Christopher A. Pattison

articles.title: GFlowQEC: Generative Flow Networks that Learn to Sample Quantum LDPC Codes
articles.title_zh: GFlowQEC：学习采样量子LDPC码的生成流网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06819v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Choosing a quantum error-correcting code for a real device means scoring candidates with circuit-level simulations so slow that only a few hundred can be run. So every evaluation counts, and a search is judged by how many good codes it finds per paid evaluation. Quantum LDPC codes built from a few group elements protect many logical qubits, but good ones are rare in a huge space. We introduce GFlowQEC, to our knowledge the first generative flow network (GFlowNet) for quantum code design. It builds a code one group element at a time and learns to propose codes in proportion to a power of their score. We train it once on scores from earlier searches, freeze it, and let it propose lifted-product codes with 180 physical qubits, scored by their distances. Ranking ten of its draws per paid call, it finds more than twice as many new top-scoring codes (inequivalent to any it was trained on) as tuned parallel tempering, even when tempering starts from GFlowQEC's training codes. It finds more than three and a half times as many as a supervised screen ranking ten random candidates per call. When both rank a hundred, the screen beats GFlowQEC, and does best ranking GFlowQEC's draws. Soft Q-learning, which shares the GFlowNet's optimal policy, does as well at one noise bias and better at the other, so the gain does not depend on the GFlowNet's training loss. Trained proposers can make a budget of expensive evaluations go further when good codes are rare.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子纠错码的设计面临候选码评估耗时的问题。本文引入了GFlowQEC，这是首个用于量子码设计的生成流网络（GFlowNet），它通过一次一个群元素的方式构建代码，并学习根据代码得分的幂次比例提出候选码。GFlowQEC在寻找具有180个物理量子比特的优异提升积码方面表现出色，其效率远超调优的并行退火和监督筛选方法。
authors: Nuno Batista, Gabriel Falcao, Penousal Machado

articles.title: Quantum Algorithms for Molecular Response Functions: Resolvent Kernels, Time-Domain Sampling, Query Lower Bounds with Matched Single-Point Calibers, and a Six-Route Comparison
articles.title_zh: 分子响应函数的量子算法：解算核、时域采样、匹配单点校准的查询下界及六种路径比较
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06821v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum algorithms for molecular response functions have mostly been studied one route at a time, most prominently the indicator-binning algorithm of Kharazi et al. We compare six routes within one accounting framework and state the conversions between their resource calibers. On the resolvent route the Lorentz-broadened spectrum is exactly a resolvent expectation; at finite gamma two boundary terms, a reversal term and a permanent-dipole pseudo-line, enter a disjoint error budget. Because the kernel subnormalization is exactly 1, the published binning accounting carries a removable Theta(alpha+1+omega) factor (49.69x and 7.75x at the definitional caliber), a correction that applies to both routes. Estimating the square root of the kernel amplitude lowers the readout cost from beta²/muₜᵢₗde₂ to beta/sqrt(muₜᵢₗde₂₎. On the time-domain route we prove a single-point amplitude-estimation theorem and convert the generalized QPE of Loaiza et al. to the same accounting. The lower bounds are Thetaₜᵢₗde(1/gamma) for parameter location, Theta(1/(gamma epsilon)) for windowed values, Omega(n/gamma) inside a restricted correlation-sampling class, and Omega(1/(epsilon gamma²⁾⁾ on the Lorentzian object; in the single-circuit-resolution caliber, gamma⁽⁻ⁿ⁾ is a grid-coverage artifact. Six routes, their calibers, an n=2 assembly with a component-grade coherence, and a phase diagram over the tested ensembles form one accounting map.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在一个统一的核算框架内比较了六种用于分子响应函数的量子算法路径，并给出了它们资源校准之间的转换关系。研究发现，在解算路径中，洛伦兹展宽谱精确对应于解算期望值，并修正了已发表的二值化核算中的一个可移除因子。此外，论文还推导了参数定位和窗口值的查询下界。
authors: Yunlong Liu, Yujin Tang, Miao Xu, Qing-Xing Xie

articles.title: Optimal Holding Times for Entanglement Swapping
articles.title_zh: 纠缠交换的最优保持时间
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06823v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We revisit the optimization of entanglement holding times in memory-based quantum repeaters for maximizing entanglement swapping throughput under different fidelity constraints - strict, probabilistic, and mean. We consider two heterogeneous quantum links that are equipped with single or multiple memories and differ in decoherence rates, memory capacities, entanglement attempt rates and success probabilities, as well as classical communication latencies. Efficient models are developed to estimate the expected entanglement throughput and the probability density functions of the conditional wait time to swap. The models are then used to satisfy different fidelity requirements by optimizing the maximum holding times for the two links. Finally, our proposed model and approach are validated with a discrete-event quantum network simulator.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了基于存储器的量子中继器中纠缠保持时间的优化问题，旨在不同保真度约束下最大化纠缠交换吞吐量。研究考虑了两个具有不同退相干率、存储容量和成功概率的异构量子链路。作者开发了高效模型来估计预期纠缠吞吐量和条件等待时间，并通过优化两个链路的最大保持时间来满足不同的保真度要求。
authors: Van Sy Mai, Richard J. La, Abdella Battou

articles.title: Arithmetic Depth, Minimal Gate Alphabets, and Exact Program-State Resources for Single-Qubit Dyadic Programs
articles.title_zh: 单量子比特二元程序的算术深度、最小门字母表和精确程序状态资源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06909v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Resource analyses for quantum programs commonly provide safe upper bounds on qubits, gates, or non-Clifford operations. We study a single-qubit dyadic fragment in which the deepest exact resource layer can instead be inferred exactly. Starting from the normalized-midpoint misty-state syntax, we define dyadic program states and the real cyclotomic tower K_D=mathbb Q(2o̧s(π/2^D)). For the projective single-qubit Clifford-cyclotomic tower widehat G_Dsubseteq SO(3), we prove the relative intersection law widehat G_Da̧p SO(3,K_d)=widehat G_d for dłe D. Combining this descent theorem with an arithmetic-closure invariant for adaptive stabilizer processing yields Fdepth(U)=Adepth(U)=Rdepth(U): the smallest real cyclotomic field containing the Bloch matrix of an exactly synthesizable channel, the shallowest dyadic gate alphabet realizing it up to global phase, and the shallowest dyadic program-state layer sufficient for exact stabilizer-assisted implementation coincide. At that common minimum, known fixed-alphabet synthesis gives minimum primitive-rotation count. We package the result as an exact static resource effect and outline a certificate-producing compiler.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子程序的资源分析通常提供量子比特、门或非Clifford操作的安全上限。本文研究了单量子比特二元片段，其中最深层的精确资源层可以被精确推断。研究结果表明，精确可合成信道的Bloch矩阵所包含的最小实圆分域、实现该信道所需的最浅二元门字母表以及精确稳定器辅助实现所需的最浅二元程序状态层是重合的。
authors: Tony Newton, Dan-Adrian German

articles.title: Photon-Counting Readout via Electro-Optic Microwave-to-Optical Transduction for Axion Haloscopes
articles.title_zh: 用于轴子晕镜的电光微波到光转导光子计数读出
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05444v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Axion dark matter searches require highly sensitive detection schemes with high scan rate to efficiently explore the parameter space. Building upon the conventional Sikivie haloscope, where axions convert into microwave photons inside a magnetic-field-immersed resonant cavity, we present a photon-counting scheme based on an electro-optic microwave-to-optical transducer. Through a comprehensive theoretical model under realistic experimental constraints, we find that the optimal operating regime employs an overcoupled microwave cavity, trading peak transduction efficiency for reduced transducer noise. Furthermore, combining parameters already demonstrated in existing devices, in a device with optimized extrinsic coupling rates, would yield a scan-rate enhancement of 5-10 relative to quantum-limited homodyne detection. Improvements in quality factors, coupling rates, and thermal management push this enhancement beyond 50. While our quantitative model is benchmarked at 9 GHz, the scheme adapts well to haloscopes across the 5-12 GHz range, where shrinking cavity volumes severely degrade the achievable scan rate. These results demonstrate the potential of electro-optical photon detection as a high-speed detection technique for axion dark matter searches.
articles.abstract_zh: 轴子暗物质探测需要高灵敏度和高扫描速率的检测方案。本文提出了一种基于电光微波到光转导器的光子计数方案，用于Sikivie晕镜。通过全面的理论模型，研究发现最佳工作状态是采用过耦合微波腔，以牺牲峰值转导效率来降低转导器噪声。该方案在9 GHz下进行基准测试，并显示出显著的扫描速率提升潜力。
authors: Jing Wu, Raphael Cervantes, Doga Murat Kurkcuoglu, Zheshen Zhang, Silvia Zorzetti

articles.title: Superconducting Qubits as Quantum Targets for Direct Particle Scattering
articles.title_zh: 超导量子比特作为直接粒子散射的量子靶标
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05469v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce a novel approach to particle detection in which a superconducting qubit itself serves as the scattering target and a resolved transition between circuit eigenstates constitutes the observable final state. The scattering amplitude factorizes into the incident-particle current and a finite-momentum electromagnetic transition response of the qubit. This momentum dependence is essential in that the energy transfer is fixed by the microwave-scale level spacing, whereas a nonrelativistic incident particle can transfer a spatial momentum parametrically larger than that energy and thereby resolve the device geometry. For charge-dominated processes, we recast the response as an induced-offset-charge kernel obtained from an auxiliary electrostatic weighting potential, providing a practical route from circuit geometry to a differential scattering cross section. We illustrate the framework with an Xmon-style transmon and photon-mediated scattering of dark matter. The exceptionally small qubit transition threshold opens sensitivity to an eV-to-keV mass regime that is largely unexplored by existing direct-detection experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的粒子探测方法，其中超导量子比特本身充当散射靶标，电路本征态之间的可分辨跃迁构成可观测的最终状态。散射振幅可分解为入射粒子电流和量子比特的有限动量电磁跃迁响应。该框架通过Xmon型transmon和光子介导的暗物质散射进行了说明，其极小的量子比特跃迁阈值使得探测eV到keV质量范围的粒子成为可能。
authors: Doojin Kim, Kyoungchul Kong, Myeonghun Park

articles.title: Shapiro spikes in driven quantum fluids
articles.title_zh: 驱动量子流体中的Shapiro尖峰
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05477v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Periodic driving of a Josephson junction produces resonant transport signatures known as Shapiro spikes, conventionally described by effective circuit models. Here, we demonstrate Shapiro spikes in a neutral quantum fluid using simulations of a potential-biased atomic Josephson junction. The dc-current resonances follow the expected Bessel-function scaling, including the suppression and revival of individual resonances with increasing modulation strength. We uncover their microscopic mechanism by showing that the phase-winding frequency develops finite plateaus at integer multiples of the drive frequency. These phase-locked states are sustained by quantized-vortex nucleation and the associated 2π phase slips. Remarkably, within a locking plateau, the dc current and density transfer can reverse direction while the phase-winding frequency remains locked to the drive, giving rise to negative-mobility transport. Our results establish a microscopic link between vortex-mediated phase slips, Shapiro resonances, and anomalous transport in a neutral quantum fluid, revealing how quantized vortices convert resonant transport into phase-locked dynamics with negative mobility.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过模拟势偏置原子约瑟夫结，在一种中性量子流体中展示了Shapiro尖峰现象。直流电流共振遵循预期的贝塞尔函数标度，并随调制强度增加而出现抑制和复苏。研究揭示了其微观机制，即相位缠绕频率在驱动频率的整数倍处形成有限平台，这些锁相态由量子涡旋成核和相关的2π相滑移维持。在锁相平台内，直流电流和密度传输甚至可以反向，从而产生负迁移率输运。
authors: Vijay Pal Singh, Ludwig Mathey, Luigi Amico

articles.title: Stabiliser codes over prime fields as weighted graphs and as quantum sets of lines
articles.title_zh: 素数域上的稳定器码作为加权图和量子线集
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05489v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We further develop the theory of quantum stabiliser codes and its links with graph theory and finite geometry. We prove that an [[n,k,d]]ₚ stabiliser code over a finite field with p elements, p prime, gives rise to a graph on n-k vertices together with two disjoint independent sets of size k. Its edges are weighted with elements of a finite field of size p. If k=0, such codes are known as graph states. Second, we view stabiliser codes as so-called quantum sets of lines in projective space, allowing us to determined their minimum distance geometrically. We describe two geometrical operations to obtain new quantum sets of lines from given quantum sets of lines. As an application, we list the number of stabiliser codes up to equivalence, for given small parameters.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文进一步发展了量子稳定器码的理论，并探讨了其与图论和有限几何的联系。研究证明，素数域上的稳定器码可以对应于一个具有特定顶点和独立集的加权图。此外，作者将稳定器码视为射影空间中的量子线集，从而能够几何地确定其最小距离，并描述了生成新量子线集的几何操作。
authors: Simeon Ball, Gülizar Günay, Robin Simoens, Ricard Vilar

articles.title: Exact teleportation bounds for fermionic Hawking thermality beyond the single-mode approximation
articles.title_zh: 超越单模近似的费米子霍金热态精确隐形传态界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05773v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fermionic teleportation near a Schwarzschild horizon involves two physically distinct ingredients that are often varied together: Hawking thermal mixing and the relative composition of the right and left Unruh modes. We separate them by factorizing the reduced map of the detected exterior fermionic mode into a mode-preparation channel and a Hawking thermal channel. At fixed right-left Unruh-mode composition, we then solve a global constrained quantum-channel optimization over all two-qubit resource states whose fully entangled fraction remains at or below the standard teleportation threshold immediately before thermal mixing. A parity twirl and positivity reduce the arbitrary-state problem exactly to a two-variable quadratic optimization. The solution yields a necessary-and-sufficient activation boundary, a second exact boundary for attaining the universal optimum, and explicit optimizing states. The resulting phase diagram contains a strict no-go region, a composition-limited activation region, and a universal-bound region. The analysis converts state-specific observations of Hawking-assisted teleportation into exact channel-level bounds over the full two-qubit state space.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨了史瓦西视界附近费米子隐形传态中的霍金热混合与Unruh模式组成。通过将外部费米子模式的约化映射分解，作者在固定Unruh模式组成下，对两量子比特资源态进行了全局受限量子信道优化。研究得到了激活边界、达到普适最优的精确边界和明确的优化态，揭示了一个包含严格禁区、组成受限激活区和普适界限区的相图。
authors: Zhiming Huang

articles.title: Kardar--Parisi--Zhang density hydrodynamics in a coherent XXZ--ASEP Lindbladian
articles.title_zh: 相干XXZ-ASEP Lindbladian中的Kardar--Parisi--Zhang密度流体动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06369v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Coherent interactions can generate quantum correlations without changing a stationary density current. Whether that current still determines long-wavelength transport is a dynamical question. We study an XXZ chain with asymmetric Lindblad hopping, whose stationary current has the asymmetric simple exclusion process (ASEP) form although its populations do not evolve autonomously. The current curvature and static susceptibility fix the leading Kardar--Parisi--Zhang (KPZ) length and amplitude without a fitted length or amplitude conversion factor. The density-visible Liouvillian spectrum, real-space spreading, and Fourier relaxation support KPZ scaling at the finite coherent couplings studied. Central and intermediate stationary density correlations are consistent with the Prähofer--Spohn profile at this microscopic scale, with resolved finite-time corrections. Reservoir-matched classical references quantify boundary effects, while symmetric hopping recovers diffusion and reduced asymmetry produces the expected crossover. These results connect an exact nonlinear current to the observed long-wavelength KPZ transport of the physical density in an interacting open quantum chain away from the isotropic Heisenberg point.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有非对称Lindblad跳跃的XXZ链，其稳态电流呈现非对称简单排斥过程（ASEP）形式。研究发现，电流曲率和静态磁化率无需拟合即可确定Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ) 长度和振幅。密度可见的Liouvillian谱、实空间扩散和傅里叶弛豫均支持KPZ标度，并且稳态密度关联与Prähofer-Spohn剖面一致。这些结果将精确的非线性电流与观测到的物理密度长波KPZ输运联系起来。
authors: Yansheng Liu, Daoguang Li, Kaixiang Lu, Mingdi Xu, Lei Pan

articles.title: Constraining Lorentz Invariance Violation via Precision Atomic Spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 通过精密原子光谱学限制洛伦兹不变性破缺
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06392v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper investigates Lorentz violation arising from quantum gravity effects in electronic and muonic hydrogen atoms. The violation is modeled through a modified dispersion relation parameterized by a dimensionless coefficient ξ and suppressed by the Planck scale. Using high-precision spectroscopic data and a chi-squared fitting procedure that carefully accounts for theoretical uncertainties in the Rydberg constant and the proton radius, the analysis yields a 95% confidence level constraint ξ in [-14.3,; 1.37] × 10⁵. The mass scaling of the effect reveals two distinct regimes: for the lowest-order deformation, the heavy nucleus amplifies the signal, while for higher-order corrections, the lepton dominates the sensitivity. These bounds approach Planck-scale sensitivity using the simplest atomic systems, thereby circumventing ambiguities inherent in more complex quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过电子和μ子氢原子研究了量子引力效应引起的洛伦兹破缺。利用高精度光谱数据和卡方拟合，对由无纲量系数ξ参数化的修正色散关系进行了约束。分析结果在95%置信水平下将ξ限制在[-14.3, 1.37] × 10⁵范围内。研究发现，在最低阶形变中重原子核会放大信号，而在高阶修正中轻子则主导灵敏度，这些界限利用最简单的原子系统接近普朗克尺度灵敏度。
authors: A. S. Lemos, J. E. J. Matias, F. Dahia, I. P. Lobo

articles.title: A Tensor-Network Chebyshev--Galerkin Method for Boundary-Value Problems in Computational Mechanics
articles.title_zh: 计算力学中边界值问题的张量网络切比雪夫-伽辽金方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06552v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum-inspired numerical methods for partial differential equations represent discretized fields and operators as quantics tensor trains (QTT), so that their cost depends on how compressible the problem is rather than on the number of unknowns. Global spectral formulations in this setting have so far relied on Fourier bases, restricted to periodic problems, or on collocation, which does not preserve the variational structure exploited by tensor-network solvers. We introduce a QTT Chebyshev--Galerkin method that assembles and solves global spectral systems directly in compressed form, without forming the underlying arrays. Starting from the weak formulation, the method handles coupled elliptic systems with variable coefficients, smoothly mapped geometries, and mixed Dirichlet--Robin boundary conditions, and yields symmetric positive-definite systems suited to variational tensor-network solvers. Parameters and random inputs enter as additional coordinates, so the same construction returns the solution over an entire parameter space in a single solve. In linear elasticity, the method retains spectral convergence and reaches errors below 10⁻⁸ on a three-dimensional benchmark, beyond those attained by QTT finite differences and Q2/Q4 FEniCSx finite elements over the tested range. A six-parameter cantilever design study covering 1.7×10⁷ designs is solved in a single 92~s run, and a stochastic problem with ten random coordinates is represented with 2.4×10⁶ times less memory than its full coefficient array.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种量子启发式数值方法，即QTT切比雪夫-伽辽金方法，用于解决计算力学中的边界值问题。该方法将离散场和算子表示为量子张量列车（QTT），直接以压缩形式组装和求解全局谱系统。它能处理具有变系数、平滑映射几何和混合边界条件的耦合椭圆系统，并生成适用于变分张量网络求解器的对称正定系统。该方法在参数空间中实现单次求解，并在线性弹性问题中保持谱收敛性。
authors: Juan José Rodríguez-Aldavero, Ángel de la Rosa Velasco, Juan José García-Ripoll

articles.title: Cryogenic suppression of correlated loss in Rydberg atom arrays
articles.title_zh: 低温抑制里德堡原子阵列中的关联损耗
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06613v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Blackbody radiation (BBR) poses a central challenge for quantum science with Rydberg atoms. By driving transitions to nearby opposite-parity states, BBR shortens Rydberg lifetimes and has long been suspected to trigger "avalanche" events known to cause correlated atom loss. Here, we suppress avalanche decay and establish BBR as its dominant trigger using a Rydberg atom array that operates either cryogenically or at room temperature. A 45~K radiation shield reduces ambient BBR, extending Rydberg nS lifetimes for n ranging from 50 to 75. BBR-induced decay rates are suppressed by 30%-50%, corresponding to an effective blackbody temperature Tₘ̊ ₑffapprox190~K. This enables controlled comparisons of Rydberg-dressed atom arrays operating in different BBR environments. Arrays of up to 70 atoms demonstrate cryogenically suppressed avalanche rates, tracking the suppression in BBR-induced decay, for both n=50 and n=60 dressing. A parameter-free rate model agrees with the measured avalanche rates after accounting for frequency-dependent cryogenic shielding, photoionization-triggered avalanches, laser phase noise, BBR decay channels, and Rydberg interaction effects. We demonstrate a quantitative description of avalanche decay and show that improved BBR shielding should further suppress correlated loss to the Tₑff=45~K achievable in the current apparatus. Our results establish a route to mitigating correlated errors that otherwise impede fault-tolerant operation in neutral-atom quantum processors.
articles.abstract_zh: 黑体辐射（BBR）是里德堡原子量子科学面临的核心挑战，它会缩短里德堡寿命并触发关联原子损耗的“雪崩”事件。本研究通过低温操作的里德堡原子阵列，成功抑制了雪崩衰变并确认BBR是其主要触发因素。一个45 K的辐射屏蔽将BBR引起的衰减率抑制了30%-50%，有效黑体温度约为190 K。实验结果与无参数速率模型吻合，为在不同BBR环境下操作里德堡原子阵列提供了受控比较。
authors: Zhenpu Zhang, Brendan P. Marsh, Ting You Tan, Quinn Manning, Daniel H. Slichter, Adam M. Kaufman, Cindy A. Regal

articles.title: Approaching the Landauer Bound without Slowing Down
articles.title_zh: 不减速地逼近朗道尔极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2407.03096v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Finite-time memory erasure is conventionally understood to incur an additional energy cost beyond the Landauer bound. Whether this bound can be approached without taking the infinite-time limit remains open. Based on a quantum speed limit, we identify coherence between degenerate states as a resource that allows the Landauer bound to be approached at a finite operation time. For both the 2N-state and collective spin models, we show that the minimum dissipated heat and the heat generated by continuous protocols approach the Landauer bound at finite operation times, with the corresponding finite-time penalty scaling inversely with system size. We further validate these theoretical predictions numerically for systems coupled to the Ohmic bosonic heat bath with various driving protocols. Our results reveal that operation time is a substitutable resource for approaching the fundamental thermodynamic bound of information erasure.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统认为有限时间内存擦除会产生超出朗道尔极限的额外能量成本。本研究基于量子速度极限，发现简并态之间的相干性是一种资源，允许在有限操作时间内逼近朗道尔极限。对于2N态和集体自旋模型，我们证明了最小耗散热量和连续协议产生的热量在有限操作时间内逼近朗道尔极限，且有限时间惩罚与系统尺寸成反比。这些结果表明操作时间是逼近信息擦除基本热力学极限的可替代资源。
authors: Yue Liu, Chenlong Huang, Xingyu Zhang, Dahai He

articles.title: Marginal-constrained entropy accumulation theorem
articles.title_zh: 边际约束熵累积定理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2502.02563v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We derive a novel chain rule for a family of channel conditional entropies, covering von Neumann and sandwiched Rényi entropies. In the process, we show that these channel conditional entropies are equal to their regularized version, and more generally, additive across tensor products of channels. For the purposes of cryptography, applying our chain rule to sequences of channels yields a new variant of Rényi entropy accumulation, in which we can impose some specific forms of marginal-state constraint on the input states to each individual channel. This generalizes a recently introduced security proof technique that was developed to analyze prepare-and-measure QKD with no limitations on the repetition rate. In particular, our generalization yields ``fully adaptive'' protocols that can in principle update the entropy estimation procedure during the protocol itself, similar to the quantum probability estimation framework.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文推导了一系列信道条件熵（包括冯诺依曼熵和夹心Rényi熵）的新型链式法则，并证明这些熵等于其正则化版本，且在信道张量积上具有可加性。将此链式法则应用于信道序列，得到了Rényi熵累积的新变体，允许对每个信道的输入态施加特定的边际态约束。这一推广为分析无重复率限制的制备-测量QKD提供了“完全自适应”协议，原则上可在协议执行期间更新熵估计过程。
authors: Amir Arqand, Ernest Y. -Z. Tan

articles.title: Efficient Classical Simulation of Low-Rank-Width Quantum Circuits Using ZX-Calculus
articles.title_zh: 使用ZX-演算对低秩宽量子电路进行高效经典模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.06764v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this paper, we introduce an algorithm for contracting (i.e. numerically evaluating) ZX-diagrams whose computational complexity is governed by rank-width, a structural graph parameter that behaves nicely under ZX rewrite rules.
