Our method evaluates a graph-like ZX-diagram in ~O(4^R) time, given its rank-decomposition of width R. By constructing suitable rank-decompositions, we provide a classical simulation algorithm for quantum circuits whose runtime is bounded by both ~O(2ⁿ⁾ and ~O(2⁽t/2)), where n is the number of qubits and t is the number of non-Clifford phase gates. Thus, our method is no slower than either the naive state-vector simulation or the elementary stabiliser decomposition baseline, and in practice can be even faster when the reduced ZX-diagram has low rank-width. We benchmark our simulation algorithm against Quimb, a popular tensor contraction library, and observe substantial reductions in floating-point operations, often by several orders of magnitude, for random and structured non-Clifford circuits and for random ZX-diagrams.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种用于收缩ZX图的算法，其计算复杂度由秩宽决定。该方法能在约O(4^R)时间内评估图状ZX图，其中R是秩分解的宽度。通过构建合适的秩分解，我们提供了一种量子电路的经典模拟算法，其运行时间受O(2ⁿ)和O(2⁽t/2))的限制。该方法在实践中可能比朴素状态向量模拟或基本稳定器分解更快，尤其当约化ZX图具有低秩宽时。
authors: Fedor Kuyanov (University of Oxford), Aleks Kissinger (University of Oxford)

articles.title: ZX-Flow: A Flexible Criterion for Deterministic Computation with ZX-Diagrams
articles.title_zh: ZX-流：一种用于ZX图确定性计算的灵活判据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.09580v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Flow criteria are used to efficiently extract computations, either in the form of measurement patterns or quantum circuits, from ZX-diagrams. Existing criteria such as causal flow, generalised flow, and Pauli flow, were all originally formulated for graph states, so they require ZX-diagrams to be in a very particular graph-state-like form. This form is easily broken by applying basic ZX rules and makes establishing some desirable properties very complicated. Here, we introduce a new "ZX-native" flow criterion called ZX-flow, formulated using a new type of decoration of a ZX-diagram we call Pauli semiwebs. These are a generalisation of Pauli webs, which have recently been used extensively in reasoning about fault-tolerant computations in the ZX-calculus. We show that ZX-flow is straightforwardly preserved by all Clifford rewrites and furthermore that a ZX-diagram has ZX-flow if and only if it is Clifford-equivalent to a graph-like ZX-diagram with Pauli flow. Finally, we show that any diagram with ZX-flow can be readily interpreted either as a deterministic measurement-based computation or as a Clifford isometry followed by a sequence of Pauli exponentials. The latter can then be efficiently extracted to a quantum circuit.
articles.abstract_zh: 现有流判据在ZX图中提取计算时，通常要求ZX图处于特定的图态形式。本文引入了一种新的“ZX原生”流判据——ZX-流，它通过Pauli半网（Pauli网的推广）来表述。研究表明，ZX-流能被所有Clifford重写操作直接保留，并且一个ZX图具有ZX-流当且仅当它与具有Pauli流的图状ZX图是Clifford等价的。任何具有ZX-流的图都可以被解释为确定性基于测量的计算或Clifford等距变换。
authors: Aleks Kissinger (University of Oxford), John van de Wetering (University of Amsterdam, Qusoft)

articles.title: Decoherence and the Reemergence of Coherence From a Superconducting "Horizon"
articles.title_zh: 超导“视界”中的退相干与相干性再现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.16765v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In a recent paper [arXiv:2205.06279], Danielson et al. demonstrated that the mere presence of a black hole causes universal decoherence of quantum superpositions (dubbed the DSW decoherence). We analyze decoherence in a superconducting analogue [arXiv:1709.06154] of the event horizon of a late-stage black hole, where Andreev reflection plays the role of Hawking radiation. We consider a normal metal interferometer threaded by an Aharonov-Bohm flux, where one of the arms of the interferometer is coupled to a superconductor by a tunnel coupling of varying strength. At absolute zero temperature and for weak coupling, we find that the scattering states of the interferometer are decohered by Andreev reflection, a nontrivial manifestation of the proximity effect analogous to DSW decoherence from the event horizon of a black hole. However, for increasing coupling strength to the superconductor, we find a reemergence of coherence via resonant tunneling through Andreev bound states. This suggests the existence of an analogue gravitational phenomenon wherein transmission mediated by virtual Hawking radiation leads to a reemergence of coherence in an interferometer placed near a black hole's event horizon.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文分析了超导模拟黑洞事件视界中的退相干现象，其中安德烈夫反射扮演霍金辐射的角色。在绝对零度弱耦合条件下，干涉仪的散射态因安德烈夫反射而退相干，类似于DSW退相干。然而，随着与超导体耦合强度的增加，通过安德烈夫束缚态的共振隧穿，相干性重新出现。这暗示了一种类似的引力现象，即虚拟霍金辐射介导的传输可能导致相干性的再现。
authors: Eric J. Sung, Charles A. Stafford

articles.title: Unlocking a fast adiabatic CZ gate and exact residual ZZ cancellation between fixed-frequency transmons using a floating tunable coupler
articles.title_zh: 利用浮动可调耦合器实现固定频率透射子之间快速绝热CZ门和精确残余ZZ抵消
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.05048v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Tunable couplers in superconducting qubit architectures enable strong qubit-qubit interactions for two-qubit gates while suppressing unwanted coupling during single-qubit operations. However, achieving low error rates for fast two-qubit gates remains challenging, as suppressing leakage and non-adiabatic errors typically requires specialized qubit, coupler, or pulse designs, often at the expense of an idling ZZ=0 condition. In this work, we demonstrate that a symmetric floating tunable coupler provides a natural platform for fast, high-fidelity adiabatic controlled-Z (CZ) gates. Its favorable energy-level structure eliminates the conventional trade-off between rapid conditional-phase accumulation and adiabatic evolution while preserving exact cancellation of residual ZZ interaction at idling. This architecture exhibits intrinsic robustness to non-adiabatic transitions, even under simple flux modulation waveforms. To push performance at short gate durations, where maintaining adiabaticity becomes more challenging despite the favorable level structure, we introduce pulse-shaping techniques based on the instantaneous adiabatic factor that further suppress non-adiabatic errors. We experimentally realize a 24 ns adiabatic CZ gate with fidelity exceeding 99.9% and stable operation over several hours with a time-averaged fidelity of 99.878%
articles.abstract_zh: 可调耦合器在超导量子比特架构中对于实现快速、低错误率的两量子比特门至关重要。本研究展示了对称浮动可调耦合器为实现快速、高保真度绝热受控-Z (CZ) 门提供了一个理想平台。其独特的能级结构消除了快速条件相位累积与绝热演化之间的传统权衡，同时在空闲时精确抵消了残余ZZ相互作用。该架构对非绝热跃迁表现出固有的鲁棒性，即使在简单的磁通调制波形下也是如此。
authors: Angela Q. Chen, Sarah Strong, Xian Wu, Stefano Poletto

articles.title: Sharp Bounds on the Eigenvalues of Kikuchi Graphs and Applications to Quantum Max Cut
articles.title_zh: Kikuchi图特征值的精确界限及其在量子最大割中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.14994v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We prove that the maximum eigenvalue of the (both signed and unsigned) Laplacian of level k Kikuchi graph of any graph G with m edges is at most m+k. This confirms four recent conjectures of Apte, Parekh, and Sud. As applications, we obtain that tensor products of one and two qubit product states achieve an approximation ratio of 5/8 for Quantum Max Cut and 5/7 for the XY Hamiltonian. Moreover, combining our bounds with the algorithms analyzed by Apte, Parekh, and Sud, yields efficient algorithms achieving an approximation ratio of 0.614 for Quantum Max Cut and 0.674 for the XY Hamiltonian. Finally, we also make modest progress on Brouwer's conjecture and improve Lew's bound on the sum of the top-k eigenvalues of a Graph Laplacian.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了任意具有m条边的图G的k级Kikuchi图（有符号和无符号）的拉普拉斯算子的最大特征值至多为m+k，这证实了Apte、Parekh和Sud的四个猜想。作为应用，研究表明一和两量子比特乘积态的张量积在量子最大割问题上达到5/8的近似比，在XY哈密顿量上达到5/7的近似比。结合这些界限与现有算法，可获得量子最大割0.614和XY哈密顿量0.674的近似比。
authors: Ainesh Bakshi, Arpon Basu, Pravesh Kothari, Anqi Li

articles.title: Detecting bipartite entanglement with PnCP maps and non-negative polynomials
articles.title_zh: 使用PnCP映射和非负多项式检测二分纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30426v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Positive non-Completely Positive (PnCP) maps are an essential tool to detect entanglement since their characterization is a dual aspect of the separability problem. A recent algorithm proposed by Kelp et al. explains how to generate PnCP maps based on the construction of certain positive non-Sum-of-Squares polynomials. We implement this algorithm in a numerically robust way and propose a working version on GitHub. We theoretically demonstrate that the maps produced by the algorithm are indecomposable, localized on the boundary of the positive cone and show that they are inequivalent with most other known PnCP maps. We numerically investigate their entanglement power, demonstrating notably that they are capable of detecting PPT entangled states that most criteria fail to detect.
articles.abstract_zh: 正非完全正（PnCP）映射是检测纠缠的重要工具。本文数值实现了Kelp等人提出的基于非平方和多项式构造PnCP映射的算法，并提供了GitHub工作版本。研究表明，该算法生成的映射是不可分解的，位于正锥边界，且与大多数已知PnCP映射不等价。数值结果还显示，这些映射能够检测大多数现有判据无法检测的PPT纠缠态。
authors: Gaël Massé, Mounir Rezig, Paul Catala, Santiago Scheiner, Laia Serradesanferm Córdoba, Enky Oudot, Damian Markham

articles.title: Quadratic speed-up of quantum adiabatic evolution with engineered dissipation
articles.title_zh: 利用工程耗散实现量子绝热演化的二次加速
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05815v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum adiabatic evolution is often slowed by nonadiabatic leakage near small spectral gaps. We propose an engineered dissipative protocol that continuously relaxes these excitations during the adiabatic evolution. In the ideal limit, a spectrally filtered jump operator induces downward transitions in the instantaneous energy eigenbasis while leaving the instantaneous ground state dark. An effective avoided-crossing analysis shows that in the regime where the engineered relaxation strength is much larger than the minimum gap, the runtime scaling can improve from the closed-system behavior O(Δ⁻²) to O(Δ⁻¹). Finite-temperature upward transitions introduce a thermal error floor, the inverse-gap runtime estimate remains applicable when the thermal excited-state population at the minimum gap stays below a fixed fraction of the target error tolerance. Numerical results show improved ground-state preparation and robustness against weak upward-jump errors over closed-system annealing. We also discuss possible superconducting-circuit implementations using structured bosonic reservoirs and the microscopic consistency requirements for realizing the effective dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子绝热演化常因小谱隙附近的非绝热泄漏而减慢。本文提出一种工程耗散方案，可在绝热演化过程中持续弛豫这些激发。在理想情况下，该方案能将运行时间标度从封闭系统的O(Δ⁻²)提升至O(Δ⁻¹)，实现二次加速。数值结果表明，该方法改善了基态制备并增强了对弱向上跳跃误差的鲁棒性。
authors: Yuanyang Zhou, Biao Wu

articles.title: Coherent Optical Control of a Single Donor Electron Spin
articles.title_zh: 单个施主电子自旋的相干光学控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36423v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Coherent spin--photon interfaces for scalable quantum networks require bright optical transitions, long-lived spin coherence, and complete coherent spin control. Donor spins in direct-bandgap semiconductors combine strong donor-bound exciton transitions with a potentially nuclear-spin-free environment. However, coherent control of an individual optically active donor spin has remained elusive. Here, we demonstrate coherent optical control of a single Cl donor electron spin in ZnSe. Resonant excitation reveals spin relaxation dynamics and measures spin coherence through coherent population trapping (CPT). Off-resonant ultrafast pulses are implemented to drive spin Rabi oscillations and demonstrate Ramsey interference. Multiple dark resonances in the CPT spectrum further reveal hyperfine coupling between the electron and the I=3/2 Cl nucleus. Together, these results demonstrate the first coherent optical control of a single donor electron spin in II--VI direct-bandgap semiconductors, establishing the essential components for exploiting optical donors in a scalable solid-state spin--photon platform.
articles.abstract_zh: 可扩展量子网络中的相干自旋-光子接口需要明亮的光学跃迁、长寿命自旋相干性和完整的相干自旋控制。本文首次在ZnSe中实现了单个氯施主电子自旋的相干光学控制。通过共振激发和非共振超快脉冲，研究人员揭示了自旋弛豫动力学、测量了自旋相干性，并驱动了自旋拉比振荡和拉姆齐干涉。这些结果为在II-VI直接带隙半导体中利用光学施主构建可扩展固态自旋-光子平台奠定了基础。
authors: Yuxi Jiang, Amirehsan Alizadehherfati, Christine Falter, Jasvith R. Basani, Nils von den Driesch, Yurii Kutovyi, Jan Seelbinder, Alexander Pawlis, Edo Waks

articles.title: Quantum Noise Spectroscopy of Criticality in an Atomically Thin Magnet
articles.title_zh: 原子级薄磁体临界性的量子噪声谱学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2407.05614v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The universality class of a phase transition dictates the behavior of low-frequency and long-wavelength critical fluctuations in a material. Studying these dynamics in thin magnetic insulators, however, remains challenging; an experimental probe must be sensitive to low-frequency, long-wavelength fluctuations while navigating the sample's small volume, inherent inhomogeneities, and fabrication limitations. Using nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond, we demonstrate T₂ (spin-decoherence) noise magnetometry as a direct and quantitative probe of critical dynamics in a tri-layer sample of CrSBr, a two-dimensional van der Waals magnet. We observe a sharp increase in the decoherence rate of the NV spin ensemble at the sample's critical temperature, highlighting our probe's sensitivity to critical fluctuations. We demonstrate that the behavior of the NV spin decoherence rate below the critical temperature is inconsistent with fluctuations due to XY criticality in 2D CrSBr. Next, by simulating the NV spin decoherence dynamics using noise models for an Ising-type transition and fitting to our data, we quantitatively measure the dynamical and the correlation length critical exponents (z and ν) and demonstrate that the observed fluctuations strongly deviate from those predicted by the short-range Ising universality class. Together, these observations indicate that the transition is Ising-like but modified by long-range dipolar interactions, emphasizing the importance of easy-axis anisotropy and long-range interactions for understanding magnetism in 2D CrSBr. Our work establishes T₂ noise magnetometry as a quantitative probe of critical dynamics in 2D materials, opening a new avenue for studying strongly correlated phenomena at the atomically thin limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 相变普适类决定了材料中低频长波临界涨落的行为。本文利用金刚石中的氮空位（NV）中心，展示了T₂（自旋退相干）噪声磁力测量作为二维范德华磁体CrSBr三层样品中临界动力学的直接定量探针。研究发现，在临界温度下NV自旋系综的退相干率急剧增加，表明该探针能灵敏探测临界涨落。通过模拟和拟合数据，研究人员定量测量了动力学参数，并发现其行为与二维CrSBr中XY临界性引起的涨落不一致。
authors: Mark E. Ziffer, Francisco Machado, Benedikt Ursprung, Artur Lozovoi, Aya Batoul Tazi, Zhiyang Yuan, Michael E. Ziebel, Tom Delord, Nanyu Zeng, Evan Telford, Daniel G. Chica, Dane W. deQuilettes, Xiaoyang Zhu, James C. Hone, Kenneth L. Shepard, Xavier Roy, Nathalie P. de Leon, Emily J. Davis, Carlos A. Meriles, Jonathan S. Owen, P. James Schuck, Shubhayu Chatterjee, Abhay N. Pasupathy

articles.title: Relativistic Quantum Chaos in Neutrino Billiards
articles.title_zh: 中微子台球中的相对论量子混沌
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.13003v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Neutrino billiards serve as a model system for the study of aspects of relativistic quantum chaos. These are relativistic quantum billiards consisting of a spin-1/2 particle which is confined to a planar domain by imposing boundary conditions on the spinor components which were proposed in [Berry and Mondragon, it Proc. R. Soc. A bf 412, 53 (1987)]. We review their general features and the properties of neutrino billiards with shapes of billiards with integrable dynamics. Furthermore, we review the features of two neutrino billiards with the shapes of billiards generating a chaotic dynamics, whose nonrelativistic counterpart exhibits particular properties. Finally we briefly discuss possible experimental realizations of relativistic quantum billiards based on graphene billiards, that is, finite-size sheets of graphene.
articles.abstract_zh: 中微子台球是研究相对论量子混沌的理想模型系统。本文综述了由Berry和Mondragon提出的自旋1/2粒子在平面区域内受边界条件限制的相对论量子台球的普遍特征。文章回顾了具有可积动力学形状的中微子台球的性质，以及两个具有混沌动力学形状的中微子台球的特征。最后，简要讨论了基于石墨烯台球实现相对论量子台球的实验可能性。
authors: Barbara Dietz

articles.title: The two-flavor Schwinger model at 50: Solving Coleman's puzzles
articles.title_zh: 双味施温格模型50周年：破解科尔曼之谜
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.08042v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In his 1976 paper "More about the massive Schwinger model," Coleman introduced 1+1-dimensional Quantum Electrodynamics coupled to two charged massive fermions. By applying Abelian bosonization, he elucidated much of the physics of this two-flavor Schwinger model, but he listed three puzzles at the end of his paper. We present new analytical and numerical calculations to solve Coleman's three puzzles and thereby deepen our understanding of this model. These puzzles pertain to the theory with equal fermion masses at θ = 0 and at θ = π, as well as the size of isospin-breaking effects when the fermion masses are unequal. For the puzzle at θ = π, the solution is related to the structure of the zero-temperature phase diagram arXiv:2305.04437: for equal fermion masses m, the model exhibits spontaneous breaking of charge conjugation symmetry and absence of confinement for any value of the gauge coupling g, so that there is a smooth interpolation from weak to strong coupling. Using two-loop Renormalization Group and integrability methods, we show that the mass gap behaves as sim m e⁻⁰.¹¹¹ g^²/m^² in the strong coupling regime młl g. Our numerical results using the lattice Hamiltonian are in good agreement with this behavior. For the puzzle at θ = 0, the solution is related to a level crossing between two isosinglet particles with different discrete quantum numbers; we demonstrate the necessity of such a crossing by comparing integrability and weak coupling calculations, and we also exhibit the crossing numerically. Finally, we provide a new estimate for the size of isospin-breaking effects caused by different fermion masses at strong coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 科尔曼在1976年论文中提出了双味施温格模型，并留下了三个未解之谜。本文通过新的分析和数值计算，成功解决了这些谜题，加深了对该模型的理解。研究揭示了在θ=π时，对于相等费米子质量m，模型表现出自发电荷共轭对称性破缺和无禁闭现象。在强耦合区域，质量间隙的行为被确定为m e⁻⁰.¹¹¹ g^²/m^²。
authors: Gabriel Cuomo, Ross Dempsey, Andrei Katsevich, Igor R. Klebanov, Ilia V. Kochergin, Silviu S. Pufu, Benjamin T. Søgaard

articles.title: Quasicrystals are Functionally Graded Materials
articles.title_zh: 准晶体是功能梯度材料
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05478v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quasicrystals exhibit long-range order without translational periodicity, posing challenges to compute their electronic properties. Here we show that a quasicrystal can be represented exactly as a periodic approximant with a spatially graded phason, establishing a connection to functionally graded materials. Building on this connection, we develop a controlled quantum theory of quasicrystals. We derive a state-dependent control parameter governed by the quantum metric of local Bloch states, determining when finite approximations are reliable. We further construct a Hamiltonian that correctly predicts Bragg gap positions, quasimomentum equivalence, and quasiperiodic eigenstates to all orders in phason strain within a finite Fourier window. We verify the theory numerically and propose a diffraction-based experimental test of the gap shift induced by phason strain. Our framework opens a route to predicting the electronic structure and functional properties of quasicrystals using methods developed for functionally graded materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 准晶体具有长程有序但无平移周期性，其电子性质计算面临挑战。本文证明准晶体可精确表示为具有空间梯度相子的周期近似体，从而将其与功能梯度材料建立联系。在此基础上，研究人员发展了一种受控的准晶体量子理论，并构建了一个哈密顿量，能正确预测布拉格带隙位置、准动量等效性和准周期本征态。该框架为利用功能梯度材料方法预测准晶体的电子结构和功能特性开辟了新途径。
authors: Michael J. Landry, Dominic Bollettieri, Akhil Sadam, Denisse Córdova Carrizales, Mingda Li

articles.title: Interplay between Spin Stripes and Pairing Crossover in the Bilayer Hubbard Model
articles.title_zh: 双层哈伯德模型中自旋条纹与配对交叉的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05840v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Whether d-wave or s_±-wave pairing prevails in the bilayer nickelate ȩLa3Ni2O7 remains unresolved, and how its observed spin order and magnetic excitations relate to the pairing mechanism is unclear. Here, we use finite-temperature determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations of a minimal bilayer Hubbard model to investigate pairing competition at strong interlayer coupling, where intralayer and interlayer antiferromagnetic correlations have comparable strengths. We find that spin stripes develop spontaneously with increasing hole doping, accompanied by a crossover of the dominant pairing symmetry from d-wave to s_±-wave. The crossover tracks the changing relative strengths of the spin correlations, with the interlayer correlations overtaking their intralayer counterparts in magnitude. Concomitantly, the dynamical spin structure factor exhibits a momentum-dependent reorganization of the magnetic excitations, consistent with fluctuating spin stripes. Our results identify the structure of spin fluctuations as a key link between spin stripes and pairing competition, offering a minimal-model perspective for understanding ȩLa3Ni2O7.
articles.abstract_zh: 双层镍酸盐La₃Ni₂O₇中d波或s_±波配对的优势以及自旋序与配对机制的关系尚不明确。本文通过有限温度行列式量子蒙特卡洛模拟，研究了强层间耦合下双层哈伯德模型中的配对竞争。结果表明，随着空穴掺杂增加，自旋条纹自发形成，并伴随主导配对对称性从d波向s_±波的转变。这一转变与自旋关联的相对强度变化密切相关，为理解La₃Ni₂O₇提供了最小模型视角。
authors: Zixuan Jia, Xuelei Sui, Shijie Hu, Tianxing Ma, Haiqing Lin, Bing Huang

articles.title: Millikelvin magnetometry up to 30~T using a multi-cross micro-Hall sensor
articles.title_zh: 使用多交叉微霍尔传感器实现高达30T的毫开尔文磁力测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06676v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a multi-cross micro-Hall sensor fabricated from an MBE-grown GaAs/AlGaAs heterostructure for high-sensitivity magnetometry. The device enables dc magnetization measurements at temperatures down to sim15~mK and in dc magnetic fields up to 30 T. Bulk samples with dimensions ranging from 100~μm to 1~mm can be measured with a resolution better than 1~μT with a 1~μA excitation at 13.77 Hz. Test-of-performance measurements were carried out by probing the field-dependent magnetization plateaus of the triangular-lattice quantum magnet K₂Co₂(SeO₃)₃ at 20~mK, the antiferromagnetic transition of K₃GdTe₂O₉ near 220 mK via temperature-dependent magnetization, and the quantum oscillations in a ruthenium single crystal. A simple and reliable sample-mounting setup that ensures reproducible magnetic measurements is provided.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了一种由MBE生长的GaAs/AlGaAs异质结构制备的多交叉微霍尔传感器，用于高灵敏度磁力测量。该器件可在低至15mK的温度和高达30T的直流磁场下进行直流磁化测量。其分辨率优于1μT，并已通过测量K₂Co₂(SeO₃)₃的磁化平台、K₃GdTe₂O₉的反铁磁转变以及钌单晶的量子振荡进行了性能验证。
authors: Bingbing Tong, Yinina Ma, Zhenhua Zhao, Shuyu Zheng, Li Lu, Peijie Sun, Gang Li

articles.title: Majorana-like Josephson branch structure in one-dimensional transport of cold atoms
articles.title_zh: 冷原子一维输运中的类马约拉纳约瑟夫森分支结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06693v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study phase-controlled transport through a one-dimensional channel of attractively interacting fermions connecting two three-dimensional BCS reservoirs. The competition between channel phase stiffness and pair tunnelling at the two contacts results in the emergence of two 4π-periodic families of stationary states, characterised by symmetric or asymmetric phase drops at the boundaries. Advancing the reservoir phase difference by 2π exchanges these families so that the equilibrium energy remains 2π periodic, while the 4π  periodicity might be attained in a diabatic regime. This structure admits a formal description in terms of two boundary Majorana operators, combining into a nonlocal fermion mode. Renormalization-group analysis shows that quantum fluctuations and phase slips are suppressed in the zero-temperature thermodynamic limit, preserving the branch crossings. The predicted branch exchange, metastable currents, and sweep-rate-dependent switching provide experimentally testable signatures of Majorana-like Josephson branch physics in a gapless interacting channel.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了连接两个三维BCS储层的吸引相互作用费米子一维通道中的相控输运。通道相刚度和两接触点处对隧穿的竞争导致了两个4π周期性稳态家族的出现。这种结构可以用两个边界马约拉纳算符来形式化描述，它们结合成一个非局域费米子模式。重整化群分析表明，在零温热力学极限下，量子涨落和相滑移被抑制，保留了分支交叉。
authors: Rory Whelan, Dimitri M. Gangardt, Igor V. Lerner

articles.title: Quantum Spin Wave Theory with Multi-Spin Interactions for Magnetic Materials Modeling
articles.title_zh: 具有多自旋相互作用的量子自旋波理论用于磁性材料建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06833v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the field of magnetism within condensed matter physics, magnetic systems are microscopically described by a spin Hamiltonian. Its parameterization is accessible through both ab initio calculations and fits to experimental data. Frequently, this is achieved via multi-stage calculations that either relate the parameters to observable material properties or map a Kohn-Sham Hamiltonian onto an effective spin model. In this realm, accurate and flexible methods are essential for simulating the physical properties of the latter. The present study focuses on one such method: spin wave theory. The approach is applied to a new formulation of the spin Hamiltonian, named polynomial localized spin model (PLSM), which includes terms of arbitrary order in the spin operators. This enables the direct application of linear spin wave theory (LSWT) to the analysis of the energy landscape and spin-wave spectrum of arbitrary collinear and non-collinear phases in any realistic magnetic material. Moreover, the classical and quantum parts of the PLSM are cleanly separated. Finally, an open-source implementation of LSWT, named Magnopy, is presented. It interfaces with modern parameterization software, supports arbitrary collinear and non-collinear systems, and is designed for both scripting and standalone use.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁性材料的微观描述依赖于自旋哈密顿量，其参数化可通过从头计算或实验数据拟合获得。本文将自旋波理论应用于一种新的多项式局域自旋模型（PLSM），该模型包含自旋算符任意阶项。这使得线性自旋波理论（LSWT）能够直接分析任意共线和非共线相的能量景观和自旋波谱。研究还提出了LSWT的开源实现Magnopy，为磁性材料的物理性质模拟提供了准确灵活的方法。
authors: Andrey Rybakov, Marco Marino, Yaroslav M. Blanter, Eugenio Coronado, Jaime Ferrer

articles.title: Fluctuating Hydrodynamics of Quantum Fluids from the Nonlinear Fokker-Planck Equation
articles.title_zh: 基于非线性福克-普朗克方程的量子流体涨落流体力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06485v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Starting from the nonlinear Fokker-Planck equation (NFPE), we establish the fluctuating hydrodynamics for quantum fluids. We also investigate the corresponding stochastic thermodynamics and derive the associated fluctuation theorems. We then apply this framework to both fermionic and bosonic systems. For the ideal Fermi gas, we study the electrical conduction and reveal a resistance proportional to the product of temperature and the density of states at the Fermi surface. For bosonic fluids, we analyze the relaxation time characterizing the critical slowing down phenomenon and identify three distinct scaling behaviors corresponding to the non-interacting, repulsive interaction, and attractive interaction regimes. Overall, this work provides a experimentally verifiable phenomenological description for the dynamics of quantum fluids and demonstrates the applicability of the nonlinear Fokker-Planck equation in characterizing such systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从非线性福克-普朗克方程（NFPE）出发，建立了量子流体的涨落流体力学，并研究了相应的随机热力学和涨落定理。该框架应用于费米子和玻色子系统，揭示了理想费米气体的电阻与温度和费米面态密度的乘积成正比。对于玻色流体，研究识别了三种不同的弛豫时间标度行为。这项工作为量子流体动力学提供了可实验验证的唯象描述。
authors: Mingjian Gu, Zhaoyu Fei, Xiaoguang Wang

articles.title: Simulating a chiral gauge theory
articles.title_zh: 模拟手性规范理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.06880v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Chiral gauge theories underlie the Standard Model, yet none has been simulated nonperturbatively. Lattice constructions that evade the Nielsen-Ninomiya obstruction entail complex fermion measures or infinite-dimensional local Hilbert spaces. Here we provide a gauge-invariant Hamiltonian lattice regularization of 1+1-dimensional abelian chiral gauge theories built from clock-and-shift qudits with Z_N gauge fields, in which the global chiral symmetry and its 't Hooft anomaly survive exactly mod N. Anomaly cancellation on the lattice lets the Gauss laws be imposed and solved exactly, reducing the theory to an unconstrained qudit chain. Using infinite matrix product states, we simulate the canonical 1+1-dimensional chiral gauge theory, the 34-50 model, and find excellent agreement with analytic predictions, showing that a finite-dimensional local Hilbert space at N=6 reproduces the expected infrared physics of the continuum 34-50 model. This provides an efficient and practical solution to the problem of simulating general abelian chiral gauge theories in 1+1 dimensions, both on classical and quantum computers.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性规范理论是标准模型的基础，但尚未进行非微扰模拟。本文提出了一种1+1维阿贝尔手性规范理论的规范不变哈密顿量格点正则化方法。通过该方法，作者成功模拟了典型的1+1维手性规范理论（34-50模型），并发现结果与解析预测高度吻合。这项工作为在经典和量子计算机上高效、实用地模拟1+1维阿贝尔手性规范理论提供了解决方案。
authors: Laurens Lootens, Hersh Singh

articles.title: Stability and mixed phases of three-component droplets in one dimension
articles.title_zh: 一维三组分液滴的稳定性和混合相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.04950v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We explore the ground state properties and excitation spectra of one-dimensional, three-component bosonic mixtures, where two majority components form a self-bound droplet coupled to a third, minority component. Within a self-consistent Lee-Huang-Yang framework, we identify distinct mixed self-bound droplet phases and characterize their phase transitions through variations of either the particle number of the majority components or the intercomponent coupling. The ensuing phases demonstrate that the minority component is untrapped, partially trapped, or fully trapped by the majority droplet species. These states are characterized by their binding energies captured by the chemical potentials and their low-amplitude excitation spectrum, including mode crossings at the particle-emission threshold. We further derive effective reduced models in the high-imbalance limit, which accurately reproduce the numerically computed ground states, while providing analytical insights into the role of quantum fluctuations. Our results establish the stability and structure of mixed droplet phases provide experimentally relevant signatures for their identification.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一维三组分玻色子混合物的基态性质和激发谱，其中两个多数组分形成自束缚液滴并与第三个少数组分耦合。在自洽的Lee-Huang-Yang框架下，作者识别出不同的混合自束缚液滴相，并通过改变多数组分的粒子数或组分间耦合来表征其相变。研究发现，少数组分可以表现为未被捕获、部分捕获或完全被多数液滴捕获的状态。该工作为混合液滴相的稳定性和结构提供了实验相关的特征。
authors: I. A. Englezos, E. G. Charalampidis, P. Schmelcher, S. I. Mistakidis

articles.title: Unified Theory of Spin and Orbital Inverse Faraday Effects in Rashba Metals
articles.title_zh: Rashba金属中自旋和轨道逆法拉第效应的统一理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.13187v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The inverse Faraday effect (IFE) offers a promising route toward optical control of magnetic moments in quantum materials. Yet experiments on spin-orbit-coupled metals indicate that no single microscopic mechanism suffices, implicating orbital currents alongside spin polarization. We derive both responses in a disordered Rashba metal using quantum kinetics and diagrammatics with impurity-renormalized optical vertices, providing the first unified diagrammatic derivation of spin and orbital IFE. Treating impurity scattering consistently, our number-conserving kinetic formulation restores full phase-space derivatives and the optical magnetic field neglected in earlier treatments. We connect nonlinear orbital magnetization to absorptive linear optical conductivity, revealing that the magnetic Lorentz force supplies half the orbital response. Our unified treatment resolves both channels across the Rashba resonance: spin IFE changes sign as frequency increases, while the orbital IFE dominates, keeping the direction of the total magnetization unchanged.
articles.abstract_zh: 逆法拉第效应（IFE）为量子材料中磁矩的光学控制提供了前景。本文利用量子动力学和图解法，首次统一推导了无序Rashba金属中自旋和轨道IFE的响应。研究发现，非线性轨道磁化与吸收性线性光学电导率相关，且磁洛伦兹力贡献了轨道响应的一半。该统一处理揭示了在Rashba共振下，自旋IFE随频率增加而变号，而轨道IFE占据主导地位，保持总磁化方向不变。

articles.title: Long-range entangled criticality from coherent errors
articles.title_zh: 相干误差引起的远程纠缠临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03811v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We find that coherent error can induce a phase transition from the clean surface code phase into an extended long-range entangled critical regime with diverging Markov length. To demonstrate this, we establish two general results of independent interest. The first relates topology and quantum information to mixed-state entanglement: we show that when a noise channel acting on a topological code preserves a higher-form symmetry and nonzero coherent information, the noisy state for generic logical input is long-range entangled. The second generalizes the local recovery construction based on finite Markov length to any locally parameterized family, thus encompassing local Lindbladian evolution, coherent errors followed by syndrome dephasing, and thermal states. We apply these results to the honeycomb surface code, in which we find an extended long-range entangled critical regime that is a quasi-long-ranged counterpart of 1-form strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking. As a byproduct of these studies, we relate the conditional mutual information to conductance in a Majorana network model.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文发现相干误差能诱导表面码从纯净相转变为具有发散马尔可夫长度的扩展远程纠缠临界区域。研究建立了两个通用结果：一是将拓扑和量子信息与混合态纠缠联系起来，表明在特定噪声条件下，拓扑码的噪声态是远程纠缠的；二是将基于有限马尔可夫长度的局部恢复构造推广到任意局部参数化族。这些结果应用于蜂窝表面码，揭示了一个扩展的远程纠缠临界区域，并附带地将条件互信息与马约拉纳网络模型中的电导联系起来。
authors: Amir-Reza Negari, Subhayan Sahu, Jan Behrends, Benjamin Béri, Timothy H. Hsieh

articles.title: Analog quantum simulation of paraparticle statistics
articles.title_zh: 准粒子统计的模拟量子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03908v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bosonic and fermionic quantum statistics describe all known elementary and emergent particles in three dimensions, although many attempts have been made to discover other valid quantum statistical frameworks. One recent formulation proposes "R-paraparticles," indistinguishable particles with nonlocal internal degrees of freedom governed by generalized exchange rules [Wang and Hazzard, Nature 637, 314 (2025)]. Here, we emulate a species of paraparticle that exhibits a generalized Pauli exclusion principle using a superconducting qubit lattice. We confirm its unique quantum statistics by measuring a 180ⁱ̧rc phase shift under paraparticle exchange, observing antibunching independent of internal degrees of freedom under two-particle interference at a beamsplitter, and finding a thermal occupation inconsistent with both Bose-Einstein and Fermi-Dirac statistics. These results demonstrate that parastatistics are observable on quantum simulation platforms, further motivating their use to explore theorized new phases of matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 玻色子和费米子统计描述了三维中所有已知的基本粒子和涌现粒子，但仍有研究探索其他量子统计框架。本文利用超导量子比特晶格模拟了一种遵循广义泡利不相容原理的准粒子。通过测量准粒子交换下的180度相移、在分束器处观察到与内部自由度无关的反聚束现象，以及发现与玻色-爱因斯坦和费米-狄拉克统计不符的热占据，证实了其独特的量子统计。这些结果表明准粒子统计可在量子模拟平台上观测，为探索新的物质相提供了动力。
authors: Gyunghun Kim, Cora N. Barrett, Sarah E. Muschinske, Junyoung An, Helin Zhang, Ilan T. Rosen, Rabindra Das, Michael A. Gingras, David K. Kim, Bethany M. Niedzielski, Meghan Schuldt, Jonilyn L. Yoder, Mollie E. Schwartz, Kyle Serniak, Jeffrey A. Grover, Max Hays, William D. Oliver

articles.title: Pump quantization changes optimal measurements for quantum sensing
articles.title_zh: 泵浦量子化改变量子传感的最佳测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03943v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Standard analyses of quantum phase sensing often neglect the overhead of generating squeezed-light by treating the pump as an undepleted classical resource. Realistically, the pump is a quantum object that undergoes significant depletion and entangles with the produced squeezed light, raising the question of how the crossover from a classical to a quantum pump limits the quantum advantage in sensing. Contrary to prior analyses, we show that quantum advantage persists despite pump quantization, but depends critically on the nonlinear (ḩi⁽²⁾) source dynamics. In particular, we demonstrate that Heisenberg scaling emerges in the regime of strong pump depletion, rather than maximum signal squeezing. At maximum squeezing, the quantum Fisher information (QFI) for interferometric sensing of an unknown phase scales as N³/², where N is the pump photon number, surpassing the shot-noise limit but establishing that squeezing itself is insufficient to attain Heisenberg scaling of N². At maximal pump depletion, where the signal flux is maximized, the QFI scales as N². In this regime, standard photon counting is suboptimal, while a joint nonlinear measurement of the entire pump-signal system is shown to achieve Heisenberg scaling. Our work shows that pump quantization changes both the optimal operating point and the measurement strategies required to preserve a realistic quantum advantage in phase estimation and, more broadly, many-body quantum dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子相位传感的传统分析常将泵浦视为未耗尽的经典资源，忽略了产生压缩光的开销。本文研究了泵浦量子化对量子传感优势的影响，发现量子优势在泵浦量子化下依然存在，但关键取决于非线性源动力学。研究表明，海森堡标度出现在强泵浦耗尽而非最大信号压缩的区域。在最大泵浦耗尽时，量子费雪信息（QFI）可达到N²标度，此时标准光子计数不再是最优测量。
authors: S. A. Wadood, L. Bello, T. Ilias, J. W. Fleischer

articles.title: The Impact of Internal Electric Fields on Accurate Diamond Magnetometry
articles.title_zh: 内部电场对金刚石磁力计精度的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03984v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center spin ensembles are a promising platform for accurate vector magnetometry, as they offer measurements referenced to a spin Hamiltonian in an anisotropic crystal with native vector sensing capabilities. However, charged dopants within the diamond produce random internal electric fields (RIEFs) that shift NV spin-transition frequencies, and their impact on the accuracy of NV magnetometry has not been investigated. Here, we characterize RIEFs' effect on NV spin-transition spectra and propose an analytical fitting function to improve accuracy in their presence. We build a Monte Carlo RIEF model that reproduces the asymmetric lineshapes observed in experimental optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) spectra, and use it as a testbed to quantify RIEF-induced errors by simulating ODMR spectra including RIEFs and comparing reconstructed magnetic fields to the known model input. With standard analysis approaches, we observe systematic errors exceeding the g-factor uncertainty in fields below sim 5 mT, while the proposed fitting function reduces the error by nearly an order of magnitude. Our results demonstrate that RIEFs can play a significant role in the systematic error budget for NV magnetometry, and offer a path towards improved accuracy in NV quantum sensing.
articles.abstract_zh: 氮空位（NV）中心自旋系综是实现精确矢量磁力计的有前景平台。然而，金刚石内部的带电掺杂物会产生随机内部电场（RIEFs），其对NV磁力计精度的影响尚未被充分研究。本文表征了RIEFs对NV自旋跃迁光谱的影响，并提出了一种分析拟合函数以提高其存在下的测量精度。通过蒙特卡洛RIEF模型模拟ODMR光谱并量化RIEF引起的误差，结果显示，在低于5 mT的磁场中，标准分析方法会导致系统误差超过g因子不确定性，而所提出的拟合函数能将误差降低近一个数量级。
authors: Jack Faller, Daphne Freda Gavras, Andrew Lowther, Romain Ruhlmann, Lilian Childress

articles.title: Gaussian Quantum Integrated Sensing and Communication
articles.title_zh: 高斯量子集成传感与通信
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04047v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider a quantum integrated sensing and communication problem over an optical link in which a low-power transmitter simultaneously communicates with a receiver and identifies the range of a defect producing a backscattered signal. We model the system as a lossy thermal-noise bosonic channel, in which the target, modeled as a beamsplitter, affects the timing of the backscattered signal through its location. Motivated by the envisioned deployment of entanglement-enabled quantum networks, we develop two protocols that allow the transmitter to leverage shared Gaussian entanglement, in the form of independent two-mode squeezed vacuum states or coupled three-mode squeezed vacuum states, to assist both sensing and communication. Since entanglement is known to enhance sensing, as demonstrated in quantum illumination, and to increase communication rates through entanglement-assisted communication, the transmitter faces a trade-off in allocating its entanglement resources between the two tasks. Our main results characterize these trade-offs under the proposed protocols in terms of achievable communication rate/sensing error-exponent regions, which outperform time-sharing schemes and demonstrate a quantum advantage.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了光链路上的量子集成传感与通信问题，其中低功率发射器同时与接收器通信并识别缺陷的距离。系统被建模为有损热噪声玻色子信道，目标通过其位置影响反向散射信号的时序。受纠缠量子网络部署的启发，研究开发了两种协议，使发射器能够利用共享的高斯纠缠（独立双模压缩真空态或耦合三模压缩真空态）来辅助传感和通信。主要结果表征了在所提出的协议下，可实现的通信速率/传感误差指数区域中的这些权衡。
authors: Tuna Erdoğan, Shi-Yuan Wang, Shang-Jen Su, Matthieu R. Bloch

articles.title: Entanglement Allocation for Quantum Integrated Sensing and Communication
articles.title_zh: 量子集成传感与通信中的纠缠分配
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04128v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Jointly supporting communication and distributed sensing over a shared, limited pool of entanglement resources is an attractive prospect for future quantum networks. We develop a network-level quantum integrated sensing and communication (Q-ISAC) framework in which a quantum base station dynamically allocates elementary Bell pairs between communication users and distributed sensing. Sensing resources are adaptively partitioned among multiple GHZ probes with dynamically selected sizes and sensing-node assignments. We derive an effective quantum Fisher information model accounting for probabilistic fusion, transmission loss, and memory decoherence, and formulate a finite-horizon allocation problem subject to communication QoS, expected sensing-information, sensing-reliability, and hardware constraints. A hierarchical constrained proximal policy optimization (HC-PPO) framework combines learned discrete sensing allocation with analytical continuous communication allocation. Numerical results show that GHZ probing requires approximately 27--30% fewer sensing qubits than separable probing under modest probe-size caps and 65-67% fewer at the highest considered target under the same sensing requirements. Adaptive multi-GHZ partitioning provides greater robustness than single-GHZ sensing, while adaptive communication--sensing sharing outperforms the evaluated fixed splits. The proposed HC-PPO framework satisfies the joint requirements in at least 99.9% of test instances across the considered sensing targets and fusion probabilities. Monte Carlo evaluation separately shows that realized terminal information reached its target in 96-98% of realizations, distinguishing expected-information satisfaction from realized sensing performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 在未来量子网络中，利用有限的共享纠缠资源同时支持通信和分布式传感具有吸引力。本文开发了一个网络级量子集成传感与通信（Q-ISAC）框架，其中量子基站动态地在通信用户和分布式传感之间分配基本贝尔对。传感资源在多个GHZ探针之间自适应划分，并动态选择探针大小和传感节点分配。研究推导了一个考虑概率融合、传输损耗和存储退相干的有效量子费雪信息模型，并提出了一个受通信QoS、预期传感信息、传感可靠性和硬件约束的有限时域分配问题。数值结果表明，在适度的探针大小限制下，GHZ探测比可分离探测所需的传感量子比特少约27-30%。
authors: Shiva Kazemi Taskooh, Mehdi Monemi, Ekram Hossain, Georges Kaddoum, Mehdi Rasti

articles.title: Initialization-controlled fault sensitivity and force-balance plateaus in noisy variational quantum optimization
articles.title_zh: 噪声变分量子优化中初始化控制的故障敏感性和力平衡平台
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04198v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study deep variational circuits for a periodic Heisenberg chain under local gate depolarization, at depths where noiseless training is coherently exact. Full-width initializations reach low coherent error faster than circuits with confined transverse generators, but incur a larger noise shift and need an order of magnitude more updates for noisy convergence. In many-body-localization-inspired initialization, bounding the initial transverse generator amplitudes keeps the operator support localized and suffices for low-fragility optimization, so longitudinal disorder and Floquet layer repetition are unnecessary. The fault-erasure fraction, the mean fraction of coherent energy removed per fault, sets the effective visibility through a parameter-free exponential model. Full-width circuits start with delocalized operator support, and once coherent energy builds up, each fault erases nearly all of it. Initially, their noise-induced gradient almost uniformly attenuates the coherent gradient, so coherent descent proceeds at the noiseless rate. They then stall on a high-noise force-balance plateau, where finite coherent and noise-induced gradients cancel to first order. At late times all initializations reach the same fault-erasure fraction and noisy-error band, but operator support contracts more slowly, at a rate set by the plateau residence time.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了局部门去极化下周期性海森堡链的深度变分电路。结果表明，全宽度初始化虽然能更快达到低相干误差，但会引入更大的噪声偏移，且需要更多更新才能收敛。受多体局域化启发的初始化方法，通过限制初始横向生成器幅度，可保持算符支持的局域性，足以实现低脆弱性优化。研究还发现，故障擦除分数通过无参数指数模型设定了有效可见性，全宽度电路最终会停滞在高噪声力平衡平台上。
authors: Longhui Shen, Fangzhou Jin, Bin Guo

articles.title: Information-Geometric Representation of Upper Bounds on Fluctuation Growth in Open Quantum Systems
articles.title_zh: 开放量子系统涨落增长上限的信息几何表示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04263v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Building on our earlier results for closed quantum systems, we investigate the dynamical evolution of quantum fluctuations and their connections to Fisher information and the quantum operations describing open-system dynamics. Starting from a general expression for the time derivative of an observable's uncertainty, we derive an alternative upper bound on fluctuation growth in an open quantum system using the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality. The resulting bound separates contributions from the evolution of the quantum state and the explicit time dependence of the observable, reducing to a known result for closed-system dynamics. We then establish a connection between fluctuation dynamics and quantum Fisher information by decomposing the density operator and the symmetric logarithmic derivative (SLD) into coherent and incoherent contributions, which leads to a bound relating the evolution of observable uncertainty to the coherent and incoherent components of the Fisher information, providing an information-geometric interpretation of fluctuation growth. To connect fluctuation dynamics with quantum operations governing open-system evolutions, we derive the time evolution of the eigenvalues of the density operator in terms of Kraus operators. Using the infinitesimal-time relation between Kraus and Lindblad operators, we obtain a corresponding expression for the eigenvalue dynamics in terms of Lindblad operators. This formulation directly relates changes in the density operator eigenvalues to the quantum processes acting on the system. We then study the results using some examples. Our results provide a framework connecting observable fluctuation growth, Fisher information, and the Kraus and Lindblad descriptions of quantum evolution, offering a route toward understanding how specific quantum channels influence the information and fluctuations available in an evolving quantum system.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于封闭量子系统的研究，探讨了开放量子系统中量子涨落的动态演化及其与费雪信息和量子操作的联系。通过柯西-施瓦茨不等式，推导了可观测物不确定性增长的替代上限，该上限将量子态演化和可观测物显式时间依赖性的贡献分离。研究还通过将密度算符和对称对数导数分解为相干和非相干部分，建立了涨落动力学与量子费雪信息之间的联系，从而为涨落增长提供了信息几何解释。
authors: Newshaw Bahreyni, Paul M. Alsing

articles.title: Reasoning about Shared-Qubit Concurrency in Quantum Computing
articles.title_zh: 量子计算中共享量子比特并发的推理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04274v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper, we develop a semantic model for the parallel execution of quantum circuits, providing a formal foundation for studying shared-qubit concurrency in quantum computing. As in classical shared-memory concurrency, parallel quantum circuits may interfere with one another through operations on shared qubits. However, quantum entanglement and the noncommutativity of quantum operations introduce additional challenges for reasoning about their correctness. To address these challenges, we generalise the classical Owicki-Gries method to quantum computing at the level of quantum circuits. Our approach enables compositional reasoning about parallel quantum circuits by separating the verification of individual components from the analysis of interference between them. We formulate proof rules for establishing the correctness of parallel quantum circuits and prove their soundness with respect to the proposed semantic model.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为量子电路的并行执行开发了一个语义模型，为研究量子计算中的共享量子比特并发提供了形式化基础。与经典共享内存并发类似，并行量子电路可能通过共享量子比特上的操作相互干扰。为解决量子纠缠和量子操作非交换性带来的挑战，研究将经典的Owicki-Gries方法推广到量子电路层面。该方法通过将单个组件的验证与它们之间的干扰分析分离，实现了对并行量子电路的组合推理，并提出了证明规则，证明了其相对于所提出语义模型的完备性。
authors: Mingsheng Ying

articles.title: An example of universal braiding in Links--Gould topological quantum computation
articles.title_zh: Links-Gould拓扑量子计算中普适编织的一个例子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04290v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct a universal quantum computational encoding via braiding in Links--Gould fusion spaces associated to U_q^H(mathfraksl(2|1)) where q is on the unit circle and is not a root of unity. The construction uses only neglectons and is realized in the morphism spaces HomU_q^H(V(0,α),V(0,-frac12)øtⁱmes ²Nøtimes V(0,α)). Under explicit positivity and arithmetic constraints these spaces admit a 2^N-dimensional computational subspace with a positive definite Hermitian form. We prove single-qubit density in U(2,1) and approximate arbitrary unitary operators on N-qubit computational subspaces with arbitrarily small leakage. The calculations use explicit inclusions, projections, and Hermitian pairings without requiring F-matrices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过在与U_q^H(mathfraksl(2|1))相关的Links-Gould融合空间中进行编织，构建了一种普适量子计算编码。该构造仅使用“neglectons”，并在特定的态空间中实现。在明确的正性和算术约束下，这些空间支持一个具有正定厄米形式的2^N维计算子空间。研究证明了U(2,1)中的单量子比特密度，并能以任意小的泄漏近似N量子比特计算子空间上的任意酉算符。
authors: Matthew Harper, Ben-Michael Kohli

articles.title: On the Hardness of Approximate Quantum Circuit Membership and Optimization
articles.title_zh: 近似量子电路成员资格和优化的难度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04381v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum circuit optimization is an indispensable component of the quantum software stack, used to reduce noise, maximize performance, alleviate costs of quantum error correction, or target specific hardware. A related problem is approximate membership: for a fixed set of unitaries S, decide whether a given circuit C is within distance ǎrepsilon of a unitary in S under some metric m. Membership is a special case of optimization, where S is a set of unitaries implementable at no cost (e.g., with noise-minimal circuits, or without magic states). Janzing, Wocjan, and Beth (Int. J. Quantum Inf., 2005) showed that, for the operator metric, the case S=I (approximate identity) is QMA-complete when C is promised to be either close to the identity or far from it. We generalize this setting in three directions: (i) promise-free inputs, (ii) besides S=I, sets S containing only Clifford unitaries, or only generalized permutation matrices (i.e., no superposition), and (iii) the trace-based, spectral, and operator metrics. We show that, in all cases, approximate membership is PP-hard for wide ranges of ǎrepsilon, provided C's gate-set can implement Clifford+T, as the gate-sets of standard hardware do. If S=I, or if S contains only generalized permutation matrices, Iin S, and m is a trace-based distance, PP-hardness holds for all non-trivial ǎrepsilon. If S=I and m is a trace-based distance, PP-hardness holds even for circuits over classical-reversible gate-sets. Our results indicate that approximate membership is harder over promise-free inputs than the QMA-complete promise version, and that this hardness persists across quantum resources (any gates, non-Clifford, superposition) and distance metrics. They directly imply PP-hardness of circuit optimization when minimizing total, non-Clifford, or superposition gate depth or count.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子电路优化是量子软件栈中不可或缺的组成部分，而近似成员资格问题是其相关问题。本文将Janzing等人（2005）关于近似恒等式是QMA完全问题的结果推广到三个方向：无承诺输入、包含Clifford酉算符或广义置换矩阵的集合S，以及基于迹、谱和算符的度量。研究表明，在所有情况下，对于广泛的ε范围，近似成员资格问题都是PP难的，前提是电路的门集可以实现普适计算。
authors: Adam Husted Kjelstrøm, Jaco van de Pol, Andreas Pavlogiannis

articles.title: Motional Decoherence of the internal state of an atom by vacuum and thermal fluctuations of a quantum field: Necessity of a fully relativistic treatment
articles.title_zh: 量子场真空和热涨落引起的原子内态运动退相干：完全相对论处理的必要性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04512v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider a massive object, such as a neutral atom or an Unruh-DeWitt detector, moving at constant speed in a quantum field and investigate how motion affects the quantum coherence of its internal degrees of freedom, manifesting as quantum dispersion in the absence of a quantum field, and decoherence in its presence. Our investigation aims to serve two purposes: One is to obtain the correct results for these effects, which are essential for the design of quantum information processing schemes where the quantum coherence of an atom's internal degrees of freedom is of major concern. The other is to expose the fallacies in commonplace approaches, which start with a non-relativistic calculation and then add on relativistic ``corrections". We first show a fully relativistic calculation of the internal dynamics based on covariance principles, and then one which ignores these principles, often justified by the atom's slow motion. By a direct comparison of results from these two approaches, we identify significant discrepancies in a non-relativistic treatment, even at low atomic speeds. The proper procedure, and a much safer one in terms of accuracy, is recommended here: first derive the dynamics and the necessary regularizations within a fully covariant relativistic framework. Only after the exact, internally consistent equations of motion are established should low-velocity limits be extracted from them. Only in this way can all the relativistic effects which matter: time dilation, aberration, non-inertial mass shifts, be systematically preserved, and accurate results obtained.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在量子场中以恒定速度运动的物体（如中性原子）的内态量子相干性如何受运动影响。研究旨在获得这些效应的正确结果，并揭示常见非相对论处理方法的谬误。通过基于协变原理的完全相对论计算与忽略这些原理的计算进行直接比较，即使在低原子速度下，也发现了非相对论处理的显著差异。这强调了在量子信息处理方案设计中，采用完全相对论方法处理原子内态运动退相干的必要性。
authors: Jen-Tsung Hsiang, Bei-Lok Hu

articles.title: Wigner-Function Fingerprints of Collective Excitations in Mirror-Terminated Waveguide QED
articles.title_zh: 镜像端接波导QED中集体激发的Wigner函数指纹
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04553v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the emission profiles of singly excited collective states and propose a matched-mode witnessing protocol in a mirror-terminated waveguide quantum electrodynamics system. The amplitudes and relative phases of the initial collective excitation are encoded in the temporal mode of the emitted single-photon wavepacket, providing a route to state verification through the common waveguide output. We identify the emission mode associated with a chosen target state and employ an auxiliary virtual-cavity representation to evaluate the quantum state of this selected output mode. For a matched initial state, the selected mode contains the emitted single photon, whose Wigner function exhibits a pronounced non-classical negative dip, serving as a distinct fingerprint of the target many-body state. With the reference mode held fixed, different initial configurations yield different photon occupations and phase-space distributions, demonstrating the state selectivity of the protocol. These results connect collective-state verification with temporal-mode analysis of the emitted radiation, offering access to collective coherence with reduced reliance on qubit-resolved correlation measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了镜像端接波导量子电动力学系统中单激发集体态的发射剖面，并提出了一种匹配模式鉴别协议。该协议通过发射的单光子波包的时间模式编码初始集体激发的幅度和相对相位，从而实现态的验证。研究发现，对于匹配的初始态，选定模式中的单光子Wigner函数呈现出显著的非经典负值凹陷，可作为目标多体态的独特指纹。这些结果将集体态验证与发射辐射的时间模式分析联系起来，为集体相干性研究提供了新途径。
authors: Kuan-Ting Lin, Chen-Yu Lee, Yu-Chen Lin, Ting Hsu, Guin-Dar Lin

articles.title: Breakdown of Linearized Dispersion in Waveguide QED
articles.title_zh: 波导QED中线性色散近似的失效
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04656v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exploring interactions between quantum emitters and guided photons, waveguide quantum electrodynamics (wQED) offers a versatile platform for quantum simulation and quantum interconnect. To simplify the quantized light-matter interactions, a linearized dispersion approximation (LDA) was widely used in wQED under the conditions of weak coupling and narrow photonic bandwidth. However, a growing number of strong-coupling wQED experiments have called the validity of LDA into question. Here, by investigating giant atoms coupled to a semi-infinite waveguide, we propose a principle to judge the validity of LDA. We find that the decoherence of the atoms exhibits rich dynamical behaviors determined by different numbers of bound states in and out of the continuum (BICs and BOCs) formed in the energy spectrum of the total atom-photon system. Based on this, we show that despite the LDA can partially preserve some of BICs, it completely erases BOCs. This causes the dominant role of LDA in the atomic dynamics to break down. Providing a physical insight into the validity of LDA, our results lay a firm foundation for exploring fundamental physics and its application frontier in strong-coupling wQED platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 波导量子电动力学（wQED）是量子模拟和量子互连的重要平台。本文通过研究巨原子与半无限波导的耦合，提出了判断wQED中线性色散近似（LDA）有效性的原则。研究发现，原子退相干行为受原子-光子系统能谱中束缚态（BICs和BOCs）数量的影响。结果表明，LDA虽然能部分保留BICs，但完全抹去了BOCs，导致其在原子动力学中的主导作用失效。这些发现为深入理解LDA的有效性提供了物理见解。
authors: H. Z. Shen, Ze Wang, X. X. Yi, Jun-Hong An

articles.title: Quantum Simulation of Electronic Structure using Quantum Density Functional Theory on a Programmable Integrated Photonic Circuit
articles.title_zh: 基于可编程集成光子电路的量子密度泛函理论电子结构量子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04694v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum simulations of molecular electronic structure hold the potential for computational advantage but are inherently limited by the linear scaling of qubit requirements with respect to system size. Quantum Density Functional Theory (Q-DFT) addresses this constraint by reformulating the interacting many-body problem in terms of a non-interacting Kohn--Sham reference system. Here, we present and experimentally validate a Q-DFT algorithm that requires only O(łog₂₍N)) qubits to simulate a system of N orbitals, thereby reducing resource overhead. More precisely, we solve the Kohn--Sham problem for the lithium hydride (LiH) molecule using the ensemble extension of the variational quantum eigensolver paradigm that minimizes the energy of the system in the subspace spanned by the ground and first excited states. To execute this task, we encode the problem with qubits on a quantum photonic platform, utilizing an architecture that combines a deterministic quantum dot single-photon source with a programmable integrated photonic circuit. By evaluating the molecular ground- and first excited-state properties, this work establishes a pathway for simulating larger molecular systems, demonstrating the viability of integrating qubit-efficient algorithms with advanced reconfigurable photonic hardware for near-term quantum chemistry applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 分子电子结构的量子模拟面临量子比特需求随系统尺寸线性增长的限制。本文提出并实验验证了一种量子密度泛函理论（Q-DFT）算法，仅需O(log₂N)个量子比特即可模拟N个轨道的系统，显著降低了资源开销。该工作利用变分量子本征求解器范式的系综扩展，在量子光子平台上求解了氢化锂（LiH）分子的Kohn-Sham问题。通过评估分子的基态和第一激发态性质，该研究为高效的电子结构量子模拟开辟了新途径。
authors: Giovanni Adriano, Akilan Rajamani, Francesco Hoch, Farrokh Labib, Nadja Z. Zaouri, Eugenio Caruccio, Gonzalo Carvacho, Nicolò Spagnolo, Riccardo Albiero, Giacomo Corrielli, Francesco Ceccarelli, Jean-Sebastien Filhol, Roberto Osellame, Taira Giordani, Fabio Sciarrino, Nathan Shammah, Bruno Senjean

articles.title: Temporal stretching of single-photon pulses by intra-cavity frequency conversion
articles.title_zh: 通过腔内频率转换实现单光子脉冲的时间展宽
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04771v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spectral bandwidth and frequency mismatch between quantum light emitters and quantum components is a common problem in the realization of hybrid quantum information networks. Here we propose a simultaneous solution to both of these problems by using a free-space cavity with an embedded nonlinear crystal that, through frequency conversion, facilitates perfect coupling into a cavity mode. The slow leakage of the cavity effectively stretches the photon pulse, resulting in a much longer photon pulse at a different wavelength. We show that the amount of stretching is strictly limited by the finesse and length of the cavity. Including realistic internal losses in the cavity, we show that it is possible to stretch a photon by at least two orders of magnitude with high efficiency. The proposed setup can thus constitute a valuable addition to the toolbox of quantum information technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子光源与量子组件之间的光谱带宽和频率失配是混合量子信息网络中的常见问题。本文提出了一种利用嵌入非线性晶体的自由空间腔来同时解决这两个问题的方法。通过频率转换，该方案能实现光子与腔模式的完美耦合，并通过腔的缓慢泄漏有效展宽光子脉冲，使其在不同波长下变得更长。研究表明，在考虑实际腔内损耗的情况下，可以高效地将光子展宽至少两个数量级。该方案为量子信息技术提供了一个有价值的工具。
authors: Mathias L. H. Korsgaard, Eva M. González-Ruiz, Anders S. Sørensen

articles.title: Bulk and edge states in Fibonacci-Bose-Hubbard clusters
articles.title_zh: 斐波那契-玻色-哈伯德簇中的体态和边缘态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04777v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the one- and two-boson energy subspaces of finite open Bose--Hubbard chains with Fibonacci-modulated hopping and zero on-site potential. Their spectra exhibit a hierarchy of bands and gaps, and a critical zero-energy mode for odd lengths, in agreement with prior research. For the singe-excitation subspace we find two families of length-invariant finite-energy states localized at the left cluster boundary. For the two-boson subspace, we report both doublon and separated-pair excitations in the form of Tamm/Shockley states localized near either end. In particular, the right-edge doublon states occur across all Fibonacci generations whereas the left-side states appear every second generation. We check numerically that the second-order perturbation theory accounts well for the structure of the spectrum and the edge states in the doublon subspace in the strong-coupling regime. The results are useful for future explorations of many-body physics beyond numerical tractability, specifically using near-term Josephson quantum simulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有斐波那契调制跳跃和零在位势的有限开放玻色-哈伯德链的一玻色子和二玻色子能量子空间。研究发现，其能谱呈现出能带和能隙的层次结构，并在奇数长度下存在临界零能量模式。对于单激发子空间，发现了两类局域在左簇边界的长度不变有限能量态。在二玻色子子空间中，观察到以Tamm/Shockley态形式存在的双子和分离对激发，这些态局域在链的两端。这些结果对于未来利用近期约瑟夫森量子模拟器探索超越数值可处理范围的多体物理学具有重要意义。
authors: G. P. Fedorov, E. E. Konopleva, O. V. Astafiev

articles.title: Autonomous cooling of Kerr-cat qubits to minutes-long bit-flip times
articles.title_zh: Kerr猫量子比特的自主冷却实现分钟级比特翻转时间
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04868v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum error correction becomes more hardware efficient when physical noise is strongly biased towards one error channel. Cat qubits realize such a bias by encoding information in two opposite coherent states of a superconducting oscillator, so that bit flips are exponentially suppressed with photon number while phase-flip rates increase only linearly. In Kerr-cat qubits, a driven double-well potential confines these states and enables fast coherent control, but excitations can induce interwell switching, limiting bit-flip times to milliseconds. Here we show that the nonlinear interaction generating the confinement can also cool these excitations. When an intra-well transition becomes resonant with a lossy readout mode, excitations are transferred out of the qubit and dissipated, as established by spectroscopy and relaxation measurements. We observe the predicted exponential scaling of Kerr-cat bit-flip times with photon number, reaching 450 s, over five orders of magnitude beyond previous demonstrations. Phase-flip rates remain consistent with intrinsic photon loss at operating points with seconds-long bit-flip times. We further demonstrate fast Z gates without measurable degradation of bit-flip protection and single-shot readout with a bit-flip probability below 10⁻⁶ per measurement. Autonomous cooling thus brings minutes-long bit-flip protection to Kerr-cat qubits while retaining fast coherent control, without additional cooling drives or circuit elements.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子纠错在物理噪声偏向单一错误通道时效率更高，Kerr猫量子比特通过将信息编码在超导振荡器的两个相反相干态中实现这种偏置。本文展示了Kerr猫量子比特中产生限制的非线性相互作用也能冷却激发，从而将比特翻转时间延长至450秒，比以往提高了五个数量级。当阱内跃迁与有损读出模式共振时，激发被转移出量子比特并耗散。该研究为实现长寿命量子信息存储和处理提供了重要进展。
authors: Sergey Hazanov, Mikhail Svintsov, Uri Goldblatt, Barkay Guttel, Fabien Lafont, Serge Rosenblum

articles.title: Quantum sensing of a weak drive signal in cascaded quantum van der Pol oscillators
articles.title_zh: 级联量子范德波尔振荡器中弱驱动信号的量子传感
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04895v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We have constructed a quantum sensing system composed of two quantum van der Pol (vdP) oscillators. Coherent and dissipative couplings are combined to establish a generic nonreciprocal coupling between the two vdP subsystems. A weak driving signal to be measured is applied to an oscillator (probe system) and then transferred via non-reciprocal coupling to another oscillator (measurement system) that is easier to measure. This allows for the acquisition of information about the driving strength of the signal being measured. For the classic cascaded dual vdP oscillators, complete non-reciprocal coupling yields a much higher susceptibility than a single classical vdP oscillator alone. For the quantum vdP system, the sensitivity generally does not diverge at the zero driving force point. When only dissipative coupling and two-particle loss are present, the system will have a dark mode at the zero driving force point, which enables the measurement precision to ultimately reach the Heisenberg limit in the time domain. Enhancing incoherent driving can effectively resist dissipation and thereby improve measurement precision. Moreover, in the strong incoherent driving regime, the improvement factor of non-reciprocal coupling over reciprocal coupling in terms of measurement precision tends to infinity as the two-particle loss rate of the measurement system approaches zero.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个由两个量子范德波尔（vdP）振荡器组成的量子传感系统，通过相干和耗散耦合建立了两个vdP子系统之间的通用非互易耦合。一个待测的弱驱动信号施加到探测振荡器，并通过非互易耦合传输到易于测量的测量振荡器。研究发现，在仅存在耗散耦合和双粒子损耗时，系统在零驱动力点具有暗模式，使测量精度最终达到海森堡极限。增强非相干驱动可以有效抵抗耗散，从而提高测量精度。
authors: Dong Xie, Chungling Xu

articles.title: Transferable Lindblad Variational Ansatz for Accelerated Steady-State Preparation
articles.title_zh: 可迁移的Lindblad变分Ansatz用于加速稳态制备
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04919v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Open quantum systems naturally relax toward steady states that underpin diverse nonequilibrium phenomena and quantum technologies. We independently control the coherent and dissipative constituents of a Lindblad generator to construct a variational product formula, termed the Lindblad variational ansatz (LVA), that accelerates steady-state preparation over natural relaxation through an optimized preparation path. The protocol consists of small-system learning, continuation to greater depth, and transfer to larger systems, followed when needed by reference-free post-training on quantum simulators. We demonstrate LVA in a bulk-dissipative Ising chain and a boundary-driven Heisenberg chain, where transferred protocols achieve matched preparation accuracies with fewer generator blocks than time-optimized first- and second-order Trotter formulas. The acceleration arises from coordinated endpoint preparation: earlier controls shape the dissipative-mode amplitudes so that the final dissipative step brings multiple components simultaneously close to their target values. Our results suggest a route to open-system quantum simulation that combines classical training on small systems with deployment and optional refinement on larger quantum devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 开放量子系统自然弛豫到稳态，这支撑着各种非平衡现象和量子技术。本文提出了一种Lindblad变分Ansatz（LVA），通过独立控制Lindblad生成器的相干和耗散部分，构建变分乘积公式，以优化制备路径加速稳态制备。该协议包括小系统学习、深度扩展和向大系统迁移，并在需要时进行无参考的量子模拟器后训练。研究表明，LVA在体耗散Ising链和边界驱动Heisenberg链中，以更少的生成器块实现了与时间优化Trotter公式相当的制备精度。
authors: Yun-Zhuo Fan, Dan-Bo Zhang

articles.title: Synchronization Mpemba Effect
articles.title_zh: 同步Mpemba效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04994v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce the synchronization Mpemba effect, in which a less synchronized initial state overtakes a more synchronized one, and demonstrate it in dissipatively coupled quantum van der Pol oscillators. Within a graph-Laplacian framework, we show that for two oscillators, the mechanism is a competition between a slowly decaying collective background and a fast transverse transient, equivalently an exchange between relative-mode displacement and phase-fluctuation errors. The same decomposition extends to networks: the synchronization error splits into transverse Laplacian modes, yielding closed-form crossing times from eigenvalue separations and initial mode weights, and a sufficient screening criterion. With only these eigenvalues entering, the rule is topology independent: crossing times of different networks collapse onto a single spectral-gap line. Thus, quantum many-body dynamics can be designed and controlled at low dimension without constructing the exponentially large Liouvillian, opening a route to quantum synchronization as a resource.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了同步Mpemba效应，即一个同步程度较低的初始态超越一个同步程度较高的初始态，并在耗散耦合的量子范德波尔振荡器中进行了演示。在图拉普拉斯框架下，研究揭示了该效应的机制是缓慢衰减的集体背景与快速横向瞬态之间的竞争。这种分解可扩展到网络，同步误差分裂为横向拉普拉斯模式，从而得到与拓扑无关的交叉时间。该研究为在低维度下设计和控制量子多体动力学开辟了新途径，将量子同步作为一种资源。
authors: Yan Li, Wenlin Li, Xingli Li

articles.title: QECert: Formal Foundations for Quantum Error-Correction Theory in Lean
articles.title_zh: QECert：Lean中量子纠错理论的形式化基础
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05047v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum error correction provides the mathematical basis for protecting quantum information against noise. Existing formalizations have established foundations for stabilizer codes and code verification. However, a systematic formal treatment of the asymptotic constructions and fundamental limitations that underpin scalable quantum error correction is still needed. We present QECert, a Lean library providing reusable formal foundations for these theoretical questions. It connects quantum error-correction criteria, stabilizer and Calderbank-Shor-Steane codes, and algebraic and homological constructions within a common framework. Asymptotically good quantum low density parity check codes provide the principal case study. We formalize constructions and asymptotic parameter theorems spanning hypergraph products, balanced products, lifted products, and quantum Tanner codes. Further developments cover Bravyi-Poulin-Terhal bounds and related locality restrictions, constant overhead magic state distillation, and energy barriers and storage errors for quantum memories. QECert establishes a reusable formal foundation for studying the capabilities, resource requirements, and fundamental limitations of quantum error correction, supporting systematic verification and further development of its theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子纠错为保护量子信息免受噪声影响提供了数学基础。本文介绍了QECert，一个在Lean中提供可重用形式化基础的库，旨在系统地处理可扩展量子纠错的渐近构造和基本限制。QECert将量子纠错标准、稳定子码、Calderbank-Shor-Steane码以及代数和同调构造连接在一个通用框架内。该工作以渐近优良的量子低密度奇偶校验码为例，形式化了超图积、平衡积、提升积和量子Tanner码的构造和渐近参数定理。
authors: Keming He, Jiahan Chen, Enji Xiong, Zhongyi Ni, Lei Zhang, Xin Wang

articles.title: Data informed Ansatz Selection for Variational Quantum Circuits
articles.title_zh: 变分量子电路中数据驱动的Ansatz选择
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05079v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Choosing a variational quantum circuit (VQC) usually means searching over ansatze and depths, and training each candidate. We give three rules that fix these choices from the data and the gate set alone, before any training. First, a circuit without entangling gates has a rank-one Fourier coefficient tensor on every subset of qubits. A singular value decomposition of a dataset's Fourier coefficients therefore indicates whether entanglement is needed, which qubits it connects, and a lower bound on the error of omitting it. Second, the rank of the quantum Fisher information matrix grows by p₀ per layer, after a first-layer deficit d₀, until it reaches a ceiling set by the dynamical Lie algebra. This law fixes the depth. Third, reading out all 2^N - 1 Pauli-Z products from one batch of shots resolves half of the state's directions, the most any single-basis readout can. A single-qubit readout resolves an exponentially small fraction. For the Madelon dataset, the rules prescribe 7 blocks of 3 qubits at depth 3: a 239-parameter classifier with 78.5% test accuracy, found without a grid search. Ablations confirm three predicted effects: shallower circuits, smaller blocks and dropping reuploading all lower accuracy.
articles.abstract_zh: 选择变分量子电路（VQC）通常涉及搜索Ansatz和深度并训练每个候选。本文提出了三条规则，仅根据数据和门集在训练前确定这些选择。首先，傅里叶系数张量的奇异值分解可指示是否需要纠缠以及连接哪些量子比特。其次，量子Fisher信息矩阵的秩随层数增长，从而确定深度。第三，从一批测量中读出所有Pauli-Z乘积可以解析状态的一半方向。这些规则在Madelon数据集上得到了验证，为VQC设计提供了一种无需网格搜索的有效方法。
authors: Manav Seksaria, Advith Desu, Anil Prabhakar

articles.title: DynaMite: Dynamic Measurement Scheduling To Accelerate Fault-Tolerant Quantum Programs
articles.title_zh: DynaMite：动态测量调度以加速容错量子程序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05233v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computers run millions of logical cycles to perform quantum error correction (QEC). As logical operations span entire logical cycles, the logical cycle time (LCT) dictates program runtime. Qubit measurements, critical to extract parity information for QEC, are the slowest operations and account for 43-86% of LCT. Measurement latencies impact fidelity: fast measurements lower our ability to correctly classify quantum states, whereas slow measurements increase the likelihood of decoherence. Hardware providers thus calibrate measurement latencies that maximize readout fidelity per qubit and use them to schedule all measurements during program execution. However, calibrated latencies are sub-optimal for logical performance because logical cycles span multiple QEC rounds, during which data qubits are not measured. This increases LCT and logical error rates (LERs) due to decoherence at the logical level. We propose DynaMite, a lightweight real-time measurement latency selection policy built on two key insights. First, logical cycles must use a measurement latency that is fast enough to reduce both LCT and LER for the QEC code, instead of the calibrated latency that only maximizes readout fidelity. Second, not all logical cycles are equal; many do not fully utilize the error budget of the QEC code, i.e., the number of failed parity checks it can tolerate without compromising LER. These cycles could use even faster measurements but do not, because latencies are chosen statically, whereas error information is only available at runtime. DynaMite exploits the fact that a logical cycle comprises multiple QEC rounds and selects the fastest latency for an upcoming round based on the error budget left and rounds remaining. Our evaluations show that DynaMite reduces LCT by 1.69x on average and up to 2.29x, and reduces LER to 0.46x on average and up to 0.13x of baseline.
articles.abstract_zh: 容错量子计算机执行数百万个逻辑周期以进行量子纠错（QEC），其中量子比特测量是决定程序运行时间的关键且最慢的操作。本文提出了DynaMite，一种轻量级的实时测量延迟选择策略，旨在加速容错量子程序。该策略基于两个关键见解：逻辑周期必须使用足够快的测量延迟以降低逻辑周期时间（LCT）和逻辑错误率（LER）。DynaMite通过动态调整测量延迟，优化了逻辑性能，解决了传统校准延迟在逻辑层面上次优的问题。
authors: Dongwhee Kim, Suhas Vittal, Poulami Das

articles.title: Universal dynamics of quantum phase transitions with fractional long-range interactions
articles.title_zh: 具有分数长程相互作用的量子相变的普适动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05273v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The complete statistical characterization of defects generated in a quantum phase transition has mostly been studied in exactly solvable models, and remains little explored in nonintegrable systems such as long-range interacting spin chains. We characterize the full defect counting statistics in a nonintegrable long-range spin chain, the fractional Ising model, by time-dependent variational-principle simulations within the matrix-product-state and matrix-product-operator formalism. Fractional interactions capture emergent multiscale correlations and long-range effects in nature, governed by the order of the underlying fractional derivative. Such couplings can be approximated on existing quantum simulation platforms, where the full defect statistics can be measured. The defect number cumulants follow power laws in the driving time, with exponents that vary continuously with the fractional order. At low fractional order, deep in the long-range regime, the mean defect number decays more slowly than predicted by the Kibble-Zurek mechanism (KZM), while at intermediate order the KZM holds with the numerically extracted many-body critical exponents. At large fractional order, the exactly solvable free-fermion limit of the model becomes progressively more accurate towards the short-range limit. We derive exact bounds on the kink-number cumulants and on the kink-kink correlations, implying an exact Gaussian limiting distribution for large system sizes. In the many-body simulations, however, kinks are more correlated, consistent with the confinement of domain walls, and these bounds are violated in the long-range regime, also in the bulk of the chain. Nevertheless, the kink distribution still approaches a Gaussian for large defect numbers, with proportionality partially broken between the cumulants.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用矩阵乘积态和矩阵乘积算符形式下的含时变分原理模拟，研究了非可积长程自旋链（分数伊辛模型）中量子相变产生的缺陷计数统计。研究发现，缺陷数累积量遵循驱动时间的幂律，其指数随分数阶连续变化。在低分数阶长程区域，平均缺陷数衰减慢于Kibble-Zurek机制（KZM）预测，而在中间分数阶时KZM成立。
authors: Andraás Grabarits, Lincoln D. Carr, Adolfo del Campo

articles.title: Quantum Advantage has Few Complexity Implications
articles.title_zh: 量子优势的复杂性含义有限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05303v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider the complexity implications of proofs of quantumness and (quantum verifier) oblivious state preparation. We show that both of these objects can coexist with the easiness of nondeterministic computation. That is, we give evidence that proofs of quantumness can exist when mathsfP = mathsfNP and that (quantum verifier) oblivious state preparation can exist when mathsfBQP = mathsfQCMA. In particular, we give a classical oracle relative to which (1) mathsfP^O = mathsfNP^O (2) mathsfBQP^O = mathsfPSPACE^O (3) Proofs of quantumness exist. In particular, there exists a language in mathsfIP^O subseteq mathsfBQP^O which is hard on average against mathsfP^O/poly. We give a unitary oracle such that (1) mathsfBQP^O = mathsfQCMA^O (2) Quantum verifier oblivious state preparation exists. These oracle separations directly imply a number of related consequences. For example, our first result implies that proofs of quantumness cannot be used to construct classical or quantum cryptography with a relativizing proof. Our second result implies that quantum computation/classical communication oblivious transfer cannot be used to construct post-quantum one-way functions with a relativizing proof.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了量子性证明和（量子验证者）遗忘态制备的复杂性含义。研究表明，这两种对象可以与非确定性计算的易处理性共存，即在P=NP时量子性证明可以存在，在BQP=QCMA时（量子验证者）遗忘态制备可以存在。通过构建经典和酉神谕，作者证明了这些分离，并指出量子性证明不能用于构建具有相对化证明的经典或量子密码学。
authors: Eli Goldin, Alex Lombardi, Tomoyuki Morimae

articles.title: Factorized approximate inverse preconditioners in the tensor train format
articles.title_zh: 张量列车格式的因子化近似逆预处理器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03859v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a preconditioning pipeline that accelerates Tensor Train (TT) linear solvers for symmetric positive-definite problems. Extending the Factorized Sparse Approximate Inverse framework to tensor networks, we construct a preconditioner as the product of a TT operator and its transpose.
