This formulation is positive semidefinite for any bond dimension and truncation, and definite whenever the factor is non-singular, satisfying the mathematical requirements of the Conjugate Gradient method. We detail the construction of this preconditioner and its integration into Density Matrix Renormalization Group (DMRG)-like linear solvers. Performance evaluations show consistent iteration reductions for anisotropic diffusion and Poisson problems across various configurations, leading to net speedups of up to 25% in ill-conditioned settings of time stepping schemes that can reuse the approximate inverses. These benchmarks were performed with the open-source Julia library DifferenTT.jl, which we also introduce in this work to provide out-of-the-box access to these preconditioned pipelines.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种预处理流程，用于加速对称正定问题的张量列车（TT）线性求解器。通过将因子化稀疏近似逆框架扩展到张量网络，构建了一个由TT算子及其转置乘积组成的预处理器。该预处理器在各种配置下，对各向异性扩散和泊松问题均显示出迭代次数的减少，在病态时间步进方案中实现了高达25%的净加速。
authors: Pau Torrente Badia, Daniel Pérez García, Artur Garcia-Saez, Stefano Carignano

articles.title: Liouvillian Kramers Degeneracy
articles.title_zh: 耗散系统中的克拉默斯简并
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03881v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Kramers theorem generally guarantees the spectral degeneracy of time-reversal-invariant Hamiltonian operators with half-integer spin, underlying a variety of physical phenomena. Despite its fundamental significance, the Kramers degeneracy has been argued to be absent in Liouvillian superoperators acting on mixed states because of the double structure of the Hilbert space. Here, we instead demonstrate that the interplay of time-reversal symmetrydag and parity symmetry enforces the Kramers degeneracy in Liouvillians. We explicitly construct dissipative many-body models of interacting fermions and spins exhibiting the Kramers degeneracy and show that their complex spectral statistics follow those of non-Hermitian random matrices in the corresponding symplectic symmetry classes. Of the three fundamental universality classes of non-Hermitian random matrices, the symplectic class has never been realized in symmetry-resolved many-body Liouvillians. Our constructions provide its explicit realizations and spectral signatures of nonintegrability in symplectic open quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 克拉默斯定理通常保证具有半整数自旋的时间反演不变哈密顿算符的谱简并性。本文证明了时间反演对称性和宇称对称性的相互作用可以在耗散系统中强制实现克拉默斯简并。作者构建了表现出克拉默斯简并的相互作用费米子和自旋的耗散多体模型，并展示了其复谱统计遵循非厄米随机矩阵的辛对称类。
authors: Kohei Kawabata

articles.title: Interaction-driven Weyl superfluids from topologically trivial bands in an optical Raman lattice
articles.title_zh: 光学拉曼晶格中由相互作用驱动的拓扑平庸能带产生的Weyl超流体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04015v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We propose a scheme to realize Weyl superfluidity from topologically trivial bands in the strongly correlated regime of a three-dimensional optical Raman lattice. The scheme builds on a pairing mechanism arising from the interplay between a large Zeeman splitting and strong Hubbard interaction. Spin-flip hopping suppressed by the large Zeeman detuning is resonantly restored when the attractive Hubbard interaction compensates the energy mismatch, yielding a correlated spin-orbit coupling that depends on the local particle configuration. Combining this density-dependent in-plane spin-orbit coupling with density-dependent spin-conserving interlayer tunneling extends the pairing mechanism to three dimensions. A self-consistent mean-field treatment of the microscopic model yields Weyl superfluids with two, four, or eight nodes, together with fully gapped weak topological superfluids. Tuning the interaction strength and particle filling drives transitions between these phases and controls the number of Weyl nodes. We further propose an experimental implementation with ultracold ⁴⁰K atoms. Our results highlight density-assisted spin-orbit coupling as a mechanism for realizing Weyl superfluidity in strongly correlated systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种在三维光学拉曼晶格的强关联区域中，从拓扑平庸能带实现Weyl超流体的方案。该方案基于大的塞曼分裂和强Hubbard相互作用之间的协同作用产生的配对机制。通过对微观模型进行自洽平均场处理，得到了具有两个、四个或八个节点的Weyl超流体，以及全能隙弱拓扑超流体。
authors: Yong-Huan Wang, Shuai Chen, Xin-Chi Zhou

articles.title: On the universality of entanglement entropy in quantum field theory
articles.title_zh: 关于量子场论中纠缠熵的普适性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04238v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The standard definition of entanglement entropy in quantum field theory requires regularizing the entangling surface and factorizing the Hilbert space, which in turn involves a choice of boundary conditions at the regularized surface. This raises two natural questions which are open at present. The first is under what conditions there is a choice of boundary conditions that leads to a unitary map between the original Hilbert space and the factorized one, which is a necessary condition for a well-defined entanglement entropy. The second concerns the situation where there are multiple such choices, in which case the question is whether they all yield the same entropy, or at least the same terms usually referred to as universal. Focusing on topological theories and using three-dimensional Chern-Simons theory as a concrete illustration, we show under specified assumptions that different such choices affect only the non-universal terms in the entropy, such that the remaining terms are universal in this sense as well, while we explicitly demonstrate that boundary conditions corresponding to non-unitary maps can change these terms. We then explain how a similar argument applies to two-dimensional conformal field theories and discuss a condition for universality in general theories.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子场论中纠缠熵的标准定义涉及纠缠表面的正则化和希尔伯特空间的因子化，这需要选择正则化表面的边界条件。本文以三维Chern-Simons理论为例，探讨了不同边界条件对纠缠熵的影响。研究表明，在特定假设下，不同的边界条件仅影响熵中的非普适项，而剩余项仍保持普适性。
authors: Orr Sela

articles.title: Closed- and open-system characterization of the Yukawa-SYK model in real time
articles.title_zh: Yukawa-SYK模型在实时下的闭合与开放系统表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04704v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Strongly correlated matter without quasiparticles is central to many-body physics, quantum chaos, and quantum gravity, motivating a considerable effort toward its realization in tabletop experiments. Two challenges remain: laboratory platforms are open systems, so conformal behavior must survive dissipation, and it must be identified through measurable quantities. We address both challenges in the Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (YSYK) model, in which bosons and fermions interact as in, e.g., light-matter systems, but through random all-to-all couplings that drive the boson to criticality without fine tuning. Solving the model in real time using the Schwinger-Keldysh formalism, we treat closed and open systems within a unified framework and, in both cases, consider a thermal steady state to map their phase diagrams. In addition to the known conformal and impurity (or SYK₂₎ regimes, we identify novel high-temperature regimes in which the fermions are driven by an essentially bare boson and show that their dynamics is captured by a quadratic model with time-dependent random hopping. Across all regimes, the fermionic softening of the boson is bounded by a ``criticality budget'' determined only by the Yukawa coupling and the temperature. Coupling the boson with a thermal environment induces a mass shift that deforms the boundaries between different regimes and exhausts the criticality budget, thus imposing a bound on temperature and dissipation rate compatible with self-tuned criticality. We further introduce a set of markers built from the two-point functions that separate all identified regimes, are accessible in linear response, and require no fit of the conformal exponents. We complement them with the quantum Fisher information, deriving upper bounds with and without dissipation. These results may help characterize holographic quantum matter beyond the closed setting.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用Schwinger-Keldysh形式在实时下求解了Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev（YSYK）模型，统一处理了闭合和开放系统。研究绘制了其相图，除了已知的共形和杂质区域外，还识别出新的高温区域。在这些区域中，费米子由裸玻色子驱动，其动力学由具有时变随机跳跃的二次模型描述。
authors: Alex Windey, Christian H. Johansen, Philipp Hauke, Andrea Legramandi

articles.title: Band structure of two-dimensional graphene and of one-dimensional nanoribbons via variational quantum algorithms: from energies to wavefunction quality
articles.title_zh: 通过变分量子算法计算二维石墨烯和一维纳米带的能带结构：从能量到波函数质量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04975v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Simulating quantum many-body systems classically encounters exponential bottlenecks, which quantum devices circumvent by natively encoding wavefunctions. In the Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) era, however, hardware noise constrains simulation accuracy. As a stepping stone toward strongly correlated materials, we compute the band structure of 2D monolayer graphene and 1D nanoribbons (zigzag and armchair) using a single variational workflow in the p_z tight-binding approximation. Non-interacting ground states also provide essential initial reference states for subspace and warm-started variational methods to solve interacting spectra. By mapping the Bloch Hamiltonian to Pauli operators, we extract the ground band via the Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) and excited subbands via Variational Quantum Deflation (VQD), validating our approach from ideal simulations to execution on physical IBM Quantum processors. In ideal simulations, the workflow reproduces exact diagonalization results with high precision, whereas hardware noise introduces energy deviations of a few hundredths of the hopping parameter. While qubit counts scale logarithmically with ribbon width, fixed-depth ansatz accuracy degrades with Hilbert space dimension. Crucially, deepening the ansatz improves ideal simulation accuracy by over three orders of magnitude but worsens energy estimates under noise, proving that practical circuit depth is bounded by hardware noise rather than expressivity. Finally, we complement energy evaluations with a wavefunction-level diagnostic measuring subspace containment. This diagnostic captures degenerate manifolds and exposes optimization failure modes disguised by energy agreement alone. Operating directly on NISQ hardware, this validated workflow establishes a controlled baseline for studying topological and strongly correlated phases in realistic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用变分量子算法，在p_z紧束缚近似下计算了二维单层石墨烯和一维纳米带（锯齿形和扶手椅形）的能带结构。通过将布洛赫哈密顿量映射到泡利算符，作者使用变分量子本征求解器（VQE）提取基带，并使用变分量子降维（VQD）提取激发子带。该方法在理想模拟中能高精度复现精确对角化结果，并在物理IBM量子处理器上进行了验证。
authors: Raúl Medrano Millán, Rodrigo Gil-Merino y Rubio, Juan Borge, Unai Aseguinolaza Aguirreche

articles.title: Ultracold polar molecules for quantum science and technology
articles.title_zh: 超冷极性分子在量子科学与技术中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05040v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ultracold polar molecules present a rich platform for experimental quantum science leveraging their unique properties. Of particular relevance is the intrinsic electric dipole moment of the molecule, which results in strong coupling to microwave fields and can be used to engineer long-range, anisotropic, and tunable dipole-dipole interactions. Such interactions can generate entanglement between molecules and enable the study of novel quantum many-body phenomena in parameter regimes inaccessible in other systems. Modern experiments in optical tweezers and optical lattices have demonstrated controlled interactions between molecules in coherent quantum states, and recently bulk gases of molecules have been cooled to quantum degeneracy. Motivated by these landmark advances, we present this article to explain many of the key concepts relevant to current research in the field.
articles.abstract_zh: 超冷极性分子因其独特的性质，特别是固有的电偶极矩，为实验量子科学提供了一个丰富的平台。这些分子能够与微波场强耦合，并可用于工程化长程、各向异性且可调谐的偶极-偶极相互作用。本文旨在解释该领域当前研究中的许多关键概念，并展望其在量子信息处理和多体物理研究中的潜力。
authors: Philip D. Gregory, Simon L. Cornish

articles.title: Quantum Error Correction in Nearly Critical Toric Codes
articles.title_zh: 近临界环面码中的量子纠错
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05375v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate quantum error correction protocols for topological codes deformed away from their stabilizer limits, particularly as they are pushed towards quantum phase transitions into trivial phases. Our focus is primarily on quantum information stored within the ground-state manifold of the transverse-field toric code (TFTC), subjected to independent bit-flip and phase-flip decoherence. Although the transverse field induces strong quantum fluctuations of m anyons in the ground states, we show that projective measurements of the "bare" toric code stabilizers can nevertheless be used to construct an efficient decoding algorithm which exhibits a finite threshold to both types of decoherence, even when the transverse field is tuned infinitesimally close to the quantum critical point. Our construction of the optimal postmeasurement decoders---that is, the optimal decoders assuming that the stabilizers are first measured---crucially relies on the stoquastic nature of the TFTC Hamiltonian, which affords a description of its ground states in terms of a classical lattice gauge theory. Using stoquasticity, we first prove that stabilizer measurements act unitarily on the undecohered TFTC ground states to excellent approximation, and that the optimal postmeasurement decoder can be efficiently implemented via Monte Carlo simulation of a constrained lattice gauge theory. We then construct the optimal postmeasurement decoder for the TFTC states under bit-flip and phase-flip decoherence, where we numerically demonstrate a finite threshold close to the quantum critical point. We provide theoretical evidence (without a rigorous proof) that stabilizer measurements constitute an optimal decoding strategy in this setting. For phase-flip decoherence, we further prove that the optimal postmeasurement decoding threshold is independent of the transverse field strength throughout the topological phase.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了拓扑码在偏离其稳定器极限，特别是接近量子相变进入平凡相时的量子纠错协议。研究主要关注横场环面码（TFTC）基态流形中存储的量子信息，该信息受到独立的比特翻转和相位翻转退相干的影响。作者证明，即使横场无限接近量子临界点，裸环面码稳定器的投影测量仍可用于构建高效的解码算法，对两种退相干都表现出有限阈值。
authors: Zack Weinstein, Samuel J. Garratt

articles.title: Linear optics and the problem of Bell-like state discrimination
articles.title_zh: 线性光学与类贝尔态判别问题
articles.abstract: arXiv:2402.00832v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A linear optics-based scheme to implement various quantum information processing tasks is of paramount importance due to its ease of implementation and low noise. Many information-theoretic tasks depend on the successful discrimination of Bell states. A no-go theorem states that it is not possible to perfectly discriminate among the four Bell states when the measurement apparatus is restricted to linear optical elements. The success probability is only 50%. Using extra resources such as hyperentanglement, ancillary entanglement, and even a minimum amount of non-linearity, complete Bell-state discrimination can be achieved. The success probability for Bell-like state discrimination is only 25%. Bell-like states are non-maximally entangled two-qubit states that resemble Bell states in structure but have unequal Schmidt coefficients. We find that this can be boosted to 50% using hyperentanglement, where extra ancillary degrees of freedom (DOF) of photons, such as polarization, momentum, or OAM, are also entangled along with the system DOF. This contrasts with Bell-state discrimination, where 100% can be achieved. Furthermore, we find that using correlations in the photons' arrival times, all four Bell states can be distinguished with 100% success probability, while for Bell-like state discrimination, it increases only to 37.5% from 25%. We observe a similar contrast when using ancillary entangled photons. While the success probability for discriminating all four Bell states increases as 1-frac12^N, where N is the number of ancillary photon pairs, for Bell-like states, it depends on the state parameters and can be less than 25% in some cases. Also, adding further ancillary photons decreases the success probability. We then show that using non-linear gadgets, namely SFG, 100% success probability can be achieved even for Bell-like state discrimination.
articles.abstract_zh: 线性光学方案在量子信息处理任务中具有重要意义，但其在贝尔态判别方面存在局限。本文研究了类贝尔态的判别问题，发现其成功概率仅为25%。通过利用超纠缠，可以将类贝尔态的判别成功率提升至50%，这与贝尔态判别可达100%的情况形成对比。
authors: Jatin Ghai, Sibasish Ghosh

articles.title: Noise Mitigation in Single Microwave Photon Counting by Cascaded Quantum Measurements
articles.title_zh: 通过级联量子测量实现单微波光子计数中的噪声抑制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2502.14804v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Single-photon detection in the microwave domain has recently emerged as a powerful tool for quantum sensing, offering a path beyond the standard quantum limit of linear amplification since their sensitivity is set by their dark-count rate rather than by the vacuum fluctuations of the detected field. Superconducting qubit-based single microwave photon detectors (SMPDs) encode the absorption of itinerant photons into discrete quantum states via engineered, non-destructive interactions. A previously demonstrated implementation based on four-wave mixing achieved high efficiency, but remained limited by residual qubit excitation and thermal noise at the detector input. Here, we propose and demonstrate a new SMPD that relies on two cascaded four-wave mixing processes. The information on photon detection is encoded on two spatially separated qubits, which mitigates noise due to uncorrelated qubit errors. Furthermore, increasing the detection frequency up to 11.7 GHz reduces input thermal noise. These combined advances lead to a record-low power sensitivity of 2.4 ḑot 10⁻²³W/sqrtHz over a bandwidth of 230 kHz.
articles.abstract_zh: 微波域的单光子探测是量子传感的强大工具，但其性能受限于残余量子比特激发和热噪声。本文提出并演示了一种基于两个级联四波混频过程的新型单微波光子探测器（SMPD）。通过将光子探测信息编码到两个空间分离的量子比特上，该方案有效抑制了非相关量子比特误差引起的噪声。这些改进使得探测器实现了2.4 × 10⁻²³ W/√Hz的超低功率灵敏度。
authors: Alexandre S. May, Leo Sutevski, Jeanne Solard, Gil Cardoso, Léon Carde, Louis Pallegoix, Raphael Lescanne, Denis Vion, James O'Sullivan, Patrice Bertet, Emmanuel Flurin

articles.title: Improving the Dynamic Range of Interacting Quantum Sensors via Optimized Quantum Control
articles.title_zh: 通过优化量子控制提高相互作用量子传感器的动态范围
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.04958v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Interacting spin ensembles are promising platforms for quantum sensing, but spin-spin interactions can induce complex, nonmonotonic responses to external fields, limiting the dynamic range over which the fields can be estimated unambiguously. Here, we propose a quantum-circuit-learning-inspired method to improve the dynamic range of interacting quantum sensors using optimized global control fields. We consider an ensemble of dipole-coupled spins subjected to an inhomogeneous magnetic field generated by an electric current. By optimizing the global control fields applied during sensing, we train the expectation value of the collective magnetization to approximate a prescribed monotonic target function. We also introduce a penalty on the magnetization variance to account for measurement fluctuations. Numerical simulations demonstrate that the optimized control can substantially enlarge the dynamic range compared with sensing without control. We further investigate the trade-off between dynamic range and estimation uncertainty and show that the variance penalty can reduce the uncertainty at the expense of dynamic range. These results demonstrate that learning-assisted global control provides a promising approach to improving the performance of interacting quantum sensors.
articles.abstract_zh: 相互作用的自旋系综是量子传感的有前景平台，但自旋-自旋相互作用会限制其动态范围。本文提出了一种受量子电路学习启发的优化全局控制场方法，以提高相互作用量子传感器的动态范围。通过优化传感过程中的全局控制场，使集体磁化强度期望值逼近预设的单调目标函数，并引入磁化强度方差惩罚。数值模拟表明，优化控制能显著扩大动态范围，同时研究了动态范围与估计不确定性之间的权衡。
authors: Yasuhiro Aota, Yuichiro Mori, Takahiko Satoh, Yuichiro Matsuzaki, Hideaki Kawaguchi

articles.title: Realizing quantum energy storage and sensing with prethermal time crystals stabilized via power-law-graded Ising interactions
articles.title_zh: 通过幂律分级伊辛相互作用稳定预热时间晶体实现量子能量存储和传感
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.14847v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study prethermal discrete time-crystalline (PDTC) phases in one-dimensional spin-1/2 chains with power-law-graded Ising interactions under periodic Floquet driving. By generalizing Stark localization to power-law-graded Ising interaction profiles, we identify robust period-doubled dynamics across a wide range of interaction exponents, stabilized by the interplay between coherent driving and spatially varying coupling. Within the PDTC phase, the energy stored in the system, interpreted as a quantum battery, increases superlinearly with system size, although no scaling advantage persists in normalized power. Beyond energy storage, we demonstrate that the PDTC phase supports enhanced quantum sensing. The quantum Fisher information associated with estimating timing deviations in the drive scales superlinearly with system size, indicating quantum-enhanced sensitivity. The degree of quantum advantage can be tuned by varying the interaction exponent, though PDTC behavior remains robust throughout. Our results position power-law-graded Ising interacting Floquet systems as robust platforms for storing quantum energy and achieving metrological enhancement.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在一维自旋-1/2链中，通过周期性Floquet驱动和幂律分级伊辛相互作用实现的预热离散时间晶体（PDTC）相。研究发现，PDTC相中的系统能量（作为量子电池）随系统尺寸超线性增长，并且支持增强的量子传感。量子费舍尔信息随系统尺寸超线性扩展，表明量子增强的灵敏度。这些结果表明，幂律分级伊辛相互作用的Floquet系统是实现量子能量存储和计量学的强大平台。
authors: Ayan Sahoo, Debraj Rakshit

articles.title: Gauge Symmetry in Quantum Simulation --- Redundancy Is All You Need ---
articles.title_zh: 量子模拟中的规范对称性——冗余即所需
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.22932v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum simulation of non-Abelian gauge theories requires careful handling of gauge redundancy. We present universal principles for treating gauge symmetry that apply to any quantum simulation approach. Our main result is that enforcing gauge-singlet constraints is conceptually and practically unnecessary for extracting physical observables. Physical states need not be represented by gauge singlets; singlet and non-singlet representations are both valid, with distinct practical trade-offs that we elucidate using analogies to BRST quantization, and the non-singlet approach is likely more efficient toward the continuum limit. As in classical electrodynamics and the path-integral formulation, gauge redundancy simplifies things. We demonstrate these principles within a complete quantum simulation framework based on the orbifold lattice, which enables explicit and efficient circuit constructions relevant to real-world QCD. We show how non-singlet approaches yield gauge-invariant observables through wave packets and string excitations, and that this approach is universal and efficient. For the limited situations where a singlet representation is genuinely required, we introduce a Haar-averaging projection implemented via linear combinations of unitaries and analyze its cost and truncation errors; its post-selection cost makes it a fallback rather than the default. We also introduce a penalty term in the Hamiltonian that eliminates non-singlet states from the low-energy spectrum. Working in temporal gauge, we map lattice Yang-Mills dynamics to Pauli-string Hamiltonians suitable for Trotterization. Classical simulations of small systems validate convergence criteria, quantify truncation and Trotter errors, and yield concrete resource estimates and scalable circuit recipes for SU(N) gauge theories.
articles.abstract_zh: 非阿贝尔规范理论的量子模拟需要处理规范冗余。本文提出了处理规范对称性的通用原则，指出在提取物理可观测量时，强制规范单态约束在概念和实践上都是不必要的。物理态无需用规范单态表示；单态和非单态表示均有效，且非单态方法在趋向连续极限时可能更高效。研究在一个基于轨道格子的完整量子模拟框架中展示了这些原则，并说明非单态方法如何通过波包和弦激发产生规范不变的可观测量。
authors: Masanori Hanada, Shunji Matsuura, Andreas Schafer, Jinzhao Sun

articles.title: Topological phase transition of deformed mathbb Z₃ toric code
articles.title_zh: 变形 Z₃ 环面码的拓扑相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.09107v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate topological phase transitions in a family of deformed mathbb Z₃ toric-code wavefunctions prepared from a cluster state by local deformations and projective measurements. Their norms map to the Q=3 Potts model for single-parameter deformations and to a three-state Ashkin--Teller-like (AT₃₎ construction with two independent four-spin couplings in the general case. Projected entangled-pair-state (PEPS) and variational uniform matrix-product-state (VUMPS) calculations identify the toric-code (TC) phase and phases in which electric (e) anyons are confined or condensed. These phases are separated by critical structures with central charges c=4/5, 8/5, and isolated c=1 antiferromagnetic (AFM) endpoints. A normalized finite-distance e-anyon pair-state norm provides a Fredenhagen--Marcu-type check of the confinement boundary, while the topological data of the quantum double D(mathbb Z₃₎ imply a topological entanglement entropy γ=łog3 throughout the gapped toric-code phase. Relative to the mathbb Z₂ case, the absence of sign-change folding leaves the AFM endpoints unfolded, and the extreme deformation reaches square ice with an emergent U(1) one-form symmetry, Hilbert-space fragmentation, and exact scar configurations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了通过局部形变和投影测量从簇态制备的一系列变形 Z₃ 环面码波函数中的拓扑相变。其范数映射到Q=3 Potts模型或三态Ashkin--Teller型结构。通过PEPS和VUMPS计算，识别出环面码相以及电（e）任意子被限制或凝聚的相。这些相由具有特定中心荷的临界结构分隔。研究还发现，与 Z₂ 情况相比，符号变化折叠的缺失使得反铁磁端点未展开。
authors: Yun-Tak Oh, Hyun-Yong Lee

articles.title: Bell Nonlocality Test on Two-Mode Squeezed Output Generated in Double-Cavity Optomechanical
articles.title_zh: 双腔光力学系统中双模压缩输出的贝尔非局域性检验
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.12050v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We explore here how to generate a two-mode squeezed output using reservoir engineering in a double-cavity optomechanical system coupled to a common mechanical resonator. Such hybrid platforms are experimentally accessible in electro-optomechanical interfaces and are relevant for high-fidelity state transfer, quantum communication, and metrological applications. By examining violations of the CHSH Bell inequality, we demonstrate that maximal squeezing does not necessarily imply nonlocality; instead, nonlocal correlations can emerge in states with lower squeezing. Furthermore, by analyzing the CHSH inequality across different cavity finesse values, we find that the parameter region supporting nonlocality can broaden even as the squeezing region shrinks. Across all regimes considered, our results emphasize the crucial influence of the mixedness of the state in determining the relationship between squeezing and nonlocality.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了如何在双腔光力学系统中通过储层工程生成双模压缩输出，并对其进行贝尔非局域性检验。通过检验CHSH贝尔不等式的违反情况，研究表明最大压缩不一定意味着非局域性，非局域关联可能出现在较低压缩的态中。此外，非局域性支持的参数区域可能扩大，即使压缩区域缩小。结果强调了态的混合性在决定压缩与非局域性关系中的关键影响。
authors: Souvik Agasti

articles.title: Measurement and feedback-driven adaptive dynamics in the classical and quantum kicked top
articles.title_zh: 经典和量子受击陀螺中的测量与反馈驱动自适应动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.19874v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In classical dynamical systems, stochastic feedback can stabilize otherwise unstable periodic orbits, giving rise to distinct controlled and uncontrolled phases as the rate of control application is varied. In this work, we apply these control protocols in classical, semiclassical, and quantum regimes to the kicked top, a paradigmatic model of quantum chaos. The quantum kicked top, modeled as the dynamics of a spin-S object, naturally interpolates between these regimes with the spin size S acting as an effective Planck constant. We show that the dynamics of the kicked top in classical, semiclassical, and fully quantum limits can all be controlled using stochastic feedback protocols. Comparing the full quantum dynamics to a truncated Wigner approximation that captures quantum noise but neglects interference beyond the Ehrenfest time, we find that low-moment observables are largely accounted for semiclassically, while higher moments retain a discrepancy that peaks at the control transition, consistent with contributions from interference and possibly nonlinearities in rare trajectories that explore the compact phase space. We also find rapid purification in the numerics studied for all rates of control considered, suggesting that control quenches the top's ability to encode a qubit of quantum information even in the uncontrolled phase.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将随机反馈控制协议应用于经典、半经典和量子受击陀螺模型，该模型是量子混沌的典型范例。研究表明，在经典、半经典和完全量子极限下，受击陀螺的动力学都可以通过随机反馈协议进行控制。通过比较完全量子动力学与截断Wigner近似，发现低阶矩可观测量在半经典上基本一致，而高阶矩在控制转变处存在差异，这与干涉和稀有轨迹中的非线性贡献有关。
authors: Mahaveer Prasad, Ahana Chakraborty, Thomas Iadecola, Manas Kulkarni, J. H. Pixley, Sriram Ganeshan, Justin H. Wilson

articles.title: Operator-Algebraic Methods for Asymptotic-Preserving Quantum Simulation of Open Systems
articles.title_zh: 开放系统渐近保持量子模拟的算子代数方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.18886v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We develop a mathematically rigorous framework for simulating emphmultiscale physical systems using quantum computational resources, by translating the emph{language of asymptotic-preserving (AP) schemes} into the formalism of quantum channels and Lindbladian dynamics. For stiff open quantum systems governed by singularly perturbed generators Ļₑₚₛ = eps⁻¹Ļfₐₛₜ + Ļₛₗₒw with eps → 0, we prove that a protocol starting in the slow manifold (with the general state case sketched via an initial boundary layer) followed by effective evolution converges uniformly to the reduced slow state of the true stiff dynamics, with an explicit global error bound O(eps²⁽¹⁺T) + TΔ t^p) that rigorously captures O(eps) physical effects (e.g., Purcell decay) without unphysical dissipation. We establish resource-complexity scaling showing that avoiding the Ømega(1/eps) stiffness penalty while capturing O(eps) dynamics is efficiently achieved via analytic adiabatic elimination to precompute the effective generator, providing dimensional savings amortized against classical precomputation. The framework is illustrated through cavity QED in the bad-cavity limit and a heuristic quantum-inspired AP discretization of linear kinetic equations. This work provides a principled mathematical bridge between classical multiscale numerical analysis and quantum simulation algorithms.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个数学上严谨的框架，用于使用量子计算资源模拟多尺度物理系统，将渐近保持（AP）方案的语言转化为量子通道和Lindbladian动力学形式。对于由奇异扰动生成器控制的刚性开放量子系统，证明了从慢流形开始的协议，通过有效演化，能均匀收敛到真实刚性动力学的约化慢态。该框架通过解析绝热消除预计算有效生成器，实现了避免刚性惩罚并高效捕获O(eps)动力学，从而节省了维度。
authors: M. W. AlMasri

articles.title: Dynamical zero modes and boundary dependence in dynamical quantum phase transitions
articles.title_zh: 动力学量子相变中的动力学零模和边界依赖性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.03438v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Boundary conditions are usually expected to cause only finite-size corrections to bulk quantities, but this expectation can fail for dynamical quantum phase transitions. In this work, we show that such boundary dependence is encoded in dynamical zero modes (DZMs) of the Loschmidt matrix, which are defined as singular vectors whose singular values vanish in the thermodynamic limit. Using the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH), extended SSH, and Kitaev models as examples, we find that the time interval where the Loschmidt rate functions (LRFs) under periodic and open boundary conditions differ coincides with the emergence of DZMs in the open-boundary Loschmidt matrix. These modes carry the boundary-dependent contribution: removing them from the open-boundary LRF recovers the periodic-boundary result. We further show that these DZMs lead to finite-precision numerical instability, since their finite-size singular values decay exponentially with system size and eventually become unresolved in fixed-precision arithmetic. A reliable small-size branch before this loss of precision can be used to estimate the LRF in the thermodynamic limit by linear extrapolation. Our results identify DZMs as both a diagnostic of boundary-dependent LRFs and the origin of the associated numerical instability.
articles.abstract_zh: 边界条件通常只引起体量的有限尺寸修正，但在动力学量子相变中可能失效。本文表明，这种边界依赖性编码在Loschmidt矩阵的动力学零模（DZMs）中。研究发现，周期性边界条件和开放边界条件下的Loschmidt速率函数（LRFs）差异的时间区间与开放边界Loschmidt矩阵中DZMs的出现相吻合。这些模式携带边界依赖性贡献，移除它们可以恢复周期性边界结果。
authors: Siyan Lin, Xu Feng, Xiuhua Tian, Shu Chen

articles.title: Tunable non-Hermitian skin effect and topological phases in ladders with staggered nonreciprocal interleg hopping
articles.title_zh: 具有交错非互易腿间跳跃的梯形结构中可调谐的非厄米趋肤效应和拓扑相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11454v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the non-Hermitian skin effect (NHSE) and topological phases in a ladder model with staggered nonreciprocal interleg hopping, consisting of a Su-Schrieffer-Heeger chain coupled to a normal tight-binding chain. By tuning the system parameters, we show that the direction of the NHSE under open boundary conditions can be reversed and can even become energy dependent. The NHSE is further characterized by the spectral winding number under periodic boundary conditions. We also demonstrate that the interleg coupling significantly enlarges the topologically nontrivial parameter regime. Remarkably, there are two topological phases characterized by winding numbers W=±1, with the zero-energy topological edge modes residing on different sites in the two legs. Furthermore, increasing the nonreciprocity of the interleg hopping modifies the topological phase boundaries and eventually drives the system into a topologically trivial phase. Our results establish staggered nonreciprocal interleg hopping as an effective mechanism for engineering both the non-Hermitian skin effect and topological phases in ladder systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有交错非互易腿间跳跃的梯形模型中的非厄米趋肤效应（NHSE）和拓扑相。通过调整系统参数，NHSE的方向可以反转甚至变得依赖于能量。研究表明，腿间耦合显著扩大了拓扑非平凡参数区域，并存在两个由缠绕数W=±1表征的拓扑相。此外，增加腿间跳跃的非互易性会改变拓扑相边界，最终使系统进入拓扑平凡相。
authors: Pu-Xuan Li, Qi-Bo Zeng

articles.title: State preparation and detection for quantum simulation of particle collisions
articles.title_zh: 粒子碰撞量子模拟的态制备与探测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26142v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Simulating the real-time dynamics of particle collisions is a promising application of quantum simulators, because classical methods such as tensor networks struggle to capture the highly entangled states generated in high-energy scattering. Realizing such simulations requires both the preparation of incoming wave packets and the detection of the outgoing scattering products. In this work, we propose protocols that address both challenges on programmable analog and digital quantum simulation platforms. Our state-preparation scheme uses a weakly coupled auxiliary qubit - or, more generally, a customized local quench - to inject a single quasiparticle with well-defined momentum. Because it relies only on conservation of energy, this scheme requires no fine-tuning or prior knowledge about particle eigenstates, making it robust against errors in calibration and implementation. The momenta of scattering products are then extracted, using only local measurements, from the interference pattern that arises when particles are reflected at the system's boundary. We validate our protocols through numerical simulations, first in a simple single-particle model and subsequently in two interacting many-body systems: a Rydberg atom chain and an Ising chain in a mixed field. We demonstrate how high-energy regimes, necessary to access inelastic scattering processes, can be reached through an adiabatic ramp, and how the wave packet shape can be optimized by spatially modulating the Hamiltonian. Finally, we show how the protocol can be generalized to systems with more than one spatial dimension. Our proposal provides a versatile approach to the quantum simulation of scattering phenomena, and is compatible with several quantum simulation platforms that are already experimentally available.
articles.abstract_zh: 模拟粒子碰撞的实时动力学是量子模拟器的一个有前景的应用。本文提出了在可编程模拟和数字量子模拟平台上解决态制备和散射产物探测挑战的协议。我们的态制备方案利用弱耦合辅助量子比特注入具有明确动量的准粒子，该方案仅依赖能量守恒，无需微调。散射产物的动量通过局部测量从粒子在系统边界反射时产生的干涉图中提取。
authors: Federica Maria Surace, Sary Bseiso, John Preskill

articles.title: On Optimal Measurement-State Preparation via Geometric Transport of the Squeezing Ellipse
articles.title_zh: 基于压缩椭圆几何传输的最优测量态制备
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28620v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Preparation of optimal measurement states is a key requirement in quantum metrology utilizing squeezed states. Besides positioning the mean state, such preparation requires proper alignment of the squeezing ellipse. We discuss a geometric framework that transforms an initially misaligned squeezed input into a measurement-optimal state in SU(2)-symmetric systems. Within this framework, the orientation of the squeezing ellipse constitutes an additional geometric degree of freedom and evolves as the mean state follows a controlled trajectory on the unit sphere. The resulting rotation of the ellipse depends on the chosen trajectory and is linked to the geometric phase through the evolution of the local basis. The discussed framework is applicable to different physical platforms admitting an effective SU(2) description. As a particular example, we consider polarization-squeezed light and outline a possible implementation using a continuously varying birefringent element.
articles.abstract_zh: 在利用压缩态的量子计量学中，制备最优测量态是关键要求，这包括平均态的定位和压缩椭圆的正确对齐。本文讨论了一个几何框架，将初始未对齐的压缩输入转换为SU(2)对称系统中的测量最优态。在该框架内，压缩椭圆的取向构成一个额外的几何自由度，并随平均态在单位球上的受控轨迹演化。该框架适用于多种具有有效SU(2)描述的物理平台。
authors: Vsevolod Salakhutdinov, Nikolay Kalinin

articles.title: Thermalization with Gaussian Quantum Cellular Automata
articles.title_zh: 高斯量子元胞自动机中的热化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05542v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study the long-time dynamics of many-body bosonic lattice systems under translation-invariant Gaussian quantum cellular automata. We formulate two sets of conditions on GQCAs which separately guarantee thermalization of any state on the local Weyl algebra to the infinite temperature state, whenever the state is locally normal and has uniformly bounded particle density. Our main intermediate result is a quantum many-body generalization of the classic Riemann-Lebesgue lemma which is a bound on expectation values of local Weyl operators involving their support and the state's particle density.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了平移不变高斯量子元胞自动机下多体玻色子格点系统的长时间动力学。作者提出了两组条件，分别保证了当局部Weyl代数上的任何态在局部正规且粒子密度均匀有界时，都能热化到无限温度态。主要中间结果是经典黎曼-勒贝格引理的量子多体推广，该引理对局部Weyl算符的期望值及其支撑和态的粒子密度给出了一个界限。
authors: Roman Geiko, Jake Gerenraich

articles.title: Deterministic Hypergraph SYK: Melonic Dominance and Maximal Chaos Without Disorder Averaging
articles.title_zh: 确定性超图SYK：无无序平均下的瓜子图主导和最大混沌
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.19255v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We show that the leading melonic structure of the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model can be realized by a single sparse Majorana Hamiltonian, without disorder averaging. In our deterministic hypergraph SYK model (hSYK), N Majorana fermions interact through O(dN) terms with uniform couplings, arranged on a fixed q-uniform, d-regular hypergraph. If the hypergraph is linear, has few short cycles, and is a spectral expander, then at large d the two-point function obeys the melonic Schwinger-Dyson equation site by site. The leading thermodynamics are therefore those of SYK, and at leading order in 1/d every bilocal fluctuation other than the Schwarzian is gapped. The four-point ladder splits into scrambling modes labeled by eigenvalues of the site adjacency operator. At strong coupling, the uniform mode is maximally chaotic, and a non-uniform mode grows only if its eigenvalue exceeds 1/(q-1). Exact diagonalization of single instances with Nłe24 agrees with the melonic two-point function and thermodynamics more closely than dense SYK of the same size, shows Wigner-Dyson level statistics, and reproduces the predicted mode structure of out-of-time-order correlators. Numerically, random linear hypergraphs typically satisfy these conditions, and for d>q also avoid emergent symmetries. The model is a natural candidate for quantum simulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 模型的主要瓜子图结构可以通过单个稀疏马约拉纳哈密顿量实现，无需无序平均。在确定性超图SYK (hSYK) 模型中，N个马约拉纳费米子通过O(dN)项以均匀耦合相互作用，排列在固定的q-均匀、d-正则超图上。研究发现，在强耦合下，均匀模式是最大混沌的，并且非均匀模式仅在其本征值超过1/(q-1)时增长。对N≤24的单个实例进行精确对角化，结果与瓜子图两点函数和热力学更吻合，并显示了Wigner-Dyson能级统计。
authors: Shiroman Prakash

articles.title: Correlated quantum criticality and topological magnetoelectric response in Bi2Se3
articles.title_zh: Bi₂Se₃中的关联量子临界性与拓扑磁电响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03670v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A defining feature of quantum materials is that multiple orders govern low-energy physics and are not independent. We study Bi₂Se₃ by combining DFT with a renormalized correlated honeycomb model in which frustrated magnetic order and helical topological surface states are coupled via one control parameter. The surface states map to a honeycomb Hubbard model with frustrated J₁₋₋J₂ exchange. Exact diagonalization up to 20 sites shows the Néel structure factor and valence-bond-solid order parameter cross at J₂/J₁ approx 0.22, agreeing with QMC/DMRG, and a dynamical spin structure factor broadens near the crossover, as expected for a spinon continuum. Band inversion of the renormalized tight-binding model occurs on the same critical locus, producing jumps in the Chern number and Z₂ invariant mirrored by the skyrmion charge Q. This gives a microscopic link: Q selects the axion angle and thus the topological magnetoelectric coupling. We distinguish axion coupling, independent of skyrmion helicity, from the helicity-dependent magnetoelectric multipole coupling, whose toroidal component scales as sinγ and vanishes for Néel-type textures. We derive the Q-topological magnetoelectric energy and estimate sim 10⁻²⁰,J per skyrmion per cycle for few-tesla fields. The cycle is thermodynamically bounded: constant-θ cycles extract no net work, and efficiency is limited by axionic entropy change.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过结合密度泛函理论（DFT）和重整化关联蜂窝模型，研究了Bi₂Se₃中的多重序。研究发现，表面态映射到一个具有受挫J₁-J₂交换的蜂窝Hubbard模型，精确对角化结果显示Néel结构因子和价键固体序参数在J₂/J₁约0.22处交叉。重整化紧束缚模型的能带反转发生在相同的临界轨迹上，导致陈数和Z₂不变量的跳变，这与斯格明子电荷Q相对应。这建立了一个微观联系：Q选择轴子角，从而决定拓扑磁电耦合。
authors: Aniekan Magnus Ukpong

articles.title: Collective Modes of Fractional States Beyond Landau Levels
articles.title_zh: 朗道能级之外分数态的集体模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03805v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Collective modes provide a powerful probe into the properties and stability of topologically ordered and strongly interacting phases of matter, such as fractional quantum Hall states. Yet, the description of fractional-state excitations away from the Landau-level limit remains a formidable challenge. We develop a framework for describing collective excitations in the strong-coupling regime of coupled-wire constructions and show that they emerge as solitons and breathers of effective sine-Gordon theories. This approach provides a systematic route to studying collective modes in a broad class of fractional states. Applied to a coupled-wire construction of the fractional quantum Hall effect, the framework captures key features of the magnetoroton branch. It naturally extends to fractional Chern insulators, demonstrating that magnetoroton-like collective modes persist well beyond the Landau-level limit. We find that the magnetoroton gap increases as the Fubini-Study metric approaches the ideal (trace-condition) limit, highlighting the important role of quantum geometry in the stability of fractionalized phases and their collective excitations. The same trend favors the stability of the long-wavelength quadrupolar mode associated with the chiral graviton. Together, these results identify a distinct interplay between fractionalization and quantum geometry, and provide an analytical framework for studies of collective excitations in fractional topological matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 集体模式是探测拓扑有序和强相互作用物质相（如分数量子霍尔态）性质和稳定性的有力工具。本文开发了一个框架，用于描述耦合线构造强耦合区域中的集体激发，并表明它们作为有效sine-Gordon理论的孤子和呼吸子出现。该方法为研究广泛分数态中的集体模式提供了一条系统途径。应用于分数量子霍尔效应的耦合线构造时，该框架捕捉了磁旋子分支的关键特征，并自然地扩展到分数陈绝缘体。
authors: Peleg Emanuel, Yuval Oreg

articles.title: Repulsion-Driven Topological Superconductivity in Twisted MoTe₂
articles.title_zh: 扭曲MoTe₂中排斥驱动的拓扑超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03833v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that a microscopic model of twisted MoTe₂ with screened Coulomb interactions produces topological superconductivity. Using the density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) on infinite cylinders, we find that the narrow Chern band of twisted MoTe₂ has Cooper pair correlations that strengthen with cylinder circumference, consistent with two dimensional superconductivity. The superconductor has chiral f-wave pairing around the valley center, and its topology produces chiral Majorana edge modes and non-Abelian vortex cores. At zero displacement field, the superconductor spans fillings -0.78łesssimνłesssim-0.72, close to the experimental range, and extends in a dome to finite displacement field. We then predict how its stiffness evolves with the filling and the tunable displacement field. The interplay with screening length is also examined. Nearby, we find a fractional Chern insulator, a topological charge density wave, a metal, and a charge-ordered state. The last is a candidate for the reentrant integer Hall regime in experiments. These results establish a route from repulsive interactions in microscopic models of moiré materials to chiral topological uperconductors with chiral Majorana edge modes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了扭曲MoTe₂的微观模型在屏蔽库仑相互作用下能产生拓扑超导性。利用无限圆柱上的密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）方法，研究发现扭曲MoTe₂的窄陈带具有随圆柱周长增强的库珀对关联，这与二维超导性一致。该超导体在谷中心附近具有手性f波配对，其拓扑结构产生手性马约拉纳边缘模式和非阿贝尔涡旋核。这些结果为莫尔材料微观模型中由排斥相互作用产生拓扑超导性提供了途径。
authors: Tianle Wang, Tomohiro Soejima, Norman Y. Yao, Ashvin Vishwanath, Michael P. Zaletel, Taige Wang, Daniel E. Parker

articles.title: LaQX: A JAX Toolkit for Neural Quantum State Simulations of Lattice Quantum Many-Body Models
articles.title_zh: LaQX：用于格点量子多体模型神经量子态模拟的JAX工具包
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04333v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural quantum states provide accurate variational representations for interacting lattice fermions and spins. Turning a new ansatz into a reproducible calculation, however, requires coordinated implementations of the Hamiltonian, sampling, optimization, observables, and accelerator parallelism. We present LaQX (Lattice Quantum simulation based on jaX), an open-source neural quantum state library based on JAX that organizes these components through common functional interfaces. Beyond ground-state variational Monte Carlo, LaQX supports excited-state calculations, Green's Function Monte Carlo refinement, adiabatic evolution, and real-time evolution with time-dependent variational Monte Carlo. It consolidates methods developed in recent high-accuracy neural quantum state studies of the Hubbard model and frustrated magnets, and the package has been used to investigate the triangular-lattice Hofstadter-Hubbard model. We document these capabilities with reproducible calculations for Hubbard, J₁₋J₂ Heisenberg, altermagnetic Hubbard, and interacting Hofstadter models. Function-oriented modules separate the scientific components and limit the source context needed for extensions by human developers and large language models. Source code, documentation, and executable examples are available at https://github.com/bytedance/laqx.
articles.abstract_zh: 神经量子态为相互作用的格点费米子和自旋提供了精确的变分表示。本文介绍了LaQX (Lattice Quantum simulation based on jaX)，一个基于JAX的开源神经量子态库，它通过通用函数接口组织了哈密顿量、采样、优化、可观测值和加速器并行等组件。除了基态变分蒙特卡洛，LaQX还支持激发态计算、格林函数蒙特卡洛细化、绝热演化和时间依赖变分蒙特卡洛的实时演化。该工具包已用于研究三角晶格Hofstadter-Hubbard模型，并提供了Hubbard、J₁-J₂ Heisenberg等模型的复现性计算。
authors: Yuntian Gu, Chaohui Fan, Ruichen Li, Haoxiang Chen, Weizhong Fu, Yixiao Chen, Dingshun Lv, Weiluo Ren, Tao Xiang, Liwei Wang, Mingpu Qin, Xiang Li

articles.title: Single-anchor Delta-learning with the cluster Gutzwiller approximation: predicting phase boundaries of strongly correlated bosons in optical lattices
articles.title_zh: 基于团簇Gutzwiller近似的单锚点Delta学习：预测光晶格中强关联玻色子的相边界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04936v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The cluster Gutzwiller method is widely used to study strongly correlated bosonic systems in optical lattices because it explicitly treats quantum fluctuations within a cluster. However, its computational cost grows exponentially with the cluster size, making large-cluster phase diagrams computationally expensive. To reduce this cost, we recently introduced Delta-learning into cluster Gutzwiller calculations and proposed multipoint regression Delta-learning (MPR-Delta), which learns the difference between small- and large-cluster results from four high-cost critical points of the target cluster and thereby predicts the complete target phase boundary. For sufficiently large target clusters, however, even computing one critical point on the phase boundary is already expensive, so obtaining four such points remains highly costly. A natural question then arises: can the complete target phase boundary be predicted with fewer high-cost critical points of the target cluster? To address this question, we propose single-anchor Delta-learning (SA-Delta), which requires only a single high-cost critical point of the target cluster to reconstruct the complete target phase boundary, thereby greatly reducing the computational cost. We test this framework on several classes of Bose-Hubbard models and find that, in the cases considered, it achieves lower reconstruction errors with fewer high-cost points than MPR-Delta. The combination of SA-Delta with the cluster Gutzwiller approximation thus provides an efficient framework for studying phase transitions of strongly correlated bosonic systems in complex optical lattices, and may be extended to more complex quantum many-body systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 团簇Gutzwiller方法广泛用于研究光晶格中的强关联玻色子系统，但其计算成本随团簇大小呈指数增长。为了降低成本，本文提出了单锚点Delta学习（SA-Delta）方法。该方法仅需目标团簇的一个高成本临界点即可重建完整的相边界，从而有效解决了多点回归Delta学习（MPR-Delta）在大型团簇中仍需多个高成本点的问题。
authors: Shengbiao Yang, Sheng Yue, Zhi Lin

articles.title: Symmetry-protected isolation of the quantum metric in chiral type-II semi-Dirac semimetals
articles.title_zh: 手性II型半狄拉克半金属中量子度规的对称性保护隔离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04996v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum geometry, comprising the Berry curvature (BC) and the quantum metric (QM), underpins a wide array of topological and transport phenomena. However, in most solid-state platforms, BC and QM signals are inherently entangled, making their experimental separation highly challenging. Here, we demonstrate that the chiral limit of type-II semi-Dirac semimetals provides a symmetry-protected mechanism to cleanly isolate the QM. At the chiral limit where the spin-orbit gap m_z=0, chiral and PT symmetries strictly suppress the BC, its dipole (BCD), and the shift current, leaving the QM and its dipole (QMD) as the sole sources of the optical and nonlinear Hall responses. This pure-QM regime exhibits distinct experimental fingerprints, including a divergent longitudinal optical conductivity and a QMD-induced nonlinear Hall conductivity that exhibits a pronounced singularity as the chemical potential approaches the nodal point. Turning on a finite m_z reactivates the BC channels, transitioning the system from a pure-QM phase into a mixed geometric phase. By deriving a scaling law for the nonlinear Hall conductivity, we establish a direct experimental strategy to separate the mixed Drude, BCD, and QMD contributions based on their distinct relaxation-time dependencies. Our findings identify chiral type-II semi-Dirac semimetals as highly tunable platforms for isolating and probing intrinsic quantum geometric effects.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子几何，包括贝里曲率（BC）和量子度规（QM），是多种拓扑和输运现象的基础。本文证明，II型半狄拉克半金属的手性极限提供了一种对称性保护机制，可以清晰地隔离量子度规。在手性极限下，手性和PT对称性严格抑制了BC及其偶极子和位移电流，使得QM及其偶极子（QMD）成为光学和非线性霍尔响应的唯一来源。这种纯QM区域表现出独特的实验特征，包括发散的纵向光电导和QMD引起的非线性霍尔电导。
authors: Wen-Hao Bian, Jing Wang

articles.title: Observation of Scaling of Higher-Order Flow in a Unitary Fermi Gas
articles.title_zh: 幺正费米气体中高阶流的标度行为观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05028v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Collective flow emerging from spatially anisotropic many-body systems is a fundamental manifestation of strongly interacting quantum matter, from ultracold quantum gases to the quark-gluon plasma created in relativistic heavy-ion collisions. Yet how collective flow emerges across different spatial harmonics and how dissipation modifies its evolution remain largely unexplored. Here we investigate the nonequilibrium expansion of a unitary Fermi gas initially confined in nearly homogeneous potentials with engineered angular deformations. By suddenly releasing the confinement, we resolve anisotropic flow harmonics up to the seventh order. Remarkably, after normalization and rescaling by the characteristic expansion timescale, the different harmonics and system sizes exhibit a universal early-time evolution. At longer times, this universality breaks down and we observe an approximately quadratic dependence of the harmonic attenuation on harmonic order, consistent with viscous acoustic scaling. Furthermore, temperature-dependent measurements reveal the role of shear viscosity in the dissipative evolution of higher-order flow. Our results open a new route to exploring the interplay between universal hydrodynamic expansion and dissipative transport, connecting collective dynamics in ultracold quantum gases with anisotropic flow in strongly interacting nuclear matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 集体流是强相互作用量子物质的基本表现，但其在不同空间谐波中的出现方式以及耗散如何改变其演化仍未被充分探索。本文研究了幺正费米气体在非平衡膨胀中的行为，并解析了高达七阶的各向异性流谐波。研究发现，在归一化和特征膨胀时间尺度重标后，不同谐波和系统尺寸表现出普适的早期时间演化。在较长时间内，这种普适性被打破，并观察到谐波衰减对谐波阶数近似二次依赖，这与粘性声学标度一致。
authors: Shuxian Yu, Zhijie Zhang, Yunyi Zhao, Shujin Deng, Meng-Zi Huang, Haibin Wu, Yu-Gang Ma

articles.title: Kekulé Superconductivity Induced by Quantum Geometry in Haldane Phases
articles.title_zh: Haldane相中量子几何诱导的Kekulé超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.21791v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Chiral two-dimensional electron gases, which capture the electronic properties of graphene and rhombohedral graphene systems, exhibit singular momentum-space vortices and are susceptible to interaction-induced topological Haldane phases. Here, we investigate pairing interactions in the inversion-symmetric Haldane phases of chiral two-dimensional electron gases. We demonstrate that the nontrivial band topology of the Haldane phases enhances intra-valley (Qq = ± 2 Kk_D) pair susceptibility relative to inter-valley (Qq = 0) pair susceptibility, favoring the emergence of a lattice-scale pair-density wave order. When longitudinal acoustic phonons mediate the pairing interaction, the system supports a chiral Kekulè superconducting order at low densities. At higher densities, the phase diagram depends on the parity of the Chern number J. For even parity, an s-wave Kekulè order appears, while for odd parity we find a Qq =0 valley triplet chiral-J and a valley singlet s-wave order at different densities. Our findings are relevant to superconductivity in rhombohedral graphene and Kagome metals.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性二维电子气表现出奇异的动量空间涡旋，并易受相互作用诱导的拓扑Haldane相影响。本文研究了手性二维电子气反演对称Haldane相中的配对相互作用。研究表明，Haldane相的非平凡能带拓扑增强了谷内配对磁化率，从而有利于晶格尺度对密度波序的出现。当纵向声学声子介导配对相互作用时，系统在低密度下支持手性Kekulé超导序。这些发现与菱形石墨烯和Kagome金属中的超导性相关。
authors: Yafis Barlas, Fan Zhang, Enrico Rossi

articles.title: Photoinduced topological phase transition in monolayer 1T^prime-MoS₂
articles.title_zh: 单层1T'-MoS₂中的光致拓扑相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.15268v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the systematic competition between perpendicular electric field and circularly polarized light in nonequilibrium topological phases of monolayer 1T^prime--MoS₂ using a low-energy k!ḑot!p Hamiltonian and Floquet theory. The off-resonant field generates spin- and valley-dependent mass corrections that reshape the Berry curvature (BC) and shift the conditions for band inversion. By evaluating the quasienergy bands, BC, and spin- valley-resolved Chern numbers, we identify a sequence of light and electric field controlled topological transitions by gap closing. Depending on the Floquet coupling strength and the electric-field parameter, the system evolves between the equilibrium quantum spin Hall (QSH) state and a set of driven phases including spin-polarized quantum Hall insulator (S-QHI), band insulator (BI) and photo-induced quantum Hall insulator (P-QHI) regimes. The results establish 1T^prime--MoS₂ as a tunable platform where circular driving selectively manipulates spin and valley degrees of freedom, enabling controlled access to non-equilibrium topological phases in transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs).
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用低能k·p哈密顿量和Floquet理论，研究了单层1T'-MoS₂非平衡拓扑相中垂直电场和圆偏振光之间的系统性竞争。非共振场产生自旋和谷依赖的质量修正，重塑贝里曲率并改变能带反转条件。通过评估准能量带、贝里曲率和自旋-谷分辨陈数，作者识别了一系列由光和电场控制的拓扑相变。这些结果确立了1T'-MoS₂作为一个可调谐平台，其中圆周驱动可以选择性地操纵自旋和谷自由度，从而实现对过渡金属二硫化物（TMDs）中非平衡拓扑相的受控访问。
authors: Mohammad Mortezaei Nobahari

articles.title: Field-induced first order quantum phase transition of the superconducting order parameter in Ising superconductors with Rashba spin-orbit coupling
articles.title_zh: 具有Rashba自旋轨道耦合的Ising超导体中超导序参量的场致一级量子相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.01910v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ising superconductors have attracted significant attention recently due to their resilience against magnetic fields far beyond the Pauli-paramagnetic limit as well as their broader role as a platform for exploring the interplay of spin-orbit coupling, valley degrees of freedom and superconducting pairing in two-dimensional materials. Their protection against external magnetic field relies on strong Ising spin-orbit coupling, which originates from in-plane inversion symmetry breaking. Due to the heavy atom nature of Ising SCs, a smaller but sizable Rashba SOC can arise from gating or interfacial effects. Here, we study Rashba spin-orbit coupling within a two-valley model of Ising superconductors with an attractive s-wave interaction. We show that Rashba SOC induces a first order quantum phase transition in Ising superconductors. At low temperatures, this means the superconducting order parameter vanishes abruptly in the vicinity of the quantum critical point. This effect, however, disappears at high temperatures. Our findings demonstrate that the low- and high temperature physics of Ising SCs are quantitatively and qualitatively different in the two-valley model.
articles.abstract_zh: Ising超导体因其对磁场的强韧性以及在二维材料中探索自旋轨道耦合、谷自由度和超导配对相互作用的平台作用而备受关注。本研究在一个双谷模型中，探讨了Rashba自旋轨道耦合对Ising超导体的作用。结果表明，Rashba自旋轨道耦合会在Ising超导体中诱导一级量子相变。在低温下，超导序参量在量子临界点附近会突然消失，但这种效应在高温下则会消失。

articles.title: Nonlocal Cooper pairs in finite topological superconductors and their relation to Majorana nonlocality
articles.title_zh: 有限拓扑超导体中的非局域库珀对及其与马约拉纳非局域性的关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.25169v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We identify two fundamental properties of the Gor'kov Green's function of finite one-dimensional topological superconductors. In the low-frequency (low-energy) regime, the normal and anomalous Green's functions become identical up to a phase factor. Moreover, they exhibit pronounced nonlocality: the components connecting the two ends of the system grow exponentially with system length, whereas the local components at either end vanish in the zero-frequency limit. These striking features signify the emergence of unconventional nonlocal Cooper pairs associated with a nonlocal fermionic mode composed of hybridized Majorana end modes. The nonlocal Cooper pairs are directly linked to fermion parity and to the nonlocal transport properties of finite topological superconductors. By uncovering the unusual nonlocal properties of the Gor'kov Green's function, our analysis advances the understanding of Majorana nonlocality, a key concept in topological quantum computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文揭示了有限一维拓扑超导体中Gor'kov格林函数的两个基本特性。在低频（低能）区域，正常和反常格林函数在相位因子上变得相同，并表现出显著的非局域性。这些特性表明了与杂化马约拉纳末端模式组成的非局域费米子模式相关的非传统非局域库珀对的出现。这些非局域库珀对与费米子宇称以及有限拓扑超导体的非局域输运性质直接相关，从而深化了对马约拉纳非局域性的理解。

articles.title: Statistical levels and spatial modes of Fock-space heterogeneity in many-body localization crossovers
articles.title_zh: 多体局域化交叉中福克空间异质性的统计层次和空间模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.15323v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Near many-body localization crossovers, local memory fluctuates strongly among eigenstates and ensemble realizations, but the observed heterogeneity combines contributions from different statistical levels. We develop a statistical framework based on configuration-space distance distributions that uses a variance decomposition to separate fluctuations within eigenstates, between eigenstates of one sample, and between samples. Applying this framework to random-cosine and quasiperiodic-cosine Ising ensembles with the same one-site field marginal, we find that, at the exact-diagonalization sizes studied, the clearest difference occurs among disorder realizations or quasiperiodic phase samples, whereas within-eigenstate and within-sample eigenstate-to- eigenstate contributions remain broadly comparable. Spatial covariances show that random outer fluctuations have a much stronger uniform component, whereas quasiperiodic phase fluctuations are organized more strongly at finite wave number and partly cancel in the spatial average controlling the distance center. We find that, near the crossover in the random ensemble, the ensemble-averaged distance center is particularly sensitive to changes in the nominal field strength. Combined with sample-to-sample differences in the realized field amplitude, this mean response accounts for much of the sample-to-sample variation in the distance center. Analysis of half-chain entanglement further shows that its sample-to-sample fluctuations likewise reflect the combined effects of amplitude variations and its own mean response. An application to a fixed-magnetization spin chain demonstrates the framework in a constrained configuration space. Resolving both statistical level and spatial mode therefore provides a more complete picture of sample- dependent many-body memory and its configuration-space probability geometry.

articles.title: Long-range deformations in Gaussian states
articles.title_zh: 高斯态中的长程形变
articles.abstract: Imaginary-time evolution by a local Hamiltonian cannot induce a phase transition in one dimension, but longer-range interactions may subvert such constraints. Starting from the ground state of the Kitaev Majorana chain, we modify the wave function by an imaginary-time evolution generated by a quadratic Hamiltonian with power-law couplings that enhance pairing correlations, typically of the form , where is the distance between two sites. As the state remains Gaussian, entanglement and correlation functions can be computed analytically. We find that the decay exponent controls three distinct infrared regimes: for , the deformation produces only smooth crossovers at finite deformation strength, while the topological regime is reached only asymptotically as the deformation strength tends to infinity. At , the deformation induces an immediate flow to the topological phase: an infinitesimal deformation strength drives the system to a topological regime, and in a particular case, an emergent Kramers–Wannier symmetry enforces Ising-like scaling at long distances. For , the deformed state shows the same critical-like behavior for all non-zero deformation strength. We observe that even with arbitrarily long-range interactions, these models do not display a sharp phase transition at non-zero deformation strength.
articles.abstract_zh: 局部哈密顿量的虚时演化无法在一维系统中诱导相变，但长程相互作用可能打破这一限制。本文从Kitaev马约拉纳链的基态出发，通过由具有幂律耦合的二次哈密顿量生成的虚时演化来修改波函数。研究发现，衰减指数控制着三种不同的红外区域：对于α > 1，形变仅在有限形变强度下产生平滑的交叉；对于α = 1，形变立即导致系统进入拓扑相；而对于α < 1，形变态在所有非零形变强度下都表现出相同的临界类行为。
authors: Francisco Pereira, Nandagopal Manoj and Sara Murciano

articles.title: Energy-accounting validation of QEC-assisted quantum batteries
articles.title_zh: 量子纠错辅助量子电池的能量核算验证
articles.abstract: Quantum error correction protects logical information, whereas a quantum battery is judged by the work it can deliver. We ask when a recovery operation applied during storage may be credited with protecting a battery’s ergotropy. The second law bounds the average work of each recovery call from below by the change of nonequilibrium free energy it causes at bath temperature ; as a storage convention we debit the nonnegative part of this change and take the net ergotropy gain left per call as the budget for all further overhead. We apply this ledger to batteries of two to four two-level cells under collective and independent Lindblad noise, testing a coherence-restoring heuristic, the four-qubit amplitude-damping code with two recovery completions, standard channel families, and reset channels. Every state in the code space of the code has zero mean energy and at most half the maximal ergotropy, so a decoder that restores the code space cannot protect a fully charged battery; a completion that leaves the rest of the Hilbert space untouched avoids this bound but still loses ergotropy on a fully charged battery during storage. Unital recoveries cannot raise the ergotropy by more than the energy they supply. For four cells and inputs diagonal in the energy basis, an optimal energy-nonincreasing covariant recovery is attained by a reset channel, whose value we give in closed form and whose gain comes from removing entropy. At mK and GHz the tested recoveries leave at most energy quanta per call beyond the debit, less than one photon at the cell frequency, so any implementation that dissipates a single quantum per call beyond the debit loses ergotropy.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子纠错（QEC）旨在保护逻辑信息，而量子电池则以其可提供的功来衡量。本文探讨了在存储过程中应用的恢复操作何时能被视为保护电池的可用功。研究人员将第二定律应用于两到四个两能级单元的电池，在集体和独立的Lindblad噪声下，测试了多种恢复策略。结果表明，恢复码空间状态的解码器无法保护充满电的电池，而保持希尔伯特空间其余部分不变的恢复操作在存储过程中仍会使充满电的电池损失可用功。
authors: Sangkeum Lee

articles.title: Quantum machine learning for quantitative finance
articles.title_zh: 量子机器学习在量化金融中的应用
articles.abstract: Machine learning (ML) and quantum ML (QML) have gained significant importance, as they offer powerful tools for tackling complex computational problems across various domains. An overview of QML’s uses in quantitative finance is presented here. The connection between quantum computing and ML in financial applications, spanning a range of use cases including portfolio optimization, market prediction and trading, pricing and risk management is examined. The different applications from the literature review are categorized based on specific use cases, ML approaches, optimization methods, and the types of quantum hardware utilized. To facilitate this examination, we employ a morphological box, which allows us to analyze different combinations of these elements across financial use cases.
articles.abstract_zh: 机器学习（ML）和量子机器学习（QML）已成为解决复杂计算问题的强大工具。本文概述了QML在量化金融中的应用，探讨了量子计算与ML在金融领域的联系，涵盖了投资组合优化、市场预测与交易、定价和风险管理等用例。研究人员根据具体用例、ML方法、优化方法和所用量子硬件类型对文献中的不同应用进行了分类，并利用形态盒分析了这些元素在金融用例中的不同组合。

The protocol integrates token generation, authentication, and verification into the existing banking workflow using experimentally motivated quantum control techniques. This mitigates card cloning, credential theft, and counterfeiting.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种量子安全的取款框架，通过用量子令牌替换可复制的经典凭证进行身份验证。该协议利用实验验证的量子控制技术，将令牌生成、认证和验证集成到现有银行工作流程中。此方法旨在有效缓解银行卡克隆、凭证盗窃和伪造等安全风险。

articles.title: Optimised finite key for satellite up-link entangled quantum key distribution
articles.title_zh: 卫星上行纠缠量子密钥分发的优化有限密钥
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03788v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Entanglement-based quantum key distribution from ground to satellite has been proposed as a scalable primitive for global quantum networks and will be demonstrated as part of the imminent QEYSSat mission. Both theoretical studies and experimental emulations have shown that a significant asymptotic key rate can be expected. In this work we investigate this scenario with a more rigorous security analysis taking into account the finite size effects that arise from short block lengths common in satellite transmission. Our findings suggest a slight alteration of the optimal source operation when informed by finite statistics as opposed to the asymptotic regime, notably that the pump power should be slightly lowered. We quantify the annual key rate based on a dynamically optimised source operation for the Heriot-Watt ground station and several satellite parameters. We find an improved annual key rate when accumulating all raw key material before extracting a secure key instead of doing so for each overpass. We ultimately show that QEYSSat will be able to generate a significant secure annual key with both strategies.
articles.abstract_zh: 地面到卫星的纠缠量子密钥分发被认为是全球量子网络的可扩展基础，并将通过QEYSSat任务进行演示。本文对该场景进行了更严格的安全分析，考虑了卫星传输中短块长度引起的有限尺寸效应。研究发现，在有限统计数据下，最佳光源操作应略微降低泵浦功率。通过动态优化光源操作，量化了Heriot-Watt地面站的年密钥率，并表明QEYSSat任务能够通过两种策略生成显著的年度安全密钥。
authors: Thomas Jaeken, Faris Redza, Stefan Bäuml, Daniel K. L. Oi, Alessandro Fedrizzi, Jasminder S. Sidhu

articles.title: Entanglement-Aware Quantum Circuit Optimization through Globally Optimal Partitioning
articles.title_zh: 通过全局最优划分实现纠缠感知量子电路优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03845v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a scalable framework for globally optimal quantum-circuit partitioning and entanglement-aware block resynthesis. The partitioning problem is formulated as an integer linear program over qubit-feasible convex subcircuits, supporting objectives such as minimizing the number of partitions or a weighted execution cost. The resulting partition selection is exact over the enumerated feasible candidates and their computed costs when the ILP is solved to proven optimality. The selected partitions are resynthesized using an operator-Schmidt rank (OSR) based synthesis technique, which exploits their internal entanglement structure. We compare the end-to-end integer linear programming (ILP)--OSR workflow with BQSKit while identifying their different routing methods, and separately compare local OSR and BQSKit synthesis on matched three- and four-qubit unitaries. On the frozen sample of 772 local unitary targets, OSR produces 741 verified syntheses versus 617 for BQSKit, and matches or improves the CNOT count in all 617 jointly verified pairs. These results demonstrate that globally optimal partition selection combined with entanglement-aware resynthesis improves circuit quality and extends block-based optimization to problem sizes that are impractical for existing optimization workflows.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种可扩展的框架，用于全局最优量子电路划分和纠缠感知块重合成。该划分问题被表述为基于量子比特可行凸子电路的整数线性规划，支持最小化分区数量或加权执行成本等目标。选定的分区使用基于算符施密特秩（OSR）的合成技术进行重合成，该技术利用了其内部纠缠结构。与BQSKit的比较结果显示，OSR在772个局部酉目标中产生了741个经过验证的合成，而BQSKit为617个，并且在所有617个共同验证的对中，OSR的CNOT计数均匹配或优于BQSKit。
authors: Gregory Morse, Muhammad Al Farizi, Jakab Nádori, László Hajas, Tamás Kozsik, Peter Rakyta

articles.title: High-fidelity quantum gate learning via physics-informed neural networks
articles.title_zh: 基于物理信息神经网络的高保真量子门学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03851v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a physics-informed neural network (PINN) approach for high-fidelity quantum gate learning in both one- and two-qubit systems. We train a PINN using the time-dependent Schrödinger equation, where smooth control fields with fixed boundary conditions are obtained by minimizing a loss function that considers model dynamics, gate error, physical constraints, regularization terms, and multiple initial conditions. Training considers pairs of mutually unbiased bases, while independent validation combines Haar-random input states with the average gate fidelity. Unitary simulations yield an average gate infidelity of 8.49×10⁻⁸ for Hadamard and values between 3.39×10⁻⁷ and 4.96×10⁻⁶ for controlled-NOT under XX, YY, and ZZ interactions. We examine how the learned control fields depend on the coupling, training configuration, and available local fields, including five exchange-type dipolar scenarios. We test the learned control fields under the Lindblad master equation with dephasing and amplitude damping, theoretically reproducing the expected first-order fidelity loss in the weak-dissipation regime. Finally, boundary-adapted Chebyshev expansions represent 139 learned controls with a minimum common count of Kₐₛₜ₌₂₄ coefficients per control for all eleven family-averaged mean squared errors to fall below 10⁻⁶. Separately, square-pulse and Strang propagation at K=30 preserve all 31 continuous polynomial references within infidelity 10⁻⁵ at N=128 and all larger tested resolutions, under both sampling rules. These results connect multi-state gate synthesis, control-resource characterization, and compact square-pulse playback.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于物理信息神经网络（PINN）的方法，用于在一量子比特和双量子比特系统中实现高保真量子门学习。通过最小化考虑模型动力学、门误差、物理约束和正则化项的损失函数，PINN在含时薛定谔方程下进行训练，以获得具有固定边界条件的平滑控制场。酉模拟结果显示，Hadamard门的平均门失真度为8.49×10⁻⁸，而受控非门在不同相互作用下失真度在3.39×10⁻⁷到4.96×10⁻⁶之间。研究还探讨了学习到的控制场如何依赖于耦合、训练配置和可用局部场，并在Lindblad主方程下测试了这些控制场。
authors: Luis Fabra, Cristian E. Susa, Alcides Montoya, Ariel Norambuena

articles.title: Hardware-Aware Design and Layout Selection in Quantum Reservoir Computing for Insurance Claims Forecasting
articles.title_zh: 量子储备池计算中用于保险索赔预测的硬件感知设计与布局选择
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03891v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum reservoir computing (QRC) processes temporal information through quantum dynamics, but it remains unclear whether small QRC models can forecast real data competitively with classical models and whether their predictions survive the transfer from ideal simulation to noisy hardware. We address both questions for a six-qubit gate-based reservoir that forecasts next-day motor-insurance claim counts. Five reservoir candidates were selected and frozen using hardware-native interaction graphs, Trotterized Ising dynamics, memory and measurement-robustness criteria, circuit cost, and calibrated-noise screening. On 232 held-out test days, the ideal candidates reached root-mean-square errors (RMSEs) of 5.66-6.12 claims/day, compared with 5.36 for ridge regression. For four of the five, the difference from ridge was not significant under a 95% block bootstrap, and their accuracy was comparable with classical recurrent and reservoir baselines. On the 156-qubit IBM Kingston processor, we ran 63 evaluations in 21 paired rounds, comparing hardware-aware, random-native, and Qiskit optimization level 1 layouts. Hardware-aware placement gave lower RMSE than Qiskit in every round, with a maximum transfer distortion of 7.59 claims/day (11.84 for Qiskit), and avoided the severe transfer failures seen for some random layouts. Most of the hardware distortion appeared as a systematic forecast shift, which a short hardware probe on training inputs detected before the test runs. Longer replay windows raised circuit cost without a consistent gain in forecasting accuracy or hardware transfer. Small QRC models can thus reach competitive accuracy on this task, and hardware-aware layout selection makes their transfer to IBM Kingston more consistent.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子储备池计算（QRC）通过量子动力学处理时间信息，但其在真实数据预测方面的竞争力以及在噪声硬件上的表现仍不明确。本文针对一个六量子比特门基储备池，预测次日汽车保险索赔数量。研究人员选择了五个储备池候选方案，并使用硬件原生交互图、Trotter化Ising动力学等标准进行评估。在232个测试日中，理想候选方案的RMSE为5.66-6.12，与岭回归的5.36相当。在IBM Kingston处理器上，硬件感知布局表现出较低的错误率。
authors: Renáta Rusnáková, Eugen Šlapak, Gaurav K. Pandey, Juraj Gazda

articles.title: Unital qubit channels are 3-noisy
articles.title_zh: 单一量子比特信道是3噪声的
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03894v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The algebraic and environmental characteristics of mixed unitary quantum operations are investigated. It is established that the composition of two uniformly n-mixed unitary channels is itself n-noisy, and this n-noisy property is shown to be an invariant under unitary equivalence. Furthermore, by utilizing majorization and the divisibility of Kraus rank-four unital qubit channels, we demonstrate that any unital qubit channel can be physically simulated using a three-dimensional maximally mixed environment. Together, these results advance the classification and physical realization of noisy quantum channels.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了混合酉量子操作的代数和环境特性。结果表明，两个均匀n混合酉信道的组合本身是n噪声的，并且这种n噪声特性在酉等价下是不变的。此外，通过利用Kraus秩四单一量子比特信道的主化和可分性，我们证明了任何单一量子比特信道都可以通过三维最大混合环境进行物理模拟。这些结果共同推动了噪声量子信道的分类和物理实现。
authors: Indu Bala, Preeti Parashar, Swapan Rana

articles.title: Non-Hermitian effective dynamics from post-selection protocols
articles.title_zh: 后选择协议产生的非厄米有效动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03910v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multiple seemingly distinct frameworks are commonly proposed to explain the emergence of effective non-Hermitian dynamics in quantum systems coupled to an environment. Furthermore, it remains contested how to properly calculate expectation values or whether thermal equilibrium states exist in non-Hermitian systems. In this work, we show that Feshbach projection, the Lindblad master equation, and the ancilla approach can all be understood through the Kraus map formalism, leading to non-Hermitian time evolution if an appropriate post-selection procedure is enforced. After first deriving an exact expression for the conditional system dynamics, we discuss the approximations employed in each approach and the classes of non-Hermitian Hamiltonians that can be obtained. Within this framework, we physically justify the consistency of the right-right formalism (as opposed to the biorthogonal one) for calculating expectation values. Finally, we demonstrate that the traditional notion of thermodynamic equilibrium is not applicable to general non-Hermitian systems. Consequently, stationary states are characterized as non-equilibrium steady states, which should not be conflated with system-projected thermal states of the system-environment composite.
articles.abstract_zh: 本工作探讨了量子系统中非厄米有效动力学的出现，并统一了Feshbach投影、Lindblad主方程和辅助比特方法，将其理解为在适当后选择程序下通过Kraus映射形式导致的非厄米时间演化。研究推导了条件系统动力学的精确表达式，并讨论了各种方法的近似及其可获得的非厄米哈密顿量类别。在此框架下，物理上证明了右-右形式（而非双正交形式）计算期望值的一致性，并指出传统热力学平衡概念不适用于一般非厄米系统，因此稳态被表征为非平衡稳态。
authors: Apostolos Siskou, Volker Meden

articles.title: Tight Quasiprobabilistic Entropic Uncertainty Relations for Discrete Quantum Systems
articles.title_zh: 离散量子系统紧致准概率熵不确定关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04009v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: It was conjectured by Wehrl and proven by Lieb that the Shannon differential entropy of the Husimi function of a continuous-variable quantum state is lower bounded by the value it takes on coherent states. This corroborates the intuition, familiar from Heisenberg's uncertainty relations, that coherent states are minimal uncertainty states. The analogous statement for the Wigner function would be that the Wigner differential entropy of states with a positive Wigner function is bounded below by the entropy of pure Gaussian states. This was conjectured a decade ago, but recently disproven. Here, we prove the analogous statement for Kirkwood-Dirac distributions with mutually unbiased bases and for the Gross-Wigner distributions. For these discrete systems, the entropy-minimizing role is played by the pure states with positive quasiprobability distributions. Further, we prove that Kirkwood-Dirac distributions with large nonpositivity have large uncertainty.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究针对离散量子系统，证明了Kirkwood-Dirac分布和Gross-Wigner分布的准概率熵不确定关系，其中具有正准概率分布的纯态扮演着熵最小化的角色。这与连续变量系统中相干态作为最小不确定态的直觉相符。此外，研究还证明了具有较大非正性的Kirkwood-Dirac分布具有较大的不确定性。
authors: Jonathan J. Thio, Stephan De Bièvre, Crispin H. W. Barnes, David R. M. Arvidsson-Shukur

articles.title: Runtime Compilation for Quantum Circuits with PQF-Enabled R_z Synthesis
articles.title_zh: 启用PQF的R_z合成量子电路的运行时编译
