articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04075v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing (FTQC) using surface codes, reducing T-count is critical for efficient computation due to the high cost of T-state distillation. Probabilistic Quantum Circuit with Fallback (PQF) synthesis significantly lowers T-counts compared to standard protocols like Gridsynth, but introduces high circuit dynamism through extra gates inserted at runtime. This dynamism invalidates static compile-time routing, as these new T gates require dynamic lattice surgery routing to establish non-intersecting ancilla paths to T-state factories while minimizing total execution time. To address this, we introduce R²⁻PQF, a Runtime Routing protocol for PQF-synthesized quantum circuits. R²⁻PQF dynamically routes gates layer-by-layer, computing paths during the execution of the previous logical timestep. To satisfy the strict computational window of sim tₗₐₜₜᵢcₑ_ₛᵤᵣgₑᵣy + tᵣₑₐcₜᵢₒₙ and non-intersectionality constraints, we implement a Wavefront Breadth-First Search (W-BFS) and synthesise it on a 500MHz FPGA and 2 GHz ASIC. For a clock cycle of 2GHz, we achieve a median logical time-step of 1.51 μ s for a 300 qubit Ising Hamiltonian circuit, demonstrating that R²⁻PQF successfully resolves the vast majority of paths (with rare exceptions) within the execution window and enables the T-count benefits of PQF without latency penalties. Compared to a baseline stalling-based solution (the only no-runtime-recomputation solution), R²⁻PQF speeds up circuit execution by 1.34× on average and up to 1.76 ×.
articles.abstract_zh: 在容错量子计算中，降低T门计数对于提高计算效率至关重要，但概率量子电路与回退（PQF）合成引入的运行时动态性使静态编译时路由失效。为解决此问题，本文提出了R²⁻PQF，一种用于PQF合成量子电路的运行时路由协议。R²⁻PQF通过在上一逻辑时间步执行期间计算路径，逐层动态路由门。为满足严格的计算窗口和非交叉约束，研究实现了波前广度优先搜索（W-BFS）并将其综合到FPGA和ASIC上，实现了高效的逻辑时间步。
authors: Siddharth Dangwal, Christopher Kang, Jad Habhab, Ritvik Sharma, Frederic T. Chong, Gokul Subramanian Ravi

articles.title: Anti-distinguishability of quantum channels
articles.title_zh: 量子信道的反可区分性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04105v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study single-query perfect anti-distinguishability/exclusion tasks of finite quantum channel ensembles, primarily using associated Choi operators and process POVMs. Weak perfect anti-distinguishability requires each measurement outcome to exclude an ensemble candidate with certainty, whereas the strong form additionally requires every candidate to have an exclusion outcome occurring with non-zero probability. For pairs of channels, both coincide with perfect distinguishability, whereas larger ensembles exhibit separations. We derive Choi-operator-support-based obstructions: weak exclusion requires at least two rank-deficient Choi operators, while strong exclusion requires the support of every candidate Choi operator to be strictly contained in the joint Choi support. The common Choi support must also lie in the kernel of the PPOVM normalisation. For commuting Choi operators, this condition is sufficient for weak exclusion when the normalisation also commutes with them. Conversely, a nonzero admixture of the same noise channel into every candidate precludes weak exclusion for any probe. We apply these results to measure-and-prepare, state-space contraction, Pauli, and replacer channels. In particular, the full permutation-channel ensemble of an unlabeled POVM is strongly anti-distinguishable exactly when some POVM effect is rank-deficient, while replacer-channel exclusion reduces to state exclusion. A Choi-commuting ensemble exhibits strong exclusion with an unassisted probe although no positive-definite PPOVM normalisation permits even weak exclusion. In contrast, commuting qubit phase gates, whose Choi operators need not commute, admit exact convex-hull criteria for weak and strong exclusion, both attainable without assistance.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文主要利用相关的Choi算子和过程POVM，研究有限量子信道系综的单查询完美反可区分性/排除任务。研究发现，弱完美反可区分性要求每个测量结果能确定性地排除一个系综候选，而强形式则额外要求每个候选都有一个以非零概率发生的排除结果。对于信道对，这两种形式与完美可区分性一致，但对于更大的系综则表现出差异。研究导出了基于Choi算子支持的障碍条件，并将其应用于测量-制备信道。
authors: Ardra Ajitha Vijayan, Nidhin Sudarsanan Ragini

articles.title: Quantum identity authentication protocol via perturbed probability amplitudes
articles.title_zh: 基于扰动概率幅的量子身份认证协议
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04129v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum identity authentication is an effective solution for establishing mutual trust between communicating parties in the post-quantum era. To address the risk of partial secret information leakage under special measurements, this paper designs a quantum identity authentication protocol based on perturbed probability amplitudes. The protocol first proposes a method of encoding a random sequence onto the probability amplitudes of quantum entangled states, forming perturbed probability amplitudes, thereby reducing the involvement of shared information between the sender and receiver. Furthermore, it presents a method for generating n-bit random authentication information based on the n-bit pre-shared information, enhancing the randomness of the authentication information relative to an attacker. The proposed protocol can resist impersonation attack, CNOT attack, and entanglement measurement attack, and ensures backward security. Under equivalent security conditions, the amount of shared information is 1/n that in Chen et al.'s scheme and half that in Dutta et al.'s scheme. And each bit of the secret message has no risk of leakage under special measurements. It can also be extended to a bi-directional quantum identity authentication protocol.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子身份认证是后量子时代建立通信方之间相互信任的有效方案。为解决特殊测量下部分秘密信息泄露的风险，本文设计了一种基于扰动概率幅的量子身份认证协议。该协议通过将随机序列编码到量子纠缠态的概率幅上，减少了收发双方共享信息的参与。此外，它还提出了一种基于预共享信息生成n比特随机认证信息的方法，增强了认证信息的随机性。该协议能抵抗多种攻击，并确保后向安全性，同时在等效安全条件下显著减少了共享信息量。
authors: Xiangqun Fu, Zheng Han, Hongwei Li, Chun Zhou, Shuo Zhang, Jianhong Shi, Tan Li, Wansu Bao

articles.title: Approximate Synthetic Spectra of Quantum Systems Associated with Compact Lie Groups
articles.title_zh: 紧李群相关量子系统的近似合成谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04306v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: How can noncommuting quantum observables retain the geometry of a classical phase space? Motivated by Mumford's question on approximately macroscopically unique (AMU) states and the work of Lin and Wang, we study synthetic spectra of position--momentum and angular-momentum systems. Under the hypotheses of their AMU theorems, nonempty synthetic spectra yield AMU states. For sufficiently small hbar, the position--momentum spectrum fills the plane, while the angular-momentum spectrum contains any prescribed ball. The latter calculation leads to compact Lie groups: we prove that highest-weight coadjoint orbits lie in regional synthetic spectra under an explicit variance bound. Function-space representations of SU(n), SO(n), and Sp(n) provide further examples.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了非对易量子可观测量如何保持经典相空间的几何结构。受Mumford关于近似宏观唯一（AMU）态的问题以及Lin和Wang工作的启发，研究了位置-动量和角动量系统的合成谱。在AMU定理的假设下，非空合成谱产生AMU态。研究还证明了最高权共伴随轨道在明确的方差界限下位于区域合成谱中，并提供了SU(n)、SO(n)和Sp(n)函数空间表示的进一步例子。
authors: Junyang Liu, Hang Wang, Houjin Wang, Haoran Xu

articles.title: A Conditional Quantum Kac-Bernstein Theorem
articles.title_zh: 一个条件量子Kac-Bernstein定理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04363v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We establish a conditional quantum Kac-Bernstein theorem for mixing of two independent, finite-mode bosonic inputs with quantum memories. We characterize exactly when the outputs are conditionally independent given both memories. Each input then decomposes into orthogonal memory sectors sharing a common Gaussian state on the physical system and a bosonic memory factor, up to sector-dependent physical displacements. In particular, triviality of the common bosonic factor implies separability of the inputs, as occurs whenever either memory has finite-dimensional support.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为两个独立的、有限模玻色子输入与量子存储器混合的情况，建立了一个条件量子Kac-Bernstein定理。研究精确地刻画了在给定两个存储器的情况下，何时输出是条件独立的。每个输入随后分解为正交的存储器扇区，这些扇区在物理系统上共享一个共同的高斯态和一个玻色子存储器因子，直至扇区相关的物理位移。特别地，共同玻色子因子的平凡性意味着输入的不可分离性，这在任一存储器具有有限维支持时发生。
authors: Hesam Hosseini, Jinpei Zhao, Masahito Hayashi

articles.title: Reducing the arithmetic cost of quantum derivative pricing with language-model circuit design
articles.title_zh: 利用语言模型电路设计降低量子衍生品定价的算术成本
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04431v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum amplitude estimation can estimate expected discounted payoffs with quadratically fewer oracle calls than Monte Carlo, but each call requires coherent computation. We use language-model-assisted circuit design to reduce reversible payoff arithmetic for a three-asset worst-of autocallable and a target accrual redemption forward (TARF). The constructions retain compact integer representations of market paths alongside contract history, reconstructing quantities temporarily for contract decisions and payoff-angle evaluation. Relative to matched internal references, the factor-sum autocallable and windowed TARF circuits reduce the product of Toffoli count and peak logical qubits (NTₒf Qₘₐₓ) by factors of 2.39 and 4.84, respectively. At a second autocallable setting, fresh search recovers a 1.35-fold saving after the tested fixed adaptation loses its advantage. For the factor-sum circuit, we prove exact coherent execution of its integer specification for every input, incoming accumulator and measurement record, with clean workspace and phase cancellation. A separate lattice calculation gives a numerical angle-tolerance-violation probability of 6.248e-8 and evaluates pricing bias under the declared loading law, with bounded omission but no certified numerical enclosure. The results connect compact representations to lower-cost payoff arithmetic and separately assessed logical and financial correctness. Their resource scope excludes loading, payoff rotation and estimation.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子振幅估计能以平方级减少预言机调用次数来估计预期贴现收益，但每次调用都需要相干计算。本文利用语言模型辅助的电路设计，降低了三资产最差自动赎回期权和目标累积赎回远期（TARF）的可逆收益算术成本。这些构造在保留市场路径紧凑整数表示的同时，也保留了合约历史，并临时重建数量以进行合约决策和收益角度评估。相对于内部参考，因子和自动赎回期权和窗口TARF电路显著降低了Toffoli门计数与峰值逻辑量子比特的乘积。
authors: Monit Sharma, Hoong Chun Lau

articles.title: Universal Free-Electron-Sideband Control
articles.title_zh: 通用自由电子边带控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04432v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Advances in free-electron quantum optics are establishing free electrons as a versatile quantum resource. Photon-induced near-field electron microscopy (PINEM) interactions and free drift provide elementary operations for shaping the longitudinal electron wavefunction, yet their full control capabilities remain unexplored. Here, we prove that a finite sequence of alternating monochromatic PINEM interactions and free drifts can approximate any prescribed inner-product-preserving map from a finite-dimensional input subspace into the full ideal electron-sideband Hilbert space to arbitrary accuracy. We therefore call the protocol PINEMAD (PINEM And Drift). This framework encompasses state preparation, unitary gates, and isometric encoding. We further show numerically that parameter optimization enables high-fidelity state preparation at finite electron energy spreads, using experimentally accessible coupling strengths and tabletop-scale total drift lengths. These results establish electron energy sidebands as a programmable quantum resource.
articles.abstract_zh: 自由电子量子光学领域的进展正将自由电子确立为一种多功能量子资源。本文证明，有限序列的交替单色PINEM相互作用和自由漂移可以任意精度地近似任何从有限维输入子空间到完整理想电子边带希尔伯特空间的内积保持映射。该协议被称为PINEMAD（PINEM And Drift），其框架涵盖了态制备、酉门和等距编码。数值结果表明，参数优化可以在有限电子能量展宽下实现高保真度态制备。这些结果确立了电子能量边带作为一种可编程量子资源。
authors: Tong Shen, Zhexin Zhao, Meng Xiao

articles.title: Hybrid Quantum--Classical Pauli-Correlator Architecture for Image Reconstruction
articles.title_zh: 用于图像重建的混合量子-经典泡利关联器架构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04442v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce the Pauli-Correlator Autoencoder (PCAE), a hybrid quantum--classical architecture for image reconstruction. PCAE splits an image into patches and compresses each patch as a matrix product state (MPS). A small quantum circuit turns each compressed patch into a few measured numbers, and a classical neural network rebuilds the patch from these numbers and the patch position. A learnable energy term, taken from physics, is added to training and tracked as training proceeds. Two versions place the six qubits on a line (PCAE1D) or on a grid (PCAE2D). An averaging step makes the PCAE2D features follow rotations and reflections of the image exactly. Trained on one image at a time, PCAE2D rebuilds images from six public datasets with a peak signal-to-noise ratio of 25.8 to 41.6 decibels. On CIFAR-10 images not used in training, a formula-based stand-in for the PCAE2D features performs within 1 decibel of several simpler classical methods. Five trained models also run on real IBM quantum computers without retraining, and rebuild images at 25.90 to 31.52 decibels. A short argument and a synthetic test show that, with a linear final layer, measuring qubits in pairs is needed for targets built from products of inputs. These results show that PCAE works as a hybrid model that rebuilds varied images and runs on today's quantum hardware at the six-qubit scale.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了泡利关联器自编码器（PCAE），这是一种用于图像重建的混合量子-经典架构。PCAE将图像分割成小块，并将每个小块压缩为矩阵乘积态。一个小型量子电路将每个压缩的小块转换为几个测量值，然后一个经典神经网络根据这些值和位置重建小块。PCAE2D版本在六个公共数据集上重建图像，峰值信噪比达到25.8至41.6分贝。五个训练好的模型也在真实的IBM量子计算机上运行，无需重新训练，并以25.90至31.52分贝的信噪比重建图像。
authors: Sparsho Chakraborty, Siddhartha Patra

articles.title: Broken-Symmetry Reference States for Sample-Based Quantum Diagonalization with Near-DMRG Accuracy
articles.title_zh: 具有近DMRG精度的基于采样的量子对角化中的破对称参考态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04496v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD) accuracy remains limited for strongly correlated systems like iron-sulfur clusters. This accuracy heavily depends on the mean-field reference state, which determines the sampling ansatz and configuration-recovery target. We extend the qcsc-prefect workflow to support a broken-symmetry unrestricted Hartree-Fock (BS-UHF) starting point, derived from atom-localized antiferromagnetic initial guesses. For the [Fe₄S₄₍SCH₃₎₄]²⁻ cubane (54 electrons, 36 orbitals, 72 data qubits; 88 total qubits), this lowers the mean-field reference by approx 534 mHa relative to the Restricted Hartree-Fock (RHF) solution (-327.0809 vs. -326.5474 Ha). Combined with deep multi-step configuration recovery on ROQUO GPU nodes at subspace dimension d = 3 × 10¹⁰, we reach E = -327.235076 Ha. This is 4.3 mHa above the finite-D = 4000 DMRG value (-327.2393952 Ha) and sim 512-517 mHa below a previous same-active-space RHF-reference SQD calculation. Extrapolating to the d → infty limit via a Gaussian-in-log d fitting ansatz gives an asymptotic estimate Eᵢₙfty = -327.244468 Ha ± 1.05 mHa, just 0.33 mHa above our discarded-weight-extrapolated DMRG estimate (ED→ᵢₙfₜy = -327.244797 Ha ± 0.46 mHa), well within their combined 1σ uncertainty. We characterize the determinant-subspace composition driving convergence, show matching validation on [Fe₂S₂₍SCH₃₎₄]²⁻, and report multi-HPC execution on Fugaku, Miyabi-G, and ROQUO. We conclude that reference-state preparation, rather than subspace size alone, is a key driver of SQD energy accuracy under strong electronic correlation.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于采样的量子对角化（SQD）在强关联系统（如铁硫簇）中的精度仍然有限，这主要取决于平均场参考态。本文将qcsc-prefect工作流扩展，以支持从原子局域反铁磁初始猜测导出的破对称非限制性Hartree-Fock（BS-UHF）起始点。对于[Fe₄S₄₍SCH₃₎₄]²⁻立方烷，该方法将平均场参考能量降低了约534 mHa。结合深度多步构型恢复，实现了接近有限DMRG值的能量，并通过外推获得了渐近估计值。
authors: Kunal Kumar, Tomonori Shirakawa, Boseong Kim, Ryo Wakizaka, Ikko Hamamura, Mitsuhisa Sato, Seiji Yunoki, Mario Motta, Hiroshi Horii, Yuri Kobayashi

articles.title: Long-lived quantum memories with rare-earth ions doped in crystals
articles.title_zh: 稀土离子掺杂晶体中的长寿命量子存储器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04526v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum memory is a core enabling device for large-scale quantum networks, serving as the fundamental building block for quantum repeaters and transportable quantum memories. Among various physical platforms, rare-earth-ion-doped crystals stand out as one of the most promising solid-state candidates for long-lived photonic quantum memories, owing to their exceptionally long spin coherence time and their compatibility with integration. In this review, we first introduce the physical mechanisms underlying long-lived spin coherence in rare-earth systems, with particular emphasis on the zero-first-order-Zeeman transition and dynamical decoupling techniques. We then review the experimental progress in this field, highlighting three distinct lifetimes--the spin coherence time, the light storage time, and the quantum storage time--and covering experiments that have achieved hour-scale spin coherence, minute- to hour-scale light storage, and minute-scale single-photon-level quantum storage. Finally, we discuss the remaining challenges that hinder the realization of practical long-lived quantum memories, explore potential strategies to overcome these obstacles, and outline the prospects for their future applications in quantum networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子存储器是大型量子网络的核心使能设备，是量子中继器和可传输量子存储器的基本组成部分。在众多物理平台中，稀土离子掺杂晶体因其超长的自旋相干时间和与集成技术的兼容性，成为最有前途的固态光子量子存储器候选之一。本文综述了稀土系统中长寿命自旋相干的物理机制和实验进展，涵盖了实现小时级自旋相干、分钟到小时级光存储以及分钟级单光子量子存储的实验。最后，讨论了实现实用长寿命量子存储器所面临的挑战及潜在解决方案。
authors: Yu-Yu Sa, Pei-Xi Liu, Zong-Quan Zhou, Chuan-Feng Li

articles.title: Decoy-state quantum key distribution with a leaky Mach-Zehnder receiver
articles.title_zh: 带有泄漏马赫-曾德尔接收器的诱骗态量子密钥分发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04539v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We prove the security of phase-encoded decoy-state BB84 quantum key distribution for a Mach-Zehnder receiver with imbalanced beam splitters and two threshold detectors that leak fine-grained information about the detection patterns. For this, we derive a lower bound on Bob's single-photon contributions and combine it with the decoy-state method and a recent phase-error framework for leaky receivers. The leakage-induced correction to the phase-error rate is independent of channel loss, providing a loss-tolerant treatment of receiver leakage even in the presence of beam-splitter imbalance. Our results provide a practical route toward loss-tolerant security proofs for imperfect QKD receivers in the presence of receiver leakage.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了针对具有不平衡分束器和两个阈值探测器的马赫-曾德尔接收器，其会泄露检测模式的细粒度信息时，相位编码诱骗态BB84量子密钥分发的安全性。为此，研究推导了Bob单光子贡献的下限，并将其与诱骗态方法和最近针对泄漏接收器的相位误差框架相结合。泄漏引起的相位误差率修正与信道损耗无关，即使在分束器不平衡的情况下，也提供了对接收器泄漏的损耗容忍处理。这些结果为存在接收器泄漏的不完美QKD接收器提供了损耗容忍安全证明的实用途径。
authors: Ryohei Mizusawa, Álvaro Navarrete, Akihiro Mizutani, Kiyoshi Tamaki

articles.title: Time-invariant negativity and persistent bound entanglement in a cyclic two-qutrit family
articles.title_zh: 循环双三量子比特族中的时不变负性和持久束缚纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04568v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the entanglement dynamics of two qutrits under collective dephasing for a family of states obtained by mixing a maximally entangled state that lives in the decoherence-free subspace with three nonstationary two-term states sharing a common amplitude ratio r. We obtain exact PPT and separability regions along the whole trajectory, a specialization of known results on cyclic sign invariant states, and we supply explicit certificates: a finite product decomposition, three fixed positive-map witnesses, and a closed realignment formula that detects every PPT-entangled state, so that no state is left undecided. The negativity is computed in closed form. It shows that the entanglement is time-invariant, positive and constant from the initial time although the state changes, exactly when the weight of the maximally entangled state exceeds the threshold Uᵣ₌ᵣ/(1+r+r²⁾. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of time-invariant entanglement for qutrit--qutrit systems under collective dephasing. For smaller weights the entanglement decays and vanishes at a finite time: the state either becomes separable (entanglement sudden death) or, for r≠1 in an intermediate range, loses distillability suddenly and remains bound entangled at all later times. Every state with negative partial transpose is one-copy distillable by a fixed local projection. The same trajectories arise from the global dephasing map and from a correlated local random-unitary semigroup, although the two channels differ on product inputs. Exact rational benchmarks and embeddings of the Horodecki and Ha--Kye--Park families are provided.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在集体退相干下，由最大纠缠态与三个非平稳两项态混合形成的一族双三量子比特态的纠缠动力学。研究获得了沿整个轨迹的精确PPT和可分离区域，并提供了明确的证明。负性以封闭形式计算，结果表明当最大纠缠态的权重超过特定阈值时，纠缠是时不变、正且恒定的，尽管态本身在变化。据作者所知，这是首次在集体退相干下展示三量子比特系统中的时不变纠缠。
authors: Wenlin Zhang, Mazhar Ali, Haobo Ma

articles.title: On Random Purifications of Isometries and Channels
articles.title_zh: 关于等距变换和信道的随机纯化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04573v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Acorn tricks turn weak quantum resources into stronger "randomized" ones. A recent example is the random purification channel, which turns t copies of a mixed state into t copies of a random purification. We ask whether analogous techniques can turn queries to an isometry into queries to a random unitary completion, or queries to a quantum channel into queries to a random isometry dilation. For an isometry from dimension N to dimension M, we give an efficient, stateful simulator for T sequential, forward queries to a fixed Haar random unitary completion. It uses at most one forward isometry query per simulated call, with total trace-distance error O(TsqrtN/(M-T)). This lifts isometry query lower bounds to arbitrary unitary completions, and copy complexity lower bounds to forward access to state preparation unitaries, with dimension-dependent loss that can be made arbitrarily small for most applications. Conversely, we construct two distributions on quantum channels distinguishable exactly with two queries to an arbitrary dilation, but requiring exponentially many channel queries for nonnegligible advantage. This rules out efficient simulation of random channel dilations. Our technique also shows that approximating the quantum switch to any constant error below 1/2 requires exponentially many channel queries, even for identical channels, giving an exponential query advantage for indefinite causal order and improving on Bavaresco et al. (2025). Finally, we show how to "decontrol" controlled forward access to an isometry: any algorithm making controlled queries to φ V for a random phase φ can be transformed into one using the same number of uncontrolled forward queries to V, generalizing the analogous result for unitaries.
articles.abstract_zh: “橡子技巧”能将弱量子资源转化为更强的“随机化”资源。本文探讨了类似技术是否能将对等距变换的查询转化为对随机酉补全的查询，或将对量子信道的查询转化为对随机等距扩张的查询。对于从N维到M维的等距变换，研究提供了一个高效、有状态的模拟器，用于对固定Haar随机酉补全的T次顺序前向查询。该模拟器将等距查询下限提升到任意酉补全，并将复制复杂度下限提升到对态制备酉的直接访问。
authors: Eli Goldin

articles.title: Spectral Quantum Memory for Implicit Neural Representations
articles.title_zh: 隐式神经表示的谱量子记忆
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04574v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Implicit neural representations (INRs) model signals as continuous functions from coordinates to values, but their performance depends strongly on how spectral capacity is allocated. Yet most Quantum INR (QINR) architectures treat spectral components as independent outputs of separate quantum blocks. We introduce the Spectral Quantum Memory Model (SQMM), a memory coupled quantum INR in which sequential hybrid data reuploading layers (bands) communicate through a shared coherent quantum memory register. Each band reads the memory, computes on its own coordinate upload, and writes part of its state back, so later bands can build on the computation of earlier ones. When memory read and write layers are input independent, we prove that the memory state forms an operator valued Fourier series whose support is contained in the Minkowski sum of the initial memory spectrum and the local band spectra. Downstream bands then condition their Fourier coefficients on the spectral content stored by earlier bands, and the memory coupling creates no new primitive frequencies. This theory motivates a spectral memory alignment loss that encourages memory to encode the spectrum expressed by the deployed prefix of the model. Across audio and image reconstruction benchmarks, SQMM improves over compact QINR and INR baselines.
articles.abstract_zh: 隐式神经表示（INRs）的性能强烈依赖于频谱容量的分配，而大多数量子INR（QINR）架构将频谱分量视为独立输出。本文引入了谱量子记忆模型（SQMM），这是一种记忆耦合的QINR，其中顺序混合数据重上传层通过共享的相干量子记忆寄存器进行通信。理论证明，当记忆读写层与输入无关时，记忆状态形成一个算子值傅里叶级数，其支持包含在初始记忆谱和局部频带谱的闵可夫斯基和中。这种记忆耦合不会产生新的原始频率，并促使下游频带根据早期频带存储的频谱内容调整其傅里叶系数，从而激发了谱记忆对齐损失。
authors: Daniel A. Moroz-Broitman, Eliya Nachmani

articles.title: Adaptive Self-Optimization of Polarization Efficiency for Low-Power NV Center Thermometers Based on PAS-Q
articles.title_zh: 基于PAS-Q的低功耗NV中心温度计偏振效率自适应优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04588v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond have attracted considerable attention for micro- and nanoscale thermometry owing to their high precision and spatial resolution. However, achieving sufficient electron spin polarization and signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) typically requires high-power or long-duration laser excitation, which introduces heating and degrades measurement accuracy and stability. To address this trade-off, a reinforcement learning (RL)-based approach is proposed to optimize spin polarization under low-heating constraints. First, a physical model integrating five-level optical pumping rates and NV spin polarization dynamics is established. A temperature-rise constraint model is then developed based on pulsed optically detected magnetic resonance (P-ODMR) measurements under varying laser powers and pulse widths in an external magnetic field. Subsequently, a Progressive Action-Space Q-learning (PAS-Q) algorithm is employed to explore the parameter space and identify optimal laser power and pulse-width combinations. The agent is trained through numerical simulations and the resulting strategy is implemented in a hardware system. Experimental results demonstrate a 44% reduction in laser-induced heating, a 33% increase in spin polarization rate based on T1 relaxation analysis, and a 71% reduction in optimization time compared with traditional methods. This approach enables efficient spin polarization with reduced laser heating and improved optimization efficiency, and may be extended to other heat-sensitive quantum spin sensors, including silicon-vacancy centers in diamond and divacancy defects in silicon carbide.
articles.abstract_zh: 金刚石中的氮空位（NV）中心因其高精度和空间分辨率在微纳尺度测温中备受关注，但实现足够的电子自旋极化通常需要高功率或长时间激光激发，这会引入加热并降低测量精度。为解决这一矛盾，本文提出了一种基于强化学习（RL）的方法，在低加热约束下优化自旋极化。研究建立了五能级光泵浦速率和NV自旋极化动力学的物理模型，并基于脉冲光探测磁共振（P-ODMR）测量开发了温升约束模型。随后，采用渐进行动空间Q学习（PAS-Q）算法探索参数空间并识别最佳激光功率和脉冲宽度组合，并将训练出的策略应用于硬件系统。
authors: Yifan Wang, Li Xing, Ruigang Wang, Zheng Qian

articles.title: Mitigating small gaps in quantum annealing through recursive XX-catalyst construction
articles.title_zh: 通过递归XX催化剂构建减轻量子退火中的小能隙
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04840v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The introduction of XX-interactions, typically in the form of an additional catalyst Hamiltonian, has shown promise as a tool for gap enhancement in quantum annealing, allowing the algorithm to obtain optimal solutions with shorter run-times. However, the optimal placements of these couplings within the problem graph has been found to be highly setting-dependent. In this work, we propose an iterative catalyst-construction protocol for the removal of a common quantum annealing bottleneck known as perturbative crossings. The method utilises the measurements returned by successive annealing runs to effectively steer the algorithm away from the local optima in which it becomes trapped. First, we motivate a framework for XX-term selection based on perturbation theory and establish its effectiveness at removing perturbative crossings on scalable toy instances with up to 39 spins, demonstrating a consistent performance both with increasing system size and number of local optima. We then simulate the recursive catalyst-construction method on a test set of 18-spin maximum-weight independent set problems that are generated to produce annealing spectra with multiple perturbative crossings. We find that the protocol significantly outperforms both catalyst-free annealing and annealing with catalysts containing randomly selected XX-terms.
articles.abstract_zh: XX相互作用，通常以附加催化剂哈密顿量的形式引入，在量子退火中显示出增强能隙的潜力，从而缩短运行时间以获得最优解。然而，这些耦合在问题图中的最佳放置具有高度依赖性。本工作提出了一种迭代催化剂构建协议，用于消除量子退火中常见的瓶颈——微扰交叉。该方法利用连续退火运行返回的测量结果，有效地引导算法脱离其陷入的局部最优。研究首先基于微扰理论提出了XX项选择框架，并证明了其在可扩展玩具实例上消除微扰交叉的有效性，随后模拟了递归催化剂构建方法在最大权重独立集问题上的应用。
authors: Natasha Feinstein, Sebastian Schulz, Robert J. Banks, Roopayan Ghosh, Kristel Michielsen, Sougato Bose, P A Warburton

articles.title: Conditional Quantum Priors for Chaotic Fluid Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 混沌流体动力学的条件量子先验
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04872v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural networks that predict chaotic dynamics can reproduce short trajectories while misrepresenting statistics over long times. Quantum priors represent selected dynamical statistics through quantum generative models and provide statistical constraints for classical neural networks. Training a separate prior for each value of a system parameter, such as the Reynolds number, does not explicitly model how these statistics vary with that parameter. We learn a conditional quantum prior that approximates selected statistics of an invariant measure at unseen parameter values within the training range, without retraining. For Lorenz-63, the prior reduces mean Jensen-Shannon divergence by 56.9% relative to a classical multilayer perceptron with a comparable number of weights across 96 unseen parameter values. Across 101 values of the same parameter, the shared prior uses 84.7% fewer trainable weights than would be required by a separate quantum neural network at each value. We then use the learned prior to regularize classical neural networks, encouraging their autoregressive rollouts to better reproduce long-term statistics. For Kolmogorov flow at Reynolds number Re=1000, prior regularization reduces forecast mean squared error by 66.0% over 318 steps relative to the classical baseline without prior regularization. We also implement a photonic quantum prior for noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) devices, achieving a mean Jensen-Shannon divergence of 4.58×10⁻³ for Lorenz-63 and 2.59×10⁻³ for Kolmogorov flow at unseen parameter values.
articles.abstract_zh: 预测混沌动力学的神经网络在重现短期轨迹时，往往无法准确表示长期统计数据。本研究学习了一种条件量子先验，该先验通过量子生成模型近似不变测度的选定统计数据，并在训练范围内对未见参数值进行预测，无需重新训练。对于Lorenz-63系统，该先验相对于经典多层感知器，在96个未见参数值上将平均Jensen-Shannon散度降低了56.9%。此外，该共享先验使用的可训练权重比每个参数值单独使用量子神经网络所需的权重减少了84.7%。研究随后利用学习到的先验来正则化经典神经网络，促使其自回归展开更好地重现长期统计数据。
authors: Shao-Bo Zhou, Yu-Ze Zhu, Hang Song, Xiang Zhao, Lin Yang, Xian-Min Jin

articles.title: Fast verification of fault tolerant magic state preparation circuits with the CNOT + T gate set
articles.title_zh: 使用CNOT + T门集快速验证容错魔术态制备电路
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04909v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magic state preparation is often among the most expensive operations in a fault tolerant quantum computation. One obstacle to coming up with better magic state preparation circuits lies in verifying their fault tolerance properties, as it is difficult to verify either by hand or in software that a very large number of combinations of faults do not give rise to high-weight or logical errors, especially in a non-Clifford circuit. In this work, we propose the use of the CNOT + T gate set to fault-tolerantly prepare a large class of magic states. We consider the propagation of Pauli faults within CNOT + T circuits and derive properties similar to those of Pauli faults within Clifford circuits, with a view to verifying fault tolerance as efficiently as possible. We present Comb, a library that can verify the fault tolerance of CNOT + T magic state preparation circuits, and demonstrate its use in verifying the fault tolerance of distance three and distance five magic state preparation circuits in minutes on a laptop. We present a distance five magic state preparation circuit that was discovered using Comb. As an independent confirmation of Comb's correctness we compare its findings to circuit-level noisy simulations for several magic state preparation circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 魔术态制备是容错量子计算中最昂贵的操作之一，其容错性验证尤其困难。本工作提出使用CNOT + T门集容错制备一类广泛的魔术态，并研究了Pauli错误在CNOT + T电路中的传播特性。研究开发了一个名为Comb的库，能够高效验证CNOT + T魔术态制备电路的容错性，并在笔记本电脑上数分钟内验证了距离为三和距离为五的电路。此外，本文还展示了一个利用Comb发现的距离为五的魔术态制备电路。
authors: Selwyn Simsek, Callum Macpherson, Chris N. Self, David Amaro

articles.title: Substantially Improved Rate and Distance for Addressable Transversal Phase Gates
articles.title_zh: 可寻址横向相位门速率和距离的显著改进
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04964v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An important ingredient in fault-tolerant quantum computation is asymptotically good codes with fully addressable transversal non-Clifford gates. Existing constructions, however, provide only small explicit guarantees for rate and relative distance. Here, we substantially improve these guarantees for fully addressable transversal phase gates at every fixed level hge3 of the Clifford hierarchy, using a cyclic encoding beyond the binary CSS framework. The encoding separates logical phase control from the joint design of rate and distance, enabling two constructions with different computational costs. A deterministic polynomial-time algebraic-geometric construction gives a common asymptotic lower bound of 52/(675h) on both quantities. A counting argument gives an exponential-time construction with exact verification, improving this bound by a factor of approximately 2.86. We further establish a universal upper bound for codes supporting fully addressable transversal single-qubit phase gates. Within our cyclic encoding framework, we obtain a stronger upper bound that is approximately 1.28 times the lower bound achieved by our exponential-time construction. As concrete examples, we construct codes with 48 and 90 physical qubits supporting fully addressable transversal T gates. These results narrow the gap between achievable code parameters and addressability bounds, providing quantitative targets for further improvements in efficient code constructions.
articles.abstract_zh: 容错量子计算中的一个重要组成部分是具有完全可寻址横向非Clifford门的渐近好码。本研究通过超越二进制CSS框架的循环编码，显著改进了Clifford层级h≥3上完全可寻址横向相位门的速率和相对距离保证。该编码将逻辑相位控制与速率和距离的联合设计分离，提供了两种计算成本不同的构造方法。确定性多项式时间代数几何构造给出了两个量共同的渐近下界，而计数论证给出了指数时间构造，将此界提高了约2.86倍。研究还建立了支持完全可寻址横向单量子比特相位门的通用上界，并在循环编码框架内获得了更强的上界。
authors: Bujiao Wu, Tongyin Lin, Bin Cheng

articles.title: Ergotropy Activation and Coherence in Dissipatively Charged Quantum Batteries
articles.title_zh: 耗散充电量子电池中的功能激活与相干性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05010v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum batteries can exploit quantum resources to enhance energy storage and work extraction, and recent experimental progress has brought their implementation closer to reality. In realistic settings, however, environmental dissipation is unavoidable, making dissipative charging a physically relevant operating regime. Here we investigate ergotropy in dissipatively charged quantum batteries, focusing on interaction-induced work extraction. For two coupled two-level systems (TLSs), we derive exact analytical expressions for the total, coherent, and incoherent ergotropy in both resonant and detuned configurations. We show that, in the resonant case, ergotropy is activated only above a critical coupling associated with an interaction-induced energy-level crossing, whereas detuning enables ergotropy already in the weak-coupling regime. Moreover, quantum coherence, although necessary for coherent work extraction, is not by itself sufficient to guarantee nonzero coherent ergotropy. In the strong-coupling regime, the resonant setup reaches the maximum ergotropy at a finite coupling strength, whereas the detuned setup approaches the same limit only asymptotically. Extending the analysis to a periodic XX spin chain of N TLSs, we analytically derive the finite-temperature coupling threshold for ergotropy activation and show that it scales as 1/N in the large-N limit. These results identify frequency detuning, interaction strength, and system size as key control parameters for ergotropy generation in open quantum batteries.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了耗散充电量子电池中的功能（ergotropy）和相干性，重点关注相互作用诱导的功提取。对于两个耦合的两能级系统，研究推导了谐振和失谐配置下总功能、相干功能和非相干功能的精确解析表达式。结果表明，在谐振情况下，功能仅在与相互作用诱导能级交叉相关的临界耦合之上才被激活，而失谐则在弱耦合区域即可实现功能。此外，量子相干性虽然是相干功提取的必要条件，但其本身不足以保证非零相干功能。在强耦合区域，谐振设置在有限耦合强度下达到最大功能，而失谐设置则接近相同的极限。
authors: Hui-Yu Yang, Kang-Yuan Chen, Kun Zhang, Yang-Yang Chen, Xiao-Hui Wang

articles.title: On Revolutionizing Power Systems: Suitability of Quantum Computing-Ready Pipelines for Stochastic Unit Commitment Optimization
articles.title_zh: 关于革新电力系统：量子计算就绪管道在随机机组组合优化中的适用性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05030v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern unit commitment (UC) scenarios, particularly those involving uncertainties from demand fluctuations and renewable energy sources, pose significant challenges to traditional optimization methods due to the large search spaces they encompass. This paper proposes a quantum computing-ready optimization pipeline for deterministic and stochastic UC, integrating classical, quantum-inspired, quantum annealing, and hybrid quantum-classical solvers across test systems, including the IEEE 118-bus system. A novel Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) reformulation accommodates generator scaling and 24-hour scheduling horizons with compact Boolean logic penalties for startup, cooldown, and spinning reserve constraints. A divide-and-conquer strategy and Quantum Computing Monte Carlo (QCMC) simulation address scalability across 27,730 uncertainty scenarios, reducing compilation time by up to two orders of magnitude. Experimental results demonstrate the pipeline's ability to achieve efficient, scalable, and accurate UC optimization under uncertainty: the hybrid quantum method approach matches the classical baseline, reduces stochastic UC runtime from 40.76 to 14.79 hours, and characterizes pure quantum annealing as limited to small systems with 0.22% to 2.18% encoding errors and constraint violations. These results provide an analysis of the scalability and computational practicality of hybrid quantum optimization for generator scheduling in UC.
articles.abstract_zh: 现代机组组合（UC）场景，特别是涉及需求波动和可再生能源不确定性的场景，因其庞大的搜索空间对传统优化方法构成重大挑战。本文提出了一种量子计算就绪的优化管道，用于确定性和随机UC，集成了经典、量子启发、量子退火和混合量子-经典求解器。研究引入了一种新颖的二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）重构，以适应发电机规模和24小时调度周期，并采用紧凑的布尔逻辑惩罚来处理启动、冷却和备用约束。通过分治策略和量子计算蒙特卡洛（QCMC）模拟，解决了27,730个不确定性场景下的可扩展性问题，将编译时间缩短了两个数量级。实验结果表明，该管道能够在不确定性下实现高效、可扩展和准确的UC优化，其中混合量子方法与经典基线表现一致。
authors: Ying-Yi Hong, Dylan Josh Domingo Lopez

articles.title: Reopening the one clean qubit case of a semi-grand challenge
articles.title_zh: 重新审视半大挑战中的“一个干净量子比特”案例
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05046v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In his 2005 list of semi-grand challenges for quantum computing theory, Scott Aaronson asked whether a quantum computer that is always in a separable mixed state can be simulated by a classical computer in polynomial time. An affirmative answer was claimed for the one clean qubit model of quantum computation. The supporting mathematical arguments relied on an exhaustive characterization of circuits that stay in separable states. Here, we give a counterexample where one pure qubit, known as the clean qubit, controls a sequence of three gates that act on a maximally mixed three-qubit register. The overall unitary that accumulates as these gates are applied has the properties that ensure the state of all four qubits remains fully separable. Crucially, we show that the final unitary cannot be put into the form required by the claimed simulation result. We also give a continuous-time implementation of the same circuit that keeps the qubits fully separable throughout and ends at the same unitary. We extend our counterexamples to a uniform family, and pinpoint the gap in the earlier proof. Since our circuits are themselves efficient to simulate classically, this work does not settle Aaronson's question. It does, however, reopen the semi-grand challenge for an actively researched model of quantum computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了斯科特·阿伦森提出的关于可分离混合态量子计算机能否被经典计算机在多项式时间内模拟的半大挑战。此前，对于“一个干净量子比特”模型曾给出肯定答案，但本研究提出了一个反例。该反例展示了一个干净量子比特控制的门序列如何使四个量子比特保持完全可分离状态，但最终的酉算符无法满足先前模拟结果所需的形式，从而指出了早期证明中的漏洞。
authors: Christopher W. Mansell

articles.title: Operational Thresholds for Long-Range Entanglement in Quantum Networks
articles.title_zh: 量子网络中长程纠缠的操作阈值
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05069v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum networks distribute entanglement between distant nodes by combining many short entangled links using local quantum operations. These operations only succeed probabilistically, yet existing percolation-based theories of entanglement transmission treat them as perfect. We approach the problem through statistical physics, using a stochastic generalization of concurrence percolation to determine how reliable local operations must be for long-range entanglement to remain possible. On hierarchical (U,V)-flower networks, which permit full analytical control across network scales, we derive an exact renormalization recursion for the probability that an end-to-end entangled connection survives. For the (2,2)-flower this yields a closed-form operational phase boundary, ηₚ = 2 - frac3227ηₛ, where ηₛ and ηₚ are the success probabilities of the series (entanglement swapping) and parallel (purification) operations, respectively. At this boundary the survival probability jumps discontinuously from 0 to Sᵢₙfty = 3/(4ηₛ₎. Numerically propagating the full distribution of end-to-end concurrence yields a second threshold in the initial link quality, which varies continuously with operational reliability. Above both thresholds the large-network state is binary: the connection either fails outright or approaches a perfect Bell pair. Our results thus reveal a two-threshold structure for long-range entanglement, in which operational reliability and initial link quality can compensate one another. Operational success rates therefore emerge alongside initial link quality as a primary design constraint for scalable quantum networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子网络通过结合短程纠缠链路和局部量子操作来分发长程纠缠，但这些操作是概率性的。本研究利用统计物理方法，通过并发渗流的随机泛化来确定实现长程纠缠所需的局部操作可靠性。在分层(U,V)-花形网络上，推导出了端到端纠缠连接存活概率的精确重整化递归关系，并为(2,2)-花形网络给出了操作相边界的闭合形式。
authors: Arn Caesar, Xinqi Hu, Kim Christensen

articles.title: Comment on "Supervised Learning with Quantum Hamiltonian Embeddings" (arXiv:2610.26833)
articles.title_zh: 对“基于量子哈密顿嵌入的监督学习”的评论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05105v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We discuss the relationship between quantum Hamiltonian embeddings (arXiv:2610.26833) and prior developments in Quantum Cognition Machine Learning (QCML), including QCML's earlier implementation on IBM quantum hardware. We consider the novelty claims and the computational role of encoding an entire dataset in a single ground state.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文讨论了量子哈密顿嵌入与量子认知机器学习（QCML）先前发展之间的关系，包括QCML在IBM量子硬件上的早期实现。研究审视了量子哈密顿嵌入的新颖性主张，并探讨了将整个数据集编码到单个基态中的计算作用。
authors: Alexander G. Abanov, Luca Candelori, Kharen Musaelian

articles.title: Quantum Query Lower Bounds from Classical Moment Matching
articles.title_zh: 基于经典矩匹配的量子查询下界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05117v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We prove a quantum analogue of the classical moment matching method, a popular framework used to prove lower bounds in property testing. For two random variables X₀ and X₁ whose moments match up to the first r-1 moments, the classical moment matching method says that no classical algorithm can reliably distinguish between input instances of length N constructed from X₀ and X₁, respectively, unless it performs at least Ømega(N¹⁻¹/r) queries. While this method has been widely explored since its inception in the seminal work of Raskhodnikova, Ron, Shpilka, and Smith (STOC 2007) to prove lower bounds for symmetric properties, it has remained an open question whether a quantum analogue of it could be proved. We prove two variants of this quantum moment matching method, which are incomparable. Our first quantum query lower bound scales as Ømega(N¹/²⁻¹/⁽²r⁾), while our second moment matching theorem yields a sharper lower bound of Ømega(N¹/²⁻¹/⁽²⁽²^r⁻¹⁾⁾), albeit for smaller parameter ranges. Our results combine a new continuous hybrid argument with the polynomial method. The continuous hybrid argument compares two hard input distributions generated from i.i.d. samples by continuously varying both distributions, keeping them identically distributed at every intermediate stage. It reduces the comparison to the effect of changing the distribution of a single sample. The polynomial method then cancels the terms determined by the matched moments. We apply these moment matching theorems to prove new optimal lower bounds on k-distinctness, k-star-freeness, planarity and outerplanarity testing, as well as to improve prior lower bounds on image size testing and K-junta testing by logarithmic factors. A key advantage of our framework is its simplicity: it reduces quantum lower bound proofs to the construction of suitable moment-matching distributions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了经典矩匹配方法的量子模拟，该方法常用于性质测试中的下界证明。研究证明了两种不可比较的量子矩匹配方法变体，给出了量子查询下界。这些结果结合了新的连续混合论证和多项式方法，为量子算法的复杂性分析提供了新的工具。
authors: Chandrima Kayal, Frédéric Magniez, Sayantan Sen, Dániel Szabó

articles.title: Effective Hamiltonians and non-Hermitian physics
articles.title_zh: 有效哈密顿量与非厄米物理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05268v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Every realistic quantum system is coupled to an environment. Including the environment restores a closed, Hermitian description, but at the cost of an intractably large Hilbert space. The Feshbach--Löwdin projection eliminates the unwanted degrees of freedom exactly, yielding an effective Hamiltonian Hₘ̊ ₑff on the relevant subspace alone---which new{generically becomes non-Hermitian when the eliminated subspace contains an energetically accessible continuum and outgoing boundary conditions are imposed}. We illustrate this through a minimal model: a particle in a box with a delta barrier at its center. Direct elimination of one half-well reduces all information about the discarded sector to a single newboundary parameter β; the same result is then rederived via the Green's function and Dyson equation, offering a pedagogical illustration of how boundary data enter the Green's-function formalism and relating β to a self-energy term. Whether β is real or complex determines whether Hₘ̊ ₑff is Hermitian or not, and the full range of behavior---from Hermitian dynamics through finite-width resonances to the counterintuitive quantum Zeno effect---follows from this single parameter.
articles.abstract_zh: 现实量子系统通常与环境耦合，导致希尔伯特空间过大。本文利用Feshbach-Löwdin投影法，精确消除了不必要的自由度，得到了相关子空间上的有效哈密顿量，该哈密顿量在特定条件下会变为非厄米。研究通过一个最小模型进行了说明，并展示了边界参数如何决定有效哈密顿量的厄米性或非厄米性，涵盖了从厄米动力学到量子芝诺效应的各种行为。
authors: Ugo Lair, David Guéry-Odelin

articles.title: Simple proof of conditions requiring maximal entanglement for local state verification and discrimination
articles.title_zh: 局部态验证和判别中需要最大纠缠的条件的简单证明
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05317v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: For deterministic state verification by separable measurements, the Schmidt rank of an entangled resource must be at least that of the state being verified [N. Yu, R. Duan, and M. Ying, IEEE Trans. Inf. Theory 60, 2069 (2014)], and if the two are equal, the resource must be maximally entangled [S. Akibue, J. Miyazaki, and H. Osaka, Lett. Math. Phys. 116, 110 (2026)]. The latter was derived from a general theorem proved using algebraic geometry. In this paper, we give a simple, self-contained proof of both statements using only linear algebra. We then use these results to show that among pure entangled resources of local dimension at most d, a maximally entangled state of C^døtimesC^d is necessary and sufficient for perfect local discrimination of a generic orthogonal basis of C^døtimesC^d, however weakly entangled. The same holds for local implementation of a generic orthogonal measurement.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提供了一个简单且自洽的证明，阐明了通过可分离测量进行确定性态验证时，纠缠资源的施密特秩必须至少与被验证态的施密特秩相等，且若两者相等，资源必须是最大纠缠态。研究仅使用线性代数方法，并进一步证明在局部维度至多为d的纯纠缠资源中，C^d⊗C^d的最大纠缠态是完美局部判别任意正交基的必要和充分条件。
authors: Somshubhro Bandyopadhyay

articles.title: Interpretable Quantum Photonic Generative Models
articles.title_zh: 可解释的量子光子生成模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05354v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a physical generative model for learning correlated multivariate data based on homodyne detection of photonic continuous-variable (CV) circuits. We use an N-mode photonic circuit in which two-mode squeezing provides correlations, local phase shifts tune the strength and sign of these correlations, and an adjustable interferometer redistributes them across modes. We train the circuit by matching its Pearson correlation matrix to the one obtained from data. We apply affine post-processing to adjust the marginals independently while keeping the relations intact. We test the model on the multivariate distribution of standardized log returns of financial assets, showing that the photonic model can represent rich correlation structures. We reproduce empirical correlations with residuals below 10⁻⁴ for five variables and recover the correct correlation signs for 94% ± 1% of 190 correlation pairs at twenty variables, with 86% of the residuals below 0.1. As a separate technical contribution, we develop an approach for simulating Kerr gates with small nonlinearity via a Hubbard-Stratonovich expansion, making them suitable for CV-based simulators. Our results establish CV photonic circuits as a platform for interpretable generative learning, suitable for representing and fast sampling of distributions across different application domains.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于光子连续变量（CV）电路零差检测的物理生成模型，用于学习相关的多变量数据。该模型通过匹配其皮尔逊相关矩阵与数据中的矩阵来训练，并利用仿射后处理独立调整边际分布。研究在金融资产标准化对数收益的多变量分布上测试了该模型，结果表明其能有效表示丰富的相关结构，并准确重现经验相关性。
authors: Dat Chi Le, Oleksandr Kyriienko

articles.title: Reading Why: Born-Measured Attention with Exact Word Evidence on Light and Qubits
articles.title_zh: 阅读原因：基于玻恩测量的注意力机制与光子和量子比特的精确词证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05355v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When a language model answers, we can usually only estimate why. We build a transformer in which every step is a Born measurement - attention |łangle q|kångle|⁴ normalised over each row, a measured product in place of the feed-forward nonlinearity, and a Born readout. With its denominators held at their values for the input, each class probability is a polynomial in the word amplitudes, so its integrated-gradient evidence is computed by a finite quadrature with no quadrature error: the words' contributions sum to the class probability above its no-information share, to 10⁻¹¹ or better. On e-SNLI natural language inference, with about 98k parameters outside the embedding, the model reaches 76.98 ± 0.17% test accuracy, level with a softmax transformer of the same size (76.62 ± 0.36%). Deleting the word its evidence ranks first changes the answer in 45% of test pairs, out of the 53% any single deletion can change, against 32% for the softmax model explained the same way and 40% by its attention x gradient. Attention can look more like the words annotators highlighted, yet accounts for the answer less well: deleting the word it ranks first changes the Born Transformer's answer in 32% of pairs. The same weights compile exactly to optoelectronic optics and to qubits, and a coherent attention layer becomes one circuit equal to the model (852 CNOTs on 23 qubits). On IBM's ibmₖᵢₙgston, reading only the attention overlaps by Hadamard tests, the device gave the model's answers on two short test pairs and kept or changed them under deletion as the model does; the evidence itself did not yet survive the device, and we work out the shots and calibration that measuring it on hardware would need.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个Transformer模型，其中每个步骤都基于玻恩测量，包括注意力机制、前馈非线性层的测量乘积和玻恩读出。该模型能够以高精度计算每个词对类别概率的贡献，从而提供精确的词证据。在e-SNLI自然语言推理任务上，该模型达到了与同等大小的softmax Transformer相当的测试准确率，并且在解释模型决策方面表现出更高的可信度。
authors: Teerawat Tongloy, Jiraporn Pongsopa, Rangsan Jomtarak

articles.title: Breaking the quantum barriers for Graph Collision
articles.title_zh: 突破图碰撞问题的量子障碍
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05356v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the graph collision problem, the task is to decide whether a known graph on n vertices contains an edge with both endpoints marked, given query access to the input bits specifying the marked vertices. We first refute the conjectured Ømega(n²/³) query lower bound with a bounded error quantum algorithm using widetilde O(n⁹²/¹³⁹) queries. We then refine this approach to obtain a widetilde O(n¹¹/¹⁷) query algorithm. We also obtain a widetilde O((nq)¹¹/¹⁷) query bound for all (partial) Boolean output functions with positive certificate complexity at most 2 and alphabet size q, contrasting a known Ømega(n²/³) lower bound for such problems with large alphabet sizes. We complement these algorithms with an Ømega(sqrtnłog n) quantum query lower bound for graph collision, exceeding the O(sqrt n) certificate complexity barrier for the positive adversary method.
articles.abstract_zh: 在图碰撞问题中，任务是判断一个已知图是否包含一个两端点都被标记的边。本文提出了一个有界误差量子算法，其查询复杂度为O(n¹¹/¹⁷)，从而驳斥了之前推测的Ω(n²/³)查询下界。研究还为具有正证书复杂性至多为2的布尔输出函数获得了O((nq)¹¹/¹⁷)的查询界限，并给出了图碰撞问题的Ω(√n log n)量子查询下界。
authors: Arjan Cornelissen, Amin Shiraz Gilani, Shiva Kintali, François Le Gall, Subhasree Patro, Xingyu Zhou

articles.title: Hardware-Efficient Reinforcement-Learned Scheduling for Quantum LDPC Decoders
articles.title_zh: 量子LDPC译码器中硬件高效的强化学习调度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04179v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum low-density parity-check (QLDPC) codes are promising for fault-tolerant quantum computing, but their decoding algorithms present significant hardware implementation challenges. Reinforcement-learned sequential belief propagation (RL-S) improves the error-correction performance of conventional belief propagation (BP) through adaptive variable-node scheduling. However, its heap-based priority management introduces substantial hardware overhead. This paper presents hardware implementations of BP, RL-S, and bucket-based reinforcement-learned BP (BRL-S) for the [[288,12,18]] bivariate bicycle QLDPC code. The BRL-S architectures employ quantized priorities and first-in, first-out (FIFO) buckets to simplify scheduling. Three configurations with two, four, and eight priority levels are evaluated. FPGA synthesis results demonstrate that BRL-S reduces lookup-table utilization by approximately 68--72% compared with RL-S. ASIC synthesis further shows reductions of 63--67% in area and 64--69% in estimated power consumption. These results demonstrate that bucket-based scheduling substantially improves the hardware efficiency of reinforcement-learned QLDPC decoders.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子低密度奇偶校验（QLDPC）码在容错量子计算中具有潜力，但其译码算法面临硬件实现挑战。本文提出了一种基于桶的强化学习置信传播（BRL-S）调度方法，以解决传统强化学习调度（RL-S）带来的硬件开销问题。研究对[[288,12,18]]双变量循环QLDPC码进行了硬件实现，结果表明BRL-S显著降低了查找表利用率、面积和功耗，从而提高了硬件效率。
authors: Mohsen Moradi, Vahid Nourozi, Wei Tang, David Mitchell

articles.title: Negative Junction Logarithms in Scalar Multipartite Entanglement
articles.title_zh: 标量多体纠缠中的负结对数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04220v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A three-region junction in a free real relativistic scalar vacuum in 2+1 dimensions yields a strictly negative logarithmic contribution to genuine tripartite Rényi multi-entropy for every integer n≥3 and all nondegenerate sector angles. The replica subtraction exactly removes loop classes associated with a single interface. Surviving loops have positive, scale-independent weight, yielding a logarithm whose sign is fixed by the negative Rényi prefactor. The selector is empty at n=2. The flat-sheet Friedrichs prescription fixes the scalar operator at the nonmanifold replica apex. It yields a convergent angular spectral formula for the coefficient.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了2+1维自由实相对论标量真空中的三区域连接，发现其对真正的三方Rényi多熵产生了严格负的对数贡献，适用于所有整数n≥3和所有非退化扇区角。通过副本减法精确消除了与单个界面相关的循环类，剩余循环具有正的、与尺度无关的权重，其对数符号由负的Rényi前因子确定。研究还通过平坦片Friedrichs规范固定了非流形副本顶点处的标量算符，并给出了系数的收敛角谱公式。
authors: Chen-Te Ma

articles.title: Wavefront engineering with atomic Huygens' surfaces made simple
articles.title_zh: 利用原子惠更斯表面简化波前工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04538v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Atomic arrays provide a cooperative platform for light-mediated interactions in nonlocal metasurfaces which can operate in the quantum regime without nanofabricated optical elements or intrinsic material absorption. We present a minimal atomic implementation to harness wavefront engineering and create a near-ideal intrinsic atomic Huygens' surface. A simple bilayer square lattice with a two-atom unit cell, not limited to small lattice spacings, provides near-unity reflectionless transmission and a full 2π phase control of transmitted light without the localized site-dependent level shifts of previous proposals. This simplification is achieved through nonlocal radiative excitations that provide the familiar electric-dipole response with even radiation parity as well as an odd-parity radiation channel whose leading multipolar interpretation combines magnetic-dipole and electric-quadrupole contributions in atoms exhibiting only electric dipole transitions. This eliminates the need to simultaneously excite pure electric-dipole and magnetic-dipole responses with exactly matched radiation. We derive a two-mode model for this response and show that it accurately captures full coupled-dipole simulations near the optimal lattice spacings. Because of the wide applicability of coupled-dipole models, the relevance of our microscopic analysis extends beyond atomic physics to nanostructured metasurfaces. Moreover, the same platform also connects directly to established subradiance-protected single-photon storage protocols, suggesting a route toward combining wavefront engineering, storage, and retrieval in a simple atomic bilayer.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出了一种最小化的原子实现方案，用于波前工程并创建近乎理想的本征原子惠更斯表面。通过一个简单的双层方形晶格，实现了近乎统一的无反射透射和全2π相位的透射光控制。这种简化得益于非局域辐射激发，其提供了偶宇称的电偶极响应以及奇宇称的辐射通道，结合了磁偶极和电四极贡献。该方法避免了同时激发纯电偶极和磁偶极响应的复杂性，并为此响应导出了一个双模模型。
authors: K. E. Ballantine, J. Ruostekoski

articles.title: Sleep-Disordered Breathing Detection with Quantum Recurrent Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 基于量子循环神经网络的睡眠呼吸障碍检测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04818v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This work investigates the application of Quantum Recurrent Neural Networks to the binary classification of sleep-disordered breathing events in time-series data, aiming to distinguish between apneic and normal breathing episodes. A variational classical--quantum architecture is proposed and evaluated against classical Recurrent Neural Network models. Experiments were conducted on multiple real-world datasets with varying levels of complexity to assess the strengths and limitations of the quantum approach. In the comparative analysis, both classical and quantum models showed comparable performance. The quantum model achieved superior performance on the smallest dataset, while yielding slightly weaker results in the most complex setting. However, the quantum approach exhibited notable strengths, such as competitive performance despite a drastically reduced parameter count and low-qubit regime, as well as good generalization capabilities. These results suggest that, despite current hardware and algorithmic limitations, variational quantum recurrent models represent a promising alternative for time-series classification as Quantum Computing technologies continue to mature.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作探讨了量子循环神经网络在时间序列数据中对睡眠呼吸障碍事件进行二分类的应用，旨在区分呼吸暂停和正常呼吸。研究提出了一种变分经典-量子架构，并与经典循环神经网络模型进行了比较评估。实验结果表明，量子模型在最小数据集上表现优越，但在最复杂设置中略显逊色，但其在参数数量大幅减少和低量子比特数下仍展现出竞争性性能和良好的泛化能力。这些结果表明，尽管存在硬件和算法限制，变分量子循环模型为时间序列分类提供了一个有前景的替代方案。
authors: Alejandro Mayorga-Redondo, José Daniel Viqueira, Diego Alvarez-Estevez, Eduardo Mosqueira-Rey, Andrés Gómez

articles.title: Generalized Lorentz Framework for Active Semiconductor Quantum Surface Plasmonics
articles.title_zh: 用于有源半导体量子表面等离子体激元的广义洛伦兹框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04933v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Nanostructured semiconductors provide an actively tunable platform for light-matter interactions across a broad spectral range. As feature sizes shrink to the deep nanoscale (~10 nm scale), nonclassical carrier dynamics and surface plasmonic responses become prominent, creating substantial challenges for a rigorous and efficient theoretical treatment. Here we develop a generalized Lorentz framework for quantum surface plasmonics in nanostructured semiconductors with arbitrary energymomentum dispersion relations. The framework enables efficient quantitative treatment of carrier nonlocality, carrier surface accumulation and depletion, and nonlocal damping in three-dimensional semiconductor nanostructures, under electrical tuning and across a wide range of doping densities. Building on this framework, we further establish a rigorous quasinormal-mode analysis that provides transparent physical insight into complex surface plasmonic responses of multiscale semiconductor structures. We demonstrate electrically controlled deep-nanoscale carrier accumulation and depletion in a semiconductor nanoantenna, leading to pronounced plasmonic-response modulation that can be interpreted in terms of eigenmode shifts, creation, and annihilation. By quantifying and linking complex nonclassical carrier dynamics with plasmonic eigenmodes, our work establishes a comprehensive quantitative framework for active semiconductor quantum surface plasmonics and will foster the convergence of electronics and photonics at the deep nanoscale.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种广义洛伦兹框架，用于处理具有任意能量-动量色散关系的纳米结构半导体中的量子表面等离子体激元。该框架能够高效地量化处理三维半导体纳米结构中的载流子非局域性、表面积累与耗尽以及非局域阻尼，并适用于电调谐和宽范围掺杂密度。在此基础上，研究进一步建立了严格的准正模分析，为多尺度半导体结构中复杂的表面等离子体激元响应提供了清晰的物理洞察。该工作展示了在半导体纳米天线中电控的深纳米尺度载流子积累和耗尽，从而产生显著的等离子体响应。
authors: Wancong Li, Qiang Zhou, Runzhi Zou, Zi He, Pu Zhang, Hongwei Han, Shuangchun Wen, Xue-Wen Chen

articles.title: Efficient simulations of spectra and transport for multiorbital quantum impurities
articles.title_zh: 多轨道量子杂质光谱和输运的有效模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05185v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum impurity calculations become challenging when multiple correlated orbitals are treated explicitly, particularly in nonequilibrium steady states. We introduce Coupled-Cluster Coupled Lindblad (C³L), a deterministic approach that combines the recently developed coupled-Lindblad compact bath representation with coupled-cluster theory to compute steady states and Green's functions directly in imaginary and real frequency. C³L has favorable polynomial computational complexity and avoids the sign problem of quantum Monte Carlo (QMC). In a real-time multiorbital benchmark, it agrees closely with state-of-the-art QMC while reducing computational cost by four to five orders of magnitude, with a further 10--100-fold speedup on a GPU. Beyond the practical reach of established real-time QMC solvers, four-orbital nonequilibrium impurities with general interactions and biased reservoirs become accessible with C³L. We obtain resonance-resolved transport signatures relevant to scanning tunneling microscopy experiments on molecular junctions.
articles.abstract_zh: 当明确处理多个关联轨道时，量子杂质计算变得具有挑战性，尤其是在非平衡稳态下。本文介绍了一种确定性方法——耦合簇耦合林德布拉德（C³L），它结合了耦合林德布拉德紧凑浴表示和耦合簇理论，直接计算虚频和实频下的稳态和格林函数。C³L具有良好的多项式计算复杂度并避免了量子蒙特卡洛（QMC）的符号问题。在实时多轨道基准测试中，C³L与最先进的QMC结果高度一致，同时将计算成本降低了四到五个数量级，并在GPU上实现了10-100倍的进一步加速。
authors: Hao-En Li, Zhen Huang, Lin Lin

articles.title: Everlasting secure key agreement from a quantum computational hybrid security model
articles.title_zh: 基于量子计算混合安全模型的永久安全密钥协商
articles.abstract: arXiv:2004.10173v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce the Quantum Computational Timelock (QCT) model, combining time-lock encryption with a quantitative noisy-quantum-storage assumption. Time-lock encryption gives Bob immediate access to the encoding seed and gives Eve the same final information as access to that seed only after a protected interval. Eve may then process her retained information without computational restriction. We state this delayed-access encryption assumption explicitly and construct MUB-QCT from a complete set of mutually unbiased bases in dimension d and an affine pair-wise independent permutation family. For single-copy encoding, every seed-independent immediate measurement has trace-distance advantage at most 1/(2sqrtd+1) and mutual information at most 1/(d+1). Effective residual storage at diamond distance at most δ from replacement adds at most δ to the individual-attack distinguishing bound. Under i.i.d. individual attacks and entropy-preserving acceptance, we obtain an asymptotic key-rate bound and formulate final-key secrecy in composable trace distance. For m independently randomized signals sharing one bit and seed, the optimal leakage under non-adaptive product measurements is min1,m/(d+1), allowing a linear-in-d detection enhancement in that attack model. We also construct a seed-independent joint measurement that recovers the bit after disclosure with error at most ǎrepsilon from O(łog d+łog(1/ǎrepsilon)) signals, retaining only classical information after measurement. This gives a quantitative separation between product and joint measurements. Bob uses two logical detection outcomes independently of d.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了量子计算时间锁（QCT）模型，该模型结合了时间锁加密和量化噪声量子存储假设。时间锁加密允许Bob立即访问编码种子，而Eve只有在受保护的时间间隔后才能获得与访问该种子相同的最终信息。研究明确阐述了这种延迟访问加密假设，并从d维度的互不偏倚基的完整集合和仿射对独立置换族构建了MUB-QCT。在独立同分布的个体攻击和熵保持接受条件下，该工作获得了渐近密钥速率界限，并以可组合迹距离形式化了最终密钥的保密性。
authors: Nilesh Vyas, Romain Alleaume

articles.title: Memory-Augmented Hybrid Quantum Reservoir Computing
articles.title_zh: 记忆增强的混合量子储层计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2409.09886v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Reservoir computing (RC) is an effective method for predicting chaotic systems by using a high-dimensional dynamic reservoir with fixed internal weights, while keeping the learning phase linear, which simplifies training and reduces computational complexity compared to fully trained recurrent neural networks (RNNs). Quantum reservoir computing (QRC) uses the exponential growth of Hilbert spaces in quantum systems, allowing for greater information processing, memory capacity, and computational power. However, the original QRC proposal requires coherent injection of inputs multiple times, complicating practical implementation. We present a hybrid quantum-classical approach that implements memory through classical post-processing of quantum measurements. This approach avoids the need for multiple coherent input injections and is evaluated on benchmark tasks, including the chaotic Mackey-Glass time series prediction. We tested our model on two physical platforms: a fully connected Ising model and a Rydberg atom array. The optimized model demonstrates promising predictive capabilities, achieving a higher number of steps compared to previously reported approaches.
articles.abstract_zh: 储层计算（RC）是一种预测混沌系统的有效方法，而量子储层计算（QRC）利用量子系统希尔伯特空间的指数增长，提供了更强的信息处理能力。然而，原始QRC方案需要多次相干注入输入，这使得实际实现复杂。本文提出了一种混合量子-经典方法，通过对量子测量进行经典后处理来实现记忆功能，从而避免了多次相干输入注入的需求。该方法在混沌Mackey-Glass时间序列预测等基准任务上进行了评估，并在全连接伊辛模型和里德堡原子阵列两个物理平台上进行了测试。优化后的模型展示了有前景的预测能力，实现了比现有方法更多的预测步数。
authors: J. Settino, L. Salatino, L. Mariani, M. Channab, L. Bozzolo, S. Vallisa, P. Barillà, A. Policicchio, N. Lo Gullo, A. Giordano, C. Mastroianni, F. Plastina

articles.title: New exact solutions of the 3D Schrödinger equation
articles.title_zh: 三维薛定谔方程的新精确解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.04725v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Previously we found a unique quantum system with a positive gauge-invariant Weyl-Stratonovich quasi-probability density function which can be defined by the so-called guillemotleftquadratic funnelguillemotright potential. In this work we have constructed a class of exact solutions to the 3D Schrödinger equation for a two-parameter guillemotleftquadratic funnelguillemotright potential based on the Ψ -model of micro and macro systems. It should be noted that the Aharonov-Bohm effect is inherent in the quantum Ψ -model. Explicit expressions for the energy spectrum and the set of eigenfunctions have been found. Using gauge invariance for scalar and vector potentials, a solution to the electromagnetic Schrödinger equation has been obtained, with a magnetic field in the form of a guillemotleftDirac stringguillemotright defined by a singular vortex probability flux field. Superpositions of eigenfunctions leading to various types of vortex and potential probability current fields have been investigated in detail. The analysis of the quantum system's properties has been carried out within the Wigner-Vlasov formalism.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于微观和宏观系统的Ψ模型，构建了一类具有双参数“二次漏斗”势的三维薛定谔方程的精确解。研究找到了能量谱和本征函数集的显式表达式，并利用标量和矢量势的规范不变性，得到了电磁薛定谔方程的解，其中磁场表现为由奇异涡旋概率流场定义的“狄拉克弦”形式。该工作还详细研究了导致各种涡旋和势概率流场的本征函数叠加，并在维格纳-弗拉索夫（Wigner-Vlasov）形式下分析了量子系统的性质。
authors: E. E. Perepelkin, B. I. Sadovnikov, N. G. Inozemtseva, A. S. Medvedev

articles.title: Unified Toolbox for Multipartite Entanglement Certification
articles.title_zh: 多体纠缠认证的统一工具箱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.17435v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a unified framework for multipartite entanglement characterization based on the conditional gradient (CG) method, incorporating both fast heuristic detection and rigorous witness construction with numerical error control. Our method enables entanglement certification in quantum systems of up to ten qubits and applies to arbitrary entanglement structures. We demonstrate its power by closing the gap between entanglement and separability bounds in white-noise robustness benchmarks for a class of bound entangled states. Furthermore, the framework extends to entanglement robustness under general quantum noise channels, providing accurate thresholds in cases beyond the reach of previous algorithmic methods. These results position CG methods as a powerful tool for practical and scalable entanglement analysis in realistic experimental settings.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个基于条件梯度（CG）方法的统一框架，用于多体纠缠表征，该框架结合了快速启发式检测和具有数值误差控制的严格见证构造。该方法能够对多达十个量子比特的量子系统进行纠缠认证，并适用于任意纠缠结构。研究通过弥合一类束缚纠缠态在白噪声鲁棒性基准测试中的纠缠与可分离性界限之间的差距，展示了其强大功能。该框架还扩展到一般量子噪声信道下的纠缠鲁棒性，为以前算法方法无法触及的情况提供了精确的阈值，使其成为实际和可扩展纠缠分析的有力工具。
authors: Ye-Chao Liu, Jannis Halbey, Sebastian Pokutta, Sébastien Designolle

articles.title: Forecasting Low-Dimensional Navier-Stokes equations via Multi-Dimensional Hybrid Quantum Reservoir Computing
articles.title_zh: 基于多维混合量子储层计算的低维纳维-斯托克斯方程预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.04006v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The prediction of complex dynamics remains an open problem across many domains of physics, where nonlinearities and multiscale interactions severely limit the reliability of conventional forecasting methods. Quantum reservoir computing (QRC) has emerged as a promising paradigm for information processing by exploiting the high dimensionality of the Hilbert space, where the dynamics of quantum systems take place. Here, we introduce a hybrid quantum-classical reservoir architecture capable of handling multivariate time series through quantum evolution combined with classical memory enhancement. Our model employs a five-qubit transverse-field Ising Hamiltonian with input-modulated dynamics and temporal multiplexing, enabling the encoding of input signals over multiple timescales. We apply this framework to two paradigmatic models of chaotic behavior in fluid dynamics, where multiscale dynamics and nonlinearities play a dominant role: a low-dimensional truncation of the two-dimensional Navier-Stokes equations and the Lorenz-63 system. By systematically scanning the quantum system's parameter space, we identify regions that maximize forecasting performance, as measured by the Valid Prediction Time. The observed robustness and reliable performances for both dynamical systems suggest that this hybrid quantum approach offers a flexible platform for modelling complex nonlinear time series.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了一种混合量子-经典储层架构，该架构能够通过量子演化结合经典记忆增强来处理多变量时间序列。该模型采用一个五量子比特的横场伊辛哈密顿量，具有输入调制动力学和时间复用功能，从而能够在多个时间尺度上编码输入信号。研究将此框架应用于流体动力学中混沌行为的两个典型模型：二维纳维-斯托克斯方程的低维截断和洛伦兹-63系统。通过系统地扫描量子系统的参数空间，该工作识别出最大化预测性能的区域。
authors: L. Salatino, L. Mariani, A. Giordano, F. D'Amore, C. Mastroianni, L. Pontieri, A. Vinci, C. Gencarelli, L. Primavera, F. Plastina, J. Settino, F. Carbone

articles.title: Counter-diabatic control of open quantum battery charging
articles.title_zh: 开放量子电池充电的逆绝热控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.05848v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Continuous-variable quantum batteries provide a viable platform for microscopic energy storage, yet environmental dissipation typically degrades both their charging efficiency and extractable work (ergotropy). In this work, we investigate the charging dynamics of an open continuous-variable quantum battery modeled as coupled harmonic oscillators driven by counter-diabatic (CD) protocols in the presence of a Markovian thermal reservoir. Using Williamson's theorem to track the Gaussian state evolution, we show that CD driving significantly enhances ergotropy compared to conventional unassisted driving. Specifically, in the underdamped regime, the CD protocol boosts the peak ergotropy while suppressing thermal degradation. In the overdamped regime, where conventional unassisted charging fails due to rapid thermal dissipation, the CD protocol maintains a robust, non-zero ergotropy. Furthermore, by evaluating the temporal fluence of the auxiliary control fields, we assess the energetic cost and confirm that these thermodynamic advantages are achieved with physically realistic control overheads. These results indicate that counter-diabatic driving provides a practical route to decoherence-resilient quantum energy storage.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在马尔可夫热浴存在下，由逆绝热（CD）协议驱动的开放连续变量量子电池的充电动力学。通过威廉姆逊定理追踪高斯态演化，研究表明CD驱动显著提高了可提取功（ergotropy），尤其是在欠阻尼和过阻尼状态下。在欠阻尼状态下，CD协议提高了峰值可提取功并抑制了热退化；在过阻尼状态下，CD协议保持了鲁棒的非零可提取功。此外，通过评估辅助控制场的瞬时通量，该工作证实这些热力学优势是在物理上可行的控制开销下实现的。
authors: Sh. Ebrahimi, S. Salimi, F. T. Tabesh, A. S. Khorashad

articles.title: Scalable quantum error mitigation for dynamical decoupling via Hadamard phase cycling
articles.title_zh: 基于哈达玛相位循环的动态解耦可扩展量子误差缓解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.12227v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum coherence remains a fundamental challenge for advancing quantum technologies. Although dynamical decoupling can suppress decoherence noise, control errors can cause the overestimation of decoherence times. Here, we present Hadamard phase cycling, a scalable non-Markovian quantum error mitigation method using group-structured phase configurations to select target coherence pathways. Validated across molecular electron spins, nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond, nuclear spins, trapped ions, and superconducting qubits, this technique enables accurate decoherence time characterization and enhanced state fidelity with linear complexity. Our results show that control-induced coherence-population mixing can substantially prolong measured echo decays in the systems studied. This mechanism provides grounds to question decoherence times obtained under comparable conditions when population-mediated contributions have not been excluded. By selecting target coherence pathways, Hadamard phase cycling establishes a robust framework for reliable quantum control, paving the way for reassessment and advancement of coherence benchmarks in the NISQ era.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子相干性是量子技术发展面临的基本挑战。本文提出了一种可扩展的非马尔可夫量子误差缓解方法——哈达玛相位循环，该方法利用群结构相位配置来选择目标相干路径。该技术在多种量子系统中得到验证，能够以线性复杂度实现精确的退相干时间表征和增强的态保真度。研究结果表明，控制引起的相干-布居混合会显著延长测量的回波衰减。通过选择目标相干路径，哈达玛相位循环为可靠的量子控制建立了一个鲁棒框架，有助于重新评估和推进相干性基准。
authors: Weibin Ni, Zhijie Li, Guanyu Qu, Asif Equbal, Zhecheng Sun, Jiale Dai, Fazhan Shi, Lei Sun

articles.title: Intrinsic non-Markovian magnetisation dynamics
articles.title_zh: 本征非马尔可夫磁化动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.07378v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Memory effects are widespread in complex systems while evidence of non-Markovian dynamics in fundamental physical systems has been limited to specifically engineered cases. Here we report on the experimental observation of non-Markovian magnetisation dynamics in crystalline cobalt. Intense terahertz electromagnetic driving brings the system into a non-equilibrium state, and allows us to follow its magnetisation dynamics in real time at low temperatures. The response reveals a striking multi-peaked frequency spectrum that defies conventional descriptions. Using open quantum system theory we evidence that a non-Markovian memory kernel, arising from spin-phonon bath coupling, naturally explains both the spectral structure and its temperature dependence. Theoretical prediction of the spectrum is accomplished by simulating the non-Markovian Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation, while analytics quantitatively determines the frequencies of three spectral peaks. The results demonstrate that intrinsic memory effects can emerge in a simple ferromagnet, opening new opportunities to explore and control non-Markovian dynamics in condensed-matter systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 记忆效应在复杂系统中普遍存在，而基本物理系统中非马尔可夫动力学的证据此前仅限于特定工程案例。本文报道了在晶体钴中实验观察到的非马尔可夫磁化动力学。强太赫兹电磁驱动使系统进入非平衡态，并允许在低温下实时跟踪其磁化动力学。响应揭示了一个引人注目的多峰频率谱，这超出了传统描述的范畴。通过开放量子系统理论，研究证明由自旋-声子浴耦合产生的非马尔可夫记忆核自然解释了光谱结构及其温度依赖性。这些结果表明，本征记忆效应可以在简单的铁磁体中出现，为探索和控制凝聚态系统中的非马尔可夫动力学开辟了新机遇。
authors: Felix Hartmann, Vivek Unikandanunni, Matias Bargheer, Eric E. Fullerton, Stefano Bonetti, Janet Anders

articles.title: Quantum data hiding with two-qubit separable states
articles.title_zh: 基于双量子比特可分离态的量子数据隐藏
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.15095v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We consider the discrimination of two-party quantum states and provide a quantum data-hiding scheme using two-qubit separable states. We first provide a bound on the optimal local discrimination of two-party quantum states, and establish a sufficient condition under which a two-party quantum state ensemble can be used to construct a data-hiding scheme. We illustrate this condition with examples of two-qubit state ensembles consisting of two orthogonal separable states. As our data-hiding scheme can be implemented with separable states of the lowest possible dimension, its practical realization becomes significantly more attainable.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了两方量子态的判别，并提出了一种利用双量子比特可分离态的量子数据隐藏方案。研究者首先给出了两方量子态最优局部判别的界限，并建立了一个充分条件，在此条件下可以构建数据隐藏方案。该方案使用最低维度的可分离态实现，显著提高了其实用性。
authors: Donghoon Ha, Jeong San Kim

articles.title: Phase-space description of photon emission
articles.title_zh: 光子发射的相空间描述
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.21783v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Interactions between charged particles and light occur in real space and time, yet quantum field theory usually describes them in momentum space. Whereas this approach is well suited for calculating emission probabilities and cross sections, it is insensitive to spatial and temporal phenomena such as, for instance, radiation formation, quantum coherence, and wave packet spreading. These effects are becoming increasingly important for experiments involving electrons, photons, atoms, and ions, particularly with the advent of attosecond spectroscopy and metrology. Here, we propose a general method for describing the emission of photons in phase space via a Wigner function.
