Several effects for Cherenkov radiation are predicted, absent in classical realm or in quantum theory in momentum space, such as a finite spreading time of the photon, finite duration of the flash and a quantum shift of the photon arrival time. The photon spreading time turns out to be negative near the Cherenkov angle, the flash duration is defined by the electron packet size, and the temporal shift can be both positive and negative. The characteristic time scales of these effects lie in the atto- and femtosecond ranges, thereby illustrating atomic origins of these macroscopic phenomena. The near-field distribution of the photon field resembles the electron packet shape, thus making ``snapshots'' of the emitter wave function. Our approach can easily be generalized to the other types of radiation and extended to scattering, decay, and annihilation processes, bringing tomographic methods of quantum optics to particle physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管带电粒子与光的相互作用发生在真实时空，但量子场论通常在动量空间描述。本文提出了一种通过维格纳函数在相空间描述光子发射的通用方法。该方法预测了切伦科夫辐射的几个新效应，例如光子有限的传播时间、闪光持续时间以及光子到达时间的量子偏移。这些效应在经典理论或动量空间量子理论中均不存在，对于涉及电子、光子、原子和离子的实验日益重要。
authors: D. V. Karlovets, A. A. Shchepkin, A. D. Chaikovskaia, D. V. Grosman, D. A. Kargina, U. G. Rybak, G. K. Sizykh

articles.title: Reducing Circuit Resources in Grover's Algorithm via Constraint-Aware Initialization
articles.title_zh: 通过约束感知初始化减少格罗弗算法的电路资源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.17725v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Grover's search algorithm provides a quadratic speedup over classical brute-force search in terms of query complexity and is widely used as a versatile subroutine in numerous quantum algorithms, including those for combinatorial problems with large search spaces. For such problems, it is natural to reduce the effective search space by incorporating problem constraints at the initialization step, which in Grover's algorithm can be achieved by preparing structured initial states that encode constraint information. In this work, we present a systematic framework with a simple preprocessing procedure for constraint-aware initialization in Grover's algorithm, focusing on problems with linear constraints. While such structured initial states can reduce the number of oracle queries required to obtain a solution, their preparation incurs additional circuit-level costs. We therefore offer a conservative circuit-level resource analysis, showing that the resulting constraint-aware initialization can improve resource efficiency in terms of gate counts and circuit depth. The validity of the framework is further demonstrated numerically using the exact-cover problem. Overall, our results indicate that this approach serves as a practical baseline for achieving more resource-efficient implementations of Grover's algorithm compared to the standard uniform initialization.
articles.abstract_zh: 格罗弗搜索算法在查询复杂度上提供了二次加速。本文提出了一种在格罗弗算法中实现约束感知初始化的系统框架，通过在初始化步骤中编码问题约束来减少有效搜索空间。尽管准备结构化初始态会增加电路级成本，但保守的电路级资源分析表明，这种方法可以提高门计数和电路深度的资源效率。该框架的有效性已通过数值模拟得到进一步验证。
authors: Eunok Bae, Jeonghyeon Shin, Minjin Choi

articles.title: Accessing Levinson-Smith and Liénard equations in a nonlinear framework of quantum mechanics
articles.title_zh: 在量子力学非线性框架中探讨Levinson-Smith和Liénard方程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.04747v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this paper, we present the reduction of a recently introduced generalized quantum scheme of Chodos and Cooper to Levinson-Smith and Liénard classes of nonlinear system that enable us to furnish a wider class of acceptable solutions. In particular, for the Levinson-Smith equations, we find their relevance to position-dependent mass quantum systems, with an interesting off-shoot that solitonic-like solutions emerge from the condition of the level surface in the system. On the other hand, for the Liénard type, which has coefficients of odd and odd symmetry in the present set up, we demonstrate that closed form solutions exist on carrying out conversion to the typical Abel form.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将Chodos和Cooper最近提出的广义量子方案简化为Levinson-Smith和Liénard类的非线性系统，从而提供了更广泛的可接受解。对于Levinson-Smith方程，研究发现其与位置依赖质量量子系统相关，并从系统等值面条件中导出了类孤子解。对于Liénard方程，通过转换为典型的Abel形式，证明了存在闭合形式的解。
authors: Bijan Bagchi, Anindya Ghose-Choudhury

articles.title: GAP Measures and Wave Function Collapse
articles.title_zh: GAP测度与波函数坍缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.19993v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: GAP measures (also known as Scrooge measures) are a natural class of probability distributions on the unit sphere of a Hilbert space that come up in quantum statistical mechanics; for each density matrix h̊o there is a unique measure GAPₕ̊o. We describe and prove a property of these measures that was not recognized so far: If a wave function Ψ is GAPₕ̊o distributed and a collapse occurs, then the collapsed wave function Ψ' is again GAP distributed (relative to the appropriate h̊o'). This fact applies to collapses due to a quantum measurement carried out by an observer, as well as to spontaneous collapse theories such as CSL or GRW. More precisely, it is the conditional distribution of Ψ', given the measurement outcome (respectively, the noise in CSL or the collapse history in GRW), that is GAPₕ̊ₒ'.
articles.abstract_zh: GAP测度是希尔伯特空间单位球上的一类自然概率分布，在量子统计力学中有所应用。本文描述并证明了GAP测度的一个新特性：如果波函数Ψ服从GAP分布并发生坍缩，那么坍缩后的波函数Ψ'仍服从GAP分布。这一发现适用于由量子测量引起的坍缩，也适用于CSL或GRW等自发坍缩理论。
authors: Roderich Tumulka

articles.title: Constructing Arbitrary Coherent Rearrangements in Optical Lattices
articles.title_zh: 在光学晶格中构建任意相干重排
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.04210v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Coherent control of motional degrees of freedom of ultracold atoms in optical lattices offers a promising route towards programmable quantum dynamics with massive particles. We propose and analyze a scheme for implementing coherent rearrangement of ultracold atoms, corresponding to arbitrary unitary transformations on single-particle motional states. Exploiting an analogy between dynamics in optical superlattices and discrete linear optics, we employ the Clements scheme to systematically construct any global N-dimensional single-particle unitary from tunneling and phase shifts in arrays of double wells. Tunneling is controlled globally, while local operations are achieved through site-resolved potential shifts. We numerically investigate the susceptibility of the scheme to intensity noise and addressing crosstalk. We identify key subroutines enabled by this unitary construction, including the Discrete Fourier Transform and the implementation of non-native Hamiltonians. Extending the scheme to two dimensions enables all-to-all atomic rearrangement with a circuit depth that scales sublinearly with the atom number, providing a high-density and highly scalable approach to atom rearrangement.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出并分析了一种在光学晶格中实现超冷原子相干重排的方案，可对单粒子运动态进行任意酉变换。该方案利用光学超晶格动力学与离散线性光学之间的类比，采用Clements方案从双阱阵列中的隧穿和相移系统地构建任意全局N维单粒子酉变换。数值研究表明，该方案对强度噪声和寻址串扰具有一定的鲁棒性，并能实现离散傅里叶变换等关键子程序。
authors: Alexander Roth, Liyang Qiu, Timon Hilker, Titus Franz, Philipp M. Preiss

articles.title: Quantum Dynamical Entropy and non-Markovianity: a collisional model perspective
articles.title_zh: 量子动力学熵与非马尔可夫性：碰撞模型视角
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.14015v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Accessing the physical mechanisms behind non-Markovian phenomena in open quantum dynamics requires the study of the statistical properties of the joint system-environment dynamics. This is impossible at the level of the reduced dynamics of the open system alone as the latter is obtained by suitably eliminating the environment. The task is instead made possible by considering multi-time correlation functions involving observables of the open system, only: the open system-environment interactions turn them into global ones thus building up correlations between the two systems. Multi-time correlations form the basis of both the theory of quantum stochastic processes and of the Alicki-Lindblad-Fannes dynamical entropy (ALF entropy for short). This latter quantity provides for quantum systems a measure of the dynamical entropy production as the Kolmogorov-Sinai entropy does for classical systems. In the case of a collisional model whereby the dissipative dynamics of a finite-level system is obtained by its coupling to an infinite classical spin chain, the ALF entropy can be explicitly computed. It turns out to depend on the parameters characterizing the statistical properties of the environment and can be related to the activation and super-activation of memory effects in the open quantum system.
articles.abstract_zh: 理解开放量子动力学中非马尔可夫现象的物理机制，需要研究联合系统-环境动力学的统计特性。本文指出，多时间关联函数是量子随机过程理论和Alicki-Lindblad-Fannes (ALF) 动力学熵的基础。通过碰撞模型，研究者显式计算了有限能级系统与无限经典自旋链耦合时的ALF熵。结果表明，ALF熵可以作为量子系统动力学熵产生的一种度量。
authors: Giovanni Nichele, Fabio Benatti

articles.title: Quantum Dynamical Entropy and Dissipative Information Flows
articles.title_zh: 量子动力学熵与耗散信息流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.14025v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Alicki-Lindblad-Fannes dynamical (ALF) entropy measures the rate at which new information is gathered about a quantum system by inspecting its long-time evolution. We propose an extension of the ALF entropy to open quantum dynamics as a measure of back-flow of information from the environment. Such a proposal is stronger than the existing ones based only on the open system reduced dynamics. In the case of a qubit collisionally coupled to a classical spin chain, we obtain an exact expression for the open-system ALF entropy explicitly depending on the environment correlations. An extreme case shows how the information flow from environment to system corresponds to vanishing entropy production as for reversible finite quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: Alicki-Lindblad-Fannes (ALF) 动力学熵衡量了通过检查量子系统长期演化所获取新信息的速率。本文提出将ALF熵扩展到开放量子动力学中，作为衡量环境信息回流的度量。对于与经典自旋链碰撞耦合的量子比特，研究者获得了开放系统ALF熵的精确表达式，该表达式明确依赖于环境关联。极端情况表明，从环境到系统的信息流对应于熵产生为零，类似于可逆有限量子系统。
authors: Giovanni Nichele, Fabio Benatti

articles.title: Competition between contrast and laser noise in laser threshold magnetometry using an external cavity diode laser
articles.title_zh: 外部腔二极管激光器激光阈值磁力计中对比度与激光噪声的竞争
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.18937v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The negatively charged nitrogen-vacancy center (NV⁻⁾ in diamond is a versatile platform for quantum magnetometry under ambient conditions. Recently, laser threshold magnetometry (LTM) has been proposed as a means to significantly enhance the sensitivity of NV-based magnetometers by incorporating a diamond hosting NV⁻ centers within a laser cavity and operating near threshold. While demonstrations have validated the concept, practical implementations remain technically demanding, requiring high pump powers and precise alignment of free-space cavities. It remains unclear whether the benefits of operating near threshold will outpace increased laser noise. In this work, we integrate an NV-diamond with a high NV⁻ content into a compact external cavity diode laser and demonstrate singlet infrared absorption optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR). We report a five-fold enhancement in the ODMR contrast by operating near the laser threshold. However, the magnetic-field sensitivity is a factor of two worse near threshold (17~mathrmnT/sqrtHz) than when operating far above threshold (7.6~mathrmnT/sqrtHz). Consequently, on this platform, near-threshold operation currently yields a net negative effect on sensitivity because the threshold-enhanced laser noise outweighs the threshold-enhanced contrast. These results demonstrate that managing this contrast-noise trade-off is a critical challenge that must be addressed to realize the potential benefits of laser threshold magnetometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 激光阈值磁力计（LTM）被提出用于增强基于金刚石负电荷氮空位（NV⁻）中心的量子磁力计灵敏度。本研究将高NV⁻含量的金刚石集成到紧凑型外部腔二极管激光器中，并展示了单线态红外吸收光探测磁共振（ODMR）。结果显示，在激光阈值附近操作可使ODMR对比度提高五倍，但磁场灵敏度反而比远超阈值时差两倍。这表明在该平台上，阈值操作的优势未能超越增加的激光噪声。
authors: Shao Qi Lim, Alexander A. Wood, Brett C. Johnson, Qiang Sun, Jan Jeske, Hiroshi Abe, Takeshi Ohshima, David J. Ottaway, Heike Ebendorff-Heidepriem, Robert E. Scholten, Andrew D. Greentree, Brant C. Gibson

articles.title: Measuring the largest coefficients of a quantum state
articles.title_zh: 测量量子态的最大系数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.00341v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce a hierarchical algorithm for identifying the indices of the largest Pauli coefficients of an unknown n-qubit quantum state, either those exceeding a threshold or the t largest ones. The algorithm traverses a prefix-based tree whose nodes represent partial sums of squared Pauli coefficients, expanding either the nodes of largest estimated weight or all nodes above a threshold, and discarding the rest. Node weights are estimated using Bell sampling on two copies of the state, or alternatively via SWAP tests on subsystems. We prove finite-sample guarantees for the exact recovery of the target set in terms of state-dependent separation margins for the relevant prefix weights, and derive bounds on the number of nodes explored by the corresponding exact traversal. While the same Bell data can be processed exhaustively, the hierarchical strategy can reduce the classical search at the cost of potentially requiring more samples to distinguish the relevant prefix weights. The efficiency of our method depends on the number of nodes of the prefix tree with non-negligible weight as well as on the statistical conditioning of these values. We validate the method numerically on Pauli-singleton states, random stabilizer states, ground states of the transverse-field Ising model, and states with hierarchical Pauli support, illustrating different structural and statistical regimes. We further benchmark the method against alternative approaches for learning Pauli coefficients. Our work addresses the targeted discovery of dominant Pauli components without performing full state tomography.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种分层算法，用于识别未知n量子比特量子态中最大泡利系数的索引。该算法遍历基于前缀的树，其节点代表平方泡利系数的部分和，通过贝尔采样或SWAP测试估计节点权重。研究者证明了目标集精确恢复的有限样本保证，并推导了相应精确遍历所探索节点数量的界限。该方法在减少经典搜索方面具有潜力，其效率取决于前缀树中具有不可忽略权重的节点数量。
authors: Nicolás Ciancaglini, Santiago Cifuentes, Guido Bellomo, Santiago Figueira, Ariel Bendersky

articles.title: Operating a bistable qubit
articles.title_zh: 双稳态量子比特的操作
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.03187v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Parasitic two-level-system (TLS) defects limit the stability and performance of solid-state quantum processors. Their interaction with a qubit can cause discrete, stochastic shifts of the qubit frequency, making the qubit bistable. We experimentally demonstrate an adaptive protocol for operating a bistable qubit with high fidelity using a classical controller powered by a field-programmable gate array (FPGA). Our "1-bit feedback" protocol estimates the qubit's bistable frequency and corrects the control frame using only one single-shot measurement, reaching the information limit set by the qubit's intrinsic entropy. We validate the protocol in a superconducting qubit by suppressing TLS-induced Ramsey beating, and deploy it to stabilize gate fidelities over time with approximately 136 kHz estimation bandwidth and a 77% error reduction. Our approach provides a simple, yet fundamentally efficient strategy for mitigating dephasing errors induced by strongly coupled TLS defects, and may enable the operation of large future qubit arrays suffering from few remaining, discrete instabilities.
articles.abstract_zh: 寄生双能级系统（TLS）缺陷会限制固态量子处理器的稳定性和性能，导致量子比特频率发生离散随机偏移，使其变为双稳态。本文实验演示了一种自适应协议，通过FPGA驱动的经典控制器高保真地操作双稳态量子比特。该“1比特反馈”协议仅用一次单次测量即可估计量子比特的双稳态频率并校正控制帧，达到了量子比特固有熵设定的信息极限。该方法有效抑制了TLS引起的退相干误差，并有望支持未来大型量子比特阵列的稳定运行。
authors: Fabrizio Berritta, Jan A. Krzywda, Tom Dvir, Paul Buttles, Stanislav Eilhart, Jeroen Danon, Ferdinand Kuemmeth

articles.title: Isotropic random walks and Brownian diffusion on complex projective space
articles.title_zh: 复射影空间上的各向同性随机游走和布朗扩散
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11438v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study isotropic random walks on complex projective space in the context of stochastic state-space exploration in open quantum systems. Using results from harmonic analysis on compact rank-one symmetric spaces, first we obtain explicit transition kernels and characterise the evolution of fidelity and geometric observables. Then, we establish the correspondence between the small-step limit and Fubini-Study Brownian motion, and also show that the long-time limit reproduces Haar-random state statistics. At the level of the density matrix, the ensemble evolution formally coincides with an isotropic depolarizing channel at all times. Our main results concern first-passage statistics to high-fidelity target states. In the Brownian limit, we derive a closed-form expression for the mean first-passage time and an explicit spectral representation of the first-passage-time distribution, with decay rates determined by the eigenvalues of the killed Fubini-Study Laplace-Beltrami operator. The resulting asymptotics reveal a strong dependence on target fidelity and Hilbert-space dimension, demonstrating the rapidly increasing difficulty of reaching high-fidelity targets through unbiased isotropic exploration. The model is purely geometric and does not incorporate microscopic Hamiltonians or Lindblad dynamics. Nevertheless, the results suggest that it offers a natural starting point for stochastic models of open quantum systems that incorporate Hamiltonian and dissipative effects, with potential applications to stochastic quantum state preparation and control.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在开放量子系统随机状态空间探索的背景下，研究了复射影空间上的各向同性随机游走和布朗扩散。研究者首先获得了显式转移核，并描述了保真度和几何可观测量的演化。随后，建立了小步长极限与Fubini-Study布朗运动之间的对应关系，并证明了长时间极限重现了Haar随机态统计。主要结果涉及高保真目标态的首达时间统计，揭示了其对目标保真度和希尔伯特空间维度的强烈依赖性。
authors: Gyula I. Tóth

articles.title: Equilibration of generalized subsystems: a quantum-channel approach
articles.title_zh: 广义子系统的平衡：一种量子信道方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18360v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum systems governed by unitary and reversible microscopic dynamics may nevertheless exhibit equilibration, in the sense that some effective description becomes time-independent. Standard equilibration results usually consider two separate situations: system-environment structures, in which the composite system evolves unitarily while the system of interest equilibrates, and restricted measurements, such as coarse-grained POVMs and observables, in which the measurement statistics equilibrate. Here, we bring these descriptions into a common state-level framework using the concept of generalized subsystems, where the accessible effective state appears as the output of a quantum channel acting on the microscopic state. We derive bounds showing that generalized subsystems equilibrate when their dimension is small compared with the effective dimension of the discarded microscopic information. We further show that this condition is met for typical initial states in large subspaces and that the resulting equilibrium description is largely insensitive to microscopic initial details. The framework recovers the usual equilibration bounds for ordinary subsystems and finite families of POVMs. As an example, we also introduce a finite-resolution energy channel that maps unresolved microscopic energy levels into effective energy levels, thereby making residual effective coherences explicit and showing how spectral multiplicities constrain those coherences while strengthening equilibration. Our results provide a unified state-level formulation of quantum equilibration under general forms of limited accessible information.
articles.abstract_zh: 这项工作提出了一个统一的框架，利用广义子系统概念和量子信道方法，来描述量子系统的平衡现象。研究表明，当广义子系统的维度远小于被丢弃微观信息的有效维度时，系统会达到平衡。此外，这种平衡状态对微观初始细节不敏感，并且该框架能够恢复标准的平衡界限。
authors: Pedro S. Correia, Adalberto D. Varizi, Gabriel Dias Carvalho

articles.title: Fast Quantum Algorithms for Learning Linear Threshold Functions
articles.title_zh: 学习线性阈值函数的快速量子算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.40331v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Linear threshold functions (LTFs) are -1,1-valued functions fw,θ(x)=sgn(łangle w,xångle-θ), where winmathbb Rⁿ has unit norm, θinmathbb R, and xinmathbb Rⁿ or -1,1ⁿ. If θ=0, the LTF is homogeneous, denoted f_w=fw,₀. LTFs are fundamental linear classifiers. We give three results: one for general LTFs and two for homogeneous LTFs. (1) With real-domain membership queries evaluating fw,θ(x) at any chosen xinmathbb Rⁿ, we learn an LTF with classification error at most ǎrepsilon under the standard Gaussian distribution using O(łog(n/ǎrepsilon)) queries and widetildeO(n) other gates. Classically, Ømega(nłog(1/ǎrepsilon)) queries are required, giving an exponential quantum query speedup. (2) A homogeneous LTF f_w over -1,1ⁿ whose k nonzero weights are equal and positive is Majority on the support of w. We identify this hidden support exactly using O(łog k) queries, exponentially improving Belovs' O(k¹/⁴) upper bound. Our algorithm uses O(nłog nłog k) gates and has O(łog nłog k) non-oracle depth. Classical algorithms require Ømega(kłog(n/k)) queries. (3) Suppose a unitary U prepares discretized Gaussian quantum examples, corresponding to intₓsqrtγₙ₍ₓ₎|xångle|f_w(x)ångle,dx. This is weaker than membership queries. Using the efficient quantum Hermite transform circuit, we learn homogeneous LTFs with classification error at most ǎrepsilon under the Gaussian distribution using O(n¹/⁴/sqrtǎrepsilon) applications of U and U^dagger and widetildeO!(fracn⁵/⁴sqrtǎrepsilon+fracnǎrepsilon²) other gates. Classically, Ømega(n/ǎrepsilon) examples are needed, giving a quartic quantum speedup in n. We show that the quantum query complexities in all three cases are optimal by proving matching lower bounds.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了三种针对线性阈值函数（LTFs）学习的快速量子算法。对于一般LTFs，在标准高斯分布下，量子算法实现了指数级的查询加速。对于齐次LTFs，算法能够以指数级更少的查询次数精确识别隐藏支持集。这些结果展示了量子计算在机器学习领域，特别是线性分类器学习方面的显著优势。
authors: Aleksandrs Krivcenko, Tuyen Nguyen, Ronald de Wolf

articles.title: Roadmap to Quantum Aesthetics
articles.title_zh: 量子美学路线图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.08363v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum mechanics occupies a central position in contemporary science while remaining largely inaccessible to direct sensory experience. This paper proposes a roadmap to quantum aesthetics that examines how quantum concepts become aesthetic phenomena through artistic mediation rather than direct representation. Two complementary and orthogonal approaches are articulated. The first, a pioneering top-down approach, employs text-prompt-based generative AI to probe quantum aesthetics as a collective cultural construct embedded in large-scale training data. By systematically modulating the linguistic weight of the term "quantum," generative models are used as experimental environments to reveal how quantum imaginaries circulate within contemporary visual culture. The second, a bottom-up approach, derives aesthetic form directly from quantum-mechanical structures through the visualization of quantum-generated data, exemplified here by hydrogen atomic orbitals calculated from the Schrödinger equation. These approaches are framed not as competing methods but as intersecting paths within a navigable field of artistic research. They position quantum aesthetics as an emergent field of artistic research shaped by cultural imagination, computational mediation, and physical law, opening new directions for artistic practice and pedagogy at the intersection of art, data, artificial intelligence and quantum science.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一份量子美学路线图，探讨量子概念如何通过艺术媒介而非直接表现转化为审美现象。研究阐述了两种互补的方法：一种是利用生成式AI从文化层面探索量子美学，另一种是通过可视化量子力学结构（如氢原子轨道）直接推导审美形式。这些方法共同构成了艺术研究中探索量子美学的交叉路径。
authors: Ivan C. H. Liu, Hsiao-Yuan Chen

articles.title: Agentic inverse design of spatially programmed materials
articles.title_zh: 空间编程材料的智能体逆向设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03795v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatially programmed functional materials, from functionally graded alloys and metamaterials to quantum superlattices, use their spatial structure to tailor physical properties. However, translating a desired spatial structure into a practical fabrication recipe remains challenging due to the complex relationship between processing conditions and resulting material structures. Here we show that a large language model (LLM) agent can inverse-design such fabrication recipes by using a physics-based simulator of ion-matter interactions as a tool. Given an arbitrary depth profile of implanted ions or vacancies, the agent selects the ion species, energies, incident angles, and target material layers; writes, runs, and interprets simulations; and iteratively refines the recipe until the simulated profile matches the target, with minimal human input. Our work demonstrates physics-guided agentic inverse design as a practical approach to making the spatial structure of materials a programmable variable, opening new opportunities to explore emergent physical phenomena and functional phases of matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 空间编程功能材料的制造面临将所需结构转化为实际制备方案的挑战。本文展示了一个大型语言模型（LLM）智能体如何利用基于物理的模拟器，对这类材料的制造方案进行逆向设计。该智能体能自主选择离子种类、能量、入射角和靶材层，并迭代优化方案以匹配目标深度剖面。这项工作为将材料空间结构作为可编程变量提供了一种实用方法，有望探索新的物理现象和功能物相。
authors: Denisse Córdova Carrizales, Abhijatmedhi Chotrattanapituk, L. Dagny Davis, Jeremy Ramsey, Ryotaro Okabe, Mouyang Cheng, Mingda Li

articles.title: Thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz for the Toda chain from inverse scattering transform
articles.title_zh: 基于逆散射变换的Toda链热力学Bethe猜想
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03857v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Thermodynamic Bethe Ansatz (TBA) procedure developed by Yang-Yang provides the free energy functional to be minimized via a variational problem. Their result not only gives the correct thermodynamics, but it also sets the framework for Generalized Hydrodynamics. Originally developed for quantum systems, this procedure has been recently successfully applied to (integrable) classical particle systems. However, this has never been done for classical field theories: no classical derivation has consistently accounted for solitons, breathers, radiation (dispersive modes), and their mutual interactions. We here derive the TBA equations for the Toda chain directly from its inverse scattering transform. This results in solitonic modes interacting with radiation, extending the soliton gas picture. We provide numerical verification of our equations against well established TBA equations in terms of particle modes. We expect the same procedure should apply to KdV, and pure radiative models as defocusing NLS and Sinh-Gordon, while we discuss current limitations in other models such as focusing NLS (and Ablowitz-Ladik) and Sine-Gordon.
articles.abstract_zh: 热力学Bethe猜想（TBA）方法在量子系统和经典粒子系统中取得了成功，但在经典场论中尚未能一致地解释孤子、呼吸子和辐射的相互作用。本文直接从Toda链的逆散射变换推导了TBA方程，揭示了孤子模式与辐射的相互作用，扩展了孤子气体图像。研究结果与已有的粒子模式TBA方程进行了数值验证，并讨论了该方法在其他模型中的适用性和局限性。
authors: Alberto Brollo

articles.title: Korringa factor in Dirac-nodal-line systems
articles.title_zh: 狄拉克节线系统中的Korringa因子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03994v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Korringa factor K(α) in the nuclear magnetic resonance studies is a widely used measure of electron-correlation effects in metals and is conventionally interpreted using the non-correlated value K(α) = 1. In Dirac-fermion systems, however, the non-correlated reference value depends on the electronic density of states (DOS) and differs from that of conventional metals. Here, we theoretically investigate the non-correlated Korringa factor K^*(α) in a Dirac nodal-line (DNL) system with finite nodal-line dispersion using a DOS-based approach. We show that K^*(α) exhibits an intrinsic temperature dependence, continuously evolving from the Dirac-fermion value of 1.71 at high temperatures to the metallic value of 1 at low temperatures. The crossover temperature is found to be proportional to the nodal-line dispersion width, identified as the characteristic energy scale governing the non-correlated Korringa factor in DNL systems. We further demonstrate that Landau quantization generates singular DOS structures that strongly enhance K^*(α), producing pronounced peaks even in the absence of electron correlations. In addition, K^*(α) exhibits two distinct types of magnetic oscillations arising from intra-level and inter-level contributions. The latter originates from the overlap of singular points belonging to positive and negative quantum-number Landau subbands at the Fermi level and represents a unique consequence of the finite energy dispersion of a DNL. These results provide a quantitative reference for interpreting NMR experiments in DNL materials and for identifying genuine correlation effects beyond DOS-induced contributions.
articles.abstract_zh: Korringa因子是衡量金属中电子关联效应的重要指标。本文理论研究了具有有限节线色散的狄拉克节线（DNL）系统中的非关联Korringa因子K^*(α)。研究发现K^*(α)表现出固有的温度依赖性，从高温下的狄拉克费米子值1.71连续演变为低温下的金属值1。此外，朗道量子化会产生奇异的态密度结构，显著增强K^*(α)，即使在没有电子关联的情况下也能产生明显的峰值。
authors: Takahiko Sekine, Kanoda Kazushi

articles.title: Dynamical Phonon Anharmonicity Drives Charge-Density-Wave Softening and Electronic Quasiparticle Decoherence in Monolayer 1H-NbSe2
articles.title_zh: 单层1H-NbSe2中动态声子非谐性驱动电荷密度波软化和电子准粒子退相干
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04038v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Charge-density-wave (CDW) instabilities in two-dimensional materials are governed by strongly anharmonic soft phonons, whose dynamical behavior remains poorly understood beyond the statically renormalized vibrations. Here, using monolayer 1H-NbSe2, we investigate how frequency-dependent three- and four-phonon interactions reshape phonon spectral functions and influence electronic excitations. We find that three-phonon interactions induce substantial dynamical softening of CDW modes, increasing the estimated transition temperature relative to static self-consistent phonon theory. Four-phonon interactions further promote such dynamical softening and enhance spectral broadening, producing non-Lorentzian lineshapes that challenge the quasiparticle picture. Incorporating dynamically renormalized phonon frequencies and electron-phonon coupling into Fan-Migdal electron self-energy calculations reveals enhanced electronic kinks, satellite features, and momentum-dependent quasiparticle decoherence, driven by the strong momentum dependence of the electron-phonon coupling matrix elements. These findings establish dynamical anharmonicity as a critical link between soft-mode lattice fluctuations and electronic spectral signatures, providing insights into coupled lattice-electron dynamics in two-dimensional quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维材料中的电荷密度波（CDW）不稳定性受强非谐软声子控制。本文以单层1H-NbSe2为例，研究了频率依赖的三声子和四声子相互作用如何影响声子谱函数和电子激发。研究发现，这些动态非谐性相互作用导致CDW模式显著软化，并增强谱展宽，产生非洛伦兹线形。将动态重整化的声子频率和电子-声子耦合纳入计算，揭示了增强的电子扭结、卫星特征和动量依赖的准粒子退相干，强调了动态非谐性在CDW物理中的关键作用。
authors: Yi Xia

articles.title: Resolving magnetic order and dynamics with polarized neutron scattering: a practical guide to longitudinal polarization analysis
articles.title_zh: 利用偏振中子散射解析磁序和动力学：纵向偏振分析的实用指南
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04050v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neutron scattering provides microscopic information on magnetic order and spin dynamics. Most experiments, however, use unpolarized neutrons and do not fully exploit the information carried by the neutron spin. Longitudinal polarization analysis (LPA), established in the pioneering work of Moon, Riste, and Koehler at Oak Ridge National Laboratory in the late 1960s, separates magnetic and nonmagnetic scattering contributions through their different effects on the neutron spin. In this review, we illustrate how LPA can distinguish weak magnetic scattering from nonmagnetic contributions, constrain small moment components, and resolve the spin-space anisotropy of magnetic excitations. We introduce the formalism connecting measured polarization channels to magnetic quantities and discuss scattering geometry, crystallographic projections, and corrections for finite polarization. Our aim is to provide a practical guide for neutron scatterers using LPA to determine magnetic structures and characterize spin excitations in quantum materials. We conclude with opportunities in altermagnets, unconventional superconductors, and kagome magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 中子散射是研究磁序和自旋动力学的微观工具，但传统非偏振中子散射未能充分利用中子自旋信息。本文作为一篇综述，详细介绍了纵向偏振分析（LPA）如何通过中子自旋效应区分磁性和非磁性散射贡献。文章阐述了LPA在识别弱磁散射、限制小磁矩分量以及解析磁激发自旋空间各向异性方面的应用，并提供了连接测量偏振通道与磁量的形式化方法和实用指导。
authors: Sijie Xu, Pengcheng Dai

articles.title: Altermagnetism-induced Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov superfluids and momentum-selective pairing channels in optical lattices
articles.title_zh: 光学晶格中交变磁性诱导的Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov超流体和动量选择性配对通道
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04214v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the superfluid phases of a two-dimensional degenerate Fermi gas in an optical lattice subject to a dₓy-wave altermagnetic term that couples to the in-plane spin component. The single-particle Hamiltonian generates anisotropic Fermi surfaces for the two pseudo-spin species while maintaining zero net polarization. Using the Bogoliubov-de Gennes approach, we show that this anisotropy favors Cooper pairing at a finite center-of-mass momentum, producing a competition between Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) and Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) pairing and leading to FFLO superfluids. We further examine the effect of a Zeeman-induced spin polarization and find that triplet and singlet pairing channels coexist and compete, resulting in a momentum-selective pairing pattern. Remarkably, this triplet pairing emerges exclusively in the FFLO phase and is entirely absent in the BCS phase. The model is readily realizable in ultracold atoms with current experimental techniques, providing a feasible route for quantum emulation and for studying unconventional superfluid phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了二维简并费米气体在光学晶格中受dₓy波交变磁项影响下的超流相。研究发现，这种各向异性费米面促进了有限质心动量下的库珀配对，导致BCS和FFLO配对之间的竞争，并产生了FFLO超流体。进一步分析表明，塞曼诱导的自旋极化导致三重态和单重态配对通道共存竞争，形成动量选择性配对模式，其中三重态配对仅在FFLO相中出现。该模型可通过超冷原子实验实现，为量子模拟和研究非常规超流相提供了途径。
authors: Qing-Yu Li, Zhen Zheng

articles.title: Anomalous Hall Response and Real-Space Current Correlations in Rhombohedral Graphene
articles.title_zh: 菱方石墨烯中的反常霍尔响应和实空间电流关联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04312v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the anomalous Hall effect (AHE) and magnetization observed in rhombohedral graphene through real-space calculations which lead to new insights. Our calculations reveal no equilibrium loop currents of the type associated with the Haldane model of a quantum anomalous Hall insulator. Instead, the AHE arises in this instance from interference between electronic paths forming oriented closed Wilson loops of current operators in the presence of valley polarization. We show some examples of these Wilson loops. Using the fact that the added-carrier charge density resides dominantly in the top and bottom layers, we develop a real-space expansion of the surface Hamiltonian that reproduces the Hall response of the full model with good accuracy. We also predict that a smooth local potential induces equilibrium circulating currents whose strength depends on both Berry curvature and the orbital moments of states at the Fermi surface.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过实空间计算研究了菱方石墨烯中的反常霍尔效应（AHE）和磁化现象。研究发现，AHE并非源于Haldane模型中的平衡环电流，而是由谷极化存在下电子路径形成的有向闭合Wilson电流环的干涉引起。基于载流子主要分布在顶层和底层的特点，我们发展了表面哈密顿量的实空间展开，并准确重现了霍尔响应。此外，研究还预测平滑的局域势会诱导平衡循环电流，其强度取决于贝里曲率和费米面态的轨道磁矩。
authors: Zhen Bi, Chandra M. Varma

articles.title: Emergence of Berry curvature dipole and nonlinear Hall effect in a novel hexagonal borophosphene allotrope
articles.title_zh: 新型六方硼磷烯同素异形体中贝里曲率偶极子和非线性霍尔效应的出现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04335v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the electronic structure, local orbital coupling, and strain-tunable nonlinear Hall response of two arsenic-substituted borophosphene-derived monolayers, As@MBP and As@AMBP, using first-principles calculations and tight-binding analysis. In the absence of spin--orbit coupling, both systems exhibit a finite Berry-curvature dipole (BCD) and a substantial nonlinear Hall conductivity, demonstrating that the nonlinear response is intrinsically driven by orbital physics and inversion-symmetry breaking. As substitution opens sizable band gaps of 120~meV in As@MBP and 90~meV in As@AMBP, well exceeding room-temperature thermal fluctuations (kBT approx 25.9~meV). Tight-binding analysis reveals that As incorporation breaks the equivalence of B-P hoppings in As@MBP and induces sign reversals in key nearest-neighbor hoppings in As@AMBP, reflecting a pronounced electronic reconstruction beyond simple geometric effects. Under mechanical strain, the redistribution of Berry curvature yields a maximum BCD of 22~mathringA in As@MBP, approximately 10 times larger than that of unstrained structure, and induces a reversal of the BCD sign. These results establish As-substituted borophosphene derivatives as promising light-element platforms for mechanically switchable nonlinear transport and quantum-material applications without relying on strong spin-orbit coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用第一性原理计算和紧束缚分析，研究了两种砷取代硼磷烯单层材料的电子结构和非线性霍尔响应。研究发现，在没有自旋轨道耦合的情况下，这两种材料均表现出显著的贝里曲率偶极子和非线性霍尔电导率，表明非线性响应由轨道物理和反演对称性破缺驱动。砷取代引入了可观的带隙，且机械应变可显著增强贝里曲率偶极子，并诱导其符号反转。
authors: Ranjan Kumar Tung, Dimple, Venkatesan Subramanian, Vijay Singh

articles.title: Thermodynamic Evidence for Multiple Field-Induced Phases in an Anisotropic Kagome Antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 各向异性kagome反铁磁体中多重场致相的热力学证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04675v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Kagome antiferromagnets are predicted to host exotic field-induced phases, yet experimental identification of their thermodynamic signatures remains challenging. Here we combine specific heat (C) and ultrasound measurements up to 36 T and down to 0.5 K to map the H-T phase diagram of the anisotropic kagome magnet Y₃Cu₉₍OH)₁₉Cl₈. We show that the suppression of long-range antiferromagnetic order with field at sim 15 T approximately coincides with the onset of the unconventional 1/6 (or 1/9) magnetization plateau previously observed in this system. The attenuation (and sound velocity) then intriguingly increases down to 0.5 K just at μ₀H = 15 T, and C/T becomes temperature independent. Moreover, our measurements are consistent with the opening of a spin gap Δ₀simeq3.5± 0.3 K within the plateau and reveal a further compressible (ungapped) phase beyond the plateau phase, unveiling a rich sequence of field-induced phases in this quantum magnet.
articles.abstract_zh: Kagome反铁磁体被预测存在奇异的场致相，但其热力学特征的实验识别仍具挑战。本文结合比热和超声测量，绘制了各向异性kagome磁体Y₃Cu₉₍OH)₁₉Cl₈的H-T相图。研究发现，长程反铁磁序的抑制与非常规磁化平台（1/6或1/9）的出现大致重合，并在平台相内观测到自旋能隙的开启。这些结果揭示了该量子磁体中一系列丰富的场致相。
authors: M. Schuchard, Q. Barthélemy, C. Marcenat, N. Wack, P. Puphal, A. De Muer, D. LeBoeuf, T. Klein

articles.title: Nonreciprocal charge transport in quantum materials: From superconductors to magnetic systems
articles.title_zh: 量子材料中的非互易电荷输运：从超导体到磁性系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04821v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonreciprocal charge transport, where current flows preferentially in one direction, has become a key topic across quantum materials. This review covers some recent progress in bulk crystals, artificial heterostructures, van der Waals systems, high-temperature superconductors, and magnetic materials. The review discusses both intrinsic origins, such as band-structure effects, and extrinsic ones, including vortex motion, device geometry, and heating artifacts. A central focus is the superconducting diode effect due to its application potential, which shows different critical currents for opposite directions. The review also examines how symmetry breaking, spin-orbit coupling, and magnetic order contribute to the observed responses. However, there remain challenges when many exciting findings lack a unified picture, and the field continues to debate the relative importance of various mechanisms. The review highlights key open questions and suggests future directions, including better experimental standards and device integration. This review aims to give a balanced view of what is known, what is uncertain, and where the field might go next.
articles.abstract_zh: 本综述探讨了量子材料中非互易电荷输运的最新进展，涵盖块状晶体、人工异质结构、范德华系统、高温超导体和磁性材料。文章讨论了其内在（如能带结构效应）和外在（如涡旋运动、器件几何形状、加热效应）起源，并重点关注了超导二极管效应。综述还强调了对称性破缺、自旋轨道耦合和磁序在其中扮演的角色，并指出了该领域面临的挑战和未来发展方向。
authors: Boning Yu, Yalei Huang, Alltrin Dhanarajagopal, Xiaofeng Xu

articles.title: Hidden Triakontadipole Order in the Triangular-Lattice Magnet CeMgAl₁₁O₁₉
articles.title_zh: 三角晶格磁体CeMgAl₁₁O₁₉中隐藏的三十二极序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04845v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The absence of magnetic Bragg peaks and a broad excitation continuum are commonly recognized experimental features of a quantum spin liquid. The Ce-based triangular-lattice hexaaluminate CeMgAl₁₁O₁₉ exhibits both signatures, yet its effective model and ground state remain under debate. Experiments have variously suggested a quantum spin liquid, proximate umbrella point, and disorder-suppressed magnetic order. Here we trace these contradictions to an overlooked multipolar degree of freedom: the transverse pseudospin of the |±5/2ångle Kramers doublet is a rank-5 triakontadipole rather than an ordinary dipole. Analyzing the magnetization, neutron spectra, and thermodynamics on equal footing, we establish a dipole-triakontadipole XXZ model with Jₚₑᵣₚ simeq 0.65 K and J_c simeq -0.13 K. The resulting planar triakontadipolar superfluid order is hidden from dipolar probes, explaining the absence of a magnetic Bragg peak in neutron scattering. The zero-field excitations separate into a low-energy triakontadipole wave and a broad higher-energy continuum. We further propose nuclear spin-lattice relaxation and spin-current experiments to probe the gapless excitations of this hidden triakontadipole superfluid. Our findings thus open a new avenue for high-rank multipolar physics in rare-earth triangular-lattice magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: CeMgAl₁₁O₁₉表现出量子自旋液体的特征，但其基态仍存在争议。本研究将这些矛盾归因于一个被忽视的五阶三十二极（triakontadipole）多极自由度。通过建立偶极-三十二极XXZ模型，揭示了平面三十二极超流序，该序对偶极探测是隐藏的，解释了中子散射中磁布拉格峰的缺失。研究还提出了核自旋晶格弛豫和自旋流实验来探测这一隐藏秩序。
authors: Yu-Bo Liu, Yuan Gao, Zhen Ma, Shufan Cheng, Xinyang Liu, Jinsheng Wen, Wei Li

articles.title: Ta-based S-I-S junctions for integrated superconducting Electronics
articles.title_zh: 用于集成超导电子学的钽基S-I-S结
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04982v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we have presented S-I-S Josephson junctions with m̊α-Ta electrodes and a m̊ TaOₓ barrier. We grew base and top α-Ta electrodes using seed layer engineering, showing both Nb and m̊ TaNₓ are viable seed layer choices, and particularly emphasize that at room temperature a re-seed layer is required to nucleate m̊α-Ta for the top electrode. However, we note that the choice of seed layer can have subtle implications on the electrical tunneling behavior of the junctions. We used room-temperature probing of variable junction areas, combined with Ambegaokar-Baratoff physics, to characterize the wafer scale critical current densities. For 0.4 μm² junctions, we found junction spreads as low as 2.0% across the 20 x 20 mm chip relevant for device performance. The entire process was carried out using standard industry foundry processing using 150 mm wafer tooling, which is an important step towards proving that Ta-based junctions can be implemented at scale. We have successfully fabricated and tested junctions with m̊α-Ta electrodes and a m̊ TaOₓ insulating tunnel barrier, demonstrating that this is a material platform which merits further investigation and studies for potential application in classical and quantum superconducting technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本工作展示了采用α-Ta电极和TaOₓ势垒的S-I-S约瑟夫森结。研究通过籽晶层工程生长了基底和顶部α-Ta电极，并强调在室温下顶部电极需要再籽晶层才能成核α-Ta。通过Ambegaokar-Baratoff物理学对可变结面积进行室温探测，表征了晶圆级临界电流密度，0.4 μm²结的均匀性低至2.0%。整个工艺采用标准工业晶圆制造流程，证明了钽基结在大规模应用中的潜力。
authors: Trent Borman, Cameron Bullock, Cole Chason, Bradley Christensen, Jonathan Cochran, Emad Din, Evan Donohue, Jason Flagg, A. L. Graninger, Eric Jones, Robert Klaes, Shawn Keebaugh, Erin Kennedy, John Kula, Jason Lapano, Melissa Loving, Christopher Pasco, Devika Pathan, Tam Pham, Timothy Pillsbury, Robert Pownall, Paige Quarterman, Jacob Ruf, Jade Simmons, Nathan Siwak, Joel Strand, Yong Mo Yang

articles.title: Synchronization in one-dimensional arrays of photon condensates
articles.title_zh: 一维光子凝聚体阵列中的同步现象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.04989v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the synchronization of coupled photonic Bose-Einstein condensates in dye-filled microcavity arrays, subject to a potential gradient. We show that in the absence of noise the desynchronisation threshold is the result of a dynamical instability. For a two-site system, we analytically derive the maximal potential difference that allows for a synchronized solution as a function of the system parameters and find that it crucially depends on the thermalization rate. For systems with N sites, we find a N⁻³ power law scaling for the critical potential difference. When quantum fluctuations are included, stochastic phase slips broaden the sharp transitions, yet the phase velocity and first order spatial coherence still reliably identify the instability threshold.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了染料填充微腔阵列中耦合光子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体在势能梯度下的同步现象。结果表明，在无噪声情况下，失同步阈值是由动力学不稳定性引起的。对于两点系统，解析推导了允许同步解的最大势能差，并发现其关键取决于热化速率。对于N点系统，临界势能差呈现N⁻³的幂律标度。量子涨落虽然会使尖锐跃迁变宽，但相速度和一阶空间相干性仍能可靠地识别不稳定性阈值。
authors: Klaas Luyckx, Michiel Yzewyn, Michiel Wouters

articles.title: Evidence for a Dirac Spin Liquid in the Kagome Heisenberg Antiferromagnet from High-Precision Neural-Network Quantum States
articles.title_zh: 基于高精度神经网络量子态的kagome海森堡反铁磁体中狄拉克自旋液体的证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05174v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The spin-1/2 kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet is a central model in the study of quantum spin liquids, yet its ground-state properties remain unresolved. We perform large-scale variational Monte-Carlo calculations using neural-network quantum states (NQSs) with kagome-geometry-aware message-passing convolution on two-dimensional tori containing up to 300 spins, and achieve exceptionally low variational energies for the kagome model. The spin and dimer structure factors show no evidence of magnetic or valence-bond long-range order. Moreover, the dominant symmetry-resolved spin and dimer correlations exhibit a common scaling behavior consistent with the emergent SO(6) monopole multiplet of the Dirac spin liquid. Finally, the fidelity of the optimized NQSs with Gutzwiller-projected mean-field states increasingly favors the Dirac state over the competing Z₂ candidates as the system size grows. Together, these complementary results provide evidence for a U(1) Dirac spin-liquid ground state in the kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究利用神经网络量子态（NQSs）对自旋1/2 kagome海森堡反铁磁体进行了大规模变分蒙特卡洛计算，获得了极低的变分能量。自旋和二聚体结构因子均未显示磁性或价键长程有序的证据。此外，主导的对称分辨自旋和二聚体关联表现出与狄拉克自旋液体中涌现的SO(6)单极多重态一致的共同标度行为。随着系统尺寸的增加，优化后的NQSs与Gutzwiller投影平均场态的保真度越来越倾向于狄拉克态，为kagome海森堡反铁磁体中的U(1)狄拉克自旋液体基态提供了证据。
authors: Zheng-Hang Sun, Christopher Roth, Ao Chen, Markus Heyl

articles.title: A Resonant-Tunneling Quantum-Dot Demultiplexer for Scalable Cryogenic Single-Electron Routing
articles.title_zh: 用于可扩展低温单电子路由的谐振隧穿量子点解复用器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05194v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scaling quantum electronic systems such as quantum-dot spin qubits and single-electron devices is increasingly limited by the wiring overhead between cryogenic devices and room-temperature control electronics. Multi-channel quantum-dot architectures that selectively route electrons using a few shared control lines, analogous to demultiplexers in classical networks, offer a promising solution. Here, we propose and theoretically investigate a gate-defined architecture of three parallel quantum dots sharing a common source reservoir and coupled to independent drain channels. Using an analytical electrostatic model and tight-binding quantum transport simulations, we show that the device can act as an on-chip single-electron demultiplexer based on resonant tunneling in the cryogenic regime. Closed-system eigenstate analysis reveals localized orbital states in each dot, and open-system transport calculations show resonant conductance peaks when these levels align with the incident electron energy, consistent with the closed-system eigenenergy evolution. By engineering the barrier-gate spacing and the relative plunger-gate dimensions, we obtain well-separated resonances with minimal overlap between channels. Bond-current density calculations show that transport is confined to the resonant channel with negligible leakage into neighboring outputs, yielding channel selectivity approaching unity for all resonant modes. The architecture is compatible with Si/SiGe and GaAs/AlGaAs platforms and can be extended to more channels, offering a route toward programmable quantum routing and resonant-tunneling-based quantum circuitry.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究提出并理论研究了一种栅极定义的并行三量子点架构，该架构共享一个公共源极并连接到独立的漏极通道。研究表明，该器件在低温下可作为基于谐振隧穿的片上单电子解复用器。通过分析静电模型和紧束缚量子输运模拟，发现当局部轨道态与入射电子能量对齐时，会出现谐振电导峰。通过设计势垒-栅极间距和相对柱塞-栅极尺寸，可以实现对电子路由的精确控制。

articles.title: Crossover duality for the quantum long-range Ising chain: perturbation theory around the short-range endpoint and a DMRG test
articles.title_zh: 量子长程伊辛链的交叉对偶性：短程端点附近的微扰理论与DMRG检验
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05284v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a weakly coupled description of the long-range transverse-field Ising chain near its short-range crossover at s_*=7/4, where the couplings decay as r⁻¹⁻s. The Ising conformal field theory is coupled to an instantaneous Gaussian field through σḩi, extending the classical long-range Ising duality to quantum chains. The equal-time interaction generates a stress-tensor deformation that causes the velocity to run and renormalizes the dynamical critical exponent z. Conformal perturbation theory gives z=1-0.720,δ+O(δ²⁾, 1/ν=(1+z)/2+O(δ²⁾, and ømega=δ+O(δ²⁾, with δ=s_*-s. DMRG calculations on periodic chains of up to 128 sites provide a consistency test using theoretical inputs for 1/ν and ømega. After accounting for slow finite-size corrections, static and dynamical estimates of z agree, supporting the crossover expansion at s=1.5 and a two-sided Padé interpolation at s=1, 1.25, and 1.5.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究提出了长程横场伊辛链在其短程交叉点s_*=7/4附近的弱耦合描述。该理论将经典长程伊辛对偶性扩展到量子链，其中等时相互作用产生应力张量形变。共形微扰理论给出了动力学临界指数z、1/ν和ω的表达式。对多达128个格点的周期链进行的DMRG计算提供了与理论预测的一致性检验，支持了在s=1.5处的交叉展开以及在s=1、1.25和1.5处的双边Padé插值。
authors: Junchen Rong

articles.title: An Exact QFT/Lattice Map for Fermions
articles.title_zh: 费米子的精确QFT/格点映射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05329v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We construct an exact map between continuum fermion fields and lattice fields in 1+1 dimensions. This map rewrites a continuum Hamiltonian as a lattice Hamiltonian with nearest-neighbor couplings and an infinite-dimensional local Hilbert space. The resulting lattice model reproduces exactly the energy spectrum, global operator algebra, chiral symmetries, and anomalies of the continuum QFT on any finite lattice. Unlike domain wall fermions, truncating the local Hilbert space introduces no extra massless modes, and the entanglement entropy of an interval converges as the truncation is removed. The lattice local algebras are of type I and lie between the type III continuum algebras of nested spatial regions, in accordance with the split property. We demonstrate this construction explicitly for N Majorana fermions, realizing the O(N)_L×O(N)_R lattice chiral symmetry. We also construct an exact lattice model for the Schwinger model and numerically reproduce the mass gap e/sqrtπ.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究构建了1+1维连续费米子场与格点场之间的精确映射，将连续哈密顿量重写为具有最近邻耦合和无限维局部希尔伯特空间的格点哈密顿量。该格点模型在任何有限格点上都能精确重现连续量子场论的能谱、全局算符代数、手征对称性和反常。截断局部希尔伯特空间不会引入额外的无质量模式，且区间纠缠熵随截断的移除而收敛。该方法已在N个马约拉纳费米子和施温格模型中得到明确展示，并数值重现了质量间隙。
authors: Shu-Heng Shao, Nikita Sopenko

articles.title: An Atlas of Classical Pyrochlore Spin Liquids
articles.title_zh: 经典烧绿石自旋液体的图谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2411.03547v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Frustrated magnetism in the pyrochlore lattice magnet has proven to be a most fruitful setting for the experimental and theoretical search for spin liquids. Besides the canonical case of spin ice, recent works have identified a variety of new classical and quantum spin liquids engendered by the generic nearest-neighbor anisotropic spin Hamiltonian for that lattice. However, a general framework for the thorough and systematic classification and characterization of these exotic states of matter has been lacking, as has an exhaustive list of all possible spin liquids that this model can support and, perhaps most interesting, what is the corresponding structure of their emergent field theory description. In this work, we develop such a theoretical framework to identify the interaction parameters stabilizing different classical spin liquids and derive their corresponding effective generalized Gauss's laws at low temperatures. Combining this with Monte Carlo simulations, we systematically identify all classical spin liquids for the general nearest-neighbor anisotropic spin Hamiltonian on the pyrochlore lattice. In doing so, we uncover new spin liquid models with exotic forms of generalized Gauss's law and multipole conservation laws. Our approach allows us to compile an atlas of all spin liquids realized in the phase diagram, providing a global picture of their mutual connections in parameter space and transitions between them. Our work will inform future theoretical and experimental studies of classical and quantum spin liquids on the pyrochlore lattice and help rationalize the exotic properties of pyrochlore magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究针对烧绿石晶格磁体中的受挫磁性，开发了一个理论框架，用于系统分类和表征经典自旋液体，并推导其在低温下的有效广义高斯定律。结合蒙特卡洛模拟，系统地识别了烧绿石晶格上一般最近邻各向异性自旋哈密顿量所支持的所有经典自旋液体，并揭示了新的自旋液体态。该工作为理解这些奇异物质态及其涌现场论描述提供了全面视图。

articles.title: Direction-selective intertwined charge, orbital, and lattice orders under uniaxial strain in hole-doped manganite: La0.75Ca0.25MnO3
articles.title_zh: 空穴掺杂锰氧化物La0.75Ca0.25MnO3中单轴应变下方向选择性交织的电荷、轨道和晶格序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.27979v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The complex interplay of charge, spin, orbital, and lattice degrees of freedom governs emergent phases in quantum materials, making strain a powerful control parameter. Recent advances in free-standing layer techniques have enabled extreme strains of nearly 8%, opening access to novel and often unexpected electronic and magnetic phases. Here, using a density functional theory approach, we investigate the effect of direction-selective uniaxial strain on the prototypical Jahn-Teller system La1-xCaxMnO3 (x = 0.25). We find that different strain directions stabilize qualitatively distinct structural, charge, and orbital responses, rather than merely different strengths of the same phase. In particular, extreme uniaxial strain selectively induces cooperative Jahn-Teller, breathing-like, and site-selective modulations, thereby enabling previously inaccessible intertwined orders in manganites. These results establish direction-selective uniaxial strain as a powerful and selective route for engineering emergent phases in quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子材料中电荷、自旋、轨道和晶格自由度的复杂相互作用决定了其涌现相，而应变是强大的调控参数。本研究利用密度泛函理论方法，探讨了方向选择性单轴应变对原型Jahn-Teller体系La1-xCaxMnO3 (x = 0.25)的影响。结果表明，不同应变方向能稳定定性上不同的结构、电荷和轨道响应，而非仅仅是相同相位的不同强度。特别是，极端单轴应变选择性地诱导了协同Jahn-Teller、呼吸式和位点选择性调制，从而在锰氧化物中实现了以前无法获得的交织序。

articles.title: Plotkin-optimal pure quantum LRCs with large minimum distances from NMDS codes
articles.title_zh: 基于NMDS码的具有大最小距离的Plotkin最优纯量子局部可恢复码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.05335v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum locally recoverable codes (qLRCs) are a class of quantum error-correcting codes that can recover an erased qudit by accessing only a few other qudits. This paper develops a general framework for constructing optimal pure qLRCs that attain the Plotkin-like bound, referred to as Plotkin-optimal pure qLRCs, from Hermitian dual-containing near maximum-distance separable (NMDS) codes. Focusing on a special class of NMDS codes called extended subcodes of generalized Reed-Solomon (ESGRS) codes, we determine their localities by analyzing certain subset sum problems over finite fields. By further exploiting the algebraic structures of ESGRS codes and related codes, we construct four families of Plotkin-optimal pure qLRCs with large lengths and more flexible minimum distances than existing constructions. These constructions provide strong global error-correction capability while retaining local recovery. To the best of our knowledge, they give the first families of qLRCs attaining the pure Plotkin-like bound. In addition, by using the resulting locality property, we resolve in the negative a related problem on ESGRS codes supporting combinatorial designs.

articles.title: QwaveMPS: An efficient open-source Python package for simulating non-Markovian waveguide-QED using matrix product states
articles.title_zh: QwaveMPS：一个用于使用矩阵乘积态模拟非马尔可夫波导-QED的高效开源Python软件包
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2258 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-11-03-2258 QwaveMPS is an open-source Python library for simulating one-dimensional quantum many-body waveguide systems using matrix product states (MPS). It provides a user-friendly interface for constructing, evolving, and analyzing quantum states and operators, facilitating studies in quantum physics and quantum information with waveguide-QED systems. This approach enables efficient, scalable simulations by focusing computational resources on the most relevant parts of the quantum system. Thus, one can study a wide range of complex dynamical interactions, including time-delayed feedback effects in the non-Markovian regime and deeply nonlinear systems, at a highly reduced computational cost compared to full Hilbert space approaches, making it both practical and convenient to model a variety of open waveguide-QED systems (in Markovian and non-Markovian regimes), treating quantized atoms and quantized photons on an equal footing. The QwaveMPS package automates the waveguide-QED-specific tensor-network operations, including construction of the time-bin evolution operator from physical parameters, the swap network required for delayed interactions, orthogonality-center and truncation management, the matrix-product factorization of N-photon Fock-state inputs, and the evaluation of single-time and two-time field observables (such as the second-order quantum correlation function) at chosen points along the waveguide. The code is available at GitHub.
articles.abstract_zh: QwaveMPS是一个开源Python库，用于使用矩阵乘积态（MPS）模拟一维量子多体波导系统。它提供了一个用户友好的界面，用于构建、演化和分析量子态和算符，促进了波导-QED系统在量子物理和量子信息领域的研究。该方法通过将计算资源集中在量子系统最相关的部分，实现了高效、可扩展的模拟。QwaveMPS使得以显著降低的计算成本研究各种复杂的动态相互作用成为可能，包括非马尔可夫机制中的时间延迟反馈效应和深度非线性系统。

articles.title: Optimizing entanglement distillation policies via Markov decision process formulation
articles.title_zh: 通过马尔可夫决策过程公式优化纠缠蒸馏策略
articles.abstract: Entanglement distillation (ED) is a fundamental operation in quantum information processing used to obtain higher-fidelity entangled pairs from a supply of less entangled quantum states using local operations aided by classical communication. In a physically relevant setting, where states with an initial fidelity of , probabilistically generated over multiple, , memory pairs distributed between two parties, Alice and Bob, are pairwise distilled, the optimal policy identifies the system-configuration dependent sequence of entanglement generation and distillation operations that need to be performed in order to minimize the expected time to reach some target fidelity . Here, we formulate and systematically analyze this task as a Markov decision process and using a value iteration algorithm, obtain optimal deterministic policies that minimize the expected waiting time required to achieve a target fidelity. Our results show that the expected waiting time under the optimal policy decreases with increasing generation probability and number of quantum memories —as expected. In contrast, it exhibits non-monotonic behavior with respect to for a fixed fidelity gap, . While the optimal policy consistently outperforms baseline policies such as the greedy, nested and entanglement pumping policies, its relative advantage is regime-dependent, being determined by the system parameters ( ), and exhibits a nontrivial dependence on the fidelity gap . Our results highlight the value of formulating ED as a Markov decision problem, enabling the systematic design of policies that achieve target fidelity thresholds for quantum information tasks in realistic resource-constrained settings.
articles.abstract_zh: 纠缠蒸馏（ED）是量子信息处理中的一项基本操作，用于从低纠缠量子态中获取更高保真度的纠缠对。本研究将纠缠蒸馏任务公式化为一个马尔可夫决策过程，并利用值迭代算法获得了最优确定性策略，以最小化达到目标保真度所需的预期等待时间。结果表明，在最优策略下，预期等待时间随生成概率和量子存储器数量的增加而减少，但对于固定的保真度差距，其行为呈现非单调性。
authors: Jigyen Bhavsar, Rajni Bala and Siddhartha Santra

articles.title: Quantum simulation of real-time Yukawa dynamics with qubits and qumodes
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00201v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Real-time quantum simulation of field theories offers access to scattering and decay dynamics, circumventing the limitations of Euclidean lattice methods. However, representing bosonic fields on qubits requires a finite-dimensional approximation and can entail costly multi-qubit operations. Hybrid qubit-qumode architectures avoid this by encoding bosonic fields directly in oscillators. We formulate scattering in the (1+1)-dimensional Yukawa theory for such a device, with staggered fermions on qubits and the scalar on qumodes. Trapped ions are a natural candidate, with the fermions on the internal states of the ions and the scalar on their collective motion, so that the Yukawa coupling becomes a native spin-dependent displacement. Emulating the device with tensor networks, we study the decay of a single scalar particle and fermion-antifermion scattering around the resonance region, using observables that can be measured on the device natively. We compare the results with those obtained using lattice perturbation theory. The emulation is able to resolve corrections beyond the Dyson summation of the one-loop self-energy.
authors: Jack Y. Araz, Jeffrey Forshaw, Ross Jenkinson

articles.title: Exhaustive Construction of Generalized Parent Hamiltonians for Matrix Product States
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00203v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Characterizing local Hamiltonians that host interesting many-body states as eigenstates has been an important problem in quantum many-body physics. For matrix product states (MPS), there is a well-known construction of parent Hamiltonians that have the MPS as the frustration-free ground state. However, recent results on quantum many-body scars have shown that such a construction does not exhaust all possible Hamiltonians that have the MPS as an eigenstate. In this work, we develop an exhaustive construction of generalized parent Hamiltonians that have a given translation-invariant MPS as an eigenstate. These go beyond the conventional projector-based construction of frustration-free parent Hamiltonians, where each local Hermitian term has the MPS as an eigenstate, by allowing non-Hermitian telescoping terms that cancel out with periodic boundary conditions (PBC). We derive a local tensor equation that establishes a correspondence between inequivalent classes of generalized parent Hamiltonians, i.e., those that cannot be related using linear combinations with frustration-free Hamiltonians, and the MPS transfer matrix spectrum. We illustrate the connection to intrinsic physical properties, including non-Abelian symmetries and zero correlation length, and further extend this construction to block-injective MPS. Our framework hence provides a systematic bridge between generalized parent Hamiltonians and the local structure of quantum states.
authors: He-Ran Wang, Lorenzo Gotta, Sanjay Moudgalya

articles.title: The exact information cost of randomized measurements in quantum metrology
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00599v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Randomized measurements provide state-independent readout for multiparameter quantum sensing. Although 3-designs retain a constant fraction of the quantum Fisher information (QFI) for every pure state, we show that 2-designs need not. In dimension (d), complete mutually unbiased bases (MUBs) retain exactly (1/(d+1)) of the QFI in the worst state and direction, attaining the universal lower bound for 2-designs built from orthonormal bases; symmetric informationally complete (SIC) measurements retain exactly ((1-1/sqrtd+1)/d). The loss comes from aligned blind spots. Relative to a basis, pure-state changes split into population and phase parts of equal dimension, but probabilities respond only to the former. Mutual unbiasedness turns a population change for one basis into a phase change for every other. The worst case already occurs for a qubit encoded in two levels. Independent random bases instead scatter their blind spots. In sufficiently large dimensions, five Haar-random bases retain, with high probability, a dimension-independent QFI fraction for every pure state and direction. Random Clifford measurements on any number of qubits retain exactly one third. Thus blind-spot geometry, not second-order symmetry alone, controls worst-case metrological performance.
authors: Wanqing Li, Jiaxin Liu

articles.title: Iterative Quantum Optimization: From Greedy Reductions to Branch-and-Bound
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00678v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Iterative quantum optimization (IQO) uses quantum-generated information to select a sequence of classical problem reductions. We introduce Bound-Aware Tree-IQO which combines this iterative structure with bounds and reversible search. Feasible measured samples update a shared incumbent, while valid classical bounds prune branches that cannot improve it. Incorporating backtracking yields an anytime method that returns the best feasible solution found when interrupted, or can be run as a complete search to return and certify the optimum. For suitable single-variable or pairwise reductions, an initial IQO path can determine the branching schedule without further quantum calls, though certifying the optimum may take superpolynomial classical time. To motivate our framework, we prove two limitations of irreversible IQO reductions based on the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA). We show an infinite family of unweighted MaxCut instances on which globally optimized level-1 QAOA makes standard Recursive QAOA strictly prefer a first reduction that excludes every optimal solution, and limits that branch to an approximation ratio of at most 2/3+o(1). In contrast, a single backtrack recovers an optimal solution using the same quantum information. Causal cone arguments give a complementary obstruction at every fixed depth of standard QAOA: a weighted MaxCut instance is shown to contain two edges with identical two-qubit reduced states, even though every optimum requires opposite edge parities. MaxCut experiments show that QAOA-guided ordering is nonrandom in exact-certification tests through n=28, while demonstrating that quantum samples can strengthen the incumbent and enable further pruning. Our results suggest that quantum data could provide useful guidance toward solving hard combinatorial optimization problems more effectively than either quantum or classical algorithms alone.
authors: Stuart Hadfield, Lucas T. Braydwood, Eleanor Rieffel

articles.title: Photon-loss tolerance of the surface-GKP code with anti-photon-loss decoding
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00694v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photon loss somewhat limits fault-tolerant photonic quantum computing. We investigate its effect on finite-energy Gottesman--Kitaev--Preskill (GKP) states by modeling the pure-loss channel directly. We obtain photon-loss threshold estimates for the surface-GKP code using nearest-lattice-point inner GKP decoding and minimum-weight perfect matching for the outer surface code. For GKP states with ϵ=0.01 and ϵ=0.05, corresponding to GKP squeezing of 20 and 13,dB, the estimated thresholds are γ^ast=5.5% (0.24,dB) and γ^ast=5.9% (0.26,dB), respectively. We then introduce an anti-photon-loss inner decoder that compensates for the contraction of the measured quadrature. It increases the corresponding threshold estimates to γ^ast=9.8% (0.45,dB) and γ^ast=6.3% (0.28,dB). Our results highlight the importance of accounting for loss-induced lattice contraction in inner decoding and demonstrate that quadrature compensation enhances the photon-loss tolerance of surface-GKP codes for both high- and moderate-quality GKP states, providing a route toward more photon-loss-robust optical quantum computing.
authors: Guan-Ju Yan, Pei-Lin Du, Ke-Min Hu, Jun-Jie He, Yu-Ze Zhu, Xing-Yu Chen, Lin Yang, An-Bang Wu, Hao Tang, Xian-Min Jin

articles.title: Quantum algorithm for weakly correlated molecular electronic ground states with sub-quintic scaling in the system size
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00751v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Weakly correlated electronic structures are predominant among molecules, and are routinely solved with heuristic classical methods such as the ``gold standard'' CCSD(T) coupled cluster model, incurring a formal time complexity O(n⁷⁾ in the number of molecular orbitals and with no guarantee of energy error ǎrepsilon at or below chemical accuracy. In this work, a quantum algorithm is presented for ground state energy estimation of weakly correlated molecules using Trotterized time evolution, with an end-to-end quantum operations cost that scales as tildeO(n⁴.⁸/ǎrepsilon²⁾ in the limit of high-order product formulae when run as a low-depth, shot-noise limited algorithm, or tildeO(n⁴.⁸ + n³.⁸/ǎrepsilon) when scaling the simulation time Tpropto 1/ǎrepsilon. The algorithm combines adiabatic state preparation using a smoothed Gevrey schedule with eigenstate filtering via quantum prolate diagonalization (QPD). Both steps of the algorithm rely on a size-independent spectral gap assumption, which is validated by numerical studies on alanine chains with up to 64 monomers. We benchmark the performance of our eigenstate filtering algorithm on a set of 28 molecules to compare our approach against prior phase estimation algorithms, finding that QPD achieves state-of-the-art cost tradeoffs for ǎrepsilon-accurate results. Physical quantum resource estimates are obtained for running Trotter step circuits with up to 40 spin-orbitals, providing a clear path for scaling up quantum simulation of chemistry on early fault-tolerant hardware.
authors: Oskar Leimkuhler, Marvin Kronenberger, Davide Castaldo, Timothy Stroschein, Srushti Patil, Rebecca Tomann, Arta Safari, Marek Miller, Gemma C. Solomon, Matthias Christandl, Markus Reiher

articles.title: Leaving Quantum Bias on the Table: Pushforwards as a Path to Quantum Advantage in Constrained Optimization
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00759v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Constrained quantum samplers often produce infeasible outputs that retain information about good feasible solutions. We develop a post-measurement framework that constructs problem-dependent classical feasibility maps from constraint-violation statistics and pushes the raw quantum sampling law forward onto the feasible set. The probability of each repaired solution is the total raw mass of its repair preimage, enlarging the successful sampling event from a target feasible set to its full repair preimage. We derive exact identities for repaired success and expected cost, and separate repair-basin geometry from sampler-dependent probability concentration. For noisy implementations, we distinguish leakage from the encoded subspace from concentration loss within it. For permutation constraints, Hungarian maximum-overlap repair provides an O(n³⁾ implementation, which we study on traveling-salesman problems (TSP). We derive conditional repaired-success bounds and quantify how basin aggregation reduces the absolute-transfer budget required by these bounds. Noiseless simulations show that optimal repair basins contain selectively overweighted infeasible contributors. For an n=10 TSP instance, pushforward repair recovered the optimum using approximately 10³ shots, compared with 10⁶ shots in the original CE-QAOA workflow without repair. On a 127-qubit IBM processor, using encodings of up to 100 qubits, repaired candidates match reference tours on smaller benchmarks and improve them on larger instances. These results establish concentration of quantum probability on useful repair preimages as a design principle for constrained quantum optimization.
authors: Chinonso Onah, Stuart Hadfield, Kristel Michielsen

articles.title: Where Does a Variational Quantum Classifier Lose Accuracy? Angle Encoding, Readout and the Fidelity-Kernel Reference in Cyberattack Detection
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00885v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When a variational quantum classifier performs poorly at detecting network attacks, it is hard to tell which part is to blame: the encoding, the trained circuit or the readout, which turns measurements into a class. In this work, we build upon a recent amplitude-encoded classifier, and we try to separate their contributions to the NSL-KDD benchmark in noiseless simulation. We compare angle and amplitude encoding, vary one component at a time, and measure each circuit against a classical yardstick: a support-vector machine on the encoded states, whose accuracy estimates what a well-trained circuit can reach. Most of the shortfall lies in the readout. Reading one qubit, or the parity of all qubits, leaves several percentage points unused, while a readout trained together with the circuit recovers most of them from the same measurements. This also explains why some classifiers stop improving as further layers are added. The encodings suit different needs. Angle encoding gives the more accurate detector on traffic like the training data and, from eight features up, shallower circuits; amplitude encoding needs far fewer qubits and catches more attacks of types never seen in training. Finally, we report that classical models, given the same inputs, are about as accurate as the best circuits, thus, registering no quantum advantage.
authors: Angelos Thomos, Theodore Andronikos

articles.title: Multiparameter quantum metrology for general and adaptive strategies
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01027v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a conic-programming framework for multiparameter estimation of quantum processes under different classes of sensing strategies. Estimation precision depends on the choice of input probe state and measurement and, when a channel is used multiple times, on the arrangement of channel uses and intermediate controls. We specify different strategy classes through linear normalization constraints on generalized measurements, and formulate the local estimation problem using linear constraints and a linear objective function. We show that the separable-cone program gives the exact precision limit under the local estimation conditions considered here, while cone relaxations yield Cramér-Rao-type lower bounds. For N uses of an identical quantum channel, we prove an exact 1/N scaling law for an RLD-based positive-cone lower bound, even for general process-matrix testers that allow indefinite causal order. Under the stated conditions on the channel and its parameter dependence, the minimum weighted mean-square error also scales as 1/N. This extends an RLD-based restriction on Heisenberg scaling from adaptive strategies to this broader class. For fixed-order adaptive strategies, we show that each process-side conic bound equals the corresponding state-estimation bound optimized over sensor combs. We establish this equality by constructing a sensor comb from the process-side normalization operator. A noisy three-parameter field-sensing model illustrates the framework.
authors: Masahito Hayashi, Yingkai Ouyang

articles.title: Optimally Weighted Constrained Shadow Tomography for Reduced Density Matrices
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01079v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate measurement of reduced density matrices (RDMs) is central to quantum simulations of many-fermion systems, but the required measurement resources remain a significant challenge. Constrained shadow tomography (CST) combines randomized measurements with N-representability conditions to reconstruct physically valid RDMs from limited measurement data. Here we improve CST by orthogonalizing the measurement constraints and using the resulting singular values to determine the relative weight of each independent measurement direction according to how strongly it is sampled by the quantum computer. These optimally weighted constraints are incorporated into the semidefinite program through a least-squares objective implemented with a Schur-complement relaxation. We demonstrate the approach for hydrogen chains on a quantum simulator and for azobenzene on a quantum processor. In both cases, optimally weighted CST systematically improves the accuracy of the reconstructed 2-RDM without increasing the measurement budget, providing a more measurement-efficient approach to partial tomography for quantum simulations of correlated fermions.
authors: Yuchen Wang, Irma Avdic, Michael Rose, Lillian I. Payne, Noah Garrett, Madhubani Mukherjee, Leah P. Weisburn, Nate Earnest-Noble, Kevin J. Sung, David A. Mazziotti

articles.title: Near-Optimal Learning of Quantum Many-Body Systems from Gibbs and Thermal Metastable States via the Stationarity Test
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01520v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the problem of learning a finite-range quantum Hamiltonian on an n-qubit D-dimensional lattice from copies of its Gibbs states at a known inverse temperature β or its thermal metastable states. Existing efficient algorithms at arbitrary temperature have sample guarantees with an epoly⁽β⁾ dependence, leaving open whether the exponent can be made linear in β. We achieve this improvement: for βge1, our algorithm learns all Hamiltonian coefficients to ellᵢₙfty-error ϵ with probability at least 1-δ using tObigl(eO⁽β⁾ϵ⁻²łog(n/δ)bigr) copies and total time tObigl(n eO⁽β⁾ϵ⁻²łog(n/δ)bigr). The measurements act on individual copies and are supported on balls of radius Obigl(β²⁺βłog(1/ϵ)bigr). Our sample complexity achieves the optimal exponential order in β, with optimal ϵ⁻² dependence up to logarithmic factors. Building on the stationarity-test framework i̧tepBergamaschi2026Stationarity, we prove a unified Fisher-information coercivity bound showing that errors in the candidate Hamiltonian produce a detectable signal with only an e⁻O⁽β⁾ loss in sensitivity. The key is a smooth frequency filter whose bandwidth remains independent of temperature, together with sharper estimates relating this signal to the Hamiltonian coefficients. For thermal metastable states, the guarantee holds under local drift ζłe e⁻Cβ²D⁺¹, for a geometry-dependent constant C>0, and above an accuracy floor tO(eO⁽β⁾ζ). The argument applies to both Gibbs and thermal metastable states and, combined with local measurements and projected stochastic gradient descent (SGD), yields both learning guarantees.
authors: Tai Hsuan Yang

articles.title: From Ghost SICs to SIC-POVMs: A Galois Reduction of Zauner's Conjecture
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01524v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Symmetric informationally complete positive operator-valued measures (SIC-POVMs, or SICs) are optimal minimal measurements for quantum state tomography. Problem~1 of Horodecki, Rudnicki and Życzkowski's open problems in quantum information asks for SICs in infinitely many dimensions.
