These structural and chemical changes result in a 25% increase in the superconducting transition temperature and a significant narrowing of the transition width. Annealing also reduced the sheet resistance and the estimated sheet kinetic inductance, increased the residual resistance ratio, and improved the magnetic-field tolerance. Together, the structural, chemical, and transport results are consistent with reduced material disorder and improved superconducting uniformity. Because RTA is a relatively low thermal budget and is a semiconductor fabrication compatible process, it offers a practical route to improve the quality of ALD-grown TiN for superconducting applications.
authors: Z. Sadirkhanov, A. Tuigynbek, M. Surendran, A. Jakyp, L. Akisheva, A. T. Hammack, A. B. Tikhonov, A. Kemelbay

articles.title: Machine Learning Aided Computational Discovery of Boride Substrates for Borophene Synthesis
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00533v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Borophene, a monolayer of boron, is distinctive among two-dimensional materials owing to its unique properties, including polymorphism and potential applications in quantum technologies and energy conversion and storage. Nevertheless, its applications are hindered by the strong binding of borophene to metal substrates, which impedes the realization of freestanding borophene. Alternative substrates with tunable binding to borophene are therefore highly desirable. Since boride layers arise during borophene synthesis on metals, borides provide potential alternative substrates for borophene synthesis. In this work, we investigate the binding energies and interactions between borophene and 1356 boride surfaces for two borophene phases (v1/6 and v1/9), using density functional theory (DFT) calculations and machine learning (ML). Importantly, incorporating ML-predicted charge transfer as an input feature to a subsequent ML model enables physics-informed predictions of binding energies. Additional DFT calculations on four representative cases were performed to validate the ML predictions. SHAP analysis reveals that the majority of key descriptors are associated with delocalized electrons, highlighting the role of electronic properties in governing binding strength. Combined DFT and ML screening identifies 65 and 73 promising boride surfaces for the v1/6 and v1/9 phases, respectively. Al- and Ag-based borides, including AlB2 and AgB2, emerge as predominant candidates for both phases. The computationally predicted candidate substrates and the deduced design guidelines provide a charge-transfer-informed ML strategy for substrate selection and represent promising steps toward the experimental realization of freestanding borophene.
authors: Luqing Wang, Qunfei Zhou, Qiucheng Li, Venkata Surya Chaitanya Kolluru, Hui Li, Albert Tsui, Joshua Paul, Pierre Darancet, Mark C. Hersam, Maria K. Y. Chan

articles.title: Quantized valley source in bilayer graphene via adiabatic quantum pumping
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00733v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a quantized valley source based on adiabatic quantum pumping in bilayer graphene in the presence of both quantum spin Hall and quantum valley Hall effects. By periodically modulating the gate voltages of two quantum dots coupled to a bilayer graphene nanoribbon, the helical edge states enable the generation of a pure valley current. Depending on the geometry of quantum dots, the number of emitted valley pairs either forms quantized plateaus or varies continuously with the pumping amplitude. The quantized plateau structure can be tuned by the static gate voltage and by the coupling between the quantum dots and the ribbon. Quantized valley pairs are robust against Anderson disorder applied in the quantum dots and persist for both zigzag and armchair quantum-dot boundaries. These results demonstrate that adiabatic quantum pumping provides a route toward electrically controllable quantized valley sources.
authors: Kai-Tong Wang, Lei Zhang, Bin Wang, Yunjin Yu, Fuming Xu

articles.title: Melting noncoplanar order on the square-kagome lattice: Chiral, flat-band, and staggered spin liquids from projective symmetry
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00987v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Noncoplanar magnetic orders carry a scalar spin chirality, and their melting by quantum fluctuations has been proposed as a route to chiral spin liquids. We ask what this route can produce on the square-kagome lattice, where couplings across the octagons stabilize noncoplanar cuboc and conical orders. We classify the fermionic spin liquids of this lattice by their projective symmetry groups, identify the symmetry class into which each noncoplanar order would melt, and compare candidate states with Gutzwiller-projected wave functions. A magnetic selection rule constrains the route: the chirality of every cuboc and conical order alternates in space, so a liquid that keeps the symmetry of its parent order has zero Chern number and no spontaneous thermal Hall response. A Chern state can descend only from uniformly chiral orders, and the regular ones we find need ferromagnetic bow-tie couplings. The energetics do not favor a chiral liquid either: among the projected wave functions we compare, a cuboc1-ordered state is lowest for strong cross-octagon couplings, and nonchiral states, a valence-bond crystal or a time-reversal-symmetric liquid, for weaker ones. The two inequivalent site orbits shape the spinons: a relative time-reversal sign between them pins flat bands to the Fermi level, and because the translations of p4mm are not commutators, staggered chiral liquids exist, which are absent on sixfold-symmetric lattices.
authors: Harsh Raj, Atanu Maity, Yasir Iqbal

articles.title: Excited-state-induced nonlinearity and polarity reversals in the thermocurrent through a quantum dot
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01006v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum dots are electrically tuneable thermal machines capable of both energy harvesting and cooling at the nanoscale in the cryogenic regime. At large thermal biases, their thermoelectric transport shows a complex behaviour, including additional extrema and polarity reversals in the thermocurrent. Though these asymmetries and nonlinearities directly affect rectification and power conversion, their origin has not been studied systematically. We address this through measurements and modelling of a single GaAs/AlGaAs quantum dot whose source is heated by white-noise excitation. Using Pauli master equation for sequential tunnelling through a two-level dot, retaining the full Fermi distributions of both leads, distinct tunnel rates for the two levels, and relaxation between them, we show that the excited state acts as a second transport channel which competes with the ground-state contribution. Strong excited-state coupling combined with slow relaxation produces polarity reversals in the thermocurrent; without both, the excited state yields only additional extrema and an amplitude asymmetry across the charge degeneracy point. Experimentally, as the source temperature increases, an additional extremum emerges in the thermocurrent which develops into a polarity reversal. Using the excited-state level spacing and ground-state tunnel rate obtained independently from pulsed-gate and bias spectroscopies, the model reproduces the positions of the observed extrema and their amplitudes to within a factor of about three, placing the device in the regime of slow relaxation and strong excited-state coupling. Our results establish thermocurrent line-shape as a probe of excited-state tunnelling and relaxation in quantum dots. Excited states, often treated as a minor correction, can dominate quantum-dot thermoelectric transport far from equilibrium.
authors: Parvathy Gireesan, Giorgio Biasiol, Madhu Thalakulam

articles.title: Anomalous response, re-emerging localization-transition and robust corner sates in self-similar peano fractal
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01099v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Anomalous spectral response from the non-interacting electrons on a peano fractal is recorded within tight-binding framework. It is observed that a minimal off-diagonal anisotropy can modulate the transport characteristics of the lattice. Drastic modification in the nature of the eigenstates has been validated through the workout of level spacing statistics. Further, a two-dimensional quasiperiodic Aubry-André and Harper variation in the overlap integral can invite re-entrant localization-delocalization transition for the self-similar model. This is associated with the possible existence of single-particle mobility edge in the energy landscape. Our results are corroborated by the evaluation of inverse participation ratio, fractal dimension and quantum dynamical response. The spectrum is shown to formulate a quantum butterfly pattern with the frequency of the modulation. Chiral symmetry protected edge states are found to be insensitive with respect to moderate diagonal disorder.
authors: Rhiddha Acharjee (Department of Physics, University of Calcutta, 92, Acharya Prafulla Chandra Road, Kolkata, West Bengal-700009, India), Sayan Bhattacharya (Department of Physics, Acharya Prafulla Chandra College, New Barrackpore, Kolkata, West Bengal-700131, India), Atanu Nandy (Department of Physics, Acharya Prafulla Chandra College, New Barrackpore, Kolkata, West Bengal-700131, India), Debnarayan Jana (Department of Physics, University of Calcutta, 92, Acharya Prafulla Chandra Road, Kolkata, West Bengal-700009, India)

articles.title: Visualizing Anisotropic Charge Transport in CrSBr using Bias-Dependent Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01217v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Anisotropic semiconductors offer unique opportunities for next-generation electronics due to their direction-dependent transport. However, conventional electrical measurements provide only spatially averaged characteristics. Here, we employ bias-dependent Kelvin probe force microscopy (KPFM) to directly visualize the response of CrSBr under different electrical bias configurations. Spatially resolved KPFM maps reveal highly distinct, crystallographic-direction-dependent potential profiles. To elucidate this behavior, we employ anisotropic transport simulations that capture the charge transport and electric-field distributions in CrSBr. The close agreement between experiment and simulation provides a unified picture of anisotropic charge transport and bias-induced potential redistribution. Our experiments further reveal a boundary-associated redistribution of the transport field when bias is applied along the a-axis, suggesting a possible role of crystal boundaries in charge transport along the low-conductivity direction. This work establishes bias-dependent KPFM as a powerful platform for uncovering localized transport phenomena in low-symmetry quantum materials.
authors: Satyam Sahu, Arijit Kayal, Bing Wu, Aljoscha Söll, Zdeněk Sofer, Matěj Velický, Otakar Frank

articles.title: Asymmetric Little--Parks Oscillations as a Probe of Coupled Pairing Channels in Surface-Superconducting texorpdfstringPtBi₂PtBi2
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01764v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by the recent discovery of unconventional surface superconductivity in PtBi₂, we theoretically study its signatures in the Little-Parks oscillations of a narrow ring made from the same material. Using a Ginzburg-Landau model with three coupled pairing channels allowed by the trigonal crystal symmetry, we show that a fixed in-plane magnetic field can make the mean-field transition temperature asymmetric under reversal of the normal flux through the ring, while preserving periodicity in the superconducting flux quantum. The leading weak-field contribution to this asymmetry is cubic in the in-plane field strength. The flux-odd component respects the threefold crystal symmetry and changes sign when the in-plane field is rotated by π/3 at fixed magnitude. Within the homogeneous ring model, this asymmetry is absent for a single pairing channel and arises from the coupling between the three channels. Our calculations further show that increasing the in-plane magnetic field can enhance the superconducting nucleation temperature through mixing of pairing channels, illustrating magnetic control of multicomponent superconductivity in mesoscopic rings. Little-Parks interferometry with independent control of flux and field direction thus offers a mesoscopic probe of the pairing state, complementary to spectroscopic studies of the gap structure.
authors: Yuriy Yerin, Stefan-Ludwig Drechsler, Carsten Timm, Jeroen van den Brink

articles.title: Fractional quantum Hall effect at ν=1/2 in wide GaAs quantum wells: Subband structure, exact diagonalization, and the magnitude of the gap
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01885v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent experiments on a wide GaAs quantum well report a fractional quantum Hall state at filling factor ν=1/2 with an unusually large activation gap, a sharp maximum of the gap as a function of density, and a possible transition from the non-Abelian Moore-Read Pfaffian to the Abelian Halperin 331 state. We analyze this system theoretically, with self-consistent subband calculations, exact diagonalization, and a reanalysis of the published transport data. We find that the well has two relevant subbands, that with the second subband frozen out the well most likely has no incompressible state at ν=1/2, that a strict bilayer at the maxima of the charge density does not produce 331, and that an active second subband is essential: the ground state is a paired state of electrons in both subbands, on a continuous path between the Pfaffian and 331, with a neutral gap much larger than that of a one-subband Pfaffian. The position of the state on this path is controlled by electrostatic energies that the accessible system sizes contain only in part, and the standard overlaps do not identify the state at these sizes. Our results are more consistent with a Pfaffian-like state than with 331, but they are not definitive. The transport data do not support the reported magnitude of the gap; the gap we extract is smaller and comparable to the calculated two-subband neutral gap. A benchmark calculation for the Laughlin state at ν=1/3 in the same well provides an experimental test of the electrostatic treatment.
authors: Sankar Das Sarma

articles.title: Symmetry-Based Transport Criterion and Robust Design for RuO₂₋ₜype Altermagnets
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01944v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnetism combines vanishing net magnetization with momentum-dependent spin splitting, enabling spin-transport functionalities without ferromagnetism. Although rutile RuO₂ has been proposed as a d-wave altermagnet, its magnetic ground state remains highly controversial. Moreover, existing transport verifications suffer from severe ambiguity due to the entanglement of spin-splitting effects and time-reversal-even spin-Hall contributions. Here, we introduce a two-pronged strategy to break the current verification impasse. First, we establish a definitive, symmetry-based transport criterion: by identifying specific crystallographic geometries where the spin-Hall background is strictly forbidden, we provide a zero-background window for unambiguous altermagnetic detection. Concurrently, to bypass the uncertain bulk energetics, we propose the RuO₂/MnO₂ superlattice as a prototypical platform to robustly enforce the d-wave altermagnetic order via interfacial magnetic proximity. Within this platform, symmetry-resolved spin-transport analysis reveals unconventional responses, including collinear spin currents enabling field-free magnetization switching and sizable spin-polarized charge currents. By combining a universal transport criterion with a robustly engineered material platform, our work transcends the debates over bulk properties, providing an actionable, definitive experimental roadmap for verifying d-wave altermagnetism.
authors: Zhaoqing Li, Yi Liu, Yizheng Wu, Zhe Yuan

articles.title: Trapping photo-carriers in undoped gate-defined quantum dots using an on-chip microwave resonator for charge readout
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02050v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scaling up gate-defined quantum dot systems is hindered by the rapid growth in the number of control gates. To tackle this challenge, we propose a different approach where the quantum dots are created from optically generated charges trapped beneath accumulation gates. By shining an above-the-gap laser light onto an undoped GaAs substrate, we demonstrate that it is possible to create and separate electron-hole pairs to form quantum dots. For the charge readout, we use a superconducting coplanar waveguide resonator capacitively coupled to the quantum dots. With these elements, we demonstrate a working many-charge double quantum dot device comprised of only two plunger gates, one tunnel coupling gate and one sensing gate. With our approach, we show that populating quantum dots does not require engineered reservoirs, source/drain bias, ohmic contacts, or in-situ doping. As a result, the number of gates can be kept minimal and the fabrication process can be simplified. Moreover, this approach can be applied to a wide range of direct-bandgap semiconductor quantum dot systems. This hybrid device demonstration is a first step towards a different scalability approach for quantum dot arrays.
authors: Pierre Lefloïc, Zhiren Wang, Yasmine Faraj, Harshana Runjeet, Michel Pioro-Ladrière, Alicia Kam, Louis Gaudreau, Mathieu Juan

articles.title: Lattice-Induced Splitting, Connectivity, and Topology of Anyon Bands
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02268v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fractional Chern insulators realize fractional quantum Hall states without external magnetic fields, while their underlying lattice periodicity allows otherwise dispersionless anyons to acquire finite bandwidth. Here we show that flux--lattice commensurability can also give rise to multiple anyon bands with nontrivial topology and symmetry-protected connectivity. In multiband vortexable systems, commensurability between the lattice periodicity and the effective magnetic unit cell of fractionally charged quasiholes leads to the folding of a quasihole Landau level into multiple bands. Interactions lift their degeneracy, producing dispersive bands with Chern numbers distinct from that of the parent quasihole Landau level. We further demonstrate that these Chern numbers can be redistributed through Dirac crossings under continuous deformations that preserve exact electronic flatness, while crystalline symmetries can enforce protected band touchings. Our results establish that fractionalized excitations can exhibit the rich band topology familiar from electronic Bloch bands, opening possibilities for nontrivial anyon dynamics beyond conventional Landau-level physics.
authors: Siddhartha Sarkar, Xiaohan Wan

articles.title: Imaging the Current Distribution in Superconducting Transition-Edge Sensors with Scanning SQUID Microscopy
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02352v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transition-edge sensors (TESs) exploit the resistive transition of a superconductor to detect minute changes in temperature. While significant progress has been made in understanding the temperature- and current-dependent resistive transition in these devices, important aspects of TES behavior under bias remain unresolved. In particular, existing TES models largely neglect spatial variations in the superconducting state and current distribution arising from device geometry and proximity effects associated with the superconducting leads and normal metal features. Using scanning superconducting quantum interference device (SQUID) microscopy (SSM), we directly image local superconducting properties and transport current in two molybdenum-gold (MoAu) X-ray TES designs. We measure the local diamagnetic response to identify superconducting regions in devices voltage-biased within the transition and the Oersted field generated by the transport current to reconstruct the corresponding current distribution. We observe bias-dependent reconfigurations of the current distribution that track current-induced changes in superconducting regions, highlighting the importance of mesoscale spatial variations for TES device physics, operation, and design.
authors: Samantha Walker, Austin Kaczmarek, Douglas A. Bennett, Jason E. Austermann, W. Bertrand Doriese, Shannon M. Duff, Johannes Hubmayr, Kelsey M. Morgan, Daniel R. Schmidt, Daniel S. Swetz, Joel N. Ullom, Joel Weber, Michael D. Niemack, Katja C. Nowack

articles.title: Competing interaction driven broad magnetic entropy distribution in triangular net compounds Ba₃RE(BO₃₎₃, RE= Dy and Ho
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02703v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Triangular magnetic lattices have attracted significant attention as a model platform for exploring frustrated magnetism and quantum spin liquids, particularly in rare-earth-based systems. These materials also hold considerable promise for cryogenic magnetic refrigeration. In this work, we investigate the magnetic and magnetocaloric properties of the rare-earth (RE) based compounds Ba₃RE(BO₃₎₃ (RE = Dy and Ho). Polycrystalline samples synthesized via a solid-state reaction method crystallize in a hexagonal structure with the space group P6₃ₘc, featuring triangular nets separated by approximately 8.8~Å along the c-axis. Detailed magnetic investigation reveals a deviation from pure paramagnetic behavior at low temperatures (T < 20 K). This is further corroborated by isothermal magnetization measurements, which exhibit non-overlapping M vs. H/T plots and reduced magnetization moments, suggesting significant crystal electric field (CEF) splitting of localized f-states. For an applied magnetic field change of 70 kOe, the maximum entropy change (Relative Cooling Power) reaches 4.2 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹ (204 J kg⁻¹) and 7.3 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹ (230 J kg⁻¹) for the Dy- and Ho-based compounds, respectively. Overall, the positive slopes of Arrott plots, the universal scaling behaviour of Δ Sₘ/Δ Sₘmax versus reduced temperature (t), and the field exponent c of the RCP versus H curves indicate a second-order nature of entropy distribution, making them promising candidates for magnetocalorics in the millikelvin range.
authors: Krishna Nand Prajapati, Prabuddha Kant Mishra, Shashi B Singh

articles.title: Superinsulation, electric confinement in condensed matter
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.02841v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superinsulation is the confining phase of condensed matter systems. It is a genuine quantum state of matter, dual to superconductivity, just as confinement in particle physics is dual to the Higgs phase. In contrast to hadron physics, the gauge field that becomes confining is not colour SU(3) but the conventional U(1) electromagnetic field. Superinsulation arises in superconductors with an emergent granular condensate when core-less XY vortices between condensate grains become tensionless, unobservable Dirac strings and magnetic monopoles are liberated and condense. This magnetic condensate confines electric fields into flux tubes, strings that generate a linear potential between Cooper pairs. These dual Abrikosov flux tubes give rise to infinite electrical resistance, persisting up to a finite deconfinement temperature. We shall review the theoretical framework of superinsulation together with its experimental validation, including the direct observation of the linear confining potential and we shall stress how phase-only approaches and disorder-based ideas for the phases around the superconductor-to-insulator transition are hard to reconcile with recent experimental observations.
authors: M. Cristina Diamantini, Carlo A. Trugenberger

articles.title: Exact fermionic matrix elements from the Bethe-ansatz solution of the Richardson-Gaudin model
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03141v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce an effective Hamiltonian description of mesoscopic superconducting systems based on the Bethe-ansatz solution of the Richardson--Gaudin model. Our central result is a compact determinant formula for the matrix elements of fermionic creation and annihilation operators, expressed entirely in terms of eigenvalue-based variables. This formula allows single-electron tunneling terms to be represented directly in the eigenbasis of the Richardson--Gaudin model, extending the eigenvalue-based framework beyond overlaps and previously known form factors. As a benchmark, we apply the method to a superconducting Anderson impurity model comprising a quantum dot coupled to an ultrasmall superconducting grain. The resulting low-energy description, formulated naturally in the canonical ensemble, captures even-odd effects, subgap excitations, and quantum-dot physics. The same framework gives access to observables not previously computed for such grain-dot systems in the canonical ensemble, such as the fixed-particle-number optical conductivity and flux-tunable spectra.
authors: Peter D. Johannsen, Valerii K. Kozin, Jelena Klinovaja, Daniel Loss

articles.title: Magnetic field as a tuning knob for edge mode interaction in integer quantum Hall interferometers
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03284v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantum Hall interferometer has been shown to be a powerful tool for probing both the nature of the chiral modes present at the edges of these systems and the interactions between them. Strong inter-edge mode interactions can lead the system into a regime where the period of the interferometer signal corresponds to an insertion of a half-quantum flux h/2e, rather than the standard flux quantum h/e. Using a highly tunable bilayer graphene device, we are able to measure the prevalence of both the h/e-period and the doubled-frequency regimes as a function of magnetic field, providing insight into the microscopic nature of the doubling mechanism. Furthermore, we are able to push our device to a regime where double-frequency oscillations coexist with a superimposed period-h/e pattern associated with the inner chiral modes farther from the edge. We argue that this regime has a natural interpretation in a picture of the frequency doubling being caused by strong capacitive couplings between the edge modes.
authors: Ning Ma, Tevž Lotrič, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Steven H. Simon, Mitali Banerjee

articles.title: The effects of an alternating bias on a single orbital spin impurity
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03507v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron spin resonance with the scanning tunneling microscope (ESR-STM) enables coherent manipulation and detection of individual atomic spins with atomic-scale spatial resolution, yet the microscopic mechanism by which the radiofrequency (RF) bias drives the spin remains under debate. We study this problem using a Redfield quantum-master-equation framework in which the oscillating bias enters explicitly through the electronic reservoirs rather than through an effective time-dependent tunneling amplitude. In the semiclassical limit, the RF voltage periodically sweeps the system through its static transport landscape, so that the transport regime depends jointly on the DC bias and RF amplitude. When the RF trajectory approaches or crosses a charge transition, the damping-like torque (DLT) associated with spin-polarized charge transfer is strongly enhanced. By contrast, the field-like torque (FLT) induced by the exchange field remains finite deeper in the Coulomb-blockade (CB) regime because it originates from virtual charge fluctuations. The RF trajectory also averages strongly bias-dependent static quantities over a finite voltage range, smoothing features such as the Lamb shift near the charge thresholds. These results establish the RF amplitude as a control parameter not only for the strength of the ESR drive, but also for the transport regime and the ratio between FLT and DLT.
authors: Matyas Nachtigall, Jose Reina-Gálvez, Christoph Wolf, Nicolás Lorente

articles.title: Ultrafast X-ray-induced dephasing of valence electrons
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.03635v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Diffract-before-destroy schemes for atomic-scale electron mapping assume that ultrashort X-ray pulses outrun radiation damage. Although atomic cores move over tens of femtoseconds, outer electrons respond much faster, compromising their locations. We test this limit in elemental silicon using broadband, energy-chirped X-ray pulses to encode time with few-femtosecond resolution. Comparing valence-sensitive structurally forbidden reflections with simultaneously measured core-dominated Bragg peaks reveals valence-bond dephasing on sub-20-fs timescales even at pulse energies where direct ionization effects are negligible. Our findings demonstrate that crystallography where outer electrons contribute substantially to Bragg peaks requires pulses shorter than today's standard sim50,fs standard. They also establish a path to disentangle valence electron and lattice contributions to order and dynamics with hard X-rays, enabling studies across molecular biology, quantum matter and devices.

articles.title: Analytic Bootstrap Solution for Quantum Mechanics on a Circle
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36031v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We solve the Schrödinger equation for a particle in the circle with a quantum mechanical bootstrap method. The main idea is that in physical situations one needs solutions of the recursion relations for the Fourier coefficients of the measure that vanish exponentially fast. We show that this results in a (generalized) continued fraction representation of the solution. The solution is an analytical function of the couplings and the energy. We also show how one this method directly computes the density of states and checking that the answer is physical is reduced to checking an inequality for a single variable. We also show how to reconstruct the wave function and how to extract the quasimomentum of the particle as a function of the energy. We illustrate our solution in the simplest case of the Mathieu equation, where we show that the method can easily resolve exponentially small bands in the band spectrum.
authors: David Berenstein, Upamanyu Moitra

articles.title: The Multi-trace Eigenstate Thermalization Hypothesis
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.00197v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce a multi-trace eigenstate thermalization hypothesis, an extension of ETH that governs connected correlations of operator matrix elements with arbitrary index structures, including several disjoint index cycles. We derive multi-trace ETH from local rotational invariance, relate its independent data to higher-order free cumulants, and construct a cyclic matrix model that encodes the resulting multi-cycle data. We provide evidence for multi-trace ETH in chaotic quantum systems and compute multi-trace correlations in low-dimensional gravity. In few-body systems, multi-trace contributions arise from correlated periodic orbits, including a linear ramp contribution to the one-point spectral form factor. In two dimensions, we compute interaction-induced multi-trace correlations from a quartically coupled bulk scalar in JT gravity, relating winding matter diagrams to corrections of matter-channel weights and anomalous dimensions. In three dimensions, we show that multi-trace non-Gaussianities arise from both topology-changing saddles and light matter. Using Virasoro TQFT and conformal mean-field theory, we compute examples involving knot and link complements and torus wormholes with matter loops. Across these settings, multi-trace ETH provides a common framework for both connected correlators in chaotic quantum systems and multi-boundary wormhole amplitudes in gravity.
authors: Ahmed I. Abdalla, Gabriele Di Ubaldo, Elisa Tabor

articles.title: Ground state and excitations of the (C₂⁽¹⁾) spin chain with non-diagonal boundaries
articles.abstract: arXiv:2611.01016v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Understanding boundary effects in higher-rank integrable quantum spin chains requires connecting exact spectral relations with the root configurations underlying their energies and excitations. With non-diagonal boundaries, determining these configurations remains challenging even when an exact spectral solution is available, hindering the direct extraction of thermodynamic properties. We address this problem for the rational C₂⁽¹⁾ chain by combining DMRG in the tensor-network framework with the quantum inverse scattering method. The numerically determined zeros of the fundamental and fused transfer-matrix eigenvalues reveal three bulk-string distributions, labeled by x, y, and w, together with boundary strings and additional roots. Substituting these configurations into the operator identities relating the two transfer matrices yields the ground-state energy and the surface energy in the thermodynamic limit under non-diagonal boundary conditions. The analytical surface energy agrees with the numerical results up to O(tfrac1N) corrections. From the regularity conditions of the operator identities, we derive a boundary-string selection rule and numerically identify allowed configurations beyond the ground state. For excitations preserving the boundary-string configuration, we identify three elementary hole excitations, X, Y, and W, in the x-, y-, and w-string distributions, respectively, and derive their energies. Based on the symmetry of the zero roots, we also present a bulk-excitation selection rule governing the allowed combinations of these elementary excitations in physical eigenstates. The framework developed here can therefore be used to systematically analyze boundary effects, bulk excitations, and related physical properties in other high-rank integrable quantum models with non-diagonal boundary conditions.

articles.title: Transversal gates for quantum CSS codes
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.21514v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this paper, we focus on the problem of computing the set of diagonal transversal gates fixing a CSS code. We determine the logical actions of these gates and characterize the subgroups that induce tensor products of single-qubit logical gates and logical identities. We describe these groups through explicit linear equations given by componentwise products of basis vectors of the underlying classical codes, which is the key difference from previous approaches. We compute the complete set of diagonal transversal gates fixing the code, and of transversal logical gates, for any CSS code arising from monomial codes, a family that includes decreasing monomial codes and polar codes. As a consequence, we recover and extend some results in the literature on CSS-T codes, triorthogonal codes, and divisible codes. We also extend these results to diagonal gates acting transversally on several code blocks and use them to characterize addressable gates.

articles.title: Graphical Analysis of Lifted Product Code Constructions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11987v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Lifted product codes are an important family of quantum low-density parity-check (QLDPC) codes, as they were the first QLDPC code family shown to be asymptotically good. Understanding the structure of their parity-check matrices HₘₐₜₕₛfX and HₘₐₜₕₛfZ, as well as the associated Tanner graphs, is essential for analyzing their decoding behavior and error-floor performance. In this work, we show that the Tanner graphs of HₘₐₜₕₛfX and HₘₐₜₕₛfZ are indeed isomorphic, and investigate their graph-theoretical structure. We establish conditions ensuring the connectivity of these graphs and provide bounds on their minimal absorbing sets, providing new insight into the combinatorial structures influencing decoding performance.

articles.title: A Universal Approach to Hydrodynamics in Higher Dimensions via Tensor Networks
articles.title_zh: 通过张量网络实现高维流体动力学的通用方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40776v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Extracting late-time hydrodynamic transport properties directly from microscopic quantum models, especially in dimensions beyond one, is believed to be classically intractable. This owes, in part, to the extensive growth of entanglement in higher dimensions and often a mismatch between geometric and tensor network locality. Here, we extend the Density Matrix Truncation (DMT) algorithm to accurately and quantitatively predict high-temperature transport coefficients (e.g. diffusion constants) in up to three dimensions. Additionally, we demonstrate the ability to capture the slow crossover dynamics characteristic of weakly broken integrability. The intuition underlying our approach is to preserve the geometrically local information crucial for hydrodynamics throughout the time evolution, despite using a one-dimensional matrix product state ansatz for higher-dimensional calculations. Our work pushes the boundary of classical computability and opens the door to benchmarking the high-temperature, late-time dynamics of generic quantum simulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 提取高维微观量子模型的流体动力学输运性质在经典计算中被认为是棘手的。本文将密度矩阵截断（DMT）算法扩展到可准确预测高达三维的高温输运系数。该方法通过在时间演化过程中保留对流体动力学至关重要的几何局部信息，克服了高维纠缠增长的挑战。这项工作拓展了经典计算的边界，并为通用量子模拟器的高温、晚期动力学基准测试提供了可能。

articles.title: Fock-space delocalization and its control in scarred-vs-ergodic dynamics
articles.title_zh: 疤痕态与遍历动力学中福克空间离域化及其控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40805v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum many-body scarred dynamics in Rydberg-atom arrays is characterized by revivals, in which the system repeatedly returns to its initial state despite its many-body complexity. But how extensively does the wave function explore the space of allowed configurations between revivals? We address this question by quantifying the fraction of configurations occupied during PXP dynamics initialized from the paradigmatic polarized and Néel states, which respectively exhibit thermalizing and scarred dynamics. Despite their striking revivals, dynamics from the Néel state spreads over exponentially many configurations, yet occupies a vanishing fraction of the full space in the thermodynamic limit. Dynamics from the polarized state, by contrast, occupies a finite fraction of the configuration space, close to anticoncentration and random-state statistics, although chiral symmetry limits this fraction to one third. A weak quasiperiodic field enables the polarized state to occupy half of the configuration space by lifting the constraint imposed by chiral symmetry. The Néel state, however, requires a stronger field to reach a comparable anticoncentrated regime. As the field increases further, the occupied fraction decreases for both initial states, revealing a nonmonotonic dependence of Fock-space delocalization on field strength without necessarily implying localization.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子多体疤痕动力学以系统周期性返回初始态为特征，但波函数在返回之间对允许配置空间的探索程度尚不明确。本文通过量化PXP动力学中占据的配置分数来解决这一问题，发现尽管Néel态动力学表现出显著的返回，但其波函数在指数级多的配置中传播，在热力学极限下仅占据总空间的极小部分。研究还表明，弱准周期场可以使极化态占据一半的配置空间，而Néel态则需要更强的场才能达到类似的离域化程度。
authors: Francesco Perciavalle

articles.title: Electronic-Structure-Informed Many-Body Encoding for Quantum Machine Learning
articles.title_zh: 基于电子结构信息的量子机器学习多体编码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40840v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Data encoding is a central challenge in quantum machine learning (QML), as it determines how classical information is mapped onto quantum states and influences the expressive power and efficiency of parameterized quantum circuits. Here, we introduce a physics-informed quantum encoding strategy that exploits the intrinsic many-body structure of electronic systems to establish a direct correspondence between the body order of input descriptors and the locality of quantum gates. Specifically, n-body electronic descriptors obtained from a single mean-field electronic-structure calculation are encoded through n-qubit gates, yielding a systematic hierarchy of quantum circuits with increasing many-body expressivity. Using reduced-density-matrix descriptors, we construct quantum machine-learning models incorporating one- through four-body encodings and benchmark their performance in predicting electron-correlation energies along bond-stretching potential energy surfaces. We demonstrate that increasing the body order of the encoding systematically improves prediction accuracy toward the full configuration interaction limit. Remarkably, disconnected many-particle densities constructed from lower-order electronic information achieve accuracy comparable to explicitly correlated two-particle densities in key cases, providing a computationally inexpensive route to higher-body quantum encodings. These findings establish a connection between the many-body structure of classical data and the design of quantum feature maps, offering a systematic, physically interpretable framework for enhancing the expressivity and predictive performance of quantum machine-learning circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 数据编码是量子机器学习（QML）的核心挑战，它影响参数化量子电路的表达能力和效率。本文提出了一种物理信息量子编码策略，利用电子系统固有的多体结构，将输入描述符的体序与量子门的局域性直接对应起来。通过n体电子描述符编码为n量子比特门，构建了具有递增多体表达能力的量子电路层次结构。研究表明，增加编码的体序可以系统地提高预测电子关联能的准确性，使其接近全组态相互作用极限。
authors: Liangnuo Zhang, Tanner Culpitt, Qiwei Yin, Linghua Zhu, Xiaosong Li

articles.title: Colloquium: Quantum information processing with ensembles of identical particles
articles.title_zh: 综述：利用全同粒子系综进行量子信息处理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40852v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Identical particles underpin most quantum technologies, but the role of indistinguishability in these processes extends far beyond the symmetrization of many-particle states. This Colloquium presents a unified operational perspective on how particle identity, indistinguishability, exchange statistics, and many-particle interference can instead be harnessed as resources for quantum information processing. We first clarify the notions of entanglement and indistinguishability for identical particles, emphasizing their dependence on the accessible measurements and information. We then review how spatial overlap, multiparticle interference, and path identity enable the generation, extraction, protection, and distillation of coherence and entanglement. Their applications to quantum metrology and imaging, state discrimination, teleportation, entanglement swapping, and quantum cloning are examined. Finally, we discuss the thermodynamic role of indistinguishability, from the Gibbs paradox to quantum thermal machines and statistics-driven engines. Across these settings, indistinguishability emerges as a controllable, task-dependent resource whose benefits are determined by state preparation, exchange statistics, interference, and measurement constraints.
articles.abstract_zh: 全同粒子是大多数量子技术的基础，其不可分辨性在量子信息处理中扮演着超越多粒子态对称化的关键角色。本综述从统一的操作视角出发，探讨了如何将粒子同一性、不可分辨性、交换统计和多粒子干涉作为量子信息处理的资源加以利用。文章阐明了全同粒子纠缠和不可分辨性的概念，并回顾了空间重叠、多粒子干涉和路径同一性如何实现相干性和纠缠的生成、提取、保护和提纯。最后，讨论了不可分辨性在量子计量、成像、态判别、量子热机等领域的应用，强调其作为一种可控的、依赖于任务的资源。
authors: Matteo Piccolini, Marcin Karczewski, Jin-Shi Xu, Chuan-Feng Li, Guang-Can Guo, Giuseppe Compagno, Farzam Nosrati, Rosario Lo Franco

articles.title: Optical Quantum Memory Processing for Quantum Hashing
articles.title_zh: 用于量子哈希的光学量子存储器处理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40904v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sender authentication is an important requirement for secure quantum communication networks. We propose programmable photon-echo quantum memory processing of a multi-time-bin photonic qudit for implementing a quantum-hash-based verification protocol. In this approach, using QM, sender (Alice) generates a quantum hash state by transforming a single stored photonic wave packet into the programmable photonic qudit. Bob's memory coherently maps the received time-bin photonic qudit into a single output mode according to phase encoding. Our scheme relies on a time-resolved coherent detection method introduced here, in which the coherent responses from individual time-bins are sequentially accumulated within Bob's spin coherence prior to the final sender verification. The key advantage of this coherent detection for quantum hashing is shown, and its potential applications are also discussed. The performed analysis demonstrates that experimentally verified parameters of contemporary optical quantum memories enable a proof of principle realization of the proposed architecture. These results reveal an additional role for quantum memories, serving not only as synchronization and repeater resources for long-distance quantum communication, but also as active elements for quantum hashing in conventional quantum key distribution systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 发送方认证是安全量子通信网络的重要需求。本文提出了一种可编程光子回波量子存储器处理多时隙光子量子比特的方法，以实现基于量子哈希的验证协议。在该方案中，发送方利用量子存储器将单个存储的光子波包转换为可编程光子量子比特，生成量子哈希态。接收方通过相位相干检测方法，将接收到的时隙光子量子比特映射到单个输出模式，并累积来自各个时隙的相干响应。分析表明，现有光学量子存储器的实验验证参数足以实现该架构的原理验证，揭示了量子存储器在量子哈希中的新作用。
authors: S. A. Moiseev, M. M. Minnegaliev

articles.title: Preparation of a Laughlin-like fractional Chern insulator on a superconducting quantum processor
articles.title_zh: 在超导量子处理器上制备类Laughlin分数陈绝缘体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41017v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fractional Chern insulators (FCIs) are lattice analogues of fractional quantum Hall states, hosting topological order and fractionalized anyonic excitations. Their realization poses a demanding target for quantum simulation. Here, we realize a bosonic FCI on an IBM Nighthawk superconducting quantum processor using classically optimized variational circuits. We target a Laughlin-like state that is an exact zero-energy ground state of a long-range parent Hamiltonian on a torus, eliminating physical edges and providing a favorable geometry for accessing fractional quantum Hall physics in a small system. On a 4×4 qubit lattice, we prepare both the four-boson FCI ground state and a three-boson state hosting two quasiholes. Measurements of particle densities and correlations reproduce the characteristic structure of the target states, while reconstructed chiral magnetization currents resolve the circulating current pattern associated with the quasiholes. The preparation of these strongly correlated topological states with shallow circuits establishes a route toward the digital simulation and manipulation of fractionalized excitations, including measurements of topological invariants and anyonic braiding.
articles.abstract_zh: 分数陈绝缘体（FCIs）是分数量子霍尔态的晶格模拟物，具有拓扑序和分数化任意子激发。本文在IBM Nighthawk超导量子处理器上，利用经典优化的变分电路，实现了玻色子FCI的制备。研究成功在4×4量子比特晶格上制备了四玻色子FCI基态和包含两个准空穴的三玻色子态。粒子密度和关联的测量结果重现了目标态的特征结构，重建的手性磁化电流也解析了与准空穴相关的环流模式。这项工作为利用浅层电路进行分数化激发的数字模拟和操控开辟了道路。
authors: Kamil Dutkiewicz, Bárbara Andrade, Geza Giedke, Tobias Grass

articles.title: Vacuum amplification across a programmable bosonic Bogoliubov stability boundary in a trapped-ion chain
articles.title_zh: 囚禁离子链中可编程玻色子Bogoliubov稳定性边界上的真空放大
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41033v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A quantum oscillator always carries vacuum fluctuations, and modulating its parameters converts them into correlated pairs of real quanta. This vacuum amplification underlies squeezed light and Hawking radiation. In a closed quadratic system, pair creation competes with the energy splitting of the modes, and growth turns exponential only once pairing overcomes the splitting. Here we realize this competition in two motional modes of a trapped-ion chain. A two-mode-squeezing drive creates the pairs, and a beam-splitter coupling splits the motion into two coupled modes at different frequencies. The two rates are tuned and calibrated independently. Starting near the motional ground state, we cross the stability boundary in two ways. First, with the drive at the sum of the two bare-mode frequencies, the phonon number stays bounded until the pairing rate exceeds the splitting and grows exponentially beyond it. Second, tuning the drive into resonance with one coupled mode lowers the threshold to zero, and only that mode is amplified into a squeezed vacuum. Separate control of the two interactions makes the threshold for vacuum amplification programmable. This control can be used to simulate particle creation and quantum phase transitions, and to operate parametrically driven bosonic devices close to their stability limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子振荡器中的真空涨落可以通过参数调制转化为关联的真实量子对，这一真空放大现象是压缩光和霍金辐射的基础。本文在囚禁离子链的两个运动模式中实现了这种竞争，其中双模压缩驱动产生粒子对，而分束器耦合将运动分裂为两个不同频率的耦合模式。研究通过两种方式跨越稳定性边界，展示了当配对速率超过模式分裂时，声子数会呈指数增长。对两种相互作用的独立控制使得真空放大的阈值可编程。
authors: Lu Qi, Duanyang Wang, Kenneth R. Brown

articles.title: Quantum Advantage in Beam-Displacement Estimation for Inter-Satellite Quantum-Secure Time Transfer
articles.title_zh: 卫星间量子安全时间传递中光束位移估计的量子优势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41198v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we investigate the practical feasibility of achieving a quantum advantage, in the context of inter-satellite quantum communication, of satellite position estimation. The investigation focuses on a quantum-enhanced scheme in which squeezing is added to the derivative mode of a Gaussian probe beam as a means of estimating photon-beam displacement. The performance of the scheme is compared against the standard quantum limit achieved by an optimal classical beam-displacement estimation scheme under a fair same-total-energy constraint. We find that although the benefit provided by squeezing rapidly diminishes as the inter-satellite distance increases due to diffraction-induced beam spreading and subsequent truncation by the finite receiver aperture, a quantum advantage can still be expected over inter-satellite distances up to approximately 100 km under practical satellite configurations. This distance scale between satellites is anticipated for Starlink-type satellite constellations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在卫星间量子通信背景下，实现卫星位置估计量子优势的实际可行性。研究重点是一种量子增强方案，通过向高斯探测光束的导数模式添加压缩态来估计光子束位移。尽管由于衍射引起的光束扩散和接收孔径截断，压缩态带来的优势随卫星间距离增加而迅速减弱，但在实际卫星配置下，量子优势在高达约100公里的卫星间距离内仍可预期。这一距离尺度与星链（Starlink）型卫星星座的预期相符。
authors: Ziqing Wang, Robert Malaney

articles.title: Time-Domain Multiplexing for Resource-Efficient Heralded GKP State Preparation
articles.title_zh: 用于资源高效预报GKP态制备的时域复用技术
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41341v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) states are key resources for fault-tolerant photonic quantum computing, but their conditional preparation via Gaussian boson sampling involves a trade-off between source count and photon-number resolution. Distributing heralding photons across more measured modes reduces the resolution required per mode, yet increases the number of simultaneously operated squeezed sources in fully squeezed spatial architectures. Here, we show that time-domain multiplexing (TDM) can reduce these physical source requirements while preserving GKP state quality. Using an end-to-end differentiable Bargmann framework, we find that TDM circuits reusing one or two squeezed sources achieve fidelities comparable to fully squeezed spatial circuits across several configurations. Selected nine-mode configurations retain fidelities above 0.95 with one photon heralded in each measured mode, mitigating detector resolution demands without a proportional increase in source count. Loss-aware reoptimization further shows that, under the investigated spatial loss models, two-mode TDM maintains fidelities near 0.80 at 1.0 dB per channel, whereas the corresponding spatial benchmarks fall below 0.60. These results demonstrate that temporal reuse provides an effective architectural route for balancing source overhead, detection demands, and state preparation performance in the presence of optical loss.
articles.abstract_zh: Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) 态是容错光子量子计算的关键资源，但其条件制备涉及光源数量和光子数分辨率之间的权衡。本文展示了时域复用（TDM）技术可以减少物理光源需求，同时保持GKP态的质量。研究发现，重用一到两个压缩光源的TDM电路在多种配置下能达到与全压缩空间电路相当的保真度。在考虑损耗的重新优化下，双模TDM在每通道1.0 dB损耗下仍能保持接近0.80的保真度。
authors: Ke-Ming Hu, Jun-Jie He, Yu-Ze Zhu, Pei-Lin Du, Lin Yang, Hao Tang, Xian-Min Jin

articles.title: Loss-aware optimization of realistic GKP gid states
articles.title_zh: 考虑损耗的实际GKP网格态优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41388v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Realistic preparation of Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) states, the prime candidates for quantum computation with bosonic systems, is inevitably burdened by photon loss. We show how taking this loss into account can lead to more robust quantum states, thereby diminishing its negative influence. Using GKP squeezing as an operational figure of merit, we formulate a loss-aware optimization procedure based on the ground state representation of GKP states. Numerical simulations for square, hexagonal, and asymmetric GKP states show that the optimal preparation generally requires a different initial grid spacing than that of the desired ideal code state. For symmetric and hexagonal lattices, the optimal parameters asymptotically follow the simple scaling relation. The optimized states exhibit better GKP squeezing and greater resilience to losses. These results provide a simple and experimentally relevant strategy for improving realistic photonic GKP state preparation in the presence of known photon loss.
articles.abstract_zh: Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) 态的实际制备不可避免地受到光子损耗的影响。本文展示了如何通过考虑损耗来获得更鲁棒的量子态，从而减弱其负面影响。研究基于GKP态的基态表示，提出了一种考虑损耗的优化程序，并以GKP压缩作为衡量标准。数值模拟表明，最佳制备通常需要与理想编码态不同的初始网格间距，优化后的态表现出更好的GKP压缩和更强的抗损耗能力。这些结果为在已知光子损耗情况下改进实际光子GKP态制备提供了一种简单且实验相关的策略。
authors: Michal Matulík, Petr Marek

articles.title: Distilling Knowledge from Search: Decoder Model Factory for Quantum LDPC Codes
articles.title_zh: 从搜索中提炼知识：量子LDPC码的解码器模型工厂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41398v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce GraphMP, a learning-based message-passing decoder for quantum low-density parity-check codes that transfers without fine-tuning across code families, code sizes, physical error rates, and noise models. GraphMP uses local message passing to keep computation scalable as the decoding graph grows. Guided by its predictions, beam search progressively refines candidate error patterns, trading additional decoding time for lower logical error rates. We develop the decoder model factory as a paradigm for training successive models on experience generated by earlier models during decoding. Model-guided search supplies verified trajectories for knowledge distillation, folding computation spent on decoding into reusable training data. Repeated collection and distillation improve the decoder across generations and adapt its strategy as the noise changes. These results motivate a coupled quantum--classical architecture with two interacting cycles: rapid decoding protects quantum information, while slower learning renews the models from operating experience. The long-term vision is a scalable decoder model factory that produces high-performance, low-latency decoders and continually adapts them to evolving quantum hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了GraphMP，一种基于学习的消息传递解码器，用于量子低密度奇偶校验（LDPC）码，其无需微调即可跨代码族、代码大小、物理错误率和噪声模型进行迁移。GraphMP利用局部消息传递实现计算的可扩展性，并通过其预测指导束搜索逐步优化候选错误模式。研究提出了解码器模型工厂范式，用于训练后续模型，利用早期模型在解码过程中生成的经验。这些结果启发了一种耦合的量子-经典架构，其中快速解码保护量子信息，而较慢的学习则根据操作经验更新模型。
authors: Anil Bilgin, Wanda Hou, Pranav Srinivas, Yi-Zhuang You

articles.title: Helper-assisted quantum sensing with low dressed-state leakage
articles.title_zh: 辅助量子传感，实现低缀饰态泄漏
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41404v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a two-qubit sensing protocol in which only a helper qubit is read out. Calibrated loading and unloading encode a transverse signal in the helper's phase, keep leakage out of a selected dressed-state band small, and return the sensor close to its idle ground state. We derive an information bound for a single sensor whose excitation stays below a prescribed budget, and simulate repeated operation with an uncertain coupling and finite-duration resets in a driven open-system model. At the tested settings, finite measurement records support estimation with infrequent resets. A helper flip at zero coupling, combined with a reversal of the coupling sign, suppresses a static helper offset shared across a record while retaining the signal, at a cost of about 27% of the no-offset information of a plain sequence of equal duration. Under slowly varying noise, averaging each cycle's likelihood over the correct noise law removes most of the added bias, and a wrong noise law can worsen the estimate. A selected directly read sensor with ideal controls and repeated nondemolition verification has the higher information rate. Any practical benefit of avoiding direct readout therefore requires a device-specific disturbance model.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一种双量子比特传感协议，其中仅读取辅助量子比特。通过校准的加载和卸载，将横向信号编码到辅助比特的相位中，同时将泄漏保持在选定的缀饰态带之外，并使传感器返回到其空闲基态。研究人员推导了单个传感器的信息界限，并在驱动开放系统模型中模拟了重复操作。结果表明，在特定设置下，有限的测量记录支持不频繁复位的估计，并且通过辅助比特翻转和耦合符号反转可以抑制静态偏移。
authors: Shirwan Abdullah

articles.title: High-efficiency photonic GHZ measurements with linear optics
articles.title_zh: 基于线性光学的高效率光子GHZ测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41524v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Probabilistic and destructive Bell-measurements, also known as fusions, constitute a fundamental primitive for photonic quantum technologies. These operations rely only on pairwise photonic interference, whereas the computational power of photonic quantum systems originates from many-body interference. Here, we introduce a family of high-efficiency linear-optical GHZ measurements based on four-mode interferometers and show that incorporating many-body interference into this ubiquitous primitive leads to more efficient entangling operations. For the four-photon case, the success probability is 9/32, and adaptive variants ensure that unsuccessful events project onto useful stabilizer states. We further show that the approach naturally generalizes to larger GHZ measurements, yielding an exponentially higher success probability than previous linear-optical schemes. Finally, we demonstrate practical advantages for graph-state resource generation, entanglement distribution between remote spin-photon interfaces, and fusion-based quantum computing. Our results establish high-efficiency many-body measurements as a new primitive for scalable photonic quantum information processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 贝尔测量是光子量子技术的基本原语，但其成功率受限于双体干涉。本文引入了一系列基于四模干涉仪的高效率线性光学GHZ测量方法，通过引入多体干涉显著提高了纠缠操作的效率。对于四光子情况，成功概率达到9/32，且自适应变体能将失败事件投影到有用的稳定器态。该方法可推广到更大的GHZ测量，并具有指数级更高的成功概率，为图态资源生成、远程自旋-光子接口纠缠分发和基于融合的量子计算提供了实际优势。
authors: Stefan N. van den Hoven, Love A. Pettersson, Anders S. Sørensen, Stefano Paesani

articles.title: FaultScope: A software package for fast error attribution in quantum error correction
articles.title_zh: FaultScope：用于量子纠错中快速错误归因的软件包
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41528v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce FaultScope, a classical simulator for quantum error correction circuits, implemented in Rust with a Python interface. FaultScope estimates logical error rates and their derivatives with respect to component error rates from the same sampled and decoded shots, without modifying or differentiating through the decoder. These derivatives enable error attribution to individual noisy components, helping identify noise hotspots for targeted noise reduction. FaultScope supports forward simulation of error propagation through circuits and direct sampling of detector and logical observable outcomes from detector error models. In our noiseless and noisy benchmarks, FaultScope has the lowest runtime among the tested simulators at every size. Computing all derivatives adds only 0.33--0.97% to the runtime of logical error rate estimation across five repetition code sizes with 7--2047 error locations. FaultScope can be used to benchmark large-scale quantum error correction schemes and guide targeted noise reduction efficiently, thereby facilitating the design and optimization of fault-tolerant quantum computing architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了FaultScope，一个用Rust实现并带有Python接口的量子纠错电路经典模拟器。FaultScope能够从相同的采样和解码结果中估计逻辑错误率及其对组件错误率的导数，从而实现对单个噪声组件的错误归因。在无噪声和有噪声的基准测试中，FaultScope在所有规模下都具有最低的运行时间。计算所有导数仅增加逻辑错误率估计运行时间的0.33%-0.97%。FaultScope可用于高效地基准测试大规模量子纠错方案并指导有针对性的降噪，从而促进容错量子计算架构的设计和优化。
authors: Yuguo Shao, Zhenyu Chen, Ningfeng Wang, Song Cheng, Zhaohui Wei, Zi-Wen Liu, Zhengwei Liu

articles.title: Symmetries and model reduction in a o̧s 2ǎrphi transmon qubit
articles.title_zh: o̧s 2ǎrphi Transmon量子比特中的对称性与模型降阶
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41542v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Engineered symmetries in superconducting circuits can protect quantum information; much like selection rules in atomic physics, they forbid transitions between the qubit states. Protected circuits, however, combine several loops and islands and host multiple nonlinearly coupled modes, calling for reduced low-energy models that inherit the circuit symmetries and make the protection manifest. We develop such a reduction for the o̧s 2ǎrphi transmon qubit, recently realized experimentally with a two-Cooper-pair interferometer, whose circuit hosts three coupled modes. Exploiting the separation of energy scales between the heavy transmon mode and the light internal modes of the interferometer, we derive an effective single-band Born-Oppenheimer model, including its geometric correction, and extend it to several bands. We identify the symmetries of the full and reduced Hamiltonians and derive exact selection rules. Finally, we identify a parameter regime beyond the single-band description that suppresses flux-noise dephasing without degrading charge-noise protection.
articles.abstract_zh: 超导电路中的工程对称性可以保护量子信息，通过禁止量子比特态之间的跃迁。本文为最近实验实现的o̧s 2ǎrphi transmon量子比特开发了一种低能模型降阶方法，该量子比特电路包含三个耦合模式。利用重transmon模式与干涉仪轻内部模式之间的能量尺度分离，推导了包含几何校正的有效单带Born-Oppenheimer模型，并将其扩展到多带。研究识别了完整和降阶哈密顿量的对称性，并推导了精确的选择规则。最后，发现了一个超越单带描述的参数区域，该区域在不降低电荷噪声保护的情况下抑制了磁通噪声退相干。
authors: Erwan Roverc'h, Kyrylo Gerashchenko, Alvise Borgognoni, Benoit Douçot, Alexandru Petrescu, Rémi Robin, Zaki Leghtas

articles.title: Hybrid Quantum Algorithms for Trade Surveillance Analytics
articles.title_zh: 用于交易监控分析的混合量子算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41874v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Anti-money laundering (AML) and trade surveillance remain largely manual: rule-based monitoring raises alerts of which, by estimate, over 95% are false positives, each reviewed by a human analyst. We benchmark four quantum and hybrid classifiers against classical baselines on a synthetic pump-and-dump detection task: a fidelity-based quantum k-nearest-neighbours classifier (QKNN) with clustering-based routing; a quantum support vector machine (QSVM) on a one-body projected quantum kernel; a 20-qubit quantum neural network (QNN) with a Pauli-ZZ feature map and RealAmplitudes ansatz; and a hybrid quantum neural network (HQNN) in which a small classical network generates every rotation angle of a five-qubit circuit. Baselines are logistic regression, XGBoost, one- and three-hidden-layer neural networks, and classical k-nearest neighbours. All models share one stratified split of 1000 accounts (800 train, 200 test, 20% suspicious) and two 20-feature representations (ANOVA and PCA); QKNN and QSVM are also tested under simulated noise, and the HQNN is run on the ibm_fez processor. The best model is classical XGBoost on ANOVA features, at a suspicious-class F1 of 61.4%. The HQNN is the strongest quantum-hybrid model, at 54.5-57.9% F1 on an ideal simulator and 55.4-59.8% on ibm_fez, ahead of six of eight classical configurations; at a 15% false-positive rate, half its alerts are genuinely suspicious. Versus the QNN (42.0% F1), it raises under half the false alarms at similar recall with a quarter of the qubits. The QKNN reaches 43.5% F1 (44.4% under noise), above classical KNN (35.6%); the QSVM does not exceed 41%. We observe no quantum advantage, but a five-qubit hybrid on today's noisy hardware already matches well-tuned classical models, with room to grow via richer circuits and larger devices. We contribute a like-for-like comparison with classical models on shared data, splits and features.
articles.abstract_zh: 反洗钱和交易监控仍主要依赖人工，规则监控产生的警报中超过95%是误报。本文在合成的“拉高出货”检测任务上，将四种量子和混合分类器与经典基线进行了基准测试。这些分类器包括基于保真度的量子k近邻、量子支持向量机、20量子比特量子神经网络和混合量子神经网络。结果显示，在ANOVA特征上，经典XGBoost模型表现最佳。
authors: Bimal Mehta, Daniel musgrove, Devanshu Shekhar, Shiplu Sarkar, Vanshaj Kerni, Varun Puram, Nitesh Kansara, Abinash Pati, Sarthak Chakraborty, Parth Gaglani, Bhaskar Roy Bardhan

articles.title: GENIE: learned quantum circuits as embedding impurity solvers, and why compactness, not correlation strength, decides when they work
articles.title_zh: GENIE：学习型量子电路作为嵌入式杂质求解器，及其工作原理——紧凑性而非关联强度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41957v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sample-based quantum diagonalization has been used as an impurity solver in density matrix embedding theory (DMET), but always with fixed-form circuits and without comparison to classical selection at the same subspace size. We introduce GENIE, a DMET impurity solver in which a generative transformer learns the sampling circuit, trained on the quantum-selected configuration interaction energy. On N2, hydrogen chains, water and a hydrogen ring, we compare GENIE at equal determinant budget with classical selected configuration interaction (CIPSI, ASCI, heat-bath CI) and with DMET combined with sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD). GENIE selects: for N2 at 200 determinants it is within a factor of 1.7 of CIPSI and 25 to 1000 times more accurate than the determinants a fixed circuit actually samples, while standard SQD reaches good energies mainly by filling the subspace. GENIE does not beat the best classical selection, and its circuits require fault-tolerant hardware. Its failures are governed by the compactness of the wavefunction relative to the budget, not by correlation strength. A cheap estimate from coupled-cluster amplitudes predicts this compactness. A router built on it never recommended GENIE where it then failed, apart from seed-to-seed variance, and it transferred unchanged to a blind test on new systems. We also identify two benchmarking pitfalls that can create apparent quantum advantages of one to two orders of magnitude.
articles.abstract_zh: 密度矩阵嵌入理论（DMET）中，基于采样的量子对角化已被用作杂质求解器，但通常采用固定形式的电路。本文引入了GENIE，一种DMET杂质求解器，其中生成式Transformer学习采样电路，并根据量子选择的组态相互作用能量进行训练。在N2、氢链、水和氢环等分子上的比较表明，GENIE在相同行列式预算下，其性能接近经典选择方法，并且比固定电路采样的行列式更准确。研究发现，GENIE的成功与否取决于波函数相对于预算的紧凑性，而非关联强度。
authors: Awadhoot Vijay Loharkar, Arcesio Castañeda Medina

articles.title: Resource efficient Sample Based Quantum Simulation through Fragmentation and Virtual Partitioning of QPU
articles.title_zh: 通过碎片化和QPU虚拟分区实现资源高效的基于采样的量子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41986v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Present-day sample-based quantum algorithms within quantum-centric supercomputing workflows require substantial classical post-processing, large circuit depths to produce chemically relevant samples, and long QPU times to execute the many circuits needed for molecules of chemically relevant size. We introduce FMO-QVM-HCI-HSQD, a resource-efficient sample-based framework that breaks a large problem into fragments, runs the fragments in parallel on virtual regions of the QPU, and reduces circuit depth through a half-qubit ansatz whose samples seed an HCI expansion. We demonstrate the algorithm on ibmₘₐᵣᵣₐₖₑₛₕ and ibm_boston for the water trimer and the carmofur_Mpro complex with up to 52 qubits, benchmarking against FMO-CCSD(T), FMO-CASCI and FMO-HCI. For the water trimer (14 spin orbitals for monomers, 28 for dimers), our method reduces the two-qubit depth by 39% compared to FMO-QVM-SQD and the QPU time by 82% compared to sequential FMO-SQD, and accesses 3% of the determinant subspace versus 40% for FMO-SQD, while achieving more accurate energies. For the carmofur_Mpro complex (16 and 32 spin orbitals), it reduces the two-qubit depth by 47% and the QPU time by 20% compared to FMO-QVM-SQD, and accesses 0.007% of the determinant subspace versus 40%, while remaining within chemical accuracy. Extending the carmofur_Mpro active space in the 6-31G basis to 52 and 104 spin orbitals, sampled on 26 and 52 qubits, the total energy deviates from FMO-HCI by only 1.22 mHa. These results show that combining fragmentation, virtual QPU partitioning and half-qubit sampling makes sample-based quantum simulation of chemically relevant systems feasible on current hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 当前基于采样的量子算法在量子中心超算工作流中面临经典后处理量大、电路深度深和QPU时间长等挑战。本文引入了FMO-QVM-HCI-HSQD，一个资源高效的基于采样的框架，它将大问题分解为碎片，在QPU的虚拟区域并行运行，并通过半量子比特拟设减少电路深度。该算法在水三聚体和卡莫氟-Mpro复合物上进行了演示，与现有方法相比，显著减少了双量子比特深度和QPU时间，同时获得了更准确的能量。
authors: R. Pradeep, Anurag Chaudhary, Ashish Kumar Patra, Anurag K. S. V., Ruchika Bhat, Sai Shankar P., G. Jaiganesh

articles.title: Topologically Protected Edge States in a Single Flux Qubit
articles.title_zh: 单磁通量子比特中的拓扑保护边缘态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.42114v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that topological edge states can be realized in a simple superconducting circuit composed of an inductively shunted flux qubit. The Josephson potential of that qubit forms a honeycomb lattice similar to the case of graphene. The additional shunting element produces a quartic potential along one flux direction, which effectively creates a boundary in flux space. We map analytically the low-energy dynamics of the circuit to an extended Su--Schrieffer--Heeger (SSH) chain, in which a quartic potential is added to the usual SSH Hamiltonian. This mapping is confirmed by numerical simulations of the full superconducting circuit. We argue that chiral symmetry still holds for the edge states of the extended model around a chiral point in parameter space. Close to this point, we numerically find that edge states in our superconducting circuit are topologically protected against perturbations that obey chiral symmetry, as is the case for charge noise. Our results show that topological effects previously thought to occur in multi-qubit systems, such as protection against decoherence, can also be found in much simpler single superconducting qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了在由电感分流磁通量子比特组成的简单超导电路中实现拓扑边缘态的可能性。该量子比特的约瑟夫森势形成类似于石墨烯的蜂窝状晶格。额外的分流元件沿一个磁通方向产生四次势，有效创建了磁通空间中的边界。研究将电路的低能动力学解析映射到一个扩展的Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) 链，并通过数值模拟证实了这一映射。结果表明，在参数空间中的手性点附近，扩展模型的边缘态仍保持手性对称性，并且在超导电路中，边缘态对手性对称扰动（如电荷噪声）具有拓扑保护。
authors: Pablo Perez-Fernandez, Manuel Pino

articles.title: Weighted hypergraph states as a resource for quantum metrology
articles.title_zh: 加权超图态作为量子计量学的资源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.42129v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum correlations can be used to improve sensing precision beyond classical limits, yet the correlated resource states needed can be challenging to prepare and preserve. Here, we study the family of weighted hypergraph states and identify subclasses characterized by their underlying graph topology that exhibit enhanced metrological performance. Using the quantum Fisher information and a novel Dicke state basis representation, we show that these subclasses outperform both separable and standard weighted graph state benchmarks over broad ranges of edge weights corresponding to weak controlled operations between qubits representing the vertices of the graph. We provide analytical formulas for an arbitrary number N of qubits, supplemented by a general study, while focusing a detailed analysis on the example case of N=4. By identifying the critical probabilities for local dephasing, we show that adding higher-order weighted hyperedges for N qubits can enhance metrological robustness, allowing the resulting states to retain a quantum advantage at higher noise levels. These probe states exhibit favorable scaling, enhanced precision, and noise tolerance. Our findings establish weighted hypergraph states as viable, structurally tunable and robust resources for quantum-enhanced metrology.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子关联可以提高传感精度，超越经典极限，但所需的关联资源态难以制备和保持。本文研究了加权超图态家族，并识别出其底层图拓扑结构表征的子类，这些子类表现出增强的计量性能。利用量子费雪信息和新颖的迪克态基表示，研究表明这些子类在广泛的边权重范围内优于可分离态和标准加权图态基准。通过识别局部退相干的临界概率，结果表明添加高阶加权超边可以增强计量鲁棒性，使所得态在更高噪声水平下仍保持量子优势。
authors: B. J. Alexander, M. S. Tame

articles.title: Gapless and Non-Equilibrium Topology in Blockaded Ladders
articles.title_zh: 阻塞梯形结构中的无能隙和非平衡拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40771v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We propose a multi-leg PXYP model as a minimal setting to explore constraint-induced intertwinement between itinerant and internal degrees of freedom. We argue that the Rydberg-like blockade induces correlations in squeezed space, providing a unified mechanism for nontrivial string order both in and out of equilibrium. In a two-leg geometry, this leads to an intrinsically gapless topological ground state, which can terminate at a supersymmetric multicritical point. This mechanism also leads to the preservation of string order for parametrically long times after a quench, which we verify using tensor network simulations and a classical stochastic approximation to the dynamics. In a three-leg geometry, the blockade leads to an additional emergent U(1) symmetry, resulting in a multicomponent Luttinger liquid where both itinerant and internal degrees of freedom are critical. This family of models arises naturally in a range of quantum simulator platforms such as Rydberg tweezer arrays and dipolar atoms in optical lattices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个多腿PXYP模型，作为探索约束诱导的巡游自由度与内部自由度之间相互缠绕的最小设置。研究认为，类里德堡阻塞在压缩空间中诱导关联，为平衡态和非平衡态下的非平凡弦序提供统一机制。在双腿几何中，这导致了固有的无能隙拓扑基态，并可在超对称多临界点终止。该机制还导致淬火后弦序在参数上长时间保持，这通过张量网络模拟和经典随机近似动力学得到验证。
authors: Ramanjit Sohal, Hannes Bernien, Ruben Verresen

articles.title: Tunable Three-Body Interactions in Microwave-Shielded Polar Molecules
articles.title_zh: 微波屏蔽极性分子中的可调谐三体相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41003v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We show that microwave shielding, which enables collisionally stable ultracold polar molecules, also leads to genuine nonadditive three-body interactions comparable to the shielding interaction itself. Their magnitude, sign, and geometrical dependence can be flexibly controlled through microwave parameters and orientation. Interaction strengths can reach the ten kilohertz-scale for ultrapolar molecules in typical optical lattices. The nonadditive three-body interactions can stabilize novel many-body phases, and should be accounted for in quantum simulation with microwave shielded molecules.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究表明，微波屏蔽不仅能使超冷极性分子实现碰撞稳定，还会导致与屏蔽相互作用本身相当的非加性真实三体相互作用。这些相互作用的强度、符号和几何依赖性可通过微波参数和取向灵活控制，对于超极性分子在典型光学晶格中可达十千赫兹量级。这种非加性三体相互作用能够稳定新颖的多体相，在利用微波屏蔽分子进行量子模拟时应予以考虑。
authors: Hanwei Yang, Tijs Karman

articles.title: Query-Efficient Quantum Multi-Objective Optimization for Materials Configuration Search via Bayesian Weight Selection
articles.title_zh: 基于贝叶斯权重选择的查询高效量子多目标优化用于材料构型搜索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41788v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Materials design is a multi-objective problem, and recent advances in quantum optimization make it possible to bring quantum solvers to bear on such problems. The realistic near-term win, though, is not raw quantum advantage but making an expensive, noisy quantum solver usable by spending its calls wisely. Quantum Approximate Multi-Objective Optimization (QAMOO) traces a Pareto front by solving a family of scalarized Ising problems, one per objective-weight vector, with QAOA --- but chooses those weights emphnon-adaptively, sampling them at random, blind to what it has already found. We recast weight selection as emphmulti-objective Bayesian optimization: our method, BW-QAMOO (Bayes-Weighted QAMOO), picks each next weight by expected hypervolume improvement (EHVI) under a Gaussian-process (GP) surrogate over the weight-to-objective map. On a frustrated alloy-configuration benchmark across min3,4 objectives and nin10,11,12 sites, BW-QAMOO reaches the same Pareto hypervolume as QAMOO's random sampling with a median 33% fewer scalarized solves across the 90/95% targets and 60--74% fewer than a uniform-grid baseline), on a genuine (simulated) QAOA solver; a paired Wilcoxon test confirms the saving is significant, and the advantage grows with the objective count m as the weight simplex expands and blind sampling wastes more of the budget. This is a emphquery-efficiency result, and we close with the open challenges on the path to real alloy data and hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 材料设计是一个多目标问题，量子优化技术为解决此类问题提供了新途径。本文将量子近似多目标优化（QAMOO）中的权重选择重新定义为多目标贝叶斯优化，提出了BW-QAMOO方法。BW-QAMOO通过高斯过程代理模型下的预期超体积改进（EHVI）来选择下一个权重。在受挫合金构型基准测试中，BW-QAMOO在达到相同帕累托超体积的情况下，比QAMOO的随机采样方法减少了中位数33%的标量化求解次数。
authors: Onur Boyar, Seiji Takeda, Akihiro Kosugi, Indra Priyadarsini S, Lisa Hamada, Sina Klampt

articles.title: Solvable coupled cluster states in d=infty with prescribed momentum distribution
articles.title_zh: d=无穷大可解耦合簇态及其规定的动量分布
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41976v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Two of the most successful ideas in many-body theory, the exponential coupled cluster ansatz and DMFT, have to date developed separately. We establish a connection between them, by showing that the infinite dimensional limit of the hypercubic lattice allows the exact closed-form evaluation of static expectation values of coupled cluster wave functions, provided the cluster amplitudes admit a low-rank decomposition. As a result, evaluation errors -- a serious concern in conventional coupled cluster theory -- can be disentangled from limitations to expressivity of coupled cluster states. For this family of coupled cluster states, the cavity construction in d→infty exactly reduces the environment of a lattice site to a Gaussian Grassmann kernel, and irreducible diagrams for one-body expectation values are found to be site-diagonal (in analogy to the DMFT self-energy). The resulting ``impurity problem" is an integral over a finite number of Grassmann variables rather than a dynamical quantum impurity problem, so that static observables derive exactly from a static self-consistency condition: a wave function counterpart of DMFT. For the simplest case of a cluster amplitude restricted to rank-one doubles, we obtain the momentum distribution in closed form. We show that any momentum distribution can be realized by a state that is the exact and unique ground state of an explicit parent Hamiltonian with a gapless single-particle tunnelling spectrum. By construction these coupled cluster states variationally recover low order perturbation theory for the Hubbard model. Their failure in the strong coupling regime near the Mott transition diagnoses a fundamental limitation of coupled cluster doubles. Intriguingly, our family of coupled cluster wave functions includes a gapless state with zero quasiparticle weight, with a momentum distribution that is completely smooth at the Fermi energy.
articles.abstract_zh: 这项工作在多体理论中建立了指数耦合簇方法与DMFT之间的联系。研究表明，在超立方晶格的无限维极限下，如果簇振幅允许低秩分解，耦合簇波函数的静态期望值可以精确地闭合形式评估。这使得评估误差与耦合簇态的表达能力限制得以分离，并导出了一个静态自洽条件，作为DMFT的波函数对应物。
authors: Izak Snyman, Serge Florens

articles.title: Charge Pumping Leptogenesis from the Symmetric Mass Generation Phase on a Four-Leg Ladder Lattice
articles.title_zh: 四腿梯形晶格上对称质量生成相的电荷泵浦轻子生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.42103v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantized charge pumping in quantum Hall systems is a bulk topological property, typically manifesting on gapless boundaries as spectral flow through chiral edge modes upon flux insertion. When the boundary is anomaly-free, it can be symmetrically gapped by symmetric mass generation (SMG) interactions. However, the effects on quantized charge pumping at an interacting gapped boundary are unclear. We address this using density-matrix renormalization group simulations of a four-leg ladder quasi-(2+1)d realization of the (1+1)d 3-4-5-0 lattice chiral fermion model with six-fermion interactions at one edge.
