We find gapless modes near the interacting edge for both weak and strong couplings, but the edge can be in a fully gapped SMG phase at intermediate coupling. We also identify spontaneous breaking of the model's Z₂ symmetry above a critical interaction strength. Across all three boundary phases, we find quantized charge pumping with the same pumped charge per flux quantum. The spatial distribution of the pumped charge varies between phases. Besides charge pumping, we study how a single injected fermion propagates under open boundary conditions. In the SMG phase, an interaction-induced flavor-mixing current develops at the endpoints of the gapped edge, which is absent in the weak- and strong-coupling limits. This current reveals a charge-redistribution mechanism unique to the SMG phase. Additionally, we propose an analogy between charge pumping in this model and a topological leptogenesis scenario in the (3+1)d Standard Model. The anomaly-free chiral U(1) symmetries of the 3-4-5-0 model play a role analogous to the baryon-minus-lepton symmetry of the Standard Model. In both settings, charge pumping can be associated with a continuous deformation along a classically defined but quantum-anomalous direction, while a discrete subgroup remains an exact quantum symmetry.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用密度矩阵重整化群模拟，研究了在相互作用的能隙边界上，量子霍尔系统中量子化电荷泵浦的效应。研究发现，在弱耦合和强耦合下，相互作用边界附近存在无能隙模式，但在中间耦合下，边界可以处于完全有能隙的对称质量生成（SMG）相。尽管边界相不同，但所有三种边界相都表现出每个磁通量子相同的量子化电荷泵浦。
authors: Runze Chi, Meng Zeng, Tao Xiang, Yi-Zhuang You, Bertrand I. Halperin, Juven Wang

articles.title: Unitary Closed Timelike Curves can Solve all of NP
articles.title_zh: 幺正闭合类时曲线可以解决所有NP问题
articles.abstract: arXiv:2410.04630v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Born in the intersection between quantum mechanics and general relativity, indefinite causal structure is the idea that in the continuum of time, some sets of events do not have an inherent causal order between them. Process matrices, introduced by Oreshkov, Costa and Brukner (Nature Communications, 2012), define quantum information processing with indefinite causal structure -- a generalization of the operations allowed in standard quantum information processing, and to date, are the most studied such generalization. Araujo et al. (Physical Review A, 2017) defined the computational complexity of process matrices, and showed that polynomial-time process matrix computation is equivalent to standard polynomial-time quantum computation with access to a weakening of post-selection Closed Timelike Curves (CTCs), that are restricted to be linear. Araujo et al. accordingly defined the complexity class for efficient process matrix computation as BQPₑₗₗ CTC (which trivially contains BQP), and posed the open question of whether BQPₑₗₗ CTC contains computational tasks that are outside BQP. In this work we solve this open question under a widely believed hardness assumption, by showing that NP subseteq BQPₑₗₗ CTC. Our solution is captured by an even more restricted subset of process matrices that are purifiable (Araujo et al., Quantum, 2017), which (1) is conjectured more likely to be physical than arbitrary process matrices, and (2) is equivalent to polynomial-time quantum computation with access to unitary (which are in particular linear) post-selection CTCs. Conceptually, our work shows that the previously held belief, that non-linearity is what enables CTCs to solve NP, is false, and raises the importance of understanding whether purifiable process matrices are physical or not.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有不确定因果结构的量子信息处理，特别是过程矩阵的计算复杂性。先前研究表明，多项式时间过程矩阵计算等价于具有弱化后选择闭合类时曲线（CTCs）的标准多项式时间量子计算。本工作解决了BQPₑₗₗ CTC是否包含BQP之外的计算任务这一开放问题，并证明了幺正闭合类时曲线能够解决所有NP问题。
authors: Omri Shmueli

articles.title: Explicit construction of a 2-design of m̊ U(2) from the theory of angular momentum
articles.title_zh: 基于角动量理论显式构造U(2)的2-设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.17127v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The main aim of this work is to present an explicit construction of a 2-design of m̊ U(2), relying only on a tool that belongs to every physicists toolbox: the theory of angular momentum. Unitary designs are a rich and fundamental mathematical topic, with numerous fruitful applications in quantum information science and technology. In this work we take a peek under the hood. We begin with a minimal set of definitions and characterizations. Then we derive all 1-designs of m̊ U(2) of minimum size. Finally, we set out, step by step, a completion procedure extending such 1-designs to 2-designs. In particular, starting from the Pauli basis n̆icodex2014 the prototypical unitary 1-design n̆icodex2014 one n̆icodex201Cnaturallyn̆icodex201D obtains the 2-design originally employed by Bennett and coauthors in Mixed State Entanglement and Quantum Error Correction. The present work also serves as a gentle and largely self-contained introduction to the subject.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文旨在利用角动量理论，显式构造U(2)的2-设计。研究首先给出了幺正设计的定义和特性，然后推导了所有最小尺寸的U(2)的1-设计。在此基础上，作者逐步提出了将1-设计扩展到2-设计的完备化过程，并展示了从泡利基出发如何自然地得到Bennett等人使用的2-设计。
authors: Rocco Maggi, Cosmo Lupo, Saverio Pascazio

articles.title: A k-entanglement measure complying with the many-body resource theory and its evaluation
articles.title_zh: 符合多体资源理论的k-纠缠度量及其评估
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.12588v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: k-entanglement provides a hierarchical characterization of multipartite correlations according to their entanglement structure, ranging from multipartite entanglement (k=n) to genuine multipartite entanglement (k=2). Its quantitative treatment for mixed states faces three related obstacles: the standard axioms for such quantifications does not incorporate the requirements from many-body resource theory, as it does not regulate how to quantify the entanglement assigned to part systems of the same multipartite state and how to describe the rule that the entanglement possessed by a part system never exceeds the entanglement possed by whole system; no explicit measures are known that satisfy the above requirements from many-body resource theory; and the extreme difficulty in numerical evaluation at mixed states of known quantifications. In this work, we first formulate an axiomatic framework for emphtrue k-entanglement measures that obeys the many-body resource theory, by supplementing usual faithfulness and LOCC monotonicity with two new ones: unification condition and hierarchy condition. Then, for every 2łeq kłeq n, we construct a witness-based true k-entanglement measure E_w⁽k,ⁿ⁾ without the convex-roof extension, which is valid for both finite- and infinite-dimensional n-partite systems. Finally, we derive a method of constructing finite-dimensional k-entanglement witnesses from positive operator and k-separable-state optimizations, design an evaluation scheme of E_w⁽k,ⁿ⁾ based on pre-established database of k-entanglement witnesses sampled by positive operators. To check the feasibility of this computing scheme, we develop a software tool, which implements the computation of the approximation of E_w⁽k,ⁿ⁾ for systems up to four qubits. Numerical tests show that the software is sufficiently accurate and reliable.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对混合态k-纠缠的量化问题，提出了一个符合多体资源理论的公理化框架。该框架通过引入统一条件和层级条件，补充了传统的忠实性和LOCC单调性要求。在此基础上，研究为每个2≤k≤n构造了一个显式的k-纠缠度量，旨在克服现有量化方法在数值评估上的困难。
authors: Jie Guo, Shuyuan Yang, Jinchuan Hou, Xiaofei Qi, Kan He

articles.title: Quantum Noise Spectroscopy of Nanoscale Charge Defects in Silicon Carbide at Room Temperature
articles.title_zh: 室温下碳化硅纳米级电荷缺陷的量子噪声谱学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.22521v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The nanoscale charge environment critically influences the performance of semiconductor devices, yet traditional characterization techniques usually lack the spatial resolution to resolve nanoscale charge heterogeneity and identify microscopic noise sources. Here, we address this critical gap by utilizing individual PL5 color centers in commercial silicon carbide as room-temperature, broadband (near-DC to GHz) quantum spectrometers. We report the first real-time, nanoscale observation of single-charge tunneling dynamics at room temperature in 4H-SiC by monitoring the random telegraph noise using optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR). This capability enables an electrical noise imaging technique that shows distinct noise variations on different wafers. Employing dynamical decoupling and T₁ relaxation spectroscopy, we observe correlations of noise spectral density across frequency bands and obtain the nanoscale electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) fingerprint of spin defects in SiC. Ultimately, through surface chemical engineering, we identify the native oxide layer as the main source of resolved electromagnetic fluctuations. This work establishes a versatile atomic-scale metrology platform bridging quantum sensing and semiconductor engineering, offering critical insights for optimizing third-generation semiconductor interfaces and advancing solid-state quantum technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用商用碳化硅中的PL5色心作为室温、宽带量子光谱仪，首次实现了对4H-SiC中单电荷隧穿动力学的实时纳米级观测。通过光学探测磁共振（ODMR）监测随机电报噪声，研究开发了一种电噪声成像技术，并观察到不同晶圆上明显的噪声变化。最终，通过表面化学工程，研究确定了原生氧化层是电磁波动的主要来源。
authors: Jinpeng Liu, Yuanhong Teng, Yu Chen, Yixuan Wang, Sen Luan, Chihang Luo, Jun Yin, Hao Li, Lixing You, Qiang Li, Chunming Yin, Ya Wang, Qi Zhang, Fazhan Shi

articles.title: On the average-case complexity of learning states from the circular and Gaussian ensembles
articles.title_zh: 关于学习圆形和高斯系综状态的平均情况复杂性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.10197v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Studying the complexity of states sampled from various ensembles is a central component of quantum information theory. In this work we establish the average-case hardness of learning, in the statistical query model, the Born distributions of states sampled uniformly from the compact symmetric spaces of type AI, AII, and DIII. These ensembles correspond in various senses to the so called circular and (fermionic) Gaussian ensembles. This finding complements analogous recent results for states sampled from the classical compact groups. On the technical side, we employ a somewhat unconventional approach to integrating over the compact groups which may be of some independent interest. For example, our approach allows us to exactly evaluate the total variation distances between the output distributions of Haar random unitary and orthogonal circuits and the constant distribution, which were previously known only approximately.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了从圆形和高斯系综中采样的量子态的学习复杂性。研究在统计查询模型中，确立了学习从AI、AII和DIII型紧致对称空间均匀采样的态的Born分布的平均情况硬度。此外，本文还提出了一种积分紧致群的非常规方法，该方法能够精确评估Haar随机幺正和正交电路输出分布与常数分布之间的总变差距离。
authors: Maxwell West

articles.title: Graph-theory measures capture weak ergodicity breaking on large quantum systems
articles.title_zh: 图论度量捕捉大型量子系统中的弱遍历性破缺
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.00094v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the onset of weak ergodicity violations in closed quantum many-body systems and focus on cases in which they occur through a transition that is controlled by a model parameter, a scenario called a weak ergodicity-breaking transition. This situation is realized in the Rosenzweig-Porter model and the quantum sun model, which we investigate here. Our analysis is based on representing quantum systems in Fock space and examining the short-time dynamics of density autocorrelation functions. From these, we extract proxies for decay rates for each individual basis state. As a first main result, we show that the distribution of such decay rates captures known weak ergodicity-breaking transitions in both models. As a second main result, we establish a connection between the decay rates of density autocorrelations and graph-theoretical measures. Concretely, we demonstrate that moments of the distribution of the recently introduced graph-energy centrality also detect the weak ergodicity transitions, which is inherited from the behavior of the decay rates. While most numerical tools are limited to small system sizes, the quantities studied in our work can be calculated analytically for large systems of many hundreds of sites and in some cases, even in the thermodynamic limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了封闭量子多体系统中弱遍历性破缺的发生，特别是通过模型参数控制的弱遍历性破缺转变。研究基于Fock空间表示和密度自相关函数的短时动力学，发现衰减率的分布能够捕捉Rosenzweig-Porter模型和量子太阳模型中已知的弱遍历性破缺转变。此外，本文还建立了密度自相关函数的衰减率与图论度量之间的联系，表明图能量中心性分布的矩也能检测到弱遍历性转变。
authors: Heiko Georg Menzler, Rafał Świketek, Mari Carmen Bañuls, Fabian Heidrich-Meisner

articles.title: Entanglement cost in non-local quantum computation
articles.title_zh: 非局域量子计算中的纠缠代价
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.02840v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This is a book-length treatment of the subject of non-local quantum computation (NLQC). NLQC is a method for implementing quantum operations that interact two systems without directly bringing the systems together. Instead, a single round of communication and shared entanglement is used. NLQC has appeared in the context of quantum cryptography, computational complexity, communication complexity, quantum gravity, and other applications. The understanding of entanglement cost in NLQC is closely tied to questions in all of these areas. We review upper and lower bounds on entanglement cost, as well as some of the applications of NLQC and its connections to other subjects.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对非局域量子计算（NLQC）进行了全面的论述。NLQC是一种通过单轮通信和共享纠缠来实现两个系统相互作用的量子操作方法。文中回顾了NLQC中纠缠代价的上限和下限，并探讨了NLQC在量子密码学、计算复杂性、通信复杂性、量子引力等领域的应用及其与其他主题的联系。
authors: Alex May

articles.title: Syndrome resampling enhances quantum error correction thresholds
articles.title_zh: 综合重采样增强量子纠错阈值
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.06101v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum error correction (QEC) enables fault-tolerant quantum computation but requires operating quantum hardware at physical error rates below code-dependent thresholds, which remains challenging for current devices. We introduce syndrome resampling, a general method that increases QEC thresholds of any decoder and suppresses logical errors without additional hardware, decoding modifications, or code-specific assumptions beyond syndrome statistics. The method exploits the fact that syndromes with low probability are likely to lead to logical failure, therefore biasing syndrome averages towards most likely syndromes effectively increases logical fidelities. We establish a direct connection between the Rényi coherent information (RCI) and powers of the syndrome probability distribution, showing that resampling syndromes according to these powers combined with maximum likelihood decoding (MLD) realizes a family of optimal thresholds associated with phase transitions in the RCI. Numerical simulations of surface codes demonstrate that syndrome resampling substantially increases thresholds for both optimal and suboptimal decoders and reduces logical error rates by up to four orders of magnitude in experimentally relevant regimes. We further show that syndrome resampling can be effectively implemented from finite data and combined with decoding-based post-selection to achieve additional gains. Finally, applying the method to existing experimental QEC data yields up to two orders of magnitude reduction in logical error rates without requiring additional measurements. Our results provide a practical and decoder-agnostic route to improved logical fidelities in near-term QEC experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了一种名为“综合重采样”的通用方法，旨在提高量子纠错（QEC）的阈值并抑制逻辑错误。该方法通过偏置综合平均值向最可能出现的综合，有效提升逻辑保真度。研究建立了Rényi相干信息与综合概率分布幂之间的直接联系，并数值模拟表明，综合重采样显著提高了表面码在最优和次优解码器下的阈值。
authors: Luis Colmenarez, Áron Márton, Markus Müller

articles.title: Time Crystals on Quantum Devices
articles.title_zh: 量子设备上的时间晶体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.27211v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Time crystals are nonequilibrium phases of matter characterized by the emergence of temporal ordering, in which an interacting many-body system develops robust structure in its time evolution that is not trivially dictated by the external driving or environment. While related phenomena have long been studied in classical nonlinear systems, their realization in entangled quantum matter represents a distinct frontier. The theoretical understanding of discrete time crystals has substantially advanced, yet recent experiments using modern quantum devices and quantum processors reveal regimes beyond established paradigms. These developments call for an extended classification of time-crystalline phases according to both their stabilization mechanisms and their physical character, including discrete and continuous, closed and open, critical, topological, quasiperiodic, and controlled realizations. We review recent implementations of time crystals on quantum platforms and propose such a classification framework, identifying promising directions for the discovery of novel time-crystalline phases of matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文综述了量子设备上时间晶体的实现，并提出了一个分类框架。时间晶体是一种非平衡态物质，其特征是时间序的出现，即相互作用的多体系统在时间演化中形成稳健的结构。文章回顾了离散时间晶体的理论进展，并讨论了现代量子设备和处理器中超越现有范式的实验结果，旨在识别发现新型时间晶体相的有前景方向。
authors: Gonzalo Camacho, Benedikt Fauseweh

articles.title: Non-Hermiticity of an anomalous superradiant phase
articles.title_zh: 反常超辐射相的非厄米性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26770v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a Hermitian squeezing-Dicke model as a minimal closed-system setting for non-Hermitian many-body physics. Squeezing generates an effective parity-time (PT) symmetry and exchanges gainy and lossy eigenmodes without dissipation. We identify an anomalous dynamical superradiant phase (DSRP) that exhibits by a mean-field superradiant order in the PT symmetry-breaking regime, accompanied by a Z₂₋ₛymmetry-breaking ground-state quantum phase transition. Additionally, it undergoes a PT-breaking dynamical phase transition at an exceptional point (EP). The excitation energy vanishes near both boundaries, giving critical slowing down. The vacuum photon number is divergent at the ground-state transition but is finite and nonanalytic at the EP, distinguishing the DSRP from the conventional superradiant phase and from a standard dynamical instability. Squeezing causes the coupling phase to act as an artificial magnetic flux, which yields flux-controlled nonreciprocal quantum amplification in the DSRP. Our results offer an alternative pathway to non-Hermitian many-body physics and nonreciprocal quantum amplification in closed Hermitian systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个厄米挤压-迪克模型，作为非厄米多体物理的最小封闭系统设置。挤压效应产生了有效的宇称-时间（PT）对称性，并在无耗散情况下交换增益和损耗本征模式。研究识别出一个反常的动态超辐射相（DSRP），其在PT对称破缺区域表现出平均场超辐射序，并伴随Z₂对称破缺的基态量子相变。挤压还导致耦合相充当人工磁通，从而在DSRP中产生磁通控制的非互易量子放大。
authors: You-Qi Lu, Jun-Ling Wang, Qing-Hu Chen, Yu-Yu Zhang

articles.title: Toward Quantum Utility in Correlated Topological Matter: Variational Preparation of Fractional Quantum Hall Manifolds
articles.title_zh: 迈向量子实用性在关联拓扑物质中的应用：分数量子霍尔流形的变分制备
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11380v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the use of variational quantum algorithms to prepare and characterize fractional quantum Hall states on near-term quantum processors. Focusing on the ν=1/3 Laughlin phase described by the V₁ Haldane pseudopotential, we formulate the lowest-Landau-level problem in second quantization, and implement particle-number-preserving variational circuits combined with the variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) and variational quantum deflation (VQD). We benchmark the approach in two complementary geometries: Haldane sphere and torus shape. On the Haldane sphere, the target state is a unique zero-energy Laughlin ground state, providing a controlled test of the variational workflow and of excited-state reconstruction. On the torus, the problem retains the genuinely two-dimensional periodic character of the quantum Hall liquid and exhibits the threefold topological ground-state degeneracy expected for the ν=1/3 fractional filling factor. This feature makes the torus a more demanding benchmark than the quasi-one-dimensional cylinder or thin-torus limits commonly exploited in state-preparation quantum protocols. We benchmark the hardware-optimized variational states against exact diagonalization using energy estimates, error-mitigated observables, and subspace-containment diagnostics. Our results show that hybrid quantum algorithms can approximately reconstruct the low-energy structure of small fractional quantum Hall systems, including the topological ground-state manifold on the torus. Beyond serving as a benchmark for quantum hardware, this geometry-resolved approach provides a route toward quantum simulations of fractional Chern insulators and strongly correlated topological phases in realistic two-dimensional materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了利用变分量子算法在近期量子处理器上制备和表征分数量子霍尔态的方法。研究聚焦于ν=1/3的Laughlin相，并结合变分量子本征求解器（VQE）和变分量子耗散（VQD）在Haldane球和环面几何上进行了基准测试。特别强调了环面作为更具挑战性的基准，因为它保留了量子霍尔液体的二维周期性特征和三重拓扑基态简并性。
authors: Sergio F. Expósito, Unai Aseginolaza, Raúl Guerrero-Avilés, Joaquim Jornet-Somoza, Francisco Guinea, Juan Borge

articles.title: Non-Clifford quantum cellular automata from invertible topological quantum field theories
articles.title_zh: 基于可逆拓扑量子场论的非Clifford量子元胞自动机
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.21697v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum cellular automata (QCAs) describe locality-preserving quantum dynamics and link quantum information, many-body physics, and topological quantum field theory (TQFT). Constructing a QCA from a TQFT, however, remains challenging: although a topological action yields a Hamiltonian with commuting terms that realizes the desired ground state, it does not by itself specify an automorphism of the full operator algebra. We develop a unified algebraic construction that extends such Hamiltonians to complete separator-flipper algebras on the full tensor-product Hilbert space, thereby defining the corresponding QCAs microscopically. In 3 spatial dimensions, our framework unifies all previously known QCA constructions associated with the Z₈×Z₂ subgroup of the Witt group, including the U(1)₂ and U(1)₄ QCAs. The same algebraic structure yields new infinite families of generalized U(1)₂ and U(1)₄ non-Clifford QCAs in spatial dimensions d=4k-1. We also reformulate the 4-dimensional w₂w₃ QCA and use it to construct QCAs from TQFTs associated with arbitrary products of Stiefel--Whitney classes. For example, we explicitly construct two infinite families: w₂ⁿw₃^m QCAs in dimension d=2n+3m-1 and w₂w₄ₖ₋₁ QCAs in dimension d=4k. For the 5-dimensional w₃² and w₂³ QCAs, our construction gives finite-depth quantum circuits, consistent with the cobordism classification. More generally, we show that our construction yields a finite-depth quantum circuit whenever the corresponding Stiefel-Whitney number vanishes on every closed oriented manifold. Overall, these results convert invertible TQFTs into microscopic QCAs, provide higher-dimensional constructions beyond the Clifford setting, and open a systematic route to characterizing their stable structures and boundary anomalies.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子元胞自动机（QCA）描述了保持局域性的量子动力学，并与拓扑量子场论（TQFT）紧密相关。本文提出了一种统一的代数构造方法，将拓扑量子场论中的哈密顿量扩展到完整的算符代数，从而微观地定义了相应的QCA。该框架不仅统一了三维空间中已知的QCA构造，还揭示了在d=4k-1空间维度中新的非Clifford QCA家族。
authors: Meng Sun, Zongyuan Wang, Bowen Yang, Nathanan Tantivasadakarn, Yu-An Chen

articles.title: Sample complexity of quantum resource testing via one-shot quantum blurring
articles.title_zh: 通过一次性量子模糊化进行量子资源测试的样本复杂度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24712v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum resource testing is a fundamental primitive of quantum information processing, profoundly connected to resource manipulation. Its goal is to discriminate n copies of a given resourceful state h̊o from all free (i.e., resourceless) states; key instances for applications are entanglement testing and quantum magic testing. The asymptotic characterisation relies on the recently proven Generalised Quantum Stein's Lemma (GQSL), which establishes the rate of decay of the false negative error probability for a fixed false positive error probability. This result, however, is intrinsically asymptotic and thus can provide no finite-resource guarantees, which makes its practical implications unclear. Here, we establish the first rigorous finite-n bounds on quantum resource testing and hence quantum resource manipulation, thus strengthening the GQSL and providing explicit estimates on the number of copies needed to achieve a prescribed performance. As notable consequences, we obtain (a) the convergence of the regularised Rényi relative entropies of a resource, which settles the important open problem from [Fang/Hayashi, arXiv:2508.12901, IEEE ToIT 72:6, 2026]; and (b) the first sample-complexity bound for asymmetric resource testing: for any fixed false positive error probability, a false negative error probability of at most δ can be achieved with n=Ołeft(fracłog(1/δ)Dⁱⁿfty(h̊o|mathcal F)i̊ght) copies of h̊o, in the limit where δ → 0.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子资源测试是量子信息处理中的一个基本原语，与资源操控密切相关。本文首次建立了量子资源测试的严格有限-n界限，从而强化了广义量子斯坦因引理（GQSL），并提供了实现预定性能所需的副本数量的明确估计。值得注意的是，该工作还推导出了资源正则化Rényi相对熵的收敛性，解决了该领域的一个重要开放问题。
authors: Dmitry Grinko, Ludovico Lami

articles.title: Fluctuation-dissipation structure of quantum geometry
articles.title_zh: 量子几何的涨落-耗散结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25006v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Geometry of quantum states is a fundamental research area with applications ranging from topological materials in condensed matter to variational algorithms in quantum information. Due to their relative simplicity, pure states are often studied, while mixed states are generally needed, e.g., to have nonzero temperature. Mixed-state geometry, however, is much more challenging and has so far lacked any structure relating distance and curvature, like the Kähler structure does for pure states. This work introduces that structure. We show that it has the physical meaning of fluctuation-dissipation---by identifying distance with fluctuations and curvature with linear response---and that it becomes the known structure for pure states, but is non-Kähler otherwise. This paints a simple picture that unifies fluctuation-dissipation and geometry of quantum states. It also applies on parameter spaces, as encountered in condensed matter or estimation theory. Our picture implies that the geometry contains all linear responses and fluctuations, proves the fluctuation-dissipation relation, explains that quantum geometry appears in any sum rule, and allows one to geometrically characterize generic transport behaviors. Closed and open systems are treated with equal ease.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子态的几何是凝聚态物质和量子信息等领域的基础研究。本文为混合量子态引入了一种新的几何结构，将距离与涨落、曲率与线性响应联系起来，赋予其涨落-耗散的物理意义。该结构统一了量子态的涨落-耗散与几何，并适用于参数空间，表明量子几何包含了所有线性响应和涨落。
authors: Per Moosavi

articles.title: Information and reference requirements for auditing collider classifiers
articles.title_zh: 对撞机分类器审计的信息和参考要求
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02781v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Assertions about collider classifiers require observable evidence and a specified deployment reference. We distinguish the classification threshold that selects events from the claim threshold that defines acceptable performance. For fixed nominal-weighted ratio claims on a frozen finite population, we apply established assorter reductions and bounded-mean confidence sequences under independent sampling with replacement and a predeclared weight bound. The anytime-valid error control is per claim, not automatically simultaneous across claims, and is not a new statistical guarantee. In 19,680 archived paired audit-stream comparisons, changing unweighted correctness and its source reference to nominal-weighted accuracy and its own reference changed 536 supported verdicts to unresolved and 226 in the reverse direction. Scores, labels, weights and exact ratios were available before these simulated audits; their stopping times demonstrate no operational acquisition saving. A post hoc analysis of 30 finite-shot quantum-kernel realizations, with paired RAW and diagonal-loading treatments, describes sensitivity to operating rules, ideal versus realized references, and fixed versus recomposed margin groups. Verdict differences are not auditor error rates, and no quantum-specific mechanism or quantum advantage is established. A CMS open-data example supports restricted aggregate statements while event-level accuracy remains unidentified. This substantial revision withdraws the previous physical-interval coverage conclusions following numerical-validation problems; the available reevaluation does not reestablish them. The retained contribution is mathematical exposition and descriptive evidence, without methodological-priority or calibrated physical-inference claims.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了对撞机分类器断言所需的观测证据和指定部署参考。它区分了分类阈值和声明阈值，并针对固定名义加权比率声明应用了既定的分类器归约和有界均值置信序列。研究表明，改变正确性指标和参考会影响审计结果，并分析了量子核实现中对操作规则的敏感性。
authors: Roberto Fernández-Barrios, Iker Pastor-López, Asier González-Santocildes, Pablo García Bringas

articles.title: Suzuki-Trotter Decompositions and other Methods for Quantum Time Evolution
articles.title_zh: 铃木-特罗特分解及其他量子时间演化方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.19184v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: (Suzuki-)Trotter decompositions, splitting methods, (Lie) product formulae... The most common numerical methods for the time evolution of quantum systems come with many names. And they are used practically everywhere with applications ranging from the solution of classical equations of motion and various Monte Carlo simulations to the real and imaginary time evolution on classical as well as quantum computers. Here we review the state of the art of said methods, focussing especially on the progress made over the last few years. We highlight recently discovered efficient time evolution algorithms and explain how best to use them in practice. A central part of this work is the estimation of error bounds that has improved greatly within the past decade. The relevance of time evolution methods for quantum computing is discussed with a focus on noisy hardware. Finally, a comprehensive overview of generalisations, related methods and alternatives to Trotterization is provided. This includes time-dependent Hamiltonian dynamics, processed methods, multi-product formulae, symplectic integrators, TDVP for tensor networks, quantum signal processing, Crouch-Grossman methods and more. The overall perspective in this work is that of a theoretical physicist. All mathematical proofs as well as some technical details are omitted for easier readability. Instead, this review serves as a hands-on guide and, of course, as a starting point for references that provide further details.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文综述了铃木-特罗特分解及其他量子系统时间演化方法，重点介绍了近年来取得的进展。文章强调了高效时间演化算法、误差界估计的改进以及这些方法对噪声量子硬件的重要性。此外，还全面概述了特罗特分解的推广、相关方法和替代方案。
authors: Johann Ostmeyer

articles.title: Resonant analogue configurations in atomic condensates
articles.title_zh: 原子凝聚体中的共振模拟配置
articles.abstract: arXiv:2406.10027v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: As a contribution to a memorial volume, we provide a comprehensive discussion of resonant configurations in analogue gravity, focusing on its implementation in atomic condensates and combining review features with original insights and calculations. In particular, we jointly analyze the analogues of the Andreev and Hawking effects using a microscopic description based on the Bogoliubov approximation. We perform a detailed study of the thermality of the Andreev and Hawking spectra for canonical black-hole solutions, finding that both can be described by a gray-body distribution to a very good approximation. We contemplate several resonant scenarios whose efficiency to enhance anomalous scattering processes is compared to that of non-resonant setups. The presence of quantum signatures in analogue configurations, such as the violation of Cauchy-Schwarz inequalities or entanglement, is analyzed, observing that resonant configurations highly increase the entanglement signal, especially for the Andreev effect. We also discuss how these results have served as inspiration for the rapidly expanding field of quantum information in high-energy colliders. Finally, we study the physics of black-hole lasers as further examples of resonant analogue structures, distinguishing three stages in its time evolution. For short times, we compute the linear and non-linear spectrum for different models. For intermediate times, we generalize the current analysis of the BHL-BCL crossover. For long times, we discuss the emerging concept of spontaneous Floquet state and its potential implications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文全面探讨了模拟引力中的共振配置，特别是在原子凝聚体中的实现。研究使用微观Bogoliubov近似分析了Andreev和Hawking效应，发现其谱线具有热性。该工作比较了共振和非共振设置在增强反常散射过程中的效率，并观察到共振配置显著增强了纠缠信号，尤其是在Andreev效应中。
authors: Juan Ramón Muñoz de Nova, Pablo Fernández Palacios, Pedro Alcázar Guerrero, Ivar Zapata, Fernando Sols

articles.title: SKFitter: Symmetry resolved Slater Koster tight-binding models from first principles for s, p, d and f electrons, spin orbit coupling and magnetism
articles.title_zh: SKFitter：基于第一性原理的s、p、d和f电子、自旋轨道耦合和磁性的对称分辨Slater Koster紧束缚模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40729v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Constructing accurate and physically interpretable tight binding (TB) Hamiltonians from first principles calculations remains challenging, particularly for materials exhibiting complex orbital hybridization, spin orbit coupling (SOC), and magnetic order. SKFitter is an open-source Python framework for constructing and optimizing symmetry resolved Slater Koster TB models directly from density functional theory (DFT) calculations performed using Quantum ESPRESSO or VASP. The framework supports s to f orbitals, incorporates on site SOC and site resolved magnetic exchange interactions, and accommodates both orthogonal and nonorthogonal basis. A central feature is the symmetry resolved parameterization of orbital manifolds, which allows independent two centre hopping integrals between symmetry allowed orbital groups and across distinct neighbour shells. SKFitter also identifies missing orbital contributions and guide systematic basis set refinement and optimizes parameters through weights. The resulting Hamiltonian can be used to evaluate anomalous (AHC) and spin Hall conductivities (SHC), and topological invariants. We demonstrate the framework using eight representative materials spanning semimetals, semiconductors, transition metals, f-electron compounds, and magnetic systems. Symmetry resolved models achieve band energy errors of 9 to 41 meV within 1 eV of the Fermi level. The fitted Hamiltonians reproduce characteristic features of the SHC response of Pt, the SOC dependence of the AHC of Fe, and the momentum dependent altermagnetic spin splitting of MnTe without any altermagnet specific interaction. For EuMn2Bi2, projection guided orbital refinement reduces the near Fermi level fitting error from 120 to 32 meV. Together, these results establish SKFitter as a flexible and reproducible framework for developing symmetry consistent, physically interpretable TB models of complex materials.
articles.abstract_zh: SKFitter是一个开源Python框架，用于从密度泛函理论计算中构建和优化对称分辨的Slater Koster紧束缚模型。该框架支持s到f轨道、自旋轨道耦合和磁交换相互作用，并可处理正交和非正交基。SKFitter的核心特点是轨道流形的对称分辨参数化，这使得能够评估反常霍尔电导、自旋霍尔电导和拓扑不变量。
authors: Sundeep Kapila, Bhaskaran Muralidharan, Satadeep Bhattacharjee

articles.title: Cavity-engineered ferroelectricity in SrTiO₃
articles.title_zh: 腔体工程化SrTiO₃中的铁电性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40756v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interfacing quantum materials with photonic cavity architectures is at the vanguard of materials engineering. The structured electromagnetic fluctuations of a dark cavity environment can renormalize fundamental thermodynamical material properties and energy scales, holding promise to create a rich ecosystem of cavity-induced ground states and functionalities absent in the bare material. However, direct experimental demonstrations that cavity coupling can stabilize or enhance genuinely new phases of matter have remained scarce. In this work, we establish the presence of cavity-induced and cavity-enhanced ferroelectric phases in free-standing SrTiO₃ membranes coupled to dark THz-frequency photonic crystal cavities. Using THz spectroscopy, we observe ultrastrong coupling (USC) between the ferroelectric soft mode in SrTiO₃ and the cavity resonance. The structural response of SrTiO₃ to this USC is measured via second harmonic generation imaging, which reveals a substantial (greater than 400%) enhancement of signal in the cavity environment and a distinct modification of the crystalline symmetry, indicating the onset and enhancement of ferroelectricity. We interpret these observations as resulting from renormalized piezoelectric and flexoelectric couplings, which in turn arise from the cavity-modified dielectric environment. This interpretation is supported with microscopic modeling via DFT-based multi-scale dynamics simulations and by macroscopic Ginzburg-Landau theory. Altogether, our experimental and theoretical results firmly confirm that cavity engineering can indeed be used to create new ground states in materials and enhance existing ones. This work establishes a new paradigm for materials engineering with direct applications for quantum transduction, quantum sensing, and nonlinear integrated photonics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了在与暗太赫兹光子晶体腔耦合的独立SrTiO₃薄膜中，腔体诱导和增强的铁电相。通过太赫兹光谱，研究观察到SrTiO₃中铁电软模式与腔体共振之间的超强耦合。二次谐波成像揭示了信号的显著增强和晶体对称性的改变，表明了铁电性的产生和增强。
authors: Omar Mehio, Sylvia Griffitt, Andrew Pierce, Emil V. Bostrom, Hanbyul Kim, Dylan P. Sotir, Darrell G. Schlom, Simone Latini, Kin Fai Mak, Jie Shan, Dongbin Shin, Angel Rubio, Ankit S. Disa

articles.title: Airy distribution of the quenched spectral form factor in non-interacting fermions
articles.title_zh: 非相互作用费米子中淬火谱形因子的艾里分布
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41393v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: For chaotic many-body systems as well as the random energy model, the logarithm of the (scaled) spectral form factor (SFF) exhibits two robust properties at late times: (i) self-averaging and (ii) a reflected-Gumbel distribution. Here, we demonstrate that both properties break down for N non-interacting fermions on a lattice of size L with an incommensurate single-particle spectrum. We show that the logarithm of the SFF, upon rescaling by 1/sqrtL, follows the Airy distribution, in stark contrast to the reflected-Gumbel law. Moreover, it is no longer self-averaging, as its mean and standard deviation are of the same order. While deviations from reflected-Gumbel statistics are generically expected for non-interacting systems, we find that an interacting integrable model exhibits reflected-Gumbel statistics at late times, mirroring the chaotic case and distinguishing it from non-interacting fermions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有不公度单粒子谱的晶格中非相互作用费米子的谱形因子（SFF）。研究表明，SFF的对数在重新标度后遵循艾里分布，这与混沌系统和相互作用可积系统中观察到的反射-Gumbel定律形成鲜明对比。该工作还指出，对于非相互作用费米子，SFF不再是自平均的。
authors: Oscar Martin, Satya N. Majumdar, Laura Foini

articles.title: Integer defects in active nematics of ellipsoidal Quincke rollers
articles.title_zh: 椭球形Quincke滚子活性向列相中的整数缺陷
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41463v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transverse propulsion changes topological ordering in dense ellipsoidal Quincke rollers. Under an alternating-current electric field, a polar velocity field coexists with perpendicular nematic particle alignment. The system supports integer +1 velocity vortices with radial particle axes and -1 saddle defects. Oppositely charged defects migrate along domain walls and annihilate as polar domains merge. These results identify propulsion direction relative to particle shape as a control parameter for defect textures and collective ordering.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在交流电场作用下，致密椭球形Quincke滚子活性向列相中的拓扑序变化。系统中存在极性速度场与垂直向列粒子排列共存的现象，并支持+1整数速度涡旋和-1鞍点缺陷。研究发现，带相反电荷的缺陷沿畴壁迁移并湮灭，这表明相对于粒子形状的推进方向是缺陷结构和集体有序化的一个控制参数。
authors: Bao Ying Fan, Lin Liu, Jie Wu, Chen Song, Wen-de Tian, Kang Chen, Tian Hui Zhang

articles.title: Dipolar Exciton Polarons in a van der Waals Homobilayer
articles.title_zh: 范德华同质双层中的偶极激子极化子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41730v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fermi polarons exemplify how many-body interactions give rise to emergent quasiparticles, providing a fundamental framework for understanding interacting quantum matter. In electron-doped two-dimensional semiconductors, exciton polarons offer optical access to Fermi-polaron physics and electrical tunability, yet achieving stronger and more controllable exciton-electron interactions remains a key challenge. Here, we realize dipolar exciton polarons in an electrically tunable van der Waals homobilayer, where interlayer excitons with spatially separated electrons and holes act as quantum impurities carrying permanent electric dipole moments. These dipolar polarons exhibit substantially enhanced exciton-electron interactions, with binding energies more than four times those of conventional intralayer exciton polarons. We further demonstrate that Fermi-sea layer polarization provides an additional degree of freedom for controlling many-body interactions. In particular, the presence of a Fermi sea induces hybridization between oppositely oriented dipolar polarons, whereas confining the Fermi sea to a single layer suppresses this hybridization and produces orientation-selective many-body dressing. Our findings establish an experimental platform for dipolar-polaron physics in which dipole orientation and Fermi-sea layer polarization jointly govern many-body interactions, opening a route towards electrically tunable interactions and dipolar-polaron-mediated attraction between itinerant electrons.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在电可调谐的范德华同质双层中实现了偶极激子极化子，其中层间激子作为具有永久电偶极矩的量子杂质。这些偶极极化子表现出显著增强的激子-电子相互作用，其结合能是传统层内激子极化子的四倍多。费米海层极化为控制多体相互作用提供了额外的自由度，能够诱导方向相反的偶极极化子之间的杂化。
authors: Yuxin Duan, Hongming Zhang, Yaofeng Zhu, Hang Zhou, Xinyue Zhang, Yan Liu, Song Luo, Long Zhang, Zhanghai Chen

articles.title: Pair-Condensation Peak in Radio-Frequency Dimer-Projection Spectroscopy of a Unitary Fermi Gas
articles.title_zh: 幺正费米气体射频二聚体投影光谱中的对凝聚峰
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41770v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Radio-frequency dimer-projection spectroscopy has recently emerged as a powerful probe of strongly interacting Fermi gases, yet its frequency-resolved spectrum remains largely unexplored. Here we show that the spectrum exhibits two qualitatively distinct features: a broad quasiparticle continuum governed by fermionic pairing and a sharp pair-condensation peak arising from the coherent projection of condensed Cooper pairs onto the final-state dimer. To reveal this physics, we develop a point-dimer approximation that exploits the separation between the molecular and many-body length scales and expresses the radio-frequency response directly in terms of pair correlations in the initial many-body state. Within the BCS mean-field theory, we derive the frequency-dependent spectrum, identify the microscopic transfer processes underlying its structure, and show that the continuum possesses a threshold determined by the superfluid gap. Our theory establishes radio-frequency dimer-projection spectroscopy as a unified probe of short-range correlations, fermionic pairing, and long-range coherence in strongly interacting Fermi gases.
articles.abstract_zh: 射频二聚体投影光谱是探测强相互作用费米气体的有力工具。本研究揭示了其频谱具有准粒子连续谱和尖锐的对凝聚峰两个显著特征。通过发展点二聚体近似和BCS平均场理论，作者推导了频率依赖的谱，并阐明了其微观转移过程。该理论将射频二聚体投影光谱确立为探测强相互作用费米气体中短程关联、费米子配对和长程相干性的统一探针。
authors: Zhixiu Peng, Zhenhua Yu

articles.title: Anomalies of TQFTs coupled to parameter spaces and constraints on ground-state degeneracies
articles.title_zh: 拓扑量子场论与参数空间耦合的异常及其对基态简并度的约束
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.42007v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Anomalies of global symmetries can arise in long-range entangled quantum many-body systems and provide useful constraints on their dynamics. In this paper, we study anomalies of d-dimensional topological quantum field theories (TQFTs) coupled to parameter spaces and their implications for ground-state degeneracies. Specifically, we formulate anomalies as obstructions to constructing parametrized families of TQFTs. We discuss how the classification of these anomalies depends on the choice of topology on the universal U(1) (d-1)-form symmetry. In this framework, we use the projective ground-state bundle obtained by compactifying the TQFT on a spatial manifold to derive a general constraint relating its ground-state degeneracy N to its torsion anomaly ømega, expressed as Nint_WømegainZ for bundles W of spatial manifolds over closed surfaces. We apply this constraint to ground-state degeneracies of (2+1)-dimensional TQFTs with framing and 1-form symmetry anomalies and to obstructions to symmetry-preserving TQFTs. We also discuss implications for bordism generators and propose a conjecture on anomaly detection by manifolds fibered over surfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了d维拓扑量子场论（TQFTs）与参数空间耦合时出现的异常，以及这些异常对基态简并度的影响。作者将异常表述为构建参数化TQFTs族的障碍，并探讨了其分类如何依赖于U(1) (d-1)形式对称性的拓扑选择。在此框架下，推导了一个将基态简并度N与其挠率异常ømega联系起来的普遍约束。该工作为理解量子多体系统中的异常和基态性质提供了新的视角。
authors: Takamasa Ando, Ryan Thorngren

articles.title: Quantum 3xplorer: AI-Native Engine for Next-Generation Quantum Materials Modeling
articles.title_zh: Quantum 3xplorer：下一代量子材料建模的AI原生引擎
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.42108v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum-mechanical approaches, such as density functional theory (DFT), underpin much of modern computational materials science and are the primary source of data for AI-driven discovery. Yet the established electronic-structure codes today represent decades-old software architectures, making new physical models slow and costly to implement, validate, and deploy on emerging hardware. We present Quantum 3xplorer (Q3, pronounced "Quantum Explorer"), an AI-native quantum simulation engine written from scratch by AI coding agents under the direction and supervision of domain scientists. As a first and demanding validation case, we implement plane-wave pseudopotential DFT end to end: norm-conserving, ultrasoft, and projector-augmented-wave formalisms, spin polarization, DFT+U, and dispersion corrections, together with forces, stresses, structural relaxation, and electronic-structure analysis. Q3 reproduces established reference implementations, runs faster on a single core in representative benchmarks, and scales across GPU-accelerated supercomputers. It was developed in weeks rather than years. Its layered, physics-first architecture separates abstract quantum-mechanical concepts from their numerical representations, making its framework extendable beyond plane waves to other basis sets and levels of theory. Its inputs and outputs follow structured, schema-validated data standards, making every result AI-ready. Q3 is open source under Apache 2.0 and built to be reused, extended, and improved by the research community. Q3 points to a paradigm shift in how computational quantum science is done. Scientists define the physics, formulate the models, and set the criteria for validation; AI agents write, test, and optimize the code. The decades-long path from a new theory to a trusted, high-performance implementation can thus collapse to days, significantly accelerating scientific discovery.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了Quantum 3xplorer (Q3)，一个由AI编码代理在领域科学家指导下从零开始编写的AI原生量子模拟引擎。Q3旨在解决现有电子结构代码架构老旧、新物理模型实现困难的问题。作为验证案例，Q3端到端实现了平面波赝势DFT，包括多种形式和修正，并能进行结构弛豫和电子结构分析。Q3不仅重现了现有参考实现的结果，在单核基准测试中运行更快，并能扩展到GPU加速的超级计算机，其开发周期也大大缩短。
authors: Vsevolod Biryukov, Sergey V. Barabash, Pranab Kumar Das, Jack Deslippe, Mauro Del Ben, Felipe H. da Jornada, Yuming Shi, Johannes Voss, Zhenglu Li, Piero Altoe, Kamal Choudhary, Ruth Pachter, Steven G. Louie, Marvin L. Cohen, Timur Bazhirov

articles.title: Observation of light-induced Haldane gap in graphene
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯中光致霍尔丹能隙的观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.42115v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Symmetry and topology, encoded in electronic wavefunctions, play a central role in the electronic properties and emergent phenomena of quantum materials. While these properties are conventionally determined by the equilibrium Hamiltonian, strong optical fields offer a fundamentally different route by reshaping the Hamiltonian on ultrafast timescales, turning symmetry and topology into dynamically controllable degrees of freedom. Graphene provides a paradigmatic platform for realizing this concept, where circularly polarized light has long been predicted to dynamically break time-reversal symmetry (TRS) and open a topologically nontrivial gap at the Dirac point. Despite extensive experimental efforts, direct observation of this Dirac gap-the defining spectroscopic signature of the dynamical TRS-breaking induced topological phase-has remained missing. Here we directly observe this light-induced Dirac gap in monolayer graphene. Time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy reveals that the gap emerges simultaneously with the optical field and exclusively under circularly polarized driving, directly linking its opening to dynamical TRS breaking. Together with Floquet theory, we identify the gap with a light-induced Haldane mass and reveal the associated nontrivial Floquet Berry curvature and Chern topology. By demonstrating dynamical TRS breaking in a prototypical non-magnetic material, our results establish optical driving as a route to ultrafast engineering of symmetry and topology, opening opportunities for dynamically tunable quantum matter beyond equilibrium.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文直接观测到了单层石墨烯中光致的狄拉克能隙，这是动态时间反演对称性破缺诱导拓扑相的关键光谱特征。研究表明，强光学场可以通过超快时间尺度重塑哈密顿量，从而动态控制材料的对称性和拓扑性质。通过时间分辨和角度分辨光电子能谱，作者发现该能隙与光学场同时出现，且仅在圆偏振光驱动下产生，直接证实了其与动态时间反演对称性破缺的关联。这一发现为利用光场调控量子材料的拓扑性质提供了实验证据。
authors: Fei Wang, Xuanxi Cai, Wanying Chen, Xiao Tang, Jinze Li, Benshu Fan, Tianshuang Sheng, Jinxi Lu, Jiansong Li, Hongyun Zhang, Pu Yu, Peizhe Tang, Wenhui Duan, Angel Rubio, Zhiyuan Sun, Shuyun Zhou

articles.title: Chiral Majorana hinge modes on a curved surface with magnetic impurities
articles.title_zh: 弯曲表面上带磁性杂质的手性马约拉纳铰链模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2310.09258v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Chiral Majorana modes, a key ingredient for topological quantum computation, arise on the surface of a three-dimensional time-reversal-invariant topological superconductor when a magnetic field induces a sign-changing surface mass. In practice, the orbital response of the superconductor tilts the surface spectrum and overwhelms the Zeeman term as the field grows. Here we show that magnetic impurities on a spherical surface can instead generate this mass term through their exchange coupling, so that only a weak field is required. The Ising surface Majorana modes mediate a ferromagnetic Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida (RKKY) interaction, derived here on the curved surface, that orders the radial impurity moments into an inversion-breaking hedgehog at zero field. An axial field instead stabilizes a domain wall across which the radial magnetization reverses sign, leaving a single chiral Majorana mode along the equator and realizing an inversion-protected second-order topological superconductor.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在弯曲表面上引入磁性杂质如何产生手性马约拉纳模式，这对于拓扑量子计算至关重要。作者发现，球形表面上的磁性杂质可以通过交换耦合产生符号变化的表面质量项，从而仅需弱磁场即可实现。这些伊辛表面马约拉纳模式介导了铁磁RKKY相互作用，在零场下使径向杂质磁矩形成一个反演对称破缺的“刺猬”结构。施加轴向磁场则能稳定一个畴壁，沿赤道留下单一手性马约拉纳模式，从而实现反演保护的二阶拓扑超导体。
authors: Ilyoun Na, James G. McHugh, Sinéad M. Griffin, Luca Chirolli

articles.title: Exact Generalized Langevin Dynamics of Pair Coordinates in Elastic Networks
articles.title_zh: 弹性网络中对坐标的精确广义朗之万动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.08320v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Generalized Langevin equations (GLEs) provide a powerful framework for describing slow dynamics in soft-matter systems, but deriving an exact GLE for a reaction coordinate from an underlying many-body system remains generally difficult. Here, we analytically derive an exact coupled GLE for the overdamped dynamics of two tagged beads in arbitrary harmonic elastic networks. We further derive an exact GLE for their relative coordinate. The memory kernel and effective restoring force are expressed explicitly in terms of the network matrices, thereby providing a systematic reduction of the high-dimensional network dynamics to a pair coordinate. Within the small-displacement approximation, we further derive a GLE for the inter-bead distance, a central observable in distance-sensitive single-molecule experiments. These results therefore have broad potential applications in modeling proteins and other soft-matter systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 广义朗之万方程（GLEs）是描述软物质系统慢动力学的有力工具。本研究解析推导了任意谐波弹性网络中两个标记珠子过阻尼动力学的精确耦合GLE，并进一步推导了其相对坐标的精确GLE。记忆核和有效恢复力通过网络矩阵明确表达，实现了高维网络动力学到对坐标的系统性降维。在小位移近似下，作者还推导了珠间距离的GLE，这在单分子实验中是一个核心可观测值。这些结果在蛋白质和其他软物质系统建模中具有广泛的应用潜力。
authors: Shunsuke Ando, Tomoya Urashita, Soya Shinkai, Tomoshige Miyaguchi

articles.title: Stacking-Directed Polarization and Excitonic Engineering in MoS₂/MoSe₂ van der Waals Heterostructures
articles.title_zh: MoS₂/MoSe₂范德华异质结构中的堆叠定向极化和激子工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.22014v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The stacking-dependent polarization and excitonic response of MoS₂/MoSe₂ heterostructures were investigated using GW+BSE many-body perturbation theory. While homobilayer MoS₂ exhibited a switchable interlayer dipole driven by registry-induced symmetry breaking, the MoS₂/MoSe₂ hetero-interface remained pinned by the intrinsic chemical potential mismatch between sulfur and selenium. In 2L-MoS₂/MoSe₂ trilayers, the stacking sequence enabled a deterministic control of photogenerated electrons between the central and bottom MoS₂ layers, governed by internal electric fields and quasiparticle band-edge shifts of 60--70~meV. Our calculations predicted a 36~meV interlayer excitonic shift, in remarkable agreement with recent experiments. These results elucidate the microscopic link between atomic registry and many-body interactions, establishing transition metal dichalcogenide trilayers as a potential platform for sliding ferroelectricity and programmable optoelectronic functionalities.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用GW+BSE多体微扰理论研究了MoS₂/MoSe₂异质结构中堆叠依赖的极化和激子响应。研究发现，在2L-MoS₂/MoSe₂三层结构中，堆叠序列能够确定性地控制光生电子在中心和底部MoS₂层之间的转移，这受内部电场和准粒子能带边缘位移的影响。计算预测的36 meV层间激子位移与实验结果高度吻合。这些发现阐明了原子排列与多体相互作用之间的微观联系，表明过渡金属二硫化物三层结构在滑动铁电和可编程光电功能方面具有应用潜力。
authors: Mohammed El Amine Miloudi, Oliver Kühn

articles.title: Level statistics in the fractal phase of generalized Rosenzweig--Porter models
articles.title_zh: 广义Rosenzweig--Porter模型分形相中的能级统计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.09444v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Rosenzweig--Porter (RP) random matrix ensemble has emerged as a minimal model for the integrability-to-chaos crossover in quantum many-body systems. Its phase diagram features a region with fractal eigenstates, exhibiting intermediate spectral and localization properties between the fully localized and fully delocalized regimes. In this work, we explore several generalizations of the RP model and determine their level statistics at the scale of the Thouless energy E_T, which characterizes the crossover. Using tools from free probability theory and the replica method, we compute the full counting statistics in the limit of large system size, and show that it takes a simple, universal scaling form around E_T, shared across all variations of the model. We validate our analytical predictions using exact numerical diagonalization of large samples, and large-deviation algorithms that resolve the full counting statistics down to probabilities as low as 10⁻⁴⁰. We also contrast our predictions with measurements on the quantum random energy model, which is the simplest model displaying many-body localization.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了广义Rosenzweig--Porter (RP) 模型的能级统计，该模型是量子多体系统中可积性到混沌转变的最小模型。RP模型相图中存在一个具有分形本征态的区域，其光谱和局域化性质介于完全局域化和完全离域化之间。作者利用自由概率论和副本方法，计算了在大系统尺寸极限下的完整计数统计量，并发现其在Thouless能量E_T附近呈现出简单、普适的标度形式。这些分析预测通过数值对角化和大数据量算法得到了验证，为理解量子多体系统的中间相提供了深入见解。
authors: Victor Delapalme, Leticia F. Cugliandolo, Alexander K. Hartmann, Marco Tarzia, Davide Venturelli

articles.title: Tensor-Network Inference in a Field-Coupled XY Model for Portfolio Allocation
articles.title_zh: 场耦合XY模型中用于投资组合分配的张量网络推断
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05045v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We apply tensor-network methods to a field-coupled XY model for long-only portfolio construction. Daily return statistics set asset-specific fields and correlation couplings. Correlation distance, four-point Gromov hyperbolicity, and Ward clustering are used to construct a sparse interaction path. A Fourier-Bessel expansion maps the continuous angular partition function to a finite-current tensor network; bottom-up and top-down contractions then give the one-site marginals and equilibrium cosine scores. A softmax map converts these scores into positive, fully invested portfolio weights. We study five equity markets over continuous ranges of inverse temperature beta and concentration gamma, and compare selected parameter pairs with long-only Markowitz frontiers and standard benchmarks. The same-sample comparisons demonstrate a tractable route from financial time series to network-adjusted allocations; predictive trading performance is outside their scope.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将张量网络方法应用于场耦合XY模型，以构建仅限多头（long-only）的投资组合。研究利用日收益统计数据设置资产特定场和相关耦合，并通过相关距离、四点Gromov双曲性和Ward聚类构建稀疏相互作用路径。傅里叶-贝塞尔展开将连续角配分函数映射到有限电流张量网络，进而得到单点边际和平衡余弦分数。这些分数通过softmax映射转换为正的、完全投资的投资组合权重。该方法为从金融时间序列到网络调整分配提供了一条可行途径。
authors: Kartikeya Chowdhry, G Subrahmanya V. R. K. Rao

articles.title: Lattice Realizations of Flat Gauging and T-duality Defects at Any Radius
articles.title_zh: 任意半径下平坦规范和T-对偶缺陷的格点实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.09126v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We analyze non-invertible topological interfaces and defects in the two-dimensional compact boson, focusing on the more exotic ones obtained by gauging continuous symmetries with flat connections on a half-space. These include interfaces between mutually irrational radii and T-duality symmetries at arbitrary boson radius. Using the modified Villain discretization on both a Euclidean two-dimensional square lattice and a quantum one-dimensional chain, we show that all these topological interfaces survive discretization and give rise to non-compact edge modes localized at the defect sites. Such non-compact edge modes imply a continuous defect spectrum and an infinite quantum dimension. In the special case of rational radii, we show how the defect action or Hamiltonian can be modified in order to compactify the edge modes and produce more standard defects with finite quantum dimension.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文分析了二维紧致玻色子中不可逆拓扑界面和缺陷，特别是通过在半空间上用平坦联络规范连续对称性获得的奇异缺陷。研究表明，这些拓扑界面，包括互为无理半径之间的界面和任意玻色子半径下的T-对偶对称性，在经过修正的Villain离散化后依然存在，并产生局域在缺陷位置的非紧致边缘模式。这些非紧致边缘模式意味着连续的缺陷谱和无限的量子维度。在有理半径的特殊情况下，作者展示了如何修改缺陷作用量或哈密顿量以紧致化边缘模式，从而产生具有有限量子维度的标准缺陷。
authors: Riccardo Argurio, Giovanni Galati, Nathan Godechal

articles.title: Quantum simulation of wave optics in weakly inhomogeneous media using block encoding
articles.title_zh: 使用块编码对弱非均匀介质中的波动光学进行量子模拟
articles.abstract: Author(s): Siavash Davani, Martin Gärttner, and Falk Eilenberger We propose a quantum algorithm that simulates the propagation of a light field through a weakly inhomogeneous medium. In the paraxial approximation, the wave equation in an inhomogeneous material takes the form of the Schrödinger equation with a time-dependent Hamiltonian. This reduction is used to … [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 043117] Published Mon Nov 02, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种量子算法，用于模拟光场在弱非均匀介质中的传播。在傍轴近似下，非均匀材料中的波动方程可简化为具有时变哈密顿量的薛定谔方程。该研究利用这种简化，为波动光学在量子计算机上的模拟提供了新的途径。
authors: Siavash Davani, Martin Gärttner, and Falk Eilenberger

articles.title: Topologically protected bound states in the continuum in the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger chain
articles.title_zh: Su-Schrieffer-Heeger链中拓扑保护的连续谱束缚态
articles.abstract: Author(s): Dunkan Martínez, Rodrigo P. A. Lima, Alexander López, Francisco Domínguez-Adame, and Pedro A. Orellana Bound states in the continuum, originally proposed within the framework of quantum mechanics, have since been observed in a variety of physical contexts, including optics, acoustics, and related fields. Of particular interest are those bound states in the continuum that are protected by continuous s… [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 043118] Published Mon Nov 02, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 连续谱束缚态（BICs）最初在量子力学中提出，现已在光学、声学等多个物理领域中被观察到。本文特别关注Su-Schrieffer-Heeger链中受连续对称性保护的拓扑连续谱束缚态。该研究深入探讨了这些特殊束缚态的性质及其在拓扑物理中的应用潜力。

articles.title: Observable signatures of exceptional points from left–right eigenstate distinction
articles.title_zh: 基于左右本征态区分的奇异点可观测特征
articles.abstract: Non-Hermitian quantum systems exhibit qualitatively distinct physical behavior compared to Hermitian systems, a prime example being spectral singularities known as exceptional points (EPs). Their relevance in, e.g. quantum sensing, unidirectional transport, and robust lasing makes it important to be able to identify EPs through observable features of a many-body system. Here, using as an example a one-dimensional complex spin chain realizing both rotation-time ( )- and parity-time ( )-symmetric regimes, we develop a framework for detecting EPs based on the distinction between left and right eigenvectors of the Hamiltonian, which in a non-Hermitian system are no longer the adjoint of each other. We first show that a global measure constructed from the difference between the Hamiltonian and its adjoint locates EPs via distinct non-analytic behavior. At the level of observables, differences in local spin correlations evaluated on the right and left eigenstates provide a reliable static detection scheme. In contrast, static bipartite entanglement measures fail to capture this distinction, urging us to study the quantum dynamics of the model. Following a sudden quench, we demonstrate that the time-averaged right–left entanglement entropy difference directly encodes signatures of the EP. In the -symmetric regime, it exhibits a pronounced peak at the EP, whereas in the -symmetric regime it behaves as an order-parameter-like quantity, remaining finite in one phase and vanishing at the transition. Our results establish a direct link between the structure of non-Hermitian eigenstates and observable signatures of EPs, providing a practical route to identify them in existing quantum simulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 非厄米量子系统展现出与厄米系统截然不同的物理行为，其中一个典型例子是奇异点（EPs）。本文以一维复杂自旋链为例，提出了一种基于哈密顿量左右本征矢量区分的奇异点检测框架。研究表明，通过哈密顿量与其伴随量之差构建的全局量以及左右本征态上局部自旋关联的差异，可以可靠地识别奇异点。
authors: Leela Ganesh Chandra Lakkaraju, Soumik Bandyopadhyay, Sudipto Singha Roy and Philipp Hauke

articles.title: Effect of noise on quantum circuit realization of non-Hermitian time crystals
articles.title_zh: 噪声对非厄米时间晶体量子电路实现的影响
articles.abstract: Non-Hermitian quantum dynamics lie in an intermediate regime between unitary Hamiltonian dynamics and trace-preserving non-unitary open quantum system dynamics. Given differences in the noise tolerance of unitary and non-unitary dynamics, it is interesting to consider implementing non-Hermitian dynamics on a noisy quantum computer. In this paper, we do so for a non-Hermitian Ising Floquet model whose many-body dynamics gives rise to persistent temporal oscillations, a form of time crystallinity. In the simplest two qubit case that we consider, there is an infinitely long-lived periodic steady state at certain fine-tuned points. Using a generalized Floquet analysis, we show that infinitely long-lived oscillations are generically lost for arbitrarily weak values of common types of noise and compute the corresponding damping rate; this result is confirmed numerically using IBM’s Qiskit platform. We further show that the complex gaps responsible for oscillation damping are opened generically at first order in perturbation theory for any convex combination of depolarization, relaxation, and dephasing, establishing that no engineered mixture of these noise channels can stabilize the time-crystalline phase. Experiments on a real device (ibmq-lima) are consistent with rapid oscillation damping, though a significant mismatch between the manufacturer noise model and observed device behavior complicates quantitative comparison, illustrating the importance of rigorous analytical noise analysis.
articles.abstract_zh: 非厄米量子动力学介于幺正哈密顿动力学和保持迹的非幺正开放量子系统动力学之间。本文研究了在有噪声的量子计算机上实现非厄米Ising Floquet模型（一种时间晶体）的效应。研究发现，即使是任意微弱的常见噪声，也会导致无限长寿命的振荡消失，并计算了相应的阻尼率。
authors: Weihua Xie, Michael Kolodrubetz and Vadim Oganesyan

articles.title: Towards studying superconductivity in the Fermi-Hubbard model on Rydberg atoms
articles.title_zh: 利用里德堡原子研究费米-哈伯德模型中的超导性
articles.abstract: We present a method for calculating the ground state energy of the Fermi–Hubbard model leveraging Rydberg atom processors and sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD). By exploiting the perturbative relationship between the Fermi–Hubbard and Heisenberg models, the procedure samples from the Heisenberg model as prepared on the Rydberg atom processor, and uses the samples to diagonalize the Fermi–Hubbard model for large . We include anisotropy and next-nearest-neighbor interactions and discuss the relevant regime for quasi-superconductivity in the 1-dimensional Fermi–Hubbard model. Numerical and experimental results on the Aquila quantum processor are presented for ground state energy calculations as well as the chemical potential. We find that the Heisenberg model sampling in the studied regime is sufficient to converge near to the ground state for up to qubits, and we see a clear advantage of Rydberg atom sampling as opposed to random sampling even with 10 more samples for diagonalization. We also present a gate-based implementation of the gate-based SQD algorithm on IBM Quantum hardware for 56-qubit Hubbard model as a benchmark. Finally, we provide a gap analysis for studying emergent superconductivity using this method.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种利用里德堡原子处理器和基于采样的量子对角化（SQD）方法，计算费米-哈伯德模型基态能量。该方法利用费米-哈伯德模型与海森堡模型之间的微扰关系，通过从里德堡原子处理器上制备的海森堡模型中采样，进而对费米-哈伯德模型进行对角化。数值和实验结果表明，该方法在研究一维费米-哈伯德模型中的准超导性方面具有潜力。
authors: Kübra Yeter-Aydeniz and Nora Bauer

articles.title: Finite-Element Electromagnetic Analysis and Evaluation of Antenna Performance Metrics Using a Quantum Linear System Solver
articles.title_zh: 使用量子线性系统求解器进行有限元电磁分析和天线性能指标评估
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40693v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electromagnetic analysis based on the finite element method is widely used in antenna design. At higher frequencies, however, the required mesh refinement makes solving large sparse linear systems the main contributor to computational cost. Quantum linear system solvers offer a potential means of accelerating this step, but their output is a superposition state: reconstructing all components of the classical solution vector would forfeit the quantum speedup. Prior studies have proposed methods for obtaining physical quantities such as scattering cross sections and scattering parameters from the solution state. To support antenna design using fault-tolerant quantum computers, we formulate the total radiated power, the radiated power within a prescribed solid angle, and the dielectric and conductive losses as observables for efficient evaluation from a quantum solution state. These observables avoid the measurement cost of reconstructing all components of the output quantum state. We develop an end-to-end hybrid quantum--classical workflow that combines finite-element electromagnetic analysis, matrix preconditioning, a quantum linear system solver, and the evaluation of antenna design metrics. To validate the workflow, we performed numerical experiments evaluating these observables for an axisymmetric coaxially fed monopole antenna. Under idealized conditions, the relative errors in the total radiated power and the dissipated power with respect to the classical finite-element solution were on the order of 10⁻³, confirming the consistency of the workflow. The proposed method is expected to provide a basis for using quantum linear system solvers to evaluate antenna performance and, in the future, to design high-frequency wireless devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 天线设计中广泛使用的有限元电磁分析在高频下计算成本高昂。本文提出了一种利用量子线性系统求解器加速该过程的方法，并将其应用于天线性能指标的评估。研究将总辐射功率、特定立体角内的辐射功率以及介电和导电损耗公式化为可从量子解态中高效评估的观测量，从而避免了完全重构经典解向量的测量成本。
authors: Hiroaki Ominato, Takahiro Ohyama, Shiro Kawabata

articles.title: Finite-resource cooling of qudits beyond thermodynamic length
articles.title_zh: 超越热力学长度的有限资源量子比特冷却
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40709v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cooling a quantum system with N thermal machines costs more than Landauer's bound. For swap-based collision models the excess is set by thermodynamic length, which is optimal for qubits and was suggested by numerics to be optimal in general. We show that for qudits, permutations of energy eigenstates that use several resonant transitions at once do better for every spectrum, reducing the excess by up to 83% near the ground state. To second order, coherent collisions do no better, and at infinite temperature d_M-level machines reduce the excess by at most a factor d_M-1.
articles.abstract_zh: 冷却量子系统所需的成本通常高于朗道尔极限。对于量子比特，基于交换的碰撞模型中，额外成本由热力学长度决定。本文研究了量子多态系统（qudits）的冷却问题，发现同时利用多个共振跃迁的能量本征态排列可以更有效地降低冷却成本，在基态附近可减少高达83%。
authors: Ansh Mishra, Aryan Senthilkumar

articles.title: Quantum manifestations of converse symmetry breaking
articles.title_zh: 量子反向对称破缺的体现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40762v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum synchronization holds promise in advancing quantum technologies such as sensing, communication, and computation. A key challenge in this rapidly developing field is to identify mechanisms that can promote the emergence of synchronous dynamics. Here, we show that quantum synchronization can be enhanced by introducing controlled heterogeneity in the form of coupling mismatches. Using spin van der Pol oscillators as a model system, we show that this mechanism constitutes a quantum analog of the phenomenon of converse symmetry breaking previously identified in classical oscillator networks, where a synchronous state is stabilized by explicit symmetry breaking. We quantify how quantum effects modify this behavior by tuning the degree of quantumness through variations of the spin quantum number. These findings suggest that quantum synchronization can be enhanced in experiments by harnessing rather than suppressing heterogeneity.
articles.abstract_zh: 这项工作探讨了通过引入受控异质性（耦合失配）来增强量子同步的可能性。研究发现，这种机制是经典振荡器网络中“反向对称破缺”现象的量子模拟，即通过显式对称破缺来稳定同步态。通过调整自旋量子数来量化量子效应如何改变这种行为，研究结果表明在实验中可以通过利用而非抑制异质性来增强量子同步。
authors: Daniel P. Buser, Biswabibek Bandyopadhyay, Adilson E. Motter

articles.title: Liouvillian spectral snapshots: A reduced-subspace approach for time-dependent and noisy open quantum systems
articles.title_zh: Liouvillian谱快照：一种用于时变和噪声开放量子系统的降维子空间方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40808v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Driven-dissipative quantum devices are routinely operated with time-dependent drives and exposed to temporally correlated classical noise. When these perturbations vary on timescales comparable to the system's intrinsic dynamics, rotating-wave and Markovian approximations can fail, making effective static descriptions unreliable. As a result, accurately modeling systems in this regime often relies on simulating the full time-dependent master equation. This is particularly demanding for processes requiring long integration times, such as rare switching between metastable states, or for stochastic perturbations requiring averaging over many noise realizations. To address these challenges, we introduce Liouvillian spectral snapshots (LSS), a reduced-basis method that enables efficient simulation of such systems by projecting the master equation onto a low-dimensional subspace capturing their coarse-grained dynamics. LSS constructs this subspace by computing the slowly decaying, low-frequency eigenoperators of the Liouvillian at a few adaptively sampled perturbation values and compressing them into a common basis. This basis is built once and can be reused across noise realizations and perturbation parameters, reducing the cost of ensemble averages and parameter sweeps.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对时变驱动和时间相关噪声下的开放量子系统，传统近似方法可能失效，导致需要模拟完整的时间相关主方程。为解决长时间积分和随机扰动模拟的计算挑战，本文引入了Liouvillian谱快照（LSS）方法。LSS是一种降维基方法，通过将主方程投影到捕获系统粗粒度动力学的低维子空间，从而实现高效模拟。该方法通过计算Liouvillian在几个自适应采样扰动值下的慢衰减、低频本征算符，并将其压缩到公共基中来构建此子空间。
authors: Hans Christiansen, André Melo, Jens Paaske, Fabrizio Minganti

articles.title: Beyond the Kubo formula: unification of adiabatic and isothermal response in quantum systems
articles.title_zh: 超越久保公式：量子系统中绝热与等温响应的统一
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40810v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The static limit of the Kubo susceptibility describes the adiabatic response of an isolated quantum system, in which energy-level occupations remain unchanged, and generally differs from the isothermal susceptibility, where these occupations readjust to thermal equilibrium. In this work, we introduce a single dynamical framework in which the adiabatic and isothermal responses arise naturally as two distinct limiting regimes. This can be done by considering explicitly an open system version of the Kubo approach in which the dissipation is governed by a typical thermalization rate of the system. By exchanging the order of the static limit and of the vanishing thermalization rate limit, the protocol yields either the adiabatic or isothermal response. This protocol has a solid physical motivation in terms of the thermalization dynamics and is valid for generic systems. We apply it to the case of the magnetic response of the electron gas and reproduce the expected results.
articles.abstract_zh: 久保磁化率的静态极限描述了孤立量子系统的绝热响应，其能级占据保持不变，这通常与能级占据重新调整至热平衡的等温磁化率不同。本文提出了一个统一的动力学框架，其中绝热和等温响应自然地作为两个不同的极限机制出现。通过考虑久保方法的开放系统版本，其中耗散由系统的典型热化速率控制，并通过交换静态极限和趋于零的热化速率极限的顺序，该协议可以得到绝热或等温响应。该协议具有坚实的物理基础，并适用于通用系统，已成功应用于电子气的磁响应。
authors: Giuliano Chiriacò, Vasco Cavina

articles.title: Witnessing and quantifying stellar rank with the Wigner function
articles.title_zh: 利用维格纳函数见证和量化恒星秩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40827v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantifying non-Gaussianity is essential for assessing the computational power of bosonic quantum systems. We introduce a framework to witness and quantify non-Gaussianity from displaced parity measurements, and we directly apply it to experimental data obtained with superconducting cavities. Our method estimates fidelities with target pure states from the displaced parity measurements, enabling certification of non-Gaussianity via the stellar rank. We further introduce refined witnesses computed by measuring the value of the Wigner function at a few points, providing efficient certification tools outperforming existing ones. Applying these techniques to Fock, binomial, cat, and GKP experimental data, we rigorously certify non-Gaussian resources and establish a stellar rank of 8 for a GKP state, setting a new benchmark across all quantum platforms. Our methods enable a rigorous quantification of non-Gaussian quantum resources directly applicable to superconducting devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 量化非高斯性对于评估玻色子量子系统的计算能力至关重要。本文提出了一种通过位移宇称测量来见证和量化非高斯性的框架，并将其直接应用于超导腔的实验数据。该方法通过恒星秩认证非高斯性，并引入了通过测量维格纳函数在几个点的值来计算的更精细的见证器，提供了优于现有方法的认证工具。将这些技术应用于Fock、二项式、猫态和GKP态的实验数据，研究严格认证了非高斯量子资源，并为GKP态建立了8的恒星秩，为所有量子平台设定了新基准。
authors: Oliver Hahn, Alex Maltesson, Varun Upreti, Marike Ellerbroek, Alessandro Ferraro, Saleh Rahimi-Keshari, Ulysse Chabaud, Giulia Ferrini

articles.title: Predictive Maintenance at the Edge: An Embedded Anomaly Detection Pipeline Trained with Quantum Optimization
articles.title_zh: 边缘预测性维护：一种采用量子优化训练的嵌入式异常检测流程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40848v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This article presents a predictive-maintenance pipeline that detects anomalies in bearings from vibration signals, adapted for deployment at the edge on low-cost microcontrollers, and that uses quantum optimization in two steps of its training. The pipeline consists of a step of vibration feature extraction and a step of classification with a one-class support vector machine (OCSVM). The features are selected by minimum redundancy and maximum relevance (mRMR) with the variational quantum eigensolver (VQE), under a limit on computing time. The OCSVM is adapted for inference at the edge without floating-point operations and is trained by a variational quantum algorithm with Pauli-correlation encoding (PCE). In small-scale tests on a simulator, with the Paderborn bearing dataset, the VQE found the optimal selection in 36% of the runs with Adam, and PCE chose better support vectors than chance, until a classical local search made the two equal. A classical baseline, the usual OCSVM trained by SMO with its weights rounded, matched them without any search.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种用于轴承振动信号异常检测的预测性维护流程，该流程适用于低成本微控制器上的边缘部署，并在训练的两个步骤中使用了量子优化。该流程包括振动特征提取和基于单类支持向量机（OCSVM）的分类。特征选择通过变分量子本征求解器（VQE）结合最小冗余最大相关性（mRMR）完成，而OCSVM则通过带有泡利相关编码（PCE）的变分量子算法进行训练。在模拟器上的小规模测试表明，VQE在部分运行中找到了最优选择，PCE选择了比随机更好的支持向量，但最终经典局部搜索使其与经典基线持平。
authors: Filipe Chagas Ferraz

articles.title: Clifford synthesis is NP-complete
articles.title_zh: Clifford合成是NP完全的
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40886v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that the problem of synthesizing a quantum circuit for a given Clifford operator using at most a specified amount of resources is NP-complete for several resource models of practical interest. Specifically, we study synthesis of a given Clifford operator using single-qubit Clifford gates and two-qubit Clifford gates, with full qubit connectivity and no additional ancilla qubits. With single-qubit gates free and CNOT as the only two-qubit gate, we show that deciding whether a given target admits an implementation using at most a specified number of CNOT gates is NP-complete, and we show that the problem remains NP-complete when any two-qubit Clifford gate is allowed and the budget counts all such gates. Moreover, we show that both results continue to hold when SWAP gates may be inserted for free, and when single-qubit gates are also considered part of the budget. In each case, we build on recent work by Li and Guan and show that there are polynomial-time reductions from Hamiltonian path in grid graphs to these decision problems, using a number of qubits quadratic in the number of grid vertices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了在多种实际资源模型下，为给定Clifford算子合成量子电路且使用资源量不超过指定限制的问题是NP完全的。具体而言，研究了使用单量子比特和双量子比特Clifford门进行合成，且具有完全量子比特连接和无额外辅助量子比特的情况。结果表明，在CNOT门作为唯一双量子比特门时，以及允许任意双量子比特Clifford门且预算计算所有此类门时，该问题均为NP完全。此外，这些结果在允许免费插入SWAP门以及单量子比特门也计入预算时仍然成立。
authors: Søren Fuglede Jørgensen

articles.title: Hypergraph cycle enumeration for efficient inference of planted k-XOR with smooth trade-off
articles.title_zh: 用于高效推断植入式k-XOR并实现平滑权衡的超图循环枚举
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40941v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce hypergraph cycle enumeration (HCE), a simple spectral framework for detecting and recovering planted signals in noisy hypergraph inference problems. We study HCE on one representative problem from this class, namely planted noisy k-XOR, also known as sparse Learning Parity with Noise (LPN). Both theoretically and empirically, HCE achieves comparable recovery behavior to Kikuchi method, matching Kikuchi hierarchy. We identify parameter regimes where HCE outperforms Kikuchi method, showing that neither algorithm is universally better. We also show a subquadratic quantum speedup for HCE by replacing one of the algorithm's steps with a quantum walk. Our classical and quantum algorithms do not refute the quartic quantum speedup of quantum Kikuchi method, which remains valid for the practically relevant regime of large size and high noise strength.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了超图循环枚举（HCE），一个用于在噪声超图推断问题中检测和恢复植入信号的简单谱框架。研究在植入式噪声k-XOR问题上对HCE进行了研究，理论和经验上都表明HCE实现了与Kikuchi方法相当的恢复性能。研究确定了HCE优于Kikuchi方法的参数范围，并展示了通过量子游走替换算法步骤可以实现HCE的亚二次量子加速。
