authors: Arman Babakhani, Enrico Fontana, Junhyung Lyle Kim, Shouvanik Chakrabarti, Ruslan Shaydulin

articles.title: Variational Programs with Open Clocks
articles.title_zh: 带有开放时钟的变分程序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40988v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Variational quantum algorithms leave the durations of Hamiltonian evolutions open for a classical optimizer to set. We present VHamilton, a minimal extension of the Hamilton quantum programming language in which such durations are open clocks: one program denotes a family of Hamiltonian trajectories, and a valuation fills its clocks with exact dyadic times, so that each instance is an ordinary Hamilton program that compiles to circuits as before. Because the semantics stays exact and affine in the clocks, the Hamiltonian structure of a variational program remainsavail able for reasoning about every valuation at once. Equivalence becomes a finite calculation, which we mechanize in Agda for a fragment and use to prove the VHamilton form of the compiler rewrite "rzz(t) = cx; rz(t); cx" for every clock value. We then show what the same structure supports in a two-qubit chemistry eigensolver written in VHamilton and run through a Haskell prototype. It supports a fusion of commuting blocks, a closed form and an expressibility proof for the ansatz, and an exact split of the error between the precision of the target and that of the clocks, with a priori bounds. It also supports a coordinate search whose queries per sweep, fixed by the spectra of the generators, do not grow with the precision. On the benchmark this search reaches the numerically verified optimum of a grid of 134 million valuations in 53 energy queries. It finds the grid optimum in only 21 of 30 validation settings, however, so the gain is conditional, not a global-optimization guarantee.
articles.abstract_zh: 变分量子算法允许经典优化器设置哈密顿演化的持续时间。本文提出了VHamilton，这是Hamilton量子编程语言的一个最小扩展，其中这些持续时间被视为开放时钟。一个VHamilton程序表示一个哈密顿轨迹族，通过对时钟赋值，每个实例都成为一个普通的Hamilton程序并编译成电路。研究还展示了VHamilton在双量子比特化学本征求解器中的应用，支持可交换块的融合、拟设的封闭形式和可表达性证明，以及目标精度与时钟精度之间误差的精确划分。
authors: Javaria Ghafoor, Amr Sabry

articles.title: Quantum Vehicle Routing Problem: a smart initialization strategy for ill-conditioned optimization landscapes
articles.title_zh: 量子车辆路径问题：针对病态优化景观的智能初始化策略
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41120v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: With the expansion of complex transport infrastructure, new paths for linking different destinations have emerged, allowing the definition of multiple routes. The introduction of new roads may also lead to disruptions in traffic flow. This problem can be generalized into a special case of VRP, which aims to find the optimal route for a fleet of vehicles within a network of destinations. Finding solutions to this problem requires an exponential number of operations, hindering the ability of exact solvers to deal with large instances, which must therefore be tackled using heuristics, often leading to suboptimal results. Quantum-based algorithms may allow us to find exact solutions in polynomial time with high probability, offering a potential future alternative to classical solvers and in this work, we focus on the QAOA. Our novel contributions are a parameter-initialization strategy that improves the convergence probability and the integration of the subtour constraints directly into the optimization without using additional qubits by employing an approximation of exponential equality constraints. We believe that our results pave the way for effectively solving instances of VRP using quantum-based solutions, leveraging the space-efficient problem encoding and our initialization strategy, which limits the effect of barren-plateau under random parameter initialization.
articles.abstract_zh: 车辆路径问题（VRP）旨在为车辆车队在目的地网络中找到最优路径，其求解复杂度呈指数级增长，传统精确求解器难以处理大规模实例。本文关注量子近似优化算法（QAOA）在解决VRP中的应用，并提出了创新的参数初始化策略，以提高收敛概率。此外，研究通过近似指数等式约束，将子路径约束直接集成到优化中，而无需使用额外的量子比特。这些结果为量子算法在解决复杂优化问题方面提供了新的途径。
authors: Emanuele Casciaro, Mario De Simone, Stefano Martina, Fabio Mascherpa, Alfonso Amendola, Filippo Caruso

articles.title: Entangled Measurement Outcomes for Optimal Postselection in Quantum Batteries
articles.title_zh: 量子电池中实现最优后选择的纠缠测量结果
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41121v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Postselection can enhance the performance of a selected quantum battery branch, raising the question of whether the optimum can always be achieved by product measurements on the auxiliary subsystems. For battery auxiliary states obtained by mixing a pure state with global white noise of strength p, the conditional ergotropy reduces to a generalized Rayleigh quotient. For 0 <1, product postselection attains the joint optimum if and only if the eigenspace associated with the largest generalized eigenvalue contains a product vector. For two auxiliary qubits, a strict product-joint gap therefore occurs precisely when this eigenspace is one dimensional and spanned by an entangled vector. Noisy W and GHZ states display qualitatively different behavior: the three qubit W state exhibits a strict gap throughout 0 <1, whereas the three qubit GHZ state admits a product optimum. For interacting two qubit batteries, the optimal postselection can switch from a Bell outcome to a product outcome as the coupling strength is varied. By contrast, the outcome averaged capacity and ergotropy are independent of the measurement basis, showing that the joint measurement advantage is genuinely postselective.
articles.abstract_zh: 后选择可以增强量子电池特定分支的性能，但最优性能是否总能通过辅助子系统的乘积测量实现仍是疑问。本文研究发现，对于混合了全局白噪声的电池辅助态，条件可用功可简化为广义瑞利商。当最大广义本征值对应的本征空间包含乘积向量时，乘积后选择才能达到联合最优。研究还发现，噪声W态和GHZ态表现出不同的行为，且相互作用的双量子比特电池中，最优后选择可能随耦合强度变化而切换。
authors: Yali Du, Zhipei Zhou, Xiaoli Hu

articles.title: Encoded reversible addition in constant Toffoli depth
articles.title_zh: 编码可逆加法在常数Toffoli深度实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41142v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that reversible in-place quantum addition modulo 2ⁿ⁻¹ can be implemented in constant Toffoli depth using O(n) space, provided that the variables are encoded in a certain non-standard form. Using measurement-based uncomputation, the Toffoli depth can be reduced to one. We also present space-depth tradeoffs and an application to programmable rotations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了在变量采用特定非标准编码形式时，可逆的模2ⁿ⁻¹量子原位加法可以在常数Toffoli深度下实现，并使用O(n)空间。通过基于测量的反计算，Toffoli深度可以进一步降低到一。研究还提出了空间-深度权衡，并将其应用于可编程旋转。
authors: Aidan Epperly, Isaac H. Kim, Mingyu Lee

articles.title: Quantum query complexity of Hurwitz stability testing
articles.title_zh: Hurwitz稳定性测试的量子查询复杂度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41180v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Determining whether every trajectory of the linear system dotx=Ax converges to zero (or, equivalently, whether A is Hurwitz stable) is a fundamental problem in control theory. It arises, for example, in verifying the stability of feedback controllers and state observers, as well as of linearized dynamical models. We study the quantum query complexity of deciding whether a matrix AinCⁿ× ⁿ is Hurwitz stable, given an exact normalized block-encoding of A. The query complexity is characterized in terms of the system dimension n and a supplied lower bound 0<νłeq ømega_A on the imaginary-axis distance ømega_A:=minₜᵢₙRσₘᵢₙ(A-itI), where σₘᵢₙ(A) is the smallest singular value of A. We prove a query-complexity lower bound of Ømega(sqrtn/ν), which holds even when A is restricted to be real and diagonal. For general matrices with nonzero ømega_A, we encode an approximation of the right-half-plane spectral projector øperatornamesign⁺⁽A):=(I+øperatornamesign(A))/2 as a block of a matrix inverse, where A is Hurwitz if and only if the projector is zero. To test this, we produce a quantum algorithm which determines if a (β,b,1/(4sqrtn))-block-encoded projector matrix (like øperatornamesign⁺⁽A)) is zero or not; for constant success probability, it has complexity Θ(βsqrtn). When the zero test is applied to specific approximations of øperatornamesign⁺⁽A), this yields an upper bound of O(sqrtnν⁻²łog(sqrtn/ν)) queries in the general case, and O(sqrtnν⁻¹łog n) when A is Hermitian or normal. The latter upper bound matches the lower bound up to a logarithmic factor. Thus the dimension dependence of quantum Hurwitz testing is nearly optimal, while the remaining factor in the non-normal case isolates an open conditioning gap.
articles.abstract_zh: 判断线性系统`dotx=Ax`的每个轨迹是否收敛到零（即矩阵A是否为Hurwitz稳定）是控制理论中的一个基本问题。本文研究了给定矩阵A的精确归一化块编码时，判断A是否为Hurwitz稳定的量子查询复杂度。查询复杂度由系统维度n和虚轴距离`omega_A`的下界`nu`来表征。研究证明了`Omega(sqrt(n)/nu)`的查询复杂度下界，并提出了一个量子算法，通过将右半平面谱投影仪的近似编码为矩阵逆的块来测试Hurwitz稳定性。
authors: Maxwell Fitzsimmons, Mohamed Serry, Meenu Kumari, Jun Liu

articles.title: Anomalous superradiant phases in a quantum Rabi zigzag chain under a synthetic gauge field
articles.title_zh: 量子Rabi锯齿链在合成规范场下的反常超辐射相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41194v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present the phase diagram of a one-dimensional quantum Rabi zigzag chain under an artificial gauge field, which is implemented via phase-modulated next-nearest-neighbor (NNN) hopping. For a system size of N=8, we analytically determine the order parameters and critical thresholds, identifying five distinct superradiant phases. For strong nearest-neighbor (NN) coupling, the system exhibits either a ferro-superradiant (FSR) or an antiferro-superradiant (AFSR) phase depending on its sign. Increasing NNN coupling induces a stripe antiferro-superradiant (sAFSR) phase with antiparallel NNN and parallel NN displacements, which is distinct from the conventional AFSR phase. Tuning the magnetic flux drives the system into chiral or antichiral superradiant phases with opposite ground-state photon currents, which are different from the conventional superradiant phases. Remarkably, geometric frustration within each triangular plaquette stabilizes chiral phases even at small magnetic flux while suppressing the sAFSR phase, which vanishes for N=6. Mapping the system onto an effective magnetic Hamiltonian yields an analogous phase diagram featuring distinct magnetic phases, offering insight into the anomalous superradiant phases. This equivalence establishes a quantum optical platform for simulating chiral magnetism.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究揭示了在一维量子Rabi锯齿链中，通过相位调制次近邻跳跃实现的合成规范场下，其相图的复杂性。作者分析确定了N=8系统中的序参量和临界阈值，识别出五种独特的超辐射相。值得注意的是，几何挫折在小磁通量下稳定了手性相，并抑制了条纹反铁磁超辐射相。
authors: Jun-Bo Tang, Lin-Jun Li, Bin Wei, Yu-Yu Zhang

articles.title: Biorthogonal universal quantum control
articles.title_zh: 双正交普适量子控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41195v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As a paradigm for describing open-quantum-system dynamics, the non-Hermitian Schrödinger equation generally modifies state norms, complicating coherent control over the system's Hilbert space. With a general instantaneous frame spanned by biorthogonal ancillary bases, we develop a biorthogonal quantum-control theory for discrete-variable systems governed by time-dependent non-Hermitian Hamiltonian. In particular, we derive a necessary and sufficient condition for extracting the transitionless pathways that transport parallel in ket and bra states. When this condition is satisfied by a set of projectors constructed with biorthogonal basis states, the non-Hermitian Hamiltonian becomes diagonal in the relevant biorthogonal subspace, enabling arbitrary initial state to evolve as a superposition of controlled transitionless passages. We further identify the parametric constraints under which the transformation linking the initial and final states becomes unitary. As a result, the final system state is automatically normalized even though the transitional dynamics is nonunitary. Our theory is justified by the bidirectional population transfer and a holomonic quantum gate implemented by a non-Hermitian three-level system in Łambda type. For the population transfer, controlled gain and loss reduce the required coherent pulse area, enabling shorter transfer times than the Hermitian benchmark with the same average Rabi frequency. Our work integrates the universal quantum control (UQC) into the biorthogonal representation, displaying full-rank passage engineering with coherent operations in non-Hermitian systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对由含时非厄米哈密顿量控制的离散变量系统，提出了一种基于双正交辅助基的量子控制理论。该理论导出了实现无跃迁路径的充要条件，使得初态和末态之间的变换在特定参数约束下变为幺正的。即使过渡动力学是非幺正的，最终系统状态也能自动归一化。
authors: Chen-yi Zhang, Jun Jing

articles.title: Testing hardware quantum machine learning claims with a null circuit: fill prediction on Binance futures with 129 qubits of an IBM Heron processor
articles.title_zh: 使用空电路测试硬件量子机器学习主张：在IBM Heron处理器129量子比特上预测币安期货的成交
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41268v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum processors are now used as feature generators for classical models on tabular data. A circuit encodes each record, the device returns expectation values, and a classical model learns from them. A recent report claimed large gains from such features, gains that appeared only on noisy hardware. These claims are hard to check, because a quantum device is not a static function. Its state changes from job to job and from one calibration to the next, and that drift can leak information about the outcome into the features. We propose a five-step protocol for testing claims of this kind. It runs a circuit that carries no data in the same jobs as the real one. It checks whether the hardware leaves a recognizable mark on each job. It compares random and natural assignments of records to jobs, replays the null results under other submission orders, and closes the leak with a job-purged backtest. We apply it, pre-registered, to the HSBC and IBM study of fill probabilities in bond trading, which reported a large hardware-only gain. We use a public analog task and run the study's circuit on a 129-qubit chain of an IBM Heron processor. Under controlled assignment the hardware features give no gain over classical features, and the device reproduces the ideal features about as well as shot noise allows. Yet every job carries a distinct fingerprint. A circuit with no data at all predicts fills well above chance when records are batched by outcome and the same job sits on both sides of the train/test split. Removing that overlap removes the effect. The protocol costs under an hour of processor time and is designed for any hardware feature or kernel pipeline on tabular data.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子处理器作为经典模型的特征生成器，其在噪声硬件上的性能提升难以验证。本文提出了一种五步协议来测试此类主张，通过在真实电路的同时运行不携带数据的空电路来检测硬件漂移。该协议应用于一项公开的模拟任务，在IBM Heron处理器的129量子比特链上运行，旨在验证硬件量子机器学习的有效性。
authors: Muhammad Faryad

articles.title: Parametric Enhancement of an Optical Spring in a Dark Signal-Recycling Cavity
articles.title_zh: 暗信号回收腔中光学弹簧的参量增强
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41270v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Optical springs tailor the response of precision sensors. Parametric amplification of the signal field stiffens the spring, extending the precision to higher frequencies. A Michelson interferometer operated at a dark fringe is the most direct way to separate the signal from the carrier for amplification. We experimentally demonstrate such quantum manipulation of the optical spring by placing an optical parametric amplifier in a cavity at the dark port, showing a significant increase of the optical-spring constant with the parametric gain within a factor of four below the oscillation threshold.
articles.abstract_zh: 光学弹簧能够调整精密传感器的响应，而信号场的参量放大可以增强弹簧的刚度，从而将精度扩展到更高频率。本研究通过在暗端口腔中放置一个光学参量放大器，实验证明了光学弹簧的量子操控。结果显示，在振荡阈值以下四倍范围内，光学弹簧常数随参量增益显著增加。
authors: Kaido Suzuki, Ryo Iden, Ken-ichi Harada, Kentaro Somiya

articles.title: Estimation of Quantum Umlaut Information
articles.title_zh: 量子元音变音信息的估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41282v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantifying correlations is important for understanding how quantum states and channels support information processing. Quantum umlaut information U connects such correlations to reliability in hypothesis testing and certain communication settings, but its known formulas require classical descriptions of the underlying states. To estimate correlations without these descriptions, we introduce measured quantum umlaut information U^M by replacing Umegaki relative entropy with measured relative entropy. Its variational formulation leads to a quantum generative adversarial framework for estimating U^M from measurement statistics of unknown bipartite states and classical-quantum channels. This framework optimizes reference states and measurements without reconstructing the target states or channel outputs. For classical-quantum channels, it also optimizes the input probabilities. We further analyze the relation between U^M and U, deriving a state-dependent gap bound and characterizing equality for full-rank bipartite states. Numerical simulations show trained estimates close on average to independently computed numerical references for U^M across the tested states and channels. These estimates could help assess how well quantum memories preserve correlations and how noise or drift affects input-output dependence in quantum transmitters and state-preparation devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子元音变音信息U量化了量子态和信道中的关联，但其计算需要经典态描述。为解决此问题，本文引入了测量量子元音变音信息U^M，并提出了一个量子生成对抗框架来从未知双体态和经典-量子信道的测量统计中估计U^M。该框架无需重建目标态或信道输出，并通过数值模拟验证了其估计的准确性。
authors: Beomjoon Kim, Donghwa Ji, Kabgyun Jeong

articles.title: Optimality of the Petz-Fuchs Smoothed State
articles.title_zh: Petz-Fuchs平滑态的最优性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41311v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum state smoothing is an estimation technique that uses past and future measurement information obtained from a continuous-in-time measurement record to reconstruct the state of an open quantum system. Recently, there has been a new approach to quantum state smoothing based on quantum retrodiction known as the Petz-Fuchs smoothed state. Here I prove that this Petz-Fuchs smoothed state majorizes all other smoothed states that only depend on the filtered state (the operator conditioned on the past measurement record) and the retrofiltered effect (the operator describing the future measurement record). To do this, I characterize the set of all possible smoothed states satisfying this condition.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子态平滑是一种利用过去和未来测量信息重建开放量子系统状态的估计技术。本文证明了基于量子回溯的Petz-Fuchs平滑态，优于所有仅依赖于滤波态和回溯滤波效应的其他平滑态。为实现这一目标，作者表征了满足此条件的所有可能平滑态的集合。
authors: Kiarn T. Laverick

articles.title: PyQLAS: A Quantum-Classical Hybrid Solver Library for Linear Systems
articles.title_zh: PyQLAS：一个用于线性系统的量子-经典混合求解器库
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41317v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum algorithms solve a linear system at a cost that grows only polylogarithmically in its dimension, but on present-day hardware that advantage is realised only if the quantum and the classical parts of a solve are apportioned deliberately. We present PyQLAS, a quantum--classical hybrid library for linear systems that exposes this apportionment as a design parameter rather than a fixed assumption. PyQLAS builds three nested solvers around a single variational core---a variational solver, an outer residual iteration, and a Krylov-subspace projection---so that the quantum subroutine can be held at a fixed circuit width while the classical host absorbs the growth of the problem. Around them, the library supplies preconditioning at two independent levels, dimension alignment, checkpointing, and device-budget control, and a solve written against the interface runs unchanged on an exact state-vector simulator, on a local sampler, and on a real superconducting processor. The library is validated on the IEEE 118-bus power flow, a standard test system in which the linear solver is embedded in a classical Newton iteration. There, the iteration converges to the specified tolerance and reproduces the classical reference solution to within 2.3×10⁻⁸ p.u. in voltage magnitude and 3.4×10⁻⁶ degrees in voltage angle.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了PyQLAS，一个用于线性系统的量子-经典混合库，它将量子和经典部分的分配作为设计参数。PyQLAS围绕一个变分核心构建了三个嵌套求解器，使得量子子程序能保持固定电路宽度，而经典部分处理问题增长。该库提供了预处理、维度对齐、检查点和设备预算控制等功能，并在IEEE 118总线潮流系统上进行了验证。
authors: Meng-Han Dou, Teng-Yang Ma, Chuang-Chao Ye, Zhao-Yun Chen, Guo-Ping Guo

articles.title: Real-time BP decoding of a high-rate QEC code
articles.title_zh: 高码率量子纠错码的实时BP解码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41413v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a real-time FPGA decoder for a high-rate [[512,174,8]] 3D product qLDPC code. We construct a circuit-level detector-error model for a compact syndrome-extraction schedule and propose a small parallel ensemble of row-wise serial min-sum decoders with cumulative memory. The decoder matches BP+OSD-CS₁₀ accuracy with one core and Relay-BP accuracy with three cores. The FPGA implementation meets the latency budget of neutral-atom and trapped-ion systems. An ASIC implementation would improve the latency, enabling real time decoding even for superconducting systems. At a physical error rate of p=10⁻³, three FPGA devices decode 174 logical qubits with a logical error rate of 5×10⁻⁷ and effective distance 6. For p=10⁻⁴, and assuming the number of BP iterations is capped to 30, the decoder's average latency is 5.1,textmu s and its worst-case latency is 97.9,textmu s.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种用于高码率[[512,174,8]] 3D乘积qLDPC码的实时FPGA解码器。该解码器采用紧凑的综合提取调度和行式串行最小和解码器并行集成，其精度与BP+OSD-CS₁₀和Relay-BP相当。FPGA实现满足中性原子和离子阱系统的延迟预算，并在物理错误率p=10⁻³时，三个FPGA设备能以5×10⁻⁷的逻辑错误率解码174个逻辑量子比特。
authors: Andreas Kell, Daniel Herr, Daniel Bascones García, Alexandru Paler, Davide Orsucci, Francisco Lázaro, Francisco García Herrero

articles.title: Analytic level statistics of the quantum Rabi model
articles.title_zh: 量子Rabi模型的解析能级统计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41421v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We derive an analytic expression for the distribution of level spacings in the quantum Rabi model. At high energies, the spectrum in a fixed parity sector takes the asymptotic form of a uniformly spaced ladder modulated by a decaying oscillation. The alternating sign of this oscillation separates successive spacings into two branches. For a finite window containing many oscillations, counting how often the two branches exceed a given spacing yields an analytic expression for the spacing density at leading order. The oscillation amplitude at the lower end of the window sets the range of spacings, and its value at the upper end fixes the positions of two cusps that form twin peaks. Spacing histograms from exact diagonalization agree with the analytic density, including its spacing range and twin peak positions. At leading order, the same spectral analysis also yields an expression for the ratio of consecutive spacings, a statistic that requires no spectral unfolding. The resulting ratio statistics agree closely with those from exact diagonalization. For windows that continue to contain many oscillations, the spacing and ratio peaks move toward unity at higher energies as the spectrum approaches a uniformly spaced ladder. The same counting approach can be explored in other systems with controlled spectral asymptotics, slowly varying spacing branches, and windows containing many oscillations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文推导了量子Rabi模型中能级间距分布的解析表达式。在高能量下，固定宇称扇区内的谱呈现出由衰减振荡调制的均匀间隔阶梯形式。通过对能级间距的分析，作者得到了间距密度和连续间距比的解析表达式，并发现其与精确对角化结果高度吻合。
authors: Zi-Min Li, Long-Jie Li, German Sierra, Murray T. Batchelor

articles.title: oracq: A Modular Framework for Implementing and Analyzing Quantum Scientific Computing Algorithms
articles.title_zh: oracq：一个用于实现和分析量子科学计算算法的模块化框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41431v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum algorithms for scientific computing are specified against access models such as block-encodings, sparse oracles, state preparations, and quantum random-access memories. Their concrete realization is deliberately left open, yet it is a research variable that changes both the numerical behavior and the resource cost of the program, so every reported conclusion is attributable to one realization. In this paper, we present oracq, a Python framework that makes this choice a managed and checkable decision. Our claim is linguistic rather than infrastructural. Algorithms are stored as persistent register-level programs whose oracle slots are declared and typed but unimplemented. A separate binding pass links compatible realizations, so one stored algorithm can be re-bound to a gate network, a QRAM-backed table, or compiled reversible arithmetic and compared across them. Typed QRAM resources, a compiler from pure Python numerical formulas to reversible fixed-point circuits, and block-encoding algebra with qubitization and QSVT-style kernels supply the constructions. Two end-to-end workflows exercise the framework, a quantum finite-volume pipeline for the compressible Euler equations and a quantum homotopy-analysis pipeline that lifts nonlinear PDEs to composable linear input models. The verification methodology separates implementation error from method error, and logical resource accounts cover programs before and after binding. The framework is openly available at https://github.com/IAI-USTC-Quantum/oracq.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了oracq，一个Python框架，旨在管理和检查量子科学计算算法的具体实现选择。该框架允许算法以持久的寄存器级程序形式存储，其预言机槽位被声明但未实现，并通过单独的绑定过程链接兼容的实现。oracq提供了类型化的QRAM资源、从Python数值公式到可逆定点电路的编译器以及块编码代数，支持灵活的算法实现和比较。
authors: Zhao-Yun Chen, Ming-Yang Tan, Guo-Ping Guo

articles.title: Almost-Quantum Correlations Violate Information Causality
articles.title_zh: 准量子关联违反信息因果性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41444v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Information causality (IC) posits that communicating m classical bits cannot give the receiver access to more than m bits of information about the sender's independent data. Although IC holds in quantum theory and excludes a broad class of supra-quantum correlations, its validity for the almost-quantum set has remained open. This semidefinite relaxation of the quantum set satisfies nontrivial communication complexity, no advantage for non-local computation, macroscopic locality, local orthogonality, and numerical evidence has suggested that it may also satisfy IC. Here we show that almost-quantum correlations violate IC, and do so without bound. Unlike earlier violations of IC, which rely on biased guesses, ours is driven by zero-error certificates: each is rare but never wrong, carries information linear in its probability, and vouches for many of the sender's bits at once. This establishes a sharp dichotomy: either IC is a valid physical principle that excludes these correlations, or any nonsignalling theory realizing them admits no mutual information obeying consistency, data processing and the chain rule. In the latter case, we discuss why the chain rule is the natural property to relinquish, and how this possibility relates to histories-based formulations and to locality defined relative to the state rather than presupposed in a fixed spacetime.
articles.abstract_zh: 信息因果性（IC）是量子理论中成立的一个原则，但其对准量子集合的有效性一直未明。本文证明了准量子关联会无限制地违反信息因果性，这与以往依赖有偏猜测的违反不同，而是由零误差证书驱动。这一发现提出了一个尖锐的二分法：要么IC是一个有效的物理原理并排除了这些关联，要么任何实现它们的非信号理论都不存在遵循一致性、数据处理和链式法则的互信息。
authors: Anandamay Das Bhowmik, Manik Banik

articles.title: An Unbounded Separation of Almost-Quantum and Commuting-Operator Correlations in Zero-Error Communication
articles.title_zh: 零误差通信中准量子与交换算符关联的无界分离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41448v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Almost-quantum correlations form the mathtt1+AB level of the Navascués--Pironio--Acín hierarchy. They strictly contain the quantum set, are characterized by a single semidefinite program, arise in Sorkin's quantum measure theory, and satisfy several principles proposed to single out quantum theory. We show that they are nevertheless unboundedly stronger than quantum correlations in a zero-error communication task. Alice and Bob receive labels s,tin[N], Nge3; after one bit from Alice, Bob must decide whether s=t, never erring but allowed to abstain. For every model of quantum correlations, from finite-dimensional tensor products to commuting operators, the optimal worst-case probability of a conclusive answer is exactly 1/N, the value attained with shared randomness, so the bound does not depend on the resolution of Tsirelson's problem. An explicit family of almost-quantum correlations attains 1/19 for every N. For certificates of equality from binary-outcome boxes, we solve the underlying semidefinite programs in closed form. The almost-quantum optimum equals N²/(17N²⁻⁸⁰N+64) for Nge8 and tends to 1/17. The first level of the hierarchy, which coincides with the set singled out by macroscopic locality, attains N/[8(N-2)], which tends to 1/8; its optimal boxes lie outside the almost-quantum set for every Nge5. For longer messages, entanglement saves at most one bit over shared randomness, whereas almost-quantum correlations reduce the one-way zero-error cost of deciding equality of n-bit strings from n bits to at most 13. The quantum bound also yields a linear witness of post-quantumness on a face of the nonsignalling polytope.
articles.abstract_zh: 准量子关联严格包含量子集合，并满足多项量子理论原则。然而，本文证明在零误差通信任务中，准量子关联比量子关联具有无界强度优势。对于量子关联，最佳结论性答案的概率为1/N，而一个明确的准量子关联族可以达到1/19。
authors: Rafiuddin Gazi, Biswadeep Chatterjee, Jayashree Karmakar, Ram Krishna Patra, Manik Banik, Anandamay Das Bhowmik

articles.title: eCAS: An Orbital Embedding Method for Quantum Computing
articles.title_zh: eCAS：一种用于量子计算的轨道嵌入方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41517v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Future fault-tolerant quantum computers will allow us to calculate electronic structures of atomistic systems. However, these systems will be intrinsically limited in size, requiring embedding theories for many systems because of the unfavorable scaling of the number of terms describing the electron-electron interaction in the second-quantized electronic Hamiltonian. Quantum embedding theories address this challenge by partitioning a quantum system into a region of interest, the impurity, and its (larger) complement, the environment. However, currently available quantum embedding methods place restrictive demands on near-future quantum computers, such as the need to measure reduced density matrices or the need for repeated evaluations. Here, we introduce the new orbital embedding method eCAS that steers clear of these pitfalls by constructing a multi-CAS problem, the active spaces of which are localized and can be solved independently of each other with any quantum algorithm. This also allows for the development of comparatively simple gradient expressions. eCAS leverages the Schmidt decomposition to construct initial impurity and bath orbitals and augments them with localized environment orbitals, based on a mutual correlation criterion. The mutual correlation criterion makes eCAS systematically improvable without the need for any iteratively determined quantities.
articles.abstract_zh: 未来的容错量子计算机在计算原子系统电子结构时面临尺寸限制，需要嵌入理论来解决电子-电子相互作用项数量的不利缩放问题。现有的量子嵌入方法对近期量子计算机提出了严格要求。本文介绍了一种新的轨道嵌入方法eCAS，通过构建多CAS问题，其活性空间局部化且可独立求解，从而避免了这些限制。eCAS利用施密特分解构建初始杂质和环境，并简化了梯度表达式，为量子化学计算提供了更实用的途径。
authors: Anna Brünisholz, Markus Reiher

articles.title: Quantum Bernstein--Kolmogorov--Arnold approximation
articles.title_zh: 量子伯恩斯坦-柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德近似
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41608v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper addresses the expressivity and representation gap in Quantum Neural Networks by establishing a quantum analogue of the classical Kolmogorov--Arnold representation theorem. We propose a constructive approximation framework over fixed input coherent states, where the dependence of the function argument is embedded entirely in coordinate qubits, while the target function dictates a single outer unitary evolution. By applying a Sprecher-type representation to the rotation angle of the state, we demonstrate that the multidimensional operator factorises into (2d+1) commuting universal inner observables. We prove that the resulting measurement probability precisely reproduces the multidimensional Bernstein polynomial of the target function. For any continuous multivariate function, the joint quantum state converges uniformly to the target output register, linking classical superposition theory with probabilistic and coherent quantum circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过建立经典柯尔莫哥洛夫-阿诺德表示定理的量子模拟，解决了量子神经网络中的表达能力和表示鸿沟问题。研究提出了一种基于固定输入相干态的构造性近似框架，其中函数参数的依赖性完全嵌入到坐标量子比特中，而目标函数决定了单一的外部酉演化。通过将Sprecher型表示应用于状态的旋转角，证明了多维算子可以分解为(2d+1)个可交换的通用内部可观测量。结果表明，由此产生的测量概率精确地再现了目标函数的多维伯恩斯坦多项式，并且对于任何连续多元函数，联合量子态均匀收敛到目标输出寄存器。
authors: Sviatoslav V. Dzhenzher

articles.title: Quantum machine learning geospatial time-series by seasonal encoding
articles.title_zh: 通过季节性编码实现量子机器学习地理空间时间序列
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41649v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum data reuploading models can increase the expressive capacity of variational quantum models, but do not necessarily improve predictive performance. In the present work, we investigate this behavior for seasonal time series forecasting and show that data encoding determines how well temporal structures are represented as circuit depth increases. We develop a fidelity-based quantum geometric description in which repeated encodings contribute to an effective input generator, so that reuploading depth changes the quantum geometry through which approximately recurrent inputs are distinguished. We construct fixed and adaptive seasonal encodings that represent observation magnitude and seasonal phase in distinct Bloch-sphere coordinates. We evaluate these encodings for monthly precipitation derived from ERA5-Land, a global reanalysis dataset, from a representative semi-arid, drought-prone tropical region in East Africa, using a 14-month lag window and reuploading depths L= 1-6. We find that in ideal simulations, standard value-based encodings degrade markedly with depth, whereas adaptive seasonal encodings preserve temporal correlation, spectral structure, and forecasting accuracy. Noisy simulations show that this encoding hierarchy persists at shallow and intermediate depths, while larger depths are limited by circuit noise and optimization difficulty. The seasonal quantum models remain competitive with established classical forecasting methods (ARIMA, random forests, and LSTMs). These results identify structure-aware quantum data encoding as a general strategy for building deeper quantum reuploading models.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子数据重上传模型可以增强变分量子模型的表达能力，但并非总能提升预测性能。本研究针对季节性时间序列预测，探讨了数据编码如何影响时间结构随电路深度增加的表示效果。文章提出了一个基于保真度的量子几何描述，其中重复编码有助于形成有效的输入生成器，从而重上传深度改变了区分近似循环输入的量子几何。研究构建了固定和自适应的季节性编码，并在东非半干旱地区月降水数据上进行了评估，结果表明自适应季节性编码能更好地保持时间相关性。
authors: Devjyoti Tripathy, Reece Robertson, Josey Stevens, Catherine Nakalembe, Sebastian Deffner

articles.title: Solving the MAX-k-CUT problem for hypergraphs with quantum computing
articles.title_zh: 利用量子计算解决超图上的MAX-k-CUT问题
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41678v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the MAX-k-CUT problem on hypergraphs by considering their representation as spin systems with Ising interactions. The corresponding cost Hamiltonian for MAX-k-CUT problem on hypergraphs is reduced to an Ising Hamiltonian with pairwise interactions. This reduction simplifies the solution of the MAX-k-CUT problem using quantum computing. As illustrative examples, a 3-uniform tight-star hypergraph and a sunflower hypergraph are considered. The corresponding Hamiltonians are constructed, and quantum protocols for the MAX-k-CUT problems are presented. The MAX-3-CUT and MAX-4-CUT instances are investigated for these hypergraphs by varying the number of Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) layers from (p=2) to (p=15) with quantum computing on IBM's Qiskit AerSimulator.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过将超图表示为具有伊辛相互作用的自旋系统，研究了超图上的MAX-k-CUT问题。研究将MAX-k-CUT问题的成本哈密顿量简化为具有成对相互作用的伊辛哈密顿量，从而简化了使用量子计算解决该问题的方法。文章以3-均匀紧星超图和向日葵超图为例，构建了相应的哈密顿量，并提出了量子协议。通过在IBM Qiskit AerSimulator上使用量子近似优化算法（QAOA），研究了这些超图的MAX-3-CUT和MAX-4-CUT实例。
authors: V. S. Yarmus, Kh. P. Gnatenko

articles.title: Exponential quantum-classical query separations for cyclic Forrelation
articles.title_zh: 循环Forrelation的指数级量子-经典查询分离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41694v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the randomized classical query complexity of cyclic Forrelation, a cyclic analogue of k-Forrelation [AA15, STOC'15; BS21, STOC'21]. Given k Boolean functions f₁,łdots,fₖ:F₂ⁿ→-1,1, the goal is to estimate Tₖ₌N⁻¹øperatornameTr(Df_₁Høtⁱmes ⁿḑots Df_ₖHøtⁱmes ⁿ), where Df_ᵢ=øperatornamediag(fᵢ₍ₓ₎:xinF₂ⁿ⁾, H is the Hadamard gate, and N=2ⁿ. This normalized-trace problem can be solved with k quantum queries in the DQC1 model. Its classical query complexity was left open in [JLS+26, FOCS'26], which conjectured a lower bound of widetildeØmega(N¹⁻²/k). We establish a nearly complete characterization of the nonadaptive classical query complexity of cyclic Forrelation. For even kge 4, we prove a tight bound of Θₖ₍N¹⁻²/k) for constant additive error. For odd kge 5, we obtain a lower bound of Ømegaₖ₍N¹⁻²/⁽k⁻¹⁾) and an upper bound of Oₖ₍N¹⁻²/k). Surprisingly, k=3 admits a polylogarithmic-query nonadaptive classical algorithm, disproving the conjecture in this case. These results suggest an unexpected parity-dependent structure: the nonadaptive complexity may be governed by the independence number of the k-cycle, leading to the exponent 1-1/łfloor k/2f̊loor, rather than the previously conjectured 1-2/k, which was motivated by a Fourier-growth heuristic. Finally, allowing adaptivity, we prove a lower bound of Ømega(N¹/⁴) for every kge4. Although formally close to k-Forrelation, the cyclic structure leads to rather different classical behavior and requires different techniques. Our lower bounds are based on hidden-shift collision constructions, and our upper bounds follow from randomized sampling together with cycle-specific conditional-moment estimates. Our results provide a systematic understanding of its query advantages over classical computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了循环Forrelation的随机经典查询复杂度，该问题在DQC1模型中可通过k次量子查询解决，但其经典查询复杂度此前仍是开放问题。研究对循环Forrelation的非自适应经典查询复杂度进行了近乎完整的刻画。对于偶数k≥4，证明了紧密界限Θₖ(N¹⁻²/k)；对于奇数k≥5，得到了下界Ωₖ(N¹⁻²/⁽k⁻¹⁾)和上界Oₖ(N¹⁻²/k)。令人惊讶的是，k=3时存在多对数查询的非自适应经典算法，推翻了此前的猜想，揭示了复杂度可能与k-循环的独立数相关的奇偶依赖结构。
authors: Yuxin Zhang, Changpeng Shao

articles.title: Extending Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization to Systems of Linear Equations
articles.title_zh: 将基于采样的量子对角化扩展到线性方程组
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41708v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Solving systems of linear equations, Ax=b, is a ubiquitous task in computational science. The Harrow-Hassidim-Lloyd algorithm requires phase estimation, controlled rotations, and post-selection, impractical on noisy intermediate-scale quantum hardware. We extend sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD), developed for quantum chemistry, to linear systems. Following the sample-based Krylov variant, the Hermitian matrix A is decomposed in the Pauli basis, the Trotterized time evolution of |bångle is sampled at several times to select computational-basis configurations, and the system is solved classically by a Galerkin projection onto the selected subspace. We prove that the subspace solution is exact when the sampled configurations contain the Krylov support of b and optimal in the energy norm for symmetric positive-definite matrices, so that noise-induced configurations cannot degrade it as long as they do not displace the ideal ones. On IBM Quantum hardware, the sampled distribution of a 4×4 example deviates from the exact one by eleven times the shot-noise level, yet the solution is recovered exactly. For a localized problem of dimension N=1024, SQD selects 33 configurations, reaches a relative error of 10⁻⁵, and its truncated subspaces coincide with the optimal choice; readout errors enlarge the subspace without degrading the accuracy. The tests also show the limitations: the selected subspace coincides with that of inexpensive classical selection, banded matrices require exponentially many Pauli terms in the binary encoding, and Trotter errors populate spurious configurations unless the circuits are deep. An MIT-licensed Python package and notebooks that reproduce the numerical results are provided.
articles.abstract_zh: 求解线性方程组Ax=b是计算科学中的普遍任务，但HHL算法对噪声中等规模量子硬件不实用。本文将为量子化学开发的基于采样的量子对角化（SQD）方法扩展到线性系统。该方法通过对|b⟩的Trotter化时间演化进行采样来选择计算基配置，并通过伽辽金投影在经典计算机上求解系统。研究证明，当采样配置包含b的Krylov支持时，子空间解是精确的，并且对于对称正定矩阵在能量范数下是最优的。在IBM量子硬件上的实验表明，即使采样分布存在噪声，也能精确恢复解。
authors: Taha Selim

articles.title: A Highly Nondegenerate Photon-Pair Source for Detector-Matched Quantum Key Distribution
articles.title_zh: 一种用于探测器匹配量子密钥分发的高度非简并光子对源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41709v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In a commercial entanglement-distribution system over telecom fibre, the single-photon detectors are the largest part of the hardware cost. In entanglement-based quantum key distribution (QKD), both photons of each pair must be detected. With two telecom photons, each arm needs either an InGaAs single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) of low efficiency or a superconducting nanowire single-photon detector (SNSPD) with its own cryostat. We study a highly nondegenerate photon-pair source that needs a telecom detector on one arm only. Two periodically poled KTiOPO₄ (ppKTP) crystals pumped at 405~nm emit pairs at 548 and 1550~nm. A Si-SPAD with 82% efficiency detects the 548~nm photon at the source node, and only the 1550~nm photon travels through fibre. A first, unoptimised module in a polarisation-correlated configuration generates about 1.5×10⁶ pairs/s per mW of pump power. It collects 13% of the pairs on the 548~nm arm and 23% on the 1550~nm arm. In an asymptotic BBM92 model, we compare its links with generic 2×1550~nm links that use a bright published source at the same pump power. At 50~km, our link with one SNSPD costs about 25% more per secret bit than the generic link with one SNSPD. With optimistic target values of 52% collection and twice the brightness, it costs about 40% as much as the generic link with two SNSPDs. Our link without a cryostat then costs about 70% less than the generic link with one SNSPD. If every link runs at its own best pump power, the two-SNSPD link is again the cheapest. The source can also serve clock synchronisation and detector calibration, which need only time-correlated pairs. All key rates assume the entangled configuration of the source, which is under development.
articles.abstract_zh: 在基于纠缠的量子密钥分发（QKD）系统中，单光子探测器是硬件成本的主要部分。本文研究了一种高度非简并的光子对源，该源仅需在其中一个臂上使用电信波段探测器。通过两个周期性极化KTiOPO₄晶体在405nm泵浦下产生548nm和1550nm的光子对，其中548nm光子在源节点由高效率Si-SPAD探测，而1550nm光子通过光纤传输。初步模块在偏振相关配置下实现了高产率，并在渐近BBM92模型中与传统双1550nm链路进行了比较，展示了其在降低探测器成本方面的潜力。
authors: Sander van Haagen, Bora Ulu, Alper Ozulker, Wardah Mahmood, Michal Krelina, Utku Tefek, Kadir Durak

articles.title: Leveraging Quantum Measurement Randomness for Shot-Efficient Diffusion Models
articles.title_zh: 利用量子测量随机性实现射击高效扩散模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41721v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In quantum computing, the readout always carries finite-shot sampling noise. Suppressing this noise through repeated measurements raises the cost of a quantum neural network (QNN). Meanwhile, a stochastic diffusion sampler deliberately adds randomness at each reverse (generation) step. This paper turns the measurement noise from a liability into a resource. Specifically, we use the noise quantum measurement produces anyway to replace part of the noise the sampler would otherwise inject. We characterize the measurement error as multinomial sampling noise propagated through a trainable linear readout. To connect the circuit's Born probabilities to the denoising task, we further formulate the diffusion process on a bounded zero-sum hyperplane mapped to the probability simplex. Therefore, we can employ a compensation noise to match the mean and covariance of the shot-noise-free linear update under some minimum shot conditions. Solving this condition for the shot count gives a state-dependent adaptive budget. For the denoising diffusion implicit model (DDIM), this budget increases as the sampler becomes more deterministic. On an eight-dimensional Gaussian mixture, the schedule achieves comparable generation quality with 303 shots per sample against a high-shot reference of 1.6×10⁶, about 5300× fewer. Latent diffusion experiments on MNIST further validate the proposed mechanism for generation in a learned latent space.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子计算中的读出总是伴随有限次测量的采样噪声，重复测量以抑制噪声会增加量子神经网络的成本。本文将量子测量噪声从劣势转化为资源，利用其替代扩散采样器中部分随机性。研究将测量误差表征为通过可训练线性读出传播的多项式采样噪声，并将扩散过程公式化在映射到概率单纯形的有界零和超平面上。通过引入补偿噪声以匹配无散粒噪声线性更新的均值和协方差，该方法为去噪扩散隐式模型（DDIM）提供了一个状态依赖的自适应测量预算，从而提高了射击效率。
authors: Tianhao Guo, Dianxin Zheng, Yuhua Qian, Yaohui Zheng, Yuzhi Yang, Merouane Debbah, Chau Yuen

articles.title: Chiral Torsional Double Wells: Tunneling and Polarizability
articles.title_zh: 手性扭转双势阱：隧穿与极化率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41782v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum tunneling between mirror-related wells of a torsional potential sets the timescale for coherent interconversion of chiral conformers. We ask whether slower tunneling also weakens the transition polarizability in hydrogen peroxide, hydrogen disulfide, and hydrogen diselenide. We use relaxed CCSD(T)//MP2 potentials and a kinetic model that removes overall molecular rotation to obtain the torsional states, then use static polarizabilities to calculate transition matrix elements between them. In the molecular frame used here, symmetry makes the matrix element of the even dipole component vanish between opposite-parity torsional states, while the odd polarizability component has a nonzero matrix element. The two quantities probe different parts of the torsional landscape: tunneling depends on penetration through the barriers, while the polarizability matrix element forms mainly within the wells. Consequently, tunneling slows sharply across the molecular series even as the matrix element grows. Higher torsional doublets and deuterium substitution further show that large changes in tunneling time can occur with little change in the transition polarizability matrix element. Calculated torsional energies for H₂O₂ and D₂O₂ agree with experimental values. Thus, slowing coherent interconversion need not weaken the intrinsic transition polarizability.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子隧穿在手性构象异构体的相干互变中起着关键作用，本文探讨了隧穿速率与过渡极化率之间的关系。研究利用弛豫的CCSD(T)//MP2势和去除整体分子旋转的动力学模型，计算了过氧化氢、二硫化氢和二硒化氢的扭转态及它们之间的静态极化率跃迁矩阵元。结果表明，隧穿和极化率矩阵元探测扭转势能面的不同部分：隧穿依赖于穿透势垒，而极化率矩阵元主要形成于势阱内部。因此，即使矩阵元增大，隧穿速率在分子系列中仍急剧减慢，且高阶扭转双重态和氘代进一步证实了隧穿时间与极化率矩阵元变化之间的解耦。
authors: Shah Ishmam Mohtashim, Manas Sajjan, Sabre Kais

articles.title: Bounding Fidelity of Non-Stabilizer States from Local Pauli Measurements
articles.title_zh: 从局部泡利测量中限制非稳定子态的保真度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41808v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonstabilizerness, commonly referred to as magic, is essential for universal quantum computation. Yet, for pure n-qubit states this property is directly linked to the hardness of direct fidelity estimation. We propose a scheme to bound the fidelity on non-stabilizer states by choosing operators with low measurement overhead and using parallel local Pauli measurements to estimate compatible observables. We selectively measure operators that share a permutational symmetry without imposing any assumption on the physical system. This selection reduces the optimization to a linear program with only O(n) variables for bounding fidelity. Our methods can be extended to bound nonlinear quantities like the purity via convex quadratic programs. For hypergraph states that can exhibit extensive nonstabilizerness, we demonstrate for up to n=500 qubits that our framework substantially reduces the measurement overhead under both local and global depolarizing noise. These results show that symmetry induced by measurement selection reduces both measurement and computational costs, enabling scalable characterization of magic resources in quantum computing and quantum networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 非稳定性（或称“魔力”）对于通用量子计算至关重要，但其纯n量子比特态的直接保真度估计难度较大。本文提出一种方案，通过选择低测量开销的算符并利用并行局部泡利测量来估计兼容可观测量，从而限制非稳定子态的保真度。该方法通过选择具有置换对称性的算符，将优化问题简化为仅包含O(n)变量的线性规划。对于超图态，该框架在局部和全局去极化噪声下显著降低了测量开销，展示了测量选择引入的对称性如何有效降低测量和计算成本，从而实现量子计算中“魔力”资源的可扩展表征。
authors: Yi Li, Otfried Gühne, Qiongyi He

articles.title: Overcoming the Representational Limitations of Amplitude Encoding for Quantum Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 克服量子神经网络振幅编码的表示局限性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41824v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum Neural Networks (QNNs) offer a framework for learning functions from classical data, but their expressive power depends critically on how inputs are encoded into quantum states. Angle encoding can require resources that scale with the number of features, whereas amplitude encoding represents d features using only O(łog₂ d) qubits. This compactness comes at a representational cost: normalization makes conventional amplitude encoding invariant to nonzero real rescaling of the input, up to an unobservable global phase. We show that this invariance induces an exact, architecture-independent restriction on the resulting hypothesis class. No downstream quantum circuit can distinguish inputs differing by nonzero real scaling. We develop a general condition under which deterministic preprocessing can remove this ambiguity and show that nonlinearity alone is insufficient. Based on this analysis, we introduce a fixed nonlinear feature map that provably distinguishes all real inputs under subsequent amplitude encoding, without adding trainable parameters and while retaining logarithmic qubit scaling. We evaluate the resulting QNN on three canonical classification benchmarks and a nonlinear synthetic dataset against conventional amplitude and angle encoding, as well as a classical neural network. Across these tasks, the proposed encoding consistently improves classification accuracy over both quantum encoding baselines by 21-44 %. Our results establish normalization-induced scale invariance as a concrete representational bottleneck of amplitude encoding and demonstrate that it can be removed while preserving a compact quantum representation, marking a step toward quantum models capable of capturing arbitrary relationships in classical data.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子神经网络（QNNs）的表达能力高度依赖于数据编码方式。振幅编码虽然能以对数级量子比特表示特征，但其归一化特性导致对非零实数缩放的输入具有不变性，从而限制了其表示能力。本文证明了这种不变性对假设类施加了精确且与架构无关的限制。研究提出了一种通用的确定性预处理条件来消除这种歧义，并引入了一个固定的非线性特征映射，该映射在后续振幅编码下可区分所有实数输入，且不增加可训练参数并保持对数级量子比特缩放。
authors: Vincent Gurgul, David Prinz

articles.title: Toward Quantum Monte Carlo for Sovereign Debt Risk: A proof of concept
articles.title_zh: 迈向量子蒙特卡洛主权债务风险评估：概念验证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41831v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a proof-of-concept pipeline that applies quantum amplitude estimation to the probability that a sovereign debt-to-GDP ratio exceeds a critical threshold at a given horizon. The pipeline combines a reduced two-factor Gaussian debt model linearized around its mean, quantum state preparation on a 32 x 32 grid, a weighted-adder circuit, an integer comparator, and Maximum Likelihood Amplitude Estimation (MLAE). On a noiseless statevector simulator with 500 shots per Grover power, the circuit estimate (a = 0.1152) agrees with the circuit's exact target amplitude (0.1153), and the observed estimation error is consistent with the amplitude-estimation scaling in the number of oracle calls. The model used here is deliberately simple: it admits a closed-form solution, so the contribution is a demonstration of the encoding and estimation workflow, not a practical advantage over classical methods. We discuss the conditions under which such a pipeline could become relevant and the obstacles that remain.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个概念验证流程，将量子振幅估计应用于主权债务占GDP比率超过临界阈值的概率计算。该流程结合了简化的两因子高斯债务模型、量子态制备、加权加法器电路、整数比较器和最大似然振幅估计。在无噪声模拟器上，电路估计结果与精确目标振幅高度一致，且估计误差符合振幅估计的缩放规律。尽管当前模型较为简单，其主要贡献在于展示了编码和估计的工作流程，并探讨了该流程未来可能的相关条件和面临的挑战。
authors: Jean-Sébastien Dessureault, Alitiana Mijoro Barisoa

articles.title: Engineered Learning Problems on Noisy Quantum Processors
articles.title_zh: 噪声量子处理器上的工程化学习问题
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41848v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Despite quantum machine learning being an active topic of research, demonstrations of algorithms run on quantum hardware beating classical methods remain rare. In this work, we demonstrate a significant performance gap using a projected quantum kernel for n=15,30 and 45 qubits over classical methods on an engineered classification problem, and show reproducibility of the results over different quantum processor units. We also demonstrate how error mitigation can widen this gap, both by improving hardware performance but also by increasing the classical difficulty, with different techniques contributing unequally to these phenomena. This work provides strong evidence that superior empirical performance of quantum hardware over all classical techniques is an achievable goal in quantum machine learning, albeit for an artificial problem. However, as with any application relying on observables, beating state-of-the-art simulation methods remains the primary challenge, as our matrix product state results here show.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管量子机器学习是活跃的研究领域，但量子硬件算法超越经典方法的案例仍属罕见。本研究在一个工程化分类问题上，利用投影量子核在15、30和45个量子比特上展示了量子方法相对于经典方法的显著性能优势，并验证了结果在不同量子处理器上的可复现性。研究还表明，误差缓解技术能通过提升硬件性能和增加经典难度来扩大这一差距。这项工作为量子机器学习中量子硬件超越所有经典技术提供了有力证据，尽管目前仅限于人工问题，但超越最先进的模拟方法仍是主要挑战。
authors: Esteban Payares, Nadia Milazzo, Ghada Ben Slama, Thomas Cope

articles.title: Control-Noise Trade-offs in Industrially Integrated {}²⁸Si/SiGe Spin-1/2 Qubits
articles.title_zh: 工业集成²⁸Si/SiGe自旋-1/2量子比特中的控制-噪声权衡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41890v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scaling silicon spin qubits to fault-tolerant processors requires semiconductor foundry integration, yet it remains unclear how industrial fabrication and dense device integration affect qubit control and noise. Here we study {}²⁸Si/SiGe electron spin-1/2 qubits fabricated using Intel's industry-compatible 300 mm process and incorporating micromagnets for electrically driven spin resonance, using a high-performance device fabricated in the RIKEN research cleanroom as a reference. Primitive π/2-gate fidelities reach the 99.99% level in the Intel devices, which also exhibit longer idle coherence, weaker low-frequency correlations and reduced qubit-to-qubit variability across several measured characteristics. In the present Intel devices, the micromagnets are integrated inline with the back-end-of-line (BEOL) contact routing, with their separation from the quantum well set through the vertical stack design. Relative to the reference, their larger separation contributes to weaker longitudinal and transverse magnetic-field gradients. The weaker longitudinal gradient suppresses the conversion of charge noise into qubit-frequency fluctuations, whereas the weaker transverse gradient reduces electrically driven spin-resonance efficiency and makes drive-dependent errors relevant at lower Rabi frequencies. Additional BEOL routing and metal levels required for two-dimensional arrays make such placement decisions increasingly consequential when scaling. These results establish an integration-level control-noise trade-off linking micromagnet placement within densely routed layouts to achievable gate performance, while very high-fidelity operation remains possible in industrially fabricated devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 将硅自旋量子比特扩展到容错处理器需要半导体代工集成，但工业制造和密集器件集成对量子比特控制和噪声的影响尚不明确。本研究对比了采用英特尔300毫米工艺制造的²⁸Si/SiGe电子自旋-1/2量子比特与RIKEN参考器件的性能。英特尔器件实现了99.99%的π/2门保真度，并表现出更长的空闲相干时间、更弱的低频相关性和更低的量子比特间变异性。研究发现，英特尔器件中微磁体与量子阱的较大分离导致了较弱的纵向和横向磁场梯度，从而抑制了电荷噪声向量子比特频率波动的转化。
authors: Leon C. Camenzind, Ik Kyeong Jin, Yi-Hsien Wu, Akito Noiri, Kenta Takeda, Takashi Nakajima, Takashi Kobayashi, Giordano Scappucci, Seigo Tarucha

articles.title: Lifting the mixed to the pure: quantum phases of matter from canonical purification
articles.title_zh: 从混合态到纯态的提升：基于规范纯化的量子物相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41926v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pure-state quantum phases are defined through finite-depth local unitary connections. This concept of phases has recently been generalized to mixed states in terms of locally reversible channels. In this work, we establish a fundamental relation between mixed-state phases and pure-state phases. We show that a locally reversible channel between mixed states can be lifted to a local isometry between their canonical purifications; thus, if two mixed states are in the same phase, then their canonical purifications are in the same pure-state phase. Furthermore, an explicit construction of the lifting isometry is given by ``half'' of the Petz recovery map, suggesting that the Petz recovery map emphwithout rotation is enough to connect mixed state phases. We illustrate our results with two examples: toric code under bit flip noise and Chern insulator under fermion number noise.
articles.abstract_zh: 纯态量子相通过有限深度局域酉连接定义，而混合态量子相则通过局域可逆信道推广。本研究建立了混合态相与纯态相之间的基本关系，证明了混合态之间的局域可逆信道可以提升为其规范纯化之间的局域等距映射。这意味着如果两个混合态处于同一相，则它们的规范纯化也处于同一纯态相。研究还通过Petz恢复映射的“一半”给出了提升等距映射的显式构造，并通过比特翻转噪声下的拓扑码和费米子数噪声下的陈绝缘体进行了示例说明。
authors: Xiaoyang Huang, Shengqi Sang, Chong Wang, Yijian Zou

articles.title: Locality, Probability and the Relevance of History
articles.title_zh: 局域性、概率与历史的相关性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41944v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Relativistic theory and experiments teach us that causal influences are constrained by the speed of light. Deterministic theories incorporate this lesson in functional terms: whether an event occurs or not is functionally determined by events that occur in its immediate causal past. In this paper we suggest a natural generalization of this constraint that applies to probabilistic theories: the probability that an event occurs is to be functionally determined by the probability of the event-occurrences in its immediate causal past. This constraint differs from Bell's criterion of local causality and turns out to imply it only under an additional assumption that requires history to be, in a sense, irrelevant. Bell-inequality-violating quantum phenomena are thus arguably not in tension with relativity, locality, "statistical independence", nor with a supposed "realism". What they instead show is that history is, in a sense, relevant.
articles.abstract_zh: 相对论理论表明因果影响受光速限制，确定性理论将其表述为事件由其直接因果过去决定。本文提出将此限制推广至概率理论：事件发生的概率应由其直接因果过去事件发生的概率函数性决定。这一约束不同于贝尔的局域因果性判据，仅在历史在某种意义上不相关的额外假设下才蕴含贝尔判据。因此，违反贝尔不等式的量子现象与相对论、局域性、“统计独立性”或“实在论”并不矛盾，反而表明历史在某种意义上是相关的。
authors: Sebastian Horvat

articles.title: No generalised contextuality from the vacuum
articles.title_zh: 真空中无法产生广义语境性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41964v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that, under certain conditions, generalised contextuality, in the sense introduced by Spekkens, cannot be created from the vacuum of a quantum field. Initial noncontextual qudit states do not become contextual just by interacting with a quantum field. This is verified in two scenarios. First, in a perturbative approach where the time evolution operator is expanded in powers of the coupling constant. Second, in the limit of zero energy gap in the spectrum of the free detector Hamiltonian. Our results are at the opposite side of what has been recently obtained in the literature regarding the harvesting of Kochen-Specker contextuality. Our results demonstrate that the existing notions of contextuality can be independent of one another and that contextuality harvesting depends on which precise notion is used.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明，在特定条件下，量子场真空中无法产生Spekkens意义上的广义语境性。初始的非语境化量子比特态不会仅仅通过与量子场相互作用而变得语境化。这一结论在微扰方法和自由探测器哈密顿量零能隙极限两种场景下得到验证。与近期关于Kochen-Specker语境性获取的研究结果相反，本研究表明现有的语境性概念可以相互独立，并且语境性获取取决于所使用的具体概念。
authors: Ruben Campos Delgado, Selman Ipek

articles.title: Logical Bell Inequalities for Marginal Wigner Negativity
articles.title_zh: 边际维格纳负性对应的逻辑贝尔不等式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.42017v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct logical Bell inequalities whose violations are determined by the Wigner function of a reduced quantum state. For odd-prime qudits, each phase-space point of any nonempty proper subsystem defines an inequality, violated precisely when the corresponding Gross Wigner value is negative. This correspondence allows us to quantify the contextuality that a reduced state guarantees for the composite system. The normalized violation gives a lower bound on the contextual fraction in the complete Weyl measurement scenario, valid for every joint state with that marginal, irrespective of its correlations. We identify a family of product states that saturates this bound. For these states, one marginal Wigner value fixes the contextual fraction of the entire system.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了逻辑贝尔不等式，其违反程度由约化量子态的维格纳函数决定。对于奇素数维量子比特，任何非空真子系统的每个相空间点都定义了一个不等式，当且仅当对应的Gross Wigner值为负时该不等式被违反。这种对应关系使得我们能够量化约化态为复合系统所保证的语境性。归一化违反值给出了完整Weyl测量场景中语境化分数的下限，适用于所有具有该边际态的联合态，与其关联性无关。研究还识别了一族饱和此下限的乘积态，对于这些态，一个边际维格纳值即可确定整个系统的语境化分数。
authors: Sanchit Srivastava, Selman Ipek, Cihan Okay, Shohini Ghose

articles.title: Empirical Evaluation of Quantum Kernel Methods for Classification: A Comparative Study with Classical Kernels
articles.title_zh: 量子核方法在分类中的实证评估：与经典核的比较研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.42029v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum kernel methods are the most concrete near-term proposal for quantum machine learning on classical data, yet published benchmarks disagree on whether they outperform tuned classical kernels, and the disagreement cannot be resolved from the literature because the comparisons are not protocol-controlled. We argue that the obstacle is one of measurement, not theory: the usual setup fixes the quantum feature map's data scaling while grid-searching the classical kernel's hyperparameters, recomputes nothing per fold, and reports cost in simulator time. We therefore treat the comparison itself as the object of study and impose three controls. The bandwidth is tuned on the same grid budget as the classical γ, the kernel is recomputed inside every fold from fold-fitted preprocessing, and cost is counted in hardware circuit evaluations. On top of these we run a factorial design of 324 cells in which dimensionality, training size, class separability and data structure are explicit covariates, together with four standard datasets, a shots-versus-gate-noise ablation, and a cost sweep. The dominant effect we measure is not quantum: tuning the feature map's bandwidth is worth 0.120 accuracy on synthetic data and 0.339 on real data, exceeding every quantum-classical difference we observe. Tuned quantum kernels are then statistically indistinguishable from a tuned RBF on all four real datasets. The advantage on synthetic data is confined almost entirely to data generated by the feature map itself, and it shrinks with dimensionality (-0.0045 per qubit) while growing with sample size. Finite sampling costs an order of magnitude more accuracy than gate and readout noise, and a fidelity kernel needs 5×10⁷ circuits at n = 10,000. Protocol variance is thus sufficient to explain the field's contradictory conclusions.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子核方法是近期量子机器学习处理经典数据的最具体方案，但现有基准测试对其是否优于调优的经典核存在争议。本文认为这种争议源于测量方法而非理论问题，指出传统比较设置存在缺陷。为解决此问题，研究引入了三项控制措施：量子核带宽与经典核超参数在相同预算下调优，核在每个折叠内重新计算，以及成本以硬件电路评估次数衡量。在此基础上，研究通过因子设计实验，考察了维度、训练规模、类别可分离性和数据结构等协变量的影响，并发现主导效应并非量子特性。
authors: Ronak Bhalgami

articles.title: Benchmarking Single-Photon Sources for Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Key Distribution
articles.title_zh: 用于测量设备无关量子密钥分发的单光子源基准测试
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.42041v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Key Distribution (MDI-QKD) enables secure communication without trusting the measurement devices, but its performance critically depends on the quality of the employed photon sources. We compare MDI-QKD implementations based on Weak Coherent Pulses (WCPs) with those employing Quantum Dot (QD) single-photon sources. WCP-based schemes are fundamentally limited by Poissonian photon-number statistics, imposing a trade-off between single- and multi-photon emissions, whereas QD sources exhibit sub-Poissonian statistics with low antibunching parameter g⁽²⁾(0). Using a decoy-state analysis for both source types, we find that even at moderate mean photon numbers, QD-based implementations outperform the best-case WCP configuration - where the mean photon number is optimised at each transmission distance - across the full range of transmission distances. We further incorporate the effect of imperfect photon indistinguishability via Hong-Ou-Mandel interference visibilities into the security framework and demonstrate that both source types are highly sensitive to even small deviations from ideal indistinguishability, significantly affecting achievable key rates and maximum transmission distance.
articles.abstract_zh: 测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）实现了无需信任测量设备的安全通信，但其性能严重依赖于光子源的质量。本研究比较了基于弱相干脉冲（WCP）和量子点（QD）单光子源的MDI-QKD实现。结果显示，即使在中等平均光子数下，QD源在所有传输距离上均优于优化后的WCP配置。研究进一步将光子不可分辨性引入安全框架，并证明两种光源类型都对理想不可分辨性的微小偏差高度敏感。
authors: Janka Memmen, Yvonne Lasars, Tobias Heindel, Nathan Walk, Anna Pappa

articles.title: The Quartic Gap Between Quantum and Dequantized Algorithms for Linear Algebra Is Tight
articles.title_zh: 线性代数中量子算法与去量子化算法之间的四次方差距是紧密的
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.42069v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum algorithms for linear algebra that access a matrix A through quantum random access memory (QRAM) prepare quantum states proportional to the solutions of linear systems and related problems. Dequantized classical algorithms, when given sampling and query access to A, return sampling and query access to an approximate solution. Both kinds of algorithms use a number of queries that is polynomial in the normalized Frobenius norm h̊o=|A|_F/|A| and does not directly depend on the dimension. For linear systems at fixed condition number and accuracy, quantum algorithms use widetilde O(h̊o) queries, whereas the best dequantized algorithms use widetilde O(h̊o⁴⁾. We prove that this quartic gap is tight in the worst case, up to a logarithmic factor. For every constant κ₀>1, we construct dense linear systems with condition number at most κ₀ for which sampling from the solution within a sufficiently small constant total variation distance requires Ømega(h̊o⁴/łogh̊o) classical queries but only Θ(h̊o) quantum queries. The same separation holds, for errors below smaller thresholds, for positive-definite systems, least squares, ridge regression, matrix powers and square roots, imaginary-time and real-time Hamiltonian evolution, and sampling from the top principal component. Our results therefore show that many quantum algorithms for linear algebra, achieve a near-quartic speedup in the worst case, over classical algorithms with sampling and query access. All of these classical lower bounds follow from the same framework, which is based on a lower bound for sampling from distributions that depend on a fixed set of Fourier coefficients of an unknown Boolean function.
articles.abstract_zh: 访问矩阵A的量子线性代数算法通过量子随机存取存储器（QRAM）制备与线性系统解成比例的量子态。去量子化经典算法在给定A的采样和查询访问权限时，返回近似解的采样和查询访问权限。对于固定条件数和精度的线性系统，量子算法使用O(h̊o)次查询，而最佳去量子化算法使用O(h̊o⁴)次查询。本文证明了在最坏情况下，这个四次方差距是紧密的，仅相差一个对数因子。研究构建了特定稠密线性系统，其解的采样需要Ω(h̊o⁴/logh̊o)次经典查询，但仅需Θ(h̊o)次量子查询，从而严格证明了这种分离。
authors: Shouvanik Chakrabarti, Dylan Herman, Junhyung Lyle Kim, Guneykan Ozgul

articles.title: Secret-shared teleportation of a two-qudit gate with a deferred recipient
articles.title_zh: 具有延迟接收者的两量子比特门秘密共享隐形传态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.42150v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An unknown quantum operation, like an unknown quantum state, cannot be perfectly copied or stored for later use. A specific gate can be embedded in an entangled resource and teleported, but its destination is fixed when the resource is created. Here we show that the capability to apply a two-qudit entangling gate can instead be secret-shared among many parties: the shares are distributed in advance, and a later key release lets exactly one of them, chosen after distribution, exercise it. A provider encrypts half of a Bell pair held with a user into n shares, one per candidate node. The selected node, given the key qudits, completes an exact non-local mathttCSUMk gate with the user's data, in every measurement branch and for any qudit dimension, with the power k chosen by the user alone. Any coalition of fewer than n candidate nodes, or the key register alone, holds no information, unselected nodes cannot tell whether a selection occurred, and the key cannot decrypt twice. For two candidates the registers form a ((3,5)) threshold scheme. Encoder and decoder are explicit O(n) circuits. The construction supports jointly authorized and anonymous gate application, advancing distributed quantum computing and quantum network capabilities.
articles.abstract_zh: 未知量子操作无法像未知量子态一样被完美复制或存储以供后续使用。虽然特定门可以嵌入纠缠资源并进行隐形传态，但其目的地在资源创建时即已固定。本文展示了将应用两量子比特纠缠门的能力在多方之间进行秘密共享的方法：份额预先分发，之后通过密钥释放，允许在分发后选择的其中一方执行该操作。提供者将与用户共享的贝尔对的一半加密成n份份额，分发给每个候选节点。被选中的节点在获得密钥量子比特后，与用户数据完成精确的非局域CSUMk门操作。该方案确保了信息安全，未被选中的节点无法得知选择是否发生，且密钥无法重复解密。
authors: Tanay Roy

articles.title: Singlet-Triplet Transition of Rotating Moiré Atoms in a Magnetic Field
articles.title_zh: 磁场中旋转莫尔原子的单重态-三重态跃迁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40786v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Moiré superlattices can bind several electrons to each potential minimum, forming few-electron "moiré atoms." Using neural quantum states that obey magnetic periodic boundary conditions, include full Landau-level mixing, and treat both spin sectors, we map the ground state of two-electron moiré atoms in a superlattice as a function of moiré depth and magnetic field strength. At strong field each atom is a spin-triplet maximum-density droplet with canonical angular momentum łangle L_zångle=-1 and a persistent circulating current: the rotating counterpart of the "Wigner molecular crystal" recently imaged in moiré superlattices. Deepening the wells drives a singlet-triplet transition to non-rotating spin-singlet atoms whose only current is a weak diamagnetic counter-circulation. The transition moves to deeper wells as the field grows, so depth and field together open a window for the formation of rotors. This is the collective analog of the singlet-triplet transition of two-electron quantum dots. At the transition, the orbital magnetic moments of the atoms reverse sign as their spin polarization switches, a joint signature accessible to magnetometry. If the atoms are instead polarized by other means, such as magnetic proximity coupling, the rotors lock at weak field into a spontaneously ordered crystal of dimers in a pinwheel pattern.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用神经网络量子态研究了莫尔超晶格中双电子莫尔原子在磁场下的基态行为。研究发现，在强磁场下，莫尔原子形成自旋三重态的最大密度液滴，并伴有持续的循环电流。随着势阱加深，原子会经历单重态-三重态跃迁，转变为非旋转的自旋单重态原子。该跃迁类似于双电子量子点的单重态-三重态跃迁，且在跃迁时原子的轨道磁矩会随自旋极化反转。
authors: Conor Smith, Yubo Yang, Shiwei Zhang, Miguel A. Morales

articles.title: Relating approaches to interacting quantum clocks and systems
articles.title_zh: 关联相互作用量子时钟与系统的方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40791v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The problem of describing the dynamics of quantum systems relative to quantum clocks with which they interact is relevant to the physics of quantum reference frames and quantum gravity alike. There have been different approaches that derive a relational time-dependent Schrödinger equation for the system relative to the clock from a time-independent Hamiltonian constraint. We show that some of these approaches, due to Smith and Ahmadi, Gemsheim and Rost, as well as the so-called Born-Oppenheimer approach, can be unified in a single framework for describing conditional quantum states. In particular, the Born-Oppenheimer approach to quantum cosmology is seen to correspond to a type of interacting Page-Wootters formalism. We discuss the issue of unitarity and linearity, or lack thereof, in the relational dynamics, and we conclude with a brief outlook to further developments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了描述量子系统相对于相互作用量子时钟动力学的问题，这对于量子参考系和量子引力物理学至关重要。研究表明，Smith和Ahmadi、Gemsheim和Rost以及玻恩-奥本海默方法等几种从时间无关哈密顿约束推导关系时间依赖薛定谔方程的方法，可以在描述条件量子态的统一框架下进行整合。特别是，量子宇宙学中的玻恩-奥本海默方法被视为一种相互作用的Page-Wootters形式。文章还讨论了关系动力学中幺正性和线性问题，并展望了未来的发展。
authors: Artur Semião, Leonardo Chataignier

articles.title: Benchmarking One-Dimensional Quantum Lattice Boltzmann Methods on Quantum Hardware
articles.title_zh: 在量子硬件上对一维量子格子玻尔兹曼方法进行基准测试
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40851v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Classical computational fluid dynamics (CFD) methods encounter significant computational bottlenecks in large systems and at high Reynolds number flows due to the rapid increase in degrees of freedom, even on flagship supercomputers. As quantum computers emerge, the Quantum Lattice Boltzmann Method (QLBM) has been proposed as a quantum-native alternative for solving fluid dynamics problems. However, until recently, nearly all studies have relied on classical quantum simulators rather than real quantum hardware. This study presents a benchmark of a one-dimensional QLBM implementation executed on three different IBM Quantum hardware. We design and test a quantum circuit for the advection-diffusion equation using amplitude encoding, a Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook (BGK)-type collision operator, and a streaming step with periodic boundary conditions. Our numerical experiments evaluate transpiled two-qubit gate count, total circuit depth, runtime, and accuracy metrics including maximum absolute error (Lᵢₙfty norm) and root-mean-square error (RMSE). We find that the present collision and streaming operators dominate the overall cost and become the primary scalability bottleneck on current hardware. To mitigate the prohibitive cost of full quantum state tomography on hardware-based benchmarking exercises, we introduce a sampler-based measurement strategy that reconstructs macroscopic density fields directly from computational-basis measurements. This approach substantially reduces measurement overhead while preserving the expected advection-diffusion dynamics on hardware. These results provide a quantitative assessment of QLBM performance in the noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) regime and identify the principal algorithmic and experimental limitations that must be addressed for QLBM to become viable for fluid dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 经典计算流体动力学方法在大系统和高雷诺数流中面临计算瓶颈，而量子格子玻尔兹曼方法（QLBM）被提出作为一种量子原生替代方案。本研究首次在三种不同的IBM量子硬件上对一维QLBM实现进行了基准测试。我们设计并测试了一个用于对流-扩散方程的量子电路，并评估了其双量子比特门计数、电路深度、运行时长和精度指标。结果表明，当前的碰撞和流传输算子是总成本的主要来源。
authors: Melvina Quartey (Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute), Lucy T. Zhang (Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute)

articles.title: Proof of the entropic c-theorem
articles.title_zh: 熵c定理的证明
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40874v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We prove an entropic c-theorem in two dimensions by constructing a c-function from the mutual information between spacelike separated wedges, defined through the relative entropy. The proof follows Casini and Huerta's, with strong subadditivity of entanglement entropy replaced by increasing differences of the mutual information, which we prove directly in the continuum from the split property and standard properties of relative entropy. The benefit of relative entropy is that every quantity we use is finite and no cutoff ever needs to be introduced. The assumptions of the theorem are only the standard axioms of algebraic quantum field theory, the split property with finite mutual information across a gap (both implied by modular p-nuclearity), and a finite ultraviolet bound on the resulting c-functions. We also note that, formally, the c-function is proportional to the minimal averaged null energy of a state that reproduces the vacuum correlations between the two wedges.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过构建一个基于类空间隔楔形之间互信息（通过相对熵定义）的c函数，证明了二维熵c定理。该证明沿袭了Casini和Huerta的方法，但将纠缠熵的强次可加性替换为互信息的递增差分。相对熵的优势在于所用量均为有限值，无需引入截断。该定理的假设仅包括代数量子场论的标准公理、具有有限互信息的劈裂性质以及对所得c函数的有限紫外界限。
authors: Jonah Kudler-Flam

articles.title: Characteristics of VHF and UHF band detection using Stark shifting in Rydberg-atom sensors
articles.title_zh: 利用里德堡原子传感器中斯塔克位移进行VHF和UHF波段探测的特性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40952v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a characterization of the sensitivity of broadband electric field measurements in the Very High Frequency (VHF) and Ultra High Frequency (UHF) bands using AC stark shifting of Rydberg states. The dependence of the sensitivity and dynamic range of the field measurements using nD5/2 states of cesium for principal quantum numbers n= 60, 70, 80, 90 and 100 is presented, detailing the intricacies involved. The frequencies considered for the measurement range from 50 MHz to 900 MHz for which a transverse electromagnetic (TEM) cell is used to excite the Rydberg atoms with the RF fields. The corresponding sensitivities achieved are in the (μ V/m)/sqrtHz range. A general trend of better sensitivity for higher principal quantum numbers is observed. This work paves the way for a better understanding of the AC Stark dependent field measurements using Rydberg sensors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文详细描述了利用里德堡态的交流斯塔克位移，在甚高频（VHF）和超高频（UHF）波段进行宽带电场测量的灵敏度特性。研究了铯原子nD5/2态在主量子数n=60至100范围内的灵敏度和动态范围依赖性。测量频率范围为50 MHz至900 MHz，实现了微伏每米每根赫兹量级的灵敏度，并观察到主量子数越高灵敏度越好的普遍趋势。这项工作为深入理解基于交流斯塔克效应的里德堡传感器场测量奠定了基础。
authors: Rajavardhan Talashila, Noah Schlossberger, David S. La Mantia, Abby Halasi-Kun, Baran Kayim, Michael A. Viray, Robert Wyllie, Christopher L. Holloway, Nikunjkumar Prajapati

articles.title: Microscopic Theory of Spin-Orbit Interactions of Light
articles.title_zh: 光自旋-轨道相互作用的微观理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40979v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Optical spin-orbit interactions (SOI), demonstrated experimentally in optical cavities, enable the polarization degrees of freedom of light to be described and controlled as an effective pseudospin, providing a foundation for spintronic-like control of light and the development of next-generation optical technologies. However, prior works describe this emergent effect using phenomenological models that fail to uncover its microscopic quantum origins, and as a result, a rigorous connection between material electronic structure and the optical SOI remains elusive. In this work, we address this fundamental challenge by developing a microscopic quantum theory starting from the non-relativistic quantum electrodynamical (QED) description of light-matter interactions. We show that this effect arises from virtual interactions between confined photons and material excitations. Crucially, our theoretical framework provides microscopic material-design principles for tuning the distinct components of optical SOI, which include the optical birefringence, photonic self-energies, TE-TM splitting, and optical Zeeman splitting, enabling precise engineering of effective magnetic fields, diabolical points, and pseudospin textures. We anticipate that the predictive capability of our microscopic theory will enable systematic screening and design of material systems for photonic spintronics and optical technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 光学自旋-轨道相互作用（SOI）在光学腔中得到实验验证，但其微观量子起源仍不明确。本文从非相对论量子电动力学描述出发，发展了一种微观量子理论来解决这一挑战。研究表明，SOI源于受限光子与材料激发之间的虚相互作用。该理论框架为调控光学SOI的不同组分提供了微观材料设计原则，包括光学双折射、光子自能、TE-TM分裂和光学塞曼分裂，从而实现精确工程。
authors: Saeed Rahmanian Koshkaki, Ding Xu, Michael Fowler, Milan Delor, Arkajit Mandal

articles.title: Exact Electron Dynamics in Linear and Chiral Cavities: Complete Field versus Single-Helicity Reduction
articles.title_zh: 线性手性腔中电子的精确动力学：完整场与单螺旋度简化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40986v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Can a chiral cavity turn a free electron into a Landau-like orbiting particle? We answer with exact solutions of three quadratic electron--cavity models in the dipole limit, valid at arbitrary coupling. A single linearly polarized mode dresses the electron mass, which delays its flight, slows the spreading of a wavepacket and entangles the packet with the cavity.
