The complete transverse field, with both circular helicities, keeps two commuting, gapless translations at any coupling, mode number and helicity splitting, so the electron stays ballistic and no synthetic magnetic field appears. Keeping a single helicity gives two inequivalent models that are not related by a gauge transformation: reducing before the Power--Zienau--Woolley transformation gives ballistic motion, whereas reducing after it gives a Landau-like crossed-quadrature Hamiltonian. They differ by a real uniform field B=słambda²/(2ømega_c) (ømega_c the mode frequency, łambda the coupling, s=±1 the helicity). In the complete theory the frequency ømega₋ₛ of the partner helicity, measured against g²⁼łambda²/(2ømega_c), decides between them: the electron is ballistic for a stiff partner, and Landau-like only at the soft-partner point, through an exact canonical reorganization that holds for the active sector but not for observables such as the electron--photon entanglement. Projecting onto one helicity after the PZW transformation is therefore not by itself a mechanism for synthetic magnetism; the mode content of the cavity is.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过偶极极限下三个二次电子-腔模型的精确解，探讨了手性腔是否能将自由电子转变为类朗道轨道粒子。研究发现，单个线偏振模式会改变电子质量，而包含两种圆偏振螺旋度的完整横向场则使电子保持弹道运动，不产生合成磁场。仅保留单一螺旋度会产生两种不等价模型，它们在规范变换下不相关，并由一个真实的均匀磁场区分。
authors: Patrick Barron, Kalman Varga

articles.title: Induced Lorentzian geometry from the fermionic quantum metric
articles.title_zh: 费米子量子度规诱导的洛伦兹几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41138v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum geometry is conventionally understood in parameter or momentum space and need not be related to a geometry in configuration space. Here we show for Dirac fermions in a background electromagnetic field that an induced Lorentzian geometry is generated from the fermionic quantum metric. We study a Lorentz covariant phase space worldline path integral construction, whose application of the adiabatic theorem onto spin degrees of freedom leads to the appearance of the Berry phase at O(hbar), and the quantum metric at O(hbar²⁾ in the worldline action. Both the Feynman and retarded/advanced propagators are examined in 3+1 and 2+1 dimensions, whose different on-shell implementations lead to related quantum metrics; QED/QED{}₃ and condensed matter Dirac theory are considered. An effective theory is found by integrating out the momenta degrees of freedom, which gives rise to an emergent Lorentzian metric in configuration space, whose perturbation to the flat metric is dependent on the quantum metric and the background field strength. Apart from the spin degrees of freedom encoded into the Berry phase, the effective theory describes a scalar particle moving in the induced quantum geometry. Phenomenological applications to the covariant geometry are further studied using spectral holonomy in a gapped 3-dimensional Dirac material.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子几何通常在参数或动量空间中理解，与构型空间几何不一定相关。本文研究了背景电磁场中狄拉克费米子，表明费米子量子度规可以产生诱导的洛伦兹几何。通过洛伦兹协变相空间世界线路径积分构造，发现绝热定理应用于自旋自由度导致贝里相和量子度规的出现。通过积分掉动量自由度，得到了一个有效理论，该理论在构型空间中产生了一个涌现的洛伦兹度规，其对平坦度规的微扰取决于量子度规和背景场强。
authors: Patrick Copinger, Pablo Morales

articles.title: Longitudinal electric corner modes in continuum quantum gauge theory with matter
articles.title_zh: 连续量子规范理论中带物质的纵向电场角模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41240v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Subregions in gauge theories give rise to edge modes and corner charges supported on their boundaries. While this is well-established classically and in quantum lattice gauge theories, the fate of corner modes remains poorly understood in continuum quantum field theories owing to their distributional nature. In this paper, we revisit this challenge and propose a new corner operator for a regional Cauchy slice algebra generated by local gauge-invariant observables of scalar QED in Minkowski spacetime. The corner mode is given by the longitudinal electric field sourced by the matter outside the subregion and thus constitutes a centre for the regional algebra. Our main goal is to show that there exists a perturbative GNS state on this algebra that quantises this mode. Pulling back the Fock vacuum to the slice, we construct this state by renormalising the divergences arising from the lack of temporal smearing. We clarify that the inclusion of the new centre mode necessitates a further renormalisation on the corner of the region, thereby physically distinguishing it and breaking the translation invariance of the state. Our work shows how the requirements of locality, renormalisability, and positivity together put strong constraints on the existence of a continuum quantum field theory which supports corner modes as genuine quantum operators. We finish with comments about the von Neumann completion of the regional algebra, as well as possible physical interpretations of the renormalised vacuum state.
articles.abstract_zh: 规范理论中的子区域会产生边界上的边缘模式和角电荷，但在连续量子场论中，角模式的性质仍不明确。本文提出了一个针对闵可夫斯基时空中标量QED局部规范不变可观测物生成的区域柯西切片代数的新角算子。该角模式由子区域外部物质产生的纵向电场给出，构成了区域代数的中心。研究表明，存在一个微扰GNS态可以量化此模式，并且新中心模式的引入需要对区域的角进行进一步重整化。
authors: Goncalo Araujo-Regado, Philipp A. Hoehn, Alok Laddha, Bilyana Tomova

articles.title: Quantum Popcorn: the shape of a phase transition bubble
articles.title_zh: 量子爆米花：相变气泡的形状
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41504v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A quantum tunneling event in field theory is usually depicted as the materialization of a spherical bubble of true vacuum. The bubble appears at rest, and its profile is the time-symmetric slice of Coleman's bounce, the Euclidean solution that controls the decay rate. However, the bubble is spherical only in the leading semiclassical approximation: at the next order the configuration is a Gaussian ensemble of fluctuations around the bounce. We derive the wave functional of the field on the nucleation slice from the half-bounce path integral, and use it to compute the root-mean-square quadrupole moment of a bubble at nucleation. The relative deformation of the bubble wall radius R is δ R/Rsim(hbar/S_b)¹/², with S_b the bounce action. Thus δ R/Rsim0.1 for a typical cosmological phase transition with S_b/hbarsim100.
articles.abstract_zh: 场论中的量子隧穿事件通常被描述为真真空球形气泡的形成。然而，气泡仅在领先的半经典近似下呈球形，更高阶近似下其构型是围绕反弹的涨落高斯系综。本文从半反弹路径积分推导了成核切片上场的波函数，并计算了成核时气泡的均方根四极矩。研究发现，气泡壁半径的相对形变δR/R与(hbar/S_b)¹/²成正比，对于典型的宇宙学相变，该值约为0.1。
authors: Kfir Blum, Ipak Fadakar, Omri Rosner, Guilherme L. Pimentel

articles.title: A Hybrid Message-Passing and Electric-Field Representation for Electrostatic QM/MM Embedding with Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
articles.title_zh: 基于混合消息传递和电场表示的机器学习原子间势静电QM/MM嵌入
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41523v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Within a hybrid quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics approach a small region of a large atomistic system is described quantum mechanically, while the rest of the system is represented by a classical force field. Despite this, the computational cost of the quantum calculation severely limits the accessible simulation and sampling time. Replacing the quantum calculation with a machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP) trained on quantum reference data can greatly increase the accessible simulation time. However, the accuracy and efficiency strongly depend on the specific way in which the MLIP incorporates information about the classical (electrostatic) environment. Here, we demonstrate that existing strategies based purely on features derived from an external electric field fail to distinguish certain environments, ultimately limiting their accuracy. As a solution, we propose an extension to the equivariant TensorNet architecture that mitigates this shortcoming by incorporating classical atoms close to the quantum region into the message-passing scheme, combined with features derived from the electric field for describing the environment farther away. We show that this combination achieves higher accuracy than either approach alone.
articles.abstract_zh: 在量子力学/分子力学（QM/MM）混合方法中，量子计算的成本限制了模拟时间。用机器学习原子间势（MLIP）替代量子计算可显著提高模拟效率，但其精度受限于MLIP如何整合经典环境信息。本文指出，纯粹基于外部电场特征的现有策略无法区分某些环境，从而限制了精度。为此，我们提出了一种对等变TensorNet架构的扩展，通过将靠近量子区域的经典原子纳入消息传递方案，并结合电场特征来描述环境，从而弥补了这一不足。
authors: Raphael T. Husistein, Shobhit S. Chaturvedi, Thomas Weymuth, Beatriz Piniello, Sélène Forget, Kresten Lindorff-Larsen, Gemma C. Solomon, Markus Reiher

articles.title: Focusing through coupled multimode fibers for miniaturized single-atom tweezer arrays
articles.title_zh: 通过耦合多模光纤实现小型化单原子光镊阵列的聚焦
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41917v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Real-world deployment of quantum technologies requires systems in low SWaP-C packages. Quantum platforms based on ultracold atoms typically trap and control atoms with optical tweezers using light focused through bulky objective lenses, which are costly and sensitive to misalignment. Multimode fibers (MMFs) offer a compact route to focusing light, but their use in forming optical tweezers for cold atoms has been limited to a single fiber. Here we use a 2x1 MMF fused coupler to obtain two independent control paths sharing a common distal facet. We form near-diffraction-limited tweezers through each channel, suppress interference by applying a small frequency offset between the channels, and demonstrate that the tweezer separation is insensitive to misalignment of the input coupling. This work provides a route to reconfigurable single-atom arrays in low SWaP-C environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子技术的实际部署需要低SWaP-C封装的系统，而传统光学镊子通常依赖笨重的物镜。多模光纤（MMFs）为聚焦光提供了紧凑途径，但其在冷原子光镊中的应用受限于单根光纤。本文利用2x1 MMF熔融耦合器实现了共享远端面的两个独立控制路径，并形成了接近衍射极限的光镊。通过施加小频率偏移抑制了通道间干扰，并证明了光镊间距对输入耦合失准不敏感，为在低SWaP-C环境下构建可重构单原子阵列提供了新途径。
authors: Benjamin P. Maddox, Daniel K. Ruttley

articles.title: Certification of quantum correlations at arbitrary distances through routed Bell tests
articles.title_zh: 通过路由贝尔测试实现任意距离量子关联的认证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2502.12241v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Transmission loss represents a major obstacle to the device-independent certification of quantum correlations over long distances, limiting applications such as device-independent quantum key distribution (DIQKD). In this work, we investigate the recently proposed concept of routed Bell experiments, in which a particle sent to one side can be measured either near or far from the source. We prove that routed Bell tests involving only entangled qubits can certify quantum correlations even in the presence of arbitrary loss on the channel to the distant device. This is achieved by adapting concepts from self-testing and quantum steering to the routed Bell test framework. Finally, as a natural extension of our approach, we outline a DIQKD protocol that, in principle, is secure over arbitrary distances.
articles.abstract_zh: 传输损耗是长距离设备无关量子关联认证的主要障碍。本研究探讨了路由贝尔实验的概念，证明仅涉及纠缠量子比特的路由贝尔测试，即使在远距离信道存在任意损耗的情况下，也能认证量子关联。通过将自测试和量子导引的概念应用于路由贝尔测试框架，该方法原则上可实现任意距离安全的设备无关量子密钥分发协议。
authors: Pavel Sekatski, Jef Pauwels, Edwin Peter Lobo, Stefano Pironio, Nicolas Brunner

articles.title: Improved Algorithms for Quantum MaxCut via Partially Entangled Matchings
articles.title_zh: 通过部分纠缠匹配改进量子MaxCut算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.15276v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce a 0.611-approximation algorithm for Quantum MaxCut and a frac1+sqrt54 approx 0.809-approximation algorithm for the EPR Hamiltonian of [arXiv:2209.02589]. A novel ingredient in both of these algorithms is to partially entangle pairs of qubits associated to edges in a matching, while preserving the direction of their single-qubit Bloch vectors. This allows us to interpolate between product states and matching-based states with a tunable parameter.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了针对量子MaxCut问题的0.611近似算法，以及针对EPR哈密顿量的约0.809近似算法。这些算法的核心创新在于，通过部分纠缠匹配中与边相关的量子比特对，同时保持其单量子比特布洛赫向量的方向。这种方法允许在乘积态和基于匹配的态之间进行参数可调的插值。
authors: Anuj Apte, Eunou Lee, Kunal Marwaha, Ojas Parekh, James Sud

articles.title: Universal resources for quantum approximate optimization algorithm and quantum annealing
articles.title_zh: 量子近似优化算法和量子退火的通用资源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.03241v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) is a variational ansatz that resembles the Trotterized dynamics of a Quantum Annealing (QA) protocol. This work formalizes this connection formally and empirically, showing the angles of a multilayer QAOA circuit converge to universal QA trajectories. Furthermore, the errors in both QAOA circuits and QA paths act as thermal excitations in pseudo-Boltzmann probability distributions whose temperature decreases with the invested resource -- i.e. integrated angles or total time -- and which in QAOA also contain a higher temperature arising from the Trotterization. This also means QAOA and QA are cooling protocols and simulators of partition functions whose target temperature can be tuned by rescaling the universal trajectory. The average cooling power of both methods exhibits favorable algebraic scalings with respect to the target temperature and problem size, whereby in QAOA the coldest temperature is inversely proportional to the number of layers, Tsim 1/p, and to the integrated angles -- or integrated interactions in QA.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文正式且经验性地阐明了量子近似优化算法（QAOA）与量子退火（QA）协议的Trotter化动力学之间的联系。研究表明，多层QAOA电路的角度收敛于通用QA轨迹，且两种方法中的误差表现为伪玻尔兹曼分布中的热激发。QAOA和QA均可作为冷却协议和配分函数模拟器，其冷却能力与目标温度和问题规模呈有利的代数标度关系。
authors: Pablo Díez-Valle, Fernando J. Gómez-Ruiz, Diego Porras, Juan José García-Ripoll

articles.title: A Diagrammatic Method for Non-Gaussian Photon Correlations in Weakly Coupled Atomic Ensembles
articles.title_zh: 弱耦合原子系综中非高斯光子关联的图解法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.03970v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We develop a scattering-theory formalism and use it to predict that a resonantly driven atomic ensemble weakly coupled to an optical mode can generate light with non-Gaussian correlations. Our approach---based on a perturbative diagrammatic expansion of multi-photon interactions---shows that photon-photon interaction mediated by the emitters causes the transmitted light to have a connected third-order correlation function g_c⁽³⁾ containing non-Gaussian field correlations. The temporal pattern of g_c⁽³⁾ is explained using the microscopic transport processes in terms of our diagrams. We derive an optical-depth-dependent bound on the perturbative truncation error and benchmark our predictions against cascaded master-equation and quantum trajectory simulations for small ensembles with ODłeq 2, identifying a regime of controlled accuracy under weak driving. Our predictions can be experimentally demonstrated in state-of-the-art nanofibre-coupled atomic ensembles.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种散射理论形式，预测共振驱动的弱耦合原子系综能产生具有非高斯关联的光。基于多光子相互作用的微扰图解展开，研究表明发射体介导的光子-光子相互作用导致透射光具有包含非高斯场关联的三阶关联函数g_c⁽³⁾。该方法解释了g_c⁽³⁾的时间模式，并为小系综的预测提供了受控精度，可在纳米光纤耦合原子系综中进行实验验证。
authors: Yangming Wang, Sahand Mahmoodian

articles.title: Reaffirming a Challenge to Bohmian Mechanics
articles.title_zh: 重申对玻姆力学的挑战
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.06584v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In our work [Sharoglazova et al., Nature 643, 67-72 (2025)], we reported the first measurement of the speed of tunnelling particles by comparing two orthogonal motions in a coupled-waveguide system. Here we respond to objections raised in comments, referee reports, preprints, and articles. In particular, we distinguish two questions that are often conflated: whether Bohmian mechanics reproduces the measured density, and whether the standard guiding equation assigns the correct state of motion to the particles. The first point follows under the usual quantum equilibrium assumptions. By contrast, identifying the guiding velocity with particle motion is an additional physical postulate, since the standard guiding equation does not follow from the Schrödinger equation alone. We argue that, in the evanescent regime, the state of motion assigned by the standard guiding equation is in disagreement with the speed following from our experiments. To make the distinction explicit, we also present a bidirectional Bohmian model that reproduces the same stationary density while assigning finite speeds compatible with the speed inferred in the evanescent regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文回应了对先前关于隧道粒子速度测量工作的质疑，该工作通过比较耦合波导系统中的两种正交运动首次测量了隧道粒子速度。作者区分了玻姆力学是否能再现测量密度与标准引导方程是否赋予粒子正确运动状态这两个问题。研究认为，在倏逝波区域，标准引导方程所赋予的运动状态与实验推断的速度不符。为明确区分，本文还提出了一个双向玻姆模型，该模型在再现相同稳态密度的同时，赋予了与实验推断速度兼容的有限速度。
authors: Jan Klaers, Violetta Sharoglazova, Marius Puplauskis

articles.title: Levitated optomechanics with cylindrically polarized vortex beams
articles.title_zh: 采用柱面偏振涡旋光束的悬浮光力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.05384v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Optically levitated and cooled nanoparticles are a new quantum system whose application to the creation of non-classical states of motion and quantum limited sensing is fundamentally limited by recoil and bulk heating. We study the creation of stable 3D optical traps using optical cylindrically polarized vortex beams with radial and azimuthal polarization and show that a significant reduction in recoil heating by up to an order of magnitude can be achieved when compared with conventional single Gaussian beam tweezers. Additionally these beams allow trapping of larger particles outside the Rayleigh regime using both bright and dark tweezer trapping with reduced recoil heating. By changing the wavelength of the trapping laser, or the size of the particles, non-linear and repulsive potentials of interest for the creation of non-classical states of motion can also be created.
articles.abstract_zh: 光学悬浮和冷却纳米粒子作为一种新型量子系统，其应用受反冲和整体加热的限制。本研究探讨了使用径向和方位角偏振的柱面偏振涡旋光束创建稳定的三维光学陷阱。结果表明，与传统高斯光束镊子相比，反冲加热可显著降低一个数量级。这些光束还能以更低的反冲加热捕获瑞利区域外的更大粒子，并能通过改变激光波长或粒子尺寸创建非线性排斥势。
authors: Felipe Almeida, Peter Barker

articles.title: Bandwidth-Cost Reduction for Photon-Matter Simulation at the Single-Photon Level
articles.title_zh: 单光子水平光子-物质模拟的带宽成本降低
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.15945v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Simulations of quantum dynamics of traveling photons interacting with matter can be used to model and design photonic quantum-network components. Such simulations require selecting a finite set of photonic modes, where smaller sets are more desirable for computational efficiency. In this work, however, we show that opting for smaller subsets alters simulation results, if done naively. We therefore provide a consistency condition that can be used to calibrate the simulation input parameters to increase efficiency while preserving accuracy, simultaneously. This condition is then used to derive a simple prescription that reduces the propagation cost by two order of magnitude in a waveguide benchmark. Finally, we extend the same calibration principle to a two-dimensional atomic array, demonstrating the simultaneous benefits beyond analytically solvable waveguide models.
articles.abstract_zh: 模拟行进光子与物质相互作用的量子动力学对于设计光子量子网络组件至关重要，但通常需要选择有限的光子模式集。本研究发现，简单地选择较小的模式子集会改变模拟结果，因此提出了一种一致性条件来校准模拟输入参数，以同时提高效率和保持准确性。该条件在波导基准测试中将传播成本降低了两个数量级，并成功推广到二维原子阵列，展示了其超越解析可解波导模型的优势。
authors: Romain Piron, Akihito Soeda

articles.title: Combinatorial Matrix Functions in Ising Models and Quantum Circuit Representation
articles.title_zh: 伊辛模型和量子电路表示中的组合矩阵函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.01868v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Permanents, hafnians, and loop-hafnians are combinatorial matrix functions defined on the perfect matchings of graphs. These matrix functions arise in the quantum amplitudes for output photon configurations in linear optical networks, which has led both to sampling hardness results and to a variety of applications. The same matrix functions also appear in Ising models, since Ising models naturally encode graphs, and the matrix functions emerge from quantum interference. However, previous results have been restricted to balanced bipartite graphs, and hence to the permanent. In this paper, we extend the graph structure of the Ising model so that all three matrix functions can be obtained. In particular, self-loops can be encoded by introducing additional spins, and the loop-hafnian is obtained from a superposition of spin states, which we call the loop-hafnian state. We show how to recover the hafnian and permanent cases as the number of self-loops decreases. Moreover, we show that the Ising dynamics we consider can be simulated on a quantum circuit with (O(n²⁾) gates for a (2n × 2n) real symmetric matrix. Specifically, we propose a quantum circuit that maps the loop-hafnian state to a basis state with (O(n²⁾) gates, and show that, by an adaptive measurement, the loop-hafnian states for all subsets of vertices can be measured simultaneously.
articles.abstract_zh: 积和式、哈夫尼安和循环哈夫尼安是定义在图完美匹配上的组合矩阵函数，它们在线性光学网络中作为输出光子构型的量子振幅出现，并在伊辛模型中也通过量子干涉显现。本文扩展了伊辛模型的图结构，使其能够得到所有这三种矩阵函数。通过引入额外的自旋编码自环，并从自旋态叠加中获得循环哈夫尼安态，研究展示了如何通过减少自环数量恢复哈夫尼安和积和式。此外，文中还提出了一种量子电路实现方案，能够以O(n²)门模拟所考虑的伊辛动力学。
authors: Minhyeok Kang, Gwonhak Lee, Youngrong Lim, Joonsuk Huh

articles.title: Millimeter Wave Readout of a Superconducting Qubit
articles.title_zh: 超导量子比特的毫米波读出
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.13837v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Millimeter waves are emerging as an enabling technology for connecting and enhancing different quantum platforms such as Rydberg atoms, optomechanics, and superconducting qubits. In this work, we explore the interaction between millimeter wave photons and conventional transmon qubits, specifically for qubit readout. We study a circuit quantum electrodynamic (cQED) system consisting of a millimeter wave cavity at ømegaᵣ = 2π × 34.7 GHz and a transmon qubit at ømega_q = 2π × 3.1 GHz coupled at rate g = 2π × 1.3. With such a large detuning between cavity and qubit, ømegaᵣ/ømega_q > 10, we are able to suppress drive induced unwanted resonant state transitions, enabling strong drives for qubit readout. We measure no resonant state transitions even when driving with more than 100 photons and read out the qubit state with more than 100 photons to achieve a measurement fidelity greater than 99% without the aid of a quantum limited amplifier.
articles.abstract_zh: 毫米波正成为连接和增强不同量子平台（如里德堡原子、光力学和超导量子比特）的关键技术。本研究探讨了毫米波光子与传统透射子量子比特的相互作用，特别关注量子比特读出。在一个毫米波腔与透射子量子比特大失谐耦合的电路量子电动力学系统中，研究人员成功抑制了驱动引起的非期望共振态跃迁。即使在超过100个光子驱动下，也未检测到共振态跃迁，并实现了超过99%的量子比特读出保真度，且无需量子限放大器。
authors: Akash V. Dixit, Zachary L. Parrott, Dennis Chunikhin, Bradley D. Hauer, Trevyn F. Q. Larson, John D. Teufel

articles.title: Preprocessing noise in finite-size quantum key distribution
articles.title_zh: 有限尺寸量子密钥分发中的预处理噪声
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.18213v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: It is known that trusted, preprocessing noise may boost quantum key distribution by expanding the range of values of tolerated noise. For BB84, adding trusted noise may allow the generation of secret keys even for qubit error rate (QBER) beyond the 11% threshold in the asymptotic regime. Here we study the effect of preprocessing noise in the finite-size regime where only a limited number of signals are exchanged between Alice and Bob. We compute the secret key rate from the full variational formulation of the sandwiched Renyi conditional entropy, optimized through nonsymmetric conic optimization. We find that trusted noise improves the key rate only for a finite interval of alpha, from the alpha approaching 1 limit up to alpha approximately 1.4. We then optimize the finite-size key rate jointly over both q, alpha, and the fraction of raw keys used for parameter estimation, to study how trusted preprocessing changes the maximum tolerable QBER as the block size increases. We show that the secret-key rate enhancement provided by optimized noisy preprocessing becomes more pronounced at higher QBER levels and can increase the maximum tolerable QBER over a broad range of finite block sizes.
articles.abstract_zh: 已知可信的预处理噪声能通过扩大容忍噪声范围来提升量子密钥分发性能。本研究在有限尺寸机制下，考察了预处理噪声对量子密钥分发的影响。通过非对称锥优化，从夹心Renyi条件熵的完整变分公式计算秘密密钥率，发现可信噪声仅在有限的alpha区间内提高密钥率。优化后的含噪预处理在较高量子比特错误率（QBER）下能显著增强秘密密钥率，并能提高最大可容忍QBER。
authors: Gabriele Staffieri, Giuseppe D'Ambruoso, Giovanni Scala, Cosmo Lupo

articles.title: Rotating-Wave and Secular Approximations for Open Quantum Systems
articles.title_zh: 开放量子系统的旋波近似和长期近似
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.26606v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We derive a nonperturbative bound on the distance between evolutions of open quantum systems described by time-dependent generators. We show how this result can be employed to provide an explicit upper bound on the error of the rotating-wave approximation in the presence of dissipation and decoherence. We apply the derived bound to the strong-coupling limit in open quantum systems and to the secular approximation used to obtain a master equation of the Gorini-Kossakowski-Lindblad-Sudarshan form from the Redfield master equation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文推导了由时变生成器描述的开放量子系统演化距离的非微扰界限。研究展示了如何利用此结果为存在耗散和退相干情况下的旋波近似误差提供明确上限。该界限被应用于开放量子系统的强耦合极限，以及从Redfield主方程推导Gorini-Kossakowski-Lindblad-Sudarshan形式主方程所使用的长期近似。
authors: Daniel Burgarth, Paolo Facchi, Giovanni Gramegna, Kazuya Yuasa

articles.title: Quantum Riemannian Hamiltonian Descent
articles.title_zh: 量子黎曼哈密顿下降算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.28624v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose Quantum Riemannian Hamiltonian Descent (QRHD), a quantum algorithm for continuous optimization on Riemannian manifolds that extends Quantum Hamiltonian Descent (QHD) by incorporating geometric structure of the parameter space via a position-dependent metric in the kinetic term. We formulate QRHD in both operator and path integral formalisms and derive the corresponding quantum equations of motion, showing that quantum corrections appear in the action integral but they are suppressed at late times by the time-dependent dissipation factor. This implies that convergence near optimal points is controlled by the classical potential while quantum effects influence early-time dynamics. By analyzing the semiclassical equation, we estimate a lower bound on the convergence time and numerically demonstrate whether QRHD works as a quantum optimization algorithm in some examples. A quantum circuit implementation based on time-dependent Hamiltonian simulation is also discussed and the query complexity is estimated.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了量子黎曼哈密顿下降（QRHD）算法，这是一种在黎曼流形上进行连续优化的量子算法，通过在动能项中引入位置依赖度量来扩展量子哈密顿下降（QHD）算法的几何结构。研究在算符和路径积分形式下推导了QRHD的量子运动方程，表明量子修正出现在作用量积分中，但在后期会被时变耗散因子抑制。这意味着最优点附近的收敛由经典势控制，而量子效应影响早期动力学。文中还讨论了基于时变哈密顿模拟的量子电路实现，并估算了查询复杂度。
authors: Yoshihiko Abe, Ryo Nagai

articles.title: Complementary Quantum Time Distributions from a Single Operational Protocol
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.10339v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A single operational protocol based on free evolution and projective measurements yields inequivalent quantum time distributions through distinct post-processing procedures. We construct an activity-based time-of-flow (TF) distribution and a presence-based quantum stroboscopic (QS) distribution, providing complementary operational notions of time. Applied to tunneling through a rectangular barrier, the regional QS mean saturates as the barrier width increases, whereas the TF mean first decreases and eventually grows for larger widths. These contrasting behaviors provide an operational interpretation of the Hartman effect, the apparent saturation of tunneling delay with increasing barrier width, in terms of quantum time distributions associated with flow through the exit region and occupation within the barrier, capturing the roles of early penetration, dominant reflection, and spectrally filtered transmission.
authors: Mathieu Beau

articles.title: A Unified Framework for Locally Stable Phases
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.00088v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose a unifying framework for characterizing pure and mixed state phases of matter across equilibrium, non equilibrium, and metastable regimes. We introduce the concept of locally stable states, defined by the operational property that any local operation (including post selection) can be reversed by a local channel. We prove that local stability is equivalent to a state being short range correlated, defined by the decay of both correlations and conditional mutual information. We demonstrate that these properties are invariant under locally reversible channels, thus defining locally stable phases. Furthermore, we prove that local stability implies both the decay of a family of nonlinear correlators, including the fidelity correlator, and the decay of correlations in the canonical purification, thus bridging the gap between mixed and pure states. Along the way, we establish two results which may be of independent interest: we show that post-selection on locally stable (short range correlated) states can be implemented via local channels and that quantum Markov chains can be characterized by the local computability of nonlinear observables.
authors: Zhi Li, Raz Firanko, Timothy H. Hsieh

articles.title: Interpretable Machine Learning for Building Analytic Quantum Circuits: the Case of Diagonal Operators
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.06633v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine Learning has become a useful instrument across many fields, but the opacity of typical ``black-box'' models limits their value for scientific discovery. In this paper we present a methodology that uses emphinterpretable Machine Learning to generate analytic mathematical hypotheses about a physical system, which can then be confirmed by a formal derivation. We demonstrate the methodology on the problem of decomposing unitary operators into elementary quantum gates. By training an interpretable model on circuits obtained numerically and analyzing its weights, we are led to a hypothesis for the analytic structure of the decomposition. Applied to the family of diagonal operators, this hypothesis yields a universal, analytic quantum circuit valid for an arbitrary number of qubits, whose CNOT count scales as O(2ⁿ⁾, improving on the O(2.5ⁿ⁾ of standard numerical methods. The resulting decomposition is proved rigorously in a companion paper.
authors: Matvei Fedin, Andrey Morozov

articles.title: Robustness-based bounds for approximate joint realizations of incompatible quantum channels
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.11924v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Several quantum channels may fail to admit an exact joint realization, a property known as incompatibility. Channel incompatibility unifies various quantum limitations, such as measurement uncertainty, the no-information-without-disturbance principle, and the no-cloning and no-broadcasting theorems. We address how accurately incompatible channels can be approximated by the marginals of a single joint channel, quantified by the minimum total diamond-norm error over all joint realizations. We establish two-sided bounds relating it to the generalized robustness of incompatibility (RoI), a noise-based resource quantifier of incompatibility. For identity channels, we determine both the RoI and the minimum total error exactly. The upper bound is attained by the optimal symmetric universal cloner, while the prefactor in the lower bound is asymptotically optimal as the dimension tends to infinity. Applying this result to measurement channels provides a unified, model-independent framework encompassing error-error and information-error-disturbance tradeoffs. Furthermore, our robustness-based evaluation of disturbance outperforms an algebraic bound for every non-trivial POVM in dimensions up to six.
authors: Shintaro Minagawa, Ryo Takakura, Kensei Torii

articles.title: No Size-Preserving Amplification with Quantum Advice
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.03377v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Marriott and Watrous showed that quantum Merlin--Arthur games admit generic error reduction without increasing witness size [Computational Complexity, 2005]. In this work, we show that this state-size-preserving amplification property does not hold for polynomial-time quantum computation with quantum advice. In particular, we present decision problems for which even a vanishing additive error reduction requires longer advice. More precisely, for every polynomially bounded advice length m(n)=ømega(1) and every error bound ǎrepsilon(n) that stays below 1/2 by at least an inverse polynomial, there is a positive function δ with δ(n)=Obigl(min{(łog m/m)¹/⁴, sqrtłog m/m,/(1/2-ǎrepsilon(n))}bigr) such that mathsfBQPǎᵣₑₚₛᵢₗₒₙ/mathsfqm subsetneq mathsfBQPǎᵣₑₚₛᵢₗₒₙ ₊ δ/mathsfqm; for constant ǎrepsilon the gap is O(sqrtłog m/m). Here, mathsfBQP_ǎrepsilon/mathsfqm is the class of languages recognizable with error at most ǎrepsilon(n) by a polynomial-time quantum algorithm with an m(n)-qubit advice state that only depends on the input length n. We show this by proving a stronger separation mathsfPǎᵣₑₚₛᵢₗₒₙ₊δ/mathsfr m notsubset mathsfBQPǎᵣₑₚₛᵢₗₒₙ/mathsfq m, where mathsfPǎᵣₑₚₛᵢₗₒₙ/mathsfrm is the class of languages recognizable with error at most ǎrepsilon(n) by a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm with an m(n)-bit advice string sampled from a distribution that depends only on n.
authors: Shih-Han Hung, Han-Hsuan Lin

articles.title: Quantum Batteries in two-dimensional material-based Josephson Junctions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.22582v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We investigate the solid-state implementation of a Dicke-like quantum battery consisting of a two-dimensional material-based Josephson junction inductively coupled to a resonator, using graphene as a representative example. In this configuration, Andreev bound states naturally act as non-interacting, energetically non-degenerate two-level systems, and the setup allows for both single-photon and two-photon resonant processes. The coupling between the LC-circuit flux and the supercurrent through the junction gives rise to peculiar longitudinal interaction terms that have no counterpart in the conventional Dicke model. We demonstrate that these additional couplings can enhance energy storage for a proper range of parameters. The proposed architecture also enables an alternative, but comparable, charging protocol that relies on tuning the superconducting phase difference across the junction.
authors: V. Varrica, G. Gemme, F. M. D. Pellegrino, E. Paladino, M. Sassetti, D. Ferraro

articles.title: The Floquet-Magnus expansion of unbounded operators
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.23734v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The Floquet-Magnus expansion is a widely used tool to derive effective descriptions of time-periodic quantum systems by approximating their dynamics with a time-independent Hamiltonian. However, its standard formulation is, strictly speaking, restricted to bounded Hamiltonians. In this work, we extend its definition and analysis to a broad class of time-periodic unbounded Hamiltonians. Our approach is based on an a priori distinct nonperturbative framework for the construction of effective Hamiltonians, which we show to reproduce the Floquet-Magnus expansion. A particular strength of our framework is that it allows us to prove that the resulting effective dynamics approximates the original time evolution propagators to arbitrary order in the high-frequency limit without requiring convergence of the Floquet-Magnus expansion, a condition that is already highly restrictive even in the bounded setting. We illustrate the scope of the method on representative models: the quantum Rabi Hamiltonian in the interaction picture, and the periodically driven quantum harmonic oscillator.
authors: Daniel Burgarth, Robin Hillier, Davide Lonigro, Leonhard Richter

articles.title: Co--dsorption of terrylene and tetrapentacontane on hexagonal boron nitride - towards a two-dimensional Shpolskii matrix
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40733v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Organic molecular emitters are promising building blocks for quantum technologies, but their use at two-dimensional interfaces is limited by diffusion, aggregation, and photobleaching. We present work towards constructing an ultrathin two-dimensional Shpolskii-like host-guest matrix on hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) by co-depositing terrylene fluorophores with the long-chain tetrapentacontane in a solution-phase process. We demonstrate that this approach disperses terrylene in a roughly one-nanometer-thin alkane layer without detectable phase separation and allows tuning the emitter density from ensembles to isolated emitters showing characteristic blinking behavior consistent with single-molecule fluorescence. Time-lapse confocal microscopy, autocorrelation analysis, and fluorescence recovery after photobleaching show that suppressed diffusion and stable emitter positions can be achieved in several samples with a tetrapentacontane matrix. Encapsulation with hBN from the top side further improves photostability, with emitters demonstrating long lifetimes despite high photon doses. Successful co-adsorption of isolated emitters and alkane matrix is a milestone towards extending Shpolskii-type molecular isolation to hBN and provides a route towards stable, interface-integrated molecular qubits.
authors: Rong Sun, Tolibjon Abdurakhmonov, Jan-Niklas Heidkamp, Julian Schröer, Paul Weinbrenner, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Tobias Korn, Oliver Kühn, Friedemann Reinhard

articles.title: Quantum Monte-Carlo study of spin-valley ferromagnetism in rhombohedral graphene
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40864v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent capacitance measurements in bilayer and trilayer rhombohedral graphene reported large magnetic entropy above the Curie temperature, suggesting the formation of fluctuating local moments. Further experimental support comes from scanning tunneling microscopy experiments in rhombohedral hexalayer graphene, which directly visualized honeycomb electron-crystal order that strengthens upon heating before melting, related to the Pomeranchuk effect. Motivated by these experiments, we construct spin-valley local-moment Hamiltonians for the quarter-metal and half-metal phases. We extract their couplings from constrained Hartree-Fock calculations, and solve their finite-temperature thermodynamics with stochastic-series-expansion quantum Monte Carlo. For the quarter metal we find a continuous 2D-Ising transition at T_c approx 0.7 K, an order of magnitude smaller than the Hartree-Fock estimate (~30 K) and closer to the experimental scale of a few kelvin. For the half metal, we study the field-induced magnetization as a function of temperature with and without proximity-enhanced spin-orbit coupling. When spin-orbit coupling is negligible, intervalley Hund's coupling enhances the magnetic response. Strong spin-orbit coupling, as can be induced by a neighboring transition-metal dichalcogenide, gives rise to the standard spin-canted ground state at zero temperature. Upon heating, the in-plane polarization decreases more rapidly than the out-of-plane polarization. Surprisingly, despite the itinerant nature of the electrons, local-moment models with microscopically determined couplings appear to capture key finite-temperature magnetic properties of rhombohedral graphene without any fitting.

articles.title: Minimal model of sticky collisions in modulated optical traps
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41075v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Collisional loss of ultracold bialkali molecules is predicted to occur through photo-excitation of collision complexes. However, recent measurements in modulated optical traps report an unexpected lack of excess survival, at odds with theoretical predictions and earlier experiments. We develop a minimal quantum scattering model that treats collisions as a coherent process occurring in the presence of the modulated trap. We demonstrate that quantum reflection from the long-range potential fundamentally alters loss dynamics, removing the tension between recent experiments and predicted sticking times. This framework provides new testable predictions such as a strong dependence on collision energy, initial molecular state, and long-range interactions, that are absent in the currently used phenomenological model.
authors: Hubert J. Jóźwiak, Tijs Karman

articles.title: Quantum-Geometric Subgap Second-Harmonic Generation in PT-Symmetric Antiferromagnetic Insulators
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41167v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Although quantum geometry plays an established role in electronic transport and optical responses, the contribution of the time-reversal-odd Riemannian connection to fully subgap responses remains less explored. Here we identify intrinsic second-harmonic generation in PT-symmetric antiferromagnets, predominantly governed by the real sector of the interband Hermitian connection and arising entirely from virtual interband transitions. In bilayer MnBi₂Te₄, the response persists in trivial phases but is enhanced in the layer-Chern phase and reverses sign with Néel order, offering a probe of quantum geometry and phase-sensitive readout of antiferromagnetic order without mobile carriers or real excitations.
authors: Shakeel Ahmad, Fei Xue

articles.title: Berry curvature quadrupole induced third-order anomalous Hall effect in altermagnetic KV₂Se₂O
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41274v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets combine compensated magnetic order with momentum-dependent spin splitting, providing a symmetry-rich platform for exploring nonlinear quantum-geometric transport. In the d-wave altermagnet considered here, the antiunitary symmetry operation TC₄z enforces a vanishing momentum-integrated Berry curvature, while inversion symmetry forbids a finite Berry-curvature dipole. Consequently, the Berry curvature quadrupole (BCQ) can provide a contribution to the nonlinear Hall response, scaling as τ², where τ denotes the relaxation time. We derive a gauge-covariant Wannier interpolation formula that enables efficient evaluation of the BCQ directly from first-principles Wannier tight-binding Hamiltonians. Applying this framework to KV₂Se₂O, we calculate the momentum-space distribution of the BCQ and the associated chemical potential dependent nonlinear conductivity. The momentum-resolved analysis reveals that the dominant contribution originates from spin-orbit coupling induced avoided arossings, directly linking the gap structure to the sign-changing nonlinear response. Our work establishes a general first-principles route to higher-order quantum-geometric responses in altermagnets, opening avenues for exploring nonlinear Hall effects in next-generation spintronic and magnetoelectronic devices.
authors: Jiacheng Yao, Zhuocheng Lu, Zhichao Guo, Hua Wang

articles.title: Quantifying Blinking Suppression and Probing Its Mechanism in PPD-Treated Single Quantum Dots
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41285v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Colloidal semiconductor quantum dots (QDs) are highly promising materials for various applications, yet photoluminescence intermittency (blinking) remains a key obstacle to their practical use. While recent advances have enabled partial or complete suppression of this effect, both the degree of suppression and the mechanism by which it occurs are often difficult to establish. In the present work we analyse the blinking suppression of single CdSe/ZnS QDs after treatment with p-phenylenediamine (PPD), recently discovered by Yang et al. We revisit the blinking mechanism in this system and show that it is governed predominantly by the trapping mechanism, rather than by Auger ionization as previously proposed. For data analysis we apply a threshold-free two-dimensional criterion recently proposed by Podshivaylov and Frantsuzov. The criterion is based on the relative quantum yield estimator łangle hatQ ångle⁽s⁾ and the decay-rate fluctuation parameter hatξ. We found that PPD treatment significantly increases the relative quantum yield and leads to only a modest increase in hatξ, indicating that the dominant effect of PPD is to shift the distribution of the non-radiative recombination rate toward lower values, rather than to eliminate its fluctuations. We further suggest a number of possible mechanisms of PPD-induced suppression and propose critical experiments for their verification.
authors: Eduard A. Podshivaylov, Egor B. Kurgin, Changgang Yang, Guofeng Zhang, Pavel A. Frantsuzov

articles.title: Universal model of the growth of III-V tetrahedral semiconductors on polar surfaces: pyramids and glue atoms. II. Adsorption of nonmetal atoms (N, P, As, and Sb) on Ga-terminated surfaces
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41571v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ab initio calculations were used to simulate the adsorption processes on Ga-terminated surfaces of tetrahedral semiconductors: GaN, GaP, GaAs and GaSb. The considered adsorbates are nonmetal species, i.e., nitrogen, phosphorus, arsenic, and antimony on wurtzite gallium nitride, i.e., GaN(0001) surfaces, zinc blende gallium phosphide, i.e., GaP(111), gallium arsenide, GaAs(111), and gallium antimonide, GaSb (111) surfaces. The cases investigated include single adsorbed nonmetal atoms and full coverage, i.e. theta=1 of these surfaces. The calculated results include the stable sites and the energies of the single adsorbed atoms: located at H3 sites at low coverage and in on-top positions at high coverage for GaP, GaAs and GaSb. At high nitrogen coverage, the N2 admolecules are formed, weakly attached to the surface. The calculated electronic properties of the single-adatom systems include the band diagrams of the slabs in real and momentum space, the energies of the quantum states. In addition, the overlaps of the quantum states of the nonmetal adatoms and the nearest topmost surface Ga atoms are given. The full coverage data include the atomic configurations and the bond energies of the adsorbed layers. The electronic properties include the above-mentioned data for single adatoms, together with additional properties related to interactions between adsorbed atoms. The evaporation stability analysis confirms that the adatoms stabilize the topmost Ga atoms against detachment because of the high energy barrier of DE > 3 eV which is further increased to DE > 4 eV by coverage located at H3 sites. Thus, growth simulations should employ unreconstructed Ga-terminated surfaces covered by nonmetal atoms located at on-top positions.
authors: Pawel Strak, Stanisław Krukowski

articles.title: Hierarchy of Electromagnetic Gauge Field Quantum Geometries
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41610v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The conventional Bloch quantum geometric tensor (QGT) describes electric-dipole geometry for spatially uniform perturbations and vertical Bloch transitions. We develop a broader framework linking quantum geometry to local and nonlocal electromagnetic response in gauge-field space, placing this tensor within a hierarchy of electric and magnetic multipole quantum geometries. The intrinsic antisymmetric adiabatic response in every electromagnetic channel is a Berry curvature in the space of its conjugate fields. The field-dependent projector uniquely fixes the QGT for that channel, pairing the response curvature with a quantum metric. This construction extends to spatially nonuniform perturbations, whose finite momentum transfer induces nonvertical Bloch transitions. We explicitly construct the current--current QGT connecting Bloch states at k±q/2, providing a unified metric and curvature description of nonlocal current response. In the doubled Brillouin zone, tangential derivatives generate conventional momentum-space QGT multipoles, whereas normal derivatives connect finite-momentum geometry to uniform electric- and magnetic-multipole-pair QGTs. We derive this connection through second order in q. The finite-momentum curvature governs the intrinsic nonlocal Hall response, while an inverse-frequency moment of symmetric optical absorption probes the index-symmetric metric sector.
authors: Bin Wang, Fuming Xu, Lei Zhang, Jian Wang

articles.title: Evaluating Instrument-Centered AI Agents for Table-Top Science Experiments
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41717v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reliable evaluation of AI agents for table-top science experiments has remained elusive because live instruments are hard to reset and share at scale, while instrument statefulness and safety constraints complicate evaluation. We introduce instrMCP and q-devBench, an evaluation stack for instrument-centered AI agents in table-top experiments. instrMCP connects coding agents to scientific instruments through the Model Context Protocol, serving as the instrument-access harness. q-devBench reconstructs 37 real experimental tasks from condensed-matter physics as virtual QCoDeS instruments covering quantum electronic transport, scanning probe imaging, and calibration workflows. q-devBench exposes reproducible failure modes in laboratory-agent systems while preserving realistic instrument-control workflows. Across a range of commercial coding-agent configurations, current systems already show substantial operational competence, satisfying 70-83% of measurement-related rubric criteria. The main bottleneck is scientific analysis, where performance falls to 28-46%. In an analysis-only ablation in which agents receive clean reference datasets without running the virtual measurement session, analysis performance improves substantially, closing roughly two thirds of the difference between the measurement and analysis scores. This suggests that much of the deficit arises from the measurement-session context, including tool-use overhead, longer context, measurement-planning decisions, and possible acquisition errors, while a residual scientific-reasoning gap remains. Together, instrMCP and q-devBench provide a practical sandbox for benchmarking, diagnosing, and improving laboratory AI harnesses, and establish a route from controlled virtual evaluation to future live-hardware validation.
authors: Jiaqi Cai, Siyu Cheng, William S. Huxter, Li-Qiao Xia, Shuwen Sun, Shuai Yuan, Yifan Zhao, Naiyuan Zhang, Weijie Li, Muxian Xu, Ilija Zeljkovic, Xiaodong Xu, Pablo Jarillo-Herrero

articles.title: Andreev-Enhanced Conductance in a Bilayer Graphene Quantum Point Contact
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41915v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum point contacts provide a platform for probing mode-dependent Andreev reflection. Here, we demonstrate Andreev-enhanced conductance in a gate-defined bilayer graphene quantum point contact coupled to a superconducting aluminum electrode. Electrostatic gating enables sequential mode occupation, verified by normal-state conductance quantization. In the superconducting state, the conductance is enhanced within the conductance plateaus, while the enhancement decreases between plateaus, consistent with the nonlinear transmission dependence of Andreev reflection. The enhancement yields effective transmission probabilities up to 0.9, and extends over a bias window of approximately 140 μV, which we associate with a proximity-induced superconducting gap, close to the gap of the aluminum film. For in-plane fields, the enhancement persists up to the critical field, and the bias window follows the spectral gap predicted by Abrikosov-Gor'kov theory. In contrast, perpendicular fields suppress the enhancement approximately linearly from zero field, deviating from homogeneous pair breaking and indicative of flux penetration.
authors: Emma Horgan, Bernd Aichner, Nadine Omar, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Luca Banszerus

articles.title: Guaranteed Slater Conditions for the Numerical Conformal Bootstrap: Fixing Instabilities in SDPB, Navigator Methods, and Skydiving
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40764v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The semidefinite programs (SDPs) of the numerical conformal bootstrap, and of S-matrix and quantum-mechanics bootstraps, are solved with primal-dual interior-point methods whose convergence guarantees rest on primal and dual Slater conditions: the existence of strictly feasible points on both sides of the duality. Many bootstrap SDPs violate these. The consequences range from slow convergence to inconclusive verdicts and the breakdown of the Skydive algorithm. We introduce "Slater tools", all acting within the PMP class accepted by SDPB. Diagnostics measure the Slater margins and, when a margin vanishes, extract the exposing certificate that identifies the degeneracy. Two independent cures follow. Transforms that provide rigorous bounds on the original SDP objective and that for the right parameter choices return the exact value. Facial reductions that use the exposing certificate to remove the degeneracies themselves. We reproduce, explain and resolve all known types of failures in a mixed-correlator 3d Ising setup. We show that the X-Slater condition (SDPB's primal) fails at every disallowed point in feasibility mode, holds in every navigator problem we tested, and can be guaranteed by one additional condition on the navigator function. We show that the folklore "instability remedy" of a twist gap works by removing degeneracies at the endpoints of the positivity conditions. These often stem from a mistake in factoring out the block prefactor but can also arise legitimately in channels that mix equal and unequal operator pairs. Finally we classify and remove all degeneracies of the published current-scalar bootstrap, among them one at x=infty, thus incurable by any gap assumption, caused by unequal polynomial degrees within one matrix block.
authors: Marten Reehorst

articles.title: Proof-Carrying Materials: Falsifiable Safety Certificates for Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.12183v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are deployed for high-throughput materials screening without formal reliability guarantees. We show that a single MLIP used as a stability filter misses 93% of density functional theory (DFT)-stable materials (recall 0.07) on a 25,000-material benchmark. Proof-Carrying Materials (PCM) closes this gap through three stages: adversarial falsification across compositional space, bootstrap envelope refinement with 95% confidence intervals, and Lean 4 formal certification. Auditing CHGNet, TensorNet and MACE reveals architecture-specific blind spots with near-zero pairwise error correlations (r <= 0.13; n = 5,000), confirmed by independent Quantum ESPRESSO validation (20/20 converged; median DFT/CHGNet force ratio 12x). A risk model trained on PCM-discovered features predicts failures on unseen materials (AUC-ROC = 0.938 +/- 0.004) and transfers across architectures (cross-MLIP AUC-ROC ~ 0.70; feature importance r = 0.877). In a thermoelectric screening case study, PCM-audited protocols discover 62 additional stable materials missed by single-MLIP screening - a 25% improvement in discovery yield.
authors: Abhinaba Basu, Pavan Chakraborty

articles.title: Researcher-in-the-Loop Evolutionary Discovery of Entanglement-Assisted Quantum Code Families
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.41183v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: LLM-guided program evolution can produce mathematical constructions, but validity, generality, and reproducibility require distinct evidence. We develop a researcher-in-the-loop discovery pipeline that combines program evolution, exact evaluation, mathematical generalization, certified nonexistence checks, and formal proof checking. We apply it to entanglement-assisted quantum error-correcting codes (EAQECCs). Starting from tasks that did not specify a family formula, evolved programs produced finite qubit constructions whose structure researchers generalized to the family [[n,1,n-1;n-q-1]]_q for prime powers qge3 at nge2q+1 and for q=2 at odd nge5. Lean checks the algebraic certificate underlying this family. Together with entanglement lifting, the family closes 54 gaps in archived EAQECC tables. The released evidence includes 115 verified code records, ten nonexistence results with checked DRAT proofs, family implementations, and preserved search programs for exact checks and seeded replay. In a controlled cohort of eight paired generation blocks, validation-selected iterative programs achieve success in 46.1% and 31.6% of held-out executions at unseen lengths n=13,15, compared with 19.5% and 3.1% for independently generated programs. In this setting, program evolution and researcher analysis turn finite computational discoveries into a proved family with independently checkable evidence.

articles.title: Macroscopic quantum coherence and entanglement in mechanical systems
articles.title_zh: 机械系统中的宏观量子相干性与纠缠
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2257 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-30-2257 The notion of a macroscopic quantum state must be pinned down in order to assess how well experiments probe the large-scale limits of quantum mechanics. However, the issue of quantifying so-called quantum macroscopicity is fraught with multiple approaches having varying interpretations and levels of computability and measurability. Here, we introduce two measures that capture independent macroscopic properties: i) extensive size, measuring the degree of coherence in position or momentum observables relative to atomic-scale units, and ii) entangled size, quantifying the number of entangled subsystems. These measures unify many desirable features of past proposals while having rigorously justified interpretations from quantum information theory in terms of coherence and multipartite entanglement. We demonstrate how to estimate them and obtain lower-bounds using experimental data from micro-mechanical oscillators and diffracting molecules. Notably, we find evidence for genuine multipartite entanglement of 10⁵ to 10⁷ atoms in recent mechanical superposition states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文旨在明确宏观量子态的概念，以评估实验在多大程度上探索了量子力学的大尺度极限。作者引入了两种独立的宏观量子特性度量：外延尺寸（衡量位置或动量观测量的相干度）和纠缠尺寸（量化纠缠子系统的数量）。研究人员利用微机械振荡器和衍射分子的实验数据，估算了这些度量，并发现了近期机械叠加态中存在10⁵至10⁷个原子的真实多体纠缠证据。
authors: Benjamin Yadin and Matteo Fadel

Using this phase profile, the dipolar point vortex model is formulated; this model reproduces the anisotropic velocities, deformed orbits, and orientation-dependent motion of vortex pairs found in full numerical simulations of the condensate. [Phys. Rev. Research 8, L042014] Published Fri Oct 30, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文推导了偶极玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中量子涡旋相位的解析表达式，该表达式捕捉了长程偶极-偶极相互作用引入的各向异性。基于此相位剖面，作者建立了偶极点涡旋模型。该模型成功再现了在凝聚体完整数值模拟中发现的涡旋对的各向异性速度、变形轨道和依赖于方向的运动，为理解偶极量子涡旋提供了理论工具。

articles.title: Entropic Fluctuations in Quantum Statistical Mechanics: A Review
articles.title_zh: 量子统计力学中的熵涨落：一篇综述
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40463v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The celebrated Evans--Searles, respectively Gallavotti--Cohen, fluctuation theorem concerns certain universal statistical features of the entropy production rate of a classical system in a transient, respectively steady, state. In this paper, we review and compare several possible extensions of these fluctuation theorems to quantum systems. We present, in an introductory way, the approach proposed in a recent series of works [Lett. Math. Phys. 114, 32 (2024): doi:10.1007/s11005-024-01777-0], [Rev. Math. Phys 38, 2461006 (2026): doi:10.1142/S0129055X24610063], [Commun. Math. Phys. 406, 201 (2025): 10.1007/s00220-025-05360-z] and [J. Math. Phys. 67, 022101 (2026): doi:10.1063/5.0311182] including a previously missing extension of the Gallavotti--Cohen (steady state) version of the FT to two-time measurement entropy production in the algebraic setting of quantum dynamical systems. We focus on the open quantum systems, where a small system interacts with several (infinitely extended) reservoirs, and discuss the following approaches: naive, two-time measurement, phase space contraction and ancilla state tomography. We review the connection with modular theory. The latter provides a way to extend the classical notions to the quantum domain. We discuss the quantum version of the principle of regular entropic fluctuations, introduced in the classical context in [Nonlinearity 24, 699 (2011): doi:10.1088/0951-7715/24/3/003]. Finally, we relate the statistical properties of these various notions of entropy production to spectral resonances of quantum transfer operators and apply this approach to a paradigmatic model of non-equilibrium statistical mechanics: the spin-fermion model. The results presented here shed a new light on the nature of entropic fluctuations in quantum statistical mechanics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文综述了将经典的Evans-Searles和Gallavotti-Cohen涨落定理推广到量子系统的多种方法。作者以介绍性的方式，展示了近期一系列工作提出的方法，包括将Gallavotti-Cohen（稳态）版本的涨落定理扩展到量子动力学系统代数设置中的两时间测量熵产生。该综述重点关注开放量子系统，讨论了包括朴素方法、两时间测量、相空间收缩和辅助态层析成像等多种方法。
authors: Tristan Benoist, Laurent Bruneau, Vojkan Jakšić, Aannalisa Panati, Claude-Alain Pillet

articles.title: Fundamental limits on photonic state preparation from phase-space majorization
articles.title_zh: 基于相空间优化的光子态制备基本限制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37755v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Preparing complex quantum states of light for quantum information processing tasks often proceeds by converting from simpler states via experimentally accessible operations. We provide fundamental bounds on such probabilistic conversions, both exact and approximate. To do so, we establish a theory of weak, fully relative majorization that compares the disorder of phase-space functions. Our framework is versatile and can be tailored to different systems and sets of allowed operations. Focusing on Wigner functions in multimode photonic systems, we establish rigorous no-go results and tradeoff relations for exact and approximate conversions involving squeezed states, cat states, Gottesman--Kitaev--Preskill states, and Fock states. In doing so, we derive novel bounds and recover known tight ones. Our results demonstrate that phase-space disorder imposes strong limitations on photonic state preparation.
articles.abstract_zh: 在量子信息处理任务中，复杂量子光态的制备通常通过实验可行的操作从简单态转换而来。本文提出了对这种概率性转换的精确和近似基本界限。为此，作者建立了一种弱的、完全相对的优选理论，用于比较相空间函数的无序性。研究聚焦于多模光子系统中的维格纳函数，为涉及压缩态、猫态、Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill态和福克态的精确和近似转换建立了严格的禁区结果和权衡关系。结果表明相空间无序性对光子态制备施加了强大的限制。
authors: Twesh Upadhyaya, Oliver Hahn, Ulysse Chabaud, Nikolaos Koukoulekidis

articles.title: Magic in Grover's Algorithm and the Role of Oracle Synthesis
articles.title_zh: Grover算法中的“魔力”与谕示合成的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37772v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Grover's algorithm is a textbook example of quantum advantage, providing a quadratic query speedup over classical methods for unstructured search. In this Letter, we characterize the non-stabilizerness, or magic, developed throughout Grover's protocol, quantifying quantum complexity with respect to the efficiently simulable stabilizer states. First, we compute the compilation-independent magic at the end of each Grover iteration, deriving an analytic prediction for the stabilizer Rényi entropy and proving that it remains intensive as the system size grows. We then investigate the magic overhead due to decomposing the circuit into elementary gates. When the solution to the search problem is known, we show that an efficient decomposition exists that keeps magic bounded despite using an extensive number of Toffoli gates. In contrast, agnostic implementations are expected to generate volume-law non-stabilizerness, as we confirm for the 3-SAT problem, which rules out efficient simulation by stabilizer-based methods in practically relevant cases. Our findings clarify the growth of magic in Grover's algorithm and the role of solution-awareness in its circuit compilation.
articles.abstract_zh: Grover算法是量子优势的典型例子，为非结构化搜索提供了相对于经典方法的二次查询加速。本文量化了Grover协议中产生的非稳定性（或称“魔力”），并以可高效模拟的稳定器态为参照来衡量量子复杂性。研究计算了每次Grover迭代结束时与编译无关的“魔力”，并推导了稳定器Rényi熵的解析预测，证明其随系统尺寸增长而保持密集。此外，文章还探讨了将电路分解为基本门所带来的“魔力”开销，并指出在已知解的情况下，存在一种高效分解方案可以限制“魔力”的增长。
authors: Alessio Paviglianiti, Vincenzo Savona

articles.title: Topological Quantum Error-Correcting Thresholds of a Symmetry-Enriched Toric Code
articles.title_zh: 对称增强环面码的拓扑量子纠错阈值
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37791v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the error thresholds of a new topological quantum error-correcting code under the independent bit-flip and phase-flip noisy channel. By mapping to classical spin-glass models, we find that if Pauli X and Z errors are equally probable, the threshold of vertex syndromes is improved by 30% compared to that of the toric code, while the threshold of plaquette syndromes is lowered. Both thresholds increase when the Z component is less likely than the X component, reaching 0.5 if the Z component is absent. An analytical proof justifies this special case of perfect correctability, and a disordered version of Peierls's argument establishes a lower bound for the vertex-syndrome threshold.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一种新型拓扑量子纠错码在独立的比特翻转和相位翻转噪声信道下的错误阈值。通过映射到经典自旋玻璃模型，研究发现，如果泡利X和Z错误概率相等，顶点综合征的阈值比环面码提高了30%，而面综合征的阈值则降低了。当Z分量比X分量可能性更小时，两个阈值都会增加，若Z分量不存在则可达到0.5。文章提供了完美可纠错这一特殊情况的分析证明，并利用Peierls论证的无序版本建立了顶点综合征阈值的下限。
authors: Jiasheng He, Ryan Thorngren

articles.title: Stellar Representation of Gottesman Kitaev Preskill States on the Double Discrete Cylinder
articles.title_zh: 双离散圆柱体上Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill态的星形表示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37831v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Covariant integral quantization is developed on the double discrete cylinder phase space, with the torus as configuration space, and yields the Wigner distribution and the stellar representation. This phase space is particularly well suited to translationally invariant states, such as the Gottesman Kitaev Preskill (GKP) states. These states are central to fault-tolerant quantum computing architectures, yet their quantum resources are still under investigation. The stellar representations of ideal GKP logical states, which behave as phase eigenstates of the double discrete cylinder, have no zeros on this phase space, whereas those of their superpositions have infinitely many. The vacuum, although Gaussian, has zeros on this phase space, and the zeros of finitely squeezed GKP states move with the widths of the peaks and of the envelope, and reach this phase space for fine-tuned widths. These features echo the role of the vacuum as the resource that makes GKP-based architectures hard to simulate.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在以环面为构型空间的双离散圆柱体相空间上发展了协变积分量子化，得到了维格纳分布和星形表示。该相空间特别适用于平移不变态，例如Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) 态。理想GKP逻辑态的星形表示在该相空间上没有零点，而其叠加态则有无限多个零点。研究发现，真空态在该相空间上存在零点，这些特征反映了真空作为使基于GKP的架构难以模拟的资源的作用。
authors: Aidan Zlotak, Nicolas Fabre, Romain Murenzi

articles.title: Quantum Foundations Beyond Bell's Theorem: A Topical Review
articles.title_zh: 超越贝尔定理的量子基础：专题综述
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37854v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We review a series of recent no-go theorems that extend the methodological and conceptual framework introduced by Bell's theorem to more sophisticated operational scenarios involving independent sources, quantum networks, joint measurements, and multiple observers. Many of these results were originally developed within quantum information science and are scattered across the literature, where their technical and application-driven success has partly obscured their broader foundational significance. We organize them around a common Bell-inspired methodology that extends beyond quantum nonlocality, and emphasize how increasingly rich operational structures change which physical assumptions can be tested.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文综述了一系列近期超越贝尔定理方法论和概念框架的“不可能定理”，将其扩展到涉及独立源、量子网络、联合测量和多观察者的更复杂操作场景。这些结果许多最初在量子信息科学中发展，其技术和应用驱动的成功部分掩盖了其更广泛的基础意义。本综述围绕一种共同的、受贝尔启发的方法论组织这些定理，并强调了日益丰富的操作结构如何改变可测试的物理假设。
authors: Flavio Del Santo, Nicolas Gisin

articles.title: The Geometry of Quantum Teleportation in Phase Space
articles.title_zh: 相空间中量子隐形传态的几何学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37861v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We formulate the standard quantum teleportation protocol within the framework of deformation quantization, employing the Stratonovich--Weyl (SW) correspondence and the associated star product on the coadjoint orbits of SU(2). Each qubit is represented by a spherical phase space S² endowed with the Kirillov--Kostant--Souriau (KKS) symplectic structure. Within this setting, we explicitly construct the phase space representations of the entangled Bell resource, the controlled-NOT and Hadamard operators, the projective measurements, and the conditional Pauli corrections. We demonstrate how the quantum information initially encoded in the Wigner function for the input qubit is redistributed through bipartite and tripartite phase space correlations. Upon consideration of a conditional unitary transformation, the measurement outcome produces a Wigner function on the receiver's coadjoint orbit that is related to the input by an outcome-dependent rotation, which can subsequently be inverted through the implementation of an appropriate Pauli correction. The covariance of the SW correspondence provides a geometric interpretation of this process, in which quantum information is redistributed and reconstructed without transferring the underlying symplectic geometry. Our formulation can also be extended to study quantum teleportation in more general phase space geometries equipped with suitable star products.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在形变量子化框架下，利用Stratonovich--Weyl (SW) 对应和SU(2)伴随轨道上的星积，构建了标准量子隐形传态协议。每个量子比特由一个具有Kirillov--Kostant--Souriau (KKS) 辛结构的球面相空间S²表示。研究展示了量子信息如何通过双体和三体相空间关联重新分布，并通过适当的泡利校正实现测量结果的逆转。SW对应的协方差为这一过程提供了几何解释。
authors: Jasel Berra-Montiel, Alberto Molgado, Mar Sánchez-Córdova

articles.title: Exact Positive-P Simulation of Open Quantum Spin Systems with Generalized Density Matrix Formalism
articles.title_zh: 采用广义密度矩阵形式对开放量子自旋系统进行精确正P模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38059v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The positive-P representation for bosons allows scalable exact simulations of many-body open quantum systems, provided dissipation is strong enough to stabilise stochastic trajectories. Designing analogous methods for spin systems, relevant to quantum technologies, remains challenging, as previous spin positive-P formulations can exhibit systematic errors even when simulations are numerically stable. Here, we develop a phase-space representation that maps spin-frac12 degrees of freedom onto parameters of a local generalized density matrix (GDM), rather than SU(2) coherent states. In all stable regimes, we observe no deviations from exact solutions, restoring the positive-P property: stable solutions are exact up to stochastic sampling noise. The GDM representation combines seamlessly with bosonic positive-P, enabling highly scalable treatment of coupled spin-boson systems. We map simulation stability versus spin and boson dissipation in the Jaynes-Cummings model and apply the method to a Jaynes-Cummings-Hubbard quasi-Lieb lattice, showing how spin dissipation and driving can destroy or restore excitation incompressibility.
articles.abstract_zh: 正P表示法为玻色子提供了可扩展的精确模拟开放量子多体系统的方法，但将其推广到自旋系统仍具挑战性。本文开发了一种新的相空间表示，将自旋-1/2自由度映射到局部广义密度矩阵（GDM）的参数上，而非SU(2)相干态。该方法在所有稳定状态下均未显示出与精确解的偏差，恢复了正P特性。GDM表示法可与玻色子正P无缝结合，实现对耦合自旋-玻色子系统的高度可扩展处理。
authors: Alex Ferrier, Yi Shi, Marzena H. Szymańska, Piotr Deuar

articles.title: Experimental Observation of Error-Resilience Phase Transition on Superconducting Quantum Processor
articles.title_zh: 在超导量子处理器上实验观测错误弹性相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38148v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Random unitaries scramble quantum information into highly nonlocal degrees of freedom, thereby providing protection from local noise. However, as demonstrated by Turkeshi and Sierant (Phys. Rev. Lett. 132, 140401, 2024 and arXiv:2603.00235), this protection may fail once local noise grows sufficiently strong. These works describe a phase transition in a noisy random encoding-decoding circuit model between an error-protecting phase, in which encoded information is recoverable, and an error-vulnerable phase, in which encoded information is lost, with the transition occurring at a critical coherent noise angle α_c approx 1.14. Here, we present the first experimental observation of this transition, conducted on IBM's ibmₚᵢₜₜₛburgh Heron r3 device for system sizes of up to N = 26 qubits. We detect this transition via three order parameters: fidelity, Rényi-2 entanglement entropy, and stabilizer Rényi-2 entropy. For the latter two, we employ randomized measurement protocols to construct estimators, and for all three, we rely on zero-noise extrapolation and M3 SPAM error mitigation. We then jointly model the finite-size scaling collapse across all three order parameters with a Gaussian process regression, yielding a critical angle α_c approx 1.01, well below the theoretical value. Inputting noiseless simulated data into the same model yields α_c approx 1.05, implying that the discrepancy between experiment and theory is due to our encoding circuits, which are not deep enough to be truly Haar-random. Finally, we observe that the same model cannot adequately identify critical behavior in unmitigated, raw experimental data. This indicates that error mitigation techniques are crucial for detecting the transition on hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 随机酉变换能将量子信息打乱以抵抗局部噪声，但当局部噪声足够强时，这种保护可能失效，导致错误保护相与错误脆弱相之间的相变。本文首次在IBM的ibmₚᵢₜₜₛburgh Heron r3超导量子处理器上，对多达26个量子比特的系统进行了这一相变的实验观测。研究通过保真度、Rényi-2纠缠熵和稳定器Rényi-2熵这三个序参量检测了相变，并利用零噪声外推和M3 SPAM错误缓解技术提高了测量精度。
authors: Emanuel Dallas, Mario Morford-Oberst, Eric Weine

articles.title: Quantum advantage by designing beneficial dissipation from lossless dynamics
articles.title_zh: 通过无损动力学设计有益耗散实现量子优势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38183v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Passive loss removes probability from a system and therefore seems unable to improve an unconditional target. This intuition is exact for classical population dynamics under sink-only removal: passive killing obeys a finite-strength monotonicity principle even after optimization over the remaining controls. Here we show that coherent quantum dynamics can violate this classical monotonicity because coherent contributions to the final target can interfere destructively. We derive a trajectory-level criterion that determines when such a detrimental contribution is physically accessible to passive loss and accumulates into a net unconditional benefit. The criterion is encoded in a response operator constructed entirely from the lossless dynamics: its spectrum determines whether weak passive loss can help, while its principal eigenvector identifies the optimal environmental mode. Applying this criterion to vibronically assisted transfer, we identify a beneficial mode formed by coherently combining two individually detrimental local loss directions. The predicted mode remains near-optimal at finite loss, producing an (8.73%) enhancement over the independently optimized lossless benchmark, compared with (9.52%) under full finite-loss optimization. Our results establish how coherent quantum dynamics can evade classical passive-loss monotonicity and provide a general task-dependent principle for designing beneficial passive environments from lossless dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 经典直觉认为被动损耗无法改善无条件目标，但本文证明相干量子动力学可以违反这一经典单调性，因为相干贡献可能发生相消干涉。研究导出了一个轨迹层面的判据，用于确定何时被动损耗能带来净无条件收益。该判据编码在完全由无损动力学构建的响应算符中，其谱决定了弱被动损耗是否有效，主特征向量则识别出最佳环境模式。将此判据应用于振动辅助转移，发现通过相干组合两个单独有害的局部损耗方向，可形成一个有益模式，并在有限损耗下实现近最优，带来显著增强。
authors: Zeng-Zhao Li, Xiao Xue

articles.title: Active Approach to Fast Quantum State Preparation and Reset in Atomic Arrays
articles.title_zh: 原子阵列中快速量子态制备与重置的主动方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38261v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rapid preparation of a target quantum state and reset to the many-body ground state are essential for quantum information processing. Here, we investigate both processes in a waveguide-coupled emitter array in the low-excitation regime. By decomposing the effective non-Hermitian Hamiltonian into biorthogonal eigenmodes, we show that relaxation depends on the initial overlap with the more subradiant modes, providing a modal explanation of the Mpemba effect. Guided by this insight, we design a reset protocol in which a finite-duration local drive activelysuppresses the relatively slow-decaying components. For the parameters studied, this reduces the time to reach a fixed residual-excitation threshold by up to approximately 25% compared with free decay. To prepare a target Dicke state, we introduce a two-step protocol that initially leaves one emitter undriven before restoring the full drive that stabilizes the target. This local control redistributes spectral weight into the more subradiant modes, driving them closer to their target amplitudes, which reduces the preparation time by up to approximately 45% while consuming less driving energy than continuous driving. Finally, we show how directional waveguide coupling shifts collective modes toward a preferred boundary through the non-Hermitian skin effect, providing guidance for selecting the preferred site for local operations. We term this fundamental dependence of the relaxation dynamics on the system's chirality the ``non-Hermitian Skin-Mpemba effect.'' These results demonstrate how selective local control can accelerate state preparation and reset in open quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 快速制备目标量子态和重置到多体基态对量子信息处理至关重要。本文研究了波导耦合发射器阵列在低激发状态下的这两个过程，并通过将有效非厄米哈密顿量分解为双正交本征模式，揭示了弛豫与初始态和次辐射模式的重叠程度相关。基于此，研究设计了一种主动重置协议，通过有限持续时间的局部驱动抑制慢衰减分量，将重置时间缩短了约25%。此外，还提出了一种两步协议来制备目标迪克态，将制备时间缩短了约45%，同时降低了驱动能量消耗。
authors: Ya-Tang Yu, Wei-Hsuan Chung, Tian-Shu Gou, Kuan-Ting Lin, H. H. Jen

articles.title: Controllability-Based Input Allocation in Quantum System
articles.title_zh: 基于可控性的量子系统输入分配
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38415v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding how local perturbations influence global quantum dynamics is important for analyzing and designing large-scale quantum systems. Existing quantum centrality measures often rely on static correlations or entanglement and do not directly capture perturbation propagation under unitary evolution. We formulate controllability allocation scoring for quantum input-output dynamics governed by the Schrodinger equation. Using the multiobservable quantum-control Gramian, we introduce virtual local Hamiltonian perturbations along a nominal trajectory and decompose the terminal-output response into channel-wise Gramian contributions. A simplex-constrained log-determinant optimization combines these contributions to define a volumetric controllability allocation score (V-CAS), specifying an optimal allocation of virtual input intensities among local Hamiltonian perturbation directions. The score measures their cooperative dynamical influence and depends on the output and trajectory. We characterize the output Gramian's range and minimum-energy properties and derive a drift-independent sufficient condition ensuring score uniqueness for almost every terminal time at which the problem is feasible. For quantum many-body systems, we develop a matrix-product-state and time-evolving-block-decimation implementation that avoids explicitly constructing exponentially large state-transition matrices. We also derive an error bound propagating Trotter and MPS-truncation errors to the discrete output Gramian. Numerical experiments show that the score captures finite-time influence patterns distinct from those identified by static correlation- and entanglement-based measures and can inform target-independent control-channel preselection.
articles.abstract_zh: 理解局部扰动如何影响全局量子动力学对于分析和设计大型量子系统至关重要。本文提出了基于薛定谔方程的量子输入-输出动力学可控性分配评分方法。通过多可观测量子控制格拉姆矩阵，引入沿标称轨迹的虚拟局部哈密顿量扰动，并将终端输出响应分解为通道格拉姆矩阵贡献。通过单纯形约束的对数行列式优化，定义了体积可控性分配分数（V-CAS），以确定局部哈密顿量扰动方向上的虚拟输入强度最优分配。
authors: Riku Yaegashi, Kazuhiro Sato, Kentaro Ohki

articles.title: Hyperentanglement-enabled Quantum Privacy Amplification for Classical-Quantum Coexistence in Fiber Networks
articles.title_zh: 基于超纠缠的量子隐私放大实现光纤网络中经典-量子共存
