articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38645v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Integrating quantum communication into existing fiber infrastructures requires coexisting with high-power classical traffic, which generates noise in the quantum channel. Spontaneous Raman Scattering (SpRS) is the dominant noise source, generating a broadband photon background that degrades quantum states and, in Quantum Key Distribution (QKD), can entirely suppress secure key generation. In this work, we implement single-copy entanglement distillation utilizing energy-time and frequency hyperentanglement, and we exploit it to perform Quantum Privacy Amplification (QPA) directly at a physical layer. Strict frequency anti-correlations of spontaneous parametric down-conversion are used to selectively discard uncorrelated Raman photons while preserving genuine entangled pairs, suppressing accidental coincidences by a factor 1/N, where N is the number of frequency channel pairs. Using passive borosilicate-glass photonic integrated circuits and standard DWDM demultiplexers over a 20~km single-mode fiber testbed, we demonstrate a 4~dB improvement in tolerance to classical laser launch power P_C when QPA is performed, extending the secure key threshold from P_C=-13.3 dBm to P_C=-9.3 dBm. The result shows that off-the-shelf telecom components can be repurposed as physical-layer quantum privacy amplifiers.
articles.abstract_zh: 将量子通信集成到现有光纤基础设施中，需要与高功率经典流量共存，这会在量子信道中产生噪声，其中自发拉曼散射是主要噪声源。本文利用能量-时间与频率超纠缠实现单拷贝纠缠蒸馏，并在物理层执行量子隐私放大（QPA）。通过自发参量下转换的严格频率反关联性，选择性地丢弃不相关的拉曼光子，同时保留真正的纠缠对，将偶然符合计数抑制了1/N倍。实验结果表明，在20公里单模光纤测试平台上，执行QPA后对经典激光发射功率的容忍度提高了4 dB。
authors: Domenico Ribezzo, Giulia Guarda, Alessandro Zavatta, Davide Bacco

articles.title: Homodyne versus heterodyne detection for classifying families of optical quantum states from finite records of detection events
articles.title_zh: 从有限探测事件记录中分类光学量子态的零差与外差探测比较
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38671v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural networks can identify an optical quantum state from an image of its phase-space function, but a real measurement gives a finite record of N detection events. Heterodyne detection samples the Husimi Q function directly, whereas homodyne detection gives the Wigner function only after a reconstruction from several phases. We ask which scheme better identifies one of seven families of states, including Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) states, under loss, dephasing and Gaussian noise. We simulate finite records on identical states for two sets of families, one with equal mean photon number and one built from the code of Ahmed et al. For convolutional networks, heterodyne detection outperforms homodyne detection with filtered back-projection by 14.1 percentage points at N=100 events and 20% dephasing in the first set (adjusted p=0.003 over 24 cells across training runs), and it depends on the number of phases and on the reconstruction. At N=10³ and 10⁴ no difference is significant, but the intervals are wide. At N=100, a homodyne network without reconstruction does not differ significantly from heterodyne detection in the first set and is nominally worse in the second. Near thermal states we show to leading order that heterodyne detection damps phase-space structure of order n exponentially, whereas homodyne detection shares unit weight among n+1 angular components, a local result that does not explain the finite-record differences. Experimental records of a GKP state, photon-subtracted squeezed states and one mode of an Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen source are classified like simulated ones, but these low-power tests probe our counting-noise model, not the seven-class accuracy. A likelihood-ratio observer shows no such gap at N=100, so our evidence concerns a reconstruction-based pipeline, not homodyne detection in general.
articles.abstract_zh: 神经网络能够从相空间函数图像识别光学量子态，但实际测量提供的是有限的探测事件记录。本文比较了零差探测和外差探测在有损耗、退相干和高斯噪声条件下，从有限探测事件记录中识别七种光学量子态家族（包括GKP态）的性能。研究发现，对于卷积网络，在外差探测在N=100个事件和20%退相干的情况下，其性能比采用滤波反投影的零差探测高出14.1个百分点。然而，在N=10³和10⁴时，两者之间没有显著差异。
authors: Franciszek Grzywa, Sebastian Dolata, Karol Bartkiewicz

articles.title: Goldbach Representations in Quantum Optics and Metrology
articles.title_zh: 量子光学与计量学中的哥德巴赫表示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38675v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We derive a relation between Goldbach representations and photon-number statistics in a quantum-optical setup. Considering an even-number Fock state injected into a stochastic beam splitter with uniformly distributed transmissivity and projections of the two output modes onto prime subspaces, we demonstrate that each successful outcome corresponds to an Goldbach representation and that the averaged detection probability is exactly proportional to the number of Goldbach representations. Then, employing the Hardy--Littlewood asymptotic formula, we demonstrate that the post-measurement state generated by a beam splitter with fixed transmissivity exhibits standard quantum limit scaling of the ultimate precision limit in terms of phase estimation, whereas an equally weighted superposition of Goldbach representations exhibits Heisenberg scaling. These results provide a quantum-optical realization of Goldbach representations and relate their statistics of with quantum metrology.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文推导了量子光学设置中哥德巴赫表示与光子数统计之间的关系。研究表明，将偶数福克态注入到具有均匀分布透射率的随机分束器中，并将两个输出模式投影到素数子空间时，每个成功结果都对应一个哥德巴赫表示，且平均探测概率与哥德巴赫表示的数量成正比。此外，利用Hardy-Littlewood渐近公式，证明了固定透射率分束器产生的测量后态在相位估计的极限精度方面表现出标准量子极限标度，而哥德巴赫表示的等权重叠加则表现出海森堡标度。
authors: Akira Sone, Maxim Olshanii

articles.title: Generalized Mean-Field Ising Model as a Benchmark Family with Exact Solutions
articles.title_zh: 广义平均场伊辛模型：具有精确解的基准族
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38803v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exactly solvable models provide opportunities to understand complex optimization problems while offering controlled benchmarks for computational methods. However, nontrivial models that combine analytical tractability with challenging optimization structure remain scarce. Here, we introduce the Generalized Mean-Field Ising (GMFI) family, a densely connected and inhomogeneous class of Ising Hamiltonians whose ground states can nevertheless be obtained exactly. This exact solution reveals a hidden low-dimensional structure and enables a complete number-theoretic classification of different system sizes and degenerate ground states. Uniquely, the GMFI family can be used to benchmark both quantum and classical optimization methods over system sizes far beyond exact diagonalization. We investigate the GMFI family using several approaches, including theoretical analysis of quantum annealing, experiments on a D-Wave quantum processor, the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA), imaginary-time evolution (ITE), greedy algorithm, simulated annealing, and a quantum-inspired greedy algorithm. Despite the GMFI model's exact solvability, it exhibits nontrivial algorithmic behavior: although the quantum-annealing gap is expected to decrease with increasing system size, it shows pronounced and unexpected system-size-dependent oscillatory signatures. These results establish GMFI models as a rare bridge between exact many-body theory, number theory, optimization, and quantum hardware, providing a scalable benchmark for identifying and understanding algorithmic limitations in classical and quantum computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 精确可解模型为理解复杂优化问题提供了机会，但结合分析可解性和挑战性优化结构的非平凡模型仍然稀缺。本文引入了广义平均场伊辛（GMFI）模型家族，这是一类密集连接且非均匀的伊辛哈密顿量，其基态可以精确获得。该精确解揭示了隐藏的低维结构，并实现了不同系统尺寸和简并基态的完整数论分类。GMFI家族可用于基准测试超越精确对角化系统尺寸的量子和经典优化方法。
authors: Madita Willsch, Gopal Chandra Santra, Dennis Willsch, Samuel Morales, Lukas Mauth, Vrinda Mehta, Fengping Jin, Kristel Michielsen

articles.title: Local Quantum Fault Tolerance Without Expansion
articles.title_zh: 无扩展的局部量子容错
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38847v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study fault-tolerant quantum computation using a fixed, local error-correction rule and a geometrically simple code: the cubical (d,d')-Toric code with d',d-d'≥ 2, including the 4D Toric code. Under sufficiently weak local-stochastic Pauli noise, our construction uses noiseless, bounded-depth classical processing per physical time step. Its correction cycle acts only on the current syndrome, has constant depth, and is repeated unchanged during idle logical computation; it requires neither multiscale decoder states nor scale-dependent communication delays. Our proof treats errors and syndromes as chains in a cubical complex, combining geometric shrinking under the sweep rule with a space--time explanation-tree argument inspired by Toom's theorem. It does not rely on expansion. We establish three results: 1.Explicit higher-dimensional sweep rule. We give a local algorithm for choosing sweep corrections on cubical (d,d')-Toric complexes, resolving the local-existence question of Kubica and Preskill. 2. Fault-tolerant computation. We prove a circuit-level threshold theorem for noisy sweep cycles interleaved with logical gates. In particular, the 4D Toric code admits a fixed, constant-depth syndrome-based correction cycle without a multiscale decoder or expansion-based encoding. We do not claim constant total-depth overhead. 3. Ideal decoding under local-stochastic noise. For an initial local-stochastic Pauli error of rate p below threshold, nd⁺¹ noiseless sweep cycles recover the encoded state on a side-length-n (d,d')-Toric code with probability at least 1-O(øperatornamepoly(n))pØmega⁽ⁿ⁾, extending earlier guarantees for independent errors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了使用固定局部纠错规则和几何简单编码（立方(d,d')-Toric码）的容错量子计算。在足够弱的局部随机泡利噪声下，该构造在每个物理时间步使用无噪声、有界深度的经典处理。其纠错周期仅作用于当前综合征，具有恒定深度，并在空闲逻辑计算期间重复不变，无需多尺度解码器状态或依赖于尺度的通信延迟。研究证明了电路级阈值定理，并给出了在立方(d,d')-Toric复形上选择扫描校正的局部算法。
authors: David Ponarovsky

articles.title: High bandwidth heterodyne sensing with bulk NV diamond
articles.title_zh: 基于块状NV金刚石的高带宽外差传感
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39022v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Developing high performance portable sensors is of significant importance for both terrestrial and satellite communications, with quantum sensors offering potential advantages in sensitivity and bandwidth. The nitrogen vacancy center in diamond is a popular quantum sensing platform for its relative simplicity and wide range of acceptable operating conditions, but suffers a limited instantaneous bandwidth due to the narrow linewidth of the spin resonance. In this work, we first present a magnetic quantum sensing scheme utilizing heterodyne mixing with strong optical and microwave driving, achieving MHz-scale instantaneous bandwidth with a sensitivity of 548 ; pT/sqrtHz in an active diamond volume of  2.5× 10⁻⁴ ; mm³ with 2 × 10¹¹ NV centers. We then demonstrate expansion of the sensing bandwidth by employing a strong magnetic gradient and many individually modulated microwave control fields, expanding the single resonance bandwidth to 48 MHz with a peak sensitivity of 8.5 ; nT/sqrtHz.
articles.abstract_zh: 氮空位（NV）金刚石色心是流行的量子传感平台，但其自旋共振线宽窄导致瞬时带宽受限。本文提出了一种利用强光和微波驱动进行外差混频的磁量子传感方案，在2.5×10⁻⁴ mm³的活性金刚石体积中实现了MHz量级的瞬时带宽和548 pT/√Hz的灵敏度。通过采用强磁梯度和多个独立调制的微波控制场，研究进一步将传感带宽扩展到48 MHz，峰值灵敏度达到8.5 nT/√Hz。
authors: H. A. M. Taylor, J. P. Duff, L. B. Miller, A. Tritt, M. S. Oldfield, K. Helmerson, M. S. J. Barson

articles.title: Fate of Quantum Magic
articles.title_zh: 量子魔性之命运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39059v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magic, a quantum resource distinct from entanglement, measures departure from states stabilized by products of Pauli operators. Such stabilizer states can be maximally entangled yet admit efficient classical description: quantum advantage requires magic. We develop a powerful framework to evaluate the degree of magic in generic many-body states. We use it to study the fate of magic under thermal and dynamical evolution. In the transverse field Ising model, we find a thermal sudden death of magic that saturates with system size, and occurs after the death of entanglement. We reach similar conclusions in generic spin chains, and in the Kitaev quantum spin liquid on the honeycomb lattice, where the threshold shows an intricate dependence on subregion shape. We then study how magic equilibrates after a quantum quench. In quenches of generic spin chains, the magic of a subregion typically dies before entanglement, contrary to thermal trajectories. An explanation is given in terms of the geometry of non-magical states. As a third type of trajectory, we examine the fate of magic with separation with an appropriate notion of non-local magic and establish a sudden death. Finally, we show how to experimentally witness a volume law of frame-robust magic in quantum materials by using neutron scattering.
articles.abstract_zh: 魔性作为一种区别于纠缠的量子资源，衡量了偏离泡利算符乘积稳定态的程度，是实现量子优势的关键。本文开发了一个强大的框架来评估通用多体态中的魔性程度，并研究了魔性在热演化和动力学演化下的命运。在横场伊辛模型中，发现魔性存在热猝死现象，且发生在纠缠消失之后。在量子骤冷过程中，通用自旋链子区域的魔性通常在纠缠之前消失，这与热轨迹相反。
authors: Liuke Lyu, Erik S. Sørensen, William Witczak-Krempa

articles.title: Force Sensing in a Recoverable Bosonic Quantum Memory
articles.title_zh: 可恢复玻色子量子存储器中的力传感
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39208v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In continuous-variable quantum information, sensing and quantum error correction in the same mode face an intrinsic trade-off: sensors must accumulate weak external displacements, whereas bosonic codes typically suppress such shifts as errors. Here, we establish compatibility by constructing finite-energy bosonic codes that enable a single oscillator to sense an external force while actively protecting an unknown logical qubit. By encoding logical amplitudes across discrete wave-packet sites and capturing the force signal in a shared internal coordinate, we achieve an endpoint probe readout that is independent of the logical state under continuous photon loss γ. Crucially, binomial site recovery cancels packet-dependent probe distortions alongside logical errors: for a (2r+2)-packet code, memory infidelity is suppressed to O(γr⁺¹) while residual memory-probe correlations scale as O(γr⁺²). Finally, superconducting quantum circuit benchmarks under competing photon-number dephasing and Kerr nonlinearity identify preferred encoding regimes for hardware implementation.
articles.abstract_zh: 连续变量量子信息中，传感和量子纠错在同一模式下存在固有权衡。本文通过构建有限能量玻色子编码，实现了单个振荡器在感知外部力的同时主动保护未知逻辑量子比特。该方案通过在离散波包位点编码逻辑振幅并在共享内部坐标中捕获力信号，实现了与逻辑状态无关的端点探测读数。二项式位点恢复能够消除探测失真和逻辑错误，并将存储器失真度抑制到O(γr⁺¹)。
authors: Tairong Bai, Wen Zheng, Haoyang Cai, Xianke Li, Yangyang Ge, Kun Zhou, Xiangmin Yu, Yu Zhang, Shaoxiong Li, Xinsheng Tan, Jie Zhao, Yang Yu

articles.title: Provably efficient experimental classification of quantum data with quantum kernels
articles.title_zh: 基于量子核的可证明高效量子数据实验分类
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39350v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Analyzing quantum systems is essential for quantum information processing, but can require exponentially many measurements without exploiting the structure of the system or task. Quantum machine learning offers a promising way to reduce this cost by learning from quantum data. Here, we theoretically establish a framework for efficient quantum-state classification and experimentally demonstrate the resulting scheme on a programmable photonic processor. Our analysis links learning efficiency to the structure of quantum data, without relying on a physical description tailored to each task. We derive sufficient conditions for accurate classification with a number of measurements polynomial in system size. We apply this guarantee to a resource problem in continuous-variable (CV) quantum computing: classifying stellar rank, a measure of non-Gaussianity. Experimentally, we implement the classification of single-mode CV quantum states with stellar rank zero and one. This is enabled by developing a programmable CV photonic processor capable of preparing and processing diverse Gaussian and non-Gaussian states and performing virtual projection onto such states, going beyond the Gaussian-only capabilities of most existing photonic platforms. The experiment demonstrates accurate classification despite experimental imperfections. Our results establish a theory-guided and experimentally validated framework for quantum-state classification that can be implemented on quantum devices available today.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论上建立了高效量子态分类的框架，并在可编程光子处理器上进行了实验验证。该分析将学习效率与量子数据结构联系起来，导出了在系统规模多项式测量次数下实现准确分类的充分条件。研究将此保证应用于连续变量(CV)量子计算中的恒星秩分类问题，并实验实现了单模CV量子态的分类。
authors: Keitaro Anai, Akimoto Nakayama, Shintaro Ooka, Hiroko Tomoda, Yuto Morohoshi, Yohji Chin, Shigehito Miki, Masahiro Yabuno, Hirotaka Terai, Peter van Loock, Kosuke Mitarai, Shuntaro Takeda

articles.title: Composable Device-Independent Quantum Digital Signatures
articles.title_zh: 可组合的设备无关量子数字签名
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39360v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Extending device-independent (DI) quantum cryptography to composably support all fundamental information security objectives is crucial for secure quantum networks. Achieving this goal requires composable quantum digital signatures (QDSs), which support integrity, authenticity, and nonrepudiation when integrated into quantum networks. Yet existing QDS protocols generally rely on assumptions about the underlying quantum devices, while their security analyses remain largely restricted to stand-alone settings, leaving related-key attacks on the underlying linear feedback shift register (LFSR)-based Toeplitz authentication unaddressed. Here, we establish the first composable security framework for QDS within constructive cryptography, and realize the corresponding ideal QDS resource by developing a DI-QDS protocol employing one-time universal hashing and multi-channel multiplexing. We further derive a related-key security bound for the underlying LFSR-based Toeplitz authentication, thereby establishing unforgeability while extending the forgery boundary considered in previous QDS security analyses. We also demonstrate the practical feasibility of our DI-QDS protocol under realistic quantum network conditions in the finite-size regime, with numerical simulations showing that it enables efficient signing of multibit documents over metropolitan-scale distances. Our results establish QDS as a composable cryptographic primitive and extend DI quantum cryptography to support the full range of information security objectives with composable security guarantees in future quantum networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在构造性密码学中建立了首个可组合的量子数字签名（QDS）安全框架，并通过开发采用一次性通用哈希和多通道复用的DI-QDS协议，实现了相应的理想QDS资源。研究进一步推导了底层基于LFSR的Toeplitz认证的相关密钥安全界限，从而确立了不可伪造性，并扩展了先前QDS安全分析中考虑的伪造边界。
authors: Jing-Wei Bian, Bing-Hong Li, Xu-Yang Lu, Shi-Gen Li, Hua-Lei Yin, Zeng-Bing Chen

articles.title: Adiabatic training of VQAs for entanglement detection
articles.title_zh: 用于纠缠检测的变分量子算法的绝热训练
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39577v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper introduces a hybrid quantum framework for training Variational Quantum Algorithms (VQAs) aimed at addressing the fundamental problem of entanglement detection using adiabatic quantum computing. This problem is of foundational significance in quantum information science and has been approached through both classical and quantum methodologies. We propose an adiabatic-inspired optimization strategy for training VQAs, which combines a discretization of the parameter space with a hierarchical segmentation scheme. The optimization problem is formulated as a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) model to leverage the capabilities of quantum annealing. Preliminary results are compared against classical neural networks and conventional VQA training techniques. The findings aim to stimulate further investigation and discussion within the scientific community regarding the efficacy and applicability of the proposed approach.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种混合量子框架，用于训练变分量子算法（VQAs），以解决利用绝热量子计算进行纠缠检测的基本问题。研究提出了一种受绝热启发的VQA优化策略，结合了参数空间的离散化和分层分割方案。优化问题被表述为二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）模型，以利用量子退火的能力。
authors: E. Acosta, C. Cano, D. Manzano, G. Botella

articles.title: Detection and Inhibition of Decoherence Through Collisions: A dynamical approach
articles.title_zh: 通过碰撞检测和抑制退相干：一种动力学方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39657v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum systems are intrinsically fragile and highly vulnerable to environmental noise, making the preservation of quantum states one of the fundamental challenges in realizing practical quantum technologies. We propose two noise-agnostic quantum state protection protocols based on a collisional model. The first protocol preserves quantum states of qubits without requiring complete prior knowledge of the underlying noise dynamics, and the second even protects a logical qubit under similar circumstances. These protocols provide robust protection for arbitrary single-qubit and entangled states against general noise processes. Furthermore, their capability to safeguard quantum states with an arbitrary number of qubits enhances the reliability, robustness, and scalability of emerging quantum architectures. These results establish the proposed framework as a promising approach for practical quantum information processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了两种基于碰撞模型的噪声无关量子态保护协议，旨在解决量子系统易受环境噪声影响的问题。第一个协议在不完全了解噪声动力学的情况下保护量子比特的量子态，第二个协议甚至在类似情况下保护逻辑量子比特。这些协议为任意单量子比特和纠缠态提供了针对一般噪声过程的鲁棒保护，增强了新兴量子架构的可靠性、鲁棒性和可扩展性。
authors: Sagnik Chakraborty, Srijon Ghosh, Federico Amato, Gniewomir Sarbicki, Dariusz Chruściński, Rosario Lo Franco

articles.title: Optimized Dynamical Decoupling for Spin Ensembles with Large Inhomogeneities
articles.title_zh: 具有大不均匀性的自旋系综的优化动力学解耦
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39693v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin ensembles show increasing promise for highly efficient quantum sensing and quantum technologies. However, protecting their coherent properties remains a significant challenge. Dynamical decoupling (DD) typically employs a sequence of fast pulses that aim to reduce the effect of unwanted system-environment interactions. However, the performance of the DD sequences typically suffers in spin ensembles, e.g., due to amplitude and frequency inhomogeneities and control errors. In this work, we compare the performance of an extensive number of DD protocols for coherence protection and quantum sensing in an ensemble of negatively charged NV centers under ambient conditions. We identify the optimal approach that uses rapid adiabatic passage pulses, which are robust to amplitude and frequency inhomogeneity, in combination with the variation of their phases. We experimentally demonstrate an improved signal contrast and an order-of-magnitude increase in memory time with the optimal sequence compared to the widely used XY8 with standard rectangular pulses. We also apply our approach for improved sensing of a weak oscillating field. While our particular demonstration is with NV centers in diamond, the optimized protocol is generally applicable to other spin ensembles and to systems with high amplitude and/or frequency inhomogeneities.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋系综在量子传感和量子技术中具有巨大潜力，但保护其相干性仍是挑战。本文比较了大量动力学解耦（DD）协议在环境条件下对NV中心系综的相干保护和量子传感性能。研究确定了使用对幅度和频率不均匀性鲁棒的快速绝热通过脉冲，并结合其相位变化的优化方法。实验证明，与传统XY8脉冲相比，该优化序列显著提高了信号对比度和存储时间。
authors: Rajan Paul, Genko Genov, Oliver Schmid, Shinobu Onoda, Yutaka Kobayashi, Junichi Isoya, Fedor Jelezko

articles.title: Digital-Analog Quantum Neural Network with Long-Range Interactions
articles.title_zh: 具有长程相互作用的数字-模拟量子神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39847v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Protocols combining single-qubit digital operations with analog quantum evolutions bypass large numbers of two-qubit entangling gates, offering a promising approach to variational algorithms and hybrid quantum simulation. Focusing on the digital-analog quantum neural network (DA-QNN) as a representative framework, this work demonstrates that incorporating long-range interactions enhances the efficiency of such hybrid algorithms. Within the analog blocks, an Ising model with power-law interactions is employed to generate entanglement, and this protocol is benchmarked across supervised and unsupervised learning tasks. Beyond discussing the effects of the transverse field and evolution time, the primary analysis focuses on how the interaction range governs the expressibility and trainability of the ansatz. For supervised image classification and many-body phase detection, long-range ansatzes match the performance of their short-range counterparts with fewer DA-QNN layers or shorter evolution times, owing to the rapid information propagation across the system enabled by nonlocal couplings. This resource reduction alleviates the classical optimization overhead and eases experimental implementation. In unsupervised phase detection, although the long-range ansatz does not outperform its short-range counterpart in every regime, the two ansatzes provide complementary signatures that jointly reconstruct the complete phase diagram. These findings establish long-range interacting platforms as a compelling resource for advancing practical, large-scale digital-analog quantum computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了数字-模拟量子神经网络（DA-QNN），并证明引入长程相互作用可以提高此类混合算法的效率。在模拟模块中，采用具有幂律相互作用的伊辛模型来生成纠缠，并在监督和无监督学习任务中进行了基准测试。研究发现，长程Ansatz在图像分类和多体相检测任务中，以更少的DA-QNN层或更短的演化时间，达到了与短程对应物相同的性能。
authors: Zongyuan Ge, Daili Li, Zewen Zhang

articles.title: Distributed Inner-Product Estimation for Continuous-Variable Quantum States
articles.title_zh: 连续变量量子态的分布式内积估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40141v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Distributed inner product estimation (DIPE) is a fundamental task in quantum information, aiming to estimate the inner product between two unknown quantum states prepared on distributed quantum platforms. For multimode continuous-variable (CV) systems, the infinite-dimensional Hilbert space poses an additional challenge. In this work, we develop a CV-DIPE protocol using only local homodyne measurements at shared phase settings and classical communication. Under a known bound on the mean energy per mode, we derive explicit finite-sample guarantees and sufficient copy counts for estimating the full inner product to prescribed accuracy and confidence. The energy constraint yields an inverse-square truncation-bias bound, while Gaussian structure strengthens the tail control to exponential decay and improves the resulting accuracy scaling. Numerical simulations with Gaussian and non-Gaussian states illustrate the balance between truncation bias and statistical error and its dependence on mode number and energy. Our results enable independent CV platforms to benchmark their state preparations against one another, even when neither state admits a tractable classical description.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文开发了一种连续变量（CV）分布式内积估计（DIPE）协议，仅使用共享相位设置下的局部零差测量和经典通信。在已知每模平均能量限制下，研究推导了估计完整内积的有限样本保证和足够的副本数量。能量约束产生了反平方截断偏差界限，而高斯结构则将尾部控制增强为指数衰减。
authors: Jun Tang, Congcong Zheng, Xutao Yu, Zaichen Zhang

articles.title: QDMin: Coherent Quantum Minimum Finding for Nuclear Deformation Landscapes
articles.title_zh: QDMin：用于核形变景观的相干量子最小寻找算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40320v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Locating the minimum of a nuclear collective landscape can require many interacting many-body calculations. QDMin (Quantum Deformation Minimum Finding) searches a parameterized Hamiltonian family with a coherent collective-coordinate register and an on-demand ground-energy threshold oracle. The oracle supplies the predicate required for quantum minimum-finding without first constructing the energy landscape point by point. We implement it for a schematic pairing-plus-multipole model using circuit-generated energy estimates during the search. In a four-point calculation, one Grover round raises the probability of the true minimum from 0.25 to 0.921. A 4×4 quadrupole--octupole-field calculation extends the complete circuit to two coordinates, although its minimum is first sampled in a round with zero Grover iterations. Its worst-case branch-preparation fidelity of 0.744 falls below the declared target, identifying coherent ground-state access as the current bottleneck. QDMin inherits expected O(sqrtN_q) candidate-query scaling in the unstructured model; total advantage depends on the many-body oracle cost and remains unestablished.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了QDMin（量子形变最小寻找）算法，用于搜索参数化哈密顿量族中的核集体景观最小值。该算法利用相干集体坐标寄存器和按需基态能量阈值预言机，无需逐点构建能量景观即可进行量子最小寻找。在四点计算中，一个Grover轮将真实最小值的概率从0.25提高到0.921。
authors: Abhishek, P. Arumugam

articles.title: Quantum communication: a discrimination approach
articles.title_zh: 量子通信：一种判别方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40358v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a state discrimination approach to unassisted quantum communication through a noisy quantum channel. Starting from the operational duality between entanglement recovery and state discrimination, we construct entanglement-generation codes with explicit decoders constructed from Petz recovery maps. The resulting error bounds hold for every number of channel uses and are expressed in terms of Petz-Rényi coherent information. For product sources, they yield exponential error decay at rates below coherent information.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于态判别的方法，用于通过噪声量子信道的无辅助量子通信。从纠缠恢复和态判别之间的操作对偶性出发，研究构建了具有由Petz恢复映射构建的显式解码器的纠缠生成码。所得的误差界限适用于任意信道使用次数，并以Petz-Rényi相干信息表示。
authors: Hao-Chung Cheng

articles.title: Rapid mixing for Gibbs samplers for quantum spin systems with all-to-all interactions
articles.title_zh: 具有全连接相互作用的量子自旋系统吉布斯采样器的快速混合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40361v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding when quantum many-body systems rapidly converge to thermal equilibrium is a central problem in quantum statistical mechanics. While spatial locality provides powerful tools for systems with an underlying geometry, fully connected models require estimates that accommodate interactions between every pair of spins. We study Gibbs-state preparation for two-local quantum Hamiltonians on arbitrary interaction graphs, including fully connected systems, via Lindblad dynamics that satisfies Kubo--Martin--Schwinger (KMS) detailed balance. Our approach is based on a quantum analogue of the classical Dobrushin condition, which controls the influence of local perturbations on the rest of the system. Using the quantum Wasserstein distance of order 1, we quantify how these perturbations propagate under the dynamics and derive contraction estimates in a high-temperature regime controlled by the maximum total interaction strength per site. These estimates require no assumptions on spatial geometry or graph growth and yield mixing times logarithmic in the system size and the inverse error tolerance, uniformly over all initial states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了通过满足Kubo--Martin--Schwinger (KMS) 细致平衡的Lindblad动力学，制备任意相互作用图（包括全连接系统）上两局域量子哈密顿量的吉布斯态。该方法基于经典Dobrushin条件的量子模拟，量化了局部扰动在动力学下如何传播。研究在高温度区域导出了收缩估计，并得到了对系统大小和逆误差容忍度呈对数关系的混合时间。
authors: Nicola Bertoni, Giacomo De Palma

articles.title: Fault-Tolerant Heisenberg-Limited Quantum Metrology with Bosonic Probes
articles.title_zh: 基于玻色子探针的容错海森堡极限量子计量学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40405v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum sensors have been shown to enable more precise measurements than classical sensors. By using entanglement and coherent evolution, the estimation error can be made to scale better in interrogation time, photon count, and other resources, achieving Heisenberg-limited scaling. However, environmental noise and hardware errors typically destroy the coherence of the sensitive quantum states. This motivates the use of fault-tolerant techniques to create more robust quantum sensing protocols. Such fault-tolerant quantum sensing approaches have been shown to enhance sensitivity for qubit systems, but many practical sensors require bosonic probes. In this paper, we propose a fault-tolerant protocol using bosons to estimate displacements in the presence of dephasing noise. We construct an optimal error-correcting code under a mean photon-number constraint. Controlled displacements couple the probe to a repetition-encoded qubit register, while repeated boson-parity measurements and resets remove probe noise without erasing the stored logical phase. Under circuit-level bit-flip noise, a distance-d code suppresses logical failures to order p⁽d⁺¹⁾/². We show that, for a decay rate γ_A, a total sensing time T and a mean photon number budget N, and for sufficiently small residual signals, the Fisher information scales as NT² over interrogation times of order γ_A⁻⁽d⁺¹⁾/². This is a significant improvement over the non-fault-tolerant approach that achieves Heisenberg scaling only for a total time mathcal O(γ_A⁻¹).
articles.abstract_zh: 量子传感器能实现比经典传感器更精确的测量，通过纠缠和相干演化可达到海森堡极限。然而，环境噪声和硬件错误通常会破坏敏感量子态的相干性。本文提出了一种使用玻色子探针在存在退相干噪声的情况下估计位移的容错协议，并构建了在平均光子数约束下的最优纠错码。该协议通过受控位移将探针耦合到重复编码的量子比特寄存器，并通过重复的玻色子奇偶校验测量和重置来消除探针噪声，同时保留存储的逻辑相位。
authors: Daniel G. Li, Lorcán O Conlon, Yu-Xin Wang, Erfan Abbasgholinejad, Twesh Upadhyaya, Alexey V. Gorshkov

articles.title: Lattice moments and quantum designs
articles.title_zh: 晶格矩与量子设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40481v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that the ensemble of unimodular Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill distributions fails to form a rigged quantum 3-design and quantify the replica defect that determines this failure. This is established by rederiving a second moment formula for symplectic lattices in a self-contained manner.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究表明，幺模Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill分布的集合未能形成一个严格的量子3-设计。我们量化了导致这种失败的副本缺陷，并通过自洽地重新推导辛格林晶格的二阶矩公式来确立这一结论。
authors: Jonathan Conrad, Kristian Holm

articles.title: Fast and accurate neural triage decoding of ultra-high-rate quantum LDPC codes
articles.title_zh: 超高速率量子LDPC码的快速准确神经分诊解码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40490v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum error correction is essential for fault-tolerant quantum computing. High-rate quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes have emerged as a promising approach to reducing the substantial physical qubit overhead of quantum error correction, enabling encoding rates exceeding 1/2 in blocks of approximately one thousand physical data qubits. However, their practical implementation requires decoders that combine high accuracy with low latency to keep pace with quantum hardware. Existing decoders of high-rate qLDPC codes can achieve high accuracy but often incur substantial computational latency, whereas neural network decoders have yet to be demonstrated for high-rate qLDPC codes. Here, we introduce emphneural triage decoding, a framework that uses syndrome consistency to adaptively allocate neural computation. A local neural message-passing network rapidly predicts error corrections, additional iterations reduce residual syndrome violations, and a rarely invoked diversification stage searches for consistent corrections to the remaining shots. We demonstrate that the textttTriage decoder can decode ultra-high-rate qLDPC codes encoding a few hundred logical qubits, including lifted-product and Kasai codes, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy comparable to the near optimal algorithmic decoders while reducing decoding latency by approximately one to two orders of magnitude. Our framework is inspired by a rigorous analysis of the exact bitwise marginal decoder, revealing a distance-independent syndrome-inconsistent error floor. In addition, we show the robustness of neural network decoders to mismatched error priors. Our results establish adaptive neural decoding as a promising route towards fast, accurate, and scalable quantum error correction in the near term.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子纠错对于容错量子计算至关重要，而高速率量子低密度奇偶校验（qLDPC）码有望减少物理量子比特开销。本文引入了一种名为“神经分诊解码”的框架，它利用综合征一致性自适应地分配神经计算资源。该解码器通过局部神经消息传递网络快速预测错误修正，并通过迭代和多样化阶段进一步减少残余综合征违规，从而实现对超高速率qLDPC码的快速准确解码。
authors: Hong-Ye Hu, Zhenlai Wang, Binzhao Luo, Tao Xiang, Chen Zhao

articles.title: Algebraic strong-to-weak symmetry breaking and partial decodability in the surface code
articles.title_zh: 表面码中的代数强弱对称破缺与部分可解码性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40567v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coherent noise can give rise to unconventional regimes of quantum information recovery and mixed-state order. We study these phenomena in two settings related by Wegner duality: the triangular-lattice surface code subject to single-qubit Pauli-Z rotations followed by syndrome measurements, and a Z₂ paramagnet subject to strongly symmetric decoherence. Increasing the rotation angle drives a transition from a decodable phase to a emphpartially decodable critical phase in the code, and from a strongly symmetric phase to a phase with emphalgebraic Z₂ strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SWSSB) in the dual paramagnet. We develop a common description of these phenomena in terms of a weakly coupled SO(n) nonlinear sigma model in the replica limit n→1. Taking this replica limit analytically, we derive universal signatures of the critical phase: an optimal Pauli decoding fidelity that approaches a universal function of the system's aspect ratio in the thermodynamic limit, and a dual fidelity correlator that decays as a universal power law. These observables relate to correlations of twist operators in the sigma model description. Large-scale numerical simulations confirm these analytical predictions. We also argue that the algebraic SWSSB phase cannot be realized by any Pauli dephasing channel acting on the Z₂ paramagnet. We probe this "non-classical" character through the output state's sensitivity to well-separated Z₂ fluxes inserted in the initial state, which reveals persistent coherence between distinct Z₂ charge trajectories at long distances.
articles.abstract_zh: 相干噪声可导致量子信息恢复和混合态序的非传统机制。本研究在与Wegner对偶性相关的两种设置中探讨了这些现象：受单量子比特泡利-Z旋转和综合征测量影响的三角晶格表面码，以及受强对称退相干影响的Z₂顺磁体。我们发现，增加旋转角度会驱动代码从可解码相变为部分可解码临界相，并在对偶顺磁体中从强对称相变为具有代数Z₂强弱自发对称破缺的相。研究还推导了临界相的普适特征，包括最优泡利解码保真度和对偶保真度关联器。
authors: Stephen W. Yan, Yimu Bao, Sagar Vijay

articles.title: Toric codes all the way down: decoupling translation-invariant topological CSS codes in higher dimensions
articles.title_zh: 高维平移不变拓扑CSS码的解耦：从头到尾的环面码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40592v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological Calderbank-Shor-Steane (CSS) codes in more than two spatial dimensions offer features useful for fault-tolerant quantum computation, such as transversal non-Clifford gates and single-shot decoding, but a systematic understanding of them is still lacking. One approach is to decouple a code: map it to a stack of higher-form toric codes by a finite-depth local CSS-preserving Clifford circuit, possibly after adding ancillas. For translation-invariant p-ary CSS codes, where p is prime (p=2 for qubits), we require the circuit to commute with the translations of a superlattice. In two dimensions, such a decoupling exists once these translations act trivially on every anyon type. In higher dimensions, excitations are sorted by their dimension into superselection layers, which can remain glued together even when translations act trivially on each layer. We show that this gluing is the only remaining obstruction: a code can be decoupled on a superlattice exactly when, after coarse-graining to it, translations act trivially on every layer and the gluing vanishes. Moreover, for a code with finitely many excitation types in each layer and m nonzero layers, once translations act trivially on every layer, further coarse-graining by a factor of pm⁻¹ in every direction removes the aforementioned gluing. Physically, the same criterion determines when the code encodes the maximal number of logical qudits on a finite torus. Finally, we give an explicit algorithm that constructs the decoupling as a circuit of SUM (qudit CNOT) and SWAP gates.
articles.abstract_zh: 高维拓扑Calderbank-Shor-Steane (CSS) 码为容错量子计算提供了有用的特性，但对其系统理解仍有欠缺。本文提出了一种解耦方法，即将代码通过有限深度局部CSS保持的Clifford电路映射到高阶环面码的堆栈。研究表明，当超晶格上的平移对每个层中的所有激发类型都作用平凡且胶合消失时，代码可以在超晶格上精确解耦。这一发现为理解和设计高维拓扑CSS码提供了系统性方法。
authors: Mingxin He, Yifei Wang, Hao Song, Yingfei Gu

articles.title: Long-Range Toric Code: Finite-Temperature Topological Order in Two Dimensions
articles.title_zh: 长程环面码：二维有限温度拓扑序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37765v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce two-dimensional toric code models with additional long-range loop interactions. Our models preserve the topologically ordered ground states of the ordinary toric code, while confining anyons at zero temperature. For sufficiently long-ranged interactions, we argue that this confinement persists at finite temperatures, strongly constraining anyon mobility and giving rise to finite-temperature topological order. This topological phase acts as a self-correcting quantum memory and exhibits long-range entanglement. For shorter-ranged interactions, signatures of topological order survive only up to an exponentially large length scale at finite temperature, yielding a partially self-correcting quantum memory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究引入了具有额外长程环相互作用的二维环面码模型。这些模型在零温度下保持了普通环面码的拓扑有序基态，同时限制了任意子。我们认为，对于足够长程的相互作用，这种限制在有限温度下仍然存在，从而强烈约束任意子迁移率并产生有限温度拓扑序。这种拓扑相可作为自纠正量子存储器并展现长程纠缠。
authors: Jacopo Gliozzi, Taylor L. Hughes, Kyung-Su Kim

articles.title: Parity-Resolved Many-Body Kinetics of a Topological Qubit under Nonequilibrium Phonon Pulses
articles.title_zh: 非平衡声子脉冲下拓扑量子比特的宇称分辨多体动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37793v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Phonon bursts from ionizing radiation cause correlated errors in superconducting quantum processors. We study prescribed nonequilibrium phonon pulses in a Majorana qubit formed by two 2,μm proximitized nanowires. Combining the lattice Lutchyn--Oreg model, microscopic electron--phonon coupling, and parity-resolved many-body dynamics, we track excitation, relaxation, and logical coherence. Without quasiparticle escape, recombination restores the initial Majorana occupations in about 130 ns, while phonons exchanged during excitation and recovery can retain logical-state information, leaving permanent coherence loss. For mirror-symmetric wires, the fractional coherence loss per wire is 0.75--1.0 times the excitation probability averaged over the two logical states, even at zero Majorana splitting; breaking mirror symmetry can suppress dephasing at small splitting. Factorized Boltzmann kinetics neglects quasiparticle correlations and overestimates residual parity flips. At equal deposited energy density, phonon spectra yield different excitation probabilities and coherence losses. Comparisons with Kitaev chains matched to the wire's gap and Majorana decay length reveal that low electron density suppresses excitation by energetic phonons, whereas hard-wall boundaries in a high-density control increase excitation efficiency by a factor of 5×10⁴ relative to the wire for pulses centered at 1 meV. Magnetic-field and chemical-potential tuning yield different phonon sensitivities at the same bulk gap through changes in spin and electron--hole structure. Including hybrid states' semiconductor weights reduces near-threshold excitation rates fourfold when the tunnel coupling equals the parent superconducting gap. Our framework connects phonon spectra to leakage, poisoning, and coherence loss to guide Majorana-device design.
articles.abstract_zh: 电离辐射产生的声子爆发会在超导量子处理器中引起关联错误。本研究通过结合晶格Lutchyn-Oreg模型、微观电子-声子耦合和宇称分辨多体动力学，研究了马约拉纳量子比特在非平衡声子脉冲下的激发、弛豫和逻辑相干性。结果表明，在没有准粒子逃逸的情况下，复合过程可在约130纳秒内恢复初始马约拉纳占据，但激发和恢复过程中交换的声子可能保留逻辑态信息，导致永久性相干性损失。研究还发现，镜像对称性破缺可以在小分裂时抑制退相干。
authors: Han Huang

articles.title: Coherent control and high purity single-photon emission from telecom quantum dots on metamorphic InGaAs
articles.title_zh: 电信波段量子点在变质InGaAs上的相干控制与高纯度单光子发射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38060v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Semiconductor quantum dots emitting in the telecommunication O- and C-bands are promising candidates as single-photon sources for fiber-based quantum communication. In this work, we show how coherent quasi-resonant and phonon-assisted excitation help reveal the intrinsic optical properties of InAs quantum dots embedded in relaxed InGaAs matrices on top of metamorphic InGaAs layers for achieving emission in the telecom bands. By systematically comparing excitation schemes, we separate excitation-induced effects from intrinsic emitter properties. This allows us to observe linewidths as narrow as 21 μeV, the disappearance of slow decay channels, and single-photon purity reaching second-order autocorrelation values in the order of 10⁻². Photoluminescence excitation reveals higher excited states, enabling coherent control of trion transitions and the observation of Rabi-like oscillations in both telecom bands. These results confirm the promising potential of these quantum dots for applications in quantum technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 在电信O-和C-波段发射的半导体量子点是光纤量子通信中单光子源的理想候选。本研究展示了如何通过相干准共振和声子辅助激发，揭示嵌入在变质InGaAs层上弛豫InGaAs基质中的InAs量子点的内在光学特性。通过系统比较激发方案，我们观察到窄至21μeV的线宽、慢衰减通道的消失以及达到10⁻²量级的二阶自相关值的单光子纯度。这些结果证实了这些量子点在量子技术应用中的巨大潜力。
authors: Beatrice Costa, Bianca Scaparra, Hubert Riedl, Gregor Koblmüller, Eugenio Zallo, Jonathan J. Finley, Lukas Hanschke, Kai Müller

articles.title: Tan's Contact for Trapped Spin-Orbit-Coupled Fermi Gases at Finite Temperature
articles.title_zh: 有限温度下囚禁自旋轨道耦合费米气体的Tan接触
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38512v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Tan's contact, bridging microscopic features of many-body quantum systems to two-body contact interactions, is pivotal in the description of quantum gases. However, past studies of Tan's contact of the spin-orbit coupled Fermi gases have been exclusively discussed at zero temperature. The thermal effects on that, which cannot be neglected in most experimental conditions, has not been explored so far. Here, through a path integral Monte Carlo (PIMC) study, we show that thermal effects fundamentally alter the scaling relation between spin-orbit coupling (SOC) and Tan's contact. The linear scaling of Tan's contact with respect to the strength of SOC found at zero temperature is drastically undermined by the thermal effects. And a new mechanism based on the competition between the mean occupancy and the energy-reweighted occupancy of the opposite spin fermion pairs within the interaction range has been unveiled, which radically changes the above linear scaling to a non-monotonic dependence. Our work should be useful for future experiments to explore the preternatural thermal effects on Tan's contact of the strongly interacting spin-orbit-coupled Fermi gas.
articles.abstract_zh: Tan接触在描述量子气体中至关重要，它连接了多体量子系统的微观特征与二体接触相互作用。以往对自旋轨道耦合费米气体Tan接触的研究仅限于零温度。本研究通过路径积分蒙特卡罗（PIMC）研究，揭示了热效应如何从根本上改变自旋轨道耦合（SOC）与Tan接触之间的标度关系。零温度下Tan接触与SOC强度之间的线性标度关系被热效应显著削弱，并揭示了一种基于平均占据和能量加权占据之间竞争的新机制，从而将线性标度转变为非单调依赖关系。
authors: Tianhao Wu, Yuanbang Wei, Rui Tian, Dongdong Pu, Beizhi Chen, Qihang Ying, Hongyan Shi, Yue Zhang, Shuai Li, Bo Liu

articles.title: Gravitational anomaly spectroscopy of a Kitaev spin liquid
articles.title_zh: Kitaev自旋液体的引力反常谱学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38704v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The chiral central charge c measures the gravitational anomaly of a two-dimensional topological phase. It fixes the heat current carried along the edge. So far, it has been accessed through thermal transport, where phonons complicate the signal, or through wave-function probes that need a pure ground state. Here we show that c is a spectroscopic quantity of the edge. A weak modulation of the edge couplings that travel along the edge is absorbed according to the Virasoro algebra. Normalized by the response to a static change of the same couplings, the absorbed weights obey Dₙ₌₂ₙłangle L₀ångle+fracc12(n³⁻ⁿ⁾, so that Cequiv2D₂₋₄D₁₌c in any state of the ideal edge theory, thermal or not. The central charge thus appears in transition weights, although it cancels from excitation gaps. The ratio of line weights with and without a vison in the bulk, Łambda=4h_σ/c, needs no calibration and fixes the conformal spin h_σ of the non-Abelian Ising anyon. For the Kitaev honeycomb spin liquid we find C=0.49999 and h_σ=0.06250 on 7168 spins. Calibrating with the shift of the measured line itself gives c within about 1% on 96 spins and within 1% under 20% random coupling errors. Interacting edge Majoranas in a fixed flux sector, treated with DMRG, keep C within 1.5% while the edge velocity changes by ±13%. An exact simulation of a quantum-processor protocol, including the native Floquet circuit, returns c within 3.5% on 96 to 600 spins.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性中心荷c衡量二维拓扑相的引力反常，并决定沿边缘传输的热流。本文表明c是边缘的谱学量，边缘耦合的微弱调制会根据Virasoro代数被吸收。通过对吸收权重的分析，可以从任何理想边缘理论状态中提取中心荷c。对于Kitaev蜂窝自旋液体，我们在7168个自旋上发现C=0.49999和h_σ=0.06250，进一步校准后，在96个自旋上c的测量精度在1%以内。
authors: Kumar Ghosh

articles.title: Mixed-State Topological Transition and Emergent Fractionalized Supersymmetry in the Non-Abelian Kitaev Spin Liquid
articles.title_zh: 非阿贝尔Kitaev自旋液体中的混合态拓扑相变与涌现分数量子超对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38741v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study a mixed-state topological transition in the non-Abelian Kitaev spin liquid driven by a bond-dephasing channel. In the vectorized picture, bond dephasing maps onto interactions between two time-reversed fractionalized Majorana systems coupled to gapped mathbb Z₂ gauge fields, enabling sign-problem-free Monte Carlo simulations. We show that increasing dephasing condenses an inter-copy fermion pair, converting m̊ Isingboxtimesøverlinem̊Ising to toric-code order in the Choi state and yielding intrinsically mixed-state topological order upon unfolding. More interestingly, at a temporal interface between topological and trivial Kitaev states, a Chern-number mismatch enforces a gapless Majorana mode. Dephasing then drives a mixed-state topological transition at which the gapless mode develops emergent mathcal N=1 supersymmetry. Our Monte Carlo simulations yield ν=1.27(3) and η_bsimeqη_fsimeq0.40, consistent with the exact supersymmetric values 5/4 and 2/5. The supersymmetric partners are fractionalized and appear physically as distinct gauge-invariant spin strings, providing concrete observables for future experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了由键退相干通道驱动的非阿贝尔Kitaev自旋液体中的混合态拓扑相变。我们发现，增加退相干会导致一个跨副本费米子对的凝聚，从而在Choi态中将Ising⊗Ising序转换为环面码序，并在展开后产生内在的混合态拓扑序。更重要的是，在拓扑态和平凡Kitaev态之间的时间界面处，陈数失配会强制产生一个无能隙的马约拉纳模式。退相干随后驱动混合态拓扑相变，在该相变点，无能隙模式发展出涌现的N=1超对称性。
authors: Zhou-Quan Wan, Hong Yao, Shao-Kai Jian

articles.title: An Eigenvector-Continued Green's Function Method
articles.title_zh: 一种本征向量延续的格林函数方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38780v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Emulating the Green's function using reduced-order equations is challenging because of the amount of information it contains. This information includes the one-particle spectroscopy over the entire energy spectrum, the one-body density matrix, and the ground-state energy. Nevertheless, the computational speedup offered by emulators is essential for applications requiring repeated model evaluations, which are ubiquitous in many-body physics. These include parameter calibration, uncertainty quantification, phase-diagram mapping, and geometry optimization. In this Letter, we introduce a systematically improvable emulator based on eigenvector continuation and moment-matching. The resulting approximation, which we refer to as an ``eigenvector-continued Green's function,'' can be obtained by solving linear equations, enabling an efficient separation of the computational workload into offline and online stages.
articles.abstract_zh: 使用降阶方程模拟格林函数具有挑战性，因为它包含大量信息，包括整个能谱上的单粒子谱学、单体密度矩阵和基态能量。本文介绍了一种基于本征向量延续和矩匹配的系统可改进模拟器，称之为“本征向量延续的格林函数”。这种近似可以通过求解线性方程获得，从而实现计算工作负载的离线和在线阶段的有效分离，为多体物理学中需要重复模型评估的应用提供了高效的解决方案。
authors: Stefano Brolli, Carlo Barbieri

articles.title: Dissipation dilution enhances SiV coupling to vdW diamond nanomechanics
articles.title_zh: 耗散稀释增强SiV与范德华金刚石纳米力学的耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39271v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Solid-state color centers embedded into mechanical resonators, where orbital states mediate interactions between spins and long-lived phonons, are a promising platform for hybrid quantum systems. The negatively charged silicon vacancy center in diamond (SiV-) is particularly favorable for strain-coupling to nanomechanical resonators because of its large spin-strain susceptibility and compatibility with device integration. Tensioned nanomechanical resonators offer an attractive route due to their ultra-long mechanical coherence times enabled by diluting defect-induced dissipation, though it is unclear if the same dilution effect undermines strain-mediated coupling to material defect centers. Here, we experimentally demonstrate a tensioned diamond nanobeam platform that enables enhanced strain coupling to SiV- orbital states. Through monitoring the optical response of the SiVs to the static and dynamical strain of the mechanical resonator, we observe that dynamical strain localizes near the clamps of these resonators under static strain. This allows us to enhance SiV-mechanical coupling and the mechanical coherence simultaneously, and provide a SiV-strain sensitivity with greatly improved accuracy over previous literature values. Thus, our work opens a pathway towards seconds-long coherence hybrid quantum systems utilizing point defects in diamond nanomechanics for quantum information processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 这项工作探讨了固态色心与机械谐振器耦合在混合量子系统中的应用。研究人员实验证明，张紧的金刚石纳米梁平台能够增强SiV-轨道态的应变耦合。通过监测SiV对机械谐振器静态和动态应变的响应，他们发现动态应变在静态应变下局域在谐振器夹具附近，从而同时增强了SiV-机械耦合和机械相干性。
authors: Guanhao Huang, Amberly Xie, Chang Jin, Evelyn Hu, Marko Lončar

articles.title: A Zoo of Fermionic Relative Rényi Negativities in the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev Models
articles.title_zh: Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev模型中费米子相对Rényi负性的“动物园”
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39349v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum entanglement is a fundamental resource that gives rise to correlations with no classical counterpart in strongly correlated fermionic systems. However, its characterization in mixed quantum states remains challenging. Established entanglement diagnostics, such as logarithmic negativity, are computationally demanding in interacting systems, and their evaluation by exact diagonalization is restricted to small system sizes. Meanwhile, conventional Rényi proxies, including twisted and untwisted Rényi negativities, can be positive even for separable states. In this work, we introduce a family of relative Rényi negativities that serve as entanglement witnesses. By relating fermionic partial time reversal to the size superoperator, we establish a path-integral representation for these Rényi negativities, enabling their evaluation in thermal states of the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model and its generalizations via a large-N expansion. Applying this method, we investigate entanglement in both the original SYK model and the Maldacena-Qi coupled SYK model. We identify a special class of relative Rényi negativities which serve as plausible proxies for logarithmic negativity and uncover first-order entanglement transitions that are invisible to simple observables. These results highlight the utility of relative Rényi negativities as probes of mixed-state entanglement in strongly correlated fermionic systems and suggest the existence of a new class of transitions where these negativities serve as free energies.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子纠缠在强关联费米子系统中至关重要，但其在混合量子态中的表征仍具挑战。本研究引入了一系列相对Rényi负性作为纠缠判据，解决了传统方法计算复杂且可能对可分离态给出正值的问题。通过将费米子部分时间反演与尺寸超算子关联，作者建立了这些Rényi负性的路径积分表示，并利用大N展开在Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 模型及其推广中进行了评估。
authors: Linjing Jiang, Pengfei Zhang

articles.title: Non-Bloch Dynamical Quantum Phase Transitions with Memory
articles.title_zh: 具有记忆的非布洛赫动力学量子相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39994v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Dynamical quantum phase transitions (DQPTs) of periodic chains are determined by real Bloch momenta. We identify non-Bloch DQPTs, which occur only in open chains and are determined by complex momenta instead. They arise in a Hermitian chain coupled to a simple substrate, whose memory is treated exactly, and originate from the point-gap winding number W of the projected propagator: for W≠0, open boundaries change both the dynamical free energy and the critical times, even in the thermodynamic limit. We find that both follow from an analytic continuation to complex momenta, and show that W can be measured by particle counting. This reveals a dynamical bulk-boundary correspondence, in which non-Hermitian topology emerges from Hermitian dynamics with memory.
articles.abstract_zh: 周期链的动力学量子相变（DQPTs）通常由实布洛赫动量决定。本研究识别出非布洛赫DQPTs，它们仅在开放链中发生，并由复动量决定。这些相变源于与简单基底耦合的厄米链，其记忆被精确处理，并由投影传播子的点隙缠绕数W引起。研究发现，当W≠0时，开放边界会改变动态自由能和临界时间，揭示了非厄米拓扑结构从具有记忆的厄米动力学中涌现的动态体边对应关系。
authors: Zhesen Yang, Wei-Wei Yang, Henning Schomerus, Jiangping Hu

articles.title: Bulk gap stability and spectral flow for fermions with weak long-range interactions
articles.title_zh: 弱长程相互作用费米子系统的体能隙稳定性与谱流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40299v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We prove that weak long-range many-body interactions preserve the bulk gap of a free fermion system and that a quasi-local spectral flow transports the free ground state to ground states of the interacting system. Let Φₕ be a free fermionic interaction, possibly including pairing terms, whose infinite-volume Majorana coefficient operator h has no spectrum in (-g,g), and let mathcal V be an even self-adjoint many-body interaction. For sufficiently small |łambda|, we construct pure ground states ømegałₐₘbdₐ of the interacting bulk system Φłₐₘbdₐ=Φₕ₊łambdamathcal V and quasi-local automorphisms β₀,łₐₘbdₐ such that ømegałₐₘbdₐ=ømega₀ᵢ̧rcβ₀,łₐₘbdₐ, where ømega₀ is the free ground state of Φₕ. Each ømega_łambda has a GNS Hamiltonian with gap at least g-C_*|łambda| |mathcal V|_*, where |ḑot|_* is the relevant interaction norm. Our result allows polynomial decay of both the free coefficients and the many-body interaction. For two-site interactions on a uniformly discrete point set ΓsubsetR^d, a sufficient condition is decay as (1+|x-y|)⁻ǎrpⁱ with ǎrpi>2d, for both the hopping and pairing coefficients and the interaction terms. The spectral-flow generator preserves the spatial exponent of the polynomial interaction norm, and its automorphisms satisfy locality bounds at that exponent. If h and mathcal V have stretched-exponential decay, so does the spectral-flow generator. The proof constructs the spectral flow and establishes the gap through an excitation-number comparison, using polynomial propagation bounds for evolved interactions proved in a companion paper.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了弱长程多体相互作用能保持自由费米子系统的体能隙，并且准局域谱流能将自由基态转化为相互作用系统的基态。研究构建了相互作用体系统的纯基态，并表明每个基态的GNS哈密顿量具有至少为g-C_*|λ| |V|_*的能隙。该结果适用于自由系数和多体相互作用均呈多项式衰减的情况，为理解具有长程相互作用的量子多体系统提供了理论基础。
authors: Stefan Teufel

articles.title: High-Fidelity Universal Quantum Gates in a Cryogenic Atom Array
articles.title_zh: 低温原子阵列中的高保真通用量子门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40329v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Neutral atoms in optical tweezer arrays have emerged as a leading platform for quantum information processing. The fidelity of entangling gates mediated by Rydberg interactions has improved rapidly and is increasingly constrained by blackbody-radiation-induced transitions, which shorten Rydberg lifetimes and create contaminant states that can cause correlated errors. Cryogenic environments can suppress these transition rates by more than an order of magnitude. However, realizing a universal gate set in such an environment has remained an outstanding challenge. Here, we demonstrate a universal quantum gate set in a cryogenic ¹³³Cs atom array, with a single-qubit gate fidelity of 99.970(2)% and a raw two-qubit entangling-gate fidelity of 99.76(8)%, within the range of leading room-temperature implementations. The entangling gate uses direct single-photon coupling between the electronic ground state and a Rydberg P state, avoiding scattering and light shifts associated with two-photon coupling. The gate operates at a modest Rabi frequency of 2π×4.3 MHz. The measured fidelity agrees with our error model dominated by atomic motion, indicating a straightforward route to higher fidelity through improved cooling, while the fundamental error contribution from Rydberg decay is below 3×10⁻⁴. These results establish a path to entangling-gate fidelities substantially beyond the current state of the art through cryogenic suppression of Rydberg decay, reducing the overhead for fault-tolerant computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 光学镊子阵列中的中性原子是量子信息处理的重要平台，但里德堡相互作用纠缠门的保真度受黑体辐射限制。本研究在低温¹³³Cs原子阵列中实现了通用量子门集，单量子比特门保真度达99.970(2)%，原始双量子比特纠缠门保真度达99.76(8)%。该纠缠门采用电子基态与里德堡P态之间的直接单光子耦合，避免了双光子耦合带来的散射和光频移，其保真度与原子运动主导的误差模型一致。
authors: Junlan Jin, Donghyuk Seo, Yue Shi, Yukai Lu, Jeff D. Thompson, Waseem S. Bakr

articles.title: Local determination of low-energy states in gapped fermion systems with weak long-range interactions
articles.title_zh: 弱长程相互作用有能隙费米子系统中低能态的局域确定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40337v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We consider bulk-gapped fermion systems whose infinite-volume bulk is obtained by adding sufficiently weak even many-body interactions to a free Hamiltonian with spectral gap g>0, allowing polynomial spatial decay of both parts. We prove quantitative local determination of low-energy states: whenever another interaction agrees with the bulk interaction inside a finite or infinite region U, with bulk terms crossing its boundary unchanged or removed, all its states with excitation energies in [0,3g/4] have local expectations close to those of the bulk ground state deep inside U. The error decays with the distance to the complement of U, independently of the interaction terms supported outside U and of the chosen low-energy state. Quantitative local determination has strong consequences. (i) The bulk interaction has a unique algebraic ground state. (ii) A strong "local perturbations perturb locally" (LPPL) principle holds: arbitrary distant defects change local ground-state expectations only by a spatially decaying error. (iii) Low-energy excitations in finite samples remain localized near the boundary for all times, up to spatially decaying tails, uniformly over arbitrary even boundary terms. (iv) Correlations from deep inside U to outside U are small, with quantitative bounds in terms of spatial separation and distance to U^c. To prove local determination of low-energy states, we combine quasi-adiabatic transport of the free ground state to the interacting bulk ground state with a new condition, local excitation detectability (LED). A companion paper establishes gap stability and constructs the transport for weak interactions, while we prove LED at sufficiently weak coupling. The abstract theorem is nonperturbative and applies whenever the transport and LED hypotheses hold.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有体能隙的费米子系统，证明了低能态的定量局域确定性。当另一个相互作用在有限或无限区域U内与体相互作用一致时，其所有激发能量在[0,3g/4]范围内的态，在U深处的局域期望值都接近体基态。这一结果表明体相互作用具有唯一的代数基态，并支持“局域扰动局域影响”原则，即远距离缺陷对局域基态期望值的影响呈空间衰减。
authors: Stefan Teufel

articles.title: Multidimensional revival dynamics in a bosonic many-body system
articles.title_zh: 玻色子多体系统中的多维复苏动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40353v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The collapse and revival of localized states in many-body systems is a quintessential example of a quantum interference phenomenon that cannot be explained purely within mean-field theories. Historically, the majority of previous work on quantum revivals has been in a Schrödinger mechanics context, typically for effectively 1D systems with a focus on the autocorrelation function as the key detection observable. The general revival subject acquires a far greater complexity in the bosonic many-body context that offers a larger variety of observables and intrinsically implies high dimensionality. Here, the focus is on the simplest nontrivial (i.e., not 1D) bosonic many-body system, namely a symmetric two-site Bose-Hubbard model. The non-equilibrium situation of a coherent initial state prepared on one of the two sites of this integrable 2D system in the strongly self-trapping regime is considered. The revival behaviors emerging from the resulting dynamics within expectation values, coherences, and the autocorrelation function are theoretically derived, and the entanglement behavior is illustrated. Several new features, unknown so far in the Schrödinger context and identified here in terms of five ``puzzles'', are encountered and discussed, among them, a synchronized resurgence behavior, differing revivals times depending on the specific observable, and a manifestation of a precession that appears in the underlying mean field dynamics. These new phenomena can be entirely understood through a comprehensive semiclassical theory, building upon the underlying classical (mean-field) phase-space structure. A quantitative comparison of the latter with semiclassical predictions and quantum perturbative calculations yields an overall excellent agreement and confirms that a full semiclassical theory is pivotal for the understanding of these genuinely quantum many-body interference phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 局域态的坍塌与复苏是量子干涉现象的典型例子，在玻色子多体系统中具有更高的复杂性。本研究聚焦于最简单的非平凡玻色子多体系统——对称双位Bose-Hubbard模型。在强自陷区域，作者理论推导了相干初态在其中一个位点上产生的期望值、相干性和自相关函数中的复苏行为，并阐明了纠缠行为。研究揭示了玻色子多体系统中一些迄今未知的多维复苏新特征。
authors: Denis Ullmo (LPTMS, Université Paris-Saclay / CNRS, Orsay), Steven Tomsovic (LPTMS, Université Paris-Saclay / CNRS, Orsay, Department of Physics and Astronomy, Washington State University, Pullman), Gabriel M. Lando (LPTMS, Université Paris-Saclay / CNRS, Orsay), Peter Schlagheck (CESAM research unit, University of Liege, Liege)

articles.title: Quasi-Phases of Quantum Matter
articles.title_zh: 量子物质的准相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40526v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Within quantum many-body phase diagrams, continuous transition lines can appear and then terminate. However, it has remained unclear whether the neighboring regimes can be meaningfully described as distinct phases, akin to water and vapour, since any sharp characterization would have to go beyond the usual notion of phases of matter. We answer this in the affirmative by introducing quasi-phases: gapped regimes near a critical point that are connected in the broader phase diagram, but not by any gapped path accessible from small perturbations of the critical theory. The physical consequences include interface modes between regimes in the same phase of matter. More striking still, describing both the extended critical line and the gapped path connecting the regimes requires a bigger multicritical parent theory. In spin-chain examples with continuous terminating lines with central charge c=1, we find multicritical c=3/2 and c=9/5 orbifolds describing so-called 'quotient symmetry protected' and 'representation symmetry protected' topological phenomena. While one-dimensional symmetry-protected topological phases are labeled by projective representation classes, these quasi-phases can have interface modes carrying higher-dimensional linear representations. We turn this into a constructive principle through a weakening of the Lieb-Schultz-Mattis anomaly. Supporting distinct quasi-phases makes an unnecessary critical point infrared-necessary, even if it is unnecessary at the ultraviolet scale. This condition is more restrictive than simply having a codimension-one critical line, revealing richer structure within phases of matter than their conventional classification suggests.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子多体相图中可能出现连续的相变线并终止，但其相邻区域是否能被描述为不同的相一直不明确。本研究引入了“准相”概念，即临界点附近的有能隙区域，它们在更广阔的相图中是连通的，但无法通过临界理论的小扰动可达的有能隙路径连接。物理后果包括同一物质相内不同区域之间的界面模式。研究发现，描述这些现象需要更大的多临界母理论，并在自旋链示例中发现了描述“商对称保护”和“表示对称保护”拓扑现象的多临界轨道形。
authors: Nick G. Jones, Paul Fendley, Nathanan Tantivasadakarn, Ruben Verresen

articles.title: Algebraic theory of abelian fractons and beyond
articles.title_zh: 阿贝尔分形子及更广范围的代数理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40596v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop an algebraic theory of fusion, mobility, and statistics in abelian gapped fracton orders and topological phases. The framework generalizes the algebraic description of abelian anyons to systems with restricted-mobility and spatially extended excitations. We consider translation-invariant bosonic systems whose pointlike and extended excitations have finite fusion order. The basic objects are braided fusion complexes (BFCs): chain complexes encoding fusion and mobility, equipped with a braiding chain map encoding statistics. Their equivalence classes define braided fusion theories (BFTs). Our framework encompasses arbitrary translation-invariant Pauli codes, as well as all abelian anyon theories in two spatial dimensions, including chiral theories. We give evidence for the conjecture that every nondegenerate BFT can be realized as the excitation theory of a gapped phase and that the BFT describing such a phase is a phase invariant. We derive constraints on pointlike fusion and mobility, showing, for example, that neither the Pauli X nor Z sectors of the X-cube and anisotropic models can occur alone in a nondegenerate BFT. For nondegenerate theories with only pointlike excitations, we extract a simpler theory of mutual statistics, consisting of a fusion module and a map to its statistical dual. This theory of mutual statistics is an invariant of the BFT and, at odd fusion order, gives an equivalent description of the full braided fusion theory. We interpret remote detection as the generalization of mutual statistics to fracton orders. In the BFC setting, we give a precise formulation of the excitation-detector principle: every nontrivial excitation can be detected by an operator supported at spatial infinity, and every nontrivial detector detects some excitation. Assuming a unique infinite-space ground state, we prove that this principle is equivalent to nondegeneracy.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文发展了一种描述阿贝尔有能隙分形子序和拓扑相中融合、迁移和统计的代数理论。该框架将阿贝尔任意子的代数描述推广到具有受限迁移和空间扩展激发的系统。研究引入了辫状融合复形（BFCs）作为基本对象，其等价类定义了辫状融合理论（BFTs）。该框架涵盖了任意平移不变的泡利码以及二维空间中的所有阿贝尔任意子理论，并为每个非退化BFT可作为有能隙相的激发理论的猜想提供了证据。
authors: Wilbur Shirley, Evan Wickenden, Bowen Yang, Agnès Beaudry, Michael Hermele

articles.title: Dissipative Dynamical Phase Transition as a Complex Ising Model
articles.title_zh: 作为复伊辛模型的耗散动力学相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2412.09591v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate a quantum dynamical phase transition induced by the competition between local unitary evolution and dissipation in a qubit chain with a strong, on-site Z₂ symmetry. While the steady-state of this evolution is always maximally-mixed, we show that the dynamical behavior of certain non-local observables on the approach to this steady-state is dictated by a quantum Ising model with a complex transverse-field (cTFIM). A crucial feature of our mapping to the cTFIM is an extensive number of local, weak, Z₂ symmetries possessed by the dynamics, allowing us to investigate these observables analytically and uncover a dynamical phase transition as the relative rate of unitary evolution and dissipation is tuned. We show that the weak-dissipation limit corresponds to a cTFIM with a large magnitude of the imaginary transverse-field, for which the many-body "ground-state" (with smallest real eigenvalue) is gapless, exhibiting quasi-long-range correlations of the local magnetization with a continuously-varying exponent. Correspondingly, the dynamics of the non-local observables show oscillatory behavior with an amplitude decaying exponentially in time. The strong-dissipation limit corresponds to a gapped ferromagnetic phase of the cTFIM, and non-local observables show exponential decay on the approach to equilibrium. This transition in (1+1)-dimensions has a peculiar, "two-sided" nature appearing as either first- or second-order depending on the phase from which the transition is approached, an analytic result which is corroborated by numerical studies. In higher dimensions, we present a field-theoretic understanding of the first-order nature of this transition, when approaching from the ferromagnetic phase of the cTFIM, though the nature of the phase with large imaginary transverse-field remains to be understood.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在具有强局域Z₂对称性的量子比特链中，局域幺正演化与耗散竞争引起的量子动力学相变。研究表明，某些非局域可观测量在趋近稳态时的动力学行为由一个具有复横场（cTFIM）的量子伊辛模型决定。通过将动力学映射到cTFIM，作者解析地揭示了一个动力学相变，并发现弱耗散极限对应于具有大虚横场幅度的cTFIM，其多体“基态”是无能隙的，表现出局域磁化准长程关联。
authors: Stephen W. Yan, Diego Barberena, Matthew P. A. Fisher, Sagar Vijay

articles.title: Genetic algorithm enhanced Solovay-Kitaev algorithm for quantum compiling of Fibonacci anyons
articles.title_zh: 遗传算法增强的Solovay-Kitaev算法用于斐波那契任意子的量子编译
articles.abstract: arXiv:2501.01746v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum compiling, which aims to approximate target qubit gates by finding optimal sequences (braidwords) of basic braid operations, constitutes a fundamental challenge in quantum computing. We develop a genetic algorithm (GA)-enhanced Solovay--Kitaev algorithm (SKA) for approximating single-qubit gates using four elementary braiding matrices (EBMs) derived from Fibonacci anyons. The GA-enhanced SKA demonstrates robust performance, efficiently identifying optimal braidwords within exponentially large search spaces. Notably, the approximation precision achieved by our method surpasses that of Monte Carlo (MC)-enhanced SKA and becomes comparable to deep reinforcement learning (RL) approaches when braidword lengths exceed 25. Implementing 2- and 3-order approximations with the GA-enhanced SKA yields optimal braidwords (with initial braiding lengths l₀ = 50 and l₀ = 30, respectively) achieving gate distances of 5.9 × 10⁻⁷ --- sufficient precision for most quantum computing applications. This work develops an optimized compilation framework for non-Abelian anyon gates, providing an essential methodology for enhancing future topological quantum computation architectures through gate optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子编译是量子计算中的一个基本挑战，旨在通过寻找基本编织操作的最优序列来近似目标量子比特门。本研究开发了一种遗传算法（GA）增强的Solovay-Kitaev算法（SKA），用于使用斐波那契任意子导出的四种基本编织矩阵来近似单量子比特门。GA增强的SKA表现出强大的性能，能够高效地在指数级大的搜索空间中识别最优编织词，其近似精度超越了蒙特卡洛增强的SKA，并与深度强化学习方法相媲美。
authors: Jiangwei Long, Xuyang Huang, Jianxin Zhong, Lijun Meng

articles.title: The construction of a universal quantum gate set for the SU(2)ₖ (k = 5,, 6,, 7) anyon models via genetic optimized algorithm
articles.title_zh: 通过遗传优化算法构建SU(2)ₖ (k = 5, 6, 7) 任意子模型的通用量子门集
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.01774v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We systematically study a numerical method for constructing a universal quantum gate set for topological quantum computation (TQC) using SU(2)ₖ anyon models. The F-matrices and R-symbols are computed through the q-deformed representation theory of SU(2), enabling precise determination of elementary braiding matrices (EBMs) for SU(2)ₖ anyon systems. Quantum gates are derived from these EBMs. One-qubit gates are synthesized using a genetic algorithm-enhanced Solovay--Kitaev algorithm (GA-enhanced SKA), while two-qubit gates are constructed through brute-force search or GA optimization to approximate the local equivalence class [CNOT]. Implementing this framework for the SU(2)₅, SU(2)₆, and SU(2)₇ models successfully generates the canonical universal gate set H-gate, T-gate, CNOT-gate. These numerical results provide conclusive verification of the universal quantum computation capabilities inherent in SU(2)ₖ anyon models. Furthermore, we obtain exact implementations of the local equivalence class [SWAP] using nine EBMs in each model.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统研究了一种利用SU(2)ₖ任意子模型构建拓扑量子计算通用量子门集的数值方法。通过q变形的SU(2)表示理论计算F矩阵和R符号，精确确定了SU(2)ₖ任意子系统的基本编织矩阵。研究利用遗传算法增强的Solovay-Kitaev算法合成单量子比特门，并通过蛮力搜索或GA优化构建双量子比特门。该框架成功为SU(2)₅、SU(2)₆和SU(2)₇模型生成了规范的通用门集，并提供了SU(2)ₖ任意子模型固有通用量子计算能力的验证。
authors: Jiangwei Long, Yizhi Li, Jianxin Zhong, Lijun Meng

articles.title: High-Fidelity Universal Quantum Gate Compilation for Non-semisimple Ising Anyons via Genetic Algorithm-Optimized Solovay-Kitaev Decomposition
articles.title_zh: 基于遗传算法优化Solovay-Kitaev分解的非半单Ising任意子高保真通用量子门编译
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.13194v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Non-semisimple Ising anyons extend the fusion space of conventional Ising models and offer a new route toward universal topological quantum computation (TQC). However, how to construct a high-fidelity universal quantum gate set that meets fault-tolerant thresholds via braiding operations of non-semisimple Ising anyons remains unexplored. By employing a Genetic Algorithm-enhanced Solovay--Kitaev Algorithm (GA-enhanced SKA), we achieve high-fidelity approximations of standard single-qubit gates (Hadamard H-gate and phase T-gate) with a recursion level of just three, meeting the fidelity requirements for fault-tolerant quantum computation. Our numerical results demonstrate that for the critical parameter range α in [2.001,, 2.022], a few braiding operations can approximate the local equivalence class [CNOT] with high precision. In contrast to prior theoretical works that established the universality of non-semisimple Ising anyons, this work provides the first complete, executable, and parameter-optimized compilation scheme for high-fidelity universal gates. It quantifies the relationship between the key physical parameter α and gate fidelity, and it delivers direct numerical evidence for the universality of non-semisimple Ising anyons.
articles.abstract_zh: 非半单Ising任意子为通用拓扑量子计算提供了新途径，但其高保真通用量子门集的构建仍是挑战。本研究采用遗传算法增强的Solovay-Kitaev算法，实现了标准单量子比特门的高保真近似，满足容错量子计算的保真度要求。数值结果表明，在特定参数范围内，少量编织操作即可高精度近似CNOT门。该工作首次提供了完整、可执行且参数优化的非半单Ising任意子高保真通用门编译方案。
authors: Jiangwei Long, Zihui Liu, Yizhi Li, Jianxin Zhong, Lijun Meng

articles.title: Ising Blockade of Resonant Transport in Dense Spin Ensembles
articles.title_zh: 密集自旋系综中谐振输运的Ising阻塞效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.04721v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Dense ensembles of nitrogen-vacancy (NV), substitutional-nitrogen (P1), and surface spins in diamond are leading platforms for quantum sensing, masers, and many-body physics, and in all of them polarization moves by resonant flip-flops (pairwise spin exchanges). We show that the Ising part of the dipolar Hamiltonian, which moves no polarization, sets how fast polarization moves. It detunes every flip-flop by exactly the difference of the Ising fields that the other spins exert on the pair, and these fields come from the very couplings that drive hopping. Dipolar transport thus throttles its own rate, an effect we call the Ising blockade, which models have so far absorbed into a measured or fitted disorder width. Deep in the blockade and at fixed composition, the diffusion constant scales as D propto J₀ₕ̊o¹/³ (coupling J₀, density h̊o) instead of the Förster-type J₀²h̊o⁴/³. Without fitting, the theory predicts the NV linewidth and all five P1 diffusion constants of [Nature 597, 45 (2021)] within 2σ; without the Ising term at the same couplings, it overshoots them five- to fifteenfold. On a spin-locked surface [Phys. Rev. Lett. 134, 050801 (2025)], the same blockade acts coherently: in exact dynamics, over a third of the spins stay polarized far longer than flip-flops alone allow, accounting for the measured four- to ninefold slowdown.
articles.abstract_zh: 金刚石中密集自旋系综是量子传感等领域的重要平台，其中极化通过谐振翻转-翻转机制移动。本研究揭示了偶极哈密顿量的Ising部分如何决定极化移动的速度，即通过Ising场使每个翻转-翻转过程失谐，从而抑制偶极输运，称之为Ising阻塞效应。该理论在不拟合的情况下，准确预测了NV线宽和P1扩散常数，显著优于不考虑Ising项的模型。
authors: Hong-Ze Ding, Jiu-Qing Liang

articles.title: Entropy Bounds via Hypothesis Testing and Its Applications to Two-Way Key Distillation in Quantum Cryptography
articles.title_zh: 基于假设检验的熵界及其在量子密码学双向密钥蒸馏中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.05870v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum key distribution (QKD) achieves information-theoretic security for a shared secret key, using distributed quantum states. To establish secret bits, two honest parties apply key distillation protocols to the resulting measurement outcomes.
