This bandlimit recasts exact gradient evaluation as a local signal recovery problem and, when the relevant frequencies lie on a known frequency lattice, yields an exact multipoint parameter-shift rule based on the discrete sine transform. The quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) provides a canonical realization in which this mechanism is governed by the local structure of the graph. Specifically, when a cost angle is varied, the relevant geometry is encoded by the contact region in the interaction line graph. At fixed circuit depth on graphs of bounded degree, the number of distinct circuit settings required for the corresponding derivative collapses from O(m) to O(1). This shows that dynamical locality is not merely a constraint on correlation propagation, but also a computational resource that enables exact gradient evaluation with fewer circuit settings in quantum optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 动态局部性虽然常被视为浅层量子电路的局限，但本文证明其能减少精确评估共享参数梯度所需的电路设置数量。对于由可交换局部项生成的层状拟设，严格的海森堡光锥将能量切片限制在有限傅里叶带宽内。这种带宽限制将精确梯度评估重构为局部信号恢复问题，并导出了基于离散正弦变换的精确多点参数位移规则，从而在固定电路深度下将所需电路设置数量从O(m)降至O(1)。
authors: Zhaoyang Song, Wei Zhang, Ji Cao, Xuexi Yi, Hong-Fu Wang

articles.title: Einstein Metrics and Quantum Control on Symmetric Tensor Product Quotients
articles.title_zh: 对称张量积商上的爱因斯坦度量与量子控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38340v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Let Mₙ₌₍PU(2)ⁿt̊imes Sₙ₎backslashPU(2ⁿ⁾ be the space of projective n-qubit unitaries modulo local unitaries and permutations of the qubits. We prove that for all sufficiently large n the manifold Mₙ carries exactly two PU(2ⁿ⁾⁻ⁱⁿvariant Einstein metrics up to scaling. Both Einstein metrics have uniformly bounded diameter after normalizing two-qubit costs, although approximating a Haar-random unitary requires exponentially many two-qubit gates. In contrast, we construct non-Einstein metrics with nonnegative Ricci curvature and exponentially growing typical control distances, and determine the sharp curvature threshold for this family.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了投影n量子比特酉算子模局部酉算子和量子比特排列的空间Mₙ。研究证明，对于所有足够大的n，流形Mₙ在缩放意义下恰好承载两个PU(2ⁿ)不变的爱因斯坦度量。这两个爱因斯坦度量在归一化双量子比特成本后具有一致有界直径。此外，本文还构建了具有非负Ricci曲率和指数增长典型控制距离的非爱因斯坦度量，并确定了该族的尖锐曲率阈值。
authors: Honghuai Fang

articles.title: Symmetry-Preserving Hierarchical Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm with Subproblems Beyond the Qubit Limit
articles.title_zh: 对称性保持的分层量子近似优化算法，其子问题超越了量子比特限制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38344v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) is a paradigmatic variational quantum algorithm for combinatorial optimization problems, yet on current quantum devices the available qubit count and achievable circuit depth remain the main bottlenecks to its practical application. Divide-and-merge reduces the number of variables encoded in a single quantum circuit, while contraction based on coarse graining extends the effective range of shallow circuits, but existing work has not addressed both challenges simultaneously. We propose symmetry-preserving hierarchical QAOA (SP-HQAOA), in which parity sector contraction preserves the zero-field Ising structure of the effective objective at every contraction step, thereby addressing both within a single algorithm. We further prove that this reduction is the unique one with this property. Successive contractions further decouple the maximum leaf block size B from the qubit limit Q per quantum call, so every quantum circuit uses at most Q qubits even when B>Q. We also establish a deterministic repair-risk bound on the possible loss in optimal value caused by each sector restriction, and the resulting bounds can be summed across contraction steps and levels of the recursive hierarchy. With depth p=1, SP-HQAOA attains 99.4% to 99.7% of the exact optimum on N=40 random regular MaxCut leaf blocks and, with at most 10 qubits per circuit, 96% of the classical reference for N=500. SP-HQAOA demonstrates the capacity to use shallow quantum circuits to address combinatorial optimization problems whose variable count far exceeds the qubit limit of a single quantum call, and may enable practical quantum optimization advantages in the near term.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对量子近似优化算法（QAOA）在量子设备上受限于量子比特数量和电路深度的问题，本文提出了一种对称性保持的分层QAOA（SP-HQAOA）。该算法通过宇称扇区收缩在每个收缩步骤中保留有效目标函数的零场伊辛结构，从而同时解决了变量编码和浅层电路有效范围扩展的挑战。SP-HQAOA能够将最大叶块大小B与每次量子调用的量子比特限制Q解耦，即使B>Q，每个量子电路也最多使用Q个量子比特。
authors: Zhaoyang Song, Wei Zhang, Ji Cao, Xuexi Yi, Hong-Fu Wang

articles.title: Quantum change point metrology
articles.title_zh: 量子变点计量学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38345v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We quantify the extra Bayes risk of locating a quantum change point and estimating its amplitude with one measurement. The joint and marginal optimizations use the full record and the same joint prior, with both parameters unknown. For product records on a known pure state curve, position has clipped absolute loss in resolution units, and amplitude offset has squared loss in fixed calibrated units. Ideal steps exhibit certified conflict at finite signal strength, including in phase records of sixteen qubits, and recover both informative marginal optima at strong signal. For finite offset prior width, a retained quantum boundary region serves position, and the remaining suffix serves amplitude. Physical recovery holds when strength grows more slowly than the square root of record length. Known smooth rises also admit leading recovery in the coherent experiment as strength grows and width shrinks. For the quintic profile, we establish two residual cost scaling laws. The residual cost is Θ(s⁻²) as s→infty. Taking the strong signal limit at fixed w yields a limiting cost of Θ(w³⁾ as w→0. In the resolved local model, quadratic position loss admits a common optimum within the covariant class. These results link onset geometry and decision loss to Bayesian measurement compatibility in quantum change point estimation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文量化了在一次测量中定位量子变点并估计其幅度的额外贝叶斯风险。研究发现，对于已知纯态曲线上的乘积记录，理想阶跃在有限信号强度下表现出确定的冲突，并在强信号下恢复信息丰富的边际最优值。对于有限偏移先验宽度，保留的量子边界区域用于定位，其余部分用于幅度估计。研究还为五次剖面建立了两种残余成本标度律，揭示了量子变点计量在不同信号强度和先验宽度下的性能。
authors: Xu Chen, Xue Ma

articles.title: Spectral Reduction Selects the Observable Imprint of Dirac Quantum Geometry
articles.title_zh: 谱约化选择狄拉克量子几何的可观测印记
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38379v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spectral constraints can alter the observable manifestation of quantum geometry without changing the local eigenspace. Relativistic electron vortices provide a sharp example: the spin orbit interaction redistributes spin and orbital angular momentum, yet its magnetic contribution differs between localized three-dimensional wave packets and stationary monochromatic beams. We resolve this discrepancy by showing that fixing the energy replaces ambient momentum derivatives in position-weighted current moments by shell-tangent derivatives and derive a Hermitian selection rule for first-order observables in momentum-dependent internal subspaces. Its extension-independent form applies beyond Dirac systems, including a broad class of antisymmetric first moments of scalar-charge velocity currents. For the free positive-energy Dirac doublet, the magnetic correction is an exact non-Abelian Berry-curvature contraction with a pointwise saturable quantum-metric bound. Changing the relative phase between the two σ_z spinor components switches this correction from zero in a conserved transverse-helicity sector to a finite value in a radial coherent superposition. At fixed finite Lorentz factor, the radial response scales as O(θ/γ), compared with O(θ²⁾ for longitudinal polarization. Spectral reduction and internal coherence thus provide distinct controls of the observable imprint of quantum geometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 谱约束可以在不改变局部本征空间的情况下，改变量子几何的可观测表现。本文通过证明固定能量可以将位置加权电流矩中的环境动量导数替换为壳切线导数，解决了相对论电子涡旋中自旋轨道相互作用磁贡献的差异。研究推导了一个动量相关内部子空间中一阶可观测量的厄米选择规则，并发现对于自由正能量狄拉克双峰，磁修正是一个精确的非阿贝尔贝里曲率收缩。
authors: Zhongze Guo, Bei Xu, Qiang Gu

articles.title: Fermionic Unruh effect revisited: Entanglement and correlation dynamics under symmetric transformations
articles.title_zh: 费米子Unruh效应再探：对称变换下的纠缠与关联动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38387v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A uniformly accelerated observer perceives the Minkowski vacuum as a thermal bath, so acceleration acts as a noise channel on correlations shared with an inertial partner. For a Dirac field in the standard treatment, the resulting map is a one-sided amplitude-damping channel, and entanglement and quantum discord survive at infinite acceleration. We introduce a symmetric Unruh-like map in which the vacuum and the one-particle state both exchange amplitude with the inaccessible Rindler region; for a Bell state it yields a bit-flip channel whose flip probability is the Fermi-Dirac occupation at the Unruh temperature. Using negativity, mutual information, and all six pairwise quantum discords, we find that the entanglement and discord between the inertial observer and the accessible mode vanish together at infinite acceleration, leaving only one bit of classical correlation. These results show that the fate of quantum correlations in noninertial frames depends on the structure of the Minkowski-Rindler map.
articles.abstract_zh: 均匀加速观测者将闵可夫斯基真空视为热浴，加速度对与惯性伙伴共享的关联产生噪声。本文引入了一种对称的类Unruh映射，其中真空态和单粒子态都与不可访问的Rindler区域交换幅度。研究发现，在这种对称映射下，惯性观测者与可访问模式之间的纠缠和量子失谐在无限加速度下同时消失，仅剩一位经典关联。这些结果表明，非惯性系中量子关联的命运取决于闵可夫斯基-Rindler映射的结构。
authors: Omid Yahyayi Monem, Hosein Mohammadzadeh

articles.title: Robustness of Magic and the Directed Geometry of State Conversion
articles.title_zh: 魔法的鲁棒性与状态转换的定向几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38401v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we introduce a state-space distance calibrated by stabilizer states based on the dual structure of the robustness of magic (RoM), and show that RoM is exactly represented as the distance to the free-state set. We then extend this geometry to state conversion by defining the directed conversion deficiency Cₘₐₜₕcₐₗ F as the distance between a target state and the set of states freely reachable from a given input state. The quantity Cₘₐₜₕcₐₗ F characterizes free convertibility and is related to the minimum stabilizer quasiprobability weight required to represent the conversion residual through the relation 1+2Cₘₐₜₕcₐₗ F. It also contains the conventional magic state resource lower bounds based on RoM and can detect stronger conversion obstructions. For single-qubit systems, we analytically construct a continuous family of mixed states with identical RoM but asymmetric convertibility.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于魔法鲁棒性（RoM）的双重结构，引入了一种由稳定器态校准的状态空间距离，并证明RoM精确地表示为到自由态集合的距离。研究将这种几何扩展到状态转换，定义了定向转换缺陷C_F，它表征了自由可转换性。C_F与表示转换残差所需的最小稳定器准概率权重相关，并且可以检测更强的转换障碍。对于单量子比特系统，研究构建了一族具有相同RoM但不对称可转换性的混合态。
authors: Satoshi Kanno, Yoshi-aki Shimada

articles.title: Harnessing Non-Markovian Memory for Quantum-Battery Capacity
articles.title_zh: 利用非马尔可夫记忆提升量子电池容量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38527v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Non-Markovianity is commonly characterized through information-theoretic signatures of memory. Here we take a thermodynamic perspective and ask whether such memory can be operationally harnessed to enhance quantum-battery capacity. Within the process-tensor framework, we compare memoryless and memory-enhanced strategies and define their performance gap as the memory-assisted capacity advantage of a multitime process. We prove that this advantage vanishes for Markovian process tensors and is bounded by a trace-distance measure of process non-Markovianity. In a complementary continuous-time setting, we show using random telegraph dephasing that memory accumulated during the evolution can enhance capacity retention relative to a matched Markovian reference under the same control class. These results identify non-Markovian memory as an operational resource for quantum-battery capacity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从热力学角度探讨了非马尔可夫记忆是否能用于提升量子电池容量。在过程张量框架下，研究比较了无记忆和记忆增强策略，并将它们的性能差距定义为多时间过程的记忆辅助容量优势。结果表明，这种优势对于马尔可夫过程张量会消失，并受限于过程非马尔可夫性的迹距离度量。这些发现将非马尔可夫记忆识别为量子电池容量的一种操作资源。
authors: Jun-Li Jiang, Xin-Zhu Liu, Xiu-Yong Ding, Xue Yang, Ming-Xing Luo

articles.title: Coherent errors, syndrome extraction and the Robustness of Magic in stabiliser codes
articles.title_zh: 稳定器码中的相干误差、综合征提取与魔法的鲁棒性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38554v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coherent errors leave stabiliser-code-encoded magic states in superpositions of syndrome sectors. We ask how much magic these coherent errors add, and whether syndrome extraction depletes logical magic. Using Robustness of Magic, we show that, for a unitary error U on a correctable region which supports no stabiliser, the encoded state has the same robustness as the logical state plus one copy of the Choi state of U , in every stabiliser code encoding. Syndrome extraction removes this copy, returning the logical robustness. The removed magic is positive for every non-Clifford error: adding a non-stabiliser state to any state multiplies one plus the robustness by a (tightly- bounded) factor above one. The magic capacity of two-qubit gates Clifford-equivalent to diagonal or single-qubit gates is equal to their Choi-state robustness. We give a linear-algebraic test for when a Clifford error makes syndrome extraction measure a logical operator, and give magic lifetimes of stored single-qubit magic states under Pauli noise. Choosing the plane of the stored state extends these lifetimes about 1.5x on rotated surface codes under low code-capacity depolarising noise. We identify states and channels in odd-prime dimension for which Wigner negativity and robustness show equal lifetimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 相干误差会使稳定器码编码的魔法态处于综合征扇区的叠加态中。本文利用魔法的鲁棒性（RoM）研究了相干误差对魔法态的影响以及综合征提取是否会耗尽逻辑魔法。研究表明，对于可纠正区域上的酉误差U，编码态的鲁棒性等于逻辑态加上U的Choi态的鲁棒性，且综合征提取会移除这部分额外的魔法。此外，研究还提供了一个线性代数测试，用于判断Clifford误差何时使综合征提取测量逻辑算符，并给出了在泡利噪声下存储单量子比特魔法态的魔法寿命。
authors: Enrico Bozzetto, Jonte R. Hance

articles.title: Learning Grover mixers for constrained optimization
articles.title_zh: 学习Grover混合器用于约束优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38572v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Grover-Mixer QAOA (GM-QAOA) is a promising quantum framework for constrained combinatorial optimization. However, its practical implementation requires the efficient preparation of a uniform superposition over feasible states. In this work, we propose a two-stage variational approach. First, a parameterized quantum circuit is trained to prepare this superposition, using an entropy-based cost function that favors a uniform distribution over feasible bitstrings. The trained circuit is then embedded in GM-QAOA, where it provides both the initial state and, together with its inverse, yields the Grover mixer. The resulting method is evaluated on two representative benchmark problems: the Maximum Weight Independent Set (MWIS) problem and the Multidimensional Knapsack Problem (MKP). While the results demonstrate consistent improvements over standard QAOA for MWIS, only marginal gains are observed for MKP, with the advantage diminishing as the problem size increases. The reduced performance on MKP reflects the growing difficulty of training the variational mixer, likely due to increasingly challenging optimization landscapes. Overall, these findings highlight both the potential of variational Grover mixers and the trade-off between their performance gains and the additional resources required for their training.
articles.abstract_zh: Grover-Mixer QAOA（GM-QAOA）是解决约束组合优化问题的有前景的量子框架，但其实现需要高效制备可行态的均匀叠加。本文提出了一种两阶段变分方法：首先训练参数化量子电路以制备均匀叠加态，然后将其嵌入GM-QAOA中作为初始态和Grover混合器。该方法在最大权独立集问题上表现出优于标准QAOA的改进，但在多维背包问题上增益有限，且随问题规模增大而减小，这反映了变分混合器训练难度增加。
authors: Matteo Vandelli, Francesco Ferrari, Daniele Dragoni

articles.title: Pulse-Informed Physical Placement for Parallel Two-Qubit Gates in Qubit Arrays
articles.title_zh: 量子比特阵列中并行双量子比特门的脉冲感知物理布局
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38604v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A parallel two-qubit layer can often be realized with several nonoverlapping sets of physical couplers, but isolated calibrations do not reveal how each realization performs after optimizing its own simultaneous control pulse. We formulate physical placement and pulse synthesis as a coupled decision problem for parallel controlled-Z gates in heterogeneous frequency tunable transmon arrays. The proposed processor-aware structural quantum multi-domain matrix (QMDM) links static processor, edge, incidence, and task information to a dynamic candidate response block. For each candidate placement P, QMDM instantiates the active Hamiltonian H_P; quantum optimal control (QOCT) generates a placement-specific pulse, direct coupled propagation returns the projected computational subspace overlap Fₘ̊ ₚᵣₒⱼ and computational survival; and these pulse-conditioned responses are fed back to QMDM to rank and progressively promote physical placements. This placement pulse response feedback defines pulse-informed physical placement. Here, to see the performance of the proposed method on 30 held-out synthetic 3×3 processors, the median final Fₘ̊ ₚᵣₒⱼ is 0.993826 for pulse-informed placement and 0.984981 for calibration-based placement. Also, when tested under different system conditions, the proposed pulse-informed approach uses 59.1% fewer candidate QOCT optimizer iterations than the exhaustive finite-budget reference. The QMDM representation and outer search are formulated for arbitrary L simultaneous two-qubit gates. Here, the present global candidate ranking validation is used for L=2.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将物理布局和脉冲合成公式化为异构频率可调超导量子比特阵列中并行受控-Z门的耦合决策问题。提出的处理器感知结构化量子多域矩阵（QMDM）将处理器信息与动态候选响应块关联起来。通过量子最优控制（QOCT）为每个候选布局生成特定脉冲，并将其性能反馈给QMDM进行排名和优化，从而实现了脉冲感知的物理布局。该方法在30个合成3x3处理器上的中值最终Fₚᵣₒⱼ为0.9997。
authors: Shahid Qamar, Wei-Feng Zhuang, Bilal Riaz, Peng Qian

articles.title: Quantum Gate Engineering in Superconducting NISQ Platforms: Experimental Methods and Emerging Directions
articles.title_zh: 超导NISQ平台中的量子门工程：实验方法与新兴方向
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38635v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This review aims to provide researchers, experimentalists, and quantum engineers with an updated and technically grounded perspective on the implementation of quantum gates in superconducting NISQ devices. The goal is to establish a comprehensive bridge between theoretical quantum circuit synthesis and its practical, experimental implementation, focusing on superconducting quantum technologies. We systematically examine the diverse landscape of superconducting qubits and processor architectures, ranging from conventional transmons to alternative and unconventional designs, evaluating their unique design trade-offs, connectivity constraints, device physics, and materials impact. Moving from theory to actual implementation, we detail how single- and two-qubit operations are synthesized via microwave-driven and flux-activated pulses. We here present our pulse engineering, wave shaping, calibration workflows, demonstrating how to bridge the gap between abstract gate models and real-world hardware limitations in the direction of a hardware-software co-design framework. To validate these operations, we choose benchmarking methodologies with the purpose to get the more efficient metric for the specific evaluation aspect, including truth tables and quantum process tomography. Therefore, we both discuss the theoretical concepts behind the gate synthesis and show experimental implementation of most fundamental gates by proposing a practical workflow.
articles.abstract_zh: 本综述旨在为研究人员、实验人员和量子工程师提供关于超导NISQ设备中量子门实现的最新技术视角。文章系统地考察了超导量子比特和处理器架构的多样性，并详细介绍了如何通过微波驱动和磁通激活脉冲合成单量子比特和双量子比特操作。通过展示脉冲工程、波形整形和校准工作流程，本综述旨在弥合抽象门模型与实际硬件限制之间的鸿沟，推动硬件-软件协同设计框架的发展。
authors: Alessandro Sarno (Dipartimento di Fisica 'Ettore Pancini', Università degli Studi di Napoli 'Federico II', Via Cinthia, 80126, Napoli, IT), Viviana Stasino (Dipartimento di Fisica 'Ettore Pancini', Università degli Studi di Napoli 'Federico II', Via Cinthia, 80126, Napoli, IT), Antonio Pio Italiano (Dipartimento di Fisica 'Ettore Pancini', Università degli Studi di Napoli 'Federico II', Via Cinthia, 80126, Napoli, IT), Alessandra Pizza (Dipartimento di Fisica 'Ettore Pancini', Università degli Studi di Napoli 'Federico II', Via Cinthia, 80126, Napoli, IT), Carlo Cosenza (Dipartimento di Fisica 'Ettore Pancini', Università degli Studi di Napoli 'Federico II', Via Cinthia, 80126, Napoli, IT), Wladislav Guarino (Dipartimento di Fisica 'Ettore Pancini', Università degli Studi di Napoli 'Federico II', Via Cinthia, 80126, Napoli, IT), Domenico Montemurro (Dipartimento di Fisica 'Ettore Pancini', Università degli Studi di Napoli 'Federico II', Via Cinthia, 80126, Napoli, IT), Francesco Tafuri (Dipartimento di Fisica 'Ettore Pancini', Università degli Studi di Napoli 'Federico II', Via Cinthia, 80126, Napoli, IT), Davide Massarotti (Dipartimento di Ingegneria Elettrica e delle Tecnologie dell'Informazione, Università degli Studi di Napoli Federico II, Via Claudio 21, 80125, Napoli, IT), Halima Giovanna Ahmad (Dipartimento di Fisica 'Ettore Pancini', Università degli Studi di Napoli 'Federico II', Via Cinthia, 80126, Napoli, IT)

articles.title: Quenched Thermodynamics from Ancilla-Assisted Imaginary-Time Evolution
articles.title_zh: 基于辅助量子比特虚时间演化的淬火热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38707v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quenched thermodynamics combines the equilibrium physics of fixed coupling configurations with a prescribed distribution of disorder. Problems related to quenched thermodynamics are generally intractable to approximate. We provide a quantum algorithm to calculate quenched disorder averages for the transverse-field Ising model, whose coupling configurations are organized into gauge classes. We show how to estimate these averages by preparing approximate Gibbs states through ancilla-assisted imaginary-time evolution. At each measurement, the ancilla record identifies the gauge class to which the energy estimate contributes. We validate our framework through an open 3×3 lattice. A one-step circuit resolves all sixteen flux classes, and a finite-shot calculation estimates the quenched energy for independently distributed bond signs. Thermodynamic integration extends the reconstruction to a quenched free-energy estimate, while comparison with exact diagonalization identifies the finite-step approximation as the dominant source of error. This use of the measurement record provides access to the thermodynamics of frustrated spin systems with a disorder distribution chosen independently of the circuit's sampling frequencies.
articles.abstract_zh: 淬火热力学问题通常难以近似求解。本文提出了一种量子算法，用于计算横场伊辛模型中淬火无序平均值，其耦合配置被组织成规范类。通过辅助量子比特虚时间演化制备近似吉布斯态，可以估计这些平均值。该框架在一个开放的3x3晶格上得到验证，单步电路可以解析所有十六个通量类，并估计淬火能量。
authors: Ibukunoluwa Adisa, Daniele Cuomo

articles.title: Generating Multipartite Entanglement via Structured-Bath Engineering
articles.title_zh: 通过结构化浴工程生成多体纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38807v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present how to dissipatively prepare genuinely multipartite-entangled steady states with mutually independent local reservoirs by harnessing an Abelian strong symmetry and temporal bath correlations. In interacting Ising chains, we demonstrate that, for a broad class of system-environment couplings, flat baths exponentially erase Ising-axis correlations. Structured baths overcome this obstruction by converting temporal bath correlations into classical spatial correlations. Strong symmetry then promotes these correlations to the quantum domain, enabling global multipartite entanglement. Within weak-coupling theory, we obtain exact steady states despite the generator's nonquadratic nature: strong symmetry reduces their construction to a classical problem for arbitrary Ising couplings. This reduction reveals an exact connection between classical distinguishability and entanglement. We then show how to engineer the bath spectrum to increase the correlation length and enable the preparation of GHZ-like states from separable initial conditions. We test the mechanism beyond the analytical regime using exact Markovian embeddings and tensor-network simulations. Our approach is particularly suited to superconducting and trapped-ion platforms, and we propose a concrete implementation for the latter using sympathetically cooled motional modes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了如何通过利用阿贝尔强对称性和时间浴关联，耗散地制备具有相互独立局部储层的真正多体纠缠稳态。在相互作用的伊辛链中，结构化浴通过将时间浴关联转换为经典空间关联来克服平坦浴对伊辛轴关联的指数擦除。强对称性进一步将这些关联提升到量子领域，从而实现全局多体纠缠。研究还展示了如何设计浴谱以增加关联长度，并从可分离的初始条件制备GHZ类态。
authors: Baptiste Debecker, Philipp Westhoff, Visal So, Sebastian Paeckel, Guido Pagano, John Martin, Mattia Moroder, François Damanet

articles.title: Key Evaluation of a Relativistic Quantum Key Distribution Over a Turbulent Free-space Optical Channel
articles.title_zh: 湍流自由空间光信道上相对论量子密钥分发的关键评估
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38808v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the performance of relativistic quantum key distribution (RQKD) over turbulent free-space optical channels for both single-photon and coherent-state implementations. A theoretical model is developed to describe the effect of atmospheric turbulence on interferometric visibility and secret-key generation by incorporating turbulence-induced phase fluctuations into the key-rate analysis. Numerical simulations are performed under realistic channel conditions to evaluate the achievable communication distance and secret-key rate. The results show that atmospheric turbulence degrades the protocol performance by reducing interference visibility, with the severity of the degradation determined by the ratio between the interferometer-arm separation r (or temporal separation of signal and reference states Δ T) and Fried's parameter. The single-photon protocol remains operational over all investigated turbulence regimes, whereas the coherent-state implementation exhibits a critical dependence on the interferometer geometry (especially on Δ T), leading to a threshold beyond which secure key generation is no longer possible. These findings quantify the impact of atmospheric turbulence on relativistic quantum key distribution and provide practical guidelines for the design and optimization of free-space RQKD systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在湍流自由空间光信道中，单光子和相干态实现下的相对论量子密钥分发（RQKD）性能。通过将湍流引起的相位波动纳入密钥率分析，建立了描述大气湍流对干涉可见度和秘密密钥生成影响的理论模型。数值模拟结果表明，大气湍流通过降低干涉可见度来降低协议性能，其中单光子协议在所有湍流条件下均可运行，而相干态实现则对干涉仪几何结构表现出临界依赖性。
authors: G. Bebrov

articles.title: Memory-Induced Limits on Entanglement Distribution
articles.title_zh: 记忆引起的纠缠分发限制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38817v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the operational limits of entanglement distribution through quantum channels reused without reinitialization. Building on an effective repeated-use channel description, we show that residual excitations left in the channel from previous uses act as a memory source that progressively suppresses coherent quantum transmission. To quantify this limitation, we derive an analytical lower bound on the quantum capacity and combine it with the Holevo-Werner semidefinite-programming upper bound. We also provide an analytical criterion to identify entanglement-breaking channels, with thresholds that depend jointly on chain length and reuse. For perfect-state-transfer chains, the resulting capacity window yields tighter estimates than previous bounds, with the relative improvement becoming substantially more pronounced closer to the entanglement-breaking threshold. Moreover, on the second use, our lower bound certifies a maximal relative timing-error tolerance across all chains with internal memory that lies just below 22.63% and is attained by the three-site chain. We further derive a fundamental relative timing-error threshold of 36.41%, above which we analytically guarantee zero unassisted quantum capacity for every chain with internal memory, independent of the number of uses. These results establish a clear benchmark model for repeated entanglement distribution, and identify timing precision, chain length, and memory accumulation as fundamental constraints on scalable quantum-network architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了通过未重新初始化而重复使用的量子信道进行纠缠分发的运行限制。研究表明，信道中前次使用留下的残余激发作为记忆源，逐渐抑制了相干量子传输。为量化这一限制，我们推导了量子容量的解析下界，并结合Holevo-Werner半定规划上界。此外，我们还提供了一个识别纠缠破坏信道的解析判据，其阈值共同取决于链长和重复使用次数。
authors: Roberto Benjamin Salazar Vargas, Hayden Zammit, Trevor Spiteri, Gianluca Valentino, Tony J. G. Apollaro, Johann A. Briffa

articles.title: Gravitational Interactions in Nuclear Clocks
articles.title_zh: 核钟中的引力相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38832v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomic clocks achieve extraordinary precision through quantum control over large ensembles of atoms, with precision increasing and atom number advancing steadily. Emerging nuclear clock technology encodes clock states in nuclear rather than electronic transitions, offering a new frontier for precision measurement. Here we study whether a large ensemble of such clock nuclei could be used to observe their mutual gravitational interaction. We investigate the gravitational redshift induced by neighboring atoms, including nuclear energy superpositions as sources of gravity, giving rise to a genuinely quantum gravitational interaction between pairs of nuclei. We find that the resulting clock frequency shift due to mutual gravity may become non-negligible for a macroscopic number of nuclei, for instance in a solid-state thorium clock, and we propose approaches to mitigate electromagnetic field effects by exploiting spatial symmetry and high-precision spectroscopy. We further discuss how energy-induced mass superpositions could be directly probed using external gravitational field sensors. By contrast, observing gravity-induced entanglement involving clocks would require substantially greater experimental advances due to decoherence from spontaneous emission. Taken together, our results suggest that nuclear clocks, either alone or in combination with complementary sensors such as optomechanical systems, may offer a future route toward probing gravity at short distances and testing gravitating quantum source masses beyond the Newtonian limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了大型核钟原子系综中原子间的相互引力相互作用。研究发现，由相邻原子引起的引力红移，包括作为引力源的核能叠加，可能导致核对之间真正的量子引力相互作用。对于宏观数量的原子核，例如在固态钍钟中，这种相互引力引起的时钟频率漂移可能变得不可忽略。文章还提出了通过利用空间对称性和高精度光谱学来减轻电磁场效应的方法。
authors: Konstantin Beyer, Niklas E. Önne, Shimon Kolkowitz, Dolev Bluvstein, Mikhail Lukin, Jun Ye, Igor Pikovski

articles.title: Gravitationally Mediated Entanglement in Interferometers with Repeated Splitting
articles.title_zh: 具有重复分裂的干涉仪中引力介导的纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38840v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Proposals to probe the quantum nature of gravity through entanglement between spatially separated masses have attracted considerable interest. In such schemes, spatial superpositions are prepared through controlled splitting operations that produce several interferometric branches. Here we propose and analyse protocols involving repeated splitting stages, each of which doubles the number of occupied paths. We show that the density matrix after n splitting stages is related to that of the (n-1)-splitting protocol through local parity dephasing. Two of the resulting sectors reproduce the preceding state, while the other two acquire additional gravitational phases. Removing the locally generated parts gives an exact lower bound on the change in negativity, expressed in terms of the preceding state's negative partial-transpose eigenspace. For two splitting stages, this leads to an explicit condition on three gravitational phases under which the additional split cannot reduce negativity. We also show that further splitting cannot shorten the lifetime of the generated entanglement. If the local internal system preserves the full branch label, the positional entanglement is retained upon recombination. We describe an implementation using a reusable two-level system and local memories, and compare it with a readout without a memory register. For the latter, we derive an exact condition for when an additional splitting stage improves the readout, based on a 2× 2 Schur complement. Numerical simulations show an advantage in positional negativity over the rates considered, with an improvement surviving the restricted readout at all decoherence rates considered at the final readout time.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出并分析了涉及重复分裂阶段的协议，旨在通过空间分离质量之间的纠缠来探测引力的量子性质。研究表明，经过n个分裂阶段后的密度矩阵与(n-1)个分裂协议的密度矩阵通过局部奇偶去相干相关联。文章还给出了负性变化的精确下界，并证明了进一步的分裂不会缩短所生成纠缠的寿命。
authors: Riccardo Zampieri, Sougato Bose

articles.title: Inferring the Number of Quantum State Transfers with Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 利用神经网络推断量子态传输的使用次数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38844v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Repeated-use quantum state transfer (QST) goes beyond the single-use paradigm by accounting for the memory that accumulates inside the transmission channel when it is not reset between uses. Consequently, the map governing the nth use of the channel differs from use to use and carries a signature of each previous use. We ask whether this use number can be recovered from transmission data alone, and show that it can: a simple feed-forward neural network, given as input the Bloch vectors sent and received over a single use of an XX spin-chain channel, is able to identify the use number with an accuracy exceeding 90%. Exploiting the U(1) symmetry of the channel, we find that a reduced two-component representation of the transmitted states improves the accuracy further, to about 95%. We characterise the dependence of the classifier on the size and composition of the training data, finding that the number of sampled states and of sampled timings are equally important. We also identify the data set sizes required to reach a given accuracy. Finally, we quantify the severity of the residual misclassifications with an earth-mover distance on the confusion matrix.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在重复使用量子态传输（QST）中，传输信道内累积的记忆是否可以通过传输数据恢复。研究表明，一个简单的前馈神经网络，以XX自旋链信道单次使用中发送和接收的布洛赫矢量作为输入，能够以超过90%的准确率识别使用次数。利用信道的U(1)对称性，将传输态简化为两分量表示可将准确率提高到约95%。
authors: Hayden Zammit, Tony J. G. Apollaro, Gianluca Valentino, Johann A. Briffa

articles.title: Execution bias, repeatability and mitigation cost in parameter-frozen molecular VQE energy evaluation
articles.title_zh: 参数冻结分子VQE能量评估中的执行偏差、可重复性与缓解成本
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38885v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A smaller statistical error bar need not mean a more accurate molecular energy. We evaluate noiselessly optimized molecular variational quantum eigensolver states on IBM Aachen and Pittsburgh, two 156-qubit Heron processors (provider-reported revision 3). Only energy evaluation runs on hardware, with parameters, layouts and compiled circuits frozen and dynamical decoupling disabled. A five-molecule pilot, three-molecule isolated cohort in three windows and known-state controls comprise 110 jobs and 28.2 billed quantum processing unit (QPU) minutes; the isolated cohort spans 30.2 h within a 31.7 h campaign. Raw 1024 O2 and BeH2 mean residuals exceed returned uncertainty by factors 12-32. Pittsburgh BeH2 cross-job standard deviation is 5.6 times mean returned uncertainty. The zero-noise extrapolation (ZNE) package reduces O2 absolute residuals by 49.7% on Aachen and 83.5% on Pittsburgh at about fourfold charge. On Pittsburgh, twirled readout error extinction (TREX) removes 80 millihartree (mHa) per Raw 1024 job charge versus 50 mHa for ZNE. Controls reveal qubit-124 preparation or readout errors 5.4-5.6 times calibration; 13 mitigated energy point estimates fall outside the mapped spectrum, with no Raw counterpart. These results support workload checks and repeated measurements before additional sampling.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在IBM Aachen和Pittsburgh的156量子比特Heron处理器上，评估了无噪声优化的分子变分量子本征求解器（VQE）状态。研究发现，原始测量结果的平均残差远超返回的不确定性，且跨作业标准偏差较大。零噪声外推（ZNE）和旋转读出误差消除（TREX）等缓解技术能有效降低残差，但会增加计算成本。
authors: Julen Larrucea

articles.title: High-Threshold Fusion-Based Quantum Computation with Optical Hybrid Qubits
articles.title_zh: 基于光学混合量子比特的高阈值融合量子计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38914v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hybrid discrete- and continuous-variable (DV-CV) encodings have been developed to overcome operational drawbacks of each individual encoding, while fusion-based quantum computation (FBQC) has emerged to address the practical challenges of scalability toward fault-tolerant photonic quantum computation. Here we introduce hybrid FBQC using small optical DV-CV hybrid resource states connected through hybrid fusions, to combine the advantages of both approaches. We develop protocols for directly generating these resource states without requiring local hybrid logic such as the Hadamard gate, together with a tailored decoding strategy that exploits the error information contained in individual hybrid-fusion outcomes. We demonstrate that hybrid FBQC achieves a photon loss threshold of 2.231% while requiring only 12 hybrid fusions per surface-code unit cell, substantially improving upon the 0.89% threshold and 60-fusion requirement of previous hybrid measurement-based scheme. These results establish optical hybrid FBQC as a high-threshold resource-efficient route to scalable fault-tolerant photonic quantum computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了使用小型光学离散变量-连续变量（DV-CV）混合资源态通过混合融合连接的混合融合量子计算（FBQC）。我们开发了直接生成这些资源态的协议，并结合了利用混合融合结果中错误信息的定制解码策略。研究表明，混合FBQC实现了2.231%的光子损耗阈值，且每个表面码单元格仅需12次混合融合，显著优于现有方案。
authors: Seong-Yeop Lim, Jaehak Lee, Nuri Kang, Seung-Woo Lee

articles.title: Adaptive Local Measurements For Quantum Learning Can Exponentially Outperform Nonadaptive Global Measurements
articles.title_zh: 量子学习中的自适应局部测量可指数级优于非自适应全局测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38922v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Can measurements chosen adaptively, in response to earlier outcomes, be exponentially more informative than measurements fixed in advance? In many quantum settings, adaptivity helps at most polynomially; known exponential advantages require coherent measurements across copies or restricted measurements. We show an exponential advantage measuring one copy at a time, with no quantum memory kept between state copies, even when the nonadaptive learner may perform arbitrary global measurements on each copy. We construct explicit families of multi-qubit states in which a scalar parameter is encoded in one of exponentially many candidate observables, with an auxiliary marker indicating which one. An adaptive protocol identifies the relevant observable and then measures it using only single-qubit measurements and one round of adaptation. At fixed accuracy, it needs logarithmically many copies as the qubit count grows, whereas every nonadaptive protocol needs exponentially many. The same mechanism yields an exponential gap in local asymptotic minimax mean squared error constants, tight up to the exponential base. The states are separable and classical in label-dependent product bases; no entanglement or other nonclassical correlations are required. The gap comes from measurement incompatibility: the candidate observables cannot be measured jointly, so a fixed measurement must divide its information budget among them, while adaptivity selects the informative one. Accordingly, the separation disappears when the candidate observables commute, and cannot occur with fully observed classical samples. Measurement incompatibility thus emerges as a resource for quantum learning, distinct from entanglement and quantum memory, that classical feedback alone can exploit.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了在量子学习中，自适应局部测量可以比预先固定的非自适应全局测量提供指数级更多的信息。我们构建了多量子比特态的显式族，其中一个标量参数编码在指数级数量的候选可观测量之一中。自适应协议仅需对数数量的副本即可识别相关可观测量并进行测量，而任何非自适应协议则需要指数数量的副本。
authors: Alireza Goldar, Zhen Qin, Zhihui Zhu, Zhe-Xuan Gong, Michael B. Wakin

articles.title: Fully Quantum Latent Diffusion for Synthetic Malware Records: Effective Denoising, Limited Class Information, and Costly Post-Selection
articles.title_zh: 用于合成恶意软件记录的全量子潜在扩散模型：有效去噪、有限类别信息和昂贵的后选择
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38974v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Malware benchmarks are difficult to share, because the samples are harmful and a corpus can reveal the incidents of its holder, while synthetic substitutes can leak training records. Quantum diffusion models, however, have been evaluated only on images or quantum states, leaving the utility, privacy, and sampling cost of their samples unknown. In this research, we introduce a fully quantum latent diffusion model for malware records, in which a parameterized circuit with one mid-circuit measurement denoises amplitude-encoded latent vectors of opcode sequences without classical neural layers. On 17 malware families with ten seeds, we compared it with random states, a perfect generator, a parameter-matched classical control, and a classical latent diffusion model. The circuit lowers its denoising infidelity by 63%, yet classifiers trained on its records reach a macro-F1 score of 0.11 on real records, against 0.08 for random states, 0.61 for a perfect generator, and 0.44 for a classical diffusion model of comparable size, and adding its records to real training data lowers the score from 0.635 to 0.593. Post-selected sampling accepts 3.0×10⁻⁷ of runs, and a training penalty that raises the acceptance to 0.14 removes most of the denoising. No synthetic record copies a training record, and smoothing the decoded lengths lowers the area under the curve of a length-based membership test from 0.80 to 0.51, which a differentially private length histogram matches with a formal guarantee. These results indicate that quantum generators of shareable security data require a joint evaluation of utility, privacy, and sampling cost.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了一种用于恶意软件记录的全量子潜在扩散模型，该模型使用带有一个中途测量的参数化电路对操作码序列的幅度编码潜在向量进行去噪。尽管该电路将去噪失真度降低了63%，但其记录训练的分类器在真实记录上的宏观F1分数仅为0.11。研究还发现，后选择采样接受率较低，表明其在实际应用中存在成本问题。
authors: Ban Q. Tran, Quang Duy Tran, Anh H. Nguyen, Ziwen Pan, Tommy Dang, Susan Mengel

articles.title: Individually Addressed Logical Pauli Measurements by QLDPC Surgery on a Trapped Ion Quantum Computer
articles.title_zh: 陷阱离子量子计算机上通过QLDPC手术实现独立寻址的逻辑泡利测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39067v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum low-density parity check (QLDPC) codes may lead to order-of-magnitude reductions in the qubit overhead required for fault-tolerant quantum computation. Achieving this improved overhead requires logical operations that selectively address individual logical qubits encoded within multi-qubit code blocks. Recently proposed architectures achieve this through QLDPC surgery, in which non-destructive Pauli measurements are performed using ancillary ''gadget'' systems transiently entangled with the code block, generalising lattice surgery. Here we implement QLDPC surgery on a [[10,2,3]] generalised bicycle code using Quantinuum's H2-2 trapped ion processor. A single-round surgery measurement using seven gadget qubits measures the barX₁ operator with a 0.72 [0.32, 1.41]% (95% credible interval) error rate and agrees with subsequent transversal measurement with 1.03 [0.60, 1.65]% error. Decoding across three rounds of syndrome extraction suppresses the gadget measurement error, reducing the error rate to below 0.26%. The syndrome after surgery confirms return to the code space and the unaddressed ''spectator'' qubit is preserved with error 0.21 [0.04, 0.67]% during the three-round measurement. We further demonstrate composition of conjugate basis gadgets by sequentially measuring barX₁ then barZ₂, reusing the gadget qubits, and obtain a 1.12 [0.60, 1.94]% error in the barZ₂ measurement. These results constitute a hardware validation of the generalised surgery primitive underlying Pauli-based computing for QLDPC architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在Quantinuum的H2-2陷阱离子处理器上，实现了针对[[10,2,3]]广义自行车码的量子低密度奇偶校验（QLDPC）手术。通过使用七个辅助量子比特进行单轮手术测量，barX₁算子的误差率为0.72%。经过三轮综合征提取解码后，辅助测量误差被抑制至0.26%以下，证实了代码空间恢复和未寻址“旁观”量子比特的保存。
authors: Surabhi Luthra, Alex Owens

articles.title: Time-Switching Energy-Harvesting Quantum Relay-Assisted FSO Communication with Displaced Squeezed Signaling
articles.title_zh: 基于时分能量收集和位移压缩信号的量子中继辅助FSO通信
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39091v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper investigates a quantum relay-assisted free-space optical (FSO) communication system in which a decode-and-forward relay is powered by time-switching optical energy harvesting and forwards the decoded information using displaced squeezed signaling (DSS). To obtain a physically con sistent description of turbulence-induced loss for non-classical signaling, each hop is modeled as a pure-loss bosonic chan nel whose random transmissivity follows a truncated Gamma Gamma law, i.e., the Gamma-Gamma irradiance conditioned on the physically admissible range of a transmittance. Under this channel, coherent states remain pure, whereas squeezed states are mapped to mixed Gaussian states. Under Helstrom-optimal detection, the average error of the coherent hop is derived in exact Laplace-series form. For the DSS hop, we derive the output states, a closed-form Gaussian fidelity with rigorous two sided bounds on the Helstrom error, and prove the existence of a loss-aware optimal photon partition. Furthermore, we prove that optimized squeezing preserves both the turbulence-induced diversity order and the leading asymptotic constant of coherent relaying, so that its benefit is a finite-photon-budget effect, and that an interior throughput-optimal harvesting fraction exists. A covariance-preserving benchmark with an exact series representation yields an analytical upper bound on the achievable throughput whose absolute gap vanishes as the relay photon budget grows. Numerical results based on the exact mixed-state Helstrom error quantify the benefit of squeezing and the regime in which it is useful.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一种量子中继辅助的自由空间光（FSO）通信系统，其中解码转发中继由时分光学能量收集供电，并使用位移压缩信号（DSS）转发解码信息。为描述湍流引起的非经典信号损耗，每个跳变被建模为纯损耗玻色子信道。研究推导了相干跳变的平均误差，并为DSS跳变导出了输出态和高斯保真度，证明了存在损耗感知最优光子划分。
authors: Nizar Khalfet, Francisco A. Monteiro, Ioannis Krikidis

articles.title: Reverse Quantum Annealing for Ground-State Energy Calculation in Molecule
articles.title_zh: 用于分子基态能量计算的逆向量子退火
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39129v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present the results of our reverse quantum annealing computations of the ground-state energies of alkaline-earth monofluoride molecules. By partitioning the Dirac--Coulomb electronic Hamiltonian into sub-QUBOs and refining forward-annealing solutions through optimized reverse-annealing schedules, residual configuration errors are systematically minimized. The electronic ground-state wave functions and energies are obtained using the Quantum Annealing Eigensolver algorithm. This work provides a pathway for achieving sub-milliHartree chemical accuracy and advancing molecular electronic structure calculations in the quantum annealing paradigm.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了利用逆向量子退火计算碱土金属单氟化物分子基态能量的结果。通过将狄拉克-库仑电子哈密顿量划分为子QUBO，并通过优化的逆向退火调度细化前向退火解，系统地最小化了残余构型误差。该工作为在量子退火范式中实现亚毫哈特里化学精度和推进分子电子结构计算提供了途径。
authors: Pradyot Pritam Sahoo

articles.title: Signatures of Narrowband and Ultrashort-Pulse-Like Probing in Coherent Anti-Stokes Raman Scattering Using Twin Beams and Sum-Frequency Generation Readout
articles.title_zh: 使用双光束和和频生成读出在相干反斯托克斯拉曼散射中窄带和超短脉冲探测的特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39138v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically investigate coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering (CARS) driven by bright twin beams with sum-frequency generation (SFG) readout. Expressing the SFG output in terms of quantum-field correlation functions yields multiple correlation structures with distinct properties associated with different interaction pathways on the bra and ket sides. Among them, frequency correlations between the CARS probe and SFG gating fields enable the two fields to act collectively as an effective narrowband probe, avoiding probe-induced spectral convolution. When this behavior appears on either the bra or ket side, the other retains Raman relaxation information as if probed by an ultrashort pulse.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论研究了由亮双光束驱动并采用和频生成（SFG）读出的相干反斯托克斯拉曼散射（CARS）。通过量子场关联函数表达SFG输出，揭示了具有不同相互作用路径的多种关联结构。其中，CARS探测光与SFG门控光之间的频率关联使两者能协同作用，形成有效的窄带探测，从而避免了探测引起的谱卷积。当这种行为出现在任一侧时，另一侧则保留了如同被超短脉冲探测的拉曼弛豫信息。
authors: Yujiro Eto, Hideaki Kano, Masahiro Takeoka

articles.title: Resonance and Transition-Channel Competition in Cavity-Assisted Floquet-State Stabilization
articles.title_zh: 腔辅助Floquet态稳定中的共振与跃迁通道竞争
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39169v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Static coupling to a dissipative cavity has been proposed as a route to autonomously stabilize Floquet eigenstates. The cavity provides an energy-selective relaxation channel: when its photon energy matches a quasienergy difference modulo drive quanta, it mediates transitions between Floquet states, followed by irreversible photon loss. Here, we show that at intermediate driving frequencies, this resonance condition alone is not sufficient for stabilization. Instead, the steady state is controlled by the interplay between resonance selection and the cavity-induced transition strengths between Floquet states, which can either cooperate or compete. This interplay leads to successful stabilization, mixed steady states despite resonance, and complete breakdown near Floquet-zone hybridization. We further show that the same mechanism extends to multilevel spin-S systems, providing a general framework for understanding when static dissipation can reliably stabilize driven quantum states.
articles.abstract_zh: 耗散腔的静态耦合被提出作为自主稳定Floquet本征态的途径。本文研究表明，在中等驱动频率下，仅共振条件不足以实现稳定。稳态受共振选择与腔诱导的Floquet态间跃迁强度之间相互作用的控制，这种相互作用可能协同或竞争。该机制导致了成功的稳定、尽管共振但仍出现混合稳态，以及在Floquet区杂化附近的完全失效，并可推广到多能级自旋-S系统。
authors: Zhuocheng Ma, Hongzheng Zhao, Liang-You Peng

articles.title: Geometric Rényi divergence and RLD Fisher information under quantum processes without definite causal order
articles.title_zh: 无确定因果序量子过程中几何Rényi散度与RLD Fisher信息
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39217v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum experiments without a definite causal order offer new ways to distinguish devices, estimate physical parameters, and communicate. We prove a common limit on these tasks: the geometric Rényi divergence at the output of a deterministic completely positive process cannot exceed the sum of the divergences of its individual channel uses. The inequality holds for every Rényi order in (0,1)u̧p(1,2] and any number of independently replaceable channels. Parallel experiments with separate reference-assisted inputs approach the bound, giving an exact equality after optimization over processes. We also prove an additive bound on the right logarithmic derivative Fisher information of parameter-dependent channels under every fixed process in this class. A resulting Cramér--Rao bound limits locally unbiased estimation precision without assuming a definite causal order, and an erasure-probability example attains the bound. The proofs for the geometric Rényi divergence and RLD Fisher information follow from the requirement that every independent choice of channels produce a normalized output. We show how this requirement controls positive local operations, and how small channel perturbations convert the divergence inequality into a Fisher-information bound, including for singular channels. Further applications give finite-use bounds on channel discrimination and exclusion, together with communication and private-state-generation converses when the processes preserve the relevant comparison conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 无确定因果序的量子实验为区分设备、估计物理参数和通信提供了新方法。本文证明了这些任务的一个共同限制：确定性完全正过程输出的几何Rényi散度不能超过其单个信道使用的散度之和。该不等式适用于特定Rényi阶数和任意数量的独立可替换信道。研究还证明了在此类固定过程中，参数相关信道的右对数导数Fisher信息存在一个可加界限，由此得到的Cramér-Rao界限限制了局部无偏估计的精度。
authors: Zixin Huang, Mark M. Wilde

articles.title: Beyond Direct Imaging: Quantum Measurement Design for Small-Target Detection in UAV Hyperspectral Sensing
articles.title_zh: 超越直接成像：无人机高光谱传感中小目标检测的量子测量设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39226v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Small mineral patches can be spectrally distinct yet difficult to detect when diffraction mixes their light with the surrounding rock. Conventional hyperspectral detectors analyze recorded intensities, leaving an opportunity to recover target evidence through the optical measurement itself. We develop a quantum-assisted framework for exploiting this opportunity in prospective unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) hyperspectral sensing. A common radiometric and diffraction model describes direct imaging and spatial-mode measurements of the same light. The theory identifies target changes that survive background fitting and explains when mode measurements retain more detection information. It quantifies losses from mode mismatch and unresolved outputs, linking the quantum benchmark to finite receiver design. A common-basis result identifies when material spectra can share a spatial measurement at fixed geometry. An adaptive receiver uses an imaging pilot to select candidate modes and combines both stages in a full-region presence test. Simulations based on measured mineral spectra and published UAV acquisition scales demonstrate gains over complete direct imaging at a shared active-exposure budget, including pilot cost and optical loss. At matched empirical 1% region-level false alarms, detection increases from 62.95% to 69.65% for a representative target. Paired analysis supports gains with registration uncertainty and, separately, under controlled nonuniform backgrounds. Calibrated mode errors reveal where measurement losses weaken or reverse the benefit. These results connect background identifiability to receiver choices and their operating conditions. They provide a framework for designing spatial measurements alongside spectral channels to detect small material features.
articles.abstract_zh: 小型矿物斑块在光谱上可能独特，但当衍射将其光线与周围岩石混合时难以检测。本文开发了一种量子辅助框架，用于无人机（UAV）高光谱传感中的小目标检测。该框架通过统一的辐射测量和衍射模型描述直接成像和空间模式测量，并识别出在背景拟合后仍能保留的目标变化。理论解释了何时模式测量能保留更多检测信息，并量化了模式失配和未解析输出造成的损失。模拟结果表明，该方法在检测性能上优于传统方法。
authors: Qipeng Qian, Jialiang Jin, Shihao Wang, Yuntao Qian

articles.title: A VLSI-Like Design and Verification Flow for Quantum Circuits: A Case Study in PI Estimation
articles.title_zh: 一种类VLSI的量子电路设计与验证流程：以圆周率估计为例
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39263v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper proposes a VLSI-like design and verification flow for quantum circuit implementation, covering four levels: behavioral modeling, register-transfer level (RTL), gate level, and full-circuit integration with quantum algorithms. Using quantum Monte Carlo methods for pi estimation as a case study, the proposed flow provides a systematic path from initial specifications to large-scale quantum circuit implementation. The paper highlights two key contributions. First, quantum digital design supports a broad range of applications beyond predefined circuit templates. This capability is particularly important for application-specific operations in algorithms such as Shor's, Grover's, and quantum amplitude estimation (QAE), and can significantly advance fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC). Second, classical simulation shows that replacing random sampling with grid sampling can achieve a quadratic improvement in this pi-estimation case without quantum computation. This suggests that the quadratic speedup may arise from the grid sampling strategy rather than from the QAE circuit itself. By adapting conventional VLSI digital design principles, this four-level flow addresses a key bottleneck in quantum circuit design and enables flexible design initiation from multiple entry points, including specifications, RTL, and gate-level descriptions, paving the way for the practical deployment of quantum computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种类VLSI的量子电路设计与验证流程，涵盖行为建模、寄存器传输级、门级和与量子算法的完整电路集成四个层面。以量子蒙特卡洛方法估算圆周率为例，该流程为从初始规范到大规模量子电路实现提供了系统路径。研究强调了量子数字设计对广泛应用的支持，并指出在圆周率估计案例中，用网格采样替代随机采样可在不进行量子计算的情况下实现二次方改进，这暗示二次加速可能源于采样策略而非量子振幅估计电路本身。
authors: Yu-Ting Kao, Yeong-Jar Chang

articles.title: Efficient Quantum Optimization via Dissipative False Vacuum Decay
articles.title_zh: 基于耗散假真空衰变的量子高效优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39266v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Efficient quantum solvers for computationally hard problems are highly desirable for near-term quantum platforms. Here, we propose a cavity-based dissipative quantum solver for a class of NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems encoded in atomic-spin Hamiltonians with a few discrete single-spin-flip transition energies. We show that the cavity-based quantum solver exploits dissipative false-vacuum decay in configuration space to facilitate escape from metastable local minima in rugged energy landscapes. Numerical studies of MaxCut and Maximum Independent Set identify favorable parameter regions for ground-state preparation. Based on the finite-size scalings of the median mixing time and instance-averaged ground-state preparation probability, we estimate time complexities for our solver that are more favorable than those of standard Grover search. These results highlight cavity dissipation as a controllable resource for quantum optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于腔的耗散量子求解器，用于解决编码在原子自旋哈密顿量中的NP难组合优化问题。该求解器利用构型空间中的耗散假真空衰变，以促进从崎岖能量景观中的亚稳态局部最小值逃逸。对MaxCut和最大独立集问题的数值研究确定了基态制备的有利参数区域。基于中值混合时间和实例平均基态制备概率的有限尺寸标度，该求解器的时间复杂度优于标准Grover搜索，突出了腔耗散作为量子优化的可控资源。
authors: Zhi-Hao Huang, Tian-Mu Hu, Shuaifan Cao, Ye Lu, Xiaopeng Li

articles.title: Analytic Solutions To Fully Quantized Parametric Amplification
articles.title_zh: 全量子化参量放大解析解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39387v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We derive analytic expressions for observable dynamics under the fully quantized trilinear Hamiltonian, governing quantum three-wave mixing and parametric amplification. Starting from a coherent pump and vacuum signal and idler, the calculation reorganizes the Heisenberg expansion into resummed depletion and return profiles, yielding directly evaluable expressions for all 1st-, 2nd- and 3rd-order correlations. The construction uses no parametric approximation or fitted parameters. Representative numerical benchmarks show errors of order 10⁻¹² throughout the entire pump depletion, and below 10⁻³ across dozens of depletion-and-back-conversion cycles, up to the first total collapse of the oscillation. The first-depletion treatment additionally provides 4th-order correlations, accommodates bright squeezed-pump inputs and reveals phenomena important to future optical quantum technologies. The framework can be extended to higher moments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文推导了在全量子化三线性哈密顿量下可观测动力学的解析表达式，该哈密顿量描述了量子三波混频和参量放大。从相干泵浦和真空信号与闲频光开始，计算将海森堡展开重组为重求和的耗尽和返回剖面，直接给出了所有一阶、二阶和三阶关联的可评估表达式。该方法不使用参量近似或拟合参数，数值基准测试显示在整个泵浦耗尽过程中误差约为10⁻¹²。该框架可扩展到更高阶矩，并揭示了对未来光学量子技术重要的现象。
authors: Wanli Xing, Timothy C. Ralph

articles.title: Conditional Information Flow and Neural Representability of One-Dimensional Rotated Cluster States
articles.title_zh: 一维旋转簇态的条件信息流与神经网络可表示性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39392v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: I study how measurement outcomes can remain conditionally dependent over long distances while the underlying state carries only a small internal memory, using one-dimensional rotated cluster states, whose exact matrix product state (MPS) bond dimension is D=2 at every rotation angle. Using exact MPS contraction, I compute the conditional mutual information (CMI) of two readout protocols: the entanglement-swapping endpoint CMI decreases from one bit at θ=0 to zero at θ=π/2, whereas a stationary bulk readout of the locally equivalent conventional cluster state vanishes at both limits. As an exact control, the spin-1 AKLT chain obeys Iₘ₌₍₄/9),3⁻m, so its CMI length equals its two-point correlation length, for an identifiable but non-generic reason. I then compare learners on the same N=64, θ=0.35 target. A positive autoregressive GRU learns the computational-basis Born distribution from a few thousand samples, but an exactly computable Bell-basis readout shows that this distribution does not fix the phases. A complex RBM reaches the N=8 ground state under an exact objective, while a short generic recurrent variational Monte Carlo pilot is still improving when its runs end. As a positive control, an MPS-induced recurrent model whose hidden state is the bond vector reaches the ground state to near machine precision at ḩi=2, whereas a ḩi=1 control fails. These results show that long CMI does not require a large bond dimension, and that building the small virtual memory into the architecture greatly eases optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在一维旋转簇态中，测量结果如何在底层状态仅携带少量内部记忆的情况下，仍能保持长距离的条件依赖性。通过精确的矩阵乘积态（MPS）收缩，计算了两种读出协议的条件互信息（CMI）。研究发现，纠缠交换端点CMI随旋转角度θ从1比特（θ=0）减小到0（θ=π/2），而局部等效的传统簇态的稳态体读出在两个极限下均消失。此外，还比较了不同学习器在特定目标上的性能，揭示了计算基Born分布不完全决定相位信息。
authors: Ziqi Xu

articles.title: Pöschl-Teller type of Jaynes-Cummings Hamiltonians: SUSY transformations
articles.title_zh: Pöschl-Teller型Jaynes-Cummings哈密顿量：超对称变换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39401v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The aim of this work is to define and investigate the generalized Jaynes-Cummings (JC) Hamiltonian by means of supersymmetric (SUSY) quantum mechanics methods. We have considered trigonometric and hyperbolic Pöschl-Teller (PT) potentials as two natural ingredients to modify the standard JC model. We show that these generalized JC Hamiltonians have a list of characteristics in common with the JC Hamiltonian, for example: matrix intertwining, excitation number symmetry, Rabi frequency, formulas for atomic inversion and classical and revival times. Therefore, we conclude that JC Hamiltonians can be considered as one example of a wider a class of generalized Hamiltonians which can be useful in broader interaction problems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文旨在通过超对称（SUSY）量子力学方法定义和研究广义Jaynes-Cummings（JC）哈密顿量。研究将三角和双曲Pöschl-Teller（PT）势作为修改标准JC模型的自然组成部分。结果表明，这些广义JC哈密顿量与标准JC哈密顿量具有许多共同特征，例如矩阵交织、激发数对称性、拉比频率以及原子反转和经典与复兴时间的公式。因此，JC哈密顿量可被视为更广泛的广义哈密顿量类别的一个例子，对更广泛的相互作用问题具有潜在应用价值。
authors: İsmail Burak Ateş, Şengül Kuru, Javier Negro, Efe Serbest

articles.title: Optimal Linear Combination of Hamiltonian Simulation for Dissipative Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 耗散动力学哈密顿量模拟的线性组合优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39541v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Linear combination of Hamiltonian simulation (LCHS) is an efficient method for simulating dissipative dynamics on quantum computers. The choice of the LCHS kernel controls the cost of the algorithm. We prove that the kernel family proposed by Ni and Ying~i̧teNY26 minimizes the LCHS query cost in the minimax sense. For target accuracy ϵ, the minimum cost is asymptotically frac2eπ(łnfrac1ϵ-łnłnfrac1ϵ+o(1)), with optimal leading constant frac2eπ. Our lower-bound proof combines weak duality with a realization lemma that approximates extremal dual functions by matrix elements of dissipative evolutions.
articles.abstract_zh: 哈密顿量模拟的线性组合（LCHS）是一种在量子计算机上模拟耗散动力学的有效方法。本文证明了Ni和Ying提出的核函数族在极小极大意义上最小化了LCHS的查询成本。对于目标精度ϵ，最小成本渐近地为frac2eπ(łnfrac1ϵ-łnłnfrac1ϵ+o(1))，其中最优主导常数为frac2eπ。该下界证明结合了弱对偶性与一个实现引理，该引理通过耗散演化的矩阵元近似极值对偶函数。
authors: Hongkang Ni, Lexing Ying

articles.title: Error-Corrected Quantum Optimization via Rydberg Atom Array Embeddings
articles.title_zh: 基于里德堡原子阵列嵌入的纠错量子优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39670v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rydberg atom quantum optimizers naturally encode the maximum independent set problem on geometric graphs. However, to solve general combinatorial optimization problems on more complex topologies, an embedding is required to overcome the limited-range native interactions. Such embeddings use gadgets, specific arrangements of atoms, which inevitably introduce ancillary atoms. Here, we show that this apparent overhead instead provides an intrinsic resource for error correction. Specifically, we demonstrate that the Parity Architecture-based Rydberg embedding naturally forms a classical error-correcting code, a principle that extends to other Rydberg blockade-based embeddings. Within superatom substructures, exact Rydberg-excitation-number constraints provide local error syndromes at no additional hardware cost and give rise to a strictly nonlinear code. To correct bit-flip errors, we introduce the precisely tailored Cluster decoder, which exploits these local constraints and the underlying gadget structure. Numerically, this approach achieves an error threshold of pₜₕgtrsim26 % across different layout geometries. Experimentally, on the QuEra Aquila QPU, the Cluster decoder recovers exact optimization solutions with an average success rate of gtrsim8% for systems of up to 107 atoms, even when bare hardware and standard greedy post-processing find none. A Rydberg atom array embedding is therefore not merely a hardware mapping of an optimization problem, but a co-designed architecture for quantum optimization in which embedding, computation, and error correction emerge from the same physical structure.
articles.abstract_zh: 里德堡原子量子优化器能自然地在几何图上编码最大独立集问题。本文研究表明，用于解决更复杂拓扑结构组合优化问题的里德堡嵌入，其引入的辅助原子可提供内在的纠错资源。具体而言，基于奇偶校验架构的里德堡嵌入自然形成了一种经典纠错码。为了纠正比特翻转错误，研究引入了专门定制的Cluster解码器，该解码器利用局部约束和底层小工具结构。数值模拟显示，该方法在不同布局几何结构下实现了约26%的错误阈值。
authors: Andrew Byun, Berend Klaver, Arinjoy De, Pedro Ildefonso, Davit Khachatryan, Alexei Bylinskii, Michael Schuler, Wolfgang Lechner

articles.title: Quantum Query Complexity of Tournament Solutions
articles.title_zh: 锦标赛解的量子查询复杂度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39702v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A tournament solution records a set of winners from a tournament, that is, from the outcomes of all pairwise comparisons among N alternatives. We study the quantum query complexity of computing tournament solutions when the outcome of each comparison has to be learned by a query. Classically, the picture is uniform: the Copeland set, the uncovered set and the top cycle all require Θ(N²⁾ queries, and so does finding a single vertex of maximum out-degree. We show that the quantum query complexity of the top cycle can be computed with tildeΘ(N) queries, and a Condorcet winner can be found with tilde Θ(sqrt N) queries. Finding a strong king requires Θ(N³/²) queries, the same as finding a vertex of maximum out-degree. We also give a self-contained alternative proof of the known Θ(N³/²) bound for finding a vertex of maximum degree, established by Gilani, Mande, Patro, and Raja. Our lower bounds reduce counting problems to tournament problems using Ambainis's adversary method. For the top cycle, we find a Hamiltonian path and locate the prefix forming the top cycle by divide and conquer.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了计算锦标赛解的量子查询复杂度，其中每次比较的结果需要通过查询来获取。研究表明，顶循环的量子查询复杂度为tildeΘ(N)，而Condorcet赢家可以通过tilde Θ(sqrt N)次查询找到。寻找一个强王需要Θ(N³/²)次查询，与寻找最大出度顶点相同。本文还提供了寻找最大度顶点的已知Θ(N³/²)界限的独立证明，并利用Ambainis的对抗方法将计数问题简化为锦标赛问题。
authors: Pragya Arora, Udit Kumar

articles.title: Maximum-Entropy Ensemble of Quantum Subsystems with a Fixed Average State
articles.title_zh: 具有固定平均态的量子子系统最大熵系综
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39712v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The reduced density matrices of Haar-random bipartite states form a fixed-trace version of the Wishart ensemble of random matrices, with an asymptotic eigenvalue density given by the Marchenko--Pastur (MP) law. We establish a similar universal form for the maximum-entropy distribution of mixed states subject to a fixed ensemble average, arguing that its eigenvalue density converges asymptotically to that of the correlated Wishart ensemble (CWE). The density is thus obtained by a free multiplicative convolution formula, which we apply to the transverse-field Ising model (TFIM) with a thermal average state to derive a high-temperature leading-order correction to the MP law. We then consider measurement by a random POVM on the purification of the mixed reference state. We show that the resulting mixed-state ensemble is asymptotically equivalent to the CWE, and provide confirming numerical evidence. We return to the TFIM example to compute the entanglement of the system with the ancilla after measurement, and give finite-temperature Page curves for the average entanglement entropies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有固定系综平均态的混合态的最大熵分布，并提出其渐近特征值密度收敛于相关Wishart系综（CWE）。通过自由乘法卷积公式，作者将其应用于横场伊辛模型，推导了Marchenko-Pastur定律的高温领先阶修正。研究还表明，通过随机POVM测量得到的混合态系综渐近等价于CWE，并计算了测量后系统的纠缠熵。
authors: Charlie Shakeshaft, Christopher David White, Harry J. D. Miller

articles.title: Non-Asymptotic Bounds via the Nussbaum-Szkoła Mapping for Quantum Hypothesis Testing
articles.title_zh: 基于Nussbaum-Szkoła映射的量子假设检验非渐近界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39784v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum hypothesis testing concerns the discrimination between quantum states. This paper introduces novel lower and upper bounds for asymmetric quantum hypothesis testing based on the Nussbaum-Szkoła mapping. Together, these bounds provide a unified recovery of both converse and achievability results across all major asymptotic regimes, including large-, moderate-, and small-deviations. Unlike existing bounds, which either rely on technically involved information-spectrum arguments or suffer from fixed prefactors and limited applicability in the non-asymptotic regime, the proposed bounds arise from a unified framework and enable, in some cases, the direct use of classical results. It is further demonstrated that these bounds provide accurate approximations to the optimal quantum error trade-off function at small blocklengths. Numerical comparisons with existing bounds, including those based on fidelity and information spectrum methods, highlight their improved tightness.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于Nussbaum-Szkoła映射，为非对称量子假设检验引入了新颖的下界和上界。这些界限统一地恢复了所有主要渐近机制（包括大、中、小偏差）的逆定理和可达性结果。与现有方法相比，所提出的界限源于统一框架，并在小块长度下提供了对最优量子误差权衡函数的精确近似，数值比较也证实了其更紧密的特性。
authors: Jorge Lizarribar-Carrillo, Gonzalo Vazquez-Vilar, Tobias Koch

articles.title: Distributed Inner Product Estimation of Continuous-Variable Quantum States
articles.title_zh: 连续变量量子态的分布式内积估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39912v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Continuous-variable distributed inner product estimation (CV-DIPE) compares unknown states prepared by distant bosonic and quantum optical systems. It supports benchmarking without efficient classical descriptions or joint measurements. We develop three CV-DIPE protocols for the natural class of energy-constrained continuous-variable quantum states, based on coordinated displaced parity, coordinated Haar measurements, and independent homodyne shadows. For arbitrary multimode inputs in this class, including entangled and non-Gaussian states, we establish truncation error bounds and worst-case sample complexity guarantees for the exact inner product. The leading terms of these bounds favor coordinated Haar measurements, whose global implementation is experimentally challenging. The three protocols provide certified inner product estimates for distributed continuous-variable systems from local measurement data.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了三种用于能量受限连续变量量子态的分布式内积估计（CV-DIPE）协议，旨在比较远距离玻色子和量子光学系统制备的未知量子态。这些协议基于协调位移宇称、协调Haar测量和独立零差阴影。研究为精确内积建立了截断误差界限和最坏情况下的样本复杂度保证，并指出协调Haar测量在理论上表现最佳，但实验实现具有挑战性。
authors: Kun Wang

articles.title: Bath-state (In)dependence of Non-Markovianity Measures in Quadratic Open Systems
articles.title_zh: 二次开放系统中非马尔可夫性度量的浴态（不）依赖性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39970v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Open quantum system dynamics fail to fulfill the conditions of the Markov approximation when the environment and system timescales are close to each other. Such behavior of these systems can be characterized by several non-Markovianity measures, which are expected to vary with the environment parameters. In this work, we consider a fermionic quadratic open quantum system, establishing bath-state independence of the Breuer--Laine--Piilo and the Lorenzo--Plastina--Paternostro non-Markovianity measures. However, our analytical results reveal that the entanglement-based and divisibility-based Rivas--Huelga--Plenio measures, as well as the entropic Megier--Smirne--Vacchini measure, remain sensitive to the reservoir state, through both its temperature and its chemical potential. Modeling the reservoir as a free-fermionic chain, we derive an exact time-local master equation for a single fermionic site in contact with it. Our numerical results for this model confirm these findings and show that the BLP and LPP measures vanish identically only on the bound-state threshold, where the bath-sensitive measures nevertheless remain finite.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了费米子二次开放系统中非马尔可夫性度量对浴态的依赖性。研究发现，Breuer-Laine-Piilo和Lorenzo-Plastina-Paternostro非马尔可夫性度量与浴态无关，而基于纠缠和可分性的Rivas-Huelga-Plenio度量以及熵Megier-Smirne-Vacchini度量则对浴态的温度和化学势敏感。数值结果证实了这些发现，并指出浴态敏感度量在束缚态阈值处仍保持有限值。
authors: Mirko Consiglio, Ilia Khomchenko, Tony J. G. Apollaro

articles.title: Identifying Logical Operations from Syndrome Histories for qLDPC Codes
articles.title_zh: 从qLDPC码的综合征历史中识别逻辑操作
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40052v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Syndrome histories are normally used to detect and correct errors in fault-tolerant quantum computation, but they can also reveal information about the logical operations executed during computation. We study logical-operation identification using syndrome histories alone or together with other classical measurement outcomes. We develop an exact inference method and a scalable approximation that account for unknown circuit faults and ideal measurement randomness. We evaluate automorphisms, logical Pauli measurements, T injections, and logical circuits combining these instructions on ([[18,4,2]]) and ([[72,12,6]]) bivariate bicycle (BB) codes under multiple noise models and error rates. A single logical instruction can be identified with over 94% accuracy under circuit-level noise with error rates between (10^ -5 ) and (10⁻³). We also achieve over 99% accuracy for automorphism-based logical circuits and 78.32% for logical circuits combining all three instructions. We further analyze identification ambiguities arising from insufficient or indistinguishable measurement information, fault timing, and approximation inference. Together, these results extend the role of syndromes beyond error decoding to identifying executed logical operations and circuits during fault-tolerant quantum computation. They also suggest that access to syndrome histories and related classical measurement outcomes may unintentionally reveal information about the executed computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了如何利用综合征历史来识别容错量子计算中的逻辑操作。作者开发了一种精确推理方法和一种可扩展的近似方法，以应对未知的电路故障和理想测量随机性。在多种噪声模型和错误率下，对双变量循环码进行了评估，结果显示单一逻辑指令的识别准确率超过94%，而结合所有三种指令的逻辑电路识别准确率达到78.32%。
authors: Yizhuo Tan, Shifan Xu, Yongshan Ding, Jakub Szefer

articles.title: Dissipative controller as a hidden source of errors in quantum gates
articles.title_zh: 耗散控制器作为量子门中错误的隐藏来源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40072v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum systems are typically controlled by classical devices that necessarily dissipate energy to the surrounding environment. By the fluctuation-dissipation theorem, this implies noise in the control field produced. We investigate the relationship between the resulting errors and the entropy produced by the macroscopic controller, working in the context of a concrete minimal model. In the most experimentally relevant regime of fast control and high fidelity, we find a tradeoff between dissipation and control errors. These findings are exemplified by perturbative calculations of the gate fidelity for simple gate implementations and of the fidelity of state transfer via shortcuts to adiabaticity in the Landau-Zener model. Our results quantitatively demonstrate that suppressing errors in quantum control typically comes at the cost of macroscopic dissipation, which is needed to tame fluctuations in the classical controller.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了经典耗散控制器在量子门中引入误差的问题，并探讨了由此产生的误差与宏观控制器产生的熵之间的关系。研究发现，在快速控制和高保真度这一实验相关区域，耗散与控制误差之间存在权衡。结果表明，抑制量子控制中的误差通常需要以宏观耗散为代价，以抑制经典控制器中的波动。
authors: Serhat C. Kadioğlu, Saulo V. Moreira, Mark T. Mitchison, Anthony Kiely

articles.title: Reversible photorefractive attack in continuous-variable quantum key distribution
articles.title_zh: 连续变量量子密钥分发中的可逆光折变攻击
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40155v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum key distribution (QKD) offers information-theoretic security, but device imperfections introduce implementation vulnerabilities. Experimental evidence of the security consequences of transmitter vulnerabilities in continuous-variable QKD (CV-QKD) remains limited. Here, we experimentally investigate a reversible photorefractive attack in a local-local-oscillator CV-QKD system. Moderate blue-light illumination reduces the modulation variance of a lithium-niobate IQ modulator to a stable value without appreciably increasing estimated excess noise. The variance recovers after illumination is removed. We elucidate the underlying physical mechanisms and develop an attack that exploits recovery to compromise modulation calibration. Receiver measurements confirm that the resulting calibration mismatch leads to overestimated channel transmittance and underestimated excess noise. Key rate calculations based on measured parameters yield a positive estimated rate when the correctly calibrated rate is nonpositive. Recovery can also make the preceding manipulation harder to identify through later inspection. This work provides the first system-level experimental evidence that a reversible photorefractive response can be exploited to compromise modulation calibration in CV-QKD. These findings highlight reversible changes in quantum transmitters as a practical security concern, motivating security analyses and protection strategies that account for both optical perturbations and subsequent recovery.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文实验研究了本地本振连续变量量子密钥分发（CV-QKD）系统中的可逆光折变攻击。适度的蓝光照射可降低铌酸锂IQ调制器的调制方差，且在移除照射后方差可恢复。研究阐明了其物理机制，并开发了一种利用恢复特性破坏调制校准的攻击方法。接收方测量证实，由此产生的校准不匹配会导致信道透射率被高估和过量噪声被低估，从而在实际安全密钥率为非正时，估计密钥率仍为正。
authors: Junxuan Liu, Yuchao Liu, Qingquan Peng, Piao Tan, Tao Wang, Peng Huang, Anqi Huang

articles.title: Inevitability of the Petz transpose map
articles.title_zh: Petz转置映射的必然性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40158v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bayes' rule is central to classical statistical inference: given a prior and a stochastic model, it determines the corresponding retrodictive conditional probabilities. In quantum theory, however, the question of whether an equally general rule of retrodiction exists and, if so, whether it is uniquely determined remains nontrivial. Here we prove that a retrodiction assignment defined for all priors and channels, which takes each predicted output state back to its prior, must coincide with the Petz transpose map if it is involutive, respects sequential and parallel composition, and agrees with unitary inversion. The theorem holds for channels between finite-dimensional full matrix algebras, with the input and output spaces restricted to the supports of the corresponding reference states. In particular, affinity under probabilistic mixtures and the characteristic square-root dependence on the reference states follow from these requirements rather than being postulated. Without involutivity, the remaining requirements characterize a family of doubly rotated Petz maps. Our result thus explains why the Petz transpose map arises in seemingly different areas of quantum theory: it is the unique quantum analogue of Bayes' rule compatible with these consistency requirements.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了量子理论中是否存在普适的逆推规则。研究证明，如果一个适用于所有先验和信道的逆推赋值是自反的、尊重序列和并行组合，并与酉反演一致，那么它必然与Petz转置映射重合。该定理适用于有限维全矩阵代数之间的信道，解释了Petz转置映射在量子信息理论中出现的必然性。
authors: Jacopo Surace, Chenxu Li, Francesco Buscemi

articles.title: Bounds for General (r,δ)-Quantum Locally Recoverable Codes
articles.title_zh: 一般(r,δ)-量子局部可恢复码的界限
