articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40273v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study general (r,δ)-quantum locally recoverable codes (qLRCs) without assuming purity or a stabilizer structure, and with arbitrarily overlapping recovery blocks. Using a selection lemma for multiple-erasure recovery, we establish a Singleton-like upper bound for general quantum subspaces. When δ=2, this bound reduces to the general single-erasure bound of Golowich and Guruswami. An integer optimization yields an explicit remainder correction that tightens the bound by up to δ-2. For pure codes, local decoupling and entropy arguments extend the parameter bound of Galindo et al., originally obtained for pure stabilizer codes constructed from Euclidean or Hermitian dual-containing classical codes, to arbitrary pure quantum subspaces. We also remove the partition assumption from several existing pure-code bounds for disjoint recovery blocks and obtain a further remainder correction by optimizing the budget. Finally, we analyze three families attaining these bounds: pure codes with overlapping recovery blocks and d=δ, which exhibit both a strict improvement of the pure-code bound and simultaneous equality in the pure-code and general bounds; impure codes with disjoint recovery blocks attaining the general bound; and an existing family of pure codes with overlapping recovery blocks and d>δ, which simultaneously attains all these bounds.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了不假设纯度或稳定子结构、且恢复块可任意重叠的一般(r,δ)-量子局部可恢复码（qLRCs）。通过多擦除恢复的选择引理，作者为一般量子子空间建立了类Singleton上界，并通过整数优化进一步收紧了界限。对于纯码，研究扩展了现有参数界限，并分析了三类达到这些界限的码族，展示了纯码界限的严格改进。
authors: Shuowei Ma, Fei Shi

articles.title: Subsystem Spacetime Code
articles.title_zh: 子系统时空码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40357v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum error-correcting codes provide a powerful framework for analyzing and designing fault-tolerant Clifford circuits. In this work, we construct the subsystem spacetime code and use it to characterize the distances of Clifford circuits. We show that its gauge group can be explicitly constructed and classified using the masking properties of the instantaneous stabilizer groups and consists precisely of faults that are harmless to the circuit. We use this framework to identify where a dynamical code loses distance and to analyze how the fault distance changes when circuits are composed from smaller components. Our results provide a versatile tool for analyzing and designing fault-tolerant circuits, with potential applications to the construction of new dynamical codes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了子系统时空码，并利用其来表征Clifford电路的距离。研究表明，该码的规范群可以被明确构建和分类，并精确地由对电路无害的故障组成。该框架可用于识别动态码何时失去距离，并分析电路由较小组件构成时故障距离如何变化。这些结果为分析和设计容错电路提供了多功能工具。
authors: Esther Xiaozhen Fu, Aranya Chakraborty, Daniel Gottesman

articles.title: Quantum Computing through Computational Imaging: Representations, Measurement, and Inference
articles.title_zh: 通过计算成像实现量子计算：表示、测量与推理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40393v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An algebraic correspondence between an imaging model and a quantum state does not specify a computational method: input access, measurement and decoding determine what can be returned. This exposition develops four distinctions for computational-imaging and engineering readers. It separates amplitude encodings of input values from encodings of complete candidate labelings, explaining why amplitude storage does not provide full-array readout. Complex-field interference motivates unknown-phase inference: complementary measurements resolve ambiguities that local Fisher information alone does not detect. Reshaping joint amplitudes into a matrix connects singular-value decomposition to pure-state entanglement, while distinguishing Schmidt rank from conditions for efficient classical simulation. In a four-pixel segmentation, an objective becomes a cost operator and a sampling circuit. One layer of the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) lowers mean energy from 1.675 to 0.686 relative to uniform sampling, yet makes a nonoptimal labeling more probable than the optimum 0.484 versus 0.365. Archived IBM and IQM measurements illustrate a separate six-variable local boundary decision. Low-rank state reconstruction and selected quantum algorithms connect these distinctions to an end-to-end resource account. The derivations and reproducible numerical references assume complex linear algebra and probability, without prior quantum mechanics. The accompanying Seeing Amplitudes browser laboratory supports interactive exploration; the article remains self-contained and connects each representation to the estimate or decision it permits and the resources that output requires.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了计算成像与量子计算之间的联系，并为计算成像和工程领域的读者提出了四个关键区别。研究分离了输入值的振幅编码与完整候选标签的编码，并解释了复场干涉如何激发未知相位推理。通过将联合振幅重塑为矩阵，将奇异值分解与纯态纠缠联系起来，并分析了量子近似优化算法（QAOA）在四像素分割问题中的表现。
authors: George Kourousias, Sergio Carrato, Roberto Pugliese, Panagiotis Dimitrakis, Alberto Carini

articles.title: Structural Bottlenecks in QAOA Mixer Design: Transport and Causal Reach
articles.title_zh: QAOA混频器设计中的结构瓶颈：传输与因果范围
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40424v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The choice of mixer is a central design decision in the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA), yet different structural limitations of a mixer need not be captured by a single metric. We identify two complementary structural bottlenecks for shallow QAOA: configuration-space transport, which limits how strongly probability can concentrate on high-quality solutions, and finite-depth causal reach, which limits which parts of a problem instance can influence a local objective term. In Part I, we derive first-order mixer-dependent objective bounds in complementary small-β and small-γ regimes. For connected regular mixer graphs, the two leading-order expressions are exactly equivalent through a graph-Laplacian identity and reduce to the same cost-weighted Dirichlet energy. We then derive a non-perturbative upper envelope from the layer-wise ell₁ spreading of the mixer unitary, yielding a cost-distribution-dependent necessary spreading condition for attaining a target approximation ratio. In Part II, we study the locality bottleneck for MaxCut by augmenting the transverse-field mixer with problem-graph-aligned two-local interactions. The resulting k-hop construction has causal radius at most (k+1)p at depth p; for the k=1 architectures studied numerically, this gives radius 2p. Across cycles, circular ladders, and high-girth regular bipartite graphs, X+XX and X+YY improve the best-found approximation ratios over the standard X mixer at equal depth, while X+YY at depth p comes within about one approximation-ratio point of plain X at depth 2p in the reach-matched cases examined. The unequal performance of the equal-reach XX and YY augmentations shows that satisfying a structural capability does not by itself guarantee performance. Together, the results provide complementary structural insights for mixer design.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了量子近似优化算法（QAOA）混频器设计中的两个结构瓶颈：构型空间传输和有限深度因果范围。研究推导了混频器依赖的一阶目标界限，并从混频器酉算子的逐层ℓ₁扩散中导出了非微扰上界。在第二部分，作者通过增强横向场混频器来研究MaxCut问题的局部性瓶颈。
authors: Jasjyot Singh Gulati, Tharrmashastha SAPV

articles.title: A universal gauge structure in the photon content of light-matter systems
articles.title_zh: 光-物质系统中光子含量的普适规范结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40446v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: After truncating the matter Hilbert space of a single-mode light-matter model, gauge transformations leave the spectrum invariant whereas the ground-state photon number is gauge dependent, hence, its meaning remains disputed. We show that this gauge dependence obeys an exact algebraic law whenever the gauge transformation acts as a displacement of the field coupled to a matter operator G. Namely, the ground-state photon number is a quadratic polynomial in the gauge parameter łambda, łangle adagger aånglełₐₘbdₐ = łangle adagger aångle₀ + Cłambda + Qłambda². Here the coefficients are the correlator C=łangle G,pångle of G and the field momentum p, and Q=łangle G²ångle. Its minimum over all gauges is naturally gauge-invariant, and for the quantum Rabi model it is determined by the ground-state energy alone. We show that it is strictly positive for the quantum Rabi and Dicke models with level splitting, so that a residual photon content survives in every gauge. At weak coupling the gauge of minimal photon number is the Jaynes-Cummings gauge, and for the Dicke model it remains so at all couplings in the thermodynamic limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了单模光-物质模型中基态光子数对规范变换的依赖性。研究发现，当规范变换作为场位移作用时，基态光子数遵循一个精确的代数定律，表现为规范参数的二次多项式。该研究还表明，对于量子Rabi和Dicke模型，最小光子数在所有规范下都是严格正的，这意味着在任何规范下都存在残余光子含量。
authors: Arka Dutta, Marcus Kollar

articles.title: Process matrices on generalised theories
articles.title_zh: 广义理论中的过程矩阵
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40448v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We extend the process-matrix framework for defining indefinite causal orders to a broad class of generalised physical theories. We give a simple re-axiomatisation of spacetime contexts in terms of naturality over classical probes, which precisely captures non-contextual assignment together with compatibility with convexity and coarse-graining within local laboratories. Using this compositional perspective, we give a clean characterisation of theories in which abstract spacetime contexts admit a process-matrix representation, and we pin down the precise conditions (satisfied by classical theory, quantum theory, and a Boxworld-like theory) under which the supermap and process-matrix perspectives on higher-order processes coincide.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将定义不确定因果顺序的过程矩阵框架扩展到一类广泛的广义物理理论。作者通过经典探测器的自然性对时空背景进行了简单的重新公理化，精确捕捉了非背景赋值以及与局部实验室中凸性和粗粒化的兼容性。研究还明确了抽象时空背景支持过程矩阵表示的理论条件，并指出了高阶过程的超映射和过程矩阵视角一致的精确条件。
authors: Matt Wilson, James Hefford, Timothée Hoffreumon

articles.title: Trajectory sharpening under quantum reference frame transformations
articles.title_zh: 量子参考系变换下的轨迹锐化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40452v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum reference frame (QRF) transformations relate the description of a physical system to different quantum observers, but their connection to concrete experimental phenomena remains largely unclear. Here we show that the trajectory-sharpening effect obtained by correlating a probed system with an effective negative-mass reference admits a natural interpretation as a QRF transformation to the frame of a negative-mass system. Using a minimal toy model of free particles with signed masses, we identify the Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen-type observables responsible for this effect with a pair of commuting relational observables that, under the instantaneous QRF transformation, are mapped to operators local to distinct subsystems. We then show that the corresponding relational trajectory is reproduced by the dynamical QRF transformation, where the transformed relational position acquires an explicit time dependence. We introduce QRF-invariant sharpness measures for relational trajectories and derive monogamy relations showing that a trajectory cannot be made simultaneously arbitrarily sharp with respect to two distinct negative-mass frames. We further show that trajectory sharpness can instead reside in a collective reference mode encoded across two physical systems, even when neither constituent alone provides an arbitrarily sharp reference, so that sharpness can be distributed rather than localized in a single constituent frame. These results provide an operational, experimentally relevant interpretation of QRF transformations for continuous-variable systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子参考系（QRF）变换将物理系统的描述与不同的量子观察者联系起来，但其与具体实验现象的联系尚不明确。本文展示了通过将探测系统与有效负质量参考系关联而获得的轨迹锐化效应，可以自然地解释为向负质量系统参考系的QRF变换。研究引入了QRF不变的关联轨迹锐度度量，并推导了单配关系，表明轨迹不能同时相对于两个不同的负质量参考系任意锐化。
authors: Matteo Fadel, Giulia Gubitosi

articles.title: Quantum-Walk Inspired Spectral Metrics for Evaluating QAOA Mixers
articles.title_zh: 量子行走启发的谱度量用于评估QAOA混合器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40459v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: QAOA mixers play an important role in enabling exploration of the exponentially large solution space of binary optimization problems. However, the choice of mixer Hamiltonian is typically guided by convention and implementation or circuit constraints, rather than by a graph-topology-aware criterion. In this work, inspired by quantum-walk mixing theory, we propose two complementary spectral heuristics for characterizing QAOA mixer topologies. The first is the normalized minimum eigenvalue separation of the mixer Hamiltonian H_M, while the second is the long-time averaged minimum eigenvalue separation of the mixer unitary U_M(β)=e⁻ⁱβ H_M. Both quantities are invariant under any positive rescaling of the mixer Hamiltonian and provide Hamiltonian- and unitary-level characterizations of the mixer's spectral structure. We use them as heuristic indicators of the mixer dynamics relevant to amplitude redistribution during QAOA evolution. We derive exact expressions and asymptotic bounds for the complete graph, hypercube, cycle, and balanced 2-D torus, revealing a broad spectral separation between the studied topology classes. We then compare these separations with empirical QAOA performance. For random permutation-invariant cost Hamiltonians, the observed performance ordering is broadly consistent with the spectral characterization. In contrast, for structured 1-D and 2-D Ising QUBOs, this ordering breaks down, indicating that mixer-cost alignment can become important. These results illustrate both the usefulness and the limitations of topology-level, cost-agnostic spectral heuristics for QAOA mixer selection.
articles.abstract_zh: QAOA混合器在探索二元优化问题的指数级解空间中发挥着重要作用。本文受量子行走混合理论启发，提出了两种互补的谱启发式方法来表征QAOA混合器拓扑。这两种方法分别是混合器哈密顿量的归一化最小特征值分离和混合器酉算符的长时间平均最小特征值分离。这些度量提供了混合器谱结构的哈密顿量和酉算符层面的表征，并被用作QAOA演化过程中振幅重新分布相关混合器动力学的启发式指标。
authors: Jasjyot Singh Gulati, Tharrmashastha SAPV

articles.title: Using domain walls to benchmark fast quantum anneals
articles.title_zh: 利用畴壁基准测试快速量子退火
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40504v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider the distribution of domain walls arising in ground states of frustrated 1-dimensional Ising spin chains with anti-parallel boundary spins. For ideal chains, a sine-squared particle-in-a-box distribution of domain walls is expected in the quantum setting, and a uniform distribution expected classically. However, for chains with random imperfections, prior work [Chancellor et al., npj Quantum Inf. 8, 73, 2022] found that the distribution in a physical implementation corresponded to neither. Instead, the domain wall distribution forms a U-shaped profile arising from a classical model with random fields, where the combination of averaging over these fields and thermal averaging produces the characteristic U-shape. With D-Wave's newer fast anneal feature, we access anneal times shorter than the coherence time and observe the expected coherent quantum behavior in the form of a sine-squared distribution. For the shortest available anneal time, the dynamics have not yet reached the sine-squared shape and instead display a different U-shape in the middle of the chains. This motivates using the extent of the domain wall distribution tail in this regime as a platform independent metric that provides a signature of both coherence time and noise levels.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了受挫一维伊辛自旋链基态中畴壁的分布，以基准测试D-Wave的快速量子退火功能。研究发现，在相干时间更短的退火时间下，观察到了预期的正弦平方分布的相干量子行为。然而，对于最短的退火时间，动力学尚未达到正弦平方形状，而是呈现出链中间的U形分布。这表明畴壁分布的范围可以作为评估量子退火性能的有效指标。
authors: Shushmi Chowdhury, Asa Hopkins, Nick Chancellor, Viv Kendon

articles.title: Grow, Compress, and Perturb: A Hybrid Quantum-Classical Pathway to Scalable Quantum Chemistry on Quantum Computers
articles.title_zh: 增长、压缩与扰动：量子计算机上可扩展量子化学的混合量子-经典路径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40561v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) variants are among leading candidates for electronic structure calculations on quantum computers, gradient-based operator selection limits their scalability. To solve this, we introduce the Hamiltonian-gradient-free VULCAN (Variational Upbuilding, Layered Compression, Adaptive N-body perturbation) layered VQE framework. Our method dynamically generates ansatz operators using Variational Double Bracket Flow (VDBF) equations. Combined with a linearly scaling minimal complete pool, it creates a pool 4-12 times smaller than QEB (Qubit-Excitation-Based) pools. By appending entire layers simultaneously, Hamiltonian gradient measurements are completely eliminated. Circuit depth is managed via a grow-then-compress scheme using efficient state-overlap measurements, and qubit requirements are reduced by projecting the Hamiltonian onto a dominant-determinant subspace. Using high-performance emulation up to 32 logical qubits, we achieve chemical accuracy at just 5-20% of the measurement cost of batched ADAPT-VQE for hydrogen chains, BeH2 and H2O. For the 32-qubit C3H6, where batched ADAPT-VQE does not reach chemical accuracy, a single VULCAN layer combined with a GPU-accelerated stochastic Epstein-Nesbet (ENPT2) correction does. This stochastic ENPT2 post-processing step enables early termination at chemical accuracy.
articles.abstract_zh: 变分量子本征求解器（VQE）在量子计算机上进行电子结构计算方面面临可扩展性挑战。本文提出了一种无哈密顿量梯度的VULCAN分层VQE框架，通过变分双括号流方程动态生成ansatz算符，并结合线性缩放的最小完整池。该方法通过同时添加整个层来消除哈密顿量梯度测量，并通过“增长-压缩”方案管理电路深度。在高性仿真中，该方法在氢链、BeH2和H2O等分子上以较低的测量成本实现了化学精度。
authors: Hugo D. Nogueira, Siwar Badreddine, Olivier Adjoua, Diata Traore, Guillaume Michel, Jean-Philip Piquemal

articles.title: On the Quantum Chromatic Gap II
articles.title_zh: 关于量子色数间隙 II
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40571v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We confirm a conjecture of the first author [SODA'26] on a strong form of pseudo-telepathy for Khot's d-to-1 games: for every d≥ 4, every ϵ>0, and every kinmathbb N, there is a d-to-1 label-cover game of classical value less than ϵ that admits a perfect quantum strategy using finite-dimensional shared entanglement with measurement contexts of radius at least k. As a consequence, there exist graphs whose quantum chromatic number ḩi_q is 3 and whose classical chromatic number ḩi is arbitrarily large. This is the first improvement on the quantum chromatic gap since the work of Brassard, Cleve, and Tapp [Phys. Rev. Lett.'99], which produced graphs for which ḩi grows exponentially in ḩi_q. To prove the conjecture, we proceed as follows. We start with a ``stretched'' version of the Mermin--Peres magic square, obtained by spacing out its equations and linking them with additional long equation wires. This operation increases the radius of the initial measurement contexts of a perfect quantum strategy for the game, while preserving classical unsatisfiability. We then apply parallel repetition to make the classical value small, and we turn the system into a pseudo-telepathic multi-layered Kneser hypergraph via a PCP construction of Dinur, Guruswami, Khot, and Regev [STOC'03]. Finally, we feed the resulting hypergraph into the reduction of Fei, Minzer, and Wang from hypergraph colouring to 4-to-1 games, we establish quantum completeness of this reduction, and we show that it preserves context radius.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证实了关于Khot的d-to-1博弈中一种强形式的伪心灵感应的猜想。研究表明，存在量子色数χ_q为3而经典色数χ可以任意大的图，这是自Brassard等人工作以来量子色数间隙的首次改进。通过对Mermin-Peres魔方进行“拉伸”并应用并行重复，作者证明了该猜想。
authors: Lorenzo Ciardo, Antoine Mottet

articles.title: What Can Be Computed with Indefinite Causal Structure?
articles.title_zh: 不确定因果结构能计算什么？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40573v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Can quantum computation become more powerful when operations do not need to follow a definite causal order? We study this question in the process matrix formalism of Oreshkov et al. (Nature Communications, 2012), which allows quantum operations to be connected without a fixed global order. In the computational model, a quantum circuit succinctly describes a process matrix, and the algorithm is given access to its generated channel, with computational cost measured by the size of the generating circuit. We give polynomial-time algorithms in two settings. First, general process matrix computation suffices to solve every problem in NP. The valid processes used by our algorithm satisfy the purification postulate of Araújo et al. (Quantum, 2017), and their generated channels are unitary, although their generating circuits are not. Second, requiring the process matrices themselves to be pure, we give a polynomial-time algorithm for unique-sink orientation, a general problem capturing several longstanding computational problems in optimization. Our unitary generators are constructed explicitly and efficiently. Assuming that unique-sink orientation has no quantum polynomial-time algorithm, our result shows that indefinite causal order can provide computational power beyond BQP within the process matrix formalism, even while preserving unitarity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了当操作不需要遵循确定的因果顺序时，量子计算是否会变得更强大。在过程矩阵形式主义下，研究提出了两种设置下的多项式时间算法。首先，通用过程矩阵计算足以解决NP中的每个问题。其次，当过程矩阵本身是纯态时，作者为唯一汇点定向问题提供了一个多项式时间算法。
authors: Omri Shmueli

articles.title: Classical communication over quantum channels: does entanglement help in nature?
articles.title_zh: 量子信道上的经典通信：纠缠在自然界中是否有帮助？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40585v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Can entangling codewords across independent uses of a quantum channel improve the rate of classical communication? An old conjecture states that there is no such entanglement advantage for all channels. Although Hastings's result and follow-up works disproved this conjecture, it turns out that enormous dimension is required to construct a channel where entanglement enhances classical communication. This indicates that there might be no entanglement advantage for many physical channels, or for all low dimensional channels. Motivated by recent progress on (generalized) amplitude damping channels, we propose a general Schur-weighted block entropy inequality, and show that there is no entanglement advantage for all phase-covariant channels including multi-level amplitude damping channels, generalized dephasing channels, and damping-dephasing channels. As a by-product, we also recover the recently established result that there is no entanglement advantage for all qubit channels.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在量子信道上进行经典通信时，纠缠码字是否能提高通信速率。尽管先前的研究推翻了“所有信道都没有纠缠优势”的猜想，但构建具有纠缠优势的信道需要巨大的维度。受振幅阻尼信道进展的启发，本文提出了一个广义Schur加权块熵不等式，并证明了所有相位协变信道（包括多能级振幅阻尼信道和广义退相干信道）都没有纠缠优势。
authors: Peixue Wu

articles.title: Probing fluctuations in photon emission statistics of spin injected quantum dots with time dependent electronic excitation
articles.title_zh: 用时间依赖的电子激发探测自旋注入量子点光子发射统计中的涨落
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40593v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrically spin-injected ensembles of InGaAs/GaAs quantum dots emit circularly polarized single photons, with the emission helicity determined by the spin polarization of the injected electrons. A ferromagnetic CoFeB spin-injection layer with perpendicular magnetic anisotropy, combined with an MgO tunnel barrier, enables spin-polarized electron injection into the quantum-dot active region, resulting in circularly polarized photon emission at zero applied magnetic field. These devices realize direct spin-charge-photon conversion in an electrically driven, microelectronics-compatible quantum light source that operates without an external pump laser. Using an extended Hanbury Brown-Twiss interferometer with four detectors and time-tagged readout, we measure time-resolved photon-number statistics that resolve up to |2ångle Fock states within a single excitation cycle. While single-photon (n=|1ångle) emission tracks the electrical excitation pulse as expected, the two-photon (n=|2ångle) statistics exhibit pronounced fluctuations at multiple temporal positions within the pulse. These fluctuations vanish upon demagnetization of the spin-injection layer, establishing a direct link between the multi-photon emission dynamics and the spin polarization of the injected carriers. The observations indicate that spin injection controls not only the helicity of the emitted photons but also higher-order temporal correlations of the emission. The behavior is phenomenologically captured by inserting both a variable excitation mechanism and a set of multi-emitter collapse operators within a stochastic wave function evolution. The platform thus opens a route to electrically driven, spin-controlled single and multi-photon Fock-state sources and provides a testbed for spin-conditioned multi-emitter dynamics in solid-state quantum light sources.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了电注入自旋的InGaAs/GaAs量子点在时间依赖电子激发下的光子发射统计涨落。研究发现，虽然单光子发射遵循电激发脉冲，但双光子统计在脉冲内的多个时间位置表现出显著的涨落。这些涨落会在自旋注入层退磁后消失，表明它们与自旋注入过程密切相关。
authors: Chiran Wijesundara, Vincent Iglesias-Cardinale, Yuan Lu, Herbert Fotso, Bo Xu, Tim Thomay

articles.title: Optimal detuning and gate time for strongly driven single-qubit gates beyond the rotating-wave approximation
articles.title_zh: 超越旋转波近似的强驱动单量子比特门的最佳失谐和门时间
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40595v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Single-qubit quantum gates are implemented as the time-controlled unitary evolution of a two-level system under harmonic driving. The rotating-wave approximation (RWA) provides closed-form gate parameters for weak coupling. Larger amplitudes, desirable to speed up the dynamics, make the RWA-designed gates inaccurate because of the neglected counter-rotating term, which also shifts the resonance (Bloch-Siegert shift). Here we study theoretically the infidelity of gates beyond the RWA, using the effective Magnus-Taylor Hamiltonian through second order in the inverse of the driving frequency. By detuning the driving frequency by an amplitude-dependent shift of Bloch-Siegert type and rescaling the operation time, the RWA gate conditions are recovered with corrected parameters. Numerical solutions of the Schrodinger equation show that these corrections lower the gate infidelity by several orders of magnitude, extending the range of usable amplitudes
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论研究了超越旋转波近似（RWA）的强驱动单量子比特门的失真度。通过使用有效Magnus-Taylor哈密顿量，研究发现通过对驱动频率进行依赖于振幅的Bloch-Siegert型失谐并重新调整操作时间，可以恢复RWA门条件并获得修正参数。数值解表明，这些修正将门失真度降低了几个数量级，从而扩展了可用振幅的范围。
authors: Alejandro D. Bendersky, Sergio S. Gomez, Rodolfo H. Romero

articles.title: Exceptional Points as Witnesses of Non-Gaussian Noise
articles.title_zh: 奇异点作为非高斯噪声的证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40612v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Efficient control of quantum devices requires the knowledge of their environmental noise, yet the commonly measured power spectrum does not fully characterize non-Gaussian fluctuations of realistic environments. Here we show that exceptional points (EPs) in the noise-averaged dephasing response can expose observable signatures of non-Gaussian statistics, distinguishing environments with identical lower-order statistics. We also introduce a theoretical model that describes dephasing environments in terms of identical independent noise sources while preserving the power spectrum. Given a calibrated single-source model, the largest EP order extracted from the measured dephasing response determines the number of sources and predicts the higher-order statistics of the combined noise. We illustrate an atomtronic readout that maps distinct EP signatures onto an evolving ensemble-averaged atomic interference pattern. Our results connect non-Hermitian dynamics to environmental noise statistics, providing a route to characterize noise in quantum devices used in computing, metrology, and precision measurement.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，环境噪声的功率谱不足以完全表征非高斯涨落。研究表明，噪声平均退相干响应中的奇异点（EPs）可以揭示非高斯统计的可观测特征，从而区分具有相同低阶统计量的环境。作者还提出了一个理论模型来描述退相干环境，并展示了如何通过测量的退相干响应中提取的最大EP阶数来确定噪声源的数量并预测组合噪声的高阶统计量。
authors: Aritra Ghosh, Subhashish Banerjee, M. Bhattacharya

articles.title: Optimal Diamond Distance Estimation for Unitary Channels
articles.title_zh: 酉信道最优金刚石距离估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40623v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The diamond distance between two quantum channels determines the optimal probability of distinguishing them from a single use. We give a quantum algorithm that estimates the diamond distance between two unknown d-dimensional unitary channels to within additive error ǎrepsilon, using O(sqrtd/ǎrepsilon) queries to the unitary channels and their inverses. The query complexity is optimal, as it matches the lower bound due to Jeon and Oh (npj Quantum Inf. 2026).
articles.abstract_zh: 金刚石距离衡量了两个量子信道单次使用时区分它们的最佳概率。本文提出了一种量子算法，能够以加性误差ε估计两个未知d维酉信道之间的金刚石距离。该算法需要对酉信道及其逆信道进行O(√d/ε)次查询，并且其查询复杂度是最佳的，与现有下限相符。
authors: Jinge Bao, Qisheng Wang

articles.title: Left-Handed Transmission Lines for the Dynamical Casimir Effect
articles.title_zh: 用于动态卡西米尔效应的左手传输线
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40624v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Left-handed (LH) superconducting transmission lines, built with series capacitors and shunt inductors instead of the series inductors and shunt capacitors of a conventional right-handed (RH) line, have a spectrum with a nonzero lower band edge and modes that become sparse at high frequencies. We study the dynamical Casimir effect in a LH line terminated by a flux-modulated SQUID and compare it with an RH line built from the same elements and with a long coplanar waveguide terminated by the same SQUID. We derive the quantum Hamiltonian and show that the coupling between two modes factorizes into their amplitudes at the SQUID. Together, the LH spectrum and the mode dependence of this coupling determine which modes are populated and how fast. With equal elements, the LH coupling grows with frequency and exceeds the RH one above a crossover pump frequency set by the cell inductance and capacitance, and only the LH line has resonances above the RH band edge. Pumping two modes at once lets a weakly coupled mode borrow coupling from a strongly coupled one, while crossings of resonance lines populate three or four modes without increasing the growth rate. Compared with the coplanar waveguide, the LH line has a similar coupling but keeps the created particles in the target mode, whereas the nearly equidistant waveguide spreads them over many pairs and needs more pump energy.
articles.abstract_zh: 左手（LH）超导传输线具有非零的低频带边和在高频处稀疏的模式。本文研究了在由磁通调制SQUID终端的LH线中的动态卡西米尔效应，并与右手（RH）线进行了比较。研究推导了量子哈密顿量，并表明LH耦合随频率增长，在特定泵浦频率以上超过RH耦合。
authors: Valentin E. Salari, Fernando C. Lombardo, Paula I. Villar

articles.title: Comparison of entangling strategies for unitary synthesis
articles.title_zh: 酉合成中纠缠策略的比较
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40642v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Trapped-ion quantum computers are promising as a platform for realizing quantum computational advantage. They promise long coherence times, near all-to-all connectivity, and potential multiqubit gates as distinguishing advantages compared to competing platforms. Regarding these advantages, it is crucial to understand the trade-offs between increasing engineering complexity and actual improvements in running quantum algorithms with a more flexible gate set. In this work, we investigate this question and develop a versatile toolset to evaluate the performance of gate sets composed of native Mølmer--Sørensen multiqubit gates. To this end, we employ unitary synthesis as an application-agnostic benchmark target and identify specific hardware requirements for multiqubit gates to be advantageous.
articles.abstract_zh: 离子阱量子计算机在实现量子计算优势方面具有潜力，拥有长相干时间、近乎全连接和多量子比特门等优势。本文旨在理解工程复杂性增加与量子算法性能提升之间的权衡。研究开发了一套工具集，用于评估由原生Mølmer-Sørensen多量子比特门组成的门集的性能，并以酉合成作为基准，确定了多量子比特门具有优势所需的特定硬件要求。
authors: Jonas Wunder, Hendrik Weimer, Ricardo Costa de Almeida

articles.title: Reconstructing hidden observables via quantum snapshot thermometry
articles.title_zh: 通过量子快照测温法重建隐藏可观测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40652v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Projective snapshots are a standard readout tool for quantum simulators, but they directly probe only observables that are diagonal in the measurement basis. We show how local equilibration and an independently calibrated equilibrium equation of state can reveal otherwise hidden conserved-density profiles. We demonstrate numerically that such ``quantum snapshot thermometry'' can recover energy fronts and a diffusion constant, distinguish spin transport from energy spreading, and reveal conserved-charge profiles invisible in the initial measurements. We also identify symmetry-imposed ambiguities in the readout and show how prior knowledge of the spatial structure can resolve them. Fixed-basis snapshot thermometry thus provides quantitative hydrodynamic information beyond transport exponents, bypassing additional measurement bases and quantum state tomography.
articles.abstract_zh: 投影快照是量子模拟器的标准读出工具，但只能直接探测测量基底中对角化的可观测量。本文展示了局部平衡和独立校准的平衡态方程如何揭示隐藏的守恒密度分布。数值模拟表明，这种“量子快照测温法”可以恢复能量前沿和扩散常数，区分自旋输运与能量扩散，并揭示初始测量中不可见的守恒电荷分布。该方法提供超越输运指数的定量流体动力学信息。
authors: Jie Ren, Andrew Hallam, Luheng Zhao, Huanqian Loh, Zlatko Papić

articles.title: Time evolution in the multi-component dynamical Keldysh models
articles.title_zh: 多分量动态Keldysh模型中的时间演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38338v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We construct a time evolution operator for a dynamical quantum models with a multi-component random Gaussian field characterized by a long correlation time. We analyze three paradigmatic cases: non-Abelian SU(2) symmetry class for the three-component Gaussian noise and Abelian symmetry classes U(1) and Z₂ for the two- and one-component noises correspondingly. Starting with a limiting case of the infinite correlation time (Keldysh model) we shown that statistics of the two-component random field with a non-zero mean is described by the Rice distribution. We derived and solved the system of coupled linear differential equations for the exact diagonal and off-diagonal single-particle Green's functions. We showed how the finite time correlation in Keldysh models are accounted by a continuous fractions method.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了具有长关联时间的多分量随机高斯场的动态量子模型的时间演化算符。研究分析了非阿贝尔SU(2)对称类以及阿贝尔U(1)和Z₂对称类三种典型情况。从无限关联时间（Keldysh模型）的极限情况出发，推导并求解了精确对角和非对角单粒子格林函数的耦合线性微分方程组，并展示了如何通过连分数法处理Keldysh模型中的有限时间关联。
authors: M. N. Kiselev

articles.title: Probing micron-range fifth forces with cold atoms in optical tweezer arrays
articles.title_zh: 利用光镊阵列中的冷原子探测微米级第五种力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38660v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We propose a new method to search for fifth forces at micron scales, by resonantly exciting the motional state of ground-state-cooled atoms in optical tweezer arrays. We develop a homodyne readout protocol based on sideband thermometry, which can approach the Standard Quantum Limit, and expand the discovery reach for fifth forces by up to four orders of magnitude compared to existing constraints. We show that this level of sensitivity can also probe well-motivated models of extra dimensions beyond the current tabletop state of the art, by leveraging the parametric enhancement of higher-dimensional gravity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种探测微米尺度第五种力的新方法，通过共振激发光镊阵列中基态冷却原子的运动态。研究开发了一种基于边带测温的零差读出协议，该协议可接近标准量子极限，并将第五种力的探测范围比现有约束扩大了多达四个数量级。这种灵敏度水平还能探测超出当前桌面实验水平的额外维度模型。
authors: Marios Galanis, Andrew A. Geraci

articles.title: Quantum Observables of Nonperturbative Superradiant Scattering
articles.title_zh: 非微扰超辐射散射的量子可观测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38690v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Inelastic scattering from N coherent spins, or any two-state system, scales as N², invalidating the Born approximation at large N even at weak coupling. We develop a nonperturbative theory of this superradiant scattering and its backreaction on the spins. Since one particle can exchange many quanta, the target's energy-transfer and energy-variance rates keep their favorable N² scaling even after the cross section saturates, unless a conservation law limits each encounter to exchange of one quantum. We apply the theory to millicharged-particle searches, as well as neutron and charged-particle beams that can test quantum protocols for detecting cosmic relics.
articles.abstract_zh: N个相干自旋的非弹性散射呈N²标度，使得Born近似在大N弱耦合下失效。本文发展了一种非微扰理论来描述这种超辐射散射及其对自旋的反作用。研究表明，靶的能量转移和能量方差率即使在截面饱和后仍保持有利的N²标度，除非守恒定律限制每次相互作用只交换一个量子。该理论可应用于毫电荷粒子搜索以及中子和带电粒子束。
authors: Asimina Arvanitaki, Savas Dimopoulos, Marios Galanis, Derek J. Li

articles.title: From Entanglement Bootstrap to DHR Theory
articles.title_zh: 从纠缠自举到DHR理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38821v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We establish a direct connection between the entanglement bootstrap and the Doplicher--Haag--Roberts theory of superselection sectors for two-dimensional quantum spin systems. Under the entanglement-bootstrap assumptions, we prove Haag duality and establish a one-to-one correspondence between simple entanglement-bootstrap anyon types and irreducible superselection sectors. For each fusion channel, we further construct an affine bijection from density matrices on the entanglement-bootstrap fusion space to normalized positive intertwiners in the corresponding operator-algebraic fusion channel. These results connect the entropic and operator-algebraic descriptions of anyons directly, without passing through exactly solvable lattice models.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了二维量子自旋系统的纠缠自举与超选择扇区的Doplicher-Haag-Roberts (DHR) 理论之间的直接联系。在纠缠自举假设下，证明了Haag对偶性，并建立了简单的纠缠自举任意子类型与不可约超选择扇区之间的一一对应关系。这些结果直接连接了任意子的熵学和算子代数描述，无需通过精确可解的格点模型。
authors: Kohtaro Kato, Yoshiko Ogata

articles.title: The geometry of Floquet states
articles.title_zh: Floquet态的几何学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38845v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper studies the moduli space of "good" periodic Hamiltonians, i.e., periodic Hamiltonians with nondegenerate Floquet spectrum. The corresponding Floquet states determine a geometric model for the moduli space of such Hamiltonians. The model is expressed in terms of configuration spaces, flag manifolds, and principal bundles. A corollary of the main result is the complete determination of the rational cohomology ring of the space of good periodic Hamiltonians. The paper also considers the adiabatic driving of a 1-parameter family of good periodic Hamiltonians. We formulate two conjectures describing the resulting asymptotic quantum evolution. These are Floquet analogues of the adiabatic theorem in quantum mechanics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了“良好”周期哈密顿量（即具有非简并Floquet谱的周期哈密顿量）的模空间。相应的Floquet态为这类哈密顿量的模空间确定了一个几何模型，该模型用构型空间、旗流形和主丛表示。主要结果的一个推论是完全确定了良好周期哈密顿量空间的有理上同调环。文章还提出了两个描述渐近量子演化的猜想，它们是量子力学中绝热定理的Floquet类比。
authors: Vladimir Y. Cherynak, John R. Klein

articles.title: Mitigating Errors in Variational Quantum Eigensolver Calculations through Extended Random Phase Approximation
articles.title_zh: 通过扩展随机相近似减轻变分量子本征求解器计算中的误差
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38904v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum hardware noise remains a major obstacle to accurate molecular simulations using the variational quantum eigensolver (VQE). We introduce a novel error-mitigation strategy based on the extended random phase approximation (ERPA), which reconstructs the two-particle reduced density matrix (2-RDM) from approximate transition density matrices, effectively filtering errors in quantum measurements. Unlike quantum subspace expansion, the approach requires only the one- and two-particle RDMs. Since ERPA preserves the input 1-RDM, we further propose a hybrid quantum-classical scheme employing an inexpensive density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculation to provide a noise-free approximation to this quantity. Benchmarks on water double-bond stretching and cyclobutadiene automerization, performed on IBM quantum hardware, demonstrate reductions in energy errors by orders of magnitude. Combined with multireference adiabatic connection (AC0) corrections, the approach additionally recovers dynamical correlation beyond the active space, yielding accurate molecular potential energy curves and reaction barriers. Our results establish ERPA as a promising, measurement-efficient route toward reliable quantum-classical electronic structure calculations.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子硬件噪声是使用变分量子本征求解器（VQE）进行精确分子模拟的主要障碍。本文提出了一种基于扩展随机相近似（ERPA）的新型误差缓解策略，该方法通过近似跃迁密度矩阵重建两粒子约化密度矩阵，有效过滤量子测量中的误差。在IBM量子硬件上进行的基准测试表明，该方法能将能量误差降低数个数量级，并结合多参考绝热连接校正，可获得准确的分子势能曲线和反应势垒。
authors: Michael Wagner, Pavel Begy, Jiří Brabec, Alexandra Tucholská, Mikuláš Matoušek, Katarzyna Pernal, Libor Veis

articles.title: Spatial-Mode Selection for Local Mineral Absorption Spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 用于局部矿物吸收光谱的空间模式选择
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39221v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Absorption-band depth measures the fractional decrease in mineral reflectance below its local continuum. Recovering this feature strength for a small mineral region supports quantitative comparisons between regions, but diffraction mixes its light with the surroundings. Conventional spectral fitting can separate mean contributions; it cannot remove background photon noise already recorded. We develop a quantum-inspired measurement framework that uses spatial-mode demultiplexing (SPADE) to retain the target absorption response while reducing background acceptance before detection. The framework connects finite mineral-region geometry and reference spectra to estimation precision. A loss-dependent design condition identifies when adding SPADE exposure improves on direct imaging (DI) under fixed-response Poisson measurements with unknown scene parameters. Joint inference from initial DI observations and both mode ports estimates target depth together with an unknown, spatially shared background spectrum. In equal-time simulations that include localization uncertainty, alignment time, calibration, and detector costs, this acquisition reduces depth root-mean-square error (RMSE) by 14%--26% across five absorption strengths relative to all-pixel DI with the same background freedom. These results use a supplied target feature shape and geometry, with target continuum slope fitted and curvature fixed. The analysis separates optical selectivity from parameter ambiguity and acquisition cost, providing a quantitative basis for spatial-mode receiver design in local mineral spectroscopy.
articles.abstract_zh: 吸收带深度衡量矿物反射率相对于局部连续谱的下降比例。本文开发了一种受量子启发的测量框架，利用空间模式解复用（SPADE）在检测前保留目标吸收响应并减少背景接收。该框架将有限矿物区域几何和参考光谱与估计精度联系起来。在包含定位不确定性、对准时间、校准和探测器成本的等时模拟中，这种采集方法在估计目标深度和未知背景光谱方面表现出优势。
authors: Qipeng Qian, Jialiang Jin, Shihao Wang, Yuntao Qian

articles.title: Quantum field theory with scale-dependent weighted measures: nonlinear momentum representations, vacuum fluctuations, and causal structure
articles.title_zh: 具有尺度依赖加权测度的量子场论：非线性动量表示、真空涨落和因果结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39285v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We reconsider the construction of free quantum fields through momentum-space weighted measures, introducing an independent energy scale that restores the conventional theory at low momenta. The resulting family is characterized by a dimensionless spectral function and includes, as a distinguished case, the spatial weight associated with the Euclidean Snyder algebra. We discuss its relation to modified dispersion relations and nonlinear momentum coordinates, and introduce an observer-covariant spectral weight defined using a timelike four-velocity. For the complex Klein-Gordon field we obtain the equal-time algebra, conserved weighted observables, vacuum fluctuations, and two-point functions in arbitrary spatial dimension. The ultraviolet conditions for their finiteness are established, and the nonlocal causal structure is analyzed in terms of a spatial convolution of the ordinary Pauli-Jordan distribution. An illustrative interacting extension and numerical profiles of the kernels and amplitudes are also presented.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了通过动量空间加权测度构建自由量子场的方法，引入了一个独立的能量尺度，以在低动量下恢复传统理论。由此产生的理论家族由一个无量纲谱函数表征，并包括与欧几里得Snyder代数相关的空间权重作为特例。研究讨论了其与修正色散关系和非线性动量坐标的关系，并引入了一个观测者协变的谱权重。对于复Klein-Gordon场，作者推导了等时代数、守恒加权可观测量、真空涨落和两点函数，并分析了非局域因果结构。
authors: S. González-Salud, R. Cartas-Fuentevilla

articles.title: QSoftCore: A Conceptual Foundation for Quantum Software Engineering
articles.title_zh: QSoftCore：量子软件工程的概念基础
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39406v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum software engineering (QSE) requires understanding application requirements, quantum programs and algorithms, quantum computation paradigms, executions, and deployment. However, relevant quantum computing (QC) concepts are often defined across physical, mathematical, and paradigm-specific levels of abstraction, making it difficult for the QSE community and hence proposed methods to refer to them consistently. To this end, we present QSoftCore, a conceptual model that reorganizes established QC concepts from a software engineering perspective and connects quantum applications, computational problems, algorithms, configurations, programs, and paradigm-specific computation specifications with state evolution, execution results, and backends. Our assessment against QSE literature across key software engineering activities indicates that QSoftCore provides shared QC referents for quantum computations, executions, deployment configurations, backends, and measurement evidence across the QSE lifecycle.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子软件工程（QSE）需要理解跨越不同抽象层次的量子计算（QC）概念，这使得一致引用变得困难。本文提出了QSoftCore，一个从软件工程视角重组现有QC概念的概念模型。它将量子应用、计算问题、算法、配置、程序和范式特定计算规范与状态演化、执行结果和后端连接起来。评估表明，QSoftCore为QSE生命周期中的量子计算、执行、部署配置、后端和测量证据提供了共享的QC参照。
authors: Tao Yue, Yuechen Li, Man Zhang

articles.title: SeQUeNCe.DQC: Full-stack Simulation of Distributed Quantum Computing
articles.title_zh: SeQUeNCe.DQC：分布式量子计算的全栈模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39476v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Distributed quantum computing (DQC) connects multiple quantum processing units to overcome the scale limits of monolithic hardware. We introduce SeQUeNCe.DQC, a new top-level module within the SeQUeNCe package that compiles monolithic circuits into topology-aware execution plans and coordinates their execution using SeQUeNCe's existing quantum-network modules and protocols. We validate SeQUeNCe.DQC by reproducing a two-node trapped-ion Grover experiment in simulation and comparing success probabilities with the reported 71% benchmark. We then evaluate how compiler strategy, topology, and memory capacity jointly govern distributed circuit execution time and success rate. In these experiments, our hybrid compilers successfully identified mixed TeleGate/TeleData execution plans that outperformed pure gate-teleportation strategies. By capturing the physical overhead of distributed quantum primitives, SeQUeNCe.DQC provides a rigorous platform for co-designing DQC software and hardware architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 分布式量子计算（DQC）通过连接多个量子处理单元来克服单片硬件的规模限制。本文介绍了SeQUeNCe.DQC，这是SeQUeNCe包中的一个新模块，它能将单片电路编译成拓扑感知的执行计划，并利用SeQUeNCe现有的量子网络模块和协议协调其执行。该模块通过模拟双节点囚禁离子Grover实验并与基准成功概率进行比较来验证。研究评估了编译器策略、拓扑结构和内存容量如何共同影响分布式电路的执行时间和成功率，并表明混合编译器优于纯门隐形传态策略。
authors: Sanjay Suresh, Caitao Zhan, Joaquin Chung, Rajkumar Kettimuthu

articles.title: Automated Verification of Hamiltonian Simulation by Quantum Signal Processing
articles.title_zh: 基于量子信号处理的哈密顿量模拟的自动化验证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39491v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present, to the best of our knowledge, the first fully automated verification framework for QSP-based Hamiltonian simulation. Our framework exploits the structure of the simulation algorithm: Hamiltonians are given as weighted sums of Pauli strings, embedded into larger unitaries through block encodings, and transformed into time-evolution operators by quantum signal processing (QSP). Using a symbolic Pauli-sum semantics for ancilla-indexed circuit blocks, our verifier proves that the distinguished all-zero ancilla block is proportional to the target Hamiltonian and infers the subnormalization factor automatically. It then verifies the QSP layer by extracting the implemented polynomial transformation and certifying its approximation error. This structure-aware abstraction is essential for scalability. Composing our verified block encoding and QSP wrapper yields an estimated macro-expanded size of about 1.52 million gates. The verifier certifies the block encoding once and checks the QSP layer through its abstract interface, without expanding the oracle calls. Our implementation verifies block encodings of structured Pauli-sum Hamiltonians with up to 256 system qubits and verifies QSP Hamiltonian-simulation instances by extracting their implemented polynomials and checking the resulting approximation bounds. These results show that fully automated verification can handle common Hamiltonian-simulation circuits at substantial scale when it exploits their algorithmic structure.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了首个针对基于量子信号处理（QSP）的哈密顿量模拟的完全自动化验证框架。该框架利用了模拟算法的结构：哈密顿量表示为泡利串的加权和，通过块编码嵌入到更大的酉算符中，并通过QSP转换为时间演化算符。验证器利用辅助索引电路块的符号泡利和语义，证明了特定的全零辅助块与目标哈密顿量成比例，并自动推断出次归一化因子。随后，它通过提取实现的量子多项式变换并认证其近似误差来验证QSP层。
authors: Min Lai, Yu-Fang Chen, Shih-Han Hung

articles.title: Kelvin-Wave Multiplication by Sound Emission
articles.title_zh: 声发射引起的开尔文波倍增
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39909v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A subsonic Kelvin quantum can emit a phonon and split into two softer quanta, increasing Kelvin population while losing energy. In the soft-phonon limit, rotational invariance relates the leading acoustic shear amplitude, odd under reversal of phonon axial momentum, to the energy released. Microscopic calculations support this dispersion dependence. In a reflecting cavity with coherent sound and Kelvin seeds, Gross--Pitaevskii evolution shows Kelvin gain, larger mean-square displacement and smaller mean-square slope; a π shift of the initial sound phase reverses these changes.
articles.abstract_zh: 一个亚声速的开尔文量子可以发射一个声子并分裂成两个能量更低的量子，从而增加开尔文波群数量同时损失能量。在软声子极限下，旋转不变性将领先的声学剪切振幅与释放的能量联系起来。微观计算支持这种色散依赖性。在具有相干声波和开尔文波种子的反射腔中，Gross-Pitaevskii演化显示开尔文波增益、更大的均方位移和更小的均方斜率；初始声波相位的π偏移会逆转这些变化。
authors: Weican Yang

articles.title: Nonequilibrium statistical thermodynamics of a small quantum system coupled to quantum reservoirs
articles.title_zh: 小量子系统与量子储层耦合的非平衡统计热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39973v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A statistical mechanical formulation where nonequilibrium averages of selected quantum observables are given exactly as averages over local density operators is used to describe the dynamics and thermodynamics of a small quantum system coupled to reservoirs. The local density operators are functionals of constraint variables that play the role of thermodynamic forces that satisfy a set of equations of motion. A focus of the work is on the evolution of the average internal energy of the quantum subsystem that may be subject to external autonomous driving that does work on the system, and on entropy production in the system. The nonequilibrium statistical thermodynamics the quantum subsystem coupled to reservoirs, as well as that for the isolated subsystem and reservoirs, are discussed. When the subsystem is coupled to large quantum reservoirs, the effects of the quantum subsystem on the reservoirs can be captured through boundary conditions on the reservoir equations, and these boundary conditions are derived. The formulation is illustrated by considering the heat transfer through a system comprising a quantum system coupled to two heat reservoirs with different temperatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用一种统计力学公式，其中选定量子可观测量的非平衡平均值精确地表示为局部密度算符的平均值，以描述与储层耦合的小量子系统的动力学和热力学。研究重点关注受外部自主驱动做功的量子子系统平均内能的演化以及系统中的熵产生。当子系统与大型量子储层耦合时，量子子系统对储层的影响可以通过储层方程的边界条件来捕捉，并且这些边界条件被推导出来。
authors: Jeremy Schofield, Raymond Kapral

articles.title: A density calculus for quantum field theory
articles.title_zh: 量子场论的密度演算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40174v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: These notes provide an introduction to Haagerup noncommutative L^p spaces for quantum field theorists. The aim is to explain how the familiar calculus of density matrices, fractional powers, and Schatten norms extends to local observable algebras of type~III, where an intrinsic trace is unavailable. We develop the construction first for a matrix algebra, making the crossed product, its trace, and the dual action explicit, before passing to general von Neumann algebras. Particular attention is paid to the representation of normal states by Haagerup densities and to the distinction between the crossed-product trace and the canonical Haagerup functional used to compute expectation values. As a concrete application, we calculate the sandwiched Rényi divergence for a coherent excitation of a chiral current, verifying monotonicity under restriction and the Rényi quantum null energy condition at every real order α>1. The presentation assumes familiarity with quantum mechanics and elementary quantum field theory, while introducing the operator-algebraic concepts needed for the construction and calculation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为量子场论学家介绍了Haagerup非交换L^p空间，解释了密度矩阵、分数幂和Schatten范数的熟悉演算如何扩展到无法获得内禀迹的III型局部可观测代数。作者首先为矩阵代数开发了构造，然后推广到一般的冯诺依曼代数。文中特别关注了Haagerup密度对正态的表示，以及交叉积迹与用于计算期望值的规范Haagerup泛函之间的区别。作为一个具体应用，计算了手性电流相干激发的夹心Rényi散度，验证了其在限制下的单调性和Rényi量子零能量条件。
authors: Tanay Kibe, Pratik Roy

articles.title: Stabilizing fluctuating Cooper pairs with a terahertz resonator
articles.title_zh: 利用太赫兹谐振器稳定涨落的库珀对
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40222v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Coupling quantum materials to electromagnetic cavities or resonators without external driving has gained prominence as a new control mechanism. Here we develop an equilibrium theory of a mesoscopic, disordered two-dimensional superconductor coupled to a subwavelength terahertz resonator, focusing on the interplay between superconducting phase fluctuations in the sample and electromagnetic fluctuations of the resonator. Modeling the resonator as a lumped-element circuit, we show that the coupling enhances, rather than suppresses, the superconducting transition temperature T_c. When the sample is smaller than the Pearl length, phase fluctuations near the Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless (BKT) transition strongly amplify this enhancement. Crucially, the resistive quasiparticle response of the sample must be included in the analysis: at low frequencies the superfluid shunts the normal-fluid channel, reducing the total sample impedance. For representative parameters, a 1 ,μm × 1 ,μm, 8 nm-thick disordered film, we find a relative T_c enhancement of about 1%, an order of magnitude larger than the 0.1%  obtained when phase fluctuations are neglected. These results identify superconductors with soft phase fluctuations as promising platforms for equilibrium control with terahertz resonators.
articles.abstract_zh: 将量子材料与电磁腔或谐振器耦合已成为一种新的控制机制。本文发展了一种介观、无序二维超导体与亚波长太赫兹谐振器耦合的平衡理论，重点研究了样品中超导相涨落与谐振器电磁涨落之间的相互作用。将谐振器建模为集总元件电路，研究表明这种耦合增强而非抑制了超导转变温度T_c。当样品尺寸小于Pearl长度时，Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) 转变附近的相涨落会显著放大这种增强效应。
authors: Frieder Lindel, Jonathan B. Curtis, Jérôme Faist, Eugene Demler

articles.title: Three-dimensional QCA that are not stably circuits
articles.title_zh: 非稳定电路的三维量子元胞自动机
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40235v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We prove that the three-dimensional chiral Zₚ Clifford quantum cellular automata of Haah and of Sun--Yang--Wang--Tantivasadakarn--Chen are, for every odd prime p, not finite-depth quantum circuits, even after tensoring with arbitrary ancillary degrees of freedom and composing with translations. Previously such statements were known only inside the Clifford category. As a consequence, the group of three-dimensional QCA modulo stabilized circuits and translations is not finitely generated. The key ingredient is a new invariant of invertible subalgebras, which we conjecture to be the square of the total quantum dimension of the hosted anyon theory, modulo rational squares.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了对于每个奇素数p，Haah以及Sun-Yang-Wang-Tantivasadakarn-Chen提出的三维手性Zₚ Clifford量子元胞自动机（QCA）并非有限深度量子电路，即使在与任意辅助自由度张量积并与平移复合之后也是如此。此前，此类结论仅在Clifford范畴内已知。因此，三维QCA模稳定电路和平移的群不是有限生成的。其关键在于可逆子代数的一个新不变量，该不变量被推测为所承载任意子理论的总量子维度的平方，模有理平方。
authors: Bowen Yang

articles.title: Collaborative AI agents for autonomous experimental research with solid-state quantum spins
articles.title_zh: 用于固态量子自旋自主实验研究的协作式人工智能代理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40589v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: An autonomous research laboratory could conduct an entire study, from formulating questions to preparing manuscripts. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers one route towards this goal. Recent AI systems take on several research roles, but may draw conclusions that the evidence does not support. Here, we present an autonomous research laboratory in which agents based on large language models assess one another's work and can stop or redirect investigations. They can generate and reject research questions, require separate theoretical checks and conduct experiments designed to challenge their claims. We demonstrate these capabilities by investigating ensembles of quantum spins in diamond. The agents derived the minimum number of calibration settings needed to predict responses to a defined family of microwave pulse sequences. They checked the result computationally and designed experiments to distinguish competing predictions. An initial experiment agreed with the theoretical predictions, but repeated reference measurements showed that the signal was drifting during data collection. The agents therefore treated the result as inconclusive and revised the measurement protocol without relaxing the acceptance criteria. The revised experiment met those criteria and supported the theoretical predictions. This study demonstrates that collaborating AI agents can select research questions, derive theoretical results and test their predictions experimentally.
articles.abstract_zh: 建立一个能够进行完整研究的自主研究实验室是人工智能（AI）的一个目标，但现有AI系统可能得出缺乏证据支持的结论。本文介绍了一个自主研究实验室，其中基于大型语言模型（LLM）的代理能够相互评估工作，并可以停止或重新定向研究。这些代理能够生成和拒绝研究问题，要求进行独立的理论检查，并设计实验来挑战其主张。通过研究金刚石中的量子自旋集合，该系统展示了其能力，包括推导微波脉冲序列所需的最小校准设置，并通过计算进行验证。
authors: El Mustapha Mansouri, Eikichi Kimura, Masato Koga, Keigo Arai

articles.title: A quantum central path algorithm for linear optimization
articles.title_zh: 一种用于线性优化的量子中心路径算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2311.03977v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose a novel quantum algorithm for solving linear optimization problems by quantum-mechanical simulation of the central path. While interior point methods follow the central path with an iterative algorithm that works with successive linearizations of the perturbed KKT conditions, we perform a simulation working directly with the nonlinear complementarity equations. Using a two-stage quantum eigenpath traversal schedule, this approach yields an algorithm for solving linear optimization problems involving m constraints and n variables to ǎrepsilon-optimality using widetildeO!łeft((m+n)³/²,ǎrepsilon⁻¹+(m+n)¹/²,ǎrepsilon⁻³/²i̊ght) queries to an oracle that evaluates a potential function. In the standard gate model (i.e., without access to quantum RAM), our algorithm can obtain ǎrepsilon-precise solutions to LO problems using at most widetildeO!łeft(łeft[frac(m+n)³/²ǎrepsilon + frac(m+n)¹/²ǎrepsilon³/²i̊ght] ḑot nnz(A)i̊ght) elementary gates, where nnz(A) is the total number of non-zero elements found in the constraint matrix.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的量子算法，通过对中心路径进行量子力学模拟来解决线性优化（LO）问题。与通过连续线性化处理扰动KKT条件的迭代内点法不同，该方法直接模拟非线性互补方程。利用两阶段量子本征路径遍历调度，该算法能够以特定的查询和门复杂度将LO问题求解到ε-最优。在标准门模型下，该算法能够以~O([(m+n)³/²ε + (m+n)¹/²ε³/²] * nnz(A))的基本门操作获得ε精确解。
authors: Brandon Augustino, Jiaqi Leng, Jialu Bao, Giacomo Nannicini, Tamás Terlaky, Xiaodi Wu

articles.title: Security of hybrid BB84 with heterodyne detection
articles.title_zh: 采用外差检测的混合BB84协议的安全性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2402.16941v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum key distribution (QKD) promises everlasting security based on the laws of physics. Most common protocols are grouped into two distinct categories based on the degrees of freedom used to carry information, which can be either discrete or continuous, each presenting unique advantages in either performance, feasibility for near-term implementation, and compatibility with existing telecommunications architectures. Recently, hybrid QKD protocols have been introduced to leverage advantages from both categories. In this work we provide a rigorous security proof for a protocol introduced by Qi in 2021, where information is encoded in discrete variables as in the widespread Bennett Brassard 1984 protocol but decoded continuously via heterodyne detection. Security proofs for hybrid protocols inherit the same challenges associated with continuous-variable protocols due to unbounded dimensions. Here we successfully address these challenges by exploiting symmetry. Our approach enables truncation of the Hilbert space with precise control of the approximation errors and lead to a tight, semi-analytical expression for the asymptotic key rate under collective attacks. As concrete examples, we apply our theory to compute the key rates under passive attacks, linear loss, and Gaussian noise.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子密钥分发（QKD）承诺基于物理定律的永恒安全性，其协议通常分为离散变量和连续变量两类。混合QKD协议旨在结合两者的优势。本文为Qi在2021年提出的协议提供了严格的安全性证明，该协议将信息编码在离散变量中（如BB84），但通过外差检测进行连续解码。混合协议的安全性证明面临无限维度的挑战，本文通过利用对称性成功解决了这些挑战。这种方法实现了希尔伯特空间的截断，并精确控制了近似误差，从而得到了渐近密钥率的紧密半解析表达式。
authors: Jasminder S. Sidhu, Rocco Maggi, Saverio Pascazio, Cosmo Lupo

articles.title: ShotQC: Reducing Sampling Overhead in Quantum Circuit Cutting
articles.title_zh: ShotQC：减少量子电路切割中的采样开销
articles.abstract: arXiv:2412.17704v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The recently developed quantum circuit cutting technique greatly extends the capabilities of current noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) hardware. However, it introduces substantial overhead in both classical postprocessing and quantum resources, as the postprocessing complexity and sampling cost scale exponentially with the number of circuit cuts. In this work, we propose an enhanced circuit cutting framework, ShotQC, which effectively reduces the sampling overhead through two key optimizations: shot distribution and cut parameterization. The former employs an adaptive Monte Carlo strategy to dynamically allocate more quantum shots to subcircuit configurations that contribute more to the variance in the final outcome. The latter exploits additional degrees of freedom in postprocessing to further suppress variance. Integrating these optimizations, ShotQC significantly reduces the sampling overhead without increasing classical postprocessing complexity, as demonstrated across a range of benchmark circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子电路切割技术显著扩展了NISQ硬件的能力，但其采样成本随切割数量呈指数级增长。本文提出了ShotQC框架，通过“采样分布”和“切割参数化”两种优化策略有效降低采样开销。采样分布采用自适应蒙特卡洛方法，动态分配更多量子采样到方差贡献大的子电路配置。切割参数化则利用后处理中的额外自由度进一步抑制方差，从而在不增加经典后处理复杂性的前提下显著减少采样开销。
authors: Po-Hung Chen, Bo-Hung Chen, Dah-Wei Chiou, Jie-Hong Roland Jiang

articles.title: Classification of locality preserving symmetries on spin chains
articles.title_zh: 自旋链上局域保持对称性的分类
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.15088v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We consider the action of a finite group G by locality preserving automorphisms (quantum cellular automata) on quantum spin chains. We refer to such group actions as ``symmetries''. The natural notion of equivalence for such symmetries is emphstable equivalence, which allows for stacking with factorized group actions. Stacking also endows the set of equivalence classes with a group structure. We prove that the anomaly of such symmetries provides an isomorphism between the group of stable equivalence classes of symmetries with the cohomology group H³⁽G,U(1)), consistent with previous conjectures. This amounts to a complete classification of locality preserving symmetries on spin chains.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了有限群G通过局域保持自同构（量子元胞自动机）作用于量子自旋链的情况，将其称为“对称性”。作者证明了这种对称性的反常性提供了对称性稳定等价类群与上同调群H³(G,U(1))之间的同构，这与先前的猜想一致。该结果为自旋链上局域保持对称性提供了完整的分类。
authors: Alex Bols, Wojciech De Roeck, Michiel De Wilde, Bruno de O. Carvalho

articles.title: Tight Generalization of Robertson-Type Uncertainty Relations
articles.title_zh: 罗伯逊型不确定关系的最紧密推广
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.19861v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We establish the tightest possible Robertson-type preparation uncertainty relation, which explicitly depends on the eigenvalues of the quantum state. The conventional constant  tfrac14  is replaced by the state-dependent coefficient [ frac(łambdaₘₐₓ + łambdaₘᵢₙ)²4(łambdaₘₐₓ - łambdaₘᵢₙ)², ] where  łambdaₘₐₓ  and łambdaₘᵢₙ denote the largest and smallest eigenvalues of the density operator  h̊o , respectively. We prove that this coefficient is optimal among all Robertson-type generalizations and does not admit further improvement. We also obtain a complete characterization of all nontrivial equality cases. Our relation becomes more pronounced as the quantum state becomes more mixed, capturing a trade-off in quantum uncertainty that the conventional Robertson's relation fails to detect. In addition, our result also provides a strict generalization of the Schrödinger's uncertainty relation, showing that the uncertainty trade-off is governed by the sum of the covariance term and a state-dependent improvement over the Robertson bound. As applications, we also refine error-disturbance trade-offs by incorporating spectral information of both the system and the measuring apparatus, thereby generalizing the Arthurs-Goodman and Ozawa inequalities.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了最紧密的罗伯逊型制备不确定关系，该关系明确依赖于量子态的本征值。传统的常数1/4被一个与态相关的系数取代，该系数由密度算符的最大和最小本征值决定，并被证明是所有罗伯逊型推广中最优的。该关系在量子态混合度增加时更为显著，捕捉了传统罗伯逊关系未能检测到的量子不确定性权衡。此外，它还严格推广了薛定谔不确定关系，表明不确定性权衡由协方差项和对罗伯逊界限的态依赖改进项共同决定。
authors: Gen Kimura, Aina Mayumi, Haruki Yamashita

articles.title: Partitions in quantum theory
articles.title_zh: 量子理论中的划分
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.22218v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Decompositional theories describe the ways in which a global physical system can be split into subsystems, facilitating the study of how different possible partitions of the same system interplay, e.g. in terms of inclusions or signalling. In quantum theory, subsystems are usually framed as sub-C*-algebras of the algebra of operators on the global system. However, most decompositional approaches have so far restricted their scope to the case of systems corresponding to factor algebras. We argue that this is a mistake: one should cater for the possibility for non-factor subsystems, arising for instance from symmetry considerations. Building on simple examples, we motivate and present a definition of partitions into an arbitrary number of parts, each of which is a possibly non-factor sub-C*-algebra. We discuss its physical interpretation and study its properties, in particular with regard to the structure of algebras' centres. We prove that partitions, defined at the C*-algebraic level, can be represented in terms of a splitting of Hilbert spaces, using the framework of routed quantum circuits. For some partitions, however, such a representation necessarily retains a residual pseudo-nonlocality. We provide an example of this behaviour, given by the partition of a fermionic system into local modes.
articles.abstract_zh: 分解理论描述了全局物理系统如何划分为子系统，有助于研究同一系统的不同划分之间的相互作用。在量子理论中，子系统通常被视为全局系统算符代数的子C*-代数，但现有方法多限于因子代数。本文认为应考虑非因子子系统的可能性，并提出了将系统划分为任意数量部分的定义，每个部分都是一个可能非因子的子C*-代数。作者讨论了其物理诠释和性质，并证明了C*-代数层面的划分可以通过路由量子电路框架表示为希尔伯特空间的分裂。
authors: Augustin Vanrietvelde, Octave Mestoudjian, Pablo Arrighi

articles.title: Brace for impact: ECDLP challenges for quantum cryptanalysis
articles.title_zh: 迎接挑战：量子密码分析的ECDLP难题
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.14011v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Precise suites of benchmarks are required to assess the progress of early fault-tolerant quantum computers at economically impactful applications such as cryptanalysis. Appropriate challenges exist for factoring but those for elliptic curve cryptography are either too sparse or inadequate for standard applications of Shor's algorithm. We introduce a difficulty-graded suite of elliptic curve discrete logarithm (ECDLP) challenges that use Bitcoin's curve y²⁼x³⁺⁷ mod p while incrementally lowering the prime field from 256 down to 6 bits. For each bit-length, we provide the prime, the prime group order, and two deterministic nothing-up-my-sleeve (NUMS) points in compressed SEC1 form. All challenges are generated by a deterministic, reproducible procedure, and no private challenge scalar is chosen in advance. We calibrate classical cost against Pollard's rho records and quantum cost against resource estimation results for Shor's algorithm. We compile Shor's ECDLP circuit to logical counts and map them to physical resources for various parameters of the surface code, the repetition cat code and the LDPC cat codes. Under explicit and testable assumptions on physical error rates, code distances, and non-Clifford supply, our scenarios place the full 256-bit instance within a 2027--2033 window. The challenge ladder thus offers a transparent ruler to track fault-tolerant progress on a cryptanalytic target of immediate relevance, and it motivates proactive migration of digital assets to post-quantum signatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 为了评估早期容错量子计算机在密码分析等经济影响应用上的进展，需要精确的基准测试套件。本文引入了一套难度分级的椭圆曲线离散对数（ECDLP）挑战，使用比特币的曲线y²=x³+7 mod p，并将素数域从256位逐步降低到6位。所有挑战均通过确定性、可复现的程序生成，并提供了每个位长的素数、素数群阶和两个确定性NUMS点。作者校准了经典成本与Pollard's rho记录，以及量子成本与Shor算法的资源估算结果，为表面码等不同参数下的Shor ECDLP电路进行了物理资源映射。
authors: Pierre-Luc Dallaire-Demers, William Doyle, Timothy Foo

articles.title: Measurement-Based Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computation on High-Connectivity Devices: A Resource-Efficient Approach toward Early FTQC
articles.title_zh: 高连接度设备上的基于测量的容错量子计算：一种面向早期FTQC的资源高效方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.18652v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose a measurement-based fault-tolerant quantum computing (MB-FTQC) architecture for high-connectivity platforms, targeting early-FTQC devices with thousands to tens of thousands of physical qubits. Unlike earlier teleportation-based architectures that rely on code concatenation for scalability, MB-FTQC operates in a zero-concatenation regime with compact fixed-distance codes, keeping the qubit overhead within reach of such devices. MB-FTQC combines offline-verified logical resource states with Knill's error-correcting teleportation, allowing each online step to use single-round syndrome extraction and independent lookup-table decoding. Under circuit-level depolarizing noise, we study a Steane-code implementation with partially fault-tolerant analog R_Z(θ) rotations and a Golay-code implementation with higher-order zero-level distillation for fault-tolerant T-state preparation. At a physical error rate of 10⁻⁴, our estimates give a megaquop-scale equivalent T-count of 1.89×10⁶ for the Steane implementation and a gigaquop-scale characteristic T-count of 1.87×10⁹ for the Golay implementation. With sufficient parallel resource supply, MB-FTQC achieves a short online critical path, while resource estimates including verification failures and retries show competitive spacetime costs. These results show that compact, fixed-distance codes can support fault-tolerant computation at substantial scales in the early-FTQC regime, without code concatenation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种针对高连接度平台（数千到数万物理量子比特）的基于测量的容错量子计算（MB-FTQC）架构。与依赖代码级联的传统架构不同，MB-FTQC在零级联状态下运行，采用紧凑的固定距离编码，使量子比特开销在早期FTQC设备的承受范围内。MB-FTQC结合了离线验证的逻辑资源态和Knill的纠错隐形传态，允许每个在线步骤使用单轮综合征提取和独立的查找表解码。在物理错误率为10⁻⁴时，Steane码实现可达到百万quop级的等效T门计数，Golay码实现可达到十亿quop级的特征T门计数。
authors: Yohei Ibe, Yutaka Hirano, Yasuo Ozu, Toru Kawakubo, Keisuke Fujii

articles.title: Quantum Orthogonal Separable Physics-Informed Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 量子正交可分离物理信息神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.12613v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce Quantum Orthogonal Separable Physics-Informed Neural Networks (QO-SPINNs), which replace selected dense hidden transformations in physics-informed PDE models with quantum-compatible orthogonal maps. A pyramidal reconfigurable-beamsplitter circuit realizes these maps with Θ(d) circuit depth. Under the stated signed-readout access model and fixed per-call failure probability, a width-d map has sequential access-cost upper bound mathcal O(dłog d/ϵ²⁾, which is asymptotically smaller than the Θ(d²⁾ cost of conventional direct dense multiplication when ϵ(d)⁻²łog d=o(d). Because unary state preparation discards magnitude, we retain each hidden-state norm classically and restore it after readout, yielding the exact map Wh under ideal readout. We study this construction in two complementary settings: forward PDE regression and a norm-controlled residual model for representation geometry and uncertainty quantification. In the norm-controlled model, structural orthogonality yields explicit bi-Lipschitz bounds, while finite-readout analysis relates sufficient reconstruction precision to a prescribed physical-coordinate resolution through trained-model constants. This makes the access-cost condition assessable for trained checkpoints, although favorable fixed-resolution scaling across widths is not established. A post-hoc Bayesian-linear covariance provides uncertainty from the same frozen predictor, and cross-PDE transfer shows that strong distance-awareness can persist even when absolute coverage calibration fails. All Quantum Orthogonal (QO) layers are evaluated by classical simulation: the results therefore characterize a quantum-compatible structured neural primitive rather than demonstrating a practical quantum-hardware advantage.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了量子正交可分离物理信息神经网络（QO-SPINNs），它用量子兼容的正交映射取代了物理信息偏微分方程模型中选定的密集隐藏变换。这些映射通过金字塔形可重构分束器电路实现，电路深度为Θ(d)。在给定带符号读出访问模型和固定每次调用失败概率下，宽度为d的映射的顺序访问成本上限为O(d log d/ϵ²)。该工作在正向偏微分方程回归和范数控制残差模型两种互补设置中研究了这种结构，其中结构正交性产生了显式的双Lipschitz界限。
authors: Pietro Zanotta, Ljubomir Budinski, Caglar Aytekin, Valtteri Lahtinen

articles.title: Some Mechanisms for the Quantum Mpemba Effect
articles.title_zh: 量子姆潘巴效应的一些机制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.13509v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In recent years, the quantum Mpemba effect (QME) which occurs when an out-of-equilibrium system reaches equilibrium faster than another that is closer to equilibrium has attracted significant attention from the scientific community as an intriguing and counterintuitive phenomenon. It generalizes its classical counterpart, extending the concept beyond thermal equilibration. This paper approaches the QME for Markovian open quantum systems from different perspectives. Firstly, we propose a physical mechanism based on decoherence-free subspaces. Secondly, we show that a macroscopic enhancement of the decay rate that scales linearly with system size can be obtained, leading to an extreme version of the phenomenon on Markovian open quantum systems. Thirdly, we study the Mpemba effect through the unravelings of Davies maps, revealing subtleties in the figures of merit which are chosen for obtaining the QME. Lastly, we propose a microscopic model for a better understanding of thermal bath dynamics in this context.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子姆潘巴效应（QME）指一个非平衡系统比另一个更接近平衡的系统更快达到平衡，近年来引起了广泛关注。本文从不同角度探讨了马尔可夫开放量子系统中的QME。首先，提出了一种基于无退相干子空间的物理机制。其次，展示了衰减速率的宏观增强可以与系统大小呈线性关系，导致马尔可夫开放量子系统中的极端QME。最后，通过Davies映射的展开研究了姆潘巴效应，并提出了一个微观模型以更好地理解热浴动力学。
authors: Rodrigo F. Saliba, Vitor M. Pereira, Raphael C. Drumond

articles.title: Hybrid Quantum Repeater Chains with Atom-based Quantum Processing Units and Quantum Memory Multiplexers
articles.title_zh: 基于原子的量子处理单元和量子存储多路复用器的混合量子中继链
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.21655v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum repeaters enable the generation of reliable entanglement across long distances despite the underlying channel noise. Nevertheless, realizing quantum repeaters poses a difficult engineering challenge due to various device constraints and design tradeoffs. Herein we propose and analyze an efficient hybrid quantum repeater design that integrates atom-based quantum processing units, spontaneous parametric down-conversion photon sources, and atomic frequency comb quantum memories. Our design leverages the strong spectrotemporal multiplexing capability of the quantum memory to enable high-rate elementary-link entanglement generation between repeater nodes. Transferring the photonic entanglement into matter-qubit entanglement, together with deterministic quantum operations, further enables reliable long-distance entanglement distribution. We analyze photon-loss channels in the hybrid architecture and propose suitable error-suppression strategies that are natively incorporated into our repeater protocol. Using numerical simulations, we demonstrate the advantages of our hybrid design for end-to-end secret key rates in a linear repeater-chain model. With continued advances in relevant hardware technologies, we envision that the proposed hybrid design is well suited for large-scale quantum networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子中继器能够克服信道噪声，实现远距离可靠纠缠生成，但其工程实现面临挑战。本文提出并分析了一种高效的混合量子中继器设计，集成了基于原子的量子处理单元、自发参量下转换光子源和原子频率梳量子存储器。该设计利用量子存储器的强大光谱时间多路复用能力，实现中继节点间高速率的基本链路纠缠生成。通过将光子纠缠转移到物质量子比特纠缠，结合确定性量子操作，进一步实现了可靠的远距离纠缠分发。数值模拟展示了该混合设计在线性中继器中端到端密钥速率方面的优势。
authors: Shin Sun, Daniel Bhatti, Shaobo Gao, David Elkouss, Hiroki Takahashi

articles.title: Gauge-Invariant Phase Mapping to Intensity Lobes of Structured Light via Closed-Loop Atomic Dark States
articles.title_zh: 通过闭环原子暗态将规范不变相位映射到结构光的强度瓣
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.23642v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present an analytical model showing how the gauge-invariant loop phase in a three-level closed-loop atomic system imprints as bright-dark lobes in Laguerre Gaussian probe beam intensity patterns. In the weak probe limit, the output intensity in such systems include Beer-Lambert absorption, a scattering term and loop phase dependent interference term with optical depth controlling visibility. These systems enable mapping of arbitrary phases via interference rotation and offer a platform to measure Berry phase. Berry phase emerge as a geometric holonomy acquired by the dark states during adiabatic traversal of LG phase defined in a toroidal parameter space. Manifesting as fringe shifts which are absent in open systems, experimental realization using cold atoms or solid state platforms appears feasible, positioning structured light in closed-loop systems as ideal testbeds for geometric phases in quantum optics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个分析模型，展示了三能级闭环原子系统中的规范不变环路相位如何以亮暗瓣的形式印刻在拉盖尔-高斯探测光束的强度模式中。在弱探测极限下，输出强度包含比尔-朗伯吸收、散射项以及依赖于环路相位的干涉项，其中光学深度控制可见度。这些系统能够通过干涉旋转映射任意相位，并提供测量贝里相位的平台。贝里相位表现为暗态在绝热遍历拉盖尔-高斯相位定义的环形参数空间时获得的几何全息，其条纹位移在开放系统中不存在。该工作将结构光在闭环系统中定位为量子光学中几何相位的理想测试平台。
authors: Nayan Sharma, Ajay Tripathi

articles.title: Trainable, self-verifying variational quantum eigensolver using adiabatic warm starts
articles.title_zh: 使用绝热热启动的可训练、自验证变分量子本征求解器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.17612v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study an adiabatic variant of the variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) in which VQE is performed iteratively for a sequence of Hamiltonians along an adiabatic path. We derive the conditions under which gradient-based optimization successfully prepares the adiabatic ground states. These conditions define a trainable tracking region. Additionally, when combined with a gap lower bound, energy-standard-deviation measurements certify eigenstate accuracy at run-time and verify convergence to the global optimum.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了变分量子本征求解器（VQE）的一种绝热变体，其中VQE沿着绝热路径对一系列哈密顿量进行迭代。我们推导了基于梯度的优化成功制备绝热基态的条件，这些条件定义了一个可训练的跟踪区域。此外，当结合能隙下界时，能量标准差测量可以在运行时验证本征态的准确性，并确认收敛到全局最优解。
authors: Bojan Žunkovič, Marco Ballarin, Lewis Wright, Michael Lubasch

articles.title: A B₁g phonon unlocks d-wave superconductivity in the repulsive Hubbard model
articles.title_zh: B₁g声子在排斥性Hubbard模型中激发d波超导电性
