articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37746v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Using numerically exact finite-temperature quantum Monte Carlo, we demonstrate that a B₁g phonon coupled to the doped t-t' repulsive Hubbard model produces genuine d-wave superconductivity at a substantial transition temperature, in excess of either interaction alone. The observed trends suggest that stronger Hubbard repulsion may cooperate with the phonon to further raise the pairing scale. The enhancement persists at stronger repulsion within the accessible window, limited by the fermion sign problem, and follows a common trend across phonon frequencies Ømega when organized by a retardation scale 2π T/Ømega. We also find a well-defined superconducting dome in doping, echoing a characteristic feature of correlated superconductors. Our results identify the B₁g phonon as a plausible microscopic ingredient for robust d-wave superconductivity in the Hubbard model and suggest a concrete, physically motivated route toward materials with higher superconducting transition temperatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用精确的有限温度量子蒙特卡洛模拟，发现B₁g声子与掺杂的t-t'排斥性Hubbard模型耦合时，能产生显著的d波超导电性，其转变温度高于单独作用。结果表明，更强的Hubbard排斥力可能与声子协同作用，进一步提高配对尺度，并在掺杂浓度上呈现出超导穹顶。这揭示了B₁g声子是Hubbard模型中鲁棒d波超导的潜在微观机制，为开发更高超导转变温度材料提供了新途径。
authors: Wen O. Wang, Tianshu Li, Xiaoyue Ma, Rong Zhang, Lei Zhang, Shruti Agarwal, Benjamin Cohen-Stead, Emily Z. Zhang, Brian Moritz, Steven Johnston, Zhi-Xun Shen, Thomas P. Devereaux

articles.title: Meta-Altermagnetism and Enhanced Spin-Splitting
articles.title_zh: 亚稳交错磁性与增强的自旋劈裂效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37754v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets are collinear magnets with zero net magnetization and spin-split electronic bands. Here, we explore whether altermagnetism can exhibit a discontinuous jump, a phenomenon we refer to as meta-altermagnetism. We show that meta-altermagnetism can emerge in 2D systems when magnetic-order-induced band reconstruction drives spin-split van Hove singularities (vHSs) across the Fermi level. Using mean-field theory for an extended t-J model on a two-sublattice square lattice including anisotropic hopping integral, we find that a first-order meta-altermagnetic transition produces an intermediate altermagnetic regime with reduced staggered magnetization but strongly enhanced magnetic octupole and time-reversal-odd spin-splitter conductivity. We further show that the first-order transition line terminates at a quantum critical endpoint, giving rise to a rich phase diagram as the chemical potential and anisotropic hopping strength are varied. Our results identify the spin split vHSs as a route to enhancing spin-splitter effect for spintronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了交错磁性是否能表现出不连续跳跃，即所谓的亚稳交错磁性。研究表明，当磁序诱导的能带重构驱动自旋劈裂的范霍夫奇点穿过费米能级时，二维系统中可出现亚稳交错磁性。通过对扩展t-J模型的平均场理论分析，发现一级亚稳交错磁性转变产生了一个中间交错磁性区域，其具有降低的交错磁化强度但显著增强的磁八极矩和时间反演奇的自旋劈裂电导率。这些结果揭示了自旋劈裂的范霍夫奇点是增强自旋劈裂效应以用于自旋电子学应用的新途径。
authors: Bogeng Wen, Hae-Young Kee

articles.title: Few-Electron Partitioning in the Fractional Quantum Hall Regime
articles.title_zh: 分数量子霍尔效应区域中的少电子分配
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37950v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by few-electron partitioning experiments [Shaju et al., Nature 642, 928 (2025)], we study the partition statistics of N-electron states at a fractional quantum Hall point contact. At the solvable point g=1/2, we obtain nonperturbative current and noise formulas for arbitrary drives, while for Lorentzian pulses (Levitons) the full counting statistics reduces to an N× N determinant. We show that the charge is transferred solely in units of e, and that symmetrized cumulants for N=2,3,4 reveal strong antibunching and higher-order correlations, observable in a (ν₁,ν₂₎₌₍₁,1/3) junction.
articles.abstract_zh: 受少电子分配实验的启发，本研究探讨了分数量子霍尔点接触处N电子态的分配统计。在可解点g=1/2处，我们获得了任意驱动下的非微扰电流和噪声公式，对于洛伦兹脉冲，完全计数统计量可简化为N×N行列式。结果表明，电荷仅以e为单位传输，且N=2,3,4的对称化累积量揭示了强烈的反聚束效应和高阶关联，这在(ν₁,ν₂₎₌₍₁,1/3)结中是可观测的。
authors: T. Jonckheere, J. Rech, B. Grémaud

articles.title: Influences of N₂ flow rate on the superconducting properties and dimensionality of epitaxial TiN thin films
articles.title_zh: N₂流量对外延TiN薄膜超导性能和维度的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38250v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: TiN thin films have received great attention in the field of superconducting quantum computing due to their low loss characteristics derived from stable chemical and thermal properties, as well as excellent electrical conductivity. In this study, TiN thin films with a thickness of 35 nm were epitaxially grown on MgO substrates using the DC reactive magnetron sputtering technique. The crystal structure, film thickness, and surface morphology of the thin films were characterized. The films exhibit a very flat surface with a root mean square roughness of only a few tenths of a nanometer. The influences of nitrogen (N₂₎ flow rate on the surface morphology, superconducting transition temperature (T_c), residual resistivity ratio (RRR), normal-state resistivity (h̊oₙ₎, upper critical field, and superconducting dimensionality were investigated systematically. The experimental results show that the TiN film deposited with a N₂ flow rate of 1.5 sccm exhibits optimal performance, including the highest T_c (4.93 K), the largest RRR, the lowest h̊oₙ, and the lowest slope of the out-of-film upper critical field near Tc. Moreover, it is found that the background vacuum inside the growth chamber has a significant impact on the superconducting properties of TiN films, and the degradation of vacuum degree can lead to the decrease of T_c. The upper critical field reveals a significant anisotropic feature. Importantly, the in-film upper critical field data demonstrates that the optimization of sample quality leads to deviation from two-dimensional superconducting behavior, which provides a new perspective on the influencing factors of superconducting dimensionality beyond the thickness of films. The present results provide useful references for a comprehensive understanding of the relationship between growth parameters and the superconducting properties of thin films.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究采用直流反应磁控溅射技术，在外延MgO衬底上制备了35纳米厚的TiN薄膜，并系统探究了N₂流量对其表面形貌、超导转变温度(T_c)、残余电阻比(RRR)、常态电阻率和上临界场等超导性能及维度的影响。实验结果表明，当N₂流量为1.5 sccm时，TiN薄膜表现出最佳性能，包括最高的T_c (4.93 K)、最大的RRR和最低的常态电阻率。该研究为优化TiN薄膜在超导量子计算领域的应用提供了实验依据。
authors: Shilong Chen, Yuchuan Liu, Yihui Sun, Xiaoni Wang, Wei Peng, Yu Wu, Gang Mu, Zhirong Lin

articles.title: Charge Filling-Dependent Valley Polarization and its Dynamics Driven by Correlated Interlayer Exciton States in WSe2/WS2 Heterobilayer
articles.title_zh: WSe2/WS2异质双层中关联层间激子态驱动的电荷填充依赖性谷极化及其动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38251v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Moiré heterostructures of transition metal dichalcogenides provide an emerging platform for studying the strongly correlated electronic and excitonic states. The valley degree of freedom and its dynamics in the strongly correlated electronic and excitonic states in the moiré system are crucial for fundamental understanding and applications of valleytronics. Although the strongly correlated states in moiré systems have been extensively investigated, their impact on valley degrees of freedom and its dynamics remains unexplored. Here, we study the charge filling-dependent valley relaxation dynamics of interlayer excitons (IXs) in WSe2/WS2 moiré heterobilayer system. The evolution of moiré IXs dynamics across the Mott transition is elucidated by combining time-resolved optical spectroscopy with Monte Carlo simulation. Our results show that the radiative decay and recombination rate of IXs are enhanced at the integer filling factors n (=-1). Moreover, the valley relaxation rate of IXs at n=±1 is significantly decreased. The resulting reduction in wavefunction overlap and phonon scattering process suppresses the nonradiative recombination and intervalley scattering of IXs. These anomalous behaviors are attributed to the modification of IXs recombination pathways and enhance excitonic coherence due to the localization of introduced charge carriers at integer filling of moiré site. Our results explore exciton and valley dynamics as sensitive probes of strongly correlated states in moiré systems and highlight possible ways to control excitonic coherence and valleytronic properties in two-dimensional quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了WSe2/WS2莫尔异质双层中层间激子(IXs)的电荷填充依赖性谷弛豫动力学。结合时间分辨光谱和蒙特卡洛模拟，阐明了莫尔IXs动力学在莫特转变过程中的演变。结果表明，在整数填充因子n(±1)处，IXs的辐射衰减和复合速率增强，同时IXs的谷弛豫速率显著降低。这种波函数重叠的减少和声子散射过程的抑制，有效抑制了非辐射复合，为理解莫尔系统中谷自由度及其动力学提供了新见解。
authors: Zhiwei Li, Haonan Wang, Yubei Xiang, Wataru Idehara, Hailin Liu, Shinichiro Matano, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Kazunari Matsuda

articles.title: Nonreciprocal Floquet tunneling dynamics of spin-orbit-coupled bosonic atoms in a non-Hermitian double-well potential
articles.title_zh: 非厄米双阱势中自旋轨道耦合玻色原子的非互易Floquet隧穿动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38597v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The stable tunneling dynamics in non-Hermitian quantum systems is one of the fundamental issues in the study of quantum transport. Nonreciprocal coupling, as another crucial manifestation of non-Hermiticity, exerts significant regulatory effects on the stability of quantum devices and on spin tunneling dynamics. Here we place spin-orbit-coupled bosonic atoms in a double-well potential with gain and loss, and investigate the effect of nonreciprocal coupling on the system dynamics. Through an analytical analysis of the Floquet states and the quasi-energy spectrum under periodic driving, we obtain the PT-symmetry phase diagram of the system. We further explore the synergistic regulation mechanism of several factors---including the strength of nonreciprocal coupling, the non-Hermitian strength arising from gain-loss, and the periodic driving---on stable spin-flip tunneling. The results show that precise manipulation of nonreciprocity and gain-loss can substantially enlarge the stable parameter region. In nonreciprocal systems with balanced gain and loss, the continuity or discreteness of the stable parameter region is determined by the parity of the driving-frequency ratio Ømega/ømega, and the spin-flip tunneling can be precisely controlled through the parameters łambda and 2ǎrepsilon/ømega. For the unbalanced gain-loss scenario, the equilibrium conditions for achieving stable spin-flip tunneling under different parities of Ømega/ømega are further provided. These findings offer a new theoretical approach for realizing robust spin-flip tunneling, provide guiding significance for the study of quantum-state transport in non-Hermitian ultracold atomic systems, and also serve as a reference for the experimental design of novel spin-based quantum devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了增益和损耗的非厄米双阱势中自旋轨道耦合玻色原子的非互易耦合对系统动力学的影响。通过对周期性驱动下Floquet态和准能谱的分析，获得了系统的PT对称相图。研究进一步探讨了非互易耦合强度、增益-损耗引起的非厄米强度以及周期性驱动等因素对稳定自旋翻转隧穿的协同调控机制。结果表明，精确操控非互易性和增益-损耗可以显著扩大稳定参数区域，为量子器件的稳定性和自旋隧穿动力学提供了新的调控手段。
authors: Limei Ju, Yingying Zhang, Jilei Liang, Shoukang Chang, Zunlue Zhu, Lu Qin, Wuming Liu, Xingdong Zhao

articles.title: High-Performance Nuclear Demagnetization Refrigerator Reaching 50 μK
articles.title_zh: 达到50 μK的高性能核去磁制冷机
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38622v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Research in the deep sub-mK regime around 0.1 mK may open new opportunities in condensed matter physics in light of recent rapid progress in quantum technologies and quantum materials. Here, we report the design and performance of a nuclear demagnetization system that provides efficient access to the deep sub-mK regime for a wide range of experiments, using a standard wet dilution refrigerator with a medium-sized copper nuclear stage. We show that the temperature measured by a Pt NMR thermometer reaches 50 μK and that the refrigerator can maintain 100 μK for more than ten days. Remarkably, even with only 12 hours of precooling, the refrigerator cools into the deep sub-mK regime and can maintain 100 μK for more than three days, providing sufficient time for sample measurements. Numerical analyses indicate that the copper nuclear-spin system is cooled to about 18 μK, whereas a local heat leak to the thermometer limits the thermometer temperature to about 50 μK. These features establish the system as a practical platform for efficient experiments in the deep sub-mK regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报告了一种高性能核去磁制冷系统的设计与性能，该系统利用标准湿式稀释制冷机和中型铜核级，可有效实现深亚毫开尔文（约0.1 mK）区域的实验。实验表明，铂核磁共振温度计测得的温度达到50 μK，且制冷机能将100 μK的温度维持十天以上。即使仅预冷12小时，制冷机也能进入深亚毫开尔文区域并维持100 μK三天以上，为样品测量提供了充足时间。该系统为在深亚毫开尔文区域进行高效实验提供了实用平台。
authors: Zhengchao Liu, Junyang Song, Bingbing Tong, Hiroki Ikegami

articles.title: Effect of the surface on the energy levels in PbS and PbSe nanocrystals
articles.title_zh: 表面对PbS和PbSe纳米晶体能级的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38874v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The structure of the electron and hole quantum confinement levels in spherical PbS and PbSe nanocrystals (NCs) is studied within the framework of a four-band effective-mass model. This level structure was initially calculated within the Kang--Wise model, which employs the standard boundary condition of vanishing carrier wave functions at the NC surface. This model, however, does not allow one to account for the effect of the NC surface on the level structure. Here, the effect of the NC surface is modeled using general boundary conditions (GBCs) imposed on the envelope wave functions at the surface. We show that the surface properties modify the size dependence of the electron and hole confinement levels and lead to an additional spin--orbit splitting of the 1Pₕ,ₑ levels. Using the GBCs, we are able to quantitatively describe the size dependence of the lowest optical transitions in bare PbS and PbSe NCs and explain the differences between the absorption spectra of bare and Cl-passivated PbS NCs
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究在四能带有效质量模型框架下，探讨了表面对球形PbS和PbSe纳米晶体中电子和空穴量子限制能级结构的影响。通过引入施加在包络波函数上的广义边界条件，模型能够解释表面性质如何改变电子和空穴限制能级的尺寸依赖性，并导致1Pₕ,ₑ能级的额外自旋轨道劈裂。利用这些广义边界条件，研究成功定量描述了裸露PbS和PbSe纳米晶体中最低光学跃迁的尺寸依赖性，并解释了裸露和氯钝化PbS纳米晶体吸收光谱之间的差异。
authors: O. Lundgren, A. V. Rodina, Al. L. Efros

articles.title: Collective sliding relaxor ferroelectricity across thousand-layer van der Waals superstructures
articles.title_zh: 千层范德华超结构中的集体滑动弛豫铁电性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38928v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Relaxor ferroelectrics are among the most important electromechanical materials owing to their exceptionally large electrostrictive responses. However, conventional relaxor behavior is generally associated with chemical complexity and structural disorder, where local compositional fluctuations generate polar nanoregions, making the microscopic origin of this behavior difficult to control and engineer. Here we report sliding relaxor ferroelectricity (S-RFE), a previously unknown relaxor state in which engineered stacking-phase heterogeneity enables cooperative interlayer sliding to generate collective relaxor behavior. Through stacking-phase engineering in rhombohedral boron nitride, we create sliding domains that act as structural analogues of polar nanoregions and cooperatively align under an electric field through interlayer sliding. This collective state produces reversible electromechanical deformation of up to approximately -1.6% with negligible hysteresis in approximately 300-nm-thick crystals, corresponding to approximately 1000 atomic layers. The resulting electrostriction coefficient (Q₃₃ of approximately 1200,m⁴C⁻²) exceeds those of most crystalline electrostrictors by orders of magnitude. Unlike conventional relaxors, whose electromechanical response is often suppressed by dipolar freezing at low temperatures, S-RFE remains active down to 1.6 K and maintains giant electromechanical functionality. Our results establish sliding relaxor ferroelectricity as a new route to relaxor behavior and reveal how atomic-scale interlayer motion can be amplified into collective mesoscale functionality across approximately one thousand layers, providing a materials-by-design platform for electromechanical, photonic, and quantum technologies based on van der Waals materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了一种前所未有的弛豫态——滑动弛豫铁电性(S-RFE)，其中通过堆叠相工程在菱方氮化硼中实现了合作层间滑动，从而产生集体弛豫行为。这种集体态在约300纳米厚的晶体中产生了高达约-1.6%的可逆机电变形，且滞后可忽略不计。由此产生的电致伸缩系数(Q₃₃约为1200 m⁴C⁻²)远超传统材料，为设计高性能机电材料提供了新途径。
authors: Nianze Shang, Cuiju Yu, Yucai Lin, Juan C. Arias-Muñoz, Jiajie Qi, Quanlin Guo, MD Gius Uddin, Youqiang Huang, Tuomas Pajunpää, Christopher P. Edwards, Rodolfo E. Canet-Albiach, Faisal Ahmed, Andreas C. Liapis, Yaoqiang Zhou, Zhibin Zhang, Hao Hong, Qing Dai, Andrea Alù, José L. Lado, Kaihui Liu, Zhipei Sun

articles.title: Comment on "Is there a density-gradient expansion for the electronic exchange energy?"
articles.title_zh: 对“电子交换能是否存在密度梯度展开？”一文的评论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38943v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Perdew et al. [arXiv:2610.07201 (2026)] dispute our finding [Phys. Rev. B 113, 115136 (2026)] that the separate exchange (bₓ₎ and correlation (b_c) contributions to the q² coefficient of the long-wavelength proper polarization function depend on the infrared regularization of the Coulomb interaction, although their sum bₓc=bₓ₊b_c does not. We question their claim that the conventional exchange coefficient is uniquely determined. In Qian's [J. Math. Phys. 56, 111901 (2015)] derivation, which Perdew et al. cite in support of their claim of a unique exchange-gradient coefficient, an integral of the form int₋ₐbdx/x crosses a singularity and does not exist as an ordinary improper integral. Its finite Cauchy principal value (which is a particular way of regularizing the integral) is obtained only by excluding equal intervals on the two sides of the singularity; unequal exclusions give different answers. Independently, Sham's calculation with the screened interaction e⁻łambda₀ r/r gives an exchange-gradient coefficient different from the bare-Coulomb calculations of Svendsen--von Barth [Int. J. Quantum Chem. 56, 351 (1995)] and Engel--Vosko [Phys. Rev. B 42, 4940 (1990)]. The discrepancy remains when łambda₀>0 is so small that 1/łambda₀ is comparable to the size of the observable universe, making the two interactions experimentally indistinguishable on laboratory scales. Why should the exactly unscreened result be preferred, even if its calculation is accepted as valid? Our calculation shows that the ambiguity of the separate contributions cancels in the combined, regulator-independent coefficient bₓc.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对Perdew等人关于电子交换能密度梯度展开的观点提出质疑。Perdew等人认为传统的交换系数是唯一确定的，但我们指出，在他们引用的推导中，一个包含奇点的积分作为普通广义积分并不存在。其有限的柯西主值仅通过对称排除奇点两侧的相等区间获得，而不对称排除会得到不同结果。此外，Sham使用屏蔽相互作用的计算也得到了与裸库仑计算不同的交换梯度系数，这进一步支持了交换系数非唯一性的观点。
authors: Mario Benites, Angel Rosado, Efstratios Manousakis

articles.title: Separating the Density Wave Phase from Zero-Resistance Superconductivity in La₄Ni₃O₁₀
articles.title_zh: 在La₄Ni₃O₁₀中分离密度波相与零电阻超导电性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38959v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Identifying the key ingredients for superconductivity under pressure in the Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates remains a formidable challenge, due to a complex interplay between structural variations, oxygen content and location, electronically ordered phases, and the need for high pressures to reach the superconducting phase. To disentangle these complex inter-dependencies, here we study a series of clean single crystals of trilayer La₄Ni₃O₁₀. We discover that enhanced biaxial, compressive pressures induce a zero-resistance state at a 60% lower pressure compared to previous reports. At the same time, we completely separate the low-pressure density wave phase from superconductivity, effectively ruling out that soft, quantum critical fluctuations of the density wave order parameter act as the pairing glue in this system. Our results establish biaxial, in-plane pressures as a powerful tool for promoting superconductivity in nickelates, unifying the required pressure scales for superconductivity in different Ruddlesden-Popper structures, and providing a connection to the recently discovered thin film samples.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究通过对三层La₄Ni₃O₁₀清洁单晶的系统研究，成功地将低压密度波相与超导电性完全分离。结果发现，增强的双轴压缩压力能在比以往报道低60%的压力下诱导零电阻态。这有效地排除了密度波序参数的软量子临界涨落作为该体系中配对胶水的可能性。该工作确立了双轴面内压力是促进镍酸盐超导电性的有力工具，统一了不同Ruddlesden-Popper结构超导所需的压力尺度，并与最近发现的薄膜样品建立了联系。
authors: P. Puphal, A. Suthar, B. Wehinger, V. Sundaramurthy, T. Priessnitz, M. Knauft, P. Sosa-Lizama, Y. -M. Wu, M. Hepting, J. Nuss, M. Isobe, P. A. van Aken, Y. E. Suyolcu, B. Keimer, H. Takagi, P. Reiss

articles.title: HERA: Assessing an Autonomous Agent for Quantum Device Measurement
articles.title_zh: HERA：评估用于量子器件测量的自主代理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39074v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model agents have begun to carry out laboratory measurements, but their scientific conclusions are useful only if they hold up under scrutiny. Demonstrating this requires controlled studies because models are stochastic and the context a model is given steers its conclusions. Here we introduce HERA, an autonomous agent designed to carry out cryogenic transport measurements of quantum devices. HERA draws on a knowledge base curated by lab members that holds measurement protocols, software tools, and literature references. We assessed HERA with a blinded trial against an expert on the stacking order of two multilayer graphene devices, an ablation of its knowledge base, and hundreds of offline replays in which models designed the trial's central measurement without running it. HERA's conclusions matched the expert's sealed conclusions on both tested devices. The ablation and the replay studies measured the impact of the knowledge base across different models, showing that with it every model designed better measurements and reasoned more soundly. To test how readily HERA extends to a new problem, we tasked it with finding and characterizing superconductivity in a different material system. This required a few hours of expert time to develop a new experimental protocol, after which HERA did both autonomously. These results show that, with a knowledge base designed for the task, language model agents are capable of sound experimental science.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了HERA，一个旨在执行量子器件低温传输测量的自主代理。HERA利用实验室成员整理的知识库，包含测量协议、软件工具和文献参考。通过与专家进行盲法试验、知识库消融研究以及数百次离线回放，评估了HERA的性能。结果显示，HERA的结论与专家对两种多层石墨烯器件堆叠顺序的结论一致。研究表明，知识库显著提升了模型设计测量和推理的准确性，证明了HERA作为量子器件测量自主代理的有效性和可扩展性。
authors: Zachary W. Gomez, Nathan Bittner, Jordan T. McCourt, Qingrui Cao, Sandesh S. Kalantre, Benjamin H. Alexander, Zhiren Zheng, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Aaron Sharpe

articles.title: Metastability, collective excitations, and traveling states of one-dimensional spin-orbit-coupled quantum droplets
articles.title_zh: 一维自旋轨道耦合量子液滴的亚稳态、集体激发和行进态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39361v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the static and traveling droplet phases of spin-orbit coupled, one-dimensional Bose-Bose mixtures with a Lee-Huang-Yang correction. For the static droplets, employing a variational analysis for an infinitely extended mixture, we show that the system can feature two ground-state droplet phases: a stripe droplet phase up to a critical Rabi coupling strength, at which it undergoes a first-order transition to a zero-momentum droplet phase. The variational results for the ground-state properties are shown to be in good agreement with numerical solutions for droplets in the thermodynamic limit as well as finite-size droplets in the "flat-top regime". For finite-size droplets, the stripe phase can feature multiple stationary states with different numbers of peaks in their stripe density patterns. The calculation of the excitation spectrum for these stationary states confirms their stability. To study the moving droplets, we investigate the ground-state phases of the system in the droplet's comoving frame. We show that in the comoving frame, droplets acquire a finite longitudinal magnetization. As a consequence, the phase diagram features two distinct phases: a traveling stripe droplet and a plane-wave droplet. The real-time evolution of these droplets in the space-fixed frame, complemented by the Bogoliubov analysis in the comoving frame, illustrates the stability of these traveling droplet phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有Lee-Huang-Yang修正的一维自旋轨道耦合玻色-玻色混合物的静态和行进液滴相。对于静态液滴，变分分析表明系统存在条纹液滴相和零动量液滴相两种基态，并在临界拉比耦合强度下发生一级相变。有限尺寸液滴的条纹相可具有多个稳定的驻态。对于行进液滴，在共动参考系中，液滴获得了有限的纵向磁化强度。
authors: Harsimranjit Kaur, Ritu, Rajat, Kuldeep Suthar, Sandeep Gautam

articles.title: Hop rates of H and D on Pt(111) at finite coverage: the memory equation and the collective friction
articles.title_zh: Pt(111)表面H和D在有限覆盖度下的跳跃速率：记忆方程与集体摩擦
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39436v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Helium scattering measures the coherent intermediate scattering function of an adlayer, the characteristic function of the separation between adparticles at two times. Published dephasing rates of H and D on Pt(111) are analysed with its memory equation and a nearest-neighbour Ising lattice gas. The measured rate belongs to the adlayer. The hop rate of a single adsorbate is extracted from it by dividing out an interaction factor, without a model of the barrier. This factor lies between 0.97 and 1.17 at 0.1~ML, so that the published single-adsorbate analyses hold there. At 0.4~ML and 80~K it lies between 1.2 and 4.7, depending on how the occupied neighbours modify a tunnelling jump. The memory function is interpreted as a friction, the collective friction, which the adlayer exerts on its own density fluctuations. The lateral coupling, fixed by the coverage series, is the free energy of a neighbouring pair, with a vibrational pair entropy. The small deformation of the measured curves from the Chudley--Elliott form, the tilt, is proposed as an observable of the coupling. The tilts at 0.15 and 0.2~ML are consistent with it, although they are hard to extract from the published curves. The memory equation provides a transition-state theory for the adlayer, with the collective friction in the role of the friction of the substrate and without divergence at the crossover. Combined with the standard quantum transition-state theory of a single adsorbate, the extracted hop rates give the friction of the substrate, 124 and 75~ps⁻¹ for H and D, independent of the coverage.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用氦散射测量了吸附层相干中间散射函数，并分析了Pt(111)表面H和D的退相速率。研究通过记忆方程和最近邻伊辛格点气模型，从吸附层速率中提取了单个吸附物的跳跃速率，并引入了相互作用因子。结果表明，该因子在不同覆盖度和温度下有显著变化，且记忆函数被解释为吸附层对其自身密度波动施加的集体摩擦。
authors: S. Miret-Artés

articles.title: Multiple Current Enhancement Regimes and Interaction Induced Re-entrant Transport in a Quasiperiodic Hubbard Ring with Antiferromagnetic Order
articles.title_zh: 具有反铁磁序的准周期Hubbard环中的多重电流增强机制和相互作用诱导的再入输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39529v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate persistent charge and spin currents in a one-dimensional quantum ring threaded by an Aharonov-Bohm (AB) flux, considering generalized Aubry-André-Harper (AAH) modulation with staggered onsite energies and antiferromagnetic (AFM) ordering in both the noninteracting and interacting regimes, with the latter treated using a self-consistent Hartree-Fock mean field theory (MFT). At half filling, two distinct current-enhancement peaks emerge as the modulation strength increases, with quasiperiodic hopping modulation playing a crucial role in establishing the two-peak structure within a restricted parameter regime. Spin-resolved bond-current profiles reveal a switch in the dominant spin contribution between the two peaks, while the inverse participation ratio (IPR) and flux-dependent spin-resolved ground-state energies provide complementary insights into the spatial characteristics of the eigenstates and their spin-dependent flux sensitivity. At quarter filling, the spin current exhibits a single enhancement peak, in contrast to the two-peak response observed at half filling. The Hubbard interaction affects the two half-filled peaks differently: it suppresses the primary peak, whereas the secondary peak exhibits a nonmonotonic, re-entrant response, with the current recovering at finite interaction strength. The interacting results are further characterized through the Drude weight, and comparisons with exact diagonalization (ED) and density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations for a finite half-filled system support the reliability of the MFT description. Our findings elucidate how quasiperiodic modulation, AFM order, band filling, and electronic correlations collectively govern the magnitude and spin-resolved character of persistent currents, giving rise to multiple enhancement regimes and interaction-induced re-entrant behavior.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在Aharonov-Bohm (AB) 磁通量穿过的广义Aubry-André-Harper (AAH) 调制一维量子环中，持久电荷流和自旋流的特性。研究考虑了非相互作用和相互作用（通过自洽Hartree-Fock平均场理论处理）两种情况，并发现半填充时随着调制强度的增加出现两个电流增强峰。自旋分辨的键电流剖面揭示了主导自旋贡献的切换，而四分之一填充时自旋电流仅呈现一个增强峰。
authors: Souvik Roy, Ranjini Bhattacharya

articles.title: Ultrasound-Assisted Facile Nanoconfinement of Luminescent Guests in Zirconium Metal-Organic Frameworks
articles.title_zh: 超声辅助下发光客体在锆基金属有机骨架中的简便纳米限域
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39622v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An accelerated sonochemical route for fabricating luminescent guest-MOF (LG@MOF) composites is demonstrated, for which light-emitting molecules are nanoconfined within porous zirconium-based hosts using probe ultrasonication rather than conventional bath sonication. Ultrasonication enables the rapid synthesis of crystalline UiO-66 and UiO-67 nanocrystals within 10 minutes, with material yields of up to 92%, and facile in situ guest encapsulation within 1 hour, hence notably faster than the traditional 24-hour solvothermal route. Using UiO-66 and the larger-pore UiO-67 as porous hosts, tuneable single- and dual-guest fluorescent host-guest systems incorporating Rhodamine B (RB) and Fluorescein (F) were achieved. Photophysical characterisation showed broadband emission, tuneable colours, high quantum yield and improved lifetime, highlighting the synergy between sonochemical conditions, structural defects, and photophysical behaviour. Additionally, the sonochemically prepared LG@UiO particles show well-defined crystal facets and potential as photoactive thin films for solid-state lighting, demonstrating their promise as a tuneable light source for optical sensing and nanophotonics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了一种加速的声化学方法，用于制备发光客体-MOF (LG@MOF) 复合材料，通过探头超声处理将发光分子纳米限域在多孔锆基主体中。超声处理可在10分钟内快速合成UiO-66和UiO-67纳米晶体，并在1小时内实现客体原位封装，显著快于传统溶剂热法。制备的LG@UiO颗粒表现出宽带发射、可调颜色、高量子产率和改善的寿命，并具有作为固态照明光活性薄膜的潜力。
authors: Yiyi Wang, James D. Taylor, Jin-Chong Tan

articles.title: Origin and photoluminescence of a shallow hydrogen-related donor in silicon
articles.title_zh: 硅中浅层氢相关施主的起源与光致发光
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39623v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Paramagnetic color centers in silicon are being investigated recently for use in quantum technologies. While the origin of most of the prominent photoluminescence (PL) lines are well understood, that is not the case for those connected to hydrogen, even though it is almost always present in silicon, e.g., shallow hydrogen-related donors (SHDs), but their atomic structure remains elusive. Recent experiments suggested connection between the SHDs and the so-called X and the Bᵢ (or Xᵢ₎ PL-lines. An SHD, termed the MT2 center, was tentatively assigned to a bistable, negative-U defect, arising due to the interaction of hydrogen with the self-interstitial complex I₄. Using high-level density functional theory calculations, we investigate the interaction of hydrogen with self-interstitial complexes In. A shallow effective-mass-theory donor arises when hydrogen attacks a Si-Si bond in Iₙ, inserting itself as a bond-center interstitial (IₙHBC) in an exothermic reaction. We demonstrate this in the case of a single self-interstitial and of a complex of four. The latter I₄H_BC complex shows electronic, spin and PL properties remarkably close to MT2. We find that hydrogen in the presence of I₄ follows the same behavior as in pristine silicon, i.e., it is a negative-U bistable defect, only detectable under illumination. In the I₄HBC complex, H can hop via photo-assisted mechanism between equivalent BC sites of the I₄ complex, leading to a motional averaged tetragonal symmetry as experimentally observed for MT2. The zero-phonon line is distinct from the X-line (attributed to the bare I₄ complex), and falls well into the range of the Xᵢ lines. Our results identify the I₄H complex as a prototype for a class of SHDs, inferring that similar SHDs may arise, with the Xᵢ lines as their PL fingerprints, when H attacks Iₙ clusters.
articles.abstract_zh: 硅中的顺磁色心在量子技术中受到关注，但与氢相关的浅层施主（SHDs）的原子结构仍不清楚。本文利用高水平密度泛函理论计算，研究了氢与自间隙复合物Iₙ的相互作用。结果表明，当氢攻击Iₙ中的Si-Si键并作为键中心间隙插入时，会形成浅层有效质量理论施主。特别是I₄H_BC复合物的电子、自旋和光致发光特性与MT2中心非常接近。
authors: Miaomiao Han, Peter Deak, Bing Huang, Adam Gali

articles.title: Exceptional Superconducting Interfaces between Graphene and Atomic Chains in A15-MoRe
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯与A15-MoRe中原子链之间卓越的超导界面
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39694v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Realizing highly transparent and magnetic-field-resilient superconducting contacts is a critical bottleneck for the advancement of two-dimensional (2D) quantum devices. Molybdenum-rhenium (MoRe) alloys have been empirically favored as they uniquely yield ballistic, highly transparent contacts to graphene that survive in high-magnetic-field regimes; however, the microscopic origin of this anomalous transparency has remained a long-standing puzzle. Here, we resolve this paradox by revealing that pristine graphene/MoRe interfaces are governed by the classical A15 superconducting phase. Combining low-temperature transport, X-ray diffraction, and atomic-resolution electron microscopy, we demonstrate that as-deposited MoRe spontaneously forms the A15 phase in direct contact with graphene, whereas thermal annealing triggers a phase transition to a hexagonal close-packed (hcp) structure that severely degrades the Josephson transparency. Crucially, the one-dimensional (1D) transition-metal atomic chains unique to the A15 structure exhibit a near-perfect lattice match (mismatch < 1%) with graphene edges. First-principles calculations further prove that the d-orbitals of these historically renowned 1D chains possibly hybridize with graphene's Dirac cone near the K point. These findings not only uncover the structural and electronic origins of optimal MoRe contacts but also establish A15-phase superconductors as a geometrically ideal, universal platform for realizing robust quantum electronics based on 2D materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 实现高透明且抗磁场超导接触是二维量子器件发展的关键瓶颈。本文揭示了原始石墨烯/MoRe界面由经典的A15超导相主导，解决了MoRe合金异常透明性的微观起源之谜。研究结合低温输运、X射线衍射和原子分辨率电子显微镜，发现沉积态MoRe与石墨烯直接接触时自发形成A15相。A15结构中独特的一维过渡金属原子链与石墨烯边缘具有近乎完美的晶格匹配，这为理解其卓越的超导性能提供了关键见解。
authors: Hiroto Ogura, Yuto Tsukidate, Shun Kondo, Zhuoqun Li, Natsuki Sasaki, Tsunenobu Sato, Azusa Utsumi, Tomohiro Otsuka, Mitsuhiro Saito, Kazutoshi Inoue, Takashi Taniguchi, Kenji Watanabe, Yuichi Ikuhara, Toshiaki Kato

articles.title: I₄ complex acting as near-infrared emitter with a quantum memory in silicon
articles.title_zh: I₄复合物作为硅中具有量子记忆的近红外发射体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39713v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Silicon color centers emitting in the near infrared offer a route to spin--photon interfaces compatible with mature complementary metal--oxide--semiconductor fabrication. A key unresolved candidate is the X-line at 1039.7 meV in the photoluminescence (PL) spectrum, long attributed to a complex of four self-interstitials (I₄₎, yet whose microscopic structure and spin properties have remained controversial and uncharacterized at a predictive level. Using hybrid-functional (HSE06) density functional theory, we unambiguously establish the bare I₄ complex as the origin of the X-line: our calculations quantitatively reproduce the zero-phonon line, the complete phonon sideband structure---identifying the prominent secondary peaks as one- and two-phonon replicas of strongly coupled quasi-local modes---and the EPR hyperfine constants. The charge transition level is found at VBM+0.08~eV, conclusively ruling out the previously proposed association with the B3 EPR center and its correlated deep donor level. Most significantly, we identify a metastable spin-1 triplet excited state separated from the singlet by sim1.6~meV, consistent with the NL51 EPR signal. The D₂d symmetry of the defect suppresses intersystem crossing and phosphorescence by first-order spin--orbit coupling, implying an exceptionally long spin--lattice relaxation time. Combined with a spectrally resolvable zero-field splitting and near-infrared emission, the triplet state of the I₄ complex constitutes a viable spin quantum memory intrinsic to silicon.
articles.abstract_zh: 硅中发射近红外光的色心为自旋-光子接口提供了途径，其中X线（1039.7 meV）长期以来被归因于四个自间隙原子（I₄）的复合物。本文利用混合泛函密度泛函理论，明确证实了裸I₄复合物是X线的起源。计算结果定量再现了零声子线、完整的声子旁带结构以及EPR超精细常数，并识别出一个与单重态分离约1.6 meV的亚稳态自旋-1三重态激发态。
authors: Miaomiao Han, Song Li, Gergő Thiering, Thomas Frauenheim, Peter Deák, Bing Huang, Adam Gali

articles.title: Quantum Hamiltonian time crystals from covariant quantum Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert relaxation
articles.title_zh: 基于协变量子Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert弛豫的量子哈密顿时间晶体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39886v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Classical Hamiltonian time crystals are constrained energy minima that move along symmetry orbits at frequencies set by Lagrange multipliers. We construct quantum counterparts by minimizing the energy over density matrices with fixed spectrum and charge expectations. A symmetry-covariant quantum Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert equation selects them as periodic attractors, preserving the spectrum and fixing the multipliers dynamically. A chiral spin trimer motivated by Cu₃ molecular magnets realizes this motion at a prepared magnetization, without a Zeeman term.
articles.abstract_zh: 经典哈密顿时间晶体是沿对称轨道运动的受限能量最小值。本文通过在固定谱和电荷期望值的密度矩阵上最小化能量，构建了量子对应物。一个对称协变量子Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert方程将其选为周期性吸引子，动态地保持谱并固定乘数。受Cu₃分子磁体启发的螺旋自旋三聚体在预设磁化强度下实现了这种运动。
authors: Antti J. Niemi

articles.title: Excitons in solid molecular hydrogen from quantum Monte Carlo
articles.title_zh: 量子蒙特卡罗方法研究固态分子氢中的激子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39894v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We use quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) methods to investigate the lowest neutral excitation of solid molecular hydrogen in phase-I under increasing compression, with emphasis on structural and response properties. We employ QMC wave functions for the excited state that feature only a single orbital substitution, or a multideterminant expansion including every single particle-hole transition, and compare the results with the Bethe-Salpeter equation (BSE) and time-dependent density-functional theory (TDDFT). We examine a number of nuclear configurations representing thermal and quantum fluctuations. The effect of the multideterminant expansion is marginal on the QMC excitation energies but crucial on the exciton localization and related quantities, irrespective of full optimization and imaginary time projection. In the strong insulating regime at low density, multideterminant QMC results match and in some cases surpass the degree of localization afforded by BSE. A similar trend is observed for transition dipole moments and excitation-induced forces, with generally good agreement between QMC and BSE but marked discrepancies for nuclear configurations where localization differs significantly. TDDFT generally gives a more extended exciton with correspondingly weaker transition dipole moments. These differences decrease upon compression, as the system approaches a semiconducting regime where multiple particle-hole transitions are less important.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用量子蒙特卡罗（QMC）方法研究了I相固态分子氢在压缩下最低中性激发的结构和响应特性。研究采用了单轨道替换或包含所有单粒子-空穴跃迁的多行列式展开的QMC波函数，并与Bethe-Salpeter方程（BSE）和含时密度泛函理论（TDDFT）进行了比较。结果表明，多行列式展开对QMC激发能量影响不大，但对激子局域化至关重要，且在低密度强绝缘区，多行列式QMC结果在激子局域化方面与BSE吻合甚至超越。
authors: Edgar Josué Landinez Borda, Ravindra Shinde, Claudia Filippi, Markus Holzmann, Saverio Moroni

articles.title: Monte Carlo simulation of mixed spin-orbit ordering
articles.title_zh: 混合自旋-轨道有序的蒙特卡罗模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39943v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The effect of a magnetic field on the thermodynamic properties of the Kugel-Khomskii model with maximal entanglement using the quasi-classical Monte Carlo method with the heat bath algorithm. The temperature dependencies of single-site correlators show that the application of a magnetic field results in non-zero magnetization and the simultaneous appearance of an orbital ordering at the same point in the Brillouin zone where a non-zero spin-orbit correlator exists.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用准经典蒙特卡罗方法和热浴算法，研究了磁场对具有最大纠缠的Kugel-Khomskii模型热力学性质的影响。单点关联器的温度依赖性表明，施加磁场会导致非零磁化强度，并在布里渊区中存在非零自旋-轨道关联器的同一点同时出现轨道有序。
authors: Yu. D. Panov, V. A. Ulitko

articles.title: Selective effects of selenium substitution on superconductivity and magnetic memory in 4Hb-TaS2
articles.title_zh: 硒取代对4Hb-TaS2超导性和磁记忆的选择性影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39969v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Disorder plays a central role in correlated quantum materials, but its effects can be highly selective when several electronic orders coexist. The van der Waals heterostructure 4Hb-TaS2 provides such a case, combining superconductivity, charge-order tendencies, strong scattering, and magnetic memory manifested through spontaneous vortices. Here we use Se substitution as a controlled local perturbation of the disorder landscape in 4Hb-TaS2. We find that superconductivity remains remarkably robust while the magnetic memory is strongly suppressed at higher Se concentrations. These results show that Se substitution does not create the hidden magnetic memory, but instead selectively weakens its macroscopic manifestation. More broadly, they reveal a sharp separation between robust superconducting and hidden-memory phases, and a highly disorder-sensitive spontaneous-vortex response in 4Hb-TaS2.
articles.abstract_zh: 无序在关联量子材料中扮演重要角色，但其影响在多种电子序共存时可能具有高度选择性。本文以硒取代作为4Hb-TaS2中无序景观的受控局部扰动，研究其对超导性和磁记忆的影响。研究发现，超导性保持显著的鲁棒性，而磁记忆在高硒浓度下被强烈抑制。这些结果表明硒取代选择性地削弱了磁记忆的宏观表现，揭示了鲁棒超导相与隐藏记忆相之间的明显分离。
authors: Shalev Gur, Sajilesh K. P., Shubam Purwar, Irena Feldman, Ilay Mangel, Nitzan Ragoler, Amit Kanigel, Beena Kalisky

articles.title: Influence of pairing and correlations on transport properties in three-terminal superconducting nanostructure
articles.title_zh: 配对和关联对三端超导纳米结构输运性质的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40059v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the local and nonlocal charge transport properties of three-terminal nanostructure, consisting of the correlated quantum dot embedded between two metallic electrodes and superconductor. Using the linear response theory, we analyze interplay of the induced on-dot pairing with the correlation effects, inspecting their influence on the conductance and thermopower. Our calculations predict negative values of the nonlocal conductance and reversal of the Seebeck coefficient when the quantum dot ground state is represented by the BCS-type singlet configuration. These phenomena are realized when the subgap charge transport is predominantly contributed by the crossed Andreev scattering. In contrast, on the doublet side, we obtain signatures for the Kondo effect manifested by the low-temperature enhancement of the charge conductance and clearly evident in the thermopower. Such temperature-dependent local and nonlocal transport properties can unambiguously identify the specific configuration of the correlated quantum dot and reveal the rich physics emerging in the doublet-to-singlet crossover region.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了由关联量子点嵌入两个金属电极和超导体之间的三端纳米结构的局部和非局部电荷输运性质。利用线性响应理论，分析了诱导的量子点内配对与关联效应的相互作用及其对电导和热电势的影响。计算预测，当量子点基态为BCS型单重态配置时，非局部电导为负值且塞贝克系数反转，这主要由交叉安德烈夫散射引起。这些温度依赖的输运特性有助于识别关联量子点的特定配置。
authors: G. Górski, V. Pokorný, T. Domański

articles.title: Quantum Metric Scaling and Its Exceptions in Classical Flat Bands
articles.title_zh: 经典平带中的量子度规标度及其例外
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40066v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantum metric length has been proposed as the localization length scale in one-dimensional flat bands. Here, we study this quantum metric scaling and the exceptions to it in a classical flat band formed by a locally resonant mass--spring system. We find that the localization length follows the quantum metric length near the flat band but departs from this proportionality at the exact flat-band frequency. Selective mass disorder also produces divergent localization lengths or arbitrarily short tails near the flat-band frequency without changing the clean metric. These exceptions show that disorder can select localization scales beyond those predicted by the quantum metric alone.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子度规长度被提出作为一维平带中的局域化长度尺度。本文在一个由局部共振质量-弹簧系统形成的经典平带中，研究了这种量子度规标度及其例外情况。研究发现，局域化长度在平带附近遵循量子度规长度，但在精确的平带频率处偏离了这种比例关系。选择性质量无序也会在平带频率附近产生发散的局域化长度或任意短的尾部，而不会改变干净度规。这些例外表明无序可以选择超出量子度规单独预测的局域化尺度。
authors: Kin Hung Fung, K. T. Law, C. T. Chan

articles.title: Single-atom billiards in an ultracold bath with energy-tunable collisions and threshold-sensitive detection
articles.title_zh: 超冷浴中具有能量可调碰撞和阈值敏感探测的单原子台球
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40098v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transport processes at the microscopic scale can differ strongly from their macroscopic counterparts, particularly when the environment is not a well-defined surface but an unordered thermal medium. Ultracold quantum gases offer a high degree of controllability and directly observable dynamics, thereby providing a versatile platform to study such transport processes under precisely controllable conditions. Here, we realize an energy-tunable single-atom collider by transporting individual cesium atoms at controlled velocity through an ultracold rubidium bath. The constant lattice velocity sets the directed contribution to the collision-energy distribution, while the lattice depth provides a tunable energy threshold for collision-induced transport disruption. By independently varying these parameters together with bath density and temperature, we separate the number of collision events from their probability to disrupt transport. Across a regime with only a few expected collisions per passage, the inferred single-collision ejection probability rises from small values to near unity as the collision energy exceeds the lattice confinement scale. The experiment thus converts microscopic collisional energy transfer into a binary single-atom observable and provides a controlled link between individual scattering events and emergent dissipative transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过在超冷铷浴中以受控速度传输单个铯原子，实现了能量可调的单原子碰撞器。研究人员通过独立改变晶格速度、晶格深度、浴密度和温度等参数，将碰撞事件数量与其破坏传输的概率分离开来。结果表明，在每次通过仅有少量预期碰撞的区域，当碰撞能量超过晶格限制时，推断出的单次碰撞弹出概率从低值上升到接近统一。
authors: Silvia Hiebel, Sabrina Burgardt, Julian Feß, Artur Widera

articles.title: Variational wavefunctions for ideal anyon gas: superfluid and skyrmion Hall crystal
articles.title_zh: 理想任意子气体的变分波函数：超流体和斯格明子霍尔晶体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.40657v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The ground state of an ideal gas of anyons with statistical angle θin(0,π) is a long-standing open problem, with renewed interest from the recent observations of fractional Chern insulators. In this work we construct variational wavefunctions that build in the exact anyon statistics and combine theory-guided composite-boson, composite-fermion and parton wavefunctions with neural-network correlations on the sphere. For spinless and SU(2) semions we confirm the paired anyon superfluid, well below the best crystal states. At θ=π/3 liquids and crystals are closer in energy for the spinless case. For θ=π/3 anyons with SU(3) flavor, we find two candidates. One is a skyrmion Hall crystal, in which the anyons form an integer quantum Hall state in the effective magnetic field from the spin texture. The other is a chiral color superconductor of six-anyon clusters, the color-flavor-locked pairing descendant of a holon metal with SU(3) color gauge symmetry and SU(3) flavor symmetry; its wavefunction is a hyperdeterminant rather than a product of parton determinants. Within our variational ansatz the color superconductor has better energy than both crystals and the color-flavor locked phases with U(1)² and Z₃ gauge groups. For twisted MoTe₂ this suggests that the reentrant integer quantum anomalous Hall phase is the skyrmion Hall crystal of the doped anyons, and that the observed superconductivity may be the color superconductor, which can undergo a transition to an f+if BCS superconductor with a jump of the chiral central charge by 3.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了理想任意子气体的变分波函数，结合了理论指导的复合玻色子、复合费米子和部分子波函数与神经网络关联。对于无自旋和SU(2)半子，确认了配对任意子超流体。对于具有SU(3)味的θ=π/3任意子，发现了斯格明子霍尔晶体和手性颜色超导体两种候选态，其中颜色超导体在变分假设下具有更低的能量。
authors: Ya-Hui Zhang

articles.title: Drift-induced nonreciprocity in image-polariton-mediated dipole emission
articles.title_zh: 图像极化激元介导偶极子发射中的漂移诱导非互易性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38348v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Electrical current bias offers a magnet-free route to nonreciprocal light propagation at the nanoscale. Here, we theoretically explore drift-induced nonreciprocity in graphene heterostructures containing hexagonal boron nitride (hBN), where graphene plasmons interact with hBN phonon polaritons in the infrared. Both the random-phase approximation and the Boltzmann transport equation are used to characterize the nonlocal optical response of drift-biased graphene. We compare graphene on hBN with an image-polaritonic structure comprising graphene, a thin hBN spacer, and a gold substrate. Carrier drift produces pronounced directional shifts of the polariton dispersion, while coupling to hBN phonon polaritons strongly modifies the nonreciprocal response. In the image-polaritonic structure, the graphene polaritons become up to twice as confined while retaining a comparable Fizeau shift. The nonreciprocal polariton dispersion produces directional near-field emission and nonreciprocal dipole-dipole interactions, the latter quantified through the cross density of optical states, reaching a left-right dissymmetry of up to ~40%. Our results identify image polaritons in drift-biased graphene as a compact, electrically tunable platform for directional coupling between quantum emitters at the nanoscale.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论研究了石墨烯异质结构中漂移诱导的非互易性，其中石墨烯等离子体与六方氮化硼（hBN）声子极化激元相互作用。载流子漂移导致极化激元色散的显著方向性偏移，而与hBN声子极化激元的耦合则强烈改变了非互易响应。在图像极化激元结构中，石墨烯极化激元的限制性增强，同时保持可比的菲索位移。这种非互易极化激元色散产生了方向性近场发射和非互易偶极-偶极相互作用，左右不对称性高达约40%。
authors: Christian Nicolaisen Hansen, Eduardo J. C. Dias, Christos Tserkezis, Joel D. Cox

articles.title: Rydberg Atomic Quantum Receiver Empowered Hybrid Non-orthogonal Multiple Access
articles.title_zh: 结合里德堡原子量子接收机的混合非正交多址接入
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.38451v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel uplink Hybrid Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) architecture assisted by Rydberg Atomic Quantum Receivers (RAQRs) to improve energy efficiency by addressing the physical constraints of atomic sensing. We formulate a joint optimization problem encompassing phase measurements and multi-user power allocation to minimize the total transmit power. This problem is particularly challenging due to the non-linear amplitude-only observations of atomic vapor cells. To decomposes the resulting non-convexity, we develop a hierarchical three-layer decomposition optimization framework that systematically decouples the global problem. The inner layer employs a customized Expectation Maximization-Gerchberg-Saxton (EM-GS) algorithm to resolve phase ambiguity and estimate equivalent channel gains. The middle layer derives closed-form optimal power allocation solutions via Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions. The outer layer utilizes linear Minimum Mean Square Error (MMSE) detection for high-reliability signal recovery. Simulation results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed framework over conventional RF-based Hybrid NOMA. Notably, the atomic architecture achieves approximately a 93% reduction in total power consumption compared to Orthogonal Multiple Access (OMA) baselines while maintaining strict backward compatibility, thereby laying a solid foundation for practical deployment in next-generation green communication networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新型上行混合非正交多址接入（NOMA）架构，该架构由里德堡原子量子接收机（RAQR）辅助，旨在通过解决原子传感的物理限制来提高能量效率。研究人员构建了一个联合优化问题，以最小化总发射功率，并开发了一个分层三层分解优化框架来解决其非凸性。仿真结果表明，所提出的框架优于传统的基于射频的方案。
authors: Xinya Shen, Zheng Chu, David Chieng, Chiew Foong Kwong, Qihao Peng, Pei Xiao, Theodoros Tsiftsis, Jianyue Zhu

articles.title: Improving Energy Efficiency of Uplink RSMA via Rydberg Atomic Quantum Receiver
articles.title_zh: 通过里德堡原子量子接收机提高上行速率分裂多址接入的能量效率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.39615v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper investigates an uplink rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA) network empowered by a Rydberg atomic quantum receiver (RAQR) to maximize energy efficiency (EE). To overcome the amplitude-only measurement limitation of the considered direct readout RAQR, we devise a phase alignment mechanism that linearizes the received signal while retaining full channel energy, thereby enabling tractable optimization. The resulting non-convex fractional EE problem is transformed via Dinkelbach's method. For IoT scenarios with symmetric rate requirements, we derive exact closed-form power allocation from the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions, which yields a globally optimal bisection search with negligible computational latency. For asymmetric rate requirements, we develop a generalized block coordinate descent-based power allocation (BCD-PA) framework that eliminates reliance on expensive interior-point solvers. We further propose a low-complexity paired allocation (LC-Paired) that exploits user pairing and closed-form bandwidth solutions via the Lambert-W function. Simulation results confirm that the KKT-based scheme attains the highest EE, while the BCD-PA offers a flexible complexity-performance trade-off. The LC-Paired scheme drastically reduces computational cost with only moderate EE degradation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了由里德堡原子量子接收机（RAQR）支持的上行速率分裂多址接入（RSMA）网络，以最大化能量效率。为克服RAQR的幅度测量限制，研究人员设计了一种相位对齐机制，并利用Dinkelbach方法转换了非凸分数能量效率问题。对于对称速率要求的物联网场景，推导了精确的闭式功率分配方案；对于非对称速率要求，开发了广义块坐标下降功率分配框架。仿真结果证实了基于KKT的方案能实现最高的能量效率。
authors: Xinya Shen, Zheng Chu, David Chieng, Chiew Foong Kwong, Qihao Peng, Zhengyu Zhu, Pei Xiao, Jianyue Zhu

articles.title: Photon pairs, squeezed light, and the quantum wave-mixing effect in a cascaded qubit system
articles.title_zh: 级联量子比特系统中的光子对、压缩光和量子混波效应
articles.abstract: Author(s): R. D. Ivanovskikh, W. V. Pogosov, A. A. Elistratov, S. V. Remizov, A. Yu. Dmitriev, T. R. Sabirov, A. V. Vasenin, S. A. Gunin, and O. V. articles.title: Re-uploading quantum data: a universal function approximator for quantum inputs

articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2256 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-29-2256 Quantum data re-uploading has proved powerful for classical inputs, where repeatedly encoding features into a small circuit yields universal function approximation. Extending this idea to quantum inputs remains underexplored, as the information contained in a quantum state is not directly accessible in classical form. We propose and analyze a quantum data re-uploading architecture in which a qubit interacts sequentially with fresh copies of an arbitrary input state. The circuit can approximate any bounded continuous function using only one ancilla qubit and single-qubit measurements, provided that sufficiently many copies of the input state and, in general, sufficiently many layers are available. By alternating entangling unitaries with mid-circuit resets of the input register, the architecture realizes a discrete cascade of completely positive and trace-preserving maps, analogous to collision models in open quantum system dynamics. Our framework provides a space-efficient and expressive approach to designing quantum machine learning models that operate directly on quantum data.

articles.title: Resource-efficient quantum simulation of transport phenomena via Hamiltonian embedding

articles.abstract: Transport phenomena play a key role in a variety of application domains, and efficient simulation of these dynamics remains an outstanding challenge. While quantum computers offer potential for significant speedups, existing algorithms either lack rigorous theoretical guarantees or demand substantial quantum resources, preventing scalable and efficient validation on realistic quantum hardware. To address this gap, we develop a comprehensive framework for simulating classes of transport equations, offering both rigorous theoretical guarantees—including exponential speedups in specific cases—and a systematic, hardware-efficient implementation. Central to our approach is the Hamiltonian embedding technique, a white-box approach for end-to-end simulation of sparse Hamiltonians that avoids abstract query models and retains near-optimal asymptotic complexity. Empirical resource estimates indicate that our approach can yield an order-of-magnitude (e.g. ) reduction in circuit depth given favorable problem structures. We then apply our framework to solve linear and nonlinear transport partial differential equations, including the first experimental demonstration of a 2D advection equation on a trapped-ion quantum computer.
articles.abstract_zh: 传输现象在多个应用领域中至关重要，但其高效模拟仍是一项挑战。本文开发了一个全面的框架，用于模拟各类传输方程，提供了严格的理论保证和系统、硬件高效的实现。该方法的核心是哈密顿量嵌入技术，这是一种用于稀疏哈密顿量端到端模拟的白盒方法。经验资源估计表明，该方法可以显著减少电路深度，并已成功应用于求解线性和非线性传输偏微分方程。

articles.title: Accuracy-cost trade-offs for reference VQE calculations of H 2 ...

articles.abstract: Variational quantum eigensolver calculations are widely used as reference workflows for assessing near-term quantum hardware, but practical guidance on their accuracy, runtime, and billed usage remains limited. Here, we present a hardware-validated reference dataset for variational ground-state energy calculations of the hydrogen molecule H2 on several IBM Quantum processors available in 2025–2026. Using a standardized Qiskit Nature workflow, we benchmark the impact of shot count, backend choice, fermion-to-qubit mapping, optimizer behavior, resilience level, and execution mode on the achievable energy accuracy relative to exact diagonalization. For the H2/STO–3G configurations examined, circuit simplification through tapered mappings provides the most consistent accuracy gains, resilience level 1 improves accuracy at a substantial billed-usage premium, and session-based execution yields no systematic accuracy advantage over single-job execution despite markedly higher billed time. The dataset and analysis provide a transparent baseline for assessing current IBM Quantum hardware for quantum-chemistry applications and for estimating the runtime effort and billed usage that non-specialist users can expect from standard workflows.
