articles.title: An exactly solvable obstructed seam on a lattice Klein bottle: bulk-locked Majorana rings and register-dependent toric codes
articles.title_zh: 格莱因瓶格子上精确可解的受阻缝：体锁定马约拉纳环和寄存器依赖的拓扑码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35931v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a frustrated seam produced by literal reflection gluing of Wen's plaquette model on a closed lattice Klein bottle. The seam operators anticommute along two cycles for even circumference and one cycle of twice the length for odd circumference. Their algebra reduces to free Majorana rings, while the commuting bulk stabilizers constrain the allowed ring sectors. This bulk locking yields exact ground energies, excitation gaps and degeneracies, checked by phase-aware Pauli traces and finite-size diagonalization, including two 24-qubit energy predictions. The seam degeneracy is not topological: the single-site seam fields tested split it at second order. We contrast this obstructed gluing with consistent toric-code realizations. An edge register preserves the anyon labels; a Hadamard-dressed site register has colour-dependent seam transport, with ground-state degeneracy 2 or 4 for even circumference and a sign-frustrated exception at odd circumference. For the enumerated lattice isometries and sizes, we compute logical gates and distances, distinguishing abstract qubit relabelling from local hardware depth. Finally, on three 16- and 24-qubit lattices, chiral matter selects a holonomy doublet whose electric-field splitting follows two competing tunnelling routes. These matter results remain finite-size statements. The main result is the exact obstructed-seam solution with bulk sector locking; the register, gate and matter calculations delimit its relation to topological codes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在闭合格莱因瓶上通过Wen方块模型的反射粘合产生的受挫缝。缝算符在特定循环上反交换，其代数简化为自由马约拉纳环，而体稳定子限制了允许的环扇区。这种体锁定机制能够精确计算基态能量、激发能隙和简并度，并且与拓扑码的实现进行了对比。研究还计算了逻辑门和距离，并区分了抽象量子比特重标记与局部硬件深度。
authors: Junhao (Eigen), Wang

articles.title: Agentic Swarms Discover Enhanchment of Fractional Chern Insulator Gaps Beyond Ideal Quantum Geometry
articles.title_zh: 智能体群发现分数陈绝缘体能隙超越理想量子几何的增强
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35934v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Can artificial intelligence (AI) move beyond solving well-defined problems to contribute to open-ended discovery in fundamental physics? Could AI propose what to explore, identify unexpected phenomena, and uncover their mechanisms? We address this using MOSAIC (Multi-agent Open-ended Scientific Analysis and Investigation through Collaboration), a collaborative swarm of AI agents (Claude Opus 5.5), to tackle a longstanding bottleneck: the small energy gaps limiting the robustness of fractional topological order and the study of anyons at higher temperatures. Rather than prescribing a model, we ask frontier models (GPT-6 Astra) to propose a theoretical framework, which MOSAIC explores through diverse strategies and rapid exchange of ideas. This reveals a striking finding: although ideal quantum geometry is considered favorable for fractional states, departing from this limit can dramatically enhance their robustness, with many-body gaps more than an order of magnitude larger than in the ideal case. Without centralized coordination, the agents explored autonomously, combined findings across agents, and formed insights from individual runs, outperforming isolated agents with the same tools. AI-assisted theoretical analysis further develops simplified models with an analytical gap enhancement factor that is unbounded within the single-band approximation. Remarkably, AI identifies the real-space quantum metric, rather than the momentum-space one, as the key quantity governing the many-body gap, revealing how flat-band wavefunctions shape two-electron interactions and yielding an index computable from single-particle wavefunctions without many-body ED to guide gap optimization. Our study demonstrates how collaborative AI agents can integrate exploration, discovery of unexpected physics, and theoretical understanding, opening new possibilities for AI-driven research in fundamental physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用多智能体开放式科学分析与协作系统（MOSAIC），探索人工智能在基础物理开放式发现中的潜力。该系统由AI智能体组成，旨在解决分数拓扑序鲁棒性受限的能隙瓶颈问题。研究发现，尽管理想量子几何被认为有利于分数态，但偏离此限制可显著增强其鲁棒性，使多体能隙比理想情况大一个数量级以上。
authors: Yitong Zhang, Changwen Xu, Andrew Boshi Li, Siddhartha Sarkar, Kai Sun, Venkatasubramanian Viswanathan

articles.title: AlgebrasTQD: Computing Algebras and Interfaces in Twisted Quantum Doubles
articles.title_zh: AlgebrasTQD：计算扭曲量子双代数中的代数和界面
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36029v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present AlgebrasTQD, an open-source code written in GAP (Groups, Algorithms, and Programming), for computing condensable algebras and the corresponding topological boundaries and interfaces of twisted quantum doubles D^ømega(G). These algebras can be used to classify 1+1d gapped and gapless phases whose symmetry is related by gauging to a finite group G with anomaly ømegain H³⁽G,U(1)), to study 2+1d anyon proliferation and to construct logical gates in non-Abelian topological quantum codes. The functions in AlgebrasTQD compute all condensable algebras A(H,F,γ,ϵ) with their algebra structure and anyons, sort them into isomorphism classes and identify the twin algebras that are inequivalent but share the same anyon decomposition. AlgebrasTQD also determines all the subalgebra relations, the corresponding Hasse diagram and the types of 1+1d phases for any chosen, possibly non-invertible, group-theoretical symmetry. For non-maximal algebras, the code computes the reduced topological order with its 3-cocycle and the map of anyons across the topological interface. Finally, AlgebrasTQD includes functions that construct certain non-Clifford logical gates via non-Abelian surface codes. We summarize the formulas that are implemented in the AlgebrasTQD code, and we illustrate its use with Abelian and non-Abelian groups including Z₂³ with ømega_III, D₈, A₄ with and without anomaly, twin algebras and twin phases, and the Clifford-hierarchy gates in quantum doubles of dihedral groups. All arithmetic is exact and AlgebrasTQD can be used with any finite group G and 3-cocycle ømega, limited only by the time and size of the calculation. The code is available at https://github.com/AlisonWarman/AlgebrasTQD
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了AlgebrasTQD，一个用GAP编写的开源代码，用于计算扭曲量子双代数D^ømega(G)的可凝聚代数及其拓扑边界和界面。这些代数可用于分类1+1维有能隙和无能隙相，研究2+1维任意子增殖，并构建非阿贝尔拓扑量子码中的逻辑门。AlgebrasTQD能够计算所有可凝聚代数及其结构和任意子，并确定子代数关系、Hasse图和1+1维相的类型。
authors: Alison Warman

articles.title: Learning Multiscale Dynamics of Nanoparticle Self-Assembly
articles.title_zh: 学习纳米粒子自组装的多尺度动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36498v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nanoparticle self-assembly offers a powerful route to programmable functional materials, but its dynamics remain difficult to understand because they arise from multiscale, many-body, and environment-dependent interactions. Liquid-phase transmission electron microscopy (LPTEM) enables real-time observation of these dynamics, yet extracting the underlying physical laws from highly stochastic trajectories remains a significant challenge. Here we develop a physics-informed, time-varying autoregressive framework that learns multiscale self-assembly dynamics directly from LPTEM videos. Continuous Eulerian fields with local density and orientational order are coarse-grained from individual video frames and evolved by a sparse, nearest-neighbor operator optimized over a constrained matrix manifold. This interpretable approach captures long-time large scale phase transitions by tracking operator volatility over time, and short-timescale local evolution and transport rules. Crucially, we extract the underlying partial differential equations, where expected symmetries naturally emerge, enabling the direct inference of fundamental coefficients. Our framework provides a robust, computationally efficient tool for discovering hidden physical mechanisms from observational data, opening a path toward the predictive design of self-assembled nanostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 纳米粒子自组装动力学因其多尺度、多体和环境依赖性相互作用而难以理解。本文开发了一种物理信息引导、时变自回归框架，直接从液相透射电子显微镜（LPTEM）视频中学习多尺度自组装动力学。该方法通过跟踪算子随时间的变化来捕捉长时间尺度的大规模相变，并揭示短时间尺度的局部演化和传输规则。最终，研究提取了潜在的偏微分方程，从而直接推断出基本系数。
authors: Shuaifeng Li, Puquan Pan, Jonas Hallstrom, Nicholas Kotov, Paul Bogdan, Qian Chen, Xiaoming Mao

articles.title: Measurement-induced entanglement phases in hyperbolic gauge-Higgs models
articles.title_zh: 双曲规范-希格斯模型中测量诱导的纠缠相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36528v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Gauge-Higgs theory in flat spacetime provides a prime theoretical model of multiple phases of matter with distinct entanglement structures. More recently, there has been interest in hyperbolic space and the influence its extensive boundaries have on these structures. Entanglement transitions between non-equilibrium phases, such as topological phases, can be realized by the competition of non-commutating measurements. Here we study the entanglement phases of gauge-Higgs models on hyperbolic lattices described by measurement-only dynamics. We chart 2D phase diagrams by employing topological entanglement entropy and introducing a generalized measurement-induced entanglement tailored for hyperbolic Higgs phases. Utilizing duality, we find a phase absent in Euclidean space, wherein the bulk lattice hosts separated clusters of symmetry-protected topological order. Transitions between this "archipelago" phase and neighboring topological and trivial phases feature a critical exponent δ belonging to a mean-field universality class. Our essential tool is a 3D resource state inspired by measurement-based quantum computation that simulates the spacetime evolution of the 2D quantum state with a third direction of entanglement. This allows us to analyze spacetime "sponges" of entanglement, which map to classical percolation theory and allow us to infer values of critical points on our phase diagrams' boundaries.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了双曲格子上规范-希格斯模型的纠缠相，这些模型由纯测量动力学描述。通过拓扑纠缠熵和为双曲希格斯相量身定制的广义测量诱导纠缠，我们绘制了二维相图。研究发现了一个在欧几里得空间中不存在的“群岛”相，其中体晶格包含对称保护拓扑序的独立簇。这些相变具有属于平均场普适类的临界指数。
authors: Cole Kelson-Packer, Hiroki Sukeno, Akimasa Miyake

articles.title: Continuum neural wavefunctions for anyons on a torus
articles.title_zh: 环面任意子的连续神经网络波函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36567v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mobile anyons in topologically ordered phases provide a setting to investigate how fractional exchange statistics shapes collective behavior at finite density. We introduce AnyFormer: a neural variational framework for continuum anyons on a torus that explicitly incorporates statistical interactions and global winding constraints. We construct a smooth orbital frame that enforces the matrix-valued torus boundary conditions, and supplement it with an analytic pair factor that supplies the regular collision behavior. The orbital geometry and many-body amplitudes are optimized in parallel by variational Monte Carlo. We apply AnyFormer to semions without an external field or interaction potential, isolating unique correlations generated solely by statistics. Our framework closely matches exact two-semion energies and yields lower variational energies than finite-cutoff exact diagonalization for N = 4 and 6 semions. Scaling up to N = 16 semions, well beyond the limits of continuum diagonalization, our calculations reveal states with pronounced correlation holes, suppressed long-wavelength density fluctuations, and a reversal of pair circulation at a distance set by the mean particle spacing. For N = 12 and 16 semions, the circulation develops damped spatial oscillations. AnyFormer thus provides a scalable variational neural-net framework for microscopic studies of correlations, chiral motion, and collective phases of bulk anyonic matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了AnyFormer，一个用于环面上连续任意子的神经网络变分框架，它明确地结合了统计相互作用和全局缠绕约束。该框架构建了一个平滑的轨道框架，并辅以解析对因子，通过变分蒙特卡罗并行优化轨道几何和多体振幅。将AnyFormer应用于无外场或相互作用势的半子，研究揭示了由统计特性产生的独特关联，并获得了比有限截断精确对角化更低的变分能量。
authors: Ahmed Khalifa, Shubhayu Chatterjee

articles.title: Algebraic flat bands and even central-band Chern numbers in a seven-orbital hopping model
articles.title_zh: 七轨道跳跃模型中的代数平带和偶数中心带陈数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36738v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Turning a flat-band parent into an isolated Chern band requires supervise of destructive interference, hopping phases, and the cell translations of the bonds. We study this connection in a seven-orbital 2 times 2 supercell honeycomb-vacancy lattice, combining analytic reductions with Bloch spectra, lattice Chern invariants, and quantum geometry. The parent lattice has three exact flat branches, a smooth periodic zero mode, and a compact localized state. A uniform gap bound shows that faint intracell-loop hopping preserves two topologically trivial insulating gaps. The intracell hopping graph also admits a staggered chiral coloring: reversing site amplitudes according to this coloring links opposite energies at momenta separated by half a reciprocal period. This constraint restricts the isolated central band to even Chern numbers and forbids a zero-energy insulating filling at every loop phase. Purely imaginary loop hopping admits a real gauge, whereas other phases allow paired band contacts connecting central bands with C3=2 and C3=4. On a specified strong-loop cut, third-order masses open the direct gaps; these gaps shrink faster than the bandwidth as the coupling grows. Changing the bond connectivity to an oriented honeycomb next-nearest-neighbor extension generates a narrower Chern band with nonuniform quantum geometry. These results distinguish individual-band topology from occupied-group topology and reveal how bond connectivity and cell translations determine which topological bands can emerge from an exactly flat parent.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在七轨道2x2超晶胞蜂窝空位晶格中，如何将平带母体转化为孤立的陈带，结合了解析约化、布洛赫谱、晶格陈不变量和量子几何。研究发现，微弱的胞内环跳跃保留了两个拓扑平庸的绝缘能隙，且胞内跳跃图允许交错手性着色。这一约束将孤立的中心带限制为偶数陈数，并禁止在每个环相中出现零能绝缘填充。
authors: Weizhuo Xu, Jiachen Qian, Shuaihua Zhang, Yanling Wu, Jun Li

articles.title: Real-Space Selection Rule for Moiré Exciton-Phonon Coupling
articles.title_zh: 莫尔激子-声子耦合的实空间选择定则
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36782v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exciton-phonon coupling (ExPC) governs energy relaxation and exciton dynamics in photoexcited quantum materials. Recent advances have revealed rich and tunable excitonic phenomena in moiré superlattices, yet the microscopic mechanisms underlying the coupling between moiré excitons and moiré phonons remain elusive. Here, we develop a real-space representation for moiré ExPC based on a unified theoretical framework combining the many-body Bethe-Salpeter equation with phonon perturbation theory. Furthermore, we uncover a general real-space selection rule: the spatial matching of a moiré exciton's electron and hole densities with the moiré-phonon-induced potential perturbations determines their individual coupling contributions, while coherent interference between the electron and hole contributions controls the total ExPC. We demonstrate this rule in prototypical WSe2/WS2 moiré heterobilayers, revealing pronounced exciton- and phonon-mode-dependent coupling, including nearly complete suppression of ExPC through destructive electron-hole interference. These findings establish the internal electron-hole spatial configuration of moiré excitons as a key degree of freedom governing the strength and mode selectivity of their coupling to moiré phonons, opening opportunities to engineer ExPC through spatially tailored moiré potentials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于统一的理论框架，发展了莫尔激子-声子耦合（ExPC）的实空间表示。研究揭示了一个普遍的实空间选择定则：莫尔激子的电子和空穴密度与莫尔声子诱导的势扰动的空间匹配决定了它们各自的耦合贡献，而电子和空穴贡献之间的相干干涉控制着总的ExPC。该定则在WSe2/WS2莫尔异质双层中得到验证，展示了显著的激子和声子模式依赖性耦合。
authors: Yixuan Liu, Shiyu Peng, Yifan Wang, Peiyao Qin, Wang Yao, Chen Hu

articles.title: Coulomb Crystallization in Free Electron Beams
articles.title_zh: 自由电子束中的库仑结晶
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37352v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Classical Coulomb crystals and quantum Wigner crystals typically arise when repulsive interactions order like-charged particles in spatially confined environments. Here, we show that transient crystallization can also emerge in freely propagating electron pulses without external trapping. Experimentally, we use a transmission electron microscope to measure number-resolved energy correlations in photoemitted pulses containing up to nine electrons, revealing strong correlations at small particle numbers that progressively disappear in the pulse interior as the number increases. To explain these observations, we combine many-body simulations with a one-dimensional statistical-mechanical model, showing that the leading and trailing electrons generate a self-induced longitudinal potential that transiently confines the inner particles, enabling the formation of an ordered chain during propagation. The resulting crystallization phase diagram reveals how many-body ordering dynamics can be understood in terms of evolving macroscopic beam properties, namely its geometry and the ratio of the mean Coulomb interaction energy to the longitudinal thermal energy. Extending this framework, we theoretically demonstrate that weak transverse guiding through electrostatic or optical ponderomotive forces can sustain crystallization at larger particle numbers and predict spontaneous longitudinal periodic bunching in continuous electron beams. Our results identify conditions under which stochastic Coulomb interactions can be harnessed to generate self-structured, strongly correlated electron beams in both pulsed and continuous regimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了自由传播电子脉冲中瞬态结晶现象。实验通过透射电子显微镜测量光发射脉冲中的能量关联，发现小粒子数时存在强关联。多体模拟和一维统计力学模型表明，前导和尾随电子产生的自诱导纵向电势暂时限制了内部粒子，促使有序链的形成。研究揭示了多体有序动力学与宏观束流特性之间的关系。
authors: Valerio Di Giulio, Rudolf Haindl, Armin Feist, Claus Ropers

articles.title: New Developments in Diagrammatic Monte Carlo for Interacting Lattice Fermions: Efficient Algorithms and Applications
articles.title_zh: 相互作用格点费米子图解蒙特卡罗的新进展：高效算法及应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37505v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This thesis develops diagrammatic methods for thermodynamic and subsystem quantities of interacting lattice fermions, providing reference calculations for quantum simulators and many-body approximations. I formulate an inverse-flavour expansion about a self-consistent Hartree saddle, enumerate non-Gaussian diagrams, and use a discrete Lehmann representation to integrate selected internal vertices analytically. Density results cover 31 state points of the six-flavour Hubbard model on a 70×70 lattice at T/t=0.15. I generalize combinatorial summation to flavour-dependent propagators and expansion shifts. CoS++ combines partial contractions to obtain connected sums for interaction subsets. A determinant-polynomial sieve evaluates the same sums through local coefficient filters; at ninth order it is 24--25 times faster than the specified CoS baselines in three-flavour dense-random-matrix benchmarks. Thermodynamic applications include a 2048-site honeycomb lattice and a three-flavour square lattice with 1024 sites. For the second Renyi entropy, I derive a fermionic replica path integral and a stable evaluation of its two-time Green functions. The connected-determinant calculation reaches tenth order on a 3×3 cluster and ninth order on larger lattices. On 50×50 sites at (U/t,μ/t,β t)=(3,1,8), the ninth-order continuation at shift α=1.3 gives S₂/Nₛ₌₀.06695 with propagated Monte Carlo uncertainty 3.0×10⁻⁵. Comparing two expansion shifts at their respective retained orders gives an endpoint difference of 2.6×10⁻⁴.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文发展了用于相互作用格点费米子热力学和子系统量的图解方法，为量子模拟器和多体近似提供了参考计算。研究提出了关于自洽Hartree鞍点的逆味展开，并推广了组合求和方法。CoS++算法结合部分收缩以获得相互作用子集的连接和，而行列式多项式筛法则通过局部系数滤波器评估这些和，显著提高了计算效率。
authors: Boyuan Shi

articles.title: Topological Criticality with Charge-(3e) Fluctuations in the (SU(3)) Triangular-Lattice Hofstadter--Hubbard Model
articles.title_zh: (SU(3))三角晶格Hofstadter-Hubbard模型中具有电荷-(3e)涨落的拓扑临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37575v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A transition between an integer quantum Hall insulator and a chiral spin liquid can become critical without closing the single-electron gap, raising the question of which composite excitations govern the change in topological order. We investigate this question in the (SU(3)) triangular-lattice Hofstadter--Hubbard model at one particle per site and magnetic flux (π/3) per triangle. Using infinite density matrix renormalization group calculations, we identify a weak-coupling integer quantum Hall phase and an interaction-driven (SU(3)₁) chiral spin liquid. Near the transition, both the neutral and charge-(3e) correlation lengths increase substantially, whereas the single-electron correlation length remains short, providing evidence for a Chern--Simons--Higgs critical theory, where a gauge-invariant monopole carries the quantum numbers of a fermionic (SU(3))-singlet trion. We discuss the implications for doping the system and recent experiments on doping (ν=-2/3) fractional quantum anomalous Hall in tMoTe(₂).
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了(SU(3))三角晶格Hofstadter-Hubbard模型中整数量子霍尔绝缘体与手性自旋液体之间的拓扑临界转变。通过无限密度矩阵重正化群计算，识别出弱耦合整数量子霍尔相和相互作用驱动的手性自旋液体。在转变附近，中性电荷和电荷-(3e)关联长度显著增加，支持了Chern-Simons-Higgs临界理论。
authors: Yang Liu, Ya-Hui Zhang, Xue-Yang Song

articles.title: Symmetry-resolved fermionic correlations in iron-oxide ground spaces
articles.title_zh: 氧化铁基态空间中对称分辨的费米子关联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36047v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Symmetries of quantum systems provide a natural way to organize the eigenspaces of many-body Hamiltonians. When degeneracies exist, however, they play a more subtle role as different sets of symmetry operators can resolve the same energy subspace into states with very different correlation properties. We study this interplay using a sequence of FeO and Fe₂O₂ models. For a Hubbard model of FeO, the ground space is 16-fold degenerate. Resolving it by local magnetizations gives a basis of Slater determinants, while total-spin quantum numbers select entangled and non-Gaussian states from the same ground manifold. Adding density-density Hund interactions breaks the independent spin rotations and reduces the ground space to a spin-reversal pair with maximal magnetization. These states are extremely close to Slater determinants in their natural occupations, yet have finite two-body cumulants and conserved-operator algebras whose orbit dimensions differ substantially from the Slater values. Fe₂O₂ provides a larger example in which spatial mode entanglement can be substantial while fermionic non-Gaussianity remains weak, with the conserved-operator structure again distinguishing the state from the corresponding Slater transformation class. Together, these examples show that symmetry resolution, mode entanglement, reduced-density-matrix correlations, and conserved-operator structure provide complementary information about interacting and degenerate electronic ground states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了量子系统中对称性在简并基态空间中对费米子关联的影响，以FeO和Fe₂O₂模型为例。对于FeO的Hubbard模型，16重简并基态空间可以通过局部磁化或总自旋量子数解析为具有不同关联性质的态。研究发现，即使态在自然占据数上接近Slater行列式，它们仍可能具有有限的二体累积量和与Slater值显著不同的守恒算符代数轨道维度。
authors: Federico Petrovich, Daniel Staros, Daniel N. Blaschke, Jian-Xin Zhu, M. Cerezo

articles.title: Generation of quantum light with tunable Wigner negativity with a semiconductor quantum dot
articles.title_zh: 利用半导体量子点生成具有可调谐维格纳负性的量子光
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36233v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Wigner-negative states of light are key resources for quantum advantage in continuous-variable optical quantum computing. They can be produced probabilistically via frequency conversion and photon detection, or deterministically by exploiting the single-photon nonlinearity of a quantum emitter. Here, we generate such Wigner-negative states of light with a tunable negativity using a single semiconductor quantum dot in a cavity. Optical coherent control of the quantum-dot transition allows to generate a quantum superposition of zero and one photon. The generated quantum states are characterized point-by-point in the phase space through homodyne measurement. The emergence of Wigner-function negativity is observed as the excitation power is increased. After correcting for collection and propagation losses, we obtain fidelities to the ideal state and quantum purities above 95%, together with near-optimal quadrature squeezing. The ability to generate a wide variety of Wigner-negative states with mature semiconductor technology opens promising opportunities for continuous-variable optical quantum technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 维格纳负性态是连续变量光学量子计算中的关键资源。本研究利用腔体中的单个半导体量子点，通过光学相干控制生成了具有可调谐负性的维格纳负性光态。通过零光子和单光子叠加态的产生，并结合外差测量在相空间中逐点表征，观察到随着激发功率增加，维格纳函数负性逐渐显现。经过损耗校正后，实现了超过95%的理想态保真度和量子纯度，以及接近最优的正交压缩，为连续变量光学量子技术开辟了前景。
authors: Hubert Lam, Petr Steindl, Yann Portella, Kiarn T. Laverick, Kian Hwee Lim, Juan R. Alvarez, Aristide Lemaitre, Maria Maffei, Alexia Auffeves, Dario A. Fioretto, Pascale Senellart

articles.title: Dynamical quantum simulations as laboratories for quantum information
articles.title_zh: 动态量子模拟作为量子信息实验室
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37589v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Dynamical quantum simulations are commonly designed to access a particular response function or correlation function. Yet the underlying protocol prepares a family of many-body states that contains information well beyond the observable for which the simulation was originally designed. In this work, we explore the idea of using these states as laboratories for quantum information. As a case study, we consider the local-pulse protocols used to compute Green functions in finite XX and XXX spin chains, and we interpret opposite source rotations as encoding a classical bit into the many-body system. This allows us to follow how the resulting record propagates, how it is encoded across local subsystems, and how readily it can be accessed with different measurements. We also find a clear separation between representation and readout. While fermionic covariance data exactly reconstruct the signed response in the XX chain, simple spin measurements recover a larger fraction of the locally available information in the XXX chain. This reversed ordering persists when we move from finite-pulse discrimination to local source-angle estimation. Going beyond the source record, the same reduced states also allow us to reinterpret results in terms of Bell state recovery and quantum communication rates, as well as providing direct access to the evolving bipartite and genuine multipartite entanglement of the system. Our results show that dynamical quantum simulations developed for response calculations can naturally be used to ask a much broader set of quantum-information questions about the many-body states they already prepare.
articles.abstract_zh: 动态量子模拟通常旨在获取特定的响应函数或关联函数，但其产生的多体态包含的信息远超最初设计的目标。本工作探讨了将这些状态用作量子信息实验室的理念。以XX和XXX自旋链中用于计算格林函数的局域脉冲协议为例，将相反的源旋转解释为将经典比特编码到多体系统中。研究了信息如何传播、如何在局域子系统中编码以及如何通过不同测量进行访问。结果发现表示和读取之间存在明显分离，其中费米子协方差数据精确重建了XX链中的带符号响应，而简单的自旋测量在XXX链中恢复了更大比例的局域可用信息，这种反向排序在从有限脉冲判别到局域源角估计时依然存在。
authors: Su Yeon Chang, Hailey S. Murray, Brian Barch, Greeshma Oruganti, Luis Pedro García-Pintos, Martin Larocca, Mark M. Wilde, M. Cerezo

articles.title: Topological Quantum Criticality in Quasiperiodic Cluster Ising Chain
articles.title_zh: 准周期簇伊辛链中的拓扑量子临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.01223v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Topological classifications of quantum critical systems have recently attracted growing interest, as they go beyond the traditional paradigms of condensed matter and statistical physics. However, such classifications remain largely unexplored in aperiodic environments, particularly under quasiperiodic modulations. In this Letter, we uncover a family of topological quasiperiodic fixed points with critical scalings intermediate between the clean and infinite-randomness limits. By exactly solving the quasiperiodic cluster-Ising chain, we demonstrate that all phase boundaries separating quasiperiodically modulated phases are governed by topological Ising-like fixed points unique to strongly modulated quasiperiodic systems. Although their local bulk critical properties match those of conventional quasiperiodic Ising critical points reported before, these fixed points host robust topological edge degeneracies and exhibit a distinct symmetry-enriched realization of the quasiperiodic Ising criticality, as further supported by complementary lattice simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子临界系统的拓扑分类日益受到关注，尤其是在非周期环境中。本研究揭示了一类拓扑准周期不动点，其临界标度介于纯净和无限随机极限之间。通过精确求解准周期簇伊辛链，证明了所有分隔准周期调制相的相边界都由强调制准周期系统独有的拓扑伊辛型不动点控制。这些不动点具有鲁棒的拓扑边缘简并性，并展现出独特的对称增强型准周期伊辛临界性，这得到了补充晶格模拟的进一步支持。
authors: Sheng Yang, Hai-Qing Lin, Xue-Jia Yu

articles.title: Electronic correlations and dynamical screening with ab initio quantum embedding
articles.title_zh: 基于从头算量子嵌入的电子关联和动态屏蔽
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.12336v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: First-principles descriptions of correlated quantum materials require a simultaneous treatment of strong local many-body effects and nonlocal dynamical screening. We present an efficient fully self-consistent implementation of GW+EDMFT that combines nonlocal correlations at the GW level with a non-perturbative treatment of local correlations within extended dynamical mean-field theory (EDMFT), with a well-defined double-counting correction and a self-consistently determined impurity interaction. Self-consistency in both the Green's function and the dynamically screened interaction is essential for describing screening processes across energy scales. A key ingredient that makes it computationally feasible is the compression of two-particle correlation functions using interpolative separable density fitting (ISDF). Applying the scheme to the Mott insulator SrMnO₃ and the correlated metal LaNiO₃, we show that the self-consistent effective local interaction resolves the overscreening inherent to constrained-RPA approaches. For SrMnO₃, this stabilizes a Mott-insulating state in quantitative agreement with experiment, while for LaNiO₃ local EDMFT corrections yield a quasiparticle mass enhancement consistent with ARPES. These results establish fully self-consistent GW+EDMFT as a reliable emphab initio framework for strongly correlated quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 对关联量子材料的第一性原理描述需要同时处理强局域多体效应和非局域动态屏蔽。本研究提出了一种高效、完全自洽的GW+EDMFT实现，它将GW层面的非局域关联与扩展动力学平均场理论（EDMFT）中的局域关联非微扰处理相结合，具有明确的双重计数校正和自洽确定的杂质相互作用。格林函数和动态屏蔽相互作用的自洽性对于描述跨能量尺度的屏蔽过程至关重要。通过对莫特绝缘体SrMnO₃和关联金属LaNiO₃的应用，结果表明自洽的有效局域相互作用解决了受限RPA方法固有的过屏蔽问题，使SrMnO₃的莫特绝缘态稳定，并与实验结果定量一致。
authors: Chia-Nan Yeh, Francesco Petocchi, Alexander Hampel, Philipp Werner, Olivier Parcollet, Antoine Georges, Miguel Morales

articles.title: Twin Algebras: Condensable Algebras beyond Anyons
articles.title_zh: 孪生代数：超越任意子的可凝聚代数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.31602v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Condensable algebras in 2+1d non-chiral topological orders characterize gapped boundary conditions and interfaces. Applied to the Symmetry Topological Field Theory, they allow classification of symmetric gapped phases and impose sharp constraints on possible phase transitions. A condensable algebra is specified not only by its underlying set of anyons, which end on the boundary or interface, but also by its algebra structure. We introduce the concept of twin condensable algebras, which have the same anyon decomposition, but inequivalent algebra structure. We revisit the classification of condensable algebras in Z(Vec_G^ømega), i.e. in group-theoretical topological orders for finite groups G with anomaly ømega. In this context we are able to identify twin algebras that arise from different mechanisms, such as subgroup data, SPT cocycles, and symmetry actions. In particular, we construct infinite families of examples of twins from so-called Gassmann triples, and exhibit cases in which the reduced topological orders are inequivalent despite having identical anyon content. Physically, twin algebras describe distinct symmetric phases that have isomorphic spaces of ground states, but inequivalent order parameters. Such twin phases never exhibit relative spontaneous symmetry breaking, and can be used to construct phase transitions without hidden symmetry breaking, which are intrinsically beyond Landau transitions.
articles.abstract_zh: 2+1维非手性拓扑序中的可凝聚代数表征了有能隙边界条件和界面，并允许对对称有能隙相进行分类。本研究引入了“孪生可凝聚代数”的概念，它们具有相同的任意子分解但代数结构不等价。在重新审视Z(Vec_G^ømega)中的可凝聚代数分类时，作者识别出源于子群数据、SPT上循环和对称作用的孪生代数。特别地，从Gassmann三元组构造了无限多族孪生代数示例，并展示了尽管任意子内容相同但约化拓扑序不等价的情况。物理上，孪生代数描述了不同的对称相。
authors: Yuhan Gai, Sakura Schafer-Nameki, Alison Warman

articles.title: Decoding Oxygen K-edge Fingerprints of NCM-811 Degradation via Ab Initio Many-Body Theory and High-Throughput Screening of Crystal Proxies
articles.title_zh: 通过从头算多体理论和晶体替代物高通量筛选解码NCM-811降解的氧K边指纹
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.02206v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The degradation of LiNi₀.₈Co₀.₁Mn₀.₁O₂ (NCM-811) in Li-ion batteries produces complex transition-metal oxides and binary phases that fundamentally limit cathode performance. While identifying these degradation products via X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) is essential for mitigating electrochemical performance loss, interpretation remains challenging due to the structural complexity of real-world samples. In this work, we present an integrated theoretical-experimental framework combining high-resolution oxygen K-edge XAS with ab initio simulations based on many-body perturbation theory and high-throughput screening from density functional theory. We first evaluate the spectroscopic fingerprints of eight layered, spinel, and nominal rock-salt reference oxides, identifying discrepancies between the idealized single-crystal bulk phase and experimental spectra. Using high-throughput screening to analyze the oxygen p-projected density of states of 38 distinct polymorphs of NiO, CoO, and MnO, we propose that the spectral differences can emerge, among other factors, from local structural variations represented here by simplified structural proxies. Our work establishes a viable and rigorous computational pathway to interpret the complex landscape of degraded battery materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 锂离子电池中LiNi₀.₈Co₀.₁Mn₀.₁O₂ (NCM-811)的降解会产生复杂的过渡金属氧化物和二元相，从根本上限制了正极性能。通过X射线吸收光谱（XAS）识别这些降解产物对于减轻电化学性能损失至关重要，但由于实际样品的结构复杂性，解释仍然具有挑战性。本工作提出了一个集成的理论-实验框架，结合高分辨率氧K边XAS与基于多体微扰理论的从头算模拟以及密度泛函理论的高通量筛选。首先评估了八种层状、尖晶石和名义岩盐参考氧化物的光谱指纹，识别出理想单晶体块相与实验光谱之间的差异。通过高通量筛选分析38种不同NiO、CoO和MnO多晶型物的氧p投影态密度，提出光谱差异可能源于局部结构变异。
authors: Daniel Duarte-Ruiz, Timo Reents, Elmar Kataev, Raul Garcia-Diez, Regan G. Wilks, Marcus Baer, Caterina Cocchi

articles.title: A Hierarchy of Exact Lower Bounds on the Laughlin Spectral Gap
articles.title_zh: 拉夫林谱隙的精确下界层次结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18854v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We develop a bootstrap approach to deriving lower bounds on the spectral gap of the first Haldane pseudopotential Hamiltonian on the sphere with N_Φ flux quanta for arbitrary N_Φ, including in the thermodynamic limit N_Φ → infty. This method can in principle be generalized to pseudopotentials describing other model wavefunctions such as the Moore--Read state or Read--Rezayi sequence. Our approach is based on Knabe's observation that if H is a Hamiltonian with ground state energy zero then the spectral gap is at least ϵ > 0 if and only if H² succeq ϵ H. To show this inequality, we split H² into two parts, one that can be analytically bounded and another that can be bounded using a finite semidefinite program (SDP). Crucially, the size of this program is determined only by cutoff parameters, and the program depends on N_Φ only parametrically, allowing us to obtain numerically exact (up to solver precision) lower bounds on the gap. In order to turn these numerical bounds into mathematically rigorous results, we introduce an algorithm that can produce nearly-optimal exact interior feasible points for large rational SDPs even if the affine constraints are highly redundant and ill-conditioned. We additionally provide an algorithm that establishes the rank stability of the SDP in the N_Φ → infty limit, which is needed to certify the bound in the thermodynamic limit. Beyond establishing a Laughlin gap greater than 1/100 in the thermodynamic limit and revealing a potential method for deriving spectral gap lower bounds for other pseudopotentials, our work provides a general method for turning numerical SDP bounds into rigorous mathematical proofs, which may have wide applicability. In particular, this work demonstrates that bootstrap methods can be used to rigorously resolve major open problems in quantum many-body physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究开发了一种自举方法，用于推导在任意N_Φ（包括热力学极限N_Φ → ∞）下，球面上第一个霍尔丹赝势哈密顿量的谱隙下界。该方法原则上可推广到描述其他模型波函数（如Moore-Read态或Read-Rezayi序列）的赝势。我们的方法基于Knabe的观察，即如果H是基态能量为零的哈密顿量，则谱隙至少为ϵ > 0当且仅当H² ≥ ϵH。为了证明此不等式，我们将H²分为两部分，一部分可以解析地界定，另一部分可以使用有限半定规划（SDP）进行界定。该规划的规模仅由截止参数决定，并且规划对N_Φ的依赖是参数化的，从而可以获得数值精确的谱隙下界。为了将这些数值界限转化为数学上严格的结果，我们引入了一种算法，可以为大型有理SDP生成接近最优的精确内部可行点。
authors: Michael G. Scheer, Eslam Khalaf

articles.title: Operator space transport in collective spin Lindbladians
articles.title_zh: 集体自旋林德布拉德算符中的算符空间输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.14291v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Boundary time crystals (BTCs) are paradigmatic examples of continuous time crystals that emerge in collective, dissipative quantum systems. Their microscopic origin, however, remains obscured by the complexity of Lindbladian many-body dynamics and has largely been investigated through semiclassical and numerical approaches. Here, we develop an exact operator space framework for collective spin Lindbladians based on irreducible tensor representations. We map the Lindbladian dynamics onto a local non-Hermitian hopping problem, where weak symmetries impose selection rules on operator transport, while the hopping amplitudes and their relative strengths determine the resulting dynamical regimes. We identify the microscopic ingredients that distinguish models supporting conventional collective precession from those supporting BTC dynamics. Our approach further reveals how non-unital dissipation can provide a source for the traceless operator subspace, providing a microscopic mechanism for the reduced sensitivity of BTC dynamics to initial conditions beyond mean-field descriptions. More broadly, our results establish operator space transport as a general perspective for understanding dissipative many-body dynamics and its connections to non-Hermitian phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 边界时间晶体（BTCs）是集体耗散量子系统中出现的连续时间晶体的典型例子，但其微观起源因林德布拉德多体动力学的复杂性而模糊。本研究基于不可约张量表示，为集体自旋林德布拉德算符开发了一个精确的算符空间框架，将林德布拉德动力学映射到局域非厄米跳跃问题。弱对称性对算符输运施加选择规则，而跳跃幅度和相对强度决定了产生的动力学机制。研究识别了区分支持传统集体进动模型和支持BTC动力学的微观成分。非幺正耗散为无迹算符子空间提供了来源，为BTC动力学对初始条件敏感性降低提供了超越平均场描述的微观机制。更广泛地说，我们的结果确立了算符空间作为理解耗散量子多体动力学的强大工具。
authors: Dominik Nemeth, Ahsan Nazir, Robert-Jan Slager, Alessandro Principi

articles.title: Entropy and Frenesy: the arrow and the bustle of time
articles.title_zh: 熵与狂热：时间的箭头与喧嚣
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17586v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Nonequilibrium statistical mechanics is the science of time as it manifests itself in the transient or steady entropy producing dynamical condition of many-body systems. Beyond the vivid multiformity of the phenomena themselves, three foundational issues lie at its heart. The first question concerns the very origin of entropy production, which gives macroscopic processes their direction and thereby defines the arrow of time: how does an atomistic mechanical world give rise to dissipated heat, thermalization, and time-reversal symmetry breaking? The second asks why, far beyond the familiar behavior of equilibrium systems, driving or agitation may produce and select stable and functionally rich structures: what is it about far-from-equilibrium, low-entropy driving that unleashes the wealth and intricacy of the natural world? The third issue is partly methodological: to determine how, and for which subclass of such wildly diverse nonequilibrium systems, a systematic, unified description and modeling from first principles remains possible. This essay addresses these issues in an informal, semi-popular-science style, offering a personally engaging yet wide-ranging introduction to the complementary roles of entropy production and the less familiar, more recently coined notion of frenesy in the dynamical fluctuations of steadily driven systems. Together, we argue, they provide a more complete starting point for understanding physical time on mesoscopic to macroscopic scales.
articles.abstract_zh: 非平衡统计力学是研究时间在多体系统瞬态或稳态熵产生动力学条件下的表现。本文探讨了三个核心基础问题：熵产生的起源如何赋予宏观过程方向并定义时间之箭；驱动或扰动为何能在远离平衡时产生并选择稳定且功能丰富的结构；以及如何对如此多样化的非平衡系统进行系统、统一的描述和建模。本文以非正式的科普风格，探讨了原子机械世界如何产生耗散热、热化和时间反演对称性破缺，以及远离平衡、低熵驱动如何释放自然世界的丰富性和复杂性。
authors: Christian Maes

articles.title: Toward Uncertainty-Aware and Generalizable Neural Decoding for Quantum LDPC Codes
articles.title_zh: 面向量子LDPC码的不确定性感知和可泛化神经解码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.06257v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum error correction (QEC) is essential for scalable quantum computing, yet decoding errors via conventional algorithms result in limited accuracy (i.e., suppression of logical errors) and high overheads, both of which can be alleviated by inference-based decoders. To date, such machine-learning (ML) decoders lack two key properties crucial for practical fault tolerance: reliable uncertainty quantification and robust generalization to previously unseen QEC codes. To address this gap, we propose a Quantum Bayesian graph Attention decoder (QuBA) that enables expressive error-pattern recognition alongside calibrated uncertainty estimates. Building on QuBA, we further develop a multi-phase training framework with enhanced cross-domain robustness enabling decoding beyond the training set called Sequential Aggregate Generalization under Uncertainty (SAGU). Experiments on bivariate bicycle (BB) codes and their coprime variants demonstrate that (i)QuBA consistently outperforms the classical baseline belief propagation (BP), achieving up to a emphtwo orders of magnitude reduction in logical error rate (LER) under confident-decision bounds on the coprime BB code [[154,6,16]]; (ii) SAGU achieves decoding performance comparable to or even outperforming QuBA's domain-specific training approach.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子纠错（QEC）对于可扩展量子计算至关重要，但传统算法的解码错误导致准确性有限且开销高，而推理型解码器可以缓解这些问题。然而，目前的机器学习解码器缺乏实际容错所需的两个关键特性：可靠的不确定性量化和对未见QEC码的鲁棒泛化能力。为解决此问题，本研究提出了一种量子贝叶斯图注意力解码器（QuBA），可实现富有表现力的错误模式识别和校准后的不确定性估计。在此基础上，进一步开发了多阶段训练框架SAGU（Sequential Aggregate Generalization under Uncertainty），以增强跨域鲁棒性。在双变量自行车（BB）码及其互素变体上的实验表明，QuBA始终优于经典基线置信传播（BP），在置信决策下可将逻辑错误率（LER）降低多达两个数量级。
authors: Xiangjun Mi, Frank Mueller

articles.title: Certified bounds on optimization problems in quantum theory
articles.title_zh: 量子理论中优化问题的认证界限
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2254 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-28-2254 Semidefinite relaxations of polynomial optimization have become a central tool for addressing the non-convex optimization problems over non-commutative operators that are ubiquitous in quantum information theory and, more in general, quantum physics. Yet, as these global relaxation methods are solved numerically, the bounds issued by the semidefinite solver can – and often do – exceed the global optimum, undermining their certifiability. To counter this issue, we introduce a framework for extracting rigorous certified bounds on non-commutative optimization problems from inexact numerical data, and apply it to several paradigmatic problems in quantum information theory. An extension to sparsity and symmetry-adapted semidefinite relaxations is also provided and compared to the general dense scheme. Our results establish rational post-processing as a practical route to reliable certification, pushing semidefinite optimization toward a certifiable standard for quantum information science.
articles.abstract_zh: 半定松弛是解决量子信息理论中非交换算子非凸优化问题的核心工具，但其数值解的界限常超出全局最优值，影响其可认证性。本文提出了一种从不精确数值数据中提取非交换优化问题严格认证界限的框架，并将其应用于量子信息理论中的多个典型问题。研究还提供了稀疏性和对称性适应的半定松弛扩展，并与通用密集方案进行了比较。结果表明，有理后处理是实现可靠认证的实用途径，推动半定优化成为量子信息科学的可认证标准。
