articles.title: Quantum Authenticated Key Expansion with Key Recycling
articles.title_zh: 具有密钥回收功能的量子认证密钥扩展
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2255 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-28-2255 Data privacy and authentication are two main security requirements for remote access and cloud services. While QKD has been explored to address data privacy concerns, oftentimes its use is separate from the client authentication protocol despite implicitly providing authentication. Here, we present a quantum authentication key expansion (QAKE) protocol that (1) integrates both authentication and key expansion within a single protocol, and (2) provides key recycling property – allowing all authentication keys to be reused. We analyse the security of the protocol in a QAKE framework adapted from a classical authentication key exchange (AKE) framework, providing separate security conditions for authentication and data privacy. We experimentally implemented the protocol with appropriate post-selection. Additional results on the security of pseudorandom basis generation in QAKE and decoy state BB84 are provided.
articles.abstract_zh: 数据隐私和认证是远程访问和云服务的主要安全需求。本文提出了一种量子认证密钥扩展（QAKE）协议，该协议将认证和密钥扩展集成到单个协议中，并提供密钥回收功能，允许所有认证密钥重复使用。研究在改编自经典认证密钥交换（AKE）框架的QAKE框架中分析了协议的安全性，并提供了认证和数据隐私的独立安全条件。该协议已通过实验实现。
authors: Wen Yu Kon, Jefferson Chu, Kevin Han Yong Loh, Obada Alia, Omar Amer, Marco Pistoia, Kaushik Chakraborty, and Charles Lim

articles.title: A Counterexample to the Optimality Conjecture in Convex Quantum Channel Optimization
articles.title_zh: 凸量子信道优化中最优性猜想的一个反例
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2253 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-28-2253 This paper presents a counterexample to the optimality conjecture for the trace distance based optimal state transformation problem proposed by Coutts et al. [Quantum 5, 448 (2021)]. The conjecture posits that for the trace distance based optimal state transformation problem, applying the sign function to the error matrix uniquely determines a dual certificate for every optimal solution. By constructing a counterexample in 2-dimensional Hilbert spaces, we disprove this conjecture.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对Coutts等人提出的基于迹距离的最优态变换问题的最优性猜想，提出了一个反例。该猜想认为，对于基于迹距离的最优态变换问题，将符号函数应用于误差矩阵可以唯一确定每个最优解的对偶证书。通过在二维希尔伯特空间中构建反例，本文成功推翻了这一猜想。
authors: Jianting Yang

articles.title: Towards quantum computing Feynman diagrams in hybrid qubit-oscillator devices
articles.title_zh: 混合量子比特-振子器件中量子计算费曼图的探索
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2252 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-28-2252 We show that recent experiments in hybrid qubit-oscillator devices that measure the phase-space characteristic function of the oscillator via the qubit can be seen through the lens of functional calculus and path integrals, drawing a clear analogy with the generating functional of a quantum field theory. This connection suggests an expansion of the characteristic function in terms of Feynman diagrams, exposing the role of the real-time bosonic propagator, and identifying the external source functions with certain time-dependent couplings that can be controlled experimentally. By applying maximum-likelihood techniques, we show that the “measurement'' of these Feynman diagrams can be reformulated as a problem of multi-parameter point estimation that takes as input a set of Ramsey-type measurements of the qubit. By numerical simulations that consider leading imperfections in trapped-ion devices, we identify the optimal regimes in which Feynman diagrams could be reconstructed from measured data with low systematic and stochastic errors. We discuss how these ideas can be generalized to finite temperatures via the Schwinger-Keldysh formalism, contributing to a bottom-up approach to probe quantum simulators of lattice field theories by systematically increasing the qubit-oscillator number.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将混合量子比特-振子器件中通过量子比特测量振子相空间特征函数的实验，视为泛函微积分和路径积分的视角，并与量子场论的生成泛函建立了明确的类比。这种联系表明特征函数可以展开为费曼图，揭示了实时玻色子传播子的作用。通过最大似然技术，研究表明费曼图的“测量”可重新表述为多参数点估计问题，并识别了在囚禁离子器件中以低系统和随机误差重建费曼图的最佳方案。
authors: S. Varona, S. Saner, O. BÄzÄvan, G. Araneda, G. Aarts, and A. Bermudez

articles.title: Optimal phase estimation in the presence of correlated dephasing
articles.title_zh: 存在关联退相干时的最优相位估计
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2251 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-28-2251 We investigate optimal metrological protocols for phase estimation in the presence of correlated dephasing noise, including spin-squeezed state sensing strategies as well as parallel and adaptive protocols optimized using tensor-network-based numerical methods. The results are benchmarked against fundamental bounds obtained either via the latest quantum comb extension method or an optimized classical simulation method. We find that the spin-squeezed states offer practically optimal performance in the regime where phase fluctuations are positively correlated but can be outperformed by tensor-network-optimized strategies for negatively correlated fluctuations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在存在关联退相干噪声时，用于相位估计的最优计量协议，包括自旋压缩态传感策略以及基于张量网络数值方法优化的并行和自适应协议。研究结果与通过最新量子梳扩展方法或优化经典模拟方法获得的基本界限进行了基准测试。结果表明，在相位波动正相关的情况下，自旋压缩态提供了实际最优的性能，但在负相关波动下，张量网络优化的策略可能表现更优。
authors: Srijon Ghosh, Arkadiusz Kobus, Stanisław Kurdziałek, and Rafał Demkowicz-Dobrzański

articles.title: Grid-state deformation in a no-jump non-Hermitian bosonic dimer
articles.title_zh: 无跳跃非厄米玻色子二聚体中的网格态形变
articles.abstract: We study the no-jump evolution of ideal grid states in a lossy bosonic dimer with differential decay. The effective non-Hermitian quadratic dynamics induces a complex symplectic flow in phase space that deforms both the primitive lattice vectors and the origin seed. The average decay rate controls common-mode attenuation, while coherent hopping and differential decay control the reduced dimer deformation. For resonant modes, the reduced displacement flow is oscillatory in the elliptic regime, linear at the exceptional point, and exponentially separating in the hyperbolic regime. Although projected lattice areas can change, the deformation comes from a determinant-one complex symplectic flow on the complexified phase space. For a Gaussian regularization of the origin seed in the resonant dimer, we derive the associated complex width matrix and show that the seed remains square-integrable and Gaussian for every positive initial width, all non-negative times, and all physical loss rates. For an initial two-mode qunaught product state, the lossless limit recovers the standard beam-splitter generation of a square Gottesman–Kitaev–Preskill Bell pair, while the no-jump dynamics produces its non-Hermitian deformation. The full no-jump probability for a normalized finite-energy input sets the postselection cost and depends on its excitation-number distribution and the reduced dimer dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有差分衰减的耗散玻色子二聚体中理想网格态的无跳跃演化。有效的非厄米二次动力学在相空间中诱导了复杂的辛流，导致原始晶格矢量和原点种子发生形变。研究发现，平均衰减率控制共模衰减，而相干跳跃和差分衰减控制简化的二聚体形变。对于谐振模式，简化的位移流在椭圆区域呈振荡，在奇异点处呈线性，在双曲线区域呈指数分离。
authors: B M Rodriguez-Lara, H Ghaemi-Dizicheh, S Dehdashti, A Hanke, A Touhami and J Nötzel

articles.title: Unconditional Security of Discrete-Modulated CV-QKD from Infinite-Dimensional MEAT
articles.title_zh: 基于无限维MEAT的离散调制连续变量量子密钥分发无条件安全性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.16105v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Discrete-Modulated (DM) Continuous-Variable (CV) Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) is an experimentally attractive approach to quantum cryptography, offering high key rates over metropolitan-scale distances while relying on state-of-the-art telecom infrastructure. However, a fundamental gap has remained between this experimental promise and rigorous security: for more than two decades, DM CV-QKD has lacked a complete composable finite-size security proof against coherent attacks. Existing works either restrict the adversary to collective attacks, impose additional finite-dimensional assumptions, apply only to specific modulation formats, or fail to recover the known asymptotic rates. Here, we resolve this longstanding problem by establishing the first complete composable finite-size security proof for DM CV-QKD protocols against coherent attacks, incorporating imperfect detectors and both fixed- and variable-length protocol variants. Our proof introduces two central results of broader interest: an infinite-dimensional marginal-constrained entropy accumulation theorem (iMEAT) and a rigorous dimension-reduction technique that makes the infinite-dimensional security bounds numerically tractable. The resulting key rates recover the known asymptotic rates and outperform established finite-size bounds based on collective attacks, while yielding positive key rates beyond 70km for experimentally relevant block sizes and parameters. Thus, our work closes a longstanding gap and places an experimentally attractive class of CV-QKD protocols on a rigorous composable security footing and provides a pathway towards their practical deployment.
articles.abstract_zh: 离散调制连续变量量子密钥分发（DM CV-QKD）在量子密码学中具有实验吸引力，但长期以来缺乏针对相干攻击的完整可组合有限尺寸安全性证明。本研究首次为DM CV-QKD协议建立了完整的可组合有限尺寸安全性证明，涵盖了不完美探测器以及固定和可变长度协议变体。该证明引入了无限维边际约束熵累积定理（iMEAT）和严格的降维技术，解决了这一长期存在的难题。
authors: Lars Kamin, Ian George, John Burniston, Florian Kanitschar

articles.title: Entangling distant qubits via flying photons under thermal noise protected by multi-time-bin encoding
articles.title_zh: 在热噪声下通过飞行光子纠缠远距离量子比特：多时间箱编码保护方案
articles.abstract: Entangling distant stationary qubits—such as superconducting qubits, color centers, trapped ions, and phononic modes—commonly relies on flying photons transmitted through noisy channels. The fidelity of remote entanglement is severely degraded by channel noise. While entanglement purification can theoretically mitigate this effect, its practical implementation in quantum networks is limited by the overhead of local operations and classical communication. We propose a multi-time-bin encoding scheme that improves the fidelity of remote entangled stationary qubits without relying on entanglement purification. Our results show that, compared to single-rail (vacuum–one-photon) encoding, the fidelity in thermal-loss Gaussian channels is improved from 0.66 to 0.89. Taking superconducting qubits connected through microwave-to-optical transduction as a representative implementation, the fidelity is increased from 0.75 to 0.98. Finally, we discuss the prospects for extending the protocol to other stationary-qubit platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 远距离固定量子比特的纠缠易受信道噪声影响，导致保真度严重下降。本研究提出了一种多时间箱编码方案，无需纠缠纯化即可提高远程纠缠固定量子比特的保真度。结果表明，在热损耗高斯信道中，该方案将保真度从0.66提高到0.89；对于通过微波-光转换连接的超导量子比特，保真度从0.75提高到0.98。该工作为在其他固定量子比特平台上扩展该协议提供了前景。
authors: Jing Wu, Changqing Wang, Andrew Cameron, Yao Lu and Silvia Zorzetti

articles.title: Same-spin correlation screens the exchange peak of the electron gas near 2kF
articles.title_zh: 电子气在2kF附近交换峰的同自旋关联屏蔽效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35896v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exchange alone gives the electron gas a local field factor with a sharp peak just below 2kF. Quantum Monte Carlo finds none. Both spin channels are computed here from their lowest diagrams with a dynamically screened interaction and no fitting. Parallel spin correlation is the negative image of exchange and removes about half the peak; the calculated spin-resolved factors account for the QMC data at rs = 1 and 2, and at q = 0 for the compressibility and spin susceptibility obtained from the ground-state energy. The two classes of diagrams are the two terms of the kernel of Hedin's vertex equation, of which the second is routinely dropped.
articles.abstract_zh: 电子气中单独的交换作用会在2kF附近产生一个尖锐的局域场因子峰值，但这与量子蒙特卡洛模拟结果不符。本研究通过计算最低阶图的动态屏蔽相互作用，发现平行自旋关联是交换作用的负像，能够消除约一半的峰值。计算得到的自旋分辨因子与rs=1和2时的QMC数据以及q=0时从基态能量获得的压缩性和自旋磁化率数据一致。
authors: Carl A. Kukkonen

articles.title: Amorphization-Depth-Dependent Bismuth Redistribution and Activation in Silicon for Quantum Devices
articles.title_zh: 硅中非晶化深度依赖的铋再分布与激活及其在量子器件中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35993v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Near-surface bismuth donors are promising for silicon quantum devices because of their rich electron-nuclear spin structure and long spin coherence, but their electrical activation is strongly influenced by implantation-induced amorphization. We compare redistribution and electrical activation of 20 keV Bi implanted directly into Si and after Si preamorphization. The two routes produce amorphous-layer depths of approximately 47 nm and 177 +/- 15 nm, respectively. After annealing at 650 C for 300 s, Rutherford backscattering spectrometry and channeling reveal comparable substitutional Bi fractions of 91 +/- 2% and 89 +/- 4%, whereas Hall measurements indicate Hall-derived electrical activation yields of approximately 60% and 90%, respectively. Depth-resolved ion-scattering analysis reveals a buried Bi-related feature at or beyond the initial amorphous/crystalline interface, within the end-of-range region, together with increasing surface segregation at higher annealing temperatures. The buried feature is consistent with trapping near residual end-of-range defects. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy and low-temperature photoluminescence on the Bi-only sample reveal no resolvable Bi-oxide contribution and a donor-related optical signature, respectively. These results show that amorphization depth and regrowth geometry govern Bi redistribution and influence electrical activation beyond substitutional incorporation alone.
articles.abstract_zh: 表面附近的铋施主因其独特的自旋结构和长自旋相干时间，在硅量子器件中具有应用前景，但其电学激活受注入诱导非晶化的强烈影响。本研究比较了直接注入和预非晶化硅中20 keV Bi的再分布和电学激活。结果显示，尽管两种方法在退火后具有相似的替代性Bi分数，但预非晶化硅的电学激活率显著更高。深度分辨分析揭示了在非晶/晶体界面附近存在埋藏的Bi相关特征，这与末端缺陷附近的捕获有关。
authors: Youcef A. Bioud, Simon-Jean Michel, Sebastien Francoeur, Sjoerd Roorda, Eva Dupont-Ferrier

articles.title: Emergent Fermi Surfaces in Periodically Driven Bose Gases
articles.title_zh: 周期性驱动玻色气体中的涌现费米面
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36038v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that the steady state of a periodically driven Bose gas coupled to a thermal bath features emergent Fermi surfaces both in its high temperature and Bose-Einstein-condensate (BEC) states. These emergent Fermi surfaces are non-analyticities in the occupation function as a function of momentum arising from the lack of detailed balance of collisions away from equilibrium. They are stronger in the BEC than in the normal gas, and can be more robust against finite temperature smearing than the usual equilibrium Fermi surfaces of Fermi gases. We also show that they give rise to analogous rich phenomena, such as Friedel oscillations in the density correlations and quantum oscillations in response to applied magnetic fields controlled by their areas, albeit with marked quantitative differences. Our results establish non-equilibrium conditions as a promising alternative pathway to achieve the long-sought-after emergence of Fermi surfaces in bosonic system. We outline strategies to experimentally discover these exotic states in ultra-cold atomic clouds.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究表明，与热浴耦合的周期性驱动玻色气体，无论是在高温态还是玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（BEC）态，其稳态都表现出涌现的费米面。这些费米面源于非平衡碰撞中缺乏细致平衡，表现为占据函数在动量上的非解析性，且在BEC中比在正常气体中更强。它们还能引起类似弗里德尔振荡和量子振荡等现象。该工作为在玻色子系统中实现费米面提供了一条新的非平衡途径。
authors: Li-kun Shi, Oles Matsyshyn, Inti Sodemann Villadiego

articles.title: Typicality of entanglement growth and transport fluctuations in quantum symmetric exclusion processes
articles.title_zh: 量子对称排斥过程中纠缠增长和输运涨落的典型性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36048v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We use macroscopic fluctuation theory (MFT) to establish the typicality of charge-transfer statistics and entanglement dynamics in the quantum symmetric exclusion process, a model of stochastically hopping free fermions with diffusive transport and long-range quantum coherence. We show that the leading long-time charge-transfer full counting statistics of individual noise realizations coincide almost surely with those of the classical symmetric exclusion process (SSEP), in equilibrium and following quenches from arbitrary occupation-diagonal product states. Our results apply to transient fluctuations in the thermodynamic limit, extending previous work that has primarily focused on stationary regimes. Our approach compares the noise averages of the charge-transfer generating function and its inverse. The former reduces to SSEP, while the latter maps to an auxiliary Brownian energy process whose MFT saddle-point problem is related to that of SSEP, yielding matching large-deviation exponents. Through free-fermion identities relating entanglement to subsystem-number fluctuations, this establishes the self-averaging of the covariance-matrix eigenvalue distribution and of Rényi and von Neumann entropies. We obtain asymptotically exact predictions for entanglement growth from domain-wall and Néel initial states, in excellent agreement with numerical simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究利用宏观涨落理论（MFT）确立了量子对称排斥过程中电荷转移统计和纠缠动力学的典型性。我们发现，在热力学极限下，单个噪声实现的长时电荷转移全计数统计几乎必然与经典对称排斥过程（SSEP）一致。该方法通过比较电荷转移生成函数及其逆的噪声平均值，并利用自由费米子恒等式将纠缠与子系统数涨落联系起来，从而建立了协方差矩阵的自平均性。
authors: Ewan McCulloch

articles.title: Three-dimensional quantum Hall insulators in magnetic pyrochlore systems
articles.title_zh: 磁性烧绿石系统中的三维量子霍尔绝缘体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36199v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that a class of pyrochlore materials provides a route to realize 3D Quantum Hall insulators, based on magnetic texture and flat band interference. We study itinerant electrons on a pyrochlore lattice Kondo-coupled to localized moments living on another interpenetrating pyrochlore lattice, with the moments forming a field-selected three-in/one-out texture. The noncoplanar texture generates complex spin-dependent hopping amplitudes and unequal local exchange energies, reconstructing the compact-localized parent flat bands into narrow bands separated by a global three-dimensional gap. The low-energy states are concentrated predominantly on kagome planes within the three-dimensional lattice, reflecting the combined effects of quantum interference and the texture-induced sublattice potential. When the lowest band is fully occupied, the response is characterized by a Chern triplet C=(1,1,1) and reciprocal Hall vector GH=(2π/a)(1,1,1), giving σyz=σzₓ=σₓy=e²/(ha). The quantized bulk Hall response enforces chiral surface spectral flow, visible as noncontractible Fermi loops at the surface. Our work opens a new direction in the search for three-dimensional quantum Hall physics in magnetic pyrochlore systems, and suggests a broad design principle based on the interplay of magnetic texture and flat-band interference.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究展示了一类烧绿石材料如何通过磁性结构和平带干涉实现三维量子霍尔绝缘体。我们研究了在烧绿石晶格上与局域磁矩Kondo耦合的巡游电子，这些磁矩形成特定的磁性构型。这种非共面构型产生了复杂的自旋依赖跳跃幅度和不等的局域交换能，将紧致局域的母体平带重构为窄带。当最低能带完全占据时，系统表现出量化的体霍尔响应，并伴随手性表面谱流。
authors: Ze-Xun Lin, Robert-Jan Slager, Claudio Castelnovo

articles.title: Towards Quantum Computation of Bulk FeO
articles.title_zh: 块状FeO量子计算的探索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36268v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum computation offers a promising path towards efficient calculations of the electronic structure of correlated materials. The properties of iron-based materials, which are key for advancing geological and astrophysical understanding, are notoriously difficult to calculate with classical computers. However, despite the many recent advances in quantum computing on near intermediate scale quantum hardware, a full treatment of the electronic structure of high-Z atoms or molecules remains challenging. Here, we investigate the ground-state properties of molecular FeO and Fe₂O₂ model Hamiltonians using classical exact diagonalization, Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE), and Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization (SQD). The experimental quintet ground state of FeO is recovered classically and with quantum algorithms, while a nonet ground state is recovered for Fe₂O₂. Although raw VQE does not achieve chemical accuracy for the ground state of FeO or Fe₂O₂, SQD with two connectivity shells recovers the exact ground energy for both molecules utilizing remarkably few quantum computational resources. Overall, our results indicate that ab ; initio-informed low-energy models of correlated materials, combined with SQD, offer a new alternative for scaling up calculations of ground-state properties of strongly correlated solids on existing quantum hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子计算为关联材料的电子结构计算提供了有效途径，尤其对于难以用经典计算机处理的铁基材料。本研究利用经典精确对角化、变分量子本征求解器（VQE）和基于采样的量子对角化（SQD）方法，探究了分子FeO和Fe₂O₂模型哈密顿量的基态性质。结果显示，SQD方法以极少的量子计算资源，成功恢复了FeO和Fe₂O₂的精确基态能量，表明其在处理高Z原子或分子电子结构方面的潜力。
authors: Daniel Staros, Federico Petrovich, Ammar Kirmani, Daniel N. Blaschke, M. Cerezo, Jian-Xin Zhu

articles.title: No friction required: Self-locking in entangled assemblies of curved filaments
articles.title_zh: 无需摩擦：弯曲丝状物纠缠组装体的自锁机制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36330v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Filaments are incredible material building blocks that, when entangled together, form robust structures with remarkable adaptive mechanics, from stiff cables to stretchable knits. Basic questions about the mechanism that holds together such structures, especially assemblies like rope, without attractive physical or chemical bonds between constituents are among the oldest considered in materials science. Contradicting a long-standing picture that structural integrity of rope-like assemblies rely on a combination of external loading and inter-filament friction to prevent spontaneous detangling (e.g. fraying of a cut rope), we demonstrate that assemblies of intrinsically-curved filaments can achieve structural integrity purely from the competition of elastic forces that resist shape-change and (traction-free) repulsive forces that prevent overlap. We analyze a friction-free model of assembly of intrinsically-helical filaments, and show that depending on filament number and preferred filament shape, overcrowding in the assemblies generate elastic pre-stresses that give rise to either self-locking entanglement or spontaneous detanglement through propagation of a soliton-like detanglement front through assemblies. We test a generalized fracture criterion for spontaneous detangling and confirm the role of shape-elastic costs to self-locking via experiment and simulation of frictional filaments, demonstrating a range of bundled structures which cannot be made self-locking for any value of friction. The mechanism of ``purely elastic cohesion" illuminated here sheds light on self-locking in a broader class of entangled structures, and further, offers design principles for new classes of active filament materials capable of stimuli-responsive assembly and disassembly.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统的观点认为绳索状结构的完整性依赖于外部载荷和丝间摩擦，以防止自发解缠。本研究通过分析固有弯曲丝状物的无摩擦组装模型，挑战了这一观点。我们证明，这类组装体仅通过抵抗形变的弹性力与防止重叠的排斥力之间的竞争，就能实现结构完整性。结果表明，根据丝状物数量和形状，组装体中的过度拥挤会产生弹性预应力，从而导致自锁纠缠或自发解缠。
authors: Benjamin R. Greenvall, Jay van den Berg, Ross E. Meinhart, Patrick A. Staudenmayer, Alfred J. Crosby, Gregory M. Grason

articles.title: Nano-Nb Superconducting 3D Josephson Junctions Arrays in Cu-Normal Matrix: Superconducting Phase Coherence and Quantum Fluctuations Properties
articles.title_zh: 铜-正常基体中纳米铌超导三维约瑟夫森结阵列：超导相干性和量子涨落特性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36482v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: To address the complex interplay of microstructural evolution, phase separation, superconductivity coherence and quantum fluctuations, we prepared Cuxwt%Nb series of granular samples by rapidly cooling, where the niobium concentration varied (x = 3, 5, 15, 20). By employing this method, we successfully obtained samples characterized by well-defined precipitates of niobium, featuring regular sizes and grain spacing. The goal was to establish a systematic and robust method approach for obtaining samples with different of sub-micrometric precipitates distributions but also to investigate their superconducting properties. Structural characterization by optical and Scanning Electron Microscopy, dc Mdc[H,T] ac inductive , as well the magneto-transport measures rhodc[H,T], Rdc[V,I.H,T], I[V,H,T] and [H,T,I] were done. Also, using a micro Hall sensor with 10 measuring transverse voltage bridges regularly distributed, we were able to obtain the real external applied magnetic field value inside of the chamber sample space. Thus e studied the dependence of configuration of the Nb grains in the superconducting coupling order parameter properties that connects the grains superconductors to the normal Cu matrix. We verify through magnetization and transport measures the signature of the double transition. This, when we apply current of different intensities, in the transport measures, and different field values, in the inductive measures. This behavior is an indication that our system is made up of by a collection of superconducting grains immersed in a well-organized in a non-superconducting matrix. The results indicate that the superconducting properties of these systems are manifested usually through two transition temperatures Tc(H) e TcJ(H).
articles.abstract_zh: 为探究微观结构演变、相分离、超导相干性和量子涨落之间的复杂相互作用，本研究通过快速冷却制备了一系列不同铌浓度的Cuxwt%Nb颗粒样品。我们成功获得了具有规则尺寸和晶粒间距的铌沉淀物样品，并对其超导特性进行了系统研究。通过多种结构和磁输运测量，我们还利用微型霍尔传感器精确测量了样品腔内的磁场，从而深入分析了铌晶粒配置对超导耦合序参量特性的影响。
authors: R. L. de Almeida, J. Albino Aguiar, J. A. H. Coaquira

articles.title: Comprehensive QM/ML Study of Dislocation Loop Line Segments in α-Zr Part I: Loop Core Geometries, Solute Binding, and Transition Barriers
articles.title_zh: α-Zr中位错环线段的综合QM/ML研究第一部分：环核几何、溶质结合和转变势垒
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36619v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Zr cladding alloys in nuclear reactors are exposed to high neutron fluxes, making irradiation-induced defects and solute segregation central to understanding their in-service behaviour. Dislocation cores involve short-range chemistry and long-range elastic fields, which are difficult to describe simultaneously using conventional atomistic methods. Using a hybrid quantum mechanics/machine learning (QM/ML) framework, this part of work examines prismatic loops in hcp α-Zr. All three loop variants are considered, including faulted and perfect, interstitial- and vacancy-type, and first- and second-order prismatic configurations. Nine possible dislocation line segments are characterised in terms of core geometry, solute binding, glide barriers and faulted-to-perfect transition pathways using QM/ML and newly implemented QM/ML-NEB calculations. Shockley and half-Shockley partials, together with basal and prismatic fault ribbons, are found to govern core stabilisation. Fe and H preferentially bind to faulted segments, whereas Sn and Nb favour perfect segments. Solutes can also drive partial motion, recombination and local unfaulting. These results establish a comprehensive picture of loop microstructure, solute trapping and transition mechanisms in α-Zr.
articles.abstract_zh: 核反应堆中Zr包壳合金的辐照诱导缺陷和溶质偏析对其性能至关重要。本研究利用混合量子力学/机器学习（QM/ML）框架，详细考察了密排六方α-Zr中的棱柱形位错环。研究表征了九种可能的位错线段的核几何、溶质结合、滑移势垒和缺陷到完美转变路径。结果发现，Shockley和半Shockley不全位错以及基面和棱柱面堆垛层错带控制着核的稳定性，且不同溶质（如Fe、H、Sn、Nb）对不同位错段表现出选择性结合。
authors: Junting Zhang, Andrew P. Horsfield, Mark R. Wenman

articles.title: Where Does the Anion-Redox Hole Go? Reliability of Open-Shell Projection-Based Embedding for Li-Rich Cathodes, from DFT Environments to Quantum Solvers
articles.title_zh: 阴离子氧化还原空穴去向何处？富锂正极中基于投影的开壳层嵌入方法的可靠性研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36659v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Anion redox in Li-rich layered oxides places holes on oxygen next to an antiferromagnetic Mn(IV) d3 lattice, a strongly correlated open-shell problem for which projection-based wavefunction-in-DFT embedding offers a route to correlated and quantum solvers, but whose errors are known mainly for closed-shell molecules. We develop a spin-unrestricted projection-based embedding, exact at the DFT-in-DFT level to the microhartree scale for closed-shell, broken-symmetry and high-spin references with point charges, and apply DMRG-in-DFT to point-charge clusters of delithiated Li(2-x)MnO3, varying the environment functional (0-100% exact exchange), geometry, active region, active-space spin, virtual space, cluster size and magnetic reference. In every setting the lowest SCF state places the hole on an oxygen pair, with no O-O bond. How the hole is shared depends on the functional together with the geometry: hybrids give a full, uncoupled hole at the DFT+U geometry but a partial, weakly covalent hole at their own geometry, a change of up to 0.5 e on one oxygen. Where spin spreads across the active/environment boundary, the integer spin projection of the active space becomes a choice worth up to 0.26 e, and at most 0.09 e once the two Mn neighbors are included. An extended state search found missed lower states for two functionals, changing a pair-oxygen spin by up to 0.45 e. Across all 82 runs the embedded mean field gives the same hole (median DMRG change 0.02-0.04 e); correlation mainly adds O-O covalency. State control and geometry consistency, not the solver, dominate the uncertainty, and total energies are not converged at 30-40 orbitals. For quantum solvers, the embedded Hamiltonian must be spin-unrestricted: a shared-orbital form reverses the hole, while sample-based quantum diagonalization reproduces exact diagonalization, as accurately as, but not better than, classical selected CI.
articles.abstract_zh: 富锂层状氧化物中的阴离子氧化还原涉及氧上的空穴，这是一个强关联的开壳层问题。本研究开发了一种自旋非限制的基于投影的嵌入方法，并将其应用于脱锂Li(2-x)MnO3的点电荷簇。结果表明，最低SCF态将空穴置于氧对上，且空穴的共享方式取决于泛函和几何结构。当自旋跨越活性区/环境边界时，整数自旋投影变得复杂。
authors: Pritam Das, Satadeep Bhattacharjee, Pil-Ryung Cha

articles.title: Robustness of Anyonic Time-Domain Interference Against Dephasing
articles.title_zh: 任意子时域干涉对退相干的鲁棒性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36686v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent anyon-collider experiments have identified time-domain braiding (TDB) as a new route to probing anyonic statistics. However, how such time-domain interference responds to environmental noise remains an open question. Here we show that TDB interference is intrinsically more robust than its spatial counterpart. In conventional spatial interference, environmental noise induces phase fluctuations that accumulate throughout all paths, leading to exponential suppression of the interference as the dephasing rate increases. In TDB, by contrast, the interfering temporal paths experience largely overlapping environmental fluctuations, whose contributions cancel out in the relative phase, so that only a small nonoverlapping temporal window contributes to dephasing. As a result, TDB interference decays only algebraically with the dephasing rate, providing a new experimental hallmark for its identification. We propose a Fabry-Perot fractional quantum Hall setup in which both types of interference coexist and experience the same environmental noise, enabling a direct comparison of their dephasing behaviors. Our results establish robustness against dephasing as a fundamental advantage of TDB and suggest new opportunities for exploiting anyonic interference in noisy mesoscopic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 任意子对撞机实验已将时域编织（TDB）确定为探测任意子统计的新途径，但其对环境噪声的响应尚不清楚。本研究表明，TDB干涉本质上比其空间对应物更具鲁棒性。在TDB中，干涉时间路径的重叠环境波动会相互抵消，导致干涉衰减与退相干速率呈代数关系。研究提出了一种Fabry-Perot分数量子霍尔装置，可直接比较两种干涉的退相干行为，证实了TDB的鲁棒性。
authors: Hai-Dong Li, Hao-Xiang Long, Gu Zhang, D. Y. Xing, Wei Chen

articles.title: Ground-State Properties of a Lattice-Coupled Strongly Correlated Model for Solid Oxygen under Pressure
articles.title_zh: 压力下固态氧晶格耦合强关联模型的基态性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36697v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Solid oxygen is an S=1 molecular magnet with strong coupling between spin and lattice degrees of freedom. Recent studies suggest that magnetic moments coexist with tetramer distortions under pressure. We derive an effective spin Hamiltonian from a two-orbital Peierls--Hubbard model with spin-orbit coupling. The resulting model contains competing easy-plane single-ion and easy-axis exchange anisotropies. We analyze this model on a square lattice using quantum Monte Carlo simulations and evaluate the magnetic contribution to the lattice stiffness for several lattice distortion patterns including the tetramer pattern. We find that the tetramer pattern is the most favorable among the considered distortion patterns throughout the parameter range studied. Moreover, competition between the two anisotropies enhances the tendency toward lattice distortion and strengthens the preference for tetramerization over the other patterns.
articles.abstract_zh: 固态氧是一种S=1分子磁体，其自旋和晶格自由度之间存在强耦合。本研究从双轨道Peierls-Hubbard模型推导出一个有效自旋哈密顿量，并使用量子蒙特卡罗模拟分析了该模型。结果表明，在所研究的参数范围内，四聚体畸变模式是最有利的。此外，两种各向异性之间的竞争增强了晶格畸变的趋势，并加强了四聚体化相对于其他模式的偏好。
authors: Naomichi Sato, Makoto Naka, Joji Nasu

articles.title: Intercomponent vortex interaction and dynamics in a uniform Bose quantum liquid
articles.title_zh: 均匀玻色量子液体中组分间涡旋相互作用与动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36710v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the interaction and dynamics of vortices belonging to different components of a binary uniform quantum liquid. Using the coupled extended Gross-Pitaevskii equations with logarithmic beyond-mean-field corrections, we derive the asymptotic interaction potential between well-separated vortices. The interaction potential retains the asymptotic form s⁻² as a function of the intervortex distance s, but its coefficient depends on the background density through the quantum fluctuation. As a result, the interaction between vortices changes from attractive to repulsive at a critical density. Real-time simulations demonstrate a corresponding reversal of orbital motion of a vortex pair from clockwise to counterclockwise, consistent with their Magnus response.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了二元均匀量子液体中不同组分涡旋的相互作用和动力学。利用耦合扩展的Gross-Pitaevskii方程，推导了分离涡旋之间的渐近相互作用势。结果发现，相互作用势的系数取决于量子涨落引起的背景密度，导致涡旋间的相互作用在临界密度下从吸引变为排斥。实时模拟证实了涡旋对轨道运动从顺时针到逆时针的相应反转，与它们的马格努斯响应一致。
authors: Rabeea Kiran, Hiroki Saito, Hsiang-Hua Jen

articles.title: Magnetic Imaging with High Spatial Resolution Using a Single Niobium-Nitride-Based Three-Dimensional Nanobridge Junction
articles.title_zh: 基于单铌氮三维纳米桥结的高空间分辨率磁成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36856v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The nanobridge junctions (NBJs) allow the miniaturization of the Superconducting Quantum Interference Device (SQUID) and improve the spatial resolution of scanning SQUID microscopy. However, the SQUID loop diameter imposed a fundamental limit on the resolution. In this work, we proposed a single niobium-nitride-based three-dimensional nanobridge junction (NbN-3D-NBJ) alternative to the nanoSQUID for high-resolution magnetic imaging. The critical current of an NbN-3D-NBJ showed an nearly monotonic dependence on the external magnetic field, enabling nanoscale mapping of the magnetic field distribution by measuring the junction's critical current with an intrinsic noise level of 100 nT/Hz¹/2. Using a NbN-3D-NBJ probe, we successfully imaged an Abrikosov vortex in a niobium film with a minimal full width at half maxima (FWHM) of 530 nm, constrained by the distance from the junction to the probe tip edge. Furthermore, we resolved 80 nm spacings between the superconducting nanowires utilizing a second probe with an optimized junction-to-tip distance. Thus, the single 3D NbN NBJ probe has been demonstrated as an effective approach for magnetic imaging with ultra-high spatial resolution.
articles.abstract_zh: 纳米桥结（NBJ）可实现超导量子干涉器件（SQUID）的小型化，并提高扫描SQUID显微镜的空间分辨率。本工作提出了一种基于单铌氮三维纳米桥结（NbN-3D-NBJ）的替代方案，用于高分辨率磁成像。NbN-3D-NBJ的临界电流对外部磁场表现出近乎单调的依赖性，实现了纳米尺度的磁场分布映射。利用NbN-3D-NBJ探针，成功成像了铌薄膜中的阿布里科索夫涡旋，并分辨了超导纳米线之间80纳米的间距，证明了其作为磁成像有效方法的潜力。
authors: Yinping Pan, Yue Wang, Xinxin Fan, Xu Liu, Shirui Liu, Xiaoyu Liu, Ling Wu, Lu Zhang, Wei Peng, Jie Ren, Jiamin Xiong, Hao Li, Lixing You, Zhen Wang, Lei Chen

articles.title: Structural supermodulation enables resonant Raman determination of crystalline orientation in Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x flakes
articles.title_zh: 结构超调制实现Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x薄片晶体取向的共振拉曼测定
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36995v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x (Bi-2212) is a d-wave superconductor with unconventional properties intrinsic to the material itself. These properties are of growing interest for quantum technologies in electronics and photonics, and twisted Josephson junctions can make direct use of them. However, Bi-2212 is strongly anisotropic, and it is challenging to find its crystal axes in flakes in advance, which limits device engineering. Here, we show that polarized resonant Raman spectroscopy reveals the orientation of both the a and b axes of Bi-2212 optically and non-destructively. By correlating Laue diffraction, HAADF-STEM and polarized Raman scattering on the same bulk crystal, we assign the b axis, along which the incommensurate structural supermodulation propagates, to the intensity maximum of the 27 cm-1 supermodulation mode, which varies in counter-phase with the 118 cm-1 Bi/Sr mode, along the a axis. Multi-wavelength measurements (458, 532, 660 nm) show that resulting in-plane contrast peaks at 532 nm and nearly vanishes at 660 nm, indicating that the anisotropy originates from an electronic resonance induced by the supermodulation. Using this resonance, we determine the crystallographic axes of exfoliated flakes and access their symmetry channels, providing a rapid orientation tool for cuprate van der Waals heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x (Bi-2212) 是一种具有本征非常规性质的d波超导体，其强烈的各向异性使得预先确定晶轴具有挑战性。本研究展示了偏振共振拉曼光谱如何光学且无损地揭示Bi-2212的a轴和b轴取向。通过关联劳厄衍射、HAADF-STEM和偏振拉曼散射，将沿不相称结构超调制传播的b轴归因于27 cm-1超调制模式的强度最大值。多波长测量表明，面内对比度在532 nm处达到峰值，表明各向异性源于超调制引起的电子共振。
authors: Flavia Lo Sardo, Tommaso Confalone, Shreya Kumbhakar, Genda Gu, Ahmad Omar, Christian G. F. Blum, Daniel Wolf, Davide Massarotti, Francesco Tafuri, Axel Lubk, Kornelius Nielsch, Nicola Poccia, Golam Haider

articles.title: Transport statistics in asymmetric coupled chaotic dots in series: Brownian motion model
articles.title_zh: 串联非对称耦合混沌点中的输运统计：布朗运动模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37090v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study statistics of transport properties in a system of two quantum chaotic cavities coupled in series through a tunable junction and connected to reservoirs with asymmetric leads. Within the random matrix theory framework and in the absence of time-reversal symmetry, the scattering matrix S undergoes a crossover from two independent circular unitary ensembles to a single CUE as the inter-cavity coupling increases. Modeling this crossover using Dyson's Brownian motion approach, with the junction width acting as a time-like parameter, we derive closed-form expressions for the time-dependent averages and variances of conductance and shot noise power for arbitrary lead asymmetry. These analytical results reduce to known expressions in the symmetric and fully coupled limits. The mapping between the Brownian time parameter and the physical junction width is found to be observable-dependent, reflecting the different eigenfunction correlations probed by conductance and shot noise power, and this dependence is examined and separately calibrated for each observable. Validating against random-matrix simulations and tight-binding transport calculations using Kwant, we find quantitative agreement for ensemble-averaged observables throughout the crossover, while variances, being more sensitive to microscopic fluctuations, show deviations from the Brownian-motion predictions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究在随机矩阵理论框架下，探讨了串联耦合的两个量子混沌腔中输运性质的统计。通过Dyson布朗运动方法建模，推导了电导和散粒噪声功率随时间变化的平均值和方差的封闭形式表达式。这些解析结果在对称和完全耦合极限下与已知表达式一致。研究发现，布朗时间参数与物理结宽之间的映射是可观测物依赖的，反映了电导和散粒噪声功率探测到的不同本征函数关联。
authors: Ashutosh Dheer, Santosh Kumar, Jayendra N. Bandyopadhyay

articles.title: Langevin dynamics towards Generalized Gibbs Ensembles
articles.title_zh: 广义吉布斯系综的朗之万动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37129v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In recent years, statistical physics tools have been used to study the dynamics of macroscopic quantum and classical integrable models. These studies have shown that, in the thermodynamic limit, long term time-averages of local observables equal statistical averages calculated with a Generalized Gibbs Ensemble (GGE). In the latter, the weight in phase space involves all constants of motion multiplied by Lagrange multipliers which are fixed by their initial values. We argue that the GGE can be interpreted as a proper Boltzmann measure of a different (non-standard) mechanical model. This measure can therefore be sampled with stochastic methods implemented, for example, as a Langevin process. We tailor the deterministic force in the Langevin equations so that at long times the stochastic trajectories sample the desired measure. We use the integrable Neumann Model -- the model of a classical particle constrained to move on a sphere under anisotropic harmonic potentials -- as a benchmark. We test the method in a setup where the Lagrange multipliers are fixed by the GGE governing the asymptotic dynamics of the isolated Neumann model following a quench. This problem has different phases depending on the initial conditions and quench protocol and, in all cases, with the stochastic evolution of an adequately tuned Langevin process we reproduce the asymptotic values of relevant observables.
articles.abstract_zh: 近年来，统计物理工具被用于研究宏观量子和经典可积模型的动力学。本研究认为，广义吉布斯系综（GGE）可以被解释为一种不同（非标准）力学模型的玻尔兹曼测度。因此，该测度可以通过朗之万过程等随机方法进行采样。研究调整了朗之万方程中的确定性力，使得在长时间下随机轨迹能够采样到所需的测度，并以可积的Neumann模型作为基准进行了验证。
authors: Rafael González-Albaladejo, Leticia F. Cugliandolo, Gustavo S. Lozano, Daniel A. Stariolo

articles.title: Hydrodynamic fluctuations in Luttinger liquids
articles.title_zh: Luttinger液体中的流体动力学涨落
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37301v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop the theory of hydrodynamic fluctuations for one-dimensional quantum liquids. At low temperatures the relaxation of interacting electrons in a single-channel wire separates into two classes: equilibration, which changes the numbers of right and left movers through backscattering and is exponentially slow, and thermalization, which redistributes energy and momentum at a fixed number of movers at a power-law rate. This separation of time scales gives the electron liquid a two-fluid description analogous to superfluid ⁴He, with the zero mode of the Luttinger liquid as the superfluid component and the gas of thermal excitations as the normal component. Using Onsager reciprocity and the fluctuation-dissipation theorem, we add Langevin fluxes to the two-fluid hydrodynamic equations, including a mutual-friction noise generated by rare backscattering events that has no counterpart in helium. We apply the theory to Coulomb-coupled quantum wires and calculate the dynamic structure factors, which contain a second-sound peak next to the plasmon doublet; the Coulomb drag resistivity, where intrawire equilibration acts as a bottleneck and turns the hydrodynamic drag into an activated temperature dependence; and the near-field heat transfer between the wires. Mode frequencies, spectral weights, linewidths, and the crossover scales of the transport coefficients are expressed through the thermodynamic properties of the liquid and a few dissipative coefficients, providing spectroscopic and transport probes of two-fluid behavior in one-dimensional quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究发展了一维量子液体流体动力学涨落理论。在低温下，单通道线中相互作用电子的弛豫分为平衡和热化两类，时间尺度分离使得电子液体具有类似于超流⁴He的双流体描述。利用昂萨格互易关系和涨落-耗散定理，研究将朗之万通量添加到双流体流体动力学方程中，包括由稀有反向散射事件产生的互摩擦噪声。该理论应用于库仑耦合量子线，计算了动态结构因子和库仑拖曳电阻率。
authors: Alex Levchenko

articles.title: Quantum critical scaling in convective active matter
articles.title_zh: 对流活性物质中的量子临界标度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37569v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct a minimal field theory for critical quantum active matter, describing a nonconserved scalar order parameter with Landau-Ginzburg ordering and self-advection. When diffusive noise dominates, higher-order quantum vertices and non-Gaussian noise fluctuations remain relevant alongside the deterministic nonlinearities, with an upper critical dimension d_c=2. A one-loop renormalization-group analysis in d=2-ϵ reveals a purely dissipative fixed point, where nonlinear noise suppresses convection, and a quantum convective saddle, where interactions, convection, and non-Gaussian noise coexist. We determine the critical exponents, show that the convective regime is distinct from conventional Burgers hydrodynamics, and discuss how it could govern transient universal scaling in microscopic models of quantum active matter before a crossover to semi-classical dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一个描述非守恒标量序参数、具有Landau-Ginzburg有序和自对流的临界量子活性物质的最小场论。当扩散噪声占主导时，高阶量子顶点和非高斯噪声涨落与确定性非线性同样重要。在d=2-ϵ维度下的一圈重整化群分析揭示了一个纯耗散不动点和一个量子对流鞍点。研究确定了临界指数，表明对流机制不同于传统的Burgers流体动力学，并讨论了其如何控制量子活性物质微观模型中的瞬态普适标度。
authors: Jamir Marino

articles.title: On-the-fly Estimation of Quantum-Corrected Thermodynamics in LAMMPS
articles.title_zh: LAMMPS中量子校正热力学的即时估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37586v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a native implementation of the Two/Three-Phase Thermodynamics (xPT, x in 2,3) method within the LAMMPS molecular dynamics framework, termed FixXPT. xPT is an approach for obtaining absolute, quantum-corrected thermodynamics (entropy, enthalpy, free energy, heat capacity, diffusivity) from the density of states function, obtained from the velocity autocorrelation function of an equilibrium trajectory. FixXPT addresses non-trivial integration challenges, including atom reordering, compute scheduling, FFT backends, unit systems, and partitioning of atomic velocities into molecular modes. Two autocorrelators are provided: a Wiener-Khinchin FFT correlator with one cumulative window-end operation, and an in-line multi-tau correlator whose memory footprint grows only logarithmically with the window length, removing the principal scaling bottleneck for long analysis windows. The velocity history of each window is distributed across the MPI ranks, so the memory the fix adds to a node stays nearly constant as ranks are added and its cost falls with the number of GPUs. Replaying identical velocity frames through FixXPT and the stand-alone pyxPT post-processor reproduces every thermodynamic observable of well-sampled groups to within 0.1 to 0.5% across the full analysis-mode matrix; sparsely populated ionic species agree within their statistical uncertainty, and the multi-tau VACF converges monotonically to the FFT result as its buffer grows, from 0.8% to 0.1% drift across a 16-fold buffer sweep. The code is distributed as a drop-in LAMMPS package.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究在LAMMPS分子动力学框架内，实现了Two/Three-Phase Thermodynamics (xPT) 方法，命名为FixXPT。xPT是一种从平衡轨迹的速度自相关函数获得的态密度函数中，获取绝对、量子校正热力学（熵、焓、自由能、热容、扩散系数）的方法。FixXPT解决了原子重排、计算调度、FFT后端等集成挑战，并提供了两种自相关器。该实现优化了内存占用和并行计算效率，为LAMMPS用户提供了强大的量子校正热力学分析工具。
authors: Robert Ramji, Ilya Mazalov, Ricardo Buarque, Alexandria Do, Xiaoxu Ruan, Tod A. Pascal

articles.title: ODAT-SE: A modular and parallel framework for simulation-based inverse problems
articles.title_zh: ODAT-SE：一个用于基于模拟的逆问题的模块化并行框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36746v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Open Data Analysis Tool for Science and Engineering (ODAT-SE) is an open-source Python framework for inverse problems that are solved by repeated forward simulations. It succeeds 2DMAT, which was developed for surface-structure analysis with quantum-beam diffraction and has since been applied to other fields. In version 3, the search algorithms were separated from the application-specific solvers, which became independent packages, and the software was renamed; this paper describes the current version 4.0. The framework connects optimization and sampling algorithms to solvers through a common interface for parameter mapping, constraints, and objective evaluation, so that an existing simulation code can be used with any of the algorithms. Relative to the previously published 2DMAT, it provides two-level MPI parallelism, which distributes candidate evaluations over processes and each evaluation over a parallel solver, checkpoint and continuation facilities, random search, global optimizers from SciPy, tensor-train optimization, and a Bayesian workflow that estimates partition-function ratios, model evidence, effective noise levels, and marginal posterior distributions. We validate the Bayesian workflow against closed-form results for a linear regression, benchmark tensor-train optimization on continuous, binary, and mixed-integer problems, and verify the two-level parallelization by the same optimum for all process decompositions. Taking up the positron-diffraction example of the 2DMAT paper, the workflow identifies the correlated structural solutions and an effective noise scale close to the imposed perturbation, while exposing incomplete convergence of symmetry-related mode weights. Solver packages, templates, and a gallery of examples support the use of the framework as a general platform for inverse-problem analysis.
articles.abstract_zh: ODAT-SE（Open Data Analysis Tool for Science and Engineering）是一个开源Python框架，用于通过重复正向模拟解决逆问题。该框架将优化和采样算法通过通用接口连接到求解器，使得现有模拟代码可以与任何算法配合使用。相对于之前的版本，ODAT-SE 4.0提供了两级MPI并行化、检查点和续接功能、随机搜索、SciPy中的全局优化器、张量列车优化以及贝叶斯工作流，极大地增强了其功能和效率。
authors: Tatsumi Aoyama, Kazuyoshi Yoshimi, Yuichi Motoyama, Akito Nakano, Hengyu Li, Yusuke Konishi, Takeo Hoshi

articles.title: Experimental evidence for quantum Brownian motion in electron-metal decoherence
articles.title_zh: 电子-金属退相干中量子布朗运动的实验证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.37293v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Feynman once remarked that the double-slit experiment has in its heart the only mystery of quantum mechanics. Arguably, the scientific significance of double-slit experiments lies in motional decoherence and the mechanism behind it. Decoherence of motional states underpins our understanding of quantum-to-classical transition. It is also central to the operation of miniaturized quantum electron devices and poses a resolution limit for electron microscopes. In this work, we provide experimental evidence for the critical role of quantum Brownian motion in electron motional decoherence. We demonstrate, for the first time, clear signatures of electron-metal decoherence and its continuous tunability. Our experiment concludes a two-decade long search for experimental realization of the Anglin-Paz-Zurek proposal, establishing electron-microchannel systems as viable open quantum platforms for free-electron quantum optics. The quantitative agreement between experiment and theory further paves the way for testing the Caldeira-Leggett quantum dissipation theory with free electrons.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提供了电子运动退相干中量子布朗运动关键作用的实验证据。研究首次展示了电子-金属退相干的清晰特征及其连续可调性，并实现了Anglin-Paz-Zurek提案的实验验证。实验结果与理论的定量一致性，为利用自由电子检验Caldeira-Leggett量子耗散理论奠定了基础。
authors: Wayne Cheng-Wei Huang, Zilin Chen, Herman Batelaan

articles.title: Quasi-flat and exact flat bands in patterned two-dimensional electron gases and honeycomb wire networks
articles.title_zh: 图案化二维电子气和蜂窝状线网络中的准平带和精确平带
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.06118v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the formation of flat bands in a two-dimensional electron gas patterned by a periodic triangular array of repulsive antidots. In the high-barrier, narrow-trench regime, the spectrum develops kagome-like band triplets, each comprising a nearly flat band and two dispersive bands, with wave functions concentrated along the potential-free trenches. The two lowest energy bands have a different character with graphene-like dispersion and wave functions localized near the junction centers. The appearance of the trench-concentrated nearly flat bands further motivates a honeycomb quantum graph model as an effective description of the narrow-trench limit. In the single-channel graph, destructive interference produces exact flat bands with compact localized eigenstates protected by the D₃ symmetry. Their energies obey a quantization condition determined by propagation along the links and scattering at the junctions. We then extend the analysis to a multichannel quantum graph and derive the most general junction scattering matrix compatible with D₃ symmetry. Even- and odd-parity transverse channels contain equivalent symmetry sectors, and D₃ symmetry therefore allows them to mix. This mode conversion can disrupt the destructive interference responsible for flat bands and generically gives those bands a finite width. Exact flatness is nevertheless retained when only one transverse-parity sector is active, or when an additional symmetry forbids mixing between the two sectors. These results connect the continuum antidot model to its quantum-graph limit and identify transverse-mode mixing as a mechanism that limits flatness in multichannel networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了由周期性三角形排斥反点阵列图案化的二维电子气中平带的形成。在高势垒、窄沟道区域，能谱呈现出类kagome带三重态，包含一个准平带和两个色散带。研究进一步提出了蜂窝状量子图模型作为窄沟道极限的有效描述，并在单通道图中通过相消干涉产生了受D₃对称性保护的精确平带。
authors: Chunxiao Liu, Igor Pishniak, Benoît Douçot, Jérôme Cayssol

articles.title: Phonon number relaxation in a 3D superfluid with a concave acoustic branch
articles.title_zh: 具有凹声学支的三维超流体中声子数弛豫
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.18298v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We consider the collisional evolution towards equilibrium of a spatially homogeneous and isotropic phonon gas of a three-dimensional superfluid with a concave acoustic excitation branch, at a non-zero but arbitrarily low temperature T. Three-phonon collisions 1φłeftrightarrow 2φ are forbidden by conservation of energy-momentum. Four-phonon collisions 2φ→ 2φ of Landau and Khalatnikov lead, after a time propto T⁻⁷, only to a partial thermal equilibrium, a Bose law of non-zero chemical potential for the phonons, because they conserve the total number of phonons. Relaxation towards complete thermochemical equilibrium is therefore ensured by the much slower five-phonon collisions 2φłeftrightarrow 3φ of Khalatnikov, in a time propto T⁻⁹. Using kinetic equations on the occupation numbers of the phonon modes and explicitly calculating the 2φ→ 3φ collisional amplitude with quantum hydrodynamics at low temperature, we determine the corresponding evolution of the fugacity z_φ of the phonon gas from the non-degenerate regime z_φ=0⁺ to complete equilibrium z_φ=1⁻. Using the conservation of total energy, we find that the fugacity varies with a non-integer power law propto t⁴/⁵ at short times and an exponential law at long times; the speed of change of entropy, always positive, is asymptotically proportional to the square of the speed of change of fugacity, (d/dt)S_φpropto[(d/dt)z_φ]², as Landau predicted for an arbitrarily slow adiabatic transformation. Our results bring to a close the study initiated by Khalatnikov in 1950 and could be experimentally verified in a gas of cold spin-1/2 fermionic atoms in the sector of the BEC-BCS crossover where the acoustic branch has a concave start, or in superfluid liquid helium-4 at sufficiently high pressure.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有凹声学激发支的三维超流体中声子气体的碰撞弛豫过程。由于能量-动量守恒，三声子碰撞被禁止，而四声子碰撞仅导致部分热平衡。完全热化学平衡则由慢得多的五声子碰撞确保，其弛豫时间与T⁻⁹成正比。通过动力学方程和量子流体动力学计算，确定了声子气体逸度从非简并态到完全平衡的演化。
authors: Yvan Castin (LKB), Mariia Tsimokha (LKB)

articles.title: Quantized Collective Fluctuations in Correlated Fermion Systems
articles.title_zh: 关联费米子系统中的量子化集体涨落
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.00211v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Collective excitations in fermionic systems play a crucial role in determining their physical properties. An important challenge is to develop efficient theoretical approaches for describing these excitations and their coupling to fermionic degrees of freedom. In this work, we revisit the problem of quantifying the contributions of individual bosonic modes of collective fluctuations to observable properties of correlated fermion systems within the framework of the Fluctuating Local Field (FLF) method. Whereas the auxiliary field in this method was previously considered only classically, we formulate its systematic extension termed Quantum FLF (Q-FLF) that incorporates selected bosonic Matsubara modes, thus tailoring it to description of quantum collective fluctuations. As a testbed, we apply the approach to a half-filled one-dimensional Hubbard chain and compute the Green's function, the total energy, and the antiferromagnetic susceptibility. Our results demonstrate that the proposed scheme enables an efficient and selective characterization of the contributions of individual bosonic modes. In particular, low Matsubara frequencies are found to have a quantitative impact on integrated observables such as total energy and antiferromagnetic susceptibility. At the same time, an accurate description of single-particle properties requires inclusion of higher-frequency bosonic modes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在涨落局域场（FLF）方法框架内，重新审视了量化集体涨落中单个玻色子模式对关联费米子系统可观测性质贡献的问题。研究提出了量子FLF（Q-FLF）方法，系统地扩展了FLF，纳入了选定的玻色子松原模式，以描述量子集体涨落。该方法应用于半填充一维Hubbard链，结果表明该方案能有效且选择性地表征单个玻色子模式的贡献。
authors: S. S. Onuchin, Ya. S. Lyakhova, L. D. Silakov, A. N. Rubtsov

articles.title: Electrically tunable Crossed Andreev Reflection in Bipolar Magnetic Semiconductors
articles.title_zh: 双极磁性半导体中电可调的交叉安德烈夫反射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.15939v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Crossed Andreev reflection (CAR) is a nonlocal quantum transport phenomenon that arises at the interfaces between a superconductor and two spatially separated metals. In this process, an electron incident from one metal combines with another electron originating from the other metal to form a Cooper pair in the SC. In this work, we theoretically investigate the quantum transport properties of a device comprising a central s-wave superconductor sandwiched between two bipolar magnetic semiconductor (BMS) leads. BMS materials possess a unique bandstructure where the conduction and valence bands are fully spin-polarized in opposite directions. By applying independent gate voltages to the two BMS leads, we selectively tune their chemical potentials to configure an antiparallel spin alignment at the Fermi energy. In the absence of spin-orbit coupling (SOC), this specific configuration perfectly suppresses both local Andreev reflection and direct electron tunneling (ET), thereby isolating and profoundly enhancing CAR. The introduction of Rashba SOC, however, induces spin-flip scattering that relaxes these strict selection constraints, yielding finite probabilities for competing scattering channels and subsequently reducing the overall CAR efficiency. Nevertheless, for SOC strengths below a critical threshold, CAR remains the dominant transport mechanism over ET. This proposed architecture provides a scalable, stray-field-free method to achieve purely electrostatic control over nonlocal transport, advancing the development of highly efficient superconducting spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论研究了由s波超导体夹在两个双极磁性半导体（BMS）引线之间器件的量子输运性质。通过独立栅极电压调谐BMS引线的化学势，可在费米能级实现反平行自旋排列。在无自旋轨道耦合（SOC）的情况下，这种配置能完美抑制局域安德烈夫反射和直接电子隧穿，从而显著增强交叉安德烈夫反射（CAR）。
authors: Polireddi Naveen, Abhiram Soori

articles.title: Shortcuts to Adiabaticity via Adaptive Quantum Zeno Measurements
articles.title_zh: 通过自适应量子芝诺测量实现绝热捷径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.17786v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Stroboscopic measurements of a time-dependent projector generate a quantum Zeno dynamics whose effective Hamiltonian is the Kato-Avron Hamiltonian for parallel transport, which reduces to counterdiabatic driving in the case of a nonselective measurement of the instantaneous eigenprojectors of the system. The same generator arises under continuous monitoring of a time-dependent observable and under a time-varying complex absorbing potential. Departures from the ideal Zeno limit are governed, in all three settings, by a single positive leakage operator with a dynamical and a purely geometric contribution. Matching the corresponding generators yields a model-independent generalized Schulman relation for the quantum Zeno dynamics in the three scenarios, and a purely geometric bound on the measurement resources needed to steer a subspace along a prescribed path.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了通过时间依赖投影仪的频闪测量产生的量子芝诺动力学，其有效哈密顿量为Kato-Avron哈密顿量。研究发现，在连续监测时间依赖可观测量和时变复吸收势的情况下，也会产生相同的生成元。偏离理想芝诺极限由一个具有动力学和纯几何贡献的泄漏算符控制，并导出了一个模型无关的广义Schulman关系。
authors: Adolfo del Campo

articles.title: Simple slow operators and quantum thermalization
articles.title_zh: 简单慢算符与量子热化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.13172v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We establish a rigorous operator-space condition for the thermalization of typical initial states. We introduce a concept of simple slow operators (SSOs), defined as operators that evolve slowly under Heisenberg-picture dynamics and have significant small-sized components. We show that the non-thermalization of typical initial states drawn from a weakly entangled state ensemble implies the existence of SSOs; equivalently, the absence of SSOs implies that typical initial states thermalize. We establish these results by introducing the concept of an ensemble variance norm of an operator, defined as the typical magnitude of the expectation value of that operator with respect to states in the ensemble. For low-entanglement ensembles, the norm is related to operator sizes, allowing us to establish a direct link between operator dynamics and thermalization.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为典型初始态的热化建立了一个严格的算符空间条件，并引入了“简单慢算符”（SSOs）的概念。研究表明，从弱纠缠态系综中抽取的典型初始态的非热化意味着SSOs的存在，反之，SSOs的缺失则意味着典型初始态的热化。这些结果通过引入算符的系综方差范数来确立，该范数将算符动力学与热化直接联系起来。
authors: Tian-Hua Yang, Ethan Jeon, Sarang Gopalakrishnan, Dmitry A. Abanin

articles.title: Discovering quantum phenomena with Interpretable Machine Learning
articles.title_zh: 利用可解释机器学习发现量子现象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.16015v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Interpretable machine learning techniques are becoming essential tools for extracting physical insights from complex quantum data. We build on recent advances in variational autoencoders to demonstrate that such models can learn physically meaningful and interpretable representations from a broad class of unlabeled quantum datasets. From raw measurement data alone, the learned representation reveals rich information about the underlying structure of quantum phase diagrams. We further augment the learning pipeline with symbolic methods, enabling the discovery of compact analytical descriptors that serve as order parameters for the distinct regimes emerging in the learned representations. We demonstrate the framework on experimental Rydberg-atom snapshots, classical shadows of the cluster Ising model, and hybrid discrete-continuous fermionic data, revealing previously unreported phenomena such as a corner-ordering pattern in the Rydberg arrays. These results establish a general framework, which constitutes an important step toward the autonomous discovery of physical descriptors from diverse quantum datasets. All methods are available through qdisc, an open-source Python library designed to make these tools accessible to the broader community.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用变分自编码器的最新进展，展示了可解释机器学习模型能够从广泛的无标签量子数据集中学习到有物理意义的表示。从原始测量数据中，学习到的表示揭示了量子相图的深层结构信息。研究进一步结合符号方法，发现了紧凑的分析描述符作为序参量，并应用于实验Rydberg原子快照等数据，揭示了新的量子现象。
authors: Paulin de Schoulepnikoff, Hendrik Poulsen Nautrup, Hans J. Briegel, Gorka Muñoz-Gil

articles.title: Ancestor Lifting of Quasi-Cyclic Additive Codes and Certified Quantum Codes
articles.title_zh: 准循环加性码的祖先提升与认证量子码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.36700v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Additive codes over Ffour that are self-orthogonal under the trace inner product correspond to binary quantum stabilizer codes. We study 1-generator (1,2)-quasi-cyclic (QC) additive codes and their exact quantum distances. For composite lengths n=ell m, an ancestor-lifting theorem transports dual words of the folded ancestor to the length-n code. A two-layer decomposition for ell=2 and a CRT splitting for odd ell yield dimension laws and explain equality, escape, and mixed-branch behavior in the certified examples. A palindromic criterion ensures symplectic self-orthogonality, while reversal pairing and a symplectic Gram rank formula describe broader construction families. Exact distances are established by information-set decoding screening, Brouwer--Zimmermann computation on the additive dual, and independent witness verification. We certify twenty-one record-breaking binary quantum codes across twenty entries of Grassl's code table, with twenty-eight certified members in total. Propagation improves thirty-four further entries, and explicit constructions are supplied for three table-tying GV entries marked Code Missing Construction. Six additional candidates are reported only with rigorous upper bounds and heuristic screening evidence. The results connect divisor-lattice structure in additive quasi-cyclic codes with reproducible certification of exact quantum distances.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了F₄上的1-生成器(1,2)-准循环加性码及其精确量子距离。对于复合长度n=ℓm，祖先提升定理将折叠祖先的对偶码字传输到长度为n的码。研究通过信息集解码筛选、加性对偶上的Brouwer-Zimmermann计算和独立证人验证来确定精确距离。本文认证了Grassl码表中二十一个破纪录的二元量子码，并改进了三十四个条目。
authors: Liangdong Lu, Ran Xu, Ruipan Yang, Qiang Fu

articles.title: Converse symplectic interlacing via low-rank singular value perturbations
articles.title_zh: 通过低秩奇异值扰动实现逆辛交错
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35376v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The symplectic interlacing theorem states that the symplectic spectrum of a 2n × 2n real symmetric positive definite matrix satisfies a 2k-step interlacing relation with the symplectic spectrum of every 2(n-k) × 2(n-k) s-principal submatrix. We prove the converse in this paper. More precisely, given a positive global symplectic spectrum of size n and a positive local symplectic spectrum of size n-k satisfying the 2k-step interlacing inequalities, we construct a 2n × 2n real symmetric positive definite matrix having the prescribed global symplectic spectrum and a 2(n-k) × 2(n-k) s-principal submatrix of it having the prescribed local symplectic spectrum. Our main tool is a reduction of s-principal compression to a rank-k singular value perturbation. In the context of the Gaussian quantum marginal problem, our result implies that the symplectic interlacing inequalities are not merely necessary conditions on Gaussian marginals, but are also the complete spectral compatibility conditions for the global-versus-local-mode marginal problem.
articles.abstract_zh: 辛交错定理指出，2n × 2n实对称正定矩阵的辛谱与其每个2(n-k) × 2(n-k) s-主子矩阵的辛谱满足2k步交错关系。本文证明了该定理的逆命题，即给定满足交错不等式的全局和局部辛谱，可以构造出相应的矩阵。主要工具是将s-主压缩简化为秩k奇异值扰动。在量子边际问题中，该结果表明辛交错不等式是全局与局部模式边际问题的完整谱兼容性条件。
authors: Priyanka Grover, Hemant K. Mishra, Sarishti Singh, Temjensangba

articles.title: Trial-space co-design for quantum simulation on noisy hardware
articles.title_zh: 噪声硬件上量子模拟的试探空间协同设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33246v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum simulations on noisy hardware are often designed as if the machine were ideal, with device limitations considered only after the basis and measurement plan have been chosen. We instead use information about the physical problem and the device at an earlier stage, to decide which states and evolution times should form a compact simulation basis. Because the target problem remains unchanged, the method adapts only the representation used to solve it. Tests on many-body and molecular models show that this approach can reveal useful directions that ordinary time evolution misses, while also exposing an important limitation: some of these directions can become too similar to estimate reliably. Realistic device data further show that hardware response can change the preferred states and evolution times before execution. Across seven acquisition days, a four-qubit experiment shows a median 54% reduction in projected-energy error from problem-informed time choices relative to uniform sampling under matched hardware conditions. These results provide a proof of principle for simulation-basis design as a practical interface between quantum algorithms and the hardware that executes them.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种在噪声硬件上进行量子模拟的试探空间协同设计方法，该方法在早期阶段利用物理问题和设备信息，选择构成紧凑模拟基态的状态和演化时间。这种方法可以揭示传统时间演化可能遗漏的有用方向。在四量子比特实验中，该方法将投影能量误差中位数降低了54%，为模拟基态设计作为量子硬件与问题之间的实用接口提供了原理证明。
authors: Bo peng, Vibin Abraham, Himadri Pathak

articles.title: When is a bosonic operator a Hamiltonian?
articles.title_zh: 玻色子算符何时是哈密顿量？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33545v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hermitian polynomials in the quadrature operators x and p are the basic ingredients of continuous-variable quantum information, and increasingly exotic ones are now routinely engineered in superconducting circuits and trapped ions. However, such a polynomial need not define unique quantum dynamics: it may define exactly one, none, or an infinite family of physically distinct ones. Such obstructions are invisible to algebraic arguments and can compromise finite-dimensional truncations, which may fail to converge or silently converge to the wrong dynamics. We develop a method, implemented as an algorithm, which decides which case occurs, and how large the family is, from the coefficients alone, with no functional-analytic input from the user. For Gaussian operators the answer is always one; for non-Gaussian ones, a regime continuous-variable quantum computing cannot do without, the other outcomes occur already for simple and physically natural Hamiltonians. We apply the algorithm to operators drawn from the recent literature.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了正交算符x和p的厄米多项式何时能定义唯一的量子动力学。研究发现，此类多项式可能定义一个、零个或无限个物理上不同的量子动力学，这些障碍对代数论证是不可见的。本文开发了一种算法，仅根据系数即可判断属于哪种情况以及家族的大小。对于非高斯算符，即使是简单且物理自然的哈密顿量也可能出现多种结果。
authors: Felix Fischer, Hermann Schulz-Baldes, Daniel Burgarth, Davide Lonigro

articles.title: The Coherent State Projection Eigenvalue Theorem
articles.title_zh: 相干态投影本征值定理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33613v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent papers have developed a cyclic symmetry projected extension for coherent state representations of bosonic Hilbert space. This extension can greatly reduce sampling errors in phase-space simulations of bosonic quantum systems that have symmetries. Here we prove an eigenvalue theorem for the continuum limit of the projected coherent states. Our intuitively appealing result is that in the continuum limit the projected coherent states are eigenstates of the symmetry generating operator. This result gives a differential identity in phase-space that includes the conserved eigenvalues. Detailed applications of these differential identities to obtaining improved Fokker-Planck and stochastic equations in many-body physics will be given elsewhere.
articles.abstract_zh: 近期研究发展了一种玻色希尔伯特空间相干态表示的循环对称投影扩展，该扩展能显著减少具有对称性的玻色量子系统在相空间模拟中的采样误差。本文证明了投影相干态在连续极限下的一个本征值定理。结果表明，在连续极限下，投影相干态是对称生成算符的本征态，这提供了一个包含守恒本征值的相空间微分恒等式。
authors: Peter D. Drummond, Margaret D. Reid

articles.title: Efficient Block Encodings of Vibrational Hamiltonians
articles.title_zh: 振动哈密顿量的有效块编码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33800v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Simulation of molecular vibrations is emerging as a promising application of quantum computing in quantum chemistry. In this work, we develop new strategies for block-encoding the second-quantized n-mode representation of the vibrational Hamiltonian, whose algebraic structure closely parallels that of the second-quantized electronic Hamiltonian. We derive linear-combination-of-unitaries (LCU) representations of this Hamiltonian based on Pauli decomposition and tensor hypercontraction (THC) and construct efficient circuits for the corresponding block encodings. We also extend the Block-Invariant Symmetry Shift (BLISS) technique to vibrational Hamiltonians, yielding a lower LCU 1-norm and, consequently, a lower overall circuit cost. For the molecules considered here, BLISS-THC reduces the Toffoli cost of quantum phase estimation by more than two orders of magnitude relative to existing block-encoding approaches. In comparison with recent Trotter-based methods, it shows up to a ninefold reduction in the T-gate count, with the relative savings tending to increase with system size. Asymptotically, and up to polylogarithmic factors, both the Pauli and THC LCUs trade additional ancillas for a quadratic improvement in scaling with the number of modes, while THC provides an additional quadratic improvement in scaling with the number of modals. These results highlight the importance of Hamiltonian factorizations and Toffoli-qubit tradeoffs for reducing the computational cost of quantum simulations of molecular vibrations.
articles.abstract_zh: 分子振动模拟正成为量子化学中量子计算的一个有前景的应用。本工作开发了块编码振动哈密顿量二次量子化n模表示的新策略，其代数结构与电子哈密顿量相似。研究基于泡利分解和张量超收缩（THC）导出了哈密顿量的LCU表示，并构建了相应的有效电路。通过将BLISS技术扩展到振动哈密顿量，显著降低了量子相位估计的Toffoli成本和T门计数。
authors: Shashank G. Mehendale, Ignacio Loaiza, Shreyas Malpathak, Stepan Fomichev, Danial Motlagh, Artur F. Izmaylov

articles.title: Hidden Fisher Information in Many-Body Quantum Sensors
articles.title_zh: 多体量子传感器中的隐藏费雪信息
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33893v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum Fisher information (QFI) determines the ultimate precision of a quantum sensor after optimization over all allowed measurements, but it does not quantify how difficult the optimal readout is to implement. We introduce a moment Fisher hierarchy F_M⁽k⁾, which measures the fraction of QFI accessible to collective spin moments up to degree k, together with a readout-complexity scale k₉₀ defined by the minimum degree required to recover 90% of the QFI. Applying this framework to a nonlinear collective-spin sensor, we show that many-body dynamics can preserve large QFI while transferring the optimal readout into high-rank SU(2) tensor sectors inaccessible to low-order collective observables. For system sizes up to N=100, first moments access only sim 10⁻² of the available QFI, while the degree required to recover 90% of it grows to k₉₀simeq 28. A rank-resolved analysis of the symmetric logarithmic derivative (SLD) under weak damping shows that the nonlinear protocol pushes the optimal readout toward the highest available tensor ranks while strongly depleting its low-rank weight. These results identify nonlinear tangent-space shear as the mechanism behind a finite-size readout-complexity bottleneck in many-body quantum metrology.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子费雪信息（QFI）决定了量子传感器的极限精度，但未量化最优读出的实现难度。本文引入了矩费雪层级和读出复杂度标度，以衡量集体自旋矩可访问的QFI比例及恢复90%QFI所需的最小阶数。研究发现，在非线性集体自旋传感器中，多体动力学能保持高QFI，同时将最优读出转移到低阶集体可观测量无法访问的高阶SU(2)张量扇区。这些结果揭示了非线性协议如何将最优读出推向最高可用张量秩，并为理解量子传感器的性能限制提供了新视角。
authors: Atta ur Rahman, Muhammad Noman, Samira Elghaayda, Saeed Haddadi

articles.title: Minimal ancilla for boosting type-I photonic fusion
articles.title_zh: 提升I型光子融合的最小辅助比特
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34257v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fusion gates enable the creation of large entangled photonic states for linear-optical quantum computing and communication protocols. However, their success probability is limited to 1/2 without additional photonic resources. Previous schemes for boosting type-I fusion have used four ancillary single photons or a two-qubit Bell state, whose preparation is probabilistic and resource intensive. Here we propose a boosted type-I fusion gate using only two independent ancillary single photons and no entangled ancillary input. It achieves a direct success probability of 5/8, matching that of the previous four-single-photon proposal while using half as many ancillary photons. The circuit is predominantly passive, with a single active element that applies a phase shift or swaps two modes according to intermediate photodetection outcomes. Unlike the previous schemes, successful outputs occupy fixed modes and require no further conditional output routing. In particular, we show that the gate is more robust to heralded ancillary-photon loss than previously proposed boosted gates and reduces the average number of single photons required to generate a six-qubit ring graph state by more than 4.6% compared with other type-I schemes. It therefore offers a resource-efficient primitive for scalable fusion-based photonic quantum information processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 融合门在光量子计算和通信中用于创建大型纠缠光子态，但其成功率通常受限于1/2。本文提出了一种仅使用两个独立辅助单光子且无需纠缠辅助输入的I型融合门，实现了5/8的直接成功率，与先前使用四个辅助光子的方案相当，但辅助光子数量减半。该电路主要为无源设计，且成功输出占据固定模式，无需额外的条件输出路由。此外，该门对预示辅助光子损耗的鲁棒性更强，并能减少生成纠缠态所需的平均单光子数量。
authors: A. A. Melkozerov, S. S. Straupe, M. Yu. Saygin

articles.title: Observation of measurement-induced localization phenomena in a solid-state spin system
articles.title_zh: 固态自旋系统中测量诱导局域化现象的观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34262v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum measurement can profoundly impact the dynamics of many-body systems, for instance, inducing phase transitions from volume-law chaotic phases to area-law localized phases. While chaotic phases emerge naturally in generic many-body systems, the experimental realization of a fully localized phase driven by measurement remains challenging, primarily owing to the stringent requirement of near-perfect isolation of the system from environmental dissipation. Here we experimentally observe measurement-induced localization phenomena in an interacting ¹³C nuclear spin system in diamond. In contrast to previous circuit-model-based experiments, our well-isolated system evolves under a physical many-body Hamiltonian with measurements intervening at intervals. By implementing either projective measurements on a single spin or global weak measurements on the entire system, we observe substantially prolonged spin autocorrelation times as the measurement frequency increases. Our results, combined with numerical simulations, provide evidence that quantum measurement can drive a many-body system into a localized regime, and lay the groundwork for future experimental investigations into measurement-induced many-body dynamics and related entanglement phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子测量能深刻影响多体系统动力学，例如诱导从体定律混沌相到面积定律局域相的相变。本文在金刚石中的相互作用¹³C核自旋系统中，实验观测到了测量诱导的局域化现象。通过对单个自旋进行投影测量或对整个系统进行全局弱测量，研究者发现随着测量频率的增加，自旋自相关时间显著延长。这些结果结合数值模拟，提供了量子测量能将多体系统驱动至局域化区域的证据，为未来研究奠定了基础。
authors: Haolin Zhang, Shaoyi Xu, Zihang Zheng, Mengqi Wang, Mingzhe Liu, Zhiyuan Zhao, Ya Wang, Tianyu Xie, Fazhan Shi

articles.title: Exact Identification of Quantum Correlations in the Minimal Bell Scenario
articles.title_zh: 最小贝尔场景中量子关联的精确识别
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34364v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bell nonlocality places the long-standing philosophical disputes over the nature of quantum theory on a mathematically rigorous, experimentally testable footing, positioning quantum mechanics between local realism and the most general no-signaling theories. Yet the precise quantum boundary has remained elusive even in the minimal Bell scenario, where the extreme points generating the set are known. Here we characterize this boundary through a computable necessary and sufficient criterion: a correlation is quantum if and only if it can be decomposed into an extreme quantum correlation and a classical correlation. The criterion follows from our proof that every Bell functional exhibiting quantum advantage admits a unique quantum maximizer. We further classify the finitely many maximal-face structures containing each nonlocal exposed point according to their local deterministic vertices. By sharply distinguishing physically realizable correlations from nonphysical ones, these results resolve a long-standing open problem and provide a new foundation for identifying the principles underlying quantum theory and determining the ultimate information-theoretic limits of quantum correlations.
articles.abstract_zh: 贝尔非局域性将量子理论的本质争议置于严格的数学和实验基础之上，但即使在最小贝尔场景中，精确的量子边界仍难以捉摸。本文通过一个可计算的充要判据来刻画这一边界：一个关联是量子的，当且仅当它可以分解为一个极端量子关联和一个经典关联。该判据源于证明每个展现量子优势的贝尔泛函都存在唯一的量子最大化器。这些结果解决了长期存在的开放问题，并为识别量子理论基本原理和确定信息极限提供了新基础。
authors: Liang-Liang Sun, Jie Wang, Sixia Yu

articles.title: QQLink: A Declarative Framework for Multi-QPU Quantum Workflow Orchestration
articles.title_zh: QQLink：一个用于多QPU量子工作流编排的声明式框架
