articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34486v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Distributed quantum protocols require measurement outcomes produced at one node to control operations at another. We present QQLink, a programming and orchestration layer that expresses these dependencies in a single program, using workflow nodes, deferred measurement references, and declared entanglement, and derives the cross-node coordination automatically. Its planner constructs a provably acyclic dependency graph in time linear in the total size of the instructions' qubit footprints. The same programs execute through simulator backends or are lowered to dynamic circuits on partitioned quantum hardware. We evaluate seven protocol workflows. Exhaustive feedforward-branch tests on the simulator runtime path, over tomographically complete input sets, yield output-state infidelities of at most 5×10⁻¹² and no incorrect classical outputs, and replaying every plan in random topological orders leaves each final state unchanged. Separate executor processes run the plans with delayed messages, with the joint quantum state held by a centralized simulation service. Every run with the full plan is correct, and removing required cross-node dependencies causes protocol failures. The lowered circuits match hand-written implementations of the same construction in two-qubit gate and conditional-block counts. Runs on two IBM Heron processors, each partitioned into virtual QPUs, demonstrate same-chip execution in two sessions a week apart. The runs also show large variation between sessions and losses beyond what calibration-derived noise models predict. Coherence-sensitive checks do not establish coherent Toffoli operation or preservation of the intended repetition-code superposition. These results support QQLink's workflow semantics on the tested execution paths and identify limits of the current hardware realization; execution across physically networked QPUs remains future work.
articles.abstract_zh: 分布式量子协议要求一个节点产生的测量结果控制另一个节点的操作。本文提出了QQLink，一个编程和编排层，它通过工作流节点、延迟测量引用和声明的纠缠，在一个程序中表达这些依赖关系，并自动推导跨节点协调。其规划器能以线性时间构建一个可证明的无环依赖图。该框架在模拟器后端上执行程序，或将其转换为分区量子硬件上的动态电路。实验评估显示，QQLink在输出状态保真度和经典输出正确性方面表现出色，为可扩展量子计算提供了新的解决方案。
authors: Vicente Leyton Ortega, Narasinga Rao Miniskar, Thomas Naughton, Travis S. Humble

articles.title: Neutrinos as Quantum Information Carriers? A Gap Analysis Against the DiVincenzo Criteria
articles.title_zh: 中微子作为量子信息载体？基于DiVincenzo判据的差距分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34666v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photons, trapped ions, neutral atoms, and superconducting circuits are all well-known quantum information platforms. Neutrinos offer a unique possibility, displaying quantum interference (flavour oscillation) over thousands of kilometres, yet interacting so weakly that they can travel through the Earth with minimal interaction. This short paper is a gap analysis. We use information from the existing literature to compare neutrinos to the seven DiVincenzo requirements. Firstly, there are five requirements to do with computation and secondly two requirements to do with communication. We analyse where the gaps are for each requirement. Overall, we find that neutrinos have high fidelity and good coherence; however, they do not have a clear qubit definition and initialisation. They do not have universal gates, individual qubit readout, or stationary-to-flying conversion, meaning they either fail or are very poor. Therefore, we think they are best considered as an exceptional flying information carrier; however, they are very difficult to control. We have outlined all of the gaps which can be used to inform future work.
articles.abstract_zh: 中微子因其独特的量子干涉（味振荡）和极弱的相互作用，被视为潜在的量子信息载体。本文对中微子作为量子信息平台进行了差距分析，将其与DiVincenzo的七项判据进行比较。研究发现，中微子具有高保真度和良好的相干性，但在明确的量子比特定义、初始化、普适门、单个量子比特读出以及固定-飞行转换方面存在显著不足。因此，中微子被认为是一种出色的飞行信息载体，但难以控制，本分析为未来研究指明了方向。
authors: Ramanuj Awasthi

articles.title: Heisenberg-Scaling Quantum Metrology of Electron-Photon Coupling via Multi-Electron PINEM
articles.title_zh: 通过多电子PINEM实现电子-光子耦合的海森堡标度量子计量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34919v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Free-electron quantum optics has recently emerged as a promising platform for coherent electron-light interactions, yet its potential for quantum-enhanced metrology remains largely unexplored. Here, we investigate the fundamental precision limit of coupling-strength estimation in multi-electron photon-induced near-field electron microscopy (PINEM), demonstrating that the quantum Fisher information scales quadratically with electron number. We then propose an experimentally accessible scheme combining squeezed-light probing and optical homodyne detection that attains Heisenberg scaling with respect to electron number, provided the electrons exhibit nonzero inter-electron coherence, while surpassing conventional PINEM sensing in photon-number enhancement as well. We further analyze the effect of imperfect electron preparation, showing that electron phase noise is converted into a fluctuating optical displacement and eventually limits the precision. To overcome this limitation, an auxiliary optical mode coupled to the same electron ensemble measures the displacement noise in the signal mode, allowing its conditional suppression and recovery of the Heisenberg scaling. Our work establishes multi-electron coherence as a resource for free-electron quantum metrology and opens the route to precision measurements of nanoscale electron-light interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 自由电子量子光学为相干电子-光相互作用提供了新平台，但其在量子增强计量学中的潜力尚未充分探索。本文研究了多电子光子诱导近场电子显微镜（PINEM）中耦合强度估计的根本精度极限，证明量子费雪信息与电子数量呈二次方关系。研究提出了一种结合压缩光探测和光学外差检测的实验方案，可在电子间存在非零相干性时实现海森堡标度，并超越传统PINEM传感在光子数增强方面的表现。该工作还分析了不完美电子制备的影响，并提出了通过辅助光学模式抑制位移噪声的方法。
authors: Zihang Zou, Feng-Xiao Sun, Yunquan Liu, Qiongyi He

articles.title: Basis-set error bounds for first-quantised quantum simulation of chemistry
articles.title_zh: 化学第一量子化量子模拟的基组误差界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35205v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In quantum simulation of electronic structure it is often expected that the estimate of the ground energy converges to the continuum basis limit at a rate of mathcal O(N⁻¹) for a basis of size N. This has been found in analytical and numerical studies, but without a rigorous treatment of the error in the quantities considered in quantum algorithms. Here we show the mathcal O(N⁻¹) scaling of the error for a wide range of cases needed for quantum simulation of chemistry. We show the error in the ground energy scales as mathcal O(N⁻¹) for plane-wave as well as spatial grid bases. For the spatial grid we consider both a periodic system and a non-periodic system with open boundaries. For time evolution, our bound on the error in the state itself is weaker than mathcal O(N⁻¹), but we show that the error in observables scales as widetildemathcal O(N⁻¹) in important cases. In particular, we may consider a smoothed observable that describes the position of particles. We show that this error scales as mathcal O(N⁻⁵/³+tN⁻¹) for time t, again both for plane-wave and spatial grid bases. For the non-periodic grid case we use a condition that the true evolution would not result in significant leakage past the boundaries, which introduces basis error unrelated to the resolution of the discretisation. We also show the error in the kinetic energy of a particle scales as mathcal O((t+łog N)/N) for the plane-wave and grid bases. Together, these results show that mathcal O(N⁻¹) scaling of the error holds for many of the relevant cases for quantum algorithms (with a trivial log factor for kinetic energy).
articles.abstract_zh: 在电子结构量子模拟中，基态能量估计通常以O(N⁻¹)的速率收敛到连续基极限。本文严格证明了在化学量子模拟所需的广泛情况下，误差的O(N⁻¹)标度。研究表明，基态能量误差对于平面波和空间网格基组都呈O(N⁻¹)标度。对于时间演化，虽然状态本身的误差界限较弱，但在重要情况下，可观测量误差仍呈O(N⁻¹)标度。这些结果为量子化学模拟的精度分析提供了坚实理论基础。
authors: Dominic W. Berry, Arkin Tikku, Sophia Simon, Ryan Babbush

articles.title: A Control Line Multiplexing Framework for Scalable Quantum Computing
articles.title_zh: 一种用于可扩展量子计算的控制线复用框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35227v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Universal fault-tolerant superconducting quantum computers are expected to require millions of physical qubits; yet extending the prevailing dedicated-control-line paradigm to this scale would exceed the wiring density and cooling-power budget of dilution refrigerators. Microwave frequency-division multiplexing (FDM) revolutionized classical communications by enabling many independent channels to share common transmission infrastructure. Translating this principle to superconducting quantum control, however, requires an all-microwave architecture and experimental validation of frequency-multiplexed gate control. Recent work in quantum error correction has demonstrated microwave-based readout, single-qubit gates and leakage suppression, whereas two-qubit gates remain predominantly driven by unipolar pulses and thus constitute the missing element of an all-microwave architecture. Here, we propose a periodically extensible hybrid multiplexing framework in which all gate operations are frequency-division multiplexed using polychromatic microwave pulses and band-pass filters, thereby reducing the required control-line count by one to two orders of magnitude. In a 1:4 demonstration, we achieve average errors of (6.4±0.2)×10⁻³ for parallel FDM CZ gates and (10.6±0.2)×10⁻⁴ for parallel FDM XY(π/2) gates, without statistically significant multiplexing-induced degradation. Together with on-chip DC sources, this FDM-based gate-control scheme completes the last missing module in a scalable multiplexed-control architecture toward universal fault-tolerant quantum computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 构建百万级物理量子比特的容错超导量子计算机面临布线密度和制冷功率的挑战。本文提出了一种周期性可扩展的混合复用框架，通过多色微波脉冲和带通滤波器实现所有门操作的频率复用。该框架将控制线数量减少了一到两个数量级，解决了传统专用控制线范式在扩展性上的瓶颈。这一全微波架构的提出，为实现大规模超导量子计算提供了关键技术路径。
authors: Dayu Li, Naibin Zhou, Zhiyuan Chen, Zihua Chen, Yu Xu, Yuan Li, Daojin Fan, Wenhao Chu, Xiawei Chen, Hui Deng, Jiacheng Gui, Linyin Hong, Bo Fan, Weiping Lin, Haonan Zou, Haoxin Lou, Xintao Zhao, Sirui Cao, Ying Chong, Qingling Zhu, Chen Wang, Yisen Hu, Kaili Zhang, Feifan Su, Haibin Zhang, Jianghan Yin, Yajie Du, Yinan Jiang, Haoping Luo, Weifeng Yang, Jiafei Wang, Jin Lin, Futian Liang, Hao Rong, Kai Yan, Ming Gong, Jinjin Li, Maliang Liu, Cheng-Zhi Peng, Shaowei Li, Xiaobo Zhu, Jian-Wei Pan

articles.title: Multistability and Critical Frustrated Superradiance in Open Anisotropic Quantum Rabi Trimer
articles.title_zh: 开放各向异性量子Rabi三聚体中的多稳态与临界受挫超辐射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35445v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the nonequilibrium steady states of an open anisotropic quantum Rabi trimer. Combining semiclassical and quantum mechanical treatments, we map out the system's phase diagram and elucidate the critical phenomena induced by anisotropic light-matter coupling, cavity dissipation, and complex photon hopping, which give rise to abundant multistable phases. Counterintuitively, the frustrated superradiant phase (FSP) can be stabilized by both positive and negative photon hopping, a feature absent in closed Rabi and Dicke trimers. We further uncover two independent dissipation thresholds for the normal superradiant phase and the FSP. Unlike isotropic open quantum Rabi trimers, both phases are suppressed once the dissipation exceeds their respective critical values. The rotating and counter-rotating interaction terms exhibit mutually reciprocal effects on the quantum phase transitions. By analyzing universal scaling behaviors with quantum fluctuations incorporated, we reveal an unprecedented finite-fluctuation critical exponent for the FSP. Moreover, the critical exponents of individual phases are coupling-strength dependent. The multistability and FSP can be tuned by anisotropy and dissipation. Our results broaden the scope of nonequilibrium quantum phase physics in few-body systems and hold promising applications for quantum state engineering and cavity/circuit quantum electrodynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了开放各向异性量子Rabi三聚体的非平衡稳态。通过半经典和量子力学方法，揭示了各向异性光-物质耦合、腔耗散和复杂光子跳跃引起的临界现象，导致了丰富的多稳态相。研究发现，受挫超辐射相（FSP）可由正负光子跳跃稳定，且存在两个独立的耗散阈值。此外，该工作还揭示了FSP前所未有的有限涨落临界指数，并指出各相的临界指数与耦合强度相关。
authors: Ya-Ping Ni, Yi-Ge Wu, Jie-Qiao Liao, Jin-Feng Huang

articles.title: Equilibrium propagation in non-equilibrium quantum systems
articles.title_zh: 非平衡量子系统中的平衡传播
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35585v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Equilibrium propagation (EP) is a powerful training algorithm for self-learning physical systems that is widely used for a variety of machine learning inspired tasks. It relies on the existence of an energy function that depends on tunable training parameters, and can be extended to apply to many-body quantum systems in equilibrium. A key challenge however is the need to repeatedly relax to the system ground state after each parameter update. We show here a route for circumventing this problem by extending EP to many-body driven-dissipative quantum systems, where the dynamics naturally relaxes to a parameter-dependent non-equilibrium steady state. Despite the lack of a free energy, we find that for a class of open systems, a quantum detailed balance symmetry still allows for an efficient EP strategy. This relies crucially on a new class of non-equilibrium static susceptibility relations that we derive in detail. We analyze examples of our new non-equilibrium training paradigm for two experimentally-relevant models: a driven-dissipative transverse field Ising model, and a parametrically-driven bosonic lattice.
articles.abstract_zh: 平衡传播（EP）是一种广泛应用于自学习物理系统的训练算法。本文提出将EP扩展到多体驱动耗散量子系统，以解决传统EP在每次参数更新后需重复弛豫到基态的挑战。研究发现，对于一类开放系统，即使缺乏自由能，量子细致平衡对称性仍能实现高效的EP策略，这依赖于新导出的非平衡静态磁化率关系。该非平衡训练范式在驱动耗散横场伊辛模型和参数驱动玻色子格点模型中得到了验证。
authors: Aditya Gandotra, David D. Noachtar, Aashish A. Clerk

articles.title: Quantum-enhanced metrology with classical shadows
articles.title_zh: 基于经典影子的量子增强计量学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35632v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum metrology relies on observables that maximize information about the parameter of interest, but are often hard to access. We develop a protocol that combines Pauli moments estimated from a fixed ensemble of randomized local measurements into an optimized method-of-moments estimator. For local Pauli classical shadows, we derive the shadow information which determines estimator variance and sample-complexity guarantees. Identifying the separable-state sensitivity limit, we show that entanglement can lead to a constant-factor sensitivity enhancement, as illustrated with one-axis-twisted probes. This protocol allows for efficient circuit-based metrology without choosing an observable.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子计量学通常依赖于难以获取的观测值来最大化参数信息。本文提出了一种协议，将从固定随机局部测量集合中估计的泡利矩组合成优化的矩量估计器。对于局部泡利经典影子，研究推导了决定估计器方差和样本复杂度保证的影子信息。通过识别可分离态灵敏度极限，该工作展示了纠缠可以带来常数因子灵敏度增强，并允许高效的基于电路的计量而无需选择特定观测值。
authors: Luca Ion, Manuel Gessner

articles.title: Decoding with alternating weighted graph sparsification for quantum low-density parity-check codes
articles.title_zh: 基于交替加权图稀疏化的量子低密度奇偶校验码解码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35735v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Real-time decoding is a fundamental necessity for building fault-tolerant quantum computers. In this work, we introduce decoding with alternating weighted graph sparsification (DAWG), an ensemble based approach that combines Tanner graph sparsification with ensembling belief-propagation (BP) decoders. The DAWG decoder runs BP decoders over the full detector error model Tanner graph for certain iterations to then transfer the posteriors to a sparsified graph in which additional rounds of BP are run. Each of the decoders in the ensemble uses a different transfer matrix to map the posterior information to the sparsified graph. We use the serial schedule for the minimum-sum BP decoders and, thus, employ Vibe decoding ideas by randomizing the schedules of each of them. The performance of the DAWG decoder is then numerically studied for bivariate bicycle codes and superdense color code circuits to be compared with other state-of-the-art decoding approaches. Importantly, the DAWG decoder shows a similar performance to Relay belief-propagation and Vibe decoding when combined with an order-0 Localized Statistics Decoding (LSD-0) post-processor. Crucially, the post-processor is called an order of magnitude less times than for Vibe with the same ensemble size, indicating that the introduced latency tail will be minimal. Furthermore, LSD-0 operates on a sparsified decoding graph of a fraction of the size of the full detector error model, which simplifies the resources required by specialized hardware to support it. Overall, the DAWG+LSD-0 decoder represents a viable low-cost BP-based decoding algorithm for quantum error correction codes.
articles.abstract_zh: 实时解码是构建容错量子计算机的关键。本文提出了一种名为DAWG（Decoding with Alternating Weighted Graph Sparsification）的集成解码方法，它结合了Tanner图稀疏化和集成置信传播（BP）解码器。DAWG解码器在完整Tanner图上运行BP解码器，然后将后验信息转移到稀疏化图上进行额外BP轮次。数值研究表明，DAWG解码器在双变量自行车码和超密集颜色码电路上的性能与现有先进解码方法相当，尤其在结合LSD-0后处理器时表现出色。
authors: Josu Etxezarreta Martinez, Francisco Garcia-Herrero, Ruben M. Otxoa, Reza Dastbasteh

articles.title: On the Energy Minimizing Problem in Plasma Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 等离子体动力学中的能量最小化问题
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33040v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A fundamental question in plasma physics and its applications to fusion theory is to find minimum energy stares of plasma.. Hong Qin has suggested the use of what he calls "Gromov ground states" which take into account the phenomenon of symplectic rigidity, as opposed to Gardner's classical approach which only use volume-preserving diffeomorphisms. Howev4er Qin's approach leads to topological difficulties because his constructions remain in the classical (Hamiltonian) domain. We circumvent these difficulties by introducing a quantum-mechanical formulation of the problem, based on the Wigner transform and the symplectic geometry of Gaussian state
articles.abstract_zh: 等离子体物理学中的一个基本问题是寻找等离子体的最小能量态。针对秦洪提出的“Gromov基态”方法在经典领域遇到的拓扑困难，本文引入了一种基于Wigner变换和高斯态辛几何的量子力学表述。该方法旨在规避现有经典方法中的拓扑难题，为等离子体能量最小化问题提供新的解决途径。
authors: Maurice de Gosson

articles.title: Boundary-condition independence of infinite-chain ground states in the S=1 J-D antiferromagnetic chain
articles.title_zh: S=1 J-D反铁磁链中无限链基态的边界条件无关性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34330v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Extending the analytic machinery and using the numerical inputs from OpenAI's proofs of the Haldane gap, we study infinite-chain ground states of the S=1 J-D antiferromagnetic model H=sumⱼ{boldsymbol Sⱼḑotboldsymbol Sⱼ₊₁+D(Sⱼmathrm z)²} for sufficiently small |D|. We consider two finite-volume settings: periodic chains with an even number of sites, and open chains with an odd number of sites and the same positive magnetic field in the mathrm z direction at both endpoints. We prove that the ground states in each setting have an infinite-chain limit along the full sequence, without passing to a subsequence, and that the two limiting states coincide. Convergence is uniform in D on a fixed neighborhood of zero. The common limit is a symmetric locally-unique gapped ground state, and its local expectation values depend continuously on D. These conclusions concern the two specified constructions, not uniqueness among all infinite-chain ground states. They provide the input for the study of a topological phase transition in a forthcoming revision of our companion paper. The author formulated the problem and proposed the basic strategy. ChatGPT Astra made substantial contributions to the inductive estimates and to completing the proof.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用Haldane能隙的证明方法，研究了S=1 J-D反铁磁模型在足够小|D|下的无限链基态。研究证明，在周期链和开放链两种有限体积设置下，基态都存在无限链极限，且这两个极限态是重合的。该共同极限是一个对称的局部唯一有能隙基态，其局部期望值连续依赖于D。这些结论为后续研究拓扑相变提供了基础。
authors: Hal Tasaki

articles.title: A semi-classical analysis of the coupling strength γ between motional quantum states of spatially distant trapped ions interacting via a conducting wire
articles.title_zh: 通过导线相互作用的空间分离囚禁离子运动量子态耦合强度γ的半经典分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2111.14957v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Interfacing ion qubits in separate traps is among the challenges towards scaling up trapped ion quantum computing. This theoretical study focuses on using a conducting wire to couple the motional quantum states of ions in separate planar traps. The approach of interfacing ion traps provides an alternative to coupling distant qubits with lasers or via ion shuttling. We develop a detailed model for the coupling strength γ, which in turn allows us to calculate the time required to exchange motional quantum states between two ions, tₑₓ.. To maximize the coupling strength γ, a rule of thumb is developed to relate the distance dₑq. between a trapped ion and a nearby pickup disk, to the optimal radius rₒₚₜ. of the disk, dₑq. / sqrt2 łe rₒₚₜ. łe dₑq.. We include a coefficient ζ which describes three self-capacitances connected in series, relating the capacitances of each part of the coupling system, which corrects an oversight common to several previous works. Our analytical model for the coupling strength is then compared with other existing analytical models in the literature. This requires a standardization of the coupling systems and mapping them to a common set of parameter values. Similarities, differences and limitations of the various models are discussed. This study's focus on the coupling strength γ and tₑₓ. provides a foundational pillar for exchanging quantum information between trapped ions via a wire. In addition, many insights are general and apply broadly to hybrid systems interfacing trapped ions with nearby conductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论研究了利用导线耦合分离平面阱中离子的运动量子态，以解决囚禁离子量子计算扩展中的挑战。研究建立了耦合强度γ的详细模型，并推导了交换运动量子态所需的时间。为最大化耦合强度，提出了陷阱离子与拾取盘之间距离与盘最佳半径的关系。该模型还引入了一个修正系数ζ，纠正了先前工作中常见的疏漏，并与其他现有分析模型进行了比较。
authors: N. Van Horne, M. Mukherjee

articles.title: A general quantum circuit framework for Extended Wigner's Friend Scenarios: logically and causally consistent reasoning without absolute measurement events
articles.title_zh: 扩展维格纳之友情景的通用量子电路框架：无需绝对测量事件的逻辑和因果一致推理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2209.09281v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Extended Wigner's Friend Scenarios (EWFSs) model agents themselves as unitarily evolving quantum systems, going beyond the standard use of quantum theory where agents are treated classically. Several no-go results suggest deep challenges in this setting: Frauchiger and Renner (FR) argued that quantum agents reasoning using quantum theory would arrive at logical paradoxes, while the Local-Friendliness theorem raises difficulties for maintaining objective notions of measurement events and causal reasoning in EWFSs. This prompts a key question: can the ability to make and test scientific predictions and reason consistently still be maintained if quantum theory applies universally, even to agents and their memories? We answer this positively by developing a general quantum circuit framework for EWFSs without assuming absolute measurement outcomes. We formalize Heisenberg cuts in terms of distinct choices of channels in the circuit, labelled by "settings", and show that FR-type paradoxes are fully resolved by making explicit the conditioning on these channels/settings. We provide concrete reasoning rules for quantum agents that ensure logical, probabilistic and causal consistency. Our framework captures all perspectives in an EWFS within a single causal structure while allowing events to be fundamentally subjective, and we show how objective events and predictions nevertheless emerge in current real-world quantum experiments. Thus, we demonstrate a relational yet operational framework that overcomes key challenges in EWFSs without altering the Born rule, unitarity, or classical logic and probability for outcomes. This establishes a formal platform to analyze and compare different EWFS arguments and extend quantum information methods consistently into the Wigner's Friend domain.
articles.abstract_zh: 扩展维格纳之友情景（EWFSs）将智能体建模为酉演化的量子系统，挑战了量子理论中关于测量事件和因果推理的客观性。本文通过开发一个无需假设绝对测量结果的通用量子电路框架，积极回应了在量子理论普适性下能否保持科学预测和一致推理的问题。该框架将海森堡切口形式化为电路中通道的不同选择，并表明通过明确这些通道/设置的条件，可以完全解决FR型悖论，从而为量子智能体提供了一致的推理规则。
authors: V. Vilasini, Mischa P. Woods

articles.title: Compressing multivariate functions with tree tensor networks
articles.title_zh: 利用树张量网络压缩多元函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2410.03572v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Tensor networks are a compressed format for multi-dimensional data. One dimensional tensor networks -- often referred to as tensor trains (TT) or matrix product states (MPS) -- are increasingly being used as a numerical ansatz for continuum functions by ``quantizing'' the inputs into discrete binary digits. Here we demonstrate the power of more general tree tensor networks (TTNs) for this purpose. We provide direct constructions of a number of elementary functions as generic tree tensor networks and interpolative constructions for more complicated functions via a generalization of the tensor cross interpolation algorithm. For a range of multi-dimensional functions we show how more structured tree tensor networks offer a significantly more efficient ansatz than the commonly used tensor train. Finally, we demonstrate how the methods introduced in this work can be used to realize a TTN-based solver for multi-dimensional, non-linear Fredholm equations.
articles.abstract_zh: 张量网络是多维数据的压缩格式。本文展示了更通用的树张量网络（TTNs）在压缩连续函数方面的强大能力。研究提供了多种基本函数的直接构造方法，以及通过张量交叉插值算法推广的复杂函数插值构造。对于一系列多维函数，结构化的树张量网络比常用的张量列车提供了更高效的拟设。此外，该工作还展示了TTN如何用于求解多维非线性Fredholm方程。
authors: Joseph Tindall, E. Miles Stoudenmire, Ryan Levy

articles.title: Fully Parallelized BP Decoding for Quantum LDPC Codes Can Outperform BP-OSD
articles.title_zh: 量子LDPC码的全并行BP解码器可超越BP-OSD
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.00254v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This work presents a hardware-efficient and fully parallelizable decoder for quantum LDPC codes that leverages belief propagation (BP) with a speculative post-processing strategy inspired by classical Chase decoding algorithm. By monitoring bit-level oscillation patterns during BP, our method identifies unreliable bits and generates multiple candidate vectors to selectively flip syndromes. Each modified syndrome is then decoded independently using short-depth BP, a process we refer to as BP-SF (syndrome flip). This design eliminates the need for costly Gaussian elimination used in the current BP-OSD approaches. Our implementation achieves logical error rates comparable to or better than BP-OSD while offering significantly lower latency due to its high degree of parallelism for a variety of bivariate bicycle codes. Evaluation on the [[144,12,12]] bivariate bicycle code shows that the proposed decoder reduces average latency to approximately 70% of BP-OSD. When post-processing is parallelized the average latency is reduced to 55% compared to the single process implementation, with the maximum latency reaching as low as 18%. These advantages make it particularly well-suited for real-time and resource-constrained quantum error correction systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种硬件高效且完全并行的量子LDPC码解码器，该解码器结合了置信传播（BP）和受经典Chase解码算法启发的推测性后处理策略。通过监测BP过程中的比特级振荡模式，该方法识别不可靠比特并生成多个候选向量以选择性翻转综合征。每个修改后的综合征随后使用短深度BP独立解码，即BP-SF。该设计消除了BP-OSD中昂贵的Gausian消元需求，实现了与BP-OSD相当或更优的逻辑错误率，同时显著降低了延迟。
authors: Ming Wang, Ang Li, Frank Mueller

articles.title: One-sided Witnesses for the Quantumness of Gravitational Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 引力动力学量子性的单边判据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.15588v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum information concepts and quantum technologies have opened the prospect of probing the quantum nature of gravity in table-top experiments. Most proposals rely on detecting gravitationally mediated entanglement, which requires measurements on both interacting systems. Here we propose an alternative test based on witnessing quantum memory effects in the dynamics of a single system. We show how the quantum memory concept allows the non-classicality of the interaction between two systems to be certified through local measurements on only one of them. We then develop a novel quantum memory witness, making the approach applicable to gravitationally coupled harmonic oscillators. This witness requires no assumptions about the dynamics, such as Gaussianity. Our results show that the quantumness of gravitational dynamics can be certified with access to only one subsystem, opening the door to asymmetric implementations that can offer conceptual and experimental advantages to probing the quantum nature of the gravitational interaction.
articles.abstract_zh: 探测引力量子性质的现有方案多依赖于检测引力介导的纠缠，需要对两个相互作用系统进行测量。本文提出了一种替代测试方法，通过见证单个系统动力学中的量子记忆效应来认证两个系统间相互作用的非经典性。研究开发了一种新颖的量子记忆判据，适用于引力耦合谐振子，且无需对动力学（如高斯性）做任何假设。该结果表明，仅通过访问一个子系统即可认证引力动力学的量子性，为探测引力量子性质提供了不对称实现方案。
authors: Konstantin Beyer, M. S. Kim, Igor Pikovski

articles.title: Anyonic membranes and Pontryagin statistics
articles.title_zh: 任意子膜与Pontryagin统计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.14314v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Anyons, unique to two spatial dimensions, underlie extraordinary phenomena such as the fractional quantum Hall effect, but their generalization to higher dimensions has remained elusive. The topology of Eilenberg-MacLane spaces constrains the loop statistics to be only bosonic or fermionic in any dimension. In this work, we introduce the novel anyonic statistics for membrane excitations in four dimensions. Analogous to the Z_N-particle exhibiting ZN× gcd₍₂,N₎ anyonic statistics in two dimensions, we show that the Z_N-membrane possesses ZN× gcd₍₃,N₎ anyonic statistics in four dimensions. Given unitary volume operators that create membrane excitations on the boundary, we propose an explicit 56-step unitary sequence that detects the membrane statistics. We further analyze the boundary theory of (5+1)D 1-form Z_N symmetry-protected topological phases and demonstrate that their domain walls realize all possible anyonic membrane statistics. We then show that the Z₃ subgroup persists in all higher dimensions. In addition to the standard fermionic Z₂ membrane statistics arising from Stiefel-Whitney classes, membranes also exhibit Z₃ statistics associated with Pontryagin classes. We explicitly verify that the 56-step process detects the nontrivial Z₃ statistics in 5, 6, and 7 spatial dimensions. Moreover, in 7 and higher dimensions, the statistics of membrane excitations stabilize to Z₂ × Z₃, with the Z₃ sector consistently captured by this process.
articles.abstract_zh: 任意子是二维空间特有的，但其向高维的推广一直难以实现。本文引入了四维空间中膜激发的新型任意子统计。研究表明，Z_N膜在四维中具有ZN× gcd₍₃,N₎任意子统计，并提出了一个56步的酉序列来检测膜统计。此外，该工作分析了(5+1)D 1-形式Z_N对称保护拓扑相的边界理论，证明其畴壁实现了所有可能的任意子膜统计，并指出Z₃子群在所有更高维度中持续存在。
authors: Yitao Feng, Hanyu Xue, Yuyang Li, Meng Cheng, Ryohei Kobayashi, Po-Shen Hsin, Yu-An Chen

articles.title: Quantum Sensing using Geometrical Phase in Qubit-Oscillator Systems
articles.title_zh: 利用量子比特-振子系统中的几何相进行量子传感
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.21983v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a quantum sensing protocol for coupled qubit-oscillator systems that surpasses the standard quantum limit (SQL) by exploiting a geometrical phase. The signal is encoded in the geometrical phase that is proportional to the area enclosed in oscillator phase space. This area is amplified through squeezing, enabling sensitivities beyond the SQL. Our method is independent of oscillator's initial state, amenable to sensing with high-temperature or logical error-corrected states. The protocol shows robustness to qubit Markovian noise and preserves its state-independence, underscoring its practicality for next-generation quantum metrology. We demonstrate application to force sensing beyond the SQL in longitudinally coupled systems, and to high-precision measurements of couplings and pulse calibration surpassing SQL in dispersively coupled circuit quantum electrodynamics (cQED) architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种利用几何相的量子传感协议，用于耦合量子比特-振子系统，可超越标准量子极限（SQL）。信号编码在与振子相空间所围面积成比例的几何相中，并通过挤压效应放大该面积，从而实现超越SQL的灵敏度。该方法独立于振子初始态，对量子比特马尔可夫噪声具有鲁棒性，并适用于高温或逻辑纠错态的传感。研究展示了其在纵向耦合系统中实现超越SQL的力传感，以及在色散耦合电路量子电动力学架构中实现超越SQL的耦合和脉冲校准高精度测量。
authors: Nishchay Suri, Zhihui Wang, Tanay Roy, Davide Venturelli, Wibe Albert de Jong

articles.title: On the relevance of Hermitian-preserving trace-preserving linear maps in asymptotic information retrieval in quantum communication
articles.title_zh: 厄米保持迹保持线性映射在量子通信渐近信息检索中的相关性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.07822v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In quantum technologies, quantum channels are essential for transmitting quantum states. Quantum channels usually introduce noise, thereby reducing the information in a state. These are mathematically described by completely positive trace-preserving linear maps that represent the generic evolution of quantum systems and are also special cases of Hermitian-preserving trace-preserving (HPTP) linear maps. Concatenating a quantum channel with another quantum channel makes it noisier and degrades its information and resource preservability. In this work, we demonstrate a physically meaningful way to compare a pair of quantum channels using Hermitian-preserving trace-preserving linear maps. Precisely, given a pair of quantum channels Łambda₁, Łambda₂ and an arbitrary unknown input state, we show that the output state of the quantum channel Łambda₂ from the pair can be uniquely identified from the output statistics of the other channel Łambda₁ from the pair, using some POVM, iff Łambda₂ can be obtained from Łambda₁ by concatenating it with a Hermitian-preserving trace-preserving linear map that is not necessarily positive. In such cases, Łambda₂ may not always be obtained from Łambda₁ through post-processing. The relation between these channels is a preorder, and we study its characterization in this work. In other words, we provide an operational interpretation of this preorder induced by HPTP linear maps in a communication scenario. Furthermore, we characterize the difficulty of implementing Łambda₂ given that Łambda₁ has already been implemented via a quantifier, namely, physical implementability. We also illustrate the implications of our results for the incompatibility of quantum devices through an example. In short, we provide valuable insights about the relevance of Hermitian-preserving trace-preserving linear maps in physically motivated settings.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子信道在量子技术中用于传输量子态，通常引入噪声并降低信息量。本文提出了一种使用厄米保持迹保持（HPTP）线性映射来比较量子信道对的物理意义方法。研究表明，给定一对量子信道Łambda₁和Łambda₂以及任意未知输入态，当且仅当Łambda₂可以通过将Łambda₁与一个不一定是正的HPTP线性映射串联获得时，Łambda₂的输出态才能通过Łambda₁的输出统计数据唯一识别。这为理解量子信道的信息退化和比较提供了新的视角。
authors: Arindam Mitra, Jatin Ghai

articles.title: Certified bounds on optimization problems in quantum theory
articles.title_zh: 量子理论中优化问题的认证界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.17713v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Semidefinite relaxations of polynomial optimization have become a central tool for addressing the non-convex optimization problems over non-commutative operators that are ubiquitous in quantum information theory and, more in general, quantum physics. Yet, as these global relaxation methods are solved numerically, the bounds issued by the semidefinite solver can - and often do - exceed the global optimum, undermining their certifiability. To counter this issue, we introduce a framework for extracting rigorous certified bounds on non-commutative optimization problems from inexact numerical data, and apply it to several paradigmatic problems in quantum information theory. An extension to sparsity and symmetry-adapted semidefinite relaxations is also provided and compared to the general dense scheme. Our results establish rational post-processing as a practical route to reliable certification, pushing semidefinite optimization toward a certifiable standard for quantum information science.
articles.abstract_zh: 半定松弛是解决量子信息理论中非交换算符非凸优化问题的核心工具。然而，数值求解器给出的界限常超出全局最优值，影响其可认证性。本文提出了一个从不精确数值数据中提取非交换优化问题严格认证界限的框架，并将其应用于量子信息理论中的多个典型问题。研究结果表明，有理后处理是实现可靠认证的实用途径，有助于推动半定优化成为量子信息科学的可认证标准。
authors: Younes Naceur, Jie Wang, Victor Magron, Antonio Acín

articles.title: QwaveMPS: An efficient open-source Python package for simulating non-Markovian waveguide-QED using matrix product states
articles.title_zh: QwaveMPS：一个用于使用矩阵乘积态模拟非马尔可夫波导-QED的高效开源Python软件包
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.15826v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: QwaveMPS is an open-source Python library for simulating one-dimensional quantum many-body waveguide systems using matrix product states (MPS). It provides a user-friendly interface for constructing, evolving, and analyzing quantum states and operators, facilitating studies in quantum physics and quantum information with waveguide-QED systems. This approach enables efficient, scalable simulations by focusing computational resources on the most relevant parts of the quantum system. Thus, one can study a wide range of complex dynamical interactions, including time-delayed feedback effects in the non-Markovian regime and deeply nonlinear systems, at a highly reduced computational cost compared to full Hilbert space approaches, making it both practical and convenient to model a variety of open waveguide-QED systems (in Markovian and non-Markovian regimes), treating quantized atoms and quantized photons on an equal footing. The QwaveMPS package automates the waveguide-QED-specific tensor-network operations, including construction of the time-bin evolution operator from physical parameters, the swap network required for delayed interactions, orthogonality-center and truncation management, the matrix-product factorization of N-photon Fock-state inputs, and the evaluation of single-time and two-time field observables (such as the second-order quantum correlation function) at chosen points along the waveguide.
articles.abstract_zh: QwaveMPS是一个开源Python库，利用矩阵乘积态（MPS）模拟一维量子多体波导系统。它提供用户友好的界面，用于构建、演化和分析量子态及算符，从而促进波导-QED系统在量子物理和量子信息领域的研究。该方法通过将计算资源集中在量子系统最相关的部分，实现了高效、可扩展的模拟。这使得研究非马尔可夫机制下的时延反馈效应和深度非线性系统等复杂动力学相互作用成为可能，且计算成本远低于全希尔伯特空间方法。
authors: Sofia Arranz Regidor, Matthew Kozma, Stephen Hughes

articles.title: Control of Multipartite Entanglement through Anisotropy against Thermal Noise
articles.title_zh: 通过各向异性对抗热噪声实现多体纠缠的控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.22815v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Preserving multipartite entanglement in open many-body quantum systems is fundamentally limited by unavoidable environmental noise. We study the open-system dynamics of multipartite entanglement in an anisotropic XXZ spin chain interacting with a thermal spin bath, focusing on two states with distinct types of multipartite entanglement: the generalized GHZ and the generalized W state. Using a master-equation approach combined with the Bethe ansatz technique, we show analytically that robustness of multipartite entanglement at low temperatures can be enhanced by suitably tuning the anisotropy of the system. Our results highlight interaction-induced spectral control as a mechanism for stabilizing multipartite entanglement in quantum computing platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 在开放多体量子系统中，多体纠缠的保持受到环境噪声的根本限制。本文研究了各向异性XXZ自旋链在热自旋浴中的多体纠缠开放系统动力学，重点关注广义GHZ态和广义W态。通过主方程结合Bethe ansatz技术，分析表明在低温下，通过适当调节系统的各向异性可以增强多体纠缠的鲁棒性。研究结果强调了相互作用诱导的谱控制作为稳定量子计算平台中多体纠缠的一种机制。
authors: Samudra Sur, Saikat Sur

articles.title: Quantifying entanglement in quantum thermodynamics via separability constraints
articles.title_zh: 通过可分离性约束量化量子热力学中的纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.17078v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The role of quantum entanglement in thermodynamical systems remains elusive. Does entanglement result in thermodynamic advantages or does it impose fundamental limitations? Here, we unambiguously quantify the amount of heat and work in a quantum system that is due to the presence of entanglement. This is achieved by constraining the system's non-equilibrium dynamics to separable states, thereby isolating the impact entanglement has on thermodynamic effects. Unlike thermodynamic entanglement measures, which signify a loose connection between entanglement and thermodynamic properties, imposing a constraint constitutes an active intervention into a system -- answering how much of a system's thermodynamics is caused by (not correlated with) its quantumness. We benchmark our theory by applying the constrained dynamics to several multipartite systems, including quantum batteries and quantum refrigerators.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子纠缠在热力学系统中的作用尚不明确。本文通过将系统的非平衡动力学限制在可分离态，明确量化了量子系统中因纠缠存在而产生的热量和功。这种约束方法能够隔离纠缠对热力学效应的影响，从而回答系统热力学有多少是由其量子性引起的。该理论已应用于量子电池和量子冰箱等多个多体系统进行基准测试。
authors: Joan Alba, Laura Ares, Jan Sperling, Julien Pinske

articles.title: Homomorphic Quantum Error Correction
articles.title_zh: 同态量子纠错
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.25692v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the algebraic compatibility between quantum homomorphic encryption and stabilizer quantum error correction in an honest-but-curious model, restricting the encryption to the transversal block-Pauli mask (X^aZ^b)øtⁱmes ⁿ controlled by two secret key bits a and b. We prove a necessary and sufficient criterion for an [[n,1,d]] stabilizer code to remain compatible with this mask, namely that the transversal X and Z operators commute with every stabilizer generator, and we specialize it to a classical-code criterion for Calderbank--Shor--Steane codes. Combining code-space preservation with the logical action of the mask, every stabilizer code falls, with respect to each of the two transversal mask operators, into exactly one of three classes: incompatible, compatible but trivially acting, or compatible with a nontrivial logical Pauli action; the two operators need not fall into the same class. We verify this classification by exact symplectic computation for rotated and planar surface codes, toric codes, triangular and toric color codes, the [[15,1,3]] code and several small codes, and find that the class is fixed by the lattice size and the boundary presentation rather than by the topological phase: the surface-code family realizes all three classes, whereas color codes realize only the two compatible ones. For encrypted computation we show that the Shor code does not implement the logical T gate by a transversal Tøtⁱmes ⁹, whereas suitable triorthogonal codes do so up to a Clifford correction. We formulate logical-Pauli masking as a code-independent algebraic template. Syndrome extraction and recovery are key-independent whenever the mask preserves the code space, so that the client only needs the block size and the class of the code to decrypt.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在“诚实但好奇”模型下，研究了量子同态加密与稳定子量子纠错之间的代数兼容性。研究证明了[[n,1,d]]稳定子码与横向块-泡利掩码兼容的充要条件，即横向X和Z算符与每个稳定子生成元对易。结合码空间保持和掩码的逻辑作用，每个稳定子码对于两个横向掩码算符中的每一个，都可分为不兼容、兼容但作用平凡、或兼容且具有非平凡逻辑泡利作用三类。
authors: Kornikar Sen, Miguel A. Martin-Delgado

articles.title: Quantum digital simulations of time-domain semiconductor spectroscopy in the semi-classical approximation
articles.title_zh: 半经典近似下时域半导体光谱的量子数字模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04295v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a digital quantum simulation framework for ultrafast optical spectroscopy of semiconductor materials. The framework is based on Brillouin-zone discretization and is designed as a quantum alternative to classical simulations based on the semiconductor Bloch equations. Its current capabilities include quantum simulations of linear absorption and optical gain, incorporating Lorentzian broadening, finite-temperature band-filling effects, and reduced-dimensionality effects. Comparison with classical simulations of GaAs within the single-particle approximation demonstrates quantitative agreement in the noiseless limit. The inclusion of realistic hardware noise characteristic of NISQ-era quantum computers effectively manifests as an additional source of scattering, resulting in increased spectral broadening. We also show that the linear optical response, including many-body interactions treated within the Hartree-Fock approximation, can be mapped onto a system of coupled classical oscillators. Under certain assumptions about the query complexity of the oscillator couplings, this system exhibits a provable quantum advantage, as demonstrated in [Phys. Rev. X 13, 041041 (2023)]. Beyond the Hartree-Fock approximation, classical simulations based on many-body quantum kinetic equations face the so-called hierarchy problem, whereas the algorithmic complexity of the quantum simulations remains unchanged, offering a promising approach to overcoming this challenge.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个用于半导体材料超快光学光谱的数字量子模拟框架，该框架基于布里渊区离散化，旨在作为半导体布洛赫方程经典模拟的量子替代方案。其当前能力包括线性吸收和光增益的量子模拟，并考虑了洛伦兹展宽、有限温度能带填充效应和降维效应。与GaAs的经典模拟比较显示，在无噪声极限下具有定量一致性。研究还表明，在某些查询复杂度假设下，该系统展现出可证明的量子优势。
authors: Mykhailo Klymenko, Bahar Goldozian, Thong Hoang, Jared H. Cole, Muhammad Usman

articles.title: Inherent interpretability provides inherent value in quantum machine learning
articles.title_zh: 固有可解释性为量子机器学习提供固有价值
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.13827v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The field of quantum machine learning (QML) evolved to value models believed to most directly rival those providing utility in classical ML, namely large-scale neural networks. This pursuit of quantum neural-network analogues has produced important theoretical insights for expressivity and trainability at scale; however, due to our inability to conduct large-scale empirical studies, this direction has contributed to skepticism that QML will provide a compelling application for quantum computers. In the meantime, classical ML has been learning a hard lesson with respect to deploying un-interpretable neural networks in the wild: model interpretability matters for human adoption. We adopt this broader ML perspective to encourage a research direction in QML that prioritizes discovering and understanding tools from quantum information theory that applied ML researchers can use to construct inherently interpretable models: models with intentional mathematical structure that guarantees domain-aligned behavior. We first exemplify this research direction through a thread of work in a neighboring area---Bayesian ML. Specifically, we discuss an efficient mathematical tool that emerged from a connection between Gaussian processes and Bayesian linear models, which has since been widely studied and used by applied researchers for problem-specific model design. We then discuss how prior QML research can be reframed as progress towards this direction, despite having been pursued with different goals in mind. Finally, we propose an initial sketch of future work in this direction, with the broader aim of better supporting the needs of applied ML researchers.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子机器学习（QML）领域曾倾向于追求与经典机器学习中大型神经网络相媲美的模型，但这导致了对QML实际应用前景的质疑。鉴于经典机器学习中模型可解释性对人类采纳的重要性，本文倡导QML研究应优先发现和理解量子信息理论中的工具，以构建具有固有可解释性的模型。这类模型具有有意设计的数学结构，能保证与领域一致的行为。
authors: Kaitlin Gili, Zachary P. Bradshaw

articles.title: The Entanglement Content of Quantum Measurement Bases
articles.title_zh: 量子测量基的纠缠内容
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21185v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Bell-state measurements are essential ingredients in many protocols for quantum information processing, ranging from quantum teleportation and dense coding to entanglement distribution in quantum networks. Their power relies on the fact that they are measurements in an entangled basis of a two-particle system and that the used Bell-state basis can be generated from a single Bell state by local unitary transformations. How can these measurements be generalized to more particles? We develop a general framework for this state-to-measurement problem: We introduce a hierarchy of classes of measurement bases, distinguished by the local transformations the parties may use for their generation from a single state. This leads to a generalization of the concept of maximally entangleable (or weighted hypergraph) states and the identification of a novel maximally entangled basis of four qubits, being a candidate for data-hiding tasks or distillation protocols. Finally, we prove that not all forms of entanglement can be encoded in an entire measurement basis.
articles.abstract_zh: 贝尔态测量是量子信息处理协议中的关键要素。本文提出了一个将贝尔态测量推广到多粒子系统的通用框架，引入了测量基类的层次结构，其区分标准是各方从单个态生成测量基所使用的局部变换。这推广了最大可纠缠态的概念，并识别出一种新的四量子比特最大纠缠基，可用于数据隐藏或蒸馏协议。研究还证明并非所有形式的纠缠都能编码在整个测量基中。
authors: Jef Pauwels, Otfried Gühne

articles.title: Minimum Cardinalities of Multipartite Unextendible Product Bases
articles.title_zh: 多体不可扩展积基的最小基数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.05657v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In quantum information theory, the state space of a multipartite quantum system is modeled by a tensor product. In the tensor-product space Cd₁øtimesḑotsøtimesCdₚ, a nonzero vector is a emphproduct state if it can be written as ketǎrphi₁øtimesḑotsøtimesketǎrphiₚ with ketǎrphiⱼinCdⱼsetminus0. An emphunextendible product basis (UPB) is a finite family of pairwise orthogonal product states such that no nonzero product state is orthogonal to all of them. UPBs play a key role in investigating quantum entanglement and nonlocal phenomena. Finding a smallest UPB is a natural extremal problem: it asks how few pairwise orthogonal product states suffice to prevent any further product state from being added. The general minimum-size problem for UPBs has been studied for over two decades since the seminal work of Alon and Lovász. Let fₘ₍d₁,łdots,dₚ₎ be the minimum cardinality of a UPB in the space, and let (fLB(d₁,łdots,dₚ₎₌₁₊sumⱼ₌₁p(dⱼ₋₁₎) be the natural lower bound. Alon and Lovász determined exactly when (fₘ) attains the lower bound (fLB), but the obstructed multipartite cases remained open in general. We prove a stabilization theorem: for every non-all-qubit system with pge3, whenever the natural lower bound fLB is unattainable, the true minimum is exactly fLB+1. Precisely, if the number of even local dimensions dᵢ is positive and even, and at least one local dimension is greater than two, then (fₘ₍d₁,łdots,dₚ₎₌fLB(d₁,łdots,dₚ₎₊₁). The proof is built on a unified graph-theoretic framework. Our result, together with earlier work, settles the minimum size problem for UPBs in all finite quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 在量子信息理论中，多体量子系统的态空间由张量积建模。不可扩展积基（UPB）是一组有限的、两两正交的积态，使得没有非零积态与它们全部正交。UPB在研究量子纠缠和非局域现象中扮演关键角色。本文研究了UPB的最小基数问题，即最少需要多少个两两正交的积态才能阻止添加任何进一步的积态。
authors: Chenhao Wang

articles.title: Subsystem self-correction of the GKP qubit
articles.title_zh: GKP量子比特的子系统自纠错
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.07702v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Passive quantum error correction, also known as self-correction, is a holy grail in quantum information science. Recent theoretical advances suggest that the Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) code can exhibit self-correction properties, positioning it as a candidate for the realization of self-correcting quantum memories. In this article, we provide a self-contained derivation of the self-correcting behavior of the ideal GKP Hamiltonian, manifested in the Arrhenius type scaling of the logical lifetime, from a quantum-information perspective based on the subsystem code decomposition. When coupling through the physical quadrature q and p, the detailed-balance jump operators decompose into a dominant part acting only on the gauge subsystem and a boundary term that acts non-trivially on the logical qubit. The boundary term is then exponentially suppressed by the Gibbs weights near the edge of the modular cells. In contrast to spin-based quantum memories such as the two-dimensional surface code, the GKP Hamiltonian realizes an effective string tension in modular phase space, whereby the energy cost increases as an error approaches the boundary of a logical sector.
articles.abstract_zh: 被动量子纠错（即自纠错）是量子信息科学中的一个重要目标。最近的理论进展表明，Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) 码可能展现自纠错特性。本文从基于子系统码分解的量子信息角度，推导了理想GKP哈密顿量的自纠错行为，其表现为逻辑寿命的阿伦尼乌斯型标度。与基于自旋的量子存储器不同，GKP哈密顿量在模相位空间中实现了有效的弦张力。
authors: Brian Chung Hang Cheung, Lasse Bjørn Kristensen, Frederik Nathan, Michael Kastoryano

articles.title: Scattering and Schmid-Bulgadaev Transition in Qubits Based on Josephson Junction Chains
articles.title_zh: 基于约瑟夫森结链的量子比特中的散射和Schmid-Bulgadaev转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33814v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A Josephson junction subject to an ohmic dissipative environment undergoes a zero-temperature quantum phase transition called Schmid-Bulgadaev transition form an insulating state to a superconducting state upon increasing the impedance of the environment above the resistance quantum. Superconducting qubits based on Josephson junction chains represent a system where it is possible to dynamically explore both sides of this transition by probing the scattering of individual plasma modes of the junction chain on a SQUID at the boundary which was achieved in recent experiments. Here, we provide a theoretical analysis of the scattering in the system paying special attention to the non-perturbative superconducting regime. We find that in this regime, a specific diagrammatic resummation must be performed in order to correctly account for fluctuation renormalization of the SQUID's potential. We find analytic expressions for the modes' frequency shifts and quality factors which together provide a full description of scattering. We argue that the non-perturbative nature of the superconducting phase manifests itself through a power-law dependence of the frequency shifts on the SQUID flux and through non-monotonous dependence of the quality factors on the mode frequency. Our predictions may be readily verified in modern low-temperature experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 约瑟夫森结在欧姆耗散环境下，当环境阻抗超过电阻量子时，会经历从绝缘态到超导态的零温量子相变，即Schmid-Bulgadaev转变。本文对基于约瑟夫森结链的超导量子比特系统中的散射进行了理论分析，特别关注非微扰超导态。研究发现，在该态下需要进行特定的图解重求和以正确解释SQUID电位的涨落重整化。我们给出了模式频率偏移和品质因数的解析表达式，这些共同提供了散射的完整描述。
authors: Sviatoslav D. Krasin, Alexey Radkevich, Emil Rizvanov, Andrew G. Semenov

articles.title: Tuning from intrinsic to disorder-dominated quantum states in a kagome antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 在kagome反铁磁体中从本征量子态到无序主导量子态的调控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34230v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The spin-1/2 kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet (AFM) provides a paradigmatic platform for realizing quantum spin-liquid (QSL) and magnetization-plateau states. Experimental progress, however, has been hindered by structural disorder, whose effects on these quantum states remain elusive. A key experimental challenge is therefore to connect intrinsic and disorder-dominated regimes through controlled disorder and identify emergent degrees of freedom associated with disorder. Here we introduce controlled point defects through electron irradiation into the spin-1/2 kagome AFM YCu3(OH)6.5Br2.5 (YCOB) and track the resulting evolution of its low-energy magnetic states. High-field magnetic torque measurements reveal that the 1/9 and 1/3 magnetization plateaus are strongly suppressed by only ~0.05% irradiation-induced defects, demonstrating that these delicate quantum many-body states are extraordinarily fragile against dilute disorder. Moreover, the irradiation induces a sign reversal of the magnetic torque only at low temperatures and low fields, indicating the emergence of correlated defect-induced moments rather than isolated free spins. Remarkably, the characteristic scaling of the magnetic specific heat, absent in pristine YCOB, progressively emerges with increasing disorder. These findings establish dilute disorder as an effective tuning parameter that drives the kagome AFM from intrinsic quantum states toward a disorder-dominated regime. The contrasting responses further identify pristine YCOB as an exceptionally clean kagome AFM for accessing intrinsic quantum states.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋-1/2 kagome海森堡反铁磁体是实现量子自旋液体和磁化平台态的典型平台，但结构无序阻碍了实验进展。本文通过电子辐照在YCu3(OH)6.5Br2.5 (YCOB) kagome反铁磁体中引入受控点缺陷，并追踪其低能磁态的演变。高场磁扭矩测量显示，仅约0.05%的辐照诱导缺陷就强烈抑制了1/9和1/3磁化平台。研究表明，这些精细的量子多体态对稀释无序极其脆弱。
authors: Y. Tanaka, R. Kumakura, T. Yamaguchi, M. Kato, K. Totsuka, B. Li, Y. Zhao, Y. Li, R. Grasset, O. Cavani, A. Alessi, V. Sharma, Y. Kohama, S. Suetsugu

articles.title: Virtual defect mediated quantum melting in supersolids
articles.title_zh: 虚拟缺陷介导的超固态量子熔化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34299v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The current understanding of supersolid melting is largely based on mean-field theories predicting that such transitions arise from a structural energy minimization mechanism. Here, we show that soft-core quasi-one-dimensional supersolids stabilized by a shallow external lattice can instead melt at zero temperature into a superfluid phase with quasi-long-range positional order through the proliferation of virtual soliton--antisoliton pairs, leading to a Kosterlitz--Thouless transition. We derive the corresponding Renormalization Group equations from first principles and use them to determine the critical properties of the system. Remarkably, the proliferation of topological defects near criticality strongly renormalizes both the density modulation and the superfluidity behavior. The transition described is intrinsically a beyond mean-field effect, since the external lattice produces only a smooth crossover between weakly and strongly modulated states at the mean-field level.
articles.abstract_zh: 现有超固态熔化理论主要基于平均场，预测其源于结构能量最小化。本文展示了浅外部晶格稳定的软核准一维超固态，可在零温下通过虚拟孤子-反孤子对的增殖，熔化为具有准长程位置有序的超流体相，导致Kosterlitz-Thouless相变。研究从第一性原理推导了重整化群方程，并发现临界点附近拓扑缺陷的增殖显著重整化了密度调制和超流行为，揭示了超越平均场效应的相变机制。
authors: Lazaros Tsaloukidis, Matheus Grossklags, Luca Salasnich, Alejandro Mendoza-Coto

articles.title: Non-magnetic impurities as a quantum microscope of finite size effects in spin chains
articles.title_zh: 非磁性杂质作为自旋链中有限尺寸效应的量子显微镜
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34596v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Finite-size effects are ubiquitous in quantum matter, yet typically invisible in the thermodynamic limit; when system size is restricted, boundaries and confinement reveal modified spectra, correlations, and emergent phenomena. With growing access to well-controlled few-spin systems, these effects are now directly observable and offer a route to probing universal physics and enabling quantum information applications. Here, we study finite-size physics in the quasi-one-dimensional Ising-like quantum antiferromagnet Ba(Co₁₋ₓMgₓ₎₂V₂O₈ with x = 2% and x = 5%, where non-magnetic Mg²⁺ ions fragment the Co²⁺ spin chains into finite segments. Combining inelastic neutron scattering and numerical calculations, we identify distinct regimes with fundamentally different low-energy quantum excitations: spinons confined to chain boundaries, and a cluster mode in shorter chains corresponding to a collective reversal of the Néel-ordered segment without classical analogue. Our results demonstrate how chemical substitution acts as a quantum microscope providing direct access to boundary-shaped excitations in strongly correlated spin systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 有限尺寸效应在量子物质中普遍存在，但在热力学极限下通常不可见。本研究利用非磁性Mg²⁺离子掺杂的准一维伊辛型量子反铁磁体Ba(Co₁₋ₓMgₓ₎₂V₂O₈，将其自旋链分割成有限段，以探究有限尺寸物理。结合非弹性中子散射和数值计算，我们识别出两种截然不同的低能量子激发：束缚在链边界的自旋子，以及在较短链中出现的无经典对应物的Néel有序段集体反转的簇模式。结果表明化学取代可作为量子显微镜，直接揭示强关联自旋系统中边界形成的激发。
authors: Quentin Faure, Shintaro Takayoshi, Virginie Simonet, Béatrice Grenier, Stéphane Raymond, Eric Ressouche, Xavier Fabrèges, Pascal Lejay, Thierry Giamarchi, Sylvain Petit

articles.title: Modeling the CNOT gate in Germanium double quantum dots
articles.title_zh: 锗双量子点中CNOT门的建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35799v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We model a controlled-NOT (CNOT) gate mediated by exchange interactions in a realistic Ge/GeSi hole spin-qubit device. We use for that purpose a computationally efficient framework based on a compact dressed basis of many-body singlet and triplet states, which enables fast time-dependent simulations that would be prohibitive within a conventional configuration-interaction approach. We discuss the dominant sources of infidelity in ideal (noise-free) devices. On the one hand, the nonadiabaticity of the tunnel barrier ramps, enhanced by the transverse component of the exchange interaction, imposes limits on the speed of the CNOT gate. On the other hand, the AC Stark shift of the conditional resonance and the off-resonant driving of the complementary transition can significantly degrade the gate fidelity and call for a careful optimization of the driving conditions. Finally, we investigate the impact of quasi-static charge noise on the fidelity of the CNOT gate. We find that the capture of charges near the qubits can strongly disrupt the conditional operation, while the nanometer-scale motion of charges results in a loss of fidelity that sensitively depends on the position and strength of the corresponding dipole. Our results quantify the requirements on barrier control, microwave driving, and charge-noise stability for high-fidelity two-qubit operations in Ge/GeSi hole-spin qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在真实的Ge/GeSi空穴自旋量子比特器件中，对通过交换相互作用实现的受控非（CNOT）门进行了建模。研究采用基于多体单重态和三重态紧凑缀饰基的计算框架，实现了快速时变模拟。分析了理想（无噪声）器件中主要的失真来源，包括隧道势垒斜坡的非绝热性对门速度的限制，以及交流斯塔克效应和非共振驱动对门保真度的影响。最后，探讨了准静态电荷噪声对CNOT门保真度的影响，发现量子比特附近的电荷捕获和纳米级电荷运动均会导致保真度下降。
authors: Mauricio J. Rodriguez, Yann-Michel Niquet

articles.title: Ground-state spaces of generalized stabilizer codes
articles.title_zh: 广义稳定子码的基态空间
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33221v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this paper, we determine the complete ground-state spaces for a broad class of generalized stabilizer quantum models defined over CW-decompositions of non-compact manifolds of arbitrary dimensions and topological type. We introduce a C^*-algebraic framework in which the quantum spin algebra A is realized as the twisted group C^*-algebra of an infinite discrete Pauli module P endowed with a symplectic structure. We establish a correspondence between stabilizer models and isotropic subgroups of P: Every Lagrangian extension of such a subgroup determines a C^*-diagonal of A, whose Weyl groupoid encodes the dynamics through a continuous 1-cocycle. This realization yields an explicit family of extremal ground-states for every admissible Lagrangian model, together with their decomposition into sectors. When the sector space is T₀, this gives a complete characterization of the ground-state spaces. We also prove that every Lagrangian stabilizer model admits a unique frustration-free ground state with a spectral gap. Our framework applies in arbitrary dimension, including higher abelian quantum doubles, homological codes, and a broad class of stabilizer models.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文确定了定义在任意维度和拓扑类型的非紧流形CW分解上的广义稳定子量子模型的完整基态空间。研究引入了C*-代数框架，将量子自旋代数A实现为具有辛结构的无限离散泡利模P的扭曲群C*-代数。建立了稳定子模型与P的各向同性子群之间的对应关系，并证明每个拉格朗日稳定子模型都存在一个具有谱隙的唯一无挫折基态。该框架适用于任意维度，包括高阶阿贝尔量子双体和同调码。
authors: Cathy Cheng, Nigel Higson, Danilo Polo Ojito, Emil Prodan

articles.title: A neural accelerated surface-roughness-based Discrete Element Method (SR-DEM) for modeling granular systems
articles.title_zh: 一种用于颗粒系统建模的神经加速表面粗糙度离散元方法（SR-DEM）
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33363v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Discrete Element Method (DEM) is an indispensable tool for modeling and understanding the basic mechanical behaviors of (dry) granular media, a class of disordered material systems of significant interest to multiple scientific domains from (geo-)physics to (chemical) engineering. At the core of all present DEM frameworks is a phenomenological friction law--commonly chosen to be of the Amontons-Coulomb type--that models the frictional interaction among constituent grains. Here, inspired by research in the tribology community, we present an alternative, fundamentally different framework, termed surface-roughness-based DEM (SR-DEM), in which contact friction is handled in a more physics-based manner. In this framework, instead of using a friction law, we explicitly resolve the surface topography of each grain and let friction emerge from collective frictionless interactions of surface asperities. In essence, we trade phenomenology for physics at the cost of an increased computational demand. To mitigate the cost, we introduce an FE²⁻like algorithm and a feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM)-based neural network surrogate, both of which are parallelized on GPU to accelerate contact computation. Crucially, using this framework in 2D, we (1) demonstrate the possibility of recovering a two-body-based Amontons-Coulomb-type friction behavior using a simple representation of surface topography, and (2) identify many-body-based frictional behaviors--more specifically, the angle of repose values--that cannot always be captured by current DEM frameworks under the same level of model complexity. We conclude by discussing future directions for SR-DEM, as well as exciting new opportunities it could unlock for a wide range of emerging applications, including (designing) suspension rheology and metamaterial mechanics.
articles.abstract_zh: 离散元方法（DEM）是理解颗粒介质力学行为的重要工具，但其核心是现象学摩擦定律。本文提出了一种基于表面粗糙度（SR-DEM）的替代框架，通过显式解析每个颗粒的表面形貌，使摩擦从表面粗糙点的集体无摩擦相互作用中涌现。这种方法以增加计算需求为代价，用物理学取代了现象学。为降低计算成本，研究引入了FE²⁻类算法和基于特征线性调制（FiLM）的神经网络代理。
authors: Xiwei Pan, Liuchi Li

articles.title: Spin-phase transition in an array of quantum rings controlled by cavity photons
articles.title_zh: 腔光子控制下量子环阵列中的自旋相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2411.13176v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We model a spin-phase transition in a two-dimensional square array, or a lateral superlattice, of quantum rings in an external perpendicular homogeneous magnetic field. The electron system is placed in a circular cylindrical far-infrared photon cavity with a single circularly symmetric photon mode. Our numerical results reveal that the spin ordering of the two-dimensional electron gas in each quantum ring can be influenced or controlled by the electron-photon coupling strength and the energy of the photons. The Coulomb interaction between the electrons is described by a spin-density functional approach, but the para- and the diamagnetic electron-photon interactions are modeled via a configuration interaction formalism in a truncated many-body Fock-space, which is updated in each iteration step of the density functional approach. In the absence of external electromagnetic pulses this spin-phase transition is replicated in the orbital magnetization of the rings. The spin-phase transition can be suppressed by a strong electron-photon interaction. In addition, fluctuations in the spin configuration are found in dynamical calculations, where the system is excited by a time-dependent scheme specially fit for emphasizing the diamagnetic electron-photon interaction.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文模拟了外部垂直均匀磁场中二维量子环方阵列的自旋相变。研究发现，每个量子环中二维电子气的自旋有序可以通过电子-光子耦合强度和光子能量来影响或控制。电子间的库仑相互作用通过自旋密度泛函方法描述，而电子-光子相互作用则通过截断多体福克空间的组态相互作用形式建模。结果表明，在没有外部电磁脉冲的情况下，这种自旋相变在环的轨道磁化中得到体现，并且强电子-光子相互作用可以抑制自旋相变。
authors: Vidar Gudmundsson, Vram Mughnetsyan, Hsi-Sheng Goan, Jeng-Da Chai, Nzar Rauf Abdullah, Chi-Shung Tang, Valeriu Moldoveanu, Andrei Manolescu

articles.title: Electronic structure, excitonic optical response, and defect stability of RbTlCl3 from first-principles
articles.title_zh: RbTlCl3的电子结构、激子光学响应和缺陷稳定性第一性原理研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.16264v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a many-body ab initio study of the electronic structure, optical properties, excitonic effects, and defect stability of RbTlCl3. Density functional theory and many-body methods are used to investigate the properties with and without spin-orbit coupling (SOC). The indirect band gaps obtained using PBE-GGA are 0.94 and 0.95 eV with and without SOC, respectively. Optical spectra are calculated using the independent-particle approximation (IPA), IPA with scissor correction (IQPA), random-phase approximation (RPA) with local-field effects (LFEs), and the Bethe-Salpeter equation (BSE). The maximum imaginary dielectric function is approximately 7 at 2 eV within IQPA and decreases to 5.7 when LFEs are included. BSE calculations yield a peak value of approximately 10.8 at 1.6 eV, revealing strong excitonic effects. Four prominent bright bound excitons exhibit binding energies of 315-365 meV. The main bright exciton is localized in reciprocal space and delocalized in real space. The spectroscopic limited maximum efficiency is estimated to be 15.4% for a 0.5-micrometer-thick film. The absence of imaginary phonon frequencies and the existence of a thermodynamically stable region indicate dynamical and thermodynamic stability. Chemical-potential analysis identifies the chlorine vacancy as the most stable neutral defect under chlorine-poor conditions and the thallium vacancy under chlorine-rich conditions. These findings establish RbTlCl3 as a promising theoretical candidate for photovoltaic applications and provide insights into excitonic effects in inorganic perovskites.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对RbTlCl3的电子结构、光学性质、激子效应和缺陷稳定性进行了多体从头算研究，考虑了有无自旋轨道耦合（SOC）的情况。研究发现，PBE-GGA计算的间接带隙分别为0.94和0.95 eV。通过多种方法计算了光学光谱，Bethe-Salpeter方程（BSE）计算揭示了强烈的激子效应，四个主要的亮束缚激子结合能为315-365 meV。主要亮激子在倒空间局域化而在实空间离域化，0.5微米厚薄膜的光谱极限最大效率估计为15.4%。
authors: Siddharth, Vinod Kumar Solet, Sudhir K. Pandey

articles.title: Subspace-Protected Topological Phases and Bulk-Boundary Correspondence
articles.title_zh: 子空间保护的拓扑相与体边对应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.20908v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: While tremendous research has revealed that symmetry enriches topological phases of matter, more general principles that protect topological phases have yet to be explored. In this Letter, we elucidate the roles of subspaces in free-fermionic topological phases. A subspace property for Hamiltonians enables us to define new topological invariants. It results in peculiar topological boundary phenomena, i.e., the emergence of an unpaired zero mode or zero-winding skin modes, characterizing subspace-protected topological phases. We establish and demonstrate the bulk-boundary correspondence in subspace-protected topological phases. We further discuss the interplay of the subspace property and internal symmetries. Toward application, we also propose possible platforms possessing the subspace property.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管对称性在拓扑相中扮演重要角色，但更普遍的保护拓扑相的原理仍待探索。本文阐明了子空间在自由费米子拓扑相中的作用，并提出哈密顿量的子空间性质可定义新的拓扑不变量。这导致了独特的拓扑边界现象，如未配对零模或零缠绕皮肤模式的出现，从而表征子空间保护的拓扑相。研究建立了子空间保护拓扑相中的体边对应关系，并讨论了子空间性质与内禀对称性的相互作用，同时提出了可能具有子空间性质的平台。
authors: Kenji Shimomura, Ryo Takami, Daichi Nakamura, Masatoshi Sato

articles.title: Web of Non-invertible Dualities for (2+1) Dimensional Models with Subsystem Symmetries
articles.title_zh: 具有子系统对称性的 (2+1) 维模型的不可逆对偶性网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.18969v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We extend non-invertible duality concepts from one-dimensional systems to two spatial dimensions by constructing a web of non-invertible dualities for lattice models with subsystem symmetries. For the Z₂ × Z₂ subsystem symmetry on the square lattice, we build two complementary dualities: a map that sends spontaneous subsystem symmetry-broken (SSSB) phases to the trivial phase (the analogue of the Kramers-Wannier (KW) duality in 1+1D), and a generalized subsystem Kennedy-Tasaki (KT) transformation that maps SSSB phases to subsystem symmetry-protected topological (SSPT) phases while leaving the trivial phase invariant. These dualities are boundary-sensitive. On open lattices, both subsystem KW and KT transformations act as unitary, invertible operators. In particular, the KT map not only matches the bulk Hamiltonians of the dual phases but also carries the spontaneous ground-state degeneracy of the SSSB phase onto the protected boundary degeneracy of the SSPT phase. On closed manifolds, however, both maps become intrinsically non-unitary and non-invertible when restricted to the original Hilbert space. We demonstrate this non-invertibility via ground-state degeneracy matching (in two copies of the Xu-Moore/Ising-plaquette model), analysis of symmetry-twist sectors mapping, and the fusion algebra of the duality operator. Enlarging the Hilbert space to include twisted sectors allows the subsystem KW map to be formulated as a projective unitary preserving quantum transition probabilities, consistent with generalized Wigner-theorem-based constructions. We also show that the KT map faithfully transmits the algebraic content of bulk and edge invariants diagnosing strong SSPT order: although strictly local SSPT repair operators map to highly nonlocal objects in the dual SSSB phase, the essential commutation algebra and the bulk-edge correspondence remain intact.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将不可逆对偶性概念从一维系统扩展到二维空间，为具有子系统对称性的格点模型构建了一个不可逆对偶性网络。研究人员构建了两种互补的对偶性：一种将自发子系统对称破缺相映射到平凡相，另一种是广义子系统Kennedy-Tasaki变换，将自发子系统对称破缺相映射到子系统对称保护拓扑相。这些对偶性对边界敏感，在开放格点上表现为酉可逆算符，而在封闭流形上则变为非酉和不可逆的。
authors: Avijit Maity, Vikram Tripathi, Andriy H. Nevidomskyy

articles.title: Coulomb Interaction and Density-Independent Exciton-Scattering Processes in Atomically Thin Semiconductors
articles.title_zh: 原子级薄半导体中的库仑相互作用和密度无关激子散射过程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.13763v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In quantum-kinetic approaches to the dynamics of Coulomb-bound many-body correlations such as excitons, trions, biexcitons or higher-order correlations, a detailed knowledge of the many-body Coulomb Hamiltonian serving as a starting point is important. In this manuscript, the second-quantized description of the Coulomb interaction between Bloch electrons in a Heisenberg-equation-of-motion approach in atomically thin semiconductors is derived and reviewed. Emphasis is put on a discussion of Umklapp processes and the dielectric screening including all local-field effects. A link between ab initio methods of screening and few-band models in effective-mass approximations for the quantum kinetics is established and important Coulomb scattering processes contributing to the exciton energy landscape and density-independent exciton scattering are discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在量子动力学方法中，推导并回顾了原子级薄半导体中布洛赫电子间库仑相互作用的二次量子化描述。研究重点讨论了Umklapp过程和包含所有局域场效应的介电屏蔽。该工作建立了屏蔽的从头计算方法与量子动力学中有效质量近似的少能带模型之间的联系，并探讨了对激子能量图景和密度无关激子散射有重要贡献的库仑散射过程。
authors: Henry Mittenzwey, Andreas Knorr, Thorsten Deilmann

articles.title: Coexistence of Ferromagnetic and Overscreened Kondo Effects in a Single Molecule
articles.title_zh: 单分子中铁磁和过屏蔽近藤效应的共存
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.07174v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The quest for quantum ground states beyond the Fermi-liquid paradigm remains a central challenge in many-body physics. The ferromagnetic Kondo effect is an intriguing variant of the Kondo effect in which an asymptotically free spin gives rise to singular Fermi-liquid behavior. Despite its theoretical importance, this regime has eluded experimental observation owing to subtle spectroscopic signatures, small energy scales, and symmetry constraints in nanostructures. Here, we demonstrate the coexistence of ferromagnetic and overscreened Kondo effects within a molecular spin system---a triangulene dimer comprising spin-1 and spin-1/2 units adsorbed on a metal surface. Low-temperature scanning tunneling spectroscopy reveals signatures of singular Fermi-liquid behavior, supported by many-body calculations. The molecular design provides control over spin configuration and coupling asymmetry, allowing distinct regimes within the same platform. Our results establish a strategy for realizing non-Fermi-liquid physics at the atomic scale and demonstrate that ferromagnetic Kondo behavior can be deliberately engineered in molecular systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在一个吸附在金属表面的三角形二聚体分子自旋系统中，首次实验证明了铁磁和过屏蔽近藤效应的共存。低温扫描隧道光谱揭示了奇异费米液体行为的特征，并得到了多体计算的支持。该分子设计提供了对自旋构型和耦合不对称性的控制，从而在同一平台上实现了不同的物理机制。这项工作为在原子尺度实现非费米液体物理学提供了新策略，并表明铁磁近藤行为可以在分子系统中被精确设计。
authors: Elia Turco, Nils Krane, Hongyan Chen, Simon Gerber, Wulf Wulfhekel, Roman Fasel, Pascal Ruffieux, David Jacob

articles.title: Unveiling Topological Fusion in Quantum Hall Systems from Microscopic Principles
articles.title_zh: 从微观原理揭示量子霍尔系统中的拓扑融合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.16525v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Establishing the fusion rules of anyonic quasiparticles in fractional quantum Hall fluids is essential for understanding their underlying topological order. Building on the conjecture that key topological properties are encoded in the ''DNA'' of candidate many-body wave functions - that is, the pattern of dominant orbital occupations restricted to a finite number of lowest Landau levels - we propose a combinatorial framework that derives these fusion rules directly from microscopic data. By extending Schrieffer's counting argument and introducing classes of topological excitations, our framework provides a unified route to the fusion rules for both Abelian and non-Abelian excitations. This approach elucidates the emergence of topological features from first principles in both fermionic and bosonic systems. In particular, we unveil the previously unknown fusion rules of the Hafnian fluid.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种组合框架，可以直接从微观数据推导出分数量子霍尔流体中任意子准粒子的融合规则。通过扩展Schrieffer的计数论证并引入拓扑激发类别，该框架为阿贝尔和非阿贝尔激发的融合规则提供了一条统一的途径。这种方法从第一性原理阐明了费米子和玻色子系统中拓扑特征的出现，并特别揭示了Hafnian流体先前未知的融合规则。
authors: Arkadiusz Bochniak, Shinsei Ryu, Jürgen Fuchs, Gerardo Ortiz

articles.title: The Kubo-Thermalization Correspondence
articles.title_zh: 久保-热化对应原理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.06666v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum thermalization describes how interacting quantum systems relax toward thermal equilibrium, a central problem in modern physics. Yet most experimental information on many-body systems comes from short-time transition spectroscopy, typically interpreted within Kubo's linear-response framework. These perspectives-long-time equilibration versus short-time response-seem fundamentally disconnected. Here we establish an exact link between them: the emphKubo-Thermalization correspondence, which connects long-time thermalized magnetization under weak driving to short-time linear-response spectra for a spin coupled to a thermal bath. The correspondence holds even when the steady state differs substantially from the initial state and when each regime is individually difficult to describe theoretically. We experimentally confirm the correspondence using effective spin-1/2 impurities realized with ultracold fermions in two internal states coupled to a Fermi sea. Our results provide a rare exact statement about quantum thermalization and offer a novel route to infer thermalization dynamics from equilibrium response measurements in strongly interacting quantum systems, independent of microscopic details of the system--bath coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了量子热化中的“久保-热化对应原理”，将弱驱动下长时间热化的磁化强度与自旋耦合到热浴的短时间线性响应谱精确关联起来。该对应关系在稳态与初始态显著不同以及每个机制单独难以理论描述时依然成立。研究人员通过超冷费米子实验证实了这一对应关系，为量子热化提供了一个罕见的精确陈述，并为从平衡响应测量推断热化动力学提供了一条新途径。
authors: Songtao Huang, Xingyu Li, Jianyi Chen, Alan Tsidilkovski, Gabriel G. T. Assumpção, Pengfei Zhang, Hui Zhai, Nir Navon

articles.title: New families of additive non-RS MDS codes and ACD codes from twisted Reed-Solomon codes
articles.title_zh: 基于扭曲Reed-Solomon码的加性非RS MDS码和ACD码的新族
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35105v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Additive codes generalize linear codes and play an important role in the construc?tion of quantum codes. As generalizations of linear MDS codes, additive MDS codes have received much research attention. As an important subclass of additive codes, ACD codes are widely used for quantum error correction. In this paper, we study single-twist additive generalized twisted Reed-Solomon (GTRS) codes over finite fields. We derive necessary and sufficient conditions for these codes to be MDS for arbitrary hook and twist parameters. Then we employ Schur squares to prove that such additive MDS codes are not monomially equivalent to additive Reed-Solomon codes. We also identify a class of additive GTRS codes whose duals remain additive GTRS codes, and show that, for all sufficiently large prime powers q whose characteristic avoids a finite set, such GTRS codes yield ACD codes.
