articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了有限域上的单扭加性广义扭曲Reed-Solomon (GTRS) 码，并推导了这些码成为MDS码的充要条件。研究利用Schur平方证明了这些加性MDS码与加性Reed-Solomon码不等价。此外，作者还识别了一类对偶码仍为加性GTRS码的GTRS码，并证明在特定条件下，这些GTRS码可以产生ACD码，这对于量子纠错具有重要意义。
authors: Xia Li, Yu Wang, Yansheng Wu

articles.title: Zero-knowledge and Quantum CSS Codes Are Equivalent
articles.title_zh: 零知识码与量子CSS码等价
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.08941v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Zero-knowledge codes, introduced by Decatur, Goldreich, and Ron (ePrint 1997), are error-correcting codes in which few codeword symbols reveal no information about the encoded message, and have been extensively used in cryptographic constructions. Quantum CSS codes, introduced by Calderbank and Shor (Phys. Rev. A 1996) and Steane (Royal Society A 1996), are error-correcting codes that allow for quantum error correction, and are also useful for applications in quantum complexity theory. In this short note, we show that (linear, perfect) zero-knowledge codes and quantum CSS codes are equivalent. We demonstrate the potential of this equivalence by using it to obtain explicit asymptotically-good zero-knowledge locally-testable codes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了（线性、完美）零知识码与量子CSS码是等价的。零知识码是纠错码，其少量码字符号不泄露编码信息，广泛用于密码学构造。量子CSS码是用于量子纠错的码，在量子复杂性理论中也有应用。这项工作通过利用这种等价性，获得了显式的渐近好零知识局部可测试码。
authors: Noga Ron-Zewi, Mor Weiss

articles.title: Hierarchy of entanglement detection criteria for random high-dimensional states
articles.title_zh: 随机高维态纠缠检测判据的层次结构
articles.abstract: Author(s): Akhil Kumar Awasthi, Sudipta Mondal, Rivu Gupta, and Aditi Sen(De) Entanglement is a cornerstone in quantum information science, yet detecting it efficiently remains a challenging task. articles.title: Noncontextuality inequalities for prepare-transform-measure scenarios
articles.title_zh: 准备-变换-测量场景中的非语境性不等式
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2250 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-27-2250 We provide the first systematic technique for deriving witnesses of contextuality in prepare-transform-measure scenarios. More specifically, we show how linear quantifier elimination can be used to compute a polytope of correlations consistent with generalized noncontextuality in such scenarios. This polytope is specified as a set of noncontextuality inequalities that are necessary and sufficient conditions for observed data in the scenario to admit of a classical explanation relative to any linear operational identities, if one ignores some constraints from diagram preservation. While including these latter constraints generally leads to tighter inequalities, it seems that nonlinear quantifier elimination would be required to systematically include them. We also provide a linear program which can certify the nonclassicality of a set of numerical data arising in a prepare-transform-measure experiment. We apply our results to get a robust noncontextuality inequality for transformations that can be violated within the stabilizer subtheory. Finally, we give a simple algorithm for computing all the linear operational identities holding among a given set of states, of transformations, or of measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文首次提出了一种系统性技术，用于推导准备-变换-测量场景中的语境性判据。研究展示了如何利用线性量词消除来计算与广义非语境性一致的关联多面体，该多面体由一组非语境性不等式定义。这些不等式是观测数据在忽略图保持约束下，允许经典解释的充要条件。此外，本文还提供了一个线性规划，可以验证准备-变换-测量实验中数值数据的非经典性，并给出了计算所有线性操作恒等式的简单算法。
authors: David Schmid, Roberto D. Baldijão, John H. Selby, Ana Belén Sainz, and Robert W. Spekkens

articles.title: A General Framework for Gradient-Based Optimization of Superconducting Quantum Circuits using Qubit Discovery as a Case Study
articles.title_zh: 基于梯度优化超导量子电路的通用框架：以量子比特发现为例
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2249 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-27-2249 Engineering the Hamiltonian of a quantum system is fundamental to the design of quantum systems. Automating Hamiltonian design through gradient-based optimization can dramatically accelerate this process. However, computing the gradients of eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a Hamiltonian–a large, sparse matrix–relative to system properties poses a significant challenge, especially for arbitrary systems. Superconducting quantum circuits offer substantial flexibility in Hamiltonian design, making them an ideal platform for this task. In this work, we present a comprehensive framework for the gradient-based optimization of superconducting quantum circuits, leveraging the SQcircuit software package. By addressing the challenge of calculating the gradient of the eigensystem for large, sparse Hamiltonians and integrating automatic differentiation within SQcircuit, our framework enables efficient and precise computation of gradients for various circuit properties or custom-defined metrics, streamlining the optimization process. We apply this framework to the qubit discovery problem, demonstrating its effectiveness in identifying qubit designs with superior performance metrics. The optimized circuits show improvements in a heuristic measure of gate count, upper bounds on gate speed, decoherence time, and resilience to noise and fabrication errors compared to existing qubits. While this methodology is showcased through qubit optimization and discovery, it is versatile and can be extended to tackle other optimization challenges in superconducting quantum hardware design.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子系统哈密顿量的设计是量子系统构建的基础，而基于梯度的优化可以显著加速这一过程。本文提出了一个用于超导量子电路基于梯度优化的综合框架，该框架利用SQcircuit软件包，解决了计算大型稀疏哈密顿量本征系统梯度的问题，并集成了自动微分。该框架能够高效精确地计算各种电路特性或自定义指标的梯度，从而简化优化过程。研究将此框架应用于量子比特发现问题，展示了其有效性。
authors: Taha Rajabzadeh, Alex Boulton-McKeehan, Sam Bonkowsky, David I. Schuster, and Amir H. Safavi-Naeini

articles.title: Proof of hiding conjecture in Gaussian boson sampling
articles.title_zh: 高斯玻色采样中隐藏猜想的证明
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2248 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-27-2248 Gaussian boson sampling (GBS) is a promising protocol for demonstrating quantum computational advantage. One of the key steps in the argument for classical hardness of GBS is the so-called “hiding conjecture'', which asserts that one can “hide'' a complex Gaussian matrix as a submatrix of the symmetric product of Haar unitary submatrices in total variation distance. In this paper, we prove the hiding conjecture for input states with all input modes squeezed, which is a setup that has recently been realized experimentally [ 10 ]. In this setting, the hiding conjecture states that a o(sqrtM)× o(sqrtM) submatrix of an M× M circular orthogonal ensemble (COE) random matrix can be well-approximated by a complex symmetric Gaussian matrix in total variation distance as M→infty. This is the first rigorous proof of the hiding property for GBS in the experimentally relevant regime, and puts the argument for hardness of classically simulating GBS with the maximum number of squeezed input modes on a comparable level to that of the conventional boson sampling of [Aaronson and Arkhipov, Theory Comput. 9, 143 (2013)] [ 1 ].
articles.abstract_zh: 高斯玻色采样（GBS）是展示量子计算优势的有前景协议，其经典硬度论证的关键步骤之一是“隐藏猜想”。本文首次严格证明了在所有输入模式都被压缩的实验相关GBS设置下的隐藏猜想。这一证明使得经典模拟GBS的硬度论证达到了与传统玻色采样相当的水平。该工作为GBS的量子计算优势提供了坚实的理论基础。
authors: Laura Shou, Sarah H. Miller, and Victor Galitski

articles.title: Finite-frequency fluctuation-response bounds for open quantum systems
articles.title_zh: 开放量子系统的有限频率涨落-响应界限
articles.abstract: We derive a finite-frequency fluctuation-response inequality for Markovian open quantum systems in an input–output setting. For any downstream measurement of the emitted field, the measured lock-in response-to-noise matrix is bounded by the output-field quantum Fisher information rate. For dissipative amplitude modulation with vacuum inputs, this information rate is further bounded by a frequency-independent signal-channel activity, which reduces for kinetic modulation to the stationary channel fluxes. For a faithful stationary state, complete access to the Markov output, and horizontal dissipative tangents, we also evaluate the intermediate output-field quantum Fisher information rate explicitly and show that it equals the activity matrix. The result is detector-facing but unraveling-independent: it applies after choosing a measurement record, while the information ceiling is set by the quantum field before any detection scheme or trajectory representation is selected. We formulate the bound for multiple signal channels and real finite-frequency quadratures, and illustrate it with a single-sided cavity, resonance fluorescence, and a two-port truncated Kerr-parametric cat resonator exhibiting appreciable channel mixing and off-diagonal matrix effects.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在输入-输出设置下，为马尔可夫开放量子系统推导了一个有限频率涨落-响应不等式。对于发射场的任何下游测量，测得的锁定响应-噪声矩阵受限于输出场量子费雪信息率。该结果面向探测器但独立于展开方式，适用于选择测量记录之后。研究者为多个信号通道和实数有限频率正交分量制定了界限，并通过具体系统进行了说明。
authors: Jie Gu and Kangqiao Liu

articles.title: Operator learning for efficient quantum computation
articles.title_zh: 用于高效量子计算的算子学习
articles.abstract: An efficient implementation of quantum algorithms is often hindered by the lack of efficient primitives for operators and state preparation. This limits both the ability of near-term quantum hardware to simulate complex problems and the potential of fault-tolerant algorithms to achieve practical quantum advantage. To address this, we propose a framework that maps discrete operators onto compact, structured quantum circuits. The resulting variational circuits can be tailored to the connectivity and long-range interaction of the target hardware. The learning process employs backpropagation together with a cost function that efficiently optimizes unitary operators and non-unitary—dense or sparse—operators using only a single ancilla qubit for block encoding. Additionally, we introduce a regularization term that reduces the approximation error. The approach is validated for both quantum mechanical and engineering applications. In the former case, we learn propagators that arise in native quantum problems—such as quantum simulation and quantum chemistry—and achieve improved resource scaling in comparison to standard Suzuki–Trotter expansions. In the latter case, we demonstrate the approach’s ability to implement the second-order central finite difference approximation of the Laplace operator—relevant for solving partial differential equations—while improving upon current error metrics. The final example deals with learning a dense, non-unitary operator that arises in the analysis of inviscid potential flow around an airfoil. These results motivate the extension of the framework to a broader class of operator-synthesis problems beyond the prototypical engineering and quantum applications considered here.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子算法的有效实现常因缺乏高效的算子原语和态制备而受阻。本文提出一个将离散算子映射到紧凑、结构化量子电路的框架，这些变分电路可根据目标硬件的连接性和长程相互作用进行定制。该学习过程利用反向传播和成本函数，仅用一个辅助量子比特即可高效优化酉算子和非酉算子。该方法在量子力学和工程应用中均得到验证，与标准Suzuki-Trotter展开相比，实现了改进的资源扩展。
authors: Paul Over, Sergio Bengoechea, Leonardo Borello Busilacchi, Martin Kiffner, Thomas Rung and Alexios A Michailidis

articles.title: The Cost of a Real Grover Oracle: Minecraft Seed Search from Software to Quantum Hardware
articles.title_zh: 真实格罗弗预言机的成本：从软件到量子硬件的Minecraft种子搜索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33139v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present the resource estimation of how known-constant arithmetic changes the cost of a Grover oracle for Minecraft 1.13.1 seed recovery, an application of quantum search to procedural content generation. The oracle developed here combines a structure-placement predicate with a reversible inverse transform of the linear congruential generator for the 32-bit residual search. Reduced-width arithmetic, phase marking, uncomputation, and complete Grover loops are verified against an independent Java reference, while production-width circuits are structurally audited. Direct Fourier-basis constant arithmetic reduces the placement-predicate width from 6n+3 to 4n+3 qubits and the structural scaling of the two-qubit gate counts from Theta(n³⁾ to O(n²⁾. Under backend-agnostic common-basis Qiskit level-0 u, CX accounting, the representative nonzero-r folded residual-search construction uses 275 circuit qubits, 48,896 CX gates, and depth 4,482, versus 467 qubits, 2,038,804 CX gates, and depth 186,328 for the original register-to-register baseline. Multi-placement conjunctions expose a width-recomputation tradeoff, and exact enumeration identifies a plateau in candidate reduction for the benchmark. We executed reduced-width placement circuits within complete Grover loops on IBM processors and Quantinuum H2-1 and show larger one-iteration increases in marked-state probability for the specialized construction than for the baseline. These results quantify the resource benefits of arithmetic specialization and show substantial routing sensitivity in the reduced-width IBM hardware experiments. Together, the results quantify the effect of specializing known-constant arithmetic within a PCG-derived oracle and show that its compiled hardware behavior strongly depends on routing and execution context.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文评估了已知常数算术如何改变Minecraft 1.13.1种子恢复中格罗弗预言机的成本。所开发的预言机结合了结构放置谓词和线性同余生成器的可逆逆变换，用于32位残差搜索。直接傅里叶基常数算术显著减少了量子比特宽度和双量子比特门计数。研究结果展示了显著的资源优化，为量子搜索在程序化内容生成中的应用提供了深入见解。
authors: Evan M. Reeves, Elias Sopkin, Thomas A. Searles

articles.title: Fully quantum training of parametric circuits with Quantum Hamiltonian Descent
articles.title_zh: 基于量子哈密顿下降的参数化电路全量子训练
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33144v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Parametric quantum circuits are usually trained by classical, local optimizers, which use the quantum computer only to evaluate the cost function, or its gradient, one point at a time. Quantum Hamiltonian Descent (QHD) takes a different route: in this quantum algorithm for continuous optimization, the parameters become the position of a quantum particle, with the cost function as its potential, and two time schedules control kinetic and potential energy so that the wavefunction explores the whole landscape and tunnels towards the global minimum. QHD, however, assumes a classically computable cost function, and its digital implementation is poorly understood: standard error bounds grow exponentially with the number of qubits per parameter, and the schedules are borrowed from classical optimization. Here we propose to train parametric circuits with QHD entirely on the quantum computer, through an online step in which the qubits encoding the parameters coherently control the circuit on a second register. We prove that, for cost functions with a smooth periodic extension, including those of parametric circuits, the simulation error admits a bound independent of the grid resolution, and that for circuits the bound grows at most linearly with the number of parameters. We also show that the ideal dynamics depends on the two schedules only through a single curve, which controls the adiabaticity of the search, and that the remaining freedom can be used to minimize the gate count. Simulations on benchmark functions and parametric circuits show that, at equal cost, schedules designed in this way markedly increase the probability of finding the global minimum.
articles.abstract_zh: 参数化量子电路通常由经典局部优化器训练，而量子哈密顿下降（QHD）则将参数视为量子粒子的位置，成本函数作为其势能。本文提出通过在线步骤，在量子计算机上完全训练参数化电路，其中编码参数的量子比特在第二个寄存器上相干控制电路。研究证明，对于具有平滑周期扩展的成本函数（包括参数化电路的成本函数），模拟误差可以得到有效控制。该方法为连续优化的量子算法提供了新的视角。
authors: Marco Burato, Leonardo Banchi

articles.title: Genuinely multipartite entangled qudits: one rule to link them all
articles.title_zh: 真正多体纠缠的量子多态系统：一个统一的连接规则
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33160v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Links of rings offer an intuitive picture of multipartite entanglement. Cutting one ring can free some of the others, just as losing a particle, i.e. tracing it out, can disentangle some of the remaining ones. This analogy classifies multipartite entanglement according to which groups of particles stay entangled when others are lost, a question at the heart of robust quantum networks. However, pure states realizing a given link class were known only in special cases. Here, we close this gap. Recasting link polynomials as hypergraphs, we give an explicit formula for pure qudit states and prove that, for every link class, their entanglement under any pattern of particle loss matches the link exactly. The same construction also controls genuine multipartite entanglement, determining exactly which of the groups that stay entangled are genuinely multipartite entangled, and all of them can be made so. As a consequence, we prove the conjecture that m-resistant pure qudit states, which stay entangled after the loss of any m particles but become fully separable after the loss of m+1, exist for any number of particles and any m.
articles.abstract_zh: 环的连接提供了多体纠缠的直观图像，但实现特定连接类别的纯态此前仅在特殊情况下已知。本文将连接多项式重构为超图，给出了纯量子多态系统（qudit）态的显式公式，并证明了其在任何粒子损失模式下的纠缠都与连接完全匹配。该构造还控制了真正的多体纠缠，并证明了m-抗性纯量子多态系统对于任意数量的粒子和任意m都存在。这项工作填补了多体纠缠分类的理论空白。
authors: Gonçalo M. Quinta, Rui André

articles.title: Post-Quantum Perfect Zero-Knowledge Arguments for NP From Any One-Way Permutation
articles.title_zh: 基于任意单向置换的NP问题后量子完美零知识论证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33185v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper, we show for the first time that post-quantum one-way permutations are sufficient for perfect zero-knowledge classical arguments for all of NP with security guaranteed against quantum adversaries. We first establish that Naor, Ostrovsky,Venkatesen, and Yung's bit commitment scheme built from any permutation using interactive hashing, called the NOVY scheme, is sum-binding and collapse-binding against quantum polynomial-time committers provided the permutation is post-quantum one-way. We then show that the collapse-binding property of the NOVY scheme allows for Blum's perfect zero-knowledge argument for HAMCYCLE to remain so exactly as it stands against quantum adversaries.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文首次证明，后量子单向置换足以实现针对量子对手安全的NP问题完美零知识经典论证。研究首先确立了基于交互式哈希构建的NOVY比特承诺方案，在置换是后量子单向的条件下，对量子多项式时间承诺者具有和绑定和坍缩绑定特性。随后，研究表明NOVY方案的坍缩绑定特性使得Blum的HAMCYCLE完美零知识论证在面对量子对手时依然成立。这一成果为后量子密码学提供了重要理论基础。
authors: Frédéric Dupuis, Rémi Ligez, Khaireddine Medhioub, Louis Salvail, Louis-Charles Thibodeau

articles.title: Quantum Heuristic Separation of Comb Inequalities for the Travelling Salesman Problem
articles.title_zh: 旅行商问题梳形不等式的量子启发式分离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33188v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Comb inequalities are essential cutting planes for the travelling salesman problem, yet their separation remains computationally challenging. We propose a quantum heuristic separation algorithm for this family of inequalities. The algorithm uses a procedure that prepares a uniform superposition of all combs with a fixed number of teeth using polynomially many gates and qubits. As part of this procedure, we present a circuit that coherently encodes the Hamming weight of a data register in one-hot form in an auxiliary register. The separation algorithm then searches for violated inequalities using the Grover-Mixer Quantum Alternating Operator Ansatz. Its running time is polynomial under prescribed polynomial budgets for the number of QAOA rounds, parameter optimization steps and samples gathered, although we provide no evidence that such budgets suffice to find a violated comb with constant probability when one exists. We provide an explicit circuit construction for the mixer unitary, the full problem Hamiltonian and a resource analysis.
articles.abstract_zh: 梳形不等式是旅行商问题的重要割平面，但其分离计算挑战性高。本文提出一种针对该不等式家族的量子启发式分离算法，该算法通过多项式数量的门和量子比特制备具有固定齿数的梳形不等式的均匀叠加态。分离算法随后使用Grover-Mixer量子交替算子Ansatz搜索违反的不等式。研究提供了混合器酉算子、完整问题哈密顿量的显式电路构造和资源分析，为解决旅行商问题提供了新的量子计算方法。
authors: Yohan Finet, Victor Drouin-Touchette

articles.title: Study of localization properties under subsystem periodic driving
articles.title_zh: 子系统周期性驱动下局域化特性的研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33189v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Periodic driving provides a powerful route for controlling localization and engineering effective Hamiltonians in quantum systems. A localized one-dimensional Aubry-André chain can be driven into a fully delocalized phase when the entire system is driven below a critical frequency. Here, we ask whether such delocalization can be achieved by driving only a part of the system. We address this question using a two-leg ladder comprising an Aubry-André chain coupled to a periodically driven clean tight-binding chain. Exact numerical calculations show that, starting from a localized static ladder, subsystem driving below a critical frequency cannot achieve complete delocalization. Instead, a mixed phase emerges, with localized and delocalized states coexisting and the fraction of delocalized states varying nonmonotonically with the driving frequency. This behavior can be understood using local effective Hamiltonians. Although these effective Hamiltonians are derived analytically in the high-frequency regime, they can nevertheless predict the localization transition occurring in the moderate-frequency regime. In fact, by quantifying the emergent nonlocality of the Floquet Hamiltonian, we show that these effective Hamiltonians provide a valid description up to a crossover frequency that is lower than the critical frequency associated with the localization transition. Our results demonstrate an alternative route to Floquet engineering, in which the transport properties of a quantum lattice system can be modified by driving only a subsystem.
articles.abstract_zh: 周期性驱动是控制量子系统局域化和设计有效哈密顿量的有力途径。本文研究了仅驱动系统一部分是否能实现完全去局域化的问题，通过一个由Aubry-André链与周期性驱动的紧束缚链耦合组成的双腿梯子模型进行探讨。精确数值计算表明，子系统驱动在低于临界频率时无法实现完全去局域化，而是出现局域态和去局域态共存的混合相。这种行为可以通过局部有效哈密顿量来理解和预测。
authors: Arpita Goswami, Ranjan Modak, Shaon Sahoo

articles.title: Quantum-Relativistic Anomalous Proper Time
articles.title_zh: 量子相对论反常本征时
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33220v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate surprising consequences of the hypothesis that gravity and proper time obey the quantum superposition principle. We show that, for a massive body prepared in a superposition of two positions and post-selected in a suitable final state, the elapsed proper time in another region of space can assume an anomalous effective value lying outside the range allowed by classical general relativity. Remarkably, the effective elapsed proper time can even become negative, corresponding to an effective evolution backward in time. We also propose an experiment to observe an anomalous effective proper time associated with the internal degrees of freedom of a quantum particle in an interferometer under Earth's gravitational field. The proposed experiment is, in principle, feasible with current technology, and its realization could provide the first experimental evidence of an interplay between quantum mechanics and general relativity beyond the effects of the Newtonian potential in flat spacetime.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了引力和本征时服从量子叠加原理的假设所带来的惊人后果。研究表明，对于处于两个位置叠加态并经过适当末态后选择的宏观物体，在另一空间区域的本征时可以呈现出超出经典广义相对论允许范围的反常有效值，甚至可能为负值。作者还提出了一项实验，以在地球引力场下的干涉仪中观测与量子粒子内部自由度相关的反常有效本征时。该实验原则上可通过现有技术实现，有望提供量子力学与广义相对论相互作用的首次实验证据。
authors: Pablo L. Saldanha, Nelson Yokomizo

articles.title: Variational Quantum Optimization of Noisy Polarization Qubit Experiments
articles.title_zh: 噪声极化量子比特实验的变分量子优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33290v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum networking enables advanced communication protocols, distributed quantum computing, and enhanced sensing. These applications are often hindered by current realizations of quantum network nodes, which utilize noisy and imperfect hardware. Here, we apply variational optimization to counteract the effects of such imperfections. We parameterize network protocols for use with variational methods and then use these methods to optimize simple prepare-and-measure protocols on an optical testbed as a proof-of-principle demonstration. We demonstrate automated polarization compensation, achieving results comparable to conventional methods. We also analyze the effects of hardware imperfections and dark counts on the performance of our optimizations. We compare the performance of various gradient estimation methods and propose natural extensions, including further improvements through the use of global optimization and hybrid gradient estimation methods, as well as the application of variational optimization to nodes deployed on fiber networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子网络应用常受限于噪声和不完善的硬件。本文应用变分优化来抵消这些缺陷的影响，将网络协议参数化以用于变分方法，并在光学测试台上优化简单的制备-测量协议作为原理验证。研究展示了自动极化补偿，取得了与传统方法相当的结果。此外，还分析了硬件缺陷和暗计数对优化性能的影响，并提出了进一步的扩展方案，为提升量子网络性能提供了实用方法。
authors: Timur Javid, Brian Doolittle, Colin P. Lualdi, Brittany Conner, Michael Vayninger, Eric Chitambar, Paul G. Kwiat

articles.title: Twirled and swirled worlds: a compositional approach
articles.title_zh: 旋转与涡旋世界：一种组合方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33294v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Twirled and swirled worlds describe generalised probabilistic theories (GPTs) restricted by symmetry-imposed superselection rules. We extend these constructions to a fully compositional setting for finite-dimensional GPTs and compact groups, treating states, effects, and multipartite transformations uniformly as processes. We distinguish system actions from process-space actions. We define actions on a theory as a whole by requiring the corresponding process-space actions to respect sequential and parallel composition. Averaging physical theory actions defines twirling, while averaging nonphysical theory actions defines swirling. We show that invariant subtheories might not satisfy process tomography, and establish conditions under which they do, involving invariant dynamically faithful states or internal classical reference frames. For locally tomographic parent theories, we prove that every theory symmetry admits a representation by linear system actions and that the invariant subtheory satisfies process tomography. An invariant multipartite process space fails local tomography if and only if some bipartition has sides sharing a non-trivial irreducible representation. We characterise when ancillary systems are necessary, which representations they must carry, and when entanglement is required for ancilla-free process tomography. We develop a framework for unifying twirled subtheories and extend incoherent simulations to compact groups. Finally, we recover bilocal classical theory as a twirled subtheory of classical theory and real quantum theory as a swirled subtheory of complex quantum theory, deriving their tomographic properties from their representation structure.
articles.abstract_zh: “旋转世界”和“涡旋世界”描述了受对称性超选择规则限制的广义概率理论（GPTs）。本文将这些构造扩展到有限维GPTs和紧群的完全组合设置中，将态、效应和多体变换统一视为过程。研究区分了系统作用和过程空间作用，并通过要求相应的过程空间作用尊重顺序和并行组合来定义对整个理论的作用。研究还证明了不变子理论可能不满足过程层析成像，并建立了满足条件，深化了对GPTs对称性的理解。
authors: Sina Soltani, Thomas D. Galley, Marco Erba, John H. Selby

articles.title: Junction Hook Errors in the Color Code
articles.title_zh: 颜色码中的结钩错误
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33347v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Color-dependent syndrome extraction schedules have been proposed to mitigate hook errors in the triangular color code. Recent work by Kishony and Fowler (arXiv:2603.28852) identifies distance-reducing hook errors by the type of anyon for which they provide a shortcut and chooses the CNOT ordering for stabilizers of each color to avoid these errors. We identify an additional class of distance-reducing hooks, which we call junction hook errors, that is not captured by this classification. The two data qubits of a junction hook error terminate anyon strings of two different colors at the point where the three colored strings of a logical operator meet, which we call the junction. As such, the hook error does not correspond to a single type of anyon, yet it still reduces the distance. For distances d=7,9,11, we verify that every non-corner plaquette admits a scheduled hook error that, together with d-2 single data qubit faults, produces an undetectable logical error using d-1 faults. Each of these is a junction hook error. Because of this, every stabilizer, including those in the bulk, still requires additional protection from hook errors (such as flag qubits) to restore the full circuit-level distance with this schedule. A minimum weight logical operator has at most one junction, however, so junction hook errors cannot accumulate on one minimum weight logical operator in the way that single-color malign hook errors can. This helps explain why the schedule still improves the circuit-level distance to d-łfloor (d+3)/6f̊loor, rather than the d/2 distance associated with spatially uniform color code scheduling.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在三角颜色码中识别出一种新的距离缩减钩错误，称之为“结钩错误”，它未被现有分类捕获。结钩错误涉及两个数据量子比特，它们在逻辑算符的三色弦交汇处终止不同颜色的任意子弦。研究发现，即使是体内的稳定子也需要额外的保护，因为这些错误可能导致不可检测的逻辑错误。
authors: Salahedeen Issa, Margaret Martonosi

articles.title: Semiclassical dynamics of higher-order squeezing: self-adjoint extensions and coherent returns
articles.title_zh: 高阶挤压的半经典动力学：自伴随扩展与相干返回
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33378v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Higher-order squeezing Hamiltonians have several self-adjoint realizations, while their classical trajectories reach infinity in finite time. We relate these extension problems through boundary amplitudes and the semiclassical propagation of coherent states. A discrete Fourier transformation gives the sink-to-source ray matrix of each quantum realization. After the first passage through infinity, the full Husimi probability measure converges to point masses on outgoing classical branches, with weights equal to the squared moduli of the matrix entries. The proof combines finite-order approximate tail solutions satisfying the exact extension boundary condition with full-norm Gaussian matching and a square-summable residual estimate. For positive energy, we determine the limit after any fixed number of passages: amplitudes evolve by powers of the unitary ray matrix, not by iterations of its squared-modulus matrix. We also realize these limits by concentrated complex amplitudes for an energy-preserving Liouville extension, distinguishing deterministic classical gluings from coherent boundary mixing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了高阶挤压哈密顿量的半经典动力学，其中经典轨迹在有限时间内达到无穷远。研究通过边界振幅和相干态的半经典传播，将自伴随扩展问题联系起来。离散傅里叶变换给出了每个量子实现的源到汇射线矩阵，并揭示了确定性经典连接与相干边界混合之间的区别。
authors: A. E. Teretenkov

articles.title: Decision-aware validation of zero-noise extrapolation in QAOA optimization landscapes
articles.title_zh: QAOA优化景观中零噪声外推的决策感知验证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33386v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Zero-noise extrapolation (ZNE) is usually validated by the accuracy of mitigated observables, yet variational quantum optimization uses those observables to select parameters. We ask whether, and by how much, an accuracy gain from ZNE coincides with a worse decision. In depth-one simulations of the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) for MaxCut on four to six qubits, each sampled 120×120 landscape yields both its mean-squared error (MSE) and the ideal regret of its selected grid minimum, comparing Richardson orders one to three with unmitigated estimation at the same total shot budget per grid point. In an exploratory screen of 675 conditions, whose per-point random seeds collide, a familywise (Holm) analysis retains only four of 540 replication conditions as showing both directional MSE improvement and regret increase. A frozen confirmation with 100 fresh paired repetitions per condition reproduces all four: median MSE improvements of 7.65-73.09% accompany median normalized regret increases of only 0.0031-0.0073. We distinguish a bias route, in which residual bias reorders the mean landscape, from a variance route, in which Richardson weights amplify finite-shot noise. Exact first and second moments on a bounded control grid find no bias-route reversal: mitigated mean landscapes preserve the ideal minima, and ZNE can more than halve expected MSE, yet finite-shot selections incur higher mean regret. Decision losses that survive strict testing are few and small in this benchmark, but reproducible and not revealed by aggregate MSE. We present a paired benchmark and recommend reporting decision regret alongside estimation error when mitigation is assessed for optimization. Results concern simulated exhaustive grids, not hardware or optimizer loops.
articles.abstract_zh: 零噪声外推（ZNE）通常通过缓解观测量的准确性进行验证，但变分量子优化利用这些观测量来选择参数。本研究探讨了ZNE带来的准确性提升是否会导致更差的决策。通过对MaxCut问题的量子近似优化算法（QAOA）进行模拟，发现ZNE在提高均方误差（MSE）的同时，可能伴随着决策遗憾的轻微增加。
authors: Vicenzo Scavino Alfaro

articles.title: Exact operator bounds on Leggett-Garg violations
articles.title_zh: Leggett-Garg违规的精确算子界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33429v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Leggett-Garg (LG) inequalities test whether correlations measured at different times admit a positive joint probability distribution over histories. A violation requires negative values in any joint quasiprobability distribution reproducing those correlations, but such distributions can have negative values even without a violation. Spacetime density kernels extend the density-matrix description to multiple times and are used to study timelike entanglement. We establish a universal bound that relates LG violations to their negative eigenvalue weight. For LG tests involving any number of measurements, we determine the least compatible kernel negativity through an exact relation valid for any system dimension, initial state, dynamics, or measurement rule. This minimum is nonzero if and only if at least one LG inequality is violated. Three-time Lüders LG tests certify at most one eighth of negativity, whereas measurements resolving individual spin levels can approach one half. Including additional incompatible qubit observables gives a further exact minimum that can exceed the LG-only ceiling without increasing the LG violation.
articles.abstract_zh: Leggett-Garg (LG) 不等式用于检验不同时间测量的关联是否允许正的联合概率分布。本研究建立了LG违规与其负特征值权重之间的普适界限，并为涉及任意数量测量的LG测试确定了最小兼容核负性。该最小值仅在至少一个LG不等式被违反时非零，且包含额外不兼容的量子比特可观测值可以提供超出LG上限的进一步精确最小值。
authors: Rathindra Nath Das, Arnab Kundu, Nemai Chandra Sarkar

articles.title: Designing Quantum Solutions to the Closest String Problem with the Non-Variational QWOA
articles.title_zh: 使用非变分QWOA设计最近字符串问题的量子解决方案
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33532v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum computing offers promising approaches to combinatorial optimization problems whose search spaces grow exponentially with problem size. The Closest String problem belongs to this category, which seeks a string that minimizes the maximum Hamming distance to any string in a given collection of reference strings. In this work, we present an end-to-end quantum implementation of the Closest String problem using the Non-Variational Quantum Walk Optimization Algorithm (NV-QWOA), evaluating its resource requirements and solution amplification capabilities. Our automated workflow converts arbitrary problem instances into quantum circuits expressed in one- or two-qubit gates that encode candidate solutions, evaluate the objective function, and apply NV-QWOA optimisation to increase the measurement probabilities of high-quality solutions. Analytical resource estimates yield a qubit complexity of O(nmłog k) and a circuit depth of O(pmłog² n + pnłog n), where n is the string length, m is the number of reference strings, k is the alphabet size, and p is the number of NV-QWOA iterations. We introduce a revised prescription for the phase-separation parameter, γ, that depends on problem size but requires no instance-specific optimization. This prescription mitigates excessive phase wrapping modulo 2π, which can weaken the relationship between objective values and the phases guiding the optimization dynamics. Across all simulated problem sizes, the algorithm consistently amplifies optimal and near-optimal candidates. This work provides an explicit gate-level implementation, an improved phase-scaling method, and a foundation for hardware experiments and benchmarking against classical algorithms.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种使用非变分量子行走优化算法（NV-QWOA）解决最近字符串问题的端到端量子实现方案。该方案将任意问题实例转换为量子电路，用于编码候选解、评估目标函数并应用NV-QWOA优化以提高高质量解的测量概率。分析资源估算表明，其量子比特复杂度为O(nm log k)，电路深度为O(pm log² n + pn log n)。
authors: Benjamin Rossdeutscher, Jingbo Wang

articles.title: Krylov geometry and optimal recovery under uncertain coherent noise
articles.title_zh: Krylov几何与不确定相干噪声下的最优恢复
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33607v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recovery from a coherent rotation with an unobserved angle depends on both the encoding and what calibration reveals about the noise. We determine their combined limit for a known finite-dimensional generator and one final recovery. Two polynomial projections organize the answer. A physical Krylov chain separates correctable error amplitudes from their first state-dependent distortion; projection onto lower-angle powers identifies the part that a coherent decoder can cancel. Under explicit rank and moment conditions, their combination gives the exact leading optimal entanglement infidelity at weak noise and a recovery attaining it for any finite logical dimension. The optimal worst-input error lies between one and d times that infidelity at leading order, for logical dimension d. When the angle distribution is unknown, we optimize one decoder for every distribution compatible with the calibration. When spectral and calibration frequencies are integer multiples of a common frequency, moment positivity turns this into an exact finite optimization. Small measured means can still allow rare finite rotations. articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在存在未观测角度的相干旋转噪声下，量子信息的最优恢复问题。研究通过Krylov几何和多项式投影，确定了编码和噪声校准对恢复的综合限制。在弱噪声条件下，给出了精确的领先最优纠缠失真度，并设计了达到该失真度的恢复方案。当角度分布未知时，研究针对与校准兼容的每种分布优化了解码器。
authors: Abhishek Chowdhury

articles.title: Path-Distinguishability Gaps at Fixed Visibility in Noisy Qubit Interferometers
articles.title_zh: 噪声量子比特干涉仪中固定可见度下的路径可区分性间隙
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33632v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The wave--particle duality relation bounds visibility and path distinguishability but does not determine their attainable values in a fixed noisy interferometer. We characterize the complete attainable region for a two-path interferometer with a qubit marker, varying the marker input while fixing the source, preparation channel, path-dependent interaction, and subsequent marker channel. At each feasible fringe visibility, the Helstrom-optimal distinguishabilities form at most two closed intervals, which can be separated by a gap. The intervals arise from opposite axial marker polarizations with the same fringe-amplitude modulus. Fixing the complex fringe amplitude instead gives a connected interval; for balanced original-path discrimination, a gap requires nonunital marker preparation. For a balanced pure source, relative π rotations, and no subsequent marker noise, we obtain a necessary and sufficient geometric criterion for a gap under some rotation axis perpendicular to the preparation displacement. Explicit channels and a time-independent Lindblad realization show how the gap depends on preparation geometry and evolution, with exact onset and optimization formulas at fixed fractional visibility. We also give sufficient bounds for excluding distinguishability intervals under calibrated finite-resolution errors.
articles.abstract_zh: 波粒二象性关系限制了可见度和路径可区分性，但并未确定其在固定噪声干涉仪中的可达值。本研究刻画了带有量子比特标记器的双路径干涉仪的完整可达区域，发现在每个可行的条纹可见度下，Helstrom最优可区分性形成至多两个闭合区间，这些区间可能被间隙隔开。研究还为在特定条件下出现间隙提供了必要和充分的几何判据。
authors: Mohd Asad Siddiqui

articles.title: Task-Directed Spectral Design for Local Quantum Tomography
articles.title_zh: 任务导向的局部量子层析光谱设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33723v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many tomography tasks require only a low-dimensional function of the state. We study local pure-state tomography under projective-fidelity access when a parametric model, a credible center, and a differentiable downstream task are known before acquisition. The pullback Fubini--Study metric and the task metric define coordinate-invariant generalized eigendirections, which we realize as a fixed library of geodesic fidelity probes. We prove two optimality results: the probe aligned with a task coordinate is its unique variance-minimizing location up to orientation, and, when prior and measurement information are diagonal in this basis, a diminishing-return greedy rule exactly minimizes the integer-budget local task-variance surrogate over the spectral library. Under common per-shot information and the stated large-budget condition, the absolute and relative gaps to arbitrary probe directions are respectively (O(B⁻³)) and (O(B⁻²)). A closed-form local estimator is followed by a task-metric localization projection that cannot increase quadratic task loss when localization holds. In six-qubit numerical experiments, the Schmidt-spectrum design activates only one or two settings and has lower mean task error than the post hoc best adaptive results across all tested dimensions and copy budgets. For full-state tomography, it likewise has lower mean infidelity throughout the tested local regime. The fixed batch uses no feedback loops and far fewer settings; under the illustrative latency model, its acquisition cost is roughly three to four orders of magnitude lower than that of the adaptive methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 许多层析成像任务仅需状态的低维函数。本研究在已知参数模型、可信中心和可微分下游任务的情况下，探讨了投影保真度访问下的局部纯态层析成像。研究定义了坐标不变的广义特征方向，并证明了与任务坐标对齐的探针是其唯一的方差最小化位置。在六量子比特数值实验中，Schmidt谱设计展示了其有效性。
authors: Guy Hay, Nir Sharon

articles.title: Induced Bell-CHSH observables in the Fewster-Verch measurement scheme
articles.title_zh: Fewster-Verch测量方案中诱导的Bell-CHSH可观测值
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33773v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Summers-Werner theorem shows that the vacuum of a relativistic quantum field theory violates the Bell-CHSH inequality maximally on complementary wedges, but it is an existence statement: it exhibits neither the observables nor an apparatus that measures them. We give an explicit operator-level realization within the Fewster-Verch measurement framework, obtaining dichotomic Bell observables of a free Majorana field in 1+1 dimensions as observables induced by local couplings to Majorana probes. The induced system smearing factorizes exactly as fₕ₌ₖ,błₐₘbdₐ,ₕ, so its support is controlled by the compactly supported coupling profile k; dichotomy is imposed by calibrating and normalizing the induced smearings rather than required of the probe observable; and a probe-only normal ordering yields the product of Alice's and Bob's induced bilinears, which the non-multiplicative induced map alone does not provide. Under explicit attainability hypotheses the induced observables saturate the Tsirelson bound in a state prepared from the vacuum. The construction extends to coupled scalar fields.
articles.abstract_zh: Summers-Werner定理指出相对论量子场论的真空在互补楔形区域最大程度地违反Bell-CHSH不等式，但未给出具体的观测值或测量装置。本研究在Fewster-Verch测量框架内，通过局部耦合到Majorana探针，给出了1+1维自由Majorana场的二分Bell可观测值的显式算子级实现。研究表明，在特定可达性假设下，这些诱导可观测值在从真空制备的状态中达到了Tsirelson界限。
authors: M. S. Guimaraes, I. Roditi, S. P. Sorella

articles.title: Initial-State Preparation for Strongly Correlated Molecules from Matrix Product States: Benchmarking and Environment-Aware Divide-and-Conquer Compilation
articles.title_zh: 基于矩阵乘积态的强关联分子初始态制备：基准测试与环境感知分治编译
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33834v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Compiling classically optimized matrix product states (MPSs) into quantum circuits is a promising route to initial-state preparation for strongly correlated molecules, but the accuracy, gate cost, and classical scalability of existing MPS compilation methods have not been systematically assessed. Here, we benchmark representative analytical, variational, and hybrid MPS compilation methods for strongly correlated systems including hydrogen chains and iron-sulfur clusters. We compare state infidelity, CNOT gate count, classical runtime, and parallel scalability across different system sizes and bond dimensions. We also introduce a divide-and-conquer environment-aware compilation algorithm (DCE), which optimizes each local isometry approximation according to its contribution to the prepared-state fidelity. The results reveal complementary operating regimes: direct variational compilation methods are gate-efficient for some smaller molecular systems with O(10) qubits and O(10) bond dimensions or moderate accuracy targets with infidelity of order 10⁻¹, whereas divide-and-conquer methods scale more favorably for larger systems and relatively higher bond dimensions of O(10-10²⁾, particularly when target infidelities below 10⁻¹ are required. Within the latter family, environment-aware optimization improves accuracy over unitary-distance-based compilation while retaining task-level parallelism. For the FeMo-cofactor (FeMoco), we find the DCE algorithm together with the MPS obtained in the entanglement-minimized orbitals (EMOs) provides a resource-efficient route to initial-state preparation. Our results provide practical guidance for selecting and developing MPS compilation methods for strongly correlated molecular simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 将经典优化的矩阵乘积态（MPS）编译成量子电路是制备强关联分子初始态的有前景途径。本研究对分析、变分和混合MPS编译方法进行了基准测试，比较了它们在强关联系统中的性能。研究还引入了一种分治环境感知编译算法（DCE），根据局部等距近似对制备态保真度的贡献进行优化，揭示了不同方法在不同系统规模和精度目标下的互补操作区域。
authors: Haiqi Liu, Longfei Chang, Zhendong Li, Wei-Hai Fang

articles.title: Helstrom geometry with time-dependent spectral calibration
articles.title_zh: 具有时变谱校准的Helstrom几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33848v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In a recent work we introduced a finite scalar-qubit-scalar spectral triple whose Connes distance reproduces the Bloch-ball trace metric up to a factor 2/Łambda, where Łambda²⁼μ_L²⁺μ_R² for isotropic link strengths μ_L,μ_R appearing in the proposed Dirac operator. Here we analyse time-dependent variation of these links, independent of the qubit dynamics. In doing so, we separate the distinguishability and calibration contributions to the spectral rate. A depolarizing example demonstrates spectral growth despite a monotonic contraction of the trace-distance. More generally, we characterize the admissible trace-distance histories compatible with a given positive spectral record and exhibit contracting and reviving realizations. At fixed Łambda, we also study a sinusoidal link imbalance that preserves the Dirac spectrum and qubit metric, while the scalar-scalar distance oscillates with half the period of the imbalance.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文分析了Helstrom几何中时变连接强度的影响，这些变化独立于量子比特动力学。研究将可区分性和校准对谱速率的贡献分离，并通过一个去极化示例展示了尽管迹距离单调收缩，谱仍可能增长。更普遍地，研究刻画了与给定正谱记录兼容的允许迹距离历史，并展示了收缩和复苏的实现。
authors: Kaushlendra Kumar

articles.title: Resource-Optimal Screening for Two-Tier Quantum System Characterization
articles.title_zh: 两层量子系统表征的资源最优筛选
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34003v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum processing units (QPUs) require frequent benchmarking to track hardware drift, yet standard protocols such as randomized benchmarking are resource-intensive and compete with application workloads for scarce QPU time. We present a resource-optimal screening strategy that combines a two-tier, risk-based testing architecture with optimal experiment design: a lightweight screening probe runs regularly and triggers expensive full characterization only when statistically significant change is detected, while the probe itself is designed to maximize detection sensitivity under explicit resource constraints. For an exponential fidelity model, we derive closed-form optimal circuit sizes and introduce an effective gate count that renders the analysis hardware-independent. We instantiate the strategy for two applications. For gate-quality verification, we show that optimally designed screening probes outperform randomized benchmarking with optimal experimental design (OED) by more than 4× in detection rate at equal resource cost. For compiler benchmarking, we formalize compiler comparison as a paired hypothesis test and derive the optimal circuit size for distinguishing compilation strategies. Despite their different observables and test statistics, both applications yield structurally the same closed-form expression for the optimal probe circuit size as a function of gate fidelity, illustrating the generality of the framework. Numerical and hardware experiments on QPUs (Rigetti Ankaa-3, IQM Garnet, IQM Emerald) confirm the theoretical predictions, with observed optimal circuit sizes matching the derived values across all devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子处理单元（QPU）需要频繁基准测试以追踪硬件漂移，但现有协议资源密集。本研究提出了一种资源最优的筛选策略，结合了两层、基于风险的测试架构和最优实验设计。该策略通过轻量级筛选探针定期运行，仅在检测到统计显著变化时触发昂贵的全面表征。研究为门质量验证和编译器基准测试实例化了该策略，并展示了其在检测率上优于随机基准测试的显著优势。
authors: Yi-Ting Chen, Aniket S. Dalvi, Nils Quetschlich

articles.title: Quantum neuroplastic learning for time-series processing
articles.title_zh: 量子神经可塑性学习用于时间序列处理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34055v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum machine learning uses quantum states and dynamics to represent and process data. In quantum reservoir computing, the physical system is typically fixed and a classical readout is trained. Inspired by the formation, strengthening and pruning of synapses during biological learning, we propose quantum neuroplastic learning (QNL), which reorganizes the couplings among the qubits of a quantum reservoir, much as experience rewires connections among neurons. Eligibility traces guide local edits to couplings, fields, gate angles and evolution time, and an edit is retained when a statistical bound on its improvement exceeds a complexity cost. We evaluate QNL under restarting and online monitored protocols on short- and long-term memory, nonlinear autoregressive processing and forecasting, and channel equalization tasks. In simulation, QNL enhances memory capacity, develops long-term recall and sustains adaptation across multiple tasks, with the largest benefit for tasks that require extended memory. On the IBM superconducting processor textttibm_fez, with six seven-qubit reservoirs running in parallel on 42 qubits (1.28 million shots in total), configurations learned in simulation and frozen before execution reduced the channel-equalization symbol error rate from 9.7% to 2.2% and achieved a lower error rate than a matched-budget tuned baseline.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种量子神经可塑性学习（QNL）方法，灵感来源于生物学习中突触的形成和重组，旨在通过重新组织量子储备池中量子比特间的耦合来处理时间序列数据。该方法利用资格迹线指导对耦合、场、门角度和演化时间的局部修改，并在改进超过复杂性成本时保留这些修改。模拟结果表明，QNL显著增强了记忆容量，发展了长期记忆，并能适应多项任务，尤其在需要扩展记忆的任务中表现出最大优势。
authors: Mostafizur Rahaman Laskar

articles.title: Two exact quantum queries use at most six variables
articles.title_zh: 两次精确量子查询最多使用六个变量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34079v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We give a direct analytic proof that every total Boolean function computable exactly with at most two quantum queries depends on at most six input variables. This bound is sharp. A previous derivation relied on a numerical classification of Boolean functions on at most four variables; to the best of our knowledge, ours is the first unconditional proof. The main difficulty beyond the one-query case is that query-path vectors need not be mutually orthogonal, so interference prevents the scalar weight-counting argument from applying. We overcome this difficulty by establishing a rigid support-and-branch decomposition: after the coordinates in the first-query support are fixed, the second query induces a family of exact one-query branches. This structural description may be of independent interest.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提供了一个直接的分析证明，表明任何通过最多两次精确量子查询可计算的布尔函数最多依赖于六个输入变量，并且该界限是精确的。与之前依赖数值分类的方法不同，这是首次无条件证明。为克服查询路径向量非正交带来的干扰难题，作者建立了一种刚性支撑-分支分解结构，该结构本身可能具有独立的研究价值。
authors: Yaqiao Li

articles.title: Feasibility of Distributed Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing: From Quantum Links to Algorithms
articles.title_zh: 分布式容错量子计算的可行性：从量子链路到算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34143v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Practical fault-tolerant quantum computation requires a large number of physical qubits, posing a major challenge for scaling up individual quantum processors. Distributed architectures offer a promising solution by interconnecting multiple processors through quantum networks. However, remote Bell-pair generation remains technically demanding, making it essential to assess computational performance under limited communication resources. In this work, we present a comprehensive resource analysis of distributed fault-tolerant quantum computation using superconducting processors connected by microwave or optical links. We show that even a single physical communication channel per node can substantially reduce the physical-qubit requirements per node under experimentally motivated, forward-looking microwave-link assumptions of a 1 MHz physical Bell-pair generation rate and 90% fidelity, although at the cost of a roughly tenfold increase in execution time. Conversely, reducing the execution-time overhead requires substantially greater communication resources, including higher Bell-pair fidelities and extensive multiplexing. These results demonstrate the potential feasibility of distributed fault-tolerant quantum computation with limited communication resources and provide a quantitative basis for balancing quantum-link performance, processor size, and execution time.
articles.abstract_zh: 实际的容错量子计算需要大量物理量子比特，分布式架构通过量子网络互连多个处理器，提供了一种有前景的解决方案。本文全面分析了使用微波或光学链路连接的超导处理器进行分布式容错量子计算所需的资源。研究表明，即使每个节点只有一个物理通信通道，在实验驱动的微波链路假设下，也能显著减少每个节点的物理量子比特需求，但代价是执行时间增加约十倍。若要减少执行时间开销，则需要更多的通信资源，包括更高的贝尔对保真度和广泛的多路复用技术。
authors: Takumi Kobayashi, Hodaka Kurokawa, Yasunari Suzuki, Hideo Kosaka

articles.title: Two-qubit binegativity can increase under local amplitude damping
articles.title_zh: 局部振幅阻尼下双量子比特双负性可能增加
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34322v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: It has been conjectured that the binegativity of two-qubit states is an entanglement monotone. We present a full-rank state as a counterexample: applying amplitude damping to only one of the qubits can increase the binegativity of the state. The output state remains full rank, and the amount of increase can be calculated exactly. In addition, we construct a family of counterexamples that vary continuously with a parameter. In the corresponding one-way local operations and classical communication protocol, the probability-weighted average of the binegativity over the branches after the local measurement is also higher than that of the initial state.
articles.abstract_zh: 曾有猜想认为双量子比特态的双负性是一种纠缠单调量。本文提出了一个全秩态作为反例，证明了仅对其中一个量子比特施加振幅阻尼操作，可以增加该态的双负性，且输出态仍保持全秩。此外，作者还构建了一个随参数连续变化的系列反例，并发现相应单向局部操作和经典通信协议中，局部测量后各分支双负性的概率加权平均值也高于初始态。
authors: Xiao-Lan Zong, Wei Song, Ming Yang

articles.title: A Reduction Bound for Entanglement Detection by Positive Free Maps
articles.title_zh: 正自由映射纠缠检测的约化界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34338v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Collins, Hayden, and Nechita used free probability to construct families of k-positive but not (k+1)-positive maps and applied them to entanglement detection. We prove that positive free maps associated with compactly supported freely infinitely divisible distributions are no stronger than the reduction criterion in every ancillary dimension. In particular, these maps cannot detect positive partial transpose entanglement. The proof combines a joint Fock realization with an operator positivity certificate derived from free Lévy data.
articles.abstract_zh: Collins、Hayden和Nechita曾利用自由概率构建了k-正但非(k+1)-正映射族并将其应用于纠缠检测。本文证明了与紧支集自由无限可分分布相关的正自由映射，在任何辅助维度下都不比约化判据更强。这意味着这些映射无法检测到正部分转置纠缠。该证明结合了联合Fock实现和从自由Lévy数据导出的算子正性判据。
authors: Chin-Yen Lee

articles.title: Pauli-ball discrepancy and stability of quantum codes
articles.title_zh: Pauli球差异与量子码的稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34399v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Pauli-ball discrepancy, a quadratic discrepancy summed over all error radii, measures how uniformly the Pauli error images of a K-dimensional quantum code cover the d-dimensional Hilbert space. At parameters attaining equality in the quantum Singleton bound with minimum code distance ≥3, or in the one-error Hamming bound with prime-power local dimension, the discrepancy of every projector of the prescribed rank equals an explicit benchmark plus an exact nonnegative remainder, which vanishes precisely for pure quantum maximum-distance-separable codes and nondegenerate perfect codes, respectively. For a Pauli ball of radius e below half the target distance and size Vₑ, this remainder linearly bounds the squared Hilbert--Schmidt distance of the error-image Gram matrix from the identity. When KVₑłeq d, it linearly bounds the diamond error and entanglement infidelity of a noise-independent polar recovery under any noise in that ball's span. For five qubits, we obtain the sharp rank-two Gram constant and exact logical channels of rotated codes attaining this linear order in diamond error. For pure states, the discrepancy equals a pure-state benchmark plus a positive weighted sum of marginal-purity defects, so absolutely maximally entangled states, when they exist, are exactly the minimizers.
articles.abstract_zh: Pauli球差异是一种衡量K维量子码的Pauli误差图像覆盖d维希尔伯特空间均匀性的二次差异。在满足量子Singleton界限或单误差Hamming界限的参数下，指定秩的每个投影仪的差异等于一个明确的基准加上一个精确的非负余项，该余项对于纯量子最大距离可分离码和非退化完美码恰好为零。该余项线性地限制了误差图像Gram矩阵与单位矩阵的平方Hilbert-Schmidt距离，并在线性范围内限制了金刚石误差和纠缠失真。
authors: Aryeh Lev Zabokritskiy "Yohananov"

articles.title: Bosonic Loss Codes with Bounded Occupation
articles.title_zh: 具有有界占据数的玻色子损耗码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34411v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study Fock-state codes on q bosonic modes, with total excitation N and at most B excitations per mode, that exactly correct every pattern of at most δ N photon losses, for q proportional to N. For every fixed cap B and every ratio q/N>1/B, we prove explicit achievable rates, positive for all sufficiently small δ>0, in logical qubits per excitation. At B=2 and q=N, the rate is positive for every δ<0.1355 and is about 0.281 at δ=0.1, compared with the previously established exact-code qutrit rate of about 0.275. We also give an explicit upper bound on the dimension of every such exact code, including degenerate codes. For the pure-loss channel truncated to at most δ N losses and renormalized, we obtain approximate codes with exponentially small worst-case error. When the loss probability is positive and at most 1/(B+1), they improve our positive exact-code rate bounds; at B=2, q=N, and loss probability 0.1, they remain positive up to δapprox0.158.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在q个玻色子模式上，总激发数为N且每个模式最多B个激发的Fock态码，这些码能精确纠正最多δN个光子损耗的任何模式。对于固定的B和q/N>1/B的比例，作者证明了可实现的逻辑量子比特/激发速率，在足够小的δ>0时为正。在B=2和q=N时，该速率在δ<0.1355时为正，并在δ=0.1时约为0.281。此外，本文还给出了此类精确码（包括退化码）维度的显式上限，并为纯损耗信道获得了具有指数级小最坏情况误差的近似码。
authors: Avraham Kreindel (Yohananov), Aryeh Lev Zabokritskiy (Yohananov)

articles.title: Emergent Recursive Kernels in Quantum Reservoir Computing
articles.title_zh: 量子储备池计算中涌现的递归核
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34430v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Learning with a quantum reservoir can be far simpler than simulating its dynamics. We show that a quantum reservoir governed by a fixed evolution, consisting of an input coupling followed by an independently sampled Haar unitary, admits an exact recursive kernel in the large-dimension limit at fixed history length. Memory orthogonality and factorization of propagated overlaps reduce each kernel evaluation to a scalar recurrence, linear in history length and independent of reservoir size. We establish self-averaging around this limit and connect the kernel coefficients to out-of-time-ordered correlators. Our analysis of finite-dimensional effects shows that the computational simplicity of the Haar kernel does not come at the expense of expressive power. Moreover, we demonstrate how the kernel can be tuned for different learning tasks by adjusting properties such as memory retention and temporal interaction order. On the NARMA10 benchmark, the tuned kernel achieves lower prediction error than the tested Ising and Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev reservoirs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了量子储备池计算，发现由固定演化（输入耦合后接独立采样的Haar酉变换）控制的量子储备池，在固定历史长度的大维度极限下，存在一个精确的递归核。通过调整记忆保留和时间交互顺序等属性，该核可以针对不同的学习任务进行调优。在NARMA10基准测试中，调优后的核实现了比Ising和Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev储备池更低的预测误差，表明其计算简洁性并未牺牲表达能力。
authors: Ce Wang

articles.title: Ancilla-free optimal quantum adder
articles.title_zh: 无辅助比特的最优量子加法器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34446v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct an exact n-bit quantum adder with O(n) gates and O(łog n) depth that requires no ancillary qubits. The circuit uses only X, CNOT, and Toffoli gates under all-to-all connectivity and is classically reversible. Our construction accelerates the controlled ladder underlying addition. Grouping the data into blocks and use existing control qubits as conditional workspace gives a recursive construction with O(nłogłog n) gates and O(łog n) depth. We then coordinate inter-block propagation via two short-path forest operations to cut the per-block workspace requirement, yielding a nonrecursive implementation with O(n) gates. Both the gate count and circuit depth are asymptotically optimal.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个精确的n比特量子加法器，它无需辅助量子比特，并具有O(n)的门数量和O(log n)的深度。该电路仅使用X、CNOT和Toffoli门，在全连接条件下是经典可逆的。通过将数据分组并利用现有控制量子比特作为条件工作空间，作者首先给出了一个递归构造，然后通过协调块间传播，实现了O(n)门数量的非递归实现。该加法器的门数量和电路深度均达到渐近最优。
authors: Junhong Nie, Jialiang Tang, Xiaoming Sun, Wei Zi

articles.title: Path integral control in the complex plane
articles.title_zh: 复平面上的路径积分控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34483v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Path integral control is a stochastic optimal control framework that computes optimal policies as weighted averages over state trajectories. It was recently shown that, combined with stochastic quantum trajectories, the path integral control approach constitutes a promising alternative for quantum optimal control. In this work, we propose an extension of path integral control to the complex plane using circular complex Wiener processes. The change of measure is defined on the driving noise space under an exact control-noise matching condition, which also accommodates rank-deficient state diffusions. Applied to stochastic Schrödinger equations, the resulting formalism gives a compact treatment of paired non-Hermitian jump channels with unequal positive dissipation rates and yields cross-entropy-optimal feedback and open-loop control formulas.
articles.abstract_zh: 路径积分控制是一种随机最优控制框架，通过状态轨迹的加权平均计算最优策略。本文提出将路径积分控制扩展到复平面，利用圆形复维纳过程。在精确的控制-噪声匹配条件下，测度变换在驱动噪声空间上定义，并能适应秩亏缺的状态扩散。将该形式主义应用于随机薛定谔方程，可以紧凑地处理具有不等正耗散率的成对非厄米跳跃通道，并得到交叉熵最优的反馈和开环控制公式。
authors: Aarón Villanueva

articles.title: Real-Time Correlation of Relaxation, Dephasing, and Two-level System Dynamics in Transmon Qubits
articles.title_zh: Transmon量子比特中弛豫、退相干和双能级系统动力学的实时关联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34485v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Materials improvements in transmon qubits have yielded remarkable advances in qubit lifetimes (T1)and coherence times (T2). However, state-of-the-art superconducting qubits experience temporal fluctuations in their performance, which limit gate fidelities and quantum processor performance. We observe correlated increases in qubit relaxation and dephasing rates that last for minutes to hours, which we call T1 and T2 excursions. Using interleaved lifetime and coherence time measurements, noise spectroscopy, and two-level-system (TLS) spectroscopy, we find that these excursions are caused by single or few strongly-coupled TLS defects that spectrally diffuse into resonance with the qubit frequency. Our measurement protocol provides a powerful tool for understanding the noise sources that cause temporal fluctuations in superconducting qubit performance.
articles.abstract_zh: Transmon量子比特的材料改进显著提升了量子比特寿命（T1）和相干时间（T2），但其性能仍存在时间波动，限制了门保真度和处理器性能。本文观察到量子比特弛豫和退相干速率的关联性增加，持续数分钟至数小时，称之为T1和T2偏移。通过交错寿命和相干时间测量、噪声谱以及双能级系统（TLS）谱，研究发现这些偏移是由单个或少数强耦合TLS缺陷谱扩散到与量子比特频率共振引起的。该测量协议为理解导致超导量子比特性能时间波动的噪声源提供了有力工具。
authors: Ambrose Yang, Alexander M. Young, Paal H. Prestegaard, Atharv Joshi, Matthew S. Ai, Q. Rumman Rahman, Faranak Bahrami, Matthew P. Bland, Jui-Lin Niu, Ourania-Maria Glezakou-Elbert, Ray D. Chang, Jocelyn Liu, Zhengyi Lu, Robert J. Cava, Nathalie P. de Leon, Andrew A. Houck

articles.title: Wave Is All You Need: A Quantum Language Model Based on Fully Connected Quantum Boltzmann Machine
articles.title_zh: 波即所需：基于全连接量子玻尔兹曼机的量子语言模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34492v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work proposes a self-attention mechanism based on the fully connected quantum Boltzmann machine (FC-QBM), and further constructs a fully connected quantum Boltzmann machine language model (FC-QBM-LM) using the mechanism as the core engine. By performing unitary evolution on semantic quantum states, the mechanism implicitly implements positional encoding and self-attention computation, eliminating the need to decompose continuous semantic streams into discrete matrices for explicit matrix multiplication, with the measurement results naturally satisfying the normalization condition. Specifically, this work rigorously derives the computational principle of the self-attention mechanism based on FC-QBM, and demonstrates that this mechanism is mathematically equivalent to the classical self-attention mechanism. The mathematical principles governing the training and generation of FC-QBM-LM are thoroughly derived, and the two corresponding algorithms are subsequently developed. An 8-qubit FC-QBM-LM is finally constructed and trained on the corpus of Tang poetry. Under the 8-qubit setting, the quantum layer implements the entire positional encoding and self-attention computation pipeline with only 44 parameters. In the noiseless scenario, the model exhibits favorable convergence. Furthermore, the quantum circuit proposed in this work, which terminates with Y-axis rotation gates, achieves better convergence than the counterpart terminating with X-axis rotation gates. Under the small-sample regime and across eight distinct noise intensity levels, the model demonstrates strong noise robustness, retaining over 99% of its noiseless convergence performance. Experiments on five-character quatrain generation reveal that the model preliminarily exhibits three core capabilities: associative and divergent thinking, content generation across imagery and human-aligned word ordering.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于全连接量子玻尔兹曼机（FC-QBM）的自注意力机制，并以此为核心构建了FC-QBM语言模型（FC-QBM-LM）。该机制通过对语义量子态进行酉演化，隐式实现位置编码和自注意力计算，避免了将连续语义流分解为离散矩阵进行显式矩阵乘法。研究严格推导了该自注意力机制的计算原理，并证明其在数学上等价于经典自注意力机制。最终，作者构建了一个8量子比特的FC-QBM-LM，并在唐诗语料库上进行了训练。
authors: Jun Liu

articles.title: Model-Uncertainty-Aware Digital Twins for Non-Markovian Quantum Repeater Memories
articles.title_zh: 用于非马尔可夫量子中继器存储器的模型不确定性感知数字孪生
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34506v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum-repeater controllers need reliable estimates of stored entanglement as adjacent links are generated. Fixed exponential lifetimes miss non-Markovian revivals, while complex surrogates are unnecessary when the microscopic family is known. We present QMemTwin, a physics-constrained digital twin that accounts for model uncertainty. It calibrates a bank of contractive passive state-space models, combines their amplitudes with finite-sample-corrected Akaike weights, and abstains when temporal-holdout data indicate unsupported dynamics. Passivity guarantees a completely positive, trace-preserving amplitude-damping channel for each candidate and their convex amplitude average. We evaluate [N cases] synthetic memories: [N supported] supported passive time-invariant cases and [N structural] nonstationary structural-shift cases. In the matched one-pseudomode regime, the correctly specified one-pseudomode fit performs best. Across [N unknown] supported cases with uncertain families, QMemTwin reduces population RMSE by [population reduction]% and Bell-fidelity RMSE by [Bell reduction]% relative to the two-pseudomode model; both paired effects remain significant after Holm correction. The flexible passive model has a slightly lower mean error for unknown families but is statistically indistinguishable from QMemTwin and loses accuracy in the matched regime. The temporal-holdout gate detects [detection]% of structural shifts, with [false alarm]% false alarms on supported families and AUROC [AUC]. In 2-, 4-, and 8-link repeater chains, the mixed cohort shows no significant 8-link goodput gain. A predeclared high-backflow stress cohort yields an 8-link goodput gain of [goodput gain]% over the two-pseudomode model, with paired p = [p value]. These results favor using a known family when available, accounting for model uncertainty otherwise and abstaining on unsupported dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子中继器控制器需要可靠地估计存储的纠缠。本研究提出了QMemTwin，一个考虑模型不确定性的物理约束数字孪生系统，以解决固定指数寿命模型无法捕捉非马尔可夫复苏的问题。QMemTwin校准一系列收缩被动状态空间模型，并结合其振幅，在数据不支持时进行规避。实验结果表明，在不确定模型族的情况下，QMemTwin显著降低了均方根误差。
authors: Muhammad Waqas Haseeb

articles.title: Quantum Anomaly Detection in network traffic using Variational Quantum Classifiers
articles.title_zh: 使用变分量子分类器进行网络流量的量子异常检测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34635v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The increasingly complex cybersecurity landscape requires more advanced network anomaly detection systems. Although, classical machine learning models are known to be effective, they reach computational bottlenecks when processing high-dimensional data. This study investigates the potential of Quantum Machine Learning (QML) for network traffic anomaly detection by evaluating four distinct Variational Quantum Classifier (VQC) architectures. A synthetic network traffic dataset is generated for the evaluations. The VQC models systematically varied feature encoding methods, parameterized ansatz circuits, quantum neural network types, and classical optimizers. Experimental results show that a trade-off exists between circuit expressivity and optimization stability. Deeper circuits (VQC-4) achieved higher accuracy of upto 89.0%, while simultaneously being sensitive to training conditions. A shallower variant (VQC-1) under performed, although it had consistent and stable optimization curves. Class-dependent biases were also observed such as in VQC-2, where the model struggled to find an effective decision boundary, and produced a large number of false negatives. The best performing model in this study (VQC-3) combined ZFeatureMap with RealAmplitudes ansatz, optimized using ADAM. Comparative analysis against classical machine learning models such as Support Vector Machine and Random Forest reveal a performance gap, where classical models are able to achieve perfect classification performance on the synthetic data. It is concluded that classical algorithms remain dominant in their ability to classify structured data with relatively simple class separations. However, due to the observed potential of certain VQC configurations to learn decision boundaries to classify data, their utility for future applications in noisier, higher-dimensional problems is highlighted.
articles.abstract_zh: 面对日益复杂的网络安全环境，本研究探索了量子机器学习（QML）在网络流量异常检测中的潜力。通过评估四种不同的变分量子分类器（VQC）架构，研究人员发现电路表达能力和优化稳定性之间存在权衡。实验结果显示，更深的电路（VQC-4）能达到高达89.0%的准确率，但对训练条件敏感；而较浅的电路（VQC-1）表现稳定但性能稍逊。
authors: Mir H M Ilham, Hardique Dasore, Abdulrahman Ababneh, Hafidz A Kabira, Samyam Shrestha, Jeyasri Sundar, Shah Haque, Eric Howard

articles.title: Rank-one Factored Gradient Descent without Restricted Isometry: Application to Quantum Pure State Tomography on Multi-Qubits
articles.title_zh: 无受限等距条件的秩一因子化梯度下降：在多量子比特纯态层析成像中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34696v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Factored gradient descent (FGD) is a scalable nonconvex method for low-rank positive semidefinite matrix recovery, in which the rank and positivity constraints are satisfied automatically by the factorization. Most of the existing theory that certifies benignity of its loss landscape, however, relies on a restricted isometry property (RIP) of the measurement map. In quantum state tomography, one of its applications, the measurements that can be acquired with stable statistics are limited by detection efficiency and drift to Pauli observables of low weight; we first show that under such partial-weight Pauli measurements RIP fails in the worst possible way. We then bundle the mutually commuting observables setting by setting, pushing the state forward to the probability distribution of each setting, and introduce a max-sliced total-variation loss. On the stratum where the setting attaining the maximum is unique there is no spurious local minimum, and provided only that the measurement map is injective on generic pure states, the global minimum is the truth up to a phase. Finally we verify these claims numerically on four qubits and compare against FGD with the ordinary loss.
articles.abstract_zh: 因子化梯度下降（FGD）是一种可扩展的非凸方法，用于低秩半正定矩阵恢复。然而，现有理论大多依赖于测量映射的受限等距性质（RIP）。本研究首先指出在量子态层析成像中，部分权重泡利测量下RIP会失效。为此，作者引入了一种最大切片总变差损失，并证明在特定条件下，全局最小值即为真实状态。数值验证在四量子比特系统上证实了这些结论。
authors: Takahiro Kajisa

articles.title: Target Detection with Asymmetric Gaussian Classical Correlation
articles.title_zh: 基于非对称高斯经典关联的目标检测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34698v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the characteristics of two-mode classical correlation in Gaussian regime, which is produced by impinging a thermal state into a beam splitter. It is explicitly investigated how a measurement on one mode affects the other. The result enables the distinction between classical and quantum correlations. Then, we show how classically correlated states are advantageous in target detection, specifically for an asymmetric classical correlation with different mean photon numbers in the signal and idler modes. Under on-off detection, the classically correlated states significantly outperform quantum correlated states as the environmental thermal mean photon number increases. Furthermore, we demonstrate the advantage of local Gaussian operations in the target detection.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了高斯体制下双模经典关联的特性，这种关联通过将热态注入分束器产生。研究明确了对一个模式的测量如何影响另一个模式，从而区分经典和量子关联。结果表明，在目标检测中，具有不同平均光子数的非对称经典关联态具有优势，尤其是在环境热平均光子数增加时，其性能显著优于量子关联态。
authors: Su-Yong Lee, Yonggi Jo, Jihwan Kim, Zaeill Kim, Yong Sup Ihn, Duk Y. Kim

articles.title: Quantum ordinal selection with two comparisons
articles.title_zh: 两次比较下的量子序数选择
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34762v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the optimal probability of selecting an object within a prescribed rank threshold using at most two noiseless coherent pairwise comparisons of an unknown strict order. Polynomial degree bounds alone can overestimate the success attainable with two comparisons. We develop a comparison-specific semidefinite model that completely characterizes attainable success. Computer-assisted proofs establish the exact optimum for every rank threshold at seven objects and for minimum selection at eight. For minimum selection, we construct an explicit algorithm family and determine its exact optimum. Bounds for all admissible two-comparison algorithms show that the family's asymptotic success is within 0.016% of the unrestricted optimum. We also prove that this relative gap has a strictly positive limit. The optimal quantum-to-classical success ratio for minimum selection converges to approximately 2.48 under the same two-comparison budget.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了在最多两次无噪声相干成对比较下，选择处于预设秩阈值内对象的最佳概率。研究人员开发了一个比较特定的半定模型来完全表征可达到的成功率。计算机辅助证明确定了七个对象在所有秩阈值下的精确最优解，以及八个对象在最小选择下的精确最优解。结果显示，在相同比较预算下，最小选择的最佳量子-经典成功率收敛到约2.48。
authors: Hongyu Wu

articles.title: Measure of set coherence
articles.title_zh: 集相干性度量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34784v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Set coherence is a quantum resource for a set of states that characterizes whether a collection of quantum states contains coherence, namely whether these states fail to be simultaneously incoherent in a common basis. In this work, we show that the free operations of set coherence are common commutativity-preserving quantum channels, from which we then establish an axiomatic framework for set-coherence measure (SCM). Within this framework, we investigate the robustness based measures deduced by taking, respectively, the average, maximum, and sum of the single-state robustnesses over a common reference basis, where the first two were previously introduced in the literature and we check here whether they satisfy our SCM axioms. Consequently, we show that the averaged robustness is an SCM but it is neither unified nor complete, the maximal robustness is a unified SCM but is neither complete nor strongly superadditive, whereas the sum robustness is a complete SCM. Furthermore, we propose several classes of SCMs based on pairwise commutators. We show that the Schatten p-norm based SCMs are complete and strongly superadditive. We also find that the universal fourth-order Bargmann gap measure proposed in the literature is a complete and strongly superadditive quantifier of set coherence. Finally, we discuss the operational meaning of the SCM in the context of optimal approximate quantum broadcasting, and show that the amount of set coherence can closely reflect the performance of this task.
articles.abstract_zh: 集相干性是量子态集合的一种量子资源，表征了量子态集合是否包含相干性。本研究确定了集相干性的自由操作是共同的保交换量子信道，并在此基础上建立了集相干性度量（SCM）的公理框架。研究人员评估了基于鲁棒性的度量，并提出了几类基于成对对易子的SCM，证明了基于Schatten p范数的SCM是完备且强超可加的。
authors: Jiabo Panel, Yu Guo, Yuqin Wang

articles.title: A General Framework for Leggett--Garg Violation in Neutrino Oscillations and Matter Effects
articles.title_zh: 中微子振荡和物质效应中Leggett-Garg违背的通用框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34832v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Leggett--Garg inequality (LGI) constrains temporal correlations under the assumptions of macrorealism and noninvasive measurability. We study the four-time quantity (K₄) for two-flavor neutrino oscillations using a pseudo-density matrix (PDM) under static conditions, instead of non-invasive measurement. With this approach, it becomes possible to examine a Horodecki-type criterion for the temporal Pauli-correlation tensor. The Horodecki criterion had been proven for CHSH inequality (R. Horodecki et al. Phys. Lett. A200, 340), For any unitary qubit evolution, the corresponding scalar is (M_R=2). Although, this result characterizes the correlation tensor and the optimized temporal construction, it does not imply that a fixed flavor observable violates the LGI at every neutrino energy or baseline. We therefore evaluate (K₄) explicitly for flavor measurements in matter of constant density. The numerical examples illustrate how matter effects modify the temporal correlations, with a pronounced matter--vacuum separation near the MSW resonance for the chosen parameters and generally smaller differences in the selected off-resonance cases. This finding motivates further investigation of matter-induced temporal correlations in atmospheric neutrinos and their potential relevance to future studies with long-baseline and atmospheric-neutrino experiments, including DUNE and Hyper-Kamiokande.
articles.abstract_zh: Leggett-Garg不等式（LGI）在宏观实在论和非侵入性可测量性假设下限制了时间关联。本研究使用伪密度矩阵（PDM）在静态条件下研究了两味中微子振荡的四时间量（K₄），从而能够检验时间泡利关联张量的Horodecki型判据。数值示例表明，物质效应会改变时间关联，在MSW共振附近表现出明显的物质-真空分离。
authors: M. M. Ettefaghi, H. Hajipour

articles.title: Modulation and protection of entanglement in a two-qubit system via two interacting oscillator control
articles.title_zh: 通过两个相互作用振子控制实现双量子比特系统纠缠的调制与保护
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34899v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the control and protection of two-qubit entanglement through engineered interactions between two auxiliary harmonic oscillators. Each qubit is coupled to a local oscillator via a dephasing interaction, while the oscillators interact through independently tunable position-position and momentum-momentum couplings. Employing the characteristic-function representation, we obtain analytical solutions for the composite-system dynamics and examine how the stability properties of the coupled oscillators determine the evolution of two-qubit concurrence.
