Our analysis reveals distinct dynamical regimes exhibiting entanglement revivals, suppression, or decay, and identifies configurations in which oscillator interactions effectively reduce entanglement degradation. We further investigate the influence of thermal dissipation using local and global master-equation descriptions, demonstrating that suitable oscillator couplings can preserve substantial two-qubit entanglement under the dissipative conditions considered. These results establish a connection between the dynamical stability of auxiliary bosonic modes and the controllability of entanglement in discrete-variable quantum systems, providing a potential strategy for entanglement protection through engineered oscillator interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究通过两个辅助谐振子之间的工程化相互作用，探讨了双量子比特纠缠的控制和保护。分析揭示了纠缠复苏、抑制或衰减的不同动力学机制，并指出振子相互作用能有效减少纠缠退化的配置。研究还表明，在耗散条件下，适当的振子耦合可以保持显著的双量子比特纠缠。
authors: Pablo Carlos López Vázquez, Andrés García, Josué Romero

articles.title: Membership in the cone of quantum states over time is NP-hard
articles.title_zh: 量子态时间锥的成员资格是NP难的
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34972v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A state over time (stote) pairs a state h̊o with a channel E as the Hermitian, generally non-positive operator (h̊oøtimes1)star J_E. Characterizing the convex cone widehatQ these operators generate was posed as an open problem in~i̧teHoogstederCalsamigliaWinter2025. We exhibit a linear copy of the bipartite separable cone as an exposed face of widehatQ: for output systems of the form B = A'R with A' a copy of the input, there is an explicit witness W₀ᵢₙwidehatQ^* and an explicit injective linear map L with σin SEP₊(A:R)iff L(σ)inwidehatQ(A:A'R). Composing with the NP-hardness of separability shows that exact membership, weak membership, and weak optimization are NP-hard for widehatQ and its dual. A quantitative stability bound makes the weak-membership reduction valid at inverse-polynomial accuracy. Thus polynomial-time membership tests do not exist unless P=NP. Independently of this complexity assumption, Fawzi's theorem implies that widehatQ(A:A'R) admits no finite semidefinite representation when d=dim Age2, r=dim Rge2, and d+r>5.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了量子态时间锥（stote）的成员资格问题。研究人员展示了二分可分离锥的一个线性副本作为该锥的一个暴露面。通过结合可分离性的NP难性，证明了量子态时间锥及其对偶的精确成员资格、弱成员资格和弱优化问题都是NP难的。这意味着除非P=NP，否则不存在多项式时间成员资格测试。
authors: Matt Hoogsteder-Riera

articles.title: Charge-Coupled Device-Based Arbitrary Waveform Generation for Qubit Control
articles.title_zh: 基于电荷耦合器件的量子比特控制任意波形生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34988v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose an arbitrary waveform generation architecture based on charge-coupled devices (CCDs) for qubit control. Waveform samples are stored as charge packets in CCD channels and sequentially clocked out as voltage samples. Multiple channels are operated in parallel and time-interleaved to achieve high effective sampling rates. The generated baseband waveforms are then upconverted to microwave frequencies to drive qubit operations. By representing waveform information as stored charge rather than as continuously generated or transmitted microwave signals, the proposed architecture provides a path to reducing cryogenic interconnect density and lowering heat load in scalable quantum control systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出了一种基于电荷耦合器件（CCD）的量子比特控制任意波形生成架构。波形样本以电荷包形式存储在CCD通道中，并顺序输出为电压样本，通过多通道并行和时间交错实现高有效采样率。这种架构通过将波形信息表示为存储电荷，而非连续生成的微波信号，有望降低可扩展量子控制系统中的低温互连密度和热负荷。
authors: Shinichi Morisaka, Ryutaro Ohira

articles.title: Self-Correcting 3D Surface Code with Growing Local Dimension
articles.title_zh: 具有增长局部维度的自纠正三维表面码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35099v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct self-correcting 3D surface codes over mathbb Z_q with local dimension q growing with system size. The model preserves the local geometry and stabilizer support of the ordinary 3D surface code and remains translation invariant in the bulk, while modifying only the stabilizer Pauli powers. We use the Lee metric to characterize error weight and consider local Metropolis dynamics with single-qudit X±¹ and Z±¹ updates, each changing the energy by at most a constant independent of q and system size N. We prove that, below the critical temperature, when the local dimension scales as q=Θ(N), the memory times in both error sectors grow at least as expłeft[Ømega(N¹/³)i̊ght]. Our numerical results further support these analytical results. Together, these results establish growing local Hilbert-space dimension as a new resource for designing self-correcting quantum memories while retaining simple local geometry and local thermal dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一种基于Z_q的自纠正三维表面码，其局部维度q随系统尺寸增长。该模型在保持普通三维表面码的局部几何和稳定器支持的同时，仅修改稳定器泡利幂。研究表明，在临界温度以下，当局部维度q与系统尺寸N成比例增长时，错误扇区的记忆时间至少以指数级增长。这些结果确立了增长的局部希尔伯特空间维度作为设计自纠正量子存储器的新资源。
authors: Jinkang Guo

articles.title: Multinomial shot sampling for quantum circuits
articles.title_zh: 量子电路中的多项式采样
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35119v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In classical simulations of quantum circuits, sampling shots (measurement outcomes) from the final state is a routine but costly step. In widely used software, including Qiskit and PennyLane, its cost grows linearly with the number of shots S, even when the simulation has already produced the full state vector, because every shot is generated and processed individually. If only the measurement counts are needed, this is unnecessary. The counts can be drawn directly from a multinomial distribution, decomposed into a sequence of conditional binomial draws, each performed in expected constant time by the BTPE algorithm. The sampling cost is then independent of S. We describe an implementation of this approach, which also shortens the computation for states whose probability is concentrated on a few outcomes, and compare it with Qiskit's sampling primitives for up to 20 qubits and 10⁶ shots. Our implementation is faster in every configuration tested, by a factor that grows with the number of shots and exceeds 10³ in most configurations at S = 10⁶, and its samples are statistically indistinguishable from those of the reference implementations.
articles.abstract_zh: 在量子电路的经典模拟中，从最终状态中采样测量结果是一个常规但成本高昂的步骤，其成本随采样次数线性增长。本文提出了一种直接从多项式分布中抽取测量计数的方案，通过BTPE算法将采样成本变为与采样次数无关。该方法在测试中比Qiskit的采样原语快10³倍以上，且样本在统计学上与参考实现无异。
authors: Ijaz Ahamed Mohammad, Daniel Nagaj, Martin Plesch

articles.title: External-field-modified entropic exchange in confined quantum systems: static versus time-dependent electric fields
articles.title_zh: 受限量子系统中外场修饰的熵交换：静态与时变电场对比
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35178v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We review how external electric fields reshape the information content of spatially confined atoms, and we contrast the response to a uniform static field with that to a monochromatic, time-dependent laser field. The central quantities are the Shannon entropies in position and momentum space, Sr and Sp, and their sum ST = Sr +Sp, which obeys the BBM bound. Using the confined hydrogen atom (CHA) and the particle in a spherical box (PISB), its tight confinement limit, as reference systems, we first show that the field-free total entropy of the CHA depends non-monotonically on the confining radius whereas that of the PISB is strictly scale invariant. We then present Stark maps of the entropies for the ten lowest m = 0 levels at the confining radius of 6 a.u. The ground-state polarizability is reduced from the free-atom value 4.5 a.u. to 4.06 a.u. in the CHA but is 46.8 a.u. in the PISB, and the entropic response of the two systems differs correspondingly.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文综述了外部电场如何重塑空间受限原子的信息内容，并对比了其对均匀静态电场和单色时变激光场的响应。研究核心是位置空间和动量空间的香农熵Sr和Sp及其总和ST。作者以受限氢原子和球形盒中粒子为参考系统，展示了无场总熵的非单调依赖性，并给出了熵的斯塔克图，揭示了两种系统在熵响应上的差异。
authors: Vinod Prasad

articles.title: Complete characterization of internal-external entanglement trade-offs in two-mode Gaussian states
articles.title_zh: 双模高斯态中内外部纠缠权衡的完整表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35183v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We characterize the exact trade-off between internal and external entanglement in asymmetric two-mode Gaussian states at fixed local symplectic eigenvalues. Internal entanglement is quantified by the negativity NA:B between the two modes, while external entanglement is quantified by the negativity NAB:CD across a Gaussian purification. Numerical sampling suggests the boundary structure of the attainable region in the (NAB:CD,NA:B) plane, which we then determine analytically. Parametrizing the global symplectic spectrum yields a closed admissible interval for the remaining spectral parameter at fixed NAB:CD. We prove constructively that every point in this interval corresponds to a physical covariance matrix, implying that all intermediate values of NA:B between the resulting sharp bounds are achievable. The upper bound is attained for opposite-sign correlations of equal magnitude, while the positive branch of the lower bound occurs when one global symplectic eigenvalue equals unity. We also identify two external-entanglement thresholds, derive a saturated monogamy-type inequality, and recover the symmetric-state limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在固定局部辛本征值下，完整表征了非对称双模高斯态中内外部纠缠之间的精确权衡关系。内部纠缠通过两模式间的负性NA:B量化，外部纠缠通过高斯纯化中的负性NAB:CD量化。研究通过数值采样和解析推导确定了可达区域的边界结构，并证明了所有中间值均可实现。此外，还识别了两个外部纠缠阈值，推导了饱和的一夫一妻制不等式，并恢复了对称态极限。
authors: Yasusada Nambu

articles.title: Quantized-resonance description of a quantum emitter dynamics in a lossy multimode cavity
articles.title_zh: 损耗多模腔中量子发射器动力学的量子化共振描述
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35184v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the multimode regime of cavity quantum electrodynamics (cQED), light-matter coupling can be strong enough such as to allows a quantum emitter to couple with multiple resonant field modes. This regime leaves distinctive signatures in the behavior of both the field and the emitter, which are already accessible by modern experimental techniques. To model such effects in lossy cavities, effective discrete-mode approaches have been widely employed, despite their accuracy beyond two modes remaining rarely benchmarked. In this work, we demonstrate the necessity of employing multiple modes to describe the multimode signatures by analyzing the dynamics of an atom in a one-dimensional lossy resonator. The atom's dynamics is simulated using the formalism developed in Weitzel et al. (2026) (arXiv:2512.18478), where a resonance quantization prescription is provided. We investigate its dependency with respect to two different parameters: the light-matter coupling strength and the atom's position. In the former case, we find that the minimal number of modes necessary to capture the essential features of the atom's dynamics increases with the coupling strength. In the latter, we further observe that the multimode regime leads to a strong position-dependency of the atom's dynamics. In all cases, we discuss the physical interpretation of our results and further discuss about how the employed formalism can be used to recover physically relevant quantities.
articles.abstract_zh: 在腔量子电动力学（cQED）的多模态下，光-物质耦合可能足够强，使量子发射器与多个共振场模式耦合。本文通过分析一维损耗谐振器中原子的动力学，证明了采用多模态描述多模态特征的必要性。研究利用共振量子化方法模拟原子动力学，并探讨其对光-物质耦合强度和原子位置的依赖性。结果表明，捕获原子动力学基本特征所需的最小模式数量随耦合强度增加而增加。
authors: Lucas Weitzel

articles.title: Quantum-Classical Framework for the Joint Optimization of Bidirectional EV Charging and Trip Assignment
articles.title_zh: 双向电动汽车充电与行程分配联合优化的量子-经典框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35300v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The integration of bidirectional (V2G) charging allows electric vehicle (EV) fleets to operate as distributed energy assets. However, the joint optimization of charging schedules and trip assignments is NP-hard. Moreover, bidirectional power flows create non-monotonic state-of-charge (SoC) dynamics that weaken standard dual-based Benders cuts. We propose a hybrid quantum-classical Benders decomposition framework. To overcome the qubit overhead associated with encoding feasibility cuts, we introduce logic-based conflict cuts, which require near-zero auxiliary qubits. Furthermore, we develop a sparse recursive SoC formulation that reduces the constraint-matrix density by a factor of T/3 in the horizon length T. We demonstrate that our framework recovers MILP-optimal solutions on benchmark instances with a low auxiliary-qubit budget, and, as a minimal proof of concept, we execute a small instance end-to-end on IBM quantum hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 双向（V2G）充电使电动汽车车队能作为分布式能源资产运行，但其充电调度和行程分配的联合优化是NP难问题。本文提出了一种混合量子-经典Benders分解框架，通过引入基于逻辑的冲突割来减少量子比特开销。此外，还开发了一种稀疏递归SoC公式，显著降低了约束矩阵密度。该框架在基准实例上能恢复MILP最优解，并已在IBM量子硬件上成功执行了一个小型实例。
authors: Mustafa Musab, Sebastian Schmitt, Markus Wappler, Jörg Lässig, Daniel Müssig

articles.title: Spectral fingerprint recognition of mobile signals via Rydberg atomic sensors
articles.title_zh: 基于里德堡原子传感器的移动信号频谱指纹识别
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35301v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rydberg-atom sensors have emerged as a promising quantum technology for broadband radio-frequency detection owing to their intrinsic calibration, wide frequency coverage, and high sensitivity. However, their potential for intelligent identification of real-world wireless signals remains largely unexplored. Here, we demonstrate a quantum-enabled framework for mobile signal classification based on Rydberg electromagnetically induced transparency spectroscopy and deep learning. Three types of wireless emissions, including cellular voice call, Wi-Fi, and 5G signals from three commercial smartphone brands, are measured to construct a spectral-fingerprint dataset. A convolutional neural network trained on this dataset achieves an initial baseline classification accuracy of 93.44%. To compensate for spectral drifts induced by temporal and environmental variations, a progressive fine-tuning strategy is employed to continuously adapt the pretrained model, enabling robust classification across diverse deployment scenarios. Furthermore, continuous real-time monitoring is demonstrated under dynamically varying wireless conditions, including cellular voice call, Wi-Fi, and their coexistence. The proposed system achieves an overall frame-level recognition accuracy of 87.67% over a 60-s measurement. These results establish a pathway toward intelligent quantum radio-frequency sensing and highlight the potential of Rydberg-atom platforms for real-time wireless signal awareness and spectrum monitoring.
articles.abstract_zh: 里德堡原子传感器在宽带射频检测方面展现出巨大潜力，但其在智能识别真实世界无线信号方面的应用尚未充分探索。本文展示了一个基于里德堡电磁感应透明光谱和深度学习的量子赋能移动信号分类框架。研究测量了蜂窝语音通话、Wi-Fi和5G信号，构建了频谱指纹数据集，并利用卷积神经网络实现了93.44%的初始分类准确率。为应对频谱漂移，采用了渐进式微调策略，实现了在动态无线条件下的鲁棒分类和实时监测。
authors: Yi-Ming Yin, Ming-Yao Cui, Ling-Yu Du, Jin-Hang Fang, Luan-Yi Wei, Bang Liu, Li-Hua Zhang, Kai Wang, Kai-Bin Huang, Dong-Sheng Ding

articles.title: Sublinear thermal state and ground state preparation for free fermions via system-bath interaction
articles.title_zh: 通过系统-浴相互作用实现自由费米子亚线性热态和基态制备
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35370v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dissipative algorithms for preparing thermal and ground states typically require a total Hamiltonian simulation time that grows at least linearly with system size N, even when their mixing time grows only polylogarithmically. We achieve sublinear simulation time for free fermions by engineering local interactions with a bath whose size grows in proportion to the system size. Starting from arbitrary initial states, our thermal state preparation algorithm achieves trace-norm error ϵ in total simulation time widetildeO(sqrtN/ϵ) at fixed inverse temperature and bounded single-particle bandwidth, while ground state preparation of gapped systems requires only polylog(N/ϵ) time. We further establish lower bounds for thermal state preparation within the bath protocols considered, identifying two obstacles to faster preparation, namely fourth-order deviations from the target thermal state and fluctuations induced by a random frequency shared by all bath qubits. Our results demonstrate that the linear simulation time barrier in dissipative state preparation can be overcome and clarify the bath and filter-design constraints that govern further complexity improvements.
articles.abstract_zh: 耗散算法制备热态和基态通常需要与系统大小N至少呈线性增长的总哈密顿量模拟时间。本文通过设计与浴的局部相互作用，实现了自由费米子的亚线性模拟时间。在固定逆温度和有界单粒子带宽下，热态制备算法在总模拟时间为widetildeO(sqrtN/ϵ)时达到迹范数误差ϵ，而有能隙系统的基态制备仅需polylog(N/ϵ)时间。研究结果表明，耗散态制备中的线性模拟时间障碍可以被克服，并阐明了进一步加速的浴和滤波器设计约束。
authors: Zhiyan Ding, Lin Lin, Ke Wang

articles.title: Multipartite dynamics beyond bipartite entanglement equilibration
articles.title_zh: 超越二分纠缠平衡的多体动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35377v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Entanglement equilibration need not mark the end of quantum-information dynamics in quantum thermalization. We show that the complete Schmidt spectra of a fixed tripartition can become stationary while its multipartite correlation structure, distinguished by local-unitary invariants, continues to evolve. This separation occurs exactly within a finite window in self-dual kicked-Ising dynamics and asymptotically in Haar-random circuits. We further demonstrate an independently tunable timescale for multipartite dynamics using quantum-error-correcting codes. When coupled to a locally scrambling bath, ordinary entanglement approaches equilibrium through rapid local scrambling, while weak logical--bath coupling drives a slower reorganization of multipartite correlations. These results reveal a deeper distinction than the ordering of equilibration times: bipartite entanglement and multipartite correlation structure can probe distinct physical channels of quantum-information dynamics, rather than merely different stages of the same relaxation process.
articles.abstract_zh: 纠缠平衡不一定标志着量子热化中量子信息动力学的终结。本文研究表明，固定三分区的完整施密特谱可以达到稳态，而其由局域酉不变性区分的多体关联结构却持续演化。这种分离在自对偶踢-伊辛动力学中精确地发生在一个有限窗口内，并在哈尔随机电路中渐近发生。研究还利用量子纠错码展示了多体动力学独立可调的时间尺度，揭示了二分纠缠和多体关联结构可以探测量子信息动力学中不同的物理通道。
authors: Yan Liu, Ya-Wen Sun, Ren-Jie Ying, Jun-Yuan Zeng

articles.title: Multimode continuous-variable quantum key distribution with CMOS-compatible photonic-electronic integration
articles.title_zh: 基于CMOS兼容光电集成的多模连续变量量子密钥分发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35410v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multiplexing and photonic-electronic integration offer a route to scalable and high-throughput quantum key distribution (QKD) networks through parallel transmission and compact hardware suited to volume manufacturing. Realizing this route requires multichannel transmitters and receivers, and a security analysis accounting for mode coupling. Here we present a CMOS-compatible photonic-electronic multimode continuous-variable QKD architecture, using polarization multiplexing as a two-mode example. Silicon-photonic transmitter and receiver chips prepare and detect two polarization modes in parallel. The receiver is co-integrated with a dual-channel 28-nm CMOS transimpedance amplifier, providing shot-noise clearances exceeding 20 dB in both channels. Pilot-assisted unitary digital recovery removes the need for active optical polarization control, while a multimode security analysis accounts for the mode crosstalk. At 2 percent residual crosstalk, the multimode analysis extends the simulated secure distance from 39 to 84 km, near the crosstalk-free limit of 89 km. Over 10 km of deployed fibre, the mean total finite-size secret-key rate estimate is 6.69 Mbit/s, 12 percent above the single-mode analysis from the same digitally recovered data. These results establish a route to scalable multimode quantum-secured networks built on technology suited to mass production.
articles.abstract_zh: 复用和光电集成是实现可扩展、高吞吐量量子密钥分发（QKD）网络的途径。本文提出了一种CMOS兼容的光电多模连续变量QKD架构，以偏振复用为例展示了双模系统。硅光子发射器和接收器芯片并行制备和检测两个偏振模式，接收器集成了双通道CMOS跨阻放大器。多模安全分析考虑了模式串扰，在2%残余串扰下，模拟安全距离从39公里扩展到84公里。
authors: Yiming Bian, Sarah Bastiaens, Saeed Hakimi, Huy Quang Nguyen, Aboobackkar Sidhique, Cédric Bruynsteen, Govind J. Wanjalkar, Ali Al Hadi Amhaz, Jasper Jans, Axl Bomhals, Ulrik L. Andersen, Tobias Gehring, Xin Yin, Adnan A. E. Hajomer

articles.title: Electron-photon entanglement in real space from quantum electrodynamics
articles.title_zh: 量子电动力学中实空间电子-光子纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35467v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the entanglement between an electron and the photon it scatters, resolved in real space and time. Starting from nonrelativistic QED in Fermi's oscillator representation, we write Fock's coupled equations for components with fixed photon number in the photon configuration space, in the length gauge, where the photon is created around the atom through a nonlocal kernel. Truncated at one photon, the equations are solved numerically without the rotating-wave approximation for a one-dimensional model atom in a waveguide with a single transverse mode and enhanced coupling. The atom is driven by a short, off-resonant laser pulse, with the electron and photon represented on real-space grids. The global electron-photon entanglement is largely transient. It peaks during the pulse and decreases as the polarized electron cloud returns to the core, leaving a state close to a product of the electron state and a superposition of the field vacuum with a single scattered photon. Local entanglement, obtained from walkers sampled across both photon-number components, exhibits opposite spatial patterns for the two particles. The electron entropy is smallest at the nucleus and maps the local strength of the dipole coupling, whereas the photon entropy is largest near the atom, where photons are created and absorbed, and smaller in the outgoing wave packets.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了电子与其散射光子在实空间和时间上的纠缠。研究从费米振子表示的非相对论量子电动力学出发，数值求解了截断至一个光子的情况，模拟了波导中一维模型原子在短离共振激光脉冲驱动下的动力学。结果表明，全局电子-光子纠缠是瞬态的，在脉冲期间达到峰值。局部纠缠则在两种粒子中呈现相反的空间模式。
authors: Ivan P. Christov

articles.title: Benchmarking quantum-annealing-based approaches for factory layout planning
articles.title_zh: 工厂布局规划中基于量子退火方法的基准测试
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35478v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The earlystage of factory layout planning has a direct effect on the operating costs, efficiency, and productivity of manufacturing systems. Conventional automated planning approaches often face a trade-off between solution quality and computational effort. Recent studies have investigated the potential of quantum annealing (QA) for solving factory layout planning problems. However, existing studies have mainly focused on individual QA-based formulations, whereas current hybrid QA solvers support multiple model types that combine QA and classical methods. To explore the potential of QA for factory layout planning, this paper benchmarks four QA based approaches implemented with the corresponding solvers, including an iterative binary quadratic model (IBQM), a hybrid discrete quadratic model (HDQM), a hybrid constrained quadratic model (HCQM), and a hybrid nonlinear model (HNLM). To improve scalability, an iterative decomposition strategy is developed for IBQM, while a candidate selection procedure is introduced for HDQM. The approaches are benchmarked against genetic algorithm, particle swarm optimization, and a hybrid tabu search and simulated annealing approach on 14 layout instances with different layout sizes, geometric complexity, spatial restrictions, and transport route configurations. The comparative analysis considers solution quality, computation time, and scalability. The results show that QA-based approaches achieve competitive solution quality and substantial computational advantages, reducing computation time by up to 94.51% relative to the classical reference methods. Among them, IBQM obtains the best solution quality in 78.6% of the instances, with a maximum improvement of 17.41% associated with an 81.34% reduction in computation time. These findings provide a basis for their further application in industrial layout planning.
articles.abstract_zh: 工厂布局规划对制造系统的成本、效率和生产力有直接影响，传统自动化方法常面临解质量与计算量之间的权衡。本文旨在探索量子退火（QA）在工厂布局规划中的潜力，对四种基于QA的方法进行了基准测试，包括迭代二元二次模型（IBQM）、混合离散二次模型（HDQM）、混合约束二次模型（HCQM）和混合非线性模型（HNLM）。为提高可扩展性，研究为IBQM开发了迭代分解策略，并为HDQM引入了候选选择程序。这些方法与遗传算法、粒子群优化等经典算法进行了比较。
authors: Xiangqian Wu, Philipp Schworm, Marcel Wagner, Jan C. Aurich

articles.title: Fast and accurate rare-event simulation by Markov chain Monte Carlo for general quantum codes
articles.title_zh: 基于马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛的通用量子码稀有事件快速准确模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35498v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The splitting method estimates logical error rates of quantum error-correcting codes deep in the rare-event regime, where direct Monte Carlo sampling is prohibitively expensive. It relies on a Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampler of faulty configurations, usually driven by one-bit-flip proposals. However, one-bit flips have been reported to be trapped on some codes, which biases the estimate. To address this issue, we propose a new kernel that combines locally balanced one-bit-flip proposals with a cluster-exchange move. We benchmark both kernels and direct Monte Carlo on twelve codes under code-capacity bit-flip noise in two ways, by comparing the mean fault weight with an MCMC-independent reference and by measuring the computation time to reach a fixed accuracy. In the first, our kernel agrees with the reference on every code, including those where one-bit flips are trapped. In the second, it is faster than one-bit flips wherever they are trapped, by orders of magnitude on some codes. Furthermore, at the lowest error rate, it is faster than direct Monte Carlo on every code, by more than four orders of magnitude on some.
articles.abstract_zh: 分裂方法用于估计量子纠错码在稀有事件区域的逻辑错误率，但传统的一比特翻转提议可能导致估计偏差。本文提出了一种新的核函数，结合了局部平衡的一比特翻转提议和簇交换移动。研究在十二种量子码上对新核函数、一比特翻转和直接蒙特卡洛进行了基准测试。结果表明，新核函数在所有代码上均与参考值一致，并且在某些代码上比一比特翻转快几个数量级，在最低错误率下比直接蒙特卡洛快四个数量级以上。
authors: Junichi Haruna, Kotaro Murakami

articles.title: Quantum state revivals, time quasicrystals, and entanglement steering in a Fibonacci-driven central-spin model
articles.title_zh: 斐波那契驱动中心自旋模型中的量子态复苏、时间准晶和纠缠操控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35555v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by the search for non-equilibrium phases of matter beyond the Floquet paradigm, we propose a route to realize perfect revivals and time quasicrystals (TQCs) in a Fibonacci-driven central-spin model with Ising interactions between the central and satellite spins in the absence of disorder. We analytically demonstrate that when the interaction strength, łambda is tuned to 2 m π, no entanglement is generated between the central and satellite spins at stroboscopic times, independent of the strength of the transverse driving field and the drive sequence. This leads to indefinitely long-lived quasiperiodic oscillations in satellite spin magnetization. Furthermore, for initial states with a definite bath magnetization, no entanglement is generated when the transverse driving field, θ is tuned to π for any value of  łambda, and the satellite spin magnetization oscillations exhibit period-3 revivals at Fibonacci times. Examining the robustness of these oscillations away from this fine-tuned limit, we identify a parameter regime where the quasiperiodic response does not decay over the timescales probed, giving rise to a long-lived π-pulse-proximate TQC regime. We further show that at special Clifford points, the system exhibits perfect quasiperiodic oscillations of the satellite spin magnetization, with a parity-dependent Fourier response. This response persists over the timescales probed, even away from the Clifford points for an even number of satellite spins, leading to the formation of a Clifford-proximate TQC. Finally, we demonstrate that at this Clifford points, the system is steered along an entangled trajectory, leading to the dynamical generation of Bell-cat and spin-cat states. These states exhibit magnetization of collective spin fluctuates quadratically with the number of satellite spins, thereby enabling Heisenberg-limited metrology.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种在斐波那契驱动的中心自旋模型中实现完美复苏和时间准晶（TQC）的方法。研究分析表明，当相互作用强度λ调谐到2mπ时，中心自旋和卫星自旋之间不会产生纠缠，导致卫星自旋磁化强度出现无限长的准周期振荡。此外，在特定条件下，卫星自旋磁化强度振荡在斐波那契时间表现出周期为3的复苏。研究还识别了一个参数区域，其中准周期响应在探测的时间尺度内不会衰减，从而产生持久的π-p。
authors: Anushka Agrawal, Adithya A. Vasista, Tanay Nag, Sayan Choudhury

articles.title: Did the Gran Sasso Experiment Rule Out the Diósi-Penrose Theory? Musing on the 2021 Result and the Present Experimental Status
articles.title_zh: 格兰萨索实验是否排除了迪奥西-彭罗斯理论？对2021年结果和当前实验状态的思考
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35608v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In 2021, a low-background experiment at the Gran Sasso National Laboratory searched for spontaneous radiation predicted by the standard Markovian Diósi-Penrose (DP) dynamics and obtained the new bound R₀ > 5.4 × 10⁻¹¹,m at 95% probability for the short-length cutoff parameter. For germanium at the experimental temperature, the parameter-free prescription identifying R₀ with the spatial quantum spread of a nucleus gives R₀ simeq 5 × 10⁻¹²,m. That particular combination, Diósi's stochastic dynamics and the Penrose-motivated mass-density resolution, was therefore excluded. Subsequent searches strengthened the cutoff bound. The Majorana Demonstrator improved it in 2022, and XENONnT has now obtained the world-leading limits R₀ > 4.9 × 10⁻¹⁰,m at 90% confidence level and R₀ > 4.5 × 10⁻¹⁰,m at 95% confidence level. These advances reinforce the 2021 exclusion but do not alter its logical scope: they emphparametrically constrain the Markovian, effectively white-noise DP dynamics, not Penrose's (and Diósi's) lifetime criterion independently of a dynamics, and not all colored-noise, dissipative, or otherwise modified gravity-related spontaneous collapse theories. We reconstruct what Gran Sasso did and did not rule out and place that conclusion in the present experimental context.
articles.abstract_zh: 2021年格兰萨索国家实验室的实验排除了标准马尔可夫迪奥西-彭罗斯（DP）动力学与彭罗斯质量密度分辨率相结合的特定组合。随后的实验，如Majorana Demonstrator和XENONnT，进一步提高了对短长度截止参数R₀的限制。这些进展加强了对马尔可夫DP动力学的参数约束，但并未排除所有与引力相关的自发辐射理论。
authors: Catalina Curceanu, Nicola Bortolotti, Lajos Diósi, Simone Manti, Kristian Piscicchia

articles.title: Quantum-Inspired and Optimization-Based CT Reconstruction Through Spin-Error
articles.title_zh: 基于自旋误差的量子启发式和优化型CT重建
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35657v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum-optimization-based computed tomography (CT) reconstruction has demonstrated quantum supremacy in reconstruction accuracy over conventional classical methods under sparse-view and corrupted-sinogram conditions. However, scaling this approach remains challenging because larger images require increasingly many binary variables and interactions in the underlying quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) model. Even with iterative region-of-interest (ROI) refinement, a 60 by 60 ROI with three X-ray mass attenuation coefficients requires 10,800 binary variables under our encoding. As an initial step toward larger quantum CT images, we investigate simulated annealing (SA) followed by spin-error mitigation for optimisation (SEMO), without altering the CT-QUBO objective. We evaluate three 54-view ROI reconstruction instances and nine-view reconstruction with detector-row corruption, comparing SA and SEMO with selected hybrid quantum-classical solver results. For the ROI cases, SEMO reduced the numbers of incorrectly reconstructed pixels in low-budget SA outputs from 13 to 1, 38 to 0, and 54 to 15. With 20 percent detector-row corruption, three of four selected SA and SEMO pairs achieved exact reconstruction. Applying SEMO to one hybrid-solver output reduced its ROI error from 78 to 1 pixel. Improvements were instance-dependent: in one corrupted-sinogram case, QUBO energy decreased while image-domain error increased slightly; in one ROI case, the refined image retained 15 incorrect pixels despite having lower QUBO energy than ground truth. At the evaluated problem sizes, SA and SEMO attained reconstruction accuracy comparable to or better than selected unmitigated hybrid-solver results, providing an initial solution-quality benchmark for future larger-scale, parallelized quantum CT image reconstruction.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于量子优化的CT重建在稀疏视图和受损正弦图条件下展现出优于经典方法的精度，但其可扩展性受限于QUBO模型中所需的二元变量数量。为解决此问题，本文研究了模拟退火（SA）结合自旋误差缓解优化（SEMO）的方法。实验结果表明，SEMO显著减少了低预算SA输出中错误重建的像素数量，为实现更大规模的量子CT图像重建提供了初步途径。
authors: Hyunju Lee, Jeonghwa Lee, Yushuang Sam Yang, Clement Chu, Anthony B. Murphy, Kyungtaek Jun

articles.title: Quantum computation of energy level degeneracy and thermodynamical properties of spin systems
articles.title_zh: 自旋系统能级简并度和热力学性质的量子计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35660v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a hybrid quantum-classical method for reconstructing energy-level degeneracies and thermodynamic properties of spin systems. A single ancilla qubit is used to measure the partition function at imaginary inverse temperatures. For spectra lying on a known equally spaced energy grid, the inverse discrete Fourier transform allows exact reconstruction of degeneracies in the absence of noise, without spectral leakage. The quantum circuits are optimized using commuting interactions and Eulerian ordering. We demonstrate the method for frustrated Ising antiferromagnets on periodic Kagome graphs with up to 36 spins, using the ibmₖᵢₙgston quantum processor. Despite substantial circuit depth and hardware noise, the reconstructed spectra retain their dominant features, and the calculated heat capacities reproduce the main temperature dependence of the exact results. Keywords: partition function, imaginary temperature, Ising model, heat capacity, ancilla qubit, quantum computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种混合量子-经典方法，用于重建自旋系统的能级简并度和热力学性质。该方法利用一个辅助量子比特测量虚数逆温度下的配分函数，并通过逆离散傅里叶变换精确重建简并度。研究在IBM Kingston量子处理器上对多达36个自旋的Ising反铁磁体进行了演示，结果表明重建的能谱保留了主要特征，计算出的热容也再现了精确结果的主要温度依赖性。
authors: V. M. Tkachuk, M. I. Samar

articles.title: κ-Parametrized Boltzmann Distribution Sampling on Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm
articles.title_zh: 量子近似优化算法中κ参数化玻尔兹曼分布采样
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35665v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative models use training data to produce new samples that resemble the original, with applications in classification and recommendation systems. Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs) are at the core of generative models but suffer from the computational intractability of training, which relies on sampling an unknown Boltzmann Distribution (BD). The Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) can assist RBM training, potentially providing benefits over strictly classical strategies. One particular problem is determining the quantum circuit depth for an arbitrary problem size that yields the expected sampling results. In this study, we evaluate QAOA-assisted sampling of BDs using Qiskit's Aer Simulator by analysing the inverse effective temperature of the distribution, κ, for tractable problem sizes. The results provide numerical evidence, based on Qiskit Aer simulations, that parameterized annealing-scheduled QAOA (PAQ-QAOA) can approximate RBM Boltzmann sampling for the tractable instances considered, while hardware performance and scaling remain open questions.
articles.abstract_zh: 受限玻尔兹曼机（RBMs）的训练依赖于玻尔兹曼分布采样，计算上难以处理。本文研究了量子近似优化算法（QAOA）辅助RBM训练的可能性，通过分析分布的逆有效温度κ，评估了QAOA辅助的玻尔兹曼分布采样。Qiskit Aer模拟结果表明，参数化退火调度QAOA（PAQ-QAOA）可以近似RBM玻尔兹曼采样，但硬件性能和可扩展性仍是开放问题。
authors: João Marcos Cavalcanti de Albuquerque Neto, Gustavo Castro do Amaral, Guilherme Penello Temporão

articles.title: Bell-pair distillation under imperfect operations
articles.title_zh: 不完美操作下的贝尔对蒸馏
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35699v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We recently proposed an entanglement distillation protocol based on local operations and classical communication that probabilistically and universally distills a maximally entangled Bell pair from multiple copies of an unknown two-qubit state [Phys. Rev. Lett. 135, 260202 (2025)]. Here, we investigate the robustness of this protocol against imperfections in its implementation. We consider several incoherent and coherent gate-error models, as well as measurement readout errors, and determine the regimes in which distillation enhances the fidelity with the target Bell state. We find that the protocol remains effective over substantial error ranges, although its robustness depends strongly on the type of error. We further analyze asymmetric errors between the two parties and identify conditions under which complementary postselection outcomes yield identical distillation dynamics, allowing the success probability to be enhanced.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了先前提出的一种基于局部操作和经典通信的纠缠蒸馏协议，在不完美操作下的鲁棒性。研究考虑了多种非相干和相干门误差模型以及测量读出误差，并确定了蒸馏能提高目标贝尔态保真度的范围。结果表明，该协议在相当大的误差范围内仍然有效，但其鲁棒性强烈依赖于误差类型。
authors: András Kinyó, Tamás Kiss, Orsolya Kálmán

articles.title: Distillable entanglement is continuous
articles.title_zh: 可蒸馏纠缠的连续性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35722v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We prove continuity of distillable entanglement, the optimal asymptotic rate at which copies of a bipartite state can be converted into maximally entangled pairs by local operations and classical communication (LOCC) with vanishing error. We establish an explicit asymptotic continuity bound that holds for arbitrary bipartite states and depends logarithmically on the system dimension. This bound has the same structure as known continuity bounds for conditional entropy, entanglement cost, and relative entropy of entanglement. Our proof constructs an explicit LOCC protocol that converts either of two arbitrary bipartite states into the other at an ebit cost that vanishes as their trace distance tends to zero.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了可蒸馏纠缠的连续性，即可通过局部操作和经典通信（LOCC）将双体态副本以渐近最优速率转换为最大纠缠对，且误差趋于零。研究建立了一个适用于任意双体态的显式渐近连续性界限，该界限与条件熵、纠缠成本和纠缠相对熵的已知连续性界限结构相同。
authors: Lukas Schmitt, David Sutter

articles.title: Parametrically Enhanced Ergotropy and Charging Power in a Three-Mode Bosonic Quantum Battery
articles.title_zh: 三模玻色子量子电池中参数增强的功提取能力和充电功率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35734v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum batteries are quantum systems that potentially serve as fuel for other quantum devices by receiving and supplying energy. In this work, we propose a theoretical scheme to enhance ergotropy and charging power of quantum Battery in the system under consideration through squeezed light. Moreover, The system comprises a coherently driven charger cavity, a strongly dissipative auxiliary cavity acting as a mediator, and an energy--storage battery cavity. Quantum nonreciprocity and directional energy flow are established via destructive quantum interference between the direct coupling path and the loss--engineered indirect path. A degenerate optical parametric amplifier integrated into the charger cavity acts as an active, phase--sensitive energy source that injects two--photon quantum excitations and anomalous correlations. Using a strictly open--quantum--system framework derived directly from the Lindblad master equation, we obtain the full expectation--value dynamics and stationary states. We show that active parametric driving drastically increases the stored energy and peak charging power while maintaining nonreciprocal energy trapping in the battery. We achieve a multi-order-of-magnitude boost in the battery's stored energy, charging power, and ergotropy. We also analyze the effects of pure dephasing on the charging power, ergotropy, and extractable work quality.. Although two--photon pumping introduces photon--number fluctuations that slightly lower the fractional ergotropy ratio a̧l Wₘ̊ B/a̧l Eₘ̊ B, the absolute extractable work remains substantially elevated compared to unassisted configurations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种理论方案，通过压缩光增强三模玻色子量子电池的功提取能力和充电功率。该系统包含一个相干驱动的充电腔、一个强耗散辅助腔和一个储能电池腔。研究表明，集成在充电腔中的简并光学参量放大器作为有源、相位敏感的能量源，能显著增加存储能量和峰值充电功率，同时保持非互易能量传输。
authors: Mustapha Tarboun, Mohamed Amazioug

articles.title: Competing coherence geometries in positive maps: positivity hierarchies, atomicity, and optimal entanglement witnesses
articles.title_zh: 正映射中竞争的相干几何：正性层级、原子性和最优纠缠判据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35758v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a family of positive maps on qudits whose Choi operators combine two competing coherence patterns: independent exchange couplings and a collective set of diagonal couplings. For every mixed member of the family, we derive exact conditions for positivity, complete positivity, and all intermediate levels of k-positivity, and we determine the complete phase structure of decomposability and atomicity. The higher-positivity thresholds depend on the channel multiplicities, whereas the exact decomposability boundary is universal in scale-free coordinates. Its proof combines an explicit positive-plus-copositive decomposition with a matching family of positive-partial-transpose (PPT) states. The latter form PPT edge states whose detection region is an ellipse, or a disk after collective rescaling. An embedded-qutrit certificate shows that indecomposability and atomicity coincide throughout the mixed family. In contrast, the purely collective endpoint is decomposable over its entire positive interval. Finally, at maximal coherence, an explicit positive subtraction produces an atomic optimal entanglement witness with the spanning property and a strictly larger PPT- detection set. The study thus provides an exactly solvable setting in which k-positivity, decomposability, atomicity, PPT-edge-state geometry, and witness optimality can be compared in arbitrary local dimension.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了一族在qudit上的正映射，其Choi算符结合了独立的交换耦合和集体对角耦合两种竞争的相干模式。研究推导了该族中每个混合成员的正性、完全正性以及所有中间k-正性的精确条件，并确定了可分解性和原子性的完整相结构。在最大相干性下，通过显式正减法可以产生一个具有跨越性质的原子最优纠缠判据。
authors: Massimiliano F. Sacchi

articles.title: Twist-controlled imaginary-time Mpemba effect in quantum spin systems
articles.title_zh: 量子自旋系统中扭曲控制的虚时间Mpemba效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35784v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct a controllable imaginary-time Mpemba effect in quantum spin systems using spatially modulated local rotations without changing initial bipartite entanglement spectra and correlation magnitudes. This feature unambiguously isolates the redistribution of spectral weights as the sole driver of the anomalous relaxation. Using the compact-boson description, we reveal that these twists act as precise mode selectors: higher-harmonic twists exclusively populate high-energy standing waves, structurally bypassing slow-decaying infrared modes to accelerate convergence. We derive exact analytical crossing times for these reversals and demonstrate that intentionally reintroducing the slow-mode population systematically delays the ITME. This exact mechanism is validated beyond the fixed-point theory via calculations on interacting XXZ chains and ladders. Furthermore, a twelve-qubit simulation of variational quantum imaginary-time evolution reproduces the reversals and their controlled delay, providing a concrete route to realize this protocol in realistic quantum circuits. Ultimately, these results provide a strictly controllable and exact starting point for realizing and investigating the imaginary-time Mpemba effect, establishing a foundational paradigm to harness anomalous non-equilibrium relaxation in quantum ground-state preparations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一种在量子自旋系统中可控的虚时间Mpemba效应，通过空间调制局部旋转实现，而不改变初始双体纠缠谱和关联强度。研究揭示，这些扭曲作为精确的模式选择器，高次谐波扭曲能加速收敛。十二量子比特的变分量子虚时间演化模拟再现了这些反转及其受控延迟，为在实际量子电路中实现该协议提供了具体途径。
authors: Zhi-Yao Ning, Zi-Xiang Li, Naoki Kawashima

articles.title: The ǎrepsilon-smoothed Entanglement of Formation and its relation to the Moreau-Yosida approximation
articles.title_zh: ε-平滑纠缠形成度及其与Moreau-Yosida近似的关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35797v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We describe a family of convex continuous functions EF,ǎᵣₑₚₛᵢₗₒₙ, ǎrepsilonin(0,1], on the set of states of a bipartite quantum system (consisting of finite-dimensional or infinite-dimensional subsystems) obtained by applying the Mora-Piani-Briegel construction of ǎrepsilon-measure (proposed in [Phys. Rev. A 109, 052413]) to the Entanglement of Formation (EoF) with the use of the trace norm distance in the role of basic metric. These functions are non-increasing in ǎrepsilon and converge pointwise to the EoF as ǎrepsilon→0⁺. We conducted a detailed analysis of properties of the functions EF,ǎᵣₑₚₛᵢₗₒₙ, using (among others) the relationship between the family EF,ǎᵣₑₚₛᵢₗₒₙǎᵣₑₚₛᵢₗₒₙᵢₙ[₀,₁] and the family E^łambda_F(h̊o)łₐₘbdₐ>₀ of Moreau-Yosida approximations of the EoF explored in [arXiv:2609.30246]. We obtain a variational expression for the functions EF,ǎᵣₑₚₛᵢₗₒₙ (which for ǎrepsilon=0 turns into the standard variational expression for the EoF). We also describe the weak subadditivity property of the functions EF,ǎᵣₑₚₛᵢₗₒₙ and analyse their continuity properties. The semicontinuity bounds for the EoF (presented in [Lob.J.Math., 46, 2632-2658],[arXiv:2404.07978]) allow us to obtain easily computable upper bounds on the rate of uniform convergence of the function EF,ǎᵣₑₚₛᵢₗₒₙ to the EoF as ǎrepsilon→0⁺ on the sets of states with bounded rank/energy of one of the marginal states. Applicability of the obtained results to other entanglement measures, in particular, to the relative entropy of entanglement, is discussed. As an auxiliary result, it is shown that for any state of an infinite-dimensional bipartite quantum system, there exists a nearest separable state w.r.t. the trace norm distance. The non-uniqueness of such a state is also shown.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一系列凸连续函数EF,ε，通过将ε-测度构造应用于纠缠形成度（EoF）并使用迹范数距离，在二分量子系统状态集上得到。这些函数随ε非增，并在ε→0⁺时逐点收敛到EoF。作者详细分析了EF,ε的性质，包括其与EoF的Moreau-Yosida近似族的关系，并得到了其变分表达式。研究还描述了这些函数的弱次可加性和连续性。
authors: M. E. Shirokov

articles.title: Sparse Carleman Embeddings for Nonlinear Discrete Dynamical Systems
articles.title_zh: 非线性离散动力系统的稀疏卡尔曼嵌入
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35824v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Discrete nonlinear dynamical systems arise in population models, iterative optimization, and numerical simulations, where computing many iterations can be costly in high dimensions. We study Carleman embedding for forced quadratic discrete systems and its application to quantum state preparation. Under explicit stability and initial-state assumptions, we prove that the truncation error decreases geometrically with the embedding degree, uniformly over all iterations. A central obstacle in discrete time is that the lifted update can become dense even when the original coefficient maps are sparse. We overcome this obstacle by constructing an exact auxiliary linear-system representation that applies the coefficient maps one tensor factor at a time, with row and column sparsities bounded independently of the truncation degree. After rescaling, the associated history system has a condition number that grows linearly with the iteration count, uniformly in the truncation degree. These results yield a quantum algorithm for preparing an approximation to the normalized nth iterate with constant success probability. Under coherent input-access assumptions, and for fixed sparsity, stability parameters, and a known positive lower bound on the final-state norm, the oracle query complexity is linear in n and polylogarithmic in the inverse accuracy. Numerical experiments in one and three dimensions illustrate the convergence of the truncated embedding.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了强制二次离散系统的卡尔曼嵌入及其在量子态制备中的应用。在明确的稳定性和初始态假设下，证明了截断误差随嵌入度几何级数下降，且在所有迭代中保持一致。为克服离散时间中提升更新可能变得稠密的问题，作者构建了一个精确的辅助线性系统表示，该表示逐个张量因子应用系数映射，行和列的稀疏性独立于截断度。这些结果为以恒定成功概率制备归一化第n次迭代的近似值提供了一种量子算法。
authors: Hsuan-Cheng Wu, Xiantao Li

articles.title: Interference-induced dynamical crossovers in quantum walks on disordered square lattices
articles.title_zh: 无序方格晶格上量子行走的干涉诱导动力学交叉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35828v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study discrete-time quantum walks with Fourier, Grover, and Hadamard coin operators on disordered square lattices, alongside classical random walks. Edges in the lattice are absent with a probability, p. In this case, both classical and quantum walks exhibit an essentially identical degradation of transport. We then study a general version of this model, in which the existing edges are retained. However, the absent edges are no longer absent, but now become partially transmitting, with a transmission coefficient f. We find that the response is now quite sensitive to the walk protocol and coin symmetry. The classical walk exhibits asymptotic stability of the anomalous diffusion exponent, β(t). In comparison, quantum walks exhibit a monotonically decaying β(t) beyond the initial transient regime, leading to the absence of quantum diffusion in two dimensions. We map the transport regimes in the (f,p) plane and identify the contour for β=1, which separates the subdiffusive and superdiffusive regimes. We also examine the effective diffusion coefficient, the inverse participation ratio, and the first two moments of edge transmission. We restrict ourselves to analyzing bulk propagation prior to finite-size boundary reflections. The results indicate that quantum transport depends significantly on coin-specific interference and cannot be fully described by transmission statistics alone.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了在无序方格晶格上，傅里叶、格罗弗和哈达玛硬币算符下的离散时间量子行走以及经典随机行走。当晶格边以概率p缺失时，经典和量子行走表现出相似的输运退化。然而，当缺失的边变为部分透射时，量子行走表现出单调衰减的反常扩散指数，导致二维中量子扩散的缺失。研究绘制了(f,p)平面上的输运区域，并分析了有效扩散系数、逆参与率和边透射的前两个矩。
authors: Ramnarayan Bera, Arijit Roy, Soumyadip Ghosh, Soumen Roy

articles.title: Network nonlocality with tripartite entangled sources
articles.title_zh: 基于三方纠缠源的网络非局域性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35838v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum networks are built from independent sources, and their nonlocality has mostly been studied with sources that emit bipartite entangled states. A source of three entangled qubits is richer, since its nonlocality can be tested by the Mermin or the more demanding Svetlichny inequality. We ask how network nonlocality relates to these two single-source notions and find that the answer depends on the wiring. When two central nodes without inputs share every source, Bell-state measurements turn every Svetlichny violation into a network violation, and even all entangled generalised Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger states violate the network inequality. When a single central node is shared, the relation reverses, and a network violation requires a Mermin violation of the source. With more sources, the maximal violation depends on whether their number is even or odd, and we give tight bounds for both cases. These results show that the way multipartite sources are wired decides which kind of nonlocality a network inherits.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子网络主要通过二方纠缠态源研究其非局域性，而三方纠缠量子比特源则更为丰富。本文探讨了网络非局域性与Mermin和Svetlichny不等式这两种单源概念的关系，发现答案取决于网络布线方式。当两个无输入的中心节点共享每个源时，Bell态测量将所有Svetlichny违背转化为网络违背。当只有一个中心节点共享时，关系反转，网络违背需要源的Mermin违背。研究结果表明，多方源的布线方式决定了网络继承何种非局域性。
authors: Sudip Chakrabarty, Amit Kundu

articles.title: Complete entropy contraction from conditional hyperboundedness
articles.title_zh: 条件超有界性导致的完全熵收缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35863v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: For finite-dimensional quantum channels compatible with a faithful conditional expectation, we show that conditional hyperboundedness and strict GNS contraction together yield a relative entropy contraction. For KMS-symmetric quantum Markov semigroups, a conditional 2→ q hyperboundedness at time t₀>0 combined with a GNS gap łambda>0 implies a modified logarithmic Sobolev constant [ α=fracłambda(1-2/q) 12(łambda t₀₊łog M+1-2/q),] where M is the hyperboundedness constant. As a consequence, completely bounded hyperboundedness over auxiliary systems gives complete versions of entropy contraction with the same rates.
articles.abstract_zh: 对于与忠实条件期望兼容的有限维量子信道，本文证明了条件超有界性和严格GNS收缩共同导致相对熵收缩。对于KMS对称量子马尔可夫半群，在时间t₀>0处的条件2→q超有界性与GNS间隙λ>0相结合，可推导出修正的对数Sobolev常数。因此，辅助系统上的完全有界超有界性能够以相同的速率实现完全熵收缩。
authors: Li Gao, Lijun Wang

articles.title: Controlling transport with structured long-range hopping
articles.title_zh: 利用结构化长程跳跃控制输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33393v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The combined effects of disorder and long-range hopping play an important role in determining localization and transport in low-dimensional quantum systems. We study transport in a one-dimensional disordered chain with nearest-neighbor hopping supplemented by a long-range hopping term. The long-range coupling is characterized by site-dependent amplitudes that may be either uniform or random. We investigate the interplay between diagonal disorder and long-range hopping, characterizing the resulting transport efficiency. We find that nearest-neighbor hopping in the presence of uniform long-range hopping amplitudes strongly suppresses delocalization over a range of weak disorder. The disorder-enhanced transport regime, established in previous studies, can be understood here as the recovery of delocalization from this strongly suppressed regime. An analytical solution in the Anderson eigenstate basis reveals the microscopic origin of this behavior. In particular, we show that the low-disorder regime of strongly suppressed delocalization can be eliminated by introducing randomness into the long-range hopping amplitudes, providing an additional mechanism for enhancing transport and qualitatively changing the response of the system to disorder.
articles.abstract_zh: 无序和长程跳跃的综合效应在低维量子系统中对局域化和输运起着重要作用。本研究探讨了一维无序链中的输运，该链具有最近邻跳跃并辅以长程跳跃项。研究发现，在均匀长程跳跃振幅存在下，最近邻跳跃在一定范围的弱无序下强烈抑制了离域化。通过在长程跳跃振幅中引入随机性，可以消除这种强烈抑制的离域化区域，从而提供了一种控制输运效率的额外手段。
authors: Boris Gurevich, Michael H. Kolodrubetz

articles.title: Dephasing-powered open quantum-dot battery
articles.title_zh: 退相干驱动的开放量子点电池
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33408v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We propose a simple realization of an open quantum battery powered by local dephasing. The setup consists of a triple-quantum-dot chain coupled at one end to a thermal reservoir, with the dot at the opposite end strongly detuned to form a high-energy storage element. Local dephasing populates this highly excited state and autonomously drives the system into a nonequilibrium steady state with high ergotropic efficiency. We find a limit where the ergotropic efficiency approaches unity, while the ergotropy itself approaches one-third of the energy detuning. We characterize the battery through its energy-storage performance, charging time, and stability, showing that the charged state remains long-lived after the dephasing source is switched off. We then demonstrate two complementary protocols for extracting the stored energy. First, nearly all the available ergotropy can be recovered through a simple cyclic unitary protocol involving only modulation of the detuned-dot gate. Second, coupling the detuned dot to an electronic load allows the extraction of electrochemical work exceeding the initial ergotropy, thereby accessing part of the battery's passive energy. Our results establish local dephasing as an autonomous resource for charging open quantum batteries and demonstrate simple routes for extracting the resulting stored energy in experimentally accessible mesoscopic platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种由局部退相干驱动的开放量子电池的简单实现。该装置由一个三量子点链组成，一端连接热库，另一端的量子点强烈失谐以形成高能存储单元。局部退相干使高激发态被占据，并自主地将系统驱动到具有高功能效率的非平衡稳态。研究发现，在某个极限下，功能效率接近统一，而功能本身接近能量失谐的三分之一。作者还展示了两种互补的能量提取方案。
authors: Alok Nath Singh, Rafael Sánchez, Andrew N. Jordan

articles.title: Communication Complexity of Integer Matrix Singularity
articles.title_zh: 整数矩阵奇异性的通信复杂度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33521v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Alice and Bob hold complementary halves of the columns of an n× n matrix of k-bit integers and decide whether it is singular over mathbb Q. Up to constant-factor dimension growth, this partitioned problem is equivalent to additive singularity, where Alice and Bob hold n× n matrices A,B of k-bit integers and test the singularity of A+B over mathbb Q. We prove a bounded-error quantum lower bound Ømega(minn³/²sqrtkłog n,n²łog(nk)) and a randomized upper bound O(n²mink,łog(k+łog n)). The bounds match at Θ(n²łog(nk)) for kge nłog n. The lower bound holds even under the promise of rank n-1 versus n. Its proof combines an integer witness with a local digit encoding, while the upper-bound protocol lifts modular kernel relations using short messages. Bitwise sharing changes how the communication complexity depends on the entry bit length k. If Alice and Bob instead hold n× n matrices A,B of k-bit integers and test whether their entrywise bitwise XOR Aøplus B is singular over mathbb Q, we prove a quantum lower bound Ømega(n²k), matching the trivial upper bound. This lower bound holds even under the promise of rank n-1 versus n. Our proof uses a dense weighted equation and a signed Fourier witness whose exceptional dyadic frequencies can be removed at small variation cost.
articles.abstract_zh: Alice和Bob分别持有n×n矩阵列的互补一半，并判断其在有理数域上是否奇异。本文证明了加性奇异性的有界误差量子下界Ω(min(n⁽³/2)sqrt(k)log n, n² log(nk)))和随机上界O(n² min(k, log(k+log n)))，在k >= n log n时两者匹配。该下界即使在秩为n-1与n的承诺下也成立。此外，对于Alice和Bob持有n×n矩阵A,B并测试其逐元素位异或A⊕B是否奇异的问题，本文证明了量子下界Ω(n² k)，与平凡上界匹配。
authors: Chengu Wang

articles.title: Admissible Subspaces for the Collective Haar Twirl: Schur-Weyl Classification and Heredity under Tensor-Factor Reduction
articles.title_zh: 集体Haar旋转的容许子空间：Schur-Weyl分类和张量因子约化下的遗传性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33553v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum private broadcasting (textsfQPB) asks whether a quantum message can be encrypted once, broadcast to several recipients, and decrypted locally while the joint ciphertext reveals no plaintext information. Broadbent, González-Guillén, and Schuknecht showed that the full tensor-power space (mathcal H_døtⁱmes t) is generally unsuitable for textsfQPB, identified (Sym^t(mathcal H_d)) as a natural plaintext space, introduced symmetric unitary (t)-designs, and asked which other subspaces support private broadcast. Using Schur-Weyl duality, we classify all subspaces (mathcal Ssubseteqmathcal H_døtⁱmes t) on which the collective Haar twirl (mathcal T⁽t⁾) is a replacement channel. Precisely, every Schur-Weyl block weight must be independent of the encoded state, and in each active block (V_łambdaøtimes W_łambda), the reduced state on the multiplicity space (W_łambda) must be fixed. This yields explicit two-block and general multiblock constructions and realizes the classification as the Schur-Weyl form of the Knill-Laflamme conditions for a complementary channel of (mathcal T⁽t⁾). We also introduce a canonical reduction under deletion of a recipient and characterize privacy heredity, design heredity, and textsfQPB-heredity for exact restricted designs. The symmetric tower is fully textsfQPB-hereditary, whereas the antisymmetric tower is fully privacy-hereditary and is design-hereditary from level (s) to (s-1) exactly when (słeq(d+1)/2). For canonical carriers in arbitrary Schur-Weyl blocks, hereditary reduction is governed by multiplicity-free branching along the Young graph and inclusion of the associated Peter-Weyl coefficient spaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子私有广播（QPB）旨在探讨量子消息能否被加密一次，广播给多个接收者，并在本地解密，同时联合密文不泄露任何明文信息。本文利用Schur-Weyl对偶性，分类了集体Haar旋转T⁽t)作为替换信道的所有容许子空间S ⊆ H_d^⊗t。每个Schur-Weyl块权重必须独立于编码状态，并且在每个活动块V_λ ⊗ W_λ中，多重空间W_λ上的约化状态必须是固定的。这提供了显式的两块和一般多块构造，并将分类实现为T⁽t)互补信道的Knill-Laflamme条件的Schur-Weyl形式。
authors: Sayantan Ganguly

articles.title: Deep-Microscopic Photonic Bandstructure of a Two-Dimensional Honeycomb Lattice
articles.title_zh: 二维蜂窝晶格的深微观光子能带结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33709v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Conventional descriptions of light in materials rely on macroscopic models that average the optical response over the microscopic lattice structures. These models are deployed in the semi-classical limit, where the collective local response over many lattice sites is adequate. However, they fail to capture the full spatial dispersion, which requires a lattice-resolved description of light. We address this limitation by formulating a deep-microscopic nonlocal theory of the photon based on the Maxwell Hamiltonian and its characteristic equation. The solution reveals the full spatial dispersion in the form of deep-microscopic photonic bandstructure, and corresponding real-space Bloch field textures. We demonstrate our theory for a two-dimensional (2D) tight-binding model of a gapped honeycomb lattice. Our framework thus extends photons to the same microscopic footing as electrons or phonons, providing a unified route to studying topology, dissipation, and quantum fluctuations of light in dispersive materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统的光学描述依赖于宏观模型，这些模型对微观晶格结构的光学响应进行平均，无法捕捉完整的空间色散。本文通过基于麦克斯韦哈密顿量及其特征方程，提出了一种深微观非局域光子理论，解决了这一限制。该理论揭示了深微观光子能带结构形式的完整空间色散和相应的实空间布洛赫场纹理。作者以二维带隙蜂窝晶格的紧束缚模型为例，验证了该理论，将光子扩展到与电子或声子相同的微观基础。
authors: Pronoy Das, Sathwik Bharadwaj, Wenbo Sun, Zubin Jacob

articles.title: Symmetry-resolved quasilocal entanglement as a key to Mott and pseudogap physics in plaquette CDMFT
articles.title_zh: 板状CDMFT中对称性分辨的准局域纠缠作为Mott和赝能隙物理的关键
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34470v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In order to identify intrinsic quantum resources in strongly interacting fermionic systems, we introduce a symmetry resolution of the parity-superselected two-site entanglement, as measured by both the fermionic negativity and the relative entropy of entanglement. We discuss how the symmetry resolution can be extended also to the full entanglement in pure and mixed two-site states. We apply our recipe to the Hubbard model, first for a dimer, and then for a plaquette cluster dynamical mean-field theory, an established method tailored to accurately capture short-range correlations. Following the evolution of the model through the interaction- and density-driven Mott transitions at zero temperature, we highlight how the three symmetry-resolved components of the two-site entanglement probe different key aspects of Mott and pseudogap physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 为了识别强相互作用费米子系统中的内在量子资源，本文引入了奇偶性超选择两点纠缠的对称性分辨，通过费米子负性和纠缠相对熵进行测量。作者将该方法应用于哈伯德模型，首先是二聚体，然后是板状团簇动力学平均场理论。通过模型在零温下经历相互作用和密度驱动的Mott转变的演化，研究强调了两点纠缠的三个对称性分辨分量如何探测Mott和赝能隙物理的不同关键方面。
authors: Gabriele Bellomia, Carlos Mejuto-Zaera, Massimo Capone, Adriano Amaricci

articles.title: Large Language Models for Quantum Code Translation: An Exploratory Study
articles.title_zh: 大型语言模型在量子代码翻译中的探索性研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34841v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum software development is challenged by quantum-mechanical semantics and fragmented software development kits (SDKs), which complicate cross-SDK code translation and execution. In this paper, we propose an LLM-based approach for translating executable programs between high-level quantum SDKs. We develop a quantum-aware translation workflow whose prompt design and validation reflect quantum semantics and accommodate the version evolution of quantum ecosystems. We conduct a preliminary evaluation of 4 LLM configurations on 43 tasks, translating Qiskit programs to PennyLane and Q#. LLMs achieve a zero-shot Pass@1 of up to 72.33%, while one-shot prompting further improves the translation effectiveness. These results suggest potential for quantum code translation by LLMs.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子软件开发面临量子力学语义和分散的软件开发工具包（SDK）的挑战，这使得跨SDK代码翻译和执行复杂化。本文提出了一种基于大型语言模型（LLM）的方法，用于在高级量子SDK之间翻译可执行程序。该方法开发了一个量子感知的翻译工作流，其提示设计和验证反映了量子语义并适应了量子生态系统的版本演进。初步评估显示，LLM在零样本设置下Pass@1准确率高达72.33%，单样本提示进一步提高了翻译效果，表明LLM在量子代码翻译方面具有巨大潜力。
authors: Xiyuan Li, Yuechen Li, Jianjun Zhao

articles.title: Bargmann-invariant witness of the graviton commutator
articles.title_zh: 引力子对易子的Bargmann不变性见证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35253v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We identify the phase of a Bargmann invariant of two matter-wave interferometers as a quantum gravity signature that cannot be reproduced by any branchwise-definite classical gravitational field. For matter coupled linearly to linearized gravity, the interferometric coherence factorizes exactly into a conservative Newtonian phase, the characteristic functional of the graviton state, and a commutator phase. For Wigner-positive graviton states, the first two are classically reproducible; therefore, decoherence alone cannot certify that gravity is quantized. The Bargmann phase isolates the commutator, which is independent of the graviton state and of all Newtonian interactions and is bounded by which-path decoherence. For gravity, this radiation-reaction effect is sixty orders of magnitude below experimental reach, but trapped-ion analogs can test it at order unity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将两个物质波干涉仪的Bargmann不变量的相位识别为一种量子引力特征，该特征无法通过任何分支确定的经典引力场重现。对于与线性化引力线性耦合的物质，干涉相干性精确分解为保守的牛顿相位、引力子态的特征泛函和对易子相位。Bargmann相位能够分离出对易子，它独立于引力子态和所有牛顿相互作用，并受限于路径退相干。尽管对于引力而言，这种辐射反作用效应远低于实验可及范围，但囚禁离子模拟可以在单位量级上对其进行测试。
authors: Hiroki Matsui

articles.title: Measurement-dependent reduction of open dynamics in the quantum phase estimation algorithm: the visible subspace and the damped Fejér kernel
articles.title_zh: 量子相位估计算法中开放动力学的测量依赖性约化：可见子空间和阻尼Fejér核
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35332v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: For the quantum phase estimation (QPE) algorithm we study the minimal space of observables that is sufficient to predict the entire output distribution under open dynamics of the counting register. Building on the general Krylov theory of reduction, we compute the structure of this space explicitly for the full Fourier measurement. The outcome probabilities are determined by cyclic sums of the state matrix. If the adjoint generator is diagonal on the matrix units, the spectral classes inside the residue classes of the index difference modulo the register dimension M give a constructive basis, an exact dimension formula, and attainable bounds: the dimension of the visible space lies between M and M²⁻M+1. The class includes independent qubit dephasing, and an analytically solvable reference model of Gorini--Kossakowski--Lindblad--Sudarshan (GKLS) type yields a damped Fejér kernel; two random-unitary channels with the same Ramsey contrast show that higher harmonics are distinguishable in the QPE distribution. For approximate reduction we use a finite-time Gramian and an a posteriori residual estimate, with a quadratic error order for a reducing unperturbed subspace and a compatible initial state. Numerical calculations check the consistency of the representations and the behaviour of the error under non-Toeplitz perturbations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了量子相位估计算法（QPE）中，在计数寄存器开放动力学下，足以预测整个输出分布的最小可观测空间。基于Krylov约化理论，我们为全傅里叶测量明确计算了该空间的结构。结果概率由状态矩阵的循环和决定，并给出了可见空间的维度公式和界限。该研究还包括独立的量子比特退相干，并提出了一个Gorini-Kossakowski-Lindblad-Sudarshan（GKLS）类型的解析可解参考模型，其产生了阻尼Fejér核，揭示了QPE分布中高次谐波的可区分性。
authors: Marina O. Gordeichuk, Oleg M. Kiselev

articles.title: Growth Phase Map of α and beta Tantalum as a Function of Growth Temperature and Oxygen Partial Pressure
articles.title_zh: α和β钽生长相图随生长温度和氧分压的变化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35768v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Tantalum thin films are used in low-loss superconducting quantum circuits, yet the growth conditions governing selection of α-Ta(110), α-Ta(111), and metastable β-Ta on c-plane sapphire remain uncertain. We deposited 100 nm Ta films by dc magnetron sputtering on Al₂O₃₍₀₀₀₁₎ at 300-900 ⁱ̧rcC while varying the O₂ partial pressure from a 5.5×10⁻¹¹ Torr ultrahigh-vacuum baseline to 2.23×10⁻⁴ Torr. Absorption-corrected X-ray diffraction texture coefficients were used to construct a ternary phase-orientation growth map in terms of temperature and the oxygen-to-Ta impingement flux ratio (2ΦO_₂/ΦTₐłeq4.8×10⁻⁶ to 19). Without added oxygen, α-Ta(110) dominated at every temperature. At an O₂ pressure of only 2.5×10⁻⁹ Torr (2ΦO_₂/ΦTₐ=2.2×10⁻⁴), α-Ta(111) accounted for 98-99% of the normalized texture weight from 300 to 700 ⁱ̧rcC, decreasing to 65% at 900 ⁱ̧rcC. Substantial β-Ta formed only at the highest oxygen dose, dominating at 300 ⁱ̧rcC and disappearing at 900 ⁱ̧rcC. The apparent β(001)/α(110) selection energy of 1.07±0.16 eV is comparable to the activation energy for oxygen diffusion in Ta, consistent with oxygen transport influencing phase selection. Oxygen also produced orientation-dependent changes in crystallite size and microstrain. These findings establish oxygen-controlled processing windows for phase- and orientation-selective growth of Ta films for superconducting devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 钽薄膜在低损耗超导量子电路中应用广泛，但其在c面蓝宝石上生长α-Ta(110)、α-Ta(111)和亚稳态β-Ta的条件仍不确定。本研究通过直流磁控溅射在300-900°C温度范围和不同氧分压下沉积了100纳米钽薄膜。利用X射线衍射织构系数构建了温度和氧-钽撞击通量比的三元相-取向生长图。结果显示，无氧时α-Ta(110)在所有温度下占主导，而少量氧气即可使α-Ta(111)在300-700°C下占据98-99%的织构权重。只有在最高氧剂量下才形成大量β-Ta，并在300°C时占主导，900°C时消失。β(001)/α(110)的表观选择能与氧在钽中的扩散活化能相当，表明氧传输影响相选择。
authors: Marius O. Eji, Tyler J. Kirkpatrick, Ty J. Cawein, Joseph P. Corbett

articles.title: How Retrocausality Helps
articles.title_zh: 逆因果关系如何提供帮助
articles.abstract: arXiv:1706.02290v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: It has become increasingly apparent that a number of perplexing issues associated with the interpretation of quantum mechanics are more easily resolved once the notion of retrocausality is introduced. The aim here is to list and discuss various examples where a clear explanation has become available via this approach. In so doing, the intention is to highlight that this direction of research deserves more attention than it presently receives.
articles.abstract_zh: 越来越明显的是，一旦引入逆因果关系的概念，许多与量子力学解释相关的令人困惑的问题就更容易解决。本文旨在列举并讨论通过这种方法获得清晰解释的各种例子。通过这样做，旨在强调这一研究方向值得比目前更多的关注。
authors: Roderick Sutherland

articles.title: Generalized coherent states and uncertainty relations in PT-symmetric position dependent mass systems
articles.title_zh: PT对称位置依赖质量系统中的广义相干态和不确定关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2208.10336v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this paper, we investigate a class of PT-symmetric quantum systems with position-dependent effective mass (PDEM). We factorize the PDEM Hamiltonian using a pair of first order differential operators. The resulting commutation relation introduces the notion of a position-dependent effective Planck parameter, which reduces to Planck's constant in the conventional Hermitian quantum system with constant mass. These factorization operators define a deformed phase space, within which we construct generalized coherent states to first order in the PT-symmetry parameter. We then revisit the Heisenberg uncertainty principle for this state and demonstrate that the deformed position and momentum operators satisfy the corresponding uncertainty relation in the PT-symmetric PDEM framework. Finally, we present explicit computational results for a toy-model oscillator with position-dependent effective mass in a PT-symmetric setting. In the conclusions section, we outline a gedankenexperiment for experimental determination of PT-symmetric parameter.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一类具有位置依赖有效质量（PDEM）的PT对称量子系统。我们使用一对一阶微分算子对PDEM哈密顿量进行因子分解，由此产生的对易关系引入了位置依赖有效普朗克参数的概念。我们在此基础上构建了PT对称参数一阶的广义相干态，并重新审视了海森堡不确定性原理。研究表明，变形的位置和动量算子在PT对称PDEM框架下满足相应的不确定关系，并给出了一个玩具模型振荡器的计算结果。文末还提出了一个用于实验确定PT对称参数的理想实验方案。
authors: Pinaki Patra

articles.title: Conditional Motional Squeezing of an Optomechanical Oscillator Approaching the Quantum Regime
articles.title_zh: 光机械振子接近量子态时的条件运动挤压
articles.abstract: arXiv:2410.09208v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Squeezed mechanical states are a highly coveted resource for quantum-enhanced sensing and serve as a compelling platform for probing the interplay between gravity and quantum mechanics. It has been predicted that a mechanical oscillator can be prepared into a quantum squeezed state if the applied measurement rate is fast relative to its mechanical resonance frequency. However, the experimental feasibility of this protocol has remained uncertain because of the difficulty in achieving low-frequency oscillators with sufficiently strong read-out. Here, we demonstrate that a careful selection of parameters in an optomechanical system, combined with optimal filtering techniques, enables the preparation of a 50 ng GaAs cantilever in a conditional classical squeezed state, achieving a minimum uncertainty of just 1.07 plus/minus 0.04 times the zero-point fluctuation level. This minimum variance is 3 orders of magnitude smaller than what has been achieved in previous experiments using the same protocol. Although we do not fully achieve the quantum squeezed regime, our demonstration provides definitive evidence that a measurement-based protocol is a practical and effective approach for the real-time preparation of macroscopic oscillators in quantum squeezed states.
articles.abstract_zh: 挤压机械态是量子增强传感的宝贵资源，也是探索引力与量子力学相互作用的引人注目的平台。本研究通过在光机械系统中精心选择参数并结合优化滤波技术，成功制备了一个50纳克GaAs悬臂梁的条件经典挤压态。该状态的最小不确定性仅为零点涨落水平的1.07±0.04倍，比以往实验的最小方差小三个数量级。尽管尚未完全达到量子挤压态，但这项工作为基于测量的协议提供了明确的实验证据，证明其在实现量子挤压态方面的可行性。
authors: Benjamin B. Lane, Junxin Chen, Ronald E. Pagano, Scott Aronson, Garrett D. Cole, Xinghui Yin, Thomas R. Corbitt, Nergis Mavalvala

articles.title: Higher-order exceptional points in a non-reciprocal waveguide beam splitter
articles.title_zh: 非互易波导分束器中的高阶奇异点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.21445v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Non-Hermitian systems have attracted significant interest because of their intriguing properties, including exceptional points (EPs), where eigenvalues and the corresponding eigenstates coalesce. In particular, quantum systems with EPs exhibit an enhanced sensitivity to external perturbations, which increases with the order of the EP. Therefore, higher-order EPs hold significant potential for advanced sensing applications, but they are challenging to achieve due to stringent symmetry requirements. In this work, we study the dynamics of a generalized lossy waveguide beam splitter with asymmetric coupling by introducing non-reciprocity as a tunable parameter to achieve higher-order EPs even without dissipation. Moreover, we analyze the evolution of NOON-states under activated non-reciprocity, highlighting its impact on quantum systems. Our results open new pathways for realizing higher-order EPs in non-reciprocal open quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 非厄米系统因其奇异特性（包括本征值和相应本征态合并的奇异点EPs）而备受关注。量子系统中的EPs对外部扰动表现出增强的敏感性，且敏感性随EP阶数增加。本文研究了具有非对称耦合的广义损耗波导分束器的动力学，引入非互易性作为可调参数，即使没有耗散也能实现高阶EPs。研究结果为在非互易开放量子系统中实现高阶EPs开辟了新途径，并分析了NOON态在激活非互易性下的演化及其对量子系统的影响。
authors: Hamed Ghaemi-Dizicheh, Shahram Dehdashti, Andreas Hanke, Ahmed Touhami, Janis Nötzel

articles.title: Simon's Period Finding on a Quantum Annealer
articles.title_zh: 量子退火器上的Simon周期查找算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.10771v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Dating to 1994, Simon's period-finding algorithm is among the earliest and most fragile of quantum algorithms. The algorithm's fragility arises from the requirement that, to solve an n qubit problem, one must fault-tolerantly sample O(n) linearly independent values from a solution space. In this paper, we study an adiabatic implementation of Simon's algorithm that requires a constant number of successful samples regardless of problem size. We implement this algorithm on D-Wave hardware and solve problems with up to 298 qubits. We compare the runtime of classical algorithms to the D-Wave solution to analyze any potential advantage.
articles.abstract_zh: Simon周期查找算法是量子算法中最早且最脆弱的算法之一，其脆弱性源于解决n量子比特问题需要从解空间中容错采样O(n)个线性独立值。本文研究了Simon算法的绝热实现，该实现无论问题大小如何，都只需要恒定数量的成功样本。我们在D-Wave硬件上实现了该算法，并解决了多达298个量子比特的问题。我们比较了经典算法与D-Wave解决方案的运行时间，以分析潜在的优势。
authors: Reece Robertson, Emery Doucet, Zakaria Mzaouali, Krzysztof Domino, Bartłomiej Gardas, Sebastian Deffner

articles.title: Intrinsic Hamiltonian of Mean Force and Strong-Coupling Quantum Thermodynamics
articles.title_zh: 平均力本征哈密顿量与强耦合量子热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.02888v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a universal thermodynamic framework for quantum systems strongly coupled to thermal reservoirs, identifying the class of initial conditions required for consistent thermodynamic behavior. Unlike other approaches, our framework provides a unified description of both thermodynamic processes and thermostatic properties, while preserving the same gauge freedoms as in the standard weak-coupling regime and retaining the von Neumann expression for the thermodynamic entropy. Furthermore, the formulation is entirely in terms of the system's reduced state, relying only on variables accessible through local microscopic control. It is therefore directly connected to experimentally accessible quantities, making it possible to address operational questions concerning the controlled system-such as determining the minimum work required to drive it between two prescribed states in the presence of a strongly coupled reservoir. We validate our approach using a paradigmatic model of a structured bosonic reservoir.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个普适的量子系统热力学框架，适用于与热库强耦合的情况，并确定了实现一致热力学行为所需的初始条件类别。该框架统一描述了热力学过程和恒温性质，同时保留了标准弱耦合体系中的规范自由度，并沿用了冯诺依曼熵表达式。该公式完全基于系统的约化态，仅依赖于局部微观控制可访问的变量，因此与实验可测量量直接相关，能够解决关于受控系统的操作性问题，例如在强耦合热库存在下，将系统从一个预设态驱动到另一个预设态所需的最小功。我们使用结构化玻色子热库的范式模型验证了该方法。
authors: Ignacio González, Sagnik Chakraborty, Ángel Rivas

articles.title: Quantum Counting in the Rydberg Blockade
articles.title_zh: Rydberg阻塞中的量子计数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.19298v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose a quantum algorithm for approximately counting the number of solutions to planar 2-satisfiability (2SAT) formulas natively on neutral-atom quantum computers (NAQC). Our algorithm maps Boolean variables to atomic registers arranged in space according to a given formula, so that 2SAT constraints are enforced via the Rydberg blockade between neighboring atoms. A quench of an initial computational basis state then produces a superposition of all solutions after sufficiently long evolution. For almost uniform superpositions, a polynomial number of measurements is enough to estimate the solution count up to any constant multiplicative factor via sampling-based counting. Numerical simulations show that the protocol leads to almost uniform solution sampling in 1D and 2D grids and produces accurate counts for small random 2SAT instances on punctured grids. We implement our algorithm on Pasqal's Orion Alpha NAQC and demonstrate approximate counts within small multiplicative factors of the exact count for a planar grid instance with 81 atoms.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种量子算法，用于在中性原子量子计算机（NAQC）上近似计算平面2-可满足性（2SAT）公式的解数量。该算法将布尔变量映射到空间中根据给定公式排列的原子寄存器，通过相邻原子间的Rydberg阻塞来强制执行2SAT约束。初始计算基态的淬火在足够长的演化后产生所有解的叠加态。对于几乎均匀的叠加态，通过基于采样的计数，多项式数量的测量足以将解计数估计到任意常数乘法因子。数值模拟表明，该协议在1D和2D网格中实现了几乎均匀的解采样，并为穿孔网格上的小型随机2SAT实例生成了准确的计数。我们在Pasqal的Orion Alpha NAQC上实现了该算法，并展示了81个原子的平面网格实例的近似计数在精确计数的较小乘法因子内。
authors: Joseph Gibson, Victor Drouin-Touchette, Stefanos Kourtis

articles.title: Universal two-excitation scattering in two-dimensional subwavelength atomic arrays
articles.title_zh: 二维亚波长原子阵列中的普适双激发散射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.17085v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Subwavelength atomic arrays are a leading platform for engineering strong light-matter interactions, presenting exciting opportunities for quantum science. However, a full understanding of their multi-excitation dynamics remains a significant challenge. In this Letter, we uncover a remarkable universal phenomenon that emerges in these arrays. Using scattering theory to analyze two-excitation interactions, we reveal a profound simplification near critical points of the collective atomic excitation band structure, determined solely from single-excitation properties. At these critical points, which emerge as band edges and saddle points (Van Hove singularities) in the two-excitation phase space, scattering becomes universal and the full two-excitation scattering matrix decomposes into a block-diagonal form. Remarkably, all scattering processes involving the photon field are completely suppressed, resulting in the perfect isolation of a unitary, nonlinear interaction channel between collective dark spin waves.
