Our findings provide exact analytical insights into few-body nonlinearities and establish a universal framework for analyzing complex scattering phenomena in ordered atomic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 亚波长原子阵列是工程强光-物质相互作用的重要平台，为量子科学提供了激动人心的机遇。然而，全面理解其多激发动力学仍是一个重大挑战。本文揭示了这些阵列中出现的一种显著的普适现象。通过散射理论分析双激发相互作用，我们发现在集体原子激发能带结构的临界点附近存在深刻的简化，这些简化仅由单激发特性决定。在这些临界点（在双激发相空间中表现为能带边缘和鞍点），散射变得普适，并且完整的双激发散射矩阵分解为块对角形式。值得注意的是，所有涉及光子场的散射过程都被完全抑制，从而完美隔离了集体暗自旋波之间的一个幺正非线性相互作用通道。我们的发现为少体非线性提供了精确的分析见解，并为分析建立了普适框架。
authors: Yidan Wang, Oriol Rubies-Bigorda, Valentin Walther, Susanne F. Yelin

articles.title: Proofs of Quantum Memory
articles.title_zh: 量子内存证明
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.04159v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this paper, we introduce a new concept, proofs of quantum memory (PoQM). A PoQM is an interactive protocol between a classical verifier and a quantum prover over a classical channel where the verifier can verify that the prover has possessed a specified number of qubits for a specified period of time. PoQM generalize proofs of quantumness (PoQ) [Brakerski, Christiano, Mahadev, Vazirani, and Vidick, JACM 2021] where a classical verifier can verify that the prover is not classical. Our contributions are summarized as follows: We introduce PoQM. We also introduce a variant of PoQM, which we call inefficient-verifier PoQM (IV-PoQM), where the verifier's final computation to make the decision is not necessarily efficient. We construct PoQM based on the hardness of LWE. Specifically, we give two constructions of PoQM. The first one is of two-round and has negligible soundness error under the subexponential-hardness of LWE. The second one is of polynomial-round and has inverse-polynomial soundness error under the polynomial-hardness of LWE. We show that IV-PoQM imply one-way puzzles. Moreover, we show that a certain restricted version of PoQM implies quantum computation classical communication key exchange, which suggests the difficulty of black-box constructing PoQM from one-way functions. We show that constant-round PoQ imply PoQM or single-round PoQ (with a quantum verifier). Single-round PoQ are ``trivial'' PoQ in the sense that the verifier asks the prover to solve a classical problem which is quantumly easy but classically hard. The result therefore demonstrates that PoQM capture ``genuinely-interactive'' PoQ. We show that if constant-round IV-PoQ that are black-box constructed from quantumly-secure falsifiable assumptions exist then IV-PoQM exist. This result implies that IV-PoQM can be constructed from quantumly-secure constant-round statistically-hiding commitments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了量子内存证明（PoQM）这一新概念，它是一种允许经典验证者通过经典信道验证量子证明者在特定时间内拥有指定数量量子比特的交互式协议。PoQM是量子性证明（PoQ）的泛化，并基于LWE问题的困难性构建。作者提出了两种PoQM构造方案，分别具有不同的轮数和可靠性误差，并展示了低效验证者PoQM（IV-PoQM）可推导出单向谜题。
authors: Minki Hhan, Tomoyuki Morimae, Yasuaki Okinaka, Takashi Yamakawa

articles.title: Complementarity in quantum and general information theories
articles.title_zh: 量子与一般信息理论中的互补性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.10800v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose an operational definition of complementarity, pinning down the concept originally introduced by Bohr. Two properties of a system are considered complementary if the definiteness of their values conflicts. We show that, within quantum theory, this notion is equivalent to the incompatibility of operations, that is, their inability to be performed simultaneously. We further show that for a generic information theory, the instruments associated with complementary properties are incompatible.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了互补性的操作性定义，旨在精确阐释玻尔最初引入的概念。如果一个系统的两个性质的确定性值相互冲突，则它们被认为是互补的。研究表明，在量子理论中，这一概念等同于操作的不兼容性，即它们无法同时执行。进一步地，对于一般信息理论，与互补性质相关的测量仪器也是不兼容的。
authors: Davide Rolino, Paolo Perinotti, Alessandro Tosini

articles.title: Exact and approximate conditions of tabletop reversibility: when is Petz recovery cost-free?
articles.title_zh: 台面可逆性的精确与近似条件：Petz恢复何时是无代价的？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.26895v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Channels N that describe open quantum dynamics are inherently irreversible: it is impossible to undo their effect completely, but one can study partial recovery of the information. The Petz recovery map hatNγ⁽textttP⁾ is a systematic construction that depends only on N and on a reference state γ, which will be recovered exactly. If the real input state was different from γ, the recovery is partial, with a guarantee of near-optimality. Generically, an implementation of the Petz recovery map would look very different from the implementation of the channel. It is natural to study under which conditions the two maps require similar or even identical resources. The noisy forward channel N is called ``tabletop time-reversible'' for a given γ when the corresponding Petz recovery map is realizable in such a way. First, we study the exact tabletop reversibility (TTR) conditions. We show in particular that a time-sensitive control of an ancilla system is needed. Second, we present the approximate TTR conditions, which do not require such a time-sensitive control. Third, we derive Lindbladian TTR conditions under a random-time collision model.
articles.abstract_zh: 开放量子动力学通道N本质上是不可逆的，但可以研究信息的局部恢复。Petz恢复映射是一种系统性构造，可精确恢复参考态γ。本文研究了Petz恢复映射与原始通道N何时需要相似甚至相同的资源，即“台面时间可逆性”（TTR）的条件。作者探讨了精确TTR条件（需要对辅助系统进行时间敏感控制）和近似TTR条件（无需此类控制），并推导了随机时间碰撞模式下的Lindbladian TTR条件。
authors: Minjeong Song, Hyukjoon Kwon, Valerio Scarani

articles.title: Distributed quantum approximate counting algorithm
articles.title_zh: 分布式量子近似计数算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.04945v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this article, we propose a distributed quantum algorithm for solving counting problem using Grover operator and a classical post-processing procedure. We apply the proposed algorithm to estimate inner products and Hamming distances. Simulations are conducted on the Qisikit platform, further demonstrating the effectiveness of our algorithm and its suitability for the NISQ era. Compared to existing counting algorithms, the proposed algorithm has advantages in terms of the number of qubits, circuit depth, and the number of quantum gates.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种利用Grover算子和经典后处理程序解决计数问题的分布式量子算法。该算法被应用于估计内积和汉明距离，并在Qiskit平台上进行了仿真，验证了其有效性及对NISQ时代的适用性。与现有计数算法相比，该算法在量子比特数量、电路深度和量子门数量方面具有优势。
authors: Huaijing Huang, Daowen Qiu

articles.title: Nonclassicality of a Macroscopic Qubit-Ensemble via Parity Measurement Induced Disturbance
articles.title_zh: 通过奇偶测量诱导扰动探测宏观量子比特系综的非经典性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.15880v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose an experimental scheme to test the nonclassicality of a macroscopic ensemble of qubits, through the violation of the classical notion of macrorealism (MR) via the fundamental measurement-induced disturbance of quantum systems. An electromagnetic resonator is used to probe the parity of the qubit-ensemble. The action of sequential measurements allows the nonclassicality of whole ensemble to manifest itself, in the ideal case, irrespective of its size. This enables to probe the macroscopic limits of quantum mechanics as the qubit-ensemble is, effectively, a single large spin of many hbar units. Even as hbar i̊ghtarrow 0 in comparison to the total angular momentum of the ensemble, a constant amount of violation of MR is found in the noiseless case. However, environmental decoherence and inhomogeneity of qubit-electromagnetic field couplings precipitate the quantum-to-classical transition. This illustrates that Bohr's correspondence principle is not fundamental, but a consequence of practical limitations. We outline an implementation with a variety of qubits (superconducting qubits, spins in semiconductors, and Rydberg atoms) coupled to a coplanar waveguide resonator, and -- via the corresponding noise analysis -- find that violation of MR is detectable up to 100 qubits via current technology.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种实验方案，通过违反宏观实在论（MR）来检验宏观量子比特系综的非经典性。该方案利用电磁谐振器探测量子比特系综的奇偶性，通过序列测量揭示整个系综的非经典性，即使在理想情况下也与系综大小无关。研究发现，在无噪声情况下，即使普朗克常数相对于系综总角动量趋于零，MR的违反量仍保持恒定。然而，环境退相干和耦合不均匀性会加速量子到经典的转变，表明玻尔的对应原理并非基本原理，而是实际限制的结果。
authors: Lorenzo Braccini, Debarshi Das, Ben Zindorf, Stephen D. Hogan, John J. L. Morton, Sougato Bose

articles.title: Quantum measurement retrodiction and entropic uncertainty relations
articles.title_zh: 量子测量回溯与熵不确定关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.20281v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study quantum measurement retrodiction using the principle of minimum change. For quantum-to-classical measurement channels, we show that all standard quantum divergences select the same retrodictive update, yielding a unique and divergence-independent quantum Bayesian inverse for any POVM and prior state. Using this update, we construct a symmetric joint distribution for pairs of POVMs and introduce the mutual retrodictability, for which we also derive a general upper bound that depends only on the prior state and holds for all measurements. This structure leads to two retrodictive entropic uncertainty relations, expressed directly in terms of the prior state and the POVMs, but valid independently of the retrodictive framework and fully compatible with the conventional operational interpretation of entropic uncertainty relations. Finally, we benchmark these relations numerically and find that they provide consistently tighter bounds than existing entropic uncertainty relations over broad classes of measurements and states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用最小变化原理研究量子测量回溯，并证明对于量子到经典测量通道，所有标准量子散度都会选择相同的回溯更新，从而为任意POVM和先验态提供唯一且与散度无关的量子贝叶斯逆。基于此更新，作者构建了POVM对的对称联合分布并引入了相互回溯性，并推导了一个仅依赖于先验态的通用上界。该框架导出了两个回溯熵不确定关系，这些关系直接以先验态和POVM表示，并被数值基准测试证明比现有熵不确定关系提供更紧密的界限。
authors: Jiaxi Kuang, Kensei Torii, Francesco Buscemi

articles.title: Frequency-matching quantum key distribution
articles.title_zh: 频率匹配量子密钥分发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.05496v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum key distribution (QKD) enables information-theoretically secure communication against eavesdropping. However, phase instability remains a challenge across many QKD applications, particularly in schemes such as twin-field QKD and measurement-device-independent QKD. The most dominant source of phase fluctuation arises from the frequency offset between independent lasers. Here we propose a method to address this issue by employing a classical photodiode to compensate for the laser frequency difference. As an application of this method, we implement this technique in a mode-pairing QKD system, achieving an error rate approaching the theoretical limit and surpassing the linear key-rate bound over a fiber distance of 296.8 km. This approach provides a practical solution for frequency matching between independent lasers and can be extended to other fields requiring precise phase stabilization.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子密钥分发（QKD）在许多应用中面临相位不稳定性挑战，尤其是在双场QKD和测量设备无关QKD方案中。本文提出了一种利用经典光电二极管补偿独立激光器频率差异的方法，以解决相位波动问题。该技术应用于模式配对QKD系统，实现了接近理论极限的错误率，并在296.8公里光纤距离上超越了线性密钥率界限。该方法为独立激光器间的频率匹配提供了实用解决方案，并可推广到其他需要精确相位稳定的领域。
authors: Hao-Tao Zhu, Yizhi Huang, Abdullah Rasmita, Chao Ding, Xiangbin Cai, Haoran Zhang, Xiongfeng Ma, Weibo Gao

articles.title: Geometric Complexity of Quantum Channels via Unitary Dilations
articles.title_zh: 基于酉膨胀的量子通道几何复杂度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.00735v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Nielsen's geometric approach to quantum circuit complexity provides a Riemannian framework for quantifying the cost of implementing unitary closed-system dynamics. For open evolutions, the reduced dynamics is described by time-dependent families of quantum channels Łambdaₜₜgₑ ₀ admitting many inequivalent Stinespring realizations, so any meaningful complexity notion must specify which microscopic resources are counted and which transformations are treated as gauge. We develop a dilation-based geometric complexity framework that distinguishes implementation-dependent complexity, attached to a specific realization, from intrinsic channel complexity obtained by minimizing over a physically admissible class of dilations. The proposed functional is subtractive: it removes purely environmental contributions from the geometric cost of the joint unitary realization. The subtraction is derived from concise structural postulates --- closed-system consistency, environment-only neutrality, and invariance under dilation gauge transformations --- and admits a natural variational and geometric interpretation. We also define noise complexity as a companion quantity measuring the geometric deviation of a noisy implementation from a prescribed ideal closed-system evolution. In the Hilbert-Schmidt setting, we establish coherence-based lower bounds for unitary and noise complexity, prove linear time scaling under time-homogeneous dilation models, and obtain dissipator-controlled bounds in the Markovian GKSL regime. We illustrate the framework on canonical single-qubit benchmark channels: dephasing, amplitude damping, and Pauli/depolarizing noise.
articles.abstract_zh: Nielsen的几何方法为酉闭系统动力学的实现成本提供了黎曼框架。针对开放演化，本文开发了一种基于膨胀的几何复杂度框架，旨在区分依赖于实现的复杂性与通过最小化物理上可接受的膨胀类获得的内在通道复杂性。所提出的函数是减法的，它从联合酉实现的几何成本中消除了纯环境贡献。该减法源于简洁的结构公设，并具有自然的变分和几何解释。
authors: Alberto Acevedo, Antonio Falcó

articles.title: Quantum circuit synthesis for fermionic excitations in coupled cluster theory
articles.title_zh: 耦合簇理论中费米子激发的量子电路合成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.07890v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This work provides a step-by-step quantum computing derivation of the unitary coupled cluster singles and doubles ansatz. We show how the structure of the ansatz emerges from fermionic algebra under unitary constraints. By explicitly connecting second quantization, Jordan-Wigner mapping, and quantum circuit synthesis, we clarify conceptual gaps between quantum physics and quantum computing implementations, particularly regarding operator locality, commutation structure, and hardware realization. We exemplify the procedure on the singles and doubles coupled cluster ansatz for the hydrogen molecule.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文详细推导了酉耦合簇单双激发（UCCSD）拟设的量子计算实现，展示了该拟设结构如何在酉约束下的费米子代数中产生。通过明确连接二次量子化、Jordan-Wigner映射和量子电路合成，作者阐明了量子物理与量子计算实现之间的概念鸿沟，特别是在算符局域性、对易结构和硬件实现方面。该过程以氢分子的单双激发耦合簇拟设为例进行了说明。
authors: Yu-Hao Chen, Renata Wong

articles.title: On the Redfield and Lindblad master equations
articles.title_zh: 关于Redfield和Lindblad主方程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.13429v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In a previous work we developed a field theoretical approach to open quantum systems using condensed matter methods. In the Born approximation we derived the Redfield equation on the basis of a multi-oscillator bath, a Dyson equation, a diagrammatic expansion and a quasi-particle approximation. In addition applying a rotating wave approximation we obtained the Lindblad equation describing a proper quantum map. The issue regarding the additional rotating wave approximation was left as an open problem. The present work addresses the open problem and presents new results. We identify a discrepancy in the popular and standard Redfield equation. The discrepancy is associated with the well-known fact that the Redfield equation does not represent a proper quantum map. The discrepancy is related to the diagrammatic expansion and a consistency requirement in the quasi-particle approximation. The explicit resolution of this discrepancy is obtained by imposing energy conservation on the Born level. As a result we obtain formal equivalence between the energy-conserving Redfield equation and the Lindblad equation without invoking the rotating wave approximation. We provide a detailed mapping of the field theoretical approach to the standard microscopic derivation in the theory of open quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文延续了之前利用凝聚态方法场论处理开放量子系统的工作，并解决了Redfield方程与Lindblad方程之间关于旋转波近似的开放问题。作者指出了流行标准Redfield方程中存在的差异，该差异与Redfield方程无法表示适当量子映射的事实相关。通过在玻恩近似层面上施加能量守恒，作者明确解决了这一差异，从而在不引入旋转波近似的情况下，实现了能量守恒Redfield方程与Lindblad方程之间的形式等价。
authors: Hans C. Fogedby

articles.title: Tensor Decomposition for Non-Clifford Gate Minimization
articles.title_zh: 基于张量分解的非Clifford门最小化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.15285v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computation requires substantial resources for non-Clifford gates. Their count also enters exponentially into the runtime of several classical simulation methods. We present algebraic methods for minimizing the non-Clifford CCZ (Toffoli) count in CNOT,CCZ phase circuits using tensor decomposition over F₂. On standard cubic benchmarks, these methods match or improve prior automated Toffoli counts, with most instances optimized in under a minute on a single CPU. With additional computation, the decompositions provide effective initializations for existing T-count methods, improving T counts on several circuits. We also present algebraic methods for CNOT-count optimization at fixed Toffoli count. This gives competitive ancilla-free finite-field multiplication circuits and reduces the CNOT count of XOR AES S-box circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 容错量子计算中非Clifford门需要大量资源，其数量也呈指数级影响经典模拟方法的运行时间。本文提出了一种利用F₂上张量分解的代数方法，用于最小化CNOT,CCZ相位电路中的非Clifford CCZ（Toffoli）门数量。在标准基准测试中，这些方法匹配或改进了先前的自动化Toffoli门计数，并在固定Toffoli门数量下优化了CNOT门计数。该方法为无辅助有限域乘法电路提供了有竞争力的方案，并减少了XOR AES S-box电路的CNOT门数量。
authors: Kirill Khoruzhii, Patrick Gelß, Sebastian Pokutta

articles.title: Theory and interpretability of Quantum Extreme Learning Machines: a Pauli transfer matrix approach
articles.title_zh: 量子极限学习机的理论与可解释性：一种Pauli转移矩阵方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.18377v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum reservoir computers (QRCs) have emerged as a promising approach to quantum machine learning, since they utilize the natural dynamics of quantum systems for data processing and are simple to train. Here, we consider n-qubit quantum extreme learning machines (QELMs) with initial-state encoding and continuous-time reservoir dynamics. Applying the Pauli transfer matrix (PTM) formalism reveals the encoding-generated features and their linear transformation by quantum channels, and thereby provides a nonlinear vector autoregression model as an interpretable classical representation of a QELM. We show that the nonlinear information processing capacity of a QELM factorizes into the ability of the encoding to represent a given target function and the decodability of the relevant Pauli features after the effective PTM. Comparing geometric and statistical decodability reveals features that are algebraically hidden yet recoverable through data correlations. We relate the decodability of Pauli features to the spreading of measurement operators under Heisenberg evolution (Krylov growth). Focusing on the unitary channel, we discuss how structured Hamiltonians, when paired with certain observables, can impair model performance, as reflected in a low rank of the readout and the effective PTMs. We trace this effect to Hamiltonian symmetries and derive asymptotic rank estimates for symmetry-resolved observable families. Our decodability analysis disentangles the contributions of encoding, reservoir dynamics, and measurement observables, and thus provides interpretable diagnostics that can inform the design of QELMs and reduce reliance on exhaustive hyperparameter search. As a specific application, we consider forecasting nonlinear dynamical systems and show that the readout of a trained QELM closely matches the expression of the underlying flow map at leading orders.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子储备计算机（QRCs）作为一种有前景的量子机器学习方法，利用量子系统的自然动力学进行数据处理。本文研究了具有初始态编码和连续时间储备动力学的n量子比特量子极限学习机（QELMs），并应用Pauli转移矩阵（PTM）形式揭示了编码生成的特征及其通过量子通道的线性变换。研究表明QELM的非线性信息处理能力可分解为编码表示目标函数的能力以及有效PTM后相关Pauli特征的可解码性，并探讨了Pauli特征的可解码性与海森堡演化下测量算符扩散（Krylov增长）的关系。
authors: Markus Gross, Hans-Martin Rieser

articles.title: Qurator: Scheduling Hybrid Quantum-Classical Workflows Across Heterogeneous Cloud Providers
articles.title_zh: Qurator：跨异构云提供商的混合量子-经典工作流调度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.05505v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present Qurator, a quantum-classical task scheduler that jointly optimizes queue time and circuit fidelity across heterogeneous architectures. Qurator models hybrid workloads as dynamic DAGs with explicit quantum semantics, including entanglement dependencies, synchronization barriers, no-cloning constraints, and circuit cutting and merging decisions. Fidelity is estimated through a unified logarithmic success score that reconciles incompatible calibration data from IBM, IonQ, IQM, Rigetti, AQT, Pasqal and other providers into a canonical set of gate error, readout fidelity, and decoherence terms. We evaluate Qurator on a simulator driven by four months of real queue data using circuits from the Munich Quantum Toolkit benchmark suite. Across load conditions from 5 to 35,000 quantum tasks with up to 120,000 classical tasks, Qurator stays within 1% of the highest-fidelity baseline at low load, achieves 30-75% queue time reduction at high load, all at a fidelity cost bounded by a user-specified target while improving on list and fair schedulers as well as state of the art schedulers on both metrics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了Qurator，一个量子-经典任务调度器，旨在跨异构架构联合优化队列时间和电路保真度。Qurator将混合工作负载建模为具有明确量子语义的动态DAG，并采用统一的对数成功分数来估计保真度。在模拟器上使用真实队列数据进行评估，Qurator在低负载下保持接近最高保真度，在高负载下显著减少队列时间，同时优于现有调度器。
authors: Sinan Pehlivanoglu, Ulrik de Muelenaere, Peter Kogge, Amr Sabry

articles.title: Low Depth Distributed Quantum Algorithms for Unordered Database Search
articles.title_zh: 用于无序数据库搜索的低深度分布式量子算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.14081v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Grover's algorithm accelerates unstructured database search quadratically compared to classical algorithms. In the NISQ era, distributed quantum computing can decrease circuit depth and reduce noise. In this paper, an algorithm for constructing query operators for subfunctions is proposed. By dividing the target string of the search problem into several substrings and integrating the query operator of each subfunction, a low-depth distributed exact quantum search algorithm is designed. The contributions of this paper are as follows: (1) The proposed distributed algorithm has a lower circuit depth and can mitigate error accumulation compared to distributed quantum search algorithms; (2) The target can be accurately located by the proposed distributed algorithm; (3) Experiments conducted with the quantum software MindQuantum confirm the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed distributed algorithm. Moreover, the introduction of noise to the circuit during these experiments indicates that the algorithm possesses an inherent capacity for noise resistance.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种低深度的分布式精确量子搜索算法，旨在加速无序数据库搜索并降低电路深度。该算法通过将搜索目标字符串划分为子字符串并集成子函数的查询算子来构建。实验结果表明，所提出的分布式算法相比现有方法具有更低的电路深度，能有效缓解误差累积，并能准确定位目标。此外，该算法还展现出固有的抗噪声能力。
authors: Huaijing Huang, Daowen Qiu, Ximing Hua, Xinyu Chen

articles.title: Randomized Subsystem Descent for Fermion-to-Qubit Mapping
articles.title_zh: 用于费米子到量子比特映射的随机子系统下降算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.17630v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose a versatile and efficient algorithmic framework for optimizing fermion-to-qubit mappings by generalizing the idea of randomized block coordinate descent. Our greedy approach, termed Randomized Subsystem Descent, iteratively samples a tractable subsystem from the full Hamiltonian, performs optimization within the subsystem under a given metric, and then reintegrates the updated subsystem into the global operator. Restricting the optimization to a subsystem at each iteration ensures computational efficiency, bypassing the dimensional bottlenecks that usually hinder global search heuristics. We benchmark our algorithm on one- and two-dimensional lattice hopping models, the Hubbard model with up to 16 × 16 sites, alongside a collection of molecular electronic-structure Hamiltonians with up to 54 modes and more than 180,000 Pauli strings. Across all benchmarks, our method consistently provides appreciable reduction in (weighted) Pauli weight, suggesting that Randomized Subsystem Descent is a practical and scalable framework for lowering the resource overhead of finding hardware-efficient Hamiltonian encodings.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种通用且高效的算法框架——随机子系统下降（Randomized Subsystem Descent），用于优化费米子到量子比特的映射。该贪婪方法通过迭代地对哈密顿量进行子系统优化，确保了计算效率并避免了维度瓶颈。在多种基准测试中，该方法显著降低了泡利权重，表明其是寻找硬件高效哈密顿量编码的实用且可扩展的框架。
authors: Gengzhi Yang, Di Wu, Haizhao Yang, Xiaodi Wu, Ji Liu

articles.title: Exploiting all ancilla outcomes in linear combinations of unitaries: low-rank recovery and quantum trapdoor functions
articles.title_zh: 利用酉算子线性组合中所有辅助量子比特结果：低秩恢复与量子活板门函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.02986v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The linear combination of unitaries (LCU) is a fundamental quantum computing primitive used to embed non-unitary operators into larger systems via ancilla post-selection. In standard LCU implementations, only the zero-state ancilla outcome is retained, while all other measurement branches are discarded as unusable overhead. We study these discarded parts. Every computational-basis outcome of the ancilla projects the system onto a different linear combination of the target unitaries; collecting these outcome states in a matrix gives a factorization Φ=CX, where C is determined by the ancilla preparation and the rows of X are the states Uₜ|ψångle, so that rank(Φ)łe K. This holds for any LCU circuit.To make the analysis easier, we use a simplified model circuit with Hadamard gates on the index register and a single rotation qubit in place of the coefficient preparation unitary, in which C is explicit. The structure suggests two complementary applications: (i) in an explicit amplitude-access model, classical low-rank matrix completion can reconstruct the full output (including the target) from a subset of its amplitude entries, while computational basis counts provide intensities and generally require additional phase information for full complex recovery; (ii) treating C as a secret key suggests a candidate quantum trapdoor function, whose security remains informal and depends on the difficulty of structured phase retrieval. The scheme thus turns the "junk" ancilla outcomes into a structured resource, possibly opening paths for further applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 酉算子线性组合（LCU）是量子计算中的基本原语，通常只保留辅助量子比特的零态结果。本文研究了被丢弃的其他测量结果，发现辅助量子比特的每个计算基结果都将系统投影到目标酉算子的不同线性组合上。这种结构揭示了两种互补应用：在振幅访问模型中，经典低秩矩阵补全可以从部分振幅条目重建完整输出。
authors: Ammar Daskin

articles.title: Neural Information Causality: A Random-Access Capacity Law for Representation Learning
articles.title_zh: 神经信息因果性：一种用于表示学习的随机访问容量定律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.09316v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: How can a learned representation remain useful when the question it must answer is chosen only after encoding? Preserving information is essential, but does not by itself ensure access to the requested target. We address this problem by deriving "neural information causality (Neural-IC)," a representation law that connects causal access to the physically specified interface capacity. For a fresh database of independent bits, the aggregate information recoverable across later queries cannot exceed that capacity, even with pre-established quantum resources. A decomposition separates capacity slack, information organized jointly across targets, and losses in producing answers. Exhaustive evaluation of trained binary codes reveals why nearly full use of a memory's information budget can coexist with limited retrieval. In a nested Bell-correlation construction, quantum assistance improves average retrieval over the optimal classical one-bit benchmark within the same communicated budget. These results give representation learning a design principle that connects information capacity to the organization and extraction of target information. By locating the constraints on later answers, the framework can inform memory allocation, encoding objectives, and decoder outputs, providing a basis for seeking better retrieval within a fixed budget.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了“神经信息因果性（Neural-IC）”，这是一个连接因果访问与物理接口容量的表示定律。该定律指出，即使有预先建立的量子资源，通过后续查询可恢复的总信息也不能超过指定容量。通过对训练过的二进制码进行评估，揭示了内存信息预算的充分利用与有限检索并存的原因。研究结果为表示学习提供了一个设计原则，将信息容量与目标信息的组织和提取联系起来。
authors: Jeongho Bang, Marcin Pawłowski

articles.title: Towards Fair Benchmarking of Quantum Transfer Learning for Visual Classification
articles.title_zh: 迈向视觉分类量子迁移学习的公平基准测试
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.19417v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum Transfer Learning (QTL) offers a promising approach for visual quantum machine learning under near-term constraints, where limited qubit counts, shallow circuit depths, and costly hybrid optimization restrict end-to-end quantum training. In this setting, pretrained classical backbones can extract high-level visual features, while compact quantum modules operate as trainable classification heads. However, existing QTL results are difficult to compare because they often differ in datasets, preprocessing, backbone settings, qubit budgets, circuit designs, optimization choices, and reporting protocols. This work presents a controlled benchmarking methodology for evaluating representative QTL methods under a unified transfer-learning pipeline. The benchmark compares DQN-QTL, QPIE-QTL, AE-CQTL, PVCQTL, and ED-QTL under shared preprocessing rules, frozen-backbone settings, training conditions, and reporting metrics. The evaluation focuses on Fashion-MNIST and Hymenoptera Ants vs. Bees as the two main datasets, while CIFAR-10 is used to provide additional configuration-level evidence on a harder natural-image task. Beyond predictive performance, the benchmark analyzes circuit size, trainable parameters, quantum parameters, training time, and architectural sensitivity to qubit count and circuit depth. The results show that no single QTL family dominates across all settings: performance depends on the dataset, encoding strategy, circuit design, and computational cost. These findings highlight the need for resource-aware QTL evaluation and provide guidance for selecting hybrid quantum-classical transfer models under near-term resource constraints.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子迁移学习（QTL）为近期视觉量子机器学习提供了一种有前景的方法，但现有研究结果因设置差异而难以比较。本文提出了一种受控的基准测试方法，用于在统一的迁移学习流程下评估代表性的QTL方法。该基准测试在共享的预处理规则、骨干网络设置、训练条件和报告指标下，比较了多种QTL方法。评估主要在Fashion-MNIST和Hymenoptera Ants vs. Bees数据集上进行，旨在提供更公平的性能比较。
authors: Nouhaila Innan, Saim Rehman, Muhammad Shafique

articles.title: Fate of Quantum Scars and Chaos-Assisted Tunneling under Dissipation
articles.title_zh: 耗散下量子疤痕和混沌辅助隧穿的命运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.22953v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum scars enable memory and recurrent dynamics, but their fate under dissipation remains poorly understood. Here, we show that distinct quantum scars can respond qualitatively differently to the same dissipative channel. We consider a collective spin model coupled to a lossy cavity and, guided by its classical limit, identify scars associated with two unstable structures: a saddle point on a dissipation-free invariant manifold with vanishing cavity field and an unstable superradiant fixed point with finite photon occupation. The former is immune to photon loss in the classical limit and exhibits persistent quantum revivals, whereas the latter couples directly to the dissipative channel, but exhibits slow dynamics. Remarkably, the superradiant scar also supports chaos-assisted quantum tunneling between two symmetry-related, macroscopically distinct semiclassical configurations, despite the presence of dissipation. Our results identify an experimentally accessible setting for exploring dissipative scarring and chaos-assisted tunneling in cavity QED.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子疤痕在耗散下的行为尚不清楚。本文研究了集体自旋模型与耗散腔耦合的情况，发现不同的量子疤痕对相同的耗散通道响应截然不同。研究揭示了与鞍点和超辐射不动点相关的疤痕，并发现超辐射疤痕即使在耗散存在下也支持混沌辅助量子隧穿。这些结果为在腔QED中探索耗散疤痕和混沌辅助隧穿提供了可实验验证的设置。
authors: Debabrata Mondal, Sohan Pati, Lea F. Santos, S. Sinha

articles.title: PauLIB: HPC Strategies for Pauli-Arithmetic-Based Quantum Computing Workloads and Simulations
articles.title_zh: PauLIB：基于泡利算术的量子计算工作负载和模拟的高性能计算策略
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.25974v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: As quantum devices become accelerators within classical HPC deployments, the efficiency of the classical partition becomes critical. Workloads such as Hamiltonian manipulation, observable backpropagation, and Pauli-based compilation reduce to bulk arithmetic on Pauli strings and sums. We present HPC strategies for this arithmetic, demonstrated in PauLIB, a header-only C++20 library: a bit-packed binary symplectic representation reducing Pauli multiplication to a bitwise XOR and population count; a sorted, struct-of-arrays layout replacing hash maps and exposing contiguous word arrays to SIMD units and GPU warps; and deterministic OpenMP parallelism with race-free output partitioning. These strategies deliver orders-of-magnitude higher throughput and smaller memory footprint than Qiskit and PauliEngine, plus a speedup from a CUDA outer-product kernel on an H100. Two case studies, g-sim and truncated Pauli propagation, inherit these gains and scale unchanged from a desktop Arm CPU to a 72-core HPC Arm server. PauLIB is open source with C++ and Python interfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 随着量子设备成为经典HPC部署中的加速器，经典部分的效率变得至关重要。本文提出了用于泡利算术的高性能计算策略，并在C++20库PauLIB中进行了演示。这些策略包括位打包的二元辛表示、有序的结构数组布局和确定性OpenMP并行化。PauLIB在吞吐量和内存占用方面显著优于现有工具，并在不同硬件平台上展现出良好的可扩展性。
authors: Florian Krötz

articles.title: QPredSGG: Hybrid Quantum Predicate Learning for Long-Tailed Scene Graph Generation
articles.title_zh: QPredSGG：用于长尾场景图生成的混合量子谓词学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.04689v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Scene Graph Generation (SGG) requires relational reasoning over objects and their interactions, but performance is constrained by long-tail predicate imbalance. Classical SGG models rely on dataset statistics, leading to biased predictions toward frequent relations rather than fine-grained semantic predicates. Although debiasing improves mean recall, predicate classification in existing frameworks still relies on high-dimensional classical decision modules with high parameter overhead. This work introduces a resource-efficient hybrid quantum predicate classifier for SGG by replacing the classical predicate head in the CFEN with a QP-Head trained using class-balanced WCE. To the best of our knowledge, this work is among the first evaluations of a hybrid quantum architecture for scene graph predicate classification on Visual Genome 150. We evaluate the impact of qubit count, encoding strategy, entangling topology, and circuit depth. Under a 4-qubit configuration using Amplitude Embedding and Strongly Entangling Layers, the QP-Head projects 4096-dimensional pair features into a 16-dimensional quantum input while using 96 trainable quantum parameters. Operating within this compressed representation space under WCE training, it achieves strong long-tail recognition, reaching a peak mR@100 of 57.25% compared to the 41.1% mR@100 reported in the CFEN baseline under standard training. Protocol-matched ablations indicate that the primary advantage of the quantum head lies in extreme representational compactness rather than an accuracy gain over full-dimensional weighted classical heads: it achieves global recall within 0.19pp of the 2048-dimensional WCE classical baseline while operating from a 128x smaller head feature space. Scaling to 8 qubits maintains robust long-tail performance (55.38% mR@100 with 384 quantum parameters), while depth analysis highlights expressibility-latency trade-offs.
articles.abstract_zh: 场景图生成（SGG）受长尾谓词不平衡的限制，导致经典模型偏向频繁关系。本文提出了一种资源高效的混合量子谓词分类器QPredSGG，通过将经典谓词头替换为量子谓词头（QP-Head）来解决这一问题。该工作首次在Visual Genome 150上评估了混合量子架构用于场景图谓词分类。研究评估了量子比特数、编码策略、纠缠拓扑和电路深度对性能的影响。
authors: Prerana Ramkumar, Nouhaila Innan, Muhammad Shafique

articles.title: Orbital Hall response of spin-1 fermions with a curved central band
articles.title_zh: 具有弯曲中心能带的自旋-1费米子的轨道霍尔响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33211v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the orbital Hall effect in a three-band system described by a low-energy Hamiltonian containing both linear and quadratic momentum-dependent contributions. The linear term lifts the degeneracy between the dispersive bands, providing a minimal setting to study orbital transport in a multiband system with a curved central band. Within a quantum kinetic approach, we derive the intrinsic orbital Hall response and analyze its microscopic origin in terms of interband coherence induced by an external electric field. We show that the orbital Hall conductivity arises from the interplay between the momentum-dependent orbital character of the eigenstates and transitions between different bands. The spin-1 structure provides a particularly transparent platform in which the contributions associated with different interband channels can be identified separately. We further show that the differential orbital Hall response provides a direct probe of the low-energy structure, exhibiting distinct scaling singularities associated with the linear and quadratic bands, respectively, while remaining independent of the ultraviolet cutoff. Our results establish a connection between the multiband quantum geometry of spin-1 fermions and their transverse orbital response, and provide a simple framework for investigating orbital transport beyond two-band models.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了三能带系统中自旋-1费米子的轨道霍尔效应，该系统由包含线性和二次动量相关贡献的低能哈密顿量描述。通过量子动力学方法，推导了本征轨道霍尔响应，并分析了其微观起源。研究表明，轨道霍尔电导源于本征态的动量依赖轨道特性与不同能带间跃迁的相互作用。微分轨道霍尔响应为探测低能结构提供了直接手段。
authors: J. H. Warnes, Dayana Joy, Pankaj Bhalla, Rhonald Burgos Atencia

articles.title: Second-Harmonic Bulk Response of Fractional Quantum Hall Fluids
articles.title_zh: 分数量子霍尔流体的二次谐波体响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33606v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a bulk description for the second-harmonic Hall response of fractional quantum Hall fluids with broken inversion and rotational symmetries, distinct from edge theories based on nonlinear edge-mode dispersion. By projecting a tilted massive Dirac model onto a single low-energy band, we construct a composite-boson Chern--Simons theory for the lowest Landau level that retains projection-induced nonlinear electromagnetic couplings. The nonlinear Hall resistivity vanishes in the dc limit, while its finite-frequency response retains the characteristic filling-factor dependence h̊o⁽²⁾TLLproptoν⁻², where ν is the Landau-level filling factor. At low frequency, its real and imaginary parts scale as (ømega/ømega_c)² and ømega/ømega_c, respectively, where ømega_c is the cyclotron frequency, and the response is strongly anisotropic with respect to the crystalline tilt axis. Notably, the Kohn-mode resonances present in the second-order conductivity cancel in the nonlinear Hall resistivity. These results establish finite-frequency nonlinear transport as a bulk probe of fractional quantum Hall fluids without requiring nonlinear edge-mode dispersion.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为具有破缺反演和旋转对称性的分数量子霍尔流体的二次谐波霍尔响应建立了体描述。通过将倾斜的大质量狄拉克模型投影到单个低能带，构建了一个复合玻色子陈-西蒙斯理论。研究发现，非线性霍尔电阻率在直流极限下消失，但在有限频率下保留了特征性的填充因子依赖性。这些结果确立了有限频率非线性输运作为分数量子霍尔流体的体探测手段。
authors: J. Luke Pimlott, Pablo Reiser, T. Hans Hansson, Habib Rostami

articles.title: Emergent parafermions with tunable localization in a quantum circuit network
articles.title_zh: 量子电路网络中具有可调局域化的涌现准费米子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33815v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: noindent Quantum circuit simulators with hybrid metal-semiconductor dots provide a versatile platform to realize Kondo anyons. These arise at critical points driven by frustrated Kondo screening of dot charge degrees of freedom and have been demonstrated experimentally in linear circuits of one or two dots. Here we study a triangular triple dot device, where geometric frustration gives rise to an emergent Z₃ parafermion shared among the three dots. We show that the parafermion can be tunably relocated to any pair of dots by applying gate voltages, and is supported in both the weak-tunneling `Kondo limit' and the strong transmission `quasiballistic' regime. The critical states survive strong coupling to external leads and other dots, establishing the basis for a scalable and reconfigurable network architecture in which non-Abelian excitations can be realized and manipulated.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有混合金属-半导体量子点的量子电路模拟器为实现近藤任意子提供了多功能平台。本文研究了一个三角形三点器件，其中几何挫折导致了在三个点之间共享的涌现Z₃准费米子。研究表明，该准费米子可以通过施加栅极电压可调地重新定位到任意一对点，并且在弱隧穿和强传输两种机制下都得到支持。这些结果为可扩展和可重构的网络架构奠定了基础。
authors: D. B. Karki, Andrew K. Mitchell

articles.title: Fermionic superfluid transition and pairing scale separation in the kagome flat band
articles.title_zh: Kagome平带中的费米子超流转变和配对尺度分离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34342v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Flat-band systems provide a promising platform for exploring exotic correlated phases owing to quenched kinetic energy and enhanced interaction effects. In this work, we investigate the flat-band superfluid transition in the attractive kagome Hubbard model using large-scale determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations accelerated by fast Fourier transforms and delay updates. Through systematic calculations of the transition temperature, spin susceptibility, and density compressibility, we establish the finite-temperature phase diagram at the flat-band filling h̊o=5/3 and find a clear linear scaling of the superfluid transition temperature with the interaction strength, Tc=0.0314|U|. Our results reveal a wide separation of temperature scales between local pair formation and global phase coherence, which stabilizes a broad intermediate supercompressible bosonic fluid region of preformed pairs that bridges the normal Fermi gas and the flat-band superfluid. We further demonstrate that both the transition temperature and density compressibility are significantly enhanced in the flat band compared to van Hove fillings. Our findings highlight the essential role of flat-band-enhanced pair-density fluctuations in separating the pairing and phase-coherence scales, offering clear experimental signatures for probing flat-band superfluidity and superconductivity in cold-atom and kagome-material platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用大规模行列式量子蒙特卡洛模拟，研究了吸引型kagome Hubbard模型中平带超流转变。通过系统计算转变温度、自旋磁化率和密度可压缩性，作者建立了平带填充下的有限温度相图，并发现超流转变温度与相互作用强度呈清晰的线性关系。研究结果揭示了局域对形成和全局相干性之间存在广泛的温度尺度分离，这稳定了一个宽广的预形成对的超可压缩玻色流体区域。此外，平带中的转变温度和密度可压缩性均显著高于范霍夫填充。
authors: Xiang Li, Yu Wang

articles.title: Quasiparticle Interactions in the S = 1/2 Heisenberg Antiferromagnetic Chain CuPzN
articles.title_zh: S = 1/2 海森堡反铁磁链 CuPzN 中的准粒子相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34536v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate spinon--spinon interactions in the quasi-one-dimensional S=1/2 Heisenberg antiferromagnet Cu(C₄H₄N₂₎₍NO₃₎₂ (CuPzN) using inelastic neutron scattering. At zero field, the spectrum exhibits the canonical multi-spinon continuum of the Heisenberg chain. With increasing field we demonstrate the appearance of an energy gap 2Δ towards momentum qi̊ghtarrow 0 between the uniform magnetization precession mode and the shifted spinon continuum. 2Δ is a direct measure of spinon backscattering interactions. Comparison with numerical matrix-product-state calculations and a recent analytical theory shows excellent agreement. By examining the integrable spin-1/2 chain, we provide an example of how quasiparticle interactions can be quantified experimentally in isotropic quantum spin systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究利用非弹性中子散射技术，探究了准一维S=1/2海森堡反铁磁体CuPzN中的自旋子-自旋子相互作用。结果显示，在零磁场下存在典型的多自旋子连续谱，而随着磁场增加，在动量趋近于零时出现一个能量间隙2Δ，该间隙直接衡量了自旋子反散射相互作用。实验结果与数值矩阵乘积态计算及最新解析理论高度吻合，为各向同性量子自旋系统中准粒子相互作用的实验量化提供了实例。
authors: Leshan Zhao, Timothy Reeder, Matthew Stone, Daniel G. Mazzone, Jakob Lass, Christof Niedermayer, Daniel H. Reich, Anna Keselman, Oleg A. Starykh, Collin Broholm

articles.title: From Autonomous Knowledge Generation to Generalizable Property Prediction: A Precision-First Pipeline for Electro-Optic Materials Discovery
articles.title_zh: 从自主知识生成到可泛化性能预测：电光材料发现的精度优先流程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34628v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electro-optic materials, whose refractive index changes linearly with an applied electric field (the Pockels effect), set the speed and energy of optical modulators and microwave-to-optical links for quantum computing. Designing better materials requires optimizing composition alongside temperature, strain, and bias field. However, general repositories lack electro-optic tensor data. We present a pipeline that builds such a database from literature following the rule: "no value is better than a wrong value." The pipeline has five stages: physics-aware acquisition, layout-aware extraction via LLM and deterministic table parsers, a three-tier verification gate, cross-paper consensus using median and median absolute deviation, and a noise-robust surrogate model audited by leave-one-material-out (LOMO) testing. Physics enters directly: notation is mapped, point-group symmetry-forbidden Pockels components are rejected, equivalent labels are merged, and values carry provenance tags. In a run over 49 publications, the gate processed 816 candidates into 414 accepted, 215 held for review, and 187 rejected. Against a hand-certified gold standard of 303 values from 16 papers, the run achieved a precision of 0.51 and recall of 0.48 for exact record matches. Across four database snapshots, held-out materials where the surrogate model beat a predict-the-mean baseline grew from 1 of 4 to 9 of 13 as the database expanded from 10 to 22 materials. While not a controlled comparison, this trend supports the premise that a precision-oriented, physics-checked database can power forward models beyond its training set and clarifies requirements for inverse material design.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种“精度优先”的流程，旨在从文献中构建电光材料数据库，以解决现有通用存储库中电光张量数据缺失的问题。该流程包含物理感知采集、基于大型语言模型和确定性表格解析器的布局感知提取、三层验证门、跨论文共识以及噪声鲁棒代理模型五个阶段。通过对49篇文献的运行，该流程从816个候选数据中筛选出414个接受数据，显著提升了电光材料发现的效率与准确性。
authors: Dibakar Datta

articles.title: Orbital-selective correlations in kagome flat bands of Co₃Sn₂S₂
articles.title_zh: Co₃Sn₂S₂ 笼目平带中的轨道选择性关联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35255v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Geometrical flat bands provide an ideal platform for studying electronic correlations and quantum-geometric effects. Although the ferromagnetic Weyl semimetal CoSnS is generally considered a moderately correlated system, recent spectroscopy experiments have revealed a flat-band feature near the Fermi level (EF) that is absent in conventional density functional theory (DFT) calculations. Using DFT plus dynamical mean-field theory and a minimal kagome model, we show that this feature arises not from heavy-fermion-like dynamical band renormalization, but from the shifting of a dₓ^₂₋y^₂ dominated geometrical kagome flat band toward EF driven by orbital- and spin-dependent self-energies. The relocated flat band enhances the local Berry curvature near EF, resulting in a strongly energy-dependent anomalous Hall conductivity and a giant anomalous Nernst effect. Our findings establish an orbital-selective correlation mechanism for positioning geometrical flat bands at EF, and propose anomalous thermoelectric transport as a sensitive probe of flat band induced topology.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究利用DFT加动力学平均场理论和最小笼目模型，揭示了铁磁外尔半金属Co₃Sn₂S₂中费米能级附近平带特征的起源。结果表明，该特征并非源于重费米子般的动态能带重整化，而是由轨道和自旋相关的自能驱动dₓ²₋y²主导的几何笼目平带向费米能级移动所致。这一重新定位的平带增强了费米能级附近的局域贝里曲率，导致了强能量依赖的反常霍尔电导率和巨大的反常能斯特效应，为通过反常热电输运探测平带诱导的拓扑性质提供了新途径。

articles.title: Information-theoretic entropy imaging of quantum matter
articles.title_zh: 量子物质的信息论熵成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35790v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phase transitions can generate intricate spatial organization invisible to spatially averaged probes, yet quantitative measures of this organization remain limited. Here we develop "entropy imaging," an information-theoretic technique that harnesses lossless compression to quantify spatial complexity, predictability, and order in quantum materials. Using this approach, emergent spatial textures can be imaged and converted into an experimentally-accessible observable: the computable information density (CID), a compression-based measure of information complexity that approaches the Shannon entropy rate in the large-system limit. Applied to millikelvin microwave impedance microscopy of graphene, the method reveals a pronounced maximum in the CID near quantum Hall transitions, a quantitative measure of the information-rich spatial organization of the critical landscape. A disordered Hofstadter model reproduces this behavior and shows that the CID can identify the quantum critical point from a sequence of images, without ensemble averaging over disorder realizations. The same framework tracks fractional quantum Hall transitions and resolves isolated fractional puddles that coexist with a disordered background. By contrast, the trivial band-edge crossover in a MoSe2/WS2 moiré heterobilayer exhibits qualitatively different behavior, suggesting that the pronounced CID enhancement observed at the quantum Hall critical point is not simply a generic feature of a conductive-insulating crossover. We further show that the geometric information encoded in CID is not reducible to a correlation length, and it can even distinguish spatial textures with identical multifractal statistics. Together, these results establish lossless compression as a framework for quantifying emergent spatial organization in quantum materials, with portability across imaging modalities and physical systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种名为“熵成像”的信息论技术，利用无损压缩来量化量子材料中的空间复杂性、可预测性和有序性。该方法将新兴的空间纹理转化为可计算信息密度（CID）这一实验可观测量。应用于石墨烯的微波阻抗显微镜，CID在量子霍尔跃迁附近显示出显著最大值，揭示了临界景观中信息丰富的空间组织。无序霍夫施塔特模型重现了这一行为，表明CID无需系综平均即可识别量子临界点。
authors: Chen Wu, Leonard W. Cao, Lingyuan Lyu, Liam Cohen, Jiahui Nie, Can Uzundal, Yujia Hu, Quanjin Wang, Ziying Yan, Sneh Pancholi, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Feng Wang, Andrea F. Young, Tarun Grover, Monica T. Allen

articles.title: Ubiquity of ocular resonances in scattering phenomena
articles.title_zh: 散射现象中“眼形”共振的普遍性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.33319v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We demonstrate how quantum mechanical scattering off a potential with a characteristic surface generically leads to a family of resonances in the complex momentum plane clustered near a roughly eye-shaped curve centered on the origin and formed by anti-Stokes lines. A particularly interesting class are potentials that are more singular than 1/r² at short distance, where the scattering surface is the separatrix between captured and deflected classical trajectories. These resonances have been recently shown to play an important role in low energy nucleon scattering, and can be related to ``creeping waves'' familiar from classical diffractive scattering and analyzed by means of Regge poles.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了量子力学散射在具有特征表面的势场中如何普遍导致复动量平面上出现一系列共振，这些共振聚集在由反斯托克斯线形成的近似眼形曲线附近。特别地，对于短距离处比1/r²更奇异的势场，散射表面是捕获和偏转经典轨迹之间的分界线。这些共振与经典衍射散射中常见的“蠕变波”和雷吉极点密切相关。
authors: Cullen Gantenberg, David B. Kaplan

articles.title: Lifshitz Phase of Quantum Gravity: The Infrared Fixed Point of the (2+1)D Unimodular Hořava-Chern-Simons Model
articles.title_zh: 量子引力的Lifshitz相：(2+1)维非模量Hořava-Chern-Simons模型的红外不动点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.34024v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We consider a nonrelativistic gravity theory in (2+1) dimensions with wᵢₙfty gauge symmetry that we call unimodular Hořava-Chern-Simons gravity. The theory has three dimensionless couplings, one of which is the Chern-Simons level κ. At large |κ|, the theory flows from an asymptotically free UV fixed point to an IR fixed point with anisotropic scale invariance characterized by a dynamical critical exponent z=2-tfrac32|κ|⁻¹. We speculate that unimodular Hořava-Chern-Simons gravity undergoes a phase transition from this scale-invariant phase to a confining phase when κ drops below a critical value.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了(2+1)维具有wᵢₙfty规范对称性的非相对论引力理论，即非模量Hořava-Chern-Simons引力。该理论包含三个无量纲耦合常数，其中之一是Chern-Simons能级κ。在大|κ|时，该理论从渐近自由的紫外不动点流向具有各向异性标度不变性（z=2-tfrac32|κ|⁻¹）的红外不动点。研究推测，当κ降至临界值以下时，非模量Hořava-Chern-Simons引力会经历从该标度不变相到限制相的相变。
authors: Maxim Zelenko, Dam Thanh Son

articles.title: Negative-Power Density of States in Chiral-Orthogonal Disordered Systems and the IR Phase of QCD
articles.title_zh: 手性正交无序系统中的负幂律态密度与QCD的红外相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.35524v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The recently discovered IR phase of QCD is characterized by an infrared (IR) sector of Dirac modes that separates and dynamically decouples from the bulk of the spectrum, becoming scale invariant in the process [1]. Among key features of this IR sector is the negative power-law behavior of Dirac spectral density near zero with power p close to -1. Here we start investigating to what extent can this behavior be mimicked by chiral Anderson models. In particular, we study 3-D chiral-orthogonal systems with logarithmic off-diagonal disorder where negative-power ``spikes'' have been observed [2]. We find that at finite disorder strength W of moderate strength, these models in fact do not have a power-singular density of states (DOS) at zero energy in the thermodynamic limit. Rather, this power p₁ vanishes and the spectrum features a very accurate power behavior with p<0 on an interval around E = 1 spreading increasingly closer to E=0 and E = infty with increasing W. We connect this to the fact that random hoppings t in these quantum systems are drawn from a scale-invariant 1/t distribution regularized via t in [e⁻W/², eW/²], and DOS with negative power can naturally arise inside that range. We show that łimW → ᵢₙfₜy p(W, E)=-1 for all energies accessible by our data. This indicates that, upon removing the cutoff W, quantum mechanics transforms the scale-invariant 1/t noise into a scale-invariant 1/E distribution of eigenstates, which mimics the interpretation of scale-invariant Dirac spectral densities in the IR phase as being due to scale-invariant glue backgrounds [1]. Our results imply that, to model the IR sector of the IR phase, the IR cutoff in chiral Anderson systems needs to be viewed as descending from the randomness strength W rather than the lattice size L.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了手性安德森模型能否模拟QCD红外相中狄拉克谱密度在零能量附近呈现的负幂律行为。研究发现，在具有对数非对角无序的三维手性正交系统中，当无序强度W适中时，这些模型在热力学极限下零能量处并不具有幂律奇异态密度。相反，它们在E=1附近的一个区间内表现出精确的负幂律行为，且随着W的增加，该区间向E=0和E=∞扩展。这一现象与随机跳跃t的标度不变1/t分布有关。
authors: Jiří Adam, Andrei Alexandru, Navdeep Singh Dhindsa, Ivan Horváth, Frank X. Lee, Nilmani Mathur

articles.title: Space-time Floquet operator: Nonreciprocity and fractional topology of space-time crystals
articles.title_zh: 时空Floquet算符：时空晶体的非互易性与分数拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.16562v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce a space-time Floquet operator for crystals whose spatial and temporal translations are intertwined. Unlike the conventional Floquet operator, which describes evolution over a full time period, the space-time Floquet operator evolves the system over a fraction of the period paired with a spatial shift that generates the primitive space-time unit cell. Its eigenmode spectrum defines a space-time band structure that unfolds conventional Floquet bands to reveal the consequences of the intertwined crystal symmetry in reciprocal frequency-wavevector space. We relate the topology of these space-time bands to quantized transport phenomena, such as Bloch oscillations and adiabatic charge transport, and uncover an intrinsically fractional charge pump enabled by the primitive space-time cycle. Numerical simulations quantitatively support these predictions with small deviations controlled by the speed of the modulation. We also demonstrate how nonreciprocal parametric resonances are naturally anticipated and accurately predicted by our framework. Our approach applies broadly to both classical and quantum systems with space-time symmetry, including non-Hermitian crystals.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了一种时空Floquet算符，用于描述空间和平移相互交织的晶体。该算符通过结合部分时间演化和空间位移来生成原始时空晶胞，并定义了时空能带结构。研究将这些时空能带的拓扑性质与布洛赫振荡和绝热电荷输运等量子输运现象联系起来，并揭示了一种由原始时空周期实现的分数电荷泵。数值模拟验证了这些预测，并展示了如何通过该框架预测非互易参数共振。
authors: Abhijeet Melkani, Jayson Paulose

articles.title: Rabi oscillations induced by nonresonant gyrating drive
articles.title_zh: 非共振旋转驱动诱导的拉比振荡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.11979v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Coherent control of two-level quantum systems is typically achieved using resonant driving fields, forming the basis for qubit operations. Here, we report a mechanism for inducing complete Rabi oscillations in monochromatically driven two-level quantum systems, when the drive frequency is much larger than the Larmor frequency of the qubit. This effectn̆icodex2015Rabi oscillations induced by nonresonant gyrating drive (RING)n̆icodex2015requires a gyrating control field, i.e., an elliptic drive trajectory that encloses a nonzero area per cycle. We illustrate the effect with numerical simulations, and provide an analytical understanding via a simple effective Hamiltonian obtained from Floquet theory and perturbation theory. We show that RING enables coherent oscillations without relying on resonant energy exchange, allows for high-pass noise filtering, provides access to non-Abelian phases in finite magnetic fields. We detail a realization in electrically driven spin-orbit qubits and argue that the RING mechanism enables amplification of the Rabi frequency using the same gate voltage amplitudes at higher drive frequencies. Our results broaden the landscape of quantum control techniques, by highlighting a pathway to achieving coherent oscillations under off-resonant driving conditions.

Here we suggest that the vortex line ensemble in the Vinen quantum turbulence in superfluids is described by the non-extensive Tsallis-Cirto statistics with δ=3. This in particular leads to the temperature, which describes the thermodynamics of the Vinen ensemble, Tsim mv², where v is the velocity of the flow and m is the mass of the atom of the superfluid liquid.

articles.title: Towards multi-QPU quantum systems: circuit mapping for high execution fidelity and low communication overhead
articles.title_zh: 面向多量子处理单元量子系统：实现高执行保真度和低通信开销的电路映射
articles.abstract: Multi-quantum processing unit (multi-QPU) architectures have emerged as a promising route for scaling up quantum computing. However, quantum circuit execution across QPUs introduces remote operations, which have lower fidelity than local operations and require additional communication resources. Circuit mapping, which determines where quantum information and operations are placed, critically affects the number of required remote operations and, consequently, the reliability and efficiency of distributed execution. Here, we introduce NAVI, a communication- and noise-aware circuit mapping framework for multi-QPU systems. NAVI addresses three mapping decisions in a staged compiler workflow: how to partition qubits according to evolving interaction patterns, which communication mode should be used for remote operations, and which physical QPUs should host the resulting qubit partitions under heterogeneous noise. Across a diverse set of benchmark circuits, NAVI reduces cumulative execution error by 40% to 55% and communication resource consumption by 60% to 72% on average compared with existing methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 多量子处理单元（multi-QPU）架构是扩展量子计算的一种有前景的途径，但跨QPU的量子电路执行引入了保真度较低且通信开销大的远程操作。电路映射对分布式执行的可靠性和效率至关重要。本文介绍了NAVI，一个通信和噪声感知的多QPU系统电路映射框架，通过分阶段的编译器工作流处理映射决策。NAVI在基准测试中显著降低了累积执行错误和通信资源消耗。
authors: Longshan Xu, Edwin Hsing-Mean Sha, Weixuan Liu and Qingfeng Zhuge

articles.title: Mutual Information Across Quantum Reference Frame Perspectives
articles.title_zh: 跨量子参考系视角的互信息
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31729v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In quantum information theory, standard notions typically presuppose a fixed partition of the world into subsystems, encoded in a tensor product structure of the Hilbert space. Yet, in some scenarios, the subsystem structure is not uniquely fixed. A case in point is the description of subsystems relative to different quantum reference frames (QRFs), where the tensor product structure, although fixed in a specific QRF, changes across different QRFs. Such a relativity of subsystems underlies many interesting features of QRFs, such as the relativity of entanglement, entropy, and coherence. It also raises a broader question: how do we compare the information across different subsystem perspectives, especially when the corresponding subsystem algebras overlap? Here, we propose a notion of quantum mutual information across different QRF perspectives, which captures the correlations between subsystems relative to different frames of reference. To do so, we focus on an algebraic definition of subsystems. Studying in detail the union and overlap between subsystem algebras relative to different QRFs, we find that the usual definition of mutual information in terms of the chain law overcounts the information associated to the overlap. Based on this insight, we propose a modified chain law and show that the resulting notion of mutual information satisfies subadditivity and connects naturally to other measures found in the literature [1]. Our investigations not only provide a way to quantify the relation between different QRF perspectives from an information-theoretic point of view but also sheds light on some important features of quantum information in absence of a fixed tensor product structure.
articles.abstract_zh: 在量子信息理论中，标准概念通常预设了固定的子系统划分，但在不同量子参考系（QRFs）下，子系统结构并非唯一固定。这种子系统相对性引出了如何比较不同子系统视角下信息的问题，尤其当相应子系统代数重叠时。本文提出了一种跨不同QRF视角的量子互信息概念，旨在捕捉不同参考系下子系统之间的关联。
authors: Leonardo Valente, Carla Ferradini, Flaminia Giacomini, Viktoria Kabel

articles.title: Quantum Complexity and Stabilizer-State Expansions: From Pairing to Deformation in Fermionic Systems
articles.title_zh: 量子复杂性与稳定子态展开：费米子系统中的配对到形变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31792v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding how collective phenomena such as pairing and deformation emerge in interacting fermionic systems, and how the correlations underlying them shape the resources required for their simulation, is a central challenge in many-body physics. We investigate various aspects of quantum complexity in a fermionic system exhibiting two main forms of collectivity, specifically deformation and pairing, through entanglement, non-stabilizerness, and fermionic non-Gaussianity. In the deformed phase, high entanglement coexists with low non-stabilizerness, while the superfluid pairing phase, by contrast, exhibits substantial multipartite entanglement and non-stabilizerness, together with maximal fermionic anti-flatness. In a second step we examine how to describe the phase diagram of the system in a classically scalable and symmetry-preserving way, by combining stabilizer-state expansion and variational basis optimization. A physics-guided decomposition of the Hamiltonian identifies the relevant stabilizer states, which can be constructed from graph states. A single stabilizer state captures the deformed phase to a large extent, and, although the number of stabilizer states required to describe the pairing phase grows exponentially with system size, a symmetry-preserving basis rotation yields a high-fidelity approximation using far fewer states. This rotated state can then serve as a practical starting point for quantum refinement.
articles.abstract_zh: 理解费米子系统中配对和形变等集体现象的出现及其对模拟资源的影响是多体物理学的核心挑战。本研究通过纠缠、非稳定子性和费米子非高斯性，探讨了费米子系统中形变和配对两种主要集体形式的量子复杂性。研究发现，形变相中高纠缠与低非稳定子性共存，而超流配对相则表现出显著的多体纠缠和非稳定子性。此外，本文还探讨了如何通过结合稳定子态展开和变分基优化，以经典可扩展且对称性保持的方式描述系统的相图。
authors: S. Momme Hengstenberg, Caroline E. P. Robin

articles.title: Graphical Rigidity of Continuous Variable Graph States under Gaussian Local Transformations
articles.title_zh: 高斯局域变换下连续变量图态的图刚性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31933v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimode entangled pure Gaussian states are an essential resource for continuous variable (CV) quantum information processing. Menicucci et al. [2011] have shown how to describe them as graphs with complex adjacency matrices. Among such complex graph states (CGSs), quantum optics experimental setups straightforwardly display correlations described by purely imaginary graph states (iRGSs) whereas theoretical literature favors off-diagonal real graph state (RGS) descriptions, which actually reflect the entanglement structure in the infinite squeezing limit [Gonzalez-Arciniegas et al. 2021]. We study them beyond this ideal case, thus establishing in the finite squeezing regime an equivalence criterion for the generic case of CGSs through a graph propagating set of conditions which either finds a Gaussian Local Unitary (GLU) converting one state to another or gives a proof of impossibility if such a GLU does not exist. In the experimentally relevant case of the conversion between iRGSs and RGSs, the set of conditions results in simple relations between the topologies of the equivalent real and imaginary graphs. Finally, we show that the canonical forms of iRGSs and RGSs imply that the topology of the CV real and imaginary graph states are too rigid to admit any exact qumode local-addition analogue to the qubit complementation or qudit local-addition, thus demonstrating the non-existence of any exact qumode local-addition for these states. We however define an approximate one when the squeezing is strong enough.
articles.abstract_zh: 多模纠缠纯高斯态是连续变量（CV）量子信息处理的重要资源，可用具有复邻接矩阵的图来描述。本研究超越了理想情况，在有限挤压区域内建立了通用复图态（CGSs）的等价准则，通过一组图传播条件来判断是否存在高斯局域酉变换（GLU）将一个态转换为另一个态。在实验相关的虚图态（iRGSs）和实图态（RGSs）之间的转换情况下，这些条件简化为等价实图和虚图拓扑之间的简单关系。
authors: Giorgio Ciliberto, Frédéric Grosshans

articles.title: Fidelity Dynamics of a Jaynes--Cummings Qubit under Markovian and Non-Markovian Coupling Noise
articles.title_zh: 马尔可夫和非马尔可夫耦合噪声下Jaynes-Cummings量子比特的保真度动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31938v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We analytically investigate the fidelity dynamics of a Jaynes--Cummings qubit coupled to a single-mode cavity in the presence of stochastic fluctuations of the qubit--cavity coupling. Such fluctuations naturally arise in cavity- and circuit-QED platforms due to fabrication imperfections, control-field noise, mechanical vibrations, and environmental disturbances. Since the qubit--cavity coupling governs the rate of coherent energy and information exchange, understanding the effects of its fluctuations is essential for assessing the performance of quantum communication, quantum sensing, and quantum information-processing protocols. We consider both Gaussian white noise and Ornstein--Uhlenbeck noise with finite correlation time as models for the coupling fluctuations. Exploiting the closed dynamics within each excitation manifold, we derive exact analytical expressions for the noise-averaged density matrix and the fidelity relative to the ideal noiseless evolution. We show that the fidelity is determined by a single decoherence factor governed by the integrated noise correlation function, establishing a direct connection between microscopic coupling fluctuations and macroscopic coherence loss. In the white-noise limit, the fidelity decays exponentially, whereas finite noise correlation times produce nonexponential decay and slower coherence loss. We further show that the crossover between Markovian-like and non-Markovian regimes is controlled by the ratio of the noise correlation rate to the coherent coupling strength, and that decoherence increases with photon number because of the enhanced effective qubit--cavity coupling. These results provide a unified analytical framework for quantifying decoherence induced by stochastic coupling fluctuations and for evaluating the robustness of cavity-QED protocols under correlated noise.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文分析研究了Jaynes-Cummings量子比特在存在量子比特-腔耦合随机波动情况下的保真度动力学。这种波动在腔-QED和电路-QED平台中自然产生，源于制造缺陷、控制场噪声、机械振动和环境扰动。理解其波动效应对于评估量子通信、量子传感和量子信息处理协议的性能至关重要。研究考虑了高斯白噪声和具有有限相关时间的Ornstein-Uhlenbeck噪声作为耦合波动的模型，并推导了噪声平均密度矩阵和相对于理想无噪声演化的保真度的精确解析表达式。
authors: Fang Wang, Da-Wei Luo, Ting Yu

articles.title: Noise-Assisted Quantum Entanglement: Memory-Enhanced Coherence in Stochastic Jaynes-Cummings Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 噪声辅助量子纠缠：随机Jaynes-Cummings动力学中记忆增强的相干性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31947v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate qubit entanglement dynamics in a two-qubit cavity system with stochastically fluctuating coupling strength, comparing white noise (Markovian) and Ornstein-Uhlenbeck noise (non-Markovian) processes. We analytically solve the system dynamics for both Fock and coherent cavity states and systematically characterize how initial qubit configurations affect entanglement generation and preservation. Our results reveal distinct dynamical regimes: in the Fock-state cavity, initial states in the single-excitation subspace generate robust qubit entanglement in decoherence-free subspaces, while initially entangled states in the double-excitation subspace exhibit inevitable decay without protective symmetries. For coherent cavities, we identify a critical photon-number threshold in the intermediate coherent-state amplitude regime where dynamics transition from low-frequency to high-frequency entanglement oscillations, while universal entanglement loss occurs at large amplitudes. Remarkable resilience against entanglement sudden death emerges under strong non-Markovian noise with long correlation times, where repeated revivals occur. These findings establish cavity photon statistics and environmental memory time as key control parameters for engineering qubit entanglement dynamics in qubit-cavity systems, revealing how system-environment correlations govern quantum information preservation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了具有随机涨落耦合强度的双量子比特腔系统中的量子比特纠缠动力学，比较了白噪声（马尔可夫）和Ornstein-Uhlenbeck噪声（非马尔可夫）过程。研究分析求解了Fock态和相干腔态下的系统动力学，并系统地表征了初始量子比特配置如何影响纠缠的产生和保持。结果揭示了不同的动力学机制，特别是在强非马尔可夫噪声下，系统展现出对纠缠猝死的显著抵抗力，并伴随重复的复苏现象。
authors: Fang Wang, Quanzhen Ding, Jun Jing, Ting Yu

articles.title: Demonstrating RFSoC-based Control of a Fully Connected Exchange-Only Qubit
articles.title_zh: 演示基于RFSoC的全连接仅交换量子比特控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31998v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Semiconductor triple-quantum dots (TQDs) are a promising platform for scalable quantum information processing, but the community has so far lacked access to affordable and flexible high-speed control electronics. SpinQICK, an open-source spin qubit-control package built on the Xilinx Radio Frequency System-on-Chip (RFSoC), directly addresses this gap by leveraging the high sampling-rate signal generation and advanced digital signal processing (DSP) capabilities of the Quantum Instrumentation Control Kit (QICK) to enable precise time-domain voltage control and readout of semiconductor spin qubits. In this paper, we use spinQICK to demonstrate coherent control, state preparation, and readout of a fully connected triangular exchange-only device. We also introduce and experimentally verify a novel dynamical decoupling (DD) sequence enabled by the triangular TQD and leverage its unique decoupling properties to characterize electrical noise. These results establish spinQICK as a low-cost, flexible platform for semiconductor spin qubit control and provide a pathway for hardware optimization through qubit-level noise diagnostics.
articles.abstract_zh: 半导体三量子点（TQD）是可扩展量子信息处理的有前景平台，但缺乏经济灵活的高速控制电子设备。SpinQICK是一个基于Xilinx RFSoC的开源自旋量子比特控制软件包，利用QICK的高采样率信号生成和高级数字信号处理能力，实现对半导体自旋量子比特的精确时域电压控制和读出。本文使用SpinQICK演示了对全连接三角形仅交换器件的相干控制、态制备和读出，并引入并实验验证了一种新型动态解耦序列。这些结果确立了SpinQICK作为低成本、灵活的半导体自旋量子比特控制平台。
authors: Abigail L. Wessels, M. Garrett Bimstefer, Joseph D. Broz, Alen Senanian, Andrew E. Oriani

articles.title: QuantumMatterExplorer: An Autonomous Agent for the Discovery of Quantum Many-Body Phases of Matter
articles.title_zh: QuantumMatterExplorer：用于发现量子多体物相的自主智能体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32001v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mapping the phase diagram of a new quantum Hamiltonian demands expert judgement at every step: which observables to measure, where in parameter space to compute, or how to separate genuine order from finite-size artefacts. We introduce QuantumMatterExplorer, an autonomous agent that takes only a Hamiltonian and its parameter ranges as input and returns a phase diagram obtained from its own numerical simulations. The agent is built on a large language model and is designed to reason over a long horizon, maintain a persistent written plan, and drive a set of computational tools, with density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations cross-checked against independent exact diagonalization. The agent combines a large language model with persistent planning, a library of expert computational-physics skills, and density-matrix renormalization group calculations validated against independent exact diagonalization. It adaptively selects quantities to evaluate, refines parameter scans, and performs finite-size analyses as evidence accumulates. After validating the approach on Hamiltonians with known transitions, we challenge it with a frustrated bilinear-biquadratic spin-1 chain with single-ion anisotropy, whose two-dimensional phase diagram was published only recently and is unlikely to appear in any training corpus. Given no hint about the expected physics, the agent proposes which observables to probe, and identifies candidate Néel, Haldane and dimerized phases, in broad agreement with the reference phase diagram. It also detects incommensurate correlations and infers the frustration-dependent geometry of the phase boundaries, all within an eight-hour compute budget. These results open a practical route to the autonomous computational discovery of new phases of quantum matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 绘制新的量子哈密顿量相图需要专家判断，而QuantumMatterExplorer是一个自主智能体，仅以哈密顿量及其参数范围为输入，即可通过其自身的数值模拟返回相图。该智能体基于大型语言模型构建，旨在进行长期推理、维护持久的书面计划并驱动一套计算工具。它结合了持久规划和专家计算物理技能库，并使用密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）计算，并通过独立的精确对角化进行交叉验证，能够自适应地选择评估量、优化参数扫描并执行有限尺寸分析。
authors: Jannes Nys, Andrew Jreissaty, Juan Carrasquilla

articles.title: Asymptotic scars arising from the remnants of quantum phase transitions
articles.title_zh: 源自量子相变残余的渐近量子疤痕
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32037v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many-body localisation, Hilbert space fragmentation and quantum many-body scars (QMBS) are well-established mechanisms of ergodicity breaking in quantum systems. Recently, asymptotic quantum many-body scars (AQMBS), non-thermal states whose stability grows with system size, have been proposed theoretically and probed experimentally. Here, we show that AQMBS arise naturally as remnants of certain quantum phase transitions. For a broad class of frustration-free Hamiltonians, we prove that their gapless excitations survive deformation into a scarred Hamiltonian as states whose energy variance is bounded by the excitation gap. Consequently, the gapless excitations at a quantum critical point become AQMBS of the scarred Hamiltonian. Their fidelity relaxation time is then set by the critical scaling of the gap, determined by the dynamic critical exponent. Modelling the critical Fredkin and Motzkin chains and the two-dimensional PVBS model, we obtain AQMBS whose variances directly reflect the dynamic exponents of the underlying transitions. Where the gap of the Motzkin chain closes super-exponentially, we find exponentially stable AQMBS, for which we also observe numerical evidence of volume-law entanglement.
articles.abstract_zh: 多体局域化、希尔伯特空间碎裂和量子多体疤痕（QMBS）是量子系统中遍历性破缺的成熟机制。本研究表明，渐近量子多体疤痕（AQMBS）作为某些量子相变的残余自然产生，其稳定性随系统尺寸增长。对于一类广泛的无挫折哈密顿量，我们证明了其无能隙激发在形变为疤痕哈密顿量后仍能作为能量方差受激发能隙限制的态而存在。因此，量子临界点处的无能隙激发成为疤痕哈密顿量的AQMBS，其保真度弛豫时间由能隙的临界标度决定。研究通过建模临界Fredkin和Motzkin链以及二维PVBS模型，获得了方差直接反映潜在跃迁动态指数的AQMBS。
authors: Leonard Logarić, Shane Dooley, Tsuyoshi Okubo, Nobuyuki Yoshioka

articles.title: Real-space construction and selection rules of center-of-mass momentum eigenstates in two-dimensional many-body lattices
articles.title_zh: 二维多体格点中质心动量本征态的实空间构建与选择规则
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32054v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a comprehensive framework for the real-space construction of center-of-mass (c.m.) momentum eigenstates in two-dimensional (2D) quantum many-body systems. Unlike standard momentum-space approaches, our real-space formalism explicitly captures the non-uniformity of cyclic subspace dimensions, which are fundamentally governed by the spatial symmetries of the many-body configurations and particle statistics. We demonstrate that performing 2D real-space translations on multi-particle states naturally induces non-trivial translation phase factors associated with the characters of these stabilizer subgroups, leading to a renormalization of permissible momentum values. Notably, we identify an anomalous cross-dimensional momentum coupling in highly symmetric particle distributions, where the permissible momentum values in one direction are strictly constrained by those in the perpendicular direction. We emphasize the algorithmic necessity of this coupling, as neglecting it leads to missing or duplicated basis states in numerical implementations. Concrete examples are provided to demonstrate the practical implementation and physical consequences of this framework.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一个在二维量子多体系统中实空间构建质心（c.m.）动量本征态的综合框架。与标准动量空间方法不同，我们的实空间形式明确捕捉了循环子空间维度的非均匀性，这主要由多体构型的空间对称性和粒子统计决定。研究表明，对多粒子态进行二维实空间平移自然会引入与这些稳定子子群特征相关的非平凡平移相因子，从而导致允许动量值的重整化。值得注意的是，我们在高度对称的粒子分布中识别出一种异常的跨维度动量耦合，其中一个方向的允许动量值受到垂直方向的严格限制。研究强调了这种耦合的算法必要性，因为忽略它会导致数值实现中基态的缺失或重复，并提供了具体的例子来演示实际实现和物理含义。
authors: Ling Lin, Yongguan Ke, Chaohong Lee

articles.title: Photon-Number Discrimination from Increasing Time-of-Arrival Separation in Wide Superconducting Microstrip Single-Photon Detectors
articles.title_zh: 宽超导微带单光子探测器中光子数分辨的到达时间分离增加
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32154v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Measurements of photon-number-dependent time-of-arrival (TOA) distributions in wide NbN superconducting microstrip single-photon detectors (SMSPDs) are presented. Two SI10m̆-long devices with widths of SI3.2m̆ and SI6.4m̆ are characterized under pulsed SI515nm excitation. The TOA histograms are described by sums of exponentially modified Gaussian (EMG) components, with the wider device exhibiting components assigned to photon numbers up to (n=8). Adjacent TOA peaks become more distinguishable relative to their widths at higher photon number, in contrast to the compression of neighboring photon-number timing shifts observed in conventional narrow-wire SNSPDs. For the components assigned to (n=7) and (n=8), the FWHM-normalized peak separation is (2.15), and the fitted EMG distributions yield an equal-prior pairwise TOA-assignment fidelity of (99.6%). The EMG exponential-tail parameter (τₙ) decreases strongly with photon number, while the Gaussian-location parameter (μₙ) continues to shift between neighboring components. A phenomenological model motivated by absorption-site-dependent vortex processes and collective current redistribution captures these timing trends. These results support wide SMSPDs as a platform for TOA-based photon-number discrimination at high photon number, relevant to multiphoton-state characterization and photonic quantum information processing. The same geometry also provides a setting to examine how the spatial distribution of photon absorption affects vortex-assisted detection.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究展示了宽NbN超导微带单光子探测器（SMSPDs）中光子数依赖的到达时间（TOA）分布测量结果。两个宽度分别为3.2μm和6.4μm的10μm长器件在脉冲515nm激发下进行了表征。TOA直方图由指数修正高斯（EMG）分量之和描述，其中较宽的器件显示出高达n=8的光子数分量。与传统窄线SNSPD中观察到的相邻光子数时间偏移压缩相反，相邻TOA峰在较高光子数下相对于其宽度变得更易区分。对于分配给n=7和n=8的分量，FWHM归一化峰分离为2.15，拟合的EMG分布产生了99.6%的等先验成对TOA分配保真度。研究还提出了一个基于吸收位点依赖的涡旋过程和集体电流再分布的唯象模型。
authors: Hsin-Yeh Wu, Shu-Xiao Liu, Boris Tuchming, Xavier-François Navick, Pu-Kai Wang, Yi-Ren Wu, Jia-Wern Chen, Marc Besançon, Jean-François Glicenstein, Pisin Chen, Yu-Jung Lu, Stathes Paganis

articles.title: Traceable Quantum Secret Sharing
articles.title_zh: 可追溯的量子秘密共享
