articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32218v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum secret sharing protects distributed quantum information against unauthorized reconstruction, yet existing schemes provide no intrinsic accountability when shares are leaked or forged. This missing capability is particularly relevant in realistic distributed settings, where compromised participants may either expose valid shares or maliciously interfere with reconstruction. Here we establish a framework for traceable quantum secret sharing under these two threat models. We introduce leakage-verifiable and traceable quantum secret sharing (LVT-QSS), which attributes leaked shares through an explicit leakage verification mechanism, and malicious-traceable and accountable quantum secret sharing (MTA-QSS), which identifies participants who submit forged shares during reconstruction. We formulate security definitions for both settings and prove that the proposed protocols satisfy the corresponding guarantees against the relevant adversaries. Numerical simulations under per-share depolarizing noise further quantify the robustness of the proposed schemes and identify verification as the dominant noise sensitive stage. These results incorporate accountability into quantum secret sharing and provide a foundation for traceable distributed quantum cryptography.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子秘密共享保护分布式量子信息免受未经授权的重建，但现有方案在份额泄露或伪造时缺乏内在问责能力。本研究建立了在两种威胁模型下可追溯量子秘密共享的框架：泄漏可验证和可追溯量子秘密共享（LVT-QSS），用于归因泄露的份额；以及恶意可追溯和可问责量子秘密共享（MTA-QSS），用于识别在重建过程中提交伪造份额的参与者。研究为两种设置制定了安全定义，并证明了所提出的协议满足对抗相关对手的相应保证。在每份额去极化噪声下的数值模拟进一步量化了所提出方案的鲁棒性，并确定验证是主要的噪声敏感阶段。
authors: Mengyan Qiao, Jian Long, Yu Li, Zhu Cao

articles.title: High Resolution Hyperspectral Quantum Infrared Imaging with Undetected Photons
articles.title_zh: 基于未探测光子的高分辨率高光谱量子红外成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32292v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum sensing in the infrared regime often demands the use of expensive and cryogenically operated detectors. Nonlinear interferometry has paved the way for information transfer from the infrared to the near--infrared or visible regime in various quantum technologies. A particularly interesting application of these interferometers involves spectrally--resolved quantum imaging using undetected photons, enabled by the use of temperature--tunable parametric amplifiers. In this work, we demonstrate spectrally resolved transmission imaging with undetected photons around 1550 nm using a spontaneous parametric down conversion based folded nonlinear interferometric scheme, registering the attenuation of a zebrafish larva as a biological feasibility test. We characterize and calibrate the interferometer, having achieved spectrally resolved interference fringes with a maximum baseline visibility of sim 74% in the near--infrared regime. Phase--stepped readout of a grating spectrometer gives a resolving power of sim1460 (from the spectrometer's point spread function) at 1550 nm, and sim 730 from the coherence length, the finest reported for imaging with undetected photons, over an instantaneous spectral window of approx 51 cm⁻¹.
articles.abstract_zh: 红外波段的量子传感通常需要昂贵且低温操作的探测器。非线性干涉测量为各种量子技术中将信息从红外传输到近红外或可见光波段铺平了道路。本工作展示了使用基于自发参量下转换的折叠非线性干涉方案，在1550 nm附近进行未探测光子的光谱分辨透射成像，并以斑马鱼幼体衰减作为生物可行性测试。研究对干涉仪进行了表征和校准，在近红外波段实现了约74%的最大基线可见度的光谱分辨干涉条纹。光栅光谱仪的相移读数在1550 nm处提供了约1460（根据光谱仪点扩散函数）和约730（根据相干长度）的分辨率，这是目前报道的最高分辨率。
authors: Aadi Suketu Bharatia, Vidya Prakash Muppalla, Ananya Asthana, Priyanka Kandankel, Tanmoy Chakraborty, Sreelaja Nair, Anshuman Kumar

articles.title: LYNX - A trapped-ion quantum information processor
articles.title_zh: LYNX - 一种囚禁离子量子信息处理器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32518v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce LYNX, a quantum information processor based on trapped ⁴⁰Ca⁺ ions. It utilizes up to 31 qubits with all-to-all connectivity. We characterize the system performance using rigorous benchmarks, such as randomized benchmarking (RB), GHZ state fidelity estimates, and quantum volume (QV) tests. The LYNX processor shows average 1-qubit gate errors of 8(5)× 10⁻⁵ tested via standard RB in a 24-qubit register. An average 2-qubit gate error in a 24-qubit register of 2.84(8)× 10⁻³ is demonstrated using interleaved RB. Furthermore, the device passes QV tests using up to 15 qubits which corresponds to a quantum volume of QV=2¹⁵.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究介绍了LYNX，一种基于囚禁⁴⁰Ca⁺离子的量子信息处理器，它利用多达31个量子比特并具有全连接能力。研究通过随机基准测试（RB）、GHZ态保真度估计和量子体积（QV）测试等严格基准对系统性能进行了表征。LYNX处理器在24量子比特寄存器中，通过标准RB测试显示平均单量子比特门错误率为8(5)×10⁻⁵。通过交错RB测试，在24量子比特寄存器中演示了平均双量子比特门错误率为2.84(8)×10⁻³。此外，该设备通过了多达15个量子比特的QV测试，达到了QV=2¹⁵的量子体积。
authors: Alexander Erhard, Georg Jacob, Max Hettrich, Philip C. Holz, Juris Ulmanis, Thomas Feldker

articles.title: Photon-Pair Advantage for Dissipative Parameter Estimation in Whispering-Gallery-Mode Interferometers
articles.title_zh: 耳语画廊模式干涉仪中耗散参数估计的光子对优势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32541v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the estimation of detuning and intrinsic loss in a lossy whispering-gallery-mode (WGM) resonator located in a balanced Mach--Zehnder interferometer. We use indistinguishable photon pairs and coherent-state probes. We show that using indistinguishable photon pairs can provide higher Quantum Fisher Information (QFI) of dissipative parameters, such as intrinsic loss, at resonance away from critical coupling. Taking into account all photon-loss outcomes, we obtain analytical QFI expressions and compare photon-pair and coherent-state probe results when they have the same mean photon number. For estimating the round-trip amplitude transmission at resonance and away from critical coupling, the photon-pair probe gives a higher QFI than the coherent-state probe, and photon-number-resolved detection saturates this QFI. This advantage is due to the photon-loss statistics and it is still accessible for a typical overcoupled condition after averaging over fluctuations of the unresolved detuning. We identify the limits of this advantage: phase doubling does not improve resonant detuning estimation, and coincidence-only detection is inefficient close to a zero transmission. These results identify the cases in which photon pairs can be useful for absorption and pump--probe WGM sensing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了在平衡Mach-Zehnder干涉仪中，对有损耗耳语画廊模式（WGM）谐振器的失谐和固有损耗的估计，并比较了使用不可区分光子对和相干态探测器的性能。结果表明，在谐振且远离临界耦合的条件下，使用不可区分光子对可以为耗散参数（如固有损耗）提供更高的量子Fisher信息（QFI）。考虑到所有光子损耗结果，研究获得了分析QFI表达式，并比较了在平均光子数相同时光子对和相干态探测器的结果。对于估计谐振且远离临界耦合的往返振幅透射率，光子对探测器提供了比相干态探测器更高的QFI，且光子数分辨探测可以达到此QFI的饱和。这种优势源于光子损耗统计，并且在典型的过耦合条件下，经过对未分辨失谐波动的平均后仍然可以获得。研究还指出了这种优势的局限性：相位加倍并不能改善谐振失谐估计，且仅使用符合计数探测效率低下。
authors: Elnaz Darsheshdar, Callum Jones, Seyed Mostafa Moniri, Antonio Vidiella-Barranco, Jolly Xavier, Frank Vollmer

articles.title: The Compendium of Super-Quadratic Computational Quantum Advantages
articles.title_zh: 超二次计算量子优势汇编
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32595v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This compendium presents a structured collection of computational problems with credible prospects for realizing meaningful quantum advantage, focused on describing problem characteristics rather than specific algorithms. It is intended for non-quantum researchers and practitioners with strong computational backgrounds, particularly domain experts, seeking to assess the relevance of quantum methods to real-world problems. The compendium focuses on enumerating core problems for which there is good evidence that a quantum computer can realize more than a quadratic speedup in offline non-relativized time-complexity (e.g., as opposed to in oracular settings, streaming models, or communication advantages). Entries characterize the structural constraints that real-world instances must satisfy to realize those advantages in practice. The intention is to provide a reference that can be leveraged to connect quantum algorithms to practical use cases.
articles.abstract_zh: 本汇编提供了一系列计算问题的结构化集合，这些问题具有实现有意义量子优势的可靠前景，重点描述问题特征而非具体算法。它旨在帮助具有强大计算背景的非量子研究人员和从业者，特别是领域专家，评估量子方法与实际问题的相关性。汇编侧重于列举核心问题，对于这些问题，有充分证据表明量子计算机可以在离线非相对化时间复杂度方面实现超过二次的加速。条目描述了实际实例必须满足的结构约束，以在实践中实现这些优势，旨在为连接量子算法与实际用例提供参考。
authors: Philipp Kammerlander, Thomas E. O'Brien, Robbie King, Rolando D. Somma, Mária Kieferová, Brad Lackey, Alexander Schmidhuber, Siddhartha Jain, Andi Gu, Yuri Alexeev, Shouvanik Chakrabarti, Ruslan Shaydulin, Pietro M. Posta, Guang Hao Low, Dar Gilboa, Matthias Troyer, Barry C. Sanders, Matthias Christandl, Elica Kyoseva, Catherine Lefebvre, Ryan Babbush

articles.title: Entanglement Asymmetry and Asymmetry Contour under Boundary Symmetry Breaking
articles.title_zh: 边界对称性破缺下的纠缠不对称性与不对称轮廓
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32733v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate how symmetry-breaking boundary magnetic fields affect magnetization and Rényi-2 entanglement asymmetry (EA) in the transverse-field Ising model. For the ground state, magnetization exhibits qualitatively distinct behaviors in the ordered and disordered phases. EA also exhibits phase-dependent behavior, which is well captured by the lower and upper bounds derived in this work. In the critical regime, both magnetization and EA exhibit behavior qualitatively consistent with the field-theoretical predictions for a related setup. We also study boundary-quench dynamics and find that magnetization propagates from the boundary into the bulk with a velocity consistent with the maximum quasiparticle velocity. In contrast, because EA is a subsystem-integrated quantity, its spatial structure is not directly resolved. We therefore introduce the asymmetry contour, a contour-like finite-difference quantity that provides a spatially resolved characterization of the symmetry-breaking information encoded in the reduced density matrix. The resulting contour is complementary to the local magnetization, retaining sensitivity to nonlocal many-body correlations while its dynamics also reflects the underlying quasiparticle propagation. These results show how EA and its contour can provide complementary information-theoretic characterizations of symmetry breaking and its spatial structure.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了横场伊辛模型中对称性破缺的边界磁场如何影响磁化强度和Rényi-2纠缠不对称性（EA）。研究发现，基态的磁化强度和EA在有序相和无序相中表现出不同的行为，且EA的行为与推导出的上下限一致。在临界区域，两者均与场论预测定性一致。此外，作者引入了不对称轮廓，这是一种提供空间分辨对称性破缺信息的新量，与局部磁化强度互补。
authors: Takahiro Orito, Daisuke Yamamoto

articles.title: Exploiting the Weyl-Chamber Structure for Hardware-Aware Quantum Circuit Compression
articles.title_zh: 利用Weyl腔结构实现硬件感知量子电路压缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32812v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum circuit compression based on tensor networks enables long-time simulation of quantum many-body dynamics on near-term hardware. While Riemannian optimization has been successfully employed for this purpose, it typically optimizes over the manifold of generic two-qubit unitaries. Consequently, the resulting gates must still be synthesized into the hardware's native gate set via KAK decomposition, an overhead that partially negates the original compression gain. We show that Riemannian-optimized gates already exhibit a predictable Weyl structure: near-RZZ for the Ising model and near-fSim for the Heisenberg XXZ model. Building on this insight, we investigate whether parameterized optimization directly over the native gate set can offer a beneficial trade-off between expressivity and circuit efficiency by reducing the circuit's dimensionality. When comparing the two approaches, we find that the small residual Weyl parameters neglected by the latter are essential for high compression of the Ising propagator, whereas for the Heisenberg propagator, the native XXZ structure can be exploited directly to build a more efficient compressed circuit.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于张量网络的量子电路压缩对于近期硬件上的量子多体动力学模拟至关重要。现有黎曼优化方法通常在通用两量子比特酉算符流形上进行，导致需要额外的KAK分解步骤。本文发现黎曼优化后的门操作已展现出可预测的Weyl结构，并探讨了直接在原生门集上进行参数化优化是否能提供表达能力和电路效率之间的良好权衡。研究表明，对于伊辛传播子，被忽略的小残余Weyl参数对高压缩至关重要；而对于海森堡传播子，可直接利用原生XXZ结构构建更高效的压缩。
authors: Neel Misciasci, Isabel Nha Minh Le, Christian B. Mendl

articles.title: Modular optical fault-tolerant quantum computation via an interface between verified resources and online logical operations
articles.title_zh: 通过验证资源与在线逻辑操作接口实现模块化光学容错量子计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32838v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a factory--processor interface architecture for modular optical fault-tolerant quantum computation that separates code-dependent encoded-resource preparation from reusable online logical processing on a common Gaussian optical processor. Beyond encoded resources, the interface specifies logical outputs, code-to-mode mapping, measurement roles, frame updates, verification records, and resource-injection boundaries. As a concrete realization, we combine an offline verified Bell-resource factory based on a recursively concatenated C₄ code with physical Gottesman--Kitaev--Preskill (GKP) qubits with an online time-domain measurement-based quantum computation (MBQC) processor. Under the specified additive-displacement-noise model and fixed postselection policy, simulations support the finite-level logical Bell-error ordering P₅
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种用于模块化光学容错量子计算的工厂-处理器接口架构，该架构将依赖于编码的资源准备与可重用的在线逻辑处理分离。该接口不仅定义了编码资源，还包括逻辑输出、编码到模式的映射、测量角色、帧更新、验证记录和资源注入边界。作为一个具体实现，作者将基于递归级联C₄码的离线验证贝尔资源工厂与物理GKP量子比特结合，并与在线时域基于测量的量子计算处理器协同工作。在特定噪声模型和后选择策略下，模拟结果支持有限级逻辑贝尔误差排序。
authors: Kosuke Fukui, Takaya Matsuura, Yohji Chin, Shohei Kiryu, Takaya Hoshi, Kan Takase, Warit Asavanant

articles.title: Hardware-Friendly Estimation of LCU-Based Expectation Values via Quantum-to-Classical Workload Shifting
articles.title_zh: 通过量子-经典工作负载转移实现LCU基期望值的硬件友好估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32841v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Estimating the expectation value of an observable O for a quantum state evolved under a general, possibly non-unitary, operator A is a fundamental task in quantum simulation, chemistry, and variational algorithms. Existing linear-combination-of-unitaries (LCU) approaches implement A on hardware, requiring ancilla qubits, controlled unitaries and, in randomized variants, fresh circuit executions for every Monte Carlo sample. These costs are prohibitive on NISQ and early fault-tolerant devices. We propose HERMES (Hardware-Efficient Reusable Measurements for Estimating LCU-based expectation valueS), which moves the processing of A entirely to the classical domain. Expanding A and O in the Pauli basis and sampling pairs of Pauli terms classically, HERMES rewrites μ = Tr(OAh̊o Adagger)/Tr(Ah̊o Adagger) as a ratio of weighted sums of Pauli expectation values on the unmodified state h̊o, with no ancillas, controlled unitaries, or quantum implementation of A. A two-level measurement reduction scheme (Pauli deduplication and commuting-group partitioning) bounds the number of distinct measurement settings independently of the sample count, unlike randomized LCU methods whose circuit executions grow linearly with it. On ground-state energy estimation of H₂ and LiH via imaginary-time evolution, HERMES matches or beats Pauli single-ancilla LCU baseline using shallow circuits with no two-qubit gates beyond state preparation under qubit-wise commuting grouping. It is also more robust to noise and completes a noisy LiH simulation infeasible for the baseline, at the cost of classical overhead growing with the number of Pauli terms in A.
articles.abstract_zh: 估计量子态在通用（可能非酉）算符A演化下的可观测量O的期望值是量子模拟中的一项基本任务。现有LCU方法在硬件上实现A，需要辅助量子比特和受控酉算符，成本高昂。本文提出了HERMES框架，将A的计算完全转移到经典域，通过在泡利基中展开A和O并经典采样泡利项对，将期望值重写为未修改态上泡利期望值的加权和比率。该方法无需辅助量子比特、受控酉算符或A的量子实现，并通过两级测量减少方案限制了测量设置的数量。
authors: Hari Hara Suthan Chittoor, Thirumalai Manimaran

articles.title: Low-frustration block encodings by patch routing
articles.title_zh: 通过补丁路由实现低挫折块编码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32946v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Block-encoding has emerged as a core primitive in many quantum algorithms, including quantum simulation. In this work, we design efficient and extensible methods for generating low-frustration block encodings of frustrated lattice Hamiltonians built from repeated local interaction patches through a technique we call "patch routing". We construct block encodings for a full Hamiltonian by first block-encoding a small local patch and then using a SWAP-style routing network to coherently apply the local patch encoding across the lattice. The expensive, local block-encoding cost is paid only once per query and is independent of lattice size, whereas the comparatively inexpensive routing network grows linearly with the lattice size, dominating at large sizes. Our method allows for a hierarchical structure in which larger patches can be block-encoded with small normalization factors, albeit at a higher (local, non-extensive) block-encoding cost, thereby reducing overall query complexity in an algorithm. We exploit symmetries and algebraic structures in local interactions to construct efficient block encodings, and we apply these techniques to the Heisenberg, Fermi-Hubbard, and honeycomb spin-liquid models. For a 120× 120 square-lattice J₁₋J₂ Heisenberg model near maximal frustration (J₂/J₁₌₀.4-0.6), our methods result in a 15-17× reduction in the leading T cost per qubitized-QPE run (ignoring initial state preparation and overlap) relative to prior state-of-the-art Pauli LCU constructions. Corresponding reductions are approximately 3× for the 120×120 Fermi-Hubbard model at half-filling. For time evolution of the honeycomb spin-liquid model on 120×120 unit cells, the leading cost is reduced by 5×. Our framework provides a systematic way forward for larger and more accurate fault-tolerant simulations of real-world quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 块编码是量子算法（包括量子模拟）中的核心原语。本文提出了一种高效且可扩展的方法，通过“补丁路由”技术为由重复局部相互作用补丁构建的挫折晶格哈密顿量生成低挫折块编码。该方法首先对小局部补丁进行块编码，然后使用SWAP式路由网络将局部补丁编码相干地应用于整个晶格。局部块编码成本与晶格大小无关，而路由网络成本随晶格大小线性增长。该方法允许分层结构，通过利用局部相互作用中的对称性和代数结构来构建高效的块编码。
authors: Minzhao Liu, Abeynaya Gnanasekaran, Ananth Kaushik, Siddharth Hariprakash, Alireza Marefat Khah, Martin Roetteler, Grant Salton

articles.title: Maximal Orbital Entanglement from Non-Interacting Fermions
articles.title_zh: 非相互作用费米子产生的最大轨道纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32974v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Orbital rotations are used in quantum many-body physics and chemistry to reduce the complexity of quantum states by compressing their correlation into a small set of relevant orbitals. In striking contrast, quantum information processing strives for the opposite: orbitals that maximize entanglement as a resource. Motivated by this, we prove that Slater determinants of N fermions on a lattice of d_A + d_B = d sites, although free of particle correlation, can carry up to mind_A, d_B, N, d-N ebits of orbital entanglement. Given enough particles and holes, this equals the maximum over all fermionic states. For arbitrary free states, we derive the maximal orbital total correlation in closed form for all bipartitions, the finest partition, and all partitions of up to five sites, using new majorization relations for Hermitian matrices. Taken together, these results turn mean-field states, the starting point of most many-body methods in physics and chemistry, into a viable resource for quantum information processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 轨道旋转在量子多体物理和化学中用于通过将关联压缩到少量相关轨道来降低量子态的复杂性。与此相反，量子信息处理则寻求最大化纠缠的轨道作为资源。本文证明了在d个格点上N个费米子的斯莱特行列式，尽管没有粒子关联，却能携带最大量的轨道纠缠。对于任意自由态，作者利用新的厄米矩阵优超关系，推导出了所有二分、最细划分以及最多五个格点的划分的最大轨道总关联的闭合形式。这些结果使平均场态成为量子信息处理的有效资源。
authors: Damiano Aliverti-Piuri, Julia Liebert, Christian Schilling

articles.title: High-quality, deep formation and identification of oxygen-vacancy defects in silicon carbide
articles.title_zh: 碳化硅中氧空位缺陷的高质量、深层形成与识别
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32642v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Optically addressable paramagnetic defects in silicon carbide (SiC) are attractive for scalable quantum technologies such as quantum sensing. PL5, PL6, and PL7 are promising defects for their high brightness and spin-readout contrast. Although generation by oxygen implantation has been reported very recently, nonuniform spin and optical properties and the limited generation depth of implanted defects hinder both high-sensitivity sensing and conclusive microscopic identification. Here we engineer high-quality defects by decoupling oxygen incorporation and defect formation, realizing highly homogeneous spin-resonance frequencies as well as narrow optical linewidths and long T2* coherence time. Further, we demonstrate defect formation beyond the ion range utilizing oxygen diffusion, exceptional among impurities in SiC. We further provide hyperfine-interaction statistics of 17O and host nuclei across many PL6 defects, making the oxygen-vacancy origin conclusive. Together, the microscopic identification and the demonstrated formation route establish a foundation for developing the oxygen-vacancy spin defect into a versatile quantum platform.
articles.abstract_zh: 碳化硅（SiC）中光学可寻址的顺磁缺陷对可扩展量子技术具有吸引力。PL5、PL6和PL7缺陷因其高亮度和自旋读出对比度而备受关注。本文通过解耦氧掺入和缺陷形成，成功制备了高质量的缺陷，实现了高度均匀的自旋共振频率、窄光学线宽和长T2*相干时间。研究还利用氧扩散实现了超越离子注入范围的缺陷形成，并提供了PL6缺陷中17O和主核的超精细相互作用统计数据，从而确证了氧空位起源。这些成果为将氧空位自旋缺陷发展为多功能量子平台奠定了基础。
authors: Ryo Shiotani, Fu-Chieh Chuang, Mitsuaki Kaneko, Tetsuri Nishikawa, Hiroshi Abe, Taiga Matsuoka, Shigehito Miki, Kazuki Okajima, Takeshi Ohshima, Yoshihiko Kanemitsu, Tsunenobu Kimoto, Naoya Morioka, Norikazu Mizuochi

articles.title: Ideal interaction dynamics of defects and background fields in condensed matter
articles.title_zh: 凝聚态物质中缺陷与背景场的理想相互作用动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32973v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: While defect dynamics in condensed matter systems is widely studied and several methods are available to track the defect position over time, the formulation of dynamical models for the coupled evolution of both defect and background field quantities seems to be more challenging. Yet, the overall behavior of a system containing moving defects is strongly influenced by this defect-field interaction. Here, we propose a modeling framework for the conservative coupled evolution of the defect density and the background fields upon focusing on two relevant cases of study: the Gross-Pitaevskii theory of quantum fluids and the Ericksen-Leslie model of nematic liquid crystals. To achieve the coupled evolution, we combine the Euler-Poincaré variational setting of continuum dynamics with the gauge theory of topological defects. While the latter allows us to overcome certain ambiguities in definition of the defect density, the Euler-Poincaré method provides a unified modeling approach in the absence of defect reconnection.
articles.abstract_zh: 凝聚态系统中缺陷动力学研究广泛，但缺陷与背景场耦合演化动力学模型的建立更具挑战性。本文提出了一个保守耦合演化模型框架，用于描述缺陷密度和背景场的演化，并以量子流体的Gross-Pitaevskii理论和向列液晶的Ericksen-Leslie模型为例。该框架结合了连续介质动力学的Euler-Poincaré变分设置和拓扑缺陷的规范理论，克服了缺陷密度定义中的歧义，并在无缺陷重连接的情况下提供了一种统一的建模方法。
authors: François Gay-Balmaz, Tudor S. Ratiu, Cesare Tronci

articles.title: Freezing and Shielding under Global Quenches for Long-Range Interacting Many-Body Systems
articles.title_zh: 长程相互作用多体系统在全局骤冷下的冻结与屏蔽效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2407.06072v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate how local perturbations spread on long-range interacting spin chains and show how their nonequilibrium behavior exactly matches the one of a Fermi-Hubbard model with long-range hoppings. We then focus on the thermalization of the fermionic model following a sudden quench of local interactions between two distinct fermionic species. For both models, the quasiparticle spectrum consists of gapped low-energy levels, while the high-energy ones accumulate at a single point. When the low-energy gaps are large enough, turning on the local interactions does not effectively mix high- and low-energy modes, resulting in a freezing of the dynamical evolution. In general, the states within the excited subspace are shielded from the long-range signatures of the model, which are responsible for the low-energy extended states, and the dynamics effectively look as if long-range couplings were absent. This shielding mechanism becomes evident in the presence of disorder. It is shown that shielding and freezing are a universal feature of long-range interacting systems, and their relation to the existence of quasistationary states is conjectured.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了长程相互作用自旋链中局部扰动的传播，并发现其非平衡行为与具有长程跳跃的费米-哈伯德模型精确匹配。研究发现，当低能隙足够大时，开启局部相互作用不会有效混合高低能模式，导致动力学演化的冻结。激发子空间中的态被模型的长程特征所屏蔽，使得动力学表现得如同没有长程耦合。这种屏蔽机制在存在无序时尤为明显，表明屏蔽和冻结是长程相互作用系统的普遍特征。
authors: Daniel Arrufat-Vicente, Nicolò Defenu

articles.title: Quantum-aware Transformer model for state classification
articles.title_zh: 用于量子态分类的量子感知Transformer模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2502.21055v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Entanglement is a fundamental feature of quantum mechanics, playing a crucial role in quantum information processing. However, classifying entangled states, particularly in the mixed-state regime, remains a challenging problem, especially as system dimensions increase. In this work, we focus on bipartite quantum states and present a data-driven approach to entanglement classification using transformer-based neural networks. Our dataset consists of a diverse set of bipartite states, including pure separable states, Werner entangled states, general entangled states, and maximally entangled states. We pretrain the transformer in an unsupervised fashion by masking elements of vectorized Hermitian matrix representations of quantum states, allowing the model to learn structural properties of quantum density matrices. This approach enables the model to generalize entanglement characteristics across different classes of states. Once trained, our method achieves near-perfect classification accuracy, effectively distinguishing between separable and entangled states. Compared to previous Machine Learning, our method successfully adapts transformers for quantum state analysis, demonstrating their ability to systematically identify entanglement in bipartite systems. These results highlight the potential of modern machine learning techniques in automating entanglement detection and classification, bridging the gap between quantum information theory and artificial intelligence.
articles.abstract_zh: 纠缠是量子力学的基本特征，但在混合态区域对纠缠态进行分类仍是一个挑战。本文提出了一种基于Transformer神经网络的数据驱动方法，用于二分量子态的纠缠分类。通过对量子态的矢量化厄米矩阵表示进行掩码预训练，模型能够学习量子密度矩阵的结构特性，从而泛化纠缠特征。训练后，该方法实现了近乎完美的分类精度，有效区分了可分离态和纠缠态，并成功将Transformer模型应用于量子态分类。
authors: Przemysław Sekuła, Michał Romaszewski, Przemysław Głomb, Michał Cholewa, Łukasz Pawela

articles.title: MERA: A Mid-Circuit-Measurement Error-Aware Compilation Framework for Quantum Circuits
articles.title_zh: MERA：一种面向量子电路的电路中测量误差感知编译框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.10921v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Mid-circuit measurement (MCM) enables qubit reuse and dynamic control in quantum processors, underpinning resource-efficient algorithms and quantum error correction. However, MCM introduces non-negligible errors, including measurement-induced crosstalk, idling-qubit decoherence, and reset infidelity. Additionally, MCM error rates vary across qubits within the same processor, with some exhibiting substantially higher errors. Existing compilers, including Qiskit-compiler and QR-Map, ignore MCM error variations, leading to fidelity loss in circuits with frequent MCM operations. In this paper, we present MERA, an MCM-error-aware quantum compilation framework that integrates MCM error modeling into the layout, routing, and scheduling stages. We first use the lightweight profiling method to capture a per-qubit MCM error distribution that remains stable for over 24 hours. The distribution guides MERA in applying MCM-error-aware layout and routing, while MERA further incorporates context-aware dynamic decoupling to improve fidelity. In evaluation, MERA delivers 24.94% -- 80.48% average fidelity gains over the Qiskit-compiler (optimization level 3) across different groups in selected benchmarks without additional SWAP overhead. It also boosts the fidelity of QR-Map-generated circuits by 29.26% on average (up to 122.58%), demonstrating its effectiveness for circuits with frequent MCM operations.
articles.abstract_zh: 电路中测量（MCM）在量子处理器中实现了量子比特复用和动态控制，但引入了不可忽略的误差且误差率因量子比特而异。现有编译器忽略了MCM误差变化，导致高MCM频率电路的保真度损失。本文提出了MERA框架，将MCM误差建模集成到布局、路由和调度阶段。MERA利用轻量级分析方法捕获每个量子比特的MCM误差分布，并指导MCM误差感知的布局和路由，同时结合上下文感知的动态解耦来提高保真度。评估结果显示，MERA相对于Qiskit编译器实现了显著的平均保真度提升。
authors: Ming Zhong, Zhemin Zhang, Xiangyu Ren, Chenghong Zhu, Siyuan Niu, Zhiding Liang

articles.title: Dissipative dynamics and superradiant countinuous time crystal in a Rydberg-interacting Dicke system
articles.title_zh: 耗散动力学与里德堡相互作用迪克系统中的超辐射连续时间晶体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.18119v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The interplay between many-body interactions and controlled dissipation provides a rich setting for nonequilibrium quantum phases. We explore the superradiant phase transitions in a Rydberg-interacting open Dicke model with cavity loss and local dissipation. We find that the nonlinear feedback from atomic interactions stabilizes the atomic collective excited state and induces resonant collective motion, which can be further converted into robust superradiant oscillations with the inclusion of local dissipation. Beyond the mean-field approximation, we prove this system can support the finite-size local dissipative temporal order, i.e., continuous time crystal, from evidences of the decreasing damping of a finite-frequency Liouvillian mode and the linear-size scaling of quantum fluctuations. The correlation between the atomic colletive dynamics and the cavity photon number makes our findings easy to detect from output optical signal. By bridging interacting atomic matter and driven-dissipative cavity QED, our Rydberg-interacting Dicke model provides a unique spin-1/2 platform for exploring dynamical phase transitions and macroscopic temporal order in open quantum matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 多体相互作用与受控耗散的相互作用为非平衡量子相提供了丰富的研究背景。本文探讨了里德堡相互作用开放迪克模型中具有腔损耗和局部耗散的超辐射相变。研究发现，原子相互作用的非线性反馈稳定了原子集体激发态并诱导共振集体运动，通过引入局部耗散可进一步转化为鲁棒的超辐射振荡。超越平均场近似，本文证明该系统可以支持有限尺寸的局部耗散时间序，即连续时间晶体，其证据包括有限频率Liouvillian模式阻尼的减小和量子涨落的线性尺寸标度。原子集体动力学与腔光子数之间的关联使得这些发现易于通过输出光信号检测。
authors: Haohang Zhou, Xianfeng Chen, Luqi Yuan

articles.title: Comment on "Quantum Limits to Incoherent Imaging are Achieved by Linear Interferometry"
articles.title_zh: 对“线性干涉测量实现非相干成像的量子极限”一文的评论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.20353v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We show that the construction of the linear interferometer in the Supplemental Material of arXiv:1909.09581 is flawed, leading to a generally suboptimal solution. We then provide the correct derivation of the optimal interferometric configuration that achieves the quantum Fisher information limit for imaging N weak incoherent emitters.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出arXiv:1909.09581补充材料中线性干涉仪的构造存在缺陷，导致其解决方案通常并非最优。作者随后提供了实现最优干涉配置的正确推导。该配置能够达到成像N个弱非相干发射器的量子费舍尔信息极限，纠正了先前工作中的不足。
authors: George Brumpton, Aiman Khan, Helia Hooshmand, Samanta Piano, Gerardo Adesso

articles.title: HQTN-SER: Speech Emotion Recognition with Hybrid Quantum Tensor Networks
articles.title_zh: HQTN-SER：基于混合量子张量网络的语音情感识别
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.14523v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Speech emotion recognition (SER) remains fragile in real-world conditions because emotional cues are subtle, speaker-dependent, and easily confounded by recording variability, while high-performing deep models typically rely on large and carefully curated training sets. Quantum machine learning offers an alternative way to introduce nonlinear correlation modeling with compact modules, yet existing quantum SER studies remain limited, and the impact of circuit structure is not well understood. This paper presents HQTN-SER, a hybrid quantum-classical framework that investigates how quantum tensor network connectivity can support SER under small-qubit settings. HQTN-SER introduces (i) an MPS-inspired quantum tensor network module that enforces structured interactions to model correlations in speech representations with a small number of trainable parameters, and (ii) a fusion strategy that combines quantum measurement features with a learned classical latent embedding for end-to-end emotion classification. We evaluate HQTN-SER on three public benchmarks (RAVDESS, SAVEE, and MDER) under a unified preprocessing and training protocol. The proposed model achieves test accuracies of 80.09% on RAVDESS, 78.12% on SAVEE, and 73.51% on MDER, with corresponding macro-F1 scores of 0.8012, 0.7826, and 0.7351, respectively. The model also exhibits stable convergence while using only three or four qubits, suggesting that MPS-inspired circuit structure can be an effective and hardware-aware design choice for quantum-assisted SER. These results provide a compact experimental baseline for studying structured quantum modules in affective computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 语音情感识别（SER）在实际条件下仍面临挑战，因为情感线索微妙且易受录音变异性影响。本文提出了HQTN-SER，一个混合量子-经典框架，用于研究量子张量网络连接性如何支持小量子比特设置下的SER。HQTN-SER引入了受MPS启发的量子张量网络模块和融合策略，并在多个公共基准上进行了评估，展现了其在SER领域的潜力。
authors: Mahad Mohtashim, Nouhaila Innan, Muhammad Shafique

articles.title: Universal quantum coding
articles.title_zh: 通用量子编码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38038v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Entanglement distillation from noisy bipartite states and reliable quantum communication over noisy channels are fundamental tasks in quantum information theory. Yet existing coding schemes typically require prior knowledge of the underlying state or channel, or assume independent or weakly correlated quantum information sources. Here, using Schur-Weyl duality, we establish a universal quantum error-correction principle that overcomes these limitations. We show that the irreducible permutation spaces arising from the local Schur-Weyl decomposition of multiple copies of an unknown bipartite mixed state form maximally entangled quantum code spaces whose error structure is governed entirely by representation theory. Correcting these symmetry-resolved errors yields protocols for entanglement distillation and quantum communication that achieve coherent-information rates with exponentially vanishing error and optimal second-order corrections, even in the case of almost i.i.d. resources. Our approach also provides sharp finite-copy guarantees that are worst-case optimal at every finite block length, including in the sample-efficient regime, where the number of copies scales only polynomially with the number of qubits. Together, these results establish Schur-Weyl duality as a general mechanism for universal, robust, and optimal quantum coding, unifying entanglement distillation, quantum error correction, and quantum communication within a common representation-theoretic framework.
articles.abstract_zh: 从噪声双分态中提取纠缠和通过噪声信道进行可靠量子通信是量子信息论中的基本任务。现有编码方案通常需要预先了解底层状态或信道。本文利用Schur-Weyl对偶性，建立了一个克服这些限制的通用量子纠错原理，并提供了在有限块长下最优的有限拷贝保证，即使在样本高效区域也表现出色。
authors: Jacopo Rizzo, Filippo Girardi, Ludovico Lami, Jens Eisert, Lorenzo Leone

articles.title: Entangling gates for the SU(N) anyons
articles.title_zh: SU(N)任意子的纠缠门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.04016v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The model of a topological quantum computer is a promising one due to its natural resistance to noise and other errors. Operations in such a computer are implemented by braiding the trajectories of anyons. While it is easy to understand how to build one-qubit operations, two-qubit operations are more difficult. In arXiv:2412.20931 we suggested an approach to build such operations for a topological quantum computer based on SU(2) Chern-Simons theory with arbitrary level using cabling of knots. In this paper we discuss how this approach should be generalized to the SU(N) case, what the differences are, and which new problems arise.
articles.abstract_zh: 拓扑量子计算机因其对噪声和其他错误的天然抵抗力而备受关注。此类计算机中的操作通过任意子轨迹的编织来实现，其中双量子比特操作更具挑战性。本文讨论了如何将之前针对SU(2) Chern-Simons理论的方法推广到SU(N)情况，并探讨了其中的差异和新问题，为构建更复杂的拓扑量子门提供了理论基础。
authors: Sergey Mironov, Andrey Morozov

articles.title: Nonadiabatic vibrational dynamics of CO on Pt(111) studied with first-principles many-body perturbation theory
articles.title_zh: 基于第一性原理多体微扰理论研究CO在Pt(111)上的非绝热振动动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31727v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the nonequilibrium vibrational dynamics of CO adsorbed on Pt(111), a prototypical adsorbate-surface system for ultrafast vibrational spectroscopy, using a first-principles framework that combines many-body perturbation theory with density functional theory. Within this methodology we explicitly account for electron-hole pair excitations and electron-mediated phonon-phonon coupling. For the latter mechanism, we evaluate the vertex-correction screening, what constitutes a methodological novelty. Our calculations qualitatively reproduce the transient evolution of the internal stretch vibrational mode observed in femtosecond pump-probe experiments, allowing us to identify in the experimental measurements a small transient blueshift after excitation with a femtosecond laser pulse. As predicted in a previous work, the reduction in the number of electronic states available for electron-phonon coupling when the electronic temperature raises at a group 10 transition metal surface, effectively screens the electron-phonon interaction giving rise to an anomalous transient blue-shift.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用结合多体微扰理论和密度泛函理论的第一性原理框架，研究了CO吸附在Pt(111)上的非平衡振动动力学。计算结果定性再现了飞秒泵浦-探测实验中观察到的内部伸缩振动模式的瞬态演化。研究识别出激发后的小幅瞬态蓝移，并将其归因于电子-声子耦合的有效屏蔽，揭示了其非绝热动力学机制。
authors: Raúl Bombín, Iñaki Fernández Tena, J. Iñaki Juaristi, Maite Alducin

articles.title: Triplon dynamics from partial Kondo screening in frustrated heavy-fermion systems
articles.title_zh: 阻挫重费米子系统中部分近藤屏蔽引起的三重子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32283v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The partially disordered (PD) phase, in which magnetically ordered and Kondo-screened sites coexist, has been proposed as a possible ground state of geometrically frustrated heavy-fermion systems. We investigate its dynamical properties in the half-filled periodic Anderson model on a triangular lattice by calculating the dynamical spin susceptibility within the random-phase approximation built on a self-consistent Hartree-Fock solution. We show that successive quantum phase transitions from the Kondo-insulating phase to the PD phase and to a magnetically ordered phase are driven by the condensation of triplon modes originating predominantly from the Kondo-screened sites. In the PD phase, magnons and triplons coexist and hybridize, leading to characteristic level repulsion in the excitation spectrum. These results reveal how triplet excitations evolve into collective magnetic modes across the successive phase transitions and highlight the dynamical interplay between magnetic order and Kondo screening in frustrated heavy-fermion systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 部分无序（PD）相被认为是几何阻挫重费米子系统的一种可能基态。本文通过计算动力学自旋磁化率，研究了三角晶格上半填充周期安德森模型中的PD相动力学性质。结果表明，从近藤绝缘相到PD相再到磁有序相的量子相变是由主要源自近藤屏蔽位点的三重子模式凝聚驱动的。在PD相中，磁振子和三重子共存并杂化，导致激发谱中特征性的能级排斥现象。
authors: Hiroki Nakahara, Masahito Mochizuki, Rintaro Eto

articles.title: Banded Chaos and Time-Semicrystalline Order
articles.title_zh: 带状混沌与时间半晶序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32297v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent work has introduced the notion of a time semicrystal, a driven nonequilibrium regime in which subharmonic temporal order survives inside deterministic chaos. Here we revisit this phenomenology from the viewpoint of classical nonlinear dynamics. Banded chaotic attractors consist of a finite number of chaotic sectors cyclically permuted by stroboscopic evolution, allowing discrete subharmonic spectral components to coexist with a broadband chaotic continuum. Exemplified through the driven Duffing oscillator and the logistic map, this structure naturally reproduces the characteristic signatures of time-semicrystalline dynamics. Within this framework, periodic subharmonic motion can enter chaos through the familiar period-doubling cascade while retaining a well-defined temporal skeleton governed by the universal Feigenbaum scaling. Temporal order within chaos can also reorganize or collapse through distinct mechanisms, producing continuous or abrupt transitions that may be intertwined with symmetry changes. These results connect time-semicrystal phenomenology with established structures of dissipative nonlinear dynamics, showing that its essential ingredients already arise in standard nonlinear systems and providing a simple framework for extending and testing the paradigm in more complex, many-body, and experimental settings.
articles.abstract_zh: 近期研究引入了时间半晶的概念，即确定性混沌中亚谐波时间序得以存活的非平衡态。本文从经典非线性动力学角度重新审视这一现象，发现带状混沌吸引子能自然再现时间半晶动力学的特征。研究表明，周期性亚谐波运动可通过倍周期级联进入混沌，同时保持由费根鲍姆标度律支配的时间骨架。混沌中的时间序还可通过不同机制重组或瓦解，产生连续或突变，并可能与对称性变化交织。
authors: Matteo Baggioli

articles.title: Multifractal Magnons Around Localized Defects
articles.title_zh: 局域缺陷周围的多分形磁振子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32457v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multifractal wavefunctions fluctuate over a hierarchy of spatial scales, remaining spatially extended while exhibiting strongly nonuniform structure. We show that magnons in otherwise crystalline two-dimensional magnets can exhibit such behavior on mesoscopic scales, without disorder or quasiperiodicity. A localized defect can mix discrete groups of nearly degenerate magnon states in a finite sample, generating multiscale interference patterns and multifractal wavefunctions. We demonstrate this mechanism for both a simple spin defect and topological magnetic skyrmions. Large-scale spin-wave calculations for skyrmions in chiral and frustrated magnets reveal clear multifractal diagnostics over the full accessible range of system sizes of above-gap modes. Crucially, skyrmions make these states experimentally observable by hybridizing them with magnetically active internal deformation modes, which gives a subset of the multifractal states a nonzero magnetic dipole moment. These states can therefore be excited by uniform ac fields and remain distinguishable at realistic frequency resolution, providing a direct route to observing mesoscopic magnon multifractality.
articles.abstract_zh: 多分形波函数在空间尺度层级上波动，呈现出强烈的非均匀结构。本文发现，在二维晶体磁体中，磁振子可在介观尺度上表现出多分形行为，且无需无序或准周期性。局域缺陷能混合有限样本中近简并磁振子态的离散组，产生多尺度干涉图案和多分形波函数。研究还表明，斯格明子通过与内部形变模式杂化，使这些多分形态具有可观测的磁偶极矩，为实验探测提供了直接途径。
authors: Adarsh Hullahalli, Yusuf Khand, Christos Panagopoulos, Christina Psaroudaki

articles.title: Hybrid Monte Carlo for the extended Kane-Mele-Hubbard model
articles.title_zh: 扩展Kane-Mele-Hubbard模型的混合蒙特卡洛模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32458v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Hubbard model offers a powerful minimal description of strongly correlated electrons in molecules and materials, yet it neglects effects observed in nature that give rise to a much richer variety of physics. For instance, including nonlocal interactions introduces a competition between strongly correlated phases, while incorporating spin-orbit coupling (SOC) can lead to the emergence of exotic topological phases. Seeking a more realistic platform for simulating graphene and, potentially, related materials such as transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs), we therefore consider the extended Kane-Mele-Hubbard model, which features a Kane-Mele SOC term and nearest-neighbor interactions. Simulating this model is particularly challenging once the nonlocal interactions become dominant over the on-site Hubbard interaction, as a severe sign problem arises already at half filling, leaving this regime largely unexplored. In this work, we develop continuous auxiliary field formulations of the model, suitable for treatment with the Hybrid Monte Carlo (HMC) algorithm. Using these formulations, we characterize the sign problem across the model's parameter space and establish where simulations are feasible, as a first step toward the full phase diagram.
articles.abstract_zh: 扩展Kane-Mele-Hubbard模型结合了自旋轨道耦合和最近邻相互作用，为模拟石墨烯及相关材料提供了更真实的平台。然而，当非局域相互作用占主导时，该模型在半填充下会出现严重的符号问题，导致该区域研究不足。本文开发了适用于混合蒙特卡洛（HMC）算法的连续辅助场公式，并利用这些公式表征了模型中的符号问题。这项工作为探索该模型的复杂物理特性奠定了基础。
authors: Finn L. Temmen, Thomas Luu, Johann Ostmeyer, Lin Wang

articles.title: Excitonic Stark Response Induced by Quantum Capacitance in van der Waals Heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 范德华异质结构中量子电容诱导的激子斯塔克响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32532v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Precise electrostatic control in van der Waals heterostructures is commonly described by a geometric capacitor model, which assumes that the internal electric field is fully determined by external gate voltages. Here, we show that this description breaks down in the presence of interfacial charge transfer, where quantum capacitance modifies the internal electrostatics. Using interlayer excitons as local probes, we observe a dipole-dependent energy splitting that persists even when the gate-induced geometric field is nominally canceled. This splitting reflects incomplete cancellation between gate- and carrier-induced fields set by quantum capacitance, while many-body renormalization is largely symmetric with respect to the two opposite dipole orientations, allowing the splitting to provide a direct optical measure of the local chemical potential. Our results reveal the central role of quantum capacitance in interface electrostatics and provide a route to probe it in operando.
articles.abstract_zh: 范德华异质结构中的精确静电控制通常由几何电容器模型描述，但当存在界面电荷转移时，量子电容会改变内部静电场，使该描述失效。本文利用层间激子作为局部探针，观察到偶极相关的能量劈裂，即使在栅极诱导的几何场名义上抵消时也依然存在。这种劈裂反映了栅极场和载流子诱导场之间不完全抵消，揭示了量子电容在界面静电学中的核心作用，并提供了一种在原位探测它的途径。
authors: Xiangzhi Hong, Yongkang Jian, Yang Chen, Rukai Cang, Yuanlong Guo, Takashi Taniguchi, Kenji Watanabe, Baigeng Wang, Erfu Liu

articles.title: Nano-ARPES observation of a flat band at the barM point in 2.4deg twisted bilayer graphene
articles.title_zh: 2.4度转角双层石墨烯中barM点平带的纳米角分辨光电子能谱观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32714v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The emergence of flat bands in twisted bilayer graphene at the so-called magic angle reveals a range of intriguing phases, such as superconductivity and Mott insulating states, resulting from electrons entering a correlated state. This establishes twisted bilayer graphene as an excellent platform for exploring correlation effects in many-body phases and across various twist angles. However, in most cases, the twist angle is not an easy parameter to control because it exhibits structural instabilities such as relaxation and reconstruction that reduce the correlation effects. Here, we report the unexpected appearance of a flat band at the barM point far from the Fermi level in a 2.4deg twisted bilayer graphene, directly visualized by angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy. Our work is the first observation of flat bands away from the barK point in twisted bilayer graphene and highlights the need to probe the entire Brillouin zone to fully capture electronic states in twisted structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 转角双层石墨烯中的平带现象揭示了超导和莫特绝缘态等多种新奇相。本文通过角分辨光电子能谱，首次直接观测到2.4度转角双层石墨烯中远离费米能级的barM点处的平带。这一发现是转角双层石墨烯中首次在barK点之外观察到平带，强调了探测整个布里渊区对于全面理解扭曲结构中电子态的重要性。
authors: Giovanna Feraco, Przemysław Przybysz, Oreste De Luca, Ying Wang, Pavel Dudin, José Avila, Jianting Ye, Paweł Dkabrowski, Paweł J. Kowalczyk, Jagoda Sławińska, Petra Rudolf, Antonija Grubišić-Čabo

articles.title: First- and Second-Order Electron Position Correlators Reveal Topological Phase Transitions
articles.title_zh: 一阶和二阶电子位置关联函数揭示拓扑相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32743v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The theory of conventional critical phenomena is built around the concepts of fluctuations and correlators of local observables. Here, we show that topological phase transitions can also be characterized through spatial and temporal two-point correlation functions associated with fluctuations of the electronic position operator. The key object is the antisymmetric part of the position-position correlation function, which yields the Chern number in the equal-time and equal-space limit. When the system is translationally invariant in space or time (the latter case corresponding to an equilibrium condition), these two-point correlators reduce to one-variable functions of the remaining variable. Remarkably, these functions are both reminiscent of critical behaviour, including divergent correlation times and lengths signalling the phase transitions. Away from these conditions, namely in non-periodic systems or genuinely dynamical processes, criticality is instead better captured by higher-order Chern-Chern correlators constructed from local or dynamical markers obtained as coincident-point limits of the position correlators. These higher-order Chern-Chern correlators can be seen as double Levi-Civita contractions of second-order position correlators, selecting the antisymmetric sector in each index pair. We substantiate this framework through numerical simulations and analytic calculations. Our results establish a general correlator-based description of topological phase transitions, applicable to crystalline, noncrystalline, equilibrium, and dynamical systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统临界现象理论基于局域可观测量涨落和关联函数。本文展示了拓扑相变也可通过与电子位置算符涨落相关的空间和时间两点关联函数来表征。位置-位置关联函数的反对称部分在等时等空间极限下给出陈数。这些关联函数展现出临界行为的特征，包括发散的关联时间和长度，预示着相变。
authors: Antimo Marrazzo, Christian Loer Llemit, Massimo Capone

articles.title: Majorana Edge-to-bound State Transition in Interferometric Superconductor Rings
articles.title_zh: 干涉超导环中Majorana边缘态到束缚态的转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32767v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Manipulating flux quanta in topological superconductors is central to vortex braiding in quantum computing. Their interferometric superconducting rings can host either topologically protected edge states with fluxes confined inside the central hollow area or vortex bound states in flux cores at the annulus walls. Here we demonstrate a strategy to drive topological edge states into vortex bound states by tuning the relative scale of vortex size and annulus width in nano-ring interferometric device on 2M-WS₂ topological superconductor. Near its superconducting transition where the coherence length exceeds the annulus width, Little-Parks oscillations exhibit expected periods for flux bundles in ring-center, consistent with edge states residing at inner and outer rims of the annulus. Upon cooling, where the coherence length shrinks below the annulus width, the unexpectedly increased oscillation period reflects multiple fluxes distributed along annulus region in flux necklace configuration, implying a transition from extended edge states to localized vortex bound states. Ginzburg-Landau simulations and local density-of-states calculations with Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations reveal that large values for both Ginzburg-Landau parameter and flux-pinning energy are vital for such a transition. Our findings provide a novel strategy for understanding flux manipulation towards flux braiding and topological quantum computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 这项工作研究了拓扑超导环中Majorana边缘态向涡旋束缚态的转变。通过调节涡旋尺寸与环形宽度在2M-WS₂纳米环干涉器件上的相对比例，研究人员成功实现了这种转变。实验观察到，在不同温度下，Little-Parks振荡周期发生变化，表明从扩展边缘态到局域涡旋束缚态的过渡。
authors: Xiangyu Bi, Aoshen Yang, Hongzi Cao, Ganyu Chen, Yuqiang Fang, Zeya Li, Qizheng Sun, Junwei Huang, Da Wang, Fuqiang Huang, Toshiya Ideue, Qianghua Wang, Yoshihiro Iwasa, Hongtao Yuan

articles.title: Magnons and excitons from Bethe-Salpeter equation and its application to graphene-based magnets
articles.title_zh: 基于Bethe-Salpeter方程的磁振子和激子及其在石墨烯基磁体中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32847v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: With the recent isolation of two-dimensional semiconducting magnetic materials, the theoretical study of spin-flip collective excitations (magnons) along with spin-conserving electron-hole bound pairs (excitons) has become particularly relevant. Describing both types of quasiparticles within the same theoretical framework is possible, in principle, but the well-established many-body formalism for the calculation of excitons, based on the intertwined Bethe-Salpeter and Hedin's equations, is not satisfactory for magnons, since the usual approximations produce a spurious gapped Goldstone mode. Here, we show that excitons and magnons can be computed on the same footing under the same Bethe-Salpeter formalism, while respecting the gapless Goldstone mode for magnons. We demonstrate how this can be achieved through the evaluation of the full Bethe-Salpeter equation, beyond the Tamm-Dancoff approximation in model Hamiltonians. As an example, we apply it to ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic graphene, faithfully represented by the extended Hubbard model. Our results clarify the roles of on-site and non-local interactions in exciton and magnon appearance and identify consistency requirements relevant to extending the approach to first-principles calculations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出了一种统一的Bethe-Salpeter方程理论框架，用于同时计算磁振子和激子，并解决了传统方法中磁振子Goldstone模式的虚假带隙问题。通过评估完整的Bethe-Salpeter方程，超越了Tamm-Dancoff近似，该方法成功应用于铁磁和反铁磁石墨烯。研究结果阐明了局域和非局域相互作用在激子和磁振子形成中的作用。
authors: Simran Chourasia, Maurício F. C. Martins Quintela, J. J. Palacios

articles.title: SO(5) multicriticality in two-dimensional quantum magnets
articles.title_zh: 二维量子磁体中的SO(5)多临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2405.06607v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We resolve the nature of the quantum phase transition between antiferromagnetic and valence-bond solid ground states in square-lattice spin-1/2 magnets - the putative deconfined quantum-critical point. Using quantum Monte Carlo simulations of J-Q models, in which Heisenberg exchange J competes with multi-spin interactions Qn formed by n singlet projectors, we demonstrate first-order discontinuities increasing with n. For n=2 and n=3, the first-order signatures are very weak and we extract universal scaling dimensions of a proximate multicritical point. Their values coincide closely with known bounds for an SO(5) symmetric conformal field theory (CFT) containing a relevant SO(5) singlet operator that destabilizes the generic deconfined critical point. We characterize the emergent SO(5) symmetry by its scaling dimensions of the leading irrelevant perturbations. Using the J-Q2-Q6 model, we tune the transition from weak to stronger first-order and find scaling of the coexisting order parameters with a large exponent beta ~ 0.85, in agreement with the relevant scaling dimensions of the multicritical point. The exponent that had previously been identified with the correlation length does not have a corresponding CFT level, and we explain it as pseudo-critical length scale of bubbles of one phase inside the other that are compressed in size by an SO(5)-violating irrelevant repulsive interaction between the two order parameters. The bubble scale reflects a hierarchy of excitation gaps generated by the SO(5) perturbation in the neighborhood of the first-order transition, akin to a Higgs mechanism. We argue that the multicritical point is the tip of a gapless spin liquid phase in frustrated Heisenberg models into which the J-Q models can be deformed, but the spin liquid, and perhaps the multicritical point itself, exist outside the regime amenable to sign-free simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过量子蒙特卡洛模拟，研究了方格自旋-1/2磁体中反铁磁态与价键固体基态之间的量子相变。研究发现，随着多自旋相互作用参数n的增加，一级不连续性增强。对于n=2和n=3，一级特征非常微弱，并提取了接近SO(5)对称共形场理论的普适标度维度。这些结果揭示了该相变中涌现的SO(5)对称性及其多临界点。
authors: Jun Takahashi, Hui Shao, Bowen Zhao, Wenan Guo, Anders W. Sandvik

articles.title: AI-Guided Computational Design of a Room-Temperature, Ambient- Pressure Superconductor Candidate: Grokene
articles.title_zh: AI引导的室温常压超导体候选材料Grokene的计算设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.00931v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce Grokene, a novel two-dimensional superlattice derived from graphene, which was identified through an AI-guided materials discovery workflow utilizing a large language model. Grokene is predicted to exhibit ambient-pressure, room-temperature superconductivity, with computational simulations revealing a high electron-phonon coupling constant and a substantial logarithmic-averaged phonon frequency (~1650 K), leading to a mean-field critical temperature of approximately 325 K. Full isotropic Eliashberg solutions further support a critical temperature around 310 K, underscoring its strong potential for room-temperature superconductivity. However, the strict two-dimensional nature of Grokene introduces phase fluctuations, limiting the observable superconducting transition to a Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) temperature of about 120 K in monolayers. To elevate TBKT toward room temperature, strategies such as few-layer stacking, substrate or gate engineering, and optimization of superlattice structure and doping levels are proposed. Our integrated workflow, combining AI-driven materials discovery with advanced many-body theories (DFPT/EPW, Eliashberg, and RPA), provides a systematic and reproducible framework for exploring novel superconductors. We suggest that experimental synthesis and comprehensive characterization of Grokene will be essential to assess these computational predictions and to explore routes toward practical superconductivity under ambient pressure.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种通过AI引导的材料发现工作流程识别出的新型二维超晶格材料Grokene。计算模拟预测Grokene在常压下具有室温超导性，平均场临界温度约为325 K，Eliashberg解支持约310 K。尽管单层Grokene的BKT温度受限于120 K，但研究提出了通过多层堆叠、衬底或栅极工程等策略将其提升至室温的可能性。
authors: DEARDAO DeSci Collaborative Team, Yanhuai Ding

articles.title: Realization of a Synthetic Hall Torus with a Topological Charge Pump in a Spinor Bose-Einstein Condensate
articles.title_zh: 在旋量玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中实现具有拓扑电荷泵的合成霍尔环面
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.14549v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report the first experimental realization of a synthetic Hall torus using a spinor Bose-Einstein condensate confined in a ring-shaped trap with in situ imaging. By cyclically coupling three hyperfine spin states via Raman and microwave fields, we impose a periodic boundary condition in the synthetic dimension, which, together with a real-space ring trap, realizes a toroidal geometry with synthetic magnetic flux penetrating the surface. This flux induces azimuthal density modulations whose periodicity is uniquely determined by the quantized toroidal flux, a hallmark of the Hall torus. We then implement a topological charge pump by adiabatically varying an axial flux through the torus, inducing quantized azimuthal transport of the atoms. We further investigate the onset of these modulations as the system transitions from cylindrical to toroidal topology. Our results establish a versatile platform for exploring quantum Hall physics and topological phenomena in synthetic curved spaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作首次实验实现了利用旋量玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体构建合成霍尔环面。通过循环耦合超精细自旋态，研究人员在合成维度上施加周期性边界条件，从而在环形阱中实现了具有合成磁通量的环面几何。实验观察到由量子化环面磁通引起的方位角密度调制，并成功实现了拓扑电荷泵，诱导了原子的量子化方位角输运。
authors: T. -H. Chien, S. -C. Wu, Y. -H. Su, L. -R. Liu, N. -C. Chiu, M. Sarkar, Q. Zhou, Y. -J. Lin

articles.title: Emergent relativistic symmetry from interacting fermions on the honeycomb bilayer
articles.title_zh: 蜂窝双层中相互作用费米子涌现的相对论对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.22259v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the phase diagram of interacting spinless fermions on the honeycomb bilayer at charge neutrality using large-scale quantum Monte Carlo simulations. In the noninteracting limit, the low-energy spectrum features quadratically dispersing bands that touch at the corners of the hexagonal Brillouin zone. Weak to intermediate interactions induce a splitting of each of the quadratic band touching points into four Dirac points, located along high-symmetry directions of the reciprocal lattice. Strong interactions lead to the formation of a layer-polarized charge density wave, which spontaneously breaks the mathbb Z₂ layer inversion symmetry and opens an insulating gap in the spectrum. We show that the semimetal-to-insulator quantum phase transition as a function of interaction is continuous and characterized by emergent relativistic symmetry. Our results for the values of the correlation-length exponent ν, the order-parameter anomalous dimension η_φ, and the fermion anomalous dimension η_ψ agree with those of the theoretically predicted 2+1D Gross-Neveu-Ising universality class with eight two-component Dirac fermions within less than 5% deviation. We also determine the crossover scale as a function of interaction strength between the nonrelativistic semimetal state at high temperatures, characterized by dynamical critical exponent z = 2, and the Dirac semimetal state at intermediates temperatures, characterized by z=1. Further reducing the temperature below the crossover scale at a fixed value of the interaction strength above the quantum critical point results in a classical ordering transition in the 2D Ising universality class.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用大规模量子蒙特卡洛模拟研究了蜂窝双层中相互作用无自旋费米子在电荷中性时的相图。研究发现，弱到中等相互作用导致二次能带接触点分裂为四个狄拉克点，而强相互作用则形成层极化电荷密度波。半金属到绝缘体的量子相变是连续的，并具有涌现的相对论对称性，其临界指数与理论预测的2+1D Gross-Neveu-Ising普适类一致。
authors: Zi Hong Liu, Lukas Janssen

articles.title: Revealing Charge Transfer in Defect-Engineered 4Hb-TaS2
articles.title_zh: 揭示缺陷工程4Hb-TaS2中的电荷转移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.24486v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a comprehensive first-principles investigation of defects in 4H_b-TaS₂. In this layered transition metal dichalcogenide, charge transfer between alternating Mott-insulating 1T and metallic 1H layers gives rise to exotic quantum phases such as the Kondo effect and topological superconductivity. Motivated by recent defect manipulation in 4H_b-TaS₂ via STM, we address their microscopic nature and impact on interlayer charge transfer. To this end, we systematically analyze over 90 defects using large-scale density functional theory (DFT) calculations. Our analysis identifies 1H sulfur vacancies, Ta-on-S antisites, and Ta interstitials as the most likely origins of the commonly observed defects, with Ta-on-S antisites producing the strongest charge-transfer modulation. Our extensive dataset, compiled from STM simulations, defect formation energies, work functions, and charge transfer, establishes a foundational resource for future theoretical and experimental studies on defect engineering in 4H_b-TaS₂.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对4Hb-TaS₂中的缺陷进行了全面的第一性原理研究，探讨了其微观性质以及对层间电荷转移的影响。通过大规模密度泛函理论计算，研究人员分析了90多种缺陷，并确定了1H硫空位、Ta-on-S反位和Ta间隙原子是常见缺陷的最可能来源。其中，Ta-on-S反位缺陷对电荷转移的调制作用最强，为未来缺陷工程研究提供了基础数据。
authors: Siavash Karbasizadeh, Wooin Yang, Wonhee Ko, Haidong Zhou, An-Ping Li, Tom Berlijn, Sai Mu

articles.title: Strain-Tuned Incommensurate Kekulé Spiral Order in Twisted Bilayer Graphene: A Quantum Many-Body Study
articles.title_zh: 应变调控扭曲双层石墨烯中的非公度Kekulé螺旋序：一项量子多体研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.20677v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The physics of twisted bilayer graphene away from the exactly solvable chiral limit and the quantum Monte Carlo sign-problem-free charge neutrality point is elusive due to the exponential increase in the computational complexity, which has rendered explanations of experimentally observed insulating and superconducting phases restricted largely to the perturbative level. Here we focus on the filling factor ν=±2 and address the question of the strain dependence of the interacting ground state by approximate quantum Monte Carlo (AQMC), state-of-the-art exact diagonalization (ED) and Hartree-Fock (HF) mean field, in order to investigate the strain-tuned transition from the Kramers intervalley coherent (KIVC) state to the incommensurate Kekulé spiral (IKS) state. While all three methods capture the KIVC order, only ED and HF detect the weaker IKS order that AQMC does not capture adequately. As the AQMC is still capable of capturing stronger orders like the KIVC, our combined protocol may open the door for further understanding of the rich phases of twisted bilayer graphene and other strongly-correlated systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用近似量子蒙特卡洛、精确对角化和Hartree-Fock平均场方法，研究了扭曲双层石墨烯中应变调控的相互作用基态。研究重点是填充因子ν=±2时，从Kramers谷间相干态（KIVC）到非公度Kekulé螺旋态（IKS）的转变。结果表明，所有方法均能捕捉KIVC序，而IKS序则主要由精确对角化和Hartree-Fock方法检测到，为理解扭曲双层石墨烯的复杂相提供了新途径。
authors: Cheng Huang, Yves H. Kwan, Maksim Ulybyshev, Fakher F. Assaad, Laura Classen, Zi Yang Meng

articles.title: Driven square lattice of quantum dots in a magnetic field coupled to a cylindrical FIR-photon cavity
articles.title_zh: 磁场中驱动的量子点方格阵列与圆柱形远红外光子腔的耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06812v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a comprehensive computational study of driven quantum dot arrays in a square lattice configuration, subject to an external magnetic field and coupled to a cylindrical far-infrared photon cavity. The driving is introduced through a harmonic modulation of the full electron-photon interaction, therefore including both paramagnetic and diamagnetic contributions. The electron-electron Coulomb interactions are treated within density functional theory, while the electron-photon coupling is modeled using a many-body configuration interaction approach at each iteration of the density functional. By exploiting the unique properties of the cylindrical TE₀₁₁ cavity mode, we demonstrate selective enhancement of diamagnetic two-photon transitions. Our results reveal that the effectiveness of harmonic modulation of the electron-photon interaction is strongly dependent on both the driving frequency and the electron occupation number per dot. When the driving frequency approaches twice the cavity photon frequency, the system exhibits resonant behavior characterized by efficient photon pumping, occupation of higher-order photon replicas, and activation of collective radial Coulomb breathing modes. These findings establish a controllable mechanism for manipulating photon states in coupled quantum dot-cavity systems and provide insights into the interplay among harmonic modulation, photonic excitations, magnetic confinement, and many-body electron correlations in dimensionally reduced nanostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对磁场中驱动的量子点方格阵列与圆柱形远红外光子腔耦合的系统进行了全面的计算研究。通过谐波调制电子-光子相互作用，研究人员发现圆柱形TE₀₁₁腔模式能够选择性增强抗磁性双光子跃迁。结果表明，调制效果强烈依赖于驱动频率和每个量子点的电子占据数，并在驱动频率接近腔光子频率两倍时表现出共振行为。
authors: Vidar Gudmundsson, Vram Mughnetsyan, Hsi-Sheng Goan, Jeng-Da Chai, Nzar Rauf Abdullah, Chi-Shung Tang, Wen-Hsuan Kuan, Valeriu Moldoveanu, Andrei Manolescu

articles.title: Visualizing Chiral Edge Modes in Twisted Cuprate Superconductors via Scanning-Probe Quantum Sensing
articles.title_zh: 通过扫描探针量子传感可视化扭曲铜氧化物超导体中的手性边缘模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.13070v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recently, unconventional superconductivity hosted by twisted van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures has received immense interest due to the exotic pairing symmetry, electronic interactions and nontrivial topological nature that are naturally relevant to the fast-advancing quantum technologies. Here, we report scanning-probe quantum sensing of nanoscale electromagnetic behaviors of twisted vdW cuprate superconductors. Using single-spin relaxometry, we directly visualize edge modes spontaneously formed in twisted Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x (BSCCO). By investigating temperature dependent variations of edge-state-induced quantum spin relaxation, we experimentally evaluate the magnitude of nontrivial topological band gap opened at nodal points in twisted BSCCO and its critical temperature behaviors under different twist angles. We further observe alternating chiral domains defined by edge modes, exploring experimental signatures of in-plane magnetic field-induced topology in 45deg twisted BSCCO. Our results advance the current understanding of twisted vdW nodal superconductors, presenting an appealing high-temperature topological superconducting material platform for cutting-edge quantum innovation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用扫描探针量子传感技术，首次直接可视化了扭曲范德华铜氧化物超导体Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x (BSCCO)中自发形成的边缘模式。通过研究边缘态诱导的量子自旋弛豫的温度依赖性，实验评估了扭曲BSCCO中拓扑能隙的大小及其在不同扭曲角下的临界温度行为。研究结果加深了对扭曲范德华节点超导体的理解，并展示了高温拓扑超导材料的潜力。
authors: Senlei Li, Xiaomeng Cui, Renzhi Sun, Lingjie Zhou, Yiran Zhao, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Genda Gu, Hailong Wang, Kartiek Agarwal, Philip Kim, Chunhui Rita Du

articles.title: Quantum compilation framework for data loading
articles.title_zh: 用于数据加载的量子编译框架
articles.abstract: Efficient encoding of classical data into quantum circuits is a critical challenge that directly impacts the scalability of quantum algorithms. In this work, we present an automated compilation framework for resource-aware quantum data loading tailored to a given input vector and target error tolerance. By explicitly exploiting the trade-off between exact and approximate state preparation, our approach systematically partitions the total error budget between precision and approximation errors, thereby minimizing quantum resource costs. The framework supports a comprehensive suite of state-of-the-art methods, including multiplexer-based loaders, quantum read-only memory constructions, sparse encodings, matrix product states (MPSs), Fourier series loaders, and Walsh transform-based diagonal operators. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework across several applications, where it consistently uncovers non-obvious, resource-efficient strategies enabled by controlled approximation. In particular, we analyze a computational fluid dynamics workflow where the automated selection of MPS state preparation and Walsh transform-based encoding, combined with a novel Walsh-based measurement technique, leads to resource reductions of over four orders of magnitude compared to previous approaches. We also introduce two independent advances developed through the framework: a more efficient circuit for d-diagonal matrices, and an optimized block encoding for kinetic energy operators. Our results underscore the indispensable role of automated, approximation-aware compilation in making large-scale quantum algorithms feasible on resource-constrained hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个自动化的量子数据加载编译框架，旨在高效地将经典数据编码到量子电路中。该框架通过权衡精确和近似态制备，系统地分配误差预算以最小化量子资源成本。它支持多种先进方法，并在计算流体动力学等应用中展示了其有效性，能够发现资源高效的策略。
authors: Guillermo Alonso-Linaje, Utkarsh Azad, Jay Soni, Jarrett Smalley, Leigh Lapworth and Juan Miguel Arrazola

articles.title: Compositional quantum heuristics for Max-Clique detection
articles.title_zh: 用于最大团检测的组合式量子启发式算法
articles.abstract: Quantum machine learning holds the promise of combining the success of classical machine learning methods with the power of quantum computing, however one of the largest obstacles facing the field is the problem of barren plateaus. Parameterised quantum circuits offer a flexible framework for developing quantum machine learning models, but their practicality is constrained by a trade-off between trainability and classical simulability. In general, circuits that are sufficiently expressive to model complex behaviour often exhibit barren plateaus, where gradients vanish and optimisation fails. In this work we investigate a compositional approach to mitigate this trade-off. We exploit the recursive structure of Max-Clique by reusing a model trained on small graph instances to guide a sequence of induced-subgraph problems whose outputs are composed into a clique of the original graph. To ensure trainability of these subcomponents, we describe a framework for constructing group-invariant loss functions, which introduce symmetry-induced inductive bias and lead to improved gradient behaviour and generalisation. In particular, we use this framework to design permutation-equivariant quantum graph neural networks for identifying maximum cliques in graphs. The models we construct exhibit superior training trajectories through symmetry-induced bias, reaching accuracies up to 30% better than the un-symmetrised counterparts. Our experiments demonstrate that the trained models generalise to larger, more complex problem instances, which we demonstrate on – node graphs. Finally, inspired by Finžgar et al (2024 PRX Quantum5 020327), we implement a recursive hybrid quantum–classical heuristic using the learned quantum models to guide a classical search procedure, demonstrating improved inference accuracy and scalability. Together, these results suggest that compositional circuits could be a viable pathway towards scalable quantum learning models that remain challenging to reproduce classically.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种组合式量子启发式方法，旨在解决量子机器学习中参数化量子电路的“贫瘠高原”问题。该方法利用最大团问题的递归结构，通过重用在小图实例上训练的模型来指导一系列诱导子图问题。为确保子组件的可训练性，研究人员设计了群不变损失函数，引入对称性诱导的归纳偏置，从而改善了梯度行为和泛化能力。
authors: Tiffany Duneau, Colin Krawchuk and Anna Pearson

articles.title: Quantum randomness beyond projective measurements
articles.title_zh: 超越投影测量的量子随机性
articles.abstract: The unpredictability of quantum physics gives rise to intrinsic randomness. In an adversarial scenario, any additional degrees of freedom must be attributed to an eavesdropper with correlations to the measurement set-up. The true randomness is then quantified by the probability that she correctly guesses the measurement outcomes, optimised over all possible strategies. Extremal measurements are appealing here, since they do not allow information to leak to such an eavesdropper. Beyond projective measurements, however, a simple question remains open: how much intrinsic randomness can be generated by a given extremal measurement? In a step towards solving it, we characterise the randomness generated by any unbiased extremal rank-one measurement acting on any state, solving the problem explicitly in dimension two. Four-outcome qubit measurements of this type are tomographic, so these results hold for fully source-device-dependent randomness too. The tetrahedral symmetric informationally complete (SIC) measurement, we find, has the least intrinsic randomness within this class. We also present the skewed SIC family of measurements, and use them to partially solve an open problem: we prove that bits of randomness, the maximal amount, can be generated device-dependently (or source-device-independently) in any dimension in which there exists a SIC measurement.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子物理的不可预测性产生了内在随机性。本文研究了超越投影测量的极端测量所能产生的内在随机性，并明确解决了二维情况下的无偏极端秩一测量问题。研究发现，四面体对称信息完备（SIC）测量在此类中具有最少的内在随机性，并提出了倾斜SIC测量族以部分解决一个开放问题。
authors: Fionnuala Curran

articles.title: Quantum batteries in two-dimensional material-based Josephson junctions
articles.title_zh: 基于二维材料约瑟夫森结的量子电池
articles.abstract: We investigate the solid-state implementation of a Dicke-like quantum battery consisting of a two-dimensional material-based Josephson junction inductively coupled to a resonator, using graphene as a representative example. In this configuration, Andreev bound states naturally act as non-interacting, energetically non-degenerate two-level systems, and the setup allows for both single-photon and two-photon resonant processes. The coupling between the LC-circuit flux and the supercurrent through the junction gives rise to peculiar longitudinal interaction terms that have no counterpart in the conventional Dicke model. We demonstrate that these additional couplings can enhance energy storage for a proper range of parameters. The proposed architecture also enables an alternative, but comparable, charging protocol that relies on tuning the superconducting phase difference across the junction.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了由二维材料约瑟夫森结与谐振器电感耦合构成的类Dicke量子电池的固态实现，以石墨烯为例。在该配置中，安德烈夫束缚态充当非相互作用、能量非简并的两能级系统，并支持单光子和双光子共振过程。研究表明，LC电路磁通与结超电流之间的耦合产生的特殊纵向相互作用项，在适当参数范围内可以增强能量存储。
authors: V Varrica, G Gemme, F M D Pellegrino, E Paladino, M Sassetti and D Ferraro

articles.title: Verified Pauli-Product Measurement Compilation for Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computation
articles.title_zh: 容错量子计算中Pauli乘积测量编译的验证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31694v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum compilers implement gates through Pauli-product measurements and classical feedback. Verifying such a compiler requires reasoning about the quantum state and the recorded outcomes together: a correction reads an outcome, a gate's internal outcomes must be hidden from its caller, and an application's outcomes must survive optimization. We introduce QPPM, a language for Pauli-product measurement programs, with a weakest-precondition semantics over store-indexed matrix assertions, following quantum Hoare logic with classical variables. Every program terminates, so the Hoare logic is a syntactic presentation of weakest preconditions whose soundness and relative completeness are immediate. Its value is that component specifications compose. All results are mechanized in Lean. We verify lowering of Clifford+T circuits to QPPM with private outcomes and supplied magic states, and an optimizer that eliminates measurements, fuses and reorders rotations, and schedules logical rounds while preserving every outcome that subsequent code can read. A compositional approximation relation bounds the effect of synthesis error on specifications and on output trace distance, and a certificate-checked pipeline selects, among synthesized circuits that meet the user's error limit, the one with the lowest certified depth bound. On QASMBench, verified fusion and scheduling reduce logical measurement depth by a median of 17.9%, and complete source-to-QPPM allowances are certified for all 35 valid selected small-suite inputs.
articles.abstract_zh: 容错量子编译器通过Pauli乘积测量和经典反馈实现门操作，其验证需要同时考虑量子态和记录结果。本文引入了QPPM，一种用于Pauli乘积测量程序的语言，并采用基于存储索引矩阵断言的最弱前置条件语义。所有结果均在Lean中机械化验证，包括将Clifford+T电路降级到具有私有结果和魔术态的QPPM，以及一个优化器。
authors: John Zhuoyang Ye, Jens Palsberg

articles.title: The Entire Quantum Computer on a Classical Leash
articles.title_zh: 经典客户端对整个量子计算机的掌控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31775v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that a classical client with no quantum hardware can use a single untrusted and potentially malicious quantum server as if it were its own trusted quantum computer. Through the server, the client can privately choose and run quantum computations, prepare quantum states, and process quantum states supplied by other parties. It can also keep quantum memory on the server, hidden from the server itself, and use that memory in later computations so its quantum state persists across rounds of interaction. Together, these capabilities let a purely classical party act as a quantum party in a variety of interactive protocols. We expect this virtual quantum computer to be a broadly useful tool. As immediate applications, we resolve two known open problems: (1) classical verification of quantum sampling with negligible computational soundness error, and (2) remote state preparation of arbitrary efficiently preparable quantum states. Underlying all of these results is a general-purpose, maliciously secure two-party computation protocol between a classical client and a quantum server, which we construct assuming only the post-quantum hardness of learning with errors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了一个没有量子硬件的经典客户端如何使用单个不可信且可能恶意的量子服务器，如同其自己的可信量子计算机。客户端可以通过服务器私密地选择和运行量子计算、准备量子态并处理其他方提供的量子态，甚至在服务器上保留对服务器本身隐藏的量子内存。这些能力使纯粹的经典方能够在各种交互协议中充当量子方，并解决了量子采样经典验证和任意可高效准备量子态的远程制备这两个开放问题。
authors: Yael Tauman Kalai, Dakshita Khurana, Justin Raizes

articles.title: Temporal Degeneracy Limits Message Passing Decoding of QLDPC Codes Under Repeated Noisy Syndrome Measurements
articles.title_zh: 重复噪声综合征测量下QLDPC码消息传递解码的暂时简并性限制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31877v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Practical quantum computations can require logical error rates of 10⁻¹² or lower. Quantum low-density parity-check (QLDPC) codes are promising candidates for reaching such rates with low qubit overhead, provided that their syndromes can be decoded efficiently. Repeated noisy syndrome measurements introduce temporal degeneracy into the space-time decoding graph. We characterize the temporal kernel, whose vectors have zero total data parity, and show that it is generated by elementary temporal codewords of weight dᵥ₊₂, where dᵥ is the variable-node degree.
