For (dᵥ,d_c)-regular parity-check matrices with fixed degrees dᵥ,d_c>2 and girth greater than four, we derive counting bounds and construct degenerate error patterns of weight (dᵥ₊₂₎/2 for even dᵥ and dᵥ₊₁ for odd dᵥ, with multiplicity Θ(nr) in the blocklength n and number of measurement rounds r. Under the isolation assumption, these patterns cause local failures of deterministic isotropic message-passing decoders under a flooding schedule. These failures depend on the node degrees rather than the minimum distance; for the bivariate bicycle (BB) codes considered, their weight is equal to four. Monte carlo simulations and fixed-weight importance sampling quantify harmful low-weight degenerate error patterns for the min-sum (MS) decoder beyond the isolation assumption. Motivated by the identified symmetries, we propose space-time anisotropic min-sum decoding with syndrome-guided realizations. Its complexity is linear in the number of Tanner graph edges for fixed maximum number of iterations and number of decoders. Numerical results on BB codes show threshold-like behavior acrossthe tested code sizes and improved failure probabilities relative to MS decoding with ordered statistics decoding post-processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 实用量子计算需要极低的逻辑错误率，而量子低密度奇偶校验（QLDPC）码是实现这一目标的有力候选。重复的噪声综合征测量会在时空解码图中引入暂时简并性，本文刻画了具有零总数据奇偶校验的暂时核，并展示了它由权重为dᵥ₊₂的基本暂时码字生成。研究发现，这些简并错误模式会导致确定性各向同性消息传递解码器在泛洪调度下出现局部故障，且这些故障取决于节点度数而非最小距离。
authors: Dimitris Chytas, Nithin Raveendran, Bane Vasić

articles.title: Optimal Control of a Fluxonium Circuit with the Q-PRONTO Numerical Method
articles.title_zh: 使用Q-PRONTO数值方法对Fluxonium电路进行最优控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31885v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Optimizing the control of large quantum systems is a resource-intensive task, where the convergence rate of the underlying iterative schemes is crucial. The recently developed Quantum Projection Operator-Based Newton Method for Trajectory Optimization (Q-PRONTO) offers a unique quadratic convergence for controlling quantum states, while most model-based solvers guarantee only an approximately linear convergence rate. As a proof of concept, here, we design and benchmark single-qubit gates optimized by Q-PRONTO based on the circuit Hamiltonian of a fluxonium superconducting qubit. To ensure that we can apply a long string of arbitrary pulses to the circuit, we modify the firmware associated with the Quantum Instrumentation Control Kit (QICK) by altering its memory allocation. We characterize the performance of the optimal solutions using standard randomized benchmarking and achieve a total error per gate of 6.6×10⁻⁴.
articles.abstract_zh: 优化大型量子系统的控制是一项资源密集型任务，迭代方案的收敛速度至关重要。本文利用新开发的量子投影算子牛顿轨迹优化方法（Q-PRONTO）对基于fluxonium超导量子比特电路哈密顿量的单量子比特门进行了设计和基准测试。通过修改QICK固件的内存分配，确保可以应用任意长脉冲串。最终，使用标准随机基准测试表征了最优解的性能，实现了6.6×10⁻⁴的每门总误差。
authors: John Barta, Brian D. Isakov, Pablo Aramburu Sanchez, Jieqiu Shao, Tamás Kalmár, Trevyn F. Q. Larson, Marco M. Nicotra, András Gyenis

articles.title: Quantum Cryptomania with Classical Communication without One-Way Functions
articles.title_zh: 无单向函数的经典通信量子密码狂热
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32145v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In classical cryptography, one-way functions are necessary for most of cryptography. In the quantum world, however, Kretschmer at TQC'21 and subsequent works have demonstrated that quantum versions of various primitives in minicrypt, such as signatures and private-key encryption, do not require quantum-computable one-way functions (textsfqOWFs). However, the question of the necessity of textsfqOWFs for primitives in Cryptomania like public-key encryption with classical public keys and ciphertexts (textsfqPKE) has remained open. We provide a comprehensive picture of the relationship between textsfqPKE and textsfqOWF. First, our main result is a black-box separation between textsfqOWFs and textsfqPKE. In particular, we show that relative to a unitary, real, and self-inverse oracle, there exists a textsfqPKE scheme (with classical keys and ciphertexts), but textsfqOWFs do not exist. Further, our oracles admit a point-function obfuscation construction, thus ruling out black-box construction of textsfqOWF from point function obfuscations. On the positive side, we construct textsfqPKE from quantum indistinguishability obfuscation for quantum circuits with classical obfuscated descriptions and efficiently verifiable one-way puzzles, which is known to be a potentially weaker assumption than textsfqOWFs, due to an existing black-box separation. Our construction is the quantum analog of the classical construction of textsfPKE from one-way functions and indistinguishability obfuscation in the quantum computation with classical communication (QCCC) setting.
articles.abstract_zh: 经典密码学中单向函数至关重要，但在量子世界中，量子可计算单向函数（qOWFs）对于某些原语并非必需。本文全面阐述了量子公钥加密（qPKE）与qOWF之间的关系，并首次证明了qOWF与qPKE之间的黑盒分离。研究表明，相对于某个酉、实且自逆的预言机，存在qPKE方案但不存在qOWF，并从量子不可区分混淆构造了qPKE。
authors: Mohammed Barhoush, Amit Behera

articles.title: Trident: Efficient Load Verification for Yoked Surface Codes using a Three-Level Memory Hierarchy
articles.title_zh: Trident：使用三级存储层次结构对轭合表面码进行高效加载验证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32152v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computers (FTQCs) commonly use the surface code to encode program qubits as error-corrected logical qubits. Unfortunately, the surface code has a poor encoding rate, so recent work has proposed Yoked Surface Codes (YSCs), which concatenate the surface code with a high-rate quantum code. The surface code qubits in YSCs are protected by the checks, or yokes, of the high-rate code. YSCs have 1D and 2D variants, which are 1.8× and 4.5× more efficient than the surface code, respectively. Modern FTQC architectures use a two-level hierarchy: surface codes perform logical operations (compute) while 2D YSCs store idle program qubits (memory). To load a qubit from memory, the FTQC first performs retrieval, which logically moves a program qubit from a 2D YSC into a surface code (8 cycles). However, retrieval is not fault-tolerant, so the FTQC must verify the load by measuring all the yokes of the 2D YSC (178 cycles). As verification dominates memory access latency, eliminating it can provide a speedup of 5.7×. Our goal is to reduce the verification overhead of 2D YSCs while retaining their storage efficiency. We exploit the fact that 1D YSCs, though less storage-efficient, incur negligible verification latency. We propose Trident, which expands the two-level hierarchy into a three-level hierarchy by adding a small intermediate level containing a 1D YSC (L1). If most loads hit L1 rather than L2 (2D YSC tier), it can significantly reduce verification overhead. We present two variants: Trident-D (demand-driven) and Trident-P (prefetch-driven), which achieve speedups of 2.8× and 4.2×, respectively, while increasing the physical qubit cost of memory by only 4.9%.
articles.abstract_zh: 容错量子计算机（FTQC）常使用表面码编码逻辑量子比特，但其编码率较低，因此提出了轭合表面码（YSC）以提高效率。现代FTQC架构采用两级存储层次，其中2D YSC用于存储空闲程序量子比特。从内存加载量子比特涉及检索和容错验证，其中验证占据了大部分延迟。本文旨在减少2D YSC的验证开销，同时保持其存储效率。
authors: Gunagya Singh Mamak, Suhas Vittal, Kabir Dubey, Kaitlin N. Smith, Moinuddin K. Qureshi

articles.title: Quantum Evolution Networks Learn Long-Time Coherent Dynamics in Driven Spin Registers
articles.title_zh: 量子演化网络学习驱动自旋寄存器中的长时间相干动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32156v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting and controlling driven quantum systems requires access to dynamics across physical parameters, initial states, and evolution times. A reusable neural model must capture this dependence while preserving unitary structure and maintaining accuracy over long-time coherent evolution. Here we introduce Quantum Evolution Networks (QENs), which map physical parameters and time to complete propagators for periodically driven three-spin registers. Shared networks learn unitary one-period propagators and compatible within-period paths, enabling predictions through known periodic composition without query-specific numerical integration. For transverse driving, the fifth-percentile fidelity, minimized over input states and sampled times, is 0.9947 over 24 periods on 256 held-out configurations. A leading-order analysis of spectrally resolved endpoint residuals predicts multicycle process error more accurately than quadratic or spectrum-averaged estimates. Interventions at matched single-period infidelity produce orders-of-magnitude differences in multicycle infidelity, demonstrating the importance of residual orientation. Compatible component replacements identify how endpoint and within-period approximations limit reconstruction accuracy. These results establish a reusable neural representation of the studied propagator families and connect its learned residual structure to its observed long-time reliability.
articles.abstract_zh: 预测和控制驱动量子系统需要访问跨物理参数、初始态和演化时间的动力学。本文引入了量子演化网络（QENs），它将物理参数和时间映射到周期性驱动三自旋寄存器的完整传播子。共享网络学习酉性单周期传播子和兼容的周期内路径，通过已知的周期组合实现预测。在横向驱动下，24个周期内256个保留配置的第五百分位保真度达到0.9947，且对多周期过程误差的预测比二次或频谱平均估计更准确。
authors: Puran Li, Condon Lau, Xiu-Hao Deng

articles.title: Performing a Quantum Subroutine Using Cluster States
articles.title_zh: 使用簇态执行量子子程序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32227v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum subroutines, like their classical counterparts, serve as essential components of larger algorithms. They can be realized using gate based architectures or measurement based quantum computation (MBQC), where computation proceeds through adaptive measurements on highly entangled cluster states. In this work, we implement a phase oracle as a reusable subroutine within the MBQC framework using experimentally feasible cluster states. Unlike prior demonstrations of Grover's algorithm in MBQC that omit explicit oracle construction, our approach provides a transparent formulation of the oracle subroutine, including its measurement patterns, byproduct correlations, density-matrix simulations, and corresponding MBQC measurement circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子子程序是大型算法的重要组成部分，可通过基于门的架构或基于测量的量子计算（MBQC）实现。本文在MBQC框架内，利用实验可行的簇态实现了一个可重用的相位预言机子程序。与以往省略明确预言机构造的Grover算法演示不同，本文方法提供了预言机子程序的透明公式，包括其测量模式、副产物关联、密度矩阵模拟以及相应的MBQC测量电路。
authors: Sakibul Islam Rayhan, Karima Hassan, Md Rasedujjaman, Md Mohsinur Rahman Adnan

articles.title: Two-Layer Verification for Fault-Tolerant Magic-State Preparation in High-Rate Quantum Codes
articles.title_zh: 高码率量子码中容错魔术态制备的两层验证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32267v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Encoded magic states are essential for universal fault-tolerant quantum computation, but their resource-efficient preparation in high-rate quantum codes remains challenging. To address this limitation, we propose two-layer verification, which combines local verification of independently prepared subblocks with logical verification after their embedding into a target code. This hierarchy detects harmful error patterns, including even-parity logical-eigenvalue flips that are invisible to a collective product check alone. We demonstrate this scheme for a [[21,3,5]] code by constructing a circuit that embeds three verified seven-qubit Steane-code magic states into the target code. Circuit-level simulations of T- and S-state preparation show logical-error suppression consistent with the code distance. These results demonstrate the potential of two-layer verification as a design principle for reliable magic-state preparation in quantum codes encoding multiple logical qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 编码魔术态对于通用容错量子计算至关重要，但在高码率量子码中高效制备仍具挑战。本文提出了两层验证方案，结合了独立制备子块的局部验证和嵌入目标码后的逻辑验证。该层次结构能检测有害错误模式，包括集体乘积检查无法发现的偶数奇偶性逻辑本征值翻转。通过对[[21,3,5]]码的电路级模拟，验证了T态和S态制备的逻辑错误抑制效果与码距离一致。
authors: Naoyuki Kanomata, Hayato Goto

articles.title: Fundamental bound on Wigner negativity generation from environmental collisions
articles.title_zh: 环境碰撞产生Wigner负性的基本界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32315v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Beyond quadratic potentials, classical evolution laws are typically thought to arise from quantum theory as an approximate description. Here we show that classical evolution laws can emerge exactly, provided the environment interacts with the system via collisions. We use this to derive an inequality that lower bounds the distribution of environmental momentum kicks by the absolute value of the Fourier transform of the potential. We show that violating this inequality is necessary and sufficient for a non-quadratic potential to generate negativity from the set of positive Wigner functions. A simple consequence of this is a lower bound on the heating rate for a quantum system to evolve effectively classically. We illustrate our results using the theory of a levitated nanoparticle subject to photon recoil and background gas collisions. We derive the strength of external potential needed to generate Wigner negative states in an optical tweezer and propose an experimental test of whether a nanoparticle in an optical lattice is operating in a non-classical regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 经典演化定律通常被认为是量子理论的近似描述，但本文表明，如果环境通过碰撞与系统相互作用，经典演化定律可以精确出现。我们推导出一个不等式，将环境动量冲击的分布以下限形式与势的傅里叶变换的绝对值关联起来。研究表明，违反此不等式是产生Wigner负性的必要和充分条件，并给出了量子系统有效经典演化的加热速率下限。
authors: Isaac Layton, Takahiro Sagawa, Ken Funo

articles.title: Finite Nonsignalling Resources Suffice to Simulate Entangled Qubits
articles.title_zh: 有限非信号资源足以模拟纠缠量子比特
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32319v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A longstanding question in Bell nonlocality is whether finite-alphabet nonsignalling resources can reproduce the continuum of measurement correlations of partially entangled qubits. Here we resolve this problem by showing that every fixed pure two-qubit state admits an exact simulation of all local projective-measurement statistics using shared randomness and finitely many Popescu-Rohrlich (PR) boxes, without communication or postselection. The boxes operate in parallel, with a worst-case bound independent of the measurement settings: at most 128o̧t⁴θ calls for the Schmidt state o̧sθ|00ångle+sinθ|11ångle, 0<θ<π/4. The key is an exact finite-selection method that reduces input-dependent continuous sampling to a choice from a fixed-length shared random list, implemented through a finite PR-box network. The construction extends to arbitrary mixed two-qubit states and local binary-outcome POVMs. This reveals a fundamental separation between the continuity of quantum measurement correlations and the alphabet size of the resources needed to simulate them, shedding light on the resource-theoretic structure of Bell nonlocality.
articles.abstract_zh: 贝尔非局域性中一个长期存在的问题是，有限字母非信号资源能否重现部分纠缠量子比特的连续测量关联。本文通过证明每个固定的纯两量子比特态都可以使用共享随机性和有限数量的Popescu-Rohrlich (PR) 盒子，在没有通信或后选择的情况下，精确模拟所有局部投影测量统计量，从而解决了这个问题。该方法揭示了量子测量关联的连续性与模拟它们所需资源的字母大小之间的根本区别，为贝尔非局域性的资源理论结构提供了新的见解。
authors: Ziao Tang, Xin Wang, Ge Bai

articles.title: Entangled logical qubits on a superconducting quantum processor
articles.title_zh: 超导量子处理器上的纠缠逻辑量子比特
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32347v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate high-fidelity logical qubit operations using textttibmₚₕₒₑₙᵢₓ, a square-lattice array of 120 coupled superconducting qubits that are capable of fast reset. Using strategies to exclude underperforming components together with noise informed decoding, we routinely produce surface codes at distance-3 and distance-5 with logical error per round below 1%. We demonstrate entanglement between two logical qubits, where logical Bell-state fidelities above 93% are observed for entanglement created via lattice surgery. With three logical qubits and lattice surgery, we perform logical teleportation of a range of states and gates, observing fidelities in the range 78% - 93%. Using reset to reduce qubit leakage, we show that repeated rounds of stabilizer measurements continue to exhibit improvements in a stability experiment up to sim 2ḑot 10⁻⁷ over 170 measurement rounds.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了在textttibmₚₕₒₑₙᵢₓ超导量子处理器上实现高保真逻辑量子比特操作。通过排除低性能组件和噪声感知解码策略，成功制备了距离为3和5的表面码，每轮逻辑错误率低于1%。研究人员还通过晶格手术实现了两个逻辑量子比特之间的纠缠，逻辑贝尔态保真度超过93%，并使用三个逻辑量子比特进行了逻辑隐形传态，保真度在78%至93%之间。
authors: Robin Harper, Xanda C. Kolesnikow, Campbell K. McLauchlan, Georgia M. Nixon, Stephen D. Bartlett, Benjamin J. Brown

articles.title: Quantum theory of laser noise in coherent-scattering levitated optomechanics
articles.title_zh: 相干散射悬浮光力学中激光噪声的量子理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32368v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: State purity is a key resource for experimental tests of quantum mechanics with massive objects. Cavity cooling of a levitated nanoparticle via coherent scattering stands out as a strategy to prepare highly pure states of its roto-translational motion. In several cases, though, the performance of cooling by coherent scattering is limited by the classical fluctuations of the laser field. Here we present a quantum theory of coherent-scattering experiments which includes the effect of the laser amplitude and phase noise. We derive a master equation for the noise-averaged particle's dynamics, valid for both center-of-mass and rotational degrees of freedom, and quantify the cooling performance for different levels of noise in state-of-the-art experiments. We compute approximate analytical expressions for the laser-noise-induced heating rates and excess phonon number in both regimes of weak and strong optomechanical coupling. Moreover, our model can be applied to laser noise processes with generic power spectral densities and finite correlation times. This work offers a toolbox to quantify and optimize the state purity in coherent-scattering experiments, and opens new avenues towards the preparation of quantum states with levitated systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 状态纯度是利用大质量物体进行量子力学实验的关键资源。本文提出了一个包含激光振幅和相位噪声影响的相干散射实验量子理论，以解决激光场经典波动对冷却性能的限制。研究人员推导了噪声平均粒子动力学的主方程，并量化了不同噪声水平下的冷却性能。该工作为量化和优化相干散射中的状态纯度提供了一个工具箱。
authors: Davide Candoli, Andreu Riera-Campeny, Lorenzo Dania, Oscar Schmitt Kremer, Johannes Piotrowski, Jayadev Vijayan, Lukas Novotny, Martin Frimmer, Oriol Romero-Isart, Carlos Gonzalez-Ballestero

articles.title: Quantum Secret Sharing from CSS qLDPC Codes: Computable Access Structures, Accessible Logical Dimension, and Topology-Aware Network Cost
articles.title_zh: 基于CSS qLDPC码的量子秘密共享：可计算的访问结构、可访问逻辑维度和拓扑感知网络成本
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32428v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum secret sharing (QSS) schemes can be constructed from quantum error-correcting codes, but characterizing their access structures and implementation costs becomes challenging for finite-length, high-rate quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes. We develop an exact computational framework for QSS induced by CSS qLDPC codes. The framework characterizes authorized, forbidden, and intermediate coalitions using restricted parity-check matrices and binary linear algebra, and introduces the accessible logical dimension (κ(A)), defined through the symplectic rank of locally supported logical classes, to refine the characterization of intermediate coalitions. We further incorporate physical network constraints through separate Tanner-incidence, Steiner-routing, and scheduling-depth costs, and treat the partitioning of physical qubits into participants as an explicit design variable. Numerical experiments on four CSS qLDPC codes verify the predicted complement duality and monotonicity properties and show substantial variation in access transitions and network costs. For the codes studied, the bivariate bicycle instance exhibits the sharpest transition, while network embedding costs vary by more than an order of magnitude across physical topologies. We also show that participant partitioning can substantially improve block-level security and reconstruction thresholds. These results provide a practical bridge between the algebraic structure of CSS qLDPC codes, the graded accessibility of quantum secrets, and the physical constraints of networked QSS implementations.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子秘密共享（QSS）方案可由量子纠错码构建，但对于有限长度、高码率的量子低密度奇偶校验（qLDPC）码，其访问结构和实现成本的表征具有挑战性。本文开发了一个精确的计算框架，用于分析CSS qLDPC码诱导的QSS。该框架利用受限奇偶校验矩阵和二元线性代数来表征授权、禁止和中间联盟，并引入了可访问逻辑维度以细化中间联盟的表征。数值实验验证了预测的对偶性和单调性，并展示了访问转换和网络成本的显著变化。
authors: Malik Mouaji, Saif Al-Kuwari

articles.title: Classical Pre-Training of Large Shallow Parametrized Quantum Circuits through Pauli Propagation and deployment on Quantum Hardware
articles.title_zh: 通过泡利传播对大型浅层参数化量子电路进行经典预训练并在量子硬件上部署
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32571v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scaling parametrized quantum circuits to a larger number of qubits is a central challenge in Quantum Machine Learning: gradient estimation via the parameter-shift rule quickly becomes prohibitively expensive, while gradient-free optimizers offer limited convergence guarantees. We apply the Pauli propagation framework to a broad class of Quantum Machine Learning problems in which the loss is expressed as a function of expectation values of the circuit's observables, while keeping the relevant quantity of interest, such as the quantum state or its samples, classically intractable to compute. By propagating the observables backward through the circuit, we obtain an explicit parametric expression for the loss that can be minimized entirely on classical hardware. We also present complementary strategies to make propagation tractable at large scale, including weight-based and degree-based truncations and pruning heuristics. We demonstrate the approach on two benchmarks run on 64-qubit circuits: Variational Quantum Eigensolver on a two-dimensional Ising model, and training of a discrete-type generative model for binary images. In both cases, the classically pre-trained parameters are deployed on the IBM quantum processor ibm_berlin. For generative learning, we additionally show that the circuits considered here require substantially fewer parametrized gates than IQP-style ansätze, reducing transpilation overhead and making deployment on current quantum hardware feasible.
articles.abstract_zh: 将参数化量子电路扩展到更多量子比特是量子机器学习中的一个核心挑战。本文将泡利传播框架应用于一类广泛的量子机器学习问题，其中损失函数表示为电路可观测量的期望值函数。通过将可观测量反向传播通过电路，可以获得损失函数的显式参数表达式，从而完全在经典硬件上进行最小化。该方法在64量子比特电路上的变分量子本征求解器和离散型生成模型训练中得到了验证。
authors: Saverio Monaco, Jamal Slim, Ran Xue, Dirk Krücker, Kerstin Borras

articles.title: QuantumBilliards.jl: An extensible, user friendly, high-performance Julia library for the large scale computation of spectra and eigenstates of quantum billiards and related problems
articles.title_zh: QuantumBilliards.jl：一个可扩展、用户友好、高性能的Julia库，用于大规模计算量子台球及其相关问题的谱和本征态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32605v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present QuantumBilliards.jl, an open-source Julia library providing a suite of numerical solvers for the two-dimensional interior Helmholtz eigenproblem with Dirichlet boundary conditions, a paradigmatic model in quantum chaos. The library implements conventional wavenumber-sweep techniques together with several accelerated eigensolvers: the Vergini--Saraceno scaling method, the expanded boundary integral method (EBIM), Beyn's contour-integral method, and the Compact Rational Krylov (CORK) method. It provides a common framework for constructing billiard geometries, exploiting discrete symmetries, computing eigenvalues and eigenstates, and treating smooth, cornered, and multiply connected domains. The library further includes reconstruction of eigenfunctions from boundary normal derivatives and the computation of Poincaré--Husimi (PH) phase-space representations. Available at: https://github.com/Quantum-Chaos-Julia/QuantumBilliards.jl.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了QuantumBilliards.jl，一个开源的Julia库，提供了一套用于求解具有Dirichlet边界条件的二维内部亥姆霍兹本征问题的数值求解器。该库实现了传统的波数扫描技术以及多种加速本征求解器，为构建台球几何、利用离散对称性、计算本征值和本征态提供了一个通用框架。它还包括从边界法向导数重构本征函数以及计算庞加莱-胡西米（PH）相空间表示的功能。
authors: Matic Orel, Črt Lozej

articles.title: Optimizing Quantum Battery via Counterdiabatic driving
articles.title_zh: 通过反绝热驱动优化量子电池
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32610v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We analyze the energy charging of a quantum battery within an open quantum framework, where the interaction between the battery element and an external power source is mediated by an ancilla system acting as a controllable switch. Specifically, we investigate the charging and discharging dynamics of a cavity-based quantum battery coupled to a driven qubit functioning as the charger. To ensure lossless power transfer, we utilize an adiabatic evolution protocol. Furthermore, we implement counterdiabatic driving, achieved by applying an auxiliary control field to the original Hamiltonian, to suppress undesired transitions and realize fast adiabatic dynamics. This scheme significantly accelerates the charging process. We demonstrate that the charging efficiency under adiabatic evolution is enhanced and exhibits stable, non-oscillatory behavior, and we determine the optimal duration for the operation. Finally, we show that counterdiabatic driving minimizes the path length between the initial and final states, inducing the shortest possible evolution distance.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在开放量子框架下分析了量子电池的能量充电过程，其中电池元件与外部电源之间的相互作用由一个可控开关——辅助系统介导。研究人员利用绝热演化协议确保无损功率传输，并实施反绝热驱动以抑制不必要的跃迁并实现快速绝热动力学。该方案显著加速了充电过程，并展示了绝热演化下充电效率的提高和稳定的非振荡行为。
authors: F. Ahmadi, S. Salimi

articles.title: Trace-distance characterization of recurrent pairwise synchronization in cavity-coupled superconducting qubits
articles.title_zh: 腔耦合超导量子比特中循环成对同步的迹距离表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32622v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically investigate recurrent pairwise synchronization in three super?conducting qubits coupled to a common single-mode microwave cavity. The qubits interact indirectly through the cavity field and are driven by a coher?ent microwave field. We obtain the coherent dynamics in the dressed-state basis and quantify pairwise synchronization by the trace distance between reduced single-qubit density matrices. The trace-distance dynamics exhibit oscillatory wave-packet structures, with low-trace-distance regions identifying finite syn?chronization windows. An envelope-threshold procedure is introduced to extract the representative duration of these windows. By varying the middle-qubit coupling strength and the relative coupling ratio of the outer qubits, we con?struct a parameter-dependent map of the synchronization-window duration. The duration decreases rapidly with increasing relative outer-qubit coupling and becomes weakly dependent on the middle-qubit coupling in the stronger-coupling regime. These results provide a reduced-state-based characterization of coherent collective dynamics in multiqubit circuit-QED systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论研究了三个耦合到共同单模微波腔的超导量子比特中的循环成对同步现象。研究人员在缀饰态基下获得了相干动力学，并通过约化单量子比特密度矩阵之间的迹距离来量化成对同步。迹距离动力学表现出振荡波包结构，低迹距离区域标识出有限的同步窗口。这些结果为多量子比特电路QED系统中的相干集体动力学提供了基于约化态的表征。
authors: Tiantian Huan

articles.title: From Link Availability to Deadline-Constrained Key Service: A Feasibility Framework for Mobile Free-Space Quantum Key Distribution
articles.title_zh: 从链路可用性到截止日期约束的密钥服务：移动自由空间量子密钥分发的可行性框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32634v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mobile free-space quantum key distribution (QKD) links can provide secret bits intermittently, whereas applications may need cryptographic key material at specified times. Optical feasibility, positive finite-key output, and deadline-compliant key service are consequently different claims. This technical note formalizes their separation through a time-indexed, security-qualified arrival process and a key-inventory model. Under explicitly stated assumptions, an elementary prefix-feasibility condition characterizes whether all demands can be served without borrowing keys from future contact windows. A stylized finite block model then illustrates why positive long-run optical availability does not ensure positive finite-key output when observations are fragmented into short contacts. Two transparent numerical examples distinguish total key yield from key delivery time and show the conditional benefit of pooling data across acquisition windows. The analysis is intended as a systems-level accounting and benchmarking framework, not a new QKD security proof or a demonstration of hardware performance. It identifies measurements and security assumptions needed to evaluate train, UAV, high-altitude-platform, and satellite-assisted optical QKD against application-level service requirements.
articles.abstract_zh: 移动自由空间量子密钥分发（QKD）链路可以间歇性地提供秘密比特，而应用程序可能需要在特定时间获得加密密钥材料。本文通过时间索引、安全合格的到达过程和密钥库存模型，形式化了光学可行性、正有限密钥输出和符合截止日期的密钥服务之间的区别。该分析旨在作为一个系统级的核算和基准测试框架，而非新的QKD安全证明或硬件性能演示。
authors: Hasan Abbas Al-Mohammed

articles.title: An Invitation to Algebraic Methods in Quantum Theory
articles.title_zh: 量子理论中代数方法的邀请
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32659v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper, we present various well-studied examples of quantum systems, and discuss how they might be analysed algebraically. We analyse the harmonic oscillator, hydrogenic atom, optical components, and particle spin using multiple algebraic methods, and highlight the central importance of algebraic relationships between operators in determining the physical character of the system. In particular, we show: the ubiquity of the Lie algebra mathfrakso(2,1)o̧ngmathfraksu(1,1) as the ``spectrum generating algebra''; the role of mathfraksu(2) and mathfraksu(1,1) in determining the action of optical components; that an elementary algebraic approach to particle spin offers novel insights into its nature versus the usual approaches; and how understanding the full (often hidden) symmetry of a problem enables it to be solved immediately without the need to solve differential equations. We hope this work will serve as a gentle introduction to algebraic methods in quantum mechanics for the interested reader --- we therefore signpost active areas of research within the community.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了量子系统中各种经过充分研究的例子，并讨论了如何通过代数方法对其进行分析。研究人员使用多种代数方法分析了谐振子、类氢原子、光学元件和粒子自旋，强调了算子之间代数关系在确定系统物理特性方面的核心重要性。该工作旨在为对量子力学中代数方法感兴趣的读者提供一个温和的入门。
authors: Peter T. J. Bradshaw, Jonte R. Hance

articles.title: Elementary proofs of quantum lower bounds for element distinctness and k-sum
articles.title_zh: 元素判别和k-和问题的量子下界的初等证明
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32693v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We give elementary proofs of the Ømega(n²/³) quantum query lower bound for element distinctness and the Ømega(nk/⁽k⁺¹⁾) lower bound for the k-sum problem, for fixed k and sufficiently large groups. The proofs use only basic properties of quantum states and linear algebra, analyzing the differences of algorithm states on different inputs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为元素判别问题和k-和问题提供了量子查询下界的初等证明。对于固定的k和足够大的群，元素判别问题的下界为Ømega(n²/³)，k-和问题的下界为Ømega(nk/⁽k⁺¹⁾)。这些证明仅使用量子态和线性代数的基本性质，通过分析不同输入上算法状态的差异来得出。
authors: Andris Ambainis, Martins Kokainis

articles.title: Optimal probes for estimating the dephasing of a quantum spin system
articles.title_zh: 估计量子自旋系统退相干的最佳探针
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32724v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the optimal estimation of dephasing in finite-dimensional quantum spin systems. We first discuss some properties of the optimal probe states and present an efficient numerical algorithm to compute the optimal precision in dephasing estimation and identify the optimal probe states. For the dephasing channel arising from Gaussian phase diffusion, a spin cat state is known to be optimal for small dephasing. We analytically determine the range of dephasing strengths over which the cat state remains globally optimal for spins J=1 and J=3/2, and derive upper bounds on its optimality region for larger spins. We then compare numerically several probe states proposed in the literature, showing in particular that the simple class of probes obtained from uniform superpositions of all levels performs near-optimally for stronger dephasing. Finally, we apply our framework to a central-spin model coupled to a nuclear-spin bath, whose dynamics we simulate using the cluster-correlation expansion. Our results show that, while the cat state is optimal for weak Gaussian dephasing, pulse-controlled non-Markovian dynamics can favor states with amplitudes distributed over multiple spin levels, and in some cases the uniform state outperforms the other fixed probes considered. This shows how the choice of probe state depends both on the dephasing strength and on the dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了有限维量子自旋系统中退相干的最佳估计问题。研究人员讨论了最佳探针态的一些性质，并提出了一种高效的数值算法来计算退相干估计的最佳精度并识别最佳探针态。结果表明，虽然猫态对于弱高斯退相干是最佳的，但脉冲控制的非马尔可夫动力学可能有利于其他状态。
authors: Leonardo Ratini, Stefano Carretta, Francesco Albarelli

articles.title: Bounding single-copy information causality violations
articles.title_zh: 限制单副本信息因果性违背
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32783v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Information causality is a physical principle that constrains bipartite post-quantum nonlocal correlations from information-theoretic assumptions. A direct characterization of the correlations satisfying it, however, remains difficult because the defining entropic condition must hold for all admissible protocols in the corresponding task. Here, we formulate the single-copy information causality problem as an optimization over all protocol parameters and simplify it by proving a deterministic reduction. We then show that generic adaptive multi-copy protocols can be represented as single-copy protocols applied to an effective behavior obtained by local wirings. As a consequence, for families of correlations closed under wirings, excluding single-copy violations suffices to exclude all finite-copy adaptive-protocol violations. We formulate the resulting membership and set-inclusion problems as optimization problems and discuss possible semidefinite programming relaxations. As an application, we study expansions of the information causality functional around zero-capacity channels, generalizing a method recently employed by Gachechiladze and Miklin to derive the Tsirelson--Landau--Masanes boundary from information causality. For expansions centered on channels whose output distribution has full support, imposing the second-order constraints for all single-copy protocols characterizes exactly the set of macroscopic locality in the CHSH scenario. Expanding instead around appropriate constant-output channels with perturbations that change the channel support, we show that every single-copy IC violation can be witnessed already at first order with a channel of arbitrarily small capacity.
articles.abstract_zh: 信息因果性是一个物理原理，它从信息论假设出发，限制了双分量后量子非局域关联。由于其定义熵条件必须对所有可接受的协议都成立，直接表征满足该条件的关联仍然困难。本文将单副本信息因果性问题表述为对所有协议参数的优化，并通过确定性归约对其进行了简化。研究表明，对于在布线操作下封闭的关联族，排除单副本违背足以排除所有有限副本自适应协议的违背。
authors: Marco Pompili, Costantino Budroni

articles.title: Minimal unitary representations of time-invariant causal quantum channels
articles.title_zh: 时不变因果量子信道的最小酉表示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32823v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we study quantum channels that respect causality in single-input-single-output linear time-invariant systems. We show that positive semidefinite kernels satisfying certain analyticity constraints, which we call Schur-class kernels, provide a suitable description of such channels through multiplicative maps (Schur multipliers). Using the Moore-Aronszajn Theorem, we establish that these multipliers admit a minimal analytic Stinespring representation, which, in the unital case, is given by multiplication by a left inner function. We then relate the output rank of pure-state inputs to the dimension of the associated reproducing kernel Hilbert space. Using de Branges-Rovnyak realizations, we derive a stability criterion for the existence of two-sided inner completions of these vector-valued functions. We further show that the adjoint of the Julia embedding associated with the realization is minimal, and that its characteristic function essentially coincides with the canonical two-sided inner completion suggested by the Beurling-Lax-Halmos Theorem. Finally, we provide algorithms for explicitly computing minimal two-sided inner completions in the case of finite McMillan degree.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了单输入单输出线性时不变系统中遵循因果性的量子信道。研究表明，满足特定解析性约束的正半定核（称为Schur类核）通过乘法映射（Schur乘子）为这类信道提供了合适的描述。利用Moore-Aronszajn定理，作者建立了这些乘子承认最小解析Stinespring表示。该工作还推导了这些向量值函数存在双边内补全的稳定性判据，并提供了计算最小双边内补全的算法。
authors: Antonius Jacobus Hasenack, Boris Škorić

articles.title: Fermion Scattering on Quantum Computers
articles.title_zh: 量子计算机上的费米子散射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32882v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Resonant scattering links particle interactions to the formation and decay of unstable excitations. We develop a hybrid quantum-computing framework to study these dynamics through fermion--antifermion collisions. Our formulation of (1+1)-dimensional Yukawa theory encodes fermions in qubits and the scalar field in qumodes. We identify the operations needed for a photonic implementation and benchmark the dynamics with tensor-network simulations. Near resonance, we resolve the build-up of a localised scalar excitation and the subsequent partial return of energy to the fermions. Enhanced entanglement accompanies this exchange. Time-dependent correlator measurements reproduce the analytically predicted decay rate to a few percent precision, with energy scans exhibiting a resonance peak consistent with packet-averaged Breit--Wigner behaviour. These results establish a concrete scattering benchmark for hybrid quantum computers and demonstrate how local real-time observables can probe particle-resonance dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 共振散射将粒子相互作用与不稳定激发的形成和衰变联系起来。本文开发了一个混合量子计算框架，通过费米子-反费米子碰撞来研究这些动力学。该框架将(1+1)维Yukawa理论中的费米子编码为量子比特，标量场编码为量子模式。研究结果为混合量子计算机建立了具体的散射基准，并展示了局域实时可观测如何探测粒子共振动力学。
authors: Steven Abel, Michael Spannowsky, Simon Williams

articles.title: One-sided-DIQKD using any pure bipartite entangled state secure against all attacks
articles.title_zh: 使用任意纯双分量纠缠态实现单边设备无关量子密钥分发，可抵御所有攻击
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32923v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) allows spatially separated parties to establish a secret key among themselves based on quantum principles. While QKD systems are being deployed worldwide, their reliance on trusted measurements makes them vulnerable. Moreover, existing protocols have largely focussed on the qubit cases, and rely on the maximally entangled state, a costly resource to generate. Here, we consider the one-sided-device-independent (1SDI) QKD protocols, where one of the measurement devices is trusted while the other is untrusted. The resource in this scenario is quantum steering, an asymmetric form of quantum nonlocality. This is inspired by a real-world scenario, where the trusted party can be considered to be a bank, or any large organisation that has sufficient resources to protect its systems and validate them, while the users are vulnerable to attacks. We then demonstrate that a secure key can be obtained using any pure bipartite entangled state in this setup. Considering realistic detectors and sources based on current technology, we demonstrate that even states that are almost separable can be used to extract a secure key. Moreover, for every pure entangled bipartite state, we find the critical detection efficiencies and visibility to obtain a secure key.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子密钥分发（QKD）允许空间分离的双方基于量子原理建立秘密密钥，但其对可信测量的依赖使其易受攻击。本文考虑了单边设备无关（1SDI）QKD协议，其中一个测量设备可信，另一个不可信。研究表明，在这种设置下，可以使用任意纯双分量纠缠态获得安全密钥。考虑到基于当前技术的实际探测器和光源，即使是几乎可分离的态也可以用于提取安全密钥。
authors: Bohnishikha Ghosh, Chithra Raj, Shubhayan Sarkar

articles.title: Generating entanglement in quantum matter with pathway-entangled photons via resonant inelastic X-ray scattering
articles.title_zh: 通过共振非弹性X射线散射利用路径纠缠光子在量子物质中产生纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32936v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) is conventionally used to probe elementary excitations and correlations in quantum materials. Here, we propose an interferometric RIXS protocol that instead creates entanglement between spatially separated regions of a solid-state material. An incident X-ray photon is coherently split by a beam splitter into two arms illuminating opposite ends of a sample. Recombining the scattered photons at a second beam splitter and detecting an energy-selected photon then projects the material into a coherent superposition of excitations at the two ends. This protocol is the X-ray, solid-state analogue of the Duan-Lukin-Cirac-Zoller (DLCZ) heralding scheme. Using a Kramers-Heisenberg formalism with quantized photon modes, we show that orthogonal and degenerate end excitations yield maximally entangled states. We illustrate this mechanism in three models: (1) two decoupled sites yield a heralded Bell state. (2) An open tight-binding chain exhibits reflection-parity-dependent interference, providing a benchmark for the interferometer's coherence. (3) A spin-1 Haldane (AKLT) chain yields an entangled pair of fractionalized edge spins. We also discuss practical considerations and challenges for realizing the protocol in X-ray experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）通常用于探测量子材料中的基本激发和关联。本文提出了一种干涉式RIXS协议，旨在在固态材料的空间分离区域之间产生纠缠。该协议通过将入射X射线光子相干分裂并重新组合，将材料投影到两端激发的相干叠加态。研究表明，正交和简并的末端激发可以产生最大纠缠态，并在三种模型中验证了这一机制。
authors: Chunjing Jia, Valentin Walther, Laimei Nie

articles.title: Certain Quantum States Already Require Quantum Time Evolution
articles.title_zh: 某些量子态本身就要求量子时间演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32937v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Model-independent tests of quantum theory, such as Bell inequality violations, focus on static properties of the theory and do not rely on its dynamical aspects. Hence, this core part of quantum theory remains largely untested in a model-independent way. We show that the structure of quantum time evolution can be examined by testing the consistency between the state space and the dynamical laws. Considering a class of generalized phase-space theories, we find that certain quantum states can only be part of a theory if the time evolution is quantum: their evolution in anharmonic potentials would otherwise result in unphysical, negative marginal distributions. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the existence of the first excited state of a quantum harmonic oscillator is already sufficient to single out the Moyal bracket (quantum dynamics) to leading order in hbar². We outline how theory-independent Wigner tomography of this state can be used to empirically exclude nonquantum dynamical theories.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子理论的模型无关检验通常侧重于静态特性，而其动力学方面仍未得到充分检验。本文展示了通过检验态空间与动力学定律之间的一致性，可以考察量子时间演化的结构。研究发现，某些量子态只有在时间演化是量子的情况下才能成为理论的一部分，否则它们在非谐势中的演化将导致非物理的负边际分布。此外，量子谐振子第一激发态的存在足以在hbar²的主导阶次上确定Moyal括号（量子动力学）。
authors: Joel D. Huber, Matthias Kleinmann

articles.title: Distributed Quantum-Centric Supercomputing with Multi-Layered Generative Learning for Intermolecular Interactions
articles.title_zh: 基于多层生成学习的分布式量子中心超算用于分子间相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32968v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum-centric supercomputing (QCSC) approaches, such as sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD), combine quantum processors with high-performance computers (HPC), offering a promising route toward solving challenging electronic structure problems. However, implementation of QCSC approaches to large active space calculations is constrained by the associated number of qubits, deep quantum circuits, sampling cost, and large-scale Hamiltonian diagonalization. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a distributed QCSC framework that decomposes complex molecular problems into parallel sub-problems requiring fewer qubits, shallower circuits, and reduced shot budgets. A physically motivated, two-step aggregation scheme then reconstructs the global solution: first, a computational bit assignment strategy optimizes a cost function to appropriately map local bit indices to global ones, yielding a mapped tensor product state (MTPS); second, an inter-fragment correlation recovery module restores missing cross-fragment interactions. Herein, we employ a multi-layered generative machine learning architecture, starting with utilizing the recently proposed physics-informed generative SQD (PIGen-SQD) as a distributed QCSC solver, followed by a secondary generative module to model configuration distributions and identify dominant sectors of the global Hilbert space. For water and formamide dimers, our method achieves up to 95% reduction in the diagonalization dimension while enhancing energy accuracy by an order of magnitude over conventional SQD. Furthermore, application to the water hexamer ((H₂O)₆₎ cage successfully decomposes a 120-qubit problem into six 20-qubit monomeric subsystems, and stitches the monomers under a dimeric approximation, demonstrating excellent agreement with the reference classical methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子中心超算（QCSC）方法在解决电子结构问题方面具有潜力，但其应用于大活性空间计算时受限于量子比特数量、电路深度和采样成本。为克服这些限制，本文引入了一个分布式QCSC框架，将复杂分子问题分解为并行子问题。该框架采用两步聚合方案重建全局解，并利用多层生成机器学习架构来恢复缺失的跨片段相互作用。
authors: Chayan Patra, Prayas Ghosh, Adwait Patkhedkar, Rahul Maitra

articles.title: Photoelectrons resolve the phase-dependent variance of bright squeezed vacuum
articles.title_zh: 光电子解析亮压缩真空的相依赖方差
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31811v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The variance of bright squeezed vacuum (BSV) is not only strong but also phase dependent, yet recent strong-field experiments with BSV have recorded only its magnitude. A coherent field of the same color provides the phase reference that resolves this phase-dependent noise. Strong-field ionization of xenon by this light shows that the photoelectron yield follows the BSV quadrature along the coherent field, and that the nonlinearity of ionization amplifies the quadrature noise many times over in the electron yield. The noise is moreover distributed unevenly over the photoelectron momentum distribution, differing by an order of magnitude between ionization channels. Strong-field ionization thus offers a phase-sensitive, channel-resolved detector of quantum light, while the quadrature noise of quantum light offers a probe of the intensity dependence of individual ionization pathways.
articles.abstract_zh: 亮压缩真空（BSV）的方差不仅强度大而且依赖于相位，但最近的强场实验仅记录了其幅度。本文通过使用相同颜色的相干场作为相位参考，解析了这种相依赖噪声。氙的强场电离实验表明，光电子产额遵循BSV沿相干场的正交分量，且电离的非线性将正交分量噪声在电子产额中放大了许多倍。强场电离因此提供了一种对量子光的相敏、通道分辨探测器。
authors: Haoran Ma, Yihe Wang, Chuan Cheng, Ian Gabalski, Aaron M. Ghrist, Eleanor Weckwerth, Mohammed Th. Hassan, Philip H. Bucksbaum

articles.title: A Topology-Aware Quantum-Classical Framework for Multi-Target Active Debris Removal using Gaussian Boson Sampling
articles.title_zh: 基于高斯玻色采样和拓扑感知的量子-经典框架用于多目标主动碎片清除
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31824v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The continued growth of orbital debris threatens the safety and sustainability of near-Earth space, making Active Debris Removal (ADR) an important mitigation strategy. Selecting k targets from N candidates yields a combinatorial search space of size binomNk, making joint target selection and mission sequencing computationally demanding. We present a topology-aware quantum-classical framework integrating orbital mechanics, weighted orbital-transfer graphs, Gaussian Boson Sampling (GBS), and multi-objective evolutionary optimization. Seven target-prioritization strategies represent physical consequence, orbital persistence, conjunction risk, network centrality, community structure, inferred source families, and random selection. GBS generates candidate target subsets from the weighted graph, which are then evaluated using PyGMO-based evolutionary optimization to identify servicing sequences that jointly minimize total velocity increment (Δ v) and mission duration, accounting for modeled timing, propulsion, and mass feasibility. We evaluate the framework across three benchmark environments, SOCRATES Minefield, Collision Cloud, and Random, with candidate-pool sizes Nin15,18,22,25 and target cardinalities kin3,5. The experiments characterize how benchmark topology, prioritization strategy, and problem scale relate to sampling behavior and downstream mission performance. By separating candidate-subset generation from detailed trajectory optimization, the framework offers a topology-aware approach to focusing computational effort on a limited set of candidate ADR missions.
articles.abstract_zh: 轨道碎片持续增长对近地空间的安全和可持续性构成威胁，主动碎片清除（ADR）成为重要的缓解策略。本文提出了一个拓扑感知的量子-经典框架，集成了轨道力学、加权轨道转移图、高斯玻色采样（GBS）和多目标演化优化。GBS从加权图中生成候选目标子集，然后通过基于PyGMO的演化优化进行评估，以确定同时最小化总速度增量和任务持续时间的服务序列。
authors: Komal Pandya, Saiyam Sakhuja, Nagaraj Kattian

articles.title: Can Spontaneous Time-Translation Symmetry Breaking Be Quantized Without Explicit Branches?
articles.title_zh: 自发时间平移对称性破缺能否在没有显式分支的情况下被量子化？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32030v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Can classically branched dynamics associated with spontaneous time-translation-symmetry breaking be quantized without explicitly retaining the branches of the Hamiltonian? We investigate this question using a reduced phase space. formulation in which the Hamiltonian is single-valued, while the critical structure of the classical Legendre map is encoded in a singular, momentum-dependent symplectic geometry. Quantization of the reduced Poisson algebra yields a deformed position-momentum commutator whose singularities determine distinct regular momentum sectors. Using the positive measure induced by the reduced symplectic structure, we identify a bounded central sector and two unbounded outer sectors. In the central sector, states with vanishing mean momentum obey a nonzero lower bound on position uncertainty, subject to the operator-domain assumptions of the representation. We further identify a possible field-theoretic connection with k-essence, where nonlinear scalar-field kinetics can produce finite-velocity degeneracies of the Legendre map. The relationship between the resulting reduced quantum description and branch-matching quantization remains unresolved and requires a comparison of the corresponding Hilbert spaces and operator domains.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在不显式保留哈密顿量分支的情况下，能否对与自发时间平移对称性破缺相关的经典分支动力学进行量子化。研究利用约化相空间公式，其中哈密顿量是单值的，而经典Legendre映射的临界结构编码在奇异的、依赖于动量的辛几何中。约化泊松代数的量子化产生了一个变形的位置-动量对易子，其奇点决定了不同的正则动量区域。
authors: Partha Nandi

articles.title: Single-step SU(3) Hahn Echo in a Qutrit Atom Interferometer
articles.title_zh: 碲原子干涉仪中的单步SU(3)哈恩回波
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32160v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Hahn echo is a well-known dynamical decoupling method that refocuses the dephasing due to energy inhomogeneities of a spin-1/2 ensemble and is widely used to extend phase coherence in quantum computers and sensors. Extensions of such techniques beyond the spin-1/2 have been reported, but have mainly used SU(2) gates, limiting their scalability. Here, we generalize the Hahn echo to qutrits using single-step SU(3) gates and extend the coherence time by more than an order of magnitude. The gates are generated through optimal control theory and implemented in an ultracold atomic ensemble in free fall. A quantum process tomography procedure benchmarks the gates and yields fidelities of ~ 93%, limited mainly by state preparation and measurement errors. Due to the geometry of the laser beams, the generalized Hahn echo also realizes a three-path Mach-Zehnder atomic interferometer with two independent interferometric phase differences. Our results therefore establish SU(3) control for dynamical decoupling of qutrits and multi-path atom interferometers, with the latter opening the possibility for vector force measurements and interferometric tests of the validity of Born's rule.
articles.abstract_zh: 哈恩回波是一种著名的动态解耦方法，用于延长量子计算机和传感器的相位相干时间。本文将哈恩回波推广到三能级量子比特（qutrits），使用单步SU(3)门将相干时间延长了一个数量级以上。这些门通过最优控制理论生成，并在超冷原子系综中实现，其量子过程层析成像的保真度约为93%。广义哈恩回波还实现了一个具有两个独立干涉相位差的三路径马赫-曾德尔原子干涉仪，为矢量力测量和多路径原子干涉仪开辟了可能性。
authors: Chirantan Mitra, Lucas Gabardos, François Impens, David Guéry-Odelin, David Wilkowski, Chang Chi Kwong

articles.title: Bose-Einstein condensate in a shell: nonlinear modes and symmetry breaking
articles.title_zh: 壳层中的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体：非线性模式与对称性破缺
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32249v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The state of a quantum particle confined to a spherical surface is commonly described using spherical harmonics, which play a crucial role in solving many scientific problems featuring spherical symmetry. A mean-field description of a system of many interacting quantum particles confined to a spherical shell naturally leads to nonlinear generalizations of spherical harmonics. In this study, we analyze the emergence of such nonlinear modes in a shell-shaped Bose-Einstein condensate with both repulsive and attractive two-particle interactions. We find several classes of nonlinear modes. The first kind is an analytical continuation of a single spherical harmonic or their superposition for nonvanishing atom-atom interaction. Some of these solutions have planar counterparts in the form of Townes solitons and Townes vortices, which either appear stable even in the case of attractive interactions or can be stabilized by three-particle interactions. The second kind originate from symmetry-breaking bifurcations in the case of a repulsive interaction, and therefore have no linear counterparts. Moreover, we demonstrate the existence of a breathing dynamics that oscillates primarily between an unstable soliton and a stable vortex necklace state. Our findings show that the physics of nonlinear matter waves on curved geometries differs substantially from that in planar systems, suggesting the feasibility of observing these unconventional wave patterns experimentally.
articles.abstract_zh: 局限于球形表面的量子粒子状态通常用球谐函数描述。本文研究了在具有排斥和吸引双粒子相互作用的壳形玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中非线性模式的出现。研究发现了多类非线性模式，包括单个球谐函数或其叠加的解析延拓，以及源于排斥相互作用下对称性破缺分岔的模式。这些结果揭示了壳层中玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的复杂动力学。
authors: Alexander Wolf, Vladimir V. Konotop, Maxim A. Efremov

articles.title: Stochastic and quantum autonomous information machine: efficiency fluctuations, precision and optimization
articles.title_zh: 随机和量子自主信息机：效率波动、精度与优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32683v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate the conversion between thermal and informational resources in an autonomous machine coupled to thermal reservoirs and a tape, playing the role of an information reservoir. The machine is able to perform information erasure driven by heat, and information-powered refrigeration, for which we introduce suitable efficiency definitions. We focus on the role of fluctuations in the currents and stochastic efficiencies, as well as in operation at optimal performance. The model is also extended to allow a coherent information reservoir, which is able to modify operation and performance. All in all, our work provides insights for the design and optimization of information-to-work conversion devices at small scales.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了自主信息机在热资源与信息资源（信息存储器）之间转换的机制。该机器能够实现热驱动的信息擦除和信息驱动的制冷，并为此引入了合适的效率定义。研究重点关注电流和随机效率中的波动作用，以及在最佳性能下的运行，并扩展模型以包含相干信息存储器。这项工作为设计和优化小尺度信息-功转换设备提供了深入见解。
authors: Lucas Trigal, Gonzalo Manzano

articles.title: QubiC 2.0: An Extensible Open-Source Qubit Control System Capable of Mid-Circuit Measurement and Feed-Forward
articles.title_zh: QubiC 2.0：一种可扩展的开源量子比特控制系统，具备电路中测量和前馈能力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2309.10333v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Researchers manipulate and measure quantum processing units via the classical electronics control system. We developed an open-source FPGA-based quantum bit control system called QubiC for superconducting qubits. After years of qubit calibration and testing experience on QubiC 1.0, we recognized the need for mid-circuit measurement and feed-forward capabilities to implement advanced quantum algorithms, and upgraded the system to QubiC 2.0 on an AMD ZCU216 RFSoC evaluation board with all these enriched features. The system uses portable FPGA gateware with a simplified processor to handle commands on-the-fly. For design simplicity and straightforward scaling, we adopted a multi-core distributed architecture, assigning one processor core per qubit. The pulses combine the unique pulse envelope and carrier information specified in a command. Each pulse envelope is pre-stored in the FPGA's block RAMs, ensuring speed and reusability throughout the quantum circuit, while pulse parameters including amplitude, phase, and frequency can be updated from pulse to pulse. The software stack is developed in Python, running on both the FPGA's ARM core and a host computer via XML-RPC. Quantum circuits can be described in a high-level language supporting both pulse-level and native-gate-level programming with high-level control flow constructs, and are compiled into binary commands loaded into the FPGA. With QubiC 2.0, we achieved multi-FPGA synchronization and low-latency data communication, and demonstrated feed-forward experiments on conditional circuits. The system also serves as a platform for artificial intelligence and machine learning driven quantum control, such as FPGA-based real-time quantum state discrimination. The enhanced QubiC system provides researchers with powerful tools to explore and implement advanced quantum algorithms and applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究人员通过经典电子控制系统操纵和测量量子处理单元。本文介绍了QubiC 2.0，一个基于FPGA的开源超导量子比特控制系统，它在QubiC 1.0的基础上进行了升级，增加了电路中测量和前馈功能。该系统采用多核分布式架构，每个量子比特分配一个处理器核心，以实现设计简洁性和可扩展性。QubiC 2.0能够处理实时指令，并支持脉冲参数的动态更新，为实现高级量子算法提供了丰富功能。
authors: Yilun Xu, Gang Huang, Neelay Fruitwala, Neel R. Vora, Abhi D. Rajagopala, Akel Hashim, Larry Chen, Noah Goss, Kasra Nowrouzi, Ravi K. Naik, Christopher Spitzer, David I. Santiago, Irfan Siddiqi

articles.title: A comprehensive benchmark of an Ising machine on the Max-Cut problem
articles.title_zh: Ising机器在Max-Cut问题上的综合基准测试
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.22117v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: QUBO formulations of combinatorial optimization problems allow for solving them using various quantum heuristics. While large-scale quantum computations are currently still out of reach, we can already numerically test such QUBO formulations on a perhaps surprisingly large scale. In this work, we benchmark Fujitsu's Digital Annealer (DA) on the Max-Cut problem, which captures the main complexity of the QUBO problem. We make a comprehensive benchmark against leading other heuristic algorithms on graphs with up to 53,000 variables by focusing on the wall-clock time. Moreover, we compare the DA performance against published performance results of the D-Wave hybrid quantum-classical annealer and the recently proposed QIS3 heuristic. Based on performance statistics for over 2,000 graphs from the MQLib, we find that the DA yields competitive results. We hope that this benchmark demonstrates the extent to which large QUBO instances can be heuristically solved today, yielding consistent results across different solvers.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对Fujitsu的数字退火器（DA）在Max-Cut问题上的性能进行了综合基准测试，该问题捕捉了二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）问题的主要复杂性。研究将DA与领先的启发式算法进行了比较，处理了多达53,000个变量的图，并关注了实际运行时间。结果显示，DA在超过2,000个MQLib图上的性能统计数据具有竞争力，与D-Wave混合量子-经典退火器和QIS3启发式算法的已发布结果相当。这项工作展示了当前启发式算法解决大规模QUBO实例的能力及其一致性。
authors: Salwa Shaglel, Markus Kirsch, Marten Winkler, Christian Münch, Stefan Walter, Fritz Schinkel, Martin Kliesch

articles.title: Succession of Ising criticality and its threshold in critical quantum Ising model subject to X+ZZ decoherence
articles.title_zh: 在X+ZZ退相干作用下临界量子Ising模型中Ising临界性及其阈值的演替
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.17871v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate a mixed state quantum criticality in the Ising model under X+ZZ decoherence. In the doubled Hilbert space formalism, the decohered state resides on the self-dual critical line of the quantum Ashkin-Teller (qAT) model, as a result of the specific choice of the decoherence channel. On the other hand, since the mixed state under X+ZZ decoherence satisfies the Kramers-Wannier self-duality in a weak sense, the Ising criticality of the pure state can be partially preserved in the mixed system. By making use of the combination of the doubled Hilbert space formalism and matrix product states, a numerical study is carried out. We numerically find that, up to moderate decoherence strength, the behavior of the mixed states on the critical line is consistent with Ising-like scaling within the accessible system sizes, with the effective central charge and critical exponents close to the Ising-CFT values c=1/2, η=1/4, and η_X=2. Our results of the central charge and critical exponents contradict the ones in the c=1 orbifold boson CFT describing the critical state of the qAT model. In addition, we also numerically observe the flow of the central charge up to strong decoherence. The strong decoherence washes out the remnant Ising criticality and induces strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究在X+ZZ退相干作用下的Ising模型中，探讨了混合态量子临界性。在双希尔伯特空间形式下，退相干态位于量子Ashkin-Teller（qAT）模型的自对偶临界线上。通过结合双希尔伯特空间形式和矩阵乘积态进行数值研究，发现中等退相干强度下，混合态在临界线上的行为与Ising型标度一致。研究结果表明，有效中心荷和临界指数接近Ising-CFT值，这与描述qAT模型临界态的c=1轨道玻色子CFT的结果相矛盾。
authors: Yoshihito Kuno, Takahiro Orito, Ikuo Ichinose

articles.title: A Counterexample to the Optimality Conjecture in Convex Quantum Channel Optimization
articles.title_zh: 凸量子信道优化中最优性猜想的反例
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.22863v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This paper presents a counterexample to the optimality conjecture for the trace distance based optimal state transformation problem proposed by Coutts et al. [Quantum 5, 448 (2021)]. The conjecture posits that for the trace distance based optimal state transformation problem, applying the sign function to the error matrix uniquely determines a dual certificate for every optimal solution. By constructing a counterexample in 2-dimensional Hilbert spaces, we disprove this conjecture.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个反例，推翻了Coutts等人提出的基于迹距离的最优态变换问题中的最优性猜想。该猜想认为，对于基于迹距离的最优态变换问题，对误差矩阵应用符号函数可以唯一确定每个最优解的对偶证书。通过在二维希尔伯特空间中构建反例，本研究成功地驳斥了这一猜想。
authors: Jianting Yang

articles.title: Open quantum spin chains with non-reciprocity: a theoretical approach based on the time-dependent generalized Gibbs ensemble
articles.title_zh: 具有非互易性的开放量子自旋链：基于时间依赖广义吉布斯系综的理论方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.08606v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study an open quantum spin chain with non-reciprocal dissipation using a theoretical approach known as time-dependent generalized Gibbs ensemble. In the regime of weak dissipation the system is fully characterized by its rapidity distribution and we derive a closed set of coupled differential equations governing their time evolution. We check the accuracy of this theory by benchmarking the results against numerical simulations. Using this framework we are able to compute both the magnetization density and current dynamics, identifying some relations between the two. The problem of the anomalous power-law exponents identified in a previous work is discussed. Our work constitutes a theoretical approach that is able to describe the physics of non-reciprocal open quantum spin chains beyond analyses based on non-interacting fermions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究采用时间依赖广义吉布斯系综的理论方法，探讨了具有非互易耗散的开放量子自旋链。在弱耗散区域，系统完全由其速度分布表征，并推导出一组控制其时间演化的耦合微分方程。通过与数值模拟结果进行基准测试，验证了该理论的准确性。该框架能够计算磁化密度和电流动力学，并揭示两者之间的一些关系，为理解非互易开放量子自旋链的物理特性提供了超越非相互作用费米子分析的理论方法。
authors: Alice Marché, Hironobu Yoshida, Alberto Nardin, Hosho Katsura, Leonardo Mazza

articles.title: Authentication in Security Proofs for Quantum Key Distribution
articles.title_zh: 量子密钥分发安全证明中的认证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.17960v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) protocols rely on authenticated classical communication. Typical QKD security proofs are carried out in an idealized setting where authentication is assumed to behave honestly: it never aborts, and all classical messages are delivered faithfully with their original timing preserved. Authenticated channels that can be constructed in practice have different properties. Most critically, such channels may abort asymmetrically, such that only the receiving party may detect an authentication failure while the sending party remains unaware. Furthermore, an adversary may delay, reorder, or block classical messages. This discrepancy means that existing security proofs under honest authentication do not directly establish security in the practical authentication setting. We address this gap using an existing security definition from the literature that permits asymmetric aborts while retaining secrecy of any key produced and agreement of the keys whenever both parties accept. Our main result is a reduction theorem showing that, under mild and easily satisfied protocol conditions, any QKD protocol proven secure under the honest authentication setting, for the standard security definition with symmetric aborts, remains secure under a practical authentication setting, for the weaker security definition that allows for asymmetric aborts. This result allows all existing QKD proofs to be retroactively lifted to the practical authentication setting (with asymmetric aborts) with a minor protocol tweak.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子密钥分发（QKD）协议依赖于经过认证的经典通信。传统的QKD安全证明通常在理想化设置下进行，假设认证行为诚实，但实际认证通道可能存在不对称中止、消息延迟、重排或阻塞等问题。本文通过使用允许不对称中止的安全定义，弥补了现有安全证明与实际认证设置之间的差距。主要结果是一个归约定理，表明在温和且易于满足的协议条件下，任何被证明安全的QKD协议在实际认证设置下也同样安全。
authors: Devashish Tupkary, Shlok Nahar, Ernest Y. -Z. Tan

articles.title: Eigenstate condensation in quantum systems with finite-dimensional Hilbert spaces
articles.title_zh: 有限维希尔伯特空间量子系统中的本征态凝聚
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.18869v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Random quantum states drawn from the Haar ensemble with a constraint on the energy expectation value Eₐᵥ = łangle ψ | H | ψångle display eigenstate condensation: for Eₐᵥ below a critical value E_c, they develop macroscopic overlap with the ground state. We study eigenstate condensation in systems with finite-dimensional Hilbert spaces. These systems display three phases: a ground-state phase, in which energy-constrained random states have macroscopic overlap with the ground state; a high-temperature phase, in which they have exponentially small overlap with each energy eigenstate; and an anti-ground-state phase, in which they have macroscopic overlap with the most highly excited state. In local spin systems the ground-state and anti-ground-state phases approach the middle of the spectrum as 1/[system size], but -- because the condensation phase transitions have exponential, rather than polynomial, finite-size scaling -- the crossover becomes exponentially sharp in system size and the high-temperature phase is best understood as an extended phase.
articles.abstract_zh: 在有限维希尔伯特空间中，受能量期望值约束的哈尔系综随机量子态表现出本征态凝聚现象。当平均能量低于临界值时，这些态与基态产生宏观重叠。研究发现这些系统展现出三个相：基态相、高温相和反基态相。在局部自旋系统中，基态相和反基态相会随着系统尺寸的增加而趋近能谱中部，但由于凝聚相变具有指数而非多项式有限尺寸标度，因此交叉变得指数级尖锐，高温相最好被理解为一个扩展相。
authors: Christopher David White, Michael Winer, Noam Bernstein

articles.title: Optimal Universal Bounds for Quantum Divergences
articles.title_zh: 量子散度的最优普适界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.09885v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We identify a universal structural principle underlying the smoothing of classical divergences: the optimizer of the smoothing problem is a clipped probability vector, independently of the specific divergence. This yields a divergence-independent characterization of all smoothed classical divergences and reveals a common geometric structure behind seemingly different quantities. Building on this structural insight, we derive optimal universal bounds for smoothed quantum divergences, including quantum Rényi divergences of arbitrary order and the hypothesis-testing divergence. Our inequalities relate divergences of different orders through bounds of the form D_βǎrepsⁱloⁿ łe D_α + correction and D_βǎrepsⁱloⁿ ge D_α + correction, and we prove that the correction terms are optimal among all universal, state-independent inequalities of this type. Consequently, our results strictly improve previously known bounds whenever those were suboptimal, and in cases where earlier bounds coincide with ours, our analysis establishes their optimality. In particular, we obtain optimal universal bounds for the hypothesis-testing divergence.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文揭示了经典散度平滑化背后普遍的结构原理：平滑化问题的优化器是一个截断的概率向量，与具体散度无关。基于这一结构洞察，研究推导了平滑量子散度的最优普适界限，包括任意阶量子Renyi散度和假设检验散度。这些不等式通过D_β ≤ D_α + 修正项和D_β ≥ D_α + 修正项的形式关联不同阶的散度，并证明了修正项在所有普适、与状态无关的不等式中是最优的。因此，本研究严格改进了先前次优的界限，并在先前界限与本文结果一致的情况下，确立了其最优性。
authors: Gilad Gour

articles.title: Recent Advances in Quantum Architecture Search
articles.title_zh: 量子架构搜索的最新进展
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.26289v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Variational quantum algorithms (VQAs) constitute a prominent paradigm for exploring the capabilities of near-term quantum computers. As the effectiveness of VQAs depends heavily on the design of variational quantum circuits, Quantum Architecture Search (QAS) has emerged as a critical research area to automate the discovery of high-performing circuit structures. This paper reviews key advancements in current research on QAS, including its core concepts, representative methodologies, applications, and emerging trends. The content is structured to ensure broad accessibility for a diverse audience of researchers while preserving the core principles of complex methodologies. In addition, we discuss remaining challenges and suggest potential research directions to offer perspectives on future exploration in this rapidly evolving field.
articles.abstract_zh: 变分量子算法（VQA）是探索近期量子计算机能力的重要范式，其有效性高度依赖于变分量子电路的设计。量子架构搜索（QAS）已成为自动化发现高性能电路结构的关键研究领域。本文综述了QAS研究的最新进展，包括其核心概念、代表性方法、应用和新兴趋势。文章旨在为广大研究人员提供易于理解的内容，同时保留复杂方法的关键原理，并讨论了现有挑战和潜在研究方向。
authors: Haozhen Situ, Zhimin He, Lvzhou Li

articles.title: Correlation Harvesting by Unruh--DeWitt Detectors in a Cylindrical Cavity: Entanglement, Mutual Information, and Quantum Discord
articles.title_zh: 圆柱腔中Unruh-DeWitt探测器的关联捕获：纠缠负性、互信息和量子失谐
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.28055v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study correlations between two Unruh--DeWitt detectors coupled to a massless scalar field confined inside a cylindrical cavity through entanglement negativity, mutual information and quantum discord measures. The entanglement negativity follows the free space behavior for small energy gaps and small separation, while it gets enhanced for large energy gap as the off-axis detector reach cavity boundary. The entanglement island, where negativity is nonzero, gets extended for large energy gaps as compared to free space and the detectors can get entangled for large separations when one of them is placed near cavity boundary. In contrast, quantum mutual information and quantum discord remain nonzero over a substantially broader parameter range, including regions in which the negativity has vanished. However, these correlations are suppressed inside the cavity as compared to the free space correlations. Therefore, boundary conditions can selectively reshape the structure of harvested correlations in quantum field theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究通过纠缠负性、互信息和量子失谐度量，探讨了圆柱腔内两个Unruh-DeWitt探测器与无质量标量场之间的关联。结果显示，纠缠负性在小能量间隙和小分离下遵循自由空间行为，但在大能量间隙下，当离轴探测器接近腔体边界时会增强。纠缠岛在腔内被抑制，但量子互信息和量子失谐在更宽的参数范围内保持非零。因此，边界条件能够选择性地重塑量子场论中捕获关联的结构。
authors: Shagun Kaushal, Harkirat Singh Sahota

articles.title: Dynamics of the Density Cube
articles.title_zh: 密度立方体的动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.02421v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Density cube theory extends the canonical quantum density matrix h̊oᵢⱼ with the addition of an extra index to h̊oᵢⱼₖ. The elements of the density cube with two different indices, h̊oᵢᵢⱼ and h̊oᵢⱼⱼ, correspond to the real and imaginary parts of the off-diagonal element h̊oᵢⱼ of the density matrix and describe double-path interference, while those with three different indices describe non-canonical triple-path interference. In this letter, we propose an equation of motion for the density cube, obtained from the quantization of ternary Nambu dynamics, and find that pairs of triple-path interferences oscillate into each other.
articles.abstract_zh: 密度立方体理论通过增加一个额外索引将规范量子密度矩阵ρᵢⱼ扩展为ρᵢⱼₖ。具有两个不同索引的密度立方体元素ρᵢᵢⱼ和ρᵢⱼⱼ对应于密度矩阵非对角元素ρᵢⱼ的实部和虚部，描述双路径干涉。而具有三个不同索引的元素则描述非规范的三路径干涉。本文提出了密度立方体的运动方程，该方程源自三元Nambu动力学的量子化，并发现成对的三路径干涉会相互振荡。
authors: Nabin Bhatta, Djordje Minic, Tatsu Takeuchi

articles.title: Interpreting Liouvillian Eigenmodes: Quantized Orbits in Dissipative Systems
articles.title_zh: 解释Liouvillian本征模：耗散系统中的量子化轨道
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20271v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In closed quantum dynamics, energy eigenstates represent physical excitations which, for systems with a classical limit, localize on quantized orbits in phase space. Such a picture is lacking in open systems: Liouvillians have distinct right and left eigenstates that decay with time and are difficult to interpret. We recover a physical correspondence by introducing a gauge-invariant quasiprobability measure combining right and left eigenstates that interprets a Liouvillian mode as a set of coherences, allowing one to visualize the modes as quasiprobability distributions in a ``doubled'' phase space. Using this measure we show that, remarkably, a damped oscillator retains its quantized ``orbits'' for a large class of linear and nonlinear loss, with measurable signatures. A thermal bath broadens these orbits, similar to energy levels, leading to a characteristic multistage relaxation. This provides an experimentally accessible open-system analog of the eigenstate-orbit correspondence underlying semiclassical quantization. For quadratic systems, our results yield dissipative analogs of invariant tori - a central concept in Hamiltonian systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 封闭量子系统中，能量本征态对应相空间中的量子化轨道。然而，开放系统中的Liouvillian本征态难以解释。本文引入一种规范不变的准概率度量，将Liouvillian模式解释为相干性集合，从而在“双倍”相空间中可视化这些模式。研究发现，阻尼振子在多种线性和非线性损耗下仍保留其量子化“轨道”，为半经典量子化中的本征态-轨道对应提供了开放系统模拟。
authors: Ashlin V Thomas, Felix Fritzsch, Masudul Haque, Shovan Dutta

articles.title: Identification and mitigation of errors in hole spin qubit readout
articles.title_zh: 空穴自旋量子比特读出误差的识别与缓解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.06898v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: High-fidelity readout of spin qubits in semiconductor quantum dots can be achieved by combining a radiofrequency charge sensor with spin-to-charge conversion and Pauli spin blockade. However, reaching high readout fidelities with hole spin qubits remains challenging due to site-dependent spin anisotropies and short relaxation times during readout. Here, we analyze the multiple error processes that arise during readout using a double-latched scheme in a germanium double quantum dot hole spin qubit system. We first investigate the spin-to-charge conversion process as a function of magnetic field orientation, and configure the system to adiabatically map the łvert downarrowdownarrow ångle state to the only non-blockaded state. We reveal a strong magnetic field strength dependence of the spin relaxation rates, and minimize it by operating at low fields. We further characterize and mitigate the error processes that arise during the double-latching process. By combining a radiofrequency charge sensor, a double-latching process, and optimized magnetic field parameters, we achieve a single-shot single-qubit state-preparation-and-measurement fidelity of 97.0% while maintaining control of both spins under the readout conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 半导体量子点中自旋量子比特的高保真度读出具有挑战性，特别是对于空穴自旋量子比特。本研究分析了锗双量子点空穴自旋量子比特系统中双锁存方案读出过程中产生的多种误差。通过优化磁场方向和强度，并结合射频电荷传感器和双锁存过程，作者实现了单次单量子比特态制备和测量的高保真度。该工作为提高空穴自旋量子比特的读出性能提供了重要见解。
authors: Eoin Gerard Kelly, Leonardo Massai, Bence Hetényi, Marta Pita-Vidal, Alexei Orekhov, Cornelius Carlsson, Inga Seidler, Konstantinos Tsoukalas, Lisa Sommer, Michele Aldeghi, Stephen W. Bedell, Stephan Paredes, Felix J. Schupp, Matthias Mergenthaler, Andreas Fuhrer, Gian Salis, Patrick Harvey-Collard

articles.title: Lattice Symmetry Remnants in Spatial and Temporal Entanglement of Quantum Critical Spin Chains
articles.title_zh: 量子临界自旋链空间和时间纠缠中的晶格对称性残余
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31676v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum critical lattice models carry universal information beyond the bulk data of their infrared conformal field theory (CFT): microscopic lattice symmetries constrain how the CFT is realized. We probe these remnants through the spatial and temporal entanglement of two Euclidean-evolved states from the same critical model. In the finite-length scaling regime, a conformal boundary encodes the long-distance effect of the short-range initial state, and boundary CFT (BCFT) organizes the universal low-lying entanglement spectrum. We formulate the temporal state as a uniform infinite matrix product state evolved by a symmetry-preserving infinite matrix product operator, using a local factorization regular even at arbitrarily small Trotter steps. For the Ising and three-state Potts chains, whose relevant symmetries are onsite, the spatial and temporal constructions approach the same BCFT structure; varying the initial state engineers conformal boundaries distinguishable spectroscopically. The spin-1/2 XXZ chain instead realizes a Lieb--Schultz--Mattis (LSM) constraint between internal U(1) symmetry and one-site translation. A U(1)-preserving short-range spatial state accommodates it through a doubled unit cell and inequivalent entanglement cuts, whereas the temporal state remains uniform along Euclidean time. Successive spatial transfer steps pump the temporal entanglement spectrum between translation-related Dirichlet sectors, equivalently between integer and half-integer compact-boson zero modes. Breaking U(1) removes both the zero mode and the alternation. Continued evolution at fixed bond dimension crosses over from the finite-length BCFT regime to a finite-entanglement regime generated by symmetry-allowed relevant deformations. Thus microscopic symmetry and anomaly data remain visible in universal entanglement by constraining the boundary realization of the infrared CFT.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子临界晶格模型包含超越其红外共形场论（CFT）体数据的普适信息，其中微观晶格对称性限制了CFT的实现方式。本文通过研究同一临界模型中两个欧几里得演化态的空间和时间纠缠来探测这些对称性残余。研究发现，对于具有局域对称性的Ising和三态Potts链，空间和时间构造趋近于相同的边界CFT结构。对于自旋1/2 XXZ链，则存在内部U(1)对称性和单点平移之间的Lieb-Schultz-Mattis约束。
authors: Xiao-Han Yang, Rui-Zhen Huang

articles.title: Heat current and noise in a point-like junction between normal metal and fractional quantum hall edge state with ν = 1/3
articles.title_zh: 正常金属与ν=1/3分数量子霍尔边缘态点状结中的热流和噪声
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31893v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this study, we investigate heat current correlations between two edge states coupled through a constriction in the fractional quantum Hall regime at filling factor ν = 1/3. This configuration allows us to map the system onto an interacting Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid with a local impurity, where the interaction parameter takes the value κ = 1/2. This specific parameter value enables the application of the refermionization method. By solving the refermionized Hamiltonian, we compute the heat current and evaluate the finite-frequency heat auto- and cross-correlation functions. Our results reveal asymmetric behavior with frequency, corresponding to absorption and emission noise, respectively. Furthermore, we examine several limiting cases, including low- and high-temperature limits as well as strong- and weak-backscattering regimes. In the weak backscattering regime, the Lorenz number approaches 4L₀ at high voltage, suggesting a rescaling of the Wiedemann-Franz law due to interactions. A detailed study of the heat current fluctuations has made it possible to identify and derive expressions for the dominant contribution in the various regimes of interest, and to reveal the predominance of partition noise.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了在填充因子ν=1/3的分数量子霍尔效应中，通过一个狭窄点耦合的两个边缘态之间的热流关联。通过将系统映射到具有局部杂质的相互作用Tomonaga-Luttinger液体，并应用重费米化方法，计算了热流以及有限频率的热自相关和互相关函数。结果显示频率上的不对称行为，对应于吸收和发射噪声。在弱反向散射区域，洛伦兹数在高电压下接近4L₀，表明相互作用导致了维德曼-弗朗兹定律的重新标定。
authors: Redouane Zamoum, Houssam Eddine Farhi, Abdellah Touati, Adeline Crépieux

articles.title: Zeeman Shift and Injection Currents under Light Irradiation
articles.title_zh: 光照下的塞曼位移和注入电流
