articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32136v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The conversion of light into electrical currents enables energy harvesting and photodetection. Conventional second-order dc photocurrents are driven by the electric component of light through electric-dipole coupling and require broken inversion symmetry. Here, we show that the electric and magnetic components of light jointly generate Zeeman shift and injection currents. Using quantum perturbation theory, we derive explicit microscopic expressions for their conductivity tensors. We systematically classify the symmetry constraints on these responses and show how they differ from those governing conventional photocurrents. In particular, both responses can occur in centrosymmetric systems with spin-orbit coupling or noncollinear magnetic order, irrespective of time-reversal symmetry. A centrosymmetric kagome model exhibits broadband responses. First-principles calculations for Mn₃Sn further predict Zeeman injection and shift current densities of 10²-10³~mathrmA/m² and 1-10~mathrmA/m², respectively, under illumination with an electric-field amplitude E=10⁴~V/m. These magnitudes place both currents within experimental reach.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统光电流需要反演对称性破缺，而本文展示了光的电场和磁场分量可以共同产生塞曼位移和注入电流。研究者利用量子微扰理论推导了其电导率张量的微观表达式，并系统分类了这些响应的对称性约束。结果表明，在具有自旋轨道耦合或非共线磁序的中心对称系统中，这两种响应均可发生。第一性原理计算预测，在特定光照条件下，Mn₃Sn中的塞曼注入电流和位移电流密度可达实验可及的量级。
authors: Ruizhi Dong, Yihua Xiao, Pengfei Wang, Ruixiang Fei

articles.title: Intrinsic Paramagnetism of Optical Phonons and Thermal Hall Effect in Quantum Paraelectrics
articles.title_zh: 量子顺电体中光学声子的本征顺磁性与热霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32224v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a microscopic theory of the phonon-mediated thermal Hall effect in quantum paraelectrics, driven by the intrinsic paramagnetism due to quantum fluctuations of the (nearly) critical optical phonon modes. The effective magnetization due to temporal fluctuations of the assosciated dipoles couple to an external magnetic field resulting the magnetoelectric term H ḑot (P × dotP) in the effective Lagrangian density of the polarisation field P. This coupling splits the transverse optical phonon spectrum into right- and left-circularly polarized chiral branches. Using the chiral phonon Green's functions and the Kubo formalism, we derive the thermal Hall conductivity κₓy from the heat-current correlation function. We observe that κₓy is proportional to the difference in spectral weights of the two chiral modes, κₓy propto A₊² - A₋², establishing a direct microscopic link between phonon chirality and transverse heat transport. Our theory predicts three key observations: (i) a linear-in-magnetic-field response κₓy propto H at low fields, evolving into nonlinear behavior at higher fields (ii) a non-monotonic temperature dependence of κₓy with a peak arising from the competition between thermal population and phonon scattering and (iii) strong enhancement of κₓy near the quantum critical point ømega₀ → 0, it exhibits power-law scaling κₓy propto Tα with α approx 0.41. Our findings provide an understanding of thermal Hall transport in quantum paraelectrics due to intrinsic paramagnetism and is aligned with the observed behaviour in SrTiO₃ and related materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了量子顺电体中声子介导的热霍尔效应的微观理论，该效应由临界光学声子模式的量子涨落引起的本征顺磁性驱动。这种耦合将横向光学声子谱分裂为左右圆偏振手性分支。利用手性声子格林函数和Kubo形式，作者从热流关联函数推导了热霍尔电导率κₓy，并发现其与两种手性模式的谱权重差成正比。该理论预测了低场下κₓy与磁场呈线性关系、高温下非单调温度依赖性等关键现象。
authors: Harsh Jain, Manideep Gone, Nabyendu Das

articles.title: Flexo-Photoresponses from First Principles
articles.title_zh: 基于第一性原理的挠曲光响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32341v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many functionally important materials, such as silicon, possess high-symmetry crystal structures that forbid even-order nonlinear optical responses, thereby limiting their application in e.g., photonics and optoelectronics. Strain gradients can effectively break symmetries, activating otherwise forbidden optical responses. Although such flexo-photoresponses have attracted considerable interest recently, a comprehensive microscopic theoretical framework is still lacking. Here, we develop a first-principles approach that can systematically evaluate a wide range of flexo-photoresponses in realistic materials. By mapping strain gradients to long-wavelength phonons within the established theory of electron-phonon coupling, our approach captures the nonlocal quantum-mechanical effects of lattice deformations on nonlinear optical responses. Applying the framework to prototypical centrosymmetric materials, including Si, cubic m̊ SrTiO₃, and monolayer black phosphorus, we demonstrate that a strain gradients of 10⁵sim10⁶~m̊ m⁻¹ can induce flexo-second-harmonic generation and flexo-bulk photovoltaic effects comparable to the intrinsic responses of non-centrosymmetric crystals. Our work establishes a rigorous foundation for strain gradient engineering of light-matter interactions, opening new avenues for nanoscale optomechanics, optoelectronics, and beyond.
articles.abstract_zh: 许多高对称性材料的偶数阶非线性光学响应被禁止，限制了其应用。应变梯度可以有效打破对称性，激活这些被禁止的光学响应。本文开发了一种第一性原理方法，可以系统评估真实材料中广泛的挠曲光响应。通过将应变梯度映射到长波长声子，该方法捕获了晶格形变对非线性光学响应的非局域量子力学效应。研究表明，在中心对称材料中，特定应变梯度可以诱导与本征响应相当的挠曲二次谐波产生和挠曲体光伏效应。
authors: Zhichao Guo, Hua Wang, Haowei Xu

articles.title: Low-Temperature Hybrid Monte Carlo for Perylene and Corannulene: Stabilizing Determinant and Force
articles.title_zh: 苝和碗烯的低温混合蒙特卡罗模拟：稳定行列式和力计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32378v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate a real world physics study of the molecules perylene and corannulene at different doping levels, and calculating selected one-, two- (exciton) and three-body (trion) correlators. This has been done by performing Hubbard-model simulations near room temperature. We find, between charge neutral and doubly charged plateaus of perylene, an interaction-induced Δ Q = 1 plateau whose width grows with interaction strength and in which the ground state is a spin doublet rather than a singlet. The algorithmic advancement enabling this study simultaneously stabilizes the determinant and force calculations to machine precision at room temperature, while scaling as well as standard determinant Quantum Monte Carlo simulations of these systems. Furthermore, our formalism retains the full time-displaced (2-point) Green's function, allowing us to construct any n-body correlator, including those that contain disconnected diagrams.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对苝和碗烯分子在不同掺杂水平下进行了哈伯德模型模拟，并计算了选定的一体、两体（激子）和三体（三重子）关联函数。研究发现，在苝的电荷中性与双电荷平台之间存在一个相互作用诱导的ΔQ=1平台，其基态为自旋双重态。该研究的算法进步在于同时稳定了行列式和力计算，达到了室温下的机器精度，并且其扩展性与标准行列式量子蒙特卡罗模拟相当。
authors: Petar Sinilkov, Thomas Luu, Johann Ostmeyer, Finn L. Temmen, Marcel Rodekamp

articles.title: Electron Wavefronts Capture Nanoscale Movies of Hypersound at Surfaces
articles.title_zh: 电子波前捕捉表面超声的纳米级动态影像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32419v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Acoustic waves transport mechanical energy and elastic strain through solids, with material composition and shape governing their propagation. In the gigahertz hypersound regime, acoustic wavelengths reach tens to hundreds of nanometres, comparable to nanoscale device dimensions. Harnessing these waves underpins high-frequency signal processing, sensing, electromagnetic coupling and quantum control. Acoustic metrology probes elastic modes and internal interfaces. Yet directly imaging how nanoscale acoustic waves interact with local structure remains challenging, requiring picometre displacement sensitivity combined with high spatiotemporal resolution. Here we demonstrate full-field imaging of laser-induced hypersound at surfaces using reflected electron wavefronts. We introduce ultrafast low-energy electron microscopy (ULEEM), exploiting the intrinsic surface sensitivity of few-electronvolt electrons. Coherent electron pulses down to femtosecond durations reflect from the topmost atomic layers, imprinting the evolving surface profile onto their wavefronts. Defocus converts phase variations into image contrast. In a thin van der Waals material, we image the thermoelastic generation and propagation of picometre-amplitude acoustic waves. Measured dispersion relations, interpreted through elastodynamic modelling, distinguish substrate-supported and locally detached regions, revealing how interfacial contact shapes propagation. Delayed wave emission reveals scattering at buried mechanical defects. Our results establish electron-wavefront imaging of nanoscale surface dynamics, enabling the exploration of ultrafast energy transport, structural transformations and coupled mechanical, electronic and magnetic phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 纳米级声波与局部结构的相互作用成像极具挑战性。本文展示了一种利用反射电子波前对表面激光诱导超声进行全场成像的方法。研究者引入了超快低能电子显微镜（ULEEM），利用低能电子固有的表面敏感性。相干飞秒电子脉冲从最顶层原子反射，将演变的表面轮廓印刻到其波前上，通过散焦将相位变化转换为图像对比度。
authors: Johannes Otto, Leon Brauns, Benjamin Schroeder, Claus Ropers

articles.title: Electronic structure of a persistent excitonic fluid far beyond the Mott limit
articles.title_zh: 远超莫特极限的持久激子流体电子结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32437v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Excitons are conventionally expected to destabilize at high photoexcitation densities, as screening weakens the electron-hole attraction. Recent studies, however, challenge this paradigm, suggesting that excitons generated by strong optical pumping can remain stable even beyond the onset of population inversion. Here, using time- and angle-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy on 2D hybrid perovskites, we provide direct evidence for such a high-density excitonic state, characterized by a distinctive Mexican-hat dispersion. Remarkably, this excitonic band reconstruction endures for orders of magnitude longer than the optical coherence time, revealing a population-sustained electronic structure that survives well into the incoherent regime. The excitonic resonance also persists far beyond optical saturation, at densities where exciton wavefunctions strongly overlap. Our findings reveal a long-lived, high-density quantum fluid of excitons with characteristics reminiscent of a BCS condensate, an electronic structure markedly different from that of the dilute limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 激子通常在高光激发密度下会因屏蔽效应而失稳。然而，本文通过对二维杂化钙钛矿进行时间分辨和角度分辨光电子能谱研究，直接证实了一种高密度激子态的存在，其具有独特的墨西哥帽形色散。这种激子能带重构的持续时间远超光学相干时间，揭示了一种在非相干区域仍能维持的电子结构。该发现揭示了一种长寿命、高密度激子量子流体，其特征类似于BCS凝聚体。
authors: Weiyan Qi, Stefano Ponzoni, Ashim Pramanik, Vitaly Gorelov, Yannis Laplace, Gianluca Stefanucci, Enrico Perfetto, Esteban Morcos, Marino Marsi, Steven Francis Udaundo, Sebastian Maherlein, Amina Taleb-Ibrahimi, Kaibo Zheng, Tonu Pullerits, Luca Perfetti

articles.title: Spontaneous Decay of High Energy Composite Fermions
articles.title_zh: 高能复合费米子的自发衰变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32763v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An electron, when added to a fractional quantum Hall fluid, famously splits into fractionally charged composite-fermion quasiparticles. We show here that a high energy composite fermion carrying a fractional charge decays into a collection of particles, including quasiparticles, quasiholes, and even whole electrons.
articles.abstract_zh: 当一个电子被添加到分数量子霍尔流体中时，它会分裂成带分数电荷的复合费米子准粒子。本文研究表明，一个携带分数电荷的高能复合费米子会衰变为一系列粒子，包括准粒子、准空穴，甚至完整的电子。这一发现揭示了高能复合费米子在分数量子霍尔体系中的新衰变机制。
authors: Mytraya Gattu, J. K. Jain

articles.title: Non-singlets and the phase diagram of Matrix Quantum Mechanics
articles.title_zh: 矩阵量子力学中的非单态与相图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32856v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The quantum mechanics of one N× N Hermitian matrix in the infinite N limit is well known to define a two-dimensional string theory when the quartic coupling constant g is tuned to a special negative value g_*. We study the thermodynamics of this Matrix Quantum Mechanics (MQM), treating the SU(N) symmetry as a global symmetry. Crucially, the non-singlets, i.e. states in non-trivial representations of SU(N), implement the effects of vortices on the discretized worldsheets. This random lattice model has the low-temperature c=1 and high-temperature c=0 phases, with the Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) transition separating them. We map out the phase diagram in the coupling--temperature plane, which is separated by the critical stability curve T_c(g) extending from g_*< g <0. We study this curve using the non-perturbative matrix bootstrap and low- and high-temperature perturbation theory, which explain the thermal instability. At low temperatures, thermally excited non-singlets backreact on the Fermi sea of matrix eigenvalues, causing it to spill over. At high temperatures, the theory is described by an effective matrix integral obtained by dimensional reduction on the thermal circle; the eigenvalue distribution of the zero mode becomes unstable at the critical coupling. We conjecture that the BKT transition occurs at a special point on the critical curve and estimate its position. Finally, we switch to the regular square lattice and study the MQM-inspired Villain model, where the link factor is the one-dimensional propagator on a circle. Using Monte Carlo simulations, we map out the BKT transition in this model.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了无限N极限下N×N厄米矩阵量子力学（MQM）的热力学，其中SU(N)对称性被视为全局对称性。非单态（SU(N)非平凡表示中的态）实现了离散世界面上的涡旋效应。该随机格点模型具有低温c=1相和高温c=0相，由Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) 相变分隔。研究者绘制了耦合-温度平面上的相图，并利用非微扰矩阵自举和低高温微扰理论研究了临界稳定性曲线，解释了热不稳定性。
authors: Igor R. Klebanov, Henry W. Lin, Pavel Meshcheriakov, Jessica Yeh

articles.title: Kagome goldene with flat bands and Dirac nodal line fermions via line-graph epitaxy
articles.title_zh: 通过线图外延制备具有平带和狄拉克节点线费米子的Kagome金烯
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.07945v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The kagome lattice has emerged as a promising platform for investigating exotic quantum phases. However, achieving a single-atomic-layer kagome lattice in elemental materials remains a significant challenge. Here, we introduce line-graph epitaxy, a novel approach that enables the atomic-scale synthesis of goldene, a monolayer of elemental gold atoms arranged in a kagome lattice. Through scanning tunneling microscopy/spectroscopy (STM/STS), and density functional theory (DFT) calculations, we demonstrate the formation of kagome goldene, featuring a flat band with a van Hove singularity approximately 1.1 eV below the Fermi level, signaling strong electron correlation effects. Notably, the flat band is disrupted at the zigzag edges of goldene nanoflakes, revealing substantial edge effects. Furthermore, our calculations show that weak interlayer interactions between goldene and the underlying Au2Ge substrate generate dual Dirac nodal lines through a proximity effect. These findings offer not only a novel strategy for constructing elemental kagome lattices, but also a generalizable framework for fabricating and controlling line-graph materials. This research advances the exploration of quantum phases driven by strong correlations and the design of materials for next-generation quantum technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: Kagome晶格是研究奇异量子相的有前景平台，但制备单原子层Kagome晶格仍具挑战。本文引入线图外延法，成功原子级合成了Kagome金烯。通过STM/STS和DFT计算，证实了Kagome金烯的形成，其具有一个位于费米能级以下约1.1 eV的平带和范霍夫奇点，表明强电子关联效应。此外，金烯与Au2Ge衬底的弱层间相互作用通过邻近效应产生了双狄拉克节点线。
authors: Qiwei Tian, Sahar Izadi Vishkayi, Chen Zhang, Jiang Zeng, Bo Li, Li Zhang, Long-Jing Yin, Yuan Tian, Meysam Bagheri Tagani, Lijie Zhang, Zhihui Qin

articles.title: Tuning the magnetic properties of Kitaev materials via the antiferromagnetic proximity effect: Novel phases and application to an α-RuCl₃/MnPS₃ bilayer
articles.title_zh: 通过反铁磁邻近效应调控Kitaev材料的磁性：新奇相及在α-RuCl₃/MnPS₃双层结构中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.22310v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In recent years, the increasing level of control over van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures has opened new routes to tune the properties of quantum materials. Motivated by these developments, we examine the potential consequences of interfacing a Kitaev honeycomb magnet, such as α-RuCl₃, with a nearly lattice-matched vdW antiferromagnet. By combining perturbation theory, exact diagonalization, and a classical energy-minimization method, we show that an effective staggered magnetic field originating from the vdW antiferromagnet can drive a monolayer of a Kitaev material into various novel phases, including an antichiral Kitaev spin liquid, a nonmagnetic nematic phase, and different types of skyrmion crystals. We then apply first-principles simulations to assess the prospect of concretely realizing this setup in a heterobilayer of α-RuCl₃ and the easy-axis antiferromagnet MnPS₃.
articles.abstract_zh: 范德华异质结构为调控量子材料性质提供了新途径。本文研究了Kitaev蜂窝磁体（如α-RuCl₃）与范德华反铁磁体界面化的潜在影响。研究表明，源自范德华反铁磁体的有效交错磁场可将Kitaev材料单层驱动至多种新奇相，包括反手性Kitaev自旋液体、非磁性向列相和不同类型的斯格明子晶体。该工作还通过第一性原理模拟评估了在α-RuCl₃/MnPS₃异质双层结构中实现此设置的可能性。
authors: Pedro M. Cônsoli, Ezra Day-Roberts, Johannes Knolle, Antia S. Botana, Onur Erten

articles.title: Polyhedral RIS Architecture with Quantum-Assisted Facet Selection for Uniform Coverage
articles.title_zh: 具有量子辅助面选择的多面体RIS架构实现均匀覆盖
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.32898v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RISs) direct coverage toward moving user equipment (UE), but practical deployments involve discrete phase control, uncertain facet positions, and UE mobility, which require the problem to be re-solved continually. We consider these challenges for the chamfered hexagonal polyhedral RIS, which provides nearly uniform coverage. With both incidence and departure angles, we bound in closed form the gain loss of its best facet relative to the best possible reflecting facet, include the known b-bit quantization loss, and extend the bound to joint random mounting errors of all facets. For a precoded multi-user downlink, each facet-selection subproblem of the max-min rate design is shown to be an exact quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) problem, suited to repeated time-constrained solving. The deployment of the base station in relation to the RIS allows the polyhedral surface to bring down the percentage of dead zones in vertical planar panels from 77% to 0.3% and increase the minimum rate by 34% relative to the STAR panel. The simulated annealing algorithm finds the optimum solution in 95% of the cases. The quantum approximation algorithm fails to do so.
articles.abstract_zh: 可重构智能表面（RIS）旨在为移动用户设备提供覆盖，但实际部署面临离散相位控制、不确定面位置和用户移动性等挑战。本文针对提供近乎均匀覆盖的倒角六边形多面体RIS，考虑了这些挑战。研究推导了最佳面相对于理想反射面的增益损失界限，并将其扩展到所有面的联合随机安装误差。对于预编码多用户下行链路，面选择子问题被证明是一个精确的二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）问题，适用于重复的时间受限求解。
authors: Noha Hassan, Halim Yanikomeroglu

By introducing an effective Hamiltonian depending on the quasiparticle momentum induced by the current, we show that the tw… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 204509] Published Mon Oct 26, 2026

articles.title: Failure of the mean-field Hartree approximation for a bosonic many-body system with non-Hermitian Hamiltonian
articles.title_zh: 非厄米哈密顿量玻色子多体系统平均场哈特里近似的失效
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2244 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-22-2244 Mean-field Hartree theory is a central tool for reducing many-body dynamics to an effective one-particle evolution. This approximation has been employed when the Hamiltonian governing the many-body dynamics is not Hermitian. Indeed, non-Hermitian Hamiltonians model particle gain/loss or the evolution of open quantum systems between consecutive quantum jumps. Furthermore, the validity of the Hartree approximation for generic non-Hermitian Hamiltonians lies at the basis of a quantum algorithm for nonlinear differential equations. In this work, we show that this approximation can fail. First, we consider the most general bosonic mean-field Hamiltonian with two-body interactions and we prove that, for non-Hermitian Hamiltonian, the Hartree equation does not capture the correct second time derivative of the one-particle marginal state at t=0 in the thermodynamic limit. Then, we analytically solve a model of N bosonic qubits with a purely anti-Hermitian Hamiltonian, compute the limit for N→infty of the one-particle marginal state and show that it does not agree with the solution of the non-Hermitian Hartree equation. We further show that there exists an initial condition such that the exact one-particle marginal state undergoes a finite-time transition to a mixed state, a phenomenon that is completely absent in the case of Hermitian Hamiltonians. Finally, we simulate a non-Hermitian Hamiltonian with real spectrum and show that, also in this case, there are initial conditions for which the Hartree equation does not reproduce the correct one-particle marginal state in the limit N→infty. Our findings challenge the validity of the mean-field Hartree approximation for non-Hermitian Hamiltonians, and call for additional conditions for the validity of the mean-field regime to model the dynamics of particle gain and loss and the open-system dynamics in bosonic many-body systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 平均场哈特里理论是简化多体动力学为有效单粒子演化的核心工具，常用于非厄米哈密顿量系统。本研究证明了该近似在非厄米哈密顿量下可能失效。作者首先证明了在热力学极限下，哈特里方程无法准确捕捉单粒子边际态在t=0时的二阶时间导数。随后，通过解析求解一个具有纯反厄米哈密顿量的N个玻色子量子比特模型，进一步证实了其结果与非厄米哈特里方程的解不一致。
authors: Matias Ginzburg, Simone Rademacher, and Giacomo De Palma

articles.title: A Symmetry-Enabled Direct Quantum Protocol for Many-Body Green’s Functions
articles.title_zh: 对称性增强的多体格林函数直接量子协议
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2245 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-22-2245 We present a symmetry-enabled direct quantum protocol for computing many-body Green's functions, a central tool for studying strongly correlated quantum systems. Our protocol relies only on native time evolution and straightforward measurements available on current hardware platforms. By exploiting parity symmetry—satisfied by a broad class of Hamiltonians in condensed matter physics and quantum chemistry, including the Fermi–Hubbard and Heisenberg models—we introduce a tailored quench spectroscopy scheme that recovers both the real and imaginary parts of two-point time correlators, from which Green's functions can be reconstructed via efficient classical signal processing. We further develop a tailored symmetric quantum Gibbs sampler that prepares parity-resolved (symmetric and antisymmetric) thermal states, enabling finite-temperature extensions within the same framework. Finally, we show that the same symmetry-based measurement primitive extends naturally to out-of-time-ordered correlators (OTOCs). Our results provide a practical route to estimating symmetry-resolved dynamical correlators on near-term and early fault-tolerant quantum hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出了一种利用对称性计算多体格林函数的直接量子协议，该协议仅依赖于现有硬件上的原生时间演化和简单测量。通过利用宇称对称性，研究人员引入了一种定制的淬火光谱方案，可恢复两点时间关联函数的实部和虚部。此外，该工作还开发了一种对称量子吉布斯采样器，以实现有限温度下的扩展，并表明该对称性测量原语可自然扩展到时间反序关联函数。

articles.title: Scalable Neural Wave Functions via Information Mixing and Hierarchical Network Architectures
articles.title_zh: 基于信息混合与分层网络架构的可扩展神经波函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30257v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Numerically simulating quantum many-body systems is one of the central challenges in modern physics, as the exponential growth of the Hilbert space with system size renders large-scale exact solutions intractable. Over the past decade, generative artificial neural networks have emerged as powerful wave function ansätze that have powered advances in finding ground state representations, reconstructing quantum states from data, and modeling dynamics in quantum many-body systems. While recurrent neural networks (RNNs) are computationally efficient, the recurrent nature can limit their capacity to capture long-range correlations. Transformer models with their underlying self-attention mechanism excel at capturing these long-range correlations, but incur increased computational requirements, restricting applications to small physical systems. In this work, we address these limitations by exploring the multi-layer perceptron (MLP) mixer model as a wave function ansatz. By mixing information globally and locally through the system via a computationally lightweight mixing strategy, this architecture promises to combine the ability to capture long-range correlations with low computational costs. We benchmark the model on finding ground state representations of two-dimensional quantum many-body systems in various phases of matter and investigate the behavior of representational accuracy and computational efficiency for different physical system sizes. By comparing its performance to RNNs and transformer models with single-site and patched input definitions, we demonstrate that the MLP mixer architecture performs competitively with state-of-the-art network models. We further show that a hierarchical combination of this model with the transformer model outperforms other state-of-the-art architectures for large-scale quantum systems, opening new avenues for investigating quantum phases of matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 模拟量子多体系统面临希尔伯特空间指数增长的挑战。该工作探索了多层感知机（MLP）混合器模型作为一种波函数拟设，旨在克服循环神经网络（RNNs）在捕获长程关联方面的局限性以及Transformer模型的高计算成本。通过计算轻量级的信息混合策略，该架构有望结合捕获长程关联的能力，为大规模量子多体系统模拟提供可扩展的解决方案。

articles.title: Transversal syndrome extraction: A unifying construction for measuring the error syndromes of any stabilizer code
articles.title_zh: 横向纠错子提取：一种用于测量任意稳定子码错误纠错子的统一构造
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30279v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fault-tolerant syndrome extraction is fundamental to stabilizer-code-based quantum error correction, yet existing general protocols incur substantial costs in either circuit depth or width. In this work, we design ancilla stabilizer states for a general transversal circuit to construct a family of fault-tolerant syndrome-extraction gadgets that interpolate between Shor and Steane syndrome extraction for any stabilizer code. The result is a configurable trade-off between circuit depth and width.
articles.abstract_zh: 容错纠错子提取是基于稳定子码的量子纠错的基础，但现有通用协议在电路深度或宽度上成本高昂。该工作为通用横向电路设计了辅助稳定子态，构建了一系列容错纠错子提取装置。这些装置可以在Shor和Steane纠错子提取之间进行插值，适用于任何稳定子码，从而实现了电路深度和宽度之间的可配置权衡。

articles.title: FVQKD: A Formal Verification of Quantum Key Distribution Security in Rocq
articles.title_zh: FVQKD：Rocq中量子密钥分发安全性的形式化验证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30645v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum key distribution (QKD), whose security is derived from quantum mechanics rather than computational assumptions, is moving into standardization and commercial deployment. Yet its security guarantees rest on technically delicate proofs checked by hand. Formal verification closes this gap, establishing a two-factor assurance: unconditional security from physical principles, and machine-checked proofs against reasoning errors. We present FVQKD, a Rocq library for machine-checking QKD security proofs. Its first result is a complete, end-to-end machine-checked proof of composable, finite-key security for BB84. The mechanization reconstructs the complete proof infrastructure from first principles, including the smooth entropy framework, the entropic uncertainty relation, and the Quantum Leftover Hash Lemma. It uncovers necessary side conditions that the published argument leaves unstated, one of which reveals a missing proof branch, and it grounds the information-theoretic bound in a formal semantics of protocol execution, which the pen-and-paper analysis lacks. The proof is entirely admit-free, relying only on the Rocq kernel and standard foundational axioms. To our knowledge, this is the first end-to-end formal verification of a QKD security proof. Built on MathComp, MathComp-Analysis, and CoqQ, the development provides quantum-information infrastructure designed for reuse across broader QKD variants and quantum cryptography applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子密钥分发（QKD）的安全性依赖于量子力学原理，但其证明过程复杂且易出错。该工作提出了FVQKD，一个用于机器验证QKD安全证明的Rocq库。它首次实现了BB84协议可组合、有限密钥安全性的完整端到端机器验证证明。该机械化证明从第一性原理重建了完整的证明基础设施，并揭示了现有手写证明中未说明的必要条件和缺失的证明分支，为协议执行的信息论界限提供了形式化语义基础。
authors: Ruixuan Deng, Zhengfeng Ji, Jiayu Zhang, Li Zhou

articles.title: Time-reversal-based quantum metrology in a central-spin architecture: from SATIN to butterfly echo
articles.title_zh: 中心自旋架构中基于时间反演的量子计量学：从SATIN到蝴蝶回波
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30686v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate quantum-enhanced time-reversal-based metrology using the central spin model, in which a single ancilla spin of magnitude Sₘ̊ cₑₙ mediates interactions between N bath spins through a star-graph topology. We demonstrate that the SATIN (Signal Amplification Through Time-reversal Interaction) echo protocol can be implemented in this setup to achieve a Fisher information of N²/e with the collective łangle J_yångle readout, corresponding to a 4.34,dB offset from the Heisenberg limit. Furthermore, we establish that this platform provides a pathway to perform the butterfly echo protocol by conjugating each evolution step with a random collective bath rotation, thereby achieving axis-agnostic Heisenberg-scaled sensing. Crucially, with a small N-independent number of random steps, the butterfly echo reaches a Fisher information of N²/4 (6,dB below the Heisenberg limit) for any unknown encoding axis, with the plateau gain tracking the Haar limit. Finally, we demonstrate that the central-spin magnitude Sₘ̊ cₑₙ provides a powerful knob to reduce the optimal protocol timescale without altering the metrological ceiling or the circuit depth required to reach isotropy. The proposed scheme is relevant to cavity QED and NMR quantum processors, where the central spin architecture arises naturally.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用中心自旋模型，探索了量子增强的时间反演计量学。研究表明，SATIN回波协议可在该设置中实现，达到接近海森堡极限的费舍尔信息。此外，该平台还可实现蝴蝶回波协议，通过随机集体浴旋转共轭每个演化步骤，实现轴无关的海森堡尺度传感。中心自旋的大小提供了一个有效旋钮，可在不改变计量上限或电路复杂性的情况下缩短最佳协议时间尺度。

articles.title: A simple proof of unitary parallelization via port-based teleportation
articles.title_zh: 基于端口的隐形传态实现酉并行化的简单证明
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30761v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Port-based teleportation (PBT) is a variant of quantum teleportation that does not require corrections on the teleported state: starting with N shared EPR states, Alice can teleport a qudit to Bob by performing a measurement on her system and informing Bob which of his N `ports' to retrieve the state, up to infidelity decaying with N. Existing quantum circuits of PBT rely on representation theory tools and the mixed Schur transform. In this note, we report an elementary efficient circuit for PBT, which has depth øperatornamepolylog(N,d). As a corollary, this gives a simple proof that all n-qubit unitaries can be parallelized to øperatornamepoly(n) depth, recovering a recent result due to Nehoran--Slote--Yuen and OpenAI.
articles.abstract_zh: 端口隐形传态（PBT）是一种无需对隐形传态态进行校正的量子隐形传态变体。该文提出了一种基本且高效的PBT电路，其深度为多对数(N,d)。作为一个推论，这提供了一个简单的证明，表明所有n量子比特酉算符都可以并行化到多项式(n)深度，从而重现了最近的研究成果。
