articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了一种基于囚禁离子链中工程光梯度的高保真度双量子比特纠缠门。该技术通过精确控制光场梯度，实现了对离子的有效纠缠。这项工作为构建更强大的量子计算和量子信息处理系统提供了新的途径。
authors: Tommaso Faorlin, Lorenz Panzl, Phoebe Grosser, Pablo Viñas, Alan Kahan, Walter Joseph Hörmann, Yannick Weiser, Giovanni Cerchiari, Thomas Feldker, Alexander Erhard, Georg Jacob, Juris Ulmanis, Rainer Blatt, Alejandro Bermudez, and Thomas Monz

articles.title: Variational Perturbation Theory in Open Quantum Systems for Efficient Steady State Computation
articles.title_zh: 开放量子系统中用于高效稳态计算的变分微扰理论
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2246 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-22-2246 Determining the steady state of an open quantum system is crucial for characterizing quantum devices and studying various physical phenomena. Often, computing a single steady state is insufficient, and it is necessary to explore its dependence on multiple external parameters. In such cases, calculating the steady state independently for each combination of parameters quickly becomes intractable. Perturbation theory (PT) can mitigate this challenge by expanding steady states around reference parameters, minimizing redundant computations across neighboring parameter values. However, PT has two significant limitations: it relies on the pseudo-inverse – a numerically costly operation – and has a limited radius of convergence. In this work, we remove both of these roadblocks. First, we introduce a variational perturbation theory (VPT) and its multipoint generalization that significantly extends the radius of convergence even in the presence of non-analytic effects such as dissipative phase transitions. Then, we develop two numerical strategies that eliminate the need to compute pseudo-inverses. The first relies on a single LU decomposition to efficiently construct the steady state within the convergence region, while the second reformulates VPT as a Krylov space recycling problem and uses preconditioned iterative methods. We benchmark these approaches across various models, demonstrating their broad applicability and significant improvements over standard PT.
articles.abstract_zh: 确定开放量子系统的稳态对于表征量子器件和研究物理现象至关重要，但传统微扰理论（PT）存在伪逆计算成本高和收敛半径有限的问题。本工作引入了一种变分微扰理论（VPT）及其多点推广，显著扩展了收敛半径，即使在耗散相变等非解析效应存在时也有效。此外，研究还开发了两种数值策略，消除了计算伪逆的需要，从而提高了稳态计算的效率。
authors: André Melo, Gaspard Beugnot, and Fabrizio Minganti

articles.title: Symmetry defects and gauging for quantum states with matrix product unitary symmetries
articles.title_zh: 具有矩阵乘积幺正对称性的量子态的对称缺陷与规范化
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2243 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-22-2243 In this work, we examine the consequences of the existence of a finite group of matrix product unitary (MPU) symmetries for matrix product states (MPS). We generalize the well-understood picture of onsite unitary symmetries, which give rise to virtual symmetry defects given by insertions of operators in the bonds of the MPS. In the MPU case, we can define analogous defect tensors, this time sitting on lattice sites, that can be created, moved, and fused by local unitary operators. We leverage this formalism to study the gauging of MPU symmetries. We introduce a condition, block independence, under which we can gauge the symmetries by promoting the symmetry defects to gauge degrees of freedom, yielding an MPS of the same bond dimension that supports a local version of the symmetry given by commuting gauge constraints. Whenever block independence does not hold (which happens, in particular, whenever the symmetry representation is anomalous), a modification of our method which we call state-level gauging still gives rise to a locally symmetric MPS by promotion of the symmetry defects, at the expense of producing gauge constraints that do not commute on different sites.
articles.abstract_zh: 本工作研究了矩阵乘积态（MPS）中有限矩阵乘积幺正（MPU）对称群存在的影响。研究推广了局域幺正对称性的概念，引入了位于晶格格点上的缺陷张量，并利用此形式研究了MPU对称性的规范化。通过引入“块独立性”条件，可以将对称缺陷提升为规范自由度，从而实现对称性的规范化，得到具有局部对称性的MPS。即使在块独立性不成立的情况下，一种称为“态级规范化”的修改方法也能产生局部对称的MPS。
authors: Adrián Franco-Rubio, Arkadiusz Bochniak, and J. Ignacio Cirac

articles.title: The three kinds of three-qubit entanglement
articles.title_zh: 三量子比特纠缠的三种类型
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2242 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-22-2242 We construct an important missing piece in the entanglement theory of pure three-qubit states, which is a polynomial measure of W-entanglement. This works in parallel to the three-tangle, which is a polynomial measure of GHZ-entanglement, and to the bipartite concurrence, which is a polynomial measure of bipartite entanglement. We also show that these entanglement measures are ordered, the bipartite measure is larger than the W measure, which is larger than the GHZ measure. It is meaningful then to consider these three types of three-qubit entanglement, which are also ordered, bipartite is weaker than W, which is weaker than GHZ, in parallel to the order of the three kinds of equivalence classes of entangled three-qubit states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了纯三量子比特态纠缠理论中缺失的重要部分，即W型纠缠的多项式度量，与GHZ型纠缠的三缠结和双体纠缠的双体并发度量并行。研究表明这些纠缠度量存在序关系：双体度量大于W度量，W度量大于GHZ度量。这使得考虑这三种类型的三量子比特纠缠变得有意义，它们也具有序关系：双体纠缠弱于W型纠缠，W型纠缠弱于GHZ型纠缠，这与三类纠缠三量子比特态的等价类顺序相对应。
authors: Szilárd Szalay

articles.title: Time crystals on quantum devices
articles.title_zh: 量子器件上的时间晶体
articles.abstract: Time crystals (TCs) are nonequilibrium phases of matter characterized by the emergence of temporal ordering, in which an interacting many-body system develops robust structure in its time evolution that is not trivially dictated by the external driving or environment. While related phenomena have long been studied in classical nonlinear systems, their realization in entangled quantum matter represents a distinct frontier. The theoretical understanding of discrete TCs has substantially advanced, yet recent experiments using modern quantum devices and quantum processors reveal regimes beyond established paradigms. These developments call for an extended classification of time-crystalline phases according to both their stabilization mechanisms and their physical character, including discrete and continuous, closed and open, critical, topological, quasiperiodic, and controlled realizations. We review recent implementations of TCs on quantum platforms and propose such a classification framework, identifying promising directions for the discovery of novel time-crystalline phases of matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 时间晶体（TCs）是一种非平衡物相，其特征是时间序的出现，即相互作用的多体系统在时间演化中形成稳健结构。尽管离散时间晶体的理论理解已取得显著进展，但现代量子器件的实验揭示了超出既定范式的区域。本文综述了时间晶体在量子平台上的最新实现，并提出了一个扩展的分类框架，根据其稳定机制和物理特性（包括离散、连续、封闭、开放、临界、拓扑、准周期和受控实现）对时间晶体相进行分类，并指出了发现新型时间晶体相的有前景方向。
authors: Gonzalo Camacho and Benedikt Fauseweh

articles.title: Entanglement dynamics in a two-transmon qubit system under continuous measurement and postselection
articles.title_zh: 连续测量和后选择下双Transmon量子比特系统的纠缠动力学
articles.abstract: We investigate the role of continuous measurement and postselection in the dynamics and entanglement of a transmon–cavity–transmon coupled system. In the dispersive regime, characterized by a large detuning between the transmons and the cavity, the two transmons interact via virtual excitation of the cavity, giving rise to an effective transmon–transmon coupling. In addition to this coherent interaction, each transmon undergoes spontaneous emission, which is continuously monitored through independent detection channels. By incorporating realistic detector inefficiencies, we analyze both efficient and imperfect monitoring scenarios and demonstrate that postselection significantly slows down the decay of entanglement compared to the unmonitored case. We formulate the stochastic master equation for the coupled system, derive the corresponding postselected master equation, and investigate the dynamics through the Liouvillian superoperator spectrum. In the interaction frame, we identify the emergence of an exceptional point and characterize the associated broken and unbroken -symmetric phases. We show how these phases influence the system dynamics and the corresponding entanglement behavior. Our results provide insight into how continuous measurement and postselection affect entanglement in dissipative quantum systems, with potential applications in quantum information processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了连续测量和后选择在Transmon-腔-Transmon耦合系统动力学和纠缠中的作用。在色散机制下，两个Transmon通过腔的虚激发相互作用，并伴随自发辐射的连续监测。研究表明，与未监测情况相比，后选择显著减缓了纠缠的衰减。通过随机主方程和后选择主方程，分析了系统的动力学，并识别了相互作用框架中出现的奇异点及其相关的对称破缺和未破缺相，揭示了这些相如何影响系统动力学和纠缠行为。
authors: Roson Nongthombam and Amarendra K Sarma

articles.title: Calculating strongly correlated ground states from the non-Markovian dissipative dynamics of Gaussian fermions
articles.title_zh: 从高斯费米子的非马尔可夫耗散动力学计算强关联基态
articles.abstract: We introduce a mapping between the ground state of interacting fermionic Hamiltonians and the non-equilibrium steady state of a purely dissipative open quantum system. Within the framework of third quantization, we map the Fermi–Hubbard Hamiltonian onto Lindblad jump operators acting on Majorana fermions. Remarkably, both hopping and interaction terms map onto jump operators that preserve the Gaussianity of Majorana fermions along individual quantum trajectories. As a result, the dynamics can be unraveled and each trajectory can be simulated efficiently using only two-point correlation functions, with a computational cost that scales polynomially with system size. We further show that finite particle number requires negative dissipative rates, leading to an intrinsically non-Markovian dynamics. The corresponding trajectory unraveling involves both positive and negative stochastic weights and exhibits a sign problem and large fluctuations, so that convergence requires an exponentially large number of trajectories. The overall computational cost remains exponential in system size despite the efficient Gaussian representation of individual trajectories, but is crucially dependent on the computational complexity of the non-Markovian unraveling, motivating further studies on the efficiency of such unravelings.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种将相互作用费米子哈密顿量的基态映射到纯耗散开放量子系统非平衡稳态的方法。在第三量子化框架内，费米-哈伯德哈密顿量被映射到作用于马约拉纳费米子的林德布拉德跳跃算符，这些算符在量子轨迹中保持高斯性，使得动力学可高效模拟。然而，有限粒子数导致负耗散率和固有的非马尔可夫动力学，轨迹解缠绕涉及正负随机权重，存在符号问题和大的涨落，导致收敛需要指数级数量的轨迹。
authors: Giuliano Chiriacó

articles.title: Lie-theoretic structure of parameter gradients in variational quantum circuits
articles.title_zh: 变分量子电路中参数梯度的李理论结构
articles.abstract: Variational quantum circuits are a central paradigm of quantum machine learning and near-term quantum computing, yet their practical optimization is often limited by strongly suppressed parameter gradients. Dynamical Lie algebras provide a rigorous description of the infinitesimal directions accessible to a variational architecture, but dynamical accessibility alone does not determine the gradient signal exposed by an actual circuit parametrization. In this work, we develop a Lie-theoretic description of parameter-gradient structure that separates four successive mechanisms: dynamical accessibility, observable visibility, state-dependent activation, and local parameter realization. The optimization observable determines which accessible directions can influence the objective and how strongly they couple to it, while the quantum state selects which of these response modes are locally activated. This information is then pulled back through the circuit parametrization to recover the actual parameter gradients. The resulting construction yields an exact modal decomposition of the accessible gradient signal, a hierarchy of structural bounds, and a natural description of state averaging. An analytical single-qubit example and controlled numerical experiments validate the successive levels of the hierarchy and show that accessible Lie dimension alone is insufficient to characterize the parameter-gradient scale. The results support a mechanism-based view of variational trainability in which parameter gradients emerge from the interaction between accessible dynamics, observable coupling, quantum-state activation, and circuit parametrization.
articles.abstract_zh: 变分量子电路的优化常受参数梯度抑制的限制。本工作发展了一种参数梯度结构的李理论描述，将其分解为动态可达性、可观测可见性、态依赖激活和局部参数实现四个连续机制。优化可观测量决定了哪些可达方向能影响目标函数及其耦合强度，而量子态则选择哪些响应模式被局部激活。该方法提供了可达梯度信号的精确模态分解、结构界限的层次结构以及态平均的自然描述。
authors: María-Luisa Pérez-Delgado and Roberto Casado

articles.title: Zeno-enhanced probabilistic error cancellation with quantum error detection codes
articles.title_zh: 基于量子纠错码的芝诺增强概率误差消除
articles.abstract: Exact probabilistic error cancellation (PEC) is unbiased but suffers exponential sampling overhead set by noise-weighted circuit volume, whereas quantum error-detecting codes remove many physical faults by stabilizer post-selection but leave an undetectable logical residue. We exploit this complementarity by using post-selection to map physical noise to a weaker accepted logical channel, and then applying PEC only to the residual channel. The resulting feedback-free QED+PEC scheme interleaves Clifford logical blocks, stabilizer measurements, post-selection, and probabilistic cancellation on accepted trajectories, without real-time decoding or active recovery. A key complication is that post-selection correlates accepted fault branches through stabilizer-commutation constraints, so the sparse Pauli–Lindblad factorization underlying bare PEC no longer applies directly. We therefore construct the inverse channel perturbatively: for fixed order , only accepted fault branches up to order are retained, reducing enumeration from branches to per block. The order- protocol cancels the normalized post-selected channel through degree , leaving a per-block error under the stated assumptions, with an explicit end-to-end error bound. For logical Greenberger–Horne–Zeilinger (GHZ)-state preparation with the Iceberg code under circuit-level depolarizing noise and ideal stabilizer measurements, first-order QED+PEC reaches physical qubits and lowers sampling overhead by three to four orders of magnitude relative to standard PEC while maintaining . Syndrome-noise tests show that readout-only flips mainly increase post-selection cost, whereas noisy GHZ-assisted global stabilizer extraction can remove the advantage. This identifies a discrete-Zeno trade-off: cheap detection reshapes the effective channel PEC must invert, rather than simply adding overhead.
articles.abstract_zh: 精确概率误差消除（PEC）无偏但采样开销巨大，而量子纠错码（QED）通过稳定器后选择消除物理故障但留下不可检测的逻辑残余。本研究利用这种互补性，通过后选择将物理噪声映射到较弱的逻辑通道，然后仅对残余通道应用PEC。所提出的无反馈QED+PEC方案在接受的轨迹上交错进行Clifford逻辑块、稳定器测量、后选择和概率消除，无需实时解码或主动恢复。该方法通过微扰方式构建逆通道，显著减少了故障分支的枚举，从而在给定阶数下有效消除归一化后选择通道的误差。
authors: Yi Yuan, Yuanchen Zhao and Dong E Liu

articles.title: Non-Markovianity in structured nonequilibrium environment: impacts on Landauer’s principle and quantum batteries
articles.title_zh: 结构化非平衡环境中的非马尔可夫性：对朗道尔原理和量子电池的影响
articles.abstract: We investigate non-Markovianity and its effects on thermodynamic principles and quantum battery performance within a structured nonequilibrium environment consisting of a three-level memory unit and two thermal reservoirs. We demonstrate that temperature imbalance, average temperature, and memory structure serve as effective control parameters for modulating non-Markovianity, exhibiting distinct behaviors for bosonic and fermionic reservoirs. An improved Landauer’s bound applicable to non-Markovian processes is derived, overcoming the limitations of its conventional counterpart. By treating the central system as a quantum battery and the environment as a charger, we show that steady-state ergotropy can be achieved and tuned via thermodynamic parameters. Furthermore, non-Markovian dynamics significantly delay the discharge of the battery. Our study provides a pathway for constructing non-Markovian thermodynamic environments and harnessing non-Markovian effects to enhance the performance of quantum thermal devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了结构化非平衡环境中非马尔可夫性及其对热力学原理和量子电池性能的影响。研究表明，温度不平衡、平均温度和记忆结构是调节非马尔可夫性的有效控制参数。文中推导了一个适用于非马尔可夫过程的改进朗道尔界限，并发现通过热力学参数可以实现和调节稳态功能。此外，非马尔可夫动力学显著延迟了量子电池的放电，为构建非马尔可夫热力学环境和利用其效应提升量子热设备性能提供了途径。
authors: Xiao-Yu Chi, Qi Zhang, Yun-Jie Xia and Zhong-Xiao Man

articles.title: Variational noise mitigation in quantum circuits: the case of quantum Fourier transform
articles.title_zh: 量子电路中的变分噪声缓解：以量子傅里叶变换为例
articles.abstract: We study a variational quantum algorithm approach for improving the implementation of the quantum Fourier transform (QFT) under realistic noise conditions. We employ a training strategy based on mutually unbiased bases (MUBs), which probes the action of the noisy variational circuit over a global set of input states and promotes generalization beyond the training ensemble. We numerically study two- and three-qubit QFT implementations under noise models combining incoherent errors with coherent crosstalk, using calibration parameters derived from a quantum device. For the 2-qubit QFT, the optimized variational circuit consistently outperforms the corresponding noisy QFT in scenarios containing coherent noise and exhibits highly reproducible optimization across independent parameter initializations. The variational advantage persists in the direct 3-qubit optimization, although with a stronger dependence on initialization. We further show that reduced MUB training sets can retain most of the performance of the complete set while substantially reducing the number of training states, whereas training only on computational-basis states leads to markedly poorer generalization and a stronger dependence on parameter initialization. Finally, exploiting the recursive structure of the QFT, we demonstrate that an optimized 2-qubit variational block can be embedded into a 3-qubit QFT and improve its noisy implementation without retraining the complete circuit. These results highlight the potential of combining global state-space training with device-specific noise-aware variational optimization to improve small noisy quantum circuits and to explore the transfer of variationally learned noise resilience to larger constructions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一种变分量子算法方法，用于在实际噪声条件下改进量子傅里叶变换（QFT）的实现。研究采用基于互不偏基（MUBs）的训练策略，以探测噪声变分电路在全局输入态集上的作用并促进泛化。数值研究表明，对于2量子比特QFT，优化后的变分电路在包含相干噪声的场景中始终优于相应的噪声QFT，并且在独立参数初始化下表现出高度可重复的优化。对于3量子比特QFT，变分优势依然存在，但对初始化依赖性更强。
authors: Rafael Gómez-Lurbe, Alexander Bernal, Armando Pérez, Bryan Zaldívar and J Alberto Casas

articles.title: Gate-based path integral quantum control applied to quantum chemistry
articles.title_zh: 基于门的路径积分量子控制在量子化学中的应用
articles.abstract: The Path integral Quantum Control (PiQC) algorithm was recently introduced as a new approach for computing optimal controls in continuous-time open and closed quantum systems. In this work, we adapt the PiQC algorithm to optimize parametrized quantum circuits and refer to this version of PiQC as the Gate-Based PiQC (GB-PiQC) algorithm. We apply GB-PiQC and the original continuous-time version of PiQC for ground state preparation of electronic structure problems, and benchmark them against the Variational Quantum Eigensolver, optimized using the standard Simultaneous Perturbation Stochastic Approximation (SPSA) optimizer, on a set of standard benchmark molecular Hamiltonians. For a fair comparison, we optimize the hyperparameters of the algorithms for each molecule. We find that both PiQC algorithms exhibit greater robustness than SPSA to variations in the target Hamiltonian induced by changes in interatomic distance, when hyperparameters for both methods are fixed at values tuned near equilibrium. Furthermore, PiQC algorithms also achieve superior performance compared to SPSA in most instances under this fixed-hyperparameter setting, particularly at stretched interatomic distances, where the Hartree–Fock solution becomes less accurate and its error grows relative to equilibrium.
articles.abstract_zh: 路径积分量子控制（PiQC）算法是一种计算开放和封闭量子系统最优控制的新方法。本工作将PiQC算法应用于优化参数化量子电路，并称之为基于门的PiQC（GB-PiQC）算法。研究将GB-PiQC和原始连续时间PiQC应用于电子结构问题的基态制备，并与使用SPSA优化器优化的变分量子本征求解器进行基准测试。结果表明，在固定超参数设置下，两种PiQC算法在原子间距变化引起的哈密顿量变化方面表现出比SPSA更强的鲁棒性，并且在大多数情况下，尤其是在拉伸原子间距下，性能优于SPSA。
authors: Peyman Najafi, Aarón Villanueva and Hilbert Kappen

articles.title: AMARQ: adaptive multi-application routing for quantum networks
articles.title_zh: AMARQ：量子网络中的自适应多应用路由
articles.abstract: Future quantum networks will have to support different applications on shared infrastructure, like fidelity-critical quantum key distribution (QKD) and latency-sensitive distributed quantum computing (DQC). The existing approaches for entanglement routing either optimise for a single application, or rely on sequential resource allocation, which results in inefficient resource utilisation, unfairness and degraded performance when multiple applications compete for shared network resources. In this paper, we propose AMARQ, a multi-objective deep Q-network based routing framework to jointly serve heterogeneous QKD and DQC traffic on shared quantum infrastructure. The agent makes adaptive and application-aware routing decisions to dynamically balance the rigid fidelity and latency requirements of QKD and the high-throughput and elastic rate requirements of DQC. The reward function combines a successful-routing throughput term with a per-edge fidelity penalty and an end-of-episode failure penalty; per-flow latency is enforced as a QoS constraint, and inter-application fairness is enforced by a dedicated admission-control loop that reserves a dynamic QKD qubit pool. We assess the performance of AMARQ on grid topologies with 25 to 625 nodes. AMARQ attains a request success ratio above 85%, which is up to 32 percentage points higher than ESDI and 39 percentage points higher than Cicconetti, while keeping the end-to-end fidelity above 0.80 and the inference latency below 90 ms for all configurations.
articles.abstract_zh: 未来的量子网络需要支持量子密钥分发（QKD）和分布式量子计算（DQC）等多种应用。现有纠缠路由方法效率低下且性能受限，为此，本文提出了AMARQ，一个基于多目标深度Q网络的路由框架，旨在共享量子基础设施上共同服务异构QKD和DQC流量。该框架通过自适应和应用感知的路由决策，动态平衡QKD的严格保真度和延迟要求以及DQC的高吞吐量和弹性速率要求。性能评估显示，AMARQ能够有效管理资源，确保不同应用的公平性和服务质量。
authors: Lamarana Jallow and Majid Iqbal Khan

articles.title: Lean-QuantumAlg: A Framework for AI Agents to Produce Quantum Algorithms that Humans Can Trust
articles.title_zh: Lean-QuantumAlg：一个用于AI智能体生成人类可信量子算法的框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30216v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI agents are increasingly capable of constructing quantum algorithms and proofs, yet machine-checked proofs alone cannot guarantee that the intended problem is solved or that resource claims match the verified computation.Here we introduce Lean-QuantumAlg, a Lean 4 framework for trustworthy AI-assisted development of quantum algorithms.Its Algorithm-Solves-Problem contract binds correctness, success probability, borrowed-state restoration and quantum and classical resource bounds to a single execution, while separating the guarantees that Lean checks from the problem specifications and execution models that humans review. We demonstrate the framework on nine AI-formalized quantum algorithms, from Grover search to quantum attacks on RSA-2048 and P-256, with less than 1% of each algorithm's imported source code requiring statement-level human review once the shared framework has been audited. By integrating reusable mathematical foundations, certified algorithmic primitives and execution-grounded verification, Lean-QuantumAlg provides a basis for AI agents to construct and certify quantum algorithms, opening a path toward scalable AI-driven discovery of quantum algorithms.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了Lean-QuantumAlg，一个基于Lean 4的框架，旨在实现AI辅助开发可信量子算法。该框架通过“算法-解决问题”契约，将正确性、成功概率、资源限制等与执行绑定，并区分了Lean验证的保证与人类审查的问题规范。研究人员在九个AI形式化的量子算法上验证了该框架，显著减少了人工审查需求，为AI智能体构建和认证量子算法提供了基础。
authors: Lei Zhang, Mingrui Jing, Yusheng Zhao, Jiahong Liu, Xin Wang

articles.title: Pure states are optimal for total energy-constrained quantum channel discrimination
articles.title_zh: 纯态在总能量受限的量子信道判别中是最佳的
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30295v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider the discrimination of two quantum channels acting on bosonic modes, with a probe state of fixed mean photon number and no ancilla. We prove that pure probes are optimal: for every mixed probe there is a pure probe with exactly the same mean photon number that performs at least as well. The result holds for arbitrary channels and for every figure of merit built from the Chernoff quantities Tr[h̊o₁^sh̊o₂¹⁻s], including the quantum Chernoff exponent, as well as for the single-shot error probability. The proof relies on a decomposition of any state of mean photon number nb into pure states of mean photon number exactly nb, which extends a matrix rank-one decomposition of Huang and Zhang to density operators of infinite rank.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了玻色模式上两个量子信道的判别问题，其中探测态具有固定的平均光子数且无辅助比特。研究证明纯态探测是最佳的：对于任何混合探测态，都存在一个具有相同平均光子数的纯态探测，其性能至少与前者相当。该结论适用于任意信道和所有基于Chernoff量的性能指标，包括量子Chernoff指数和单次错误概率。
authors: Christos N. Gagatsos

articles.title: Dealing with low-weight errors that lead BP OSD to fail
articles.title_zh: 处理导致BP OSD失效的低权重错误
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30305v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Belief Propagation combined with Ordered Statistics Decoding (BP OSD) is an open-source decoding tool used widely within the community due to its versatility and ease of application to Quantum Low Density Parity Check (QLDPC) codes. However, the degeneracy of quantum codes has been observed to degrade the performance of BP OSD, particularly leading to error floors for low physical error rates. Here, we investigate the low-weight error configurations responsible for such failures in Bivariate Bicycle codes. We show that, at code capacity, BP OSD fails on errors whose weight is significantly smaller than d/2, arising from global symmetries of the decoding graph that prevent the convergence of parallel BP. Furthermore, our analysis reveals new pitfalls that can arise when analysing the performance of BP OSD in the rare events regime, such as loss of ergodicity in splitting methods and numerical instabilities in the decoder. We show how to mitigate these failure mechanisms by modifying the BP update rules and the decoder implementation, leading to substantial improvement in logical error rate.
articles.abstract_zh: 信念传播结合有序统计解码（BP OSD）在量子低密度奇偶校验（QLDPC）码中广泛应用，但量子码的简并性会导致其性能下降，尤其在低物理错误率下出现错误平台。本文研究了二元循环码中导致BP OSD失效的低权重错误配置，发现这些错误源于解码图的全局对称性，阻碍了并行BP的收敛。研究还通过修改BP更新规则和解码器实现来缓解这些失效机制，显著提高了逻辑错误率。
authors: Giacomo Fregona, Matthias C. Löbl, Benjamin J. Brown, Michael J. Kastoryano, Stefano Paesani

articles.title: Normal-Form Characterization of Adaptivity and Entanglement in Pauli-Based Computation
articles.title_zh: 基于泡利计算中适应性和纠缠的范式表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30315v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pauli-based computation (PBC) is a measurement-based model of quantum computation that samples from output distributions of universal Clifford+T circuits. Here, we provide a normal form (NF) that completely characterizes its adaptive and entanglement structures. These insights unify PBC with one-way quantum computing as dual or `time-reversed' counterparts. We use the NF to advance strategies for distributed computation and investigate magic-state injection rates. We also demonstrate an exponential improvement in the detection of unnecessary magic-state qubits, allowing their efficient removal. Our NF further enables ahead-of-time circuit compilation using PBC, reducing CNOT gate count and quantum memory of random quantum circuits on average by 50% and 40%, respectively, beating other state-of-the-art compilers.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于泡利计算（PBC）是一种测量型量子计算模型。本文提出了一个范式（NF），完整表征了PBC的适应性和纠缠结构，将PBC与单向量子计算统一为对偶或“时间反转”对应物。该范式可用于改进分布式计算策略、研究魔术态注入率，并显著提高不必要魔术态量子比特的检测效率。此外，利用该范式进行PBC的提前电路编译，可平均减少随机量子电路的CNOT门数量和量子内存。
authors: Filipa C. R. Peres, Selman Ipek, Daniel Lovsted, Joshua Nevin, Anne Broadbent

articles.title: Delta-Doped GeV⁻ in diamond with isotope resolvable optical spectra
articles.title_zh: 钻石中具有同位素可分辨光学光谱的Delta掺杂GeV⁻
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30375v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Group IV color centers in diamond -- silicon, germanium, tin, and lead-vacancy centers -- are a promising platform for quantum networking. Typical Group-IV creation utilizes ion implantation during diamond growth that leaves the color centers with a broad depth distribution and damage-induced strain inhomogeneity. Deterministic placement and damage reduction in Group IV generation are essential for improving this platform. In this letter, we report on the localization of germanium-vacancy (GeV⁻⁾ to a < 10 nm layer via the timed injection of GeH₄ during microwave plasma chemical vapor deposition. In this layer we have realized 17 ppm of Ge and a strain-free environment for the GeV⁻. Subsequent electron irradiation and annealing have generated a sheet density of 0.12 GeV⁻/μm². The minimal damage from color center generation mitigates spectral inhomogeneity and allows spectral resolution of isotopic clusters, with the best cluster having an inhomogeneous distribution of 2.14 GHz and an average linewidth of 47 ± 11 MHz. Our study gives insight into formation dynamics of GeV⁻ in delta-doped systems and estimates our vacancy to GeV⁻ yield to be ≥ 90%, establishing an athermal nearest-neighbor formation model. We further characterized the spin T₂^* and set a lower bound of 730 ns, limited by a paramagnetic defect.
articles.abstract_zh: 钻石中的IV族色心是量子网络的重要平台，但传统方法存在深度分布广和应变不均匀问题。本文通过在微波等离子体化学气相沉积过程中定时注入GeH₄，成功将锗空位（GeV⁻）局域到小于10纳米的层中，实现了17 ppm的Ge浓度和无应变环境。这种方法产生的色心损伤极小，有效缓解了光谱不均匀性，并首次实现了同位素簇的光谱分辨。该研究深入揭示了Delta掺杂系统中GeV⁻的形成动力学。
authors: Ian N. Hammock (Pritzker School of Molecular Engineering, University of Chicago, Chicago, USA), Kinfung Ngan (JILA and Department of Physics, University of Colorado Boulder, Boulder, USA), Antoni W. articles.title: Memory--Transport Competition in Physical Two-Bath Quantum Reset Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 物理双浴量子重置动力学中的记忆-传输竞争
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30457v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coherence preservation and environmental renewal offer competing ways of controlling quantum memory and transport. We show that a seemingly natural protocol which exactly replaces the bath occupations while preserving arbitrary system--bath coherences need not correspond to a physical fermionic state. We instead construct a two-reservoir protocol with independent, number-conserving thermal attenuators, for which complete positivity and fermionic admissibility hold by construction. Physical attenuation necessarily modifies bath populations as well as cross correlations; the coherence control is not an independent hard-reset knob. Quadratic dynamics reduces the stroboscopic problem to an exact matrix fixed-point equation without a weak-coupling or Markov approximation. Analytically, coherence retention enhances the leading short-cycle transfer rate, including the complete-erasure limit; no general endpoint-vanishing theorem exists. An exact stationary continuity theorem forces the through-current to vanish whenever either reservoir is left entirely unrefreshed, although no analogous theorem suppresses it at complete erasure. For biased structured reservoirs, exact finite-chain calculations display distinct coherence-, current-, and signed energy-transfer operating points; a resolved high-retention boundary layer exposes strong finite-size sensitivity of the coherence peak. The model provides a microscopic, fermion-admissible benchmark for the interplay of reservoir coherence, particle transport, and energetic exchange.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了量子记忆和传输控制中，相干性保持与环境更新之间的竞争。研究发现，一个看似自然的、在保持任意系统-浴相干性的同时精确替换浴占据的协议，可能不对应于物理费米子态。为此，作者构建了一个具有独立、粒子数守恒热衰减器的双浴协议，该协议在构建上满足完全正性和费米子可容许性。分析表明，相干性保持能增强短周期传输速率，但当任一储层未完全刷新时，通过电流必然消失。
authors: Jishad Kumar, Achilleas Lazarides, Tapio Ala-Nissila

articles.title: Distributed dual-comb spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 分布式双梳光谱学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30462v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose distributed dual-comb spectroscopy, a quantum-enhanced sensing architecture that simultaneously exploits spatial- and spectral-domain entanglement to improve the extraction of global spectroscopic information across broadband frequency ranges. Our scheme consists of a network of Mach-Zehnder interferometers interrogating spatially separated samples, each driven by a classical frequency comb at the bright port. A single two-mode squeezed frequency comb is distributed through a passive beam-splitter array into K entangled combs, establishing multipartite correlations across sensors while preserving intrinsic spectral entanglement. The protocol is compatible with both heterodyne detection and division detection, and enables parallel estimation of weighted-average absorption features over multiple frequency components. Compared with spatially separable quantum strategies requiring K independently engineered nonclassical comb sources, our approach achieves enhanced signal-to-noise performance using only a single quantum resource distributed across the network. These results establish a scalable route toward broadband distributed quantum spectroscopy with simultaneous spatial and spectral advantage.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种分布式双梳光谱学方案，这是一种量子增强传感架构，同时利用空间和光谱域纠缠来改进宽带频率范围内的全局光谱信息提取。该方案通过一个无源分束器阵列将单个双模压缩频率梳分发到K个纠缠梳中，在传感器之间建立多方关联。该协议兼容外差检测和分束检测，并能并行估计多个频率分量的加权平均吸收特征，相比传统方法，仅需一个量子资源即可实现增强的信噪比性能。
authors: Haowei Shi, Kartikeya Arora, Zheshen Zhang, Quntao Zhuang

articles.title: Photon localization: Local measurements, localized states, and causality
articles.title_zh: 光子局域化：局域测量、局域态与因果关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30473v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We review what it means for a relativistic particle to be localized and argue that the most useful approach is through local measurement. This perspective ties localization directly to relativistic causality and measurable outcomes in spacetime. Strict localization in quantum field theory is formalized by states that give the same expectation value as vacuum for all local observables outside some spacetime region. With this formalism, single photons cannot be strictly localized, but coherent states can. The structure and interpretation of local observables and local operator algebras are discussed in connection with the Reeh-Schlieder theorem. Since probabilities of local measurement outcomes cannot vanish in vacuum, particle detection events must be phrased carefully. Key characteristics of strictly localized states are surveyed alongside concrete strategies for constructing them. The relationship between localization, causality, and on-demand sources is analyzed, finding that strictly localized states can represent localized, propagating information in quantum field theory. Explicit examples of localized photonic states are presented with an emphasis on quantum optics, including states that approximate single photons and (entangled) Bell states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文回顾了相对论粒子局域化的含义，并提出通过局域测量是理解其最有效的方法，这直接将局域化与相对论因果关系和时空中的可测量结果联系起来。在量子场论中，严格局域化由在特定时空区域外对所有局域可观测量给出与真空相同期望值的态来形式化。研究发现，单个光子不能严格局域化，但相干态可以。文章还讨论了局域可观测量、局域算子代数的结构和解释，并分析了局域化、因果关系与按需光源之间的关系。
authors: Jan Gulla, Johannes Skaar

articles.title: On the Role of Problem Structure in Single-Layer QAOA
articles.title_zh: 问题结构在单层QAOA中的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30511v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Problem structure is regarded as a key factor influencing the performance of the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA), yet it remains an informal notion without a precise mathematical characterization. In this work, we address this issue by identifying a mathematical object that captures problem structure as seen from the perspective of the target state amplitude in single-layer QAOA. Specifically, we show that this structure is encoded in a joint probability distribution induced by the unique coarsest partition of the computational basis, determined by problem cost values and mixer-dependent walk counts. The statistical dependence between these classes provides a means of quantifying the available problem structure and identifying necessary conditions for exponential amplification. To assess the extent to which this structure can translate into algorithmic performance, we establish a mean-max non-separation bound relating the parameter-averaged probability of measuring the target configuration to its variational maximum. For NPO-PB problems with polynomially many distinct mixer eigenvalues, these probabilities exhibit the same scaling up to polynomial factors. This allows us to characterize the exponential scaling of optimal amplitude amplification by analyzing the parameter-averaged probability without explicitly optimizing the variational parameters. We then derive an exact expression for the parameter-averaged probability as a matrix inner product involving two objects that separately encode the joint structural distribution and the mixer dynamics. This representation provides a framework for identifying the structural mechanisms governing the amplification of the target-state probability or its exponential suppression relative to the mixer capacity. We demonstrate these mechanisms through analytically tractable examples involving transverse field and Grover mixers.
articles.abstract_zh: 问题结构被认为是影响量子近似优化算法（QAOA）性能的关键因素，但其数学表征尚不明确。本文通过识别一个数学对象来捕捉单层QAOA中目标态振幅视角下的问题结构，该结构编码在由计算基的唯一最粗划分所诱导的联合概率分布中。这种统计依赖性提供了一种量化问题结构和识别指数放大必要条件的方法。研究还建立了平均-最大非分离界限，将参数平均测量目标配置的概率与其变分最大值联系起来。
authors: Guilherme Adamatti Bridi, Franklin de Lima Marquezino, Andris Ambainis

articles.title: Probing quasiperiodic spectral accessibility with a finite-rate quantum Otto cycle
articles.title_zh: 用有限速率量子奥托循环探测准周期光谱可达性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30555v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quasiperiodic systems combine sharply different spectral and localisation regimes with a dense hierarchy of dynamical time scales. We show that a finite-rate quantum Otto cycle can use this structure as a thermodynamic probe, revealing which parts of the spectrum become dynamically accessible and thermodynamically relevant during a driven transformation. For a generalised Aubry-André-Harper chain, the resulting response is not determined by the static quasiperiodic regime alone: extended, near-critical, and crossing protocols do not exhibit universal ordering of work fluctuations. Instead, the statistics reflect transition pathways that are simultaneously dynamically coupled, thermally occupied, and energetically significant. The same spectral accessibility separates thermodynamic recovery from microscopic adiabatic recovery. Positive mean work can reappear while the population transfer dynamics remain strongly nonadiabatic because finite-rate population transfer is redistributed toward energetically less costly channels rather than suppressed. The full work distribution reveals a further separation, with a finite rate window in which positive-work cycles form a majority although the mean work remains negative. This behaviour persists in finite-size analysis. A thermally weighted spectral susceptibility connects these effects to a distributed hierarchy of dynamically active spectral regions rather than to a single minimum-gap bottleneck. Finite thermal contacts preserve this picture while introducing a second time scale and intercycle memory. Quantum Otto cycles can therefore provide a fluctuation-resolved thermodynamic probe of quasiperiodic spectral accessibility, complementary to direct spectroscopic and eigenstate-resolved diagnostics.
articles.abstract_zh: 准周期系统结合了截然不同的光谱和局域化机制以及密集的动力学时间尺度。本文展示了有限速率量子奥托循环如何利用这种结构作为热力学探针，揭示在驱动变换过程中哪些光谱部分变得动态可达和热力学相关。对于广义Aubry-André-Harper链，其响应不仅由静态准周期机制决定，而是反映了同时动态耦合、热占据和能量显著的跃迁路径。研究还发现，正平均功可能在非绝热布居转移动力学中重新出现。
authors: Shujie Cheng, Lucas C. Céleri, Norton G. de Almeida, Gao Xianlong, G. D. de Moraes Neto

articles.title: Mode-Selective Micromotion Compensation via Coherent Excitation of a Ground-State-Cooled Motional Mode
articles.title_zh: 通过基态冷却运动模式的相干激发实现模式选择性微运动补偿
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30614v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Excess micromotion induced by stray DC electric fields limits the control fidelity of trapped-ion experiments. Various techniques have been developed to detect and compensate ion displacements from the RF null by monitoring modulated fluorescence, ion positions, or micromotion sidebands. Although these approaches are effective, they do not probe the displacement through a ground-state-cooled motional mode and therefore offer limited compatibility with quantum-enhanced sensing protocols. Here, we demonstrate a micromotion compensation method based on the driven coherent amplitude of a ground-state-cooled motional mode. In this approach, the ion displacement is converted into a coherent motional excitation by an auxiliary RF drive and detected through the qubit. We determine the optimal compensation field with a 1σ statistical uncertainty of 8 mV/m. The method is naturally compatible with quantum-enhanced sensing protocols employing nonclassical motional states, including Fock, squeezed, and Schrödinger-cat states, providing a pathway toward quantum-enhanced micromotion compensation.
articles.abstract_zh: 杂散直流电场引起的过量微运动限制了囚禁离子实验的控制保真度。本文提出了一种基于基态冷却运动模式的驱动相干振幅的微运动补偿方法。在该方法中，离子位移通过辅助射频驱动转换为相干运动激发，并通过量子比特进行检测。研究人员以8 mV/m的1σ统计不确定度确定了最佳补偿场。该方法与采用非经典运动态的量子增强传感协议兼容，为量子增强微运动补偿提供了途径。
authors: Tetsu Kinase, Ippei Nakamura, Atsushi Noguchi

articles.title: On the Structure of Quantum Finite-Level Systems: Decoherence-Free Subsystems, Quantum Nondemolition Variables, and Back-Action-Evading Measurements
articles.title_zh: 量子有限能级系统的结构：无退相干子系统、量子非破坏变量和反作用规避测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30616v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The purpose of this paper is to conduct a comprehensive structural analysis of quantum finite-level systems in the Heisenberg picture, where the evolution of system observables is modeled by bilinear quantum stochastic differential equations (QSDEs). Firstly, real coordinate transformations that preserve commutation and anticommutation relations are characterized, and relative admissibility between different orthonormal Hermitian bases is formulated. Secondly, strongly aligned subspaces are introduced, based on which decoherence-free subsystems (DFSs) are constructed in general orthonormal Hermitian basis as well as the generalized Gell-Mann basis. Thirdly, conditions for the existence of quantum nondemolition (QND) variables are given in terms of both linear systems theory and spectral separation by output-signal observables. Finally, a sufficient condition for quantum back-action-evading (BAE) measurements is established. A four-qubit nearest-neighbor Heisenberg chain with collective dephasing illustrates these structural properties of quantum finite-level systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在海森堡绘景下对量子有限能级系统进行了全面的结构分析，其中系统可观测量演化由双线性量子随机微分方程建模。研究首先表征了保持对易和反对易关系的实坐标变换，并提出了不同正交厄米基之间的相对可容许性。其次，引入了强对齐子空间，并在此基础上构建了无退相干子系统（DFS）。最后，文章给出了量子非破坏（QND）变量存在的条件，并建立了量子反作用规避（BAE）测量的充分条件。
authors: Jia Gu, Guofeng Zhang, Ian R. Petersen

articles.title: Coherence and imaginarity of qubit states under vanishing Bargmann invariants
articles.title_zh: 量子比特态在Bargmann不变量消失条件下的相干性和虚度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30618v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Set coherence and set imaginarity are two important quantum resources defined by sets of states. We investigate tuples of qubit states under vanishing higher-order Bargmann invariants and show that their set coherence and set imaginarity are each related to whether they contain a pair of orthogonal states. Specifically, when the relevant higher-order Bargmann invariants vanish, the tuple contains a pair of orthogonal states if and only if removing some state makes the remaining tuple incoherent. Moreover, when maximally mixed states are excluded, the same vanishing conditions imply that the tuple is imaginarity-free if and only if it contains a pair of orthogonal states. As a consequence, under these conditions, a tuple of single-qubit states has imaginarity precisely when every tuple obtained by deleting one of its states is coherent.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨了量子比特态组在高级Bargmann不变量消失条件下的集合相干性和集合虚度。结果表明，这些量子资源与态组是否包含一对正交态有关。具体来说，在特定条件下，态组包含正交态当且仅当移除某个态后剩余态组变得不相干。此外，排除最大混合态后，在相同条件下，态组无虚度当且仅当其包含一对正交态。
authors: Hao-Fan Wang, Lin Chen

articles.title: High-fidelity and robust controlled-Z gates for superconducting transmon qubits. II. System-parameter uncertainties and overall errors
articles.title_zh: 超导Transmon量子比特的高保真和鲁棒受控-Z门。II. 系统参数不确定性和总误差
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30681v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the companion paper (Part I), we developed an optimal-control framework to suppress intrinsic and decoherence-induced errors in controlled-Z (CZ) gates between directly coupled, frequency-tunable transmons. Here, we extend this framework to incorporate uncertainties in coupling strength, anharmonicities, and zero-flux qubit frequencies, enabling the design of high-fidelity gates robust against noise and parameter uncertainties. We classify these uncertainties by whether they perturb the off-diagonal coupling strengths or the diagonal detunings of the Hamiltonian, and we identify distinct suppression mechanisms for each class. Coupling errors are mitigated through dynamical decoupling induced by strong detuning modulation. For a 30-ns gate, this strategy reduces the coupling error to 6.21×10⁻⁷ and tolerates coupling-strength uncertainties up to 2π×4 MHz while keeping total gate infidelity below 10⁻³. Detuning errors are minimized near a symmetric-detuning operating point that balances the two dominant leakage-mediated interactions. A 24-ns gate operated near this point tolerates individual uncertainties of up to 2π×5 MHz in each relevant diagonal parameter under the same infidelity threshold. We further optimize gate performance under realistic conditions where intrinsic errors, decoherence, and parameter uncertainties coexist across six representative stages of progressively improving hardware performance. The resulting stage-specific controls achieve lower infidelity and greater robustness. Together with the companion study (Part I), this framework offers a practical approach to balance speed, fidelity, and robustness while reducing the need for exhaustive characterization and frequent recalibration in large-scale superconducting quantum processors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文扩展了前作的优化控制框架，以设计对噪声和参数不确定性具有鲁棒性的高保真受控-Z（CZ）门。研究将系统参数不确定性分为扰动非对角耦合强度和对角失谐两类，并提出了不同的抑制机制。这些策略显著提高了CZ门的鲁棒性，使其能容忍较大的参数不确定性，同时保持低门失真度。
authors: Chia-Hsien Huang, Hsi-Sheng Goan

articles.title: Demand-Driven Routing Space for Lattice-Surgery Compilation
articles.title_zh: 面向格点手术编译的需求驱动路由空间
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30747v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lattice-surgery compilation places logical qubits on a grid of surface-code tiles and routes their interactions. Sparse static layouts limit routing contention but reserve space that often remains idle. Reducing this reservation requires balancing area savings against additional gate serialization and qubit movement. In this paper, we present a co-designed dynamic architecture and compiler that allocates routing space according to circuit demand. The architecture preserves a fixed virtual qubit floorplan while allowing its physical spacing to change between execution stages. The compiler coordinates placement, scheduling, and routing to implement lattice surgeries using fewer physical qubits. Across our application benchmarks, our method reduces space-time volume by 55.6% in geometric mean and compiles 75.5 times faster than the evaluated DasCot configuration. A circuit-synthesis case study shows how our compiler exposes optimization tradeoffs.
articles.abstract_zh: 格点手术编译在表面码瓦片网格上放置逻辑量子比特并路由其相互作用。本文提出了一种协同设计的动态架构和编译器，根据电路需求分配路由空间。该架构在保持固定虚拟量子比特布局的同时，允许其物理间距在执行阶段之间变化。实验结果表明，该方法在应用基准测试中将时空体积平均减少了55.6%，并且编译速度比现有方法快75.5倍。
authors: Hanyu Wang, Wan-Hsuan Lin, Zihan Chen, Eddy Z. Zhang, Jason Cong

articles.title: Exceptional point structure and chiral state transfer in a rate-operator-engineered PT-symmetric Bose-Hubbard dimer
articles.title_zh: 速率算子工程化PT对称Bose-Hubbard二聚体中的奇异点结构和手性态转移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30836v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rate operator quantum jumps (ROQJ) is a general method to unravel a master equation describing the dynamics of an open quantum system into stochastic pure state trajectories. By post-selecting on no jumps occurring, one obtains a trajectory generated by a non-Hermitian Hamiltonian. The ROQJ allows for versatile modification of this non-Hermitian evolution, with each non-Hermitian Hamiltonian corresponding to a different continuous measurement scheme. We apply the ROQJ to modify the non-Hermitian dynamics of the open three-particle Bose-Hubbard dimer model under environmental non-local dephasing to construct a PT-symmetric non-Hermitian Hamiltonians with a general two parameter PT-symmetric imaginary diagonal part, which generalizes the well-known gain-loss Bose-Hubbard dimer. We characterize the symmetry structure of the spectrum for different on-site interaction strengths. For vanishing on-site interaction, we find the unbroken PT-symmetry region enclosed by order two exceptional lines of different character and four order four exceptional points, two of which are not found in the usual gain-loss Bose-Hubbard dimer. Additionally, we find regions with degenerate imaginary parts of the eigenvalues, also not found in the gain-loss Bose-Hubbard dimer. In this parameter space, we use time-dependent rate operator transformations to investigate state transfer under slowly varying parameter loops. Loops encircling an order four exceptional point exhibit chiral state transfer. Because the loops cross exceptional lines, the final states are superpositions of eigenstates. Chiral state transfer is also found with non-zero homogeneous on-site interaction when the loop crosses over broken PT-symmetry regions of different character. Using inhomogeneous on-site interactions, we find direction dependent state transfer between eigenstates without crossing or encircling exceptional points.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用速率算子量子跳跃（ROQJ）方法，构建了一个具有通用两参数PT对称虚对角部分的非厄米哈密顿量，用于描述开放三粒子Bose-Hubbard二聚体模型。研究了不同局域相互作用强度下能谱的对称结构。在局域相互作用消失的情况下，发现了由二阶奇异线和四个四阶奇异点包围的未破缺PT对称区域，其中两个四阶奇异点在传统增益-损耗Bose-Hubbard二聚体中未曾发现。
authors: Jaakko Luomala, Federico Settimo, Kimmo Luoma, Iiro Vilja, Jyrki Piilo

articles.title: Scale-free localization in pseudo-Hermitian quantum walk
articles.title_zh: 赝厄米量子行走中的无标度局域化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31067v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scale-free localization is a distinctive phenomenon in non-Hermitian systems, where specific eigenstates, known as scale-free localized states (LSs), possess localization lengths that scale linearly with the system size. Here, we show that a single non-Hermitian defect in one-dimensional quantum walks (QWs) induces scale-free localization. Driven by non-Hermiticity, the QW system undergoes a pseudo-Hermitian (PH) phase transition and the PH symmetry breaking is accompanied by the emergence of scale-free localization. As non-Hermiticity is further increased, the system undergoes a second phase transition, marked by the emergence of two pairs of bound states. Crucially, we identify the critical points of both transitions using localization properties. Furthermore, we extend our investigation to two-dimensional QWs, where a single non-Hermitian defect also induces scale-free localization, thereby demonstrating the universality of this phenomenon. Our work provides a valuable perspective for further exploring defect physics and a type of novel LS in non-Hermitian quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了非厄米系统中独特的无标度局域化现象，其中特定本征态的局域化长度与系统尺寸呈线性关系。研究发现，一维量子行走中的单个非厄米缺陷可以诱导无标度局域化，并伴随赝厄米相变和对称性破缺。随着非厄米性的增加，系统会经历第二次相变，并出现两对束缚态。该工作还将其推广到二维量子行走，证实了这种现象的普适性。
authors: Haiting Zhang, Lei Xiao, Cui-Xian Guo, Quan Lin, Peng Xue

articles.title: Norm-Aware Product Formulas for Hamiltonian Simulations
articles.title_zh: 用于哈密顿量模拟的范数感知乘积公式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31070v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: With the target of efficiently solving the quantum-mechanical Schrödinger equation on future quantum computers, first- and second-order product formulas for the time-evolution operator are proposed, designed to exploit hierarchies in the operator norms of the individual Hamiltonian components. Inspired by the THRIFT product formula, these decomposition schemes achieve a suppression of the leading error term by a factor of alpha<1 with respect to the standard Lie--Trotter--Suzuki splitting of the same order, where alpha quantifies the norm ratio between the dominant and subdominant parts of the Hamiltonian. Unlike THRIFT, the proposed formulas retain the general product-formula structure, making them applicable to Hamiltonians whose terms act on an arbitrary number of qubits. The advantages of this approach are demonstrated through numerical experiments on engineered two-dimensional spin-1/2 XY model systems and isolated molecules within the double-factorization framework.
articles.abstract_zh: 为了在未来的量子计算机上高效求解薛定谔方程，本文提出了利用哈密顿量各分量算符范数层级关系的一阶和二阶时间演化算符乘积公式。这些分解方案能够将主导误差项抑制一个小于1的因子，优于同阶的标准Lie-Trotter-Suzuki分裂方法。与THRIFT公式不同，所提出的公式保留了通用的乘积公式结构，适用于作用于任意数量量子比特的哈密顿量。
authors: Carlos A. Piñeiro Moreno, Pascal Krause, Annika Bande

articles.title: The limits of magic-state distillation
articles.title_zh: 魔术态蒸馏的极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31115v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magic-state factories are a major cost of fault-tolerant quantum computing, yet how few noisy inputs they need is known only for restricted protocols. We show that, for tolerating input faults, any stabilizer protocol, however adaptive, postselected or multistage, is no better than a projection onto one stabilizer code, and that for rational targets a fault pattern is harmful exactly when its complement is. Searches over all codes show that quadratic distillation of one T state needs exactly nine inputs and that the eight-input CCZ factory is optimal. At order d, one T state needs n≥2d.
articles.abstract_zh: 魔术态工厂是容错量子计算的主要成本之一，但其所需噪声输入的最小数量仅在受限协议中已知。本文证明，对于容忍输入错误，任何稳定器协议，无论其自适应性、后选择性或多阶段性如何，都不优于投影到一个稳定器码。研究发现，二次蒸馏一个T态需要精确九个输入，并且八输入CCZ工厂是最佳的。
authors: Llorenç Balada Gaggioli, Jakub Mareček

articles.title: Quantum Constrained Hamiltonian Descent
articles.title_zh: 量子约束哈密顿下降法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31170v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose Quantum Constrained Hamiltonian Descent (QCHD), a continuous-time quantum framework for optimization under smooth equality constraints. The unconstrained counterpart, Quantum Hamiltonian Descent (QHD), minimizes a cost function by simulating the Schrödinger dynamics of a particle in the potential given by the cost function. Applying Dirac's formalism to the classical dynamics with constraints, we construct an intrinsic quantum Hamiltonian with a Laplace--Beltrami operator on the constraint manifold in a kinetic term. Its evolution preserves the constraints exactly without penalty terms and is expected to solve quantum-dynamically the constrained optimization problem. We analyze its relation to Quantum Hamiltonian Descent supplemented by a strong penalty term. For a squared-distance penalty, the effective tangential dynamics acquires an extrinsic-curvature potential and, in nontrivial normal-rotation sectors, a coupling to the normal-bundle connection. These embedding-dependent terms remain in the strong-penalty limit, generally yielding quantum dynamics different from QCHD. Numerical comparisons for circular, elliptical, and two simultaneous constraints show faster optimization and improved concentration near global minima for the initial states and finite penalty strengths considered.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了量子约束哈密顿下降法（QCHD），这是一个在平滑等式约束下进行优化的连续时间量子框架。通过将狄拉克形式主义应用于经典约束动力学，构建了一个内在的量子哈密顿量，其演化能精确保持约束。研究还分析了QCHD与带有强惩罚项的量子哈密顿下降法的关系，并指出在强惩罚极限下，两者产生的量子动力学通常不同。
authors: Yoshihiko Abe, Ryo Nagai

articles.title: Entanglement certification of attosecond light fields with photoelectron interferometry
articles.title_zh: 利用光电子干涉法对阿秒光场进行纠缠认证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31187v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The emergence of entangled quantum optical states in high-harmonic generation raises a fundamental problem about its characterization, namely, how can entanglement of extreme-ultraviolet radiation be certified for attosecond light fields? Here, we provide experimentally accessible separability tests, particularly showing that attosecond photoelectron interferometry provides a direct solution to this problem. This is achieved by a quantum optical treatment of mapping photoelectron interferometry to the measurement of optical correlation functions. This yields a negative-partial-transpose witness for infrared-XUV entanglement and a sufficient witness of genuine multipartite entanglement without auxiliary optical measurements. We evaluate both witnesses on explicit optical states and identify how the protocol can be extended to XUV-XUV entanglement certification. Hence, we establish attosecond photoelectron interferometry as a general framework for entanglement certification across a wide range of optical frequencies.
articles.abstract_zh: 高次谐波产生中纠缠量子光学态的出现，提出了如何认证阿秒光场中极紫外辐射纠缠的挑战。本文提出了一种实验可行的可分离性测试方法，表明阿秒光电子干涉法为该问题提供了直接解决方案。该方法提供了一种红外-极紫外纠缠的负偏置转置判据，以及一种无需辅助光学测量的真实多体纠缠的充分判据。
authors: Philipp Stammer

articles.title: Fluctuation-free Quantum Battery Charging Enabled by Bell-like Entangled and Separable Charger States
articles.title_zh: 贝尔类纠缠态和可分离充电器态实现的无波动量子电池充电
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31242v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The implication of entanglement in quantum battery charging remains poorly understood. In addition, intrinsic quantum randomness poses a fundamental challenge to charging uniformity across distinct trials. To address these issues, we study a three-qubit system within a cascaded collision frame, with two qubits acting as the charger and the third serving as the battery. After each collision, an adaptive measurement is performed on the charger, yielding four conditional post-measurement battery states with identical expected stored energy. For arbitrary fixed charger states, we derive analytical expressions for the recurrence relation of stored energy. We find that stored-energy fluctuations depend on whether the dynamics relies on the battery phase (γₙ). For two Bell-like families of entangled states, together with their computational basis states termed Bell-like separable states, the dynamics is (γₙ)-independent and fluctuations vanish, whereas for other entangled and separable states, fluctuations emerge. These insights establish a paradigm for engineering charger states to design uniform-charging quantum-battery architectures despite inherent quantum randomness.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了纠缠在量子电池充电中的作用，并解决了充电均匀性面临的挑战。在一个三量子比特系统中，研究发现存储能量的波动取决于动力学是否依赖于电池相位。对于两类贝尔类纠缠态及其计算基态（贝尔类可分离态），动力学与电池相位无关，且波动消失。这些发现为设计具有均匀充电特性的量子电池架构提供了新思路。
authors: Longyan Gong, Jing Zhang, Yongtao Li

articles.title: Can Entanglement-Induced Feature-Map Designs Improve Projected Quantum Kernels?
articles.title_zh: 纠缠诱导特征图设计能否改进投影量子核？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31260v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Projected quantum kernels (PQKs) have emerged as a notable approach to circumvent the hardness of machine learning tasks arising from the exponential dimensionality of the quantum Hilbert space. However, recent PQK studies often rely heavily on extensive classical hyperparameter tuning of the radial basis function (RBF) kernel parameter and the support vector machine regularization parameter. The extensive tuning can mask the true representational power of the underlying PQKs induced by quantum feature maps, which has not been explored in detail. Thus, this work aims to expose the structural capabilities of PQKs by isolating and evaluating their native inductive bias through comparisons between untuned and tuned PQKs against the RBF baseline. Furthermore, we propose novel quantum feature maps that leverage two-qubit entanglement to capture multivariate correlations in IoT data. The results show that extensive tuning can lead to competitive performance architectures, while our proposed entanglement topologies exhibit a significantly stronger native inductive bias. This reveals that superior quantum architectural design can yield structurally better PQKs with improvements arising from quantum-mechanical properties rather than from classical hyperparameter tuning.
articles.abstract_zh: 投影量子核（PQKs）是解决量子希尔伯特空间指数维度带来的机器学习任务困难的一种方法。本文旨在通过比较未调优和已调优的PQKs与径向基函数（RBF）基线，揭示PQKs的结构能力及其固有的归纳偏置。此外，研究提出了利用双量子比特纠缠来捕获物联网数据中多变量相关性的新型量子特征图。结果表明，所提出的纠缠拓扑结构表现出显著更强的固有归纳偏置，强调了优越的量子架构设计的重要性。
authors: Ravi Kumar Jha, Hsuan-Yin Lin, Eirik Rosnes

articles.title: High-fidelity entanglement of two spectrally-distinct solid state emitters
articles.title_zh: 两个光谱不同固态发射体的高保真纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31283v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Solid state quantum emitters with electronic spin properties can be entangled using optical interferometric which-path erasure techniques that rely on identical frequencies and linewidths of the emitters. This promises a powerful, fast and scalable platform for quantum technologies. Using current protocols, a pair of emitters embedded in a waveguide interferometer can be deterministically prepared in a maximally entangled state. However, the amount of entanglement diminishes rapidly with increasing separation of the emission lines and variations in the linewidths of the emitters. Solid state emitters such as quantum dots are subject to intrinsic variations in the fabrication process. Therefore, manufacturing the required number of identical emitters on a chip is not scalable. In this Letter, we present a method that uses readily available pairs of entangled photons to entangle solid state emitters with large transition frequency separations and linewidth variations, circumventing the need to fabricate optically identical emitters. We demonstrate a concurrence of C = 0.95 for typical quantum dots using narrowband photon inputs.
articles.abstract_zh: 固态量子发射体的纠缠通常依赖于发射体相同的频率和线宽，但制造大量光学特性相同的发射体难以实现。本文提出了一种新方法，利用现成的纠缠光子对来纠缠具有大跃迁频率间隔和线宽变化的固态发射体。该方法避免了制造光学相同发射体的需求，并展示了对典型量子点实现0.95的纠缠度，为可扩展的量子技术平台提供了可能。
authors: Daniel R. E. Hodgson, Pieter Kok

articles.title: Quantum Fokker-Planck solvers as trainable generative models
articles.title_zh: 量子Fokker-Planck求解器作为可训练的生成模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31330v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop and analyze generative models based on quantum solvers of stochastic differential equations. Unlike the common approach based on layered variational quantum circuits with parameterized rotations, we parameterize the potential of a Langevin process. The associated Fokker-Planck (FP) equations are Hermitianized and solved using a linear combination of cosine operators implemented through quantum singular value transformation. By encoding the square root of the stationary density, the model enables sampling through computational-basis measurements and is efficiently controlled by coefficients of the block-encoded diagonal potential. We train the proposed model to match empirical distributions within the family described by FP equations, demonstrating parameter recovery for multivariate probability distributions. Crucially, the model remains trainable at scale. Sample-efficient and convex optimization for in-distribution targets arises from a physics-informed inductive bias and holds regardless of the dimensionality of the problem. We provide circuit constructions and efficient block encodings of the main components of the algorithm and analyze resource requirements. Our approach frames quantum generative learning as quantum model discovery and provides a foundation for extending this framework to high-dimensional, strongly correlated scientific data.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文开发并分析了基于随机微分方程量子求解器的生成模型。该模型通过参数化朗之万过程的势能，并利用量子奇异值变换实现余弦算子的线性组合来求解Fokker-Planck方程。通过编码平稳密度的平方根，该模型能够通过计算基测量进行采样，并可高效地训练以匹配经验分布。该方法在物理信息归纳偏置下实现了样本高效和凸优化，且与问题维度无关。
authors: Tariq Mahassen, Marcin Jastrzebski, Oleksandr Kyriienko

articles.title: Qubits Are Not Enough: Deflation and Measurement Limits in Variational Quantum Modal Analysis
articles.title_zh: 量子比特不足：变分量子模态分析中的紧缩与测量限制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31393v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Amplitude encoding stores an N-degree-of-freedom structural mode using ceiling(log2 N) qubits. This article develops an evaluation framework for variational quantum eigensolvers in finite-element structural dynamics. A Cholesky transformation maps the generalized eigenproblem to a symmetric mass-orthonormal Hamiltonian, ensuring Euclidean quantum-state orthogonality equals structural mass orthogonality. For higher modes, the deflation penalty condition is sharpened to a necessary-and-sufficient threshold, with a Davis-Kahan bound quantifying effects of approximate projectors. Numerical studies separate mapping correctness, ansatz expressibility, preprocessing, Pauli growth, finite-shot uncertainty, and damage localization. For 128-DOF chains, consistent-mass whitening increases transformed-operator density from 0.023 to 0.308 and Pauli terms from 576 to 2950. Exact state-vector experiments show qubit count and circuit expressibility are distinct. At 10⁵ shots per Pauli term, first-mode frequency RMS error is 2.45%. In an oracle-state study, 10% stiffness loss is localized in 84.5% of trials. Results sharpen the deflation condition, quantify resource bottlenecks, and claim no speedup.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为有限元结构动力学中的变分量子本征求解器开发了一个评估框架。通过Cholesky变换将广义本征问题映射到对称质量正交哈密顿量，确保量子态正交性与结构质量正交性一致。研究明确了高阶模态的紧缩惩罚条件，并通过数值研究分析了映射正确性、ansatz表达能力、预处理等因素。结果表明，量子比特数量和电路表达能力是不同的，并量化了有限次测量的不确定性。
authors: Bikalpa Gautam, Akil Raj Subedi

articles.title: Nonlinear quantum noise polarization in macroscopic nonlinear QED
articles.title_zh: 宏观非线性量子电动力学中的非线性量子噪声极化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31406v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct a quantum theory of light in nonlinearly responding materials with dispersion and absorption and, in particular, show the emergence of non-Gaussian noise associated with nonlinear absorption processes. Our theory is based on a path-integral formulation of the microscopic Huttner-Barnett model including cubic matter self-interaction required for ḩi⁽²⁾ nonlinear processes. We show that the noise polarization emerges naturally from a decoupling of the stochastic weights of the bath response which, in case of cubic self-interactions, leads to a decoupling via Airy functions. As the theory is, by construction, consistent with the nonlinear fluctuation-dissipation theorem, it constitutes a viable quantum theory of light in nonlinear media.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了色散和吸收非线性响应材料中的光量子理论，并特别展示了与非线性吸收过程相关的非高斯噪声的出现。该理论基于包含三次物质自相互作用的微观Huttner-Barnett模型的路径积分表述。研究表明，噪声极化自然地源于浴响应随机权重的解耦，在三次自相互作用情况下通过艾里函数实现解耦。该理论与非线性涨落-耗散定理一致，为非线性介质中的光提供了可行的量子理论。
authors: Arman Kashef, Stefan Scheel, Marco Ornigotti

articles.title: The Impact of Markovian Errors on Random Circuits
articles.title_zh: 马尔可夫误差对随机电路的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31500v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Randomized benchmarking (RB) returns a single decay parameter or gate error rate, but when the noise is gate-dependent that parameter is notoriously difficult to interpret. We study RB and related random-circuit benchmarks under small gate-local Markovian noise by factorizing each noisy gate into its ideal action followed by the exponential of a small error generator and then perturbing the RB mathscrL matrix, which models the RB decay. For any low-error gate set that satisfies the requirements of RB (it is a sequence-asymptotic unitary 2-design), we show that Pauli-stochastic error rates contribute linearly to the RB decay parameter, while Hamiltonian error rates contribute through a gauge-invariant quadratic form. Pauli-correlation and active generators are absent from the linear term and enter only at higher order. For the single-qubit native gate set Xπ/₂,Yπ/₂ we derive this quadratic form explicitly in terms of three first-order gauge-invariant (FOGI) coordinates: the two intrinsic over-rotations and one relational axis-tilt error. The resulting formula explains the dependence of DRB on the sampling distribution and the compilation dependence of CRB. These results turn RB decay rates into interpretable functions of experimentally meaningful elementary error rates.
articles.abstract_zh: 随机基准测试（RB）在门依赖噪声下难以解释其衰减参数。本文通过将每个噪声门分解为理想作用和误差生成器的指数形式，研究了小门局部马尔可夫噪声下RB和相关随机电路基准测试。研究表明，Pauli随机误差率对RB衰减参数呈线性贡献，而哈密顿量误差率通过规范不变的二次形式贡献。对于单量子比特原生门集，推导出了二次形式，解释了DRB对采样分布和编译的依赖性。
authors: Anthony M. Polloreno, Timothy Proctor, Robin Blume-Kohout

articles.title: ArcTN: Efficient Tensor-Network Contraction Planning for Quantum Circuit Simulation
articles.title_zh: ArcTN：用于量子电路模拟的高效张量网络收缩规划
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31554v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tensor-network simulation of quantum circuits depends on contraction orders with low computational cost and small intermediate tensors, found without excessive planning time. We present ArcTN, a contraction-order optimization framework with two search presets. Light keeps planning overhead low, and Heavy spends more effort on refinement. Both combine randomized-greedy construction, subtree reconfiguration, and parallel tempering with stage-specific stopping rules. ArcTN also provides Fixed and Dynamic slicing to meet tensor-size limits and executes the returned orders. On the 30 QC32 quantum-circuit networks completed by all eight compared configurations, Light reduces FLOPs by 61.32% and plans 1.62× faster than Cotengra Auto/CMA-ES, and Heavy reduces FLOPs by 43.83% and plans 7.21× faster than Cotengra AutoHQ/Optuna. Heavy also needs 11.85% fewer FLOPs than OMECO TreeSA-8 and plans 1.33× faster. Dynamic slicing meets the size limits in all 90 runs on 18 scalar-output networks and reduces total sliced FLOPs by 31.99% relative to Fixed slicing, at the cost of longer planning. With a common NumPy executor, Heavy has the lowest combined planning and execution time among five configurations on the runs that all of them completed. On 672 networks built from 320 MQT Bench circuits, Heavy obtains the lowest geometric-mean FLOPs on the 142 large networks while planning 3.1× and 31× faster than Cotengra AutoHQ and Hyper128.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子电路的张量网络模拟依赖于低计算成本和小型中间张量的收缩顺序。本文提出了ArcTN，一个具有两种搜索预设的收缩顺序优化框架，结合了随机贪婪构造、子树重配置和并行退火。ArcTN还提供固定和动态切片以满足张量大小限制。实验结果表明，ArcTN在计算量和规划时间方面均优于现有方法，动态切片显著减少了总切片浮点运算次数。
authors: Zhengyi Liu, Li Liu, Songtao Liu, Xianglong Liu, Xiangzhen Zhou, Mingyu Huang, Dingchao Gao, Shenggang Ying, Ji Guan, Bolong Chen

articles.title: Size-independent Logarithmic Sobolev Inequalities for Quantum Gibbs Samplers
articles.title_zh: 量子吉布斯采样器的尺寸无关对数Sobolev不等式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31571v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a new method for proving L² and modified logarithmic Sobolev inequalities with constants independent of system size for quantum Gibbs samplers whose Lindblad generators satisfy Kubo-Martin-Schwinger (KMS) detailed balance. We first establish the L² logarithmic Sobolev inequality by transporting it along a temperature-dependent path from the infinite-temperature product state to the target Gibbs state while maintaining a size-independent decay rate for the sandwiched Rényi-2 divergence. A tensor-power argument, combined with the quantum asymptotic equipartition property, then transfers this decay bound to relative entropy, yielding the modified logarithmic Sobolev inequality. This approach provides a general framework for proving size-independent logarithmic Sobolev inequalities for quantum Gibbs samplers. We apply it to two regimes: one-dimensional quantum spin chains at every finite temperature, and finite-range quantum spin systems at sufficiently high temperature in any fixed dimension.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新方法，用于证明量子吉布斯采样器的L²和修正对数Sobolev不等式，其常数与系统大小无关。该方法通过沿温度依赖路径传输，从无限温度乘积态到目标吉布斯态，同时保持夹心Rényi-2散度的尺寸无关衰减率。结合张量幂论证和量子渐近均分性质，将此衰减界限转移到相对熵，得到了修正对数Sobolev不等式。该框架适用于一维量子自旋链和任意固定维度下足够高温的有限范围量子自旋系统。
authors: Hongrui Chen, Zhiyan Ding, Jianfeng Lu

articles.title: Mixed State Deep Thermalization under Generic Quantum Errors
articles.title_zh: 泛型量子误差下的混合态深度热化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31580v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pure-state deep thermalization predicts that, after sufficient scrambling, projected ensembles approach universal distributions that contain information beyond the reduced density matrix. In realistic quantum systems, however, noise is unavoidable and the projected states are generally mixed. Whether mixed-state deep thermalization admits an analogous universal limiting distribution has remained unclear. Here we answer this question for quantum dynamics containing local quantum channels, i.e., errors. We show that the late-time mixed-state projected ensemble is completely determined by the normalized Choi state of the error channel and is universal, independent of the microscopic details of the underlying unitary dynamics. We establish this result analytically for dual-unitary circuits, global Haar-random dynamics, and local Haar-random circuits at large local dimension, and verify it numerically in qubit circuits and kicked Ising dynamics. In a solvable setting, we further find exponentially fast convergence to the limiting ensemble. Our results extend deep thermalization to noisy quantum dynamics and establish a direct correspondence between quantum errors and universal random mixed-state ensembles.
articles.abstract_zh: 纯态深度热化预测投影系综会趋近于通用分布，但在实际量子系统中，噪声导致投影态通常是混合态。本文研究了包含局部量子通道（即误差）的量子动力学中的混合态深度热化。研究表明，晚期混合态投影系综完全由误差通道的归一化Choi态决定，并且是通用的，与底层酉动力学的微观细节无关。该结果通过分析和数值验证，将深度热化扩展到有噪声的量子动力学。
authors: Xie-Hang Yu, Pavel Kos

articles.title: Continuous Measurement of Quantum Axion Dark Matter
articles.title_zh: 量子轴子暗物质的连续测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30250v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We provide a fully quantum-mechanical description of the continuous measurement of wavelike dark matter. Our focus is cavity haloscopes, although our results inform a broad range of axion searches. We extend the input-output formalism by treating the axion as a quantum field, finding how its quantum state is imprinted onto higher-order moments of observables of the outgoing transmission-line modes. We further develop a novel measurement-record formalism, which computes the joint probability distribution of all measurement outcomes and is well suited to studying the axion in the time domain. With it, we compute the exact axion-induced number distribution for the first time, demonstrating that it is not Poisson. We argue that virialized axion dark matter is expected to be in a Gaussian quantum state, and show that number or quadrature measurements can distinguish this from the predictions of a coherent state or even a Bose-Einstein condensate. Finally, we show that intrinsically quantum effects, such as those from Fock or squeezed axion states, are far too weak to detect.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提供了波状暗物质连续测量的完全量子力学描述，重点关注腔体检波器。研究将轴子视为量子场，扩展了输入-输出形式主义，并开发了一种新的测量记录形式主义来计算所有测量结果的联合概率分布。首次计算了精确的轴子诱导数分布，并证明其不是泊松分布。研究还表明，数量或正交测量可以区分维里化轴子暗物质的预期高斯量子态与相干态或玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的预测。
authors: Yunjia Bao, Dhong Yeon Cheong, Nicholas L. Rodd, Joey Takach, Lian-Tao Wang, Kevin Zhou

articles.title: Symmetry-Preserving and Scalable Variational Circuits for the Lattice Gross-Neveu Model
articles.title_zh: 晶格Gross-Neveu模型的对称性保持和可扩展变分电路
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30270v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study variational preparation of ground states and sector-resolved excited states in the (1+1)-dimensional lattice Gross-Neveu model. We construct fixed circuits preserving either total fermion number or every flavor number, and a problem-specific scalable-circuit adaptive variational quantum eigensolver (SC-ADAPT-VQE). Classical circuit benchmarks cover massless and massive systems through 30 qubits, using exact-diagonalization and tensor-network reference results. Imposing flavor-number conservation improves the achieved energies in the completed two-flavor comparisons. Selected massive fixed-ansatz benchmarks with one to four flavors have relative energy errors of approximately 1 × 10⁻⁵ - 2 × 10⁻⁴, smaller than the quoted literature errors where available, although discretizations and computational resources differ. The adaptive pool combines translated bulk and boundary-sensitive generators with an interaction-sensitive cross-flavor family. Selected massive SC-ADAPT benchmarks with one to three flavors have relative energy errors below 2.1 × 10⁻³. For one flavor, matrix-product-state evaluations extend the transferred circuits to 60-400 qubits without target-side operator selection or parameter optimization, giving energy deviations of approximately 0.35% - 1.76% from density-matrix renormalization-group reference values at maximum bond dimension 256. At fixed flavor number, range caps, and append count, the adaptive construction has a precompilation local-factor count linear in volume and a volume-independent shared-parameter count; fixed-accuracy performance at arbitrary volumes remains unestablished. Sequential deflation also prepares low-lying states within a fixed flavor-number sector, with projector fidelities providing a basis-independent assessment of degenerate target eigenspaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了(1+1)维晶格Gross-Neveu模型中基态和扇区分辨激发态的变分制备。研究构建了保持总费米子数或每个味数的固定电路，以及问题特定的可扩展电路自适应变分量子本征求解器（SC-ADAPT-VQE）。经典电路基准测试涵盖了无质量和有质量系统，通过施加味数守恒提高了能量精度。自适应池结合了平移体和边界敏感生成器以及相互作用敏感的跨味族。
authors: Vivan Bhatt, Zhongtian Dong, Kyoungchul Kong, Kwangmin Yu

articles.title: Finite-width altermagnetic quantum rings: angular-channel hybridization and Aharonov--Bohm physics
articles.title_zh: 有限宽度交变磁量子环：角通道杂化与阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆物理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30536v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study a finite-width two-dimensional quantum ring with a quadratic d-wave altermagnetic term, Tan--Inkson confinement, a perpendicular magnetic field, and independently tunable Aharonov--Bohm (AB) flux. The altermagnetic interaction mixes m and m±2 angular channels while preserving their parity. Circular symmetry renders the crystal orientation spectrally irrelevant and makes the two spin blocks exactly isospectral. The resulting same-parity anticrossings are resolved at low filling, and multichannel mixing is found near the Fermi level of highly occupied rings. Independent converged calculations for Nₑ₌₁₄₀₀ and 1800 establish the reconstructed Fermi edge and magnetic response in a finite field window and the persistent current over a full AB flux period. The analytic conventional reference separates radial-subband depopulation (dHvA-type cycles) from finer finite-ring shell oscillations; we do not assign a global Fourier spectrum to unverified altermagnetic field scans. The few-electron thermal response is obtained from an exact fixed-particle-number canonical partition function, avoiding finite-system errors of a fixed-mean-number approximation. The circular model supports an equilibrium charge current but no persistent spin current.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有二次d波交变磁项、Tan-Inkson限制、垂直磁场和独立可调Aharonov-Bohm (AB) 磁通的有限宽度二维量子环。交变磁相互作用混合了m和m±2角通道，同时保持其宇称。圆形对称性使得晶体取向在光谱上无关，并使两个自旋块完全同谱。研究解析了低填充下的同宇称反交叉，并在高占据环的费米能级附近发现了多通道混合。
authors: Edilberto O. Silva

articles.title: Cluster property and entanglement in the superconducting state
articles.title_zh: 超导态中的团簇性质与纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30581v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present the conditions for satisfying the cluster property in the superconducting state. Using these conditions, we show that the cluster property employed when deriving the order parameter of the superconducting state (OPSS) holds true, and that the OPSS is given by {}_Słangle Ψ | hatψ(x)hatψ(x') | Ψ ångle_S, where |Ψångle_S is the superconducting state, and where hatψ(x) is the field operator of superconducting electrons.
