This provides a resolution to the long-standing concern raised by Leggett et al. regarding particle-number fluctuation in the superconducting state. In addition, by considering the entanglement between two particles composed of the maximum geminal of the BCS ground state [J. Phys. Commun. 5, 095003 (2021)], it is confirmed that the larger the deviation from the conditions for satisfying the cluster property becomes, the greater the magnitude of the entanglement becomes. This shows not only the effectiveness of the conditions for satisfying the cluster property but also the justification of the OPSS that has been commonly used.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了超导态中满足团簇性质的条件，并证明了在推导超导态序参数（OPSS）时所使用的团簇性质是成立的。研究表明OPSS由超导态的场算符给出，解决了Leggett等人提出的关于超导态中粒子数涨落的长期担忧。通过考虑BCS基态最大对偶粒子组成的两个粒子之间的纠缠，证实了偏离团簇性质条件越大，纠缠程度越大，从而验证了团簇性质条件的有效性和OPSS的合理性。
authors: Katsuhiko Higuchi, Masahiko Higuchi

articles.title: All-photonic millimeter-wave and terahertz signal core at room and cryogenic temperatures
articles.title_zh: 全光子毫米波和太赫兹信号核心在室温和低温下的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30857v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Millimeter-wave and terahertz technologies offer new opportunities for high-capacity communications, sensing, and quantum systems, but electronic signal chains above 100 GHz are limited by weak sources, noisy receivers, and lossy interconnects. Photonic approaches mitigate these constraints by enabling chip-scale high-frequency components, yet existing implementations generally retain lossy off-chip electrical or free-space links, hindering dense and compact integration for cryogenic or space-constrained settings. Here, we show a monolithic lithium tantalate photonic chip, termed a signal core, which generates, modulates, routes, and detects continuous-wave signals at discrete frequencies between 100 GHz and 2.5 THz. The architecture integrates high-frequency functional modules on chip and uses exclusively fiber-based optical interfaces. Bidirectional coherent electro-optic conversion enables signal generation, detection, and nanosecond-scale amplitude and phase modulation, while micro-coplanar striplines interconnect the modules into an end-to-end signal chain on a single chip. Our modules achieve single-photon electro-optic coupling rates of g₀/2π=10 kHz and peak drive-power-normalized photon-flux conversion efficiencies of 1.0%/mW for generation and 0.5%/mW for detection. It also operates at 4 K in a dilution refrigerator through the same fiber-only optical links. Together, these capabilities establish an all-photonic platform for millimeter-wave-to-terahertz systems and offer a broadly applicable architecture for applications constrained by electrical-interconnect loss, heat load, and footprint.
articles.abstract_zh: 毫米波和太赫兹技术在通信、传感和量子系统中具有巨大潜力，但传统电子信号链存在限制。本文展示了一种单片钽酸锂光子芯片，称为信号核心，它能在100 GHz至2.5 THz的离散频率下生成、调制、路由和检测连续波信号。该芯片集成了高频功能模块，并采用纯光纤接口，实现了双向相干电光转换以及纳秒级幅度和相位调制。这种全光子集成方案克服了现有技术的局限性，为低温或空间受限环境下的高密度集成提供了可能。
authors: Jiawen Liu, Chengli Wang, Aleksei Gaier, Tianyi Zhang, Gabriel Jülg, Yazan Lampert, André Garcia Primo, Alessandro Tomasino, Hua Li, Xin Ou, Ileana-Cristina Benea-Chelmus

articles.title: A Personal History in Quantum Foundations: an Oral History Interview
articles.title_zh: 量子基础的个人历史：一次口述历史访谈
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30998v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This oral history interview provides Yakir Aharonov's personal and conceptual recollections from the 1950s to the 2000s, focusing on his academic trajectory, some of his major contributions to quantum foundations, and his perspective on the development of the field. The interview traces Aharonov's academic career through the Technion, University of Bristol, Brandeis University, Yeshiva University, University of South Carolina, Tel Aviv University, George Mason University, and Chapman University. The interview also traces the development of Aharonov's work and collaborations on the EPR paradox, time-energy uncertainty relations, quantum measurement theory, quantum frames of reference, the two-state vector formalism, weak values, protective measurements, and several other contributions. It includes recollections of meetings and discussions with David Bohm, Niels Bohr, John Clauser, Paul Dirac, Rudolf Peierls, Aage Petersen, and Abner Shimony. Also mentioned: David Albert, Jeeva Anandan, Peter Bergmann, Gideon Carmi, Avshalom Elitzur, Dave Finkelstein, Vladimir Fock, Itzhak Kalugai, Ed Lerner, Joel Lebowitz, Stanley Mandelstam, Yuval Ne'eman, Sandu Popescu, Maurice Pryce, Daniel Rohrlich, Nathan Rosen, Joseph Safko, Paul Singer, Daniele Struppa, Leonard Susskind, Lev Vaidman, Chien-Shiung Wu.
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇口述历史访谈记录了Yakir Aharonov从1950年代到2000年代的个人和概念性回忆，重点关注他的学术轨迹、对量子基础的重大贡献以及他对该领域发展的看法。访谈追溯了Aharonov在多所大学的学术生涯，并详细阐述了他在EPR悖论、时能不确定关系、量子测量理论等方面的研究工作和合作。其中还包括他与David Bohm、Niels Bohr等著名科学家的会面和讨论。
authors: Guy Hetzroni, Yakir Aharonov

articles.title: The often overlooked role of sound in liquid thermal transport
articles.title_zh: 液体热传输中声音常被忽视的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31127v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Formulated a hundred years ago, the Bridgman formula for thermal conductivity of liquids postulates a proportionality between sound velocity and thermal conductivity. This designates phonons as heat carriers in a liquid. Its empirical success has been under-appreciated and its conceptual implications overlooked. It is not mentioned in well-known condensed-matter textbook. Here, we review its origin, its links to hydrodynamic Euler equations and to the fundamental paradox surrounding the parabolic heat equation and its fate across the quantum-classical crossover.
articles.abstract_zh: 百年前提出的Bridgman液体热导率公式，假定声速与热导率成正比，暗示声子是液体中的热载体。尽管该公式在经验上取得成功，但其概念性影响常被忽视，也未被主流凝聚态教科书提及。本文回顾了Bridgman公式的起源，探讨了其与流体动力学欧拉方程以及抛物线热方程基本悖论的联系，并讨论了其在量子-经典交叉中的演变。
authors: Kamran Behnia

articles.title: Realization of a Superleak in a Quantum Gas
articles.title_zh: 在量子气体中实现超漏
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31185v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ultracold quantum gases offer a controllable and microscopically accessible platform for understanding and engineering superfluidity. Yet, realizing a superleak that selectively transports the superfluid while suppressing normal flow has remained elusive. Here, we harness an optical superlattice to realize such a superleak through dynamical selectivity. The superfluid undergoes coherent Josephson transport, whereas the normal component exhibits slow, thermodynamically limited response, resulting in a flow-rate contrast of 500(49). Exploiting this contrast, we demonstrate repeated filtering of the normal component and dynamical purification of the superfluid, while sustaining coherent driven oscillations for up to 100 cycles. Our results establish a controllable atomic superleak and open possibilities for manipulating transport and thermodynamics in quantum fluids.
articles.abstract_zh: 超冷量子气体是研究超流性的理想平台，但实现能选择性传输超流体并抑制正常流动的“超漏”仍具挑战。本文利用光学超晶格，通过动态选择性成功实现了超漏，超流体表现出相干约瑟夫森传输，而正常组分响应缓慢，流速对比度高达500(49)。该工作展示了对正常组分的重复过滤和超流体的动态纯化，为操纵量子流体中的传输和热力学开辟了新途径。
authors: Wan-Ling Yang, Shao-Bo Liu, Xiang Luo, Chao Yang, Hai-Lin Li, Yu-Zhou Yang, Yong-Kui Wang, Bing Yang

articles.title: Orbital-coherence memory in electrical transport and its self-consistent Maxwell response
articles.title_zh: 电输运中的轨道相干记忆及其自洽麦克斯韦响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31390v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: An internal electronic coherence changes electrical transport only when it feeds back on the physical current. We develop a reduced description of this feedback and distinguish its exact consequences from the assumptions required for a microscopic realization. An opposite-parity two-orbital Hamiltonian identifies a current-coupled orbital force. Under an explicitly stated moment closure and collision ansatz, it yields a passive three-state response with an exponentially damped oscillatory memory. The resulting conductivity redistributes a fixed optical weight and predicts a nonmonotonic dependence of dc conduction on coherence damping at fixed remaining parameters. The orbital reduction constrains the coupling and internal frequency through a shared bare splitting, providing a test beyond unconstrained spectral fitting. A charge-conserving spatial extension couples to Maxwell equations through a positive energy balance and separates the constitutive response from longitudinal collective and transverse electromagnetic modes. We formulate complex-conductivity and transmission tests, including the limits of parameter identification over a finite bandwidth. The model supplies a conditional connection between orbital dynamics, transport memory, and electromagnetic observables; conductivity alone does not establish a uniquely quantum mechanism, and a material-specific collision calculation and closure-error assessment remain necessary.
articles.abstract_zh: 内部电子相干性仅在反馈于物理电流时才会改变电输运。本文提出了一种简化的反馈描述，并区分了其精确结果与微观实现所需的假设。通过一个具有相反宇称的双轨道哈密顿量，识别出一种电流耦合的轨道力，并在特定假设下，产生具有指数衰减振荡记忆的被动三态响应。由此产生的电导率重新分配了固定的光学权重，并预测了直流传导对相干阻尼的非单调依赖性。该工作还通过正能量平衡将电荷守恒的空间扩展与麦克斯韦方程耦合，并提出了复电导率和传输测试。
authors: Pengfei Zhu

articles.title: Krylov Complexity and Entropy of Composite Quantum Systems
articles.title_zh: 复合量子系统的克雷洛夫复杂度与熵
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31394v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate the behaviour of Krylov complexity as the number of degrees of freedom of a quantum system increases. Specifically, we show that for tensor products of commuting subsystems, the leading excess complexity is controlled by a weighted variance of the subsystem Lanczos coefficients. This provides a quantitative measure of dynamical heterogeneity and a precise characterization of synchronous evolution. We also show that Krylov entropy is able to disambiguate the information associated with subsystems composition from that generated by dynamical mismatch, and that the same Lanczos variance controls the leading mismatch contribution to both complexity and the entropy. Our results establish excess complexity and Krylov entropy as complementary probes of the emergence of collective dynamics in large quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了克雷洛夫复杂度随量子系统自由度增加的行为。研究表明，对于可交换子系统的张量积，主导的超额复杂度由子系统Lanczos系数的加权方差控制，这为动态异质性和同步演化提供了定量度量。克雷洛夫熵能够区分子系统组成信息与动态失配产生的信息，且相同的Lanczos方差控制着复杂度和熵的主要失配贡献。这些结果确立了超额复杂度和克雷洛夫熵作为探测大型量子系统集体动力学出现的互补探针。
authors: Jeff Murugan, Victor Van Aswegen, Hendrik J R Van Zyl

articles.title: Nanopillar metasurfaces uniting high optical reflectivity with ultracoherent nanomechanics
articles.title_zh: 纳米柱超表面结合高光学反射率与超相干纳米力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31452v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Mechanically compliant mirrors are key components in cavity optomechanics. However, the requirements to achieve the best optical and mechanical performance are usually in direct competition. A high reflectivity for tightly focused beams entails thick reflectors, whereas ultracoherent flexural nanomechanics necessitates thin membranes. We eliminate this trade-off by introducing high-refractive-index nanopillar metasurfaces on top of a thin membrane. We pattern a 50 micrometer-diameter array of nanopillars to form a photonic crystal. The flat band behavior of guided resonances in the photonic crystal enables a reflectivity of 99.82(1)% for a tightly focused beam of 7 micrometer waist. The combination of two guided resonances creates a 100 nanometer-wide high-reflectivity band around 1550 nanometer. Simultaneously, the nanopillar patterning realizes a density-modulated phononic crystal that isolates an ultracoherent localized mechanical mode with a Qḑot f-product of 2ḑot 10¹⁴Hz. The demonstrated nanopillar metasurfaces enable lightweight mirrors for room-temperature quantum optomechanics and for use as levitated mirrors or lightsails.
articles.abstract_zh: 腔光力学中的柔性反射镜通常面临光学和机械性能的矛盾。本文通过在薄膜上引入高折射率纳米柱超表面，解决了高反射率与超相干纳米力学之间的权衡问题。该超表面由50微米直径的纳米柱阵列构成光子晶体，其导模共振的平带行为实现了对紧聚焦光束99.82(1)%的反射率。同时，纳米柱图案化形成密度调制声子晶体，隔离出具有2×10¹⁴Hz Q·f积的超相干局域机械模式。这些纳米柱超表面为室温量子光力学、悬浮镜或光帆提供了轻量级反射镜。
authors: Alexander Jung, Anastasiia Ciers, Hannes Pfeifer, Albert Hansson, Johanna Örgård, Daniel Stachanow, Viktor A. Lilja, Philippe Tassin, Witlef Wieczorek

articles.title: Quantum theory of molecular orientation
articles.title_zh: 分子取向的量子理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2403.04572v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We formulate a quantum phase space for rotational and nuclear-spin states of rigid molecules. For each nuclear spin isomer, we re-derive the isomer's admissible angular momentum states from molecular geometry and nuclear-spin data, introduce its angular position states using quantization theory, and develop a generalized Fourier transform converting between the two. We classify molecules into three types -- asymmetric, rotationally symmetric, and perrotationally symmetric -- with the last type having no macroscopic analogue due to nuclear-spin statistics constraints. We discuss two general features in perrotationally symmetric state spaces that are Hamiltonian-independent and induced solely by symmetry and spin statistics. First, we quantify when and how an isomer's state space is completely rotation-spin entangled, meaning that it does not admit any separable states. Second, we identify isomers whose position states house an internal pseudo-spin or "fiber" degree of freedom, and the fiber's Berry phase or matrix after adiabatic changes in position yields naturally robust operations, akin to braiding anyonic quasiparticles or realizing fault-tolerant quantum gates. We outline how the fiber can be used as a quantum error-correcting code and discuss scenarios where these features can be experimentally probed
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为刚性分子的转动和核自旋态构建了量子相空间。研究从分子几何和核自旋数据推导出异构体的角动量态，并利用量子化理论引入角位置态，开发了两者之间的广义傅里叶变换。文章将分子分为三类：不对称、旋转对称和全旋转对称，其中最后一类由于核自旋统计约束而无宏观对应物。研究还讨论了全旋转对称态空间中两个与哈密顿量无关、仅由对称性和自旋统计诱导的普遍特征，包括异构体态空间何时完全旋转-自旋纠缠，以及识别其位置态包含内部伪自旋或“纤维”自由度的异构体。
authors: Victor V. Albert, Eric Kubischta, Mikhail Lemeshko, Lee R. Liu

articles.title: Enhanced Whispering Gallery Mode Phase Shift using Indistinguishable Photon Pairs
articles.title_zh: 利用不可区分光子对增强回音壁模式相移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2404.17409v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a theoretical investigation of a whispering gallery mode (WGM) resonator coupled to a Mach-Zehnder interferometer (MZI) and show a bimodal coincidence transmission spectrum when the input state is an indistinguishable photon pair. This is due to the doubled WGM phase shift experienced by the path-entangled state in the interferometer. Further, we model the noise in a WGM resonance shift measurement comparing photon pairs with a coherent state. At least a four-fold improvement in the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) is possible, with clear implications for quantum-enhanced WGM sensing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论研究了回音壁模式（WGM）谐振器与马赫-曾德尔干涉仪（MZI）的耦合，并发现当输入为不可区分光子对时，会出现双峰符合传输谱，这源于路径纠缠态在干涉仪中经历的双倍WGM相移。进一步，通过比较光子对与相干态的WGM共振移位测量噪声，结果表明信噪比至少可提高四倍。这为量子增强WGM传感提供了重要启示。
authors: Callum Jones, Antonio Vidiella-Barranco, Jolly Xavier, Frank Vollmer

articles.title: Reducing QPU Calls in Variational Quantum Algorithms via Classical Offloading of Gradient Computation
articles.title_zh: 通过梯度计算的经典卸载减少变分量子算法中的QPU调用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.16361v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Variational quantum algorithms (VQAs) are a promising approach for leveraging near-term quantum computers, but trainability and quantum-resource costs remain major challenges. Here we address these challenges with the Hardware Efficient and dynamical LIe algebra supported Ansatz (HELIA) and two training methods combining the classical-enhanced g method with the quantum-based Parameter-Shift Rule (PSR). This distributes gradient estimation and training across classical and quantum hardware. We evaluate ground-state estimation of 6- to 18-qubit Hamiltonians using the Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) and quantum phase classification for Hamiltonians up to 12 qubits. For VQE, our methods improve accuracy and success rates, with a mean reduction in estimated logical quantum evaluations of up to 60% relative to Full-PSR training of the same ansatz. For classification, the largest improvement in mean peak test accuracy relative to Full-PSR is 2.8 percentage points. We also use these methods as a warm-start pretraining strategy for Hamiltonians with exponential-dimensional dynamical Lie algebras. Gradient diagnostics for the studied Hamiltonian configurations show slower gradient-variance decay than the selected deep hardware-efficient reference over the simulated system sizes, potentially paving the way for training large-qubit quantum models.
articles.abstract_zh: 变分量子算法（VQAs）在近期量子计算中前景广阔，但可训练性和量子资源成本是主要挑战。本文通过硬件高效和动态李代数支持的Ansatz (HELIA)以及结合经典增强g方法与量子参数移位规则(PSR)的两种训练方法，解决了这些挑战。该方法将梯度估计和训练分布到经典和量子硬件上，显著减少了QPU调用。在变分量子本征求解器(VQE)和量子相位分类任务中，与传统方法相比，该方法在准确性和成功率上均有提升，并能将逻辑量子评估次数平均减少高达60%。
authors: Rahul Bhowmick, Harsh Wadhwa, Avinash Singh, Tania Sidana, Quoc Hoan Tran, Krishna Kumar Sabapathy

articles.title: Engineering Quantum-Enhanced Transport by Supertransfer
articles.title_zh: 通过超转移工程化量子增强传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.05045v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Collective behaviour of the components of a quantum system can significantly alter the rates of dynamical processes within the system. A paradigmatic collective effect is superradiance, the enhancement in the rate that radiation is emitted by a group of emitters relative to that emitted by independent emitters. Less studied are collective effects in energy transport, notably supertransfer, the enhancement of the rate of energy transfer from donors to acceptors due to delocalised excitations. Despite its generality as a collective enhancement mechanism in transport, there has been no direct experimental detection of supertransfer because, in most physical platforms where delocalisation arises naturally, delocalisation cannot be turned on and off to evaluate its effect on energy transfer. Here, we show that supertransfer could be directly observed using a quantum device based on a superconducting circuit. The programmability and control offered by an engineered device would allow controllable delocalisation of quantum states, giving full tunability over supertransfer. Our guidelines for engineering supertransfer could inform the design of future quantum-enhanced devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子系统组分的集体行为能显著改变系统内动态过程的速率，其中超辐射是辐射发射速率增强的典型集体效应。本文关注能量传输中的集体效应——超转移，即由于离域激发而导致能量从供体到受体传输速率的增强。尽管超转移作为一种普遍的集体增强机制，但由于在多数物理平台中难以控制离域化，其直接实验检测一直缺失。本文提出利用基于超导电路的量子器件直接观测超转移，该器件的可编程性和可控性将实现量子态的可控离域化，从而全面调控超转移。
authors: Adesh Kushwaha, Ivan Kassal

articles.title: Multi-FPGA Synchronization and Data Communication for Quantum Control and Measurement
articles.title_zh: 用于量子控制和测量的多FPGA同步与数据通信
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.09856v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum computing has grown from novel physics experiments with a few qubits controlled by a single controller to systems with qubit counts that require multiple controllers working in concert. While a few expensive multi-board commercial solutions exist, most open-source solutions are limited to single-board radio frequency system-on-chip (RFSoC). The essential requirements for a multi-board solution are clock synchronization among multiple boards and the ability to transfer data with low latency for performing real-time feedback. In this work, we design a clock synchronization framework to distribute deterministic clock and synchronize the clock counters across multiple RFSoC boards to generate time-aligned radio frequency (RF) pulses used to control qubits. We also develop a data communication system over a fiber link to transfer quantum measurement data among multiple field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs). This clock synchronization and data communication module has been integrated into the open-source quantum control system, QubiC, to enable the execution of quantum algorithms across multiple boards. We validate the design through bench tests and qubit experiments on a superconducting quantum processor. Qubit coherence experiments driven by two clock-synchronized boards show no measurable degradation compared to single-board operation. The data communication link, built directly on raw gigabit transceivers with a minimal custom protocol, achieves a one-way board-to-board latency of 71.2 ± 2.6 ns and enables a real-time cross-board conditional bit-flip experiment, demonstrating mid-circuit measurement and feed-forward across multiple boards well within the qubit coherence time.
articles.abstract_zh: 随着量子计算系统规模的扩大，多控制器协同工作成为必要，但现有开源解决方案多限于单板系统。本文设计了一个时钟同步框架，用于在多个RFSoC板之间分发确定性时钟并同步时钟计数器，以生成用于控制量子比特的时间对齐射频脉冲。同时，开发了基于光纤链路的数据通信系统，用于在多个FPGA之间传输量子测量数据。该模块已集成到开源量子控制系统QubiC中，实现了跨多板执行量子算法，并验证了其设计。
authors: Yilun Xu, Neel R. Vora, Neelay Fruitwala, Akel Hashim, Abhi D. Rajagopala, Gang Huang, Irfan Siddiqi

articles.title: Diffusive Stochastic Master Equation (SME) with dispersive qubit/cavity coupling
articles.title_zh: 具有色散量子比特/腔耦合的扩散随机主方程（SME）
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.18925v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We provide a detailed analysis of the quantum diffusive Stochastic Master Equation~(SME) for qubit/cavity systems with dispersive coupling, incorporating classical input signals and output signals (measurement outcomes via homodyne/heterodyne detection). We show that the dynamics of the qubit/cavity density operator converges exponentially towards a slow invariant manifold. This manifold is parameterized by the density operator of a emphfictitious qubit governed by a quantum SME that incorporates the classical input/output signals while preserving complete positivity and trace. The reduced cavity (resp. qubit) operator, obtained by partial trace over the qubit (resp. cavity), is then expressed as a time-varying deterministic quantum channel acting on the fictitious-qubit density operator. This formulation avoids the non-Markovian descriptions---with temporarily negative dephasing rates or detection efficiencies exceeding one---that appear in several publications. Extensions are considered in which the qubit is replaced by a qudit dispersively coupled to an arbitrary set of cavity modes driven by collective classical input/output signals.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究详细分析了具有色散耦合的量子比特/腔系统的量子扩散随机主方程（SME），并纳入了经典输入和输出信号。研究表明，量子比特/腔密度算符的动力学呈指数收敛到一个慢不变流形。该流形由一个受量子SME控制的“虚拟量子比特”的密度算符参数化，该SME在保持完全正性和迹的同时，整合了经典输入/输出信号。这种表述避免了在一些出版物中出现的非马尔可夫描述，并可扩展到量子多比特系统。
authors: Pierre Rouchon

articles.title: Space-Time Optimisations for Early Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computation
articles.title_zh: 早期容错量子计算的时空优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.08848v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Fault-tolerance is the future of quantum computing, ensuring error-corrected quantum computation that can be used for practical applications. Resource requirements for fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) are daunting, and hence, compilation techniques must be designed to ensure resource efficiency. There is a growing need for compilation strategies tailored to the early FTQC regime, which refers to the first generation of fault-tolerant machines operating under stringent resource constraints of fewer physical qubits and limited distillation capacity. Present-day compilation techniques are largely focused on overprovisioning of routing paths and make liberal assumptions regarding the availability of distillation factories. Our work develops compilation techniques that are tailored to the needs of early FTQC systems, including distillation-adaptive qubit layouts and routing techniques. In particular, we show that simple greedy heuristics are extremely effective for this problem, offering up to 60% reduction in the number of qubits compared to prior works. Our techniques offer results with an average overhead of 1.2X in execution time for a 53% reduction in qubits against the theoretical lower bounds. As the industry develops early FTQC systems with tens to hundreds of logical qubits over the coming years, our work has the potential to be widely useful for optimising program executions.
articles.abstract_zh: 容错是量子计算的未来，但其资源需求巨大。本工作开发了针对早期容错量子计算（FTQC）系统的编译技术，该系统面临严格的物理量子比特和蒸馏能力限制。研究引入了适应蒸馏的量子比特布局和路由技术，并表明简单的贪婪启发式算法在此问题上非常有效。与现有工作相比，该方法可将量子比特数量减少高达60%，平均执行开销为1.2倍。
authors: Sanaa Sharma, Prakash Murali

articles.title: Hamiltonian and double-bracket flow formulations of quantum measurements
articles.title_zh: 量子测量的哈密顿量和双括号流公式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.15412v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce a framework that unifies quantum measurement dynamics, Hamiltonian dynamics, and double-bracket gradient flows. We do so by providing explicit expressions for stochastic Hamiltonians that produce state dynamics identical to those that happen during continuous quantum measurements. When such dynamical processes are integrated over sufficiently long time intervals, they yield the same results and statistics as during wavefunction collapse. That is, wavefunction collapse can be interpreted as coarse-grained (stochastic) Hamiltonian dynamics. Alternatively, wavefunction collapse can be interpreted as double-bracket gradient flows determined by derivatives of (stochastic) potentials defined in terms of observables with direct physical interpretations. The gradient flows minimize the variance of the monitored observable. Our derivations hold for general monitoring described by non-Hermitian jump processes. We show that such reinterpretations of measurement dynamics facilitate the design of feedback processes. In particular, we introduce feedback processes that yield deterministic double-bracket flow equations that prepare ground states of a target Hamiltonian, and state-agnostic feedback processes for state preparation. We apply the latter for entanglement stabilization of a two-qubit system considering a setup with imperfect measurements and feedback delay. We conclude by re-interpreting feedback processes as gradient flows with tilted fixed points.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究引入了一个统一量子测量动力学、哈密顿动力学和双括号梯度流的框架。通过提供产生与连续量子测量期间相同状态动力学的随机哈密顿量的显式表达式，研究表明波函数坍缩可以被解释为粗粒度的（随机）哈密顿动力学。此外，波函数坍缩也可以被解释为由可观测量的（随机）势导数确定的双括号梯度流，该梯度流最小化了被监测可观测量的方差。这些对测量动力学的重新解释有助于设计反馈过程，包括产生确定性双括号流方程以制备特定状态的反馈过程。
authors: Aarón Villanueva, Luis Pedro García-Pintos

articles.title: Dissipative Time Crystals as Passively Protected Oscillating Qubits
articles.title_zh: 耗散时间晶体作为被动保护的振荡量子比特
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.20269v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Passive error correction schemes have so far been limited to static memories rather than dynamical qubits. We demonstrate that a driven-dissipative bosonic system, the Bose-Hubbard dimer (BHD), can encode a persistently oscillating qubit within a dynamical noiseless subsystem (DNS). The strong parity symmetry of the system leads to degenerate stationary states, whose mutual coherence breaks the time translation symmetry, giving rise to a time crystal in the thermodynamic limit. This time crystal undergoes a dissipative phase transition controlled by the driving force, with the DNS present above the transition point. This noiseless subsystem, and hence the qubit, is resilient to collective loss and at most quadratically affected when the strong symmetry condition is weakened. The decoherence from collective dephasing also cancels in the leading order, with the cancellation being exact at a specific drive strength, set by the photon-number difference between the two logical states. Tuning the drive extends this cancellation to unbalanced dephasing. These results establish dissipative time crystals as a medium for autonomously stabilized oscillating qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究证明了一个驱动-耗散玻色-哈伯德二聚体（BHD）系统可以在一个动态无噪声子系统（DNS）中编码一个持续振荡的量子比特。该系统在热力学极限下表现出时间晶体行为，其强宇称对称性导致简并稳态，相互相干性打破了时间平移对称性。该时间晶体经历一个由驱动力控制的耗散相变，DNS存在于相变点之上。这个无噪声子系统（以及量子比特）对集体损耗具有弹性，并且在强对称条件减弱时最多受到二次方影响，为自主稳定量子比特提供了新的途径。
authors: Mert Esencan, A. I. Lvovsky, Berislav Buča

articles.title: Thermodynamic Uncertainty Relation with Quantum Feedback
articles.title_zh: 具有量子反馈的热力学不确定关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.22651v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Fluctuations are intrinsic to microscopic systems and impose fundamental limits on nonequilibrium precision, as captured by the thermodynamic uncertainty relation (TUR), which links current fluctuations to entropy production. While feedback control is expected to further suppress fluctuations, its role within the TUR framework has remained unclear, particularly in quantum systems where control is inherently information-driven. In this Letter, we consider open quantum systems weakly coupled to a thermal environment, in which quantum jumps are continuously monitored, and Markovian feedback is applied. Using quantum mutual information to quantify the information contribution induced by feedback, we derive a finite-time TUR for arbitrary time-integrated currents in terms of entropy production and mutual information. Our results uncover how feedback control suppresses fluctuations together with thermodynamic cost and establish a fundamental precision bound imposed by information-based control. As an application, we analyze a quantum clock model and demonstrate that the clock precision can be enhanced by feedback control in the presence of a single thermal reservoir.
articles.abstract_zh: 涨落是微观系统固有的特性，并对非平衡精度施加了基本限制，这由热力学不确定关系（TUR）所描述。本研究考虑了与热环境弱耦合的开放量子系统，其中量子跳跃被连续监测并应用马尔可夫反馈。利用量子互信息量化反馈引起的信息贡献，研究推导了任意时间积分电流的有限时间TUR，其与熵产生和互信息相关。结果揭示了反馈控制如何抑制涨落及其热力学成本，并建立了信息驱动控制所施加的基本精度界限，并通过量子时钟模型进行了应用分析。
authors: Ryotaro Honma, Tan Van Vu

articles.title: Unified Framework for Quantum Resource Recycling via Instrument-Dependent Back-action
articles.title_zh: 基于仪器依赖反作用的量子资源回收统一框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.03513v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Accurate characterization of measurement backaction is crucial for understanding the limits of reusing quantum correlations in sequential scenarios. Here, we develop a unified quantum-instrument framework that goes beyond simple measurement statistics, explicitly attributing correlation sharing to Kraus-structure-dependent backaction. By tracing operational differences to this underlying physical mechanism, our framework integrates previously disparate strategies. Within this formulation, we derive general conditions for unbounded unilateral nonlocality sharing across arbitrarily many observers. The framework further reveals that Bell nonlocality remains shareable in bilateral sequential scenarios. These results establish quantum instruments, rather than POVMs alone, as the fundamental constraints on correlation sharing, providing a unified conceptual framework for quantum resource recycling.
articles.abstract_zh: 准确表征测量反作用对于理解在序列场景中重用量子关联的限制至关重要。本研究开发了一个统一的量子仪器框架，超越了简单的测量统计，明确将关联共享归因于克劳斯结构依赖的反作用。通过将操作差异追溯到这一潜在物理机制，该框架整合了先前分散的策略。在此公式中，研究推导了任意多个观察者之间无界单边非局域性共享的通用条件。该框架进一步揭示了贝尔非局域性在双边序列场景中仍然可共享，从而确立了量子仪器而非仅POVM作为关联共享的基本约束，为量子资源回收提供了统一的概念框架。
authors: Zinuo Cai, Jianxin Song, Changliang Ren

articles.title: Numerical security analysis for practical quantum key distribution
articles.title_zh: 实用量子密钥分发的数值安全分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.12984v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum key distribution (QKD) promises information-theoretic security based on quantum mechanics and idealized device models. Practical implementations, however, deviate from these models due to unavoidable device imperfections, and existing security proofs fall short of capturing the complexity of real-world systems. Here we introduce a versatile numerical finite-key security framework valid against general coherent attacks and applicable to a broad class of practical QKD setups. It accommodates most relevant imperfections at both transmitter and receiver, including non-independent-and-identically-distributed (non-IID) signals arising in high-speed QKD systems due to the limited bandwidth of optical modulators, while requiring only partial characterization of the apparatuses. We demonstrate the power of our framework by proving the security of a realistic decoy-state QKD implementation with laser sources, providing a practical route towards rigorous security certification of real-world QKD setups.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子密钥分发（QKD）承诺基于量子力学和理想设备模型提供信息论安全。然而，实际实现由于不可避免的设备缺陷而偏离这些模型，现有安全证明未能捕捉真实系统的复杂性。本研究引入了一个通用的数值有限密钥安全框架，该框架对一般相干攻击有效，并适用于广泛的实用QKD设置。它适应了发射器和接收器的最相关缺陷，包括高速QKD系统中由于光调制器有限带宽引起的非独立同分布（non-IID）信号，同时仅需要对设备进行部分表征。研究通过证明一个具有激光源的现实诱骗态QKD实现的安全性，展示了该框架的强大功能，为真实世界QKD设置的严格安全认证提供了实用途径。
authors: Álvaro Navarrete, Guillermo Currás-Lorenzo, Margarida Pereira, Marcos Curty

articles.title: Roto-Reflection Geometry of Pure Two-Qubit Entanglement
articles.title_zh: 纯两量子比特纠缠的旋转反射几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12637v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Pure two-qubit entanglement is usually characterized by scalar quantities such as concurrence. Here we show that it also has a natural geometric form. In the Pauli correlation tensor, maximally entangled states appear as improper orthogonal maps between two local Bloch spheres. These maps are roto-reflections. For partially entangled pure states, the same roto-reflection geometry is recovered after separating the contraction associated with concurrence. We call the corresponding geometric object the Entanglement Roto-Reflection Plane (ERRP). It organizes the maximally correlated directions of the two-qubit state and provides a covariant geometric complement to the scalar magnitude of entanglement. We further illustrate the usefulness of this geometry through partial transposition, where it provides a direct construction of the maximally entangled negative eigenvector and a geometric interpretation of negativity.
articles.abstract_zh: 纯两量子比特纠缠通常用标量量（如并发度）来表征。本研究表明，它也具有自然的几何形式。在泡利关联张量中，最大纠缠态表现为两个局部布洛赫球之间的非正交映射，即旋转反射。对于部分纠缠的纯态，在分离与并发度相关的收缩后，可以恢复相同的旋转反射几何。我们将相应的几何对象称为纠缠旋转反射平面（ERRP），它组织了两量子比特态的最大关联方向，并提供了纠缠标量大小的协变几何补充。研究通过部分转置进一步说明了这种几何的有用性，它提供了最大纠缠负特征向量的直接构造和负性的几何解释。
authors: Stanislav Filatov, Marcis Auzinsh

articles.title: Finite-Shot Operating Windows for Virtual Distillation and Symmetry Verification
articles.title_zh: 虚拟蒸馏和对称性验证的有限次操作窗口
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.15464v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum error mitigation methods are usually compared by their infinite-shot bias, yet in an experiment the comparison is decided by a finite shot budget, by the instability of the estimator, and by the cost of each shot. We derive finite-shot mean-squared-error laws for virtual distillation (VD) and symmetry verification (SV) whose leading terms predict when one method overtakes the other and whose remainders are bounded with explicit constants. For VD the law contains the statistical bias and denominator instability of the quotient estimator, together with the sample size needed before the quotient can be trusted; for SV it separates the floor left by undetectable errors from the cost of postselection. A first-order decomposition of the noise generator shows which error components each method removes. Two such laws give a tie, a uniform dominance, or a trade-off whose crossing budget scales as p⁻² or p⁻¹ in the noise rate p; when the remainder bounds are sharp enough, they turn the leading crossing into a certified interval. In exact white-box QAOA simulations the predicted p⁻² scaling (fitted exponent -1.97) and the sign pattern of all pairwise comparisons (300/300 cells) are recovered, one pre-specified all-instance criterion is not met, and the crossings lie 3--13% above the leading prediction; a certified interval containing the exact crossing is obtained only in a closed model. Gate-level simulations and runs on two IBM backends show why the ideal VD advantage disappears in the tested instances: interferometric overhead and denominator instability move its window beyond the tested budgets, where SV has the lower mean-squared error.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子误差缓解方法通常通过其无限次偏差进行比较，但在实验中，比较结果由有限次预算、估计器的不稳定性以及每次操作的成本决定。本研究推导了虚拟蒸馏（VD）和对称性验证（SV）的有限次均方误差定律，其主要项预测了何时一种方法优于另一种，并且其余项以显式常数进行界定。对于VD，该定律包含商估计器的统计偏差和分母不稳定性，以及商可信赖所需的样本量；对于SV，它将不可检测误差留下的下限与后选择成本分开。噪声生成器的一阶分解显示了每种方法消除了哪些误差分量。两个这样的定律给出平局、均匀优势或权衡，其交叉预算以噪声率p的p⁻²或p⁻¹缩放；当余项界限足够尖锐时，它们将领先交叉转化为认证区间。
authors: Vicenzo Scavino Alfaro

articles.title: Searching for Ultralight Dark Matter with MOLeQuTE: a Massive Optically Levitated Quantum Tabletop Experiment
articles.title_zh: 利用MOLeQuTE：一个大型光学悬浮量子桌面实验寻找超轻暗物质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.00166v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Many well theoretically motivated models of ultralight dark matter are expected to give rise to feeble oscillatory forces on macroscopic objects. Optically trapped sensors have high force sensitivities but have remained relatively unexplored in this context. In this work we propose a new, tunable, optically trapped sensor specifically designed to detect such forces. Our design features a high-mass (sim mg) plate whose high aspect ratio allows its weight to be supported by a vertical beam without excessive heating. We present the first systematic analysis and optimisation of quantum noises in optically trapped systems and show that our setup has the potential to operate at the standard quantum limit with current off-the-shelf technologies. We demonstrate that our sensor could offer unique access to large regions of uncharted parameter space of vector B-L dark matter, with projected sensitivities that could advance existing limits by several orders of magnitude over a broad range of frequencies.
articles.abstract_zh: 许多理论上充分论证的超轻暗物质模型预计会对宏观物体产生微弱的振荡力。光学捕获传感器具有高力敏感度，但在这一背景下相对未被探索。本工作提出了一种新型、可调谐的光学捕获传感器MOLeQuTE，专门设计用于探测此类力。该设计特点是采用高质量（毫克级）板，其高纵横比允许其重量由垂直光束支撑而不会过度加热。研究首次对光学捕获系统中的量子噪声进行了系统分析和优化，并表明该装置有潜力在现有商用技术下达到标准量子极限。研究证明该传感器可以独特地探测矢量B-L暗物质的广阔未知参数空间，预计在宽频率范围内将现有极限推进数个数量级。
authors: Louis Hamaide, Hannah Banks, Peter Barker, Andrew A. Geraci

articles.title: In-Situ Differential-Light-Shift Cancellation for Trapped-Atom Clocks
articles.title_zh: 用于囚禁原子钟的原位差分光频移抵消
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.26398v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Differential light shifts (DLS) induced by optical trapping fields fundamentally limit the stability and accuracy of trapped-atom microwave clocks. We demonstrate an in-situ method to cancel DLS by simultaneously interrogating multiple spatially separated atomic ensembles at different trap intensities generated from a common light source. By operating the ensembles at set intensity ratios and performing Ramsey spectroscopy, the intensity-dependent frequency shifts are measured within each experimental cycle and extrapolated to the zero-intensity limit. This approach effectively enables shot-to-shot determination of a DLS-free frequency without requiring magic wavelengths or species-specific cancellation schemes. We validate the method for Rb atoms trapped in time-averaged potentials by introducing controlled variations of the total trap power and show that the extrapolated frequency remains insensitive to these fluctuations. The technique is general and can be extended to other systematic shifts, providing a scalable route toward improved stability and accuracy in compact trapped-atom clocks and related quantum sensors relying on optical dipole traps
articles.abstract_zh: 光学囚禁场引起的差分光频移（DLS）从根本上限制了囚禁原子微波钟的稳定性和准确性。本研究展示了一种原位抵消DLS的方法，通过同时询问多个空间分离的原子系综，这些系综由共同光源产生不同陷阱强度。通过在设定的强度比下操作系综并进行拉姆齐光谱测量，可以在每个实验周期内测量与强度相关的频移，并外推到零强度极限。这种方法有效地实现了无DLS频率的逐次确定，而无需魔术波长或特定物种的抵消方案。该技术具有通用性，可扩展到其他系统性频移，为紧凑型囚禁原子钟和相关量子传感器提高稳定性和准确性提供了可扩展的途径。
authors: Jan Simon Haase, Alexander Fieguth, Igor Bröckel, Jens Kruse, Carsten Klempt

articles.title: π-Flux Tuning of Quantum Paramagnetism in the Triangular-Lattice Hubbard Model
articles.title_zh: 三角晶格哈伯德模型中量子顺磁性的π-通量调谐
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30290v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We compare two time-reversal-symmetric triangular-lattice Hubbard models at half filling: the zero-flux model and a staggered π-flux model with zero and π flux through oppositely oriented triangles. Although both reduce to the same Heisenberg model at leading order in the strong-coupling limit, their distinct charge fluctuation profiles yield different quantum paramagnetic regimes. Combining a strong-coupling expansion with infinite density matrix renormalization group (iDMRG) calculations, we find that the positive ring-exchange of the zero-flux model promotes spontaneous chirality, consistent with its notion of a chiral spin liquid at intermediate coupling. In the staggered-π-flux model, whose noninteracting limit is a Dirac semimetal, the ring exchange changes sign and disfavors chiral order and we find no resolvable scalar chirality. This renders flux-tuned ring-exchange an efficient discriminator between chiral and non-chiral quantum paramagnets at finite coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究比较了半填充时两种时间反演对称的三角晶格哈伯德模型：零通量模型和交错π-通量模型。尽管两者在强耦合极限下都简化为相同的海森堡模型，但它们独特的电荷涨落分布产生了不同的量子顺磁区域。结合强耦合展开和无限密度矩阵重正化群（iDMRG）计算，研究发现零通量模型的正环交换促进了自发手性，这与其在中间耦合下的手性自旋液体概念一致。在交错π-通量模型中，其非相互作用极限是狄拉克半金属，环交换改变了符号并抑制了手性序，未发现可分辨的标量手性。这表明通量调谐的环交换是区分有限耦合下有手性和无手性量子顺磁体的有效判别器。
authors: Zhaochen Liu, Andreas Feuerpfeil, Ronny Thomale

articles.title: Quantum Phases and Structural Transitions of Bosons in Bubble-Shaped Confinements
articles.title_zh: 气泡状束缚中玻色子的量子相和结构转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30381v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the structural properties and superfluid behavior of soft-core bosons confined in a spherical bubble trap at large particle numbers (N łe 1800). Using Path Integral Monte Carlo simulations with worm algorithm sampling in continuous space, we show that increasing N drives a sequence of layering transitions: beyond the established bilayer supersolid, a third concentric layer of clusters emerges at N approx 1800. By analyzing the distribution of permutation cycles distribution, we demonstrate that a finite superfluid fraction (fₛ approx 10%) persists even in this multi-layer regime. These findings clarify the role of particle number in driving layer formation on curved manifolds, offering a concrete guide for future experiments with bubble-trapped bosons.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用路径积分蒙特卡罗模拟，探讨了在球形气泡陷阱中大粒子数（N ≤ 1800）软核玻色子的结构特性和超流行为。结果表明，随着粒子数N的增加，玻色子会经历一系列分层转变，在N约1800时，除了已知的双层超固态外，还会出现第三个同心簇层。即使在这种多层状态下，仍存在有限的超流体分数（约10%）。这些发现阐明了粒子数在弯曲流形上驱动层形成的作用，为未来的气泡束缚玻色子实验提供了具体指导。
authors: Fabio Cinti, Gabriele Costa, Giuseppe Pellicane, Santi Prestipino, Matteo Ciardi

articles.title: Localization Contrast As a Fundamental Limit of Radiative Quantum Efficiency
articles.title_zh: 局域化对比度作为辐射量子效率的根本限制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30741v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Disorder can localize valence- and conduction-band states to different degrees, yet whether such localization contrast has observable consequences remains poorly understood. Here, we show that localization contrast strongly impacts competing carrier-recombination channels. We illustrate this behavior in random InₓGa₁₋ₓN alloys. Increasing the In content from x=13.5% to x=22% progressively localizes the valence-band maximum state while leaving the conduction-band minimum state comparatively delocalized. This contrasting localization decreases the interband optical momentum matrix element underlying radiative recombination. For Auger-Meitner recombination, however, localization alone does not determine the coupling; atomic-scale disorder also breaks primitive-cell translational symmetry and modifies the momentum-space and phase structure of the states. This generates additional low-Q components and enhances the Auger coupling by more than five orders of magnitude relative to pristine GaN. Thus, we provide a microscopic explanation for the competing trends in radiative and Auger recombination. More broadly, our results establish localization contrast as a mechanism through which disorder can control optical and carrier-carrier interactions in semiconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨了局域化对比度对载流子复合通道的显著影响，并将其作为辐射量子效率的根本限制。在InₓGa₁₋ₓN合金中，增加In含量会使价带最大态局域化，而导带最小态保持离域，这种对比度降低了辐射复合的带间光学动量矩阵元。对于俄歇-迈特纳复合，原子尺度无序破坏了平移对称性，使俄歇耦合增强了五个数量级以上。这些结果为辐射和俄歇复合的竞争趋势提供了微观解释。
authors: Arsineh Apelian, Tanay Tak, Xuance Jiang, Tsung-Yin Tsai, James S. Speck, Vojtech Vlcek

articles.title: Universal Synthesis of Large-Area Hybrid Perovskite Monolayers Enabling Lithography-Free, Low-Static-Power Optoelectronics
articles.title_zh: 大面积杂化钙钛矿单层的普适合成实现免光刻、低静态功耗光电子器件
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30764v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Solution-phase synthesis of monolayer hybrid organic-inorganic perovskites is constrained by rapid out-of-plane crystal growth, uncontrolled nucleation, and strong interlayer aggregation, yielding flakes of only a few μm. We introduce a steric-engineering ternary-solvent growth strategy to synthesize monolayer and few-layer A2MX4 hybrid perovskites with exceptionally large surface areas. By combining alcohol cosolvents with an amine additive, out-of-plane stacking is suppressed. Using (PEA)2CuCl4 as a model system, monolayers with lateral areas exceeding 1000 μm2 are achieved, representing a massive dimensional increase over conventional methods. Molecular dynamics and quantum-chemical calculations show that longer-chain alcohols reorganize precursor solvation, while solvent volatility prolongs edge-mediated precursor transport during annealing. This strategy demonstrates universal applicability across diverse organic spacer cations (PEA+, F-PEA+, PentA+), metal centers (Cu2+, Mn2+, Pb2+), and halides (Cl-, Br-, I-). The large lateral dimensions enable direct, solvent-free electrical contact fabrication via physical shadow masking, bypassing chemical degradation from solvents used in conventional lithography. Planar devices fabricated from isolated ultrathin (PEA)2PbI4 channels exhibit ultra-low dark currents down to the 10⁻¹⁵ - 10⁻¹³ A range, enabling femtowatt-to-picowatt static power consumption, ~ 0.2 pW at 5 V, a 250-fold reduction relative to drop-cast films, while maintaining a high light-to-dark current ratio of 4.3 x 102. This work establishes precise steric and solvation control as a paradigm for scalable, compositionally diverse, low-static-power monolayer 2D perovskite optoelectronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统的溶液相合成方法难以获得大面积杂化有机-无机钙钛矿单层。本研究提出了一种空间位阻工程三元溶剂生长策略，成功合成了具有超大表面积的单层和少层A2MX4杂化钙钛矿。通过结合醇类共溶剂和胺添加剂，有效抑制了面外堆叠，实现了横向面积超过1000 μm²的单层。该策略适用于多种有机间隔阳离子、金属中心和卤化物，并能直接实现免溶剂的电接触制造，为低静态功耗光电子器件铺平道路。
authors: Shankeerthan Kalyanasundaram, Swarit Dwivedi, Sanje Mahasivam, Christopher R. McNeill, Sudha Mokkapati

articles.title: Broadband emitter localization and prefabrication two-photon interference from InAs/InP quantum dots monolithically grown on an InGaAsP/InP distributed Bragg reflector
articles.title_zh: InAs/InP量子点在InGaAsP/InP分布式布拉格反射器上单片生长实现宽带发射器定位和预制双光子干涉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30905v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate a monolithic telecom C-band single-photon platform based on low-density InAs/InP quantum dots grown on an InGaAsP/InP distributed Bragg reflector, with simulated upward light-extraction efficiency exceeding 10% within the 40 nm spectral band. Enhanced light extraction is crucial for wide-field photoluminescence imaging, enabling approximately 3 nm statistical centroid-localization precision of QD emitters due to improved signal-to-noise ratio. The identified charged exciton emitting at 1549.5 nm exhibits single-photon emission purity up to 94.7%, validated by a raw peak-area integration under pulsed quasi-resonant excitation. Under these conditions, photons emitted sequentially from the unprocessed planar structure reveal a raw two-photon interference visibility of 51% of the photon wave packet within the 2 ns time window and 41% over a 4 ns integration window, all without Purcell enhancement typical for cavity-embedded emitters. Combining broadband extraction, high photon coherence, and emitter preselection on a native III-V wafer, this architecture paves the way for marker-based deterministic fabrication of high-quality monolithic nanophotonic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了一种基于InAs/InP量子点在InGaAsP/InP分布式布拉格反射器上单片生长的电信C波段单光子平台。该平台具有超过10%的模拟向上光提取效率，实现了约3纳米的量子点发射器统计质心定位精度。在1549.5纳米处发射的带电激子表现出高达94.7%的单光子纯度。未经处理的平面结构发出的连续光子在没有珀塞尔增强的情况下，显示出51%（2纳秒）和41%（4纳秒）的原始双光子干涉可见度，为高质量确定性制造奠定基础。
authors: Paweł Mrowiński, Jan Śmigiel, Mikołaj Badura, Beata Ściana, Wojciech Kijaszek, Emilia Zikeba-Ostój, Paweł Holewa, Marcin Syperek

articles.title: Chiroptical Valleytronic in SnSe
articles.title_zh: SnSe中的手性谷电子学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30930v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum geometric properties of Bloch electrons play a central role in governing light-matter interactions and transport phenomena in solids. Here, we report quantum-geometric chiroptical selection rules that generate a helicity-dependent momentum-space population imbalance in the group-IV monochalcogenide SnSe. By combining time- and angle-resolved extreme-ultraviolet photoemission spectroscopy with ab initio real-time simulations of photoexcited carrier dynamics, we identify valley-selective excitation at opposite crystal momenta arising from the breaking of time-reversal symmetry under circularly polarized illumination. We theoretically demonstrate that the magnitude of valley circular dichroism is strongly constrained by crystal symmetry through its influence on the quantum geometric tensor, the key quantity underlying valley optical selection rules. The resulting chiroptically induced valley polarization decays on sub-picosecond timescales through intervalley scattering mediated by electron-phonon coupling. Furthermore, we show theoretically that the population imbalance between valleys at opposite momenta gives rise to a helicity-reversible transient photocurrent. These findings provide microscopic insight into how quantum geometry governs valley-selective light-matter interactions, valley polarization, and photocurrent generation in van der Waals materials exhibiting hidden and transient symmetry breaking.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报告了在SnSe中产生螺旋度依赖的动量空间布居不平衡的量子几何手性光学选择规则。通过结合时间分辨和角度分辨的极紫外光电子能谱与从头算实时模拟，研究人员发现在圆偏振光照射下，由于时间反演对称性破缺，在相反晶体动量处存在谷选择性激发。谷圆二色性的大小受晶体对称性通过量子几何张量的约束。这种手性诱导的谷极化通过谷间散射在亚皮秒时间尺度上衰减，并且相反动量谷之间的布居不平衡产生了螺旋度依赖的谷电流。
authors: Yiming Pan, Sotirios Fragkos, Umberto Dellasette, Quentin Courtade, Dominique Descamps, Stéphane Petit, Fabio Caruso, Samuel Beaulieu

articles.title: Spin-Dependent Transport in One-Dimensional Mercury- and Silver-Mediated DNA Nanowires
articles.title_zh: 一维汞和银介导DNA纳米线中的自旋相关输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31508v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Metallo-DNA nanowires serve as a versatile, programmable scaffold for molecular-scale electronics. In this work, we demonstrate that periodic heavy-metal coordination fundamentally reshapes the electronic landscape of DNA, generating dispersive, metal-centered conduction bands rather than isolated localized states. Driven by enhanced inter-layer coupling, where second nearest-neighbor hopping plays a crucial role: the conduction bandwidth can approach 1 eV, more than double that of canonical DNA. These broad bands suggest enhanced robustness of transport against structural fluctuations. As a result of relativistic effects, in these quasi-one-dimensional materials, spin-orbit (SO) coupling enhances band dispersion and governs spin-dependent transport. We predict that although ligand hybridization reduces atomic SO splitting, the effective SO splitting in these nanowires is comparable to the next-nearest-neighbor hopping strength, which results in considerable spin mixing. We find that Hg2+-coordinated nanowire exhibit pronounced spin-flip conductance comparable to spin-conserving conductance across the LUMO manifold. This efficient spin conversion remains robust over extended molecular lengths and is accompanied by a set of highly delocalized unoccupied states with oscillating nodal structures, readily accessible under low-bias transport measurements. In contrast, the Ag+-coordinated nanowires exhibit weak spin-flip scattering that is more than an order of magnitude smaller than spin-preserving transport. This duality establishes the choice of coordination metal as a decisive parameter to govern metal-metal interaction, electron delocalization, and spin-dependent transport. Overall, our findings demonstrate how relativistic effects and quantum confinement intersect in these bio-templated, quasi-one-dimensional molecular conductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作揭示了金属化DNA纳米线如何根本性地重塑DNA的电子结构，形成分散的、以金属为中心的导带，其带宽可达1 eV，是典型DNA的两倍。增强的层间耦合和重要的次近邻跳跃，预示了输运对结构波动的鲁棒性。相对论效应和自旋轨道耦合增强了能带色散并控制自旋相关输运。研究预测，Hg2+配位的纳米线在LUMO流形上表现出显著的自旋翻转电导，与自旋守恒电导相当。
authors: Arpan De, William Livernois, Simon Vecchioni, Yoel P. Ohayon, M. P. Anantram

articles.title: Breathing and quadrupole modes in squeezed Bose-Bose liquid drops
articles.title_zh: 压缩玻色-玻色液滴中的呼吸模式和四极模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.31581v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the lowest excitation modes of binary ³⁹K ultradilute droplets confined harmonically in one direction, which reduces the critical number of particles needed to sustain a self-bound state. Using the density functional built from first-principles quantum Monte Carlo calculations (QMC), which incorporates the effects of finite range interactions, we study the crossover of the oscillation modes from three to two dimensions. For weak squeezing, we observe the coupling between breathing and quadrupole modes, resulting from the breaking of spherical symmetry. Increasing the squeezing, the higher-frequency mode corresponding to three-dimensional breathing mode becomes unstable. For squeezings stronger and comparable to experiments, we analyze the dependence of the excitation modes on the droplet size for several interactions and show the reduction of the number of particles needed to sustain stable oscillations. The differences between the results obtained with the QMC functional and the extended Gross-Pitaevskii theory are increased with respect to the case of previously studied spherical droplets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨了在一维方向上谐波束缚的二元³⁹K超稀薄液滴的最低激发模式，这种束缚降低了维持自束缚态所需的临界粒子数。利用从量子蒙特卡罗计算构建的密度泛函，研究了振荡模式从三维到二维的交叉。结果显示，弱压缩导致呼吸模式和四极模式之间的耦合，而更强的压缩会使三维呼吸模式变得不稳定。研究还分析了激发模式对液滴尺寸的依赖性，并指出与球形液滴相比，量子蒙特卡罗泛函和扩展格罗斯-皮塔耶夫斯基理论之间的差异更为显著。
authors: Marko Korda, Leandra Vranješ Markić, Jordi Boronat

articles.title: Quantum geometry and quantum capacitance in the orbital magneto-electric effect
articles.title_zh: 轨道磁电效应中的量子几何与量子电容
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.02911v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The orbital magneto-electric effect (OME), the generation of a steady-state orbital angular momentum (OAM) density by an electric field, is a central component of orbitronics. Nevertheless its microscopic interpretation is complicated by the existence of two qualitatively different contributions: the intra-band Edelstein term stemming from the combined effect of the equilibrium OAM and Fermi surface shift, and the inter-band contribution, stemming from Zitterbewegung induced by the electric field. Here we develop a pedagogical density-matrix formulation of the OME within the framework of the modern theory of Bloch-electron OAM, in which the two contributions naturally emerge from distinct parts of the density matrix, and their distinct quantum geometric structures are clearly seen. In the inter-band contribution, in addition to the local- and itinerant-circulation terms, we show that a band-diagonal displacement, or charge dipole, is present, which is linear in the electric field and governed by the normalized quantum metric. For a tilted massive Dirac cone the Zitterbewegung OME and the Fermi-surface orbital response occur for orthogonal electric-field orientations, providing a route to separate them experimentally. The itinerant-circulation contribution is identical to the dipolar one, so in a two-band model the dipole accounts for exactly half of the inter-band response, both in the doped regime and in the insulating gap. Our recent insights identify quantum-metric engineering as a route for enhancing orbital magneto-electric responses and clarify the relation between modern orbital magnetization, polarization, and orbital torque phenomenology.
articles.abstract_zh: 轨道磁电效应（OME）是电场产生轨道角动量（OAM）密度的现象，包含带内埃德尔斯坦项和带间颤动效应两种贡献。本研究在布洛赫电子OAM现代理论框架下，发展了一种OME的密度矩阵教学公式，清晰地展示了这两种贡献如何从密度矩阵的不同部分产生，并具有独特的量子几何结构。在带间贡献中，研究发现了一个与电场呈线性关系并受归一化量子度规控制的带对角位移（或电荷偶极子）。对于倾斜的大质量狄拉克锥，颤动OME和费米面轨道响应在特定电场方向上发生。
authors: James H. Cullen, Daniel P. Arovas, Roberto Raimondi, Dimitrie Culcer

articles.title: Benchmarking the accuracy of superconducting pair-pair correlations within Constrained Path Quantum Monte Carlo
articles.title_zh: 约束路径量子蒙特卡罗中超导对-对关联精度的基准测试
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.25858v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ground state properties of the Hubbard model are of fundamental importance to understand the mechanism of unconventional superconductivity in the high-T_c cuprates and other materials. One of the most powerful numerical methods for strongly interacting models is quantum Monte Carlo, which however faces a fundamental limitation, the Fermion sign problem. The sign problem can be mitigated using approximate methods such as Constrained Path Monte Carlo, where the sign of the overlap with a trial wavefunction is constrained to remain positive. Beyond the constraint, additional approximations must be made in order to measure observables for operators that do not commute with the Hamiltonian. We examine critically the most commonly used approximation, back propagation, as well as a recently proposed constraint release measurement technique. In comparisons with a variety of systems that can be solved numerically exactly by other methods, we find that back propagation tends to underestimate long-range superconducting pair-pair correlations. Except in special cases such as one dimension, back propagation introduces an uncontrolled approximation even when the exact trial wavefunction is used. The constraint release technique can provide accurate results, with the disadvantages that it much more computationally expensive and reintroduces the sign problem.
articles.abstract_zh: 哈伯德模型的基态性质对于理解非常规超导机制至关重要。量子蒙特卡罗（QMC）面临费米子符号问题，可通过约束路径蒙特卡罗（CPMC）缓解。本研究批判性地评估了常用的反向传播近似以及最近提出的约束释放测量技术。与可精确求解的系统进行比较发现，反向传播倾向于低估长程超导对-对关联。除一维情况外，反向传播引入了无法控制的近似。
authors: Jodie Roberts, Beau A. Thompson, R. Torsten Clay

articles.title: Examining the Anomalous Nature of Chiral Effects in Thermodynamics
articles.title_zh: 考察热力学中手性效应的反常性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.02079v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum anomalies give rise to novel transport phenomena, including the generation of a current in a relativistic fluid due to the presence of magnetic field or vorticity. We present an exclusive and direct computation of the chiral anomaly in the adiabatic regime within the path integral for a massless fermion on a generic electromagnetic and curved background, including local temperature and chemical potential. We identify new quantum-thermodynamical contributions to the breaking of axial symmetry which induce the Chiral Separation and Vortical Effects.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子反常导致了新颖的输运现象，例如相对论流体中磁场或涡度引起的电流产生。本研究在路径积分框架下，对无质量费米子在一般电磁和弯曲背景（包括局部温度和化学势）下的手性反常进行了绝热区域的直接计算。研究识别出轴向对称性破缺的新量子热力学贡献，这些贡献诱导了手性分离效应和涡旋效应。

articles.title: A Photonic Tautochrone: Spatiotemporal Beam Focusing for Enhanced Nonlinear Response
articles.title_zh: 光子等时线：时空光束聚焦以增强非线性响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.03691v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We propose to implement an optical analogue of the tautochrone property of the cycloid to allow the focusing of ultrashort pulses inside photonic systems. This allows to enhance nonlinear effects, resulting in orders of magnitude increase of nonlinearity-induced phase shifts, while employing low irradiances. Building upon the optical-mechanical analogy, we show how to produce optical limiters for temporal light pulses, and how to implement temporal bistability and even multistability with large numbers of states. Finally, we move this concept to the quantum realm and predict a tautochrone quantum blockade regime with a stronger antibunching.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出了一种摆线等时线特性的光学模拟，用于在光子系统中聚焦超短脉冲，从而在低辐照度下将非线性效应增强数个数量级。基于光机类比，该工作展示了如何为时间光脉冲制造光学限幅器，并实现具有大量状态的时间双稳态和多稳态。此外，该概念被推广到量子领域，预测了一种具有更强反聚束效应的等时线量子阻塞机制。
authors: W. Verstraelen, S. Zanotti, N. W. E. Seet, J. Zhao, D. Sanvitto, J. Zuñiga-Perez, K. Dini, Y. G. Rubo, T. C. H. Liew

articles.title: Work statistics of sudden quantum quenches: A random matrix theory perspective on Gaussianity and its deviations

articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2241 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-22-2241 We show that, for sudden quenches, the work distribution reduces to the statistics of the traces of powers of Haar unitaries, which are random unitary matrices drawn uniformly from the unitary group. For translation-invariant quadratic fermionic chains with interactions extending to m neighbors and periodic boundary conditions, the Loschmidt amplitude admits a unitary matrix model / Toeplitz representation, which yields a work variable of the form W=sumᵣłₑ ₘ aᵣ ReøperatornameTr U^r (and in models with pairing terms -superconducting pairing- additional bᵣ ImøperatornameTr U^r terms appear). By invoking multivariate central limit theorems for vectors of traces of unitaries, we obtain a Gaussian distribution for P(W) with variance Var(W)=frac12sumᵣ r (aᵣ²⁺bᵣ²⁾ and asymptotic independence across different powers. We also characterise the conditions under which non-Gaussian tails arise, for example from many interaction terms or their slow decay, as well as the appearance of Fisher-Hartwig singularities. We illustrate these mechanisms in the XY chain. Various numerical diagnostics support the analytical results.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了在瞬时量子猝灭中，功分布可简化为哈尔酉矩阵幂次迹的统计量。对于具有平移不变性的二次费米子链，洛施密特振幅可表示为酉矩阵模型，从而得到高斯分布的功变量。研究还阐明了非高斯尾部出现的条件，例如多相互作用项或其缓慢衰减，以及Fisher-Hartwig奇点的出现，并在XY链中进行了验证。

articles.title: The Prevalence of Straight Shots in Control Space for Reaching Optimal Quantum Performance
articles.title_zh: 控制空间中实现最优量子性能的“直射路径”的普遍性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28852v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Gradient-based algorithms are often applied to identify an optimal control for maximizing a quantum objective functional by following a steepest ascent path to the top of the control landscape. In contrast, this paper explores straight shots through control space where movement along such a path corresponds to a less demanding monotonic complete climb up the landscape for the optimal objective value. Existing studies of control landscapes have revealed the presence of straight shots, but identifying them required computationally intensive stochastic methods. In this paper, we introduce a non-stochastic straight-shot search algorithm (STSA) that identifies a large class of straight shots. We apply STSA to numerically generate more than 10,000 distinct straight-shot optimization paths and analyze their statistical distribution for each of the objectives of (i) state-to-state transitions, (ii) general observables, and (iii) unitary transformation generation. The results show a decrease in the nearest-neighbor distances among straight shots as the sample size increases, suggesting their prevalence in control space. We further conjecture that the starting locations of the straight-shot pathways on a landscape level set may form connected neighborhoods, motivating future investigation into their underlying topological structure. The present paper focuses on the use of STSA for locating massive numbers of straight solutions. However, the STSA is not a high-efficiency algorithm in its present form, but the discovered prevalence of control straight shots leaves open future advances to accelerate the discovery of straight shots as optimal controls.
articles.abstract_zh: 梯度算法常用于寻找最优量子控制，但本文探索了控制空间中的“直射路径”，其对应于更简单的单调上升优化过程。针对识别直射路径计算成本高的问题，本研究提出了一种非随机直射路径搜索算法（STSA）。通过数值生成并分析了超过10,000条直射优化路径，结果表明直射路径在控制空间中普遍存在，为量子控制优化提供了新思路。
authors: Yiyou Chen, Gabriele Herr, Herschel Rabitz

articles.title: Digital Quantum Simulation of Dynamics in Interacting Fields
articles.title_zh: 相互作用场动力学的数字量子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28993v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Matter under extreme conditions behaves as a non-equilibrium, strongly-interacting quantum system. Such systems are in the non-perturbative regime of quantum chromodynamics (QCD), where their time evolution is classically intractable. Quantum computing offers a promising alternative, but present-day devices are limited in qubit count and circuit depth, so efficient formulations and algorithms are key to scaling toward experimentally relevant QCD simulations. A scalable framework is established for simulating energy loss and hadronization in 1+1-dimensional SU(2) lattice gauge theory, in which a heavy quark traverses a lattice of light quarks. Classical lattice QCD methods are translated into physics-informed circuits to prepare the interacting ground state. The evolution is run on IBM's quantum processor ibmₚᵢₜₜₛburgh, where the charge distribution and energy loss are measured. A further study develops the quantum simulation of the fully gauge-fixed SU(2) Hamiltonian in a mixed basis, a formulation that is expected to remain efficient at all gauge couplings. Digitizing the continuous gauge fields with as few as three qubits per plaquette reproduces low-energy observables with 10⁻³ precision. Scaling to larger systems is limited by resource overhead, which motivates truncations that preserve the relevant observables. Sequency Hierarchy Truncation (SeqHT) exploits the hierarchy in basis-operator contributions. Demonstrated on the adiabatic preparation of the łambdaφ⁴ ground state on ibmₛₕₑᵣbrooke, SeqHT reduces circuit depth by ~30%, suppressing hardware noise in the extracted observables. All simulations in this dissertation are validated on quantum hardware against classical benchmarks. These studies advance quantum simulations of real-time QCD dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 极端条件下的物质表现为非平衡、强相互作用的量子系统，其时间演化在经典计算中难以处理。本文建立了一个可扩展的框架，用于模拟1+1维SU(2)格点规范理论中的能量损失和强子化。研究将经典格点QCD方法转化为物理信息电路，并在IBM量子处理器上运行，测量了电荷分布和能量损失。此外，还开发了混合基下完全规范固定SU(2)哈密顿量的量子模拟，有望在所有规范耦合下保持高效。
authors: Zhiyao Li

articles.title: Evaluation of the quantum Fisher information for large systems via an ancilla
articles.title_zh: 通过辅助比特评估大系统的量子费舍尔信息
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29146v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum Fisher information (QFI) is a fundamental quantity in quantum information and quantum mechanics, and evaluating it in various physical systems has become an important research topic. However, its evaluation in large systems still faces many challenges. Hereby we propose an ancilla-based protocol for evaluating the QFI of large systems and establish the conditions under which this protocol can ``perfectly'' evaluate the QFI in theory. As a demonstration, the protocol is applied to quantum circuits to evaluate the QFI of the Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger state.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子费舍尔信息（QFI）是量子信息和量子力学中的基本量，但在大系统中评估它仍面临挑战。本研究提出了一种基于辅助比特的协议来评估大系统的QFI，并建立了该协议在理论上“完美”评估QFI的条件。作为演示，该协议被应用于量子电路，以评估Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger态的QFI。
authors: Qi Liu, Xin-Yu Hao, Jing Liu

articles.title: Quantum Simulation of Non-Markovian Open Quantum Systems via Low-Rank Kernel Compression and Coupling Dilution
articles.title_zh: 通过低秩核压缩和耦合稀释对非马尔可夫开放量子系统进行量子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29372v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present an error-controlled framework for the quantum simulation of non-Markovian open-system dynamics in Gaussian environments. For a system coupled linearly to a Gaussian environment with zero mean, the bath's influence on the reduced dynamics is completely determined by its two-time correlation kernel. This allows us to replace the microscopic environment with an equivalent bath that has the same kernel. On a finite simulation interval, a rank-N approximation of the kernel yields an effective bath of N bosonic modes with time-dependent couplings to the system. To encode these modes in qubits, we first truncate each mode to its lowest d occupation levels. When stronger couplings lead to large occupations, we introduce coupling dilution, which replaces each mode with several more weakly coupled copies while preserving the bath correlation kernel. This distributes excitations across more modes and trades additional modes for smaller local dimensions. We derive explicit reduced-state error bounds and establish polynomial circuit width and depth in simulation time and inverse accuracy under stated spectral-decay and coupling-regularity assumptions, provided elementary unitaries admit polynomial-cost implementations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个误差受控框架，用于高斯环境中非马尔可夫开放系统动力学的量子模拟。通过低秩核近似，将微观环境替换为具有相同两时间相关核的等效浴，该浴由N个玻色子模式组成。为将这些模式编码到量子比特中，研究引入了耦合稀释技术，用多个弱耦合副本替换每个模式，以在保持浴相关核的同时降低局部维度。该方法推导了明确的约化态误差界限，并在模拟时间和逆精度方面建立了多项式电路宽度和深度。
authors: Hengzhun Chen, Zhenning Cai

articles.title: Photon Correlations Control Quantum Fisher Information in Coherent Multidimensional Spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 相干多维光谱中光子关联对量子费舍尔信息的控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29422v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coherent multidimensional spectroscopy probes interactions and dynamics of molecular systems through nonlinear optical signals. Quantum light excitation has been explored as a means of controlling these signals, raising the question of how excitation-light correlations affect the precision of molecular parameter estimation from the emitted signal. In this work, we show that photon-number correlations and two-photon coherence play distinct roles in encoding molecular information in the emitted rephasing signal. In the weak-emission regime and within the single Schmidt pair approximation, we derive a normally ordered information law in which the joint photon-number moment and the squared magnitude of the two-photon coherence weight the amplitude and phase sensitivities of the molecular response, respectively. For matched temporal modes and mean photon numbers in each input mode, two-mode squeezed vacuum enhances both weights relative to coherent excitation, whereas independent displaced squeezing preserves the amplitude weight but reduces the phase weight. The background population and its parameter dependence also affect the total quantum Fisher information, which therefore cannot be inferred from the coherent mean-field signal alone. We derive a leading-order bound on its enhancement over coherent excitation when the background population is nonnegative and common to the compared sources. These findings provide criteria for selecting excitation sources according to how the target molecular parameter affects the amplitude and phase of the response.
articles.abstract_zh: 相干多维光谱通过非线性光学信号探测分子系统的相互作用和动力学。本研究揭示了光子数关联和双光子相干性在发射的重相位信号中编码分子信息时扮演的不同角色。在弱发射和单施密特对近似下，导出了一个正序信息定律，其中联合光子数矩和双光子相干的平方幅度分别加权分子响应的振幅和相位敏感性。研究发现，双模压缩真空能增强这些权重，而独立的位移压缩则保持振幅权重但降低相位权重。
authors: Chenghong Huang, Yuta Fujihashi, Akihito Ishizaki

articles.title: Semiclassical molecular dynamics simulations of electromagnetically induced transparency cooling of 2D and 3D ion crystals in a Penning trap
articles.title_zh: 潘宁阱中二维和三维离子晶体电磁感应透明冷却的半经典分子动力学模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29718v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motional modes of trapped-ion crystals in Penning traps can now be cooled to near their ground states via electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) cooling. Numerical simulations are valuable tools for interpreting EIT cooling results and optimizing experimental protocols, but existing molecular dynamics codes are limited to the simulation of Doppler cooling. In this work, we fill this gap by implementing a semiclassical model of EIT cooling in a novel MD code. By simultaneously evolving the ions' internal quantum states and classical motion, we are able to calculate the instantaneous EIT laser forces acting on the ions. We first validate our code by comparing the single-ion cooling rate to fully quantum simulation results. Next, we analyze cooling of the drumhead modes in planar ion crystals, quantifying the effects of planar ion motion and a finite laser beam width. Finally, we demonstrate efficient EIT cooling of the axial modes in 3D ellipsoidal crystals containing up to 500 ions. Such crystals are a promising platform for future quantum sensing experiments with enhanced sensitivity. We find that the mode spectra of 3D crystals can be engineered to enable sympathetic cooling of the low-frequency boldsymbolE×boldsymbolB modes. This numerical framework provides a powerful tool for modeling sub-Doppler cooling techniques and for optimizing future quantum sensing and quantum information experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 潘宁阱中囚禁离子晶体的运动模式可通过电磁感应透明（EIT）冷却至接近基态。本研究通过在一个新型分子动力学代码中实现EIT冷却的半经典模型，填补了现有模拟仅限于多普勒冷却的空白。该代码同时演化离子的内部量子态和经典运动，计算瞬时EIT激光力。研究验证了代码的准确性，并分析了平面离子晶体中鼓膜模式的冷却，最后展示了对包含多达500个离子的三维椭球晶体轴向模式的有效EIT冷却。
authors: John Zaris, Wes Johnson, Krishna Balaji Sogathur, Athreya Shankar, John J. Bollinger, Allison L. Carter, Murray J. Holland, Scott E. Parker

articles.title: Encoding a bosonic mode into qubits for simulating boson-matter interactions
articles.title_zh: 将玻色模式编码到量子比特中以模拟玻色子-物质相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29762v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We explore the space-time cost of encoding of a bosonic mode into a set of qubits via various encodings, and their resilience to noise. In particular, we compare the performance of the unary Fock state encoding, an unexplored encoding of Fock states into Dicke states (``Dicke'' encoding), and the binary quadrature encoding. We do so by considering a displacement as well as a simulation of a Dicke model, coupling a bosonic mode to a set of atoms represented as qubits. Using classical simulations, we assess the accuracy and optimized space-time costs in terms of number of qubits, circuit depth and CNOT count of a quantum simulation of the time dynamics using these encodings. Although our study is far from comprehensive, we find that the binary quadrature encoding is overall most favorable in terms of being very space-efficient and relatively time-efficient due to the use of the quantum Fourier transform. Our novel Dicke encoding leads to very shallow circuits, but pays in terms of using many more qubits. We probe the use of an H2-2 Quantinuum trapped-ion qubit device (56 qubits) for displacement and Dicke model simulation in the low boson-number regime, where we find that noise leads to visible deviations from ideal circuit dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了将玻色模式编码到量子比特集中的时空成本及其对噪声的弹性。研究比较了单模福克态编码、福克态到迪克态的编码（“迪克”编码）以及二元正交编码的性能。通过经典模拟，评估了这些编码在量子模拟时间动力学中的准确性、量子比特数量、电路深度和CNOT门计数方面的优化时空成本。结果表明，二元正交编码在空间效率和时间效率方面总体上最为有利，而新颖的迪克编码则能实现非常浅的电路，但需要更多的量子比特。
authors: Maarten Stroeks, Jelena Mackeprang, Yaroslav Herasymenko, Barbara Terhal

articles.title: Injection is all you need: parallel universal logic in high-rate concatenated self-dual codes
articles.title_zh: 注入即所需：高码率级联自对偶码中的并行通用逻辑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.30087v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a quantum architecture that achieves addressable and parallel universal fault-tolerant logical in high-rate codes. The codes are obtained from the flexible concatenation of small-distance high-rate self-dual CSS codes. Addressable and parallel universal logic on the resulting K logical qubits is injected by fault-tolerantly preparing and then consuming diverse logical K-qubit CSS stabilizer states and logical łvert H ångleøtⁱmes K global magic states. Flag-at-origin is used to prepare the stabilizer resource states while a concatenated cultivation protocol prepares the global magic states. These resource states are consumed by Steane-QEC or Knill-QEC teleportation gadgets, which simultaneously perform quantum error correction. Any quantum algorithm with T-depth D_T can be executed by consuming 12D_T or fewer resource states. We benchmark the fault-tolerant preparation of the resource states for several two-level concatenations of the [[k+4,k,2]] H codes and the Hamming [[15,7,3]] code. In particular, we find that the concatenated cultivation offers at least one order of magnitude spacetime reduction compared to cultivation in the surface code.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种量子架构，可在高码率代码中实现可寻址和并行通用的容错逻辑操作。该架构通过容错制备和消耗多种逻辑K量子比特CSS稳定器态和全局魔术态来实现逻辑注入。研究利用Flag-at-origin协议制备稳定器资源态，并采用级联培养协议制备全局魔术态。这些资源态通过Steane-QEC或Knill-QEC隐形传态装置消耗，同时执行量子纠错。基准测试结果表明，级联培养协议在时空开销上比传统培养协议至少减少了一个数量级。
authors: Joseph Sullivan, David Amaro, Michael A. Perlin

articles.title: Engineering Low-Latency, High-Throughput Quantum Decoders on NVIDIA GPUs
articles.title_zh: 在NVIDIA GPU上设计低延迟、高吞吐量的量子解码器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28867v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We design and optimize a quantum error correction (QEC) decoder for NVIDIA GPUs, combining Relay belief propagation, a state-of-the-art message-passing algorithm, with order-zero ordered statistics post-processing. Our implementation uses CUDA Graphs to control GPU execution, stops updates for converged samples, and collects unresolved samples in queues for post-processing. We optimize sparse traversal through coalesced message accesses, prefetching, and register reuse, and accelerate binary post-processing with warp-level collectives. In addition, mixed FP16-FP32 arithmetic and INT8 quantization reduce message storage and traffic while retaining accuracy using accumulators at higher precision. We evaluate surface, hypergraph product, and bivariate bicycle code workloads on NVIDIA A100 and GH200 data-center GPUs and a commodity RTX 5080. On the bivariate bicycle code at error probability 0.003, INT8 halves amortized decoding time relative to independently tuned FP32 with a negligible logical error rate increase on RTX 5080. With independent syndrome batches submitted back-to-back to concurrent decoder instances, RTX 5080 delivers 91% of GH200's highest measured throughput with an 8.9x shorter median submission-to-correction latency. The combination of performance optimization, mixed precision, INT8 quantization, and concurrent decoder instances opens a path toward QEC decoder clusters built from commodity GPUs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文设计并优化了一种用于NVIDIA GPU的量子纠错（QEC）解码器，该解码器结合了Relay信念传播算法和零阶有序统计后处理。实现中利用CUDA Graphs控制GPU执行，并通过优化稀疏遍历和加速二元后处理来提高效率。此外，混合FP16-FP32算术和INT8量化减少了消息存储和流量，同时保持了精度。在双变量循环码上，INT8量化将摊销解码时间减半，且逻辑错误率增加可忽略不计。
authors: Stefano Markidis, Luca Pennati, Ivy Peng

articles.title: Mamba Quantum Eigensolver (MQE): A Selective State Space Model for Scalable Ground State Simulations in Quantum Chemistry
articles.title_zh: Mamba量子本征求解器（MQE）：一种用于量子化学可扩展基态模拟的选择性状态空间模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29779v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Predicting molecular electronic structure using Quantum Computing approaches is a challenge in Computational Chemistry. Traditional Variational Quantum Eigensolvers (VQEs) are typically hindered by optimization challenges. The alternative Generative Quantum Eigensolver (GQE) mitigates this by reformulating ground-state search as discrete sequence generation, but its Transformer backbone suffers from quadratic computational complexity, bottlenecking scalability for larger molecules. To address this, we introduce the Mamba Quantum Eigensolver (Mamba-QE), which replaces the Transformer with a Selective State Space Model (SSM) to process operator sequences with linear O(L) complexity. Additionally, we integrate a distance-conditioned mechanism enabling the direct prediction of complete potential energy surfaces (PES). Evaluated on the H₂ molecule, Mamba-QE reproduces Full Configuration Interaction (FCI) reference energies well within chemical accuracy, achieving an energy error below 3×10⁻⁶ Ha across 16 geometries with zero variational violations. Mamba-QE maintains high expressive power while establishing a robust, scalable foundation for quantum simulations of complex molecular systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了Mamba量子本征求解器（Mamba-QE），旨在解决传统变分量子本征求解器（VQE）的优化挑战和生成量子本征求解器（GQE）的二次计算复杂度问题。Mamba-QE用选择性状态空间模型（SSM）取代了Transformer，实现了线性O(L)复杂度的算子序列处理。此外，它还集成了距离条件机制，可以直接预测完整的势能面。在H₂分子上的评估显示，Mamba-QE在化学精度内很好地重现了全组态相互作用（FCI）参考能量，为可扩展的基态模拟奠定了基础。
