authors: Atanu Maity, Chunxiao Liu, Rhine Samajdar, Yasir Iqbal

articles.title: Hierarchical Response Theory of Electronegativity from Atomic Mean Inner Potential
articles.title_zh: 基于原子平均内电位的电负性分层响应理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.29765v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Electronegativity, introduced by Pauling nearly a century ago, remains chemistry's most widely used yet conceptually ambiguous quantity: is it a fixed atomic constant, or does it depend on chemical environment? We resolve this debate by recasting electronegativity as a continuous response function rooted in the Atomic Mean Inner Potential (AMIP), a quantum-mechanical observable accessible through first-principles calculation and, ultimately, electron holography. Expanding the AMIP with respect to fractional electron removal defines a hierarchy of physically distinct coefficients: the static electronegativity ḩi₀, the Electrostatic Rigidity R---whose sign indicates whether an atom hardens or softens upon oxidation---and the Electrostatic Anharmonic Modulus A. A logarithmic-derivative decomposition links these coefficients to two competing microscopic channels, electronic screening loss and geometric volume collapse, whose balance governs the response of all 102 elements. This competition produces a systematic dichotomy between softening main-group elements and hardening d-block elements, two scaling laws within the transition series (closed-shell stiffening and principal quantum softening), and two anomalies: a pronounced exchange-driven effect at half-filled d⁵ configurations and a near-perfect cancellation in Ce. It also resolves the long-standing Cs--Fr controversy, identifying Fr as a critical element whose near-boundary response is amplified fivefold by relativistic contraction of the 7s orbital. The framework reproduces the classical Allen, Pauling, and Mulliken scales as well as Lewis acidity trends, and makes three falsifiable experimental predictions. It transforms electronegativity from a lookup-table number into a predictive, hierarchically structured quantum descriptor.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将电负性重新定义为基于原子平均内电位（AMIP）的连续响应函数，解决了电负性是固定常数还是依赖化学环境的争议。通过对AMIP的展开，定义了静态电负性、静电刚度和静电非谐模量等一系列系数。这些系数与电子屏蔽损失和几何体积塌缩两个竞争微观通道相关联，解释了所有102种元素的响应行为，并揭示了主族元素软化与d区元素硬化之间的系统性二分法。
authors: Jin-Cheng Zheng

articles.title: Reducing strain fluctuations in quantum dot devices by gate-layer stacking
articles.title_zh: 通过栅极层堆叠减少量子点器件中的应变波动
articles.abstract: arXiv:2312.09235v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Nanofabricated metal gate electrodes are commonly used to confine and control electrons in electrostatically defined quantum dots. However, these same gates impart strain-induced potential fluctuations that can potentially impair device functionality. Here we investigate strain fluctuations in Si/SiGe heterostructures, caused by (i) lattice mismatch, (ii) materials-dependent thermal contraction, and (iii) depositional stress in the metal gates.By simulating gate geometries, ranging from simple to realistically complicated, we identify two opposing effects in overlapping gate structures: (a) gate-driven behavior arising from isolated gates vs (b) oxide-driven behavior arising from the thin oxides separating the gates in an overlapping geometry. These limiting behaviors induce strains of opposite sign, pointing towards the possibility of suppressing strain fluctuations through careful design. Here, we demonstrate in numerical models, a nearly total suppression of short-range strain fluctuation through device optimization. These results suggest that strain fluctuations should not pose an insurmountable challenge to qubit uniformity, provided that oxide and overlapping gate thicknesses can be tuned.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了Si/SiGe异质结构中由金属栅极引起的应变波动，这些波动可能损害量子点器件的功能。通过模拟栅极几何结构，作者识别出重叠栅极结构中两种相反效应，它们产生符号相反的应变。研究表明，通过优化器件设计，可以几乎完全抑制短程应变波动，这为实现量子比特均匀性提供了可行途径。
authors: Collin C. D. Frink, Talise Oh, E. S. Joseph, Merritt P. Losert, E. R. MacQuarrie, Benjamin D. Woods, M. A. Eriksson, Mark Friesen

articles.title: Field-Induced Weyl-Like Crossings and Longitudinal Magnetoconductivity in Dirac Systems
articles.title_zh: 狄拉克系统中场致类外尔交叉与纵向磁导率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2402.16859v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the field-induced separation of effective Weyl-like crossings and the associated longitudinal magnetoconductivity in Dirac systems using a finite-temperature quantum electrodynamics response-function approach. Starting from the one-loop photon polarization tensor in a magnetized fermionic medium, we identify a longitudinal electromagnetic mode associated with a nonvanishing pseudoscalar invariant bf Eḑotbf B. We use this response to construct an effective low-energy Dirac model in which the two chiral sectors undergo opposite momentum shifts. Within this description, we derive an analytical expression for the longitudinal magnetoconductivity without introducing an independent phenomenological internode relaxation time. The chiral contribution contains an explicit B² prefactor, while its coefficient depends on the magnetic field and temperature through Landau-level thresholds and Fermi-Dirac occupation factors. The resulting conductivity exhibits a nonmonotonic magnetic-field dependence and an inverse-temperature regime under appropriate conditions. These results provide a connection, within the proposed effective model, between the longitudinal electromagnetic response, field-induced Weyl-like crossings, and longitudinal magnetotransport.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用有限温度量子电动力学响应函数方法，研究了狄拉克系统中场致类外尔交叉的分离及其相关的纵向磁导率。研究构建了一个有效的低能狄拉克模型，并推导了纵向磁导率的解析表达式。结果表明，手性贡献包含一个B²前因子，其系数依赖于磁场和温度，且所得电导率在适当条件下表现出非单调的磁场依赖性和逆温度区域。
authors: J. L. Acosta Avalo

articles.title: Pseudomagnetic focusing of valley-polarized beams in strained graphene
articles.title_zh: 应变石墨烯中谷极化束的赝磁聚焦
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.21056v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In addition to spin, the low-energy charge carriers in graphene have two inequivalent valley flavors K and K' related by time-reversal symmetry, which can potentially serve as carriers for additional information. One promising route of controlling the valley degree of freedom relies on strain-induced pseudomagnetic fields, which couple with opposite signs to the two valleys. In this work, we theoretically investigate quantum transport in strained graphene devices that host tailored pseudomagnetic field profiles for valley manipulation. We focus on experimentally feasible geometries and propose transverse pseudomagnetic focusing in a bent graphene ribbon as an efficient method for generating valley-polarized currents, even in presence of disorder. Our work highlights pseudomagneto-transport in graphene as a viable tool for valleytronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论研究了应变石墨烯器件中的量子输运，该器件利用应变诱导的赝磁场来控制谷自由度。作者提出在弯曲石墨烯纳米带中实现横向赝磁聚焦，作为一种高效生成谷极化电流的方法，即使在存在无序的情况下也有效。这项工作强调了石墨烯中的赝磁输运在谷电子学应用中的可行性。
authors: Alina Mreńca-Kolasińska, Christophe De Beule, Jia-Tong Shi, Aitor Garcia-Ruiz, Denis Kochan, Klaus Richter, Ming-Hao Liu

articles.title: Fast and Sensitive Readout of a Semiconductor Quantum Dot Using an In-Situ Microwave Resonator with Enhanced Gate Lever Arm
articles.title_zh: 利用增强栅极杠杆臂的原位微波谐振器对半导体量子点进行快速灵敏读出
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.00765v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report an experimental study of a Si/SiGe double quantum dot (DQD) directly coupled to a niobium superconducting coplanar stripline (CPS) microwave resonator. This hybrid architecture enables high-bandwidth dispersive readout suitable for real-time feedback and error-correction protocols. Fast and sensitive readout is achieved primarily by optimizing the DQD gate lever arm, guided by MaSQE quantum dot simulations, which enhances the dispersive signal without requiring high-impedance resonators. We demonstrate a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of unity with an integration time of 34.54 nanoseconds, corresponding to a system bandwidth of 14.48 MHz and a charge sensitivity of 0.000186 e per square root hertz. Analysis of the voltage power spectral density (PSD) of the in-phase (I) and quadrature (Q) baseband signals characterizes the system's readout noise, with the PSD's dependence on integration time providing insight into distinct physical regimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了Si/SiGe双量子点与铌超导共面带状线微波谐振器直接耦合的实验研究。这种混合架构实现了高带宽色散读出，适用于实时反馈和纠错协议。通过优化双量子点栅极杠杆臂，实现了快速灵敏的读出，信噪比达到1，积分时间为34.54纳秒。电压功率谱密度分析揭示了系统的读出噪声特性。
authors: Tim J. Wilson, HongWen Jiang

articles.title: Josephson Oscillation and Nonlinear Self-Trapping in Quasi-one-dimensional Quantum Liquid
articles.title_zh: 准一维量子液体中的约瑟夫森振荡与非线性自陷
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.00674v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this article, we study the two-mode method to analyze the Josephson oscillation for a trapped binary Bose-Einstein condensate while taking into account the beyond mean-field and three body interactions. For this purpose, we use the archetypal model of double well potential and study the Josephson oscillation and self-trapping phases in quasi-one dimension. Additionally, our analysis provides quantitative discussion on the effect of asymmetry and dimension. We further corroborate our findings with Bogoliubov quasi-particle method and notice the existence of roton-like mode.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用双模方法，研究了考虑超越平均场和三体相互作用的囚禁二元玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中的约瑟夫森振荡。研究利用双势阱模型，探讨了准一维系统中的约瑟夫森振荡和自陷相。分析还定量讨论了不对称性和维度的影响，并通过Bogoliubov准粒子方法证实了类旋子模式的存在。
authors: Shivam Singh, Ibrar, Suhail Rashid, Ayan Khan

articles.title: Entropy transport through a superfluid quantum point contact: A Keldysh field-theory approach
articles.title_zh: 通过超流量子点接触的熵输运：Keldysh场论方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.00679v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the matter and entropy transport between two ultra-cold neutral Fermi-gas reservoirs linked by a quantum point contact under a chemical-potential gradient. We describe the two leads with a BCS mean-field model and derive the current-bias characteristics for both particle and entropy transport. We compute the out of equilibrium steady-state currents by using the Keldysh formalism. In accordance with previous works in the literature, we confirm the well-known behavior for the particle current and extend the computation to the entropy current in the BCS regime. The entropy current shows an oscillatory behavior at low voltage in the ballistic junction limit. We analyze the results for a wide range of values of the junction's transparency. We also compare our findings with experimental results in cold atomic gases in the unitary regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用Keldysh场论方法，研究了在化学势梯度下，通过量子点接触连接的两个超冷中性费米气体储层之间的物质和熵输运。研究基于BCS平均场模型，推导了粒子和熵输运的电流-偏置特性。结果显示，在弹道结限下，熵流在低电压时表现出振荡行为。研究还分析了不同结透明度下的结果，并与超冷原子气体的实验结果进行了比较。

articles.abstract: Author(s): Jingkai Quan, Chongxiao Fan, Benshu Fan, I-Te Lu, Dante M. Kennes, and Angel Rubio Cavity vacuum fluctuations offer a promising route to modifying material properties without external driving, yet a general framework for predicting the resulting symmetry breaking is lacking. Here, the authors analyze the Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian to establish symmetry rules for light-matter interactions with linearly polarized cavity modes, and classify their effects across all 32 crystallographic point groups. Quantum electrodynamical density functional theory calculations demonstrate these rules through cavity-induced band splitting and modified vibrational spectra, providing general guidelines for symmetry-guided cavity materials engineering. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 245129] Published Thu Oct 22, 2026

articles.title: Polynomial-Time Classical Simulation of BosonSampling under Any Constant-Fraction Photon Loss
articles.title_zh: 任意恒定比例光子损耗下玻色采样算法的多项式时间经典模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27065v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding how photon loss changes the classical complexity of BosonSampling is central to assessing the robustness of near-term photonic quantum advantage. In this work, we present a polynomial-time classical simulation algorithm for lossy BosonSampling that applies whenever a constant fraction of the input photons survives. We consider the standard fixed-loss model, where N input photons propagate through an M-mode interferometer and exactly N-n photons are lost uniformly at random, leaving n surviving photons at the output. For any constant surviving fraction n/Nin(0,1), the algorithm samples from a distribution within total variation distance ǎrepsilon of the fixed-loss BosonSampling distribution with probability at least 1-δ over Haar-random interferometers, in time øperatornamepoly(M,N,ǎrepsilon⁻¹,δ⁻¹). We further extend the fixed-loss analysis to the uniform-transmission-loss model and obtain analogous polynomial-time simulability for any fixed transmission rate ηin(0,1). These results substantially extend the known provably simulable regime of n=O(sqrtǎrepsilon N) surviving photons or η=O(sqrtǎrepsilon/N) transmission rate, and demonstrate that even the experimentally relevant linear-survival regime can admit efficient classical simulation under the conditions considered here.
articles.abstract_zh: 理解光子损耗如何改变玻色采样的经典复杂性，对于评估近期光子量子优势的鲁棒性至关重要。本文提出了一种针对损耗玻色采样的多项式时间经典模拟算法，适用于任何恒定比例的输入光子存活情况。该算法显著扩展了已知可证明模拟的范围，为评估光子量子计算的实际可行性提供了重要理论基础。
authors: Byeongseon Go, Hyunseok Jeong

articles.title: Cavity models of non-Abelian gauge theories
articles.title_zh: 非阿贝尔规范理论的腔模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27070v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In quantum optics and related fields, cavity quantum electrodynamics provides a powerful framework for modeling the low-energy properties of bound charges coupled to electromagnetic fields, using a minimal set of atomic levels and isolated photonic modes. Here, we develop a similar framework for non-Abelian gauge theories, focusing on the pure-gauge dynamics of SU(2) fields as the conceptually simplest example. Starting from the corresponding Yang-Mills Lagrangian, we derive an SU(2) cavity Hamiltonian in the Coulomb gauge, represented in terms of only three localized bosonic modes. Unlike its non-interacting electromagnetic counterpart, this model exhibits a nontrivial excitation spectrum featuring bound composite gauge particles ('glueballs') as the lowest-energy configurations. We extend this framework to one-dimensional arrays of coupled SU(2) cavities and discuss the driven excitation of a glueball condensate and the clustering of multi-glueball states as two elementary interaction-induced processes in these models. These examples offer a glimpse into the multitude of novel many-body phenomena that arise within this cavity SU(2) framework and we show how this physics at the interface between particle physics and quantum optics can be experimentally explored using state-of-the-art superconducting quantum circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 在量子光学领域，腔量子电动力学为建模束缚电荷与电磁场耦合的低能特性提供了强大框架。本文为非阿贝尔规范理论开发了类似的框架，以SU(2)场的纯规范动力学为例。该模型展示了非平凡的激发谱，其中束缚复合规范粒子（“胶球”）是最低能量构型。该框架扩展到耦合SU(2)腔的一维阵列，并讨论了胶球凝聚体的驱动激发和多胶球态的聚集。
authors: Lucia Valor, Jacquelin Luneau, Klaus Liegener, Stefan Filipp, Peter Rabl

articles.title: The next phase of quantum energy science: from mechanisms to applications
articles.title_zh: 量子能源科学的下一阶段：从机制到应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27165v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A growing research community spanning quantum batteries, molecular and excitonic energy transport, polaritonics, quantum materials and nuclear control has begun to describe its work in terms of quantum energy or quantum energy science. What connects these otherwise disparate efforts is the deliberate use of quantum states, couplings, collective effects and engineered environments to control energetic states and pathways. A key difference from quantum information science is that the complete quantum state does not always need to be preserved; engineered dissipation or dephasing can even improve the desired outcome. We organize this emerging domain through a framework that connects mechanisms, functions, capabilities, and applications. We identify five elementary functions (Excite, Hold, Release, Transfer, and Transform) and examine the mechanisms that implement them. The same functions recur from the molecular to the nuclear scale, although their relative implementation difficulty can differ sharply. Moving toward technology, we highlight three engineering capabilities (Storage, Routing, and Conversion) through the performance metrics that matter for their applications. Stretch scenarios illustrate what performance targets could make these capabilities technologically consequential.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子能源科学是一个新兴领域，旨在利用量子态、耦合、集体效应和工程环境来控制能量状态和路径。与量子信息科学不同，它不总是需要保持完整的量子态，甚至可以通过耗散或退相干来优化结果。本文提出了一个连接机制、功能、能力和应用的框架，并识别了激发、保持、释放、传输和转换五种基本功能。该工作还探讨了存储、路由和转换三种工程能力，以推动量子能源技术的发展。
authors: Florian Metzler, Matt K. Lilley, Matthew C. DeCapua, Peter L. Hagelstein, Jonah F. Messinger, Nicola Galvanetto

articles.title: Comparative Optical Spectroscopy of Er³⁺, Tm³⁺, and Eu³⁺ Molecular Complexes at Cryogenic Temperature
articles.title_zh: 掺铒、掺铥和掺铕分子配合物在低温下的比较光学光谱研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27223v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rare-earth molecular complexes are attracting increasing interest for quantum information applications because of their structural flexibility and chemical tunability. Here, we compare the cryogenic optical properties of Er³⁺, Tm³⁺, and Eu³⁺ complexes in the same ligand environment. Optical spectroscopy shows differing behavior across the three systems: spectral hole burning is observed in the Eu³⁺ complex, whereas no measurable hole is detected in the Er³⁺ and Tm³⁺ complexes. We measure laser-induced local heating and rethermalization in the Er³⁺ and Tm³⁺ powder-like samples, observing strong local heating and slow thermal relaxation in the cold-plate cryostat. The recovery occurs over several seconds and, for some Er³⁺ excitation conditions, extends over tens of seconds. The comparison across the three ions nevertheless suggests that heating alone is unlikely to account for the full contrast. Rather, the different behaviors of Eu³⁺, Tm³⁺, and Er³⁺ point to ion-dependent relaxation and decoherence processes associated with their electronic level structure and coupling to the molecular environment. Temperature-dependent linewidth and line-shift measurements are further consistent with phonon-mediated broadening through coupling to crystal-field levels.
articles.abstract_zh: 稀土分子配合物因其结构灵活性和化学可调性在量子信息应用中备受关注。本文比较了相同配体环境下Er³⁺、Tm³⁺和Eu³⁺配合物在低温下的光学性质。光学光谱显示，Eu³⁺配合物中观察到光谱烧孔，而Er³⁺和Tm³⁺配合物中未检测到。研究发现，Er³⁺和Tm³⁺样品存在激光诱导的局部强加热和缓慢热弛豫，且不同离子的行为差异表明弛豫和退相干过程与电子能级结构及其与分子环境的耦合有关。
authors: Farhad Rasekh, Sahil, Arsalan Mansourzadeh, Diogo Alves Gálico, David Hunger, Muralee Murugesu, Daniel Oblak

articles.title: Choi-Jamiołkowski isomorphism(s) and channel/state duality, naturally!
articles.title_zh: Choi-Jamiołkowski同构与信道/态对偶性，自然而然！
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27394v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Provided a maximally entangled state vector in HøtimesH, the Choi-Jamiolkowski isomorphism of quantum information theory (or channel/state duality) produces a mapping of mathsf CP(H,K) (completely positive maps of density operators on H tothose on K) onto the density operators on KøtimesH, which extends to a unitary map. Here, H and K are finite-dimensional Hilbert spaces.The nature of this construction, the form of the associated formulas, and the possibility of versions which do not require an entangled vector seed, are illuminated from the perspective of naturality, in the sense of Eilenberg and MacLane.There is a unique such correspondence (``Choi map'') natural in both H and K which produces density operators on either mathsf L(H,K) (Hilbert-Schmidt inner product) or KøtimesH^* instead of KøtimesH. In particular, no entangled state input is required. There are no such binatural maps carried on KøtimesH, but those natural in only K are canonically associated with unitary maps Hi̊ghtarrowH^* and derive from the binatural maps. The construction recovers the standard Choi-Jamiolkowski formulae and shows how they express naturality.
articles.abstract_zh: Choi-Jamiołkowski同构是量子信息理论中的核心概念，它将完全正映射与密度算符联系起来。本文从Eilenberg和MacLane意义上的“自然性”角度，阐明了该构造的本质、相关公式的形式以及无需纠缠态作为输入的版本。研究发现，存在一种在H和K中都自然的唯一对应关系（“Choi映射”），它将密度算符映射到L(H,K)或K⊗H^*上，且无需纠缠态输入。
authors: Paul E. Lammert

articles.title: Systematic Truncated Wigner Approximation for Open Spin Systems Reveals Long-Range Order Far from Equilibrium
articles.title_zh: 开放自旋系统的系统截断Wigner近似揭示远非平衡态下的长程有序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27462v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-range interactions can protect dissipative order against fluctuations, but determining when they do so in two dimensions remains out of reach for existing many-body methods. We develop a continuous SU(2)-covariant truncated-Wigner framework that maps the problem onto stochastic dynamics with one Bloch sphere per site. Derived systematically from the exact Stratonovich-Weyl evolution of the Lindblad equation, it generates both drift and reservoir noise for arbitrary spin S. Benchmarks against exact and tensor-network calculations validate its description of non-equilibrium dynamics and steady states. Applied to 400-site two-dimensional dissipative anisotropic XY lattices, our method reveals physics missed by mean-field and perturbative approaches: vortex-antivortex proliferation destroys the predicted staggered-XY phase for nearest-neighbour coupling, whereas algebraically decaying interactions stabilize an extended Z₂₋ₒᵣdered phase. We obtain the first beyond-mean-field steady-state phase diagram of the long-range interacting model, revealing reentrant loss of order at strong coupling and closure of the ordered region beyond αapprox 3.5. Our new method provides a scalable route to strongly correlated driven-dissipative systems with long-range interactions, higher-dimensional geometries, spin-boson couplings, and spins beyond one half, relevant to modern experiments with magnetic atoms and polar molecules in optical lattices and tweezer arrays.
articles.abstract_zh: 确定长程相互作用如何保护耗散序免受二维波动影响，对现有方法而言仍是挑战。本文开发了一种连续SU(2)协变截断Wigner框架，将问题映射到每个格点一个布洛赫球的随机动力学。该方法能描述非平衡动力学和稳态，并应用于400格点的二维耗散各向异性XY晶格。研究揭示了超越平均场和微扰方法的物理现象，并首次获得了长程相互作用模型的超越平均场稳态相图。
authors: Igor Timofeev, Dawid A. Hryniuk, Marzena H. Szymańska

articles.title: Low-nonlinearity advantage of hollow-core fiber for wavelength multiplexing of quantum entanglement and classical DWDM signals
articles.title_zh: 空心光纤在量子纠缠与经典DWDM信号波长复用中的低非线性优势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27540v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coexistence of classical and quantum light in optical fiber is a key requirement for scalable quantum networks. However, it is fundamentally limited by nonlinear crosstalk from intense classical signals. Hollow-core fiber (HCF), with its intrinsically low optical nonlinearity, offers a promising solution. Here, we experimentally demonstrate the coexistence of polarization-entangled photons with dense wavelength-division multiplexed (DWDM) classical signals with a total launch power of 11.2 dBm, and perform a direct comparison between equal-length single-mode fiber (SMF) and photonic-bandgap-based HCF deployed in a campus network. We observe that HCF suppresses background noise by approximately two orders of magnitude compared to SMF, while preserving high-fidelity entanglement distribution. Our results provide clear experimental evidence of the advantage of HCF and establish its potential as a transmission medium.
articles.abstract_zh: 在光纤中实现经典光与量子光的共存是可扩展量子网络的关键要求，但受限于经典信号的非线性串扰。本文实验证明了空心光纤（HCF）在偏振纠缠光子与密集波分复用（DWDM）经典信号共存方面的优势。研究发现，HCF将背景噪声抑制了约两个数量级，同时保持了高保真度纠缠分发。这些结果为HCF作为量子网络传输介质的潜力提供了明确的实验证据。
authors: Hikaru Shimizu, Arisa Ohno, Mao Miyasugi, Yumeno Seki, Naoyuki Funaoka, Yukari Takada, Aruto Hosaka, Shun Fujii, Hiroyuki Tsuda, Masahiro Takeoka

articles.title: Resolving Nonlocal State Reduction via Induced Coherence in Frequency-Comb Biphoton Sources
articles.title_zh: 通过频率梳双光子源中的诱导相干性解决非局域态约化问题
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27602v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: How macroscopic definite outcomes and nonlocal correlations emerge from entangled superpositions across spacelike-separated regions without superluminal action or it ad hoc wavefunction collapse remains a defining open question in the foundations of quantum mechanics. Here, we resolve this century-long paradox within linear relativistic quantum electrodynamics by developing an open-system and measurement-defined framework realized in dual, spacelike-separated nonlinear crystals driven synchronously by a multi-mode optical frequency comb and seeded by an ultra-narrow coherent laser. Expanding the transverse electromagnetic vector potential into discrete single-photon frequency-comb supermodes, we show that tracing out the unmeasured continuous-wave idler field yields an exact spatial dephasing Lindblad master equation whose decoherence rate is governed by the non-orthogonal state overlap of single-photon-added coherent states. Connecting this open-system map to free-vector-space quotient measurement theory, we demonstrate that single-particle interference arises from the geometric projection of the composite state onto detector-defined conditional cosets rather than remote collapse, establishing strict operational equivalence across pump, seed, and signal phase scans. The resulting wave-particle-entanglement triality equality P² + E² + V² = 1 is saturated across the complete parameter space, while the atomic-clock-referenced comb structure anchors continuous-variable time-frequency displacement stabilizers directly at the hardware layer. Our work unifies induced coherence, Bohr's complementarity, and quotient measurement theory, providing a microscopic pathway toward fault-tolerant bosonic quantum information processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子力学基础中的一个核心问题是，宏观确定性结果和非局域关联如何从类空间隔区域的纠缠叠加中产生，而无需超光速作用或波函数特设坍缩。本文在线性相对论量子电动力学框架内，通过开发一个开放系统和测量定义的框架来解决这一百年悖论。研究表明，通过追踪未测量的连续波闲频场，可以得到一个精确的空间退相干Lindblad主方程，其退相干速率由单光子相干态的非正交态重叠决定。
authors: Tai Hyun Yoon

articles.title: Controlled-Z Gates via Floquet Coupling to Two Auxiliary States in Transmon Circuits
articles.title_zh: 通过Floquet耦合到Transmon电路中两个辅助态实现受控-Z门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27834v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-fidelity entangling gates are essential for quantum information processing. In transmon circuits, higher excited states provide additional pathways for engineering interactions within the computational subspace. Here we demonstrate controlled-Z (CZ) gates that exploit two noncomputational states, ket02 and ket20, through selective Floquet coupling. The nontrivial parametric modulation can activate both auxiliary transitions from ket11 while suppressing the leading exchange between ket01 and ket10. Based on this approach, we develop two gate protocols: a nonadiabatic round trip through a bright auxiliary superposition and adiabatic evolution along a zero-energy dark state, both achieving average gate fidelities above 99.99% in numerical simulations. Control of the modulation phase further extends the bright-state protocol to conventional and unconventional geometric CZ gates. Effective-model simulations show that unconventional control improves tolerance to residual ZZ coupling and static qubit-frequency offsets relative to conventional control over the parameter ranges examined. Simulations including neighboring spectator qubits show that the original nonadiabatic bright-state and adiabatic dark-state CZ protocols retain high gate fidelities. This framework offers new routes toward the experimental realization of CZ gates and their geometric implementations.
articles.abstract_zh: 高保真纠缠门是量子信息处理的关键。本文演示了在Transmon电路中利用两个非计算态|02⟩和|20⟩，通过选择性Floquet耦合实现受控-Z（CZ）门。研究开发了两种门协议，在数值模拟中均实现了超过99.99%的平均门保真度。调制相位的控制进一步将亮态协议扩展到常规和非常规几何CZ门，且非常规控制提高了对残余ZZ耦合和静态量子比特频率偏移的容忍度。
authors: Yutao Chen, Jia-Chi Zhang, Tian-Ming Li, Yu Liu, Kai Xu, Heng Fan

articles.title: Constant-Depth Quantum Barrier Option Pricing via a Static Bivariate Oracle Framework
articles.title_zh: 基于静态二元预言机框架的恒定深度量子障碍期权定价
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27929v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum amplitude estimation offers a theoretical quadratic speedup over classical Monte Carlo methods for financial derivative pricing. However, extending gate-based algorithms to path-dependent barrier options has historically been hampered by sequential path discretization, where tracking price paths across d monitoring dates incurs a linear escalation in qubit footprint and gate depth (O(d)), posing severe coherence challenges for near-term quantum processors. In this work, we present a constant-depth quantum pricing framework that fundamentally eliminates the temporal dependency of barrier monitoring. Leveraging the Brownian reflection principle and Girsanov theorem, we project the continuous supremum dynamics onto a static bivariate joint distribution of the terminal price S_T and running supremum M_T. This allows decoupling dynamic boundary checks into a static bivariate oracle comprising two parallel comparators and a dual-controlled rotation gate. We prove this architecture reduces circuit depth and comparator complexity from O(d) to an invariant O(1), while supporting discrete monitoring via zero-quantum-cost boundary corrections. Transpilation benchmarks for daily monitoring (d = 252) show our framework slashes physical CNOT count by 98.59% (from 2262 to 32) and compresses two-qubit depth by 98.02% (from 1514 to 30 layers). Under a realistic 127-qubit IBM Eagle noise model, the shallow circuit achieves a 7.84% relative valuation error with M3 readout mitigation. Finally, the framework seamlessly extends to nonlinear exotic payoffs lacking analytical solutions, establishing a noise-resilient pathway toward practical quantum advantage in computational finance.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子振幅估计为金融衍生品定价提供了理论上的二次加速。然而，路径依赖型障碍期权的门基算法受限于顺序路径离散化，导致量子比特占用和门深度呈线性增长。本文提出了一种恒定深度的量子定价框架，通过布朗反射原理和吉尔萨诺夫定理，将连续上确界动态投影到终端价格和运行上确界的静态二元联合分布上。该架构将电路深度和比较器复杂度从O(d)降低到不变的O(1)，同时支持通过零量子成本边界校正进行离散监控。
authors: Ji-Hui Mo, Yuan-Hong Tao

articles.title: Microscopically informed self-consistent multi-resolvent closure for dense many-body spectra
articles.title_zh: 密集多体谱的微观信息自洽多分辨闭合方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28031v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The exact multi-resolvent hierarchy of dense many-body spectra encodes higher-order spectral-weight correlations, but closing it predictively for interacting Hamiltonians remains a challenge. We introduce the multi-resolvent self-consistency (MRSC) equations, which separate an exact algebraic hierarchy from an approximate finite-parameter closure. The exact Feshbach geometric identity organizes r-resolvent cumulants into a ladder over irreducible vertices Gamma⁽r), and the projected hierarchy expresses those vertices as functionals of the cumulants. The closure works in finite parameters: a connectivity basis organizes a general Hamiltonian's seed into class amplitudes, and a causal r-fold Stieltjes representation with a moment-field identity reduce moment matching to a finite-dimensional problem closed at a predictive fixed point. On the free-fermion benchmark the tested exact identities are reproduced and the Faddeeva closure is recovered at r=1. In a blind test on the interacting Ising chain, with the exact two-resolvent data withheld, the Hamiltonian-derived closure predicts the tested probes to 0.35%-0.97%. At the observable level the exact two-resolvent sector supplies a sign-correct, energy-resolved correction to the single-resolvent baseline for the off-diagonal eigenstate-thermalization-hypothesis (ETH) variance, of order one relative to it. Closure errors organize hierarchically: a level-by-level deficit decomposition, anchor measurements of the isolatable terms, and an explicit propagation bound. The same moments further yield a diagnostic chain for the window conditions of local rotational invariance -- an exact drift-kernel identity, a proven single-state identifiability boundary, and a transferability census over couplings and realizations -- a finite-order framework, not a proof of universal emergence.
articles.abstract_zh: 密集多体谱的精确多分辨层次结构编码了高阶谱权重关联，但对其进行预测性闭合仍是一个挑战。本文引入了多分辨自洽（MRSC）方程，将精确代数层次结构与近似有限参数闭合分离。该闭合方法在有限参数下工作，通过连接基和因果r重Stieltjes表示将矩匹配简化为有限维问题。在自由费米子基准测试中，该方法再现了精确恒等式，并在相互作用伊辛链的盲测中，对探测器的预测精度达到0.35%-0.97%。
authors: Zhiqiang Huang

articles.title: Ensemble basis-free coherence for quantum communication
articles.title_zh: 量子通信中的系综无基底相干性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28333v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The resource theory of coherence quantifies the quantum properties of states and their role in quantum information processing. Extending coherence theory to ensembles, the natural objects in quantum communication, remains an active research direction, with their operational potential still being explored. In this work, we establish a maximally coherent ensemble in every finite dimension: the continuous ensemble of pure states distributed according to the normalized Haar measure attains the tight upper bound on basis-free relative entropy ensemble coherence. We then prove that ensemble coherence bounds the effective informational advantage of postselective measurements over the Holevo quantity for two equiprobable pure states. Finally, for the qubit B92 QKD protocol, we show that the coherence of Alice's ensemble upper-bounds the secret key rate in the asymptotic regime. These results give ensemble coherence a quantitative operational meaning in quantum communication and cryptography
articles.abstract_zh: 相干性资源理论量化了量子态的性质及其在量子信息处理中的作用。本文在每个有限维度中建立了一个最大相干系综，即根据归一化Haar测度分布的纯态连续系综，它达到了无基底相对熵系综相干性的紧上界。研究证明系综相干性限制了后选择测量相对于Holevo量的有效信息优势。此外，对于量子比特B92 QKD协议，Alice系综的相干性在渐近状态下限制了秘密密钥速率，为系综相干性在量子通信和密码学中提供了定量的操作意义。
authors: Aleksei Kodukhov

articles.title: Floquet ground state order
articles.title_zh: Floquet基态序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28336v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Clean, interacting, periodically driven systems are believed to thermalize to featureless, infinite-temperature states that preclude the formation of stable ordered states. Here, we show stable quantum order, distinct from prethermal order, and its phase transitions in the ground state of the average-energy operator. Decomposing the time evolution into geometric and average-energy dynamics, we apply Geometric Floquet theory to identify the Floquet ground state. We derive a general variational principle to compute the Floquet ground state in large interacting periodically driven systems, and use it to develop a matrix product state algorithm. In driven nonintegrable chains of more than 100 interacting spins, our numerical simulations exhibit a gapped, area-law entangled Floquet ground state in extended parameter regimes; the ground-state manifold can support both dressed equilibrium order (e.g., Floquet antiferromagnets) and inherently nonequilibrium order (e.g., ground-state time crystals). This quantum order is protected by a finite average-energy gap, which closes at phase transition points upon changing model parameters. We decompose Floquet phases of matter into their equilibrium and nonequilibrium elements: whereas the Floquet ground state at any fixed time is a representative of an equilibrium phase of matter, the nonequilibrium content is entirely produced by the drive holonomy and is geometric. Finally, we identify quasilocal counterdiabatic driving as a mechanism for the stability against heating of gapped Floquet ground states in nonintegrable quantum systems, and argue why Floquet ground states evade the Eigenstate Thermalization Hypothesis. Our work enables the study of interacting nonequilibrium matter deep into the many-body regime, and lays the foundations for the engineering of strongly correlated ordered quantum states.
articles.abstract_zh: 周期性驱动的相互作用系统通常被认为会热化到无特征的无限温度态，从而阻止稳定有序态的形成。本文展示了在平均能量算符基态中存在的稳定量子序及其相变，这种量子序与预热序不同。通过几何Floquet理论，研究识别了Floquet基态，并推导了一个通用的变分原理来计算大型相互作用周期性驱动系统中的Floquet基态。数值模拟显示，在扩展参数区域内存在一个有能隙、面积律纠缠的Floquet基态，该基态可以支持修饰平衡序和固有的非平衡序。
authors: Suman Mondal, Paul M. Schindler, Marin Bukov

articles.title: Stable charged energy and phase transitions in an anisotropic Dicke quantum battery with Kerr nonlinearity
articles.title_zh: 具有克尔非线性的各向异性迪克量子电池中的稳定充电能量和相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28373v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phase transitions (PTs) in quantum many-body systems offer a powerful route to manipulate the performance of quantum batteries (QBs). Here, we investigate an anisotropic Dicke QB with Kerr nonlinearity, focusing on the role of PTs in the charging process of the QB system. By analyzing how the Kerr nonlinearity reshapes the cavity level-spacing structure, we find that multiple near-degeneracies emerge at specific nonlinearity strengths. Away from the region of multiple near-degeneracies, the stable stored energy is governed primarily by the ergodic-nonergodic transition (ENET), whereas within this region it is controlled by first- and second-order dissipative phase transitions (DPTs). We employ Liouvillian spectral theory to quantify the critical slowing down associated with the DPTs, and use the Wigner function to characterize the properties of the cavity field in the vicinity of criticality. We optimize the charging process via reinforcement learning (RL) and reveal the physical mechanism underlying performance enhancement from the perspective of ergodic and nonergodic phase dynamics. Our results offer a feasible pathway for manipulating and optimizing quantum battery performance based on intrinsic PT behaviors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有克尔非线性的各向异性迪克量子电池，重点关注相变在充电过程中的作用。研究发现，克尔非线性会重塑腔体能级间距结构，导致在特定非线性强度下出现多重近简并。稳定的存储能量主要由遍历-非遍历转变控制，但在多重近简并区域内则由一阶和二阶耗散相变控制。作者还通过强化学习优化了充电过程，并揭示了性能提升的物理机制。
authors: Shao-Fan He, Lv-Ting Gong, Fu-Quan Dou

articles.title: Quantum Simulation of the Static Yukawa Model via Effective Particles on a Trapped-Ion Quantum Simulator
articles.title_zh: 基于囚禁离子量子模拟器通过有效粒子对静态汤川模型进行量子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28453v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Trapped-ion, neutral-atom, and circuit QED quantum computers naturally enable coupled qubit-boson simulations. Boson-fermion interactions arise in quantum field theory, where renormalization is required to obtain finite results. We study one of the simplest examples of a coupled fermion-boson system, the static Yukawa model, on the QSCOUT trapped-ion system. We use similarity renormalization to express the same physics in terms of effective particles described by different values of the renormalization parameter s. This enables us to map data taken in the window of bosonic occupancy that is experimentally accessible to larger occupancies of distinct effective particles. We use this to study strongly coupled, high-occupancy regimes despite limited readout ranges. Using a trapped-ion qubit-boson device on Sandia National Laboratories' QSCOUT platform, we demonstrate the time evolution of the static Yukawa model.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在QSCOUT囚禁离子系统上，对耦合费米子-玻色子系统中的静态汤川模型进行了量子模拟。研究利用相似性重整化将物理现象表达为由不同重整化参数描述的有效粒子。这种方法使得实验可及的玻色子占据数据能够映射到更大占据数的不同有效粒子，从而在有限读出范围下研究强耦合、高占据态。该工作展示了静态汤川模型的时间演化。
authors: Qingfeng Wang, Christopher G. Yale, Edward C. Tortorici, Brian K. McFarland, Daniel Lobser, Melissa C. Revelle, Andrew J. Landahl, Susan M. Clark, Peter J. Love

articles.title: Tuning between collective dynamics and scrambling through initial-state symmetry alignment in long-range spin models
articles.title_zh: 通过长程自旋模型中初始态对称性对齐来调控集体动力学与量子信息扰乱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28462v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-range interactions in many-body quantum systems give rise to a wide range of dynamical phenomena, from collective dynamics well described by integrable mean-field models with symmetric all-to-all couplings, to fast scrambling of quantum information from disordered long-range interactions. Here, we investigate scenarios in which both regimes emerge within a single deterministic, translation-invariant XY spin model with long-range couplings. We consider a sparse powers-of-two (PWR2) graph, where each spin interacts with a logarithmic number of neighbors, and a power-law-decaying model. By altering the initial state via local perturbations on a completely symmetric state, we show that the dynamics changes from collective to scrambling as witnessed by bipartite and multipartite entanglement measures. We characterize this collective-to-scrambling crossover using Lyapunov exponents in the semiclassical regime, and show that the spectral properties of the coupling graph adjacency matrix provide a very efficient tool to predict the onset of fast scrambling. Our results offer a unified framework for controlling the switch between collective and scrambling dynamics in a setup accessible in experiments with neutral atoms in cavities or in tweezer arrays.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了长程相互作用自旋模型中，通过初始态对称性对齐来调控集体动力学和量子信息扰乱的机制。作者在一个确定性、平移不变的XY自旋模型中，通过局部扰动完全对称的初始态，展示了动力学如何从集体行为转变为扰乱。这种转变通过双体和多体纠缠度量以及半经典区域的Lyapunov指数进行表征。研究结果提供了一个统一的框架，用于控制集体动力学与量子信息扰乱之间的切换。
authors: Sridevi Kuriyattil, Johannes Kombe, Andrew J. Daley, Pablo M. Poggi

articles.title: Cumulative locality governs collective quantum charging
articles.title_zh: 累积局域性主导集体量子充电
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28614v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum batteries can outperform their classical counterparts through collective quantum effects, yet the conditions enabling such advantage remain unclear. Using a generic class of free-fermionic chargers we prove that global operators are insufficient for scalable superextensive charging and that a cumulative hierarchy of many-body operators is required, with the structure of the battery determining the degree of advantage. This is obtained by relating the charging power to the norm of the commutator between the battery and charger Hamiltonians and deriving an upper bound only capturing noncommuting terms. Moreover, we revisit the concept of participation number and propose an effective definition that accounts for the relative strength of the contributing terms, correlating it with the charging power scaling. Not limited to quadratic Hamiltonians, our results establish cumulative locality as a key resource for quantum charging advantage.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子电池通过集体量子效应可以超越经典电池，但其优势条件尚不明确。本文证明了全局算符不足以实现可扩展的超广延充电，需要多体算符的累积层次结构。通过将充电功率与电池和充电器哈密顿量对易子的范数联系起来，并推导出一个仅捕获非对易项的上限，作者建立了累积局域性是量子充电优势的关键资源。
authors: Sebastián V. Romero, Xi Chen, Yue Ban

articles.title: Searching for axions with quantum interferometry
articles.title_zh: 利用量子干涉测量法寻找轴子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.13181v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum phase measurements offer a complementary route to axion searches. We show that axion-photon interactions can imprint both Aharonov-Bohm (AB) and Berry phases in experimentally motivated quantum setups. For a coherently oscillating axion dark matter background, the induced effective current generates a time dependent magnetic flux in an rf-SQUID, leading to a measurable voltage signal through the Josephson phase. For representative benchmarks, this AB phase search reaches the minimum axion-photon coupling gₐγγmⁱⁿsim 7.8×10⁻¹⁴~GeV⁻¹ at axion mass mₐsim 10⁻¹⁰~eV, with projected sensitivity that can improve on existing limits in that parameter space by roughly one to two orders of magnitude. We also identify a geometric phase observable in a Mach-Zehnder interferometer with an adiabatically rotating magnetic field, providing a proof-of-principle phase-based probe of meV-scale axions even when they do not constitute the dark matter, although sensitivity on the coupling remains weaker than current bounds with conservative tabletop benchmarks. Extending the analysis to a three level photon-axion quasiparticle (AQP)-axion system, with the AQP realized in a topological magnetic insulator, we find a potentially measurable THz Berry phase dominated by the AQP sector, furnishing a nontrivial validation of the formalism in a richer coupled system. These setups establish quantum phase observables as a useful new framework for axion searches, with immediate phenomenological promise in superconducting circuits and longer term potential in quantum enhanced interferometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出量子相位测量为轴子探测提供了一条补充途径，轴子-光子相互作用可以在实验量子装置中印刻阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆（AB）相和贝里相。对于相干振荡的轴子暗物质背景，感应的有效电流在射频超导量子干涉器件（rf-SQUID）中产生时变磁通量，导致可测量的电压信号。研究还识别出马赫-曾德尔干涉仪中的几何相可观测性，为探测meV量级轴子提供了原理验证。
authors: Tanmay Kumar Poddar, Michael Spannowsky

articles.title: Nambu-Goldstone Bosons and Quantum Fisher Information
articles.title_zh: 南部-戈德斯通玻色子与量子费希尔信息
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27054v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The quantum Fisher matrix and geometric tensor are powerful tools for quantifying the nature of quantum systems. Unfortunately, the formalism needed to compute these quantities is opaque and has limited the development of physical intuition for their behavior, even in the ground state. For quantum systems with continuous symmetries, we know the ground state can be understood in a model-independent and intuitive way from the correlation functions of conserved currents and charges. In this paper, we demonstrate an equivalence between the quantum Fisher matrix associated with the ground states of systems with continuous symmetries and the Nambu-Goldstone. bosons produced by broken generators. We will show that the information metric defined by the Fisher matrix is the same as the Zamolodchikov metric that defines the coset space of the system. Next we show that the Uhlmann curvature associated with multi-parameter estimation is the same as the charge density matrix that defines the difference between type-A and type-B Nambu-Goldstone bosons. We demonstrate these connections in several examples and discuss the generalization to finite temperature.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了量子费希尔矩阵和几何张量在量化量子系统性质方面的应用。对于具有连续对称性的量子系统，作者证明了与基态相关的量子费希尔矩阵与破缺生成子产生的南部-戈德斯通玻色子之间存在等价性。研究表明，费希尔矩阵定义的信息度量与定义系统陪集空间的Zamolodchikov度量相同。此外，与多参数估计相关的Uhlmann曲率与定义A型和B型南部-戈德斯通玻色子之间差异的电荷密度矩阵相同。
authors: Eugene Chen, Daniel Green

articles.title: Controlling Optical Quantum Interference with Plasmonic Metasurfaces
articles.title_zh: 利用等离激元超表面控制光学量子干涉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27226v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The ability to efficiently control optical quantum interference by the same device is a challenging task that promises to enable key operations in quantum information processing. Here, we tackle this problem by presenting a composite quantum plasmonic metasurface operating as an ultrathin non-unitary beamsplitter capable of achieving both single photon bosonic bunching and fermionic anti-bunching interference just by varying the incident photons frequency or changing the design dimensions. The presented metasurface combines a plasmonic grating corrugated by periodic nanoslits that can achieve extraordinary optical transmission with additional nanostripes on top forming nanocavities characterized by localized gap plasmon resonances. The photon-photon interactions are analyzed based on calculating the quantum coalescence metric which accurately portrays the obtained bunching or anti-bunching quantum interference. The presented quantum interference operation is applicable to both fundamental non-classical light interactions and in the design of more applied quantum optical logic gates used in quantum computing and communications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种复合量子等离激元超表面，作为超薄非酉分束器，能够通过改变入射光子频率或设计尺寸，实现单光子玻色子聚束和费米子反聚束干涉。该超表面结合了周期性纳米狭缝的等离激元光栅和形成纳米腔的纳米条带。光子-光子相互作用通过量子聚结度量进行分析，准确描绘了所获得的聚束或反聚束量子干涉。
authors: Lawrence M. Qin, Sky Semone, Matthew J. Brandsema, Christos Argyropoulos

articles.title: Orchestrating Key Scarcity: Global Capacity Allocation in Hybrid QKD-PQC Networks
articles.title_zh: 协调密钥稀缺性：混合QKD-PQC网络中的全局容量分配
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27332v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This article presents a Distributed Key Management System (DKMS) that provisions quantum-safe symmetric encryption keys to applications across a network. To overcome the distance and rate limitations inherent to Quantum Key Distribution (QKD), the architecture adopts a hybrid design: it utilizes multi-hop trusted relays for physical key transport, while applying an end-to-end Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) layer to ensure the relayed key material remains strictly protected from intermediate nodes. Because QKD transforms key generation into a scarce physical resource, managing unpredictable application demands poses a critical capacity allocation problem. The core contribution of this work is an SDN-driven control plane that globally orchestrates the network. Rather than relying on vulnerable hop-by-hop capacity reservations, a central controller simultaneously computes optimal filling rates and multipath routing for all per-peer key buffers. This global orchestration ensures that no application is starved and that all key buffers synchronize their filling processes. Evaluated on a Kubernetes-based digital twin across five distinct network topologies, the controller successfully filled all key buffers to capacity in under six minutes. Furthermore, under deliberately excessive demand, the network demonstrated graceful degradation, safely rejecting excess requests through controlled rate-limiting rather than experiencing catastrophic failure.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种分布式密钥管理系统（DKMS），用于在网络中为应用程序提供量子安全的对称加密密钥。为克服量子密钥分发（QKD）的距离和速率限制，该系统采用混合设计，结合多跳可信中继和端到端后量子密码（PQC）层。针对QKD密钥生成作为稀缺资源的问题，作者提出了一个由SDN驱动的控制平面，通过全局协调网络来计算最优填充速率和多路径路由，确保所有密钥缓冲区同步填充过程，避免应用程序饥饿。
authors: Pablo P. Rejo, Manuel Fernández-Veiga, Ana Fernández-Vilas, Diego Cajaraville-Aboy, Javier Vecino-Peñas, Rebeca P. Díaz-Redondo

articles.title: Steering of topological criticality in the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger chain via non-Hermitian substitutional impurities
articles.title_zh: 通过非厄米替代杂质调控Su-Schrieffer-Heeger链中的拓扑临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27436v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate the topological phase in a one-dimensional Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chain in the presence of a finite concentration of non-Hermitian substitutional impurities. Our primary focus is the discovery of a deterministic mechanism to actively reconfigure the topological phase boundaries by introducing site-dependent, non-reciprocal intracell and intercell hopping amplitudes. Specifically, breaking the internal structural symmetry of the non-reciprocal impurity hoppings induces a targeted macroscopic displacement of the critical point. This mechanism allows for the controlled expansion or compression of the topological phase strictly via local defect asymmetry. We validate this boundary displacement through finite-size scaling analysis. The extracted correlation length critical exponents (ν approx 1.455 and ν approx 1.397 for symmetric and asymmetric configurations, respectively) confirm a disorder-induced departure from the pristine SSH universality class, with the exponent diverging at high defect densities. We also report an impurity-induced real-to-complex spectral transition geometrically characterized by the Non-Hermitian Skin Effect. Ultimately, our results establish how isolated non-Hermitian asymmetries cooperatively interact to deterministically shift macroscopic topological protection.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在一维Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) 链中引入有限浓度非厄米替代杂质时的拓扑相。研究发现了一种确定性机制，通过引入依赖于位置的非互易胞内和胞间跳跃振幅，主动重构拓扑相边界。这种机制允许通过局部缺陷不对称性来控制拓扑相的扩展或压缩。通过有限尺寸标度分析验证了边界位移，并报告了杂质诱导的实到复谱跃迁。
authors: Juan A. Cañas, Guo-Qing Zhang, A. Martín-Ruiz

articles.title: Atmospheric channel model for QKD over satellite megaconstellations
articles.title_zh: 卫星巨型星座QKD大气信道模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27856v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Atmospheric turbulence and channel loss represent the primary limiting factors in ground-to-satellite quantum communication systems, yet their joint impact remains insufficiently characterized across diverse operational conditions. In this work, we develop a comprehensive and open atmospheric channel model for quantum optical links along ground-to-satellite paths, integrating altitude-dependent molecular and aerosol absorptions. The model is validated with available data from missions such as Micius and Hispasat, including a secondary viability assessment for a hypothetical Starlink-based quantum communication network, where we evaluate the predicted channel behavior in terms of single-photon transmittance and power balance, alongside the channel capacity of the link for uplink and downlink exclusively. Our comparative analysis demonstrates the ability of our channel model to predict real data under simple atmospheric behavior assumptions, which offer practical guidelines for the design and optimization of future quantum satellite missions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文开发了一个全面的开放式大气信道模型，用于地对卫星量子光链路，整合了高度依赖的分子和气溶胶吸收。该模型通过墨子号和Hispasat等任务的现有数据进行了验证，并对基于Starlink的假设量子通信网络进行了可行性评估。研究结果展示了该模型在简单大气行为假设下预测真实数据的能力，为未来量子卫星任务的设计和优化提供了实用指导。
authors: Sergio Gándara Gándara, Javier Vecino-Peñas, Ana Fernández-Vilas, Manuel Fernández-Veiga, Rebeca P. Díaz-Redondo

articles.title: Computing excited states of dipolar Bose--Einstein condensates by constrained gentlest ascent dynamics
articles.title_zh: 通过约束最缓上升动力学计算偶极玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的激发态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27878v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Dipolar Bose--Einstein condensates (BECs), i.e., BECs with long-range dipole-dipole interactions (DDI), exhibit extraordinarily rich physics and serve as a versatile experimental platform for exploring exotic quantum states of matter. Within the mean-field framework, a dipolar BEC can be described by the Gross--Pitaevskii (GP) model with a DDI term. Its stationary states consist of the ground state, which minimizes the GP energy functional under the normalization constraint, and excited states, which are higher-energy critical points that typically correspond to constrained saddle points. Excited states encode collective excitation modes and play a key role in the dynamical stability and quantum phase transitions of cold-atom systems. However, in contrast to the extensively studied ground state, they remain far less explored numerically, especially in dipolar systems. In this work, we develop a numerical method based on the constrained gentlest ascent dynamics (CGAD) that systematically computes excited states of dipolar BECs by stably targeting constrained saddle points with any prescribed Morse index. Specifically, a semi-implicit sine-pseudospectral discretization with an orthonormalization correction step is adopted, and the nonlocal DDI terms are evaluated efficiently and accurately via the nonuniform fast Fourier transform (NUFFT). The resulting scheme is applied to one-, two-, and three-dimensional dipolar BECs, enabling a detailed numerical investigation of their excited states. Remarkably, our simulations reveal that excited states can persist even in regimes where the ground state of the condensate becomes mean-field unstable. This work provides a computational framework for studying excited states in dipolar quantum gases and offers insights for future theoretical and experimental investigations.
articles.abstract_zh: 偶极玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BECs）展现出丰富的物理现象，其激发态在动力学稳定性和量子相变中扮演关键角色。本文开发了一种基于约束最缓上升动力学（CGAD）的数值方法，能够系统地计算偶极BECs的激发态。该方法通过稳定地瞄准具有任意指定莫尔斯指数的约束鞍点，为偶极系统激发态的数值探索提供了有效工具。
authors: Fu Zheng, Wei Liu, Xu Qian

articles.title: Black Holes are about Quantum Information
articles.title_zh: 黑洞与量子信息
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28185v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We review and analyse quantum information-theoretic approaches to black hole evaporation that purport to bring us closer to a resolution of the black hole information paradox. Our focus is on the Page-time paradox and on the contribution of the Hayden-Preskill model to understanding information release under the assumption of unitary evaporation. In this model, the black hole is taken to be a finite-dimensional quantum system whose dynamics can be represented by a quantum circuit, and its information-processing and communication abilities are studied. We identify the assumptions underlying this modelling and highlight two key features, fast scrambling dynamics and entanglement as a resource, that underpin the information release in the model. We argue that this reasoning exemplifies a broader change in how information is used in black hole physics, in which quantum information theory now provides a useful operational modelling framework. This application avoids earlier philosophical objections insofar as it is not based on epistemic ignorance and does not regard information as a substance. This line of reasoning has become central to the debate and, as such, warrants greater attention from the philosophy of physics community.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文回顾并分析了量子信息理论方法在解决黑洞信息悖论方面的应用，重点关注Page时间悖论和Hayden-Preskill模型对幺正蒸发下信息释放的贡献。在该模型中，黑洞被视为一个有限维量子系统，其动力学可用量子电路表示。研究强调了快速扰乱动力学和纠缠作为资源是模型中信息释放的关键特征，并认为量子信息理论为黑洞物理学提供了一个有用的操作建模框架。
authors: Aude Corbeel, Sebastian De Haro

articles.title: Quantum entanglement and contextuality with complexifications of E₈ root system
articles.title_zh: 基于E₈根系复化的量子纠缠与语境性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2210.15338v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Witting configuration with 40 complex rays was suggested as a possible reformulation of Penrose model with two spin-3/2 systems based on geometry of dodecahedron and used for analysis of nonlocality and contextuality in quantum mechanics. Yet another configuration with 120 quantum states is considered in presented work. Despite of different number of states both configurations can be derived from complexification of 240 minimal vectors of 8D real lattice corresponding to root system of Lie algebra E₈. An analysis of properties of suggested configuration of quantum states is provided using many analogies with properties of Witting configuration.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了量子纠缠和语境性，提出了一种包含120个量子态的新配置。该配置与Witting配置（40个复射线）均可从李代数E₈根系的240个8D实格最小向量的复化中导出。研究通过与Witting配置的类比，分析了所提出量子态配置的性质，为量子力学中的非局域性和语境性提供了新的视角。
authors: Alexander Yu. Vlasov

articles.title: Mitigating the barren plateau problem in linear optics
articles.title_zh: 缓解线性光学中的贫瘠高原问题
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.02430v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We prove that variational quantum algorithms using discrete variable boson samplers suffer from barren plateaus and that by changing to fermionic statistics, which is classically efficient to simulate, the barren plateau scaling is less severe. Moreover, when using fermionic statistics the cost landscape boils down to one unit frequency Fourier mode per variational parameter, irrespective of circuit design, ansatz or variational problem, allowing for more efficient parameter shift rules. This simplified cost landscape allows for the gradient-free Rotosolve algorithm to be used to gain a considerable speed-up over the original bosonic algorithm. Motivated by this, we propose a non-linear parametrised phase shifter, the dual-valued phase shifter, that generates these single-harmonic cost landscapes for bosonic statistics. We propose three ways to achieve this by using either non-linear optics, measurement-induced non-linearities, or entangled resource states simulating fermionic statistics. The latter two require linear optics only, allowing for implementation with widely-available technology today. Despite this, the classical simulability of free fermions and the fact the fermionic algorithm can defeat the bosonic algorithm casts doubt on whether the quantum advantage of boson sampling results in any practical advantage in this setting.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了使用离散变量玻色子采样器的变分量子算法存在贫瘠高原问题，并指出改用费米子统计可以减轻该问题。费米子统计下的成本函数景观简化，从而实现更高效的参数移位规则和Rotosolve算法的加速。受此启发，作者提出了一种双值移相器，通过非线性光学、测量诱导非线性或模拟费米子统计的纠缠资源态，为玻色子统计生成单谐波成本景观，其中后两种方法仅需线性光学即可实现。
authors: Matthew D. Horner

articles.title: Temporal entanglement transition in chaotic quantum many-body dynamics
articles.title_zh: 混沌量子多体动力学中的时间纠缠跃迁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.03846v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Temporal entanglement (TE) of an influence matrix (IM) has been proposed as a measure of complexity of simulating dynamics of local observables in a many-body system. Foligno et al. [Phys. Rev. X 13, 041008 (2023)] recently argued that the TE in chaotic 1d quantum circuits obeys linear (volume-law) scaling with evolution time. To reconcile this apparent high complexity of IM with the rapid thermalization of local observables, here we study the relation between TE, non-Markovianity, and local temporal correlations for chaotic quantum baths. By exactly solving a random-unitary bath model, and bounding distillable entanglement between future and past degrees of freedom, we identify a regime where TE is extensive and reflects genuine non-Markovianity. This memory, however, is entirely contained in highly complex temporal correlations, and its effect on few-point temporal correlators is negligible. An IM coarse-graining procedure, reducing the allowed frequency of measurements of the probe system, results in a transition from volume- to subvolume- (area or logarithmic) law TE scaling. We demonstrate the generality of this TE transition in 1d circuits by analyzing the kicked Ising model analytically at dual-unitary points, as well as numerically away from them. This finding indicates that dynamics of local observables are fully captured by a subvolume-law IM. We provide evidence that the compact IM MPS obtained via standard compression algorithms accurately describes local~evolution.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了混沌量子多体动力学中时间纠缠（TE）与非马尔可夫性及局部时间关联的关系。通过求解随机酉浴模型，作者发现TE在特定区域内具有广延性并反映真实的非马尔可夫性，但这种记忆主要存在于复杂的时间关联中，对少点时间关联的影响可忽略。此外，对影响矩阵进行粗粒化处理，可以导致TE从体定律标度向亚体定律（面积或对数）标度转变，揭示了这种TE跃迁的普遍性。
authors: Ilya Vilkoviskiy, Michael Sonner, Qi Camm Huang, Wen Wei Ho, Alessio Lerose, Dmitry A. Abanin

articles.title: A General Framework for Constructing Local Hidden-state Models to Determine the Steerability
articles.title_zh: 构建局部隐态模型以确定可导引性的一般框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.21848v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Not all entangled states can exhibit quantum steering, and determining whether a given entangled state is steerable is a crucial problem in quantum information theory. The main challenge lies in verifying the existence of a local hidden-state (LHS) model capable of reproducing all post-measurement assemblages generated by arbitrary measurements. To address this, we propose a machine learning-based framework that employs batch sampling of measurements and gradient-based optimization to construct an optimal LHS model. We validate our method by analyzing the steerability of two-qubit Werner and two-qutrit isotropic states. For Werner states, our approach saturates the analytical visibility bounds under three Pauli measurements, arbitrary projective measurements (PVMs), and arbitrary positive operator-valued measurements (POVMs). For isotropic states, we achieve the known analytical bounds under arbitrary PVMs. We further investigate the steerability of this class of states under arbitrary POVMs, and our results suggest that POVMs can offer an advantage over PVMs in revealing the steerability of such states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个基于机器学习的通用框架，用于构建局部隐态（LHS）模型以确定量子态的可导引性。该框架通过批量测量采样和基于梯度的优化来构建最优LHS模型。研究人员通过分析两量子比特Werner态和两量子三态各向同性态的可导引性验证了该方法，结果表明其能达到已知的解析界限。此外，研究还发现正算子值测量（POVMs）在揭示某些态的可导引性方面可能优于投影测量（PVMs）。
authors: Yanning Jia, Fenzhuo Guo, Mengyan Li, Haifeng Dong, Fei Gao

articles.title: Tensor computing application programming interface: An application-oriented, lightweight API for portable high-performance tensor network computations
articles.title_zh: 张量计算应用程序接口：一种面向应用的轻量级API，实现可移植的高性能张量网络计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.23917v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Tensor networks (TNs) are a central computational tool in quantum science and artificial intelligence. However, the lack of a unified software interface across tensor-computing frameworks severely limits the portability of TN applications, coupling algorithmic development to specific hardware and software back ends. To address this challenge, we introduce the Tensor Computing Application Programming Interface (TCAPI)---an application-oriented, lightweight API designed to enable framework-independent, high-performance TN applications, currently specified for textttC++ and textttPython. TCAPI provides well-defined type-system conventions that abstract tensor objects, together with a minimal yet expressive set of core functions for essential tensor manipulations and tensor linear-algebra operations, with operation semantics shared across language specifications. Through numerical demonstrations of representative tensor-network applications implemented in textttC++ using TCAPI, we show that code written against TCAPI can be migrated seamlessly across heterogeneous hardware and software platforms while achieving performance comparable to native framework implementations. We further provide open-source implementations of TCAPI based on Cytnx and ITensor in textttC++, and on NumPy in textttPython, demonstrating its practicality and ease of integration with existing tensor-computing frameworks.
articles.abstract_zh: 张量网络是量子科学和人工智能中的核心计算工具，但缺乏统一的软件接口限制了其应用的可移植性。为解决此问题，本文引入了张量计算应用程序接口（TCAPI），这是一个面向应用的轻量级API，旨在实现独立于框架的高性能张量网络应用，目前支持C++和Python。TCAPI提供抽象张量对象的类型系统约定和一套核心函数，通过数值演示证明了使用TCAPI编写的代码可以在异构硬件和软件平台间无缝迁移，并保持可比的性能。
authors: Rong-Yang Sun, Tomonori Shirakawa, Hidehiko Kohshiro, D. N. Sheng, Seiji Yunoki

articles.title: Deterministic feedforward-based generation of large optical coherent-state superposition
articles.title_zh: 基于确定性前馈的大型光学相干态叠加生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.22068v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large optical coherent-state superpositions are essential to advance quantum sensing, quantum repeaters and error-correction codes. We propose a deterministic feedforward protocol employing qubit-mode dispersive coupling, currently available in cavity quantum electrodynamics (QED). We show this single-mode protocol to outperform the advanced three-mode Gaussian-photon-number-resolving detector scheme both in terms of average fidelity and quantum non-Gaussian phase-space properties, and propose sensitivity to weak displacements of interference fringes as a feasible and conclusive witness of quantum interference. This approach combining QED with electro-optical feedforward is extendable to tailored states for applications and other platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 大型光学相干态叠加对于量子传感、量子中继器和纠错码至关重要。本文提出了一种确定性前馈协议，利用腔量子电动力学（QED）中可用的量子比特-模式色散耦合来生成这些状态。该单模协议在平均保真度和量子非高斯相空间特性方面均优于先进的三模高斯光子数分辨探测器方案。研究还提出了对干涉条纹微弱位移的敏感性作为量子干涉的可靠证据，并指出该方法可扩展到其他定制态和平台。
authors: Michele N. Notarnicola, Marcin Jarzyna, Radim Filip

articles.title: Geometric Construction of Optimal Teleportation Witnesses
articles.title_zh: 最优量子隐形传态判据的几何构造
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.22226v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Not all entangled states are useful for quantum teleportation. We present a geometric method to construct optimal teleportation witnesses, which provide operational necessary and sufficient criteria for identifying the teleportation usefulness of arbitrary two-qudit entangled states. Specifically, by developing a two-layer iterative cutting-plane algorithm to solve the shortest distance problem from the target state h̊o to the convex set S of useless states, we obtain the projection point σ^* in S and then construct the optimal teleportation witness from the projection geometry. Moreover, the shortest distance D(h̊o) obtained during this construction also serves as a necessary and sufficient criterion for usefulness. We apply our method to identify the teleportation usefulness of three classes of entangled states.
articles.abstract_zh: 并非所有纠缠态都适用于量子隐形传态。本文提出了一种几何方法来构造最优隐形传态判据，为识别任意两量子比特纠缠态的隐形传态有用性提供了操作上的充要条件。通过开发两层迭代割平面算法求解目标态到无用态凸集的最短距离，研究人员获得了投影点并据此构造了最优判据。该方法在识别三类纠缠态的隐形传态有用性方面得到了应用。
authors: Yanning Jia, Fenzhuo Guo, Mengxuan Bai, Mengyan Li, Haifeng Dong, Fei Gao

articles.title: Continuous-time quantum control across an exponentially small bottleneck in a frustrated Ising ring model
articles.title_zh: 连续时间量子控制穿越受挫伊辛环模型中指数级小的瓶颈
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.07168v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Continuous-time Quantum Annealing (QA) is a strategy for preparing the ground state of nontrivial many-body systems. In its standard form, the dynamics is generated by a time-dependent interpolation between a simple driving Hamiltonian and the target problem Hamiltonian, usually implemented through a linear schedule. This approach faces the crucial bottleneck of small spectral gaps, which may require exponentially long annealing times to ensure adiabaticity. Here, we show how to implement quantum control over the annealing schedule in a frustrated Ising ring, one of the simplest models exhibiting an exponentially small bottleneck gap. By optimizing smooth continuous-time annealing schedules with a dressed-CRAB approach, and using a digitized representation of the dynamics to efficiently evaluate gradients, we construct protocols that strongly outperform standard fixed schedules. The optimized dynamics bypasses the bottleneck through a strongly nonadiabatic mechanism, leading to efficient ground-state preparation despite the exponentially small minimum gap. In particular, the annealing time required to reach a fixed residual-energy threshold is found to grow linearly with system size rather than exponentially. We further examine a lowest-order variational counter-diabatic correction and find that, once schedule optimization is allowed, it does not lead to any improvement.
articles.abstract_zh: 连续时间量子退火（QA）在制备多体系统基态时常面临谱隙过小的瓶颈，导致退火时间呈指数增长。本文展示了如何在受挫伊辛环模型中实现对退火调度表的量子控制，该模型具有指数级小的瓶颈间隙。通过使用dressed-CRAB方法优化平滑的连续时间退火调度表，研究构建的协议显著优于标准固定调度表。优化后的动力学通过强非绝热机制绕过瓶颈，实现了高效的基态制备，有效缩短了所需退火时间。
authors: Vincenzo Roberto Arezzo, Kiran Thengil, Giuseppe Santoro

articles.title: Operator learning for efficient quantum computation
articles.title_zh: 用于高效量子计算的算子学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.20184v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: An efficient implementation of quantum algorithms is often hindered by the lack of efficient primitives for operators and state preparation. This limits both the ability of near-term quantum hardware to simulate complex problems and the potential of fault-tolerant algorithms to achieve practical quantum advantage. To address this, we propose a framework that maps discrete operators onto compact, structured quantum circuits. The resulting variational circuits can be tailored to the connectivity and long-range interaction of the target hardware. The learning process employs backpropagation together with a cost function that efficiently optimizes unitary operators and non-unitary --dense or sparse-- operators using only a single ancilla qubit for block encoding. Additionally, we introduce a regularization term that reduces the approximation error. The approach is validated for both quantum mechanical and engineering applications. In the former case, we learn propagators that arise in native quantum problems --such as quantum simulation and quantum chemistry-- and achieve improved resource scaling in comparison to standard Suzuki--Trotter expansions. In the latter case, we demonstrate the approach's ability to implement the second-order central finite difference approximation of the Laplace operator --relevant for solving partial differential equations-- while improving upon current error metrics. The final example deals with learning a dense, non-unitary operator that arises in the analysis of inviscid potential flow around an airfoil. These results motivate the extension of the framework to a broader class of operator-synthesis problems beyond the prototypical engineering and quantum applications considered here.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子算法的有效实现常受限于算子和态制备缺乏高效原语。本文提出了一个将离散算子映射到紧凑、结构化量子电路的框架，其变分电路可根据目标硬件的连接性和长程相互作用进行定制。学习过程采用反向传播和成本函数，仅用一个辅助量子比特即可高效优化酉算子和非酉算子。该方法通过量子力学和工程应用验证，在量子模拟和量子化学等问题中学习传播子，并实现了优于标准Suzuki-Trotter方法的资源缩放。
authors: Paul Over, Sergio Bengoechea, Leonardo Borello Busilacchi, Martin Kiffner, Thomas Rung, Alexios A. Michailidis

articles.title: Time-Reversal and Reversible Dynamics in Cavity QED for Quantum Metrology
articles.title_zh: 腔量子电动力学中用于量子计量的时间反演与可逆动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02320v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum-enhanced metrology relies on entanglement to achieve sensitivities beyond the standard quantum limit. While remarkable progress has been made in generating highly entangled many-body states, extracting their metrological advantage remains a central challenge because the encoded information is often inaccessible to realistic measurements. A key development of the past decade has been the realization that many-body interactions can play a dual role: they can be used not only to generate entanglement, but also to decode it. This idea underlies interaction-based readout and time-reversal protocols, in which controlled non-linear dynamics transform weakly encoded signals into experimentally accessible observables. Cavity quantum electrodynamics (QED) provides a particularly powerful setting for these approaches because it combines collective enhancement, tunable interactions, and controllable reversibility within a single platform. In this review, we discuss the emergence of time-reversal protocols in cavity QED, from their conceptual roots in Loschmidt echoes to modern implementations of signal amplification through a time-reversed interaction (SATIN), scrambling-enhanced metrology, and more general interaction-based readout schemes. We examine the physical mechanisms that enable reversible many-body dynamics, review key experimental demonstrations, and discuss future directions involving complex entangled states, nonlinear decoding, and emerging quantum platforms. Together, these developments suggest that the ability to decode quantum information may become as important as the ability to generate it, establishing reversible many-body dynamics as a central resource for quantum-enhanced sensing.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子增强计量学依赖纠缠实现超越标准量子极限的灵敏度，但提取其计量优势仍是挑战。本文综述了腔量子电动力学（QED）中时间反演协议的出现与发展。QED平台结合了集体增强、可调相互作用和可控可逆性，使其成为实现基于相互作用的读出和时间反演协议的强大环境。这些协议通过受控的非线性动力学将弱编码信号转化为可实验观测的量，从而实现信号放大。
authors: Simone Colombo, Edwin Pedrozo-Peñafiel

articles.title: Temperature Beyond Equilibrium in Isolated Quantum Many-Body Systems and Their Subsystems
articles.title_zh: 孤立量子多体系统及其子系统中的非平衡温度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08655v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Temperature is one of the central concepts of thermodynamics, yet its meaning far from equilibrium remains unclear. The problem is especially challenging in isolated quantum many-body systems, whose states evolve unitarily, may remain far from equilibrium, and retain energy coherence, a genuinely quantum feature with no direct classical counterpart. Specifically, energy fluctuations in a nonstationary quantum state have two distinct origins. Part of these fluctuations comes from uncertainty in the energy populations and has the usual thermodynamic meaning. The rest comes from quantum coherence between energy sectors and is responsible for the state's time dependence. We propose that, even away from equilibrium, temperature identifies the state within the family of regular states sharing the same energy-coherence structure. The resulting inverse temperature is obtained from a principle of minimum discrimination information, which selects the least distinguishable state compatible with the prescribed energy and coherence structure. This replaces the usual maximum-entropy principle, which, applied naively, can yield a biased estimator of the inverse temperature. We also lay the groundwork for an extension of the construction to subsystems and show that, although the inverse temperature of a subsystem is not determined by its reduced state alone, under an alignment assumption, its instantaneous rate of change is a local quantity for sufficiently large subsystems.
articles.abstract_zh: 温度在远离平衡态时其含义仍不明确，尤其在孤立量子多体系统中，其态演化是酉的，并保留能量相干性。本文提出，即使在非平衡态下，温度也能识别具有相同能量-相干结构的正规态。由此产生的逆温度通过最小判别信息原理获得，该原理选择与给定能量和相干结构兼容的最不区分态。这取代了通常的最大熵原理，避免了其可能产生的偏差估计。
authors: Maurizio Fagotti

articles.title: Proof-of-Principle Implementation of Quantum Key Distribution in an Indefinite Causal Order
articles.title_zh: 不确定因果序中量子密钥分发的原理性实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.13561v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In quantum physics, the order in which different operations occur can be placed in superposition. The resulting processes have an indefinite causal order, which is of fundamental interest and can be viewed as a novel quantum resource enabling new protocols. Here, we report an experimental proof-of-principle implementation of one such protocol, where we perform BB84-like quantum cryptography by placing AB's measurement-and-preparation operations in a photonic quantum SWITCH. By embedding AB within the quantum SWITCH, the protocol achieves an average eavesdropper detection probability of 0.15 ± 0.02 per shared qubit, with eavesdropper detection performed through measurements of the control qubit rather than comparing the key. Unlike standard BB84 and related schemes, which detect eavesdropping by publicly revealing and discarding a fraction of the raw key, our approach requires no disclosure of key material: every retained qubit can, in principle, be tested for eavesdropping while remaining available for key generation. Although the present implementation does not yet constitute a secure quantum key distribution protocol, owing to post-selection required for measurements within the quantum SWITCH, it provides a proof of principle that indefinite causal order can be exploited to detect eavesdropping without sacrificing key bits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报告了在不确定因果序中实现量子密钥分发（QKD）协议的原理性实验。研究人员通过将BB84类量子密码学中的测量和制备操作置于光子量子SWITCH中，实现了平均0.15 ± 0.02的窃听者检测概率。与传统BB84不同，该方法通过测量控制量子比特而非比较密钥来检测窃听，无需公开和丢弃原始密钥。尽管当前实现尚未构成安全的QKD协议，但它展示了一种无需披露密钥材料即可检测窃听的新途径。
authors: Yann Valibouse, Martí Cladera-Rosselló, Michael Antesberger, Hector Spencer-Wood, Kyrylo Simonov, Patrik Sund, Mathieu Bozzio, Philip Walther, Lee A. Rozema

articles.title: Parallel Quantum Advantage with Limited Adaptivity Requires Structure
articles.title_zh: 有限适应性下并行量子优势需要结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20297v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Aaronson and Ambainis (Theory of Computing, 2014) conjectured that quantum query algorithms admit efficient almost-everywhere classical simulation: for any T-query quantum algorithm, its acceptance probability can be approximated on a (1-δ) fraction of inputs, up to ϵ additive error, using poly(T, 1/ϵ, 1/δ) classical queries. At a high level, the conjecture suggests that exponential quantum speedups are possible only on sufficiently structured inputs. In this work, we make progress on this conjecture by proving it for quantum algorithms that make massively parallel quantum queries. In contrast, Yamakawa and Zhandry (Journal of the ACM, 2024) showed that quantum algorithms restricted to parallel queries can still achieve exponential speedups over classical algorithms for sampling problems. We establish our simulation theorem by proving the stronger statement that parallel-query quantum algorithms cannot distinguish the uniform distribution over oracles from oracles drawn from so-called "dense distributions". Our main technical contribution is a coupling theorem that relates the uniform distribution over oracles to oracles drawn from dense distributions. We further extend this approach beyond the purely parallel setting. We prove simulation theorems for quantum algorithms with constant rounds of adaptivity, and for quantum algorithms with a bounded quantum-query prefix followed by a massively parallel quantum-query stage.
articles.abstract_zh: Aaronson和Ambainis曾提出一个猜想，认为量子查询算法在几乎所有输入上都可被高效地经典模拟。本工作通过证明该猜想对大规模并行量子查询算法成立，从而取得了进展。研究表明，并行查询量子算法无法区分预言机的均匀分布和“密集分布”，这为模拟定理提供了更强的支持。
authors: Qipeng Liu, Saachi Mutreja

articles.title: The JLMS formula in a large code with approximate error correction
