This significantly reduces the subnormalised condition number and, in one case, reduces the degree of the QSP polynomial approximation to 1/x by 100,000. Reduced precision digitisation is shown to become more effective as the number of preconditioning infill levels is increased and, in one case, reduces the number of multiplexed rotations from 2,785,576 to 546 whilst maintaining an infidelity of 2.6×10⁻⁵ relative to the classical solution. The effect of digitisation on QSVT solutions is demonstrated using 2D and 3D unstructured mesh aerofoil cases. Due to its flexibility and automatic applicability, we believe our 1-sparse decomposition block encoding can offer benefits to other quantum applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 非结构化网格在计算流体动力学（CFD）建模和模拟中广泛应用，但需要高效的块编码电路。本文提出了一种新的非结构化网格求解器块编码方法，通过将系统矩阵分解为1-稀疏矩阵之和来降低次正规化。该方法利用有限矩阵带宽和重复值，并考虑了数字化（降低精度）的情况。实验结果表明，该方法能够实现一个次正规化因子接近常数的块编码。
authors: Leigh Lapworth, Jarrett Smalley, Christoph Sünderhauf

articles.title: Local-Channel Stability of Classical mathbb Z₂ Lattice Gauge Models
articles.title_zh: 经典Z₂格点规范模型的局部信道稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27939v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We establish sufficient conditions for two-way local quantum-channel stability in classical mathbb Z₂ lattice gauge models with spins on m-dimensional cells of a d-dimensional lattice. Each interaction multiplies the spins on the boundary of an (m+1)-cell. This family, defined on the full spin Hilbert space without a Gauss-law constraint, includes the Ising model at m=0 and the magnetic sector of the toric code at m=1. The low-temperature proof combines two ingredients: locally indistinguishable flat sectors and extended magnetic defects of dimension d-m-1. For 1łe młe d-2, sufficiently weak local classical perturbations at sufficiently low positive temperature preserve equivalence to the canonical flat ensemble. No internal or gauge symmetry is required of the perturbation. For weak noncommuting perturbations, we prove the same conclusion in a smaller sufficient window by reducing the diagonal probabilities to a weak classical interaction and recovering the coherences with a local channel. The conversion channels use product ancillary inputs, have polylogarithmic causal radius, and achieve any prescribed inverse-power whole-system trace-norm error. Sufficiently high-temperature states are instead two-way equivalent to a product state. Independent finite-dimensional onsite systems can be included with weak local couplings. An optimized covariance between two distant neighborhoods of parallel m-tori is nonincreasing under one-way local conversion and invariant under two-way conversion. Its values mathcal Fₘ₌₁ and 0 distinguish the proved low- and high-temperature domains without a protecting symmetry. These sufficient domains do not determine the full phase diagram.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了经典Z₂格点规范模型中双向局部量子信道稳定性的充分条件，该模型在d维格点的m维单元上具有自旋。研究表明，在1 ≤ m ≤ d-2的条件下，足够弱的局部经典扰动在足够低的温度下能保持与正则平坦系综的等价性，且对扰动不要求内部或规范对称性。对于弱非对易扰动，通过将对角概率简化为弱经典相互作用并利用局部信道恢复相干性，在较小的充分窗口内也得到了相同的结论。
authors: Guanxi Xun, Weiguang Cao, Haruki Watanabe

articles.title: Cooling more while dissipating less: anomalous tradeoffs from thermodynamic geometry
articles.title_zh: 冷却更多而耗散更少：热力学几何带来的反常权衡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27948v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that, starting from the same state, optimal driving can sometimes reach a colder (or hotter) target in the same amount of time while dissipating less energy, or equivalently dissipate the same amount of energy in a shorter time. We study this counterintuitive phenomenon in the slow-driving regime of an open quantum system, where we name it Near-Equilibrium Anomalous Tradeoff (NEAT). We establish necessary conditions for its occurrence and show its underlying geometric origin. While NEAT is reminiscent of the well-known Mpemba effect, the two phenomena are distinct in general. We demonstrate NEAT in an exactly solvable qutrit model, as well as for d-dimensional birth-death dynamics with independently controlled energy levels. Finally, we show how NEAT can improve the performance of Carnot engines.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文揭示了一种反直觉的现象，即在相同时间内，从同一初始态出发，最优驱动可以达到更冷的（或更热的）目标，同时耗散更少的能量。研究将此现象命名为近平衡反常权衡（NEAT），并建立了其发生的必要条件及其几何起源。尽管NEAT与Mpemba效应相似，但两者本质上是不同的。作者在一个可精确求解的三能级系统和d维生灭动力学中验证了NEAT，并展示了其如何提高卡诺热机的性能。
authors: Andrea Canzio, Vasco Cavina, Salvatore Raia, Vito Vetrano, Matteo Scandi, Paolo Abiuso

articles.title: The Fer expansion of a driven spin under mathfraksu(2) operations cannot terminate beyond first order
articles.title_zh: 驱动自旋在su(2)操作下的费尔展开不能终止于一阶以上
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27979v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Fer expansion writes the propagator of a driven quantum system as an ordered product of exponentials, each generated by the time integral of an effective Hamiltonian that governs the evolution left over by the previous factors. It can be stopped after finitely many factors whenever this leftover evolution is known in closed form, for instance when the effective Hamiltonian commutes with itself at all times, or precesses about a fixed axis with constant angular velocity. For mathfraksu(2), in any representation, from a qubit to a spin of any size, we resum the Fer recursion into a closed map on curves in R³. We prove that, for a real-analytic drive, in both cases the expansion stops beyond the first factor only trivially, when the first exponential is already exact.
articles.abstract_zh: 费尔展开将驱动量子系统的传播子表示为指数的有序乘积。本文研究了su(2)代数下驱动自旋的费尔展开，并将其递归重构为R³中曲线的封闭映射。研究证明，对于实解析驱动，无论在哪种情况下，费尔展开只有在第一项指数已经精确时才能在第一阶之后终止，即无法在更高阶非平凡地终止。
authors: Lorenzo Bagnasacco, Daniel Burgarth, Vittorio Giovannetti, Kazuya Yuasa

articles.title: Phase shifts and fluctuations from motional, relativistic, and dark-matter effects in ion-trap clocks
articles.title_zh: 离子阱时钟中运动、相对论和暗物质效应引起的相移和涨落
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27994v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ions possess both center-of-mass motion and internal states, rendering trapped-ion optical clocks susceptible to perturbations of both degrees of freedom, which results in systematic shifts and fluctuations with motional and relativistic origins. We develop a quantum theory that connects these effects to filter functions determined by the employed pulse sequences and show how the interrogation can be tailored to suppress or enhance specific perturbations. Our treatment includes laser frequency noise and motional effects such as recoil and Doppler shifts, micromotion and excess micromotion, as well as state-dependent trap imperfections and accelerations, e.g., caused by Stark shifts. We further account for relativistic effects including time dilation and the mass defect, and show how the same framework can be applied to hypothetical dark-matter signals. By considering ensemble-averaged phases and their variances, we characterize both systematic shifts and fluctuations, while asynchronous operation relative to the Paul-trap drive allows motional fluctuations to average down between runs. Our results provide a unified framework for characterizing and controlling the systematic and statistical contributions that determine the trueness and precision of trapped-ion optical clocks.
articles.abstract_zh: 离子阱光钟易受质心运动和内部态扰动的影响，导致系统性频移和涨落。本文发展了一种量子理论，将这些效应与脉冲序列决定的滤波函数联系起来，并展示了如何通过优化探测来抑制或增强特定扰动。该框架涵盖了激光频率噪声、反冲和多普勒频移等运动效应、微运动和过量微运动、态依赖陷阱缺陷以及斯塔克频移引起的加速度等。研究还考虑了相对论效应和假设的暗物质信号，为表征系统性频移和涨落提供了一个统一的框架。
authors: Alexander Bott, Fabio Di Pumpo, Enno Giese

articles.title: Optimal Approximate Quantum Conversion from a Taut-String Principle in Majorization-Based Resource Theories
articles.title_zh: 基于优超资源理论中紧弦原理的最优近似量子转换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28015v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Optimal approximate state conversion is a fundamental task in quantum resource theories, yet existing solutions are largely tailored to specific distinguishability measures and resource theories. We show that every optimal approximate-conversion problem in the three paradigmatic majorization-based quantum resource theories of non-uniformity, bipartite pure-state entanglement, and pure-state coherence reduces exactly to one of only four elementary taut-string constructions. This holds for problems generated by Schur-convex spectral distances and by a broad family of quantum divergences satisfying a natural reduction property with respect to the corresponding equivalence group. The resulting framework encompasses a broad class of physically relevant distinguishability measures, including the trace distance, all unitarily invariant norms, quantum relative entropy, maximal quantum f-divergences, and the α-z Rényi relative entropies. The increment vector of the corresponding taut string completely determines both the optimal approximation error and a canonical optimal state. Our results establish a common geometric framework for approximate quantum resource conversion, revealing that a broad class of seemingly different optimization problems is governed by the same taut-string geometric principle.
articles.abstract_zh: 最优近似态转换是量子资源理论中的一项基本任务。本文证明了在非均匀性、双体纯态纠缠和纯态相干性这三种基于优超的量子资源理论中，每个最优近似转换问题都可以精确地归结为四种基本紧弦构造之一。该框架适用于由Schur凸谱距离和满足自然约化性质的量子散度族生成的问题，涵盖了广泛的物理相关可区分性度量。研究结果为近似量子转换建立了一个通用的几何框架。
authors: Franco Meroi, Cesar Massri, Marcelo Losada, Guido Bellomo, Gustavo Martin Bosyk

articles.title: Relativistic Strong Quantum Mpemba Effect
articles.title_zh: 相对论强量子姆潘巴效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28017v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Unruh effect links acceleration to thermalization, providing a relativistic setting for anomalous quantum relaxation. We demonstrate a it relativistic strong quantum Mpemba effect in the Unruh thermalization of a two-level detector coupled to a massless scalar field. For a fixed pair of isospectral initial states, relaxation curves that never cross in inertial motion exhibit a Mpemba crossing above a threshold acceleration. At a higher, precisely tuned acceleration, the initially farther state has zero overlap with the slowest decay mode and relaxes with a faster asymptotic exponential rate. We identify how competition between transition and dephasing channels governs the relaxation spectrum, where sufficiently strong longitudinal coupling enables acceleration to switch the relaxation bottleneck between population and coherence modes. We derive the spectral-switching condition and construct isospectral preparation protocols that eliminate slow-mode contributions within their physical domains. These protocols reveal how coherence can suppress or enhance slow-mode overlap at fixed purity, depending on the underlying spectral structure. Our results establish acceleration as a control parameter for anomalous quantum relaxation, connecting relativistic quantum dynamics with nonequilibrium thermodynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在与无质量标量场耦合的两能级探测器的Unruh热化中，展示了一种相对论强量子姆潘巴效应。对于一对固定的等谱初始态，在惯性运动中永不交叉的弛豫曲线，在超过阈值加速度后会表现出姆潘巴交叉。在更高、精确调整的加速度下，初始较远的态与最慢衰减模式的重叠为零，并以更快的渐近指数速率弛豫。研究揭示了跃迁和退相干通道之间的竞争如何控制弛豫谱，并构建了等谱制备协议以消除慢模式贡献。
authors: Zhilong Liu, Zehua Tian, Hui Jing, Jieci Wang

articles.title: Optimal Quantum-Circuit Synthesis and Implementation of General Unitaries with Parallelized Bitstring-Conditioned Rotations
articles.title_zh: 基于并行比特串条件旋转的通用幺正算符最优量子电路合成与实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28057v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically introduce a quantum-circuit synthesis protocol to realize any n-qubit transformation Uin U(2ⁿ⁾, up to a diagonal. The resulting circuit is directly native to and optimal in gate count and depth for systems where bitstring-conditioned rotations with tunable angle and axis, C⁽ⁿ⁻¹⁾R(θ,φ), form the set of native operations. Subsequently, we suggest how this protocol can be implemented in a few-mode superconducting circuit, and experimentally demonstrate the method for the smallest nontrivial case, i.e., for two qubits. We report an average gate fidelity of 97.6 % for Haar-random two-qubit unitaries up to phase shifts in the computational basis. Importantly, these results suggest that multimode devices, such as those in the multimon or multiunimon families may become competitive with qubit-array networks for general-unitary implementations for qubit counts as low as three.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论上提出了一种量子电路合成协议，用于实现任意n量子比特变换U，直至一个对角矩阵。该协议生成的电路对于以可调角度和轴的比特串条件旋转作为原生操作的系统而言，在门计数和深度上都是最优的。研究进一步提出了在少模超导电路中实现该协议的方法，并对最小的非平凡情况（即两个量子比特）进行了实验演示，实现了97.6%的平均门保真度。这些结果表明多模器件在通用幺正算符实现方面可能与量子比特阵列网络具有竞争力。
authors: Heikki Suominen, Suman Kundu, Heidi Kivijärvi, Sasu Tuohino, Mikko Tuokkola, Eemeli Forsbom, Madhavi Chand, Vasilii Vadimov, R. Vijay, Mikko Möttönen

articles.title: A q-Inspired Radial Quantum Kinematics
articles.title_zh: 一种q启发式的径向量子运动学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28061v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study how the one-dimensional deformation suggested by nonadditive q-calculus can be extended to a rotationally covariant quantum model and what observable consequences follow from this extension. We choose a radial extension about a distinguished center in which only the radial derivative is deformed, while tangential derivatives retain their ordinary form. Within this model, we construct self-adjoint frame-momentum operators and derive a rotationally invariant uncertainty bound with a correction proportional to the mean distance from the center. We then adopt a non-negative kinetic Hamiltonian built from these momenta and derive the leading harmonic-oscillator energy shifts for weak deformation. The energy corrections split the levels with different orbital angular momenta that are degenerate in the undeformed oscillator, while preserving the degeneracy associated with rotational symmetry.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了非加性q-微积分提出的一维形变如何扩展到旋转协变量子模型，以及由此产生的可观测后果。研究选择了一种围绕特定中心的径向扩展，其中只有径向导数发生形变，而切向导数保持其通常形式。在此模型中，作者构建了自伴随的框架动量算符，并推导了一个旋转不变的不确定性界限。此外，还导出了弱形变下谐振子能级的领先能量偏移，这些能量修正分裂了在未形变振子中简并的不同轨道角动量能级。
authors: Mir Afrasiar, Xian-Hui Ge

articles.title: Measurement incompatibility in Bayesian quantum estimation beyond quadratic loss
articles.title_zh: 贝叶斯量子估计中超越二次损失的测量不兼容性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28070v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In single-shot Bayesian multiparameter quantum estimation, measurement incompatibility can increase the minimum joint quadratic loss by at most a factor of two relative to the bound obtained by optimising each parameter separately. Using the generalised Barnum--Knill inequality, we establish the same bound for a wider class of additive losses generated by positive score functions, showing that this limitation extends beyond the standard quadratic setting. To illustrate this result, we consider a broad family of periodic losses, including the sine loss sometimes employed in interferometry, and derive the corresponding incompatibility bound for Bayesian multiphase estimation with arbitrary prior knowledge. We further extend the framework to unbounded losses, such as absolute losses; this also recovers the case of quadratic losses.
articles.abstract_zh: 在单次贝叶斯多参数量子估计中，测量不兼容性可使最小联合二次损失相对于单独优化每个参数获得的界限最多增加两倍。本文利用广义Barnum-Knill不等式，将此界限推广到更广泛的正分数函数生成的加性损失类别，表明该限制超越了标准二次损失设置。研究还考虑了包括正弦损失在内的周期性损失，并将其框架扩展到无界损失（如绝对损失），同时涵盖了二次损失的情况。
authors: Francesco Albarelli, Stefano Chessa, Jesús Rubio

articles.title: Dimension-free marginal inequalities for pure three-party states
articles.title_zh: 纯三体态的无维度边际不等式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28162v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantum marginal problem, concerned with the compatibility of local and global properties of a multipartite quantum system, is arguably one of the fundamental questions in quantum theory. In this article we introduce a novel family of inequalities bounding the allowed local spectra of a pure tripartite state. The number of inequalities in this family grows with the dimension of the system. Most importantly, the inequalities hold for arbitrary dimensions. For equal local dimension at most 4, they generate the complete set of eigenvalue inequalities.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子边际问题是量子理论中的一个基本问题，涉及多体量子系统的局部和全局性质的兼容性。本文引入了一族新的不等式，用于限制纯三体态的允许局部谱。这些不等式的数量随系统维度增长，且最重要的是，它们适用于任意维度。对于局部维度至多为4的情况，这些不等式能够生成完整的特征值不等式集合。
authors: Simon Morelli

articles.title: Parallel Teleportation via AME(5,2) States on IBM Quantum Hardware
articles.title_zh: 基于IBM量子硬件的AME(5,2)态并行隐形传态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28204v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The five-qubit Absolutely Maximally Entangled AME(5,2) state, whose every pair of qubits is maximally mixed so that all its information lives in non-local correlations, could in principle serve as a single shared quantum networking resource for teleporting two unknown qubits in parallel (each via its own Bell measurement and Pauli correction). Nonetheless, its hardware implementations remain scarce despite its theoretical importance. Here, we demonstrate parallel teleportation based on a five-qubit absolutely maximally entangled state, AME(5,2), on the superconducting processor ibmₚᵢₜₜₛburgh. We construct three-qubit Clifford decoders that extract two Bell pairs using three logical two-qubit gates for each of 60 inequivalent sender-receiver assignments. Using parallelization and classical Pauli frame post-processing, we retain reference-receiver entanglement on both channels after three teleportation rounds. With XY4 dynamical decoupling and the lowest-cost decoder, the final entanglement fidelities are 0.704±0.028 and 0.680±0.022, where uncertainties are pointwise 99% confidence-interval half-widths over eight trials. Their lower bounds exceed the separability threshold of 1/2. The decoder with lower circuit depth generally retains higher mean fidelity, and XY4 generally improves on XX. These results establish a hardware demonstration of two-channel entanglement transmission through repeated AME-assisted teleportation and provide compact decoding circuits for reconfigurable multipartite communication.
articles.abstract_zh: 五量子比特绝对最大纠缠AME(5,2)态理论上可作为共享量子网络资源，用于并行隐形传态两个未知量子比特。本文在超导处理器ibmₚᵢₜₜₛburgh上，基于AME(5,2)态演示了并行隐形传态。研究构建了三量子比特Clifford解码器，并利用并行化和经典Pauli帧后处理，在三次隐形传态后保持了两个通道上的参考-接收方纠缠。最终的纠缠保真度分别为0.704±0.028和0.680±0.022。
authors: Zheng Liang Lim, Hoi-Kwong Lo

articles.title: Structured light for addressable two-qubit gates in medium-sized ion crystals: modeling motional and dephasing errors
articles.title_zh: 用于中型离子晶体中可寻址双量子比特门的结构光：运动和退相干误差建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28217v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Geometric phase gates with addressed laser radiation are widely used in trapped-ion quantum computers to drive high-fidelity entangling gates on an arbitrary qubit pair of a larger ion chain. Such programmable connectivity exploits the collective phonons to mediate the desired interaction, while simultaneously achieving robustness to their thermal fluctuations by a careful calibration of the gate time with respect to the laser and vibrational-mode frequencies. Crosstalk errors can arise when the spectator qubits, which should ideally remain idle during the gate, are partially driven by the laser fields. The minimal crosstalk, which is set by the laser beam size on the spectator ions, can be achieved when the addressing beams propagate perpendicular to the ion chain. However, this results in exciting the radial phonons, and can complicate achieving high-fidelities as the ion chain grows due to the so-called spectral mode crowding. In this work, we present the theoretical description of a scheme recently implemented by Faorlin et al.. This scheme overcomes these complications by engineering addressable state-dependent forces along the ion-chain with laser beams that propagate perpendicular to it through the use of structured light gradients. In this way, one can excite the axial phonons and avoid the spectral mode crowding, while simultaneously minimizing the crosstalk. We present a detailed derivation of the entangling gate scheme, together with analytical closed-form expressions for the leading contribution to the gate error caused by thermal motional fluctuations and dephasing noise. Our results confirm that such fluctuations account for up to 93% of the error budget under the operating conditions of the gate implemented by Faorlin et al.. We identify target parameters to reduce the motional error from the reported 10⁻³ to the 10⁻⁵ level.
articles.abstract_zh: 陷阱离子量子计算机中，利用可寻址激光辐射的几何相门广泛用于驱动任意量子比特对的高保真纠缠门。然而，当寻址光束垂直于离子链传播时，会激发径向声子，并因光谱模式拥挤而使长离子链难以实现高保真度。本文提出了一个理论方案，通过沿着离子链工程化可寻址的状态依赖力来克服这些复杂性，从而实现中型离子晶体中的高保真可寻址双量子比特门。
authors: Pablo Viñas, Alan Kahan, Tommaso Faorlin, Lorenz Panzl, Phoebe Grosser, Thomas Monz, Alejandro Bermudez

articles.title: Dynamical Mean-Field Theory for Real Materials using Variational Quantum Compressed Time Evolution on a Quantum Computer
articles.title_zh: 基于量子计算机上变分量子压缩时间演化的真实材料动力学平均场理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28231v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We design a hybrid quantum-classical computational workflow, combining density functional theory and dynamical mean-field theory, to investigate the electronic properties of CaCuO2, a parent structure of high-temperature cuprate superconductors. Our approach uses a quantum algorithm as an impurity solver that is based on variational quantum compressed time evolution to compute the time-dependent Greens function on an IBM Heron quantum device. Utilizing error mitigation techniques and a Lehmann representation fitting procedure, we extract the density of states from the signal in the accessible time regime. Despite the significant challenges rooted in the residual imprecision of currently accessible NISQ devices, we successfully resolve the characteristic features of the spectral function. However, we find that the required numerical accuracy for full DMFT self-consistency exceeds current hardware capabilities, indicating that practical real-material DMFT applications will necessitate post-NISQ hardware developments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文设计了一种结合密度泛函理论和动力学平均场理论的混合量子-经典计算流程，用于研究高温铜氧化物超导体母体CaCuO2的电子性质。该方法利用基于变分量子压缩时间演化的量子算法作为杂质求解器，在IBM Heron量子设备上计算时间依赖的格林函数。尽管当前NISQ设备的精度有限，研究成功解析了谱函数的特征，但发现实现完整DMFT自洽所需的数值精度超出了现有硬件能力。
authors: Stefan Wolf, Johannes Selisko, Timo Eckstein, Ludwig Nützel, Maximilian Amsler, Christopher Wever, Georgy Samsonidze, Thomas Eckl, Michael J. Hartmann

articles.title: Observable-Level Framework for Finite-Key Security in Coherent-One-Way Quantum Key Distribution
articles.title_zh: 相干单向量子密钥分发中有限密钥安全性的可观测层面框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28239v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Practical security analysis of Coherent-One-Way (COW) quantum key distribution requires optical-device modeling, finite experimental statistics, and security inference to be treated consistently without conflating assumptions. We present a modular observable-level simulation framework organized through the pipeline θₚₕys -> p -> O -> Sⱼ₍O), in which physical source, channel, receiver, and detector parameters determine detector-resolved event probabilities, a finite-block layer applies an effective dead-time treatment and generates aggregate detector counts, and interchangeable security evaluators act on the same observable record. The framework is verified against analytical optical, virtual-state, and finite-key relations and evaluated against reported experimental COW-QKD operating points. The Kato finite-key calculation reproduces the refined experimentally reported secure-key rates most closely at intermediate distances, with deviations of -1.5% at 50 km and -10.3% at 75 km. Monitoring bright-port decoy counts agree within 0.9-2.4%, while remaining distance-dependent dark-port residual identifies the principal model-sensitive observable of the present physical description. Applying Kato and Azuma-Hoeffding concentration treatments to identical detector records isolates the effect of finite-key statistical inference and shows substantially tighter Kato phase-error bounds for rare-event monitoring records studied here. Holding the Kato evaluator fixed, joint optimization of coherent-state mean photon number mu and receiver splitting fraction t_B increases model-predicted secure-key rate by 7.4-20.2% relative to optimization of mu alone with t_B = 0.3. The framework therefore provides a common computational interface for experimental reproduction, controlled security-model comparison, model-based protocol optimization, and modular adversarial stress testing in COW-QKD.
articles.abstract_zh: 相干单向（COW）量子密钥分发的实际安全性分析需要一致地处理光学设备建模、有限实验统计和安全性推断。本文提出了一个模块化的可观测层面模拟框架，该框架通过物理参数确定事件概率，应用有效死区时间处理并生成聚合探测器计数，并允许可互换的安全评估器作用于相同的可观测记录。该框架已通过分析光学、虚拟态和有限密钥关系进行验证，并根据报告的实验COW-QKD操作点进行了评估。
authors: Aryan Kuntal, Utkarsh Giradkar, Mudit Chaudhary, Amit D. Lad

articles.title: Quantum Broker: QoS-Aware Distribution of Quantum Computations
articles.title_zh: 量子代理：面向QoS的量子计算分发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28342v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cloud-accessible quantum computing has made heterogeneous Quantum Processing Units (QPUs) available through provider platforms that differ in qubit technology, calibration state, queueing behavior, and pricing model. This heterogeneity makes execution management a quantum-engineering concern: a quantum circuit may be executable on several backends, but the resulting cost, latency, fidelity, and reproducibility depend on backend selection and on how measurement shots are allocated. This paper presents the Quantum Broker, an open-source and provider-agnostic framework for Quality-of-Service-aware quantum execution management. The framework operationalizes shot-wise distribution by exploiting the statistical independence of quantum measurement shots to dispatch a single circuit across multiple heterogeneous QPUs according to user-defined constraints and optimization objectives. It combines a modular execution architecture, interchangeable backend-profiling strategies, and the Quantum QoS Specification Language (QQSpec), a declarative language for expressing QoS requirements. Dispatch planning is supported by two solver backends: a mixed-integer linear-programming (MILP) solver, and a nonlinear dual-annealing solver. Experiments on benchmark quantum circuits and noisy simulator backends show that the Quantum Broker can produce feasible QoS-aware dispatch plans under heterogeneous backend conditions and can improve QoS satisfaction with respect to single-backend and naive multi-backend baselines. The results also expose a practical trade-off between planning time and dispatch quality, with the nonlinear solver producing higher-quality allocations at increased computational cost. Overall, the Quantum Broker provides an extensible execution-management layer for engineering portable, reproducible, and QoS-aware quantum software over fragmented quantum cloud infrastructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 云可访问的量子计算使得异构量子处理单元（QPU）可用，但其执行管理面临成本、延迟、保真度等挑战。本文介绍了Quantum Broker，一个开源且与提供商无关的QoS感知量子执行管理框架。该框架通过利用量子测量次数的统计独立性，根据用户定义的约束和优化目标，将单个电路分发到多个异构QPU上。它结合了模块化执行架构、可互换的后端分析策略和量子QoS规范语言。
authors: Giuseppe Bisicchia, Alessandro Bocci, Jose Garcia-Alonso, Juan Manuel Murillo, Antonio Brogi

articles.title: COΦ - COmpiling PHotonics into dIgital quantum circuits
articles.title_zh: COΦ - 将光子学编译为数字量子电路
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28349v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photonic and qubit-based (digital) approaches to quantum computing are largely regarded as separate paradigms. This article aims to bridge these paradigms by developing a method for mapping quantum-optical systems onto qubit-based quantum circuits. The key ingredient enabling this mapping is the introduction of a truncation of the Fock space describing single-mode optical states. Within this framework, representations of basic photonic operations are developed, including the phase-rotation operator, the displacement operator, the squeezing operator, and the beam splitter. Explicit quantum circuit constructions are provided for Fock-space truncations of dimension N=2 and N=4. We discuss benchmarking of the implemented operations and identify the regime of applicability and the limitations of the proposed method. The presented results can be used to simulate quantum optical circuits on qubit-based quantum computers, with special relevance to Gaussian Boson Sampling in the low-photon-number regime. To demonstrate the practical applicability of this approach, we complement the theoretical framework with a Python-based quantum programming tool COΦ that compiles Blackbird quantum-optics programs into qubit-based OpenQASM circuits using a truncated Fock-space encoding. The compiler is available on GitHub at https://github.com/Quantum-Cosmos-Lab/cophi.
articles.abstract_zh: 光子学和基于量子比特的数字量子计算通常被视为独立的范式。本文旨在通过开发一种将量子光学系统映射到基于量子比特的量子电路的方法来弥合这些范式。关键在于引入描述单模光学态的Fock空间截断，并在此框架下开发了基本光子操作的表示。研究提供了N=2和N=4维度的Fock空间截断的显式量子电路构造，并讨论了该方法的适用范围和局限性。
authors: Grzegorz Czelusta, Marcin Markiewicz, Jakub Mielczarek, Artur Miroszewski

articles.title: Capturing Open Quantum System Dynamics with Compact Dressed Hamiltonians
articles.title_zh: 利用紧凑缀饰哈密顿量捕获开放量子系统动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28358v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We advance the compact dressed Hamiltonian (CDH) framework to simulate the dynamics of open quantum systems strongly coupled to structured bosonic environments. The CDH approach combines reaction-coordinate mapping with a polaron transformation, incorporating strong system-environment hybridization into a dressed representation before truncating the collective bosonic mode. As a result of this truncation, dynamical features are captured with substantially fewer states than in the original representation. The residual environment is treated using a weak-coupling Markovian quantum master equation. We benchmark the method for spin-boson-type models including a single spin, coupled spins, and spin ensembles, considering both resonant and off-resonant regimes and weak to strong system-bath coupling. Comparisons with hierarchical equations of motion and converged reaction-coordinate calculations demonstrate that the CDH representation systematically approaches the reference dynamics with a compact Hilbert space, accurately reproducing oscillation frequencies, relaxation behavior, and long-time populations over a broad parameter regime. The method further captures cooperative phenomena, including bath-mediated interactions, synchronization between spins, and signatures for collective emission. Beyond efficient time propagation, the CDH framework provides direct access to the spectrum and eigenmodes of the Liouvillian. We demonstrate that slow dynamical modes converge rapidly in the CDH representation, enabling identification of relaxation timescales without fitting time-dependent observables. As a whole, the CDH framework provides an efficient and physical description of strongly coupled open quantum-system dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了紧凑缀饰哈密顿量（CDH）框架，用于模拟与结构化玻色子环境强耦合的开放量子系统动力学。CDH方法结合了反应坐标映射和极化子变换，将强系统-环境杂化纳入缀饰表示，然后截断集体玻色子模式。这种截断使得能以显著更少的态捕获动力学特征。通过与分层运动方程和收敛反应坐标计算的比较，证明CDH表示在紧凑希尔伯特空间内系统地逼近参考动力学，准确再现了广泛参数范围内的振荡频率、弛豫行为和长时间布居。
authors: Zachary Giles, Dvira Segal

articles.title: Hidden parabolic subgroups of GLₙ over finite chain rings
articles.title_zh: 有限链环上GLₙ的隐藏抛物子群
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28368v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We give a bounded-error quantum polynomial-time algorithm for finding hidden parabolic subgroups of GLₙ₍R) over any effectively presented finite chain ring R. We call auxiliary group elements or subgroups used to extract information through oracle queries emphprobes. For chain length at least two, elementary abelian socle probes first recover the complete flag modulo the maximal ideal. When the residue field has size qge3, we reconstruct the flag recursively, lifting rank-one terminal members one digit at a time. The intermediate digits reduce to abelian hidden subgroup problems, while the final digit is a finite-field multiple-shift problem solved using learning from subset and Fourier sampling. For q=2, where distinct flags can have the same stabilizer, we instead lift the conjugate parabolic subgroup through the congruence filtration. A final linear system determines it modulo normalizer directions. The algorithm outputs generators with probability at least 1-ϵ in time poly(n,łog|R|,łog(1/ϵ)). Consequences include GLₙ₍Z/NZ) for every Nge2 and, with an explicit maximal-order presentation, GLₙ₍O_K/NO_K) for number fields K.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种有界误差量子多项式时间算法，用于在任何有效呈现的有限链环R上寻找GLₙ(R)的隐藏抛物子群。该算法通过辅助群元素或子群（探针）提取信息。对于链长至少为二的情况，首先恢复模极大理想的完整旗。当剩余域大小q≥3时，通过递归方式重构旗；对于q=2，则通过同余过滤提升共轭抛物子群。该算法以至少1-ϵ的概率在多项式时间内输出生成元。
authors: Muhammad Imran

articles.title: Scrambling Separates Superradiance from Quantum Chaos
articles.title_zh: 混杂将超辐射与量子混沌分离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28412v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Early studies on the Dicke model linked superradiance to quantum chaos, whereas later anisotropic Dicke and Rabi studies reached apparently conflicting conclusions. We resolve this tension by distinguishing global chaos from local instability. Along the isotropic Dicke path, a sweep at fixed low excitation energy crosses both the superradiant boundary and a nearby chaotic window, explaining the reported correlation. However, the anisotropic Dicke model can be chaotic in the normal phase and regular in the superradiant phase, making superradiance neither necessary nor sufficient for global chaos. A fidelity out-of-time-order correlator (FOTOC), in contrast, probes the local stability of the stationary point selected by the initial wave packet. The superradiant transition destabilizes the origin, whereas a change in anisotropy can restore its stability and create displaced saddles. Wave packets centered at these saddles exhibit exponential FOTOC growth even on a classically regular Dicke energy shell with Poisson statistics. This local sensitivity also enables quantitative spectroscopy: combined with the topology of stationary points and local density of states relations, FOTOC dynamics reconstructs the absolute amplitudes of spectral singularities in both models without fitting the density of states.
articles.abstract_zh: 早期研究将Dicke模型的超辐射与量子混沌联系起来，但后续研究出现了冲突结论。本文通过区分全局混沌和局部不稳定性来解决这一矛盾，发现超辐射并非全局混沌的必要或充分条件。研究表明，保真度逆时序关联器（FOTOC）能探测初始波包所选定驻点的局部稳定性，超辐射跃迁会使原点失稳，而各向异性变化可恢复其稳定性并产生位移鞍点。
authors: Long-Jie Li, Li-Li Gao, Zi-Cheng Liu, Zi-Min Li, Murray T. Batchelor

articles.title: Chaos and scrambling in anisotropic Dicke and Rabi models
articles.title_zh: 各向异性Dicke和Rabi模型中的混沌与混杂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28415v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Identifying the quantum signatures of classical chaos remains a central question in quantum physics, and quantum scrambling provides a new perspective on this correspondence. We study two distinct limits of the same model to examine how the correspondence between chaos and scrambling changes across different regimes. The thermodynamic-limit anisotropic Dicke model exhibits a close correspondence between chaos and scrambling, whereas this correspondence breaks down in the large-frequency-ratio limit of the anisotropic Rabi model (ARM). The contrasting chaotic behavior in the two limits originates from the different numbers of classical degrees of freedom, whereas their similar scrambling behavior stems from eigenstate delocalization. This implies that, in the large-frequency-ratio limit, eigenstate delocalization alone is insufficient to qualify the ARM as a classically chaotic model. This finding suggests that identifying chaos in quantum systems requires jointly considering the classical degrees of freedom and eigenstate delocalization.
articles.abstract_zh: 识别经典混沌的量子特征是量子物理学的核心问题，量子混杂为此提供了新视角。本文研究了同一模型的两个不同极限，以考察混沌与混杂之间的对应关系如何随不同机制变化。热力学极限下的各向异性Dicke模型展现出混沌与混杂的紧密对应，但在各向异性Rabi模型（ARM）的大频率比极限下，这种对应关系破裂。研究表明，在量子系统中识别混沌需要同时考虑经典自由度和本征态离域化。
authors: Long-Jie Li, Li-Li Gao, Zi-Cheng Liu, Zi-Min Li, Murray T. Batchelor

articles.title: Efficient Ground-State Manifold Amplification for Rydberg Atom Arrays via Houdayer Cluster Updates
articles.title_zh: 通过Houdayer簇更新实现Rydberg原子阵列高效基态流形放大
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28528v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate a hybrid quantum-classical approach for exploring ground-state manifolds of maximum independent set problems, in which quantum hardware supplies the initial solutions and an entirely classical post-processing algorithm expands them, increasing the solution diversity of quantum hardware measurements by up to several orders of magnitude. Quantum optimization devices, while capable of generating high-quality solutions, can suffer from fundamental sampling limitations. This is particularly problematic for applications that strongly depend on a large variety of uncorrelated optimal solutions. We apply the Houdayer cluster update algorithm to systematically expand quantum-generated solution sets through classical post-processing. We validate our approach on a test bed of 43 problem instances from QuEra's Aquila analog annealing device, achieving diversity amplification factors, defined as the increase in the number of distinct solutions at a given set size, of up to 11923x with a median of 24.3x across different problem scales and hardness parameters. Because exact ground-state degeneracies are known for these instances, the recovered fraction of the manifold can be measured rather than bounded: post-processing recovers a median of 21% of the ground-state manifold, and provably all of it for six instances. We also demonstrate that, in some cases, the classical post-processing can discover independent sets larger than those found by the quantum hardware, thus improving on solution quality and not just diversity. While the method is non-ergodic and cannot guarantee complete manifold coverage, it consistently discovers a larger number of high-quality, and in some cases strictly better, configurations than quantum sampling alone. This work demonstrates how simple classical post-processing can enhance the utility of quantum optimization results.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种混合量子-经典方法，用于探索最大独立集问题的基态流形。该方法利用量子硬件提供初始解，并通过经典的Houdayer簇更新算法进行后处理，显著增加了量子硬件测量结果的解多样性。在QuEra Aquila模拟退火设备上的测试表明，该方法将解多样性放大因子提高了最高11923倍，中位数为24.3倍。这有效解决了量子优化设备在采样多样性方面的局限性。
authors: Andrew J. Ochoa, Martin J. A. Schuetz, Helmut G. Katzgraber

articles.title: NeST: ultra-high-rate qLDPC codes with sub-50μs stabiliser cycles via spin shuttling
articles.title_zh: NeST：通过自旋穿梭实现亚50微秒稳定器周期的超高速qLDPC码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28538v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum low-density parity-check codes now reach encoding rates up to 50% at useful distances. Their checks however are long-range group actions, not local neighbourhoods, and that connectivity has so far been supplied by neutral atoms. Silicon spin qubits offer the same primitive --- coherent transport of qubit blocks --- through electron shuttling, and on microsecond rather than millisecond timescales. They however travel along fabricated tracks rather than free space: permutations an atom array obtains by moving tweezers must here become collision-free motions on a physical lattice. We here present the first code and spin-qubit hardware co-design. We build an architecture whose geometry mimics that of a family of non-abelian groups, broad enough to host codes of excellent parameters: a hierarchy of nested conveyor-belt loops on a plain square lattice of shuttling tracks, in which every group multiplication becomes a rigid, globally controlled motion of whole qubit trains. We call it NeST, for Nested Shuttling Tracks. A code search over the family returns rate-20% mitten codes up to [[1400,280,łeq 28]], and circuit-level simulations including shuttling dephasing give thresholds above 10⁻³ with sub-50μs stabiliser cycles, two to three orders of magnitude faster than neutral-atom implementations. Via extrapolations, we estimate that this largest code may reach a logical error probability per qubit per round of 10⁻¹⁴, assuming a ten-fold improvement on early shuttling demonstrations, with other physical errors at p=0.1%. Logic is compatible with NeST too: for the [[150,30,10]] code we build a code-surgery gadget in which every qubit again moves only by rigid belt motions, at no qubit cost and a 29% increase in gate layers. This demonstrates that ultra-low-overhead fault tolerance and a fast clock speed are not competing goals, and that silicon spin qubits can supply both.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了NeST（Nested Shuttling Tracks）架构，首次实现了量子低密度奇偶校验（qLDPC）码与硅自旋量子比特硬件的协同设计。该架构利用电子穿梭实现量子比特块的相干传输，其几何结构模仿非阿贝尔群，支持具有优异参数的编码。NeST通过在方形晶格上构建嵌套的传送带环路，实现了全局控制的量子比特列运动。模拟结果显示，该家族可生成编码率为20%的“手套码”，距离可达[[1400,280,≤28]]。
authors: Adam Siegel

articles.title: Complete Modified Logarithmic Sobolev Inequalities for one-dimensional quantum Spin Chain
articles.title_zh: 一维量子自旋链的完全修正对数Sobolev不等式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28600v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We prove a complete modified logarithmic Sobolev inequality with a system-size-independent constant for Chen--Kastoryano--Gilyén Gibbs samplers on one-dimensional spin chain at every fixed positive temperature. The result holds for Hamiltonians with bounded finite-range interactions, including noncommuting and spatially nonuniform interactions. It yields trace and diamond mixing times of order O(łog N+łog(1/ϵ)). The proof establishes complete spatial entropy factorization and absorbs quasi-local errors as conditional relative entropy at the original joint state and reference. The static estimate also yields a system-size-independent CMLSI for the single-site Petz heat-bath and regularised heat-bath dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了在任意固定正温度下，针对一维自旋链上的Chen-Kastoryano-Gilyén Gibbs采样器，存在一个与系统大小无关的常数的完全修正对数Sobolev不等式。该结果适用于具有有界有限范围相互作用的哈密顿量，包括非对易和空间非均匀相互作用。它表明迹和钻石混合时间为O(log N + log(1/ϵ))量级。该证明通过建立完全空间熵分解并吸收准局域误差，为单点Petz热浴和正则化热浴动力学提供了与系统大小无关的CMLSI。
authors: Li Gao, Jingyu Guo, Sihao Wang

articles.title: Elastic field causing noncommutativity
articles.title_zh: 引起非对易性的弹性场
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.08604v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study how a uniform torsion background, modeling a continuous density of screw dislocations and induces effective spatial noncommutativity and reshapes the energy spectrum of a free quantum particle. Within the geometric theory of defects, the metric yields a first-order (magnetic-like) coupling in the transverse dynamics, equivalent to an effective magnetic field Bₑff proportional to p_z Omega, where Omega encodes the torsion strength. In the strong-coupling (Landau) regime, the planar coordinates obey [x,y] != 0 and the spectrum organizes into Landau-like levels with a slight electric-field-driven tilt and a uniform shift. Thus, increasing Omega drives the system continuously toward the familiar Landau problem in flat space, with torsion setting the noncommutativity scale and controlling the approach to the Landau limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了均匀扭转背景如何诱导有效的空间非对易性并重塑自由量子粒子的能谱。在缺陷的几何理论框架内，度规在横向动力学中产生了一阶（类磁）耦合，等效于一个与p_z Omega成比例的有效磁场。在强耦合（朗道）区域，平面坐标满足[x,y] ≠ 0，能谱组织成朗道状能级。研究表明，增加扭转强度Omega可使系统连续趋向于平坦空间中熟悉的朗道问题，扭转设定了非对易性尺度并控制了向朗道极限的逼近。
authors: A. L. Silva Netto, A. M. de M. Carvalho, G. Q. Garcia, C. Furtado

articles.title: Minimal-length kinematics of coherent light and a proposed two-color vacuum chronoscopy
articles.title_zh: 相干光的最小长度运动学与一种双色真空计时学提议
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26892v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The unification of quantum theory and general relativity suggests the existence of a minimal measurable length, leading to a generalized uncertainty principle (GUP) and an energy-dependent vacuum group velocity. Testing these effects with macroscopic objects typically encounters the ``soccer-ball problem,'' where applying Planck-scale deformations to the total momentum predicts observationally ruled-out velocity deviations. We adopt the QFT-natural prescription in which the GUP modifies single-mode commutators, and verify by explicit calculation that the macroscopic group velocity of a multimode coherent pulse reduces to the single-photon GUP velocity evaluated at the central wavelength, multiplied by the classical Gaussian-beam factor, with no dependence on the total pulse energy. The energy--momentum relation E=pc itself is unmodified; the deformation enters through the velocity--momentum relation and is equivalent to a modified dispersion relation in the wave vector, with a quadratic coefficient that depends on which of the two variables is used. The soccer-ball problem ,---, which arises only when the GUP is applied to the center-of-mass momentum of a composite system ,---, is therefore absent for coherent light, and macroscopic petawatt pulses probe the same parameter space as single high-energy photons. Building on this framework, we propose a two-color vacuum chronoscopy experiment using a short-pulse petawatt laser and its high-harmonic generation. By systematically varying the macroscopic beam waist, our setup separates Planck-scale kinematic shifts from classical diffraction delays, establishing a controlled, source-independent terrestrial methodology whose sensitivity we assess against current astrophysical bounds and against the dominant waist-independent systematics that limit it, residual-gas dispersion and the harmonic birth-time offset.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子理论与广义相对论的统一暗示存在一个最小可测长度，导致广义不确定性原理（GUP）和能量依赖的真空群速度。本文采用量子场论中GUP修改单模对易子的方法，并通过计算验证了多模相干脉冲的宏观群速度，它等于在中心波长处评估的单光子GUP速度乘以经典高斯光束因子，且与总脉冲能量无关。能量-动量关系E=pc本身未被修改，变形通过速度-动量关系引入。该研究避免了“足球问题”，并为检验GUP效应提供了新的视角。
authors: Zhi-Wei Wang, Saurya Das, Samuel L. Braunstein

articles.title: Symmetry and Quantum Interference in the Attosecond Domain
articles.title_zh: 阿秒领域中的对称性与量子干涉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26901v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this review, we examine the interplay of symmetry and quantum interference in the attosecond domain primarily through one- and two-electron photoelectron momentum distributions. Using our own work, we discuss how tailored laser fields provide control over dynamical symmetries, and how quantum-orbit methods make it possible to connect the resulting momentum-space structures to specific ionisation, propagation, and rescattering pathways. Particular emphasis is placed on ultrafast photoelectron holography and nonsequential double ionisation through recollision excitation with subsequent ionisation, where several distinct forms of quantum interference can be identified and manipulated. We also discuss how target properties, including the binding potential, orbital symmetry and parity, modify this mapping. Finally, we consider emerging opportunities offered by non-classical states of light, for which photon statistics and quantum fluctuations provide additional degrees of freedom for controlling symmetry and strong-field electron dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇综述主要通过单电子和双电子光电子动量分布，探讨了阿秒领域中对称性与量子干涉的相互作用。文章讨论了定制激光场如何控制动力学对称性，以及量子轨道方法如何将动量空间结构与特定的电离、传播和再散射路径联系起来。特别强调了超快光电子全息术和非序贯双电离中多种形式的量子干涉。此外，还探讨了靶材特性如何影响这种映射，并展望了非经典光态在控制对称性和强场电子动力学方面的新机遇。
authors: C. Figueira de Morisson Faria, S. Hashim, J. Rivera-Dean, T. Rook

articles.title: Parallel Omnidirectional Atom Rearrangement with Dynamic Holograms
articles.title_zh: 基于动态全息图的并行全向原子重排
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27053v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The ability to assemble and reconfigure individual atoms is central to performing quantum science using optical tweezer arrays. Here, we demonstrate parallel omnidirectional atom transport and rearrangement using dynamic holograms generated by a single kilohertz-rate spatial light modulator. By carefully characterizing survival and heating, we show that atoms remain confined even when successive holograms are commanded before the liquid crystal has settled, enabling significantly faster transport. To generate holograms in real time, we develop and implement a warm-start, weighted Gerchberg-Saxton algorithm that achieves performance comparable to neural-network methods without requiring any training. Combining these techniques, we assemble ytterbium atoms into a 2078-site kagome lattice with 99.0% mean filling. In addition, we demonstrate parallel transport between array layers, combining axial and transverse motion to reconfigure atoms in three dimensions. Our approach is readily adaptable to existing tweezer platforms and provides a method for large-scale SLM-based atom assembly as well as programmable three-dimensional control.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了使用单个千赫兹速率空间光调制器生成的动态全息图，实现并行全向原子传输和重排。通过优化原子存活率和加热，即使在快速连续的全息图指令下，原子也能保持受限，从而实现更快的传输。研究团队开发了一种暖启动、加权Gerchberg-Saxton算法以实时生成全息图，其性能与神经网络方法相当。结合这些技术，他们成功将镱原子组装成一个2078个格点的kagome晶格，平均填充率达99.0%，并实现了三维原子重排。
authors: Samuel A. Engel, Dewei Gong, Ziguang Lin, Lysander Christakis, Kang-Kuen Ni, Norman Y. Yao

articles.title: A group theoretic calculation of multi-invariants of some stabilizer states
articles.title_zh: 某些稳定器态多重不变量的群论计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27098v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study multi-invariants---a multi-partite generalization of Renyi entropies---of simple stabilizer states, for an arbitrary replica symmetry group. We develop a group theoretic technique for evaluating such invariants, which operates on the replica group and involves counting intersections among its cosets. Our techniques streamline the calculations of multi-invariants for graph states with two GHZ-like nodes and for certain generalizations thereof. The methodology developed here is most suitable when the quantum state is simple but flexibility over the replica group is desired.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了简单稳定器态的多重不变量，这是Renyi熵的多体推广，适用于任意复制对称群。研究团队开发了一种群论技术来评估这些不变量，该技术作用于复制群并涉及计算其陪集之间的交集。该方法简化了具有两个GHZ型节点的图态及其某些推广的多重不变量计算。这种方法特别适用于量子态简单但需要复制群灵活性的场景。
authors: Bartlomiej Czech, Yichen Feng, Jonathan Harper, Xin-Xiang Ju

articles.title: Allight: A Perfect Photon Collector
articles.title_zh: Allight：一种完美的单光子收集器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27161v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Collecting photons from quantum emitters remains a key limitation in light-matter interaction because conventional lenses collect light only from one direction. Here, we introduce a perfect light collector by inverse-designing a surrounding dielectric structure that encloses the emitter to increase photon-collection efficiency toward unity. Decomposing the device into several refractive interfaces enables emission collection from the full 4π solid angle with adiabatic reshaping into a collimated beam. We experimentally demonstrate, in two dimensions, the ray bending that collimates omnidirectional emission. Our collector transforms current paradigms for highly efficient photon collection from narrowband, cavity-based techniques into experimentally robust, broadband, non-resonant dielectric devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统透镜只能从一个方向收集光子，限制了光与物质相互作用中的光子收集效率。本文介绍了一种名为“Allight”的完美光子收集器，通过逆向设计围绕发射体的介电结构，将光子收集效率提高到接近100%。该器件通过多个折射界面，能够从完整的4π立体角收集发射光，并将其绝热重塑为准直光束。实验在二维空间中验证了其对全向发射光的准直能力。Allight将高效光子收集从窄带、基于腔体的技术转变为实验鲁棒、宽带、非谐振的介电器件。
authors: Dan Porat, Ran Finkelstein, Tal Carmon

articles.title: Quantum-Seeded Distributed Post-Quantum Group Signatures for 5G V2X Communications
articles.title_zh: 用于5G V2X通信的量子种子分布式后量子群签名
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27316v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communications rely on elliptic-curve signatures that a quantum adversary breaks and on pseudonym certificates whose anonymity rests on rotation rate, not cryptography. This work presents qDGSP, a post-quantum V2X infrastructure: a hash-based dynamic group signature scheme (DGSP, over SPHINCS+ and WOTS+) distributed between a central controller and roadside verifiers. Group keys derive deterministically from quantum key distribution (QKD) seeds served over the ETSI GS QKD 014 interface, so no group-signature secret crosses the classical channel. qDGSP-EA (Ephemeral Association) binds an ephemeral ML-DSA-65 key to one group signature per 5G cell: messages remain unlinkable across cells, linkable within one. On a testbed with emulated 5G links, median end-to-end latency stayed within the 100ms ETSI budget for every variant. The qDGSP-EA intra-cell DENM matched the NIST ML-DSA-65 baseline on the wire, and under load EA mode raised delivery from roughly 78% to 93%.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了qDGSP，一种后量子V2X通信基础设施，旨在解决现有V2X通信中椭圆曲线签名易受量子攻击和匿名性不足的问题。qDGSP是一个基于哈希的动态群签名方案，利用量子密钥分发（QKD）种子确定性地生成群密钥，确保群签名秘密不通过经典信道传输。qDGSP-EA模式将临时ML-DSA-65密钥绑定到每个5G小区的群签名，实现跨小区消息不可链接、小区内可链接。在模拟5G链路测试中，所有变体的端到端延迟中位数均在100毫秒的ETSI预算内，且在负载下，EA模式将消息传递率从约78%提高到93%。
authors: P. Blanco-Casal, P. Rejo-Iglesias, D. Cajaraville-Aboy, J. Vecino-Peñas, R. P. Díaz-Redondo, A. Fernández-Vilas, M. Fernández Veiga

articles.title: Non-Classicality in tW system via negativity and geometric quantum discord
articles.title_zh: 通过负性和几何量子关联研究tW系统中的非经典性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27404v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We perform a phenomenological study of non-classical correlations in the mixed-dimensional qubit-qutrit system realized by leading order pp→ tW production at sqrts=13 TeV in the leptonic final state. The two missing neutrinos are reconstructed with conditional normalizing flows trained on simulated detector-level objects, and the joint spin density matrix h̊oₜWinH₂øtimesH₃ is obtained in a generalized Bloch representation from the angular distributions of the leptonic decay products. Non-classical correlations are quantified using the Peres--Horodecki negativity and geometric quantum discord. We quantify the correlations at different region of mₜW at the reconstruction level within the Standard Model and the impact of two reducible backgrounds viz. tbart and WWj processes, tagged using boosted decision trees. We further study the behavior of correlations in presence of anomalous chromomagnetic and chromoelectric dipole moments of the top quark. The sensitivity reach of the quantum observables along with polarization and spin correlation parameters are reported for current LHC and future HL-LHC scenario.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对在13 TeV质子-质子对撞中，通过领先阶pp→tW产生并伴随轻子末态的混合维度量子比特-量子三态系统中的非经典关联进行了唯象学研究。研究人员利用条件归一化流重建了缺失的中微子，并从轻子衰变产物的角分布中获得了广义布洛赫表示下的联合自旋密度矩阵。非经典关联通过Peres-Horodecki负性和几何量子关联进行量化，并在标准模型框架内和存在可约背景的情况下，分析了不同mₜW区域的关联行为。研究还探讨了顶夸克异常色磁和色电偶极矩对关联的影响。
authors: Amir Subba, Yu Shi

articles.title: Searching for Axion Dark Matter via Superconductor-Spin Hybrid Magnetometers
articles.title_zh: 通过超导体-自旋混合磁力计寻找轴子暗物质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27764v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Axions are a compelling dark matter candidate suggested by theories beyond the Standard Model. The predicted axion-electron coupling and the resulting pseudomagnetic field allow for laboratory axion searches. Here we report an experimental axion search via a superconductor-spin hybrid magnetometer. A state-of-the-art broadband magnetometer with a sensitivity of sub-100 aT/Hz¹/² at tens of kHz has been realized by coupling a ferrite spin sensor to a readout system based on a superconducting quantum interference device. The most stringent terrestrial constraints on the axion-electron coupling have been established in the frequency range 5sim60 kHz. In the future, an improvement on the constraints of more than 4 orders of magnitude is foreseeable through arrays of superconductor-spin hybrid magnetometers with optimized designs. This work demonstrates the potential of superconductor-spin hybrid magnetometers in high-precision magnetic field sensing and the study of fundamental physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 轴子是标准模型之外理论提出的一个引人注目的暗物质候选者，其预测的轴子-电子耦合会产生伪磁场。本文报告了一项通过超导体-自旋混合磁力计进行的轴子实验搜索。研究团队通过将铁氧体自旋传感器与基于超导量子干涉器件的读出系统耦合，实现了一个在数十kHz频率下灵敏度低于100 aT/Hz¹/²的宽带磁力计。该工作在5至60 kHz频率范围内建立了目前最严格的轴子-电子耦合地面限制。未来有望将限制提高四个数量级以上，展示了该技术在高精度磁场传感和基础物理研究中的巨大潜力。
authors: Runqi Kang, Jian Zhang, Liangliang Rong, Xing Rong

articles.title: Certified Non-Degenerate Maximum-Likelihood Benchmarking of Quantum LDPC Decoders
articles.title_zh: 量子LDPC译码器非退化最大似然基准测试的认证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28008v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The measured logical error rate of a quantum low-density parity-check (QLDPC) code depends on the decoding algorithm. We develop a framework that certifies non-degenerate maximum-likelihood (ML) decoding outcomes on individual sampled shots under circuit-level noise, providing a common reference for comparing decoders and codes. Upper and lower bounds on the minimum correction cost in the true and competing logical classes establish success, failure, or an undecided outcome. Branch-and-bound search refines these intervals while retaining valid bounds under resource limits. Counting the outcomes bounds the empirical ML logical error rate, with interval width equal to the undecided fraction. Results for two bivariate bicycle codes show that best-first ordered statistics decoding (BF-OSD) tracks the non-degenerate ML benchmark closely while leaving some ML-correctable shots.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子低密度奇偶校验（QLDPC）码的逻辑错误率受译码算法影响。本文提出一个框架，用于在电路级噪声下认证单个采样中的非退化最大似然（ML）译码结果，为比较不同译码器和编码提供通用参考。该方法通过对最小校正成本设置上下界来确定成功、失败或未决结果，并利用分支定界搜索优化这些区间。对两种双变量自行车码的测试表明，最佳优先有序统计译码（BF-OSD）能紧密跟踪非退化ML基准。
authors: Michele Banfi, Marco Ferrari, Antonino Favano, Alberto Tarable, Luca Barletta

articles.title: Enhanced orbital-angular-momentum dimensionality and spatial-spectral decoupling in thin-film SPDC
articles.title_zh: 薄膜SPDC中增强的轨道角动量维度和空间-光谱解耦
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28020v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Thin-film spontaneous parametric down-conversion, due to the relaxed phase-matching condition, generates photon pairs that are extremely broadband in frequency and angle and highly entangled in time/frequency and position/momentum. Here we show that it also provides a very broad orbital angular momentum (OAM) spectrum, which, in contrast to the case of bulk crystals, is decoupled from the frequency spectrum. To demonstrate it experimentally, we generate photon pairs in a 7~μm-thick lithium niobate film and compare them with those from a 500~μm-thick periodically poled lithium niobate crystal under identical pump conditions. The thin-film source exhibits a substantially broader OAM spectrum, with the azimuthal Schmidt number almost 9 times larger than that of the bulk source. On this highly entangled state, we perform quantum-state tomography in selected two- and four-dimensional OAM subspaces, demonstrating high-purity maximally entangled states. These results highlight thin nonlinear films as a promising platform for high-dimensional quantum-state generation with weak spatial--spectral coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 薄膜自发参量下转换（SPDC）因其宽松的相位匹配条件，能产生频率和角度极宽、时间/频率与位置/动量高度纠缠的光子对。本文研究表明，薄膜SPDC还能提供非常宽的轨道角动量（OAM）谱，且与频率谱解耦。实验中，7微米厚铌酸锂薄膜源的OAM谱比500微米厚晶体源宽得多，方位角施密特数几乎是后者的9倍。这些结果表明薄膜非线性材料是生成高维量子态的理想平台。
authors: Dmitrii Akatev, Jakub Lewandowski, Maria Chekhova

articles.title: Dynamics of two bosons with density-assisted tunnelling in a one-dimensional tilted lattice
articles.title_zh: 一维倾斜晶格中具有密度辅助隧穿的两个玻色子的动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28278v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate the dynamics of two bosons in a tilted one-dimensional optical lattice with both standard and density-assisted tunnelling. The relative sign of the two tunnelling processes strongly affects the Bloch dynamics, leading to distinct reinforcing and competing regimes. We examine how the tunnelling processes generate correlations and find that, in the absence of onsite interactions, the early-time entanglement growth follows the same scaling with the density-assisted tunnelling amplitude. Finite onsite interaction changes this picture by breaking the symmetry between the reinforcing and competing regimes and enhancing the correlation differently in two regimes. This shows how the interplay between the two tunnelling mechanisms can change dyanmics and entanglement in a controlled few-body setting. Particularly, at equal tunnelling amplitudes, the doublon and singlon sectors decouple completely for arbitrary onsite interaction, lattice tilting, and initial state.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一维倾斜光学晶格中两个玻色子的动力学，其中包含标准隧穿和密度辅助隧穿。两种隧穿过程的相对符号显著影响布洛赫动力学，导致增强和竞争两种不同机制。研究发现，在没有局域相互作用时，早期纠缠增长与密度辅助隧穿振幅呈相同标度。有限的局域相互作用打破了增强和竞争机制之间的对称性，并以不同方式增强了相关性，揭示了两种隧穿机制如何协同改变动力学和纠缠。
authors: Muhammad S. Hasan, Vikash Mittal, Tomasz Sowiński

articles.title: Orbital-angular-momentum control of localized Floquet states and photocurrents in Weyl semimetals
articles.title_zh: 魏尔半金属中局域Floquet态和光电流的轨道角动量控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28396v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Structured light provides a route to controlling quantum materials not only through its polarization, but also through its spatial profile and orbital angular momentum (OAM). We develop real space theories of a Weyl semimetal driven by a vortex beam and show that optical OAM generates highly localized Floquet vortex states with pronounced circulating photocurrents. Exploiting cylindrical symmetry, we derive a Bogoliubov-de Gennes-like radial equation that resolves the states by angular momentum and reveals their evolution between the light-dressed Weyl cones. For Laguerre-Gaussian beams, the spatially varying drive produces strong hybridization between localized vortex states and bulk states. We complement this continuum description with a Wilson-lattice formulation that retains the full two-dimensional spatial structure and enables direct calculation of local photocurrents. Both approaches consistently identify OAM-induced vortex states localized around the beam axis. The lattice calculation further shows that these states support substantially stronger circulating current densities than the more extended surface states, with the largest current densities associated with the most strongly localized, low-angular-momentum vortex modes. Our results establish optical OAM as a tunable control parameter for creating and manipulating localized current-carrying states in Weyl systems and provide a real-space framework for studying photocurrents generated by spatially structured light.
articles.abstract_zh: 结构光可以通过其偏振、空间分布和轨道角动量（OAM）来控制量子材料。本文发展了涡旋光束驱动魏尔半金属的实空间理论，表明光学OAM能产生高度局域的Floquet涡旋态和显著的循环光电流。研究利用柱对称性导出了类Bogoliubov-de Gennes径向方程，并结合Wilson晶格公式，一致地识别出OAM诱导的局域涡旋态。晶格计算进一步显示，这些态支持比扩展表面态更强的循环电流密度。
authors: Kyle S. Netherwood, Juan I. Aranzadi, Nils Jacobsen, Michael A. Sentef, Sang Soon Oh

articles.title: Entanglement Distribution in Quantum Switch Networks: Memory Limits and Achievability
articles.title_zh: 量子交换网络中的纠缠分发：内存限制与可实现性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28596v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the minimum persistent memory required to distribute a graph state through a quantum switch. Specifically, consider a central switch that assists n remote users in distributing a graph state, using independently generated user-switch Bell pairs. Since Bell-pair generation is probabilistic, different links generally succeed at different times. When a Bell-pair is generated, the qubits may need to be stored in memory while waiting for other links to succeed. Recently, new protocols have been proposed to reduce this storage overhead by processing and releasing some switch qubits before all Bell links are available. However, these protocols do not characterize the minimum persistent switch memory required at each stage. Moreover, the local-cover method in the state-of-the-art Piecemaker protocol is computationally expensive for general target graphs. In this work, we characterize the minimum persistent switch memory required after any subset of users' Bell links are generated and processed. We then develop an online stabilizer-transition protocol that attains this limit, which can be implemented in polynomial time in the number of qubits n. Remarkably, this optimal protocol can provide substantial memory reductions over existing heuristic approaches. In particular, for the path graph Pₙ over n users, Piecemaker protocol requires at least łfloor n/2f̊loor qubits of peak persistent memory for every Bell-links generation order, whereas under the order (1,2,łdots,n), our protocol requires only one persistent switch qubit. Finally, the same stabilizer-transition framework also provides a direct forward construction for sequential graph-state generation using the minimum number of quantum emitters, equal to the maximum of the height function.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了通过量子交换机分发图态所需的最小持久内存。由于贝尔对生成是概率性的，不同链路成功时间不同，需要存储量子比特。现有协议旨在减少存储开销，但未能明确各阶段所需的最小持久交换机内存。本工作刻画了在任意用户贝尔链路生成和处理后所需的最小持久交换机内存，并提出了一种在线稳定器转换协议，该协议能达到此限制，且可在多项式时间内实现。
authors: Lei Hu, Alptug Aytekin, Stavros Mitrolaris, Mohamed Nomeir, Subhankar Banerjee, Sennur Ulukus, Saikat Guha

articles.title: Characterizing supersolid phase transitions in trapped quantum gases with tilted dipoles at finite temperature
articles.title_zh: 有限温度下倾斜偶极子囚禁量子气体中超固相变的表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28621v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Motivated by a recent experimental work [hrefhttps://arxiv.org/abs/2608.20327arXiv:2608.20327], we theoretically investigate the nature of phase transitions in a trapped dipolar quantum gas upon tuning the contact interaction strength and dipole orientation. Using extended Gross-Pitaevskii simulations including thermal and quantum effects, we map the phase diagram comprising unmodulated superfluids, triangular droplet arrays, and stripe states. We further characterize the order of the transitions separating them through imaginary-time hysteresis analysis. The unmodulated-to-modulated transition evolves from discontinuous to continuous with increasing dipole tilt before becoming discontinuous again at large tilts. The degree of continuity is further affected by particle number, temperature, and confinement. While continuous behavior generally correlates with the emergence of stripe states, this correspondence is not systematic, and finite-size effects also influence the continuity of the transition. The triangular-to-stripe transition is found to be discontinuous at small contact interaction strengths and becomes increasingly continuous upon approaching the unmodulated-to-modulated phase boundary. Our results reveal a tunable transition order in finite dipolar quantum gases and provide guidance for its experimental investigation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论研究了囚禁偶极量子气体中相变的性质，通过调整接触相互作用强度和偶极方向。利用包含热效应和量子效应的扩展Gross-Pitaevskii模拟，绘制了包含非调制超流体、三角液滴阵列和条纹态的相图。研究通过虚时滞后分析表征了这些相变，发现非调制到调制相变随偶极倾斜角增加而从不连续变为连续，并在大倾斜角时再次变为不连续。三角到条纹相变在小接触相互作用强度下不连续，并逐渐变得连续。
authors: Julian Kusch, Lauriane Chomaz, Wyatt Kirkby

articles.title: Variational Perturbation Theory in Open Quantum Systems for Efficient Steady State Computation
articles.title_zh: 开放量子系统中用于高效稳态计算的变分微扰理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.00085v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Determining the steady state of an open quantum system is crucial for characterizing quantum devices and studying various physical phenomena. Often, computing a single steady state is insufficient, and it is necessary to explore its dependence on multiple external parameters. In such cases, calculating the steady state independently for each combination of parameters quickly becomes intractable. Perturbation theory (PT) can mitigate this challenge by expanding steady states around reference parameters, minimizing redundant computations across neighboring parameter values. However, PT has two significant limitations: it relies on the pseudo-inverse -- a numerically costly operation -- and has a limited radius of convergence. In this work, we remove both of these roadblocks. First, we introduce a variational perturbation theory (VPT) and its multipoint generalization that significantly extends the radius of convergence even in the presence of non-analytic effects such as dissipative phase transitions. Then, we develop two numerical strategies that eliminate the need to compute pseudo-inverses. The first relies on a single LU decomposition to efficiently construct the steady state within the convergence region, while the second reformulates VPT as a Krylov space recycling problem and uses preconditioned iterative methods. We benchmark these approaches across various models, demonstrating their broad applicability and significant improvements over standard PT.
articles.abstract_zh: 确定开放量子系统的稳态对于表征量子器件至关重要，但独立计算每个参数组合下的稳态是不可行的。传统微扰理论（PT）虽能减少计算量，但受限于伪逆的计算成本和收敛半径。本文引入了一种变分微扰理论（VPT）及其多点推广，显著扩展了收敛半径，并开发了两种无需计算伪逆的数值策略。这些方法克服了PT的局限性，实现了开放量子系统稳态的高效计算。
authors: André Melo, Gaspard Beugnot, Fabrizio Minganti

articles.title: Correlated emission of electron-current waves
articles.title_zh: 电子电流波的关联发射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.24052v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Correlated emission of light offers a potential avenue for entanglement generation between atomic spins, with potential application for sensing and quantum memory. In this work, we investigate the conditions for the correlated emission by color centers into an electronic bath of conduction electrons. Unlike emission into bosonic modes, electrons can absorb energy via two-particle processes across a large range of length scales. We find that two length scales are particularly relevant in a clean system: one set by the Fermi velocity and the frequency of the color centers v_F/Δ, and the other set by the Fermi wavelength łambda_F łl v_F/Δ. Subradiance requires emitters to be spaced at a distance closer than the Fermi wavelength, while superradiance requires spacing less than sqrtłambda_F v_F/Δ, so long as the emitters are initialized with coherence. We show that the emitted current burst has a spiral form, and we discuss the experimental possibility to observe correlated dissipation by color-center qubits coupled to electronic environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 关联光发射为原子自旋间的纠缠生成提供了途径。本文研究了色心向导电电子电子浴中关联发射的条件，发现清洁系统中存在两个关键长度尺度。亚辐射要求发射器间距小于费米波长，而超辐射要求间距小于特定值，前提是发射器具有相干性。研究表明，发射的电流爆发呈螺旋状，并讨论了在电子环境中观察色心量子比特关联耗散的实验可能性。
authors: Shane P. Kelly, Eric Kleinherbers, Yanyan Zhu, Yaroslav Tserkovnyak

articles.title: QUT: A Unit Testing Framework for Quantum Subroutines
articles.title_zh: QUT：一个用于量子子程序的单元测试框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.17538v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present the architectural design and prototype implementation of QUT (Quantum Unit Testing), a framework for unit testing of quantum subroutines. The framework is developed with a focus on usability and simplicity, making the complex theoretical concepts behind quantum unit testing accessible to a wide range of users with diverse backgrounds. This is achieved through the implementation of polymorphic probabilistic assertions, whose evaluation methods adapt to the data types of the arguments used in assertion statements, which may vary according to the context-dependent semantics of quantum subroutines. These arguments can be represented as qubit measurement outcomes, density matrices, or Choi matrices. For each type, the architecture integrates a specific testing protocol - such as quantum process tomography, quantum state tomography, or Pearson's chi-squared test - while remaining flexible enough to incorporate additional protocols in the future. The framework is built on the Qiskit software stack, providing compatibility with a broad range of quantum hardware backends and simulation platforms. Drawing on the reasoning provided by the denotational semantics of quantum subroutines, this work also highlights the key distinctions between quantum unit testing and its classical counterpart.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了QUT（量子单元测试）框架的架构设计和原型实现，旨在为量子子程序提供单元测试功能。该框架注重可用性和简洁性，通过实现多态概率断言，使复杂的量子单元测试理论概念易于理解。QUT能够适应不同数据类型（如量子比特测量结果、密度矩阵或Choi矩阵），并集成了量子过程层析、量子态层析等测试协议。该框架基于Qiskit软件栈构建，兼容多种量子硬件后端和模拟平台。
authors: Mykhailo V. Klymenko, Thong Hoang, Hoa Nguyen, Samuel A. Wilkinson, Bahar Goldozian, Xing Zhenchang, Qinghua Lu, Muhammad Usman, Liming Zhu

articles.title: Entanglement spectrum and Schmidt mode evolution during two-particle scattering
articles.title_zh: 双粒子散射过程中的纠缠谱和施密特模演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.02239v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A particle initially in a pure state but interacting with some environment evolves into a discrete ensemble of pure states, the eigenstates of its reduced density operator, with ensemble probabilities given by the corresponding eigenvalues. In this work, we use numerics to present explicit results for the time-dependence of these eigenvalues and eigenstates for simple scattering experiments in one and two dimensions. This provides a time-resolved picture of the scattering process, showing in detail how an initial state described entirely in terms of continuous parameters evolves into a discrete set of possible outcomes, each with an associated probability and time-evolving wavefunction. We find that for scattering of Gaussian wavepackets in one dimension, the late time spectrum is dominated by two large eigenvalues nearly equal to the transmission and reflection probabilities associated with the central value of momentum. The corresponding eigenstates appear as single-peaked reflected or transmitted wavepackets. The remaining smaller eigenvalues, which increase to a maximum during scattering and then decrease to small values, correspond to reflected or transmitted wavepackets with multiple spatially separated parts. In this case and also for two-dimensional scattering, we find that successively smaller eigenvalues correspond to probability distributions with successively more peaks. These multi-peaked states correspond to outcomes of the scattering experiment where a particle initially in a single wavepacket ends up in a superposition of separated wavepackets after scattering.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过数值方法，展示了在一维和二维简单散射实验中，粒子约化密度算符的本征值和本征态随时间演化的具体结果。这提供了一个时间分辨的散射过程图像，详细展示了初始纯态如何演化为离散的纯态集合。研究发现，对于一维高斯波包散射，晚期谱主要由两个与透射和反射概率相关的较大本征值主导。其余较小的本征值在散射过程中先增后减。
authors: Arsam Najafian, Mark Van Raamsdonk

articles.title: Multipath wave-particle duality with exact quantification of which-path knowledge
articles.title_zh: 具有路径信息精确量化的多路径波粒二象性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.13083v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A quantum system (quanton) traverses an interferometer with N equally probable paths and interacts with another quantum system (detector) that stores path information in a set of symmetric states. In this framework, we present a systematic quantitative study of wave-particle duality based on entropic trade-off relations between quantum coherence, characterized by the relative entropy of coherence of the quanton state, and which-path knowledge, quantified by the mutual information obtained through detector-state discrimination. Unlike prior upper-bound-based formulations, we obtain an exact quantification of which-path knowledge for the discrimination strategies considered here, encompassing previous strategies and extending beyond them. A general optimal measurement is implemented through a state-separation map governed by a continuous parameter ξin[0,1], followed by minimum-error (ME) discrimination of either the successful outputs only (standard approach) or both successful and failure outputs (concatenated approach). Our framework identifies a strategy-dependent hierarchy that generally emerges in the tightness of the resulting duality relations. At ξ=0, both approaches reduce to the ME measurement, which typically yields the tightest relation. For ξ>0, each approach yields a distinct relation that generally becomes less tight as ξ increases, with the concatenated strategy always yielding a relation at least as tight as its standard counterpart. We further characterize saturation of these relations by identifying the detector-state sets that lead to it and show that nontrivial saturation occurs only for interferometers with a nonprime number of paths. From these sets, we elucidate how the underlying structure of the quanton-detector correlations gives rise to this behavior and explains the lack of universal saturation in multipath duality relations for pure states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个系统性的波粒二象性定量研究框架，基于量子相干性（由量子态的相对熵表征）与路径信息（通过探测器态判别获得的互信息量化）之间的熵权衡关系。与以往基于上限的公式不同，该工作对所考虑的判别策略获得了路径信息的精确量化。通过一个由连续参数控制的态分离映射，实现了通用的最优测量。该框架揭示了在结果紧密性中普遍出现的策略依赖性层次结构。
authors: L. F. Melo, O. Jiménez, L. Neves

articles.title: A Route to Quantum-Coherent Thermodynamics
articles.title_zh: 量子相干热力学之路
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.12212v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Equilibrium thermodynamics emerges because a vast number of microscopic states become indistinguishable at the level of local observables. We start from the observation that a nonequilibrium quantum state can also be represented by an ensemble of pure states that minimizes the average energy variance. We show that varying the statistical weights within this optimal family organizes state space into ``minimum-variance leaves'', which generalize the space of stationary states underlying equilibrium. We observe thermodynamic compression on the leaves, which in the simplest scenario manifests itself in the indistinguishability of states with the same energy density. We call this ``leaf typicality''; at equilibrium it reduces to eigenstate thermalization or its generalizations. Numerical tests support leaf typicality on some leaves and indicate a breakdown of its stronger forms on others, suggesting a rich thermodynamic organization beyond equilibrium. These results open a route to a unified statistical mechanics of equilibrium and nonequilibrium quantum states.
articles.abstract_zh: 平衡热力学源于大量微观态在局域可观测量层面变得不可区分。本文提出，非平衡量子态也可由最小化平均能量方差的纯态系综表示。通过改变该最优系综内的统计权重，态空间被组织成“最小方差叶”，这推广了平衡态下的稳态空间。研究观察到叶上的热力学压缩，在最简单情况下表现为相同能量密度态的不可区分性，即“叶典型性”。数值测试支持了某些叶上的叶典型性，并揭示了其他叶上更强形式的失效，预示了超越平衡态的丰富热力学组织。
authors: Maurizio Fagotti

articles.title: Tight Quantum Speed Limit for Ergotropy Charging in the N-Qubit Dicke Battery
articles.title_zh: N量子比特Dicke电池中能量提取充电的紧致量子速度极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.10415v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We derive a quantum speed limit for ergotropy charging in the N-qubit Dicke battery. With the qubits initially in their ground state and the charger in a coherent state of mean photon number barn, the charging time to a target fraction ǎrepsilon of the maximum extractable work obeys, in the classical-field limit, Γ_N τ*(ǎrepsilon) ≥ arcsinsqrtǎrepsilon, where Γ_N = 2łambdasqrtbarn/N is a single rate combining the light-matter coupling, the charger amplitude and the system size. The bound is geometric: although the ergotropy is defined by an optimisation over unitaries, it reduces to a fixed function of the angle swept by the collective spin on the Bloch sphere, and the drive bounds the rate at which that angle can grow, so the charging time is at least the required arc divided by the maximum angular velocity. The reduction rests on an exact statement about work extraction: only the coherent component of the drive delivers extractable work, while its vacuum fluctuations deposit energy that remains locked in the passive state. This makes the short-time coefficient independent of the charger occupation, and it is what separates a bound on extractable work from a bound on stored energy, which no instantaneous-power argument can supply. At finite charger occupation the inequality is tested rather than proved: numerical integration of the full Dicke Hamiltonian, with a dynamical charger and a mixed battery state, finds the bound respected at every admitted charging time for two to five qubits, and approached most closely in the limit of small target work. The familiar square-root estimate is the chord to this arc, recovered in the small-angle limit and weaker whenever a large fraction of the maximum work is required.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文推导了N量子比特Dicke电池中能量提取充电的量子速度极限。在经典场极限下，充电时间满足一个几何界限，该界限与集体自旋在布洛赫球上扫过的角度有关。研究发现，只有驱动的相干分量提供可提取功，而真空涨落沉积的能量则锁定在被动态中。
authors: Anass Jad, Abderrahim El Allati

articles.title: Quantum Algorithms for Gibbs Expectation of Non-log-concave and Heavy-tailed Distributions
articles.title_zh: 非对数凹和重尾分布的吉布斯期望量子算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.00656v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We establish a systematic framework of unbiased quantum sampling and estimation protocols for the classical Gibbs expectation.
