This framework generalizes existing approaches to the partition function estimation and has broader applications in various fields. We consider sampling and estimation for a wide class of non-log-concave distributions, particularly heavy-tailed ones, under relaxed assumptions beyond strong convexity, such as dissipativity. We develop an unbiased extension of quantum-accelerated multilevel Monte Carlo (QA-MLMC) to eliminate all biases from discretization and time truncation, together with introducing a change-of-measure approach and the Girsanov theorem via Radon-Nikodym derivatives. As a result, our approach achieves quantum complexity widetildeO(ϵ⁻¹) within error ϵ, whereas the classical MLMC requires widetildeO(ϵ⁻²) and existing quantum algorithms yield biased estimators under stronger assumptions. Furthermore, our unified framework enables unbiased quantum sampling and estimation for certain heavy-tailed distributions after transformation. We provide several concrete applications of our approach in statistics, machine learning, and finance, towards more practical scenarios of the quantum acceleration of stochastic processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为经典吉布斯期望建立了无偏量子采样和估计协议的系统框架。该框架推广了现有方法，并适用于广泛的非对数凹分布，特别是重尾分布。通过引入测度变换和Girsanov定理，作者开发了量子加速多级蒙特卡洛（QA-MLMC）的无偏扩展，实现了在误差ϵ内复杂度为widetildeO(ϵ⁻¹)的量子算法，优于经典方法和现有量子算法。
authors: Xinmiao Li, Jin-Peng Liu

articles.title: Scalable Determination of Penalization Weights for Constrained Optimizations on Approximate Solvers
articles.title_zh: 近似求解器上约束优化的可扩展惩罚权重确定方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.02416v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) provides problem formulations for various computational problems that can be solved with dedicated QUBO solvers, based on classical or quantum computation. A common approach to constrained combinatorial optimization problems is to enforce the constraints in the QUBO formulation by adding penalization terms. Penalization introduces an additional hyperparameter that significantly affects the solver's efficacy: the relative weight between the objective terms and the penalization terms. Here we study the problem of a priori determining suitable penalization weights from a foundational and practical perspective. We formally establish that finding its optimal value for Gibbs solvers is mathsfNP-hard even approximately and #mathsfP-hard exactly. This serves us as a motivation to develop a widely applicable heuristic strategy for determining suitable penalization weights, with provable guarantees for Gibbs solvers, and polynomial complexity for broad problem classes. Experiments across diverse problems and solver architectures, including large-scale instances on Fujitsu's Digital Annealer, show robust performance and order-of-magnitude speedups over existing heuristics. We further extend the strategy to quantum approximate optimization and demonstrate its performance on Quantinuum's H2-2 trapped-ion processor.
articles.abstract_zh: 约束组合优化问题常通过在二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）公式中添加惩罚项来处理，其中惩罚权重是影响求解器效率的关键超参数。本文从理论和实践角度研究了预先确定合适惩罚权重的问题，并证明了其最优值对于吉布斯求解器是NP-难的。为此，作者提出了一种广泛适用的启发式策略，该策略对吉布斯求解器具有可证明的保证，并对广泛问题类别具有多项式复杂度。
authors: Edoardo Alessandroni, Sergi Ramos-Calderer, Michel Krispin, Markus Kirsch, Christian Münch, Fritz Schinkel, Stefan Walter, Martin Kliesch, Leandro Aolita, Ingo Roth

articles.title: One pure steered state implies Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen steering for two-qubit entangled states
articles.title_zh: 一个纯受控态意味着两量子比特纠缠态的爱因斯坦-波多尔斯基-罗森导引
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.18243v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this work, we show that a two-qubit entangled state admitting at least one pure steered state is Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen (EPR) steerable from Alice to Bob. Pure steered states signifies that the quantum steering ellipsoid of Bob is tangent to his Bloch sphere at least at a single point. Furthermore, we prove that for a two-qubit entangled state, Bob's quantum steering ellipsoid is tangent to his Bloch sphere at exactly N points, for Nin  0,1,2,infty, if and only if Alice's quantum steering ellipsoid is tangent to her Bloch sphere at exactly N points. For any two-qubit entangled state, therefore, if one party can steer the other to at least one pure state, the state is two-way EPR steerable. We also present several illuminating examples of two-qubit entangled states such that the EPR steering can be verified in terms of pure steered states. Our result addresses the Gisin theorem in a EPR steering scenario: at least a single pure steered state implies two-way steering.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明，如果一个两量子比特纠缠态至少存在一个纯受控态，则该态从Alice到Bob是爱因斯坦-波多尔斯基-罗森（EPR）可导引的。纯受控态意味着Bob的量子导引椭球至少在一个点上与他的布洛赫球相切。研究进一步表明，如果一方能将另一方导引至至少一个纯态，则该态是双向EPR可导引的。
authors: Qiu-Cheng Song, Joonwoo Bae

articles.title: On Performance and Limitations of Quantum Wave Packet Dynamics Simulated using NISQ Hardware
articles.title_zh: 使用NISQ硬件模拟量子波包动力学的性能与局限性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.20078v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate one-dimensional quantum wave-packet dynamics using a grid-based encoding of the wave function onto qubit registers. Time evolution is implemented using a split operator approach, with the kinetic energy operator realized via the Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) and arbitrary discretized potentials represented by commuting Pauli-Z gates. The algorithm is benchmarked against classical grid-based simulations and validated using a noiseless Qiskit Statevector simulator before being implemented on current quantum hardware (IBM Quantum and IonQ) for qubit counts ranging from two to five. Good agreement with benchmark calculations is obtained for two- and three-qubit implementations, while deviations increase at larger qubit counts due to hardware noise and increased circuit depth. Among the devices examined, the algorithm maintains closer agreement with the benchmark on the trapped-ion IonQ Forte processor as the number of qubits increases.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了使用基于网格的波函数编码在量子比特寄存器上的一维量子波包动力学。时间演化通过分裂算子方法实现，并在无噪声模拟器和实际量子硬件（IBM Quantum和IonQ）上进行了基准测试。结果显示，在两到三个量子比特实现中与经典模拟吻合良好，但随着量子比特数量增加，由于硬件噪声和电路深度增加，偏差也随之增大。
authors: Tamila Kuanysheva, Jonathan Andrade-Plascencia, Jayakrushna Sahoo, Brian Kendrick, Dmitri Babikov

articles.title: QML-PipeGuard: Detecting Channel-Substitution Attacks on Quantum Machine Learning Pipelines in Untrusted Clouds
articles.title_zh: QML-PipeGuard：检测不可信云中量子机器学习管道的信道替换攻击
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.25066v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: As machine-learning workloads move onto quantum hardware they inherit a trust problem classical AI deployments have largely solved and quantum ones have not: quantum machine learning (QML) is already sold as a cloud service, and a customer cannot check that the circuit they paid for is actually the circuit that ran. We show the gap is exploitable. A malicious or cost-cutting provider can substitute the declared quantum channel with one that reproduces every accuracy test the customer performs, passes the single-observable checks used in practice, and still differs from the declared computation at the channel level. We call this a channel-substitution attack and instantiate it in three deployments: audit evasion, service downgrade, and result forgery in reproducibility review. QML-PipeGuard detects the attack at runtime from measurement statistics the customer already collects. Its guarantee is two-sided, stated in the distance a local verifier measures: any substitution shifting a single-qubit output marginal by δ in trace norm forces a contract deviation of at least δ/sqrt3, the constant tight and independent of qubit count; the guarantee is relative to the chosen observable family and reference-input set. For local-unitary substitutions the adversary's blind set is characterised exactly, as a commutation condition, which gives the defender a rule for choosing challenge inputs that shrinks it. A finite-shot budget rule bounds false accepts and false alarms at once, one tolerance separates attack from the benign drift observed here, and every decision enters a hash-anchored audit trail. On an IBM Heron r2 processor a substituted quantum-kernel intrusion-detection pipeline evades the weak contract and our verifier halts it, while the honest channel stays within tolerance.
articles.abstract_zh: 随着机器学习工作负载转向量子硬件，出现了客户无法验证实际运行电路的问题。本文揭示了恶意提供商可能通过信道替换攻击来规避审计、降级服务或伪造结果。作者提出了QML-PipeGuard，一种在运行时从测量统计数据中检测此类攻击的方法。该方法提供双边保证，确保任何单量子比特输出边际的替换都会导致可检测到的合同偏差。
authors: Esra Yeniaras

articles.title: Near-Optimal Quantum Algorithm and Complexity Analysis for Riccati Problems
articles.title_zh: 黎卡提问题的近最优量子算法与复杂度分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.37207v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We develop quantum algorithms that construct block-encodings of solution matrices for continuous- and discrete-time algebraic Riccati equations (CAREs and DAREs), differential Riccati equations (DREs), and finite Riccati recursions. The Quantum Weighted Riesz Method, unifying four kinds of Riccati problems, constructs projectors onto the solution graphs using weighted Riesz branching operators and recovers the solution matrices. Under the stated access and normalization assumptions, our algorithms for CAREs and DAREs have near-optimal query complexity Θ(mathcal Rα) up to logarithmic factors, with the generalized singularity factor mathcal R that reflects spectral separation, and the output normalization α. For DREs and finite-horizon problems, the query complexity has an additional initialization conditioning factor κₘ̊ ᵢₙᵢₜ. We establish product query lower bounds for specified input-oracle families, demonstrating necessary joint dependence on spectral separation and initialization or output scale. We also prove that selected-value promise problems are BQP-complete on explicit circuit-generated families of single-control discrete-time algebraic and zero-terminal differential Riccati equations. Applications include classical feedback evaluation for linear-quadratic control, a query-complexity comparison for stable random-phase approximation Riccati equations in quantum chemistry, and heated boundary control with numerical validation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文开发了用于连续和离散时间代数黎卡提方程（CAREs和DAREs）、微分黎卡提方程（DREs）以及有限黎卡提递推的量子算法。这些算法通过量子加权Riesz方法构建解矩阵的块编码，并实现了近最优的查询复杂度。研究还建立了乘积查询下界，证明了对谱分离和初始化或输出尺度的必要联合依赖性。
authors: Jingyao Wang, Yanqiao Wang, Bowen Li, Jin-Peng Liu, Zhengfeng Ji

articles.title: On the structural properties of Lie algebras via associated labeled directed graphs
articles.title_zh: 通过关联标记有向图研究李代数的结构性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.16161v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present a method for associating labeled directed graphs to finite-dimensional Lie algebras that are graph-admissible. The proposed framework enables visual identification of key structural algebraic features. We first formalize this approach and establish several classes of Lie algebras that admit the categorization as graph-admissible Lie algebras, and then investigate suitable valid graphs for this approach by translating the antisymmetry of the Lie bracket and the Jacobi identity into rules that such graphs must satisfy. Furthermore, based on these foundations, we provide graph-theoretic criteria for solvability, nilpotency, presence of ideals, simplicity, semisimplicity, and reductiveness of an algebra. We also present practical algorithms for constructing such graphs and those associated with the lower central series and derived series via iterative pruning procedures. We further cover specific examples, such as the Schrödinger and Lorentz algebras, which illustrate the applicability of the developed tools to physically relevant cases. Moreover, we explore applications in physics, where the method facilitates computation of similarity transformations essential for determining quantum mechanical time evolution via the Lie-algebraic factorization method. We also discuss a possible generalization of the framework based on magma-gradings of Lie algebras and formulate related open questions. Our approach bridges algebraic and combinatorial perspectives, offering theoretical tools for this area of mathematical physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种将标记有向图与图可容许的有限维李代数关联的方法，从而实现关键代数结构特征的可视化识别。作者形式化了这一方法，并建立了图可容许李代数的类别。在此基础上，提供了代数可解性、幂零性、理想存在性、单性、半单性和可约性的图论判据，并给出了构建此类图的实用算法。
authors: Tim Heib, David Edward Bruschi

articles.title: Magic and Wormholes in the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev Model
articles.title_zh: Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev模型中的“魔性”与虫洞
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.12339v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Any quantum state is fully specified by the expectation values of a complete set of Hermitian operators. For a system of Majorana fermions, such as the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model, this set of observables can be taken to be all possible strings of Majorana fermion operators. The expectation values of these fermion strings in a thermal state depend erratically on the microscopic couplings that specify the SYK Hamiltonian, and we study their statistical properties directly in the thermodynamic limit using path integral techniques. When the underlying SYK Hamiltonian is chaotic, we find that these expectation values are well-modeled as real Gaussian random variables with zero mean and a variance that we compute. In contrast, for the integrable variant of SYK, we find that the expectation values are actually non-Gaussian. We then use these results to study measures of magic in the SYK thermal state, including the robustness of magic and the stabilizer Rényi entropy. We also show that our results can be quantitatively reproduced with a dual gravity calculation in the chaotic case at sufficiently low temperature. In this dual gravity model the variance of a given microscopic operator string is related to a wormhole geometry stabilized by a massive particle which is dual to the operator string. Our results thus provide a concrete and quantitative setting in which to study the relationship between randomness, wormholes and closed universes, as well as a holographic dual of quantum magic.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用路径积分技术，在热力学极限下研究了Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev（SYK）模型中Majorana费米子算符串的期望值统计性质。对于混沌SYK哈密顿量，这些期望值可被建模为实高斯随机变量；而对于可积SYK变体，它们是非高斯的。研究进一步利用这些结果探讨了SYK热态中的“魔性”度量，并指出在混沌情况下，这些结果可以通过对偶引力计算在足够低的温度下定量复现。
authors: Valérie Bettaque, Brian Swingle

articles.title: A quadratic Grassmann manifold optimization problem arising from quantum embedding methods
articles.title_zh: 量子嵌入方法中产生的二次格拉斯曼流形优化问题
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.17080v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This article presents a mathematical analysis and numerical strategies for solving the optimization problem of minimizing the quadratic function J(P) = Tr(BP)- frac12 Tr(A P A P), where A,B in mathbb RM × Mₘ̊ ₛyₘ, with A succeq 0, over the Grassmann manifold m̊ Gr(m,mathbb R^M). While this problem is non-convex and typically admits non-global local minima - posing challenges for Riemannian optimization and self-consistent field (SCF) algorithms - we identify cases where the global minimizer can be obtained by solving an auxiliary convex problem. When this approach is not directly applicable, the solution to the auxiliary problem still serves as an effective initialization for Riemannian optimization methods and SCF algorithms, significantly improving their performance. This work is motivated by applications in quantum embedding methods, particularly in the construction of bath orbitals, where such optimization problems naturally arise.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对一个在格拉斯曼流形上最小化二次函数的优化问题进行了数学分析和数值策略研究。尽管该问题是非凸的且通常存在非全局局部最小值，但作者识别出可以通过求解辅助凸问题获得全局最小值的特定情况。即使不能直接应用，辅助问题的解也能作为黎曼优化和自洽场算法的有效初始化，显著提高性能。
authors: Thomas Ayral, Eric Cancès, Fabian M. Faulstich, Lin Lin, Alicia Negre

articles.title: Finite-Dimensional Type I von Neumann Algebras in PyTorch: A GPU-Accelerated Framework for Random Block-Diagonal Operators
articles.title_zh: PyTorch中的有限维I型冯·诺依曼代数：随机块对角算子的GPU加速框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.15882v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: torchᵥₙₐₗgebra is a PyTorch library for numerical work with finite-dimensional von Neumann algebras, i.e. direct sums of matrix algebras. These algebras are central to operator algebra theory and, via commutants of symmetries, describe quantum systems with conserved charges or superselection rules. To our knowledge, no numerical software treats them as a data type with their centre, family of traces, conditional expectations, inclusions and functional calculus. The library fills the gap between computer algebra (exact but small-scale) and quantum simulators (large-scale but limited to Hilbert-space matrices): it handles batches of operators on CPUs and GPUs with automatic differentiation, and converts operators, states and channels. Key features: Compact tensor representation: 4D tensor (B, C, kmax, kmax), where B is batch size (e.g. Monte Carlo samples), C is the number of summands, and kmax is the max block size, enabling batched GPU processing. Lazy evaluation: matrix data materialized only on access, avoiding memory waste. Random operator generation: custom eigenvalue distributions; Haar, SU(n), COE, CSE unitary ensembles. Functional calculus and spectral methods: matrix absolute value, square root, inverse, entropy via SVD; automatic switch between exact diagonalization (block size up to 256) and power iteration for extreme eigenvalues. Three trace functionals: Tr_blunt (sum of block traces), Trₙₒᵣₘ (dimension-normalized), tauᵥN (faithful normal tracial state). Performance: on a Tesla P100 GPU, processing 20,000 samples of 100x100 operators yields up to 30x speedup over traditional CPU workflows. Availability: open-source at https://gitlab.com/a.hobukob/vonₙₑᵤₘₐₙₙₜypeᵢ/
articles.abstract_zh: torchᵥₙₐₗgebra是一个用于处理有限维冯·诺依曼代数的PyTorch库，它填补了计算机代数和量子模拟器之间的空白。该库支持在CPU和GPU上批量处理算子，并具有自动微分功能，能够转换算子、状态和信道。其主要特点包括紧凑的张量表示、惰性求值和随机算子生成，从而实现高效的GPU批处理。
authors: Irina Nikolaeva, Andrej Novikov

articles.title: Norm properties of quantum uniformity measures
articles.title_zh: 量子均匀性测度的范数性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17454v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We give a complete classification of the norm properties of quantum uniformity measures, introduced by Bu, Gu, and Jaffe to analytically characterize the Clifford hierarchy. Resolving an open question they posed, we show that quantum uniformity measures define norms precisely for k=2,3,4. In particular, we establish the triangle inequality for k=4, whereas for every k≥5 it fails in some dimension. The higher-order result is proved using the structure theory of norming systems of linear equations over finite fields. We also study the geometry of quantum uniformity measures, establishing explicit bounds on the modulus of convexity whenever they define norms. Finally, we give a complete classification of the norm properties of matrix-valued Gowers uniformity functionals, showing that only k=2 defines a norm.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对量子均匀性测度的范数性质进行了完整分类，解决了Bu、Gu和Jaffe提出的一个开放问题。研究表明，量子均匀性测度仅在k=2,3,4时定义范数，并为k=4建立了三角不等式。对于k≥5，三角不等式在某些维度下失效。此外，本文还研究了量子均匀性测度的几何性质，并对矩阵值Gowers均匀性泛函的范数性质进行了分类。
authors: Berke Ünal

articles.title: Zeeman Quantum Geometry of the Layer Pseudo-spin
articles.title_zh: 层状赝自旋的塞曼量子几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26982v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional layers coupled by position-dependent interlayer tunnelling host a layer pseudo-spin whose polarization is a controllable internal degree of freedom. We introduce the quantum geometry of this layer pseudo-spin: a mixed tensor formed from the interband Berry connection and the layer matrix element, which governs the response to an oscillating in-plane electric field. Because the layer pseudo-spin is an Ising-type scalar invariant under threefold rotation, its selection rules differ from those of a pseudovector spin. In a minimal two-band model, the layer-pseudo-spin quantum metric and Zeeman--Berry curvature are nonzero, while their zone integrals vanish. An in-plane drive therefore leaves the spatially averaged polarization unchanged at linear order but imprints a moiré-periodic intracell pattern, directly imageable by layer-resolved tunnelling. For twisted MoTe₂ bilayer, we quantify the local dipole modulation and identify the rectified, helicity-odd, and third-harmonic channels through which a net response appears at higher order.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究引入了层状赝自旋的量子几何概念，其由带间贝里联络和层矩阵元形成的混合张量构成，并控制着对振荡面内电场的响应。由于层状赝自旋是三重旋转下的伊辛型标量不变量，其选择规则与赝矢量自旋不同。在一个最小的两能带模型中，层状赝自旋的量子度规和塞曼-贝里曲率非零，但其区域积分消失。面内驱动在低阶下不改变空间平均极化，但会形成莫尔周期性的胞内图案，可通过层分辨隧穿直接成像。
authors: Bingxuan Jiang, Shihao Zhang

articles.title: Field Theory of the Gutzwiller Projection
articles.title_zh: 戈茨维勒投影的场论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27050v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Gutzwiller projection produces a well-known ansatz for spin-liquid and quantum Hall ground-state wavefunctions that is amenable to numerical simulation, with the Laughlin wavefunction being the most celebrated example. A long-standing issue is the precise relation between the Gutzwiller projection and the closely related parton gauge theory. Here, we clarify this issue by providing a field-theoretic description of the Gutzwiller projection. In a path integral description, the universal physics of the projected state is described in terms of a gauge field supported on a temporal slab of vanishing width ϵ i̊ghtarrow 0 coupled to the bulk matter fields. We analytically derive the universal physics of various Gutzwiller projected states. Our construction is also applicable to discrete symmetries, and we use it to analyze various projected SPT states. Among our results, we show that the Gutzwiller projection is not a good ansatz for the long-distance properties of U(1) Dirac spin liquids, spinon Fermi surface spin liquids or composite Fermi liquids, and that the Gutzwiller projection of a quantum spin Hall state has only quasi-long range order. In contrast, in examples where the gauge field is gapped, including Laughlin states, Z₂ spin liquids and Luttinger liquids, we show that the slab gauge theory from Gutzwiller projection reproduces the correct universal physics of the full parton gauge theory. We also present a generalization of our field theory that describes G-intertwining defects, with application to self-duality defects of recent theoretical interest.
articles.abstract_zh: 戈茨维勒投影是自旋液体和量子霍尔基态波函数的一种常用数值模拟方法。该工作通过提供戈茨维勒投影的场论描述，阐明了其与部分子规范理论之间的精确关系。在路径积分描述中，投影态的普适物理由一个时间切片上支持的规范场与体物质场耦合来描述。研究分析推导了各种戈茨维勒投影态的普适物理，并将其应用于离散对称性，分析了多种投影SPT态。
authors: Abhijat Sarma, Cenke Xu, Chong Wang

articles.title: Quantum Oscillations across Hole Crystallization in Rhombohedral Graphene
articles.title_zh: 菱方石墨烯中空穴晶化过程的量子振荡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27134v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent quantum-oscillation measurements in rhombohedral graphene reveal an abrupt increase in the dominant frequency and the emergence of additional frequencies as the carrier density is lowered toward superconductivity. Noninteracting band models can account for multiple frequencies but do not explain the upward jump. We show that these features can arise from two competing fates of the inner hole pocket in an annular Fermi sea: collapse into a simply connected Fermi liquid or crystallization into an anticrystal, in which localized holes coexist with itinerant electrons. Pocket collapse contracts the outer Fermi contour at fixed density, whereas hole crystallization preserves a larger contour that supports magnetic-breakdown orbits. This contrast provides a possible explanation for the frequency jump, while additional reconstructed orbits produce a multitone spectrum. Our results support the anticrystal as a candidate normal state near superconductivity in rhombohedral graphene.
articles.abstract_zh: 菱方石墨烯中量子振荡测量显示，随着载流子密度降低，主导频率突然增加并出现额外频率。该研究表明，这些现象可能源于环形费米海中内空穴口袋的两种竞争命运：塌缩成简单连接的费米液体或晶化成反晶体。口袋塌缩会收缩外费米轮廓，而空穴晶化则保留更大的轮廓并支持磁击穿轨道。这种对比为频率跳跃提供了可能的解释，同时额外的重构轨道产生了多音谱。
authors: Daniele Guerci, Enrico Rossi

articles.title: Ballistic transport and crystallographic control in altermagnetic quantum rings
articles.title_zh: 异磁量子环中的弹道输运和晶体学控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27173v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study coherent two-terminal transport through a finite-width d-wave altermagnetic quantum ring with nonmagnetic leads. A confined Aharonov--Bohm flux remains exactly h/e periodic and, in the symmetric one-mode geometry, produces an exact half-flux transmission zero. A perpendicular field shifts the interference pattern according to an effective area Aₘ̊ ₑff=1.0342,π r₀² and the altermagnetic splitting resolves the common zero into nearby spin-dependent nodes. Rotating the crystal reverses the transmitted spin, whereas the mirror orientation θ_A=π/4 is exactly spin degenerate. For a 50~nm reference ring, sub-tesla fields yield windows with |P_T|>0.99, the most accessible of which requires a uniform field alone and no confined flux. Finite-bias, thermal, disorder, Zeeman, and spin-conserving voltage-probe calculations show that the polarization is appreciably more stable than individual coherent-resonance amplitudes. These results identify interference-node positions, flux periodicity, and crystal-controlled spin polarization as experimentally useful signatures of an altermagnetic mesoscopic interferometer.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨了通过有限宽度d波异磁量子环的相干两端输运。受限的阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆磁通保持h/e周期性，并在对称单模几何中产生精确的半磁通传输零点。垂直磁场会根据有效面积移动干涉图样，异磁分裂将共同零点解析为附近的自旋相关节点。旋转晶体可以反转传输自旋，而镜像取向则精确地自旋简并。
authors: Edilberto O. Silva

articles.title: Diffusive Description of Superconducting Single-Photon Detectors Using Quantum Mechanics
articles.title_zh: 基于量子力学对超导单光子探测器的扩散描述
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27189v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The methodology of non-Hermitian quantum mechanics is employed to parameterize the dynamics of coupled classical diffusion equations describing low- and high-energy quasiparticles in superconducting single-photon detectors in one to three spatial dimensions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作采用非厄米量子力学方法，对描述超导单光子探测器中低能和高能准粒子动力学的耦合经典扩散方程进行参数化。研究涵盖了一维到三维空间中的超导单光子探测器。
authors: Krzysztof Pomorski, Eryk Halubek

articles.title: Intrinsic Curvature Controls Spontaneous Entanglement of Elastic Rods
articles.title_zh: 内禀曲率控制弹性杆的自发缠结
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27342v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report results from an experimental investigation on the role of intrinsic curvature in the spontaneous entanglement of elastic rods subjected to controlled tumbling. We examine two distinct entanglement mechanisms, knotting and locking, in a statistical ensemble of straight and helical rods with varying arc length and natural curvature. Our primary finding is that natural curvature exerts a dominant, non-monotonic influence on knotting, with a critical curvature that suppresses knot formation and significantly reduces the probability of knotting relative to equivalent straight rods. In contrast, locking is largely insensitive to curvature and scales primarily with rod length. These results, obtained for the macroscopic experimental system studied here, identify geometric parameters that govern distinct entanglement modes in tumbled elastic rods and may inform entanglement processes in microscopic filamentary systems such as DNA.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过实验探讨了内禀曲率在弹性杆自发缠结中的作用，考察了打结和锁定两种缠结机制。主要发现是自然曲率对打结有主导的非单调影响，存在一个临界曲率抑制打结形成。相比之下，锁定机制对曲率不敏感，主要随杆长变化。这些结果揭示了控制翻滚弹性杆不同缠结模式的几何参数，并可能为DNA等微观丝状系统的缠结过程提供信息。
authors: Fani Derveni, Javier Sabater, Pedro M. Reis

articles.title: Fully Automated Wannier Disentanglement via Projectability Selection in Gaussian and Augmented Plane-Wave Frameworks
articles.title_zh: 基于高斯和增广平面波框架中可投影性选择的全自动Wannier解缠结
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27411v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Constructing the frozen manifold for entangled bands requires balancing exact reproduction of the target bands with sufficient variational freedom to build a well-localized subspace from the broader Bloch pool. We present a workflow that systematically determines the energy ceiling for a target number of selected Wannier projections, freezing every Bloch state below this threshold across the sampled k-mesh. By measuring projectability, the spectral weight of each Bloch state projected onto the target localized basis, the workflow detects missing conduction channels and quantifies discrepancies between orbital character and energy-based freezing. In comparisons where we controlled the extent of the energy ceiling, freezing all sub-ceiling states is generally favored over projectability-based frozen states. Of the seven materials we tested, freezing all sub-ceiling states lowers the band error on four from between 11 meV and 1.2 eV to 18 meV or less, and matches the projectability-based choice to within about 2 meV on the remaining three. In each of the four, projectability-based frozen states give the lower spread, showing that spread alone cannot identify the better model. With the frozen states held fixed, the workflow minimizes the gauge-invariant spread, constructs the gauge from density-matrix columns on atomic orbitals, and passes an isolated set of bands to Wannier90 for localization. The workflow is implemented in two programs for seamless high-throughput Wannierization with WIEN2k (wien2wannier) and CRYSTAL (LCAO2Wannier). Using a single set of calibrated defaults, the CRYSTAL implementation with analytic overlaps produces models that reproduce the reference bands of five cells, from bulk h-BN in a joint valence-and-conduction model to a magnetic framework with 1424 orbitals. The WIEN2k implementation produces eight such models from seven calculations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出了一种全自动工作流程，通过系统地确定目标Wannier投影数量的能量上限，来构建纠缠能带的冻结流形。通过测量每个布洛赫态在目标局域基底上的可投影性，该流程能够检测缺失的导电通道并量化轨道特性与基于能量的冻结之间的差异。实验结果表明，冻结所有低于上限的态通常优于基于可投影性的冻结态，显著降低了能带误差。
authors: William P. Comaskey, Jose L. Mendoza-Cortes

articles.title: Magnetic-Field Effects on the Electronic States of the K₄ Lattice
articles.title_zh: 磁场对K₄晶格电子态的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27539v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the electronic states of the K₄ lattice in a uniform magnetic field within a nearest-neighbor tight-binding model. The K₄ lattice is a e̊v{noncentrosymmetric three-dimensional network with triple-Dirac cones at the Γ and H points}. By fixing the Bloch momentum component parallel to the field, the Peierls-substituted tight-binding problem reduces to an effective two-dimensional problem and yields a Hofstadter spectrum e̊v{whose self-similar subpatterns reflect the geometry of the lattice projected onto the plane perpendicular to the field}. A square-like substructure emerges on the flux scale φ = 1/8 for bmBparallel[100], and honeycomb- and triangular-like substructures emerge on the finer scale φ = 1/32 for bmBparallel[111]e̊v{. Here φ is the flux through the elementary plaquette of the projected lattice, and these scales correspond to one flux quantum per projected unit cell. Owing to the screw axes of the chiral K₄ network, the field-parallel momentum acts as an additional flux, which, for commensurate values of this momentum, shifts the spectrum along the flux axis and brings the second triple-Dirac cone at the H point into the magnetic spectrum}. In the weak-field limit, we derive the Landau-level structure from a low-energy effective Hamiltonian around the Γ point. The three-component nature of the triple-Dirac cone gives rise to a cubic secular equation, whose solutions describe how a pseudospin-flat branch coexists with two relativistic Landau ladders e̊v{and a single chiral n=0 level dispersing linearly along the field, in agreement with the lattice calculation}.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在均匀磁场下，利用最近邻紧束缚模型研究了K₄晶格的电子态。K₄晶格是一个非中心对称的三维网络，在Γ和H点具有三重狄拉克锥。通过固定平行于磁场的布洛赫动量分量，问题简化为有效的二维问题，并产生了霍夫施塔特谱。由于手性K₄网络的螺旋轴，平行于磁场的动量充当额外的磁通，使得谱线沿磁通轴移动。
authors: Katsuhiro Takahashi, Shouya Yoshida, Katsunori Wakabayashi

articles.title: Orbital Magnetization within Self-Consistent Hartree-Fock via an Envelope Theorem
articles.title_zh: 基于包络定理的自洽哈特里-福克轨道磁化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27624v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Orbital magnetization is an elementary thermodynamic response function of a quantum system: the derivative of the grand potential with respect to magnetic field. However, naive perturbation theory is fraught with difficulties, as even infinitesimal magnetic fields shatter any bands into a Hofstadter butterfly spectrum. Even at the self-consistent Hartree-Fock (mean field) level, rigorous formulas for the orbital magnetization have only become available within the last year. This work provides a straightforward derivation of orbital magnetization at the mean field level using a completely real-space approach. The key tools used are the magnetic perturbation theory developed in the 1960s and an envelope theorem, which is a standard result in the calculus of variations. For simplicity, we restrict to insulating states at zero temperature on the infinite plane. We also discuss the natural connections to projected position operators and quantum geometry, as well as practical numerical computations.
articles.abstract_zh: 轨道磁化是量子系统的一个基本热力学响应函数，即巨势对磁场的导数。该工作利用完全实空间方法，结合磁微扰理论和包络定理，直接推导了平均场水平下的轨道磁化公式。研究主要关注无限平面上零温度下的绝缘态，并讨论了其与投影位置算符和量子几何的联系，以及实际数值计算。
authors: Daniel E Parker

articles.title: Andreev Scattering Driven Surface Photogalvanic Effect
articles.title_zh: 安德烈夫散射驱动的表面光伏效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27683v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The surface photogalvanic effect is a powerful tool for generating macroscopic direct currents in centrosymmetric film structures via asymmetric scattering of carriers at film boundaries. Here, we uncover a fundamentally distinct regime of photoinduced transport in normal metal-superconductor heterostructures, in which the macroscopic photocurrent is governed by Andreev scattering at the interface rather than by classical scattering. We demonstrate that the interplay between asymmetric surface scattering and Andreev retroreflection yields a giant, strongly frequency-dependent anomalous photocurrent. Strikingly, the electron-hole conversion at the normal-superconducting interface dictates a macroscopic sign reversal of the photogalvanic current across the superconducting transition, and induces non-analytic spectral kinks exactly at the pairing gap frequency. Our results establish the Andreev reflection-driven surface photogalvanic effect as a platform for optical control of superconducting correlations and suggest a direct, non-invasive spectroscopic probe for gap dynamics in hybrid quantum devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 表面光伏效应是中心对称薄膜结构中产生宏观直流电的有效工具。该研究揭示了正常金属-超导体异质结构中光致输运的一个根本不同的机制，其中宏观光电流由界面处的安德烈夫散射而非经典散射控制。研究表明，不对称表面散射和安德烈夫逆反射的相互作用产生了巨大的、强频率依赖的反常光电流。电子-空穴转换导致光伏电流在超导转变时发生宏观符号反转，并在配对能隙频率处产生非解析谱扭结。
authors: V. M. Kovalev, I. G. Savenko

articles.title: Non-uniform grids to accelerate electron-phonon coupling calculations for superconductivity
articles.title_zh: 用于加速超导电子-声子耦合计算的非均匀网格
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27718v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Efficient and accurate evaluation of electron-phonon interactions is essential for predictive superconductivity calculations, but dense Brillouin zone sampling requirements pose a major computational bottleneck. To overcome this, we introduce an accelerated, highly scalable framework that combines a double delta truncation scheme with non-uniform Farey grids in both k and q space. The truncation strategy significantly reduces computational cost by restricting integration to states satisfying energy constraints near the Fermi level, while the Farey grids dynamically resolve sampling errors from localized scattering and stabilize convergence. Applied to elemental aluminium and several high-pressure hydrides, this combined methodology reduces computational cost by up to two orders of magnitude and yields electron-phonon coupling constants and superconducting critical temperatures Tc typically within about 5% of full-grid benchmarks. This approach overcomes sampling bottlenecks associated with dense uniform grids, making accurate, low-cost predictions of superconductivity in complex quantum materials feasible.
articles.abstract_zh: 电子-声子相互作用的精确评估对于超导预测至关重要，但密集的布里渊区采样是计算瓶颈。该工作引入了一种加速且高度可扩展的框架，结合了双德尔塔截断方案和k、q空间中的非均匀Farey网格。该方法将计算成本降低了两个数量级，并使电子-声子耦合常数和超导临界温度Tc的预测精度在5%以内。这使得复杂量子材料中超导性的准确、低成本预测成为可能。
authors: Kang Wang, Siyu Chen, Sun-Woo Kim, Kieran Bozier, Chris Pickard, Bartomeu Monserrat

articles.title: Good-Γ Numbers: A Shell-Optimized Route to the Thermodynamic Limit in Quantum Monte Carlo Calculations of the High-Density Two-Dimensional Electron Gas
articles.title_zh: Good-Γ数：量子蒙特卡洛计算高密度二维电子气热力学极限的壳层优化路径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27761v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Single-particle finite-size errors remain a central obstacle in quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) simulations of periodic systems, conventionally reduced via twist averaging (TA). Here we introduce Good-Γ (GG) particle numbers as system sizes N at which the Γ-point Hartree--Fock (HF) energy of the high-density two-dimensional uniform electron gas (2D UEG) lies anomalously close to its thermodynamic-limit (TL) value. All results in this work concern the 2D UEG in its high-density Fermi-liquid regime, rₛ₌₁₋₋₄. We systematically investigate the kinetic- and exchange-energy errors, Δ KE(N) and Δ EX(N), that underlie this one-body finite-size-error cancellation across four densities and both spin polarizations. We then compare diffusion Monte Carlo (DMC) energies extrapolated to the TL from GG-N sequences against twist-averaged extrapolations at the same densities and polarizations, finding agreement to within a fraction of a millihartree in every case, independent of whether a 1/N or an N⁻⁵/⁴ extrapolation form is used.
articles.abstract_zh: 单粒子有限尺寸误差是周期系统量子蒙特卡洛模拟的主要障碍。该研究引入了Good-Γ (GG) 粒子数，即系统尺寸N，在此尺寸下高密度二维均匀电子气（2D UEG）的Γ点哈特里-福克能量异常接近其热力学极限值。通过系统研究动能和交换能误差，该方法在四种密度和两种自旋极化下，将扩散蒙特卡洛能量外推至热力学极限，与扭曲平均外推结果一致。
authors: S. Azadi, T. D. Kühne, A. Principi, M. S. Bahramy

articles.title: Luther-Emery liquid in one-dimensional attractive Fermi gas
articles.title_zh: 一维吸引费米气体中的Luther-Emery液体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27823v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: One-dimensional (1D) interacting Fermi gases underpin a rich variety of quantum liquids, ranging from the Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid and the Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov paired state to the Luther-Emery liquid (LEL). Notably, the LEL-characterized by gapless excitations in charge or spin degree of freedom and gapped excitations in the other-has long been theoretically predicted but has eluded definitive experimental observation to date. By exactly solving the attractive Yang-Gaudin model via the Bethe ansatz, we fully determine the low-energy excitation spectra for both spin and charge channels. For fully paired fermions, the spectrum features gapped spin excitation coexisting with gapless charge excitation. We further employ bosonization to derive analytical expressions for the dynamical structure factor (DSF) of the gapped spin excitation, which is a long-standing challenge in this study. In the trapped gas, we find that the spin Bragg spectroscopy peak occurs at a much higher frequency than the charge-mode peak, where the splitting frequency between these two peaks scales approximately linearly with the interaction strength. Crucially, the spin gap manifests as a sharp threshold in the spin DSF, below which spectral weight is completely absent, proving a direct and unambiguous spectroscopic fingerprint of the LEL. Our work establishes quasi-1D trapped attractive Fermi gases as a pristine experimental platform for the long-sought direct observation of the LEL.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过Bethe ansatz精确求解吸引Yang-Gaudin模型，确定了一维吸引费米气体中Luther-Emery液体的低能激发谱。结果显示，对于完全配对的费米子，存在有能隙的自旋激发与无能隙的电荷激发共存的现象。文章还利用玻色化方法推导了有能隙自旋激发的动力学结构因子解析表达式，并预测了囚禁气体中自旋布拉格光谱峰与电荷模式峰的分裂频率与相互作用强度近似线性相关。
authors: Hai-Ying Cui, Yi-Cong Yu, Aashish Kafle, Han Pu, Randall G. Hulet, Thierry Giamarchi, Xî-Wen Guan

articles.title: Classical-to-Quantum Transition in Blackbody Radiation Thermodynamics: Planck's Law without Statistical Assumptions
articles.title_zh: 黑体辐射热力学中的经典到量子跃迁：无需统计假设的普朗克定律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27858v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Inspired by Fermi's model of radiation-matter interaction, we investigate the classical dynamics of a closed, finite-energy system, in which matter is coupled to an electromagnetic field. We find that energy is progressively transferred to increasingly high-frequency field modes, so that the effective temperature of both matter and radiation approaches zero in the long-time limit - in sharp contradiction with the finite-temperature equilibrium assumed by classical blackbody thermodynamics. Requiring consistency with the Stefan-Boltzmann and Wien laws identifies a characteristic time t_L, at which both laws are simultaneously satisfied. Strikingly, classical spectra obtained for different energies and cavity sizes collapse onto the universal Planck distribution at t_L. We conjecture that quantum dynamical localization arrests the classical energy cascade at t_L, and that the Planck distribution emerges as a dynamical consequence of this arrest - without invoking any a priori statistical assumption.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文受费米辐射-物质相互作用模型的启发，研究了封闭有限能量系统中物质与电磁场耦合的经典动力学。研究发现，能量会逐渐转移到高频场模式，导致有效温度趋近于零，这与经典黑体热力学相悖。通过与Stefan-Boltzmann和Wien定律一致性，确定了一个特征时间t_L，在此时间点，经典光谱会收敛到普朗克分布。作者推测量子动力学局域化阻止了t_L处的经典能量级联，从而使普朗克分布作为这种阻止的动力学结果而出现，无需任何先验统计假设。
authors: J. Wang, G. Casati, G. Benenti

articles.title: Thermodynamic Stability of Classical mathbb Z₂ Lattice Gauge Models
articles.title_zh: 经典Z₂格点规范模型的热力学稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27938v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Finite-temperature phases are traditionally studied through spontaneous symmetry breaking, but symmetry-breaking fields can remove their distinction, as in the Ising model. This motivates the search for stable nontrivial thermal phases without symmetry protection. For classical mathbb Z₂ lattice gauge models with spins on m-dimensional cells in a fixed spatial dimension d, we prove joint analyticity of the thermodynamic free-energy density in temperature and perturbation strength at sufficiently low positive temperatures under sufficiently weak local perturbations, whenever 1łe młe d-2. Perturbations need not preserve internal or gauge symmetries and may include noncommuting quantum interactions. A separate high-temperature expansion yields an analytic region reaching infinite temperature at any fixed finite perturbation strength. These results establish thermodynamic stability and support the conjecture that low- and high-temperature regimes remain separated by a thermal transition without symmetry protection.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了经典Z₂格点规范模型在有限温度下的热力学稳定性，旨在寻找没有对称性保护的稳定非平凡热相。对于固定空间维度d中m维单元格上的自旋模型，作者证明了在足够低的温度和足够弱的局部扰动下，热力学自由能密度在温度和扰动强度上具有联合解析性。此外，高温度展开也揭示了一个解析区域，该区域在任何固定的有限扰动强度下都能达到无限温度。这些结果确立了热力学稳定性，并支持了低温和高温区域在没有对称性保护的情况下仍通过热相变分离的猜想。
authors: Shunsuke Sengoku, Weiguang Cao, Haruki Watanabe

articles.title: Adiabatic confinement and number-theoretic spectra of massless Dirac fermions in twisted trilayer graphene
articles.title_zh: 扭曲三层石墨烯中无质量狄拉克费米子的绝热限制与数论谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28063v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrons in graphene move like massless relativistic particles, making them exceptionally mobile but difficult to trap because Klein tunnelling permits unimpeded passage through electrostatic barriers. This challenge extends to atomic collapse and hadron confinement. Twisted trilayers form Bernal and rhombohedral domains joined by smooth boundaries, bringing their carriers into contact. Here we show that a new mechanism, distinct from established approaches, confines massless fermions in equilateral triangular Bernal domains without mass barriers, bulk gaps or physical edges. Simulations and analytical modeling reveal that massless carriers have no adiabatic continuation into rhombohedral domains, while escape through nonadiabatic coupling to massive carriers is exponentially suppressed by smooth stacking variation. Perfect reflection in the adiabatic limit turns Bernal domains into quantum cavities in a gapless, edgeless metal. Striking density-of-states oscillations encode Eisenstein-integer arithmetic, linking energies and degeneracies to norms and prime factorizations. These findings bring relativistic confinement and number theory into experimentally accessible electronic spectra.
articles.abstract_zh: 石墨烯中的电子表现为无质量相对论粒子，难以捕获。本研究揭示了一种新机制，可以在扭曲三层石墨烯的等边三角形伯纳尔（Bernal）畴中限制无质量费米子，无需质量势垒、体能隙或物理边缘。模拟和分析模型表明，无质量载流子无法绝热地进入菱面体（rhombohedral）畴，而非绝热耦合到有质量载流子的逃逸则被平滑堆叠变化指数抑制。在绝热极限下，伯纳尔畴成为无能隙、无边缘金属中的量子腔。引人注目的态密度振荡编码了爱森斯坦整数算术，将能量和简并度与范数和素因子分解联系起来。
authors: Kunihiro Yananose, Changwon Park, Young-Woo Son

articles.title: Neural Network Fractional Quantum Hall States with Learnable Orbital Pair Matrix Factors: Balancing Physical Priors and Flexibility
articles.title_zh: 具有可学习轨道对矩阵因子的神经网络分数量子霍尔态：平衡物理先验与灵活性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28095v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural network fractional quantum Hall (FQH) states offer a promising alternative for capturing Landau level (LL) mixing and for understanding FQH physics, yet the incorporation of physical priors has so far been limited to the minimal exact constraints built into the ansatz. Working in spherical geometry, we show that the network's flexibility suffers both when only minimal additional physical priors are supplied and when priors such as flux attachment are imposed rigidly. In the former case, the monopole harmonic product orbital (MHPO) ansatz is difficult to optimize, whereas in the latter, the expressivity of the neural network is restricted. We therefore propose the orbital pair matrix factor MHPO (MHPO-M) ansatz, which balances physical priors against flexibility by not only replacing the fixed Laughlin structure with learnable pair factors but also making them dependent on both the electron configurations and the orbitals. Across ν=1/5, 1/3, and 2/5, MHPO-M achieves the lowest variational energy among the tested variants, and a factorized orbital readout based on it enables scaling to 35 electrons, with energies competitive with trends inferred from three-LL exact-diagonalization results. These results demonstrate that physical priors can be appropriately incorporated without sacrificing the flexibility of neural network wavefunctions, opening a promising path toward accurate, scalable modeling of FQH systems with LL mixing.
articles.abstract_zh: 神经网络分数量子霍尔（FQH）态为捕获朗道能级（LL）混合和理解FQH物理提供了有前景的途径。本文在球形几何中，提出了一种新的轨道对矩阵因子MHPO（MHPO-M）变分波函数，旨在平衡物理先验知识和神经网络的灵活性。该方法通过可学习的对因子取代固定的Laughlin结构，并使其依赖于电子构型和轨道。在ν=1/5、1/3和2/5填充因子下，MHPO-M在测试变体中实现了最低的变分能量，并且基于其分解的轨道读出方法能够扩展到35个电子，其能量与现有方法具有竞争力。
authors: Yubing Qian, Weiluo Ren, Ji Chen

articles.title: Electronic driving of torsional modes in carbon nanotubes via orbital-phonon coupling
articles.title_zh: 通过轨道-声子耦合实现碳纳米管扭转模式的电子驱动
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28326v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically investigate electronic driving of a torsional mode in a suspended carbon nanotube quantum dot. The valley states in a nanotube carry opposite orbital magnetic moments along the tube axis, and intervalley mixing forms valley-mixed eigenstates whose splitting can be controlled by an axial magnetic field. We formulate an orbital-rotation coupling between the torsional angular velocity and the valley orbital angular momentum. Using a master equation for sequential tunneling through normal-metal electrodes, we calculate the steady-state current and the phonon distribution of the torsional mode. When the valley-state splitting matches the torsional phonon energy, orbital transitions can drive the mode out of equilibrium. The contacts control both phonon pumping and its electrical readout, allowing substantial excitation with a positive, vanishing, or negative current response. The mechanism requires no intrinsic spin or valley polarization of the electrodes, but uses state-dependent tunneling at the contacts.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论研究了悬浮碳纳米管量子点中扭转模式的电子驱动机制。纳米管中的谷态携带沿管轴方向相反的轨道磁矩，谷间混合形成谷混合本征态，其分裂可通过轴向磁场控制。研究建立了扭转角速度与谷轨道角动量之间的轨道-旋转耦合关系，并利用主方程计算了稳态电流和扭转模式的声子分布。当谷态分裂与扭转声子能量匹配时，轨道跃迁可以驱动该模式脱离平衡。该机制利用接触点处的状态依赖隧穿，无需电极的本征自旋或谷极化，即可实现显著的声子激发和电学读出。
authors: Koji Yamada, Wataru Izumida, Mamoru Matsuo, Takeo Kato

articles.title: Initial-State-Dictated Dynamical Universality Classes in Quantum Criticality
articles.title_zh: 量子临界性中由初始态决定的动力学普适类
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28365v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The concept of universality class lies at the core of phase transition physics, with each class uniquely characterized by a dedicated set of critical exponents. Here, we introduce the concept of initial-state-dictated dynamical universality classes in nonequilibrium quantum critical dynamics. By studying the imaginary-time relaxation dynamics of the dimerized Heisenberg model, we demonstrate that distinct kinds of initial states can give rise to different dynamical universality classes within the same equilibrium universality class. Specifically, we find that "classical'' paramagnetic (random-spin) and "quantum'' paramagnetic (dimerized and antidimerized) initial states yield drastically different critical initial slip exponents in the bulk. This initial-state dependence also extends to boundary critical dynamics, where different initial states yield different surface critical initial slip exponents even within the same boundary universality class. Remarkably, for the antidimerized initial state, we uncover an anomalous scaling law violating the conventional relation between the bulk and surface critical initial slip exponents. Our results establish an initial-state-controlled dynamical classification of quantum criticality that extends beyond the conventional equilibrium universality paradigm.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了非平衡量子临界动力学中由初始态决定的动力学普适类概念。通过研究二聚化海森堡模型的虚时弛豫动力学，作者证明了在相同的平衡普适类中，不同类型的初始态可以产生不同的动力学普适类。研究发现，“经典”顺磁态和“量子”顺磁态初始态在体相中产生截然不同的临界初始滑移指数，这种初始态依赖性也延伸到边界临界动力学。值得注意的是，对于反二聚化初始态，研究揭示了一个异常标度律，违反了体相和表面临界初始滑移指数之间的传统关系。
authors: Yu-Rong Shu, Shuai Yin

articles.title: Quantum Formulation of the Spinterface Model
articles.title_zh: 界面自旋模型（Spinterface Model）的量子表述
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28406v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a fully quantum formulation of the spinterface model for the chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS) effect, implemented within the non-equilibrium Green's function (NEGF) formalism. The model consists of a gold atom hosting a localised magnetic moment, coupled to a chiral molecular chain with Rashba spin-orbit coupling, and contacted by two non-magnetic leads. The magnetic moment is determined self-consistently from the non-equilibrium electronic distribution, and the spin-resolved transmission is computed from the mean-field Hamiltonian. We show that the interfacial magnetic moment and the chiral Rashba term cooperate to produce large current polarisations that reproduce the key experimental signatures of CISS: high polarisation, a threshold emergence at four total sites followed by interference-modulated growth with chain length, thermal suppression, and sign reversal upon chirality inversion. The central new result of this work is a clean separation of the CISS effect into an even (achiral) and an odd (chiral) contribution to the spin current, IS_z(φ) = IS_zm̊ eveⁿ(φ) + IS_zm̊ odd(φ). We demonstrate that IS_zm̊ odd vanishes exactly at fixed m_z for chains of fewer than four sites and becomes non-zero for chains of four or more sites, with the smallest junction exhibiting a non-zero odd part being the four-site geometry (one gold atom plus three molecular sites). The odd part arises from reciprocity breaking in a device that is simultaneously chiral, magnetically asymmetric (moment on the gold end only), and long enough to support two or more Rashba-active bonds. This provides a direct, parameter-free test of whether an observed spin signal is genuinely chiral or arises from an achiral spin-valve mechanism.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在非平衡格林函数（NEGF）框架内，提出了手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）效应的界面自旋模型的全量子表述。该模型由一个带有局域磁矩的金原子、一个具有Rashba自旋轨道耦合的手性分子链以及两个非磁性引线组成。研究表明，界面磁矩和手性Rashba项协同作用，产生大的电流极化，重现了CISS的关键实验特征。该工作的核心新结果是将CISS效应引起的自旋电流清晰地分离为偶（非手性）和奇（手性）两部分贡献。
authors: Seif Alwan

articles.title: Sum-over-poles framework for quantum embedding to approach the real-frequency axis
articles.title_zh: 基于极点求和框架的量子嵌入方法以逼近实频率轴
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28472v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a real-frequency framework for the quantum embedding of solids, based on sum-over-poles (SOP) representations. We partition the lattice into periodically repeated interacting fragments and derive an embedded Dyson equation for the fragment, to be solved self-consistently. The resulting scheme generalizes the algorithmic-inversion method of our previous work to interacting Hamiltonians and is closely related to dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT), especially when an extended impurity problem is introduced. By exploiting the compact pole expansion of the embedding potential, we carry out the self-consistent procedure close to the real axis, which avoids ill-posed analytic continuation. In addition, the SOP representation allows us to introduce a pole-and-residue dynamics, which we use to reach the self-consistent solution. After deriving the method, we benchmark it against exact-diagonalization implementations of DMFT on the one-dimensional Hubbard ring at half filling. The framework offers a natural route to real-space dynamical quantum embedding, for periodic systems as well as for strongly correlated defects in materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了一种基于极点求和（SOP）表示的实频率量子嵌入框架，用于固体材料的研究。该方法将晶格划分为周期性重复的相互作用片段，并推导出一个嵌入式戴森方程进行自洽求解。通过利用嵌入势的紧凑极点展开，该自洽过程可以在接近实轴的区域进行，从而避免了病态的解析延拓问题。此外，SOP表示还引入了极点和留数动力学，用于达到自洽解。该框架为周期系统以及材料中强关联缺陷的实空间动态量子嵌入提供了一条自然途径。
authors: Alessandro Carbone, Massimo Capone, Nicola Marzari, Tommaso Chiarotti

articles.title: Acceleration of CTQMC via Denoising Diffusion Models with Auxiliary Spectral Functions
articles.title_zh: 基于辅助谱函数的去噪扩散模型加速连续时间量子蒙特卡洛方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28542v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Continuous-time Quantum Monte Carlo (CTQMC) impurity solvers are a numerically exact, but expensive, option for solving the Dynamical Mean Field Theory (DMFT) equations, with statistical noise from undersampling presenting a major challenge to low temperature studies. This noise is especially egregious within the sampled self-energy, which can destabilize the self-consistency loop upon insertion into the Dyson equation. In this work, we introduce a neural denoiser for fermionic imaginary time Green's functions based on the diffusion model architecture trained on synthetic data. The network predicts positive and normalized auxiliary spectral functions consistent with the noisy imaginary axis CTQMC data, which is then refined via autodifferentiation to match the measured self-energy, its first two high-frequency moments, and impurity occupation similar to the Constrained Residual Minimization (CRM) method. This leads to Green's functions and self-energies that are causal by design. Through this denoising framework we are able to reduce the required CTQMC measurement steps by a factor of 10-100. We benchmark our method with a half-filled Hubbard model on a Bethe lattice, a two-patch Dynamical Cluster Approximation (DCA) of the two-dimensional Hubbard model, and the SrVO₃ system. We reproduce the Mott transition upon increasing Coulomb interaction for the half-filled Hubbard model with only 5000 CTQMC measurements, the pseudogap transition for the DCA two-dimensional Hubbard model with only 5×10⁵ measurements, and match the spectral function of SrVO₃ with 50 times fewer measurements than the reference. Since we generate auxiliary spectral functions, we recover the approximate spectral functions of the systems for free without performing analytic continuation.
articles.abstract_zh: 连续时间量子蒙特卡洛（CTQMC）杂质求解器在解决动力学平均场理论（DMFT）方程时面临统计噪声挑战。本文引入了一种基于扩散模型架构的神经网络去噪器，用于费米子虚时格林函数。该网络预测与噪声CTQMC数据一致的辅助谱函数，并通过自动微分进行优化，以匹配自能、高频矩和杂质占据。这种去噪框架能够将所需的CTQMC测量步骤减少10-100倍，显著提高了计算效率，并确保了格林函数和自能的因果性。
authors: Rishi Rao, Li Zhu

articles.title: Bilocal flows and universality with field-dependent regulators
articles.title_zh: 场依赖调节器下的双局域流与普适性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27063v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Many functional renormalization group flows employ a regulator that depends on the fields, as in proper-time and spectrally adjusted flows and in background-independent formulations of gauge theories and quantum gravity. Such a regulator generates additional terms in the flow, and their omission may spoil universality. We introduce bilocal flows, in which the effective action depends on the field and on the cutoff kernel as independent variables. The construction identifies the additional terms, and an exact sum rule shows that the first nontrivial coefficient of the anomalous dimension coincides with that of a fixed-regulator flow for every admissible regulator profile, so that universality is restored. For massless łambdaφ⁴ theory with a proper-time regulator, the reduced flow gives a profile-dependent anomalous dimension, while the completed flow gives the universal two-loop coefficient C_η=1/6 for every profile.
articles.abstract_zh: 许多泛函重整化群流采用依赖于场的调节器，这可能导致额外的项并破坏普适性。本文引入了双局域流，其中有效作用量依赖于场和截断核作为独立变量。这种构造识别了额外的项，并且一个精确的求和规则表明，反常维度的第一个非平凡系数与固定调节器流的系数一致，从而恢复了普适性。对于带有本征时调节器的无质量λφ⁴理论，该方法能够得到普适的两圈系数C_η=1/6。
authors: Alfio M. Bonanno, Renata Ferrero

articles.title: Nonlocality effects on fermions confined within a hard-wall potential
articles.title_zh: 非局域性对硬壁势中受限费米子影响的研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27349v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate nonlocality effects on the energy spectrum of spin-1/2 fermions confined by hard-wall potentials. Starting from a nonlocal Dirac theory with a modified kinetic term, we formulate the associated field equation in flat spacetime using cylindrical coordinates. By exploiting the eigenvalue spectrum of the squared Dirac operator, the original infinite-order equation is reduced to a finite-order problem. We also show that on the branch continuously connected to the local Dirac theory the nonlocal corrections can be encoded in an effective fermion mass. We then find analytical energy spectra for two confining geometries: a cylindrical hard wall and a quantum ring defined by two concentric cylindrical boundaries. In both cases, the radial equations reduce to Bessel equations and the boundary conditions quantize the allowed modes. The local hard-wall spectra are recovered for Łambda→infty, whereas finite nonlocality shifts the mass contribution and, consequently, the particle--antiparticle energy separation. These results provide a direct characterization of nonlocal effects in quantum-confined fermionic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了非局域性对硬壁势中受限自旋1/2费米子能谱的影响。从一个具有修正动能项的非局域狄拉克理论出发，研究者在平坦时空中用柱坐标建立了相应的场方程。通过利用平方狄拉克算符的本征值谱，将原始的无限阶方程简化为有限阶问题。研究发现，非局域修正可以编码为有效费米子质量，并推导了圆柱形硬壁和量子环两种限制几何下的解析能谱。这些结果直接表征了量子受限费米子系统中非局域效应。
authors: G. Q. Garcia, P. J. Porfírio, E. Brito, D. C. Moreira

articles.title: Invariant pseudo-unitary matrix ensembles and local statistics and conductance fluctuations of the DMPK ensemble
articles.title_zh: 不变伪酉矩阵系综与DMPK系综的局域统计和电导涨落
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.27532v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We consider the DMPK ensemble, which models quantum transport in a disordered wire, and describe its limiting local statistics as the number of particles tends to infinity. In the metallic regime, as well as at crossover I, we obtain sine statistics in the bulk, Bessel statistics at the hard edge and Airy statistics at the soft edge. In the insulating regime, we prove localization around certain explicit deterministic positions with Gaussian fluctuations. This confirms and quantifies the predicted universal and localized behavior in the physics literature. At crossover II, we obtain explicit limiting kernels in the bulk and at both edges, which interpolate between these regimes. The hard edge kernel involves Legendre functions and, to the best of our knowledge, is new, while the bulk and soft edge kernels agree with those derived for the squared singular values of critically scaled products of independent Ginibre matrices. To explain these similarities, we construct a class of invariant pseudo-unitary matrices that is closed under taking products and use it to interpret the DMPK ensemble as the joint density of the spectral variables of a product of such random matrices. More generally, the latter takes the form of a polynomial ensemble of derivative type involving a second order differential operator compatible with the Legendre functions. Finally, we obtain uniform asymptotic expansions of the mean and variance of the conductance and prove that the DMPK ensemble admits universal conductance fluctuations, i.e. the variance of the conductance tends to 1/15 throughout the whole metallic regime. This again confirms the predictions in the physics literature.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨了DMPK系综在粒子数趋于无穷时的局域统计特性，该系综用于模拟无序导线中的量子输运。在金属区和交叉I区，获得了体内的正弦统计、硬边缘的贝塞尔统计和软边缘的艾里统计。在绝缘区，证明了粒子在特定确定位置附近的局域化并伴有高斯涨落，这证实并量化了物理文献中预测的普适和局域行为。为解释这些相似性，作者构建了一类在乘法下封闭的不变伪酉矩阵，并用其将DMPK系综解释为谱变量的联合密度。
authors: Dong Wang, Thomas Wolfs

articles.title: Direct Urca process facilitated by non-Fermi-liquid quantum criticality
articles.title_zh: 非费米液体量子临界性促进的直接Urca过程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.28023v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Conventional Fermi-liquid theories of dense nuclear matter predict that the direct Urca process requires a proton fraction above a threshold of Yₚ approx 0.11--0.15, which is rarely reached in low-mass neutron stars. Here we show that this stringent kinematic constraint is drastically relaxed by the non-Fermi liquid behavior arising from superfluid and superconducting quantum criticality in neutron stars. In the non-Fermi-liquid regimes, nucleons have a smooth momentum occupation without a sharp Fermi surface, and their chemical potentials develop a logarithmic temperature dependence. These intrinsic features fundamentally alter the standard β-equilibrium relation. Consequently, direct Urca neutrino emission can be activated even at low nuclear densities. This modifies the long-standing Urca-threshold paradigm and indicates that direct Urca process has the opportunity to occur in low-mass neutron stars.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统的费米液体理论认为直接Urca过程需要质子分数高于0.11-0.15的阈值，这在低质量中子星中很少达到。本研究表明，中子星中超流和超导量子临界性引起的非费米液体行为，可以显著放宽这一严格的运动学限制。在非费米液体区域，核子没有尖锐的费米面，其化学势呈现对数温度依赖性，这些特性从根本上改变了标准的β平衡关系。因此，直接Urca中微子发射即使在低核密度下也能被激活，这修正了长期存在的Urca阈值范式，并表明直接Urca过程有机会发生在低质量中子星中。
authors: Hao-Fu Zhu, Guo-Zhu Liu

articles.title: Quantum Spin Singlet Ground State with Large Excitation Gap in the S = 3/2 quasi-1D van der Waals materials MoX3 (X = I, Br)
articles.title_zh: S = 3/2准一维范德华材料MoX3 (X = I, Br)中具有大激发能隙的量子自旋单态基态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.12613v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report the first experimental evidence for a quantum-disordered spin-singlet ground state and gapped triplon excitations in quasi-one-dimensional van der Waals materials. The insulating van der Waals trihalides MoI3 and MoBr3 are analyzed in a combined thermodynamic, spectroscopic, and theoretical investigation. These materials contain structurally dimerized atomic chains of face-sharing octahedra with alternating short and long Mo-Mo separations along the chain direction. Temperature-dependent bulk magnetic susceptibility measurements reveal a broad thermally activated response consistent with a large spin gap. Inelastic neutron scattering (INS) spectra provide direct evidence of a collective spin gap at an exceptionally large energy transfer of ~ 30 meV (~ 348 K) for MoBr3. The absence of low-energy magnetic spectral weight and the activated susceptibility are inconsistent with a conventional classical antiferromagnetic ground state. Instead, they point to a spin-singlet ground state with a large singlet-triplet excitation gap. To identify the microscopic origin of this gap, we perform density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations on one-dimensional spin chains using exchange constants derived from density functional theory (DFT). The dominance of the single dimer exchange term allows the inter-dimer coupling along the chain and between chains to be treated using perturbation theory. Intrachain exchange lowers the isolated-dimer triplet energy by producing a dispersive triplon band. INS data show the triplon bandwidth to be ~ 20 meV. Interchain coupling produces negligible additional bandwidth on the order of 1 meV. The INS measurements directly establish quantum spin-singlet and triplon physics in MoBr3 with a large singlet-triplet gap on the scale of room temperature, while the susceptibility and theoretical results indicate closely analogous behavior in MoI3.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究首次报告了在准一维范德华材料中，量子无序自旋单态基态和带隙三重子激发的实验证据。通过热力学、光谱学和理论研究，分析了绝缘范德华三卤化物MoI3和MoBr3。非弹性中子散射（INS）谱直接证实了MoBr3在约30 meV处存在集体自旋能隙。低能磁谱权重的缺失和激活磁化率与传统经典反铁磁基态不符，反而指向具有大单重态-三重态激发能隙的自旋单态基态。
authors: Jordan Teeter, Topojit Debnath, Harshil Goyal, Md. Sabbir Hossen Bijoy, Maedeh Taheri, Nicholas R. Sesing, Clayton Mantz, Josemaria Garcia, Mathew B. Stone, Colin Sarkis, Do Hoon Kiem, Sohee Kwon, Mina Yoon, Fariborz Kargar, Kirill Shtengel, Tina T. Salguero, Alexander A. Balandin, Roger K. Lake

articles.title: Néel Ordered Magnetic Phases in Bipartite Quasicrystals
articles.title_zh: 二分准晶中的Néel有序磁相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.22204v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetism is a fundamental research area in which the recently proposed altermagnetism (AM) has become an emergent frontier. Very recently, the quasicrystal (QC) was proposed as a possible platform to realize AM. However, the existence of AM in QCs still lacks vigorous evidence. In this work, we adopt the sign-problem-free projector quantum Monte Carlo (PQMC) algorithm to investigate the magnetic phases in the half-filled Hubbard models in various 2D bipartite QCs, and always obtain Néel ordered states. While the Néel states in bipartite crystals are usually antiferromagnetism (AFM), we find it common that those in bipartite QCs can also be AM or ferrimagnetism (FIM). Based on symmetry analysis, combined with our comprehensive PQMC results, we propose a general criterion for determining the magnetism classes of the Néel states in a bipartite QC: According to whether the two sublattices are related by inversion, a non-inversion point-group operation such as mirror or rotation, or no operation about the unique symmetry center, the corresponding Néel state is AFM, AM or FIM / geometry-enforced AM (G-AM), respectively. The G-AM is a special type of s-wave AM caused by the unique QC structure formed through projection from high-dimensional crystals to lower dimensions, which is rare in crystals. For example, our results yield symmetry-protected AM for the two D₄₋ₛymmetric Thue-Morse QCs and G-AM for the D₅₋ₛymmetric Penrose QC at half-filling. Our results provide a solid foundation for experimental investigations and potential applications of different classes of magnetism in QCs.

articles.title: Efficient simulation of Bose-Einstein condensates in nontrivial topologies

articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.05447v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Bubble-shaped Bose-Einstein condensates (BECs) constitute a unique class of quantum fluids with a hollow, thin-shell geometry that supports a wide variety of phenomena that are distinct from those of compact condensates. Numerical simulation of such systems is particularly challenging due to their inherently three-dimensional structure and extreme aspect ratios. We present an efficient finite-difference simulation framework designed for solving partial differential equations in such nontrivial topologies with a focus on the static and dynamical modeling of bubble-shaped BECs. By employing selective spatial sampling on a semi-structured grid, our method substantially reduces memory usage and achieves more than an order-of-magnitude improvement in computational performance compared to conventional split-step Fourier solvers. The algorithm is naturally extendable for highly parallel execution on GPUs, enabling large-scale, time-dependent simulations of thin-shell condensates. We apply this framework to simulate the formation of bubble BECs through a controlled hollowing-out protocol using ab initio trapping potentials relevant to the Cold Atom Laboratory aboard the International Space Station. From these simulations, we identify characteristic timescales and parameter ramps required to achieve adiabatic evolution, thereby assessing the feasibility of experimentally realizing bubble-shaped condensates in microgravity environments.

articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18629v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study collective charge excitations in pseudospin-1 triple-point semimetals within the random-phase approximation, considering both the linearised model with a flat-band and its quadratic-corrected counterpart. We analyse their density response, Drude weights, screening, plasmon dispersion and damping, particle-hole continua, and Friedel oscillations from the long-wavelength to the arbitrary-momentum regime. The quadratic correction renders the flat-band dispersive and endows it with a Fermi surface, thereby affecting the overall response. Comparisons with Weyl and Hopf semimetals reveal how bandstructure and quantum geometry jointly govern collective charge dynamics. While the Drude weights are determined by the Fermi surface and band-velocities, interband screening, plasmon dispersion, and Friedel oscillations reflect the quantum geometry of the eigenstates.

articles.title_zh: 远低于颜色码阈值的量子纠错
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24077v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum error correction enables scalable fault-tolerant quantum computation by suppressing logical errors exponentially with code distance once physical error rates fall below a critical threshold. Here we demonstrate below-threshold operation of triangular color codes with distances d=3,5, and 7 on Quantinuum's Helios trapped-ion quantum processor. Leveraging both circuit- and hardware- level leakage reduction schemes, we achieve logical error rates as low as 5₋₂⁺⁴× 10⁻⁶, and demonstrate error suppression by over an order of magnitude, Łambda=12₋₂⁺³, with each successive increase in code distance. Moreover, we demonstrate below threshold scaling of error rates for Clifford two-qubit randomized benchmarking circuits when encoded in d=3,5 color codes, achieving logical error rate of 7⁺³₋₃× 10⁻⁵ per logical two-qubit Clifford at distance 5 with a suppression factor of Łambda=9₋₃⁺⁸. We compare logical performance for existing near-optimal algorithmic decoders, and both convolutional neural network and transformer-based neural network decoders capable of real-time decoding an order of magnitude faster than the syndrome extraction rate. These results approach the logical error rates required for megaquop-scale quantum computation and indicate that scaled trapped-ion processors could reach application-relevant performance with substantially smaller code blocks than indicated by previous results in other qubit modalities.

articles.title: Nonlocality as a Benchmarking Tool for Quantum Processors
articles.title_zh: 非局域性作为量子处理器基准测试工具
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24196v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Benchmarking quantum processors is a central task in every roadmap aimed at quantum advantage. Here, we discuss a benchmarking protocol based on the violation of the Svetlichny inequality, which is designed to simulate genuine multipartite nonlocality. We compare it with Mermin's inequality, and present the results of applying this framework to two different quantum processing units -the superconducting system Garnet (from IQM) and the ion-trap system Marmot (from AQT), testing different families of quantum circuits for three to five qubits under identical experimental conditions. We also run simultaneous triplet tests across the full register, including a comparison between GHZ and linear cluster states, to probe how Svetlichny-inequality violations depend on qubit location and calibration. Our results demonstrate that tests based on genuine multipartite nonlocality provide a powerful tool to characterize the collective performance of quantum devices and to guide their calibration and optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子处理器基准测试是实现量子优势的关键任务。本研究提出了一种基于Svetlichny不等式违背的基准测试协议，旨在模拟真正的多体非局域性。该协议与Mermin不等式进行了比较，并应用于IQM的超导系统Garnet和AQT的离子阱系统Marmot，测试了3到5个量子比特的不同量子电路。结果表明，基于真正的多体非局域性的测试为表征量子设备的集体性能及其校准和优化提供了强大工具。
authors: Andrés Camilo Granda Arango, Carla Sophie Rieger, Carlo Cuccu, Giuseppe Sergioli, Luigi Iapichino, Tobias Valentin Bauer, Roberto Giuntini, Federico Hernán Holik

articles.title: EntangledEdge: A Distributed System for Orbital Quantum Sensing and Learning
articles.title_zh: EntangledEdge：用于轨道量子传感与学习的分布式系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24353v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An orbital quantum sensor is more precise than classical and holds its information in a quantum state's superposition and entanglement, which classical measurement collapses. Learning on quantum-sensed data therefore requires a distributed system in which the data stay quantum from sensor to inference. We present EntangledEdge, the first system architecture to unify orbital quantum sensing and learning end-to-end, with a quantum data plane and a classical control plane. It routes each event to a channel-matched model in a capacity-diverse bank, adapts its detection threshold without labels, and aggregates across stations by hardware fidelity. Evaluated with a hybrid prototype (real quantum processors, simulated orbit-to-ground link) over satellite telemetry, EntangledEdge achieves high-quality inference at bounded per-event cost, improves quantum processor utilization, and scales with fleet size.
articles.abstract_zh: 轨道量子传感器比经典传感器更精确，其信息以量子态的叠加和纠缠形式存在。因此，对量子传感数据进行学习需要一个分布式系统，确保数据从传感器到推理过程保持量子态。本研究提出了EntangledEdge，这是首个统一轨道量子传感和学习的端到端系统架构，包含量子数据平面和经典控制平面。该系统通过混合原型（真实量子处理器、模拟星地链路）在卫星遥测数据上进行评估，实现了高质量推理、提高了量子处理器利用率并可随规模扩展。
authors: Mohammad Abrarul Hasanat, Amit Samanta, Jason Ludmir, Tirthak Patel, Rohan Basu Roy

articles.title: Certifying Nonlocal Spin Quantum Entanglement from Local Tunneling Spectra
articles.title_zh: 从局域隧穿谱认证非局域自旋量子纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24440v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum entanglement is intrinsically nonlocal, whereas tunneling spectroscopy measures one site at a time. We show that this apparent mismatch can be overcome: local tunneling spectra can certify spin entanglement without coherent control or absolute intensity calibration. An exact spin sum rule turns the high-bias conductance into an internal normalization, allowing the inelastic spin-flip weight to place a lower bound on the local quantum Fisher information. Total-spin conservation then fixes the otherwise inaccessible intersite fluctuation, converting two local spectra into a bound on a collective entanglement witness. We incorporate coupling to the substrate through a spectroscopic bound on spin leakage, while a hierarchy of thresholds distinguishes entanglement between the spins from entanglement with their environment. Including instrumental broadening and noise, the resulting certificate holds at a stated confidence level. These results establish a route for extracting nonlocal quantum information from equilibrium local spectroscopy.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子纠缠本质上是非局域的，而隧穿谱测量是局域的。本研究展示了如何克服这种不匹配，通过局域隧穿谱在无需相干控制或绝对强度校准的情况下认证自旋纠缠。精确的自旋求和规则将高偏置电导转化为内部归一化，使得非弹性自旋翻转权重能够为局域量子Fisher信息设定下限。总自旋守恒进一步确定了难以获取的位间涨落，将两个局域谱转化为集体纠缠判据的界限。这些结果为从平衡态局域谱中提取非局域量子信息开辟了一条新途径。
authors: Payman Kazemikhah, Ruolun Zhang, Xiangyu Luo, Byunghoon Kim, Yu-Peng Zhu, Md. Shafayat Hossain, M. Zahid Hasan

articles.title: Efficient Quantum Algorithm for Mixed-State Quantum Geometry
articles.title_zh: 混合态量子几何的高效量子算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24686v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mixed-state quantum geometry plays a fundamental role in quantum metrology, multiparameter estimation, and the characterization of quantum many-body systems. Yet, unlike its pure-state counterpart, accessing mixed-state geometry requires solving an ill-conditioned Lyapunov equation for the symmetric logarithmic derivative (SLD), posing a major challenge for resource-efficient quantum computation. Here we address the challenge and develop a novel quantum algorithmic framework for efficiently accessing the quantum Fisher information matrix (QFIM) and quantum geometric tensor (QGT) of mixed states. Our key insight is to uncover a previously unexplored connection between the positive semidefinite structure of density matrices and exponentially convergent Gauss-Laguerre quadrature, enabling an efficient integral-based construction of the SLD. A rigorous complexity analysis further establishes the resource efficiency of our algorithm, demonstrating logarithmic precision dependence and double-logarithmic ancillary-qubit overhead at fixed conditioning. Building on this construction, we achieve near-Heisenberg precision scaling for diagonal QFI estimation without quantum phase estimation and construct unified block encodings of the full QFIM and QGT under a bounded spectral-gap assumption. A complementary regularized algorithm extends efficient diagonal estimation to exponentially small spectral gaps under a bounded-response condition. Our results establish a resource-efficient route to coherent mixed-state quantum geometry, enabling its direct integration into quantum linear-algebra algorithms without classical reconstruction and opening new possibilities for quantum-enhanced multiparameter metrology.
articles.abstract_zh: 混合态量子几何在量子计量学、多参数估计和量子多体系统表征中发挥着基础作用。然而，与纯态不同，获取混合态几何需要求解对称对数导数（SLD）的病态Lyapunov方程，这对资源高效的量子计算构成了重大挑战。本研究开发了一种新颖的量子算法框架，用于高效获取混合态的量子Fisher信息矩阵（QFIM）和量子几何张量（QGT）。该算法通过密度矩阵的正半定结构与指数收敛的高斯-拉盖尔求积之间的联系，实现了SLD的有效积分构造，并在固定条件下展示了对数精度依赖和双对数辅助量子比特开销。
authors: Chenyang Wang, Qi Zhao, Xiao Yuan, Xiaoxia Cai

articles.title: Characterizing Local and Correlated Pauli Noise in Quantum Teleportation Circuits
articles.title_zh: 量子隐形传态电路中局域和关联泡利噪声的表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24840v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We analytically characterize how the location and the local or correlated structure of stochastic Pauli errors affect a three-qubit coherent quantum-teleportation circuit. Independent local channels and a fully correlated two-qubit channel are inserted separately in six configurations. Propagating each Pauli-error realization through the Clifford circuit yields the effective channel on Bob's qubit and analytical expressions for the average and state-resolved fidelities. Under a common ordered-pair probability convention, the six configurations form three pairs that induce equivalent reduced channels on Bob. Within each pair, corresponding Pauli-error realizations have the same probabilities and produce the same effective Pauli operator on Bob's output state. The equivalence therefore holds for every input state within the stochastic Pauli models considered here, rather than only for the average fidelity. Correlated Z errors do not affect the output for the first pair; local X and Z errors exhibit complementary qubit sensitivity for the second; and correlated same-axis Pauli errors cancel for the third. These results classify the error response of the selected circuit configurations and show that it depends jointly on the error statistics, Pauli axis, and position within the protocol.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究分析性地表征了随机泡利错误的发生位置、局域或关联结构如何影响三量子比特相干量子隐形传态电路。研究在六种配置中分别插入了独立的局域通道和完全关联的双量子比特通道，并推导了Bob量子比特上的有效通道以及平均和态分辨保真度的解析表达式。结果表明，在所考虑的随机泡利模型中，六种配置形成三对，它们在Bob的输出上产生等效的约化通道，且这种等效性适用于每个输入态。这些结果对错误进行了分类。
authors: L. Anjos, Jose Alfredo de Leon, R. S. Sarthour, Alejandro Fonseca
