articles.title: Symmetry-breaking chelation enables room-temperature all-optical spin coherence readout of aqueous Cu(II) for chemoselective discrimination
articles.title_zh: 对称破缺螯合实现室温下水溶液Cu(II)的全光自旋相干读出，用于化学选择性识别
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24925v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Optical initialization and readout of molecular electron spins in water remains challenging for 3d transition-metal complexes. Their Laporte-forbidden d-d transitions yield weak transition dipole moments, so optical spin detection in aqueous Cu(II) previously required ~1 M concentrations. Here we overcome this constraint through symmetry-breaking chelation. Coordinating Cu(II) with EDTA imposes a non-centrosymmetric ligand field with enhanced metal-ligand covalency, relaxing Laporte restrictions and amplifying d-d transition dipole moments. This design enhances absorption and magnetic circular dichroism by 7.3- and 5.6-fold, enabling ultrafast spin readout down to 100 μM with an apparent dephasing time T2^*~0.54 ns. As a proof-of-concept for selective molecular-spin sensing, histidine addition extends T₂^* to ~0.8 ns in a concentration-dependent manner, whereas glycine produces no measurable effect. These results show that symmetry breaking provides a strategy to create molecular spin-photon interfaces, opening avenues toward all-optical, analyte-responsive quantum sensing in water.
articles.abstract_zh: 在水溶液中实现3d过渡金属配合物的分子电子自旋光学初始化和读出一直具有挑战性。本研究通过对称破缺螯合克服了这一限制，将Cu(II)与EDTA配位，引入非中心对称配体场，增强了金属-配体共价性，从而放宽了Laporte限制并放大了d-d跃迁偶极矩。这种设计将吸收和磁圆二色性分别提高了7.3倍和5.6倍，实现了低至100 μM的超快自旋读出，表观退相干时间T2^*约为0.54 ns。这些结果表明，对称破缺为创建分子自旋-光子界面提供了一种策略，为水溶液中全光、分析物响应的量子传感开辟了道路。
authors: Jinlei Li, Qiaoyun Wu, Qiaoqiao Shao, Zhubin Hu, Haitao Sun, Zhenrong Sun, Donghai Feng

articles.title: Spatial Discretization Error for Quantum Chemistry Simulation
articles.title_zh: 量子化学模拟中的空间离散化误差
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25260v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonrelativistic quantum chemistry is based on the Schrödinger equation in continuous, unbounded space. Computational approaches on classical and quantum computers often truncate the spatial domain and introduce a finite-dimensional basis, reducing the continuum problem to a finite-dimensional one. There is therefore a fundamental question: to what extent does this approximation capture the original continuum problem? In this work, we develop a general Sobolev-Galerkin framework for estimating spatial discretization errors in quantum simulation with unbounded Hamiltonians. We apply this framework to many-body Coulomb systems and establish both periodization and Galerkin error estimates for wave-function dynamics and ground-state energies. For dynamics, the finite-basis projection error of the exact wave function does not capture the full basis-discretization error: an additional dynamical projection error enters our bound at a different rate, and we introduce an inner-product argument to control this contribution. Interestingly, the spatial convergence rates for wave-function dynamics and ground-state energies differ quantitatively. For ground-state energies, we establish a sharp M⁻¹ convergence rate at fixed cell size, where M is the number of one-particle basis functions. We also show that a uniform M⁻¹ convergence rate is impossible for the corresponding real-time wave-function error with general H² initial data. The analysis relies on many-body Sobolev estimates with explicit polynomial dependence on system size. Combining these estimates with state-of-the-art quantum algorithms, we obtain, to our knowledge, the first rigorous end-to-end complexity bounds for quantum simulation of molecular and electronic dynamics with all spatial errors explicitly controlled. The number of basis functions is determined directly from the continuum problem, without regularization.
articles.abstract_zh: 非相对论量子化学基于连续、无界空间中的薛定谔方程，而计算方法通常会截断空间域并引入有限维基。本研究开发了一个通用的Sobolev-Galerkin框架，用于估计具有无界哈密顿量的量子模拟中的空间离散化误差。该框架应用于多体库仑系统，建立了波函数动力学和基态能量的周期化和Galerkin误差估计。研究发现，波函数动力学和基态能量的空间收敛速率在定量上有所不同。
authors: Di Fang, Jiaqi Zhang

articles.title: Anomalously fast heating of ground states in dephased SU(N) spin systems
articles.title_zh: 退相干SU(N)自旋系统中基态的异常快速加热
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25310v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We identify a strong quantum Mpemba effect in which a many-body ground state heats faster than every Gibbs state at finite positive temperature under the same dissipative dynamics within a fixed-color sector. In ferromagnetic SU(N) exchange systems with local dephasing, exact coherence shells confine the ground-state evolution and exclude all slower Liouvillian modes. Its relaxation rate is fixed by the bath, independently of system size, exchange graph, and integrability. We derive an energy-resolved sign criterion that guarantees a slower thermal contribution throughout the positive-temperature range. An exact finite-chain solution proves this rate inversion, and symmetry-resolved calculations confirm the criterion in larger spin-one chains, including nonintegrable exchange. The zero-temperature endpoint of a continuous Gibbs family can therefore be dynamically isolated by its exact exclusion from slow relaxation channels.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究发现了一种强量子Mpemba效应，即在固定颜色扇区内，多体基态在相同的耗散动力学下，比有限正温度下的所有吉布斯态加热得更快。在具有局域退相干的铁磁SU(N)交换系统中，精确的相干壳层限制了基态演化并排除了所有较慢的Liouvillian模式。其弛豫速率由浴决定，与系统大小、交换图和可积性无关。研究导出了一个能量分辨的符号判据，证明了这种速率反转，并为通过精确排除慢弛豫通道来动态隔离连续吉布斯家族的零温度端点提供了依据。
authors: Tairan Lou, Junxiao Chen, Xiang-Ping Jiang, Mingdi Xu, Lei Pan

articles.title: Can Quantum Entanglement Increase the Capacity of a Classical Relay Channel?
articles.title_zh: 量子纠缠能否增加经典中继信道的容量？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25334v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show positive and negative results on classical relay channels with entanglement assistance, revealing a sharp contrast between strictly causal and causal relay encoding. First, we consider van der Meulen's setting of a unit-delay relay, with strictly causal encoding. We show that the standard cutset upper bound continues to hold with entanglement assistance, and deduce that entanglement does not increase the capacity for several classes of relay channels. Second, we consider a zero-delay relay, where the encoding is causal. We present an example in which entanglement enables rates that exceed the cutset upper bound by at least 12.5%. Namely, entanglement shared between the source and relay significantly increases the capacity of a classical zero-delay relay channel.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究展示了纠缠辅助经典中继信道的正反结果，揭示了严格因果和因果中继编码之间的鲜明对比。对于具有严格因果编码的单位延迟中继，纠缠辅助下标准割集上限仍然成立，表明纠缠不会增加容量。然而，对于零延迟中继，本研究提出了一个例子，其中纠缠使速率超过割集上限至少12.5%。这表明源和中继之间共享的纠缠可以显著增加经典零延迟中继信道的容量。
authors: Elsa Mizrahi, Uzi Pereg

articles.title: In situ certification of multiparticle indistinguishability in a generic interferometer
articles.title_zh: 通用干涉仪中多粒子不可分辨性的原位认证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25471v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a scalable and efficient in situ method for assessing the multiparticle indistinguishability of identical bosons or fermions in quantum interference experiments on linear interferometers by harnessing quantum parallelism and the bunching/anti-bunching tendencies of these particles. The proposed certification method can be applied to any generic linear interferometer. For particles occupying distinct input ports of a Haar-random unitary interferometer, the number of experimental runs required to attain a prescribed statistical precision is polynomial in the number of particles, the interferometer size, and the inverse precision, with high probability. Our method is robust under losses: for uniform particle losses, the polynomial scaling is preserved when the inverse single-particle survival probability is polynomially bounded. Our scheme is especially suitable for certifying the indistinguishability of single photons in large-scale interference experiments, such as Boson Sampling in the regime of quantum advantage over classical computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种可扩展且高效的原位方法，用于评估线性干涉仪中相同玻色子或费米子在量子干涉实验中的多粒子不可分辨性。该方法利用量子并行性和粒子的聚束/反聚束趋势，适用于任何通用线性干涉仪。对于占据Haar随机酉干涉仪不同输入端口的粒子，达到预定统计精度所需的实验运行次数与粒子数量、干涉仪尺寸和逆精度呈多项式关系。该方案在损耗下也具有鲁棒性，特别适用于大规模干涉实验中单光子不可分辨性的认证，例如在量子优势区域的玻色子采样。
authors: Valery Shchesnovich

articles.title: Topological Quantum Gates on FCIs with Bounded Quantum Geometry
articles.title_zh: 具有有界量子几何的分数陈绝缘体上的拓扑量子门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25472v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-band 2D fractional Chern insulators (FCIs) have recently been shown, in principle, to admit unusual anyonic order, associated with Bloch Hopfions localized in momentum space. Here we show that bounding the integrated quantum metric along one primitive Brillouin-zone cycle may refine this topological order to |C| distinct braiding observables, cyclically permuted by lattice translations, for Chern numbers |C| > 1. The cyclic structure entails mildly non-abelian braiding phases and otherwise matches the spectral flow exhibited by the FCI's hybrid Wannier states, with the metric bound equivalently a bound on the states' real-space spread. We give a classification of quantum gates in principle implementable on this topological order; among them we find the non-Clifford T-gate and the non-Clifford entangling CCZ-gate. This points to novel pathways to fault-tolerant quantum processes within the known orbital structure of FCIs, potentially informing experimental searches towards hardware for future topological quantum computers.
articles.abstract_zh: 双带二维分数陈绝缘体（FCIs）原则上已被证明具有与动量空间中局域的Bloch Hopfion相关的奇异任意子序。本研究表明，限制沿一个原胞布里渊区循环的积分量子度规，可以将这种拓扑序细化为|C|个不同的编织可观测量，对于陈数|C|>1，这些可观测量通过晶格平移循环置换。这种循环结构带来了轻微的非阿贝尔编织相，并与FCI混合Wannier态表现出的谱流相匹配。研究还对原则上可在此拓扑序上实现的量子门进行了分类，包括非Clifford T门和非Clifford纠缠CCZ门，这为在FCI已知轨道结构内实现容错量子过程提供了新途径。
authors: Hisham Sati, Urs Schreiber

articles.title: Measuring the Quantum Phase of Multiphoton Systems
articles.title_zh: 多光子系统量子相位的测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25727v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantum phase of a multiparticle system has remained a long-standing mystery in quantum physics. The absence of a phase operator that faithfully represents this physical quantity has prevented the formulation of a meaningful uncertainty relation with particle number. Here, we resolve this problem by measuring, for the first time, the quantum phase of multiparticle systems containing up to fifteen particles. We achieve this through a new quantum state tomography scheme that combines homodyne interferometry with photon-number-resolving detection. This approach enables us to reconstruct complementary photon-number and phase representations and establish the corresponding number-phase uncertainty relation. Our measurements further provide access to the mutually unbiased basis of a multiparticle system, a fundamental resource for multiparticle quantum information processing. Furthermore, we report the spatially resolved characterization of the quantum phase. These results provide an operational framework for measuring quantum phase in multiparticle systems, with implications for fundamental quantum physics and scalable multiparticle quantum technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 多粒子系统的量子相位一直是量子物理学中的一个长期未解之谜。本文首次通过结合零差干涉测量和光子数分辨探测的量子态层析成像方案，测量了包含多达十五个粒子的多粒子系统量子相位。该方法重建了互补的光子数和相位表示，并建立了相应的数-相不确定关系，为多粒子系统中的量子相位测量提供了操作框架。这些结果对基础量子物理和可扩展多粒子量子信息处理具有重要意义。
authors: Ian Baum, Riley B. Dawkins, Jannatul Ferdous, Omar S. Magana-Loaiza

articles.title: Perturbation theory for quantum information quantities of Gaussian states
articles.title_zh: 高斯态量子信息量的微扰理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25792v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many quantum-information tasks can benefit from Gaussian quantum resources, while their fundamental performance limits are characterized by quantum information quantities. However, a unified perturbation theory for these quantities directly within the Gaussian-state formalism has been lacking. We develop such a theory for the von Neumann entropy, quantum relative entropy, quantum Chernoff quantity, and quantum fidelity, using perturbations of the moments of a reference Gaussian state. Using general Fréchet-derivative identities, we derive compact second-order expressions for reference-state covariance matrices whose symplectic eigenvalues are all greater than 1/2. We also show that the perturbative quantum Chernoff quantity is maximized at its symmetric point, yielding the quantum Chernoff exponent (QCE). We further show that symplectic eigenvalues equal to 1/2 can lead to slower asymptotic vanishing, potentially improving the corresponding fundamental performance limits. For reference-state covariance matrices containing symplectic eigenvalues both equal to and greater than 1/2, we identify sufficient conditions under which the former determine the leading covariance-matrix contributions, allowing the remaining modes to be traced out without changing the leading-order asymptotic scaling or the coefficient. Applying the framework to quantum illumination and incoherent-light sub-Rayleigh object discrimination, we recover known asymptotic QCEs directly within the Gaussian-state formalism. In the latter problem, the slower asymptotic vanishing explains the known quadratic scaling of the QCE with the source separation.
articles.abstract_zh: 许多量子信息任务受益于高斯量子资源，但其性能极限缺乏统一的微扰理论。本文针对冯诺依曼熵、量子相对熵、量子切尔诺夫量和量子保真度，在高斯态形式下发展了一种微扰理论。研究利用参考高斯态矩的微扰，推导了协方差矩阵的紧凑二阶表达式，并探讨了辛特征值对渐近衰减和性能极限的影响。
authors: Zihao Gong, Saikat Guha

articles.title: Quantum computing for plasma physics in magnetic-confinement fusion
articles.title_zh: 磁约束聚变等离子体物理的量子计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25885v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Plasma simulations for magnetic-confinement fusion (MCF) involve high-dimensional kinetic dynamics, strong nonlinear coupling, complex geometries, and multiscale spatiotemporal behavior, imposing severe computational bottlenecks. While quantum computing offers a potential alternative for accelerating plasma simulation problems, its practical advantage for fusion research has not yet been demonstrated. We review existing quantum computing studies across kinetic dynamics, wave interactions, equilibrium, and macroscopic stability, evaluating their hardware implementations and operational bottlenecks. Current studies remain largely restricted to linearized equations, reduced models, or isolated computational subroutines, leaving a substantial gap from realistic fusion simulations. We summarize key problem characteristics, including high dimensionality, structured dynamics, and measurement requirements, under which plasma applications are most likely to yield a quantum advantage. Guided by these considerations, we highlight potential approaches and present a roadmap toward practical quantum advantage of simulating plasma in MCF.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁约束聚变（MCF）中的等离子体模拟面临计算瓶颈，而量子计算有望加速等离子体模拟问题。本文综述了现有量子计算在等离子体动力学、波相互作用等方面的研究，并评估了其硬件实现和操作瓶颈。研究指出当前工作仍局限于线性化方程或简化模型，与实际聚变模拟存在差距。文章总结了等离子体应用可能获得量子优势的关键问题特征，并提出了实现MCF等离子体模拟量子优势的路线图。
authors: Chenjia Zhu, Shuai Xu, Yousheng Zhang, Yunfeng Liang, Yue Yang

articles.title: How Quantum Is Light? Concepts, Measures, and Applications of Optical Quantumness
articles.title_zh: 光的量子性如何？光学量子性的概念、度量与应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25894v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum states are ultimately responsible for numerous counterintuitive phenomena that defy classical intuition. As the development of quantum technologies accelerates, our ability to harness these quantum resources becomes essential. This review addresses a fundamental question. How do we quantify the quantumness of a state, and which specific traits distinguish it from its classical counterparts? We examine quantumness through both theoretical and operational lenses, providing a clear framework for state characterization. Ultimately, we demonstrate that certifying quantumness is not just a theoretical exercise. It is a practical necessity for identifying, and realizing quantum advantage in real-world applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子态是许多反直觉现象的根本原因，随着量子技术的发展，利用量子资源变得至关重要。本文综述了如何量化一个态的量子性以及区分其与经典对应物的特定特征。研究从理论和操作层面审视了量子性，提供了一个清晰的态表征框架。最终，文章指出量子性的认证是识别和实现现实世界应用中量子优势的实际必要性。
authors: Soumyakanti Bose, Hyukjoon Kwon, Yong Siah Teo, Hyunseok Jeong, Luis L. Sánchez-Soto

articles.title: Entanglement-enhanced Ramsey spectroscopy of broadband signals
articles.title_zh: 纠缠增强的宽带信号拉姆齐光谱学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25912v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The use of entanglement in sensing is often motivated by improved sensitivity arising from non-classical correlations among probes. For static signals, however, this quantum advantage in Ramsey spectroscopy with N probes is known to be highly susceptible to dephasing, which severely limits the possible gain from entanglement. In contrast, we consider sensing of signals that vary in time. Considering the simplest example of dephasing by classical white noise, we show that entanglement allows a large increase in bandwidth when estimating the frequency components of a time-dependent signal. Without sacrificing any sensitivity, entanglement allows for an increase in bandwidth by a factor of N. Alternatively, when interrogation times are limited by the signal bandwidth rather than by dephasing, the average estimation uncertainty over a fixed bandwidth is reduced by a factor of sqrtN compared with separable states.
articles.abstract_zh: 纠缠在传感中的应用通常旨在提高灵敏度，但对于静态信号，拉姆齐光谱中的量子优势易受退相干影响。本文研究了时变信号的传感，并以经典白噪声引起的退相干为例，展示了纠缠如何大幅增加估计时变信号频率分量的带宽。在不牺牲灵敏度的情况下，纠缠可使带宽增加N倍。当询问时间受信号带宽限制时，纠缠可使固定带宽内的平均估计不确定性降低√N倍。
authors: Noah Kaufmann, Anders Søndberg Sørensen

articles.title: Multi-path Security in Quantum Networks with Trusted Nodes
articles.title_zh: 具有可信节点的量子网络中的多路径安全性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26120v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum communication networks promise information-theoretic security but this security collapses if intermediate relay nodes are compromised, a risk that grows sharply when compromised nodes cannot be identified. We address this twofold: first, we show that multi-path routing provides quantifiable protection against unidentified compromised nodes. Second, we provide a comprehensive statistical and graph-theoretic analysis of network and node security under compromise, covering full and partial node compromise, optimal placement of additional edges via an iterative method, and comparative hacking-probability analysis across network topologies. Together, these results identify the topology and multi-path routing strategy that most improves security for a given network. We apply this framework to quantum key distribution across multiple network topologies, demonstrating a scalable route to secure, reliable quantum communication under realistic, unidentified adversarial threats, without relying on quantum memory.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子通信网络承诺信息理论安全性，但中间中继节点受损会使其安全性失效。本文提出多路径路由可为抵御未识别受损节点提供可量化的保护。研究还提供了网络和节点安全性在受损情况下的统计和图论分析，涵盖了完全和部分节点受损、通过迭代方法优化附加边的放置以及跨网络拓扑的比较黑客攻击概率分析。这些结果为在现实、未识别的对抗威胁下实现安全、可靠的量子通信提供了一条可扩展的途径。
authors: Muhammad Kumail Haider, Aeysha Khalique

articles.title: Universal Quantum Criticality from a Gaussian Variational Manifold
articles.title_zh: 基于高斯变分流形的普适量子临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26246v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Universal behavior at continuous phase transitions is encoded in long-wavelength fixed-point theories controlled by dimensionality and symmetries. It is a central question for which systems this universal behavior and the underlying long-wavelength description can be captured by a noninteracting theory allowing for analytical and accurate predictions. In this work we provide a systematic procedure for obtaining the best noninteracting fermionic description of a quantum phase transition through fermionic Gaussian states. We demonstrate the performance of our procedure for the interacting long-range transverse-field Ising chain. This formulation reduces the problem to a self-consistent Euler equation that yields a critical line in close agreement with independent numerical benchmarks, while its singular momentum structure provides analytic predictions for continuously varying critical properties. Yet exact diagonalization shows that Gaussian-state fidelity to the exact ground state is poorest, and non-Gaussianity strongest, near the transition. Thus, accurate predictions for critical properties can emerge from the Gaussian variational description even where its microscopic wave-function approximation is weakest.
articles.abstract_zh: 连续相变中的普适行为由维度和对称性控制的长波长不动点理论编码。本文提供了一种通过费米子高斯态获得量子相变最佳非相互作用费米子描述的系统方法。研究以相互作用长程横场伊辛链为例，展示了该方法的性能。该公式将问题简化为自洽的欧拉方程，其临界线与独立数值基准高度一致，并为连续变化的临界性质提供了分析预测。
authors: Reyhaneh Khasseh, Fabian Ballar Trigueros, Markus Heyl, M. A. Rajabpour

articles.title: Physics-anchored residual quantum neural networks for cloud-cover parameterization
articles.title_zh: 用于云量参数化的物理锚定残差量子神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26279v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Compact quantum neural networks have been explored for cloud-cover parameterization, but their predictive value depends on how physical knowledge is incorporated and which classical models provide the reference. We investigate an offline residual formulation that retains a fitted XR cloud-cover estimate and learns a correction to its logit in transformed target space. Using released ICON/DYAMOND-derived data, we compare ten model variants in six- and eight-input settings, with three matched replicates and 10,000 training samples per replicate. All quantum circuits use local Z readout and noiseless exact expectation values. Under a common 30-epoch protocol, residual prediction reduced physical-space test mean squared error relative to direct QNN prediction by 54.3% and 38.8% for six-input XYZ and ZZXY circuits, and by 49.2% and 38.9% for their eight-input versions. Residual QNNs also outperformed the selected compact residual multilayer perceptron in every paired replicate. A larger, longer-trained Grundner-Q1 adaptation nevertheless achieved lower error: residual Q1 reached mean MSEs of 0.00778 and 0.00791, compared with 0.01124 and 0.01082 for residual XYZ. The results support residual prediction for compact simulated QNNs within the tested budget and establish a clear boundary set by stronger classical references. They do not establish computational quantum advantage or online climate-model skill.
articles.abstract_zh: 紧凑型量子神经网络已被探索用于云量参数化，但其预测价值取决于物理知识的整合方式和经典模型的选择。本文研究了一种离线残差公式，该公式保留了拟合的XR云量估计，并学习了其在变换目标空间中的logit校正。实验结果表明，残差预测显著降低了物理空间测试均方误差，且残差量子神经网络在所有配对复制中均优于选定的紧凑型残差多层感知器。
authors: Zhuo Wang, Ce Yu, Bin Yang

articles.title: Giant Rydberg Excitons Delineated as Relativistic Bound States
articles.title_zh: 巨里德堡激子被描绘为相对论束缚态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26435v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We examined the energy-momentum relationship of the valence band of Cu₂O, which has gained interest as an emerging solid host for giant Rydberg states. Our findings reveal a nonparabolic dispersion, described using the rest mass (0.570 times the free electron mass) and rescaled light speed (1.6× 10⁵ m/s), which draws parallels with relativistic theory for high-energy particles. We propose a straightforward expression for the bound-state energies of Rydberg excitons with finite quantum defects, whose energy scheme deviates from the hydrogenic series. This formulation identifies relativistic kinematics as the physical origin of quantum defects, offering a streamlined basis for future studies on complex many-body correlations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了氧化亚铜(Cu₂O)价带的能量-动量关系，发现其具有非抛物线色散，可用静止质量和重新标定的光速描述，与高能粒子的相对论理论相似。研究提出了一种简单的表达式来描述具有有限量子缺陷的里德堡激子的束缚态能量，其能量方案偏离氢原子系列。该公式将相对论运动学识别为量子缺陷的物理起源，为未来研究复杂多体关联提供了基础。
authors: Mitsuyoshi Takahata, Ikuko Akimoto, Nobuko Naka

articles.title: End-to-End Optimization of Partial Fault Tolerance in Neutral-Atom Arrays
articles.title_zh: 中性原子阵列中部分容错的端到端优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26471v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fault-tolerant (FT) quantum computation offers a pathway to quantum advantage, but its realization is hindered by its significant overhead. The partially FT "STAR" architecture reduces the cost of universal computation at the price of relaxing FT requirements for non-Clifford operations, increasing exposure to hardware noise. Therefore, maximizing its performance and applicability demands careful co-design with the underlying hardware. In this work we investigate the co-design of the STAR architecture with neutral-atom platforms, connecting the underlying atomic physics to logical error modeling and application-level performance. At the physical level, we identify a favorable noise bias in ¹⁷¹Yb Rydberg gates, and show how it can be enhanced through error-selective pulse optimization. At the logical level, we identify an intrinsic error suppression mechanism, yielding vanishing logical coherent noise in leading order. Detailed circuit-level simulations of surface code implementations show more than an order of magnitude reduction in logical error relative to previous estimates. As a concrete target application, we focus on the Fermi-Hubbard model with periodic boundaries, for which we design a simulation circuit particularly suited to early implementations. We quantify the resource tradeoff of partially and fully FT approaches to gate synthesis, with the former showing approximately an order of magnitude reduction in state-injection depth, and an even larger reduction in Clifford resources. Comparing with classical and fully FT approaches, we identify regimes where partial fault tolerance provides both lower overheads and lower error rates. In our estimates, this is accessible with moderate error rates psim 10⁻³ and a few thousand qubits, underlining that for these types of problems, partial FT approaches provide a compelling pathway to early quantum advantage.
articles.abstract_zh: 容错量子计算实现量子优势面临巨大开销。本文研究了STAR架构与中性原子平台的协同设计，旨在优化部分容错量子计算的性能。研究在物理层面识别了¹⁷¹Yb里德堡门中有利的噪声偏置，并通过误差选择脉冲优化增强了它。在逻辑层面，发现了一种固有的误差抑制机制，使逻辑相干噪声在主导阶次上消失。详细的电路级模拟显示逻辑错误率比先前估计降低了一个数量级以上。
authors: Stefano Veroni, Aydin Deger, Andrew J. Daley

articles.title: PPT-assisted capacities of bosonic Gaussian channels
articles.title_zh: PPT辅助的玻色子高斯信道容量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26783v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We determine the exact quantum communication and entanglement-distribution capacities of three fundamental bosonic channels, namely thermal loss, thermal amplification and additive Gaussian noise, assisted by operations that completely preserve positive partial transpose (PPT). These operations are more powerful than local operations and classical communication (LOCC), but cannot generate distillable entanglement on their own. For thermal loss, the unconstrained capacity coincides with the Pirandola-Laurenza-Ottaviani-Banchi (PLOB) bound throughout the non-entanglement-breaking regime. The corresponding upper bounds are also attained for thermal amplification and additive noise. We extend these results to energy-constrained communication, establishing exact capacities for all three channels at every prescribed mean input energy. Our results solve a class of bosonic capacity problems under PPT assistance and establish exact benchmarks for determining whether the same communication rates can be achieved via LOCC alone.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文确定了在完全保持正部分转置（PPT）操作辅助下，三种基本玻色子信道（热损耗、热放大和加性高斯噪声）的精确量子通信和纠缠分发容量。研究发现，对于热损耗信道，在非纠缠破坏区域内，无约束容量与PLOB界限一致。这些结果还扩展到能量受限的通信，为所有三种信道在每个给定平均输入能量下的精确容量提供了基准。
authors: Matthew Barber, Stefano Pirandola

articles.title: Fast Hubbard-Thouless Pumping with Local Counterdiabatic Driving
articles.title_zh: 局部反绝热驱动下的快速Hubbard-Thouless泵浦
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26786v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Counterdiabatic (CD) driving suppresses the excitations of fast protocols by adding an auxiliary Hamiltonian, but in many-body and topological systems the exact CD term is generally non-local and multi-body. We study this obstruction for Thouless pumping in the Rice-Mele model, first without and then with interactions. For noninteracting fermions, the exact CD term of the pump is non-local, but the variational framework of Sels and Polkovnikov yields accurate nearest-neighbor approximations. For the spinful Rice-Mele chain with onsite and nearest-neighbor repulsion, in the regime where the competition of the two interactions stabilizes quantized pumping, this approach fails: the infinite-temperature variational action only penalizes the CD amplitudes, and the resulting two-parameter nearest-neighbor term does not prevent the pump from breaking down when the cycle time is reduced from 50/t to 2/t. We trace the failure to the structure of the exact many-body gauge potential, whose amplitude for each hop depends on the interaction energy that the hop costs. Resolving the nearest-neighbor currents by this energy, and fixing the coefficients with a ground-state-weighted action, gives a local ansatz with 14 coefficients that keeps the interacting pump quantized for cycle times T=2/t and T=1/t, with an accuracy per site that does not degrade between rings of 8 and 12 sites.
articles.abstract_zh: 反绝热（CD）驱动通过添加辅助哈密顿量来抑制快速协议的激发，但在多体和拓扑系统中，精确的CD项通常是非局域和多体的。本文研究了Rice-Mele模型中Thouless泵浦的这一障碍，发现对于无相互作用费米子，变分框架能提供准确的最近邻近似。然而，对于自旋Rice-Mele链，该方法在相互作用稳定量子化泵浦的区域失效，导致泵浦在循环时间缩短时崩溃。研究将此失败归因于精确多体规范势的结构，并提出通过能量解析最近邻电流来解决问题。
authors: Alexander Chansky

articles.title: Trapped-ion quantum simulation of (1+1)D SU(2) lattice gauge theory via loop-string-hadron formulation
articles.title_zh: 基于环-弦-强子公式的(1+1)维SU(2)格点规范理论的囚禁离子量子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24091v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a quantum simulation of the SU(2) lattice gauge theory in 1+1 dimensions with one flavor of fermions, performed using the trapped-ion Quantinuum System Model H2. This work is based on the loop-string-hadron (LSH) formulation of the gauge theory, and is distinguished by using qubits to represent both bosonic-gauge and fermionic-matter degrees of freedom. Furthermore, we access the j=1 electric-flux sector beyond the jₘₐₓ=1/2 truncation commonly used in SU(2) quantum simulations. To that end, we digitize an electric-field degree of freedom using a multiqubit register for representing the bosonic quantum number. Our simulation therefore synthesizes several key ingredients relevant to quantum simulations in higher spatial dimensions, in particular explicit local gauge-field degrees of freedom represented here by a multiqubit bosonic register, while relying solely on circuit-construction optimizations that are expected to scale polynomially with lattice size. This work demonstrates that modern quantum hardware is increasingly able to accommodate the features of complicated but physically important lattice gauge theories while successfully reproducing the expected Trotterized dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用囚禁离子Quantinuum System Model H2，对具有一个费米子味的(1+1)维SU(2)格点规范理论进行了量子模拟。该工作基于环-弦-强子（LSH）公式，并创新性地使用量子比特同时表示玻色子规范场和费米子物质自由度。模拟还首次访问了j=1电通量扇区，超越了SU(2)量子模拟中常用的jmax=1/2截断。这项工作展示了现代量子硬件在处理复杂但物理上重要的格点规范理论方面的能力。
authors: Toshiaki Kaji, Jesse R. Stryker, Yutaro Iiyama, Lento Nagano, Enrico Rinaldi, Christian W. Bauer, Koji Terashi

articles.title: BQP^cc is not contained in MA^cc
articles.title_zh: BQP^cc不包含在MA^cc中
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24742v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We exhibit a bipartite language with a poly-logarithmic quantum communication protocol and polynomial Merlin-Arthur communication complexity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了一种具有多对数量子通信协议和多项式Merlin-Arthur通信复杂度的二分语言。这一发现表明，在通信复杂度理论中，量子计算能力（BQP^cc）超越了经典交互式证明系统（MA^cc）的能力范围。
authors: Dmytro Gavinsky

articles.title: Low-Field J-Coupling Spectroscopy Measured with a Diamond Nitrogen Vacancy Spectrometer
articles.title_zh: 使用金刚石氮空位谱仪测量的低场J耦合光谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24815v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Nitrogen vacancy centers in diamond (NVs) are point defects well suited to quantum sensing of magnetic fields. NV spin states can be initialized and read out optically with high spatial resolution, enabling detection of pL-scale volumes of nuclear spins. Using Coherently Averaged Synchronized Readout (CASR), standard NMR spectroscopy techniques such as free decay, spin echo, and PGSE have been performed with Hz-scale spectral resolution using NV-diamond sensors. However, using NV detection for conventional high-resolution NMR at multi-tesla fields is challenging due to the need to manipulate NV electronic spins at resonance frequencies 100 GHz or higher. Low-field J-coupling spectroscopy provides an alternative path to chemical resolution in a regime more easily accessible to NVs. Here, we demonstrate homonuclear and heteronuclear J-coupling spectroscopy using an NV-NMR spectrometer based on permanent magnets operating at sim890 kHz proton Larmor frequency (bias magnetic field sim21 mT). This field strength enables chemical characterization based on J-coupling using sequences such as Synchronized Echo (SyncE) and Spin-Echo Double Resonance (SEDOR), which do not require the strong chemical shift dispersion and pristine field homogeneity of high-field NMR. The frequency range is easily detected by NVs using standard XY dynamical decoupling sequences and is well-suited for applying Overhauser DNP, which can boost proton signal by two orders of magnitude. We acquire initial NV-NMR measurements of T₁, T₂, and Overhauser DNP in glycerol before advancing to SEDOR spectroscopy of methanol-¹³C and a methanol-¹³C/acetonitrile-2-¹³C mixture at sample volumes sim50 pL, in which we demonstrate measurement of ¹J_CH couplings and resolution between species. We also acquire a homonuclear J-coupling spectrum of a natural-abundance propylene carbonate sample.
articles.abstract_zh: 金刚石中的氮空位（NV）中心是磁场量子传感的理想点缺陷，能够以高空间分辨率检测皮升级的核自旋。尽管NV检测在高场NMR中面临挑战，但低场J耦合光谱为化学分辨率提供了一条替代途径。本文展示了使用基于永磁体的NV-NMR谱仪进行同核和异核J耦合光谱测量，该谱仪在约890 kHz质子拉莫尔频率下运行。这项工作通过J耦合序列实现了化学表征，为NV-NMR传感器的应用开辟了新方向。
authors: Stephen J. DeVience, John W. Blanchard, Camille G. McDonnell, Ronald L. Walsworth

articles.title: Real-time quantum simulation of hadron production in deep inelastic scattering
articles.title_zh: 深度非弹性散射中强子产生的实时量子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25350v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop a quantum simulation framework for meson production in deep inelastic scattering based on light-front QCD Hamiltonian formalism. A quark-antiquark dipole, prepared either as a single-momentum state or as the qbar q component of a virtual photon, is evolved in real time through the color field of a nuclear target via Trotterized unitary evolution. We consider both proton and gold nuclear targets, each characterized by their respective saturation scale. From the evolved state we extract the transverse momentum broadening, the total and elastic cross sections, and the J/ψ production rate by projecting onto the J/ψ light-front wavefunction. We then extract the nuclear modification factor R_A at different photon virtuality Q² and analyze nuclear modification effect. Results of classical simulations show good agreement with analytical eikonal predictions across a broad range of parameters. For the single-momentum dipole, quantum simulation is demonstrated on a quantum circuit emulator with a smaller lattice size, and results are consistent with the classical benchmark. This work establishes a first-principles, amplitude-level pathway toward computing exclusive hadron production in deep inelastic scattering, directly relevant to the physics program of the Electron-Ion Collider.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于光锥QCD哈密顿量形式，开发了一个用于深度非弹性散射中介子产生的量子模拟框架。通过Trotter化酉演化，模拟了夸克-反夸克偶极子在核靶色场中的实时演化。研究提取了横向动量展宽、总截面、弹性截面以及J/ψ产生率，并分析了不同光子虚度Q²下的核修正因子R_A。经典模拟结果与解析理论预测吻合良好，小格点尺寸下的量子模拟结果也与经典基准一致，为从第一性原理层面理解强子产生提供了新途径。
authors: Xianghui Cao, Meijian Li, Yang Li, Wenyang Qian

articles.title: Non-planar contact structures with Calabi-Yau Fillings and topological quantum computation
articles.title_zh: 具有Calabi-Yau填充的非平面接触结构与拓扑量子计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25878v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper is a non-planar counterpart of the author's earlier work on planar contact structures and topological quantum computation. There the page is planar and all branch points are paired by disjoint liftable arcs, compatibly with the joint eigenlines of the Ising representation and with Calabi-Yau (CY) Stein fillings, those with vanishing first Chern class. Here the page has genus g and connected binding, presented as a simple degree-three cover of the disk. Every maximal system of disjoint liftable arcs has exactly g members and leaves two branch points unused. The half-twist interchanging the two points is not liftable, but its cube is, and lifts to the identity. An integral residue criterion supplies the CY test. A factorization localized on a contact connected sum is automatically CY. Unlike in the planar case, a CY factorization need not be the shortest. Once the fusion channels of the g pairs are fixed, Ising fusion determines the channel of the remaining pair, and braiding acts there only by scalars. Fibonacci fusion can leave that channel undetermined, and the powers of the cube then act by ten distinct relative phases on a single joint eigenspace, while the CY Stein filling stays fixed
articles.abstract_zh: 本文是作者早期关于平面接触结构和拓扑量子计算工作的非平面对应。研究探讨了亏格为g的非平面接触结构，其中最大不相交可提升弧系统有g个成员，并留下两个未使用的分支点。文中提出了一个积分残差判据来检验Calabi-Yau（CY）填充，并指出CY分解不一定是最短的。该工作深入分析了Ising和Fibonacci融合在非平面结构中的行为，为拓扑量子计算提供了新的理论视角。
authors: Atsuhide Mori

articles.title: High-order resonances and emergent coherent dynamics in interacting Stark chains
articles.title_zh: 相互作用斯塔克链中的高阶共振与涌现的相干动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26328v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A linear potential gradient can strongly suppress quantum dynamics, while interactions can activate resonant many-body processes whose higher-order structure remains largely unexplored. Here we uncover a systematic hierarchy of high-order interaction--tilt resonances in an interacting Stark chain, where the resonance order counts the minimal number of elementary exchange steps involved. These resonances manifest as long-lived coherent oscillations with order-dependent timescales. By isolating individual resonant channels and developing a microscopic effective description, we connect these dynamical timescales to the underlying many-body exchange processes and reveal a pronounced dependence on the initial-state structure. Our results provide crucial insights into high-order many-body resonances and show how commensurate interaction-to-tilt ratios generate a hierarchy of parametrically slow coherent many-body dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 线性势梯度能强烈抑制量子动力学，而相互作用则可激活高阶结构未被充分探索的共振多体过程。本文揭示了相互作用斯塔克链中高阶相互作用-倾斜共振的系统性层级结构，这些共振表现为具有依赖于阶数的长时间相干振荡。通过分离共振通道并发展微观有效描述，研究将这些动力学时间尺度与潜在的多体交换过程联系起来。结果为理解高阶多体共振以及如何通过相互作用与倾斜比率产生参数化慢相干多体动力学提供了重要见解。
authors: Jiahe Chang, Hongzheng Zhao

articles.title: KrMM Recurrences: HPC-Enhanced Estimators for Nonlinear Classical Shadows
articles.title_zh: KrMM递推：用于非线性经典影子的HPC增强估计器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26472v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: While quantum technologies are rapidly evolving, near-term applications heavily rely on hybrid quantum-classical paradigms. Among these, the classical shadows framework has gained a lot of traction, not only for quantum information science, but also for the development and verification of quantum hardware. It allows to efficiently classically estimate many properties of quantum states from randomized measurements alone, a task that is otherwise intractable due to the destructive nature of measurements in quantum systems. There are, however, many properties of interest that are, due to their very problem formulation, not efficiently estimable. In this work, we identify a computational kernel occurring in estimators of polynomial functions, a class of problems that are in general computationally difficult to solve. We show that this structure allows a row-wise partition that, together with a custom SIMD vectorization, enables massive parallelization and can reduce the computational cost significantly. We show applicability and scalability of the approach on different tasks, and our results showcase that the approach allows high sequential throughput and close-to-ideal parallel scaling. The work thus provides a new way of identifying and exploiting structure in classical shadow estimators, resulting in practical advantages on inherently difficult problems.
articles.abstract_zh: 经典影子框架在量子信息科学和量子硬件开发中备受关注，它能从随机测量中高效估计量子态的许多性质。然而，对于多项式函数的估计器中存在一个计算核心，通常难以高效求解。本文识别了这一计算核心，并展示其结构允许行式划分，结合定制的SIMD向量化，可实现大规模并行化并显著降低计算成本。研究结果表明，该方法在不同任务上具有良好的适用性和可扩展性，为解决非线性经典影子中的计算难题提供了高效途径。
authors: Matthias Gruber, Sabrina Herbst, Ivona Brandic, Vincenzo De Maio

articles.title: Observation and control of polariton noise in a thermal Rydberg atom electrometer
articles.title_zh: 热里德堡原子静电计中极化激元噪声的观测与控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26479v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The establishment of metrics and control of fundamental noise sources in quantum sensing is a long-standing goal in quantum science and technology. We report on the observation of polariton-mediated optical noise in a thermal Rydberg atom vapor and demonstrate its active control and suppression using a radio-frequency field in Rydberg electrometry. The noise exhibits structured amplification and reduction across the Rydberg electromagnetically induced transparency resonance. This reveals a nonlinear slow-light feedback mechanism in which the polariton medium stores and releases probe-field energy. We show that the reference radio-frequency field used in Rydberg heterodyne receivers can also tune the medium into an operating regime where high electromagnetic-field responsivity coincides with reduced optical noise. This operating-point control enables optimization of the electric-field sensitivity within the constraints imposed by Rydberg-polariton physics. These results establish polariton noise as a previously unrecognized intrinsic noise source in thermal Rydberg vapors and the corresponding control method as a crucial aspect of continued efforts to achieve fundamental sensitivity limits in Rydberg electrometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子传感中基本噪声源的度量和控制是量子科学技术的一个长期目标。本文报告了在热里德堡原子蒸气中观测到极化激元介导的光学噪声，并展示了在里德堡静电测量中利用射频场对其进行主动控制和抑制。该噪声在里德堡电磁感应透明共振处表现出结构化的放大和减小，揭示了一种非线性慢光反馈机制。研究表明，射频场可以调节介质进入高电磁场响应与低光学噪声并存的工作区域，从而优化电场灵敏度。
authors: Teng Zhang, Luís Felipe Gonçalves, Alisher Duspayev, Georg Raithel, David A. Anderson

articles.title: Exploring ground state phase diagrams of Rydberg atom arrays with finite projected entangled-pair states
articles.title_zh: 利用有限投影纠缠对态探索里德堡原子阵列的基态相图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26520v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Rydberg atom arrays (RAA) have been advocated as a promising avenue for the quantum simulation of different exotic quantum states. Numerical predictions for the ground state properties of this experimental platform can, however, be challenging in two-dimensional setups. In particular, faithfully treating long-range interactions is often crucial for distinguishing the fate of competing phases, but it usually comes at considerable cost. Projected entangled-pair states (PEPS), optimized via a sampling-based approach, have been shown to deal with such terms on the same ground as shorter-range ones. In this work, we employ these tools to investigate debated physical questions in different frustrated geometries of RAA, from the emergence of spin-glass physics on the Kagomé lattice to topological order beyond the PXP model on the Ruby lattice. By that, we contribute to establishing PEPS as well-suited tools for creating digital twins of RAA experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 里德堡原子阵列（RAA）被认为是量子模拟奇异量子态的有前景平台，但其二维设置中的基态性质数值预测具有挑战性，尤其是在处理长程相互作用时。本文利用通过采样优化后的投影纠缠对态（PEPS）工具，研究了RAA在不同受挫几何结构中的物理问题，包括在Kagomé晶格上自旋玻璃物理的出现以及在Ruby晶格上超越PXP模型的拓扑序。这项工作有助于确立PEPS作为创建RAA实验数字孪生的合适工具。
authors: Konrad Schröder, Erik Lennart Weerda, Matteo Rizzi

articles.title: Quantum superposition of black hole states as a communication resource
articles.title_zh: 黑洞态的量子叠加作为一种通信资源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2203.05861v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The interplay between black holes and quantum information has revealed deep connections between gravity and quantum mechanics. For example, the classical spacetime geometry of a black hole has been shown to degrade quantum entanglement shared by nearby observers, one of whom is in free fall. Here we examine how this picture changes when the black hole's mass degrees of freedom are allowed to exist in a coherent quantum superposition, corresponding to a superposition of distinct spacetime geometries. We show that such quantum coherence can mitigate the loss of entanglement between nearby observers, thereby enhancing the performance of quantum communication protocols operating in the vicinity of the black hole.
articles.abstract_zh: 黑洞与量子信息的相互作用揭示了引力与量子力学之间的深刻联系。经典黑洞时空几何已被证明会降低附近观测者共享的量子纠缠。本文研究了当黑洞质量自由度处于相干量子叠加态时，即对应于不同时空几何的叠加时，这种情况如何改变。研究表明，这种量子相干性可以减轻附近观测者之间的纠缠损失，从而增强在黑洞附近运行的量子通信协议的性能。
authors: Richard Howl, Ali Akil, Hlér Kristjánsson, Xiaobin Zhao, Giulio Chiribella

articles.title: A Quantum Approach For Reducing Communications in Classical Secure Computations with Long Outputs
articles.title_zh: 一种用于减少长输出经典安全计算中通信的量子方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2310.05213v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: How could quantum cryptography help us achieve what are not achievable in classical cryptography? In this work we study the classical cryptographic problem that two parties would like to perform secure computations with long outputs. As a basic primitive and example, we first consider the following problem which we call secure function sampling with long outputs: suppose f:0,1ⁿⁱ̊ghtarrow 0,1^m is a public, efficient classical function, where m is big; Alice would like to sample x from its domain and sends f(x) to Bob; what Bob knows should be no more than f(x) even if it behaves maliciously. Classical cryptography, like FHE and succinct arguments [Gen09,Kil92,HW15], allows us to achieve this task within communication complexity O(n+m); could we achieve this task with communication complexity independent of m? In this work, we first design a quantum cryptographic protocol that achieves secure function sampling with approximate security, within O(n) communication (omitting the dependency on the security parameter and error tolerance). We also prove the classical impossibility using techniques in [HW15], which means that our protocol indeed achieves a type of quantum advantage. Building on the secure function sampling protocol, we further construct protocols for general secure two-party computations [Yao86,GB01] with approximate security, with communication complexity only depending on the input length and the targeted security. In terms of the assumptions, we construct protocols for these problems assuming only the existence of collapsing hash functions [Unr16]; what's more, we also construct a classical-channel protocol for these problems additionally assuming the existence of noisy trapdoor claw-free functions [BCMVV,BKVV].
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了量子密码学如何解决经典密码学中难以实现的问题，特别是关于具有长输出的安全计算。研究首先提出了一个名为“长输出安全函数采样”的问题，即在输出m很大的情况下，Alice向Bob发送f(x)时，Bob只能知道f(x)。经典方法通常需要O(n+m)的通信复杂度，而本文设计了一种量子密码协议，在近似安全下实现了O(n)的通信复杂度。同时，该工作还证明了经典方法在此问题上的局限性，突显了量子协议的优势。
authors: Jiayu Zhang

articles.title: Optimizing Pulsed Optically Detected Magnetic Resonance Acquisition: A Digital Signal Processing Perspective
articles.title_zh: 优化脉冲光探测磁共振采集：数字信号处理视角
articles.abstract: arXiv:2404.05629v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ensembles of nitrogen vacancy (NV) defect centers in diamond have attracted considerable interest for fundamental studies and applications in quantum sensing and quantum information processing. Pulsed optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) and related pulse-sequence protocols are essential for the coherent manipulation and characterization of the NV spins. Here, we introduce a novel framework for analyzing pulsed ODMR data acquisition and subsequent processing from the perspective of digital signal processing (DSP). As a central part of this approach, we model the data processing procedure as an effective digital bandpass filter that suppresses a broad range of noise spectral components, thereby reducing the noise in the processed data. This analysis identifies an intermediate frequency (IF) band whose spectral contribution to this noise is maximum. The proposed DSP-based analysis is experimentally validated using an oscilloscope based acquisition method, and is also applied to optimize key measurement parameters. In particular, the introduction of an analog low pass filter in the signal path is shown to remove aliasing of noise into the IF band, and thus improve signal quality. Our results also establish the oscilloscope as a viable data acquisition device for pulsed ODMR, with practical advantages including on-board waveform averaging, real-time signal visualization, and simplified system debugging. The proposed framework can be extended to other detection techniques and material platforms for ODMR.
articles.abstract_zh: 金刚石中的氮空位（NV）缺陷中心在量子传感和量子信息处理中备受关注。本文从数字信号处理（DSP）的角度，提出了一种分析脉冲光探测磁共振（ODMR）数据采集和处理的新框架。该方法将数据处理建模为有效的数字带通滤波器，以抑制噪声并优化关键测量参数。研究通过实验验证了所提出的DSP分析的有效性，并展示了引入模拟低通滤波器可消除混叠效应。
authors: Anuvab Nandi, Sayan Chakraborty, Yashvardhan Jain, Kanav Sharma, Samiran Chakraborti, Himadri Himani, Abir Mondal, Sumit Mukherjee, Chiranjib Mitra

articles.title: Nonequilibrium quantum states emerging from flippable spins in random networks
articles.title_zh: 随机网络中可翻转自旋产生的非平衡量子态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.11466v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recent advances in programmable quantum simulators have enabled the realization of irregular interaction networks, which natural crystal lattices cannot provide, together with time-resolved observation of quantum many-body dynamics. Understanding the nonequilibrium states that emerge from such networks has only just begun, and whether quantum many-body scar states can emerge in them remains open. Here, focusing on a quantum Ising spin system with random interaction networks under a weak transverse field, we introduce the flippability, the fraction of flippable spins, and present phenomenological laws that predict the emergence of quantum many-body scar states from the network structure. As the flippability increases, the Hilbert space becomes less fragmented. The largest kinetically accessible subspace shows nonintegrable level statistics, yet hosts a few eigenstates with abnormally low participation entropy, signalling scar states. Real-time dynamics from Fock states confirm these signatures: systems with higher flippability tend toward thermalization, whereas a few initial states show anomalously nonthermal dynamics. The flippability thus links the interaction-network structure of the Hamiltonian to nonequilibrium many-body dynamics without translational invariance, and may apply to other kinetically constrained quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 可编程量子模拟器实现了不规则相互作用网络和时间分辨的量子多体动力学观测。本文研究了弱横向场下具有随机相互作用网络的量子伊辛自旋系统，引入了“可翻转性”概念，并提出了预测量子多体疤痕态出现的唯象定律。研究发现，可翻转性增加会减少希尔伯特空间的碎片化，且最大的动力学可达子空间展现出非积分能级统计，但仍包含具有异常低参与熵的疤痕态。实时动力学模拟进一步证实了这些特征，揭示了可翻转性对系统热化行为的影响。
authors: Yoshiaki Horiike, Yuki Kawaguchi

articles.title: Quantitative Quantum Soundness for Bipartite Compiled Bell Games via the Sequential NPA Hierarchy
articles.title_zh: 通过序贯NPA层级实现二分编译贝尔博弈的定量量子可靠性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.17006v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Compiling Bell games under cryptographic assumptions replaces the need for physical separation, allowing nonlocality to be probed with a single untrusted device. While Kalai et al. (STOC'23) showed that this compilation preserves quantum advantages, its quantitative quantum soundness has remained an open problem. We address this gap with two primary contributions. First, we establish the first quantitative quantum soundness bounds for all bipartite compiled Bell games via a newly formalized convergent sequential Navascués-Pironio-Acín (NPA) hierarchy: any polynomial-time prover's score is controlled by a finite-level hierarchy value, and finite-level convergence gives a negligible gap to the commuting quantum value, or to the tensor-product quantum value under flat optimality. Second, we develop the sequential NPA hierarchy as a computational tool of independent interest, establishing its convergence and a stopping criterion based on flatness, and identifying its conic dual as a sparse SOS hierarchy.
articles.abstract_zh: 在密码学假设下编译贝尔博弈，使得无需物理分离即可用单个不可信设备探测非局域性。本文首次通过新形式化的收敛序贯Navascués-Pironio-Acín (NPA) 层级，为所有二分编译贝尔博弈建立了定量的量子可靠性界限。研究表明，任何多项式时间证明者的得分都受有限层级值的控制，且有限层级收敛能提供与交换量子值或张量积量子值之间的可忽略差距。此外，本文还发展了序贯NPA层级作为独立的计算工具，确立了其收敛性及基于平坦度的停止准则。
authors: Igor Klep, Connor Paddock, Marc-Olivier Renou, Simon Schmidt, Lucas Tendick, Xiangling Xu, Yuming Zhao

articles.title: A Symmetry-Enabled Direct Quantum Protocol for Many-Body Green's Functions
articles.title_zh: 一种用于多体格林函数的对称性增强直接量子协议
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.03288v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a symmetry-enabled direct quantum protocol for computing many-body Green's functions, a central tool for studying strongly correlated quantum systems. Our protocol relies only on native time evolution and straightforward measurements available on current hardware platforms. By exploiting parity symmetry -- satisfied by a broad class of Hamiltonians in condensed matter physics and quantum chemistry, including the Fermi--Hubbard and Heisenberg models -- we introduce a tailored quench spectroscopy scheme that recovers both the real and imaginary parts of two-point time correlators, from which Green's functions can be reconstructed via efficient classical signal processing. We further develop a tailored symmetric quantum Gibbs sampler that prepares parity-resolved (symmetric and antisymmetric) thermal states, enabling finite-temperature extensions within the same framework. Finally, we show that the same symmetry-based measurement primitive extends naturally to out-of-time-ordered correlators (OTOCs). Our results provide a practical route to estimating symmetry-resolved dynamical correlators on near-term and early fault-tolerant quantum hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种对称性增强的直接量子协议，用于计算强关联量子系统中的多体格林函数。该协议仅依赖于现有硬件平台上的原生时间演化和直接测量，通过利用宇称对称性，引入了一种定制的淬火光谱方案，可恢复两点时间关联函数的实部和虚部。此外，研究还开发了一种对称量子吉布斯采样器，用于制备宇称分辨的热态，并将该对称性测量原语扩展到时间反序关联函数（OTOCs）。这些结果为在近期和早期容错量子设备上估计对称分辨的动力学关联函数提供了实用途径。
authors: Changhao Yi, Cunlu Zhou

articles.title: Modelling optimal implementation of an arbitrary N-qubit quantum gate within the generalized Bloch vectors formalism
articles.title_zh: 广义布洛赫矢量形式下任意N量子比特量子门的最优实现建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.18059v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The optimal implementation of quantum gates for closed N-qubit systems is one of the key challenges for practical realization of many quantum information processing tasks. In the present article, based on the generalized Bloch vectors formalism [J. Phys. A: Math. Theor. 54, 195301 (2021)] for a finite-dimensional quantum system, we develop a new general model for the optimal implementation of quantum gates, which is formulated in terms of the Bloch vectors for the unitary evolution operator and the system Hamiltonians, drift and control, and has the unified mathematical form, which is standard for the mathematical control theory and applicable for the implementation of an arbitrary N-qubit gate within any closed N-qubit system, satisfying the controllability conditions. Within the developed optimal model, the cost functional has both the terminal part and also, the integral part with the special scaling, and this allows us to specify the quantum optimal control synthesis via solving the two-point boundary value problem (BVP) for the system of ordinary differential equations (ODEs), which can be explored numerically by any of the known BVP solvers for ODEs. The numerical experiments, conducted for the implementation within the developed optimal model of a variety of N=1,2,3 qubit gates, demonstrate the high accuracy of the model-based results.
articles.abstract_zh: 封闭N量子比特系统量子门的最优实现是量子信息处理中的关键挑战。本文基于广义布洛赫矢量形式，开发了一种新的通用模型，用于任意N量子比特量子门的最优实现。该模型以幺正演化算符和系统哈密顿量的布洛赫矢量表示，具有统一的数学形式，适用于满足可控性条件的任何封闭N量子比特系统。在该最优模型中，成本泛函包含终端部分和具有特殊尺度的积分部分，通过求解常微分方程组的两点边值问题，可以实现量子最优控制综合。
authors: Elena R. Loubenets, Sergey Kuznetsov

articles.title: Generating function and Bloch representation for quantum Fisher tensor
articles.title_zh: 量子费雪张量的生成函数和布洛赫表示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.05260v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Uhlmann relative amplitude between two density matrices is shown to be a generating function, through which the quantum Fisher tensor that contains both the quantum Fisher information matrix and the mean Uhlmann curvature can be obtained via differentiation over system parameters. In the pure state limit, our generating function recovers that of the quantum geometric tensor proposed by Hetényi and Lévay, and also clarifies the fidelity and phase between two quantum states as the generating functions of the quantum metric and Berry curvature, respectively. A generic expression for the quantum Fisher tensor in terms of the Bloch representation of density matrices is derived, which facilitates the calculation of the tensor, mean Uhlmann curvature, and geometric properties derived from the quantum Fisher information matrix. Canonical ensembles of spins are adopted to demonstrate our formalism, which reveals a constant Ricci scalar, a vacuum Einstein equation, and a cosmological constant on the 3D Euclidean manifold of the magnetic field
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了两个密度矩阵之间的Uhlmann相对振幅是一个生成函数，通过对系统参数求导可得到包含量子费雪信息矩阵和平均Uhlmann曲率的量子费雪张量。在纯态极限下，该生成函数恢复了量子几何张量，并阐明了量子态之间的保真度和相位分别是量子度规和贝里曲率的生成函数。研究还推导了量子费雪张量在密度矩阵布洛赫表示下的通用表达式，简化了张量、平均Uhlmann曲率以及从量子费雪信息矩阵导出的几何性质的计算。通过自旋正则系综的演示，揭示了磁场3D欧几里得流形上的常数里奇标量、真空爱因斯坦方程和宇宙学常数。
authors: Felipe P. Abreu, Wei Chen

articles.title: Memory effects in repeated uses of quantum channels
articles.title_zh: 量子信道重复使用中的记忆效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.05661v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum Information Processing (QIP) tasks can be efficiently formulated in terms of quantum dynamical maps, whose formalism is able to provide the appropriate mathematical representation of the evolution of open quantum systems. A key QIP task is quantum state transfer (QST) aimed at sharing quantum information between distant nodes of a quantum network, enabling, e.g. quantum key distribution and distributed quantum computing. QST has primarily been addressed insofar by resetting the quantum channel after each use, thus giving rise to memoryless channels. Here we consider the case where the quantum channel is continuously used, without implementing time- and resource- consuming resetting operations. We derive a general, analytical expression for the nth-use average QST fidelity for U(1)-symmetric channels and apply our formalism to a perfect QST channel in the presence of imperfect readout timing. We show that even relatively small readout timing errors give rise to memory effects which have a highly detrimental impact on subsequent QST tasks.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子信息处理（QIP）任务常以量子动力学映射形式表述，其中量子态传输（QST）是关键任务。传统QST研究通常假设信道在使用后重置，形成无记忆信道。本文考虑了量子信道连续使用而无需重置的情况，推导了U(1)对称信道第n次使用平均QST保真度的通用解析表达式。研究发现，即使是相对较小的读出时序误差也会产生记忆效应，对后续QST任务造成严重不利影响。
authors: Hayden Zammit, Roberto Salazar, Gianluca Valentino, Johann A. Briffa, Tony J. G. Apollaro

articles.title: Quantum simulation of the Dicke model in a two-dimensional ion crystal
articles.title_zh: 二维离子晶体中迪克模型的量子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.06114v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum many-body systems driven far from equilibrium can exhibit phase transitions, chaos and entanglement, but probing these phenomena in large, nearly closed systems remains challenging. The Dicke model, which couples an ensemble of two-level systems collectively to a single bosonic mode, provides a fundamental framework for exploring these phenomena in light-matter interactions. Here we show that a two-dimensional crystal of approximately 100 trapped ions realizes this model and accesses integrable dynamical phase transitions, signatures of chaotic dynamics and fluctuation-driven spin-phonon excitation growth. Adiabatic elimination of the vibrational mode reveals ferromagnetic and paramagnetic dynamical spin phases, whereas strong spin-phonon coupling produces irregular trajectories and local relaxation consistent with quantum thermalization. Following a quench from an unstable fixed point, correlated excitation growth precedes generalized vacuum Rabi collapses and revivals; calibrated calculations identify two-mode squeezing 2.6 dB below the standard quantum limit, supported by reconstruction from spin measurements. By connecting collective dynamical instabilities to experimentally accessible signatures of quantum correlations, these results establish large ion crystals as a scalable platform for investigating non-equilibrium light-matter dynamics and generating resources for quantum-enhanced sensing.
articles.abstract_zh: 远离平衡态的量子多体系统展现出相变、混沌和纠缠等现象。本文展示了一个由约100个囚禁离子组成的二维晶体如何实现迪克模型，并揭示了可积动力学相变、混沌动力学特征以及涨落驱动的自旋-声子激发增长。研究通过绝热消除振动模式，揭示了铁磁和顺磁动力学自旋相，并观察到强自旋-声子耦合导致的非规则轨迹和局域弛豫。从不稳定不动点淬火后，关联激发增长先于广义真空拉比塌缩和复苏，校准计算识别出低于标准量子极限2.6 dB的双模压缩。
authors: Bryce Bullock, Sean R. Muleady, Jennifer F. Lilieholm, Yicheng Zhang, Arghavan Safavi-Naini, Robert J. Lewis-Swan, John J. Bollinger, Ana Maria Rey, Allison L. Carter

articles.title: Theory of Two-Qubit T₂ Spectroscopy of Quantum Many-Body Systems
articles.title_zh: 量子多体系统双量子比特T₂谱学理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.18176v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Multi-qubit quantum sensors are rapidly emerging as platforms that extend the capabilities of conventional single-qubit sensing. In this work we show how suitable pulse sequences applied to a two-qubit sensor enable separate extraction of the response and noise of a probed environment within a T₂ spectroscopy framework. By resorting to representative examples, we demonstrate that this approach can resolve the spatio-temporal spreading of correlations in a many-body system. In particular, the resulting correlated dephasing signal captures features such as the dispersion of low-energy excitations, which manifest as light-cone-like profiles in the propagation of correlations. We further show that non-equilibrium conditions, for instance those induced by external driving, can modify this profile by producing additional fringes outside the light-cone. As a complementary application, we demonstrate that the method clearly distinguishes between different transport regimes in the system, including ballistic spreading, diffusive broadening, and the crossover between them.
articles.abstract_zh: 多量子比特量子传感器正在扩展传统单量子比特传感的能力。本文展示了如何通过对双量子比特传感器施加合适的脉冲序列，在T₂谱学框架内分别提取被探测环境的响应和噪声。该方法能够解析多体系统中关联的时空传播，捕获低能激发的色散等特征，表现为关联传播中的类光锥剖面。研究还表明，非平衡条件可以改变这一剖面，并在光锥外产生额外的条纹，该方法还能清晰区分系统中的不同输运机制。
authors: Hossein Hosseinabadi, Pavel E. Dolgirev, Sarang Gopalakrishnan, Amir Yacoby, Eugene Demler, Jamir Marino

articles.title: Entanglement and photoelectron holography in dissociative photoionization: molecular quantum eraser
articles.title_zh: 解离光电离中的纠缠与光电子全息术：分子量子擦除器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.16107v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In a double-slit experiment with a bipartite system, the visibility of interference fringes depends on the availability of which-way information. Here, we report a Bell-like state of photoelectron and residual ion in the multiphoton dissociative ionization of the D₂ molecule. Evidence for entanglement is provided by the correlated emission directions of photoelectron and ion, which is observed using a COLTRIMS reaction microscope. In the presence of this correlation, the holographic interference fringes contained in the photoelectron momentum distributions are suppressed, indicating the existence of which-way information. The interference pattern persists when a single ionic state is populated and thus no which-way information is available. The experimental observations and conclusions are supported by the numerical solution of the electronic-nuclear time-dependent Schrödinger equation. Our work demonstrates that coincidence spectroscopy of ions and electrons is a powerful method for studying fundamental concepts of quantum information science within the context of ultrafast light-matter interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 在双缝实验中，干涉条纹的可见性取决于“哪条路径”信息的可用性。本文报道了D₂分子多光子解离电离中光电子和残余离子的贝尔态，通过COLTRIMS反应显微镜观察到光电子和离子的关联发射方向，提供了纠缠的证据。这种关联的存在抑制了光电子动量分布中的全息干涉条纹，表明存在“哪条路径”信息。当只填充一个离子态时，干涉图样得以保留，因为此时没有“哪条路径”信息。该工作展示了离子和电子符合谱学在超快光物质相互作用背景下研究量子信息科学基本概念的强大能力。
authors: Sebastian Hell, Paul Winter, Martin Gärttner, Julian Späthe, Saurabh Mhatre, Dejan B. Milošević, Gerhard G. Paulus, Manfred Lein, Matthias Kübel

articles.title: Entanglement Enhanced Sensing with Qubits affected by non-Markovian Dephasing
articles.title_zh: 受非马尔可夫退相干影响的量子比特纠缠增强传感
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.22368v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Entanglement has been proposed as a means to improve the sensitivity of sensing weak signals. While the degree of this quantum advantage is well understood in noiseless settings, the situation is more complex under realistic conditions, where the system is subject to decoherence. In this case, the enhancement depends on the specific noise characteristics. Previous treatments of colored noise typically assume that the noise is uncorrelated between successive experiments. Here, we consider the scenario in which the noise exhibits correlations across multiple shots. We derive a simple fundamental limit to the sensitivity based on the fact that the sensitivity cannot be better than the signal-to-noise ratio seen by the probe. Focusing on Ramsey spectroscopy with probes affected by pure classical dephasing, we show that, for suitable spatial and temporal noise correlations, entangled probes achieve a better scaling of the sensitivity with the number of probes than separable states. This demonstrates that entanglement can provide a substantial improvement for Ramsey spectroscopy subject to correlated noise.
articles.abstract_zh: 纠缠被认为是提高弱信号传感灵敏度的方法。本文研究了在噪声存在跨多次实验关联的非马尔可夫退相干条件下，纠缠如何增强传感灵敏度。我们推导了一个基于探头信噪比的灵敏度基本极限。研究表明，对于合适的时空噪声关联，纠缠探头在拉姆齐谱学中能实现比可分离态更好的灵敏度标度，证明了纠缠在受关联噪声影响的拉姆齐谱学中可提供显著改进。
authors: Noah Kaufmann, Kasper H. Nielsen, Eva M. González-Ruiz, Anders S. Sørensen

articles.title: Quantum limit cycles with continuous symmetries from coherent parametric driving: exact solutions and many-body extensions
articles.title_zh: 具有连续对称性的相干参量驱动量子极限环：精确解和多体扩展
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.25864v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: There is widespread interest in many-body quantum systems that exhibit limit-cycle or time-crystalline behaviour. An ideal quantum limit cycle would be realized using fully coherent driving (to minimize noise) and also have a continuous internal symmetry (to ensure generation of monochromatic radiation). While these two requirements may seem incompatible, we introduce in this work a large class of multi-mode bosonic limit cycle models based on coherent parametric driving which possess an O(N) continuous symmetry. Surprisingly, the full quantum dissipative steady state of these models can be found exactly. They exhibit rich physics, including steady state entanglement, reduced phase diffusion and the possibility of realizing quantum limit tori. The basic mechanism we identify provides a unified way to understand how coherent parametric driving can yield symmetry-enriched limit cycles, and also helps us understand related models where the relevant symmetries are weakly broken. The models we study are compatible with a range of different experimental platforms, including quantum optical setups and superconducting quantum circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了一类基于相干参量驱动的多模玻色子极限环模型，该模型具有O(N)连续对称性，并能实现理想的量子极限环。令人惊讶的是，这些模型的完整量子耗散稳态可以被精确求解。研究发现，这些模型展现出丰富的物理现象，包括稳态纠缠、相扩散减小以及实现量子极限环面的可能性。该工作提出的机制为理解相干参量驱动如何产生对称性增强的极限环提供了统一视角，并与多种实验平台兼容。
authors: Sihan Chen, Aashish A. Clerk

articles.title: Quantum Quenches that Resemble Operator Growth
articles.title_zh: 类似于算符增长的量子猝灭
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.23874v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study growth quenches, which are local quenches that may gradually destabilize a false vacuum in certain kinetic constrained quantum lattice models, such as the East-West model. We point out a formal analogy with the dynamics of a local operator in the Heisenberg picture. Exploiting this analogy, we obtain several results on growth quenches by adapting operator-dynamics concepts and methods. First, applying the Krylov approach (recursion method), we conjecture the linear growth of Lanzcos coefficients in generic quenches, aₘ sim ν m (diagonal), and bₘ sim α m (off-diagonal), extending an operator growth hypothesis. We show that the growth quench dynamics is localized in both Krylov and Fock spaces when |ν| > 2 α, and derive a bound for the growth quench analogue of Lyapunov exponent łambda_L łe sqrt4 α² - ν² when |ν| < 2 α. Second, we realize the Fock localization in large N solvable growth quenches inspired by Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) models. The bound on Lyapunov exponent is saturated in large-q SYK grow quench. By contrast, the growth quench is almost always Fock localized in a nonrandom all-to-all growth quench amenable to semiclassics. Finally, in the 1D East-West model, we interpret Fock space cage states as the existence of a conserved charge. We show that the latter has ballistic transport due to current conservation. Moreover, adding hopping with a fine-tuned amplitude induces a partial localization due to a flat band. Our work suggest growth quenches as a promising approach to realize non-equilibrium coherent phenomena in many-body systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了增长猝灭，这是一种在某些动力学受限量子格点模型中可能逐渐破坏假真空的局域猝灭。作者指出了增长猝灭与海森堡绘景中局域算符动力学之间的形式类比，并利用此类比获得了关于增长猝灭的若干结果。通过Krylov方法，研究推测了通用猝灭中Lanczos系数的线性增长，并展示了在特定条件下增长猝灭动力学在Krylov和Fock空间中的局域化。此外，该工作还在受Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 模型启发的增长猝灭中实现了Fock局域化。
authors: Xiangyu Cao

articles.title: Picosecond-resolved entanglement distribution over an urban free-space channel
articles.title_zh: 城市自由空间信道上的皮秒级分辨纠缠分发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.21093v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Time-evolving entangled states describe quantum particles whose correlations evolve in time according to a well-defined dynamics. Such states can be generated in a variety of physical systems and are promising resources for several quantum technologies, ranging from quantum clock synchronization to quantum communication. However, their full potential is currently limited by the fact that the entanglement dynamics often occur on timescales comparable to the achievable synchronization precision, especially in experiments aimed at distributing entanglement through noisy urban channels. In this context, accurate timing is not merely a technical detail, but a fundamental requirement for faithfully observing and exploiting the underlying quantum correlations. Here, we demonstrate the faithful distribution of a fast-evolving entangled state over a 270 m free-space channel connecting two buildings in the center of Rome. The developed system incorporates a synchronization device capable of achieving sub-50 ps timing accuracy between the two ends of the link while simultaneously supporting channel stabilization. Our results demonstrate that time-evolving entanglement can be reliably transmitted through a noisy urban free-space channel, representing an important benchmark toward long-distance free-space quantum communication and the future implementation of time-correlated entangled states in demanding scenarios such as satellite-based quantum networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 时间演化的纠缠态是量子技术的重要资源，但其潜力受限于纠缠动力学与同步精度相当的时间尺度。本文展示了在罗马市中心270米自由空间信道上，对快速演化纠缠态的忠实分发。该系统集成了亚50皮秒时间精度的同步装置，并同时支持信道稳定。研究结果表明，在嘈杂的城市环境中，高精度同步对于观察和利用量子关联至关重要。
authors: Alessandro Laneve, Fabrizio Cienzo, Santiago Gomez, Paolo Barigelli, Philip Menz, Mattia Beccaceci, Giuseppe Ronco, Giorgia Grossi, Ievgen Brytavskyi, Thomas Oberleitner, Markus Wiener, Christian Weidinger, Tobias M. Krieger, Ailton Garcia Jr., Saimon Filipe Covre da Silva, Michele B. Rota, Nicolò Spagnolo, Henning Weier, Fabio Sciarrino, Armando Rastelli, Rinaldo Trotta

articles.title: Classification of bipartite observables II: NIP observables and the Todorcevic trichotomy
articles.title_zh: 二分可观测量分类II：NIP可观测量与Todorcevic三分支定理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12908v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This is the second of a series of three papers that bring model theory to quantum information. The dividing lines of Shelah's classification theory, which separate the tame first-order theories from the wild ones, become properties of bipartite observables: properties of the expectation values obtained when two independently prepared quantum systems are idealized one after the other. In this paper we focus on Shelah's independence property. An observable without it has idealized responses of the first Baire class, and Todorčević's trichotomy for Rosenthal compacta divides such observables into three classes, each containing a physical order. In the transverse-field Ising model, the spontaneous magnetization decides whether the family of magnetizations is stable or lies in the second class.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文是将模型论引入量子信息系列论文的第二篇，主要关注Shelah分类理论中的独立性性质。研究表明，缺乏独立性性质的可观测量具有第一Baire类的理想响应。Todorčević关于Rosenthal紧集的分类将这类可观测量划分为三类，每类都包含一种物理序。在横场Ising模型中，自发磁化决定了磁化族是稳定的还是属于第二类。
authors: Eduardo Dueñez, José Iovino

articles.title: Monolayer van der Waals kagome lattice for high-temperature flat-band physics
articles.title_zh: 用于高温平带物理的单层范德华kagome晶格
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24071v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Kagome lattice materials host a remarkably rich landscape of novel quantum phenomena, all arising from the intrinsic interplay of topology, correlation, and frustration. While previous studies have been mostly limited to bulk three-dimensional (3D) kagome crystals, the realization of a true two-dimensional (2D) kagome system has remained a long-standing goal, to unlock fundamentally new physics and engineering pathways inaccessible in 3D systems. In this work, we establish the first ideal 2D monolayer kagome lattices by leveraging a novel and versatile van der Waals (vdW) kagome family, A2T3X4 (A = K, Rb, Cs; T = Ni, Pd, Pt; X = S, Se). Our nano-focused angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (nano-ARPES) directly characterizes the electronic structure of A2T3X4 down to the monolayer limit, notably revealing an isolated kagome-derived flat band just below the Fermi level. Via gate-engineering of 2D A2T3X4, the kagome flat band can be further tuned to the Fermi level, allowing direct access to the partially filled flat band physics and establishing a qualitatively new 2D flat band platform. Compared to existing moire-based artificial flat band systems, this vdW kagome-based intrinsic flat band system realizes more than 220 times higher flat band electron density, opening an entirely new density and energy regime for exploring 2D flat band physics. Harnessing this high-electron-density flat band in 2D vdW kagome system provides a clear pathway to scale emergent flat band phenomena - such as fractional quantum anomalous Hall states - to far higher temperatures than currently achievable, as long-envisioned in theory and further supported by our many-body calculations.
articles.abstract_zh: Kagome晶格材料因其拓扑、关联和阻挫的相互作用而展现出丰富的量子现象。本文首次通过新型范德华kagome家族A₂T₃X₄（A=K, Rb, Cs; T=Ni, Pd, Pt; X=S, Se）实现了理想的二维单层kagome晶格。纳米角分辨光电子能谱（nano-ARPES）直接表征了A₂T₃X₄的电子结构，揭示了费米能级下方孤立的kagome衍生的平带。通过栅极工程，该平带可进一步调谐至费米能级，为研究部分填充平带物理提供了全新的二维平台。
authors: Hyungkun Bong, Choongjae Won, Seongyong Lee, Soomin Oh, Phuong X. Nguyen, Raghav Chaturvedi, Sehyun Oh, Jiyong Han, Paul Malinowski, Chad Mowers, Jimin Kim, Sae Hee Ryu, Hyunjong Lee, Jinhyeok Choi, Sangsu Yer, Chris Jozwiak, Aaron Bostwick, Eli Rotenberg, Craig M.
