articles.title: Boundary Element Modeling for THz-SNOM Near-Field Probes
articles.title_zh: 用于太赫兹扫描近场光学显微镜探针的边界元建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24151v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Terahertz scanning near-field optical microscopy (THz-SNOM) enables spatially and spectrally resolved investigation of low-energy collective and topological states in quantum materials and nano-structured devices by exploiting the strongly localized near field generated by a polarized atomic force microscopy (AFM) tip. Because the THz near-field response is highly sensitive to tip geometry, understanding how geometric parameters control field confinement and decay is essential for selecting tip designs that provide the spatial resolution required for specific experiments. In this work, we develop a boundary element method (BEM) for modeling the electrostatic near-field of a conducting AFM tip in response to an external background field. The tip is represented by a simplified closed, blunt-cone geometry with its surface discretized into panels using increased mesh density near the apex. A modified Green's function is used to calculate interactions between surface panels, while an augmented linear system simultaneously enforces the equipotential boundary condition on the conducting surface and overall charge neutrality to determine the induced surface-charge distribution. We validate the BEM by comparing the resulting near-field decay with that obtained from a three-dimensional quasi-static COMSOL Multiphysics simulation. The BEM accurately reproduces the COMSOL field-decay behavior while requiring orders of magnitude fewer mesh elements and substantially reducing computational cost. These results demonstrate that the BEM provides an accurate and computationally efficient framework for systematically investigating the dependence of THz near-field confinement on AFM tip geometry. This framework can be extended to more complex and experimentally realistic tip geometries, providing a route toward rational tip selection and design for application-specific spatial-resolution requirements.
articles.abstract_zh: 太赫兹扫描近场光学显微镜（THz-SNOM）通过利用极化原子力显微镜（AFM）尖端产生的强局域近场，实现对量子材料和纳米结构器件中低能集体和拓扑态的空间和光谱分辨研究。本文开发了一种边界元方法（BEM），用于模拟导电AFM尖端在外部背景场作用下的静电近场。该模型将尖端表示为简化的钝锥几何形状，并采用改进的格林函数计算表面面板之间的相互作用。该方法有助于理解几何参数如何控制场限制和衰减，从而优化探针设计以满足实验所需的空间分辨率。
authors: Noah Reich, Richard Kim, Thomas Koschny, Jigang Wang

articles.title: Kohler's Rule Holds in the Strange Metallic Hubbard Model
articles.title_zh: Kohler定律在奇异金属Hubbard模型中成立
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24208v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Unconventional magnetotransport violating Kohler's rule has been reported in many strongly correlated strange metals, but the exact origin of these violations is yet unknown. To investigate this question, we use determinant quantum Monte Carlo to compute the magnetoresistance of the hole-doped Hubbard-Hofstadter model. Despite T-linear resistivity exceeding the Mott-Ioffe-Regel limit and the nominal absence of well-defined quasiparticles, we find Kohler's rule unexpectedly holds across a wide range of on-site interaction strengths and hole dopings. In particular, Kohler emerges below a crossover temperature T^starapprox t identified from the double occupancy and specific heat, coinciding with the onset of local singlet correlations between lattice sites. We thus propose that Kohler scaling in this regime reflects a more general form of many-body quantum coherence. Our results show that strong correlations and strange metallicity do not themselves generically produce anomalous magnetoresistance.
articles.abstract_zh: 许多强关联奇异金属中存在违反Kohler定律的非常规磁输运现象，其确切起源尚不清楚。本文利用行列式量子蒙特卡洛方法计算了空穴掺杂Hubbard-Hofstadter模型的磁阻。研究发现，尽管存在T线性电阻率和缺乏明确定义的准粒子，Kohler定律在广泛的相互作用强度和空穴掺杂范围内出乎意料地成立。Kohler定律的出现与局部单重态关联的形成温度一致，表明该尺标反映了更普遍的多体量子相干性。
authors: Rebekah M. Jin, Emily Z. Zhang, Jixun K. Ding, Brian Moritz, Thomas P. Devereaux

articles.title: A Chiral Superlattice Route to Spin-Split Topological Antiferromagnetism
articles.title_zh: 手性超晶格实现自旋劈裂拓扑反铁磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24242v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interplay between chirality and magnetism is a profound topic, spanning particle physics, condensed matter, chemistry and origin of life. In this paper, we study this interplay in the new antiferromagnet (AFM) UOTe, and we report a chiral superlattice route to spin-split topological phenomena from collinear antiferromagnetism. Pristine UOTe is a collinear AFM without Berry curvature or spin-split bands. However, we identify the spontaneous formation of a chiral superlattice in UOTe, which can be viewed as frozen chiral phonons at finite wave vector. When electrons move through the chiral superlattice, their orbital Bloch wavefunction and quantum geometry are modulated by the strong chiral superlattice potential, generating large Berry curvature in the chiral superlattice, which we detect by the nonlinear Hall effect. At 150 K, the chiral superlattice induced Berry curvature couples to the collinear AFM order, generating a giant anomalous Hall angle ~0.14 abruptly near T_N that is among the largest in bulk magnets. Moreover, our spin Hanle precession measurement shows that the chiral superlattice also generates spin-polarized current from the collinear AFM, a long-standing goal in spintronics. We shed light on the supermodulation formation mechanism based on chemical ion size and physical interlayer-intralayer energy competitions, using which we propose a design principle to discover similar bond-mismatch superlattices, providing a chiral superlattice pathway through real space engineering of quantum geometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了手性与磁性在新型反铁磁体UOTe中的相互作用，并提出了一种通过手性超晶格实现自旋劈裂拓扑反铁磁现象的途径。尽管纯净UOTe是共线反铁磁体，但研究发现其中会自发形成手性超晶格，该超晶格能调制电子的轨道布洛赫波函数和量子几何，从而产生巨大的贝里曲率。在150 K时，手性超晶格诱导的贝里曲率与共线反铁磁序耦合，产生了巨大的反常霍尔角。自旋Hanle进动测量进一步表明，手性超晶格还能产生自旋极化电流。
authors: Thao Dinh, Mengke Liu, Jian-Xiang Qiu, Sougata Mardanya, Suk Hyun Sung, Xuan Hoang Le, Christopher Broyles, Chengfeng Zhu, Qiaozhi Xu, Haotian Chen, Zack Rehfuss, Yu-Fei Liu, Xiaoyu Zeng, Houchen Li, Peng Guo, Jinchen Liu, Tianye Huang, Jingtian Shi, Michael Smith, Joanna M. articles.title: Quantum state tomography through multi-frequency Josephson effect
articles.title_zh: 通过多频约瑟夫森效应实现量子态层析成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24391v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Macroscopic quantum effects emerge when the coherent behavior of countless microscopic quantum states manifests collectively at a visible scale, as exemplified by the supercurrent carried by innumerable finite-momentum Cooper pairs. By rigorously analyzing the time evolution of superconducting nanodevices including finite-momentum superconductors and quantum-dot Josephson junctions, we analytically derive the ubiquitous macroscopic supercurrent that originates from quantum interference between distinct many-body eigenstates, which we term as the dynamic interference supercurrent. The dynamic interference supercurrent in a system of two Andreev spin qubits exhibits multi-frequency Josephson effect in the absence of external voltage and is governed by the response of the many-body eigenfunctions (ěrt rångle) to variations in the superconducting phase φ, determined by the φ-space Berry connection Cᵣᵣ'=łangle r|partial_φ|r'ångle. The macroscopic dynamic interference supercurrent, an inherent property of the superposition state itself, enables an advanced quantum entanglement measurement of the Andreev spin qubits. These findings open new avenues for investigating superconducting nanodevice properties from a wave-function level, with substantial implications for advancing quantum science and technology in solid-state superconducting devices, such as quantum computer, communication, memory, and sensor.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过严格分析超导纳米器件的时间演化，解析推导了一种普遍存在的宏观超电流，其源于不同多体本征态之间的量子干涉，称之为动态干涉超电流。在没有外部电压的情况下，两个Andreev自旋量子比特系统中的动态干涉超电流表现出多频约瑟夫森效应。这种宏观动态干涉超电流是叠加态本身的固有属性，可用于Andreev自旋量子比特的先进量子纠缠测量。这些发现为量子态层析成像开辟了新途径。
authors: Xian-Peng Zhang, Ting-Rui Hu, Zhen-Biao Yang, Rubén Seoane Souto, Yugui Yao

articles.title: Structural signatures of a topological transition in a disordered tetrahedral network
articles.title_zh: 无序四面体网络中拓扑转变的结构特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24574v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological transitions in disordered network materials are often characterised using descriptors of entanglement, such as ring linking and writhe, which can be difficult to access experimentally. Here we investigate whether a topological transition can instead be identified using structural descriptors more readily connected to experiment. We reanalyse configurations of a colloidal tetrahedral network model known to exhibit a pressure-driven transition between unentangled and and entangled states. We show that the cumulative all-rings vertex symbol (CARVS), a descriptor of medium-range network topology based on ring statistics, provides a clear signature of this transition despite containing no explicit information about ring linking. We further show that network entanglement produces characteristic changes in the radial distribution function and structure factor, including the emergence of short-range correlations between nonbonded nodes and the disappearance of a low-angle scattering pre-peak. These results establish experimentally accessible structural signatures of topological transitions in disordered tetrahedral networks. Comparison with canonical continuous random networks further suggests that framework materials with extended linkers may provide promising candidate systems in which to search experimentally for entanglement-driven topological transitions.
articles.abstract_zh: 无序网络材料中的拓扑转变通常通过难以实验获取的纠缠描述符来表征。本文研究了是否可以使用更容易实验获取的结构描述符来识别拓扑转变。通过重新分析胶体四面体网络模型的构型，研究发现基于环统计的中程网络拓扑描述符——累积全环顶点符号（CARVS）——提供了该转变的清晰特征。此外，网络纠缠会在径向分布函数和结构因子中产生特征性变化。这些结果为无序四面体网络中的拓扑转变建立了可实验获取的结构特征。
authors: Florence Ellary, Thomas C. Nicholas, Dwaipayan Charkabarti, Andrew L. Goodwin

articles.title: Theory of High-Temperature Fractional Chern Phases in Monolayer van der Waals Kagome Materials A₂T₃X₄
articles.title_zh: 单层范德华kagome材料A₂T₃X₄中高温分数陈相的理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24633v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fractional Chern insulators bring the fractional quantum Hall effect, with its anyonic excitations, to zero magnetic field. So far they have been realized in moiré materials, where the long superlattice period weakens electronic interactions and confines these phases to cryogenic temperatures. Early proposals instead envisioned topological flat bands on atomic-scale lattices, where fractionalization could persist to far higher temperatures, but a suitable material has been lacking. Here we theoretically identify monolayers of the recently synthesized van der Waals kagome family A₂T₃X₄ as such a platform, combining intrinsic topological flat bands and strong Coulomb interactions with gate-tunable carrier density and layer assembly. Exact diagonalization of models derived from density functional theory reveals ferromagnetism over broad filling ranges, supporting diverse fractional Chern insulators, anomalous composite Fermi liquids, and charge-ordered phases. In particular, in Cs₂Pd₃S₄, the fractional Chern insulator exhibits a many-body gap of approximately 26 meV in the largest system accessible with band mixing allowing at most one interband electron-hole excitation. Layer assembly further provides a natural route to fractional quantum spin Hall insulators: bilayers with antiparallel magnetizations support this phase at realistic separations. These results identify an experimentally accessible material family in which chemical composition, carrier density, and stacking offer complementary routes to fractionalization at enhanced energy scales and control over topological order.
articles.abstract_zh: 分数陈绝缘体将分数量子霍尔效应及其任意子激发带到零磁场。本文理论上识别出最近合成的范德华kagome家族A₂T₃X₄的单层材料，作为实现高温分数陈相的平台。该材料结合了本征拓扑平带和强库仑相互作用，并具有可门控调谐的载流子密度。基于密度泛函理论模型的精确对角化计算揭示了在宽填充范围内的铁磁性，支持多种分数陈绝缘体、反常复合费米液体和电荷有序相。
authors: Soomin Oh, Jiyong Han, Jinhyeok Choi, Donghae Seo, Mingu Kang, Gil Young Cho

articles.title: Turning Number and the Geometry of Disorder-Induced Topology
articles.title_zh: 转动数与无序诱导拓扑的几何学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24637v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The geometry of momentum-space Hamiltonian maps derived from the zero-frequency single-particle Green's function provides a route to a refined topological characterization of quantum systems beyond the noninteracting clean limit. The central idea is to complement standard topological invariants by invariants that characterize the geometry of the map itself. As a paradigmatic example, we study the one-dimensional chiral Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model with disorder, where the topological Hamiltonian defines a planar Bloch loop. In addition to its conventional winding number, this loop possesses an integer turning number that characterizes the winding of its tangent vector. We identify turning-number transitions that occur while the topological Hamiltonian remains finite and spectrally gapped, driven solely by a vanishing tangent vector of the Bloch loop, and obtain an extended phase diagram with additional topological structure beyond the winding-number classification. Asymptotic analysis predicts the emergence and disorder dependence of the corresponding transition regime, in agreement with the numerical results. Our findings establish the geometry of momentum-space Hamiltonian maps as an additional source of topological structure beyond conventional classifications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种通过动量空间哈密顿量映射的几何学，对量子系统进行更精细拓扑表征的方法。研究以一维手性Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型为例，发现其拓扑哈密顿量定义的平面布洛赫环除了常规缠绕数外，还具有表征其切向量缠绕的整数转动数。该工作识别出在拓扑哈密顿量有限且谱带隙存在的情况下，仅由布洛赫环切向量消失引起的转动数转变。这些发现建立了无序诱导拓扑的几何学特征，并扩展了传统的缠绕数分类。
authors: Lars Emmrich, Michael Potthoff

articles.title: Epitaxial Displacement-etched GaAsSb Quantum Dots Emitting at Telecom Wavelengths
articles.title_zh: 采用位移刻蚀法制备的电信波长GaAsSb外延量子点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24768v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Semiconductor quantum dots (QDs) are essential components for integrated photonic and quantum information systems, yet current epitaxial growth techniques face significant limitations in complexity of growth, material selection, and density tunability. Here we report a displacement etch technique that enables controlled formation of GaAsSb QDs with emission at telecommunications wavelengths. Our approach uses arsenic molecular flux (As₂₎ to react with antimonide surfaces through thermodynamically favorable displacement reactions, creating three-dimensional quantum confined nanostructures without requiring strain-driven growth or complex droplet-based processes. Density functional theory shows the two competing As-for-Sb exchange pathways to be nearly equivalent in both reaction energy and activation barrier, which places morphological control in the subsequent adatom kinetics rather than in the surface reaction itself. A single process parameter, the As₂ exposure, sets the QD areal density across three orders of magnitude, from 10² to 10⁵ μ m⁻², covering both isolated emitters and dense gain media. Structural analysis reveals well-defined GaAsSb QDs with a mixed GaAs/GaSb composition and no extended defects. Temperature-dependent photoluminescence measurements confirm emission at 1550 nm (0.8 eV) within the telecommunications C-band, with characteristic QD-like temperature dependence. Because the QDs form on a lattice-matched GaSb surface in a single growth step, the technique offers a practical route to C-band emitters built into the GaSb/AlGaSb device family already used for mid-infrared sources and detectors.
articles.abstract_zh: 半导体量子点是集成光子和量子信息系统的关键组件，但现有外延生长技术存在局限性。本文报告了一种位移刻蚀技术，能够可控地形成在电信波长发射的GaAsSb量子点。该方法通过砷分子流与锑化物表面发生热力学有利的位移反应，无需应变驱动或复杂液滴过程即可创建三维量子受限纳米结构。该技术通过单一参数（As₂暴露量）实现了量子点面密度在三个数量级范围内的调控。
authors: Sadhvikas Addamane, Sanghyeok Park, Quinn T. Campbell, Evan M. Anderson, Thomas Rotter, Darryl Shima, Julia Deitz, Paul Kotula, Ganesh Balakrishnan, Oleg Mitrofanov, Igal Brener, Prasad P. Iyer

articles.title: Tensor network Monte Carlo study of the J1-J2 Ising model on the square lattice
articles.title_zh: 方格J1-J2伊辛模型的张量网络蒙特卡罗研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25270v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The frustrated square-lattice J1-J2 Ising model exhibits rich magnetic phases, yet its phase transitions remain difficult to characterize due to critical slowing down in conventional Monte Carlo and truncation errors inherent to tensor renormalization group methods.We develop a tensor-network Monte Carlo (TNMC) algorithm for this frustrated model, which supports both open and periodic boundary conditions. For periodic lattices, we use a sweeping block-update strategy that updates spin blocks while fixing surrounding spins.To boost efficiency, we couple our sampler with histogram reweighting, and test each technique standalone to validate these independent optimizations.We perform extensive finite-size scaling analyses at g=0.55 and g=1.0, extracting apparent critical temperatures and effective thermal exponents from Binder-cumulant data.Our method offers an efficient, nearly bias-free path for large-scale simulations of J1-J2-type frustrated magnets under periodic boundaries and generalizes readily to other frustrated spin lattices.
articles.abstract_zh: 挫折方格J1-J2伊辛模型展现出丰富的磁相，但其相变特征难以确定。本文开发了一种适用于该模型的张量网络蒙特卡罗（TNMC）算法，支持开放和周期性边界条件。该方法通过扫描块更新策略和直方图重加权技术提高了效率，并进行了广泛的有限尺寸标度分析。该方法为周期性边界条件下J1-J2型挫折磁体的模拟提供了一条高效且几乎无偏的途径。
authors: Wanying Zheng, Tao Chen, Youjin Deng, Wanzhou Zhang

articles.title: Signatures of slow particle transport in the interacting Aubry-André chain
articles.title_zh: 相互作用Aubry-André链中慢粒子输运的特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25557v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Slow delocalization in strongly disordered many-body quantum chains can originate from two distinct mechanisms: rare resonances and avalanches, rooted in the energy statistics, or an energy-independent combinatorial path-entropy obstruction in operator space. Quasiperiodic potentials eliminate rare regions with similar potentials that are thought to be responsible for avalanche instabilities and modify the statistics of resonances, thus allowing us to delineate the two mechanisms. To do so, we numerically study the entanglement entropy S(t), number entropy S_N(t), and Hartley number entropy S_H(t) following a quantum quench in the interacting Aubry-André chain with disorder strength D. We find S(t)simμłn t, S_N(t)simνłnłn t with growth rates μsimνsim D⁻γ and γapprox 3, the same behavior that was previously found in the case of quenched disorder. Furthermore, the saturation values S_H(t→infty) continue to grow with system size L as łn L, a growth that persists for Dgtrsim 8 where MBL was argued to be stable. The similarity of the quasi-periodic and quenched disorder cases points to a common origin of the slow particle transport that does not rely on rare-region avalanches and persists despite strongly modified resonance statistics.
articles.abstract_zh: 强无序多体量子链中的慢退局域化可能源于稀有共振和雪崩机制，或算符空间中与能量无关的组合路径熵障碍。本文通过数值研究相互作用Aubry-André链在量子猝灭后的纠缠熵、粒子数熵和哈特利粒子数熵，以区分这两种机制。研究发现，准周期势与淬火无序情况下的慢粒子输运行为相似，表明其可能具有共同的起源。
authors: S. Sharifan, M. Kiefer-Emmanouilidis, J. Sirker

articles.title: Generalised Fluctuating Dynamic Density-Functional Theory: Derivation and Applications
articles.title_zh: 广义涨落动力学密度泛函理论：推导与应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26129v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Classical density-functional theory is a powerful theoretical framework for studying the equilibrium density distribution of complex many-body systems. The core of the framework is to bridge microscopic and macroscopic descriptions of fluids through a variational principle that minimises the system's free energy. For dynamical settings, dynamic DFT (DDFT) extends the equilibrium framework to capture the time evolution of an order parameter, typically density. However, DDFT is often insufficient for mesoscopic systems far from equilibrium where fluctuations become significant, necessitating a stochastic extension: fluctuating DDFT. Here we derive a generalised FDDFT from first principles starting from the microscopic Hamiltonian dynamics using coarse-graining techniques, including Zwanzig's projection operator method. The resulting FDDFT applies to arbitrary observable fields, where the dynamics are driven by a thermodynamic force expressed in terms of an entropy functional. The dynamics consist of reversible, dissipative, and stochastic contributions, each directly linked to the underlying microscopic dynamics via the Liouville operator, Green-Kubo relations, and the fluctuation-dissipation theorem. To highlight the difference in the level of description between DDFT and FDDFT, we demonstrate how further coarse-graining via averaging leads to a generalised DDFT, valid at the macroscale. To showcase the effectiveness and utility of the generalised FDDFT, we apply it to two prototypical fluid systems: colloidal and simple viscous fluids. In the former case, we utilise the new formalism to re-derive the recently found colloidal FDDFT. In the latter case, we rigorously recover the non-isothermal extension of the Landau-Lifshitz fluctuating Navier-Stokes equations, providing fundamental derivation of this well-known phenomenological model, enabling to clarify its underlying principles.
articles.abstract_zh: 经典密度泛函理论是研究复杂多体系统平衡密度分布的强大框架。本文从微观哈密顿动力学出发，利用粗粒化技术推导了广义涨落动力学密度泛函理论（FDDFT）。该理论适用于任意可观测场，其动力学由熵泛函表示的热力学力驱动。所得的FDDFT包含可逆、耗散和随机贡献，每部分都与底层的微观动力学直接相关。
authors: Toby Kay, Serafim Kalliadasis

articles.title: Evidence of valence bond solid and quantum paramagnetism in the J₁₋₋J₂₋₋J₃ Heisenberg model from pseudofermion functional renormalization group
articles.title_zh: 基于赝费米子泛函重整化群的J₁-J₂-J₃海森堡模型中价键固体和量子顺磁性的证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26135v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by recent tensor network studies reporting a quantum spin liquid (QSL) within the quantum paramagnetic (QP) regime, we investigate numerically the zero-temperature phase diagram of the J₁₋₋J₂₋₋J₃ Heisenberg model on the square lattice using the pseudofermion functional renormalization group (pf-fRG). Thanks to improved frequency resolution and larger lattice truncations, we are able to explore a significantly larger parameter space than previous pf-fRG work to map out the phase boundary of an extended QP region. We further resolve possible bond order within the QP regime by measuring the dimer response to small deformations in J₁, i.e. bond anisotropy that breaks the point-group symmetry of the Hamiltonian. The functional renormalization group flow of the dimer susceptibility suggests that the QP window splits into two: a region where it grows continuously down to the lowest energy scale to signal valence bond solid (VBS) order, and another region where it reaches a peak at a finite scale and is subsequently suppressed to indicate a QSL.
articles.abstract_zh: 受近期张量网络研究报告的量子自旋液体启发，本研究利用赝费米子泛函重整化群数值探究了方格上J₁-J₂-J₃海森堡模型的零温相图。通过改进频率分辨率和扩大晶格截断，作者们绘制了扩展量子顺磁区域的相边界，并揭示了该区域内可能的键序。结果表明，量子顺磁窗口分裂为两部分：一部分表现出价键固体序，另一部分则指示量子自旋液体。
authors: Gün Günal, Erhai Zhao, Ahmet Keleş

articles.title: Bicircular light tunable topological phases and nonlinear Hall responses in odd-parity magnets
articles.title_zh: 双圆偏振光调控奇宇称磁体中的拓扑相和非线性霍尔响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26163v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets are an emerging class of magnetic materials that exhibit characteristic features of both ferromagnets and antiferromagnets. Odd-wave magnets, where the momentum-dependent spin splitting follows an odd-parity form factor, provide a distinct platform for exploring unconventional magnetic and topological phenomena. In this work, we demonstrate light-induced topological phase transitions in odd-parity magnets driven by bicircular light. We show that a cascade of topological phase transitions occur as the relative amplitude ratio of the two beams is varied. These are accompanied by sharp changes of the quantum metric. We demonstrate that bicircular light unlocks nonlinear Hall responses arising from Berry curvature and quantum metric in irradiated odd-wave magnets, and formulate the underlying selection rules. Our results show that both the topology and the nonlinear responses in odd-parity magnets can be directly controlled by a bicircular drive.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了双圆偏振光如何在奇宇称磁体中诱导拓扑相变和非线性霍尔响应。作者们发现，通过改变两束光的相对振幅比，可以引发一系列拓扑相变，并伴随量子度规的急剧变化。研究还表明，双圆偏振光能够激发由贝里曲率和量子度规引起的非线性霍尔响应，并建立了相应的选择定则。这些结果揭示了奇宇称磁体的拓扑性质和非线性响应可以通过双圆偏振驱动直接控制。
authors: Md Afsar Reja, Awadhesh Narayan

articles.title: Development of microwave multiplexed readout for athermal phonon TES-based detectors
articles.title_zh: 基于非热声子TES探测器的微波复用读出技术发展
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24300v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Continued advancements in sub-eV calorimetric measurements are being enabled through the athermal phonon detection channel, with applications spanning a diverse array of fields, including low-mass dark matter searches, coherent elastic neutrino-nucleus scattering, and quantum information science. While Transition Edge Sensors (TESs) have achieved the lowest thresholds to date, they face significant scalability bottlenecks due to the inherent constraints of conventional SQUID readout architectures. To address this limitation, we present an update on R&D to develop practical, highly multiplexed, microwave readout for athermal phonon TESs, which can enable a dramatic increase in both sensor count and target mass, with a focus on sub-GeV dark matter searches as a target application. This work leverages advances from highly scaled mm-wave, x-ray, and gamma-ray TES systems, adapting them to the unique needs of low-threshold rare event measurements. We quantify the basic readout functionality and noise level in our dilution refrigerator testbed and demonstrate operation of a variety of TES devices with saturation powers significantly lower than mm-wave and x-ray devices. We demonstrate proof-of-concept multiplexed readout of background event pulses, bound the readout's contribution to the parasitic TES background load to <1 fW, and discuss a cryogenic inline RF filtering scheme. These results demonstrate practical solutions to several of the key challenges that must be solved before a next-generation athermal phonon detector at scale is realized.
articles.abstract_zh: 亚电子伏量热测量技术在暗物质探测、中微子散射和量子信息科学等领域取得进展，但传统SQUID读出架构限制了其可扩展性。本研究旨在开发一种实用的、高复用度的非热声子过渡边沿传感器（TES）微波读出技术，以克服现有瓶颈。该技术有望显著增加传感器数量和目标质量，特别适用于亚GeV暗物质探测。作者们量化了读出功能和噪声水平，并展示了多种低饱和功率TES器件的运行。
authors: Tran Tsan (Physics Division, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, Berkeley, CA, USA), Douglas A. Bennett (National Institute of Standards and Technology, Boulder, CO, USA), Daniel T. Becker (Department of Physics, University of Colorado, Boulder, CO, USA), Rebecca Carney (Engineering Division, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, Berkeley, CA, USA), Johnathon D. Gard (Department of Physics, University of Colorado, Boulder, CO, USA), John A. B. Mates (National Institute of Standards and Technology, Boulder, CO, USA), Joel N. Ullom (National Institute of Standards and Technology, Boulder, CO, USA, Department of Physics, University of Colorado, Boulder, CO, USA), Michael R. Williams (Physics Division, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, Berkeley, CA, USA), John C. Groh (Physics Division, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, Berkeley, CA, USA)

articles.title: The Anyon Atlas
articles.title_zh: 任意子图谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25439v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We classify possible topological quantum field theories in 2+1 dimensions with up to 22 anyons in the bosonic case and up to 26 in the fermionic case, through the modular data of modular and supermodular tensor categories. We construct such data via congruence representations of SL(2,Z) using a numerical optimization algorithm that scales to high rank. We chart the relations between the resulting theories, including anyon condensations and Chern-Simons realizations. We find examples of modular data that do not appear to arise from any Chern-Simons theory by any sequence of condensations of anyons or gaugings of ordinary global symmetries. These examples give qualitatively new topological quantum field theories, which go beyond any notion of gauge theory. For examples in this class with 11 and 12 anyon types, we solve the pentagon and hexagon equations explicitly, showing that these modular data are realized by full unitary topological quantum field theories. We also introduce https://www.AnyonAtlas.org, an online resource for exploring the data.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究通过模张量和超模张量范畴的模数据，对2+1维中玻色子情况下最多22个任意子、费米子情况下最多26个任意子的拓扑量子场论进行了分类。作者们利用数值优化算法构建了这些数据，并绘制了理论之间的关系，包括任意子凝聚和Chern-Simons实现。研究发现了一些无法通过Chern-Simons理论或规范化普通全局对称性产生的模数据，这些例子揭示了超越传统规范理论的新型拓扑量子场论。
authors: Jonah Berean-Dutcher, Clay Cordova, Julio Parra-Martinez, Richard Tuddenham

articles.title: Optical vortex bullets with large angular momenta
articles.title_zh: 具有大角动量的光学涡旋子弹
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26289v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate three-dimensional spatiotemporal optical vortex solitons (light bullets with a toroidal shape) carrying higher-order orbital angular momentum in Kerr media with anomalous group-velocity dispersion and a transversely localized Gaussian profile of the linear refractive index. Stationary vortex bullets with topological charges (winding numbers) 1łeq ell łeq 4 are obtained as numerical solutions of the three-dimensional nonlinear Schrödinger equation, and their existence, structure and stability are systematically analyzed. In terms of atomic Bose-Einstein condensates, these solutions represent matter-wave solitons with embedded vorticity. We examine the dependence of the solution families on the propagation constant, the depth and width of the guiding profile, and ell . It is found that the increase of ell  requires one to use a stronger or wider waveguiding potential to sustain localized states satisfying the Vakhitov-Kolokolov (VK) stability criterion. VK-complying and non-complying branches of vortex-soliton families are separated by a degenerate Townes branch. Direct simulations reveal that, although the guiding profile substantially suppresses the collapse and extends the propagation distance of vortex bullets, their robustness is ultimately limited by azimuthal instabilities, whose growth is enhanced for values of ell . These results demonstrate that engineered refractive-index landscapes significantly enlarge the stability domain of spatiotemporal vortex bullets and provide guidelines for supporting optical bullets carrying large orbital angular momenta.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究在克尔介质中，探讨了携带高阶轨道角动量的三维时空光学涡旋孤子（环形光子弹）。通过求解三维非线性薛定谔方程，作者们获得了拓扑荷为1到4的稳定涡旋子弹数值解，并系统分析了其存在性、结构和稳定性。研究发现，随着拓扑荷的增加，需要更强或更宽的波导势来维持满足Vakhitov-Kolokolov稳定判据的局域态。
authors: José R. Salgueiro, Carlos F. Sánchez, Boris A. Malomed, Ángel Paredes, Humberto Michinel

articles.title: Numerical and theoretical studies of the Anderson transition in the chiral symmetry classes with weak topology
articles.title_zh: 具有弱拓扑手性对称类中安德森相变的数值和理论研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.16555v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Combining lattice-model simulations with a renormalization group (RG) analysis of effective theories, we investigate the nature of the Anderson transition in chiral symmetry classes with one-dimensional (1D) weak topology. In the simulation study, we extend previous transfer matrix analyses to the chiral symplectic class, and study numerical Lyapunov exponents via a finite-size scaling (FSS) analysis that assumes spatially isotropic scaling. The analysis shows that, as in the other two chiral symmetry classes, the weak topology induces an intermediate quasi-localized (QL) phase between metal and Anderson insulator phases. In this QL phase, the localization length of wave functions diverges exclusively along the direction of the 1D weak topology. A comparison of the universal critical exponents across the three chiral symmetry classes indicates that the quantum criticality of the metal-to-QL transition varies, depending on the nature of the time-reversal symmetry. Motivated by this numerical observation, we revisit and extend our previous two-dimensional (2D) RG analysis to all three chiral classes, now newly incorporating a one-loop renormalization of the weak topological term in the analysis. The revised analysis reveals that a quasi-localized strong-coupling fixed point previously reported in the chiral unitary class is unstable under this new inclusion; instead, the strong-coupling phase is entirely governed by a stable fixed point with conventional localized character. Nevertheless, in the chiral unitary and chiral symplectic classes, the RG analysis still yields the hallmark of the 1D weak topology through the spatially anisotropic scaling of the Anderson transition criticality. These theoretical findings suggest that a conclusive numerical identification of the 2D QL phase requires a finite-size scaling approach that accommodates generic (anisotropic) spatial scaling.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究结合晶格模型模拟和有效理论的重整化群分析，探讨了具有一维弱拓扑手性对称类中安德森相变的性质。模拟结果显示，弱拓扑诱导了金属相和安德森绝缘体相之间的一个中间准局域（QL）相。在该QL相中，波函数的局域长度仅沿一维弱拓扑方向发散。对三种手性对称类中普适临界指数的比较表明，金属到QL相变的量子临界性取决于时间反演对称的性质。
authors: Shiyin Kuang, Tong Wang, Zhenyu Xiao, Pengwei Zhao, Ryuichi Shindou

articles.title: Interactive proofs for verifying (quantum) learning and testing
articles.title_zh: 用于验证（量子）学习和测试的交互式证明
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2239 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-20-2239 We consider the problem of testing and learning from data in the presence of resource constraints, such as limited memory or weak data access, which place limitations on the efficiency and feasibility of testing or learning. In particular, we ask the following question: Could a resource-constrained learner/tester use interaction with a resource-unconstrained but untrusted party to solve a learning or testing problem more efficiently than they could without such an interaction? In this work, we answer this question both abstractly and for concrete problems, in two complementary ways: For a wide variety of scenarios, we prove that a resource-constrained learner cannot gain any advantage through classical interaction with an untrusted prover. As a special case, we show that for the vast majority of testing and learning problems in which quantum memory is a meaningful resource, a memory-constrained quantum algorithm cannot overcome its limitations via classical communication with a memory-unconstrained quantum prover. In contrast, when quantum communication is allowed, we construct a variety of interactive proof protocols, for specific learning and testing problems, which allow memory-constrained quantum verifiers to gain significant advantages through delegation to untrusted provers. These results highlight both the limitations and potential of delegating learning and testing problems to resource-rich but untrusted third parties.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了资源受限的学习者/测试者能否通过与不受信任但资源不受限的方进行交互，更有效地解决学习或测试问题。作者们证明，在多种情况下，资源受限的学习者无法通过与不受信任的证明者进行经典交互获得优势。然而，当允许量子通信时，研究构建了多种交互式证明协议，表明量子通信可以帮助克服资源限制。
authors: Matthias C. Caro, Jens Eisert, Marcel Hinsche, Marios Ioannou, Alexander Nietner, and Ryan Sweke

articles.title: Reliable Entropy Estimation from Observed Statistics for Device-Independent Quantum Cryptography
articles.title_zh: 基于观测统计数据对设备无关量子密码学进行可靠熵估计
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2238 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-20-2238 We introduce a numerical framework for reliably estimating conditional von Neumann entropies, a central quantity in device-independent quantum cryptography and randomness generation. Our method is based on semidefinite relaxations derived from the Navascués--Pironio--Acín hierarchy and provides entropy bounds directly from observed statistics, assuming only the validity of quantum mechanics. The approach builds on a recent integral representation of entropy and substantially improves efficiency: it requires about half as many support variables as existing methods, while allowing these variables to be chosen projectively, leading to a significant reduction in runtime. These advances enable the practical certification of randomness and security even in noisy conditions, while integrating seamlessly with modern entropy accumulation theorems. Consequently, our framework becomes a versatile tool for quantum cryptographic protocols, broadening the possibilities for secure communication in untrusted environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种数值框架，用于可靠估计条件冯诺依曼熵，这是设备无关量子密码学和随机性生成中的核心量。该方法基于Navascués-Pironio-Acín层级导出的半正定松弛，并直接从观测统计数据提供熵界限。新方法显著提高了效率，所需支持变量减少约一半，并允许投影选择变量，从而大幅缩短运行时间。这些进展使得在噪声条件下也能实际认证随机性和安全性，并与现代熵累积定理无缝集成。
authors: Gereon Koßmann and René Schwonnek

articles.title: Asymptotically good bosonic Fock state codes
articles.title_zh: 渐近优良的玻色子福克态编码
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2240 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-20-2240 We study the error-correction properties of multi-mode Fock-state codes under amplitude-damping (AD) noise, focusing on the asymptotic regime in which the total excitation of the code states grows without limit and the number of photon losses induced by the noise scales linearly with it. In this setting, existing code families, which correct only sublinearly many photon losses, do not protect against amplitude-damping (AD) noise with a constant loss parameter. As our main result, we address this gap by constructing asymptotically good Fock-state codes relying on random classical codes in the discrete simplex. Unlike many standard constructions of random quantum codes, our construction introduces randomness through the underlying classical indexing structure. Randomization also enables another desirable feature: bounded per-mode occupancy, which limits the number of photons in any individual mode and thereby increases the coherence lifetime of the code states. Finally, via a relation between Fock-state codes and permutation-invariant codes, our results also yield asymptotically good families of qudit permutation-invariant codes as well as codes in monolithic nuclear state spaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了多模福克态编码在振幅阻尼噪声下的纠错特性，特别关注总激发无限增长且光子损耗与噪声线性相关的渐近机制。作者们通过构建基于离散单纯形中随机经典编码的渐近优良福克态编码，解决了现有编码无法有效对抗恒定损耗参数振幅阻尼噪声的问题。该构造引入了随机性，并实现了有界单模占用，从而延长了编码态的相干寿命。
authors: Dor Elimelech, Arda Aydin, and Alexander Barg

articles.title: Strong-to-Weak Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking Transitions on a Quantum Processor
articles.title_zh: 量子处理器上的强-弱自发对称破缺转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26229v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mixed quantum states can exhibit unconventional forms of symmetry breaking without pure-state counterparts. A prominent example is strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SW-SSB), which cannot be diagnosed by observables linear in the density matrix. Here, we experimentally resolve finite-size critical signatures of SW-SSB transitions on a superconducting quantum processor. We develop a measurement protocol that combines quantum measurements with classical processing based on the known dephasing channel to reconstruct nonlinear mixed-state correlators. Using only two measurement settings, the protocol reconstructs fidelity, Rényi-2, and linear correlators, as well as string observables. Applying this approach to matrix-product states subjected to power-law-correlated dephasing, we observe finite-size crossings and scaling collapses in nonlinear correlators, accompanied by decaying linear correlations. We further map the estimated SW-SSB transition points across initial-state and channel parameters. Measurements of linear and Rényi-2 string observables further reveal signatures of mixed-state symmetry-protected topological (SPT) phases, with a nonlinear string-order crossover aligned with an independently estimated SW-SSB transition point. Our results establish a quantum-classical approach to probing SW-SSB critical behavior and mixed-state SPT order.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究在超导量子处理器上实验性地揭示了强-弱自发对称破缺（SW-SSB）转变的有限尺寸临界特征。作者们开发了一种结合量子测量和经典处理的测量协议，用于重建非线性混合态关联函数。该协议仅需两次测量设置即可重建保真度、Rényi-2和线性关联函数以及弦观测量。研究结果揭示了非线性关联函数中的有限尺寸交叉和标度坍缩，并进一步绘制了SW-SSB转变点。
authors: Zhi-Yuan Wei, Christopher Fechisin, Yu-Xin Wang, Jeet Shah, Tsung-Cheng Lu, Cheng-Ju Lin, Alexey V. Gorshkov

articles.title: Programmable optical parametric amplifier synthesizer for cubic phase states and amplified Schrödinger cat states
articles.title_zh: 用于立方相态和放大薛定谔猫态的可编程光学参量放大器合成器
articles.abstract: We introduce a programmable optical parametric amplifier (OPA) synthesizer that, under a heralded photon-number-resolving framework, generates high-fidelity cubic phase states (CPSs) and amplifies Schrödinger cat states. By systematically exploring both the catalytic configuration, where the idler input and output contain the same number of photons ( ), and non-catalytic configurations ( ), we discover two qualitatively different functionalities. First, with a coherent-state signal input, our protocol generates CPSs with fidelity exceeding across a broad range of ( , ) configurations. Second, using a Schrödinger cat state as the signal input, the same framework amplifies the cat state: an input cat with amplitude is transformed into an output squeezed cat with while maintaining fidelity above . The catalytic configuration preserves the input parity and restores the idler state, whereas non-catalytic configurations enable parity-flipping amplification with higher success rates. Moreover, the amplified output can serve as a seed for subsequent amplification rounds, offering a self-seeding pathway to progressively larger cat states. Our protocol requires only moderate-gain OPA operation and low-order photon-number-resolving detection, providing a flexible and experimentally accessible platform for CPS preparation and amplified squeezed cat state generation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种可编程光学参量放大器（OPA）合成器，其在预示光子数分辨框架下，能够生成高保真立方相态（CPSs）并放大薛定谔猫态。通过系统探索催化和非催化配置，研究发现了两种不同的功能。该协议能以高保真度生成CPSs，并能将输入的薛定谔猫态放大为挤压猫态，同时保持高保真度。
authors: Yusuf Turek, Ming-Yan Sun and Xiao-Xi Yao

articles.title: Asymmetric Entanglement-Assisted Quantum Locally Recoverable Codes
articles.title_zh: 非对称纠缠辅助量子局部可恢复码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23889v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Locally recoverable codes (LRCs) permit reconstruction of a lost coordinate from a small subset of the remaining coordinates, a property that is a fundamental coding technique for distributed storage and, more recently, for fault-tolerant quantum memories and distributed storage systems. Existing constructions of quantum locally recoverable codes (qLRCs) and their entanglement-assisted generalizations (EA-qLRCs) impose a single locality parameter r governing recovery from both bit-flip (X-type) and phase-flip (Z-type) errors, even though physical noise is rarely symmetric between the two. We introduce entanglement-assisted quantum locally recoverable codes (EA-qLRC) with emphasymmetric locality r_X,r_Z, in which X-type and Z-type errors are corrected from recovery sets of size at most r_X+1 and r_Z+1, respectively. We extend a stabilizer sufficient condition for this property and, in particular, the CSS framework, where asymmetric locality corresponds to separate locality conditions on the two classical codes mathcal C₁ and mathcal C₂ underlying the construction. From this characterization we derive Singleton-, Griesmer-, Plotkin-, sphere-packing-, and Cadambetextendash Mazumdar-like bounds for CSS-type asymmetric EA-qLRCs (AEA-qLRCs) built from Proposition~e̊fCSS-EA-qLRC-Asym, and we characterize exactly when a pure CSS-type AEA-qLRC built from a pair of classical LRCs attains the Singleton-like bound with equality.
articles.abstract_zh: 局部可恢复码（LRC）是分布式存储和容错量子存储的关键技术。现有量子局部可恢复码（qLRC）及其纠缠辅助泛化（EA-qLRC）对X型和Z型错误采用单一局部性参数。本文引入了具有非对称局部性参数r_X和r_Z的EA-qLRC，以分别纠正X型和Z型错误，并扩展了其稳定器充分条件和CSS框架，从而推导了相关的编码界限。
authors: Vijay Kumar, Ramakrishna Bandi

articles.title: Designing Robust Quantum Gates
articles.title_zh: 设计鲁棒量子门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24039v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: For given control channels, quantum control theory determines whether quantum gates can be realized, but not their resilience to errors. We address this problem by establishing existence criteria for robust gate implementation in d-level systems. Our criteria reveal that implementability of all gates is not enough: a universal family of robust gates exists if and only if the driven Hamiltonians share no common symmetry. When these criteria hold, we can make gates resilient to any combination of static perturbations, uniform Hamiltonian rescaling, perturbations at a finite set of selected frequencies, and perturbations with arbitrary selected waveforms. We can impose robustness conditions broadly with limited information about errors, e.g., against any static perturbations; we can also tailor these conditions to the platform, e.g., against environment-induced noise with dominant spectral peaks, requiring no spectral details beyond the peak frequencies. We numerically construct explicit protocols for robust gates, reducing average gate infidelity by approximately two to seven orders of magnitude under Hamiltonian perturbations and environment-induced noise. Together, our existence criteria and numerical constructions provide practical guidance for evaluating the potential of quantum platforms and designing robust quantum gates.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子控制理论虽能确定量子门的可实现性，但对其抗误差能力关注不足。本文建立了d能级系统中鲁棒量子门实现的判据，揭示了通用鲁棒门存在的充要条件是驱动哈密顿量不共享共同对称性。当满足这些判据时，量子门可抵抗多种静态扰动、哈密顿量均匀重标、特定频率扰动及任意波形扰动。数值构建的协议将平均门失真度降低了约2至7个数量级。
authors: Yuanxing Hao, Marin Bukov

articles.title: Performance of a Hot Rb Vapour-Based Portable Quantum Memory
articles.title_zh: 基于热铷原子蒸气的便携式量子存储器性能研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24098v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum repeaters will be paramount to the success of the future quantum internet. Presently however, the losses incurred in fibre communications are unsustainable when fragile quantum states are transmitted over long distances. The most effective repeater nodes will require incorporation of a minimum of two quantum memory units (QMems) for successful operation. Therefore a network composed of numerous nodes will ideally require scalable repeaters that contain QMems that are portable, robust and do not require a high amount of overhead. Here we investigate the performance of a commercial QMem based on a warm vapour of Rb atoms. Specifically, we characterize the coherence time, absolute efficiency, signal to noise ratio and bit error ratio of this device over a range of vapour temperatures that are readily controllable. For our system, we place these performance metrics into the same conventions as those established for current optical communication protocols. Development of QMem systems meeting these benchmarks will be a vital step for seamless integration of QMems systems into present-day communication architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子中继器是未来量子互联网成功的关键，其中量子存储器（QMem）至关重要。本文研究了一种基于热铷原子蒸气的商用便携式QMem的性能。研究人员在不同蒸气温度下，对其相干时间、绝对效率、信噪比和误码率进行了表征，并将其性能指标与现有光通信协议的规范进行了对齐。
authors: Kenneth Gregory, Konrad Socha, Khaled Mnaymneh, Connor Kupchak

articles.title: Translation-Invariant Pure States with Exotic Half-Chain Factors
articles.title_zh: 具有奇异半链因子平移不变纯态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24154v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct translation-invariant pure quasifree fermionic states on the one-dimensional lattice whose half-chain von Neumann algebras are hyperfinite factors of type IIᵢₙfty or III_łambda for any 0<łambdałeq 1. Via the Jordan-Wigner-Araki transformation, these yield translation-invariant pure spin-chain states with the same half-chain factors, demonstrating that such factors need not be of type I or III. Each state is the unique ground state of a gapless, translation-invariant parent Hamiltonian with superpolynomially decaying interactions. For any fixed factor type, the interval entanglement entropy can exhibit widely varying growth rates, from arbitrarily slow divergence to nearly power-law growth, showing that entropy scaling does not determine the factor type. In contrast, we prove that gauge-invariant quadratic Hamiltonians with finitely many flavours and exponentially decaying hopping exhibit a dichotomy: their ground states either satisfy an area law with a type I half-chain factor, or have logarithmic entropy growth with a type III₁ factor. The counterexample was discovered with AI assistance.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了在一维格子上具有奇异半链冯·诺依曼代数（IIᵢₙfty型或III_λ型）的平移不变纯准自由费米子态。通过Jordan-Wigner-Araki变换，这些态产生了具有相同半链因子的平移不变自旋链态，表明此类因子不限于I型或III型。研究还发现，对于任何固定因子类型，区间纠缠熵可以表现出从任意慢发散到接近幂律增长的广泛变化率，这与规范不变二次哈密顿量的行为形成对比。
authors: Ruizhi Liu, Jinmin Yi

articles.title: Trajectree - A quantum trajectory-based quantum circuit simulator
articles.title_zh: Trajectree：一种基于量子轨迹的量子电路模拟器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24160v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce Trajectree, a quantum trajectory-based quantum circuit simulator that uses a novel, state-saving partial execution of the quantum circuits to simulate broad and deep noisy quantum circuits efficiently. Trajectree can efficiently generate a large number of Monte Carlo samples by saving partially executed trajectories. We conduct extensive performance analysis of the Trajectree approach, proving the utility of the trajectory saving scheme for simulations of open quantum systems. Using this architecture, we show that Trajectree can simulate standard benchmark noisy circuits over five times faster than Google's QSim, a part of the Cirq package. We also analyze Trajectree's performance for simulating quantum optical systems relevant to communication and computing applications. We demonstrate applications of the optical backend to simulate three optical experiments: CHSH Bell test, entanglement swapping, and optical CNOT gate. This shows Trajectree's potential for simulating noisy qudit and optical systems efficiently.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了Trajectree，这是一种基于量子轨迹的量子电路模拟器，它利用新颖的状态保存部分执行技术，高效模拟广泛而深入的噪声量子电路。通过保存部分执行的轨迹，Trajectree能够高效生成大量蒙特卡洛样本。性能分析表明，Trajectree在模拟标准基准噪声电路时比Google的QSim快五倍以上，并展示了其在模拟量子光学系统（如CHSH贝尔测试、纠缠交换和光学CNOT门）方面的应用潜力。
authors: Ansh Singal, Allen Zang, Jordan Thomas, Alexander Kolar, Anirudh Ramesh, Joaquin Chung, Rajkumar Kettimuthu, Prem Kumar

articles.title: Probing wetting and solidification dynamics of neon thin films with a high-T_c superconducting circuit
articles.title_zh: 利用高温超导电路探测氖薄膜的润湿和凝固动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24167v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Integrating condensed noble gases with superconducting circuits offers new opportunities for operating hybrid quantum devices. In particular, electrons on solid neon have recently emerged as exceptionally coherent charge qubits, however the growth of the underlying neon films on patterned devices remains poorly controlled. We monitor neon films near the triple point using a multimode resonator fabricated from high-T_c YBCO, which remains superconducting at temperatures where the liquid phase exists and whose geometry sets a thickness-sensing window near 1 μm. In the liquid state we observe rich film dynamics: uniform wetting that saturates near 20 nm, drainage of thicker films, and spontaneous thickness oscillations, reflecting the extreme sensitivity of thick films in this regime. A galvanic connection to our sensing volume enables in-situ electrostatic tuning of the liquid film thickness. Statistics of freezing the neon across various liquid levels reveal variations of the solid film thickness by approximately an order of magnitude. We also observe a two-fold increase in the quality factor of the resonators at the level of 10³ with added neon and rule out dielectric loss as the limiting factor. Our results demonstrate that hermetic packaging facilitates the investigation of both rich non-equilibrium fluid dynamics and the impact of condensed noble gas films on microwave loss in superconducting circuits, but may not be the best modality for growing solid neon films with precisely controlled thickness.
articles.abstract_zh: 将凝聚态稀有气体与超导电路结合为混合量子器件提供了新机遇。本文利用高温超导YBCO多模谐振器，监测了三相点附近的氖薄膜，揭示了液态下丰富的薄膜动力学，包括均匀润湿、排水和自发厚度振荡。研究还实现了液膜厚度的原位静电调谐，并发现凝固过程中固膜厚度变化约一个数量级，谐振器品质因数提高了两倍。
authors: Brennan Dizdar, Yueheng Shi, David I. Schuster, Christopher S. Lang

articles.title: Optimal robust single-qubit gates in superconducting quantum processors
articles.title_zh: 超导量子处理器中的最优鲁棒单量子比特门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24212v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computing requires high-fidelity quantum gates that are resilient to control errors and device imperfections. Here, we develop energy-optimal control pulses for single-qubit gates that are simultaneously robust against frequency detuning and waveform inhomogeneities while also suppressing leakage outside the computational subspace. Combining the optimized pulse envelopes with an adaptive control scheme, we experimentally demonstrate optimal robust gates on a superconducting quantum processor. For a gate duration of 90ns, we achieve fidelities above 99.9% for the X gate and 99.6% for Hadamard-type gates. For the X gate, we maintain fidelities above 99.5% for simultaneous drive-amplitude variations up to 20% and qubit detuning up to 4 MHz. This robustness outperforms that of conventional Gaussian pulses by an order of magnitude, without much difference in peak gate fidelity. These results establish a route towards robust single-qubit control in large-scale quantum processors, advancing the development of fault-tolerant quantum computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 容错量子计算需要高保真且对控制误差和器件缺陷具有鲁棒性的量子门。本文开发了能量最优的控制脉冲，用于实现对频率失谐、波形不均匀性以及计算子空间外泄漏具有鲁棒性的单量子比特门。实验结果表明，在90纳秒的门持续时间下，X门保真度超过99.9%，Hadamard型门超过99.6%。X门在驱动幅度变化高达20%和量子比特失谐高达4 MHz的情况下，仍能保持99.5%以上的保真度，性能远超传统高斯脉冲。
authors: Tangyou Huang, Anuj Aggarwal, Jingjun Zhu, Akshay Gaikwad, David Niepce, Marcus Rommel, Andreas Nylander, Amr Osman, Anita Fadavi Rousari, Janka Biznárová, Stéphane Guérin, Gheorghe Sorin Paraoanu, Anton Frisk Kockum, Giovanna Tancredi

articles.title: Generalized Svetlichny Inequalities as a Cross-Platform Benchmark for Quantum Processors
articles.title_zh: 广义Svetlichny不等式作为量子处理器的跨平台基准
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24213v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A cross-platform benchmark should be device-independent yet sensitive to imperfections accumulated during execution. Building on prior work, we formulate and validate a protocol through demonstrations based on generalized Svetlichny inequality violations (a simulation, rather than a loophole-free certification, of multipartite nonlocality) for larger subsystem sizes. We apply it unchanged to three processors, the trapped-ion Marmot and IBEX Q1 (both manufactured by AQT) and the superconducting Euro-Q-Exa System 1 (IQM), using identical GHZ-state circuits with fixed theoretical measurement settings from N=2 to N=10 qubits. Both trapped-ion processors sustain violations up to ten qubits, while the superconducting processor loses them beyond six qubits under unmitigated (raw) conditions; readout-error mitigation recovers violations up to eight qubits, with a substantial fraction of the degradation attributable to measurement imperfections. These processors provide a heterogeneous testbed for validating the protocol's cross-platform applicability and discriminating power, demonstrating its practicality as a common framework for assessing collective quantum performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出并验证了一种基于广义Svetlichny不等式违背的跨平台基准协议，用于评估量子处理器的性能。该协议独立于具体设备，但对执行过程中累积的缺陷敏感。研究人员将该协议应用于离子阱和超导量子处理器，使用GHZ态电路从2到10个量子比特进行测试。结果显示，离子阱处理器能维持高达10个量子比特的违背，而超导处理器在未缓解条件下最多6个，经读出误差缓解后可达8个量子比特，证明了该协议的普适性和鉴别能力。
authors: Andrés Camilo Granda Arango, Giuseppe Sergioli, Luigi Iapichino, Tobias Valentin Bauer, Carlo Cuccu, Roberto Giuntini

articles.title: Quantum-Classical Iterative Refinement for the Pressure-Poisson Equation on NISQ Hardware
articles.title_zh: NISQ硬件上压力-泊松方程的量子-经典迭代细化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24342v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a hybrid quantum-classical iterative refinement for the pressure-Poisson equation of the incompressible Navier-Stokes projection method on noisy quantum hardware. Rather than solving the pressure equation once per time step, we solve it repeatedly for the normalized residual and scale each quantum direction by a least-squares fit to the physical residual. As a result, the error of the quantum solve enters as a contraction factor sinθₖ of the residual rather than as an error floor. This removes the requirement of a state infidelity below 10⁻⁷ that was estimated for single-solve schemes. With a boundary-consistent staggered (MAC) discretization, the pressure residual equals the velocity divergence left after projection up to the factor Δ t/h̊o. On the IBM processor ibm_cleveland, a four-qubit (16×16) problem reached a relative residual below 10⁻⁷ within eight to ten corrections in all 20 runs of a pre-registered experiment, whereas a single solve with a comparable number of shots stopped at 0.33-0.59. In a six-qubit (64×64) pilot, all three runs reached the same tolerance in 13 corrections. On the IonQ Forte processor, a manufactured-solution benchmark reached 5.6×10⁻⁸ in nine corrections, with a pressure error of 4.9×10⁻⁸. Finally, we carried out the variational training itself on ibm_cleveland, so that every sampled value of the cost function was obtained from hardware measurements. The residual fell to 5.6×10⁻⁴ in seven corrections, below the pre-specified tolerance of 10⁻³, at the rate predicted by a noise model and with 24 min of QPU time.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种混合量子-经典迭代细化方法，用于在NISQ硬件上求解不可压缩Navier-Stokes投影法中的压力-泊松方程。该方法通过重复求解归一化残差，并利用最小二乘拟合对每个量子方向进行缩放，从而将量子求解的误差转化为残差的收缩因子，消除了对状态失真度低于10⁻⁷的要求。在IBM ibm_cleveland处理器上，一个4量子比特问题在8-10次修正内达到了低于10⁻⁷的相对残差，在IonQ Forte处理器上，一个6量子比特问题在13次修正内达到了相同容差。
authors: Doyeol "David" Ahn (Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, University of Seoul, Seoul, Republic of Korea 2 Singularity Quantum Inc., Newport Beach, CA, USA 3 Center for Quantum Information Processing, University of Seoul, Seoul, Republic of Korea 4 School of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, Gyeongsang National University, Jinju, Republic of Korea 5 National Quantum Laboratory at Maryland), Byeongyong Park, Rho Shin Myong, Franz Klein

articles.title: FTWeave: Composing Logical Execution, Real-Time Decoding, and Magic-State Supply in Tightly Integrated Quantum-Classical Systems
articles.title_zh: FTWeave：在紧密集成量子-经典系统中组合逻辑执行、实时解码和魔术态供应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24344v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum applications depend on both decoded measurement information and a continuing supply of magic states. While an operation waits for either, its logical data require protection that produces more syndrome data and decoding work. Architects must provision the quantum and classical parts of the machine together, before complete systems are available to measure. FTWeave is a system-level simulator for this architectural exploration. It accepts OpenQASM 2/3 circuits, CUDA-Q Logical compiler artifacts, Stim circuits, and provider-derived physical inputs through adapters that preserve operation and measurement dependencies. Users bind these inputs to quantum resources, classical processors, memory, communication, and factory configurations. One event timeline determines application progress, resource ownership, and continuing protection. This supplies the system model needed to connect circuit and decoder evidence to application performance. Controlled demand studies and complete multiplier and Ising circuits show why the coupling changes provisioning decisions. A fixed-work approximation predicts a 3.55x multiplier speedup from additional factories where the coupled model gives almost none. Explicit ownership also changes useful capacity: increasing decoder workers alone has no benefit in a storage-constrained case, while increasing workers and feedback entries together gives 4.93x speedup. Selected color and hypergraph-product code mappings take 53-90% longer under decoder service variability, despite an unchanged mean. These comparisons identify useful resource combinations and distinguish protection work from the elapsed lifetime of quantum data.
articles.abstract_zh: 容错量子应用依赖于解码测量信息和持续的魔术态供应。FTWeave是一个系统级模拟器，用于容错量子应用的架构探索，它将逻辑执行、实时解码和魔术态供应紧密集成。该模拟器接受多种电路输入，并将其绑定到量子和经典资源，通过单一事件时间线确定应用进展和资源所有权。需求研究表明，这种紧密耦合改变了资源配置决策，固定工作量近似预测乘法器速度提升3.55倍。
authors: Panayiotis Christou, Shuwen Kan, Ying Mao

articles.title: Prototype-Guided Optimization of Quantum Data Embeddings with Linear Cost
articles.title_zh: 线性成本下原型引导的量子数据嵌入优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24403v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In supervised quantum machine learning with classical data, classification performance critically depends on the geometry induced by quantum data embedding. Existing data-adaptive approaches rely on pairwise fidelity evaluations between samples, which scale as O(B²⁾ for B samples and create a computational bottleneck in iterative embedding optimization. To address this issue, we propose a prototype-guided framework for efficient data-adaptive quantum embedding. Using class-prototype separation and sample-to-prototype compactness, we derive a measurable lower certificate for class-ensemble distinguishability and construct a prototype-based objective requiring only O(B) fidelity evaluations. We integrate this objective into an end-to-end pipeline that combines task-specific quantum circuit architecture optimization with continuous refinement of the data-embedding parameters. Across five benchmark datasets with up to 20 qubits, our method retains competitive quantum kernel support vector machine (SVM) performance while reducing fidelity-evaluation cost, with particularly strong gains over budget-matched pairwise optimization on T-MNIST. Geometric analyses examine how the learned embeddings relate to kernel alignment and classification margins, revealing dataset-dependent benefits and limitations. We further derive a prototype-based classifier in the reproducing kernel Hilbert space that provides an explicit witness for the SVM objective and a low-cost proxy for model selection, and extend the framework to multiple prototypes for multimodal class structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 在监督量子机器学习中，数据嵌入的几何结构对分类性能至关重要，但现有数据自适应方法存在O(B²)的计算瓶颈。本文提出了一种原型引导框架，将保真度评估成本降至O(B)。该方法利用类别原型分离和样本到原型的紧凑性，推导了类别集合可区分性的可测量下界，并将其整合到端到端优化流程中。在多达20个量子比特的五个基准数据集上，该方法在保持竞争性量子核支持向量机（QK-SVM）性能的同时，显著降低了保真度评估成本。
authors: Seokhoon Jeong, Daniel K. Park

articles.title: Margin-Based Generalization for Quantum Machine Learning with Classical Data Encoding
articles.title_zh: 经典数据编码下量子机器学习的基于裕度的泛化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24426v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding generalization is essential for assessing the practical viability of quantum machine learning. In many applications, quantum models operate on classical data that must first be encoded into quantum states, making the encoding part of the effective hypothesis class. We develop a margin-based generalization framework for this setting, covering both fixed and trainable quantum data encodings. For fixed encodings, the existing margin bound transfers unchanged. For trainable encodings, we derive a bound using a two-scale covering argument that combines the original margin-dependent term with an additive encoding-capacity term of order tilde O(sqrtL/m), where L is the number of trainable encoding parameters and m is the training-sample size. Across 19,440 simulated training runs spanning various image datasets, circuit architectures, and optimization settings, the inverse margin performs best among five baseline and two bound-derived complexity measures under conditional-independence and 90th-percentile sign-error criteria, within bootstrap uncertainty. These results provide a unified margin-based view of generalization in quantum machine learning with classical data.
articles.abstract_zh: 理解泛化能力对于评估量子机器学习的实际可行性至关重要。本文为经典数据编码的量子机器学习开发了一个基于裕度的泛化框架，涵盖了固定和可训练的量子数据编码。对于可训练编码，推导出的界限包含一个附加的编码容量项。在19,440次模拟训练中，逆裕度在多种复杂性度量中表现最佳，为量子机器学习的泛化提供了一个统一的基于裕度的视角。
authors: Ju-Young Ryu, Tak Hur, Daniel K. Park

articles.title: Quantum-Correlation-Based Multi-Emitter Localization in Information-Limited Regimes via Learned Inference
articles.title_zh: 基于量子关联的受限信息域多发射器定位：通过学习推理实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24457v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum correlation measurements have emerged as a powerful tool for localizing multiple emitters with subwavelength separation. Multi-emitter localization consists of two distinct tasks: identifying the emitter count N and estimating their positions łeftxⁱi̊ght. Existing fit-and-select frameworks fit the measured intensity and autocorrelation data using several models corresponding to different values of N and then select the best-supported model. This procedure lets errors from the multi-parameter optimization of emitter positions propagate into the choice of model, degrading performance under photon-limited and high-background conditions. We propose a method that directly infers the emitter count and positions from the multimodal data via learned inference. Learned inference improves both the emitter-counting accuracy and localization precision compared to the fit-and-select method. It achieves more than tenfold improvement in precision and requires up to five times fewer photons to achieve practically meaningful localization with the largest gains observed under low photon counts, strong background, narrowly spaced emitter configurations, and spatially truncated data. This photon-efficient quantum-assisted localization framework offers a promising route toward real-time biological imaging and single-particle tracking in densely labeled samples.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子关联测量已成为亚波长分离多发射器定位的强大工具。现有方法在光子受限和高背景条件下性能下降。本文提出了一种通过学习推理直接从多模态数据中推断发射器数量和位置的方法。该方法显著提高了发射器计数精度和定位精度，与传统方法相比，定位精度提高了十倍以上，所需光子数量减少了五倍。
authors: Sanket K. Tripathy, Simeon I. Bogdanov

articles.title: Local response theory of multiparameter sudden-quench quantum Otto engines
articles.title_zh: 多参数骤冷量子奥托发动机的局域响应理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24482v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multiparameter quantum Otto engines raise an optimization problem absent in single-parameter cycles: which small quench vector maximizes the quadratic approximation to the exact output work in a multidimensional control space? We develop a local response theory for sudden-quench Otto engines with quantum working media described by linearly controlled Hamiltonians. We show that the local quadratic work decomposes into a thermal-bias gain and a quadratic response cost, whose competition determines the quench vector that maximizes the local quadratic work at a prescribed quench amplitude. We illustrate the theory in a minimal two-level working medium, where radial and transverse quenches play distinct roles, and in a finite interacting XYZ spin chain, where the resulting quench vector is determined by the balance between thermal-bias and response cost. Our results provide a practical local criterion for designing small multiparameter quenches in sudden-quench quantum Otto engines.
articles.abstract_zh: 多参数量子奥托发动机提出了一个优化问题，即在多维控制空间中，哪个小的骤冷向量能最大化精确输出功的二次近似。本文为具有线性控制哈密顿量的量子工作介质的骤冷奥托发动机开发了一种局域响应理论。研究表明，局域二次功分解为热偏置增益和二次响应成本，它们的竞争决定了最大化局域二次功的骤冷向量。该理论为设计骤冷量子奥托发动机中的小多参数骤冷提供了实用的局域判据。
authors: Dehua Liu, Yihang Cai, Biao Xiong, Jibing Liu, Chuanjia Shan, Jianhui Wang

articles.title: Logical-Space Theory of Ordered-Statistics Decoding for Quantum LDPC Codes
articles.title_zh: 量子LDPC码有序统计解码的逻辑空间理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24503v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum decoding succeeds when a correction matches the logical class of the error, whereas ordered-statistics decoding (OSD) searches a finite list of physical corrections. We connect these spaces through a rank-k logical-signature map Mₘ̊ ₗₒg:mathbb F₂^q→mathbb F₂^k. For fixed, error-independent orderings it yields the exact logical-signature distribution, the OSD-0 logical error rate, and the logical-class coverage of any fixed list. For minimum-cost list decoding we prove P_L=Pₘ̊ ₘᵢₛₛ+Pₘ̊ ₛₑₗ, separating absent-class from wrong-selection failures. Hypergraph-product and bivariate-bicycle codes are consistent with the coverage predictions. On the [![144,12,12]!] gross code, 672 coverage-aware candidates outperform 899 combination-sweep candidates (paired McNemar p=0.013), while two lists with identical logical coverage give P_L=11.30% and 3.78%; the signature-based coverage compression persists across 30 random column orderings. Logical coverage and within-class representative selection are therefore complementary resources that candidate count alone does not capture. The framework guides OSD list construction and compression by identifying coverage requirements and distinguishing coverage losses from failures of representative selection.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子解码的成功取决于纠正与错误的逻辑类别匹配，而有序统计解码（OSD）则搜索有限的物理纠正列表。本文通过一个秩-k逻辑签名映射连接了这些空间，并推导了精确的逻辑签名分布和OSD-0逻辑错误率。研究表明，逻辑覆盖率和类内代表选择是互补的资源，仅凭候选数量无法完全捕捉。该框架为OSD列表的构建和压缩提供了指导。
authors: Yun Shang

articles.title: Exact Quantum Query Complexity of the Five-Bit Symmetric Boolean Function Exact⁵₃,₄
articles.title_zh: 五比特对称布尔函数Exact⁵₃,₄的精确量子查询复杂度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24518v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Let (f = EXACT⁵₃,₄) be the Boolean function that equals 1 exactly on inputs of Hamming weight 3 or 4. Earlier numerical studies reported success probabilities close to one using three queries, but the existence of an exact three-query algorithm had remained unresolved. This paper settles this problem by proving that the exact quantum query complexity of (f) is (4). For the lower bound, we express every three-query algorithm through layer-by-layer Gram matrices of low-degree Fourier coefficients. We then construct a fixed rational dual certificate whose slack matrices are all positive definite. This certificate separates the necessary Gram-matrix region from the exact-output condition and therefore rules out every exact algorithm using at most three queries in the stated model. The positivity verification reduces to five small rational matrices and Sylvester's criterion. For the upper bound, we invoke the previously known four-query algorithm for the seven-bit function (EXACT⁷₃,₄) and apply the standard padding reduction. To quantify the near-exact behavior, we use the same certificate to derive a valid, though not claimed tight, lower bound (frac2560043779488192449>0) on the worst-case error of every algorithm using at most three queries. This positive error gap is compatible with the near-unit success probabilities reported in earlier numerical studies, which do not establish exact computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文解决了五比特对称布尔函数Exact⁵₃,₄的精确量子查询复杂度问题，证明其为4。通过构建一个固定的有理对偶证书，排除了所有使用至多三次查询的精确算法，从而确立了下界。对于上界，则通过应用已知的四次查询算法和标准填充归约实现。
authors: Guoliang Xu, Haoran Zhang, Mengfan Wu, Songyao Xue, Mingke Liu

articles.title: Concatenated continuous-drive protection of exchange-based spin-qubit gates
articles.title_zh: 交换基自旋量子比特门的级联连续驱动保护
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24582v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exchange-based two-qubit gates in semiconductor spin qubits are sensitive to low-frequency detuning noise and control errors. Here, we extend concatenated continuous driving (CCD), implemented by phase modulation of a global microwave drive, to exchange-based SWAP and sqrtSWAP operations between double-dressed spin qubits and investigate its effectiveness for protecting two-qubit gates. We find that CCD retains strong protection against quasistatic common-mode detuning errors while substantially improving robustness against Rabi-frequency errors and qubit-to-qubit Rabi-frequency mismatch compared with conventional continuous dressing. By contrast, the gate fidelity is impacted by differential detuning errors. By modeling partially correlated quasistatic detuning noise, we further show that the noise-averaged gate fidelity depends strongly on the spatial correlation of the qubit-frequency fluctuations, with positive correlations enhancing CCD protection by suppressing the differential-noise component. These results identify the symmetry and spatial correlation of qubit-frequency noise as key factors governing continuous-drive protection in coupled spin-qubit systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 半导体自旋量子比特中的交换基两量子比特门对低频失谐噪声和控制误差敏感。本文将级联连续驱动（CCD）扩展到双态自旋量子比特之间的交换基SWAP和sqrtSWAP操作，并研究其保护两量子比特门的有效性。研究发现，CCD在保持对准静态共模失谐误差的强大保护的同时，显著提高了对拉比频率误差和量子比特间拉比频率失配的鲁棒性。结果表明，量子比特频率噪声的对称性和空间相关性是连续驱动保护的关键因素。
authors: Takuma Kuno, Takeru Utsugi, Andrew J. Ramsay, Hideo Arimoto, Tetsuo Kodera, Hiroyuki Mizuno

articles.title: Collective Strong Quantum Mpemba Effect in Accelerated Quantum Detectors
articles.title_zh: 加速量子探测器中的集体强量子Mpemba效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24658v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Collective coupling to the Minkowski vacuum allows uniformly accelerated quantum detectors to exhibit a strong quantum Mpemba effect, in which a state initially farther from equilibrium relaxes faster than a closer one. We establish the existence of this effect for every fixed finite number of detectors N≥ 2 at sufficiently small transverse separation within the pointlike secular master equation. The mechanism originates from two reflection sectors whose populations are conserved by the leading collective dynamics. Weak intersector transfer at finite separation generates an isolated, parametrically slow relaxation mode. A simple family of initial states permits its leading-order cancellation by matching the equilibrium sector populations, while a corrected preparation eliminates the slow-mode amplitude exactly. We construct a reference state that establishes a genuine reversal of trace-distance ordering. Numerical calculations and local-rate-preserving controls identify the collective origin of the effect, while spatially smeared detector calculations support its persistence within the second-order secular framework. The same mechanism extends to detectors coupled to a common thermal field, with analytically distinct slow relaxation rates. Thus, strong Mpemba relaxation is not exclusive to acceleration but emerges from a more general interplay between collective dissipation, reflection-sector conservation, and weak symmetry-breaking transfer.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了均匀加速量子探测器中集体强量子Mpemba效应的存在性，即初始状态离平衡态越远，弛豫速度越快。该效应源于两个反射扇区，其布居数由主导的集体动力学守恒。通过数值计算和局部速率保持控制，确定了该效应的集体起源，并支持其在二阶长期框架内的持续存在。
authors: G. D. de Moraes Neto, Richard Q. Matos, Norton G. de Almeida

articles.title: Adiabatic controlled-Z gate for neutral atoms with Förster-enhanced Rydberg dressing
articles.title_zh: 基于Förster增强里德堡修饰的中性原子绝热受控Z门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24755v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study an adiabatic controlled-Z (CZ) gate for neutral atoms in which dipole-dipole coupling between nearly degenerate Rydberg pair states enhances the interaction between dressed ground states. This coupling produces an avoided crossing in the two-atom dressed-state spectrum. Approaching the crossing enhances the dressed interaction, but also reduces the dressed-state gap and increases the Rydberg admixture. We identify a Förster-enhanced operating range in which the required conditional phase is accumulated with adiabatic return and small transient Rydberg population. We then analyze the finite-time dynamics of the two-qubit computational states under a smooth pulse. Reducing the dressing strength weakens the dressed interaction, so maintaining the target phase at the same pulse duration requires operation closer to the avoided crossing, where the Rydberg admixture increases. This dependence is then used to select the shortest gate at a fixed peak Rabi frequency in the Förster-enhanced operating range that accumulates the CZ phase with high Bell-state fidelity while keeping the Rydberg population small. Changing the Förster defect shifts the avoided crossing, while the gate parameters change only weakly. For a specific rubidium Förster channel, the selected gate corresponds to experimentally relevant laser coupling, pulse duration, and interatomic separation. We also estimate errors from the finite Rydberg lifetime and from weak excitation of a neighboring spectator atom. For the parameters considered, the spectator-induced error remains below the finite-lifetime contribution.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一种用于中性原子的绝热受控Z（CZ）门，其中近简并里德堡对态之间的偶极-偶极耦合增强了修饰基态之间的相互作用。这种耦合在双原子修饰态谱中产生了避免交叉，从而增强了修饰相互作用。研究确定了一个Förster增强的工作范围，在此范围内，可以在绝热返回和小瞬态里德堡布居数的情况下积累所需的条件相位，并分析了有限时间动力学。
authors: Diksha Thapliyal, Ajay Wasan

articles.title: Where should we look for the deviation from quantum mechanics?
articles.title_zh: 我们应该在哪里寻找量子力学的偏差？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24857v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We argue that the experimental measurement of the lifetime and decay law of metastable helium is a promising way to find a deviation from quantum mechanics. We analyze the decay of the metastable state for a quartic deformation of quantum mechanics. We find that the absolute change of the mean lifetime can be significant even if the modification is small. We show that, in the Wigner--Weisskopf approximation, the deviation from the exponential law in the modified theory can occur on time scales comparable with the lifetime.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文认为，实验测量亚稳态氦的寿命和衰变规律是寻找量子力学偏差的一种有前景的方法。研究分析了量子力学四次形变下亚稳态的衰变，发现即使修改很小，平均寿命的绝对变化也可能很显著。在Wigner-Weisskopf近似下，修正理论中与指数定律的偏差可能发生在与寿命相当的时间尺度上。
authors: Jerome Nicolas, Albert Schwarz

articles.title: On the Complexity of Level-Synchronized Tree Automata for Quantum Circuit Verification
articles.title_zh: 量子电路验证中层同步树自动机的复杂度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25138v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reliable quantum computation requires methods for verifying quantum circuits. Level-synchronized tree automata (LSTAs) were recently introduced to represent sets of quantum states for this purpose. We study LSTAs along two axes relevant to verification: the complexity of their decision problems and the size of their representations under circuit operations. We prove that acyclic LSTAs have NP-complete nonemptiness and Π₂^P-complete language inclusion, and that general language inclusion is EXPSPACE-complete. We further prove inherent quadratic representation growth under individual quantum gates in a fixed qubit order, and give an adjacent-qubit reordering construction that preserves level synchronization. These results clarify the scope of applicability of the automata-theoretic toolbox for quantum circuit verification.
articles.abstract_zh: 可靠的量子计算需要验证量子电路的方法。本文研究了用于表示量子态集合的层同步树自动机（LSTA）的决策问题复杂性和在电路操作下的表示大小。研究证明了非循环LSTA的非空性是NP完全的，语言包含是Π₂^P完全的，而通用语言包含是EXPSPACE完全的。这些结果阐明了自动机理论工具箱在量子电路验证中的适用范围。
authors: Michael Blondin, Samy Chady Khoumsi-Kasmi, Guillermo A. Pérez, Marnix Suilen

articles.title: Exact probability laws of random inner products: Dirichlet splines, overlaps, uncertainty, and Bargmann invariants
articles.title_zh: 随机内积的精确概率定律：Dirichlet样条、重叠、不确定性和Bargmann不变量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25196v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Inner products of random matrices and random quantum states---such as orbital inner products, expectation values, overlaps, and cyclic Bargmann invariants---are shown to follow from two underlying mechanisms: the diagonal of an induced random state is Dirichlet distributed, and the expectation value of a random pure state in a rank-one or two-by-two operator is a numerical shadow on an elliptical disk. For states induced by an environment of dimension K, the expectation value of any observable is a Curry--Schoenberg spline with each eigenvalue repeated K times, and the vector of moments has an explicit density on a simplex; for a qutrit, the variance law is obtained in finite form.
