The overlap of two random qubit states attains its mode at its mean for every rotation-invariant ensemble, but for Hilbert--Schmidt qutrits the density at the mean has a strictly negative derivative, so mode and mean separate; for large environments, the centred overlap converges to a variance-gamma law rather than a Gaussian. For two noncommuting qubit observables, the joint law of the two standard deviations is derived for all K, and the probability of coming within a small distance of the optimal sum of variances scales as a power of that distance, with a different exponent when the Bloch axes are orthogonal. For three Haar-random qubit states, the exact density of the Bargmann invariant is given in terms of a complete elliptic integral, together with its local behaviour and elementary marginals. In every dimension, the probability that its real part is negative---certifying basis-independent coherence---is computed, along with all mixed moments. For cycles of arbitrary length, the invariant is shown to be driven by an exact three-parameter Markov chain, and the logarithm of its modulus obeys a law of large numbers and a central limit theorem.
articles.abstract_zh: 随机矩阵和随机量子态的内积，如轨道内积、期望值、重叠和循环Bargmann不变量，遵循两个基本机制。对于由K维环境诱导的状态，任何可观测量的期望值都是一个Curry-Schoenberg样条。研究还发现，对于旋转不变系综，两个随机量子比特态的重叠在其均值处达到众数，但对于Hilbert-Schmidt三比特，众数和均值分离。
authors: Lin Zhang

articles.title: Simulation-Based Quantum Forensics for QKD: Machine Learning Attack Detection and Signature Extraction
articles.title_zh: 基于仿真的QKD量子取证：机器学习攻击检测与特征提取
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25203v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) supports secure key establishment under ideal protocol assumptions, but practical systems remain exposed to implementation-level attacks against optical channels, detectors, and controller behavior. This study presents Quantum Forensic Log (QF-LOG), a simulation-based forensic framework for analyzing aggregated QKD operational logs rather than raw quantum states. QF-LOG uses four observable features: quantum bit error rate (QBER), photon count, latency in milliseconds, and abort flag. The framework classifies normal operation and three simulated attack-related conditions: partial intercept-resend, detector-blind, and fiber-tap. A physics-inspired Generator-A dataset with 5 million balanced records was constructed using explicit mathematical generation models for all four features. A transparent threshold baseline, logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost were evaluated on Generator-A. The full-feature learning models achieved macro F1-scores from 0.8211 to 0.8243 and outperformed the transparent two-feature comparator. Feature diagnostics showed that QBER contributed most, followed by latency in milliseconds and photon count, while no single feature reproduced the full feature set performance. Robustness was assessed on a separately generated Generator-B dataset of 5 million records that uses the same governing equations under shifted simulated operating parameters. Without retraining or tuning, their macro F1-scores decreased to values from 0.5645 to 0.5669. These findings show that QF-LOG can support interpretable forensic classification in a controlled synthetic setting, but stable internal evaluation does not establish reliability under changed simulated QKD operating conditions. The framework provides a documented basis for future evaluation across broader simulated settings and hardware-generated QKD logs.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子密钥分发（QKD）在理想协议假设下支持安全密钥建立，但实际系统仍面临实现层面的攻击。本文提出了QF-LOG，一个基于仿真的取证框架，用于分析聚合的QKD操作日志。该框架利用量子比特错误率（QBER）、光子计数、延迟和中止标志等四个可观测特征，对正常操作和三种模拟攻击条件进行分类。机器学习模型在所构建的数据集上取得了良好的性能，其中QBER贡献最大。
authors: Madhab Chandra Das, Sajid Ahmed, Uzair Hussain, Van Vung Pham

articles.title: LiftDiff: Guided Discrete Diffusion for Quantum Code Construction
articles.title_zh: LiftDiff：用于量子码构造的引导式离散扩散模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25213v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The realization of fault-tolerant quantum computation relies on Quantum Error-Correcting Codes (QECC). Of particular interest are codes that combine a high encoding rate with sufficient distance. Existing algebraic constructions, such as lifted product (LP) codes, build a large quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) code from a classical base matrix. In this work we introduce LiftDiff, a generative approach to the discovery of QECC. A discrete denoising diffusion model is trained to generate base matrices over the group algebra F₂[Zₑₗₗ], which are then expanded into LP codes. The reverse diffusion process is guided by an energy function that evaluates quantum code properties, including girth, degree, sparsity and decoding performance, steering the sampler toward matrices that yield LP codes with favorable parameters. Our method discovers codes with parameters such as [[169,13,11]], [[143,15,9]], and [[260,24,10]], including a [[247,19,14]] code that achieves the highest kd²/n among the baselines. Moreover, several discovered codes outperform the Gross code across a broad range of the tested physical error rates under both code-capacity and circuit-level noise.
articles.abstract_zh: 容错量子计算的实现依赖于量子纠错码（QECC）。本文引入了LiftDiff，一种用于发现QECC的生成方法。该方法训练一个离散去噪扩散模型来生成基矩阵，然后将其扩展为提升积（LP）码。逆向扩散过程由评估量子码属性的能量函数引导，从而生成具有良好参数的LP码。该方法发现了一些性能优于现有基线的量子码。
authors: Yotam Peled, Eliya Nachmani

articles.title: Fully quantum fidelity-based entropic continuity bounds
articles.title_zh: 基于全量子保真度的熵连续性界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25299v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a continuity bound for quantum conditional entropies in terms of fidelity, with no dependence on the dimension of the conditioning system. Our results encompass both the von Neumann entropy and one version of sandwiched Rényi entropy, which is particularly relevant for applications in quantum key distribution (QKD). In such applications, this bound should provide improved results as compared to previous continuity bounds based on trace distance. We also show that the bounds can be sharpened as expected for classical-quantum states, and verify that they hold when the conditioning system has countably infinite dimension. Finally, we present several variants tailored for exponential functions of the Rényi entropies instead, which should be relevant for QKD applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个基于保真度的量子条件熵连续性界限，该界限不依赖于条件系统的维度。研究结果涵盖了冯诺依曼熵和夹心Rényi熵的一种形式，后者在量子密钥分发（QKD）应用中尤为重要。与之前基于迹距离的连续性界限相比，该界限有望在QKD应用中提供更优的结果。此外，研究还展示了这些界限在经典-量子态下可以被收紧，并验证了其在条件系统具有可数无限维度时依然成立。
authors: Matthew Simon Tan, Ernest Y. -Z. Tan

articles.title: Exact quantum Hamming-weight computation at optimal depth and minimum width
articles.title_zh: 最佳深度和最小宽度下的精确量子汉明权重计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25315v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hamming-weight computation and symmetric Boolean functions are basic primitives for quantum arithmetic and state preparation, where circuit depth and qubit overhead matter. We construct an exact circuit computing the Hamming weight of an n-qubit register with depth O(łog n) and size O(nłog n), using only the n input qubits and m=łceilłog₂₍ₙ₊₁₎c̊eil binary output qubits. The circuit uses arbitrary one-qubit gates and CNOTs with all-to-all connectivity. Both depth and total width are optimal. Our constructions combine tree structures and pipelining, temporarily using input qubits as workspace. We also give exact circuits for every symmetric Boolean function with the same depth and size bounds, using only m ancillary qubits returned to zero. Finally, we apply the counter to exact preparation of balanced Dicke states for even n. With only O(łog n) ancillary qubits, we obtain expected depth O(łog² n) using measurements and classical feedforward, and depth O(n¹/⁴łog n) using unitary gates alone.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个精确计算n量子比特寄存器汉明权重的量子电路，其深度为O(log n)，大小为O(n log n)，仅使用n个输入量子比特和m个二进制输出量子比特。该电路利用树形结构和流水线技术，实现了最佳的深度和总宽度。研究还给出了具有相同深度和大小界限的对称布尔函数的精确电路。最后，该计数器被应用于偶数n的平衡Dicke态的精确制备。
authors: Wei Zi, Pei Yuan, Junhong Nie

articles.title: Squeezing and Decoherence of Axion Dark Matter
articles.title_zh: 轴子暗物质的挤压与退相干
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25466v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bosonic particles beyond the Standard Model, such as axions, are among the leading candidates for dark matter. If such particles have a small mass, they are usually described as a purely classical field. However, it was recently shown that this description is incomplete: their inherent gravitational self-interactions can squeeze the field, producing a quantum feature beyond the classical description. Here we analyze squeezing of light dark matter in the presence of decoherence. We show that squeezing is continuously generated, and rapidly enough to survive dissipation, and may also remain present under thermal fluctuations and dephasing. Our results demonstrate that dark matter might possess persistent quantum features and motivate further investigation of their implications for dark matter detection.
articles.abstract_zh: 轴子等玻色子粒子是暗物质的主要候选者之一。本文分析了在退相干存在下轻暗物质的挤压现象。研究表明，挤压效应是持续产生的，并且速度足够快以抵抗耗散，甚至在热涨落和退相干下也能保持存在。这些结果表明暗物质可能具有持久的量子特性，并为进一步探索其对暗物质探测的影响提供了动力。
authors: Vasileios Fragkos, Igor Pikovski

articles.title: Randomness Certification from Statistically Hiding Commitments
articles.title_zh: 基于统计隐藏承诺的随机性认证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25518v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Randomness certification aims to guarantee that the output of an untrusted quantum device contains genuine randomness that remains unpredictable even given quantum side information held by an adversary. For a classical verifier interacting with a single quantum device, such a guarantee cannot rely on the physical separation underlying standard Bell tests and must instead follow from computational restrictions on the prover. Building on the framework of Computational Bell Inequalities, we distinguish classical and quantum virtual-input hiding, showing that the former suffices for proofs of quantumness, whereas the latter enables randomness certification against quantum side information. Our main technical contribution is to establish quantum virtual-input hiding for a commitment-based protocol derived from the proof of quantumness from one-way-functions by Morimae and Yamakawa. We show that statistical hiding together with ordinary computational binding against quantum polynomial-time senders suffices, without requiring stronger quantum binding notions such as sum-binding or collapse-binding. This yields a randomness-certification protocol from post-quantum statistically hiding bit commitments. In particular, existing constructions of such commitments from post-quantum one-way permutations imply that post-quantum one-way permutations suffice for randomness certification. We further instantiate our construction using quantum-secure trapdoor claw-free functions, obtaining an efficient classical verifier, and in the quantum random oracle model, obtaining randomness certification without additional computational assumptions but with an inefficient verifier. These instantiations separate the cryptographic properties sufficient for randomness certification from the additional structure required for efficient verification within our commitment-based framework.
articles.abstract_zh: 随机性认证旨在确保不可信量子设备的输出包含真实的随机性，即使在对手拥有量子侧信息的情况下也无法预测。本文在计算贝尔不等式框架的基础上，区分了经典和量子虚拟输入隐藏。研究的主要技术贡献是为Morimae和Yamakawa基于单向函数的量子性证明协议建立了量子虚拟输入隐藏。结果表明，统计隐藏与针对量子多项式时间发送者的普通计算绑定相结合就足以实现随机性认证，而无需更强的量子绑定概念。
authors: Ilya Merkulov, Rotem Arnon

articles.title: Quantum State Search with Classical Interactive Advice
articles.title_zh: 带有经典交互建议的量子态搜索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25657v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study whether a quantum verifier can find a hidden quantum state by exchanging classical messages with an unbounded prover who knows the state. The verifier has access to a reflection oracle about the target. For a Haar-random n-qubit target, we prove that achieving constant average fidelity with the target requires (q+1)²⁽B+1)=Ømega(2ⁿ⁾, where q is the number of verifier queries and B is the total prover-to-verifier communication. The bound allows arbitrary classical interaction and unrestricted computation between queries. Our proof extends the lower bound of Aaronson and Kuperberg from a single classical proof to an arbitrary classical interaction. As a result, we obtain a quantum-oracle separation of UniqueQMA from QCIP with polynomially many classical messages. In particular, we give a unitary oracle U such that there exists a language LinUniqueQMAU but LnotinQCIPU. We further give an oracle construction for a notion known as QMA-QCIP[2] gap problem. This gives average case hardness for a QMA language under classical access to a QCIP[2] decision oracle and is used in establishing negative results on witness encryption and quantum indistinguishability obfuscation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了量子验证者是否可以通过与知道隐藏量子态的无界证明者交换经典消息来找到该量子态。研究证明，对于一个Haar随机的n量子比特目标，实现与目标恒定平均保真度需要大量的验证者查询和证明者到验证者的通信。该证明将Aaronson和Kuperberg的下界从单个经典证明扩展到任意经典交互。结果表明，在多项式数量的经典消息下，UniqueQMA与QCIP之间存在量子谕示分离。
authors: Mohammed Barhoush

articles.title: Distributed Phase Tags: A Locality-Preserving Realification Compiler for Misty-State Quantum Programs
articles.title_zh: 分布式相位标签：一种用于迷雾态量子程序的局域性保持实化编译器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25703v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Complex amplitudes can be simulated over real Hilbert spaces by adjoining a two-dimensional real/imaginary degree of freedom. In a multipartite program, however, one globally shared phase tag is not a locality-preserving program transformation: every party would have to act on the same auxiliary system. We recast the distributed real simulation of multipartite quantum mechanics as a syntax-directed compiler into a real misty-state intermediate language. For n parties we give explicit phase-reference codewords |0ångleP_ₙ and |1ångleP_ₙ on n local tags and prove that the same real operator J=XZ on any single tag realizes the logical action of multiplication by i. If a complex party-local gate is A=A_R+iA_I, its real translation is [ widehat Aⱼ₌A_Røtimes I+A_Iøtimes Jⱼ, ] which acts only on party j's data and local phase tag. We prove an intertwining theorem for arbitrary finite party-local pure-state circuits, exact preservation of computational-basis measurement probabilities, preservation of the run-time interaction graph, and one-rebit-per-party overhead. For the canonical three-party GHZ program, the translation lies entirely inside the ordinary black-and-white misty gate fragment: controlled-J replaces the complex phase operation, while the invariant JⱼJₖ|0ångle_P=-|0ångle_P transfers the required branch sign. This yields a short correctness proof for all four promised GHZ inputs and explains the earlier 64-path cancellation calculation at a single logical phase-code boundary. We distinguish this program realification problem from the weaker task of finding any real strategy with the same correlations, and state precisely which parts are known real-Hilbert-space simulation and which parts belong to the misty-language compilation layer developed here.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将多方量子力学的分布式实数模拟重构为一个语法导向的编译器，将其转换为实数迷雾态中间语言。对于n个参与方，研究给出了n个局部标签上的显式相位参考码字，并证明了在任何单个标签上相同的实数算子J=XZ实现了乘以i的逻辑作用。该方法证明了任意有限方局部纯态电路的交织定理，精确保持了计算基测量概率，并保留了运行时交互图，且每方开销为一个实比特。
authors: Dan-Adrian German, Tony Newton

articles.title: Efficient Block Encodings for Ensembles of Molecular Hamiltonians
articles.title_zh: 分子哈密顿量集合的高效块编码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25968v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurately characterizing molecular properties and reactivity often requires electronic-structure calculations across an ensemble of molecular geometries. Quantum algorithms that process such ensembles coherently could address this challenge, but they require Hamiltonian block encoding circuits that combine advanced factorization techniques with sublinear scaling in ensemble size. Here, we introduce SVD-THC, which extends tensor hypercontraction to sets of Hamiltonians defined at different nuclear geometries through a singular value decomposition of the ensemble. We use SVD-THC to construct a single multiplexed block encoding circuit for all geometries in an ensemble. We then evaluate the approach on ensembles generated by varying internal rotational coordinates in 1-bromo-2-chloroethane as well as in glycine and alanine dipeptides, corresponding to established model systems for peptide conformational landscapes, with up to 5,184 geometries. Across several resolutions of the internal-coordinate grids, the Toffoli complexity of the resulting circuits grows only weakly with the number of geometries, changing by at most 12% over grids that differ in size by up to 576×. In an energy-thresholding circuit, this yields 35--200× fewer Toffoli gates than slicing together single-geometry block encodings. This approach could help make coherent processing of molecular geometry ensembles a useful primitive for fault-tolerant quantum computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 准确表征分子性质和反应性通常需要对分子几何结构集合进行电子结构计算。本文引入了SVD-THC方法，通过对集合进行奇异值分解，将张量超收缩扩展到在不同核几何结构下定义的哈密顿量集合。研究利用SVD-THC为集合中的所有几何结构构建了一个单一的多路复用块编码电路。该方法在多个内部坐标网格分辨率下，所得电路的Toffoli复杂度随几何结构数量的增长非常微弱。
authors: Cristian L. Cortes, Andrew J. Jenkins, William Pol, Dario Rocca, Mark Steudtner, Gian-Luca R. Anselmetti, Matthias Degroote, Nikolaj Moll, Raffaele Santagati, Michael Streif, Markus R. Hermann

articles.title: Conjugate measurement-induced evolution towards maximally mixed states in quadratic quantum systems
articles.title_zh: 二次量子系统中共轭测量诱导的向最大混合态演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25976v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In an earlier work, we showed that, in the interaction-dominant setting, coupling the conjugate variables of a subsystem to distinct environment modes drives the subsystem to a maximally mixed state. Here, we extend the study to the full quadratic dynamics of a single-mode subsystem coupled to a two-mode environment, and identify the phase-space mechanism responsible for the asymptotic behavior. By tracking the exact reduced Weyl characteristic and Wigner functions, we demonstrate that they lose their dependence on local phase-space coordinates on every fixed compact region. In free-particle model, this happens for all values of coupling, whereas in the harmonic oscillator model, it happens above a critical value of the coupling. Under a finite-volume and momentum regularization, this behavior corresponds to the reduced subsystem approaching a maximally mixed state.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将先前的研究扩展到单模子系统与双模环境耦合的完整二次动力学，并识别了导致渐近行为的相空间机制。通过追踪精确的约化Weyl特征函数和Wigner函数，研究表明它们在每个固定的紧致区域上失去了对局部相空间坐标的依赖性。在有限体积和动量正则化下，这种行为对应于约化子系统趋近于最大混合态。
authors: S. Adarsh, T. P. Sreeraj

articles.title: A Dual-Uplink Dual-Satellite Architecture for Entanglement Distribution
articles.title_zh: 一种用于纠缠分发的双上行双卫星架构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26034v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Satellite-based quantum links are a promising enabler of long-distance entanglement distribution, overcoming the exponential losses of optical fibers. In uplink architectures, entangled photons are generated at ground stations and transmitted to orbiting satellites, reducing space-segment complexity but introducing significant atmospheric and geometric losses. Single-satellite dual-uplink configurations are additionally limited by the requirement of simultaneous visibility between both ground stations and the satellite. In this work, we investigate a dual-uplink dual-satellite network architecture and compare its performance with the single-satellite scheme under identical physical assumptions. The proposed topology introduces an inter-satellite link (ISL) that decouples the ground-station separation from the atmospheric uplink geometry. A realistic channel model is employed, incorporating geometric attenuation, atmospheric turbulence, background noise, and Bell-state measurement efficiency. The overall success probability and practical fidelity are evaluated as functions of satellite altitude and ground-station separation. Our results show that while the single-satellite configuration is suitable for regional-scale networks, it becomes infeasible for large separations due to geometric constraints. The proposed dual-satellite architecture mitigates this limitation and significantly extends the achievable communication distance, representing a key step toward scalable quantum internet infrastructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 卫星量子链路是实现远距离纠缠分发的有前景技术。本文研究了一种双上行双卫星网络架构，并将其性能与单卫星方案在相同物理假设下进行了比较。所提出的拓扑结构引入了星间链路（ISL），将地面站间距与大气上行链路几何结构解耦。研究采用了包含几何衰减、大气湍流、背景噪声和贝尔态测量效率的现实信道模型，评估了总成功概率和实际保真度。
authors: Charilaos C. Angelidis, Ioannis K. Marmorkos

articles.title: Time-resolved transient absorption spectroscopy with quantum light
articles.title_zh: 基于量子光的瞬态吸收时间分辨光谱学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26041v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a fully quantum theory of time-resolved transient absorption spectroscopy, providing a general framework for describing the linear response of a nonequilibrium target to quantum probe fields beyond the semiclassical approximation. We elucidate how quantum correlations between probe-field frequency modes couple to coherences in the target and derive a simple expression for computing the resulting spectroscopic signals. We identify conditions under which quantum light can modify transient absorption spectra beyond the limits achievable with classical fields. Our work establishes a theoretical foundation for exploiting quantum light in ultrafast spectroscopy and suggests new routes for resolving dynamics in matter on timescales shorter than the duration of the probe pulse.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个完全量子的时间分辨瞬态吸收光谱学理论，为描述非平衡目标对量子探测场的线性响应提供了一个通用框架。研究阐明了探测场频率模式之间的量子关联如何与目标中的相干性耦合，并导出了计算所得光谱信号的简单表达式。该工作为在超快光谱学中利用量子光奠定了理论基础，并为在比探测脉冲持续时间更短的时间尺度上解析物质动力学提供了新途径。
authors: Mingrui Yuan, Nikolay V. Golubev

articles.title: HyQ-LC: Improving Light-Curve Classification with Hybrid Quantum--Classical Learning
articles.title_zh: HyQ-LC：利用混合量子-经典学习改进光变曲线分类
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26052v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Light curves reveal stellar variability and support studies of stellar evolution and cosmic distances. Reliable classification is therefore important for large time-domain surveys. We present HyQ-LC for ten-class stellar light-curve classification using 359 handcrafted features and 633,034 training objects. The main model combines a window multilayer perceptron (MLP) backbone with a nine-qubit readout using amplitude encoding and angle re-uploading. Both this hybrid and its pure-MLP control have 44,238 parameters. On a shared 20,000-object test set, the hybrid has macro-averaged F1 (Macro-F1) point gains of 0.8276 and 1.2393 percentage points over the pure MLP on two fine-tuning seeds. A separate fixed-fusion configuration achieves slightly higher Macro-F1 but lower accuracy than approximately budget-matched LightGBM. Its positive class-level differences are concentrated in CEP, RRC, and ROT, while the full-budget LightGBM reference scores higher on both metrics. All circuits are simulated classically. The comparisons retain existing validation-selected checkpoints and use the same test objects, with features, predictions, and recomputation code publicly available. The results identify point-estimate improvements over the tested controls while leaving the specific contribution of the quantum branch unresolved.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了HyQ-LC模型，用于十类恒星光变曲线分类，该模型结合了窗口多层感知器（MLP）骨干网络和使用振幅编码及角度重上传的九量子比特读出。在共享的20,000个对象测试集上，混合模型在宏平均F1分数上比纯MLP模型有显著提升。尽管所有电路都是经典模拟的，但研究结果表明混合量子-经典学习在光变曲线分类任务中具有潜力。
authors: Xinghang Yu, Bin Yang

articles.title: Enhanced charging in open Rabi and Dicke quantum batteries
articles.title_zh: 开放Rabi和Dicke量子电池中的增强充电
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26126v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate open-system charging protocols for Rabi and Dicke quantum batteries under direct incoherent pumping. The charging dynamics follows a Lindblad master equation, while effective non-Hermitian generators describe the conditioned no-jump mechanism. For a single Rabi battery, this pumping suppresses coherent energy backflow, broadens the high-energy charging window, and improves robustness against both timing errors and detuning. At the selected Rabi operating points, pumping also increases ergotropy and the extractable fraction of the stored energy. For finite Dicke batteries, direct incoherent pumping likewise stabilizes the charging dynamics. Across the finite-size scan, the strongest pump considered improves the peak stored energy and ergotropy per cell and near-peak timing robustness relative to the Hermitian reference. The maximum average charging power also increases, although this metric includes pump-assisted jump contributions. Equal-input comparisons show that the relative performance of common-cavity Dicke and independent Rabi batteries varies with the pump-input bound. Taken together, these results show that direct incoherent pumping provides a route to stabilized charging in Rabi and finite Dicke quantum batteries.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在直接非相干泵浦下Rabi和Dicke量子电池的开放系统充电协议。充电动力学遵循Lindblad主方程，而有效的非厄米生成器描述了条件无跳跃机制。对于单个Rabi电池，这种泵浦抑制了相干能量回流，拓宽了高能量充电窗口，并提高了对定时误差和失谐的鲁棒性。对于有限Dicke电池，直接非相干泵浦同样稳定了充电动力学，并提高了峰值存储能量和每个单元的可用功。
authors: A-Long Zhou, Nuo Xu, Ya-Wen Xiao, Li-Li Gao, Long-Jie Li, Zi-Min Li, Chuan-Cun Shu

articles.title: Quantum control as renormalization group flow
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26154v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Renormalization Group (RG) establishes relations between effective descriptions of physical systems at different scales; in Hamiltonian RG, these relations induce a flow in the space of Hamiltonians. In direct correspondence, we design an RG framework for quantum control by constructing a flow in the space of time-dependent Hamiltonians. A prescribed control subspace, selected to contain only experimentally accessible terms, forms the fixed-point manifold, while the flow preserves the target unitary and monotonically reduces the Hamiltonian weight outside this subspace. Exploiting the freedom in constructing the flow, we introduce flow-equation engineering to enhance the versatility of the framework for diverse control problems, including time-periodic and open-interval smooth protocols with prescribed endpoints. We provide two disparate applications to exhibit the utility of our approach: (i) Nonperturbative Floquet engineering beyond the regime of validity of high-frequency expansions, which we demonstrate by constructing an implementable time-periodic protocol for the Haldane model; (ii) Accessible fast-forward driving from unit-fidelity counterdiabatic evolution, which we showcase for large transverse-field Ising chains away from the adiabatic regime by compressing the long-range multibody adiabatic gauge potential into the original time-dependent Ising control schedules. Our control RG framework reveals a unifying perspective on Hamiltonian engineering and unitary quantum control, and can serve as an organizing principle behind seemingly disparate nonequilibrium quantum dynamics.
authors: Zuo Wang, Paul M. Schindler, Modesto Orozco-Ruiz, Nguyen H. Le, Florian Mintert, Marin Bukov

articles.title: A Readout-Aware Theory of Approximate Heisenberg Propagation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26222v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Classical methods for computing quantum expectation values often propagate observables in the Heisenberg picture. To remain tractable, these methods rely on approximations that discard operator components during evolution. Yet the magnitude of these components alone does not determine the resulting expectation-value error, which also depends on their subsequent evolution and the input state. We develop emphgeneralized Pauli propagation, a common algebraic framework encompassing Pauli propagation, Lie-algebraic simulation, and Krylov subspace methods. Using weighted commutator graphs, we derive exact identities that relate approximation errors to the signed contributions of omitted and discarded operator components. Our central result establishes emphdelayed observability, identifying conditions under which these contributions vanish at low orders in propagation time. We use this structure to develop finite-order error estimates and state-dependent selection rules. We further prove that retaining the symmetry-preserving part of a weak perturbation eliminates first-order expectation-value errors under suitable symmetry conditions. By revealing how approximation errors affect the desired expectation value, our framework provides a basis for more informative error analysis and the development of readout-aware simulation strategies.
authors: Yubraj Bhandari, Jakob S. Kottmann, Adelina Bärligea

articles.title: Sidewall Metrology Protocol for Superconducting Qubit Devices
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26223v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sidewall morphology is a potentially important factor influencing superconducting qubit performance, yet its quantitative characterization remains challenging due to the absence of standardized measurement protocols. In this work, we develop a scanning probe microscopy-based measurement framework for the quantitative characterization of superconducting qubit sidewalls. The framework introduces a refined root mean square lateral sidewall roughness descriptor and a new curvature-equivalent radius for quantifying vertical sidewall morphology. The descriptors and measurement procedures are applied to different components of qubit devices, forming the basis of a proposed sidewall characterization protocol. This provides a foundation for quantitative comparisons of fabrication processes across laboratories, enabling future investigations of correlations between sidewall geometry and qubit performance.
authors: Jørgen Garnæs, Henrik S. Guttesen, Astrid T. Rømer, Oscar Danielsson, Emily P. Duggan, Zhenhai Sun, Asen Lyubenov Georgiev, Li Wei Chang, Morten Kjaergaard, Mark Bieler, Lukas Grünhaupt, Sabbir A. Khan

articles.title: The Fundamental Memory Ceiling of Noisy Quantum Reservoirs
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26228v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fresh qubits, not size, set how long a noisy quantum system can remember. With k input qubits reinitialized per time step, the longest memory any reservoir can attain under depolarizing noise is exp[Θ(k)] time steps, whatever its size, dynamics, and input encoding. A universal upper bound and an explicit reservoir that attains the exponential scaling establish this optimal resource law. The bound depends on the dynamics only through the entropy that fresh qubits remove per time step, so it holds for any Markovian noisy dynamics without feedback, including measurement-free error correction.
authors: Markus Baumann, Jonas Stein, Claudia Linnhoff-Popien

articles.title: Squeezing-type lower bounds on generalized metrological sensitivity
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26319v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce squeezing-type lower bounds for a hierarchy of variance bounds under specific unbiasedness constraints, which generalizes the quantum Cramér-Rao bound. Our construction directly extends standard squeezing coefficients to the corresponding generalized metrological sensitivities while retaining their experimentally accessible structure. We show how observables maximizing these bounds can be identified analytically within families of accessible observables. If arbitrary observables are accessible, the optimized squeezing-type bound recovers the exact generalized metrological sensitivity. These bounds provide efficient and experimentally viable characterizations of generalized metrological sensitivities that are especially relevant in finite-shot scenarios and in the transition from local to global parameter estimation.
authors: Irene García-Martínez, Manuel Gessner

articles.title: Higher-order Parity Constraints for Quantum Approximate Optimization
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26381v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Parity Architecture was originally introduced in the context of quantum optimization algorithms to overcome hardware connectivity constraints. Here, we show that its benefits extend beyond this role by identifying specific parity transformations that enhance the success probability of the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) for optimization problems defined on hardware-native and sparse graphs. Numerical simulations suggest that this enhancement originates from the higher-order operators introduced by the Parity representation, which accelerate the propagation of correlations across the physical device. We investigate this mechanism for the Signed Max-Cut problem on 3-regular graph instances and demonstrate its practical relevance on IBM Heron quantum processors. QAOA parameters are first classically optimized on small training instances containing up to 14 vertices and subsequently transferred to larger instances executed on quantum hardware. We consider Signed Max-Cut instances of up to 40 vertices and find that, together with an error mitigation technique, the parity-based QAOA identifies the optimal solutions for all the considered 40-vertex instances, whereas the conventional QAOA fails under the same conditions.
authors: Anita Weidinger, Glen Bigan Mbeng, Roeland ter Hoeven, Wolfgang Lechner

articles.title: Two-qubit cryo-CMOS control of a spin register in diamond
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26413v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Utility-scale quantum technologies will not only require a well-performing quantum platform, but also classical control hardware that is scalable, efficient, and meets the design requirements set by the quantum system of interest. One approach is the application of silicon CMOS technology, a highly scalable and mature technology, to design application-specific integrated circuits (ASIC) that are optimized for the quantum system. In this work, we present two-qubit control of electron and nuclear spins in NV centres in diamond, using a cryogenic CMOS qubit controller integrated with a diamond quantum device in a cryostat. Using Gate Set Tomography (GST) we characterize the performance of the single-qubit gates on both electron- and carbon nuclear spins, and analyze the limiting noise processes. We use dynamical decoupling to engineer a two-qubit gate, and estimate F₂q,avg = 95(2)% for the electron-nuclear two-qubit gate fidelity. Our demonstration of cryo-CMOS-driven two-qubit gates is a key step towards highly-integrated quantum devices based on colour centres.
authors: H. B. van Ommen, N. E. Fakkel, M. van Riggelen, J. Yun, L. A. Enthoven, M. A. B. ElBadry, F. Sebastiano, M. Babaie, T. H. Taminiau

articles.title: The Four-Qubit Hyperbolic Quadric Has Contextuality Degree 315
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26465v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The contextuality degree of a set of Pauli contexts is the least number of contexts that every noncontextual ±1 assignment violates. For the four-qubit hyperbolic quadric Q⁺(7,2), with 135 points and 1575 lines as contexts, Muller et al. conjectured from heuristic searches that the degree is 315 and that the violated contexts of every optimal assignment form a dual polar space DW(5,2). We prove both conjectures. The lower bound has a short proof by hand: every doily (GQ(2,2)) of the quadric contains ten Peres-Mermin grids covering each of its lines four times, so every assignment violates at least three of its fifteen lines, and averaging over the doilies gives 1575/5=315. The equality case is local: an assignment is optimal exactly when it violates one ruling of one grid in every doily. Using this as a SAT encoding, we show that there are exactly 240 optimal violated sets, one orbit of O⁺⁽⁸,2), each isomorphic to DW(5,2). The same argument gives the first lower bounds łceil L/5c̊eil for all quadrics with L lines in Nge4 qubits. The degree theorem is kernel-checked in Lean 4, and the completeness of the enumeration is certified by a DRAT proof checked by the verified checker cakeₗₚᵣ.
authors: Zhengyu Li, Amandeep Gupta, Vijay Ganesh

articles.title: Exact projective-steering boundary and sample-size optimization for angularly averaged hyperon-antihyperon states
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26526v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In hyperon-antihyperon production through electron-positron annihilation, quantum steering provides a stricter test of nonclassical spin correlations than entanglement. We determine when steering survives angular averaging and optimize angular selections to reduce the sample size needed to resolve it. In the specified production-frame spin convention, we show that windows symmetric about 90 degrees with even production-angle acceptance yield phase-independent Bell-diagonal states. Applying the necessary and sufficient criterion for steering under arbitrary dichotomic projective measurements determines the exact boundary for this family and reveals a steering region missed by the three-setting Cavalcanti-Jones-Wiseman-Reid (CJWR) criterion. For positive production parameters and uniform full-range acceptance, the steering threshold is αsimeq0.36065. We derive the covariance of weak-decay angular moments, construct fixed linear witnesses, and optimize the angular window. For J/ψ→ŁambdabarŁambda, steering survives full-range averaging. The statistical model predicts that, after separately optimizing the two angular selections at nominal z=5, the required full-range pair sample decreases from 8.61×10⁴ for CJWR to 2.80×10⁴ for the projective witness, a 67.4% reduction. This advantage persists under the production-acceptance and analyzing-power variations studied.
authors: Weicheng Miao, Linzhi Jiang, Bingbing Li

articles.title: Local Measurement Theory for Quantum Cellular Automata
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26587v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The formulation of quantum measurements compatible with relativistic causality is obstructed by the tension between the locality of observable algebras and the dynamical state transformations induced by measurement processes. We develop a local measurement theory for quantum cellular automata, lattices of finite-dimensional quantum systems with a causal reversible dynamics evolving in discrete time steps. Measurement processes are described by localized completely positive maps and organized into operational measurement protocols, finite non-adaptive sequences of local instruments distributed across the causal cone induced by the automaton local dynamics. Each protocol induces an effective measurement on the initial time slice, whose support is constrained by the causal structure generated by the automaton. Non-local measurement effects therefore arise through causal propagation and composition of local operations, rather than from primitive non-local interventions or instantaneous collapse prescriptions. We establish the corresponding spatial support bounds and characterize the resulting measurement architecture. As an explicit example, we construct a two-step protocol for a one-dimensional nearest-neighbour qubit automaton which, for suitable automaton parameters, realizes a Bell-basis projective measurement on two neighbouring sites after coarse-graining of the local outcomes. Away from this point, the same protocol generates a continuous family of deformed Bell measurements whose entanglement and stabilizer Rényi non-classicality can be quantified explicitly. The framework thus provides a causally consistent operator-algebraic mechanism for synthesizing spatially extended quantum measurements from strictly local operations.
authors: Tommaso Brambilla, Alessandro Tosini, Paolo Perinotti

articles.title: Beyond Fidelity: Resolving Errors in Photonic Seed State Generation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26603v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An important aspect of many linear optical quantum computing architectures is probabilistically generating small dual-rail qubit entangled states, or seed states. While many schemes to achieve this have been discovered, attention has been primarily focused on minimizing input resources and maximizing success probability rather than establishing a detailed understanding of linear-optical error performance. In this work, we develop a framework for resolving sensitivities to physically distinct errors in linear optical state generation, allowing us to identify precise ways in which these errors affect the properties of the output state. We use this framework to identify seed state generators in which destructive many-photon interference prevents detector loss and detector noise from causing a falsely successful heralding event. We show that this effect suppresses errors, for example cutting the effective loss on the output of particular Bell state generators in half relative to a standard scheme. We also present a new Bell state generator in which both detector loss and detector noise do not affect the quality of the output Bell state to first order, and a 4GHZ generator with >75% higher success probability than a standard circuit. In addition we provide some useful identities, bounds and invariants for studying linear optical seed state generation.
authors: Sara Bartolucci, Patrick Birchall, Jacob Bulmer, Sam Gartenstein, Mihir Pant, Terry Rudolph, Chris Sparrow, Andrzej Veitia

articles.title: Non-Markovian exceptional points and information backflow: a Heisenberg reaction-coordinate approach
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26620v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The primary pathway to the investigation of exceptional points (EPs) in open quantum systems has been the use of Markovian master equations. However, recently it has been realised that they can arise in settings that show non-Markovian behaviour. The main approach in this direction has been the use of pseudomodes, which allow the influence of a structured environment to be replaced by new damped auxiliary modes. In this work, we use a Heisenberg-equation approach which relies on the reaction-coordinate formalism to obtain exact analytical dynamics. First, we show how our method considerably simplifies the analysis compared to the use of master equations. Second, we utilise it to discuss non-Markovian revivals in systems with second and higher-order EPs, showing that the notion that EPs demarcate the onset of revivals is not generally true. We then utilise our results to discuss the dynamical effects of higher-order non-Markovian EPs, deriving bounds on the number of revivals and investigating enhanced asymptotic relaxation near higher-order EPs. Finally, we investigate non-Markovian EPs with engineered reservoirs and show how they can be utilised to control the rate of irreversible information loss.
authors: Daniel Holst, Gianmichele Blasi, Shishir Khandelwal

articles.title: Ground-State Sampling Correspondence between Penalty-Based and Constrained Quantum Annealing
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26687v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum annealing generally samples degenerate ground states with nonuniform probabilities. This unfair sampling depends on how the driver Hamiltonian couples these states near the end of annealing. For combinatorial optimization problems with a cardinality constraint, the penalty method and constrained quantum annealing (CQA) differ in these couplings. The transverse-field driver of the penalty method does not directly couple feasible ground states, whereas the fully connected XY driver of CQA couples pairs of them related by a single spin exchange. We investigate how this difference affects ground-state sampling, using closed-system simulations of random graph bipartitioning instances together with degenerate perturbation theory. For the instances studied, the conditional ground-state distribution of penalty-based quantum annealing approaches that of CQA at sufficiently large penalties and long annealing times. This convergence can be explained by the effective Hamiltonian of penalty-based quantum annealing, in which virtual single-spin flips to infeasible states generate a second-order interaction proportional to the CQA driver projected onto the feasible ground-state manifold, which is the leading term of the effective Hamiltonian of CQA. In the numerical simulations, the Jensen--Shannon divergence between the conditional ground-state distributions of penalty-based quantum annealing and CQA decreases approximately as the inverse square of the penalty-to-objective energy ratio, consistent with the perturbative analysis. This correspondence between the effective Hamiltonians extends to equal-weight fixed-magnetization constraints under the same perturbative conditions, providing a common mechanism for sampling bias in the two implementations.
authors: Shunta Ide, Shu Tanaka

articles.title: Measurement-efficient energy estimator for quantum chemistry of photodynamic materials
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26689v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate modelling of chemical reaction rates requires precise correlated energy differences. Quantum computing offers a potential route to their determination, but extracting energies from quantum-prepared states can demand prohibitive sampling. We demonstrate measurement-efficient correlated energy estimation using an electronically challenging H₂DBB--Ru model derived from a Ru-functionalized hafnium metal-organic framework relevant to radiodynamic and photodynamic therapies. The mixed estimator combines a quantum-prepared target with sparse multiconfiguration references and recovers ground-state corrections using magnitude-only compute-uncompute measurements. Analytical variance estimates predict 1.6 mHa precision with a few hundred shots, about 100 times fewer than the single-determinant formulation and three orders of magnitude fewer than optimized Hamiltonian-term sampling. With approximate targets, it reaches comparable accuracy using simpler state preparation than direct expectation-value estimation. Emulator and trapped-ion experiments on Quantinuum Helios validate the approach up to (10,10), including a 50-qubit circuit combining AI-assisted state preparation with error detection, providing a measurement-efficient route to correlated energy differences for challenging chemical problems.
authors: Connor Lenihan, Kripa Panchagnula, Luca Erhart, Jem Guhit, Carlo A. Gaggioli, Gabriel Greene-Diniz, Gabriel Laude, Megan Cerys Rowe, Fabian Finger, Pranav Kalidindi, Enrico Rinaldi, Mikko Muuronen, Chandrika Mulakala, Thomas M. Soini, Elvira Shishenina, David Muñoz Ramo, David Zsolt Manrique

articles.title: Quantum Optimal Control Primer
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26725v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This is a set of detailed notes that are part of a Ph.D. Course on Quantum Control delivered at the Department of Chemistry of Seoul National University in 2014. Part of this course was also taught in the Department of Chemistry of the Friedrich Schiller University Jena. It focuses on quantum optimal control and quantum optimal control algorithms based on the gradient and extended gradient methods.
authors: Ignacio R. Sola

articles.title: A General Master Equation for Two Accelerated Detectors: Stationary States and Entanglement
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26753v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We derive a general Gorini-Kossakowski-Lindblad-Sudarshan master equation for two co-located, uniformly accelerated two-level detectors weakly coupled to scalar fields in the Minkowski vacuum, retaining coherent and dissipative contributions for arbitrary orientations, field masses, and spacetime dimensions. For equal orientations, we determine stationary states and their entanglement for two couplings to massless fields in four dimensions: symmetric coupling yields acceleration-dependent concurrence, whereas rotating-wave coupling gives acceleration-independent concurrence.
authors: Riccardo Acquaviva, Paolo Facchi

articles.title: Supervised Learning with Quantum Hamiltonian Embeddings
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26833v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning is widely regarded as a promising application in which quantum computing could offer a computational advantage. However, general quantum machine learning models with provable guarantees on performance, trainability, and efficient inference remain limited. In this work, we introduce quantum Hamiltonian embeddings, a supervised learning framework in which a classical training dataset is encoded into a single effective, parameterized Hamiltonian. Training optimizes the parameters of this data-dependent Hamiltonian, whose approximate ground state defines the classification rule. Once the ground state has been approximated using a quantum algorithm, inference can be performed either classically using a classical representation of the learned state, or with a quantum representation of the state. We establish efficient methods for gradient estimation and prove favorable generalization guarantees. Furthermore, under standard cryptographic assumptions, we show that Hamiltonian embeddings can realize hypothesis functions beyond the reach of efficient classical algorithms. We then demonstrate the framework at scale on IBM Heron processors using a standard benchmark dataset. Together, these results establish Hamiltonian embeddings as a new framework for quantum machine learning, combining theoretical guarantees with a path for experimental investigations at scale on quantum hardware.
authors: Riccardo Molteni, Minjun Jeon, Paolo Braccia, Abhinav Deshpande, Vedran Dunjko, Liang Jiang, Su-un Lee, Swarnadeep Majumder, Javier Robledo Moreno, Parthasarathy Suryanarayanan, Kunal Sharma

articles.title: Quantum algorithms for optimal control: large-scale finite-horizon linear-quadratic regulation
articles.title_zh: 量子算法用于最优控制：大规模有限时域线性二次调节
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26843v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop quantum algorithms for optimal control over a prescribed finite time interval (finite horizon), focusing on continuous-time linear-quadratic regulation (LQR). This foundational control problem often requires solving a nonlinear matrix Riccati equation, which can be costly for large systems and long control durations on conventional classical solvers. We instead work directly with the state-costate optimality equations, reformulating the LQR problem as a multiple-shooting linear system. Importantly, we prove a condition-number bound for the system that is independent of the horizon, under stabilizability and detectability assumptions. By incorporating the initial and final conditions into a single linear system, we can solve the subsequent linear system more efficiently with a quantum linear systems subroutine. For a given initial state, our quantum algorithms return classical estimates of the optimal cost and the optimal control inputs at a selected time, without constructing a Riccati solution operator. Given sparse-matrix block-encodings, an initial-state preparation oracle and a fixed number of control inputs, the query and gate complexities scale polylogarithmically with system size and control duration, provided that sparsity, relevant norms, and stability parameters are bounded. The dependence on the target error is inverse-linear up to logarithmic factors. We establish the required bounds uniformly in system size and duration for a family of damped mass-spring chains with two endpoint controls. Numerical experiments support the analysis.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文开发了针对预设有限时间区间（有限时域）最优控制的量子算法，重点关注连续时间线性二次调节（LQR）问题。该方法通过将LQR问题重构为多重射击线性系统，并证明了在可镇定性和可检测性假设下，系统条件数与时域无关。利用量子线性系统子程序，该算法能更高效地求解包含初始和最终条件的线性系统。对于给定初始状态，量子算法可返回最优成本和选定时刻最优控制输入的经典估计值，无需构建Riccati解算子。
authors: Xiajie Huang, Cristina Álvarez Yuste, Nikita Guseynov, Nana Liu, Javier González-Conde

articles.title: How do late-time photons "record" primordial curvature perturbations?
articles.title_zh: 晚期光子如何“记录”原初曲率扰动？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23999v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Inflationary cosmology faces a fundamental gap between primordial quantum fluctuations and the classical cosmic history inferred from observations. Although the primordial quantum state is a superposition of field configurations, standard cosmology assumes one definite realization of curvature perturbations and uses classical perturbation theory to describe the resulting gravitational potentials, CMB anisotropies, and large-scale structure. Squeezing and decoherence of primordial fluctuations alone do not explain why this one-realization description is physically meaningful. We address this issue through Cosmological Classical Branches (CCBs), using the quantum-information-theoretic notion of physical records. In CCBs, distinct late-time matter components carry compatible records of the same primordial configuration. A record in one component makes that configuration readable, while a disjoint compatible record suppresses interference accessible to operations on the first. Each branch thus admits a common c-number primordial label at finite resolution, while the global quantum superposition persists. This Letter summarizes the framework developed in Ref.~i̧teKuroda2026CCB.
articles.abstract_zh: 暴胀宇宙学在原初量子涨落与观测推断的经典宇宙历史之间存在根本性鸿沟。本文通过宇宙学经典分支（CCBs）概念，利用量子信息论中的物理记录思想来解决这一问题。在CCBs中，不同的晚期物质组分携带着相同原初构型的兼容记录。这些记录使得每个分支在有限分辨率下都具有共同的c数原初标记，同时全局量子叠加态依然存在。
authors: Tomotaka Kuroda, Fumiya Sano, Yusuke Yamada

articles.title: Transient Heat Conduction on Quantum Hardware: Replicated Temperature-Field Reconstruction and Shot-Count Sensitivity with a Variational Quantum Linear Solver
articles.title_zh: 量子硬件上的瞬态热传导：基于变分量子线性求解器的温度场重建与计数敏感性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24004v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Implicit discretizations of transient heat conduction repeatedly generate sparse linear systems, making diffusion problems a natural test bed for quantum linear solvers. This study evaluates how accurately a variational quantum linear solver (VQLS) recovers the temperature field produced by one backward-Euler step of one-dimensional conduction on IBM quantum hardware. A pre-specified confirmatory experiment compares N=4 interior temperatures encoded on two qubits with N=8 temperatures encoded on three qubits using ten paired hardware blocks; a separately defined N=16, four-qubit extension is evaluated in five independently scheduled exploratory blocks. Local VQLS optimization reduces relative temperature-field error to approximately 10⁻⁸ for all three cases, establishing an essentially exact ideal reference at this scale. On hardware, mean relative L2 temperature-field error is 8.07% for N=4 and 20.14% for N=8, a paired increase of 12.06 percentage points (95% CI, 10.71-13.42; exact paired sign-flip p=0.001953). The exploratory N=16 mean is 24.75+/-1.84%. A pre-specified N=16 shot-count follow-up then evaluates the same locked circuit at 2,048, 8,192, and 32,768 shots in six independently scheduled blocks. Mean field error remains 23.64%, 24.57%, and 24.37%, respectively; the 32,768-minus-2,048-shot contrast is +0.74 percentage points (95% CI, -0.65 to 2.12; p=0.281). In contrast, ideal multinomial sampling predicts a reduction from 2.68% to 0.75%. Higher shot counts reduce block-to-block variability but do not recover the mean cold-side temperature field. The results show that full-field readout of a strongly nonuniform thermal state is limited by more than ordinary finite-shot sampling under the tested hardware conditions, motivating observable-focused quantum formulations for heat flux, stored energy, and selected temperatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究评估了变分量子线性求解器（VQLS）在IBM量子硬件上重建一维瞬态热传导温度场的准确性。实验比较了N=4（两量子比特）和N=8（三量子比特）两种情况下的温度场重建，并扩展至N=16（四量子比特）。结果显示，VQLS在理想情况下能将相对温度场误差降至约10⁻⁸，但在硬件上，N=4和N=8的平均相对L2误差分别为8.07%和20.14%。该工作揭示了量子硬件在解决扩散问题中的潜力与挑战。
authors: Yijin Mao, Yuwen Zhang

articles.title: Gate-defined quantum dot and charge noise analysis in a Forksheet transistor
articles.title_zh: Forksheet晶体管中的栅控量子点与电荷噪声分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24136v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We report the cryogenic characterization of a 14-nm nMOS Forksheet transistor down to 10 mK. We demonstrate that the device retains transistor operation with improved characteristics at cryogenic temperatures, while also forming a gate-defined quantum dot that can be tuned to the single-electron regime. In the quantum-dot regime, we perform low-frequency charge-noise measurements across different charge occupations and observe an average charge-noise amplitude of łangle S₀ångle = 10;μeV/sqrtHz at 1 Hz, with a minimum measured value of 3.3;μeV/sqrtHz. These results highlight the potential of Forksheet technology for the monolithic cointegration of quantum and classical CMOS functionalities in future quantum processors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了14纳米nMOS Forksheet晶体管在低至10 mK的低温特性。研究表明，该器件在低温下仍保持晶体管功能并展现出改进的特性，同时形成了可调谐至单电子态的栅控量子点。在量子点工作模式下，测得的平均电荷噪声幅度为10 μeV/√Hz（1 Hz），最低值为3.3 μeV/√Hz。这些结果突出了Forksheet技术在未来量子处理器中单片集成量子与经典CMOS功能的潜力。
authors: Dominic Leclerc, Claude Rohrbacher, Alexis Morel, Joffrey Rivard, Romain Ritzenthaler, Christian Lupien, Hans Mertens, Naoto Horiguchi, Eva Dupont-Ferrier

articles.title: Electric Flux as a Criterion for String Breaking and Schwinger Pair Production
articles.title_zh: 电通量作为弦断裂和施温格对产生的判据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.24175v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We define string breaking by the midpoint electric field falling to half a flux unit. In the massive Schwinger model, an energy balance between intact string and screened configuration predicts this separation using only vacuum observables and meson masses as input. We observe numerically that this half flux point corresponds to equal weights of the two configurations thus explaining the observed peak of the entanglement entropy as maximal uncertainty of the binary flux. The same binary uncertainty explains the entanglement peak at the vacuum transition. Near breaking, screening organizes part of the spatial entanglement between the string interior and exterior into a nearly maximally entangled bit. Within the selected flux sectors, this approximate encoded Bell pair records whether the flux is screened and nearly separates from the remaining correlations. The vacuum transition exhibits the same structure. The string and the θ-vacuum reveal a matching structure of the capacity of entanglement minimum at their transition point, linking their entanglement spectra. The transition rearranges degrees of freedom coherently as revealed by the entanglement asymmetry and Robustness of Magic of disjoint subregions. Finally, we construct the θ-vacuum and string wavefunctions with high fidelity using a restricted Boltzmann machine ansatz.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将弦断裂定义为中点电场降至半个通量单位。在大质量施温格模型中，通过能量平衡预测了弦断裂，并数值观察到半通量点对应于两种构型的等权重，解释了纠缠熵峰值。研究发现，在断裂附近，屏蔽将弦内部和外部的部分空间纠缠组织成一个近似最大纠缠比特。弦和θ真空在过渡点展现出匹配的纠缠容量最小值结构，揭示了自由度的相干重排。
authors: Sebastian Grieninger

articles.title: Large Language Model Steering of Acousto-Optic Tweezer Arrays
articles.title_zh: 大语言模型对声光镊阵列的引导控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25014v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Controlling quantum hardware requires choosing and revising experimental strategies as nonlinear response, coupling, and drift limit calibration. We experimentally investigate a general-purpose large language model (LLM) as a human-in-the-loop strategy layer for a neutral-atom tweezer platform. Through step-by-step interaction with experimental feedback, the LLM guides a transition from multiplicative row--column correction to a drift-corrected local response-matrix method when separable feedback stalls. Deterministic software performs image analysis and numerical updates, while an experimentalist verifies and authorizes each waveform. For a 10×10 crossed-acousto-optic-deflector array, this workflow reduces the Gaussian-peak coefficient of variation from 20.30% to 1.57% in 30 candidate-update rounds. The experiment demonstrates feedback-informed strategy selection on a physical quantum-control subsystem, rather than direct generation of control parameters alone. These results highlight the potential of LLMs to guide control optimization across diverse quantum platforms by adaptively formulating and refining experimental strategies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文实验性地研究了通用大语言模型（LLM）作为中性原子镊子平台中人机交互策略层的作用。通过与实验反馈的逐步交互，LLM引导了从乘法行列校正到漂移校正局部响应矩阵方法的转变。对于10×10交叉声光偏转器阵列，该工作流程在30轮更新中将高斯峰变异系数从20.30%降低到1.57%。这些结果突出了LLM通过自适应制定和完善实验策略，指导各种量子平台控制优化的潜力。
authors: Cheng Sheng, Kai-xuan Xiao, Yin Zhang, Wen-hao Wang, Feng-yi Zhang, Xu-xing Geng, Guang-ming Huang, Gao-xiang Li

articles.title: Noise-Awareness in Quantum Software Testing: An Empirical Landscape Analysis
articles.title_zh: 量子软件测试中的噪声感知：一项实证性景观分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25233v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) hardware has transformed quantum computing into a practical experimental platform while introducing fundamental challenges associated with hardware noise, decoherence, and probabilistic execution. Although quantum software testing (QST) has rapidly emerged as an active research area, it remains unclear to what extent existing testing methodologies explicitly engage with noisy and hardware-constrained execution environments. This paper presents a systematic empirical landscape analysis of noise-awareness in QST research through a deterministic, taxonomy-guided analytical framework applied to 61 papers published between 2018 and 2025 across eight testing paradigms, contrasting how contributions are framed with how they are evaluated. Among the analyzed papers, 47 (77.0%) are noise-oblivious and only 14 (23.0%) explicitly engage with noise-related execution concerns, while only 11 (18.0%) report evaluation on physical hardware or a noisy simulator. Test generation, the largest paradigm, exhibits a noise-awareness rate of only 14.3%, and debugging and repair 18.2%; coverage-based, metamorphic, and differential testing contain no noise-aware contributions. Noise-aware methodologies emerged late and remain outnumbered in all analyzed years. Framing and evaluation are strongly associated (odds ratio 40.5, p < 0.001) yet diverge for individual papers: 5 of the 14 noise-aware papers evaluate only on ideal simulators. Inferential statistical tests are reported in only 16.4% of papers. The classification framework was validated against a blinded, human-coded reference sample, achieving almost perfect inter-rater agreement on testing-technique classification and substantial agreement on noise-awareness. The framework provides a reusable empirical basis for longitudinal analysis of hardware-conscious testing practice.
articles.abstract_zh: 噪声中等规模量子（NISQ）硬件带来了硬件噪声、退相干和概率执行等挑战。本文对量子软件测试（QST）研究中的噪声感知进行了系统性实证分析，审查了2018年至2025年间发表的61篇论文。结果显示，77.0%的论文忽视噪声，仅23.0%明确关注噪声相关执行问题，且仅18.0%在物理硬件或噪声模拟器上进行评估。这表明QST领域在应对噪声环境方面仍有显著差距。
authors: Mir Mohammad Yousuf, Shabir Ahmad Sofi, Bisma Majid

articles.title: Response theory at low temperature for weakly interacting quantum spin systems
articles.title_zh: 弱相互作用量子自旋系统在低温下的响应理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25249v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recent work by Greenblatt, Lange, Marcelli, and Porta (Commun. Math. Phys. 2024) provides the first rigorous justification of adiabatic theory for interacting quantum systems at positive temperature. Their analysis treats weakly interacting lattice fermions and combines a rigorous Wick rotation with fermionic cluster expansion techniques. Here, we study a class of weakly interacting quantum spin systems and derive response theory at positive temperature, thereby covering non-Fermi systems for the first time. Our proof identifies and exploits the locality property of local indistinguishability as a key ingredient in carrying out low-temperature adiabatic expansions. The fact that these systems satisfy local indistinguishability was recently established jointly with Adhikari (arXiv:2508.15907) using cluster expansion methods together with a probabilistic swapping trick.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一类弱相互作用量子自旋系统，并首次推导了其在正温度下的响应理论，从而涵盖了非费米系统。该证明识别并利用了局部不可区分性这一局域性质，作为进行低温绝热展开的关键要素。这些系统满足局部不可区分性这一事实，最近已通过聚类展开方法和概率交换技巧得到证实。
authors: Joscha Henheik, Marius Lemm, Tom Wessel

articles.title: De Finetti Structures in Networks of Quantum Systems
articles.title_zh: 量子系统网络中的De Finetti结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25280v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Consider N identical quantum systems at the vertices of a graph, interacting via pairwise edge couplings. We designate K vertices as a system of interest mathrm S and the remaining N-K as a reservoir mathrm R. Under generic connectivity assumptions between mathrm S and mathrm R, we show that for N→infty, the reduced state of mathrm S converges to a convex combination of symmetric product states of K single-vertex density matrices -- called a de Finetti representation. Unlike in standard derivations for symmetric (exchangeable) systems, we establish de Finetti representations for quantum networks, which are inherently non-exchangeable. We construct the representations explicitly and quantify the convergence rate. We show that Erdős--Rényi random graphs exhibit the de Finetti structure: as the reservoir grows, the reduced state of any fixed finite subgraph converges almost surely to an explicit deterministic product state. As applications, we establish a general area law for the entanglement entropy of mathrm S, analyze mean-field and fluctuation scalings of the mathrm S-mathrm R interaction, and illustrate our results on qubit networks. We also derive quantitative convergence estimates for information-theoretic quantities, including von Neumann entropy, mutual information, and entanglement within mathrm S and between mathrm S and mathrm R.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了图顶点上N个相同量子系统通过成对边耦合相互作用的情况。在系统S与环境R之间的通用连接假设下，证明了当N趋于无穷时，S的约化态收敛到K个单顶点密度矩阵的对称乘积态的凸组合，即De Finetti表示。与传统对称系统不同，本文为本质上非可交换的量子网络建立了De Finetti表示，并量化了收敛速度。研究还展示了Erdős--Rényi随机图也展现出De Finetti结构，并将其应用于纠缠熵的面积定律分析。
authors: Gavin Hull, Marco Merkli

articles.title: Cryogenic Recharacterization of a Commercial 22 nm FD-SOI Foundry Standard-Cell Library
articles.title_zh: 商用22纳米FD-SOI代工厂标准单元库的低温再表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25498v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Wiring and bandwidth bottlenecks between a quantum processor and room-temperature electronics can be reduced by placing digital control at the cryogenic stage, but commercial foundry standard-cell libraries are not specified for operation at 4 K. A cryogenic recharacterization flow is therefore developed for a commercial 22 nm FD-SOI foundry standard-cell library using commercially available cryogenic compact-device models, while retaining the original cell circuits, layouts, logic functions, and implementation semantics and remaining compatible with the commercial synthesis, place-and-route, and signoff methodology used at room temperature. Body-bias dependence is quantified over 38,640 matched slew/load points at zero, +/-0.9 V, and +/-1.8 V body bias. Relative to full bias, zero-bias operation increases the median rising and falling delays by 38.6x and 33.0x, while approximately 90% of transitions exceed the foundry-defined maximum-transition envelope. The 0.8 V-to-0.4 V level shifter is even more sensitive to body bias: its worst-case falling delay decreases from 30.6 ns at zero bias to 0.56 ns at +/-1.8 V. For the outbound 0.4 V-to-0.8 V crossing, driving the 0.8 V receiver without a level shifter dissipates 57.7 uW of static power per bit at full bias, against 0.196 nW when level-shifted. In post-route analysis of the unchanged extracted physical database of a fabricated 32-bit ALU, the register-to-register setup boundary increases from 1.3 MHz at zero bias to 37.9 MHz at +/-0.9 V and 132.9 MHz at +/-1.8 V.
articles.abstract_zh: 为解决量子处理器与室温电子设备之间的布线和带宽瓶颈，本文开发了一种针对商用22纳米FD-SOI代工厂标准单元库的低温（4 K）再表征流程。该流程利用商用低温紧凑器件模型，同时保持原始单元电路和逻辑功能。研究量化了体偏置依赖性，发现零偏置操作会显著增加延迟，且电平转换器对体偏置更为敏感。这些结果为在低温环境下集成量子和经典CMOS功能提供了关键数据。
authors: Mohamed Gharib, Rami Rasheedi, Salma Abdelzaher, Henry Shi, Mike Hammer, Llorenç Fanals-i-Batllori, Aldo Pena Perez, Antonino Miceli, Inna Partin-Vaisband

articles.title: Subsystem quantum Rényi-Bhattacharyya distance in 2D CFTs and its holographic applications
articles.title_zh: 二维共形场论中子系统量子Rényi-Bhattacharyya距离及其全息应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25685v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop a systematic method to compute the subsystem fidelity and Rényi fidelity in two-dimensional conformal field theories (CFTs) from the operator product expansion of twist operators, and apply it to the subsystem quantum Bhattacharyya distance (BD) and Rényi-Bhattacharyya distance (RBD). We validate the method against exact results in the free massless fermion and boson theories, and then use it to compute the BD and RBD in holographic CFTs between two heavy primary states, between two thermal states, and between a heavy primary state and a thermal state. When the two states differ in their classical, order-c data, the distances are of order c, and the states are distinguishable already at the level of classical gravity; when the leading data coincide, the distances are of order 1/c at every order of the short interval expansion, so that the distinguishability becomes a perturbative quantum gravity effect. For a heavy primary state and its thermal counterpart, the leading contribution to the BD appears at order ell⁸ and is of order c⁰, whereas the RBD is generically of order c, in line with the earlier finding that a heavy primary state and a thermal state share the same order-c entanglement entropy but have different order-c Rényi entropies in the short interval expansion.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种系统方法，通过扭曲算符的算符积展开计算二维共形场论（CFTs）中的子系统保真度和Rényi保真度，并将其应用于子系统量子Bhattacharyya距离（BD）和Rényi-Bhattacharyya距离（RBD）。该方法在全息CFTs中计算了不同量子态之间的BD和RBD。研究发现，当两个态在经典数据上存在差异时，距离为c量级；当主要数据一致时，距离为1/c量级，表明可区分性成为微扰量子引力效应。
authors: Yihao Wang, Jiaju Zhang

articles.title: Online Scheduling and Distribution of Quantum Circuits over Quantum Networks
articles.title_zh: 量子网络中量子电路的在线调度与分发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.25875v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Emerging quantum networks enable distributed quantum computing (DQC) by interconnecting modest, noisy quantum processors. However, practical deployments face tight memory budgets, probabilistic entanglement generation, and decoherence, all while serving multiple users. In realistic settings -- cloud execution, iterative/interactive workloads and concurrent jobs -- circuits do not arrive in a single batch but as a stream. This creates a fundamentally online problem: the system must react to stochastic arrivals, balance latency and throughput, and remain stable under varying loads without foresight of future jobs. We study Online Scheduling and Distribution of Quantum Circuits (OS-DQC) and formalize the online scheduling problem for quantum networks: circuits arrive over time and must be executed without knowledge of future arrivals. At each event time (arrival or completion), the system decides which waiting circuits to launch and how to place their qubits, while accounting for congestion from in-flight circuits and constraints due to finite memories and decoherence. The objective is to minimize the mean completion time and makespan under these physical and resource constraints.
articles.abstract_zh: 新兴量子网络通过互连中等规模、有噪声的量子处理器，实现了分布式量子计算（DQC）。然而，实际部署面临内存预算紧张、概率性纠缠生成和退相干等挑战。本文研究了量子电路的在线调度与分发（OS-DQC）问题，并将其形式化为量子网络的在线调度问题。系统需在电路随时间流式到达且未知未来任务的情况下，决定启动哪些等待电路以及如何放置其量子比特，以最小化平均完成时间和总工期。
authors: Yukun Yang, Himanshu Gupta

articles.title: Distributing Quantum Circuits Using Pre-Distributed Entanglement Pairs over Quantum Networks
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26099v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Distributing quantum circuits across a network of quantum devices is a recent approach to improve the scalability of quantum computation. Entangled pairs of qubits distributed across network nodes are used as a communication resource for executing inter-node (remote) gates. However, establishing these entanglement pairs incurs significant latency, and doing so during the circuit's execution may lead to the decoherence of logical qubits. Instead, it may be beneficial to distribute certain entanglement pairs before the circuit is executed. Thus, we consider the problem of distributing a quantum circuit across a quantum network containing some pre-distributed entanglement pairs and seek to minimize the execution time of the circuit. We address this problem in three steps. First, given the quantum network and (optionally) a probability distribution over training circuits, we determine a set of pre-distributed entanglement pairs under a specified budget. Second, we compute a qubit-to-memory allocation that minimizes the expected execution time given these pre-distributed resources. Finally, we identify any additional entanglement pairs required during execution, generate them concurrently, and execute the circuit gates. We evaluate our methods on a broad range of benchmark circuits.
authors: Yukun Yang, Ranjani G. Sundaram, Himanshu Gupta

articles.title: Wave-Particle Complementarity in Quantum Walk from a Quantum Mechanical Perspective
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26204v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A quantum walk is a mathematical model and a quantum version of a random walk. For the past two decades, it has been studied from mathematical and physical viewpoints. It has many desirable properties. This paper reevaluates quantum walk from a quantum mechanical perspective, as Feynman essentially proposed it as a toy model in his path integral method. Then we demonstrate that the quantum walk model exhibits both particle-like and wave-like properties by showing reflection and partial reflection as a particle and interference as a wave. In particular, for an initial state supported at two sites ±ell, we explicitly derive the weak limit distribution of the Hadamard walk and show that the Konno distribution is modulated by the interference factor 2o̧s²⁽ell k(x)). The resulting interference profile is reminiscent of far-field (Fraunhofer-type) diffraction.
authors: Norio Konno, Shigeki Matsutani, Etsuo Segawa, Tomoyuki Terada

articles.title: Q-MALDetect: Quantum Image-Based Malware Detection and Adversarial Robustness Analysis
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26240v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum machine-learning (QML) models are increasingly considered for security applications, yet their adversarial robustness in malware analysis remains insufficiently understood. This paper presents Q-MALDetect, a hybrid convolutional and variational-quantum detector for byte-image representations of x86-64 Executable and Linkable Format (ELF) binaries, and evaluates it under feature-space and a range of Grad-CAM-guided, executable-aware evasion attacks. The model achieves 97.2% training accuracy, but its robustness deteriorates as attack strength increases, with the strongest evaluated feature-space attack reaching a 78.7% attack success rate (ASR). Among executable-aware attacks, Grad-CAM-guided no-operation (NOP) insertion produces the highest conditional ASR of 32.9%. Dynamic adversarial training is the most effective evaluated defense, reducing feature-space ASR to as low as 5.0%, executable-aware ASR to 7.7%, and the sequential-attack ASR to 34.0%. In contrast, convolutional-autoencoder preprocessing increases executable-aware ASR to 39.7%, coinciding with a rise in Grad-CAM attribution mass within the mutable .text region from 35.2% to 45.7%. Ablation results reveal no monotonic relationship between qubit count and robustness, while the encoding interface modifies the learned attack surface without neutralizing the strongest attack. These findings demonstrate that the effectiveness of attacks and defenses depends strongly on the perturbation constraints and evaluation conditions. Reliable deployment of QML malware detectors therefore requires assessment against both feature-space and executable-aware attacks rather than reliance on clean accuracy or generic denoising alone.
authors: Walid El Maouaki, Mohammad Izen, Nouhaila Innan, Alberto Marchisio, Muhammad Shafique

articles.title: Phase-sensitive quantum-state texture during thermalization of a Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya Heisenberg dimer
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26736v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate quantum-state texture during the thermal relaxation of an anisotropic spin-1/2 Heisenberg dimer subject to a longitudinal magnetic field and a Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interaction. Starting from local transverse and longitudinal couplings to a bosonic bath, we construct a global weak-coupling Lindblad equation, identify its transition channels, and discuss the applicability and limitations of the secular approximation. The Gibbs state is obtained explicitly in the local spin basis, revealing that the DM coupling controls both the modulus and phase of the single-excitation coherence by modifying the energy splitting and rotating the chiral phase. For heating and cooling protocols, we compare rugosity, fidelity-based texture, and trace-distance texture with coherence, vector spin chirality, and purity. The relaxation dynamics separates population thermalization from the decay and precession of deliberately prepared energy-basis coherence. Their combined contribution to local coherence produces DM-dependent texture overshoots and, during cooling, damped oscillations and sign changes of the coherence quadratures. These transients differ from the evolution of coherence magnitude and purity, while trace-distance texture weights them differently from the overlap-based quantifiers. Calculations at reduced dissipation preserve the texture maxima within the secular model. The results identify a phase-sensitive diagnostic of relaxation.
authors: Onofre Rojas, Zhirayr Adamyan, Fadwa Benabdallah, Vadim Ohanyan

articles.title: Boundary-Sensitive Quantum Order on Non-Amenable Lattices
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.26859v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We show that quantum systems on non-amenable lattices, whose boundaries constitute an extensive fraction of the system, host novel forms of bulk ordering with no Euclidean counterpart. Combining boundary-retaining iDMRG with an exact symmetry-fixing duality, we investigate p<5 state clock models on the coordination-3 infinite Cayley tree. We find that between the ordered and disordered phases lies an emergent intermediate phase with bulk order induced by an arbitrarily weak boundary field rather than by conventional spontaneous symmetry-breaking. This establishes boundary-sensitive order as a distinct quantum ordering mechanism defying Landau's spontaneous symmetry-breaking paradigm. The intermediate phase realizes a bulk-boundary correspondence in which the unpolarized boundary selects a specific ordered bulk state.
authors: Xingzhi Wang, Zohar Nussinov, Gerardo Ortiz

articles.title: Classical simulators as quantum error mitigators via circuit cutting
articles.abstract: arXiv:2212.07335v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce a circuit cutting-based error mitigation framework, simulated quantum error mitigation (SQEM), in which an auxiliary error-mitigation subcircuit is simulated classically while the main computation is executed on quantum hardware. For the class of circuits considered here, SQEM can be implemented with polynomial overhead by mitigating one qubit at a time and classically recombining the resulting output distributions. This qubit-wise strategy avoids the exponential overhead of cutting all protected qubits simultaneously, while providing a scalable approximation to joint mitigation. We demonstrate the method using Pauli check sandwiching within VQE hardware-efficient ansätze and obtain ground-state energies close to noiseless ansatz simulations, including chemical accuracy for LiH.
authors: Ji Liu, Alvin Gonzales, Daniel Dilley, Zain H. Saleem
