Our experiments suggest that an encoding with higher distance, even if requiring more ebits, can yield a lower logical error rate for distributed operations, and that ``upgrading'' an encoding prior to distributed operations and having a cache, as part of node architecture, for qubits can be useful for distributed operations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了量子纠错码的不同编码选择及其对节点架构的影响，特别是在分布式横向扇出操作中的应用。实验结果表明，即使需要更多e比特，具有更高距离的编码也能为分布式操作带来更低的逻辑错误率。此外，在执行分布式操作之前“升级”编码以及在节点架构中设置量子比特缓存，对分布式操作可能是有益的。
authors: Seng W. Loke

articles.title: Quantum Tsallis Entropy Estimation: Near-Optimal Bounds and High-Precision Improvements
articles.title_zh: 量子Tsallis熵估计：近最优界限与高精度改进
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22983v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Estimating statistical properties of probability distributions is a fundamental problem in statistics and theoretical computer science. We develop quantum algorithms for estimating the q-Tsallis entropy H_qTsa(P) =fracsumᵢ₌₁ⁿ pᵢ^q-11-q when 0 <1, given purified quantum query access to a distribution P on [n]. When 0 <1, we introduce a two-stage simultaneous probability estimation procedure, yielding a quantum algorithm with query complexity widetildeOłeft(fracnfrac¹²⁺frac¹²qǎrepsilonfrac¹²q+fracn¹⁻qǎrepsiloni̊ght), which improves the result given by Chen et al. (ICALP 2026) when ǎrepsilon=Ob̊ran¹⁻²q.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文致力于估计概率分布的统计特性这一基本问题，并开发了量子算法来估计当0 < q < 1时，给定对[n]上分布P的纯化量子查询访问下的q-Tsallis熵H_qTsa(P)。我们引入了一种两阶段同步概率估计过程，从而得到了一种量子算法，其查询复杂度在特定误差范围内相较于现有工作有所改进。
authors: Chengshen Gao, Zongxing Xiong, Lvzhou Li

articles.title: Discrete time crystals and classical logic gates in coupled open Dicke models
articles.title_zh: 耦合开放Dicke模型中的离散时间晶体与经典逻辑门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23043v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the dynamics of coupled discrete time crystals (DTCs) in the coupled Dicke model or Dicke dimer (DD) with dissipation. By numerically simulating the mean-field dynamics of the system, we show that coupling two DTCs decreases their oscillation amplitude following a transient relaxation period. For sufficiently strong coupling, the coupled DTCs become unstable, resulting in the system relaxing towards the normal phase (NP). We demonstrate that the relaxation time diverges near the critical coupling strength, suggesting a continuous phase transition. Using the truncated Wigner approximation (TWA), we explore how the dynamics are affected by the introduction of quantum fluctuations. We also consider a scenario in which an NP is briefly coupled to a DTC, seeding the NP to transform into a DTC that is either synchronized or anti-synchronized relative to the DTC. We investigate the robustness of this phenomenon in the presence of noise. Using these results, we propose a scheme to perform NAND and NOR operations with three DTCs by sequentially coupling the input and output sites. We identify the parameter regimes in which the logic gate architecture remains valid, and investigate how the protocol is affected by the presence of quantum fluctuations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了耗散耦合Dicke模型（Dicke二聚体）中耦合离散时间晶体（DTCs）的动力学。数值模拟表明，DTCs的耦合会降低其振荡幅度，强耦合会导致系统不稳定并弛豫到正常相。弛豫时间在临界耦合强度附近发散，预示着连续相变。基于这些结果，我们提出了一种通过顺序耦合输入和输出站点，利用三个DTCs执行NAND和NOR操作的方案。
authors: Emmanuel D. G. U, Roy D. Jara Jr., Jayson G. Cosme

articles.title: Sample-Based Quantum Linear Solver and Bounds on Krylov-State Sampling
articles.title_zh: 基于采样的量子线性求解器与Krylov态采样的界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23138v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: To solve linear systems Ax=b, we propose a sample-based quantum linear solver combining quantum Krylov-state sampling with classical variational diagonalization. Rather than simulating the cost Hamiltonian H_b(A)=A^dagger(I-|bånglełangle b|)A, we measure quantum Krylov states e⁻ⁱAT|bångle generated by the original Hermitian operator A in the computational basis. We then classically diagonalize the projected cost Hamiltonian to reconstruct an approximate solution. Using a representation of A⁻¹|bångle as a linear combination of quantum Krylov states, we derive lower bounds on computational-basis sampling probabilities from solution amplitudes. We establish support-discovery guarantees for finite nonnegative-time grid sampling and signed-time sampling, which permits both positive and negative evolution times. The former bounds the maximum evolution time, whereas the latter improves ideal shot complexity at the cost of occasional long evolutions. For a condition-number bound κ on A, a lower bound β_L on the solution probability weight of each of L target basis states, and failure probability δ, signed-time sampling achieves O(κ²β_L⁻¹łog(L/δ)) shots, matching a worst-case lower bound up to constants within an evolution-only observation model in a specified parameter regime. Finally, we analyze the effects of finite-length qDRIFT compilation and circuit reuse on sampling and derive an infidelity bound for the reconstructed solution.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于采样的量子线性求解器，它结合了量子Krylov态采样与经典变分对角化来解决线性系统Ax=b。该方法通过在计算基下测量由原始厄米算符A生成的量子Krylov态，然后经典对角化投影的代价哈密顿量来重构近似解。我们推导了从解振幅到计算基采样概率的下界，并为有限非负时间网格采样和带符号时间采样建立了支持发现保证。
authors: Byeongyong Park, Keunhong Jeong, Doyeol Ahn

articles.title: Controlled PROP: Theory and Applications to Quantum Circuits
articles.title_zh: 受控PROP：理论及其在量子电路中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23192v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Control is a fundamental concept in quantum and reversible computational models. It enables the conditional application of a transformation to a system, depending on the state of another system. We introduce a general framework for diagrammatic reasoning featuring control as a constructor. To this end, we provide an elementary axiomatization of control functors, extending the standard formalism of PROPs to controlled PROPs. As an application, we show that controlled PROPs facilitate diagrammatic reasoning for quantum circuits. In particular, they admit a simple and complete axiomatization involving at most three qubits, whereas in the standard PROP setting, completeness necessarily requires axioms involving arbitrarily many qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了一个以控制作为构造器的图示推理通用框架，将标准PROP形式主义扩展到受控PROP。我们提供了控制函子的基本公理化。作为应用，研究表明受控PROP有助于量子电路的图示推理，它允许一个简单且完备的公理化，最多涉及三个量子比特，这与标准PROP设置中需要任意数量量子比特才能实现完备性形成对比。
authors: Noé Delorme, Simon Perdrix

articles.title: Learning angles for quantum approximate optimization
articles.title_zh: 量子近似优化算法的角度学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23296v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) and its variants are leading algorithms to help solve challenging combinatorial optimization problems. QAOA maps these problems to Ising Hamiltonians such that their ground state is the desired solution. Candidate solutions are then drawn from a variational quantum circuit. The performance of QAOA hinges on a set of variational angles. However, finding good angles is an instance-specific and computationally expensive non-convex classical optimization task. Here, we learn the mapping from the problem instance to high-quality QAOA angles. Our learned models replace the per-instance optimization, that we call the solver, with a single forward pass that is several orders of magnitude faster than the solver with a near identical quality. Our models further generalize to unseen topologies such as Barabási-Albert and 2D grid graphs. Experiments on quantum hardware confirm that QAOA samples with angles produced by our open-source models are indistinguishable from solver angles. Crucially, models sensitive to the topology of the problem instance increase the quality of the QAOA angles. Our work amortizes a major bottleneck in QAOA by an up-front data generation and training cost. Importantly, this cost can be amortized over time in settings where many similar problems are optimized on a regular basis, as is often the case in applications for industry.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子近似优化算法（QAOA）的性能高度依赖于变分角度，而寻找这些角度是一个计算成本高昂且实例特定的非凸优化任务。本文提出学习从问题实例到高质量QAOA角度的映射，使学习模型能够以远快于传统求解器的方式生成角度，且质量几乎相同。这些模型还能泛化到未见的拓扑结构，量子硬件实验证实其生成的QAOA样本与求解器角度的样本无异。
authors: Johannes Jakubik, Isabelle Wittmann, Zaheed Gaffoor, Gciniwe Simphiwe Baloyi, Craig Mahlasi, Etienne Vos, Thomas Brunschwiler, Daniel J. Egger

articles.title: SpinControl: Control Software for Prototyping and Benchmarking of Spin-Qubit Devices and Measurement Protocols
articles.title_zh: SpinControl：用于自旋量子比特器件和测量协议原型设计与基准测试的控制软件
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23316v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum computers require software to control the states of the qubits. As the actions on qubits grow in complexity with circuit execution, calibration, and benchmarking, the complexity of the control software grows in tandem. Spin-qubit quantum computers are at a stage where experimentalists need low-level access for tuning and calibration, and quantum algorithm researchers want high-level circuit-level access. In this article, we present the software design of SpinControl. SpinControl integrates three architectural metrics: 1) customizability, to allow prototyping devices and measurement protocols, is achieved by separating data and behaviour; 2) modularity and extensibility are achieved by separating functionalities into different components; and 3) robustness, to reliably execute quantum circuits on many qubits, is achieved by CI pipelines and input validation. SpinControl allows different types of measurements while customizing the instruments used, the pulse or circuit program executed, and the data processing. It allows building standardized experiments from measurement and analysis building blocks and executing these for calibration in a custom and conditional order. SpinControl implements these functionalities alongside robust configuration and data management, a connection to the cloud, and calibration scheduling. Pulse and circuit compilation, virtual gate matrices, as well as spin-qubit-specific GUIs integrated by SpinControl, make heavy use of software packages developed by Delft University of Technology: pulse lib, core-tools (both open source), and QConstruct
articles.abstract_zh: 量子计算机需要复杂的软件来控制量子比特状态、校准和基准测试。本文介绍了SpinControl的软件设计，该设计集成了可定制性、模块化和鲁棒性。SpinControl通过分离数据与行为实现设备和测量协议的原型设计，通过分离功能实现模块化和可扩展性，并通过CI管道和输入验证确保鲁棒性。它允许定制仪器、脉冲或电路程序以及数据处理，从而能够从构建块中构建标准化实验。
authors: Harold B. Meerwaldt, Daniël P. van der Velde, Pieter T. Eendebak, Michiel J. Haye

articles.title: Bell scenarios encode classical non-causality
articles.title_zh: 贝尔情景编码经典非因果性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23367v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bell and contextuality scenarios are unified within the Acín-Fritz-Leverrier-Sainz hypergraph formalism, in which measurements are hyperedges. Multipartite measurements are obtained from product rules that combine independent contextuality scenarios into a single hypergraph. Several such rules exist: they are structurally distinct, yet yield the same classical, quantum, and boxworld correlations. Here, we show that this difference is not incidental, unveiling an unexpected connection. The measurements of composite Bell scenarios are exactly the process functions, the deterministic classical communication protocols that may be non-causal, i.e., lack a definite causal order without generating paradoxes. Validity of a hyperedge and logical consistency of a process function are thus one and the same condition. This allows us to characterize process functions by normalization and no-signaling alone, providing transformations that generate non-causal process functions from no-communication ones. The product rules, in turn, order process functions by causal structure, from no-communication to non-causality, which yields a graphical criterion for the latter: a process function is non-causal precisely when its hyperedge is generated by the disjunctive but not the maximal product. We thereby obtain the first joint hypergraph representation of (non-causal) process functions and (nonlocal-without-entanglement) measurements, recasting classical non-causality as a non-standard way of composing black boxes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在Acín-Fritz-Leverrier-Sainz超图形式主义下统一了贝尔和语境性情景，其中测量被视为超边。研究发现，复合贝尔情景的测量恰好是非因果的确定性经典通信协议，即过程函数。超边的有效性与过程函数的逻辑一致性是同一条件，这使得仅通过归一化和无信号条件即可表征过程函数。该工作揭示了复合贝尔情景与非因果过程函数之间的深层联系，并提供了从无通信协议生成非因果过程函数的方法。
authors: Andreas Leitherer, Kyrylo Simonov, Ravi Kunjwal, Antonio Acín, Kuntal Sengupta, Hippolyte Dourdent

articles.title: Resonance crossings and diabolical points for DC electric field quantum sensors
articles.title_zh: 直流电场量子传感器的共振交叉与魔鬼点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23392v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Since the 1990s, experiments on double-well heterostructures have highlighted a key phenomenon: applying an external DC electric field induces pronounced wave packet oscillations at specific field strengths.  To gain a deeper insight into this effect, a comprehensive quantitative analysis of the properties of quantum resonances near a crossing point is required.  This approach lays the theoretical foundation for devising a quantum sensor capable of rapidly and efficiently determining whether the strength of an external DC electric field lies within a narrow target range.
articles.abstract_zh: 自20世纪90年代以来，双阱异质结构实验揭示了直流电场在特定场强下能诱导显著波包振荡的现象。为深入理解此效应，本文对交叉点附近量子共振特性进行了全面的定量分析。该研究为设计一种量子传感器奠定了理论基础，该传感器能够快速高效地判断外部直流电场强度是否处于狭窄的目标范围内。
authors: Andrea Sacchetti

articles.title: Cayley access models for matrix functions: reachable class and cost
articles.title_zh: 矩阵函数的凯莱访问模型：可达类别与成本
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23429v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study how to compute f(A)b on a quantum computer, where A is Hermitian. When f is nonsmooth or has localized difficulty in the spectrum, classical numerical linear algebra approximates it with rational functions rather than polynomials. We propose the Cayley transform, parameterized by σ in R and γ > 0, as an alternative to the standard quantum access model. The two parameters let one concentrate accuracy where f is difficult, which standard models can achieve only by raising the polynomial degree globally. This transformation converts Hermitian matrices to unitaries, allowing generalized quantum signal processing to apply Laurent polynomials bounded on the unit circle. We compare three access models (block encoding, matrix exponential, and Cayley encoding) in terms of query complexity and of the cost of their circuit realization. When the difficulty of f is localized in the spectrum, the Cayley encoding reduces the required degree by a factor of three to four, and it represents the shifted resolvent exactly at degree one. For spectral projectors, the standard models cannot reach the target accuracy at fixed degree, because their approximants cannot concentrate resolution near the discontinuity. Realizing the Cayley encoding from a block encoding requires solving a shifted linear system, whose cost offsets its query-complexity gain over the standard models. For structured matrices arising in practice, however, low-depth circuits for the encoding can be constructed directly, and the gain is preserved at the circuit level.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在量子计算机上计算厄米矩阵函数f(A)b的方法，特别针对函数f在谱中存在非光滑或局部困难的情况。作者提出了一种由参数σ和γ控制的凯莱变换作为标准量子访问模型的替代方案，该变换允许在函数困难区域集中精度。研究结果表明，当函数f的困难性局限于谱时，凯莱编码能将所需度数降低三到四倍，并且在度数为一时精确表示移位预解式。
authors: Gianna M. Del Corso

articles.title: Solving Large-Scale Parameter Inference in Controllable Nuclear Fusion via Coherent Ising Machines and Block Coordinate Descent
articles.title_zh: 通过相干伊辛机和分块坐标下降解决可控核聚变中的大规模参数推断
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23507v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bayesian inference enables self-consistent plasma parameter inversion in tokamak integrated data analysis by fusing multi-source diagnostics. However, under nonlinear Gaussian likelihoods, finding the maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimate typically relies on sampling methods whose high computational overhead precludes real-time plasma control. To address this bottleneck, we propose a Bayesian inversion framework using a Coherent Ising Machine (CIM)-a quantum computing architecture based on coupled degenerate optical parametric oscillators (DOPOs). With native all-to-all connectivity, the CIM directly maps the negative log-posterior potential onto a spin Hamiltonian and leverages quantum vacuum fluctuations for rapid state-space search during pitchfork bifurcation. Validated on plasma current profile inversion for the EAST tokamak, this method achieves a single-run solution time of approximately 1 ms. Although current qubit limits necessitate a block-wise iterative scheme that prevents full real-time execution today, rapidly scaling quantum hardware offers a clear pathway toward real-time tokamak control.
articles.abstract_zh: 贝叶斯推断在托卡马克集成数据分析中实现了等离子体参数的自洽反演，但传统采样方法计算开销大，难以实现实时控制。本文提出了一种基于相干伊辛机（CIM）的贝叶斯反演框架，将负对数后验势映射到自旋哈密顿量，并利用量子真空涨落进行快速搜索。在EAST托卡马克等离子体电流剖面反演上的验证显示，该方法单次运行求解时间约为1毫秒。尽管当前量子比特限制需要分块迭代方案，但快速发展的量子硬件为实现实时托卡马克控制提供了明确途径。
authors: Zijie Liu, Wenchao Liu, Wenxin Li, Anzhe Jiang, Hongdong Zhu, Qi Gao, Yin Ma, Hai Wei, Yao Huang, Yuehang Wang, Kai Wen, Jiangang Li

articles.title: Electrostatic Limits on Quantum Spatial Search
articles.title_zh: 量子空间搜索的静电学限制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23560v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We prove that a quantum walker cannot search a two-dimensional lattice in Grover's O(sqrt N) time, resolving the long-standing open question posed by Aaronson and Ambainis in 2003. A walker that hops between neighbouring sites of an L× L lattice, N=L², needs Ømega(sqrtNłog N) local steps at least to find a marked vertex, even with unlimited memory and free queries. Hence, Tulsi's algorithm is asymptotically optimal. Our proof rests on a surprising correspondence with classical electrostatics. We treat the marked vertex as a point charge and weight the overlap between the walker's states with and without the mark by the potential drop, which vanishes where queries act. Only local steps change this weighted overlap, at a rate limited by the field energy, so the lower bound is set by the self-potential of the charge. In the plane this self-potential grows logarithmically with system size, like the Coulomb potential, leading to the extra root-logarithmic factor. Several marked vertices turn the charge into a conductor, and the lower bound depends on their arrangement through its capacitance.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了量子行走者无法在二维格子上以Grover的O(sqrt N)时间进行搜索，解决了Aaronson和Ambainis在2003年提出的长期开放问题。在L×L格子上，即使拥有无限内存和免费查询，寻找一个标记顶点至少需要Ω(sqrtN log N)的局部步数。这一证明基于与经典静电学的惊人对应关系，将标记顶点视为点电荷。研究结果表明，Tulsi的算法在渐近意义上是最优的。
authors: Weikang Li

articles.title: Partially isophase electro-magnetic configurations
articles.title_zh: 部分等相电磁配置
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23645v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Separation of variables in Schrödinger equation allows an infinite-dimensional family of physically distinct field configurations that are dynamically indistinguishable in one selected sector, labeled by a conserved quantum number, while differing in all others. We call such a symmetry a partial isophase symmetry. Two main examples are considered: axially symmetric magnetic backgrounds (a rigid spectral flow of the Fock--Darwin oscillator, purely magnetic isophase families, and a two-channel extension) and a Cartesian slab geometry (magnetic barriers in two-dimensional electron gases, treated in the Appendices). We further discuss the consequences of this symmetry for the inverse spectral problem and consider its quasiclassical counterpart.
articles.abstract_zh: 薛定谔方程中的变量分离揭示了一类无限维的物理上不同但在一个选定扇区（由守恒量子数标记）中动力学上无法区分的场配置，作者称之为部分等相对称性。本文探讨了轴对称磁背景和笛卡尔平板几何中的主要例子。研究进一步讨论了这种对称性对逆谱问题的影响，并考虑了其准经典对应物。
authors: Andrey M. Pupasov-Maksimov

articles.title: Delta-sigma noise shaping for low-resolution quantization in Gaussian-modulated continuous-variable quantum key distribution
articles.title_zh: 高斯调制连续变量量子密钥分发中低分辨率量化的Delta-Sigma噪声整形
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23654v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Low-resolution digital-to-analog conversion can simplify continuous-variable quantum key distribution (CVQKD) transmitters, but coarse quantization increases excess noise and can generate data-correlated spectral replicas. We demonstrate digital delta--sigma modulation (DSM) for low-resolution waveform generation in Gaussian-modulated CVQKD. In a 500-MBaud CVQKD system over 20~km of fiber, 3-bit second-order DSM achieves an estimated asymptotic secret key rate of 46.38~Mbps at an oversampling ratio of 12, whereas uniform quantization yields no positive rate. With 4-bit second-order DSM, the rate reaches 50.11~Mbps, approximately 97% of the 12-bit reference. A noise model combining the DSM noise-transfer function with matched filtering guides the sampling-rate and signal-band design for effective noise suppression. We also identify a phase-conjugate spectral replica arising from third-order intermodulation between the pilot tone and quantum signal, and evaluate its key-rate penalty using a linear-replica security model. At 3-bit resolution and an oversampling ratio of 24, first-order DSM reduces the experimentally estimated leakage-mode strength by approximately four orders of magnitude. Together, our findings establish the security boundaries and operating conditions of DSM, providing design guidance for low-resolution CVQKD transmitters.
articles.abstract_zh: 低分辨率数模转换可简化连续变量量子密钥分发（CVQKD）发射机，但粗量化会增加额外噪声。本文展示了在500-MBaud、20公里光纤的CVQKD系统中，数字Delta-Sigma调制（DSM）用于低分辨率波形生成。结果显示，3比特二阶DSM在过采样率为12时可实现46.38 Mbps的渐近秘密密钥率，而均匀量化无法产生正速率。该研究还识别了由导频音和量子信号三阶互调引起的相位共轭谱副本，并评估了其对密钥率的影响。
authors: Wenjun Fan, Zhenlin Zhao, Dawei Wang

articles.title: Expressivity of IQP Feature-Map Quantum Kernels via Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces
articles.title_zh: 基于再生核希尔伯特空间的IQP特征映射量子核的表达能力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23692v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum kernels are among the most promising methods in quantum machine learning, providing a natural way to embed data into high-dimensional Hilbert spaces via quantum circuits and capturing non-linear relationships in data. Their learning behaviour is governed by the function class they represent, which is formally characterized by the structure of the associated Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space (RKHS). However, a theoretical characterization of this function class, and of how it depends on the choice of feature map and its hyperparameters, is still lacking. In this work, we focus on the Instantaneous Quantum Polynomial (IQP) feature map and derive a Fourier representation of the associated RKHS generators as finite sums of trigonometric functions evaluated on polynomially transformed input variables, with a finite set of accessible frequencies determined by the circuit construction and scaled by the bandwidth hyperparameter. This representation identifies three bandwidth regimes with qualitatively distinct expressive properties from localised, through multimodal, to periodic. Numerical experiments on synthetic datasets with controlled periodic and multimodal structure, across data dimensions and feature-map configurations, reproduce the three regimes in both supervised classification and unsupervised anomaly detection, benchmarked against a classical Gaussian kernel. These results make the relationship between expressivity and data structure explicit for IQP kernels: expressive power translates into a practical benefit only when the accessible frequencies match with the structure of the data, which provides a criterion for selecting the bandwidth when the periodic or multimodal structure of data is known.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子核是量子机器学习中的重要方法，但其表达能力及其与特征映射和超参数的依赖关系尚缺乏理论表征。本文专注于瞬时量子多项式（IQP）特征映射，并推导了其关联再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）生成器的傅里叶表示。该表示揭示了三种带宽机制，它们具有从局部到多模态再到周期性的定性不同的表达特性。数值实验进一步验证了这些理论发现。
authors: Valeria Repetto, Stefano Melchionna, Romina D'Aurizio

articles.title: Recursive Operator Localization and Spectral Gap Descent via the Geometry of Local Spectral Expansion
articles.title_zh: 基于局部谱展开几何的递归算子局域化与谱隙下降
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23695v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce Recursive Operator Localization (ROL), a framework for constructing hierarchies of local energy problems linked by linear maps between Hilbert spaces. To address spectral-gap problems, including those arising in quantum systems, we study a realization of ROL by nested subspaces indexed by a weighted simplicial complex. Using spectral gaps of auxiliary classical random walks on links, we propagate geometric estimates upward and use them to turn local spectral gaps at the bottom of the hierarchy into a spectral-gap bound for the global operator. For weighted scalar-valued functions on facets, the ROL decomposition becomes the law of total variance, recovering classical spectral-gap bounds from local link expansion (Alev and Lau, STOC 2020). Moreover, for positive binary spin distributions, conditional influence describes the overlap of the corresponding subspaces, yielding known heat-bath gap bounds from spectral independence (Anari, Liu, and Oveis Gharan, FOCS 2020). The framework also offers a route toward quantum Gibbs sampling, with applications requiring model-specific geometric estimates and energy comparisons.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了递归算子局域化（ROL）框架，用于构建通过希尔伯特空间之间线性映射连接的局部能量问题层次结构。为解决量子系统中的谱隙问题，研究通过加权单纯复形索引的嵌套子空间实现了ROL。该框架利用辅助经典随机游走的谱隙，将局部谱隙转化为全局算子的谱隙界限。ROL分解在特定条件下恢复了经典谱隙界限，并为量子吉布斯采样提供了新途径。
authors: Ryu Hayakawa

articles.title: Quality-of-Transmission Estimation in Quantum Networks: Compute, Simulate, or Learn?
articles.title_zh: 量子网络中的传输质量估计：计算、模拟还是学习？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23827v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Future quantum networks will rely on control-plane decisions such as routing, scheduling, entanglement provisioning, purification, and memory allocation. Each decision depends on a timely and reliable estimate of the quality of the entanglement that a candidate path can deliver, with end-to-end fidelity as a central metric. Inspired by the optical-networking experience with quality-of-transmission (QoT) estimation, this article asks when a quantum controller should compute fidelity analytically, simulate it, or learn a surrogate model. The optical analogy is useful but incomplete: optical QoT estimation often predicts a scalar transmission margin, whereas quantum QoT estimation must account for probabilistic entanglement generation, random memory waiting times, decoherence, state consumption, and measurement constraints that can make fidelity a stochastic target. We propose a compute/simulate/learn framework for quantum QoT estimation and illustrate it with a simulation-based proof of concept. Our study shows that analytical composition can be sufficient in simple regimes, that simulation becomes necessary when stochastic memory effects shape the delivered fidelity distribution, and that lightweight learned surrogates can approximate simulator labels at much lower runtime cost for online control. We close with open challenges for deployment, including stochastic targets, sim-to-real transfer, data-generation cost, physics-informed learning, and generalization beyond individual paths to full network topologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 未来的量子网络将依赖于控制平面决策，如路由和纠缠分配，这些决策需要及时可靠地估计候选路径的纠缠质量。本文受光网络传输质量（QoT）估计的启发，探讨了量子控制器何时应通过分析计算、模拟或学习代理模型来估计端到端保真度。研究提出了一个计算/模拟/学习框架用于量子QoT估计，并通过基于模拟的概念验证进行了说明。结果表明，在简单情况下分析组合足够，而当存在随机内存效应时模拟变得必要。
authors: Anis Bekri, Amar Abane, Van Sy Mai, Abdella Battou, Saddek Bensalem

articles.title: Leveraging verifiable structure in quantum circuits to find more efficient compilations with agentic AI
articles.title_zh: 利用量子电路中可验证结构通过智能AI实现更高效的编译
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23832v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We discuss an effective paradigm of utilizing AI agents to better compile quantum circuits when one can constrain bottleneck subroutines to have some form of classically verifiable structure. For example, when critical subroutines are composed exclusively of reversible classical logic, phasing operations, and measurement based uncomputation, one can efficiently simulate execution for classical inputs. This property facilitates efficient certification of approximate circuit synthesis via a form of fuzz testing, provided suitable assumptions on the input distribution. While this pattern was recently exploited to improve quantum cryptanalysis circuits, here we highlight the flexibility of the broader approach by discussing three important applications. (1) The computation of 1/sqrtx that bottlenecks real space simulations of the Coulomb operator such as those important for modeling inertial confinement fusion reactors. (2) The decoding of Reed-Solomon codes which bottlenecks the decoded quantum interferometry algorithm when used to approximately solve the optimal polynomial intersection problem. And (3) the quantum look-up tables and controlled application of Givens rotations that bottleneck the most performant quantum algorithms for simulating chemistry in second quantization. We discuss reference implementations of these algorithms and how they can be constrained and verified in the interest of seeding a Kaggle competition designed to accelerate AI-based research into the optimization of their compilation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了一种利用AI智能体优化量子电路编译的有效范式，尤其当瓶颈子程序具有经典可验证结构时。这种特性使得通过模糊测试高效认证近似电路合成成为可能。研究通过讨论三个重要应用，包括库仑算子的实空间模拟、里德-所罗门码的解码以及量子查找表，展示了该方法的灵活性。该方法有望显著提高量子算法的编译效率。
authors: Tanuj Khattar, Nicholas C. Rubin, Craig Gidney, Michael Broughton, Guang Hao Low, Ryan Babbush

articles.title: Task-aligned spectral inductive biases in parameterized quantum circuits
articles.title_zh: 参数化量子电路中任务对齐的谱归纳偏置
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23834v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Parameterized quantum circuits are widely investigated in quantum machine learning, yet how their architecture can provide task-aligned inductive biases remains poorly understood. We study data reuploading quantum circuits with two distinct inputs: a signal that varies between samples and a fixed, task-defined spectral query that specifies how the signal should be probed. We show that encoding the query can change the circuit's hypothesis class over the signal by modulating how its existing signal frequencies are combined, without introducing new sample-dependent information. This mechanism matches tasks built on nonuniform Fourier transforms, whose evaluation frequencies specify the query and whose sampling positions guide its encoding. We examine this connection in a classification task inspired by synthetic aperture radar, where acquisition geometry determines a query for classifying unfocused spectral patches before image formation. Across small-scale spectral and radar-like tasks, aligned queries improve learning from limited data over parameter-matched circuits with mismatched or absent queries. These results provide a route from known spectral task structure to the design and validation of inductive biases in parameterized quantum circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 参数化量子电路在量子机器学习中备受关注，但其架构如何提供任务对齐的归纳偏置仍不甚明了。本文研究了具有两种输入的量子电路：一个随样本变化的信号和一个固定的、任务定义的谱查询。研究表明，编码查询可以通过调制现有信号频率的组合方式来改变电路对信号的假设类别，从而提高有限数据下的学习效果。这些结果为设计具有任务感知归纳偏置的量子电路提供了新途径。
authors: Felix Frohnert, Adrián Pérez-Salinas, Sebastian Lange, Marcus Schwaebisch, Evert van Nieuwenburg, Vedran Dunjko

articles.title: Semiclassical Analysis of Wave Dynamics via Wigner Transforms: Applications to the Quantum Harmonic, Anharmonic, and Dirac Oscillator
articles.title_zh: 基于维格纳变换的波动力学半经典分析：在量子谐振子、非谐振子和狄拉克振子中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22414v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this Master's thesis, we give a pedagogical introduction to the semiclassical analysis of wave dynamics in single-band and multi-band systems. We show how the semiclassical evolutions of Wigner functions can approximate the dynamics of wave packet centers and wave packet deformations. Three systems of increasing complexity are considered: the quantum harmonic oscillator and the quantum anharmonic oscillator as single-band systems, and the Dirac oscillator as a two-band system. We explain the origins of the first-order semiclassical corrections (Moyal, Littlejohn-Flynn, and Berry) in the equations of motion and examine their effects on predictive accuracy. Another focus is set on the conditions for validity of the semiclassical analysis. For both the quantum anharmonic and the Dirac oscillators, a dimensionless parameter controlling the accuracy of the approximation is identified. In multi-band systems, the formalism applies only to states within a single adiabatic subspace, which, for the Dirac oscillator, corresponds to an energy branch. This motivates the construction of single-branch almost coherent states: approximately Gaussian wave packets formed by superpositions of states from a single energy branch. Their centers undergo oscillations with an aperiodic envelope. These states enable comparison between semiclassical Wigner function evolution and the commonly used Sundaram-Niu formalism. We show that semiclassical Wigner function evolution captures deformation-related dynamics, including the initial decay of oscillations, which the Sundaram-Niu formalism cannot describe by construction. Additionally, exact quantum evolution reveals partial relocalization of these single-branch almost coherent states, a phenomenon that cannot be captured by the semiclassical evolution.
articles.abstract_zh: 本硕士论文对单带和多带系统中的波动力学半经典分析进行了教学性介绍。论文展示了维格纳函数的半经典演化如何近似波包中心和波包形变的动力学。研究考虑了量子谐振子、量子非谐振子和狄拉克振子三种系统，并解释了运动方程中一阶半经典修正的来源及其对预测精度的影响。
authors: August Burg

articles.title: Universal Threshold Laws for Dipolar Evaporation of Molecular Fermi Gases
articles.title_zh: 偶极分子费米气体蒸发冷却的普适阈值定律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22639v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fermi statistics suppress the elastic collisions that rethermalize a Fermi gas during evaporative cooling, creating a fundamental low-temperature bottleneck for producing quantum degenerate gases. We show that, for shielded single-component ultracold dipolar molecular Fermi gases in the Wigner threshold regime, this bottleneck is governed by universal threshold laws fixed by the effective dimensionality of the gas. In this regime, Fermi suppression of rethermalization scales quadratically with temperature in 3D but only linearly in 2D. Consequently, the thermalization-to-loss ratio is more favorable in 2D than in 3D, and these results suggest that 2D geometries are better suited for reaching deep degeneracy. We also present ab initio close-coupling calculations that agree well with experimental measurements on Fermi degenerate gases of KRb molecules, supporting our conclusions.
articles.abstract_zh: 费米统计抑制了费米气体在蒸发冷却过程中的弹性碰撞，从而在产生量子简并气体时造成了根本性的低温瓶颈。本研究表明，对于维格纳阈值区域中受屏蔽的单组分超冷偶极分子费米气体，该瓶颈受气体有效维度决定的普适阈值定律支配。研究发现，费米抑制在3D中与温度呈二次方关系，而在2D中仅呈线性关系，这表明2D几何结构更适合实现深度简并，并得到了从头算耦合计算的支持。
authors: Kevin B. Xu, John L. Bohn, Reuben R. W. Wang

articles.title: From quantum emitters to technological platforms: a perspective on semiconductor quantum dots
articles.title_zh: 从量子发射器到技术平台：半导体量子点的展望
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23106v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Photonic quantum technologies are based on controlled photon states. To generate these, quantum dots have emerged as excellent sources of single and entangled photons. In this Perspective, we briefly review the chronological development of quantum dots as photon sources, from their beginnings as quantum emitters in the early 2000s to the advanced photonic devices being developed today. We highlight the interplay between fundamental research and industrial aspects before discussing the photonic quantum technologies we expect to emerge in the near future.
articles.abstract_zh: 光子量子技术依赖于受控光子态，而量子点已成为单光子和纠缠光子的优秀来源。本展望回顾了量子点作为光子源的编年史发展，从21世纪初的量子发射器到当今先进的光子器件。文章强调了基础研究与工业应用之间的相互作用，并讨论了预计在不久的将来出现的光子量子技术。
authors: Klaus D. Jöns, Dorian A. Gangloff, Doris E. Reiter

articles.title: Multiscale Quantum-Classical Simulation of Protein Autoproteolysis in a Million-Atom Membrane Environment
articles.title_zh: 百万原子膜环境中的蛋白质自蛋白水解多尺度量子-经典模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23108v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Predicting chemical reactions in biomolecules is challenging because reactive centers are embedded within complex environments that strongly influence their energetics and mechanisms. Here, we present a hybrid quantum-classical workflow that combines molecular dynamics, density functional theory, and correlated wavefunction methods, tightly integrating CPUs, GPUs, and quantum processing units (QPUs) to enable simulations across multiple length and accuracy scales. We apply this approach to ADGRG1 autoproteolysis, a maturation reaction in an adhesion G protein-coupled receptor that has not previously been studied using correlated electronic-structure methods. Our simulations treat a biologically realistic system containing more than one million atoms, including the full-length uncleaved receptor embedded in an endoplasmic-reticulum membrane, while incorporating a 54-qubit IQM quantum processor and up to 1,200 NVIDIA H100 GPUs. These results demonstrate how quantum computers can serve as accelerators within scalable scientific workflows, extending correlated electronic-structure methods to biologically relevant systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 预测生物分子在复杂环境中的化学反应极具挑战性。本研究提出了一种混合量子-经典工作流程，结合了分子动力学、密度泛函理论和关联波函数方法，并紧密整合了CPU、GPU和量子处理单元。该方法应用于ADGRG1自蛋白水解反应，模拟了一个包含超过一百万个原子的生物学真实系统，展示了量子计算机如何作为可扩展科学工作流程中的加速器，将关联电子结构方法扩展到生物学相关系统。
authors: Alexander Orlov, Alexis Ralli, Tim Weaving, Michael Williams de la Bastida, Reuben Martin, Zohim Chandani, Minh Chung, P. V. Sriluckshmy, Fedor Simkovic IV, Luigi Iapichino, Peter J. Love, Christian B. Mendl, Andrea Townsend-Nicholson, Peter V. Coveney

articles.title: Unconditional Quantum PAC Learning Advantage in the Large Error Regime
articles.title_zh: 大误差区域中无条件量子PAC学习优势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23268v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We establish an unconditional super-polynomial separation between quantum and classical PAC learning of Boolean functions under the uniform distribution in the large error regime. For every advantage łambda(n) = n⁻ømega⁽¹⁾, we construct a concept class that a polynomial-time quantum learner learns to agreement 1/2+łambda(n) with success probability at least 1-1/n^k. The learner uses only quantum random examples and outputs a polynomial-size deterministic classical circuit. In contrast, no polynomial-time classical learner achieves agreement 1/2 + łambda(n)/n^k with success probability greater than 1/n^k, even with membership queries. To achieve this, we develop a nearly-optimal quantum learner that uses quantum random examples to produce a hypothesis achieving a prescribed correlation with an arbitrary Boolean function. The learner generalizes Fourier sampling from parity hypotheses to quadratic hypotheses. While standard Fourier sampling is insensitive to the sign of the correlation, we use interference to bias sampling toward positively correlated hypotheses. This is combined with a careful analysis of the resulting distribution to boost both the learner's success probability and its agreement with the target function. We believe that the resulting quantum learning algorithm might be of independent interest. Finally, although a robust quantum PAC learning advantage holds unconditionally in the large error regime, we note that an analogous separation between quantum and classical learning in the small error regime would imply that mathsfNP nsubseteq mathsfBPP.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究在大误差区域中，建立了在均匀分布下布尔函数量子PAC学习与经典PAC学习之间无条件的超多项式分离。对于任意优势函数，量子学习器能够以高成功概率学习概念类，并输出多项式大小的确定性经典电路。相比之下，经典学习器即使有成员查询也无法达到相同的性能，这得益于一种将傅里叶采样推广到二次假设的近乎最优量子学习器。
authors: Igor C. Oliveira

articles.title: Action-Quantized Scar Multiplets and Dissipative Cat States from Fractal Period-Locking in the Open Quantum Baker Map
articles.title_zh: 开放量子贝克映射中分形周期锁定产生的行动量子化疤痕多重态和耗散猫态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23573v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We open the quantum baker map with a position window of width w and center q_c. Classical pruning tiles the (q_c,w) plane into diamonds where the T leading resonances form root-of-unity multiplets. At w=1/2 one periodic orbit survives for almost every q_c, and the multiplets are quantized without free parameters: their modulus 2⁻¹/² saturates the pressure bound and their phase is the orbit action. They form cycling multicomponent cat states, and the opening becomes one mid-circuit measurement, enabling spectroscopy with sim10² shots on quantum processors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究通过宽度为w、中心为q_c的位置窗口打开量子贝克映射。经典修剪将(q_c,w)平面划分为菱形区域，其中T个主导共振形成单位根多重态。在w=1/2时，几乎每个q_c都存在一个周期轨道，多重态被无参数地量子化，其模数达到压力界限，相位为轨道作用量。它们形成循环多组分猫态，并且该开放过程成为一次中电路测量，使得量子处理器能够进行约10²次光谱测量。
authors: Leonardo Ermann

articles.title: Scaling of entanglement with distance between subsystems: detection of phase transitions in the t'-π-flux model
articles.title_zh: 子系统间纠缠随距离的标度：t'-π-通量模型中相变的检测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23770v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The system-size scaling of bipartite entanglement can be used to detect phase transitions. We develop a related approach for strongly correlated electron models where large density matrices or large system size scaling are inaccessible. To this end, we demonstrate that phase transitions of various kinds are signaled by a sharp signature in the first- or second-order logarithmic derivatives of the negativity measuring entanglement between small clusters at varying distances. Crucially, we show how to mitigate the effect of quantum Monte Carlo noise at large distances when computing the negativity. Our focus is on the t'-π-flux Hubbard model using auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo simulations. It has the particular advantage of showing three distinct phase transitions in a single model: semimetal to band insulator, semimetal to antiferromagnetic Mott insulator, and a magnetic order-disorder transition belonging to the Gaussian, Gross-Neveu, and O(3) Wilson-Fisher universality classes, respectively.
articles.abstract_zh: 双分量纠缠的系统尺寸标度可用于检测相变。本研究为强关联电子模型开发了一种相关方法，通过分析小簇之间纠缠负性对距离的一阶或二阶对数导数的尖锐特征来检测各种相变。研究展示了如何在大距离计算负性时减轻量子蒙特卡洛噪声的影响，并将其应用于t'-π-通量哈伯德模型，该模型在一个模型中展现了三种不同的相变。
authors: Maksim Ulybyshev, Gergő Roósz, Gabriele Bellomia, Karsten Held, Fakher Assaad, Frederic Bippus

articles.title: Experimental Demonstration of a Balanced Travelling Wave Parametric Amplifier
articles.title_zh: 平衡行波参量放大器的实验演示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23810v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Superconducting travelling-wave parametric amplifiers (TWPAs) provide broadband gain, low added noise, and high dynamic range, making them attractive for applications requiring wide instantaneous bandwidth. This is crucial for amplifying multiplexed narrow band signals spread over a wide frequency range, such as qubit resonator arrays, or amplifying inherently wide band signals, such as in spectrometers or radiometers. In many cases, however, the useful bandwidth of a TWPA is limited by the production of the idler tone at an image frequency. For three-wave-mixing (3WM) TWPAs, for example, an input signal at fₛ is indistinguishable from one at fₚ - fₛ, which can produce spectral ambiguity when the input spectrum is broadband or not known in advance. We experimentally demonstrate a balanced architecture that doubles the instantaneous image-rejected bandwidth available to a 3WM TWPA by spatially separating the amplified signal from the output pump and generated idler, which resolves the sideband degeneracy. The architecture consists of two amplifiers connected between a pair of 180ⁱ̧rc hybrid couplers, with the signal and pump injected and output through the sum and difference ports, respectively. Using two kinetic-inductance TWPAs, we demonstrate approximately 20 dB of signal gain across nearly an octave of bandwidth, together with pump rejection below --20 dB and an average image rejection of approximately --15 dB over the operating band. These results establish balanced TWPAs as a practical approach to broadband parametric amplification, enabling improved contamination free bandwidth and eliminating the need for complex filtering.
articles.abstract_zh: 超导行波参量放大器（TWPA）提供宽带增益、低附加噪声和高动态范围，但其有用带宽常受限于闲频音的产生。本论文实验演示了一种平衡架构，通过空间分离放大信号与输出泵浦和产生的闲频音，将三波混频（3WM）TWPA的瞬时图像抑制带宽加倍，从而解决了边带简并问题，这对于需要宽瞬时带宽的应用至关重要。
authors: Nikita Klimovich, Peter K. Day, Henry G. Leduc, Boon-Kok Tan

articles.title: MIP*=RE
articles.title_zh: MIP*=RE
articles.abstract: arXiv:2001.04383v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We show that the class MIP* of languages that can be decided by a classical verifier interacting with multiple all-powerful quantum provers sharing entanglement is equal to the class RE of recursively enumerable languages. Our proof builds upon the quantum low-degree test of (Natarajan and Vidick, FOCS 2018) and the classical low-individual degree test of (Ji, et al., 2020) by integrating recent developments from (Natarajan and Wright, FOCS 2019) and combining them with the recursive compression framework of (Fitzsimons et al., STOC 2019). An immediate byproduct of our result is that there is an efficient reduction from the Halting Problem to the problem of deciding whether a two-player nonlocal game has entangled value 1 or at most 1/2. Using a known connection, undecidability of the entangled value implies a negative answer to Tsirelson's problem: we show, by providing an explicit example, that the closure Cqₐ of the set of quantum tensor product correlations is strictly included in the set Cqc of quantum commuting correlations. Following work of (Fritz, Rev. Math. Phys. 2012) and (Junge et al., J. Math. Phys. 2011) our results provide a refutation of Connes' embedding conjecture from the theory of von Neumann algebras.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究证明了MIP*类（可由经典验证者与多个共享纠缠的强大量子证明者交互决定的语言）等于RE类（递归可枚举语言）。该证明建立在量子低度测试和经典低个体度测试的基础上，并整合了最新进展。一个直接的副产品是，存在从停机问题到判断双玩家非局部游戏纠缠值的问题的有效归约，这暗示了对Tsirelson问题的否定答案。
authors: Zhengfeng Ji, Anand Natarajan, Thomas Vidick, John Wright, Henry Yuen

articles.title: Molecular Ground State Simulation by Subspace Restriction and Hund's Rule
articles.title_zh: 通过子空间限制和洪特规则进行分子基态模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2404.03268v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Subspace Restriction Scheme (SRS) is presented to address the qubit and resource constraints of molecular simulation on near-term quantum hardware. SRS restricts a molecular Hamiltonian to a selected determinant subspace before qubit encoding, so a D-dimensional subspace requires only q=łceilłog₂Dc̊eil qubits. We apply SRS to the established seniority-resolved Multi-Hund Subspaces MHS(Ømega) and develop compact encodings for these sectors. At fixed seniority and filling fraction, MHS asymptotically uses about half as many qubits as a compact particle-conserving encoding. For the H₂₂ chain, the register shrinks from 44 to 20 qubits. Compression can nevertheless increase Pauli-operator density and does not always reduce measurement cost. In noiseless VQE benchmarks, shallow circuits reach within 1.6~mHa of the exact subspace minima using only 4--30 CNOT gates. However, the corresponding subspace minima for LiH, HF, OH, and CH remain 4.39--9.73~mHa above FCI. Full-space UCCSD reaches chemical accuracy but requires hundreds to thousands of CNOT gates. SRS therefore provides a controlled resource--accuracy trade-off when register width is the binding constraint and the target state is well represented within a selected seniority sector.
articles.abstract_zh: 子空间限制方案（SRS）旨在解决近期量子硬件上分子模拟的量子比特和资源限制。SRS在量子比特编码前将分子哈密顿量限制到选定的行列式子空间，从而显著减少所需的量子比特数量。虽然压缩可能增加泡利算符密度，但无噪声VQE基准测试表明，浅层电路在子空间内能达到良好精度，尽管子空间最小值可能仍高于FCI。
authors: Tsung-Chi Chiang, Calvin Ku, Jyh-Pin Chou, Alice Hu, Peng-Jen Chen, Ching-Jui Lai

articles.title: Inverse Current in Coupled Transport: A Quantum Thermodynamic Model
articles.title_zh: 耦合输运中的逆电流：一个量子热力学模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2405.01295v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The recent discovery of inverse current in coupled transport (ICC) in classical systems [Wang et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 124, 110607 (2020)] -- where an induced current flows opposite to two mutually parallel thermodynamic forces, yet remains consistent with the second law of thermodynamics--reveals a striking and counterintuitive transport phenomenon. Using an exactly solvable model of strongly coupled quantum dots, we develop a thermodynamic framework to describe the ICC phenomenon at the quantum level. By systematically connecting the microscopic and macroscopic formulations of the entropy production rate in terms of appropriate entropic biases and entropic fluxes, our analysis identifies the conditions under which a genuine ICC effect can arise in quantum thermal transport and highlights potential applications in autonomous quantum engines and refrigerators.
articles.abstract_zh: 耦合输运中逆电流（ICC）的最新发现揭示了一种反直觉的输运现象。本研究利用一个可精确求解的强耦合量子点模型，建立了一个热力学框架来描述量子层面的ICC现象。通过系统地将微观和宏观熵产生率公式联系起来，分析确定了量子热输运中产生真正ICC效应的条件，并强调了其在自主量子引擎和冰箱中的潜在应用。
authors: Shuvadip Ghosh, Nikhil Gupt, Arnab Ghosh

articles.title: Predicting Dynamics from Flows of the Eigenstate Thermalization Hypothesis
articles.title_zh: 从本征态热化假设的流中预测动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.01073v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Analytical treatments of far-from-equilibrium quantum dynamics are few, even in well-thermalizing systems. The celebrated eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (ETH) provides a post hoc ansatz for the matrix elements of observables in the eigenbasis of a thermalizing Hamiltonian, given various response functions of those observables as input. However, the ETH cannot predict these response functions. We introduce a procedure, dubbed the statistical Jacobi approximation (SJA), to update the ETH ansatz after a perturbation to the Hamiltonian and predict perturbed response functions. The Jacobi algorithm diagonalizes the perturbation through a sequence of two-level rotations. The SJA implements these rotations statistically assuming the ETH throughout the diagonalization procedure, and generates integrodifferential flow equations for various form factors in the ETH ansatz. We approximately solve these flow equations using statistical information about Jacobi rotations as input, and predict both quench dynamics and autocorrelators in the thermal state of the perturbed Hamiltonian. The predicted dynamics agree with exact numerics in both random matrix models and spin chains, outperforming second-order time-dependent perturbation theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 远离平衡态量子动力学的解析处理方法很少。本研究引入了一种统计雅可比近似（SJA）程序，用于在哈密顿量受到扰动后更新本征态热化假设（ETH）的假设并预测受扰动的响应函数。SJA通过统计假设在对角化过程中生成ETH假设中各种形状因子的积分微分流方程。预测的动力学与精确数值结果吻合。
authors: Dominik Hahn, David M. Long, Marin Bukov, Anushya Chandran

articles.title: Characterization of Linear Measurements in Cavity Optomechanics: Examples and Applications
articles.title_zh: 腔光力学中线性测量的表征：示例与应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.21419v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Detailed understanding of physical measurements is essential for devising efficient metrological strategies and measurement-feedback schemes, as well as finding fundamental limitations on measurement sensitivity. In the quantum regime, measurements modify the state of the system of interest through measurement backaction as a direct consequence of the Heisenberg principle. In cavity optomechanics and electromechanics, a plethora of strategies exist for measuring the mechanical motion using electromagnetic fields, each leading to different competition between measurement imprecision and backaction. While this range of techniques allows broad applications of optomechanical and electromechanical devices, it makes direct comparison of different measurement methods difficult. We develop a formalism for quantifying the performance of optomechanical measurements using a few relevant figures of merit. Our approach is inspired by similar characterizations in quantum optics and quantifies the main properties of quantum measurements -- the ability to distinguish different quantum states and preservation of signal in the presence of measurement noise. We demonstrate our concept on the most common optomechanical measurements -- displacement detection, coherent quantum noise cancellation, and quantum nondemolition measurements -- and perform detailed analysis of errors in optomechanical nondemolition measurements. This newly acquired knowledge allows us to propose a strategy for quantum nondemolition measurements in levitodynamics using coherent scattering. Our results complement existing knowledge of linear optomechanical interactions and open the way to new understanding of optomechanical measurements, thus allowing also novel applications of optomechanical devices in fundamental physics and quantum technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文旨在深入理解物理测量，以开发高效的计量策略并确定测量灵敏度的基本限制。作者提出了一种形式体系，用于量化腔光力学测量的性能，通过少数几个相关的品质因数进行评估。该方法借鉴了量子光学中的类似表征，并量化了量子测量的主要特性，即区分不同量子态的能力以及在测量存在下信号的保持。
authors: F. Bemani, O. Černotík, R. Filip

articles.title: Diagrammatic Reasoning with Control as a Constructor, Applications to Quantum Circuits
articles.title_zh: 以控制作为构造子的图示推理及其在量子电路中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.21756v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Control is a fundamental concept in quantum and reversible computational models. It enables the conditional application of a transformation to a system, depending on the state of another system. We introduce a general framework for diagrammatic reasoning featuring control as a constructor. To this end, we provide an elementary axiomatization of control functors, extending the standard formalism of PROPs to controlled PROPs. As an application, we show that controlled PROPs facilitate diagrammatic reasoning for quantum circuits by introducing a simple and complete set of relations involving at most three qubits, whereas in the standard PROP setting any complete axiomatization necessarily requires relations acting on arbitrarily many qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 控制是量子和可逆计算模型中的一个基本概念。本文引入了一个以控制作为构造子的图示推理通用框架，并对控制函子进行了基本公理化，将PROPs的标准形式主义扩展到受控PROPs。作为应用，研究表明受控PROPs通过引入涉及最多三个量子比特的简单完整关系集，简化了量子电路的图示推理。
authors: Noé Delorme, Simon Perdrix

articles.title: The three kinds of three-qubit entanglement
articles.title_zh: 三量子比特纠缠的三种类型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.07617v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We construct an important missing piece in the entanglement theory of pure three-qubit states, which is a polynomial measure of W-entanglement. This works in parallel to the three-tangle, which is a polynomial measure of GHZ-entanglement, and to the bipartite concurrence, which is a polynomial measure of bipartite entanglement. We also show that these entanglement measures are ordered, the bipartite measure is larger than the W measure, which is larger than the GHZ measure. It is meaningful then to consider these three types of three-qubit entanglement, which are also ordered, bipartite is weaker than W, which is weaker than GHZ, in parallel to the order of the three kinds of equivalence classes of entangled three-qubit states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构建了纯三量子比特态纠缠理论中一个重要的缺失部分，即W型纠缠的多项式度量。该度量与GHZ型纠缠的三缠结以及双体纠缠的双体并发度量并行。研究还表明这些纠缠度量是存在序关系的，双体度量大于W度量，W度量大于GHZ度量，这与三类纠缠三量子比特态的等价类顺序相对应。
authors: Szilárd Szalay

articles.title: Analysis of Hydrogen Contamination in Al/AlOx/Al Josephson Junctions
articles.title_zh: Al/AlOx/Al约瑟夫森结中氢污染的分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.14113v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Hydrogen contamination in Josephson junctions may contribute to device-to-device variability in superconducting qubits, yet its incorporation, location, and bonding in tunnel barriers remain poorly understood. We combine molecular dynamics simulations of aluminum oxidation in dense O2 and H2O environments with atomistic quantum transport calculations. The simulations produce amorphous AlOx barriers with experimentally relevant hydrogen concentrations. Analysis of 400 statistically independent samples shows that the number of incorporated H atoms follows a beta-binomial distribution, reflecting correlations arising from self-limiting oxidation. Most H atoms reside near the AlOx surface, primarily in Al-OH and Al-OH-Al motifs. Quantum transport calculations for Al/Al2O3/Al junctions reveal that hydrogen enhances transmission near the Fermi level by creating an interface dipole that shifts the oxide bands relative to the electrode Fermi level. Combining hydrogen-number statistics with calculated transmission coefficients yields a probability distribution for the Josephson energy. At an average hydrogen content of 2.56 at.%, we predict E_J/h = 10.23 GHz with a standard deviation of 3.6 MHz. Hydrogen shifts the mean Josephson energy by approximately 11%, proportionally to its concentration, but contributes far less to device-to-device variability than observed in state-of-the-art fabricated junctions. These findings provide an atomistic understanding of hydrogen incorporation and its impact on Josephson energy.
articles.abstract_zh: 约瑟夫森结中的氢污染可能导致超导量子比特的器件间差异，但其在隧穿势垒中的掺入、位置和键合机制尚不清楚。本文结合了铝在O2和H2O环境中氧化的分子动力学模拟与原子级量子输运计算。研究发现氢原子主要以Al-OH和Al-OH-Al形式存在于AlOx表面附近，并通过创建界面偶极子增强了费米能级附近的传输。
authors: Yu Zhu, Aldilene Saraiva-Souza, Félix Beaudoin, Hong Guo

articles.title: Logarithmic-depth quantum state preparation of polynomials
articles.title_zh: 多项式对数深度量子态制备
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.16527v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum state preparation is a central primitive in many quantum algorithms, yet it is generally resource intensive, with efficient constructions known only for structured families of states. This work introduces a method for preparing quantum states whose amplitudes are given by a degree-d polynomial, using circuits with logarithmic depth in the number n of qubits and only mathcal O(n) ancilla qubits, improving previous approaches that required linear-depth circuits. The construction first relies on a block-encoding of an affine diagonal operator based on its Pauli-basis decomposition, which involves only n terms. A modified linear-combination-of-unitaries (LCU) technique is introduced to implement this decomposition in logarithmic depth, together with a novel circuit for the EXACT-one oracle that flags basis states in which exactly one qubit is in the state |1ångle. It then uses a generalized quantum eigenvalue transformation (GQET) to promote this affine operator to an arbitrary degree polynomial. Theoretical analysis and numerical simulations are reported along with a proof-of-principle implementation on a trapped-ion quantum processor using 14 qubits and more than 500 primitive quantum gates. Because polynomial approximations are ubiquitous in scientific computing, this construction provides a scalable and resource-efficient approach to quantum state preparation, further improving the potential of quantum algorithms in fields such as chemistry, physics, engineering, and finance.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子态制备是许多量子算法中的核心原语，但通常资源密集。本文提出了一种制备量子态的方法，其振幅由d次多项式给出，使用对数深度电路和O(n)个辅助量子比特，改进了先前需要线性深度电路的方法。该构造依赖于仿射对角算子的块编码，并引入了改进的酉算子线性组合技术和广义量子特征值变换。
authors: Baptiste Claudon, Alexis Lucas, Jean-Philip Piquemal, César Feniou, Julien Zylberman

articles.title: Quantum instanton theory for metastable collective spin systems
articles.title_zh: 亚稳态集体自旋系统的量子瞬子理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.15091v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Collective spin systems -- driven-dissipative spin ensembles whose unitary and dissipative processes act uniformly on all spins, allowing their dynamics to be described as a single macrospin -- play an important role in atomic and solid-state physics. Their intrinsic nonlinearity gives rise to multiple long-lived metastable states that ultimately relax to a unique most probable state. This dominant state can change with a control parameter, leading to first-order phase transitions. We develop a real-time instanton approach based on quantum quasiprobability dynamics that captures the stationary state in the large-spin limit and the asymptotic scaling of relaxation rates. We further show that these features are not accurately described by the previously applied semiclassical Wigner approach due to its neglect of non-Gaussian fluctuations.
articles.abstract_zh: 集体自旋系统在原子和固态物理中扮演着重要角色，其固有的非线性导致多个长寿命亚稳态。本文开发了一种基于量子准概率动力学的实时瞬子方法，该方法能够捕捉大自旋极限下的稳态和弛豫速率的渐近标度。研究还表明，先前应用的半经典维格纳方法由于忽略非高斯涨落，无法准确描述这些特征。
authors: Krzysztof Ptaszynski, Maciej Chudak, Massimiliano Esposito

articles.title: Probability distribution analysis of the cascaded variational quantum eigensolver
articles.title_zh: 级联变分量子本征求解器中的概率分布分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.00807v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The cascaded variational quantum eigensolver (CVQE) circumvents the need for iterative communication between the quantum and classical processing units that is necessary in the conventional VQE algorithm. While CVQE offers complete freedom to choose the guiding state as input, not all guiding states provide both accurate solutions and efficient resource usage. Our work presents a process based on trapezoidal-state preparation for selecting guiding states that yield accurate many-electron ground-state solutions with minimal resource consumption. By analyzing state probability distributions at different stages of CVQE calculations for the collision complex mediating the H₂ + H₂⁺ i̊ghtarrow H₃⁺ + H bimolecular reaction, we identify stage-specific errors, trace their impact on final classical optimization, and determine the optimal guiding-state parameters for given resource constraints. Our findings uncover a critical trade-off on noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) devices, demonstrating that shallower diabatic circuits provide the best compromise among optimization efficiency, state quality, sampling cost, and signal-to-noise ratio in our system.
articles.abstract_zh: 级联变分量子本征求解器（CVQE）避免了传统VQE算法中量子与经典处理单元之间迭代通信的需求。本文提出了一种基于梯形态制备的方法，用于选择能够以最小资源消耗获得准确多电子基态解的引导态。通过分析CVQE计算中不同阶段的态概率分布，研究揭示了在噪声中等规模量子（NISQ）设备上，较浅的绝热电路在优化效率、态质量、采样成本和信噪比之间提供了最佳折衷。
authors: Yi-Hua Lai, John P. T. Stenger, Gloria Bazargan, Igor V. Schweigert, Daniel Gunlycke

articles.title: Separability from Multipartite Measures
articles.title_zh: 基于多体度量的可分离性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.02097v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We show that multi-invariants provide necessary and sufficient criteria for full separability in finite-dimensional multipartite systems. For tripartite three-qubit states, the third-order negativity gives an exact criterion for full separability for both pure and mixed states. We then extend the framework to four-qubit pure states, whose full characterization requires eighteen independent real parameters. We identify eighteen independent entanglement measures, consisting of six bipartite, eight tripartite, and four quadripartite measures, with the third-order negativity serving as a key separability criterion. Finally, we generalize the construction to multipartite qudit systems and discuss an application to conformal field theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了多不变量为有限维多体系统中的完全可分离性提供了充要条件。对于三体三量子比特态，三阶负性为纯态和混合态的完全可分离性提供了精确判据。研究将该框架扩展到四量子比特纯态，并识别出十八个独立的纠缠度量，其中三阶负性是关键的可分离性判据。
authors: Chen-Te Ma, Ma-Ke Yuan

articles.title: Caustics and catastrophes in strong-field physics - Picard-Lefschetz theory as a universal approach to saddle-point methods in attosecond science
articles.title_zh: 强场物理中的焦散和突变——Picard-Lefschetz理论作为阿秒科学中鞍点方法的通用方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.03794v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ultrashort laser pulses on the attosecond timescale are typically achieved via high-order harmonic generation (HHG), a nonlinear process in which atoms interact with intense light fields to emit a broad spectrum of harmonics. HHG is commonly described in terms of a `quantum orbits' model based on several interfering electron trajectories, thereby incorporating both quantum-mechanical effects and an intuitive picture of classical dynamics. By tuning the parameters of the driving laser field, the interplay between these trajectories can be controlled, shaping the emitted light. Mathematically, this model expresses the harmonic response as a highly oscillatory integral. Applying saddle-point methods to this integral allows it to be decomposed into contributions from distinct saddle points of the semi-classical action, thereby linking quantum dynamics to classical trajectories. However, a general framework for applying these methods across arbitrary parameters and laser configurations has been missing. In this thesis, we introduce Picard-Lefschetz theory and develop practical numerical methods for its application. These enable the evaluation of oscillatory integrals and identification of contributions from individual critical points. We apply these techniques to strong-field ionisation and HHG, focusing on caustics - enhancement features where trajectories coalesce and standard approximations fail. Our methods remain valid in these regions, allowing systematic analysis of parameter regimes and revealing previously inaccessible features. This work improves the understanding and control of ultrafast light-matter interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 阿秒超短激光脉冲通常通过高次谐波产生（HHG）实现，这是一种非线性过程。本文引入了Picard-Lefschetz理论，并开发了其应用的实用数值方法，以解决在任意参数和激光配置下应用鞍点方法缺乏通用框架的问题。这些方法能够评估高振荡积分，从而将量子动力学与经典轨迹联系起来。
authors: Anne Weber

articles.title: A finite-shot mean-squared-error boundary for Richardson zero-noise extrapolation
articles.title_zh: Richardson零噪声外推的有限次测量均方误差边界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.08251v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Zero-noise extrapolation (ZNE) reduces the bias of noisy quantum-circuit measurements, but Richardson coefficients and shot splitting increase their statistical error. This paper determines the noise strength at which Richardson ZNE starts to lower the mean-squared error relative to the unmitigated estimator at a fixed shot budget B. The boundary is set by the balance between the leading squared-bias improvement and the leading excess-variance penalty: depending on the variance exponent of the measurement, it shrinks with B, becomes a budget threshold, or disappears. For fixed Richardson extrapolation with linear leading bias, the Richardson order and the shot allocation change only constants; the boundary exponent is set by the measured observable and protocol. Deterministic stabilizer measurements and nonzero-variance Hamiltonian or variational-energy measurements have boundaries that shrink as B⁻¹ and B⁻¹/², and for finite-outcome shot measurements these two classes are the only ones. Qiskit Aer simulations of Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) and quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) circuits reproduce this separation, and on IBM Quantum hardware ZNE lowers the mean-squared error at equal budget in 75 of 101 instances.
articles.abstract_zh: 零噪声外推（ZNE）可以减少噪声量子电路测量的偏差，但Richardson系数和测量次数分配会增加统计误差。本文确定了在固定测量预算下，Richardson ZNE开始降低相对于未缓解估计器的均方误差的噪声强度边界。该边界由主导的平方偏差改进和主导的超额方差惩罚之间的平衡决定，并得到了GHZ和QAOA电路的Qiskit Aer模拟验证。
authors: Vicenzo Scavino Alfaro

articles.title: Spectral theory of energy-selective quantum search with Ising Hamiltonian phase oracles
articles.title_zh: 基于伊辛哈密顿量相位预言机的能量选择性量子搜索的谱理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.03380v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We develop an exact spectral-response theory for the Grover-type iterate (W_T=D_ξexp(-i T H)), in which the evolution generated by a diagonal Ising Hamiltonian is used directly as a continuous phase oracle. An energy-grouped recurrence and its generating-function solution show how the empirical characteristic function determines the position, width, height, and saturation time of an energy-selective resonance. For an annealed Gaussian density of states, a high-density-tail resonance containing (M) configurations is reached after (Θ(sqrt2ⁿ/M)) oracle calls with success probability (Θ(1)), giving a quadratic query improvement over independent uniform sampling with classical energy evaluation. For correlated random Ising spectra, overlap-dependent covariances lead to a realization-dependent resonance shift with root-mean-square scale (O(n⁻³)), parametrically larger than the resonance width, and can also reduce the peak height. The shift is both an algorithmic detuning and a coherent probe of sample-specific spectral fluctuations whose ensemble statistics reflect the Ising overlap structure. Spectral symmetrization and iterative calibration can remove or compensate the resonance-center displacement for prescribed-energy targeting. We also clarify the relation to designed spectral filters and the precision and coherence requirements of this asymptotic primitive.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为Grover型迭代器开发了一种精确的谱响应理论，其中由对角伊辛哈密顿量产生的演化直接用作连续相位预言机。能量分组递推及其生成函数解展示了经验特征函数如何确定能量选择性共振的位置、宽度、高度和饱和时间。对于退火高斯态密度，高密度尾部共振在Θ(sqrt2ⁿ/M)次预言机调用后达到，成功概率为Θ(1)，实现了查询的二次加速。
authors: A. S. Plyashechnik, A. A. Zhukov, A. V. Lebedev, W. V. Pogosov

articles.title: Optimal single-copy estimation of quantum state moments: why øperatornameTr(h̊o³⁾ and øperatornameTr(h̊o⁴⁾ are equally hard
articles.title_zh: 量子态矩的单拷贝最优估计：为何 Tr(ρ³) 和 Tr(ρ⁴) 同样困难
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.37781v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Estimating nonlinear properties of an unknown quantum state with restrictive experimental accessibility is a fundamental problem in quantum learning. We study the sample complexity of estimating the state moments øperatornameTr(h̊o^t), allowing arbitrary adaptive single-copy measurements. While purity estimation has optimal sample complexity Θ(sqrt d) at constant additive error, the optimal dimension dependence for higher moments has remained unclear. We resolve this question for every fixed integer tge 2: for any sufficiently small constant additive error, the optimal sample complexity is [ Θ!łeft(dfracłceⁱlłog₂ tc̊eⁱl¹⁺łceⁱlłog₂ tc̊eⁱli̊ght) ] with constant success probability. The complexity thus follows a dyadic hierarchy: for each integer h≥1, all moment orders 2h⁻¹
articles.abstract_zh: 量子学习中，估计未知量子态的非线性性质是一个基本问题。本文研究了在允许任意自适应单拷贝测量的情况下，估计量子态矩 Tr(ρ^t) 的样本复杂度。研究发现，对于任意固定的整数 t≥2 和足够小的常数加性误差，最优样本复杂度遵循一个二进层级结构，解决了高阶矩最优维度依赖性的问题。
authors: Zhenhuan Liu

articles.title: Anyon bound states in MoTe₂ Fractional Chern Insulators
articles.title_zh: MoTe₂ 分数量子霍尔绝缘体中的任意子束缚态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22473v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Binding anyons to optically active excitons offers a route to manipulate fractional excitations and reveal the internal spatial structure of anyons. We establish the formation of anyon bound states between a mobile dipolar exciton and an e/3 quasihole in a twisted bilayer MoTe₂ fractional Chern insulator. Using exact diagonalization of a continuum-based interacting model, we identify a regime of meV-scale binding and strong exciton-quasihole entanglement controlled by exciton mobility and the distance between the exciton and the FCI. Spatial correlations resolve a localized depletion core carrying approximately e/3 charge around the exciton, providing a real-space characterization of the bound state. Beyond its fractional charge, the quasihole exhibits a moiré-induced octupolar structure. Interlayer tunneling anisotropy strongly deforms this structure while leaving the enclosed charge nearly unchanged, linking the internal profile of the anyon to the underlying electronic quantum geometry. These findings establish conditions for robust exciton-anyon binding in moiré heterostructures and show how these composites provide access to properties of fractional excitations beyond their total charge.
articles.abstract_zh: 将任意子与光学活性激子结合，为操纵分数激发和揭示任意子内部空间结构提供了途径。本文通过对连续相互作用模型进行精确对角化，证实了在扭曲双层MoTe₂分数量子霍尔绝缘体中，移动偶极激子与e/3准空穴之间形成了任意子束缚态。这些发现为莫尔异质结构中激子-任意子稳健结合提供了条件，并展示了这些复合体如何提供对任意子性质的深入理解。
authors: Tianhong Lu, Luiz H. Santos

articles.title: Fractional Chern insulators and composite Fermi liquids vs. charge order in twisted MoTe₂
articles.title_zh: 扭曲MoTe₂中的分数量子霍尔绝缘体、复合费米液体与电荷序的竞争
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22479v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The bandstructure of twisted MoTe₂ around 3.7ⁱ̧rc consists of spin-valley locked Chern bands with a bandwidth that is smaller than the interaction scale. As such, the strongly correlated phases familiar from Landau levels can be realized: Quantum Hall states, composite Fermi liquids and charge order. These states have in common that they are all favoured by strong interactions, however changing the quantum geometry and topology of the bands as well as their bandwidth via the displacement field and twist angle tilts the balance between them. We provide a comprehensive exact diagonalization analysis of the competition between these states and in particular elucidate the nature of the charge order at fillings ν=-frac14,-frac13,-frac12,-frac23. Furthermore, we analyze the effect of band mixing by going beyond a single band per valley. This effect of band mixing is crucial for reconciling the numerical phase diagrams with experimental observations.
articles.abstract_zh: 扭曲MoTe₂的能带结构在特定角度下由自旋谷锁定的陈能带组成，其带宽小于相互作用尺度，从而可实现强关联相。本文通过全面的精确对角化分析，阐明了量子霍尔态、复合费米液体和电荷序这些强关联态之间的竞争关系，并特别揭示了在填充因子 ν=-1/4, -1/3, -1/2, -2/3 处的电荷序性质。研究还分析了超越单谷单能带模型的能带混合效应，发现其对于协调数值相图与实验观测至关重要。
authors: Enrique Aguilar-Méndez, Glenn Wagner

articles.title: Quantum-interference correction to conductivity in disordered electronic bands with non-uniform quantum geometry
articles.title_zh: 具有非均匀量子几何的无序电子能带中电导率的量子干涉修正
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22500v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Weak localization in two-dimensional disordered electron systems originates from constructive interference between time-reversed scattering paths, giving rise to a logarithmically divergent quantum-interference correction to the dc conductivity. This behavior is generally suppressed when time-reversal symmetry (TRS) is broken. In this study, using a band-projected framework motivated by spin- and valley-polarized rhombohedral N-layer graphene (RNG), we show that nonuniform quantum geometry can qualitatively modify quantum-interference corrections to dc transport. In particular, continuously tuning the quantum geometry can change the sign of the conductivity correction, corresponding to a crossover between localization and antilocalization tendencies. Remarkably, at special values of the parameter controlling the quantum geometry, weak-localization (WL) or weak-antilocalization (WAL) can re-emerge despite broken microscopic TRS. At these special points, the orbital structure of the Bloch states gives rise to an emergent antiunitary symmetry that protects a gapless Cooperon mode and restores the logarithmically divergent quantum-interference correction characteristic of WL or WAL. Our results establish nonuniform quantum geometry as a mechanism for controlling quantum interference and electron localization in multiorbital electronic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维无序电子系统中的弱局域化源于时间反演散射路径的相长干涉，导致直流电导率的对数发散量子干涉修正。本文研究表明，非均匀量子几何可以定性地改变直流输运的量子干涉修正。通过连续调节量子几何，可以改变电导率修正的符号，实现局域化和反局域化趋势之间的转变。值得注意的是，即使微观时间反演对称性被破坏，弱局域化或弱反局域化仍可在特殊参数值处重新出现。
authors: Yip Chun Wong, Asimpunya Mitra, Yong Baek Kim

articles.title: Kitaev, semi-Dirac, and spinon quantum spin Hall liquids on the square-hexagon-dodecagon lattice: A parent projective symmetry group classification
articles.title_zh: 方-六边形-十二边形晶格上的Kitaev、半狄拉克和自旋子量子自旋霍尔液体：母体投影对称群分类
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22965v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The square-hexagon-dodecagon (SHD) lattice hosts an exactly solvable Kitaev spin liquid, while further-neighbor couplings frustrate its Heisenberg magnet into classically degenerate lines where quantum fluctuations can melt the Néel order. To place this state among the lattice's spin liquids, we classify fermionic parton mean-field states with singlet and spin-orbit-coupled triplet amplitudes by their projective symmetry groups (PSGs). As SHD sites lack site symmetry, its Z₂ PSGs are the projective classes of p6mm with time reversal, from which those of every single-orbit p6mm lattice follow. In the idealized Kitaev model, where lattice operations do not rotate spins, these liquids carry a single Z₂ PSG descending from the SU(2) Lieb-flux state, and their projections are exact eigenstates. The PSG's sixfold-rotation sign, fixed by the dodecagon flux, doubles all Majorana bands, and the mirrors exclude a chiral phase in any uniform field, so only a sublattice-staggered three-spin term drives the non-Abelian Ising phase. Beyond the Kitaev state, we find a critical semi-Dirac spin liquid, with mean-field correlations propto r⁻³ along three directions and r⁻⁶ otherwise, and extended Dirac phases with up to 48 fermion flavors, among them an N_f=12 state whose PSG forbids every singlet mass. Out-of-plane Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya couplings gap the Dirac states of its U(1) class into a mean-field spinon counterpart of the Kane-Mele quantum spin Hall insulator, with spin Chern number 1 or 3 and spin-carrying monopoles. Chiral states imply Kalmeyer-Laughlin, semion×semion, and three-fermion orders, rotation-breaking ones show q→ -q asymmetric neutron spectra, and sign-alternating fluxes break time reversal alone. Masses and monopoles in these many-flavor phases and the energetics of frustrated SHD Heisenberg models are natural next steps.
articles.abstract_zh: 方-六边形-十二边形（SHD）晶格可承载精确可解的Kitaev自旋液体。本文通过投影对称群（PSGs）对具有单重态和自旋轨道耦合三重态幅度的费米子部分子平均场态进行分类，以理解SHD晶格上的自旋液体。研究发现，在理想化的Kitaev模型中，这些液体具有单一的Z₂ PSG，并且PSG的六重旋转符号使所有马约拉纳能带加倍。除了Kitaev态，还发现了一种临界半狄拉克自旋液体。
authors: Harsh Raj, Yasir Iqbal

articles.title: Transport Signatures of a Kinetically Self-Trapped Nagaoka Polaron
articles.title_zh: 动力学自陷Nagaoka极化子的输运特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23013v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nagaoka polarons are canonical examples of kinetic magnetism. Although their spin structure is well understood, their transport remains unexplored. We compute the dynamical mobility of a single hole in the square-lattice t-model using resummation-based quantum Monte Carlo and analytic continuation. Upon cooling, an incoherent Drude-like response gives way to a finite-frequency peak as the dc mobility vanishes. The peak signals an internal mode of a hole confined by its ferromagnetic cloud. Our results establish transport as an incisive probe of polaron formation and kinetic self-trapping.
articles.abstract_zh: Nagaoka极化子是动力学磁性的典型例子，但其输运性质尚未被充分探索。本文利用基于重求和的量子蒙特卡罗方法和解析延拓，计算了方格t模型中单个空穴的动态迁移率。研究发现，随着冷却，非相干的类Drude响应转变为有限频率峰，同时直流迁移率消失。这个峰值标志着被铁磁云限制的空穴的内部模式，表明输运是探测极化子形成和动力学自陷的有效手段。
authors: Yusong Xiao, Yuan Wan

articles.title: Universal Long-distance Tail of Particle-number Density near a Wall in Superfluids
articles.title_zh: 超流体中壁面附近粒子数密度的普适长程尾部
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23165v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the long-distance recovery of the particle-number density near a static, impermeable wall in a d-dimensional Galilean-invariant superfluid. Using superfluid effective field theory (EFT) on a half-space, we show that quantum phonon fluctuations produce a z⁻⁽d⁺¹⁾ tail in the smooth density profile at zero temperature, where z is the distance from the wall. The tail coefficient is fixed by the bulk equation of state and is independent of microscopic wall details. At low temperature T, the thermal length cₛ/T, with cₛ the bulk sound speed, separates the zero-temperature behavior at intermediate distances from a thermal Tz⁻d tail at larger distances for d>1. For d=1, the long-distance phonon contribution instead decays as exp(-4π Tz/cₛ₎. The EFT applies to both Bose and Fermi superfluids, including strongly interacting Fermi gases at unitarity. We estimate the normalized tail amplitude in three dimensions across the BCS--BEC crossover using experimental sound-speed data.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了d维伽利略不变超流体中，静态不渗透壁面附近粒子数密度的长程恢复行为。利用半空间上的超流体有效场论，研究表明量子声子涨落会在零温度下产生一个z⁻⁽d⁺¹⁾的平滑密度分布尾部，其系数由体态方程决定且与微观壁面细节无关。在低温下，热长度将零温行为与更大的距离处的Tz⁻d热尾部行为分开。该有效场论适用于玻色和费米超流体，包括强相互作用的幺正费米气体。
authors: Keisuke Fujii

articles.title: Non-Adiabatic Spin-Induced Currents in Magnetic Weyl Semimetals
articles.title_zh: 磁性外尔半金属中非绝热自旋诱导电流
