articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23197v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically study dc electric currents induced by rapid spin precession in noncentrosymmetric magnetic Weyl semimetals using the Floquet--Keldysh Green's-function formalism. The spin dynamics act as a time-dependent chiral gauge field and the geometric structure of electric currents is expressed in terms of the Berry curvature, the quantum metric, and the shift vector. For an isotropic Weyl cone, only an injection current is generated. This current scales quadratically with the driving frequency and linearly with the relaxation time associated with coupling to a fermionic bath. We further show that a finite Weyl-cone tilt modifies the available interband-transition phase space, smooths the frequency dependence of the current, and allows for a shift current and another type of injection current, both of which flow in directions determined by the tilt and the direction of the precession. A finite net current can remain after summing contributions from Weyl nodes of opposite chiralities when their transition phase spaces are inequivalent.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用Floquet-Keldysh格林函数形式，理论研究了非中心对称磁性外尔半金属中由快速自旋进动引起的直流电流。自旋动力学表现为时变手性规范场，电流的几何结构由贝里曲率、量子度规和位移矢量表示。研究发现，对于各向同性外尔锥，仅产生注入电流；而有限的外尔锥倾斜会改变可用的带间跃迁相空间，并允许产生位移电流和另一种注入电流。当具有相反手性的外尔节点跃迁相空间不等价时，可以保留有限的净电流。
authors: Kota Watanabe, Akihiro Ozawa, Hiroaki Ishizuka, Hiroki Isobe, Kentaro Nomura

articles.title: Finite-temperature phase diagram of dipolar bosons in a cylindrical setup
articles.title_zh: 柱形偶极玻色子系统的有限温度相图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23687v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Temperature plays a non-trivial role in dipolar systems, being able to either induce or destroy spatial density modulations. In order to shed light into the interplay between thermal effects and quantum correlations, we employ the path integral Monte Carlo method (PIMC) to obtain the phase diagram of a system of dipolar bosons in an infinite cylindrical geometry and at finite temperatures. For a fixed total density, we vary the scattering length of the interaction and the temperature, and characterize the structure and superfluidity of the emerging phases. The PIMC method accounts for thermal effects and quantum correlations at all orders, and can be used to quantitatively estimate the superfluid fraction of the system. Remarkably, we find a regime of parameters where, starting from a supersolid, the spatial order vanishes with temperature before the superfluidity does. We also find a region of the phase diagram where the superfluid fraction displays a non-monotonous dependence with temperature. Our results extend previous descriptions, relying on Bogoliubov theory, to larger temperatures in the thermodynamic limit and illustrate how spatial modulations and superfluidity are lost as temperature is increased.
articles.abstract_zh: 温度在偶极系统中扮演着重要角色，能够诱导或破坏空间密度调制。本文采用路径积分蒙特卡罗（PIMC）方法，研究了无限圆柱几何中偶极玻色子系统在有限温度下的相图。研究发现，在某些参数区域，从超固态开始，空间序会先于超流性随温度升高而消失。此外，相图中还存在超流体分数对温度呈现非单调依赖性的区域。这些结果扩展了之前基于Bogoliubov理论的描述，并揭示了热效应与量子关联的复杂相互作用。
authors: Juan Sánchez-Baena, Raúl Bombín, Jordi Boronat

articles.title: Engineering nonrelativistic spin splitting in semiconductors by altermagnetic proximity
articles.title_zh: 通过交变磁体近邻效应在半导体中实现非相对论自旋劈裂工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.23773v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets combine vanishing net magnetization with momentum-dependent, nonrelativistic spin splitting, offering functionalities attractive for spintronics and quantum devices. Their practical use, however, is constrained by the limited availability of materials that simultaneously possess the required altermagnetic symmetry, semiconducting electronic structure, and weak spin-orbit coupling. Here we show that these requirements can instead be separated between constituent materials through proximity engineering. We develop an analytical theory for a conventional semiconductor coupled to a gapped d-wave altermagnet and demonstrate that virtual tunneling transfers the altermagnetic spin splitting to the semiconductor. Crucially, the induced nonrelativistic and relativistic spin splittings exhibit qualitatively different dependences on band alignment. Virtual processes involving the valence and conduction bands of the altermagnet can reinforce the altermagnetic splitting while contributing with opposite signs to the interfacial Rashba coupling. Consequently, electrostatic tuning can access a regime in which the Rashba splitting vanishes while a sizable d-wave spin splitting persists. Exact diagonalization of the full heterostructure model confirms the analytical theory and establishes the robustness of this mechanism beyond the perturbative regime. Our results identify altermagnetic proximity as a route for engineering nonrelativistic spin-split electronic states in established semiconductor platforms, providing a general strategy for disentangling magnetic and relativistic spin interactions in quantum heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 交变磁体结合了零净磁化和动量依赖的非相对论自旋劈裂，在自旋电子学和量子器件中具有吸引力。本文提出通过近邻工程，将交变磁体的特性转移到常规半导体中。研究建立了常规半导体与带隙d波交变磁体耦合的分析理论，并证明虚拟隧穿可以将交变磁性自旋劈裂转移到半导体。关键的是，诱导的非相对论和相对论自旋劈裂对能带对准表现出定性不同的依赖性，通过静电调谐可以实现拉什巴劈裂消失的区域。
authors: Sing Lam Wong, Marcel Franz

articles.title: Sub-Landau levels in two-dimensional electron system in magnetic field
articles.title_zh: 磁场中二维电子系统的子朗道能级
articles.abstract: arXiv:2406.06212v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study two interacting electrons in a two-dimensional system under a strong magnetic field and show that their numerically exact solutions organize into a set of em sub-Landau levels characterized by relative angular momentum quantum number m. These sub-levels define correlation-resolved subspaces of the Landau-level Hilbert space, while retaining the full degeneracy associated with center-of-mass motion. Within this structure, the accessible states in each correlation channel are effectively reduced, leading to a natural organization of guiding-center states consistent with a fractional occupancy. We further analyze the role of electron correlation, Zeeman splitting, and disorder in stabilizing spin-polarized electron-pair states. Building on the two-electron states, we construct a class of many-electron trial wavefunctions based on correlated electron pairs with fixed m, which encode short-range correlations through the vanishing of the pair wavefunction at small separation. Our results establish a direct connection between exact two-body physics and the organization of correlated many-electron states in the lowest Landau level, providing a microscopic perspective on how relative angular momentum structures can underpin the emergence of correlated phases in quantum Hall systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了强磁场下二维系统中两个相互作用电子，发现其数值精确解组织成一组由相对角动量量子数m表征的子朗道能级。这些子能级定义了朗道能级希尔伯特空间的关联分辨子空间，同时保留了与质心运动相关的完全简并性。研究进一步分析了电子关联、塞曼劈裂和无序在稳定自旋极化电子对态中的作用。这些结果建立了精确两体物理与最低朗道能级中关联多电子态组织之间的直接联系。
authors: Guo-Qiang Hai

articles.title: Parasitic Two-Level Systems in Merged-Element Transmon Qubits
articles.title_zh: 合并元件Transmon量子比特中的寄生双能级系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.22593v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In conventional transmon qubits, decoherence is dominated by a large number of parasitic two-level systems (TLS) residing at the edges of its large area coplanar shunt capacitor and junction leads. Avoiding these defects by improvements in design, fabrication and materials proved to be a significant challenge that so far led to limited progress. The merged-element transmon qubit (''mergemon''), a recently proposed paradigm shift in transmon design, attempts to address these issues by engineering the Josephson junction to act as its own shunt capacitor. With its energy mostly confined within the junctions, efforts required to improve qubit coherence can be concentrated on the junction barrier, a potentially easier to control interface compared to exposed circuit areas. Incorporating an additional aluminium deposition and oxidation into the in-situ bandaged Niemeyer-Dolan technique, we were able to fabricate flux-tunable mergemon qubits achieving mean T₁ relaxation times of up to 130μ s (Q approx 3.3 × 10⁶). TLS spectroscopy under applied strain and electric fields, together with systematic design variations, revealed that even for mergemon qubits - despite their significantly reduced footprint and increased junction barrier volume - careful design considerations are still essential to avoid coherence limitations due to surface loss.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统Transmon量子比特的退相干主要由寄生双能级系统（TLS）引起。本文提出了一种新型合并元件Transmon量子比特（“mergemon”），通过将约瑟夫结设计为自身的分流电容器，将能量主要限制在结内，从而将相干性改进的重点放在结势垒上。通过改进的制备技术，研究人员成功制备了可调谐mergemon量子比特，实现了高达130μs的平均T₁弛豫时间。TLS光谱分析表明，即使对于这种设计，TLS仍然存在。
authors: Etienne Daum, Benedikt Berlitz, Steffen Deck, Alexey V. Ustinov, Jürgen Lisenfeld

articles.title: Magnetic-field-free parity-protected qubit based on a narrow altermagnet Josephson junction
articles.title_zh: 基于窄交错磁体约瑟夫结的无磁场宇称保护量子比特
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.18145v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnets provide a new route to engineer superconducting circuits without magnetic fields. We theoretically study the Andreev bound state (ABS) spectrum of a finite-width altrmagnet-based Josephson junction and show how the d-wave altermagnetic symmetry and geometric confinement shape its low-energy excitations. We find a clear distinction between the two d-wave symmetries: dₓ^₂₋y^₂ order produces spin splitting, whereas dₓy order preserves spin degeneracy and exhibits splitting of the ABS spectrum induced by intermode hybridization. Leveraging these novel features, we propose applying a transverse electric field to tune the system and realize a magnetic-field-free, parity-protected superconducting qubit that we call altermon.
articles.abstract_zh: 交错磁体为无需磁场设计超导电路提供了新途径。本文理论研究了有限宽度交错磁体约瑟夫结的安德烈夫束缚态（ABS）谱，并揭示了d波交错磁对称性和几何限制如何影响其低能激发。研究发现两种d波对称性存在明显区别，并利用这些特性，提出通过施加横向电场来调谐系统，从而实现一种无磁场、宇称保护的超导量子比特，称之为“altermon”。
authors: Sakineh Vosoughi-nia, Michał P. Nowak

articles.title: Orbitally Tuned Composite-Fermion Pairing Transitions in Bilayer Graphene
articles.title_zh: 双层石墨烯中轨道调控的复合费米子配对跃迁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.21383v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The effective interaction between composite fermions, set entirely by the Coulomb potential and the underlying electronic Landau level orbitals, can stabilize exotic fractional quantum Hall states. In particular, half-filled Landau levels with different orbital character can host either metallic or paired phases of composite fermions. Here, we leverage experimental control over the orbital composition to realize a composite-fermion pairing transition in the first excited Landau level of bilayer graphene. Transport measurements at filling factors ν = 9/2 and 11/2 reveal conductive states giving way to well-developed plateaus with increasing displacement fields. These states are insensitive to an in-plane magnetic field, indicating single-component ground states and thus pointing at non-Abelian orders. Our numerical study, based on displacement-field-dependent Landau-level wave functions, supports the orbital origin of the pairing transition and suggests Moore-Read or anti-Pfaffian ground states.
articles.abstract_zh: 复合费米子之间的有效相互作用可以稳定奇异的分数量子霍尔态。本文利用对轨道组成的实验控制，在双层石墨烯的第一激发朗道能级中实现了复合费米子配对跃迁。输运测量显示，随着位移场的增加，导电态转变为清晰的平台，这些态对平面内磁场不敏感，指向非阿贝尔序。数值研究支持了配对跃迁的轨道起源，并暗示了Moore-Read或反Pfaffian基态。
authors: Ravi Kumar, Tomer Firon, André Haug, Misha Yutushui, Alon Ner Gaon, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, David F. Mross, Yuval Ronen

articles.title: Fully gapped superconductivity in magic-angle graphene Cooper-pair islands
articles.title_zh: 魔角石墨烯库珀对岛中的全能隙超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14685v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The mechanism behind superconductivity in magic-angle graphene systems remains an open question. Recent tunnelling and superfluid stiffness measurements have suggested a nodal superconducting gap, but these probes are typically applied to large-area devices, where twist-angle inhomogeneity and disorder can hinder resolving the intrinsic superconducting spectrum. Here we introduce quantum dots in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene and access a regime where gate-tunable superconductivity competes with strong Coulomb repulsion upon adding an additional carrier to the island. The islands exhibit 2e-periodic Coulomb blockade, revealing a well-defined quasiparticle gap in the island spectrum, inconsistent with the presence of nodes in the order parameter. Within the same device, we also realize coupled superconducting islands and proximitized quantum dots, establishing a monolithic platform for hybrid dot devices. Our results point to a nodeless quasiparticle gap in moiré graphene and demonstrate the potential of mesoscopic hybrid structures to probe their correlated phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 魔角石墨烯系统中超导机制仍是未解之谜，此前测量曾暗示存在节点超导能隙。本文在魔角扭曲双层石墨烯中引入量子点，观察到2e周期库仑阻塞，揭示了岛谱中明确的准粒子能隙，这与序参数中存在节点的观点不符。研究结果表明莫尔石墨烯中存在无节点的准粒子能隙，并展示了介观混合结构在探测其关联相方面的潜力。
authors: Alexandra Mestre-Torà, Marta Perego, Clara Galante Agero, Takashi Taniguchi, Kenji Watanabe, Thomas Ihn, Klaus Ensslin, Artem O. Denisov

articles.title: Mean-Field Dynamics of the Bose-Hubbard Model in High Dimension
articles.title_zh: 高维Bose-Hubbard模型的平均场动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2501.05304v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The Bose-Hubbard model effectively describes bosons on a lattice with on-site interactions and nearest-neighbour hopping, serving as a foundational framework for understanding strong particle interactions and the superfluid to Mott insulator transition. This paper aims to rigorously establish the validity of a mean-field approximation for the dynamics of quantum systems in high dimension, using the Bose-Hubbard model on a square lattice as a case study. We prove a trace norm estimate between the one-lattice-site reduced density of the Schrödinger dynamics and the mean-field dynamics in the limit of large dimension. Here, the mean-field approximation is in the hopping amplitude and not in the interaction, leading to a very rich and non-trivial mean-field equation. This mean-field equation does not only describe the condensate, as is the case when the mean-field description comes from a large particle number limit averaging out the interaction, but it allows for a phase transition to a Mott insulator since it contains the full non-trivial interaction. Our work is a rigorous justification of a simple case of the highly successful dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT) for bosons, which somewhat surprisingly yields many qualitatively correct results in three dimensions.
articles.abstract_zh: Bose-Hubbard模型是理解强粒子相互作用和超流-莫特绝缘体转变的基础框架。本文旨在严格确立高维量子系统动力学中平均场近似的有效性，以方格上的Bose-Hubbard模型为例。研究证明了在维度趋于无穷大时，薛定谔动力学和平均场动力学之间的一格点约化密度矩阵的迹范数估计。该平均场近似针对跳跃振幅而非相互作用，从而导出一个包含完整非平凡相互作用的丰富且非平凡的平均场方程，能够描述凝聚体并允许向莫特绝缘体的相变。

articles.title: Post-selection-free decoding of measurement-induced area-law phases via neural networks
articles.title_zh: 神经网络实现无后选择解码测量诱导的面积定律相
articles.abstract: Monitored quantum circuits host a rich variety of exotic non-equilibrium phases. Among the most representative examples are measurement-induced phase transitions between distinct area-law entangled states. However, because these transitions are characterized by specific entanglement quantities such as mutual information or topological entanglement entropy that are nonlinear functionals of the density matrix, their experimental observation requires multiple identical quantum trajectories via post-selection, which becomes exponentially infeasible for large systems. Here, we leverage modern machine learning tools to address this challenge. We devise a neural network (NN) architecture combining a convolutional NN with an attention mechanism, and use raw measurement outcomes directly as input to classify trivial, long-range entangled, and symmetry-protected topological phases. Rather than estimating trajectory-resolved entanglement measures, the network acts as a classifier of the unconditional distribution of measurement records, trained at the pure-phase points and calibrated against phase boundaries independently established from entanglement diagnostics. We show that the system’s relaxation to a steady-state phase manifests as a sharp convergence in the classifier’s accuracy, without any quantum state reconstruction. We systematically study the performance of our network as a function of sample size, input data, spatial and temporal constraints, and system size scalability. Our results demonstrate that this approach is robust and post-selection-free, offering a practical pathway for experimentally probing measurement-induced phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 监测量子电路中的测量诱导相变通常需要通过后选择来表征纠缠量，但这对于大型系统来说指数级不可行。本文提出了一种结合卷积神经网络和注意力机制的神经网络架构，直接使用原始测量结果来分类不同的纠缠相。该网络作为测量记录无条件分布的分类器，避免了对轨迹分辨纠缠量的估计，从而解决了实验观察的挑战。

articles.title: Quantum lock-in detection via successive adiabatic evolution
articles.title_zh: 基于连续绝热演化的量子锁相检测
articles.abstract: In recent years, quantum lock-in detection has emerged as a promising technique to accurately detect weak signals submerged in background noise. However, the signal-to-noise ratio of existing protocols is severely limited by spectral leakage resulting from control operations implemented in pulse form. Here, we propose a general protocol for realizing quantum lock-in detection by employing successive quantum adiabatic evolution. In our protocol, the signal modulation is achieved by adiabatically controlling the time evolution of the quantum probe, which enables the implementation of sinusoidal modulation functions. The realization of sinusoidal-wave modulation substantially mitigates the problem of spectral leakage and facilitates the extraction of the complete characteristics of the target signals. We present a practical implementation scheme of adiabatic quantum lock-in detection based on nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond, and demonstrate that the proposed protocol possesses strong resilience against experimental imperfections. Our results establish adiabatic quantum lock-in detection as a robust and experimentally accessible approach to detection of weak alternating signals in noisy environments, thus promoting the advance of real-world quantum sensing technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 现有的量子锁相检测协议因脉冲形式的控制操作导致的频谱泄漏而限制了信噪比。本文提出了一种通过连续量子绝热演化实现量子锁相检测的通用协议。该协议通过绝热控制量子探针的时间演化实现正弦波调制功能，显著减轻了频谱泄漏问题。研究还提出了基于金刚石氮空位中心的绝热量子锁相检测的实际实施方案，并证明了其对实验缺陷的强大鲁棒性。

articles.title: Mechanical trisqueezing in circuit quantum acoustodynamics with SNAIL devices
articles.title_zh: 基于SNAIL器件的电路量子声动力学中的机械三压缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20670v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Continuous-variable quantum information processing with mechanical oscillators requires a uni- versal gate set, including a genuine non-Gaussian evolution. While circuit quantum acoustodynamics (cQAD) experiments have realized bilinear and quartic (four-wave mixing) operations by coupling mechanical modes to transmon qubits, the intrinsic Kerr nonlinearity of these devices precludes access to odd-order effective Hamiltonians such as trisqueezing. Here we propose a cQAD architec- ture in which a mechanical mode, hosted in a high-overtone bulk acoustic-wave resonator (HBAR), is coupled to a superconducting nonlinear asymmetric inductive element (SNAIL). By combining the cubic nonlinearity of the SNAIL with parametric flux driving, we engineer a three-wave mixing interaction that generates trisqueezed mechanical states, producing the characteristic triangular, star-shaped Wigner function with negative regions indicative of non-Gaussianity. We derive the effective trisqueezing Hamiltonian from the full circuit model, identify the drive frequencies and flux modulation required to isolate the desired interaction from competing terms, and quantify the achievable coupling strengths for parameters compatible with current fabrication capabilities. Our results establish a hardware-efficient route to non-Gaussian resource generation in mechanical quantum systems, extending the toolbox of cQAD toward universal continuous-variable quantum computation and enhanced quantum-limited sensing.
articles.abstract_zh: 机械振子的连续变量量子信息处理需要非高斯演化，但现有电路量子声动力学（cQAD）实验难以实现奇数阶有效哈密顿量，如三压缩。本文提出了一种cQAD架构，将高泛音体声波谐振器中的机械模式与超导非线性非对称电感元件（SNAIL）耦合。通过结合SNAIL的三次非线性和参数磁通驱动，该方案能够产生具有负Wigner函数区域的机械三压缩态，从而实现非高斯性。
authors: Yi-Zhou Bu, Matteo Fadel, Kai Xu, Heng Fan

articles.title: Quantum Partial Information Decompositions, an Operational Order on Ensembles, and Direct Quantifications of Objective Information
articles.title_zh: 量子部分信息分解、系综上的操作序以及客观信息的直接量化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20694v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The partial information decomposition (PID) framework is an extension of classical information theory that enables a systematic analysis of the structure of information in multipartite systems. We advance a simple extension of this framework enabling the construction of multipartite quantum PIDs (QPIDs); generalizing recent, exclusively bipartite, extensions. We construct two QPIDs of the Holevo quantity. First a naive QPID based on the classical minimum mutual information. Second a sophisticated QPID enabled by our development of an operational partial order on quantum ensembles in terms of ensemble (inter-)convertability. Finally, as a concrete example of how QPIDs can be applied, we investigate objectivity scenarios; using our Holevo QPIDs to directly quantify objective information in extended graph states. These findings ultimately establish a foundation upon which generic multipartite QPIDs can be systematically constructed, introduce an operational partial order on ensembles, advance QPIDs as interesting objects of study in their own right, and demonstrate their immediate applicability to problems in quantum information.
articles.abstract_zh: 部分信息分解（PID）框架是经典信息论的扩展，用于分析多体系统中的信息结构。本文提出了一个简单的扩展，以构建多体量子PID（QPID），并构建了两种Holevo量的QPID。通过引入基于系综（互）可转换性的操作性偏序，实现了更复杂的QPID。研究还通过QPID直接量化了扩展图态中的客观信息，为量子信息问题提供了新的分析工具。
authors: Alexander Nico-Katz

articles.title: Quantum prepare-and-measure scenarios: concepts and methods
articles.title_zh: 量子制备-测量场景：概念与方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20725v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Prepare-and-measure scenarios are among the simplest and most widely used settings for quantum communication. A sender prepares a physical system in one of several possible states, which a receiver then measures. Despite this simple structure, these scenarios offer a rich framework for exploring the differences between classical and quantum communication, revealing quantum advantages, and developing protocols for quantum cryptography and device certification. In this tutorial, we give a ground-up introduction to prepare-and-measure scenarios and the methods used to study them. We introduce different frameworks for constraining and characterising communication, with an emphasis on semi-device-independent approaches to quantum information. We also cover modern convex-optimisation techniques for characterising the correlations achievable in these scenarios and illustrate how these tools can be applied in practice. Our aim is to give newcomers the conceptual and technical foundations needed to approach the current literature and apply prepare-and-measure methods in their own research. We conclude with a discussion of open problems and directions for future work.
articles.abstract_zh: 制备-测量场景是量子通信中最简单且广泛使用的设置之一，用于探索经典与量子通信的差异、揭示量子优势以及开发量子密码学协议。本教程全面介绍了制备-测量场景及其研究方法，重点关注量子信息的半设备无关方法。文章还涵盖了表征这些场景中可实现关联的现代凸优化技术，旨在为研究人员提供理解和应用制备-测量方法所需的概念和技术基础。
authors: A. de Oliveira Junior, Santiago Zamora, Jonatan Bohr Brask, Rafael Chaves, Armin Tavakoli

articles.title: Alternating Squeezing and Photon Subtraction for Optical Cat-State Generation
articles.title_zh: 交替挤压和光子减法用于光学猫态生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20728v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Schrödinger cat states are important non-Gaussian resources for quantum information processing and quantum-enhanced metrology. Although photon subtraction from squeezed vacuum states has proven useful for generating such states in the optical domain, scaling to large amplitudes while maintaining high fidelity and heralding probability remains challenging. To address these obstacles, we analyze alternating squeezing and photon-number-subtraction operations. Rather than optimizing for a single heralding outcome, we formulate cat-state generation as a fidelity-constrained multibranch problem, jointly optimizing the total probability of all photon-number outcomes satisfying a prescribed fidelity threshold at one common experimental setting. Already for plain photon subtraction, this provides a more operational measure of the usable generation probability and can favor parameter configurations that differ from single-branch optima. Considering experimental constraints on available squeezing and photon-number-resolving capability, we demonstrate improvements in fidelity and success probability compared with plain photon subtraction, without necessarily increasing the required squeezing resources. Without restrictions on photon-number resolution, we find that the optimal architecture of the alternating scheme reduces to one of two single-subtraction endpoint configurations, depending on the available squeezing resources. When photon-number resolution is additionally limited, genuinely alternating branches can become advantageous. We derive analytical expressions for the conditional states, cat-state fidelities, and heralding probabilities, enabling efficient multibranch optimization and a systematic analysis of resource trade-offs, sensitivity to experimental parameter deviations, and heralding loss. Together, these results identify the architecture best suited to a given resource budget.
articles.abstract_zh: 薛定谔猫态是重要的非高斯量子信息处理资源，但通过挤压真空态进行光子减法生成猫态时，难以在高保真度下扩展到大振幅。本文分析了交替挤压和光子数减法操作，并将猫态生成表述为一个保真度受限的多分支问题，共同优化满足预设保真度阈值的所有光子数结果的总概率。研究表明，与单纯的光子减法相比，该方法在保真度和成功概率方面有所改进。
authors: Johanna Conrad, Fabian Steinlechner, René Sondenheimer

articles.title: Practical wavelength selection for quantum-augmented networks over shared optical fiber
articles.title_zh: 共享光纤上量子增强网络的实用波长选择
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20987v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In a quantum augmented network, sharing optical fiber with classical traffic requires quantum wavelength selection to balance logical fidelity, block acceptance, and classical data reception. Here we develop a wavelength-selection framework for an error-corrected three-stage quantum communication protocol. Under a thermal-background model with independent errors, an ideal one-photon receiver, and ideal recovery, we derive an accepted qubit channel and a key-independent lower bound on logical entanglement fidelity. Combining this bound with block acceptance gives an entanglement-fidelity yield bound, which we maximize over evaluated wavelengths subject to fidelity and classical link-budget requirements. For the Steane [[7,1,3]] code at 5 km per traversal and -10 dBm per classical channel, the largest fidelity certificate occurs near 1537 nm, whereas the largest yield bound occurs near 1551 nm. Along the 1.25 Gb/s classical link budget with 0.2% base error, the optimized yield bound falls below 10⁻⁶ near 10 km per traversal, while fidelity remains certified at 0.99 or higher at longer spans. These results distinguish fidelity and yield constraints and identify certified operating regions for quantum-augmented networks sharing optical fiber.
articles.abstract_zh: 在量子增强网络中，与经典流量共享光纤需要量子波长选择来平衡逻辑保真度、块接受率和经典数据接收。本文为纠错三阶段量子通信协议开发了一个波长选择框架，并推导了逻辑纠缠保真度的下限。通过最大化纠缠保真度产量界限，研究发现最大的保真度证书出现在1537 nm附近，而最大的产量界限出现在1551 nm附近，为实际应用提供了指导。
authors: Nitin Jha, Prateek Paudel, Abhishek Parakh

articles.title: Classification of quantum states through conserved operators
articles.title_zh: 通过守恒算符对量子态进行分类
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20988v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Determining whether quantum states can be interconverted by a prescribed set of transformations is a fundamental problem in quantum information. Here we develop a general classification framework based on conserved operators (COs), i.e., not necessarily hermitian matrices having the state of interest as an eigenstate. We first show that COs belonging to the algebra generating the allowed transformations can be obtained from the kernel of a quantum covariance matrix. Their number determines the dimension of the accessible orbit, while their algebraic structure and eigenvalues provide further constraints on state convertibility. We establish general bounds on the number of COs and prove that highest-weight states, like separable states in the case of n qudits, attain the maximum. We also show how these operators generate parent Hamiltonians having the characterized state as an exact ground state. We then also consider positive zero-eigenvalue COs, which encode forbidden directions of reduced density matrices and incorporate rank-based constraints into the same framework. Applying this approach to multiqubit SLOCC, we obtain complementary classifications from algebraic and rank COs. While for nłeq 3 qubits both lead to the usual classes, for n=4 qubits they distinguish 17 and 20 types separately, and 29 when combined. The combined classification yields 287 fixed types and 4 continuous families for n=5 qubits, and 4926 fixed types and 147 continuous families for n=6 qubits, providing, to our knowledge, the most refined exhaustive classification of SLOCC-convertibility classes based on such data.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子信息中的一个基本问题是确定量子态是否可以通过一组预设变换相互转换。本文开发了一个基于守恒算符（COs）的通用分类框架，这些算符不一定是厄米矩阵，但具有目标态作为本征态。研究表明，COs的数量决定了可访问轨道的维度，其代数结构和本征值提供了态可转换性的进一步约束。该方法还可用于生成以特定态为精确基态的母哈密顿量，并应用于多量子比特SLOCC，提供了互补的分类工具。
authors: Federico Petrovich, R. Rossignoli, M. Cerezo

articles.title: Optimising multipartite entanglement manipulation in quantum networks
articles.title_zh: 量子网络中多体纠缠操纵的优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21420v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-range, genuine multipartite entanglement (GME) between distant parties in a quantum network is a crucial resource for distributed quantum information processing. Through controlled manipulation of short-range GME states in the network via stochastic local operations aided by classical communication (SLOCC), long-range GME can be established between selected target nodes on demand. Optimizing such multipartite entanglement distribution protocols under constraints imposed by the network architecture, target-node set, and available resource budget is a key challenge in resource-efficient manipulation of GME. We present a general operational framework for manipulating GME in quantum networks by classifying the relevant networking operations into three broad primitives-inflation, deflation, and purification-reflecting their effect on the proliferation of GME through general bounds and illustrative examples. We show how these primitives can be combined to construct a broad class of multipartite quantum repeater protocols, enabling their systematic optimization, and demonstrate the framework with a simple example. Applying our approach to networks of Dür-Cirac-Tarrach states reveals a rich landscape of achievable end-to-end GME and accessible entanglement classes. More generally, our framework provides a systematic approach to the construction and optimization of multipartite quantum repeater protocols for scalable and resource-efficient GME distribution in quantum networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 远程、真正的多体纠缠（GME）是分布式量子信息处理的关键资源。本文提出了一个通用的操作框架，通过将相关网络操作分为膨胀、收缩和纯化三个基本原语来操纵量子网络中的GME。这些原语可以结合起来构建广泛的多体量子中继协议，从而实现其系统优化。该框架有助于在网络架构、目标节点集和可用资源预算的约束下，优化多体纠缠分发协议。
authors: Shashank Shekhar, David Elkouss, Siddhartha Santra

articles.title: Periodic conditional measurements on a photonic chip
articles.title_zh: 光子芯片上的周期性条件测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21465v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum measurements not only extract information but also reshape quantum evolution through measurement backaction. Here, we investigate periodic conditional measurements, in which coherent evolution is repeatedly interrupted by local measurements. We show that the bright and dark modes of the conditional evolution operator provide a unified spectral description of both the post-selected final state along no-detection trajectories and the statistics of detection events. Using a three-dimensional photonic chip, we demonstrate on-demand state engineering through dark-mode preservation and bright-mode selection, enabling the protection of topological corner states and excited-state shelving. We further observe the predicted transition of the total detection probability on an effectively infinite one-dimensional lattice and identify its microscopic origin in Floquet near-dark modes. These results establish periodic conditional measurements as a general framework for engineering conditional quantum states and manipulating event-detection statistics in monitored quantum dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子测量不仅提取信息，还通过测量反作用重塑量子演化。本文研究了周期性条件测量，其中相干演化被局部测量反复中断。研究表明，条件演化算符的亮模式和暗模式为无检测轨迹的后选择终态和检测事件统计提供了统一的谱描述。通过三维光子芯片，该工作展示了按需态工程，实现了拓扑角态的保护和激发态的搁置，并确立了周期性条件测量作为工程条件量子态和操纵事件检测统计的通用框架。
authors: Xuan Chen, Ruo-Yu Yin, Xiao-Wen Shang, Xi-Jun Yuan, Ze-Feng Lan, Hong-Jing Du, Yi-Jun Chang, Bao-Jing Liu, Wen-Hao Zhou, Xi Tan, Eli Barkai, Hao Tang, Xian-Min Jin

articles.title: Finite-Frequency Boson-Number Bounds Across the Quantum Rabi Transition
articles.title_zh: 量子Rabi跃迁中有限频率玻色子数界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21556v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider the quantum Rabi model, a fundamental model of quantum optics describing a two-level system coupled to a bosonic mode, including counter-rotating terms. In the limit of large separation between the two-level transition frequency and the bosonic mode frequency, the model exhibits a quantum phase transition at a critical coupling strength. Although the model is exactly solvable, simple analytic expressions for important physical quantities are generally unavailable. We derive rigorous upper and lower bounds for the ground-state energy and boson occupation number across the quantum phase transition at finite frequency ratios. Our results characterize the subcritical, critical, and supercritical regimes and establish the scaling behavior of the boson occupation near the critical point. Exact numerical diagonalization demonstrates the tightness of the derived bounds, while the resulting finite-frequency inequalities provide experimentally testable predictions for trapped-ion quantum simulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子Rabi模型描述了两能级系统与玻色子模式的耦合，并在临界耦合强度下表现出量子相变。本文推导了在有限频率比下，基态能量和玻色子占据数的严格上下界。这些结果表征了亚临界、临界和超临界区域，并建立了临界点附近玻色子占据数的标度行为。导出的有限频率不等式为离子阱量子模拟器提供了可实验验证的预测。
authors: Razmik G. Unanyan, Michael Fleischhauer, Nikolay V. Vitanov

articles.title: Remote Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill Entanglement Generation between Trapped Ions
articles.title_zh: 囚禁离子间远程Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill纠缠生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21754v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Distributing entanglement directly between error-corrected logical qubits is an important capability for scalable quantum networks. We propose a heralded protocol for generating remote entanglement between Gottesman--Kitaev--Preskill qubits encoded in the motional modes of spatially separated trapped ions, using the internal electronic states to interface the motional qubits with emitted photons. We derive the protocol for single-rail and polarization photonic encodings and evaluate the effects of finite GKP squeezing, photon loss, photon recoil, motional heating, and motional dephasing on the decoded logical state. Moreover, we numerically analysed the fidelity of distributed logical Bell-pair fidelity. We find that one can achieve more than 95% of fidelity in the realistic situation. The protocol combines motional-control and photonic-networking operations that have already been demonstrated in trapped-ion experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 在可扩展量子网络中，直接在纠错逻辑量子比特之间分发纠缠至关重要。本文提出了一种预示协议，用于在空间分离的囚禁离子运动模式中编码的Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill（GKP）量子比特之间生成远程纠缠。该协议利用内部电子态将运动量子比特与发射光子连接，并评估了各种实验缺陷对解码逻辑态的影响。数值分析表明，在实际情况下可以实现超过95%的分布式逻辑贝尔对保真度。
authors: Haruki Aoki, Kazufumi Tanji, Shohei Kiryu, Masahiro Takeoka, Junko Ishi-Hayase

articles.title: Superconducting circuits host two-level systems with lifetimes exceeding one second
articles.title_zh: 超导电路中存在寿命超过一秒的双能级系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21853v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding the microscopic environment of superconducting qubits is a central challenge for quantum technologies. Parasitic two-level systems (TLSs) of various microscopic origins are ubiquitous and limit qubit performance through decoherence, frequency drifts, and leakage. Recently, long-lived TLSs with lifetimes exceeding those of state-of-the-art qubits have been shown to induce correlated qubit dynamics, with direct implications for quantum error correction. Here, we perform wide-band quantum-jump correlation spectroscopy on flux-tunable transmon qubits and identify microscopic degrees of freedom that outlive the qubit by orders of magnitude. Pump-probe measurements at varying detunings from these objects reveal intrinsic lifetimes exceeding one second. Their weak coupling to the qubit, in the kilohertz range, is consistent with positional defects described by the standard tunneling model, without excluding other microscopic origins such as magnetic spin impurities or trapped quasiparticles. More broadly, these results establish superconducting qubits as a sensitive probe of exceptionally long-lived microscopic degrees of freedom and open a route toward their controlled access and functionalization.
articles.abstract_zh: 超导量子比特的微观环境是量子技术面临的核心挑战，其中寄生双能级系统（TLSs）会限制量子比特性能。本研究通过宽带量子跳跃关联光谱和泵浦-探测测量，在可调谐Transmon量子比特中识别出寿命超过一秒的微观自由度。这些TLSs与量子比特的弱耦合（千赫兹范围）与标准隧穿模型描述的位置缺陷一致，为理解和利用长寿命微观自由度提供了新的视角。
authors: Mathieu Féchant, Phillip Lenhard, Nicolas Gosling, Ritika Dhundhwal, Denis Bénâtre, Wolfgang Wernsdorfer, Thomas Reisinger, Ioan M. Pop

articles.title: Selected Stabilizer Subspaces for Compact Many-Body Wave Functions
articles.title_zh: 用于紧凑多体波函数的选定稳定子子空间
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21907v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Selected configuration interaction (SCI) obtains accurate many-body solutions by variationally diagonalising the Hamiltonian in a sparse, iteratively selected set of configurations, but can lose compactness when the target state has broad configurational support. We introduce selected stabilizer interaction (SSI), a fully classical, SCI-inspired method that instead iteratively constructs a nonorthogonal subspace spanned by a systematically enlargeable set of selected stabilizer states. A single stabilizer, generated by Clifford operations, can encode a structured superposition of (possibly exponentially) many configurations, shifting the relevant compression from configurational to stabilizer sparsity. We benchmark ground-state energies, fidelities, superposition degrees and required expansion lengths against exact diagonalization and equivalent SCI schemes for the transverse-field Ising, XXZ Heisenberg, and Hubbard models, finding particularly strong compression from the stabilizer representation in the spin models, and increasing advantage with system size for these systems. The results establish a proof of principle for heuristic selected stabilizer diagonalization, while also identifying particular challenges in symmetry handling and effective exploration of the stabilizer space.
articles.abstract_zh: 选定组态相互作用（SCI）在处理具有广泛组态支持的目标态时可能失去紧凑性。本文引入了一种受SCI启发的全新经典方法——选定稳定子相互作用（SSI），它通过迭代构建由选定稳定子态张成的非正交子空间。SSI将压缩从组态稀疏性转移到稳定子稀疏性，并在横场Ising、XXZ Heisenberg和Hubbard模型中，相对于精确对角化和SCI方案，展现出显著的压缩优势，尤其在自旋模型中随系统尺寸增大而优势更明显。
authors: Maria-Andreea Filip, George H. Booth

articles.title: Looking Beyond Visibility: Resolving the Temporal Structure of Continuous-Wave Four-Photon Hong-Ou-Mandel Interference
articles.title_zh: 超越可见度：解析连续波四光子Hong-Ou-Mandel干涉的时间结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21909v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hong-Ou-Mandel interference underpins many photonic quantum information protocols and is commonly characterized by a single visibility parameter. This quantity is typically obtained by averaging over a fixed coincidence window, thereby discarding details of the underlying temporal structure that are critical in continuous-wave processes. Four-photon interference with continuous-wave sources furthermore requires photon pairs with long coherence times, which we generate in microring resonators and measure with ultrafast time-resolved detection. Here, we model and resolve their interference and temporal structure by recording all four photon arrival times and mapping their relative delays onto a three-dimensional coincidence histogram relative to a trigger detection. The resulting structure preserves relative arrival-time correlations that are usually discarded and enables post-processed optimization of coincidence windows to trade off visibility against count rate. This method provides a general benchmark for continuous-wave sources in interference-based quantum network protocols.
articles.abstract_zh: Hong-Ou-Mandel干涉是光子量子信息协议的基础，通常通过单一可见度参数表征，但这会忽略连续波过程中关键的时间结构细节。本研究通过微环谐振器产生具有长相干时间的四光子对，并利用超快时间分辨探测记录所有光子到达时间。通过构建三维符合直方图，该方法成功解析了干涉和时间结构，为基于干涉的量子网络协议中的连续波源提供了通用基准。
authors: Sabine Häussler, Meritxell Cabrejo-Ponce, Ana Maria Torres, Baghdasar Baghdasaryan, Karen Lozano-Mendéz, Fabian Steinlechner

articles.title: ZZ-Free bSWAP Gates under Strong Driving in Far-Detuned Fixed-Frequency Transmons
articles.title_zh: 远失谐固定频率Transmon中强驱动下的无ZZ项bSWAP门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21936v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Far-detuned frequency allocations in fixed-frequency superconducting processors mitigate spectral crowding but constrain cross-resonance interactions at practical drive amplitudes. Here, we demonstrate that a single strong drive induces a large XX-YY interaction in the far-detuned regime, while a weak second tone tunes the accompanying ZZ phase. The interaction realizes a 150-ns sqrtbSWAP gate, which can directly prepare a maximally entangled state from the ground state. For the implementations on the same qubit pair at matched drive strengths, cross resonance gives a shorter CNOT operation, while sqrtbSWAP gives a 33% shorter SWAP operation with a higher IRB fidelity. The multilevel theory further predicts a regime where stronger driving can yield a speed advantage for CNOT as well, a possibility absent in the two-level model. As an application of the XX-YY interaction, we also demonstrate two-spin squeezing beyond the standard quantum limit through two-axis countertwisting. The interaction realized here complements cross resonance and offers a route to efficient gate synthesis and quantum simulation of interacting spin systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 在固定频率超导处理器中，远失谐频率分配可缓解频谱拥挤，但限制了交叉共振相互作用。本研究展示了在远失谐区域，通过单一强驱动诱导大的XX-YY相互作用，并用弱的第二音调调节伴随的ZZ相位，实现了150纳秒的sqrtbSWAP门。该门可以直接从基态制备最大纠缠态，并且在SWAP操作上比交叉共振方法缩短33%并具有更高的IRB保真度。此外，该XX-YY相互作用还可用于实现超越标准量子极限的双自旋挤压，为高效门合成和相互作用自旋系统的量子模拟提供了新途径。
authors: Akinori Machino, Kazuhisa Ogawa, Yuto Ikegai, Takafumi Miyanaga, Koichiro Ban, Nilton F. G. Filho, Hidehisa Shiomi, Toshi Sumida, Shuhei Tamate, Yutaka Tabuchi, Yasunobu Nakamura, Makoto Negoro

articles.title: Thermal activation of photon catalysis in difference-intensity Mach-Zehnder interferometry with squeezed thermal light
articles.title_zh: 差分强度马赫-曾德尔干涉仪中压缩热光子催化的热激活
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22004v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Realistic non-Gaussian operations, which can be implemented by mixing a nonclassical Gaussian state with a Fock state at a beam splitter and then heralding on a photon-number-resolving detector, are known to improve phase estimation in a Mach-Zehnder interferometer. The existing studies have considered the single-mode squeezed vacuum for difference-intensity and parity detection, and the two-mode squeezed thermal state for parity detection alone as the initial Gaussian resources. However, a real squeezer in the lab actually produces single-mode squeezed thermal light, which has not been studied in a coherent-plus-resource interferometer. We take up this case and using the phase space Wigner picture, we obtain the heralded state produced by photon subtraction, addition and catalysis on a single-mode squeezed thermal resource, and evaluate the corresponding phase sensitivities. Single-photon catalysis, which is useless on squeezed vacuum, becomes a useful operation for any thermal occupation above nthsimeq0.2, and since it heralds with a probability near one-half, it turns out to be the best success-weighted operation over the whole thermal range. In the vacuum limit our results reproduce the known hierarchy, where two-photon catalysis is the best operation. The quantum Fisher information computations confirms that thermal noise enhances the phase information encoded in the catalyzed state, demonstrating that difference-intensity detection closely approaches the ultimate precision bound across most operational regimes, and, together with a loss analysis, verifies the robustness of the effect.
articles.abstract_zh: 非高斯操作能提高马赫-曾德尔干涉仪中的相位估计精度。本研究首次探讨了在相干加资源干涉仪中使用单模压缩热光的情况，并利用相空间Wigner图，评估了光子减法、加法和催化操作在单模压缩热资源上产生的预示态及其相应的相位灵敏度。结果表明，对于任何高于约0.2的热占据数，单光子催化（在压缩真空上无用）成为一种有益的操作，并且由于其接近一半的预示概率，它在整个范围内是最佳的成功加权操作。
authors: Kirtpreet Singh, Arvind

articles.title: Loss-independent time-delay estimation via Hong-Ou-Mandel photon bunching detection
articles.title_zh: 基于Hong-Ou-Mandel光子聚束探测的无损耗时间延迟估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22023v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work we study the application of two-photon correlated quantum states for high-precision time estimation. To achieve this, photon pairs were fed into a Hong-Ou-Mandel polarization interferometer to generate N00N entangled states with N = 2. Two- and four-detector schemes were considered, and the achievable time estimation precision of each was studied, with particular emphasis on the system's Fisher information in each case. Our results reveal that using a four-detector scheme, enabling the measurement of both coincidence and photon-bunching terms, achieves the maximum precision given by the quantum Fisher information, without the need of characterizing system losses. We also show that correlations between repetitions arise due to systematic errors, limiting the precision enhancement that can be obtained by increasing the number of repetitions. Taking these correlations into account, we show that the four-detector scheme outperforms the two-detector scheme in the precision of time-delay estimation. With the experimentally determined calibration uncertainties, the four-detector scheme improves the dispersion by a factor of 2 for the repetitions performed, reaching up to a factor of 4 as both schemes approach their systematic floors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了利用双光子关联量子态进行高精度时间估计的应用。通过将光子对输入Hong-Ou-Mandel偏振干涉仪生成N=2的N00N纠缠态，并比较了双探测器和四探测器方案的时间估计精度。结果表明，四探测器方案通过测量符合项和光子聚束项，无需表征系统损耗即可达到量子Fisher信息给出的最大精度。考虑到重复测量中系统误差引起的关联，四探测器方案在时间延迟估计精度上优于双探测器方案，将色散提高了2倍。
authors: Julián Defant, Agustina G. Magnoni, Miguel A. Larotonda, Laura T. Knoll

articles.title: Energetic channels in finite many-body quantum charging
articles.title_zh: 有限多体量子充电中的能量通道
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22034v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We examine how a finite many-body system can function as an effective charger for a single-qubit quantum battery, using the Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick model as a paradigmatic setting. As our figure of merit, we consider the battery ergotropy while explicitly resolving the energetic flows across the composite system. In the absence of intra-charger interactions, we show that the generation of non-zero ergotropy is controlled by the competition between collective coupling and spectral mismatch. We further demonstrate that even passive positive-temperature charger states can generate finite battery ergotropy, provided the charger is sufficiently large and sufficiently hot. Intra-charger interactions restructure the charger spectrum and qualitatively modify the available energetic pathways. While they can enhance the amount of energy accessible for charging, they can simultaneously divert energy into internal many-body and battery-charger interaction channels, producing an energetic impedance to direct charger-to-battery transfer. Consequently, battery ergotropy alone is insufficient to characterize an effective many-body charger: the useful work generated and its energetic provenance must be assessed together.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文以Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick模型为例，研究了有限多体系统如何作为单量子比特电池的有效充电器。研究发现，在无充电器内部相互作用时，非零可用功的产生受集体耦合和谱失配的竞争控制。即使是被动正温度充电器态，只要足够大和热，也能产生有限的电池可用功。充电器内部相互作用会重构充电器谱并改变能量路径，虽然能增加可用于充电的能量，但也会将能量转移到内部多体和电池-充电器相互作用通道，从而产生能量阻抗。因此，仅靠电池可用功不足以表征有效的多体充电器。
authors: Dara Murphy, George Mihailescu, Anne Matthies, Irene D'Amico, Steve Campbell

articles.title: Generalized m-body mean-field projections for classical simulation of d-dimensional Heisenberg-picture dynamics
articles.title_zh: 用于d维海森堡图像动力学经典模拟的广义m体平均场投影
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22069v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Classical simulation of quantum many-body dynamics is challenged by the rapid growth of operator complexity, particularly in higher dimensions where tensor-network methods become increasingly demanding. We develop state-adapted Pauli-weight propagation based on generalized m-body mean-field projections, which compress many-body observables into optimal low-body representations in a covariance geometry induced by the initial state. Combined with adaptive Krylov-like restricted Heisenberg dynamics, this provides an alternative to conventional Hilbert--Schmidt Pauli-weight truncation. We derive necessary and conditional sufficient bounds on low-body approximation accuracy using standard operator complexity measures and characterize possible dynamical failure mechanisms of the state-adapted method. Numerical benchmarks demonstrate substantial state-dependent accuracy gains, while identifying regimes of reduced accuracy or violations of Pauli spectral bounds. For a three-dimensional system of 80 interacting spins, our method achieves strong body-order convergence, close agreement with independently converging tensor-network simulations, and substantially smaller sparse Pauli representations. These results establish state-adapted Pauli propagation as a promising approach to classical simulation of higher-dimensional coherent many-body dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 经典模拟量子多体动力学面临算符复杂度快速增长的挑战，尤其在高维情况下。本文提出了一种基于广义m体平均场投影的状态自适应Pauli权重传播方法，它将多体可观测量压缩为最优的低体表示。结合自适应Krylov型受限海森堡动力学，该方法为传统Hilbert-Schmidt Pauli权重截断提供了替代方案。数值基准测试表明，该方法在80个相互作用自旋的三维系统中实现了显著的状态依赖精度增益和强大的体阶收敛性，与独立收敛的张量网络模拟结果高度一致。
authors: Federico Tomás B. Pérez, Gabriela Wójtowicz, Matthias Kost, Martin B. Plenio

articles.title: Connectivity Bounds for GHZ Graphs
articles.title_zh: GHZ图的连通性界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22190v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) states are multipartite entangled quantum states that play a central role in quantum information theory, with applications in quantum communication, cryptography, and distributed quantum computing. A major experimental goal is to create high-dimensional GHZ states using multiple entangled parties. Krenn, Gu and Zeilinger discovered a surprising bridge between these quantum-optical experiments and graph theory: certain photonic experiments can be represented by edge-coloured, edge-weighted graphs, and the dimension of the produced GHZ state equals the number of feasible monochromatic inherited vertex colourings. This led Krenn and Gu to conjecture that every GHZ graph with more than four vertices has dimension at most 2. A counterexample would give a new high-dimensional multipartite GHZ construction, while a proof would clarify fundamental resource limitations in quantum optics. It is known that the conjecture holds for graphs of vertex connectivity at most 2 [MFCS 2024], and that simple GHZ graphs with n>4 vertices have dimension less than n/sqrt2 [Quantum 2024]. However, no general upper bound depending only on vertex connectivity was known. We prove that every simple connected GHZ graph G with at least four vertices has dimension at most 2κ⁽G⁾⁻¹+binomκ(G)2, where κ(G) is the vertex connectivity of G. We also prove new bounds in terms of edge connectivity and maximum degree.
articles.abstract_zh: Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) 态是量子信息理论中的核心多体纠缠态。Krenn、Gu和Zeilinger发现光子实验与图论之间存在联系，其中GHZ态的维度等于可行单色继承顶点着色的数量。他们推测，所有超过四个顶点的GHZ图的维度至多为2。本文研究了GHZ图的连通性界限，已知该猜想对顶点连通性至多为2的图成立，但目前尚无普遍的上限依赖于连通性。
authors: L. Sunil Chandran, Rishikesh Gajjala

articles.title: Energetics of Fault-Tolerant Spin-Qubit Quantum Computation
articles.title_zh: 容错自旋量子比特量子计算的能耗
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22199v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Semiconductor spin qubits offer a promising route to compact and scalable quantum computers, combining long coherence times in isotopically purified silicon with compatibility with semiconductor manufacturing. Beyond computational speedup, their energy efficiency is an important consideration for future large-scale systems. We evaluate the power and energy requirements of a Loss-DiVincenzo spin-qubit quantum computer by analyzing the Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) and benchmarking it against the classical Fast Fourier Transform (FFT). We develop a detailed energy budget, identifying cryogenic cooling as the dominant baseline contribution before quantum error correction (QEC). The comparison between the QFT and the classical FFT reveals that, for any quantum workload operating under a polynomially bounded sampling regime, the crossover in energy consumption occurs at smaller problem sizes than the crossover in execution time. Thus, quantum computing can become energetically competitive before achieving a speedup in execution time. We then incorporate surface-code QEC and analyze the energy costs of QEC cycles, gate synthesis, and decoding. At scale, instrumentation and decoding become dominant contributions, while cryogenic cooling imposes a constraint on scalability. We show that optimizing the control-signal demultiplexing ratio can reduce the overall energy cost by approximately two orders of magnitude. For a system with about one million physical qubits, we estimate a power consumption of approximately 100 kW, at least one order of magnitude below that of today's highest-performance classical computing systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 半导体自旋量子比特为紧凑和可扩展的量子计算机提供了有前景的途径，其能效是未来大规模系统的重要考量。本文通过分析量子傅里叶变换（QFT）并与经典快速傅里叶变换（FFT）进行基准测试，评估了Loss-DiVincenzo自旋量子比特量子计算机的功耗和能量需求。研究发现，在量子纠错（QEC）之前，低温冷却是主要的基线能耗。QFT与FFT的比较表明，在多项式有界采样机制下，量子计算的能耗交叉点出现在比执行时间交叉点更小的问题规模处，意味着量子计算在实现速度提升之前即可在能耗上具有竞争力。
authors: João Santos, Jayshankar Nath, Marco Pezzutto, Valentin Savin, Tristan Meunier, Yasser Omar

articles.title: Efficient quantum simulation of unitary gates based on atomic ensembles
articles.title_zh: 基于原子系综的酉门高效量子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22207v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a technique to perform efficient unitary time evolution of a general spin Hamiltonian based on the system with identical qubits, as naturally realized by permutation symmetric atomic ensembles. We employ Cartan decomposition method to the associated Hamiltonian Lie algebra and construct the symmetry adapted generators to implement unitary operator of the ensemble Hamiltonian. This enables the compact circuit representations of the system dynamics in terms of experimentally accessible collective spin operations and exploits the Dicke basis structure of the ensembles as an effective qudit representation. We benchmark Cartan based evolution against both exact time evolution and the Suzuki Trotter product formula. Our results show that the Cartan protocol accurately reproduces the operator dynamics, spin expectation values, and fluctuation observables with zero error that are substantially smaller than those obtained through Trotterization while maintaining an optimized circuit structure. In addition, scaling analysis with the ensemble size demonstrates that the Cartan error remains independent of the atom number while the corresponding Trotter error increases with the system size, highlighting the improved efficiency of the Cartan approach for a larger system size.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文开发了一种基于相同量子比特系统（如置换对称原子系综）对通用自旋哈密顿量进行高效酉时间演化的技术。通过对哈密顿量李代数进行Cartan分解，并构建对称适应生成器，实现了系综哈密顿量的酉算符。该方法以实验可行的集体自旋操作形式提供了紧凑的系统动力学电路表示，并利用了系综的Dicke基结构作为有效的qudit表示。与精确时间演化和Suzuki-Trotter公式相比，Cartan协议能以显著更小的误差精确重现算符动力学、自旋期望值和涨落可观测量，且误差与原子数量无关。
authors: Manish Chaudhary, Tim Byrnes

articles.title: Constrained dissipation and the lifetime of quantum many-body scars
articles.title_zh: 受限耗散与量子多体疤痕的寿命
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22223v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the fate of quantum many-body scars in the PXP model subject to Markovian dissipation. We show that when local jump operators respect the same symmetries of the Hamiltonian the full Liouvillian spectrum displays a tower of states with properties analogous to standard quantum scars: large overlaps with Néel states and equally spaced gaps in the imaginary part of the eigenvalues, set by a single frequency. Whether the long-time dynamics is dominated by scars is determined by the real parts of the eigenvalues, which are set by the ratio between the two relaxation rates γ± describing spin flips down-to-up or up-to-down respectively. For asymmetric dissipation (γ₊ > γ₋₎ the scarred eigenvalues have the smallest real parts: the resulting enhanced fidelity oscillations are further stabilized by staggered jump operators. In contrast, replacing the full projection operator in the dissipators with a partial one breaks the symmetries of the problem and is seen to destroy dissipative scars altogether.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了PXP模型中量子多体疤痕在马尔可夫耗散下的演化。研究表明，当局部跳跃算符尊重哈密顿量的对称性时，完整的Liouvillian谱会显示出具有标准量子疤痕特性的态塔。疤痕是否主导长时间动力学取决于特征值的实部，这由向上和向下自旋翻转的两个弛豫率之比决定。在非对称耗散下，疤痕特征值具有最小的实部，导致增强的保真度振荡，并由交错跳跃算符进一步稳定。然而，用部分投影算符替换耗散器中的完整投影算符会破坏问题对称性，从而完全消除耗散疤痕。
authors: Weyner Ccuiro, Rosario Fazio, Alessandro Silva

articles.title: SynDebug: A Framework to Debug Logic Bugs in Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing Programs
articles.title_zh: SynDebug：一个用于调试容错量子计算程序中逻辑错误的框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22275v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) introduces substantial systems-level complexity through quantum error correction (QEC), making debugging FTQC programs challenging. Existing quantum debugging approaches primarily target logical-level circuits and do not naturally support debugging within realistic FTQC execution flows. We present SynDebug, the first systems-level debugging framework for FTQC programs. SynDebug introduces lightweight assertion-based debugging primitives that operate directly within encoded FTQC infrastructures while avoiding additional logical surface area and minimizing temporal overhead. We evaluate SynDebug across multiple QEC code families, code distances, and encoded workloads, including state preparation, entanglement validation, and Shor-style programs. Our results demonstrate that SynDebug enables practical FTQC debugging with an average 1.8% additional circuit depth overhead (0% in most cases) and no measurable increase in the logical error rate, showing that systems-level debugging for large-scale FTQC applications is both feasible and practical.
articles.abstract_zh: 容错量子计算（FTQC）因量子纠错（QEC）引入了显著的系统级复杂性，使得程序调试极具挑战。本文提出了SynDebug，首个针对FTQC程序的系统级调试框架。SynDebug引入了轻量级的基于断言的调试原语，可在编码的FTQC基础设施中直接操作，同时避免额外的逻辑表面积并最小化时间开销。实验结果表明，SynDebug实现了实用的FTQC调试，平均仅增加1.8%的电路深度开销，且逻辑错误率没有可测量的增加，证明了大规模FTQC应用的系统级调试是可行且实用的。
authors: Nicholas S. DiBrita, Jack Lange, Tirthak Patel

articles.title: Magna: simulating magic state factories as cheaply as Clifford circuits
articles.title_zh: Magna：像Clifford电路一样廉价地模拟魔术态工厂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22315v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Classical simulation of magic state factories, including distillation, cultivation, and code switching, is challenging because of their substantial non-Clifford content. We introduce textttmagna (magic-state-factory assessment via global network algebra), a classical simulator that simulates such protocols as cheaply as Clifford circuits. textttmagna expresses the figures of merit of a protocol, namely the acceptance rate and the fidelity of the accepted states, as tensor networks, which it reduces globally by exploiting a structural correspondence with transversal gates on quantum codes. textttmagna further supports feedforward conditioned on arbitrary functions of mid-circuit measurement outcomes, including decoder outputs. We simulate Bravyi--Haah distillation with up to 100 output magic states at a cost that does not grow exponentially in the number of outputs, and achieve state-of-the-art sampling times for distance-5 magic state cultivation on both color codes and RP² surface codes. Finally, we validate nonlinear feedforward on a logical-level distillation protocol with 15 rounds of decoder-dependent feedforward. textttmagna aims to contribute to the key infrastructure for the large-scale evaluation and optimization of magic state factories.
articles.abstract_zh: 魔术态工厂的经典模拟因其大量的非Clifford内容而极具挑战。本文介绍了Magna，一个经典模拟器，能够像Clifford电路一样廉价地模拟魔术态工厂协议。Magna将协议的性能指标表示为张量网络，并通过利用与量子码上横向门的结构对应关系进行全局约化。该模拟器在Bravyi-Haah蒸馏和距离为5的魔术态培养方面取得了最先进的性能，证明了其高效性和实用性。
authors: Yifei Wang, Yingfei Gu

articles.title: Stability of Quantum LDPC States under Local Pauli Noise
articles.title_zh: 局部泡利噪声下量子LDPC态的稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22357v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes have a canonical mixed state---the normalized projector onto the code space---that lies at the intersection of quantum error correction and quantum many-body physics, yet the stability of its information-theoretic structure under local noise remains poorly understood. Recent progress on mixed-state phases of matter has identified the spatial decay of conditional mutual information (CMI) I(A:C|B) as a key diagnostic of such stability, analogous to the role of the spectral gap for quantum ground states. We prove that, for the normalized code-projector state of a Z_d qLDPC stabilizer code under local Pauli noise, the CMI across a buffer B separating A from C decays exponentially with the width of B in two complementary noise regimes independent of system size. At weak noise, this holds for full-system tripartitions, where correlations between the two sides require an error cluster to cross the buffer, an exponentially unlikely event. At strong noise, exponential decay holds whenever the buffer supports no logical operator, since correlations can persist only along rare chains of buffer qudits that remain informative. Under an additional space-uniformity assumption, we establish the robustness of Levin--Wen topological entropy. On finite-dimensional lattices of size n, the weak-noise bound further implies a constant-layer quasi-local Petz recovery channel of range O(poly(łog n)/ǎrepsilon) that recovers the noiseless state within trace-distance error ǎrepsilon. Both CMI bounds apply to general qLDPC interaction graphs, including geometries where such constant-depth quasi-local recovery need not exist. Thus, the exponential decay of the noise-induced CMI provides a general criterion for mixed-state phase stability.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子低密度奇偶校验（qLDPC）码的规范混合态在量子纠错和量子多体物理的交叉点上，但其信息论结构在局部噪声下的稳定性尚不清楚。本文证明，对于Z_d qLDPC稳定器码的归一化码投影态在局部泡利噪声下，条件互信息（CMI）I(A:C|B)随缓冲B的宽度呈指数衰减。这一发现揭示了qLDPC码在不同噪声条件下的鲁棒性，为理解其信息稳定性提供了理论基础。
authors: Tai-Hsuan Yang, Andrew D. Kim, Akash Vijay, Jong Yeon Lee

articles.title: Discovering state-of-the-art quantum circuits with large language models
articles.title_zh: 利用大型语言模型发现最先进的量子电路
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22367v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Significant efforts are currently being directed toward the implementation of large-scale quantum information processors, but realizing useful quantum advantage also requires the development of efficient quantum algorithms. While for many practical problems the dominant resource costs are associated with a small set of computational primitives, optimizing them in the quantum setting presents unique challenges, including a reversibility constraint absent from ordinary classical computation. Here we introduce an evolutionary framework in which large language models (LLMs) propose circuit designs and an independent evaluator verifies and scores them. We apply this framework to tasks spanning numerical computation, chemistry, optimization, quantum simulation, and number theory. In seven of the eight tasks, the discovered circuits significantly reduce both Toffoli and qubit counts relative to the state of the art. In the eighth, the search discovers a new reversible architecture for prime-field modular inversion. By handling reversibility differently, the architecture makes divsteps -- a classical algorithm previously impractical for reversible integer arithmetic -- viable and substantially improves the Toffoli-qubit trade-off for modular inversion. These results open the door for evaluator-guided LLM co-design of new algorithmic structures for quantum computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 实现大规模量子信息处理器需要高效的量子算法，但量子环境下的优化面临独特挑战，包括可逆性约束。本文引入了一个进化框架，其中大型语言模型（LLMs）提出电路设计，并由独立评估器进行验证和评分。该框架应用于数值计算、化学、优化、量子模拟和数论等任务。在八项任务中的七项中，发现的电路显著减少了Toffoli门和量子比特数量，超越了现有技术水平，并在第八项任务中发现了一种用于素数域模逆的新型可逆架构。
authors: Andi Gu, Alek H. Kemeny, Susanne F. Yelin, Mikhail D. Lukin

articles.title: A Rydberg atom array coupled to a high-cooperativity optical cavity
articles.title_zh: 耦合到高合作度光学腔的里德堡原子阵列
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20889v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Integrating Rydberg-state control of atom-atom interactions with cavity control of atom-light interactions enables the combination of local entangling operations with photon-mediated long-range coupling, measurement, and communication. Such integration is challenging because electric fields generated by charges on cavity optics and by cavity-stabilizing actuators may disturb Rydberg-state coherence. Here, we couple a Rydberg tweezer array to a high-cooperativity optical cavity, suppressing the electric fields produced by cavity length actuation so that the residual field variation of about 3~mV/cm rms does not limit Rydberg coherence. We demonstrate two capabilities that neither system provides alone. First, we use Purcell-enhanced fluorescence to read out atoms directly in the ground-Rydberg basis within 7.5~μs, well within the Rydberg-state lifetime, with ground- and Rydberg-state detection infidelities of 3% and 5%, respectively, and with low atom loss. Second, we use Rydberg-Rydberg interactions to control collective light-atom scattering into the cavity mode. Specifically, we drive blockaded Rabi oscillations between a state with two ground-state atoms, which scatter collectively with a superradiant or subradiant rate controlled by the atomic positions, and an entangled state with a single Rydberg excitation, which scatters like a single atom. These capabilities open routes toward networked Rydberg processors, mid-circuit measurements in analog quantum simulators, and many-body quantum optics with entangled emitters coupled collectively to light.
articles.abstract_zh: 将里德堡态控制的原子间相互作用与腔控制的原子-光相互作用相结合，可实现局部纠缠操作与光子介导的长程耦合、测量和通信。本文将里德堡光镊阵列耦合到高合作度光学腔，成功抑制了腔长驱动产生的电场，使残余电场变化不限制里德堡相干性。该系统展示了两项独立系统无法实现的能力：一是利用Purcell增强荧光在7.5微秒内直接读取基态-里德堡态原子，二是利用里德堡-里德堡相互作用控制集体光-原子散射进入腔模式。
authors: Tai Xiang, Yue-Hui Lu, Tsai-Chen Lee, Jacquelyn Ho, Michael Lan, Zhenjie Yan, Harry Levine, Nathaniel B. Vilas, Dan M. Stamper-Kurn

articles.title: Localized states of the non-Hermitian Schrödinger equation with a complex 1/r² potential: from Efimov states to bipolarons
articles.title_zh: 具有复数1/r²势的非厄米薛定谔方程的局域态：从Efimov态到双极化子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21155v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the non-Hermitian Schrödinger equation with a complex 1/r² potential, which bridges Hermitian few-body and non-Hermitian many-body physics: a real attractive potential describes Efimov bound states, whereas a purely imaginary one describes the medium-induced interaction between two heavy polarons at large separations. We solve this equation analytically, obtaining both the localized and continuum states, and compare the solutions with numerical and WKB results. As the imaginary part of the potential is increased, the energies of the Efimov bound states acquire imaginary parts and rotate counterclockwise in the complex plane. On approaching the purely imaginary potential, the excited states disappear sequentially, while the Efimov ground state is smoothly connected to a bipolaron state localized at short distance. Such a bipolaron is localized solely by the medium-induced imaginary interaction, without any attractive real potential. Solving the equation by finite differences, we find that each bipolaron state is necessarily accompanied by another localized state that oscillates on the scale of the mesh size and hence has no counterpart in the continuum limit. Each such pair coalesces at an exceptional point as the strength of the purely imaginary potential is varied, whereas the coalescence is lifted once a finite real part is introduced. We show that this behavior originates from a symmetry of the discretized Schrödinger equation that holds for any purely imaginary potential.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有复数1/r²势的非厄米薛定谔方程，该方程连接了厄米少体物理和非厄米多体物理。研究发现，随着势的虚部增加，Efimov束缚态的能量获得虚部并在复平面上逆时针旋转。当接近纯虚势时，激发态依次消失，而Efimov基态平滑地连接到短距离局域的双极化子态。这种双极化子仅由介质诱导的虚相互作用局域化，无需任何吸引性实势。
authors: Kyoka Tsunoda, Kazuki Yamamoto, Shimpei Endo

articles.title: Jianmu-Q: Bridging Quantum Field Theory and Quantum Hardware with AI Agents
articles.title_zh: Jianmu-Q：用AI智能体连接量子场论与量子硬件
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21942v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum computing offers a promising approach to non-perturbative simulations of quantum field theories, particularly for real-time dynamics and systems affected by the sign problem. Yet translating continuum field theories into quantum computations remains a challenging interdisciplinary task. Here we introduce textttJianmu-Q, a multi-agent framework that transforms natural-language descriptions of quantum field theories into quantum simulation workflows. Specialized agents handle theoretical formulation, lattice discretization, qubit mapping, and circuit design, while physical consistency checks and independent numerical calculations provide validation throughout the workflow. We benchmark the framework on three field theories of increasing complexity: the (1+1)-dimensional Nambu--Jona-Lasinio and Schwinger models, and a (2+1)-dimensional Z₂ gauge theory. Across these systems, noiseless quantum-circuit simulations converge toward independent exact-diagonalization and tensor-network results, while selected circuits are executed on IBM quantum hardware, demonstrating an end-to-end, validation-guided approach to quantum simulation of field theories.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子计算为量子场论的非微扰模拟提供了有前景的方法，但将连续场论转化为量子计算仍是挑战。本文介绍了Jianmu-Q，一个多智能体框架，能将量子场论的自然语言描述转化为量子模拟工作流。专业智能体负责理论公式化、格点离散化、量子比特映射和电路设计，并通过物理一致性检查和独立数值计算进行验证。该框架在三种复杂性递增的场论上进行了基准测试，展示了端到端、验证导向的量子模拟方法。
authors: Xiaolin Wang, Xingyu Guo, Jinyang Li, Tianyin Li, Enke Wang, Lingxiao Wang, Hongxi Xing

articles.title: Classification of bipartite observables III: simplicity, mixtures and quantum error correction
articles.title_zh: 二分可观测量分类III：简洁性、混合物与量子纠错
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22205v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The paradigm of a simple unstable theory in the sense of Shelah is the theory of the random graph, the Fraïssé limit of the finite graphs. Quantum error correction has a paradigm of its own, and we show that it is the counterpart of the random graph: the Pauli group on countably many qubits, taken modulo phases and with commutation as its relation, is the Fraïssé limit of the finite alternating spaces over the two-element field, and its form computes the syndromes of stabilizer codes. Seen through this correspondence, simplicity theory turns out to be a theory of error correction. Clifford encoding circuits implement the homogeneity of the Pauli group, forking recognizes the logical errors, and the independence theorem of Kim and Pillay is the gluing of syndromes. The two paradigms look alike as first-order structures, and they part company only when observables enter. Each defines a bipartite observable, and we prove that, once preparations are mixed, both acquire the tree property of the second kind in real-valued logic. They reach it by different roads, however, and we show that the probes decide which. The probes of the Pauli observable are the Pauli channels; for them the indicator of each syndrome sector is the difference of the responses of two uniform mixtures, and actual mixtures already witness the tree. The probes of the Rado observable see only marginals; conditions given by actual mixtures remain compatible on disjoint blocks, and the tree must be sought among idealized preparations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将量子纠错的范式与随机图理论联系起来，表明可数个量子比特上的泡利群是有限交错空间在二元域上的Fraïssé极限，其形式计算稳定器码的综合征。通过这种对应关系，简洁性理论被揭示为一种纠错理论。研究还证明，当制备态混合时，随机图理论和量子纠错这两种范式在实值逻辑中都获得了第二类树性质，但它们达到此性质的路径不同。
authors: Eduardo Dueñez, José Iovino

articles.title: Low-overhead tailoring and learning of noise in graph states
articles.title_zh: 图态中噪声的低开销定制与学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.12870v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Graph and hypergraph states are important resource states for realizing universal quantum computation and diverse non-local physical phenomena. However, noise learning in such states is challenging due to their large entanglement and magic. This work establishes a low Clifford hierarchy circuit-based scheme for tailoring and learning noise in (hyper)graph states generated by multiple controlled-Z gates. The key is to convert the noisy input state into diagonal form and derive the convolution equation for the diagonal noise rates, which has a lower resource overhead. Such a diagonal form can be used in real quantum simulation by using the same conversion technique on the graph state input. We demonstrate that a single-depth Bell measurement is sufficient in our scheme for arbitrary graph states, while noise tailoring can be done via Pauli operations. After that, we suggest the Walsh-Hadamard transform and some approximation method for decoding the convolution equation to estimate the tailored noise. We prove that constant sampling and polynomial time complexities are sufficient to guarantee bounded noise estimation error with respect to the l₂₋ₙₒᵣₘ, which usually requires exponential complexity with existing noise estimation methods. The polynomial complexities are maintained even for the more stringent l₁ approximation under the sparse noise assumption. Conclusively, we propose novel methods for characterizing the noise properties of an entangled state at a lower cost than that of state generation. Moreover, compared with state verification methods, we can attain richer information on noise rates and enable noise mitigation, thereby providing guarantees for the preparation of graph states.
articles.abstract_zh: 图态和超图态是实现通用量子计算和非局域物理现象的重要资源态，但其噪声学习因纠缠和“魔力”大而具有挑战性。本文提出了一种基于低Clifford层级电路的方案，用于定制和学习多控Z门生成的（超）图态中的噪声。该方案通过将含噪输入态转换为对角形式并推导对角噪声率的卷积方程，实现了较低的资源开销。研究表明，对于任意图态，单深度贝尔测量足以满足要求，且噪声定制可通过泡利操作完成。
authors: Guedong Park, Jinzhao Sun, Hyunseok Jeong

articles.title: Entanglement Detection with Rotationally Covariant Measurements -- From Compton Scattering to Lemonade
articles.title_zh: 旋转协变测量下的纠缠检测——从康普顿散射到柠檬水
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.03984v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The accurate and efficient detection of quantum entanglement remains a central challenge in quantum information science. In this work, we study the detection of entanglement of polarized photons for measurement devices that are specified by rotational covariance. We derive explicit positive operator-valued measures (POVMs) showing that any such (idealized) setting is classified by one real measurable parameter r. In particular, we give a POVM formulation of the Klein-Nishina formula for Compton scattering of polarized photons. We provide an SDP-based entanglement certification method with computable bounds that operates on the full measured statistics, also considering semi-device independent scenarios. Furthermore, we show that, while Bell violations are impossible with two rotationally covariant measurements, EPR steering can still be certified under one-sided symmetry constraints. Finally, we demonstrate how our approach can be applied by analyzing a rotationally covariant showcase experiment using scattered polarized light in a selection of soft drinks. Our results motivate further investigation of entanglement detection with lemonade- based detectors.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子纠缠的精确高效检测是量子信息科学的核心挑战。本文研究了在旋转协变测量设备下偏振光子纠缠的检测，并推导了显式正算子值测量（POVMs），表明任何此类理想设置都由一个可测量的实参数r分类。研究提供了基于SDP的纠缠认证方法，并证明了尽管两个旋转协变测量无法实现贝尔不等式违反，但在单侧对称约束下仍可认证EPR导引。最后，通过分析软饮料中散射偏振光的旋转协变实验，展示了该方法的应用。
authors: Marlene Funck, Ilija Funk, Tizian Schmidt, René Schwonnek

articles.title: General Quantum Protocol for Communication via n--Qubit GHZ States
articles.title_zh: 基于n量子比特GHZ态的通用量子通信协议
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.14280v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This study presents a generalized n--bit superdense coding protocol that enables the transmission of n classical bits of information using an entangled n--qubit quantum system and the transmission of n-1 qubits. The protocol involves creating a maximally entangled n--qubit GHZ state, encoding the classical message with Pauli--Z and Pauli--X gates, and then transmitting and decoding the message via quantum communication, quantum operations, and measurements. The key novelty of this work is an explicit, scalable n--bit encoding routine, realized on the GHZ channel with a low--depth encoding layer using only single--qubit Pauli--X and Pauli--Z operations. The protocol was tested on real quantum hardware using Qiskit 2.0 and the IBM--Fez quantum computer for message lengths of 4, 6, 8, and 10 bits, as a circuit--level proof of concept on a single processor; the physical transmission of qubits between the parties was not implemented. Results show that success rates decrease as message length, transpiled circuit depth and gate count increase; the latter two are set mainly by transpilation rather than by the encoding itself. A mutual information analysis shows that the transmitted information exceeds the classical bound of n-1 bits only for short messages. Strategies to improve performance include sending messages in shorter segments and advances in qubit coherence and gate fidelity. This work offers a practical and easily scalable quantum communication protocol with potential applications in quantum networks and communication systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种广义的n比特超密编码协议，利用纠缠的n量子比特系统和n-1个量子比特的传输，实现n个经典比特的信息传输。该协议涉及创建最大纠缠的n量子比特GHZ态，使用Pauli-Z和Pauli-X门编码经典消息，并通过量子通信、量子操作和测量进行传输和解码。其核心创新在于一个显式、可扩展的n比特编码例程，仅使用单量子比特Pauli-X和Pauli-Z操作在GHZ信道上实现低深度编码层。该协议在IBM量子硬件上进行了概念验证，结果显示成功率随消息长度、转译电路深度和门计数增加而降低。
authors: Saba Arife Bozpolat

articles.title: Simulation of topological superconductors and their competing orders using photon-mediated interactions
articles.title_zh: 利用光子介导相互作用模拟拓扑超导体及其竞争序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.17889v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Realizing and controlling the unconventional pairing featured by topological superconductors remains a central challenge. We introduce a cavity QED quantum simulator that engineers competing chiral pₓ₊ᵢₚ_y and dₓ^₂₋y^₂+idₓy orders by tailoring cavity-mediated couplings between atomic pseudospins that emulate momentum-dependent pairing channels.
