The desired spatially inhomogeneous cavity-mediated couplings can be engineered in a 2D optical lattice using incommensurate cavity-lattice wavelengths naturally occurring in cavity QED systems. This minimal and fully tunable platform enables controlled state preparation and continuous measurement of superconducting order parameters. To probe this competition, the platform enables selective excitation and direct time-domain detection of Bardasis-Schrieffer modes---collective excitations of the subdominant pairing channel. The same competing channel can have an even stronger impact out of equilibrium, where a sudden quench can drive its growth and abruptly reshape the dominant superconducting order, despite the stability of the dominant order in equilibrium. Together, these results establish cavity QED as a controlled setting for revealing hidden competing orders and exploring nonlinear dynamics of topological superconductivity that remain elusive in solid-state and ultracold-atom systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 实现和控制拓扑超导体中非传统配对是一个核心挑战。本文介绍了一种腔QED量子模拟器，通过定制原子赝自旋之间的腔介导耦合，模拟动量依赖的配对通道，从而工程化竞争的手性pₓ₊ᵢₚ_y和dₓ^₂₋y^₂+idₓy序。该平台实现了超导序参数的受控态制备和连续测量，并能选择性激发和直接时域检测Bardasis-Schrieffer模式。研究表明，竞争通道在非平衡态下可能产生更强影响，突然的骤冷可驱动其增长并重塑主导超导序。
authors: Anjun Chu, Joyce Kwan, Eric Yilun Song, Seth Hew Peng Chew, James K. Thompson, Ana Maria Rey

articles.title: Realization of a cavity-coupled Rydberg array
articles.title_zh: 腔耦合里德堡原子阵列的实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.12152v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Scalable quantum computers and quantum networks require the combination of quantum processing nodes with efficient light-matter interfaces to distribute quantum information in local or long-distance quantum networks. Neutral-atom arrays have both been coupled to Rydberg states to enable high-fidelity quantum gates in universal processing architectures, and to optical cavities to realize interfaces to photons. However, combining these two capabilities and coupling atom arrays to highly excited Rydberg states in the mode of an optical cavity has been an outstanding challenge. Here we present a novel cavity-coupled Rydberg array that achieves this long-standing goal. We prepare, detect, and control individual atoms in a scalable optical tweezer array, couple them strongly to the optical mode of a high-finesse optical cavity and excite them in a controlled way to Rydberg states. We show that high-cooperativity coupling to an optical cavity -- demonstrated via the dispersive shift of the resonance of the cavity in presence of the atoms -- and strong Rydberg interactions -- demonstrated via the collective enhancement of Rydberg coupling in the atomic array -- can be achieved in our setup at the same spatial location. Our presented experimental platform opens the path to several new directions, including the realization of quantum network nodes, quantum simulation of long-range interacting, open quantum systems and photonic-state engineering leveraging high-fidelity Rydberg control.
articles.abstract_zh: 可扩展的量子计算和量子网络需要结合量子处理节点与高效的光-物质接口。将原子阵列与里德堡态和光学腔结合一直是一个挑战。本文提出了一种新型腔耦合里德堡原子阵列，成功实现了这一目标。该工作在可扩展的光学镊子阵列中制备、探测和控制单个原子，并将其强耦合到高精细度光学腔的模式中，同时受控激发至里德堡态。
authors: Jacopo De Santis, Balázs Dura-Kovács, Mehmet Öncü, Adrien Bouscal, Dimitrios Vasileiadis, Johannes Zeiher

articles.title: Obstacles to Continuous Quantum Error Correction via Parity Measurements
articles.title_zh: 基于奇偶校验测量的连续量子纠错的障碍
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.02106v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Time-continuous quantum error correction, necessary to protect quantum information under time-dependent Hamiltonians, relies on weak continuous syndrome measurements. Implementing these measurements requires a continuous coupling among at least two qubits and a meter, a demanding requirement. We show that, under continuous operation, common parity-measurement protocols in the circuit quantum electrodynamics platform corrupt the logical information. The failure arises from approximating the three-body interaction by a sum of two-body couplings to the meter, which prevents simultaneous suppression of measurement backaction on the logical and error subspaces. We argue that the same mechanism applies more generally beyond the circuit quantum electrodynamics setting. Taken together, our results impose a practical limitation on continuous stabilizer quantum error correction and point to the viable alternatives -- architectures that realize native three-body interactions, or erasure-based encodings in which the error subspace need not be protected.
articles.abstract_zh: 时间连续量子纠错依赖于弱连续综合征测量，但其实现需要至少两个量子比特和一个测量仪之间的连续耦合。本文发现，在连续操作下，电路量子电动力学平台中常见的奇偶校验测量协议会破坏逻辑信息。这种失效源于将三体相互作用近似为两体耦合，阻碍了对逻辑和误差子空间测量反作用的同步抑制。研究结果对连续稳定器量子纠错施加了实际限制，并指出了可行的替代方案。
authors: Anton Halaski, Christiane P. Koch

articles.title: Implementation of non-local arbitrary two-qubit controlled gates via geometric quantum computation with Rydberg anti-blockade
articles.title_zh: 基于里德堡反阻塞几何量子计算的非局域任意两量子比特受控门实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.17656v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In the context of Rydberg anti-blockade, this paper proposes a new scheme for a high-fidelity controlled-unitary gate based on non-adiabatic holonomic quantum computation. Under specific detuning and interaction conditions, the scheme achieves a suitable evolution path for non-adiabatic holonomic quantum computation through reverse engineering of pulse parameters. This scheme can implement arbitrary two-qubit controlled gates with favorable robustness. We also evaluate the effects of spontaneous emission and laser intensity errors on the fidelity; numerical simulations show that the geometric gate scheme still exhibits excellent performance under these errors. Furthermore, we extend the scheme to non-local gates via entanglement transfer and quantum teleportation techniques, and demonstrate its application in the mutual conversion among four-qubit entangled states (GHZ, cluster, and W states). This finding indicates the potential applicability of our scheme to complex quantum information processing tasks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在里德堡反阻塞背景下，提出了一种基于非绝热完整量子计算的高保真受控酉门新方案。该方案通过脉冲参数逆向工程，实现了非绝热完整量子计算的合适演化路径，能够以良好的鲁棒性实现任意两量子比特受控门。数值模拟表明，该几何门方案在自发辐射和激光强度误差下仍表现出色。此外，该方案还可扩展到非局域门，并应用于四量子比特纠缠态的相互转换。
authors: Le-Jiang Yu, Jia Zheng, Kun Pu, Chao Gao

articles.title: Instability-enhanced quantum sensing with tunable multibody interactions
articles.title_zh: 基于可调多体相互作用的不稳定性增强量子传感
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.05047v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Dynamical instabilities can amplify small perturbations into measurable signals, offering a route to quantum-enhanced sensing. This mechanism was experimentally demonstrated in a collective spin system with quadratic interactions, described by a twist-and-turn Hamiltonian, where quantum evolution near an unstable point leads to exponential growth of spin fluctuations, enabling metrological gain beyond the standard quantum limit. Here, we show that a quartic extension of this Hamiltonian substantially increases the amplification. This additional nonlinear term reshapes the phase-space structure, generating new unstable fixed points with larger local Lyapunov exponents and therefore faster signal amplification at shorter evolution times. Remarkably, even for the same instability rate (equal Lyapunov exponent), collective multibody interactions outperform the quadratic case, demonstrating that metrological gain is not determined by the Lyapunov exponent alone. We show analytically that the finite-time growth of the gain is governed also by the local phase-space curvature around the unstable point. Only for a symmetric unstable point, as in the quadratic case, is the finite-time gain described by the Lyapunov exponent alone. Our results identify local phase-space curvature as an additional resource for optimizing the speed and performance of quantum sensors.
articles.abstract_zh: 动力学不稳定性可以将微小扰动放大为可测信号，为量子增强传感提供了途径。本文研究发现，将扭转哈密顿量扩展到四次项可以显著增加放大效应。这种额外的非线性项重塑了相空间结构，产生了具有更大局部李雅普诺指数的新不稳定不动点，从而在更短的演化时间内实现更快的信号放大。研究表明，即使在相同的失稳率下，集体多体相互作用也优于二次相互作用，表明计量增益并非仅由李雅普诺指数决定。
authors: Bidhi Vijaywargia, Jorge Chávez-Carlos, Francisco Pérez-Bernal, Lea F. Santos

articles.title: The bulk spectral gap is certifiable from above but uncomputable from below
articles.title_zh: 体谱隙可从上方认证但无法从下方计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.03836v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Determining spectral gaps in the thermodynamic limit is a central challenge in quantum many-body physics. When a fixed boundary condition is imposed, this problem is undecidable: no algorithm, even with unlimited resources, can decide for every Hamiltonian whether it is gapped. Yet the thermodynamic limit is meant to capture the intrinsic properties of very large systems, which should not depend on how their boundaries are chosen. Here, we therefore consider the bulk spectral gap problem, which concerns only the intrinsic excitations of the infinite system, independently of any boundary. We first give a general algorithm producing a hierarchy of certified upper bounds on the bulk gap, arbitrarily tight at the cost of more computation. Second, we prove that the spectral gap problem remains undecidable in the bulk: no algorithm can decide whether the bulk gap is positive, already for translationally invariant nearest-neighbour chains of fixed local dimension. The bulk spectral gap is thus certifiable from above but uncomputable from below. More precisely, the bulk-gaplessness promise problem is RE-complete, exactly as hard as the halting problem. The same construction also shows that deciding whether an explicitly given state is a ground state of the infinite system is undecidable. Finally, we apply the upper-bounding algorithm to the spin-1/2 kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet to produce the first nontrivial certified upper bounds on its bulk gap.
articles.abstract_zh: 在量子多体物理中，确定热力学极限下的谱隙是一个核心挑战。本文研究了体谱隙问题，即无限系统固有的激发，与边界条件无关。研究首先提出了一种通用算法，可以生成体谱隙的认证上限。其次，证明了体谱隙问题在体态下仍然是不可判定的，即没有算法可以判断体谱隙是否为正。因此，体谱隙可以从上方认证，但无法从下方计算。
authors: Xiangling Xu, Matthias Schötz, Jie Wang, Victor Magron, Igor Klep, Omar Fawzi, Marc-Olivier Renou

articles.title: Phase Retrievability of Super Operators and Measurements
articles.title_zh: 超算子和测量的相位可恢复性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26474v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We continue the study of Phase Retrieval in the Quantum Information setting in the style of i̧teliu2023phase, in a manner which is more general in two primary ways: (a) Instead of only pure states we consider also states (and positive semidefinite operators) of bounded rank, as is done in Quantum Tomography; (b) We consider general super operators instead of only quantum channels. We show that in order to have phase retrieval with respect to positive semidefinite operators of bounded rank, it suffices to discriminate between perfectly distinguishable pairs (i.e. those with orthogonal supports). From this we prove that phase retrievability is always Lipschitz stable with respect to the trace norm, and then we use the Fuchs-van de Graaf inequalities to deduce stability with respect to the Bures--Wasserstein distance (thus generalizing the known stability results for phase retrieval in Frame Theory). For Hermitian-preserving super operators taking values in block-diagonal matrices, we characterize phase retrievability in terms of conditions inspired by the classical complement property from Frame Theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在量子信息背景下，以更普遍的方式继续研究相位恢复问题，考虑了有界秩的正半定算子和广义超算子。研究表明，对于有界秩的正半定算子实现相位恢复，只需区分完全可区分的对即可。由此证明了相位可恢复性对迹范数总是Lipschitz稳定的，并进一步推导出对Bures-Wasserstein距离的稳定性。对于取值于块对角矩阵的厄米特保持超算子，本文根据经典补性质的启发，刻画了相位可恢复性。
authors: Javier Alejandro Chávez-Domínguez, Jeremiah Ifeanyi Isu

articles.title: Optimality of Gaussian Entanglement of Formation
articles.title_zh: 高斯纠缠形成度的最优性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.01909v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We prove that the entanglement of formation of every two-mode Gaussian state coincides with its Gaussian restriction, solving a longstanding open problem in continuous variable quantum information theory. The key result is a sharp affine relation between entanglement and a generalized Einstein--Podolsky--Rosen observable, valid for arbitrary pure two-mode states, including non-Gaussian ones. We further prove that the entanglement of formation is additive on arbitrary tensor products of two-mode Gaussian states, and hence coincides with the entanglement cost, settling the latter for all two-mode Gaussian states. As a consequence, we obtain in closed form the entanglement cost of thermal-loss, thermal-amplifier and additive-noise bosonic channels. Our results, which also extend to bisymmetric multimode states, establish that no two-mode state is less entangled than the Gaussian state with the same covariance matrix, yielding measurable lower bounds on both the entanglement of formation and the entanglement cost of arbitrary non-Gaussian states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了所有双模高斯态的纠缠形成度与其高斯限制一致，解决了连续变量量子信息理论中一个长期存在的开放问题。关键结果是纠缠与广义爱因斯坦-波多尔斯基-罗森可观测量之间存在精确的仿射关系，适用于任意纯双模态。研究还证明了纠缠形成度在任意双模高斯态的张量积上是可加的，因此与纠缠成本一致。这些结果为任意非高斯态的纠缠形成度和纠缠成本提供了可测量的下限。
authors: Gerardo Adesso

articles.title: Empirical Quantum Advantage in Constrained Optimization from Encoded Unitary Designs
articles.title_zh: 来自编码酉设计的约束优化中的经验量子优势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.14296v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce the Constraint-Enhanced Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (CE-QAOA), a shallow, constraint-aware ansatz that operates inside the one-hot product space [n]^m, where m is the number of blocks and each block is initialized in an n-qubit Wₙ state. We give an ancilla-free, depth-optimal encoder that prepares Wₙ using n-1 two-qubit rotations per block, and a two-local block-XY mixer that preserves the one-hot manifold and has a constant spectral gap on the one-excitation sector. At the level of expressivity, we establish per-block controllability, implying approximate universality per block. At the level of distributional behavior, we show that, after natural block and symbol permutation twirls, shallow CE-QAOA realizes an encoded unitary 1-design and supports approximate second-moment (2-design) behavior; combined with a Paley-Zygmund argument, this yields finite-shot anticoncentration guarantees. Algorithmically, we wrap constant-depth sampling with a deterministic feasibility checker to obtain a polynomial-time hybrid quantum-classical solver (PHQC) that returns the best observed feasible solution in O(S n²⁾ time, where S is a polynomial shot budget. We obtain two advantages. First, when CE-QAOA fixes r >= 1 locations different from the start city, we achieve a Theta(n^r) reduction in shot complexity even against a classical sampler that draws uniformly from the feasible set. Second, against a classical baseline restricted to raw bitstring sampling, we show an exp(Theta(n²⁾⁾ minimax separation. In noiseless circuit simulations of traveling salesman problem instances with n in 4,...,10 locations from the QOPTLib benchmark library, we recover the global optimum at depth p = 1 using polynomial shot budgets and coarse parameter grids defined by the problem size.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了约束增强量子近似优化算法（CE-QAOA），这是一种在独热积空间中运行的浅层、约束感知型拟设。该算法提供了一种无辅助比特、深度最优的编码器，并使用一个保持独热流形的双局域块-XY混合器。在表达能力方面，实现了每块可控性，意味着近似的每块普适性。在分布行为方面，浅层CE-QAOA实现了编码酉1-设计并支持近似二阶矩行为。
authors: Chinonso Onah, Roman Firt, Kristel Michielsen

articles.title: Quantum Many-Body Mpemba Effect through Ruelle-Pollicott Resonances
articles.title_zh: 通过Ruelle-Pollicott共振实现的量子多体Mpemba效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.11788v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Relaxation towards equilibrium is often assumed to be slower when a system starts farther from equilibrium, but this intuition fails in the Mpemba effect. Recent advances in controllable quantum platforms have enabled the exploration of its quantum analogue, the quantum Mpemba effect (QME), yet its microscopic origin remains largely unclear. Here we provide a general framework for understanding the QME in closed quantum many-body chaotic systems by reformulating the equilibration process of local subsystems in terms of Ruelle-Pollicott (RP) resonances. We show that suppressing the initial-state overlap with the dominant RP resonant mode accelerates subsystem equilibration and thereby yields the QME. We further uncover that a novel type of strong QME can occur via complete translation-symmetry breaking of initial states. We substantiate our predictions using the prototypical kicked Ising chain and a quantum automaton circuit. These findings cast the QME in closed many-body systems into a unified framework with open-system analogues and provide experimentally accessible signatures on state-of-the-art quantum platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: Mpemba效应挑战了系统离平衡态越远弛豫越慢的直觉。本文通过Ruelle-Pollicott（RP）共振重新构建局部子系统的平衡过程，为理解封闭量子多体混沌系统中的量子Mpemba效应（QME）提供了一个通用框架。研究表明，抑制初始态与主导RP共振模式的重叠可以加速子系统平衡，从而产生QME。此外，通过初始态的完全平移对称性破缺，可以产生一种新型的强QME。
authors: Shion Yamashika, Ryusuke Hamazaki

articles.title: Symmetry-twisted multi-entropies: Order parameters for 2D SPT phases
articles.title_zh: 对称扭曲多熵：二维SPT相的序参量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.12023v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Although symmetry-protected topological phases (SPTs) can be distinguished by their entanglement properties, it has been unclear how to extract this information directly from expectation values beyond the 1D case. Here, we close this gap and propose a pair of nonlocal order parameters that can detect and distinguish all bosonic SPTs in 2D protected by internal discrete, Abelian unitary symmetries. The desired topological invariants are extracted by these quantities by effectively simulating the SPT path integral on topologically non-trivial spacetime manifolds. Our order parameters are defined in terms of expectation values of partial symmetry and permutation operations acting on fixed numbers of replicas of the system in finite spatial regions. These expectation values correspond to symmetry-twisted versions of multipartite entanglement quantities known as multi-entropies. We show explicitly that our two order parameters detect symmetry-protected four-party and six-party entanglement, respectively, and we constrain possible "spurious" contributions. We analytically test our proposal in fixed-point lattice models. Our results suggest multipartite entanglement to be a defining feature of SPTs; indeed, we expect our methods to generalize to fermionic and higher-dimensional systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管对称保护拓扑相（SPT）可以通过其纠缠特性来区分，但如何直接从期望值中提取这些信息在二维以上情况尚不明确。本文提出了一对非局域序参量，可以检测和区分所有受内部离散阿贝尔酉对称性保护的二维玻色子SPT。这些序参量通过模拟SPT路径积分在拓扑非平凡时空流形上提取所需的拓扑不变量。它们对应于多体纠缠量（多熵）的对称扭曲版本，并能检测对称保护的四体和六体纠缠。
authors: Ramanjit Sohal, Michael Levin, Ruben Verresen

articles.title: Enabling large language model agents for high-fidelity many-body perturbation theory calculations
articles.title_zh: 赋能大型语言模型代理进行高精度多体微扰理论计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20779v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many-body perturbation theory (MBPT) methods, including the GW approximation, the GW plus Bethe-Salpeter equation (GW-BSE) method, and GW perturbation theory (GWPT), among others, provide accurate first-principles descriptions of excited-state properties and multiparticle interactions of materials. However, their use remains limited due to complex multi-software workflows, interdependent physical parameters, and substantial theoretical expertise. Large language model (LLM) agents, which couple a language model to software tools, show potential in automating computational tasks, but MBPT remains an unaddressed challenge. We show that LLM agents tested in our work, including frontier models such as Opus 4.7 and GPT-5.5, do not reliably construct MBPT workflows in one attempt, suggesting that correct setup requires expert knowledge and consistency that current models lack. Across tested model-harness combinations, out-of-the-box agents average 54%, 36%, and 19% on GW, GW-BSE, and GWPT workflow benchmarks, with strong model dependence and large run-to-run variation. Errors typically originate from cross-stage inconsistencies that surface only several stages after they are introduced. We therefore develop AI-Donkey, an agentic framework that combines expert-curated knowledge with deterministic execution to enable high-fidelity GW, GW-BSE, and GWPT calculations and analyses. With AI-Donkey, all tested agents, from frontier proprietary models to open-weight models, produce complete, runnable MBPT workflows with no observed run-to-run variation. We further demonstrate autonomous calculations and post-processing on 1D, 2D, and bulk materials, including the many-body enhancement of Fröhlich electron-phonon coupling in polar semiconductors. Our approach provides a general framework for knowledge engineering to enable reliable agentic workflows in computational materials science.
articles.abstract_zh: 多体微扰理论（MBPT）方法提供了材料激发态性质和多粒子相互作用的精确第一性原理描述，但其应用受限于复杂的工作流程和所需的专业知识。大型语言模型（LLM）代理在自动化计算任务方面显示出潜力，但MBPT仍是一个未解决的挑战。本文研究表明，当前LLM代理无法可靠地一次性构建MBPT工作流程，其在GW、GW-BSE和GWPT工作流程基准测试中的平均成功率较低。错误通常源于跨阶段的不一致性，表明现有模型缺乏构建正确设置所需的专业知识和一致性。
authors: Benran Zhang, Byeongchan Lee, Zien Zhu, Chih-En Hsu, Zhenfa Zheng, Hung-Chung Hsueh, Young Woo Choi, Mauro Del Ben, Zhenglu Li

articles.title: Transdimensional Chern insulators in rhombohedral multilayer graphene superlattices
articles.title_zh: 菱方多层石墨烯超晶格中的跨维度陈绝缘体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21310v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent experiments on lightly electron-doped rhombohedral multilayer graphene (RMG) in the "transdimensional" regime revealed anomalous Hall hysteresis under both perpendicular and in-plane magnetic fields, pointing to the emergence of transdimensional orbital magnetism in an interaction-driven "Fermi-lune" metal. Here we demonstrate that, by coupling to the moiré potential, this transdimensional orbital ferromagnetic metal can evolve into quantized Chern insulator phases in twisted RMG/hBN moiré superlattices. Using unrestricted Hartree-Fock calculations, we find that interaction-driven reconstruction isolates a spin-valley-polarized |C| = 1 Chern band, leading to a "transdimensional Chern insulator" (TDCI) state exhibiting both in-plane and out-of-plane orbital magnetizations. A minimal two-band model is introduced to describe the unique properties of TDCI, which unveils the intimate connection between non-reciprocal velocity and in-plane orbital magnetization. We further analyze the collective excitations of TDCIs, and identify soft charge and spin modes that may lead to density wave instabilities in certain cases. An in-plane magnetic field can harden the soft density-wave mode and may drive a transition from density-wave state to TDCI. Finally, when the |C| = 1 band is fractionally filled, the many-body ground state may be a fractional Chern insulator with broken rotation and mirror symmetries.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近的实验揭示了轻电子掺杂菱方多层石墨烯（RMG）在“跨维度”区域的异常霍尔滞后现象。本文证明，通过与莫尔势耦合，这种跨维度轨道铁磁金属可以在扭曲的RMG/hBN莫尔超晶格中演化为量子化的陈绝缘体相。非限制性Hartree-Fock计算发现，相互作用驱动的重构分离出一个自旋谷极化的|C|=1陈带，形成具有面内和面外轨道磁化的“跨维度陈绝缘体”（TDCI）态。研究还引入了一个最小双带模型来描述TDCI的独特特性，并分析了其集体激发。
authors: Min Li, Xin Lu, Lei Wang, Jianpeng Liu

articles.title: Thermodynamic-limit bootstrap: Solving fractional quantum Hall ground states
articles.title_zh: 热力学极限自举法：求解分数量子霍尔基态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21317v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strongly interacting ground states are usually computed in finite systems and then extrapolated to the thermodynamic limit (TDL). Here we develop a quantum many-body bootstrap that solves fractional quantum Hall ground states directly in the TDL. The method gives rigorous and quantitatively tight lower bounds on the ground-state energy and identifies the ground-state structure and topological order. For Laughlin and Pfaffian parent Hamiltonians, it reproduces exact pair-correlation functions and low-lying orbital entanglement spectrum (OES) nearly level by level. For Coulomb interactions, the rigorous TDL energy bounds closely match thermodynamic estimates from exact diagonalization and density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) extrapolations, and the local diagnostics recover established Laughlin and Moore--Read OES counting and Friedel oscillations of the composite Fermi liquid. Beyond these benchmarks, the bootstrap resolves the thermodynamic ground states at ν=1/4 and ν=12/5, identifying a composite Fermi liquid and øverlineRR₃ topological order, respectively. The same framework applies equally well to Abelian and non-Abelian, gapped and gapless quantum Hall states. The TDL bootstrap therefore provides a general ground-state solver that determines both the energy and the state directly in the TDL.
articles.abstract_zh: 强相互作用基态通常通过有限系统计算并外推至热力学极限。本文提出了一种量子多体自举法，可以直接在热力学极限下求解分数量子霍尔基态。该方法为基态能量提供了严格且量化紧密的下限，并能识别基态结构和拓扑序。它成功再现了Laughlin和Pfaffian母哈密顿量的精确对关联函数和低能轨道纠缠谱，并与库仑相互作用下的精确对角化和DMRG外推结果吻合。
authors: Qiang Gao, Taige Wang

articles.title: Flat-band ferrimagnetism in the edge-centered honeycomb antiferromagnet: From harmonic flat magnon to broad continuum
articles.title_zh: 边中心蜂窝状反铁磁体中的平带亚铁磁性：从谐波平坦磁振子到宽连续谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21580v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: One of the most striking aspects of a flat band is not merely its lack of dispersion, but that it reduces the single-particle kinetic energy to a very small scale, allowing interaction effects to become the dominant energy scale in the low-energy physics. This picture has underpinned concepts such as flat-band ferromagnetism, flat-band superconductivity, and localized magnons. A more fundamental question, however, remains. Flat bands belong to the language of single-particle or linear-spin-wave physics; whether they survive as protected sharp excitations in a genuine many-body quantum magnet, or merely provide a skeleton of spectral weight left by the noninteracting picture, remains unclear. We study the spin-1/2 Heisenberg antiferromagnet on the edge-centered honeycomb lattice to examine this question. In contrast to flat bands in geometrically frustrated magnets such as kagome, this lattice has a 2:3 sublattice imbalance that renders the intersublattice coupling matrix rectangular, whose null space gives rise to a flat band at the single-particle level. The same imbalance stabilizes a ferrimagnetic ground state through the Lieb--Mattis theorem and leads to an edge-site-localized flat magnon in linear spin-wave theory. Combining linear spin-wave theory, sign-problem-free stochastic series expansion quantum Monte Carlo, and stochastic analytic continuation, we find that quantum fluctuations transform this harmonic flat mode into a broad continuum whose centroid is about 1.55J and nearly dispersionless along the high-symmetry path. Sublattice imbalance thus offers an unfrustrated route that unifies flat bands and ferrimagnetism, and suggests that flat-band geometry organizes many-body spectral weight rather than giving rise to a protected quasiparticle.
articles.abstract_zh: 平带的一个显著特征是它将单粒子动能降至极小，使相互作用效应在低能物理中占据主导地位。然而，平带是否能在真正的多体量子磁体中作为受保护的尖锐激发而存在，仍不清楚。本文研究了边中心蜂窝晶格上的自旋-1/2海森堡反铁磁体，发现其2:3的子晶格不平衡导致了单粒子层面的平带，并通过Lieb-Mattis定理稳定了亚铁磁基态。该工作旨在探讨平带在多体系统中的行为。
authors: Sicheng He, Zhixuan Zhao, Hanxiang Di, Shuaihua Zhang, Yanling Wu, Jun Li

articles.title: Exciton superfluidity in two-dimensional bilayers at zero and high magnetic fields
articles.title_zh: 零磁场和高磁场下二维双层中的激子超流性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22037v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study interlayer exciton superfluidity versus layer separation in two-dimensional electron-hole bilayers at zero magnetic field and quantum Hall bilayers at total filling ν_T=1. Unscreened Hartree-Fock theory predicts coherence at every finite separation, with an energy scale decaying inversely with separation at large distances. We examine how screening, correlations, and spatial instabilities modify this prediction. At zero field, we solve the linearized gap equation with the full momentum and frequency dependence of the interaction screened within the random-phase approximation, without an imposed cutoff. The apparent plasmon enhancement of pairing in the ladder approximation is largely cancelled by the second-order crossed-rung correction. Static screening determines the leading pairing exponent in the controlled high-density limit at fixed separation. At large separation, the pairing scale falls exponentially with squared separation while the instability persists. Extending this result to fixed density assumes Fermi-liquid layers and higher-order dynamical corrections subleading to the static pairing interaction. At high field, we obtain an analytic uniform Hartree-Fock saddle point in the lowest Landau level, coherent at every finite separation. Within Hartree-Fock theory, its finite-wave-vector collective-mode instability favors an excitonic supersolid, distinguishing loss of spatial uniformity from loss of coherence. We conjecture that the quantum Hall bilayer evolves continuously toward weak pairing of composite fermions, with a scale far below the mean-field prediction at large separation. This suppression could produce an apparent critical separation at finite temperature without a ground-state quantum phase transition. The comparison separates the existence, energy scale, and spatial stability of interlayer coherence.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了零磁场下二维电子-空穴双层和总填充因子ν_T=1的量子霍尔双层中的层间激子超流性与层间距的关系。未屏蔽的Hartree-Fock理论预测在任何有限层间距下都存在相干性。研究进一步探讨了屏蔽、关联和空间不稳定性如何修正这一预测，发现在大层间距下，配对尺度随层间距的平方呈指数衰减，而空间不稳定性依然存在。
authors: Sankar Das Sarma, Yang-Zhi Chou

articles.title: Difference between pair creation and anomaly matching: Nontrivial aspects of invertible symmetries and defects in SU(N) models
articles.title_zh: 对偶产生与反常匹配之间的差异：SU(N)模型中可逆对称性和缺陷的非平凡方面
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21478v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the connection between the SU(N)K Wess-Zumino-Witten (WZW) model and SU(N)K' WZW models, enforcing the unbroken ZN symmetries. The fundamental underlying structures are the (half-)integer spin simple currents in the topological quantum field theories and anomaly matching conditions in conformal field theories. For the (half-)integer spin simple current condition of the folded models SU(N)Kboxtimes_ZN øverlineSU(N)K' or SU(N)Kboxtimes_ZN SU(N)K', we obtain the generalized pairing condition K= ± R²K' (mod.N) with gcd(R,N)=1. On the other hand, the anomaly matching condition results in the weaker condition K= ± RUK' (mod.N) with gcd(R,N)=gcd(U,N)=1. Surprisingly, the anomaly matching without the pairing condition results in the intrinsic mismatch of the preservation law of the ZN defects and symmetries. The pairing condition canonically relates symmetries and defects, as in category theory, whereas it is unclear whether it can be a guiding principle in prohibiting the massless renormalization group flows.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了SU(N)K Wess-Zumino-Witten (WZW) 模型与SU(N)K' WZW 模型之间的联系，并强调了未破缺的ZN对称性。研究发现，折叠模型的(半)整数自旋简单流条件给出了广义配对条件K= ± R²K' (mod.N)，而反常匹配条件则导致了较弱的条件K= ± RUK' (mod.N)。令人惊讶的是，没有配对条件的反常匹配会导致ZN缺陷和对称性守恒定律的内在不匹配。
authors: Yoshiki Fukusumi, Shuma Nakashiba

articles.title: Quantum geometry, localization, and topological bounds of spin fluctuations
articles.title_zh: 量子几何、局域化和自旋涨落的拓扑界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.17454v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study how topological crystalline defects--dislocations--reshape the real-space quantum geometric tensor and act as tunable sources of quantum geometry. We show that dislocations strongly enhance the quantum metric, establishing a direct link between lattice topology and the Hilbert-space geometry of states. We characterize the quantum geometry of topological magnons in ordered arrays of dislocations, demonstrating that defect-induced geometric enhancement controls their localization and topological protection. In disordered arrays, dislocation-driven geometry expands the accessible topological phase space and enables transitions to disorder-induced topological phases. Our results identify the quantum metric as a tunable bridge between crystalline topology, magnonic excitations, and emergent topological matter in aperiodic solid-state and synthetic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了拓扑晶体缺陷（位错）如何重塑实空间量子几何张量，并作为量子几何的可调谐源。研究表明，位错能显著增强量子度规，建立了晶格拓扑与希尔伯特空间几何之间的直接联系。该工作还揭示了缺陷引起的几何增强如何控制拓扑磁振子的局域化和拓扑保护，并在无序阵列中实现向无序诱导拓扑相的转变。
authors: Carlos Saji, Roberto E. Troncoso

articles.title: Simulating cavity QED with spin-orbit coupled Bose-Einstein condensates revisited
articles.title_zh: 重新审视用自旋轨道耦合玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体模拟腔量子电动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.28368v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Simulating cavity quantum electrodynamics in synthetic platforms offers a route to studying light--matter physics without real photons. We reassess the frequently invoked analogy between harmonically trapped, spin--orbit-coupled atoms and the quantum Rabi and Dicke models, with particular emphasis on squeezing and entanglement. A single non-interacting atom realizes the quantum Rabi Hamiltonian exactly, up to elementary spin and phase-space rotations. For N non-interacting atoms, however, the center-of-mass mode is only one member of a complete orthonormal set containing N-1 relative modes. We prove that, after all modes are included, the spin--spin terms generated by the collective mode cancel exactly against those generated by the relative modes. Equivalently, the original Hamiltonian is a sum of independent one-particle Hamiltonians and therefore cannot create interparticle entanglement from a separable state. Contact interactions invalidate this cancellation but do not remove the relative modes or turn the exact many-body Hamiltonian into a Dicke model. A one-mode Dicke description can arise only as a controlled low-energy approximation after all relevant relative excitations have been shown to be spectrally suppressed. We discuss this distinction together with experimental scales, finite temperature, and possible mode-selection strategies. We also distinguish the single-particle interference underlying density fringes from the interaction-stabilized stripe supersolid observed in many-body condensates.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文重新评估了谐振阱中自旋轨道耦合原子与量子Rabi和Dicke模型之间的类比，特别关注挤压和纠缠。研究发现，单个非相互作用原子可以精确实现量子Rabi哈密顿量。然而，对于N个非相互作用原子，集体模式产生的自旋-自旋项与相对模式产生的项会精确抵消，这意味着原始哈密顿量是独立单粒子哈密顿量的和，无法从可分离态产生粒子间纠缠。
authors: Muhammad S. Hasan, Karol Gietka

articles.title: Bulk-dissociated topological bands without spin-orbit coupling in hetero-dimensional superconducting metamaterials
articles.title_zh: 异维超导超材料中无自旋轨道耦合的体解离拓扑能带
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.08675v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Topological superconductors (TSCs) in superconducting hybrid heterostructures, which integrate superconducting and non-superconducting materials, have been intensely investigated with the hope of discovering exotic non-Abelian anyons for fault-tolerant quantum computing. In this effort, a challenge for hybrid superconducting systems is controlling hybridization, which is often a balance between enhancing the superconducting proximity effect at the cost of suppressing desirable electronic properties such as strong spin-orbit interactions. Hence, discovering hybrid superconducting systems with topological properties controlled and enhanced by material geometry design without spin-orbit interactions would be intriguing to explore. In this work, we theoretically study a square superconducting network decorated with spin-polarized magnetic adatoms. We find that localized Yu-Shiba-Rusinov bound states at magnetic adatom sites collectively form a weak topological superconducting phase despite the absence of spin-orbit interactions. We then demonstrate that by tuning the Fermi energy of the network, the system can transition from a weak TSC phase to a bulk-dissociated TSC phase where the edge state bands separate from the bulk, giving rise to unexpected features such as nodal lines and co-existing bulk-dissociated edge and corner modes. Moreover, our findings highlight how hetero-dimensional superconducting metamaterials can serve as a useful template for controlling the coupling and dissociation between electronic degrees of freedom of different dimensionalities.
articles.abstract_zh: 拓扑超导体在超导混合异质结构中备受关注，以期发现用于容错量子计算的非阿贝尔任意子。本文理论研究了装饰有自旋极化磁性吸附原子的方形超导网络。研究发现，尽管没有自旋轨道相互作用，磁性吸附原子处的局域Yu-Shiba-Rusinov束缚态仍能集体形成弱拓扑超导相。通过调节网络的费米能，系统可以从弱拓扑相转变为其他相。
authors: Joseph J. Cuozzo, Sayed Ali Akbar Ghorashi, Purna P. Paudel, Dale Huber, Wei Pan, François Léonard

articles.title: Quantum dynamics shaping through fully actuated system representations
articles.title_zh: 通过全驱动系统表示实现量子动力学塑形
articles.abstract: Quantum control has achieved remarkable success in state transfer, trajectory tracking, and optimal control, yet a fundamental gap remains between trajectory generation and dynamics shaping. Unlike robotic and mechanical systems, where feedback design can directly prescribe transient behaviors such as convergence rates, damping, and robustness, most quantum control methods focus on identifying control fields that achieve a desired evolution without explicitly shaping the dynamics along that evolution. Here we bridge this gap by extending the fully actuated system (FAS) paradigm from classical control to finite-dimensional bilinear quantum systems. We show that controllability does not imply full actuation in quantum dynamics: the Lie-group structure of quantum evolution generally prevents a controllable quantum system from being represented as a FAS. To overcome this limitation, we introduce virtual quantum measurements and construct a local partial FAS representation in the output space, where the highest-order output derivatives are directly assignable by the control Hamiltonians. This representation enables explicit cancellation of nonlinear input–output dynamics and provides a constructive framework for quantum dynamics shaping. The resulting closed-loop behavior can be prescribed through arbitrary pole placement or fixed-time convergence with preassigned settling-time bounds. We further develop an offline closed-loop emulation procedure that converts the feedback law into implementable open-loop control waveforms. Numerical studies on single-qubit and two-qubit systems demonstrate accurate trajectory tracking, fixed-time convergence, prescribed gate-error decay quantified by average gate fidelity, and tunable trade-offs among convergence speed, robustness, and control effort.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子控制在状态转移、轨迹跟踪和最优控制方面取得了显著成功，但在轨迹生成和动力学塑形之间仍存在基本差距。本文将经典控制中的全驱动系统（FAS）范式扩展到有限维双线性量子系统，以弥合这一差距。研究表明，量子动力学中的可控性并不意味着全驱动。为克服这一限制，作者引入了虚拟量子测量，并在输出空间中构建了局部部分FAS表示，从而实现了非线性输入-输出动力学的显式抵消。
authors: Zihao Ren, Lei Wang, Hongye Su, He Kong, Guodong Shi and Guangren Duan

articles.title: The noise cost of reservoir locality in broadband quantum amplifier chains
articles.title_zh: 宽带量子放大器链中储层局域性的噪声代价
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20654v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Directional quantum amplifiers enable weak-signal readout while protecting the source, but reservoir noise limits sensitivity. Finite-band suppression must reconcile frequency-dependent responses with fixed local couplings and finite rates. We construct adjacent-site loss channels attaining the known single-frequency minimum under local compatibility conditions, as an uncapped benchmark. For specified uniform and dimerized chains, we compare fixed reservoirs at matched drift, ports, high-gain band and complete gain/loss rate caps. At the representative cap R=8 and halfwidth Ømega=0.05, nearest-neighbor arithmetic band average noise exceeds the unrestricted optimum by more than 1.01265 quanta in the uniform chain for every finite Nge64. Boundary-response bounds give necessary rates and targets requiring range two. At N=64, finite-auxiliary calculations retain a noise advantage under matched total coupling budgets; response bounds quantify noise-resolution tolerances. These theoretical results guide reservoir design and noise calibration for a proposed cryogenic microwave array with a 100 kHz design band.
articles.abstract_zh: 定向量子放大器能实现弱信号读出并保护源，但储层噪声限制了其灵敏度。本文构建了在局部兼容条件下达到已知单频最小值的相邻位点损耗通道作为基准。研究发现，在均匀链中，最近邻算术带平均噪声超过了无限制最优值。这些理论结果为低温微波阵列的储层设计和噪声校准提供了指导。
authors: Chengxi Li, Hao Zhu, Tie-Fu Zhang, Lin Zhuang, Wanzi Sun, Wuming Liu

articles.title: Surviving readout errors and incomplete postselection in monitored quantum circuits
articles.title_zh: 监测量子电路中读出误差和不完全后选择的存活
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20712v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study how readout errors affect dynamics in monitored quantum circuits. Such errors make postselection effectively incomplete, conditioning trajectories on imperfect rather than true records. Focusing on U(1)-symmetric circuits, we find that the charge-sharpening transition survives at a finite error rate, with the sharp phase's vanishing fluctuations replaced by a finite steady-state plateau. The charge fluctuations show a shallow minimum near the ideal transition point as a function of measurement rate, signaling the competition between measurement-induced purification and noise-induced mixing. By decomposing the fluctuations into quantum and classical contributions, we show the minimum marks where incomplete postselection still retains enough trajectory memory to attenuate noise-induced mixing, leaving a detectable signature of the transition even in a noisy setting. Mid-circuit measurements are far harder to mitigate against readout errors than standard end-of-circuit ones, because the errors corrupt the postselection itself; the decomposition therefore offers a minimal mitigation framework and a route to locate the transition directly from experimental data. Our results show that charge sharpening survives readout errors in a quantitative and experimentally accessible way.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了读出误差如何影响监测量子电路中的动力学，这些误差使得后选择变得不完全。针对U(1)对称电路，研究发现电荷锐化转变在有限误差率下仍然存在，其尖锐相的消失涨落被有限稳态平台取代。电荷涨落曲线在理想转变点附近呈现浅谷，表明测量诱导纯化与噪声诱导混合之间的竞争。
authors: Murtaza Ali Mir, Teemu Ojanen, Ali G. Moghaddam

articles.title: A constructive solution to the n-representability problem
articles.title_zh: n-可表示性问题的一个构造性解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20737v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a solution to the fermionic quantum marginal problem by constructing the complete family of two-body witnesses at each level of a weighted sum-of-squares hierarchy. Our construction combines positive-semidefinite Gram matrices with explicit linear nullspace constraints that exactly cancel all higher-body contributions, replacing the search for individual representability conditions with a systematic algebraic procedure. Beyond the completeness proof, we demonstrate the construction numerically by solving the associated semidefinite program and recovering the exact ground-state energy of a Richardson Hamiltonian in the three-fermion sector. We further prove that higher-degree particle-number multipliers are unnecessary when the full sum-of-squares generating algebra is used. These results establish a unified constructive framework for verifying the physicality of a candidate two-particle reduced density matrix through a complete characterization of all two-body witnesses.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过构建加权平方和层次结构中每个级别的完整两体见证族，提出了费米子量子边际问题的一个解决方案。该构造结合了正半定Gram矩阵和显式线性零空间约束，精确抵消了所有高阶体贡献。数值演示通过求解半定规划，恢复了三费米子扇区中Richardson哈密顿量的精确基态能量。这些结果为验证候选两粒子约化密度矩阵的物理性提供了一个统一的构造性框架。
authors: Nicholas C. Rubin, A. Eugene DePrince III

articles.title: Standard and Bipolar Rectification in Tilted Periodically-Driven Quantum Systems
articles.title_zh: 倾斜周期驱动量子系统中的标准和双极整流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20765v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Developing mechanisms to control transport in correlated quantum systems is essential for advancing quantum circuit technologies. In this work, we establish a rectification mechanism for both particle and energy flow in a fermionic system coupled to external baths, in the presence of a tilted potential modulated locally by a time-periodic drive. The drive generates particle and energy currents even in the absence of chemical or thermal bias between the baths. These drive-induced currents are enhanced at resonant frequencies at which avoided crossings occur in the Floquet quasienergy spectrum, reflecting the role of the Floquet states as intermediate channels for transport. Once a bias between the baths is introduced, the drive-induced current contribution can reinforce, compete with, or even cancel the bias-induced contribution. These effects enable rectification in the non-interacting regime, which we quantify via the rectification coefficient R. This coefficient measures the asymmetry between transport up the tilt (forward bias) and down the tilt (reverse bias). In addition to standard rectification, where transport is reduced under reverse bias, we identify a regime of bipolar rectification, in which the current flows only up the tilt regardless of the bias polarity. At the boundary between standard and bipolar regimes, the system achieves perfect rectification, corresponding to complete suppression of the reverse-bias current. In the presence of interactions between particles, the parameter region that supports bipolar rectification is enlarged and R can be enhanced by many orders of magnitude. Our results establish a rectification mechanism for particle and energy transport that can be experimentally realized in condensed matter and cold atom systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种在倾斜周期驱动量子系统中控制粒子和能量流动的整流机制。即使在没有化学或热偏置的情况下，驱动也能产生粒子和能量电流，并且这些电流在Floquet准能量谱中出现避免交叉的共振频率处得到增强。当引入偏置时，驱动引起的电流贡献可以增强、竞争甚至抵消偏置引起的贡献，从而在非相互作用区域实现整流。
authors: Joaquín Peñuela-Parra, Juan José Mendoza-Arenas

articles.title: The Lovász number is not alone: a continuum of Rényi points in the entanglement-assisted spectrum of graphs
articles.title_zh: Lovász数并非孤立：图的纠缠辅助谱中Rényi点的连续统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20775v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Li and Zuiddam's entanglement-assisted asymptotic spectrum of graphs consists of the normalized graph parameters that are additive under disjoint unions, multiplicative under strong products and monotone under entanglement-assisted cohomomorphisms; the entanglement-assisted Shannon capacity is their pointwise minimum. To our knowledge, the Lovász number ǎrtheta was its only known element. We find a continuum of others. Three quantities of Duan and Winter, łog₂ǎrtheta, the minimal Holevo capacity Cₘᵢₙ and the logarithm of the no-signalling simulation cost Σ, are the smallest information radii of classical-quantum channels compatible with a graph, measured with Petz-Rényi divergences of orders 0, 1 and 2. At order zero this is due to Schrijver (as credited by Dalai) and to Duan and Winter; at order one it is the min-max formula for the Holevo capacity. Interpolating in the order gives a family ǎrtheta_α, 0łeαłe2, and we prove that every member lies in the spectrum. The main step, multiplicativity under strong products for channels that need not factor, follows from an exact nesting identity for compressions. Sandwiched Rényi radii of order βin[1/2,infty] give the same family, at α=2-1/β. On the five-cycle the family takes every value in [sqrt5,5/2]. A Hilbert-Schmidt inequality for the pentagon gives Cₘᵢₙ(C₅₎₌łog₂₍₅/2), proving a conjecture of Duan and Winter. We also settle the two open links of their inequality chain: the graph-level no-signalling simulation rate always equals its single-letter value łog₂Σ(G), and a 32-vertex graph from the Mermin-Peres magic square has Cₘᵢₙ<łog₂Σ, certified in exact rational arithmetic. Finally, Σ never exceeds the projective rank of the complement; a rank inequality for the same square makes this strict on a 1440-vertex graph.
articles.abstract_zh: Li和Zuiddam提出的图的纠缠辅助渐近谱由在特定操作下具有加性、乘性和单调性的归一化图参数组成，其点态最小值是纠缠辅助香农容量。本文发现，除了已知的Lovász数外，该谱中还存在一个连续统的元素。通过Petz-Rényi散度测量的经典-量子信道的最小信息半径，可以得到Duan和Winter提出的三个量，它们在不同阶数下对应于Lovász数、最小Holevo容量和无信号模拟成本的对数。研究证明，通过插值得到的Rényi参数族中的每个成员都属于该谱。
authors: Nidhal Mghirbi, Seth Douglas

articles.title: Infinite magic and the emergence of the continuum
articles.title_zh: 无限魔力与连续统的涌现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20790v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Which features of a quantum state are needed for a relativistic quantum field theory to emerge from a lattice system? We address this question by establishing a quantitative relationship between the type classification of hyperfinite von Neumann algebras and the quantum-information-theoretic resource of nonstabilizerness, also called magic. Our results establish two complementary parts of this relationship. First, we prove that any stabilizer system on a lattice defines a canonical GNS Hilbert space in which local von Neumann algebras do not contain type III factors in their central decomposition. As an explicit example, we prove that for stabilizer systems with short-range order, the local algebras are isomorphic to tensor products of hyperfinite factors of type I or type II. This demonstrates that the absence of magic is accompanied by the absence of type III factors in the local algebras, therefore prohibiting the appearance of a quantum field theory. Second, for the hyperfinite factors of Araki, Woods and Powers, we prove a quantitative equivalence: The limiting factor is of type III if and only if the locally optimized min-relative entropy of magic diverges. This divergence is necessary to generate the continuous spectrum associated to a type III factor. Thus, in this setting, the emergence of a type III factor requires not merely the presence of magic, but an infinite amount of it. These results provide a rigorous setting supporting the proposal that infinite magic is a necessary structural ingredient for the emergence of a relativistic continuum from lattice systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了量子态的哪些特性是相对论量子场论从格点系统涌现所必需的，通过建立超有限冯诺依曼代数的类型分类与量子信息理论资源“非稳定态性”（即“魔力”）之间的定量关系来解决此问题。研究证明，格点上的稳定器系统定义的局部冯诺依曼代数不包含III型因子，表明“魔力”的缺失伴随着III型因子的缺失，从而阻止了量子场论的出现。此外，对于Araki、Woods和Powers的超有限因子，研究证明了极限因子是III型当且仅当局部优化的最小相对熵满足特定条件。
authors: Leo Shaposhnik, Lorenzo Leone, Lennart Bittel, Dimitris Saraidaris, Alexander Jahn, Jens Eisert

articles.title: Sparse-QITE: Discovering Compact Generators for Quantum Imaginary-Time Evolution via Regularization Methods
articles.title_zh: Sparse-QITE：通过正则化方法发现量子虚时演化的紧凑生成器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20791v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum imaginary-time evolution (QITE) provides a systematic route to ground-state preparation, but its cost grows rapidly with the locality D of the unitary approximation, for which the local Pauli basis scales as 4^D. We introduce Sparse-QITE, a regularized formulation that promotes compact generators, reducing the number of quantum operations and yielding circuits with fewer gates and lower depth. We derive rigorous bounds on the sparsification error and benchmark the method in one-dimensional transverse-field Ising and antiferromagnetic Heisenberg models. Sparse-QITE exhibits a controllable sparsity--accuracy trade-off while retaining strong compression even in the high-accuracy regime. In scalability experiments with respect to D, the active support grows much more slowly than in standard QITE and, in several regimes, approximately saturates over the domain sizes studied. After circuit construction and transpilation, some of the largest-domain cases require only about 1% of the standard-QITE gate count while maintaining high accuracy. We further introduce adaptive and active-discovery variants: the former selects the regularization strength dynamically during the evolution, while the latter reduces the number of Pauli expectation values that need to be evaluated and, consequently, the measurement requirements. These results establish sparsity-promoting regularization as a route toward more resource-efficient QITE. More broadly, these results suggest that sparsity-promoting regularization may also benefit variational quantum algorithms.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子虚时演化（QITE）是制备基态的系统方法，但其成本随酉近似的局域性D迅速增长。本文引入了Sparse-QITE，这是一种正则化公式，旨在促进紧凑生成器，从而减少量子操作数量并产生更少门和更低深度的电路。研究推导了稀疏化误差的严格界限，并在横场Ising和反铁磁海森堡模型中对该方法进行了基准测试。Sparse-QITE在保持高精度的同时展现出可控的稀疏性-精度权衡，并且在可扩展性实验中，其活跃支持的增长速度远低于标准QITE。
authors: Rafael Gómez-Lurbe, Luca Ion, Alberto Acevedo, Andreu Anglés-Castillo

articles.title: Syndrome-Resolved Decoding of Qubit Readout Errors
articles.title_zh: 量子比特读出错误的综合征分辨解码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20810v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Readout errors in superconducting qubits include incorrect state assignment, bit flips within the computational subspace, and leakage to non-computational states. These errors require different mitigation strategies, yet conventional measurement fidelity and repeatability metrics do not resolve their individual contributions. Previous repeated-readout studies have shown that temporal correlations reveal additional information about readout errors. Here we introduce the Readout Error Decoder (RED), which converts repeated thresholded binary records into a channel-resolved error budget. Controlled error injections validate the channel-specific response of the decoder. We demonstrate RED on both fluxonium and transmon qubits and across distinct leakage-lifetime regimes. RED identifies the error channels limiting readout performance without requiring dedicated discrimination of non-computational states, providing a basis for targeted readout optimization across different qubit modalities.
articles.abstract_zh: 超导量子比特的读出错误包括状态分配不正确、计算子空间内的比特翻转以及泄漏到非计算状态，这些错误需要不同的缓解策略。本文引入了读出错误解码器（RED），它将重复的阈值二进制记录转换为信道分辨的错误预算。通过受控错误注入验证了RED对特定信道的响应，并在fluxonium和transmon量子比特上进行了演示。RED能够识别限制读出性能的错误信道，无需专门区分非计算状态，为不同量子比特模态的靶向读出优化提供了基础。
authors: Han Zheng, Vladimir Pešić, Nikolay Gusarov, Andrea Lizzit, Taketo Imaizumi, Chulwoo Ahn, Marco Nicolas Mueller, Raymond Mencia, Edoardo Charbon, Vladimir E. Manucharyan

articles.title: Entanglement of superpositions in zero-energy subspace: insights from stabilizer theory
articles.title_zh: 零能量子空间中叠加态的纠缠：来自稳定器理论的见解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20846v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exact zero-energy eigenstates built from entangled dimers have recently been found in a large class of spin Hamiltonians. While the individual states have a simple structure, their superpositions can have very different entanglement properties. In this work, we study these superpositions for geometrically local spin-1/2 chains with periodic boundary conditions. Using stabilizer theory and polynomial methods, we characterize the subspace they span and find the minimum entanglement entropy between two halves of the chain. For Hamiltonians generated by a single local Pauli interaction with noncommuting translates, this minimum obeys a volume law at fixed interaction range. The structure of the least-entangled superpositions also suggests further exact eigenstate constructions, including zero-energy states separable between the two halves of the chain and states at nonzero energies.
articles.abstract_zh: 近期在大量自旋哈密顿量中发现了由纠缠二聚体构建的精确零能量本征态。本文利用稳定器理论和多项式方法，研究了几何局域自旋-1/2链在周期性边界条件下的这些叠加态。研究表征了它们所跨越的子空间，并找到了链两半之间最小纠缠熵。对于由单个局域泡利相互作用生成的哈密顿量，在固定相互作用范围下，该最小纠缠熵遵循体积定律。
authors: Konstantin Antipin, Richik Sengupta

articles.title: Perfect and peak state transfer on IBM quantum hardware
articles.title_zh: 在IBM量子硬件上实现完美和峰值态转移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20855v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We run continuous-time quantum walks with perfect and peak state transfer on a present-day superconducting quantum processor, IBM Quantum's 156-qubit Heron device ibmₖᵢₙgston, deliberately without error correction or error mitigation. Perfect state transfer and its relaxations have been studied extensively in algebraic graph theory, where one can prove exactly which graphs move a quantum state from one vertex to another with probability one (or with the largest probability the graph allows, in the case of peak state transfer), and at what time. Our experiments cover perfect state transfer on the hypercubes Q₂ = C₄ and Q₃, and on the Hamming-weighted paths HPₙ, the equitable-partition quotients of the hypercubes Qₙ, for n up to 20; peak state transfer on the Xₙ family for n up to 11; and, for comparison, moving the state along a path of qubits by a sequence of SWAP gates.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在IBM Quantum的156量子比特Heron设备ibmₖᵢₙgston上，在不进行纠错或错误缓解的情况下，运行了具有完美和峰值态转移的连续时间量子行走。实验涵盖了超立方体Q₂=C₄和Q₃上的完美态转移，以及Hamming加权路径HPₙ上的完美态转移。此外，还研究了Xₙ家族上的峰值态转移，并与通过一系列SWAP门沿量子比特路径移动状态进行了比较。
authors: Priscilla Awuah, Krystal Guo

articles.title: A tutorial on quantum scattering theory and coupled-channel calculations of bimolecular collisions
articles.title_zh: 量子散射理论和双分子碰撞耦合通道计算的教程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20882v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Collisions between atoms and molecules govern how energy is exchanged and redistributed in the gas phase, underpinning phenomena from spectral line broadening and interstellar molecular excitation to the cooling and trapping of molecules. A quantitative account of these collisions requires connecting the theoretical description of the interaction between the collision partners to measurable quantities such as cross sections. However, scattering theory as presented in quantum mechanics textbooks does not readily translate into numerical methods. Here, we formulate the scattering problem in Dirac notation, as customary in present-day quantum mechanics courses, and show how to build a practical numerical framework from it. We derive the "coupled channel" representation of the scattering problem with correct asymptotic behaviour and introduce Numerov's method to obtain time-independent wavefunctions, from which we calculate cross sections, the observables measured in scattering experiments. Starting from single channel scattering, we build up to the realistic collision of a ground-state atom with a diatomic molecule.
articles.abstract_zh: 原子和分子之间的碰撞控制着气相中能量的交换和再分配，是光谱线展宽、星际分子激发以及分子冷却和捕获等现象的基础。本文以狄拉克符号形式阐述了散射问题，并展示了如何构建实用的数值框架。研究推导了具有正确渐近行为的散射问题的“耦合通道”表示，并引入了Numerov方法来获得时间无关的波函数，从而计算散射实验中测量的截面。
authors: Karl P. Horn, Christiane P. Koch

articles.title: monoprop: Scaling Pauli and Majorana propagation via Anticommutation Indices
articles.title_zh: monoprop：通过反交换索引实现Pauli和Majorana传播的扩展
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21000v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce monoprop, an open-source, massively parallel operator-propagation framework for fermion and qubit bases. For N qubits or modes, existing codes represent each of the K tracked operator terms (Pauli strings or products of Majorana operators) as a 2N-bit string, testing each for anticommutation with the gate at O(KN) cost per gate. Here, we introduce the anticommutation index which rapidly looks up the terms anticommuting with a gate. A local gate changes only the terms that touch its sites, and when terms are truncated to act on few sites, only a fraction sim1/N touch any given qubit or mode, and we use this to prove the time per gate scales as O(K/N). This counterintuitive result tells us that for a fixed number of terms, increasing the number of sites can make things faster. We demonstrate this numerically, and show monoprop scales almost ideally to 8192 cores, tracking 9.5×10¹⁰ terms. Beyond propagation, we present memory-efficient surrogate graphs, which record one propagation and replay it at new angles, for fast energy re-estimation and parameter gradients, and an efficient method for finding energy-minimising gates and optimal angles for simulating adaptive quantum-chemistry circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了monoprop，一个用于费米子和量子比特基的大规模并行算符传播开源框架。针对现有代码在N个量子比特或模式下以O(KN)成本测试每个算符项与门的反对易性问题，monoprop引入了反交换索引，可以快速查找与门反对易的项。研究证明，对于固定数量的项，增加站点数量可以加快处理速度，时间复杂度可达O(K/N)。数值结果表明monoprop在8192个核心上几乎理想地扩展，跟踪了9.5×10¹⁰个项。
authors: Aaron Miller

articles.title: Reducing QUBO Complexity in Drone Delivery Through Classical Feasibility Preprocessing
articles.title_zh: 通过经典可行性预处理降低无人机配送中QUBO的复杂性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21003v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Drone-delivery planning combines routing decisions with operational constraints such as payload capacity and limited onboard energy, resulting in combinatorial optimization problems that can become costly to encode directly in binary form. This work investigates a hybrid quantum--classical approach in which candidate drone missions are generated and evaluated classically before constructing a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) model for mission selection. Payload- and energy-infeasible missions are removed during preprocessing, while the reduced QUBO is solved using exact enumeration, simulated annealing (SA), and the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA), with mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) used as a classical reference. Experiments on controlled synthetic delivery instances evaluate solution quality, the effect of preprocessing, and computational scaling. Exact QUBO optimization reproduces the MILP optimum on the evaluated small instances, while SA achieves 100% feasibility with a median optimality gap of 0%. Combined payload-and-energy preprocessing reduces the mean number of QUBO variables by 29.60% and quadratic interactions by 49.20%, while reducing mean SA runtime by 31.26%. In contrast, the evaluated shallow statevector-based QAOA configuration achieves lower feasibility and is restricted to small QUBO instances. These results indicate that, in the considered setting, the main practical benefit of the hybrid architecture comes from classical feasibility preprocessing that reduces the binary search space before QUBO-based optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 无人机配送规划结合了路径决策和有效载荷容量、有限机载能量等操作约束，导致组合优化问题直接编码为二进制形式成本高昂。本文研究了一种混合量子-经典方法，其中候选无人机任务在构建用于任务选择的二次无约束二进制优化（QUBO）模型之前，通过经典方法生成和评估。预处理过程中移除了有效载荷和能量不可行的任务，然后使用精确枚举、模拟退火（SA）和量子近似优化算法（QAOA）求解简化后的QUBO。
authors: Silvie Illésová, Vojtěch Novák, Martin Beseda

articles.title: Singular wave functions and quantum collapse in inverse-power potentials
articles.title_zh: 逆幂势中的奇异波函数与量子坍缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21044v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum collapse (QC) occurs under the action of the inverse-power potential U(r)=-U₀/(2rⁿ) in the framework of the Schroedinger equation. The corresponding stationary wave functions feature an infinite number of spatial oscillations at ri̊ghtarrow 0. The ground state (GS) is missing in the presence of the QC, but the available bound states at finite energies may be physically relevant, as they are normalizable. This work aims to produce singular stationary wave functions. The analytical findings represent an asymptotic form of the stationary wave functions at ri̊ghtarrow 0, which fill a continuous spectrum, and some exact solutions for the wave functions, obtained under appropriate conditions. As a regularized version, we also consider the potential truncated at a finite difference from the center. The regularized wave functions feature a finite number of spatial oscillations, the missing GS reappears, and the spectrum of the bound states is discrete.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子坍缩（QC）在薛定谔方程框架下，逆幂势U(r)=-U₀/(2rⁿ)的作用下发生。相应的定态波函数在r趋近于0时呈现无限次空间振荡。本文旨在产生奇异定态波函数，分析结果给出了r趋近于0时定态波函数的渐近形式，它们填充了连续谱，并在适当条件下获得了一些波函数的精确解。作为正则化版本，研究还考虑了在距中心有限距离处截断的势，此时正则化波函数具有有限次空间振荡，缺失的基态重新出现，并且束缚态谱是离散的。
authors: Hidetsugu Sakaguchi, Boris Malomed

articles.title: Agent-assisted experimental strategy transfer across quantum processors
articles.title_zh: 代理辅助的量子处理器间实验策略转移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21047v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Progress in quantum hardware requires a growing volume of experiments across diverse devices, straining the capacity of human experts. Automation remains challenging because device differences and drift can render workflows developed on one processor unsuitable for another. Here we present an agent-assisted experimental strategy for conducting experiments across three-qubit nuclear magnetic resonance processors. Developed on one processor and applied sequentially to four others, the strategy uses an agent to assess experimental evidence, select subsequent measurements and adapt procedures, with operators providing instrument preparation and physical intervention. Using three-qubit Grover state preparation as a common task, each deployment combined device-specific calibration, control-pulse optimization and measurement. The experimental strategy was refined through sequential deployment, and all four processors ultimately produced outputs dominated by their respective marked states. The marked-state populations of the reconstructed dominant eigenstates ranged from (0.910) to (0.959), with relative deviations below (3.8%) from the ideal value of 0.945. These results demonstrate that an agent-assisted experimental strategy can be reused and refined across processors to realize a common quantum task, providing a basis for scaling experimental practice beyond individual devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子硬件的进步要求在不同设备上进行越来越多的实验，这给人类专家带来了压力。本文提出了一种代理辅助的实验策略，用于在三量子比特核磁共振处理器之间进行实验。该策略在一个处理器上开发，并依次应用于其他四个处理器，利用代理评估实验证据、选择后续测量并调整程序。通过顺序部署，实验策略得到了完善，所有四个处理器最终都产生了以其各自标记态为主的输出。
authors: Shi-Yao Hou, Zipeng Wu, Chao Zhang, Guanru Feng, Keren Li, Jingen Xiang

articles.title: Multiplicative Semidefinite Programming Upper Bounds on Quantum No-Signalling-Assisted Zero-Error Capacity
articles.title_zh: 量子无信号辅助零误差容量的乘性半正定规划上界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21071v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study zero-error communication and exact simulation of quantum channels assisted by quantum no-signalling correlations. For a channel with Kraus operator space K, we introduce a semidefinite programming parameter Γ(K) that is exactly multiplicative under tensor products and upper-bounds Θₘ̊ NS(K), where łog₂Θₘ̊ NS(K)=C₀,ₘ̊ NS(K) and C₀,ₘ̊ NS(K) denotes the asymptotic quantum no-signalling-assisted zero-error capacity. Among known upper bounds on Θₘ̊ NS given by semidefinite programs, Γ is the tightest. We also prove that the previously introduced simulation lower bound Σ⁻(K) is exactly multiplicative and satisfies Θₘ̊ NS(K)łeqΓ(K)łeqΣ⁻(K)łeqΓ(K)². Using this multiplicativity, we show that neither S₀,ₘ̊ NS(K)=łog₂Σ⁻(K) nor its regularized extension S₀,ₘ̊ NS(K)=łimnolimitsₙ→ᵢₙfₜyn⁻¹łog₂Σ⁻(Køtⁱmes ⁿ) holds in general. This answers an open question about the asymptotic simulation cost S₀,ₘ̊ NS(K). For classical-quantum channels, we obtain sharp bounds. If r is the effective output dimension, then Θₘ̊ NSłeqΓłeq(1+r¹/²)Θₘ̊ NS/2 and ΓłeqΣ⁻łeq(1+r¹/²)Γ/2. If k is the minimum rank of the output support projections, then Σ⁻/Θₘ̊ NSłeq[(1+r¹/²)/(1+k¹/²)]², and this bound is sharp for every 1łeq kłeq r. Thus, we obtain the sharp bound S₀,ₘ̊ NS-C₀,ₘ̊ NSłeq2łog₂[(1+r¹/²)/(1+k¹/²)].
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了量子无信号关联辅助下的量子信道零误差通信和精确模拟。对于具有Kraus算符空间K的信道，研究引入了一个半正定规划参数Γ(K)，该参数在张量积下具有精确乘性，并作为渐近量子无信号辅助零误差容量C₀,ₘ̊ NS(K)的对数上界。该参数Γ是已知半正定规划上界中最紧的。研究还证明了先前引入的模拟下界Σ⁻(K)也具有精确乘性，并满足Θₘ̊ NS(K) ≤ Γ(K) ≤ Σ⁻(K) ≤ Γ(K)²。
authors: Xin Li, Yinan Li

articles.title: Stitched surface codes: planar concatenation through GHZ corridors
articles.title_zh: 缝合表面码：通过GHZ走廊的平面级联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21357v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a fault-tolerant quantum-memory architecture that concatenates four distance-t rotated surface-code patches with the [[4,2,2]] outer code, encoding two logical qubits at code distance d = 2t in a physical footprint of N < 2(2t+1)² qubits on a square lattice with nearest-neighbor connectivity. The outer-code stabilizer generators XXXX and ZZZZ, each of physical weight 4t, are measured in situ via verified Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) ancillae distributed through narrow corridors between adjacent patches, without lattice surgery or long-range gates. The outer-code gadgets introduce hyperedge fault mechanisms, but by design each decomposes into graphlike components, so the complete syndrome is decoded by a single minimum-weight-perfect-matching pass. Circuit-level simulations show logical error rates that scale as p^t, consistent with distance-2t protection. Finally, we implement the construction experimentally on a 105-qubit Willow superconducting processor in both the ZZ and XX memory bases. With the correlated-matching decoder, increasing the code distance from d = 4 to d = 6 reduces the block logical error rate by a factor of 1.52. The construction thus provides a near-term testbed for concatenated architectures beyond the standard surface code.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种容错量子存储架构，通过[[4,2,2]]外码将四个距离为t的旋转表面码块级联起来，在具有最近邻连接的方形格子上编码两个逻辑量子比特。外码稳定器生成器通过GHZ辅助比特在相邻块之间的狭窄走廊中原位测量，无需晶格手术或长程门。电路级模拟显示逻辑错误率与p^t成比例，与2t距离保护一致，并在105量子比特的超导处理器上进行了实验实现。
authors: Mohamed A. Shalby, Alexandre Bourassa, Amir Karamlou, Leigh Martin, Alexis Morvan, Nicholas Noll, Craig Gidney, Leonid P. Pryadko

articles.title: Parallel Repetition for Entangled Games via Conditional Relative Entropy
articles.title_zh: 基于条件相对熵的纠缠博弈并行重复
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21410v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We give a proof of the cubic parallel-repetition bound for finite two-player entangled games using quantum conditional relative entropy. For a game with entangled value 1-ǎrepsilon<1 and answer alphabets mathcal A,mathcal B, its n-fold repeated value is at most [ exp[-Ømega(ǎrepsilon³ⁿ/L)],qquad L:=max1,łog(|mathcal A||mathcal B|), ] for every nge1. This recovers Song's cubic rate. We also prove a threshold bound: the probability of winning a fraction at least 1-ǎrepsilon+δ is at most exp[-Ømega(δ⁵ⁿ/(ǎrepsilon²L))] for 0<δłeǎrepsilon. Our information charge is the decrease in relative entropy when a question reference is discarded. Our comparison states preserve the original conditional question law. A chain rule bounds the coordinate charges using the cost of conditioning on checked wins and retaining checked answers. Our main lemma converts small charges into nearby pure-state descriptions and local corrections, each depending only on one player's question. Together with Song's sampler, these enable approximate local preparation of the conditioned workspace.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用量子条件相对熵，证明了有限双玩家纠缠博弈的立方并行重复界限，恢复了Song的立方速率。对于纠缠值为1-ε<1的博弈，其n次重复值至多为exp[-Ω(ε³ⁿ/L)]。作者还证明了一个阈值界限，并引入了信息荷的概念，即丢弃问题参考时相对熵的减少，从而实现条件工作空间的近似局部准备。
authors: Rahul Jain

articles.title: Crossovers between Time-Bin and Energy-Time Entanglement in Homodyned Resonance Fluorescence
articles.title_zh: 零拍共振荧光中时间间隔和能量-时间纠缠的交叉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21428v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically investigate photonic entanglement generated by homodyning resonance fluorescence from a two-level emitter with a phase-locked laser field. Under weak excitation, increasing the relative laser-field amplitude produces crossovers from time-bin to energy--time and back to time-bin entanglement. The intermediate energy--time regime occurs near amplitude matching, where destructive interference suppresses the single-photon component, allowing the two-photon contributions to dominate the coincidence signal. We evaluate the resulting photon statistics and first-order coherence and characterize the entanglement through violations of the CHSH Bell inequality in a Franson interferometer. This scheme provides a route to controlling photonic entanglement through linear optics and coherent interference.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论研究了通过对两能级发射器的共振荧光进行零拍检测所产生的光子纠缠。在弱激发下，增加相对激光场振幅会导致时间间隔纠缠、能量-时间纠缠以及再次时间间隔纠缠之间的交叉。中间的能量-时间区域发生在振幅匹配附近，此时单光子分量被抑制，双光子贡献占据主导。该方案通过线性光学和相干干涉，为控制光子纠缠提供了一条途径。
authors: Zi-Qi Zeng, Jian Wang, Bang Wu, Zhiliang Yuan

articles.title: Accurate gap control of 3D-integrated superconducting quantum circuits using asymmetric indium architecture and multi-angle flip-chip bonding
articles.title_zh: 使用非对称铟结构和多角度倒装芯片键合实现3D集成超导量子电路的精确间隙控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21435v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Flip-chip 3D integration is a key enabling technology for overcoming the routing and layout constraints of planar superconducting quantum processors, but it requires accurate and uniform control of the inter-chip spacing while preserving qubit coherence. In conventional processes, thick indium bumps are deposited symmetrically on both chips, while dedicated spacers are introduced to limit the residual tilt. Here, we present a flip-chip bonding process based on an asymmetric indium architecture, combining 20,μm thick indium bumps on the control chip with 200,nm thin indium pads on the qubit chip. Using electrical and microwave measurements, we demonstrate low resistance and low loss indium interconnects, and show that transmon qubits integrated with this process reach relaxation and coherence times of T₁₌₍₁₅₉±14),μs and T₂,ₑcₕₒ=(294±42),μs, respectively, comparable to planar devices. Combined with a multi angle compression procedure that suppresses systematic tilt, this approach reduces the average post bonding tilt to (20±12),μrad. These results establish an asymmetric indium architecture combined with multi angle compression as a robust, coherence preserving route toward 3D integrated superconducting quantum processors.
articles.abstract_zh: 倒装芯片3D集成是克服平面超导量子处理器布线和布局限制的关键技术，但需要精确控制芯片间距并保持量子比特相干性。本文提出了一种基于非对称铟结构的倒装芯片键合工艺，实现了低电阻、低损耗的铟互连。该工艺使集成的transmon量子比特达到与平面器件相当的弛豫和相干时间。结合多角度压缩程序，该方法将键合后的平均倾斜度降低至(20±12)μrad，为鲁棒的3D集成提供了新途径。
authors: L. Richard, N. Bruckmoser, J. Feigl, D. Bunch, A. Bhattacharjee, L. Koch, I. Tsitsilin, V. P. Bader, H. Hu, L. Södergren, S. Filipp

articles.title: Limits of adaptive linear postprocessing in six-state quantum key distribution
articles.title_zh: 六态量子密钥分发中自适应线性后处理的局限性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21469v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-way classical communication improves the noise tolerance of quantum key distribution, but the limits of adaptive parity processing remain unclear. For the six-state protocol with equal three-basis error rate pin[p_*,1/2], where p_*=(5-sqrt5)/10simeq27.64%, we construct a single compatible collective attack that defeats a broad class of linear postprocessing. Each public message may be an affine function of the sender's raw key, chosen adaptively from the public history. For every finite input length and every accepted transcript of positive probability, Eve's optimal probability of recovering any affine function of Alice's raw key is at least Bob's. Consequently, reliable agreement on a linear final key is incompatible with secrecy. The same conclusion holds for arbitrary publicly seeded privacy amplification after reliable recovery of a linear candidate. The proof conditions on the complete transcript, which restricts the two raw keys to affine subspaces. A local degradation of Eve's state, a known Rényi-entropy comparison, and a coset-probability inequality then give the recovery comparison. Both inequalities are proved in self-contained appendices. The result allows block splitting, regrouping, nonzero-syndrome selection, and adaptive linear reconciliation.
articles.abstract_zh: 双向经典通信可以提高量子密钥分发的噪声容忍度，但自适应奇偶校验处理的局限性尚不明确。本文针对六态协议，构建了一种单一兼容的集体攻击，能够击败广泛的线性后处理。研究表明，对于任何有限输入长度和接受的记录，Eve恢复Alice原始密钥的任何仿射函数的最佳概率至少与Bob相同。因此，在线性最终密钥上达成可靠一致与保密性不兼容，这一结论也适用于任意公开播种的隐私放大。
authors: Toyohiro Tsurumaru

articles.title: Reducing the Cost of Qudit State Preparation by Learning a Sparse Structure for SNAP Gates
articles.title_zh: 通过学习SNAP门的稀疏结构来降低Qudit态制备成本
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21557v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Preparing quantum states in bosonic qudits with SNAP--Displacement sequences requires both optimizing the gate parameters and deciding which Fock levels should be controlled by each SNAP gate. A fully parameterized ansatz assigns an independent phase to every Fock level in every gate, leading to a number of phases that grows steeply. This constitutes a problem for short to medium term systems as controlling many phases requires complex control pulses which are subject to increased control errors. Previous work reduced this cost by restricting the trainable phases to predefined sparse patterns, such as a diagonal or a grid, which however may not be optimal for a specific target state. In this work, we address this limitation by introducing a method that learns which phases are needed together with their values, using a differentiable mask. A sparsity penalty encourages the removal of unnecessary phases, while temperature annealing gradually turns the masks into binary decisions. We compare the proposed method with fully parameterized and predefined sparse ansatzes on Fourier and Haar-random target states. The evaluation considers both the minimum number of phases required to reach different infidelity thresholds and the overall trade-off between fidelity and phases required, measured through Pareto frontiers and hypervolume. The results show that learning the location of the phases together with their values provides competitive or improved fidelity--resource trade-offs, although the advantage depends on the target state and qudit dimension.
articles.abstract_zh: 使用SNAP-位移序列制备玻色子qudit量子态需要优化门参数并确定每个SNAP门应控制的Fock能级。传统的全参数化方法导致相位数量急剧增加，增加了控制复杂性和误差。本文提出了一种通过可微分掩码学习所需相位及其值的方法，利用稀疏性惩罚和温度退火来移除不必要的相位。该方法在傅里叶和Haar随机目标态上与现有方法进行了比较，旨在降低qudit态制备的成本和复杂性。
authors: Marco Pennazio, Leonardo Ignazio Pagliochini, Riccardo Pellini, Maurizio Ferrari Dacrema, Paolo Cremonesi

articles.title: Time-optimal robust quantum control for partially known errors
articles.title_zh: 部分已知误差的时间最优鲁棒量子控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21596v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Robust quantum control usually assumes one of two extremes: the error is of a known form and only its strength is unknown, or nothing at all is known about it. In practice one often sits in between. The size of a static error is unknown, but its class is known, for example, it only shifts energy levels, or it acts on each subsystem separately. We ask how fast a control can cancel, to first order, every error in such a class. A time-independent Hamiltonian can do this if and only if all errors in the class have zero diagonal in a common basis. In that case an equally spaced energy ladder in this basis does it after one period. A lower bound that holds for any time-dependent control with bounded drive power shows that this simple constant control is optimal for several natural classes, including unknown level shifts and unknown local errors on two subsystems. Completely unknown errors need a time-dependent control, and there, knowing the error class shortens the minimum time by a factor sqrtd²⁺¹. So partial knowledge of the error changes not only how long an optimal robust control takes, but also its form.
articles.abstract_zh: 鲁棒量子控制通常假设误差形式已知或完全未知，但实际情况常介于两者之间。本文研究了在已知误差类别但强度未知的情况下，控制能以多快速度抵消误差。研究发现，如果所有误差在共同基下对角线为零，则时间无关哈密顿量可在周期后完成此任务，且对于某些误差类别（如未知能级偏移）是时间最优的。部分误差知识不仅缩短了最优鲁棒控制所需的时间，也改变了其形式。
authors: Llorenç Balada Gaggioli

articles.title: Practical Fidelity Estimation for Noisy Quantum Devices Using Direct and Survival-Probability-Based Protocols
articles.title_zh: 使用直接和基于生存概率的协议对噪声量子设备进行实用保真度估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21606v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reliable characterization of quantum states and quantum processes is central to the development of scalable quantum computing. Standard characterization techniques such as full quantum state tomography become rapidly impractical as system size increases. In this work we present two software-oriented fidelity estimation protocols that avoid full tomographic reconstruction while remaining experimentally relevant for noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices. The first protocol is direct fidelity estimation (DFE), where the fidelity between a target state and an experimentally prepared state is estimated from importance-sampled Pauli measurements. The second protocol is a survival-probability-based method that reconstructs fidelity from experimentally accessible moments of a noisy evolution and its approximate inverse, and is intrinsically robust against state-preparation-and-measurement (SPAM) errors. We discuss the theoretical basis of both approaches, analyze their noise sensitivity, and present numerical evidence on representative multiqubit states under depolarizing, dephasing, and amplitude-damping channels.
