For DFE we show that attenuation-aware correction improves robustness against measurement noise. For the survival-probability approach we show that an L₂₋ₒₚₜᵢₘᵢzed expansion substantially outperforms naive Taylor truncation in high-noise regimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 随着系统规模的增加，量子态和量子过程的可靠表征变得不切实际。本文提出了两种软件导向的保真度估计协议，旨在避免完全层析重建，适用于噪声中等规模量子设备。第一个是直接保真度估计（DFE），通过重要性采样Pauli测量来估计保真度。第二个是基于生存概率的方法，从噪声演化及其近似逆的实验可访问矩中重建保真度，并对SPAM误差具有内在鲁棒性。
authors: Ahmed Aman, Kaustav Chatterjee, Younes Javanmard, Tanmoy Pandit

articles.title: Driving the cooling process of a quantum system via classical noise
articles.title_zh: 通过经典噪声驱动量子系统的冷却过程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21608v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: It is known that under particular hypotheses anomalous thermalization processes can occur, such as the Mpemba effect, consisting in a faster cooling down when the system is prepared in a hotter initial condition, thus making convenient to warm up the system before the freezing process in order to make it freeze in a shorter time. It is shown here that the action of a Markovian classical noise during the freezing process can accelerate the approach to the zero-temperature thermal state. This prediction is counterintuitive, especially after observing that a classical noise can be considered equivalent to the action of an infinite-temperature reservoir, since both drive the system toward the same state. These facts lead to the statement that warming up the system during the contact with a low-temperature reservoir can accelerate the cooling process.
articles.abstract_zh: 已知在特定假设下会发生异常热化过程，例如Mpemba效应。本文研究表明，在冷却过程中引入马尔可夫经典噪声可以加速系统向零温热态的趋近。这一发现是反直觉的，因为经典噪声通常被认为等同于无限温度热库的作用。研究结果表明，在与低温热库接触期间对系统进行加热，反而可以加速冷却过程。
authors: B. Militello, A. Napoli

articles.title: Quantum instanton approach to metastable collective spin systems: Numerical implementation and applications
articles.title_zh: 亚稳态集体自旋系统的量子瞬子方法：数值实现与应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21684v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Driven-dissipative collective spin systems can host several long-lived metastable states; rare switching between them governs slow relaxation and first-order dissipative phase transitions associated with changes in the dominant stationary state. In the companion Letter [arXiv:2604.15091], we introduced a quantum instanton framework based on exact quasiprobability dynamics to describe this switching and illustrated it with a minimal model possessing a simplifying symmetry. Here we develop its numerical implementation, combining collocation and shooting methods, and apply it to two microscopically motivated systems: the Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick model with purely collective dissipation and the cooperative resonance fluorescence with collective and local dissipation. By determining the leading exponential scaling of switching rates between metastable attractors, we predict the stationary magnetization, the first-order dissipative phase-transition point, and the exponential scaling of slow relaxation rates. These predictions agree with quantum master-equation calculations and an exact analytical result for the second model without dephasing. We also examine how the choice of quasiprobability representation affects numerical convergence and find that the alternative semiclassical Wigner approach, based on Gaussian truncation, has varying accuracy across models and parameter regimes. These results substantiate the framework's applicability to experimentally relevant collective spin systems with both collective and local dissipation.
articles.abstract_zh: 驱动耗散集体自旋系统可存在多个长寿命亚稳态，它们之间的罕见切换控制着慢弛豫和一阶耗散相变。本文基于精确准概率动力学，发展了量子瞬子框架的数值实现，并将其应用于Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick模型和合作共振荧光系统。通过确定亚稳态吸引子之间切换速率的主导指数标度，该方法成功预测了稳态磁化强度、一阶耗散相变点和慢弛豫速率的指数标度，并与量子主方程计算结果一致。
authors: Maciej Chudak, Massimiliano Esposito, Krzysztof Ptaszynski

articles.title: Operator-Space Entanglement Entropy in Random Fermionic Gaussian Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 随机费米子高斯动力学中的算符空间纠缠熵
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21723v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the von Neumann operator-space entanglement entropy (OSEE) of initial product operators evolved under random gaussian dynamics, as modeled by a Brownian SYK₂ model. By exploiting a mapping to a domain-wall melting problem, we derive an exact expression for the time-dependent bipartite OSEE in the thermodynamic limit, and obtain an analytic characterization of the corresponding gaussian Page curve emerging at late times. Our results build on recent work on the entanglement dynamics in the all-to-all quantum simple exclusion process, leveraging tools from RMT, including the Coulomb-gas approach and a mapping to the free Jacobi process. Finally, based on our results, we discuss the possibility of relating the OSEE with non-gaussianity measures in the Heisenberg picture.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在布朗SYK₂模型模拟的随机高斯动力学下演化的初始乘积算符的冯诺依曼算符空间纠缠熵（OSEE）。通过映射到畴壁熔化问题，推导出了热力学极限下时间相关的二分OSEE的精确表达式，并解析表征了晚期出现的相应高斯Page曲线。研究结果利用了随机矩阵理论工具，并讨论了将OSEE与海森堡图像中的非高斯性度量联系起来的可能性。
authors: Pablo Bayona-Pena, Elena Gramellini, Lorenzo Piroli

articles.title: Local finite rate semi device independent randomness expansion from quantum contextuality
articles.title_zh: 基于量子语境性的局部有限速率半设备无关随机性扩展
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21765v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Finite rate randomness expansion (RE) which is secure against quantum adversaries is a crucial information processing task which is well studied in the case of two non-communicating parties sharing Bell non-local correlations in a device independent manner. In this paper we show that contextual correlations with only a single localized party are sufficient for RE in a semi-device independent (SDI) manner. We propose a template SDI-RE protocol which is applicable for arbitrary N-cycle non-contextuality (NC) inequalities and derive its RE rate under finite statistics. As a special case, we also highlight the advantages of the situation when RE is constrained by Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt (CHSH) inequality but with characterized measurements implemented by only a single party. Our template protocol also incorporates non-ideal statistics which may not satisfy perfect commutativity and perfect repeatability, both of which are necessary in a loophole-free test of NC inequalities. As such, several recent experimental implementations of significantly loophole-free tests of NC inequalities can be modified for secure RE following our approach.
articles.abstract_zh: 有限速率随机性扩展（RE）是信息处理中的一项关键任务。本文证明了仅有一个局部方参与的语境关联足以实现半设备无关（SDI）的RE。作者提出了一个适用于任意N循环非语境性（NC）不等式的模板SDI-RE协议，并推导了其在有限统计下的RE速率。该协议还考虑了非理想统计数据，可用于修改近期无漏洞NC不等式测试的实验实现，以实现安全的RE。
authors: Dhananjoy Ghosh, Nandana J, Jaskaran Singh

articles.title: Same Spectrum, Harder First-Order Training: Phase-Locking in Single- versus Multi-Qubit Re-Uploading Circuits
articles.title_zh: 相同谱，更难的一阶训练：单量子比特与多量子比特重上传电路中的锁相现象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21778v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Angle-encoded variational quantum circuits implement truncated Fourier series. For one-dimensional inputs, a single-qubit re-uploading (serial) circuit represents every function that a multi-qubit circuit with the same encoding budget E can; we find that this exchange of width for depth is not free in first-order training. Because its state lives on the Bloch sphere, all parameters of the serial circuit move the state, at each input, along one complex direction, which we call emphphase-locking. We prove that this costs no Fourier direction but leaves no direction to spare: however many parameters it has, the serial circuit has at most 2E+2 tangent directions, one more than its 2E+1 Fourier coefficients need, while a two-qubit control with the same encoding budget and model class generically has at least 6E+6. The cost in training is measured against this control, as the number of runs out of 100 that reach the optimum within a fixed step budget. On an exact loss with flat-spectrum targets the gap grows with E; at E=32 the serial circuit converges in 3, 53 and 83 runs under gradient descent, Adam and Levenberg--Marquardt, the control in 99, 100 and 100. On three real-world series, at matched parameter counts, the serial circuit reaches the least-squares optimum in at most 9 runs under Adam and in 32 to 93 under Levenberg--Marquardt, the control in at least 98 and in all 100; its held-out error is up to about 1.5 times that of the control under Adam, but no larger in the typical run under Levenberg--Marquardt.
articles.abstract_zh: 角度编码的变分量子电路实现了截断傅里叶级数。研究发现，在单量子比特重上传（串行）电路中，这种深度换宽度的代价在第一阶训练中并不小，因为其参数在布洛赫球上移动状态时会产生“锁相”现象。这导致串行电路的切线方向数量远少于多量子比特电路。数值实验表明，在多种优化器下，串行电路的收敛性能显著低于对照组，且差距随编码预算E的增加而增大。
authors: Michael Poppel, David Bucher, Maximilian Zorn, Markus Baumann, Sebastian Wölckert, Claudia Linnhoff-Popien, Philipp Altmann, Jonas Stein

articles.title: Quantum-compatible Riemannian conjugate gradient for ground-state preparation
articles.title_zh: 用于基态制备的量子兼容黎曼共轭梯度法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21782v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Riemannian optimization provides a natural geometric framework for designing quantum algorithms for ground-state preparation, most notably through quantum imaginary-time evolution. However, existing geometry-aware approaches primarily employ steepest-descent updates, leaving more advanced methods from classical Riemannian optimization largely unexplored. In this work, we introduce quantum conjugate gradient descent (QCGD), a quantum-compatible implementation of Riemannian conjugate gradient that combines the steepest descent direction with information retained from previous search directions. In our numerical experiments, the proposed approach achieves faster convergence per iteration than the baseline double-bracket quantum imaginary-time evolution (DB-QITE) algorithm, and we quantify the associated circuit cost with gate counts produced by Qrisp. This improvement, however, comes at the cost of increased circuit depth for each update step, revealing a trade-off between convergence rate and implementation complexity. Nevertheless, since the circuit depth for those algorithms grows exponentially with the number of iterations, the proposed method may offer practical advantages, particularly in the early fault-tolerant regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 黎曼优化为设计量子基态制备算法提供了自然的几何框架。本文提出了一种量子兼容的黎曼共轭梯度下降（QCGD）算法，该算法结合了最速下降方向和先前搜索方向的信息。数值实验表明，QCGD在每次迭代中比基线双括号量子虚时演化（DB-QITE）算法收敛更快。然而，这种改进是以每次更新步骤增加电路深度为代价的，揭示了收敛速度和实现复杂性之间的权衡。
authors: Andres Arcia-Lopez, Marek Gluza, Yudai Suzuki, Cyrus Mostajeran

articles.title: Controlled-Memory Identification with Shared Generators: Dimension--Horizon Tradeoffs and Quantum--Classical Separation
articles.title_zh: 共享生成器下的受控记忆识别：维度-时间范围权衡与量子-经典分离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21797v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We determine the finite-horizon identification limits of a (d)-dimensional memory when the control interface is restricted to four shared, time-homogeneous generators. A writer encodes a message by applying a prefix word to a common root state. The verifier then applies a candidate-dependent query word followed by a shared terminal binary test, with each word of length at most (T). For fixed error tolerances (łambda₂>0) and (łambda₁₊łambda₂<1), the optimal identification sizes satisfy (łn Nₘₐₜₕₛf Q,₄=Θłₐₘbdₐ_₁,łₐₘbdₐ_₂(mind²,T)) for arbitrary CPTP generators and (łn Nₘₐₜₕₛf S,₄=Θłₐₘbdₐ_₁,łₐₘbdₐ_₂(mind,T)) for stochastic maps. Four unitary letters and four permutation letters attain these respective bounds, showing that a four-letter reversible alphabet reaches the static code-size orders in optimal quadratic and linear word length. In the fully dimension-limited regime, this yields (łn Nₘₐₜₕₛf Q,₄=Θ(d²⁾) versus (łn Nₘₐₜₕₛf S,₄=Θ(d)), establishing a quadratic quantum--classical separation in logarithmic code size. Low-overlap Grassmann and agreement-code packings supply the orbit endpoints, while exact inverse query words match each encoded state to its designated test. At the sharp boundary (łambda₂₌₀), (0łeqłambda₁<1), all four model classes satisfy (łn N=Θ(minłn d,T)). Thus any fixed positive false-acceptance tolerance activates the metric-packing regime, whereas zero false acceptance imposes an exclusive-witness constraint and yields the logarithmic-dimension boundary.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了当控制接口受限于四个共享、时齐生成器时，(d)维记忆的有限时间范围识别极限。研究发现，对于任意CPTP生成器和随机映射，最优识别大小存在特定关系。该工作表明，四字母可逆字母表在最优二次和线性字长下达到了静态码字大小的阶数。在完全维度受限的情况下，这导致了对数码字大小的二次量子-经典分离，揭示了量子系统在信息识别能力上相对于经典系统的显著优势。
authors: Yixin Zhao

articles.title: Three-axis Active Magnetic Compensation with Spatial Feedforward Matrix Decoupling and Hysteresis PI Regulation for Suppressing Zeeman Decoherence of Cold Atom Quantum Memories
articles.title_zh: 基于空间前馈矩阵解耦和迟滞PI调节的三轴主动磁场补偿，用于抑制冷原子量子存储器的塞曼退相干
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21801v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cold-atom quantum memories require a near-zero magnetic environment (residual field <1 microtesla) to mitigate Zeeman decoherence. Conventional three-axis active compensation suffers from inter-coil crosstalk and geomagnetic drift, which degrade the uniformity and long-term stability of the zero-field region. To address this, we propose a spatiotemporally cooperative feedback-controlled suppression architecture for magnetic interference. An integrally printed three-dimensional orthogonal coil frame mechanically suppresses inter-axis flux leakage. A spatial feedforward inverse matrix is introduced to algorithmically eliminate first-order cross-coupling. A dual-threshold hysteresis incremental-PI controller filters magnetometer quantization fluctuations and avoids frequent small jitter adjustments of coil driving currents. Hardware ablation experiments, long-duration stability tests and spatial magnetic-field mapping were conducted. Experimental results show that during a 714.4 s continuous steady-hold stage, the mean and maximum residual fields at the central point reach 0.112 microtesla and 0.224 microtesla, respectively. The overlapping Allan deviations of all three components remain below 5 nT for averaging times of 1.9-178.2 s. Based on differential-ferrofluid lattice-scan measurements combined with centre-constrained quadratic vector reconstruction and soft Maxwell regularization, a weak-field spatial distribution with an RMS variation of 5.65 microtesla is fitted within a spherical region of interest of radius 5 mm, where 67.5% of the model volume meets the sub-5 microtesla coverage criterion. For a prolate ellipsoidal region matching the atomic-cloud distribution with full axis lengths of 10, 5, and 5 mm, the upper field bound within 93.7% of the volume is 2.68 microtesla.
articles.abstract_zh: 冷原子量子存储器需要近零磁场环境以减轻塞曼退相干，但传统补偿方法存在串扰和漂移问题。本文提出了一种时空协同反馈控制的磁干扰抑制架构，通过一体化打印的三维正交线圈框架、空间前馈逆矩阵解耦和双阈值迟滞增量PI控制器来解决这些问题。实验结果表明，在714.4秒的连续稳定保持阶段，中心点的平均和最大残余磁场分别达到0.112微特斯拉和0.224微特斯拉。该方法显著提升了零场区域的均匀性和长期稳定性。
authors: Ya Li, Xiao-Long Zou, Xiang-Yao Liang, Chang-Qing Niu, Xin Guo, Wei-Zhe Qiao, You-Xing Chen

articles.title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Optimization for Emergency-Priority Traffic Signal Control
articles.title_zh: 混合量子-经典优化在紧急优先交通信号控制中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21883v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Emergency-priority traffic signal control requires reducing emergency-vehicle delay while limiting disruption to ordinary traffic. This work investigates a finite-horizon QUBO formulation and compares Exact QUBO optimization, QAOA, CVaR-QAOA, a quantum machine-learning policy, fixed-time control, and max-pressure control in a three-intersection corridor. The study evaluates three traffic-demand regimes, examines the effect of the emergency-priority weight, and compares quantum solutions with the exact QUBO optimum. The optimization-based controllers achieved reliable emergency progression across all tested demand regimes, while max-pressure produced lower ordinary-traffic delay. Increasing emergency priority reduced emergency travel time but increased congestion, with diminishing improvements at larger weights. CVaR-QAOA reproduced the exact QUBO solution more accurately than standard QAOA, although the resulting differences in closed-loop traffic performance were comparatively small.
articles.abstract_zh: 紧急优先交通信号控制旨在减少紧急车辆延误，同时限制对普通交通的干扰。本研究探讨了有限时间范围的QUBO公式，并比较了精确QUBO优化、QAOA、CVaR-QAOA、量子机器学习策略、固定时间控制和最大压力控制在三交叉路口走廊中的性能。结果表明，基于优化的控制器在所有测试需求下均实现了可靠的紧急车辆通行。CVaR-QAOA比标准QAOA更准确地再现了精确QUBO解，尽管对闭环交通性能的影响相对较小。
authors: Silvie Illésová, Vojtěch Novák

articles.title: Opinion bubbles in the quantum Buridan's ass problem
articles.title_zh: 量子布里丹之驴问题中的意见气泡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21923v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantum Buridan's ass problem concerns a network of interconnected nodes in which transitions between the nodes are governed by the laws of quantum mechanics. In such situations interference between probability amplitudes plays a key role in determining whether the probability of leaving the initial node is large or small and also the speed at which the associated transitions occur. In this paper we extend this idea to consider transitions between one given set of coupled nodes and the remainder of the network. We have in mind a quantum analogy to changing an opinion, in which the initially occupied set of nodes is one opinion bubble, with the remaining parts of the network corresponding to a different opinion. We find that quantum interference again plays a crucial role in the dynamics. A further key component is the role of symmetry between the nodes and their interconnections, as it is symmetry that lies at the heart of the Buridan's ass puzzle. In the classical Buridan's ass paradox it is symmetry between competing alternatives that freezes the ass into indecision. In the quantum case, however, interference results in a far richer dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子布里丹之驴问题研究了互连节点网络中由量子力学定律控制的节点间跃迁。本文将此概念扩展到考虑给定耦合节点集与网络其余部分之间的跃迁，将其类比为意见的改变，其中初始节点集代表一个“意见气泡”。研究发现，量子干涉在动力学中起着关键作用，并且节点及其互连之间的对称性也是一个重要因素。与经典布里丹之驴悖论中对称性导致犹豫不决不同，量子情况下干涉导致了更丰富的动态行为。
authors: Leonid Chaichenets, Jaroslav Novotný, Igor Jex, Stephen M. Barnett, Tamás Kiss

articles.title: Synergistic charging of a quantum battery via Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction and non-Markovian noise
articles.title_zh: 基于Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用和非马尔可夫噪声的量子电池协同充电
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21928v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Protecting quantum batteries from environmental noise remains a challenge. Using exact Burshtein-Kubo equations, we study a two-spin quantum battery with Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) coupling under indepen dent local longitudinal random telegraph noise (RTN). At a fixed effective noise scale, the DM-assisted slow switching protocol yields a superadditive transient ergotropy gain and near-maximal ergotropy during the initial charging stage, while the no-DM slow-switching control reaches comparable ergotropy only in a later revival. A finite superadditive region persists at fixed RTN amplitude, with protocol-dependent location and gain. In the Ising model, the enhancement is nonmonotonic in DM strength, with intermediate coupling giving near-optimal performance. Dressed-channel analysis associates this enhancement with changes in transition frequencies and longitudinal-noise matrix elements that reduce slow-RTN spectral weight. Superadditivity also persists in the tested anisotropic XY model.
articles.abstract_zh: 保护量子电池免受环境噪声影响是一个持续的挑战。本文利用精确的Burshtein-Kubo方程，研究了在独立局部纵向随机电报噪声（RTN）下，具有Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya（DM）耦合的双自旋量子电池。研究发现，在固定有效噪声尺度下，DM辅助的慢速切换协议在初始充电阶段产生了超加性瞬态功提取增益和接近最大功提取。这种增强与跃迁频率和纵向噪声矩阵元素的变化有关，从而降低了慢速RTN的谱权重。超加性在测试的各向异性XY模型中也持续存在。
authors: Si-Yu Zhang, Meng-Long Song, Hai-Tao Dong, Xue-Ke Song, Liu Ye, Dong Wang

articles.title: Quantum control of solid state qubits via Reinforcement Learning
articles.title_zh: 基于强化学习的固态量子比特量子控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21987v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The use of reinforcement learning (RL) in the design of quantum control strategies for pulse level control of NISQ era quantum devices is attracting growing interest. Model-free RL, not requiring preexisting knowledge of the physical system, acts as a black-box optimization tool well suited for noisy devices. In this work, we provide a simulation-based analysis of the performance of model-free RL for state preparation and qubit gate design in a challenging setup: indirect control of NV nuclear spins in a spin-bath. In particular, the spin-bath is modeled via the generalized cluster correlation expansion accounting for magnetic impurities and intra-bath interactions. We analyze the performance of the RL agents by performing simulations with minimally observable environments and noisy, sparse rewards as introduced in (Phys. Rev. X 12, 011059), and compare them to other state-of-the-art black-box optimization tools.
articles.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）在设计NISQ时代量子设备的脉冲级量子控制策略方面日益受到关注。本文对无模型强化学习在具有挑战性的NV核自旋间接控制场景中，用于态制备和量子比特门设计的性能进行了基于仿真的分析。研究通过考虑磁杂质和浴内相互作用的广义簇关联展开来建模自旋浴。该工作比较了RL智能体与其他最先进的黑盒优化工具的性能，验证了其在噪声环境下的有效性。
authors: Dennis Herb, Mirko Rossini, Sabine Wölk, Joachim Ankerhold, Dominik Maile, Alessio Belenchia

articles.title: Bubble-Sort Exchange Networks: Symmetry Selection Rules and Language-Model Distillation on Exchange-Only Spin Chains
articles.title_zh: 冒泡排序交换网络：交换型自旋链上的对称选择规则和语言模型蒸馏
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22093v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: On a chain of exchange-coupled quantum dots a Heisenberg exchange pulse of area pi is a SWAP, so the parallel bubble-sort SWAP network of superconducting chains is native to exchange-only (EO) spin qubits, and any other pulse area fuses routing with an entangling interaction. We build a variational "bubble-sort exchange network" (odd-even transposition, one parameter per pulse) and study it as a Born machine read out by Pauli spin blockade. Exchange conserves total spin, so the reachable readout distributions are fixed by the total-spin content of the initial product state. For the two-spin singlet-triplet encoding we derive a selection rule -- outcomes with k triplet pairs are bounded by the initial weight in sectors S <= k (S = 0 excluded for k = 1) -- and prove by a transportation argument that it is also sufficient: the reachable distributions form the polytope cut out by the rule, and its total-variation floor is attained. Products of singlets and T0's forbid whole outcome classes; the Neel state forbids none; the three-spin EO code has no floor. We then distil, in noise-free simulation, next-token distributions of GPT-2 over restricted vocabularies into the network, with matrix-product-state (MPS) Born machines as classical control. At six logical qubits the three-spin chain reaches KL = 0.011 nat at depth N and 0.004 at 2N, below the bond-dimension-4 MPS; the two-spin chain from the Neel state reaches 0.014 at 2N and 0.004 at 3N, against 0.28-1.5 from singlet/triplet products for the first teacher. Final states lie largely outside the code space: leakage is a resource, not an error. No arrangement of disjoint pulses meets every pair in fewer than N-1 rounds, and at depth 2N the chain distils as well as a 2D array or non-local couplings. Sector-restricted simulation extends this to 10-14 logical qubits (up to 30 dots).
articles.abstract_zh: 在交换耦合量子点链上，海森堡交换脉冲可以实现SWAP操作，这使得并行的冒泡排序SWAP网络天然适用于交换型（EO）自旋量子比特。本文构建了一个变分“冒泡排序交换网络”，并将其作为通过泡利自旋阻塞读出的玻恩机器进行研究。研究导出了双自旋单重态-三重态编码的选择规则，并证明了其充分性。此外，该工作在无噪声模拟中，对GPT-2的下一个token分布进行了蒸馏，展示了其在量子信息处理中的潜力。
authors: Yuichiro Minato

articles.title: Operational Limits of Gravity-Mediated Entanglement
articles.title_zh: 引力介导纠缠的操作极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22097v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tests of gravity-mediated entanglement aim to determine whether two massive objects in spatial superposition can become entangled through their mutual gravitational interaction. In an ideal model, the two objects are often treated as pointlike branches, but real wave packets have a finite width and are also exposed to dephasing and residual non-gravitational forces. We study these effects in a two-branch gravitational cat-state model with Gaussian wave packets. The Newtonian interaction is averaged over the finite wave-packet width, and spatially correlated dephasing is included phenomenologically. We then ask a practical question: when does the generated state remain useful rather than merely entangled? To answer this, we examine Bell violation, teleportation fidelity, coherent information, Fisher information, and state distinguishability. We find finite parameter windows where the same state is Bell-nonlocal and teleportation-useful, but these windows shrink as the wave packets become broader or the dephasing becomes stronger. We also show that a residual electrostatic branch interaction can coherently cancel the gravitational nonlocal phase and strongly suppress the operational signal. The results identify finite-width and electrostatic tolerance boundaries that should be considered in future tests of gravity-mediated entanglement.
articles.abstract_zh: 引力介导纠缠的测试旨在确定两个处于空间叠加态的宏观物体是否能通过相互引力作用而纠缠。本文在一个具有高斯波包的双分支引力猫态模型中，研究了有限波包宽度、退相干和残余非引力力对引力介导纠缠的影响。通过分析贝尔不等式违反、隐形传态保真度、相干信息等指标，研究发现存在有限的参数窗口使纠缠态具有实用性。然而，这些窗口会随着波包变宽或退相干增强而缩小，表明了引力介导纠缠的实际操作限制。
authors: Atta ur Rahman, Muhammad Noman, Ying-Jian Zhu, Jia-Xin Peng, Saeed Haddadi

articles.title: Patchwork: automated lattice surgery and space-time partitioning for real-time decoding
articles.title_zh: Patchwork：用于实时解码的自动化晶格手术和时空分区
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22112v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce patchwork, a lattice-surgery compiler for arbitrary multi-qubit Pauli measurements on a prescribed narrow-corridor two-dimensional surface-code layout. Systematic geometric rules simplify stabilizer placement and gate scheduling, including for logical Y measurements implemented using twist defects. We introduce measurement circuits and schedules that, together with protruding lobes of Y-extension patches, preserve the full effective code distance for all numerically tested code distances. To support parallel decoding, we develop a wavefront algorithm that partitions merged lattice-surgery patches into space-time commit, buffer, and cleanup regions. Simulations of three sequential multi-qubit Pauli measurements acting on ten logical qubits show that staged decoding achieves total failure probabilities close to those of monolithic decoding over the parameters tested. These methods provide an automated framework for fault-tolerant lattice surgery and a route toward scalable, real-time decoding.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了Patchwork，一个用于在预设窄走廊二维表面码布局上进行任意多量子比特泡利测量的晶格手术编译器。该系统利用系统的几何规则简化了稳定子放置和门调度，并引入了测量电路和调度以保持完整的有效码距离。为支持并行解码，开发了一种波前算法将合并的晶格手术补丁划分为时空提交、缓冲和清理区域。模拟结果表明，分阶段解码的总失败概率接近于整体解码，为可扩展的实时解码提供了自动化框架。
authors: Christopher Chamberland, Muyuan Li, Scott Thornton, Justin Gage Lietz, Melody Ren, Antonio deMarti iOlius

articles.title: Gyrators for superconducting circuit design
articles.title_zh: 超导电路设计中的回转器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22145v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Assuming only the solubility of Kirchhoff's laws, the conservation of energy, and the form of the constitutive relations, we present a flux-charge symmetric Hamiltonian formalism that always admits a symplectic reduction for nonsingular, well-posed circuits involving gyrators, inductors, and capacitors (LCG circuits) with arbitrary non-linearity. The formalism introduces a notion of circuit duality on non-linear non-reciprocal circuits and a family of point transformations that inserts, removes, and moves reciprocal elements across gyrators while preserving the Hamiltonian spectrum. With these transformations, we extend Tellegen's classic result that gyrators make reciprocal elements behave as their dual to non-linear reciprocal elements such as the Josephson junction and quantum phase slip. Furthermore, we present conditions under which non-reciprocal circuits can be transformed to dynamically equivalent reciprocal circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个磁通-电荷对称的哈密顿形式，适用于包含回转器、电感器和电容器（LCG电路）的任意非线性、非奇异、适定电路，并始终允许辛约化。该形式引入了非线性非互易电路上的电路对偶概念，以及一系列点变换，可以在回转器之间插入、移除和移动互易元件，同时保持哈密顿谱。这些变换将泰勒根的经典结果推广到约瑟夫森结和量子相变等非线性互易元件，并给出了非互易电路可转换为动态等效互易电路的条件。
authors: Ciro Salcedo, Sasha Cocquyt, Andrew Osborne, Andrew A. Houck

articles.title: Programmable all-to-all entangling gates for cavity-coupled atoms
articles.title_zh: 可编程的全连接腔耦合原子纠缠门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22220v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fault tolerant quantum computers greatly benefit from having both high fidelity entangling gates and a non-local qubit connectivity. However, most entangling gates for neutral atoms are local, requiring separated atoms to be moved using optical tweezers to yield entanglement between them. Here, we design a high fidelity Mø lmer Sø rensen-like entangling gate between neutral atoms coupled to a photonic cavity, enabling a programmable all-to-all connectivity through the shared cavity coupling. The gate is both robust to changes in cavity photon number, and enables selective entanglement between any subset of separated atoms through local laser addressing. This eliminates the need to physically move atoms to perform the gate, and therefore motional errors and erasure are suppressed. Using experimentally realistic parameters we demonstrate gate fidelities exceeding F > 0.99, with higher fidelities achievable through optimal control of the pump amplitudes.
articles.abstract_zh: 容错量子计算机需要高保真纠缠门和非局域量子比特连接。本文设计了一种高保真Mølmer-Sørensen型纠缠门，用于光腔耦合的中性原子，通过共享腔耦合实现可编程的全连接。该门对腔光子数变化具有鲁棒性，并通过局部激光寻址实现任意分离原子子集之间的选择性纠缠。实验参数表明，门保真度超过0.99。
authors: Angus Crookes, Ben Yuen, Angela Demetriadou

articles.title: Classical Capacity of Single-Mode Bosonic Gaussian Channels
articles.title_zh: 单模玻色高斯信道的经典容量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22308v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The classical capacity of a noisy optical channel is the maximum rate at which information can be transmitted reliably, given a constraint on the mean input energy. For the ubiquitous bosonic Gaussian channels, which include standard models of loss and noise in fibre and free-space optical links, determining this rate requires addressing whether entanglement between channel uses or non-Gaussian signals can outperform Gaussian encodings. More precisely, the question is whether the energy-constrained Holevo information is additive across arbitrarily many channel uses and coincides with its Gaussian counterpart. We answer these fundamental questions in the affirmative for every single-mode bosonic Gaussian channel at every input energy. Namely, we prove that independently prepared Gaussian states with Gaussian-distributed random displacements achieve the capacity, including in the low-energy regime where squeezing the signals competes with encoding information in their displacement. Our proof connects an entanglement inequality to a sharp, additive lower bound on output entropy. We then characterise communication above capacity: under a strict total photon-number cutoff, the probability of correct decoding decreases exponentially with the number of channel uses, and we derive explicit bounds on the decay exponent. When only the mean photon number is constrained, a simple energy-rescaling formula determines exactly the entire asymptotic rate--error trade-off: the capacity at mean photon number N and allowed average decoding error ϵ equals the vanishing-error capacity at mean photon number N/(1-ϵ). Together, these results identify the ultimate limits of classical communication for some of the most fundamental models of optical communication.
articles.abstract_zh: 噪声光学信道的经典容量是信息可靠传输的最大速率。本文肯定地回答了单模玻色高斯信道在任意输入能量下，能量受限的Holevo信息是否具有可加性并与高斯编码一致的问题。研究证明，独立制备的具有高斯分布随机位移的高斯态可以达到信道容量。该证明将纠缠不等式与输出熵的精确可加下界联系起来。
authors: Gerardo Adesso, Ludovico Lami, Vittorio Giovannetti

articles.title: Magic in quantum trajectory unravelings of noisy random quantum circuits
articles.title_zh: 噪声随机量子电路量子轨迹展开中的“魔力”
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22318v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantum-trajectory description of a noisy quantum circuit is not unique: every Kraus representation of the noise channel defines a different unraveling, i.e., a different ensemble of pure states that averages to the same density matrix. While all unravelings share the same expectation values of observables, they generally differ in the amount of quantum resources carried by the individual trajectories. Here we study non-stabilizerness, or magic, quantified by the stabilizer Rényi entropy, in quantum-trajectory unravelings of Haar-random and T-doped random Clifford brickwork circuits subject to local dephasing noise of strength p. The canonical unraveling in terms of Pauli jumps is Clifford and leaves magic untouched, so that trajectories retain the Haar-random value of non-stabilizerness. Exploring the full two-parameter family of minimal unravelings, we find that the trajectory-averaged magic can be substantially reduced by a state-independent choice of Kraus operators, and that the optimal choice is not in general the projective-measurement unraveling, but a two-outcome generalized measurement in which the Kraus operators correspond to a weak measurement of the noisy qubit. The optimal unraveling reduces the extensive magic density of the trajectories by a p-dependent factor without altering its linear scaling with system size. At the same time, it produces a very broad distribution of magic over trajectories, with a sizable fraction of trajectories retaining Haar-random magic. Since the cost of stabilizer-based classical simulation grows exponentially with the magic of the state, these high-magic trajectories, rather than the average, control the simulation cost. Our results delineate the potential and the limitations of unraveling optimization as a route to the classical simulation of noisy quantum dynamics with stabilizer methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 噪声量子电路的量子轨迹描述并非唯一，不同的Kraus表示定义了不同的展开。本文研究了在局部退相干噪声下，Haar随机和T掺杂随机Clifford砖块电路的量子轨迹展开中的非稳定性（“魔力”）。研究发现，通过与状态无关的Kraus算符选择，轨迹平均的“魔力”可以显著降低。最优选择通常不是投影测量展开，而是一种两结果的广义测量。
authors: Sara Santos, Alessio Paviglianiti, Vincenzo Savona

articles.title: Representation-split Carleman lattice Boltzmann with near-unit step success probability on quantum computers
articles.title_zh: 量子计算机上具有接近单位步成功概率的表示分裂Carleman格子玻尔兹曼方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20620v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Carleman lattice Boltzmann method replaces the quadratic collision of the lattice Boltzmann equation by a linear map on a lifted state. Existing block encodings of this map succeed with probability 10⁻⁵ to 10⁻² per step, so that the probability of a multi-step evolution decays exponentially with the number of steps. This study develops multi-relaxation-time Carleman lattice Boltzmann, a representation split in which the Carleman-lifted collision is performed in a moment basis on the amplitude-encoded state, while streaming remains a permutation in population space. The level-2 hierarchy closes under collision but not under streaming, which generates the work of pressure, advection and stress on the momentum flux. The state therefore remains the full pair array, and the moment representation is an orthogonal change of basis of the population one, with identical dynamics and truncation error. The operator to be block encoded changes with the basis, and with it the success probability of a quantum step. In the weighted Hermite basis with the amplitude encoding fᵢ/sqrtwᵢ, the relaxation is a diagonal operator of norm one, and the level-2 collision stage becomes this diagonal plus a sparse coupling from products of conserved moments. A structured block encoding of this form raises the single-step success probability on the D2Q9 lattice from 10⁻² for the best population encoding to 0.98. With the pair sector in relative coordinates and scaled, one step requires O(łog² N) Toffoli gates and is verified by statevector simulation. The encoding and readout overhead of a T-step run is then polynomial in T and N rather than accumulating a factor p^T. For resolved flows, the remaining exponential loss in coherent multi-step Carleman lattice Boltzmann evolution is set by the non-equilibrium norm relaxed by dissipation rather than by the block encoding.
articles.abstract_zh: Carleman格子玻尔兹曼方法将格子玻尔兹曼方程的二次碰撞替换为提升态上的线性映射。现有方法的单步成功概率较低，导致多步演化概率呈指数衰减。本研究提出了一种多弛豫时间Carleman格子玻尔兹曼方法，通过在矩基下对振幅编码态执行Carleman提升碰撞，显著提高了量子步的成功概率。在加权Hermite基下，弛豫是一个范数为一的对角算符。
authors: Hua-Dong Yao, Sauro Succi

articles.title: Finite-cutoff geometry from double-scaled SYK
articles.title_zh: 双尺度SYK模型中的有限截断几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20703v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop a finite-cutoff holographic description of the double-scaled SYK (DSSYK) model. We construct microscopic deformations of Kourkoulou-Maldacena and thermofield-double SYK states whose double-scaling limits reproduce a lower-dimensional analogue of TøverlineT and TøverlineT+Łambda₂ deformations, which we denote T² and T²⁺Łambda₁, respectively. The ensemble-averaged theory describes wormhole states in finite-cutoff sine dilaton gravity, and finite-cutoff anti-de Sitter and de Sitter geometries in the low- and high-energy regimes, respectively. The analysis includes both perturbative and non-perturbative solutions to the energy spectrum flow equation, and the regions behind and beyond the respective horizons. Only the perturbative branch admits physical quantum states. We study how to incorporate end-of-the-world (ETW) branes in the finite cutoff holographic dictionary. The ETW brane leads to an additional boundary theory deformation, which leads to black hole or eternal traversable wormhole geometries depending on the existence of normalizable bound states. We extend the finite cutoff length evaluations for constant mean curvature (CMC) slices, and interpret them as complexity in the boundary theory. We discuss possible extensions with matter. Our results provide a microscopic framework for studying the finite-cutoff boundaries, CMC slices and branes in the holographic dictionary of DSSYK.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文发展了双尺度SYK（DSSYK）模型的有限截断全息描述。通过构建Kourkoulou-Maldacena和热场双SYK态的微观形变，其双尺度极限再现了T²和T²⁺Λ₁形变。系综平均理论描述了有限截断正弦膨胀引力中的虫洞态，以及低能和高能区域的有限截断反德西特和德西特几何。研究还探讨了如何在有限截断全息字典中引入世界末日（ETW）膜。
authors: Sergio E. Aguilar-Gutierrez

articles.title: Boundary-induced geometrical frustration in a square Rydberg-atom lattice
articles.title_zh: 方形里德堡原子晶格中边界诱导的几何挫折
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20723v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study geometric defects in square-lattice Rydberg-atom arrays induced by lattice-size parity in the striated density-wave phase. While odd-sized lattices select a single striated domain, even-sized lattices seed incompatible domains at the four corners, resulting in a π/2-rotation invariant state with a geometrical defect emanating from the lattice center. At larger detunings, we instead identify a π-rotation-invariant state with two domains nucleated by opposite corners and separated by a one-dimensional diagonal defect. We probe the state-preparation protocol on the Aquila atomic quantum processor and benchmark it with equilibrium and real-time dynamics tensor-network simulations. Our results assess the role of boundaries and lattice size in determining the global ordering in programmable quantum matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了条纹密度波相中，晶格尺寸奇偶性在方形里德堡原子阵列中引起的几何缺陷。奇数尺寸晶格选择单个条纹畴，而偶数尺寸晶格在四个角产生不兼容的畴，导致中心出现几何缺陷。在较大失谐下，发现了由对角角核化的两个畴组成的π旋转不变态。研究结果评估了边界和晶格尺寸在确定可编程量子物质全局有序中的作用。
authors: Marco Rigobello, Luka Pavešić, Daniel Jaschke, Pietro Silvi, Marco Di Liberto, Simone Montangero, Simone Notarnicola

articles.title: Long-lived local coherences at high temperature from frozen domain walls
articles.title_zh: 高温下由冻结畴壁产生的长寿命局部相干性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20724v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Local coherences between distinct charge sectors--measured by the single-particle Green's function or the transverse spin autocorrelation function--do not overlap with hydrodynamic modes. At finite temperature, therefore, they decay faster than any power law in generic chaotic systems. We present a mechanism by which these coherences can persist anomalously long, for integrable and chaotic spin chains (including the XXZ and Fredkin spin chains) that obey a quantum group symmetry. We show--using a Mazur bound derived from the quantum-group symmetry, together with locality and a "non-undershoot" assumption--that the transverse spin autocorrelation function C(t) equiv łangle σ⁻ₓ₍ₜ₎ σ⁺ₓ₍₀₎ångle can decay at most algebraically: C(t) gtrsim 1/t². This bound is not tight: in the large-anisotropy limit of the XXZ spin chain, at infinite temperature, we explicitly compute C(t) sim sqrt3/(18 sqrtt). We also compute this decay rate in the XXZ spin chain for general easy-axis anisotropy, and estimate it to scale as C(t) sim t⁻²/z (for transport exponent z) in the chaotic models.
articles.abstract_zh: 局部相干性在有限温度下通常比任何幂律衰减得更快。本文提出了一种机制，使得这些相干性在遵循量子群对称性的可积和混沌自旋链中异常持久。研究表明，横向自旋自相关函数C(t)最多以代数形式衰减，即C(t) ≳ 1/t²。在XXZ自旋链的大各向异性极限下，C(t) ~ √3/(18√t)。
authors: Sarang Gopalakrishnan, Romain Vasseur

articles.title: Schrödinger's unpublished hidden-variable model in the 1944-45 debate over the "Collapse of Determinism"
articles.title_zh: 薛定谔在1944-45年“决定论崩溃”辩论中未发表的隐变量模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20752v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In the mid-1940s, the question of whether quantum mechanics could be supplemented by deterministic hidden variables resurfaced in a debate in ^textitNature. I show that Erwin Schrödinger drafted a hitherto unpublished response to this controversy. In it, Schrödinger provided an explicit hidden-variable model, thereby showing that such models could not be ruled out. I reconstruct the historical context of this forgotten manuscript and publish here the first transcription and analysis. Importantly, Schrödinger's proposal should be understood as a proof of principle rather than as evidence of his commitment to determinism.
articles.abstract_zh: 20世纪40年代中期，《自然》杂志上重新出现了量子力学是否能通过确定性隐变量补充的争论。本文揭示了埃尔温·薛定谔草拟了一份此前未发表的对此争议的回应，其中他提供了一个明确的隐变量模型，表明此类模型无法被排除。作者重建了这份被遗忘手稿的历史背景，并首次对其进行转录和分析。薛定谔的提议应被理解为原理证明，而非他致力于决定论的证据。
authors: Flavio Del Santo

articles.title: The Magic Barrier: A Universal Feature of Quantum Thermalization
articles.title_zh: “魔力屏障”：量子热化的一种普遍特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20768v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We show that the emergence of a ``magic barrier'', characterized by a transient maximum of nonstabilizerness during rapid entanglement growth, is a universal feature of thermalization within quantum ergodic theories, which is intimately connected to random matrix spectral properties. Starting from a pure product state, we analytically determine the time evolution of entanglement entropy, antiflatness, capacity of entanglement, and nonlocal trace distance magic under unitary dynamics generated by random matrix Hamiltonians drawn from all three Gaussian ensembles. We find that the transient maxima of antiflatness, capacity of entanglement, and nonlocal magic occur on the same characteristic timescale as the maximum rate of entanglement growth. These results establish that the magic barrier is a universal feature of RMT thermalization, suggesting universality across quantum chaotic systems. We conclude that quantitative simulations of thermalization in ergodic quantum theories inherently require quantum computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文揭示了“魔力屏障”的出现是量子遍历理论中热化的一种普遍特征，其表现为快速纠缠增长过程中非稳定性的瞬态最大值。研究分析了随机矩阵哈密顿量产生的幺正动力学下纠缠熵和“魔力”的时间演化。结果表明，非稳定性和“魔力”的瞬态最大值与纠缠增长的最大速率发生在相同的特征时间尺度上。这些发现确立了“魔力屏障”是随机矩阵理论热化的普遍特征，并暗示了量子混沌系统中的普适性。
authors: Jakob J. Minar, Andreas Schäfer, Leonhard Schmotzer, Clemens Seidl

articles.title: Collective Organization of String Fragmentation
articles.title_zh: 弦碎裂的集体组织
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20793v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: How coherent confining strings reorganize into hadronic matter is a central open problem in nonequilibrium gauge dynamics. Using real-time tensor-network simulations of the massive Schwinger model, we identify a collective organization underlying string fragmentation. For intermediate masses, the dynamics simplifies and more than 99% of the temporal evolution of the electric-field probability distribution is governed by a single collective mode whose decay tracks the survival probability of the parent string. The extracted survival law exhibits the same Gaussian dependence implied by the Lund world-sheet area law, providing microscopic support for its characteristic area law dependence without assuming the Lund fragmentation mechanism. The same mode controls the transition from the coherent string to the produced mesons, explains the universal non-thermal effective fluid equation of state, and essentially controls the growth of bipartite entanglement through the causal propagation of massive pairs. These results identify collective fragmentation as an organizing principle of coherent string breaking and provide a microscopic perspective on the dynamical origin of a central ingredient of Lund hadronization.
articles.abstract_zh: 相干限制弦如何重组为强子物质是非平衡规范动力学中的一个核心问题。本文利用大规模施温格模型的实时张量网络模拟，揭示了弦碎裂背后的集体组织。对于中间质量，动力学简化，电场概率分布的时间演化主要由单一集体模式控制。该模式的衰减轨迹与母弦的存活概率一致，并控制着从相干弦到介子的转变以及双分量纠缠的增长。
authors: Romuald A. Janik, Maciej A. Nowak, Marek M. Rams, Ismail Zahed

articles.title: Data-Driven Optimization of Seminumerical Exchange for SIMD CPUs
articles.title_zh: 面向SIMD CPU的半数值交换数据驱动优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21075v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a seminumerical exchange algorithm (SNK) based on the sn-LinK method [Laqua et al., J. Chem. Theory Comput. 16, 1456 (2020)], optimized for modern multi-core central processing units with single instruction multiple data vector instructions and report its implementation into the Q-Chem quantum chemistry program. Vectorization and memory management strategies for the Boys function and 3-center-1-electron (3c1e) integral kernels are given. Several new considerations are made in the computation of the 3c1e integrals: the Head-Gordon Pople horizontal recurrence relations, same-center optimizations, and multishell optimizations, all implemented symbolically employing the SymPy symbolic algebra library and exported as optimized C++ code leveraging common-sub-expression elimination (CSE) optimization techniques. A general scheme for choosing optimal integral kernels is developed through rigorous timing benchmarks. The resulting implementation is tested against traditional 4c2e exchange for several systems and basis sets, showing 1-2 orders of magnitude speedups for systems of practically relevant sizes (100-500 atoms, 2000-10000 basis functions). For smaller molecules, comparisons are also made against the more efficient occ-RI-K method showing a break-even point around 50-100 atoms beyond which SNK dramatically outperforms due to its superior sub-quadratic (between linear and quadratic) time complexity as well as its effectively negligible memory demand.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于sn-LinK方法的半数值交换算法（SNK），并针对现代多核SIMD CPU进行了优化，将其实现到Q-Chem量子化学程序中。研究给出了Boys函数和3中心1电子（3c1e）积分核的向量化和内存管理策略。通过严格的计时基准测试，开发了一种选择最优积分核的通用方案。该实现对实际相关尺寸的系统显示出1-2个数量级的加速。
authors: Jesse DiCenso, Henryk Laqua, Martin Head-Gordon

articles.title: Displacement-noise-free gravitational-wave detector using quantum tomography of photon orbital angular momentum states
articles.title_zh: 利用光子轨道角动量态量子层析成像的无位移噪声引力波探测器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21112v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Gravitational waves (GWs) induce quantum transitions between photon orbital-angular-momentum (OAM) states with amplitudes α±. Exploiting this effect, we present a displacement-noise-free detection framework that extracts GW information from the OAM Hilbert space. Parametrized quantum state tomography of the GW-induced OAM sidebands enables a single V-shaped detector to resolve all seven wave parameters: the frequency, propagation direction, two polarization amplitudes, and initial phase of each polarization. Direct detection of the sidebands yields a weak signal of approximately 10⁻¹⁵,W. We therefore introduce a stronger reference state r |0>P, with r=0.01, to enhance the detected signal. For an arm length of L=4,m, N=160 round trips, a paraxial parameter of γ=0.1, an incident light power of PBS=10,kW, a wavelength of łambdaₒₚₜ=1064,nm, and GW amplitudes of A=10⁻¹⁸, we estimate sideband transition amplitudes of |α±|sim10⁻¹⁰ and signal powers of order 1,nW, scaling as PBSα±propto PBSANLγ/łambdaₒₚₜ. The shot-noise-limited sensitivity floor is S¹/²ₙ₌₁.6×10⁻²⁰,Hz⁻¹/². Because the scheme measures OAM transition amplitudes rather than differential arm lengths, it is intrinsically free from displacement noise and provides a broadband probe of GWs, specifically bridging the 0.1--10,Hz mid-frequency gap.
articles.abstract_zh: 引力波（GWs）能诱导光子轨道角动量（OAM）态之间的量子跃迁。本文利用这一效应，提出了一种无位移噪声的探测框架，从OAM希尔伯特空间提取引力波信息。通过对引力波诱导的OAM边带进行参数化量子态层析成像，单个V形探测器能够解析所有七个波参数。该方案通过测量OAM跃迁振幅而非差分位移，实现了散粒噪声限制的灵敏度。
authors: Haorong Wu, Xilong Fan, Lixiang Chen

articles.title: Regret Lower Bound for Online Learning of Quantum States with Logarithmic Loss, with Applications to Quantum State Tomography and Confidence Sequences for Matrix Means
articles.title_zh: 量子态对数损失在线学习的遗憾下界及其在量子态层析成像和矩阵均值置信序列中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21273v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the problem of online learning of quantum states with logarithmic loss, which is a quantum generalization of online portfolio selection and has applications to quantum state tomography, the task of estimating an unknown quantum state from measurement outcomes. We first establish a regret lower bound, showing that the regret rates of Exponential Weights and the algorithm of Tseng et al. (2025) have optimal polynomial dependence on the dimension. Our analysis leads to two further results. First, our lower-bound proof leads to a quantum state tomography algorithm that is sample optimal up to polylogarithmic factors in the sample size. Second, we develop an algorithm for constructing confidence sequences for the mean of a matrix-valued random variable. A numerical experiment shows that the latter algorithm is competitive with existing methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了对数损失下量子态在线学习问题，该问题是量子投资组合选择的推广，并应用于量子态层析成像。研究建立了遗憾下界，表明现有算法的遗憾率在维度上具有最优多项式依赖性。此外，该分析还导出了一个在样本量上达到准最优的量子态层析成像算法，并开发了一种用于构建矩阵值随机变量均值置信序列的算法，数值实验表明其具有竞争力。
authors: Yen-Huan Li, Wei-Fu Tseng

articles.title: Finite-size geometric crossover toward fragmentation of the potential energy shell in the quantum random energy model
articles.title_zh: 量子随机能量模型中势能壳层向碎裂的有限尺寸几何交叉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21631v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The quantum random energy model (QREM) is a paradigmatic model for studying delocalization-localization transitions at finite energy density in Fock space. In the computational basis, its diagonal energies are independent Gaussian random variables, in contrast to the correlated energies of local interacting models such as the disordered XXZ chain. In this work, we construct a potential energy shell associated with a basis state, defined through its energy variance, and investigate its connectivity on the Fock-space hypercube. As the transverse field is varied, this energy-selected subgraph undergoes a finite-size geometric crossover between fully connected and fragmented regimes. Furthermore, we observe a correlation between the shell connectivity and the finite-size fractal dimension of the eigenstates, as extracted from the participation entropy. For the QREM, the statistical independence of the diagonal energies allows the shell connectivity to be analyzed as an effective independent site percolation problem on the hypercube, with its crossover scale estimated within a one-hop approximation. At finite energy density, this estimate gives a nonmonotonic dependence of the crossover scale on system size L: increasing L initially favors connectivity, while beyond an energy-dependent scale L^*(ǎrepsilon) the trend reverses towards fragmentation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了量子随机能量模型（QREM）中势能壳层的连通性，该模型是研究Fock空间中有限能量密度下离域-局域转变的范式模型。通过能量方差定义与基态相关的势能壳层，并探讨其在Fock空间超立方体上的连通性。研究发现，随着横向场的改变，这个能量选择的子图在完全连接和碎裂状态之间经历有限尺寸几何交叉，并且壳层连通性与本征态的有限尺寸分形维数之间存在关联。
authors: Ishita Modak, Vatsana Tiwari, Soumya Bera

articles.title: Diffusion Language Models as Open Quantum Systems
articles.title_zh: 作为开放量子系统的扩散语言模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21672v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Diffusion language models generate text by reversing a classical diffusion process over token sequences. We show that their continuous-time forward and reverse dynamics can be embedded in the framework of open quantum systems, which describes quantum systems interacting with their environment. This connection provides a basis for extending diffusion sampling to superpositions of sentence states and for modifying the underlying generation dynamics. We construct a τ-leaping unraveling scheme that simulates stochastic trajectories of these states while updating multiple token positions at each step. This enables generation conditioned on superposed prompts or thoughts, which we call Superposition of Prompts (SoP) and Superposition of Thoughts (SoT). The same formulation yields Quantum-Inspired Remasking (QIR): perturbing the masked-diffusion dynamics produces a confidence-based rule for revising previously generated tokens. Experiments with pretrained diffusion language models show that superposition-based generation can retain information from conditioning components not selected at the final measurement, while QIR improves LLM-assessed text quality when applied at an appropriate stage of generation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将扩散语言模型的连续时间正向和反向动力学嵌入到开放量子系统框架中，为将扩散采样扩展到句子态叠加以及修改生成动力学提供了基础。研究构建了一种τ-leaping展开方案，可模拟这些状态的随机轨迹并同时更新多个令牌位置。这使得基于叠加提示（SoP）或叠加思想（SoT）的生成成为可能，并引入了量子启发式重掩码（QIR），实验表明叠加生成能保留未被最终测量的条件信息，且QIR能提升LLM评估。
authors: Akinori Tanaka, Yukinao Akamatsu, Takuki Tomita, Yuji Hirono

articles.title: Realization Divergence in Multi-Provider Quantum Computing: A Pre-Registered Study of What Survives Measurement
articles.title_zh: 多供应商量子计算中的实现差异：一项关于测量结果存活性的预注册研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21714v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum programs pass through compilers, transpilers and vendor services before execution. However, the distance between what was written and what runs is rarely measured. We call this distance realization divergence: the observable difference in how an identical source circuit is realized and behaves across quantum software stacks. We report a hardware study across three vendors and four devices, combining pre-registered predictions with explicitly identified exploratory analyses and amendments. In a compilation experiment with assigned placement policies, embedding radius correlates with two-qubit overhead at Spearman 0.805, against 0.492 for circuit size. Under a fixed lowest-index policy, an eight-qubit Bernstein-Vazirani circuit exhibits greater execution divergence than a twelve-qubit circuit on IQM Emerald. The opposite ordering occurs on IQM Garnet. Both comparisons replicate across two repetitions with disjoint confidence intervals. These results support a placement-dependent explanation, without isolating individual hardware noise mechanisms. The same ordering inversion is absent on the all-to-all IonQ control. On Rigetti Cepheus, a follow-up using topology-aware native placement found no consistent advantage in correct-answer probability for either submission track, but did not establish equivalence between the tracks. Structural comparisons depend on metric weighting, placement and device generation. Provider interfaces also limit observability: Rigetti's supported-operation list remained unchanged across a device generation that replaced the native entangler. We classify silent interface failures in composed toolchains and identify checks at toolchain boundaries, connecting valid cross-provider comparisons with concrete software-quality practices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了量子程序在不同量子软件栈上执行时，其编写代码与实际运行行为之间的“实现差异”。通过对三家供应商和四台设备的硬件研究，发现编译实验中嵌入半径与双量子比特开销呈强相关性。在固定最低索引策略下，八量子比特的Bernstein-Vazirani电路在IQM Emerald上表现出比十二量子比特电路更大的执行差异，而在IQM Garnet上则相反，这些结果支持了与放置策略相关的解释。
authors: Jouni Peltonen, Vlad Stirbu, Tommi Mikkonen

articles.title: Probing Deconfined Quantum Criticality Point on a Digital Quantum Computer
articles.title_zh: 在数字量子计算机上探测去禁闭量子临界点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21761v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A deconfined quantum critical point (DQCP) is a continuous transition between ordered phases with unrelated broken symmetries, beyond the Landau-Ginzburg-Wilson paradigm. In one dimension, such a transition between a z-polarized ferromagnet (zFM) and a valence-bond solid (VBS) is well established numerically in a frustrated spin-1/2 chain. Here we ask whether a superconducting quantum processor can resolve this transition and its signatures despite finite-size effects and device noise. The ground states are prepared by ancilla-projected quantum imaginary-time evolution (QITE), whose exact target states are compressed by tensor-network optimization into shallow depth quantum circuits. The hardware data distinguish the phases through their order parameters, spin and dimer correlations, structure factors, correlation ratios, and snapshot distributions. The crossing of the order parameters locates the transition, and its finite-size extrapolation lies close to the thermodynamic-limit value obtained from large-scale numerics. A noise model based on the device calibration accounts quantitatively for the reduced amplitudes measured on hardware. Our findings demonstrate that a Landau-forbidden transition between competing orders can be resolved on current quantum processors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了超导量子处理器能否识别一维受挫自旋-1/2链中z极化铁磁体与价键固体之间的去禁闭量子临界点（DQCP）及其特征。研究通过辅助比特投影量子虚时演化制备基态，并利用硬件数据区分不同相。结果显示，序参量的交叉定位了相变点，其有限尺寸外推值与大规模数值模拟的热力学极限值接近，且基于设备校准的噪声模型定量解释了硬件上测得的幅度衰减。
authors: Mrinal Kanti Giri, Pinaki Sengupta

articles.title: One generation of the Standard Model as a quantum error-correcting code
articles.title_zh: 标准模型的一代粒子作为量子纠错码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21879v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Together with a right-handed neutrino, the fermions of one generation of the Standard Model are labelled by five bits, a combinatorial structure tied to anomaly cancellation. We make this precise. Anomaly cancellation is the vanishing of a cubic form, the defining property of triorthogonal codes, the quantum error-correcting codes behind magic state distillation. Removing the right-handed neutrino gives a [[15,1,3]]ₚ code for every prime p, including the Bravyi-Kitaev code for p = 2. For qutrits it is the unique shortest distance-three triorthogonal code.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出，标准模型中一代费米子（包含右旋中微子）可由五个比特标记，这种组合结构与反常抵消紧密相关。研究精确阐释了反常抵消是三次形式的消失，这是三正交码的定义性质，而三正交码是魔术态蒸馏背后的量子纠错码。移除右旋中微子后，对于每个素数p，包括p=2时的Bravyi-Kitaev码，都得到了一个[[15,1,3]]ₚ码，对于三态量子比特，它是唯一的距离为三的最短三正交码。
authors: Shiroman Prakash, K. L. Ramya

articles.title: Quantum Systems as results of Geometric Evolutions
articles.title_zh: 作为几何演化结果的量子系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:math-ph/0506038v6 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In the framework of deterministic finslerian models, a mechanism producing dissipative dynamics at the Planck scale is discussed. It is based on a geometric evolution from Finsler to Riemann structures defined on the fiber bundle  TM→  M. Quantum states are equivalence classes, composed by the configurations that evolve through an internal dynamics drive by the above geometric evolution. Each equivalence class is conformed by the ontological states that evolve to the same final state. The existence of an hermitian scalar product in an associated linear space is discussed and related with the quantum pre-Hilbert space. This hermitian product emerges from geometric and statistical considerations. Our scheme recovers the main ingredients of the usual Quantum Mechanics. Several consequences are discussed and compared with the predictions of the standard Quantum Mechanics. A natural solution of the cosmological constant problems is proposed, as well as a mechanism for the absence of quantum interferences at classical scales.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在确定性芬斯勒模型框架下，探讨了一种在普朗克尺度产生耗散动力学的机制，其基于纤维丛上从芬斯勒到黎曼结构的几何演化。量子态被定义为等价类，由通过内部几何演化到相同最终状态的构型组成。研究讨论了相关线性空间中厄米标量积的存在性，并将其与量子预希尔伯特空间联系起来，该方案恢复了传统量子力学的主要要素，并提出了宇宙学常数问题的自然解决方案以及经典尺度下量子干涉缺失的机制。
authors: Ricardo Gallego Torrome

articles.title: Heisenberg-limited metrology from the quantum-quench dynamics of an anisotropic ferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 各向异性铁磁体量子猝灭动力学中的海森堡极限计量学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.23606v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The emerging field of quantum magnonics seeks to understand and harness the quantum properties of magnons -- quantized collective spin excitations in magnets. Squeezed magnon states arise naturally as the equilibrium ground states of anisotropic ferromagnets and antiferromagnets, representing an important class of nonclassical magnon states. In this work, we show how a qubit-conditioned quantum quench of an anisotropic ferromagnet can be used for Heisenberg-limited parameter estimation based on measurements of the qubit only. In the presence of ground-state squeezing, the protocol yields information about the eigenmode frequency of the coupled magnon-qubit system, whereas no information is gained in the absence of such squeezing. The protocol therefore leverages genuine quantum correlations in the form of magnonic squeezing while simultaneously relying on the equilibrium character of this squeezing -- a feature distinctive to magnetic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了如何利用各向异性铁磁体的量子猝灭动力学，通过仅测量量子比特来实现海森堡极限的参数估计。在基态压缩存在的情况下，该协议能够提供关于耦合磁振子-量子比特系统本征模频率的信息，而在没有压缩时则无法获得。该协议利用了磁振子压缩形式的真实量子关联，同时依赖于这种压缩的平衡特性，这是磁性系统的一个独特特征。
authors: Z. M. McIntyre, Ji Zou, Jelena Klinovaja, Daniel Loss

articles.title: Geometric Optimization over Quantum State Spaces: Tight Uncertainty Relations and Resource Certification
articles.title_zh: 量子态空间上的几何优化：紧致不确定性关系与资源认证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.00595v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Determining the fundamental limits of nonlinear functionals of quantum measurement statistics is a crucial yet generally intractable nonconvex optimization problem. We introduce a generic support-function-based outer-approximation framework for solving concave-minimization (or convex-maximization) problems over the quantum state space. By mapping the problem onto a reduced Z space, we characterize the exact quantum boundary through supporting half space derived from the largest eigenvalues of effective observables. This yields an effective method that produces tight bounds for general measurements in finite-dimensional quantum systems with preassigned numerical precision. As an initial application, we recover the exact variance-based uncertainty relations of [PRL 119, 170404 (2017)] and efficiently compute optimal entropic uncertainty relations (EURs). Our results reveal that standard analytical and majorization-based EUR bounds are fundamentally loose for generic measurements, and we show that the resulting exact bounds directly enhance quantum steering detection under asymmetric settings. We further apply the framework to determine the maximal athermality resource certifiable from a restricted measurement scenario. Our method thus provides a universal computational tool for exploring the boundaries of quantum state space and the limits of quantum resources.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于支撑函数的通用外逼近框架，用于解决量子态空间上的凹最小化（或凸最大化）问题。通过将问题映射到约化的Z空间，研究利用有效可观测量的最大特征值导出的支撑半空间来刻画精确的量子边界。该方法能为有限维量子系统中的一般测量提供具有预设数值精度的紧致界限，并应用于恢复精确的基于方差的不确定性关系和高效计算最优熵不确定性关系，揭示了标准分析和基于主化的熵不确定性关系界限对于一般测量而言存在根本性松弛。
authors: Ma-Cheng Yang, Cong-Feng Qiao

articles.title: Contractivity of time-dependent driven-dissipative systems
articles.title_zh: 时变驱动耗散系统的收缩性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.16067v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Experimentally relevant quantum systems are frequently described by a time-dependent Lindblad master equation in which the dissipation due to interaction with an environment is fixed, but the experimenter has control over the Hamiltonian, which therefore can change with time. A fundamental question that is also of practical relevance is to determine when such systems invariably lose information about their initial state (are exponentially contractive independent of the Hamiltonian) or when the control can be used to prevent this loss of information to some degree. Here, we identify the necessary and sufficient criterion on the dissipator for Hamiltonian-invariant contractivity. If the dissipator does not fulfil this criterion, but by itself is exponentially contractive, we also establish exponential contractivity for sufficiently weak or slow drives and construct examples where strong or fast driving prevents exponential contraction.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了由时变Lindblad主方程描述的量子系统的收缩性问题，旨在确定系统何时不可避免地丢失初始态信息，以及哈密顿量控制能否阻止这种信息损失。研究识别了耗散器满足哈密顿量不变收缩性的充要条件。如果耗散器不满足此条件但本身呈指数收缩，则对于足够弱或慢的驱动，系统仍呈指数收缩，但强或快的驱动可能阻止指数收缩。
authors: Lasse H. Wolff, Daniel Malz, Rahul Trivedi

articles.title: Clock-transition-enabled long electron spin coherence of telecom emitters in CeO₂
articles.title_zh: CeO₂中电信波段发射体的时钟跃迁实现长电子自旋相干性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.07332v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Rare-earth-ion-doped crystals has emerged as a promising platform for quantum technologies, owing to their narrow telecom-band optical emission, long spin memory, and compatibility with silicon integrated photonic architectures. However, the realization of scalable quantum devices requires host materials with intrinsically dilute spin environments to suppress decoherence. In this context, erbium (Er³⁺) doped cerium oxide (CeO₂₎ is an attractive candidate due to the ultra-low concentration of nuclear spins in the host matrix and its compatibility with silicon-based technologies. Here we perform a comprehensive investigation of the coherence properties of Er³⁺ electron spin qubit in CeO₂ via semiclassical as well as detailed cluster correlation expansion simulations. By systematically exploring magnetic field strength, pulse sequences, erbium concentration, and spin temperature, we identify regimes where decoherence from the spin bath is strongly suppressed. Our investigations illustrate that at dilute doping concentration (of the order of 10 ppb) and sub-Kelvin temperatures, operation near clock transitions enables Hahn-echo coherence times to approach the second timescale even at natural isotopic abundance. Importantly, from a practical standpoint, coherence times on the order of sim 10 ms are expected even at liquid helium temperature (about 2 K) for similar concentrations. Moreover, we demonstrate that an additional enhancement can be obtained with conventional multi-π-pulse dynamical decoupling protocols. Thus, our findings establish Er³⁺ doped CeO₂ as a front-runner for realizing spin qubits, quantum memories, and integrated quantum networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文全面研究了掺铒（Er³⁺）二氧化铈（CeO₂）中Er³⁺电子自旋量子比特的相干特性。通过半经典和详细的簇关联展开模拟，系统地探索了磁场强度、脉冲序列、铒浓度和自旋温度等参数。研究发现，在稀释掺杂浓度（约10 ppb）和亚开尔文温度下，在时钟跃迁附近操作可以显著抑制自旋浴引起的退相干，从而实现长Hahn-echo相干时间。
authors: Basanta Mistri, Vishal Ranjan, Siddharth Dhomkar

articles.title: Optimal Calibration of Quantum Network Links
articles.title_zh: 量子网络链路的最优校准
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.18167v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The reliable distribution of entanglement is essential for the effective operation of quantum networks. Due to fundamental differences between quantum and classical communication systems, it is necessary to develop specialised algorithms and protocols that also account for quantum-specific constraints. In this work, we focus on the issue of recalibration. As suggested by recent experimental studies, the process of local entanglement generation in a quantum link degrades over time due to environmental changes that have to be estimated and compensated via a fixed-duration calibration operation, during which the link is not available. Therefore, in such a quantum network, every link alternates between an activation period, during which it operates normally, and a calibration period, during which it cannot participate in the end-to-end entanglement distribution, thereby creating a trade-off between link quality (the initial fidelity of generated pairs, which decays during activation) and availability (the fraction of time the link is usable, which calibration reduces). We develop analytically a protocol for optimally assigning activation periods to each link in linear quantum repeater chains, subject to any general end-to-end fidelity requirements and local initial fidelity thresholds. Building on this foundation, we extend to general quantum networks, where multiple paths may cross at common links. To this, we propose a heuristic approach, evaluate it through simulations, and compare its performance with a benchmark, a numerical approach and theoretical bounds, confirming the analytical ordering of their performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文关注量子网络中链路的重新校准问题，该问题源于环境变化导致局部纠缠生成过程随时间退化。由于校准操作会使链路暂时不可用，因此在链路质量（纠缠对的初始保真度）和可用性（链路可用的时间比例）之间存在权衡。研究分析性地开发了一种协议，用于最优地分配激活和校准周期，以平衡这些因素，从而确保量子网络的可靠运行。
authors: Vinay Kumar, Claudio Cicconetti, Marco Conti, Andrea Passarella

articles.title: Separability rigidity of Gaussian states under positive domination
articles.title_zh: 高斯态在正支配下的可分离性刚性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.36336v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We prove a separability rigidity theorem for finite-mode Gaussian states. Let h̊o_G be Gaussian and let mathcal I be a fixed partition of the modes. If h̊o_G dominates a nonzero positive operator T that is separable across mathcal I, 0≠ Tpreccurlyeq h̊o_G, then h̊o_G itself is separable across mathcal I. The dominated operator is arbitrary and need not be Gaussian. The theorem has three applications. First, any Gaussian channel admitting a nonzero entanglement-breaking completely positive subchannel is itself entanglement breaking, even when that subchannel is non-Gaussian. Second, if a resource state dominates a positive multiple of a faithful separable state, no finite-copy, postselected separability-preserving protocol can prepare an entangled Gaussian state exactly with nonzero success probability. Third, a connected graph of entangled Gaussian two-mode marginals certifies genuine multipartite entanglement of every compatible global state, even if the global state is non-Gaussian; the certification is robust to sufficiently small trace-norm errors in the marginals. As a structural corollary, mixing states separable across different partitions cannot produce new Gaussian states, so full inseparability and genuine multipartite entanglement coincide for finite-mode Gaussian states and identical copies of a biseparable Gaussian state cannot activate genuine multipartite entanglement.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了有限模高斯态的可分离性刚性定理：如果一个高斯态支配一个非零且在给定模式划分下可分离的正算符，那么该高斯态本身在该划分下也是可分离的。该定理有三个主要应用，包括证明任何包含非零纠缠破坏子信道的高斯信道本身也是纠缠破坏的。此外，该定理还表明，纠缠高斯双模边缘态的连通图可以证明任何兼容全局态的真实多体纠缠。
authors: Evgeny Shchukin, Peter van Loock

articles.title: Quantum Superposition Principle and Geometry
articles.title_zh: 量子叠加原理与几何学
articles.abstract: arXiv:quant-ph/0407242v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: If one takes seriously the postulate of quantum mechanics in which physical states are rays in the standard Hilbert space of the theory, one is naturally lead to a geometric formulation of the theory. Within this formulation of quantum mechanics, the resulting description is very elegant from the geometrical viewpoint, since it allows to cast the main postulates of the theory in terms of two geometric structures, namely a symplectic structure and a Riemannian metric. However, the usual superposition principle of quantum mechanics is not naturally incorporated, since the quantum state space is non-linear. In this note we offer some steps to incorporate the superposition principle within the geometric description. In this respect, we argue that it is necessary to make the distinction between a 'projective superposition principle' and a 'decomposition principle' that extend the standard superposition principle. We illustrate our proposal with two very well known examples, namely the spin 1/2 system and the two slit experiment, where the distinction is clear from the physical perspective. We show that the two principles have also a different mathematical origin within the geometrical formulation of the theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了将量子力学的叠加原理纳入其几何表述的方法。尽管量子态空间是非线性的，导致标准叠加原理难以自然融入，但作者提出区分“射影叠加原理”和“分解原理”以扩展标准叠加原理。通过自旋1/2系统和双缝实验的例子，该工作阐明了这些新原理的物理意义，并为量子力学的几何描述提供了更完整的框架。
authors: Alejandro Corichi

articles.title: Dark Subspaces and Invariant Measures of Quantum Trajectories
articles.title_zh: 量子轨迹的暗子空间与不变测度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2409.18655v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum trajectories are Markov processes describing the evolution of a quantum system subject to indirect measurements. They can be viewed as place dependent iterated function systems or the result of products of dependent and non identically distributed random matrices. In this article, we establish a complete classification of their invariant measures. The classification is done in two steps. First, we prove a Markov process on some linear subspaces called dark subspaces, defined in (Maassen, Kümmerer 2006), admits a unique invariant measure. Second, we study the process inside the dark subspaces. Using a notion of minimal family of isometries from a reference space to dark subspaces, we prove a set of measures indexed by orbits of a unitary group is the set of ergodic measures of quantum trajectories.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对描述量子系统演化的马尔可夫过程——量子轨迹的不变测度进行了完整分类。研究分两步进行：首先，证明了在暗子空间上定义的马尔可夫过程存在唯一不变测度。其次，通过引入从参考空间到暗子空间的最小等距族概念，证明了由酉群轨道索引的一组测度构成了量子轨迹的遍历测度集。
authors: Tristan Benoist, Clément Pellegrini, Anna Szczepanek

articles.title: Molecule-by-molecule nanoresolved picosecond Purcell-enhanced emission at room-temperature in hollow plasmonic nanocone metamaterials
articles.title_zh: 空心等离子体纳米锥超材料中室温下逐分子纳米分辨皮秒Purcell增强发射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.15095v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Nanoscale variations in the electromagnetic environment strongly influence quantum emission processes, yet direct quantitative visualization of these effects at the single-emitter level remains challenging. By combining single-molecule super-resolution microscopy with time-correlated single-photon counting (TCSPC), we read the local electromagnetic environment of each molecule from its position and its excited-state lifetime. Using wafer-scale arrays of hollow plasmonic nanocones, we map position-dependent variations in the local density of optical states (LDOS) along the nanocone axis. We observe pronounced LDOS gradients that evidence a shortening of the fluorescence lifetime from nanoseconds to few picoseconds. The measured decay rates along the nanocone axis with maximum value at the top ring, yielding a total spontaneous-emission rate enhancement of more than two orders of magnitude at the single-molecule level, reaching an enhancement of the total spontaneous-emission rate of up to two orders of magnitude at the single-molecule level, in agreement with numerical simulations. These results provide direct experimental access to three-dimensional electromagnetic landscapes and establish a non-perturbative platform for quantitative molecular nanosensing in complex photonic architectures. The approach opens new opportunities for engineered room-temperature photon sources, vectorial field sensing, and scalable integrated nanophotonic technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文结合单分子超分辨显微镜和时间相关单光子计数技术，在室温下实现了对空心等离子体纳米锥超材料中单分子Purcell增强发射的纳米分辨研究。通过绘制沿纳米锥轴线的光学态局域密度（LDOS）变化，观察到显著的LDOS梯度，导致荧光寿命从纳秒缩短至皮秒。实验结果显示，在单分子水平上，总自发发射速率增强超过两个数量级，与数值模拟结果一致，为理解纳米尺度电磁环境对量子发射过程的影响提供了直接实验证据。
authors: R. Margoth Córdova-Castro, Dirk Jonker, Clément Cabriel, Mario Zapata-Herrera, Bart van Dam, Yannick De Wilde, Robert W. Boyd, Arturo Susarrey-Arce, Ignacio Izeddin, Valentina Krachmalnicoff

articles.title: Entanglement and apparent thermality in simulated black holes
articles.title_zh: 模拟黑洞中的纠缠与表观热性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.22774v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We investigate the apparent thermality of Hawking radiation in the semi-classical limit of quantum black holes using the mean-field limit of a chiral spin-chain simulator, which models fermions propagating on a black hole space-time in the continuum. In this free-theory regime, no genuine thermalisation occurs. Nevertheless, we show that a bipartition across the event horizon yields a reduced density matrix whose mode occupations follow an apparent thermal Fermi-Dirac distribution. In contrast, partitions away from the horizon do not exhibit such thermal distributions, reflecting the absence of thermal behaviour. Our results demonstrate that Hawking radiation appears thermal only with respect to horizon bipartitions in free theories, with genuine thermal behaviour expected to emerge only in the presence of strong interactions deep in the black hole interior, a study of which we leave for future work.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用手性自旋链模拟器研究了量子黑洞半经典极限下霍金辐射的表观热性。在自由理论体系中，尽管没有真正的热化发生，但跨越事件视界进行二分时，约化密度矩阵的模式占据遵循表观热费米-狄拉克分布。研究表明，霍金辐射仅在对视界进行二分时才呈现热性，而真正的热行为预计只会在黑洞内部深处的强相互作用下出现。
authors: Iason A. Sofos, Andrew Hallam, Jiannis K. Pachos

articles.title: Fluctuation-Induced Supersolidity at the Superfluid-Solid Interface
articles.title_zh: 超流体-固体界面处的涨落诱导超固态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.08739v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Supersolidity, combining superfluid and crystalline orders, has been realized in dipolar Bose-Einstein condensates by tuning interatomic interactions. Here we show that supersolidity can also emerge from mode coupling at a superfluid-solid interface, without modifying bulk interactions and for a broad class of superfluids. Using an analytical and numerical treatment of the coupled superfluid and phonon fields, we derive the criterion for a density-modulation instability driven by interfacial coupling and dependent on dimensionality. In superfluid helium, the instability first appears at the roton mode, while in a Bose-Einstein condensate with contact interactions it occurs at the lowest accessible wave vector set by the system size. Beyond the threshold, the ground state acquires an interfacial density modulation while the bulk remains superfluid, forming a hybrid superfluid-supersolid phase. Our results identify interfacial mode coupling as a promising route to supersolidity, enabling the simultaneous exploitation of interfacial supersolid and bulk superfluid quantum properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出超固态可以在超流体-固体界面处通过模式耦合而产生，无需改变体相互作用。通过对耦合超流体和声子场的分析与数值处理，推导出了由界面耦合驱动的密度调制不稳定性的判据。研究表明，在超流氦中，不稳定性首先出现在旋子模式，而在具有接触相互作用的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中，则出现在由系统尺寸决定的最低可达波矢处。这种机制为实现超固态提供了一条新途径，可同时利用界面超固态和体超流体的量子特性。
authors: Baptiste Coquinot, Ragheed Alhyder, Alberto Cappellaro, Mikhail Lemeshko

articles.title: Emergent chiral Higgs mode in π-flux frustrated lattices
articles.title_zh: π-通量受挫晶格中的涌现手性希格斯模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.08925v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Neutral-atom quantum simulators provide a powerful platform for realizing strongly correlated phases, enabling access to dynamical signatures of quasiparticles and symmetry breaking processes. Motivated by recent observations of quantum phases in flux-frustrated ladders with non-vanishing ground state currents, we investigate interacting bosons on the dimerized BBH lattice in two dimensions-originally introduced in the context of higher-order topology. After mapping out the phase diagram, which includes vortex superfluid (V-SF), vortex Mott insulator (V-MI), and featureless Mott insulator (MI) phases, we focus on the integer filling case. There, the MI/V-SF transition simultaneously breaks the mathbb Z₂T and U(1) symmetries, where mathbb Z₂T corresponds to time-reversal symmetry (TRS).
