Using a slave-boson description, we resolve the excitation spectrum across the transition and uncover a chiral Higgs mode whose mass softens at criticality, providing a dynamical hallmark of emergent chirality that manifests via the oscillation of the loop currents in quench dynamics. Our results establish an experimentally realistic setting for probing unconventional TRS-broken phases and quasiparticles with intrinsic chirality in strongly interacting quantum matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了二维二聚化BBH晶格上相互作用玻色子的量子相，并绘制了包含涡旋超流体、涡旋莫特绝缘体和无特征莫特绝缘体相的相图。在整数填充情况下，莫特绝缘体/涡旋超流体转变同时打破了时间反演对称性和U(1)对称性。通过奴役玻色子描述，作者揭示了一个手性希格斯模式，其质量在临界点处变软，为涌现手性提供了一个动力学标志，通过淬火动力学中环电流的振荡来体现。
authors: Maria Lanaro, Lorenzo Maffi, Marco Di Liberto

articles.title: Is a covariant virtual tachyon viable?
articles.title_zh: 协变虚超光速粒子是否可行？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.20474v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Sidney Coleman has noted that superluminal particles or observers would be able to go back in time and have no definite trajectory according to subluminal observers, while not violating Lorentz invariance [1]. Recently, Dragan and Ekert have significantly developed similar ideas even further, which lead to formulation of ``quantum principle of relativity'' that intimately links the two theories [2]. However, field theory descriptions of an on-shell tachyon, described by scalar field φ with negative mass squared parameter, lead to violation of basic principles of relativity or quantum mechanics. In this work, we investigate whether purely virtual tachyons can be consistent within the fakeon framework--the only known viable formulation of purely virtual particles. We show that the supports of the real part of the tachyon Feynman propagator, which is also the principal-value propagator (PVP), and the Wheeler propagator intersect only on the light cone. We show that PVP cannot be time-ordered two-point function of a local Hermitian field, excluding the direct extension of the canonical formalism to free fakeon tachyon. Finally, with an imposed tachyonic PVP, interactions with electrons generate composition-dependent accelerations that violate the weak equivalence principle, and we provide a quantitative bound on this scenario. Our analysis identifies obstacles to formulating covariant quantum field theory of interacting virtual tachyon.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在假子（fakeon）框架内，纯虚超光速粒子是否能与相对论和量子力学基本原理保持一致。尽管在壳超光速粒子会导致基本原理的违反，但研究发现超光速粒子费曼传播子实部（即主值传播子PVP）和惠勒传播子的支持集仅在光锥上相交。此外，PVP不能作为局域厄米场的时间序两点函数，排除了将正则形式直接扩展到自由假子超光速粒子的可能性。
authors: Krzysztof Jodłowski

articles.title: A closed system setting for quantum thermalisation in free fermions
articles.title_zh: 自由费米子量子热化与闭合系统设置
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06362v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study thermalisation and the possible occurrence of the Mpemba effect in a closed quantum setting that mimics the interaction of a system with thermal reservoirs coupled only at its boundaries. Specifically, we consider a tripartite geometry in which a finite chain, initially prepared at a finite temperature, is suddenly connected on both sides to two semi-infinite chains of the same nature held at a different temperature. These outer chains act as thermal baths, while the full system evolves unitarily under a homogeneous Hamiltonian. This setup provides a simple quantum realisation of a temperature quench and closely resembles the original scenario in which the classical Mpemba effect was first observed. We focus on two paradigmatic free-fermion models, the XX chain and the transverse-field Ising chain, which respectively preserve and break the global U(1) particle-number symmetry. As a probe of relaxation, we consider the Frobenius distance between the time-evolved reduced density matrix of the central subsystem and its stationary state, which is the thermal state at the bath temperature. Exploiting the free-fermionic structure of both models, the dynamics remains Gaussian and the Frobenius distance can be expressed exactly in terms of two-point correlation functions. Combining this representation with generalised hydrodynamics, we derive analytical predictions for the Frobenius distance in the hydrodynamic limit, providing a complete characterisation of the thermalisation process. Using these results, we investigate the possible occurrence of the Mpemba effect. We find that, despite the genuine non-equilibrium dynamics displayed by the system, no Mpemba effect arises in this setting. Our analysis identifies a broad class of boundary-driven thermalisation protocols in which relaxation is fully characterised analytically and exhibits no anomalous acceleration of equilibration.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在一个模拟系统与边界热浴相互作用的闭合量子设置中，研究了自由费米子的热化过程以及Mpemba效应的可能性。通过将一个有限链突然连接到两个不同温度的半无限链，构建了一个简单的量子温度骤冷场景。研究以XX链和横场伊辛链为例，利用中心子系统时间演化约化密度矩阵与其稳态之间的Frobenius距离作为弛豫探针，探讨了这些模型中的热化行为。
authors: Purvaash Panduranghan-Udhayashankar, Filiberto Ares, Pasquale Calabrese

articles.title: Quantum models with the Yang-Lee phase transition
articles.title_zh: 具有杨-李相变的量子模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.19732v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this article, we present four different 1+1D quantum models that realize the Yang-Lee (YL) phase transition under a deformation that preserves PT symmetry. These are the antiferromagnetic Ising spin chain in transverse and longitudinal magnetic fields, the massive Schwinger model, the Blume-Capel model, and the three-state quantum clock model. Using the state-operator correspondence, we identify the YL critical point, compute the scaling dimensions of the lowest operators in each model, and find perfect agreement with the exact results for the YL criticality in two dimensions. Using bosonization for the Schwinger model and the Polyakov-Hubbard transformation for the other models, we show that in all of these quantum models the YL critical point is described, as expected, by a massless bosonic field with an i φ³ interaction. In the quantum clock model, this critical field interacts with a massive bosonic field, and we identify the massless and massive states in the Hamiltonian spectrum. In addition, we numerically compute the two-point function of φ at the Yang-Lee critical point and show that it grows with distance, in agreement with theoretical expectations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了四种在PT对称变形下实现杨-李（YL）相变的1+1维量子模型，包括反铁磁伊辛自旋链、有质量Schwinger模型、Blume-Capel模型和三态量子钟模型。通过态-算符对应，作者识别了YL临界点并计算了最低算符的标度维度，与二维YL临界性的精确结果吻合。研究表明，所有这些模型的YL临界点都由一个具有iφ³相互作用的无质量玻色子场描述。
authors: Erick Arguello Cruz, Grigory Tarnopolsky

articles.title: Transport in multilayer graphene: resistance from stacking faults
articles.title_zh: 多层石墨烯中的输运：堆垛层错引起的电阻
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20713v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multilayer graphene exhibits rich possibilities for stacking. While natural bulk graphite predominantly occurs in the Bernal structure, where layers are stacked in an -ABAB- pattern, rhombohedral stacking has sprung to prominence recently. It is well known that Bernal graphite exhibits anisotropic transport, with high resistance to currents along the stacking axis. Careful experiments using pillar geometries have measured out-of-plane resistance, attributing it to stacking faults where planes slip out of the nominal ABAB sequence. The observed resistance shows anomalously large, non-Gaussian, sample-to-sample variations. In this article, we build a theoretical framework to calculate c-axis resistance of graphene stacks with an arbitrary stacking arrangement. Our approach builds on the idea that, regardless of stacking sequence, we have in-plane translational symmetry. With in-plane momentum as a good quantum number, c-axis transport reduces to an effectively one-dimensional problem that can be addressed using the Landauer paradigm. We calculate the resistances of a variety of simple stacking faults in both Bernal and rhombohedral systems. We also calculate the resistance of a rhombohedral 'slab' embedded between Bernal leads. Remarkably, despite both Bernal and rhombohedral graphite being metallic, the system exhibits insulating behaviour. We attribute this to Fermi surface mismatch. We next calculate the resistance of a multilayer sample with stacking disorder. Resistance is non-self-averaging, akin to a one-dimensional wire where disorder has a strong localizing effect. The median resistance grows exponentially with stack size, indicating insulating character driven by localization. Our results demonstrate that transport measurements on mesoscopic graphitic pillars serve as signatures of stacking faults, and in particular, probe localization-driven physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了一个理论框架，用于计算具有任意堆垛排列的多层石墨烯的c轴电阻。该方法基于面内平移对称性，将c轴输运简化为一维问题，并利用Landauer范式进行处理。研究计算了伯纳尔和菱方结构中多种简单堆垛层错的电阻，旨在解释实验中观察到的异常大且非高斯分布的样品间电阻变化。
authors: C. M. Wilson, R. Ganesh, K. V. Samokhin

articles.title: All-temperature superfluidity in two dimensions
articles.title_zh: 二维空间中的全温度超流性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20717v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In local theories with short-range interactions, continuous symmetries cannot be spontaneously broken in two spatial dimensions at nonzero temperature. U(1)-symmetric models instead admit a Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless (BKT) phase with quasi-long-range order and nonzero phase stiffness, which is normally destroyed at high temperatures by vortex proliferation. Here, we show that a BKT phase, and with it superfluidity, can persist to arbitrarily high temperatures. Using the large-N expansion, we study a (2+1)-dimensional quantum field theory in which a complex scalar is coupled to the critical O(N) model. At the biconical fixed point, where the inter-sector coupling is negative, the thermal effective potential has a circle of minima with nonzero U(1) amplitude. Integrating out the gapped fluctuations yields an effective theory for the compact phase mode at distances large compared to 1/T. Since temperature is the only scale at the fixed point, the phase stiffness grows linearly with temperature, with a proportionality factor that scales linearly with N and is fixed entirely by the fixed point. This renders vortex operators irrelevant for sufficiently large N. We further show that the vortex fugacity is exponentially small in N.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了二维空间中超流性在任意高温下持续存在的可能性。通过大N展开法，研究了一个(2+1)维量子场论，其中一个复标量场与临界O(N)模型耦合。在双锥固定点处，相刚度随温度线性增长，且与N线性相关，这使得涡旋算符变得无关紧要。这一发现表明，Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) 相及其超流性可以在二维空间中保持到任意高的温度。
authors: Bilal Hawashin, Soumyadeep Chaudhuri, Igor F. Herbut, Michael M. Scherer

articles.title: Quantum oscillations in a solvable model of a Kondo insulator
articles.title_zh: Kondo绝缘体可解模型中的量子振荡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20734v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the effects of interactions on the low-energy density of states (SdH) and magnetization (dHvA) quantum oscillations (QOs) in a Kondo insulator. Toward this end we introduce a generalization of the periodic Anderson model with Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) interactions at each site that is exactly solvable in the large-N limit, where N is the number of flavors of the heavy f electrons. We show analytically and numerically that the insulating state remains stable in terms of spectrum, thermodynamics, and transport at low temperatures even for interaction strengths much larger than non-interacting band gap of the hybridization-gap insulator. We analytically derive generalizations of Lifshitz-Kosevich (LK) formulae, distinct for the SdH and dHvA QOs, for the interacting insulator. We find that the SdH oscillation frequencies, F₀± δ F, corresponding to the conduction and valence band edges, can be weakly renormalized by interaction relative to their non-interacting values. In contrast, dHvA QO frequency F₀ is not renormalized by interactions, and remains the same as that for the non-interacting unhybridized bands. The QO amplitudes show a remarkable difference: the dHvA amplitude is essentially unaffected by interactions, while the SdH amplitude is strongly enhanced due to gap renormalization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨了相互作用对Kondo绝缘体中低能态密度（SdH）和磁化（dHvA）量子振荡的影响。通过引入一个在Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev（SYK）相互作用下可精确求解的周期性安德森模型，作者发现绝缘态在强相互作用下仍保持稳定。研究导出了相互作用绝缘体的Lifshitz-Kosevich公式的推广形式，并发现SdH振荡频率受相互作用的轻微重整化，而dHvA振荡频率则不受影响。
authors: Abhisek Samanta, Mohit Randeria, Sumilan Banerjee

articles.title: Modified anisotropy and distinct phase diagrams in the nearly isotropic S=1 triangular-lattice antiferromagnet Rb₂Ni(SeO₃₎₂
articles.title_zh: 近各向同性S=1三角晶格反铁磁体Rb₂Ni(SeO₃₎₂中修饰的各向异性和独特的相图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21154v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The triangular-lattice antiferromagnet serves as a benchmark platform for realizing exotic quantum phases, in which magnetic anisotropy plays an essential role. In this work, we report modified magnetic anisotropy and phase diagrams in the nearly isotropic S=1 triangular-lattice antiferromagnet Rb₂Ni(SeO₃₎₂, compared with those of its isostructural analog K₂Ni(SeO₃₎₂. The magnetic susceptibility of Rb₂Ni(SeO₃₎₂ exhibits an easy-axis anisotropy with g_c > gₐb, opposite to the easy-plane anisotropy observed in K₂Ni(SeO₃₎₂. The single Néel transition observed at zero field splits into two transitions at around 10~T, and a magnetization plateau is observed between 21~T and 37~T for both out-of-plane (Hparallel c) and in-plane (Hparallel ab) field directions in Rb₂Ni(SeO₃₎₂. We construct magnetic phase diagrams that are distinct between Rb₂Ni(SeO₃₎₂ and K₂Ni(SeO₃₎₂. These findings highlight the sensitivity of field-induced magnetic phase behavior to anisotropy in nearly isotropic triangular-lattice antiferromagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究报告了近各向同性S=1三角晶格反铁磁体Rb₂Ni(SeO₃₎₂中磁各向异性和相图的显著变化，与同构类似物K₂Ni(SeO₃₎₂形成对比。Rb₂Ni(SeO₃₎₂表现出易轴各向异性，并在磁场下观察到奈尔转变分裂和磁化平台。研究构建了与K₂Ni(SeO₃₎₂不同的磁相图，强调了场致磁相行为对各向异性的敏感性。
authors: Xuejuan Gui, Xu-Guang Zhou, Chen Zhang, Zhongcen Sun, Yuan Sun, Chenglin Shang, Akira Matsuo, Yasuhiro H. Matsuda, Koichi Kindo, Henrik M. Rønnow, Weiqiang Yu, Rong Yu, Peng Cheng, Juanjuan Liu, Jieming Sheng, Jinchen Wang

articles.title: Plasmon Collapse in a Directional Strange Metal
articles.title_zh: 定向奇异金属中的等离激元坍缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21209v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strange metals are widespread in strongly correlated quantum matter and closely intertwined with high-temperature superconductivity and quantum criticality, yet their microscopic charge dynamics remain fundamentally unresolved. Whether well-defined collective modes survive in an incoherent electronic fluid or dissolve into overdamped continua remains intensely debated. Here, employing high-momentum-resolution inelastic electron scattering complemented by direction-resolved transport, we show that the van der Waals compound MoOCl₂, a "bad" metal known to host unusually "good" plasmons, exhibits a striking dichotomy in electronic coherence and charge dynamics. Transport reveals coherent Fermi liquid behavior along one in-plane crystallographic axis and an incoherent strange metal response along the orthogonal axis. This dichotomy extends directly to the charge response. The Fermi liquid direction supports a well-defined, long-lived plasmon, whereas the strange metal direction exhibits an overdamped excitation that progressively loses its collective character with increasing momentum. Beyond a critical momentum (q_c approx 0.008 mathringA⁻¹), the mode undergoes a reversal into negative dispersion and ultimately collapses into a broad, nearly featureless continuum with a robust high-energy boundary (E_c approx 1.75 eV). Remarkably, thickness-dependent measurements show that both q_c and E_c remain nearly unchanged despite substantial modifications of Coulomb screening, revealing them as intrinsic scales of incoherent charge density fluctuations. These results establish a unique single-material platform in which coherent and incoherent electronic states are partitioned into in-plane orthogonal channels, and demonstrate that incoherent electronic fluids retain intrinsically structured charge dynamics beyond the quasiparticle paradigm.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用高动量分辨非弹性电子散射和方向分辨输运，揭示了范德华化合物MoOCl₂中电子相干性和电荷动力学的显著二分性。沿一个晶轴表现出相干费米液体行为和明确的等离激元，而沿正交轴则呈现非相干奇异金属响应和过阻尼的等离激元激发。研究发现，奇异金属方向的等离激元在超过临界动量后逐渐失去其集体特性。
authors: Jiade Li, Peiyi He, Deng Hu, Jiakai Wang, Jifeng Shao, Wan-Shun Du, Xuetao Zhu, Jiandong Guo, Zhiwei Wang, Peng Gao

articles.title: Non-equilibrium Muon Dynamics Imitating Fractional Spin Excitations in a Quantum Spin Chain
articles.title_zh: 量子自旋链中模拟分数自旋激发的非平衡μ子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21523v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fractional spin excitations in low-dimensional and frustrated magnets are commonly associated with sporadic spin fluctuations, as observed in quantum spin liquids, spin ices, and other complex magnetic states. In this study, we investigate the spin dynamics in the amplitude-modulated magnetic ground state of AgCuVO₄, a spin-1/2 chain compound with competing intrachain interactions, by muon spectroscopy. Our data reveal a Gaussian decay of muon polarization that remains remarkably resilient against applied magnetic fields---a behavior often interpreted as evidence of emergent sporadic spin dynamics. However, density functional theory calculations of muon stopping sites and their quadrupolar level-crossing resonance spectra suggest an alternative mechanism: a two-state model where the muon randomly hops between two nearby sites, eventually equilibrating across both on a microsecond timescale via quantum delocalization. These findings provide a microscopic explanation for the field-resilient muon polarization and indicate that such behavior may not always stem from intrinsic spin fluctuations, but can also arise from non-equilibrium muon dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究通过μ子谱学探究了AgCuVO₄（一种具有竞争链内相互作用的自旋-1/2链化合物）的自旋动力学。实验数据显示μ子极化呈高斯衰减，且对磁场具有显著的韧性，这通常被解释为偶发自旋动力学的证据。然而，密度泛函理论计算提出了一种替代机制：μ子在两个近邻位点间随机跳跃，通过量子离域在微秒尺度上达到平衡。这些发现为场韧性μ子极化提供了微观解释，并表明此类行为可能并非总是源于内在自旋涨落。
authors: A. Hromov, A. Zorko, M. Gomilšek, P. J. Baker, A. Prokofiev, M. Pregelj

articles.title: Low magnon damping of a EuSe film down to millikelvin temperatures
articles.title_zh: EuSe薄膜在毫开尔文温度下的低磁振阻尼
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21733v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rapid development of quantum magnonics over the past decade has created a demand for magnetic materials that keep their magnon losses low at millikelvin temperatures and add functionality beyond that of the established iron garnets and ferromagnetic metals. The europium chalcogenides are natural candidates - they are magnetic semiconductors whose moment of 7,μB per Eu²⁺ ion stems from a half-filled 4f shell with zero orbital momentum, so that spin-orbit coupling and intrinsic damping are expected to be weak. Here we characterize an epitaxial film of the metamagnet EuSe on diamagnetic BaF₂ by magnetometry and broadband ferromagnetic resonance from 10 K down to 30 mK. EuSe combines a saturation magnetization of 1100 kA/m with antiferromagnetic, ferrimagnetic and ferromagnetic phases that are reached with fields below 0.25 T. In contrast to a Gilbert-damped ferromagnet, the linewidth of the field-aligned film decreases with increasing frequency and field, and below 750 mK it no longer depends on temperature. At 30 mK, 68 GHz and 1.8 T, it reaches 5.5 mT, close to the values of bulk single crystals, which corresponds to a magnon lifetime of 2 ns and to an upper bound of 1.1×10⁻³ for the Gilbert damping parameter. These properties make EuSe and the europium chalcogenides promising materials for hybrid quantum systems and quantum magnonics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究通过磁力测量和宽带铁磁共振，表征了外延EuSe薄膜在10 K至30 mK温度范围内的特性。EuSe薄膜在低磁场下展现出反铁磁、亚铁磁和铁磁相，并具有1100 kA/m的饱和磁化强度。研究发现，该薄膜的线宽随频率和磁场增加而减小，并在750 mK以下不再依赖温度，在30 mK时达到5.5 mT的低值，表明其具有极低的磁振阻尼。
authors: Rostyslav O. Serha, Jan Hofer, Khrystyna O. Levchenko, Andreas Ney, Sergej O. Demokritov, Gunther Springholz, Andrii V. Chumak

articles.title: Microwave spectroscopic evidence of a moiré-commensurate electron crystal in monolayer graphene
articles.title_zh: 单层石墨烯中莫尔-公度电子晶体的微波光谱证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21875v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We probe the conductivity of the lowest Landau level of a moiré-aligned monolayer graphene device by broadband microwave transmission through a coplanar waveguide (sim50 mK, 15.4--18 T), isolating the longitudinal channel through a low-minus-high frequency band difference D(ν). We resolve a series of minima in D(ν) that drift with field along lines of fixed carrier density rather than fixed Landau filling, the hallmark of moiré-commensurate electron crystals. The strongest minimum is present at every field and matches no fractional quantum Hall or integer Hofstadter state. It lies at band filling s=1/3, one electron for every three moiré cells---the generalized Wigner crystal that DaSilva, Jung, and MacDonald predict as the most favorable fixed-density (t=0) commensuration. The weaker minima fall near neighboring commensurate fillings.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究通过宽带微波传输探测了莫尔对齐单层石墨烯器件最低朗道能级的电导率。实验观察到一系列电导率最小值，这些最小值随磁场沿固定载流子密度线而非固定朗道填充因子线漂移，这正是莫尔-公度电子晶体的特征。最强的最小值出现在带填充s=1/3处，与预测的最有利的固定密度公度态相符，为莫尔-公度电子晶体的存在提供了微波光谱证据。
authors: A. Solodovnyk, P. Colgan, K. Watanabe, T. Taniguchi, L. W. Engel, S. Dietrich

articles.title: Spin-1/2 Heisenberg diamond-like decorated honeycomb lattice in a magnetic field from the perspective of localized magnons and exact diagonalization
articles.title_zh: 磁场中自旋-1/2海森堡金刚石状修饰蜂窝晶格的局域磁振子和精确对角化研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21955v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The spin-1/2 quantum Heisenberg model on the diamond-decorated honeycomb lattice in a magnetic field is investigated using complementary analytical and numerical methods. The ground-state phase diagram comprises Lieb-Mattis ferrimagnetic, dimer-tetramer, monomer-dimer, spin-canted, and saturated paramagnetic phases, giving rise to characteristic magnetization plateaus, continuous and discontinuous field-induced transitions. In the highly frustrated regime, a localized-magnon approach based on an effective classical lattice-gas model provides an accurate description of the low-temperature magnetism and thermodynamics in agreement with numerical results. At intermediate frustration, finite-temperature calculations reveal characteristic specific-heat signatures of the field-induced transitions including the development of Ising critical behavior at the field-induced transition between the monomer-dimer and Lieb-Mattis ferrimagnetic phase.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究结合解析和数值方法，探讨了磁场中金刚石状修饰蜂窝晶格上的自旋-1/2量子海森堡模型。基态相图包含多种磁相，并展现出特征性的磁化平台和场致相变。在高度受挫区域，局域磁振子方法能准确描述低温磁性和热力学性质。中等受挫区域的有限温度计算揭示了场致相变的特征比热信号，包括在单体-二聚体与Lieb-Mattis亚铁磁相变之间出现的伊辛临界行为。
authors: Katarina Karlova, Malo Rouxel, Jozef Strecka, Andreas Honecker

articles.title: A rigid commensurate host and a defect that switches: vacancies in the frustrated alternating spin-(1, 1/2) Heisenberg chain
articles.title_zh: 刚性公度主格与可切换缺陷：受挫交替自旋-(1, 1/2)海森堡链中的空位
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22140v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The alternating spin-(1,tfrac12) Heisenberg chain with a frustrating next-nearest-neighbor coupling J₂ loses its Lieb--Mattis moment through a discontinuous transition to a singlet whose nature was left open. Using an SU(2)-symmetric density-matrix renormalization group, in which the total spin is a quantum-number label, we identify that phase and follow a single vacancy through it. The total spin collapses directly from S=L/4 to S=0, with no partially polarized window. The singlet phase is critical: its singlet--triplet gap closes as 1/L, its entanglement entropy grows logarithmically with a central charge csimeq1.8, and its modulation wavevector, extrapolated from L=80 to 200, is commensurate at 3π/4 and independent of J₂ to 5×10⁻⁵. Removing the central S=1 site switches the ground state of the doped chain from a triplet to a singlet at J₂ast=0.3068(3), where the host shows no feature; the triplet is not bound to the vacancy but spread over one of the two segments it leaves. The transmission of correlations through the vacancy saturates at a finite value below J₂ast, T(infty)=0.102(15) and 0.036(9) at J₂₌₀.28 and 0.30, and the cut-chain law Tpropto L⁻¹ is excluded on both sides. We also show that the longitudinal correlator is not an observable in a triplet sector.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究利用SU(2)对称密度矩阵重整化群方法，探究了具有受挫次近邻耦合J₂的交替自旋-(1, 1/2)海森堡链中的空位效应。研究发现，该链通过不连续转变失去Lieb-Mattis矩，进入一个临界单重态，其总自旋从S=L/4直接坍缩到S=0。移除中心S=1位点会导致掺杂链的基态从三重态切换到单重态，且三重态并非束缚于空位。
authors: R. L. Silva, R. C. Silva, A. R. Pereira

articles.title: Local wave-packet spectroscopy of the Drude weight in Tomonaga-Luttinger liquids
articles.title_zh: Tomonaga-Luttinger液体中Drude权重的局域波包光谱学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22257v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate wave packets generated by a local pulse electric field in a Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid (TLL) with a U(1) charge q. Bosonization shows that a local pulse field creates two counterpropagating packets with opposite accumulated charges ± qK and velocity v, where K and v are the TLL parameter and velocity. The packet motion produces a linearly growing charge polarization P(t)=2 qDt in the conducting TLL at non-equilibrium, allowing the Drude weight D=vK to be extracted from real-time local dynamics. We test this local-packet description by time-dependent variational principle simulations of the spin-1/2 XXZ chain. The simulations visualize the density, current, energy, and entanglement profiles in the space-time plane and confirm the predicted packet charge and propagation velocity. We also show that excess energy and entanglement remaining near the pulse region are suppressed in the weak-pulse limit. Finally, the Drude weight obtained from the packet-induced polarization agrees with the exact Bethe-ansatz result, demonstrating local-packet spectroscopy of intrinsic transport in a TLL.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了局域脉冲电场在Tomonaga-Luttinger液体（TLL）中产生的波包。玻色化理论表明，脉冲场会产生两个带有相反累积电荷和速度的对向传播波包。这些波包的运动在非平衡态下产生线性增长的电荷极化，从而可以从实时局域动力学中提取Drude权重。通过对自旋-1/2 XXZ链的时间依赖变分原理模拟，验证了波包电荷和传播速度的预测，并证实了该方法能够准确测量TLL的Drude权重。
authors: Takayuki Yokoyama, Yasuhiro Tada

articles.title: Extended strange metal and superconductivity in partially filled moiré Hubbard bands
articles.title_zh: 部分填充莫尔Hubbard带中的扩展奇异金属和超导电性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22307v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Moiré semiconductors provide a physical realization of the Hubbard model. Bandwidth-tuned Mott transitions and complex phase diagrams mimicking those of high-temperature superconductors have been demonstrated near a weak Mott insulating state at half-band-filling. The platform also provides an opportunity to explore the physics of a partially filled Hubbard band at doping densities far away from the Mott insulator, a regime that has remained largely unexplored. Here we report the emergence of an extended strange metal (ESM), in both doping density and twist angle, in a partially filled Hubbard band of twisted bilayer WSe2. The ESM is in the clean limit, persists down to 100mK, and spans over multiple symmetry-breaking ground states; it also appears only at small twist angles, where electronic correlations are strong. These observations distinguish the state from the reported strange metals associated with quantum criticality and favor the viewpoint that it is an intrinsic state of matter. We also report the observation of a new superconducting dome being developed from the ESM but far away from both the Mott insulating state and the van Hove singularity of the material. Our work opens the door to exploring the new regime of partially filled Hubbard bands in the clean limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究报告了在扭曲双层WSe₂的部分填充Hubbard带中，发现了一种在掺杂密度和转角上都扩展的奇异金属（ESM）态。该ESM态在清洁极限下存在，并持续到100mK，横跨多个对称破缺基态，且仅在电子关联性强的较小转角下出现。这些发现表明ESM是一种本征物态，并且研究还观察到一个新的超导穹顶从ESM发展而来，但远离Mott绝缘态。
authors: Yiyu Xia, Yichi Zhang, Zhongdong Han, Hongyuan Li, Brandon Bauer, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Wenjin Zhao, Jie Shan, Kin Fai Mak

articles.title: Parafermions in polarized ν=2/3 Fractional Quantum (Anomalous) Hall Heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 极化ν=2/3分数量子（反常）霍尔异质结构中的准费米子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22348v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by recent experimental signatures of fractional Chern insulators in 2D quantum materials, we investigate the realization of mathbb Z₃ parafermion zero modes (PZMs) on edges of spin-polarized ν=2/3 fractional quantum Hall states which are proximitized by superconductors. Unlike the spin-unpolarized Halperin state, the polarized ν=2/3 edge contains counterpropagating electron and fractional quasihole modes, giving rise to a plethora of competing tunneling and pairing processes. We focus on the vicinity of the fixed point where these modes reorganize into decoupled charge and neutral sectors, with the neutral sector describing an emergent dipole degree of freedom. Using bosonization and renormalization group analysis, we lay out the parameter space in which the interedge dipole interactions gap the neutral sector to stabilize one dominant tunneling and one dominant pairing channel resulting in a double sine-Gordon model in the charge sector which supports Z₃ PZMs at domain walls. We discuss both clean and disordered systems. In clean systems this mechanism requires a certain degree of control of the interaction strength and range. In contrast, disorder can provide a more generic route: While short-ranged, edge-uncorrelated disorder % on the two edges suppresses the simultaneous pinning required for stable parafermion modes, when the disorder on the two edges is sufficiently correlated, as expected for smooth disorder potentials, the parameter regime hosting PZMs increases.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究受分数陈绝缘体实验迹象启发，探讨了在超导体近邻的自旋极化ν=2/3分数量子霍尔态边缘实现Z₃准费米子零模（PZMs）的可能性。研究发现，极化ν=2/3边缘包含对向传播的电子和分数准空穴模式，通过玻色化和重整化群分析，确定了在电荷扇区中支持Z₃ PZMs的参数空间。该机制在清洁系统中需要对相互作用强度进行一定程度的控制。
authors: Steffen Bollmann, Andreas Haller, Thomas L. Schmidt, Jukka I. Väyrynen, Elio J. König

articles.title: Dirac Representation for Lattice Spin Operators: Spin-1/2 and Spin-1 cases
articles.title_zh: 晶格自旋算符的狄拉克表示：自旋-1/2和自旋-1情况
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.11917v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce a quantum representation of lattice spin operators (LSOs) by mapping quantum spins to their classical analogues for spin values S=1/2 and S=1. The resulting Dirac (bra--ket) forms are derived from the structure of binary and ternary digit distributions in non-negative integers. o̧lorblue The construction requires only an enumeration of the lattice sites and is therefore independent on the spatial dimension and lattice geometry. o̧lorblack Analytical expressions for extracting the jth bit or trit of an integer without performing an explicit binary or ternary decomposition are obtained. o̧lorblueAs an application of the representation, o̧lorblack we analyze the one-dimensional spin-1/2 XXZ Heisenberg model with open boundaries in a magnetic field in both absence (uniform magnetic field) and presence of disorder (random magnetic field). In the absence of disorder (clean system), we demonstrate that the corresponding eigenvalue problem can be reduced to a tight-binding problem on a graph. For the isotropic case, this is solved analytically without resorting to any spinless transformation or the Bethe Ansatz. In the presence of disorder, a convergent perturbation theory is elaborated. Our analytical results are benchmarked against exact diagonalization for systems up to Kłeq 18 spins. These computations exploit the global U(1) symmetry to block-diagonalize the Hamiltonian and the spin-inversion symmetry to further decompose the zero-magnetization sector. Quantitative agreement between analytical and numerical results is observed.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种晶格自旋算符（LSOs）的量子表示方法，通过将量子自旋映射到其经典对应物，适用于S=1/2和S=1的自旋值。该构造仅需枚举晶格位点，与空间维度和晶格几何无关。作为应用，研究分析了磁场中一维自旋-1/2 XXZ海森堡模型，并展示了在无序情况下，相应的本征值问题可简化为图上的紧束缚问题，且在各向同性情况下可解析求解。
authors: Maseim Bassis Kenmoe

articles.title: Anomalous Thermal Conductivity Reversal Driven by a Fluctuating Charge Density Wave
articles.title_zh: 由涨落电荷密度波驱动的反常热导率反转
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.15915v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: For more than a century, the lattice thermal conductivity of crystalline solids has been known to decrease with increasing temperature, as the phonons that carry heat scatter more strongly via Umklapp processes. Here we report a pronounced violation of this rule in the layered charge-density-wave (CDW) metal 2H-TaSe2. Its in-plane thermal conductivity is strongly nonmonotonic: it peaks sharply at the 122 K ordering transition, collapses to a deep minimum near 210 K, and then anomalously reverses, rising with temperature to at least 350 K. Such a high-temperature reversal, in which a crystal conducts heat more efficiently as it is heated, is rare in crystalline solids. Its thermal conductivity minimum lies deep in the disordered phase well above the ordering transition, unlike the weak, transition-centered anomalies of other charge-density-wave systems, pointing to heat conduction governed by fluctuating rather than established order. Combining inelastic X-ray scattering, selected-area electron diffraction, and synchrotron X-ray diffraction, we attribute the reversal to phonons scattering off persistent, fluctuating charge order that survives more than 150 K above the long-range transition, to at least 300 K. A phenomenological phonon-CDW scattering model, tied directly to the measured diffraction linewidth and intensity, quantitatively reproduces the entire nonmonotonic curve. We also reveal that the charge order melts not abruptly but through a fluctuation- and defect-driven, weak first-order process, leaving short-range correlations far above the transition. This work establishes fluctuating charge order as a sensitive control knob for thermal transport in quantum materials and thermal conductivity as a powerful probe of the hidden charge order.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究报告了层状电荷密度波金属2H-TaSe2中晶格热导率随温度升高而降低这一百年规律的显著违反。其面内热导率表现出强烈的非单调性：在122 K有序转变处达到峰值，在210 K附近降至深谷，随后反常地随温度升高而上升至至少350 K。这种高温反转在晶体固体中十分罕见，表明热传导受涨落而非已建立的有序态控制。结合多种散射实验，研究将此反转归因于声子与持续涨落的电荷有序态的散射。
authors: Han Huang, Jinghang Dai, Joyce Christiansen-Salameh, Jiyoung Kim, Samuel Kielar, Desheng Ma, Noah Schinitzer, Danrui Ni, Gustavo Alvarez, Chen Li, Carla Slebodnick, Mario Medina, Bilal Azhar, Ahmet Alatas, Robert Cava, David Muller, Zhiting Tian

articles.title: Quantum Monte Carlo calculations in the nuclear shell model by the complex Langevin method
articles.title_zh: 通过复朗之万方法在核壳模型中进行量子蒙特卡罗计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.15116v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The nuclear shell model is known to describe the properties of various nuclei extremely well. However, the auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo calculations cannot be applied to it with general interactions due to the sign problem. The model has therefore been investigated primarily by variational methods, where the accuracy of the results depends crucially on the ansatz for the wave function. Here we perform the auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo calculations in the case of small systems at finite temperature using the complex Langevin method (CLM), which has been successfully applied to various interesting systems with the sign problem over the decade. In particular, we show the existence of a parameter region in which the validity criterion for the CLM is satisfied and the expectation value of the energy obtained by exact diagonalization is correctly reproduced. Thus the CLM can be a complementary approach to the variational method for large systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 核壳模型在描述各种原子核性质方面表现出色，但由于符号问题，辅助场量子蒙特卡罗计算无法应用于具有一般相互作用的核壳模型。本研究利用复朗之万方法（CLM）对有限温度下的小系统进行了辅助场量子蒙特卡罗计算。结果表明存在一个参数区域，在该区域内CLM的有效性判据得到满足，并且能够正确复现精确对角化得到的能量期望值。这表明CLM可以作为大型系统变分方法的补充方法。
authors: Yuhma Asano, Yuta Ito, Jun Nishimura, Noritaka Shimizu

articles.title: Z-Opt: A Near-Optimal Reduced-Complexity Two-Dimensional Grassmannian Constellation
articles.title_zh: Z-Opt：一种近最优的降复杂度二维格拉斯曼星座
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.04545v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Grassmannian constellations achieve the capacity of noncoherent communications over Rayleigh fading channels at high SNR, yet their efficient construction remains challenging. In this paper, we present two construction methods for Grassmannian constellations on G(2,1), termed S-Opt and Z-Opt, and propose two low-complexity detectors. Both construction and detection are performed on the unit sphere, known as the Bloch sphere in quantum computing. Exploiting the proportionality between the chordal distance on the Grassmann manifold and the Euclidean distance on the Bloch sphere, we derive a theoretical upper bound on the minimum chordal distance from the Fejes-Toth bound. The S-Opt constellation is constructed from sphere-packing solutions and achieves the theoretical limit corresponding to the considered optimal Bloch-sphere packings. The S-Opt detector applies to arbitrary constellations on G(2,1) and requires a number of complex multiplications scaling linearly with the number of receive antennas and logarithmically with the constellation size, and a number of numerical comparisons scaling logarithmically with the constellation size, while achieving the same performance as the GLRT detector. Based on the insight from the S-Opt construction, we further propose the Z-Opt constellation, constructed by stacking regular polygons on the Bloch sphere, whose minimum chordal distance approaches the derived upper bound over the evaluated constellation sizes. The Z-Opt detector requires a number of complex multiplications scaling linearly with the number of receive antennas and a number of numerical comparisons scaling logarithmically with the square root of the constellation size, while achieving the same performance as the GLRT detector for the Z-Opt constellation.
articles.abstract_zh: 格拉斯曼星座在高信噪比下能实现瑞利衰落信道上的非相干通信容量，但其高效构建仍具挑战。本文提出了两种在G(2,1)上构建格拉斯曼星座的方法（S-Opt和Z-Opt），并提出了两种低复杂度检测器。利用格拉斯曼流形上的弦距离与布洛赫球上的欧几里得距离之间的比例关系，推导了最小弦距离的理论上限。S-Opt星座由球堆积解构建，达到了理论极限，其检测器复杂度随接收天线数量线性增长，随星座大小对数增长。
authors: Kotaro Shigenaga, Hiroki Iimori, Yuto Hama, Chandan Pradhan, Szabolcs Malomsoky, Naoki Ishikawa

articles.title: Post-Quantum Secure Aggregation via Code-Based Homomorphic Encryption
articles.title_zh: 基于码本同态加密的后量子安全聚合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.13031v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Secure aggregation lets a server learn the sum of inputs from multiple users without learning individual contributions. Recent single-server protocols achieve this with key- and message-additive homomorphic encryption (KAHE), but existing instantiations rely on lattice assumptions. We instantiate a KAHE from the Learning Parity with Noise (LPN) assumption and analyze the challenges that arise with the Hamming metric. Decryption of the aggregate amounts to decoding over a q-ary symmetric channel whose crossover probability grows with the number of users. Security under leakage of the key sum reduces to LPN with a noise rate that is quadratic in the KAHE noise rate, and a matching attack shows that this loss is inherent when all but two users collude. Asymptotically, we characterize the optimal communication cost in closed form, showing that the overhead over the raw payload vanishes as the input length grows, and decouple the field size from the input range via the Chinese remainder theorem. In cross-silo settings, our protocol requires less communication than information-theoretically secure aggregation for moderate to high collusion.
articles.abstract_zh: 安全聚合允许服务器了解多个用户的输入总和，而不学习单个贡献。现有协议依赖于格点假设，本研究从带噪声奇偶校验（LPN）假设实例化了密钥和消息可加同态加密（KAHE），并分析了汉明度量带来的挑战。聚合解密相当于在交叉概率随用户数量增长的q元对称信道上进行解码。在密钥和泄漏下的安全性归结为LPN，其噪声率是KAHE噪声率的平方，并证明了通信开销随输入长度增长而消失。
authors: Sebastian Bitzer, Maximilian Egger, Mumin Liu, Antonia Wachter-Zeh

articles.title: Lévy-Khintchine Structure Enables Fast-Forwardable Lindbladian Simulation
articles.title_zh: Lévy-Khintchine结构实现快速可前向Lindbladian模拟
articles.abstract: Author(s): Minbo Gao, Zhengfeng Ji, and Chenghua Liu Simulation of open quantum systems is an area of active research in quantum algorithms. In this Letter, we revisit the connection between Markovian open-system dynamics and averages of Hamiltonian real-time evolutions, which we refer to as Hamiltonian twirling channels. By applying the Lévy-Khintchi… [Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 160405] Published Fri Oct 16, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 开放量子系统的模拟是量子算法领域的一个活跃研究方向。本研究重新审视了马尔可夫开放系统动力学与哈密顿实时演化平均值之间的联系，并将其称为哈密顿旋转通道。通过应用Lévy-Khintchine结构，该工作旨在实现Lindbladian模拟的快速前向演进，详情需查阅原文。
authors: Minbo Gao, Zhengfeng Ji, and Chenghua Liu

articles.title: Thermodynamic Uncertainty Relation with Quantum Feedback
articles.title_zh: 带量子反馈的热力学不确定关系

articles.title: Rare Event Simulation of Quantum Error-Correcting Circuits
articles.title_zh: 量子纠错电路的稀有事件模拟
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2237 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-15-2237 We describe a practical approach for accessing the logical failure rates of quantum error-correcting (QEC) circuits under low physical (component) failure rate regimes. Standard Monte Carlo is often the de facto approach for studying the failure rates of quantum circuits. However, in the study of fault-tolerant error-correcting circuits, the ability to extend this approach to low physical failure rates is limited. In particular, the use of Monte Carlo to access circuits that are relatively large or have high correcting power becomes more difficult as we lower the input failure rates of the individual components (gates) in the circuit. For these reasons, many simulations studying the circuit model go no lower than end-to-end logical failure rates in the 10⁻⁶ regime. In this report, we outline an approach that borrows from earlier work by Bravyi and Vargo [ 6 ] to the more complex circuit noise model. Earlier works studied both the capacity and phenomenological noise models [ 6 , 3 , 5 ], but the work is insufficient for generating similar simulations in the circuit-noise model. To the best of our knowledge, our team is the first to develop a full prescription of the rare event simulation by splitting technique for the circuit-based noise model. We have also generated promising results that are confirmed by standard Monte Carlo simulation under an accessible regime. This work shows that we can access noise in the circuit-model prescription of quantum error-correcting code to failure rates below 10⁻²⁰ regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出了一种实用方法，用于在低物理（组件）故障率下评估量子纠错（QEC）电路的逻辑故障率。传统的蒙特卡洛方法在低物理故障率下对大型或高纠错能力的电路模拟存在局限。作者们借鉴了早期工作，并将其应用于更复杂的电路噪声模型，以克服现有模拟在10⁻⁶逻辑故障率以下难以进行的挑战。
authors: Carolyn Mayer, Anand Ganti, Uzoma Onunkwo, Tzvetan Metodi, Benjamin Anker, and Jacek Skryzalin

articles.title: Asymmetric quantum Rabi model, trap-dipole resonance, and quantum gates with optically trapped ultracold polar molecules
articles.title_zh: 光学捕获超冷极性分子的非对称量子拉比模型、陷阱-偶极共振和量子门
articles.abstract: Optically trapped ultracold polar molecules can have multiple long-lived states for coding quantum information, and can exhibit electric dipole-dipole interactions (DDI) which enable entanglement generation. The general understanding on the quantized motion (QM) of optically trapped molecules is that it causes fluctuation of DDI. Here, we find that the molecular QM can realize an asymmetric quantum Rabi model, which is of specific importance in the study of fundamental physics. The molecular QM can also lead to an exotic trap-dipole resonance, resulting in excess population loss to uncoupled motional states, and, hence, should be avoided in a general quantum control over polar molecules. To examine the impact of QM on quantum computing based on polar molecules, we introduce two protocols, (1) a one-pulse iSWAP gate which can be realized by a global microwave pulse, and (2) a controlled-phase gate with an arbitrary controlled phase. Both gates can attain a high fidelity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨了光学捕获超冷极性分子的量子化运动（QM）对量子信息处理的影响。研究发现分子QM可以实现非对称量子拉比模型，并导致一种特殊的陷阱-偶极共振，后者应在量子控制中避免。为评估QM对基于极性分子的量子计算的影响，论文提出了两种高保真度的量子门协议：单脉冲iSWAP门和任意受控相位的受控相位门。
authors: Yan Lu and Xiao-Feng Shi

articles.title: Quantum Mpemba effect: anomalous relaxation of multi-spin system under local noise
articles.title_zh: 量子姆潘巴效应：局域噪声下多自旋系统的反常弛豫
articles.abstract: The quantum Mpemba effect (QMPE) is characterized by a state initially farther from equilibrium relaxing faster than one closer to it. In this work, we investigate the QMPE in an open central-spin model, and examine whether the QMPE emerges when the spins’ system is subjected to their independent noisy environment for different initial states. Simultaneously, we analyze the influence of the noisy environment on the dynamics and demonstrate that tuning local noise strengths can induce the QMPE. Furthermore, we systematically explore finite-size effects by varying the number of peripheral spins. In addition, we investigate the Pontus Mpemba effect within the same framework, demonstrating that an auxiliary decohering environment can accelerate the approach to stationarity. To observe the effect, we select the trace distance, energy, and -norm coherence as observables. By combining initial-state engineering (global rotation operations) with the modulation of the noisy environment, we clearly reveal the physical mechanisms for inducing and controlling the QMPE in this model. Our results show that both rotating the initial states and applying non-uniform local noises can alter the relaxation rate ordering among different states, leading to crossings in the evolution curves of various physical quantities, that is, the realization of the QMPE. This finding provides a new perspective for manipulating anomalous relaxation behavior in the quantum many-body system and open quantum system.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究了开放中心自旋模型中的量子姆潘巴效应（QMPE），即初始态离平衡态越远弛豫越快。研究发现，在自旋系统受独立噪声环境影响时，通过调整局域噪声强度可以诱导QMPE。此外，论文还探讨了有限尺寸效应和庞图斯姆潘巴效应，并结合初始态工程和噪声环境调制，揭示了诱导和控制QMPE的物理机制。
authors: Xiao-Xu Ning, Zhen-Dong Wei, Wei-Bin Yan, Zhong-Xiao Man, Yun-Jie Xia, Ying-Jie Zhang and Qing-Yu Cai

articles.title: Invertible subalgebras for chiral semion topological order
articles.title_zh: 手性半子拓扑序的可逆子代数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18953v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chiral topological order is incompatible with strictly two-dimensional local commuting-projector Hamiltonians on finite-dimensional tensor-product Hilbert spaces. Invertible subalgebras (ISAs) provide an alternative framework. We construct an ISA supporting chiral semions, together with its anti-semion commutant, on a square lattice with one qubit per edge. We give explicit non-Pauli generators for both algebras and prove that together they generate all local operators on the Hilbert space. Starting from the Z₄ toric code, we condense the boson e²m² and identify the semion and anti-semion algebras. We then decompose each Z₄ qudit into two qubits and use a finite-depth circuit to disentangle one qubit per edge fixed by the condensation constraints. Pumping the semion ISA along the z direction defines an explicit three-dimensional non-Clifford quantum cellular automaton (QCA). We show that pumping eight times is equivalent to a translation followed by a finite-depth quantum circuit with ancillary qubits. We also give an explicit finite-depth circuit relating this construction to the semion QCA previously obtained from topological quantum field theory. A similar condensation construction yields a U(1)₄ ISA on a square lattice. Together with the semion and earlier odd-prime ISAs, finite stacking realizes every pointed Witt class of bosonic Abelian anyon theories. Finally, we extend both constructions to all spatial dimensions d=4k-2, with one qubit or Z₄ qudit on each (2k-1)-cell for the semion or U(1)₄ ISA, respectively.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性拓扑序与严格二维的局域对易投影哈密顿量不兼容，该文提出可逆子代数（ISA）作为替代框架。作者在方格晶格上构建了一个支持手性半子及其反半子对易子的ISA，并给出了显式的非泡利生成元。通过Z₄环面码的凝聚和量子比特分解，该工作还定义了一个三维非Clifford量子元胞自动机，并展示了其与先前获得的半子QCA的关联。
authors: Yu-An Chen, Meng Sun, Nathanan Tantivasadakarn, Zongyuan Wang, Bowen Yang

articles.title: Logical gate set tomography
articles.title_zh: 逻辑门集层析成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19034v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum error correction (QEC) can strongly suppress noise, but predicting whether a computation succeeds requires understanding not only how much effective noise persists after QEC, but what form that noise takes. To thoroughly characterize this noise, we introduce logical gate set tomography (``logical GST''). Logical GST produces detailed representations of noisy logical operations that can be used to derive higher-level metrics, such as gate fidelity and diamond distance, and to test for non-Markovian and coherent logical errors. We use logical GST to obtain the first full, self-consistent characterization of a universal single-qubit logical gate set, implemented in the seven-qubit Steane code using Quantinuum System Model H1, a 20-qubit trapped-ion quantum processor. In the experimental data from H1, logical GST identified predominantly logical Pauli-stochastic errors, found no evidence of logical non-Markovianity, and detected weak potential signatures of coherent logical error. By contrast, higher-shot datasets generated with Quantinuum's detailed system emulator, identify mechanisms for weak but statistically significant logical non-Markovianity and strong evidence of coherent logical error. Finally, we use logical GST to perform error attribution with the system emulator, revealing how specific physical error sources shape logical error mechanisms.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子纠错能有效抑制噪声，但要预测计算成功率，需理解纠错后残余噪声的性质。该文引入了逻辑门集层析成像（logical GST）技术，用于详细表征噪声逻辑操作，并推导高层度量。通过在Quantinuum System Model H1上对七量子比特Steane码实现通用单量子比特逻辑门集进行实验，logical GST识别出主要是逻辑泡利随机误差，未发现逻辑非马尔可夫性，并检测到弱的相干逻辑误差迹象。
authors: Piper C. Wysocki, Juan Gonzalez De Mendoza, Karl Mayer, Natalie C. Brown, Ciaran Ryan-Anderson, Jalan A. Ziyad, Jordan H. Hines, Daniel G. Hothem, Corey I. Ostrove, Timothy J. Proctor, Kevin C. Young, Robin J. Blume-Kohout, Charles H. Baldwin, Kenneth M. Rudinger

articles.title: The Generalized BEADS Representation: An Informationally Complete Visualization of Mixed Quantum States
articles.title_zh: 广义BEADS表示：混合量子态的信息完备可视化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19054v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A deep understanding of quantum information theory is essential for quantum science and technology. However, quantum mechanics and particularly quantum information theory suffer from a lack of intuitive images. Visualization tools offer novel perspectives on many problems in quantum physics by revealing important properties of quantum states and processes that are otherwise obscured by abstract mathematical formalisms. Here, we extend the previously established BEADS representation of pure states to the so-called generalized BEADS representation of mixed quantum states. We introduce spherical functions, so-called beads to visualize correlation structures of mixed quantum states. A recursive optimization scheme is used to obtain minimum-entanglement pure state decompositions of all subsystems of a given N-qubit state. We show how correlation function components can be decomposed into individual contributions that directly correspond to different types of correlations of mixed states. This allows us to visually characterize the total correlation, genuine n-partite entanglement, nonclassical quantum-discord-type correlations as well as classical correlations. After outlining the mathematical details relevant for constructing the representation, we examine the generalized BEADS representations for various classes of mixed states including product, classically correlated, separable but nonclassically correlated, as well as entangled states. As exemplary applications of the generalized BEADS representation, we showcase entanglement distillation and the effects of noise channels.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子信息理论缺乏直观图像，限制了对其的深入理解。该文将纯态的BEADS表示扩展到混合量子态的广义BEADS表示，引入球形函数（珠子）来可视化混合量子态的关联结构。通过递归优化方案，该方法能够获得给定N量子比特态所有子系统的最小纠缠纯态分解，并分解关联函数分量以表征总关联、真实n体纠缠和非经典量子失谐型关联。
authors: Celina Bräutigam, Steffen J. Glaser, Dennis Huber

articles.title: The cost of classically simulating quantum communication is as high as it could be
articles.title_zh: 经典模拟量子通信的成本可能达到最高
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19060v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A long-standing open question is to characterize the classical communication cost of simulating the correlations arising from measurements on finite-dimensional quantum systems. We consider this question in the prepare-and-measure scenario. First we construct a classical simulation model involving a finite average number of bits of one-way communication that simulates exactly the correlations arising from arbitrary d-dimensional quantum states and arbitrary measurements. Second, we show that no classical simulation protocol involving a finite average message dimension can exist for d≥ 4, hence strengthening a recent result of de Gois, Santos and Vieira. Our first result relies on a more general simulation theorem which can be applied to certain continuous variable (i.e. infinite-dimensional) quantum systems, and even beyond quantum theory, e.g. to generalized probabilistic theories. In particular, we show that multimode Gaussian states of bounded average energy and general Gaussian measurements admit an exact classical simulation with a finite expected number of bits. Overall, our results show that the classical simulation cost of quantum communication is essentially as high as it could be.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文探讨了模拟有限维量子系统测量关联所需的经典通信成本。研究首先构建了一个经典模拟模型，该模型通过有限平均比特的单向通信精确模拟任意d维量子态和测量的关联。其次，研究证明对于d≥4，不存在涉及有限平均消息维度的经典模拟协议，从而强化了现有结果。这些结果表明，经典模拟量子通信的成本可能达到其理论上限。
authors: Riccardo Castellano, Pavel Sekatski, Nicolas Brunner

articles.title: A modular quantum computer based on Cornucopia codes
articles.title_zh: 基于丰饶角码的模块化量子计算机
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19073v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ultra-high-rate quantum error correction codes can store many logical qubits in a single code block with few physical qubits. A fault-tolerant quantum computer, however, also requires a universal set of logical operations on individually addressable logical qubits, and the ancilla overhead of these operations may erode the advantage of the high encoding rate. Here, we propose the Cornucopia architecture, in which a universal set of logical operations is implemented at low overhead for the Cornucopia codes. In particular, we focus on the [[2844,1426,18]] Cornucopia code as an example and introduce a modular quantum computer built from such code blocks connected by bridges. Each block stores 1,426 logical qubits and serves as a universal logical processor. Exploiting the code's translation symmetry, we construct a family of reusable gadgets that individually address 1,422 logical qubits within each block. These gadgets support three universal logical instruction sets: basic, high-throughput and fixed-extractor. Excluding magic-state factories, a module with sufficient workspace to execute any instruction in the basic set requires an average of 4.1 physical qubits per logical qubit, compared with 3.0 for memory alone. The architecture thus preserves the resource advantage of ultra-high-rate quantum memory while enabling universal logical computation, providing a route towards low-overhead fault-tolerant quantum computers.
articles.abstract_zh: 超高编码率量子纠错码能以少量物理量子比特存储大量逻辑量子比特，但容错量子计算机还需要低开销的通用逻辑操作。该文提出了丰饶角（Cornucopia）架构，以低开销实现丰饶角码的通用逻辑操作。以[[2844,1426,18]]丰饶角码为例，构建了一个由代码块通过桥接连接的模块化量子计算机，每个模块存储1426个逻辑量子比特并作为通用逻辑处理器。
authors: Zhide Lu, Weikang Li, Yinghao Ma, Hanyu Yan, Bingrun Wang, Yixuan Ma, Zheng-Zhi Sun, Dong-Ling Deng

articles.title: Retrieving Metrological Information from Noisy Squeezed Spin States via Bayesian Optimization
articles.title_zh: 通过贝叶斯优化从含噪声压缩自旋态中提取计量信息
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19471v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Frequency inhomogeneity can obscure the metrological advantage of squeezed spin states, making the choice of readout crucial. We study interacting spin-1/2 ensembles with static local frequency disorder and optimize a common collective readout over independent disorder realizations. Using Bayesian optimization of the full measurement-outcome distribution, we identify observables combining dipole and quadrupole operators that yield greater classical Fisher information than the optimized dipole readout considered here. For ensembles of up to 17 spins, their disorder-averaged CFI surpasses the standard quantum limit at both disorder strengths studied, including a regime where the dipole readout remains below it. For the larger ensembles studied, fixing the encoding axis to the direction that maximizes the disorder-averaged quantum Fisher information retains nearly the same performance. These results identify a route to extracting metrological information from frequency-disordered spin ensembles through the choice of collective observable.
articles.abstract_zh: 频率不均匀性会掩盖压缩自旋态的计量优势，因此读出方式至关重要。该文研究了具有静态局域频率无序的相互作用自旋-1/2系综，并通过贝叶斯优化集体读出方式。研究发现，结合偶极和四极算符的观测值能产生比优化偶极读出更大的经典费舍尔信息，并且在所研究的无序强度下，其无序平均CFI超越了标准量子极限。
authors: Enze Li, Yunjie Cai, Jingwei Zhang, Emi Yukawa

articles.title: Dynamical Decoupling of Nonclassical States in a Biased-Noise Spin Qudit
articles.title_zh: 偏置噪声自旋量子位中非经典态的动态解耦
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19676v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Encoding quantum information in d-dimensional systems (qudits) with d>2 offers appealing new directions for resource-efficient quantum computing. However, protecting the coherence of nonclassical qudit resource states remains an open challenge. Dynamical decoupling (DD) is a well-established technique for extending coherence, but its application to qudits is hindered by the quadratic scaling of the decoupling sequence overhead with the dimension d. As a result, demonstrations of qudit DD have so far been limited to low-dimensional qudits. Here, we show that noise-biased qudits enable a nontrivial reduction of this overhead, for example, from quadratic to linear. We perform qudit DD on a model d=8 qudit, the nuclear spin of an antimony donor in silicon. We benchmark DD performance on highly nonclassical states such as uniform superpositions, cat states, and Haar random states and measure coherence improvements up to a factor 5 to 10. For a spin-cat error correction code, continuous DD extends the coherence time of the logical superposition |+ångle_L to 225~ms, compared to 19~ms under free evolution and 85~ms with a Hahn echo. This improvement shows that DD sequences tailored to a system's noise bias can significantly enhance the lifetime of encoded logical qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 将量子信息编码在d>2维量子位中可提高量子计算的资源效率，但保护非经典量子位态的相干性仍是挑战。动态解耦（DD）技术在量子位中的应用受限于其与维度d的二次方开销。该文展示了噪声偏置量子位能将DD开销从二次方降低到线性，并在d=8的锑掺杂硅核自旋量子位上实现了DD。实验表明，DD将非经典态的相干性提高了5到10倍，并显著延长了逻辑叠加态的相干时间。
authors: Arjen Vaartjes, Namit Anand, Rocky Y. Su, Akram Youssry, Ritik Sareen, Jeffrey Marshall, Mark R. van Blankenstein, Danielle Holmes, Benjamin Wilhelm, Bibek Pokharel, Xi Yu, Laura A. O'Neill, Martin Nurizzo, Alexander M. Jakob, Fay E. Hudson, Kohei M. Itoh, Andrew S. Dzurak, David N. Jamieson, Andrea Morello

articles.title: Quantum-enhanced phase interrogation of a fiber-optic strain sensor
articles.title_zh: 光纤应变传感器的量子增强相位询问
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19752v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fiber-optic sensors enable high-sensitivity measurements of various physical parameters. Here, we demonstrate a quantum-enhanced interrogation of an all-fiber-optic Fabry-Perot resonator, employing entangled two-photon interference to probe directly strain-induced optical phase shifts. The resonator is interrogated by a narrow-linewidth laser that is frequency-locked to its resonance mode, thereby exploiting the cavity's inherent sensitivity to variations in the fiber length. To access the phase fluctuations transferred to the interrogation field due to external perturbations on the sensor, we implement an in-fiber Mach-Zehnder interferometer readout. This configuration allows the sensor to operate both with classical coherent light and with entangled photon pairs generated via spontaneous parametric down-conversion. Harnessing two-photon entangled states corresponding to an N = 2 NOON state, we experimentally demonstrate a reduction of the measurement noise below the standard quantum limit. These results provide clear evidence of the quantum advantage in enhancing fiber-optic sensors under practical constraints on optical power.
articles.abstract_zh: 光纤传感器可实现高灵敏度物理参数测量。该文展示了对全光纤法布里-珀罗谐振器的量子增强询问，利用纠缠双光子干涉直接探测应变引起的光学相移。通过使用N=2 NOON态的纠缠双光子态，实验证明测量噪声可降低至标准量子极限以下。这些结果清晰地证明了在实际光功率限制下，量子优势在增强光纤传感器方面的潜力。
authors: Romain Dalidet, Marialuisa Capezzuto, Hugo Degert, Davide D'Ambrosio, Saverio Avino, Anthony Martin, Sebastien Tanzilli, Laurent Labonte, Paolo De Natale, Gianluca Gagliardi

articles.title: Tomography for coherent noise
articles.title_zh: 相干噪声层析成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19779v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coherent noise poses a fundamentally greater challenge to quantum error correction than independent s- tochastic Pauli errors, because unitary errors preserve interference between error paths, can accumulate over multiple quantum error correction rounds, and leave the encoded logical channel with a residual coherent com- ponent. If the parameters of such coherent noise can be accurately determined, this knowledge can be exploited to inject correlated priors into the decoding graph, and to perform maximum-likelihood decoding under poly- nomially tractable structures, significantly improving the accuracy of syndrome-based decoding. In this work, we introduce one protocol to determine the model and parameters of coherent noise, and reduce the complexity of the experiment from 16nto O(16), which is of great significance for correcting coherent noise in quantum error correction.
articles.abstract_zh: 相干噪声对量子纠错构成比随机泡利误差更大的挑战，因为它会积累并留下残余相干分量。该文提出了一种确定相干噪声模型和参数的协议，并将实验复杂度从16ⁿ降低到O(16)。准确确定相干噪声参数有助于将其注入解码图，从而显著提高基于综合征解码的准确性，对量子纠错中的相干噪声校正具有重要意义。
authors: Long Huang

articles.title: Majorana Edge Modes Reshape Kibble-Zurek Scaling in Kitaev Honeycomb Ribbons
articles.title_zh: 马约拉纳边缘模式重塑Kitaev蜂窝状纳米带中的Kibble-Zurek标度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19923v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent progress in programmable quantum simulators motivates exact benchmarks for nonequilibrium dynamics in topological quantum matter. We study the Kitaev honeycomb model driven through its critical regions by a linear ramp of the bond coupling J_z over a ramp time τ, comparing zigzag and armchair ribbons with fully periodic tubes. The production of excitations exhibits a geometry-dependent finite-size crossover controlled by N₂/sqrtτ, the ratio of the ribbon width to the Kibble--Zurek length. Periodic tubes obey the expected critical-line Kibble--Zurek scaling and serve as the boundary-free benchmark. Zigzag ribbons follow the same scaling until defect production is exponentially suppressed by a finite-width algebraic gap floor associated with the formation of Majorana edge modes, whose occupation is pinned by inversion parity. Armchair ribbons instead support transient Majorana edge modes with exponentially small gaps, producing width-parity-dependent defect plateaus: exactly one defect per unit length for odd widths and an approximate, transient plateau near one half for even widths. The quench-generated entanglement entropy and fermionic logarithmic negativity inherit the same geometry-dependent structure, and the negativity further distinguishes the coherence-borne entanglement of the Kibble--Zurek regime from the population-borne entanglement of the edge-mode plateaus. These results identify boundary Majorana modes as the mechanism controlling departures from ideal Kibble--Zurek dynamics and provide geometry-resolved benchmarks for programmable simulations of topological matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用可编程量子模拟器，探讨了Kitaev蜂窝模型在通过临界区域时的非平衡动力学。结果显示，激发产生表现出几何依赖的有限尺寸交叉，受纳米带宽度与Kibble-Zurek长度之比控制。锯齿形纳米带中，马约拉纳边缘模式的形成会指数级抑制缺陷产生，而扶手椅形纳米带则支持瞬态马约拉纳边缘模式，导致缺陷平台依赖于宽度奇偶性。
authors: Hyesung Choi, Antonio Mandarino, Mahn-Soo Choi

articles.title: Photon Demultiplexing Using Spatial Routing
articles.title_zh: 基于空间路由的光子解复用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19933v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatial sectioning of the far-field noncollinear field from spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) is a promising approach for multiparty quantum communication. Although demonstrations with six pairs of users have been reported, the fundamental limits remain unknown. These include the maximum number of channels, the required degree of channel optimization, and the dependence on input parameters. In this paper, we provide a practical framework that answers these questions by connecting input parameters and invoking a design theorem. For a representative configuration, we realize 12 user-pair channels with routing consistency exceeding 0.9999 at a 12% reduction in photon flux. We further show that sectioning improves the accidental-coincidence budget linearly with the number of channels N, allowing the aggregate key rate to scale with the user count. These results provide a design strategy for spatial-division multiplexing of entangled photons analogous to the channel-spacing standards used in wavelength-division networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种利用自发参量下转换（SPDC）远场非共线场进行空间分段的光子解复用方法，旨在实现多方量子通信。研究建立了一个连接输入参数并引入设计定理的实用框架，以确定最大通道数、所需通道优化程度以及对输入参数的依赖性。该方法还线性改善了意外符合预算，使总密钥速率随用户数量扩展，为纠缠光子的空分复用提供了设计策略。
authors: Hashir Kuniyil, Asad Ali, Saif Al-Kuwari

articles.title: Advances in quantum optomechanical control based on cavity cold-atom systems
articles.title_zh: 基于腔冷原子系统的量子光力学控制进展
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20040v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cavity optomechanics represents a frontier research direction in quantum science and technology, centered on the control and exploration of interactions between electromagnetic fields and mechanical motion. Rooted in quantum mechanics, this field realizes efficient coupling and precise manipulation of optical fields and mechanical vibrations through the structural design and precise regulation of optical microcavities and mechanical oscillators, thereby revealing and harnessing novel quantum phenomena. In recent years, cavity optomechanics has evolved into an interdisciplinary frontier integrating quantum optics, condensed matter physics, and quantum precision measurement, exhibiting profound application in both fundamental physics research and quantum information science. With advancements in technologies such as nanomanufacturing and laser cooling, optomechanical interactions have been successfully demonstrated in various experimental systems. Among these platforms, cavity cold-atom systems stand out as one of the ideal platforms for implementing quantum optomechanics. Featuring exceptional environmental isolation, long quantum coherence times, and strong light-matter interaction, these systems provide a crucial testbed for exploring strong and even ultrastrong optomechanical coupling effects as well as rich nonlinear quantum phenomena. This paper reviews the recent progress in optomechanical control and manipulation based on cavity cold-atom systems. We first outline the fundamental principles of standard cavity optomechanical systems. Then, we describe the experimental realization of linear and nonlinear optomechanical couplings in cold-atom systems. After that, we focus on the representative applications of this platform in high-precision quantum sensing, quantum memory, and the preparation of macroscopic nonclassical states. Finally, we give an outlook and challenges in this field.
articles.abstract_zh: 腔光力学是量子科学与技术的前沿领域，专注于控制和探索电磁场与机械运动之间的相互作用。该领域通过光学微腔和机械振荡器的结构设计与精确调控，实现光场与机械振动的有效耦合和精确操控。腔冷原子系统因其卓越的环境隔离和长量子相干性，被认为是实现量子光力学的理想平台之一。
authors: Baijun Li, Tianxiang Lu, Jie Wang, Hui Jing

articles.title: Strong subadditivity of topological entropy on the torus: Rényi order and non-Abelian structure
articles.title_zh: 环面上拓扑熵的强次可加性：Rényi阶数与非阿贝尔结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20078v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We classify strong subadditivity for the canonical topological Rényi functional at finite positive orders on an unpunctured torus in the topological quantum field theory of any finite unitary modular tensor category. Universal validity means validity for all pure ground states and all regular region pairs with transverse or disjoint boundaries and compatible corner rounding. At von Neumann order one, the inequality holds universally. For each fixed order strictly between zero and one, universal validity is equivalent to pointedness, meaning that every simple anyon type has quantum dimension one. For every nonpointed category and each finite positive order other than one, we construct a violating pure state and an allowed pair. For a fixed pointed category and fixed order above one, universal validity is equivalent to a same-order modular Fourier entropy bound for every pure state. Global homological constraints on actual unions and intersections and established weighted modular uncertainty prove the order-one theorem. For parallel annuli at fixed flux distribution, the order-one functional is affine in their positive count. At other orders, unequal quantum dimensions on the occupied support induce strict curvature that suitable overlapping regions convert into negative deficits. Under the boundary-charge cutting prescription, the von Neumann theorem extends to arbitrary logical density matrices in the same ground space.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在任意有限酉模张量范畴的拓扑量子场论中，对未穿孔环面上有限正阶规范拓扑Rényi泛函的强次可加性进行了分类。研究发现，在冯诺依曼一阶时，该不等式普遍成立。对于介于零和一之间的固定阶数，普遍有效性等价于“尖点性”，即每个简单任意子类型具有量子维度一。对于非尖点范畴和除一之外的每个有限正阶，研究构造了一个违反纯态和允许对。
authors: Yi Liang

articles.title: Loss-Tolerant Measurement-Device-Independent QKD over Untrusted Repeaters via High-Dimensional Time-Bin Multiplexing
articles.title_zh: 基于高维时间复用的抗损耗测量设备无关量子密钥分发协议通过不可信中继器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20148v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a loss-tolerant measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution (MDI-QKD) protocol using time-bin-multiplexed single photons entangled with local qubits stored in nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers. In each round, Alice and Bob each send a single multiplexed photon to an untrusted intermediary, Charlie. Each photon first becomes entangled with Charlie's NV-center qubits; Charlie then performs entanglement swapping between his NV qubits to establish EPR pairs between Alice's and Bob's local qubits. With d time bins per photon, łog₂ d + 1 EPR pairs can be generated per transmitted photon, substantially increasing the probability of EPR-pair creation under limited channel bandwidth. To further mitigate the effects of prolonged memory storage, the protocol employs a memory-insensitive (MI) architecture, where multiple banks of qubits and multiplexed photon routing reduce the effective memory lifetime requirements. This approach enhances loss tolerance, enabling higher secret key rates and secure key distribution over longer distances compared to conventional single-photon protocols. Using the Lo-Chau EPR-QKD framework and Shor-Preskill reduction, we prove that the protocol is secure without trusting intermediate nodes, making it suitable for quantum networks with untrusted repeaters.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种抗损耗的测量设备无关量子密钥分发（MDI-QKD）协议，该协议利用与氮空位（NV）中心存储的局部量子比特纠缠的时间复用单光子。通过每个光子使用d个时间箱，每次传输可生成log₂d + 1个EPR对，显著提高了在有限信道带宽下EPR对的创建概率。为缓解长时间存储的影响，协议采用了一种存储不敏感（MI）架构，增强了抗损耗能力，实现了更高的密钥速率和更长距离的安全密钥分发。
authors: Yu-Chun Yin, Ching-Yi Lai, Alexei Ashikhmin

articles.title: A hybrid quantum interferometer bridging Hong-Ou-Mandel and N00N-state interference
articles.title_zh: 连接Hong-Ou-Mandel和N00N态干涉的混合量子干涉仪
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20202v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) interference offers robustness in high-noise environments due to its phase-insensitive nature, while N00N-state interference provides enhanced phase sensitivity for precision measurements in low-noise settings. However, their realizations have typically required separate experimental platforms. Here, we report a single hybrid quantum interferometer that can dynamically transition between HOM and N00N-state interference by adjusting two time delays, τ₁ and τ₂. This tunability enables operation in phase-insensitive, phase-sensitive, or hybrid modes within a unified setup, as confirmed by theoretical analysis and experimental demonstration. Our system offers a versatile platform with potential for quantum sensing applications, paving the way for integrated quantum technologies capable of adapting to diverse noise conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) 干涉在噪声环境中具有鲁棒性，而N00N态干涉则提供增强的相位灵敏度，但两者通常需要独立的实验平台。本文报道了一种单一的混合量子干涉仪，通过调整两个时间延迟，可以动态地在HOM和N00N态干涉之间转换。这种可调谐性使得该系统能够在统一的设置中以相位不敏感、相位敏感或混合模式运行，为量子传感应用提供了一个多功能平台。
authors: Zi-Qi Zeng, Samuel Corona-Aquino, Tao Xie, Bin Yin, Yan Guo, Yukun Song, Yun Meng, Kai Zou, Song Li, Xiaolong Hu, Alfred B. U'Ren, Roberto de J. León-Montiel, Chenglong You, Baihong Li, Dongzhou Wang, Rui-Bo Jin

articles.title: Petz Recovery through a Single Polar Transformation for Approximate Quantum Error Correction
articles.title_zh: 通过单一极变换实现近似量子纠错中的Petz恢复
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20515v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Petz recovery map provides a near optimal decoder for approximate quantum error correction, but its inverse square-root normalization complicates circuit implementation. We use the polar structure of the Petz recovery isometry to implement recovery through a single quantum singular value transformation (QSVT). We give explicit block-encoding circuits and an extended recovery isometry that yields approximate Petz recovery without postselection. We bound the diamond distance between the approximate and ideal Petz encoding-recovery channels in terms of a spectrum-weighted loss, which provides a channel specific objective for optimizing the QSVT angles. Uniform polynomial approximation yields an asymptotic error bound that decays exponentially with the number of QSVT iterations, at a rate controlled by the smallest nonzero scaled singular value. Applications to Haar-random encoding and the Hayden-Preskill protocol illustrate the tradeoff between circuit depth and recovery accuracy and place existing scrambling decoders within a common Petz recovery framework.
articles.abstract_zh: Petz恢复映射为近似量子纠错提供了一个近乎最优的解码器，但其逆平方根归一化使其电路实现复杂。本文利用Petz恢复等距的极结构，通过单一量子奇异值变换（QSVT）实现恢复。研究给出了显式块编码电路和扩展恢复等距，实现了无需后选择的近似Petz恢复。通过谱加权损耗来限制近似与理想Petz编码-恢复信道之间的钻石距离，并展示了QSVT迭代次数增加时误差界限呈指数衰减。
authors: Hanzhang Zhao, Shenglong Xu

articles.title: Stabilizer entropy cones as self-dual slices of linear rank cones: a five-party gap and dependence on the local dimension
articles.title_zh: 稳定子熵锥作为线性秩锥的自对偶切片：五方差距与对局部维度的依赖性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18905v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Entanglement entropies of multipartite pure states satisfy linear inequalities; for stabilizer states, the backbone of quantum error correction, the achievable entropy vectors generate a convex cone. We show that, after a linear lift, the closure of this cone is exactly the self-dual slice of a classical object on one more element than there are parties: the closed cone generated by the rank functions of arrangements of subspaces over GF(d) for a prime local dimension d, and of subgroups of abelian groups of exponent dividing d in general. This correspondence brings two features of rank inequalities into play. First, the purifier acts as an extra variable: already for five parties the stabilizer cone is strictly smaller than the quantum linear rank cone, with which earlier evidence suggested it might coincide; an explicit six-variable inequality witnesses the gap. Second, the characteristic of the field enters, so the cone depends on the local dimension. It does not for up to four parties. With enough parties, the cone of Z_d qudits is contained in that of Zd' qudits if and only if d divides d', and already for six parties the logical zero state of Steane's code lies outside the stabilizer cone of every odd local dimension. For this last result we show that the seven-variable characteristic-dependent inequalities we checked all follow from Shannon inequalities on the self-dual slice, and instead transfer one of them through a family of subgroups derived from the Fano plane.
articles.abstract_zh: 多体纯态的纠缠熵满足线性不等式，对于量子纠错的核心——稳定子态，可实现的熵向量生成一个凸锥。本文证明，经过线性提升后，该锥的闭包恰好是经典对象（比参与方多一个元素）的自对偶切片。研究发现，对于五方系统，稳定子锥严格小于量子线性秩锥，并提出了一个六变量不等式来证明这一差距。此外，该锥还依赖于局部维度，对于Z_d量子比特的锥包含在Z_d'量子比特的锥中当且仅当d整除d'。
authors: Xidan Song, Ruifeng Cao

articles.title: Measurement-induced criticality for non-Abelian anyons: The monitored golden chain
articles.title_zh: 非阿贝尔任意子的测量诱导临界性：受监测的黄金链
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18965v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Non-Abelian anyon chains whose interactions favor a single fusion channel host quantum critical ground states described by minimal-model conformal field theories (CFTs) protected by a topological symmetry. We show that their measurement-only counterpart, where non-commuting fusion charge measurements act locally on the anyons of a chain of L sites, provides a fundamental example of a non-unitary CFT controlling a non-Abelian learning problem. Mapping the monitored dynamics to a random tensor network, we numerically find 1/L scaling Lyapunov gaps, logarithmic entanglement scaling with the chord length, and an effective central charge in the Shannon entropy of the measurement record. The conserved topological charge sharpens with dynamical exponent z= 1 and is learnable by a decoder on an O(L) time scale. As the topological symmetry is a non-invertible symmetry of the SU(2)ₖ anyon theories, we establish the monitored golden chain (k=3) as a non-Abelian generalization of the weakly (Kramers-Wannier) self-dual quantum critical point of the toric code (k=2), and the first of a family for k≥ 3.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了非阿贝尔任意子链的测量诱导临界性，其中非对易融合电荷测量局域作用于链上的任意子。研究表明，这种受监测的动力学可映射到随机张量网络，并数值发现1/L标度的李雅普诺夫间隙、与弦长呈对数关系的纠缠标度以及测量记录香农熵中的有效中心荷。该工作将受监测的黄金链（k=3）确立为环面码（k=2）弱自对偶量子临界点的非阿贝尔推广。
authors: Zhaohui Zhi, Bo Han, Romain Vasseur, Andreas W. W. Ludwig, Simon Trebst, Guo-Yi Zhu

articles.title: A low-cost compact muon detector for millikelvin operation
articles.title_zh: 一种用于毫开尔文操作的低成本紧凑型μ子探测器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20132v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ionizing radiation produces correlated errors in superconducting qubits, posing some challenges to quantum error correction. In addition, it causes background events in other superconducting cryogenic devices, such as kinetic inductance detectors and superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors. Cosmic muons are a component of this background that can only be partly shielded against at ground level, but can be tagged by an independent detector inside the cryostat, so that the affected data can be vetoed, or the muon tags incorporated into error correction. We present a low-cost, compact muon detector consisting of two plastic scintillator modules, each read out by a silicon photomultiplier (SiPM), operated in coincidence. We characterize the SiPMs from room temperature down to 10 mK, including the breakdown and upper-limit voltages that define the operating bias range. Operated as a muon counter, the detector measures a coincidence rate that, as expected, is independent of temperature within uncertainties and agrees with analytical and Monte Carlo predictions. Below approximately 8 K, each muon event produces two pulses, one narrow and one broad, an effect that, to our knowledge, has not been reported before. Coincidences with an independent muon detector outside the cryostat confirm that muons are still counted reliably in this regime.
