By studying the appearance of double pulses as a function of temperature and magnetic field up to 4.5 T, we find a behavior consistent with the phase diagram of a type-II superconductor. This links the double pulses to a superconducting material in the SiPM, likely an adhesion layer or diffusion barrier introduced during manufacturing. The mechanism by which the superconducting state produces the second pulse is not yet understood.
articles.abstract_zh: 电离辐射在超导量子比特中产生相关错误，对量子纠错构成挑战，并导致其他超导低温设备中的背景事件。本文介绍了一种低成本、紧凑型μ子探测器，由两个塑料闪烁体模块组成，每个模块由硅光电倍增管（SiPM）读出并以符合方式操作。该探测器作为μ子计数器运行时，测得的符合率在不确定性范围内与温度无关，并与分析和蒙特卡洛预测一致。
authors: Tengiz Ibrayev, Danish Khan, Alex Herscovics, Komal Kataruka, Matilda Lawton, Sandhya Sharma, Steven Waddy, Laura Manenti

articles.title: A quantum annealing approach to the minimum distance problem of quantum codes
articles.title_zh: 量子退火方法解决量子码的最小距离问题
articles.abstract: arXiv:2404.17703v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum error-correcting codes (QECCs) are at the heart of fault-tolerant quantum computing. As the size of quantum platforms is expected to grow, one of the open questions is to design new optimal codes of ever-increasing size. A related challenge is to certify the quality of a given code by evaluating its minimum distance, a quantity characterizing code's capacity to preserve quantum information. This problem is known to be NP-hard. Here we propose to harness the power of contemporary quantum platforms to address this question, and in this way help design quantum platforms of the future. Namely, we introduce an approach to compute the minimum distance of quantum stabilizer codes by reformulating the problem as a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) problem and leveraging established QUBO algorithms and heuristics as well as quantum annealing (QA) to address the latter. The reformulation as a QUBO introduces only a logarithmic multiplicative overhead in the required number of variables. We demonstrate the formulation using the D-Wave Advantage 4.1 quantum annealer and the hybrid quantum-classical algorithm Qbsolv, and benchmark the resulting QUBO-based implementations against specialized classical distance-finding methods. The QA- and SA-assisted implementations show broadly comparable performance, while the classical comparison clarifies the relative strengths of heuristic optimization and exact distance certification. Our results establish a solver-independent QUBO formulation with only a logarithmic multiplicative overhead in the number of variables and characterize connectivity and minor embedding as central limitations of its present implementation on quantum-annealing hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子纠错码（QECCs）是容错量子计算的核心，评估其最小距离是认证代码质量的关键挑战，该问题是NP难的。本文提出了一种利用量子退火（QA）计算量子稳定子码最小距离的方法，通过将问题重新表述为二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）问题。这种重构仅引入了所需变量数量的对数乘法开销。研究使用D-Wave Advantage 4.1量子退火器和混合量子-经典算法Qbsolv验证了该方法。
authors: Refaat Ismail, Ashish Kakkar, Anatoly Dymarsky

articles.title: Fundamental Limits on QBER and Distance in Quantum Key Distribution
articles.title_zh: 量子密钥分发中量子误码率和距离的根本限制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.22319v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum key distribution (QKD) enables information-theoretic secure communication, yet its ultimate tolerance to noise and achievable transmission distance remain fundamentally constrained. We establish the maximum quantum bit error rate (QBER) compatible with secure QKD and derive corresponding upper bounds on communication distance. Our results follow from a fundamental capacity threshold for qubit Pauli channels and apply to protocols based on two or more mutually unbiased bases, using either single-photon or weak coherent sources. By connecting information-theoretic limits to realistic physical noise models, we obtain universal bounds on achievable distances in fiber and free-space links, including diffraction-limited constraints relevant to deep-space quantum communications. These findings clarify the ultimate noise robustness of QKD and delineate the fundamental boundaries of secure quantum communication.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子密钥分发（QKD）实现了信息论安全的通信，但其对噪声的最终容忍度和可达传输距离受到根本限制。本文建立了与安全QKD兼容的最大量子误码率（QBER），并推导了相应的通信距离上限。研究结果源于量子比特泡利信道的基本容量阈值，并适用于基于两个或更多互不偏基的协议。通过将信息论限制与实际物理噪声模型相结合，该工作获得了光纤和自由空间链路中可达距离的普遍界限，阐明了QKD的最终噪声鲁棒性并划定了安全量子通信的基本边界。
authors: Stefano Pirandola

articles.title: Heterogeneous entanglement between a trapped ion and a solid-state quantum memory
articles.title_zh: 囚禁离子与固态量子存储器之间的异质纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.05836v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Hybrid quantum networks offer a promising architecture for scalable quantum information processing and a future quantum internet, as they can combine the complementary strengths of disparate physical platforms. While single-atom systems provide deterministic quantum logic gates, atomic ensembles enable large-capacity quantum storage. However, generating entanglement between such heterogeneous systems has remained an open challenge, primarily due to fundamental spectral mismatches and system complexity. Here, we demonstrate a hybrid quantum network that entangles a single trapped mathrm¹⁷¹Yb⁺ ion and a quantum memory based on m̊ ¹⁵³Eu³⁺o̧lon!Y₂SiO₅ crystal over a 75-m separation. Using polarization-maintaining quantum frequency conversion, we map spin-photon entanglement onto a hybrid entanglement between a single spin qubit and a collective excitation of the quantum memory. The resulting entangled state achieves a fidelity of (89.21 ± 2.23)% and violates the CHSH-Bell inequality by 6 standard deviations (S = 2.328 ± 0.055), confirming nonlocality between two heterogeneous nodes. This work establishes entanglement between a quantum processing module with a multiplexed quantum memory node, representing a key step toward a scalable, multifunctional quantum internet.
articles.abstract_zh: 混合量子网络为可扩展量子信息处理提供了前景广阔的架构，但异质系统间的纠缠生成因光谱失配而面临挑战。本工作展示了单个囚禁的¹⁷¹Yb⁺离子与基于¹⁵³Eu³⁺:Y₂SiO₅晶体的量子存储器之间跨越75米的混合纠缠。通过偏振保持量子频率转换，研究人员将自旋-光子纠缠映射到混合纠缠态，实现了89.21%的保真度并显著违反了CHSH-Bell不等式，证实了两个异质节点之间的非局域性。
authors: Chen-Xu Wang, Yi-Yang Wang, Tian-Xiang Zhu, Qing-Quan Yao, Peng-Jun Liang, Yuan-Cong Li, Zi-Peng Liu, Ran He, Yong-Jian Han, Jin-Ming Cui, Zong-Quan Zhou, Yun-Feng Huang, Chuan-Feng Li, Guang-Can Guo

articles.title: Learning Quantum Operator Dynamics from Short-Time Data
articles.title_zh: 从短时数据学习量子算符动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.14699v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Real-time dynamics of quantum observables provide direct access to excitation spectra and correlation functions in quantum many-body systems, but currently available quantum devices are limited to short evolution times due to decoherence. We propose a neural ordinary differential equation (Neural ODE) framework with a physics-driven neural network to reconstruct long-time operator dynamics from short-time quantum data. By expanding observables in the Pauli basis and exploiting locality and symmetry constraints, the operator evolution is reduced to a tractable set of coefficients whose dynamics are learned from the measurement data. Applied to the Ising spin chain with mixed fields, the operator learning method accurately extrapolates its long-time correlation function and resolves its excitation spectrum. We validate the framework by collecting short-time data from IBM's superconducting quantum processor and successfully reconstruct the Fourier spectrum of an N=8 Ising spin chain with 5 times enhanced precision. Our results demonstrate a scalable and data-efficient strategy for extracting dynamical and spectral information from practical quantum hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 当前量子设备受退相干限制，难以获取量子可观测量在长时间内的实时动力学。本研究提出了一种基于物理驱动神经网络的神经常微分方程（Neural ODE）框架，用于从短时量子数据重建长时间算符动力学。通过在泡利基中展开可观测量并利用局域性和对称性约束，该方法将算符演化简化为可处理的系数集，并从测量数据中学习其动力学。该方法在伊辛自旋链上成功应用，并经IBM超导量子处理器数据验证，显著提高了傅里叶谱的重建精度。
authors: Jinyang Li, Satoshi Iso, Shunji Matsuura, Lingxiao Wang, Xiaoyang Wang

articles.title: Magnetic domains stabilized by symmetry-protected zero modes
articles.title_zh: 由对称性保护的零模稳定的磁畴
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.15510v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Understanding mechanisms for the breakdown of thermalization in closed quantum systems is a central problem in quantum many-body physics. We demonstrate strong nonergodic behavior in the XX model on coupled chains, where domain-wall initial states retain an inhomogeneous magnetization profile for arbitrarily long times. We find that this effect arises due to zero modes protected by chiral symmetry. Using an analysis based on the Lanczos algorithm, we identify evidence for a localization transition in the thermodynamic limit at a critical coupling between the chains. We further show that antiferromagnetic defects in the initial state and symmetry-breaking perturbations restore slow thermalization, whereas it remains robust for symmetry-conserving perturbations. These results establish that degenerate, symmetry-protected subspaces can give rise to thermodynamically stable nonergodic dynamics in experimentally accessible quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 理解封闭量子系统中热化失效的机制是量子多体物理学的核心问题。本研究在耦合链上的XX模型中展示了强烈的非遍历行为，其中畴壁初始态能长时间保持不均匀的磁化分布。研究发现这种效应源于手征对称性保护的零模，并通过Lanczos算法分析揭示了热力学极限下链间临界耦合处的局域化转变。结果表明，反铁磁缺陷和破缺对称性的微扰会恢复缓慢热化，而对称性守恒的微扰则保持其鲁棒性。
authors: Pavel Kos, Dominik S. Wild, Kristian Knakkergaard Nielsen

articles.title: Structured-Light Magnetometry in a Coherently Controlled Atomic Medium
articles.title_zh: 相干控制原子介质中的结构光磁力测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.25781v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: A structured-light-based approach to magneto-optical rotation (MOR) magnetometry is proposed, in which magnetically induced polarization rotation is converted into a directly observable spatial displacement. A radially polarized Laguerre--Gaussian beam propagating through cold ⁸⁷Rb atoms in the presence of a longitudinal magnetic field experiences circular birefringence, which induces a relative phase shift between the σ₊ and σ₋ polarization components. This phase shift manifests itself as the angular rotation of a petal-shaped interference pattern, enabling the MOR angle to be determined directly from the spatial intensity distribution. Unlike conventional MOR detection techniques based on balanced polarimetry or Stokes-parameter reconstruction, the proposed method requires only a fixed-axis polarization projection and avoids computationally intensive polarization analysis. By translating polarization rotation into a topology-dependent spatial observable, the scheme enables direct and spatially resolved magnetic-field measurements. Furthermore, the use of electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) allows low-loss operation while preserving high sensitivity. These characteristics make the proposed technique a promising platform for optical magnetometry and structured-light-based quantum sensing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究提出了一种基于结构光的磁光旋转（MOR）磁力测量方法，将磁致偏振旋转转换为直接可观察的空间位移。当径向偏振的拉盖尔-高斯光束穿过存在纵向磁场的冷⁸⁷Rb原子时，会经历圆双折射，导致σ₊和σ₋偏振分量之间产生相对相移。这种相移表现为花瓣状干涉图样的角旋转，从而可以直接从空间强度分布确定MOR角。该方法避免了复杂的偏振分析，并结合电磁感应透明（EIT）实现了低损耗操作。
authors: Parkhi Bhardwaj, Shubhrangshu Dasgupta

articles.title: Topological zero-reflection points in multi-terminal quantum wire junctions
articles.title_zh: 多端量子线结中的拓扑零反射点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.31586v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study scattering in noninteracting multi-terminal quantum wire junctions and show that junctions with dihedral symmetry can exhibit exact zero-reflection points for N ge 4 terminals. By analyzing the scattering matrix, we identify these reflectionless points in the (E,t') parameter space, where E is the incident particle energy and t' is the junction hopping amplitude. These points exhibit an even-odd dependence on N and converge asymptotically to a common limiting value in the large-N limit. We show that the reflectionless points are characterized by an integer winding number associated with the phase of the reflection amplitude, providing a topological description for their stability against weak on-site disorder. We also consider junctions with broken time-reversal symmetry and find that a magnetic flux can induce additional reflectionless points, including for the N = 3 case. For a four-terminal junction threaded by a π-flux, we identify a unique parameter regime in which the reflection amplitude vanishes over the entire energy band. Finally, we discuss experimental signatures through the behavior of Friedel oscillations and examine the stability of these reflectionless points in the presence of weak interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了非相互作用多端量子线结中的散射现象，并发现具有二面体对称性的结（N ≥ 4）可以展现精确的零反射点。通过分析散射矩阵，这些无反射点在(E,t')参数空间中被识别，并表现出对N的奇偶依赖性，在大N极限下渐近收敛。这些点由反射振幅相位相关的整数缠绕数表征，提供了其对弱局域无序稳定性的拓扑描述。研究还发现磁通量可以诱导额外的无反射点，包括N=3的情况。
authors: Abhiram Soori, Udit Khanna, Diptiman Sen

articles.title: Non-Abelian quantum Hall states at strong Landau level mixing: finding anyons with first-principles AI
articles.title_zh: 强朗道能级混合下的非阿贝尔量子霍尔态：用第一性原理AI寻找任意子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18967v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Non-Abelian anyons, strange particles forming the basis of fault-tolerant topological quantum computing, are predicted to emerge in fractional quantum Hall states at even-denominator filling factors. Identifying which topological order is realized has proven to be a challenging problem that requires an accurate, non-perturbative treatment of realistic Landau level mixing, which has so far been missing from theoretical studies. Here we present the first complete solution of non-Abelian quantum Hall problem that includes all electrons and all Landau levels, for spin-polarized electrons at filling factor ν = 3/2. We develop a momentum-resolved neural-network variational wave function, optimized solely on the microscopic Hamiltonian, which gives direct access to the topologically degenerate ground states. Without any physics input about the expected outcome, it discovers a degenerate ground-state manifold whose entanglement reveals anyons with quantum dimension sqrt2, the hallmark of Ising-type non-Abelian order. By directly computing the overlap with trial wave functions, we further show that Landau level mixing favors the anti-Pfaffian over other candidate states. Our results demonstrate the power of neural-network wave functions in finding and characterizing non-Abelian anyons from first principles, in regimes of strong Landau level mixing, relevant to many recent experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 非阿贝尔任意子是容错拓扑量子计算的基础，预计出现在偶数分母填充因子的分数量子霍尔态中。识别其拓扑序需要对朗道能级混合进行精确的非微扰处理，这在现有理论研究中尚缺失。本工作首次为填充因子ν=3/2的自旋极化电子提供了完整的非阿贝尔量子霍尔问题解决方案，包括所有电子和朗道能级。研究开发了一种动量分辨的神经网络变分波函数，仅通过微观哈密顿量进行优化，直接揭示了具有量子维度sqrt2的任意子，这是伊辛型非阿贝尔序的标志。
authors: Pierre-Antoine Graham, Ahmed Abouelkomsan, Liang Fu

articles.title: Full-Continuum Ultrafast Quantum Gas Microscopy
articles.title_zh: 全连续超快量子气体显微镜
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18994v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum gas microscopy provides single-shot access to many-body configurations, but their microscopic reconstruction has so far largely relied on a predefined discrete spatial basis during fluorescence readout. Here we realize ultrafast atom-resolved fluorescence microscopy of an ultracold ¹⁶²Dy gas directly in continuous space, with all external confinement removed during imaging. Exploiting the large mass and broad optical transition of dysprosium together with a high numerical aperture in-vacuum objective, we detect single atoms within 4,μs while maintaining an effective point-spread function with a full width at half maximum of 254.8(3),nm, and an isolated single-atom classification fidelity of 99.72(3)%. We use the measured single-atom response to construct a statistical configuration-inference model that recovers atomic positions and multiplicities, coming from overlapping atoms, directly from single fluorescence snapshots. Benchmarking our model on Monte-Carlo generated images shows a total reconstruction fidelity of 98.7%. Our approach extends quantum gas microscopy beyond predefined detection lattices, enabling atom-resolved measurements of counting statistics and higher-order spatial correlations directly on the intrinsic length scales of continuum many-body systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子气体显微镜能够单次获取多体构型，但其微观重建通常依赖于预定义的离散空间基底。本研究实现了超冷¹⁶²Dy气体在连续空间中直接进行超快原子分辨荧光显微成像，成像过程中移除了所有外部限制。利用镝的大质量和宽光学跃迁特性以及高数值孔径真空物镜，研究人员在4微秒内探测到单个原子，并保持了254.8(3)纳米的有效点扩散函数，单原子分类保真度达到99.72(3)%。
authors: Andrea Litvinov, Clemens Ulm, Eva Casotti, Gerard Solà Berga, Manfred J. Mark, Francesca Ferlaino

articles.title: Topological superconductivity in layered d-wave altermagnetic metals
articles.title_zh: 层状d波交变磁性金属中的拓扑超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19017v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate multilayer d-wave altermagnetic metals with odd-parity helical p-wave pairing. In the minimal bilayer system, interlayer tunneling reconstructs the spin-split Fermi surfaces and generates two layer-hybridized sectors with distinct effective chemical potentials. Without Rashba spin-orbit coupling (RSOC), the emergent mirror symmetry and subsystem chiral symmetry stabilize phases with different numbers of helical Majorana edge-mode pairs and additional counterpropagating pairs, jointly characterized by the mirror Chern number and the winding numbers defined along high-symmetry lines. The combination of RSOC and the altermagnetic exchange field gaps out the helical Majorana pairs while, in a certain parameter regime, leaving another pair of counterpropagating Majorana edge modes gapless, giving rise to second-order topological phases with isolated or twofold Majorana corner modes, as well as a hybrid-order phase in which gapless Majorana edge modes coexist with Majorana corner modes. We identify a layer symmetry that elucidates the physical origin of these phases. For an arbitrary N-layer system, such a symmetry naturally arises from the interlayer-coupling matrix, allowing N-fold Majorana corner modes to emerge when all layer-hybridized sectors enter the nontrivial second-order regime. Our results establish the interplay among the layer degree of freedom, odd-parity pairing, and Fermi-surface configurations as a controllable route to engineering topological superconductivity in layered altermagnetic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了具有奇宇称螺旋p波配对的多层d波交变磁性金属中的拓扑超导性。在最小双层系统中，层间隧穿重构了自旋分裂的费米面，并产生了两个具有不同有效化学势的层杂化区域。在没有Rashba自旋轨道耦合（RSOC）的情况下，出现的镜像对称性和子系统手征对称性稳定了具有不同数量螺旋马约拉纳边缘模式对的相。RSOC与交变磁交换场的结合会使螺旋马约拉纳对产生能隙，但在特定参数范围内，会留下另一对反向传播的马约拉纳边缘模式无能隙，从而产生具有孤立或双重马约拉纳角模式的二阶拓扑相，以及边缘模式与角模式共存的混合阶相。
authors: Yijie Mo, Zhongbo Yan

articles.title: Pseudo-relativistic fermions and topological states in zinc-blende semiconductors and their heterostructures (Habilitation thesis)
articles.title_zh: 闪锌矿半导体及其异质结构中的赝相对论费米子和拓扑态（教授资格论文）
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19140v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tracing my scientific path from many-body physics in semiconductor nanostructures to topological quantum matter, this Habilitation à diriger des recherches (HDR) memoir presents only part of my research since defending two PhD theses in Toulouse and Nizhny Novgorod in 2011. Focusing on pseudo-relativistic fermions and topological states in zinc-blende semiconductors and their heterostructures, it highlights my independent research program: identifying physical problems, developing predictive theories, and initiating new directions with experimentalists. The first part addresses Kane fermions in bulk HgCdTe: temperature-driven band inversion, domain-wall states, the collapse of Landau levels in crossed electric and magnetic fields, and disorder-induced topological transitions. The second examines pressure-, temperature-, and disorder-driven phase transitions in single and double HgTe quantum wells (QWs), including bilayer-graphene-like semimetals and a two-dimensional higher-order topological insulator (2D HOTI) phase beyond the minimal BHZ model. The third develops three-layer InAs/Ga(In)Sb QWs as a III-V platform for massless Dirac fermions, large-gap quantum spin Hall insulators, 2D HOTI phases, and semimetals with quadratic band touching, and discusses InAsₓSb₁₋ₓ/InAsySb₁₋y heterostructures as a promising alternative. Several of these predictions are supported by experimental observations, including quantized helical edge transport up to 60 K and the unconventional quantum Hall effect. Defended on March 25, 2026, at the University of Montpellier. Jury: Michel GOIRAN (chair and rapporteur, LNCMI-CNRS, Toulouse); Alexey KAVOKIN (rapporteur, Westlake University, Hangzhou); Robson FERREIRA (rapporteur, LPENS-CNRS, Paris); Alexei BARANOV (member, IES-CNRS, Montpellier); Benoit JOUAULT and Frédéric TEPPE (members, L2C-CNRS, Montpellier).
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇教授资格论文（Habilitation thesis）追溯了作者从半导体纳米结构中的多体物理到拓扑量子物质的科学研究历程。论文重点关注闪锌矿半导体及其异质结构中的赝相对论费米子和拓扑态。研究内容涵盖了块体HgCdTe中的Kane费米子、HgTe量子阱（QWs）中由压力、温度和无序驱动的相变（包括双层石墨烯类半金属和超越最小BHZ模型的二维高阶拓扑绝缘体相），以及作为无质量狄拉克费米子III-V平台的三层InAs/Ga(In)Sb量子阱。
authors: Sergey S. Krishtopenko

articles.title: Spectral signatures of spin textures and the emergence of a pseudogap
articles.title_zh: 自旋织构的谱学特征与赝能隙的出现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19269v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Periodic solids with strongly interacting electrons display phenomena -- from Mott localization to high-temperature superconductivity -- that escape conventional band theory. Efforts to address this unconventional physics have been typically cast in the language of Green's function theories and the associated frequency- and momentum-dependent self-energies capturing strong correlations beyond the reach of mean-field theories. Here, we underscore that frequency- and momentum-dependent self-energies emerge also from mean-field solutions that break translational symmetry, and that these self-energies can display the characteristic fingerprints of strong correlations for certain, physically meaningful, spatial patterns. We showcase this perspective by studying the paradigmatic case of the 2D Hubbard model. We find that already at the mean-field level the doped antiferromagnet displays, in addition to stripes, many quasi-degenerate self-consistent solutions with antiferromagnetic textures organized into antiphase domains separated by hole-rich interfaces, reminiscent of the phase-separation scenario. Remarkably, these solutions map into spectral functions that display very distinctively the phenomenology of the pseudogap, including the nodal-antinodal dichotomy of the self-energy, Fermi arcs, and a complementary Luttinger surface. The result is a conceptually simple description of such an intricate many-body state: the pseudogap emerges as the momentum-space spectral portrait of the real-space interplay between antiferromagnetic domains and the metallic interfaces, which echoes the role of spin-fluctuations identified by nonperturbative methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有强相互作用电子的周期性固体展现出超越传统能带理论的现象，例如莫特局域化和高温超导。本研究强调，频率和动量相关的自能也可以从打破平移对称性的平均场解中产生，并且这些自能可以展现出强关联的特征指纹。通过研究二维哈伯德模型的典型案例，研究发现掺杂的反铁磁体在平均场水平上就表现出许多准简并的自洽解，这些解具有反铁磁织构和富空穴界面，类似于相分离情景，并映射到具有赝能隙特征的谱函数。
authors: Matteo Quinzi, Andrea Pintus, Tommaso Chiarotti, Massimo Capone, Nicola Marzari

articles.title: Signatures of symmetry-stabilized Dirac fermions in correlated oxide CaNbO3 thin films
articles.title_zh: 钙铌氧化物薄膜中对称性稳定狄拉克费米子的谱学特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19276v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Symmetry-protected electronic states in correlated oxides offer a route to combining topology, lattice tunability, and many-body interactions, but creating such topological electronic states in complex oxides remains challenging. Here, we show that oxygen octahedral rotations provide a symmetry-control parameter for stabilizing Dirac-related electronic states in epitaxial CaNbO3 films. By comparing compressively strained tetragonal films and relaxed orthorhombic films, we demonstrate that distinct octahedral rotation patterns preserve nonsymmorphic symmetry and lead to distinct transport signatures consistent with Dirac-like electronic states. The films exhibit metallic transport with high mobility of 138,000 cm2 V-1 s-1, multichannel conduction, and Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations from small high-mobility Fermi pockets. Landau-fan diagram analysis indicates finite Berry-phase contributions, while first-principles calculations reveal a strain-driven evolution from nodal-line band crossings in the orthorhombic phase to Dirac-electron band features in the tetragonal phase. These results establish oxygen octahedral symmetry as a design knob for engineering topological electronic states in correlated perovskite oxides.
articles.abstract_zh: 在复杂氧化物中创建拓扑电子态仍然具有挑战性。本研究表明，氧八面体旋转可以作为对称性控制参数，稳定外延CaNbO₃薄膜中的狄拉克相关电子态。通过比较受压四方薄膜和弛豫正交薄膜，研究人员证明了不同的八面体旋转模式保留了非共形对称性，并导致了与狄拉克类电子态一致的独特输运特征。薄膜表现出高迁移率的金属输运、多通道传导以及来自小高迁移率费米袋的Shubnikov-de Haas振荡，第一性原理计算揭示了从正交相中的节点线能带交叉到四方相中狄拉克电子能带特征的应变驱动演化。
authors: Yunkyu Park, Seoung-Hun Kang, Jeongkeun Song, Minsik Kong, Seohee Kim, Shan Lin, Eun Sang Choi, Km Rubi, Hua Zhou, Sangmoon Yoon, Hu Miao, Satoshi Okamoto, Jong Mok Ok, Ho Nyung Lee

articles.title: Room-Temperature Metallic 2D Ferromagnetism Stabilized by Quantum Metric
articles.title_zh: 量子度规稳定室温金属二维铁磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19713v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The recent discovery of long-sought dice-lattice bands in layered electride YCl opens up unprecedented opportunities for studying correlated electrons in real dice lattice systems. While the weakly dispersive band at the Fermi level is partially filled and density-wave states are expected due to Fermi surface nesting based on conventional theories, the ARPES measurement nevertheless revealed a uniform flat band splitting of 0.5 eV, suggesting unusual ferromagnetism (FM) borne out of the metallic 2D dice lattice. In this Letter, we propose that the uniform metallic FM order is stabilized by the prominent quantum metric near topological band crossing points at K and K', which reconstructs the magnetic instability in the dice metal and tips the density-wave instability toward a uniform FM order. Importantly, our analysis based on random phase approximation (RPA) and Hartree-Fock theory predicts a remarkably high Curie temperature above room temperature for the 2D FM order. These findings establish the first example of a room-temperature 2D metallic magnet stabilized by quantum metric, which not only exemplifies the fundamental significance of quantum geometry in solids but also bears far-reaching applications in energy-efficient high-density magnetic memories.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近在层状电化物YCl中发现的骰子晶格能带为研究真实骰子晶格系统中的关联电子提供了前所未有的机会。尽管费米能级处的弱色散能带部分填充，并且基于传统理论的费米面嵌套预计会导致密度波态，但ARPES测量却揭示了0.5 eV的均匀平带分裂，表明金属二维骰子晶格中产生了异常的铁磁性（FM）。本研究提出，拓扑能带交叉点K和K'附近显著的量子度规稳定了这种均匀的金属FM序，将密度波不稳定性转向均匀FM序。随机相近似（RPA）和Hartree-Fock理论分析预测，该二维FM序的居里温度显著高于室温，这确立了第一个由量子度规稳定的室温二维金属磁体的例子。
authors: Teng-Fei Ying, Jianqi Zhong, Songyuan Geng, Fangjie Chen, Haoxiang Li, Benjamin T. Zhou

articles.title: Beyond Kitaev exchange: Γ'-driven magnetism in Ag₃LiRh₂O₆
articles.title_zh: 超越Kitaev交换：Ag₃LiRh₂O₆中Γ'驱动的磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19770v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In Kitaev magnets, frustration arises from bond-dependent spin anisotropic interactions, which can potentially realize sought-after quantum spin liquid phases. However, material realizations with dominating Kitaev exchange are scarce and the broad parameter space of extended Kitaev models remains largely unexplored experimentally. Here, we use density-functional theory, cluster many-body, spin-wave, and density-matrix renormalization calculations to show that the recently discovered honeycomb rhodate Ag₃LiRh₂O₆ hosts an off-diagonal exchange Γ₁' that is second in magnitude only to the ferromagnetic Kitaev exchange K₁. This combination of K₁ and Γ₁' explains key experimental observations, an unusually high magnetic ordering temperature of 94 K at ambient pressure and its rapid decrease under hydrostatic pressure as Ag₃LiRh₂O₆ evolves from ferromagnetic toward zigzag order within the honeycomb planes. Our spin-wave calculations further predict an unusual topology of the magnon bands arising from the Γ₁' term in the spin Hamiltonian of the honeycomb layer. We show that the large trigonal splitting of t₂g states enhances Γ₁', the hitherto underappreciated term in Kitaev magnets, and opens the way to new interesting regimes of the extended Kitaev model.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用多种理论计算方法，揭示了蜂窝状铑酸盐Ag₃LiRh₂O₆中存在一个仅次于铁磁Kitaev交换K₁的非对角交换Γ₁'。K₁和Γ₁'的结合解释了该材料在环境压力下异常高的磁有序温度（94 K）及其在静水压力下迅速下降的实验现象。自旋波计算进一步预测了由Γ₁'项引起的磁振子能带的特殊拓扑结构，并指出t₂g态的大三角分裂增强了Γ₁'。
authors: Efrain Insuasti Pazmino, Shi Feng, Ramesh Dhakal, Ioannis Rousochatzakis, Stephen M. Winter, Johannes Knolle, Alexander A. Tsirlin

articles.title: Making Weak Interlayer Excitons Absorb: Manipulating the Effective Oscillator Strength via Purcell Engineering of Critical Coupling
articles.title_zh: 使弱层间激子吸收：通过Purcell工程临界耦合操纵有效振子强度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20307v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interlayer excitons (IXs) in transition metal dichalcogenide bilayers possess unique dipolar properties, providing a path for exploring correlated many-body phases, electrically tunable dipole-dipole interactions, and long-range exciton transport. However, the large electron-hole separation underlying their dipolar character also results in a significantly reduced oscillator strength, limiting their direct optical interaction with light, and thus the direct probing of their dynamics and many-body interactions. Here, we show that by using Purcell engineering of critical coupling, a weak interlayer transition can absorb as strongly as the dominant intralayer transition, despite its much smaller intrinsic oscillator strength. Using this approach, in an open cavity architecture we demonstrate an order of magnitude IX absorption modulation in bilayer and trilayer MoS2, with doubling of the IX to A-exciton interaction strength weight from ~23% to ~53%. Furthermore, we demonstrate that in a tailored closed cavity architecture, the IX enhancement can reach beyond an order of magnitude, from ~5% to ~83% excitonic absorption, enabling IX absorption similar to intralayer excitons. An analytical description of the interaction is obtained via a closed-form transmission-line model which separates the excitonic and photonic contributions to the optical response, revealing how cavity architecture can be designed towards critical coupling. Our findings establish Purcell engineering of critical coupling as a general route to controlling and enhancing weak excitonic transitions.
articles.abstract_zh: 过渡金属二硫化物双层中的层间激子（IXs）因其独特的偶极特性而具有重要研究价值，但其较弱的振子强度限制了直接光学探测。本研究展示了通过Purcell工程临界耦合，可以使弱层间跃迁的吸收强度与主导的层内跃迁相当。在开放腔结构中，实现了MoS2双层和三层中IX吸收的一个数量级调制，并将IX与A激子的相互作用强度权重从约23%提高到约53%。
authors: Saroj Poudyal, Anabel Atash Kahlon, Michael Klein, Matan Meshulam, Yonatan Gershuni, Thomas Poirier, James H. Edgar, Mukesh Kumar, Seth Ariel Tongay, Itai Epstein

articles.title: A Boson-informed neural network for Ground States of Many-Body Schrödinger equations
articles.title_zh: 一种用于多体薛定谔方程基态的玻色子信息神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18875v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We propose a symmetry-preserving Boson-informed neural network (BINN) for the variational Monte Carlo computation of interacting-boson ground states in continuous space. The framework explicitly separates the two dominant physical scales of the system. At the microscopic interaction scale, a cell Jastrow factor absorbs the leading near-contact stiffness, while at the macroscopic scale, a potential-aware envelope encodes the external confinement, leaving the neural network to capture a smoother many-body residual. Across both two- and three-dimensional tests, the BINN approaches the Hartree and Gross-Pitaevskii limits with an empirical O(N⁻¹) finite-size trend in both energy and density. The energies agree with diffusion Monte Carlo to within 0.06% for the particle number tested up to 350 in the three-dimensional shrinking-range case. Applications are made under various trapping scenarios, justifying robust performance of BINN.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种对称性保持的玻色子信息神经网络（BINN），用于连续空间中相互作用玻色子基态的变分蒙特卡罗计算。该框架明确分离了系统的两个主要物理尺度，通过细胞Jastrow因子处理微观相互作用，并利用势能感知包络编码宏观外部限制。在二维和三维测试中，BINN在能量和密度上都接近Hartree和Gross-Pitaevskii极限，并与扩散蒙特卡罗结果高度一致。
authors: Zhizhong Kong, Jerry Zhijian Yang, Cheng Yuan, Xiaofei Zhao

articles.title: Adaptive qubit freezing enables robust graph partitioning for divide-and-conquer QAOA
articles.title_zh: 自适应量子比特冻结实现分治QAOA的鲁棒图划分
articles.abstract: Separator-based divide-and-conquer QAOA (DC-QAOA) can address graphs wider than the qubit capacity of one circuit, meaning the number of physical qubits usable by that circuit, but the large graph partitioner (LGP) in DC-QAOA aborts when no small vertex separator exists. We introduce frozen LGP (FrozenLGP), a three-phase extension of this specific pipeline. It first runs standard LGP (Phase 1); after failure, it freezes a minimum node cut of each selected residual graph, conditional on the first budget-feasible separator (Phase 2); and it uses a deterministic width-feasible split as coverage-preserving partitioning (CPP) for a final fallback (Phase 3). For a fixed frozen spin assignment, removed Ising couplings are folded exactly into local fields; assignment selection, QAOA, truncated reconstruction, and fallback ranking remain approximate. On the pooled high-connectivity partition benchmarks ( ), the scalable driver achieves 89.8% separator-based coverage without the CPP fallback at freeze budget , compared with 4.6% for standard LGP alone. In the 100-instance end-to-end benchmark, FrozenLGP’s Phase 2 increases coverage without CPP from 76 to 91 instances in the selected best-restart outcomes. The deterministic CPP fallback handles the remaining nine. CPP-inclusive coverage is 100%, including all tested partitioning instances up to vertices. This is a termination guarantee, not a measure of freezing-based recovery. When Phase 1 succeeds, both methods follow identical seeded circuit paths and attain identical approximation ratios. Compared with QAOA-in-QAOA, FrozenLGP achieves higher mean approximation ratios at each measured size, at the cost of more invoked subcircuit solves and greater aggregate quantum work. Under two simulated noise channels, the coverage extension persists while the reported output distributions of every method degrade under the stronger channel. In simulation, these results support FrozenLGP as a topology-robust front end for separator-based DC-QAOA.
articles.abstract_zh: 分隔器分治QAOA（DC-QAOA）在处理超出单个电路量子比特容量的图时，其大图划分器（LGP）可能因缺乏小顶点分隔器而中止。本研究引入了FrozenLGP，这是一个三阶段扩展，旨在提高图划分的鲁棒性。FrozenLGP在标准LGP失败后，通过冻结残余图的最小节点割来增加覆盖率，并在最终回退时使用确定性宽度可行分割。在基准测试中，FrozenLGP在不使用回退的情况下实现了89.8%的分隔器覆盖率，显著优于标准LGP的4.6%。
authors: Sokea Sang, Leanghok Hour, Dongmin Kim and Youngsun Han

articles.title: Optimal Disorder Strength for Approximate Unitary k-Designs in Spin Chains
articles.title_zh: 自旋链中近似酉k-设计的最优无序强度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18954v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum simulators with disordered spin Hamiltonians offer a natural route to Haar-like unitary ensembles, but face a competition. Disorder enhances randomness, yet strong disorder suppresses dynamics and localizes the system in the computational basis. This suggests an optimal intermediate disorder strength for approximating a unitary k-design, which has so far been identified mainly empirically. Here, we develop a perturbative theory for the moment gap Δ⁽k⁾, the deviation of the k-th moment operator from its Haar value, for the full spectrum of the interacting XXZ chain in a fixed-magnetization sector. We find the non-monotonic asymptotic scalings łn Δ⁽k⁾sim -σ² at weak disorder and łn Δ⁽k⁾sim -1/σ at strong disorder, whose crossover sets an optimal disorder strength σ_csim Jₓy, where Jₓy is the energy scale of the non-random interaction. We further show that a multi-quench protocol further suppresses the gap exponentially in the number of quenches. Numerical simulations confirm both scalings and this exponential suppression, and we demonstrate the usefulness of the protocol for classical shadow tomography. This work suggests that strong disorder may block both thermalization and the formation of unitary designs through a common localization mechanism.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有无序自旋哈密顿量的量子模拟器是实现类Haar酉系综的途径，但存在无序强度与系统动力学之间的竞争。本研究为相互作用XXZ链的k阶矩间隙Δ⁽k⁾发展了微扰理论，揭示了在弱无序下Δ⁽k⁾~-σ²和强无序下Δ⁽k⁾~-1/σ的非单调渐近标度，其交叉点确定了最优无序强度。研究还表明，多淬火协议可以指数级地抑制间隙，数值模拟证实了这些发现，并展示了该协议在经典阴影层析成像中的应用价值。
authors: Tian-Gang Zhou, Yi-Neng Zhou, Thierry Giamarchi, Julian Sonner

articles.title: Stabilizer Rényi Entropy Without a Phase Reference
articles.title_zh: 无相位参考的稳定器Rényi熵
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18955v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Stabilizer Rényi entropy quantifies magic relative to a complete Pauli frame. In settings such as helicity states of massless particles, unsynchronized qubit registers, energy eigenbases, and systems under superselection rules, the computational basis may be fixed while the transverse Pauli axes remain unspecified. The stabilizer Rényi entropy then depends on the choice of those axes. We define a phase-averaged stabilizer Rényi entropy by averaging the Pauli moments before taking the logarithm. It is exactly invariant under independent local rephasings. For pure states, it vanishes precisely when the state is a stabilizer state in every phase convention. For a broad class of sparse supports, it reduces to a closed-form function of the basis-state probabilities alone. Within this class, the ceiling for n channels is łn[n³/(6n-5)] for n≥3 and łnfrac75 for two channels. We apply the invariant to tree-level gluon scattering at four and five points, where the helicity-basis phases are unspecified. It saturates the two- and three-channel ceilings: łnfrac75 at four points and łnfrac2713 in 3→2 scattering. In same-helicity 2→3 scattering, it lies between a floor of łnfrac87 and a ceiling of łnfrac184125, reached in the resolved soft limit and particular collinear limits, respectively. In every configuration studied, the invariant is independent of the fixed external colors.
articles.abstract_zh: 稳定器Rényi熵通常依赖于横向泡利轴的选择。本研究定义了一种相位平均的稳定器Rényi熵，通过在取对数前对泡利矩进行平均，使其在独立的局部重相位下保持精确不变。对于纯态，当状态在所有相位约定下都是稳定器态时，该熵恰好为零。该方法应用于四点和五点树级胶子散射，其中螺旋度基相未指定。
authors: Jinwei Chu, Savan Kharel

articles.title: Programmable Polaron Models and Tomography in Trapped-Ion Quantum Simulators
articles.title_zh: 囚禁离子量子模拟器中的可编程极化子模型与层析成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18970v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strong coupling between mobile charge carriers or excitons and lattice vibrations gives rise to polarons: quasiparticles formed by charge carriers dressed by a cloud of phonon excitations. Polaron formation determines transport properties of systems ranging from transition-metal oxides and organic semiconductors to light-harvesting complexes. In excitonic systems that admit a hard-core boson description, mapping the excitations to pseudospins provides a natural framework for studying polaron physics, including the nonperturbative regime in which hopping amplitudes, phonon energies, and coupling strengths are comparable. Here, we propose a trapped-ion blueprint for realizing spin-phonon Hamiltonians with programmable spatial coupling between excitation density and phonon displacements, encompassing local Holstein and long-range Fröhlich-type interactions. To access strongly dressed quasiparticles whose bare spectral weight is suppressed, we introduce displaced Green's functions implemented through spin-dependent phonon displacements. Their spectral response reveals the polaron band spectrum, including binding energies and phonon-excitation sidebands, while spatially resolved measurements probe the structure of the phonon dressing cloud, providing a route to polaron tomography. We further complement this spectroscopy with direct and ancilla-assisted measurements of spin-phonon correlations that track the coupled dynamics of the excitation and its environment. These approaches connect the emergent quasiparticle spectrum to the microscopic buildup of its dressing cloud, enabling controlled studies of how the spatial range of coupling shapes polaron formation and mobility.
articles.abstract_zh: 极化子是电荷载流子与晶格振动强耦合形成的准粒子，其形成决定了多种系统的输运性质。本研究提出了一种囚禁离子蓝图，用于实现具有可编程空间耦合的自旋-声子哈密顿量，涵盖了局域Holstein和长程Fröhlich型相互作用。为了探测裸谱权重被抑制的强缀饰准粒子，研究引入了通过自旋依赖声子位移实现的位移格林函数。这些函数的谱响应揭示了极化子能带谱，包括结合能和声子激发。
authors: Filip Marijanovic, Utso Bhattacharya, Abhishek Menon, Visal So, Guido Pagano, Eugene Demler

articles.title: Federated Unlearning of Quantum Data via Classical Shadows
articles.title_zh: 基于经典影子的量子数据联邦遗忘学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19077v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum federated learning trains a quantum neural network (QNN) across nodes that hold quantum data, such as the states of quantum sensors. To forget data, unlearning methods for quantum models replay them, and federated unlearning from stored updates removes whole nodes only. Quantum data cannot be replayed, since a state is consumed when measured and cannot be cloned. We propose Shadow-based Data Erasure (SHADE), in which each node records a classical shadow of every training state, a few randomized single-qubit measurements taken at training time. The gradient and curvature of a QNN on a state are expectations of observables, so SHADE estimates them for the forget data from the shadows at any later parameters and removes their effect by a federated Newton correction. Only classical estimates cross the network. We prove that the shadow size needed for a target unlearning error grows exponentially in the size of the backward light cone of the measured observable and not in the number of qubits. In simulation with 50 nodes and on edge boards, SHADE matches the forget accuracy of retraining within 0.5 points, without replay and in under 0.2 s.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子联邦学习在持有量子数据的节点间训练量子神经网络，但量子数据无法重放以实现遗忘。本研究提出了一种基于影子的数据擦除（SHADE）方法，其中每个节点记录每个训练状态的经典影子。SHADE利用这些影子估计遗忘数据的梯度和曲率，并通过联邦牛顿校正来消除其影响，且仅有经典估计值在网络中传输。研究证明，实现目标遗忘误差所需的影子大小与被测量可观测量的后向光锥大小呈指数增长。
authors: Zihao Ding, Jun Huang, Cong-cong Xing

articles.title: Post-Optimization Subspace Corrections to Quantum Ansätze
articles.title_zh: 量子拟设的后优化子空间校正
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19109v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Circuit depth and measurement count are the main limitations for chemical applications of the leading variational quantum algorithms on quantum computers. We show that both resource requirements can be reduced by augmenting adaptive variational quantum algorithms with post-optimization corrective techniques. We focus on two such techniques---Hamiltonian-moment Krylov subspace diagonalization and the identity-augmented quantum self-consistent equation of motion (q-sc-EOM)---applied to optimized ADAPT-VQE states without further ansatz growth or nonlinear optimization. Across molecular systems studied with up to 20 qubits, first-order Krylov correction reduces the optimized iterations (and the corresponding number of adaptive layers) needed to reach the 1.6~mEₕ threshold by up to approximately sixfold, with a general trend toward larger reductions at higher determinant Rényi entropy. We also find measurement-cost reductions of up to approximately fortyfold using a suitable resource-cost model. Identity-augmented q-sc-EOM improves molecular potential-energy curves obtained from truncated ADAPT-VQE ansätze with limited expressivity and recovers accuracy from states produced by sampled operator ranking without additional gradient-based operator selection, providing an advantage when small pool gradients make selection measurement intensive. Together, these post-optimization corrections offer routes to improve energy accuracy and reduce adaptive circuit growth in quantum algorithms as quantum hardware advances.
articles.abstract_zh: 电路深度和测量计数是变分量子算法在化学应用中的主要限制。本研究表明，通过在自适应变分量子算法中加入后优化校正技术，可以减少这两种资源需求。研究重点介绍了两种技术：哈密顿量矩Krylov子空间对角化和恒等式增强量子自洽运动方程（q-sc-EOM），它们应用于优化的ADAPT-VQE状态。结果显示，一级Krylov校正可将达到目标阈值所需的迭代次数减少约六倍，并使测量成本降低约四十倍。
authors: Prince Frederick Kwao, Bharath Sambasivam, Jason Saroni, Srivathsan Poyyapakkam Sundar, Edwin Barnes, Ayush Asthana

articles.title: Selective Control and Imaging of Higgs and Goldstone Modes with a Quantum Simulator
articles.title_zh: 利用量子模拟器选择性控制和成像希格斯和戈德斯通模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19219v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We realize the mesoscopic Bose-Hubbard model at unit-filling on a two-dimensional array of transmon qubits and selectively excite collective modes associated with amplitude or phase fluctuations of the superfluid order parameter. We identify these modes respectively as the Higgs and Goldstone modes using complementary local observables, extracted from measuring the number of particles on each site. Modulation of the coupling between sites excites the Higgs mode, which we detect via the density of doubly occupied sites. In contrast, modulation of the local chemical potential with an appropriately chosen spatial profile excites the lowest-frequency Goldstone mode, which we detect via changes in the local density. The two modes have different symmetries and do not couple to one another. By varying the system geometry, we characterize the impact of finite system size on the evolution of both modes. In the thermodynamic limit, decay into a continuum of lower-energy excitations can obscure the Higgs response. In our mesoscopic system, however, the finite system size leads to spectral gaps and allows us to detect the Higgs mode as a coherent, long-lived excitation. Our work demonstrates how finite quantum simulators can isolate and probe physical phenomena that become difficult to resolve in the thermodynamic, large-scale limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究在二维超导量子比特阵列上实现了单位填充的介观玻色-哈伯德模型，并选择性地激发了与超流序参量振幅或相位波动相关的集体模式。通过测量每个位点上的粒子数，研究人员将这些模式分别识别为希格斯和戈德斯通模式。通过调制位点间的耦合或局部化学势，可以分别激发希格斯模式和最低频率的戈德斯通模式。在介观系统中，有限的系统尺寸导致了谱隙，从而能够将希格斯模式检测为相干振荡。
authors: Connie Miao, Pranjal Praneel, Thomas G. Kiely, Eliott Rosenberg, Nicole S. Ticea, Pedram Roushan, Erich Mueller, Andre G. Petukhov

articles.title: Quantum-classical algorithm interpolation for spatial search
articles.title_zh: 空间搜索的量子-经典算法插值
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19255v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum-walk algorithms can quadratically reduce the dependence of spatial search on the classical hitting time HT. Realising this speedup using standard quantum-walk algorithms, however, requires deep coherent circuits, limiting their applicability on near-term and early fault-tolerant quantum devices. We derive a parameterised family of hybrid quantum-classical spatial search algorithms that continuously interpolates between the classical and fully coherent quantum regimes, trading off circuit depth for total query complexity. For any γin[0,1], our algorithms use circuits of depth widetildeO(HTγ/²) and find a marked vertex with constant success probability at total cost widetildeO(HT¹⁻γmathsfS + HT¹⁻γ/²(mathsfU + mathsfC)), where mathsfS, mathsfU, and mathsfC denote the setup, update, and checking costs, respectively. We also derive an optimal continuous depth-query trade-off for fixed-point amplitude amplification, providing a potential building block for other hybrid designs.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子游走算法可以二次方地减少空间搜索对经典命中时间HT的依赖，但实现这种加速需要深层相干电路。本研究推导了一族参数化的混合量子-经典空间搜索算法，可以在经典和全相干量子机制之间连续插值。这些算法通过权衡电路深度与总查询复杂度，为近期和早期容错量子设备上的空间搜索提供了更实用的解决方案。
authors: Diogo Ramos, Duarte Magano

articles.title: Quantum Reservoir Computing for Attention-like Selective Reproduction
articles.title_zh: 用于类注意力选择性再现的量子储备池计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19272v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Choosing which information to use as the context changes is a basic cognitive operation. We introduce a new task of this kind for quantum reservoir computing (QRC): a binary cue indicates which of two simultaneous input streams the reservoir must reproduce. In simulated spin reservoirs with a trained linear readout, infinitely many measurements (exact expectation values) let the reservoir reproduce the cued stream accurately. At a finite number of measurements (N_M), the score exceeds that of a linear readout of the raw inputs only at large (N_M) because of sampling noise. Performance increases with both entanglement and coherence in the computational basis, and then saturates. These results show that QRC can select and reproduce a cued stream, and they are a starting point for harder cognitive tasks.
articles.abstract_zh: 选择在上下文变化时使用哪些信息是一种基本的认知操作。本研究为量子储备池计算（QRC）引入了一项新的任务：一个二进制提示指示储备池必须再现两个同步输入流中的哪一个。在模拟自旋储备池中，QRC能够准确地选择并再现提示的流，其性能随纠缠和计算基相干性增加而提高。这些结果表明QRC能够执行选择性再现，为更复杂的认知任务奠定了基础。
authors: Hadi Zadeh-Haghighi, Christoph Simon

articles.title: Gap-Priced |Tångle-States: Dynamic |Tångle Post-Selection and Budget-Aware Factory Provisioning
articles.title_zh: 间隙定价|Tångle态：动态|Tångle后选择与预算感知工厂配置
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19299v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magic |Tångle-state preparation dominates the cost of fault-tolerant quantum computation on surface codes, yet cultivation and distillation are typically provisioned statically, leaving much of the program's error budget unused. We present Gap-Priced |Tångle States (GP|Tångle-S), a lattice surgery scheduler and factory allocator that co-optimizes both methods under a total T-error budget. GP|Tångle-S uses the complementary gap of each cultivated state as a fidelity estimate and dynamically adjusts the cultivation gap cutoff, converting budget slack into speed by giving the scheduler control over the cultivation post-selection. GP|Tångle-S also characterizes distillation factories by size, |Tångle-state production rate, and budget slack, and introduces cultivating factories that embed cultivation within routing channels, achieving fidelities otherwise requiring two-level distillation at a single-level footprint. GP|Tångle-S organizes these characterizations into a factory catalog, and performs distillation factory allocation over this catalog in tandem with the gap cutoff using dynamic-programming to achieve one of i) minimum spacetime volume, ii) minimum execution time, or iii) minimum space overhead, all within a user-provided T-error budget. Across sixteen benchmarks under high and low T-error budgets of 10⁻³ and 10⁻⁵ respectively, GP|Tångle-S consistently outperforms cultivation-only and single-factory baselines without exceeding the budget, achieving a 5.5× geometric mean speedup in logical cycle count and a 3.4× geometric mean reduction in space-time volume.
articles.abstract_zh: 魔术|Tångle态的制备是表面码容错量子计算的主要成本来源，但其培养和蒸馏通常是静态配置的，导致大部分错误预算未被利用。本研究提出了间隙定价|Tångle态（GP|Tångle-S），这是一种晶格手术调度器和工厂分配器，可在总T误差预算下共同优化这两种方法。GP|Tångle-S通过动态调整培养间隙截止值，将预算松弛转化为速度，并引入了将培养嵌入路由通道的培养工厂，从而提高了效率。
authors: Maxwell Poster, Sayam Sethi, Yuhao Liu, Jonathan Baker, Costin Iancu

articles.title: Leakage benchmarking with decohering subgroups in the presence of preparation and measurement errors
articles.title_zh: 在制备和测量误差存在下使用退相干子群的泄漏基准测试
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19304v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A common problem with physical qubits is that the state can leak outside the computational subspace. To characterize the problem, it is desirable to measure both the leakage probability and the fidelity of gates inside the computational subspace. Randomized benchmarking is a readily accessible method for estimating average gate fidelities and can be modified to account for leakage. However, in the presence of state preparation and measurement errors (SPAM) there are parameter degeneracies, and fidelities and leakage become underdetermined. We study the example of qudits with any number of leakage levels under the assumption of gate-independent noise. We show that randomized benchmarking sequences with leakage level decoherence can be analyzed as a Markov process with noisy classical preparations and measurements. This result generalizes to randomized benchmarking with random gates from an arbitrary group that contains a phase-decohering subgroup. We characterize the parameter degeneracy in inferring the Markov process, preparations and measurements. Based on this characterization we develop a measurement and inference method taking advantage of known conservative bounds on SPAM to constrain fidelity, leakage and other parameters of the Markov process, state preparations and measurements. As part of our study, we experimentally implemented the measurement method for a qubit defined on the one-excitation subspace of two transmons, for which there are two leakage levels. We determined confidence intervals accounting for parameter degeneracy for a number of performance parameters of the system. For leakage and fidelity, we compare these intervals to those obtained for several conventional methods for leakage benchmarking.
articles.abstract_zh: 物理量子比特的一个常见问题是其状态可能泄漏到计算子空间之外。为了表征此问题，需要测量泄漏概率和计算子空间内门的保真度。本研究探讨了在存在制备和测量误差（SPAM）的情况下，泄漏基准测试的挑战。我们展示了具有泄漏级别退相干的随机基准测试序列可以被分析为带有噪声经典制备和测量的马尔可夫过程，并基于此开发了一种测量和推断方法。
authors: Shawn Geller, Tongyu Zhao, Alex Kwiatkowski, Scott Glancy, Raymond W. Simmonds, Emanuel Knill

articles.title: Quantum LDPC Codes from Polynomial Minors
articles.title_zh: 基于多项式子式的量子LDPC码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19459v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct quantum codes from codewords of a cyclic code and the minors of a polynomial matrix. The construction uses a two-row, three-column matrix whose minors yield a second matrix satisfying the CSS orthogonality condition. We derive the code dimension from the greatest common divisors of the entries and minors, with a simplified formula for odd lifting factors. A residue characterization identifies additional common factors of the minors and leads to a method for controlling the dimension through polynomial selection. We also give a condition for changing the minor generator without changing the code. Explicit polynomial constructions yield 13 quantum codes with verified minimum distances, including a [[255,80,12]] code of rate 80/255.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用循环码的码字和多项式矩阵的子式构建了量子码。该构造使用一个两行三列的矩阵，其子式产生一个满足CSS正交条件的矩阵。研究人员从矩阵元素和子式的最大公约数推导出码的维度，并给出了奇数提升因子的简化公式。通过显式多项式构造，他们得到了13个具有验证最小距离的量子码，其中包括一个[[255,80,12]]码。
authors: Vahid Nourozi, Roxana Smarandache, David G. M. Mitchell

articles.title: Shot- and Noise-Aware Pauli Correlation Encoding for Max-Cut Experiments on IBM Heron Quantum Processor
articles.title_zh: 针对IBM Heron量子处理器上Max-Cut实验的散粒噪声感知Pauli关联编码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19544v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pauli correlation encoding (PCE) encodes m binary variables in the signs of k-body Pauli correlators of n=O(m¹/k) qubits, and trains a parameterized circuit on a relaxed loss of sharpness α. The strongest published schedules sharpen this loss aggressively and are benchmarked with exact expectation values, whereas a quantum computer estimates correlators from a finite number of shots. We show that the sharpness is a hidden shot budget. Since the expected sign of a correlator estimated from S shots, erf(csqrtS/2), agrees with tanh(0.851sqrtS,c) to within 0.019, the edge term of the relaxed loss at α=0.851sqrtS approximately equals, up to a constant, minus twice the cut expected from decoding S shots. This explains why schedules tuned with exact expectation values lose their advantage at realistic budgets, and yields a shot-aware schedule whose final sharpness is set by the shot budget. On five G-set graphs with 800 variables on 13 qubits, this schedule outperforms every published schedule at its target budget in all 150 paired comparisons of the decoded circuit output, owing to the sharpness at 1.6×10⁴ shots and mostly to switching off the regularization at 10³; after a classical bit-swap search, it remains the best on average at 1.6×10⁴ shots. Device noise damps the correlators by a factor s, which amounts to a smaller shot budget s²S. On the IBM Heron processor ibm_fez, an all-to-all ansatz of the type used for the best published G-set results compiles to 835 CZ gates and decodes to a random cut, while our 96-CZ hardware-native circuit, trained in simulation and sharpened to αsimeq0.65,ssqrtS, retains up to 0.919 of the best-known cut. For new circuits, a damping and an offset calibrated on other circuits of the same graph predicted the decoded cuts at 10³ shots to within 0.002.
articles.abstract_zh: Pauli关联编码（PCE）将二元变量编码到Pauli关联器的符号中，并通过参数化电路训练。本文指出，编码中的“锐度”参数实际上是一个隐藏的散粒预算。研究表明，精确期望值调优的调度在实际预算下会失去优势，并提出了一种散粒噪声感知的调度方法。在IBM Heron量子处理器上对Max-Cut实验的评估显示，该调度在给定预算下优于所有已发布的调度。
authors: Achraf Boussahi

articles.title: Cryogenic Multiplexing Control Chip for Superconducting Quantum Processor
articles.title_zh: 用于超导量子处理器的低温复用控制芯片
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19599v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper proposes a scheme and design of cryogenic multiplexing control chip (MCC) which enables one microwave cable to control many superconducting qubits. Designed based on adjustable inductor, MCC is a non-reciprocal device which generates microwave signals between 4 and 8 GHz and constructs XY control circuit to operate qubits. The effects of filters, isolators, power splitters, qubits and load impedance on MCC are analyzed in the frequency-domain simulation. And in time-domain simulation, the response time, Gaussian pulses, single-sideband, amplitude and frequency compensation of MCC are examined. The MCC can be integrated with the superconducting qubits on the same package at 20 mK temperature stage, and output specific microwave pulses used to drive the superconducting qubits without crosstalks. The MCC can greatly reduce the number of microwave control lines and is beneficial to the development of large-scale superconducting quantum processor.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出并设计了一种低温复用控制芯片（MCC），旨在通过一根微波电缆控制多个超导量子比特。该MCC基于可调电感设计，是一个非互易器件，能产生4-8 GHz的微波信号并构建XY控制电路。仿真结果表明，MCC能够与超导量子比特集成在同一封装中，在20 mK温度下输出特定微波脉冲以驱动量子比特而无串扰。该芯片有望大幅减少微波控制线的数量，从而促进大规模超导量子处理器的发展。
authors: Rutian Huang, Xiao Geng, Xinyu Wu, Genting Dai, Liangliang Yang, Jianshe Liu, Wei Chen

articles.title: Transport Information Beyond Strong Eigenstate Thermalization
articles.title_zh: 超越强本征态热化理论的输运信息
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19675v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strong eigenstate thermalization (ETH) in operationally mean-ergodic, non-chaotic systems provides an opportunity to investigate whether Floquet eigenstates retain information about classical transport beyond their leading thermodynamic behavior. We address this question using the double kicked top (DKT), which exhibits nonmixing transport and dynamics consistent with weak mixing transport under variation of its control parameters. We show that the coefficient m of the leading finite-size correction to the normalized eigenstate entanglement entropy (EE) s tracks the restructuring between these transport regimes even when the thermodynamic-limit entropy c becomes nearly insensitive to them. This coefficient m is positive for nonmixing transport and negative when dynamics consistent with weak mixing transport dominate. The coefficient's sign reversal in the coexistence regime remains stable as the semiclassical resolution increases. Our results demonstrate that finite-size eigenstate structure can encode signatures of classical transport that are invisible in the thermodynamic-limit entropy, providing an eigenstate-based diagnostic of dynamical organization beyond the leading thermodynamic behavior associated with strong ETH.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在强本征态热化（ETH）系统中，Floquet本征态是否保留了超越其主要热力学行为的经典输运信息。研究使用双踢陀螺（DKT）模型，发现归一化本征态纠缠熵（EE）的前导有限尺寸修正系数m，即使在热力学极限熵对输运机制不敏感时，也能追踪不同输运机制之间的重构。该系数的符号变化揭示了经典输运的特征，这些特征在热力学极限熵中是不可见的。
authors: Avadhut V. Purohit, Harshit Sharma, Udaysinh T. Bhosale

articles.title: Acoustic scattering from quantum dynamics
articles.title_zh: 基于量子动力学的声学散射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19873v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scattering of sound waves propagating in a compressible fluid is linked to the quantum dynamics generated by a class of non-Hermitian Hamiltonian operators. The scattering amplitude is expressed in terms of the corresponding evolution operator. This is used to provide a new proof of the reciprocity theorem in acoustic scattering, conduct analytic low-frequency acoustic scattering calculations, and study the scattering of sound waves by a finite planar array of delta-function point scatters embedded in an infinite acoustic slab. A detailed discussion of acoustic scattering properties of a homogeneous acoustic slab including a pair of delta-function point scatters on one of its faces is provided.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将可压缩流体中声波的散射与一类非厄米哈密顿算子产生的量子动力学联系起来。散射振幅用相应的演化算子表示，并用于重新证明声学散射中的互易定理。研究人员进行了低频声学散射的解析计算，并探讨了无限声学平板中嵌入的有限平面阵列点散射体的声波散射。该工作为理解声学散射提供了新的量子动力学视角。
authors: Farhang Loran, Ali Mostafazadeh

articles.title: Trading energy for coherence in mode discrimination
articles.title_zh: 模式判别中能量与相干性的权衡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19897v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Energy is arguably the main resource in classical physics; coherence is the prototypical quantum resource. In this paper, we study the interplay between these two resources in the task of optimal mode discrimination. This task, motivated by cryptography and metrology, consists of finding in which mode a signal has been encoded, for a given finite set of possible modes. After recalling that the task can be cast as a semi-definite program, we solve completely the case of two-mode discrimination under a hard energy constraint nłeq N. Specifically, we identify the region of modes overlap, for which the maximal energy state (the Fock state with N excitations) is the best choice for discrimination. For other overlaps, having access to coherence leads to better discrimination.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在最优模式判别任务中，能量和相干性这两种资源之间的相互作用。该任务旨在识别信号被编码在哪种模式中。研究人员完全解决了在严格能量约束下双模式判别的情况，并确定了模式重叠区域，在此区域内最大能量态是最佳选择。对于其他重叠情况，利用相干性可以实现更好的判别性能。
authors: Shuyang Meng, Valerio Scarani

articles.title: Single and coupled quantum van der Pol oscillators: Wigner-function dynamics, exact qutrit solutions, and synchronization
articles.title_zh: 单个和耦合量子范德波尔振荡器：Wigner函数动力学、精确三能级解和同步
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19904v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study quantum van der Pol oscillator in which single-photon pumping competes with a nonlinear two-photon dissipative channel to produce a quantum limit cycle, and the question of how two such oscillators with non-identical intrinsic frequencies synchronize in the sense of phase locking when coupled dissipatively to one another. For a single oscillator, starting from a Lindblad description of the dynamics, we derive the exact Wigner-function evolution equation, and show that its Fokker--Planck approximation admits in the appropriate regime an equivalent classical Itô stochastic description that reproduces remarkably well the full Lindblad dynamics. Notably, the stochastic approach provides an efficient means of capturing system dynamics in the semiclassical regime, where a large number of energy eigenstates contribute and direct numerical simulations become computationally demanding. Restricting to the three lowest Fock states and using a parity symmetry, we obtain in closed form the stationary-state density matrix and its Wigner-function representation that displays pronounced nonclassical features. For two non-identical oscillators, we study the full Lindblad dynamics numerically and characterize synchronization through the stationary-state order parameter as a function of frequency mismatch and dissipative coupling. We find that increasing the effective nonlinear dissipative strength suppresses the synchronized region. Restricting the two oscillators to the three-level qutrit subspace, a parity symmetry reduces the stationary-state problem to an exact 41-dimensional linear system, allowing to compute the synchronization order parameter. In this reduced description, results in the limit of large dissipation agree closely with those from the full dynamics, while exhibiting in the limit of small dissipation a double-peak synchronization structure accompanied by a phase reversal.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了单个和耦合量子范德波尔振荡器，其中单光子泵浦与非线性双光子耗散通道竞争以产生量子极限环。对于单个振荡器，研究人员推导了精确的Wigner函数演化方程，并展示了其Fokker-Planck近似在适当条件下可由经典Itô随机描述很好地再现。对于两个非相同振荡器，研究探讨了它们在耗散耦合下如何实现锁相同步。
authors: Rohitashwa Chattopadhyay, Vinayak Pendse, Shamik Gupta

articles.title: On the structure of low-rank PPT entangled states violating Peres conjecture
articles.title_zh: 违反Peres猜想的低秩PPT纠缠态的结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19905v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bound-entangled states with positive partial transpose (PPT) can exhibit quantum steering and Bell nonlocality, disproving the long-standing Peres conjecture and its stronger steering counterpart. These counterexamples, obtained through explicit constructions or numerical searches, raise the question of whether they share a common structural origin. We address this question in the low-rank regime by asking whether known counterexamples can be obtained, up to invertible local filtering, from the complement of an unextendible product basis (UPB). We find that the answer depends crucially on the local dimension. In 3øtimes3, the rank-four structure of PPT entangled states implies that both the steerable PPT state of Moroder et al. and the Bell-nonlocal PPT state of Vértesi and Brunner can be obtained from UPB-complement states under invertible local filtering. For three qubits, in contrast, rank-four states that are PPT across every bipartition are separable across each cut. Moreover, comparison of the product-vector structure of the relevant kernels shows that the known three-qubit Bell-nonlocal PPT states cannot be obtained by invertible local filtering from the complement of any three-qubit UPB. Going beyond rank four, we further show that a known rank-eight three-qutrit state, supported on the complement of a UPB and PPT across every bipartition, is genuinely multipartite entangled. These results show that UPBs provide a unifying structural origin for important low-rank PPT entangled states in 3øtimes3, but that nonlocal bound entanglement is not, in general, a UPB phenomenon.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有正部分转置（PPT）的束缚纠缠态可以表现出量子导引和贝尔非局域性，从而反驳了Peres猜想。本文在低秩状态下探讨了这些反例是否具有共同的结构起源，即它们是否可以通过可逆局部滤波从不可扩展乘积基（UPB）的补集获得。研究发现，答案关键取决于局部维度。在3x3系统中，已知的可导引和贝尔非局域PPT态可以从UPB补集态获得，但在三量子比特系统中则不能。
authors: Gurvir Singh, Manik Banik

articles.title: Quantum Folding in Chebyshev-Based Quantum Subspace Diagonalization
articles.title_zh: 基于切比雪夫量子子空间对角化中的量子折叠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19922v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum subspace diagonalization (QSD) with a Krylov space spanned by Chebyshev polynomials of the Hamiltonian is a natural ground-state method for fault-tolerant quantum computers, but every guarantee it offers---convergence rate, noise floor, and the cost of turning its classical output back into a physical state---is controlled by the overlap of the reference state with the true ground state, which decays exponentially with system size for any product state and non-trivial Hamiltonian. We propose quantum folding: for a system governed by a local Hamiltonian, seed the QSD with the product of the ground states of its subsystems, which differs from the target only through the interface terms. We prove a nonasymptotic error bound for the Chebyshev QSD that is linear in the measurement noise, by transplanting Kirby's effective-Hamiltonian analysis to the Chebyshev--Krylov basis, and identify the block-encoding rescaling of the Hamiltonian as a parameter of the guarantee. Exact simulations of antiferromagnetic Heisenberg chains show that the folded reference state reduces the Krylov dimension for a given accuracy severalfold and lowers the error under noise by two to five orders of magnitude relative to the Néel state. We show how the Ritz vector is prepared as a physical state and that the ground-state generation probability obeys a tight ceiling set by the overlap, so that recursive folding prepares ground states at polynomial cost. Taken together, these results allow for a scalable QSD framework that avoids the exponentially small ground-state overlaps associated with conventional product-state initialization. Finally we compute the fold fidelity itself: a slow power law for the gapless spin-1/2 chain, a size-independent constant for the gapped spin-1 chain, and an exact closed form converging to 1/4 for the AKLT chain.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子子空间对角化（QSD）是一种用于容错量子计算机的基态方法，但其性能受参考态与真实基态重叠的限制。本文提出了“量子折叠”方法，通过将子系统的基态乘积作为QSD的初始参考态。研究证明了切比雪夫QSD的非渐近误差界限与测量噪声呈线性关系。对反铁磁海森堡链的精确模拟表明，折叠参考态能显著降低达到给定精度所需的Krylov维度。
authors: Seung Park, Dongni Chen, Stefano Chesi, Kyunghyun Baek, Mahn-Soo Choi

articles.title: Deterministic and Programmable Fusion for Scalable Generation of Photonic Graph States
articles.title_zh: 用于可扩展生成光子图态的确定性可编程融合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19927v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Entanglement in multiphoton graph states is an important resource with various applications, such as measurement-based quantum computing and memory-less quantum repeaters. While some primitive instances have been successfully prepared, scalable generation of large-scale graph states with programmable connections remains an outstanding challenge. Fusion provides a promising "divide-and-conquer" approach by linking smaller resource states into larger, more complex graphs. However, its practical scalability has been limited by the probabilistic nature of conventional fusion protocols, which necessitates extensive hardware overhead and feed-forward resources to achieve deterministic outcomes. Here, we introduce and experimentally demonstrate a deterministic fusion operation with built-in error mitigation, capable of connecting small time-bin-encoded cluster states--originally generated on-demand from a quantum emitter--into larger, reconfigurable photonic graph states of increased sizes. The fusion operation is realized by nondestructively projecting pairs of flying microwave photonic qubits into Bell states using superconducting circuits with in-situ programmability. Crucially, the protocol features active reset and reuse of matter qubits during graph state generation, thereby circumventing the coherence constraints of the quantum emitter and enabling the generation of genuine multipartite entanglement across 13 photonic qubits. Our results establish a scalable framework for photonic graph-state synthesis, paving the way for fault-tolerant measurement-based quantum computation and distributed quantum networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 多光子图态的纠缠是量子计算和量子中继器中的重要资源，但其可扩展生成仍面临挑战。本文提出并实验演示了一种确定性融合操作，该操作具有内置的错误缓解功能。该方法能够将小型时间编码簇态连接成更大、可重构的光子图态。通过使用超导电路将飞行微波光子量子比特对非破坏性地投影到贝尔态，实现了这一融合操作，为大规模光子图态的生成提供了可扩展的途径。
authors: Yan Li, Yunfan Yang, Zenghui Bao, Jize Yang, Luyan Sun, Yipu Song, Yukai Wu, Hongyi Zhang, Luming Duan

articles.title: Improved Quantum Algorithms for Rényi Entropies Estimation
articles.title_zh: 改进的Rényi熵估计量子算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19936v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Entropy estimation of discrete probability distributions is a fundamental problem in statistical inference and quantum property estimation. In this paper, we study the problem of estimating Rényi entropy H_α(p) for any distribution p = (pᵢ₎ᵢ₌₁ⁿ given its purified quantum query-access. For non-integer α > 1, our algorithm estimates H_α(p) to within additive error ϵ using only widetildeObig(nmax¹/²,¹⁻¹/α/ϵbig) queries, which improves the best known upper bound for dependence on both n and 1/ϵ. For 0<α<1, our algorithm has query complexity widetildeObig(n¹/⁽²α⁾/ϵmax¹,¹/⁽²α⁾big), which improves the dependence on 1/ϵ of the current best upper bound without incresing its n dependence. Our approach adapts the multi-level estimation framework to relative approximation of the power sums and leverage binary search to remove the requirement of prior knowledge of them. We also strengthen the precision-dependent lower bound to Ømegabig(1/ϵmax¹,¹/⁽²α⁾big) for 0<α<1, which identifies the optimal precision dependence of our algorithm.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在给定纯化量子查询访问权限下，估计离散概率分布的Rényi熵H_α(p)的问题。对于非整数α > 1，提出的算法将查询复杂度改进至O(n⁽¹/2) * (1/ϵ)⁽¹⁻¹/α))，提升了对n和1/ϵ的依赖性。对于0 < α < 1，算法的查询复杂度为O(n⁽¹/(2α)) * (1/ϵ)⁽¹/(2α)))，在不增加n依赖性的前提下改进了对1/ϵ的依赖性。该方法通过多级估计框架和二分查找，提高了Rényi熵估计的效率和精度。
authors: Zongxing Xiong, Chengshen Gao, Lvzhou Li

articles.title: Joint-measurement advantage and finite-time transitions in accelerated detector registers
articles.title_zh: 加速探测器寄存器中的联合测量优势和有限时间跃迁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19941v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Unruh response thermalizes accelerated detectors, but the entanglement remaining in a register does not by itself specify what distributed measurements can recover. We study this distinction for a four-qubit cluster state whose two assisting nodes independently undergo generalized amplitude damping, while the target nodes remain isolated and the environments are inaccessible. We derive the exact joint-assisted concurrence and the exact one-way value for arbitrary local measurements. The joint optimum equals the bipartition negativity, and computational-basis measurements attain the one-way optimum. A polar-decomposition argument, together with compactness, establishes a necessary and sufficient condition for separable measurements to attain the joint optimum and proves a strict gap whenever this condition fails. For assisting detectors at equal Unruh temperature with relaxation-rate ratio r>1, joint advantage exists precisely when the thermal excitation factor satisfies q<1/r. At finite positive temperature it ends at a unique finite time, while the remaining entanglement is nonzero. For r=2, both the transition time and remaining resource have closed expressions. These results identify when joint assistance is necessary within the independent weak-coupling thermalization model.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了Unruh响应热化加速探测器后，寄存器中剩余纠缠与分布式测量可恢复信息之间的区别。研究以一个四量子比特簇态为例，推导了精确的联合辅助纠缠和任意局部测量下的单向值。结果表明，当热激发因子q < 1/r时，联合优势存在，并在有限正温度下于一个独特的有限时间结束，而此时剩余纠缠仍非零。该工作揭示了加速探测器系统中纠缠和测量优势的复杂动态。
authors: Zhiming Huang

articles.title: Testing graph isomorphism using simple quantum circuits
articles.title_zh: 使用简单量子电路测试图同构性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19962v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The graph isomorphism problem asks whether two graphs are equivalent up to a permutation of their vertices. Its precise computational complexity remains unresolved, and it is still unknown whether a polynomial-time algorithm exists. We investigate whether simple graph-dependent Instantaneous Quantum Polynomial-time (IQP) and Quantum Approximate Optimisation Algorithm (QAOA) circuits can distinguish non-isomorphic graphs. We first show that suitable IQP and QAOA constructions allow the underlying graph to be reconstructed using a polynomial number of samples. Building on previous work using the QAOA energy, we show that Hamming weight distributions can distinguish graph pairs at circuit depths for which the numerically computed energy gap is zero. We then apply graph invariants to the matrix of ZZ correlators on the output distribution. For the specific case of the graph spectrum, at QAOA depth p=2, this invariant numerically distinguishes all 10,486 cospectral regular graph pairs tested on up to 18 vertices. For IQP circuits, we introduce a finer invariant based on probability multiplicities within Hamming weight sectors, which distinguishes every non-isomorphic graph pair tested numerically. Finally, we derive exact graph-theoretic characterisations of the IQP output distribution at θ=π/2 and θ=π/4. These results show that simple graph-dependent quantum circuits encode substantial structural information, while leaving open whether this information can be extracted efficiently for general graph isomorphism.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨了简单的图依赖瞬时量子多项式时间（IQP）和量子近似优化算法（QAOA）电路能否区分非同构图。研究表明，合适的IQP和QAOA结构可以通过多项式数量的样本重建底层图。此外，通过汉明权重分布和图不变量，这些电路在特定深度下能够区分图对。例如，在QAOA深度p=2时，数值上区分了所有测试的10,486对余谱正则图。
authors: Samuel Beasley, Ashley Montanaro

articles.title: Hyperentanglement in intermediate phase-space planes: benchmarking a photon-pair source for quantum key distribution
articles.title_zh: 中间相空间平面中的超纠缠：用于量子密钥分发的双光子源基准测试
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20005v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We characterize a source of photon pairs simultaneously entangled in polarization and in the transverse spatial degree of freedom, with the spatial measurements performed in intermediate planes of the fractional Fourier transform. The source consists of two crossed type-I crystals in a non-collinear geometry, such that the transverse variables carry information about the crystal of origin. Detection in the crystal plane reveals this information completely and destroys the polarization entanglement, so that a scheme using the near and far fields as conjugate spatial bases cannot support a parallel polarization channel. In intermediate planes both spatial bases combine position and momentum, such that the which-crystal information is partially erased, and the polarization entanglement survives in all four combinations of spatial bases. Applying Bell and Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen criteria to the same photon pairs certifies both degrees of freedom simultaneously. We evaluate quantum bit error rates and asymptotic secret key rates in each degree of freedom, and find that the source delivers two simultaneously usable channels per photon pair.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文表征了一种在偏振和横向空间自由度上同时纠缠的双光子源，其空间测量在分数傅里叶变换的中间平面进行。研究发现，在这些中间平面中，空间基底结合了位置和动量信息，部分消除了“哪个晶体”的信息，从而使偏振纠缠在所有四种空间基底组合中得以保留。通过评估量子比特错误率和渐近秘密密钥率，该光源为每个光子对提供了两个可同时使用的通道。
authors: Murilo H. Magiotto, Millena B. Novaes, Wesley B. Cardoso, Ardiley T. Avelar, 1 Paulo H. Souto Ribeiro, Stephen P. Walborn, Guilherme L. Zanin, Rafael M. Gomes

articles.title: Multi-Instantons and Exact-WKB Stokes Jumps in Multi-Well Quantum Mechanics
articles.title_zh: 多阱量子力学中的多瞬子与精确WKB斯托克斯跳跃
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20006v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the relation between the exact-WKB Delabaere--Dillinger--Pham Stokes jumps and the multi-instanton expansion of a one-dimensional potential with N equal-depth minima. For a single barrier this relation is the Bogomolny--Zinn-Justin cancellation between the instanton--anti-instanton ambiguity and the Borel ambiguity of perturbation theory, and we extend it to every consecutive barrier interval and to the integration contours themselves. In the dilute large-T regime at fixed nonperturbative grade, we derive the quasi-zero mode integral over the instanton separations from the Euclidean path integral and reduce it to Gamma and Hankel periods. With the local Weber level function of each well and one normalization per well fixed by the local Weber connection matrix, these periods reproduce the two lateral connected exact-WKB coefficients. The two lateral contours of each instanton--anti-instanton separation differ by exactly one Hankel cycle, and this linear Picard--Lefschetz relation reproduces the Stokes jump of the connected coefficient. A numerical solution of the Schrödinger equation for a symmetric triple well confirms the resulting two-barrier level splitting. At higher fixed grade, the map from ordered event sequences to normalized scalar coefficient products is not one-to-one. At leading dilute order the scalar weight of a closed event sequence depends only on the numbers of barrier crossings, mathcal Ibarmathcal I pairs, and mathcal Imathcal I/barmathcal Ibarmathcal I pairs. We construct two inequivalent grade-six triple-well event sequences with the same product of local Weber amplitudes, which embed in every potential with Nge3 wells. Our results hold within the regular dilute, one-loop, local Weber approximation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了精确WKB Delabaere-Dillinger-Pham斯托克斯跳跃与具有N个等深势阱的一维势的多瞬子展开之间的关系。研究将单势垒的Bogomolny-Zinn-Justin抵消关系推广到每个连续势垒区间和积分路径。在稀疏大T区域，从欧几里得路径积分推导出瞬子分离的准零模积分，并将其简化为Gamma和Hankel周期。数值求解对称三阱薛定谔方程的结果证实了这些关系。
authors: Alireza Behtash, Syo Kamata

articles.title: Pinning of a High-Energy Wavepacket by a Single Impurity
