articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20096v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The single-mode approximation (SMA) has been widely employed in ultracold spinor gases, where all spin components share the same spatial mode. By adopting generalized Van Vleck (GVV) perturbation theory, we achieve a relative error of 10⁻⁶ in the ground-state energy with a reduced effective Hilbert space dimension of sim 10³ for two spin-1 bosons confined in a one-dimensional hard-wall trap. With the accurate GVV method, we explore the validity of the SMA across ground-state properties and quench spin dynamics for two ⁷Li, ⁸⁷Rb, or ²³Na atoms. Numerical results show that the quadratic Zeeman energy q provides a powerful control knob: by increasing |q|, the fidelity between the spin components in the ground state gradually decreases, leading eventually to the breakdown of the SMA (due to the competition between the kinetic energy and the quadratic Zeeman energy). Quench spin dynamics with abruptly increased q further reveals multiple resonances, where the SMA-predicted micromotion and beyond-SMA macromotion appear simultaneously. These results point to a direction to investigate the quantum spin-mixing dynamics beyond the SMA, particularly in recent experiments of strongly interacting spin-1 atomic gases.
articles.abstract_zh: 单模近似（SMA）在超冷旋量气体中被广泛应用。本研究采用广义Van Vleck微扰理论，精确计算了受限在硬壁陷阱中的两个自旋-1玻色子的基态能量。研究发现，二次塞曼能量q是一个强大的控制旋钮，增加|q|会导致基态中自旋分量之间的保真度逐渐降低，最终导致SMA失效。骤然增加q的猝灭自旋动力学进一步揭示了多个共振，其中SMA预测的微观运动和超越SMA的宏观运动同时出现。
authors: Yanhong Liu, Fulin Deng, Haoxue Qiao, Wenxian Zhang

articles.title: Transport regimes in tunnel ferromagnetic Josephson junctions
articles.title_zh: 隧道铁磁约瑟夫森结中的输运机制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20268v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a systematic study of the temperature-dependent transport properties of Nb- and Al-based superconductor--insulator--thin superconductor--ferromagnet--superconductor (SIsFS) Josephson junctions. By varying the superconducting material and the thickness of the intermediate superconducting layer, we identify three distinct transport regimes: a tunnel-dominated SIS-like regime, a temperature-driven crossover, and a complex weak-link regime. A unified Usadel-based description connects these regimes through the self-consistent pair potential of the intermediate s-layer. While for Al-based devices an SIS-like transport regime is observed, a self-consistent calculation of the s/F/S proximity electrode, combined with perturbative tunnel coupling to the outer electrode, accounts for Nb devices with different thickness of the superconducting interlayer. The calculation places the 10-nm-interlayer sample in a proximity-supported, strongly suppressed s state, close to the SInFS limit in which the interlayer is effectively driven normal (n). A reduced nonlinear long-junction description captures the same limiting physics. The evolution of I_cR_N(T) thereby provides a direct experimental signature of the three transport regimes. Beyond the fundamental interest, the results establish practical design guidelines: Nb junctions with sufficiently thick s interlayers are well suited for high-speed cryogenic memory elements and tunable superconducting parametric amplifiers, while Al junctions are natural candidates for coherent superconducting quantum circuits
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究系统地考察了基于Nb和Al的超导体-绝缘体-薄超导体-铁磁体-超导体（SIsFS）约瑟夫森结的温度依赖性输运特性。通过改变超导材料和中间超导层的厚度，作者识别出三种不同的输运机制：隧道主导的SIS类机制、温度驱动的交叉机制和复杂的弱连接机制。统一的Usadel描述通过中间s层的自洽对势将这些机制联系起来。
authors: R. Satariano, A. A. Golubov, E. Raja, R. Ferraiuolo, F. Calloni, H. G. Ahmad, A. Vettoliere, N. Poccia, L. Parlato, G. Ausanio, C. Granata, G. P. Pepe, M. Yu. Kupriyanov, F. Tafuri, D. Montemurro, D. Massarotti

articles.title: Orbitronics in Zero-dimensional Graphene Nanoflakes via Electrode Coupling
articles.title_zh: 通过电极耦合在零维石墨烯纳米片中实现轨道电子学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20454v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that graphene nanoflakes realize a previously unexplored form of orbitronics in which orbital currents emerge in the absence of intrinsic angular momentum of the constituent atoms. Starting with a hexagonal graphene nanoflake, we demonstrate the presence of energy-degenerate eigenstates with opposite non-zero expectation values of the angular momentum. Placing electrodes in an appropriate configuration on the flake couples the reservoirs more strongly to one of the two opposite-angular-momentum states, yielding a chiral current that carries a net orbital angular momentum. The resulting circulating orbital currents generate magnetic fringe fields that are experimentally accessible with spin centers or superconducting quantum interference magnetometers, providing avenues for their experimental realization. Finally, our work establishes a new platform for exploring and studying orbitronics in zero-dimensional systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究展示了石墨烯纳米片实现了一种前所未有的轨道电子学形式，其中轨道电流在组成原子没有本征角动量的情况下产生。通过在纳米片上放置适当配置的电极，可以更强地耦合到两个具有相反角动量期望值的简并本征态之一，从而产生携带净轨道角动量的手性电流。这些循环轨道电流产生的磁场可以通过自旋中心或超导量子干涉磁力计进行实验探测，为零维系统中的轨道电子学研究提供了新平台。
authors: Washington F. dos Santos, Eudes Gomes da Silva, Denis R. Candido, Alexandre Reily Rocha

articles.title: Magnetic Susceptibility of Superconducting Films in the Meissner-London Regime
articles.title_zh: 迈斯纳-伦敦态下超导薄膜的磁化率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20455v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Extracting the London penetration depth, łambda(T), from the measured magnetic susceptibility, ḩi(T), of a superconducting platelet in a perpendicular magnetic field requires knowing the function ḩi(łambda) computed for the actual sample geometry. Thin films are increasingly important in quantum computing and superconducting electronics, most of which operate at ultra-low excitation fields in the vortex-free regime. Understanding their electromagnetic response in the Meissner--London (finite-łambda, no vortices) state is therefore essential for extracting intrinsic properties such as the London penetration depth and superfluid phase stiffness. While numerous prior works have addressed different aspects of this problem, here we focus on providing an analytical semi-empirical representation of ḩi(łambda) based on the 2D sheet-current model and establishing the limits of its applicability using two independent full 3D numerical solutions: finite-element modeling and a volume-current integral equation. As a result, we provide ḩi(łambda) for a disc of radius a and thickness d in closed form, valid for all łambda and for aspect ratios δequiv d/(2a)łe0.05, and accurate to 0.1%. The two-dimensional sheet description with Pearl length Łambda=2łambda²/d is adequate for δ łesssim10⁻⁴ and łambda gtrsim 4d. Thicker films require the full closed form, which includes the three-dimensional corrections. Using the same numerical analysis, we provide an empirical formula that maps rectangular samples---the geometry most commonly used in experiments---onto a disc with an ``effective radius'' for subsequent calculation of ḩi(łambda), and formulate a complete calibration protocol for whole-sample susceptibility measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 从超导薄片在垂直磁场中测得的磁化率中提取伦敦穿透深度，需要了解针对实际样品几何形状计算的磁化率函数。本研究旨在提供基于二维薄片电流模型的磁化率函数解析半经验表示，并利用两种独立的完整三维数值解建立其适用范围。最终，作者给出了半径a、厚度d的圆盘在所有伦敦穿透深度和纵横比下都有效的磁化率函数闭合形式。
authors: Ruslan Prozorov

articles.title: Landau quantization of C₃ high-fold fermions in honeycomb lattices
articles.title_zh: 蜂窝晶格中C₃高重费米子的朗道量子化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20595v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present the theory of the Landau levels of C₃ high-fold fermions in honeycomb lattices. These fermions arise as a generalization of the tight-binding model in a honeycomb lattice with one orbital per site, known to describe graphene, to a family of models with several orbitals per site transforming according to representations of C₃, relevant for triangulene two-dimensional crystals. The models are defined by the number of orbitals nₐ and n_b at the a and b sites of the unit cell. They feature energy bands that combine flat bands and Dirac cones, that are isomorphic to those of graphene, the Lieb, pₓy honeycomb, and the Kagome tight-binding models. Combining tight-binding and kḑot p methods, here we compute the Landau levels of the (1,1), (1,2), (2,2) and (3,3) models, we compare them to those of the reference models, and we explore the similarities and differences with the Landau levels in graphene. Our findings reveal that the nature of C₃ high-fold fermions combine Dirac-type Landau quantization, originating from the linear crossings and associated relativistic band dispersion, with anomalous Landau quantization rooted in the quantum geometry of the singular flat bands.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究提出了蜂窝晶格中C₃高重费米子朗道能级的理论。这些费米子是石墨烯紧束缚模型的推广，适用于具有多个轨道且按C₃表示变换的晶体模型。通过结合紧束缚和k·p方法，作者计算了(1,1)、(1,2)、(2,2)和(3,3)模型的朗道能级，并与参考模型和石墨烯中的朗道能级进行了比较。研究结果揭示了C₃高重费米子的性质结合了狄拉克型朗道量子化和异常朗道量子化。
authors: Luisa Madail, Joaquín Fernández-Rossier

articles.title: Nodal nematic superconductivity in moiré graphene
articles.title_zh: 莫尔石墨烯中的节点向列超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20605v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Unconventional superconductivity can emerge in various forms in strongly correlated systems. Historically, the most extensively studied examples include nodal and triplet pairing, which were experimentally detected in cuprates and superfluid helium-3, respectively. Beyond these canonical cases, there are also nematic superconductors, in which the rotational symmetry of the lattice is broken in the superconducting state. While there are several examples of nematic superconductors whose pairing emerges inside a preexisting nematic normal state, experimental evidence for superconducting states that intrinsically break rotational symmetry on their own has been exceedingly scarce. Here, we report the experimental realization and identification of an intrinsic multi-component nodal nematic superconducting state in magic-angle twisted trilayer graphene (MATTG). By integrating tunneling spectroscopy with quantum transport measurements, we directly probe the symmetry of low-energy superconducting quasiparticles. Deep inside the superconducting state, we observe a pronounced two-fold anisotropy in the zero-bias tunneling conductance under an in-plane magnetic field, which is strongly suppressed together with superconductivity as the temperature or perpendicular magnetic field is increased. Remarkably, the major axis of anisotropy rotates by up to 90ⁱ̧rc across the superconducting dome, indicating an intrinsic, field- and density-tunable symmetry of the low-energy excitations. These behaviors imply a nodal superconducting state in MATTG that spontaneously breaks the six-fold rotational symmetry of the moiré superlattice. Our results establish moiré graphene as a versatile platform for realizing and interrogating nodal nematic superconductivity, opening a new avenue for exploring unconventional symmetry-breaking superconducting states in two-dimensional materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 非常规超导性在强关联系统中以多种形式出现，其中节点和三重态配对是研究最广泛的例子。本研究报告了在魔角扭曲三层石墨烯（MATTG）中本征多组分节点向列超导态的实验实现和识别。通过结合隧道光谱和量子输运测量，作者直接探测了低能超导准粒子的对称性。在超导态深处，观察到零偏压隧道电导在面内磁场下表现出显著的二重各向异性。

articles.title: Anomalies, higher symmetries, and homotopy theory I: crossed precosheaves and a nonabelian Cech construction
articles.title_zh: 异常、高阶对称性与同伦理论 I：交叉预余层与非阿贝尔切赫构造
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19004v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Symmetries of a quantum field theory or a quantum lattice model are expected to be described not by a group but by a homotopy type, whose homotopy groups are the higher symmetry groups and whose Postnikov invariants encode 't Hooft anomalies. We propose a homotopy-theoretic definition of 't Hooft anomalies based on the structure of localized symmetries in the operator-algebraic approach. The input is a crossed precosheaf: a collection of groups attached to regions of space, equipped with pairings recording that the commutator of two transformations localized in two regions is localized in their intersection. To a crossed precosheaf and a finite family of regions we attach a pointed connected homotopy type, the Cech-Loday classifying space. As the family of regions ranges over finite covers of space, the classifying spaces form a pro-object in the homotopy category. There is a canonical map from the ordinary classifying space of the symmetry group to this pro-type. Composing this map with a group action gives an anomaly whose nontriviality obstructs gauging. In favorable cases, the Cech-Loday space is essentially independent of the cover. In such cases, the homotopy fiber of the canonical map is a candidate for the classifying space of the higher group of symmetries. We give examples of crossed precosheaves arising from gauge transformations in continuum field theory and from quantum cellular automata and finite-depth circuits. For quantum spin systems in one and two dimensions, our construction recovers the Else-Nayak index and its generalizations to two dimensions.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子场论或量子格点模型的对称性预计由同伦类型描述，其同伦群是高阶对称群，Postnikov不变量编码't Hooft异常。本研究基于算子代数方法中局域对称性的结构，提出了't Hooft异常的同伦理论定义。输入是一个交叉预余层，即附着于空间区域的群集合，并配备了记录两个局域变换的交换子局域于其交集的配对。作者将一个有指向的连通同伦类型（Cech-Loday分类空间）附加到交叉预余层和有限区域族上，并指出其非平凡性阻碍了规范化。
authors: Anton Kapustin, Shixiong Xu

articles.title: High-Harmonic Generation Probes Quantum Nuclear Fluctuations in Liquid Water
articles.title_zh: 高次谐波产生探测液态水中的量子核涨落
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19967v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Nuclear quantum effects are essential for an accurate description of the hydrogen-bonded structure of liquid water, yet their spectroscopic signatures can be subtle and difficult to measure. Moreover, probing these effects in solution on femtosecond timescales (or below) is an open challenge that is pivotal for optical control of hydrogen bonds and ultrafast spectroscopy of proton transfer. Here, we combine path-integral molecular dynamics with real-time time-dependent density-functional theory to explore high-harmonic generation (HHG) in liquid water from first principles, rigorously accounting for quantum nuclear delocalisation. Relative to classical-nuclei simulations, quantum sampling suppresses the harmonic yield around certain harmonics by up to an order of magnitude, inducing local structural minima. By analysing the ab initio simulations and reproducing the key effects with a simplified model Hamiltonian, we trace the physical origins of the interference minima to the broadening of valence-band states induced by hydrogen-bond fluctuations, a mechanism expected to generalise to other hydrogen-bonded structures. Our work shows that nuclear quantum effects are indispensable for capturing ultrafast electronic dynamics in liquids, and demonstrates the power of liquid HHG spectroscopy for attosecond probing of nuclear fluctuations.
articles.abstract_zh: 核量子效应对于准确描述液态水的氢键结构至关重要，但其光谱特征难以测量。本研究结合路径积分分子动力学和实时含时密度泛函理论，从第一性原理探索液态水中的高次谐波产生，并严格考虑了量子核离域化。结果显示，量子采样能显著抑制谐波产额，并诱导局部结构最小值。该工作将干涉最小值归因于氢键涨落引起的价带态展宽，为理解氢键结构中的量子核效应提供了新视角。

articles.title: Fluctuation-driven multi-step charge density wave melting in monolayer TiSe₂
articles.title_zh: 涨落驱动的单层TiSe₂中电荷密度波多步熔化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.20355v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The exact microscopic origin, symmetry, and thermal melting mechanism of the charge density wave (CDW) phase in TiSe₂ remain intensely debated, particularly regarding chiral structural order and multi-step phase transitions. Using large-scale molecular dynamics driven by an accurate machine-learning interatomic potential, we resolve the finite-temperature structural dynamics of the monolayer TiSe₂. We demonstrate that CDW melting deviates from conventional mean-field second-order behavior, undergoing a two-step process characterized by an extended fluctuation region (200-250 K) with proliferating domain walls, phase decoherence, component-selective melting, and an overdamped soft optical phonon. Furthermore, anisotropic long-wavelength thermal fluctuations spontaneously stabilize an asymmetric 3Q CDW order with P1 symmetry. These findings provide a unified microscopic framework for fluctuation-driven transitions in 2D quantum materials, demonstrating that the complex CDW physics of TiSe₂ is captured entirely via non-perturbative electron-phonon and phonon-phonon interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: TiSe₂中电荷密度波（CDW）相的微观起源、对称性和热熔化机制仍存在激烈争议。本研究利用大规模分子动力学模拟，揭示了单层TiSe₂在有限温度下的结构动力学。结果表明，CDW熔化偏离了传统的平均场二阶行为，经历了一个两步过程，包括一个扩展的涨落区域。这些发现为二维量子材料中的涨落驱动相变提供了统一的微观框架。

articles.title: The thermopower properties of interacting systems
articles.title_zh: 相互作用系统的热电势特性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.14225v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Seebeck coefficient quantifies the voltage generated across a material in response to a temperature gradient. Recent studies have shown that strong electronic correlations can enhance this coefficient, producing anomalous behavior near half-filling associated with the Mott plateau. This raises the possibility that other interaction scales, not necessarily originating in Mott physics, could give rise to similar enhancements. Here, we investigate the Seebeck coefficient in the presence of attractive interactions, nearest-neighbor interactions, sublattice potentials, and electron-phonon coupling. The Seebeck coefficient is obtained via the Kelvin formula, using entropy data derived from density calculations within determinant quantum Monte Carlo (DQMC). We find that these additional interaction scales can indeed enhance the Seebeck coefficient and further induce multiple sign changes as a function of doping. We show that this anomalous behavior is associated with the opening of a gap in the ground state, as computed via cluster perturbation theory (CPT). Moreover, electron-phonon coupling alone-even in the absence of on-site repulsion-can produce a Seebeck anomaly. We relate these sign changes to a restructuring of the Fermi surface and an accompanying change in its topology, an effect commonly observed in cuprates.

authors: M. A. Habitzreuter, Willdauany C. de Freitas da Silva, Rodrigo A. Fontenele, Natanael C. Costa, Thereza Paiva

articles.title: High-Girth QLDPC Codes from Circulant and Affine Permutation Matrices
articles.title_zh: 基于循环和仿射置换矩阵的高围长QLDPC码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19451v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study two explicit constructions of binary Calderbank--Shor--Steane quantum low-density parity-check (QLDPC) codes with check weight six. The first uses a fixed circulant shift pattern and yields parameters o̧de6N2N+26 with Tanner graph girth twelve for N=31 and every Nge37. A graph incidence interpretation gives the ranks and girths, and a uniform weight six logical operator establishes the exact distance. The second construction uses fixed matrix polynomials with circulant and affine permutation coefficients. Here, a polynomial commutation identity guarantees orthogonality for every cyclic lift. Four realizations give [[192,16,8]], [[288,16,12]], [[384,16,14]], and [[576,32,20]], with Tanner girth eight and computationally certified distances. We give reproducible construction data, distinguish classical cycle distance from quantum distance, and identify the limitations of both families.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了两种构造校验权重为六的二元Calderbank-Shor-Steane量子低密度奇偶校验（QLDPC）码的方法。第一种方法使用固定的循环移位模式，为特定N值生成具有围长为十二的Tanner图的QLDPC码。第二种方法利用具有循环和仿射置换系数的固定矩阵多项式，保证了正交性。该工作提供了可复现的构造数据，并指出了这两种码族的局限性。
authors: Vahid Nourozi, Roxana Smarandache, David G. M. Mitchelldag

articles.title: Analog Cosmology in a Quenched Bose-Einstein Condensate Bubble
articles.title_zh: 淬火玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体气泡中的模拟宇宙学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20382v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent interest and realization of ultracold bosons confined in shell-shaped, or bubble, traps have opened up several directions in the study of Bose-Einstein condensates (BECs) in intrinsically curved geometries. Here, we explore the prospect of using thin spherical shell-shaped BECs as analog gravity simulators of an expanding or contracting curved universe. We study an interacting BEC bubble subject to a temporal quench of the interaction strength. Our theoretical approach, which uses a Bogoliubov treatment following a dimensional reduction of a spherical BEC to the low-energy excitations of a shell-shaped structure, demonstrates how this system serves as a laboratory analog for a positively curved universe having a time-varying scale factor. We investigate spontaneous pair production triggered by quenches associated with exponentially decaying or growing interaction strengths, focusing on the emergence of oscillations in the structure factor---analogous to Sakharov oscillations in the Cosmic Microwave Background angular power spectrum. We quantify the entanglement of the produced pairs via logarithmic negativity, and show how this measure may be extracted from the power spectrum. These findings establish a bridge between quantum information science and early-universe cosmology in a laboratory setting.

articles.title: Approach to optimal quantum transport via states over time
articles.title_zh: 通过“时间态”实现最优量子输运的方法
articles.abstract: Quantum 10, 2236 (2026). https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2026-10-14-2236 We approach the problem of constructing a quantum analogue of the immensely fruitful classical transport cost theory of Monge from a new angle. Going back to the original motivations, by which the transport is a bilinear function of a mass distribution (without loss of generality a probability density) and a transport plan (a stochastic kernel), we explore the quantum version where the mass distribution is generalised to a density matrix, and the transport plan to a completely positive and trace preserving map. These two data are naturally integrated into their Jordan product, which is called state over time (“stote''), and the transport cost is postulated to be a linear function of it. We explore the properties of this transport cost, as well as the optimal transport cost between two given states (simply the minimum cost over all suitable transport plans). After that, we analyse in considerable detail the case of unitary invariant cost, for which we can calculate many costs analytically. These findings suggest that our quantum transport cost is qualitatively different from Monge's classical transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从新角度探讨了构建蒙日经典输运成本理论的量子模拟问题。研究将质量分布推广到密度矩阵，输运计划推广到完全正且保迹的映射，并将两者整合为“时间态”。该工作假设输运成本是时间态的线性函数，并详细分析了酉不变成本的情况，发现其与蒙日经典输运成本存在质的差异。

articles.title: Efficient noisy quantum state and process tomography
articles.title_zh: 高效的含噪声量子态和过程层析成像
articles.abstract: Efficiently characterizing large quantum states and processes is a central yet notoriously challenging task in quantum information science, as conventional tomography methods typically require resources that grow exponentially with system size. Here, we introduce a structure-agnostic learning framework for noisy -qubit quantum circuits under i.i.d. single-qubit noise. We first prove that quantum states with unital noise channels admit an efficient learnable representation in the logarithmic-depth regime. We then extend this framework to quantum process tomography under constant noise, deriving a unified protocol that applies to both unital and non-unital noisy channels and retains efficient guarantees for logarithmic-depth circuits. This process-learning formulation is input-agnostic and imposes no distributional assumptions on the input quantum states. We further study a more general regime with arbitrary noise strength. In this setting, low-weight Pauli propagation induces a terminal truncation whose threshold depends logarithmically on the inverse accuracy, leading to quasi-polynomial complexity and near-unit success probability in the average case. In contrast to the preceding two results, this arbitrary-noise guarantee does not impose any restriction on the circuit depth, and therefore covers arbitrary-depth circuits, including both the noiseless limit ( ) and the strong-decoherence regime ( ). Numerical simulations of two-dimensional Hamiltonian dynamics further demonstrate the accuracy and robustness of the approach, including for structured circuits beyond the random-circuit setting assumed in the theoretical analysis. These results provide a scalable and practically relevant route toward characterizing large-scale noisy quantum devices, addressing a key bottleneck in the development of quantum technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统层析成像方法资源需求随系统尺寸呈指数增长，高效表征大型量子态和过程是量子信息科学中的挑战。本文提出了一种结构无关的学习框架，用于处理独立同分布单量子比特噪声下的含噪声量子电路。该框架证明了具有幺正噪声信道的量子态在对数深度范围内可高效学习，并将其推广到恒定噪声下的量子过程层析成像。该方法在平均情况下实现了准多项式复杂度，并具有接近单位的成功概率。
authors: Chenyang Li, Shengxin Zhuang, Yukun Zhang, Jingbo B Wang, Xiao Yuan, Yusen Wu and Chuan Wang

articles.title: Half the interference, most of the answer: approximate quantum simulation via path-sum pruning
articles.title_zh: 一半的干涉，大部分的答案：通过路径和剪枝实现近似量子模拟
articles.abstract: Classical simulation of quantum circuits is expensive for two distinct reasons. The obvious one is state-space size: an -qubit system requires exponentially many amplitudes. The less obvious one is interference: useful output distributions emerge only after many computational histories have been coherently combined at common endpoints, and this aggregation step is itself a substantial source of cost. We introduce statistical interference sampling, a framework that makes this second bottleneck explicit by treating endpoint interference as a separately schedulable computation. Using the Chemical Abstract Machine as our model, weighted path contributions evolve as concurrent molecular species, and interference reactions combine contributions that share a common output state. A threshold rule terminates the process once an endpoint accumulates sufficient amplitude, discarding the remaining reactions. The method does not improve worst-case complexity and is not intended as a general-purpose simulator. Its purpose is to ask a more targeted question: how much of the interference calculation can be skipped while still recovering a useful output distribution? Across repeated independent executions at each threshold, we observe a circuit-dependent tradeoff among endpoint-interference work, task-level success, and distributional fidelity. We use Deutsch–Jozsa as a worked illustration and evaluate the method on Grover search, Simon’s problem, and Shor period-finding. We find that thresholding omits substantial endpoint-interference work while attaining high observed task success. An early-termination policy can attain 100% observed task success on several Grover, Simon, and Shor configurations while omitting up to 65% of the interference work. Circuits with strong amplitude separation, where a large gap exists between the amplitude accumulated at the correct endpoint and the maximum amplitude attainable at any incorrect endpoint, benefit most from thresholding; circuits with flatter output distributions, where valid outputs share comparable amplitudes across many endpoints rather than concentrating probability on a single marked state, are less amenable to this strategy. These results suggest that interference arithmetic is a structured resource that admits meaningful approximation, and that exposing it explicitly opens new opportunities for pruning strategies across path-sum, Pauli-path, and tensor-network simulation methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 经典模拟量子电路的成本高昂，不仅因为状态空间大，还因为干涉计算复杂。本文引入了统计干涉采样框架，将端点干涉视为独立可调度的计算。该方法通过设定阈值来终止计算，以确定在保留有用输出分布的同时可以跳过多少干涉计算。该工作旨在探索在近似量子模拟中优化干涉计算的策略。

articles.title: Empirical Scaling Laws of Quantum Vision Transformers
articles.title_zh: 量子视觉Transformer的经验缩放定律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13970v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum machine learning (QML) is a promising application of quantum computing, yet when and how practical learning models can achieve quantum advantage remains poorly understood. Even a polynomial improvement in the resources needed to attain a given predictive performance would be significant. In this work, we investigate empirical scaling laws of quantum vision transformers (QViTs), which connect QML to the transformer architecture underlying modern large language models. We ask whether QViTs exhibit scaling behavior analogous to classical models and how this behavior changes when qubit number is included alongside dataset size and model parameters. The validation losses in our numerical image-classification experiments are well described by a joint shifted power-law model in qubit number, transformer depth, and training dataset size. Expressing this fit in terms of the classical encoder parameter budget identifies a regime in which increasing the number of qubits can compensate for fewer classical encoder parameters at comparable predicted performance. This finding is consistent with earlier observations of parameter efficiency in quantum learning models and suggests a direction for exploring possible resource savings in QML.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子机器学习（QML）是量子计算的一个有前景的应用，但其实现量子优势的条件尚不明确。本文研究了量子视觉Transformer（QViTs）的经验缩放定律，将其与经典模型进行比较。数值实验表明，验证损失可以用量子比特数、Transformer深度和训练数据集大小的联合幂律模型很好地描述。研究发现，增加量子比特数可以在预测性能相似的情况下弥补经典编码器参数的不足。

articles.title: Can the Quantum Fisher Effective Dimension Judge a Hybrid Quantum Neural Network?
articles.title_zh: 量子费雪有效维度能否评估混合量子神经网络？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14070v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hybrid quantum neural networks (QNNs) pair a classical feature extractor with a variational quantum circuit, and the effective dimension of the circuit's quantum Fisher information matrix (QFIM) is widely used to assess such models. This scalar is often interpreted as an indicator of trainability or accuracy, although these readings are rarely tested under controlled conditions. We therefore investigate what it actually measures. We define the effective dimension as the participation ratio of the QFIM diagonal, which lies between one and the parameter count, and we evaluate it across two image datasets, four frozen backbones including a random-projection control, four circuit depths on eight qubits, and three seeds. During training, the effective dimension remains well below the parameter count, and its correlation with test accuracy ranges from -0.72 to +0.87, changing sign across seeds in half of the configurations. Increasing depth activates a larger share of the circuit directions, from 0.38 to 0.91 of the parameter count, while the initialization gradient variance remains between 1e-5 and 1e-4, so no barren plateau (BP) appears at eight qubits. At a fixed circuit, the four backbones share an initial effective dimension of 6 to 9, even though CIFAR-10 accuracy ranges from 23.14% to 86.44%. These results show that the effective dimension characterizes circuit geometry rather than model quality. We conclude with a practical protocol that assigns each diagnostic to the question it can answer.
articles.abstract_zh: 混合量子神经网络（QNNs）结合了经典特征提取器和变分量子电路，其量子费雪信息矩阵（QFIM）的有效维度常被用于评估模型。本文研究了有效维度在受控条件下的实际测量意义，将其定义为QFIM对角线的参与比。实验结果表明，有效维度在训练过程中远低于参数数量，且与测试准确率的相关性在不同配置下差异显著。研究还发现，增加电路深度会激活更多电路方向，但未出现贫瘠高原现象。
authors: Md Masum Mia, Amith Khandakar, Mohamed Arselene Ayari

articles.title: Hamiltonian-Dependent Compressibility and Physical Preservation in Approximate Quantum Compilation using Tensor Networks
articles.title_zh: 基于张量网络的近似量子编译中哈密顿量相关的可压缩性和物理信息保持
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14125v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Approximate quantum compilation (AQC) using tensor networks provides a promising route to reducing the circuit resources required for quantum simulation. However, the factors governing the compressibility of many-body dynamics and the extent to which compressed circuits retain physically relevant information on quantum hardware remain poorly understood. We investigate these questions using AQCtensor for an 80-qubit one-dimensional anisotropic XYZ Heisenberg chain initialized in a Néel state. By varying the exchange anisotropy and external magnetic field, we find that compression performance changes systematically with the anisotropic coupling configuration and field orientation. These variations are strongly associated with a nested-commutator measure related to second-order Trotter error, with corresponding directional trends also reflected in the target-state MPS bond dimension. For an 80-qubit quantum-hardware evaluation, AQCtensor compresses a 10-repetition target evolution to 5 repetitions while retaining a target-state fidelity of 0.995474, reducing the total circuit depth by 45.9% and the two-qubit gate count by 47.6%. The compressed circuit exhibits comparable behavior across magnetization, nearest-neighbor correlation, and Hamiltonian expectation measurements, while process-level diagnostics and local reduced-state tomography provide complementary characterization beyond these observables. Together, these results link AQCtensor compressibility to Hamiltonian commutator structure and target-state complexity and demonstrate substantial circuit reduction while retaining physically relevant features in an 80-qubit quantum-hardware experiment.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于张量网络的近似量子编译（AQC）为减少量子模拟所需的电路资源提供了途径。本文使用AQCtensor研究了80量子比特一维各向异性XYZ海森堡链的可压缩性和物理信息保持问题。研究发现，压缩性能随各向异性耦合配置和磁场方向系统性变化，且与二阶Trotter误差相关的嵌套对易子度量强相关。在80量子比特量子硬件评估中，AQCtensor将目标演化压缩了50%，同时保持了0.995474的目标态保真度，显著减少了电路深度和双量子比特门数量。
authors: Dohyun Kim, Namshik Han

articles.title: Lifting an [n,k,d] Binary Linear Code to an [[n,k,d]] Quantum Stabilizer Code
articles.title_zh: 将[n,k,d]二元线性码提升为[[n,k,d]]量子稳定子码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14192v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The codeword stabilized (CWS) framework provides a systematic method for constructing quantum error correcting codes from a simple undirected graph and a classical code. When the underlying classical code is linear, the resulting quantum code is a stabilizer code. In this work, we investigate the conditions under which an arbitrary [n,k,d] classical binary linear code can be lifted to an [[n,k,d]] quantum stabilizer code using the CWS framework. We analyze the random CWS code constructed from a given [n,k,d] binary linear code C and an Erdős-Rényi random graph G(n, frac12). We establish a lower bound on the probability that the resulting quantum code preserves the minimum distance d of the classical code. This probabilistic analysis yields a Gilbert-Varshamov-type condition on the n,k,d parameters of the classical code that guarantees the existence of a graph resulting in a quantum code with the same n,k,d parameters.
articles.abstract_zh: 码字稳定（CWS）框架提供了一种从简单无向图和经典码构造量子纠错码的系统方法。本文研究了在CWS框架下，任意[n,k,d]经典二元线性码可以提升为[[n,k,d]]量子稳定子码的条件。通过分析随机CWS码，研究人员建立了所得量子码保留经典码最小距离d的概率下限。这项概率分析为经典码的n,k,d参数提供了一个Gilbert-Varshamov型条件，保证了存在一个图可以生成具有相同n,k,d参数的量子码。
authors: Thamadathil Aswanth, Navin Kashyap

articles.title: Exponential Quantum Advantage in Stationary Signal Sensing
articles.title_zh: 稳态信号传感中的指数级量子优势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14424v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sensing time-varying signals is essential for precision measurement and for characterizing fluctuations in physical systems. In this work, we show that quantum entanglement provides an exponential advantage in the acquisition time required to learn the temporal statistics of a stationary classical signal. The task is to estimate the characteristic function of joint displacements on selected bosonic modes within a fixed-duration window, using continuous measurements of one signal realization. We present an entanglement-assisted scheme based on two-mode squeezed probes and local Bell measurements with protected idlers, and bound its acquisition time accounting for readout noise and correlations between signal windows. For a strictly stationary pulse family, it achieves polynomial acquisition time at inverse-polynomial accuracy with logarithmic squeezing and polynomial photon number. On the other hand, we prove that any local idler-free protocols require acquisition time exponential in the number of selected temporal modes per window. This lower bound holds for both sequentially prepared and arbitrarily temporally entangled probes, allowing non-Gaussian inputs and measurements and causal classical feedback, as long as each output is measured destructively within its time bin. These results establish an exponential quantum learning advantage for a single continuously monitored stationary signal, with the sensing cost measured by total acquisition time.
articles.abstract_zh: 感知时变信号对于精密测量和表征物理系统波动至关重要。本文证明了量子纠缠在学习稳态经典信号时间统计所需的采集时间上提供了指数级优势。研究提出了一种基于双模挤压探测和局部贝尔测量的纠缠辅助方案，并在严格稳态脉冲族下实现了多项式采集时间。同时，研究证明任何局部无闲置协议所需的采集时间与每个窗口选定时间模式的数量呈指数关系。
authors: Sojeong Park, Changhun Oh

articles.title: Hyperpolarization-enabled cooperative molecular magnetic amplification
articles.title_zh: 超极化实现协同分子磁放大
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14425v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Detecting weak magnetic fields at hertz frequencies is central to biomagnetism, geophysical sensing, and searches for new physics, yet it remains challenging because of technical systematics and environmental noise. Here, we realize a continuously operating molecular magnetic amplifier. Signal amplification by reversible exchange (SABRE) parahydrogen-based hyperpolarization maintains non-equilibrium spin order at zero field, turning scalar-coupled nuclear spins in liquid state molecules into an active, frequency-selective gain medium. Measurements of its complex magnetic susceptibility (ḩi) reveal an intrinsic response of  | ḩi | approx 10. By feeding the collectively generated magnetic field back to the spins below the threshold for self-sustained J-oscillation, we extend the effective spin coherence and cooperatively enhance the susceptibility up to  | ḩi | approx 80. Near threshold, this produces approximately fourfold amplification of a weak (20 pT) magnetic field at 3.37 Hz at the sensor location. These results establish hyperpolarized molecules as a tunable active magnetic medium for narrowband quantum sensing and precision measurement.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究实现了一种连续运行的分子磁放大器，用于检测赫兹频率的弱磁场。通过可逆交换信号放大（SABRE）的超极化技术，将液体分子中的核自旋转化为有源、频率选择性的增益介质。实验结果表明，该方法可将弱磁场放大约四倍，为窄带量子传感和精密测量提供了可调谐的活性磁介质。
authors: Jingyan Xu, Raphael Kircher, Min Jiang, Xinhua Peng, Danila Barskiy, Dmitry Budker

articles.title: Quantum-Fisher-information-aware optimization yields a quantum reservoir advantage over tuned classical reservoirs
articles.title_zh: 量子费舍尔信息感知优化使量子储备器优于调谐经典储备器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14454v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that a quantum reservoir computer optimized with its quantum Fisher information (QFI) has a quantum advantage over a classical reservoir of equal readout cost, provided by a quantum-information advantage: optimizing the quantum parameters with the QFI metric. On Mackey-Glass forecasting, a driven Jaynes-Cummings reservoir with one to three atoms beats a tuned echo-state network at every size from 4 to 30 trained weights, by 25-69% in held-out error, and is ahead of 99.5% of 10,000 random networks. After grid and Bayesian searches saturate, the QFI-aware stage lowers the error by 29-51% at 12-30 weights, beyond equal-budget black-box search or classical-parameter gradients alone, and at 30 weights turns a loss into a win. We then derive a fundamental QFI bound on the first-order rate of change of the retrained loss and factorize the gap to this bound into five link efficiencies that identify the physical mechanism limiting optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，通过量子费舍尔信息（QFI）优化的量子储备器，在相同的读出成本下，相对于经典储备器具有量子优势。在Mackey-Glass预测任务中，一个驱动的Jaynes-Cummings储备器在预测误差上显著优于调谐的echo-state网络。研究还推导了重训练损失一阶变化率的QFI基本界限，并分析了限制优化的物理机制。
authors: Phi Hung Nguyen, Daniel Soh

articles.title: Exploring Dynamical Quantum Phase Transitions via the Dynamical Phase Accumulated at an Equilibrium Critical Point
articles.title_zh: 通过平衡临界点积累的动态相位探索动态量子相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14591v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate dynamical quantum phase transitions (DQPTs) generated by a two-step linear quench with a finite waiting time at the equilibrium critical point. The waiting stage leads to the accumulation of a dynamical phase that depends on the waiting time and directly reflects the critical spectral structure. In the transverse Ising chain, this accumulated phase modifies the critical structure of DQPTs from a single-critical-mode (SCM) regime to a multiple-critical-mode (MCM) regime. We analytically and numerically determine the boundary between the two regimes. Along this boundary, the waiting time approaches a constant in the sudden-quench limit, whereas in the slow-quench limit it follows Kibble--Zurek (KZ) scaling with the quench time. In the SCM regime, the rate function exhibits a conventional linear singularity, r(t)-r(t*)propto |t-t*|^α, with the critical exponent α=1 near the critical time. At the SCM--MCM boundary, this exponent changes to α=1/2, leading to a divergent first derivative of the rate function. Additional discrete parameter lines with α=1/2 also appear within the MCM regime in the parameter plane spanned by the waiting and quench times. Our findings establish a direct connection between the accumulated dynamical phase and the critical structure of DQPTs, further supported by an extended Su--Schrieffer--Heeger (SSH) model.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过在平衡临界点处具有有限等待时间的两步线性淬火，探讨了动态量子相变（DQPTs）。等待阶段导致动态相位的积累，该相位反映了临界谱结构。在横向伊辛链中，这种积累的相位将DQPTs的临界结构从单临界模式（SCM）区域改变为多临界模式（MCM）区域，并分析了其临界指数的变化。
authors: Han-Chuan Kou, Peng Li, Zhi-Han Zhang, Zhen-Yu Zheng

articles.title: Scalability and performance metrics for boson sampling devices
articles.title_zh: 玻色子采样器件的可扩展性与性能指标
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14602v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Linear-optical platforms provide a promising route to demonstrate quantum computational advantage, particularly through the boson sampling problem. While a boson sampling system should be large enough to show the quantum advantage, the size of the boson sampling problem is often restricted by experimental constraints. In particular, as a boson sampling system is scaled up, experimental constraints can limit its effective problem size to permit efficient classical simulation. In this paper, we investigate the theoretical scalability bounds for boson sampling systems under practical experimental conditions, including photon loss, mode mismatch, and input state error. We employ non-negativity conditions for phase-space quasiprobability distribution functions to analyze these effects. In addition, we introduce two device-level metrics, the boson sampling score which measures the usable capacity of a given device and the boson sampling volume which provides a common hardware-level benchmark for comparing different platforms and assessing their access to an advantage-relevant problem size regime. Our results provide fundamental insights into the performance of boson sampling systems under realistic experimental conditions and offer practical guidelines for scaling up boson sampling systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 线性光学平台为展示量子计算优势提供了有前景的途径，特别是通过玻色子采样问题。该研究探讨了在实际实验条件下，包括光子损耗、模式失配和输入态误差等因素对玻色子采样系统理论可扩展性的限制。文章还引入了玻色子采样分数和玻色子采样体积这两个器件级指标，用于衡量设备可用容量和提供硬件级基准，以评估其达到量子优势相关问题规模的能力。
authors: Dong-Gil Im, Chung-Hyun Lee, Joonsuk Huh, Yoon-Ho Kim

articles.title: Entanglement generation from degeneracy breaking of superradiant Liouvillian steady states by local operations
articles.title_zh: 通过局域操作打破超辐射Liouvillian稳态简并性产生纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14788v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superradiance is a collective optical effect where emitters cooperatively radiate with a maximal intensity scaling proportional to the square of the number of emitters. Despite the superradiant cascade transitioning through highly entangled states, it has been shown that, for dynamics along the Dicke ladder, superradiance need not generate entanglement between the emitters. By contrast, we show how introducing incoherent local processes -- normally considered detrimental to both entanglement and superradiance -- can generate high levels of inter-emitter entanglement. We develop a general framework, using degenerate non-Hermitian perturbation theory, for the study of superradiant Liouvillian steady-state degeneracy breaking by these local operations from a few emitters up into the thermodynamic limit. From this, we are able to show that entanglement becomes ubiquitous in this regime and demonstrate its robustness against other forms of symmetric environmental noise. In the regime where pumping dominates, we find that population accumulates towards the maximally entangled minimal pseudo-spin states, corresponding to multi-emitter singlet states. This provides a deeper insight into many-body entanglement and the curious connection between local operations and entanglement generation.
articles.abstract_zh: 超辐射是一种集体光学效应，但沿Dicke阶梯的动力学不一定产生发射器之间的纠缠。该研究展示了引入非相干局域过程如何产生高水平的发射器间纠缠。通过简并非厄米微扰理论，研究建立了一个通用框架，揭示了纠缠在该机制下普遍存在，并对环境噪声具有鲁棒性。
authors: Adam Burgess, Erik M. Gauger

articles.title: Entanglement detection in dynamical quantum systems
articles.title_zh: 动态量子系统中的纠缠检测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15021v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum science and engineering increasingly target the exploitation and control of large-scale dynamical systems. As system size grows, novel phenomena and quantum advantages emerge, but the resulting many-body dynamics become correspondingly harder to monitor and characterize. In particular, the underlying Hamiltonian often lacks symmetries, and the induced many-body dynamics quickly become hard to track. Focusing on one of the most important quantum features---entanglement---we demonstrate that, for a broad class of common Hamiltonian models, one can design effective witnesses that detect both the presence and structure of entanglement over relatively long evolution times. Inspired by stabilizer-based simulation, we track the evolution of generalized stabilizers of the underlying state and use them to construct linear entanglement witnesses. Through numerical experiments on Heisenberg-type Hamiltonians with up to twelve qubits, we show that the required number of measurement settings can be kept at a modest scale as the system size increases, and entanglement detection remains effective over evolution times that significantly exceed those accessible to naive approaches. The corresponding calculations can be carried out largely symbolically. Furthermore, unlike accurate state simulation, the stabilizer-based design of entanglement witnesses can be performed in a much more coarse-grained, digitized manner. We hope these results will stimulate further exploration of the quantum control of large systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 随着量子系统规模的增长，多体动力学监测和表征变得更具挑战性。该研究展示了对于一类广泛的哈密顿量模型，可以设计有效的纠缠判据，以检测纠缠的存在和结构，并能覆盖相对较长的演化时间。通过对多达十二个量子比特的海森堡型哈密顿量进行数值实验，证明了所需测量设置的数量可以保持在适度规模，且纠缠检测在较长演化时间内依然有效。
authors: Xingjian Zhang, Jiayi Wu, Jue Xu, Qi Zhao

articles.title: Signal-to-noise problems in fault-tolerant quantum computation
articles.title_zh: 容错量子计算中的信噪比问题
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15210v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum computation offers a promising alternative to classical Monte Carlo methods by naturally avoiding sign problems through unitary evolution. A common misconception follows from this: because quantum simulation sidesteps the sign problem, it is often assumed to be an essentially perfect substitute for classical sampling. This is false---quantum measurements are intrinsically stochastic, and estimating observables often requires a number of samples that grows exponentially with system size, time separation, or inverse temperature, exactly as in the classical signal-to-noise problem. In this work, we analyze the origin and structure of signal-to-noise problems in quantum computation, drawing parallels with classical Monte Carlo, and demonstrate that such noise persists even in sign-problem-free regimes. We discuss strategies to mitigate it, in particular a quantum generalization of Stein control variates construction, in which unbiased estimators are built from operator commutators [X,A] and their discrete diagonal counterparts, and validate the approach with exactly solvable numerical examples that quantify the achievable variance reduction. Our results underscore that variance reduction, not merely sign-problem avoidance, is required to make quantum algorithms practically viable for many-body physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子计算虽然通过酉演化避免了符号问题，但量子测量本质上是随机的，估计可观测值所需的样本数量可能随系统大小、时间间隔或逆温度呈指数增长，类似于经典信噪比问题。该研究分析了量子计算中信噪比问题的起源和结构，并提出了缓解策略，特别是Stein控制变量构造的量子推广。通过可精确求解的数值例子验证了该方法，量化了可实现的方差降低。
authors: Hyunwoo Oh

articles.title: A Quantum Analogue of the Covering Lemma: Limits of Exact Anonymous Computation
articles.title_zh: 覆盖引理的量子模拟：精确匿名计算的局限性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15601v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Can quantum communication determine the size of an anonymous network when no size bound is known? Classical impossibility proofs rely on the covering lemma: an execution can be reproduced on a larger network with the same local structure. Quantum interference invalidates this argument - a measurement record possible on a network can become impossible on a cover. We show that the impossibility of exact counting nevertheless survives. Our main result is a quantum analogue of the covering lemma that preserves local possibilities rather than complete executions. Within a cyclic covering family, every local measurement outcome possible at a node remains possible at a corresponding node in every sufficiently large network. This holds even after information has travelled around the smaller network, beyond the reach of a simple locality argument. We extend the principle to the universal covering tree and finite covers with sufficiently long cycles. The proof combines tensor-network methods with graph coverings: a common representation across network sizes turns normalization into a constraint on which local outcomes can occur. For uniform synchronous protocols with independently prepared nodes, this support-lifting principle rules out zero-error counting and even the production of a guaranteed finite size bound on anonymous rings and the other cyclic covering families considered here. It also rules out exact leader election with termination in finite time with probability one on these families. Measurements, classical control, and local memory growing with time are allowed; no predetermined running-time bound is assumed. Quantum interference thus defeats execution lifting without enabling infallible certification of network size.
articles.abstract_zh: 经典覆盖引理在匿名网络中无法确定网络大小，而量子干涉似乎能推翻这一论断。该研究提出了覆盖引理的量子模拟，证明了精确计数的不可行性依然存在。在循环覆盖族中，节点上所有可能的局域测量结果在足够大的网络中仍然可能发生。该证明结合了张量网络方法和图覆盖理论，为理解匿名量子通信的局限性提供了基础。
authors: Giuseppe Di Molfetta, Petra Camilli

articles.title: Separability criteria and lower bounds of entanglement via realignment
articles.title_zh: 基于重排的纠缠可分性判据和下界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15664v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The detection and quantification of quantum entanglement are central problems in quantum information science. Based on the realignment of density matrices and the vectorization of reduced density matrices, we construct a family of enhanced separability criteria for bipartite and multipartite quantum systems. Our criteria recover the previously proposed realignment-based criteria as special cases and detect more entanglement than the earlier ones. Moreover, we derive tighter lower bounds for the concurrence and the convex-roof extended negativity, criteria for detecting the genuine tripartite entanglement, and lower bounds on genuine-multipartite-entanglement concurrence. The advantages of our results are demonstrated with detailed examples.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子纠缠的检测和量化是量子信息科学的核心问题。该研究基于密度矩阵的重排和约化密度矩阵的矢量化，构建了一系列增强的双体和多体量子系统可分性判据。这些新判据不仅包含了现有基于重排的判据作为特例，还能检测到更多的纠缠。此外，研究还推导了更紧的并发度和凸顶扩展负性的下界，以及用于检测真实三体纠缠和真实多体纠缠并发度的下界。
authors: Yuhang Xie, Yanjun Chu, Shao-Ming Fei

articles.title: Molecular Vibronic Complexity as a Quantum Resource for Optimal Control: Nonadiabatic Mixing Creates Protected Coherence Subspaces in Dissipative Environments
articles.title_zh: 分子振子复杂性作为最优控制的量子资源：非绝热混合在耗散环境中创建受保护的相干子空间
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15743v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In molecules, electronic coherence typically decays within a few hundred femtoseconds, a timescale usually attributed to the environment. We show that it is set to a large extent by which coherences are excited: the molecule can host coherences that the bath barely sees, and optimal control can find and exploit them. Using gradient-based optimal control (GRAPE) with Redfield dynamics, we maximize the total vibronic coherence between the electronic ground and an optically bright electronic excited state in a three-state model with nonadiabatic features, in two regimes of low and high nonadiabatic mixing and for different system-bath coupling strengths. The Liouvillian spectrum reveals, in both regimes, a well-separated coherence mode with substantial ground-bright character that decays on a picosecond timescale. This mode is protected by mixing with the dark state, which brings the geometry of the optically accessible excited state close to that of the ground state and thus weakens its coupling to the bath. Without prior information, GRAPE finds this mode and keeps the photoexcited wave packet near the Franck-Condon region. At equal fluence, it increases the coherence at 800 fs by more than two orders of magnitude over a Gaussian pulse at the weakest coupling, and by many more at stronger coupling. The Liouvillian predicts the bath dependence of the long-lived coherence to within 1%, and a Gaussian pulse tuned to the mode frequency comes within 10% of the best pulse found. Beyond two-level and spin systems, our study puts forward the vibronic structure of molecules as a route to protected coherence subspaces, identifying a dark-state protection mechanism and a design criterion based on molecular parameters. These results lay the groundwork for our goal of using vibronic molecular systems as a resource for long-lived, controllable coherences in molecular quantum information science.
articles.abstract_zh: 分子中的电子相干性通常在几百飞秒内衰减，这通常归因于环境。该研究表明，分子可以承载环境几乎不可见的相干性，并且最优控制可以发现并利用它们。通过梯度优化控制（GRAPE）和Redfield动力学，研究在一个具有非绝热特征的三态模型中最大化了电子基态和光学亮激发态之间的总振子相干性。结果揭示了一个受保护的相干模式，其衰减时间达到皮秒级别，并展示了其在耗散环境中的鲁棒性。
authors: Elisa Palacino-González

articles.title: Local-dimension-invariant low-density parity-check stabilizer codes
articles.title_zh: 局域维度不变的低密度奇偶校验稳定器码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15893v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The protection of quantum information in systems leveraging more than two basis states (qudits) is an ongoing challenge. A tool for transforming the plethora of qubit stabilizer codes into qudit stabilizer codes is the local-dimension-invariant (LDI) extension to the stabilizer formalism. A drawback of the LDI method is that generally in order to ensure the distance of the resultant code is at least preserved the newly selected local-dimension will need to be any prime bigger than a large cutoff value. In this work we consider the repercussions of this large cutoff value, then by focusing on quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes we are able to bring down this cutoff value. Notably, we are able to reduce it in some cases to the initial local-dimension and for arbitrary CSS qubit-derived codes to singly exponential in d with no dependence on the number of logicals k. This reduces the size of the caveat in LDI forms in their distance preservation condition.
articles.abstract_zh: 保护多基态量子信息（qudits）是一个持续的挑战，而局域维度不变（LDI）方法能将量子比特稳定器码转换为量子维度稳定器码。LDI方法的一个缺点是，为保持码距，新选择的局域维度通常需要大于一个较大的截止值。本研究通过关注量子低密度奇偶校验（qLDPC）码，成功降低了这一截止值，在某些情况下可降至初始局域维度。这显著减小了LDI形式中码距保持条件的限制，对量子信息保护具有重要意义。
authors: Md. Shahinul Islam, Aaryan Reza, Lane G. Gunderman

articles.title: Scalable Exact Non-Pauli Noise Simulation for Fault-Tolerant Quantum Circuits
articles.title_zh: 可扩展的容错量子电路非泡利噪声精确模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15975v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum design relies on simulating noisy quantum error correction (QEC) circuits with hundreds to thousands of physical qubits and large circuit depths. High-throughput stabilizer simulators, such as Stim, are the de facto tools for this regime. However, these simulators typically support only Clifford gates and stochastic Pauli noise. As a result, more realistic device noise models-such as coherent control errors and thermal relaxation-are often approximated using Pauli Twirling. This replacement offers speed but can introduce inaccuracies. To address this, we propose QuasiStim for scalable exact QEC simulation of realistic noise, with QuasiFold as a compiler frontend and DeltaFrame as a sampling backend. QuasiFold lowers sampling overhead by merging equivalent non-Pauli sites in the quantum circuit. DeltaFrame samples the resulting stabilizer trajectories by reusing precomputed predicted references instead of resimulating the full tableau for each shot. QuasiFold can reduce the number of shots by over 100× on bivariate-bicycle (BB) codes. Compared to a per-shot tableau simulator, DeltaFrame is 166×--1331× faster on rotated surface-code memory under coherent R_Z noise as d grows from 5 to 35. QuasiStim also makes the PTA bias measurable: the gap is non-negligible and varies with noise strength, decoder, and circuit schedule. QuasiStim will be open-sourced upon publication at https://github.com/isaachyw/QuasiStim
articles.abstract_zh: 容错量子设计依赖于模拟含有数百到数千物理量子比特的噪声量子纠错（QEC）电路。现有的稳定器模拟器通常只支持Clifford门和随机泡利噪声，导致真实设备噪声模型常通过泡利旋转近似，但会引入不准确性。为解决此问题，本研究提出了QuasiStim，用于可扩展地精确模拟真实噪声下的QEC电路，并配备了编译器前端QuasiFold和采样后端DeltaFrame。QuasiFold通过合并等效的非泡利位点来降低采样开销，DeltaFrame则通过重用预计算的预测参考来加速采样，显著提升了模拟效率和准确性。
authors: Yuewen Hou, Gokul Subramanian Ravi

articles.title: Measuring higher-order bulk topology in a programmable quantum simulator
articles.title_zh: 在可编程量子模拟器中测量高阶体拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16046v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological insulators lie outside the standard Landau paradigm: Instead of being characterized by local order parameters and spontaneous symmetry breaking, their defining properties are encoded in the global structure of their quantum states and manifested as robust boundary states. Crystalline higher-order topological insulators can extend this principle by hosting localized corner modes in two and higher dimensions. Although these boundary modes can be detected spectroscopically through the local density of states, determining the underlying bulk topology, for example through nested Wilson loops, remains an outstanding experimental challenge. Here we use up to 728 qubits in a superconducting analogue-digital quantum simulator to realize and probe a hierarchy of one-, two-, and three-dimensional topological insulators governed by effective tight-binding Hamiltonians. By reconstructing complex propagators from real-space measurements, we obtain complementary boundary and bulk characterizations: local densities of states reveal localized boundary modes, whereas experimentally reconstructed band projectors yield bulk topological invariants, culminating in a three-dimensional octupole moment extracted through third nested Wilson loops. These results establish a route to realizing, characterizing, and manipulating topologically protected states in programmable three-dimensional quantum matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 拓扑绝缘体以其量子态的全局结构和鲁棒的边界态为特征，而高阶拓扑绝缘体则在二维及更高维度中承载局域化的角模式。尽管边界模式可通过局域态密度进行光谱检测，但确定其潜在的体拓扑仍是实验挑战。本研究利用超导模数量子模拟器中的多达728个量子比特，实现了并探测了一维、二维和三维拓扑绝缘体的层次结构，并通过实空间测量重建了复传播子，获得了互补的边界和体表征。
authors: Pratik Sathe, Niclas Heinsdorf, Majid Kheirkhah, Rahul Deshpande, Fabio Altomare, Andrew J. Berkley, Martin Dehn, Richard Harris, Emile Hoskinson, Stefan Paul, Gabriel Poulin-Lamarre, Jack Raymond, Chris Rich, Mohammad H. Amin, Marcel Franz, Andrew D. King

articles.title: Device-to-protocol simulation of spectrally-resolved quantum photonic circuits
articles.title_zh: 量子光子电路的谱分辨从器件到协议的模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16150v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting quantum-photonic circuit performance requires retaining source and device physics without making photon-counting calculations prohibitively expensive. Here we present PhoQuS, a framework that combines frequency-resolved source models, electromagnetic compact models and spatially correlated fabrication variation to simulate quantum photonic circuits. Covariance-Gram reduction after full-resolution Gaussian propagation lowers readout cost while retaining dominant spectral correlations. For continuous-variable state preparation, spectral reduction accelerates photon counting by 60.4-fold in an approximate Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill circuit. Frequency-resolved modeling guides the use of cascaded squeezing with temporal walk-off compensation, yielding 0.99 fidelity to the single-mode circuit reference and 0.98 conditional purity in lossless simulations. For discrete-variable state preparation, simulations of three-photon Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger circuits across a virtual wafer show that component robustness alone does not predict circuit fidelity, which depends jointly on source spectra, circuit architecture and control. PhoQuS connects device physics to protocol-level performance through a unified workflow that retains spectral detail while reducing readout cost.
articles.abstract_zh: 预测量子光子电路性能需要兼顾光源和器件物理，同时避免光子计数计算成本过高。本研究提出了PhoQuS框架，它结合了频率分辨光源模型、电磁紧凑模型和空间相关的制造变异来模拟量子光子电路。通过全分辨率高斯传播后的协方差-格拉姆降维，降低了读出成本并保留了主要的谱相关性。该框架在连续变量和离散变量态制备中均展示了显著的性能提升和对电路保真度的深入理解。
authors: Seongjin Jeon, Youngbin Kim, Joaquin Matres, Dong-Yeop Na, Young-Ik Sohn

articles.title: Time-Frequency Continuous-Variable Quantum Teleportation with Single Photons
articles.title_zh: 基于单光子时频连续变量的量子隐形传态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16198v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum teleportation, a key building block for quantum technologies, enables distant parties, Alice and Bob, to transfer an unknown quantum state using entanglement, local operations, and classical communication. In this work, we propose a quantum teleportation protocol for single-photon time-frequency continuous variables, where time is the time of arrival at a detector. We detail the operational requirements of the protocol, notably the nonlinear interactions needed for the photon-photon time-frequency entangling gate. By explicitly treating the detector position as the reference frame for time of arrival, we show that, even with ideal classical and quantum channels, the input-output fidelity is not unity unless the receiving party can correct the detector-position mismatch. This results in a trade-off between teleportation fidelity and the temporal bandwidth of the input photon wavepacket. The protocol itself can be used for remote detector synchronization. In particular, we show that time-frequency cat and Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill states provide an internal temporal ruler through fidelity revivals. We further derive the classical and best-copy fidelity thresholds for single-photon Gaussian wavepackets, finding that the relevant vacuum-equivalent shot noise is input-dependent, in contrast with quadrature-based continuous-variable quantum teleportation. Our proposal derives from a quantum theory of space-time events, whereafter we establish space as a reference for the time degree of freedom, thereby grounding our work in ongoing research on reference frames and superselection rules in quantum optics and quantum information. Beyond protocols harnessing time-frequency continuous variables of single photons, this work points toward remote synchronization in quantum communication architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子隐形传态是量子技术的关键组成部分，允许远距离传输未知量子态。本研究提出了一种针对单光子时频连续变量的量子隐形传态协议，其中时间指光子到达探测器的时间。协议详细阐述了操作要求，特别是光子-光子时频纠缠门所需的非线性相互作用。研究发现，即使在理想信道下，输入-输出保真度也并非为一，除非接收方能校正探测器位置失配，这导致了隐形传态保真度与输入光子波包时间带宽之间的权衡。
authors: Mohamed Meguebel, Nadia Belabas, Nicolas Fabre

articles.title: Deterministic preparation of squeezed and non-Gaussian states in coupled qubit-boson systems
articles.title_zh: 耦合量子比特-玻色子系统中挤压态和非高斯态的确定性制备
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16207v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deterministic preparation of bosonic resource states is a central task in continuous-variable quantum information processing and quantum metrology. Here we develop a measurement-based imaginary time evolution (MITE) protocol for preparing squeezed and non-Gaussian states. The protocol combines ancilla-mediated weak measurements of the Hamiltonian with a conditional phase rotation that suppresses excited state trapping and stabilizes convergence toward the ground state. The method is potentially applicable in hybrid discrete variable-continuous variable (DV-CV) platforms, where the qubit acts as the measurement readout. We demonstrate deterministic convergence over a broad range of parameters and show that the performance degradation near the stability boundary is governed by the shrinking Bogoliubov quasiparticle gap. The same framework also extends to non-Gaussian bosonic resource states, including Schrödinger cat states and excited states of the single-mode squeezing Hamiltonian, which display Wigner negativity. The squeezed states remain robust under bosonic loss over experimentally relevant regimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 确定性制备玻色子资源态是连续变量量子信息处理和量子计量学的核心任务。本研究开发了一种基于测量的虚时间演化（MITE）协议，用于制备挤压态和非高斯态。该协议结合了辅助比特介导的哈密顿量弱测量和条件相旋转，以抑制激发态捕获并稳定收敛到基态。该方法在混合离散变量-连续变量（DV-CV）平台上具有潜在应用，并展示了在广泛参数范围内的确定性收敛性，且挤压态在实验相关范围内对玻色子损耗保持鲁棒性。
authors: Fengquan Zhang, Xiaotong Liu, Yuping Mao, Zhiyuan Lin, Tim Byrnes

articles.title: Collective Floquet engineering between two distant superconducting artificial atoms
articles.title_zh: 两个远距离超导人工原子之间的集体Floquet工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16210v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A one-dimensional waveguide is a crucial medium for transferring propagating quantum information between remote qubits, yet the photon-mediated interaction is typically fixed by the static device geometry, qubit parameters, and their couplings to the transmission line. Such an interaction can be engineered to be coherent or dissipative via virtual- or real-photon exchange, respectively, yet its effective strength remains fixed in either case. Here we demonstrate dynamical control over this interaction by applying Floquet engineering to two superconducting qubits coupled to a waveguide terminated by a capacitive mirror. By positioning one qubit at an antinode and the other qubit at a node or an antinode of the resonant standing wave, we realize a Hermitian or non-Hermitian coupling between the two qubits. A periodic flux drive of the qubit frequencies then enables on-demand control of the coherent energy splitting and the collective decay. Our results establish Floquet engineering as a route to dynamically reshape both coherent and dissipative photon-mediated interactions between remote quantum emitters.
articles.abstract_zh: 一维波导是远程量子比特间传输量子信息的关键介质，但光子介导的相互作用通常由静态器件几何结构固定。本研究通过对耦合到电容镜端接波导的两个超导量子比特应用Floquet工程，实现了对这种相互作用的动态控制。周期性的磁通驱动使得对相干能级分裂和集体衰减的按需控制成为可能，这为动态重塑远程量子发射器之间相干和耗散光子介导相互作用提供了新途径。
authors: Y. -H. Huang, Jiale Yuan, Z. Q. Niu, Y. -S. Tsai, K. -C. Yu, P. -H. Hsu, K. -M. Hsieh, Haw-Tyng Huang, J. C. Chen, P. Y. Wen, Y. -H. Lin, Z. -R. Lin, Da-Wei Wang, I. -C. Hoi

articles.title: Minimal Subsystems for Characterizing Genuine Multipartite Entanglement
articles.title_zh: 表征真实多体纠缠的最小子系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16215v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Genuine multipartite entanglement (GME) is a valuable resource for quantum technologies, but quantifying it in many-body systems can be demanding since measures defined through optimizations over bipartitions are often assumed to require large joint measurements and many measurement settings. We introduce the concepts of GME evaluation length and GME evaluation number, which capture, respectively, the largest subsystem that must be jointly measured and the number of distinct subsystems that need to be measured to evaluate multipartite entanglement measures defined via bipartition optimizations. Taking the genuine multipartite concurrence (GMC) as a canonical example, we show that, for N-qubit Haar-random pure states, the GMC can be evaluated using only N single-qubit purity measurements. Thus, for typical many-body states, evaluating the GMC requires considering only the N single-site bipartitions, rather than the exponentially many distinct bipartitions. We further corroborate this behavior numerically for physically accessible states generated by local random quantum circuits. Our results show that the practical cost of quantifying GME can be dramatically lower than suggested by its formal definition, establishing measurement complexity as a complementary operational lens for multipartite entanglement.
articles.abstract_zh: 真实多体纠缠（GME）是量子技术的重要资源，但在多体系统中量化它通常需要大量的联合测量和多种测量设置。本研究引入了GME评估长度和GME评估数概念，分别捕获评估通过二分优化定义的多体纠缠度量所需联合测量的最大子系统和需要测量的不同子系统数量。以真实多体并发度（GMC）为例，研究表明对于N量子比特的Haar随机纯态，GMC仅需N次单量子比特纯度测量即可评估，这显著降低了评估典型多体态GMC的实际成本。
authors: Shashank Shekhar, Siddhartha Santra

articles.title: Classical and Quantum Information Measures Characterizing Convertibility: An Axiomatic Approach
articles.title_zh: 表征可转换性的经典和量子信息度量：一种公理化方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16267v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this PhD thesis, we take an axiomatic approach to studying multivariate divergences, which are measures of the information content of a tuple of classical or quantum states. These divergences are studied in the context of large-sample and catalytic convertibility of tuples of states. This type of convertibility is characterized by the ordering of an axiomatically defined family of divergences. In this thesis, we identify this family of divergences explicitly for two scenarios, one classical and one quantum. In the classical setting, we show that the relevant divergences are certain generalizations of the bivariate Rényi divergences. Unlike previous studies, we do not require the distributions to have the same support, yielding interesting new divergences. In the quantum setting, we consider pairs of classical-quantum states with pure component states, and find that majorization is characterized by all α-z relative entropies for α<1. This demonstrates the first operational interpretation of these relative entropies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本博士论文采用公理化方法研究多元散度，即衡量经典或量子态元组信息内容的度量。这些散度在态元组的大样本和催化可转换性背景下进行研究，这种可转换性由公理化定义的散度族排序来表征。论文明确了经典和量子两种场景下的相关散度族，在经典设置中，相关散度是二元Rényi散度的推广。在量子设置中，研究发现主化（majorization）由所有α<1的α-z相对熵表征，首次为这些相对熵提供了操作性解释。
authors: Frits Verhagen

articles.title: Pathfinder-BP: A Low-Latency Recursive Decoder for Topological Codes
articles.title_zh: Pathfinder-BP：一种用于拓扑码的低延迟递归解码器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16375v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose Pathfinder-BP, a recursive decoder for topological quantum codes that combines belief propagation with controlled bit-flipping. An initial BP pass identifies and permanently fixes high-confidence errors. Upon convergence failure, the decoder recursively explores alternative error patterns by tentatively flipping low-confidence variables. On surface codes, Pathfinder-BP achieves a noise threshold and logical error rate comparable to minimum-weight perfect matching (MWPM). A crucial advantage of Pathfinder-BP is its highly parallelizable structure, which yields a worst-case decoding latency quasi-linear in the code distance, making it a suitable candidate for low-latency hardware implementation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种名为Pathfinder-BP的递归解码器，用于拓扑量子码，它结合了信念传播（BP）和受控比特翻转。初始的BP过程识别并永久修复高置信度错误，当收敛失败时，解码器通过试探性翻转低置信度变量来递归探索替代错误模式。在表面码上，Pathfinder-BP实现了与最小权重完美匹配（MWPM）相当的噪声阈值和逻辑错误率。Pathfinder-BP的一个关键优势是其高度并行化的结构，可实现与码距离准线性相关的最坏情况解码延迟，使其成为低延迟硬件实现的合适选择。
authors: Stefano Tinelli, Francisco Lázaro, Francisco García Herrero

articles.title: Benchmarking a randomized quantum algorithm for estimating expectation values of molecular observables
articles.title_zh: 基准测试一种用于估计分子可观测值期望值的随机量子算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16379v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Randomized quantum algorithms for the estimation of expectation values of molecular observables offer a promising route to early fault-tolerant quantum advantage by trading circuit depth for an increased number of samples. However, this begs the question whether the resulting measurement overhead remains feasible for industrially relevant molecular systems. In this work, we benchmark the randomized sampling algorithm of Wang et al. [1] through numerical simulations on a hydrogen molecule and resource estimates for various active spaces of the cytochrome P450, an industry-relevant system in the pharmaceutical industry. Our numerical simulations reveal that the analytical error bounds significantly overestimate the actual sampling error, whereas the analytical bound on the required imaginary evolution time is comparatively tight, exceeding a direct DMRG estimate by roughly 44% for the active space where the comparison is feasible. The measurement overhead nevertheless remains prohibitively high: even for the smallest active spaces, the expectation-value estimation alone requires around 1010 samples, scaling to beyond 1015 for the largest active spaces considered. These results suggest that substantial improvements in measurement strategies or algorithmic scaling are necessary before randomized early-fault-tolerant algorithms become competitive for industrial quantum chemistry applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 随机量子算法通过增加样本数量来换取电路深度，为早期容错量子优势提供了一条有前景的途径。本研究通过对氢分子进行数值模拟，并对细胞色素P450（一种工业相关分子）的不同活性空间进行资源估算，对Wang等人提出的随机采样算法进行了基准测试。数值模拟表明，分析误差界限显著高估了实际采样误差，而所需虚时间演化的分析界限相对紧密。然而，测量开销仍然过高，即使对于最小的活性空间，期望值估计也需要约10¹⁰个样本，对于更大的系统则超过10¹⁵个。
authors: Anna Schroeder, Gian-Luca R. Anselmetti, Matthias Degroote, Florian Dommert, Michael Kaicher, Chandan Kumar, Michael Streif, Davide Vodola

articles.title: Entanglement and parametric resonance in coupled oscillator systems
articles.title_zh: 耦合振子系统中的纠缠与参量共振
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16389v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a system of two quadratically-coupled harmonic oscillators, prepared respectively in the ground state and in a coherent state. This toy model can describe for instance the dynamics of one mode of a quantum field evolving in a harmonically-oscillating classical background. In such situations, it is well-known that, depending on the background oscillation amplitude and coupling strength, the system may exhibit parametric resonance. Using the Feynman-Vernon influence functional, we analyze the interplay between parametric resonance and quantum entanglement by perturbatively computing the purity of the mixed state resulting from tracing over one of the oscillators. We find a runaway behavior of the quantum entanglement between the two oscillators, as well as a rapid breakdown of the validity of perturbation theory, in regions of parametric instability. This provides a quantitative confirmation of various statements in the literature and is highly relevant to questions pertaining to the validity of the semiclassical approximation in coupled quantum-classical systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了两个二次耦合谐振子系统，其中一个处于基态，另一个处于相干态。该模型可描述量子场模式在谐振经典背景下的动力学。利用Feynman-Vernon影响泛函，通过微扰计算混合态的纯度，分析了参量共振与量子纠缠之间的相互作用。研究发现在参量不稳定性区域，量子纠缠呈现失控行为，且微扰理论的有效性迅速失效。这些结果定量证实了文献中的各种论断，并对耦合量子-经典系统中半经典近似的有效性问题具有重要意义。
authors: Roxane Thériault, George Zahariade

articles.title: Bell's go theorem: regaining local causality with a new notion of realism
articles.title_zh: 贝尔的“去”定理：以新的实在论概念重获局域因果性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16493v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bell's theorem is popularly stated as the inconsistency of quantum theory with local realism. Realism is here formalized by the ontological models framework, where elements of reality are points of a measurable space and probabilities obey the Kolmogorov axioms. In the Bell scenario, locally causal ontological models posit a common cause supporting a global valuation, a joint assignment of outcomes to all measurements at once, across incompatible contexts. Within this notion of realism, Bell's theorem makes any realist explanation of the quantum predictions conspiratorial: any mechanism, whether superluminal, superdeterministic, or retrocausal, must be finely tuned so as never to manifest operationally. We redefine realism through a new ontological framework that generalizes the standard one. The elements of reality, which we call records, are no longer points but relational parts of a point-free generalization of a topological space (sublocales of a locale). A record shared by two incompatible contexts establishes the sameness of a measurement across them, without such pairwise identities composing into a global valuation, and the common cause is then a web of such records. Within this framework, Bell's no-go theorem becomes a go theorem: local causality, restated for records, is no longer at odds with the quantum statistics. This is possible because modularity, the inclusion-exclusion law of classical probability, fails across incompatible contexts, so that the probability theory generalizes Kolmogorov's. We exhibit explicit models reproducing several quantum strategies, including the optimal CHSH violation. More broadly, locally causal models of this kind attain every Bell-CHSH value up to the algebraic maximum. A realist explanation of the quantum predictions need not be conspiratorial; every causal influence posited by these models is reflected in the operational predictions.
articles.abstract_zh: 贝尔定理通常被表述为量子理论与局域实在论的不一致性。本研究通过一个新的本体论框架重新定义了实在论，该框架是对标准框架的推广。在该框架中，实在的元素（称为“记录”）不再是点，而是拓扑空间（locale的子局部）的无点推广的关系部分。两个不兼容上下文共享的记录确立了测量在它们之间的一致性，而无需这些成对的同一性构成一个全局估值。这种方法旨在在不诉诸超光速、超确定性或逆因果关系的情况下，重新获得局域因果性。
authors: Lorenzo Catani, Nesta van der Schaaf, Rui Soares Barbosa

articles.title: Fisher-Information Certification from Bell Statistics: CHSH Bounds, Information Loss, and Finite-Data Guarantees
articles.title_zh: 贝尔统计中的费雪信息认证：CHSH界限、信息损失和有限数据保证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16702v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bell-test data are typically used to certify nonlocal correlations, while quantum metrology is concerned with the sensitivity of measurement statistics to unknown parameters. Here we connect these tasks at the level of experimentally accessible Bell statistics. Using standard moment-based Fisher-information inequalities, we derive lower bounds on the classical Fisher information directly from Bell scores and their parameter dependence, without requiring full state tomography. For CHSH measurements we establish a hierarchy between the information contained in the full outcome record, the set of individual correlators, and the compressed Bell parameter, thereby quantifying the metrological cost of data compression. In polarization-phase sensing, this hierarchy reveals a Bell-metrology tradeoff: the point of maximal CHSH violation need not maximize, and can even suppress, the Fisher information carried by the Bell score itself. We further derive finite-sample lower-confidence bounds from coincidence counts and analyze the effects of biased marginals, accidental coincidences, visibility loss, and multipair emission. The framework provides a practical route for extracting metrological guarantees from Bell-type experiments using only standard correlation measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将贝尔检验数据与量子计量学联系起来，利用基于矩的费雪信息不等式，直接从贝尔分数及其参数依赖性推导出经典费雪信息的下限。研究建立了CHSH测量中信息层级，并揭示了极化-相位传感中的贝尔-计量权衡。此外，工作还推导了有限样本的置信下限，并分析了各种实验因素的影响。
authors: Juan Sumaya-Martínez, Omar Olmos-López, Jorge Mulia Rodríguez

articles.title: Realistic simulation of universal multiport interferometers with losses within a Gaussian formalism
articles.title_zh: 基于高斯形式的通用多端口干涉仪损耗的真实模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16719v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photonic technologies are among the leading platform contenders for demonstrating quantum advantage.
