Nevertheless, photon losses represent the major hurdle for the realization of a fault-tolerant optical quantum computer, and the need for an accurate characterization of this phenomenon is crucial for classical simulations of quantum algorithms on noisy backends. The noisy regime would require the simulation of the algorithm on a Fock backend or rather assuming the a priori hypothesis on the uniformity of the optical losses, which may lead to wrong predictions about the outcome from the algorithm on a cerain hardware. We propose a Gaussian model that can reproduce a lossy dynamics through the experimental characterization of imperfect interferometers, yielding the corresponding mean vector and the covariance matrix. Such model can be adapted to any continuous-variable architecture (spatial or time-bin encoded) and for both the Gaussian boson sampling or general-dyne based algorithms. Eventually, we quantify the drift of optical losses from being uniform throughout the multiport interferometer by a numerical simulation. This work proposes a blueprint for future characterizations, tailor-suited for specific devices and architectures, as well as for potential error correction and mitigation techniques, and it paves the way for realistic simulations of quantum algorithms on NISQ optical platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 光子损耗是实现容错光学量子计算机的主要障碍。本文提出了一种高斯模型，通过对不完美干涉仪的实验表征，能够重现损耗动力学，并得到相应的均值向量和协方差矩阵。该模型适用于任何连续变量架构，可用于高斯玻色采样或基于通用外差的算法。最终，通过数值模拟量化了多端口干涉仪中光损耗偏离均匀性的程度。
authors: Sebastiano Corli, Dario Chemoli, Samuele Altilia, Edoardo Suerra, Dario Tamascelli, Simone Cialdi, Enrico Prati

articles.title: The Quantum Character Transform
articles.title_zh: 量子特征变换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16827v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bastidas et al. (2025) highlighted the importance of exploiting group symmetries to reduce computational overhead and unify simulation methods across both condensed matter physics and ab initio quantum chemistry. I discuss the discrete character transform, which is the group Fourier transform restricted to Z(C[G]), the center of the group algebra, where class functions form a commutative convolution algebra and irreducible characters are its spectral basis. The normalized character table of a non-abelian group can be obtained through a restriction operator, which means an efficient quantum character transform for any finite group with an efficient quantum Fourier transform. I give complementary quantum algorithms for class convolution based on direct class-sum block encoding and spectral implementation in the character basis, explaining their applications to symmetry-adapted many-body dynamics, molecular and spectroscopic symmetry analysis, and quantum walks, as well as characterizing the central information used in hidden-subgroup problems, including its limitations for graph isomorphism.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文讨论了离散特征变换，即群傅里叶变换在群代数中心上的限制。研究表明，非阿贝尔群的归一化特征表可以通过限制算子获得，这意味着对于任何具有高效量子傅里叶变换的有限群，都可以实现高效的量子特征变换。作者提出了基于直接类和块编码和特征基中谱实现的互补量子算法，并解释了它们在对称适应多体动力学、分子和光谱对称分析以及量子行走中的应用。
authors: Kagwe A. Muchane

articles.title: Geodesic steering for rapid dissipative entanglement distribution
articles.title_zh: 用于快速耗散纠缠分发的测地线引导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16854v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We describe an optimal-control strategy designed to accelerate the dissipative preparation of complex, highly entangled quantum many-body states. Analogous to optimal steering of isolated quantum systems, our scheme identifies control pulses that guide the evolution of open quantum systems along trajectories of instantaneous steady states while minimizing leakage resulting from non-adiabatic transitions. In many cases of interest, these control parameters can be derived analytically and without the need for computationally expensive numerical simulations of the full many-body master equation. We apply this technique for the preparation of bi- and multipartite entangled states in qubit systems coupled to a common photonic waveguide or a distributed squeezed reservoir. In both scenarios, our optimal-control strategy significantly outperforms the bare relaxation dynamics after a quench, reducing preparation times of near-maximally entangled states by orders of magnitude. This drastic speedup makes dissipative entanglement distribution protocols compatible with high-fidelity quantum information processing applications and illustrates more broadly the potential of leakage minimization for accelerating reservoir-engineering schemes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种最优控制策略，旨在加速复杂、高度纠缠量子多体态的耗散制备。该方案通过识别控制脉冲，引导开放量子系统沿着瞬时稳态轨迹演化，同时最小化非绝热跃迁导致的泄漏。研究将此技术应用于量子比特系统中双体和多体纠缠态的制备，并表明其最优控制策略显著优于淬火后的裸弛豫动力学，将近最大纠缠态的制备时间缩短了几个数量级。
authors: Keshav Venkataraman, Pablo Martinez-Azcona, Marko Ljubotina, Adrian Parra-Rodriguez, Peter Rabl

articles.title: Enhanced Quantum Metrology via Saddle-Point Scrambling in Phase Space
articles.title_zh: 通过相空间鞍点扰动增强量子计量学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17047v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonlinear effects are widely utilized in quantum metrology to enhance measurement precision by leveraging complex dynamical behaviors. Here, we propose a quantum scrambling-integrated scheme that optimizes the selection of initial states and parameter encoding by exploiting the nonlinear dynamical trajectories and their geometric properties in phase space. We consider a two-mode Bose-Einstein condensate as a typical example. Within a certain parameter range, using uncorrelated spin coherent states located at saddle points and separatrices enables the measurement precision to reach the Heisenberg scaling. An analytical expression for the quantum Fisher information under long-time evolution is provided, and our analysis further reveals that the enhancement mechanism is governed by the sensitivity of the energy spectrum to parameter variations. Compared to the criticality-enhanced protocol that requires parameters to approach the critical point, our scheme offers a distinct advantage in its applicability over a broader range of parameters. Moreover, this scheme can also be applied to models that include one- and two-axis countertwisting interactions and chaotic dynamics. This Letter offers a new perspective for advancing the application of nonlinear dynamics to enhance the parameter estimation precision in quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种量子扰动集成方案，通过利用相空间中的非线性动力学轨迹及其几何特性，优化初始态选择和参数编码，以增强量子计量精度。以双模玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体为例，研究表明在特定参数范围内，使用位于鞍点和分离子上的非关联自旋相干态可使测量精度达到海森堡标度。该方案在更广泛的参数范围内具有优势，并可应用于包含单轴和双轴反扭转的模型。
authors: Lei Shao, Hai-Jun Xing, Libin Fu

articles.title: Optical Detection of Coherent Nuclear Spin Control in a Molecular System at Room Temperature
articles.title_zh: 室温下分子系统中相干核自旋控制的光学检测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17050v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Molecular systems with optically addressable electron spins are emerging as versatile quantum sensing platforms, offering tunable qubit properties and molecular-scale spatial control. Owing to their longer lifetimes, coupled nuclear spins provide an attractive resource for enhancing sensing performance. For molecular spin systems, the ability to initialise, coherently control and readout nuclear spins at room temperature is crucial for realising such benefits. Here, we present the first optical detection of nuclear magnetic resonance and coherent nuclear spin control with a molecular system at room temperature. Specifically, we demonstrate optically detected Rabi oscillations of ¹⁴N nuclear spins in the photoexcited triplet state of the organic chromophore 6,13-diazapentacene. The strong hyperfine coupling between the electronic spin and ¹⁴N nuclei enhances the nuclear Rabi frequency, enabling fast coherent nuclear-spin rotations. This work lays the foundation for leveraging nuclear spins as memories for enhanced molecular-based quantum sensing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文首次实现了在室温下对分子系统中的核磁共振和相干核自旋控制进行光学检测。研究具体展示了在有机发色团6,13-二氮杂并五苯的光激发三重态中，¹⁴N核自旋的光学检测拉比振荡。电子自旋与¹⁴N核之间的强超精细耦合增强了核拉比频率，从而实现了快速相干核自旋旋转。这项工作为利用核自旋作为存储器，增强基于分子的量子传感奠定了基础。
authors: Eoin O. Irving, Ziqiu Huang, Max Attwood, Sam L. Bayliss, Sarah K. Mann

articles.title: Architecting Instruction Execution for Scalable Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing
articles.title_zh: 可扩展容错量子计算的指令执行架构设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17058v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scaling fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) requires orchestrating millions of operations continuously across a tightly coupled classical-quantum control stack. A critical challenge in this orchestration is determining the optimal hardware-software boundary, i.e., the Quantum Instruction Set Architecture (QISA). We focus on cryogenic, fixed-connectivity qubit platforms, such as superconducting and topological Majorana qubits. For these, existing QISA choices either operate at too low a level, violating cryogenic thermal budgets at scale, or at too high a level, imposing unrealizable complexity on the control engine. To reason about these tradeoffs, we introduce the ARIES instruction set hierarchy, which categorizes QISAs into distinct abstraction levels. To systematically evaluate these levels, we develop an end-to-end evaluation toolflow featuring a cycle-accurate classical driver and hardware engine simulator. Using eight quantum applications across superconducting and topological qubit platforms, we measure instruction bandwidth, transceiver power dissipation, and measurement processing overheads. We demonstrate that while physical-level abstractions exceed the thermal limits of dilution refrigerators by orders of magnitude, canonical-level abstractions significantly underestimate hardware routing congestion and execution runtimes. Our Level 4 QISA (local logical operations) offers an optimal architectural balance. As quantum hardware platforms scale toward FTQC in the coming years, our findings provide concrete architectural guidance for the design of their classical control stacks and instruction interfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 扩展容错量子计算需要协调数百万次操作，其中关键挑战是确定最优的硬件-软件边界，即量子指令集架构（QISA）。本文针对低温、固定连接的量子比特平台，引入了Aries指令集层次结构，将QISA分为不同的抽象级别。为系统评估这些级别，研究开发了一个端到端评估工具流，并使用八个量子应用测量了指令带宽、收发器功耗和测量处理开销。
authors: Dmitry Filippov, Justin Hogaboam, Mathias Soeken, Raghu Gatta, Prakash Murali, Matthias Troyer

articles.title: Cyclotomic Structure and Exact Recurrences in Floquet Many-Body Quantum Dynamics
articles.title_zh: Floquet多体量子动力学中的分圆结构和精确复现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17137v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Periodically driven quantum systems exhibit a wide range of complex dynamics, including chaos. Yet, at special parameter values, their evolution can recur exactly. Several quantum protocols have recently been proposed that exploit exact Floquet recurrences to demonstrate genuine quantum advantage. Such recurrences can be studied through the arithmetic structure of the Floquet unitary. In this work, we establish a necessary and sufficient arithmetic criterion for exact recurrence and determine the minimal recurrence period when one exists. Because recurrence is a global property of the unitary, it holds for every initial state. Applying our framework requires only knowledge of the number field associated with the Hamiltonian parameters. We demonstrate the method using the kicked Ising chain, establishing exact recurrences in both Clifford and non-Clifford regimes. We further show that, in the recurrent non-Clifford regime, magic--a resource for quantum computation--is generated at intermediate times and undergoes exact periodic revivals enforced by the recurrence of the full Floquet unitary. By connecting number theory, quantum many-body dynamics, and quantum information, our work shows that exact recurrence extends beyond Clifford circuits and opens new avenues for magic generation and quantum hardware benchmarking.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了Floquet多体量子动力学中精确复现的充要算术判据，并确定了最小复现周期。该框架仅需哈密顿量参数相关数域的知识，并以踢动伊辛链为例进行了验证，在克利福德和非克利福德区域均建立了精确复现。研究进一步表明，在复现的非克利福德区域，量子计算资源“魔力”在中间时刻产生，并经历由完整Floquet酉算符复现所强制的精确周期性复兴。
authors: Amit Anand, Dinesh Valluri, Shohini Ghose

articles.title: On the Computational Complexity of Blind Quantum Machine Learning
articles.title_zh: 盲量子机器学习的计算复杂性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17145v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Can quantum advantages in computational efficiency coexist with quantum advantages in privacy? In this paper, we construct and use MasonQ, a universal brickwork transpiler, to answer this question with a resounding yes. We approach this question by bridging two seemingly disparate paradigms: universal blind quantum computation (UBQC), based on measurement-based quantum computation, and quantum machine learning (QML) algorithms such as the Harrow-Hassidim-Lloyd (HHL) algorithm and quantum recommendation systems. We provide new upper bounds on the depth of UBQC brickwork graphs, establishing that D = O(ømega n), where ømega is the circuit width and n its computational gate complexity. This is enabled by our newly developed transpiler MasonQ, which maps arbitrary quantum circuits to computational brickwork graph states. Given an optimal Qiskit circuit as input, we prove optimality (up to logarithmic corrections) of the MasonQ transpiler in terms of asymptotic scaling of the total brickwork graph width and depth after decomposition into bricks, enabling systematic cost analyses of blind implementations in near-term experiments and asymptotic regimes. Leveraging MasonQ, we derive depth bounds for several representative blind quantum machine learning (B-QML) algorithms, including the quantum Fourier transform, the HHL algorithm, recommendation systems, and quantum transformers. Lastly, we analyze concrete resource estimates for near-term demonstrations of blind quantum machine learning. We propose a minimal B-QML implementation requiring only a 12 qubit quantum server. To the best of our knowledge, MasonQ is the first functional and optimal universal circuit-to-brickwork-graph transpiler to implement the full brickwork transpilation process from first principles.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过构建和使用通用砖块转译器MasonQ，探讨了计算效率的量子优势与隐私的量子优势能否共存，并给出了肯定的答案。研究通过连接通用盲量子计算和量子机器学习算法来解决这一问题，并为UBQC砖块图的深度提供了新的上限。MasonQ转译器能够将任意量子电路映射到计算砖块图态，从而实现了对盲实现系统性成本分析。
authors: Rex Fleur, Tzula B. Propp, Sebastian Feld

articles.title: Programmable Floquet Response for Quantum Sensing
articles.title_zh: 用于量子传感的可编程Floquet响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17156v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum sensing is typically based on phase accumulation and is therefore fundamentally tied to the coherence time of the sensing system. Here we introduce an alternative sensing paradigm based on programmable Floquet locking in periodically driven two-level systems. We show that periodic control generates an effective Floquet locking field whose orientation and amplitude depend on global offset, allowing information to be encoded in the driven population relaxation dynamics, not in the integrated phase. By controlling transfer between distinct Floquet locking manifolds, external perturbations can be mapped onto engineered relaxation responses whose characteristics are programmable through the driving sequence. We numerically demonstrate this approach for both DC and frequency-selective AC sensing, and show that temporal encoding of the response can provide enhanced precision in the presence of slow instrumental fluctuations. These results illustrate the potential of programmable Floquet responses and open the way to exploring new sensing strategies in driven quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于周期性驱动两能级系统中可编程Floquet锁定的新型量子传感范式。研究表明，周期性控制产生一个有效的Floquet锁定场，其方向和幅度取决于全局偏移，从而将信息编码在驱动的布居弛豫动力学中。数值模拟证明了该方法在直流和频率选择性交流传感中的应用，并显示了其在存在缓慢仪器波动时提供增强精度的潜力。
authors: Dionisio Cendoya, Kang Xu, Lisandro Buljubasich, Carlos A. Meriles

articles.title: Whither quantum advantage? New classical lower bounds for Max-Cut on large-girth 3-regular graphs
articles.title_zh: 量子优势何在？大围长3正则图Max-Cut的新经典下界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17236v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Every 3-regular graph of girth at least g has a cut containing at least a fraction M_g of its edges, and the best rigorous bounds at large girth are 0.912łe łimg→ᵢₙfₜyM_g łe 0.92386. Lower bounds on M_g follow from the performance of local algorithms: on a graph of girth g ge 2p+2 a depth-p local algorithm sees the same tree around every edge, so its expected cut fraction on that tree bounds M_g from below. We apply this strategy to the Variational Iterative Rotation Algorithm (VIRAL), a classical local algorithm, and evaluate it on the depth-p tree for every even depth up to p=32. The resulting bounds exceed those recently obtained from the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) for every pge 4, by 0.005 to 0.011, and they extend the range of girths covered from g=36 to g=66. Notably, at g=66 we obtain M₆₆ ge 0.9127 at 99.99999% confidence level, which raises the asymptotic lower bound from 0.912 to 0.9127.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将变分迭代旋转算法（VIRAL）应用于大围长3正则图的Max-Cut问题，以推导新的经典下界。研究在深度p树上评估了该算法，结果表明其获得的界限超过了量子近似优化算法（QAOA）的最新结果。值得注意的是，在围长g=66时，获得了M₆₆ ≥ 0.9127的下界，将渐近下界从0.912提高到0.9127。
authors: Flaviano Morone, Shivang Rawat, Dries Sels

articles.title: Quantum Cryptography and Autoformalization in Lean
articles.title_zh: Lean中量子密码学与自动形式化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17286v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum key distribution provides secure communication by relying on physics principles and mathematical reasoning. Security proofs across the field can contain gaps, often between individually valid theorems integrated under mismatched assumptions. We produce an end-to-end security theorem formalized in the Lean proof assistant, eliminating hidden hypotheses by building only on Lean's standard axioms. Our proof covers composable security of the entanglement-based qubit BB84 protocol against coherent attacks by the postselection technique, accounting for finite block size, and is written in a language that enforces local operations and classical communication to help ensure a faithful representation of the protocol. The proof itself was enabled by LLM-based autoformalization, and with the proof complete, we used the same pipeline as a discovery machine, reducing the finite-size penalty on the key rate. Our work sets a reproducible standard for security arguments in quantum cryptography and shows how formal proof engines can accelerate discovery across quantum information science.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在Lean证明助手中形式化了一个端到端的量子密钥分发安全定理，消除了隐藏假设，并涵盖了基于纠缠的BB84协议在相干攻击下的可组合安全性。该证明考虑了有限块大小，并以强制局部操作和经典通信的语言编写，以确保协议的忠实表示。这项工作为量子密码学中的安全论证设定了可复现的标准，并展示了形式化证明引擎如何加速量子信息科学领域的发现。
authors: Maor Ben Shahar, Jonathan Morag, Dirk Englund, Kfir Sulimany

articles.title: Ghost unitaries for loss-resilient photonic resource-state generation
articles.title_zh: 损耗弹性光子资源态生成的“幽灵幺正”算符
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17300v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Entangled few-photon states, such as Bell and Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) states, are central resources for discrete-variable photonic quantum information processing. In many architectures, these states are generated probabilistically by first heralding single photons from biphoton sources and then interfering them in linear-optical circuits. In this work, we show that the entanglement structure of said biphoton sources can be directly exploited for noise-engineering to deliver higher quality resource states. Using the transpose identity of multi-mode squeezed vacuum states, we introduce "ghost-unitary" implementations in which the target resource-generation interferometer is applied to the heralding modes rather than to the delivered resource modes. When the dominant imperfection is interferometric loss, this relocation converts direct amplitude damping of the output into false-positive heralding events that require both higher-pair emission and photon loss. In the low-squeezing regime, these events are parametrically suppressed, yielding higher-fidelity conditional resource states. We analyze this mechanism for single-qubit states, two-photon NOON states, Bell states, and a family of n-qubit GHZ states, as well as for single-qubit teleportation and type-I-fusion-based resource growth. Across these examples, we delineate finite parameter regimes in which ghost-unitary implementations outperform direct implementations, with particular relevance to frequency-bin photonics where active linear-optical transformations can be relatively lossy. We also prove that, in the setting considered here, the direct implementation of the n-GHZ family delivers identically damped outputs: equivalent to the ideal state followed by uniform amplitude damping. This extends the known n=2,3 cases and provides a structural result of independent interest for photonic quantum information processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出了一种利用双光子源纠缠结构进行噪声工程的方法，以生成更高质量的光子资源态。通过引入“幽灵幺正”实现，将目标资源生成干涉仪应用于预报模式而非输出模式。这种方法在干涉损耗为主的缺陷下，将输出的直接振幅阻尼转化为可抑制的假阳性预报事件。在低压缩状态下，这些事件被参数化抑制，从而获得更高保真度的条件资源态。
authors: Kevin J. Randles, Manuel H. Muñoz-Arias, Kevin Thompson

articles.title: Optical interferometric tools for probing memory effects
articles.title_zh: 探测记忆效应的光学干涉工具
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17322v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent efforts to detect non-Markovian memory have become increasingly important, motivated by the broad relevance of memory effects in quantum information processing, metrology, and thermodynamic engines. Here, we show that interferometric methods, particularly the phase shift and visibility, provide an experimentally accessible framework for probing environmental effects and witnessing non-Markovian dynamics. Specifically, suitably constructed witness operators enable the detection of non-Markovianity through measurable phase shifts in the interference pattern. Furthermore, we prove that the interferometric visibility is monotonically non-increasing under incoherent CP-divisible (Markovian) dynamics. Consequently, any revival of the optimized visibility constitutes a sufficient signature of information backflow and hence non-Markovianity. The effectiveness of the proposed phase-based and visibility approaches is illustrated for representative examples of non-Markovian dynamics. Our results offer a simple and experimentally feasible framework for probing memory effects, with potential applications in quantum sensing and noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出利用干涉测量方法，特别是相移和可见度，来探测环境效应并见证非马尔可夫动力学。通过构建合适的见证算符，可以通过测量干涉图样中的相移来检测非马尔可夫性。研究证明干涉可见度在非相干CP可分（马尔可夫）动力学下是单调非增的，因此优化可见度的任何复苏都构成信息回流和非马尔可夫性的充分标志。
authors: Saheli Mukherjee, Bivas Mallick, Samyadeb Bhattacharya, Ananda G. Maity, A. S. Majumdar

articles.title: Krylov Complexity and Quantum Many-body Scars in Non-Hermitian Kinetically Constrained Models
articles.title_zh: 非厄米动力学受限模型中的克雷洛夫复杂度与量子多体疤痕
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17328v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Thermalization in closed quantum systems and its breakdown are central to understanding the emergence of statistical behavior in isolated many-body systems. Kinetic constraints can hinder thermalization by restricting the allowed dynamics and giving rise to non-ergodic behavior. While various aspects of ergodicity breaking in kinetically constrained models have been extensively studied in Hermitian systems, their behavior in non-Hermitian kinetically constrained models remains less explored. In particular, the inequivalence of left and right eigenstate ensembles in non-Hermitian systems raises the question of whether they exhibit qualitatively different dynamical and eigenstate properties. In this work, we study non-Hermitian generalizations of the paradigmatic PXP and PPXPP models, focusing on their Krylov complexity, eigenstate structure, and dynamics. By exploiting the Arnoldi's algorithm, we find distinct behavior of Krylov complexity in the left and right eigenstate ensembles as non-Hermiticity is increased: in the right ensemble, it exhibits persistent oscillations with an increasing period, while in the left ensemble, it gradually saturates. The characteristic arch-shaped profile of the Arnoldi coefficients is also modified differently in the two ensembles, with a Hermitian-like arch re-emerging in the left ensemble at large non Hermiticity. Additionally, in the non-Hermitian PXP model, the right ensemble retains the characteristic scar structure, while the left ensemble develops additional non-scar eigenstates with anomalously low entanglement and large overlap with the vacuum state. These findings reveal that non-Hermiticity can affect Krylov dynamics and eigenstate structure differently in the left and right ensembles, demonstrating the need to treat them separately when characterizing non-Hermitian kinetically constrained systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨了非厄米动力学受限模型中的热化现象及其破缺，特别关注非厄米PXP和PPXPP模型的克雷洛夫复杂度、本征态结构和动力学。利用Arnoldi算法，研究发现随着非厄米性的增加，左右本征态系综中的克雷洛夫复杂度表现出截然不同的行为。右系综呈现周期增加的持续振荡，而左系综则逐渐...（详情需查阅原文）。
authors: Arkaprava Sil, Rudraksh Kaushik, Souvik Kundu, Prasant Mallik, Sudipto Singha Roy

articles.title: Generating Superposition of Transverse Ising Ground States by Quantum Interaction
articles.title_zh: 通过量子相互作用生成横向伊辛基态的叠加态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17334v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate superpositions of quantum Ising ground states generated through a quantum interaction, in which the nearest-neighbor coupling strength is promoted to an operator acting on a central auxiliary spin. We prepare the central spin in a superposition, which allows the chain to evolve coherently under different effective interaction strengths. The states are prepared by adiabatic evolution of the joint system comprising the central spin and the many-body spin chain, followed by a measurement on the central spin and post-selection of a specific outcome. It is possible to prepare superpositions of transverse-field quantum Ising ground states belonging to the three magnetic phases, namely, the paramagnetic, ferromagnetic, and anti-ferromagnetic phases. For a spin-1/2 central system, it is possible to prepare superpositions of ground states belonging to any two phases, while for the spin-1 case, the superpositions may contain three ground states, each belonging to one of the three phases. We analytically derive expressions for the magnetization, spin correlations, and entanglement of such states. The magnetization and spin correlations show distinct features in different superposition sectors. The nearest-neighbor entanglement is largest where the transverse field and Ising interaction compete, and its behavior differs from that of the magnetic observables. We also derive the quantum Fisher information relevant to estimating the Ising interaction strength. And it exhibits multiple peaks near the critical points of the constituent ground states, with the maximum value showing Heisenberg scaling, for the parameters and system sizes examined.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究了通过量子相互作用生成量子伊辛基态叠加态的方法，其中近邻耦合强度被提升为作用于中心辅助自旋的算符。通过对中心自旋进行叠加态制备，并结合绝热演化和后选择测量，可以制备属于顺磁、铁磁和反铁磁三种磁相的横向场量子伊辛基态的叠加态。研究还解析推导了这些叠加态的磁化强度、自旋关联和纠缠表达式。
authors: Koushik Das, Sayan Mondal, Ujjwal Sen

articles.title: Distributed quantum phase sensing using an SU(1,1) Perelomov coherent state in a Mach-Zehnder interferometer network
articles.title_zh: 在马赫-曾德尔干涉仪网络中使用SU(1,1)佩雷洛莫夫相干态进行分布式量子相位传感
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17447v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a theoretical study of distributed quantum sensing using a reconfigurable network of N Mach--Zehnder interferometers to simultaneously estimate weighted linear combinations of relative phase shifts. The proposed scheme relies on injecting a Perelomov coherent state, generated from the SU(1,1) group representation, into one port of a passive quantum circuit while the remaining modes are initialized in the vacuum state, thereby establishing non-trivial quantum correlations among the sensors. Based on multi-parameter quantum estimation theory, our analysis shows that this entangled strategy outperforms the standard shot-noise limit and asymptotically achieves the Heisenberg limit. Furthermore, we highlight the crucial role of the first beam splitter's asymmetry; specifically, the optimal transmission coefficient that maximizes sensitivity corresponds to its maximum imbalance. Compared to a separable approach utilizing the same total average photon number, the entangled strategy yields a more efficient use of quantum resources, guaranteeing an accuracy gain between 1 and N. This demonstrates that the entangled strategy is systematically superior to its separable counterpart. Ultimately, these results illustrate the potential of entangled distributed quantum sensor networks for high-precision measurements and provide clear guidelines for optimizing interferometric architectures in quantum metrology.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究理论探讨了在可重构的N个马赫-曾德尔干涉仪网络中，利用SU(1,1)佩雷洛莫夫相干态进行分布式量子传感。该方案通过注入这种相干态，在传感器之间建立非平凡的量子关联，从而在多参数量子估计理论下，其纠缠策略超越了标准散粒噪声极限并渐近达到海森堡极限。研究还强调了第一个分束器不对称性的关键作用，并表明该纠缠策略比可分离方法更有效地利用量子资源，实现了1到N倍的精度增益。
authors: Seloua Boulifa, Abdallah Slaoui, Hanane EL Hadfi, Rachid Ahl Laamara

articles.title: Imaging the topological sign of a Dirac mass with spin-polarized tunneling
articles.title_zh: 利用自旋极化隧穿成像狄拉克质量的拓扑符号
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17464v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A Dirac mass is characterized not only by its magnitude but also by its sign, which influences the Berry curvature, Hall response, and the propagation direction of chiral boundary modes. However, local spectroscopy of magnetic topological surfaces has so far accessed only the gap magnitude |M|. Here we show how the topological sign of M can be determined locally. We first establish the sign information that spin-resolved tunneling can access and the reference required to obtain an absolute Hall sign. Although spin--orbital entanglement generally obscures the relation between measured spin and Dirac pseudospin, crystalline rotation symmetry alleviates this ambiguity at the band edge. On a C₃ axis, an axial tip couples to a fully spin-polarized state whose tunneling asymmetry directly reveals the sign of the occupied-band Berry curvature, independent of orbital composition. We further show that the zeroth Landau level provides an independent mass-sign measurement with an unpolarized tip, while opposite domains and their chiral domain-wall modes provide self-consistency checks. These results pave the way for imaging the locations where the topological character changes within a material, rather than merely identifying where a spectral gap appears.
articles.abstract_zh: 狄拉克质量的符号对贝里曲率、霍尔响应和手性边界模式的传播方向有重要影响，但局部谱学此前只能获取其大小。该工作展示了如何局部确定狄拉克质量的拓扑符号，通过自旋分辨隧穿和晶体旋转对称性来揭示占据带贝里曲率的符号。研究还表明，零朗道能级和相反畴及其手性畴壁模式可提供独立的质量符号测量和自洽性检验。
authors: Payman Kazemikhah, Ruolun Zhang, Byunghoon Kim, Xiangyu Luo, Zachary Ducorsky, Yu-Peng Zhu, Md. Shafayat Hossain, M. Zahid Hasan

articles.title: Coherent optical control of a thousand qubits in a three-dimensional trapped-ion crystal
articles.title_zh: 三维囚禁离子晶体中千个量子比特的相干光学控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17583v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Leading quantum platforms are largely limited to one or two dimensions, whereas three-dimensional Coulomb crystals of trapped ions self-assemble into dense qubit arrays with no rearrangement overhead. Coherent optical control of such crystals has nonetheless been out of reach, because the optical transition couples to nearly all 3N collective modes, i.e., a thermally occupied quasi-continuum bath. Here we cool about 3,600 modes of a crystal of over 1,200 ions below single-phonon occupation, using a continuous cooling band that spans more than five octaves in vibrational spectrum, from about 50 kHz to 2.1 MHz. The crystal then serves as a register of optical qubits, allowing global initialization, coherent manipulation and collective detection. We demonstrate ensemble optical coherence of 21.6 milliseconds and reduce the optical-transition frequency uncertainty from 389 Hz for a single ion to 12 Hz for over a thousand ions, approaching the expected projection-noise scaling. Our approach could be extended to even larger crystals with phonon-mediated many-body couplings, opening a route towards entanglement-enhanced precision metrology and three-dimensional quantum simulation, particularly with spatial-shaped illumination for region-resolved collective control.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究实现了对包含1200多个离子的三维囚禁离子晶体中约3600个模式的冷却，使其低于单声子占据。通过这种方式，该晶体可作为光学量子比特的寄存器，实现全局初始化、相干操控和集体探测。研究展示了21.6毫秒的系综光学相干性，并将光学跃迁频率不确定性从单离子的389 Hz降低到千余离子的12 Hz，接近预期的投影噪声标度。
authors: Yue Li, Yuxiang Huang, Yi Li, Xu Cheng, Zihan Xie, Qingyuan Mei, Chang-Ling Zou, Ya Wang, Xinhua Peng, Yiheng Lin, Jiangfeng Du

articles.title: Fast charging of quantum batteries assisted by nonlinear couplings
articles.title_zh: 非线性耦合辅助的量子电池快速充电
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17599v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Charger-mediated quantum batteries offer promising opportunities for efficient energy transfer and storage at the quantum level, with potential advantages beyond their classical counterparts. Here, we theoretically demonstrate that nonlinear charger-battery interactions can substantially accelerate the charging of quantum batteries. In the weak-driving regime, sufficiently strong nonlinear coupling can dominate over the effect of dephasing and significantly reduce the charging time. In the strong- and optimal-driving regimes, where the optimal driving strength maximizes the steady-state ergotropy in the linear-coupling regime, nonlinear coupling gives rise to a new optimum in the charging time beyond that of the linear-coupling regime, accompanied by nearly critically damped dynamics. Remarkably, even in the absence of external driving, nonlinear coupling alone can substantially reduce the charging time, providing an alternative route toward fast battery charging. Our results establish nonlinear charger-battery coupling as an effective resource for accelerating quantum-battery charging and broaden the scope of interaction-enabled quantum advantages in energy transfer and storage.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究从理论上证明，非线性充电器-电池相互作用可以显著加速量子电池的充电过程。在弱驱动和强驱动状态下，足够强的非线性耦合能有效缩短充电时间，甚至在没有外部驱动的情况下，非线性耦合也能显著减少充电时间。这些结果表明非线性耦合是加速量子电池充电的有效资源。
authors: Y. -J. Shen, Y. -C. Shen, C. -H. Chu, H. H. Jen

articles.title: From Syndromes to Computation: A General Framework for Logical Operations in Quantum Error-Correcting Codes
articles.title_zh: 从综合征到计算：量子纠错码中逻辑操作的通用框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17612v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computation requires error-correcting codes that not only protect quantum information but also support useful logical operations with practical physical realizations. Here we develop a general framework in which the stabilizer syndromes of commuting Pauli rotations directly organize logical-gate design. We derive an exact codespace-preservation condition valid at arbitrary rotation angles, providing a common stabilizer-level description for CSS and non-CSS codes and for both Clifford and non-Clifford operations. A particularly useful equal-syndrome specialization reduces Clifford gate design to stabilizer factorization, yields a general generator weight bound of łceil d/2c̊eil for distance-d codes, and systematically extends to logical rotations higher in the Clifford hierarchy. Applied to bivariate-bicycle (BB) and non-CSS Mirror qLDPC codes, the framework gives explicit low-weight Clifford and controlled-phase gates. Our implementations yield new low-weight gates, including an addressed T gate on the [[16,4,4]] BB code, T-type rotations on the [[64,8,8]] BB code, and CCZ-, CS-, and T-type operations on the [[36,6,6]] Mirror code. We also develop analytic constructions using Clifford algebra bases, which turn the syndrome constraints into explicit algebraic relations and provide a systematic route to logical addressability. We use this approach to analytically construct addressed CNOT, SWAP, controlled, and CCZ-type gates on recursive hypercube codes. An independent construction on middle quantum Reed--Muller codes yields C{}^rZ gates that saturate the equal-syndrome weight bound. These results establish stabilizer syndromes as a constructive link between the stabilizer structure of a quantum code, the logical computations it can directly support, and the fault-tolerance properties of their physical realizations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出了一个通用框架，利用可交换泡利旋转的稳定器综合征直接组织逻辑门设计，以实现容错量子计算。该框架导出了适用于任意旋转角度的精确码空间保持条件，为CSS和非CSS码以及Clifford和非Clifford操作提供了统一的稳定器级描述。通过应用于双变量自行车(BB)和非CSS Mirror qLDPC码，该框架给出了显式的低权重Clifford和受控相位门，并产生了新的低权重门实现。
authors: Hunter Nelson, Arshag Danageozian, ChunJun Cao, Sophia E. Economou, Edwin Barnes

articles.title: Enhanced weak-field sensing using detuned squeezing
articles.title_zh: 利用失谐压缩增强弱场传感
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17682v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Achieving measurement precision beyond the standard quantum limit (SQL) is a fundamental object in quantum metrology. In this manuscript, we propose a streamlined protocol for weak signal sensing in a trapped-ion spin-oscillator system that simultaneously exploits detuned motional squeezing and spin-oscillator entanglement. By combining these two quantum resources, the phase accumulation in this spin system is significantly accelerated, as a result achieving an exponential improvement in the sensitivity over unsqueezed cases. Remarkably, we show that the significant metrological gain provided by our protocol persists in noisy environments, with the sensitivity remaining below the SQL. In particular, our protocol retains a distinct advantage in the short interrogation time regime, thus demonstrating the practical potential in quantum-enhanced sensing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出了一种在囚禁离子自旋-振子系统中进行弱信号传感的简化协议，该协议同时利用了失谐运动压缩和自旋-振子纠缠。通过结合这两种量子资源，自旋系统中的相位积累显著加速，实现了灵敏度相对于非压缩情况的指数级提升。该协议在噪声环境中仍能保持显著的计量增益，且在短询问时间范围内具有明显优势。
authors: Li-Wen Zhang, Yang Liu, Han-Jie Zhu, Wei Qin

articles.title: Multi-parameter estimation enhanced by level crossing Hamiltonian structure with Bayesian feedback
articles.title_zh: 贝叶斯反馈下由能级交叉哈密顿结构增强的多参数估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17790v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Level crossings, where two quantum energy levels intersect, are ubiquitous in quantum systems and play a central role in controlling quantum dynamics. In this study, we establish a framework that connects these level crossing structures to the ultimate precision limits of quantum metrology. By analyzing a Hamiltonian with the level crossings structure, we identify the conditions under which multiple parameters can be estimated simultaneously with maximal sensitivity near the level crossing point. We then construct a resource efficient sensing protocol based on unitary quench dynamics and Bayesian estimation, enabling high precision, low cost parameter estimation without requiring entanglement or complex control. We present a protocol whose estimation precision saturates the Holevo Cramer Rao bound, the tightest achievable precision bound in multi parameter estimation. Using the two level model and the two spin Ising model as illustrative examples, we demonstrate how the protocol can be applied to a system with level crossing Hamiltonian structure. Our findings reveal that level crossings serve as universal operating points for precision quantum metrology, offering a simple and scalable path toward practical multi parameter sensing across diverse quantum platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究建立了一个将能级交叉结构与量子计量学极限精度联系起来的框架。通过分析具有能级交叉结构的哈密顿量，研究确定了在能级交叉点附近同时以最大灵敏度估计多个参数的条件。该工作还构建了一种基于幺正淬火动力学和贝叶斯估计的资源高效传感协议，实现了高精度、低成本的参数估计，其估计精度达到了Holevo Cramer Rao界限。
authors: Ryo Tatsumi, Le Bin Ho, Hiroaki Matsueda

articles.title: Emergent Non-Biorthogonal Born Rule at Dynamical Quantum Phase Transitions
articles.title_zh: 动力学量子相变中涌现的非双正交玻恩定则
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17855v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Non-Hermitian dynamics possesses distinct left and right eigenstates, but their normalization freedom obscures a direct probabilistic interpretation. Starting from a globally Hermitian system governed by the standard Born rule, we generalize dynamical quantum phase transitions (DQPTs) from a reference state to a physical subspace. This generalization provides a clear probabilistic interpretation of left and right states: when each state is normalized to itself, their mutual overlap determines a directly accessible dynamical transition rate. We discuss the new phenomena governed by this emergent non-biorthogonal Born rule and further identify a class of exceptional-point DQPTs (EP-DQPTs), at which the eigenstates of the critical propagator coalesce. Our theory places the probabilistic interpretation of non-Hermitian quantum mechanics on the firm footing of Hermitian quantum mechanics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究从全局厄米系统出发，将动力学量子相变（DQPTs）推广到物理子空间，为非厄米动力学中左右本征态提供了清晰的概率解释。当每个态自身归一化时，它们的相互重叠决定了一个直接可访问的动力学跃迁速率。该理论还识别出一类特殊点DQPTs，其中临界传播子的本征态会合，从而将非厄米量子力学的概率解释建立在厄米量子力学的坚实基础上。
authors: Wei-Wei Yang, Henning Schomerus, Jiangping Hu, Zhesen Yang

articles.title: Experimental Benchmarking of a 256-Qubit Room-Temperature NV-Diamond Quantum Processor with an Optically Programmable Biomolecular Quantum Bus
articles.title_zh: 具有光可编程生物分子量子总线的256量子比特室温NV金刚石量子处理器实验基准测试
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18245v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report Zeus-256, a room-temperature nitrogen-vacancy (NV) diamond processor with 256 simultaneously active processor-level logical qubits arranged in a 16 x 16 array. Each logical qubit combines an NV electron-spin ensemble with nuclear-spin memory and ancillary resources. OpenQASM 2.0 circuits are transpiled into RFSoC-controlled microwave, radio-frequency, optical, timing, measurement and bus-configuration sequences. An optically programmable proprietary protein-chromophore layer with an internal metastable-triplet spin mediator provides a reconfigurable biomolecular quantum bus for local and long-range interactions. Benchmarks cover QFT, GHZ entanglement, Grover search, arithmetic, variational, neural-network, graph-state and Shor-family circuits. Factor recovery is reported for 11 integers of 8-84 bits, with 10 attempts per instance; the 84-bit endpoint uses 256 qubits and 40,250,342 reported gates, with a reported execution time of 551.694 ms. Bell-CHSH measurements yield S = 2.8008 +/- 0.0446. Three-qubit Grover search returns the marked state in 958 of 1,024 shots (93.55%), compared with an ideal reference of 94.53%. A separate 30,000-shot population-and-parity protocol yields fixed-phase GHZ+ fidelity of 99.8960%, an estimated standard error of 0.2885 percentage points and a conservative physical 95% interval of [98.2342%, 100%]. Timing metrics are partial and do not establish quantum advantage. Scaling to 9,984 processor-level logical qubits is an engineering target, distinct from the demonstrated register.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报告了Zeus-256，一个256量子比特的室温氮空位（NV）金刚石处理器，其逻辑量子比特以16x16阵列排列。该处理器利用光可编程的生物分子量子总线实现局域和长程相互作用，并支持OpenQASM 2.0电路。基准测试涵盖了多种量子算法，包括QFT、GHZ纠缠、Grover搜索和Shor家族电路，并成功实现了8-84位整数的因子分解。实验结果展示了该处理器在量子计算任务中的高性能和可扩展性。
authors: Adams Ivanov, Daniela Herrmann, Erick Giovani Sperandio Nascimento

articles.title: V-type Atomic Variance Squeezing
articles.title_zh: V型原子方差压缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18362v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Variance squeezing of a V-type atom interacting with a dissipative cavity is investigated. First, the influence of atomic initial state parameters on the variance squeezing is explored. The results show that the atomic variance squeezing switches alternately between Sx and Sy as the initial state parameter alpha sweeps from -pi to pi. The two squeezing intervals are symmetric about alpha = pi/4, each with a width of pi/2. For alpha = pi/14, only the Sx component can generate variance squeezing and will eventually disappear with time evolution due to unavoidable environmental noise. Then, the influence of system parameters on the variance squeezing is also studied. It is found that, the optical variance squeezing depth of Sx is determined solely by the atomic initial parameters and is independent of the system parameters. Both weak cavity-environment coupling and atom-cavity detuning can significantly enhance the robustness of the Sx variance squeezing. The SGI parameter has an extremely weak influence on variance squeezing. These results are beneficial for high-precision quantum communication applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了V型原子与耗散腔相互作用时的方差压缩现象。结果表明，原子初始态参数会影响方差压缩在Sx和Sy分量之间的切换，且Sx分量的光学方差压缩深度仅由原子初始参数决定。弱腔-环境耦合和原子-腔失谐能显著增强Sx方差压缩的鲁棒性，而SGI参数影响极小。这些发现对高精度量子通信应用具有重要意义。
authors: Chenrui Bi, Hong-Mei Zou, Zhao-Yang Tong, Zijin Liang

articles.title: Finite-energy two-way assisted capacities: Exact formulas for multimode loss and fading
articles.title_zh: 有限能量双向辅助容量：多模损耗和衰落的精确公式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18731v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study quantum communication, entanglement distribution, and secret-key generation through multimode bosonic loss and fading channels, assisted by local quantum operations and two-way classical communication. Using sector teleportation, we determine the exact two-way quantum and secret-key capacities of multimode pure-loss channels under a mean photon-number constraint, allowing arbitrary adaptive quantum protocols. We extend these results to continuous frequency-dependent loss under a power constraint and identify the optimal allocation of photons among optical modes. For constant loss over an unlimited bandwidth, we obtain a closed-form capacity proportional to the square root of power. For randomly varying loss, we determine exact finite-energy capacities when the channel realization is publicly revealed, distinguishing knowledge before and after transmission. When fading remains unobserved, we derive capacity bounds and explicit formulas for an on/off channel. We also establish strong-converse bounds, with exact thresholds for the deterministic loss models considered here, observed fading, and unobserved fading with finitely many possible transmissivities. Under mean energy constraints, these thresholds generally exceed the corresponding finite-energy capacities. These results guide energy allocation and provide benchmarks for energy-constrained optical quantum communication with multimode signals and variable loss.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了通过多模玻色子损耗和衰落信道的量子通信、纠缠分发和秘密密钥生成，并利用局域量子操作和双向经典通信进行辅助。研究人员使用扇区隐形传态，确定了在平均光子数约束下多模纯损耗信道的精确双向量子和秘密密钥容量。这些结果被推广到连续频率相关损耗和随机变化的衰落信道，并给出了容量的精确公式和界限，为量子通信协议的设计提供了理论基础。
authors: Stefano Pirandola, Gaetana Spedalieri

articles.title: Deterministic and programmable generation of mechanical multipartite entangled states
articles.title_zh: 机械多体纠缠态的确定性可编程生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18778v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimode mechanical resonators offer a large set of densely packed, long-lived bosonic modes within a single compact device, making them attractive for quantum simulation, quantum information processing, and quantum-enhanced sensing. Many such applications rely on multipartite entanglement, yet deterministic mechanical entanglement has so far been largely limited to pairs of modes. Here we demonstrate the deterministic and programmable preparation of multipartite entangled states among the phonon modes of a high-overtone bulk acoustic wave resonator coupled to a superconducting transmon qubit. By sequentially applying optimal-control-engineered isometries between the qubit and successive modes, we generate matrix product states of bond dimension two, including W, Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ), and cluster states. We fully characterize these states via quantum state tomography and certify genuine multipartite entanglement among up to four modes. We further demonstrate correlated-noise sensing by exploiting the complementary decoherence responses of the stored W and GHZ states, isolating inter-mode phase correlations from local decoherence and placing quantitative bounds on collective dephasing. Our results establish a scalable approach to preparing multipartite entangled states in mechanical systems, with promising applications in multiparameter sensing and tests of quantum mechanics with massive objects.
articles.abstract_zh: 多模机械谐振器因其紧凑设备中大量密集、长寿命的玻色子模式，在量子模拟、信息处理和增强传感方面具有吸引力。本研究展示了在与超导transmon量子比特耦合的高次泛音体声波谐振器的声子模式之间，确定性且可编程地制备多体纠缠态。通过顺序应用优化控制设计的等距变换，成功生成了键维为二的矩阵乘积态，包括W态、GHZ态和簇态。研究通过量子态层析成像完全表征了这些态，证实了多达四个模式间的真实多体纠缠，并展示了利用存储态的互补退相干响应进行相关噪声传感的能力。
authors: Isabelle Franzen, Max-Emanuel Kern, Q. Rumman Rahman, Igor Kladarić, Stefano Marti, Yiwen Chu, Zhi-Yuan Wei, Matteo Fadel

articles.title: mathsfEFIŁeftrightarrowmathsf1PRS
articles.title_zh: EFI对与1PRS的等价性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18799v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A series of recent works has established EFI pairs as the "minimal" assumption for quantum cryptography. Recently, Cavalar et al. [CCC+26] showed that EFI pairs are equivalent to non-uniform expanding single-copy pseudorandom state generators (1PRS), and obtained a non-uniform meta-complexity characterization of EFI pairs. We remove the non-uniformity in their construction and prove that EFI pairs are equivalent to expanding 1PRS. As a corollary, we obtain the first uniform meta-complexity characterization of EFI pairs. Together with the equivalence of statistically verifiable one-way state generators and commitments proved by Batra and Jain [BJ24], this gives a quantum analogue of the classical equivalence between one-way functions, commitments, and pseudorandom generators.
articles.abstract_zh: 近期研究已将EFI对确立为量子密码学的“最小”假设。Cavalar等人证明了EFI对等价于非均匀扩展的单拷贝伪随机态生成器（1PRS）。本研究消除了其构造中的非均匀性，证明了EFI对等价于扩展的1PRS，从而首次获得了EFI对的均匀元复杂度表征。结合统计可验证单向态生成器与承诺的等价性，这为经典单向函数、承诺和伪随机生成器之间的等价性提供了量子类比。
authors: Rishabh Batra

articles.title: Gaussian entanglement and quantum communication: geodesic optimization and multimode bounds
articles.title_zh: 高斯纠缠与量子通信：测地线优化和多模界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18827v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Loss and noise limit the use of light to distribute entanglement, transmit quantum information, and establish secret keys. Gaussian states have a compact description in terms of means and covariance matrices, but their entanglement still requires global optimization. We develop a framework for computing Gaussian-restricted versions of the relative entropy of entanglement and Rains entanglement. An integral representation reveals a convex geometry under matrix geometric means and reduces Gaussian Rains entanglement to relative entropy minimized over Gaussian states with positive partial transpose. We obtain unique optimal reference states and additivity for independent Gaussian input states. Our convex-majorization algorithm has an explicit geometric convergence rate, uniform in the faithful regularization parameter and valid for pure input states. Controlled numerical integration and approximate convex subproblem solutions give a bit-complexity bound that is polynomial in accuracy bits for each fixed rational input covariance matrix, with explicit dependence on covariance size. These calculations bound extractable entanglement and, through the relative entropy of entanglement, extractable secret key. Teleportation simulation, energy allocation, and a convex optimization of passive-basis loss cores give bounds on quantum and private communication under an input-energy constraint, allowing arbitrary two-way classically assisted protocols. Two- and three-mode examples compare the bounds with achievable rates, including matching pure-loss benchmarks. Finally, we separate the Gaussian-restricted quantities from their unrestricted counterparts and give a photon-number truncation method with controlled error for computing the latter.
articles.abstract_zh: 损耗和噪声限制了光在纠缠分发、量子信息传输和秘密密钥建立中的应用。高斯态虽然描述紧凑，但其纠缠量计算仍需全局优化。本研究开发了一个计算高斯限制下纠缠相对熵和Rains纠缠的框架，揭示了矩阵几何平均下的凸几何结构。研究获得了独立高斯输入态的唯一最优参考态和可加性，并提出了一个具有明确几何收敛速度的凸主化算法，为可提取纠缠和量子通信容量提供了界限。
authors: Hemant K. Mishra, Mark M. Wilde

articles.title: Electric-dipole-induced nuclear electric resonance in silicon
articles.title_zh: 硅中电偶极子诱导的核电共振
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14139v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The nuclear spin of a phosphorus atom in silicon is considered as a promising quantum information carrier for quantum computing due to its long coherence time. Coherent control of the nuclear spin is typically realized using nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR). In this work, we theoretically propose that with the aid of hyperfine interactions and magnetic field gradients, fast electric-dipole-induced nuclear electric resonance (EDNER) can be achieved. The stronger EDNER (compared with NMR) arises from the combined effects of hyperfine interaction between the nuclear and electron spins and coupling between the electron spin and charge degrees of freedom mediated by magnetic field gradients in this scheme. By operating at specific working points, the nuclear-spin splitting becomes less sensitive to electrical noise, enabling long coherence times and high-fidelity quantum operations. All elctrical, addressable control of nuclear spins paves the way for scalable silicon-based quantum computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 硅中磷原子的核自旋因其长相干时间被认为是量子计算中极具潜力的量子信息载体。本研究理论提出，借助超精细相互作用和磁场梯度，可以实现快速的电偶极子诱导核电共振（EDNER），其强度高于传统的核磁共振（NMR）。通过在特定工作点操作，核自旋分裂对电噪声的敏感度降低，从而实现长相干时间和高保真量子操作。这种全电学可寻址的核自旋控制为可扩展的硅基量子计算铺平了道路。
authors: Jiyun Su, Shihang Zhang, Peihao Huang

articles.title: Categorifying Quantum Spin Systems
articles.title_zh: 量子自旋系统的范畴化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14165v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop a homotopical framework for understanding the space of quantum spin systems based on topological n-nets, which assign associative unital algebras to local regions in an n-dimensional space in a manner that captures the locality structure of the underlying lattice theories. The net-theoretic perspective admits a natural categorification, in which the category of topological n-nets carries the structure of a higher Morita category. Moreover, the nets of greatest physical interest form a Karoubi-complete subcategory that shares many of the characteristic structural features of the category of finite TQFTs. Our main result identifies the group of locality-preserving symmetries of (3+1)-dimensional quantum spin systems (i.e. quantum cellular automata modulo stabilization, finite-depth quantum circuits, and translations) with the full Witt group of nondegenerate braided fusion categories, thereby answering a question posed by Haah.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于拓扑n-网格发展了一个同伦框架，用于理解量子自旋系统空间，该框架将结合幺半代数分配给n维空间中的局部区域，以捕捉底层晶格理论的局域结构。这种网格理论视角自然地允许范畴化，其中拓扑n-网格的范畴具有高阶Morita范畴的结构。主要结果将(3+1)维量子自旋系统的局域保持对称群与非退化辫状融合范畴的完整Witt群等同起来，回答了Haah提出的一个问题。
authors: Matthew Yu

articles.title: Experimental observation of Higgs oscillations and their power-law decay across pairing regimes in a cavity QED quantum simulator
articles.title_zh: 腔QED量子模拟器中希格斯振荡及其在配对机制中幂律衰减的实验观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14171v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Understanding how pairing correlations in superconductors evolve out of equilibrium is a central challenge in quantum many-body physics. In systems with s-wave pairing, the character of Cooper pairing evolves continuously from a BCS regime of weakly bound, overlapping pairs to a BEC regime of tightly bound molecules, each with distinct excitation spectra. Here we realize and probe pairing dynamics across these regimes using cold, non-degenerate ⁸⁷Rb atoms coupled to an optical cavity with Floquet dressing. Our cavity-QED platform emulates fermionic superfluids through a mapping onto Anderson pseudospins, while optical and microwave control tunes the ratio of interactions to single-particle energies, providing a flexible approach complementary to ultracold Feshbach and ultrafast solid-state platforms. Following a quench, we observe persistent pairing and transient oscillations of the order parameter associated with a collective amplitude (Higgs) mode. We find that the decay of these oscillations sharply distinguishes weak- and strong-pairing regimes: in the weak-pairing regime, oscillations decay with a power-law exponent |α|=0.65(8), whereas in the strong-pairing regime the decay is substantially faster, with |α|>1. The oscillation frequency is set by the minimum quasiparticle excitation energy, directly linking nonequilibrium dynamics to the underlying excitation spectrum. Our results establish nonequilibrium dynamics as a direct probe of pairing character and collective excitations in interacting quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 理解超导体中配对关联如何非平衡演化是量子多体物理学的核心挑战。本研究利用冷非简并⁸⁷Rb原子与光腔耦合的腔QED平台，模拟了费米子超流体，并实验观测了配对机制中的希格斯振荡及其衰减。研究发现，这些振荡的衰减行为能清晰区分弱配对和强配对机制，在弱配对机制中，振荡以幂律指数|α|=0.65(8)衰减。这项工作为理解量子多体系统中的非平衡配对动力学提供了新的见解。
authors: Chitose Maruko, Haoqing Zhang, Eliot A. Bohr, Leah Huzjak, Anjun Chu, Victor Gurarie, Chengyi Luo, Ana Maria Rey, James K. Thompson

articles.title: Spiral Edge States in Topological 2D Sb2Te3 Crystals
articles.title_zh: 拓扑二维Sb2Te3晶体中的螺旋边缘态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14905v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This work explores the edge state conduction properties of twinned and spiraled, 2D Sb2Te3 topological insulator crystals. We show the structure supports spatially continuous edge states within two spiral and knotted edge conduction channels. The channels are connected through a topological defect. This geometry introduces boundary conditions into the 2D crystal that modifies the edge state dispersion. Using a combination of low loss Electron Energy Loss Spectroscopy, Magnetic Force Microscopy and traditional carrier transport measurements we identify a distinct excitation at 0.155 eV in the spiral that seems to be related to two isolated states within the gap. This state is localized to the crystal edges. The modification of edge state bands using manipulation of a systems quantum geometry may open new avenues for the use of 2D topological systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 这项工作研究了孪晶和螺旋状二维Sb2Te3拓扑绝缘体晶体的边缘态传导特性。研究发现，该结构在两个螺旋和打结的边缘传导通道内支持空间连续的边缘态，这些通道通过拓扑缺陷连接。这种几何结构引入了边界条件，改变了边缘态的色散关系。结合电子能量损失谱、磁力显微镜和载流子输运测量，研究人员在螺旋结构中识别出0.155 eV的独特激发，该激发与能隙内的两个孤立态相关并局限于晶体边缘。通过操纵系统量子几何来修改边缘态能带，可能为二维拓扑系统的应用开辟新途径。
authors: Timothy Carlson, Daniel Lazega, Scott McGuire, Mihirangi Medahinne, Motahhare Mirhosseini, Gabriel Marcus, ChaoChao Dun, Maria Kolesnik-Gray, Vojislav Krstic, David Carroll

articles.title: Ergodicity breaking transition beyond qubits
articles.title_zh: 超越量子比特的遍历性破缺转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15546v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The local Hilbert space dimension is a fundamental parameter in quantum many-body systems, but its role in controlling the ergodicity-breaking transition remains less explored. We systematically study this question by introducing toy models of qudits in zero dimensions that exhibit an ergodicity-breaking transition. Using the hybridization condition, we analytically obtain the dependence of the critical value of the interactions on the local Hilbert space dimension. Numerical studies of spectral correlation measures show agreement with the theoretical predictions, hence confirming the existence of the ergodicity-breaking transition in these models. We further introduce a distinct higher spin version of the model and numerically obtain the same critical behavior, demonstrating that the observed critical point is independent of the microscopic structure of interactions considered.
articles.abstract_zh: 局部希尔伯特空间维度是量子多体系统中的一个基本参数，但其在控制遍历性破缺转变中的作用尚未得到充分探索。本研究通过引入零维qudit玩具模型，系统地探讨了这一问题，这些模型表现出遍历性破缺转变。利用杂化条件，研究人员解析地获得了相互作用临界值对局部希尔伯特空间维度的依赖关系。数值研究结果与理论预测一致，证实了这些模型中遍历性破缺转变的存在，并表明所观察到的临界点与所考虑的相互作用微观结构无关。
authors: Tanay Pathak, Abhik Kumar Saha

articles.title: Variational Minimization of Almost Strong Zero Modes in Parafermionic Wires
articles.title_zh: 准强零模在费米子线中的变分最小化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15748v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Strongly interacting fermionic chains obeying a Zₙ symmetry can host topological phases with highly degenerate ground-state manifolds. The different ground states are connected by strongly bound fractionalized edge modes called parafermionic zero modes. While exactly preserved under time evolution at zero temperature, interactions lead to a destabilization of these modes at finite energy densities, and, given a generic Hamiltonian, obtaining the lifetime of these modes is often impossible as it requires knowledge of the full spectrum of the Hamiltonian or long time evolutions. Here, we propose a novel quantum-inspired algorithm that can be used to variationally search for these almost strong zero modes in generic parafermionic chain models. We demonstrate analytically and numerically that our ansatz faithfully reproduces the exact results and finds strongly bound parafermionic operators in the non-integrable Kitaev-Hubbard chain and chiral Potts model. Our results further allow us to verify the existence of a true strong zero mode in the symmetrical limit of the chiral Potts model for Z₃₋ₚₐᵣₐfermions.
articles.abstract_zh: 遵循Zₙ对称性的强相互作用费米子链可以承载具有高度简并基态流形的拓扑相，其中不同的基态通过强束缚的分数化边缘模（即准费米子零模）连接。本研究提出了一种新颖的量子启发算法，可用于在通用准费米子链模型中变分搜索这些准强零模。研究人员通过分析和数值方法证明，该方法能忠实地再现精确结果，并在不可积的Kitaev-Hubbard链和手性Potts模型中找到强束缚的准费米子算符。这些结果进一步证实了在Z₃准费米子手性Potts模型的对称极限下，存在真正的强零模。
authors: Niklas Tausendpfund, Matteo Rizzi

articles.title: Few-Magnon Universality beyond Contact Interactions in Long-Range Spin Chains
articles.title_zh: 长程自旋链中超越接触相互作用的少磁子普适性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16126v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum few-body systems exhibit a rich variety of phenomena that provide fundamental insights into universality. A paradigmatic example is the Efimov effect, in which an infinite tower of three-body bound states emerges with binding energies forming a geometric sequence. Motivated by advances in trapped-ion systems, recent theoretical work has predicted that the Efimov effect can arise in certain long-range quantum spin chains, where magnons exhibit a general dispersion ϵₖ₌ᵤ|k|^z with zin(0.52,0.88) and interact through a contact potential. Nevertheless, whether Efimov universality persists in the presence of experimentally relevant long-range interactions between magnons remains unexplored. In this work, we address this issue by investigating the two- and three-magnon problems with a model interaction potential V(x)=V₀/(1+|x|^β). Our results demonstrate that few-body universality persists for any β>1: In the two-magnon sector, the low-energy expansion of the scattering matrix near a two-body resonance agrees with the universal form predicted by contact-interaction theory. The three-magnon bound-state spectrum exhibits Efimov scaling, with a scaling factor consistent with the theory. We further highlight the experimental relevance of our model, which can be readily realized in trapped-ion systems. Our results pave the way for quantum simulations of universal few-body physics beyond the traditional paradigm of nonrelativistic particles.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子少体系统展现出丰富的现象，为普适性提供了基本见解，其中Efimov效应是一个典型例子。本研究旨在探讨在实验相关的长程磁子相互作用下，Efimov普适性是否依然存在。通过研究具有模型相互作用势V(x)=V₀/(1+|x|^β)的两磁子和三磁子问题，结果表明，对于任何β>1，少体普适性都持续存在。在两磁子扇区，散射矩阵在两体共振附近的低能展开与接触相互作用理论预测的普适形式一致，且三磁子束缚态谱展现出Efimov标度行为。
authors: Yiran Huo, Pengfei Zhang

articles.title: Foundations for a Lens of Quantum Governance
articles.title_zh: 量子治理视角的建立
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16939v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The second quantum revolution is a revolution of information. Advances in quantum computation, communication, and sensing offer new capabilities while raising questions about how quantum infrastructures will be organised, accessed, and governed. We argue that their significance for governance lies not in transforming political principles, but in how their technical and infrastructural requirements may affect existing relationships of authority, responsibility, legitimacy, and power. This paper develops a quantum governance lens that connects governance scholarship with quantum information science, examining interactions between technical design, institutional arrangements, and infrastructural dependencies. We apply this lens to five areas: quantum computation, quantum key distribution, Quantum Byzantine Agreement, blind quantum computation, and dual-use quantum sensing. These applications illustrate how technical capabilities may influence access, trust, privacy, oversight, and accountability, while demonstrating that technical guarantees cannot resolve institutional questions independently. We conclude that quantum technologies do not necessarily introduce unique governance challenges or require entirely new governance frameworks. Rather, they provide a context in which established questions of legitimacy, accountability, and equity must be reconsidered in relation to emerging technological capabilities and institutional choices.
articles.abstract_zh: 第二次量子革命是信息革命，量子计算、通信和传感的进步带来了新能力，同时也引发了关于量子基础设施如何组织、访问和治理的问题。本文提出了一种量子治理视角，将治理学术与量子信息科学相结合，审视技术设计、制度安排和基础设施依赖之间的相互作用。研究人员将此视角应用于量子计算、量子密钥分发、量子拜占庭协议、盲量子计算和军民两用量子传感等五个领域。这些应用表明，技术能力可能影响访问、信任、隐私、监督和问责制，但技术保障不能独立解决制度问题，因此量子技术需要更全面的治理框架。
authors: Shira K. Huizing Lemstra, Tzula B. Propp

articles.title: Emergence of quantum transport in SnTe films upon structural refinement
articles.title_zh: SnTe薄膜结构精修后量子输运的出现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14233v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological crystalline insulators are distinguished from the conventional Z2 topological insulators by crystalline symmetry protection of the surface states. Quantitative characterization of these states requires magneto-transport measurements from which the phase coherence length and number of independent coherent channels can be extracted. Here we report such measurements on textured thin films of SnTe grown on Bi2Te3 buffered c-plane sapphire (Al2O3) by pulsed laser ablation. A post deposition annealing protocol was implemented to control the crystallographic texture, which reveals improved crystallinity and enhanced epitaxial alignment along the [111] direction in films annealed at elevated temperatures. The higher carrier density and lower resistivity seen in films annealed at 100 oC are suggestive of Sn vacancies which act as native acceptor defects, while films annealed at 200 oC approach the 1:1 stoichiometry. The magnetoresistance of all samples at T < 10 K characterized by a cusp centered around zero-field is suggestive of weak antilocalization and interpreted in the framework of the Hikami-Larkin-Nagaoka theory in the strong spin-orbit coupling limit. At T > 20 K, the MR is small and positive, and deviates from conventional Kohler scaling. An approximate collapse of the MR curves between 50 and 250 K is obtained using an empirical temperature-dependent scaling factor, indicating that changes in the Hall-derived carrier density alone cannot account for the observed scaling behavior. These results demonstrate that post growth annealing strongly influences the interplay between stoichiometry, crystallinity, and coherent transport in SnTe thin films.
articles.abstract_zh: 拓扑晶体绝缘体通过晶体对称性保护表面态，其定量表征需要磁输运测量以提取相位相干长度和独立相干通道数量。本研究报告了在Bi2Te3缓冲的c面蓝宝石上通过脉冲激光烧蚀生长的SnTe织构薄膜的磁输运测量结果。通过沉积后退火协议控制晶体织构，发现高温退火的薄膜结晶度提高，沿[111]方向的外延排列增强。在100°C退火的薄膜中观察到较高的载流子密度和较低的电阻率，表明存在作为本征受主缺陷的Sn空位，而200°C退火的薄膜接近1:1的化学计量比。所有样品在T < 10 K时磁阻在零场附近呈现尖峰，表明存在弱反局域化效应，并根据Hikami-Larkin-Nagaoka理论进行解释。
authors: Shrinkhala Sharma, Rabindra Basnet, Thomas Parker, Afolabi Akinfaderin, Alexander Samokhvalov, Rajeswari Kolagani, Ramesh C. Budhani

articles.title: Explicit Solvents Reverse Temperature Dependence of Phase Behavior in Charged Fluids
articles.title_zh: 显式溶剂逆转带电流体相行为的温度依赖性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14366v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In most theories of electrolyte and polyelectrolyte solutions, the solvent is treated implicitly as a dielectric continuum. While this approximation has enabled major advances, it neglects coupling between ionic and dipolar degrees of freedom. Using molecular dynamics simulations and the mean-spherical approximation, we show that this coupling qualitatively alters electrostatically driven phase behaviour. At finite ion concentrations, many-body ion-dipole correlations reverse the temperature dependence of effective electrostatic interactions, leading to upper-critical solution temperature (UCST) behaviour in direct contrast to the lower-critical solution temperature (LCST) behaviour predicted by implicit-solvent electrostatic theories. This phase reversal arises from ion-induced suppression of local dipolar screening, a collective effect inaccessible to pairwise implicit-solvent descriptions.
articles.abstract_zh: 在大多数电解质和聚电解质溶液理论中，溶剂被隐式处理为介电连续体，但这种近似忽略了离子和偶极自由度之间的耦合。本研究利用分子动力学模拟和平均球面近似，表明这种耦合定性地改变了静电驱动的相行为。在有限离子浓度下，多体离子-偶极关联逆转了有效静电相互作用的温度依赖性，导致出现上临界溶解温度（UCST）行为，这与隐式溶剂静电理论预测的下临界溶解温度（LCST）行为形成鲜明对比。这种相逆转源于离子诱导的局部偶极屏蔽抑制，这是一种双体隐式溶剂描述无法触及的集体效应。
authors: Pierre J. Walker, Zhen-Gang Wang

articles.title: Direct Observation of Chirality-Dependent Berry Curvature Dipole via Cross-Axial Nonlinear Hall Effect in Trigonal Te
articles.title_zh: 通过三方碲中交叉轴非线性霍尔效应直接观测手性依赖的贝里曲率偶极
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14367v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum geometric quantities, such as Berry curvature (BC) and quantum metric, are known to govern the physical and topological properties of materials, making access to these quantities critically important for the comprehensive understanding of the materials. Chiral crystals offer a natural platform in which structural handedness can control quantum geometry and nonlinear transport, but direct experimental access to the quantum geometric quantities has remained elusive. Here, we show that trigonal tellurium (Te) hosts an enantiomer-dependent Berry curvature dipole (BCD) that can be accessed through the measurement of cross-axial nonlinear Hall effect (NHE), unlike previously studied in-plane configurations where the BCD contribution vanishes. Angle-resolved measurements on left- and right-handed Te devices reveal a second-order transverse response whose sign reverses with crystal chirality. The extracted cross-axial nonlinear susceptibility, ḩiyₓz, exceeds the in-plane susceptibility, ḩiₓₓₓ, by more than two-folds, indicating a strong BCD-driven contribution. First-principles calculations attribute this behavior to a topologically nontrivial hedgehog-like BC texture near the H points and predict a BCD that reverses sign between opposite enantiomers, consistent with experiment. These results establish cross-axial nonlinear Hall transport as a symmetry-selective probe of chirality-controlled quantum geometry in tellurium and related chiral materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子几何量，如贝里曲率和量子度规，控制着材料的物理和拓扑性质，因此获取这些量对于全面理解材料至关重要。本研究表明，三方碲（Te）具有手性对映体依赖的贝里曲率偶极（BCD），可通过测量交叉轴非线性霍尔效应（NHE）来获取。对左手性和右手性Te器件进行角度分辨测量，揭示了二阶横向响应，其符号随晶体手性反转。提取的交叉轴非线性磁化率超过面内磁化率两倍以上，表明BCD驱动的贡献很强。第一性原理计算将此行为归因于拓扑性质。
authors: Jaehyun Lee, Junhee Shin, Daryll J. C. Dalayoan, Miju Park, Changhee Sohn, Gang Qiu, Noejung Park, Binghai Yan, Tony Low, Hosub Jin, Seon Namgung

articles.title: Exotic metallic phase in a heterotic Kondo lattice: violation of Luttinger's theorem and absence of Kondo gap
articles.title_zh: 异质近藤晶格中的奇异金属相：卢廷格定理的违反与近藤能隙的缺失
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14556v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fermi surface transformation accompanied by quantum phase transition is widely observed in correlated electron systems including heavy fermion materials and van der Waals quantum heterostructures. The unified Anderson lattice description for this phenomenon suggests that their interacting ground states in the case of electron half filling always destabilize the metallic phase in the strong Kondo-coupling regime. We examine this issue within the paramagnetic phase of a Kondo lattice system with a heterotic layered structure. In the weak Kondo-coupling regime, the system exhibits a fractional Dirac liquid involving the massless or massive Dirac fermions and a charge neutral spinon Fermi surface. In the strong Kondo-coupling regime, the spinons hybridize with the Dirac fermions resulting in an intermediate nearly-flat hybridizing band together with the conduction and valence heavy fermion bands, yielding a large electric Fermi surface. Absence of the Kondo gap between these bands is observed depending on the stacking configurations of the layered structure. In particular, the system remains metallic even at the exact half filling in this regime and Luttinger's theorem is violated across the critical point. Implications of these results on the van der Waals quantum heterostructures are briefly discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 费米面转变伴随量子相变在关联电子系统中广泛存在，但强近藤耦合区间的金属相稳定性问题仍待探讨。本研究在具有异质层状结构的近藤晶格系统的顺磁相中检验了这一问题。在弱近藤耦合区，系统表现出分数狄拉克液体，而在强近藤耦合区，自旋子与狄拉克费米子杂化，形成中间的准平坦杂化带以及导带和价带重费米子带，产生大的电费米面。研究发现，根据层状结构的堆叠构型，这些能带之间不存在近藤能隙。特别是，即使在精确半填充时，系统仍保持金属态。
authors: Hanting Zhong, Shuxiang Yang, Chao Cao, Xiao-Yong Feng, Jianhui Dai, Hai-Qing Lin

articles.title: Emergent one-dimensional Bloch oscillations in coupled Ising layers
articles.title_zh: 耦合伊辛层中一维布洛赫振荡的涌现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14857v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bloch oscillations typically arise in periodic systems subjected to a constant force generated by a potential gradient. Here, we study domain-wall dynamics in coupled Ising layers under asymmetric longitudinal fields. The interlayer coupling is of Heisenberg type and acts as an effective transverse coupling in the emergent pseudospin representation. We show that the rung pseudospin structure gives rise to kinetic constraints, restricting the many-body dynamics to an emergent one-dimensional quasiparticle subspace within the original two-dimensional system. Furthermore, the imbalance between the longitudinal fields of the two layers induces an effective linear potential for the emergent domain-wall excitations, leading to their confinement between two oppositely polarized ferromagnetic domains. Remarkably, the resulting Wannier--Stark ladder of domain-wall excitations gives rise to Bloch oscillations in the absence of a conventional tilted potential, revealing a distinct mechanism for coherent quantum dynamics. Numerical simulations of time-dependent observables confirm the analytical predictions.
articles.abstract_zh: 布洛赫振荡通常出现在受恒定力作用的周期系统中。本研究探讨了不对称纵向场下耦合伊辛层中的畴壁动力学。层间耦合是海森堡型的，在涌现的赝自旋表示中充当有效的横向耦合。研究表明，梯形赝自旋结构产生了动力学约束，将多体动力学限制在原始二维系统中的一个涌现一维准粒子子空间。此外，两层纵向场之间的不平衡诱导了涌现畴壁激发的有效线性势，导致它们被限制在两个极化相反的铁磁畴之间。由此产生的畴壁激发的Wannier-Stark阶梯在没有传统倾斜势的情况下产生了布洛赫振荡，揭示了一种独特的相干量子动力学机制。时间依赖性可观测量的数值模拟证实了分析预测。
authors: E. S. Ma, Z. Song

articles.title: Superlattice-Stabilized Fractional Chern Insulators in a "Berry Basin" Model
articles.title_zh: “贝里盆地”模型中超晶格稳定的分数陈绝缘体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15197v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The discovery of integer and fractional Chern insulators in rhombohedral graphene, following their discovery in the isolated topological flat band in twisted MoTe₂, motivates a search for the conditions under which an electronic band can host a topological correlated state. In this Letter we introduce a ``Berry basin" model which captures the essential features of rhombohedral graphene: a dispersive band with a flat bottom, momentum-space winding of a ``layer" degree of freedom, and Coulomb interactions, while also including periodic potentials, enabling controlled studies of the interplay of quantum geometry, superlattice modulation, and electron-electron interactions in producing correlated topological states beyond the isolated topological band paradigm. While integer Chern insulators emerge at strong coupling without a superlattice potential, stabilizing the fractional state requires nonzero potential for all interaction strengths we access. We provide insight into the greater robustness of integer and fractional Chern insulators in rhombohedral graphene when electrons are polarized away from the moiré interface. Our results establish a new class of systems that host robust fractional Chern insulators and provide a controlled numerical platform to test competing theories of interacting topological phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 菱形石墨烯中整数和分数陈绝缘体的发现，促使人们寻找电子能带能够承载拓扑关联态的条件。本研究引入了一个“贝里盆地”模型，该模型捕捉了菱形石墨烯的关键特征，并包含了周期性势，从而能够受控地研究量子几何、超晶格调制和电子-电子相互作用在产生超越孤立拓扑能带范式的关联拓扑态中的相互作用。虽然整数陈绝缘体在没有超晶格势的强耦合下出现，但稳定分数态需要所有相互作用强度下的非零势。研究结果深入揭示了当电子偏离莫尔界面时，菱形石墨烯中整数和分数陈绝缘体具有更强的鲁棒性。
authors: Yongxin Zeng, Andrew J. Millis

articles.title: Matrix-product-state GPLHR for non-Hermitian many-body eigenproblems
articles.title_zh: 用于非厄米多体本征问题的矩阵乘积态GPLHR方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15387v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Computing multiple eigenstates of non-Hermitian many-body operators plays an important role in investigating excitation spectra, spectral properties, and relaxation dynamics in interacting and open quantum systems. However, this task is challenging because the eigenvectors are generally nonorthogonal and the Hilbert space dimension grows exponentially with system size. Here, we formulate the generalized preconditioned locally harmonic residual (GPLHR) method in a matrix product state (MPS) framework to efficiently compute multiple targeted right eigenstates whose eigenvalues lie near a specified shift in the complex plane. Successive randomized compression (SRC) is employed to accelerate operator applications. We test the method on transcorrelated and complex Hubbard chains, an interacting non-Hermitian Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chain, and a Liouvillian model. The results demonstrate that GPLHR combined with MPS provides an efficient and accurate approach for computing multiple eigenstates of non-Hermitian many-body operators.
articles.abstract_zh: 计算非厄米多体算符的多个本征态对于研究相互作用和开放量子系统中的激发谱、谱性质和弛豫动力学至关重要。本研究在矩阵乘积态（MPS）框架下提出了广义预处理局部谐波残差（GPLHR）方法，以高效计算其本征值位于复平面中指定偏移附近的多个目标右本征态。研究人员采用连续随机压缩（SRC）来加速算符应用。该方法在跨关联和复Hubbard链、相互作用非厄米Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链以及Liouvillian模型上进行了测试。结果表明，GPLHR结合MPS为计算非厄米多体算符的多个本征态提供了一种高效且准确的方法。
authors: Xingyao Wu, Zhangyu Yang, Yanbin Chen, Yu Wang, Feng Chen

articles.title: Unlocking the potential of polymer networks for high strength through topology
articles.title_zh: 通过拓扑结构释放聚合物网络实现高强度的潜力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15552v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A covalent polymer network is orders of magnitude weaker than individual covalent bonds. This large gap reveals an unrealized potential. The weakness of a network comes not from individual covalent bonds, but from how they are connected. Here we unlock this potential by identifying a topological criterion, involving optimally sparse crosslinks, long chains, and dense entanglements. Optimizing each topological variable alone is insufficient for high strength, yet exceptional strength emerges when they are combined within a narrow regime. We describe the physics of this synergy, and use the criterion to strengthen networks widely used but known to be weak. For example, we prepare a polyacrylamide hydrogel of 90 wt% water, amplifying strength from a commonly reported value of ~0.1 MPa to ~6.5 MPa. The exceptional strength is achieved without sacrificing other properties, such as softness, toughness, and elasticity. The criterion establishes topology as a general design principle for strong polymer networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 聚合物网络的强度远低于其单个共价键，这表明其潜力尚未完全发挥。本文通过识别一个涉及最优稀疏交联、长链和密集缠结的拓扑准则，成功提升了聚合物网络的强度。研究人员利用该准则显著增强了聚丙烯酰胺水凝胶的强度，同时保持了柔软性、韧性和弹性等其他性能。该准则为设计高强度聚合物网络提供了通用的拓扑原理。
authors: Zheqi Chen, Yu Zhou, Chenghai Li, Ho Cheung Shum, Zhigang Suo

articles.title: Wilson-loop formulations of the spin polarization and the spin Chern number
articles.title_zh: 自旋极化和自旋陈数的Wilson环公式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16246v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper, we derive the spin polarization and the spin Chern number in momentum and real spaces in terms of the Wilson loop in each spin sector. For these derivations, the spin matrix in the subspace of occupied or unoccupied states is generalized by the unitary rotation to prevent the spectral gap from closing. In the presence of a finite spin gap, the spin eigenvectors recompose the eigenstates of the Hamiltonian in two spin sectors.
