A dimensional reduction leads to the charge polarization in each spin sector in terms of the Wilson loop along the effective Brillouin zone (BZ) in one dimension (1D). A linear combination of the charge polarizations defines the spin polarization, which naturally quantifies the spin Chern number in momentum space. It is also shown that the spin Chern number is directly derived from the local Wilson loops on a discrete 2D BZ. The theoretical treatment is further generalized for real space in a supercell framework, which can deal with ordered and disordered systems in a unified manner. In this framework, the spin Chern number in real space is formulated in terms of the Wilson loop around the BZ boundary. These formulations are used to numerically evaluate topological phases in the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang model. Numerical results show an equivalence of the spin Chern number and the Z₂ index.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用每个自旋扇区中的Wilson环，推导了动量空间和实空间中的自旋极化和自旋陈数。通过酉旋转推广自旋矩阵，以防止能谱间隙闭合。研究表明，自旋极化可以通过各自旋扇区电荷极化的线性组合来定义，从而自然地量化动量空间中的自旋陈数。该理论处理进一步推广到实空间，可统一处理有序和无序系统。
authors: Kiminori Hattori, Ryuki Uchida

articles.title: Pressure Evolution of the Superconducting Order Parameter of Kagome Superconductor CsV3Sb5
articles.title_zh: 笼目超导体CsV3Sb5超导序参量的压力演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16253v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Kagome superconductors AV3Sb5 (A = K, Rb, Cs) offer an outstanding platform for exploring the interplay among charge-density-wave (CDW) order, superconductivity (SC), and nontrivial topological electronic states. For CsV3Sb5, moderate hydrostatic pressure induces a double-dome superconducting phase diagram while monotonically suppressing the CDW phase, which signals an unconventional coupling between SC and CDW. Nevertheless, the microscopic nature of the pressure-modulated superconducting state and its relationship with CDW order remain poorly understood. Here we employ soft directional point-contact spectroscopy (SDPCS), combined with superconducting resistive measurements, to probe the superconducting order parameter of CsV3Sb5 under hydrostatic compression. Our anisotropic PCAR measurements resolve two distinct s-wave superconducting gaps along the c-axis and a strongly anisotropic gap within the ab plane. Two-band Blonder-Tinkham-Klapwijk (BTK) fits to the c-axis spectra yield a large gap satisfying 2Delta1/kBTc > 3.52 and a small gap with 2Deltas/kBTc < 3.52. The spectral-weight-averaged coupling ratio 2Deltaavg/kBTc is enhanced in the pressure window between P1 and P2, suggesting that pressure-induced modifications of the low-energy electronic structure may contribute to the evolution of superconductivity. For ab-plane junctions, the superconducting gap anisotropy is gradually suppressed above P1, accompanied by the emergence of a pronounced peak-dip-hump structure suggestive of enhanced coupling between superconducting quasiparticles and a bosonic excitation. These results shed new light on the intricate entanglement between CDW and SC in kagome superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 笼目超导体CsV3Sb5在适度静水压下表现出双拱形超导相图，同时电荷密度波（CDW）相被抑制，这表明超导与CDW之间存在非传统耦合。本研究利用软定向点接触光谱结合超导电阻测量，探测了静水压缩下CsV3Sb5的超导序参量。各向异性测量揭示了沿c轴的两个不同s波超导能隙以及ab平面内强烈的各向异性能隙。这些结果有助于深入理解压力调控下超导态的微观性质及其与CDW序的关系。
authors: Haiyan Zuo, Wangju Yang, Zhifan Wu, Yuqing Zhao, Qiuxia Chen, Weiming Lao, Yangpeng Qi, Hechang Lei, Haizi Cong, Cong Ren

articles.title: Emergence of Nonlocal Hydrodynamics in Many-Body Radiative Heat Transport
articles.title_zh: 多体辐射热传输中非局域流体动力学的出现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16488v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a nonlocal hydrodynamic theory of radiative heat transport in many-body systems by coarse graining their microscopic electrodynamic interactions. Long-range radiative exchange naturally generates a spatially nonlocal constitutive relation in which the heat current at a given position depends on temperature gradients over an extended region, while energy conservation retains its local conservative form. Fourier transport emerges as a controlled long-wavelength limit when the interaction kernel has a finite second spatial moment. When this moment fails to converge, spatial nonlocality survives coarse graining and gives rise to non-Fourier transport. The resulting framework establishes a systematic bridge between discrete many-body fluctuational electrodynamics and a continuous description of radiative heat transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过对多体系统微观电动力学相互作用进行粗粒化，发展了一种辐射热传输的非局域流体动力学理论。长程辐射交换自然产生空间非局域的本构关系，其中给定位置的热流取决于扩展区域内的温度梯度。当相互作用核具有有限的二阶空间矩时，傅里叶传输作为受控的长波长极限出现；若该矩不收敛，则空间非局域性得以保留并导致非傅里叶传输。该框架为离散多体涨落电动力学与辐射热传输的连续描述之间建立了系统性的桥梁。
authors: Mauricio Gomez Viloria, Florian Herz, Riccardo Messina, Philippe Ben-Abdallah

articles.title: Scalable Quantum Monte Carlo for Shannon-Rényi Entropy: An Experiment-visitable Probe of Quantum Phases and Criticality
articles.title_zh: 香农-雷尼熵的可扩展量子蒙特卡洛方法：量子相和临界性的实验可访问探针
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16494v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Shannon-Rényi (SR) entropy characterizes the probability distribution of many-body wave functions in a chosen basis and is directly accessible from single-shot measurement snapshots in cold-atom experiments, yet its theoretical evaluation in interacting systems carries exponential cost. Here we construct a field-theoretic spacetime manifold for the SR entropy in which q replicas are glued at the imaginary-time boundaries, recasting it as a ratio of generalized partition functions amenable to large-scale quantum Monte Carlo simulation. On this basis we develop a reweight-annealing framework with two complementary strategies: a virtual-parameter scheme interpolating between unglued and fully glued limits via binomial-weighted partial gluing, and a real-parameter scheme using a physical coupling constant as the annealing variable within stochastic series expansion. Both reduce the computational cost from exponential to polynomial. Most importantly, we establish for the first time a finite-size scaling theory for the SR entropy near a quantum critical point, S_q=a(g)L²⁺S_q⁰łeft((g-g_c)L¹/νi̊ght); data collapse of its first derivative yields the correlation-length exponent ν for both the O(3) and Ising universality classes, realized in the spin-frac12 columnar dimerized Heisenberg model and the bilayer Heisenberg-Ising model. The same simulations extract the Goldstone-mode count N_G=2 and the Z₂ ground-state degeneracy łn 2 from subleading terms. These results elevate the SR entropy to a standalone, order-parameter-free diagnostic of quantum criticality with the same scaling status as the entanglement entropy, and close the loop between theory and quantum simulation by enabling quantitative benchmarking of experimental snapshots from state-of-the-art quantum simulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 香农-雷尼（SR）熵表征多体波函数的概率分布，在冷原子实验中可直接测量，但其在相互作用系统中的理论计算成本呈指数级增长。本文构建了一个SR熵的场论时空流形，并将其重构为广义配分函数的比率，从而适用于大规模量子蒙特卡洛模拟。研究人员开发了一种重加权退火框架，将计算成本从指数级降低到多项式级。此外，该工作首次建立了量子临界点附近SR熵的有限尺寸标度理论。
authors: Dong-Xu Liu, Zhe Wang, Zenan Liu Yi-Ming Ding, Zheng Yan

articles.title: Optically driven ultrafast lattice contraction in a topological crystalline insulator
articles.title_zh: 拓扑晶体绝缘体中光驱动的超快晶格收缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16513v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The ability to dynamically control topological order remains a central challenge in the exploration of quantum materials. Here, we investigate the lattice and electronic response of the topological crystalline insulator (TCI) Pb₁₋ₓSnₓSe to ultrafast optical excitation using time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (tr-ARPES) in combination with X-ray diffraction (XRD) and first-principles calculations. Static XRD measurements establish the lattice constant as the key control parameter for the topological transition, with a critical value a_c=6.073 Å separating the normal-insulator and topological phases. Despite generating electronic temperatures far above the topological-to-normal transition temperature T_c, optical excitation in the TCI phase does not induce a phase transition. Instead, it drives an ultrafast lattice contraction of Δ a approx -0.45 pm within less than 1 ps that counteracts thermal expansion and prevents the system from reaching a_c. The optical excitation therefore pushes the system deeper into the topological phase, providing a direct explanation for the absence of an optically driven transition. Total-energy calculations reveal that this behavior originates from the band inversion in the topological regime, which reverses the character of the photoinduced charge transfer and transiently strengthens atomic bonding. These findings identify band inversion as a mechanism that fundamentally alters the nonequilibrium lattice response, with general implications for ultrafast optical control of topological materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 动态控制拓扑序是量子材料研究中的一个核心挑战。本研究结合时间分辨角分辨光电子能谱、X射线衍射和第一性原理计算，探究了拓扑晶体绝缘体Pb₁₋ₓSnₓSe在超快光激发下的晶格和电子响应。结果显示，光激发在拓扑晶体绝缘体相中并未诱导相变，而是驱动了小于1皮秒的超快晶格收缩。这种收缩抵消了热膨胀，使系统远离拓扑相变临界点，从而解释了光驱动相变缺失的原因。
authors: M. H. Berntsen, W. Chen, D. Phuyal, J. Wu, A. Grubišić-Čabo, M. Dendzik, Q. Guo, A. Orthaber, C. Li, R. M. Geilhufe, J. Weissenrieder, O. Tjernberg

articles.title: Bogoliubov excitations of a Bose-Einstein condensate in the presence of the non-Hermitian skin effect
articles.title_zh: 非厄米趋肤效应存在下玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的Bogoliubov激发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16525v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The non-Hermitian skin effect is one of the most remarkable topological features of non-conservative physics. It causes a macroscopic accumulation of states at the boundaries of a confined system, opening new ways for controlling and directing waves in non-Hermitian settings. This effect has recently been observed in experiments with Bose-Einstein condensates of exciton polaritons and ultracold bosonic quantum gases. The underlying physics is captured by a mean-field Hamiltonian with a trapping potential and an imaginary gauge field. While prior work has examined the effect of the imaginary gauge field term on the condensate itself, its effect on the collective excitations on top of the condensate remained unexplored. Here, we develop a new theory for the Bogoliubov excitations in a non-Hermitian framework and systematically study their spectrum across different interaction regimes. By analysing the position expectation values, we find that while the repulsive interactions oppose the localisation of the condensate due to the skin effect, the excitations remain strongly affected by the imaginary gauge field. As a consequence, in the presence of harmonic confinement, we predict a strong shift in the dipole oscillation frequency, which can be observed in experiments. This is in contrast to Hermitian systems, where this frequency is fixed by the trap dimensions. Furthermore, we develop a consistent second-quantised field theory of the collective excitations in this non-Hermitian system. Strikingly, we find that a second-quantised treatment removes the shift of the dipole oscillation frequency entirely. This intriguing discrepancy between the two theoretical approaches to the treatment of elementary excitations in a non-Hermitian system can be resolved in experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 非厄米趋肤效应导致受限系统边界处态的宏观积累，为非厄米环境中的波控制提供了新途径。本文发展了一种非厄米框架下Bogoliubov激发的新理论，并系统研究了其在不同相互作用机制下的能谱。研究发现，虽然排斥相互作用会抵抗凝聚体因趋肤效应引起的局域化，但激发态仍受到虚规范场的强烈影响。这为理解非厄米系统中的集体激发提供了新的视角。
authors: Carlo Panu, Ulf Peschel, Oleg A. Egorov, Elena A. Ostrovskaya, Eliezer Estrecho

articles.title: Real-space obstruction control of the shift current in two-dimensional Quantum Spin Hall insulators
articles.title_zh: 二维量子自旋霍尔绝缘体中位移电流的实空间阻塞控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16544v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The search for materials exhibiting a large bulk photovoltaic effect has recently expanded to low-band-gap systems capable of operating in the infrared regime, with potential applications in optoelectronics. Among the microscopic mechanisms contributing to this phenomenon, the shift current is one of the dominant sources of photocurrent generation. Owing to its geometric origin, the shift current is not only determined by the optical transition probability but also by the real-space displacement associated with the optical excitation, making non-centrosymmetric materials with obstructed electronic wave functions particularly promising candidates. In this work, using a tight-binding model of a quantum spin Hall insulator on a triangular lattice, we investigate the nonlinear photocurrent across trivial, quantum spin Hall, and higher-order topological insulating phases. We show that obstructed topological phases exhibit a substantially enhanced shift-current response, despite the similar electronic band structure. We identify the origin of this enhancement in optical transitions between states belonging to distinct Wannier-center sectors, which allow for a large real-space displacement upon photoexcitation and, depending on the topological phase, control the sign of the shift current. Our results extend the search for controllable bulk photovoltaic effects to materials characterized by real-space electronic obstruction and identify indenene, a monolayer of In on SiC(0001), as a promising candidate for realizing this phenomenon.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有大体光伏效应的材料在光电子学中具有潜在应用，其中位移电流是光电流产生的主要微观机制之一。位移电流的几何起源使其不仅取决于光学跃迁概率，还与光学激发相关的实空间位移有关。本研究利用三角晶格上量子自旋霍尔绝缘体的紧束缚模型，发现阻塞拓扑相表现出显著增强的位移电流响应，尽管其电子能带结构相似。这种增强源于属于不同Wannier中心扇区态之间的光学跃迁。
authors: Michele Bagaglini, Mattia Iannetti, Jonas Erhardt, Jörg Schäfer, Ralph Claessen, Giorgio Sangiovanni, Gianni Profeta

articles.title: Nontrivial topological properties from the cooperation of static perturbations and Floquet fields in type-II semi-Dirac semimetals
articles.title_zh: II型半狄拉克半金属中静态微扰与Floquet场协同作用产生的非平凡拓扑性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16659v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we present a comprehensive theoretical study for the topological and anomalous transport properties of type-II SDSMs under three scenarios, i.e., static symmetry-breaking perturbations, periodic Floquet driving by two-frequency orthogonally polarized light (TFOPL), and their cooperative effects in the hybrid scenario. We first show that a static mass m_z opens a bulk gap and drives the system into a Chern insulator with Chern number Cm̊ per=± 2,m̊ sgn(m_z). In comparison, TFOPL alone only shifts the positions of Dirac points and cannot open a full gap. Nevertheless, it produces a Berry curvature odd in the x-direction, yielding a finite Berry curvature dipole (BCD) along x proportional to the sine of the initial phase, while the y-component vanishes. The hybrid scenario, by contrast, exhibits a remarkably rich phenomenology. Specifically, its gap-closure criterion becomes cubic and thus admits up to three real roots when the effective parameter along the x-direction is negative, thereby producing multiple light-tunable gap-closing points and a series of topological phase transitions. In particular, the BCD exhibits a double-peak structure with strong enhancement near gap-closing manifolds and synchronized sign reversal of the full vector under external tuning. We further analyze the anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC), anomalous Nernst conductivity (ANC), and anomalous thermal Hall conductivity (ATHC). The AHC and ATHC exhibit quantized plateaus that serve as signatures of Chern-insulator phases, while the ANC, being a Fermi-surface probe, provides complementary local information and can identify light-induced gaps even when global topological invariants remain unchanged. Taken together, these results offer useful insights into the topological properties of 2D type-II SDSMs and related systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文全面理论研究了II型半狄拉克半金属在静态对称破缺微扰、双频正交偏振光周期性Floquet驱动以及两者协同作用下的拓扑和反常输运性质。研究表明，静态质量项可以打开体能隙并驱动系统进入陈绝缘体态，而单独的Floquet驱动仅移动狄拉克点位置但不能打开完整能隙。混合场景则展现出丰富的现象，其能隙闭合判据变为三次方程，可产生多个光可调的能隙闭合点和一系列拓扑相变。
authors: Wen-Hao Bian, Jing Wang

articles.title: Topological Chiral Superconductivity from Doping Correlated Charge Transfer Insulator with Orbital Magnetism
articles.title_zh: 掺杂具有轨道磁性的关联电荷转移绝缘体产生的拓扑手性超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16674v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological chiral superconductivity has been extensively studied from the perspective of electronic structures in momentum space, while its emergence from real-space processes in strongly interacting systems remains largely unexplored. Here, we study a doped charge-transfer insulator in a strongly repulsive spinless-fermion model with three sublattices and 2π flux per unit cell. Combining perturbative analysis, exact diagonalization, and density matrix renormalization group simulations, we establish a topological superconducting ground state with p+ip symmetry. In the large charge-transfer gap limit, chiral charge-transfer excitations generate a correlated-hopping process that provides a microscopic mechanism for electron pairing and its chiral structure. The chiral superconductivity persists into the smaller-gap regime, where chiral excitonic two-particle bound state can emerge. Our results establish a concrete real-space route to topological chiral superconductivity upon doping strongly interacting charge-transfer insulators with orbital magnetism.
articles.abstract_zh: 拓扑手性超导性在动量空间电子结构方面已得到广泛研究，但在强相互作用系统中其从实空间过程的出现仍未充分探索。本文研究了掺杂的电荷转移绝缘体，并结合微扰分析、精确对角化和密度矩阵重整化群模拟，确立了具有p+ip对称性的拓扑超导基态。在大电荷转移能隙极限下，手性电荷转移激发产生关联跳跃过程，为电子配对及其手性结构提供了微观机制。我们的结果为通过掺杂具有轨道磁性的强相互作用电荷转移绝缘体实现拓扑手性超导性提供了具体的实空间途径。
authors: Wen Sun, Yuan Yang, Shou-Shu Gong, Wen Huang

articles.title: Quantum Ising transition on the Cayley tree: boundary criticality, universality, and an effective Bethe line
articles.title_zh: Cayley树上的量子伊辛相变：边界临界性、普适性与有效Bethe线
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16774v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate quantum criticality in the transverse-field Ising model on finite Cayley trees and demonstrate that their extensive boundary fundamentally changes the nature of the quantum phase transition compared with the infinite, boundary-free Bethe lattice. Using tree tensor-network simulations for systems with up to N=12286 sites, we identify a boundary-driven continuous transition at hₓ^capprox1.76, distinct from the mean-field Bethe-lattice transition at hₓ^capprox2.23. We characterize this transition through finite-size scaling of the magnetization and magnetic susceptibility and extract a consistent set of critical exponents. By introducing next-nearest-neighbor interactions, we demonstrate the robustness of the extracted critical exponents, providing numerical argument for the Ising boundary universality class on the Cayley tree. Furthermore, we show that the physics of the boundary-free Bethe lattice can be efficiently recovered on a finite Cayley tree by fine-tuning a local boundary field. The resulting effective Bethe line, whose existence is tied to the mean-field nature of the bulk transition, effectively screens the extensive boundary and restores both the critical point and the mean-field critical scaling of the infinite Bethe lattice.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了有限Cayley树上横场伊辛模型的量子临界性，并发现其广泛的边界从根本上改变了量子相变的性质。通过树张量网络模拟，研究人员识别出由边界驱动的连续相变，其临界点与平均场Bethe晶格相变不同。通过磁化强度和磁化率的有限尺寸标度，提取了一致的临界指数集，并证明了其鲁棒性。此外，研究还表明，通过微调局部边界场，可以在有限Cayley树上有效地恢复无边界Bethe晶格的物理特性。
authors: Pietro Richelli, Natalia Chepiga

articles.title: Microscopic Modeling of Interlayer Tunneling in Twisted Bilayer Cuprates
articles.title_zh: 扭曲双层铜氧化物中层间隧穿的微观建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.16930v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The field of twistronics, recently extended to twisted bilayer cuprate systems, has generated considerable interest due to the prediction of d+id' states close to a 45ⁱ̧rc twist, as suggested by multiple experimental probes. Theoretical studies of these systems using a variety of models and many-body theoretical techniques have revealed multiple competing order parameters. The large variability in experimental results and theoretical predictions demands an accurate microscopic model for these systems, in particular a more realistic description of the interlayer tunneling. In this study, we fit the in-plane hopping and compute the interlayer tunneling amplitudes by calculating the orbital overlap between dₓ^₂₋y^₂ wave functions at each site of the twisted square-lattice model. We observe sign-changing tunneling amplitudes, a strong twist-angle dependence of the direct tunneling term, and long-range tunneling amplitudes that often dominate over direct tunneling. We investigate the band structure, Fermi surfaces, and spectral functions in comparison with those obtained from the phenomenological model and find a substantial redistribution of spectral weight that modifies the competition between different superconducting ground states. We determine the phase diagram as a function of twist angle, filling, and direct tunneling strength, which is controlled by the c-axis distance between the monolayers, and observe a reduction in the region of time-reversal-symmetry-breaking (TRSB) d+id' states compared with the phenomenological model. Finally, we investigate the Josephson critical current across the phase diagram and find strongly suppressed critical currents close to a 45ⁱ̧rc twist, consistent with experimental observations.
articles.abstract_zh: 扭曲双层铜氧化物系统因其预测的d+id'态而备受关注，但实验和理论结果存在较大差异。本研究通过计算扭曲方格模型中dₓ^₂₋y^₂波函数之间的轨道重叠，拟合了面内跳跃并计算了层间隧穿振幅。研究发现隧穿振幅符号变化、直接隧穿项对扭曲角有强依赖性，且长程隧穿振幅常占主导。该工作还比较了其能带结构、费米面和谱函数与唯象模型的结果，并发现显著的重新分布。
authors: Siddhant Panda, Andreas Kreisel, Laura Fanfarillo, P. J. Hirschfeld

articles.title: Spatial Engineering of Topological Quantum Matter with Structured Light
articles.title_zh: 利用结构光对拓扑量子物质进行空间工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17181v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Structured light provides a powerful means of controlling matter while itself exhibiting nontrivial spatial topology. Here, we show that these spatial structures can be harnessed to locally engineer the topological properties of matter. In a paradigmatic example of a topological insulator with Dirac surface states driven by an optical skyrmion beam, we show that structured light spatially tailors the effective Hamiltonian, yielding position-dependent topological gaps and Dirac velocities. The resulting gap modulation can create topological and trivial regions separated by optically defined interfaces, without introducing material boundaries or chemical modifications. We further show that the geometry of these interfaces can be controlled through the spatial structure of the light, in particular its orbital angular momentum. Our results establish structured light as a route to dynamically pattern topological phases and open a broader perspective on the interplay between topology in light and matter, including the possibility of transferring topological characteristics between the two.
articles.abstract_zh: 结构光为控制物质提供了强大手段，同时自身也展现出非平凡的空间拓扑。本研究展示了如何利用这些空间结构来局部调控物质的拓扑性质。以光学斯格明子束驱动的拓扑绝缘体为例，研究表明结构光可以空间调制有效哈密顿量，产生位置依赖的拓扑带隙和狄拉克速度。这种带隙调制能够在不引入材料边界或化学修饰的情况下，通过光定义界面创建拓扑和非拓扑区域。研究还发现界面的几何形状可以通过光的空间结构，特别是其轨道角动量来控制。
authors: Matias Mustonen, Ali G. Moghaddam, Teemu Ojanen, Marco Ornigotti

articles.title: Revealing topological protection through unprotected operations in a Majorana parity qubit
articles.title_zh: 通过马约拉纳宇称量子比特中的非保护操作揭示拓扑保护
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17198v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A recent experiment reported coherent parity oscillations between minimal Kitaev chains, demonstrating a Majorana parity qubit (arXiv:2607.09511). Operations on this qubit are controlled by coupling two Kitaev chains and are intrinsically unprotected against noise in the coupling strength. Here we show how the exponential protection in the underlying chains can nevertheless be revealed through unprotected qubit operations. To this end, we develop an analytical theory of quasistatic dephasing for two coupled N-site Kitaev chains at the sweet spot. In Rabi experiments, protection can be resolved by adapting the operating point with chain length: depending on the coupling architecture, it appears as an exponentially increasing optimized number of coherent oscillations or as a longer coherence time. Ramsey experiments show an exponentially increasing coherence time, provided the chains can be sufficiently decoupled. Our analytical theory takes into account the non-Gaussian splitting statistics of the Kitaev chains, allowing us to quantitatively predict the scaling with chain length. Moreover, we determine how residual noise and imperfections limit the range of chain lengths over which this scaling can be observed. Our results show how qubit dynamics can be used to probe Majorana protection in experimentally realistic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近的实验展示了马约拉纳宇称量子比特的相干宇称振荡，但其操作本质上不受耦合强度噪声的保护。本研究展示了如何通过非保护的量子比特操作来揭示底层链中的指数级保护。为此，作者发展了一种针对两个耦合的N位Kitaev链在最佳点处的准静态退相干分析理论。在拉比实验中，保护可以通过调整操作点与链长来解析，表现为相干振荡次数的指数增加或更长的相干时间。拉姆齐实验也显示出指数增加的相干时间，前提是链可以充分解耦。
authors: Sebastian Miles, Juan Daniel Torres Luna, Francesco Zatelli, Nick van Loo, Antonio Lombardi, Vincent P. M. Sietses, Florian J. Bennebroek Evertsz', Bart Roovers, Leo P. Kouwenhoven, Michael Wimmer

articles.title: Berry curvature from plane-wave mixing: A three-band model with emergent symmetries
articles.title_zh: 来自平面波混合的贝里曲率：一个具有涌现对称性的三能带模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17209v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional materials can host topological phases stabilized either by an intrinsic moiré potential or topological crystallization. Crucial to the topology of these phases is the interplay between the (self-consistently generated) potential and the spinor structure, which imbues the band-projected potential with momentum-dependence. Truncating this potential at linear-order in momentum, we obtain a three-band model that captures the low-energy band structure and Berry curvature of such topological bands. We analytically find that the Berry curvature strongly depends on momentum-dependence of the potential. Furthermore, we identify that the model can be tuned to have emergent symmetries, including U(1) and anti-unitary symmetries. Emergent-symmetry breaking perturbations drive the system to regimes hosting topological flat bands, quadratic band touchings, and multiple Dirac cones. We recover many of these features when studying an un-truncated model of a łambda-jellium spinor inside of a periodic potential. Our results reveal a rich interplay of spinor structure and a potential in determining the topology of the ground state.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维材料中的拓扑相由莫尔势或拓扑晶化稳定，其拓扑性质关键在于势与旋量结构之间的相互作用。本研究将势在动量上截断至线性阶，得到一个三能带模型，该模型能捕捉拓扑能带的低能带结构和贝里曲率。分析结果表明贝里曲率强烈依赖于势的动量依赖性。该模型可调谐以产生涌现对称性，包括U(1)和反幺正对称性。涌现对称性破缺扰动可使系统进入具有拓扑平带、二次能带接触和多个狄拉克锥的区域。
authors: Avi Vadali, Tomohiro Soejima

articles.title: Observation of stacked vortex structure with number controllable Majorana zero mode in Bi₂Te₃/FeTe heterojunction
articles.title_zh: 在Bi₂Te₃/FeTe异质结中观察到具有可控数量马约拉纳零模的堆叠涡旋结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17701v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Creation and control of Majorana zero modes (MZMs) in solid devices is the key challenge in realizing fault tolerant topological quantum computation. Here we report spectroscopic evidence for number controllable MZMs in stoichiometric one quintuple layer Bi₂Te₃/FeTe heterostructures, together with the observation of stacked vortices in superconducting islands. Low temperature scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy reveal a long period moire superlattice arising from lattice mismatch, which induces nanoscale modulation of superconducting gaps. Magnetic vortices exhibit a stacked core structure with two layer derived bound state branches: a dispersive branch evolving into an X-shaped pattern away from the vortex center, and a quantum-limit branch characterized by a spatially unsplit MZMs together with discrete integer quantized Caroli-de Gennes-Matricon states. Notably, MZMs are observed in all measured vortices, and their number can be tuned by magnetic field and the size of Bi₂Te₃ islands. These results establish stoichiometric 1QL-Bi₂Te₃/FeTe as a patterned superconducting interface that enables isolated and few-vortex Majorana configurations, providing a controlled platform for fuse MZMs.
articles.abstract_zh: 在固体器件中创建和控制马约拉纳零模（MZMs）是实现容错拓扑量子计算的关键挑战。本研究在化学计量比为单五层Bi₂Te₃/FeTe异质结构中，报告了可控数量MZMs的光谱证据，并观察到超导岛中的堆叠涡旋。低温扫描隧道显微镜和光谱揭示了由晶格失配引起的莫尔超晶格，导致超导能隙的纳米级调制。磁涡旋表现出堆叠的核心结构，包含两个层衍生的束缚态分支。值得注意的是，所有测量的涡旋中都观察到MZMs，其数量可以通过磁场和Bi₂Te₃岛的尺寸进行调谐。
authors: Xinru Han, Zhaokun Luo, Quanxin Hu, Xingjian Zhu, Xiaohong Pan, Dan Mu, Xinyu Liang, Zulin Xu, Qiheng Wang, Ryan L. Kong, Mingyuan Li, Zhengliang Zhang, Fazhi Yang, Mojun Pan, Xin Liu, Qiangqiang Gu, Baiqing Lv, Gan Wang, Hong Ding

articles.title: Skin phase transition of a skyrmion in a ferromagnetic superfluid
articles.title_zh: 铁磁超流体中斯格明子的表皮相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.17796v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Compared with a scalar Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC), a spinor BEC supports richer phenomena because of its internal spin degrees of freedom, including topological solitons such as domain walls or skyrmions. Here, we theoretically reveal three distinct axisymmetric soliton structures formed as a circular domain wall in a spin-1 BEC, connected within fixed winding numbers. We refer to these structures as the broken-axisymmetry (BA)-skin, antiferromagnetic (AF)-skin and normal-core phases. Their occurrence is controlled by the two dimensionless parameters in the absence of linear Zeeman coefficient p=0: q/μ, the ratio of the quadratic Zeeman coefficient to the chemical potential, and cₛ/cₙ, the ratio of spin interaction to the density interaction. The BA-skin and AF-skin phases exhibit local easy-plane magnetic order and local easy-plane spin-nematic order, respectively, while the normal-core phase is similar to a doubly quantized vortex analogous to that of a scalar BEC with a density depletion at the center. We obtain semi-analytical estimates of selected transition boundaries separating these phases by analyzing the Bogoliubov-de Gennes equation and also numerically confirm them by solving the Gross-Pitaevskii equation. We estimate the skyrmion radius using a hydrostatic approximation and compare the result with numerical solutions. We envision our results on skyrmions in a spin-1 BEC can trigger further investigation on novel soliton structures in a magnetic superfluid.
articles.abstract_zh: 相比标量玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC），旋量BEC因其内部自旋自由度而支持更丰富的现象，包括拓扑孤子。本研究理论揭示了自旋-1 BEC中作为圆形畴壁形成的三种不同的轴对称孤子结构，它们在固定缠绕数内相互连接。这些结构被称为破轴对称（BA）-表皮相、反铁磁（AF）-表皮相和正常核心相。它们的出现受两个无量纲参数控制。BA-表皮相和AF-表皮相分别表现出局部易平面磁序和局部易平面自旋向列序，而正常核心相类似于标量BEC中具有中心密度耗尽的双量子化涡旋。
authors: Wooyoung Yun, Se Kwon Kim, Hiromitsu Takeuchi

articles.title: Numerical methods and analytic results for one-dimensional strongly interacting spinor gases
articles.title_zh: 一维强相互作用旋量气体的数值方法和解析结果
articles.abstract: arXiv:2408.06060v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: One of quantum physics' fundamental, but largely unsolved, problems is the computation of the correlation functions in many-body systems. In this paper we address this problem in the case of one-dimensional spinor gases with repulsive contact interactions in the presence of a confining potential. We take advantage of the fact that in the strong coupling limit, the wavefunction factorizes with the charge degrees of freedom expressed as a Slater determinant of spinless fermions and the spin sector described by a spin chain of Sutherland type with exchange coefficients that depend only on the trapping potential. This factorization is also present in the expressions for the correlation functions. Still, analytical and numerical investigations were hindered by the fact that the local exchange coefficients and the charge component of the correlators are expressed as N-1 multidimensional integrals, with N the number of particles, which are notoriously hard to compute using conventional methods. We introduce a new approach to calculating these integrals that is extremely simple, scales polynomially with the number of particles, and is several orders of magnitude faster than the previous methods reported in the literature. This allows us to investigate the static and dynamic properties, temperature dependence, and nonequilibrium dynamics for systems with a larger number of particles than previously considered and discover new phenomena. We show that, contrary to natural expectations, the momentum distribution of strongly interacting trapped spinor gases becomes narrower as we increase the temperature and derive simple determinant representations for the correlators in the spin incoherent regime valid for both equilibrium and nonequilibrium situations.
articles.abstract_zh: 计算多体系统中的关联函数是量子物理中一个基本但尚未解决的问题。本论文研究了一维强相互作用旋量气体在限制势场中的关联函数问题。作者利用强耦合极限下波函数因子化的特性，即电荷自由度表示为无自旋费米子的斯莱特行列式，自旋部分由Sutherland型自旋链描述。针对传统方法难以计算的N-1维积分，本研究提出了一种新的计算方法，该方法极其简单，计算复杂度随粒子数呈多项式增长，并具有多项优点。
authors: Ovidiu I. Patu

articles.title: Macroscopic quantum interference of the center-of-mass motion of levitated superconducting microparticles enabled by magnetic higher-order traps
articles.title_zh: 磁性高阶陷阱实现悬浮超导微粒质心运动的宏观量子干涉
articles.abstract: We show how magnetostatic higher-order multipole traps can be used to generate macroscopic quantum interference of the motion of levitated superconducting microparticles. An appropriate combination of multipolar magnetic fields offers great versatility in constructing various trap potentials, including anharmonic trap potentials such as Duffing or double-well types. Crucially, the anharmonic trap potentials realize a nonlinearity on the order of hundred times the zero-point motion, i.e. on a length scale below nanometers. These anharmonic potentials allow for the generation of quantum features of the center-of-mass motion of a magnetically levitated superconducting microparticle. Importantly, they can be easily generated with a static arrangement of coils, requiring only that the current running through them is tunable. We propose protocols exploiting the versatility of the magnetic trap landscape to generate non-Gaussian motional states. We solve the dynamics of the center-of-mass motion of the particle in phase space and analyze its parameter dependence. Furthermore, we give a recipe to distinguish classical from quantum behavior in a statistically meaningful way through measurement of the position of the particle. Our results open a path to accessing the quantum regime of the center-of-mass motion of objects with masses larger than picogram, i.e. atomic mass units. This will enable fundamental physics experiments for studying the transition between quantum and classical behavior, exploring the intersection between quantum physics and gravity as well as probing of certain types of dark matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了如何利用静磁高阶多极陷阱来产生悬浮超导微粒质心运动的宏观量子干涉。通过多极磁场的适当组合，可以构建多种陷阱势，包括Duffing或双阱型非谐陷阱势。这些非谐势能实现远超零点运动的非线性，从而产生磁悬浮超导微粒质心运动的量子特征。研究提出了利用磁陷阱景观的多功能性来生成非高斯运动态的方案，并分析了其动力学和参数依赖性，还提供了一种在统计学上区分经典和量子行为的方法。
authors: Jaume Cunill-Subiranas, Fabian Resare, S Zhao, Sofia Qvarfort, A Metelmann, Carles Navau and Witlef Wieczorek

articles.title: Optomagnonic generation of entangled traveling fields with different polarizations
articles.title_zh: 光磁振子产生不同偏振的纠缠行进场
articles.abstract: The optomagnonic coupling between magnons and optical photons is an essential component for building remote quantum networks based on magnonics. Here we show that such a coupling, manifested as the magnon-induced Brillouin light scattering, can be exploited to entangle two propagating optical fields. The protocol employs two pairs of the whispering gallery modes coupled to the same magnon mode in a yttrium-iron-garnet microsphere or microdisk. In each pair a strong pump field is applied to activate either Stokes or anti-Stokes scattering. Due to the magnon mode involving in the two scattering processes and as a mediation, Stokes and anti-Stokes photons of different polarizations get entangled. The entanglement can be extracted by filtering the traveling output fields centered at the Stokes and anti-Stokes sidebands. Optimal conditions are identified under which strong output entanglement can be achieved.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁振子与光子之间的光磁振子耦合是构建基于磁振子的远程量子网络的关键组成部分。本研究展示了如何利用这种耦合，即磁振子诱导的布里渊光散射，来纠缠两个传播的光场。该方案采用两对与同一磁振子模式耦合的耳语画廊模式，在每个模式对中施加强泵浦场以激活斯托克斯或反斯托克斯散射。由于磁振子模式作为介导参与两个散射过程，不同偏振的斯托克斯和反斯托克斯光子得以纠缠。研究还确定了实现强输出纠缠的最佳条件。
authors: Zi-Xu Lu, Huai-Bing Zhu, Xuan Zuo and Jie Li

articles.title: Encoding numerical data for generative quantum machine learning
articles.title_zh: 用于生成式量子机器学习的数值数据编码
articles.abstract: Generative quantum machine learning (ML) models are trained to deduce the probability distribution underlying a given dataset, and to produce new, synthetic samples from it. The majority of such models proposed in the literature, like the quantum circuit born machine (QCBM), fundamentally work on a binary level. Real-world data, however, is often numeric, requiring the models to translate between binary and continuous representations. We analyze how this transition influences the performance of quantum models and show that it requires the models to learn correlations that are solely an artifact of the way the data is encoded, and not related to the data itself. At the same time, structure of the original data, like continuity, can be obscured in the binary representation, hindering generalization. To mitigate these effects, we propose a strategy based on Gray-codes that can be implemented with essentially no overhead, conserves structures in the data, and avoids artificial correlations in situations in which the standard approach creates them. Considering datasets drawn from various low-dimensional probability distributions, we verify that, in most cases, QCBMs using the reflected Gray code learn faster and more accurately than those with standard binary code. This shows that, as complement to specifically tailored circuit ansätze or data pre-processing, binary encodings can be used to introduce inductive biases into generative ML models.
articles.abstract_zh: 生成式量子机器学习模型旨在学习数据集的概率分布并生成新样本，但大多数模型在二进制层面工作，而实际数据常为数值型。本研究分析了二进制与连续表示之间的转换如何影响量子模型的性能，并指出这种转换可能导致模型学习到与数据本身无关的编码伪影。为缓解这些影响，作者提出了一种基于格雷码的编码策略，该策略几乎没有额外开销，能保留数据结构并避免人工关联。通过对各种低维概率分布数据集的验证，结果表明使用反射格雷码的量子电路玻恩机在大多数情况下表现更优。
authors: Michael Krebsbach, Florentin Reiter, Thomas Wellens, Hagen-Henrik Kowalski and Ali Abedi

articles.title: Detector-Frame Quantum Limits for Heterodyne Timing in Relativistic Optical Links
articles.title_zh: 相对论光学链路中外差定时探测器帧量子极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13963v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-baseline optical links for space interferometry and satellite quantum networks rely on heterodyne phase tracking under Doppler motion and gravitational frequency shifts. These relativistic shifts can generate large detector-frame beat-frequency offsets over finite readout windows and thereby constrain the temporal precision of front-end phase readout. We develop a detector-frame framework for this problem using an effective two-mode signal--local-oscillator model in which relativistic motion rescales the local-oscillator frequency. Within this setting we derive closed-form Mandelstam--Tamm and Margolus--Levitin bounds for representative Gaussian resources and connect global state distinguishability with the operational precision of heterodyne phase tracking. In the bright-local-oscillator regime we identify a geometric--operational mismatch: the joint optical state can evolve on arbitrarily short global timescales while the relevant information rate is set by the measured detector record. Combining this result with an open-loop transient-acquisition analysis, we show that white phase noise and relativistic beat-frequency drift that is approximately constant over the acquisition window generate a cube-root scaling benchmark for the optimal pre-lock open-loop integration window and the minimum residual phase error. These results establish detector-frame benchmarks for quantum-limited heterodyne timing in relativistic optical links and clarify how global dynamical bounds enter task-restricted continuous optical measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 空间干涉测量和卫星量子网络的远距离光学链路依赖于多普勒运动和引力频移下的外差相位跟踪。这些相对论性频移会在有限读出窗口内产生大的探测器帧拍频偏移，从而限制前端相位读出的时间精度。本研究为此问题开发了一个探测器帧框架，使用一个有效的双模信号-本振模型，其中相对论运动重新调整了本振频率。在此框架下，作者推导了代表性高斯资源的Mandelstam-Tamm和Margolus-Levitin界限，并将全局状态可区分性与外差相位跟踪的操作精度联系起来。
authors: Salman Sajad Wani, Aatif Kaisar Khan, Saif Al-Kuwari, Mir Faizal

articles.title: Parameter-Efficient Multilinear Readout for Quantum Reservoir Computing
articles.title_zh: 量子储备池计算中参数高效的多线性读出
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13974v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum Reservoir Computing (QRC) uses fixed quantum dynamics as a high-dimensional feature map. Still, standard pipelines flatten reservoir measurements and train a linear readout, ignoring the natural tensor structure across time steps, qubits, and observables. We propose a multilinear readout for quantum reservoir computing (ML-QRC), a tensor-structured neural readout compressed through mode-wise projections. Relative to a dense hidden-width-64 neural readout, this reduces the feature-to-hidden parameter count from 64TnF to d(T+n+F)+64d³, giving a 12.1× feature-block compression at T=50, n=6, d=8, and F=n+binomn2. Across Mackey-Glass forecasting and TFIM phase classification, ML-QRC remains statistically competitive with Ridge on Mackey-Glass and obtains the numerically highest full-data TFIM accuracy among tested methods, while using 12.0× fewer parameters than the full dense MLP. Its clearest benefit is improved low-data stability relative to neural MLP readouts on Mackey-Glass; this advantage does not transfer to TFIM, where Ridge performs best at 50% data. Overall, ML-QRC is best viewed as a tensor-structured neural readout that compresses dense MLP readouts while preserving QRC tensor structure, rather than as a replacement for simple linear/Ridge readouts in the tested regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子储备池计算（QRC）利用固定的量子动力学作为高维特征映射，但传统方法忽略了跨时间步、量子比特和可观测量的自然张量结构。本研究提出了一种用于QRC的多线性读出（ML-QRC），这是一种通过模式投影压缩的张量结构神经网络读出。与密集神经网络读出相比，ML-QRC显著减少了参数数量，实现了特征块的压缩。在Mackey-Glass预测和TFIM相分类任务中，ML-QRC在统计上与Ridge方法具有竞争力，并在全数据TFIM准确性上达到最高，同时使用更少的参数。其主要优势在于提高了低数据条件下的稳定性。
authors: Van Tien Nguyen, Panagiotis Markopoulos

articles.title: Prelocality No-Go Theorems and Exactly Solvable Relational History Hamiltonians
articles.title_zh: 预局域性禁行定理与精确可解的关系历史哈密顿量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14081v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exact permutation covariance does not itself supply a sparse metric geometry. For permutation-covariant, full-support k-body interaction orbits, the incident interaction norm scales as binomN-1k-1|J_N||h|; such orbits cannot have uniformly finite range in metrics of diverging diameter. A permutation-invariant Hamiltonian diagonal in the graph basis has ground-state multiplicity at least N!/|Aut(G)| whenever G is a ground graph. We give a quantitative version for approximately symmetric energies, together with fixed-radius connectivity and unitary-isometry obstructions. The trace-distance asymmetry of an arbitrary state also bounds its probability of selecting one labeled graph. We then construct two exactly solvable finite relational history Hamiltonians. A cyclic clock with a reversible incidence update has a unique ground state; gauge reduction yields a cycle Laplacian with a rank-one pin and the exact gap ΔN,L=E_* (1-o̧sθ_L), where tan(Lθ_L/2)=1/sinθ_L and 0<θ_L<π/L. In particular, ΔN,L/E_*=π²/(2L²⁾⁻²π²/L³⁺O(L⁻⁴), independently of the number of vertices. In an alternative order-free architecture, one clock qubit per unordered pair gives commuting four-local terms, 2^N ground states and a size-independent gap E_*(1-1/sqrt2). A fixed-weight control penalty selects binom Nq ground states without reducing the gap. These exact finite results expose clock and locality resource tradeoffs; they do not establish an emergent geometric phase.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了精确置换协方差与稀疏度量几何之间的关系，指出在某些条件下，置换协变相互作用的范围不能是有限的。研究给出了近似对称能量的定量版本，并构建了两个精确可解的有限关系历史哈密顿量。其中一个循环时钟具有唯一的基态，其能隙与顶点数量无关，另一个是无序架构。
authors: Maxim V. Churilov

articles.title: How long is a photon?
articles.title_zh: 光子有多长？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14088v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A photon has the strange property that it travels along a null interval with zero proper time, hence its emission and absorption points are, in a sense, a singular event. For their part, the emission and absorption processes have a finite duration which determines the spectral content of the photon. The question in the title points to the conceptual difficulty in `stitching' together these three intervals, which all correspond to the same physical entity but have fundamentally incompatible temporal descriptions. A previously developed model for quantum wavefunction propagation solves this apparent dilemma by formulating the life cycle of a photon in terms of recursive Fourier transforms on dual spaces. Because it doesn't treat space as dependent on time, and it is built on the Fourier transform whose phase is an invariant in special relativity as well as the foundation of the uncertainty principle, the model is a promising candidate framework for making quantum mechanics compatible with relativity. The model proposes to serve as an improved Klein-Gordon equation, or relativistically compatible replacement for Schrödinger's equation.
articles.abstract_zh: 光子在零本征时间间隔内传播，其发射和吸收过程却有有限持续时间，这导致了对光子寿命在时间描述上的概念性难题。本文介绍了一个基于对偶空间上递归傅里叶变换的量子波函数传播模型，该模型通过不将空间视为时间依赖来解决这一困境。该模型有望成为改进的克莱因-戈登方程或薛定谔方程的相对论兼容替代方案，以统一量子力学与相对论。
authors: Sky Nelson-Isaacs

articles.title: Compass in the Mirror: Quantum Backpropagation with the Hopf Ansatz
articles.title_zh: 镜中罗盘：基于霍普斯猜想的量子反向传播
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14177v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A variational quantum state may have many control angles, and its complete gradient contains one derivative for each. The task is to turn access to selected derivatives into a shared finite-shot record for the complete vector. The Hopf ansatz supplies the setting: it constructs any normalized pure state from nested two-way magnitude splits and, for complex states, leaf phases, with one directly programmed angle per split or phase. Earlier Hopf constructions prepare the state, recover coordinates from known amplitudes, and provide indexed derivative access. With a phase-calibrated controlled reflection, the inverse Hopf frame maps each normalized magnitude direction to a computational label, so every all-X outcome contributes to every magnitude derivative. A separate signed leaf record supplies the complex phase block. A checkpoint variant reverses only the suffix below a selected depth and returns that layer's gradient block. For a complete chart with M real-valued parameters, sufficient execution counts are O(łogłog M) for the global method and O(łog Młogłog M) for the complete checkpoint schedule at fixed additive coordinate accuracy and confidence. The global saving is record reuse, not a reduction of the M-entry output. Under the designated direct-angle schedules, the global method's assigned Hopf CNOT work and input/output-inclusive storage have at most logarithmic overhead relative to a matched scalar evaluation. The same Hopf geometry thus carries a state forward and the objective's complete coordinate response backward.
articles.abstract_zh: 变分量子态的完整梯度包含多个导数，本文旨在将选定导数的访问转化为完整向量的共享有限次记录。研究利用霍普斯猜想构建任意归一化纯态，并通过相位校准的受控反射，将每个归一化幅度方向映射到计算标签。该方法为具有M个实值参数的完整图表提供了高效的执行计数。
authors: Ruge Lin, Ranyiliu Chen

articles.title: Below-threshold execution of fault-tolerant ripple-carry addition on a trapped-ion quantum computer
articles.title_zh: 在离子阱量子计算机上实现低于阈值的容错纹波进位加法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14202v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We deploy a universal fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) architecture based on error-detecting [![8,3,2]!] and [![4,2,2]!] codes on Quantinuum's Helios-1 trapped-ion quantum computer. We compile and execute ripple-carry adder (RCA) circuits for classical inputs up to five bits on this architecture. Uncomputing a workspace qubit provides an additional ``algorithmic check'' to detect errors. While available at both the physical and logical levels, this check synergizes with our architecture by increasing the effective fault distance of many circuit locations from two to four. Combining this algorithmic check with the error-detecting codes, we observed only a single logical failure in one-bit addition after burst-error filtering, yielding an estimated logical failure rate of (6.0 ± 5.9) × 10⁻⁵. This is well below the (3.5 ± 1.3) × 10⁻³ failure probability observed for one-bit addition on the same hardware in unencoded form. Two- and three-bit adders also showed performance improvements, while the longer four- and five-bit adders executed just above threshold.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在Quantinuum的Helios-1离子阱量子计算机上部署了基于纠错码的通用容错量子计算架构。研究编译并执行了多达五比特的纹波进位加法器电路，并通过取消计算工作空间量子比特引入了额外的“算法检查”以增强错误检测能力。结合纠错码和算法检查，一比特加法实现了远低于未编码形式的逻辑错误率，二、三比特加法也显示出性能提升。
authors: Jacob S. Nelson, Andrew J. Landahl, Andrew D. Baczewski

articles.title: Quantum Signal Processing Phase Factorization via Logarithmic Derivatives
articles.title_zh: 基于对数导数的量子信号处理相位因子分解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14259v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum signal processing (QSP) requires the efficient computation of phase factors associated with a polynomial transformation. One existing stable factorization method avoids direct root finding but relies on Prony's method to recover a polynomial from weighted power sums of its roots (arXiv:2202.02671). We present a modification of this approach that eliminates Prony's method by using the logarithmic derivative of an associated polynomial. Because the logarithmic derivative has the same residue at every root after accounting for multiplicity, its Fourier coefficients directly yield the unweighted power sums of the roots inside the unit disk. The Newton--Girard identities then recover the coefficients of the corresponding polynomial without computing its roots. The resulting algorithm has O(dłog² d) computational complexity and simplifies the factorization procedure of the original method. In numerical experiments on Hamiltonian simulation, eigenstate filtering, matrix inversion, and the Fermi--Dirac operator, our implementation computes phase factors in seconds with maximum errors on the order of 10⁻¹².
articles.abstract_zh: 量子信号处理（QSP）需要高效计算与多项式变换相关的相位因子。本文提出了一种改进的相位因子分解方法，通过使用相关多项式的对数导数，避免了Prony方法和直接求根。该算法利用对数导数的傅里叶系数和牛顿-吉拉德恒等式来恢复多项式系数，计算复杂度为O(d log² d)。数值实验表明，该实现能在数秒内计算出相位因子，最大误差约为10⁻¹²。
authors: Christopher Peng

articles.title: The GHZ Game in Black and White
articles.title_zh: 黑白GHZ博弈
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14411v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that it is possible for three people to win the GHZ game with just the standard real valued misty state formalism, but each party will need to have two balls instead of one. That is, there will be six balls involved, rather than three. In fact, as a general rule, instead of using complex numbers in a quantum computer you can always add a qubit to "tag" complex numbers. But for proofs of non-locality, like the GHZ game, we cannot have a single universal tagging qubit, because all three parties would need access to it and therefore they could potentially transfer information via it. That's where we need to replace the one ball with three that each only need to be accessed locally.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了在标准实值“迷雾态”形式主义下，三人可以通过GHZ博弈获胜，但每方需要两个球，总共六个球。研究指出，在量子计算机中，通常可以通过添加一个量子比特来“标记”复数。然而，对于GHZ博弈等非局域性证明，不能使用单一的通用标记量子比特，因此需要将一个球替换为三个仅需局部访问的球。
authors: Terry Rudolph, Tony Newton, Dan-Adrian German

articles.title: Harmonic Reduction of Spin-Coupled Grover Walks on Hypercubes via Quantum Bernoulli Noises
articles.title_zh: 基于量子伯努利噪声的超立方体自旋耦合格罗弗游走的谐波约化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14467v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider spin-coupled Grover walks on hypercubes within the framework of quantum Bernoulli noises (QBN). We identify parity-dependent harmonic subspaces generated by the central Hamming layers: in even dimension they give a fixed-point subspace, whereas in odd dimension the walk reduces on the harmonic subspace to an explicit eight-dimensional reduced dynamics. Using symmetric-group representation theory, we characterize the corresponding isotypic structure and determine the reduced spectrum. The harmonic reduction also yields explicit long-time probability behavior and shows that the resulting states may occupy an asymptotically vanishing fraction of the hypercube while still spanning its full Hamming diameter.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在量子伯努利噪声框架下研究了超立方体上的自旋耦合格罗弗游走。研究识别了由中心汉明层生成的奇偶性依赖的谐波子空间，并在奇数维度下将游走约化为八维的显式动力学。通过对称群表示理论，本文刻画了相应的同型结构并确定了约化谱，揭示了长时间概率行为，表明所得状态可能占据超立方体渐近消失的部分，同时仍跨越其完整的汉明直径。
authors: Ce Wang

articles.title: Fast continuous ion transport through X-junctions with low motional excitation for QCCD architectures
articles.title_zh: 用于QCCD架构的低运动激发X结快速连续离子传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14472v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Trapped ion quantum computing based on the quantum charge coupled device (QCCD) architecture uses functional zoning and ion transport to enable high fidelity computation and all to all qubit connectivity. As trapped ion quantum processing units (QPU) scale, 90deg X-junction turns account for an increasing fraction of total transport time. Frequent junction crossings, therefore, make transport speed and final phonon excitation direct determinants of quantum algorithm execution efficiency. However, complex electric fields in X-junctions complicate waveform design, making it difficult to achieve high speed and low final phonon excitation simultaneously. Here, we develop a waveform design method for low-phonon-excitation high-speed X-junction(LHX-T) transport. It integrates low barrier pseudopotential channel design using multiple radio frequency (Multi-RF), multidimensional shortcut to adiabaticity dynamics, and constrained DC voltage optimization over the entire transport sequence. This framework connects waveform design, control, and computational validation, with smooth multichannel waveforms computed rapidly through a Karush-Kuhn-Tucker(KKT) linear system. The resulting waveform transports a single ¹⁷¹Yb⁺ ion through a 90deg turn in 5μ s at an average speed of 14.6 m/s. Over 50 consecutive round trips, the final equivalent coherent phonon number consistently stays below 0.001, with no noticeable accumulation over time. System level evaluations at the QCCD scale show that the median duration of a single execution cycle is reduced by about 30% across various circuit types. The fraction of execution time spent on transport decreases from approximately 70% to 55%. This approach offers a means of designing fast ion transport waveforms with low phonon excitation for scalable QCCD based QPUs and provides a technical basis for efficient execution of quantum algorithms.
articles.abstract_zh: 离子阱量子计算中的QCCD架构依赖离子传输实现高保真计算和全连接。X结转弯在传输时间中占比增加，其传输速度和最终声子激发直接影响量子算法效率。本文开发了一种用于低声子激发高速X结传输的波形设计方法，该方法结合了多射频伪势通道设计、多维绝热捷径动力学和受限直流电压优化。该框架实现了波形设计、控制和计算验证的整合。
authors: Jie Xiao, Zhao Wang, Chenghong Zhu, Shiqiang Gao, Xin Wang, Fa Dai, Xu Wang

articles.title: Sample-Size Scalability and Representation Sensitivity of Quantum Machine Learning Models for Higgs Boson Event Classification
articles.title_zh: 希格斯玻色子事件分类中量子机器学习模型的样本量可扩展性和表示敏感性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14533v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum machine learning offers new approaches to multivariate event classification in high-energy physics, but its performance relative to optimized classical methods remains uncertain under limited training data and restricted quantum resources. We investigate the sample-size scalability and representation sensitivity of a quantum support vector machine and a variational quantum classifier for Higgs-boson signal--background discrimination using simulated events from the ATLAS Higgs Machine Learning Challenge. The models are trained on balanced subsets ranging from 250 to 4000 events and evaluated on held-out samples preserving the original class distribution. Principal component analysis (PCA) and autoencoder (AE) representations are examined to reduce the input dimensionality and quantum-resource requirements. Four optimized classical classifiers are used as benchmarks under a common preprocessing, validation, and evaluation protocol. We assess training-sample scalability in classical and quantum classifiers using a four-component PCA representation and examine representation sensitivity through a secondary matched-event comparison of four- and eight-component PCA representations. Within the evaluated Higgs-boson classification setting, the QSVM showed stronger performance than the VQC at larger training sample sizes, while remaining below the best-performing classical classifiers.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了量子支持向量机和变分量子分类器在希格斯玻色子信号-背景区分任务中的样本量可扩展性和表示敏感性。研究使用ATLAS希格斯机器学习挑战赛的模拟事件进行训练和评估，并考察了主成分分析和自编码器表示对输入维度和量子资源需求的影响。通过与四种优化经典分类器进行基准比较，评估了量子模型在有限训练数据和资源下的性能。
authors: Shiksha Bhardwaj, Ankhi Roy

articles.title: Entanglement-Capability-Aware Finite-Bond Circuit Cutting for Distributed Quantum Computing
articles.title_zh: 面向分布式量子计算的纠缠能力感知有限键电路切割
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14580v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Distributed quantum computing distributes workloads that exceed a single processor's capacity across resource-constrained components. Circuit cutting enables this decomposition, but its effectiveness depends on partition choice. We present SACE, a Simulation-Aware Circuit Partitioning framework with Entanglement-Capability-Aware Screening. EP-Cost screens partitions using a parameter-dependent entanglement-capability proxy and native implementation cost. Under reconstruction constraints, finite-bond refinement selects the candidate that minimizes the worst-subcircuit discrepancy between normalized MPS simulations at bond dimensions ḩi and 2ḩi. Across 14 exhaustively enumerated small-scale candidate spaces, EP-Cost-guided genetic algorithm selections attain co-optimal native quasiprobability decomposition (QPD) overhead, with a median within-circuit Spearman correlation of 0.9965 between EP-Cost and QPD overhead. At matched cut counts, EP-Cost reduces QPD overhead by 25.20× and 16.89× for 8- and 9-qubit QFT circuits, respectively, and improves sampled reconstruction. On 12-qubit approximate QFT, deterministic reconstruction reduces Pauli-observable mean absolute error in all six low-bond conditions and total-variation distance in five. With five cuts and 7,776 QPD terms, SACE is best on all four reconstruction metrics in four of six conditions. At 24 qubits, SACE improves exact-local QFT accuracy in all 30 instance-bond-dimension conditions against each EP-Cost-only, Kernighan-Lin, and spectral baseline. The 50-qubit QFT comparisons remain favorable as reference convergence improves. Weighted QAOA circuits provide complementary, more bond-sensitive evidence. Refinement benefits persist across three search methods; larger candidate panels improve the optimized proxy without guaranteeing lower exact-local error.
articles.abstract_zh: 分布式量子计算通过电路切割将超负荷工作分配到资源受限的组件上。本文提出了SACE框架，一个模拟感知电路划分框架，通过纠缠能力感知筛选来优化划分选择。EP-Cost利用参数依赖的纠缠能力代理和原生实现成本筛选分区，并在重建约束下选择最小化最差子电路差异的候选。实验结果表明，EP-Cost显著降低了准概率分解（QPD）开销，并改进了采样重建。
authors: Weidong Liu, Qingqing Jiang, Yufu Liu, Ruiqing He, Jiandong Shang, Hengliang Guo, Qiang Chen

articles.title: Reducing Trust Cost in Quantum Application Development Using AI
articles.title_zh: 利用人工智能降低量子应用开发中的信任成本
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14665v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative AI can be a powerful tool for supporting the design and implementation of quantum applications, whereas the burden of checking whether generated circuits realize the intended computation increases. In this study, we regard this burden of human understanding, checking, and judgment as ``trust cost,'' and propose a development methodology that integrates AI and formal verification to reduce it. In the proposed development methodology, the implementation is divided into three components: a target mathematical specification, a quantum circuit, and a correspondence theorem and its proof that prove the agreement between the two. This division separates the specifications and theorem statements checked by humans from the theorem proofs entrusted to mechanical checking. As a concrete development example of this proposal, we describe an implementation for the time evolution of a stochastic particle system and its results.
articles.abstract_zh: 生成式AI在量子应用设计和实现中具有潜力，但增加了验证生成电路是否符合预期的负担，即“信任成本”。本文提出了一种结合AI和形式化验证的开发方法来降低这种信任成本。该方法将实现分为数学规范、量子电路和证明两者一致性的对应定理及其证明，从而将人类检查的规范与机械检查的定理证明分离。
authors: Katsuhiro Endo

articles.title: Clifford Invariants and Three-Copy Quantum Tests
articles.title_zh: Clifford不变量与三副本量子测试
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14758v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We give an explicit treatment of the third tensor power of the Clifford representation on n qutrits, for n≥2. This representation has five pairwise inequivalent irreducible constituents, with multiplicities 1,1,1,1,2. The decomposition reduces the Clifford twirl of a tensor cube to four real parameters. Two of them are spectral moments of the input. The other two are cubic invariants expressed as sums of cubes of the Weyl characteristic function and the discrete Wigner function. On trace-one Hermitian matrices, the invariant polynomials of degree at most three are spanned by the constant function and four algebraically independent functions. These functions do not separate Clifford orbits. For pure inputs a single parameter suffices. We recover its range and the characterization of its maximum by stabilizer states. We bound the stabilizer fidelity, determine full separability across the three copies in the symmetric family, and recover the criterion for a complex projective 3-design. We classify the jointly invariant quantum Boolean functions. For stabilizer testing and for testing unknown observables we give explicit bounds on copies and queries. We also give character formulas for the finite projective Clifford groups and record the complete character table for two qutrits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对n个三态量子比特（n≥2）上的Clifford表示的第三张量幂进行了显式处理，该表示包含五个不等价的不可约分量。分解将张量立方体的Clifford旋转简化为四个实参数，其中两个是输入的光谱矩，另外两个是三次不变量。研究还确定了纯输入情况下的单个参数范围，并给出了稳定器保真度的界限，以及对称族中三副本完全可分离性的判据。
authors: Xingya Fan, Yongzhi Luan

articles.title: Avoiding Defects within Heavy-Hexagon Architecture
articles.title_zh: 避免重六边形架构中的缺陷
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14778v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When implementing scalable fault-tolerant quantum computing using superconducting quantum processors, one of the critical challenges to overcome is the presence of defective qubits arising from fabrication and calibration imperfections. A defect on a specific qubit severely restricts the connectivity between adjacent qubits, disrupts stabilizer measurements, induces frequent detection events, and consequently inflates the logical error rate. To mitigate this issue, various strategies have been proposed, such as syndrome extraction circuits based on stabilizer folding and the construction of super-stabilizers via gauge operators. However, these methods have primarily been developed for architectures with relatively high connectivity of 3 to 4. Furthermore, experimental demonstrations showing an actual reduction in logical error rates in the presence of physical hardware defects have been lacking. In this work, we propose a defect-avoidance scheme tailored for the heavy-hexagon architecture, which features a lower connectivity of 2 to 3. While previous approaches required four measurement cycles to measure all gauge operators comprising a super-stabilizer, our proposed scheme completes all gauge measurements within only two cycles. We experimentally validate this approach on IBM quantum hardware by identifying physical defects and implementing the defect-avoidance circuits. As a result, avoiding the defect yields an approximately 10% reduction in the logical error rate per cycle for both logical X and Z errors. These findings demonstrate that defects in superconducting hardware can be successfully handled even under the constrained connectivity of heavy-hexagon lattices, and that defect avoidance substantially reduces logical errors on real quantum hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 在超导量子处理器中实现可扩展容错量子计算时，缺陷量子比特是一个关键挑战。现有缺陷缓解策略主要针对连接度较高的架构，且缺乏实验验证。本工作提出了一种针对连接度较低的重六边形架构的缺陷规避方案，旨在解决缺陷对量子比特连接性、稳定器测量和逻辑错误率的影响。
authors: Hansol Kim, Younghun Kwon

articles.title: Classical Communication Helps Single-Shot Quantum Compression
articles.title_zh: 经典通信有助于单次量子压缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14785v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Free classical communication can yield an unbounded single-shot saving in quantum compression, even though it leaves the asymptotic rate of an i.i.d. source unchanged. At every fixed error in (0,1), we exhibit sources whose unassisted compression cost is arbitrarily large, yet a single qubit suffices with classical communication and no preshared entanglement. We establish this separation by determining the exact optimal source fidelity for compression through an m-dimensional noiseless quantum channel, with and without free classical communication, while preserving correlations with an inaccessible reference. Without classical assistance, the optimal fidelity is exactly the Ky Fan norm |h̊o|₍ₘ₎, the sum of the m largest eigenvalues of the source state. With classical assistance, we obtain an explicit spectral threshold formula and a protocol attaining it. Classical communication strictly improves fidelity whenever m is smaller than the source rank. The corresponding compression costs are two smoothed versions of the log-rank entropy, also called max-entropy: trace-distance smoothing under local operations and quadratic smoothing under LOCC. For i.i.d. copies of a fixed source with positive entropy variance, however, the two costs have identical first-, second-, and third-order asymptotic terms. For nonlattice spectra, we determine the constant-order advantage: classical communication saves łog₂₍ₑ₎₋₁ bits per block asymptotically, and the ratio of assisted to unassisted minimum communication dimensions converges to 2/e.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了经典通信对单次量子压缩的帮助，发现其能带来无限的单次节省，尽管不改变渐近速率。研究通过确定通过无噪声量子信道进行压缩的最佳源保真度来证明这一点，无论是否有经典通信。结果表明，当信道维度小于源秩时，经典通信能显著提高保真度，并提供了相应的压缩成本公式。
authors: Omri Farber, Gilad Gour

articles.title: A complete classification of operator controllability for closed three-level quantum systems driven by a single control
articles.title_zh: 单一控制驱动的闭合三能级量子系统算子可控性的完整分类
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.14938v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we study operator controllability of finite-dimensional closed quantum systems driven by a single coherent control. Two general Lie-algebraic results on controllability of such systems are proved. The first gives sufficient conditions under which controllability of the system is preserved when controlled energy-level shifts are added. The second gives a sufficient basis-element condition under which the dynamical Lie algebra contains mathfraksu(N) and the system is therefore operator controllable. These results, together with known controllability conditions, are applied to obtain a complete classification of operator controllability of all three-level quantum systems in terms of their free and interaction Hamiltonian matrix elements. This classification covers all combinations of energy-level and level-spacing degeneracies, two or three allowed transitions, as well as the presence or absence of controlled energy-level shifts, and gives necessary and sufficient conditions for operator controllability in each case.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了由单一相干控制驱动的有限维闭合量子系统的算子可控性。研究证明了两个关于此类系统可控性的李代数结果，并将其应用于三能级量子系统。最终，本文根据自由和相互作用哈密顿量矩阵元素，对所有三能级量子系统的算子可控性进行了完整分类，给出了每种情况下的充要条件。
authors: Sergey Kuznetsov, Alexander Pechen

articles.title: Generative learning of time series with holographic quantum circuit sampling
articles.title_zh: 基于全息量子电路采样的时间序列生成学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15083v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum generative models face growing qubit requirements and concentrated loss landscapes when learning long time series. Here we introduce holographic quantum circuit sampling (HQCS), which combines mid-circuit measurements, qubit reuse and independently parameterized temporal blocks to generate trajectories with a fixed number of qubits. For Haar-random HQCS and a normalized exponential kernel, we prove inverse-polynomial bounds on maximum mean discrepancy loss variance, contrasting with exponential concentration in global Haar-random generators. For generic members of a family of nonstationary Markov processes, temporal parameterization reduces exact-generation gate counts from quadratic to linear in sequence length relative to a specified class of repeated shared-block generators. Simulations demonstrate learning of Gaussian autoregressive processes and historical Volatility Index (VIX) trajectories, with the latter achieving over tenfold lower maximum mean discrepancy than the tested classical benchmarks. These results establish a framework for quantum time-series generation with fixed qubit requirements and provable avoidance of exponential loss concentration as sequence length grows.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对量子生成模型在学习长时序数据时面临的量子比特需求增长问题，本文引入了全息量子电路采样（HQCS）方法。HQCS通过结合中途测量、量子比特复用和独立参数化的时间块，以固定数量的量子比特生成轨迹。该方法在理论上证明了损失方差的逆多项式界限，并在模拟中展示了对高斯自回归过程和历史波动率指数（VIX）轨迹的有效学习，性能优于经典基准。
authors: Bingzhi Zhang, Matthew W. Lee, Tom Finke, Quntao Zhuang

articles.title: The Rényi area law conjecture is false below α=1 in high dimensions
articles.title_zh: 高维空间中当 α<1 时，Rényi 面积定律猜想不成立
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15199v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Area laws express the expectation that entanglement in gapped quantum ground states scales with a boundary rather than a volume. In one dimension this holds for every Rényi entropy, and the Rényi area-law conjecture asserts the same in higher dimensions for each fixed 0<α<1. Here we disprove this conjecture in every spatial dimension two and higher. We construct finite-range Hamiltonians with fixed local dimension, bounded interaction strength, unique ground states and a uniform spectral gap, whose ground states exhibit volume-law Rényi entanglement while obeying a von Neumann area law and remaining connected to product states through uniformly gapped local paths. The mechanism is error-space complexity: locally identifiable components of arbitrarily small weight can encode states with high entanglement complexity. We also establish the worst-case rank-error trade-off for approximate ground-state projectors, a key tool in one-dimensional area-law proofs. At fixed gap, the optimal Schmidt rank at projection error ϵ across a planar cut of cross-section A scales as exp[tildeΘ((Ałogϵ⁻¹)²/³)] when łogϵ⁻¹gtrsim A. Thus α=1 is the sharp threshold for a universal Rényi area law within this adiabatically connected class.
articles.abstract_zh: 面积定律通常认为纠缠在有能隙量子基态中与边界而非体积成比例。Rényi 面积定律猜想认为在高于一维的空间中，对于固定的 0<α<1，该定律也成立。本文在高维空间中推翻了这一猜想，构建了具有体积定律 Rényi 纠缠的基态，同时仍遵循冯诺依曼面积定律。研究揭示了误差空间复杂性是其机制，并确定了 α=1 是区分面积定律和体积定律的尖锐阈值。
authors: Tomotaka Kuwahara

articles.title: Monogamy of quantum steering in exciton--cavity optomechanical system
articles.title_zh: 激子-腔光力系统中的量子导引单配性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15233v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we study a theoretical scheme to investigate the monogamy of quantum steering in a hybrid exciton--cavity optomechanical (EOM) system. Within the Gaussian-state formalism, we quantify the steerability among the exciton, photon, and mechanical modes in both the steady-state and dynamical regimes. We establish and verify CKW-type monogamy inequalities for Gaussian steering and demonstrate that the distribution of bipartite steering among the three modes can be controlled through the system parameters. We further examine the influence of thermal noise and temporal evolution on the steering properties and the corresponding monogamy relations. Our results show that increasing the temperature generally suppresses the strength of Gaussian steering and modifies the degree of steering sharing imposed by the CKW-type monogamy relations. In contrast, in the dynamical regime, the steerability can increase with evolution time over suitable temporal windows, indicating that the transient dynamics can be exploited to enhance quantum correlations. These results highlight the potential of hybrid exciton--optomechanical platforms for controllable quantum correlations and provide a promising route toward the generation and manipulation of multipartite quantum resources.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在混合激子-腔光力（EOM）系统中，理论研究了量子导引的单配性。研究在稳态和动态机制下量化了激子、光子和机械模式之间的导引能力，并建立了高斯导引的CKW型单配性不等式。结果表明，系统参数可以控制双模导引的分布，且热噪声通常会抑制导引强度，而动态演化在特定时间窗内可以增强导引能力。
authors: Hamza Harraf, Mohamed Amazioug, Rachid Ahl Laamara

articles.title: Photonic realization of an electromagnetic cavity field with uniform mirror motion
articles.title_zh: 具有均匀镜面运动的电磁腔场的光子实现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15312v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We perform a detailed mathematical study of the effective Hamiltonian describing a non-stationary electromagnetic cavity field, introduced by C.~K.~Law, in the presence of uniform linear motion. We find that the corresponding dynamical equations admit a unitary diagonalization and that the normalized velocity of motion satisfies the two-sided bound łvert v/c v̊ert łesssim 10.1716. Although this result is mathematically consistent, the interval obtained is an order of magnitude larger than the physically admissible range łvert v/c v̊ert < 1. To address this limitation, we propose a reinterpretation of bosonic coupling terms as generators of the symplectic algebra Sp(4,R), identifying them with transformations that can be implemented through linear optical elements. Within this photonic approach, the coupling parameters are not restricted to small values, allowing us to explore regimes of strong effective interactions. In this case, we demonstrate the generation of two-mode squeezed states and derive analytical expressions for the average photon number in each mode. Furthermore, we analyze statistical properties that characterize mixedness and entanglement, including intermode correlations, the Mandel parameter, and the linear entropy. The corresponding Wigner function provides a phase-space visualization of the system's behavior, illustrating the connection between cavity motion, mode coupling, and nonclassical field correlations via the underlying symplectic algebra.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对C.K. Law提出的描述非平稳电磁腔场在均匀直线运动下的有效哈密顿量进行了详细的数学研究。为解决物理限制，研究提出将玻色子耦合项重新解释为辛代数Sp(4,R)的生成元，并通过线性光学元件实现。在此光子方法中，耦合参数不再受限于小值，从而能够探索强有效相互作用的区域，并展示了双模压缩态的生成。
authors: A. R. Urzúa, I. Ramos-Prieto, R. Román-Ancheyta, J. Récamier-Angelini, L. Medina-Dozal, F. Soto-Eguibar, H. M. Moya-Cessa

articles.title: Genuine Information Backflow Requires Noncommuting Initial System States
articles.title_zh: 真正的量子信息回流需要非对易的初始系统状态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15430v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Gorini-Kossakowski-Lindblad-Sudarshan (GKLS) equation, a cornerstone of open-system theory, describes Markovian semigroup dynamics in which information about the initial preparation cannot revive. Beyond this regime, information revivals are widely interpreted as backflow from a non-Markovian environment. However, a decrease followed by an increase in information retrievable from the system need not imply that information has returned from the environment [PRX Quantum 6, 020316 (2025)]. It may instead arise from noise correlations unrelated to the system's initial preparation, carried by inert degrees of freedom that never interact with the system and therefore cannot mediate backflow. Such revivals are called extrinsic; genuine backflow is reserved for revivals that cannot be explained this way. The framework developed in that work, however, assumes access to arbitrary initial system states, an assumption often incompatible with physical constraints or limited experimental control. This leaves open which properties of the available preparations are necessary for an information revival to certify genuine backflow. Here we extend the framework to allow the description of restricted families of initial states and show that genuine backflow is possible only if the family contains noncommuting states. If all available states commute, as in a classical stochastic process, every revival can be explained by a suitable inert extension and is therefore extrinsic. Noncommutativity of the available system states is thus necessary for information revivals to provide an operational signature of environmental memory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了开放量子系统中信息回流的条件。虽然信息复苏常被解释为非马尔可夫环境的信息回流，但研究指出，并非所有信息复苏都代表真正的回流，有些可能是由与系统初始状态无关的噪声相关性引起的。本文扩展了现有框架，证明了真正的量子信息回流需要非对易的初始系统状态，这对于理解和验证非马尔可夫过程至关重要。
authors: Abdullah Alsharari, Francesco Buscemi

articles.title: Breakdown of thermalization in quantum spin systems with long-range interactions
articles.title_zh: 具有长程相互作用的量子自旋系统中的热化失效
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15530v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum thermalization of closed systems -- i.e. the relaxation of local properties to their thermodynamic value along the Hamiltonian evolution -- is generically expected in non-integrable systems at finite energy density. In this work we show that quantum spin systems with at least one spin component coupled through long-range ferromagnetic interactions, and a second spin component coupled to a field, cannot in general thermalize to a paramagnetic state whenever they have a finite, negative energy per spin. The long-range interactions we consider decay as a power law of the distance, sim r⁻α with α < d, where d is the number of spatial dimensions of the system. The lack of thermalization is generic to an infinite family of Hamiltonians, and it is not associated to any form of integrability. It can instead be understood by the anomalous features of the thermodynamics of the system in the paramagnetic phase, which cannot be reflected in the properties of the eigenstates. This leads to a breakdown of eigenstate typicality and of the eigenstate thermalization hypothesis. Interestingly, the non-thermal states emerging at long times in the dynamics display long-range multipartite entanglement, elevating the breakdown of thermalization to a resource.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有长程铁磁相互作用的量子自旋系统中的热化现象。研究发现，当系统具有有限负自旋能量时，这类系统通常无法热化到顺磁态，即使它们是非可积的。这种热化失效源于顺磁相中系统热力学的异常特征，导致本征态典型性和本征态热化假设的失效。
authors: Filippo Caleca, Fabio Mezzacapo, Tommaso Roscilde

articles.title: Riemannian Formulation of Sample-Based Quantum Krylov Solvers for Elliptic Problems: Energy-Norm Guarantees and Duct-Flow Applications
articles.title_zh: 椭圆问题的基于采样的量子克雷洛夫求解器的黎曼公式：能量范数保证和管道流应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.15586v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sample-based quantum linear solvers measure quantum Krylov states e⁻ⁱAT|bångle and reconstruct the solution of Ax=b classically on the observed basis states. We develop this approach for positive-definite systems that arise from elliptic partial differential equations. We show that the sampling guarantees hold in any fixed basis with an efficient transform. We then replace the variational reconstruction by a Galerkin solve on the sampled set. For this reconstruction we derive expected and high-probability energy-norm error bounds, a sample complexity in terms of the smallest sampling probability on an essential set, a computable residual certificate, and a support-completeness theorem for the dephased outcome law. We formulate the method for elliptic problems on Riemannian cross sections. In two dimensions the stiffness matrix is metric-independent in conformal coordinates, and curved vessels lead to the same matrix class.
