articles.title: Error correction and quantum information spreading on sparse random graphs
articles.title_zh: 稀疏随机图上的纠错与量子信息传播
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12597v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum error-correcting codes on graph geometries beyond regular euclidean lattices have emerged as a promising route toward robust quantum information processing. A major challenge in quantum error correction is the trade-off between favorable properties of codes constructed in high dimensionality and the need for locality in practical implementations on near-term hardware. Sparse intermediate geometries may combine the advantages of both, but how their structure governs quantum information dynamics and code performance remains unclear. Here we show that the spectral dimension dₛ, defined from the low-energy spectrum of the graph Laplacian, is the universal parameter connecting these properties. Using Floquet random Clifford circuits on two distinct sparse graph architectures with tunable spectral dimension, we find that dₛ governs both quantum information spreading and the scaling of the resulting quantum error-correcting code distance. We identify a geometry-induced entanglement phase transition from localized area-law to ergodic volume-law, whose universality is determined by dₛ and exhibits long-range percolation criticality. In the ergodic phase, the circuit acts as a CSS code encoder whose code distance is set by the competition between two logical sectors --- the cost of severing the graph and the length of its shortest winding cycle --- which connectivity pushes in opposite directions. The spectral dimension organizes this trade-off, highlighting a maximum at intermediate dₛ retaining sparse connectivity and physical realizability.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子纠错码在非欧几里得图几何上的应用为鲁棒量子信息处理提供了新途径。本文研究了稀疏随机图上量子信息动力学和纠错码性能，发现图拉普拉斯算子的低能谱定义的谱维度 dₛ 是连接这些性质的普适参数。研究表明，dₛ 控制着量子信息传播和纠错码距离的标度，并识别出一种由几何引起的纠缠相变。
authors: Giovanni Cemin, Marin Bukov, Andrea Solfanelli

articles.title: Analog quantum simulation of Shastry-Sutherland Ising materials
articles.title_zh: Shastry-Sutherland伊辛材料的模拟量子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12800v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Frustrated magnets host rich emergent behavior because competing interactions generate dense manifolds of low-energy states. The Ising Shastry-Sutherland model is a paradigmatic setting, motivated experimentally by Ising-like rare-earth tetraborides such as TmB₄ and ErB₄, whose field-induced magnetization plateaus have motivated extensive microscopic modeling. Yet how tunable quantum fluctuations reorganize this material-motivated phase diagram remains largely unexplored. Here, we realize a transverse- and longitudinal-field Ising model on the Shastry-Sutherland lattice using a programmable Rydberg-atom array. We map its quantum phase diagram using density matrix renormalization group calculations and probe corresponding signatures experimentally in arrays containing more than 110 atoms. Beyond the established classical phases, the calculations identify two regimes absent in the classical limit and stabilized at finite transverse field: a 2/5 filling plateau whose finite stability region emerges from a classically degenerate phase boundary and a symmetry-preserving quantum-dimer regime replacing classically selected collinear order. Experiments on finite open arrays reveal signatures consistent with these regimes across three boundary-pinning conditions, with the resulting response maps agreeing qualitatively with the calculated phase diagram. Our results establish programmable Rydberg-atom arrays as tools for exploring frustrated, material-motivated Hamiltonians and motivate searches for new, quantum-driven magnetization plateaus and quantum-dimer behavior in ErB₄ under a transverse field or in strain-tuned TmB₄.
articles.abstract_zh: 阻挫磁体因竞争相互作用而产生丰富的涌现行为。本文利用可编程里德堡原子阵列，在Shastry-Sutherland晶格上实现了横向和纵向场伊辛模型。通过密度矩阵重整化群计算和实验探测，研究人员绘制了其量子相图。结果揭示了在有限横向场下稳定的两个新量子态：一个2/5填充平台和一个对称保持的量子二聚体态，这些在经典极限下是不存在的。
authors: Vahagn Mkhitaryan, Milan Kornjača, Mao Lin, Alexander Schuckert, Majd Hamdan, Sergio H. Cantú, Ammar Ali, Tommaso Macrí, Nathan Gemelke, Alexander Keesling, Peter Komar, Travis S. Humble, Alexei Bylinski, Pedro L. S. Lopes, Fangli Liu, Alexandra Boltasseva, Mikhail D. Lukin, Arnab Banerjee, Vladimir M. Shalaev, Sheng-Tao Wang

articles.title: Trainable Quantum-Native Language Models: Dissipative Memory, Capacity Limits, and Hardware Validation
articles.title_zh: 可训练的量子原生语言模型：耗散记忆、容量限制与硬件验证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12806v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study byte-level autoregressive language models whose hidden state is a small quantum register, whose transitions are learned token-conditioned quantum channels, and whose next-byte probabilities come directly from Born-rule measurements without a learned classical vocabulary projection or softmax. In the fixed-width recurrent setting, unitary dynamics cannot contract or reset stored distinctions; experimentally, unitary recurrence loses to its retrained one-token control in every tested variant. Introducing learned dissipation, then token-conditioned dissipative gating, yields useful memory beyond one token. The gated model improves test negative log-likelihood by 0.20 +/- 0.03 nats/byte over retrained parameter-matched one-token controls at context length 12, and by 0.29-0.33 at longer contexts, but never beats retrained two-token controls. A key-value recall benchmark shows a width-dependent threshold: one stored pair meets the pre-registered accuracy bar at 4-5 memory qubits, two pairs at 6-7, and three pairs remain unsolved. This is consistent with, but does not establish, a capacity explanation for the short effective memory horizon. As a secondary result, one-qubit models reach lower stationary memory entropy than a heuristically optimized classical predictive frontier at matched error in 9/9 seeds. On IBM Heron hardware, computational-basis memory-register distributions show signal against a uniform null in 12/12 circuits across prefixes of up to 12 tokens, next-bit probabilities pass pre-registered accuracy bars at four-token prefixes, and bytes are generated autoregressively by sampling physically measured bit probabilities. The tested models are classically simulable and substantially worse than classical n-gram baselines. We claim no computational quantum advantage.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了以小型量子寄存器为隐藏状态的字节级自回归语言模型，其状态转移通过学习的量子信道实现。研究发现，引入学习到的耗散和基于token的耗散门控，可以实现超越单个token的有用记忆。在键值召回基准测试中，模型的记忆容量表现出与量子比特宽度相关的阈值，这与对短有效记忆的容量解释相符。
authors: Deniz Yunus Göğüş

articles.title: An Instability of the Quantum Markov Length
articles.title_zh: 量子马尔可夫长度的不稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12929v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Markov length, the length scale governing the exponential decay of conditional mutual information (CMI) in a quantum many-body state, has proven useful for characterizing mixed-state phases of matter. Nevertheless, we show that a state's Markov length is not generally stable under weak local channels. The failure of stability occurs already at a pure product state. We demonstrate this explicitly in a one-dimensional fermionic chain, where a fine-tuned depth-two circuit of nearest-neighbor Gaussian channels maps the vacuum to a state whose CMI decays emphalgebraically and whose Markov length is therefore infinite, even when the channels are taken arbitrarily close to the identity. The algebraic decay is rooted in the nonanalyticity of the von Neumann entropy at rank-deficient density operators. We exhibit an analogous instability on an ordinary qubit chain. More generally, we show that the Markov length is unstable in any translation-invariant state with even a single rank-deficient reduced density operator. These results pose a challenge to recent definitions of mixed-state phase equivalence based on the Markov length.
articles.abstract_zh: 马尔可夫长度是描述量子多体态中条件互信息指数衰减的尺度，常用于表征混合态物质相。然而，本文证明了在弱局域信道作用下，量子态的马尔可夫长度通常是不稳定的。研究在一个一维费米子链中明确展示了这种不稳定性，即使信道任意接近恒等操作，马尔可夫长度也能变为无穷大。这些结果对基于马尔可夫长度的混合态相等价性定义提出了挑战。
authors: David C. Newsom, Michael Levin

articles.title: Quantum-assisted rendezvous on hypercubes: a quantum Bernoulli noise approach
articles.title_zh: 超立方体上的量子辅助会合：一种量子伯努利噪声方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12949v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study quantum-assisted balanced rendezvous on the d-dimensional hypercube in a one-step two-agent quantum-walk framework, where the two agents move the same Hamming distance and meet at a common midpoint. The key structure is a projective t-sphere resolution, which governs exact finite-dimensional quantum attainment. Its scalar analogue recovers the corresponding classical characterization. We characterize finite-dimensional quantum attainment of the no-signalling benchmark, construct quantum strategies from projective sphere resolutions, and establish a rigidity theorem for optimal finite-dimensional strategies. A marked difference appears between nearest-neighbor and higher-cardinality updates: quantum advantage can occur in the former, whereas in the latter the geometry of the relevant Hamming spheres rules out exact finite-dimensional attainment of the no-signalling value. Together, these results connect quantum-walk dynamics, Hamming-sphere geometry, and quantum rendezvous within the quantum Bernoulli noises (QBN) framework.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在一步两智能体量子行走框架下，研究了d维超立方体上的量子辅助平衡会合问题。研究发现，投影t-球分解是实现精确有限维量子会合的关键结构。结果表明，在最近邻更新中可以出现量子优势，而在高基数更新中，相关的汉明球几何排除了精确的有限维无信号值实现。这些发现将量子行走动力学、汉明球几何和量子会合在量子伯努利噪声框架内联系起来。
authors: Ce Wang

articles.title: Quantum Information-Theoretic Analysis of Optical Fiber Sensing via Stimulated Brillouin Scattering
articles.title_zh: 基于受激布里渊散射的光纤传感的量子信息理论分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12980v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Stimulated Brillouin scattering (SBS) is a powerful mechanism for distributed sensing in optical fibers, as the Brillouin response is highly sensitive to local material parameters. Assuming the input probe is a quantum state, we develop a quantum-information-theoretic framework for SBS-based fiber sensing and intrusion detection. Starting from a linearized opto-acoustic Hamiltonian, we derive an effective input-output relation for a short fiber segment. We then model each fiber segment as a single-mode bosonic Gaussian channel and the entire fiber as a cascade of quantum channels. We then compute the quantum Fisher information for general SBS-dependent parameters and identify optimal measurement settings to achieve the quantum limit, comparing them with receiver-constrained strategies such as heterodyne detection and photon counting. In addition, we propose an adaptive approach that achieves first-order asymptotic optimality and provides a novel second-order correction to address preliminary miscalibration. As an application, we apply the framework to the fiber-tapping detection problem.
articles.abstract_zh: 受激布里渊散射（SBS）是光纤分布式传感的强大机制。本文提出了一个基于SBS的光纤传感和入侵检测的量子信息理论框架。研究人员计算了量子费雪信息，并确定了实现量子极限的最佳测量设置。此外，还提出了一种自适应方法，实现了首次渐近最优性，并提供了新颖的二阶校正以解决初步校准误差。该框架可应用于光纤窃听检测问题。
authors: Kiran Adhikari, Janis Nötzel

articles.title: When irrelevance governs: dissipation-regression scaling in open quantum criticality
articles.title_zh: 当无关性主导时：开放量子临界中的耗散-回归标度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13033v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The real-time dynamics of quantum phase transitions in open systems coupled to finite-temperature environments sits at the heart of contemporary condensed-matter and quantum-information science. Here, invoking a Schwinger-Keldysh formalism, we uncover that, within the coherence-dominated regime of critical real-time evolution, a dissipative coupling deemed naively irrelevant determines, counterintuitively, the longest timescale that holds sway. Possessing a well-defined temporal scaling dimension, it engenders a novel dissipation-regression scaling that systematically reproduces the unusual Kibble-Zurek scaling and relaxation observed in recent numerical studies. By contrast, dissipation-dominated dynamics behaves qualitatively differently. There, furthermore, we show that the discretized and diagonalized formulations of the same open quantum Ising chain realize distinct universality classes.
articles.abstract_zh: 开放系统中量子相变的实时动力学是凝聚态和量子信息科学的核心。本文利用Schwinger-Keldysh形式，发现在临界实时演化的相干主导区域内，一个看似无关的耗散耦合却决定了最长的时间尺度。这种耦合产生了一种新的耗散-回归标度，系统地再现了Kibble-Zurek标度和弛豫现象。研究还表明，同一开放量子伊辛链的离散化和对角化形式实现了不同的普适类。
authors: Fan Zhong

articles.title: Error Mitigation by Zero-Noise Extrapolation (ZNE) in Indirect-Control System
articles.title_zh: 间接控制系统中零噪声外推（ZNE）的错误缓解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13038v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The indirect-control paradigm offers a scalable approach to quantum computation by restricting external operations to a small subset of qubits, whereas the entire system evolves under its intrinsic many-body Hamiltonian. This framework reduces hardware complexity and limits the noise introduced through control channels. Recently, Anan et al. proposed an implementation of the variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) within this indirect-control architecture. However, the impact and integration of quantum error mitigation techniques in such a setting remain largely unexplored. In particular, zero-noise extrapolation (ZNE), a widely used error mitigation strategy, has not yet been systematically adapted to indirect-control VQE. A key requirement of ZNE is the controlled amplification of noise, which is commonly achieved through circuit-level techniques such as unitary folding. In the indirect-control framework, however, quantum operations are largely governed by continuous time-evolution under the system Hamiltonian, making the construction of physically realizable inverse operations non-trivial. In this study, we investigate the feasibility of implementing ZNE within the indirect-controlVQEframework.We address the challenges associated with unitary folding in the presence of time-evolution operators and, with a minimal relaxation of the indirect-control constraint, we propose a ZNE-based error-mitigation strategy that exploits the symmetry of the one-dimensional XY spin chain.
articles.abstract_zh: 间接控制范式通过限制外部操作于少量量子比特，为量子计算提供了一种可扩展方法。本文研究了零噪声外推（ZNE）这一广泛使用的错误缓解策略在间接控制变分量子本征求解器（VQE）中的可行性。由于间接控制框架中量子操作主要由系统哈密顿量的连续时间演化控制，实现ZNE所需的噪声受控放大面临挑战。本研究旨在探讨ZNE在此类系统中的应用与集成。
authors: Arijit Das, Masaki Owari

articles.title: Zak Phase Quantization without Global Symmetry through Destructive Interference
articles.title_zh: 通过相消干涉实现无全局对称性的扎克相量子化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13250v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Zak phase provides a fundamental geometric characterization of one-dimensional band structures and, when quantized by symmetry, serves as a bulk indicator of polarization and boundary phenomena. Conventionally, its exact quantization is tied to a global symmetry of the Bloch Hamiltonian, such as inversion or reflection symmetry. Here, we demonstrate a distinct mechanism by which the Zak phase remains exactly quantized even when the corresponding protecting symmetry is explicitly broken at the level of the full Hamiltonian. The mechanism is based on local support symmetry and destructive interference: symmetry-breaking degrees of freedom are coupled to a topological parent system in such a way that the relevant Bloch states cannot leak into them. The preserved states therefore retain their parent wave functions and inherit their quantized Zak phase exactly, despite the absence of the protecting global symmetry. We establish this mechanism for general one-dimensional insulators and demonstrate it in an inversion-broken minimal model and a reflection-broken armchair nanoribbon, where a quantized π Zak phase and associated boundary-localized states persist. We further show that perturbations violating the exact destructive-interference condition continuously dequantize the Zak phase, while a finite regime with a near-π Zak phase and boundary response can survive. Our results establish wave-function support, rather than global symmetry alone, as a mechanism for protecting quantized quantum geometry in one-dimensional systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 扎克相是描述一维能带结构的基本几何特征，其精确量子化通常与布洛赫哈密顿量的全局对称性相关。本文展示了一种独特的机制，即使在全局对称性被明确破坏的情况下，扎克相也能保持精确量子化。该机制基于局部支撑对称性和相消干涉，使得相关布洛赫态无法泄漏到对称破缺的自由度中。研究在反演破缺模型和反射破缺扶手椅纳米带中验证了这一机制。
authors: Geonwoo Hwang, Jun-Won Rhim

articles.title: Decoder- and Noise-Aware Optimization Framework for Clifford-Deformed Quantum Error-Correcting Codes
articles.title_zh: 面向解码器和噪声的Clifford形变量子纠错码优化框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13589v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Practical fault-tolerant quantum computing requires qubit-efficient quantum error correction (QEC). Clifford deformations (CDs) modify the stabilizers of a QEC code to lower its logical error rate at no additional resource cost. However, the number of possible CDs grows exponentially with the number of qubits, making exhaustive search infeasible beyond small codes. In this work, we further show that under circuit level noise the optimal CD depends strongly on both the noise model and decoder. To make systematic CD optimization possible, we introduce Evolution-Based Best-arm Identification (EBBI), a shot-efficient search algorithm that treats the circuit, noise model and decoder as a black box. We benchmark EBBI's performance on the rotated surface code, under two strongly Z-biased circuit-level noise models with the PyMatching decoder. At distance 3, EBBI finds the optimal CD using up to sim 1100× fewer shots than random search. At distance 5, when run at the target error rate, the median EBBI run converges to the CDs we believe to be optimal, while random search never converges. Under a Z-biased SI1000-like noise model, EBBI discovers a new CD, the B-XZZX code, which we generalized to larger distances. It differs from XZZX on only a fraction O(d⁻¹) of the qubits at code distance d, yet its relative advantage grows from approx 5% at d = 3 to approx 12% at d = 11. We thus show that the B-XZZX pattern found by EBBI can be systematically scaled to larger code distances. Our work represents a first step towards scalable CD optimization for general QEC codes.
articles.abstract_zh: 实用容错量子计算需要高量子比特效率的量子纠错（QEC）。Clifford形变（CDs）可以修改QEC码的稳定子以降低逻辑错误率，且不增加额外资源。本文提出了一种基于进化的最佳臂识别（EBBI）算法，用于系统地优化CDs，该算法将电路、噪声模型和解码器视为黑盒。在旋转表面码上的基准测试表明，EBBI在寻找最优CD方面比随机搜索效率高得多，并且在复杂噪声模型下能够收敛到最优CD。
authors: Julius Rye Bønnelykke, Benjamin Joecker, Peter Krogstrup, Vincent Philippe Michal, Mark Kamper Svendsen

articles.title: Entanglement Catalysis Beyond the Asymptotic Rate
articles.title_zh: 超越渐近速率的纠缠催化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13602v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum entanglement is a fundamental resource in quantum information science, commonly consumed to perform tasks like quantum teleportation and quantum key distribution. Entanglement concentration converts partially entangled pure states into nearly perfect Bell pairs. While its efficiency is well understood in the asymptotic limit, practical protocols must operate with finite systems. In this finite regime, and at the low error levels relevant in practice, performance is penalized by corrections that reduce the achievable yield. We investigate whether this fundamental finite-size penalty can be mitigated by an entanglement catalyst: an auxiliary state that aids the transformation but is returned exactly and uncorrupted. Although such a catalyst cannot increase the leading-order asymptotic yield, we show that it fundamentally alters the finite-size scaling. For every bipartite pure state with nonuniform Schmidt coefficients, we exactly determine the optimal second-order correction to the yield and show that catalysis completely overcomes this finite-size penalty.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子纠缠是量子信息科学中的基本资源。本文研究了在有限系统下，纠缠催化剂是否能缓解纠缠浓缩协议中的有限尺寸惩罚。研究表明，纠缠催化剂虽然不能增加领先阶的渐近产率，但能从根本上改变有限尺寸标度，并完全克服了非均匀施密特系数双分量纯态的有限尺寸惩罚。
authors: Alexander Streltsov

articles.title: Judd-Ofelt analysis and coherent spectroscopy of europium-based molecular complexes for quantum information applications
articles.title_zh: 用于量子信息应用的铕基分子配合物的Judd-Ofelt分析和相干光谱学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13664v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rare-earth-ion based molecular crystals are emerging as a promising platform for quantum information applications, combining long optical coherence times with the chemical tunability of coordination chemistry. Here we present a comprehensive optical characterisation of twelve Eu³⁺-based molecular complexes, with a focus on the coherent ⁵D₀ łongrightarrow  ⁷F₀ transition at sim580 nm. Judd-Ofelt analyses are performed across all complexes, providing insights into ligand-field environments, local point-group symmetries, and the resulting branching ratios of the coherent transition. We find that lower point-group symmetry (C₁, C₂₎ yields higher branching ratios of the ⁵D₀ łongrightarrow  ⁷F₀ transition, exceeding 1% in several complexes. Optical inhomogeneous linewidths measured at 4.2 K reveal narrow linewidths for some complexes of below ten GHz, indicative of a highly ordered crystalline environment. Optical coherence measurements of one of the complexes, 5-Eu, yields an optical coherence time of T₂opt = 2.3~μs at 4.2 K, comparable to the best-performing molecular systems reported to date. Systematic characterisation and quantitative comparison will be key to find structure-property relations guiding rational design of optimised complexes for quantum information applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 稀土离子分子晶体是量子信息应用的有前景平台。本文对十二种Eu³⁺基分子配合物进行了全面的光学表征，重点关注580 nm处的相干⁵D₀ → ⁷F₀跃迁。Judd-Ofelt分析揭示了配体场环境和点群对称性对跃迁分支比的影响，研究还测量了窄的非均匀线宽和2.3 μs的光学相干时间，表明这些材料在量子信息领域具有潜力。
authors: Nicholas Lester Jobbitt, Sascha Weis, Timo Schweizer, Vishnu Unni Chorakkunnath, Evgenij Vasilenko, Tobias Haas, Barbora Brachnakova, Senthil Kumar Kuppusamy, Hartmut Schubert, Mario Ruben, Michael Seitz, David Hunger

articles.title: Dynamical Lie Algebras for Fixed-Gate Quantum Ansätze
articles.title_zh: 固定门量子Ansätze的动力学李代数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13709v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Parameterized Quantum Circuits have emerged as a central framework for variational quantum algorithms in the NISQ regime, with major applications in quantum simulation, combinatorial optimization, and, more recently, quantum machine learning (QML). By developing a new approach for computing dynamical Lie algebras associated with quantum circuits combining parametrized gates and non-parametrized entangling gates, we aim to extend the applicability of recent algebraic results to architectures that are actually used in quantum machine learning.
articles.abstract_zh: 参数化量子电路已成为NISQ时代变分量子算法的核心框架，广泛应用于量子模拟、组合优化和量子机器学习。本文提出了一种计算结合参数化门和非参数化纠缠门的量子电路相关动力学李代数的新方法。该方法旨在将最新的代数结果应用于量子机器学习中实际使用的架构，从而扩展其适用性。
authors: Orlane Zang, Daniel Juteau, Tony Quertier, Grégoire Barrué

articles.title: Locality-Preparation Time Tradeoffs in Dissipative Quantum Systems
articles.title_zh: 耗散量子系统中的局域性-制备时间权衡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13784v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dissipative state preparation engineers quantum many-body states as steady states of an open-system dynamics. The spatial range of the required dissipation sets both the feasibility of analog implementations and the connectivity and control complexity of digital ones. Yet how this locality quantitatively constrains preparation times remains largely unknown. Here, we establish an exact locality-preparation time relation for quadratic fermionic systems and develop a construction that optimizes the locality of the dissipative dynamics while preserving the target state. Applied to the Kitaev chain, our framework reveals sharply different locality-preparation time tradeoffs in critical and gapped regimes. At criticality, suppressing the algebraic tails of the jump operators necessarily forces the preparation time to grow algebraically with system size. By contrast, both trivial and topological gapped phases admit exponentially localized dissipation with a finite preparation time in the thermodynamic limit. Our results identify when fast dissipative preparation is compatible with local control and when criticality imposes an unavoidable dynamical cost.
articles.abstract_zh: 耗散态制备将量子多体态作为开放系统动力学的稳态。本文为二次费米子系统建立了精确的局域性-制备时间关系，并开发了一种优化耗散动力学局域性同时保持目标态的方法。应用于Kitaev链时，该框架揭示了临界和带隙区域中截然不同的权衡，识别了快速耗散制备何时与局部控制兼容，以及临界性何时施加不可避免的动力学限制。
authors: Philipp Westhoff, Sara Murciano, Mattia Moroder

articles.title: Enhanced analogue quantum computation with a logically-encoded XX gadget
articles.title_zh: 利用逻辑编码的XX小工具增强模拟量子计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13845v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The introduction of two-body XX interactions has been shown to improve the performance of quantum annealing in solving certain combinatorial optimisation problems and would enable the simulation of a broader class of many-body Hamiltonians. Due to experimental constraints, such interactions are typically not natively available on analogue quantum devices. To overcome this limitation we introduce the truss gadget. This is an exact construction that generates two-body XX interactions using only one-body X and Z fields and two-body ZZ interactions which are readily accessible on, for instance, superconducting quantum annealers. We experimentally validate the construction by reproducing the dynamics of a target XX Hamiltonian on a trapped-ion quantum processor. We then apply the gadget to an illustrative set of instances of the weighted maximum-independent-set problem on a superconducting quantum annealer. We empirically determine an approximate thousand-fold improvement in the probability of finding a state close to the ground state for these instances, over implementation without an XX interaction.
articles.abstract_zh: 双体XX相互作用能提高量子退火性能，但通常在模拟量子设备上不可用。本文引入了“桁架小工具”，这是一种精确构造，仅使用单体X、Z场和双体ZZ相互作用来生成双体XX相互作用。研究在离子阱处理器上验证了该构造，并在超导量子退火器上将其应用于加权最大独立集问题，实现了寻找接近基态的概率约千倍的提升。
authors: Robert J. Banks, Natasha Feinstein, Roopayan Ghosh, Sebastian Schulz, Kristel Michielsen, Sougato Bose, P. A. Warburton

articles.title: Evolution and breakdown of chiral anomaly in Weyl semiconductor tellurium
articles.title_zh: 魏尔半导体碲中手性反常的演化与破裂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13084v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Chiral anomaly in topological materials manifests as negative longitudinal magnetoresistance, yet the tunability and evolution of this effect remain elusive. Here we show that doped tellurium serves as a versatile platform to realize a giant negative longitudinal magnetoresistance that is highly tunable via the Fermi level and magnetic field. By moving the Fermi level towards the Weyl point, we observe a pronounced enhancement of negative magnetoresistance, which arises from chiral anomaly and robustly persists up to ambient temperature. Beyond the quantum limit, the system exhibits positive linear magnetoconductance, serving as a compelling transport signature of the chiral anomaly in the lowest Landau level. Notably, in the extreme quantum limit at cryogenic temperatures, the magnetoresistance undergoes a dramatic reversal from negative to positive. This reversal points to a potential field-induced phase transition into a collective electronic state driven by enhanced electron-electron interactions. Our findings provide valuable insights into the unconventional chiral transport and emergent correlated quantum states under extreme magnetic fields.
articles.abstract_zh: 拓扑材料中的手性反常表现为负纵向磁阻，但其可调谐性和演化机制尚不明确。本文发现掺杂碲是一种实现巨负纵向磁阻的多功能平台，该磁阻可通过费米能级和磁场高度调谐。研究观察到，在极端量子极限下，磁阻从负转正，这可能预示着场致相变进入集体电子态，为极端条件下的非常规手性输运和关联量子态提供了重要见解。
authors: Zhifeng Xue, Jiaji Zhao, Yi Ji, Fuyang Chen, Nannan Tang, Gangjian Jin, Bing Shen, Bin Wang, Yang Wang, Mingxi Chi, Jin-Zhu Zhao, Ruiqiang Wang, Qizhong Zhu, He Wang, Huakun Zuo, Donghui Guo, Dingyong Zhong, Mingxun Deng, Huichao Wang

articles.title: Theory of exciton-exciton interactions in crystalline systems
articles.title_zh: 晶体系统中激子-激子相互作用理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13246v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Excitons are bound electron-hole pairs in semiconductors whose interactions influence optical properties and determine their collective behavior and emergent correlated phases. Despite the theoretical and experimental significance of these phenomena, a microscopic theory of exciton-exciton interactions that takes into account the full composite nature of these quasiparticles is lacking. Here, we present a general theory of exciton-exciton interactions that builds upon our previous publication [Physical Review B 113, 155440 (2026)], which applied only to conventional semiconductors with weak band hybridization. By contrast, the theory presented here is valid in virtually any crystalline semiconducting system and can be applied to the study of biexciton formation and correlated excitonic phases in systems where band topology, quantum geometry, and moiré effects play a significant role. In addition to the analytical theory, we also present results in simple systems with flat bands with a nontrivial quantum metric and show that the biexcitonic spectrum differs strongly from that in the case without quantum geometry. Our theory paves the way for accurate quantitative calculations of biexciton spectra and excitonic many-body phases in modern condensed-matter systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 激子是半导体中的束缚电子-空穴对，其相互作用影响光学性质和集体行为。本文提出了一种普适的激子-激子相互作用理论，该理论适用于几乎所有晶体半导体系统，并考虑了激子的复合性质。该理论可应用于研究带拓扑、量子几何和莫尔效应显著的系统中的双激子形成和关联激子相，并展示了在具有非平凡量子度规的平带系统中，双激子谱与无量子几何情况下的显著差异。
authors: L. Maisel Licerán, H. T. C. Stoof

articles.title: Exponential entanglement advantage in sensing correlated noise
articles.title_zh: 感测关联噪声中的指数级纠缠优势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2410.05878v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Correlated noise naturally arises in quantum systems due to, e.g., phase and amplitude fluctuations in global control or long-range correlations generated by a many-body sensing target near criticality. In this Letter, we propose a new form of exponential quantum advantage in the context of sensing correlated noise. Specifically, we focus on the problem of estimating parameters associated with Lindblad dephasing dynamics, and show that entanglement enhancement in the sensitivity (as quantified via quantum Fisher information of the sensor state) arises for estimating the strength of fluctuations in the noise fields' center-of-mass mode. In the presence of strong background fluctuations, such enhancement grows exponentially with the number of probes in the shot-limited regime, when the measurement and reset operations are slow. This result stands in stark contrast with previously studied scenarios of sensing uncorrelated dephasing noise, where one can prove that entanglement does not lead to an advantage in the signal-to-noise ratio. Our work thus opens a novel pathway towards achieving entanglement-based sensing advantage, which may find applications in characterizing decoherence dynamics of near-term quantum devices. Further, our approach provides a potential quantum-enhanced probe of many-body correlated phases by measuring noise generated by a sensing target. We also discuss realization of our protocol using near-term quantum hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 关联噪声在量子系统中普遍存在。本文提出了一种在感测关联噪声背景下实现指数级量子优势的新形式。研究表明，在估计噪声场质心模式的波动强度时，纠缠可以指数级增强传感器的灵敏度。这一结果与先前研究的非关联退相干噪声场景形成鲜明对比，为实现基于纠缠的传感优势开辟了新途径。
authors: Yu-Xin Wang, Jacob Bringewatt, Alireza Seif, Anthony J. Brady, Changhun Oh, Alexey V. Gorshkov

articles.title: Superconducting-antiqubit simulation enables optimal phase estimation via unitary inversion
articles.title_zh: 超导反量子比特模拟通过酉反演实现最优相位估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.04315v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A positron is equivalent to an electron traveling backward through time. Casting transmon superconducting qubits as akin to electrons, we simulate a positron with a transmon subject to particular resonant and off-resonant drives. We call positron-like transmons "antiqubits." An antiqubit's effective gyromagnetic ratio equals the negative of a qubit's. This fact enables us to time-invert a unitary implemented on a transmon by its environment. We apply this platform-specific unitary inversion, with qubit--antiqubit entanglement, to achieve a quantum advantage in phase estimation: consider measuring the strength of a field that points in an unknown direction. An entangled qubit--antiqubit sensor offers the greatest possible sensitivity (amount of Fisher information), per qubit, per application of the field. We prove this result theoretically and observe it experimentally. This work shows how antimatter, whether real or simulated, can enable platform-specific unitary inversion and benefit quantum information processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过对超导transmon量子比特施加特定驱动，模拟了“反量子比特”，其有效旋磁比与量子比特相反。这种平台特有的酉反演能力，结合量子比特-反量子比特纠缠，实现了相位估计的量子优势。研究理论证明并实验观察到，纠缠的量子比特-反量子比特传感器在未知方向场强测量中提供了最高的灵敏度，展示了反物质在量子信息处理中的潜力。
authors: Xingrui Song, Surihan Sean Borjigin, Flavio Salvati, Yu-Xin Wang, Nicole Yunger Halpern, David R. M. Arvidsson-Shukur, Kater Murch

articles.title: High-throughput bidirectional electro-optic transduction assessed with a practical quantum capacity
articles.title_zh: 基于实用量子容量评估的高通量双向电光转换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.09873v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A microwave-optical transducer of sufficiently low noise and high signal transfer rate would allow entanglement to be distributed between superconducting quantum processors reliably within the lifetimes of their quantum memories. We report the continuous operation of an efficient transducer at high enough bandwidth to realize kHz signal transfer rates, in downconversion as well as upconversion, with noise levels approaching that required for quantum information transfer. To define the significance of our advance and clarify the multifaceted performance required for quantum networking tasks, we derive a broadband quantum channel capacity that bounds the maximum rate at which quantum information can be sent through realistic finite-bandwidth thermal-loss channels. This capacity serves as a comprehensive measure of transducer capability and provides insight into the relative importance of disparate performance metrics. We find that the broadband capacity depends on the throughput---defined as the product of efficiency, bandwidth, and duty cycle---and on the added noise. We present measurements of a membrane-based opto-electromechanical transducer with high throughput of 7 kHz and at an input-referred added noise of 3 photons in both upconversion and downconversion, demonstrating that bidirectional transducer capacities comparable to superconducting qubit decay rates are within reach. In downconversion, throughput of this magnitude at the few-photon noise level is unprecedented, marking an improvement of nearly four orders of magnitude over previous work.
articles.abstract_zh: 微波-光学换能器对于在超导量子处理器之间可靠分发纠缠至关重要。本文报告了一种高效换能器的连续运行，实现了kHz信号传输速率和接近量子信息传输所需的噪声水平。为评估其性能，研究推导了宽带量子信道容量，该容量综合衡量了换能器能力，并揭示了吞吐量（效率、带宽和占空比的乘积）和附加噪声对其的影响。
authors: M. D. Urmey, S. Dickson, K. Adachi, S. Mittal, L. G. Talamo, A. Kyle, N. E. Frattini, S. -X. Lin, K. W. Lehnert, C. A. Regal

articles.title: Finite-Size Effects in Quantum Metrology at Strong Coupling: Microscopic vs Phenomenological Approaches
articles.title_zh: 强耦合下量子计量学的有限尺寸效应：微观与唯象方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.19994v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Equilibrium quantum metrology is often formulated under assumptions of weak system-bath coupling and thermodynamic limit scaling, which may not be valid for realistic finite-size (FS) quantum devices. Here, we establish how strong coupling (SC) and FS effects jointly modify achievable precision bounds for equilibrium quantum probes. Considering a transverse-field anisotropic XY spin chain coupled to a thermal environment, first utilize we derive a full polaron transform to derive the effective Hamiltonian at equilibrium. Then, using the bare Hamiltonian and the obtained effective Hamiltonian and taking into account the role of FS effects in the calculation of partition function, we derive an analytic expressions for the quantum Fisher information (QFI) for a general parameter for the equilibrium state in weak coupling (WC) and SC regimes, respectively. In contrast to this microscopic approach, we also utilize the Hill's phenomenological nanothermodynamics to calculate an effective QFI expression at SC. Our results, presented for specific cases of magnetometry and thermometry, reveal that considering FS and SC effects lead to substantial and systematic deviations in QFI, even for moderate system sizes, and that commonly used thermodynamic-limit approximations can significantly misestimate precision. This work also highlights the inadequacy of phenomenological approaches in describing the metrological capability and thermodynamic behavior of systems at SC. Our work establishes a consistent framework for evaluating metrological performance of realistic, finite quantum devices operating beyond the weak-coupling paradigm.
articles.abstract_zh: 平衡量子计量学常假设弱系统-浴耦合和热力学极限，这不适用于有限尺寸量子器件。本文研究了强耦合和有限尺寸效应对平衡量子探针可实现精度界限的共同影响。研究通过微观方法推导了横场各向异性XY自旋链在弱耦合和强耦合下的量子费舍尔信息解析表达式，并与Hill的唯象纳米热力学方法进行了对比，结果表明考虑有限尺寸和强耦合效应会导致显著的修正。
authors: Ali Pedram, Özgür E. Müstecaplioğlu

articles.title: Noise Thresholds for Quantum Advantage in the Bernstein-Vazirani and Deutsch-Jozsa Algorithms
articles.title_zh: Bernstein-Vazirani和Deutsch-Jozsa算法中量子优势的噪声阈值
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.01884v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We analytically investigate the robustness of the Bernstein-Vazirani and Deutsch-Jozsa algorithms against single-qubit Pauli noise, of which bit-flip, phase-flip, and depolarizing noise are special cases, using the density-matrix formalism. For a general Pauli channel acting on each qubit after every gate, we derive exact closed-form expressions for the success probability of a single run as a function of the error probabilities and the number of qubits n, and validate them against Qiskit simulations. The noise enters only through the probability ǎrepsilon with which each output bit is flipped. Under bit-flip noise with error probability p > 1/2 the most probable outcome of the Bernstein-Vazirani algorithm is the complement of the correct one, which classical post-processing corrects, whereas depolarizing and phase-flip noise never bias the output toward a wrong outcome. For the Deutsch-Jozsa algorithm, the success probability is the average over constant and balanced oracles, and the results are given for the single-variable balanced oracle, which is shown to be the least robust of all balanced oracles for ǎrepsilon < 1/2. For a single run, the tolerable error probability of both algorithms decreases as 1/n. We then determine the minimum number of repetitions required for a given confidence and compare it with the number of queries of the classical algorithms. The threshold error probability below which the noisy Bernstein-Vazirani algorithm retains its query advantage increases with n, whereas that of the Deutsch-Jozsa algorithm with its standard readout decreases as 1/n. This contrast indicates that algorithms whose answer is encoded in many independently decodable output bits are considerably more robust to noise than algorithms whose verdict depends on a single global outcome.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用密度矩阵形式，分析研究了Bernstein-Vazirani和Deutsch-Jozsa算法对单量子比特泡利噪声的鲁棒性。研究推导了单次运行成功概率的精确闭式表达式，并与Qiskit模拟进行了验证。结果表明，对于Bernstein-Vazirani算法，位翻转噪声可能导致最可能结果为正确结果的补码，而对于Deutsch-Jozsa算法，单变量平衡预言机在特定条件下显示出最低的鲁棒性。
authors: Muhammad Faizan, Muhammad Faryad

articles.title: Entanglement thresholds for sequential nonlocality sharing in star networks
articles.title_zh: 星形网络中序列非局域性共享的纠缠阈值
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.13357v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum networks promise scalable distributed quantum information processing. Realizing this potential depends critically on the efficient use of nonclassical resources. Sequential sharing of quantum nonlocality provides a resource-efficient route for recycling entanglement across multiple observers. In network settings, however, such recycling is typically constrained by a trade-off between the number of active branches and the achievable sharing depth. Here we investigate this problem in star networks using probabilistic projective measurements. We establish an explicit entanglement threshold above which nonlocality can be shared across all branches up to any target depth, and below which we determine the optimal trade-off between the number of active branches and the achievable number of sequential rounds. We further analyze the protocol's robustness to noise and its experimental observability, clarifying its practical feasibility. These results establish quantitative design principles and entanglement requirements for scalable nonlocality recycling in quantum networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子网络中非经典资源的有效利用对可扩展分布式量子信息处理至关重要。本文研究了星形网络中序列非局域性共享的纠缠阈值问题，该共享允许在多个观察者之间循环利用纠缠。研究建立了明确的纠缠阈值，并分析了协议对噪声的鲁棒性和实验可观测性。这些结果为量子网络中可扩展非局域性循环利用提供了定量设计原则和纠缠要求。
authors: Ming-Xiao Li, Yuqi Li, Rui-Bin Xu, Mo-Ran Zhu, Haitao Ma, Chang-Yue Zhang, Zhu-Jun Zheng

articles.title: Optimizing Entanglement Distribution Protocols: Maximizing Classical Information in Quantum Networks
articles.title_zh: 优化纠缠分发协议：最大化量子网络中的经典信息
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.25360v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large-scale quantum networks depend on the efficient distribution of entangled pairs between distant nodes. However, state-of-the-art solutions rely on restrictive operational assumptions, incur prohibitive computational complexity, and optimize metrics misaligned with application needs. This paper addresses the entanglement distribution problem introducing four pivotal advances. First, since the primary application of quantum communication is private information transmission, we derive the Ensemble Capacity, a novel metric that quantifies the private classical information enabled by entanglement distribution. Second, we propose a generalized formulation of the Entanglement Distribution Problem that allows arbitrary sequencing of entanglement swapping and purification, removing the structural restrictions of prior models. Third, to navigate the resulting combinatorial space, we introduce a dynamic programming-based hypergraph generation algorithm that preserves exact, continuous fidelities, avoiding quantization, while pruning sub-optimal sequences in advance. Finally, we integrate these solutions into CODE, a two-tier orchestration framework enabling near-real-time network operation. Extensive evaluations show that our approach achieves higher private information capacity and significantly lower computational complexity than existing solutions, while meeting the sub-second latency requirements of dynamic quantum network operation.
articles.abstract_zh: 大规模量子网络依赖于高效的纠缠对分发，但现有解决方案存在局限性。本文提出了四项关键进展来解决纠缠分发问题，包括引入新的度量“集成容量”以量化私有经典信息。研究还提出了广义的纠缠分发问题公式，并引入了基于动态规划的超图生成算法，最终将这些解决方案整合到一个名为CODE的两层编排框架中。
authors: Ethan Sanchez Hidalgo, Diego Zafra Bono, Guillermo Encinas Lago, J. Xavier Salvat Lozano, Jose A. Ayala-Romero, Xavier Costa Perez

articles.title: Multi-flux Aharonov-Bohm caging with tunable couplings
articles.title_zh: 具有可调耦合的多通量阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆囚禁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.23546v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Aharonov-Bohm (AB) caging is the complete wavefunction localization effect in translational-invariant lattices induced by destructive phase interference. These phases originate from the gauge fields such as the penetrated magnetic fields, which are directly related to several novel topological quantum states of matter. Recently, this effect has shown significant potential for applications in quantum simulation and topological quantum computation. Here, we propose a scalable protocol to derive universal conditions for AB caging with multi-flux. The numerical simulations validate the theoretical predictions by directly observing AB caging phenomena. We also investigate the breakage of the caging effect with onsite detuning, decoherence and non-Hermitian transitions. Our protocol provides an alternative approach for advancing quantum simulation of exotic states of matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆（AB）囚禁是一种由破坏性相位干涉引起的波函数局域化效应，在量子模拟和拓扑量子计算中具有潜力。本文提出了一种可扩展的协议，用于推导多通量AB囚禁的普适条件，并通过数值模拟直接观察到该现象。研究还探讨了囚禁效应在存在局域失谐、退相干和非厄米跃迁时的破坏，为推进奇异物质态的量子模拟提供了一种新方法。
authors: Le-Chuan Wang, Sai Li, Jia Liu, Zheng-Yuan Xue

articles.title: Lie Algebra-Based Quantum Optimal Controls Interpolation
articles.title_zh: 基于李代数的量子最优控制插值
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.02014v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a framework combining Lie group theory and feed-forward neural networks to efficiently generate quantum optimal control pulses for arbitrary unitary operations in superconducting qubit systems, bypassing the need for explicit optimization at inference time. The exponential scaling of the Hilbert space dimension with qubit number makes standard optimization approaches computationally prohibitive when large ensembles of distinct propagators must be processed, a bottleneck that is particularly acute in Trotterized quantum simulation. Our method addresses this limitation by pre-computing a representative set of control pulses via Lie group theory and training neural networks to map target propagators to their corresponding pulses. We demonstrate the approach on superconducting qubit systems of 2, 3, and 4 qubits, finding high reconstruction fidelity for specific combinations of Lie algebra parameters. As a physically motivated benchmark, we apply the methodology to reconstruct control pulses for the Trotter propagators of a neutrino system undergoing collective flavor oscillations. The successful generalization across system types demonstrates that a single model -- trained once on hardware-specific random propagators -- can serve as a universal control-pulse generator for any target quantum system of compatible Hilbert space dimension, offering a promising route toward scalable quantum simulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个结合李群理论和前馈神经网络的框架，旨在高效生成超导量子比特系统中任意酉操作的量子最优控制脉冲，避免了推理时的显式优化。该方法通过预计算一组代表性控制脉冲并训练神经网络来映射目标传播子。研究在2、3和4量子比特超导系统上进行了演示，并将其应用于中微子系统Trotter传播子的控制脉冲重建，展现了良好的泛化能力。
authors: Piero Luchi, Francesco Pederiva

articles.title: DC Conductance of X-shaped Majorana Interferometer reveals Non-Abelian Anyon Statistics
articles.title_zh: X形马约拉纳干涉仪的直流电导揭示非阿贝尔任意子统计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.24171v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose a four-terminal, X-shaped chiral Majorana interferometer with a central floating superconducting island, enabling the direct detection of the non-Abelian statistics of Ising anyons via the linear-response DC conductance tensor in charge transport experiments. Here, Ising anyons are realizable as edge vortices nucleated at Josephson line junctions defining the superconducting island, where both edge-vortex and Majorana-fermion tunneling processes can occur. We show that in such a multi-terminal Majorana interferometer, both the vacuum and the fermionic fusion channel for Ising anyons are possible. This is in contrast to two-arm interferometers, where only the vacuum fusion channel is accessible and the DC conductance contribution from edge vortices always vanishes. Using a low-energy effective theory derived via chiral bosonization, we find that in the X-shaped interferometer, the DC conductance tensor is completely isotropic, yielding a non-zero conductance when simultaneous edge-vortex and Majorana tunneling activates the fermionic fusion channel. Apart from conductance oscillations in a gate-tunable charge parameter, which display an offset related to the anyon topological spin, measuring a finite conductance can already provide direct evidence for non-Abelian statistics in this geometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种四端X形手性马约拉纳干涉仪，能够通过线性响应直流电导张量直接检测Ising任意子的非阿贝尔统计。研究表明，在这种多端马约拉纳干涉仪中，Ising任意子的真空和费米子融合通道都是可能的。通过手性玻色化导出的低能有效理论，发现直流电导张量完全各向同性，并在同时发生边缘涡旋和马约拉纳隧穿时产生非零电导。
authors: Domenico Giuliano, Andrea Nava, Reinhold Egger, Fabian Hassler

articles.title: Reinforcement Learning to Harness Approximation Errors for Long-Time Quantum Simulation
articles.title_zh: 利用强化学习驾驭近似误差实现长时间量子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20139v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Accurate digital quantum simulation at long times is limited by the accumulation of errors inherent to approximate simulation. Here we introduce RL-Trotter, a reinforcement-learning framework that treats unavoidable approximation errors as resources for error correction rather than merely imperfections to suppress. We show that low-dimensional information from conservation laws, such as the energy and energy variance, provides a sufficient learning signal to guide the agent, which learns to adapt a single scalar---the next Trotter step size---without access to the target wave function. By optimizing the entire long-time evolution rather than individual steps, RL-Trotter discovers self-correcting sequences in which later errors compensate for those accumulated earlier, increasing the accuracy of the long-time dynamics. The learned policies are intrinsically robust to measurement noise, substantially reducing measurement overhead. They also generalize to previously unseen, physically similar initial states and transfer from small, classically simulable systems to systems an order of magnitude larger. This enables a practical protocol based on classical pretraining followed by direct deployment or limited fine-tuning on quantum hardware. Our results establish a broader perspective for quantum algorithms: errors in approximate evolution can be orchestrated into resources for accurate and resource-efficient quantum dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 准确的长时间数字量子模拟受限于近似模拟固有的误差累积。本文引入了RL-Trotter，一个将不可避免的近似误差视为误差校正资源的强化学习框架。该框架通过优化整个长时间演化，发现自校正序列，从而提高长时间动力学的准确性。学习到的策略对测量噪声具有内在鲁棒性，并能泛化到未见过的物理相似初始态，为实用协议提供了可能。
authors: Yu-Bo Shi, Markus Heyl, Roderich Moessner, Marin Bukov, Hongzheng Zhao

articles.title: Efficient Quantum Simulation of Linearized Vlasov--Poisson Dynamics Using Trotter and THRIFT Hamiltonian Simulation Methods
articles.title_zh: 使用Trotter和THRIFT哈密顿量模拟方法高效量子模拟线性化Vlasov-Poisson动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23127v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Vlasov--Poisson system provides the fundamental kinetic description of plasma and plays a central role in understanding collective phenomena such as Landau damping and wave--particle interactions. Efficient numerical simulation of these dynamics remains challenging because of the high dimensionality of phase space. In this work, we studied magnetized and non-magnetized plasma using a quantum simulation framework for the linearized Vlasov-Poisson equation by reformulating the discretized system as a Hermitian Hamiltonian suitable for gate-based quantum computation. The time evolution is implemented using first, second and fourth-order Trotter--Suzuki product formulas and the recently proposed Time-Resolved Interaction Framework (THRIFT). The performance of the different simulation methods is systematically evaluated through electric field evolution, state fidelity, convergence behavior, energy conservation, entanglement entropy and quantum resource requirements, including circuit depth and two-qubit gate complexity, for both magnetized and non-magnetized plasma models. To further reduce finite time step errors without increasing circuit depth, Richardson extrapolation is incorporated as a error-mitigation technique. The results provide a comprehensive comparison of Trotter and THRIFT approaches and establish practical guidelines for accurate and resource-efficient quantum simulation of plasma dynamics on gate-based quantum computers.
articles.abstract_zh: Vlasov-Poisson系统是等离子体动力学的基本描述，其高效数值模拟因相空间高维性而具挑战。本文利用量子模拟框架研究了线性化Vlasov-Poisson方程的磁化和非磁化等离子体。时间演化通过Trotter-Suzuki乘积公式和THRIFT方法实现，并系统评估了不同模拟方法的性能。研究旨在减少有限时间步长误差，为等离子体物理的量子模拟提供了深入见解。
authors: Kartick Paul, Rahul V, S. Aravinda, Reetesh K. Gangwar

articles.title: Anomalies of global symmetries on the lattice
articles.title_zh: 格点上全局对称性的反常
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.21209v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: 't Hooft anomalies of global symmetries play a fundamental role in quantum many-body systems and quantum field theory (QFT). In this paper, we make a systematic analysis of lattice anomalies - the analog of 't Hooft anomalies in lattice systems - for which we give a precise definition. Crucially, a lattice anomaly is not a feature of a specific Hamiltonian, but rather is a topological invariant of the symmetry action. The controlled setting of lattice systems allows for a systematic and rigorous treatment of lattice anomalies, shorn of the technical challenges of QFT. We find that lattice anomalies reproduce the expected properties of QFT anomalies in many ways, but also have crucial differences. In particular, lattice anomalies and QFT anomalies are not, contrary to a common expectation, in one-to-one correspondence, and there can be nontrivial anomalies on the lattice that are infrared (IR) trivial: They admit symmetric trivial gapped ground states, and map to trivial QFT anomalies at low energies. Nevertheless, we show that lattice anomalies (including IR-trivial ones) have a number of interesting consequences in their own right, including connections to commuting projector models, phases of many-body localized (MBL) systems, and quantum cellular automata (QCA). We make substantial progress on the classification of lattice anomalies and develop several theoretical tools to characterize their consequences on symmetric Hamiltonians. Our work places symmetries of quantum many-body lattice systems into a unified theoretical framework and may also suggest new perspectives on symmetries in QFT.
articles.abstract_zh: 全局对称性的't Hooft反常在量子多体系统和量子场论中扮演着重要角色。本文对格点反常进行了系统分析，并给出了精确定义。研究发现格点反常在许多方面再现了量子场论反常的预期性质，但也存在关键差异，例如存在红外平凡的非平凡格点反常。尽管如此，格点反常仍具有许多有趣的后果。
authors: Yi-Ting Tu, David M. Long, Dominic V. Else

articles.title: Search for free non-Abelian anyons in paired composite-fermion states
articles.title_zh: 在配对复合费米子态中寻找自由非阿贝尔任意子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12645v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The even-denominator fractional quantum Hall (FQH) states, understood as topological superconductors of composite fermions, are predicted to support elementary quasiparticles (QPs) or quasiholes (QHs) obeying non-Abelian braid statistics. Using the microscopic framework of parton theory, we investigate many experimentally observed paired composite-fermion states and find that their elementary QPs and QHs in general bind to form Abelian molecules, thus obscuring non-Abelian braid statistics. An exception is the ν=1/2 state in wide quantum wells, where our calculations show free QPs or QHs; we thus identify this state as an especially promising candidate for realizing and studying non-Abelian braid statistics. We also indicate how the study of such bound states can help reveal the topological structure of the state.
articles.abstract_zh: 偶数分母分数量子霍尔（FQH）态被预测支持服从非阿贝尔编织统计的基本准粒子或准空穴。本文利用部分子理论的微观框架，研究了许多实验观察到的配对复合费米子态。研究发现，这些态中的基本准粒子和准空穴通常结合形成阿贝尔分子，从而掩盖了非阿贝尔编织统计。然而，ν=1/2态在宽量子阱中是一个例外，其自由准粒子或准空穴使其成为实现和研究非阿贝尔编织统计的理想候选。
authors: Mytraya Gattu, J. K. Jain

articles.title: Nonlocal Josephson coupling and current redistribution in a large-area graphene multiterminal Josephson junction
articles.title_zh: 大面积石墨烯多端约瑟夫森结中的非局域约瑟夫森耦合和电流再分配
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12753v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multiterminal Josephson junctions (MTJJs) extend conventional two-terminal Josephson physics to devices defined by multiple superconducting phases, where rich phenomena have been predicted. However, in conventional MTJJs, superconducting transport is often dominated by local coupling between neighboring leads, obscuring physics that goes beyond simple connectivity. Here, we realize a multiterminal Josephson network in a graphene Hall bar geometry with micron-scale dimensions, enabling substantial nonlocal coupling between distant terminals. Our key observation is a pronounced negative differential longitudinal resistance (NDLR) in the four-probe response near switching currents, while no such feature appears in two-terminal measurements. We reproduce the NDLR response with a network containing the interplay between two distinct forms of nonlocality: nonlocal Josephson coupling, which determines the switching sequence of the superconducting network, and nonlocal normal-state conductance, which redistributes current after different regions switch. Our results highlight the potential of the emergent NDLR for characterizing superconductor--semiconductor hybrid systems and for nonlinear circuits. Further, this Josephson Hall bar geometry provides a platform for exploring the interplay between mesoscopic superconductivity and many-body ground states in graphene-based heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 多端约瑟夫森结（MTJJ）将传统约瑟夫森物理扩展到由多个超导相定义的器件，预测了丰富的现象。本文在微米级石墨烯霍尔棒几何结构中实现了多端约瑟夫森网络，实现了远端终端之间显著的非局域耦合。研究观察到在开关电流附近四探针响应中出现明显的负微分纵向电阻（NDLR），并用包含非局域约瑟夫森耦合和非局域常态电导相互作用的网络重现了NDLR响应，突出了NDLR在表征超导网络中的潜力。
authors: Luojia Zhang, Kushagra Aggarwal, Jay D. Sau, Ethan G. Arnault, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Valla Fatemi

articles.title: Real-Time Relaxation Dynamics of Dark Excitons in Mirror-Symmetric Monolayers
articles.title_zh: 镜像对称单层材料中暗激子的实时弛豫动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12996v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Symmetry governs which exciton-phonon (exc-ph) scattering channels can exist, but not which a relaxing exciton actually uses. Combining group theory with ab initio many-body perturbation theory, we derive the mirror parity σₕ, of finite-momentum excitons in planar D₃ₕ monolayers, and form exact exc-ph selection rules that hold across the whole Brillouin zone. The parity of the lowest exciton band changes across a closed contour. The even phonons connect states of the same parity, while odd phonons connect states of opposite parity. We use these rules to compute exciton linewidths and we solve the real-time Boltzmann transport equation for monolayer GaN as the test case and benchmark it against monolayer hBN.
articles.abstract_zh: 对称性决定了激子-声子散射通道的存在，但并非决定了弛豫激子实际使用的通道。本文结合群论和从头算多体微扰理论，推导了平面D₃ₕ单层材料中有限动量激子的镜像宇称σₕ，并形成了在整个布里渊区都成立的精确激子-声子选择规则。研究利用这些规则计算了激子线宽，并求解了单层GaN的实时玻尔兹曼输运方程，并与单层hBN进行了基准测试。
authors: Rishabh Saraswat, Mantasha Ansari, Rekha Verma, Sitangshu Bhattacharya

articles.title: Ultrafast laser-stimulated field emission from a metal: a non-equilibrium Green's functions approach
articles.title_zh: 金属中超快激光诱导场发射：非平衡格林函数方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13251v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ultrafast laser-assisted field emission from metallic nanotips is a promising route for generating coherent electron pulses. However, existing theoretical models often neglect many-body strong correlation effects in the emitter's electronic structure and its response to the optical field. In this work, we propose a theoretical framework based on the non-equilibrium Green's function formalism to simulate the out-of-equilibrium electron dynamics across a strongly driven matter-vacuum interface, in a one-dimensional model. Treating the tip-vacuum coupling perturbatively, we find that the interplay between strong-field emission and multi-photon emission regimes can be described in terms of a filtering of the emitter's local density of occupied states through field-dressed vacuum propagators. By including electron-electron interactions via the second-Born approximation, we show that correlation-induced modifications in the electronic structure are directly transferred to the far-field spectrum. Finally, by self-consistently solving the Dyson equation at the interface, we uncover a dynamic back-action regime driven by the optical field, characterized by a periodic polarization of the emitter, which reshapes the far-field spectrum. This shows that the non-equilibrium Green's functions approach provides a versatile framework for exploring and analyzing field emission of correlated electrons.
articles.abstract_zh: 超快激光辅助金属纳米尖端场发射是产生相干电子脉冲的有前景途径，但现有模型常忽略多体强关联效应。本文提出了一个基于非平衡格林函数形式的理论框架，用于模拟强驱动物质-真空界面上的非平衡电子动力学。研究发现，强场发射和多光子发射机制的相互作用可以通过发射器局域占据态密度的滤波来描述。通过自洽求解界面处的戴森方程，揭示了由光场驱动的动态反作用机制。
authors: Luciano Jacopo D'Onofrio, Adolfo Avella, Martin Eckstein

articles.title: Controlling the Atomic Reconstruction in Twisted MoSe₂/WSe₂ with a Monolayer hBN Spacer
articles.title_zh: 用单层hBN间隔层控制扭曲MoSe₂/WSe₂中的原子重构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13493v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Twisted van der Waals heterobilayers are a promising material platform for studying collective exciton many-body phenomena, but near-aligned structures often exhibit a local, anisotropic atomic reconstruction that compromises lateral homogeneity. The present study describes how atomic-scale rearrangement in adjacent regions of hBN-encapsulated, near-aligned MoSe₂/WSe₂ heterobilayers is controlled by the presence of a mono- or bilayer hBN spacer between the two monolayers. High-angle annular dark-field STEM directly resolves the atomic alignment in both layers and shows that the spacer suppresses the reconstruction and strongly increases the structural uniformity of the heterobilayers. 4D-STEM quantitatively maps local rotation, dilation, and heterostrain, revealing that the separated regions remain consistent with rigid moiré superlattice simulations, whereas without the spacer the structural parameters have two to three times broader distributions. By suppressing reconstruction, ultrathin hBN spacers therefore provide an effective route to enhance lattice homogeneity in MoSe₂/WSe₂ heterobilayers targeting collective excitonic and optoelectronic phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 扭曲范德华异质双层结构在研究集体激子多体现象方面具有潜力，但近乎对齐的结构常出现局部各向异性原子重构。本研究通过在MoSe₂/WSe₂异质双层之间引入单层或双层hBN间隔层，成功控制了原子尺度的重排。结果表明，hBN间隔层能有效抑制原子重构，显著提高异质双层的结构均匀性，为增强MoSe₂/WSe₂异质双层的晶格均匀性提供了有效途径。
authors: Johannes Figueiredo, Kaiyuan Chen, Aubrey Penn, Mirco Troue, Sebastian Loy, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Frances M. Ross, Julian Klein, Alexander W. Holleitner

articles.title: Alter-excitons in Altermagnets: Symmetry, Splitting and Dispersion
articles.title_zh: 交流磁体中的“交变激子”：对称性、劈裂与色散
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12900v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Magnetism provides a fertile platform for discovering emergent quantum phenomena governed by symmetry. Recent developments of spin-space-group (SSG) theory have revealed altermagnets as a distinct class of nonrelativistic collinear magnets with unconventional spin-dependent electronic structures. Here, we demonstrate that altermagnetic symmetry imposes fundamentally different constraints on electronic and excitonic excitations. Although the quasiparticle and two-body Hamiltonians possess identical SSG symmetries, we find that symmetry-protected degeneracies present in the electronic band structure can be intrinsically lifted in the exciton spectrum at specific momenta. This splitting arises solely from the many-body nature of excitons and does not require spin-orbit coupling or noncollinear magnetic order. Combining symmetry analysis with many-body perturbation theory, we predict a novel class of spin-split excitonic quasiparticles, termed alter-excitons, and reveal their characteristic dispersions in altermagnetic systems. Our results establish excitons as a sensitive probe of hidden spin-space symmetries and uncover a new route toward symmetry-engineered many-body phenomena in collinear magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 交流磁体是一种新型非相对论共线磁体，具有非传统的自旋相关电子结构。本研究发现，交流磁体对称性对电子和激子激发施加了根本不同的限制。研究预测了一种新型自旋劈裂激子准粒子，称为“交变激子”，并揭示了其在交流磁体系统中的特征色散。这些结果表明激子可作为探测隐藏自旋空间对称性的敏感探针。
authors: Yuanfan Xiong, Liangyu Wang, Xuan Wu, Wei Hu, Jinlong Yang

articles.title: Quantum Theory of Exciton Magnetic Moment: Interaction and Topological Effects
articles.title_zh: 激子磁矩的量子理论：相互作用与拓扑效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.07284v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Combining magnetometry with optical spectroscopy has uncovered novel quantum phenomena and is emerging as a powerful probe of quantum materials. However, the theory of the magnetic response of excitons, correlated electron-hole pairs in insulators, remains incomplete due to insufficient treatment of electron-hole interactions and quantum geometric effects. In biased bilayer graphene, for instance, theoretical predictions of valley g-factors for p-excitons deviate from experiment by nearly an order of magnitude. Here, we develop a quantum theory of the exciton orbital magnetic moment, based on first-order perturbation theory within the GW plus Bethe-Salpeter Equation approach and a rigorous treatment of the position operator in the response of exciton states to a magnetic field. Our formalism reveals three distinct contributions that go beyond the heuristic approaches used in the literature: a Berry-phase-corrected single-particle electron and hole moment difference, a term from envelope-function winding linked to electron-hole relative motion, and a center-of-mass correction from exciton band quantum geometry, with the latter two being completely new effects not considered in previous studies. Our ab initio calculations yield results in excellent agreement with experiment, establishing the importance of interaction and quantum geometric effects in the magnetic response of excitons.
articles.abstract_zh: 激子作为绝缘体中的关联电子-空穴对，其磁响应理论因对电子-空穴相互作用和量子几何效应处理不足而尚不完善。本研究基于GW加Bethe-Salpeter方程方法和对位置算符的严格处理，发展了激子轨道磁矩的量子理论。该理论揭示了三个超越传统启发式方法的独特贡献：贝里相修正的单粒子电子和空穴磁矩差、与电子-空穴相对运动相关的包络函数缠绕项，以及激子能带量子几何引起的质心修正。
authors: Gurjyot Sethi, Jiawei Ruan, Fang Zhang, Weichen Tang, Chen Hu, Mit Naik, Steven G. Louie

articles.title: Lee--Yang Zeros and Pseudocritical Drift in J-Q Néel Antiferromagnet--Valence-Bond Solid Transitions
articles.title_zh: J-Q 奈尔反铁磁体-价键固体相变中的李-杨零点与伪临界漂移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.15116v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Square-lattice J-Q models provide a sign-problem-free setting for probing the quantum phase transition between Néel antiferromagnet and columnar valence-bond solid. We analyze this transition through the scaling of Lee--Yang zeros, computed within stochastic series expansion quantum Monte Carlo by reweighting configurations sampled near criticality in the presence of complex source fields. Benchmark studies of the dimerized Heisenberg model and the checkerboard J-Q model validate the method, yielding stable (O(3)) critical scaling in the former and clear spacetime-volume scaling in the latter, as expected for a first-order transition. Applying the same analysis to the J-Q models, we find a pronounced and systematic drift of the leading-zero scaling with increasing system size, consistent with an extended pseudocritical regime. The Lee--Yang scaling implies an effective scaling dimension (Δφ) of the (SO(5)) order-parameter field that decreases with size and is consistent with vanishing in the thermodynamic limit. Such behavior lies below the scalar unitarity bound of any unitary relativistic conformal field theory in (2+1) dimensions and enforces inverse spacetime-volume scaling of the zeros, the hallmark of a first-order transition. These results support a weakly first-order interpretation of the Néel--VBS transition and establish the finite-size Lee--Yang zeros as a sensitive, symmetry-resolved diagnostic of pseudocriticality and transition order in the J-Q family.
articles.abstract_zh: 方格J-Q模型为研究奈尔反铁磁体与柱状价键固体之间的量子相变提供了无符号问题设置。本研究通过随机级数展开量子蒙特卡洛方法计算李-杨零点的标度，分析了这一相变。结果显示，随着系统尺寸的增加，主导零点标度出现显著且系统的漂移，这与扩展的伪临界区域一致。李-杨标度表明(SO(5))序参量场的有效标度维度随尺寸减小，并在热力学极限下趋于消失。
authors: Chunhao Guo, Zhe Wang, Danhe Wang, Zenan Liu, Haiyuan Zou, Zheng Yan

articles.title: Contrasting Γ- and K-Valley Moiré Physics in Twisted Monolayer/Bilayer WSe₂
articles.title_zh: 扭曲单层/双层WSe₂中Γ谷和K谷莫尔物理的对比研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.18212v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Electronic orbital character plays a central role in determining electronic correlations, spin-orbit coupling, dimensionality, and ultimately the quantum phases of condensed-matter systems. Two-dimensional moiré materials have emerged as highly tunable platforms for exploring correlated phenomena, but the role of orbital degrees of freedom remains largely unexplored. Here, we identify twisted monolayer/bilayer WSe₂ as a platform in which displacement-field tuning enables moiré physics to be realized in both the K and Γ valleys. The distinct orbital characters of these valleys give rise to contrasting correlated phases at moiré filling factors ν=1 and ν=1/3. At ν=1, the K-valley state is a weak insulator, consistent with an antiferromagnetic state near a van Hove singularity in the intermediate-coupling regime, similar to that observed in twisted bilayer WSe₂. In contrast, the Γ-valley state exhibits a pronounced Pomeranchuk effect, consistent with proximity to a Mott transition. At ν=1/3, the K valley hosts a robust generalized Wigner crystal, whereas the Γ-valley state lies near the crystallization boundary and again exhibits a Pomeranchuk effect, with localization enhanced by increasing temperature or magnetic field. Our work highlights the importance of orbital character in defining quantum phases in moiré systems, and identify the Γ valley as a promising platform for exploring correlated phenomena near quantum phase transitions, where competing phases and enhanced fluctuations may give rise to unconventional phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 电子轨道特性在凝聚态物质的量子相中扮演关键角色。本研究发现，扭曲单层/双层WSe₂是一个独特的平台，通过位移场调谐可在K谷和Γ谷实现莫尔物理。这两个谷的不同轨道特性导致在莫尔填充因子ν=1和ν=1/3时出现对比鲜明的关联相。K谷表现出弱绝缘体和鲁棒的广义维格纳晶体行为，而Γ谷则展现出显著的庞恰梅兰效应，接近莫特转变和结晶边界。
authors: Jackson Kuklin, Ning Mao, Milan Mandigo-Stoba, Edgar Elias, Tianci Song, Connor Engel, Pola Pietrzkowski, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Daniel Rhodes, Yang Zhang, Qianhui Shi

articles.title: Exponential advantage in continuous-variable quantum state learning
articles.title_zh: 连续变量量子态学习中的指数优势
articles.abstract: npj Quantum Information, Published online: 12 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41534-026-01391-z Exponential advantage in continuous-variable quantum state learning
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇发表在《npj Quantum Information》上的文章探讨了连续变量量子态学习中的指数优势。该研究可能揭示了在特定量子计算任务中，连续变量系统如何实现显著的性能提升。具体的研究方法和详细结论需查阅原文。

articles.title: A quantitative model for embedding quantum-secure communications and evaluating communication autonomy in industrial control systems
articles.title_zh: 一种用于在工业控制系统中嵌入量子安全通信并评估通信自主性的定量模型
articles.abstract: npj Quantum Information, Published online: 12 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41534-026-01396-8 A quantitative model for embedding quantum-secure communications and evaluating communication autonomy in industrial control systems
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇发表在《npj Quantum Information》上的文章提出了一种定量模型，旨在工业控制系统中集成量子安全通信并评估其通信自主性。该模型可能为提升工业系统网络安全和韧性提供了新的视角。具体的研究细节和模型应用需查阅原文。

Vasileios Theos

Brian Jowers

articles.title: Security bounds for unidimensional discrete-modulated CV-QKD: a Gaussian extremality approach
articles.title_zh: 单维离散调制连续变量量子密钥分发（CV-QKD）的安全性界限：高斯极值方法
articles.abstract: Unidimensional (1D) Gaussian-modulated continuous-variable quantum key distribution protocols have been proposed as a way to simplify implementation and reduce costs through single-quadrature modulation, requiring only one modulator while maintaining compatibility with standard optical infrastructure. Here, we determine security bounds for a 1D discrete-modulated protocol under the Gaussian extremality assumption by extending the method of Ghorai et al (2019 Phys. Rev. X9 021059). We establish the appropriate symmetry arguments to extend the method to the 1D discrete-modulated case, define the physicality zone in which the protocol is allowed to operate, and derive a security bound against collective attacks in the asymptotic regime via semidefinite programming. Our analysis for uniformly distributed coherent states reveals a limitation: the Gaussian extremality assumption systematically overestimates Eve’s information with increasing constellation size, yielding bounds so conservative that secure key extraction becomes increasingly limited for larger constellations, even under ideal conditions. This overestimation worsens with excess noise and restricts viable modulation amplitudes to near-vacuum values. Unlike two-dimensional protocols, where Gaussian extremality improves with constellation size, 1D protocols lack the growing phase-space isotropy required for the approximation to remain tight as the constellation grows. Our results expose these limitations and highlight the necessity of alternative methods or optimized non-uniform constellation designs for this class of protocols.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过扩展现有方法，在高斯极值假设下确定了单维离散调制连续变量量子密钥分发（CV-QKD）协议的安全性界限。研究建立了适用于该协议的对称性论证，定义了协议可操作的物理区域，并通过半定规划推导了渐近集体攻击下的安全界限。分析发现，高斯极值假设会系统性地高估窃听者信息，导致安全性界限过于保守，尤其是在星座尺寸增大和存在过量噪声时，限制了安全密钥的提取。
authors: John A Mora Rodríguez, Maron F Anka, Leonardo J Pereira, Micael A Dias and Alexandre B Tacla

articles.title: Warm-Start Quantum Computation for Energy Readout and State Preparation
articles.title_zh: 用于能量读出和态制备的温启动量子计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12485v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Estimating a ground-state energy and preparing a ground state both split into a front-end that supplies an approximate state |ḩiångle and a back-end that reads or refines it. We argue, and measure at every step, that the only thing crossing that split is the front-end's spectral weight distribution pₙ₌|łangle Eₙ|ḩiångle|² over the eigenstates of the problem Hamiltonian H_P. Everything downstream is priced in it, so the front-end is a swappable module, and we swap it seven times without altering anything to its right. We call the arrangement WARP. Four back-ends spend that distribution. A readout (A) samples g(t)=łangleḩi|e⁻ⁱH_Pt|ḩiångle on the device and extracts true eigenvalues by classical signal processing, returning an energy below the variational bound of the state it was handed, from a signal 50× shorter than a Fourier transform needs. Three routes spend the same account on a state instead. An adiabatic schedule (B) has a minimum gap set by the overlap; a discrete amplification (C) is cheaper in depth but must halt at an index the overlap fixes, so it needs a measured value and not a bound; a recursion (D) of depth O(3^m) raises the question of whether it can be run at all. The interactions are the substance. On stretched N₂ a sample-based diagonalisation reports a variational bound 79 mHa high, fifty times outside chemical accuracy; reading the state it has already prepared returns E₀ to 1.4×10⁻⁶ Ha, three orders of magnitude inside it, and needs no new front-end and no new circuit. And because the weights price everything, they must be measurable when scarce, so we beat a weak reference against a strong one and recover overlaps four orders of magnitude below the shot-noise floor. We map the operating envelope throughout, and state the limitations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种名为WARP的温启动量子计算框架，用于基态能量估计和基态制备。该框架将计算分为前端（提供近似态）和后端（读出或精炼），并强调前端的谱权重分布是两者之间唯一的连接。研究展示了四种后端方法，其中一种读出方法通过经典信号处理从短得多的信号中提取真实本征值，并返回低于变分界限的能量。另有三种方法用于态制备，包括绝热演化、离散放大和递归方法。
authors: Tien D. Kieu

articles.title: TLS loss in superconducting resonators on epitaxial hBN thin films
articles.title_zh: 外延hBN薄膜上超导谐振器中的TLS损耗
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12556v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The integration of low-loss dielectrics into superconducting circuits is of importance to the functionality of quantum computers and sensors. In this work, we fabricate and measure niobium resonators atop few-layer, epitaxial hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) grown by Molecular Beam Epitaxy on a sapphire substrate and compare against a control counterpart without hBN. We conduct radiofrequency measurements which probe the responses to power, temperature, and temporal fluctuations of two-level systems. The resonators integrating hBN maintain low dielectric loss with a low-power internal loss tangent on the order of 10⁻⁶, and demonstrate hBN can be added to the conventional superconducting qubit stack with minimal degradation of the quality factor. This research represents a first step towards a materials-driven strategy to eliminate phonon-mediated correlated errors in solid-state quantum systems, which leverages the thermal properties of 2D materials to prevent athermal phonons excited in the device substrate from transmitting across the superconductor-substrate interface. The same technique applied to quantum sensors would maximize phonon collection by blocking phonons from entering passive metal films.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在蓝宝石衬底上通过分子束外延生长的少层外延六方氮化硼（hBN）薄膜上的铌超导谐振器。通过射频测量，研究发现集成hBN的谐振器保持了低介电损耗，低功率内损耗角正切约为10⁻⁶，且对传统超导量子比特堆叠的品质因数退化影响最小。这项工作为通过材料驱动策略消除固态量子系统中声子介导的相关误差迈出了第一步，利用二维材料的热特性阻止非热声子在超导体-衬底界面传输。
authors: J. Christiansen-Salameh, D. J. Temples, R. Linehan, S. Sussman, Aloyse Maille, F. Abouzahr, L. Alexis, K. Anyang, D. Bowring, G. Bratrud, E. Celi, A. H. Colón Cesaní, R. Khatiwada, D. Molenaar, O. Peek, A. Rodriguez, O. Seidel, D. Schlom, D. Sotir, S. Uemura, Y. Wu, E. Figueroa-Feliciano, D. Baxter, Z. Tian

articles.title: Correlated Pair Creation with Positive- and Negative-Frequency Oscillators in a Trapped-Ion Quantum Simulator
articles.title_zh: 囚禁离子量子模拟器中正负频率振子的关联对产生
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12579v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin-dependent forces enable independent control over the effective frequencies of bosonic motional modes and their coupling strengths to spins in trapped-ion spin-boson quantum simulators. We show that the relative signs of these effective frequencies provide an important programmable resource for engineering distinct multimode dynamics. Focusing on a two-mode quantum Rabi model, changing the frequencies of the two modes from the same sign to opposite signs reorganizes the resonance structure of the spin-mediated bosonic interaction, converting the dominant resonant process from excitation exchange to correlated pair creation. In the dispersive regime, the resulting effective interaction realizes a two-mode parametric amplifier with stable oscillatory, critical, and exponentially amplifying regimes separated by a spin-dependent instability threshold. Across these regimes, the dynamics generate collective-quadrature squeezing and bipartite motional entanglement. Preparing the spin in a coherent superposition further allows different spin components to experience distinct stability regimes, generating tripartite spin-boson entanglement, while spin postselection can coherently combine the conditional bosonic branches to generate non-Gaussian entangled bosonic states. Finally, we outline an implementation using parameters within reach of current trapped-ion platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了囚禁离子量子模拟器中自旋依赖力如何独立控制玻色子运动模式的有效频率及其与自旋的耦合强度。研究发现，这些有效频率的相对符号是工程化不同多模动力学的重要可编程资源。在双模量子拉比模型中，将两模式频率从同号变为异号，可将主导的共振过程从激发交换转变为关联对产生。在色散区，由此产生的有效相互作用实现了双模参量放大器，并能生成集体正交压缩和双分量运动纠缠，甚至通过制备自旋相干叠加态产生三分量自旋-玻色子纠缠。
authors: Visal So, Mingjian Zhu, Han Pu, Guido Pagano

articles.title: Latent Symmetry in Quantum Zeno Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 量子芝诺动力学中的潜在对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12647v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum Zeno dynamics constrains a continuously monitored system to measurement-selected subspaces. Here we show that the structure of such Zeno subspaces can be governed by a emphlatent symmetry, namely a symmetry that is absent from the geometry of the underlying physical network. We consider a minimal circuit-QED network of coupled microwave resonators subject to quantum-nondemolition (QND) monitoring of local photon occupations. Two distinguished resonators are geometrically inequivalent, yet are exactly exchanged by a latent symmetry of the network. Strong monitoring partitions the single-excitation Hilbert space into three quantum-Zeno subspaces, two of which correspond to localization on the distinguished resonators. Latent symmetry exactly exchanges these two Zeno subspaces and enforces identical escape and residence statistics despite their different microscopic environments.
