In the strong-measurement regime their residence times grow linearly with the measurement strength and diverge in the ideal Zeno limit, where the measurement subspaces become dynamically disconnected. Our results show that latent symmetry can act as a hidden organizing principle of quantum Zeno dynamics, imposing exact relations between measurement-selected subspaces that are geometrically inequivalent in the physical system.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文揭示了量子芝诺动力学中芝诺子空间的结构可由一种“潜在对称性”支配，即一种在物理网络几何中不存在的对称性。研究以一个耦合微波谐振器的最小电路QED网络为例，该网络受到局部光子占据的量子非破坏（QND）监测。尽管两个独特的谐振器在几何上不等价，但它们通过网络的潜在对称性精确交换。强监测将单激发希尔伯特空间划分为三个量子芝诺子空间，其中两个对应于在独特谐振器上的局域化，潜在对称性确保了它们具有相同的逃逸和驻留统计。
authors: Stefano Longhi

articles.title: Fast computational primitives for La-cross qLDPC codes
articles.title_zh: La-cross量子LDPC码的快速计算原语
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12685v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum LDPC codes promise to reduce the overhead of fault-tolerant quantum computation, but their practical use requires efficient logical gates, measurements, and access to non-Clifford resources. Here, we develop a complete set of computational primitives for La-cross hypergraph product codes. For a subclass of these codes, we show that seed automorphisms together with fold-transversal gates generate the full logical Clifford group up to Pauli corrections. We further prove that every rank one logical operator admits D pairwise disjoint physical representatives, enabling parallel gauging and a space--time tradeoff for logical measurements. Finally, we construct an addressable surface code interface for injecting externally prepared resource states into selected logical qubits. Together, these results establish La-cross codes as a simple, low-connectivity generalisation of surface code computation, retaining analogous computational primitives while providing a complete Clifford+T instruction set across multiple encoded qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为La-cross超图积码开发了一套完整的计算原语，旨在降低容错量子计算的开销。对于这类代码的一个子类，研究表明种子自同构与折叠横向门结合可以生成完整的逻辑Clifford群。此外，研究证明每个秩一逻辑算符都允许D个两两不相交的物理表示，从而实现并行规范和逻辑测量的时空权衡。最后，构建了一个可寻址的表面码接口，用于将外部制备的资源态注入选定的逻辑量子比特。
authors: Andrea Di Fini, Tom Hartweg, Laura Pecorari, Guido Pupillo, Samuel Crew

articles.title: Coset Lifted Product Codes: Constructing Quantum LDPC Codes from Non-Normal Subgroup Actions
articles.title_zh: 余集提升积码：从非正规子群作用构造量子LDPC码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12782v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce coset lifted product (CLP) codes, a family of quantum LDPC codes that combine the protograph structure of lifted product codes with the coset action of Aydin, Tamo, and Barg i̧teAydinTamoBarg2026. Given a finite group G, a subgroup H łe G that need not be normal, a protograph A over mathbb F₂[G], and a protograph B over mathbb F₂[N_G(H)], the two protographs act on the cosets G/H from the left and from the right to produce quantum CSS codes. Further, for groups of odd order, we give an explicit formula for the dimension as a sum over the irreducible representations h̊o of G of hypergraph product dimensions. A search over 14,843 pairs (G,H) with H restricted to be non-normal and 120 łe n łe 400 yields certified codes that exceed the best published value of Q=kd²/n at check weights 6,7 and 9, i.e., we obtain [[360,20,20]] at w=6, a [[360,24,20]] code at w=7, and codes [[252,16,18]] and [[288,16,20]] at w=9. Our search also produce high-distance codes with parameters [[168,10,14]], [[240,8,20]] at w=6 and [[216,8,18]] at w=7.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入了余集提升积（CLP）码，这是一类结合了提升积码原型图结构和余集作用的量子LDPC码。给定有限群G和其非正规子群H，两个原型图分别作用于余集G/H，生成量子CSS码。对于奇数阶群，研究给出了维度的显式公式。通过对14,843对(G,H)的搜索，获得了在校验权重6、7和9时性能超过现有最佳值的认证码，例如[[360,20,20]]和[[360,24,20]]等高距离码。
authors: Rajendra Prasad Rajpurohit, V. Lalitha, Shayan Srinivasa Garani

articles.title: Quantum-Circuit Residuals for Receptor Functional Potency Prediction: Predictive Gains and Quadratic Structure
articles.title_zh: 用于受体功能效力预测的量子电路残差：预测增益与二次结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13037v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The predictive performance of neural networks for receptor functional potency modeling depends on both molecular representations and prediction-head design. Using GLP-1R cAMP-related pEC50 prediction as the primary task, we jointly train a classical molecular encoder with a linear base head and a shallow quantum-circuit residual head that share the learned molecular representation. We evaluate the models using random and structure-group splits, include tuned Chemprop as a domain reference, and extend the evaluation to ADRB2 and MC4R. Under the GLP-1R structure-group split, the quantum-residual models reduce mean absolute error relative to the corresponding base models from 0.677 to 0.639 with a multilayer perceptron (MLP) encoder and from 0.680 to 0.641 with a graph neural network (GNN) encoder. In structural control experiments, a parameter-count-matched real-orthogonal control achieves similar predictive performance, suggesting that some quantum-residual gains may be associated with structured quadratic feature interactions. By combining receptor functional potency prediction with structural analysis of the quantum residual, this study provides empirical evidence to inform compact residual-head design and highlights the potential of quantum-circuit parameterizations for this task.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了量子电路残差在受体功能效力预测中的应用，以GLP-1R cAMP相关pEC50预测为主要任务。研究联合训练了一个经典分子编码器与线性基础头和浅层量子电路残差头，共享学习到的分子表示。在GLP-1R结构组划分下，量子残差模型相对于基础模型显著降低了平均绝对误差。结构控制实验表明，部分量子残差增益可能与结构化的二次特征交互有关。
authors: Chenyan Jia, Yaping Ma, Yuen Wang, Cong Guo

articles.title: All-optical deconvolution via quantum cross-correlation spectroscopy with bright twin beams
articles.title_zh: 基于亮双光子束的量子互相关光谱全光去卷积
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13074v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The resolution of spectroscopic measurements is fundamentally limited by the convolution between a system's intrinsic response and the instrument response function, creating an ill-posed inverse problem. While entangled photons can theoretically bypass these limits, low photon flux has hindered their experimental realization. Here, we propose quantum cross-correlation spectroscopy (QCCS), utilizing macroscopic twin beams (signal and idler beams) to physically circumvent this convolution limit in coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering. Employing the signal beam as a broadband probe, QCCS achieves all-optical deconvolution through a correlation-enhanced sum-frequency generation channel between the convoluted anti-Stokes and idler beams. By subtracting the uncorrelated background using a 500-femtosecond temporal window, we successfully retrieve narrow Raman bands (8 cm⁻¹ and 15 cm⁻¹) completely obscured by a 75 cm⁻¹ probe bandwidth without numerical deconvolution or prior knowledge. Our results establish macroscopic quantum correlations as a robust resource for high-fidelity spectroscopy, paving the way for ultrashort-pulse-free operando studies under natural, incoherent excitation conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种量子互相关光谱（QCCS）方法，利用宏观双光子束（信号光和闲频光）在相干反斯托克斯拉曼散射中实现全光去卷积，以克服光谱测量的卷积限制。QCCS通过信号光作为宽带探针，利用卷积反斯托克斯光和闲频光之间相关增强的和频生成通道实现去卷积。实验成功地在没有数值去卷积或先验知识的情况下，从被宽带探针完全掩盖的信号中恢复了窄拉曼谱带。这项工作确立了宏观量子关联作为高保真光谱的强大资源。
authors: Yujiro Eto

articles.title: A robust digital receiver architecture for continuous-variable quantum key distribution
articles.title_zh: 连续变量量子密钥分发的一种鲁棒数字接收机架构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13090v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Continuous-variable quantum key distribution utilizes advanced digital signal processing techniques to mitigate channel impairments, driving the progress of high-performance quantum secure communications. Specifically, digital heterodyne receivers are commonly implemented using down-conversion algorithms to detect both components simultaneously where the signal is modulated onto an intermediate frequency to avoid low-frequency noise and bypass stringent optical phase-locking requirements. However, a rigorous analysis of the quantum security implications of the digital down-conversion algorithm remains absent. In this paper, we investigate the algorithm process from the perspective of quantum operator evolution, revealing that the frequency folding effect inherent in down-conversion inevitably mixes the image-frequency information into the baseband signal. To address this issue, we propose a novel operator reconstruction detection scheme based on dual-path digital heterodyne receiver. By performing a non-equal weighted combination of the output operators along two optical paths in the digital domain, this scheme perfectly cancels out the image-frequency operator physically. The robust receiver architecture preserves the baseband noise-suppression advantages, inherently achieves perfect mode balancing for asymmetric optical detection losses, and fundamentally closes the image-frequency crosstalk. Practical experiments have validated the feasibility of the proposed architecture and its effective suppression of image-frequency noise, achieving a performance of 11.4 Mbps @ 42 km. This work lays a solid theoretical and algorithmic foundation for future high-performance, highly secure digital continuous-variable quantum key distribution systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 连续变量量子密钥分发（CVQKD）利用数字信号处理技术来减轻信道损伤，但数字下变频算法的量子安全性影响尚未得到严格分析。本文从量子算符演化的角度研究了该算法，揭示了下变频中固有的频率折叠效应会将镜像频率信息混入基带信号。为解决此问题，作者提出了一种基于双路径数字外差接收机的新型算符重建检测方案，通过对两条光路输出算符进行非等权组合，完美抵消了该效应。
authors: Lu Fan, Xuesong Xu, Miao Yu, Zhengyu Li, Yunsong Yin, Hao Shi, Xuanyu Guo, Song Yu, Yichen Zhang

articles.title: Temporal-Access Resource Theory for Continuous Process Tensors
articles.title_zh: 连续过程张量的时域访问资源理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13110v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The uncontrolled endpoint channel can conceal how well a quantum process can protect a logical task under time-resolved control. We formulate a fixed-task resource theory of continuous process tensors with physical access interfaces, entrance-erasing free objects, and budgeted free conversions. Complete-record total-variation error measures performance; the calibrated capability is monotone under conversions that preserve a common free baseline. For unknown-state transmission the baseline is exactly 1-d⁻². Two qubit processes with the same endpoint channel have optimal errors 0 and p=sin²⁽²gh) at the same finite pulse budget in an ideal-transparent system-only window architecture, forcing any endpoint-only predictor to err by at least p/2 on one of them. An exactly solvable family shows how the allocation of a fixed interaction phase around a control window sets the attainable error, and a nontrivial perfect echo requires and attains total control action π in that architecture. The separation extends directly to every qubit unitary target at a budget that includes its boundary gate, while unitary tasks in any dimension have baseline 1-d⁻² whenever a budget-feasible free realization gives the depolarizing output. Complete-record implementation bounds quantify coherent and dissipative control imperfections. Continuous-process randomized compilation supplies physical instrument pullbacks; compatible completion conditions extend their action, and certified dynamical bounds yield achievable task-error and capability guarantees. The resulting theory identifies temporal structure and control investment that endpoint characterization alone cannot resolve.
articles.abstract_zh: 不受控的端点信道可能掩盖量子过程在时间分辨控制下保护逻辑任务的能力。本文提出了一种针对连续过程张量的固定任务资源理论，该理论包含物理访问接口、入口擦除自由对象和预算受限的自由转换。性能通过全记录总变差误差来衡量，校准能力在保持共同自由基线的转换下是单调的。该理论揭示了即使具有相同端点信道的两个量子比特过程，其最优误差也可能显著不同，强调了时域访问的重要性。
authors: He Wang

articles.title: Pulsed control of an entanglement-breaking index: thermal valleys, a certified valve, and its open-close asymmetry
articles.title_zh: 纠缠破坏指数的脉冲控制：热谷、认证阀门及其开关不对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13135v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The entanglement-breaking index of a channel is the number of self-compositions after which all entanglement with a reference system is destroyed. In a thermal qubit collision loop whose round is affine in the bath polarisation p, some circuits have thermal valleys: on an interior window of p the index falls below its infinite-temperature value. Rounds at different p compose exactly, so every schedule of polarisations defines a composite channel whose entanglement-breaking status can be certified in ball arithmetic. A gated search of 33 million random circuits finds no valley with contrast above about 3e-3, with an interior maximum near index 90, and yields six certified targets. At the reference target, held inside its window for 88 rounds, a centred excursion to p = 0.05 restores entanglement at exactly eight rounds: every shorter centred pulse certifiably fails, and so do the same eight rounds at the start. A 53-round pulse certifiably beats the static protocol, a depth-three valley is walked down its staircase by pulse duration, and a 1.2 per cent coherent tilt of the ancilla opens the switch at fixed population. Closing the switch costs 21 to 35 rounds. The asymmetry is not one of local rates, which agree to within about two per cent at matched circuit positions (certified). It is one of distance and response: closing must remove an entanglement margin 2.2 times larger, and while hot rounds added to a window hold act almost independently, window rounds added to a hot hold act collectively. Near the crossing, the lever of the log-margin is that of a linear approach to the entanglement-breaking boundary, with no free parameter. At the reference target, depolarising noise of about 4ν/n per round kills a signature of size ν read after n rounds: 1.3e-4 for the static signal, 6.5e-6 for the eight-round switch.
articles.abstract_zh: 信道的纠缠破坏指数是指其自复合多少次后与参考系统的所有纠缠被破坏的次数。本文研究了热量子比特碰撞循环中纠缠破坏指数的脉冲控制，发现某些电路存在“热谷”现象，即在特定参数窗口内指数低于无限温度值。通过门控搜索和球算术认证，作者发现了具有特定对比度的热谷，并展示了通过精确的脉冲序列可以恢复纠缠，甚至超越静态协议。研究还揭示了开关操作中的不对称性。
authors: Eran Kopel

articles.title: Continuous-wave AC magnetometry up to hundreds of megahertz using nitrogen-vacancy centers under a strong transverse magnetic field
articles.title_zh: 在强横向磁场下利用氮空位中心实现高达数百兆赫兹的连续波交流磁力测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13153v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond are promising quantum sensors for AC magnetic fields. However, conventional dynamical-decoupling-based magnetometry becomes technically demanding at high frequencies because of the requirement for increasingly short and high-power microwave pulses. This paper describes an AC magnetometry technique based on continuous-wave optically detected magnetic resonance (CW-ODMR) measurements, which enables the detection of signals in the hundred-MHz range. By applying a strong static magnetic field transverse to the NV axis, the energy separation between the relevant electron-spin states was tuned and resonantly coupled with the target radiofrequency (RF) magnetic field, thereby forming RF-dressed states. Unlike pulsed dynamical-decoupling schemes, this approach does not require high-power microwave pulse sequences. The key feature of our method is that the detectable frequency can be tuned by controlling the bias magnetic field strength. Using this methodology, we have experimentally achieved the frequency-tunable detection of AC magnetic fields from 14.4-632 MHz. The sensitivity was 0.558 uT/Hz⁽⁰.5) at 14.4 MHz and 24.4 uT/Hz⁽⁰.5) at 632 MHz. We characterized the field-dependent ODMR contrast and linewidth, and found that their degradation at large transverse fields is a important factor limiting the high-frequency sensitivity. These results establish a simple CW-ODMR approach for widely tunable RF magnetic-field sensing without high-power pulsed spin control.
articles.abstract_zh: 金刚石中的氮空位（NV）中心是交流磁场的潜在量子传感器，但传统方法在高频下技术要求高。本文提出了一种基于连续波光探测磁共振（CW-ODMR）的交流磁力测量技术，可在数百兆赫兹范围内检测信号。通过施加与NV轴垂直的强静磁场，该方法调谐电子自旋态的能量分离并与目标射频磁场共振耦合，形成射频修饰态。该方法无需高功率微波脉冲序列，且可调谐检测频率，实验实现了14.4-632 MHz的交流磁场检测，灵敏度为0.558 uT/Hz⁽⁰.5)。
authors: Ryusei Okaniwa, Rui Suzuki, Yuichiro Matsuzaki, Norio Tokuda, Junko Ishi-Hayase

articles.title: Verifiable Sampling for Delegated Generative Quantum Machine Learning
articles.title_zh: 委托生成式量子机器学习的可验证采样
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13211v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative machine learning has shown remarkable results across a wide range of interdisciplinary tasks, motivating significant efforts toward Quantum Generative Models as a path to beyond-classical performance, given their capability of generating classically intractable distributions. However, comparatively little attention has been paid to securely delegating such computations to a powerful remote quantum server. In this work, we propose a blind and verifiable protocol for sampling that can be used for the inference phase of such quantum models. Such a protocol inherits blindness from Universal Blind Quantum Computing and achieves verifiability by exploiting known approaches based on trapification schemes. Alongside, to delegate the training phase, we discuss an extension of the previously proposed verifiable end-to-end Delegated Variational Quantum Algorithms (Inajetovic et al., Phys. Rev. Research, 2026). Beyond the usual Accept/Abort outcome characterizing verification protocols, the sampling protocol for inference also provides, even against a malicious server, an estimation of the amount of corrupted generated samples, i.e., a fine-grained feature describing the quality of the outcome connecting verification protocols and application-level benchmarking.
articles.abstract_zh: 生成式机器学习在多领域任务中表现出色，量子生成模型有望超越经典性能，但安全地将此类计算委托给远程量子服务器的研究相对较少。本文提出了一种用于量子生成模型推理阶段的盲且可验证的采样协议，该协议结合了通用盲量子计算的盲性和基于陷阱方案的可验证性。此外，作者还讨论了委托训练阶段的扩展方案。该协议不仅提供接受/中止结果，还能在面对恶意服务器时估计被破坏的生成样本量。
authors: Matteo Inajetovic, Anna Pappa, Petros Wallden

articles.title: Block encoding of semiseparable matrices via their generators
articles.title_zh: 通过生成器实现半可分离矩阵的块编码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13228v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present an explicit quantum circuit that constructs a block encoding of a generator-representable semiseparable (one-pair) matrix directly from its two generators. For an N× N semiseparable matrix with N=2ⁿ, the circuit uses 2n+2 ancilla qubits and has O(m̊ polylog N) depth, and it realizes a (2sqrtN,,2n+2,,2 sqrt2 ǎrepsilon)-block encoding, where ǎrepsilon is controlled by the accuracy of the state-preparation routines that load the generators. The building blocks of the circuit are cyclic shifts, swaps, and Hadamard gates, each admitting an efficient implementation through the binary decomposition of the relevant indices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种显式量子电路，可以直接从两个生成器构建生成器可表示的半可分离（一对）矩阵的块编码。对于N=2ⁿ的N×N半可分离矩阵，该电路使用2n+2个辅助量子比特，深度为O(m̊ polylog N)。它实现了(2sqrtN,,2n+2,,2 sqrt2 ǎrepsilon)-块编码，其中ǎrepsilon由加载生成器的态制备例程的精度控制。电路的基本构建块包括循环移位、交换和Hadamard门，这些门都可以通过相关索引的二进制分解实现高效实现。
authors: Giacomo Antonioli, Gianna M. Del Corso, Roel Van Beeumen

articles.title: Circuit Design Problems in Binary Polynomial Quantum Optimization
articles.title_zh: 二进制多项式量子优化中的电路设计问题
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13283v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Solving combinatorial optimization problems on near-term quantum computers mainly relies on their quadratic unconstrained binary formulation. Lately, binary polynomial formulations start to take the center stage, having a better scaling with respect to the number of used qubits. However, while quadratic forms are straightforward to implement on quantum circuits, polynomial forms of degree d incur in circuit depth overheads, due to the lack of d-qubit gates, for d≥ 3, on current hardware. In this paper, we study the problem of designing the shallowest quantum circuit for a given polynomial form. We formulate it as a classical binary linear problem and we prove the textsfNP-completeness of a variant of it. On the algorithmic side, we offer a scalable and performant heuristic method to tackle it, Tempura, as well as faster binary linear problem formulations, which offer computational feasibility while sacrificing optimality. Our performance evaluation shows that the algorithms yield far shorter circuits than the state-of-the-art approaches, and Tempura is mostly comparable with them in terms of runtime.
articles.abstract_zh: 近期量子计算机上的组合优化问题主要依赖二次无约束二进制形式，但二进制多项式形式在量子比特使用数量上具有更好的扩展性。然而，由于当前硬件缺乏d≥3的d-量子比特门，多项式形式在量子电路实现中会增加电路深度开销。本文研究了为给定多项式形式设计最浅量子电路的问题，并将其表述为经典的二进制线性问题，证明了其变体的NP完备性。作者提出了一种可扩展且高性能的启发式方法Tempura，以及更快的二进制线性问题公式，这些方法能生成比现有技术更短的电路。
authors: Dylan Laplace Mermoud, Dimitri Watel, Sourour Elloumi, Andrea Simonetto

articles.title: A General Method for Extending Isoscattering Non-Isospectral Quantum Graphs
articles.title_zh: 扩展等散射非等谱量子图的通用方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13349v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The present paper sets out a general method for extending the isoscattering, non-isospectral quantum graphs. The methodology is illustrated by considering two graphs, denoted by Γ₁ and Γ₂, which have the same total metric length but different topologies. It is demonstrated that, despite the fact that their scattering matrices are identical, their eigenvalues, denoted by kₙ, and Euler characteristics differ from one another. The next step in the process is to extend both graphs by affixing the same star graph to each of them. Utilising the Titchmarsh-Weyl M-function formalism, it is proven that the newly constructed, extended graphs are also isoscattering and non-isospectral.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种扩展等散射非等谱量子图的通用方法。通过考虑两个具有相同总度量长度但拓扑结构不同的图Γ₁和Γ₂，作者证明了尽管它们的散射矩阵相同，但特征值和欧拉示性数不同。进一步，通过将相同的星形图附加到这两个图上，并利用Titchmarsh-Weyl M函数形式，证明了新构建的扩展图仍然是等散射和非等谱的。
authors: Omer Farooq, Michal Lawniczak, Leszek Sirko

articles.title: System-Design Optimization of a Single-Transmitter, Single-Fiber QKD-based ITS Communication Link
articles.title_zh: 基于单发射器、单光纤QKD的ITS通信链路系统设计优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13359v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deploying QKD-based secure communication at scale requires reducing duplicated optical hardware while preserving the rate of protected user data. Earlier studies established the physical feasibility of carrying CV-QKD and classical signals over shared infrastructure, motivating a quantitative comparison between optical hardware savings and the OTP-encrypted rate. We perform this comparison by defining the secure communication rate (SCR) as the rate jointly supported by secret-key generation and classical transport, and using it to optimize a shared discrete-modulation CV-QKD link. The model combines a binomial 64-QAM security bound with a trusted receiver, protocol traffic, spectral leakage - optical power leaking into the quantum receive band - and Raman scattering. At 25 km, the asymptotic model gives an optimized SCR of 12.079 Mbps, compared with 12.095 Mbps for a separated-link reference, while reducing the transmitter and fiber counts from two to one each in the modeled direction. Increasing channel separation suppresses spectral leakage, but the resulting SCR gain diminishes once receiver bandwidth limits the rate. Under the adopted receiver-noise law, increasing the bandwidth budget from 350 to 750 MHz raises the projected 25-km SCR to 24.535 Mbps despite higher trusted electronic noise. For the studied metropolitan link, sharing saves optical resources with little rate loss, while receiver-bandwidth improvements provide greater benefit than further spectral separation. Together, these results suggest an integration path: share the transmitter and fiber, limit unwanted classical power in the quantum receive band, and increase usable receiver bandwidth where the noise budget permits.
articles.abstract_zh: 规模化部署基于QKD的安全通信需要减少重复光学硬件，同时保持受保护用户数据的速率。本文通过定义安全通信速率（SCR）来量化光学硬件节省与OTP加密速率之间的关系，并优化了共享的离散调制CV-QKD链路。该模型结合了二项式64-QAM安全界限、可信接收器、协议流量、光谱泄漏和拉曼散射。在25公里处，优化后的SCR为12.079 Mbps，与分离链路的12.095 Mbps相比，同时将发射器和光纤数量从两个减少到一个。
authors: Shivang Srivastava, Guillaume Ricard, Yves Jaouën, Matteo Schiavon, Romain Alléaume

articles.title: Quantum extreme learning for forecasting experimental chaotic electronic circuits
articles.title_zh: 用于预测实验混沌电子电路的量子极限学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13388v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum reservoir computing and its special case, quantum extreme learning, are powerful tools for predicting classical discrete time-series with quantum devices. Forecasting continuous signals, however, requires careful discretization as oversampling artificially boosts short-term accuracy but fails over realistic intervals, while undersampling captures too few features and yields poor predictions. Here, we experimentally generate four continuous time-series signals from a chaotic electronic circuit for forecasting with quantum extreme learning. Since simplified circuit models do not fully capture real behaviour, it is unclear whether algorithms that predict simulated time-series also work for experimental signals. We address discretization via two approaches: (i) sampling local peaks/troughs; and (ii) uniform sampling at the autocorrelation timescale. The former captures resonant behaviour, while the latter fully captures chaotic features as well as allowing the reconstruction of chaotic attractors. Our algorithm achieves high forecasting accuracy for both simulated and experimental signals, demonstrating its power for continuous signal processing on near-term quantum simulators, and remains robust against moderate decoherence.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子储备计算和量子极限学习是利用量子设备预测经典离散时间序列的强大工具。然而，预测连续信号需要仔细的离散化。本文通过实验从混沌电子电路生成四种连续时间序列信号，并使用量子极限学习进行预测。作者通过两种离散化方法（采样局部峰谷和在自相关时间尺度上均匀采样）解决了离散化问题。结果表明，该算法对模拟和实验信号都实现了高预测精度，展示了其在连续信号预测方面的强大能力。
authors: Mohammad Sharifian, Qingyu Li, Chiranjib Mukhopadhyay, Abolfazl Bayat, Ludovico Minati

articles.title: Modelling Josephson Junctions with Boundary Conditions: Towards High-Fidelity Models for Superconducting Qubits
articles.title_zh: 基于边界条件建模约瑟夫森结：迈向超导量子比特的高保真模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13417v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Josephson junctions are the central nonlinear element of superconducting qubits, yet their standard description is reached through a chain of approximations. We propose a purely quantum-mechanical model of the junction, formulated directly in Hilbert space: a charged particle moves on a one-dimensional loop, and the junction is a point at which the wave function obeys self-adjoint boundary conditions, labelled by a coupling strength łambda, which controls the transparency of the junction, and a phase jump δ, which plays the role of the superconducting phase difference. For a loop with a single junction we solve the spectral problem and show that the ground-state momentum expectation, identified with the supercurrent, factorises exactly as łanglehatp₀ångle = I_c(δ,łambda)sinδ. For opaque junctions I_c becomes independent of δ and the first Josephson relation I=I_csinδ is recovered; for strongly attractive coupling, where the ground state is bound to the junction, the sinδ law is also recovered, but with an exponentially suppressed amplitude. For more transparent junctions, however, the model emphpredicts deviations from the pure sinδ law: I_c acquires a dependence on δ already at order łambda⁻², compatible with the higher Josephson harmonics recently found necessary to describe superconducting qubit spectra, and a fully transparent contact yields a current linear in δ. When the phase varies in time, a gauge transformation shows that the voltage drop across the junction is proportional to dotδ, so that the second Josephson relation emerges without being imposed. The boundary-condition approach thus reproduces both Josephson relations from first principles and predicts corrections to them, offering a route towards higher-fidelity models of superconducting qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 约瑟夫森结是超导量子比特的核心非线性元件，但其标准描述是通过一系列近似得到的。本文提出了一种纯粹的量子力学模型，直接在希尔伯特空间中构建，其中结被视为波函数服从自伴随边界条件的点。该模型揭示了基态动量期望（超电流）精确分解为I_c(δ,λ)sinδ。对于不透明结和强吸引耦合，恢复了第一约瑟夫森关系I=I_csinδ，但对于更透明的结，模型预测了与纯sinδ定律的偏差。
authors: Luis Bueno Blanco, Juan Manuel Pérez-Pardo

articles.title: Harmonic analysis and circuit approximation of Sobolev functions on quantum input spaces
articles.title_zh: 量子输入空间上Sobolev函数的调和分析与电路逼近
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13477v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We derive approximation rates for Sobolev functions defined on the complex unit sphere and complex projective space, representing quantum states, and on the special and projective unitary groups, representing quantum unitary operations. By using harmonic analysis on compact groups and compact homogeneous spaces, we characterize the corresponding Peter--Weyl decompositions and Sobolev spaces via irreducible representations and the Laplace--Beltrami operator. Combining spectral truncation with finite-depth quantum-circuit approximation, invoking the Solovay--Kitaev theorem, we establish quantitative rates that separate the spectral truncation error from the circuit approximation error.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文推导了定义在复单位球、复射影空间（代表量子态）以及特殊和射影酉群（代表量子酉操作）上的Sobolev函数的逼近率。通过在紧群和紧齐次空间上使用调和分析，作者利用不可约表示和Laplace-Beltrami算子表征了相应的Peter-Weyl分解和Sobolev空间。结合谱截断和有限深度量子电路逼近，并援引Solovay-Kitaev定理，建立了区分谱截断误差和电路逼近误差的量化速率。
authors: Philipp Schmocker

articles.title: Finite Quantum Engineering Thermodynamics
articles.title_zh: 有限量子工程热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13511v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A useful thermodynamic model predicts what a device will do without tracking its full microscopic state. For a finite quantum working medium, the difficult question is which quantities should actually be measured. We develop a task-based method that keeps exact energy accounting separate from calibrated macroscopic prediction. Operator geometry identifies what a measured record determines and bounds what remains uncertain. We then compare direct measurements of dynamical observables with earlier measurements of the same coarse record, selecting the representation together with its measurement cost. A Bose--Hubbard example yields a compact response table tested over a continuous operating region and on unseen microscopic trajectories. A driven Ising chain shows why history is not always the cheaper choice. The result is a way to turn detailed quantum dynamics into a small, reusable, and explicitly qualified thermodynamic description.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于任务的方法，用于有限量子工作介质的热力学建模。该方法将精确的能量核算与校准的宏观预测分离，并利用算符几何识别测量记录所确定的量并限制不确定性。通过玻色-哈伯德模型和驱动伊辛链的例子，该研究展示了如何将详细的量子动力学转化为紧凑、可重用且明确限定的热力学描述。
authors: Borhan Ahmadi

articles.title: Construction of isoscattering non-isospectral quantum graphs using the concept of a germ graph
articles.title_zh: 利用胚图概念构建等散射非等谱量子图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13512v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The recently developed concept of germ graphs (P. Kurasov it et al., Phys. Rev. Research bf 7, L022071 (2025)) is employed to construct families of isocattering, non-isospectral graphs that exhibit dissipation. More specifically, a new pair of isoscattering non-isospectral graphs is constructed by connecting the existing isoscattering non-isospectral graphs, so called attachments, to the different contact vertices of the germ graph. The existing isoscattering non-isospectral graphs contained a two-loop graph labelled ΓA₂ and a three-loop graph labelled ΓA₃. These graphs have an equal total metric length, but different topologies. The resulting graphs Γ₃ and Γ₄ are verified as non-isospectral using their Euler characteristics, while their isoscattering properties are investigated by calculating the one-port scattering matrices numerically.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用最近发展的胚图概念，构建了具有耗散特性的等散射非等谱量子图族。研究通过将现有等散射非等谱图（附件）连接到胚图的不同接触顶点，构建了一对新的等散射非等谱图。通过欧拉示性数验证了所得图的非等谱性，并通过数值计算单端口散射矩阵研究了它们的等散射特性。
authors: Omer Farooq, Michał Ławniczak, Leszek Sirko

articles.title: Correlation-Based Measurement of Entanglement in Rank-2 Mixed States
articles.title_zh: 基于关联的秩2混合态纠缠测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13579v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study correlation-based entanglement evaluation in rank-2 mixed states of two- and multi-qubit systems. The relevant two-dimensional subspace is treated as a logical qubit embedded in the physical Hilbert space, and factorizable realizations of its logical Pauli operators are classified. For two qubits, this yields nontrivial canonical encodings related by local Clifford transformations. The relation between logical and physical Bloch vectors admits a geometric interpretation as a transversely deformed Bloch sphere, leading to closed-form expressions for two-qubit concurrence and generalized concurrence across N-qubit bipartitions. The entanglement scaling factor is obtained directly from complementary-subsystem correlations, without prior calibration of state-preparation parameters. Noisy simulations using the IBM Quantum FakeKingston backend model, with readout-error mitigation and zero-noise extrapolation, confirm the analytical results up to N=10 qubits. The protocol therefore enables entanglement estimation from only a small number of measurement settings for this class of rank-2 logical states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了双量子比特和多量子比特系统中秩2混合态的基于关联的纠缠评估。研究将相关的二维子空间视为嵌入物理希尔伯特空间中的逻辑量子比特，并分类了其逻辑泡利算符的可分解实现。该方法无需预先校准态制备参数，直接从互补子系统关联中获得纠缠标度因子。通过噪声模拟验证了分析结果，表明该协议能以少量测量设置实现秩2逻辑态的纠缠估计。
authors: M. I. Samar, V. M. Tkachuk

articles.title: Encoding Matters: A Qubit-Efficient Reformulation for Quantum Resilient Routing
articles.title_zh: 编码至关重要：量子弹性路由的量子比特高效重构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13621v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Qubits are powerful computational resources because each additional qubit doubles the size of the accessible state space. This expressive power comes at a cost: adding qubits also increases circuit size, constraint overhead, and exposure to hardware noise. These limitations are especially critical for near-term quantum computers, making the number of qubits required to formulate a problem a central practical concern. In this work, we present a method for efficiently mapping logistics and routing problems onto qubits through structure-aware encoding reduction. We demonstrate the method on a benchmark problem of latency-resilient routing under dual-link failures. For this benchmark, the reduced formulation substantially lowers both the qubit count and the compiled circuit complexity while preserving the original optimization task. By running the reduced model on the same trapped-ion quantum computer as the benchmark, we obtain a 100X improvement in the success probability. This finding shows how careful problem formulation can make current quantum hardware substantially more effective for practical optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种通过结构感知编码约简，将物流和路由问题高效映射到量子比特的方法。该方法在双链路故障下的延迟弹性路由基准问题上进行了演示，显著降低了量子比特数量和编译电路复杂度。在相同的离子阱量子计算机上运行约简模型，成功概率提高了100倍，表明仔细的问题表述能显著提升当前量子硬件在实际优化中的效率。
authors: Emanuele G. Dalla Torre, Bat-El Friedman, Daniel Porat

articles.title: Operational signatures of exceptional quantum channels
articles.title_zh: 异常量子信道的操作特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13622v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exceptional points (EPs) are usually introduced as defective degeneracies of non-Hermitian Hamiltonians and, in fully open quantum dynamics, of Liouvillian generators. Here we formulate an operational theory of exceptional points that does not invoke a Hamiltonian or a master equation. The primitive dynamical object is a completely positive trace-preserving (CPTP) quantum channel Φ, applied an integer number n of times, while physical data are probabilities pₙmathbf A(x|h̊o) associated with states h̊o and observables mathbf A having measurements results x. We define exceptional channels through nontrivial Jordan chains of Φ and show that a Jordan block of order m generates discrete polynomial-exponential terms with maximal degree m-1. This places the physics of exceptional points in contact with what can be directly measured in experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种不依赖哈密顿量或主方程的异常点操作理论，将完全正迹保持（CPTP）量子信道Φ作为基本动力学对象。研究通过Φ的非平凡约当链定义异常信道，并证明m阶约当块会生成最大次数为m-1的离散多项式-指数项。这使得异常点的物理学与实验中可直接测量的量建立了联系。
authors: Paulo A. Brandão

articles.title: Finite-Size Limits of Adaptive Pauli Prediction
articles.title_zh: 自适应泡利预测的有限尺寸极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13652v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Can quantum data reliably answer questions chosen from earlier results? We prove that M adaptive Pauli predictions on n qubits require Ømega(sqrtminn,M) copies at fixed accuracy. Published upper bounds make this tight for Młe n. Thus n adaptive predictions cost Θ(sqrt n) copies, whereas a fixed list costs only O(łog n). The lower bound uses diagonal states and commuting observables, identifying a statistical cost of adaptation. We also quantify how this cost increases with precision.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了量子数据对基于先前结果选择的问题的可靠性。研究证明，对n个量子比特进行M次自适应泡利预测，在固定精度下需要Ω(sqrt(min(n,M)))个副本。当M≤n时，这与已发表的上限相符。因此，n次自适应预测需要Θ(sqrt(n))个副本，而固定列表仅需O(log(n))个副本，揭示了适应性的统计成本。
authors: Luofei Wang, Boyu Liu, Zihe Wang, Zhangqi Yin

articles.title: Diversity-Aware Ensemble of Quantum-Classical Models via Combinatorial Fusion
articles.title_zh: 基于组合融合的多样性感知量子-经典模型集成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13808v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Variational quantum circuits (VQCs) are highly sensitive to circuit architecture, yet most quantum machine learning pipelines select a single best design and discard the remaining candidates. This paper addresses whether the structural diversity across quantum circuit search spaces can be used to produce stronger predictions through model fusion. We apply Combinatorial Fusion Analysis (CFA), a model fusion framework that selects and combines multiple scoring systems using rank-score function (RSF) and cognitive diversity (CD), to a pool of 29 architecturally diverse classical models and quantum circuits. Using a diversity-aware model selection method, we identify subsets of maximally diverse models and combine them with both score and rank combination. Experiments on four binary classification benchmarks covering different domains demonstrate that CFA-based hybrid classical-quantum fusion consistently outperform the best individual model on every dataset considered with improvements up to 6.03% in accuracy. When comparing with relevant literatures, the CFA framework further achieves superior performance across all four datasets.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了利用量子电路搜索空间中的结构多样性来增强模型预测能力。研究将组合融合分析（CFA）框架应用于29个结构多样的经典模型和量子电路池，通过多样性感知模型选择方法识别并组合了最大多样性模型子集。在四个二元分类基准测试中，基于CFA的混合经典-量子融合始终优于最佳单一模型，准确率最高提升6.03%。
authors: Jingyan Xu, Yuanhong Wu, Samuel Yen-Chi Chen, Sean Patten, Christina Schweikert, D. Frank Hsu

articles.title: A Hardware-Native Trapped-Ion Hybrid Qudit-Oscillator Instruction Set
articles.title_zh: 一种硬件原生的离子阱混合量子数-振子指令集
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13843v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scaling trapped-ion processors by adding ions remains challenging. A complementary route exploits the multilevel internal structure of each ion to increase the computational Hilbert space per ion. We introduce a hardware-native hybrid qudit-oscillator instruction set for a general d-level internal register coupled to bosonic modes and prove that three of its native operation families suffice for universality of one qudit coupled to several modes. Adding an entangling operation between ions extends universality to a connected register of several qudits. The architecture natively supports both phase-space and sideband instruction sets and is implemented in the open-source framework HybridLane. As a representative application, we reproduce the dissipative vibronic dynamics of a three-chromophore complex previously simulated on a hybrid qubit-oscillator superconducting platform. Moving from a one-qubit-per-state register to a single qudit stores the entire electronic manifold in one ion, so every electronic coupling becomes a local intra-ion transition and the lab-frame Hamiltonian compiles directly into the ISA. Under the stated sequential timing model from a 40Ca+ qudit processor, one Trotter step is projected to run about ten times faster on the qudit, with an average RMSE of approximately 1.1 percent against the published reference.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种硬件原生的混合量子数-振子指令集，用于与玻色模式耦合的通用d能级内部寄存器。研究证明，其三种原生操作族足以实现一个量子数与多个模式耦合的普适性，并通过添加离子间的纠缠操作将普适性扩展到多个量子数的连接寄存器。该架构支持相空间和边带指令集，并在开源框架HybridLane中实现，成功复现了三色团复合物的耗散振动动力学。
authors: Masoud Hakimi Heris, Yuan Liu, Frank Mueller

articles.title: No advantage from classical assistance for energy-constrained bosonic dephasing channels
articles.title_zh: 能量受限玻色退相干信道中经典辅助无优势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13854v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We prove that four capacities of single-mode bosonic dephasing channels coincide under an average photon-number constraint: the unassisted quantum capacity, the unassisted private capacity, the two-way classically assisted quantum capacity, and the two-way public-classically assisted private capacity. The assistance may be interactive: the parties can exchange classical messages between channel uses and choose subsequent inputs based on earlier outcomes. For every finite value of the constraint, their common value is the coherent information optimized over Fock-diagonal input states satisfying the constraint. The proof uses a relative entropy comparison with the completely dephasing channel to derive chain rules for the Rains relative entropy and the relative entropy of entanglement. These chain rules give an upper bound on the rates achievable by adaptive protocols whose mean input photon number is constrained on average over all channel uses. We also show that both chain rules are attained by canonical purifications of finite-energy Fock-diagonal states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了在平均光子数约束下，单模玻色退相干信道的四种容量（无辅助量子容量、无辅助私有容量、双向经典辅助量子容量和双向公共经典辅助私有容量）是相同的。这些容量的共同值是满足约束的福克对角输入态上优化的相干信息。该证明利用相对熵与完全退相干信道的比较，推导了Rains相对熵和纠缠相对熵的链式法则，并表明这些链式法则可由有限能量福克对角态的规范纯化实现。
authors: Amir Arqand, Graeme Smith

articles.title: GPU-Based Parallel BP Decoding for Quantum LDPC Memory
articles.title_zh: 基于GPU的量子LDPC存储并行BP解码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13879v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) decoding requires reliable corrections and low latency over long syndrome histories. We extend BP-SF, an oscillation-guided belief-propagation (BP) decoder with independent syndrome-flip trials, by introducing windowed and streaming operations. Our CUDA implementation combines disordered-memory retries, sliding windows, correlation-aware graphs, and layered scheduling. Circuit-level simulations test fixed-basis memory and complete logical Pauli-frame recovery. On the [[144,12,12]] bivariate bicycle code at physical error rate p = 0.002, parallel BP-SF reduces 99.9th-percentile call latency by a factor of 13.15 relative to an eight-chain Relay-BP GPU baseline on 100,000 matched samples for which every tested method's initial BP stage fails within 80 iterations. Windowed BP-SF maintains a flat logical error rate and nearly constant per-round compute time through 512 rounds, reaching a 17.1-fold speedup over monolithic decoding. In 512-round full-frame streaming decoding with 2.97-ms syndrome arrivals, layered BP-SF on a transformed joint graph with 20 retries reduces 99.9th-percentile correction-release age from 166.29 to 36.25 ms relative to the joint graph with flooding updates and 100 retries. These results connect parallel BP post-processing to lower decoding costs and earlier correction release in streaming quantum memory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文扩展了BP-SF解码器，引入了窗口化和流式操作，以满足量子低密度奇偶校验（qLDPC）解码对可靠纠正和低延迟的需求。CUDA实现结合了无序内存重试、滑动窗口、关联感知图和分层调度。在[[144,12,12]]二元自行车码上，并行BP-SF将99.9%的调用延迟降低了13.15倍，窗口化BP-SF在512轮中保持平坦的逻辑错误率和接近恒定的每轮计算时间，实现了17.1倍的加速。
authors: Ming Wang, Yanbo Zhao, Ang Li, Frank Mueller

articles.title: Bicycle Race: small two-block codes on the Pareto frontier
articles.title_zh: 自行车竞赛：帕累托前沿上的小型两块码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13880v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-block group-algebra codes are among the simplest quantum LDPC codes, and many of them are translation invariant on a twisted torus, which suits neutral-atom arrays and other platforms with movable qubits. We ask how far they go at small sizes when searched systematically across all groups. To tackle this question, we use a series of algebraic constraints and screens to design a search pipeline capable of enumerating broad and complete swathes of two-block codes on a laptop. With it we census about 10⁸ two-block codes with up to 320 qubits at check weights five to nine. Several of these censuses are exhaustive, and support complete statements; for instance, the Gross code is, up to equivalence, the only abelian weight-six two-block code with n łe 200 to reach kd²/n=12, and the known [[64,18,8]] is the best two-block code by kd²/n across weights five to nine with n łe 94. The censuses are also large enough to give insights into where good codes live - they concentrate in a handful of groups; abelian groups give the best codes at small n and non-abelian groups at large n, with the crossover appearing to move out as the check weight grows; and high quality codes become 100 to 1000 times rarer per draw from weight six to weights eight and nine. Using the group algebra and the census data to steer a statistical search finds four to fifteen times as many good codes as uniform draws in equal time. Among the codes found are [[102,20,10]] and [[120,24,10]] at check weight nine, which we simulate in noisy syndrome-extraction circuits, and [[288,16,16]], the best weight-six two-block code with n łe 300. At check weights seven to nine, our best codes exceed the best published kd²/n with exact distance at the same check weight in most length bands up to 320 qubits. All codes are available in a public database.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统搜索了小型两块群代数量子LDPC码，以评估其在小尺寸下的性能。研究设计了一个搜索流程，枚举了多达320个量子比特、校验权重为五到九的约10⁸个两块码。结果表明，好的编码集中在少数几个群中，阿贝尔群在小n时提供最佳编码，而非阿贝尔群在大n时表现更优。
authors: Gideon Lee

articles.title: Quantum Query Complexity of Maximum Degree and its Generalizations
articles.title_zh: 最大度及其推广的量子查询复杂度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13906v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the quantum query complexity of several basic graph problems. 1) We prove a tight Θ(n³/²) bound for finding a maximum-out-degree vertex in an n-vertex tournament, resolving a conjecture of Mande, Paraashar, and Saurabh [FSTTCS'23]. 2) Using the same proof idea, we give a direct proof that finding a maximum-degree vertex in an n-vertex undirected graph requires Θ(n³/²) quantum queries, a bound implicit in the work of Apers and Lee [CCC'21]. Both lower bounds above hold even for computing only the maximum degree or maximum out-degree. 3) We also study Maximum (k,n-k)-Cut, which asks for the largest cut with one side of size k. For every constant k≥ 1, we give an O(n²⁻¹/⁽k⁺¹⁾)-query quantum algorithm. 4) We establish a reduction to Maximum (k,n-k)-Cut involving k-Graph Collision, which asks whether the marked vertices of a known graph contain a k-clique. For k≥ 3, this yields unconditional lower bounds with exponents strictly larger than 3/2, showing that this problem is strictly harder than computing maximum degree. Additionally, under a conjecture we propose for k-Graph Collision, the reduction yields a lower bound matching our upper bound above.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了几个基本图问题的量子查询复杂度。研究证明了在n顶点锦标赛中寻找最大出度顶点需要Θ(n³/²)的紧密界限，并直接证明了在n顶点无向图中寻找最大度顶点需要Θ(n³/²)的量子查询。此外，对于最大(k,n-k)-割问题，本文提出了一个O(n²⁻¹/⁽k⁺¹⁾)查询的量子算法，并建立了与k-图碰撞问题的归约，为k≥3的情况提供了严格大于3/2指数的无条件下界。
authors: Amin Shiraz Gilani, Nikhil S. Mande, Subhasree Patro, Nithish Raja

articles.title: A scalable sample-based quantum diagonalization solver for general Pauli-sum Hamiltonians
articles.title_zh: 可扩展的基于采样的通用泡利和哈密顿量量子对角化求解器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13907v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A scalable ground-state solver to be used in sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD) is presented. The solver is built on JAX API, and is intended to be run on GPU platforms and possibly many-GPU high-performance computing facilities. It is capable of subspace diagonalization in up to 2³⁰-dimensional subspace, with possible upgrades to enable even larger-scale operations. The two main components, a general-purpose eigensolver and an SQD-specific matrix-vector operation function, are described in detail. Efficiency of the eigensolver with respect to the GPU memory is demonstrated using a simple physics model. Furthermore, good strong scaling of the eigensolver in many-GPU environment is observed.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种用于基于采样的量子对角化（SQD）的可扩展基态求解器。该求解器基于JAX API构建，旨在GPU平台和多GPU高性能计算设施上运行，能够处理高达2³⁰维的子空间对角化。研究详细描述了其通用特征求解器和SQD特有的矩阵-向量操作函数，并展示了求解器在GPU内存效率和多GPU环境下的良好强扩展性。
authors: Yutaro Iiyama

articles.title: An entangling Hubbard quasiparticle collider on a digital quantum processor
articles.title_zh: 数字量子处理器上的纠缠哈伯德准粒子对撞机
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13946v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scattering of quasiparticles provides direct access to the interactions that govern strongly correlated systems. In this work, we realize the quasiparticle scattering experiment of the Fermi-Hubbard model on a digital quantum processor by colliding a doublon and a holon in the half-filled chain of 21 sites encoded on 42 qubits of the ibm_boston processor. For the first time, we measure the transmission probability of quasiparticles of the Hubbard model on quantum hardware, which agrees with the Bethe-ansatz scattering matrix without free parameters. Beyond the scattering probabilities, the collision generates entanglement by superposing the transmitted and reflected components, which we infer from the particle-number fluctuation. In sharp contrast, a control collision between two doublons shows neither the interaction dependence nor the number fluctuation, as expected for indistinguishable particles. Our work demonstrates that the ability to create quasiparticles of a chosen flavor on demand and program their motion and interactions makes a digital quantum processor a new experimental toolset for probing the entanglement structure generated by quasiparticle scattering.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在数字量子处理器上实现了费米-哈伯德模型的准粒子散射实验，通过在ibm_boston处理器上编码的21个位点（42个量子比特）的半满链中碰撞一个双子和空穴。研究首次在量子硬件上测量了哈伯德模型准粒子的传输概率，并发现其与Bethe-ansatz散射矩阵一致。此外，碰撞通过叠加透射和反射分量产生纠缠，这为利用数字量子处理器探索纠缠结构提供了新的实验工具。
authors: Chan Bin Bark, Hanbyul Kim, Yoonil Koo, SeungBeom Hong, Seik Pak, Kwang Jun Ahn, Sangmo Cheon, Youngseok Kim, Moon Jip Park

articles.title: Lieb-Robinson bounds for irreversible dynamics via adaptive Dyson expansion
articles.title_zh: 通过自适应戴森展开法研究不可逆动力学的Lieb-Robinson界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12731v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this note, we study a broad class of time-dependent and irreversible dynamics for quantum spin systems in both finite and infinite volume. We develop a simple and flexible strategy for expanding commutators of the form [A,τₛ,ₜ , B] in terms of self-avoiding paths of sets, where A and B are local operators and τₛ,ₜ is the Heisenberg time evolution. This adaptive Dyson expansion requires no backwards time evolution and is thus also applicable to irreversible dynamics. Furthermore, we discuss how such an expansion directly implies Lieb-Robinson bounds. A central feature of our result is that the obtained Lieb-Robinson bounds are independent of any Hamiltonian and dissipative on-site terms of the generator.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了有限和无限体积量子自旋系统中的一类广泛的时间依赖和不可逆动力学。研究开发了一种简单灵活的策略，通过自避路径展开形如[A,τₛ,ₜ , B]的对易子，该自适应戴森展开法无需逆向时间演化，因此也适用于不可逆动力学。结果表明，所获得的Lieb-Robinson界限独立于生成器的任何哈密顿量和耗散局域项。
authors: Carla Rubiliani, Marius Wesle, Tom Wessel

articles.title: Graphene double quantum dot as a solid-state two-level system in the THz range
articles.title_zh: 太赫兹范围内的石墨烯双量子点作为固态两能级系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13196v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Matter-based two-level quantum systems are fundamental building blocks of quantum technologies, underpinning applications in quantum computing, simulation, communication, and sensing. Today, most of these two-level quantum systems, including Rydberg atoms, trapped ions, superconducting circuits, molecules, and quantum dots, involve transition frequencies in microwave or optical domains. However, extending their transition frequency to the THz spectral range could provide numerous benefits, leveraging the unique properties of THz radiation. Here, we show that an hBN-encapsulated graphene double quantum dot realizes a two-level system with a transition frequency in the THz spectral range. Using low-temperature transport spectroscopy in the dark combined with modeling based on nonequilibrium Green's function formalism, we demonstrate the formation of an artificial molecule, featuring bonding and antibonding states separated by an energy of up to 0.6 meV, corresponding to a resonance frequency of 0.145 THz. This approach provides direct access to important parameters of open double quantum dot systems, including tunneling rates, offering a practical alternative to conventional techniques such as photon-assisted tunneling, which are challenging to implement at THz frequencies. The realized 2D-material-based THz two-level system, compatible with direct on-chip integration, could serve as a key building block for future THz quantum technologies. Furthermore, by involving a single-electron transition, coupling these devices to a THz resonator could enable the exploration of ultra-strong light-matter interactions at the fundamental limit of a single transition coupled to a single cavity, beyond the reach of existing THz quantum systems based on collective transitions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了hBN封装的石墨烯双量子点可以实现太赫兹（THz）频谱范围内的两能级系统。通过低温传输光谱学和非平衡格林函数形式的建模，研究证明了人工分子的形成，其键合态和反键合态之间的能量间隔高达0.6 meV，对应0.145 THz的共振频率。这种方法为开放双量子点系统的重要参数（包括隧穿速率）提供了直接访问途径。
authors: Alexis Wietzke, Solen Coeymans, Benjamin Hue, Simon Messelot, Aurelien Schmitt, Michael Rosticher, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Jerome Tignon, Sukhdeep Dhillon, Rebeca Ribeiro, Audrey Cottet, Matthieu Delbecq, Takis Kontos, Juliette Mangeney

articles.title: Second quantization and compactness of induced Gaussian quantum Markov semigroups
articles.title_zh: 诱导高斯量子马尔可夫半群的二次量子化与紧致性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13358v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We characterize compactness of the Hilbert-Schmidt semigroups induced by finite-mode Gaussian quantum Markov semigroups with a faithful normal invariant state. A unitary second-quantization representation for every  s -embedding shows that compactness at one positive time, compact resolvent, drift stability, and uniqueness of the normal invariant state are equivalent. These conditions imply immediate trace-class membership for all embeddings. We derive exact trace-norm and Hilbert--Schmidt norm formulas, an embedding-independent trace identity, and the generator spectrum with algebraic multiplicities. Examples show that compactness does not require the existence of a spectral gap and that a spectral gap need not imply compactness when the invariant state is not unique.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文刻画了由具有忠实正规不变态的有限模高斯量子马尔可夫半群诱导的希尔伯特-施密特半群的紧致性。研究表明，在某个正时间点的紧致性、紧致预解式、漂移稳定性以及正规不变态的唯一性是等价的。这些条件意味着所有嵌入都立即属于迹类，并且推导了精确的迹范数和希尔伯特-施密特范数公式。
authors: Zheng Li

articles.title: Replica Transition at Measurement-Altered Ising Criticality
articles.title_zh: 测量改变的伊辛临界性中的副本相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13802v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Performing measurements on gapless quantum ground states can give rise to new universal phenomena, whose origins remain poorly understood even for the paradigmatic Ising critical point. Replica methods offer a natural framework to study such post-measurement ensembles, with the replica limit Q→ 1 describing physical Born-averaged observables. Here we show that, for the monitored critical Ising chain, the replicated post-measurement ensemble of states itself undergoes a phase transition precisely at the physically relevant replica limit Q → 1, preventing standard replica treatments. We use boundary conformal field theory (BCFT) methods to explain the underlying mechanism of this transition. Our methods yield a perturbative analytic calculation of the universal O(1) constant in the Shannon entropy of the measurement record, previously known only numerically. We also apply our tools to study measurement-averaged spin correlators, providing a unified description of the universal properties of measurement outcomes and post-measurement states in the critical Ising chain.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在无能隙量子基态上进行测量所产生的普遍现象，特别是对于受监测的临界伊辛链。研究发现，在物理相关的副本极限Q→1处，复制的测量后态系综本身会经历一个相变，这阻碍了标准副本方法的应用。通过边界共形场理论（BCFT）方法，本文解释了这一相变的潜在机制，并对测量记录的香农熵中的O(1)常数进行了微扰解析计算。
authors: Kabir Khanna, Sara Murciano, Romain Vasseur

articles.title: QTestBench: A Test Framework for Evaluating LLM-Generated Quantum Code
articles.title_zh: QTestBench：一个评估LLM生成量子代码的测试框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.13811v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong results in classical code generation and are increasingly used to write the unit tests that safeguard that code. Whether they can do the same for quantum software is less clear, because quantum programs are probabilistic, depend on numerical tolerances, and are judged by domain-specific checkers, so a well-formed test can still disagree with the benchmark's verdict. Existing quantum benchmarks measure whether a model produces a correct solution, but not whether its tests can distinguish correct implementations from faulty ones. We introduce QTestBench, a framework that evaluates LLM-generated quantum test suites against independent benchmark checkers, never treating the tests themselves as ground truth. For each task, QTestBench prompts models to produce syntactic, semantic, and behavioral tests, injects candidate solutions at runtime, and compares each test verdict with the checker's label under three validation cohorts, each answering a distinct diagnostic question. We benchmark five LLMs on eight PennyLane QHack challenges and ten Qiskit HumanEval tasks. Generated suites almost always execute, but discrimination lags behind: the best generator reaches a test quality of 0.71 on QHack and 0.34 on Qiskit HumanEval, so executability alone overstates test quality. Oracle-verified synthetic mutants stabilize bug-detection estimates when natural faulty solutions are scarce, as on three of ten Qiskit tasks that yield none. QTestBench offers a reproducible, cross-framework benchmark for the trustworthiness of LLM-generated quantum tests.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了QTestBench，一个用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）生成的量子测试套件的框架。鉴于量子程序的概率性、对数值容差的依赖以及领域特定检查器的判断，现有量子基准无法有效评估LLM生成的测试。QTestBench通过将LLM生成的语法、语义和行为测试与独立的基准检查器进行比较，从而评估其区分正确和错误实现的能力。
authors: Meriem Terki, Nouhaila Innan, Minghao Shao, Muhammad Kashif, Alberto Marchisio, Muhammad Shafique

articles.title: Proof of a Universal Speed Limit on Fast Scrambling in Quantum Systems
articles.title_zh: 量子系统中快速信息扰乱的普适速度极限证明
articles.abstract: arXiv:2404.15403v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We prove that the time required for sustained information scrambling in any Hamiltonian quantum system is universally at least logarithmic in the entanglement entropy of scrambled states. This addresses two foundational problems in nonequilibrium quantum dynamics. (1) It sets the earliest possible time for the applicability of equilibrium statistical mechanics in a quantum system coupled to a bath at a finite temperature. (2) It proves a version of the fast scrambling conjecture, originally motivated in models associated with black holes, as a fundamental property of quantum mechanics itself. Our result builds on a refinement of the energy-time uncertainty principle in terms of the infinite temperature spectral form factor in quantum chaos. We generalize this formulation to arbitrary initial states of the bath, including finite temperature states, by mapping Hamiltonian dynamics with any initial state to nonunitary dynamics at infinite temperature. A regularized spectral form factor emerges naturally from this procedure, whose decay is universally constrained by analyticity in complex time. This establishes an exact speed limit on information scrambling by the most general quantum mechanical Hamiltonian, without any restrictions on locality or the nature of interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明了任何哈密顿量子系统中持续信息扰乱所需的时间普遍至少是对纠缠熵的对数函数。这一发现解决了非平衡量子动力学中的两个基础问题，即确定有限温度下平衡统计力学在量子系统中适用的最早时间，并证明了快速扰乱猜想的一个版本。该结果基于能量-时间不确定性原理的改进，并建立了信息扰乱的精确速度极限。
authors: Amit Vikram, Laura Shou, Victor Galitski

articles.title: Physics-inspired Generative AI models via real hardware-based noisy quantum diffusion
articles.title_zh: 基于真实硬件噪声量子扩散的物理启发式生成式AI模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.22193v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum Diffusion Models (QDMs) are an emerging paradigm in Generative AI that aims to use quantum properties to improve the performances of their classical counterparts. However, existing algorithms are not easily scalable due to the limitations of near-term quantum devices. Following our previous work on QDMs, here we propose and implement two physics-inspired protocols. In the first, we use the formalism of quantum stochastic walks, showing that a specific interplay of quantum and classical dynamics in the forward process produces statistically more robust models generating sets of MNIST images with lower Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) than using totally classical dynamics. In the second approach, we realize an algorithm to generate images by exploiting the intrinsic noise of real IBM quantum hardware with only four qubits. Our work could be a starting point to pave the way for new scenarios for large-scale algorithms in quantum Generative AI, where quantum noise is neither mitigated nor corrected, but instead exploited as a useful resource.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了并实现了两种物理启发式协议，用于通过真实硬件噪声量子扩散构建生成式AI模型。第一个协议利用量子随机游走形式，通过量子与经典动力学的特定相互作用，生成了统计上更鲁棒的MNIST图像集。第二个协议则利用仅四个量子比特的IBM量子硬件的固有噪声来生成图像。这项工作为利用量子噪声作为有用资源，开发大规模量子生成式AI算法开辟了新途径。
authors: Marco Parigi, Stefano Martina, Francesco Aldo Venturelli, Filippo Caruso

articles.title: Classical and Quantum Heuristics for the Binary Paint Shop Problem
articles.title_zh: 二进制喷漆车间问题的经典与量子启发式算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.15294v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Binary Paint Shop Problem (BPSP) is an mathsfAPX-hard optimisation problem arising in automotive manufacturing: given a sequence of 2n cars, comprising n distinct models each appearing twice, the task is to decide which of two colours to paint each car so that the two occurrences of each model are painted differently, while minimising consecutive colour swaps. Performance is measured by the paint swap ratio -- the average number of colour changes per car -- which directly affects production efficiency and cost. Prior work showed that the Quantum Approximate Optimisation Algorithm (QAOA) at depth p=7 achieves a ratio of 0.393, outperforming the then-best-known classical heuristic, Recursive Greedy, with a proven asymptotic expected ratio of 0.4 [Phys. Rev. A 104, 012403 (2021)]. More recently, the Recursive Star Greedy (RSG) heuristic was proposed with a conjectured expected ratio of 0.361. Here, we formally reduce BPSP to weighted MaxCut, yielding an exact Ising formulation, and benchmark two state-of-the-art low-depth QAOA variants -- eXpressive QAOA and Recursive QAOA -- at p=1 (denoted XQAOA₁ and RQAOA₁₎ against four classical BPSP heuristics. Across instances ranging from 2⁷ to 2¹² cars, XQAOA₁ achieves an average paint-swap ratio of 0.357; in our instance-wise benchmarks, it outperforms RQAOA₁ on almost all instances and each of the four classical baselines, including RSG, on every instance. Surprisingly, RQAOA₁ deteriorates with problem size despite employing provably near-optimal QAOA₁ parameters at each recursive step, eventually falling behind RSG at the largest sizes. To our knowledge, this is the first report of size-dependent performance degradation of RQAOA₁ at scale. In contrast, XQAOA₁ remains stable across all tested sizes, with no evidence of size-dependent degradation.
articles.abstract_zh: 二进制喷漆车间问题（BPSP）是一个汽车制造中的APX-hard优化问题，旨在最小化连续颜色交换。本文将BPSP正式归约为加权MaxCut问题，得到了精确的伊辛公式。研究将两种最先进的低深度QAOA变体（eXpressive QAOA和Recursive QAOA）与四种经典启发式算法进行了基准测试，为解决这一复杂的优化问题提供了新的视角。
authors: V Vijendran, Dax Enshan Koh, Ping Koy Lam, Syed M Assad

articles.title: Scalable and telecom single-erbium system with record-long room-temperature quantum coherence
articles.title_zh: 具有创纪录室温量子相干性的可扩展电信单铒系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.11879v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Achieving long-lived (μs-scale) quantum coherence at room temperature in the telecom C band remains a central unsolved challenge for solid-state quantum platforms, with coherence at this timescale previously demonstrated only under vacuum cryogenic conditions at temperatures over 600 times lower. To this end, we introduce a CMOS-compatible nanoengineering approach that deterministically controls the number of Er ions within a nanoscale volume and their electromagnetic environment using sub-5 nm silicon-based hollow nanopillars, which achieves the first deterministic spatial isolation of single erbium ions. This nanostructure-enabled isolation suppresses ion-ion interactions and local electromagnetic field noise, enabling single-erbium-ion operation under ambient conditions. The resulting individually addressable single-ion devices exhibit record room temperature optical coherence times of T2*= 32 μs and T2 > 100 μs in the telecom C-band. We further present the first demonstration of background-free, upconversion-enabled single photon emission from multilevel erbium qudits, providing high contrast coherent optical readout. Beyond these performance gains, our work, through sub-5-nm nanoscale engineering, establishes isolated single-ion environments as a viable route to room-temperature operation for solid-state quantum systems. This approach has the potential to address the long-standing barrier of room-temperature decoherence and open a manufacturable, telecom-compatible pathway toward scalable quantum networks, distributed sensing, and cryogenic-free quantum photonic integrated circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种CMOS兼容的纳米工程方法，通过使用亚5纳米硅基空心纳米柱，实现了单铒离子的确定性空间隔离。这种纳米结构隔离抑制了离子间相互作用和局部电磁场噪声，使得单铒离子能在环境条件下运行。由此产生的可单独寻址的单离子器件在电信C波段展现出创纪录的室温光学相干时间，T2*= 32 μs和T2 > 100 μs。
authors: Alex Kaloyeros, Natasha Tabassum, Spyros Gallis

articles.title: Quantum Approximate Optimization for Decoding of Low-Density Parity-Check Codes
articles.title_zh: 用于低密度奇偶校验码解码的量子近似优化算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.21124v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Decoding Low-Density Parity-Check (LDPC) codes is a fundamental problem in coding theory, and Belief Propagation (BP) is one of the most popular methods for LDPC code decoding. However, BP may encounter convergence issues and suboptimal performance, especially for short-length codes and in high-noise channels. The Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) is a type of Variational Quantum Algorithm (VQA) designed to solve combinatorial optimization problems by minimizing a problem-specific cost function. In this paper, we present a QAOA-based decoding framework for LDPC codes by formulating a decoding cost function that incorporates both parity-check constraints and soft channel reliability information. The resulting optimization problem is solved using QAOA to search for low-energy configurations corresponding to valid codewords. We test the proposed method through extensive numerical experiments and compare its performance with BP decoding. The experimental results demonstrate that the QAOA-based decoder achieves a higher probability of correctly recovering the transmitted codeword than BP across multiple experimental settings.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于量子近似优化算法（QAOA）的低密度奇偶校验（LDPC）码解码框架。该框架通过构建一个结合奇偶校验约束和软信道可靠性信息的解码成本函数，利用QAOA来寻找对应于有效码字的低能量配置。数值实验结果表明，与信念传播（BP）解码相比，QAOA解码器在多个实验设置下能以更高的概率正确恢复传输的码字。
authors: Krishnakanta Barik, Goutam Paul

articles.title: Operator dynamics in k-Markov random circuits
articles.title_zh: k-马尔可夫随机电路中的算符动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.18217v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We demonstrate that k-Markov sequences of unitary gates provide low-cost handles to manipulate the rate and structure of information spreading compared to traditional random, 0-Markov, circuits. For SWAP gates and brickwork circuits, we use graph cover time to demonstrate how k-Markov processes can be used to control operator transport. With SWAP gates and the set of Clifford gates that can change operator weight, we show how k-Markov sequences can be used to manipulate scrambling time and generate novel structures of spatial-temporal correlations across a qubit network. We show that k-Markov circuits constructed from PSWAP gates at fixed angle are equivalent to standard brickwork circuits with PSWAP angle drawn from non-uniform distributions generated by the k-Markov process. In those circuits, the time evolution of the average Hamming weight and the space-time correlation structure that remains after one-point quantities equilibrate again vary significantly from the 0-Markov case, depending on the transition probabilities of the process. More broadly, these results identify finite temporal memory as a control handle distinct from a circuit's degree of quantum chaos. For gate sets that fall short of volume-law scrambling, the equilibrium reached by one-point diagnostics is fixed by the gates alone, while the choice of k-Markov rule controls the approach to equilibrium and the structure of persistent, late-time correlations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，与传统随机（0-马尔可夫）电路相比，k-马尔可夫酉门序列能以低成本方式操控信息传播的速度和结构。通过SWAP门和Clifford门，作者展示了k-马尔可夫序列如何控制算符传输、操纵混淆时间并生成新颖的时空关联结构。研究还发现，k-马尔可夫电路在平均汉明权重和时空关联结构方面与0-马尔可夫情况存在显著差异，这取决于过程的跃迁概率。这些结果将有限时间记忆识别为一种独特的控制手段。
authors: Unnati Akhouri, Pei-Jun Huang, Elliott Rose, Sarah Shandera

articles.title: Mixed eigenstates in spin-boson systems with one-photon and two-photon interactions
articles.title_zh: 具有单光子和双光子相互作用的自旋-玻色子系统中的混合本征态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.05037v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Spin-boson systems have attracted increasing attention as accessible experimental platforms and for their potential applications in designing quantum technologies. One characteristic of these systems is the transition from regular to completely chaotic behavior when certain control parameters are varied. However, the characterization of their mixed phase space has not been thoroughly explored. In this work, we investigate the properties of mixed eigenstates in spin-boson systems, comparing one-photon interactions with two-photon interactions. We propose a generalized definition of the phase-space overlap index to identify genuine mixed eigenstates. Our study highlights the fundamental differences that arise when two-photon processes are considered compared to one-photon processes and provides complementary evidence supporting the validity of the principle of uniform semiclassical condensation of quasiprobability functions in spin-boson systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋-玻色子系统因其作为可访问的实验平台和在量子技术设计中的应用潜力而备受关注。本研究深入探讨了自旋-玻色子系统中混合本征态的性质，并比较了单光子和双光子相互作用下的差异。作者提出了一种广义的相空间重叠指数定义来识别真正的混合本征态。研究结果揭示了双光子过程与单光子过程相比所产生的根本性差异，并为自旋-玻色子系统中准概率函数均匀半经典凝聚原理的有效性提供了补充证据。
authors: David Villaseñor, Marko Robnik

articles.title: Borns Rule from Reversible Evolution and Irreversible Outcomes
articles.title_zh: 从可逆演化和不可逆结果推导玻恩定则
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.07418v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We show that the quadratic measure associated with the Born rule need not be introduced as an independent probabilistic postulate, but follows, under the stated structural and regularity assumptions, from the compatibility between reversible linear evolution and the formation of stable records. Physical processes alternate between reversible dynamics and episodes of record formation. Quantities that remain well defined throughout such processes must therefore admit a representation that remains consistent across both regimes. Prior to record formation, alternatives combine additively at the level of complex amplitudes, whereas successive record-forming distinctions admit a multiplicative representation through refinement. Requiring compatibility between these compositional structures constrains the admissible weight assignment to the family of weights proportional to the pth power of the amplitude magnitude. The finite-dimensional specialization of Lamperti's isometry theorem then singles out p = 2 as the unique value compatible with continuous reversible linear mixing while preserving total weight. The Born rule therefore emerges as the unique weight assignment compatible with reversible linear composition, multiplicative record refinement, phase invariance, and continuous reversible invariance, without invoking probabilistic assumptions or a specific interpretation of quantum measurement.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明，与玻恩定则相关的二次测度无需作为独立的概率公设引入，而是在特定结构和正则性假设下，从可逆线性演化与稳定记录形成之间的兼容性中自然导出。要求这些组合结构之间的兼容性，将允许的权重分配限制为与振幅幅度的p次方成比例的权重族。Lamperti等距定理的有限维特化进一步指出p=2是唯一与连续可逆线性混合兼容且保持总权重的值，从而玻恩定则得以涌现。
authors: Oskar Axelsson

articles.title: Adaptive Window Decoding based on Spatiotemporal Complementary Gap
articles.title_zh: 基于时空互补间隙的自适应窗口解码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.14637v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Real-time decoding plays a crucial role in practical fault-tolerant quantum computing. Window decoding, in which the decoding problem is divided into windows, is a promising approach. While reducing the window size is desirable for faster decoding, each window contains a buffer region whose size must typically be at least the code distance to avoid degrading the logical error rate, which limits how much the window can shrink. In this paper, we propose an adaptive decoding scheme in which window decoding is first performed with a small buffer size and a decoding confidence (soft information) is computed; if the confidence is low, the buffer size is enlarged and decoding is redone. This approach reduces the average decoding time, since most shots are decoded with a small buffer. A central challenge in realizing this scheme is that existing forms of soft information are not directly applicable to window decoding, especially with a small buffer. We address this challenge by introducing a new form of soft information, the spatiotemporal complementary gap, specifically designed for this setting. Numerical simulations demonstrate that the proposed scheme reduces the average buffer size by approximately 40% while maintaining the logical error rate. Beyond the reduction of average decoding time, the proposed method is also expected to contribute to reducing the reaction time for non-Clifford operations and relaxing the hardware requirements for real-time decoding.
articles.abstract_zh: 实时解码在容错量子计算中至关重要，其中窗口解码是一种有前景的方法。本文提出了一种自适应窗口解码方案，该方案首先使用小缓冲区进行解码并计算解码置信度。如果置信度较低，则增大缓冲区大小并重新解码，从而减少平均解码时间。为解决现有软信息不适用于小缓冲区窗口解码的挑战，作者引入了一种新的软信息形式——时空互补间隙。数值模拟结果验证了该方案的有效性。
authors: Moeto Mishima, Riki Toshio, Kaito Kishi, Jun Fujisaki, Hirotaka Oshima, Shintaro Sato, Keisuke Fujii

articles.title: Neutrino Telescope Event Classification on Quantum Computers
articles.title_zh: 量子计算机上的中微子望远镜事件分类
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.16530v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum computers represent a new computational paradigm with steadily improving hardware capabilities. In this article, we present the first study exploring how current quantum computers can be used to classify different neutrino event types observed in neutrino telescopes. We investigate two quantum machine learning approaches, Neural Projected Quantum Kernels (NPQKs) and Quantum Convolutional Neural Networks (QCNNs), and find that both achieve classification performance comparable to classical machine learning methods across a wide energy range. By introducing a moment-of-inertia-based encoding scheme and a novel preprocessing approach, we enable efficient and scalable learning with large neutrino astronomy datasets. Tested on both simulators and the IBM Strasbourg quantum processor, the NPQK achieves a testing accuracy near 80%, with robust results above 1 TeV and close agreement between simulation and hardware performance. A simulated QCNN achieves a ~70% accuracy over the same energy range. These results underscore the promise of quantum machine learning for neutrino astronomy, paving the way for future advances as quantum hardware matures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文首次探讨了如何利用当前量子计算机对中微子望远镜观测到的不同中微子事件类型进行分类。研究比较了神经投影量子核（NPQK）和量子卷积神经网络（QCNN）两种量子机器学习方法，发现它们在宽能量范围内均能达到与经典机器学习方法相当的分类性能。通过引入基于转动惯量的编码方案和新颖的预处理方法，实现了对大型中微子天文学数据集的高效可扩展学习。实验结果表明，NPQK在模拟器和IBM量子处理器上均取得了接近80%的测试准确率，QCNN也达到了约70%的准确率，这突显了量子机器学习在中微子天文学领域的巨大潜力。
authors: Pablo Rodriguez-Grasa, Pavel Zhelnin, Carlos A. Argüelles, Mikel Sanz

articles.title: Evolving Hybrid Quantum-Classical Architectures for Image Classification
articles.title_zh: 用于图像分类的演化混合量子-经典架构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.03220v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Hybrid quantum classical neural networks integrate parameterized quantum circuits (PQCs) with established deep learning architectures, but their performance depends strongly on the choice of quantum circuit architecture, a choice that remains largely manual. Most existing approaches rely on hand-designed or fixed circuit ansätze, requiring circuit structure, gate composition, and qubit connectivity to be specified in advance with no guarantee that they suit the task. This limitation is especially acute in image classification, where quantum circuits must transform features extracted by classical networks while remaining compact enough for practical training, requirements that generic, task-agnostic ansätze are unlikely to satisfy simultaneously. We extend EXAQC, an evolutionary framework for automated quantum circuit discovery, to image classification. EXAQC evolves PQCs as intermediate processing modules while retaining classical feature-extraction and prediction layers. On MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10, EXAQC achieves 98.42%, 90.62%, and 85.47% accuracy, respectively, while using comparable gate counts to other quantum architecture-search methods. Against classical networks, evolved hybrid models maintain comparable accuracy with substantially fewer trainable parameters, reaching 85.68% on CIFAR-10 with over 25× fewer parameters than a 10-layer CNN. Encoding choice also matters: rotation-based encodings (RX, RY, U3) outperform amplitude encoding by 22-25 points on CIFAR-10. These results demonstrate that automated circuit discovery yields compact quantum modules that can replace larger classical components in vision architectures while retaining competitive accuracy.
articles.abstract_zh: 混合量子-经典神经网络将参数化量子电路（PQCs）与深度学习架构相结合，但其性能高度依赖于量子电路架构的选择，而这通常是手动完成的。本文将EXAQC（一个用于自动化量子电路发现的演化框架）扩展到图像分类领域。EXAQC演化PQCs作为中间处理模块，同时保留经典的特征提取和预测层。在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10数据集上，EXAQC分别达到了98.42%、90.62%和85.47%的准确率，且门计数与其他量子方法相当。
authors: Devroop Kar, Daniel Krutz, Travis Desell

articles.title: Spinodal-controlled freeze-out and nucleation at the first-order superfluid-supersolid transition of a dipolar gas
articles.title_zh: 偶极气体一级超流-超固相变中的旋节线控制冻结与成核
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12511v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dipolar quantum gases in elongated traps become supersolid through a transition that is continuous at intermediate density but first order at low and high density; at the continuous point, ramps of the scattering length follow Kibble--Zurek scaling. We study ramps across the first-order superfluid--supersolid transition of ¹⁶⁴Dy in an infinite tube using the three-dimensional extended Gross--Pitaevskii equation with truncated-Wigner noise. With quantum noise only, the uniform superfluid survives the metastable window and transforms after its spinodal, where the roton softens. For onsets occurring during the linear ramp, the delay measured from this spinodal has a fitted exponent ζ = 0.36 ± 0.02, close to the continuous-transition result and the mean-field value 1/3.
